text: I'm actually not sure why I waited so long to review this place. I've had countless fancies here and they were and are always fresh and delicious. The staff is friendly, the place is clean and they're always coming out with new fun flavors as well as bringing back oldies.
I love their Boiled Seafood it is very good and well seasoned. Their service is fast and quick and I love their staff, they are so nice.

I am not really sure why this place gets such terrible reviews!  I have always had a good experience here and I have tried lots of dry cleaners in South Tampa!  The clothes have always been returned in pristine condition and actually look like they have been dry cleaned.  I cannot say that for other dry cleaners.  I have never had a broken button or zipper or any sort of damage [knocks on wood].  The clothes have always come back on time, although admittedly, I am never in a rush to get the clothes back.  They are always available when I pick them up several days later, although they do apparently have next day service.  Next, I can usually find a coupon for the dry cleaning, either online or in a local advertisement.  They have recently started offering "coins" where you occasionally get 20% once you have spent over a certain amount.  Next, the service has always been fabulous.  There's a clerk there by the name of Ms. Monica who is always super friendly and goes out of her way to assist me.  I am a fan of Quality Plus Cleaners.  I did deduct a point because, like one of the other reviewers indicated, the location is quite odd on the corner of two very busy streets and the parking is super limited and you are required to park in an odd diagonal manner.  It is hard getting out of the parking space too if someone else comes in and parks in front or behind you.  And, recently, it has been hotter than hades in the actual store, literally I would say close to 100 degrees.  It is honestly cooler OUTSIDE the store.  I assume the air is not working and I feel a little sorry for the clerks.  But, I am in and out, so these things are only mildly annoying.  I would recommend these folks.  I do not think you would be disappointed.

This is one of my favorite Italian restaurants to go to for pasta in Edmonton. 

I have tried several of the pasta dishes and the standout is "Fettuccini con Pollo" always mouth-wateringly delicious. I like that they take reservations for any night of the week for any time that you want (it is hard to find a place that will do that on a Friday or Saturday night anymore). 

The portion sizes are huge; I normally cannot finish a meal but I can usually get 3 meals out of my one pasta dish. I think the drinks are overpriced (even for the restaurant standard) and the bread they bring after ordering tastes store bought. The servers are hit and miss but I understand there is high turnaround with the service industry.

The scrumptious pasta dishes will keep me coming back for more every time.

3-4-1 happy hour is worthy it. 
Jazz bands are good 
Small place with backyard patio. 
Laid back so don't expect much but nice attitude and strong drinks

Beef brisket sandwich was excellent with spicy sauce and potato salad. Tender, moist, quality meat. It's piled with so much meat that there's no way you could pick it up and eat it like a sandwich. Yeah, that's my worst criticism. And no wifi.

Best concert venue that I have ever been to.! Great place, great music and awesome people!  I have fun whenever I go to The Rock, especially when Head P.E. came to town, the best concerts in Tucson happen at the Rock.  http://rocktucson.com/

But it's not always rock n roll or metal live music, they have all genres including rap artist, again local artists and touring artists and their entourage.  Seriously the best music venue in Tucson for an intimate close up live show from your favorite bands or groups.

Sound techs are great at what they do too and  I love being so close to the band's when they play, I really get into the music.  Thanks for being such a kick ass place to let out some steam or pent up energy.  I always have fun there and have seen many awesome local bands play and great touring ones, as mentioned before.  And most of the bands are there afterwards to meet the fans and selling merch of course, to fun their tours and whatnot.

https://www.facebook.com/rocktucson/events

https://twitter.com/TheRockinTucson

https://foursquare.com/v/the-rock/4b0586d1f964a520cd6f22e3

The Rock in Tucson also has a beer garden outside in a nice patio area with grilled good available which delicious.  My favorite is the grilled chicken breast sandwich, minus the bun!  It' so juicy and flavorful. They have grilled food to order available inside too, where the all ages

The best things to do in Tucson happen at The Rock so here is a link to buy tickets for upcoming events.http://www.songkick.com/venues/2415-rock

Surprisingly good for the burbs. unique items on the menu and extensive beer selection.  I would definitely come back here on a weeknight when I don't want to cook but don't want to eat bad food either.  DH had the mac and cheese with sausage and something else-it was so good, and I had the california burger which was cooked to perfection.  If you like fries-I would say they have amazing fries, fresh and hot-so delis.

I like this place way more than other similar chains. In both quality of product and service. The staff are very friendly and always have smile on their face which doubles the joy of having ice cream. Unlike some other places in which staff are like zombies, only to weigh your ice cream shot a number and discharge your account and hand you crap! Keep it up Tutti Frutti, stay unique!

The char-grilled oysters where delicious, drenched in butter, Cajun seasoning and served up on french bread. So good I had to come back again the next day! I also tried some of the New Orleans sampler not very impressed with the gumbo or jambalaya, red beans and rice were pretty good but def. go and have some oysters and abita.
Had a great time with friends and family tonight and want to give a big shout out to our servers Alex and Rolina. And a special thanks to Andy the chef. Thanks for a good night
We had a large crew driving through and couldn't have picked a better place for breakfast. Amazing food and service! We could not recommend it more!

My father in-law chose to have his birthday dinner at the Kimberton Inn. The place is beautiful, there's no denying that. As we walked in, I thought, "If this place is good, I'll bring visitors from out of town here if I want to impress them." 

I won't be doing that. 

My dinner was good. $30 lamb chops better be. The Caesar salad, however, was all dressing and a little lettuce on the side. The croutons were stale white bread. My husband's sun-dried tomato risotto was...in word: gross. It was not creamy like risotto should be, and these "sun-dried" tomatoes tasted like mushy diced tomatoes from a can. Everyone in our party had one bite and agreed.

Perhaps worse than my husband's meal: our waitress never came back to check on us, so he was never given the chance to send it back. We told the busboy and he said, "Oh."

To end on a good note, the cappuccino I had to wash down my bite of risotto was fantastic and smooth. It didn't even need sugar.

I give three stars because the service was lackluster. They weren't busy but the barista had an attitude, we just would not go back here.

We really only stopped by because it was so cold and to check out some Cash swag at the museum store.

Alright, so I am struggling with my review for this. So, I am going to go straight down the middle. 

I had a wonderful time when I went to see Phantom of the Opera. I had seen it before at the Jubilee back in 2006. There had been some changes since then. One of them being you can now bring your drinks into the theatre with you if you ask for the plastic cups(COOL!!). So, you don't have to down your drinks quickly. I, also, find that no matter where you sit in the theatre it's amazing. You can see and you will enjoy no matter what. I've sat on all levels and enjoyed every where I've sat. The only thing I wish, was the cushions on the seats were a little better and if the seats where a little higher up the back, like the movie theatre seats. 

So, I had this as a 5 star until I had spoken to a really great friend of mine who had the worst experience with customer service here. He was suppose to see Phantom and bought the season tickets for this. He had wonderful seats, and is the BIGGEST fan. We had discussed him going on a different day than I was and he was just ecstatic. Well, unfortunately, the date he thought he was going is this upcoming Sunday, and then he went to make sure his tickets were on ticketmaster and when he went to see, nothing was there. He did buy these 3 months ago, and I am not taking the blame off him at all... but he was suppose to see the show yesterday. Boo! He missed it. Well, he called everywhere and just the customer service he received from the Jubilee was horrendous. He asked if there was anything they could do for him and they said "not unless you pay for other tickets".... well I understand this, but why not fill the theatre (my opinion)... and then after explaining that he can't afford after buying the season tickets, he basically got a "too bad" and was hung up on.  I have been doing customer service long enough to know you do not hang up on anyone. At least try to be helpful, and explain everything, but do not hang up. Like I said, I don't replace his blame for not checking his tickets but I don't like hearing bad customer service when a little empathy goes a long way.

Residence Inn of Marriott is usually our place of choice to stay when we travel. However, this has been the worst RI choice we have ever experienced. First of all, there was construction going on because of a remodel which is okay but we were directly under the room where the actual construction was taking place and we had no warning! The bed was small and not comfy so please make sure you are getting at least a queen sized bed before checking in. Second, the maid service was less than average and the cleaning supplies was left in our room the entire time. On a good note, the front desk workers were really nice and hospitable. We were here for 3 nights and spent a lot of money. Very disappointed. We chose this place for their reputation of space and comfort and this is not the place!

I gave it a try on grand opening day with their free pizza coupon they so graciously handed out.  I had a good experience, the dinning area was clean, the wait wasn't that long and I love that you can watch your pizza being made right in front of you.  Definitely a great place for someone on the go and being in the heart of downtown.  They have a kids menu so I'll be back with the family and we will see what my princess thinks.

Dealing with customers isn't all that tough.  You start with, "How ya doin', can I help you find something?"  You don't stare at the customer and wait for them to initiate the conversation.  I have also noticed that it's worse in the summer at Menard's.  They have a lot of kids working that don't know a hammer from a pry bar working there.  Their prices seem to be a bit better, hence I sometimes do what I must to save a couple of bucks.
What a great find. On our way home from NY and found this restaurant on Yelp. Awesome eggplant sauce for dipping. Great waitress named Melanie. Check it out, you can go wrong.

One of my favorite go-to breakfast/lunch options. The bagels are good, but the real highlights are the custom schmears. Don't come here if you hate cream cheese. If you love cream cheese, you will love their schmears. They offer a perfect, generous ratio of cream cheese to top your bagel, and if you are lucky enough to have extra, it's phenomenal by the spoonful of spread on crackers. They have great options for sweet or savory! I like to get the veggie delight on a toasted whole wheat everything bagel or the stuffed French toast if I'm in a sweet mood. Bagel sandwiches are generally in the $5-7 range, and they are well worth it with the amount of toppings mixed into the schmear. Gluten free bagels are available! To top it off, Schmear It has very friendly staff and gives 5% of proceeds to local causes.

First time in NOLA and this place was recommended. Stopped here for dinner one night and ended up coming back a second time. Great jambalaya and gumbo. We also tried the etouffee, alligator and crawfish and all were good. Nice spot for dinner in the French Quarter but out of the craziness of Bourbon St.

After lunch in the French Quarter, we went looking for dessert when I remembered this place opened a couple months ago. It's owned by a nice Italian couple who recently moved to New Orleans, I believe. The space is super cute and bright, perfect for if you want to take instagram pictures! Their biscotti gelato is very good, sort of reminds me of birthday cake. They also sell other desserts as well as bagels (they say it's shipped in from New York!) and paninis, so I'd love to come back and try those next time.

Hit miss here some days hibachi is the thing to do Great show Great food, service is definitely to desired when using table service and ordering off menu.  Food is good and sushi is A Grade so if you don't mind the waiting and rude rush to get you out.  (No drink refills, xtra napkins, menu changes etc)
Excellent food and tons of choices. Everything I've tried here is good. Food comes out fast but tastes homemade.  One of my top lunch stops. Highly recommend it!

Went on a Thursday during their Happy Hour (half off apps and great drink prices) and had a great time! All the staff were so friendly and gave us some great recommendations and steered us through the menu as there are so many crazy yet tasty options. We got a bit intimidated by all the donut burgers going past, especially as the donuts were blue in support of the Tampa Bay lightning, so between the two of us we shared the Buffalo Cauliflower Popcorn, the Datchos, and an order of poke tacos. Everything was delicious and we had so much food! Paired the meal with refreshing elder-flower gin and tonics, which we both highly recommend!

Loved loved loved this hotel!! My hubby surprised me with a night stay here and he couldn't have done any better!!! Forst off it's right off of bourbon street! Which allows you to be close to everything!!!! Then the best part is the customer service! It was like staying at a friend's house for the weekend. I mean the type of friend that you can give them the key ao you wont lose it throughout the night. The type of friend that you can call in case you get lost or even too tipsy. Now for the hotel its self is awesome!! It stays true to its architectural era but still up held its comfort feel. We stayed in the honey moon suite so it had a wrap around balcony to die for. I would definitely stay here again. And don't let the fact that it's haunted stop you from staying here. I'm sensitive to these things and still I felt sooo comfortable,calm and relaxed that it was a second thought. My hubby dis good and from now on everywhere we stay from now on has to measure up...

The captain arrived on my tray along with some fresh fries. I knew then and there it will die in minutes. I proceeded to bite the first chunk. Yuuum. The captain: 4 patttys, american, mayo, ketchup,pickles and onion. Delicious simplicity at its finest. The fries were good too however I recommend they give 2 ketchup packs vs just one. All washed down with a cold Civil Life American Browne. What a meal. Get here asap. I highly recommend and will be back!

I found this location to be better than most of the Chipotle locations that I have been to. They have accommodated my requests in a friendly and accurate fashion. While there might have been some growing pains upon first opening, the place seems to be running well, and despite lines, they seem to move at a reasonable pace.

Staying in St. Louis for the next week for Urbana, so checking out the food options nearby. A few steps from Hyatt and Hilton at the Ballpark hotel, so its not too far. Food and portions were quite good, affordable prices (the price you'd expect for a diner, ~$10-20). Got the Italian sausage pasta and cheese lasagna with four friends and split it, so the bill in the end came up for around 24$ and we were all adequately satisfied. Service was a bit slow/spotty in getting our bills in the end, but understandable, as the place was busy. Would recommend!

Amazing. Just driving through Nashville and stopping for lunch. Multiple people recommended the pharmacy to us. It did not disappoint. I can only assume it gets its name from the hand crafted drinks, ice cream sodas in a variety of flavors. Any drink can have cbd added to it too. 

The menu is primarily burgers. I really thought it was unique to have different meat options within the burger toppings as well. I went for the stroganoff burger. So creamy and delicious with béchamel sauce and onion. You can also create your own. Burgers beyond your wildest dreams. Finish it off with a shake! Community style seating at long tables with small parties so you know

I went here with my wife for a nice dinner. The appetizer and salad/soup was good but there was a problem with my wife's entree. The bottom of the steak was charred/burnt. These things happen and it's understandable, what's more important is how the restaurant responds to an issue that's raised like this. Well this is where it was very disappointing. Basics of customer service recovery involve acknowledging a mistake and doing whatever you can to help resolve this. Well, they apologized, took the plate with half a steak away to the chef, then the chef came to apologize. No offer for a discount, no offer for a free meal on our next visit to make it up to us, no dessert, absolutely nothing. Unfortunately they really missed the mark here on both food quality but more importantly on customer service. Purportedly being trained with Disney quality customer service did not help them here. Very very disappointed, feel like I was robbed. If anyone at Atlantis reads this and wants to reach out feel free to. Need to coach the team on service recovery.

Up until a few weeks ago, this would be a "six star" review. The bar downstairs was our new favorite place in Nashville. The 3 stars here are purely for the environment. It used to have the best, creative, well made drinks rivaling any place like the Patterson House in Nashville. And the pork rind nachos were one of the most unique things in town to recommend. However that has now been removed from the menu (which I understand there will be changes of course.) But the most disappointing things is that they have changed their drinks to be more generic. Gone are the wonderfully creative mixology drinks full of flavor and character. All we are left with is generic drinks mad to look fancy but that you could get anywhere. Such a shame. Very sad.
Delicious food. Great to be able to sit and eat. Fast and friendly service. Jimmy Gs definitely is worth eating.

I used to love this place. Amazing crab cakes and great beer. However, I had a corporate happy hour here. We got placed at a table and ordered appetizers. When the food came we realized that there was only 1 plate of a dish that we asked for 2 plates of. The waiter put in the order. We then hear two waitresses in the kitchen (behind our table) make fun of us and call us idiots for not putting in 2 orders of this plate in the first place. This is unacceptable service.

If I could post a minus star, I would. When U-verse raised the monthly fee by about 75% a couple of months ago, I researched the various (other 2!) providers in the St. Louis County region. Based on reviews and services offered, I chose Direct TV. Major mistake! Have had the service for 2 months, and have continuous problems -- which Direct TV has graciously offered to fix for $99.00. No wonder more people are dropping cable (with it's 200+ crap for sale channels).  Find an alternative and please share it!

Nice staff, great location if going to the Fox to see a show. Used to be great food, very tasty. I think with the new management the quality of the food has gone way down. Everything was very bland for the price.  Have to find a new place to go now before seeing a show.

My husband brought home this food last night trying to fool me that it was from our regular sher e punjab. It was almost inedible for me and I was hungry and pregnant. The consistency of the tikka masala and veggie korma was akin to lumpy gravy that hadn't been stirred. The only distinction between the two dishes were the color and no recognizable chile flavors or other spices I'm used to from Indian cooking. The rice itself was chewy and slimy and yuck. We've been searching for a new Indian place as sher e Punjab has been really oily lately and all their flavors starting to melt into one but this was disgusting food and I'm angry my husband spent more than 5 dollars here. Sher e Punjab at least has some obvious color and spices used in their dishes and although recently oily are pretty consistent and incredibly economical. 
** also I used to come to Gandhi for the lunch buffet years ago, but after it never ever ever changed and always was similarly blanned.

Haven't dined in the restaurant, but we like their takeout. Delivery is convenient, especially since you can order online. They have a really wide variety of Chinese and Japanese fare, and great combos at good prices. My new favorite thing is their Japanese deluxe combo---a meat (chicken teriyaki), white rice, sushi roll, miso soup, ginger salad, and tempura veggies and shrimp for $14.00. Great value!
Excellent store! Everything is really fresh, employees are nice, and things are easy to find. So glad they put one in my neighborhood!

I always come here and the food is amazing! Light, quick, and tasty. Besides noodle soup, they have amazing spring rolls and really good sushi - type rolls that are made without rice and instead rolled in lettuce with glass noodles and other items inside. My description may be terrible and do no justice to the actual item, but trust me it is amazing. 

If you're in the uptown area and want a quick, delicious meal. Stop here!

This is my first time trying this restaurant and I have to say I am utterly impressed with the variety of food options and the taste of the food. I ordered the shrimp with red sauce and it came with rice, salad, fries and yummy ness. Not sure if you met us as a word that's the best way I can describe the flavor and the taste of this restaurant you definitely have to try this instead of your typical red lobster. The dishes are so creative and you get a lot for your money. My plate of food for dinner was only $15 and I have enough leftovers to last me a couple of days. It sounds silly but I like how patient the restaurant is as I was practicing my Spanish as well. Great flavor hidden gem.

This our new goto vegetarian spot in Nashville. It looks like it's going to be a weekend regular for us.

Had the alfredo tonight.  So good I had cognitive dissonance that it actually had no dairy. 

Loaded potatoes are delicious. A splash of cayenne garlic hot sauce really hits the spot. 

11:00am on the weekends seems to be the sweet spot between breakfast and lunch. Straight to a table with no waiting.   

Came for dinner today. The spaghetti and wheat balls were delicious.

Kimu is tucked in the stripmall wasteland that is America and is placed next to Yats which the Indy Hipster scene is so beholden to.  But fear not Kimu delivers!!  Since a lot of religious refugees from Myanmar came here you get the sense that it does cater to the Burmese community. And that is fine by me !!!

The staff is very friendly and the food was served quickly!! I love the pork Shan noodles and the lemongrass chicken was amazing! You really taste the authenticity in the flavor. It's as if someone's grandmother made it for them at home, yep I said it. I do recommend that you go at lunch time to save a little but the price itself is very reasonable.

I will going back to Kimu (hopefully soon) and I certainly hope that many of you try it as well. Because of Myanmar's geographic location their food is inspired by southeast and south Asian cuisine, just think what if Indian food got married to Thai food and had a child. Kimu gets a high recommendation!

Ripoff artists. They overcharge for everything, and don't really give a damn if your animal gets better. Go to Tampa Bay Veterinary Emergency if you want great service at a far better price. 20 cheaper for visit, 20 cheaper for the exact same anti nausea med.

An unassuming Italian restaurant located in a strip mall that went above expectations! Ambiance is very understated and has only a few tables available. They provide bread with an olive tapenade. We got the calamari appetizer, which is not fried calamari but grilled with vegetables. We also got the yellow fin tuna, which was a bit fishy. The entrees were great, with the lasagna special being our favorite! I usually avoid lasagna because it tends to get mushy and over cooked. This lasagna was firm and held together well, and tastes like a warm hug. We also tried a few other dishes which all tasted great. They also have an extensive wine selection. Surprised at how much I enjoyed this place being I'm a native NY/NJ where Italian food is abundant. Service was also amazing and would definitely come back again. 

Overall a great place if you're looking for a no-frills, low-key place with great, home cooked italian food.

My daughter came here recently with her friends and one of them ordered a glass of pinot noir and the waitress told her how much it was before she was surprised at the end, so even though we did not get a personal response, at least they listened. I went there today with friends and the spinach salad was delicious, the fried pickles were crispy and hot and the service excellent. My friends liked their chili and soup but we did not order any wine this time:) Thank you for figuring it out.

This nail salon is my favorite on the beach! It has been at this location for many years, under the same ownership! The proprietors are friendly and very focused on pleasing their clients. Everything is clean and tools are sterilized. I have been to other salons here on the beach, but they don't compare to Queen Nails! In addition to being reasonably priced, Queen Nails does an excellent job, be it a mani, pedi, fill-in,etc. For an extra $5, the warm oil "gloves" are divine and leave your hands feeling soft and rejuvenated!No matter the technician...The "Queen", her hubby or her Mom, you will love being pampered along with relaxing, spa-like music. This may not be the most elegant salon on the beach, but it is by far the best, in my opinion. My fill-ins hold up very nicely, time after time.Some of the other salons on the beach actually charge more if the period of time since your last appointment is more than 2 weeks!  I have recommended QN to a number of friends and they, like me, have made it their go-to nail salon. QN is located across the street from Mickey D's, in a tiny strip mall. Remember: They do not charge inflated "tourist" prices. QN is a gem!

3 stars only because the server was nice and friendly. The food however was disappointing. Two of us got a variety of eggs Benedict, and all the yolks were cooked solid. Flavor was lacking as well. I wanted to love this place after hearing such great things from so many people, and maybe it was an off day, but we were not impressed with the food. Also, the menu listed the coffee drinks at $3.00, and when the bill came our latte and cappuccino we're $4.00 each. I'm not going to cry over $2.00 but I think it's messed up to charge different prices than the menu lists. $45 later (before tip) for 4 overcooked eggs and 2 coffee drinks, definitely not worth it.

Parking garage located in the heart of the action. Very close to independence Hall and all of Philadelphia's big tourist attractions.

Garage is clean, secure, well maintained, with abundant spaces. Spaces are not overly tight. 

 Be sure to bring your ticket with you after you park. You will need it to get back into the garage and you will need to pay before exiting. This  is a good security measure, as it keeps the riff raff out of the garage.

Neighborhood is safe, well lit, and well populated. 

Prices are quite reasonable. I parked for many hours for a little over $20 on a Saturday. 24 hours for $24, which is a bargain. by many big city standards.

This is my go to parking garage whenever I go into downtown philadelphia.

First time for the schnitzel mit spaetzle and I was very disappointed.  The schnitzel was tender but the entire plate, meat, spaetzle and greens were soaked in grease, it was like someone loaded the plate and then poured the latent grease from the cooking pan on top of the meal.  It was terrible.  A couple of other reviews complimented the "sauce", sorry there is no such thing as sauce poured over a schnitzel and I spent five years in Germany in the Army, mushroom gravy (jaeger schnitzel) yes, but not cooking grease.  Nice selection of on-tap craft beers and my friends open beef sandwich looked and tasted great, but who taught them what a schnitzel is I wonder?

· Stale po-boy bread
· Hot sauce bottle had no lid
· Bare utencils set directly on table
· Never checked on us, not once. Had to flag down for everything, including the check.  
· Didnt explain food; was a sampler with very similar looking items
· $7 for half a cup of gumbo. 
· Restroom had no paper towels

Food was tolerable. Your standard Cajon fare; basically a tourist trap.
Extremely poor service n food. Avoid Kathi roll, Thali has only half naan n tasteless sabzia.Taste was poor. Arrghhh, bad start to the day
I did a walk in and it was a bit crowded..not a surprise however, considering the many positive reviews I read before coming. I received a gel pedicure and I love it. I will definitely be coming back

I was looking for a Christmas present so I made sure to test every section of the store to find the best gift. The security guard followed me the whole time and was staring at me like I was about to steal. It was sooo annoying to be trying on makeup and having a man stare you down.

Alright, I've been here many times because the wings are fantastic. The service here is outright horrible though. If you're in a rush or need to grab a bite to eat, don't come here. If you love wings and have time to enjoy a meal with a nice locally brewed beer, definitely come here. They have a great selection of sauces for the wings and they're all quite tasty.

They out do themselves EVERY time!!!
My all time favorite is their clam sauce pasta dish,  they never changed the original recipe, thank you,  but everything on the menu is the Best! Everything is fresh and always delicious!!!
Tonight we had the white spinach and tomato pizza...SOOO good! 
The new owners,  the staff, and can't forget the girls in the kitchen,  all SO great!!!
If you haven't been yet,  Go! If you haven't been in a while Go!!! 
You will NOT be disappointed!!!

Jay Fisher is the best bartender I have ever encountered in my entire life. His knowledge of drinks, liqueurs, and cocktails is second to none. Tasting's wine selection is incredible and please do yourself a favor and come for the unbelievable half priced bottles on Sunday, but trust me when I say that Jay is producing the best cocktails in Indianapolis.
The potstickers were sooo amazing & cheap. All good prices. Our favorite was the crunchy sushi! It all tastes so fresh and doesn't break the bank!

Wasn't impressed. Ordered large salmon bowl and large beef bowl. The beef bowl did not have any sesame, green onions or kimchi like the pictures. I think they ran out of things but just continued to serve entrees that way. I say this bc there was like literally barely any rice at the bottom of both bowls too. 
Nothing special about the salmon bowl, quite disappointing to be honest. Value of it definitely was not there. Paid $20 for just the salmon bowl, came out with noting but cheap lettuce, very little sparsely spread out rice and 2 pieces of salmon, each piece measured about 2"x5! 

Paid $33!!! 

I was pretty annoyed because not only was the restaurant empty when we ordered, we had to wait exactly 25 minutes for our food to be brought out. Now, would I have been that annoyed normally no but bc someone who came a good 10 minutes after us ordered and they were served their food first. Hard to miss in an empty place. I would suggest people be cognizant of that. Who wouldn't be annoyed?

The 2 stars was due to the worker being nice and polite. He gave us a little more rice. The taste is good but would we come back? Umh nahhh

What a fabulous restaurant! Our meal was outstanding, from the appetizers (local cornbread crusted okra, homemade sausages), to the whole yellow snapper, to a trio of amazing desserts. Our waiter Mike was exceptionally knowledgeable about cuisine and wines, and his enthusiasm was infectious.

I gave this place another chance last night hoping the shortcomings from last time were because I ordered a salad.  I really wanted to like this place considering it's generally in my neighborhood, so this time I ordered a burger and fries since I figured you can't really go wrong with that at a bar.  However, I was pretty disappointed, which sucks, considering the inside of the place feels like a really nice, friendly homey bar that would crank out great bar food.

For one, there's no hostess so it was a kind of guessing game as to if we should seat ourselves when walking in.  The service wasn't bad but it wasn't good either - kind of apathetic and no mention of specials or anything like that.  BF got the buffalo wings since last time we really enjoyed their chicken fingers in buffalo sauce. Wings were great and so is the sauce - kicking myself for not ordering that.

I ordered the burger that came with blue cheese, bacon and caramelized onions with fries on the side.  When the server brought it out, I was impressed with the sheer size of the burger, but the plate they gave me was the same size plate as my BF's appetizer wing plate and I had no room at all to place the burger down without making a royal mess.

As for the burger, it was cooked a perfect medium, there was tons of blue cheese and the bacon was crispy - the good flavors were all there.  But the "caramelized" onions were slimy, COLD and barely caramelized.  It was off-putting.  The lackluster bun completely disintegrated in my hands with all the toppings plus the lettuce and tomato, so that it became a mushy mess and I ended up eating just the meat since so much of the bun fell off.

The fries were the worst part.  On the plate, they looked so good.  But upon touching and eating them, I realized they were rubbery and underdone, soggy and laden with grease - not crispy, crunchy or salty at all.  Very disappointing.  If the fries were good, I could have given them the benefit of the doubt - but how do you screw up the most basic side ingredient?  

Daily drink specials seem decent and the menu is varied but I don't see myself returning any time soon except maybe ordering takeout for those wings.

This place amazed me!!
We just visited some family in Tucson, and this was our main outing. I truly can't wait to go back and visit again.
During the summer, they are open on Saturday evenings. We arrived around 7pm, so the cost was only $6 per person. The views were gorgeous, as the sun was setting. The views were actually so amazing that they look almost unreal... too perfect! A particular bonus was that we were here at the beginning of monsoon rain season, and the storms rolled in as the sun was going down. After it became dark, we stopped for some ice cream and watched the lightning show.
I am not from the area, nor from that desert, so all of the beautiful plant life was new to me. I took over 100 photos, including sunsets, vegetation, animals and family members. 
I would highly recommend visiting on a summer evening. However, they do close some of exhibits at 7pm, so you may want to arrive at 5 or 6. (I believe the reduced price was after 6pm.) We were unable to see the hummingbirds, and the other bird aviaries. Of course, this just means that we will have to return!

Stopped at this bakery while I was on my way to a meeting. I wanted to pick up something to enjoy with my coffee. Ran into the owner. I asked if he had a cream cheese frosted donut with cherry filling. He was surprised that I asked for a cherry filled donut and stated that he doesn't sell to many donuts and does not carry a variety as they would not sell well for him and instead offered me a cherry filled Danish. I took his advice and opted for the Danish. It had a cinnamon swirl and was garnished with a streusel topping and icing. Portion was huge; the Danish was big enough for two. The cherry filling was mediocre. What made the Danish memorable was its thick and rich glaze like icing. This bakery offered other assortments and seemed to even take cake/pie/pastry orders for the holidays and other occasions.

My Mom and I get our hair cut at Richard Nicholas. Together. Like, at the same time.  Which is a miracle. A blessed, most holy and unabashed miracle that no other salon could ever hope to replicate or live up to. It also means that I'll never be able to move away from Philadelphia....

Don't get me wrong, my Mom is the best, but she's also the same person who insisted I always wear something velvet to Christmas parties and bought me bright, white Keds as my go-to footwear all through grade school. Times have thankfully changed and she no longer wears holiday earrings that light-up or make noise, but we're not exactly simpatico on the fashion front. We also have different careers, interests and unfortunately, live in different countries. A couple of years ago, my Mom came back from a tour in the nether regions of a very third world country. Her hair was bedraggled at best. Conversely, my hair was a too short, layered mess that had been chopped into reluctant submission by many a subpar stylist. Joey tackled my uneven 'do and turned it into a easy-to-manage confection that was fashion forward but subtle. It also grew out like a dream. Joe (no 'y') gave my Mom a progressive cut and color advice that she could take with her on her next stint overseas. Getting the appts. was a breeze, we were seated quickly after a lovely hair wash/massage and treated like gold by the entire staff. Neither stylist expected us to know hair lingo or be able to describe exactly what we wanted but gave us uniquely suited cuts that made us both feel and look uber fab.  (In fact, I'm pretty sure I just babbled a string of adjectives at Joey during our consultation that went something like: I-want-sexy-fun-cool-hair-awesomeness-but-not-too-weird-or-difficult-because-I'm-lazy-in-the-morning-oh-who-am-I-kidding-I'm-lazy-all-the-time.  And somehow, he got it.) Since then, I look forward to going to R.N. for cuts and, as mawkish as it sounds, to hang out with my Mom when she's in town.

In conclusion, Richard Nicholas is a fantastic salon with talented, kind employees who never make me wear velvet anything and encourage my Mom not to either. Yay Richard Nicholas!

I had them do my install through Floor & Decor.  It took over a month to complete.  Inexperienced installers, it took several tries to get things right.  Workers NEVER put in an 8 hour day.  I went to Floor & Decor to complain, and they wouldn't give me the time of day to voice my concerns!  The owners even came out at my request to see their installers shotty work!  Now, I have a board that is loose.  I called them, three different times, left three messages over the course of a week, they WOULD NOT return my call!  I called a repair man via the internet, who looked at my problem, and said he can't fix it!!  So now what???  My suggestion?  DO NOT LET THEM DO YOUR INSTALL!  Use them at your own risk!!  Just look at the other reviews..........!

I always try to give them the benefit of the doubt BUT THEY ALWAYS MESS MY ORDER UP!!! I get a plain bengal with cream cheese and bacon AND ITS ALWAYS HARD AND COLD AND TASTE LIKE Onion!!! 




I even asked for it to not taste like onion!!! Still does it's so much weird flavors going on like they use the same knife for everything!!!

I can't say enough about the customer service at this shop.  I arrived in Philly with a plan to get my bike put together for the IMAC event and Margaret, Pat and Stanley took care of me pronto.  We had a miscue on the appointment schedule, but under the time constraint with my race, they took care of me right away. Stanley did an amazing job building my bike back better than it was before.  You guys rock!!! Thank you very much!

God, this place is overwhelming. Also, probably don't come here hungover, it's going to REALLY overwhelm you. Most places take only cash. They literally have EVERYTHING here but it's just too much. Also, why is it only indoors? Let's take this party outside. After walking around for 15 minutes unclear what to do, I finally just closed my eyes and picked a Rueben place. Sloppy Rueben with a side of potato salad. My bf closed his eyes and picked a cheesesteak place. Subpar cheesesteak with a bag of chips. It is what it is. Don't come here with expectations. Don't come here trying to find a SPECIFIC place either. People are everywhere, bumping into you, stepping on the back of your feet, crowding you. Just close your eyes, pick a place, and get the hell out of there.

Tace is actually a really tasty restaurant. I have been there several times and have brought clients. Every time I have had good food and service. The owner is very nice and goes over and beyond to make sure his customers are happy. 

I'm not sure why there are negative comments as I have not had a bad experience. I would like to see more customers there and more live music, but the quality of food is spot on.

The seating arrangement at this hole in the wall skewer/hot pot joint is barely functional with a total of 5 bar-stools and an L-shaped stainless steel dining counter. But the food, by jove blew our expectations and by far! Easily one of the most satisfying and memorable meals in Chinatown till date.

We understand that their business is mostly take out by nature but why wouldn't one want to eat delectable skewers hot off the grill or slurp a piping hot bowl of goodness if it meant waiting for some twenty odd minutes in a relatively cramped area. Trust us, it's worth it especially in cold weather. Such comfort factor! There were a few undergrad students from Drexel among the patrons for the night and we asked one of them about the fare and he replied that the food was very close to what one gets back home and is a great fix for a homesick palate. So there you have it folks! Your official seal of approval. 

As far as our meal selection for the night went, we ended up ordering two skewers at first (a rib-eye and a fish ball) and also a hot pot bowl to share between the two of us. 

For the hot pot bowl, one has to choose a minimum of $7s worth in selections that go into the bowl. Each selection ranging from $0.50 to $2 in price. We went with lotus root, white radish, ribeye, fish ball, wood ear mushroom and egg noodles to add up to the $7.

One also gets to choose a spice level while ordering the skewer or the hot pot bowl. We went with the "Very Spicy" level for both. We did get warned by the staff that the spice level we chose would knock our socks off but we decided to stick to our guns since both of us are chilli heads (and yes they did not lie one bit about the heat). The "Very Spicy" level is roughly equivalent to mixing a few generous tablespoons of a #10 Habanero Hot Sauce into the soup base. So make your selections with this reference in mind. At the end of the day, you will not be disappointed with whatever spice level you go with because the hot pot base by itself is so delicious and fragrant.

Coming to the skewers, they were charcoal grilled to perfection. So smoky, tender and succulent. We observed the chef as he worked his routine. He would grill the meat for a bit, then take the skewers off to baste the protein with a marinade, place them back on the grill a little longer, sprinkle some spice powders and then plate them out. After we scarfed down the two skewers and the hot pot contents, we could not resist the temptation of ordering another skewer so we went with the chef's special lamb skewer and that was our favorite grilled item for the night. Worth fighting a war over.

Highly recommend that you all try this gem of a restaurant on the outer perimeter of Philly's Chinatown.

I came all the way from NY to get a cheesesteak. I went to Geno's first and decided to come here. The sandwich was excellent. The motto is Don't Eat A Mistake. And they are correct. I should have went here first. But I am taking some sandwiches back to Ny for dinner.

Great food, interesting drink selection, and good selection of craft beers.
Not a huge place, so plan ahead.  Some of the best food in the area.

I went in to Purcell with my husband and got two new Michelin tires and rims for the front of our Class A 34' motorhome, as one of the rims had cracked in the weld and the wheel size had to be changed. We obviously arrived on a busy day, because we were there for nearly five hours total. 
The shop servicing large vehicles was dirty, untidy and complete chaos. Whilst we were waiting, we sat in the front waiting area, which was clean and pleasant, but switched to the rear waiting area after a while as there was a TV and chairs, instead of high stools. Unfortunately this waiting area was dirty and dingy. During this time a couple came in and emptied the cash in the candy machine. They "cleaned" it with the dirtiest and smelliest rag we had ever seen and a spray of something that made us cough and choke. They then refilled the machine. Please don't ever buy candy from this, as the germs must be horrendous! 
Finally we were advised our motorhome was ready, and that they advised weatherstripping be installed inside the wheel covers as the new rims were slightly smaller. 
A few days later my husband tried removing the nuts on the wheel covers but they would not budge. He called a friend to come and assist with it, but he was also unable to even move them a fraction. 
So this meant taking a second trip down to Purcell to get them to remove them, which they did with a breaker bar. This extra trip would not have been necessary if they hadn't overtightened the nuts. They are only supposed to be a little over hand tight. They should have been well aware of this. After all, how many vehicles do they deal with? 
My husband had to completely replace the nuts on the front wheel covers. They would not pay for the replaced wheel cover nuts. They were unapologetic and dismissive of our problem. We won't be going back!

This restaurant reminded us more of a West Los Angeles establishment. More modern ambiance and more hip than the normal New Orleans restaurants. This is not bad mind you, just different from say K Pauls or Court of Two Sisters. The food was really good and more of an Asian fusion cuisine. We liked it a lot. Try the pistachio
crusted  trigger fish, mild and served with a nice sauce over risotto. Service was a bit spotty but we were in no hurry. We will go there again next trip.

I've been here three times to sell and was turned away every time. Once was on October 29th, when I showed up 3 hours before closing and was told they couldn't take any buys because they were closing early "for Halloween" contrary to the hours posted on the website and store's Instagram. Two other times I'd show up over an hour before closing, and double checked on the store's Instagram to see when they would stop accepting buys, but was turned away anyway because they had too many buys from earlier in the day. Please keep consistent hours, hire some more staff and update the Instagram when you're closing early so you're not wasting your customers' time! I used to come here all the time to shop and sell but now I'll have to look elsewhere.

WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER!  I would not recommend this store to my worst enemy. We ordered our entire kitchen through them and it was a complete disaster. So many errors on their part and when you call they're rude and act like it's your fault. I was exchanging 2 cabinets and they told me i owed $900. Fully fought with me on the phone insisting I owed this amount. When I asked for a break down of pricing they refused. Called me back 10 minutes later apologizing because they did the math wrong and I owed $180. They make everything feel like your fault. They delivered the back panel for our island in the completely wrong color. I couldn't fit it in my car to exchange and they were going to take 2 weeks to deliver- my contractor had to drive 1.5 hrs to do the exchange. To say they're awful is a complete understatement. Run away. Never use them. For anything. Ever. I can't stress how awful they truly were
Ooooh each time I've gone here the food has been amazing and people have been so nice. Everything I've ever ordered has been delicious. And I live the atmosphere.

Such great food at this establishment! We crave their Thai chicken rice! The crab rangoons are so tasty! We get beef & chicken usually with some noodles. Never disappointed! Vegetarian options are so flavorful! We also got the fried vegetables they are so good! I appreciate their diligence to stay clean and keeping things disinfected.

Our first visit to Tupelo Honey was for Sunday Brunch, and we were not disappointed. Thankfully, we had reservations. The entry-area was overflowing with people waiting for a table, but we were seated immediately. That, in itself, is worthy of a great review!

Our server, Asia, was outstanding; friendly and efficient. She made us feel like her only customers, even though we saw her darting around the entire back of the restaurant, serving many other tables. 

Asia walked us thru the menu and highlighted the more popular dishes. The food was tasty, and we especially enjoyed the shrimp and grits. 

Tupelo Honey stands out among all the dining choices in Cool Springs. So glad to have this restaurant nearby!

When this theater opened up, it was wonderful, nice and clean....it has gone downhill from there. It is cheaper to go to the Cheesecake Factory and order a Kobe beef cheeseburger than it is to get the chicken tenders and fries meal at this theater. Ticket prices are okay, but there are cheaper places out there to go.

The main reason why I will not come back here is how the management handles those who use their cell phones in the theaters. The situation had occurred when I wanted to see a movie on my birthday and during the previews before the disney movie, some lady had her cell phone on and bright, which is a major distraction. She had been asked by moviegoers around her to turn it off/put it away, but was not doing it. I got up to inform management of this and when someone finally came in, she was hostile to them and myself. They took her out of the theater for five minutes, to only let her in after some sob story about taking her kids to the theater, and instead of sitting where she had been, she decided to sit behind me and would nastily jangle her keys every so often during the movie itself. After the movie had let out, she left before my family did and waited outside of the theater, glaring nastily at us and followed us. We complained to management, they said there was nothing that they could do, and we asked if security could escort /us/ out to the car because that lady had been joined by a few large friends of hers that were also glaring at us.

When I go to the movies, I want to be safe, especially with those news stories of shootings going on. The management failed in a big way, and so did AMC when I complained to them about that theater. I have found a theater that I like much better that doesn't charge an arm, a leg, and two pints of blood to have a drink.
Absolutely delicious! The food was amazing, the waiter was friendly and the ambiance was welcoming. We will definitely be back when we return to New Orleans!
Best oysters hands DOWN! Chargrilled Oysters aren't for sharing lol get an order for each person.

It can take years to find the perfect hair dresser. Look no more! Caitlin is amazing! I have been following her for a few years and she has landed at the fab eSalon. No fail I walk out looking like a rockstar every time. From cut to color, she listens to my ideas and incorporates her own to keep my hair looking like Hollywood fresh. ESalon is modern, clean, the stylists are up to date on style, convenient as you book online, they have great products- Kevin Murphy!and they offer tanning! Which I have yet to try. Overall I couldn't be happier. Caitlin will change your hair game!

Way great icecream ! Service was a cheerful young lady that would give great credit to any business.  I especially like the taste of the icecream Smooth and silky on ths tongue. Bring the family and enjoy!

I've received massages and facials at Essentias and have enjoyed all my experience. I really have to say they offer a tranquil environment for relaxation and pampering.  My son even had a haircut with Mary and he looked so handsome. Loved my experiences there!

Ok so haters need not apply to this place. 

The interior is completely lack luster but kind of sketchy awesome. We went at 8:00 pm on a Friday night me + wife + our 2 & 4 year old who are not good restauranters. We were the only ones there for the most part so children sitting down and playing cars and ponies was totally ok.

The food is above average Indian food and we saw three Indian families coming for pick up that has be a good sign! 

If you looking to be amazed perhaps go elsewhere but if you want veggies with basmati rice and you have kids this place is for you.

If you are vegan like we, you will love that they outline everything on the menu and will gladly tell you what is vegan at the buffet.
Sooo good!! Get the shrimp tortellini or the lobster ravioli. Delicious! Crab leg appetizer, amazing sauce. Friendly staff, delicious food, fun atmosphere.
They no longer have the buffet which is a better scenario. Excellent food, love the order at counter option.

It's nice and clean, they offer you drinks and they are polite. The place is really pretty but they over price you, I literally got a new set with gel nail polish with two lines on one of my fingers and it cost $45 and she told me she wasn't even gonna charge me for the two lines, imagine if she did it would of been $50 or more for something simple

I came here today to meet the kind and talented Joe Matteo, the salon fit me in on short notice which was great.  I got a full head of foil highlights, toner and blow out.  Joe is a great listener, very friendly and easy to talk to. I showed him photos of the color I was thinking of, he gave me his honest advice and a few hours later, I felt 10 times better than when I walked in.  I definitely felt relaxed getting my hair done, especially because Joe was very friendly and I knew I was in good hands. The highlights are very natural, a dark blonde/light caramel brown and they look beautiful!  I am very happy with the highlights and Joe is very down to earth and sweet, he communicated with me every step of the way.  I'm thrilled to have found a great colorist, I'll be back for more foils in 6-8 weeks, hopefully a cut soon too. All of the staff at Richard Nicholas are very kind, it was a great experience from assistants getting me fresh water, a new towel and a great blowout!  I also greatly appreciated the receptionist and assistant complimenting me on my new 'do!  Joe and the other staff at RN are wonderful!
Great vegan spot outside of the French quarters. We went for breakfast and it did not disappoint.

This was by far one of the best presents I've ever sent to someone.  Forget flowers.....a singing telegram is the way to do it.  My 85 year old aunt LOVED her "Classic Bell Hop" singing telegram.  My aunt said Kim had a beautiful voice and that this gift was so special that it brought her to tears - good tears.  Planning and booking this was so simple because Chris was very helpful and professional.  We corresponded by e-mail before and after the telegram was delivered and it was a pleasure doing business with them.  I highly recommend Classic Singing Telegram to anyone looking for an extra special present.  And, by the way, the prices are very reasonable.  I will definitely be using this company again as well as telling everyone about them.
This is the only pizza I eat these days. The spicy soprasetta pizza hit the spot for me. Its indeed spicy and very tasty.

machines are rigged! used to be able to get a lot of free spins with good pay out. but now its super hard to get free spins and when you finally do the machines dont pay out! they are always fixing, updating, or adding something so i guess they are rigging the machines to make up for the cost! i know its called gambling but this casino sucks and its rigged
Great soup dumplings and chive dumplings! We always order from Dim Sum Garden when we want good dumplings.
My husband and I ate here and we loved it so much! The food was delicious and perfect portion. The drinks were yummy and ice cold. The strawberry rhubarb pie is the best ever!

Wasn't impressed by the drinks or service. I stopped in an hour and a half before close to meet up with someone until they closed. I felt pressured when I was ordering. I was asking a lot of questions because I'm picky when it comes to my drinks. I don't like them sweetened, a certain kind of milk etc. the girl behind the counter seemed annoyed. I went with a steeped chai tea latte and she said it wasn't sweetened but when I received my drink it was too sweet and she said they sweeten it with brown sugar. Annoyed that I paid $5 for something I wouldn't drink any more of I asked to return it for a regular tea. The girl continued to be rude and act annoyed and gave me my tea without offering me my money back for the difference. There are definitely better coffee shops around and I probably won't be returning here.

The full package.  Went during restaurant week.  Excellent ambience, superb service, great food.  I had the filet mignon.  On par with capital grille as the best steakhouse in Philly.  Cant wait to try the porterhouse next time. Dessert was one of the highlights.  Caramel pudding and pear sorbet were exquisite.

I like Mexican food, and have tried many restaurants of that type here in Reno.  Like many people, I have sort of homed in on one particular dish as a benchmark for comparing restaurants.  In my case, the dish is Carne Asada.  At the Sparks Coffee Shop. Their. Carne Asada breakfast is the best. The eggs are perfectly cooked, it comes with nice home fries and great beans with chorizo. But the meat is the star. Really large quantity of the best tasting marinated flap steak I've ever had anywhere. You've gotta try it.
Staff is friendly and very knowledgeable about coffee.  We both got the "Bruce Lee" breakfast sandwich which came with mango.  I will definitely go back & try some others. Coffee is always good.

This place may have the best calzone in America. I would have expected that honor to go to a place in Philly or NYC - but nope - this little hole in the wall in NOLA is my clear calzone champ.

If you're looking for a local dive (I mean that affectionately) with great food, this is your place. It ain't pretty, it ain't big, but damn it is good. 

We walked in there at 2:00am after arriving from an extremely late flight. 
Let me say this - the staff were busting their butts getting delivery and take out orders out the door. It's admirable to see folks working that hard, especially that late at night. Good job y'all! I noticed and was impressed.

If you're COVID cautious and want to eat somewhere with distance or nice outdoor seating then this is not your place. Make your order to go and enjoy it in your near by hotel. 

Thanks for a great first meal for our NOLA trip, and for helping a rough travel day end on a high note.

Ok, I went back in recently and I get covid19 is tough and these folks are awesome for being open. One small request, I got the italian sandwich and it barely had any meat on it compared to before. Not sure if times are tough but please make the sandwiches worth the money.  Otherwise, awesomeness all around for this establishment.

I would give this restaurant 3 stars. I had high expectations going in here, because of the reviews on yelp. I ordered a deep fried meatball sandwich and a root beer. I thought the root beer was the best part of the meal and was absolutely fantastic. The sandwich was good, not great. I didn't like the coleslaw on it and thought it should have been served plain or with another type of sauce. The bread was so hard that it was nearly inedible and I ended up just eating the meat with a fork instead. Also, there was a small hair in one of my meatballs so I ended up not eating anymore after finding that. The group that I went with had mixed reviews on the free sides. The spicy chili was decent but very hot! Cornbread was hard. The biggest disappointment was the bread pudding. I normally love bread pudding but what they served made me nauseous. One helper described it as being like warm snot and I think that is an accurate description. It was terrible and I wish I would've not ordered it. I do think this is a unique restaurant though.

OK Barbecue place.  The chicken was good, and worth getting.  The barbecue pork was a little dry, but was helped by their good sauce.  Veggies were OK and went well with the plate. I was disappointed that they did not offer Brunswick stew.  That seems strange for a barbecue place.  Worth a try if you are in the area and in the mood for  barbecue. Rustic (as it should be). A little slow, but they have nice employees so you really don't care.
Every now & then I go back, but do not repeat the visit anytime soon.  Food is okay; nothing special.  It's essentially a bar which happened to add a food area.  Too noisy for me.

The place to go for great Greek food and fantastic service.  Located across from the docks in Tarpon Springs.  We all ordered the Lamb K-Bab plates and a Greek salad, which were excellent.  We had one of the nicest servers we've ever had in any restaurant.  Their bakery has an unbelievable variety of items. You can go crazy trying to decide on what to order.

Really nice staff. Had the room next to us having a party at 3 am. Front desk had it handled within five minutes. Super nice lady working. I stayed here about eight years ago when it was in nicer condition. I'm under the impression that these are newer owners. The hotel has definitely seen better days. I know it's expensive to update a hotel, but it's in definite need of some work. I found a chicken tender under my nightstand. So housekeeping does not seem to be a strength. Furniture is run down looking. Could do with being aired out.

What an awesome group of people to buy from. They made it happen from Travis F. to John the General Manager to Tony F. in Sales . In a very short time, I might add.. I walked out with a new Civic LX. 
Thank you and here's to all of you 10 plus!!

It is a modest restaurant that my family and I just popped into. It was very quiet, and not many people were there. The waiter was very nice, and the appetizers were superb. I've never eaten a tortilla that tastes just like a perfectly-buttered biscuit before today. The entrees were delicious and there was plenty to take home for later enjoyment. We plan on returning very soon.

Awesome establishment. Very clean, neatly organized store, great atmosphere. Staff was friendly. I ordered the California Dream pitaya bowl with gluten-free granola. They forgot about my order so I went back up to the register after about 10 min and they apologized and made it quickly for me. They also gave me a free bowl coupon to use in the future. That definitely made up for the long wait. The pitaya bowl was fresh and delicious!Overall I would recommend!

TL;DR - A beautiful building with great facilities but an administration/management that will frustrate you to no end so consider that heavily before signing a lease here. 

I don't typically write reviews but I was compelled to write this one due to my extremely poor living experience here this past year solely due to the admin/management personnel of Hanover North Broad. As I'm sure you can see from the pictures, all of the facilities are extremely nice: spacious layouts, modern finishes, etc. However, despite all of that my overall experience here was soured because of the administrative staff. The people that initially helped me sign my lease were fantastic: attentive, friendly, and would go the extra mile for their tenants. However, they regularly replace their staff thus their tenure was short-lived and their replacements (Jay, Brandon, & Ian) were an extreme disappointment. They were extremely unresponsive, lazy, and often times would appear annoyed at the simplest of requests. Here are some of the examples of situations we dealt with under this staff:

- No one answering the phone during business hours (would always forward to off-site secretary) despite physically seeing them in their offices not actively doing anything

- Significant delays for completion of routine maintenance requests (one of such was leak from shower which caused water damage to carpeting in nearby closet, which still took a week to address)

- Losing packages/mail of significant value despite someone in admin physically signing for said mail but unable to find my personal mail/packages upon request

- A homeless man was found to be squatting in the staircase of East Building during the initial part of my year there and numerous complaints were made about safety concerns but it took management over 2 weeks to address issue

- East Building Gate leading to garage and front door of East building wouldn't adequately close thus anyone could access apartments freely from outside. Took over a month for this to be adequately addressed (at the same time homeless person above was squatting, worsening our safety concerns)

- Although paying for parking at the facility, when an inadvertent ticket was gotten on my car, Hanover wouldn't adequately communicate that with the Parkway Parking group. This negligence led to them putting a Barnacle (windshield boot) on my car which was a hassle to get off and extremely frustrating. 

- On top of all this, upon moving out, despite hiring cleaners to clean our apartment this same negligent staff then tried to shake us down with insane charges for what would've normally been considered routine wear and tear. 

Even my movers upon moving out echoed similar concerns they had heard from others about the administration here (great building, negligent staff). I truly did consider living here another year but the frustrations from the admin were far too many to consider putting up with for even another month. What I've seen from the management at my current building in just under two months is leagues ahead of what I witnessed at Hanover.

This place is ALWAYS missing something when I get food delivered from them via UberEats.  The food is not good enough for this to happen consistently.

Update:  Tried one more time so I'll explain more.  First discovered on UberEats. Was so excited at the prospect of not having to leave home and have good food for me and the boyfriend.  First order was great. Everything included. But with the subsequent orders, things were missing.  It was usually wiz or side sauce...an order of fries once...no big deal.  According my UberEats app, I ordered 21 times since January.  I was a dedicated customer.  My last order was the last straw, they forgot to include a sandwich!!  My sandwich!!!  No more!  And when I called to say something, they blamed UberEats.  The delivery person just picks up the bag.  Lame excuse!  The food is good.  The service is THE WORST.

The space is small and narrow but very inviting - rustic but simple and well lit. The staff was incredibly friendly during my first visit, patiently answering my questions, and continued to be so on my second visit when I brought a friend. Their drip coffee was tasty as I needed an afternoon pick me up. My friend enjoyed her cappuccino. They take credit card and have seating not only in the front but also in the back. I would come here to read or work if I lived in the area!

This is by far my favorite Mexican place in the area!!!!! The food is so delicious and reasonably priced. The staff is great, too! I always get served by a friendly face. I haven't had many dishes because I'm obsessed with the chicken and cheese flautas, but my boyfriend tries to get new things and he's never disappointed. Most people pass right bc it used to be a Pizza Hut & I'll admit, having gone there a ton as a kid, it still has the vibe!! But the food is so worth it.

I live a few miles away, yet only came here for the first time last night. Man, do I feel like I've been missing out! Enjoyed a glass of wine during their happy hour with $5 glasses of wine ($6 for Lux) and other discounted specialty drinks (Monday -  Friday, 4-6pm). The hostess and waitress were both knowledgeable and friendly. Unfortunately we had dinner reservations at a different restaurant later that evening, but the Full Dinner Menu and Happy Hour menu were enticing. Will be back to try more!

Absolutely a terrible dealer. We scheduled an appointment two days ahead to check an Audi A3 they have, and we got the confirmation call from this dealer one day ahead. We promised we will be there. However, when I drove 40 minutes to there, the salesman told us, the car brought to Audi dealer for the maintenance, and he tried to text us but didn't get responded. I checked the number and found out he texted to a WRONG NUMBER! I was like... wait... your front desk can call me, but you can't record my number??? Since we don't want to waste time, we negotiated the price, but the salesman said, we have to buy their Warranty with the car. EXCUSE ME? We are buying an Audi not a Hyundai! Why should I service my Audi in your store??? It is totally waste our time!!!! The service is super UNPROFESSIONAL!!!

One or two vegan options. The waitress seemed annoyed by the questions we asked. Too pricy,  it was legit mediocre food. Corn were hard and so were the black beans.  Lets not talk about the Jasmine Rice. Everything on my plate tasted as if it was literally microwaved. No taste whatsoever. I honestly rated a one because of this. Upscale my behind.  Cauliflower steak was alright,and it is something that I would do at home. Beautiful restaurant and beautiful designs, but it lacked in food options and taste. Fancy restaurant with no fancy foods.
Love the clam chowder soup. Love the oyster. Fresh and delicious! Brought my friend here and she fell in love with the oyster when she tried it for the first time..

Shop here if you don't mind buying defective products that you are unable to get a refund on. 

We discovered this cute little shop while wandering around the French Quarter.   They had a fun pair of shoes on the mannequin outside the clothing shop next door (with the same owners).  I purchased a pair of unique shoes (that they only had one pair of in each size).  I am used to shopping in reputable stores that treat customers fairly, so I concerned myself with how the shoes looked and felt and I didn't look for defects.  
After I got back to my hotel room, I discovered that there was a big stain on the heel.  (It looked like glue that had soaked through the fabric.)  I took the unworn shoes and the receipts back to the store and pointed out the defect.  The sales clerk offered us an exchange within the store, but the same shoes weren't available in my size.  I requested a refund.  He pointed to the sign by the register and said that most stores in The Quarter don't give refunds.  
When we protested, the clerk indicated to us that because he usually shops in thrift stores, he finds it completely acceptable to purchase clothing that is stained and/or defective.  This store is NOT charging thrift store prices, so I do NOT find stains or defects in the merchandise acceptable.
During day Sabrina is a awesome waitress. Night time it's all about the locals. Overall great cheap food and happy hour isn't to bad.

I highly recommend Carl! Superb service, on time, quality service and very satisfied with the mounting of televisions.  He has done two sets in my home will be back to do the third set next week. 5 star service.
Tom M.  Largo, Fl.

I've been back twice since my original review.  That alone ought to tell you something.  Both times I had lunch out on the private courtyard/patio.  I am never going back inside if the weather allows!

Both times Stephanie was my waitress.  Both times she was fabulous.  She even let me live down pouring my beer into a candle holder (I thought it was just a weird shaped glass!) the last time.

Neither my guests or I have had a bad meal yet.  I look forward to the next visit.  See you in the courtyard!

Etch is an incredible restaurant tucked away in downtown Nashville.  Went here for a lunch on a day date from a recommendation of a friend and this place did not disappoint!!

Me and my wife split the Etch salad (so good) and had the Argentinian beef tenderloin and Indian chicken as our meals.  Both were phenomenal choices and the food was amazing!!  This place was hoping for lunch and we will definitely come back for dinner - one of our favs now in Nashville.

Absolute worst parts and service department ever!  I purchased a part from this company that is DEFECTIVE and they refuse to let me return it. These guys are a bunch of con artists. They sell parts on eBay as well!  They suck!

I went to this Walmart recently and the outside parking lot was absolutely disgusting.  There was so much garbage everywhere and it grossed me out!!  It was like dodging landmines on the way in.    I felt like I didn't even want to buy food from here.  I just went in and bought what I needed and got out of there.   But...not before having to witness a full on fight between customers in line, which by the way, is the 2nd time I witnessed fighting between customers at this Walmart.  I don't know...this Walmart is just really dirty.   You know...1st  impressions say alot about the experience you are about to have at this Wal-Mart, and that disgusting parking lot speaks volumes!!

My sweet baby cousin treated me to dinner and it ended up, unfortunately, being just an okay meal. We had spicy meatballs for the appetizer and they were fantastic. Three largest meatballs that were  well seasoned with just enough tomato sauce. I ordered the salmon and asked for lump crab on top. My cousin got the chicken Alfredo. The crab wasn't fresh and tasted weird so I just moved it off my salmon. The sides were great as well. My cousin enjoyed her dish, but stated a little more seasoning. Not a bad spot. Much lore chill/lax than we thought. No need to dress up.

Cute neighborhood taco place! Nothing fancy, you order inside and sit outside. There is a window for when the server calls you to come pickup your order. Clean easy friendly fast service. 

Tacos were HUGE and delicious!

We try to visit Level 11 at least twice during our stay in the St. Pete area. The view is stunning, the sunsets amazing, and the drinks and food are reasonably priced. We have consistently had excellent service. Try the smoked fish dip appetizer and the island tacos. You will love it!
We had a lot of fun, and there were some clever gags. It was especially cool to be there on Geek Night. And yes, I recognize the irony of that statement. ;)

Chocolate snowball is insanely good! Between that and mega mango, definitely two of the best snowballs in the entire metro area! Any of the "mega" flavors are great! Haven't had a disappointing visit yet. Snowballs are consistently delicious and the staff is always friendly.
Great service for large group on short notice. Fish and chips and Irish stew were unbelievably good. Highly recommend and will come back again next time in town.

Pure Spa is my go-to place for an indulgent, self-care or girl's spa day in the Greater Philadelphia area.  I've enjoyed massages at other spas in the area, but once I discovered Pure Spa in Ambler, I knew I had found my massage/spa-day headquarters.  I've now been there at least a half-dozen times, and the service and experience is always top-notch.

The team is friendly and welcoming, and the facilities are clean, well-maintained, and simple yet tastefully decorated for relaxation. The massage therapists and estheticians are professional and knowledgeable, happy to answer questions and tailor the services to your needs.  

Personally, my favorite service is the Fusion massage - the blend between the relaxing Swedish massage and the therapeutic deep tissue massage.  I've also enjoyed a few of their special seasonal aromatherapy massages, a nice change of pace.  I always feel spectacular after a day at Pure Spa.  

Beyond the massage and facials themselves, one of the small touches that sets Pure Spa above other spas I've visited is their relaxation room.  It is so nice to not be rushed out after a wonderful massage.  To sit quietly (or enjoy some catching up with a friend) in the comfy robe while enjoying a cup a tea after a massage makes the experience truly divine.  Thanks Pure Spa for the incredible service!

one word. AUDABOMB. 

ice cream stuffed in an oversized macaron.  for $5 it's the best of both worlds.  the flavor varies each week, follow the bakeshop on fb for flavor updates.  this weeks flavor is taro and butter pecan.  oh side note: make sure to get your own, your not gonna want to share this.

Wasn't super impressed. The dish I got was ok. Maybe I'm just not a ramen person. My friend got the same dish and loved it, so maybe just not my thing. The service was not good, though. And we were literally seated at the same table with another couple people which annoys me. Infrequent drink refills, took a while to get our bill and cards back.

I've heard a lot of great things about The Pharmacy and was really excited to try it! I came here alone on a Monday afternoon and was able to sit right away at the bar. 

I ordered the Pharmacy Burger $9 with sweet potato fries. It came pretty quickly. The burger was pretty good but did not live up to the expectation of what I've heard. The fries were also good but pretty average.

I think for the price, this is a great spot! I spent less than $10 and got a really filling meal. 

I would recommend trying one of the more dressed up burgers!

P.S. They have a patio!

The Fireside is a must!  We always enjoy sitting at the bar for happy hour.  Mark is a fantastic bar tender.  He is always super friendly and he makes the best drinks in town.  The ambience is fun--the music videos remind me of my youth.  Don't miss it!

Not the worse airport I've seen (Dallas-Fort Worth might hold that title).  Suggest getting there 2 hours prior; the ticketing lines can get lengthy here. Even so, I was only waiting about 10 minutes when 30 people were in front of me.  The agents are also very helpful. 

There seemed to be a decent selection of restaurants. Also, plenty of news/magazine stands along the terminals.
