Two things I didn't like: the terminal drop-off area can be confusing for rookies. It's a series of winding road and directional signs can sneak up on you. Also, I'm not a fan of the rail systems, but I guess they are a necessary evil. This airport is carpeted...which I found slightly odd. Lastly, the security screening area sucks! They had 2 lanes opened for and 20 gates. That's unsat. And there were lots of TSA agents just standing around most of the time. 

Overall, not the worst place to fly out of, into, or through, but I'm sure there's better.

Juan's can fly that food into my mouth anytime!!!!
The bad ass bacon bean dip started this food orgy , it's spicy meatiness and creamy beanlishness( I made it up I know ) , quickly followed by Juan's steak tacos which bursted with flavor onto my tongue. The chicken quesadilla must have had crack in it because I have become an addict with one bite! I finally finished it off with some beef nachos topped off with a money shot smathering of sour cream........ receptors in my brain are firing off left and right! Do not miss your chance to get off on this food.

Ceviche is our go-to spot when we just want a really great meal for a decent price. There's never a wait to sit, and the patio offers great outdoor seating (wear bug spray some nights!)

In all the times we have gone this year alone (12+) we have NEVER been disappointed. We are always trying something new. Steak is cooked to perfection, the flavors are complex, and it is totally worth the money. Their $4 sangria during happy hours can't be beat!

Great waitstaff and an attentive owner make it a wonderful experience every time. We will be back again soon.

Nice little co-op gallery in the heart of Ybor! Plenty of affordable pieces of art, all made with love by local artists. Yea, there's a lot of strange stuff, but it's always a welcoming environment  and it's always fun to stop in and see what the artists are working on.

It's interesting to see that the place is actually a For Lease storefront that they managed to negotiate using and paying for utilities until the space is filled, because it's in a really great spot in the heart of Ybor.

It looks like they constantly have different art openings, which they keep updated on their website and Facebook. We managed to be in the area when they had one of their Second Saturday "art walk" nights, which was neat because it coincided with the Castle's Steampunk party so everyone was decked out in their best gear. It's always packed on those nights (probably because of the free snacks), but it's fun to stop in if you're in the area!

The general experience was ok. Server went over items not available which honestly would constitute providing a new menu. Especially considering the menu had stains and watermarks on it. So we asked for a Carmel Apple martini or a flurtini neither of which the bartender could make. Really?? You sell champagne and vodka. We were told he didn't have the ingredients. You sell champagne, orange juice etc, you had the ingredients. The service is NOT on par with prices!! Charging four star prices for two star service is not acceptable. We ordered feast for two. Everything was cold or chilly. Not what we expected from a supposed upscale restaurant. Steak, lamb portions were cold but good. Shrimp, boar, mushrooms, carrots were not. I do believe that the server was doing the best that he could with what he was working with. Unfortunately this restaurant is not anywhere near 4 stars! We did not complain to management as it is not in our nature. It's more of a life lesson. We will not be back.
We had the food delivered .. catfish platter and po-boy fried alligator.. the food was cold when it arrived an hour later, therefore we did not experience a good meal. We were disappointed ..

What a place!

If you do not come here at least once you are a fool. The cheapest and most delicious breakfast in the world lives here. 

2 orders of beignets and 2 orders of large coffees was about $12!!!!!

If you've never had beignets you're missing out. Fried dough literally doused in powdered sugar. Where can you go wrong? Especially with 3 per order. 

The coffee is flavored with chicory and is downright delicious and I'm jonesing for it right now. 

Please do yourself a favor and go here.

I barely eat in the mall food court but ever since I try Seoul Fresh the first time, I come every time when I'm in the mall. Great food quality, good portions and very tasty. Love the beef bowl and fried egg.

Who doesn't love Top Golf? Since moving to Nashville (a year ago) I've been here too many times to count. I've been to 3 other top golfs as well but the service at the Nashville location is by far the best. People usually review when something goes wrong, but places deserve the credit when they're doing what's right also and this place has got it. Thanks for always providing a fun time!

Beautiful hotel. We had a corner room with a beach view on the third floor. The hotel has immediate access to the beach and lounge chairs/umbrellas for rent at $25/day. The hotel supplies towels for free. There is a great restaurant with sunset views. (The coconut pineapple bread is awesome!)

Free parking too!

This was the perfect hotel for a short beach getaway.

I came in an hour before closing, so they asked me to take it to go, which I didnt mind. But, the waitress who took my order has a very "rude" tone of voice, almost commanding hence minus one star. 

I would come back to dine in and truly experience the restaurants atmosphere and hot food off the stoves. My to go order got cold and stale real fast. 
Lemon grass pork banh mi was pack with flavors. The shrimp spring rolls were huge! And the soft shell crab in bao with cucumbers were the bomb!
Really good BBQ shrimp and great service.   I will be going back the next time i'm in New Orleans.

Super disappointed. The service was what to be expected. However, the food was mediocre. We ordered appetizers, drinks, main entrees & dessert...nothing stood out, or wowed me which was upsetting since our expectations for Emeril Legasse's restaurant were higher than normal. The presentation was there, but the flavor lacking. Got the dinner special waygu beef, (MUCH smaller portion for what your paying) lacquered duck, served with french fries? (Pomme frites) (these were our main entrees); for appetizers the new orleans hot frog legs & smoked crab cheesecake boulettes; dessert was the creme brulee & lastly NOLA greens (regular ass salad...only thing that stood out was the watermelon radish and grapefruit pieces). It was honestly whatever. We've eaten better food at non-fine dining restaurants...I suggest you save your money & eat at Willie Mae's, Acme oyster house, Canjun's, Felix....It's well worth the money and experience.
Quoted quickly.  Arrived on time.  Did a fantastic job.  Friendly folks.  They had to go the extra mile to get the right glass.

My favorite pizza and pasta place in the Indianapolis area. My husband and always order a pizza and pasta dish to split. The beekeeper pizza is absolutely delicious, and we haven't tried a pasta dish we don't like. Make sure and come on a Friday when the chef makes a house gnocchi dish; soft pillowy deliciousness.

Pietro's is a new locally-owned pizza place tucked away in a strip mall across the street from the Target in Nora. It is easy to drive by the restaurant and not even notice it. They only offer delivery or carry out so you won't be able to sit down and eat there. 

I ordered a 10" pepperoni pizza and a side of breadsticks with nacho cheese. Both the pizza and the breadsticks were $2 or $3 more than what you would pay at a national chain like Domino's. The pizza is outstanding! It had a generous amount of cheese, the sauce was good and the parmesan on the crust was a nice touch. I wasn't impressed with the breadsticks though; they were pretty dry and bland.

Pietro and Nila were working behind the counter and the customer service could not have been better. They were friendly and courteous and they worked quickly, but not at the expense of the food. There are plenty of restaurants that could learn from how the Pietro's staff treats its customers. Their service is as good as it gets!
First time ever eating oysters and i'm pretty sure this was the way to do it! These were pretty delicious! grilled and smother in butter and lemon. staff was very friendly.

I've been to many Jim n Nicks but went to this location for the first time 2 nights ago. Our server seemed really out of it and kept forgetting everything. He was replaced in the middle of our meal (not by request-not sure what happened.) The woman who took over for him was great and even gave us some cheese biscuits to go because we had to wait a long time for the first batch. My favorite is the BBQ chicken plate, and their fries are amazing! You can't go wrong with anything on the menu here.
I am the one who recommended Andrew V to go check out the hair garage. Best cuts in Tucson. Jeff does a fantastic job. Whenever Jeff is unavailable Chloe hooks me up. Fresh cuts, always.

a.  Ordered 2 appliances from Goedeker's
b.  Two weeks after placing the order I received an email with instructions for receiving the shipment 
c.  The instructions mainly stated how Goedeker's wouldn't be held responsible for much of anything
d.  At no time during the order process did I receive these instructions.  If I had, I wouldn't have purchased from this company
e.  Long story short, the appliances came crushed, customer service was non-existent, it took 3 months to receive replacements
f.  Christian company?  I think not
This is the best place to eat if you have a cute date night planned. The food and the atmosphere was amazing! Definitely will be back!

I know it might seem weird to give any DMV 5 stars, but I'm not backing down. There is an option at the Reno and Carson City DMVs to make an appointment for whatever service you might need. I needed to renew my registration so I made an appointment for 8:30a.m. I wanted to get there early to avoid any lines or crowds. I was able to go right to the desk to check in, and while the woman was writing the number to be called, I heard the number! Such a quick and easy visit. I know there are kiosks around the city to avoid a trip to the DMV, but I'd rather not have someone over my shoulder.

It is wonderful that the area finally has a restaurant like District 611, unfortunately, they need to work out some kinks.  

First, the positives:  the decor and overall mood of the restaurant are great. When you first walk in, there is a traditional pizza oven at the center of the dining area, with a tile mural that represents Broad Street in Philadelphia. While waiting for our table, we enjoyed sitting at the pizza bar and watching orders being made.

However, from the moment we were seated at our table, we felt incredibly rushed. Our server, Jessica, was very friendly and accommodating, but we couldn't help but feel as though she was in a hurry to get our meals out and clear our table for the next guests- and this continued the whole time we were there. 

We ordered appetizers, and when we were a little over halfway finished them, our main entrees came out. Or I should say, two of them did. I ordered the scallops and my father ordered the chicken, but it was another 10 minutes before my boyfriend's pizza was delivered. Another 5 minutes passed before my mother got her caesar salad. By the time everyone got their entrees, my scallops had been on the table for 15 minutes, and were stone cold. 

The food itself was average. For appetizers we ordered the ricotta cakes, which I did not especially enjoy, and the warm ricotta with honey, which was tasty. My scallops were well cooked, but I found the risotto to be bland. My dad had the same complaint about his roasted chicken.  If I were to go back to this restaurant again, which I'm not sure I would, I would stick to ordering pizzas.  

On a final side note, for this entire restaurant, there is only  ONE restroom that accommodates ONE guest at a time.  As you can imagine, on a busy Saturday night, this was problematic.  (There was also no purse hook, which, ladies- you know is annoying.)

From beginning to end, this was by far my least favorite brewery I've been to in Indianapolis. For starters the lady behind the bar was not only super uncomfortable to talk to, but she also didn't tell us anything about the flight that she gave us (she didn't even let us pick the ones we got to try). I would have understood had there been a ton of people there, but we were two of the four people sitting at the bar. She had zero personality and zero training in the customer service department. 
Then once we got the beer I was hoping that everything would get better. Wrong. Out of all the beers we tried, we didn't like any of them. I had high hopes for the house beers, but was strongly disappointed. 
Will definitely not be returning.

This was my first experience when it comes to creole cuisine, so I don't have much to compare to when it comes to taste. I ordered the Creole combination which came with gumbo, jambalaya and crawfish pie. The gumbo was spicy but good, the jambalaya was tasty and the crawfish pie, (which I want sure about), was delicious. Our waitress said they make the pies daily then deep fry. It tasted like a savory pie and I loved it. 
Our service was friendly and the location is right across from Jackson Square and the cathedral. The restaurant is open and you have a nice breeze with gorgeous views!
Shockingly good food! I don't like catfish. My lovely wife does. She orders and it was the BEST I've ever had. Great hush puppies too

I have gone to this Valvoline for the last couple of years for my oil changing needs. I don't have the nicest of cars and it sometimes needs a little more TLC than the others that come through the doors and they always step up to the task. 

The service has always been quick, friendly and informative! I know absolutely nothing when it comes to cars and they always explain to me what they are doing and why they are recommending a specific option. The longest wait time I have experienced was about 10 minutes and it is usually about a 10-15 minute service. This is awesome because you can just drive up, no appointment necessary. 

Another Yelper mentioned that they do not hard sell and that is honestly so true -- which is another reason that I love this place! They are there to inform and educate but are not pushy in any way - which is appreciated! 

I would definitely check them out and go to them if you are in need of any quick-servicing needs!

Really cute place with tasty pulled pork, brisket and jalapeño Mac and cheese. My only criticism is the ribs. It was not fall of the bone good, it was chew and chew until your jaw hurts. Anyways! You walk in, pick and buy what you want and then, can either hang inside or out. The decor is so cute!!

Saw previous reviews on yelp, stopped in here while waiting for our condo to be ready and happy we did! We had the lunch special of soft shelled crab sandwiches and they were right on point, crispy not greasy and fresh with a really light batter.
Washed it down with a pair of reef donkey IPAs

To start, the food is INCREDIBLE....however, customer service via phone is GARBAGE. I live 5 min from this location and whether it's busy or during dead hours, staff never wants to answer a phone for To-go orders. I have even called while outside of the store, during a not busy hour, and they did not answer the phone. When I walked in, employees were on their phones and talking with one another and letting the phone ring. 

I only call in orders due to the capacity of how busy this location can get.. and if you don't call and order over the phone, they make you wait for at least 30-45 minutes. You would think that this would be a great way for them to make extra money, but the staff is, in my opinion, lazy. However, once you get your food, you are satisfied and happy. I wish they would care a little more on the customer service side.

Love this place! Greatest beer selection I've found anywhere in the Treasure Valley. Food far and above typical Gastropub fare. Welcoming exterior suited to downtown Boise. The atmosphere inside is downright festive. A must for anyone visiting Boise.

In my book, hands down the heavyweight champion of all Chinese restaurants. Decor is stunning. Food is clean and fresh. They don't have a huge menu here.... but what they do, they do VERY well. The double cooked pork belly with leeks is probably my favorite dish of all time. 
A great beer selection which should not be overlooked.
Dumplings in chili oil should be a standard order along with the Dan Dan Noodles.

I am BEYOND disappointed with this establishment. 

I was beside myself when my grandfather, a war HERO, was completely disregarded by the people 'working' at this so called 'liquor store'.

My grandfather (Stewart), was just looking to pick up some refreshments for his wife's Birthday hullabaloo, but was horrified by the sight of a rodent scurrying around the store. When he reported his findings to the 'cashier', he was met with grief, anguish and contempt. The seemingly harmless cashier with a smug look on his face spit on my grandfather, and told him to leave 'his store' (as if he was the owner !?!?!?).

Anyway... cannot believe they treated a VETERAN like this... will be back NEVER.

I came here with a friend right when it opened at 11am on a Saturday. We were seated promptly and given very attentive service! We sat outside on the patio since the weather was beautiful. I love the space, furniture, and interior of this restaurant - clean, simple, and modern.

We tried both the hot chicken and duck buns for appetizers. The hot chicken bun was better than the duck simply because the meat and sauce combination was much more juicy and flavorful than the duck.

Ramen - will preface this with the fact that I have a weird taste in ramen... I don't think my "favorite" ramen is necessarily the "best" ramen (I've had "great" ramen in Tokyo and thought it was just so-so), so heed my review with caution! I ordered the Shoyu Ramen and really loved it! I thought the broth was just perfect in flavor and seasoning. The best part of this dish was definitely the pork chasu. It was so tender and juicy. As for the noodles themselves, it was not too hard/chewy, more bouncy and on the soft side - which is what I love in my noodles. I ordered the garlic as a side which surprisingly added a ton more flavor to the broth itself but not overwhelmingly so.

I would definitely come back again when craving ramen as this is probably one of the best places to get your ramen fix in Nashville!

I have been to Via Bicycle twice and both times I have been incredibly happy with the service!  I went in asking to buy a new tire pump because mine was broken. Instead of selling me a new one, they told me to come back the next day so that they could fix it. Sure enough, I brought it back and they fixed it for free! Thanks to their commitment to helping customers (not just making money), I'll be coming here for all of my future bike-related needs!

We were excited to try this place because the food looks great however after walking into a cramped bar with people packed in like sardines, being greeted by an entirely unfriendly bartender, and then being told by the hostess that there was a 35 minute wait for a table on top of everything else we decided to go somewhere else. 
Maybe we will try again during the week when it's less busy and when there is a different bartender working...

Wow, beautiful day to eat outside. My shrimp Caesar was amazing. The issue, the waitress. She was terrible. Waited 10+ minutes for her to come. Ten more minutes for our drinks. Then she asks if we need more time to look at the menu! Never brought the drink refills she offered. Then i tried to wave down the hostess who definitely made eye contact and looked away. Could not be bothered to ask what I might need. Had to go inside with my food to get a box. Had to track her down for the check. Not one question as how things were. Actually had RBF as we checked out. Seriously, find another job. We've all had bad days at work but being bitchy after ruining my lunch isn't cool. I have to add, I've worked in hospitality for 30 years. Everyone has off days. Too bad I got her day when I go out so rarely.

Very disappointed! I had one short afternoon off and got to spend way too much of it here waiting! Sat staring at the 10 minute oil change sign for well over an hour. When I finally had to ask them to check on my car, he came back and said there had been a problem with the car in front of me and it had been sitting there waiting to get the tires rotated. He said it would be done in 10 minutes, yeah right. I said I just want to leave after waiting so long and they checked me out for full price and said I could come back at my convenience to get my tires done. This whole this was inconvenient and you want me to come back after you charged me full price for wasting this much time without getting everything I was promised? I don't think so, not ever again!
Great guy! Very courteous and professional. He quickly returned my request for a quote, we set up an appointment for the next day and he was punctual for the appointment. I very highly recommend!
Close friends took us out to dinner here and we enjoyed it. Sampler appetizer and Shwarma were big hits. My teenager that has never had this cuisine wants to come back. Great find.
Decent breakfast and lunch food with ok service and atmosphere. For lunch I usually get their vegetarian sandwich which is pretty good.

Food & service have hit their stride. Pizza crusts are now crisp, not too doughy or bland. Pizza toppings range from fairly traditional to the adventurous--and all good, whether you want a tomato sauce and cheese kind of pizza or a white pie. 

A rotating draft beer list has something for almost everyone--all but maybe the Miller Lite crowd. The pasta is fresh, the sauces rich & not over sweet, & the salads are generous, fresh & delicious. Salads may be my favorite items on the menu.

Clarkville has been pretty good since it opened, but lately they have raised their game deliciously.
A cool spot that's full of history and good beer. Sucks when it gets crowded, but that's your typical weekend night anywhere.

What can I say about a buffet that had never been said before?  Nothing really.  This is your typical  chinese food that you can find in any chinese buffet.  There is quite a vast selection of food you can want.  All the food is quite fresh never seen anything that was looking old or sitting out there for a few hours.  

The waitresses were fine, got our plates and refilled our sodas in a timely manner.  Bathroom were quite clean compared to others I have been in.  

All in all, this buffet to me was OK.  There was nothing spectacular about it.  Typical chinese buffet.  Food to me was tad bit salty for my liking but everyones palate is quite different.   So if your looking for a buffet in the area around Franklin Mills, give this one a try.

Happy Eating!!  :)

Pretty good sports bar for sports bar food. If tou dont eat meat your options are very limited. One of our part only found one thing they wanted off the menu (tuna wrap) and it turned out they were out of tuna. The burger i got was huge, and i couldn't finish it. Most of their specialty burgers have a lot of extras on them like the Payton which has onion rings and pulled pork plus all the usual condiments. Reasonably priced beers with local options. Excellent beniges. Really friendly service but the orders seems to take a long time even though it was less than 1/2 full. Thats what loses marks for me.

We just moved to the area and wanted to get some brunch food. We saw Honeys had such good reviews on Yelp and one of our friends recommended it as well. During covid times we decided to get takeout. We ordered the open Jebs biscuit, the lemon ricotta pancakes, and spicy chicken sandwich. ALL WERE AMAZING. I love the southern take on these dishes and definitely something you wouldn't find in Philly.  I LOVED how they deconstructed the lemon ricotta pancakes and we got to assemble them with the side of whipped ricotta. I am still craving them right now and could order them again and again. The only thing that was a negative was the biscuit part was a little hard and I expected it to have a soft biscuitness vibe to it but the combo with the vegan sausage and gravy it really hit the spot!

Customer service =AWFUL. The girl was rude, condescending and was like you think you can fit that size? Are you kidding me?!? Every designer fits differently lady. They make you put on gloves when you fit the dresses and you cant take them off. Although, the lady trying dresses on next to me didn't have any on. The girl keeps yelling about me possibly stepping on the dress. You have to be kidding me. And while you look at the dresses she stands right behind you, watching you and breathing on your neck.

Ladies- forget this place. Go to Neiman...the dresses there will be the same $ but service is amazing (they even give you a bottle of water if you need)

Also, on jansboutique online store the dresses are about $50-60 cheaper than in-store!!! WTF?

A couple of days ago a pebble hit my windshield. It left a dime sized crack and rather than let it grow I decided to have it filled. On my way home on the corner of Broadway and wilmot there's a sign advertising $100 with every windshield replacement so I decided to call. The receptionist told me that they fill cracks for free and to come in, they took my car back in minutes. I'm just waiting to get it back. In about 7 minutes the chip was fixed at no charge. They do window tinting as well, I'm definitely coming back thank you!

I love Christy! She is the best and the service is great! I have nothing but good things to say. Whenever I order online my order always arrives sooner than what it says in my email. If you are looking for a good pizza spot then you should definitely choose this one.

Worst place ever. RIP OFF.
Went there because my brakes were making noise. he insisted I needed all new brake pads and all new roaders...for a low low price of $480.  I told him that I was going to come and pick it up and go somewhere else - so he only charged me an hour of work, to do nothing. 
I took it somewhere else, who said I had ONE bad brake pad and for $26 I got it fixed. 

Will never go back.
People were friendly but this was the worst gel mani I've ever had. Cuticles are sloppy, polish outside of nails. I was so relaxed there - too bad.

We did the 5 in 1 tour, we had Trent as our guide. His stories were historically accurate, relevant, and entertaining. We really enjoyed our tour. Highly recommend if looking for a walking tour in New Orleans.

I signed in online as they advertise so you don't have to wait. The Great Clips web page confirmed I was the next person in line and they "were holding my place" so I drove over there in a rush and walked in right behind a guy who pulled into the parking lot after I did. The stylist asked his name and entered it in the computer. He had not signed in online. Then she turned to me asking if I was the one showing on her computer as an online check-in. I said yes. Apparently, she was the only person working that morning. The stylist told the guy to come over to the chair. Very softly she said, "It will be just a few minutes." When I realized the online check-in meant nothing, I walked out of the shop.

Not sure what went on this evening. We eat at this one every once in awhile. Bacon came out so well done that the server said it was being redone. The other person's sausage patties were overly done as well. Server had to be asked to return. Pancakes were like crepes. And if there is one item we like it would be the pancakes. I think nothing is being watched in kitchen. Not enough employees as servers have to clean tables. So after a busy evening 8pm and too many dirty tables. This is becoming a bad diner!!!

Great meet up/coffee spot. The atmosphere is fun and sheik, but the food can be selectively lacking. Please do not eat sushi here. It's obviously made by a kid who thought they could make it themselves, and said "oh this is easy, let's put it on the menu!" The other non-asian choices are much better. 

A+ for drinks and party time!

Found a car here for my daughter. The salesman was very pushy about deposit money and after agreeing to a price with myself AND my husband when it came time to sign papers there was $750 added to our agreed upon price. The sales manager rudely showed me the computer screen where "it's clearly indicated in bold black letters" that the price shown included a $750 discount and "are you in the military?" which he knew I was not. I CAN read but this was NOT the final price discussed with the salesman I had been dealing with for days. 

I walked out and purchased a car from Dean Team Ballwin (my 3rd from them) and had absolutely NO hassle and no surprise costs and no request for deposit money. I negotiated the price of that car completely by text and email and showed up only to sign papers to purchase (easiest purchase ever). Dean Team Kirkwood will no longer be getting any of our business and we own 3 VW's.

What an amazing new addition to the Broadmoor neighborhood.

This has already become a fantastic community facility holding numerous programs every week such as: knitting circles, ESL tutoring, homework help, computer classes, and chess club....just to name a few. They are also planning cooking classes in the teaching kitchen on site.

Overall, it is a great space and a great resource.

This is the absolute best Mexican restaurant in Indianapolis. My family & I go at least once a week. The workers are always kind & attentive & the food comes out quick. The taco salad, arroz con pollo, & burrito la Piedad are some of my family favorites, & the queso is a must. La Piedad is my favorite restaurant in Indy, and I request to go there on my birthday every year. It has a great authentic vibe and always satisfies. 10/10 would recommend.

Wish I could give this "establishment" zero stars. I can understand mistakes now and then, but to have mistakes every single time. Come on. I feel like a complete idiot every time we go here. I should know better. I truly believe that they will get the order right just once. We now drive a mile down the road to the Zionsville location. The owner of this McDonalds is disgrace to a tradition.

I was really excited about the vegan offerings. I ordered the vegan omelette and enjoyed it for the most part. The pesto was fantastic! I was put off by the tofu, it was served in cold, plain cubes. It would have been a better dish had it been marinated and cooked in some fashion. The music they were playing was great and it was a nice atmosphere. Pretty unhappy with our server who just had a snarky attitude with us and wasn't very attentive. We asked our server for a recommendation on something and she said "You can decide that, your options are right there." We ran out of water by mid meal and had asked for orange juice twice only for it to arrive after we had finished our meal (and bussed our table for her as we waited). Other servers seemed great and we wished we had been sat in their sections since we could see and hear how fun and engaging they were with their tables.

It was craving some more Mexican food, so I stopped here. It was ok. I had the chicken soft tacos and pork tamales. I like the tacos more but they were nothing special. The tamales were ok but something was off. I could not put my hand on what it was. I may pass here in the future, unless Im really wanting a soft taco. I ordered carry-out and they were fast about getting it to me. I know they have some small fees for carry out (like 50 cents a taco).

Just ok...

A friend brought me to Lure for lunch today. What a treat! Although fish is not often my first choice for a meal I have to say that, by far, this was the best fish & chips I've ever had! If you get a chance, this is a must visit. From the decor, to the wait staff, to the ambiance....absolutely good, good food!

My experience with Renew was great from from the moment I called them. The man on the phone was very nice & informative and explained the pricing and what I should expect as a finished job. He also told me that they won't accept payment until I look over my vehicle and am completely satisfied. Now, here's where they really showed what good of a business they are.... The guy showed up to detail the exterior of my car. I told them on the phone that my car was parked under a pine tree for months and a 1/4 of the car was covered in dried up sap. They said they should be able to get it off no problem. I pointed the guy to my car and he started working. I got a call about 45 minutes later asking me to come outside. The owner, Steve, was now on site as well.  He showed me where they removed a little test spot and they did get the sap off but since it had caked up for so long it also removed some of the clear coat on my paint job.  He told me that was the best they could do and that this was one of the worst sap cases he had seen. He said if I wanted to pay them that they would get it all off but the clear coat would most likely need to be reapplied afterwards. He suggested that I save my money by not using them today and just goto a body shop and see what they could do for me.  There's not too many businesses out there that would do that. Most of the time they're just out to get your money.  So, even though I ended up not using their services, I still have nothing but positive things to say about them and I will definitely be using them for my other vehicles.  Thanks, Steve, for all your help. A++
I hadn't been at Shintori for a while, the food is still delicious, the wait was a little long but it was well worth it.

This place is still my favorite go to Mexican food place. I usually don't know what their specials are, but if you're indecisive  .. go with the specials! Their burritos are filling ( will admit lots of carbs- beans and rice) but also tasty for the price

Having grown up in northern NM I was excited to see a "New Mexican" resturaunt in Boise.  I recognized all the different entrees and decided on the combo Christmas style.  I gave them 3 stars, but what was lacking was the true Hatch chile.  This is a problem with serving green chile that is not fresh from Hatch.  I found the same problem with Jack n Grill in Denver- not using fresh (non canned) chile.  With that being said, I liked their recipes and found the food good.  I do laugh at those "Tex-Mex" snobs that were dissatisfied with this place.  This is NOT "TexMex" food, if it were, they wouldn't have the Zia on their sign.  Tex-Mex was banned in Neuvo Mexico the day the Texans ran from Glorietta Pass back to El Paso!  My suggestion:  Get real green chile!

Having ate there again, I will have to knock off a star.  While it is decent New Mexican for Boise, I have now determined there is no fresh Hatch being used here. That, my friend, is a no-no.

I've been to JoToro twice and I enjoyed myself both times. The first time that I went-I was blown away. The bacon appetizer was so delicious and just filling. The tacos were delicious as well. I will warn you-this is located in Channelside with all of the fancy upgrades of being in Sparkman's Wharf so it is pricey. The first time someone took me for my birthday so I did not pay anything and for two people-I could tell it was a pretty penny with the drinks, appetizers and tacos. 

The second time, I took my sister and wow-I was like ohhh ok!! They paid for me. Jotoro has tasty food, it's not authentic but they were able to emulate some traditional themes in their dishes. The drinks are tasty and pack a nice punch which is always the goal-right?

For the price, I would say you can get better elsewhere but for the service and the location...it is kind of expected. I would definitely try it but if you are looking for authentic Mexican food...it probably will not be impressive. If you are just looking for food that may be tasty and want to impress a date. I would give it a try.

Impressed.... A friend took me here for lunch and I didn't expect much, but in the end, Miss Saigon has earned at least 4 stars from me.

We had the spring rolls to start - Delish!  So fresh, love the textures.  And then I had pho.  The garnishes were so fresh, the meat was good, broth was perfectly spiced - Yum!

This location was crowded at lunch, though the dinning area is a decent size.  The service was good.  I really want to try the other location, which is closer to me anyway, but I'll be back here if the opportunity presents!

Very cute little bistro in the heart of artsy Safety Harbor where you can choose to sit outside on the covered patio or inside with the white clothed tables.  We sat inside which was nice by the window, but next time I will definitely sit outside. It is very loud inside. 

We tried a few appetizers including the Wild Boar ribs, charcuterie, and the special of the day appetizer was the soft shell crab. Soft shell crab was my favorite favorite, as well as the wild boar. I would get those in a heart beat again. The charcuterie was good too.

Their french onion soup is nice, but was not my favorite. What was good was all the cheese, the onions are milder. It's not drowning in salt, but it still did lack flavor to me.

I ordered the duck confit which I liked. It was moist and flavorful and the acorn squash made it even more yummy. My hubby's pork belly was not my fave. I hate that gooey fatty texture. His potatoes were perfect, but I the Brussel sprouts, ehh. The steak bite I had was oh so good.

This is a nice place for a night out especially their phenomenal drinks for sure, but definitely not an inside eating place. Not a first date place either except if you are sitting outside.

My new addiction, finally the brazilian treats came to edmonton. Chef Joao, susana and  beatriz are super friendly and have created a delicious menu. You can come out of here full since they have soups and sandwiches that has a cheesebread for a bun. If you have not tried a cheesebread it is time you discover this soft, gooey and melt in your mouth bread. If youre too full for a sandwich then you can enjoy it as a tiny buns. Their coffee is imported and has a great flavor that one can enjoy as a brazilian specialty or just a plain coffee. If you dont like coffee they also have teas and juices. every flavor of their brigadeiros and I love them all. I always get the preboxed brigadeiros cause i could never choose just one flavor. They dulce de leche cheesecake(just the right amount of sweetness), coconut cakes and more. Free wifi, great lighting to sit and enjoy the cleanliness and aroma  of freshly brewed coffee.

Five stars for their happy hour. For only $6 you can get any appetizer and sangria pitchers are less than $20. This is a steal for center city price. The service was great, where the waitress asked us multiple times if we wanted any additional tapas. Cuban sandwich is delicious as well as their spinach empanadas. They have more of a lounge environment with couches and candle lightning. I would recommend this place to take someone on a date or grab drinks for happy hour. Would like to try their dinner menu.

Outstanding service - you call and you talk to a person - not a machine.

My vehicle was done 2 days earlier than expected.

A++

The food is fabulous but lately not the wait staff. You should notice that we don't have utensils and you should remove the empty plates that sat at the table for 20 minutes. For 80 bucks for three customers, I expect more.

I like to do business with honest people. I had a recent experience with Robert Quirk, Owner of Lincoln Heating and Air. I called the number for service because my AC went out. We were hot, miserable. Robert picked up the phone and was very friendly and helpful. He said if I didn't mind grabbing a screwdriver he might be able to save me a holiday service call. I grabbed a screwdriver and Robert told me to go to the condensing unit outside. He gave me very specific instructions to try a couple of things that involved me following his directions. We got to the power box, there was a wire that had become not functional and by cleaning the box and by turning a screw the unit came back to life. After me thanking Robert, I told him I was very happy with the way he treated me and I would tell all of my friends of the honest Abe kind of service. Honest people still are out there. Robert Quirk and Lincoln Air are such people. They truly do make every penny count.  You will be elated with the way they treat you.

I enjoyed the atmosphere and the food and drinks were good, but not good enough for the price we paid. My husband ordered their special which was fettuccine topped with salmon. It was $44 which is ridiculous considering the ingredients used and the portion size. There was enough food without being overwhelming like so many restaurants serve these days,  which was great, but it was just too expensive for a SMALL amount of pasta (the most inexpensive food ever) and a small piece of fish. The gumbo was excellent and at $5 for a bowl it wasn't unreasonable. Overall, it was 5 star pricing for a 2-3 star experience.

Don't go here and if you must go inside. Drive though is a joke. They leave out items you ordered and get all the modifiers wrong on the burgers. This happened to us the last couple of times we have been here. My wife ordered a Dr Pepper and was given a Fanta. When she asked them to fix it, they dumped the Fanta and put Dr Pepper and ice in the same cup, did not rinse it out or get a new cup. Then when we got home to eat  the food, we realized hat our chili was not in the bag, the fries were not cooked all the way through, and there was lettuce and no cheese on my wife's cheeseburger, even though she clearly order it with only no lettuce. Her Dr Pepper tasted weird with the Fanta mixed in it. And these are the people that want $15 an hour! Go to another location. This one can't find good help and has been this way for too long!

Extremely overpriced for mediocre pizza and sub par service, the waitress , who took 10 minutes just to get us a menu on a half hour lunch break was by herself during the rush, so maybe not her fault, but we paid for the Lunch "special" for 11 bucks a pie, and were brought a child size pizza that was eaten in 4 bites... definitely not going back, they are straight robbing the public of money, time, and an experience... very disappointing,

The long and short of it, I walked out of Cafe Ole a happy customer.

We checked out this place upon a recommendation from a concierge, and it turned out to be a good idea.  I was a little apprehensive.  I had never been to a coffee house that had an Israeli-influenced menu.  However, the lovely lady behind the counter was able to point me in the right direction, and I ordered a egg white turkey wrap and a chai.

AWESOME!  The portions were ample, and the ingredients were fresh.  I felt like I had eaten a hearty meal, but without feeling like it was going to sit like a rock in my stomach throughout the morning.

Although it was busy, we didn't have any trouble finding a nice sized table (big enough to enjoy a newspaper on).  The atmosphere was friendly, and you could see that there were folks there that were regulars.

I would definitely come back here again.  Maybe for a lunch...  :)

Thanks, Cafe Ole!

Ordered delivery for Yujo and the food was still hot! I ordered the creamy tonkatsu without any extra ingredients and I felt like there could have been a little bit more vegetables/sides. For next time, I'll have to order more! The soup was flavorful but a little bit oily for me. The brown sugar genmaicha tea was good! Make sure to add the boba to your online order though because the first time I ordered it, I didn't realize you had to add the boba and thought it came with it automatically (definitely my mistake). Food was good, so I'll be back!

Originally from CA (SF bay area) and newly relocated  to Tampa only to discovery two things that we missed from back home here at Jannah Market -/ Kunfaa (made the right way) and HALAL deli meat for our subs. 
Br. Ibrahim, his wife and family genuinely welcomed us to the area and provided above-par hospitality -personally showcasing many of their delicious savory and sweet items which couldn't be refused - lending me to spend much more than I initially intended    :) 
As someone who's been globetrotting the 90s, you have a GEM of a place here in Tampa and I urge you to drop by and give Jannah Market and try -didn't mean to make a rhyme... 
All the best of peace  -and stay safe!

I had an excellent taco here, after stopping to pick up some party supplies next door! The staff is friendly, kind, and helpful. The outdoor seating is clean and comfortable, and the people watching is excellent! I will be back :)

My husband and I stopped here recently after a movie for some takeout cheesesteaks.  Unfortunately, when we got home we realized how much they skimped on the meat. What a disappointment.  I think the photo speaks for itself.  We will never go back.

THIS PLACE IS DISGUISED  NEVER I REPEAT NEVER WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY HERE !!!! wish I could put 0 stars this was the the worst food I ever had, this place needs to be shut down, the coustmer servicer was horrible  I will never go there again not even if they paid me. My husband had to spit out spoiled food. We went out on our anniversary they will not pass inspection shut they ass down even the employees look dirty!!!!!

We love ocean prime !! Kat and Ryan rock it out at the patio bar! They are ways very hospitable and keep the drink suggestions coming. The ambiance is wonderful and happy hours are great! A must stop in the west shore area !

Amazing food amazing service and great vegan options. So glad my family decided to come here for a birthday celebration it was over all an incredible experience. Also everything is really nicely decorated. Big fan I will definitely be coming back when I visit Burlington again. I highly recommend the roasted pepper dip it is fantastic. Just a flavor explosion I loved it
Gave me an awesome price and same day service on a Saturday..i would highly recommend him to everyone  ..real stand up people at rydon

.....update on my earlier review.
I often pass by LA 23 BBQ as treat/snack on my way back  or to Lake Hermitage. The establishment is a bit pricey but I keep my order very simple,jalapeño sausage.
After a long day of camp repair I stopped in for the usual,when given the total I was SHOCKED by the additional 25% increase in the price! The cost is $5 per link,for a 5oz or less link! When I asked about the increase,I was told the lower price was a 'special' but it has been $4 for since I first started stopping to get product there! The publicity that this place has received maybe has got them a bit rambunctious in their pricing! 
I'll be delaying my stop til Rouses to pick up a full pound of andouille for the same $5. 
Thanx! For the memories.
Good food. Wonderful service. Lovely atmosphere. Our "go to" spot when we want an upscale meal but feel like being at a neighborhood restaurant. It is really $$$.

Third time I've been to Forest & Main and feel ready to give an educated review! 

PROS- I'm not a beer drinker but the beers are wonderful. I've tasted many and find they are complex and smell great and I can vouch for my boyfriend who buys their beer by the growler. Freshness of food is always top notch. I love their seasonal menus and even a main stay like their burger is just so so tasty! Service is always knowledgeable and helpful. You can tell there is a lot of pride and attention to detail going on. The people here clearly are passionate about good food and good beer.

Only cons.. Wish they had a better wine selection. If you're not a beer drinker choices are slim. Though I respect their choice of selecting a local wine, sorry PA, I've never been impressed by your wines. Wish there were a fresher selection available for the appetizer. With only bread, popcorn, hot soup, or cheese to chose from (current menu) in the heat, I'm pining for a gazpacho or crispy vegetables to dip in to something! 

But those cons are just me being picky. We love Forest & Main and I'm always wondering why I don't come more often each time I visit. Keep up the good work and if you happen to get better wine you'll be five staring all the way!

Yall this is my new favorite place.  I must have said "lets go to Sirtaky for Greek!" maybe 100 times since our first visit.  

Greek food is possibly my favorite.  (It's a hard choice...) And Sirtaky is the best you can get ANYWHERE!  

I'm slowly converting hubby too, I always order something different and let him have a bite or two and he is starting to crave it just as much as I do.  lol  

Their gyro's (YEE-ROW) are the best around.  THE BEST.  Falafel is a little on the small side, but they give you a good amount plus pita and hummus.  It's so crispy and delicious, a little more on the delicate side than your usual Falafel, but that is what makes it SO GOOD.  It's not as dense as I'm use to, it's light and airy!

The hummus is amazing.  I could put it on everything.  It does not have the bitter taste that you sometimes find in store bought hummus and with the super soft pita and oil with olives they give you its just great.  The eggplant salad (Melitzanosalata) is even better than the hummus!  Try it!  

And you can't get any better with their prices!  It's so reasonably priced, even their dinner entree's! We will be back soon!  I can't wait to try the salmon, I hear its EXCELLENT.  

Parking during lunch hours can be a little treacherous, especially now with the road work being done, but there are plenty of FREE lots less than a block away.

And now I want Sirtaky for dinner..... yumm!!  You will seriously be doing the happy food dance in the booth!

Had been wanting to come here for a while since it is close to home and I pass by it all the time. It had also been recommended to me since they have specials during the week. Ultimately though not blown away with the food. I had the ossobuco which was very tender but it was under seasoned and the sides were just ok. My wife had a pasta dish which was also under seasoned and she didn't even finish. The standout was a sriracha shrimp app we enjoyed. The service was good and the restaurant was clean.

Male, bald bartender was unbelievably rude to every customer, a guy next to me tried getting his attention for when he had a second and instead of nicely acknowledging the customer he sarcastically waved back sort of like and eff you. Also he was extremely impatient with my drink order and others. I work in the service industry so I know how overwhelming a busy night can be but there was no excuse for his attitude. I'm big on tipping even with not so great service because tips are a big part of my income but he did not get a tip from me or many others. I will not be going back to this bar specifically because I do not want to be waited on by him.

Dr Brennan was amazing! I had to go see him twice for two different issues, and both times the experience was great. He was very informative, patient, knowledgable, and the treatment provided was by far the best I have ever received. I would recommend Dr Brennan to all family and friends.

The store manager is a really nice guy -very friendly service. But because this is a big company, they plan to charge you triple the cost. They said i needed a new battery and proceeded to tell me that I can buy a battery there for $140 plus labor which was going to cost me $360~ all together. No. I went to an actual store and bought a new battery for $70 and installed it myself because batteries aren't difficult to install with my 10 year old car. That's just an example of what they told me out of the numerous "issues" they said was wrong with my car and also the cost. Like i said, "triple".  

They have a nice deal on groupon where you get three oil changes and a numerous of car services just for the total cost of $34. Definitely take advantage of this deal but don't listen to the bullshit they tell you afterwords because they are literally squeezing every thing they can out of you by telling you exaggerated issues with your car. 

Overall, good service, but big companies want to take everything you have and exaggerate issues.

Stopped in for a late lunch. Atmosphere seems good but it was late afternoon so not many people in the dinning room. I had the burger w/a side of potato salad. My wife had the smoked tuna BLT w/a side of potato salad. The burger was very good and my wife called the smoked tuna BLT "outstanding". The reason I gave The Backyard a four star instead of a five is the potato salad and no fried egg for the burger. Potato salad is a common side in New Orleans and usually mustard based but this one tasted more like cold mash potatoes with eggs. They need to add salt, pepper, dill relish and maybe try a little mustard. It may be just me but fried egg on burgers are very trendy now. It appears they have eggs in house because they are in the potato salad. It would be a nice addition to the extras to have a fried egg as an ad on for the burger. Overall great place to grab a bite. I'm sure we will return.
Spotless restaurant, excellent food and service. Rachel was our server this morning. We enjoyed our relaxing dining experience. Definitely will come back again!

When i started hanging out in Chinatown, this was the bakery i frequented a lot.  I always got pork buns, corn buns, almond danish roll thing (lol), and fried dumpling.  I also love their fruit tart & chocolate mousse ! And my dad likes the bubble tea here.

However, I stopped going here because I don't know if it's just me but stuff like the pork bun has gotten really salty for my taste.. but still at under $1 for one, it's still a deal.

Nice enough staff, great soda selection, tasty sandwiches.  The owner travels a few times a year and picks up sodas from different areas, and they are all stored in a giant cooler.  Glass bottle sodas ftw!! This is a true hole in the wall kinda place that has nothing corporate about it.  A fun experience and has a lot of repeat potential for most who go there.

Came on taco Tuesday and didn't even realize it. Shrimp taco was underwhelming, but the burger was amazing! Bartender (Morgan) was great and the atmosphere is nice. 

I would definitely come back.

My wife raved about their chai tea.  I had two egg (over easy and cooked perfectly) bacon, sour dough toast, and a 1/2 order of biscuits and gravy. all the food was cooked very well. some items on the menu seemed price a bit higher than they should. The gravy was nice and thick with a nice black pepper note at the end, just how I like it. if I had to say a negative thing the biscuit was a little dense and dry.  We will be back for breakfast and have to try their dinner some time.

3 stars.

It's okay. Service was fine. Food was aiight. Nothing spectacular or mind-blowing here. Kinda pricey, though.

$7.99 margarita special was an okay "deal". Tasty, but not potent. I drank it all on a pretty empty stomach and didn't feel a thing. 

Salsa is okay. Tastes like it came outta a jar. Good, but not great.

Chimichanga was okay. I choose shredded chicken which has an adobo sauce that adds some moisture and a tad of flavor.

Queso was okay. I'm glad I didn't order a side like I normally do. It's not THAT good, IMO. It kinda has an American cheese imitation flavor that I wasn't excited about.

If you have a hankering for some Mexican, it'll do. It's not gonna be in heavy rotation for me, though.

Overall: Just "okay".

This is a cool place that a lot of locals hang out at at all hours of the day.  im in noway a starbucks coffee drinker (hot choc and chi tea fan) but i do like to go down there on a chilly night and get hot choc and read.  H/O they are doing away with being open 24 hours (me thinks for now).  I found out through a friend I see up there on week nights i go.  The other night i tried to find a sign by the front door alerting people of the change but no sign!  I hope mgt at least tells the homeless old men that sleep in the store on a nightly basis of the changes!

I'm still learning what's in Tucson and we accidentally noticed this location after visiting the Tuscon Mall.
It's large and you can move around freely between all the good stations.
I always judge by the Won Ton Happiness salad and this one uses enough dressing to make it tasty.
I loved this location for sure. It was not crowded and I liked that.
Yup, we'll be back.

I thought this place was going to be awesome.... Negative!! We went out as a group of 4, our waiter ignored one of my friends the entire time, ripped the menu out of their hand and didn't ask once what they wanted to drink. We were sitting there for probably an hour before we got drink refills and when our food came out, the sides were cold, water glasses filthy and service incredibly horrible! Just saying, the outside might looks nice, but never again!
I came I drank I left happy....nuff said

Both my husband and I got a stomach ache after eating at Peg's.  I am from the south & know how good grits should taste.  Theirs lacked that southern flavor & charm.  The restaurant was also crowded and noisy.  We will not be visiting this restaurant again in the near future.

Okay. Just ordered large flat bread. The few times I have visited this establishment was for drinks with friends. This is the second time ordering the pizza. I will say it was okay. I was here a couple of days ago and the delicious aroma made me come to tonight to order. It was just okay. On the website it mentions fresh mozzarella, well there were a few slices that did not even have mozzarella on them! Oh well. That being said I have had a few good beers and wine by the glass. The bartenders downstairs have been friendly. I also had a very delicious desert, it is a chocolate cake (kind of like a brownie) It was primo. I still like this place and will go back. Takeout would help. By the way I spent 20 dollars on my large flatbread. (I am certainly not a cheapo especially when it comes to food)  I won't be doing that again. Was not worth it taste wise.  Great beers, wine by the glass, cool neighborhood spot. Try it for yourself, especially if you are a local.

I thought I would update my review since it was outdated and short. Lighthouse coffee is my second home. Todd,melanie,joel,hannah and caleb are family. 
Lighthouse coffee reminds me of that old show Cheers. Everyone knows you, they great you by your name and are genuinely friendly.
If you did not know I am a coffee junkie,took me awhile to come to grips and realize it, but yes I love my coffee.
I roast my own on occasion, and just recently bought a high end espresso maker. You are probably like saying, so get to the coffee review. Well I just wanted to share that when i go get coffee it is like a classroom. 
Todd has taught me to pull a good shot,how to froth  milk and how to angle the milk pitcher so you do not get to much air.
Most owners will not do that, because they are afraid they will lose business.

With lighthouse and Todd, it is a appreciation of the coffee and process. It is educating there customers on organic coffee and fair trade. It truly is old school coffee, and I love it.
I wish school could have been this fun.

The price of the food at Brewburgers is what really makes it stand out.  $4 burgers (toppings not included) and $5 salads (not including meats) are pretty good deals (as long as you're simplistic with your food like me).  

We got the 20 wings plus a pitcher of beer for $20 deal.  My boyfriend, who is a self proclaimed wings connoisseur, said they were good, but do not rank in his top favorite wings (one being the wings from Hattricks).  However, he is upset that we haven't been here sooner, since we live within walking distance.  

We also got the sweet potato tater tots, which I really enjoyed.  It was a nice twist on the classic tater tots and different than the quickly becoming ubiquitous sweet potato fries.  

The clientele here were not what I expected.  Almost every table outside contained children under the age of 10.  We went at about 6 p.m.  I'm still surprised, because the inside looks like it could be a pretty cool bar scene if a different age group was present.  Along with a lot of families there, it seems like a lot of older couples from the neighborhood nearby walk over to grab a bite to eat.

If it wasn't for the fact that Brewburgers is so close I don't think I would go back, because I would travel to eat here.  Atmosphere means a lot to me and being that I'm in my 20s, which puts this place low on my list to go back to.

I loved the bread, which is why I gave such a high review, but every other aspect was disappointing: poor service, poor interior design, and sub par food and drinks. 

Poor service: the person working the counter made us feel like the least important customers. The owner came out and explained their history to another group, and completely ignored my party. No one checked in on us or asked us how the food and drinks were. 

Poor interior: they have one of the dumbest design flaws I've ever seen. The bar I sat at sloped down. The board was warped. This caused my ice water to slip down and fall onto me. I can't believe no one noticed this in the process of construction. Do NOT sit at the bar. The whole shotgun layout made it hard to navigate and impossible to walk through. 

Low quality food: I ordered the green juice and it was intensely bitter. The cold brew tasted like it had been sitting a long time (as cold brew ages, the acidity increases). The donut was more tough than a typical donut and didn't not taste like the flavor of the glaze. It only tasted of sourdough, because the flavor of sourdough is overpowering. The lavender morning bun was tough like bread and also not sweet. It was more like eating a bread bun than a cinnamon bun. The bread itself was good but I wish they would use their talent to develop better dough for donuts and buns. 

I hope the best for this place, because I like to support young people pursuing their dreams. But my very disappointing experience means I won't be coming back again.
Food was great. Prices are great. Our server Karley was fantastic. She provided great service. I'll be coming back.

I have lived in Philadelphia for 14 years, and in that time I have taken many vans to Don's. They are super reliable, honest, genuine nice people. Do extremely high quality work. Most recently, I needed to use a torx bit to install the benches of my van, and they let me park out front & use their bit for free. Couldn't recommend these guys highly enough!!!

The food has been great both times I went! Loved the fast service and variety considering it's a small place! My favorite would be the kale chips and the banh mi. Their chicken is always very flavorful and not too strong - done just right! I recently tried the duck confit banhmi and I loved it!

Service great and most of all Friendly! Beer  & wine selection real good for this type of place; but where we had a delicious lunch the other week at this new place, today's dinner was :( :( :( 
We had a party of 4; appetizers were from a box of frozen stuff from Costco :(  : tacky mozzarella sticks, blah garlic bread and the most awful, awful deep fried calamari...  One of us had the chicken tenders and French fries: nothing tasted appealing, the chicken was some deep, deep fried meat from an old hen and most fries we undercooked; the salad bar was heavy on the fish-side with fake crab and tired looking mini shrimp that came from some Thai shrimp farm... The only good tasting food was the  minestrone soup and the clam chowder. Both were delicious.  Guys and gals at Borrello: you have to do something about the ingredients you use and/ or hire a new cook if you want to make it to the 12 month mark! I recommend you cut the menu in half and only focus on what you know you can be good at. Good luck. We will try you again in a few months and see if things improve.

Food was okay but it took 25 minutes to get it when it wasn't busy.  The kitchen staff was too busy talking to worry about getting guests served and the pagers in the basket buzzed constantly.  They never went off!  Oh, and the ice machine jammed.  I can't really say the food was bad but sometimes it's not worth the hassle.  Sheesh!

Yuri was my waxer. She made me feel comfortable during my first Brazilian. She was quick and made it as painless as possible. This place has a great price point and great value. If you're looking for a great Brazilian in nashville for a great price, it's here

I had the scallops which were tasty, but the beans that accompanied them were bland and the aioli toast was soggy. The Brussels had wonderful toasted hazelnuts but we're too oily. Overall I was disappointed and probably wouldn't try the place again.

Loved the ambiance. We called ahead to get a reservation and so we got a private booth. Loved the decor and we were greeted by such friendly staff. The appetizers were delicious. Loved the ramen and the smoothies are to die for so definitely order one. My daughter enjoyed the bubble tea as well. I really enjoyed the experience. It was so refreshing to be acquainted with such nice people I love friendly people.

For our 1 year anniversary my girlfriend scheduled me a classic facial at Rescue. It was my first facial anywhere, but something tells me that Rescue is at the top of it's game. We were greeted as soon as we exited the elevator and escorted to the lounge area. We were offered water or tea (I had the cucumber water. Yum!) 

We sat down and looked around and waited for my appointment. I was taken in pretty soon and my gf waited in the lounge area for me. I'm really bad with names. I believe Rachel was the person who did my facial? I hope that's right. She was wonderful. She assessed my face, I put on the robe and then she went right to work. The conversation was good and she told me a lot about my face and what it needs. It was very informative. My face also felt AMAZING afterwards. I felt like I was glowing and I had a huge confidence boost for the rest of the day. 

I didn't feel like any products were being pushed on me, which I appreciated. She did recommend one product that I bought that day (Lotion P50) and I'm excited to look into her other recommendations. 

I had a perfect experience here. I can't wait until Winter so I can get another one! (They recommend quarterly facials for my skin type.) 

I also got my eyebrows done while I was there and tinted. They look perfect! They really do look like I have naturally perfect eyebrows. They don't look overdone at all. I also have very fair brows and it is amazing what a difference it makes having them a little darker. 

So yes, this was my first spa experience, but I'm thrilled I had it at Rescue and I can't wait to go back. My girlfriend also gets an A+ from me for picking this place.

EDIT: I forgot to mention that she stayed in the lounge area for the hour I was getting my facial and she said the staff there was awesome to her. They offered for her to take a steam (she didn't though) and they consistently made sure she had a drink. She just relaxed and read magazines and said it was actually really nice and relaxing. I was worried about her being bored so that was lovely to hear.

The hurricanes are the truth. So the truth, bring Excedrin.  The ambiance inside along with the funny looking courtyard is cool

Grade: B

Different than any Mexican food I have ever had, I am not sure if the the tortillas are handmade but they were very soft and yet crunchy in a supreme way. The tacos come in these wonderful colorful wrappers and the cheese is shredded in a remarkably uniform manner, the staff of cooks should be applauded for how accurate the food was when compared to the bright signage. My double-decker (one of their originals) looked just like its poster version. Stunning really, this food was equally easy to digest, as if half the digesting had been done for me in advance I have been eating at this franchise for a while now and I have to say if you only go out once in a while, you will get exactly what you expect from the Goleta Taco Bell.

Great staff! Overall the food was great, I definitely would recommend this. One thing that's worth trying is the crawfish even though it was a bit spicy. The looks of it may fool you but it makes up for it with the food!

Place is a joke, they dnt stand by there own estimates there staff is a joke and you get different answers from different staff on the same question. If you wreck your bike I wouldn't use them either. Trying to telling people wrong information about dealing with insurance claims because they don't know when they are talking to someone that actually deals with insurance companies and accident claiming for a living. They extend the truth just to get a sale. I know now why they have a bad rep in the motorcycle community around here.
I like this place, food is delicious and tiramisu is the best. Definitely will go back again

Man, seeing how many reviews there are here makes me nervous that I'll never get in again...

I really wanted to check out the Franklin Mortgage and Investment Company ever since I read about it in City Paper, but the first time I tried to go my girlfriend and I ended up going home after finding out that there was a long wait to get in.  I suppose we should have expected a wait on a Friday night, but I was naively hoping the place hadn't been discovered yet.

Not fully daunted, we tried again a few weeks later, and this time the bouncer offered to call me when a table was available so we could go get drinks across the street at Tria - an offer which I very much appreciated.  I'd have waited all night to get in if I could do all my waiting in other bars rather than in the line.  That said, I was pleasantly surprised that we only had to wait half an hour before getting the call to head in.

I could see immediately after we got in why we were made to wait - it seems they only let as many people in as they have seats, and I'd estimate that there are no more than 40 seats available.  We were seated at bar itself, which was a mostly enjoyable experience.  I liked watching the bartenders make all the drinks, but my girlfriend didn't enjoy the stray droplets that hit her while one of them was being shaken carelessly.  She'd probably give the place 4 stars as a result, but I just have to give it 5

I'm a huge fan of Islay scotch, and was amazed to find it featured in one of FM&IC's drinks, the Cowboy Killer.  It's essentially a Manhattan made with a mix of Islay and other scotches instead of bourbon, and is next to impossible to make  It must have taken a lot of experiments to determine the ratios required to make the drink palatable, and even with this knowledge you'd have to do the mixing just right to get the flavors into balance.  Somehow the guys at FM&IC nail it.

This, combined with the dearth of bars like it in Philadelphia, make FM&IC a place that is definitely worth checking out.  Maybe after I make it out to APO one of these days I'll have something to compare it to.

I'm having the greatest time at La Roca with my sisters! I came here with expectations that my cinco de Mayo experience would be ruin due to the weather but it was beyond well worth it. Our sever Gabby has made us feel like family and we've been having the best conversations with Tim. I don't usually write reviews, but instead give compliments on person however this was an exception. So if you're in the mood for great food, fantastic drinks and great service. Definitely the place to be. Can't forget about the general manager Dave!

I went here tonight looking for a good pizza and let me tell you Madison ave pizza is NJ like I don't like to say that because I think NJ has the best ! But I found a Gem . We also ordered wing they were good also . So go check them out you won't be disappointed!!! Great pizza  good people !!!

After Being trapped in the drive through for 20 minutes, I finally  arrived at the window where I was ignored for 4 more minutes until I I asked for my drink. The barista was rude and told me "everyone wants their drinks"  I will never go to this Starbucks again

Food was okay. My daughter ordered the soup. It was supposed to come with sour dough bread. It didn't. We asked. They said they were out. Didn't even offer a substitution. Just said they were out. What the heck???  Who does that these days. The kid working the counter was kind of rude. I'll eat somewhere else next time. Plenty of other good restaurants on Main.

Stopped here for some delicious dessert. The blueberry thrill was so amazing that I would've licked the bowl. The decor is so 50s and love the counter.  Oh and they sell Triple X soda!

I shall return.

We purchased a pool and spa from Pool and Spa Depot. From the first day we entered the store, the staff has been warm, friendly, honest, and accommodating. John Deeds is our "go to" sales rep, and he has been in contact with us through every step of this process. He listens to our wants and needs, and has come out to our property to help us during the design process. He definitely goes above and beyond his job! The contractor is also in constant contact with us; updating us every step of the way. I would highly recommend John and his team to anyone!

Simply put - this business should be shut down.  My daughter took her 4 month old kitten to this vet for tests when he was acting lethargic.  The vet ran a battery of tests....and they NEVER called her to give the results - she called for updates, but was given no updates except "when the result is negative, we dont call"...then the vet tech finally got up and looked for the reportt - and came back with "oh, the results came back positive" ...for what they said was 'worms'...A MONTH HAD PASSED! And in that time, the cat continued to go down hill...we stopped to pick up the medicine immediately after hearing the 'test postiive we have medicine for you", only to come home and find that her 4 month old kitten was now unable to walk and just fell over. This morning on the way to OUR vet office (VCA Neshaminy), the kitten passed away.  

This poor 4 month old kitten suffered for a MONTH because of this irresponsible veterinary hospital. Whether its the vets thenselves or the hospital staff, SOMETHING HAS TO CHANGE. How dare the hospital take $$ and watch an animal suffer.

Never again - this place is a disgrace.

We were warmly welcomed upon entry and seated right away at 8:00 on a Saturday. 
We shared the Chicken Salad appetizer and I had the Khao Soi with chicken and my husband had the Green Curry with chicken. Everything was SO delicious and well served. Must return!
Been here 5+ times. Great food. Amazing service!! The boys at the bar really do a Good job. Pizza is always timely and delicious.

READ READ READ THIS IN ITS ENTIRETY.  
I have never been so UNHAPPY with my dining experience as I am today.  Read this in its entirety to be floored.   I'm a local and just can't believe owners would be suffice with such sub-par staff.  Becca was our waitress.  It's evident she's received no training at any level at anything in her life.  My girlfriend and I and her two pups decided to head on down the street to take advantage of Willies kick ass burgers.  We sat outside and seated ourselves at the least dirty of the 4 tables available. On each of the dirty tables lay half full ashtrays (disgusting).  It was clear that Becca had the outside and the other waitress had the inside.  It was clear that no tables had been cleaned since opening.  I asked Becca to wipe down the table and when she did spray it with Windex, she sprayed it in my direction and wiped the food onto our laps (First thing taught in waiter school).  Next, we ordered two waters and a coke.  On her way out to give us our drinks, she was carrying, no joke, 6 drinks and ended up spilling 2 of them on the dogs.  Next we ordered our food.  We decided to get the chicken parmesan and the burger with jalapeños.  Originally my GF wanted the Blue Cheese burger, but we decided to get the jalapeño burger with a side of bleu cheese.  The food came out pretty quickly but there were no jalapeños but did have the bleu cheese on the side.  Was gonna ask for jalapeños when she came back, but she didn't.  We asked for water for the dogs when we got there; never got it.  I had to go to the bar to get a refill on my coke because she didn't show back up after delivering our food.  Side note:  one table was upset they didn't get refills, one gentleman had to go to the bar to get another beer, and another couple just got up and left because they never even got their drinks.  They were pretty upset too.  

So we finish our meal and I go inside to get the check and a box because I thought the girl got lost. I speak to the bartender and asked if there's a manager on duty in which she replied no.  She asked what was wrong and I explained to her everything that occurred.  She said she would see about comping something, which wasn't what I was looking for, but would have helped to ease the frustration.  

NOW HERE'S WHERE WE GET TO THE GOOD PART

Becca comes out to the table with the check and nothing's comped.  No apologies or anything.  I told her the bartender said she was going to comp something and that's when Becca became very argumentative.  She argued that we were going back and forth about which burger we wanted.  In fact we went from one burger to another.  That's not back and forth.  She asked why I didn't tell her when it came out, in which I replied, she would have had to stop by our table for me to let her know.  She continued her argument.

NOW HERE WE GO!!!!!!!!!

She had the nerve to say, and I quote, "You should know better than to argue with somebody younger". WTF?!?!  My GF and i looked at each other... Did she really just say that?  I said I'm gonna discuss that with the manager and she said she's not worried about it and that she's been there for more than a year.  I said I'm writing a Yelp review as we speak and she said she should have worn her "Yelp this" shirt.  
 
I'll reach out to the owner and see how they feel about Becca's comments and her terrible service.  If she still has a job after this I would be flabbergasted.
.
IT GETS EVEN BETTER:

When I got home, I called the bar to get management/owner info and a woman picked up.  I asked whom I'm speaking with and she absolutely refused to tell me.  She asked who I was as if it were a game.  I told her my name and she asked what I needed.  I asked her again what her name was and still she refused.   She even asked what I looked like?  Huh?  I even told her I was recording the conversation and all of the sudden the phone got disconnected.  I called back and had to deal with the same incompetent girl still refusing to provide any information.  I called back a couple minutes later and got the other girl working whom took my info and notified me that there is no management, only the owner who pops in here and there.  We'll see if I get a phone call.

When we want to go on a nice date, my husband and I always choose Fogo first. It's pricey but going for brunch is reasonable. You can stay and eat until you're full, and for birthdays they give free desert!
