It's a delicious selection of every kind of meat imaginable really. Worth the trip and price.

I came back to WOB after fifteen years, because they just won the Tucson Weekly's Best of Tucson for wings.  I had to see what the fuss was about.

Tuesday is their cheap wing night, and the place was very crowded.  No problem, though - get a beer and chill out.

The wings are the best I've ever had.  No foolin'.  The building is small and crowded and not the fanciest, but you're probably not here for the ambiance.  Enjoy the low-brow atmosphere.

I got 15 wings and a 25-ounce Kiltlifter for $11.  Such a deal!

Let me start off by saying I really like Campo. The food is always amazing! I happened to be here for a retirement party, that had been booked (so they knew we were coming). I was surprised that they seemed rather unprepared for the amount of people that would want to have a glass of wine or a beer on a Friday afternoon at a retirement party. I felt bad for the two people they had behind the bar as the crowd of 30+ people were unable to be served on the patio due to the "one check" limitation (everyone wanted to be able to pay separately). The appetizers that were brought out were tasty (the charcuterie tray especially), the meatballs were just ok. My biggest complaint was how slow the bar was, but they were overwhelmed and doing the best they could. I would think that if Campo knows that there would be a large crowd, they would have staffed for that. Growing pains?

One of my worst lunch experiences in recent memory.  I can't believe I spent $3.13 here for a slice of crap.  I'm not that hard to please but it really was that appalling.  Stop by Joe's Pizza instead.  It's only a block and a half away and you won't be sorry! :)

My first time and certainly not my last time!! The portions are huge!!! I'm going to have the best leftovers tomorrow. I had the bean & cheese & rice burrito. Delicious!!! My boyfriend had the steak burrito and he loved it. We shared the queso and again-delicious!!! Our order was prepared fast, pickup was easy and everyone was Covid compliant. The staff was super nice. We'll definitely be back for takeout and can't wait to dine on the patio soon.

I had a 2 hour layover at PHL Airport - twice. It's a fairly large airport - I believe I saw 5 concourses, alphabetically labeled. There is a shuttle if the concourse is a bit far. 

-Lots of shopping store, they have Bose, Body Shop, convenience stores and others which I can't recall right now. 
-Food options - meh! Not the best of what I have experienced. And the coffee was the worst tasting coffee I have ever had! I took two sips and dumped the rest. I can not remember the name of the coffee place - but it was near the gates at concourse F.
-WIFI - apparently it is free, IF you can get it to work. The first time I flew through philly was peak time of the day and eventhough I connected to WIFI, I was not able to access the internet. The second time, since it was around 8pm I was able to connect and browse - np. Even Netflix worked!

The BEST thing I experienced at this airport - is the quick massage salon. You can book anywhere from 15mins to an hour. I got a chair neck/shoulder massage. My wait time was about 15mins. Total cost $25 and a great experience! I was in layover and had a while to go so this massage really eased some of my stress.

Another thing this airport has - you can book a lounge/room. From what I saw it has sofa, bed, tv, and you can book this relaxing room for your layover. A great idea! Especially if you are travelling with kids or just need to de-stress. One of the best inventions man has thought of.

Overall, I think it is a good airport. Just need to improve on the eateries available!

The food isn't to my liking, and it was my first time ordering from there. I definitely had better. By reading all the reviews, I thought it would "blow" my taste buds away. But, it didn't. The hot wings wasn't too bad.
Absolute hidden gem. I loved their chicken tikka masala. Authentic, family owned Indian restaurant. I will return if I am in the area.
This is a really nice family restuarant. The food is really good, family style. My husband had the meatloaf sandwich, which he really liked.
It's a beautiful trail with bridges and trees. Very nice for walking, running. Good distance, not too far, or too short. I love it!

Bad news - Mama's Grill has changed to "Chick Pea's."  The name isn't the only thing that has changed.  One of the wonderful things about Mama's Grill was that they'd fry up the falafel for each individual order.  But the falafel pita I had the other day was just average.  It's truly disappointing.  I would have never gone to Maoz when I could eat yummy Mama's Grill.  Now I'll have to haul ass down to Bitar's.

Coops appears a bit like a dive bar. But don't let that fool you.  I eat here every time I'm in New Orleans and I will be back. I won't suggest one thing. I suggest you try everything.  So far I have not been disappointed.  Although I will suggest a bloody mary to go with your fine meal. They are perfect and have the most awesome pickled green beans in them.
Meh, it's something to do, cheap and not a compete waste of time. I'd rather pa a little more and have a guided tour, than wander around looking at glass vases.

We called carlucci's express to order delivery. The girl on the phone was all over the place and couldn't answer simple questions about different pizza pies. I found myself explaining her several times about what I wanted to order. We ordered large Margherita pizza with two toppings. The delivery guy was on time. However, I must say that after trying pizza , I was not impressed. Too much garlic and not a lot of cheese. It didn't taste like Margherita pizza to me. In general, it wasn't bad but not great. I will try a different place next time.

Though I've been going here for well over a decade, I always seem to forget how much I like their food.  Great selections at great prices.  They have a core line-up of beers that has a few good ones (I like the Red, IPA, and the Porter) so even if the seasonals aren't up to par, theres always something good on.  But...the seasonals usually include a couple gems as well.  I love sitting up on the roof in good weather.  Solid staff, and a pretty good bargain.

Extremely rude staff.  I made an appointment and missed the appointment time.  When I received a call to reschedule the woman who called me, Jackie, was discourteous, short, and uncaring.  This is not the service I expect and if it is any indication of the level of customer service I would receive a tenant, I would strongly advise against this location.
Over rated, over breaded, over cooked. Expected more. Worst seafood on the beach. Won't be back.

In for the weekend from out of town and this is such a great spot to come in and watch a game and have a pint! Great selection and great atmosphere if you want to catch a game with some friends! Great service and personable bartenders!

Day in - Day out, Tacos El Rey is Stellar in terms of food quality, value and the people who work there.  I would say that I have eaten there on average once a week ever since they opened, before that going back over twenty years I used to eat at the original Sutro location.

Today I was hungry just before noon and while Westbound on 8th street heading on to I80 West I made a split second decision and dove into Roberto's. Take a look at that Review.

I just looked over some recent Reviews one of which gave them a Poor Rating stating that the Guacamole obviously came out of a tub. The Guacamole at Tacos El Rey is Stellar, always FRESH, as if two minutes before you order it it wasn't guacamole at all, it was a couple of fresh avocados still in the skin. Everyone of my friends that I have brought there over the years have said that the guacamole was probably the best that they had ever had.

I have eaten at Top Restaurants all over the country, from Morton's to Ruth's Chris, Emeril's, The Oceanaire, Gene & Georgeti, Ron Sushi, The Tadich Grill, Steak Houses, Fish Houses, Italian, French, Japanese, Chinese, Vietnamese and Mexican, I could go on and on because believe me the list is long...

Taco's El Rey is a fine value for very good food and HEY, if you don't like something tell them, they will make it right with a good attitude.

Got their truffle special of the night steak. Love the flavor and all! Just a little too overcooked. Asked for medium rare but it came out well done.  but love the flavor and all! (Didn't asked them to redo it cuz they're closing pretty soon) I don't wanna trouble the kitchen and everyone else about it. Hubby liked his tri tip steak. Would come back and try again!

get the Guac please- not on the menu upstairs but ask for it.  delicious and served w/ plantain chips!

Ceviche - we got the sampler for 2.  long island fluke (the jasmine infused pearls didn't do much), thai (mixed seafood, good), and rainbow (my FAVE).

skirt steak - really like the presentation on that long plate.  meat falls apart once you cut into it.  not the juiciest but i suppose that's what the tomato/beans are for.

sugar cane tuna - my husband and father in-law loved it

cuban cigar dessert - such a fun dessert bc of the flame!  very creative.  and yummy.  take a bite of the ice cream, w/ caramel, and the cigar - all together!

bread - delicious.

Great service provided by Kevin and team at SOS Automotive. If you're looking for affordable auto services, such as a low cost but high quality brake job in the Tampa Bay area, look no further. Took my Range Rover in for a brake job, all parts provided. In and out with all 4 pads, rotors, and sensors replaced for an extremely competitive price. Unlike L&R Tire Express up the street, this place 1). Got me in, same day 2). Answers the phone when you call (wow! What a concept!) 3). Keeps their promise as to price and time quoted. Would definitely recommend!
The drunken fried rice taste good but the sushi was not. The drinks are overpriced and not good, really disappointed. The drunken fried rice including the shrimp tails.

If I could rate this his rating a  0 I would. We waited for two hours and we could never get a table.  Many people were seated ahead of us.  Talked with "manager" and she refused to help us. Awful! Will never go there again. Worst experience ever in Nashville:
Heard the food was great but I personally just love their ice cream :). A little on the pricey side but with the view you get of the fountain center, it's all well worth it.

Our waiter Matt is just amazing! Every time we go back we always make sure that he is the one taking care of us. The manager Amanda really cares about her customers too and spends time talking to every table about their questions and concerns. She really makes sure every customer has the best service possible. My boyfriend and I always go and we would really suggest the pesto sausage pizza with peppers and onions it's amazing!!! Would recommend for everyone to go.

Stopped in after work for Happy Hour  cocktails & bar bites with a co-worker. Happy Hour I believe is from 4 until 6 30 weekdays. Dee was our server in the bar area & she was very sweet & attentive. I had 2 Jim Beam cocktails & my co-worker 2 margaritas on the rocks. From the menu we ordered  bruschetta & fried shrimp with slaw. Total was $20. I'll definitely return. The crowd was light & everyone was quite friendly.

A cornerstone of the center city lunch hustle and bustle, Joe's pizza has only got better through the passing of time. I remember Arnesto's father a stocky strong Italian man with fingers like cigars creating the first multiple display of gourmet pizzas to hit the philly pizza scene. A true artisan of pizza the man only does it one way and that is Mmmmm Good. The place has expanded and the sandstone and mosaic tiles give the place a very earthy, serene and clean atmosphere. Having passed and trained his family in the old world tradition the shop is in great hands. So when you want a slice of heaven go to Joe's, When you want to be satisfied, go to Joe's  because anybody who knows goes to Joe's. Who knows you might even see pops there on occasion and say hello to the maestro. This is where it all started

I came based off the reviews and was somewhat disappointed. The positive thing is that the employees were very nice. The food itself isn't authentic New Orleans cuisine. I ordered the fish dinner and expected catfish, instead I got tilapia...which to me doesn't scream New Orleans. The fish wasn't all the way done on one side, and it wasn't the freshest fish, so I ate around it, I probably should have asked for another piece but didn't want to be disappointed. I was expecting the dessert to be homemade, so I ordered the red velvet cake. The cashier informed me that they got it from a store but it was really good...um yep...so...if you're looking for authentic N.O. cuisine, this isn't it. They made an attempt look authentic by creating an ambiance with Saints and Mardi Gras decor, the food doesn't match. For authentic Cajun cuisine, go to Louisiana.

Went twice.  The first visit was great.  The food was good, tasty, and quick, and the beer selection was pretty respectable.

The second time, we were on a time crunch.  We walked in, and asked if we could get our order to go because of that (we were working a convention and had a limited time to eat).  They were happy to oblige, and took our orders and money right away, seating us at the bar while we waited.  The food took a very long time to come out, wasting our entire lunch break just waiting.  We took our food back to the venue, and sat down to gobble down our food in five minutes.

Out of seven orders, three were extremely messed up.  I can't have bleu cheese.  I ordered my veggie burger with no cheese.  Instead, it came out smothered in bleu cheese.  I had to choose between throwing away my meal and skipping lunch, or getting violently sick to my stomach.  I chose to skip lunch.

Another one of my party got no onions - he was allergic.  Again, lots of onions.

The Salmon BLT somehow turned into a bacon cheeseburger.  No sign of salmon, or in fact the lettuce or tomatos either.

I cannot recommend this place.

These people are shady and the type of mechanics you worry about when it comes to making up things and over charging.  Took my car there and they told me it would cost $1100 for new alternator and battery.  Gave me a whole story on why my battery was dead and why it cost so much to change an alternator.  I questioned my battery having problems so I went back and asked for my keys cause I wanted to take my battery back to pepboys since I had a warranty for it.  The guy initially says he can't give me my keys (to my own car).  Then goes on saying why do I want to check my battery cause it won't matter cause my car won't start.  Then says I have to wait for the lady next to him.  Anyway, I end up getting my keys and taking my battery to pepboys.  They say of course nothing is wrong with my battery and charge it up for me.  I went back that night installed my battery and took it back.  Don't go to these crooks.  Don't fall for their inspection coupons.  You'll end up spending when it's not necessary.

To start, I've been to the Sichuan district in China known for their spicy (both hot and flavorful) and this is closest I've come to finding a restaurant that meets the amazing flavors of this area in both NYC and Philly. To say the least, I'm returning here a lot.
Our waiter (as well as all of the staff) was very attentive. They allow you to alter what spice level you want for any of their dishes.
I for one, love spicy food but I wouldn't go past a 7, while a 3 my minimum, I wouldn't try to do anything hotter even on a dare.
Two things that knocked them down to a four star would be that the rice started sticking together in big clumps very quickly and became hard to eat with. Second their "special drinks" really aren't special just very sweet and not a lot of alcohol. Just stick with the regular drinks.
Just make sure to book early!!! They fill up around dinner time on the weekends but what an amazing atmosphere. Can't wait to go with a big group and do hot pot!

Liberty Thrift is located in Montgomeryville Pa on Route 309 in place of the old Impact thrift store. I've been to Impact years ago but last Saturday 9/26/20 was my first visit to Liberty Thrift. We were looking for a shelf to hold cd's (they had CD racks but we have a lot of cd's). We did not find it but I was impressed by their cd selection! It might take a bit to see them all but they have some hidden gems for only $1. I must note, the quality is hit or miss and make sure to check to see the disc is correct or even in the case! (standard thrift shopping 101). I found some R.E.M., Green Day, The Cranberries and The Libertines all in great condition! There was a lot more to look at and even if it did get crowded the prices are good. My only real complaint is the parking is not good at all. Very small, cramped and terrible to move around along the main building. I'd recommend parking on the side, not as crowded. Also be aware that bring on Route 309 leaving either way is a nightmare. This alone prevents me from coming back often. If you are still willing to brave the traffic I would recommend it. It's not my favorite thrift store but its still worth a look.

Me and my lady had got home, and had a note on our door from Nv energy, saying the gas had been turned off and we had to set up a time for a technician to come out and turn it back on. James a service technician had come by for our neighbor who had called. He offered to take time to get us taken care of. Thanks James for handling the situation like a professional!

I am there pretty often on Tuesdays for lunch. Our server knows us already and knows what we order. She always comes to check on us and the food is usually always right the first time. The servers will correct the mistake and let the manager know if something was not right. The only issue I had was a server a few times that was not friendly, but that person is not there as often as I do not get that server anymore

We were craving tacos and since I had a client meeting not too far away we decided to try this place out. Located on a corner and occupying a large space at the onset of main Street and Arch Streeti n Norristown, La Michoacana was a welcome find. 

Clean, vibrant, friendly, attentive and inviting would be some great descriptors however I feel that where this restaurant earned a 5 star from me  is the fact that the food was fresh and delicious and that the customer experience and care was so thoughtful.

We ordered shrimp tacos and quesadilla. The quesadilla came with veg inside, which was mentioned in the menu but we thought it would be along with as opposed to inside. Clearly our mistake and we asked for that to go. The server asked if it was okay and we explained that we made a mistake (my love does not like to eat vegetables) and would like to take it to go. The server took the plate back to the kitchen. When he returned without the to go box he told us they were going to redo it. We protested several times letting him know that it was no problem. It was our mistake and we would gladly take it as I would eat it later (probably give it to a homeless person).

He insisted that the kitchen was already redoing the order. So we thanked him and a few minutes later a fresh steak and cheese quesadilla with meat and cheese only, arrived. It was delicious. I know what you may be thinking. It's just a quesadilla, tortilla, meat and cheese right?!?!? No, nope, nadda. I say, each component was well seasoned and fresh and well executed. I feel like a restaurant that can execute the basics of their cuisine on an exceptional manner is the foundation and building blocks of more complicated dishes. 

Needless to say, the kind care and flavors took my 4 star to a 5.

We tried Livery because we were in search of a new restaurant that we hadn't been to. This place did NOT disappoint! We ate tapas style and my favorite part was the empanadas! This is definitely a place I will return to many more times. Our server was super nice and went over his favorites and recommendations. Overall, this is an amazing place to try if you're looking for somewhere new-to-you!

Always heard good things about this place but never tried it until today. Definitely was missing out. Had a steak taco and a shrimp taco - delicious. I'm all about taco Tuesday so I will be coming here more often. Prices not bad for what you get - they give you a lot of meat. I also like that the flour tortillas had a little crunch to them. Loved it!
Amazing food that is always consistently prepared well and cooked to perfection!  Just finished and can't wait until I return back again.

I cannot tell you how much I appreciate Ron and the Wardrobe Clinic team. I called the Wardrobe Clinic 2 days if that before I needed a dress altered for a wedding and when I say Ron was fast acting man, that's an understatement he not only gave me a next day appt but Taren another designer working on my dress had me snatched all the way around. I will definitely continue to support this establishment. Trust me you will not be disappointed.
Went on a Sunday evening. The server Steph was awesome. Steak was delicious. Excellent people and excellent service. Enjoyed the meal and friendliness of the staff. Good stuff

The neighborhood is a little scary and the building seems a little out dated...having said this...GO HERE TO EAT!  Our server(Heather R) recommended we get a pitcher of beer to save money and she knew the menu and gave me recommendations...you could tell she actually ate here which is a good sign!  I got the Buffalo wings blackened with a side of sauce and they were so good!  My husband got fried oysters.  He said they were cooked PERFECTLY which is rare at many of these smaller restaurants.  We also got a side of coconut shrimp which were huge.  All of their sauces were very well done also.  Our server recommended that we swap one of our side of fries with onion rings...they were great!  Husband ordered deviled crab...expected it to be in the Shell bit it wasn't and it was fried..and he said he was pleasantly surprised!  Awesome scenery (by the river...not the neighborhood you pass through), awesome service, awesome food!  If we ever come back to Tampa we will be coming back! Thank you Rick's on the River and Heather R!

Well who would have expected to have such a Vegas style time in well, Reno??? Certainly not me. Admittedly I had sort of a bias against Reno. Not much poppin'! But boy was I wrong...After spending New Year's Eve day snowboarding in Truckee - that's right I said Truckee. I mean look who wants to go all the way into Tahoe and deal with well, all those dang people? Me and my crew - two couples traveled on in to the Peppermill in Reno to spend our New Year's Eve and well hopefully turn up!!! We all got a standard room which was reasonably priced for New Year's Eve, and well furnished. The hotel overall has been kept up which is nice. We took a nap, got dressed then headed down to the casino! Cha-ching! The crew got hungry so we inquired about dinner with a nice young lady who turned us over to Billy - who said he was the general manager. He escorted us to the restaurant where we ate like fat cats! Steak, the best cauliflower soup I've ever had, wine, veggies. The service was impeccable - waiter was funny, attentive and quick. Later the host told us that Billy had comp'd most of our drinks! And boy we were drinking! The nightclub where we counted down the New Year was a few steps away. The dj spun some OK jams...I mean I like trap music so I guess it's not for everyone. :-) Had the best unexpected time at the Peppermill in Reno. May even do it again and make it a tradition. Definitely a hidden gem.

Such a great experience! Rosemary was helpful, not overbearing, but always available when needed. She walked us through every step and was very articulate and knowledgeable of the stock. Make sure to ask for her if you go because she will take care of you!

My boyfriend and I recently went to Campo to celebrate our three-year anniversary. The atmosphere is delightful, the food is delicious, and and the service is remarkable. 
To start, we each ordered a glass of wine, I had the Pinot Noir that they serve by the glass, and my  boyfriend had a Cab. We ordered an appetizer to share, which was the Fritto Misto- or calamari. It was delicious, and there are even some fried zucchini in it. I'm SO about fried zucchini.  For dinner, we were already feeling full so we decided to share the  burger with a side of mashed potatoes. 
The burger was delicious, and big, too. I can't imagine eating the entire thing by myself, especially after eating the Fritto Misto, but pair with the garlic mashed potatoes. It was delicious and the perfect meal. For dessert, we shared the Caramel Budino, as our waitress, Trisha, told us it was delicious and their speciality. And, let me tell you! It was.  
Overall, the experience I had at Campo was delightful, and I will definitely be going back soon if not to just get some another Carmel Budino to take home (I won't share the second time).
The tacos were great but didn't care for the fact that you only got 1 taco for such an expensive price tag.

More than just a hot spot in the evenings...The Lodge provides some eclectic dining with the south tampa ambiance we all love, Feel like sushi? They got it, How about buffalo Man n Cheese (yummy!)? What about brunch with mimosa's? How about steak nachos? They literally have it all. Sit outside for a nice quiet lunch or happy hour...or enjoy a drink later for some Soho nightlife.

My wife and went with a specific budget and a couple of unusual needs in mind like a split California King, adjustable platform and a cooling gel mattress. RUDY is the man! He was very helpful explaining the subtle differences in various products and why the price varies so much by brand name. We didn't feel pressured to make any decision today and he did not try to upsell us or throw us into a different price range. We picked our set, stayed within our budget and started to pay when I happened to notice a high end looking futon (yes I said high end looking futon). 

It was in the sofa position and I sat down on it. Comfortable, good back support...seems nice. Before I could even ask RUDY was breaking the futon out into a bed for me. I laid down on it and thought I could sleep a few nights on this bed if I had to. RUDY then raised the ends of the futon to make a nice chaise lounge. Wow, my man cave will love this. SOLD! Great for when we have company as well.

First timer, pretty much tried the whole menu, the Chicken and Beef Bowls were very good, just a little sriracha would be perfect. Finally some good teriyaki at an affordable price. The food reminds me of all the great teriyaki places in the Seattle area, some of you will know what I mean. The tacos were pretty tasty also, and good size. Maybe the best deal in town for quality and portion size.
Most courteous and polite staff I have ever encountered at a fast food restaurant. Bangin chicken (and milkshakes).

Thank you for the great experience. We were pleasantly surprised to discover this place, a place that actually puts  love and care on every aspects of the restaurant. My favorite part was the tomato herb mix dip served with the bread. Omg! I would have bought it if it was bottled and sold. The handmade pasta was delicious. However, my one complaint would be there was too much sauce which got in the way of being able to enjoy the pasta. Thank you

I love everything about this pizza, the ordering and pick-up process. 
First - you can order and pay on-line, pick up in-store.  Which means the margin of error for toppings and such is almost NIL. Also, no stink eye when you order 12 toppings, lol.  Do that at a regular pizza place!
The crust is amazing, not the typical dough pizza we get her in the Philly area.  Toppings are FRESH - and so incredibly tasty compared to a 'regular' pizza place.
I get there on time and go right to pick-up because it is already paid for. So easy!
The manager (Ryan I think) is really nice and friendly at each pick-up. I've never seen a mess in this store, behind the counter is always clean, even during the rushes.
Can't recommend this pizza place more.  
And a bonus, there is a Mod Pizza where one of my daughters lives in another state.  I can order on-line for them and have her pick it up as a surprise for an easy dinner for them - I really like I can do that.
I wish there was a Mod Pizza in every location my adult children live, it is so fun to call after ordering and saying 'Hey - can you add a note to the top of the box for my daughter' and they do!

Ordered a muscle appetizer for big muscles in A marinara sauce served with a generous grilled garlic bread. Had a delicious rum punch with generous portion of alcohol. The scallop lunch included 10 med size scallops and a side. This restaurant is much better than the others I tried in the area. The ambience is all Beachy and clean
Really great cheesesteak. Lots of beef and plenty of Whiz. Nice soft bread. The Reading Terminal is a fun place.

The review about the Attorney General opening an investigation on this shop is completely BOGUS.  Full disclosure: I'm one of the owners. For 24 years we have serviced  our community with honesty and great service. 99. 9 % are satisfied customers. Many of our customers have been coming to us for over 20 years.  Quality and good service is paramount to us.  I don't know who wrote this malicious comment but I encourage all our customers to write a fair and honest  review of our service.   And yes, we are open following CDC guidance and precautions.  Stay safe and healthy.

We stopped in during a rain storm and happened to catch happy hour - which is amazing by the way. Likely it would have been a little more than we would have liked to pay if it hadn't been happy hour, but the beer and wine selection was great and very reasonable! The food selection on the happy hour menu was enough to tide us over until dinner.
Loved it!  Went around 6pm on Thurs night and had a 10 minute wait.  Crab cakes, oysters, and gumbo were all excellent.  Service was great.  We will come back here.

Kinda tricky review. My husband prefers large portions when we eat out. He gets his feathers ruffled easily over small portions. I wanted to watch the Cardinals game and didn't want to drive very far from home. Syberg's fit the bill. Found a great booth right in front of 4 televisions. My husband got to watch basketball and baseball. Music was tolerable. I HATE loud music while Im eating and talking. So far so good. Salad was excellent. Far better than I expected. Loved the home made croutons (my favorite). They also had a sweet onion dressing we both loved. It was also a large portion for a side. Theeeeen the food came out. Strong fish smell right away from my fish n chips. I set it clear across the table and never touched it. It's still in my refrigerator. Lobster mac n cheese. They used very few Langostino lobster, which are basically like small shrimp. It was over priced @ $15.99. We enjoyed the sampler appetizer platter. Fought over the toasted ravioli. I loved the sweet marinara. Husband also had the steak special with sweet potato fries. He was disappointed, but I kinda liked the few bites I had. To top off the night our waitress gave our ticket to our neighbors and gave us their much cheaper one, right after she asked my husband if he wanted one check or two. Huh?

We stumbled into Buona Pizza driving down to St. Pete Beach. Pretty good food! I had the gnocchi and asked them to make it with meat sauce. Came out piping hot and tasted good. Came with a side salad. 
My wife ordered calzone. Huge portion size! They didn't add the pepperoni in hers so she was disappointed there. 
The bread came out very hot and fresh and smelled amazing.

Went here to see a concert and was super impressed with the quality of the venue for non-burlesque shows.

The sound was great, good drinks and the venue is very intimate.

Only wish there were some more seating options for concerts around the perimeter.
When we were here there were only like 4 tables etup which everyone was battling for.
Great place for lunch! Awesome sammys and a great variety of teas. The staff is very friendly and each sandwich is made with love and care. My top sammy place in St. Pete for sure!

The gumbo and the Italian stallion are my go tos.  But the people are why I go back.  I have always been well cared for.  Their beer and wine are wonderful.  They will alter anything to meet your needs.
Cool bar.   Cool atmosphere.   Nice setting.   And  its nawlins so doesn't get any better.  Beer only stop hence the 4.  No issues.  Mary was funny too.

Indian Fast food. Period. The location is convenient and the service is quick. But I would not send anyone here who is looking for quality Indian cuisine. 

The meat is always over cooked. And the food is served on disposable plates with plastic utensils, something I would willingly overlook if the food tasted better. Not that its totally bad. For the price and proximity to the city, you get, well, fast food. It fills you up, but it's nothing to write home about.

I remember when I first moved here, I would ask around for a great place to get Indian food. I was meet with thoughtful sighs and was told that when Minar Palace closed, so did the last great place to get Indian food in the city. So, I was stoked when this place re-opened in this new location. I was so ready to try the food that so many Philadelphians thought was lost - but alas, I was totally underwhelmed by the experience. 

This is a great place to grab a quick bit to eat. But you can find better flavors and better cooked Indian food in the city. You just have to look for it.

This by far is one of the worst experiences ever in a steak house. The waiter was absolutely rude and thought so highly of himself that he just ran around with rockstar attitude directing his assistant like a slave and when he came around to us he gave short quick questions and answer to which they lack any hospitality. My wife got the bone in Ribeye which was decent but I've had better. My Steak Diane which was supposed to be cooked for me, I presume it should also be cooked in front of me was cooked directly behind me where I can't see but I get to feel the flames? Waiter then ran around the restaurant telling everyone how he felt sick today... I don't need to hear that $h17! If you're sick, stay your @$$ home and don't come into work bitching. Since food was average but carrying a premium price coupled with arrogant/sick waiter I can only give a 2 star.

Food-3
Service-3
Atmosphere-1

Cheese steak was good but not anything that is notable compared to my other cheesesteak favorites.   I would go here if I lived close by but I would not personally seek out this place for the cheesesteak experience.

Love love love this place!!! 

I wish they had more locations (specifically in Miami). They have a whopping 58 beers on draft and they are all self service! Yup! That's right! It's so neat! Every beer has a description on a little computer on the tap. It tells you the price per ounce and the alcohol percentage as well. They give you a bracelet that you scan and whaaala! You can pour yourself a tiny bit to try it before you fill up your cup. Probably the coolest experience ever. They have a great selection. You won't be disappointed!

Although the main attraction seems to be pizza, we decided to try a couple different appetizers for a little variety.

We had:
-Wings- they absolutely delicious and flavorful. 
-Philly Cheesesteak Eggrolls- They are served with beer battered cheese dip, which is yum yum. I love that the beer doesn't overpower the cheese like I've had in the last. 
-Smokey Gouda Mac'n Cheese- Definitely has a smokiness to it and was delicious. 
-Crispy Mozzarella & Meatball Lollipops- These were good, but I could have honestly done without them. 

Definitely will return when I am in town!

If I could give Masha 1000 stars, I would! From the moment I first met Masha and her husband Rich, I knew I had to have them for my engagement session. Their passion, sample work they showed me, and overall friendly and positive vibe drew me to them. 

Before the photo shoot: Masha gave me ideas of locations and communicated with me on outfits, times, and weather updates prior to the day so I always kept in the loop. 

During the shoot: Masha and Rich drove all around OC for us and spent the whole day shooting us. They were so easy going, made suggestions but also listening to what we wanted. My fiancé and I really got to know them and feel comfortable with them. 

After the shoot: I am a picky person when it comes to myself in photos and I was blown away by them. They are pictures that I will cherish for the rest of my life. Everyone I've shown them to say they are the best engagement pictures they've ever seen, and I agree with them!

Masha and Rich, thank you so much for your professionalism, time, energy, and talent. You both go ABOVE and BEYOND!!! I cannot thank you enough for the memories you've given me and Michael.

This nail salon is okay it all depends who does your nails. I would recommend going during the weekdays mid day they are less busy. It seems like on the weekends they are supper busy and they try to get as many clients done fast and the service isn't as effective. Here are a few photos of the work they have done

Ordered from Denim for our quarantined 50th wedding anniversary on May 23rd and was delighted by our meal as always.  Chef David made some special accomodations for me that was outside the regular take-out menu.  I had my all-time favorite restaurant meal of scallops and they were as perfect as ever - toasted on the outside and tender inside with wonderful seasoning. The beet arugula salad was even more perfect than I remembered it.  Chef David even threw in a dessert because it was our anniversary.  I love how the vegetables are not an afterthought like many restaurants but stand out on their own.  Try the carmelized cauliflower, you will not be disappointed with them!

Patagonia Outlet - Reno is an awesome store. 

So, we went in today to buy some clothes for our kids. Mainly, clothes for winter. The one piece suit for kids. They didn't have many selection for kids because it is end of season. But I love buying clothes end of season because you get better deals. We asked for help and the staff there are awesome. Very helpful! This outlet is great. 

Now I am a firm believer in "you get what you pay for". The items we were buying were pretty pricey but high quality. I have never bought anything here and gone damn what a waste of money. Because everything that I have ever bought from Patagonia they have a crazy warranty where if the product it defective in anyway they will replace it. They stand by their product and it shows. I am a firm believer in there product and that they produce really high quality items. I will definitely pay for items that will last. 

Now for the staff they went out of their way to research these one piece suit for my kids and they did a great job. They didn't have it at the store so they will have it shipped to my house. They also got me free shipping as well and on top of that they took about $30 bucks of the price tag for bought items and saved us $60. Pretty awesome. I didn't have to ask for this they just did it for me. How awesome it that? That is great customer service! 

Bathrooms are downstairs and you have to go through these doors. It's a bite wierd but they are in an older building. I really do like their use of this space and the location they chose is good. If you are from Reno you know that this area is a bit of a sketchy part of town, but it is an up an coming area. I'm just being real haha. I would just be on guard around here if you are going to your car just cause I know that there are people walking around who might do you harm; especially, at night. Just be aware but no need to be alert. But I do feel like this part of town is starting to become better. 

Parking is also a bit weird they have a parking lot there but it is very small. Parking can be a bit of a challenge if there are a lot of people here. But I seem to always fine parking here. Just keep that in mind. I don't know if they have a remedy for a full parking lot. I would love to know what their solution for that situation. But my experience here has been a good one and I will definitely be back. Thanks for reading my review.

This review has nothing to do with the quality of their food due to the fact that I was never able to get any. 

Yelp says that they are open till 9pm which is apparently wrong. I called at 8:10 to place an order for pick up. The phone was immediately answered and I was asked to wait on hold. At 10 minutes, someone finally picked up the phone (I was pretty irritated but had my heart and stomach set on some tzatiki) and said "yay" to which I replied that I'd like to place an order for pick up. The man said "oh, we're already closed".  I informed him that the Internet says they are open till 9 and that he just sat me on hold for 10+ minutes. He said, "I don't know...". What do you mean you don't know? You're the one who put me on hold!!! Yikes! Anyway, I hope their in-person staff is better but I won't be going to eat here any time soon.

I've been shopping at s 4th street fabric stores for more years than I'd like to admit (30+).  Fleishmann's has always been one of my favorites.  Their supplies rival the best NYC trim stores in addition to a respectable selection of fabrics, especially woolens!  It seems to be my one stop shop for the majority of my supplies.  Customer service and a helpful friendly staff make it even better.  As other fabric stores in the area seem to be dropping like flies, Fleischmann's just seems to get better with age.
They catered for a drug rep. It was soup salad and cookies the food over all was good but our salad was a little brown

It's an absolute bliss to be at this place! It's calm and soothing and so much positive energy around!!  The exercise doesn't drain you out and makes you strong from inside!! And Valerie is such a great person, her individual attention gives so much motivation. I loved being a part of this studio, all thanks to Valerie.
Waited for table. Not busy finally got seated waited 20 minutes no server. Left went across to Ricky T got right in best servers ever.

SeeClickFix.com, the this company has been sited for illegal chemical dumping and usage of the facility.  PinellasCleanAir.org has the story, people in the neighborhood getting sick- how crazy- the guy should move to an industrial park-   check out the story, my buddy got real ill living near there

Drake winery is unbelievable! Morgan
Is so freakin awesome, knowledgable, and personable. The wine is delicious the location is a little hard to find but completely worth the search. Go to drake winery! You will enjoy yourself .

Does not take walk ins when there are all of three people in the place and as rude as all the other reviews said.  Don't bother. Go somewhere else.  Queen nails around the corner was happy to have the business

This location has gone downhill since it opened, particularly in the last 6 months. Food is about the same but the customer service is severely lacking. Delivery takes longer than it should and the employees generally seem to be ambivalent when confronted with a service issue (late delivery, long hold time, orders not made correctly). It's too bad because I work in the same plaza as this store, but it's not worth the hassle anymore.
Clearview did a great job with landscaping our back yard. Very kind, professional and very pleased with the job they did. Highly recommend using them for your next landscaping project.

I returned home yesterday to find a huge leak under the kitchen sink. Since it was late on a Saturday, we have many family members coming this Thursday, for Thanksgiving, I was panicked. I logged onto Yelp. We live southeast Tucson.

Dave from Day & Knight Drain answered the call;  he could be here in less than 24 hours, a Sunday morning, on his way to another appointment in Vail. Whew! 

He called ahead, showed up on time,was clean, neat, professional then fixed the drain in no time. I am so grateful! His pricing is fair but his professionalism & responsiveness are over the top. Thanks, Dave!

The team is really nice, but I've had multiple issues with them keeping appointment times in the evening. I typically arrive 10-15 minutes prior to my appointment time and wait. About 15 minutes after my appointment time, I ask the receptionist how much longer it will be. On multiple (3+) occasions the receptionist has responded that they are running 45-50 minutes behind schedule, so it will be another 30 minutes or so. The first couple of times I just requested that they call me to let me know that they are running behind. I do not mind rescheduling, I just do not like to wait 30 minutes to find out that I will need to reschedule. It seems like every other appointment this happened. Like I said, great staff, just not very professional when keeping appointment times in the evening. Maybe daytime appointments fair better.

My first tip is that this place, in my opinion is a splurge. Patachou pricing is on the high end of what I like to spend for brunch and this place is even more costly. That's my only complaint. Do I think it is worth it, sometimes. I've been here twice in about 3 years. In part because I live downtown but my biggest deterrent is the price. Every breakfast item is over $13-$15. Coffee is $3.5 per CUP. I had a piece of quiche and a cappuccino (I'd rather upgrade my single cup of $3.50 Joe to a $4.50 cappuccino) and my bill was $19.08 before tip. 

The food here is amazing. Phenomenal even. My quiche was light, airy and creamy. My fruit cup was full of perfectly ripe fruit cut into tiny bite size pieces. The staff was friendly. Heck I got to chat with the chef about food which was great but the dent it made on my wallet is still haunting me. 

My recommendation is to dine her when someone else is paying the tab.
Very helpful and friendly staff. Most amazingly comfortable bed. Extremely clean. Easy to catch cabs.

I like Bubbs although weirdest day to be closed on Monday but that's Catalina for ya. First time I had burnt ends was in Kansas City and they were amazing so tried them at Bubbs and they were yucky BUT second time tender just over sauced and need another name other than burnt ends like steak ends lol.
So cool! They had informational videos and relics from Merica's** past! This is a must see in Philly!

Came here with a group of friends. The food (or at least what we had of it) was delicious. Unfortunately the service was so terrible we left before our entrees arrived. The server had a bad attitude from the beginning. It was at the end of a shift on Valentine's day- so forgivable. However, when we brought it to the managers attention he was defensive and rude. I worked as a front of house manager for a year and a half and dealt with some rude customers. I didn't even think we were being unreasonable (asking to order some appetizers before our entrees). However, rather than trying to smooth things over, the manager was defensive and tried to make us pay for food we hadn't even received. No matter how good the food is, it isn't worth the horrible service.

I used to like this place, but lately every time I've come in their menu is not accurate. Not only are they out of stuff, but they have stuff listed that they have no intention of ever restocking. I have to laugh a bit because of how many times per day they must say "we're out of that". 

Today:
- no pudding toppers (2 listed)
- no grass jelly topper
- no waffles (whole screen of menu dedicated to waffles they do t even have this week)
- no sea salt topper, no plans to make more, still listed in menu 

After a while it just becomes tiresome to come in and try to order things. 

FIX THE MENU PLEASE

Apparently shorts are not allowed at MM after 4pm...but for only certain people. And yes I know they have a dress code on their website which is fine if they enforced it equally. I can't get a seat with nice dress shorts and dress shirt but others allowed with athletic shorts and t-shirt. And it's Tampa in the summer, who enforces pants dress code when it's 900 degrees outside. Berns doesn't even do that. Not really the time to be so selective to potential customers.

I won't repeat the reviews I read on Yelp that convinced me to try Dear Sushi. The positive reviews are correct- friendly, inexpensive, good quality, and clean. Those four words describe my experience. 

Sushi is food, like any other. You can go out all fancy and have some chef blow your mind over a burger too, but you pay for it. I don't have to have my mind blown all the time. I want good, quality food and a reasonable price. Dear Sushi is this place in Donelson. 

I would urge anyone who likes sushi and lives in the area to support these fine folks and keep it open so I can continue to enjoy it.

I leased a Chevy Malibu from Dimmitt and am satisfied with my overall experience and outcome. My initial inquiry was over the phone and I dealt with Will. He made himself readily available and answered all of my questions promptly. That's more than I can say about some of the other dealerships that I called.

Went to Walgreens last night. Was having an issue with my cell phone and needed some advice. Behind the electronics' counter was a fine, bearded young man named Jonathan. He was FANTASTIC!!!! Not only Kind and Super Professional but gave me Excellent advice. I came home knowing once again I received the Best Service at Oddie Walgreens.

First of all, you can have your dog on the enclosed heated patio.  Honestly, this alone would make it 5 stars in my mind.  Derby loved it out there!

Food is good.  Maybe not as tasty as other Cunningham group restaurants but tasty.  Nachos are very inconsistent.  I wish they were served on a larger plate so all chips would be covered in toppings.  Also, more brisket would be nice.  

Burger was great.  Chicken sandwich was great.  Overall, place is great.

You won't be disappointed if you know what you're getting: this place has great atmosphere and decor. It is not a hole-in-the-wall place. They have a liquor license, so you can get things like margaritas. The food is good, but not great. This is the perfect place to sit down and have a meal and drinks with friends, but the food probably won't be the best of anything you've ever had.

Hipster taco bar is what I here on reviews. I live blocks away so I have o go. But here's the thing; Loco Pez isn't like that; Personally I can ignore pretentious people and enjoy the food.  Great nachos.... Love that I can taste a little of each in taco form before ordered as burritos, empanadas or quesadillas, too. And before I forget good margaritas.

After buying a classic truck, I wanted a much quieter sound than it had.  After calling them and telling what I wanted, I took my truck in for the new muffler.  Still, it was too loud and not what I had pictured with the sound.  Ron told me several things they could do, and we agreed on a different muffler system.  Ahhh...perfect! And, for the same quoted price!  Ron, Todd and their team took great care of me and did a outstanding job. I highly recommend them.

They seriously  need a second cashier. Food is good, but the line is long and to get in and out is a pain. People everywhere. Seen about 15 people leave because the waiting in line was rediculous and moved so slow. Wanted extra beer, guess what...stand in line again. Needs some  tweeking on the line system. Food is good but will it out weight this line system for food and drinks. Time will tell.
Great food and really nice looking, also great servers like my boi Kc he really chill and gives a great service

We had high hopes but were disappointed in our overall experience tonight. The major issue was the service. We sat outside and the male waiter seemed like he didn't want to be there (based on a comment he made as well as his attitude thru the whole night). He also wasn't very knowledgeable about the menu and wasn't very attentive or quick. He is in the wrong industry, in my opinion, and should consider changing jobs. 

The food wasn't bad. Salsa was decent. Chips were ok. The tableside guacamole was fine but bland - we had to add our own salt and didn't taste the lime. 

Mahi tacos were decent. A friend got fajitas and it took a few minutes for them to come back with her tortillas and fixings to go along with it, so she sat waiting. 

They were out of all vodka which was shocking. This affected the drink choice for 2 out of 3 of us. 

Overall the service was the main disappointment and I have no interest in coming back unless things really turn around and they get things organized and better staff. Too many other good options out there.  Sorry.

I've visited a few Aldis in/around Indianapolis, and this is by far the nicest and cleanest yet (also probably the largest). I came in just to grab a few items and ended up looking around wishing I had a quarter for a cart or the ability to grow an extra hand. Their selection was quite impressive in regards to fresh fruit & veggies (compared to the other Aldi's I've visited). Despite being in the not-so-nicest area of the near-Southside I can see myself returning.

Needed to get fingerprinting to schedule my real estate exam & found this place. They are open from about 9-5 I believe I'm for sure they close at 5 though. They do take walk-ins as well. I went in and was the only person there so I did not have to wait. I was greeted by Gus who was super friendly. 

The fingerprinting was pretty fast. Whole process took about 3 minutes. I was in an out. He printed off a receipt with my info & stated the result should be ready in about 3 business days. Super easy process. I'd highly recommend!

Trendy, inexpensive, pretty, and tasty, these are all good words to describe Sweet Charlie's rolled ice cream. They have many options as to what to mix in with your ice cream but only one ice cream flavor, vanilla.  This isn't a big deal but when you order your flavors it gives you the impression that the ice cream will be one of those flavors in your selection. Not so. 

I liked the ice cream, I wouldn't go out of my way to go here again because it wasn't really stand out in terms of taste, I would even go so far as to say there wasn't much taste at all, but if you want to try the rolled ice cream fad, it'd be a good place to go because all the toppings are free and it looks sooo pretty. 

I was a little disappointed but my expectations were also very high because I love the Franklin Fountain and they're hard to compete with. 

The service was good, fast and friendly, and you get to watch them roll your ice cream which is very satisfying. There is also room to sit in the back if you want to eat in. I believe they also make gourmet waffles now. They come with all sorts of toppings and looked pretty nice. 

Not a standout place but not bad if you're into the fad.

I absolutely love coming to this place! It's a very small hidden gem right off Gulf Boulevard in Saint Petersburg beach. If you want to get seated right away make sure you arrive at least by 6 PM. Other than that it could be anywhere between a 20 to 30 minute wait. There's only about 10 tables in the restaurant. I totally see what all the hype is about! The steaks are to die for! At a reasonable price! The onion straws and fries are also pretty darn good. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a casual but high-end tasting steak house!
Bayardo was great to me and my guests. He took real good care of us. The food and drinks were on point.. the waitresses were great and the locals were really inviting.  Definitely will visit again.

This was my first experience using professional movers, and I am very impressed with the service my wife and I received from BEK.

The movers (Zach and Ben) were courteous, friendly, polite and knowledgeable. They treated our belongings like they were their own, wrapping everything thoughtfully with the utmost precision. Our stuff arrived in exactly the same shape as it did when we left our apartment. Maybe even better! 

The price we paid was extremely fair and worth every penny. No hidden fees, no surprises and I got everything I was expecting. As someone who had a lot of heavy shit on a 2nd floor apartment, I don't think I could have done it without them. Ben and Zach were young, strong dudes and you could tell they loved their jobs (they both said so!), which showed in their work. Very professional.

Although I don't plan to move again for a very long time, when I do, I'll call BEK.

For my first time here it was good could've been great but somehow they couldn't locate my reservation for a party of 10 for my sons birthday. They spilled water all over my sons plate of food  also. I will say that they made up for it with their service. Food was delicious and I will come back just a little upset that it wasnt great from the start. My rating is a 3.5 out of 5.
I tried the hot chicken wings today. the taste was fine, but the wings are really small.  I don't recommend order wings here.

The food isn't great. I didn't enjoy many of the dishes with the exception of the steamed shrimp dumplings-- the rest of the dishes just weren't good. The sui mai didn't have any flavor and their turnip cakes weren't pan fried but deep fried, nasty. I will not be returning.

They said a 30 minute wait. I found  20 min later that it was because only had 4 server's
 At that  point  I left. The place was not busy.

This Regent Optical location in Chinatown is the only optical place I shop at because they have a huge selection of glasses and sunglasses AND they seem to give you great prices (especially if you are a repeat customer).

It can be intimidating walking in, especially if you aren't Asian. However, don't let that deter you from walking in. There are many staff who speak English,and for the most part they are all friendly - maybe not overly - but are professional and see enough people on a daily basis that they know what they're doing.

We get our yearly eye exams here as well - the most recent visit in September, we were booked in to see Dr. Clement Chan. He's been then most thorough and patient ophthalmologist to date. My husband and I were both happy with his service. The female ophthalmologist though tends to be more rushed and impatient from previous experience.

This past visit, Duong (sp?) was the guy who helped me out with both choosing glasses and sunglasses, was well as when we came back to have our glasses fitted. He was super nice, professional and easy to work with.

They can also direct Blue Cross if you have a Blue Cross plan.

Free street parking out front.

This place was amazing. Great drinks. Awesome mimosas before a flight. Quick, good food. Amazing staff. Look for Colleen. She is amazing to talk to and makes the best drinks. 10s 10s 10s across the board. Come here if you just got off your flight. Or if your waiting for one.

This Lion's Choice has become the WORST and consistently has quality issues. Which saddens me as they used to be high quality with great service. We love Lion's Choice but are so frustrated with this location- we will finally not ever be back. They mess our order up 100% of the time, even when I try to repeatedly confirm with them. It is extremely disappointing.

Charlie, Charlie, Charlie... what can I say. I've tried multiple different items, ones recommended by our host as well as ones not 2 popular. I'll tell you this the food was executed by a culinary genius! However some items I was informed by the chef was unavailable because they were simply "out". Mind u this was Father's Day evening... (At 8pm your out of your classic NY STEAK??? And your a STEAK HOUSE?? )
Regardless it was great service and the food we did get was amazing. Pictures tell it all.. $450+ tip for 3 ppl.
Yeah... I'll run that again

St. Elmo's was good, and definitely has some notable tastes to try. The Shrimp Cocktail - my parents and I got one to share and I'm SO glad we did. It's notorious for the horseradish and it's no joke. This isn't the kind you'll spoon the sauce on, more like if your shrimp has a light shmeer of it, you'll clear all your sinuses. I ordered my steak medium rare, though it came out rather rare. I'd recommended ordering medium if you want medium rare. The tastes were good, and on special occasion I may return, but I'm okay saying that I've experienced St. Elmos - honestly because I'm a huge Parks and Rec fan
I love putting Ike's balls in my mouth, straight up... His snowballs are pretty good too

This is literally a hole in the wall, but when we arrived there were some gentlemen who guided us inside and we were seated pretty quick. The cleanliness of this place was not up to par. There were bugs flying around us the entire time. The home fries looked like lumpy mashed potatoes. The pancakes we're good. My friend ordered shrimp and grits that had so much oil, she had to soak it up with the bread and at that point she didn't even have the desire to eat it. We ordered the peach cobbler in which we had to remind them a few times that we ordered. The peach cobbler wasn't good at all.

Had opportunity to eat here today and was not disappointed.  The food was absolutely delicious!! Bobby, the owner, was great  in checking on us and provided great service. I had the Shrimp Tikka Masala and my wife had Chicken Curry Tikka Masala-- will definitely be going back!
I go here quite often as it's close to my house. They do a good job in/out and much better than Mister.
another great night. Octopus...excellent, addictive. braised short rib, excellent. can't say enough.

This is a wonderful place.  The rooms are lovely and well appointed. The innkeepers, Mark and Paul, are wonderful hosts and make a delicious breakfast.  Great attention to detail is very apparent in the rooms and common areas. We will definitely stay here the next time we're in Tucson.
To have only one cashier and the rest self checkouts is truly poor customer service. There is enough people walking around that could be checking customers out

The staff were great but eating vegetarian here was a disappointment.  The mixed vegetable curry market was mostly gravy--no big vegies. I only recognized some small pieces of carrots. Get on over to the farmer 's and put some vegies in your vegie dishes!
A very crazy place! Very friendly bartenders and great music. We mostly had drinks but also the fried shrimps and it was amazing!

excellent tasting food and the service was pretty friendly. definitely agree that it's a takeout place primarily, but the food is hot, and tastes very good. that's all I really expected, most Jamaican places are like that, so don't expect Steven Star ambience! Jerk chicken is spicy and delicious and agree that the curried goat is superb.

I like each cigar shop I visit more, and Xhale is no exception.  I doubt I'll be looking for another spot.  I stopped in to buy a humidor (which is awesome), and Brad, the owner was really friendly and informative.  He truly has a passion for cigars and want to share that.

The store has a really great selection, and this is the first cigar shop I've visited where I actually wanted to hang out.  Two HD TVs with sports playing and some nice leather chairs are a great touch.  The prices here are decent; they're on par with the quality, which is high.  

I'm looking forward to shopping and smoking here in the near future.
Brandy B was awesome ! Tacos great as usual and guac in point. Great outdoor patio to enjoy while waiting if you have to.

Will never order from here again. Twice we ordered through GrubHub. Twice we got ripped off. The first time they left out the 12 piece shrimp. This time they left off a 12 piece shrimp, and 2 fries. Both times it was cold and the portions were small. For what little we got, considering how much we paid, it's just not worth it.

Some sort of gas line issue foiled my attempts to go back and enjoy Sylvan Park this week. That was unfortunate because it has been much too long since I have been in to enjoy this meat and three, most likely because I take it for granted since I am in the neighborhood.

I think Sylvan Park has taken over other restaurants in town and rebranded them as Sylvan Park. Well, this Sylvan Park Restaurant is actually in Sylvan Park. I would say that just goes to show you what an ace reputation this place has since they are able to go in and call the other restaurants Sylvan Park.

I was first intrigued to go here to sample their delicious pies. Mmmmm, pies. I was not disappointed. Lovely chocolate, perhaps even coconut with great meringue. 

The interior of the place somehow reminds me of my grandmother's kitchen. It is very homey. The food is almost as good as my granny's. Sylvan Park (at least this location) is a stellar example of the meat and three so prevalent around Nashville.

The Smoke and Fire burger is amazing, great local beer selection. Another great addition to downtown STL. Just returned for the second time and the pb&j was the best burger I have ever eaten!  And done forget the homemade ice cream (salted caramel) and the wide selection of the best craft beer the STL has to offer.

This is my go-to spot on Wednesday nights especially in the winter time.  I come for the food and stay for the awesome Quizzo at 8pm with Rob, probably easily the most entertaining quizzo master I've gotten to play with.

Menu wise the food is your average bar food with a few nostalgic classics like grilled cheese and tomato soups and corn dogs.  My favorite thing on that menu though is by far their burger.  Sometimes on their seasonal menu you'll catch my favorite dish I've ever ordered from there which is their poutine. SO FREAKING GOOD! 

Service wise it's great.  My regular waitress that I try to get everytime is Jen, she is bar far the sweetest, attentive and most entertaining waitress I've ever had wait on me.  

This place offers the 3 things that make a restaurant great for me and it's done so consistently. Great food, great service and affordable/fair pricing.


See everyone next Wednesday for Quizzo!

I tend to look for more local places when in need of coffee, as we all should.  I heard through the grapevine to try Birds Nest Cafe, so I decided to check this place out. When arriving, after smiling at the local art in the surroundings and a few art abstracts, I was nicely greeted and already felt my anxiety shiver away. The lady working, Miss Lindsey, steered me in the right direction for my beverage and food choices. My Chai latte was phenomenal, the coconut milk added such an amazing flavor (oddly). I ordered a delicious panini! So cheesy and delightful. Lots of flavors. I'm glad to know this place exists! I will be studying a lot this semester and have found a place where I am most comfortable. Cheers!

Horrible horrible horrible disaster. They threw my entire move cross country  off schedule and I am still paying for the disaster they put me in. They booked another job over mine at the last minute the DAY of my move across country - WOW. Movers I scheduled on the receiving end 1,800 miles away could not reschedule soon, so now I am living in hotels because of Nicolosi's desire to make an extra buck. Jack Jr and Kristina wouldn't tell me what was going on, Jack Jr. said he'd come help, then stories kept changing and they left me hanging for hours. No apologies. I had rented a truck and needed to drive 500 miles that day for an 1,800 mile drive. Didn't happen, 'cause Nicolosi screwed up my entire move and it was too late that day to get the auto trailer hooked up to the truck. So I had to stay in a hotel that night (they didn't pay for that), had to rebook all of my hotels, change my move in date for the new place for after Thanksgiving, will not be able to spend Thanksgiving with family across country, and still can't find movers to hire on receiving end, because everyone is booked and Nicolosi delayed me. Thanks Nicolosi. No mattress bag as Jack had promised several times. Mattress packed left to right, not front to back, so heavy boxes got pushed up against mattress & pushed it out of shape. They put my carbon frame bikes beneath heavy boxes - loaded last!!! Bikes got totally bent out of shape - see photos! Fragile boxes on top in the back with no rope holding them in place. Movers showed up high as a kite and much later than Jack said they would, and didn't give a damn about my time frame. I provided furniture pads AND rope AND ratchet straps and they didn't use all of them, used none of the rope and only half of the ratchet straps, and some of my things were ruined because they weren't padded or strapped in - see photos. They seemed good at packing truck at first, but why expensive bikes in the very back? Awful communication between Jack Sr. and Jr, as Jack Sr. had booked my move and Jack Jr. said it wasn't on the schedule. Never again. I'll use AAA Soto next time.

This little hideaway is worth the trip! I've only had the pleasure at the Trolley location but I love it. I try to stop on my way each time between philly and DC. Love the option of brown or white rice too

I went here for a prenatal massage by Michael and it was a bad experience- first he said he had to look up how to massage a pregnant woman which didn't inspire confidence. Next he said I was much bigger than he was expecting (for the record, I am slender and had a very healthy pregnancy - shows how little experience he had with pregnancy, also not very professional). He also kept talking and talking throughout the whole massage about controversial topics like politics and the economy, so I felt I couldn't relax. Finally, I didn't feel the place was the cleanest...there was hair on all the towels and sheets he used. Oh yeah and he was also dressed like it was his day off, not at all very professional.

Food is amazing!  We shared fried chicken, crawfish, Caesar salad, biscuits, gumbo, and HOMEMADE Hurricanes.  These Hurricanes are the best and made from REAL fruit juice!  Only $5!!!!!! Poppy makes them fresh- no Hurricane on tap here!  Derick was a great waiter and very helpful and nice.  Would recommend coming in and having good food and Hurricanes!!!

Cigar city brewpub was great from the moment we walked in! Our server was great, the beer was refreshing and the food was delicious! I ordered the ropa vieja and had a couple of the lighter beers. I would definitely recommend this place!

This place is immaculate. You walk in, and feel like you walked into an expensive, tranquil oasis. Very clean, professional, relaxing, great selection of colors, well staffed, comparable prices. My only drawback is that I wish they wouldn't have rushed through my manicure, but am more than willing to give them another shot!

Definitely worth stopping in for a great manicure in a beautiful environment.

Sure, I practically had  to park in Ardmore and walk back due to the tiny lot. And yes, since they are the only library for Haverford Township, parents have to fight to the death for the books on the summer reading lists. But I am in need of educational activities for my kids that don't cost a lot and this library fits the bill! From weekly groups like Creative Corner and various story times, to near daily summer programing, we will be there at least twice a week. We will probably be covered in Rita's. Sorry in advance.
I have been bring my dog here her whole life, the level of service and quality job keep me returning! I love the staff and love that they know my dog and always have her looking great!

I know that it's just a starbucks so my expectations are not crazy high or anything, but other reviewers are correct when they say it is slow service here. Although the coffee is fine, the baristas always seem to be in a bad mood to me, and they are ALWAYS out of food items like cake pops and sandwiches. The only reason I keep coming is how convenient the location is to my work. 

Today I ordered a Gouda sandwich and it was falling apart in the bag which irritated me, but I have no idea if that was the fault of the barista. However, I also got espresso con panna and the cup was 90% whipped cream so I couldn't even get to my coffee. I had to open the top and scrape half of the whipped cream out. I guess to be fair, was a generous portion for a small upcharge. 

Something else I would say about the location is it is especially uncomfortable for hanging out in. All there are are hard wooden tables, no soft couches, no space for more than 4 people. The lighting is really weird; it's hard to describe but basically one side of the place is blindingly bright and the other is dingy.

I always stay at the Sands when I come to Reno, and I have to say it's quite cozy. The rooms are a great deal, especially during the week, and the casino offers many member discounts at stuff like the buffets and player's perks with the Player's Card. Speaking of the buffet, the buffet at the Sands isn't too bad. It's themed, with different food offered nightly, like New Orleans on Sundays and various other foods during the week, but the only problem is that the selection of food is a bit small. But it's a great deal for a small amount of money, and the staff is friendly and attentive. The pool at the Sands is large, with a hot tub, ample lounge chairs, and a full bar, but there are pool parties on Friday nights that are meant for adults only, with blackjack tables, bar service, music, volleyball, and bikini contests, so be wary if you're not into that. The rooms are very spacious and clean, and they have also been recently remodeled and updated. Wifi from the hotel is available at a rate of $5.99 per hour, $9.99 per day (24 hours) and $49.99 per week. There is a large keno and bingo room in the casino as well. 

The Sands in pet friendly in one of the towers, but is very strict on dog owners: if you own a dog and want to bring it, it can't be any more than fifty pounds, it must remain in its cage when it's alone in your room, it cannot be a pitbull or pitbull mix, and you have to put down a $50 deposit that I believe is returned upon inspection of your room at checkout. There is also a $15 dollar fee for every day that the dog is with you in your room.

The Sands has many restaurants and cafes, including the 24 hour Mel's Diner, which is a themed 50's style diner. The food is a bit pricy but you're definitely getting what you pay for here; everything is a large portion, especially the desserts, like the brownie sundae, which is not only huge but delicious. Mel's also provides room service for the Sands. There is parking in both the lots surrounding the hotel and the covered multi level garage. I've been coming to the Sands for many years with my family and we've never been disappointed; it's a great deal for a reasonable price.

I have tried a couple of different app. The Vietnamese crepe was good, I just think a little pricey for what it is. Their stuffed grape leaves however were juicy, moist, and left me wanting more. Marana Rock DGC has been considered by many in the disc golf community to be the best Tucson area courses and although I have yet to play any of the other courses, this course is a true treat to play. Especially considering I'm a player from Cali and the desert environment is totally foreign element for me to play in. 

The course is laid out in a water basin which, on this March visit, was dry except some mud near the middle of the basin. While this course is set in the middle of the desert, there's a lot of non-desert elements including some marsh land including green grass and a few pine trees full of pine needles. I could hear the sounds of frogs in the area as well. But most of the course is set in the desert with plenty of holes involving a dry clay riverbed, a monster 800 plus foot hole played out in massive sand dunes, and rocky bluffs. Unexpectedly there are several elevation changes throughout the course. 

Finding the course might be a challenge since there's no real address (the address I used is the one given to me by Google Maps for where the course is closest to). There will be a blue pump station on the right hand side of Coachline / Milligan and a driveway leading to a dirt road. Follow the road to the parking area and park. There's a sign right by the driveway saying "Marana Disc Golf Course". Be sure to wear shoes with traction and bring water since it does get warm even on cooler March days like the one I ventured out on (it got into the upper 70s). 

The course was actually quite hard considering all of the obstacles (trees, bushes, rock mounds, bluffs) you have to deal with. Quite a few long holes with two par 4s mixed into 18 total holes. Tee pads are all nicely put together with cement and very cool numbered tiles to dictate what tee pad goes with what hole. Each hole has a sign and usually there's a marker on what basket position is in play. The course has some really impressive views of Marana's desert landscape including mountain views with cactus lining the mountain ridges. Like any non-urban course, be sure to be aware of where your walking as reports of snakes (including rattlesnakes) and other wildlife have been known to cruise the area. A few of the tee areas have shade and benches, so you can take breaks from the desert sun. 

I think Marana Rock is still a mostly unknown course since only a handful of people were out on a Sunday afternoon playing. Most people here in So. Cal who know of some of the more popular AZ courses (Fountain Hills, Vista Del Camino) have never heard of this course. It's really a shame this course isn't played by more people since it's really a trip of a course. On the way to Pheonix or coming into Tucson via the 10, Marana Rock is a must stop for any disc golfer looking for a unique experience.

I came back again, and my family tried the meat lovers pizza. Absolutely, delicious and the price is the best around. The ingredients were fresh and you get the perfect amount of each of the meats. Jad's doesn"t take short cuts, so please support this establishment.

Ordered delivery. Great salads in the mixed meze, with the exception of the hummus, which was pretty bland and tasteless. The pita bread was good and they give you a lot of it. This place is perfectly fine! Stayed here with my husband for 2 weeks when we moved back to mainland America. The rooms, bed, bathroom are clean! Maid services daily.
