BEWARE OF FAKE REVIEWS!! Another yelper messaged me after I wrote this listing describing another customer who had a very similar experience to mine. She also found out that Chelsey was fired from her previous salon because she didn't live up to standards. She may have a lot of friends who write fake reviews, but please don't be fooled like I was!

Review Below:
1. I am a true lost cause when it comes to styling hair. Going to the salon for me is normally a great experience, mostly because I get to learn a new way to style my hair. I told Chelsey at least 5-6 times in different ways that I am clueless about styling my hair and I really look forward to seeing how she styles my new haircut. 

Instead, when the haircut was over, she sort of played with my hair, moved it around a little then no joke, literally says: "I don't know what to do with this. Why don't you style it. I hate when other people style my hair." Trust me, I remember EXACTLY what she said, because I was in such shock. Imagine, telling a stylist you need help styling, then they make you style your own hair in the salon! She even handed me the hairspray and said: "Here, you try," after I also requested some suggestions about products to use beyond hairspray. What bothers me even more, is that she gave me a haircut that she couldn't even style. If she, the expert, couldn't do anything with it, what am I expected to do with my plebian hair styling skills?

2. I had two photos of the cut I wanted. At the end when I was styling MY OWN HAIR, I went to look at the photos I brought to help me figure out how to style, at which point Chelsey says: "Oh, you can't style it like that because your haircut is too short." Well, it wasn't too short when I came in. Even worse, she says this in a strangely snarky way with attitude insinuating that it was somehow my fault that she cut my hair too short. The two photos were two different ways to style. Surprise, she couldn't style it either of the ways in either photo. 

I have absolutely been to the salon before and left with a cut different from what I asked for. In those circumstances, however, the stylist at least styled my hair and made it look good (not to mention was polite). Here, I was left to the wolves without even an effort on her part and left the salon looking like a mess (because, like I said, I suck at styling my hair). 

Part II
When I arrived, Chelsey looked at the two photos I brought without saying anything, so I tried to discuss what I wanted from each. She still didn't say anything until I asked her, "do you think you can do this, and do you think this will look good?" She finally responded in a strange monotone and said, "yeah, this will be fun." And she took a photo so we could do a before and after. 

We began and I thought her strange monotonic, apathetic affect was perhaps a result of her genius, based on others' raving reviews. I don't need personality in a hairdresser, in fact, I prefer not to talk at all. But this was quite a strange, non-communicative experience. I discussed the great reviews, which brought me to her, and she said, "yeah, I'll definitely cry when I get my first bad review." This makes me wonder now if she says something like that to all of her customers in order to dissuade dissatisfied customers from writing a negative review because they know they'll hurt her feelings. 

I hate to be the bad guy, but I'd rather save the feelings of future customers than to hurt one person's feelings who was so extremely inept with my cut. 

Regarding the before and after photo, I'll let you guess if she took an after photo of her lovely work.  (answer is no-and I don't wonder why)

As I was struggling to style my own hair, she said- "why don't you give it a week and if you want it changed, you can come back. You'll probably get used to it in a week" (like having a haircut she couldn't even style was something I just needed to get used to...). This was also code for, you need to leave, at which point I paid, left a large tip (because it did take her almost 2 hours..to get nowhere), and left. 

I also have the misfortune of having fine hair that gets greasy really easily. When asking for suggestions about the best way to reduce my greasy mess she straight face recommended I damage my hair by bleaching it because the damage would make it look less greasy. RED FLAG, you can bleach hair WITHOUT severely damaging it! If you are a hairstylist saying this, maybe this should be a customer concern.

At least there was wine, I probably would have left a sobbing mess

Cute place. Feels more like a fast food type than a gourmet burger place. Heavy burger and grill smell inside, unfortunately sticks to the clothes. 

Didn't have their regular fries so I took sweet potato tater tots. Ehhh. I love sweet potato fries. It the tots were not that good. Their inside felt... Mashed. 

Got the regular cheeseburger though they have a very nice selection of burgers and tons of toppings. Burger was good, the meat, the cheese, heavy on the mayo and ketchup which I love! For some reason it had a cucumber inside. It was partly pickled. It not all the way. I dunno, was kinda wierd. I ate it separately and left the burger to be a burger. 

Good fair pricing. 
A nice burger place.

I must say that i have a great meal every time i come to Kalamatas.  This time I had to ask them for help because i cannot eat dairy.  I had a chicken pita with Greek dressing and roasted potatoes.  It was fresh (as always!) and delicious. Their ice tea is always fresh too.   So different than other Greek restaurants and so much more authentic.  
Thanks to the staff for making it a pleasant experience!

We had a FANTASTIC tour
Evian is a fantastic guide!!! 
He was funny and informative.
His knowledge of the houses and cementery was wonderful, 
He had a open and responsive manor that was very entertaining too.
Our group had a wonderful time and would recommend him anytime!

First time visiting the Staff was ever friendly and speak of knowledge of weapons.    The Building was set up A+ 
everything clean and will organize.

Absolutely amazing tacos! I got three of them and the price per size wad perfect....the taste was off the scale! There is a reason this is top rated taco place in Tampa. I pulled up late on a Sunday night and the owner was about to close shop. He stopped and gladly made me my tacos. Could not be happier! Do yourself a favor and come here to get the flavor!

I love this place. So happy to finally find a great Thai place. The staff is so sweet, they know us by name :) The food is always perfect. I recommend the chicken pad thai, fried tofu & THAI TEA!! If you're looking for thai food, GO HERE!!

I stopped in for a quick breakfast during my Saturday morning shopping at Reading Terminal. Ordered the smoky andouille Po Boy. The food was tasty and loved the fresh bread. Cool seating area in the middle of the terminal makes for a nice touch.
Great size  sandwiches.baked fresh bread with some really nice choices.  Great service.  Its not deli town, but they will get there.

Incredible selection of oils and vinegars. One better than the next. Flavors you never knew existed!

You get to taste everything before you buy it and you can buy different sizes depending upon your needs. 

Not the low end stuff you get in the grocery stores. High end great products without having to spend a fortune on shipping and reasonably priced to boot!

Really good customer service and suggestions form this family run business.

Love the raspberry balsamic. Will be doing more shopping here tomorrow.

Highly recommend this store to anyone looking for really good quality products and selections.

I was pleasantly pleased with the Covid measures taken place at the DMV. It was a bit frustrating to have to take an Appt so far out... a bit over 3 weeks because that was what I could get... But with an Appointment I walked right in they asked for my appointment number checked my temperature and allowed me to walk to the check in counter. I was given a number and waited about 35 minutes for my number to be called. When I got to the window the woman was friendly and quick doing her best to get me in and out quickly so I could go on about my day. I had checked beforehand to make sure what documents I might need and I had no issues. This was a good experience. Everyone I came across was friendly and helpful.

Sooo much potential, but overall wasn't a very clean location. Out of multiple sauces.. no ranch (key item to the hipcity ranch chicken sandwich), no aioli, and no hip city sauce). How does that even happen? Then charge to add buffalo sauce since they didn't have the sauce it should have come with!! Do better, HipCity!

Myself, wife and daughter went for Sunday brunch. First and foremost, the bang bang shrimp here is not to be missed. With this in mind, I ordered the bang bang Benedict which really was just ok... I wouldn't order it again. My wife, however had the saucy shrimp and grits and damn, loved it. Most of my reason for this review was the service. Our waiter, Mike, nailed it. This was the closest to perfect service I've had in a very long time. Informative but not pushy, just the right amount of conversation while also just letting us enjoy the meal.

Jacob was the DJ for our wedding on Oct 1, 2016 at the Florida Aquarium. He was absolutely wonderful, and all of our guests had a great time! My husband and I wanted to do some fun variations on traditional wedding music, and he had all the options we could've wanted. He was very professional, and really helped us lay out our entire wedding day in the easiest and most fun way possible. 

The music was fantastic, our dance floor was always full, and he also played some fun games with us and our guests that kept everyone entertained all night. We highly recommend him for any wedding or event!

Everytime I go to Zahav I am blown away again and again. The food is still absolutely fantastic. The menue changes slightly everytime giving you something new to try. The service is always fantastic. We went for my mother's birthday and every person that came to our table wished her a happy birthday.  To top of an evening of fantastic world class food and service we got to meet the man himself. Micheal was so nice. It was great to see him still making sure everything was running the way it should. Still the top restaurant in philly in my book.
Love this place.. great authentic Italian food, friendly staff.  Ossmuy and Maila were welcoming and on top of the refills. Definitely recommend and will be coming back.

Bait and switch here all the time. Online inventory is a joke. "Let's put all these deals online that show we have them, say you have to pick it up in the store, and then not have it!!!" Employees then laugh and say "Can I interest you in something that costs $100 more?" Hahahaha, joke is on me, I'm done with you Target.

This place was so awesome! I'm so impressed with the authenticity of it. At first, it's a little confusing trying to figure out where to go to order food. I ordered the Philly Cheese Steak and it was fabulous! It tasted so fresh. I sat at the coffee bar and ate my sandwich. When I was done, I ordered the most amazing iced Latte. It tastes like real coffee with some flavoring. I've never been so happy with a meal before.

I'm a regular love this place I always ask for Janis , Jeff , or Cora as servers love them always friendly and professional ,but I generally enjoyed dining here, fun atmosphere  for games ,nothing fancy good solid food .... Fish tacos, lobster Mac , and the crab dip are a few of my favs. Gets really packed for games so get there early

NO STAR!!!  I've been coming here for almost 2 years because of convenience. I tolerated the cleaning and the poor customer service. And now I'm not going back for GOOD! They just LOST my $395 Rag and Bone favorite pants. The pants were less than a year old and I wore them only 3 times. After 2 MONTHS of trying to get answers from the owner they offered me a fee for replacement, a fee that was a fraction of the original amount. They (owner Tim) NEVER talked to me about the fee. I'm sure hoping for me to just be okay with the amount HE decided.  They don't care about customer service or doing good work, so why should they care about your clothes? Advice..DON'T SUBJECT YOURSELF OR YOUR CLOTHES to them. There are many great cleaners out there who understand the importance of customer service and doing good work.  I'm willing to drive a little bit further to go to them.

Overall, we had a great time dining on a Sunday night. We made reservations and couldn't get anything earlier than 8:15 PM, and spent about 2 hours dining. There is only valet parking available, which was easy enough and they had 2 valet stands available to leave your car; however, the number of people valeting seemed to clog up the side street, so give yourself a few extra minutes and bring a few dollars to tip. When we arrived inside, our table wasn't yet ready so we went to the bar area. The bar wasn't terribly crowded (there were open seats) but it took quite a long time for staff to take our order. The bartender did apologize for the wait, which was appreciated. We got our drinks and waited about 5 more minutes before being seated at our table in a large back room. We had plenty of space and our servers were nice. One thing I was a bit disappointed in was that we asked for assistance in ordering a bottle of wine and the server didn't seem to know much about what they served -  we gave a few specifications about what we were looking for to drink with dinner and were told "a pinot grigio or a sauvignon blanc is probably what you want." We were disappointed that he couldn't make quality suggestions, especially since we were told by the serving assistant that he was for all intents and purposes a sommelier, and since they had about 10 of each kind. ANYWAY, that was really the only issue with the service - overall, the meal was spaced out well, the duck tacos were delicious, our meat came out perfectly, the parmesan fries were delicious, we wound up loving our wine, and our meals were served with buttered rolls that were divine. In between courses, they brought out small tastes of things (goat cheese on a cracker; sorbet as a palate cleanser), compliments of the chef and those were very nice touches. For a quality steakhouse, the prices are very good and they didn't rush us at all. We felt well taken care of, aside from bar service and not being able to recommend wine. The portions were great and we truly enjoyed the evening.

Never bring your phone to this place for a repair. I broke my camera lens and brought it here to be repaired. The person who fixed my phone had no idea what he was doing and severely screwed it up. The camera lens was worsened after the repair than it had been before I took it in. So I demanded that he remove it, and I demanded a refund for the $70 I paid for a shoddy work. He removed it, causing even more further damage to the camera lens. Now Apple has told me that fixing it will cost me $599, and whomever fixed it earlier didn't know what they were doing. He even scratched the camera lens and poked several of the inter camera lenses. 
Thank to you now my phone value is 0$ worth! Wasted of my damn time!! Be aware people!!!

Finally, sushi and Asian cuisine in Apollo Beach. Variety and quality of sushi is fantastic. Other menu dishes are delicious. Been looking for good Asian food since I moved to Tampa a decade ago. Finally found it.

Found another gem.  An alternative to downtown Hermitage Cafe if you do not want the traffic.  Great homestyle food with neighborhood atmosphere. Customers know each other and a blue collar hangout. Good portions and excellent personal service. Will be back often as it closer to home. Definitely a hole in the wall find.

Definitely a place that needs more Yelp presence. I learned about this place on a radio ad and as I was looking for good darts from some place without a copper dome I found myself here. Walking into this place is like a step back into time. 

I played pool off and on in college, but one time, one God forsaken, time I challenged my dad  in the local VFW, a man who hadn't seen a pool table in 25 years or so. I took one shot, sank zero balls and my then 68 year old father ran the table.  This is the sort of place he frequented in the 50's. 

The owner gave me a great deal on my darts when you combine the expertise I received in the selection. If I knew precisely what I needed Amazon would be better, but I didn't. I got a great deal and great service. Pool seemed ridiculously cheap here too. Something like 5 bucks per hour for tables and cue rental. Patrons seemed upstanding and friendly. 

I may take my 78 year old dad here and see if I can sink one legitimately.

Hard to say too much about carry out, but I really enjoyed the pizza. The crust was crispy on the outside and soft in the middle, the tomato sauce was sweet-ish but seasoned well, the cheese was well, I don't know what you say about cheese ... it was cheesy?

The shop is a few doors up Third from Market, which pulls it just out of the "mainstream" enough that it may not get much notice, but it's worth trying for your pizza-eating needs in Old City.

I usually go to the deptford mall to get bubble tea as I don't feel like driving all the way to Philly. This place actually makes authentic bubble tea, I tried the Thai and my boyfriend tried the original bubble tea. We also got the shrimp and bacon ball with their cheese steak rolls. The sauce that comes on the side is sweet with a slow heat. This is my new favorite place to come too as they have a lil of everything. Also they have rolled ice cream which the only other place I knew of close to here was in Collingwood. Looking forward to bring family, friends, and coworkers here.

A few friends and I came here. We wanted to do the tasting menu but to be honest it was a little overwhelming. We decided to ask the server of the chef would pick our courses and it was the absolute best decision. No time spent having everyone agree on 10 dishes and the chef even gave us a few courses that were not even on the menu. Would definitely come back!

One of my favorite places on earth! This place is spectacular for so many reasons. You can explore on your own and experience marvelous artisan items, like fresh bread, pastries, jams and jellies, candies, produce, and dairy items. However, you can also come here with a large group and please everyone with their cuisine of choice!

I've been here twice. The first time I was with just a friend, and we really enjoyed the shopping experience. The second time I was chaperoning an eighth grade field trip, and it was the first time the whole week that nobody complained about food because everyone was able to get what they wanted. (Unfortunately, I made the poor choice of going to Tokyo Sushi....avoid at all costs!). There are even vegetarian and vegan options at most locations. You can find something for everyone, and then you can all eat together in one of the several seating areas and enjoy the vibrant ambiance of the market!

See this is why I love yelp. I would have never found this place without you guys. Right off E. Washington, this place is not easy to spot, a larger sign would help Dan, I got in right before closing time and entered through the kitchen. I'm here! 

On the menu board you have Mississippi and Louisiana, the wife and I both went Louisiana, I got a bowl of Jambalaya and should have got a cup, huge portion, she got the red beans and rice/w half order of gumbo we also got a side of dirty rice for the kid. Everything was excellent, this is real deal Louisiana cooking. All the sides you would expect they even have gator. 

Everybody is gracious and welcoming, prices are fair, place is inviting, two thumbs up for Chef Dan.

I went two days ago. I was looking for greeting cards: sympathy and congratulations to a high school grad, Sudoku books and dark chocolate.

I found them all.

I was concerned about the greeting cards, but I found two cards that perfectly expressed my sentiment. And they were 2/$1.

Skip Hallmark's $3.99 cards, and go here.

Two Sudoku books were acceptable. They didn't have many.

Dark chocolate. 3.5-ounce bars for $1. Have one ounce of dark chocolate every day, and you're good. Right? Well, if you eat more than one ounce, it could be troublesome. I'm holding on the one ounce.

Joey was the checkout guy. He is so personable and talkative. WHERE does Dollar Tree find these great clerks? I'm baffled. But it makes for an incredibly wonderful checkout situation.

For some reason, I always turn to pho as my hangover cure and this place always delivers. The service is fast. The vietnamese iced coffee is strong. And the pho is always delicious. Alternatively, I love the vermicelli special with pork and spring rolls whenever I want a change from the pho. This place is super accommodating and great for larger groups!

When your a small hands on family owned restaurant you can put the little details into your restaurant and that's the best thing about this place.   The beef is  hand selected by the owner and is A+++. You cannot beat the price for what you get.  Everyone there was so nice and attentive and fun to talk to but not overly talkative or informative that you couldn't enjoy the company you came with.  We sat at the bar for dinner and David the bartender was so knowledgeable and eager to make us the perfect drinks.  
I don't know if everyone working there is family but by their attitudes and love for the business I would have to say yes or the owner treats them like family because it shows in their pride for what they do.  We cannot wait to return.

First time in and the person who greeted me was friendly and helpful. Restroom was clean and tables were clean and neat. The hot and sour soup had a great flavor and texture. The Kung Pao Chicken was very good as well.  Going to try Cow Fun next time!

We have eaten here on numerous occasions and have never had a bad experience. I've eaten beef and chicken a few times and enjoyed it, however I think the seafood is where Ozona Blue shines.

Service is sometimes a little slow if they are busy but It's always been friendly. 

Perfect deck and bar area for watching the sunset over the marina. 

Added attraction:  watch the bats that inhabit the boat garages take flight at dusk!

I don't like to review chain restaurants usually because it's pretty pointless , but this place pisses me off.. I understand that I'm not going to get FRESH seafood but there is no reason it should be that bland .. I know it's microwaved bullshit, but it takes a special talent to make every thing on the menu taste exactly the SAME . I don't mind paying good money for quality , but how can they charge these kind of prices and put out the garbage they put out. They make a big point of telling you about how fresh and seasoned their seafood is , they omit the part about the crab legs being rubbery and bland .. I blame myself for  actually coming to this place and I will make damn sure it never Happens again..

After the insanity and huge Miller Lites found on Bourbon Street, it's nice to find a place off the beaten path with a calmer mood and a divine beer selection.

The walk from the French Quarter might be a little "interesting" for some people, but we enjoyed seeing different aspects of New Orleans. You can take the trolley out there as well. 

We came during happy hour and saved a few bucks off the American beers. I got to try some local beers that's I've never had before. The Southern Pecan was my favorite.

If you're into good beers and a cozy old-school vibe, you'll love this place!

I saw a 2015 Genesis sedan loaded up and listing for $55000. It was on special for $37900, an amazing deal. I called the dealer and they said that the figure reflected all the rebates available. I asked for the actual price. The woman calked back quoting a figure $10,000 higher than the "special" claiming it was a misprint. Here's the funny thing. As of today, this car has been for sale 220 days and the price has never changed. Now would a reasonable person believe that they haven't corrected an error over a seven month period? Or is it more likely that they willfully misstated the price of the car? I've seen other reviews posted by folks who went to the dealer only to be told about the "mistake." I'm inclined to call them dishonest and deceitful. Buyer be ware!
Well balanced fun and learning activities for toddlers! All the staff are friendly and they really care about your child.

Close to, if not my favorite restaurant in philly. Carne asada, and tres leches, with a bottle of our own wine. I really can't say anything negative about this place. Want to go back and try more stuff!

I always loved Five Guys and this is consistent with the ones I've been to DC. Five Guys is probably the best fast-casual burger chain in the East Coast, but the best east coast burger may still have to go to burger joint or shake shack. Unless you want the restaurant style burger, which is a whole different argument. 

My issue with all Five Guys is that a double cheeseburger is the cost of a whole meal including fries and a drink anywhere else, and I also love Chick-Fil-A which happens to be across the parking lot from this location. 

I would beg Five Guys management wherever that is located to consider the idea of having value "combos."

Wow, I should have read the reviews before coming here. Def would not return.

I waned the flautas with pulled pork but they didn't have pulled pork and I was even trying to touch the ground beef. So instead I ordered the ropa vieja which I've had Several times and LOVED (@alma de cuba). 
It was literally as bad as you can get.

Rice was poorly cooked. The menu stated that the beef would be simmered with veggies..I did NOT see any veggies on my plate...just salty dry pulled beef. There was refried beans that didn't make the grade.
It was soo bad. I hardly even touched the plate.

Anyway, this place is cheap. But I beg you to save your money- add it up and go to Alma de cuba OR even El Vez.

Or go to taco bell...at least u only spend $3 and you sorta know what you are getting.

I have used Best Choice several times in the last 10 years for small repairs and projects.  They were always friendly, on time and easy to work with.  They always offered free estimates and were affordable.  At one point, I was so comfortable with them as my "go to plumber" I wouldn't even get additional estimates.

But things have changed.  Last year I called and their quote seemed really high for a repair.  That led me to make a few more phone calls and another 2 quotes came in much lower.  So I learned my lesson.  Even though I like them, in the future continue to get 3 quotes because I can no longer trust they will value me as a customer.

Moving forward...I called again this week to get a quote on a different repair.  Service with the administration was awful.  It took 3 phone calls this week just to clarify I can't meet during certain times.  That's a bit upsetting because we went over this on the initial phone call.  Sloppy admin. work is always a turnoff for me.  I feel like that's the face of the company and if they can't take care of me in the office they won't take care of me with the repair.  To make it worse they originally told me it was a free estimate but then later told me they will charge a $150 diagnostics fee.  As stated in the initial phone call, I don't want the radiators diagnosed I want them changed from baseboard to cast iron heaters.  Plus I needed my water heater looked at.  She said I must have been misquoted initially.  There is a charge for this.  In all my years I have never paid a diagnostics fee to Best Choice so this was very upsetting to learn.  

I hate writing any type of negative review.  But if you want to run your loyal customers away this is exactly how you do it!  Poor customer service and overcharging means I will be looking elsewhere.  I don't know if management or ownership has changed but they just aren't what they used to be.  I've called several other reputable, certified plumbers.  Not a single one of them charges a $150 diagnostics fee.  I scrolled through other reviews and I only see responses from Best Choice to the negative ones (mostly excuses on why the review is negative instead of trying to set a positive tone and fixing the situation).  I don't see any responses to positive reviews thanking customers.  In my opinion that is a reflection in itself of where Best Choice is at with their customer service.  I hope Best Choice can get it together.  At one point they were a really, really great company.

I wandered in during lunch for a different dining experience in Mid-City.  I wound up being pleased with what I found.  

I started off with a simple, but yummy Caesar Salad (standard fare), then followed up with Baked Buffalo Wings & Pesto Wings.  The Baked Buffalo Wings had some sort of rub on them & were decadent.  The Pesto Wings were pretty good, too.

Will definitely revisit for lunch, as I'm sure that, being primarily a bar, this place gets rowdy at night.

The first time I went I had a lackluster experience.  Maybe I ordered the wrong things?  But my 2nd visit was AMAZING!  There were 3 of us and we ordered a full slab, beef brisket, and chicken.  Ribs were hands down the best thing we had.  Meat so tender and flavorful.  Brisket was a little dry and chicken was just "eh" in my opinion but the kids enjoyed anyway.  The sauces and sides enhanced the meal.  Can't wait to go back!

Unfortunately, I wasn't impressed.  Was not crowded at all, but they seemed disorganized and aloof.  Chicken itself was good (tasty and juicy), but I was really craving mashed potatoes....no such thing.  Mac and cheese wasn't fantastic.  I asked for butter for my corn muffins and she looked at me like I was asking for a jar of cyanide.  Too bad...I was really disappointed.

I dont know if it was me but I had the shrimp poboy here on Super Bowl Sunday and yes the shrimp were huge and overstuffed but the sandwich had no taste. It was just alot of bread and tasteless shrimp with the batter coming all off. I already have a problem with their tasteless water based roast beef and now the shrimp has fallen off. Unfortunately one of my favorite places is swiftly turning into a tourist trap.
Had to get tire plugged in short amount of time.  The crew came through for me.  Have had my wife's car and mine there as well and every time the service we get is great.

This was our first time and it definitely won't be our last!  Seriously good food with fresh ingredients.  The ribs were moist and saucy and the porcetta sandwich was incredible.  
It was a Saturday night and we couldn't figure out why this place wasn't busier.
A hidden gem, however the addition of a more eclectic decor to go with their outstanding food would make it more of a dining experience!
this place is now "permanently closed"! despite "open" on website, phone number also disconnected!

Was really disappointed on their "company policy" what kind of hotel says you have to stay for a minimum of three nights? I'm sorry people work and might not be able to get that extra day off. I was so excited to stay here, too -- what a huge disappointment.

Nothing short of amazing!  My wife and I were in tampa on vacation and let me tell you, Athony the manager was noting short of amazing. Very friendly and the food is amazing. Anthony really made us feel like family. Will absolutely be back!!

I visited the German American Society for their annual Oktoberfest held over several weekends in October.

The festival includes a band that plays German music and  other varieties of music to get the crowd moving.  There is a large dance floor in the middle of the event and there were definitely people dancing and having a great time.

They serve two varieties of German beer including Oktoberfest and a lighter option.  They also serve several food options including potato pancakes, schnitzel, bratwurst, German potato salad, sauerkraut and more.

Admission is $10 per a person and a pitcher of German beer is $18 which is a bit steep but there is a Groupon available for $26 that includes admission for two, a pitcher of beer and two potato pancakes.  Steal!!

If you are looking for something to do on the weekends in October check out this event!

went there tonight Sunday 06/09/19 had a great dinner with my daughter 
food was good service was great and the management even threw in some extras at no charge will be going back again thanks to the management and our servicer...

Dined here this afternoon. Two out of the four of us were gluten free, but we all ordered off the gluten free menu so we could share. As one of the non-GF diners,  I COULD NOT tell the difference. The pasta was fresh (made in-house) and delicious. We sampled the vodka penne, chicken parmesan, house marinara, and mac and cheese. All delicious. As were the mozzarella sticks and chicken fingers. What a pleasure it was to ALL be able to share our meals. None of us felt left out. Also, the server was wonderful, friendly and happy to share the history of her family's choice to offer so many gluten-free options. We will definitely be coming back, and I think we have found our gluten free caterer for our daughter's wedding. So happy that this is so close to home.  :)

Massimo's is an absolute gem. Coming in from NY to visit family and it is not easy to find similar quality italian food. This restaurant does not disappoint! Massimo works tirelessly to serve the highest quality food. From Dover Sole to Osso Buco, you will not go home hungry! Great service too!!

I totally disagree with the majority! Even though Giovanni's is is about a mile from where I live, is clean & friendly, their gelato is not as creamy or flavorful as Frost. I've had REAL Italian gelato & Frost is the closest I've found around the many other places I've tried. This is just my opinion & everyone's tasting ability is different so I'm glad from those who like Giovanni's!

No parking in Walmart parking lot!!!
So I got up early this morning to get to Walmart and beat the crowds, however they don't open till 7 AM. Which was very disappointing. 
How many times do you go to Walmart and you can't find a parking spot up close.   well I was here at 6:15, the entire parking lot on one side was full . WHY???? because the employees park there for the day. You would think that a Big chain like Walmart would request for their employees to park further out in the parking lot to leave the spaces closer to the store for customers. 
I really hope that Walmart reads these reviews and this can be addressed. Especially for elderly people who now have to walk further to get into the store.
I LOVE THIS PLACE! It's a really cute place and general sanders is my favorite! I think it's a little pricey but everything on the menu is really fresh and good

This is one of my new favorite spots in Berry Hill. As a first timer, I decided to go with the classic "Vodka Rocks," which comes with a sour lime cordial, lime wedge and a heavy pour of the incredibly smooth Big Machine vodka. The drink was delicious and smooth with a noticeable yet not overwhelming bite from the lime. The soda rounded off things, making for a simple yet tasty cocktail.

The full bar is suited for fans of all types of alcohol -- craft beers, whiskeys, gin, etc. Even the nonalcoholic options sounded good (coffee).

The service was great. The interior is intimate and relatively small. Parking is limited (all the more reason to take Uber or Lyft). While I didn't eat during this visit, there were several items on the menu that caught my attention.

I can't wait to go back and try some of the more adventurous cocktails.
Coming here to ABC Title will indeed save you time and less stress than going to the DMV. Save yourself the headache and go to ABC Title, it's really is scary fast!

On my first visit I was not really impressed,but I will give it another try. I ordered the vegetable soup which to me was totally flavorless.  It tasted like someone had strained hot water through a sock full of vegetables and threw a scan't handfull of unseasoned rice and raw vegetables in it. 

Also they advertise a vegan wrap but they only have a honey wheat tortilla to wrap it in.  Hopefully they will realize that honey is NOT vegan and will have maybe a spinach or regular white tortilla in the future.   

I did notice a good selection of fresh veggies, and salads with nuts, dried fruits that looked really appetizing.  I will keep that in mind in the future.

I will give them another try, but I certainly won't order the water soup again or I won't get the wrap until it is actually vegan.  I had anticipated the rice bowls but I am a bit concerned that they will be as flavorless as the soup.

Stopped in after our RUN317.  Atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming even though our party of three were likely the sweatiest and stinkiest in the joint!  I ordered a veggie burger which was just ok.  Needed some spice to make it awesome.  Again...my love of sweet potato fries was happy.  

Dessert...yes...do it!!!  And order the funnel cake fries.  The are delicious!!
This one star goes to the pictures of the Huevos Rancheros I have seen. A plain omelette with canned enchilada sauce is not "Huevos Rancheros."

I wasn't very impressed. I asked for unseasoned fries and was told they are pre seasonsed. I asked about the chips and was told they are barbecue which I thought was an odd choice for chips. I have a severe garlic allergy and asked if the coleslaw had garlic and was told they 'just threw away the container' so they didn't know. Apparently they only have one container of coleslaw. I ended up with the grilled cheese, which was just a lot of cheese on white bread.Definitely not my kind of place.

I'm in town for a tradeshow and travelling solo, so I was looking for something laid back and informal.

I got there around 6:30 on a Monday and while it definitely wasn't full, it wasn't empty either.  Happy hour goes until 7, so that was a nice bonus. (They have $4 drinks and $4 snacks.)

After way too much deliberation, I went with the shrimp and chorizo tacos with a side of mac and cheese (couldn't resist after all the reviews).  Both were delicious!  I'd order either again in a heartbeat.

I just got back from my first visit to the brand new Walmart Supercenter here in town.  Finally, the North Valleys have a Walmart!  What's more, the North Valleys finally have a major shopping presence.  The opening was this morning and it was a very festive occasion with a pretty decent turnout from the locals. 

The store is beautiful and the location around it is visually striking.  There was an abundance of employees and suits on hand to welcome the shoppers and ask if any assistance was needed.  The store is clean and organized, as is expected from a brand new store.  

The layout is a bit different from the other stores in town that I'm accustomed to shopping at.  It's going to be a while before I become fully comfortable with it and know where to find the paper towels automatically.  The grocery section is well stocked with the usual suspects however, I did notice that the coffee creamer selection was pretty limited compared to the other Walmarts in town. Nothing major but it definitely registered on my radar.  It made me wonder what other selections might be limited.  Time will tell when I do my first major grocery shopping trip there later this month.  

The employees seemed very friendly, of course, I'm sure a lot of that was due to it being opening day.  But on the whole, I would say they were as excited as the shoppers.  It made for a very fun atmosphere to shop in, though I did get a little tired of being asked how they could help me by about the 10th time.  

The food vendor this particular location is Subway sandwiches which was neither a foregone conclusion nor a surprise.  We already have two Subways up here and two McDonald's so either vendor would have been rather superfluous.  I wish they could have found a different vendor to work with, even though I know Walmart tends to default to Subway or McDonald's these days.  Some variety would have been nice. 

It'd also be nice if they had some place to get a hot cup of coffee.  I sure would have liked it this morning.  Maybe Subway serves coffee, if so I didn't see any obvious signs to that effect.  

The biggest mark against this location is the utter lack of self-checkout lanes.  There are NONE to be found.  Each side of the store has some "speedy" checkout lines (none of which were at all speedy when it came time to check out, by the way), but the lace of self-checkout is a major problem.  That disappointed me more than anything else.  

There's some room for improvement here, to be sure, but I think on the whole it's a great store.  The parking lot is laid out thoughtfully and is easy to navigate, the store looks great inside and out and the experience is rather pleasant.   I'm sure my review will change as time goes on but I wanted to get this out there!

Capogiro gets much acclaim for its interesting and off-beat gelato flavors.  I haven't been there more than three or four times in the last few years, but each time, I'm never impressed.  Most recently, I stopped in with a few friends on a busy Saturday (it was Midtown Festival).  We tried a few flavors and finally decided on a small fig and kiwi-- the acidity of the kiwi should have balanced well with the fresh, rich, sweetness of the fig.  Unfortunately, the two flavors were muted by a creamy fattiness that did not leave me feeling pleased or satisfied.  

The price was somewhat high for such a small serving, but I suppose that is to be expected for such a well known place.  They were kind enough to let us sample several flavors without much question, though.  

Maybe I'm a naysayer, maybe I'm overly critical.  The bottom line is that capogiro has some inventive flavors, executes consistently, but it's good, not very good, and not great.

The wings, the jerk, teriyaki, and the hot were all amazing. Delicious, and now I am on the hunt to find some wings like it in STL. 

They serve the full menu at the bar and the bar is not as loud as I imagined it would be.

They play good music, no twangy country that only appeals to one type of crowd. 

The bartenders were very nice and lots of fun. We had just gotten engaged a couple nights before and they were offering to take pictures of us and oooohing and aaaahhhing over the ring and congratulating us. 

The specialty drinks are expensive, so pick something you KNOW you probably won't find a variation of anywhere else, especially if you are not from the area. I got the Jamey's Ginger. It is like a Moscow Mule except with Jameson. It will kick your booty. 

We had amazing food, excellent service, and I am sad that this place is in Nashville and not in St. Louis.

I love Dali. I am only giving this museum 4 stars because I love him and his work so much. However, I am not a huge fan of this museum. I visited the old Dali museum in St Pete probably 7 or 8 years ago. I was blown away! After admiring  his works in books for years, it was so surreal (pun intended) to see them in person. Then in 2004, I decided to go visit his 3 museums (teatro-museo, Gala's castle and the Port Lligat home) in Spain. If you are a true admirer of Dali, nothing can compare to seeing the landscapes that inspired his works and the home environments that he created! 

When I heard all the buzz around the new Dali opening in St Pete, I decided I needed to make another trip from Indy down to Florida with the main purpose being to visit the museum. There seemed to be a lot of hype around the building itself and so I was excited to see it's architecture and explore this new home created to house this impressive collection. I think my expectations were too high. Yes, the exterior side of the museum with the glass is really cool and unique, both inside and out. And the spiral staircase inside seems very Dali-esque. 

Other than the glass wall & staircase, the interior of the museum feels so stark, sterile and not like it was inspired by Dali in anyway. This is very disappointing to me. I would give the plain white walls and overall boring interior 1 star. Maybe the creators wanted it to be a simple backdrop that wouldn't compete with Dali's works for visitors' attention, but to me... it was a huge letdown. Perhaps I had anticipated that this building, designed with Dali and his paintings in mind, was going to somehow echo the theater museum that he had created in Figueres... one giant surrealist creation designed as a home for many more of his works. This was not the case. 

The sterile environment does not do Dali proud, in my opinion. While I would encourage admirers of Dali or even someone unfamiliar with him who happens to be in the area to visit the museum, I am personally not in any hurry to return. I will just save up my money for a plane ticket to Barcelona and make my way north, next time the Dali bug bites me! :)
