Great spot to pick up a quick lunch. Let's you try out samples and have a rotating menu each day.

Under new management....... Again.... 

I ordered the tacos carnitas, which was my favorite under the last 2 owners. What I got was 3 tacos full of inedible gristle, fat, and pork skin. 

Absolutely disgusting. 

Two stars because the rice and beans were pretty good.
The service is excellent and staff is very friendly. The wonton and noodle soup is delicious! A very calming environment to be in and you can't beat the value.

Great hole-in-the-wall restaurant with really friendly staff. I've been going here for a few years now and they never disappoint. Their pho is hard to beat and is authentic. If you're not into pho then you'll be glad to know that they have many scrumptious dishes for you to choose from. I, personally, love their spring rolls. I've tried some other Viet places around Nashville and this is definitely the best.

In town from Los Angeles for the USC game. Landed here to grab some drinks and check out the bar scene in Tucson. This place had a good vibe and the drinks were priced fairly. Most importantly, plenty of good looking ladies with no attitudes.

I've had take out from Asian Kitchen a few times over the year and it promised to be our favorite Chinese restaurant.  However the last time will probably be our last time.  Not sure if they got new kitchen staff or new recipes but everything was so hot and I'm not talking about the temperature.  I love spicy food but I could not eat the hot and sour soup.  While the menu clearly states the sesame chicken is spicy, I've eaten it from here more than once and multiple times elsewhere and never was it so hot that I couldn't eat it. Sorry Asian Kitchen but we won't be returning. I'm giving it 4 stars based upon previous visits but this last visit was hardly worth 2.
The Goodbar was amazing!! Ryan was our bartender and crafted the best drinks. Truly created a great experience, can't wait to come back!

The five stars is for the southern fried tofu (the actual tofu). The bread on the poboy was extremely tough to eat, so if I had to rate the samdwich id give it a 4, but just barely. 

My mint tea was lovely. And the chickpea salad was good. If I came back I would try something off their "fresh" section of the menu and get the southern fried tofu on its own, not the poboy.

These guys are fantastic. My usual mechanic was slammed and he recommended Darin to assist my son who was in Florida visiting relatives and was stranded with car trouble. It was nerve racking being in VA and not being able to help him but the guys fixed his problem in record time and took the worry from my shoulders. At a very reasonable price I might add. If I still was living there they would be my backup service guys for sure. Can't thank them enough for what they did for my family.

Initially, liked the food the several times we ordered out.

Finally, had lunch there one time as a couple, then had immediate and daylong diarrhea. 

Service was not the best.

Quite reluctant now to go back for their food.

An old favorite The Pasta House. Unfortunately the one in our hometown closed. While out of town celebrating my birthday we ate lunch here. The food was amazing just as I remember. The service was the best we've received in a LONG time! The waitress was very attentive and keep our drinks filled. The other waiters and the bus boys were also very friendly.  The restaurant is as clean and seemed to be handling the Covid effects well. We will defiantly go back when in the area again!
Terrific clinic - convenient and they take great care of man and beast alike!

I ordered takeout and had a terrible experience. The chicken fingers were no more than glorified chicken nuggets. The meat was an odd consistency of tough and chewy and the meat was obviously ground up. For $10 this was the worst chicken tender I've ever had. I ate a piece of mold on the fries and had to spit out my food in lieu of almost throwing up. A terrible eating experience that I will never be returning to. Chicky's Pizza pub can sit on a brick.

Loved the service and the food was fresh and seasoned perfectly! I liked how you can get as many toppings as you want without being charged an additional fee. The atmosphere is so clean and friendly! Definitely recommend this place to anyone who loves fish and salads!

Went here only a few times. Wasn't going enough so I decided to cancel it well they wouldn't let me cancel without a written notice as to why. Didn't get to them in time and now I have a credit agency calling me. Avoid this place.

Now it's deserving a one  star because every cheap ass comes here because they are charging @
Howard park!! I hope they march the price of Howard beach

Best wings I have ever had.  I would go there more often but the store is 35 minutes away...so I try to make sure it's "on the way" whenever I can.  I can't vouch for the rest of their menu as I have never tried any of their other food and don't see a need to.

One word - deceptive.  My wife was new to town and purchased a couch, and was told it was "bonded leather".  When she asked what that meant, the salesperson told her that it was genuine leather on the surfaces people sit and synthetic on the non seating surfaces, etc.  That is simply wrong.  Bonded leather, I later learned, is a fully synthetic product that includes shreds of ground up leather to make an artificial product, but it doesn't wear or feel exactly the same as real leather and the entire couch is made of this product, not just the non seating surfaces.

I would not trust this store.

I was hit from behind in stopped turnpike traffic, I was fine but got damage to the bumper and car itself.  I took my car in as scheduled, I thought it might take a few weeks to do.  When I got a call that my car was done I was happily surprised.

They were fabulous to deal with and my car seriously looks brand new!!!

Thank you for the wonderful and painless experience!!!

Cantina Dos Segundos is a must on every visit to Philly. Even among the huge selection of vegetarian food options in this town, the Cantina's vegan cheesesteak burrito stands out. 

They get an entire extra star just for this dish. The rest of the menu is solid, if inauthentic, Mexican fare. That's just how good Mexican food is, even a totally gringo-fied version can earn a few stars if accompanied by real Mexican Coke.

Short staffed. Only one person was working when I went. I came to pick up photos (that took me 2 hours to order because the app kept having errors) and to get a photo for my baby's passport, and when I arrived the person said because she's by herself she cannot take a passport photo. She also complained about the size of my photo order and that I wanted to actually look at some of the photos before purchasing them. I get that it stinks to be alone manning a store, but it also stinks to schlep your baby to get a photo and be told it's not possible. I then tried to go back the next day and was told the machine was broken. Very frustrating. Will be avoiding this location from now on and Walgreens altogether if I can help it.

Beau n Mo's Italian Eating House St. Petersburg, FL was on point! 

Lobster, Parmesan Mashed Potatoes, Linguini & Clams, Shrimp de Jhong, and the very best Brussels of my life: Sriracha/Honey!

I have been here many times and once again, today, received great care. I was taken back right away and am already on my way to feeling better. Thanks for being in the neighborhood and such great healthcare providers.
Finally a Nashville restaurant that lives up to the hype!  Delicious burgers.  Great atmosphere.  Friendly service.

Get there before the crowd because the seating is limited. If you can get in when its not busy, you can get unlimited sides and bread pudding. Woot! Great little hole in the wall. De-freakin-licious sandwiches! Like overflowing with meaty, spicy, saucey goodness. *drool* Every sandwich I've tried is killer. Wish they had a bigger spot. I'd love to sit here at lunch, or even outside, but usually it's overflowing with people at lunch. Wicked awesome food, cheap sandwiches, cool/punky staff. Great for those looking for something different on their lunch break.
Went to this place to get a few drinks. They charge you $4 extra per drink and you have to get in line at the bar to get the money back. Ridiculous.

No trip to St. Louis would be complete without a trip to the Anheuser-Busch brewery for the Budweiser Brewery Experience! We recently hosted guests who were visiting from New York, and even though one of our guests had been to St. Louis, they had never been on the tour of the Brewery. I'm glad we went, because in a post pandemic world, the tour has changed a bit and it was interesting to see more of the campus. 

While the tour used to be free, you now pay $15 a person, but as I mentioned, it is actually an expanded tour. So the $15 didn't feel outrageous.  This was my first time inside the Bevo bottling facility, which was the added bonus of paying for the tour. It was very cool to see all the fresh bottles of beer whizzing across the massive warehouse.

There are a few things you can always count on when you go to the Budweiser Brewery Experience, one of which is the quirky tour guides. Anheuser-Busch does such a great job of hiring tour guides who are full of life and have huge personalities. They always have great one-liners and witty dad jokes. At this point I've done the tour so many times that I feel like I can spew out the their memorized facts and figures, but WOW do they have a massive knowledge of the history of Budweiser. 

The second thing you can count on is an Instagrammable moment. The campus is beautiful and so historic. Even though it's an active work site, you it's always pristinely kept. Going into the Clydesdales' stables is always a wowing experience. It's hard to not just have your phone out, snapping photos the entire time. 

Finally, the promise of day-fresh beer is the best part of the tour. While you used to be able to drink on the tour, you are now given a 16oz, fresh beer to take home, chill and enjoy. Nothing is better than a fresh beer from the Brewery!

I used to absolutely love yogurtology's oatmeal cookie ice cream with the streusel topping but when I went today I was disappointed. Not only do they no longer carry the streusel topping but the oatmeal cookie ice cream tastes completely different and isn't very good. I ended up tossing the ice cream when I got home. I hate to say it but I don't have plans to go back.

Toots has quickly become a favorite for me and my family.

The food is reliable and consistently good.  It is a "wing joint" and if you know that going in you will be happy with your dining experience.  It also really good for kids.  We feel comfortable taking our daughters there and they even offer kids meals for free.

All in all, this is a good bet for an inexpensive meal out with the family...  

Try the Hot BBQ sauce... it is AMAZING
Over 100 flavors of coca cola. Nuff said.

Staff is great and the food is great. 
Don't forget to try the homemade ice cream, it's so good.

Awesome. Grab the Hot Damn! For a religious experience. Killer chicken. Greens were on point. Definitely check this place out. Recommend going at an off time or getting it to go as it's always bumping.
Little Gourmand is the cutest little French shop with great sandwiches. I hope it does well! :)

I really, really like this place. I have always been a fan of "different" pizzas and weird combinations. Let's face it, the other pizza buffets in the area are awful. Bia Maria's is nothing like your typical pizza buffet. 

Basically, you order whatever pizza you want. You can pick from dozens of combinations or you can make your own. They bring that pizza to you first. You take as much of it as you want. Then, it gets offered to the other tables. If there is any left after that, it goes under a heat lamp on the buffet. I LOVE this concept. You can basically sit at your table and be offered all fresh, new pizza. You don't even need to go to the buffet if you don't want to. 

It should be mentioned that they have the Coca Cola Freestyle machine and a salad buffet comes with your meal. The salad buffet looked a little iffy. I was there for the pizza, not the salad. I don't think anyone at the restaurant actually was eating the salad when we were there. 

In addition to the regular pizza, you can also order dessert pizzas and cinnamon sticks. Some of the things I tried include BBQ beef pizza, cheeseburger pizza, buffalo chicken pizza, loaded baked potato pizza, vanilla Bavarian pizza and peanut butter Bavarian pizza. The pieces are on the smaller side, so you can definitely try a lot of different pizzas. Still, I did eat way too much here. I highly recommend the BBQ beef and the peanut butter Bavarian. 

Our total (before tip) was $23 and some change for 2 dinner buffets and 2 sodas. Not bad at all. We will definitely be back to Mia Maria's. I hope this is a restaurant that makes it.

First visit... this place it was amazing.  The food was great but the dining experience was also great.  The total experience took us about 2.5 hours but we had all the courses.  Such great food and so much fun.  Highly recommend it for a family outing.

Ashley was our server... she was great.
Decent $30 pedicure, the only thing is it doesn't include paraffin wax. Overall the place and employees are nice and there are a lot of colors to choose from.

Delicious food with a dollop of racism and classism to go.

Placed on order online yesterday. Pretty smooth experience. The problem started when I went there to pick it up. I was repeatedly asked if I had placed the order myself. I pulled up the order confirmation on my phone and showed it to multiple people.

Eventually, it transpired that they had mistakenly given my order to someone else. Not a problem. It's a busy restaurant. Mistakes happen. I waited as they rushed my order through.

Eventually they came out with the order and said - "You can let the customer know that we will be giving them a discount." - It is at this point that I felt judged. I realize this is a fancy sit down place, so appropriate attire is expected. They looked past my North Face jacket, the Gap jeans at the tiny amount of brown skin peeking above my face mask and decided that I couldn't possibly want to eat southern food. Ergo, I must be the delivery guy.

This in Boise. In 2020. Racism and classism is alive and well.

Full disclosure, they comped the entire order after my wife wrote them an email.

I write this review to warn my fellow Boisians of color and let them know what to prepare for should they go here.

Needless to say, I will not be going back here.

Service and food were good, better than I expected. They lose a star for not serving alcohol on Sunday. I had the beef hibachi dinner, which came with a California roll, soup, salad, & fried rice for $9.99. It was good, especially for the price. My wife had the all-you-can-eat sushi for $15.99. Edamame, soup, salad, etc were also available. Again, all was good and at a good price. Maybe the owner read the earlier review, because everyone was friendly and greeted us as we arrived and departed.

I had the 8 rib plate and the ribs were just as good as they are in Memphis.  I can't remember if I had a cup of Gumbo or a cup of Red Beans & Rice for an appetizer, but I was definitely full leaving after dinner.  Definitely recommended!

This place was suggested by the locals around Brandon and Gibsonton alike. My first visit to a Cuban restaurant. Upon entering the facility I was subtly emerged into what felt like an actual Cuban cafe.. Only thing missing was the cigars! The party I was with 'hablan espanol' so it gave it an almost truly Hispanic experience. Our initial waiter was very busy handling the whole floor himself then we were given a substitute for the night, which was thoughtful. The menu did not seem too foreign to me at all so I got the of tail! It came out hot! Bone falling out of the meat and the flavor was to good. Next time I go I should order a double!

 But after filling up on black beans and rice for my side, the waiter came to suggest desert.. And coffee.. I thought to myself 'it's 10pm so why not enjoy some authentic Cuban coffee'. To my surprise I ordered the coffee over desert and I can tell you it was the best meal decision I could have made. Only because the party I was with gave up on their tres leche cake and pumpkin flan! Smorgasbord! I didn't have to add sugar to my cup of Cuban if you know what I mean. I thank the gentleman profusely for his suggestions and his description of the coffee that had me choose liquid over baked goods. It was a good experience and a long night after dining. I will spoil myself here any time.

This place is absolutely amazing. Truly authentic Italian pasta and pizza. I had the Amatriciana pasta and the primavera pizza. The pasta melts in your mouth and the pizza dough is just perfect. I highly recommending this place.

April 01, 2016

This is a follow-up on my review from 09/28/2014.  I was right when I wrote that review and I will not apologize for it. HOWEVER, restaurants CAN and DO improve. That's what Erin Pub has done in this case.  I went with my friend Margie to an early dinner at Erin Pub and this is what I experienced:

(1) We were greeted warmly and our waitress was a delight. She took our initial orders quickly and returned just as quickly with our drinks and some bread. Though I don't like the bread they serve, it was served quickly and I was very hungry. 

My friend Margie always orders the king-cut of the prime rib ($23.99), served medium rare. She takes home most of it because it feeds her for at least three additional meals! I ordered the early-bird dinner of Marsala Chicken ($13.50). I ordered fries and a side-salad to go with it and I have to say that I was completely STUFFED.  My dinner, as well as my friend's, was served PIPING hot and fast. Mine was so hot that I could barely take a bite initially! I LOVED IT.  I had asked the waitress if she would ask the kitchen to toss some additional mushrooms onto my order and they did it happily.  

I did not eat the rice - as the fries were SO hot and crisp that I could not resist them. Nor could I resist using the bread to sop up the sauce from my dinner after all the chicken was gone and that completely put me over the top. You could have rolled me home at that point. 

With my dinner I ordered a 16-oz. BLUE MOON beer ($4.99) and it was wonderful. It's my standard choice if I can't get a Sam Adams beer.  IF you have not had Blue Moon beer, you owe it to yourself (if you're 21 or older, of course) to go taste it. It's great beer.

I was glad I went to Erin Pub early. It was nice not to have to fight crowds to get in there and to have the complete attention of the kitchen. They did a great job for us and I would definitely go back.

Really had a nice experience for lunch. The Parmesan truffle fries were okay, they could've used more flavor. But the sauce served with them was fantastic!!! The service was kind and diligent about checking on your needs. The atmosphere was very calming and inviting. I had the turkey burger, full of flavor but the cole slaw was spectacular! I could eat it every day I do think the prices are high. I could only afford it occasionally. If the prices dropped, I'd visit often.

The food was DELICIOUS!!! The people were friendly. My only negative thing to say is that we received our food following some folks that ordered after we did. It took a while but it was with the wait! 

We ordered the banana waffles, jalapeño potato salad (has a little kick but not overly spicy) and the ouster mushroom poboy!!

What a great place to enjoy the beautiful beaches, people, and food. Of course I had to have a sloppy joe. It did not disappoint. I would recommend this place, ever though you have to park across the street. Worth it.

Sometimes you need to listen to your instincts.

After getting a few things in a local hardware store, my wife suggested we get Chinese for dinner, and that the nearby place, King Buffet, was a place she was at for lunch a few years ago and it was good.

To me, this breaks a cardinal rule:  Never eat at a place where the word "Buffet" is in the restaurant's name.  Still, my wife ate there, so we gave it a shot.

Each booth had a paper sign taped to the wall stating that "eating raw meats and shellfish can increase your chances of food-borne illness".  Oh great - That's not reassuring.

The buffet was bad.  I don't have any other way to say it.  The pepper steak was cold, the egg rolls had an off-taste like frostbite from being in the freezer too long (not that I know if they were, but that's what they tasted like).  I wish I had something positive to say...  Well, the fountain Cokes weren't flat.  I can give them that.

At $14 a pop, you can do far better IMHO.

I dream of this place!  The blackened fish tacos with the mango salsa are heavenly. The ingredients are so fresh. My dad, brother, and cousin also loved their tacos.  The vibe is super chill and laid back. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Awesome facility.. great for watching sports... unfortunately the staff was not very friendly.  I could have hung out if they were more helpful with the beer introductions/guidance. Being an avid brewery searcher... this place is very low on my global findings.

This little restaurant was just what the doctor ordered from the full bellied lunch we had yesterday of Nashville BBQ. Their Lucayan Salad was amazing, but I was in love with their Black Bean Nachos. For me, my wife's Salad was the best. It was a Black Bean Salad with tortilla chips in it and was fantastic. This little place is a must try and surprised I have not tried it before now.

This is probably one of the best gastropubs I've visited anywhere in America. I was in Nashville for work and arrived in town on a Sunday evening. If you don't know much about the South, the majority of stores and restaurants close early on Sunday. Why? B/c God said so, apparently. So one of the few places that was still open around 8 PM was Tavern. 

I stumbled upon this place as I was looking for a place to eat and I was very delighted that I found it. On the inside, this place is pretty cool and hip. Since it was Sunday night, it was slow which meant great service. I ordered a hef, the mussels, and parmesan fries. It was delicious. The mussels were a lot better than the last mussels I had in LA at Little Bear. The fries were well cooked and I loved the parmesan flavor.

When I am back in Nashville, I'll definitely return.

There is something to be said for a hotel which dares run a restaurant and bar. One thing I must say about this place is that the inside of the restaurant is pretty. It has a high ceiling and a relaxing environment and the staff are very sweet and polite. It is also off the beaten path so to speak and and has a feeling of being away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of Nawlin's and the Quarter.

I am all about a Louisiana breakfast now chillren'! I am talkin' strong chickory coffee served with real cream. I am talkin' about catfish.. YES.
Fried catfish for BREAKFAST. A couple of fried fillets or nuggets served with some cheese grits, scrambled eggs with hot sauce and a biscuit if you like with butter and some good fruit preserves for a breakfast desert!
I did try their breakfast taters which were also good. 

The service here was a bit slow but I did not mind because I was not in a hurry. The comfortable and even pretty surroundings along with the pleasant and low key activity was all part of the vibe here. The Whitney is a pretty hotel and a great way to start workin' the Big Easy mojo. 

The only thing here that I was not too crazy about was their specially made Lil Dizzy hot sauce. Its just not that good people. Too sweet and more like tomato ketchup than hot sauce. Could I just have some good ole' Louisiana Hot Sauce or some Tobasco? Keep trying though and maybe ya'll will get it right. 

Overall a pleasant experience and I would eat here again. Especially since it is so conveniently located right downstairs. A great way to break into the day.
I was not impressed. I had the stuffed flounder and for the price I was expecting something with some flavor. What a let down. The view was nice.
Best Brunch place in NOLA, we had to return before we left town. Will definitely try for dinner. Beautifully decorated and staff is super nice. Keep it up! 'Till next time

Normally I have a great experience! We have been going to Take 5 for a while. I went to get my normal oil change and the price was DOUBLE what it normally was. Not to mention, they didn't do any of the normal services that they say are included in the oil change like wiping the windshield and putting air in my tires. Neither of those were done. The employees were not as friendly either. We won't be going back.

One of those places that has a ton of cool stuff because it is so overpriced it never leaves. $22+ for new CDs, 400% mark ups on just about anything remotely collectible or out of print. Hope they figure it out before they're out of business.

Outdoor patio is fantastic, the cocktails were fantastic, the service was good, the food was mediocre AT BEST. Which is also what I heard from co-workers that had gotten take-out the day before. I was hoping they were wrong, and I'm still hoping they're just working the kinks out. I'll wait a while and give them another chance and update my review accordingly. I honestly think this could be a great place if they figure out the food.  On a side note...I looked at their "Allergen Chart" for their menu items, as we often dine with friends with various food restrictions. I think some additional work and emphasis would be well spent altering the menu a bit to cater to this crowd.  With all that said, I hope they find their groove. I'm just gunna hang out at Bardenay until they do, the food is better.

I believe this place is newer, my first time here, I'll say the distinguished menu may scare those who are the finicky eater, as myself, I ordered the prasino burger without tomato jam and onions, and asked for it cooked medium well, which it came out me medium rare, not happy with the burger at all. the menu does not explain enough, like the vegetable soup is a pretty exotic vegetable soup, I wasn't impressed honestly.The prices are a bit on the higher end $12 for a under cooked burger? Also the breakfast potatoes came out completely ice cold. other than the food, Great ambiance and vibe of this place, I would suggest to go for drinks here and enjoy the atmosphere, very hip and modern.

Ordered food from this restaurant while staying at Omni and it was by far the worst meal I've ever had. Ordered the filet mignon, medium, with a baked potato and carrots, tomato and mozzarella salad, and bread pudding.

The filet came burnt on the outside and totally rare on the inside. The tomato and mozzarella salad was laughable. It came with 6 little pieces of mozzarella and HUGE chunks of unripe tomatoes that had zero flavor. It came with a vinaigrette that was mostly oil and also had zero flavor. The bread pudding was big chunks of bread with what tasted and looked like vanilla pudding. The only thing that tasted good was the ice cream. 

I am honestly shocked reading the reviews that this place is on par with Fleming's. For the amount of money I paid for this meal, total joke and zero chance I would ever return.
Service was great, fast and food was freshly fried!!! We enjoyed our visit. The catfish is a must try!!!

This museum sat mainly ignored by the city when it was first built in the late 70's. But when Columbus Blvd was being rehabbed it finally sprung to life. The Olympia and the adjoining sub finally got some attention. Both ships could use some maintanence to insure our great grznd children will be able to visit them. Plus the S S United States is a few piers south that should be rescued and rehabbed for a hotel or casino so she too can tell her story as well. The seaport museum is now drawing the attention it so sorely deserves.

We finally stopped in to Big Lug a few nights ago, and there were several pleasant surprises to be had. First of all, they serve food until late - I believe until 1:00 a.m. (when they close) during the week and 2:00 a.m. on Saturday and Sunday. Secondly, there were several seating and eating options available - downstairs dining room, upstairs patio or open air "indoor" seating, and the beer garden downstairs. We've had several beers now from Big Lug (while dining at Rockstone Pizza Pub next door) and they've all been good - B+ beers. The service is friendly and casual, just like we like it. Last fun surprise was the funny touches of children's bathroom books in the bathroom (Everybody Poops and The Gas I Pass). It just made me chuckle. In an area where most places close relatively early (this side of Keystone anyway) it's nice to have a solid late night option.
If you're looking for amazing stylists then you must try Bella Capelli! Traci has been doing my hair for years. I always leave the salon loving my hair!

I finally found the best nail salon in St Pete FL . Traveling in our RV this winter has made it very difficult to trust nail salon reviews and I have had too many bad experiences to keep track of. This salon is very upscale , clean, with English speaking technicians with great experience. Lan did my pedicure and she couldn't have been cuter . she took care of those horrible ingrown toenails and was very gentle. Leah gave me a nail shellac and trimmed my tough cuticles perfectly. The salon was spotless, calm , with gentle music in the background and not all that personal chatter between technicians most places have . I will be able to return once more before I leave for our next trip.Keep up the great work Solar nails & Spa. :-)

I recently stopped by this nearby bakery in my endless search for cannolis, but I didn't stop there!

First of all they have a nice assortment of individual treats and cakes in their display case to choose from. If you are overwhelmed no fear you take a number on the way in and when your number is called you get undivided attention from one of their employees. The girl helping me was very nice, knowledgable, and patient as she described each and every treat in their case to me. 

Besides the cannoli, I also chose a mini cookie dough cheesecake, orange cream mini cake, an assortment of butter cookies, and was beyond thrilled to find they'd combined two of my favorites: carrot cake with coconut (on the icing and in the cake). 

I didn't even wait to get home to sampled a butter cookie and ohhhhh my god! Cookiegasm! By far the best butter cookie I have ever had in my life! So light and delicate! I will definitely be back for more!

Later that evening my roommate and I split the coconut carrot cake cupcake - it is definitely enough for two! I found it to be too heavy on raisins but that's just personal preference. She loved it. 

The orange cream cake was also divine and the cheesecake was good but very rich. The cannoli tasted fresh 3 days later. The inside is coated in chocolate to keep it crisp. 

Definitely worth checking out.

Ordered appetizers and entrees but entrees came out and 5 minutes later still no appetizers. Had to cancel appetizers. Ordered wonton noodle soup, soup temperature is barely like warm. Seems like they weren't ready for us. We were early before lunch traffic hours. Got the check price was pretty decent

My boyfriend and I went on August 29 to celebrate his 22nd birthday. It was just the 2 of us being that we wanted to do something romantic, just the 2 of us, for his birthday dinner. I could tell you what we ate, but that would take a while. However, I will say we had the 4 course meal and it was yummy. We enjoyed the food AND the service. I made reservations to make sure we wouldn't have to wait. Once we arrived, we were seated within minutes. The only bad experience we had during our meal was the group of LOUD, ROWDY girls giggling in the booth near us. Our server Sarah, was super attentive! The moment we ordered she started bringing our dishes. As we finished one course, she would quickly clear the table and bring out the next. We were there for about 3 hours but that is because we took our time and enjoyed one another's company. My boyfriend ordered the blueberry sage lemonade with alcohol after tasting mine, but hated the alcoholic version. I asked our waitress if he could get the regular one and she was more than happy to do so. That alone is worth me coming back. I love when a restaurant can do things that will help their customers. I ordered chocolate covered strawberries using a coupon I received and did not have any problem getting them. I didn't read any reviews before going since I'd gone previously before in Baton Rouge. However, today after reading the reviews, I would encourage you to go for yourself. I had a pleasant dinner that Friday night. My boyfriend loved the ambiance, food, and the service. We enjoyed it so much that we are returning tonight for cheese and chocolate fondue.

Incredible food and friendly service! 
Comfort food at its best! 
5 stars! Well done Dan! 
Take-out only for now, and all of the employees are following CDC guidelines

Don't eat at Jax's the food was horrible.. I order a hamburger and it came with no cheese, no tomato, only meat and bread and the meat was cold. I was very disappointed I will never eat here again. I do not recommend this place... Maybe they are known for their beer. Not to mention it took us one hours to get our cool food.

We ordered four tacos for lunch - beef, BBQ (spelled like "Egg" on the menu board) shredded beef, pork, and marinated pork. They were out of the marinated pork, so we just tried three. The taco meats were good, but could have used more carmelization. The BBQ beef tasted like Chinese food. The tortillas are handmade. So sure, they're better than factory tortillas, but were perhaps the most stiff and bland handmade tortillas I've had.

Great environment and staff

Food was great and the beer list is recommended for anyone that loves Belgium beers

This place is just the best. We go most Monday nights for the 50c wings, and the Hell in a Hand Basket fries are friggin' DELICIOUS. Crispy fries loaded with chili and cheese, can't beat it. The bartenders are great, prices are solid, and they have a great beer selection to boots. A+ neighborhood bar with a beautiful corner view!

My first time ordering here. Wanted a late night snack, so I ordered 3 things off the menu, total came to $20. The cha gio tasted like fish, not crispy like I thought. Didn't eat it. The shrimp tempura roll was less crisply fried, less browner, more whitish. I only ate that, the others I didn't. Not sure if I will order from here again...at least not anytime soon
I've more appreciation of the freedom we are enjoying today. This was a real eye opener. Thank you to all the veterans. Thank you for your sacrifice.

Strange donuts? More like strange disappointments. Average donuts and above average prices. We went over there at around 1 pm and there were barely any interesting or strange donuts at all. I had the fat Steve (just a chocolate long John) that was not anything special. 
However, the store was cool looking and I guess it was one of those things like you go and say you went. But maybe you shouldn't go, and say you did.

The Brunchery definitely lived up to it's reputation! I had a waffle, which was delicious, along with an awesome steak omelet. My favorite item was probably the biscuit though. It was cut in half and obviously grilled on a skillet with ample butter applied. 10/10 would recommend!

I can't comment on this place for a regular night out, but my friends and I stopped in on a Sunday afternoon, drawn in by the sign outside saying it was the world's best karaoke. The place was completely empty, which was a little weird, but we had fun singing and not having to wait for our songs to play.  The host was having a great time, interacting with us while we performed, providing entertainment, and making it not so awkward that the bar was empty.  The only other downside was song selection - they had a lot of the overplayed karaoke songs, but not a lot of new stuff or songs that aren't heard all the time.

BTO more like BRO T.O. 

Seriously, its similar to visiting a fraternity/sorority house. Lets just say the normal U of A California rejects. But the froyo is alright, the prices are alright, and a good toppings. If you decide to go Just get your yogurt and leave. The clientele is obnoxious.
Very good and safe for Gluten free, dairy free ... Fresh breads, muffins and cakes.

Rude employees 

Cater to drinking locals above others

Dirty and dark, outdated, dusty
Geno was absolutely amazing and took great care of us. Great energy and fresh food. Hospitality at its best.

My wife and I were in town for a show. We've stayed near Germantown before and enjoy the neighborhood and being close in. I mistakenly reserved a table thinking it was a place we ate at last trip. I was mistaken - but a very pleasant error. The restaurant was great!!!
The filet my bride had was one of the best we've had. She prefers med well, which can be trouble. But it was tender and moist. We're 'slimming' for our daughters wedding and potatoes are a rare treat. The mashed potato that accompanied the steak was worth the 'cheat.' We shared a salad and crab/devilled eggs - both excellent. My Red Fish was terrific along with a grilled red chard and creamed corn - perfect. For a Thursday evening it was 80% filled, even in the best places, being unable to have a conversation across the table is unfortunate. Here - no issue - the high wood beamed ceiling is a huge +. We also treated ourselves to two small scoops of house made ice cream. Mint from garden! 
We were pleased with cocktails, my wife with her wine and the beer list is great. New certain stop each visit. So, sorry I misplaced the receipt with servers name - she was a pleasure. As was the entire evening ...

This place lacks focus. If this were the only restaurant at a marina I'd understand and be delighted by the large entree portions, raw disregard for the concept of of fusion, and the guy with the guitar trying to play along to his iTunes playlist--unfortunately this is not the only restaurant in town. Overhyped and over priced.

Pickleman's Cafe is great. It has very quickly become one of my favorite restaurants.

If you like spicy food, I highly recommend you try out the chicken giardiniera pizza. Giardiniera is a mixture of pickled hot peppers and vegetables, and they load a bunch of it on top of a crispy thin crust pizza with grilled chicken. They have me hooked on the stuff. I buy a jar of the stuff when I visit, and I put it on everything at home.

I've also had a few of their sandwiches. My favorite is the BBQ chicken (with giardiniera added, of course.) My wife enjoys the asiago chicken club, though I've never tried that one. 

The staff has been excellent each time I've been. There's a couple of employees that smile and make faces to my two year old daughter while we're in line, which makes her day. That in turn, makes me really happy, and glad to come back again and again.

No wait for fill. Walked right in around 4:30P.M. on a weekday. First time visit. Loved the inside. Very nicely done. Could use some music to enhance the ambience and create a more serene environment. So many colors on the wall. With my little knowledge of nails, I was amazed. Quality of work was good. Nail tech listened to what I wanted.
Friendly environment and great customer service. My go to nail spot after a long day of work!

I agree with Mike.  The shop is very cool...and laid back.  Very clean and interesting too.  I had work done by Dustin that's exactly what I wanted - and in less time than I ever expected.

There's no wonder they're booked weeks (and sometimes months) in advance.  It's a great place, filled with very talented artists.  I highly recommend them.

OPENING ON MONDAY NOVEMBER 19th 2012


Jersey Mikes is coming to Amtrak 30th Street Station.....near Drexel, U Penn.....saw them doing a trial run with select customers this weekend (Nov 16 thru 19th).....i hear they are sampling food (FREE).

Have tried their cheesesteaks and deli type subs.....both are YUM......the deli subs are unbelievable for a fast food type place.  They slice fresh cuts right in front of you and build your fresh sandwich just like an old fashioned NY deli.

They will also be located right next to a brand new WENDYS HAMBURGERS.......i can see it now.....a Jersey Mikes Sub coupled with a FROSTY from WENDYS !!!!

Can't wait for this great addition to Train Station food choices.

Joe C.
Great restaurant! We got a picanha and it was delicious! The beans were very well seasoned! The service was great too!!!

We have been to the Sunday brunch buffet at Founding Farmers KOP twice during the pandemic and had an excellent experience both times.

The food and drinks were amazing and all high quality.  Everything was delicious!  The service from all of the staff was outstanding and super friendly as well.  Emily was our server both times and she was the best!

One of the most important things to us was that this restaurant goes above and beyond to follow all COVID guidelines so we felt very safe and comfortable dining there.  We are very cautious about where we dine out because there are many restaurants that do not follow guidelines and are dismissive about COVID safety.  We have actually walked out of restaurants due to feeling unsafe and/or unwelcome.  It's so wonderful to find a restaurant like Founding Farmers where you can still comfortably enjoy the experience of dining out!

Founding Farmers has maintained the same level of quality, atmosphere, and service that they had pre-pandemic so I would highly recommend treating yourself to brunch there!

This is the worst place to purchase anything. Ive been to this place a handful of times only due to quick items to purchase.i.e. a cool drink or a tobacco product. Each time the guy there trys to weasel an extra dollar out of the customer by jacking up prices and pretending "its not him but the company". They purposely leave items unpriced so he can belt out a price to customers abusing the fact that this location is the only store within proximity. The entire refrigerator section has no price tags. When asked why, he responds with selected memory and micro aggression. He also states he doesnt know the managers number or store information. Also, he arrogantly said" dont ask if you like you buy if you dont he doesn't care". Its my experience he will provoke arguments with the customer and locking the door while your in there to use culture bias and abuse the system by calling police. I grew up here, its appalling and disrespectful to treat customers negatively, sheepshly steal to make profit and have bias towards the people of the community. This location should be shut down. Everyone has to make money but the customer shouldnt be weasled, undermined and dismissed while he makes a profit.

While Boomerang didn't really have any clothes items that I was particularly interested in, the place was packed with some pretty neat stuff.  Upstairs there were several racks of what Boomerang refers to as "finer thrift" items.  I can certainly see why--these shirts, pants, blouses and dresses aren't Salvation Army or Goodwill type of items.  They're carefully cared for, clean and in close-to-new condition.

While the selection at Boomerang certainly isn't bad, it seems like the women's selection is a bit more extensive.  I was able to find a few interesting button-ups, but they don't carry my style of shirts (mostly old Western shirts and things of that nature).  Regardless, the prices were still pretty low considering how nice everything was, and the collection was pretty eclectic in style and size.

There is a pretty cool little area downstairs primarily full of clothing, thought the spiral staircase to get down there is a bit treacherous.  In addition to clothes, Boomerang also carries some paintings, furniture, lamps and other random kitschy items.  I found a very cool end table with a sliding top and an embossed picture of a wolf on it for just $40, but I don't really have anywhere to put it.  In retrospect, I probably should have bought it.  Damn.
I'm not sure if it was a joke or not but my $20 entree was the size of a kids meal. Be warned.

Newer to the Brandon area. This Chipotle is always my "go-to" when I'm wanting a quick meal. I've become "a regular" and continue to go back to this location due to the friendly staff, wonderful management, consistency, and quality of food. Occasionally catch a long line, but worth the wait for the pleasant interaction.

Great food. Very authentic. My wife is from Mexico and we're in Southern California where it's hard to get bad Mexican food. So when we travel we're picky. We liked this place. Great salsa, good tinga and carne asada. Great service. I only gave 4 out of five based on two things... the chips and tortillas for the tacos were really oily and the prices were kind of high. I'd still come back here. 
The quirky atmosphere is really enjoyable and unique. We missed the live music which was just setting up as we were leaving.

Stopped in here for a drink after a huge dinner close by. We were quickly greeted by the owner himself who was excited to tell us about his place. I appreciated his passion and was bummed not to get to try any food. 
I saw this great looking pizza pot pie that I can't wait to try. 
The server we had was not attentive enough and took my order twice in the same visit to the table. Like she forgot she already got it. She did that to another member of the table too -there were only five of us. 
Drinks came quickly enough and were nice  and strong. 
We plan to come back soon with a large work party   I'll update review when I get to try the food.

This is a nice place to go with families.  Atmosphere is fun and loud.  We had the captains seafood platter with added soft shell crab (extra $5.95).  It was average taste... Batter was not crunchy.  Tarter sauce was good but runny. Mash potatoes with brown gravy was not homemade which was disappointing.  I also had strawberry daiquiri but it was too icy and I can tell they used syrups not fresh strawberries ($9.00).  We wanted to try desert so we ordered the bread pudding....not what we were expecting.  It came out square blob with raisins and what we assumed to be pumpkins but it was canned peaches inside. There was no bread pieces that we found. All in all I am pretty disappointed and will not be back. Our total bill was almost $60 with tip.  They suggest 18% tip however I don't believe tipping 18% unless it's a fancier joint...this was a casual diner at best.  Service was good. Our waitress was nice.

I recently visited Canyon Cafe after getting my son's picture with Santa. I had been here a few years ago for happy hour but hadn't come back. My hubby and I were hungry so we dropped in and after a brief (under 5 minute) wait, we were seated. We were served chips and salsa right away. They were the highlight of our visit. The chips are seasoned nicely and there are different colors and also sweet potato chips. Yum! Too bad we were never offered more after the basket was gone. My hubby got a margarita, which also was good. I ordered the grilled veggie tacos and he got the chimichanga. The tacos were pretty bland, and I didn't get why they had two tortillas on top of each other. Unnecessary. The black beans were also bland, and the rice was just gross - too much of a spice that rice shouldn't have, maybe cumin? Service was not great, and like our chips, our waters were also neglected, despite our waitress being nearby. I'd come back for happy hour (chips and drinks) but not again for a meal.

I was so happy to see this White Spot as most others are now closed in 
Edmonton. My husband and I went for dinner a few months ago. I had the fish and chips which was very good. My husband had a mushroom burger 
which he enjoyed. I will definitely have the fish again.
Service was a bit slow but we didn't mind. It was like -30C so it was great
to be in the warm restaurant. 
We will be taking my 95 year old mother in law for dinner soon as White 
Spot has been a favourite in their family. And, I look forward to going!

Hard to beat it for the price! Don't let the lack of crowd scare you away. Nobody is ever here, and the food is quite excellent. 

My fifth-grader said about the chicken hibachi, "Best chicken of the year." 

And my 7th grader said of the sushi, "It was VERY good."
Great vibes it was my first time going on a boat I had a great time but it was a bit longer than I expected but overall a great experience

My party and I went here for breakfast and it was some of the best breakfast we had our entire trip!

The drinks were to die for, service was outstanding, and the food was delicious. I really enjoyed the Lost Bread and my partner loved the St. James Crepe. A really great experience all around and I would definitely go here again!

Excellent food, excellent dining experience.

Atmosphere is relaxed. Place is very nice and clean.  Staff was attentive, nice and explained menu items well. 

Started with complimentary pita bread, which was freshly made and warm. Hummus and dolmeh appetizers were great. 

Entree was the Persian Room special, which consisted of barg (filet mignon), chicken filet, koobideh kabob and basmati rice. For $41, you get a huge platter that easily serves 2-3 people. All of the meat was seasoned well and very, very tender. The Filet was my favorite. 

Not a cheap meal, but well worth the money. This is a great addition to Tucson. No matter what part of town you live in, you should definitely check this place out.

The food is really good. Great beer selection on draft. They have biker nights if you ride a bike. It's a great place to grab a drink and socialize. It has a old cowboy saloon style vibe. I got bean tacos with their Queso sauce and chips, which was really good. Service was ok they only had a few servers. The cook came out to ask about the food which was great. Overall a great place and reasonable prices.

I have to give a special shout out to "Brian". His customer service was nothing shy of great to say the least. I took a trip to this store because I needed some supplies build a temporary prop using pvc pipe for my daughters' 1st birthday. He took about 15-20 to personally help me cut and measure the pieces. 
I am grateful for his customer service and willingness to go the extra mile to help a customer. Thanks again Brian, continue to provide great service sir!!!

I visited the Farm House for lunch. We arrived around noon on a weekday, and there was only one other table with customers. Within minutes, the place filled to about 2/3 full and we went from feeling like we were in the Twilight Zone to a normal lunch spot.

Speaking of lunch, they call it brunch. translation: some, but not all, of the dishes on the limited menu could pass for southern breakfast. Also note that the menu is heavy on pork products - bacon, sausage, pork bellies, etc.

Our orders were taken promptly, but as the restaurant filled up, our service declined. The appetizers we ordered never showed up. One of my colleagues received undercooked catfish. It looked like there was only one server for the entire dining room.

The food: I got the blue plate, with catfish, squash, fruit and cornbread. The cornbread was delicious yet small, the catfish had a nice crunchy batter, and the rest was average. I'd tell you about the appetizers but we did not get to try them.

All in all, I rate the food 3 stars, the service 2 stars.

Tofu Bahn Mi tasted great and was super filling. Hubby had the pork Bahn Mi and wouldn't stop talking about it. Noodles were okay, a bit disappointing, especially since I'm big on noodles. If the seating arrangement weren't so awkward (and hard to get) I would come here more often but on a Friday night or weekend it's pretty cramped and uncomfortable. Otherwise, this place is great.

I have always had great experiences with Dr. Clark and the downtown dental team. Andrea Hayden as a hygienist makes the visits fun, and her bedside manner is top notch. If there is any work that needs to be done on my teeth or they have any new treatments/products that she feels would help my dental health and hygiene, she is very knowledgable and articulate explaining the pros and cons, and does a great job not making me feel pressured into getting the any of the treatments or products. 

I have referred a few friends to Downtown Dental when they moved to Nashville, and I will continue to do so.

Right along the main drag into olde Gulfport is Yummy's.  

Set amid a complex of other gift shops, it is a quick and easy eat place with sandwiches, ice cream and some amazingly good hot dogs. 

Big plump franks with all the fixins.  If for nothing else, stop in and have a scoop or two of ice cream.  Great cones. Then sit at the tables outside under the big trees and relax.  Very nice place and a favorite here in charming little gem of a village. 

Gulfport.  A slice of old Florida hidden amid all the Tampa Bay growth.

Ordered online and received a confirmation for curbside pickup at 6:23pm.  Being New Years eve, there were about 50 cars waiting to pickup their orders.  Waited 30min, decided to call for the status of my order.  Was told they are running about 45min late but will let them know that I was waiting for my order.

Called again 15min later, was told that they are running 1hr behind but gave me the option to cancel my order.  Told them I just waited over a hour and your are asking me if I wanted to cancel my order?  Was told my order will be ready in 15min, called again 20min later to find out they cancelled my order.

Wasted over 1hr & 30min to find out they cancelled my order without notifying me.  Speaking with manger Elisa was complete waste of time.  She's the one that cancelled my order and had the balls to ask me if I wanted to wait for my order.  Are you kidding me??? 

Worse service I experienced and would never recommend this place.  If you like waiting for your food and run by horrible management, this is the place to be.
The female manager has a really bad attitude and always rude, especially for Chinese customers!!!!!!!!

This is the most dishonest business I have ever dealt with. They work harder to discredit the customer then they do on resolving your complaint. Don't bother dealing with management. They believe the lies their workers tell them even when you prove otherwise. Their workmanship is some of the worst I've seen. I should have hired a couple of high schoolers instead. I'm sure they would have done a better job. Beware!

TO ALEX AND YOUR RESPONSE; Like I stated, your Foreman was lying in what he told Colt about how much paint was left. Then Colt accused me of adding paint to the bucket trying to discredit me. And I was not rude or foul with anyone. Just another lie by your foreman and crew. That's what your people do is lie to take the attention away from their shameful work.
