This review is based solely on Happy Hour. I have had Distrito tacos before from the truck, so i already knew I was a fan of the food. When I heard a Distrito was opening up right by my hometown, I was thrilled! I finally made it here for Happy Hour with my mom and was not disappointed. The Happy Hour is a steal compared to the regular priced menu, and the atmosphere is pretty cool! I hope to make it back soon!

Best part: the salsa....they have one of the best salsas I have ever had! The chicken meat was great quality but the seasoning was overdone. I wish the tortilla was softer and fresher. Otherwise this place is good but not amazing.
This coffee house sits in the middle of a quiet street. It is a laid back and understated place. The iced Americanos and iced tea were very refreshing. Nice  place to get work done.

We were in a few weeks ago, and it was a nice visit.

They've got a variety of stores to enjoy as well as a juice bar and a chocolate store.

All hits on my lists, but it's also a historical place, and they've remodeled the building so that you can enjoy it, with glimpses of the past and viability for the immediate future.

Not worth the stop honestly. Lots of better options around. I ordered a salad and it came with dirty raw mushrooms and too much cheese. Whatever bottled ranch they're using is disgusting. We got the spinach dip which came with tortilla cheese that were covered in garlic powder and Parmesan, which was too much and gross. I had to shake the chip off first. The dip was sub par. The chicken tenders were okay and the homemade bbq sauce reminded me of the McDonald's tangy bbq. The food did come out hot but service was slow considering we came at a time where there were barely any costumers.

Arrived a little after eight for a date night with my boyfriend.  We planned on getting drinks, appetizers and enjoying the view.  The bar was in transition from happy hour (ended at 7) to night club (starting at 10) so we had a relatively laid back experience.  We selected our own table with two leather armchairs in the corner with views to the east and north. I felt like I was on the top of the world.
We ordered their specialty drinks. These cocktails are premade and almost "on tap".  I had the "Friend With Benefits" (rum,strawberry,vanilla) and the boy had the "The Blue Gentleman" (bourbon, blueberries). They were really tasty as evidenced by how fast we drank them and garnished beautifully with fruit and large ice cubes.  These drink were only $7 which reminds me why I love Saint Louis.  In what other city can you pay less than 10 dollars for a drink on a rooftop bar. I like anything covered in truffle oil so we tried the Truffled Popcorn.  It was really light but savory with oil and some sprinkled cheese.  It was definitely the perfect compliment to a sweet drink.  
We then took a lap around the bar to see the view from every angle.  I could definitely see how awesome it would be during or after a game.  We then ordered a second round a drink, I tried the red wine sangria.  My boyfriend ordered another bourbon drink since it was the manliest seeming cocktail.  We also decided to try the duck pizza.  This was the best decision.  The duck was really tender and salty which played off the sweet potatoes and bitter arugula on the flatbread.  The pizza was large, more than we could finish.  
I highly recommend 360 for drinks, snacks and view.  Our timing was perfect for an intimate date but I would love to come back later at night for the dance floor sometime!

The workers at this location are exceptionally friendly and personable . This was my 2nd visit and and everything from service to food to coffee is outstanding here. Even the other customers were friendly and engaging at this casual and relaxed location.  What would I recommend? No, the question to ask is what wouldn't I recommend! The variety of coffee flavors, the bakery items and the decent bagel with cream cheese that was toasted perfectly. The atmosphere is laid-back and cheeky. Works perfectly for families and singles as well as their pets.Seek out the interesting art, sculptures and unique gifts available around the store, as well.  OK, so the only downside would be the amount of flies inside the cafe. Hopefully they are addressing this situation, but don't let that stop you from coming inside and grabbing any of their delicious treats.

If you are looking for a more upscale casual place in Metairie this is the place to go.  Cozy atmosphere with white linens and a great staff.  Every time we are looking for a nice place to get a good meal and don't want to head into New Orleans this is where we end up.  For a starter, I am a fan of their onion strings and wood fired oysters. If you come here I suggest getting a steak. I have tried their paneed veal, which I would give a 3 out of 5 stars... it was good but nothing special.  I also have made my way through their dessert menu and my number one suggestion is their chocolate mousse cake.  Another plus is that they have great happy hour specials as well so it's a great place to come relax after work!

Loved my Scotch eggs and wedge salad and Dad loved his corned beef and cabbage.  Daughter's first request of chicken strips and fries was rejected about 20 minutes after she had ordered it because they were out of chicken strips.  She switched to a cheese steak sandwich which was low on meat and high on bread and onions.  Husband had a meat pie of some sort and said it was OK and tried the mashed potatoes and left them uneaten.  Pub quiz night was the highlight.  Service slow and sketchy though the waiter was cute.  Out of sticky toffee pudding when it came time for dessert.

Sunday 11:00 had to wait to get in. There are seats inside and outside to sit and wait. Had to park behind the building. Free. 
There are frog figurines all over. Surprise surprise. I got the bacon omelet with home fries. This was the biggest omelet I have ever had. It also came with a slice of whole wheat and white toast. 
The home fries were just a little warm. Service was quick.

At 6'8" 250 lbs I was not able to finish it. 

The bathroom is four out of five bowls.

Worst service! Ordered delivery and was told it would be an hour because the driver didn't get in for another half hour which I was fine with. Called after hour and 15 and was told they didn't have something in my order and had to go out and get it and that it would leave soon. I said to forget about that item and they could just bring the rest. That was a 40 min ago. I live about 5 min away and it still is not here. Called and was told that he had a lot of deliveries. This is ridiculous!

We used to live near here and come here with some regularity. The food was good and the place was fun. NO MORE! Don't waste time, memory or money here. The menu lies. Mexican fried chicken is a fried chicken happy meal with a full plate of sawdust textured "Mac and cheese" with the Mac cooked down into paste. There was no Pork at 7pm on Saturday evening for carnitas. The beer is OK. We were there 6/11/16 ~7-8pm.

This is a cute place with a good vibe. You feel as if you're in a tropical backyard while dining here. We came straight from a walk on the beach and were welcomed without an issue. There were others in shorts and summer dresses so the attire is pretty casual. I ordered the shrimp bowl. To be fair, we got there an hour before they were closing so I'll give them another try earlier in the day. The rice was hard and almost non-existent but given it was the end of the night maybe they were trying to make it last ‍. The bowl was good. The shrimp were large and well seasoned; a couple more would've been nice. The taco bowl is small but it's deep so I felt like I was stretching the 5 shrimp throughout the meal. I probably should've ordered shrimp & chicken like my husband or gotten an extra serving of shrimp had I known. The ingredients were fresh. I ordered the ground beef burrito to go for my son. It was pretty wide around and he said it tasted good.  The staff were friendly. There's a TV for entertainment also. They have beer & wine but no sangria.

The bathroom wasn't the cleanest but again it was the end of the night and I'm sure people come from the beach and make it messy.
I'd give it 3.5 stars if I could.

So my fiancé brought me here to propose to me by the river! Once we got inside and the employees found out, they were congratulating us and being so welcoming! They give us a flute of champagne for each of us and wrote "Congratulations" on our dessert plate. It's the small things but it was so nice! 

The staff we dealt with were very attentive and so kind. They even offered to take pictures for us. 

For an Appetizer, we ordered the duck egg rolls. They were okay but nothing special. For dinner, I ordered the bison Riley which was delicious and the Brussel sports that came with the entrée complemented it so well! My fiancé had the NY strip. He enjoyed that as well. We ordered sides of asparagus and the triple Mac n Cheese. The asparagus were so skinny and almost looked burnt but I think it was too skinny. The triple Mac n cheese was delicious! I mean, I didn't get to eat it until the next day because of my excitement for being engaged. However, heating it up to eat it the next day was just as good! Haha for dessert we ordered the water wheel or something like that. It's basically chocolate on chocolate on chocolate. It was delicious! Haha we ordered coffee with it but it was cold. We told the server and she brought us new cups asap! 

Overall, I enjoyed the experience. Very friendly, food was delicious, and the view is beautiful! It is a fancier restaurant so I would suggest dressing up. Business casual is the attire that's appropriate. I would definitely come back. Especially when it's warmer so we can sit on the outside patio!

Fast Casual that offers close to Full Service which is super Friendly and attentive!

*Order at the Counter and they bring it to You! 

Brian the Manager is one of the best Managers! He was wearing many hats as he also assisted Customers from beginning to the end of their Order and meal. 

Karlee and Shelby are super friendly and attentive 

Hope District and Regional Managers will recognize and reward Brian and his Team at this Location 

They truly go that extra mile 


I had Cod Fish Tacos, Guacamole, Chips and Salsa 

The Hot Sauce Bar is great with lots of variety  

It was clean

I watched people wiping down high chairs. You rarely see that! 

Lots of parking 

Eat there or get it to go! 

You know you want to go! ;) 

I plan to return for Taco Tuesday $5.99 Deal

My first time at Diablo...I went with 7 other folks to celebrate a birthday of one of them...The server who walked up to us wasn't appear to be happy. Perhaps because we were a large group? Or he was simply having a bad day? I was a little confused. He lacks attention taking our orders (because he messed up 3 peoples' orders in our group) not to mention lacking SMILE!! 

I've worked at a plenty of restaurants before. And I understand how difficult it can get. But i felt like I was the one who was trying to give off good impression to this dude rather than the other way around. Yikes.

The food was great. The drinks were alright. But I miss the Pollo Rey...that used to be here for the prior 25+ years! Not sure if I would go back.

this is  really just an upscale pizza place with cocktails. Very few if any GF options.  It was screaming loud inside so we sat out and it was lovely. Good service in terms of friendly and quick to take our order but inattentive to our order as our waiter didn't pay careful attention to what was/wasn't delivered to us. They neglected to include the sausage on our pizza- They followed up with a correct one but only after I had to ask and it arrived too late to enjoy). He also forgot one of our two apps. I think they need some time to settle in. 

It's a lot like Earth Bread.

We've always had a wonderful experience with Bakersfield and absolutely love the atmosphere along with the food! We took a break for awhile just due to coming too often, but after this afternoon we were reminded how great of a restaurant it is! Not to mention we had above par service - Kaytlyn was awesome! She was on top of it but not overbearing and provided us everything we could have possibly needed. Highly recommend to any of you considering giving this place a shot!

A great place to eat. The food never disappoints, Many different types of salsa all delicious. It's the type of place that you can just order the next thing on the menu and it's just as good as the previous item. Highly recommended!

Stumbled upon this gem of a restaurant for lunch.  Food and service were absolutely outstanding. We ordered the spicy chicken sandwich with fries and the chicken ceasar salad. Both entrees were phenomenal. Will definitely be back.

We stopped by here today.  I found Loli's competition.  The tacos were super good!!!!!  We ordered 9 carne asada tacos for 3.  They were only $2.50 each.  So definitely much more reasonably priced.  $3.00 each of you want to add cheese and sour cream.  

First of all, we love loli's!   The original location tastes better. 

Back to this taco spot - it's really good.  To me, they are just as good as loli's and less expensive.   

A recent trip to loli's set me back $30+ for 9 carne asada tacos.  No drinks.  

Here, we ordered the same 9 tacos with 2 drinks (1 Jarrito and 1 bottle water) for only $25.50!!!

Loli's does have inside dining.  A small place at the original location and a larger one on their Hillsborough location.  

This taco place has outside only dining which consist of two picnic tables with plenty of shade and fans.  

I love this place and I think we found our next go to taco place.

Lisa is the best at what she does. See her on TV:
https://www.facebook.com/video.php?v=748903991831120&set=vb.283845548336969&type=2&theater

Best dealership in the whole  world. Best customer service. These guys give free haircuts and milkshakes at the dealership, amazing!! But really great cars, great prices. Definitely need to check out! WP.

Fairmount is the much cheaper, more red-neck version of Kentucky Derby and a perfect summer weekend off-the-beaten-path activity if you live in the St. Louis area. Races go from May to first week of September (Post times are usually either 1 or 7:30pm. Check their schedule). The entrance on summer Friday nights are $2.50 per person. Beers are $4 a pop. Food similarly reasonably-priced. Bets are at $2 minumum (How much you pay obviously depends on the odds. Check out their website for how to bet). On a summer weekend evening, you get the full gamut of participants: from teenage girls in flowery summery dresses to large families with excited toddlers to grandpa puffing on cigars in a corner. The horses are beautiful and well-groomed. You can check them out at the staples before start of the race. One you pick your favorite horse, there are plenty of machines inside to sell you a ticket. 

By all means, grab a few friends and go, especially if you have never been to a horse track. There are plenty of seats (inside and out) if you get tired of standing by the fence. It's fun to watch and it won't cost you an arm and a leg (unless you have a gambling problem...in that case don't read this review).

Ordered takeout and it took 45 minutes on a Wednesday at 3pm. We waited in the restaurant and when the food was finally done we left. The burger was burnt black and rock solid. The salad was subpar. They didn't have boneless wings so we had chicken fingers instead and they were dry. The wait staff we encountered was very friendly and did apologize for the wait, which is always appreciated.

Thank you Postino for the perfect date night with my Mom! This was our first time out since the pandemic and they did not disappoint.

First, the staff!! Amazing from the moment we walked up, literally to the moment we left, it was special and we felt it. Each and every person on this team is amazing. Gorgeous humans with the kindest hearts... service makes all the difference and ya'll nailed it. 

Now the food. You must have the cauliflower! We started with that the moved to the goat cheese meatballs, and shared the bruschetta! No word other than delicious and I can not wait to come back to try everything else on this menu.

Thank you Zoey for a warm and much needed welcome. And to Riley, may we always be seated with you.

We will be back again and again and again.

Well...I wish we had an opportunity to eat this delicious food that I've heard so much about...NOT!  My boys and I wanted to celebrate Mother's Day at a different spot, including with my mom.  I saw all the wonderful reviews about this place and thought it was a great choice.

I called to confirm they were open, but no one answered the phone.  When we get here, there was 1 table available, and it wasn't extremely busy.  We placed the order around 4:15pm CST.  As time progressed, we noticed others were coming in after us and getting their food.  Around 4:45 or so I went up to the counter.  The gentleman who took our order said something like..."It's good.  It's coming" - something like that.  After about 15 more minutes, I decided to get our money back.  

When I go up to the counter to make this request...Come to find out...The gentleman hadn't put our order in at all!  It was sitting up on the back counter!  Sigh!  I paid with a debit/credit card.  They didn't know how to give me the refund or void the charge!  It took 3 of them and a phone call to some 800# and 10 minutes later...it "appears" that they took care of the void!  One of the ladies offered to give us some ribs for the trouble...I respectfully declined:  I was too ticked at that point and just ready to leave.

Maybe this is a good place...But they didn't seem really ready for "prime-time".  After all...Mother's Day is the busiest restaurant day of the year.  I'm not sure what their problem was!  I haven't decided whether or not we are going back.  I don't see how they survive lunch rushes!   Our Plan B was Happy China which is right down the road from there.  That was a much better choice!!!

After my first horrible experience and review, LL's owner reached out to me to rectify the problem. I appreciated her prompt and honest response in order to address my concerns. I made a follow up appointment to give LL another chance. This time, after reading the reviews, I wanted no one BUT Nicole. She was meticulous in her care of my nails. She did not file them too harshly and she took her time applying the base, color, and top coats. The process took a while (about 2 hours), but thats because I had a gel removal process which took longer than expected. 

My appointment was 2 weeks ago and went very well. I thank LL for asking me to return so that they could give me a better experience. The service was comped as well. Normal gel manicure is $40. Nicole took her time and my gel manicure lasted a full 14 days.
New to the area this year .  Tried Luigi S on a few occasions now  every time it's been  perfect.  Taste.  Cost.  Service.  They have done very well.

Amanda's maternity and newborn sessions were a baby gift from our extended family to my son, his wife and their now five children. From the planning sessions, to the photo shoots and then the final pictures, Amanda was amazing. The family had a fun time and now they have many amazing pictures to treasure. Amanda, thank you! You have a gift for capturing these children and the love surrounding them.

Wow this place is good. It's about a 20 min hike from the main State Street SB area. When we arrived around 5:15PM there was a line out the door. It was incredibly crammed because they are currently doing construction in one of the dining areas. 

I liked that you went up and ordered and then sat down because it gave me a chance to spy on everyone else's food and determine what I wanted to order. The portions are huge but this place is NOT cheap. I think we spent close to $50 for just two people. I got the steak quesadilla and my husband got the fish tacos. They were amazing. They have a big selection of salsa that you can get to go with your food/chips. They definitely rush you out so this is not the place for a relaxed, extended meal. I hope I can come back once they are done renovating and not feel as rushed and cramped.

Gutes UK Pub

Die Dekoration is nett gemacht, im UK style, auch wenn es natürlich nicht einem klassischen Pub entspricht. 
Der Raum ist gross und offen gehalten und nicht so dunkel wie in einem klassischen Pub.

Der Laugenbretzel Burger war lecker, die Drinks natürlich sowieso.
Service war ok, als es voll wurde dauerte es etwas länger, aber trotzdem freundlich.

Recently moved here and made an appointment with Ms. Lane Williams for an ultimate brow. I've always been picky about finding a great esthetician. I really lucked out in finding her. She made me feel comfortable, listened and I got one of my all time fav wax services. Couldn't speak highly enough. Friendly service, easy booking online and a premium staff. Highly recommend!!!

I had a few wedding pictures printed to give as Christmas gifts and couldn't be more pleased! It was really easy to upload the pictures online, choose the finish and picture size.
In our case, we had to crop some of the image out (HUGE bummer) but I'm glad we had the option to choose how each image was clipped. This is a feature you won't see at places like Walgreens and, trust me, it's REALLY necessary!
The job was done very quickly and the quality is great - 2 thumbs way up! I won't print pictures anywhere else.
For 6 4x6s and 6 8x10s, all matte finish we paid $34 including tax.

They deliver downtown!!! I was planning on going to their cart located behind the courthouse, but I didn't have cash, so I called their concrete location to check and see if they accepted debit/credit. The gal that answered the phone put me on hold to ask and Keith, the owner, quickly hopped on the phone to explain to me that their cart has picked up and moved on for financial reasons. He explained they do deliver downtown, free of charge, so I placed my order! Thirty minutes later my food showed up still warm and crispy!

I ordered the Eggplant Parmesan sandwich and a coke. Now keep in mind, this is not something I would normally order but did it because it was highly suggested. I won't order it again, only because my stomach couldn't handle the fat content but the flavor of the sandwich was spectacular. For those of you that would enjoy that type of meal, I highly recommend it. The price of the sandwich and soda, however, blew me away. $11!! In my opinion, overpriced for a meal of that size. I won't be able to do that one again! If it weren't for the call I received from Keith an hour later asking how I enjoyed my meal, I probably would have rated it a 4 for the price alone. But the impassioned efforts of Keith, the owner, to make sure his customers are happy and satisfied rates a 6, so I averaged it out!

Look, where else are you going to get biscuits and gravy and an omelet and coffee for about five bucks at 3 AM?  And where else do you get all of this while watching a drunk old man hit on a young punk rock chick while a waitress who hates you offers you pie?  BTW, the pie is pretty good.  You should try it.
OMG... Shredded beef tacos and the best tamales in Pinellas County. I loved this place and the food was awesome.

Walked no help. Sat at a table that wobbled almost spilled the drinks. Waitress tried her best. Ordered food. Only 10 people in the restaurant and food came out very cold. Tasted horrible. Would never ever go back.
This was by far one of the best meals and dining experience I have had.  I am well traveled and have been fortunate enough to have dined at many well known establishments.  This one takes the prize!

I am so happy I stumbled into this bookstore while strolling through South Street. This isn't a traditional bookstore where you would find classic novels. 

This bookstore is for someone who is interested in left leaning, progressive, or anarchist themed books. This place even have books from prominent POC figures like Maya Angelou and James Baldwin. You can also find child friendly versions of some of the books which I thought was very neat and cool. The books are a bit pricey, but you will definitely find something(s) that grab your attention.

I had been wanting to get my nose pierced for years and finally came across the perfect place! I appreciare the fact that everyone is so friendly, the company's message to their customers encouraging everyone to feel beautiful in their newly decorated skin, and their very clean environment! I will definitely choose Straight to the Point for any future piercings!
Working in the medical field, I also appreciate the fact that they apprentice there and was happy to be pierced by someone in training! While the pandemic struck shortly after my visit, I wasn't able to make it in for a 30 day follow up, my piercing still healed well! I can't wait to go back and pick out something new, as their jewelry selection is beautiful too!

The experience last night was less than desirable.  The coleslaw was presented without any dressing.
When it was brought to their attention it was not really taken care of in an satisfactory way.   We were told that the coleslaw was made at the time of ordering.  Good coleslaw has to have sometime for the dressing to combine with the raw vegetables.
The fish was dry and the portions were very  small.
Very disappointed.  Felt like the manager did not try to make amends for our dissatisfaction.

The best wine tour! We had a huge van for all of us, and Tony was the best tour guide and driver for the day. He was so fun, informative, and even rescheduled our reservations when tastings were running late. He made a huge effort to make it a great time for us. Thank you Tony!

Sweet Lollapalooza is truly the best chocolatier in Edmonton, probably even Alberta. They've won many international awards. They have a massive collection of individual chocolates. My faves are passion pardou (probably spelling that wrong), burnt butter caramel, and the eggnog at Xmas time! But the deliciousness doesn't stop there. Probably my absolute favorite item in this little shop is the passion caramels, raspberry caramels, and regular caramel. Oh boy, they are amazing. Pro-tip - put them in fridge.

The staff are always so friendly and helpful. The location is on the main floor of Commerce Place, kind of hidden behind the escalators. But don't stop looking until you find it!

This is one of the best pizza places I've been to outside of NY!! Being a native New Yorker expectations are really high, but NY Pizza delivered! The pizza variety and quality were excellent; the staff and establishment were greats too! If you're looking for a taste of home or just want some good pizza give NY pizza a call!  I had the plain cheese and the florentine and they were both excellent, with prices that are reasonable too!

What a disappointment! I've dined at this Beef's several times in the past, but the last two experience have been abysmal. This place seems to be going downhill...and fast. Visited on a Tuesday night (Kids eat free night) and it wasn't very busy. However, after we were seated it took a good 5 minutes to be acknowledged. They would not honor cards I had for free draft beers in combination with the kids eat free, but it took another 10 minutes to have a manager come and explain this to us. 

Fast forward to us finally getting to order food. Waitress comes to table to ask if we need more time. Picture this: 5 year old playing with stack of 4 menus and everyone else twiddling their thumbs. You think we're ready to order? Uh, yeah. Food took forever. Food was sub-par. Totally unimpressed. I got the club wrap after sampling it at a recent Yelp event and it being delicous. It was meh. The rest of my party got the buffalo chicken wrap (yuck), grilled cheese, and macaroni and cheese. Luckily you can't mess up the kid orders. Took another decade to get our check, and then she walked away before I could hand her my credit card which I already had out on the table. Another 10 minutes passes and she gets my card. I was so ready to get out of that place. 

It will be a good while before I step foot in a Beef O' Brady's. Left a bad taste in my mouth. Sad, because I know they all aren't this horrible. But the memory of tonight makes me shudder.

I was visiting from out of town pick this place based on reviews. Arrived at my appointment with Paris a little early took about 45/50mins until I was in a chair for a wash/silk press (she was working with another client), after my wash and sitting under the dryer for almost 30mins (I was forgot about) and passed along to Aisha who finished my hair, she did a nice job. I think time management and communication with the client is important and I felt neither were met, stylists dislike for clients to be late and I dislike to wait when I have an appointment.

The "east coast" donair (pizza), fingers and donair sauce, DON'T taste anything like the real stuff. I've been looking for a replacement since PIZZA HUT closed in Fort Saskatchewan (and I live in Edmonton! I use to drive there at least once a week ). So if you're feeling home sick and want the real stuff, or close to, this isn't the place for fellow east coasters. Donair sauce doesn't have that garlicky-sweet taste and the fingers also weren't that garlicky. That aside.... the fingers were still FANTASTIC! I got half with bacon, half without and favoured the half without best. Super cheesy and delicious! Dough was a bit on the floury side for both pizza and fingers. I liked them better the next day personally  I had one bite of the personal donair pizza and didn't like that much.. at all and ended up tossing it as the donair sauce wasn't my favourite. I do wish I could remember the cashiers name. I spoke to her on the phone and then again when I picked-up. She was a delight, happy, funny, very easy to speak with and informative. I was thinking about dessert and she actually had a brownie cooked and showed me what it looked like. Even wafted the smell toward me . I wasn't in the mood for sweet but it was still nice of her to take time to show me! I waited outside until my order was ready and she then walked it out to me! You'd think based on my experience and disappointment my rating would be much lower and if we're honest... if it wasn't for that one lady, it would absolutely be 1 star. I'll say I won't go out if my way to get food from here again but might drunkenly order those garlic fingers again  EXTREMELY LOVELY CASHIER !

Went there for late breakfast and arrived around 10am.  At the greeting station, we were told there was a wait for a table of about 30 minutes. The person took my first name and mobile number.   We walked to the nearby shops and after about 20 minutes, received a text that our table was ready.  This is a great feature as we were able to take a walk while we waited. On my Android phone, I was able to see how many patrons were ahead of me and how much longer the wait would be.

The restaurant appears clean and the tables are not too close to each other.  There are an equal number of booths to tables.  The atmosphere is busy but not overwhelming.  There are an ample amount  of servers and the food comes out without much wait.  We were not rushed to leave even though there was still a wait when we were done.

I ordered a single multigrain blueberry pancake which is about 8" across.  The menu says it is big but it is not as big as it was a few years ago (I hate when portion size is reduced to make it fit the current profit margin. The menu should state the diameter size (or amount of batter in ounces) of the pancake. The price was $4.95.  It may not be as big as it used to be, but it was just as good.  The side of blueberry sauce was warm and not too sweet. I did not try the syrup which was provided in a glass decanter.

My wife had a two-scrambled egg platter.  The price was $9.99.  It came with two scrambled eggs (although the portion was so small it could have been one egg), two chicken sausage patties, a (thick) slice of multigrain toast and home-style potatoes.  The eggs and potatoes were slightly under-seasoned and the other items were tasty.  If the eggs were property portioned for a "two egg scramble" it would have been a good dish.

We both ordered hot tea which comes in an individual hot water decanter.  The tea was served with lemon wedges and the server brought various organic tea packets to the table which from which to choose.  The packets remained throughout the meal but we did not ask for additional hot water.  The price was $2.59 each.

Notes: When we were seated I asked the server for water which did not come.  A different server brought our food and I asked again for water which was delivered promptly.  Also, they have stevia packets at the table.

In summary, a good place to eat but they may drop the ball on some things when they are busy.

The vintage items in the window caught my eye, as I was walking down the strip. The inventory is a little smaller than other comic stores that I have visited, yet there is something for everyone there. They even have a comedy night, on certain nights. The staff, possibly the owner, was extremely friendly and definitely helpful in terms of telling us places we should visit during our brief stay in town. 

Even set up the video game system for the ladies to play while they had a few alcoholic beverages. Actually, I was pleasantly surprised that they even served alcohol in a comic book store. It definitely gave something for the misses to do while I roamed the store. For this and many other reasons this store does stand out.

20% included gratuity on a check for two people? Food was great as always but that was a big turn off. Not interested in going back anymore and the funny thing is we would have tipped way more had we been given the choice to fill it in. Oh well...

A true gem of colonial architecture, San Xavier Del Bac is not to be missed when visiting Tucson.  

You'll probably want to go sometime in the non-summer (November-May).  I seem to recall it being not air conditioned, and you won't want to be rushed as you view the white dove of the desert!

Poor customer service! I really want to like this place since it is a local business and it's close to my house, but this place is useless! I've been in three times now and every time I swear I'll never be back....I think I'll stick to it this time.

Love their pasta carbonara!! My dad tried steak (unfortunately I can't remember which one, but it was delicious..). I have always had good experiences here. It is very loud in there though, but it is a big restaurant and lots of people fit there. The staff is always very friendly!

This business is not transparent in their pricing. My friend and I only got two dishes each $9.00 and the price came out to be $24 dollars. Since they don't have you a bill to show all the charges it's hard to tell how they are charging each customer. The menu prices are always increasing but they say it's out of date. I do not recommend this place any longer. It used to be a family favorite.
I had the pleasure of a thorough house cleaning from them.  What a wonderful job!  So professional and accommodating!  I would highly reccomend this company.

Our 1st time ordering here.......
Great experience, tried the stromboli supreme & cheese fries. The Strombolie was very cheesy. Both were good & the delivery was pretty good, food was still hot. Will be ordering again to try more things.

Decided to go here after not having been to outback for a few years. The new ad campaign actually worked in getting us here. Wish it hadn't. We sat at a table in the bar area. Our food took unusually long to come out especially based on the number of other people dining. While we waited dirty dishes and food scraps were continously piled in bins on the floor next to where we were seating. Disgusting. They were there the entirety of our stay. When the food came out my steak was extremely under cooked and my girlfriend's over, both were bland (virtually tasteless) and her's was the toughest steak either of us have ever had at a restaurant, even a chain restaurant like this. I remember outback being a decent meal and this certainly wasn't that. I would never go back here. Meal was bad from top to bottom and the restaurant itself was poorly maintained. If they'll pile dirty dishes and food out in the open with total disregard I can only imagine what the kitchen looks like.

I ordered the boil. It was pretty decent, just needed a bit more sauce as it seemed a bit dry to me. The corn def tasted like it came straight from a crawfish boil pot, I think that was my favorite part.
I also ordered a pie that I felt wasn't as sweet as I hoped it'd be but hey that's all just preference. 

I guess I hoped for more flavor, it was prettier than it tasted. It was okay.

We went in on a Friday night without reservations, hostess told us it would be about 15 mins wait. She was sweet and nice. We got our table less than 15 mins. I ordered the tri-tip French dip with a cosmopolitan. My husband ordered the spaghetti and meatballs. Both were delicious and the waitress was great! Service was quick and she came back several times to make sure everything was great and make conversation with us. We ordered cherry pie to go. Loved the place!

Haven't had dinner at Grillsmith for years.  Went there Saturday night for husband's birthday, with friends and family.  Two butter dishes on the table were dirty, when we sat down at the table.  They had butter marks on plates.  I ordered Asian Chicken.  The menu says it is sautéed chicken breast, with a sweet garlic sauce, broccoli, mushrooms, and red peppers, served over Asian noodles.  The chicken was already cut. Into pieces and mixed with the vegetables in a sweet spicy sauces (not garlic).  I called and spoke with the manager on duty today.  He apologized for the dirty plates.  He said there was a new chef on duty last night and might have made the sauce a little spicy.  He said the chicken is flattened and cut into pieces, then don't advertise
A chicken breast.  I will probably not eat there again or recommend it to my friends.

Excellent. Excellent, excellent, excellent!!  Everything we had was wonderfully prepared, tasted so good, and presented beautifully.  Etch is everything you want in a very fancy, quite contemporary restaurant.  

I was at Etch for a very celebratory birthday dinner, so a sampling of EVERYTHING was welcome.  I don't drink much these days, but I did spring for the Hemingway cocktail, which I loved.  The first food recommendation from our waiter was the butter tasting, which is worth its weight in fat.  It was awesome to try the duck butter, goat butter, truffle butter, and smoked plugra butter (I'm still not too sure what plugra is, but it was awesome - I thought it tasted faintly like a smoked fish).  Then came the roasted cauliflower appetizer, which lived up to its hype.  The cauliflower itself was AWESOME, and the pea pesto and other accents it came with were awesome too.

For an entreé, I had the duck.  I love duck, but what sold me was that it came with ginger grits.  It was a fabulousl tasting and well concocted meal, however I have to say the winning main dish at the table was the short ribs.  I almost ordered this, as I was really in the mood for tender red meat and korean noodles.  This would be what I opt for next time.  That shrimp aioli?  Woah...

I've said my favorite restaurant in Nashville is the Midtown Café - really nice food in a classy setting (an old house), and the employees are excited about the food.  It's not overly ambitious or trendy; It's like a slice of old-Nashville.  I feel Etch is on the other end of the spectrum - creativity, modern, American but with pan-cultural undertones.  Once again, our waiter was a die-hard foodie and very excited about Etch's offerings.  Etch is an envelope pusher, and is definitely several cuts above most other Nashville "trendy" restaurants when it comes to the food!!  Definitely on its way to becoming one of Nashville's favorites, if not your own.

Short story: amazing bread pudding that lived up to our high expectations. 

Stopped in here for one thing and one thing only: the infamous bread pudding Sunny Anderson recommended on The Best Thing I Ever Ate. The place is nothing fancy, just a little diner with an old school vibe. The staff is friendly and welcoming, the place is clean and smells like home cooking. The place was pretty empty so we didn't have to brave the long line Sunny warned about on the episode. We ordered the BP and oh-em-gee - it did not disappoint. Perfectly sweet, gooey, crispy at the top, with chunks of fruit cocktail here and there - delicious. We also had some coffee, which was yummy and complimented the indulgence quite well. A definite must-do while in NOLA.

The place was all decorated for Christmas.  It was beautiful. So many ornaments! Worth checking out just to see all the trees. Each one different. Then go for lunch at Branches. Can't wait to come back in the spring when they get all the bedding plants.

I would like to praise Matt C. to the skies because of his outstanding work at my home today fixing the water dispenser on my GE Refrigerator door.  It turned out to be a hose with a lot of cracks in it.  It was a hard job getting my refrigerator out from the wall, but Matt persevered, and not only was able to replace the cracked hose, but he scrubbed the floor where the fridge had sat for 18 years, and cleaned the coils, and did a fantastic job of fixing my fridge and cleaning behind the fridge.  He was polite, and courteous, and was extremely helpful and accommodating.  Hawkins & Sons is most fortunate to have such a caring, conscientious employee.  He knows his job, and gets the work done.  A thankful customer, Mrs. Eleanor C. Munson, 3203 Coachman Road, Surrey Park, "Wilmington, DE 19803

So as past patrons of this restaurant it saddens us to have to report our incident as the management did not take responsibility or resolve. BE WARNED they must be under new management or just have been hit with economical factors that have turned this once great place into a nightmare. DO not eat here for your own health. After the 4th of July Parade our group of 11 went there and 4 of us got FOOD POISONING. What's worse is we returned two items with creams in them that tasted sour and then we believe our food poisoning was from the Rosemary Stuffed Chicken we all had all 4 eaten. Ruined our holiday ... we all immediately feel seriously ill to the point of meds and had to leave town and not even enjoy the fireworks that night! We immediately called and missed the manager and nobody wanted to look into this for future clients that day. Then after many conversations to management they refunded a tiny portion of the big bill that we obviously did not enjoy...and refused to take responsibility or take action or show remorse. Unreal and unexpected reaction as we were good patrons and referred a lot of biz there way.
On top of this incident we notice a decline in service and quality overall. It's only a matter of time before this catches up with them...

UPDATE : Since posting this "real review" the owner has called us and threaten us with legal action? Calling our going to public sites to warn others "SLANDER". Saying his wife is a high powered atty. What bothers me most about this - he has spent more time pursuing our actions than actually worrying about the food issue we had. Simply another let down. Simple solution would have been to just refund all parties involved and solved his kitchen issues to prevent for future clients!

For my last dinner out in Philly before heading back to Vienna, it was a meal spent with friends at the Philadelphia Cricket Club.  The Philadelphia Cricket Club in Chestnut Hill is the oldest country club in America and one of its most famous.  Besides all the sporting amenities, it has a really pretty restaurant and bar area.  Dinner here is usually pleasant and my last dinner was no exception.  The food is not as awesome as the atmosphere but it's still pretty good.  I enjoyed a NY strip steak with truffled French fries & sautéed broccolini..  An amuse-bouche of salmon pate provided a nice appetite whetter.  And dessert was a tasty figgy pudding topped with vanilla ice cream.  Service is always cordial.  Raising a glass of Languedoc wine at the Philadelphia Cricket Club was the perfect way to say goodbye to Philly for now as I look forward to returning to Vienna!.

Comparing quality and all you can eat (except for Sachiko on Valencia) at the following I've visited frequently:
     - Sachiko on Valencia (Best quality highest price)
     - Takamatsu on Speedway (best all round for price / quality)
     - Sushi Garden on Broadway
     - Sushi Hama on Oracle

Price (lowest): 
1st (tie $20): Takamatsu, Sushi Garden,Sushi Hama
2nd (no all you can eat): Sachiko

Rice flavor (I expect a good balance of sweet and tangy) :
1st: Sachiko   
2nd (dull): Takamatsu   
3rd  (dull) (tie): Sushi Garden, Sushi Hama

Fish quality: same as Rice quality

Service & Decor: 
1st: Sachiko 
2nd: the rest are identical

Last deciding factors: 
If you like the Vegas roll (deep fried battered tasty as heck goodness)... Sushi Garden and Takamatsu have it. Sushi Hama has a weird sesame covered version and man is it greasy, not as good. 

At Takamatsu I've only had one bad experience with sloppy sushi at the bar from chef sloppy pants but there is one other chef who is very attentive and professional .. you'll spot him right away.

*I'm leaving out Wok'n Sushi and Sushi Ten, only went there once each but they were pretty good.

No much here for eating in -- mostly service counter with a few tables scattered about.  I had a cheesesteak and fries, which were fine -- although not memorable.  I think Jean's is safe choice, especially for takeout.

Wonderful, amazing, delightful, fantaBALOUS place!!!!!!

I love drinking tea (REAL tea, not that nasty iced tea sh*t), so I was pleased with their menu selection of different types of black tea. the desserts were very delicious and filling. They had scones with proper cream (British style) just like the ones I ate during my childhood in England. 

The decor is so pretty and bright, I enjoyed seeing the flowers and paintings around me as we drank tea and ate our meals. 

We were served teas in pretty China tea cups and saucers (yasssss). 

I will come back here again for my birthday.

I've visited the Manhattan a couple times and enjoyed the food immensely. I'm a cheese chick, and these folks know how to add it in all the right places. Beef medallions with goat cheese....mashed potatoes with feta...ooh wee! But if you're looking for good-sized portions, this isn't where you want to be. It's gourmet food that tastes good and looks good...on a tiny plate...but without a tiny price.

Loved the bourbon ball drink, made with Makers Mark, Frangelico hazelnut,  and creme de cocoa.

I dig live music, so I applaud any establishment that aims to offer it on a nightly basis. But I worry about this spot because both times I went, I thought they were closed because there was literally nobody there. Granted, these were weeknights. It's in a residential area, so maybe location is a factor.
Best clinic in Edmonton. You need to go see Dr. Leoni he is the best dentist in town!

It started to rain while we were strolling the area. Popped in for a beer. Lovely patio area. Excellent selection of beer on tap.  Took a peek at the menu and have put this place on our let's go back and spend some time eating and drinking. We shall return

I came here for the first time for one of Buku Fest's after parties. After an awesome Friday at Buku Fest, my friends and I attended BUKU Late with NGHTMRE, B2B, Slander, Ekali, Medasin, Wavedash, and Klutch. 

The Joy Theater was not what I expected it to be. I thought it would be sort of like a movie theater with seats everywhere, but there was a massive dance floor for everyone to get down and dance! There is a front bar by the entrance and another bar inside by the dance floor, so everyone can get some drinks without too long of a wait. For the event, there were plenty of water containers for everyone who needed water, which was greatly appreciated. The restrooms are small, so there can be a line sometimes. I did not go upstairs, but it seemed like a lot of people enjoyed it up there. 

I go to a lot of events, but this was probably one of the better events I have been to. It was my first time here, so I really shocked with the sound and the lighting of the stage. The sound was clear with heavy bass that shook the whole dance floor. The lights added such dramatic effects and had a bunch of lasers shooting from the stage which looked amazing. Everything was done perfectly for the artists' talents to be showcased on stage! I know everyone had a blast for this event!

I'm still thinking about my visit last week! From the moment we walked in the service was attentive and friendly. The food was made to order, but quick (until dessert when another large party had arrived). This is a Caribbean spot with an upscale vibe: white booths, table cloths, definitely a spot for either a casual gathering or a nice dinner out.

The jerk wings were our favorite starter, all-over mouth heat (as jerk should be!) and juicy, tender meat. The heat paired well with the relaxed virgin sunrise cocktail (Virgin for the Virgin Islands, available with and without alcohol). Mmmmm! The Coco bread was tasty, but not a must-have, unless you're really feeling like cheese bread.

Go. You won't regret it.

On Wednesday, December 11th (approximately 10 p.m), my friend and I went to get a cheesesteak. When we walked to the counter, the male cashier loudly told my friend and me that they were out of food and only had water. I asked the guy if he was concerned about an angry online review. He brashly gestured to the empty dining room and said, "No. As you can see, business is booming." At this point, I was ready to leave, but my friend really wanted a cheesesteak. We had the audacity to order two fountain drinks. The guy told us that he had turned off the fountains (it was an hour before closing) and offered us Red Bull or water. I declined both; I generally don't drink energy drinks at night. The employee put the machine on and we did get soft drink. Midway during the meal, the cashier came over to my friend and me and apologized, saying he was kidding and gave us a cookie. At this point I had no stomach for dessert. The only reason why I didn't post sooner is because I've been busy and I wanted to write this review when I had time to ensure I express my disappointment. I won't be back. The next time my friend wants a cheesesteak, I'll save him the grief and just fly him to Philadelphia. The cashier was extremely rude and made me feel most unwelcomed.

Took my 2017 Jeep GC SRT to have lowering springs installed yesterday and I can't be anymore happy about the service.  To start off, Chase gave me all the information I needed to know and what to expect after having these springs installed.  He also took the time to price out other things I would like to get done to my Jeep.  You can tell that these guys are honest and not out there to make a quick buck.   I waited for my install which I thought would take 5+ hours but these guys got it done quick and done right!  I drove a little over an hour to get to them and I would definitely make the drive again to have any modifications done to it. Just the peace of mind of having things done right is priceless!  

If you love your Car/SUV as much as I do definitely do not hesitate to give these guys a call.  They will go above and beyond!  Amazing Customer Service!

My husband and I returned for a Valentine's weekend stay and every little thing was impeccable! The last time we were here was 5 months ago for our wedding - the wedding was fabulous, but service was spotty. What a difference 5 months has made, as the team here completes the transition into the Marriot family. This stay we opted for Club access, which is an incredible value, and staff here is above and beyond. 

This is a unique, gorgeous property. It also holds a special place in our hearts, being the place where we got engaged and got married. This stay truly solidified it as a mainstay in our lives, and a place we will be marking many a special occasion. Thank you for the continued memories!

Super cool place!
Small, personal, nice staff!

BEST PRICES IN TOWN.

The guys there must not make any money......  I have seen them sell things for less than what other gun shops in town are buying the for.

Awesome small business.  I look forward to seeing how the grow in their competitive market.  

Defiantly stop by and say hello.

It has everything but great food.
Pulled pork doused in sauce
Sides are from KFC - ok kidding, but might as well be
Randy's or 27th street are close and better
Sad too, because he has an awesome smoker and shack
Just seems to be mailing it in

Cappys is a favorite with my family because it has interesting typing choices and you can get either Chicago or new York style pizza. They also have interesting premises being on an old house. The beer selection it's pretty good and they have trivia cards at the tables. My family week talk to each other here more than everyone being on their devices.

If you are a donut lover, OR think donuts are just okay and want to change your mind, head to Beiler's and pick out a dozen, maybe 12 totally different flavors. There are so many types - you are BOUND to find something you love.

The yeast-based donuts are to die for, both topped and filled with some of the most incredible creams, jellies, custards, fruits, jams, glazes, and toppings you'd never think of.

Some highlights for us have included the classic Boston Creme, the maple bacon, the strawberry shortcake, and the key lime. When we have our wedding at Reading Terminal Market, we had to decide which desserts we wanted. Our biggest regret was not getting Beiler's! Maybe if we renew our vows someday. 

Until then, we feel lucky every time we get to pick up a box in Philly, or even at the local farmer's market near us now in Mullica Hill, NJ.

Incredible ham and sausage and greens.  Po'Boy great too althought it could use more sauce.

Great bloody mary.

Don't know why it took me so long to come here, visited for the first time with a group of friends. One of the features here is the ability to sit outside and be part of the "Ybor" culture. I ordered the Cioppino has the consistency of soup very good. A friend ordered the Salmon and also liked it. Need to go back and try one of their signature drinks. It's nice to see that Ybor has improved somewhat from what it used to be.

My boyfriend and i go here for every anniversary and it is spectacular! Wonderful ambiance, fantastic staff, wine and food. Very pricy but you get what you pay for.  The escargots is to die for and you can't miss with any entree! I highly recommend.

Relatively easy to get an appointment.  Amazing combo of deep tissue/Thai massage and stretching.  All masseuses have been incredibly professional

PHS Pop Up Garden, Pennsylvania Horticultural Society's pop-up beer garden on South Street is definitely a place to grab a cold beer, some food and relax with your pup. Philadelphia is known to be the least dog friendliest city, which surprised me that a lot of the local breweries were not dog friendly. But luckily I was able to find this pop up garden.

PHS Pop Up Garden is only available during the summer for their brewery. Have a handful of great beers on tap to choose from, some tasty menu items that include frito pie, buffalo ranch popcorn, featured irish whiskey and rose. Please note that there are also cocktails and non alcoholic beverages available as well for purchase (for those under age and/ or not drinking). 

My husband and I came here with our little girl dog on a Thursday early evening, a little before 5:30 pm. We had our IDs checked and then sat at a table and just enjoyed ourselves. My husband ended up getting beer, Founders IPA, $6.50, which he liked. I opted to go sans alcohol this evening since we had alcohol earlier in the day. 

Music was playing, the weather cooled down and had a light breeze. Friendly people stopped by our table to pet my dog (she just loves attention) and stayed here for about an hour. I wonder if there is something like this back at home where I live. 

Please note that most of the garden is covered in case it rains, in which it did sprinkle a little bit during our visit. There is also porta potties, but the nice ones that you would rent for an event. The ladies restroom had hand soap, hand dryers, paper towels and was clean upon my visit.

This pop up garden is definitely a great place to relax this summer, especially with your pup, grab a beer and meet up with a few friends.

Love this place! Quick fast and fresh! Went in last night and got a great discount, and food was ready in about 15mins! The cashier that greeted me, she was very sweet and helpful! This is always my go to pizza place!

Scape is one of the best local eateries to sit outside, eat good food and people watch. They offer curbside seating by a fountain in a walk friendly entertainment district.

The food is good too. I personally like the brunch (not buffet). The shrimp & grits appetizer is not as good as the sexy grits plate at Mojo, but it still rocks. I love the complimentary beignets delivered from the kitchen, as well as the organic poached eggs skillet (approx $10). Very fresh, and yummy. The food here is slightly pricey, but not bad. It's worth a couple of extra bucks for the view!

They got my order wrong. Ordered a chicken breast with salad and they gave me smothered cheese with chicken (pic attached). 

I'm in charge of a large school and I'm not eating lunch today because of this place. 

We are not ordering from here again and neither should you.

I will admit up front I am a serial diner at Bakersfield, but It's just so darn good. The food is always fresh and full of flavor, and the wait staff are very helpful and friendly. Items I recommend would the the guacamole (use the spoon!) or the queso as a starter. The margaritas are very fresh and tangy, plus there is a great selection of local brews. Pollo Asado  or Short Rib Tostadas are excellent (large portions to share). For Tacos my faves are short rib (is this a trend?), Baja Shrimp, and Carnitas. I like to add a healthy dose of fresh squeezed lime to the tacos. About the only thing that is not a go to for me are the Tortas which are essentially a sub sandwich (lots of bread). I have never had a bad meal or bad service here, a great value for downtown too.

First time tonight going there! Awsome servers, we had 9 people eating and no complaints, Awsome steak , on a side note it could have been a little bigger! , taste wise, it was awsome! Will definitely go again

Great sandwich, was torn between the tower and French dip. Glad with my tower choice. My boyfriend used to go there all the time and he said it's still as good but their prices are higher and the portion sizes are smaller than before.
I love the simple menu, fast but fresh food and nice atmosphere. I had the Chinese chopped salad band Thai curry soup...the perfect combination for a cool winter afternoon. The staff was awesome!!

Was greeted with a smile and warm hello as soon as I entered the door. My daughter ordered the meatball sub kids meal with Ruffles cheddar and sour cream chips, and pink lemonade. I got the Greek chicken grilled sub with a small Harvest Chicken salad. The wait was brief as there were no other orders ahead of us. My sandwich was flavorful with it's tzaziki dressing and banana peppers. The salad was ok...I'm not a fan of iceberg lettuce, even if it's mixed with other greens.   Checkout was easy, and we had no issues getting a table. Not a place I frequent often, but seem to enjoy it when I do.

The service is just strange.

My date and I went for dinner last night.  The waitress was attentive and kind but she didn't speak much English and she was apologizing a lot.... not sure why.

The food was good though.  I had halibut and and chips and it was probably the best I've had in a non-seafood joint.  It was actually delicious.  My date had some special burger.  It was called the Radical something... and it looked great.  He enjoyed it... ate every bite!

The fries were overcooked... but that doesn't really bother me.  

All in all, it's a decent choice when you want something casual in South Common.

I wanted to love this place so much because it's steps from the apartment. It was pretty dead for a Friday night which was nice because we were seated right away. My boyfriend and I ordered one cocktail, one beer, shrimp & grits and the redfish. The drinks took a really long time and once my cocktail was done, the server first delivered it to the wrong party. When it was sent back the server picked it up and brought it over to our table. When I tasted it, it was so disgusting and definitely not what I ordered so I told another server that i think they got it wrong. She told me she would take it throw some mango in it but I decided to just have water at that point. The shrimp & grits were PERFECT - like the best I've had, I was very impressed. My boyfriends dish though was so shockingly salty, that a guy who will pretty much eat anything pushed his food around while stealing bites of mine. I offered to send it back but he is way too sweet and felt bad because they were closing. It tasted like the chef had tripled the correct amount of salt and then added another 1/2 cup to taste. I ended up mentioning it to the server despite my bf's protests because it was bad. The two stars are for the shrimp & grits bc they were phenomenal but the mediocre service and severely oversalted dish kept Munch from getting any more stars.

Wow! Where to start. Let's start with Patty. What a gem. She took such good care of us. Her knowledge of the menu was extensive & refreshingly accurate She was kind helpful & provided an excellent experience. The food. Excellent. Nice size portions . Top quality. Flavorful. Everything was amazing. The atmosphere. Feel like you are in someone's home. Outstanding all the way around. What a hidden treasure.

Good looking place. My friend and I both had the burger, which was very tasteless, but the shoestring fries were yummy. I had one glass of wine and it was good. I will definitely come back but probably just for wine.

Fantastic customer service!! My boyfriend and I rented jet skis & the two guys that helped us were friendly and answered all of my embarrassingly dumb questions. They also took awesome pictures of us on the jet skis before we took off. Once out on the water the jet ski ride was lots of fun and we got a full hour. Overall the experience was safe, friendly and fun thanks to the workers and water!
Great people and service!  They not only helped me with my current issue but took on finding out why my second car still did not have plates.  amazing service that goes beyond measure.

Wow, they are great! I stopped in on a whim wanting to have some fun and rent a faster jet ski and they delivered! Jet ski is fairly new and topped out at 50mph. The scenery of the area was great, service was also good.

Highly recommend them, had no expectations renting from them but today/my hour jet ski rental was top notch. 

The reviews do not lie, they truly are 5 star when it comes to a fun boat rental!

Hola! If you love Mexican food, this is the place! A big plus for me is their homemade flour tortillas! They are thin and delish, nothing is better than a homemade tortilla! The chips and salsa are good, I personally like thin chips, these are thick but good, the salsa is thin but full of flavor and spice!!

I got their Masterpiece dish, which consists of a taco with your choice of meat, ( I got the ground beef) , enchilada and chili relleno. All my favorites in one dish! I like that you can choose between refried beans or whole pinto beans. Don't get me wrong, I love refried beans, but I do love some whole pinto beans! 

The taco was so yummy, I could eat 15 but my body don't need 15!  The meat was seasoned perfect, filled with cheese , lettuce and tomato oh my! The chili relleno was cheesy and yum and perfect amount of spice ! I also love that they do not use so much batter, which turns me off. I unfortunately didn't get to my enchilada, was way full! Oh and the rice! Light and fluffy with great flavor! 

My husband got the sliced pork carnitas, oooo my yum!! The meat was so flavorful and tender! Another family member had the Chili Verde , ummm fantastic! So full of flavor and Mexican spices and beef so tender!

The only bummer part of this was the service. When we did get service it was friendly, but in terms of getting us menus and taking our order could have been better, but it was a very busy Friday night and big parties at each table. We have been here before and have had good service.

We had a wonderful stay here! The staff was wonderful, our room as well as the rest of the hotel was clean and very well-maintained. The pool was wonderful, they have a free breakfast which is included in your stay. Rooms are spacious, the bathroom is clean and well stocked. I have on-site parking which is affordable and you are right downtown able to walk to restaurants and shopping. Highly recommended, especially at this price!

Horrible service by the manager who is an older gentle man with tattoos (just so you know who I am not ok with). So I had immense surgery on my neck from a previous car accident and went to the drive through.  The man in the drive through rushed us so badly and over talked and expected us to understand what in the world he was saying. After approaching the window and asking if the drink was correct, the lady.was sweet and tries pushing the drink through the window of the car. I get it after being out of work for 2 weeks I get it..but be excited to work again because we customers are putting money into your paycheck. Then the manager (after I asked for him), tries backing up the guy and gets angry at me for asking if the drink is right. How is this my fault if I'm paying for the meal and trying to be happy with what I'm going to eat? The manager gets more annoyed and tells us " well anything else you need today?!!!!" And we said no thanks and he says "ok great have a great day then!!!!" 
I even explain and said," look I'm sorry I just had surgery and it's just hard for me to hear and understand what you guys are serving." They are not apologetic only expect you to know th e rules and pay them. If just a "I'm sorry yes we will look into this asap!" Was said which was NOT, I wouldn't complain. I think the owners should talk to the manager and the window speakers. #THISISNOTOK TO TREAT CUSTOMERS.
I am so happy with the services here. Our dog actually prances after a visit for nails and grooming.

Simple yet amazing. We dropped in for lunch. It was crowded but we got a table within 15 minutes. I had the cold roast beef with arugula and horseradish. The name is a bit ironic because the onion roll was toasted with butter on the flat top which made the sandwich that much better! The husband had the Italian which was killer. We shared potato salad and the house made chips. Every bite was better than the last. This place consistently delivers.

More often than not, if I'm at Lakeside's food court  at lunchtime Byblos is where I choose to eat.  There are several menu options, and the food is good.

Today I had the rice bowl with brown rice, gyro meat, tzaziki sauce, lettuce, tomato, red onion and this delicious red pepper sauce.  I don't know what's  in the sauce, but I love it! It's spicy and very flavorful.  I'd describe the flavor if I could, but it's not something I recognize.  My husband had it on his rice bowl once and urged me to try it.  I'm definitely not sorry that I did!

In addition to their rice bowls their gyros are fantastic and so are their mixed grilled veggies.  

I have a hard time finding healthy AND tasty food in the mall. There's Subway, and they have some healthy options, but I'm not crazy about the way anything tastes. There's Smoothie King, but sometimes when I drink my lunch, i just don't feel like I've had a meal.  At Byblos I don't feel like I'm sacrificing anything to have both taste and a healthy lunch.

Crowded, but not a crazy long wait. 
Breakfast was good and not too pricey. 
Service wasn't the best, but I wouldn't call it slow either since it was crowded. 
One negative I have was my coffee wasn't too hot and the mugs are so small. 2nd cup was hot though. 
I'd definitely recommend this place for breakfast.

Wow!  Where to start?

My fiancé and I were lucky enough to sit in the outdoor/patio area.  It was PACKED!!  We anticipated a long wait for appetizers, wine, and food since every seat in the entire restaurant was taken, but everything came in a timely manner.

Onto the food:  The arancini is an absolute must-order.  It was the highlight of the meal.  I wish we had placed 2-3 orders.

My fiancé ordered the spaghetti and meatballs.  The meatballs were juicy, flavorful.. just perfection.  I got the shrimp scampi.  I will admit I had a little food envy after taking a bite out of one of the meatballs, but no complaints on the scampi.  
We will be back next time we are in Philly.  Until then I'll be dreaming of those Rice balls.

I have never had troubles getting a reservation and I've been three times in the past year! However for people who reserve online CHECK YOUR SPAM FOLDER the confirmation was sent there. The food here is so good and one of my favourite places to have a night out. The atmosphere is both perfect for a romantic evening and for a cool place to take your friends. I was proposed to here so it will forever have a place in my hear. I know my (now) husband was really happy with the service from the owners who really helped him out with the whole proposal aspect of the evening. I've also brought a friend here from out of town and she quoted the place as one of the best places she's ever been to as well. This is definitely on my top recommended places for anyone in downingtown to go! Just remember it's cash only and byob 50$ per person before tip which is amazing for the quality food you are getting and the great vibe!

Rue127 is an absolute gem.

This New American restaurant-- only two months on the scene-- strikes the perfect balance between Louisiana comfort and New Orleans chic. The wine selection is extensive, the service staff is friendly and attentive, and the food is absolutely incredible. As an extra plus, diners can watch the chefs (both CIA grads and former Commander's Palace chefs) in action through the clear window into the kitchen.

My favorites included the amuse-bouche (a corn cake, craime fraiche, and salmon combo), the risotto (so rich and creamy), and the homemade vanilla ice cream topped with peanut brittle. 

I was very impressed with the variety of options created by the dessert chef-- including deep-fried cupcakes-- and I was particularly impressed by how involved the executive chef's family was in the business... waiting, bussing, hosting, tending bar. You can tell-- as soon as you walk in-- that you're entering a family establishment. One can only hope that as Rue127 takes off (as it undoubtedly will) it can hold onto that intimate feel.
My wife and I love going here and have been twice in the past couple of weeks. Build our own bowls is our favorite. Delicious and plenty to eat.

I came for the blackened Fresh Florida Grouper Sandwich and it didn't disappoint but it didn't wow me either. If you're here it's probably the item to get. I was also interested in the seafood chowder. It only comes in a bowl so I got my friend Will on board so we could split it. They actually brought it out split in two for us which was thoughtful. My interest was mostly based on how much seafood they've packed into this bowl. It's got clams, grouper fish, and even shrimp in here. I thought it was just okay and could have had more quantity of the seafood and less of the chowder.
Ordered online & it was waiting for me at a table close to the door when I arrived. I've never eaten at this restaurant before but I will for sure be back! Our food was fresh & delicious!!
This place is such a little gem and has such a great vibe . Food is good and everyone is so friendly .

Dream Girl and I dropped in on a Saturday night, which we knew might be a mistake, and in a way it was. The place was so noisy that we planned to move on, but the hostess told us we could go upstairs. Then she said that upstairs was only if you "knew someone", but we went on up anyway.

Service there was slow though there were few customers when we arrived. It filled up and we saw several orders returned as they weren't right. My Manhattan was first made with Scotch and returned. The second one was just boubon and water. I just kept it as that's an OK drink for me, but it seems strange that a place like that doesn't know how to make a Manhattan.

The food, when it arrived, was good. I had the Baked Eggs Southern Style and DG had a cheeseburger. We ate it all and were filled up.

It's hard to rate this place, but I gave it 4 stars for its excellent renovation and the history. Food is fine, but service - at least upstairs on the balcony - is 2 stars. The noise seems to be what new restaurants and their customers want, but conversation is tough. The mezzanine was quieter espeially back by the wall, so we were OK in that department. We enjoyed the videos with music from the past.

I was in that building many times as a boy when it was Woolworth's. The tuna salad sandwiches for 35 cents and a nickel Coke were excellent!

Great experience, today. I had a "tangled" chain. My regular bike shop told me it wold be two weeks to inspect and another two weeks to repair. This bike shop is a Central Indiana staple. I called Gray Goat - South. They told me to bring in my bike. I did and it was repaired in thirty minutes. Great service, friendly staff and I felt I was a professional operation. The repair price was fair. While I was waiting I found a new bike I may purchase. Great staff!
I love this place in the heart of the funk zone their patio is so much fun. Their beer is awesome and they always have a great selection. Staff is super friendly ! Highly recommended.

This used to be my go-to place for everything.  A woman used to manage this store-she, and the store was great.  She's long gone and it's gone WAY down hill.  Compared to Lowe's at Glendale, landscape plants are crap.  Compared to Lowe's "Allen + Roth" lines, home decor items and furnishing lack any sense of style, and selections are non-existent.  Shelves holding tile do not match the displays and displays are not marked.  

Most importantly, service is non-existent.  Have a return?  Expect to stand in line without any acknowledgement like 'I'll be right with you'.  Expect to walk by no less than 6 employees, none of who will ask if you need help.  You can use the app to try to find stuff, but there is a good chance it will be wrong.  When someone does ask you how you are doing or need help, and you kindly return the question, they are 'waiting to go home'.  Or, when I asked someone if they could help me get down and impossible to reach item, you'd thing I asked them to cut off their arm they were so put-out. 

Expect cashiers who can't ring things up.  Use self checkout? Expect no help with ringing oversized items, or when I tried to ring up and item, the cashier snapped 'that's the wrong one!'.  Why would you put multiple bar codes on a product?

This isn't just here, I had similar experiences at an out of state store.  I returned most of what I bought and repurchased similar things from Lowe's.  I work too hard for my money to be treated like crap when I spend it.

Ate at the White Dog Cafe on Sansom Street in Philadelphia back in April, where they specialize in local foods (delicious.) and taking it slow. 

But maybe that was just our waiter taking the whole slow food movement far too literally. We could have done better with a *little* more attention from the waitstaff.

Regardless: All good. And highly recommended.

p.s. The structure itself is also a delight: the restaurant spans two old homes and the tables are set in alcoves and cosy corners to lend intimacy without being small.

I have been going with my family since 1987.  It is my favorite restaurant in all the world.  Whenever anyone comes to town I take them or suggest they give it a try.  The current owner is George who took over from his folks when they retired.  He has kept 100% of the charm I remember from my childhood.  The calamari and saganaki are to die for! For added ambiance, go on a Friday or Saturday night when they have a belly dancer.

Heard about the buzz on this restaurant and after seeing all the pictures of their food, I thought I'd check out the place for dinner.

When we arrived at the restaurant, we noticed one of the chefs and waitresses standing outside smoking a cigarette right in front of the entrance. When we actually entered the place, there was no-one to be seen. Right at the entrance, there is a stairwell up the second floor...so we thought perhaps we needed to walk upstairs to be seated. Finally, the hostess (who was in the midst of eating her dinner) stood up from seating near the bar to seat us. It was 8PM and there were absolutely no customers so we were concerned. Once we got our menus, we noticed that there were no sushi options which was disappointing because that was the main reason we came to try out this restaurant. We asked if there was a separate sushi menu -- to our continued disappointment, we were informed that they lost their sushi chef...

Nevertheless we stayed and ordered some of the Thai selections. We ordered the Chicken Drunken Noodles and Spicy Bamboo dishes. To our pleasant surprise, the flavor was decent for both dishes. The chicken was slightly overcooked which gave a rubbery taste, but the spices made up for it. In my opinion, the portions were a tad smaller compared to other Thai restaurants with the same price point. 

This particular dining experience left me wanting more...especially the sushi.

Great barbecue! We sat on the patio and enjoyed the nice weather. We ordered and our food was delivered in minutes. You can tell they do a lot of business and take care to make sure the dishes are served fast and fresh. Our server was very friendly and checked on us frequently. Would definitely recommend.
I started with three tacos and they were so good I ended up trying all of them. The albondigas were my favorite. I was in town for for days and went back three times.

This is not your typical burger joint. I've been there several times now and their burgers are excellent. Staff are super friendly and accommodating just a great little place to have a burger And a beer. I think it may be the best burger in town , the fries were OK.  I haven't tried there onion  rings yet but I heard good things. And they a have craft beer on tap.
Easter Brunch consisted of avocado toast and fried chicken sliders.  The sliders came with sausage gravy which was good not too spicy.  Avocado toast was fresh and delicious.
