Not the best bookstore, but certainly not the worst either. The store has its own publishing company: Black Widow Press-- dealing specifically with authors from the Dada/Surrealist movement. They've only published the discontinued poems of authors such as Tristan Tzara, Robert Desnos, and Andre Breton, however it is still a start! Personally, I would prefer if they republished some of the harder-to-find stuff such as Jacques Vache's '4 Dada Suicides,' however I suppose there is always the internet. So if you get lost in the Vieux Carre Quarter from drinking too many Absinthe's, stumble your way over to this bookstore and check out the Black Widow Press stuff...

We've been here many times. Food is good for SB but nothing special. However our 8 year old likes the kids pasta that comes with a soft cone ice cream. When it came to dessert, I asked for an adult cone and a kids cone. We were told to wait 10 mn for the machine to freeze ice cream. We waited. Another 10 mn later, the young manager said it would take another 10 mn. So we waited. Finally we said we can't wait anymore as my husband had to go to work. They offered my kid a piece of toffee to compensate. The hostess at the desk apologized and offered to bring the dessert menu to "buy" dessert! So we complained that we've been waiting 20-30 mn for the stupid soft cones and asked to see the manager. she said she was the manager!! The least they could have done is to comp us for a dessert, having waited so long. And we told her so. But The manager was less helpful than the male server who hardly showed up. Meanwhile the place was packed. obviously they are taking their loyal clientele for granted. Sorry Jane, you lost us as customers. You should train your managers to try to remedy problems not accentuate them. The manager said the ice cream machine rarely didn't work. I pointed this out that another time we came in and the same happened. Maybe time to have a plan B for the when the machine doesn't work? Toffee won't cut it in any kid's book. Very disappointing how things were handled by a young, seemingly inexperienced manager. And since when is the hostess the same as a manager. Cutting corners in staffing definitely shows. Be forewarned.

Well today (8/5) I gave Jet's another chance.  The concord location screwed up my on-line order and the manager Jenna gave us a gift certificate to come back and try again.  Well tonight I ordered three pizzas.  The guy on the phone sounded new when he took my pick up order so I made sure to review my order several times.  Low and behold I show up 20 minutes later and they screwed up my order again, failing to enter in my third pizza.  They offered to make me another one at no charge to which I waited another 20-25 minutes.  While waiting, I watched a kid who was cutting pizza and placing pies into boxes.  He was also packaging wings to go.  His mask was down below his mouth and around his chin the entire time I waited for my pizza.  At check out, I mentioned this to the manager who did absolutely nothing.  I then proceed to pay for my pizzas.  I gave them a Jet's coupon for 20% off and then proceeded to give him my gift certificate.  He said, " I cant use both"!  No where on coupon or my gift certificate did it say this was a problem.  Since when is a gift certificate not considered "cash".  After insisting he call his boss, he figured out how to do the transaction.  Then I realized I was charged for the pizza they screwed up and told me would be free.  This location is not managed well and the kids working there clearly don't give a shit.  Look at your security footage between 6-6:30pm on 8/5 and you will see your darling pizza handler with his mask not covering his nose or mouth.  He is the PIZZA HANDLER and you manager kid said nothing!  Wish I had my phone that I left in the car so I could have snapped a picture to show!  For what you charge for pizza you should be able to get better help.

We were very unhappy with our food. It had a weird taste. We ordered 1/2 chicken, mac and cheese, mashed potatoes with graveyard and biscuits. Nothing was good we had it delivered thru a service and the delivery was quick first time I order there and I will not order again
Zanies is the best comedy club in town.  Top level comics, shows start on time, and the drinks are great.  The Machine is the best drink and best value for your money.

We came here specifically for their happy hour.  Before we left, we checked the website to make sure they were having it today.  When we got here, we were told the booths at the bar were 4 reservations only so, naturally, I said we'd sit at the bar 4 happy hour.  Then the charming (he said sarcastically) host & hostess said there was no happy hour.  I explained to them we came here because there was a happy hour, per the restaurant's website.  The hostess shrugged her shoulders.  The host said something to the effect of whaddaya gonna do.  I said I wanna speak to the mgr.  The mgr. (Adrienne?  Andrea?) apparently went to the same charm school as the host & hostess.  All she said was that she'd call the webmaster.  I said that does me no good.  She (guess what?) shrugged her shoulders.  Against my better judgment I stayed.  I'm glad I did.  Justin the bartender made our day.  Not only is he a great bartender, he's got a great sense of humor & great personality, but, most importantly, he totally understands how to provide excellent customer service.  Justin should b the mgr. of this place.  The food here is always good but Justin seems to b the only 1 who works here who knows how to treat customers

Federal donuts is more than coffee and donuts! Thier chicken sandwich is really great, the fried chicken is juicy and the sweetness of the potato roll compliments the slightly spicy saice they use. The donuts are also fantastic you can taste the freshness. After having one you won't be able to eat a "donut" from Dunkin ever again!
I go once a week and it's always amazing! Staff is friendly as well. I order from the app and only once was there an issue with the cup not being filled. (Only once though)

It's located smack dab in the French Quarter, and like so many other restaurants in the area it knows it's audience, tourists. This place is a tourist trap, nothing more. Get outside the French Quarter, go ask a local, but please go else where to find MUCH better food.
Megan did my hair and makeup for a wedding that I was a guest at. She was amazing!!! Took my ideas and style type and made me feel so pretty!!! I would highly recommend Megan and this salon.

Some of the stylists are very nice and do a great job. But honestly I wouldn't waste my money here. I used to go all the time. But the last couple times I went I decided that was it. I wasn't even acknowledged when I walked in. I signed in, sat down, and not one person said anything to me until it was my time to come back. I'm not saying you need to kiss my butt when I walk in the door, but a simple "hi, how are you...what can we help you with..." would be nice. Cindy is the manager and she's the worst! She is so rude! She is very obnoxious. The stylists yap to each other while they're doing your hair, curse, talk about people who aren't there. It's not relaxing at all. They have really raised their prices too. If you're going to spend that kind of money do yourself a favor and go to a nicer place.
Same day service and they fixed my garage door properly. The prices were reasonable and high service quality
We ate brunch last Sunday here. Very cute spot with outdoor seating. The food was good - I had the Moroccan beef with eggs, while my wife had the crab omelet. The staff is very friendly.

This place is amazing! Definitely a must try if you are in Nashville. The food menu is just as unique and delicious as the drink menu. We couldn't get a reservation but waited a short time and sat at the bar. We had to google a few items on the menu and that's fantastic in my eyes. Definitely a stand alone restaurant  must

First let me say that I'm Cantonese and also a major foodie.  I've been coming to Dragon Village for years when Mary was the owner and was initially worried when she sold the restaurant to a new owner, who's name is Billie.  

I've eaten at the 'new' Dragon Village a half-dozen times now and am thrilled that Billie, who is also Cantonese, has decided to add authentic Cantonese dishes to the menu.  For example, beef chow fun, Cantonese 'dry' style ('gaun chow now haw') is a classic dish that you will not find in your typical Americanized Chinese restaurant because it is very difficult to cook correctly.  The version at DV is truly outstanding, with tender beef, perfectly cooked noodle and great 'wok hei' flavor on par with what you would find in NYC or San Francisco China Town.  If you want to sample authentic Cantonese food in Tucson, this dish is a must-order.  

Another Cantonese classic on the menu is 'Young Chow Fried Rice', which is very different than the simple fried rice you typically find at other restaurants.  The Dragon Village version is the best you'll find in town, with stir fried white rice (no soy sauce), shrimp, roast pork, lettuce and egg.  I've had this dish dozens of times here and it never fails to disappoint.

Last week I tried the 'Singapore Mei Fun', a curry infused stir-fried fine rice noodle with chicken and shrimp.  This is another dish that really tests the skill of the chef and again is perfectly executed at Dragon Village.

According to Billie, he has also added Cantonese style roast chicken dish to the menu, but I haven't tried it yet.  I hope he continues to add Cantonese items because there are very few places in Tucson to have this style of Chinese food.  

I've also tried some of my 'go to' non-Cantonese dishes from when Mary owned the restaurant and I'm happy that they haven't changed one bit.  For example, the curry shrimp is still fantastic with zucchini, potatoes, and cabbage in addition to the generously sized shrimp.  According to Billie, the main chef stayed with the restaurant, so it makes sense that these dishes are the same.

I definitely recommend Dragon Village but if you go there, be brave, pass on the orange chicken and try some of Billie's new Cantonese dishes!

Seriously the best first twenty minutes of your toddler's life. 

$1.50 gets you there. $3.00 gets you there and back with your screaming toddler, his stroller, your nephew and his bicycle. 

And if it's as awesome as you imagine you can go again. Or you can stay home and drink. Drink all of the wine.
Always great specials. I can't get enough of this place . I just found out about their Saturday brunch, I will be attending .

Will never eat here again! Tonight as I'm enjoying a meal with my friend for her birthday I look over and see A ROAXH CRAWLING ON THE BACK OF HER BOOTH SHE WAS SITTING IN. and not a tree roach, a damn German roach. These roaches are not found outside, they dwell in dirty place and by the THOUSANDS. y'all know what roaches I'm talking about!!! Never have I ever had this happen to me ANYWHERE, even in the French Quarter!! Anyways, we have our waiter get the manager and he proceeds to tell me that's it's no big deal and it's hot and we were by the door! Excuse me? I used to work in the French quarter with OPEN DOORS and never had this happen to any GUESTS! And for the manger to just shrug his shoulders at the uncleanliness of his own restaurant is disturbing! If you want Mexican please travel the extra few blocks to Corettas, it's WORTH IT AND CHEAPER!!

My garage door has been broken for close to a week. Another company came out twice. The first time was working but questionable and stopped working by the next day. They came back, supposedly fixed the door, but quit working within an hour. I contacted Local Garage Doors on Friday, July 9th, 2022, and they scheduled me between 1:00 and 3:00 PM on July 11, 2021. They followed up with a text confirming that date and time. I called because I wanted to speak with the tech coming out to explain what was going on to try to avoid several more trips figuring out what was wrong. The person who answered seemed to have no idea anything was scheduled, and left me on hold a long period of time, then came back and said my appointment was scheduled in error. They can schedule me another day. They have "no one working in Nevada today". I thought this was a local family owned business. They also advertise as open every day of the week. I had already canceled a third visit with the initial company with whom I was working. Now I'm stuck in my garage for who knows how long. I've had a major surgery on my back that makes manually lifting the door out of the question. And Local Garage Doors made virtually no contact with me to let me know the schedule was an error and no one would be here.

12 July 2021.  This is an update to above. Local Garage Door just sent me an automated phone call and an email that a tech was on the way. I DID NOT reschedule after they didn't show up or notify me that they would not be here for the appointment on 11 July. No way would I use this place now.

Finally a Vietnamese place in South Tampa that is authentic and delicious! Of course if you are coming here you have to get the pho, in addition, the pork chops are phenomenal. If you are an iced coffee fan be sure to try out the Vietnamese iced coffee! Egg rolls and summer rolls were so good though too!

I could not be happier with the service I received at Rennen! Not only did they have the lowest price for the service I received (compared to two other locations), they were extremely quick. I called at 5pm and was able to bring my car in the next morning and they had it finished by 3pm. Steve was so friendly and I wish I could rate higher than 5 stars!

2 beers and any breakfast item for $16 is a great deal. The Bloody Mary was fantastic and perfectly spiced. Lots of wonderful outdoor seating and the patio is dog friendly which is always a plus! Food was 4 out of 5 but overall I'd give it 5 for good drinks, atmosphere, friendly staff, clean restaurant.

They have some really good beers and it is a very fun brewery to visit.  They have some fun names for their beers.  One was "Or it gets the Gose", which is a reference to Silence of the Lambs.  Also, B Nektar Zombie Killer was surprising good.  I usually don't go towards fruity drinks, but it could be a habit forming mead/cyser.  I wish I lived closer.

This is a super clean, very quaint hotel near Frenchman and a few blocks from Bourbon.  I go to NOLA at least once a year and I have stayed in many of the old hotels.  They all have a lot of charm but this one is by far the best.  It is old but it isn't dingy or musty like the others and it is VERY clean.  The tiny bar and restaurant is top notch and every day it is filled with locals that stop by for a bite or a drink.  The best part of all is the staff.  They are all courteous and helpful.  Mostly they are friendly in the NOLA way, treating you like an old friend.  I will only stay here from now on!

Best vegan burger I have ever tasted. The fries are what they're known for but they should be known for perfecting the vegan burger. I'm not fully vegetarian, but this one makes me want to convert. I like the variety of dips and spreads offered for the fries and burgers and they have a decent beer selection with rotating taps.
never will go back. went there in the afternoon on may 17th 2017. food not good and management were very impolite, disrespectful, arrogant, unfriendly, rude, unprofessional, and not courteous at all!

If you go in with a coupon they will find a reason not to honor it. 

I have never gotten color in my hair. I have always been sort of afraid to try something new. But recently I had been considering it and then I got this coupon in the mail. And I finally thought that this would be the perfect time to try something new. 
It was new customers event that they were having, so I though that it would be perfect! 
even though we are both new customers, they refused to honor a coupon with my sisters name on it (same last name!). It was bad enough that 
the stylist had to embarrass me in front of a room full of people, but she didn't have to get nasty with me.  That's not a way to treat first customers nor is it a way to build repeat business. I will happily pay full price somewhere else.

Came here for brunch specifically for the French toast (because I LOVE French toast) and it was DELICIOUS. Simple yet full of flavor - exactly how it should be. Also had eggs, bacon and home fries and everything was fantastic!! I also tasted my husbands cheesey grits and they are a party in your mouth! Definitely recommend this diner find in Seminole Heights!

Most DISGUSTING food that I have ever eaten. I felt bad because our waiter was good, but the food reminded me of food that I would imagine being served in a nursing home. My party was so grossed out. My dish had a chicken dish and the sauce was slop and the chicken was like a McDonalds happy meal. I question whether I will have food poisoning this week or not. AVOID THIS SLOP HOUSE LIKE THE PLAGUE. I only gave it 1 star because there is no option for ZERO STARS .

Woo hoo! Is right, Yelp! I loved this place. Stopped in while visiting family over the holidays. Loved the beer selection, unique food and the burgers were awesome! 

We had a few Dogfish Head beers, flight of a few other craft beers from the area.  I loved the atmosphere - it was rustic, gastropub-y & an old time America feel to it. Would definitely stop in again. 

It is small so I would recommend reservations if they have it or expect to wait a few minutes. Cheers!
Really great food! We've been driving from San Diego stopping along the way and this is the best stop we've made so far by far!! (:

I used this Brake Master years ago until they were selling me things - a second and third opinion dismissed.  Have not been there for years but put new tires on a car and shop recommended them.  I tried BM again for an alignment.  After that I had clunking going on - went back to tire shop.  They found nothing, found private person who diagnosed the tie rod had loose nut.  Took car back into BM they said they re-align.  During this time an irate customer was bringing his car in for the third time for alignment.  Three times?  Save your time - go else where!  I will not be back.

This chain is over hyped.   I had a slab of ribs that were tough, undercooked and nowhere near as good as they should have been.   I am used to fall off the bone ribs.  If that's what you are looking for, this is NOT the place.  Smells good, though.

Ordered delivery through Postmates , Not giving a 5 because I only ordered the rice & peas, fried plantains & quesadilla .   ny meal was  delicious .  Got the side of hot sauce which was very yummy .   Very satisfied & will order from there  again ...

Nice to find Latin food  in the area .

This high-end establishment draws us back again and again. It is hard to imagine better food in a nicer setting with more elegant service. It is elegant without being pretentious. Menu remains small but with enough varied and creatively unique dishes that everyone in your party will find something they will love. Unusual in this restaurant category is that it is BYOB, so you have no excuse for not having a perfect wine too!
Great place to go!! They make you feel like you are family!! The food is fantastic !!!!!!

Old school ice cream shop that is a philly staple!!! Loved the unique flavors they have and how the "cups" are cute little takeout containers! My boyfriend loves waffle cones and always gets them whenever we get ice cream and he said that this waffle cone was the best he's ever had :) On the pricier side for ice cream, but you get plenty for it. I got a small ice cream in a cup but added whipped cream and it filled up the whole container and I couldn't finish it because there's so much lol. Definitely worth a visit if your in the old city region by the riverside and craving some good ice cream!!

My wife and I are huge fans of Mexican food.  We are also very picky. Grand Hacienda Mexico was absolutely fantastic! We visited this place while on vacation and if this restaurant was near where we live we'd eat there every night.
The chimichanga I ordered was outstanding. It was big and it was flavorful.
My wife ordered the chicken tacos and she loved them. They were not dried out like other Mexican places tend to serve.
The huge basket of chips and the large serving of salsa was just the icing on the cake.
Trust me when I tell you that you will not be disappointed eating here!
LOVE sushi. This place is great and should be a regular spot if you enjoy a sushi night out.

I have never eaten there, and can only speak for our Thanksgiving catered/take out experience. With a wife working full-time and in Grad school, and me working and redoing all our floors, for the first time in 27 years of marriage we decided to let someone else cook Thanksgiving dinner. The theme of dinner was a light hearted ribbing of my wife , who opted for Monells based on a work function meal catered by them. The fact that we didn't get food poisoning, and the turkey, kept it from being a one star.  The dressing was bagged cornbread stuffing with some water sprinkled on it. Mashed potatoes, not mashed with cream/milk or butter, but water. The Mac and cheese was some boxed mix, watery and terribly salty,(the only item seasoned). The cranberry sauce was straight from the can. The yeast rolls, well we 
should have done Sister Schubert. The gravy weak and bland. I didn't eat the veggies.

Its been awhile since I was last here which didn't leave a great impression on me because of poor service.  
I'm glad I came back.  I would say service wasn't bad but more indifferent but that didn't really bother me since I really enjoyed the food. 
We ordered guacamole with an assortment of chips which I couldn't stop eating them!
I then ordered the Raw Tuna Tostada which was SOOOOO good.  The dish came with 4 small tostadas topped with raw tuna so to some, this may not be considered enough for a meal but I found it enough, considering I ate a lot of chips with it. 
We got tres leches cake for dessert and wow. Definitely recommend. not too sweet.  moist with warm sweetness.  So delicious

Cupcakes are one my favorite foods, so this place is on one of my tops! I just recently moved down to Florida and when I drove past this place, I knew I had to stop! These cupcakes are all delicious.

My favorite is the blueberry. I can not get enough. I think the cream cheese frosting works so well. 

My life would be made if I could ever get a job there. You need to try this place if yo haven't, you won't regret it!

Fourking fantastic from start to finish!  The friendliness of the staff, the engagement, the food - all amazing!  

I wasn't too sure what to expect but was intrigued by the concept. The reservation process is simple (thanks Yelp!) and after that, you just show up on your reservation date. You'll be greeted with a smile and a welcome and be shown to your seat. You're not sardined into a spot, which is sooo nice. Your party is all served their courses at the same time and all you do is enjoy the experience. Everything we ate was delicious! We had such a great time that we made reservations for our next visit before we had even left. 

This is definitely a place to check out!

I was out to celebrate my friend new job position and we were looking for soul food so i went on yelp and this place popped up instantly. I had my son with me so i feared there would be no place for him to sit or park his little stroller. However, the hostess had got my son a high chair (which he sat in woohoo) and i was able to park my stroller in a spot away from people so I would not make any traffic. We started our night off with cocktails. I had a Cecil's Cocktail which was so delicious and minty for $8 bucks. Not too fruity and not too harsh, it was just right!  Not bad at all. My friend had the Ruby Hendrix which was very citrusy. She enjoyed her drink a lot as well! Finally It was time for food. We could not make our minds up on what to eat so we closed our eyes and wherever our hands landed that is what we ordered.  I ordered the slow cooked pot roast and pimento mac n cheese. I was very skeptical at first because not too many people can make a good tender and juicy pot roast. It was sooooo Good.  My roast was nice and juicy and just full looking. My pimento mac n cheese was good as well.I have never had pimento cheese before so i was blown away by the taste and texture. No complaints here! I took maybe five bites and was instantly full. My friend went with the Angus burger which she said was really good. we will be back it was good
Great new place to check out.  Perfect spot for dinner or even just to get a couple drinks.  Food was great and service was even better.  Will defiantly be back again.

I make it a point whenever I am in town to stop here for a nice selection of tasty treats. Weinrich's never fails to disappoint.  Classic goodies such as cookies, cupcakes, cakes and pie... along with petite fours (my personal favorite) and cannolis. The hubby says their coffee is pretty good too.  Stop by for a sweet treat and remember... share with the family!

When you are living on the South Side of town...you feel like the step child of the coffee community.   All the higher end craft coffee is in the Midtown area.  Or was.  I should say was.  Because now, OWC is down here on the week days.

A single espresso machine, brewed and pour overs can all be had here.  It's their roasting facility and they have it running like a well oiled machine. I assume this meant they were ready to take on the herculean task of satisfying the craft coffee needs of us Southies. (I'm kidding, dont call us southies.  That's ridiculous.)

The non-descript strip mall business park location becomes a bit more comforting inside with a couch and a small table to quaff your caffeine.  There is also a larger table with enough chairs for a small group of people.  

For the coffee snob.  This is exactly what you are looking for.   Quality beans, roasted in a quality way and then prepared by skilled baristas. 

Parking is great.  And so is the selection of bags for sale.

I've yet to receive my dress back from being altered and I can already tell you, I will not be returning for Sam's services.

 I suppose the first thing that irked me was the price ($50.. I've had similar alterations done for $20) of a few rather simple alterations to be complete in about 3.5 weeks to a dress that was no more than $45. I suppose you get what you pay for, so I agreed.

Yesterday, I went to pick up my dress on the date and time range that Sam and I had agreed on. To my surprise at 6:45 pm the store was closed with no lights on, even though business hours say that the store is opened until Mon-Fri until 7:30pm.

Though I was annoyed, I figured I could take my lunch to pick up the dress the following day. I arrived today at 11:45 AM and found a sign that said he would return at 12:00PM. No big deal. I can definitely wait 15 minutes. However, he never showed up. I finally ended up leaving at 12:15 after wasting my entire lunch waiting for him to show up. I saw at least 5 people go up to the door during the time I sat in my car waiting. 

I plan to go again tonight after I get off work as the event I am needing this dress for is on Saturday and in a completely different city and state. 

This is definitely not what I expect from a business regardless of how  my dress alterations turn out.

Shannon was a referral for my bridal makeup from one of her regulars that gets eyelash extensions. She is so sweet and did a wonderful job! Even though I had a few photos with shimmery eyeshadows, her experience shined through as she mentioned that matte shadows look the best in photos. She took several photos with her phone of her completed job and wrote down exactly the colors and products she used so it was easier on the day-of. She was very affordable and came on-site to my hotel. Everyone loved their makeup and I wouldn't hesitate to use her again! Not to mention that through her recommendation for a hair person she works with regularly for weddings (Lauren Woodard at Bliss), I found my girl to do my hair as well and was SUPER pleased with the result.

The food was unique. The salad bar is fantastic. The crouton are still hot... The steak was very well cooked because you cook it yourself. Overall a fantastic experience and the beer on tap was yummy. We will o back again.

We stopped again as regular customers and were really pleased with the meals. Two awesome burgers and two fried fish meals were cooked quickly and perfect. Fast service and friendly hosts. It's about a 20 minute drive off route to eat by the waterfront on the river, but there are so many good restaurants here and a pretty and safe river walk to stretch legs that it's worth the stop. We walked and saw some people rowing on the river and a few large cranes. Fun.

Vapor Savior is definitely a "savior". I went to this place because of word of mouth. If you are wanting to quit smoking  or go down to a less dangerous habit, I recommend vaping. I have heard countless stories of people switching to vaping e-cigarettes and it has saved their lives and it provided them with numerous of benefits. Of course the vapor contains nicotine, however you can purchase vapors that contain no nicotine at all. 
This place also carries a ton of flavors. I particularly enjoy the milk chocolate and cinnamon rolls. They also had some decent flavors. Mother's Joy wasn't too bad, but it was too subtle for my tastes. 
Be aware their e-juice is 70 percent PG and 30 percent VG, if you have allergies, I would ask for a 100 percent PG blend.
The staff is definitely helpful and you can try their many flavors. This girl definitely had some patience as I tried at least half a dozen flavors before I came up with two. The prices are also pretty competitive too. 
I so recommend and as well, they have a website where you can browse selections before you come to the store.
Its a huge place that I will come back to in the future!

Came here last night for the first time with my bf and we had a great experience. It was very busy which makes sense because the food is excellent. We sat inside, honestly it's a little too noisy for our taste but when we come back next time we will just sit outside. I got a really yummy gin cocktail that I loved. The okra fries app was outstanding and my boyfriend raved about them all night. I had the pompano entree and he had the duck entree. Both excellent. I had the key lime dessert and he had the ice cream of the day (which was banana spice or something like that) probably the best key lime dessert I've had in awhile. Service was good too. We will definitely be back

I took my 1996 Honda Accord in to get the "exterior detail" package and they did and excellent job on the car. They definitely shed a few years of sun damage off, especially on the hood. My car is shiny now instead of matte. The tires look new and the wheel wells look nice and black, huge plus.

Came here for Mother's Day dinner. They weren't busy when we arrived. They sat us upstairs where the lights were so dim you couldn't read the menu. When they closed the curtains due to the sun it was almost pitch black. Our server was Brian- he was an asshole. When we looked up the menu online we must have been viewing lunch. Asked the server if they had a lunch menu. He replied with attitude "Yeah for lunch but now it's dinner." Asked how many came with the filet sliders and Brian said 3. When they arrived it only came with 2. We called him over and he said "It depends on the size of the meat." Asked Brian if I could have just a regular cheese pizza instead of the Margherita as I don't like tomato or thick mozzarella. He said a Margherita pizza is just cheese. I tried explaining to him the difference and pointed to the table behind us where a girl had a simple cheese pizza. Brian fought me on it so I said whatever, never mind as I was now frustrated with his attitude. My pizza still came out with large chunks of tomato on it. Pizza had no taste and looked like it had been sitting for hours. Brian was rarely anywhere to be found through out the whole dinner. When he went to box our food, he used his BARE hands and put our pizzas in. The only good thing was the truffle fries. Never again, especially because Brian was a dick.

Our first time here. We ordered the dumplings which I thought they were pretty bland. We also ordered the chicken puff. This appetizer was the best out of the two. Then  we order the Chong's roll and another roll I can't even recall the name. It was forgettable. Both rolls were just OK. 
For drinks we ordered the old fashion and acai Cosmo. The Cosmo tasted like cough syrup I couldn't even finish it. 
We won't come back here.

Just had one of the tastiest meals I have ever had. We sat at the bar and started with the special fresh cucumber and gin cocktail and a Hobo Cabernet from Alexander Valley. Appetizers of refreshing ceviche full of tasty herbs and lime and (I never thought I would be saying this) umami bomb Brussels sprouts with a carmelized sugar fish sauce with Korean pepper that we devoured. I had one of the specials: squid and pork belly with Adzuki beans. It had a Fresno pepper verde sauce over it that was magical with the squid. D had the Local Black cod off the regular menu that had a browned butter sauce with miso and cooked perfectly. Peter and Johnny, the chefs, were very gracious and we enjoyed watching them work their artistry.

This JJ just opened... I don't know the exact date but it seems like it was this month (August 2012). Considering that, and that JJ is a chain sub shop normally staffed by teenagers, I didn't set my expectations super high. And overall I was pleasantly surprised.

My first visit was via the drive-thru. It's the first JJ I've ever been to with a drive-thru. The employee on the intercom was friendly and even a little funny, and the food came out super fast. Orders were correct. Nothing to complain about here.

My second visit was in store. The register employee needed some training. After taking payment he handed us cups and then just stopped talking. We've been to many JJ before, so we knew to sit and wait for sandwiches, but a new customer would have definitely felt like they were left hanging. Not a huge deal since he was probably on his first week. Then my sandwich came out on the wrong bread. Honestly, I didn't know if I ordered it wrong or the employee rang it up wrong, so I was asking in a very polite tone. The first employee I pointed it out to told me that's how it was rang up, more or less telling me to just deal with it. Luckily a second employee quickly cut him off and said he'd fix it, no problem. 60 seconds later I had a new sandwich.

So it's not perfect... the staff needs a training but that is to be expected when a shop first opens. Will JJ replace Mom's or LeGrands or Macklind Ave Deli for my sandwich fix? No. But sometimes you want a sandwich and you don't want to wait, and that's where Jimmy John's comes in.
Very delicious fish tacos and Val's margarita (even tho it was awfully small for $11).  Would definitely frequent here more if I wasn't newly transplanted to the Northshore.

I will start this by saying I am not a beer drinker. This is a great brewery that did not have an overwhelming selection but I do feel it had a beer for everyone. I had the sour as well as a mint, vanilla and chocolate. While that combination sounds odd it was fantastic. I really did enjoy them. The prices are great. The facility is not large and can get busy when the brewery bus stops by. 

I love that you can bring your own food. 

I love dogs but I do wish that people kept them on leash while there. There were just several roaming around. 

I love all the art on the walls that is also available for purchase. 

There are many breweries popping up everywhere but I think the unusual flavor combinations is what makes this one unique.

Gary made our experience very pleasurable. He gave us lots of unknown information on the eclectic collection of European cars. The cars that were there, which can change often because they are all register cars that are driven by the owner, were well taken care of, maintained, and restored beautifully.

The wait wasn't terrible, but there was definitely a wait! Took us about 20 mins to get seated but it was uphill from there. 

Our waitress was quick and friendly. The Snickers milkshake is a must!!!! They serve you a frosted glass and the entire container which is atleast 2 full servings. I got partially full off of half of the milkshake before they served the food.

The Bacon Cheeseburger is a banger. The Smothered Crabmeat fries were good also, but a little salty. The Onion rings needed salt bad, they were the disappointment of the evening BUT the milkshake more then made up for it. 

This was my.first, but certainly not my last because the milkshake list is fairly extensive. I'd be surprised if you don't manage to find atleast one you like.

I've been to Stitch House quite a bit and held out before writing a review.  Beer is good.  Food is hit or miss.

The wings, chicken & hog sandwich, chicken parm and cuban were all pretty tasty. 
The summer bake (squash, zucchini, eggplant in marinara) was not.  
Brussel sprouts weren't cooked enough. Fried green tomato was cooked too much.
Terrific cake snd service. Their cakes are far and away better than those overpriced bakeries in Yardley. Doughnuts are awesome too.

Like Matthew M, I also just moved back to NOLA after a seven year hiatus, and I loved the bar.  It feels relaxed and sophisticated, yet still has a certain funkiness that makes it comfortable and endearing.  The selection is fantastic and the prices are very affordable.  

On the particular night I visited, I guess there were some issues with the service crew.  The owner was behind the bar and super stressed and made us wait for nearly 10 minutes for the second half of a glass of champagne (he emptied a bottle with the 1st half).  Then, he was talking to someone else while he finished the pour, but didn't tell us how much we owed him.  My friend became quite pissed, as she was in town visiting friends and didn't want to be staring at this stressed out bartender--she wanted to be with her peeps.  Understandable.  

I thought this would be a good opportunity to try out a theory.  I wanted to sort of shame this guy into good service since we'd be there for a few more rounds, so we left him an $8 tip for his crappy service for our 2 glasses of wine.  It totally worked.  However, this is not a tip to service industry-types who may read this.  He didn't get a tip at all the next round, so it came out even anyway.  Also, he knew the people at my table, as it turns out, but once he got things under control, he came around to wait on our table regularly.  So, I'm not sure if it was my smartass/jackass theory or him knowing people, but at least we had perfect service after that.  

This would be a fantastic date spot, by the way.

Two thumbs up for Yats, and kudos for being a non-bar-and-grill location on the ever-popular Mass Ave.

It's a great option if you want to be able to order, sit, and eat your meal in less than 15 minutes without it feeling like fast food. It's definitely a no-frills kinda place, but that adds to its semi hole-in-the-wall appeal. Order from the chalkboard menu, pay, and your food will be peeking out from the little window in less time than you can imagine. From a traditional restaurant standpoint, there aren't a ton of options (maybe 8-10?) but if you know that you're going specifically for Cajun/Creole, then it is plenty of options. You have the opportunity to try one or two of the menu items for ridiculously low prices. My half-and-half dinner with a drink came in under $10.

Food-wise, I opted for the chili cheese etouflee and the jampalaya. I'm a huge fan of spicy food (but not over the top), and the jambalaya hit the spot there. The spice on the etouflee was not quite as high, but it still had really developed flavors and I could see myself cuddling up in front of a fire with a bowl of that in the winter. The only downside is that I felt like the food was lukewarm. Granted, the AC was broken on the side of the restaurant I was in, so maybe I wouldn't have liked it if it were piping hot, but a touch warmer wouldn't have hurt anything.

On top of a great meal, the people were super friendly, even offering a gentleman who was waiting for a friend a free fountain drink. Also, I overheard that they are moving more north on Mass Ave (around July?) and that they will serve alcohol at their new location. Overall, not sure you can beat this grab-and-go cajun option on the convenient Mass Ave.

This is a great event for all people of age. Whether you are brand new to the Tampa area, just visiting, or a local looking for an exciting venture. The event organizers are super fun, energetic, and keep the party going on and off the party bus. You start the party by meeting at one of Tampa's top taverns to enjoy a drink and meet up with your fellow crawlers. From there, you are transported in style to the next bar location. The party keeps revolving and you enjoy a tour of some of Tampa's local social locations. The party bus experience is amazing. You laugh, you dance, enjoy drinks, and mingle with the many other people in the group. Prepare yourself for one of the best times of your life.

Had a 9:00-12:00 window.  No call.  At noon we called.  They couldn't tell us when they would be here.  We cancelled and called Steamy Concepts.  This company is consistently late and their techs don't seem to care.  Stanley Steemer is off our list forever.

This place. Oh my. Came here for our second anniversary and absolutely loved it. The service is impeccable. Christina is the best! Highly recommend the DIY cheese board - they have an espresso lavender variety that is to die for. Before trying all of the cheeses, someone came over and suggested how to taste them, which I loved. Sitting outside was such a romantic experience - even when it's chilly; they have heat lamps between all of the tables. 

We couldn't have asked for more.
This is my favorite sushi restaurant in the city.  Neat lighting and atmosphere.  The tuna is amazing!  Definitely a must for my next visit back to the city.

Three stars only because we just had nacho supreme and drinks. Nachos were big and good. Wife went specifically for a margarita. It was a blue one is all I know.  She got a good strong buzz so she was happy and feeling no pain. I had a 32 Oz modelo. Frosted mug and lime slice. We sat at the small bar and watched them make strong drinks. Staff seemed lil rough around the edges experience wise but we're super friendly. Will update when we try the dinner. What we seen on other tables looked good.

The Farmer's Daughter feels like a classic country inn albeit slightly too roomy and with a hint of new construction ambiance upon entry.  The food quality mirrors this disappointing experience.  

Charcuterie and cheese good but certainly not great.  Squash soup very disappointing.  Greek salad flatbread?  MEH.  

The elderly and middle management type clearly gobble this stuff up.  But if you're a food snoot keep driving and get into Philly for some real food at Osteria where the menu is surprisingly similar and worlds better in terms of value.  

Regretfully,

FS

This place is the best! I was unable to buy my wedding dress from them as I did not live in town at the time, but a few of my friends have gotten their wedding dresses here and I have bought 2 bridesmaids dresses from Swoon. 

They are always on point and super sweet, which I really appreciate. They are personal,'professional, patient and honest. The girls at Swoon happily helped me in a pinch with my wedding dress by sending me to one of their seamstresses. Who is also fantastic and a total sweet heart. 

Yes they are a little more money that others in town, but they are worth every penny!
Delecious food and beautiful view! Try going right before sunset for a fun dinner moment and try the seafood boil!
Love this place! My go to for sushi. BYO and super affordable. Great variety of sushi options too. Ask for Casey - he's my favorite.

The restaurant can not measure the size of the crab based on a consistent standard, as these two pieces showed above are all 'Jumbo' size crab while the size difference is so obvious. The upper one is from the old bay flavor dozen I ordered, which I believe is a normal jumbo size one, while the bottom one from the Cajun flavor dozen I believe is not (as shown in the photo, the difference is obvious).

My friend and I visited the restaurant together, and she ordered half a dozen medium size crab, and I order have a dozen jumbo size crab. The crab price based on the size (Jumbo $70 a dozen, large $60 a dozen, medium $50 a dozen). When the crabs arrived to our table, I noticed all of my 6 jumbo crabs are even smaller than my friend's medium crabs, so I asked my waitress to check with the kitchen whether she gave us the wrong size, but she denied immediately without checking with the kitchen and pointed me to the manager( a college age young girl). 

She came to our table after about 10mins, then started with the speech that they would never make any mistake with the size, the ones I got is for sure jumbo size ones. Then, I asked if that's the case why my friend's medium ones are all larger than my jumbo ones, she said occasionally jumbos are smaller than medium. WHAT? I responded that firstly I couldn't agree this is an occasional thing as all my 6 jumbo crabs are smaller than medium. Secondly, while I paid $20 more for the jumbo compared to the medium, I should rely on luck to get the crabs actually larger than medium ones? Don't they have a standard measurement for the size? SUDDENLY, the manager started to find excuse by saying maybe the kitchen gave my friend the Large size instead of Medium by mistake, so you feel your Jumbo crabs are smaller than the Large size. WHAT? While I complained that they served me the wrong smaller size, she said they would never made a mistake, but then she said my friend was given large size instead of medium by mistake? The only compensation she offered finally is to give me 20% for the crabs, ($70*0.8=$56) still more expensive than the medium ones $50 while I got the ones even smaller than medium and accused me as a unreasonable customer... I then ordered another 3 jumbo old bay crabs as I wanted to see this time what size they would actually give me, then I got the right size this time, as shown in the first photo, the upper larger one. Then I showed the obvious difference to the manager, she still insisted they are all jumbo size ones.... CAN'T Believe it! I have been a loyal customer to this restaurant for more than 5 years, really disappointed when I was treated like this. Ruined my whole night and the argument we had scared my friend's little baby causing him cried. Feel so sorry for the baby...

Jazmine is our new go to Chinese joint. Service is great. Henry was our server and was really attentive but not too much so. The food was fantastic and came out quickly and very hot. A bit on the pricey side for Chinese but you get what you pay for and I'm good with that. The restaurant is very clean and nicely decorated. We'll definitely be back next Chinese craving.

I'm a little torn about a rating to give Cucina Forte- some aspects of it are 5-star, and other aspects of it are 3-star, so I'll settle for a solid 4. On one hand, I love that the funky decor and lighting give the place an authentic feel. The service is very friendly as well. I've had the same waitress every time I've been here, and she does an excellent job of remembering repeat customers. She even gave my friend and I complimentary glasses of wine the last time I was here! Very sweet of her. Although the presentation isn't the prettiest, the gnocchi here is some of the best I've had in terms of melt-in-your-mouth texture. However, I think the prices are a bit steep for a neighborhood spot like Cucina Forte. The last time I was here, my friend and I split a salad, an appetizer, and 2 gnocchi entrees and ended up paying 40$ each! We searched the receipt for contributing factors to this surprisingly high price and discovered that the buffalo mozzarella appetizer we split was 15$. The quality of the cheese, olives, and sundried tomatoes on the plate didn't really live up to that price, unfortunately. Still, I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a BYOB dinner spot near the Italian Market, I'd just advise them to ask about the prices for the specials before ordering.

I was at Coop's back in May and I thought I reviewed it then, but it would seem that I did not. I asked some locals where to get the best jambalaya and the guys unanimously voted for Coop's. They also warned me not to go into the bathroom for some reason because it would scar me. That, of course, meant that I had to go to the bathroom and see what the deal is about. Short story is that there is nothing notable about the bathroom and the jambalaya was definitely the best we had in NOLA. Adding some extra protein in the form of well seasoned rabbit on top of their andouille sausage and shrimp made it that much better than any of the other restaurants that seem to really cater to the NOLA tourist. If and when I visit again, I'll be sure to try the other items on the menu, but I wouldn't regret ordering the jambalaya again.

Check this places out guys. The gents who cut are both great, the price is a steal in Center City, and their hours are AWESOME for a barber in the city! You'll get a great cut regardless of who's chair you're in. Bonus for us grad students, it's only $20 if you've got your Student ID handy.

Allow me to set the scene... A lovely day in charming Webster Groves, a town of genuine, interesting, good-hearted people, two girls in search of a relaxing place to write Thank You notes to family and friends, sip coffee drinks, and purchase gifts for upcoming graduation events.  We stumble upon PuddinHead Books in Old Orchard.  

Trying not to judge a book by its cover, we ignore the awkward silence, horrendous lighting, unpleasant welcome, and watery Chai lattes.  I browse one of the tables of memoirs as my sister orders our beverages.  We nestle into the cushy couch, attempting to make ourselves at home as we have done in bookstores in cities across the world, from Paris to San Francisco, so many times before.  

As we begin to write in our cards, within moments are approached by who I assume to be the owner, or perhaps an employee on a power trip.   "Could you NOT write on a book I am trying to sell?  I am going to need to sell that at full price one day."  As shocked as I was by the tone and demeanor, I quickly looked to see what sort of crime my sister had committed.  She was in fact writing on a book, but on top of at least 30 sheets of thick, card stock.  What would have been a reasonable request came off as one of the most rude and aggressive acts of "customer relations" I have ever witnessed.  There was not a hint of compassion or friendliness in her voice and she proceeded to stand scowling until the book was placed back on the coffee table, casually stacked in the messy heap where it was found.  My sister's apology did not matter in the least, as she stormed off, making the silence unbearable.  

ENTER AT YOUR OWN RISK.  

FYI: The tainted book is a "Not for Children Children's Book" entitled The Littlest Bitch.

Arrived at the "restaurant" and ordered chicken shawarma with a Greek salad, kibbeh, spanakopita, hummus and pita. $30. Two cooks behind the counter. Not a lot of English spoken here. Free peppermint tea in the corner. Hummus had NO garlic! Greek salad had no dressing. No Greek olives. Shawarma had dry chicken in a large pita with a tsp tzaziki sauce. Not enough sauce for all the dry chicken. The kibbeh were fried perfectly but very dry and not flavorful. Spanakopita was small but very good. About as good as any Greek restaurant. Nothing to write home about! Plastic forks and knives. Paper towels for napkins. Drinks weren't offered and there was a vending machine with bottled drinks at the back by the bathrooms. For the money, I guess it's ok, not great. Truly a middle Eastern street stand/cafe. Not really a restaurant. Not a Greek restaurant either. Probably won't stop by again.

I ordered pizza from here last week, because I had a coupon. The pizza was fine, but it took almost two hours to get here.
Because of that experience, pizza hut sent me a coupon for a free large pizza, to make up for it.
I just used the coupon, and was forced to order $10 worth of other food in order to get my free pizza.
Well, the other food was delivered. No pizza.
Called the restaurant, and they're making me a new one. It's been nearly two hours since the other food was delivered, and I"m STILL waiting for the pizza.
What will they do to fix this? Send me a coupon for another free pizza? 
No thanks.

I have been to this Deli three times. Twice I got a meatball sandwich, once it was the best meatball sandwich I ever had and the other time it was pretty good as well. I once got another sandwich and it was pretty good as well. 

Every time I go in the guys working behind the Deli counter go out of their way to be really nice to you and friendly to you as well. At first I thought it was just a coincidence, but after three times I do not believe so. 

The prices are a little high for a sandwich with no sides. If they kept their current price and threw in a large pickle and a potato salad it would be perfect. I know Deli meat is not as expensive as the prices would indicate. 

Top notch and I am glad I found this place. I will most likely go back one day towards the end of August.

They are so nice here! I needed my propane tank replaced and had just dealt with UHaul on Seminole Blvd which he was so rude to me!  Here at Ace Hardware they had just closed and opened their store back up for me to help me! I got my propane tank replaced super quick and was on my way! definelty will be back. Thank you so much!

So Goleta's restaurant selection was pretty average and repetitive...it's getting better and Jane in the Marketplace definitely adds that boost of selection here in Goleta. I really love Montecito Cafe but the fact that I live in Goleta I don't get to head out to Montecito as much as I like to. The fresh ingredients is a huge plus! Welcome to The Goodland Jane! :)
Practical family friendly furniture at reasonable prices.  They let you know which items are available for quick ship and which will take longer.

Food:  Memorable considering I also recently had dinner at Lincoln Ristorante in Lincoln Center- which was not memorable.

Ambience:  Sat outside after drinks at the Spotted Cat...awesome.  Inside looked tight but great feel.

Service:  Adequate.

First...I would like to give this place 4 stars....but the service was simply too slow..and the sushi, although good, was not exceptional. What would allow a 4 is the terrific location on the Truckee River in downtown. We asked for outdoor seating which was ideal for the warm fall evening. The all you can eat  is typically priced and comes with some great appetizer options and a simple dessert if you can still eat. Between the 4 of us we sampled about 12 sushi varieties....all rolls. Only two stood out: Mo Beta and the Kona Girl. The spice is negligible on their spicier versions...so ask for more heat if you want a kick.

The cut I got at eye candy annoys me to no end. It looked good at the time, after styling, so I didnt mention anything to my stylist, but every day since then I've noticed the long sideburns that I've gotten, only above my right ear, which is constantly slipping out from behind my right ear and just kind of sits there awkwardly. Sigh. I asked for bangs and I got side burns. Cool.

Purchased paint stripper, but I didn't need it, so I brought it back. Tossed the receipt, unfortunately, but I thought I could just get store credit, which I would've been satisfied with. When I came in, the guy (who, when I called to complain later, turned out to be the owner) said he couldn't take it back because it was used. Fact: I had never even opened it. He proceeded to open the canister, point to some of the liquid that had gummed around the rim, and say, "Look, you used it." Professing that I hadn't used it, he replied, "I can't take it. You might have poisoned it and then I'd be in trouble."
 
First, I'm offended that he insisted that the unopened canister was used. Second, I'm offended at his suggestion that I might have poisoned the paint stripper. And third, you're supposed to use paint stripper in a well-ventilated area because PAINT STRIPPER IS ALREADY POISON.

Not coming back here and warning people to turn away because of the way I was treated by the owner himself. Wanted to like the place because it seemed cozy and local, but this was just outrageous. This is my first review of anything on Yelp, so if it's not yet obvious, I joined only to write about how bad of a taste (perhaps I was poisoned!) San Andres Hardware left in my mouth.
Was told takeout burger would be ready in 10 mins. Not ready for 30 mins after ordering. Not even busy inside.
Absolutely amazing! I got the berry bowl and asked them to add Nutella and peanut butter. It was so good! Super fresh. Can't wait to go back! I only wish they were in st Pete.

Used to love We Dat. But it has since gone down especially in regards to customer service. Once had to put in an order in Uber Eats three times just for it to be delivered very late due to some event they were having at the restaurant. But if you can't do both at once, then you should have closed for the event. Second and last time at We Dat: put in an order online on the restaurant's website (ordered a 25 piece wing plate with fries with a bread pudding and plus tip = $40). Got to the place and they said the website was wrong and that was the price for 20 wings and not 25. How is that my fault? Fix your site! And to top it off, the order wasn't ready anyway about an hour later. Guy at the counter told us that "everybody has to wait." What do you call the hour we gave y'all? No apology ever uttered. So, ended up getting a refund for the plate. They lost a $40 order over 5 wings and awful time management and customer service. Was looking forward to the Gentilly store, but will no longer be patronizing the business. 

Fool me once, shame on you; fool me twice, shame on me.

The drive-through is so so so so slow the girl taking the order seems like she doesn't know what English is. No care in the world they don't care about their customers. We've been in this drive-through for the last 20 minutes and he has not moved. I wish I would've went to canes
Great friendly staff, lots of parking, amazing food and excellent dessert! what more can you ask?

Garden tour ( seeing inside a mansion) and Denise as our guide was excellent - lots of historical information and about 8 on our bus- ( so small group)
Very beautiful history of the gentle New Orleans and its history ( not the party side)
Recommend highly- 
A few years ago, we took a plantation tour with this company and excellent historical perspective from out guide.

Nothing much to say about this place.  It's your standard decent-enough-beer-trying-to-milk-you-on-food Philly bar.  Certainly not the worst but nowhere near the best.  Kind of like Devil's Den but not trying as hard.

I have nothing but praise for PAWS!  I went to the Olde City location last Monday;t he staff were friendly and very helpful.  My initial plan was to wait until the "Clear The Shelters" even this past Saturday, and had been told over the telephone that the sooner I got my application in, the better chance I had of having it approved before the event.  When I arrived, my application was reviewed and approved on the spot; I think it was because I had it already completed, plus copies of my other cats' medical records and proof of residence.

I didn't see any kittens that interested me there, so went online and looked at the ones being fostered.  I found four kittens that I liked, and after contacting the people who were fostering them, I chose an adorable 3-month-old gray tabby and white male kitten.  His foster parent and I talked on the phone and set up a meeting for Wednesday at the Grays Ferry location where she worked.  The paperwork was completed, and I brought my kitten home!  We'll be returning for

Some people feel that the detailed application is too personal, but PAWS only has the animals' welfare in mind, and wants to make sure that they will be going to loving homes for life.

This is my second time coming here and still not impressed. It was a Saturday night at about 7:30 and we had a short wait. Sat down at a high top table closets to the service door. Ordered 2 dozen charbroiled oysters. Typically these are served piping hot but these were room temp. I know because we weren't given any utensils! After we asked for silverware we were told that it would be 3 minutes since they were all being washed. Our oysters were our second appetizer btw. Our entrees were well-cooked. Happy hour 2-for-1 margaritas were a bit too sweet. Waitress was a bit absent minded. Don't think we will ever return. So many better restaurants.

So I am not known for trying something new, so when my friend invited me out to dinner and told me it was an Indian restaurant, I was skeptical. Since it was for her birthday, I agreed. And I am so glad I did!  Everything from the soup to the naan(bread) to the entree ( I had the Chicken Makhani, my husband had the Chicken Korma) was delicious!  I will definitely be going to Indeblue again!  Our host was Mara, and she made the dining experience exceptional. She was very helpful in explaining all of the dishes and made sure we were well taken care of.

Quick and clean nail salon. Found them online because they are one of the few nail salons that takes reservations online which is convenient. I normally go for the gel manicure and am always pleased. Today I also got the regular pedicure which comes with a hot stone massage which was much needed on this snowy April day. 

They also do waxes and massages although Ive never had one I know a lot of people come in to get them down.

Make an appointment online and you wont be disappointed!

I know, a chain! While in Key West last year couldn't get in the door, but mid day, mid week Nashville after the Fourth, no prob! 
Noisy, yes, Jimmy screaming from every TV, yes!
Our waitress, Anastasia suggested the "Fried Green Tomatoes" which 
were as she said "fabulous"!
I had the "Cuban", eh glorified ham sandwich but tasty and my bride had the "Cheese Burger in Paradise" and it was very good with their signature onion rings.
We had lots to take back to the Club Hotel to enjoy with their free "happy Hour" and Hors d'œuvre.

It is a tourist trap worth stopping at wherever you are, after all isn't there a little "Parrothead" in all of us?

Off to the Bourbon trail in Kentucky  mañana!

In my time in Nashville, no where have I felt more at ease in any restaurant than at TailGate Brewery. The vibe is incredibly casual, and pop cultural references adorn every feasible wall in mural marvels. You will be greated by Pulp Fiction caricatures holding Tailgate brews on one entry wall, while the other is festooned with the Marauder's Map from Harry Potter. When I tell you the mere walls are a feast for the eyes, you know this will be an excellent dining location. 

First off: there is ample parking at TailGate west. In addition to the generous lot in front of the restaurant, they also have a section marked out for overflow parking. If you're worried about crowding indoors for a seat, fear not: on warm, summer evenings, they have not one, not two, but three variations in outdoor seating options. There is a semi-enclosed section with screened windows to provide some shade, a "porch" area with canvas coverings, and open-air picnic tables. The restaurant looks out over a gorgeous hill, all lush and green. Bonus: you can take a picnic blanket and your pup to this location!

The beers are amazing, and they truly have something on tap for everyone. This is a brewery, after all. The bartenders are always willing to give a recommendation, and they are known for being extremely friendly. I've never had a pour I didn't like here, from hazy IPAs to sours to stouts. If you drink beer, you will find something you enjoy. I recently noticed they even have a prosecco cider available. Imaginative people out at TailGate inventing all the brews.

The food pairs perfectly with the choice beverages. You can get everything from my favorite spicy feta dip to some truly mouth-watering pizza options. They have specials pretty often, and weekly discounts as well. My favorite has to be the California Burrito Pizza special. It was a mix of, I kid you not, waffle fries and assorted rich sauces. Also, they never skimp on the cheese. 

This brewery is magic. Did I mention they have soft serve as well? They also just recently constructed an outdoor bar area, so if you are dining porch-side, you can stay al fresco as long as you like.

Nice, small area for dogs to roam and swim. It's hard for the owners though because there is hardly any shade and it gets hot in Sparks, NV. This is a perfect trip for a cloudy day or early in the morning or late evenings during the summer.

Bring your own toy because there won't be any left over and also there are bags provided. Owners are usually mindful of their dogs at this place but there is no separation for big or small dogs.

It's an easy place for a nice lazy afternoon of In-N-Out and then dog swimming at their enclosed dog beach area.

We dined at Annata for dinner. Our server was sooo nice and helpful. We got a cheese w prosciutto charcuterie. It had a wide array of items and was not only tasty but presented nicely.  I highly recommend getting this! 
We also got the salad with vinaigrette, corn, & tomatoes. It was okay but the dressing didn't have too much flavor. Our entrees were the pork shoulder (mine) and the pear and cheese pasta purses (hubbys). I tried both, and his was better. The pasta filling was a bit sweet for my taste but the cream sauce was lovely, as were the mushrooms. 
My pork shoulder  was a bit disappointing due to the "crisp" apple slaw being soggy and not having much of a flavor besides watered down horseradish. The softened apricots on the side seem a bit of an afterthought, maybe better incorporated somewhere else on the dish. The flavor of the meat was good and the broth it rested on was nice. 
All in all a nice place. The only thing that stinks is the tea place next door had quite a few guests that were smoking outside, which isn't the iciest when dining outside, but not the restaurants fault just a side note. 
A few tweaks to the food and this would be a solid 4 stars.
Good I liked it the Chang Chicken is good but it not General Tso but the Lo Main is very good.

Excellent pizza, but not open late night for when we leave the bar?

Boo!
Very good Korean food and a decently valued sushi bar.

I just moved to the area over the weekend, and my back was very sore. I had been a little hesitant to come here with the previous reviews. I am so glad I went anyway! I've been to a number of massage places over the years, including many with Groupon deals, etc. most of the massages were fine, but nothing to write home about. But my experience at Hand and Stone was amazing!

The check-in was a little crowded, so I didn't get to fill out a form before I went back. My massage therapist was Tom, and I can't say enough good things about him! He listened to what I said about my back and the soreness I had. Then, instead of just giving me a general massage, he really focused on those problem areas. His technique was SO GOOD. I don't know what he did, but it felt amazing as he was doing it, and afterwards, my back seriously felt brand new. He was extremely thorough and asked me several questions about where I wanted him to focus. He even took the time to do various stretches on my legs and lower back, and it must have worked! 

Seriously do yourself a favor and check them out. If you ask for Tom, you won't be disappointed. I am not a massage expert by any means, but in my opinion, it was the best massage I've ever had.

The ladies in the childrens department are my favorite!!!  They are kind, helpful; just all around super nice!!  The kiddos and parents who attend their events are lucky because they love what they do. 

Unfortunately it is not all rave reviews. Many of the front desk folks can be unhelpful and grumpy. Not sure why, but the front desk personality unfortunately is consistently bad. Not to mention many books and items I have returned in the outdoor bin don't get checked back in. It's very irritating and then you find a bill of them requiring you purchase a replacement when they are typically on the shelves.
Mhe...  Filling dinner.  Not to bad, good size portions.  I didn't make it to the desert.  The coffee was soso.  Convenient to the hotel...
Very disappointed. What was a great experience turned into a nightmare. From start to finish. Food was meh and the service just lacked. Really went downhill since I last ate here. Sad

I am from Dallas,  TX and I am used to paying $50 (before tip) for a simple pedicure.  In fact I had a pedi before I came to Florida for vacation.  Girls decided to have a little spa day and I figured since we could walk there we should give it a try.  I went in not expecting much and was more than surprised.  They spend a lot more time massaging than I am used to. And after walking on the sand for a couple of days the extra time spent on massaging was incredible. I got the upgraded package and my pedi was only $40 (before tip).

Ratatatatataaaaa!!!! BLAM! BLAM! BLAM!!!
Pap! Pap! Pap!  Ahhh...the sounds of gunfire in the morning, the afternoon, and the evenings at this amazing and state of the art indoor range will make you happy to be alive and demonstrating your 2nd Amendment tights in style.

This place has it all:

10 public lanes - 6 tactical private lanes - 4 Uber private lanes attached to their amazing party or group gathering room - they're acoustically sound (yes, you do still need ears on!) and their HVAC keeps the air so clean, you won't notice all the gunpow that's discharges in there!  Fully accredited range masters keep the safety and even help you learn the gun you're shooting if you forget something. Seasoned marksmen, first timers, certification classes, or if you just want to come with your friends or family and watch them behind the privacy and comfort of their lounge, there's something for everyone!

Now, let's talk retail space...  it's like a kid at Christmas (hint...hint, Santa) in there. They have all the guns, Amos, targets, eyes, ears, range bags, holsters, and anything else you could want here and the prices aren't bad. They're not online prices, but certainly not full retail either. And put it this way, no FFL fees and no shipping so it's worth just a little more plus you'll get service before, during, and after the sale. This is likely my go to for my guns. I do wish their FFL fees were cheaper; something to consider lowering?

Bring your friends, bring your bros, oh heck, bring everyone!

I brought my group for lunch. The food is good and the service was excellent. The fried chicken was a hit. The atmosphere is pleasant and very accommodating. It is also priced right. Great for large parties.

OH HOT DAMN! Okay, so we all know hot chicken is Nashville's unofficial mascot. This was our first stop on our trip. It was a chilly rainy day and the Uber dropped us off right in front as we eagerly waited for a famous hot chicken warm up.

There was a line, but I don't let those discourage me. It went by pretty quick and in we were! 

I ordered the hot chicken with the creamiest Mac n cheese. It's interesting because I'm so used to "buffalo style" where it's wet, but in Nash it's dry rubbed. 

All in all...I can take the heat
Love this place! Our first time here and will be back many, many times! We had the Skinny Nikki. What a combination of flavors! I'm telling  ya, stop by and sit for a spell, you won't regret it.

We actually prefer NYpie because it's much better pizza,  but occasionally we get a craving for Papa John's. Tonight we were on hold for over 20 minutes. Fortunately we live within a block so we just drove down. There was a line of traffic circling the building and lines of people inside. We finally just gave up. They don't answer the phone and are jammed to the gills at the store. We went to NY pie and and will keep going there until this location gets it together. I guess this must be a franchise location that is not under the watch of corporate. Shame

We hosted our rehearsal dinner here and Ben and the entire staff went above and beyond for us. Ben met with us to answer all of our questions and helped us pick out our menu. All the food tasted great and everyone enjoyed the atmosphere!

Greatest boba tea!

We started going here waaaay back when they first opened near our home at the Orange Gove/Lee Lee's location. I grew up spending ton of my life in California, specifically LA and the Bay Area, and Bing's teas are among the best. 

We got to know the owners and Bing was very particular of her teas (why a favorite of mine was never to her liking but I loved it). I always love supporting a good small business wait starts up and enjoyed the flavors as they arrived! 

We have since moved out of Tucson and have tried boba teas across the nation and I have tried them in China as well. Bings is a place my family and I miss the most as the owners are genuinely nice to us and the tea flavors are ones I find myself comparing all others to. Sometimes we joke that we'd only visit Tucson again to have a tea from Bings again!

My first time for shawarma. What a treat! I ordered the chicken shawarma sandwich, my wife had the chicken shawarma arabi, and my son had the mix shawarma & rice. I tasted my wife's french fries, they are like none you've ever had. So, I had to have an order of fries - when I went to pay, the owner/cook/server said no, just enjoy your meal.  Like the fries, the colesloe also has a unique and delicious flavor. Everything, right down to the chopped pickles was outstanding. Oh, and I can't forget the falafil mahshi - it dosen't get any better than this. I suggested to the very personable owner that he open a place in Kirkwood - he said he was there for a year but it didn't do well enough: very definitely Kirkwood's loss. One more thing: we had leftovers and they tasted as good as fresh - I've found that this usually only happens when the food is really fresh and well seasoned. We will be back!

The food was excellent - we had the five course tasting menu which is really more like eight courses. Really excellent speck to start off followed by a shared portion of their fried chicken (really delicious). The actual first course was a simple spring vegetable salad on a cashew cream base - lovely veggies cooked perfectly for the salad. That was followed by fingerling sweet potatoes lightly fried for an excellent crisp with a curried tomato sauce. The third course was a Mexican stew with lamb which fell a little flat for us - it didn't really go well with the rest of our meal and we felt the flavors didn't mix well together. The main course was a perfectly seared duck breast with celeriac. The "first dessert" was served on a big cube of ice - points for presentation - and was a light lemon sherbet with fennel. The dessert was beautifully made squash blossom beignets with a cream cheese "sauce". 

Service was excellent by almost all the staff. For some reason our waiter welcomed us, took our food order, and then never visited our table again. It was very strange. The other servers brought out the food, answered our questions, etc. A strange model that left us feeling both ignored by our waiter but also well taken care of by the staff.

What can you say about an American classic? Great food, average fast foods prices. You can't visit without having their famous A&W root beer float. 
I don't know if it's a regional thing but the bacon was great too! I had a bacon cheese burger combo.  
One thing that is a bit "alarming" is that as I'm writing this, they have a fire in the back of the kitchen lol so the entertained was great as well!
This place is pretty good. It is that time of year where bar trivia is best held outside. Food was good as always and not really any complaints. Good Times!

We had 6 people. There was a group of 4 behind us. We were playing a 2v2v2 scramble and we were moving at a normal pace. Belk staff came up to us and said we had to play 4 people per hole and 2 had to wait. We asked why and the reason was, and I quote, "slow play" and that the people behind us were having to wait on all 6 of us. I'm not going to argue with any employees but I will say that the common sense here is missing completely and that rule is 100% stupid and not thought through. Please tell me on how making 2 of us wait until the other 4 tee off and get out of driving range and then letting them tee off is fast than all of us teeing off at the same time and moving at the same pace. We are rather young and I think the ranger was looking for an excuse to do something because he was bored. Mind you that the four of us that were forced to tee off before the other two of us were also waiting on a group of 4 in front of us, so the people behind us had to wait even longer when they split us up. The rule is not thought out and the fact that we were threatened to be kicked off the course for playing with 6 FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER, is completely unreasonable and we will not be back. Very nice course, the customer service seems to be bored and looking for a reason to feel a sense of authority!
Just delicious! One of my favorite resturant of all time! Wonderfull food, in a historic/romantic setting.
Cody was our server tonight he is a very professional and very friendly it was super busy but he is the best give him a promotion or at least a raise he deserves it
Excellent choice for pizza. I have grown up eating this as a child. The buy one get one deal is nice on a weekend with kids.

Bought a painted, pre-hung patio door set. Built the frame and hung the door, but the doors did not fit (they bumped before closing, and one door was noticeably higher than the other in the frame. But, door frames flex, and anyone who has installed heavy patio door sets knows you cannot get a 1x door frame 100% square or stiff enough to truly verify fit without securing it to something (i.e the rough opening). So, we hoped it would all line up better once installed. So we installed the door (square, plumb, and level), but the issue persisted. So I took some pictures and made a claim on the website. As we waited on a response to the claim with a gaping hole in our home, we considered the possible outcomes. Based on the company's claim form, those options seemed to be 1) send the door back, 2) arrange a local pro to come fix it, 3) get a partial refund. Options 1 and 2 made no sense. I was installing the door (like all the other doors in my house) and we were not interested in waiting weeks on a return/replacement process.
