Of course, we would appreciate a partial refund, but regardless, there did not seem like there was any good reason to not proceed with the project. So, I trimmed the door, re-positioned and re-mortised the hinges, repainted the door, and finished the project. 

When they got back to us about the claim, they gave us two options: 1) ship the door back so they could determine if it was defective, or 2) send us a new top and bottom plate for the frame. Of course, those options were ridiculous. They knew from the pictures that the door was already installed. I told them that those options were unacceptable and requested a $325 refund (that is half of what we paid to have the door hung and painted). 

Then we got a call from Door N More to discuss the matter. Their representative basically said that 1) because we altered the door, they could not verify that it was defective, 2) anybody could claim that a door was defective and request a refund, and 3) that I probably did something wrong to make it not fit. While 1 and 2 are true, and 3 is certainly within the realm of possibility, I am not used to being treated like an inept scammer when I have a customer service issue. The called ended with the representative requesting that I request a smaller refund, and they would consider it. 

So, you may get a good product from this company. They seem to have a reasonable number of positive reviews. . If however, there is an issue with your order, don't expect them to care or go beyond the absolute minimum effort to make it right. Meanwhile, as you spend  your time and even more of your money to fix their mistakes, expect to be treated like a con artist for requesting some kind of restitution.

Love Tupelo Honey. Great shrimp n grits on a previous visit but today and typically it's the small mousse desserts and the great beer selection! Tony at the bar was super quick to serve and knowledgeable on his beers and dessert.

I have used takeout service from Bottega Michaelangelo twice in the past 6 months. The good I received was good. However, on both occasions an e tire meal that I ordered was left out of my pick-up. VERY frustrating.

I reserve my 1-star ratings for those special places that don't have a chance in hell of me coming back to. Last night was full of special douchebaggery and skanky-panache, so it's getting a review. 

After moving from another CWE bar to this one around midnight, my group of 20 walked into (wait for it... I'm pretty sure it hasn't been commented on before) a giant bro fest, full of assholes, drunken girls, and half-naked girls trying to make fake dance floors out of the walkways. The bartend-ress was a MAJOR bitch. People were sitting at the bar, so I was in the second row of people and could barely see past the person sitting in front of me. I ordered my drink, and she left for a few minutes to get it. In the meantime, a drunk friend was getting a little obnoxious so I turned around to talk to him. This lasted no more than 30 seconds. I turned back around to wait for my drink, and after a minute the bartendress chick saw me and made a snarky comment to the girl in front of me (who also happened to be a friend of mine), "OH, NOW she's ready for her drink," and literally zinged it so hard across the counter that it barely stopped before falling off the counter. WTF. I wasn't drunk at all and I know I hadn't been inattentive to her coming back. I understand that she was having an extremely busy and, most likely, stressful evening. But W.T.F. No tip for that bitch, see how much better your night's going to get from here.

Add to all this that the floor smelled like urine. 

I have yet to order food in here, so I cannot attest to this. However, I will never ever come back here on a weekend again, and never again if I can help it (it has been group decision to move here all 3 times I've been). The once I did come midweek, it wasn't bad, our drinks were refereshed quickly and our waiter was nice. Weekends again? EFF no.

Updating my 5-star review to reflect 2021... STILL AMAZING, STILL COVID SAFE, ALL PASTRIES ARE BACK. Kouignn Amann are incredible (weekend only), and the cinnamon roll and morning bun are amazing. I'm still here for the mushroom croissant, and I have just discovered that their BACON is the BEST! 

I'm still trying to figure out how to order that croissant bun sandwich that's featured on the Yelp... that thing is perfectly photo-worthy (as is literally everything here).

Looking forward to trying their bread loaves soon!
A local favorite!  The best burgers anywhere!  On the weekend be prepared for a long wait.  Burgers are served with baked potatoes.  Try the monsoon, it will start your night right :)

They make great drinks here, but this is honestly the slowest location in the world!  Great people, and I never have to add to my drink when I pick it up.  I'm not sure if it's a staffing issue or what but every time I go there it takes forever.  You often can't make online orders there, which is severely needed since there is no drive thru.

After reading reviews about Beifeld, I decided to give them a try. From the very beginning, Uday and staff we're extremely welcoming and helpful. My now fiance wanted to include one of her grandmother's diamonds in her engagement ring, Uday made the process seamless and made me feel comfortable the entire time. He created a completely custom ring, exactly as my fiance had envisioned. He then took it a step further by creating a wax ring for her to visually see. The diamond selection was incredible and he worked with our budget. The turn around time on the ring was a short 10 days. Beifield is a small family business with strong jewelry roots, I would highly recommend to any and everyone!

-Allison & Dave

So I have never bowled here, but I do come here for their absolutely amazing, out of this world, freaking delicious veggie hot wings.  They have a fairly extensive veggie/vegetarian menu and I will make trips specifically to eat their veggie wings.  A friend came to visit from Sweden and I took her here!  The space is fun to have a drink, some tots, and play some arcade games on a weekend when they have a DJ.  Fun place.

I ordered a to go order and it was delicious worth every single penny. The food was fresh, delicious, perfect size. One star off because I asked for extra hot sauce on the side and they didn't meet that. I will definitely go back to try other dishes.

Chicken taco meat was very salty and the beans on the kids meal were so spicy my daughter couldn't eat them.  The nachos were more like stacked tostadas.  They were also extremely salty and the cheese wasn't that great.  Disappointing. . .

I have been all over Nashville and had many amazing meals at amazing places.  Miel is officially my favorite, putting places like Silo and Husk on notice. Make sure to get a Cruller for dessert and the cocktails are top notch!
This my favorite Spanish restaurant, amazing in every aspect. Every time feels like a throwback in time . Food always tops just like service. Small or large party. FANTASTIC

Great fresh menu. Very easy to eat healthy. Wine is pricey at $10 per glass. Loved the brussel sprout salad with currants and hazelnuts in a citrus vinaigrette. My husband had the pork and I had the flat iron. Both were delicious. Our daughter had the pizelle - very spicy and no sauce. The broccoli fondata side was my favorite. We tried the signature potatoes but didn't think they had much flavor. Would go again. Shout out to our server Ronnie who made excellent recommendations.

Realistically I'd give Nest 3.5 stars if I could.  We ordered through Uber Eats so I can't comment on the restaurant itself.  Below is a description of our experience ordering from Nest Neighborhood Kitchen through Uber eats.

-Food quality: 4 stars for taste, healthiness, and portion size with relation to the price.  
-Timeliness of the order: quick, but wasn't hot.  Not blaming the Nest for that since it was delivered.
-Total cost: Mabry bowl ($12); egg sandwich ($9.50); crispy house potatoes ($3); French toast nuggets ($5).  Total with tax, tip, service fee, and delivery fee $40.86.
-Order accuracy: 2 stars.  This was the crux of our issues with the order.   My wife is pregnant and can't have certain thing so when ordering we specifically wrote what to exclude from the order, but unfortunately, they didn't pay attention and included it anyway.  This was frustrating because their food is normally on point and decent.  Hopefully this was a one time thing.  I will update this review after giving them one more shot.

Their wings are some of the best Nashville and the surrounding area have to offer. Many other establishments opt for extra jumbo wings and they don't know how to cook them properly leaving a fatty wing with silly putty skin. Jefferson's wings are the perfect size wing and they know how to cook the hell out of them! Their crinkle fries are a perfect pairing with any wing order and the ranch is some of the best you will taste. I have yet to have bad service or a warm beer in all my years frequenting this establishment. I have been on life long mission to find the perfect wing experience, and right now they are winning.

Too bad, This used to be a really good Shoprite, but it is sinking fast.  Why are their potatoes always old, as though they are last summers potatoes,  I had hamburger in my freezer from last January when it still sold good and tasty. Now the hamburger is this tasteless worst than Mcdonalds garbage. If you want steak, expect a thinly sliced less than tasty  variety and don't look for marbling.  Pork chops look for old previously frozen meat lacking flavor.  Could be a Covid 19 problem with finding source for good product, but, high price and poor quality are a problem especially since they are using Covid 19 as an excuse for not providing refunds for poor quality products, Puhleeessss.
Awesome vibe for pirate, beach, creole seafood experience ! Friendly & prompt service. Strong cocktails. Good quality food. Bands on the weekend make it more fun! Great spot to return!!

My second favorite mall in the area ( I like Chesterfield mall better because of the store selection and general layout) but this one has a good store selection also, it just depends on what you're shopping for. West Co also has the parking garage which is awesome in the summer (shade) but the parking really is a mess over christmas.Also the walkways inside the center of the mall are too narrow, I don't know what they were thinking when they redid the mall, the could have made those walkways a couple feet wider, especially if they are going to fill the center up with kiosks. Other than the walkways, i still love this mall.

Was looking for a nice clean place to sign my daughter up for gymnastics. Went to Danik for a trial class. First of all the older lady at the front is not friendly what so ever. But I can look past that. During my daughters class I saw something out of the corner of my eye and it was a mouse. YUCK!!  The other moms saw it to and we told the instructor and she acted as if it was a normal occurrence. Then we notice a mouse trap right by the door where the kids Go in and out. (One of the one where the trap snaps down, which is not safe with little kids around!) I'm glad it was just a trial class and I hadn't signed her up yet cause we will not be back that is so gross!

Our lender, Veterans United, put us in touch with a realtor that they have a positive relationship with and that was Michelle Foster. As first time home buyers, Michelle went above and beyond in helping us understand the ins and outs of buying a home. She took the time to explain the multiple documents, home owners association regulations and also the required inspections; HVAC, home appraisal, pest inspection, home inspection and final walk through. Not only did she call and schedule the required vendors for us, but also came to the inspections. Michelle was not only professional and personable but easy to work with and contact through email, text and calls.  She has a great sense of humor which is needed for an ordeal like this. 

With Michelle's help, we were able to find a home we adore and close on time. From the time our offer was accepted, to the date we received our keys was just 28 days! She also scheduled the Sierra Nevada Properties complementary moving truck for our in town relocation. 

While in the new home, the seller forgot to leave the mail box keys, gate code, garage code and garage remotes. Michelle contacted their agent for us to locate this information. She also gave us the contact information for our home warranty for any future repairs. 

Michelle also bought us a kind and considerate house warming gift! The gifts were exactly what we needed to make the house a home! It was so kind of her to do that for us, after all the work she put into making this transaction possible. 

If you need an agent that is amazing and knows how to properly assist her clients, contact Michelle Foster!
Friendly, attentive staff, and well priced. I love coming to Tina's. It's relaxing and affordable and best of all, if I'm at Tina's it means I'm in Santa Barbara!

Visited Flyte for the first time and the food was delicious.  Everything tasted fresh and service was good.  As others have mentioned, the portions are on the small side so everyone at our table was still hungry for dessert.  

I was disappointed that a restaurant as upscale as Flyte did not periodically check the status of the rest rooms.  The ladies room had no paper towels at all, and someone had placed a roll of toilet tissue at the sink for hand drying.  Of course, that left the stall without toilet tissue.  The room just needed a staff member to make a quick check of the facilities, but that was not happening.

I am very surprised that out of all these reviews, no one has raved about the clam strips... Well, I will. Flowing Tide has the BEST clam strips around!!! They are lightly fried to perfection with a slight hint of grittyness to prove they are real. Served with a ranch and an amazingly unique sweet cocktail sauce, these are a definate local favorite and one of the best kept secrets in Reno.

I came in with my sister on a hot Saturday afternoon...

When we arrived there was a line up all the way out the door so it must be good :) 

I decided on keylime because I love citrus flavors. My sister ordered the colorful one ( I can't remember the name).

It's a cozy ice cream shop which is cute but can be quite tight when there's so many ppl crammed in all at once. 

The ice cream was great! I love how cold and flavorful it was, you just can't go wrong with ice cream lol .

I will definitely come back whenever i'm in St. Albert.
Really pleasantly surprised.... While not a traditional Italian restaurant. Have a good menu. Very tasty food good atmosphere cheerful waiter. Definitely will go back.
The absolute coolest store I have ever been to. They have such an amazing assortment of interesting items and are always so helpful and friendly. Lots of awesome outdoor decor and indoor decor

Went one time... It wasn't bad but...when you have a line of cars CONSTANTLY coming through and can only staff so many people in one place, you should expect it to be rushed. Reading some of these comments...I feel people expect the entire staff to focus on their car alone for 30 minutes. If that was the case they wouldnt be in business. I've been thinking about getting a monthly package but I'd rather save the money and do it myself right down the street at the self car wash. I may take 2 hours washing, drying vacuuming and detailing, but I feel that's the service others and myself expect in a quick car wash type place like that, I mean the car wash itself is automated...the wax is a waterfall? That's not how wax is supposed to be applied to a car. Nothing against their business model, it works great for them, and those who go, just don't expect attention to detail when you have a line of cars waiting for the same attention behind you. My advice to those who are dissatisfied with the service, do it yourself.

Two visits so far:
First with my girlfriends. It was a Friday night, so there was a bit of a wait for a table, but not too bad. We split the calamari, which was delicious and we really enjoyed the sweet/spicy glaze as a nice change from breading and marinara sauce. The hummus plate was large, pretty and great for sharing. I enjoyed the ricotta pizza (though picky me would have preferred if they'd blanched and peeled the tomatoes first so slices could more easily be bitten into). Two others enjoyed the short rib pizza. The calamari and sangria were both missing items that were cited on the menu, so it was odd they hadn't mentioned they were short of ingredients. 

Tonight my husband and I went for some burgers. He got the Bridget's burger and I got the house-made veggie burger (well-spiced black bean burger) with pepper jack and barbecue sauce. Burgers were good, fries were crisp. 

So far service is still a bit off, but they're new and trying hard, so I'm sure they'll smooth that out. 

They've opened up the place from its Solaris set-up, added TVs for watching games, and are redoing the garden seating. 

Menu has a few sandwiches, a few pizzas, a few entrees, a few entree salads with choice of proteins, and several apps. Simple but nice. Great price point for a neighborhood restaurant. We'll be back.

Sneak peek: I hear they'll be starting Sunday brunch.

"Back by Popular Demand" as they say...(though I've never heard of it before in my life)...the "With Love Beer Garden" is probably the best way in the City to spend a Thursday after-work happy hour.  It's just a nice relaxing atmosphere, and the people there are totally chilled-out. The not-so-local "local" Victory Summer Ale has been going down smooth as chocolate milk, and I'll surely miss this delicious brew when it's out of season. (Hello Oktoberfest!)    I'll head back next Thursday to finish it off for the summer, but I'll definitely be looking forward to it again next year. Good times.

It's definitely more upscale than your standard "Chinese take-out." The presentation of the food and the atmosphere is equivalent of a 5-star place, but the food is still heavy, and makes you feel fat and bloated, none-the-less.

All the reasons I love Yelp, is they let you place yourself on the waiting list that is definitely a must if your goal is to dine here in the NOLA.  

Now I will say, even if you're on the wait-list you will still have to wait for your table but I think it's worth the wait.  Drink specials especially on the weekend are better than the competition.  Heavy on the pour and great on the goodness.  I went for the bachelorette party with a moderate size group and they had enough space to accommodate us.  A bunch of rowdy ladies got really quiet when the food came, so that says a lot about the food on the menu.

The only reason I couldn't give it a full 5 stars is due to the fact that the wait list is simply to make sure you and your party are present.  Be ready to wait another 10-20 minutes especially if you have a party greater than 4-5.

I have been a customer for years and I have to say when we think of coming to lunch or dinner we always think of Delgado's ... the food is ALWAYS delicious, drinks are to die for and the servers always so friendly!!! The POPPERS !!! Amazing!!!! Delicious!! The guacamole, the best I've ever had!! The Michuacano (spelling) is my absolute favorite!! 
Poppers, michuacano and Jalapeño cucumber margarita and I'm a happy person !!! The local spot ever!!!

Not as many bagel choices as some places, but what they have is good. I like that the sesame seed bagel had sesame seeds on both sides. Added some cinnamon raisin cream cheese.  They probably put too much on, resulting in a messy experience but it was delicious. I pre-ordered before they opened and it was waiting for me when the store opened. Great service.

It's Friday, and it's hot as balls. My central air stops working. I flee to the 'burbs in denial. Three days later (on Monday afternoon), I realize I should act like an adult and deal with the problem. I call R&R. They're cheerful and reassuring, and they tell me they'll be out between 8:00 and 10:00 AM the next day. Given the less-than-stellar luck I've had with contractors, I don't hold my breath. And then at 9:00 AM, Ramon shows up, unphazed by the howling furballs that launch at him as soon as I open the door. Within five minutes, he's diagnosed the problem (my fan motor is kaput). He tells me exactly how much it will take to fix it, then proceeds to get it working within an hour--and with considerably less noise than before. He checks my freon and explains the benefits and drawbacks of adjusting the level. He replaces my air filter. He cleans up and leaves with a smile and a check that is far less than I expected when the AC broke. I'm a cool cat again, and I'll be using R&R for duct cleaning, chimney cleaning and every other HVAC issue that arises from now on. Now excuse me while I go sprawl across the air vent in my underwear. Ahhhhh...

I've eaten here twice.  The first time was on a "getaway weekend" without going away -- where we booked a hotel in town and ate like pigs, Le Bec Fin, Osteria, etc.

Simply put, the meal we had at Le Bec Fin was far and away the best meal I've had anywhere.  I had no idea food could even taste like that.  The other restaurants we visited that weekend all paled in comparison -- even the highly touted Osteria really suffered.  The meal was so good, that my wife and I decided that the $400 we spent was actually a better value than the $125 we spent at Osteria.  It was that good.

The second time was on a weekday business dinner.  Not quite the same experience.  This was clearly the "B team" staff on a Tuesday night.  No George Perrier visiting tables and popping the champange with his sword.  No multiple visits from the dessert cart.  The meal was still good, but definitely within the realm of other restaurants.  I've had better meals than the second visit.

I'm keeping this at five stars, because the first meal was so transcendent that I cannot get it out of my mind.  Every aspect was just perfect, the amuse bouche and the soup and the salad and the steak and the risotto with shaved truffes and the sorbet and the petit fours and the dessert cart and the cheese cart.  Crazy, crazy good.  I'm former consultant who's eaten in NYC, San Fran, Dallas, Miami, Chicago, LA, India, Spain, and the average of my two visits is still better than any restaurant I've eaten at anywhere.

If you're going to go, go on Saturday night.

One of my favorite places!!! The drink happy hour is pretty decent but the FOOD HAPPY HOUR IS AMAZING!! Their specials are always incredible!! Literally anything you order is delicious and the staff is so so friendly! The manager knows me and my appetizer order by now (the ricotta )
Da best place on eeeeearth

Wonderfully strong and flavorful coffee. We happened upon this location after visiting the Liberty Bell as it's right across the street, located on the first floor of an office building. A cortado and a latte were ordered and they were quickly and perfectly delivered. Very friendly and efficient staff.

I've been visiting the Trolley House for YEARS but moved away from Boise and then back, and something must have changed while I was gone. The last 2 visits there have been awful. I took my family there on a Saturday morning, no wait and not many customers (tells you something). I ordered a cinnamon roll, hashbrowns, and biscuits and gravy. The waitress or maybe the owner (older lady) told me, "wow-that sure is a lot of carbs-are you sure you don't want to have something else?" UMMMMM EXCUSE ME!????? I don't need to be JUDGED about what I am ordering at your restaurant. I ordered my son an orange juice, and when he finished it, he asked for another. The waitress looked at me to make sure it was ok, and when I said yes, she asked me if I was sure? Did I want him to have that much sugar? Should she just put water in the cup? AT THIS POINT I was ready to walk out, but food was on it's way. Let me just say NEVER order the "CINNAMON ROLL". Mine came out as 2 STALE Pillsbury cinnamon rolls-no joke. They were absolutely disgusting and even though everyone at my table tried them, none of us could eat more than a bite. Noticing the amount of "cinnamon roll" left, the waitress asked if I wanted a box for them. When I said no thank you she asked if I was sure. I assured her I was sure, and she asked me YET AGAIN. She literally asked me 4 times if I wanted to take those home and not WASTE THEM!!!!!!!!!!!!! Why she didn't ask if there was something wrong with them so she could notify the kitchen staff beats me. After that she stood about 10 feet from our table and STARED ME DOWN the rest of the meal. The biscuits and gravy I ordered were absolutely disgusting and looked like a canned version you'd buy for fifty cents and the "sausage" was cold-so I didn't end up eating that either. My husband enjoyed his eggs Benedict. My son ended up throwing up later that afternoon...not sure if it was caused by the food, but I wouldn't be surprised. The table next to us had to send the creamer back because it was bad. It's such a shame because Trolley House used to be PACKED every weekend, and I LOVE the history and all of the pictures and such. We will NEVER EVER be back for fear of RUDE service, crappy food, and possible food poisoning. SAD!

Movers were very pleasant.  One of the guys was a temp and this was his first job with Clemmer.  He worked on taking apart and putting together my bed.  One of the slats broke.  One of the bolts holding the frame together in the corners was missing.   I found that out when I sat on the bed and the mattress fell through almost to the floor.  Several pieces of furniture were chipped.  A large chunk was broken off a cabinet and glued back on.  I won't be bothered filing a complaint.  The worst part was that my carpets are now filthy and there is a grease spot in one room.  The pads used for wrapping furniture were beyond disgusting.  They need to be cleaned at least once in a millenium.  My house is covered in dirt, leaves, grass, etc.   One of my lamps is broken.  This added to an already stressful situation.  Ugh.
We love this place!!!! Sommelier Rachel knows her stuff! Will be back just for her recommendations ;)

I just got delivery so, will make this a quick one.

The chirashi was good, nothing amazing, but well priced and tasty for 10pm delivery on a week night.  No shellfish, just nice plump pieces of your run of the mill raw fish.

We also got every type of dumpling they had.  My shumai didn't really stand out but the others were definitely edible.

If close by or too drunk to go out, this place is definitely worth your time and effort.

So today my technician, Melissa, rushed through my insertion process then when I was almost done with my donation she tells me she needs me to keep my eyes open. No technician has ever asked me to my eyes open in the two years I've been donating here. I am a high functioning Autistic person. My disability is social and all those strangers around me makes me nervous. So I listen to music on my headphones and keep my eyes closed unless interacting with a member of staff. I thought reasonable accommodations were required to be available for disabled persons but I guess I was wrong. The only reason I could think of that one would not be allowed to close ones eyes is because one would appear sleeping, and that is reasonable. It is very dangerous to donate while sleeping as it risks air bubbles which cause embolisms. What's not reasonable is thinking someone lip syncing, pumping their fist for the plasmapheresis machine, and kicking their feet could possibly be considered asleep regardless of whether or not their eyes were closed? I don't want to come back, but it's my only source of income during this pandemic as I was not in essential employee when the order to shelter in place went across the country

Just went through the eegees drive thru and had the single worst customer service ever.  We had 7 hungry people in the car ready to eat.  We placed our order with what sounded like 2 different people.  They repeated it back correctly at the window.  As I got ready to pay I had the nerve to ask for an extra cookie.  Avery gave me a look of disgust that I added something else.  She charged me then handed me our drinks then forgot the cup of water I had asked for when I ordered.  I reminded her and she looks at me and grunts in exasperation!!  The people in the back seat of my car asked "was that toward you?" Because it was that loud!  She's getting my water and I ask her "is it a problem to ask for a cup of water?"  Avery responds "yes when you keep asking for stuff in the drivethru at rush hour!"  She goes on to tell me that it's a problem because she's doing everything alone WHAT???  This is a restaurant - I'm supposed to ask for stuff.  I ask to speak to a manager because this girl is arguing with me.  Zoraya comes to the window and is apologetic.  There are 4 cars behind me so I quickly explain how awful it is for me to ask for water and a cookie- oh the horror.  She tells me the fries are behind so we pull up to wait.  A gentleman comes out with the wrong order but he's nice and says he'll be back.  We finally get our order and make sure it's all there.  Then Maria comes out and again apologizes for her coworker.  3 out of 4 people were very nice but the one with the attitude makes this restaurant a must miss.  Or if you do go, don't ask for anything extra at the window that is apparently unacceptable.

You just can't get any better.   Amazing food, knowledgeable staff (for beer especially), and a fantastic beer menu.   Good for families, couples, the boys, or a quick bite to eat solo watching the game.    Fantastic place.

My favorite place to stay in Santa Barbara. 

1. Super convenient location
2. Immaculately clean 
3. Bed & pillows are comfy
4. Everyone that works here is super sweet
5. Love the sun deck! 

Still haven't managed to use the bikes, but I always tell myself I'm going to, haha. Next time!

Love this spot.

Our breakfast was good but the service was not.  We started out with one server who then introduced us to our new server.  We were ignored for about 15 min and then our server took our order. It took 45 minutes for 3 omelets to be served and one came with mushrooms when we clearly stated no mushrooms.  Sorry, we won't be back.

I called the naked monkey a day in advance to see if they could squeeze me in for a quick wax. They said they had a 15 minute slot open but they would be willing to remove as much hair as possible in that timeframe. So I showed up, and the lady was able to get almost all my hair - more than she said was possible on the phone when I called the day before. Sweeeet. They were quick, professional, and not painful at all. The facilities were very clean and cozy too.

I will definitely be back. The food was really good - flavorful, good texture... There was a nice, full menu. And the staff was very friendly (though a bit hard to understand - a pretty thick accent, which makes me like this place even more!). 
I didn't give 5 stars because I didn't leave thinking "I must tell all my friends about this", but it's a great option for Greek food in Nashville!

It was nice for a hotel restaurant.  Food was decent - tried the crab cake benedict for breakfast and it was tasty.  

Overall, nice experience but just kinda eh.
Everything was so delicious. The meat was seasoned well and the sides were so yummy. Staff was friendly and efficient. I cant wait to go back.
I'm from The Bay Area and then moved to Sparks NV then on to Boise ID and here at Big Al's on a Sunday and I have had the best wings that I have ever had.

Outstanding!
Great experience. Fast service. Super nice & polite crew.
Highly recommended!

I placed an order this morning on the mobile app almost 20 minutes before I arrived to pick up. Upon arrival my drink still wasn't ready. The barista began to make it then stopped half way to help someone who was placing a large order and I did not have another 10 minutes to wait as I was on my way to work. I walked out with no drink and no refund :( this has happened to me multiple times at this location. I order way ahead of time and it's never ready unfortunately this morning I didn't have time to wait.

At 9am blaring loud music too hard to focus. My new card wouldn't work on the pump outside. Being on an important phone call and blaring loud music then the card reader not working really upsets me. I went inside and just mentioned about the card reader didn't care to get angry or anything even though I was. The cashier proceeded to have an attitude saying there was NOTHING wrong with the card reader yet I had plenty in my account and it worked on the first try inside. I felt that was rude. With all the chaos of how loud it was I made the mistake of putting the money on the wrong pump..Went back got it transferred and she never transferred my rewards to the other pump so I didn't even get to use it. I went to this one because it's generally cheaper than coolsprings,  next time I will go pay extra in coolsprings to be treated better.

This is the dealership of choice to take "care" of your needs. Be it service, sales, parts, merchandise, management...everyone in every department steps up to help you like your part of the family. I had not been riding for over 2 years since my not-at-fault accident due to multiple surgeries and doing physical therapy. My bike had been repaired in just a couple weeks after my accident at this dealership since there was no frame damage. I had just started riding again this past June. Then on Sept 19 coming home from my ride I had a mishap with my front suspension on the forks. I went into the parts dept and saw Sam. When Sam heard what had happened to me he said he'd be right back. Well he comes back with the service manager Don who was so concerned by my ordeal that he said I would not have to pay for anything. He would even send his guy to pick up my bike so they could do the repair and go over & check every part and bolt that was replaced. When I saw George the Gen/Mgr I told him what an awesome crew he had. Then Don  hooked me up with his service rep Mark who really went over the details with me. I was so pleased with the way I was treated that I told Don I was interested in the LED park/ signal lamps on display.  He said if I wanted them he'd take care me & give me a great deal which he did. So when Mark called me the next day I said I would like to have the LED lamps too. This is the way this dealership operates. They go above and beyond to exceed all your expectations! Thanks again to Don, Mark, Sam, Big George and all the crew at Harley Davidson NPR and especially my girls in general merchandise Carol, Jackie and Melissa. I`m back on the road again..."Let's Ride"!!

There are many other places in Tucson that I like better than Nimbus, but my family comes here once in a while because it's a convenient location for everyone to meet. I'm not a big fan of the TVs all over the place, the monkey art, or fried food menu items, but I like the pizza and beers. Also, they're good with kids, and mine like to play with the pizza dough, then send it off the be cooked and dusted with sugar and cinnamon.

I was skeptical at first when I saw that there were several other locations around the city, as often times that means a place that was once great has overextended and lost quality. However, this was very clearly not the case with Ruby Slipper Cafe! 

After waiting about 20 minutes outside for a table for 2 (they take your cellphone number and call you when your table is ready which is very convenient) we were seated at a communal hightop table near the bar. The service took a little while to get going, but eventually we put in our drink orders - one Mimosa and one 19th Hole (a spiked Arnold Palmer). The drinks were great, so great that we may have enjoyed another round or two before our meal came to and end :)

We had a hard time deciding what to order because a lot of the options looked great! We eventually used Yelp as our guide and went with the Banana Fosters French Toast and the Eggs Cochon. The French Toast was just as delicious as described by follow Yelpers. You could taste the eggs and sugar all melted together and it was heavenly!

All in all it was a tasty experience and I would recommend it :)

Nice little place. Family owned traditional Mexican. I go for the torta. It's a Mexican sandwich on a soft bread. It's meat with lettuce, tomato and avocado. Creamy, meaty, delicious! Good value for the money. Nice people too.

This was our very first stop in New Orleans, as it was recommended to us by our cab driver. The oysters on the half shell were the cleanest and most delicious oysters me and my future husband ate the entire trip, bar none. And the fried pickles were AMAZING the batter was light and fluffy and we devoured them. The same batter was used for the friend shrimp and crab and we just couldn't get enough. Also, the hush puppies were soft and deliciously flavored also the best I had in New Orleans. Our server was attentive and friendly. I would (and already have to some friends) recommend Felix's for a reasonably priced delicious seafood lunch or dinner

Place is a solid choice for a burger. They aren't too too fancy, but have a good variety of options to please just about everyone. Some of them are creative. The basic 5-Star burger is classic and can't go wrong, in my opinion.

The sides are great too, but some are small in size so keep that in mind! Two splitting an order of cheese curds was fine.

I'll keep this place in mind since it's closer to me - won't have to truck to Range for a decent specialty burger anymore.

I was VERY unpleasantly surprised today by this business.  I, like so many other reviewers below me, bought the Groupon for an oil change and tire rotation because I lived close by and it was a fantastic deal.  I love supporting local businesses as well, and probably would have continued going to this shop if I had had a good experience as I just moved back to town and my old shop recently closed for business.  That was not the case.  I work during their business hours, so I sent my boyfriend over at our appointment time to redeem the deal with a paper copy of our voucher - completely within the rules and regulations laid out on the deal site.  In fact, it SPECIFICALLY states that you can EITHER use the mobile app or the paper copy.  It wasn't feasible for my boyfriend to take my phone with him to redeem the offer or for me to give him my login info, since we typically don't share passwords, and we figured the paper copy was good enough.  

When my boyfriend arrived, he was told that he could not use the deal because he did not have the mobile app installed or the login information.  He was completely turned away.  He then called me, and I called the business to see what was going on.  I tried to explain to the owner of the business that I was upset and confused by their policy, since nowhere on the deal is this policy mentioned, and was told in a very angry, condescending tone not to "tell him how to run his business".  I was also told that "there are plenty of other tire shops I can go to".  I also attempted to explain our predicament - that we had purchased the groupon with my account but I was not able to be present to redeem it - and I was told that there was no way to resolve it.

At this point I was seething, and decided to call Groupon.  They were very troubled by this man's behavior and gave me a refund for my purchase, since he refused to provide the service I had paid for.

I think we will go ahead and take the business owner up on his offer to go to one of the other shops in the area,  Maybe they'll be reasonable adults.

Authentic Filipina writhing here: The bicol was decent. Has a kick to it. If you like spicy you'll like. The pork on the stick was cold they didn't heat it up. The people were nice and friendly. It's a small place off ulmerton near US19. The pancit wasn't good. They didn't season it very well. Tasted kind of old like it's been sitting and pancit is good when it's fresh. The rice was okay. Lumpia was okay. My mother said it was plain. She didn't like the food. The fish was also okay. The environment has a potent smell. My hair stunk afterwards. Maybe they just need a new cook. The owners are from pampanga. I was hoping to taste some good local Filipino food but was disappointed. I was just in the Philippines 1 month prior to visiting this place and wanted a taste of home but didn't get it . I hope they do better though. I wish them well. But I won't be back  I'll drive to Orlando Nipa Hut for some REAL, good, authentic Filipino cuisine.

The food here was decent at best. I was here during essence festival and it was a hella long wait. I waited though because I have heard soooooo many good things about the restaurant. After waiting a little over an hour to get in and over 1.5 hours for food, it finally made it and honestly was not enjoyable. I didn't think the food was that great for the price. The Mac and cheese was not good and I'm a big fan of Mac and cheese. The seafood was fair but not fair enough for their prices. I may give it another try next time I'm in NOLA but I doubt it.

Good service and ambiance for sure. I am not the biggest fan of Cajun and Creole food. But I loved the smokiness that was in all of Trenasse's dishes. Very flavorful and filling. I wish that they had a few more vegetarian dishes on their menu.

Seriously good food. Had the Kobe meatloaf and it was delicious my Husband thoroughly enjoyed his prime rib French dip sandwhich as well. Only down side was we never once we offered more drinks which we love our drinks so it was disappointing, but for a rainy Tuesday the two waitresses working seemed a little overwhelmed.

Took a group of customers here on the recommendation of a colleague.  There were 9 of us and we were well taken care of.  They have a good menu with plenty of options for both lunch and dinner as well as a comprehensive selection of appetizers.  Everyone was very happy with their food and I can say that my steak was prepared perfectly.  If I find myself in the area again I will be sure to eat here again.

Nice addition to neighborhood and community. We are a coffe-centric city but it is nice to get some education into the world of teas and their medicinal values. They do serve coffee for those who need their fix. :)

Most amazing salon I have found since moving to Tucson!!! The salon is so clean and well kept. The employees are kind and not fake. JEN IS AMAZING!!!!!! She did an incredible job at listening to me and doing exactly what I asked - thank you Jen!!!! I will be back - with the rest of my family!!!!!!!!

Very expensive. Lots of things to see but really confusing map and instructions on how to get to certain areas. Shark tunnel, main tank with turtles sharks and sting rays, penguin area were cool. Hippos were okay, shark bridge was ok also. Admission for adults $30 per person, ridiculous. 

Went there on a Saturday around noon. Parking lots were full. We were directed to park in a parking garage near the aquarium and pay 10$ cash before entering the garage. Mkay, what if I didn't have cash..?

Well well well...what can I say about a restaurant I was so excited to see in Santa Barbara but...was very disappointed with my dining experience.  I'm really shaking my head because I had high hopes for this place.  I've dined at restaurants like this in Los Angeles and they really put this one to shame.  This place is way overpriced and you don't get your money's worth in quantity or quality.

I dined there with my friends.  We had shrimp, beef, pork, a soup.  The shrimp was split down the middle and I'm not talking about butterflied shrimp.  I mean one shrimp was cut in half to make two pieces.  I have NEVER seen a restaurant skimp to such a degree.  I was appalled!  It was hard to tell the difference between the beef and the pork and the marinades on the meat seemed to disappear shortly after putting them on the grill like the meat was dipped once, no marinating and brought right to the table.

The soup was good and the pork was actually very tender.  That was the best thing about the whole evening.  I had a Sprite which also tasted a little weird so I didn't drink much of it.  I did like the curvy shape of my tumbler.  :)

The restaurant is a little small but you don't feel like you're sitting on top of other patrons.  The parking lot is in the back but there aren't a lot of spaces.  Will I go back to this restaurant again?  Uh...absolutely not.  I'll stick to driving down to LA for really good "cook your own BBQ" experience.

P.S. I hate the name.  Does everything have to be little "i" something? iCant!

Was hoping the reviews were wrong but they are 100% correct put a $2000 hold on my credit card when I picked up the rental car no one at the counter for 20 minutes person was at the bathroom when I went to return my car the Porter said just leave it and will check it in I said no I want proof that I returned the car with no issues had to wait 20 minutes for somebody to come to check in the car car had bald tires dangerous in Florida with all the rain. Tampa airport and NTSB take notice this company should not be allowed to operate. See picture attached with balled  tires and empty counter

While enjoyhing a ladies weekend away---we decided that this would be a great place to go---i mean if it is good enough for OPRAH.....we had to go....It was old school all the waiters where johnny on the spot and impeccable......it was certainly a dinning experience and I am glad I went----i of course go the pasta named after Ms. Winfrey and my friends both got other choices we sampled and gave two thumbs up to the flavor of everything.  They are an expensive place but you are paying for the experience---white linen table clothes----tableside preperation of your sauce/pasta----we were very aware of all the staff just waiting to see if we had any needs---If i took a sip of water it was flled up again right away...so a little over the top but a fun experience.  worth going once for sure....

Jordan gave great service!  Hamburgers have some unusual spices in them, but very flavorful. Big ole honking steak fries were very tasty! It's a Pepsi product place was its only downfall for me. Whatda ya gonna do? It's the age old controversy. I think restaurants need to have both. Pepsi and Coke need to work out a way to share!

Had a nice lunch yesterday. Tried the adult grilled cheese with apples and bacon. It was good; think it would be better if apples were frilled or sautéed first. They make the sandwich cold quickly. Huge portion of tater tots. The ice tea and lemonade were good and the waitress was great, but She didn't share her name. 

There's a special parking lot in the back just for Llewellyn's. I've always parked on Main St! Didn't know it was there. Just walked right in through the patio.

Don't waste your money. Worst BBQ place in Tucson. Had to dump BBQ sauce if you even want to call it that on my beef brisket just to eat. It was so dry and chewy. On a good note their beef brisket may pass for a ok jerky. They also have bad customer service and they just sit around.

I've been seeing both Kaitlyn and Jillian for almost two years now at the KOP location, and they are both wonderful. Kaitlyn is very skilled & knowledgeable in her area of expertise and Jillian is extremely caring of her clients and always looking to help. Dee, the receptionist, is the sweetest person and is always radiating positivity.

Only "con" is that there's been a few occasions where I've had to wait a while in the waiting room/exam room as they were running behind. Certain treatments are also a little pricey, but that's just part of the aesthetics game these days.

This is a casual, but kickass place to get good food @ a decent price.  Everytime I go to Nashville, I come here for the fried avocado (Everyone seems to be in agreement for how great these are!), and my friends fill up on PBR. I can't vouch for drink prices, as I'm almost always  just an innocent bystander. Alleycat is nice for their veggie options, although there are quite a few meaty meals on the menu. 

There's a nice outdoor patio area, which we always sit @, which might be more kid friendly/amenable than the inside area. The patio is complete w/ strung-up christmas lights and wrought-iron(?) chairs, which actually aren't too, too unbearable to sit in.

Amazing!!! I'm not vegan and this donut did not feel like it was lacking ANYTHING. Got the pumpkin and pecan donut and it was amazing. Perfect texture, perfect level of sweetness, and a great price. 10/10

Gone there many times and always enjoyed the food... something changed...food is horrible, low grade crap.  What changed?  New management?  Will never go back.
Sad

Not one to complain often but I had the worst experience here this afternoon for lunch. I have been a number of time and had fairly good service, but great food. Service was very poor and felt as if I was just another number today but food was still good. Just very disappointing that it felt as if i was being pushed in the entrance and out the exit.

I went to Louie's for brunch after a great recommendation from a friend. My experience was ok at best.  Communication between the staff seemed to be troubled, as we were initially left unattended after a failed pass off of our table from one waitress to the next. Service was quite slow even though the restaurant was nowhere near full while we dined.

My chief concern with any brunch is the quality of the mimosas. They have a nearly bottomless option, which is a set price for a full carafe and a dollar extra for subsequent fills. I understand that typically that is one carafe of champagne and one carafe of juice, but during my visit they were running out of carafes to give and therefore served them mixed. Also notable is that the "hibiscus mimosa" on the menu is only cranberry juice and champagne. 

I ordered the shrimp and grits. They come topped with scrambled eggs, a detail that is omitted from the menu. The portion was smaller than I expected and in my opinion not worth the $15, especially with only 3 shrimp. Flavor-wise, I have no complaints. The grits were creamy and the green sauce topping the dish was pretty good. I also enjoyed bites of my friend's breakfast potatoes.

This was my first visit back in a couple years and it was pretty much the same. Fine service, fine food, fine experience. The decor is outstanding, love the patio. It is a comfortable atmosphere and feels very welcoming. Probably what I enjoyed the most of the experience was the patio :)

The night started off slowly, our server was prompt in greeting us, but took time in getting us our drink order. She didn't tell us her name which I thought was different. I ordered the Oktoberfest and was pleasantly surprised. Really enjoyed it, great flavor not overly heavy.

I ordered the fish and chips and a Caesar salad. They were all pretty good. Nothing to scream about but not terrible. (I wish I would've ordered the wings... delicious!) the fish was pretty flimsy and the batter wasn't my favorite, but again, definitely not the worst. 

There seemed to be a good flow going on with the staff, which always helps with having a good experience, not people running all over the place.

All in all, this was a fine experience and I'll be back!

Great take-out spot. I had the Fried Veggie Pinton and it was delicious. At first I wasn't sure if it was going to fill me up but half-way through I was stuffed. Definitely ask for the sauces because they are FANTASTIC. 

Staff was also friendly and you can't beat the prices.

Visited the brick and mortar store on opening day and was absolutely thrilled. I got the goat cheese galette (DIVINE), poppy seed cranberry, maple pecan, and sugar creme, and they were all fantastic. Can't wait to go back and try every flavor.

I have been using CarSmart for over 5 years now. It is a great auto shop for any of your needs. I have only ever had one issue, and the owner stepped in quickly to make it right. I work with Patrick, who is amazing. He even helped me by giving his opinions on my most recent car search. All the guys are great though, and they even provide free loaner cars or a shuttle. Check them out! You won't regret it.

Love the fajitas! They give you more then enough for a great price.  I always judge a Mexican restaurant on their fajitas and margaritas.  This place knows what they are doing!  I have been here more times than I can count.  The place is huge too a lot of different dining room areas and a bar area.  The atmosphere is colorful and full of artwork from the tables to the walls.  Great place highly recommend!

Had to update my review just to mention the Whiskey Black Pepper wings! They are really good and you should definitely try them if you like wings or if you're just looking for a good appetizer to try.

Jazzy Doris was packing up when I passed her table in the City Market this afternoon, and when I said I wanted to buy a slice of pie, she gave me a BOGO deal (Woo hoo!).  She had three lavors left--pecan, blueberry sour cream, and blackberry--and I bought a blackberry and blueberry sour cream.  Oh YUM!  Both the filling and the crust are tasty (well how can't it be when lard is one of the ingredients), and the portion is an appropriate size for the price of $3/slice.  Best of all, there's love and lard in every bite!  Doris said she is at the City Market on Wednesdays and Saturdays, and you can always call and order a whole pie.  I might have to take you up on your offer, Doris!  I'll be looking for Jazzy Doris the next time I'm in the City Market!

I probably only make it bowling once or twice a year, if that, so my experience at bowling alleys is limited and my expectations are never high. That being said, Western Bowl seemed significantly better than any place I had been to in the past and gets 5 stars from me for being clean, friendly, and very accommodating. It's a little out of the way when coming from downtown, and in a part of town I don't see myself frequenting, but I think this is where I will make sure to go from now on if I am ever looking for a place to bowl.

Really, the thing that made it over the top was the lady who was working the cash register when we got there. I guess I have a little bit of a stereotype of bowling alley employees based on my previous experience, but this lady was extremely nice and accommodating, and handled our slightly unorganized group and request to make numerous transactions for the same group with a smile on her face. She even had someone bring us paper plates and plastic ware to our lane so that we could eat the birthday cake that they also let us bring in.

It looked like a typical large bowling alley, but it was clean and any traces of the days when bowling alleys were so full of smoke you couldn't see the other end have been eliminated and there was no residual smoke smell in the air. Everything looked to be well maintained and working exactly like it should. They had half of lanes lit up like normal, and half set up for cosmic bowling, with black lights, neon decoration, and colored lights. It was pretty empty at 9:00 on a Friday night, which was not expected but it was nice. They got us 2 lanes right next to each other so our group didn't have to split up. They also left unused lanes in between the occupied ones when new groups showed up so you had more space until they absolutely needed it, which was considerate of them. They will take reservations, but I think they require a small deposit in order to hold lanes for you. There were plenty of lanes available on Friday night when we got there, but it's always better to be safe than sorry. 

I don't remember exactly, but I think we paid about $14 a person for shoe rental, the cosmic bowling option, and 2 hours of unlimited bowling. That was as much bowling as I ever hope to do at 1 time, and seemed like a good deal. They had one of their 2 bars open, and on par with other bowling places, it's a cheap place to drink relative to any restaurant bar. Their 32 oz draft craft beers are the same price as a pint anywhere else, and they even come in a plastic souvenir cup so you'll never forget the experience. They also have a full bar so they can make mixed drinks. The computers were easy to figure out and get all the names put into, and they have graphics that pop up showing you where to try to throw the ball and little animations that are fun to watch. The unused screens are playing the music videos from the 90s hits that they had playing all night. 

Overall, this place exceeded my expectations for a bowling alley, and I feel confident recommending it to anybody looking for a place to go bowling.
Love it here it's a meeting spot for when I come down to see my florida friends xo I love the fresh salads and pasta dishes but I love the chocolate muffins yum !!!!

I was torn on this review because I actually did enjoy my experience and the food quite a bit, but it was not the absolute best Thai food I have tasted. That being said it was easily 4.5 stars as it was some of the best Thai food I have tasted. The service was great and the spice level was exactly what I would expect. I can tell that it is going to be hotter than alot of places, but 2-3 stars of heat is absolutely fine for most people. Needless to say I will return and try another dish as that may push it to 5 stars for me, but I just hate giving a place 5 unless I am truly blown away. If you want some quality Thai food in a great environment with great service this should be on your list, even if you have to drive a little bit to get here.
The coffee is out of this world! I had the toast and lox Benedict. Only outdoor seating- but its in a cute quite area

We had an amazing experience at Sambuca! We loved the goat cheese artichoke appetizer! My friend and I split the scallops and and an order of the havarti dill tots- both were delicious. Shout out to Emerson our waiter!! He made our night so much fun! Rachel Rodriguez has an amazingly beautiful soulful voice and we were lucky to hear her perform. She was great about taking requests from the audience and provided a lively atmosphere to the night. From the P-Pod Posse thanks for an amazing evening!!

I've been to other Rock Bottoms. This one has some issues. They forgot to put the side in a simple carry-out order. When we went in person a couple days later, it was about half full.  There were 4 employees hanging around the hostess stand, I could not tell what they were doing. The main hostess tells us an empty table near the front won't be clean for 10 minutes. Our party, and the 4 employees at the hostess stand, wait for 10 minutes, and someone from the back finally cleans the table and lets us sit, at our wet sticky table. Other dirty tables sat there unattended during our meal.
For a brewery restaurant, you would think they would have at least one Porter or Stout, right? Darkest beer was a brown ale. They did have a $14.99 glass of basic chardonnay, I think the full bottle is $8.99 at the CVS.  The waitresses were good, although they have no beer knowledge.  Overall, the food is decent. They are very light on the actual meat part of your fajita or chicken sandwich, but the burgers are better sized.

This felt like a big waste of money. We took my parents here to celebrate and left very disappointed. We waited over 40 minutes for our appetizer to arrive. The wines are over priced. The Shiraz was not enjoyable. The brocollini side we had was too salty to eat. The arancini was only average (I've had amazing arancini in other restaurants in the city), the $46 steak was completely over seasoned. The service was so slow that we didn't even get to try dessert. The location is nice and the pizza was good. Would not recommend, completely disappointing.
Highly recommend their breakfast.  Everything is good, service is fast, prices are fair.  French toast and biscuits and gravy are can't miss.

tip from a local: you MUST eat mexican food in tucson! 
so we went yelping away for a mexican restaurant and boy were we very glad we did! 

ordered:
*shrimp ceviche-$7.99 -skip! wasn't all that and a bag of chips. felt a bit disappointed. if you do order it make sure you squeeze them limes and add tapitato.
*fish street taco- it was good but not the best fish tacos i have had. 
*barbacoba street taco-man this was sooooo GOOD! the meat was full of flavor and totally made the meal exceptional. 
*children menu- chicken quesadilla -nothing crazy. my kid didn't really take to it. 
*beef fajita - 2 thumbs up! definitely a must order and you must dip it in the salsa in order to have that wow factor. 

loved the salsa bar! yum yum yum! staff were super nice! all smiles and definitely made indecisive customers feel at ease. the staff didn't rush us as we were trying to figure out what we wanted to order. she provided great suggestions. portions are sharable. very reasonably priced. this yelper definitely would recommend you to come here and get the beef fajita and barbacoba taco! you totally won't be disappointed! i sure was not! 

tips:
*shared parking lot with other businesses.
*restroom available for customers
*full bar. serves alcohol
*high chair is available.
*cash and credit card accepted.
*indoor seating only. 
*mexican bottled coke is available.
*ask for extra napkins. it'll get a bit messy!

At 28 weeks, I was dropped by Dr. Soffici and his girlfriend, Susan Regenhardt.  She was my midwife and he was her back-up doctor.  7 months pregnant and abandoned with no prenatal care.  You must be thinking that I did something horribly offensive to deserve such treatment. All I did was express my concerns about Dr. Soffici's dismissive 5 minute ultrasound.  That's right.  And I didn't even speak to Dr. Soffici about it! I spoke to his girlfriend, my midwife (where I'm sure there's some sort of patient confidentiality agreement).
This is my third pregnancy and my first with a midwife. I quickly learned that aside from taking urine samples and checking blood pressure, there were no ultrasounds available to measure growth during office visits. So, I was really looking forward to my 19 week 3D scan with Soffici.  I brought my husband and two kids (ages 11 and 8), excited to see our new baby and to make sure she was growing properly.  The appointment lasted no more than 5 minutes (the ultrasound DVD proves it). I'm guessing the baby was in bad position, but the doctor said nothing.  He just kept printing out strange and horrific photos.  My daughter even asked if the baby had skin yet.  And then, Dr. Soffici's nurse came in, said he had a phone call, and the appointment was over. As he left, I asked if the baby was ok and he barked back, "I would tell you if there was a problem."  Good to know, I thought. The whole thing was so odd.  When I was pregnant with my other two children the 3D ultrasounds lasted over 45 minutes. And we got amazing photos of both kids.  
At my next appointment with the midwife, I shared the disappointing experience.  She seemed shocked and assured me that Dr. Soffici would do another ultrasound, if I desired. I was concerned, however, because he was her backup doctor.  And I couldn't help but think that if something went wrong during labor and Dr. Soffici recommended a C-section, my first thought would be that he was late for a dinner reservation.  In the end, I felt that since I had given birth naturally twice before, it probably wouldn't come to that. The midwife recommended that I go in for a 28 week scan.
I called Dr. Soffici's office right away to schedule the ultrasound, but they couldn't get me in until 31 weeks.  I accepted the appointment.  What else could I do?  He's the only guy in town with the technology. 
Then, a week later, on a Saturday, we received a fedex from Dr. Soffici stating that he was canceling my ultrasound appointment and terminating care.  He stated that since he was Susan's back-up doctor, she too would be terminating care. Abandoned, I had to find another doctor quickly.  It took me numerous calls and texts to retrieve my records and I still don't have reimbursement for any part of Susan Regenhardt's $4000 midwife fee (she does not take insurance). 
In the end, I know it's for the best -- I wouldn't want Susan or Dr. Soffici delivering my baby. I'm seeing a doctor in LA now. And I can't tell you how wonderful if feels to be cared for by a doctor who really cares.  I can't believe I was willing to settle for a mediocre midwife and doctor just to stay in Santa Barbara. My advice to you - go to LA.  And if you hire Dr. Soffici, whatever you do, don't complain!

Olio Pizzeria was a last minute Yelp search, in search for a late night snack. When we entered, we just chose to sit at the bar, Sam the bartender was our server. We ordered cocktails and a Margarita Pizza.

Service was very good, cocktail and pizza very good!

I'm a baby when it comes to any sort of work in my mouth. First of all, I enjoy the setting. It was relaxing, and has plenty to do for my little kids. They love the fish tank, gaming chairs, and watching a movie. The staff are so friendly and welcoming, including Dr.Weaver who is entertaining and funny, but also quite the comfort to the big babies out there:) I enjoy the friendship of the staff, especially McKenzie. Feels like I've known everyone for a long time:) 
I had also had been to another orthodontist, but Dr Jaw's office notice things and were more detailed in their approach than the other office, I was impressed. I have braces and Invisalign. I go in every three weeks. My appointments are quick and efficient. They also have a fun rewards program. One of my most favorite things is that they buy my kids Halloween candy back and donate it to the troops. Love this, and my kids do too!!!
I am so grateful to know that there is an office that is local that I can trust to do a great job, with me and my kids.

These guys knocked it out of the park tonight. We had a birthday party with some special seating needs and they couldn't have been more helpful or responsive. The food was awesome as always and we all left LOVING Outback. Steak and lobster rocks

UPDATE: I understand the management has changed since my negative food event and 3 day intestinal roller coaster ride. In all fairness to them, and in the spirit of generosity, I will up my rating to middle of the road. You challenged me to try again Desi, so I will.


OLD review:

Food poisoning.

I'm pretty sure it was the mint chutney, which in years past would sit out on the buffet line. It wasn't there...so I asked for some, and out comes a cold, half empty, open container. That little voice in my head tried to warn me. Two days later...If I had only listened.

Besides that it was a letdown! Cold tandoori chicken and dried out tikka masala. 

Done w Desi V.

We enjoy this place and have been there several times.   Great atmosphere, nice vibe, and the food is pretty good.  We usually get a three meat plate with a couple sides, and that is enough for both my wife and I.   The bbq isn't quite as good as say, Sugarfire or Pappy's, but it is still tasty.  The pulled pork is the best, the brisket has a nice peppery Texas style rub, but can be a little chewy.  The St Louis ribs are good also.  Among the sides, we like the green beans, sweet potato fries, and the cheesy grits.

I have spent so much time there through the years. My husband and I just love hiking the beautiful trails and you decide whether you want to do a long hike or short. My dogs love it, the kids, it's really the perfect park for all ages. We have taken beautiful photographs because every season has something to offer and then don't forget the dog museum. I can't say enough, except if you have never experienced Queeny, I think your missing out.
Best vidaloo! The serving were a lot. Two can share one serving. One of my favorites in Tampa!

It has been over two and a half years since my first review and my mom, my sister and myself are still faithfully using the services at Unlimited Salon and Day Spa. Thanks for keeping a great place running for so many years Roe!

We have eaten here a year or so ago and was good.
Happened to be on that side of Nashville, and decided to go again.
So Family dinner night out, it is.

ordered:
Half and Half -Roast Beef Poboy ( dressed) and Jambalaya.
Half and Half -Roast Beef Poboy ( dressed) and Etouffee.
Half and Half -Alligator Poboy (dressed) and Seafood Gumbo.
Bowl of Red Beans and Rice.
Kids Chicken Tenders and Fries.
Double order of  3 X Beignets
Kids 12 and under get a free ice cream sundae.
2 Abita Rootbeers (can) 
2 teas


Everything was great. 
Everyone enjoyed their meal, and all but one needed a Togo box.
We took 4 Beignets home.

Only thing, we would of changed...... we like our Roast Beef Poboy's to be "wet" (dripping with gravy, where it soaks into the bread).

We are a family that knows Cajun style food, and this place is probably as close to S. LA. As you can get. 
It actually beats some of the places in New Orleans we have eaten at.

Service was ok. Could of been a little more attentive to drinks, and clearing plates.

The Beignets- one is quite big, and not what you get at Cafe Du Monde in New Orleans. ( reason for the Togo box of the other 4).

Price wise, for the above = $91.00

Honestly, there are fancier restaurants in Nashville, but I don't believe you will find a better meal, price wise to compete.

Everyone agreed it was a good decision for dinner, and worth our drive.
Looking forward to our next visit.

Our family are big fans.  

Its a small resturant that can get loud but not so loud you cant here (at least not yet for me).  

The food is always well prepared and if you need modifications they are happy to do so.

The service has always been excellent.  The owner is usually the hostess and if he sees anything wrong he will take care of it. 

If you go on the weekends expect a wait

My Fiance' and I are newly engaged and wanted to get away from our busy lives for the weekend. I was referred by a friend to the Secret Garden Inn. This place is perfect for couples! It's very charming and quaint. The owner, Dominique, is a really sweet and lovely lady. She invited us to a wine tasting where we met another newly engaged couple. 
The room was cozy and relaxing. We had a deck and a hot tub. But the best part, was that I was able to relax here. I'll admit it, I'm kinda' uptight. But here, I felt really calm and collected. I didn't want to leave! This place deserves the five stars just for that, but they receive the five stars for being the best BnB I've been to.
Easy parking right now.  Though could be different on a non holiday. Pizza is ok. Garlic knots tasty. Service at counter was ok.

Unagi is my absolute favorite sushi place! I've been going for years now.  The airline roll with cream cheese added and the unforgettable roll are to die for. The noodle salad is sooo yummy too. Affordable and quick. Not the most aesthetic interior but the food makes it worth it.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!
Dr Kristy Charles has literally been a long saver for me! She explained procedures, answered many questions and is very, very patient. The staff is on time and everyone is very welcoming. 
The older I get the more I need Advanced Dermatology. 
I'm very happy, Dr Kristy Charles is superb.
Without a doubt, 5 stars!

In this day and age of rushed appointments and transactional business walking into Milano Nails is such a joy.

It's the little things like them offering you water the second you walk in. The fact that it smells clean and not overpowering of chemicals.

The opportunity of having an organic pedicure if you choose to.

The nice music playing at the perfect level so you can relax.

The staff is friendly and nice the services are well priced and their chairs are super comfortable. If you are looking for a place, I highly encourage you to try them!

Loved it!

Amazing food! 

Clean, bright and uplifting atmosphere.

Excellent service!

I'll surely be back!

Just bought tiles for a small vestibule project from Michael. I'd been searching for over two years and I was paralyzed by indecision. Michael was like a psychologist! He was patient and listened to me and steered me toward finally making a decision and let me take home a sample while I considered my options. I will definitely be using them again for any future projects. Big thank you to Michael!

Without a reservation, you may expect to wait an hour.  It was difficult to understand the check in process. I found it challenging to know where I was in line. There were two different waiting areas which made it hard to know who was next. There didn't seem to be a clear process of checking off names.  Making this process more transparent to the customer may help. 

This was my first visit and I was not impressed.   I am a fan of the owners other restaurants so I held them to a higher standard. I'll stick with the restaurant downtown.
Our server was great, the food was great. I would give 5 stars but we almost didn't eat here due to the rude host.

Went in for gel manicure and regular pedicure. I had a Groupon deal - first of all, they said I couldn't avail that without an appointment, which is just rude!
Secondly, there were only 2 women who work here and when we went in with 2 mani pedis and 1 mani, they made it sound like we would get done in no time, but made us wait forever!
One of them was constantly on her phone or going outside repeatedly.
I would give it one more star if at least the quality was good - but the gel mani came off in a week. 
Would NOT recommend.

Great experience at the new and improved location. The breadsticks were amazing and just like I remembered at their previous location. The pizza was great too and the service was very friendly. Nice place to take the family out to eat or watch a game on their big screen and for a reasonable price.  We will definitely be back!

My favorite greasy spoon in the city. The breakfast selection is delicious and cheap, they also have the best homefries in the city
 Never had anything on the lunch menu though

4 of us went for dinner on Thursday evening.  What an incredible menu!  Not the usual items found on most Indian restaurant menus.  We shared 4 small plates and 2 entrees.  The lamb was luscious!  The green bean entrée was fantastic.  We also had the rabbit stuffed naan, wow, to die for!  We tried both shrub beverages, both were delicious.

I am so sorry to have to write this yelp review. We live in st Pete and have been dying to try Ulele. As a yelp elite member I've poured over reviews and was so excited to come. We've walked past it quite often on our river walk rambles and today was the day to try. After waiting for forty five minutes we finally got to a table. Our waitress, who I remember her name but don't want to post it online, did not make us feel welcome at all. I was afraid to ask her questions about the menu. We drove this far and the main thing I wanted was okra fries. I was told they were out so our entire day into Tampa to get the fries was in a way wasted. We did order the corn muffins which were very tasty. The whipped butter was excellent. We were going to order other food off the menu but the way we felt by the waitress did not entice us to stay longer. I almost cried at the table due to the high hopes I had upon arrival and my subsequent disappointment shortly thereafter.

Tried this for the first time recently,  good fried ckn is hard to be found around here outside of the publix deli. Cajun sauce comes on the side so you have the option. We did the Tues special, 3 piece ckn and it comes with plenty of steak fries, less than $8. I ordered a side of slaw  too..next time I'll skip that, I'm  fussy about coleslaw and I didn't care for it, however the ckn was excellent ..the fries too! 1 huge breast, 1 big leg and a nice sized thigh,  I liked that they didn't try to skimp with wing..very good, relaxed atmosphere ,everyone was very friendly, helpful, it's a small takeout place but you can eat in, which we did. Very good.

This is some of the best Indian food I have had in a long time. We ordered this meal as take out. For our appetizer we ordered a fried onion vegetable combination only because they were all out of every kind of samosa on the menu, but it was very good. Our main courses were the Chicken Tikka Masala and the Chana Gobi. They were both very excellent served with rice. Also ordered some nan bread for dipping in the Masala gravy, yum! We felt the portions were perfect for the money and we even had leftovers. Very good, a must try.

This place sucks... customer service person has an attitude when I wanted to return a brand new dishwasher that i literally bought 2 hours ago after I completely installed the electric, drain, and plumbing.. The top rack was jacked up wouldn't pull out without grinding on the slider...  i called immediately and asked to speak to someone and they told me to call fridigaire... frigidaire has a recording saying they are to too busy and cant answer calls right now...    wasted about 2.5 hours... my be a blessing in disguise... I usually only shop at home depot but saw this deal online at lowes and that's why I bought it...   I'm done with lowes... place is complete garbage...

My hotel recommended this location. The operating hours posted on the paper on the door are incorrect. They recently reopened on Mondays until 8pm.. 

Thankfully the hostess allowed me in at 7:40pm and directed me to the barstaff to ask for a to-go order.  The bartender was lovely! He was so kind and said that I could order anything I wanted, despite the lack of time. He gave me a glass of wine, a menu, and asked me to sit at the pub tables.

I didn't want to keep them any longer so I asked for his suggestions for something they could prepare quickly. I ordered their brussell sprouts, pub fries, and wings. After settling up he asked again if I wanted another drink and if I wanted to stay and eat. I thanked he and the host and slipped out to eat at my hotel. I was in and out of there in "one glass of wine time." I was very happy with my experience and would recommend it to anyone passing through or local.

In my last visit we had the lunch buffet which was very good. Great place to meet and enjoy their food.  Lots of room to accommodate a large group. Great service and close to businesses in the area. Got the seafood bisque today and steak medallion.
My boyfriend got a cheesesteak and I got a buffalo chicken cheesesteak. Not very good and our sandwiches were around $8 a piece. I've had so much better for the price.

What ever you do go to good Sam these people left me on the summit for 2 days in freezing weather if you value your life at all go to good Sam I caught the flu so bad I thought I was going to die, even went to hospital

Sushi and I have nothing in common but this is a great place to get a bite.  My mom loved the sushi and sampled several of the many options. I had the Korean BBQ which came in a very hot (still bubbling) metal plate.  I really enjoyed my meal and the ambiance was nice, decent music and not too loud.

Self-serve frozen yogurt with a toppings bar. You pay by weight, so if you love tons of toppings you will pay more. They had about 6 or 7  different flavors on the evening we first went.
