I really didn't care for the Orange sweet peppers the rest was ok. We both didn't feel so well a little while after eating there. I would not drive out of my way to go back. I would rather go to others places first.

This place was such a pleasant surprise.  My party of six went here last Saturday night when it was pretty damn cold outside (well, it was January, doy!).  Nevertheless, we ended up outside in the beer garden area because the inside was overflowing with people having a really good time.  Once we were out there, we realized that it wasn't that bad because they have an abundance of heaters and fire pits all over the place.  Once ordered, the food didn't take very long to come out and everybody was stoked with what they ordered.  The potato pancakes were one of my favourites, mmmmm.  
This place is just a really good time.  They have ping pong set up out back, and Jenga for most of the tables.  OH! I'm now a fan of mulled wine thanks to FH.  Sitting outside, sipping some delicious mulled wine, playing Jenga with friends, enjoying some indie music, eating German food....what more could you ask for, really?

Despite this being a pretty big college scene, the food and drinks are surprisingly very good and HELLA cheap when it's happy hour. 12oz frozen margs were 3 bucks each and 14 wings for 7 bucks!

My girlfriend and I ordered the buffalo mild wings, chicken quesadillas, strawberry margarita, and raspberry margarita. 

Wings: 8/10
Quesadillas: 5/10
Strawberry Margarita: 10/10
Raspberry Margarita: 9/10

As you can see, we wouldn't get the quesadillas again, but we were so satisfied with the wings and drinks it really doesn't affect my rating. 

BEWARE. We ordered mild wings and I am a spice lover and these had quite the kick to them. So unless my waitress mistakenly heard wild, and not mild, be cautious if you are not great with heat.

Diverse, unique flavours samples are available. I had butter pecan ale, which was very good. The owner was friendly and welcoming. $2.92 was more than I'd normally spend on a single scoop of ice cream but it was worth it. All cups and spoons are biodegradable.

Omg so good. The name speaks for itself. GET THE ROAST. And the greens. The turnips were amazing along with all the other carb sides!! Skip the chocolate pie as it's not very good but as for the meat and 3... WOW! 

Just hop in line, order, pay, fix your drink, find a table and let the meat and three melt in your mouth.

They took in an activity stolen car. Then they put it in the auction pool. I ended up with it. I had to sue to get 2/3 of my money back.

Not a stolen, recovered, branded title. ACTIVELY stolen. Indiana State Police took it when I showed them. 2 years in court.

It was a VIN clone, and a poor one. Its impossible they didn't know EXACTLY what they were doing.

I lost money. The little dealer that picked it up from auction is now out of business. Lost his income, livelihood.

Proof is in Marion County Superior Court cause 49D07-1601-PL-001026

My settlement didn't include an NDA and I will keep posting this review over and over.

These people are dishonest and if you buy anything from them you're stupid.

I love this place. Especially this location because it's so conveniently located by the airport and the hotels. Their shrimp tacos are soooo good. Their German Pretzel and cheese is amazing too. I really like their blonde beer. It's so smooth and so light. They have outdoor seating as well. Great atmosphere.

I was jonesing for some Pho. Pho 36 was closed for this week (vacation?), so I went down and across the street. 

Glad I did. The (?) Chicken Rice Noodle soup is Pho as far as I'm concerned.

It was a great lunch!

I have given a lot of thought about writing a review about a restaurant visit. I finally decided to write one because I am extremely disappointed. My family and me used to go very frequently to Longhorn when it was located on dale mabry hwy. W loved their food and customer service.
Today was our first time coming to the new location on westshore blvd... first and probably last.
WHen we were seated @ our table, the host never said hello, or your server will be right with you, but I thought it was because they were having a busy night although we didnt have to wait @ all to be seated.
The server, Carla, was anything but friendly and customer service driven. She came, introduced herself, asked what we would like to drink, and if we were ready to order an appetizer. I already knew what we wanted, but I felt like she wwas rushing things. We had only been sitting @ the table for less than 2 minutes.She never came back to check on us, just to pick up the dirty dishes, and did not even ask if it was okay to take them away. when she brought the check, she placed it on top on the bread basket, what kind of restaurant etiquette is that? I know longhorn is not a fancy restaurant @ all, but I just thought that was completely unacceptable.
For the food, I have mixed opinions. Everytime we have gone, we have asked for the Wild West shrimp as a starter. It was pretty good, as always. All three of us asked for salad as one of the sides, it came too early, and barely had any dressing on. I had the renegade sirloin with mashed potatoes. the steak tasted delicious but i could have made better mashed potatoes at home. my mother had the same kind of steak but with the loaded potato- she was not impressed at all by it. My boyfriend had the hand-battered shrimp with mashed potatoes as well. the shrimp batter was bitter, and the shrimp was not juicy @ all. we were so upset we didnt even stay for dessert. 
I am really sorry for this place because it is in a great location, and the place looks very nice, and clean. 
It wasnt very busy for a saturday night, i guess that says a lot!!!
probably not coming back, unless i hear they make big changes, and send their waiters and waitresses to customer service school!
Great drinks and lots of plugs for the laptop crowd. Free wifi. Duh
I had the steak fajitas which were great. The service was fast and the restaurant was clean

I love that they have brown rice option for sushi (call ahead and be clear how much you'll eat) 

The apps are great! We love the fish cheek, cooked to perfection. 

Never had anything we didn't like. 
Well prepared and a nice quiet place to get a nice meal. 

Haters posting bad reviews haven't read the menu (ie they have all different styles of Asian not just Japanese) 

They have something for everyone. 
Prices are comparable to other sushi/ Asian restaurants.

I have been back several times now, and it has been solid. My house is too far away for delivery, but it is worth driving a few miles to eat in. Again, that pepperoni!  The edges curl up and get crisped to perfection.  Love this place. And it is in the UPromise network, so I am eating pizza to pay down my student loan debt. Brilliant!

THIS WAS A GREAT EXPERIENCE !!!! Ke'Shana is AMAZING !!! this was my first haircut since moving to Boise from Huntington Beach,  Ca. and I can't wait to go back !!! Ke'Shana knew exactly what to do with my hair and im soooooooooooo in love with the cut she gave me. She. Is. A. Rockstar. For sure :-) next stop: colortown #KeShanaRocks !!!!!
Fantastic tap selection with a very friendly and knowledgable staff.  The food is off the menu from PW upstairs - which is reasonably priced and tasty.  Great place to grab a pint.
This is my favorite papaya salad . It is delicious . The place is nice and spacious. I would recommend it to friends and family .

Great food and the people were really nice and the place was very clean. I had the Cleaver sandwich and it was delicious and my son had the half rack of ribbs and my wife had the Chicken Burrito it was fresh and healthy.

Nice decor inside and nice patio. Spacious interior for covid dining.  The three of us spent $67. All coffee products ordered were good. All three of us ordered dishes with eggs. Here, the restaurant failed miserably. The scrambled eggs were dry, hard and brown on the bottom. In my waffle egg, spinach, feta cheese dish the eggs were the same. Food was dry end way overcooked. We returned the scrambled eggs and asked for scrambled soft. What was returned were scrambled eggs in a waffle pattern. That's not how it came originally nor was this what we asked for. Again the eggs were dry and overcooked. I lifted up the egg formed as a waffle and again the eggs were brown on the bottom. We waved the white flag. We surrendered our desire for good scrambled eggs. Clueless in the kitchen is my review overview. We all agreed never to return.
service was fast and super friendly. I enjoyed the summer love tea specialty, it was refreshing and not overly sweet. I can't wait to go back and try some food :p
My first time going was this past Sunday and I'm glad I went. The atmosphere is nice and the food is very authentic! The staff were friendly as well. Definitely going to be a regular at this place.

Ohhhh my gosh. Yes. The pizza is good.

I ordered a slice of the Franz Park, and was amazed when it came out. It was a HUGE slice, topped with ricotta cheese, red sauce, garlic olive oil, basil, and sliced tomatoes. Everything tasted fresh, and the crust (my favorite part) was crispy, flavorful, and I didn't even feel bad when I ate all of it.

I drank a glass of some of the best chardonnay I've ever had, and the bartender turned off the music and turned on the sound of the Cards game for me. I sat at a high-top table and worked while watching the entire game, and it was seriously the nicest afternoon. Can't wait to go back and try more of the pizza! 

Really nice people running this place. My only complaint was that it was really warm in there, but then again, when it's triple digits outside it's going to happen. I will be back at Felix's very soon!
Spent my Saturday night going to see drew lynch. Joe and Christian were my waiters and were awesome. Always a fun time at helium.
I asked an employee a question about where to find a particular product and he was very curt with his reply. Also the prices for dog items seem high. I wouldn't come here again.

Love this place!!!!  We got their ice cream and baklava deal.  So worth it- huge thing of ice cream and 2 pieces of your choice of baklava for $6!  I tried the espresso ice cream and this may be possibly the best ice cream ?3 ever had and I don't really love espresso ice cream.  Baklava is my jam.  They have Persian, Iraqi, etc baklava- different types with different nuts, etc.  it was hands down phenomenal.  I really want to support this place as much as possible- I want to see it succeed.
Had their burger was delicious. The restaurant was beautiful and service was great. Nice brunch spot. Will go back for sure to try other items.

Nice little neighborhood joint offering burgers and a lot more.  The Brussels sprouts are worth the drive from airport.  Definitely more a local dive than a tourist trap.  Expect to pay 15 for a burger and drink..  I had schnitzel and giggles and it was delicious.
great place to meet friends.  Band is always good but you never know what kind of music they are going to play.  Beer is good!  Food of course is of Irish nature.

Well where to start... WOW! It's really all that's needed. I've come a few times now and it just keeps getting better. I tried the Gyoza for the first time and it was delicious, the sauce even had a little kick to it and I love spice so that was a happy surprise. I also can't stop ordering the Tonkatsu Red Chili, just enough residual heat to make the spicy sniffles happen but not so spicy you can't keep eating it. (I actually add a cup of the spicy garlic to up the intensity a little bit but my wife thinks it's spicy enough without the extra) I've notice in the three times I've been here that there's never a good time to get a quick table, but that's okay for me because it just means the place is here to stay and it's most definitely worth the wait!

The food was amazing.. poultrygeist is deliciously hot.  Our waiter was Dylan and he was awesome.. great service,  very friendly and great with people of all ages. .  We love Dylan! Thanks for making our Nashville trip even better

This place does have delicious food BUT it takes forever!!!! First off we ordered appetizers tonight, asked for water and iced tea. Well the iced tea is the powered mix that's super tea, so they don't brew it, and I never got my water. After our food came, ( the rest of the tables food came) I asked again for my water and finally. After waiting for an hour, my plate came. It was ridiculous. A total time of two hours just to get everything! Do not recommend if your in a hurry or starving.
Hotel very clean. Excellent service. Only complaint is that your neighbors make lots of noise after cardinals games.
The smoked chicken dip is perfectly portioned and tasty! On Tuesday, happy hour is all day and includes both food and booze. Ashley W. is great and super friendly. Come see her for great service!

Went there last night with a party of 14.  If you know how small this place is, you'll know that a party of that size takes up probably half of the dining room.  These people are experts though - they have a perfectly sized menu with just enough options and everything was done with precision.  Everyone's food came out at the same time and everything was beyond expectations.
  
I would've been impressed with the level of service and food quality we had if we had a party of 4.  With a party of 14, it's amazing.

One star is generous.  They charge monthly fees that are excessive and provide little, if any, service.  After recently going to back door trash pickup - which sounds nice, it has been communicated that anything not in a strong, closed, and plastic trash bag, it will not be taken.  While I understand this in terms of a large item such as a mattress or other furniture item (which must be taken several miles away), what about cardboard boxes or items that do not easily fit into plastic trash bags?  Sadly, this is just the most recent issue. 
If a resident posts a comment or question on the community website, it will be shut down almost immediately.  
This HOA does nothing more than collect monthly fees, issue fines, and bully residents.

The only reason I'm still a customer here is because of the food, which is fantastic. I usually tend to do take out, and nearly every time I order, I have to make 2-3 calls that go to voicemail before I can get somebody on the line. I generally excuse it to the restaurant being busy, however today I had to call a total of FIVE times before anybody answered to take my order. At this point I had nearly arrived. About five minutes later I arrived and the restaurant was not busy at all. Other times when I order takeout, the staff will watch me standing at the register and will continue their conversations before eventually ringing me up. Half the I can see my food sitting in the window for up to ten minutes until I can hail somebody down to hand it to me. Not to be mistaken, the staff is indeed incredibly friendly, but they generally do not seem to be very interested in providing satisfactory service.

She almost scammed me today... thankfully I found all of your reviews first! She told me her name is Alisa McLeod, she is shipping the goods from Lancaster PA, but texted me from a (302) number. 

Thank you all so much for your reviews! I am sorry she took advantage of you and I sincerely hope you all get your money back.
This place is disgusting. My silverware came with a piece of rice stuck on the fork and not to mention the spell of mold. The waiter was decent that's about the only good thing I can say.

I am updating my review simply because of the responsiveness and great attitude of the management.  I am rooting for this hotel and I feel that they deserve a second chance.  After all they are facing a very difficult transition as they update this hotel to keep it competitive. I'm sure with this level of service and professionalism by their management, they will be extremely successful. Hang in there.  I'll be back.

Our waitress, Shelly, was AWESOME! Not too little and not too much as far as her checking on us. We got the combo platter with shrimp and crawfish. It was the best fried crawfish I've had because you could actually taste the meat and not only the batter. Definitely going back

This is a review of the Christmas lights experience.

I did some research ahead of time and read all about the buffet they offered and decided to skip it and go for the lights and beverages.  My kids are older, so I figured we could score some soda or hot chocolate to pacify them.  After all, hubby and I just wanted to do it for the free adult beverages and we knew we would have to throw them something to keep them happy.

We got there a few minutes before opening which was the right move.  The parking is great if you work there, not so great going in as a tourist.  It's every man, woman and child for themselves!  See a spot?  Don't hesitate, park!

We had to wait in line to get in and then walk through an area with people waiting for the buffet.  For the $13 or $15 fee, they had one paper plate.  They were all holding on to it for dear life, so I don't know what that was about.  I just remember thinking I was glad we were skipping that.

As far as walking around, there are lots of pretty spots and you can pay (and wait in a long line) for photo with a Clydesdale or kind of avert the system and do your own thing.  There are spots along the way with photo ops and they are free.

We got bracelets at the door after they checked our id and they had 5 tickets on them.  There were stations for Stella Artois, Budweiser, Bud Light, Lime-A-Rita and something else I couldn't remember.  The drinks are only 4 ounces, but free! 

They didn't really have anything for kids, no matter what age.  They had fire pits you could rent out, I think they were $50 or more and we saw one unmanned hot chocolate station.  So kids in a wagon or stroller would be great, you could throw them a few crackers and be done with it.  My teenagers were whining a lot about being cold and asking when we were leaving.

The best way to do this is to go with some friends, no kids, get there when they open and bring extra money for the bar!

While I usually try to go somewhere at least twice before leaving a review...I don't think that will be necessary here. While we had to wait for 1.5 hours (thank you No Wait app tho) to get in it was well worth it.

The Good
- Moscow Mule Slushy. Yes, I said slushy. It was absolutely amazing and I had to try really hard to not order 2.
- I don't eat calm chowder often...but wow this was really really good.
- I ordered the Buffalo crawfish poorboy. I'm not exaguratting when I say it's the best one I've ever had. The sauce and slaw were perfect and it didn't fall apart like others do.

Just 2 minor complaints that don't take away from the 5 star rating.
- The chips were really salty. 
- Our waiter wasn't very attentive.

I would recommend that you try them out if you haven't yet. I know I'll be going back soon!
Yum meat good grill. Delicious, great customer service and people cooked for us. Magical experience for 3 hungry single moms in med school. Decent price for all you can eat

This locations getting worse day after day! From the service to their equipments. For a month straight I would be told that they can't use my reward card because the machine was down, until one day I said I can't take that for an answer. All the sudden the machine was working fine! The other day, I had the reward with my credit card to the cashier, as I drive always to check my rewards, I see that she didn't even swipe my card! Luckily they have the reward numbers to claim them! But, how stupid do they think their customers are? I know when you didn't swipe my reward card! Yesterday, I went to pickup some bagels and cream cheese for the breakfast. I had to wait at least half an hour to get to the window through their drive-through. By time I get home, of course they had forgot my cream cheese which I paid for! I called to speak to the manager. She apologizes and promises that she will mail me one tomorrow! So, they promote their delivery services everywhere, I live less than a mile away. She expects me to eat my bagels plain and she promises me to send my cream cheese a day later. Which by the way I never saw to this day because no one is home and I haven't received a phone call yet! I go to Panera at least 5 to 6 times a month and they can see that on my reward card. You would think that they would take care of their customers, but they don't give damn!

No, not good. Since this is the only place to eat in this forgot about terminal I think one should be able to order just egg, bacon and potatoes. I am not a fan of grits nor biscuit. I remember this terminal stinks while flying American for 7 years. Eat outside or if you have the time go to Old College Inn in terminal D. 

Al Copeland is turning in his grave!!

The dreaded "check engine" light displayed on my dashboard. Totally stressed me out. I normally bring my car to the dealership but they wouldn't be able to get to my car till later in the week. Like most people, I can't be without my car for an extended period of time. A friend mentioned going to Marks in MidCity. I called and a very friendly voice answered and I was instructed to drop my car off, due to my work schedule it was unfortunately after business hours, no problem for the shop. 

The very next day, before lunch I received a call stating my car was ready for pick up. I don't understand the mechanics of it all but needless to say the check engine light is OFF and my car is running smoothly without breaking the bank, thanks Mr. Mark!
Great Philadelphian breakfast. They have scrapple pork roll and anything else that you would love about breakfast. Definitely an every weekend thing for me.

I went here Saturday night with my spouse. We got a babysitter, so it was a big date night for us. The place was busy, but not too busy for the bartenders to be so nice, welcoming, and personable. Unfortunately they had ran out of their own brews, but they are working on that. After we got our beers, we scoured the games. This is a fun way to enjoy a beer. The room was hot and no air movement, so wear a t shirt and shorts. I anticipate seeing what they do with their outdoor patio area this summer. I will definitely be back!

I like the soup, it is always good, Italian hoagie, chicken buffalo cheesesteak and the chicken buffalo salad. My father says the clams with red sauce is the best he's ever had and he eats everywhere. The Sicilian pie is very tasty, good flavor and great crunch. They also make a good vodka rigatoni and you can add salmon of shrimp etc. It is very causal there.

Food was great. We ordered the home fries and biscuit benny. Very tasty and the poached eggs were cooked to perfection. Service was superb. Key is the best!  Our party of ten sat down and immediately water bottles appeared along with coffee, cream and sugar. Then came Key, smiles and all, taking our orders and answering any questions we had. She made our experience a very memorable one that will last forever in our hearts.
Favorite place to eat for family n I.  Making one on the South side was the greatest idea.  I just hope parking is expanded a bit more!!

We have been to the Birchwood a few times and it has always been delicious. Everything on the menu is very good and you really can't go wrong (order the scallops!) our most recent visit my husband and I were under a lot of stress because we were in the middle of purchasing a home that had yet to close. We were obviously conversing very seriously about the matter and our server took note and was very accommodating and friendly. Anyway, if you happen to think of it... Ask to sit in Thomas' section. He's a rad dude and we'll definitely go back.

I'm heartbroken that I live in New York and therefore can't eat at Han Dynasty as often as I'd like (meaning daily).  I was visiting friends in Philly this past weekend and they introduced me to this fantastic place.  I'm no stranger to great food, living and dining in Manhattan, but I can honestly say this was one of the best meals I've had in a long time.  The menu is full of the usual "standards," but there is nothing standard about any of these dishes.  The cold sesame noodles were AMAZING (I considered ordering another bowl) and the garlic chicken was fantastic - just the right amount of garlic and just the right amount of "spice."  The staff was also wonderful - we explained what we liked and they made recommendations and Han even came over to our table to make sure everything was to our liking. Can't wait to go back when I'm in Philly next!

Definitely call and make reservations 'cause word spreads fast and this place is sure to be a hot spot!

I was a first time customer and had a pizza delivered. The young lady who answered my call could barely hear me over the background noise. The pizza arrived when she said it would  and the driver was nice. However, this was the worst pizza I've ever had (when Domino's is half the price and tastes better there is something really wrong). It didn't help that I was drinking cheap red wine and working on a piece of equipment that was in the same shape as my pizza. I don't believe in throwing out food, but after four slices, I had to toss it. 
I called and spoke to the manager and told him of my experience. He looked up my order and offered to deliver a free pizza to me. I declined due to the time and he told me that there is a free pizza on my account if I ever decide to come back.
Make of this what you will.

I think this buffet place is decent, my husband loves it.  I just wish they had more vegetarian options, the dishes NEVER change.  It'd bee better if there were more hot dish selections instead of all the rinky-dink desserts.  We always do the buffet take-out and the prices end up being pretty decent.  All-in-all, it's nice to go to every once in a while; the ladies up front are always very nice and sweet.

If you like sandwiches stop what you are doing and go now.  You can make your own but I would recommend trying one on their menu first.  They know what they are doing.  If you are in a hurry call ahead.  They are busy during the lunch rush but hustle to get it done.  One of the best beer selections in town too.  And I can honestly say the owners are the happiest people I have ever seen run a restaurant.  Good vibes and great sandwiches.

Should have written this a month ago.  Better late then never.  My husband and I had Thanksgiving dinner at the Inn.  We weren't sure what to expect but I have to say it was great.  Atmosphere, server and food were exceptional.  Best succatash ever and they gave you 2 pieces of pie so u could try both.  We will definitely go back next year if not sooner.

Love me some Four Muddy Paws. All of my dogs food and treats come from this pet boutique. I appreciate their attention to the the quality and manufacturing of the products that they carry in their inventory. I am a label reader and whatever I buy for my fur-babies has to be natural, made in the USA or Canada. My babies do not eat anything that is made/processed in China. 

STL recently participated in Dining Out For Life. FMP may not be a restaurant, but they stepped up to the plate and offered 25% of their sales on May 2nd as a donation for this incredible charity to end HIV. Also, during the month of June they have stepped up shown their "Pride". 

On the day of Dining Out, I had to stop by and grab some treats and a couple new bowls for my K-9's. To be honest, my K-9's did not need a new bowl. They have more then a soup kitchen, but who's counting.  Then during this month of "pride", I've stopped by to buy them special treats made by, Treats Unleashed another great and supportive company here in STL made to show the Rainbow.

Customer service here is always great. I am such a regular, that most of the staff knows my name. I highly recommend becoming a regular here, they'll track your purchases of dry food and after 10 purchases of the same size brand/size bag, your 11th one will be FREE. Gotta love that. 

I'll be back? - If I don't, the dogs will lock me out of the house. 

When: May 2 and June 15, 2019 (most recently)
Why: Gotta keep the dogs happy

Arthur did a horrible job paving my driveway and I called countless times and left a message  about the shoddy work and they didn't return any of my phone calls until they got a notice to appear in small claims court.
Arthur lied under oath and denied he gave me a two year guarantee that I had in writing . A&H lost the case in small claims court and I have the paperwork to prove it. Don't waste your time with this clown .

Last time I went, they gave me polish that I did not ask for. Gave them another chance, got sns. Asked to keep my shape and length and she messed up my shape. Got a polish change on my feet and it was subpar. For $50, not worth it. I'm very disappointed and won't be back.

I recently made a point to explore the deep south parts of Philly, and this place showed up on my radar. I wasn't expecting much because it's out of the way from pretty much the rest of Philly, but was pleasantly surprised. 

First, I noticed they have a great beer list. A whole array of craft brews and many different styles, though I found the beers to be a bit pricey across the board. I don't remember seeing a beer less than $6 and many were more than that, but I could be mistaken. 

For food, I split the chorizo poutine and duck quesadilla with my group, and then split the lamb sausage and shroom burger with my boyfriend. Chorizo poutine--was definitely seemed more like chili fries than a poutine, but it tasted good so I didn't mind. Duck quesadilla--I remember thinking this could have had just a bit more flavor, like it was missing a little something. Lamb sausage--this was my favorite of the things we got. Great flavors! Shroom burger--this was too salty. Thank goodness I was splitting it because I don't think I could have eaten the whole thing. 

Service from the boys working here was great! If I'm ever in the neighborhood again I'll stop by.
Best pho I ever ate. My new favorite resturant. Best in south jersey for sure. Place is very clean and waiters are very nice and fast.

Tucked in a small line of restaurants on Haverford Avenue in Ardmore, I had driven by this place many times and never even noticed it.  But, when I was looking for a great sushi place on the Mainline, I turned to Yelp for suggestions and am glad I did.  We have eaten at Harusame three times now, twice in the restaurant and once for take-out.  On all three occasions the sushi has been among the best I have had.  Tonight we started with an order of Edamame, then had American Dream Roll, California Roll, Tempura Roll, and Eel Roll. The American Dream Roll was my favorite, rock shrimp tempura inside, topped with king crab and crab sticks along with the chef's special sauce.  The meal was reasonably priced at $40 including tip.
A few other details, parking on the street can be a little tight, but there is a parking lot for the train stop across the street and it being the weekend, we parked there.  The interior has an Asian vibe. There are lots of booths and some tables.  It's not super high-end, but comfortable and more than adequate. They also offer take-out a number of varieties of beer should you be in the neighborhood and need a six pack. The wait staff is attentive and friendly.  I look forward to going back and trying other items on the menu.

This was my church home for about 12 years until I moved to California last fall.  It was my second family.  The worship is wonderful, the messages are relevant and Bible-based, and the focus is on Jesus.

Visited this restaurant last night and Michelle served us and she was OUTSTANDING and please sit her section if you want great service. I guess I need to mention that our dishes were really good as well. 

We visit this spot several times and it's always pretty good. Usually it is pretty busy and have to wait but this time we walked straight in and was seated but as we were leaving there were a wait. I highly recommend getting there prior to 7 pm especially on Friday.

Wow !!

What a find in Tucson, Tavolino is Authentic, the Ambiance is great, the staff all relaxed and inviting, and the food ... SPLENDIDO !  

I moved here from the Pacific Northwest a few months ago and have been searching for a true Italian restaurant.  I have eaten at a number of decent places, but had almost given up hope until a friend recommended Tavolino.  Situated across from the hustle and bustle of Casa Adobes plaza in a strip mall at the Southeast corner of Ina and Oracle.  

As soon as you walk through the front door you know your in someplace special.  So many places have a corporate feel these days, and a number of the family run Italian joints in the Tucson area feel a bit dated and/or Americanized.  Tavolino has just the right amount of modern edge, European stylistic influence in design, and functional, elegant simplicity.  The music, I assume piped in off the internet, Is what you would hear in a cafe in Milan, or a bistro in Naples, or a Hotel on Ischia.  You sit down and your mind wanders, the smells of the kitchen, or brick oven wafting through the air making you wonder what specials are on the list of the Cameriera tonight. 

Mossimo aims to please... commonly there are three to four specials.  The menu, like the restaurant, simple but enticing, two pages, yet you find yourself having to consciously choose.  Don't worry, you can't go wrong.

The Wine ... Oh the wine !!! ... It is like backpacking the countryside of Italy.  Your not going to find a Cabernet, or Merlot, , Pinot Noir here, again not to worry.  Mossimo has selected some of the most incredible varietals Italy Has to offer.  Tell the bartender what aspects you enjoy about wine, and take an adventure, you might just be surprised, since 2001 Italian winemakers have really stepped up their game.  I personally enjoy Fruity, Drinkable, Medium Bodied Reds, and therefore go for the Barbera and Dolcetto D' Alba from Piemonte in Northern Italy.

After dinner, you can get an Apertif, Espresso, or Cappuccino made by a skilled Barista, or better yet a freshly prepared dessert.  Tonight Mossimo was making Profiteroles from scratch, the excitement on his face as he was whipping up these confections was palpable, you can tell the man loves his job.  You can taste it in every bite.

Lunch:  At lunchtime Tavolino turns into a Pizzeria / Trattoria ... The Brick Oven heats up and you feel like your in downtown Firenze... Pizza, Panini, Inaslata, Zuppa.  You can get in an out if your on your lunch break or relax and enjoy the siesta.
