When she was done there was a huge piece out.. I said "does this look good??" and she certainly got an attitude with me and started "fixing it." I left in tears and went home and brushed my hair out and went to my event in the same bun I wear to the gym. I have never had someone pull my hair so hard with no disregard period for the amount of pain they were causing. I am not sure if I will ever go back here because of this experience because it is such a crap shoot about which stylist you get. Also, when I took apart my hair... I found she had tied bands and tied my actual hair in knots.

Tips:
-Saturday mornings/ afternoon are crazy at this place... so book ahead
-Get there early
-Bring 100 pictures or your pinterest board etc
-Stop them in the middle and question things
-Say if you don't like it 
-Don't ever get an updo here ... EVER

I love Millers they have the best burgers! I just recently turned my wife onto Millers and she loves the food. I can't wait until the Deptford location opens do i can go more often. If you like bar food and good burgers this is the place to be!

Sooo This Place Is Really Good They Make Make The Bread For The Subs From Scratch, Best Bread I've Ever Had In My Life The Philly Is To Die For. Service Is Always Good Food Done In A Timely Manner. I Called On A Tuesday Around 3:00pm They Were Suppose To Open At 11am From What Yelp And The Internet Says, But They Will Be Opening At 5pm .... It's Not A Holiday. Either Way I Really Wanted My Philly

I was reading a review for this place that said it was better than the Desert Museum. True True True. the plants are fantastic. The lushness of the gardens. The labeling of the plants. The shaded and sunny areas. The benches to sit and enjoy the birds and butterflies. The sculptures. The garden shop with so many cactus and succulents and more. This place is incredible and a do-not-miss event in Tucson. We came on a day when there was a concert (included in admission) and it was classical guitar and had a big crowd. Top shelf, top quality, friendly people, Possibly the number one attraction in Tucson.

My family and I went here to celebrate me getting a new job. Everything was absolutely phenomenal. Every single part of the meal was delicious. Natasha was our waitress and she was just great. She was so friendly and did her job so well even though she was losing her voice. THANK YOU SO MUCH NATASHA. YOU ROCK!!!!!! Definitely will be back and requesting her.

The only thing great about this place is the fact its on the beach. The food was not great. My kids had some fish and chips, the wife had a chicken sandwich and i had a hamburger. Personally i thought my food was plain it was lacking the wow factor, in short this is how i would describe it frozen food plain. The wife and the kids did like their food, why because they were hungry

I have been eating at the Red Habanero since it opened after following them from their fast food location over in Carmel and I don't think I've ever had a bad meal. The service is usually great and if there is one must for Mexican food lovers, get the salsa trio to eat with the chips over their house salsa.

FREE TOUR. Wonderful tour led by Mary that gave a great historical account of the site. Inexpensive goods to be had at the gift shop and tasty fry bread in the parking lot for $3. This was a great experience and I highly recommended anyone making this a stop on their visit to Tucson.
My father in law loves this place.  We live in Bucks County and he insisted we take him here for his birthday.  An hour away and worth the trip.  If you go you will not be disappointed.

Was looking for a good pizza because I've heard people from Philly claim to have the best pizza in the US.   I'm from Chicago and I remember reading a Yelp review from someone from Philly visiting a Chicago pizza parlor saying that she was "skeptical about trying Chicago-style pizza because she's from Philly".    Of course no one outside of Philly has heard of Philly-style pizza.

We checked the Yelp reviews for pizza in downtown Philly and Nomad came up as the highest rated in our area.   When we stepped inside, I thought "I'm pretty sure this is not what Philly-style pizza is supposed to be" based on how fancy they looked on everyone's tables.   We were hungry so we decided to stay.

The pizza is excellent.   All the ingredients are top-notch.   It's done brick-oven style and the crust is evidence of that.   Crispy on the outside and chewy and airy on the inside.  The sauce has an herbed spice that is nice kick in the pants.  Not too much cheese so that the gourmet toppings are highlighted properly.

This is definitely artisanal pizza and not the Philly pizza locals claim is the best in the country.   That's fine with me, because we tried Philly pizza later during our visit and it was not something to be proud of.   However, Nomad is.

Really good pizza & pasta! 

We go in and have a pitcher once and a while.. Good food & good prices, friendly owner & super clean restaurant.

I think people forget about these great little hole in the wall places that have been around for a while! This pizza is really tasty! 

Support your local shops!

I work nearby and stop in for lunch frequently.  They have a great assortment of food offerings and I receive consistent quality.  My 4 star review is simply due to service being a tad slow...even when they do not seem busy.  As a positive they have amazing salads and fabulous omelet...including a make your own!

This is the second time I have been to this place. First visit was alright. I won't call the place as the best ramen but if I am craving for ramen, this place will do. 

We order pork buns, takoyaki, two ramen. Pork buns was definitely not worth it. I would totally not recommend it. It was just a slide of pork with an other piece of veggie for $6.95. Totally not worth it. Takoyaki can use a little more sauce on top. It was a little dry. Ramen was average. The one thing I love about it it's that it's not too salty. Light and smooth. These ramen always come in a big size bowl where I can always take the leftover home. 

Overall, I would say this is a local spot for a quick ramen fix.

Run as fast as you can! Unfortunately, I have eaten here a few times because it's so close to the law school at Penn and I've never come into contact with such rude, unhappy, and unappreciative owners/managers. The waitstaff is constantly in flux because no one can handle working with the screaming woman that runs the place and I admittedly feel a bit afraid when approaching the cash-register to make my order!

The pizza is okay, but the pain and suffering involved in ordering it definitely isn't worth it! I actually enjoy their mista verde chicken salad, but again, the deplorable service overshadows the average food. 

Two words: Don't go!

I absolutely love this vet. I had a dog for 18 1/2 years and took her to dr. Stryeski. I have another dog and take her there . She gives great advice and would not take my dog anywhere else. The staff is also great.

Food was very good. I had the President's plate (couldn't resist), and wife had deluxe burro. They had chicken nuggets to satisfy our picky daughter, and although I didn't see it on the menu, they made a cheese quesadilla for our youngest. President's plate was a good variety of what is offered, and all of it was very good, especially the spiced shredded beef taco. Wife thought the deluxe burro was ok, nothing special. The wait to our table was not too bad. Although they had a healthy amount of customers waiting to be seated, the owner (who was greeting customers at the front counter was right on the money when he estimated my wait time of 20 minutes. 

Out of the plethora of Mexican restaurants around, Mi Nidito's house salsa is spicier than what I have experienced, and was very tasty...it stands out among the masses. Our waitress was very nice, but was not very attentive to our table. Once we ordered, we did not get visited until our food arrived. My drink had remained empty for about 15 minutes. After the food arrived, she was more attentive to the table. 

The atmosphere inside is great. The walls looked to be professionally painted with designs, and the ambiance was just right. This is the second time I have been here, and one thing I noticed this time and last time (over a year ago) is that the customers are very friendly. Now that I am a local, I will definitely return.
Food A
Service B-
Décor A
Overall B+. 

I would love to give five stars, and upon returning I hope to update this review. Next time, I will venture deeper into the menu.

Visited this restaurant while in Nashville Tennessee for a little vacation. This place was in walking distance from our hotel. My wife and I had ham and cheese omelettes. She also ordered orange juice as it was freshly squeezed and very tasty! The coffee was also very good and tasty. Will definitely be going there again on a return visit to Nashville.

We tried this place based on reviews and LOVE it! Our pup was in desperate need of all over care (hair, nails, etc). We dropped her off and had enough time to grab a meal (took approx. 1hr). Added bonus was receiving an update call 10-15 minutes before she was done. Jackie is great with dogs, even the barking feisty ones (like ours). We will definitely be back!

More than I expected.  Hospitality, boasted chicken, great service and price.  A 5 star chicken experience for sure, albeit in a rustic but very clean setting.  Had lunch platter 1/2 chicken (breast + 3 large wings), unmistakably broasted to perfection, cob corn and broccoli sides served pronto.  Totally crisp, w moist, flavor sealed in.  $8.99 + drink.   Pizzas, Italian and country frIed classics as well.  Worth the cabfaire and a permanent stop on future visits.  Recommend without hesitation.  Bob from Texas

I've been taking my children to Cherry Hill Peds for almost 24 years.  I am very thankful for Dr. Taubman and Dr. Rosen . Not only have they given my children the best care ,but I have never had to take my children to the emergency room they are always available even on holidays . They are both very knowledgeable and updated on new practices I have entrusted them with my children's health and well-being there entire life. And I don't take the lightly.
Wonderful experience for an out of towner looking for a blowout.

I got a room King suite 1100 a nite Very dirty complain five times by the last night I still haven't cleaned  it the way I want it and then  The manager says will give you 100 dollar credit. I told her to keep it ! gorgeous place but not clean Judge for yourself for the pictures

BEST BEST chicken place in town!!! Great food, great service and freshest chicken!
This place is clean! Everyone was friendly! Will definitely be back.  
Chicken is full of flavor and crispy! Best of all it is fresh! Not just sitting there all day

We went last night for the happy hour ($5 tacos, margaritas, and guacamole). It was really good. I had the Best corn bread at this restaurant, random right?. I tried at least 7 dishes and i don't think you can go wrong with any choice you make. This is a solid restaurant to go to.

This place is a scam!!!!!!! I had placed an order with one total amount & was charged a different amount. Meaning they over charged my account. I called & the retards told me it was my banks fault. I called my bank & they told me what I already know, which is my account was overcharged by them. This piece of trash restaurant also told me that other people have called "making up lies" saying that they overcharged their accounts with 10+ dollars. We are know doing an investigation on the situation & I will be making soo much noise on this. I will report this everywhere, you low life bottom bitch motherfuckers got me fucked up if you think you will get away with this. They also have gotten a couple orders of mine wrong, Do Not Order From Here!!!!!!!Makes Noise Dreams Will Come True!

If the owner reads this, please tell your family that we still talk on the West Coast about Rosie's (DiCostanza Wichanski) hoagies out here -- "No lettuce" -- you must be related!  So many friends had them 40 years ago in West Chester.  So glad the family is still making hoagies, and I will find you next time I am in the area!  The best hoagies of all time!

Good quick and responsive service. Solid BBQ; the pork belly was particularly good. I don't usually eat the bread at BBQ, but their Texas toast was great. Incredible tap list. Appealing atmosphere. Very kid-friendly. Our toddler loved the mac and cheese. We will come back for sure.
This spot hits every single time! The crust on the chicken is one of a kind. Everything is seasoned to perfection. Don't cheat yourself when in New Orleans!

Best Mexican restaurant in Saint Louis! This is coming from someone who is Mexican and works in a Mexican restaurant. They have the best food and service! I have not had a chance to try their margaritas but the food is amazing! Hopefully one day, they get a bigger location!

When I first organized a #YelpFitClub event (which just so happened to be my first time spinning-ever) I had no idea that a few weeks later I would be discovering my new favorite form of exercise. I'm not talking plain old workout where ya look at the clock every 5 minutes, I'm talking busting ass and having fun while you're at it. 

What's the recipe for burning 500-600 calories in an hour all while smiling? 
-enthusiastic and engaging instructors (all 4 that I have experienced thus far have pulled off the perfect balance of making it fun yet pushing the class to the next level)
-themed rides - I especially enjoyed the Michael Jackson ride (complete with a large video screen and MJ attire)
-great music (that perfectly fits the mixed age group)
-classes that mix spinning with core and arm exercises (weights, bands, etc.)

If my recipe doesn't convince you, maybe the two week $35 special will do the trick? You can take as many classes as you want! Quite the deal and I would venture to say you will be coming back for more after the two weeks end.

I tried Coco Blue today after reading the recent reviews and I honestly could have done a better job painting my nails myself. I stopped in on Sunday afternoon and I was the only customer. The pedicure started fine.  The leg massage was great, which is the only reason I'm giving 2 stars rather than one.  But the tech obviously has trouble staying in the lines. There's polish all over my cuticles and sides of my toes. 

My gel manicure is even worse. Uneven top coat application and they don't even do a full manicure. It was more like a polish change. No soak and cuticle push/trim, just random pulling with the snips. I didn't get the regular duration under the lights before she told me the polish was dry and started spraying the alcohol.  Needless to say the polish was still tacky and the finish is now dull.  The manager even came over to inspect and clean up the application around my cuticles.  All I got was some cuticle oil and was sent on my way.  I'm not sure why there were in such a hurry.  I was the only customer and we finshed with me at 5pm, but they don't close until 6:30.  The techs seemed very interested in doing each other's nails though.  The following morning, my cuticles are torn up and my polish is already lifting from the uneven application.  The manager said I could back back within 3 days if anything happened to my manicure.  Thanks but no thanks.  For $70 for a gel manicure and regular pedicure, I'll stick with Rittenhouse Nails.

Woah, woah, woah. I'm kind of shocked with how many bad reviews there are of this place. I f**king LOVE this place. I met my wife Lynette here. The woman in front of me in line didn't have any cash on her to pay the $20 cover, so I spotted her the money. When we got inside, she hit the ATM and bought me a drink for helping her out. We talked and danced all night. I bought her drinks, she bought me drinks, back and forth. At one point I lost her in the crowd, so I went to the bathroom. Walked into the wrong one, met Lynette, we doinked in the stall, and it was happily ever after from there.

Inventive takes on some Asian classics! Portions are on the smaller side, and service is somewhat slow (we ended up waiting ~20 minutes for our food after we texted them that we arrived).

Shrimp Toast: 4/5
Loved how the outside was crispy and buttery while the inside was fluffy and stuffed full of shrimp. Only thing was that I thought the sweet chili sauce on the side didn't add much.

Tsukemen Dipping Noodles: 4/5
I could tell that the noodles were fresh, and the ajitama (ramen egg) was cooked perfectly. The chicken broth was also packed full of umami flavor and had a decent amount of heat, which I enjoyed. Although the chicken wing was tasty, I couldn't detect much of the scallop. Another thing is that since the noodles were served cold, they stuck together in one big clump, and I had to use my hands to pull them apart.

White Chocolate Kartoffelkage: 5/5
The star of the meal! Wasn't sure what to expect, but this ended up being a giant white chocolate cream puff layered with caramel and surrounded by a thin blanket of marzipan dusted in cocoa powder and sprinkled with candied fruit. All the components complemented each other to make a truly unique dessert.
Great variety, amazing location on the truckee river. Exceptional service, but pricey. Totally recommend the bee sting pizza!

My family has been a fill a bagel supporter for several years. After moving away from Philly, I always try to grab a fill bagel sandwich when in town. Today, venturing into the shop they were almost out of everything. Service was extremely rude, slow, and the someone budged in line and was allowed to budge in line. Still I ordered a bagel with cheese, egg, and sausage. When I finally made it out of the parking lot and back home...I was blocked in the parking lot for several minutes, at home I discovered that I got the wrong order. No sausage on my bagel and they gave me a sesame seed bagel instead of egg. No longer will my family visit this place for a treat. We will be heading to the Village Deli as our sole breakfast sandwich place from now on, where service is quicker with a smile and costs less.

We arrived at 4pm. They tried to set us the furthest table away with one wheel chair and one walker In a party of six finally got a table closer .  Then didn't get our food til 5:35 pm. Service was horrible and never offered us desert .  This was such a disappointment although the food was good . : /

I know I've given this place 5 stars but I can't honestly say I'll eat here again. The atmosphere is nice, kind of pub like. Our waitress was friendly and service was nice. The food selection to us was slim but we're picky so I can't judge them on that. However the description of the food and what they actually bring you is off. I was so thankful I didn't order I  think it was cod. Couple next to me did and it came out on top of this green looking soup. Not what I would have thought based on the menu description. But we ended up with the salmon, which basically was a salad, calamari and a veggie platter. All very tasty and enjoyable. The experience just wasn't enough to bring us back.

So let me just say - I wanted to love this place. I really did. As one of the newest additions to the hopping DTSP scene, No Vacancy has everything to be a dope successful place to go and enjoy cool drinks and good food outside or inside  in cold ac especially in the coming hot months. Now granted, the official "grand opening" isn't until 2-8-19, but from the looks of it, they are super busy and running as if they were opening on the Saturday night I went. 

Upon entry, the place is rather small. Has a maximum occupancy of 49 people I think it was. The bar was PACKED and hopping. The decor beautiful. Old Florida at its finest. Neon lights, flamingos, photos of 80's supermodels etc. Outside is a full patio, with patio heaters , umbrellas and all the cocktail vibes you can want with another bar. This is all great. The service though - that is still to be desired. The guy working behind the bar, while super nice, wasn't ready for Saturday night prime time. My friends and I waited about 30-40 minutes to get drinks and service at the bar. No exaggeration. The guy was by himself and every other time someone would order, he'd have to either look up the recipe on his phone or ask someone else somewhere far from the bar, mind you, on how to make the drink. The bar also was littered with plates and drinks from prior folks, since there wasn't really any one to help at the bar to clean up I don't know if that's the way to run a lounge, even if it's just a "soft" opening on a Saturday night. Especially if it's running at full capacity with people wanting to check out your place and get some drinks as if it was a grand opening. The drinks themselves were a bit watered down and more club sodaish then alcohol. This bar situation definitely needs to be addressed and fixed sooner than later. 

Another bright spot though besides the beautiful decor was the food when it eventually came out. Ordered Alligator Bites and Poolside sliders made of Mojo Pork. Both were cooked well and had great flavor paired with the Garlic Aioli sauce.
Again, the place is beautiful, the decor lovely and the food very good so far. As long as the bar and service picks it up, this place should do good business. Looking forward to coming back when it's got some footing.

I've tried to fall in love with this place, I really have. I love a good burger and beer. Lindy's should be my haven of Tuscon. However, it falls short in some areas. Enough that it'll remain an occasional retreat when I'm craving lots of beef.

Lindy's burgers are good. The beer selection is good. The cheesesteaks are okay. The chicken sandwiches are good. The atmosphere is quirky and is a good reflection of Tucson's underculture. The menu is weird and creative like the decor and everything is executed pretty consistently.  Why the average marks then? Well while most everything is good, there's some bad as well.

Lindy's is small. Very small considering it's popularity. Not really it's fault, but even on a weeknight you very well may be waiting 30 minutes plus for a table. Would be less of a problem if there were a place you could wait comfortably for a table. Alas there isn't and so a hoard of people can often be found wandering about in front of the place. Depending on who you are and your hurry, this can drive you away to find quicker eats.

The service is iffy. I understand it's a busy place, made worse since it's so cramped. It's a dive so I don't expect to be waited on hand and foot, but I do get more attention at Five Guys and In-and-Out for less money.

The prices are okay, depending on what you order. Sides are cheap-ish. Extra patties are actually pretty cheap so load them up. 

While most everything here is consistent, it's almost always consistently "okay". Things are often underseasoned and some of the ingredients are questionable (like Bac-Os instead of real bacon on the loaded fries).  I'm critical of Lindy's because I love a good dive. Lindy's is a good dive but, If one has to venture to busy 4th Ave, wait 45 minutes for service and spend a decent penny, I personally would like something with just a bit more kick-arse to it. Lindy's could easily become this with maybe a bigger space, and some small tweaks to the ingredients and service. All of that said, it's still a favorite of mine, and I hope it gets better with time.

We were seated at a table with a family of four with three in our party. A couple arriving later was seated at the divider and left shortly after they were seated. We waited about 20 minutes with soup and salad before our chef came to the table after taking our cooking preferences the manager came over and asked that the cook move to another table that requested him. He took the tray with our food back to the kitchen with him. I started my timer. It took 11minutes 13 seconds for a new chef to greet our table. I reset my timer and it took 15 minutes and 41 seconds for the chef to cook our food, including cooking preferences, which we of course had to give again to the new guy. 

Wait staff superb, chef excellent, food terrific, manager should look for a new line of work in light of his poor choices.... "sure we can accommodate your chef request as soon as he finishes with the table he is with... you are welcome to begin with sushi and drinks while you wait." Would have been a much better choice than what he did could have driven the ticket price up for that table, too. Fail.

This place is great!  Having lived in Honduras for a couple years, I was familiar with Honduran food going in.  The place was very bright and clean.  Staff was friendly.  I ordered the Baleadas, and they tasted perfectly authentic. The tortillas especially had that home made chewy quality.  I would gladly drive 45 minutes to eat here again!

I still have a soft spot for Tips being the first place I saw live music in New Orleans - 16 years ago? Yikes. Rebirth and Walter Wolfman Washington. Wow. Nothing special as a room really but they do have one of the best line-ups of music any given week.

The Pad Thai is phenomenal! Thai food is my favorite, every time I go to a Thai restaurant I order Pad Thai, this was one of my favorite dishes.  It just depends on the place but some of the restaurants don't offer tea. I ordered the Chrysthathmum tea that has all kinds of health benefits, this is a must if you visit. The tea has vitamin c, caffeine free, natural coolant, detoxifies the liver, rejuvenates the brain and helps ease digestion. I liked it so much that I buy it when I go to the grocery store. 

The staff is friendly and accommodating. This place is new and very clean. I was very impressed with the interior decorating.

They had the two drinks we were craving : mojito and Ramos Gin ! Drinks were delish. Good ambiance.  However I was watching a short video on my phone and was told to turn it down though people were talking even louder than the video. Meh, kinda pissed me off.

Oh Omni, how I wish all hotels were like you. We arrived early Saturday morning and we're able to check in right away. The room was beautiful and had big windows, but the view was not so great. The bathroom was big and has a box shower, toilet, single sink, a lot of counter space and a magnifying mirror. The room had a king bed and a couch. It was decorated very well.

Concierge: we spoke with Lauren and Ryan and both were SO helpful. They each gave us so many great recommendations about Nashville and also got us tickets to the Opry for that night. 

Convenience: there is a car at the hotel which will take you anywhere in the city that's within a 3 mile radius. Our drivers were Joe and Jason and were also so nice and helpful giving us some ideas of where to go and what to do. You just go down to the concierge desk to request the car or you can call a number which they give you upon check in. 

Within the hotel there is a bar (Barlines) which is very good - I have a review for that place - a cool poster shop called Hatch, 2 restaurants (one steakhouse and the other we went to for breakfast but I'm pretty sure they have lunch and dinner there too), a little food shop and the country music hall of fame. 

The hotel is very big and open and all the staff we spoke with was very nice and welcoming.

I sat here on a Thursday 2 months ago and had a spicy tuna roll as well as a Mexican roll. Thursday is $2 off night and it was great. I had miso soup as my appetizer which arrived quickly. Since I sat at the bar the sushi took no time and was great! The Mexican was a refreshing delicious surprise with some lime zest and crunch to it. The spicy tuna also did not disappoint. Service was ok. She was very nice and knowledgeable but when I needed something after my order she was not paying attention or I could not find her. Took me a while to find her when I wanted the check. Nonetheless, I will be back. Probably on Thursday :)
This place is trendy, they have great drinks and lots of draft beers. The service is wonderful and the chicken is AMAZING!!!! I also recommend the mac n cheese....you will not be disappointed!!!

This La Fitness is usually too crowded. There aren't enough machines. The equipment is old. The ladies' locker room is way too small. I have been to 2 Clearwater locations, the Tyrone location and this one. This is the closest to my house, but unfortunately, it is also my least favorite.

We came in on Saturday night and it was busy. Not overwhelmingly busy but busy enough to have people waiting at the door. I was a little confused because they had a lot of empty tables yet people were still waiting outside to be seated. Our server was friendly but she seemed a bit overwhelmed herself. We sat down and quickly ordered. It took us a while to get our meals. I ordered the 7 oz steak and my husband ordered the pulled chicken and chicken wings. I ordered my steak medium well but it seemed like the steak was on the well done side. I should've just asked for medium if that was the case. Sizes were fair for the price I'll give it that. My mom hated her dish. It was presented on a bbq grill which was basically for presentation but the food was not hot. It's like an illusion in the pictures advertised because they made it seem like it was so much food when it wasn't. It should've come with 2 sides instead of one.  Overall, the food was just ok. It's not something i would be bragging about. They do have better specials during the week like i wanna say all you can eat tacos on Wednesday's.  If you're curious, check it out.

Last night I finally tried out the "Master" room. I was not overly impressed. Our host was fine and nice but didn't have much accumen for the task. The video barely explained the room concept. The instructions were scant. 

At several times, we asked for clues but the radios weren't working correctly and we had to wait for an answer. Some of the items in the room were showing their age and did not work correctly (I don't want to give anything away). This is my biggest complaint about a puzzle room. 

My other complaint is when puzzles have little way to logic through. Several times we just found ourselves guessing at things or needing clues. One riddle was just poorly constructed. Even after being given the answer, it still made little sense. 

I wasn't impressed by this room.

Man, I wish there is a Mexican restaurant like this in my neck of the woods! Everything on their menu is great quality and very tasty. My kids had the enchiladas and they just devoured them in minutes. My wife is a finicky eater and she even devoured her seafood burrito. She even said that this is her new favorite Mexican food, which is a shocker. Every time we are SB, we always stop here for lunch and Los Agaves never disappoint!
The absolute best wings I had in NOLA. Strong drinks and the Cuban wraps are fantastic too. Great spot. Will definitely return.

Let me start out by saying that the food was excellent as was the service. My main issue was that it was grossly overpriced. You are definitely paying for the name here.

We all decided on the price fixed dinner which included a salad (honestly nothing special), pasta with meatballs and sausage and a ricotta cheese pie dessert. The pasta was fresh, the meatballs both very large and delicious and the sausage could be cut with a fork. However, any way you slice it - it was still pasta, meatballs and sausage for $140.00 for four people. I am not sure what else I was hoping to get for the price, but that in my mind was a little over the top. The total tab including (1) beer or wine for each of us and coffee was $230.00 including tip.

Liquor and beer lists are somewhat limited though I felt the prices there were reasonable. The place was almost empty when we got there at 5:30 - perhaps 50% full when we left around 7:00 on a Sunday night.

Love the outdoor garden in back!  Cheese plates were great and the truffle egg salad was delish.  

Won't deduct a star but "no splitting bills across multiple credit cards?"  Is it 1997?

Excellent food and great people. The Spot's fresh hand-roasted coffee is some of the best I have tasted, and if you are really hungry, this is the place to go for a hearty breakfast or amazing sandwich. The menu is creative, the ingredients fresh, and every order is hand-made with care.  The staff is friendly and accommodating.

Everything we tried here was delicious. We especially enjoyed the Bruiser (bacon & bleu cheese burger); Tatonka (sriracha fried chicken sandwich); and Manslayer (breakfast burrito). The portions are more than generous and the flavors are huge. Definitely worth a stop anytime you find yourself in St Pete.

This is for the NEW Capriccio that opened near Love Park.

So far so good - my 4 year old and I have been here 3 times and had ice cream and chocolate covered pretzels and milk for snacks.  She loves it here and usually when we come iot's pretty mpty.

It is brand spankin' new - and the bathroom (ask for a key) is still clean and fit for use.

It has pretty much the same menu as the Old Capriccio on 17th Street.

The manager, Liz, is really nice and has a son about my dd's age so that's cool.  I wish them much success.  Hope they can keep in clean and new looking.

I love BBQ and enjoyed the half rack, baked beans and slaw but it was nothing great as a lot of reviews led me to believe. The mild sauce was ok but had a very ketchup taste. 
The ribs were tasty and tender and fell of the bone. The baked beans were the best part of my meal.  Seasoned very well and not just beans covered with BBQ sauce. 
Atmosphere is the very trendy warehouse/old gas station feel. Service was fine. 

It's a good place to try and see for yourself.

This is such a neat museum, a definite must for anyone who's visiting Philadelphia, wither with or without kids. Even as an adult, this museum will bring out the child in you. 

We got here right around when it opened, it didn't look crowded from the outside, but once we got inside, there were screaming kids and parents everywhere. I definitely enjoyed the electricity, body and brain exhibitions. Didn't get to see the Jurassic World exhibition, as the line was ridiculously long. 

Would definitely visit here again in the near future!

I just got C & B's via Order Up Delivery Svc and what a perfect wintry in home dinner. I ordered the Swanky Frank w/ fries and completely enjoyed my loaded up frank. The fries had a little seasoning on them which added a nice touch. I also ordered a lg bowl of beef chili just because I had to have some chili from a chili house. It was nicely pkg'd and I plan on having a late night snack w/some chili later. I requested the sour cream and crackers on the side for warming. I would 100% suggest using Order Up for some cozy chili at home this winter!
The sushi was very good. The ramen was okay but I wouldn't go back for it i would go back for the sushi.  Very nice on the inside

One of the best targets in the area. Some of the nicest staff I've ever met. The Electronics department is top notch. One of the gentlemen there was just outstanding at his job. I think his name started with a j or something.
I could eat at this restaurant daily. Love the food. The dining areas are nice. Lots of craft beers to choose from. One of my favorites in Hendersonville.

My husband & I stayed one night 9/11/21-9/12/21.  The was a black garbage bag at "our" door upon arrive....wasn't going to look in it!  The door was dirty inside, the carpet had food crumbs under the chairs...edges of carpet haven't been vacuumed for a long time...(I have pictures to show all of this) ....not sure how much vacuuming was done even in the easy access areas...the bedding was stained on top and on the sheets, didn't take a shower because there was mold and mildew in the tub and tile....lastly,
there was hair in the coffee maker water holder...needless to say....I wouldn't recommend for ANYONE!

I went to Bubba Gumps with 2 friends. We got there at 8:05pm on a Thursday night. We walked up to the hostess stand and asked for a table. We were told they were not seating any more people for the night. Was very surprised since they stay open until 9pm. I won't make that mistake again.

Not that Royal Tavern needs another glowing review, but I'll put my two cents in. Whenever I have friends or family in from out of town, I take them to the tavern. Love the burger, love the hummus plate (I make everyone try it), love the sauce that comes with the fries. The pomegranate sangria is delicious. Beer selection is incredible. Brunch isn't too bad either, but given the choice, I'd go for dinner. Atmosphere is spot on. (Can we talk about their gorgeous carved-wood bar back?) Reasonably priced. Go early! It fills up fast.

Always happy with the service that I get from team at Fancy Fingers. It was the first place that I have tried SNS at and the product is really good and lasts well. Don't think I will visit any other nail salon.

This salon has a friendly staff. However they never have enough staff for walk ins! I have been there many occasions and was told we are busy today. Open chairs and not enough staff. Very frustrating! I went to a new salon and found they have more hygiene precautions and do a much better job with more detail! Too bad! This salon is in my neighborhood.! Yet I now drive 2 more miles for a welcome and nice salon results.

My family and I walk in and don't get passed the door.  We are stopped by the owner, he asks how old my youngest child is.  After I tell him 7 he says he cannot have patrons under 8 years old.  He states that is due to his insurance policy.  They he proceeds to walk away.  

Needless to say we are not white. 

We did look at his website, which reads he cannot patronize under 7. 

Disturbing.

I have been using Gateway for more than 25 years and have never had a single problem with any work they have performed and this includes all of my prior company trucks. Nick and his guys are fantastic.

I had heard about this place and was very pleased with the service/ price and the atmosphere.

The chicken was great.

This is a great car service on all accounts.  Both our drivers to the airport and return home were very friendly and right on time.  Helped with our luggage, provided us with water, and just made our experience so awesome!

OMG
OMG
OMG

Sooooo worth the wait. May go back tomorrow. I got the Coops Sampler platter. I would have taken a picture but they will almost kick you out if caught using your cell phone. 

Did I saw OMG. oMG. oMG enough?!?!?

My dinner companion got fried chicken. Again, amazing. And the prices are beyond reasonable. Worth the wait and the price. 

I may got back tomorrow to try something else.

The joy of Lil' Pop Shop is in its novelty. I sampled the goat cheese, apple, and rosemary pop and the earl grey and black pepper pop. Both were absolutely delicious. The flavors were very subtle and nuanced - a welcome change from classic popsicles and ice cream flavors. Definitely worth a try!

I use to love this place, however it has gone down hill. Last week my fiancé and I went there for dinner. We both ordered shrimp fajitas. While my fiancé was eating he bit down on a metal wire. It cut the inside of his mouth. The owner came over and apologized. Then I found a piece of meat that WAS NOT SHRIMP. The owner came back over and gave me an excuse. I would never go back to this restaurant again.

I have been coming here for many years, and this past visit will be my last. The food was bland, overcooked, and had no flavor. The NY strip steak had no taste, and the Bernaise sauce was terrible. The bacon wrapped steak bites were over cooked with no flavor. The service was not good either. No one bothered to ask how our food was once we got it, and we never received one of our sides.  Also, having Celine Dion blast in your ears while eating an expensive steak dinner is not enjoyable.

We have been to this location many times and unfortunately it doesn't seem to get any better. We usually sit in the bar area, and the service is lacking to say the least. They were not that busy, service was slow, wings were over cooked, had to ask for silverware. Very disappointed. Poor management.

I attended a novac noff event last night at this restaurant not knowing what to expect. Was utterly amazed at the size of venue and its asthetically appealing design very classy yet homey feeling. Great flat screens at bar to watch the saints destroy the dirty birds along with super hospitable bartenders and servers. Now I guess the important things the food.excellent!!!!!! Try the sliders amazing try the bread pudding with sweet and spicy syrup try the debris fries to die for! Will be recommending all over town and to all of out of towers that get in my uber!

Excellent meal (Alligator wings, Cajun Farmhouse Sausage Wontons, Stuffed jalapenos, Scallops & Shrimp (a special), Chargrilled Rabbit, pot du creme, pecan pie), and fine, gracious & attentive service. 

A few quibbles (they had run out of a few dishes by 7:30pm (hey, I guess these things happen); the room tends to get very loud; the bleu cheese shoestring potatoes with the rabbit seemed a strange pairing (but the ONLY culinary misfire of the meal)) but nothing that would keep me from going back.

All is forgiven :-)
I never leave disappointed. I usually get gel for my nails and they always seem to have new colors. Great people giving great service, offering alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks. Love this place.

My second visit proved disappointing. I took my food to go, or I would have complained there. Fries needed more cooking (I think they hurried them), and the strawberry milk shake, woefully thin, I was able to suck down the whole thing, in less than ten minutes. I prefer to "eat" some of my shake...as in super thick. 8.54 for the two items, was too much. Also, I feel, adding an extra bag with ketchup and napkins is wasteful!!!  NEXT!!!
Great stop for a lunch. Got the Swedish meatballs and I piece of almond pie. All was delicious.
Really good tasting pizza! Being from Chicago and being a true pizza snob I give this place 5 stars. Try it out. I would and do recommend it.

Short rib burger excellent! $11.00 though? Plus an extra $1.00 to change from chips to fries? $12.00 burger... Great selection of beers. Most are expensive - $6 range. But they actually had a special on all Yards beers tonight $4 per... Bartenders and waitresses good. 
Need better variety of food. Too much overpriced junk food and slim selection of healthy foods. Great place to drink beer though.
Amazing! Great food, selection varies and has something for everyone. Mango Martini  highly suggest it! Service is on point! Definitely make a visit and see how much you don't regret it!!
Clean and comfortable rooms. Hot, hot, hot water temperature (love)! Easy access to freeway and free wi-fi.

On Sunday May 25 we rented two Kayaks from Sweetwater in Weedon Preserve. Check in was quick and easy. You aren't going to get a warm and fuzzy feeling from them. They are crazy busy getting kayaks in and out of the water. What you will get is a well oiled machine and they will get you in a kayak quickly. We were given a map showing us how to get to the trail. The trail was beautiful and with easy paddling can be done in about 3 hours. The $40 rental is for 4 hours so you will have time to explore on your own. When we returned it was fairly easy getting out. There wasn't an official check in procedure which for safety reasons concerned me. We pretty much just called out our name. What if no one heard? What if someone forgot? At the end of the day if two kayaks are missing who is actually missing if you don't have people sign back in? This is why they lose a star. When you have people out on the water who are more than likely inexperienced you need to care for their safety a little better. We made it back safe and sound and had a great time though. I recommend.

Delicious! I'm here in STL from SD for work and had come on a recommendation from a coworker. I ordered the calzone and at first sight, this thing was intimidating and huge - took up a little over half of my plate! The taste: their calzone was on point. Especially the dough. It was like nothing I have ever had before, for real dough. Heh. Heh. It is the creation of the Gods. Dip it in their marinara sauce, and you almost forget your are eating alone! (my situation... & I hate eating alone).

I'd like to start out by first saying the staff who checked us in and the valet staff were always so friendly and funny. The hotel looks to be nice and in a good location.

As far as the negatives go, the beds had pillows with other people's hair still there. I know because as a black woman with curly hair the hairs found were long and blondish. I called and asked the front desk to bring more pillow cases which never came. We ended up falling asleep without the pillows that had hair on them.

Another issue is the hotel needs a bit of work. The old world charm would be nice if things didn't need repair: cracked missing grout in the tub area, the curtains were hanging on by a thread, the closet door is broken, and the bathroom door has obvious water damage at the bottom. Also there isn't a need for two refrigerators. This is simple maintenance and upkeep that is expected for a more prestigious city. 

Lastly, bugs in the bathroom. It looked like two roaches in the tub, one on the floor and another fell out of the towels. This should not occur with proper pest control and maintenance.

My next return to Santa Barbara would probably be at another hotel.

OMG! This pizza is amazingly delicious. I read the reviews and it seems the Chicago style is the people's fave, so that's what I went with. I was skeptical because most Chicago style pizzas aren't fully cooked and gummy in the center. Not this one! This pizza was fire! Perfectly cooked all the way through. Premium ingredients. Loaded. I ordered the 10" with pepperoni, sausage, bacon, mushrooms, garlic, jalapeños, onion and bell pepper. I could only eat one slice. I am full. I am satisfied. And, I will be back.

The Wife and I have been looking for a nice pizza place like we had in Seattle and we found it here. The service was great and the food was top notch. Food came out quick and was very hot and flavors really popped in your mouth. The place is very small and quaint but if your neighbor smells of smoke or has decided to put the whole bottle of perfume on it can make you want to pack up and finish your meal at home.

Great place to stay. Had a service dog they had no problem letting stay their too. They didn't ask for papers or proof so made it fairly simple. 
I would recommend this place to others, lack of parking, and not an exactly spic and span clean room...
Other then that great customer service and good prices.

I've been looking forward to revisiting Park Cafe & was not disappointed!! This place is yummy!! The arugula salad with fresh blueberries was delicious & the barrata fresh mozzarella & heirloom tomatoe salad was wonderful as well! Fantastic wine list keeps me coming back!

I visited Craft Street with my in-laws for the first time when they were in town this past weekend for a wedding.  I've been meaning to try it out since they opened, so this seemed like a good opportunity.  

The décor was amazing.  Brick walls, mason jar chandeliers, and a large, beautiful bar area were the first things I noticed.  We had to wait a few moments to be seated because they were starting to get busy.  The hostesses were very friendly and sat us as soon as there was a table ready.  (We sat inside, but there is also a nice outside seating area).  Our server was also wonderful and took great care of us.  We ordered the Meatloaf Sliders and Buffalo Cauliflower for appetizers......so good!  I had the Craft Street Salad for my entrée.....loved the dressing on it! Nice and fresh salad - it was also very large.  We definitely didn't leave hungry!  

Sadly, there was no room for dessert, so I'll have to go back again!  On a side note, the bathrooms were also very clean....I'm very picky about restaurant bathrooms.   All-in-all, great place, and I'll definitely be going back again!

US Airways customer service is terrible! I asked the lady at the counter if I could move up my flight since the earlier flight had plenty of seats available and she replied " yes, for 75.00 dollars extra" I could not believe how she responded to me! If you have empty seats why would you charge your customers more? I already paid for a ticket! This will be my last flight with them! JetBlue all the way next time!

Looks good from the outside...the Looby is nice looking too ..the breakfast is good ...but the room was .....old ...the carpet looked old and dirty ... I would have not stayed at this hotel had I been alone but traveling with the family is a little complicated so I choose to stay .. there were no plates or cups In the room just the normal hotel stuff like coffee machine , microwave and refrigerator ...the view was good but the room ..I don't know how the other roomIn the hotel are but ours was not a hotel quality room ..

What a lucky find. Came across this coffee truck yesterday by chance and had an amazing Americano. Came back again today for another because it was so good.  I will definitely be frequenting Spaddy's for my caffeine fix.

Simply put amazing! Great wine selection and dishes. The chefs and waitstaff were fabulous. Probably the best view of the arch in the city. We were able to take some awesome pictures from their rooftop balcony.

I bought my 2017 Hyundai Elantra about a year n a half ago at Brandon Honda just down the road as part of the "1st time buyer program". It was a little beat up cosmetically, but they told me I could trade it in for anything I wanted after 6 months of consistent and on time payments. The best part was that it was still under warranty for like 18-ish thousand more miles! I ended up dropping It off multiple times because the engine/drive train was acting REALLY weird. The first time I dropped it off, they told me it was because I was riding around town and did NOT have it in "Eco mode ". The second time I dropped it off, they told me it was because I was riding around town IN "Eco-mode".  The third time they just plain out wouldn't take it. And then my warranty was up... Now I'm sitting here at 82,000-ish miles and the motor is completely shot in my car does not work at all... Then I discovered that Hyundai has a drivetrain warranty of 100,000 miles... I was never told any of this by anybody at this company I had to find out on my own... Now here I have been calling them for the last two hours straight and their receptionist, Jordan, answers the phone every 10 times I call the other nine times she answers then quickly transfers it to a voicemail of someone who is probably not even in the office... Then I called back seven more times in order for her to answer and plain out told her, you know I can hear you picking up the phone and transferring it to a voicemail? I know you're probably at the end of your workday and very aggravated too much I am equally if not more aggravated at the fact that I have a car I dropped off with y'all three times for the problem that has now caused my car to become completely unusable and broken down... To which she replies oh you need the financial department right? I say yes and she transferred me to a another voicemail!!! ...of get this,  not even Hyundai- the Nissan dealership next-door!!! I still have yet to be able to talk to anybody in the entire building that can answer my questions about the drivetrain warranty even though I just looked up the information of Courtesy Hyundai and they don't even close until 9 PM! If I could possibly talk to any other place about my problems, I would! I would not recommend using this location to anybody on the planet! My experience has been absolutely the worst experienceI've had in my life, no exaggeration whatsoever!

There are two kinds of Circle Ks. One type is the newer stores aspiring to be a Race Trac but falling a bit short. The other type is older stores in need of renovation, sometimes desperately so. At least this one isn't desperate but it does need a lot of help.

The gas pumps are obsolete and often out of service. If you decide to pay at the pump there is a fairly good chance you'll have to go inside for a receipt.

At some point they added to the sidewalk on the west side of the building possibly to allow room for vending machines. The new concrete is uneven with unfinished edges and generally looks like it was done by a 7 year old whose only prior construction experience is with Play Doh.

Credit for inside cleanliness though. On my last visit the store was clean. Some areas of the floor were freshly mopped. However no "Wet Floor" warning device was present.

Circle K is the king of super cheap fountain drinks. Fortunately the drink I prefer wasn't in one of the four out of service dispensers. And I'm glad I didn't need gas on this visit. As is often the case there were multiple people in line trying to get a position for the far too few pumps.

It seems Circle K doesn't realize that with a chain all stores are reflection on all others in the chain.

What a cool little place on Beach Drive, I stopped in the other day while walking on beach drive. I noticed a lot of diners on the patio and it looked like a cool little place. Although, I wasn't really hungry I figured this would be a cool spot to chill for a few, read the paper, people watch and grab a coffee. I ordered a cappuccino and an order of bigne's. Ahhhhhh, the angels started singing as I ate my hot sweet treat with powdered sugar, sipped on my cappuccino, and watched the lovely women in tight pants jog on by. All day, all day......

Best of the best.  It will knock the socks off any Home Depot.  As a matter of fact, it is in a different class altogether.  Apparently this locally-owned store cares about their employees so they keep their staff.  You can get to know the staff here and listen to their tips and product recommendations and develop a sense of trust in your home repair needs.

One thing - if you're following a GPS, most of the GPS directions lead you about a half a mile away from where the store really is.  I made a manual change to mine.

The upstairs is devoted to gardening, light electrical, cleaning, etc.  The downstairs, which has its own separate entrance, is the heavy duty construction and gardening area.

No need to run to box stores when you have a gem like this in the area.

I enjoy the reliable and yummy sandwich and soup from Panera from time to time and really like that they have a drive-thru! This location has proved on many visits that I have to go inside and order, then check that all is there- and request things that had already been asked for again ... ugh... I no longer use the drive thru because it's not convenient if I have to park after the fact to get things missing from the bag .
so the food is good but attention to detail lacking...

My wife and I like to venture and try new restaurants, most of the times we follow other reviews on Yelp to help make our decision.  With that said we tried Seafood Unlimited anyway and found out why the place losing customers and why they had such low reviews.  These are my 3 issues with the place....(please read, this may help save your life or at least trips to the bathroom)

1. We had the seafood pasta and their lobster special (I'll get to the seafood pasta in a bit).  As we are finishing our meal the chef comes out of the kitchen and proceeds to apologize on the phone with a customer from the night before, in the middle of the restaurant.  He is apologizing to the customer for getting sick on the lobster special he ate the other night and how his entire family spent the night in the bathroom.  Did I mention that my wife and I were just finishing our lobster special?  Seriously? Does that conversation need to take place right there for everyone in the restaurant to hear?  We were lucky and did not get sick but I don't have to tell you what a negative impression that left. 

2. The seafood pasta only had shrimps and scallops.  Anytime I ever had seafood pasta from any seafood restaurant, it had more than two seafood ingredients and I'm counting my corner pizzeria that happens to serve seafood pasta.  The pasta was ok but it lacked the seafood flavor and I guess I know why. I think it's a very expensive dish especially when you only have two ingredients....I could have done better, the pizzeria around the corner certainly does. 

3. Appetizer and desert.  We had the fried mussels...it lacked flavor as if it was precooked and not fresh.  Desert was $6 and was super tiny.  

I would not recommend this place especially for the price you are paying.  Employees were nice enough but lacked the attention to detail and missed on providing some added service we saw other tables received.  If you decide to go....be warmed.  Did I tell you about the lobster?

We were there early and asked to be seated in the party room, was told that party room was reserved but we couldn't get the other party room cause we can't reserve it?!!   Then she would speak Chinese to the waitress and was cursing at us in front of our kids cause she was frustrated or something.  We had a party of 15 and would not leave a dollar here for a business like this ever again. Needless to say we left and would not be back!  Food is mediocre at best.
Great for taking out or dining in.  Very friendly, quick service, and super food.  Reasonable prices, too.  I have tried several dishes here and have yet to be disappointed.
Hyatts are the way to go, champagne at check in and a great room to boot. It doesn't hurt that is staff is friend and location is great. Favorite hotel in Tampa.

Can't look up reviews on Yelp and not pick the one with 5 stars!

Everyone says get the grouper sandwich. It is really good and I really don't like fish. It's a very mild fish. The hubs says he liked the blackened better than my fried but I'm not a fan of all things blackened. 

The fries are really good too!  They are coated in a batter and sprinkled with Parmesan!  So yummy. 

Oh it's a cute fish shack and the bathroom is really clean!

If I could give 0 stars I would. The Cadence is a money suck where the staff does not care about you, the maintenance is slow, and the maintenance done is poor quality. There is no communication from staff, I was not even emailed move out procedures. When I moved out (DURING THE COVID PANDEMIC) they made no accommodations to safety for the tenants, but rather did construction work making hallways smaller, or closed. During moving out I asked for a moving bin as we had used during move-in, but I was told that they won't even do that because "We actually don't help with move-out" If you are considering living here, don't even bother checking it out. Completely NOT WORTH IT.

My boyfriend bought a car here a month ago.  He traded in two cars and paid cash for a used Hyundai Santa Fe.  They gave him less than book value for the one car, but it wasn't too far off.  They have a three day return policy or 30 day exchange policy.  Our mechanic checked out the car and told us the ball bearing needed to be replaced.  Fred Beans gave him a rental while they did the work.    He was having some issues with the Santa Fe, it was him, not the SUV.  He went back to the dealership after three weeks.  After test driving a few vehicles, they put a dealer tag on a Kia Sportage.  He drove that for a few days and then exchanged for that SUV.  No problem.  No hidden fees.  I'm not sure how easy it would have been, had he financed.  I was impressed by how accommodating they were and how easy it was.  They gave him the amount he paid for the Santa Fe, towards the Sportage.

Side note:
ONE complaint about the rental.  They called on a Saturday to say he needed to bring the rental back for another, because the insurance on the rental was going to expire the next day.  Seriously?  THAT was ridiculous.

Cute Italian market/deli place. Came across this place while yelping for a place for lunch. We got some sandwiches to go and some cold side dishes. Prices are pretty reasonable. Oh and don't forget the dessert bar! Just walking by it made my mouth water! YUM!

There's a seating area outdoor but if it's too hot, there are limited seating inside by the coffee bar. Inside the market, there's also a cheese and wine room where they have assortment of cheeses and friendly staff there to answer all your cheese and wine questions :)

Terrible. Just terrible. I took my car in because the check engine was on and Ricardo said it was the cats and it would cost $2,300 to fix!! 30 seconds later he went down to $1,200. Is that even possible? C'mon man. Be honest. I checked online and it was 850$ for the OEM cats. Then Rick came and said he could clean them to get the check engine to turn off. So I gave them the car and when I came to pick it up, THEY TOOK MY FOG LIGHTS!! And Rick said they fell out during a test drive. REALLY? ARE YOU KIDDING ME? If they fell out you would've ran over them and popped the front tires. THEN HE SAID "so you're calling me a theif" WELL IF THE SHOE FITS! Ricardo gave me $50 off the price which was pretty decent. Overall, TERRIBLE SERVICE. ONE STAR BUDDY.

Maybe its just me, other people staying at the nearby hotel seemed to enjoy this spot for its value and serving sizes as well as convenience, but I had very little interest in any of the items I tried.  While they provide large portions I found the items I received tasting more of heavy grease than actual flavors of meat. (I got the Chicago style steak sandwich). In my personal opinion the sandwich quality appears to resemble that of a subway sandwich, only it takes triple the length to receive, and the steak and vegetables look as if they've sat in the sun to dry.  The fries were good, and cannot comment on the quality of their pizzas.

This place is huge. Private parking lot with side entrance right into Starbucks. Once up the escalators, you walk onto a drink bar, towards the right into the produce section and it goes on pending which direction you move towards.

Prices are reasonable and lots of fresh ingredients. The plus side about this place is the dine in food court and drinks. It is definitely somewhere to shop and grab a bite.

They also have a wine and beer section. Pretty nice selection. Bakery is small but right next to the charcuterie area. Pretty cool.

I've been waiting for this location to open for a long time and made it my business to visit on opening day. Unfortunately, I wasn't very happy with the experience. The staff was excellent, but the line was pretty long to only have one open register taking orders (no biggie). The disappointment came with the food itself. Other BonChon locations "cook to order". I wasn't expecting that here as foot traffic is expected to be much much higher. I did expect the wings to be pretty much precooked and waiting to be boxed......and for the most part, it was. I only waited about 4 minutes for my 20 wings as opposed to 30 minutes to an hour at other locations. That being said, I did not expect the wings to be barely warm, pretty dry and have minimal sauce brushed on them. Total letdown (and On-Line or call-ahead ordering was not available). I'm gonna have to stick with the Cherry or 39th Street Philadelphia locations even though I can't stand driving down there. The free t-shirt was the best part of the visit.

Maybe it's just opening day mishaps. If so, I'm sorry to have been apart of it and would've requested a refund if I could. I wish this location the best as it is in a prime location. Provide a fresh, hot and properly sauced product as your fellow locations do and it'll be a hit.
Service is butts. Rude and arrogant. Food was good but I'd rather rub my face on some whit poop than deal with this service again

If I could give 0 stars, I would.  This place absolutely sucks a big donkey salami.  The installation was not done as they explained, the sales guy had halitosis and spoke in ebonics, the product is mediocre,  and they put a large hole in the dash with a screwdriver and are denying any wrongdoing.  They won't warranty their work and they have no return policy.  Do yourself a huge favor; avoid audio express at all costs.

Love the Joint and Dr. Brownley! The Joint has totally changed my life. The first time I went in I needed a cane to walk, after my very first adjustment though I walked out without it and although I have had a few relapses, haven't had to use the cane now for months. I have multiple medical issues including Lupus, Fibromyalgia, Degenerative Disc Disease and Straight Neck Syndrome. I've been under chiropractic care for most of my life as it's one of the best drug-free ways that I've found (in addition to yoga) to manage my pain and various conditions and keep me in motion. I've never made as much as progress though as I have at The Joint. With traditional chiropractic I often wasn't able to see my doctors when I really needed to because I had to schedule appointments and at times wait 3-4 days or longer to see a doctor. All while in severe pain, having migraines and sometimes unable to get out of bed. The Joint has completely changed that for me though! I can now get care whenever I need it. The ladies in the office are great and super-helpful! I really liked Dr. Mohsen, when he was there, but love Dr. Brownley, he is awesome! Have been a patient for 9 months and will definitely keep going weekly to keep my health in check! It makes all the difference in the world for me! Can't recommend them highly enough!

You can't go wrong with a balcony on Bourbon.  You can get much better prices a block down at the ER, but you don't come here for a good drink or even a good deal.  You want the view and you want the giant beer mug.  Come early to get your spot on Saturday nights or during Mardi Gras.  This is one of those places on Bourbon that you can tell someone to meet you and you know exactly where to go.

Alex was the best! She was the sweetest and most helpful we could ask for. On top of all that, she was patient and gave us the exact custom shirts we wanted! 

She also helped us gave us great ideas on what to put and we went with it, and they turned out great! The nephews and grandpa are going to love their new custom shirts! 

Will be back and highly recommend asking for Alex to help design and print your custom clothes! She was measuring it all properly to make sure it would look great!

Thanks ALEX!

Over salted food and just OK service. We use to love it here but every time we come it just gets worse. Their regulars will keep them open and busy but don't let it fool you. You can get better somewhere else. And don't even bother trying the sushi.

Adequate. A good bargain to jump on when they publish their 2 for $16 deal coupon deal. The pizza is average for the area, well prepared and not overly Americanized/greasy like Ardmore pizza and Boston pizza but it lacks the quality of brick oven or board walk pizza.

Cheekwood is one of my favorite places to visit in Nashville. It's a wonderful treasure this city has that embraces art, history, nature, and community. Nationally known artist have displayed there work at Cheekwood other indoors and out. Learn about the history of Cheekwood while visiting the art museum in the mansion.

If you are a local, I recommend getting a membership. Admission is pricey, but a membership will allow to come back to experience the different seasons at Cheekwood. The gardens are filled with beautiful, colorful tulips in the spring. In the fall you can enjoy their harvest season and their big Dias Los Muertos festivals. It's a nice, safe place to enjoy taking walks. 

Do note that occasionally members will have to pay fees for special events, but with a discount. An example of this is the Lights in the winter and yoga in the gardens in spring and summer. There are many free family and kid activities throughout the year. You can add a guest feature to your membership and bring a interchangeable person with you on your visits.

Cheekwood offers different gardens and building for rent for weddings. It's also a lovely place for proposals. Be appreciate of their volunteers. Many devote a lot of time and care to making experiences at Cheekwood great!

The Pineapple Room restaurant is nice. Be aware that if you are not a member you will need to pay admission to eat at the Pineapple Room, even if you don't plan on touring the gardens.

This place was amazing. I'm not 100% sure, but I think we had four custom cocktails. We didn't look at a menu, just asked the bartender what he would recommend if we like whiskey and he started making the drinks! Normally I would be scared, but everyone around the bar looked really happy with what they were drinking so we just went with it. All four of us tried the four drinks he created and I ended up with a ginger martini drink that was absolutely amazing. 

I didn't get the chance to eat the food, but it looked good to me. Their menu has some very interesting selections. We had some of their bread while we waited and that was really good.
Delicious gem in Media that we stumbled upon. Definitely will be going back frequently. Had short rib paperdelle, crab cakes, and creme brûlée cheesecake. All was amazing!

There aren't a lot of rock clubs in NOLA. In the Big Easy, it's all about jazz/r&b. So, for the few clubs/bars that do offer something different, I tip my hat. One Eyed Jacks traffics in touring indie bands, local DJ nights and even burlesque shows! The Dazed On Toulouse nights mix up 70s pop, classic rock and even prog tunes. Divey, spooky, historical - ditch those clubs on Bourbon and head over here!
Excellent service and food. Very good beer selection, salads and a diverse selection for pizza toppings!

I love this place! The tequila selection is great, and the food is even better. I've never had bad service either, gotta love the table-side guacamole. Courtney was our server and took excellent care of us. Try the pork tacos, you won't be disappointed!

I've been wanting to visit Phillys Magic Garden for years! This was the highlight of my trip! Hard to believe this use to be an empty plot of land filled with garbage and used to create something so beautiful! From the mosaics to the hand carved detailed and the functional bike chandelier everywhere you looked was astounding. We had someone who worked there that provided background information as well as the artist. She mentioned he does stop by and work on site. Perhaps you will be lucky to meet him.
These are some huge donuts. That have a great taste that make you come back every morning and try them all.

Came down to SB for business and decided to check out some eateries downtown. Despite using navigation, The Habit is tucked in from the other shops on State St so it may be a challenge to locate.

Charburger w/ Cheese
- Fresh and tasty, although not out of this world tasty!

Onion Rings
- Slightly over-fried

The Vanilla shake was delicious but super heavy... I tossed out half the shake in an effort to not double in size! ;)

By far the best time I, and my son, had the entire stay at Treasure Island. Even Parasailing didn't come close. Thanks for the great time, conversation memories and laughs. All this and I don't even drink alcohol !

Bustling indoor food court with very attentive staff cleaning the tables between customers. There's a nice variety of food including Middle Eastern, American, and your typical New Orleans fare. The barbecue shrimp and grits were flavorful and the shrimp is very fresh. Clean restrooms and restaurant.

I have been to the Frist a number of times for all different kinds of exhibits since it opened, and I have never been disappointed. I simply want more. I love love love the architecture!  Be sure to snag a pamphlet at the front. It explains the history and the symbolism behind some of the detailing. It also explains that the Frist was originally Nashville's head post office and is now on the National Register of Historic Places, which helps you cut them slack on the limited space. Just be mindful of the exhibit schedule. If part of it is closed, it may not feel there's not much to see.

The museum has a nice flow and everyone who works there is helpful and friendly. They have a cafe and an open outdoor area for when the weather is nice. Its a very relaxing place all together. There is also an area upstairs for kids which helps keep even tiny visitors entertained.  Parking is convenient, but closes when the building does so you will have to move your car if you plan on exploring the area into the night.

We wanted convenience and family friendly while hoping to try some local fare (our first time here) and not even being that hungry- not an easy combo to handle,  haha. 

We stopped at Grand Isle and enjoyed a wonderful service staff- we were eating an early dinner (6) so the place was pretty quiet still.  We decided on the alligator "wings" appetizer with three of us just ordering a dinner salad with onion rings to share and one of us ordered the alligator po boy. Everything was tasty but we were especially delighted to learn that we love alligator! 

4 stars for great food, location, service- decked 1 star for small selection. 

As a side note to NOLA cuisine - I'm kinda surprised at how try hard everything is and the $$$ associated with it. I'd love to find a place that provides the local tasty foods that isn't all fried or all decked out into oblivion. Does it exist?! We'll see.

So I went here for Haste The Day's last show last Friday. This place is pretty big. I got up in the second row and I could see ok. The sound was good, and the staff on my side were nice. Didn't really stop anyone from doing anything. I would've given this place 5 stars until I heard about the staff on the other side piratically abusing the crowd. Pushing people for no real reason. Someone even got the police called on them for crowd surfing and bumping into a security guard. I heard they also thew someone off the stage and all the way into the pit once and they got a concussion. So yeah, some of the staff are nice, but some really aren't.
Oh and they have the best phone reception I've ever had at a show.
Donuts are well known, but I've learned a valuable lesson about this location....open the box and check it before leaving.  It's a bummer to get home with a dozen of the wrong item.

Came in on a late Sunday afternoon to grab a bite and it was pretty packed.  We were able to grab a table outside pretty easily, though.  Given how busy they were it was refreshing that our server was quick to come out and get drink and food orders and came back quite a bit to check on all her tables outside.  

I ended up having the mild shake and bake wings and they were some of the best wings that I've had.  They also accommodated my drums only request, which can be pretty rare when ordering wings.  This place ranks as one of the best sports bars in the downtown area and I can see why after my visit.  Make sure you try the wings if you stop in here!
Their sweet saffron rice is delicious. Very good service and food overall.

When you think of Mexican food or the culture of Mexico it's a breath of fresh air, very festive and full of life! Walking into Memos is the opposite these days. Tonight we were told they were short staffed and could not serve us at the bar because it would take away the time from the six tables in the restaurant. We have been going to Memos for over a year before an appointment next door and typically spend around 100-150 for some drinks and a few tacos. Don't get me wrong, they have some some of the best drinks in Mt Juliet which is one of the reasons we go, but it seems lately the service has missed its mark. We have walked out the last two times we have walked in. The second time I was hopping that the first time was a fluke. Instead we went to Calabria a couple doors down got great service and food and some how they have plenty staff to have seating at the bar.

Love this place. Always smells like fajitas in there. I'd check out the half Asian bartender J Shots, he likes to give massages while you eat and not in an awkward way.. The little guy behind the bar named Richie was quite amenable to my guy and girlfriends!

Run! I would give 0 stars if possible. The worst orthodontist ever! Was put on a payment plan and last appointment was told I only had 150$ payment left to get my braces off. Today was my appointment and they took off my braces and had me sign all these papers saying my balance was at 0$ but when I got up to the counter they said I still owed 1500$! This place is a huge rip off and just wants to steal your money! If they persist, I will creat a lawsuit against them! Very rude!

I. Love. This. Place. Great atmosphere, servers and bartenders are super personable, beer list is fantastic AND they usually have Bulleit Rye. 

Food can be a little spicy for most folks, but they're up front about that.

Perfect place to catch up with friends, work or people watch. 
I always seem to loose track of time when I'm here.

Chais are a specialty and the wraps are delicious! 
Parking is hit and miss though, it always seems to be busy.

They have a good selection of firearms and products. They also have a well organized and clean. While prices are all list or close to list and selection is run of the mil firearms, it is the typical store aimed at the uneducated firearms enthusiasts. 
My low review is due to two things. I was muzzled by an old moron carrying his rifles to his car. Instead of pointing the barrel in the air when walking like the employee behind him helping him take 2 rifles to his car, the stupid old jackass thought my legs , chest and head was a better direction for the end of his barrels to be pointing .In the past I would have kicked his ass in the parking lot. Since we have cameras everywhere today, I choose to keep my freedom by moving on.
I been to many gun stores  across the USA. This was one of the few that I was not greeted by an employee when I walked in. Not a good sign. Since no one said a word to me the entire time I was in the shop, I took it as I should have, an insult since they did not want my money or see if I needed anything. 
Well it was a good place to take a piss since the restroom are clean, it is the only reason they got two stars.

First off, I have to mention what an amazing and kind service we had. Straight from the moment we sat down until the moment we walked out the door, we were treated with utmost respect and kindness. Very attentive and would continuously check in on our table. The food came out in perfect fashion, with enough time for you and your table to have a conversation, and short enough to where you won't start starving! Food was amazing, filled with flavor and priced very fairly. We had the butter chicken, chicken tikka masala and chicken tikka naan, all finger licking good!!! 10/10 recommend :)

Great coffee, lattes, etc. at great prices! A little "highschool cafeteria" on the accommodations, but I think this is part of the novelty they are going for. Super nice people who take pride in their product.

To start off, Wiley was nice and professional over the phone.  They were exactly on time.  Wiley and Nick made the move so easy for me and my roommate that we basically sat around.
