The move was done professionally and fast.  Plus, they were great to get along with and we had a few good laughs.  I have moved 3 times in the last 4 years and they have been the cheapest and the best movers! Thanks guys.

I love coming here. The issue is I have a hard time waiting for it. It seems like no matter what time I go, the food takes forever. I do appreciate the food though. The padre is an amazing burrito paired with the green salsa. 

Everyone who works there is so amazingly warm. It's just a great environment.

I decided to give this place another shot when a good friend and I were in the neighborhood and she was craving seafood. Horrible first impression for her and even worst second experience for me.The food did not improve but this time it was the service that left a bad taste in my mouth. 

We ordered a bowl of pho to share and a pound each of the cajun crawfish and shrimp. The pho was fine and the shrimp was average. I popped a crawfish in my mouth and noticed immediately that it did not taste fresh. I dismissed it, thinking it was just that one. I tried a couple more.The strong cajun flavor did not mask the foul odor and taste. I did not say anything, assuming it was just my picky tongue. But my friend took one bite and spat out her crawfish. We flagged down the waitress and she returned with a new bag of crawfish.

It was a new batch but the crawfish was still bad. My friend and I decided to just let it go. We had already finished the rest of our meal and were full anyway. However, our waitress stopped by to ask us how the new batch was. We expressed our honest opinion. Her first reaction was to inform us that she could not comp the crawfish for us and that we couldn't have it for free. We were completely bewildered. One, we never asked for or desired a refund. Two, we could not have been nicer about the issue. 

A few minutes later, someone we presumed was the chef walked over to us with the waitress, holding a live crawfish in his hand. They dangled it in front of us. "See? All our crawfish are fresh." 

It was a bad meal, but the service was even harder to digest. Won't be returning.

Very overpriced for a salad for lunch (one crab cake and thin greens was $16 and diet coke was $4) .  There were mistakes on two out of the three orders, plus, an incorrect bill! The decor is very nice, but the chairs were somewhat uncomfortable.  No need to return!

We got my sons iPhoneX screen replaced here. Just under $200. Within 2 weeks the screen stopped working. It glitches.the screen goes green/white and goes on and off like a strobe light. My son dropped it maybe 3 feet but he stopped the fall with his knee so it was a SMALL fall. It also has a new otter box case. When my husband took it back they said there was a crack. There is no visible crack. And they said that they wouldn't do anything to fix it. They also said that this was due to the fact that there was no screen protector on it. This was taken off because they gave it to my husband with a bubble in it. My husband asked them about it and they said "it would work itself out". Well my son tried to work it out himself and ended up taking it off. 
Crap service and terrible product. Cheap parts used. Save yourself the time. Apple is pretty much the same price with way better customer service. Live and learn

We felt a bit rushed when we first got there but that all slowed down once we got our salads. Four of us went for the tasting and it was a ton of food at a very reasonable cost. The service was great with a nice atmosphere and the food extremely flavorful but a bit too salty in some dishes.

Strong smell of food throughout the clinic, the intake clerk had an open bag of chips on his desk which seemed unsanitary. While I waited in the exam room I overheard the doctor speaking in an aggressive manner with another patient so loudly that I could clearly hear the words ( pertaining to what I felt was a very private health issue). After the patient left the doctor laughingly discussed her with the nurse also within my earshot and concerning details that should absolutely be confidential. I was honestly shocked and uncomfortable with this level of unprofessionalism. Cannot recommend. Please note I use an alias for reviews as my name is distinctive and I do not want to be harrassed. Jim I was indeed there on 6/13 and can describe each person who worked there that day. I think your staff could use a refresher course on HIPAA protocols
Came here the other week. Don't think I'll ever come back due to lack of service and cleanliness. We are eating raw fish right?
Tasty avacado eggs, incredibly huge red velvet cake. With my girlfriend, we could only finish one fourth of it.

Worst hotel ever! Showed up to the hotel just to meet some buddies that were staying there until my check in time came in. I was asked to be removed out the building. Without me even saying a word. Never bothered nobody, even the police showed up! That's crazy ! Worst place ever! Especially on business term!

Really great food - great atmosphere and I will be back.  Everyone should go there- try the whole menu, totally worth it.  Staff reminded me of the great experience I had at Nashville Street Tacos a few hours earlier.  I highly recommend going to Stillery with a big appetite.

Carne asada tacos are some of the best I've ever eaten. Dobladas (grilled tacos) are delicious too. Lorena (I assume it was her working) is very friendly and helpful.

Jules is cute, clean, no frills, organic restaurant that serves gf pizza and desserts. The gf pizza crust is good, not great but they are a ton of options to choose from. The desserts from a local baker, are pretty yummy. I had a salad which was really delicious and I highly recommend trying while having a slice.
Great grouper sandwich!  Good service. Delicious Cuban bread pudding for desert. We will be back.

Had a pedi appointment late Friday and it was great. Took their time and did a great job. Wasn't rushed at all and I appreciate that very much! Good prices. Good work. Just want i wanted. Will be back and sharing with friends!

First off let me start by saying I myself do hair, sew-ins to be Specific. Went in today for a middle part sew in due to me being lazy plus my boyfriend want to treat me. NICE people but WORST EXPERIENCE. Took almost 5 hours just for a normal sew in when normally it should take no more than 2 hours. Second, the braid pattern wasn't for my thin and fine hair, straight back could've made the hair full and leave no space in the middle. I had SPACE all in the back cause she braided it side to side. Third, no oils and grease was applied on my scalp which will cause dryness and breakage for my fine hair. My "Brazilian hair" was handle poorly, she was trying to get tangles out with a small tooth comp which is a no no to anybody who ever own a good quality Brazilian hair. My leave out wasn't straighten or was my weave. So basically I paid 80 bucks to get my real hair braided which I could've easily done myself and on top of that I got a fucked up sew in. Good for braids, NOT GOOD FOR SEW IN. She didn't use all my hair like I wanted to, calm it wouldn't  fit. Got home and redid it myself and everything went in like always. BAD EXPERIENCE AND WILL NEVER GO BACK FOR A SEW IN AGAIN. Never seen a hair salon that do weave and don't have a single straighter to straighten hair and leave out. Then she had the nerve to ask me to what I'll will do with my leave out and tiny bit of edges that was left out. That erked me even more.

I used to love coming here. The cupcakes are delicious and they serve Intelligentsia Coffee, one of my favorites. Today, however, was awful. The noise coming from the kitchen was unbearable and the people working there seemed totally oblivious to the fact that guest were having lunch, visiting with friends, and trying to have a conversation. Won't be back any time soon :(
Best little blues bar in Nashville, TN.  Stage, dancing and bar with some of the best musicians and down to earth people just enjoying the music and drinks!  So much fun! Can't wait to go back soon!

I order from here all the time. I've never had my order messed up, and the food is always good. I especially like the fact they keep your address on file after your first order, and they ALWAYS ALWAYS deliver my food between 30-45 mintues. 
The girls on the phone aren't the friendliest but this isn't a five star resturant. Plus they tend to be busy so I understand how hectic things probably get.

Dr. Van and his team always make the experience as painless and positive as possible. It's really a family approach that I like. Most employees have been there for many years and Dr. Van takes a positive mentoring approach with dental assistants. He always calls right after the appointment to check in on how I am doing. The work is always first rate (I have had crowns, fillings and implants here). He is experienced, has all the latest technology and the financial counseling is first-rate. I read the review before and can tell you that the work they did in advance of your first cleaning was needed. If you want to have your teeth for life, see Dr. Van.

If you do not have a reservation don't even bother going. We decided to walk down last Saturday morning and were sorely disappointed. The hostess was very rude, she acted as though our presence was a huge bother to her. She told us the wait was 1 1/2 hours. They might as well have a sign that says "reservations only".  No apologies at all. The menu prices were also higher than I had expected. Over all we will not be returning there.

Good place to come if you need to eat fast, and or just want to get home fast, burgers are all surprisingly good but the ice cream(can't remember what they call it there) is hard to not eat although it gives you a stomach ache. Even if you only eat half of a small it still is upsetting, but I still recommend coming here.

My girlfriend and i really enjoyed the hotel.  The staff were friendly and courteous.  We had the Suite. It was clean and extremely comfortable.  The continental breakfast in the mornings were delicious.  The hotel was situated in the French Quarters which made it extremely convenient to get around.  We loved our time there.  Jarod was the helpful and extremely professional!!
Lived at Montgomery ct in Narberth! The worst! One maintenance man they worked half to death, bugs, broken closet doors, 2 major floods- do not rent here!

I love supporting local black owned businesses & this one is right around the corner from me in Carmel! I ordered the catfish with macaroni & yams for the sides. The catfish was on point!! And the filets are huge! The yams were a little too sweet for my liking. And the macaroni could've used a little more cheese & seasoning. Overall great experience & good food. I'll go back to try something else soon.
This is a great and authentic Mexican place! The food is fantastic and the staff is super friendly

I wasn't initially drawn here although I pass it everyday because it didn't seem very vegetarian friendly. We got a Groupon and got to check it out though. 

Incredible!
Quinoa ~ With Black Beans, Fresh Corn, Bell Pepper, and Spiced Pepitas over Baby Greens in a Sherry Vinaigrette 7

Quesadilla ~ Grilled Flour Tortilla with Chihuahua Cheese and your choice of:    Huitlacoche (Mexican Corn Truffle) 8

Tacos~ {Fresh Vegetables 13,}
All Served with Pico de Gallo, Crema, Warm Soft Corn Tortillas, and Shredded Romaine

Desert was INCREDIBLE! Their presentation of the pictures on the iPad was really appealing. I thought it was going to be typical Mexican restaurant desert but they blew me away! 

We didn't BYOB but this looks yummy:
Tequila Mixers

Margaritas: Fresh Lime, Mango, Passion Fruit, Guava, Peach, Guanabana, Scarlet (Pomegranate)  ~ Available On Ice by the Pitcher 9 or Glass 3 OR Frozen by the Pitcher 9) 

They seemed a bit stressed, I think the Groupons brought in a lot of business, but they were so sweet and caring that I didn't care much :) 

I would love to see more outside seating if possible.

Cute little boutique on Mass Ave. I visited on Small Business Saturday to get a "#naptown" t-shirt that I had seen on their IG account. Smells kind of funny in there... like old things. She does have some vintage items in there, so maybe that's why. Anyway, I'll be back for the "Bye, Felicia" t-shirt for obvious reasons.

Bea Arthur. I don't know who you are, but this ice cream that is named for you is fabulous. My softserve vanilla is injected with sweet sweet sweeeet dulce de leche, and dipped in wafer crust. My childhood memories of chasing the ice cream truck and getting rainbow sprinkles has been obliterated. My ice cream craving is bigger and gayer now.

We were walking in the Mall From Kohls to Sprouts for a little exercise. I wanted to go in the Summit Hut. I hadn't been there and my husband was looking for a knife, a pocket knife. This is a very serious purchase for someone that carries a pocket knife at all times.  Taylor the sales person gave my husband the complete tutoring about function of the knives.
In the meantime I was cruising the store...
I found leather and suede protector. 
 
 You would have thought I hit the lottery! Hey Taylor explained what I need for my purse and what I need for  My telephone wallet that is the best buttery suede A surprising purchase from Amazon for my Galaxy S8 plus made in London. The bottom line is butter suede would never stay perfect unless I got something to seal and protect it.
 when I got home I got out 6 pairs of suede shoes and hit it.
 This may not be a really important thing to yelpers but to me it's really important to be able to save my leather and suede. Summit hut has excellent service people that love their jobs..Taylor said you know you don't want that for that,
 you want wax for leather,  spray for suede.
The exciting part about this store is you can't make a mistake purchase!
 IF YOU ASK.
 What would work best for your purpose this has excellence service

I eat here regularly for lunch. They have an excellent selection of personal pizzas, sandwiches and salads. My favorite salad is the Southwest Chop with Beef (can be made sans meat or with chicken too). Place is very clean and the staff is very friendly, professional and helpful.
Cookies were absolutely delicious! We should have gotten a smaller box - they are super rich and filling. Delicious treat and we will want to try more!

I don't remember what might have been up my butt the day I first ate at Parkway, or the day I wrote the review, that caused me to give it 4 stars. Whatever it was, I got over it today.

For one thing, I liked sitting in the bar area a lot better; we got table service and it was fun watching the bartender interact with the folks at the bar. Everybody was welcoming, right down to the cook who let us come in the employee entrance because it was closer.

And the food! The gumbo was again amazing, and the surf-and-turf po' boy was just ridiculous! I couldn't even pick it up without roast beef spilling out, and one poor shrimp just couldn't stay on and tragically met its end on the floor. I couldn't decide which was better, the shrimp or the beef, but then I realized it didn't matter! We probably won't be here in town long enough to get back for another round, and that almost makes me cry.

Came on a random Wednesday early evening. They have a really adorable outdoor area with heat lamps. And bonus points: it's truly like a green house! There's cute plants all around.

The food was really good. I was pleasantly surprised since it wasn't as busy as other restaurants on the street. We ordered the aji pulpo, roast beef sandwich and korean pork belly tacos. They were all really delicious. Just the right amount of flavor and not greasy at all. They also had these amazing house fries - shoestring & crispy. My husband cleaned (literally vacuumed) his plate. We left feeling absolutely stuffed. 

Also I highly recommend their iced tea. I'm sure it's Lipton but it was refreshing on a hotter fall day!

Dear Tamale Lady,

Can you be my Tucson mom? You wouldn't mind would you? Your tamales are so close to my heart -but even closer to my heart's arteries. They remind me of the exceptional "Norteno" style tamales I can get 2 blocks away from my parents' home back  in Texas. Two blocks! Sigh. I eagerly await your response. Perhaps you could send it along with a dozen of your goodies.

Sincerely,

Marina "Me gustan sus tamales" M.

Decent crowd but not busy.  I ordered a couple drinks, and then added on a couple of drinks when she returned.  Bar tender was extremely rude because I started adding to my tab.  Apparently, she wasn't interested in increasing bar revenue or her tab.

Very cool place! Everyone is so full of life and friendly. There always seems to be at least one child present when I've gone, which seems to indicate to me that they have a nice atmosphere. 

I've taken Zumba there a few times, and it's always been a lot of fun. The people who come to class are pretty varied, but everyone has seemed really nice. The instructors are super enthusiastic, which really helps make the class work. Zumba is also just a really great class. It's nice that Hooprama is offering it, because it's a wonderful and fun way to exercise. It's like you never even realize that you're working so hard, and then all of the sudden you realize you've been sweating and you need to stop for some water. This is how exercise should be!

There are chairs and toys so if someone wants to wait for you while you take the class (or if kids want to play) it's rather comfortable. It's also kind of fun to watch other classes if you get there early, to get a taste of what is going on in the studio. The Hooprama people seem to have cool ads for things that are going on in Nashville, if you're looking for things to do, it's a great place to find some connections.

Parking is available on the little side street next to the studio. There's limited parking in front, and you really can't park in the other spaces for the complex. If you're there at night you might want to walk out to the street with someone if it's dark, but overall that area's not too bad. And people are really considerate about that. It's also conveniently right next to a grocery store, so if you want to stop on your way home for a few things it's easy to manage!

Best restaurant EVER! The staff were friendly, the service was great and the food was delicious! Not only that, I was passing through Boise on my way to Washington. When I got well into Oregon and had to get gas, I realized I had left my debt card at the restaurant. I immediately called and spoke with a lady named Allwin (not sure exactly how to spell it). She mailed me my card right away! And, so far, it hasn't been compromised. Kudos to all the nice staff and yummy food!!

When I was younger I loved going to KFC for their popcorn chicken and biscuits. But I have to agree with every bad review of this location. Every time I have come here they have been out of something or the food wasn't up to it's usual standard. The review about substituting items is true. Some employees will let you, most of them like to be jerks. Sadly, I never feel welcome here. Go down the block to Popeyes, or better yet, across the street to Caines.

Sky lounge operates both the dining area upstairs (before you go through security) and the small bar and snack area downstairs. I've only been to the area downstairs and the drinks and snacks are well priced. For snacks they have you're usual junk food as well as premade sandwiches and hummus.

I love Thai food and most places I've been to were good.
This place, unfortunately, doesn't deserve more than 2 stars.
The only good thing about it is its location.
Me and my mom were visiting Santa Barbara and decided to have lunch on State street, and here it was - Thai food with great reviews (4 starts)- obviously, we bought it.
I ordered my favorite noodle dish- Pad See Ew. My mom asked for shrimps with mixed veggies and white rice on the side.
The service was pretty slow, I think we waited for at least 20 minutes. 
My dish looked fine... but I've never had such a bad Pad See Ew before. The worst thing about it was broccoli. They were very undercooked (almost raw) and very bitter. Another thing, the sauce wasn't sweet enough for this dish. I've had Pad See Ew many times in different places. This place served me the worst version of it.
My mom's plate was quite large, but the funny thing is it was mainly the veggies. There were literally 6 medium sized shrimps. And when the bill came with 12 $ for this portion, I was furious. The waitress actually never told me the price of it beforehand, so I assumed that it wouldn't be more expensive than other dishes on the menu (8-9$). 
I will never come back to this place!

What a perfect fancy yet casual restaurant! We opted to dine outdoors, which was surprisingly cool and comfortable. Food was presented beautifully and tasted divine! This is a must-try if you are in NOLA! Be sure to get reservations!

Came to Philly for an overnite  with the family from NJ. Did several breweries today on our way down and saved the best for last. Been here several times already and always delicious food and attentive friendly service. Today had the wings and burrata for appys, then I had a bowl of prime rib chili which is something I've never had before and it was fabulous. Rest of table had prime rib, porchetta and grilled cheese sandwiches . I sampled a bite of each which were all really good. Great music on the turntable and wonderful beers served up by Dave the beer meister. Definitely one of our favorite spots when in Philly.
Excellent food. Great, authentic and full of culture. Also stays true to being an actual pho restaurant.

We were on spring break and were told this was the spot we HAD to check out, and they weren't kidding. The food was eclectic and nice for a family with varied tastes. I personally enjoyed devouring the monster burrito with a side of their tasty French fries. One of my hubbys favorite things is that they bottle their own soda in house! While we weren't able to witness the bottling process - the soda speaks for itself, and it's a sparkling conversationalist. My kids voted that the mile high floats - all made with their own sodas - was the highlight of the evening. You won't be able to resist the floats once you see the bubbling soda topped with a mountain of ice cream being delivered to a table near yours.

had diane burger cooked medium, was good. had the tucson blonde, was good, got a little hoppy as it warmed. really liked the tortilla soup. nice local watering hole, would go back for more next time i'm in tucson.

The nearly constant line out the door hints of the cool treasures you'll find inside. If you can get away from work or play, mid afternoon is a good time for no line. Service is always courteous and helpful.

Apparently Jeni's started in O-hi-o. All I can say is O-my-o. I'm a die-hard fan of Berkey Creamery (at arch-rival PSU. After all, that's where Ben & Jerry and a host of other ice cream stars got their start.) But Jeni....oh, Jeni you have got it absolutely right! For this review I'm trumpeting my kudos for the Buckeye Master of Ice Cream.

Start with fine, fresh ingredients like Tennessee (and Ohio) grown strawberries, roast gently (yes, roast), add some buttermilk, then puree them. Pure elegance in ice cream. 

Brown butter almond brittle - a simple classic flavor. 

Brambleberry Crisp (actually blackberries and currants mixed throughout) - sweet and tart with a bit of chew from the oat streusel pieces. 

Backyard Mint - smooth and simply refreshing.

Bangkok Peanut - Pow! Pizazz! with a bit of lingering Cayenne heat. 

Sweet Corn and Blackberries - who would have guessed that these two would pair so very well? 

Yazoo Sue with Rosemary Dusted Bar Nuts (now that's a mouthful and a palate full) - you won't believe it 'til you try it. Creamy goodness of cherry wood-smoked porter, blended with almonds, cashews, peanuts, and pecans dusted with rosemary, brown sugar, and cayenne. Jumpin' Jehosephat Jeni. (Note: This flavor a few others are available in pints only.)

There are many more....stop by and taste for yourself.

Finally - my current favorite (subject to change next week)...Sweet Cream Biscuits with Peach Jam...need I say more? Yep, "more" splendid ice cream from Jeni's, please.
Came for happy hour after work. Their bean dip is sooo yummy. Margs were a bit weak, but their premade. Bartender was really nice, and pretty cute. I'll be back for sure!

Visited this Kmart today. Aisles were very well-stocked and cashier was fine. Not overly friendly but not rude either. The store was a ghost-town. There were only probably 5 people in there. Which I kind of liked. However, the aisles are very narrow. I felt like I kept bumping into stuff in here. They also only had one check-out line open. Which to me seems odd.  All in all, it's an ok store. Pretty obvious it is on its last legs.

9 out of 10 negative reviews are related to their delivery, which I agree is horrendous. But you got to take this place for what it is. It's modeled after a neighborhood get-n-go but with ALL healthy options. It aims to provide affordable food to people with limited income. It's at a bus stop, next to the court. 

Part of the reason it's so healthy is that they don't buy processed foods and they cook based on what they'll expect to sell that day. The way it used to be. So don't be a bummer because they're trying to keep it fresh, keep it genuine. Just ask what they have going that day. It'd be nice if they offered that info from the start, but the customer can also take a little initiative too. 

You get one or two grumps but for the most part the staff is super nice. They're also working folks in the heart of the city catering to a wide range of customers from lawyers to construction workers, homeless to hipster. So give em a break of they don't act like the world stops when you place your order. 

Red beans and white beans are solid. Chicken is great. Don't get delivery.

Holy cow. If you want cream cheese with a bagel on the side, the Spread is your place to go. I am pleased with the taste & flavor of the bagel but the amount of cream cheese was off putting. I had to get a knife and scrape off more than half of the cream cheese from my bagel. In my opinion, I had three times the amount a normal bagelry serves.

I am not one to complain but after telling many people about my experience they all convinced me I needed to call Del Frisco's and tell them about my bad experience. I tried to call and the manager could not be found nor returned my call. Why would  they want to hear about a complaining customer?

I took my girlfriend here for Valentine's day and was greeted nicely by the hostesses and brought to our table. The hostess was extremely friendly and carried a conversation with my girlfriend the entire way. It seemed odd that on Valentines Day the place was not near as crowded as we anticipated but because of the snow over the last few weeks we came to the conclusion that that could have been the reasoning. With this being said we expected EXCELLENT service because our section was empty for the exception of 2 other couples. When we first arrived their was food on the floor below our table and the waitress didn't know the special menu that was offered for Valentines day. We asked for a cocktail menu and she was surprised that the specials were not on their menu. She wasn't aware of any of the specials for the evening including what the regular menu offered as opposed to the Vday menu they provided us. After we ordered our drinks and appetizers the drinks didn't arrive for a least 10 minutes. Like I said, there was only 2 additional couples in our section and both received drinks quickly. The waitress returned to the table quickly after getting our drinks but it felt as though she was rushing us along to order. Looking back now we understand why. 

Our reservation was for 8pm. It was a Friday night and no one in the section after 9 for the exception of us. After we received our food the waitress never returned to our table. After 20 minutes we decided to order drinks from another individual. The drinks came quickly but our meal was almost eaten. To make matters worse the wait staff decided to clear the floors and all tables before handing us our check. It was 9:30 and we had all anticipation of staying for a few more cocktails, but never received additional service. They took our credit card, came right back, and took the signed receipt. We didn't see our waitress the rest of the night. The staff said have a good night and we left!

We were at del friscos a few weeks ago and the service was impeccable. It was completely night and day. Looks like Friday date nights at del friscos won't be happening any time soon, but hey you can experience it for yourself! I just hope you get our first waitress from a few weeks ago, and not the Vday downer!

First the positives: it's a relaxing place, and the ambiance is nice.  The beer is decent: not great but not horrible-B grade.  The Gmork, however is on the mark: very delish imperial stout. That gets an A+.

Now the negatives: ordered the 1/2 chicken which could fit into the palm of my hand.  For $21.50 that shouldn't be.  This is a brewery so the menu should be simple, filling and good.   maybe that is the case with their fish and chips and burger, but I have to honestly say I felt ripped off.  If it was a Cornish hen, it should have specified that in the menu but it didn't.  The meat was equal to about 3 buffalo wings. The beers, though not bad, need improvement.  They don't stand out.  The Moria has no body given it is a Porter.  I may consider giving them a second chance down the road though.

Cinnamon roll is awesome! Sandwiches are all terrific! Breads all homemade, all ingredients fresh and delicious.  5 varieties of coffee available for breakfast, good iced tea, and good beer selection.
We were very pleased with this project. We have already recommended to friends.  We will definitely continue to recommend them.

After considerable research, I determined that 3M's Crystalline film would provide the UV protection and heat reduction for my customed ordered 2015 Porsche Boxster GTS. Research also revealed that a competent installer was an even more crucial factor in the look and performance of the film than the film itself, and Orange Tint and Tunes had the best reputation in the Tampa Bay Area.

  Orange exceeded my expectations by first providing additional education on their products and services from least expensive to most without an upsale. They even showed live examples of the Crystalline film installed on cars in both shade and sun to help me determine the degree of tint. They accommodated my schedule by setting up an appointment within 2 days, drove me to work after I dropped off my car, and picked me up afterwards, all within the quoted times.  

The job was flawless; no bubbles, scratches, or distortions to indicate that the glass was anything other than factory original. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for professional service.

City Museum is unlike any other museum I've been to. Honestly, it didn't feel like much of a museum at all, but more like a jungle gym meets a junk yard- and truthfully, I mean that in the most loving way possible.

Before I forget to mention it - this is the first museum I've come across that has in and out privileges. Come and go as much as you want.

Oh, second thing I must mention- this place had a lot of snack areas, which I loved. One floor smelled like movie theater popcorn, but sadly, no movie to be watched. Average prices that you'd expect. Let's be real- they need to make money, guys.

Ok, ok, ok. So I really had no clue what to expect, and really don't know what I witnessed other than pure mayhem here. $15 will get you into the museum and another $5 will get you onto the roof. 

The museum has three or so levels of stuff. Crazy chairs that no matter how you spin, you won't fall off of. Art work. There is old aquarium pieces. Lots of light fixtures. It's like the weirdest estate sale, but nothing is for sale. Lots of ropes for kids of all sizes to jump with and ramps to do whatever on too. Slide galore here. One slide is 10 stories long. Honestly, my only negative about this is one of the slides I had gone down left my body badly bruised. Lesson learned- if it wasn't originally built for man, I shouldn't slide on it. Ladies- if you're wearing a skirt or short-shorts, don't slide either, especially in the summer on the outdoor slides because you're going to burn yourselves. 

Other than the huge welt left on my left arm, I really loved it here. I don't know what the purpose of the museum is, but there is a ton of stuff to look at, interact with or just get some cool pictures for your Instagram.

Papas has the best pizza and wings around. If you haven't tried their buffalo chicken cheesesteak you should stop everything you're doing and get one now. Seriously though, they are freaking delicious.
This little place cooks up some very tasty food. Reasonably priced quick service for take out or dine in. Great salsa bar too.

This restaurant is very well done, serving straight-forward, very well prepared Tuscan food in a straight-forward, competent, friendly manner. Service is very quick and very friendly. We tried St. Louis Gooey Butter Cake for the first time...holy cow!

Great responsiveness, hands on service, great communication....everything you want and more than you normally get! Working with a local company is important to our community and these guys are great!!

Craig and Emily are the greatest little shop owners that I know. This buried treasure is one of my favorite go-to lunch spots in Indianapolis and great for my local grocery needs. 

Let's start by saying that they push the limits on their daily-rotating sandwiches. I've tried things here that I would've never dared to try elsewhere. Total and complete taste-bud satisfaction has been a result and I'm glad I stumbled upon this place because it's definitely made me venture out and try new things.

Parking is ample as they have spots up front and a gravel side lot next to the store. There are only a few spots to sit inside, but when it's a beautiful day they open their huge front garage doors and have more than enough seating with their outside picnic tables. They also offer free water for yourself or your pup if you're out on a walk.

They have fresh deli meats that are some of the best I've ever had the pleasure of grilling and an array of LOCAL goods that range from cheese to ice creams.

I love this little place more and more each time I go and I'm glad their become more of a staple in the neighborhood.

Wildwood is the absolute epitome of shopping local.

I've been to the store twice.  Each time I needed advice and help with how to take care of the stone in our home.  I hadn't planned on buying anything the first time, and I felt no pressure to buy.  I never felt like I was being rushed either.  The second time was again for advice and a sealer.  I was treated so well and I never felt embarrassed by any dumb questions. I will always go to them for any help or products now.  It is so nice to have small-town customer service with professional, "big-city" choices.

My friends and I were going to Jaffurs for Bachlorette wine tasting event. Our first event was Jaffurs. We walked in with six girls and then the guy said he wouldn't take us because they don't take six people with out reservations. (Please keep in mind, there was not a single soul in the place at this time and I just drove three and a half hours from Laguna Beach to do this tasting.) I asked him if he would take us separately since we are paying separately. He spoke down to me and litteraly spoke to me as if I had a mental comprehension problem that they don't take six. I asked again if we all came in at different times and weren't a party would he take us. He said yes. I said then can you ring us up like that please. He said if you didn't just hear what I said. I politely said I heard just fine and thank you for being so hospitable. You just lost six sales. Have a nice day. Please don't support the round, white, tall gentleman who treated six young women with such discontent. I don't know how the wine was nor do I ever care to buy. My landlord owns a restaurant and she is discontinuing the product as well. I'm sure due to their extraordinary service.

Thanks Frank for a warm welcome and surprise room upgrade! Only another hotel separated the Inn from the beach. The rooms were newly upgraded with new furniture, a cool blue river stone bed board and newly upgraded bathroom (one big sink with two faucets) - it was tres cool. 

Since the rooms did not have any air conditioning (not really needed this close to the beach) we appreciated the in-room standing fan as well as the whisper quiet ceiling fan. 

I think what separates this inn from other hotels that offer the same boring continental breakfast, is someone like Frank who truly welcomes a beautiful morning with you. Like other reviewers before me, the super continental breakfast offers fresh, local pastries, fresh coffee with every flavor creamer, juices, boiled eggs and a variety of cereal. The last morning we were there, I was looking for a blueberry bagel I enjoyed the day before and didn't find one. On cue, Frank pops his head in the back and comes out with a tray of bagels and offers me the blueberry. That kind of service makes this place memorable. 

We got in-room massages again from our favorite pair of masseurs - Ruth and Mary Jean (see my review for Massage Therapy Associates) and both massage tables they bought fit in the Superior King Room very nicely. We turned on the fireplace to give us some relaxing ambiance. 

Let me address some of the negative reviews here and from Travel Advisor websites.  
- The train - heard it once (it tooted for 2 seconds), didn't bother me and never really heard it again.  
- Also, I had a question and walked in the middle of a heated discussion between a customer and Frank.  The customer complained about the bill stating his wife (nowhere to be seen) said that they should have 25% off.  Frank said he told his wife that you had to book this online to get the discount - which they never did.  (it clearly said that on the website when I was looking for a place)  The disgruntled guest rudely called Frank cheap, I thought it was the other way around.

Note that when you check in, like any hotel, you sign a form that says: you will not smoke on the premises,  you will return the brass key given to you, etc. etc... so if you leave without returning the key, you signed a waiver that says you will pay the $25.  In defense of the Inn, I think if one expects a hotel to be responsible, the hotel owners have every right to expect the same of their guests.  (Take it from me, a person who stays 200+ nights/year at various hotels.  I've been doing this since 1998.) 

All in all, for the price (got 10% off with my AAA card), newly updated rooms and location, it's probably the best deal in town.
This specific location has been very consistent with it's serving portions customer service. Their salad is fresh which is obviously important.

I'm a wimp when it comes to spicy stuff so the short rib taco was too much for me, but the Al Pastor had a nice balance of sweet & meat. Bit surprised the guac had a kick to it as well. But all the food was really fresh. They make their own tortillas. 
Pineapple marg was incredibly strong -- so good for folks who like it that way. 
The service was EXCELLENT. Would go back there for that alone.

At Del Frisco's, it is all about the steak, offering all varieties and cuts from regular steak through 45 day dry aged beef to various worldly wagyus.  You are faced with multiple selections, any of which is a winner.  We chose the signature double eagle rib eye.  This 32 ounce triumph, a steak for two, is prepared and then cut and served to you table side.  With your choice of sides and appetizers, served family style, most can't finish their meals and leave with little Del Frisco's bags.  Of note to go along with the high standards of this restaurant, the help is very knowledgeable and solicitous.  (A special call out to Alex our server, whose pleasantness was infectious and only further enhanced our meal.)  They also are willing to adapt for people with food allergies.  They custom prepared her meal so she would have no problems and when they didn't have a beverage which was safe for her to drink, the manager personally ran out to a local convenience store and brought her back a bottle of smart water.  Kudos to a restaurant that cares that much about their customers.  In the end, though the meal is pricey, you are getting what you pay for.
This park was the perfect spot to have a picnic lunch before we headed to the airport. There was plenty of parking, and many picnic tables, most of which are under shelters.
Quick pizza to eat in or to go. The meat lovers is delicious! The bbq chicken was about average. Our daughter loved the cheese pizza.

Positives: no minors allowed, comfortable seats, covered parking. Negatives: small screens, waiters walking in front of the screen at any time during the show, and mice running throughout the theater after lights go out.

Yelp, sometimes a place deserves a "6 out of 5".

Papa Roux Toux serves up your favorite Cajun joy from the original east-side location, only awesomely located in City Market. 

I can't express enough how awesome the Voodoo mayo is. It's definitely in the "top 5" sauces ever. Yes, ever!

Po'Boys come with a side and a drink -- but unfortunately, they don't do the Coke/Pepsi thing. It's usually something cool and bottled though, Root Beer or a flavored soda. And, there's the Tap Room upstairs where you can grab a beer -- since you'll have to eat upstairs anyhow if you're dining in, there being no room downstairs to sit and eat.

Want more value?? Saturdays before noon, you can get 2 Po'Boys for $10 (with sides and drinks) before noon.

We LOVE this place- Las Fajitas in Antioch, TN on Murfreesboro Rd.! The service is friendly and it is a quiet place to go when we want to talk.

My family is originally from New Mexico so I grew up eating Mexican food for breakfast, lunch and dinner. 

* Las Fajitas salsa is made fresh with cilantro, not sweet, and just the right spicy touch. 

* Their Chili Rellenos have a meat sauce that my husband and I appreciate; 

* Their pulled chicken is made fresh and I can tell the difference from other restaurants. 

* Their chicken chimichangas are the best I've had with fresh pulled chicken with generously drizzled cheese sauce & crunchy ends... other restaurants use beans inside their chimichangas (as a budget stretch, I imagine.) 

* HEALTHY CHOICES: Now, when I'm being healthy, they have an amazing fresh choices like a grilled chicken salad loaded with fresh veggies (broccoli, peppers, carrots, etc.) and their tacos authentico are great healthy choices (My husband and I love their fish tacos authentico). We also like their Filet de Pescado (fish filet with rice and guacamole salad.)

* They make great Margaritas and have a full bar.

* They have GREAT space for large groups! We've had several of our family birthday party's inside the restaurant... They love to treat their customers special!

When you go, tell them "Camille" sent you! (It won't get you anything more than an extra smile, I'm sure.)

I have lived at Hamlin at lake Brandon since 2015, and I just renewed my lease. I wanted to take a minute to say that I'm very pleased with my apartment, office staff and maintenance staff! The office staff are very professional, attentive and knowledgeable!... The Maintenance staff is very professional, timely and knowledgeable! With these qualities and cohesion makes a perfect team!! I strongly recommend this apartment community (five stars) and glad to call it home....THANK YOU to all the staff for what you do, to make Hamlin at Lake Brandon the place to live!!!! Retired Law Enforcement, David Shaffer

In a nutshell.....awful. My sister and I have eaten Thai food for years and have probably been to every Thai place in Nashville, so we really do know good Thai, and this isn't it!  Even though there were maybe 8-10 other diners there, we felt rushed to order even though we had only taken about 10 minutes to look over the extensive menu. The manager or owner stood in front of the food prep area and stared sternly at all the diners, never smiling, kinda creepy.  The spring rolls tasted like the cabbage was rancid. They brought me the wrong food, which is fine, that happens, no problem. My sister began eating hers and the noodles were glistening with grease and cooked to the point of being mushy. Her sauce had very little flavor, almost like it was watered down, and the cook was too stingy with the spices, but she didn't send it back, she was nice and simply asked for some rice to eat with it so she could avoid the noodles. After 20 minutes, my order arrived and the chicken was almost raw. When I bit into it, my jaw literally bounced back open it was so undercooked.  I told the stern guy about it, and he actually  said "You cannot keep sending back plates of food!" WE HAD NOT SENT ANYTHING BACK. My sister had merely asked for some rice, kept her plate and tried to make do! So I told him, that I wouldn't have to send my food back if the chicken hadn't been nearly raw. It was such a horrible experience, he spoke so rudely to us, and my sister and I are truly nice, affable people who are respecting of others. We will never eat there again!

Enjoyed dinner immensely here.  There were four of us and we were greeted by the friendly owner and wife of the chef. Had the Cyprus Mesas dinner which everything was delicious. Mythos has a definite family feel and it makes you feel like you're over for dinner at their home. We were entertained by some dancing from the chef and breaking of plates.  Not over the top but like you would imagine in a traditional setting.  The baklava for dessert was unreal and made by the chefs wife. Highly recommend coming here!

This place is a hidden gem!! Fantastic breakfast burritos, loved RICH-strong coffee and didn't pay "state Street" prices
Service was fast and friendly!!

I was lured by the smell of Szechuan pepper as I walked on Race street and decided to stop by for dinner. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted and seated immediately by the friendly staff. Then the hot tea and ice water came soon after; we didn't even need to ask. About 90 % of the menu consisted of spicy items (just how I like it) and theres three levels of spiciness to choose from. The food came out in reasonable time even when they had a good amount of customers. For starters, I ordered the cold platter sampler since I wanted to try a bit of everything--it had pig ears, pork belly, sliced beef, and beef tendons. Everything on the platter was aromatic and a tolerable spicy; the pig ears would've tasted better if it was sliced as thin as the tendons though. As I was having dinner with just my sister we ordered only two entrees: spicy chicken and crab. Both entrees were so delicious! When I eat a lot of Szechuan peppers, my tongue tends to get numb and everything has no taste to it anymore but surprisingly the entrees were distinctly flavorful from one another. We never told our waitress what spicy level we wanted but our food was just right. Our waitress checked back with us a few times and asked us to let her know how the food was so they could improve. She even gave milk teas on the house which really helped soothe the burning sensation in out mouths...I highly recommend as we all know milk helps with spiciness. 

Final verdict--I recommend this place if you love spicy food! The service is great and the food is good, so why not? That's a rarity for a new restaurant.

The beer is alright and the venue is great for watching games. During our visit the service was not great and the bathroom situation was terrible. The women's room was out of order and so the men's room became the only facility. The trouble with it is the place was crowded and there were a very limited number of stalls for everyone to use creating long waits.

Me and a friend ate at the Clayton location for the first time on a Saturday. Our food was SO good - I had the breakfast fried rice, which I would definitely order again, and my girlfriend had the breakfast tacos. Both of us enjoyed our food and our coffee and loved being able to see what others around us were ordering. Other menu items I'd like to try to thanks to our cozy, community-style seats include biscuits & gravy, the donuts, the oatmeal, and the avocado toast. Our server, Katie, was friendly and attentive. As others have mentioned, we hopped on the waitlist on Yelp about 45 minutes before we arrived and were seated almost immediately. I would recommend planning ahead and joining the waitlist unless you go before 9:30am. This is a small restaurant and you will most likely be sitting near other people, but if you embrace it, you will love your experience at Half & Half!
Finally had their tamales and they were damn good. The key was to go a bit later than noon to give them time to actually make them all.
Delicious authentic and creative Mexican food. Margaritas are tasty and potent. Patio is great for outdoor dining. Mark provided excellent and attentive service. Don't miss Nixta!

Really good horchata and some great carnitas.  They overfill the soft tacos with a bunch of meat, some onions, cilantro, salsa, so 2-3 tacos is all one needs for lunch, and at $1.85 each the price is right.  Chicken tacos also came out good.  In fact, there was so much meat on them, that I separated the two tortillas and turned each taco into two tacos...my 3 tacos became 6.  #winning  I usually hit up Lily's Tacos on Chapala, but this place is really convenient for me and is definitely going to be a go-to alternative.

Had a nice young man named Lucas as our server. We had not been here before and went to enjoy the tenderloins. The sandwiches were very good but the hostess "Mary Ann" left a very bad taste in our mouths. She was rude, arrogant and condescending. The walkway and entrance to the restaurant was easily wheelchair accessible as was the wider door. We approached the hostess stand and "Mary Ann" looked at my husbands wheelchair with disdain and then showed her stupidity by offering us a booth. I said 'no' and she said he could get out of the chair.  We started to leave and she then offered a table. (She had saved the table for her friends, we learned). We reported the indecent to our server who told the manager/owner? We expected him to stop by our table to apologize for her but he did not. A good tenderloin is not worth a rude employee.

I only joined OTF about two weeks ago but I am already obsessed! The workouts are challenging but exiting, each day it's something totally new. I love being held accountable by signing up in advance, I've worked out more in the past two weeks than I have all year long. The trainers are so nice and keep you motivated throughout the class. It's so worth it!

Pretty good. I was told it was the best burger in town but I would have to disagree. I just ordered the midtown burger and it was good but I think it had been overhyped. The fries are really good and they give you a lot. We also ordered the caramel apple dessert which was a huge let down - don't order this. I tried my friends creme brûlée and it was REALLY good. I would order that if I go again.
This place hits the spot on every note. Strong coffee, delicious biscuits, & perfect NOLA atmosphere. Love it.

This is my all time favourite place for vegan peanut butter banana waffles and vegan meats. They also have better desserts than most normal bakeries and they can make things with ingredients you request. I can't have refined sugars and they do special orders!! Love them so much!! Their omelette is my second fav dish. Must try!!

I give the place 2 stars but only because there is a really nice employee in the Floral department, the rest are pretty much worthless. I go there because it is very close to my house but hate myself the instant I walk in because the place is always in flux. It seems to me things are constantly being moved and rearranged. I get mad and sad because I cannot get to the craft paint immediately and then noticed things are gone completely.  What happened to the clothing and accessories for dolls and stuffed animals. There is clothing for American Girl but nothing else. It seems I got there and usually leave in frustration, empty handed or with a necklace charm because I swear soon the store will be nothing but findings and charms and beads.  

Once if you are able to find what you need, the true horror starts as you are corralled single file into the checkout. God forbid you are bot natured or prone to hot flashes as this can be a long long drawn out wait. O, the indignities of suddenly being drenched in sweat and wishing you could bolt for the door, but alas you are hemmed in by partitions on one side with merchandise racks all around. This newish corralling feature (it has been around about a year and a half) has saved me lots of money as I refused to be pinned in with a cart so I limit  my purchases. The genius that thought this was a good idea has never had a hot flash or been claustrophobic. 

The only thing good about the place these days except for the girl in floral is the searingly disapproving employees that are abundant at this location are no longer manning the checkout process.

I Loved Omailia's when they were here. I don't know enough about needlers yet other than it's a little too expensive. But I'm sure the rent is out of control so that's why they put a hefty price on everything. It looks like they have everything there and I'm really glad that Our neighborhood has a grocery store so I can't be griping too much because I have to get the car and drive somewhere

Definitely a great place to eat for those with a health conscious appetite.  The menu offered plenty of choices even though half of the menu items are just not in my appetite wheelhouse.  The ones that were in my wheelhouse (steak, cheese) all came with a slight surcharge as well.  Considering the actual size of the meal itself (a bowl of 1 protein, 1 veggie, and 2 bases) it was a tad pricey for my liking, but then again eating healthy typically is.  I would probably return here at some point, and maybe sneak in my own sides.  :-)

My boyfriend and I just went to this place for the first time. It was rather empty, but we have no idea why because it was the best place EVER!! We have been to many other crepe places, including Beau Monde and found this to be just as good, if not better in some ways. It is different than Beau Monde, and was a nice change for us. These are more traditional crepes (flat, circular). It is not a pretentious place--it is relaxed and not fancy at all, but we really liked the atmosphere. 

One big thing is that they feature GLUTEN-FREE crepes!!!! As a gluten-free person for over 5 years, I have never had better gluten free crepes. I have never had any gluten-free crepes in the city at all. These were insanely delicious. I had nutella and banana. It was cooked to perfection, crispy in all the right places, ooey-gooey in others, lightly browned, with dusted powdered sugar. The other crepe we ate was savory--egg, mushroom, and herbs. This was simple and done perfectly. We devoured both.

The guy who waited on us was extremely kind, hospitable, and gracious. He was knowledgeable about the gluten-free crepes. The whole check was pretty inexpensive considering how pricey fancy crepes can be. We spent $18 ish on two wonderful crepes with great fillings. We would have happily paid more. There were more expensive options but we left totally satisfied with our choices. 

Bottom line, we have no idea why some other reviewers have maligned this place. We'll be going back ASAP. Yummmmm....

Definitely the best kept secret in town. This food is as good as it gets. Not only is it the healthiest thing I can find in Santa Barbara, it also tastes absolutely AMAZING. Super fresh, organic, local and tasty. I crave the Bento Box if I don't have one for a day or two, they're delicious and leave you feeling full and energized. Olly, the owner of Kotuku, is super knowledgeable about health in general. He is always willing to spend time with his customers to chat with them about anything and everything. He answered all the questions I had regarding different herbal remedies, the ingredients in his food and how he makes all his beverages and other products. Its obvious that Olly takes the time and effort to ensure that the products he provides his customers with are definitely of the highest quality. Not to mention he's just an overall kind, considerate person (& well traveled New Zealander). Check it out and you won't be disappointed!

I have tried to contact enterprise/Alamo (same counter) at Santa Barbara airport for two weeks. I have put in a lost item report weeks ago and I had a friend in the area drive up to talk to them when they did not reply. They said they would call back a WEEK ago regarding an expensive lost item, when the car was returned by the next customer. Shocking they do not check their cars after renting as my lost item was not in a hidden location- which makes me think something sketchy is going on here. I have contacted alamos corporate and yet the Santa Barbara airport enterprise/Alamo counter will still not return emails or calls, or call back a friend in town. I am reaching out here in hopes I will get a reply from at least someone.

I REALLY love the Dunedin House of Beer. It has the typical "dirty whole in the wall" bar feel that I really love. They have dozens of beers on tap only they have something I have never seen before...something genius...an electronic beer board! Why haven't more bars thought of that? It's easy to change and easy for everyone to read since it is in type. 

We visited most recently on Saint Patrick's Day. We ended up visiting Dunedin House of Beer first and last. Yes, we liked it so much that we came back and finished our night out here. They have the large "human sized" jenga and connect four which is fun. They also have a variety of arcade games, televisions, etc. 

We received great service while we were here. The bartenders were busy, but able to easily keep up with the crowd. 

We were both able to find several beers that we loved and several that we wanted to try among their dozens of choices. They also had some local beers which is nice. 

We will be visiting Dunedin HOB on every future Dunedin trip!

We (5 of us) came here on the recommendation of a friend and we all had a wonderful dinner. 

We started things off with smoked salmon.  Wonderfully delicious salmon on a bed of potato galette or something like a 'bird nest of hash browns.' It was great!

I ordered mussels and also jumbo lump crab & avocado toast. The mussels were fresh and perfectly cooked in a slightly spicy sauce that was wonderful. The crab came on toast and all I can say is that it's a must try! So very very good!

We shared a Bars of Sin to end the meal, and the only sinful thing about it was how quickly it was gone. Yummyness extraordinaire!

As Arnold said, 'I'll be back!'

Back in town again for business and yet again Pinky's doesn't disappoint. This time I eat the chorizo wrap with avocado, (wow) best breakfast wrap ever! I have to mention the staff here, it's nice to see the same faces again, they were working non stop, keeping smiles on their faces, leaving time to joke and have fun with guests. Lauren was our server and had us laughing the whole time.

As a full timer, I have camped all over the country. This is the worst of the worst! It's been open since 1968...don't let that fool you. It looks pretty but is run by owners that know nothing about the lifestyle and don't care to know. I'll never come back

I went to this nail salon after being referred here by a co-worker. The facility was clean. The wait was approx 15 min for an acrylic fill and gel polish. $30 for these services. My nails look great! I would recommend this nail salon.

Celina's, a centerpiece in the Ethnic Kenner Village, has the best pupusa in the city-you can count on that!  Believe me, I have tried many a pupusa, and Celina's was not only the tastiest, but also one of the least expensive!  So you can have pupusa everyday!  It's not so cheap that you feel like a terrible person afterward, but its certainly NOT overpriced (*cough* La Macarena *cough*).  If you have not tried the pupusa yet, you must hurry in and gobble one down!

*My Honduran associate validates the authenticity and overall tastiness.

CLOSED?! Our movie was supposed to start at 10:15pm. We arrived at 10:17, and they told us they were closed.... Huh? We asked for an explanation, but all they could say was, "Because we're closed." Meanwhile, many other customers showed up to see the same movie, but soon left confused and disappointed.

AMC put on quite a show this evening. So much for a night at the movies.

After leaving a bad review Burroughs mill has reached out and finally has made some attempt to hear me out and has worked on improving some of the conditions which I have addressed, although I'm hoping the community continues to hold up these standards I'm glad they have taken a step in the right direction as of right now I'm rating a 3 stars and hope to re-review this community in a few months hopefully with a higher score once I see a continued effort from the community.

First time trying this restaurant and I'm thoroughly disappointed. I ordered the vegetable eggroll and spicy eggplant and both were so tasteless I could barely tell them apart. Rice was cold and stale, like leftovers from yesterday. Doubt I'll give them another shot.

Yapple Yogurt hits the spot on a hot day.
Enjoyed sampling their wide variety of flavors.
Agree with a previous review about adding banana as a possible new flavor - think it would be popular.
My only complaint is the way in which people and children handle the dispensing machines should be addressed. Near the beginning of the line there is a tiny bottle of hand sanitizer, and on a busy day I did not see one person use it. Perhaps if there was a sign to "please cleans hands first," along with a LARGE bottle of sanitizer that is easily seen, this would help. Additionally I don't feel very young children should be getting yogurt themselves. An additional sign perhaps stating "must be over 10 yrs. old to operate" or whatever would be nice. The little ones literally have their hands all over the place, and that is neither sanitary nor appetizing.
Additionally the cashier was eating yogurt herself while checking people out.
Not a good idea, and am sure that shouldn't be permitted.

I'm new to Florida but have been a regular at Chiptole's all over the country. My recent visit was the 1st time they have never honored a military discount. The cashier even asked the manager and he looked and me before making his decision then said no.

Very offended. Can't believe that. Honor your military.

Everyone knows McDonald's food. The food is typical McDonald's, the service at this location is some of the worst. Staff is rude, not attentive and could care less how long it takes to serve you. If you have to go to this location, plan on waiting. 

I've rarely seen them mess orders up but it does happen. The thing that is the most upsetting is the lack of any sort of customer service.

It goes to show that the only good reviews for this location are not actually for this location but for the food of the McDonald's chain as a whole.

My favorite sandwich here, the Beef Martini, is so amazing that it must be tried by everyone at some point in their lives. Every time I go I want to try new things and all have been great...but the Beef Martini takes the cake. Other than cubans maybe, Tampa isn't exactly known for it's sandwich shops or corner store deli's. There's only a few that I'd actually recommend, but Wright's is at the top of my list.

Have been in the showroom a ton of times and have been greeted each time with smiling faces. They have been always helpful with parts needed and have a huge inventory of machines and gear. Beautiful showroom too.

The service is always excellent. The food is authentic and smells incredible. It is easily accessible off the I-10. The place has a nice crowd but is never overly crowded.  The portion sizes are just right and the menu has a lot of variations. It has enough variations to appeal to the pickiest eaters and the least adventurous eaters. It also appeals to Thai food lovers.

Awesome coffee and vanilla almond bear claw 
However I really appreciate customer service and they failed at being at least somewhat welcoming. 

The young lady gave a very unwanted vibe and didn't seem like she wanted to be at work. All I really care for is some recognition but I guess she was having a terrible morning. Sucks because I really like their coffee :(

After a long drive our air bnb host recommended Edleys. It was a perfect start to a great visit to Nashville.  Great food fast service and inexpensive. The BBQ pork and brisket were delicious.  I loved the grit casserole.

Amazing priced lunch specials (3 rolls for $13) and and even more amazing atmosphere. it's so beautifully decorated it feels like you're in the middle of Manhattan, and the sushi chefs are so polite and usually give you a random little piece of something unusual before your meal as a little appetizer when you sit at the bar, so you get to try some new things. Wonderful place, fast service, all fresh food, you never leave unhappy.
Yo golden nugget I was amazed first they sell seamoss gold ding pick  cleansing drink I got was good customer service was God great spot

Definitely one of the best Thai restaurants in Tampa. I ordered the Drunken Noodles which was flavorful and a large serving.  if you usually order Pad Thai, try the DN instead. Pretty similar but just as tasty. Service was also very good here, as is typical at most Thai restaurants. Clean place. Decor nothing special but nothing to knock. (edit: decor is much nicer after their expansion awhile back)

Elizabeth recently helped us with the purchase of our first home. It was a fantastic, seamless experience, from conception to completion. Communication was clear and concise. Information was provided between parties so quickly at times we were blown away. Her experience in the industry really showed during our home inspection and throughout the entire process - she knew all the right questions to ask and led us through the process with ease. It's easy to see that Elizabeth cares for her clients and her community, we can't recommend her enough and would work together again in a heartbeat!

It's admirable to have such a great restaurant open during covid. Even though they could open during Covid at 25% they chose to only serve outside.  We visited once for dinner and then again for brunch. Both meals memorable. The tables were socially distanced, with heaters and all the staff wore masks correctly.  

I love that there were many locals eating there that Travis, our wonderful server, knew by name. His energy was contagious, along with his bar tending prowess. 

A couple of favorites were the shrimp and grits for breakfast and the grilled cheese/tomato soup for dinner. Fried pickles were surprisingly addictive. 

I'm looking forward to another trip to Philly... hopefully post covid.

Definitely stop in here for oysters! Some of the best in the city shucked by some of the best in the city. Didn't have a long wait in line and got a seat at the bar. Enjoy a dozen raw oysters, then ordered a poboy. The poboy was great as well (fried shrimp). Plenty food for the price, and the wait wasn't as long as expected for the place being full. Great mix of local and tourist - but I prefer this spot to some of the other "authentic" oyster houses in this area.

I do not recommend going here.... I called ahead and made an apt, when I showed up they were "short staffed" and I wasn't even seen til about an hour passed my original APT. On top of it, the polish I chose was so dry and they tried to liquify it, but after doing 3 coats the polish was still streaky. He spent about an hour and a half on my toes. I was suppose to get gel mani at the same time, and that didn't happen. So an apt that was suppose to take 1 hr and a half tops took almost 3.5hrs. My gel manicure already started peeling after 48 hours. Let's just say, I will never go back here because customer service is obviously not their strong point

Orders fried green beans and fried green tomatoes, both very good! The fried chicken is amazing and cooked perfectly! The place is always busy so make reservations if you do not have time to wait and be prepared to pay a cover of they have a band.

Went to New Orleans for my mother's birthday this year, and this was one of our favorite spots. We sat and enjoyed the carousel for a good two hours. I had the Freench 007, which was okay, and then had the Pimm's Cup, which was excellent. Our bartender was Cory and he was great fun. My parents tried their other signature drinks and they enjoyed them a lot. The best part of the carousel is that with limited seating, you have to sit next to others, and people would actually have interesting conversations with you. My mother says if she goes back to New Orleans she just wants to spend a day there sitting and chatting to people!

Very unique place. Even though $$$ couldn't leave without trying and witnessing the pouring of the house specialty Absinthe. They plane a sugar cube over a small flat strainer with booze in a cup then poor I believe water over the cube until it dissolves. They place it on fire and serve room temp. It was pretty good but a sipping thing which I had to chug because they announced they were closing soon after ordering it.
We enjoyed getting to explore this area of Tucson. Why I love where I live was an adorable little store that allowed us to take a bit of Tucson home with us.

This wonderful restaurant is tucked away in a corner by Big Lots. I never would have thought it could be so good, but believe me, IT IS! I love the Dragon roll, spicy Tuna and Pad Thai. Can't wait to try more items!

Had a great experience getting my flow master super 40 series and exhaust tip installed for a decent price. Cost me around $240 for parts and the install, they did great welding work. My 2011 ram 1500 4.7L V8 has a nice deep growl to it. Not too loud on the highway either.

Great food, even better service! A little pricey for the average college student but totally worth the splurge. Their pastor tacos, chicken burger, and buffalo fries are my go to. So good I've been there twice in the past week. Definitely recommend! Super happy to have a new go-to vegan restaurant. Also very clean with a mellow atmosphere.
Cheap Amish bakery.  I would definitely have uncontrolled diabetes type 2 if I lived in philly.

Let me start off by saying that this place has one of the best micro/craft beer selections of any place I have been to; you could spend hours trying all of their beers. And they are constantly changing their beer selection and staying tuned in with the seasons. The staff is friendly and down to earth. And food specials are very reasonably priced. We typically eat here for lunch on Fridays, but I have had lunch here on other weekdays as well. It is walking distance from my office. The lunch crowds are not usually too crowded, so getting a seat (usually at the bar for us) is not a problem. Now here's why I didn't give it 4 or 5 stars. For some reason, this place does not want to hire the proper number of staff, e.g. bartenders, to handle the lunch crowd. I am thinking it boils down to money and tips, as most things unfortunately do. It is not uncommon that we need to flag down our bartender to get his or her attention just to put a food order in, and it can take a long time to receive our food. Then it can take a while longer to get the bartender's attention to ask for the check. There are times when the bartender disappears for five minutes at a time and the patrons all look at each other confused. We are not typically in a hurry when we're there, but I like to keep my lunch session to an hour. With all of these major delays in the process, we can spend upwards of 90 minutes in this place. I still have work to do after lunch! I have heard that this place gets packed in the evenings and on weekends, but I am never there for that experience. I'd recommend, but I hope management heeds my words and gets another bartender in there to handle the lunch crowds.

I am really impressed with this place. I highly recommend you call for an appointment though, especially on the weekends. I took my car to get my Sirius Satellite Radio fixed, kept getting the "antenna is disconnected/broken" error and they spent a great deal of time trying to find a solution. They were very patient and knowledgeable regarding my car stereo. You can even watch TV while you wait, no wifi though for the public. Daniel was very patient and communicated with me while I waited for an hour regarding the "check antenna" words on my radio. Overall, highly satisfied and it was only $25!

Just got to town and stumbled on Pat O'Briens which was a recommendation to us. Busy busy busy but plenty of room. The hurricanes do come in a glass, glass, that you get to keep or can return the bar for 3 bucks back. Stanley was our server he was very genuine and welcoming as we stood there not knowing what to do. Would be worth a stop.

Great place with GREAT food!  Had the pickle chips cuz they were on special for $3.50 and they were amazing. Ordered burgers and my daughter and I tried something different. Server suggested the Vienna burger and I was concerned about liking the bacon jam but it was excellent!  Totally wanna come back here when it's nicer out to see it rockin and rolling. Highly recommend this place!

I love the service, but unfortunately got billed again for the exact same service, 67 days after the fact. Was charged for dry cleaning in mid-march, and then got hit by surprise with another debit for the exact same service over two months later. So in a nutshell, have used the service three times, but have paid for it four times now. Costly mistake, WCL.

Delicious. We got the $99 platter with the amazing sauce and the sauce really was AMAZING. The server recommended it and I'm glad she did. 

With three people in our party we were unable to finish the whole platter but we sure did try! The mussels, clams, crawfish, potatoes and corn were delicious and the only complaint is that the snow crab and king crab legs were a tad on the salty side even without the sauce. Some sausages in the boil would've been nice too. 

The service was perfect, there's a full bar and multiple tv's if you wanna catch a game, there's plenty of seating if you wanna hit this place up as a group. Plenty of street parking. Two hour parking limit out front. 

Highly recommend. Would dine here again soon.

Always clean, well stocked, and low priced! I shop at this publix every other week for our groceries and I am never disappointed! They have new buy one, get ones each week and they carry Boars Head!!! That's always a win. The staff is bright and friendly and the store policies are phenomenal: for example if they have lanes something wrong, they give it to you for free! And they always offer to help you load your car! I love Publix and it is truly a pleasure to shop there.
