To make matters worse, they totally ripped off some of the previous restaurant's menu. Sushime used to be the sushi place in Lenox. Umami may have been able to keep the sushi dude from Sushime, but the teeny tiny changes they made to the rolls ruin the awesomeness that was Sushime. 

I'm not sure why tacos and Korean BBQ and sushi and sweet potato fries are all on the same menu. It's like they wanted to just cover all their bases. They installed a massive refrigerator with bottles of beer, and removed the sushi bar (which was a highlight of the previous owners). If you want sweet potato fries and good beer, go to Burger Republic. If you want good sushi, go across the street. This place is a waste of time. 

Oh! Fun bonus fact? The owner, when I met her the first time, spent a solid 10 minutes telling me how much money they sunk into their remodel and trash talking the previous sushi restaurant. That's tacky.

So full disclosure to start with... I so wanted to hate this place. I went in expecting to hate it here, yet I can't. It's a welcome addition to St. Albert.

As a rule I hate chain restaurants and bars and avoid them like the plague. I have always just lumped The Canadian Brewhouse, O2's Taphouse, Browns Social House, First Round, and Hudson's (to name a few) as same sh*t, different pile. These are places I only ever find myself at when invited to a gathering by others... never a spot I would choose to go on my own. Yet I have already been here three times since they have opened...

So why the change of heart? Simply put, this is a pretty damn cool spot with a good beer selection and food that was wayyyyy better than I expected. As well, they have some very cool items decorating this place. Our first venture here was about a week after they opened. Heather and I were caught in the chaos of Christmas shopping and prep and while running to Superstore Liquor she suggested we take a break and grab a drink at the new spot in town next door. We did, and had a couple of fantastic Caesars (we consider ourselves somewhat of Caesar snobs so I think our opinion should be good) and an order of onion rings to nibble on as a snack. So let me say for the record, the onion rings orders here are MASSIVE and they are delicious.  The jalapeno ranch they serve them with is amazing as well.

While on our first visit I learned that they do a FREE Oilers gameday bus from all locations. My previous two visits have been to take in a beer and a bite before heading off to the Oilers game. I have fallen in love with the Tzatziki Greek Wrap (with a side of onion rings of course). There is always a good drink special (Heather took advantage of the Thursday wine specials before a game) and the tankards are awesome. The portions here are sizeable, other people ordering poutine, pizzas and burgers all had amazing looking meals.

The first two times we came here we had a seat at the bar. My only complaint at this place would be that the service at the bar can be a bit dicey. Maybe chalk it up to being a new business but confusion seems to be in abundance when trying to be served at the bar. You never really know who your server is as the lady who introduced herself both times was never seen from again until the bill came. And getting a bill was a challenge both times. The third time we sat at a table and the service was fantastic. We will go that route on future visits.

They have a great looking patio up top that will be a great St. Albert summer addition. I was admittedly wrong on dismissing this spot when I heard it was opening in St. Albert... there's a reason they are a successful chain, they are doing a lot of things right.

I read so many good reviews about this place, I decided I had to try it. 

We came in on a Sunday afternoon for lunch and they weren't busy at all. We sat in the main dining area, and only about half of the tables were full. We were told to seat ourselves, and ended up at a table that had a leaking room above it, dripping down on the empty seat next to my friend. Not cool.

It took a long time for someone to come and take our drink order. I got the Creole Mary which was just the right amount of spicy and pretty damn fantastic. We ordered a dozen Gulf Oysters as an appetizer and then the waiter walked off. He came back about 15 min later and took our entree order.....but didn't bring the oysters with him.

About 15 min after that, we got our entrees. I ordered the crawfish enchiladas, which were just ok. My friend ordered a sandwich which he also had lukewarm feelings about. 

About half way into our entrees, we flagged the waiter down and told him to cancel our oyster appetizer order. He looked confused and kept asking "Are you sure?". Ummm....yes, we are sure we want to cancel the appetizer we never got now that we are almost done with our entrees. 

He came back later and tried to fix things by saying that our oysters were accidentally given to another table (we could see pretty much everyone else who was eating and none of them had gotten oysters. Also, with the variety of oysters on the menu, it would be pretty amazing if someone in this group happened to order the exact same oysters we did at the exact same time and somehow get them without us seeing it, even though we sat by the kitchen and watched all of the food coming out). It's most likely that our order never was put in for these, which is lame considering they weren't even busy. 

We liked the atmosphere and the drinks we ordered. We agreed that while we likely wouldn't stop here for a meal the next time we are in STL, we would maybe pop in for a drink.

Sadly I could not buy coffee here because they only accept cash despite having an iPad as the primary cashier interface. I've helpfully pasted some solutions to this below and hope the owners decide to join the 21st century. When I asked why they only took cash, one person glibly replied "so you know how much you can spend" which implies to me that the management is incapable of managing their own money electronically, therefore requiring their customers to pay cash to compensate. 

Best of luck guys. 

https://squareup.com/
https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/credit-card-reader
http://www.payanywhere.com/

3 or maybe 4 stars.  I actually liked Vinny T's - for a CHAIN faux-talian they are OK in my book.  They were very accomodating to our little daughter who loved her ziti and meatballs.  I'd go back.  Way better than Olive Garden and less obnoxious than Bucca di Fake-o.
This is my third try at finding a great nail shop. And I found it. There are a bunch of regulars, the owner really cares, the experience is wonderful. I am a satisfied and a returning customer.

-had chicken app and oyster taco
-have been here a couple times and hadn't come back in awhile due to terrible service about a year ago
-taco was perfect!! absolutely loved it.
-service was good although we went during lunch so no wait
-would go there again

We have a small ice maker that stopped producing ice and Edwards is a Slotsman dealer so I hestiantly called them for service after reading the reviews on Yelp. The initial call was fine and the service professional identified the issue immediately and ice maker was working within the hour.

Was in the city doing holiday stuff and stopped in M&S, not our first choice, but Ruth's Chris had close the nearby location, and car parked at Wannamkers.  We placed orders for drinks, one salad, one app, entree.  Salad and app came within a reasonable time, but drink took forever to come.  They either brought the wrong drink, or they honestly thought that an SoCo old fashioned should be served in a martini glass or didn't know how to make one (WTF?  Heard of Google?).  Sent that back, ordered another drink, which never came.  We were trying to flag down the server so that we could get water glasses filled, as app was spicey. Our server was no where to be found for 45 minutes.  We decided to leave, and we went to Morton's, which coincidentally, is owned by the same parent company (Landry) that M&S is.

We were chatting with our server and told her what happened at M&S.  She told us, that she, personally, sees about one customer a month who walks out of M&S and goes to Morton's (If this is what ONE person at ONE restaurant is noticing, I can only imagine the traffic that's heading into nearby restaurants like Capital Grill or Fogo de chao, etc).  She was telling us she took family there (she get's a discount as a Landry's employee) and had seen pretty much what everyone complaines about, both as a customer and as someone in foodservice industry.

Went there last night with a friend for some lite bites - trying to watch calories!!!

The 2 glasses of wine I had were delicious and refreshing and only $5 each.  The shared plate of cheese and charcuterie along with olives (my fave) and cashews hit the spot!  

Will definitely be back for more!

So many disconnects and still a great food experience.

Hello Christmas lights and tinsel! Wow. This little place is floor to ceiling decorations, and sprinkles Tibetan prayer flags, funky signs, framed photos, and posters all around with the lights that are strung everywhere. It's quite the statement, but it doesn't seem to carry over to the food, which was delicious and somewhat sophisticated. 

Another disconnect? The wait staff the night we were there was all men in their 50s in flannel shirts.They were a little gruff but knowledgeable about the menu and provided good service. I don't know how they pulled off looking bewildered and beleaguered while also being damn good waiters. It was like some truckers decided to wait tables for a night and their lives counted on doing it well.

Total connect? Great food! Lots of good choices on their seasonal menu. Fresh, delicious food. I really enjoyed my pasta and everyone else loved their dishes, including the vegetarian platter (chef's choice), the Manchego Stuffed Pork Loin, The Beef Bourguigon, and the Seared Diver Scallops. All were perfectly cooked and very tasty. One of our best meals while in town.

Apparently their executive chef is working to make a name for herself on reality cooking shows like Chopped and Cutthroat Kitchen. Our friends who dined with us and are local mentioned this when they suggested the place. It didn't carry much weight in our decision, but was an interesting fact.

I highly recommend this place for the food. The dining experience itself was distracting, but the quality of the cooking and the excellence of the recipes let me shut it all out.

Breakfast date with my hubby on our anniversary weekend. It's a popular place so the wait in line can be long but very very worth it!! It's right on state street with great patio dining. You order at the counter then wait at your table for food. We enjoyed cappuccinos while we waited. Very good espresso! But you have to build your own hash with sweet potatoes! Must must must do this! You won't regret it. You don't even need to add sauce to it. We also shared the Luau French toast which was quite yummy as well. We absolutely loved our hash breakfast! Very fresh ingredients. No grease kitchen here! We highly recommend this place for breakfast.

I am in total agreement with everything the negative reviews say about Onyx.  They are slow, unorganized, rude, and unprofessional.  They are so disorganized, that I have to be the one to remind them to pay the water bill (which I include in my monthly rent every month) so the water doesn't get shut off.  No one talks to the other in that office...I have no idea what they do all day.  I have a leak in this place and they are completely ignoring it and only patching and fixing the drywall, NOT fixing the leak. So there's probably mold all inside these walls and they don't care.  As long as they get their money.   

I wouldn't give them a dog house to manage for me. And I would give them negative stars if I could.

Pretty good spot on South Street. The ambience is very nice and modern inside. I wasn't blown away by the food, but it was all good. During happy hour which is from 4-6 during the week, they offer $3 chicken or ground beef tacos which were both pretty good, but nothing special or amazing. They offer a big variety of fruit margaritas as well, they were also good but not very strong. The nachos came with a variety of meat options and were a large size good for a few people to split. The service was great and they were very quick on getting food and drinks out. I would probably return here again in the future, but it wasn't a place that I would rush to get back to immediately.

Awful food. Inexperienced service. Went there for a group party.  This is a place that makes an attempt at seasonal and modern fare, but fails miserably.  The pumpkin risotto was dry and excessively spiced.  The apple dessert tasted literally like fuel...as if they poured lighter fluid on it - completely Inedible.  The waiters didn't notice or care to see that no one was eating the food.  The  price tag was $65 which included entry to Terror Behind the Walls (a haunted house tour across the street), so essentially you're paying over $50 for this crappy food. Would NEVER go back to this place to eat.  If I was forced to, I might go for a  drink if the weather was nice, as they do have curbside and semi-outdoor seating.

Well, it's a Chase Bank. So every time I'm here there's always a line. They're constantly busy- from simple transactions to account opening etc.  There is an ATM inside if you don't feel comfortable using one of the 2 drive up ATMs.  Last time I was there, a staff member was assisting customers / showing them how to use the new ATM which is very user friendly.  There are usually only 2 tellers working so if you need to see a human- be prepared to wait about 10 minutes.  Every time I have interacted with a staff member they were very friendly.  So overall- good service, just be prepared to wait.

I don't usually write these as I am in the service industry and bad days are bad days..but when u cone in to pick up dinner quickly for a family of four, and the cashier is not the nicest person in the world..then the biscuits were hard, so we were told to wait a couple mins..did..then she said sorry 8 mins..and the manager was still trying to give us the hard biscuits.. No offer of discount no drink while waiting, really reinforces why I don't use fast food often.. The customer service is absolutely awful, and definitely not fast..and as it us 5pm these things should have been set up for dinner rush

I do recommend the Carpet Store, if you want a quality product at an affordable price with personalized service.  You are treated as an individual by their staff and your concerns are treated with utmost care.  I plan to continue working with them for other projects for my family and friends.  Thanks to Jim and his staff :).

No complaints here with the quality of the food. Everything is clean and organic and customer service is superb. The donuts are awesome if you get them when they're fresh in the morning, otherwise it's a no-go for me. Although the quality is high, so are the prices. Be willing to pay $10-$15 for a meal at this stylishly themed restaurant.

I love coffee and wanted to try a new drive thru coffee shop. Unfortunately, it literally tasted like milk with hot water. I ordered a 16oz Americano hot with LIGHT cream. One pump hazelnut.
Gross! No coffee taste at all. So disappointed. It was over $3 too (which isn't a bad price if it was good).

Had the best meal with the best service. Got to enjoy their alligator as my appetizer which was phenomenal. For an entree I had the seafood pot pie which was one of the best I've ever had. Shelly our server was such a sweetheart. Highly recommend this place!

How did I miss this place until now? 
We attended a wine dinner in the Steakhouse and it was wonderful! 
Marco and Kevin - and the whole staff - took very good care of us. 
The food, the wine, the company - all delightful! 

Started with a delicious crab cake. Move on to an amazing blackberry spinach salad - the dressing was to die for - sounds a bit crazy - but it was terrific!! Next was the main - perfectly cooked filet (well, it is a steakhouse) with a bordelaise sauce, yummy potatoes and herb roasted veg. 
Did I mention the delicious chocolate torte? 

Each wine paired very nicely. They didn't do baby-pours either - regular pour of each wine, changed glasses after each course - it was everything it should have been. 

When is the next one?

I've been using this location for years.   Proficient, knowledgeable,  Quick, easy, the lowest price in town that I have found.... I once went to another vendor across town because it was convenient in my travels.... my vehicle ended up oddly failing. Brought it to my mechanic who found nothing wrong ...he told me to go back to them for a retest and it passed the second time.  Ever since I always go back to this vendor ...I highly recommend them ....

While it may not look like much on the outaide this quaint little restaurant has one of the best flavors and price tag around Indy. 

They have some of the best and most affordable tacos in town! Every Monday during lunch hours they have $1 tacos! Additionally they have a salsa bar where you can mix different salsa and different spiciness to your liking.

I always order a vagre here, which is fried catfish. When I say 'fried' i mean 'fried' to the point where you can eat the bones. The vagre is fresh and well seasoned and the salsa really finishes it off.

The only caveat is the cleanliness of the place and sometimes the service can be slow. Other wise, this place give the most bang for your buck

This review is for the Hatron Drive location but there is no location listed for them on Yelp. 

The pharmacy here is incompetent. I don't throw this word around lightly, but we are talking truly should be shut down. They have given me the wrong medication, and would have given me the wrong medication several times after that if I was not on top of my own medical care. If anyone receives multiple medications or the lesser love you miss you want you who may be easily confused, this is a place to stay away from.  I am following up this review with a complaint to the FDA. They should not be licensed to distribute drugs if they can make so many mistakes with just one customer. Check your medications and make sure you have the right one.

I met the owner of this Brewery back when it opened and complimented him on the beer and design buildout of this location. I go back regularly for the beer and people watching on State Street. Unfortunately the staff and in particular one of the managers were very underwhelming in their service but more importantly the Manager appeared to be a leftover Skater dude with stringy hair and trucker hat that would rather argue with people than work on ways to improve the experience. I stopped going here after 2-3 similar types of experiences. Too many options to get treated like a visiting LA weekend  vs dedicated local beer enthusiasts. The state of service in SB is problematic at best but this kid needs to curb his attitude when confronted with simple expectations from guests. Feel free to PM me for more information. Truly embarrassing experiences for this Location

This was the first place I tried while moving here. Granted Lynn did a really good job with the final product and was super sweet, my hair was dripping wet (not up in a towel) after being washed. My back was soaked as I sat in the chair. I was heading home afterwards, so I wasn't too bothered by it. But.. when I went to wash my favorite, expensive dress that I wore to work that day, it was RUINED! There are small circular spots on the front and the back has a giant bleach place where my wet hair was on my dress. I'm devastated as this dress was purchased several years ago and can't be replaced. The owner called me to offer a complimentary service. I'm happy she is trying to make the situation right; I know this isn't her fault. I will update after my next hair appointment.

The food was ok, not great. I had the chicken plate with old creamed spinach and a joke of a salad. I wouldn't be back.. I felt the place was dirty, from the flys in the dining room, to the clear window at the food prep area to the disgustingly dirty unisex bathrooms!! Urine stained floor, no toilet paper and dirty sink. I'm giving it two stars due to the friendly service and eagerness to give us samples of the prepared meats. Wish them best of luck servicing this area

A follow up on the last review.  The owner was not happy with the review and said he would not work on the car again. This response may be a good indicator of the customer service to expect if there is a problem.  Instead of trying to find out why a poor review was posted, learn from it, and then try to resolve the situation, the response was the opposite. An emotional reaction where the customer must be wrong and the shop will just refuse to address the issue.  No one should be surprised my follow up review is poor.

Love the coffee and the women who work there. Honestly, the staff is my favorite part of going there. They're super nice and always remember my order! They also have my favorite coffee some frenchie roast by klatch?? It's delicious! Super darrrrrrk, flavorful and full bodied, ya know, all the good aspects of a black coffee without that nasty bitter vibe.

This was our second visit to Atlantis' newest restaurant-Red Bloom, and it was even better than the first time!  This second visit we brought our kids and grandkids to celebrate our anniversary, and we all had the best experience!  The food is so delicious!  Everything we ordered (and it was a lot) was fantastic, but what made it a 5-star experience for all of us was the amazing service!  Our servers were Dominic and Jose and they were on top of all our needs at every second!  Dominic was very busy, but was excellent and always ready to help, but Jose was by far the best server any of us had ever experienced!!!  He went above and beyond all of our needs!  He even heard us discussing how we would need to pick up some fries for the toddler and he offered to order it at another restaurant in Atlantis and delivered it to our table!  I mean...what more could you ask for?  This place will always be on our agenda when visiting Reno!

I shopped Sprouts for the first time April 22, 2019.   I saw a freezer case with liver.  I took one of the packages and it was NOT frozen.   Several other packages, also not frozen.   I notified an employee who immediately removed several of the packages.   I went back and took a package, colder but still not frozen.  Decided against buying any "frozen" goods there.  Bought an avocado, it was dried out.   I did buy several bottles of Kombucha.   Just finished a bottle (5/2/19).  Oops bottle is stamped "Enjoy by 3/11/19".  Disappointed.   Had hoped for better.

The Firkin & Wolf is part of the nationwide Firkin chain of Pub-style restaurants, and maintains a uniform menu across all locations. The theme lightly accents British/English heritage, but the overall appearance is American. Dress as you are, since most people come in everything from sweats to slacks and everything in-between.

The food at Firkin & Wolf is good, with most items rating a 2-3 and a few select items reaching 3-4. Sorry, this isn't a five-star restaurant, and there's no sign of signature-level food.

Beverages are Firkin & Wolf's highlight, with plenty of non/alcoholic drinks available from a lengthy menu. All Firkin locations I've visited have a bar, and Firkin & Wolf keeps with tradition here.

Large parties might want to call ahead, but there are several booths that can comfortably seat 6-8 people. The prices are med-high for a pub, but it depends on your tastes. I've eaten here six times, and only had one complaint (water refills were scarce). Overall, I believe that Firkin & Wolf rates a 4 on its best day, and a solid 3 on average.

So based on Jon L's review I went to this place, desperately looking for a very specific last minute gift. Three to be more precise. 

These people were amazing, very friendly, kind, and more importantly, knowledgable. With a few details about what was needed and the budget I had to spend, they put together something incredible that was the talk of the event these items were needed for! The flowers I ended up getting were beautiful and healthy. The people who work there are great. 

There are only two small reasons this is not five star: 1. We get there and there was very little stock. I kind of attribute it to being a busy day but still, not a big selection. and 2. They tried to sell these dying sunflowers to us. I don't like dying sunflowers. 

This is definitely a place I will be purchasing from in the future (just not those sunflowers; maybe the next shipment won't be so bad).
Very good ramen-- my first time. I had the chicken. The broth was tasty and hearty. I plan to return!

The only reason I gave it a star is because I have to. The food is terrible. Our waitress was terrible. And the location and cleanliness is terrible. None of the cooks were wearing gloves, the bathroom is out of paper goods and the floors are dirty. Avoid at all costs!

Staff was very nice and friendly
Ordered apps
Pate was nice - frites way too salty
Wine was good
Entrees
Cornish hen was nice
Lamb fricasee - terrible!
I got an overcooked dry piece of lamb
It tasted like  lamb was boiled too long
In water I would not recommend
Very surprised that they would let this dish leave the kitchen!

Jenne and Dana are the greatest. From the minute you walk in the door you feel comfortable and relaxed.  They always have cookies, wine..etc. sitting out for clients. I have only been for the waxing thus far and Jenne always does a great job. The prices are reasonable and they even have birthday discounts set up. I can't recommend this place enough.

I'm probably one of the only people in Tampa who is not a fan of Buddy Brew.

I went once to study and the big coffee machine was on making a ton of noise.
I don't think the staff is particularly friendly. It seems like they are trying to be hipster and cool but they come off as snobby. I know their coffee is supposed to be 'authentic' but I don't think it tastes any different than anywhere else (maybe I'm just not good at telling between good/bad quality coffee).

It's also really small inside - which isn't their fault - but for the laid back type of place it is I would want more places to study or do work or talk with a friend.  

I would go back once more just to make sure it wasn't a fluke.

Every time family comes to visit I take them on the double decker bus tour and every time we go through Magazine Street the tour guides always point out this restaurant and today my husband and little girl finally hit it up. It was awesome really cool atmosphere very nice waiter and great food! Definitely would love to come back!
The best jeweler in town by far.  Honest, fair and very talented.  Highly recommend!

Good for if you're on a budget, but I think we could have done better for a hotel near/in the Quarter. The lobby and public areas weren't very clean, our room was dingy and damp, and the shower was so gross. It had rusty drains, low water pressure, a dirty tub, and the handle was very hard to turn. We weren't too trusting of the staff since they didn't seem like they were super organized or helpful, so we declined housekeeping service for our two night stay, just to be safe. 

We honestly didn't spend very much time in the room, but on our last night (about 6:00am Sunday morning), the fire alarm went off and we were awoken by someone banging on our door telling us to evacuate. We weren't about to leave anything in the room, so we quickly got dressed and packed our suitcases to find that there was nothing wrong and everyone was being let back upstairs. On top of that, a bum had been in the breakfast area stealing all the food that was out and the management was shooing him away. 

I think next time that we visit, we'll either be staying in a bed and breakfast off the Quarter, splurging more for a nicer hotel, or staying an Airbnb for around the same price. Staying at this La Quinta was not worth the hassle or the dirty rooms.

I went their for lunch at Rowe bar outdoor seating overlooking the beach. The outdoor seating is very well place and comfortable. I ordered the burger and was delicious. Also, the house red wine Cabernet Sauvignon was good. The staff is attentive and friendly.
I had my coffee and desert in the hotel lobby. Very modern classic style.
I highly recommend.

I have been going to this shop since they opened and am always happy with the work that they do.  My nails look perfect everytime!!! They are so friendly and nice everytime I come in and they do am amazing job!!! I love this Nail Salon I have finally found a nail Salon in Clayton!!!!

I've only been in this DD once before but the manager remembered what I ordered from nearly a month before. Everyone I've met so far is incredibly friendly and respectful. The store is also kept very clean and organized. I may be stopping in more often since I now know they truly care about their customers!

We called for a floral delivery and when they went to deliver, they could not get through the gated entrance of the community.  They contacted us and tried several times to reach the recipient.  They then contacted a neighbor on the call box and were able to gain access and deliver an arrangement.  Their customer service was wonderful and we appreciated the extra effort to make the delivery.

The restaurant is inside an old residence.  We were there for brunch on a Saturday and there was not much of a crowd.  If you go during dinner hours, I suspect that carrying on a conversation would be difficult with the tables packed in.  Our server was very attentive.  We had the omelet and pancake and we were very happy with our food and the prices were very reasonable.  I would recommend you stop in.

Five stars sums it up. Bristol's has great seafood. Their menu has a lot to choose from and the specials make your choice even harder. I had pan seared sea scallops that I can still taste a week later. 

The service was equally phenomenal. Our waiter sounded like he was the chef as he described each special and then flawlessly answered our questions about the menu. We actually applauded his presentation. 

It all added up to a great dining experience. Bristol's is a little pricey but I highly recommend it to all Yelper's.

Best. Meal. I. Have. Ever. Had. Bill the waiter was superb, water guy always kept our glasses full. The flat bread, risotto, and pork was cooked to perfection. Risotto was not heavy, pork tenderloin was flavorful and tender. Very good cake and dessert selection. I'm sad to live in Indiana 4 hours away!

Allison does wonderful makeup and real put me as ease. 
Tara did an awesome job on my microbladding. She really listened to what I wanted. I'm so happy. 
I'd recommend any of the girls at Birds of Prey.

Dr. Graham, and everyone at his practice, is wonderful! They offer kind, high quality, personalized, and affordable dental work. Fillings they did for me 15 years ago are holding up fine. Dr. Graham is so thoughtful that he once called me regarding innovations in a non-dental, health specialty that we had previously discussed during an appointment. I recommend this practice to all of my friends and family!

Went in on a whim to get my septum pierced today, Upon entering we were greeted by an older gentleman and Zach. I was accompanied by my boss and my friend. My friend decided to sit by the older gentleman and while I got my piercing done, he entertained her with funny Facebook photos among other things. Zach is very well spoken, knowledgable, and polite. I have a couple other piercings but this has been one of my favorite experiences in a tattoo shop EVER. Zach is excellent at what he does, and everyone who was present at the time were so humble and sweet. I will definitely be making another 2 hour drive to get something else done soon!

Do not order the beef dumplings... literally pouring out fat. Fat that solidified on the plate. Couldn't even eat them. Greasy is not the word.... just picture a plate full of 1/4" of lard. Mmmm. And they were completely tasteless, to boot. Menu is weird, otherwise...not sure what theme they are going for.

Spent lunch in Nashville today and found Epice to be a very pleasant surprise not too far from an old favorite (frothy monkey) but seemingly worlds away from what I remember about 12South. 

It's a pretty smart layout brought to us by the same gent behind Kalamatas on Hillsboro (is that even still there?) with a decent amount of natural light if for a slender dining hall.  But the best spot in the house in my opinion is at the bar.  Because of how Epice is arranged, the bar gives a superior view of just about everywhere else and close proximity to the action in the kitchen. Plus I really like the scales with classic Lebanese species conspicuously just above eye level in the background... a truly nice touch. 

For lunch, I started with the Adas be-silik, a surprisingly light and lemony lentil soup with chard. Then I migrated to the Sfeeha, a scrumptious flatbed with cured thin strips of beef...an accompaniment to a. Barolo. 

For the main it was Lahmajin, lamb in a flatbread wrap with their signature pickles and onion relish.  Good stuff, once again. But you know... As good as everything else was, the signature was actually the desert. 

The date tart is special. I've been a lot of places and eaten many strange and wonderful things just recently...but the date tart may be my favorite desert in 2015 (I know it's still early). It's a Meyer lemon and ginger spice candied date with lemon curd and apricot chutney that's not to be missed.   Simple as that. 
.
The best in Nashville. Be sure to get there on off hours or expect a wait. Regardless it is totally worth it. Make sure you pick up some Jackelope for a smooth ending.

If you want Mexican for lunch this is your place.  The lunch specials are really reasonable and all include a soda.

Best of all the service is FAST.  As soon as you sit down, chips and salsa are on the table, drinks are over shortly, and your food is out within 5 minutes after you order which is important if you are trying to get back to work.  I can't speak to the dinner service but lunch is excellent.

This place is awesome. The coffee is great, the atmosphere is like a little living room where everyone in town feels at home and, if you are in a bind and need a pound of coffee at 10pm- they'll keep the light on for you and greet you with a smile. The coffee is LaColombe- so it's localish- but the service is straight up neighborhood local and fantastic.

This is one of my favorite Mexican spots.  It's not much to look at.  It's really just a roadside hole in the wall with a few benches and tables outside.  None of that matters because the food is so good.  From the grouper tacos and the shrimp & chorizo tacos to the tasty burritos, it's all made fresh to order.  They're a small operation so you may have to wait a few minutes for them to make your food, especially when it's crowded.  But a freshly prepared authentic tasting meal is worth the wait.

Decent little breakfast spot right around the corner of the JW hotel in New Orleans. I ordered the seafood omelet and it came with hash browns and a biscuit.  There was nothing spectacular about the food but it tasted ok and the prices were good. The staff were friendly.

This might be the cleanest and best organized grocery store in the city. The meat and poultry is fresh. The seafood area is nicely presented and you don't smell fish! The produce ranges from not-yet-ripe to over ripe. It's good to find super ripe when you need it for today's meal. The fresh foods are in great shape. Best of all? It's affordable. Where else can you get dry aged steaks for such a good price? Easily $5-$8 less per pound than anywhere else.

My nails are amazing !!!! I am extremely picky about my nails and they did the best job. My nails have never looked this good before. Their prices are beyond reasonable and they gave an extra long massage at no additional charge. The place was spotless and the girls were so friendly and helpful. I will never go anywhere else for my nails

Cheap gas but owner is rude and arrogant. Their counter sign promoted a dashboard wipe w/ a car wash but Don Risdon took issue with my insisting on it after I'd paid for the wash. Then he yelled at his counter help, blaming them. Don't let his folksy radio presence fool you:  stand your ground while he hurls ugly curses at customers and staff alike and don't go back.

Update!  The owners reached out to me after I posted my initial review of this restaurant.  I really appreciated that they actually read these reviews and they want to make sure to use this information for improving the business.  The owner provided a sincere apology for the negative service experience that we encountered; shared the corrective actions that they have taken to address this issue; and provided a gift card for us to use if we decided to give them another chance. 

We returned to the Grain Exchange on Sunday night and we really enjoyed our experience!  We were greeted and seated by our server as soon as we entered the restaurant.  She was attentive while also keeping a nice relaxed pace through out the dinner service.  As mentioned in the previous review, they have a great dinner menu, draft list, and creative yet classic cocktail selection.  We also checked out the dessert menu for the first time and as a true Southerner, I will put my stamp of approval on the pecan pie, too!  The great service really made the rest of the positive aspects of this restaurant stand out so much more this time.  Grain Exchange, please keep up the good work!  Your efforts are recognized and greatly appreciated.   I am looking forward to visiting again, soon!
I love this place. Very affordable, close to my office - this is a regular breakfast spot for me. The egg and cheese kolache is warm, fluffy and delicious.

Horrible place. Pretty sad that when people leave honest reviews with their real name attached, this place will call them and tell them to change their review, or else. In my mother's case, she disagreed, and said she was not happy. They quickly removed her dogs as patients, and sent a notice to her via the postal service. 

Horrible customer service. They should be ashamed, but they're not.
I love this salon, it's got a new owner and the staff that work there are amazing! You really can't go wrong here!
I came here with my family and we were all impressed. The food was so good and the atmosphere was spectacular! Would recommend.
Great service, food, and setting.  The raw tuna was phenomenal.  No fishy taste or smell.  Fish tacos were great.  Drinks were good.  Definitely check this place out.

Amazing hotel that surpassed my expectations. The lobby was clean and beautiful with helpful and funny staff. They have a courtyard with a pet cat named Patrick who is 7 years old. He was brought in to keep any rodents away. The inn was a former bakery with the courtyard being the space that the goods would enter thru. Their online website claims there was one incident of a possible haunting but it sounds like it wasn't anything big (just some noises). The history behind this place makes staying here that much better. I got a 2 bedroom suite (not an interior room because windowless rooms are terrible) with a side living room area. There were 2 TVs (1 in the bedroom & 1 in the living room). I loved the decor and architecture of the rooms. There was one feature brick wall, french styled doors for the main entrance, gold coffee tables and lamps, modern bathroom with walk-in glass shower and all the amenities you expect inside a hotel room (towels, soaps, hair blower, etc.) I would absolutely stay here again and recommend it for anyone who wants a cute/beautiful/charming hotel walking distance from all the main attractions French Quarters has to offer. I cannot wait to return again.

It's great that a common ice cream place is placed right across the beach. They also have candies and coffees/teas. 

Three stars because I think it's overrated. Some of the staff were super accommodating and kind and others gave an attitude.

Their flavors aren't anything special, however, the ice cream is real. It melts fast so that means little or no emulsifiers in it. 

They have a few tables inside and out, both on the sort of patio and around the side of 8th. 

The tables aren't cleaned regularly, so be prepared to reposition yourself and belongings or grab some napkins prior to or get nasty!

They didn't have mint-(choco)-chip when I was there..... that's my go-to flavor! I tried a couple of flavors and got a small cup with two flavors for $3.50. I then wanted a coffee post purchase and I wasn't able to locate a garbage bin to toss out my empty cup. I asked one of the boys behind the counter where the bins are and he said outside (I didn't want to go outside, I was outside all day!) and he said that they're overflowing, and then when he saw my frustration because the main door was flooded with families entering and ordering he said there's one inside right between the door and the counter.... again! That's right where it was overwhelming with people. 

I asked if he could take it and if I could place an order for coffee. He completely ignored me and turned his head the other way. Then he motioned for some newcomers to order and basically got rid of me. It did the trick. I grabbed my stuff and pushed through the swarm of people and the trash bin was overstuffed inside too. Half of my rubbish fell in the gap between the bin and the ice cream counter. 

I don't think I'll be back. The girls working behind the counter we're courteous and did amazingly. I gave a  $0.50 tip for the ones who initially helped me. 
-----
After messaging in depth with the owner, I've learned that the ingredients in the Vanilla ice cream are as follows: Cream, milk, skim milk, sugar, whey, stabilizer (locust bean gum, guar gum), vanilla extract, vanilla bean. Contains Milk.

Happy eats!
The place is nice tried the jerk chicken and cheesesteak poutine added the cheese curds for extra but it was delicious.

I had Gulf Fish. It was unnecessarily breaded and finished with a sweet something that ruined it. The room is elegant and there was live music which was very good. Service was very good. But food has room for improvement.

We had a wonderful dinner here. We received a warm welcome and our waitress was prompt and friendly. I had the chicken Marsala with a side of penne - the chicken was tasty, the mushrooms were fresh and tasty and the red sauce was very good too. My husband had the veal scallopini and the veal was nicely cooked and the veggies were plentiful and fresh. The restaurant is also BYOB so next time we bring the vino!
I normally love going to noodles. But the service here is so bad I have to suggest trying one of the other places on the loop. Pretty much anywhere else you'll get competent service and better food.

Wonderful spot for lunch or brunch. BYOB. Eclectic but fun and interesting decor. Nothing matches but it works! A varied and eclectic mix of food as well. Some Latin influences. We had some pretty darn good beef empanadas and a solid meatloaf stuffed with cheese and peppers and wrapped in bacon. The bread pudding dessert was abundant and too good to leave behind! Definitely worth a visit when antiquing or hanging out in Lambertville.

I gave birth to my first daughter here on January 14th and I absolutely can't say enough positive things about the team. They are the most passionate caring individuals I have ever met and they made giving birth a truly incredible experience.  What an amazing group of people, I feel so very well cared for.

Wow. Utterly blown away at all the positive reviews. We order wings, BBQ pizza, Caesar salad, rib platter, brisket, a couple of items off the  Children's menu and numerous sides. The ribs and brisket were slightly above average, but EVERYTHING else was very very poor. Must be a tourist trap because as a local I will not be back.

If you're looking for a Mom and Pop Greek restaurant hidden in a plaza you can easily pass by with HUGE PORTIONS of food
 then look no further. This place is almost what Yelp was made for to find little small gems that you wouldn't otherwise notice and share them with others so they can experience what they have to offer

I've been going to Seven Springs Slovakia for a few years now with intermittent breaks in between yet each time I stop in the couple who run this restaurant remember me, greet me with a huge smile and always do an excellent job serving me very delicious extremely large portion Greek food for less than the franchised places would like Little Greek. In fact, Little Greek lost my business the day I found Seven Springs Souvlaki. The Gryo's here seem like half a pound of meat are wrapped inside and the Greek salad is a meal in itself that'll completely fill up an entire plate or a to go box which you'll get included in a Gryo pita dinner for $9 and some change. It does take a little while to get your food so be prepared for that however the gentleman who works in the kitchen is normally by himself and his wife works the register and helps serve and their granddaughter is also a part-time server. When I say this is a mom-and-pop small business Seven Springs Souvlaki is exactly that. Support a small Greek Eatery ran by authentic Greeks that would love to learn your name greet you and who make you into a return customer.

Great food and fresh ingredients make a great meal! Overall very much enjoyed our experience and the food here. Started off with the appetizer plate which was good, but did not realize everything was battered in tempura and deep fried on this plate. Good way to sample dumplings, tried fish cakes for the first time(not my fav), crab Rangoon's, calamari and fried veggies. Dipping sauces were good but tasted very similar. Our meals were delicious with lot of fresh veggies-what else would you expect from a veggie stir fry?! Thai fried rice was an absolute hit at our table as we had a couple of people order this. Portions were HUGE and was enough to last for leftovers. Would definitely stop again next time we are in the are!

I would like to say this is the first review I have written on anything.  I just felt like I needed to write this review.

We stayed in the hotel.  The rooms were average, same for the food we ate while there.  Drinks at the Tiki bar were good. I had Thin Catfish and Coleslaw, fresh, fast and seasoned to perfection!! My husband had Catfish, fries, hush puppies, and coleslaw. Tried the "44" drink... will have you totally wasted!! (So good)... a must try venue!!!

Upon entering , you smell and feel a bit of the "seasoning" of this place , which shows that it's been around for a while . I ordered the Belgian waffle with a side of eggs sausage and bacon . Bacon was crispy sausage wasn't too salty and eggs were ok but the Belgian waffle had too much of the strawberry topping . The service was good too . Overall a good breakfast joint but didn't have the WOW factor . Maybe I could've got something else ?
Very tasty pho, and excellent summer rolls. Very clean place, and very good service. I will definitely return agin in the future.
Had an amazing lunch! They even had gluten free!!! Service was wonderful. Sushi was fresh, every thing was delicious. I had the lime shrimp salad, I'll definitely repeat it.

Second time at Copper Pig and I am a fan. First time for dinner this time for lunch. Had the Beet Fries & Brussel Sprots (shared) again and they are amazing. Tried the Tacos 2 with meat & 1 with scallops which were just ok.  Enjoyed the Short Ribs last time which was excellent. My companion seemed to enjoy the cheese steak. The service is Spot On! Sad I'm moving out of the neighborhood, but I will return here.

Igloo is my favorite froyo place in the city and I frequent it often (like.. way too often). They have a decent selection of flavors and I usually opt for vanilla plus peanut butter or cookies and cream. The vanilla is fat free and the others are low fat so it is a treat that leaves you feeling not TOO guilty! Their topping selection is not the best I've ever seen but it gets the job done. When I'm being extra gluttonous, I opt for these crispy peanut buttery balls.. I don't know how to explain better than that but they are LEGIT. I would like it if their fruit selection was a little more variable when I am trying to be healthier with my choices. Their nuts and wet toppings are extra but delicious. Usually my cup of yogurt costs around 4-5 bucks which is completely worth it. They have a rewards program that you give them your phone number and every certain amount you spend (I think it's 50) gets you a 5 dollar credit! So glad Igloo came to this part of the city!

I had my routine eye exam and the doctor said she want to take a picture of one of my eyes to check something. What she didn't tell me is that this was not covered in my routine exam. They went ahead and filed the claim on my insurance and I only found out after months later when they sent me a bill for that after insurance denied.
The drinks and appetizers were very good. My $47.00 steak was fatty and chewy, a big disappointment. The other two entrees at our table were quite good.

Riding the Segway through the city was SOOOO fun!!! But I have this experience 3 stars for one reason only....our tour guide was awful. Don't go on a tour with Brad guys...not even sure why this guy is a tour guide. He doesn't seem to like people and he's super socially awkward. Also if you ask him a question about anything that's not in his "script" he gets visibly annoyed. Wish I could have enjoyed this tour with a better tour guide rather than spending the entire time focusing on how awful he was at his job.

I ordered a fresh salad, dressing on the side. The salad was good and I even put the remainder of the salad, without the dressing, in fridge and had it the next day.  The veggies were so fresh it tasted great the next day with the other half of garlic bread.  Well done TLP!

Loved the smoke salmon bagel sandwich and the puff pastries! The baklava is a bit too sweet for me, but does have good texture

I will definitely come here again the next time I am in Philly.
Definitely a top poboy spot now that I can no longer go to Gene's poboy this is definitely my go to spot when you in and around the quarter.

This is one of my favorite places to go for Chinese... Vietnamese egg rolls yum...
The Hot and sour soup so very tasty..just the right amount if vinagar... The daily special is always more than enough to fill you up without breaking the bank.
Their spicy dishes are so yummy, they will even customize the heat level.
There's also a drive thru as well as delivery.

I went to get some shades and the lady who works here was absolutely no help and made me feel stupid. You would think she would be kinder considering I am trying to give her business. I tried to show her what I wanted and I didnt have the lamp available to bring in and she told me I should have known.

Great location if you have a car or not. On State Street but not in the directly downtown area but fairly easy to get to downtown or to other places to eat. A very walkable area, which was great. 

The service was great - very helpful staff. It is pretty spread out but the staff was great about giving an option for which room you'd prefer which is a nice change. Comfy beds, medium sized rooms, all good things. 

The free wifi was awesome, very easy to use. Easy check in and check out and very helpful staff as far as directions and places to eat.

This hotel is so dog friendly we love it...everyone is so nice just stayed this weekened loved it...they serve starbucks coffee,beautiful room and pool,  I would only stay here in the area ... such a nice staff... The nighttime mgr is a young lady who is especially nice she helped us check in and throughout our stay...hotel is so clean...   beautiful so conveinant to everything love it...
Another Super Krewe that rolled right by my business, that kept us full before and after. Fantastic theme, floats, bands and throws

Edited review:

Initially, this was a bad review, but they turned around and came through for us. The fact that they found the solution to my issue and reached to let me know shows good consideration for the customer. The shop has great selection and a fun vibe with several live tropical rescue birds to give some life to a place full of gorgeous old furniture and accessories. Thank you for rectifying what was essentially a mixup in communications. We will be returning!

Food is good, but be careful and check over your bill.  Found an item on the bill that was not ordered.  Pointed it out to the waitress.  Was told original bill was cancelled, and lo and behold, charge is on bank statement.  Now waiting to have the incorrect charge cancelled, so let's see how many days that takes.
Quick and efficient kind and courteousNever pushy and they also wear their mask and gloves at all times

Delicious food, fun atmosphere, wonderful service. That about sums it up. I tried the 'Beer Butt Chicken' and it was nice and juicy. Love the white sauce that came with it. My hubby went for the hot chicken and he might have taken the heat a little too high (he asked for it, he got it). He acknowledged that it was still very good, but he might take the heat down a notch next time.

The owner of this shop is incredible.  She is not only knowledgeable about her craft, but also very personable.  I have purchased some of their products and love them!  I have also taken two of their classes and have had a really good time at both of them.  In the most recent class (garland and wreath making) I jokingly told the owner that I needed a little gnome to go along with my forest themed garland.  My mom went into the store today to purchase some stocking stuffers and guess what the owner happened to have for me?!  A TINY GNOME! He now lives on my mantle with my garland.  I love this place.  Please shop here and take the classes.  You won't regret it.

Joey B's in South County was my first introduction to the Gianino family chain of restaurants and it was a pleasant one for the most part. I seem to be the only one who was unaware of the South County location because it doesn't seem to be struggling for business. I came here with my family on a Saturday night for dinner and we ended up leaving because the wait to get seated was too long. Undeterred, we came for lunch the next day and while still crowded, we were able to grab a seat at the bar while we waited.

Joey B's design seems to be a cross between a typical South County bar restaurant and a more refined dining restaurant. The decor is modern and more fancy than a typical bar or chain restaurant. In this identify crisis, the Moscow Mule somehow got lost in the mix to my disappointment. I settled for a Schlafly IPA on tap instead. 

When we got seated, I ordered their special which was a Southwest burger with blackened beef patty, avocado, and egg. The burger was one of the best burgers I've had in a while. The egg was perfectly cooked and the avocado and pickles complimented the blackened meat very well adding a freshness and depth to the each bite. The burger itself was slightly overcooked than the medium-well I requested, but there was enough flavor and depth to the seasoning that it didn't take away from my enjoyment of the burger. 

I also tried the Jalapeno burger and the Sirloin sandwich. I wasn't as big of a fan of the jalapeno burger, which seems to be a popular choice, because I expected more spiciness given that the beef patty is stuffed with jalapenos and the cheese is a jalapeno cheddar. I could definitely taste the jalapeno flavor but none of the spiciness. The sirloin sandwich was too dry for me, but that may be attributed to it being well done. I would have still liked a sauce or something of that nature. I did like the garlic bread, it was nice and crispy. 

The service was acceptable, but spotty at times.

I don't normally advocate for rewards programs, but Joey B's has a rewards card which earns you a point for each dollar spent and 10$ for each 100 points you earn, giving you a 10% discount essentially. I may have to come drink here more often. 

Overall, I would recommend checking this place out, preferably on off hours to avoid the rush.

Okay don't laugh, but we went to this place last year for a late evening snack after a waitress from another local suggested the fried chicken, and I must say the chicken was great.  We went again this year and the chicken was just a good as the first time.  It's not what you would expect from a corner gas station, but it's well worth a visit.

My cousin was just married in the courtyard here last weekend.  Yes, an outdoor wedding in December.  Good thing the ceremony was short.  The space is beautiful - opened in 1929 as a finishing school for girls, and seeing how badly I could stand to be finished, it was a good thing I ended up here.  I didn't really see the rooms, other than the "bridal suite" where my cousin got dressed for the big day, but the grounds were great and the restaurant quite decent.
We had a brunch buffet and I have no complaints about any of the food - better than average catered wedding fare.  The staff was sweet and attentive, and the views from the room where we sat were spectacular.  I can only imagine it at sunset - nothing beats sunset in the desert.

Visited Here for the first time at 9:30 pm.  We were greeted right away, waitress was at our table in a few seconds.  Nice size beer list and burgers were unique.  Three different burgers and we all will be back!  Fries were good also.  Try their Kumo special with the egg on top!  Yum.  We also appreciated that they were aware of their music volume level with the place almost empty.  We had heard that the music was played so loud you could not carry on a conversation.  Not true on Sunday night, so thank you.  The only reason for a 4 was the only catsup they carry has jalapeño.   Yikes, too spicy and I really like catsup for my fries.  Waitress was very good!

All waiters and waitresses sucks. Only friendly to their friends and locals. If you are tourists and not white do NOT come here unless you want poor service or threats that you will not get good service if you choose to sit at a table instead of at the bar. Some Indian people came in while we were eating and forced to take their food to go. 100% NOT RECOMMENDED.
I am a frequent visitor to Sweet Sage. Food is always good, service is always great.  We love Heather!  And, Catherine, the hostess, is always grumpy.

When I bought my new black Touareg in 2011, Pete made sure that I had a good professional finish to ward off the effects of mountain driving.  What a great investment!  VIP polished it up again recently and VOILA!!  It looks good as new!   The team comes equipped with their own water, products, equipment and expertise to ensure every inch of your car is immaculate.  VIP's difference is their attention to detail and they CARE!  Your vehicle is the best detailer hands I've ever seen!!  Impressive.

We can now add a place to our list of go-to spots in Chinatown! We ordered the Pad See Ew, Pad Kee Mao, and Chicken Rice with fried and boiled chicken. Everything was DELICIOUS. The kids ate everything too, well, except for the Pad Kee Mao because of the spice factor. The Pad Kee Mao was my favorite, probably the best I've had in Philly! Would definitely try again in the future.

Just bad!!! Where do I start! How about our server CANDICE. She was extremely rude!!! She did not refill drinks, never came back to ask about our meal and then add a 20% tip to our individual bills because she knew she would not be getting great tips from our party. I would never recommend this place to anyone. It was just that bad!

The smoked salmon avocado toast is absolutely amazing! The lattes are always made to perfection. Order a side of their mashed sweet potatoes- second best thing on the menu! The service is always exceptional. Highly recommend this local favorite.
Got a bike there today amazing service and people.the bike techs where amazing also definitely recommend them to any one

This place can get so smoky so wear your least favorite clothes there.  We tried 'all you can eat' but beef meat quality was pretty bad except for bul-go-gi.  Also you have no choice on picking meats until you try first round of everything. All you can eat includes short rib meat, marinated chicken, marinated pork, pork belly, marinated beef(bul-go-gi), and thinly sliced brisket. Soup doesn't come with the meal but you get plenty of side dishes. Food in general, they were tasty but little disappointed by the short rib meat quality. Service was pretty good. They were very attentive.

Cute little coffee shop in downtown Norristown.  I am always on the lookout for new spots to sneak away to for when I am working from home or on a Saturday morning.  This place has a very friendly staff, decent amount of seating and plug options if you need to do work.  Pastries are from LeBus and were fresh and I know they work with other local suppliers/vendors for what they offer at their cafe.

An economical Friday wedding brought me here two weeks ago. Given the park's proximity to Murdertown, I was initially wary of attending. 

The Rockwood mansion is a well-maintained stone edifice originally erected in the nineteenth century. There are some anachronisms, like the addition of an elevator, but overall everything looked well-preserved. History buffs would enjoy taking a tour. 

The mansion served as a stately backdrop for the wedding, and the only complaint I could raise on structural grounds would be the excessive amount of mold collecting in the ceiling and crossbeam area on the upper floor. The ceremony was upstairs; naturally my boredom (or was it piety?) during the ceremony led me to look up and see the mold.
Great food and service. I'll definitely be returning next time I'm in the treasure valley area. I ordered the pad Thai with tofu and had them make it spicy. And I really enjoyed it.

Not a huge fan. It was really cold inside, the lavender latte was super super sweet and the espresso didn't taste great. I liked the avocado toast but it definitely wasn't worth the money, especially because of how skimpy the toppings were. There was hardly any avocado on it! It's a cute environment, but other coffee shops have cute atmospheres with better coffee, so I probably won't be back. Also- every time I asked someone a question about the coffee, they didn't know the answer, which was totally unhelpful :/
A delightful place for a good meal.  Never been disappointed.  Right on the beach too.

Relolcation Coordinator and Drivers were very communicative and let me know the status of the move throughout the delivery window.  The drivers were very efficient and careful loading and unloading the cars, even though both my pickup and drop off locations were a little difficult.  The delivery driver had an additional challenge with a low clearance near my house, but called ahead to figure out the best way to get to my location and still made the delivery window.

This is an odd lil spot with a weird dining area! But the staff were so friendly and the food was amazing! I imagine that if this place were just a bit larger they would certainly be doing plenty of business! Love this lil secret spot!

We hired Oh So Vivant for our wedding in June 2018 and they were beyond a hit! Incredibly professional and so creative! The backdrops and props are truly one of a kind, and having a professional there to personalize experience, give ideas, and interact with the guests makes it all the more fun! Easily the best photo booth option in St. Louis!

I could not have been more pleased with the service I received from bellhops. Tristan H. who
was the leader of my crew was super professional, very in control without being bossy and a very accommodating person. The other two fellas were equally professional.I will definitely use Bellhops in the future.


Eddie B.

I'm excited hear that they take credit cards now... my only issue with my last visit (many years ago) was with the fact that they didn't take credit cards and I was left hanging with no cash or checks on a $200 repair. I'll bring my business back now... my XT5 has a few scratches and dents that need to be disappeared!

What a wonderful experience. I called two days prior to my move and then the next day asked if they could come a day early. They accommodated my request, and we're at my front door within 3 hours. The movers themselves were very professional, quick and gentle with my furniture. I was very impressed with the entire transaction including the friendliness of the receptionist, and the willingness to help me when I was in such a time crunch.
I am always a fan of a HomeGoods store. Great location, nice staff, clean store, and great selection! Love it!

The Cowboy steak that I had was pretty much as good as it gets in regards to beef.  It was cooked to a perfect medium rare with plenty of smoky notes from the mesquite grill and it was full of flavor.  The mushrooms that I ordered were also delicious and they added a nice level of great taste to the steak when I ate them together.  We sat at the wrong table though and the ranch beans that we ordered were rather bland.  Our table was the closest one to the grill and it was hot!  They did this fun thing where they made a big announcement about anyone wearing a tie and then they cut that person's tie off.  They did that twice while we were there, which added a unique entertainment value to our dining experience.  The only downfall is that we went to this restaurant on a Tuesday, so none of the rides were running.  They had some exhibits open, such as the magician, but no train rides for us.

I tried SUP for my first time a week ago and am really happy I finally did! it's really reminds of comfort places back in the bay area. I got the chicken tortilla which is my favorite and it was delish. I can't wait to go back, since I frequent Reno and try some of the sandwiches. If you are in the area, a for sure try!

Firstly, the line was ridiculous. You wait in line and they let groups in every five minutes. The line was NOT long but it took us an hour to get through. Then when we got through there was ANOTHER line which the wait was about 20 more minutes. You can walk through each attraction in 5-8 min. I maybe saw only 10 total actual actors throughout the entire experience. They must've been short Everything was animatronic. And the majority of the walking you did was through dark hallways between rooms. It was not good. It was not remotely scary and I scare easy. It wasn't worth the wait in line or the money spent. Go somewhere else.

We discovered Better Bodies when looking for a place for my wife to work out after giving birth.

Justin, Steve and the rest of the crew at Better Bodies really care about each client.  They work hard to bring their expertise to bear in each unique situation.

Whether you're looking to get in shape and need someone to teach you how or just need the extra accountability a trainer provides, Better Bodies is the place to go.

They're almost always running a special of some sort so make sure to ask. (I went because they were doing a "spouse comes free" special.)
Great pizza!! Ran in really quick to grab a slice. Grabbed pepperoni slices. Had great flavor. Very close to NY style! Definitely will be back for another late night slice.

We've attended two birthday parties here in the past year and all the kids enjoyed it. They have two rooms with inflatable slides and bounce house type inflatables. Then you move to a party room at the end to eat. The pizza and wings were surprisingly good. But it seems a bit expensive for 10 kids it runs about $300, which doesn't include extra food or drinks for the parents.

I go to this pet store because it is very close to my house and they are pretty cost effective. It's nice to support local businesses especially now. I brought my not super social chihuahua in and he was just grumbling about everything and anxiously barking. But the employees made sure to give him some attention and that helped him calm down. This is good. We really need to work on our socializing and I feel like he made progress today.
I was looking for a new food. He doesnt need to be on the frozen food he was being fed and not only was I assisted very promptly, but the employees really know what they were talking about. I used to be a pet nutrition specialist so I knew what they were saying was true.
They were also super friendly. Made a not so great day a bit better!

This morning I got the raspberry paleo doughnut and the chocolate chip doughnut. Both were DIVINE. They are sweet and "cakey" while also leaving you feeling energized and healthy. A great Saturday morning treat to act as an intermission in my farmer's market ritual. I would go back for the raspberry 10/10.

We ordered two steaks, both medium rare. We got one  that was absolutely rare, and one that was well done with no pink at all. The staff was great, but it would be nice if a steak restaurant could cook a steak correctly. With sides and dessert-- $200.00 for two  people-- and that's without wine-- an additional $85.00 we paid for separately at the bar. So, almost $300.00 for two people-- and we won't be going back. 

There's another steak place across the street and East about a block. Next time, we'll go there.

We've come here a few times and it's always a gamble. Sometimes we go and they have an awesome guitar player/singer playing great music and the food is decent. Then other times the food is bad and the staff is unpleasant. 

This time, our waiter was really impatient. We had sat down and were immediately asked if we were ready to order. We had not even looked at the menu yet. 

He came back about five minutes later and asked us if we were ready, we weren't, then he came back one minute later and asked if we were ready. He kept asking us if we were ready, so much so, that he was actually making us take longer to figure out what we wanted because he kept interrupting.

We were ready to order - he came back and said, "one more time".... So we ordered. The food came back literally three minutes later. I was an idiot and I took about five bites. I immediately had to visit the restroom which had no toilet paper but ample paper towels. I had never gotten sick because of the food there before tonight. Because of the bad experience that I've had this time, I will never ever return.

I can see Friendly's being a top spot in some people's bar rotation, but it's not in mine.  If I am going to go visit a bar that still allows smoking, I'll take my talents to Colombo's.  Nonetheless, Friendly's does offer some perks:  Washers out in the back (outside so you avoid the smoke), super cheap drinks, and the real South St. Louis experience.  You will certainly be stared at upon entering by all of the regulars, but don't worry, they will make you feel welcome.  They don't call it Friendly's for no reason, you know!  I really can't speak for the food here, because I just stopped in for a bucket with some friends.  It's a great neighborhood bar that is worth checking out once at least.

I highly recommend doing one of these. Go at the 8pm showing because you'll get the full feel of haunting and the stories your guide tells you. Also, make sure to get Brent as a tour guide. He's super knowledgable, funny, and extremely sincere in his love for New Orleans. I've been to New Orleans three times and this is my first time getting a ghost tour. I wish I had done one earlier. Make sure to bring some money to tip your guide. They work extremely hard.

I heard their waxing pads are well made but I wouldn't know since it's been 11 days and my order still hasn't arrived. But that isn't what's frustrating for my first (AND ONLY) time as their customer.

I spent $200 on a variety of cleaning and waxing products, which I could have ordered from Amazon (as a prime member) and received the next day FOR THE EXACT SAME COST, but I thought I'd give the profit to the company directly so I ordered it directly from them.

I ordered online on a Thursday with the hopes of waxing my boat the following week, which I had planned a staycation to do exactly that...

On the following Wednesday when I still hadn't received the product, I looked at the confirmation email and saw a tracking #. I checked and it showed delivery the following Tuesday. (2 days short of 2 weeks).

I phoned the company with the hope of some type of discount or compensation for the ridiculous amount of time I was waiting. BTW, no coupon codes or freebies on my online $196 order. I spoke to "Gary" and explained the situation. No offers, no solutions, just a "that's highly unusual" and that he would pass on my concern to others. (Not exactly sure what that meant and my bad for not clearly telling him I thought his company should give me a discount or store credit.)

An hour after that phone call, I got an advertisement from the company offering me free bug remover if I ordered $40 of their product.

That really set me off, so I sent an email to customer service once again explaining how I victimized myself by trying to give them my business and that they should minimally credit part of my order or send me 5 bottles of their bug remover since I paid them 5X the amount of the minimum order. :)

I received an email stating my order clearly had a warning that it would take 5-10 business days and that the 12 days between order and delivery was actually only 7 business days. No apologies, no acknowledgment of my discount request, pretty much just a "GO FUCK YOURSELF" condescending reply.

When the product does arrive, I hope for their sake it lasts past the warranty period, as I will do everything in my power to return anything to this piss poor customer service company.  Then again, if something is defective, I'm guessing the chance of getting it fixed will be zero, based on the above.

This 2 boat, 2 car owner will be spending plenty in the future on cleaning products and I guarantee not one dime of that will go towards any Griot's Garage products.

The location in NW Reno continues to please time after time.  Fantastic value for the money.  Not to mention the quality and tasty factor!  At this point I have to try the Sparks location to see if it is as good.  You can't go wrong at the NW Reno location though, guaranteed.
I knew after having one chip this place was going to be authentic. Must try. Great flavors , nice atmosphere.
I stumbled on this place and fell in love!  The ice cream and cookies are awesome as is the service!!

Went back "home" for my monthly trip to New Orleans to see my handsome BF. Booked a cruise for Sunday, 10/18/15 and it was such a gorgeous day on the Mississippi River. New Orleans has really great weather in the fall and spring...like Cali weather! 

Had reservations for 10am. We arrived 15 min earlier but we should have gotten there at 9:30am which would have prevented us from missing getting our preboarding picture taken. Boo! I love taking pics with my BF...I cherish all the memories. I'm sentimental like that!

So anyways, it was a 2 1/2 hour cruise. We had the pleasure of being able to listen to our Narrator/Guide, Christopher Tidwell, who had lots of energy and awesome stories to tell us about the history of New Orleans. We had even asked him if he could sit in the back seat of our car and take a tour so we can listen to all his storytelling. Very fun and informative man! He's got a great voice. Make sure you get him if you book a cruise on the Creole Queen. 

We were able to eat the brunch Buffett that they offer at 10:30am downstairs on the boat. For $14 each person, they had all you can eat Caesar salad, pasta, gumbo, jambalaya, and bread pudding and it comes with a drink. Not bad at all! The bread pudding was good and they serve it hot too! We went for seconds, thirds...fourth servings. 

A little windy during the boat ride so take a jacket. 

Half way through the trip we stopped at Chalmette Battlefield and we were able to explore for 30 minutes. Wasn't expecting to get off the boat but that made it even more exciting! Love the history of New Orleans. This old city has a lot of character. This is one cruise that you don't want to miss. What a steal on Groupon! Glad I was able to take advantage! Of course, it always matters who you're with also...it made it such a romantic cruise! LML

Given all the rave reviews, we decided to try this place. Huge mistake! There were 7 of us and we went with the Chef's 6 course tasting menu. First course was scallops, and it definitely was not fresh as we could smell the fishiness the moment the servers brought our plates. That bad start spoilt our entire evening. Unfortunately, the rest of the dishes were nothing to shout about either. After dinner, we ordered an expresso but was served a big cup of regular coffee instead! Maybe it was just our unlucky night, but this place is now definitely off our list. At $120 pax, I expected better quality food and experience.

There are few places that I look forward to going to. This is one at the top of my list! Cheryl and her mother are truly the most kind hearted, gentle, knowledgeable people. They remove all the awkwardness out of colonics. You feel so great when you leave! This place is an asset to the community and your health.
Atmosphere is great. Beautiful yard. Customer service is probably the WORST I've seen in the city of NOLA. Especially for a person of color. Ridiculous!
What a surprise!  I live near here and never knew we had such a treasure!  They have good food great prices and a lovely patio.  Definitely worth your time in finding it!!

I was woefully incorrect about what size I am, the difference in my new bra versus the old is night and day and can be seen in my posture and felt in my reduced back pain. The woman who assisted me was professional and efficient (I think I was in and out of there in about 15 minutes - but there was no feeling of being rushed at all). They have a large selection, and she even offered to order a few bras that they didn't have in my size just for me to come back and try on. I found what I needed without that being necessary. I am now a huge fan of Freya and elomi, having bought 2 bras of the former and a sports bra of the latter (having been educated that if you have a large bust, any sports bra that can be pulled over your head will NOT be supportive enough, so underwire and hooks it is - but it is very comfortable). My total came to $200 even, which is pricey, but also an investment I think - spending less in a department store or VS for something that doesn't actually fit you is the true waste of money. They take your info and you get a discount on the 6th bra you buy. I would recommend and will probably return to look at their swimsuits.

I love this store because of the brands. I'm only giving 4 stars because it doesn't carry ALL of the brands I like to use or try, which makes me waste time having to go to Dillard's or Macy's -  at the end of the day, that particular dilemma won't prevent me from going :)  I did read from another reviewer that the sales reps do follow you around too much, which I totally agree with it being very annoying.
