I literally must say this was the worst restaurant experience I've had in my entire life, and I'm no youngster. Sadly, my mother had chosen Cracker Barrel for her 90th birthday dinner. First off, took forever to even get drinks which were for the most part waters only. Apparently waiter delayed putting in our orders so my elderly parents finally got their salads about 20 min later. 

Eight of us in party, six of which had issues with their meals. My husband actually ended up leaving due to delay of food and then wrong meal brought out after lengthy delay.   My niece, who is vegetarian, inquired on whether there was any meat in the gravy.  Several employees had agreed that no there was no meat in it. Come to find out after doing our own research online that YES there is!!
Major issue considering someone may have food allergy and they don't even know what's in their food. 

Needless to say, this was a catastrophe of a meal and I'm pretty certain I will never visit this restaurant again.

I really don't like the yelp rating system that much. 2 stars is average with yelp, i think 3 stars should be average or they should have a 2.5 star option. Marcello was very average with our food choices. Not bad but nothing really memorable either.

We went here on a weekday night. It was difficult to choose between the several restaurants on Farnsworth Ave. We had been to the Farnsworth House before, liked it a lot, but wanted to try something new. Marcello looked inviting from the outside and had the most customers. Probably should have stuck to the highest yelp reviews for our choice looking back.

We did not have the Pizza which most yelpers seem to love. Maybe that was our mistake. We had a two pasta dishes, one veal and one with a vodka sauce. They were just average at best. Nothing special, no wow factor, basically standard pizzaeria style Italian food. 

The outdoor seating is very nice. The staff was very friendly and attentive. If I came back again I would stick to the pizzas.

The chicken livers were fried to perfection and not overdone . Actually , some of the best I've had. The green onion aioli and pepper marmalade complemented them nicely. The St Claude burger was also cooked to a perfect medium rare , and it came with great fries and house made ketchup. My wife and I ate here for the first time yesterday and we  were both very impressed.   It's nice to have a place like this in the neighborhood.

2019 Solstice Parade was disappointing, as was the festival. It was my first time going, and I expected more floats and better quality ones. I liked the adult costumed dancing acts, but the rest was basically people putting a ribbon in their hair and walking up State street. I thought a festival that supposedly had over 100,000 attendees each year would be much better.

The festival wasn't any better. A few stands selling stuff, very few food booths and horrible music.

Was the first and last time I'm attending.

A decent pita place, I guess. Luckily I hit the place right before the lunch rush - otherwise, I think I would've been stuck in line for a while... the cashier was taking his time...

I grabbed a Caesar Chicken pita combo (comes with drink and chips) with tax and tip for $9. Seems a little pricy for what I got, but it tasted okay.

The Caesar Chicken pita has romaine lettuce, chicken, bacon, and some Caesar dressing (I forget if there were tomatoes... guess it wasn't that memorable of a pita). And you pretty much have to take it to go since there's no seating. The nice girl preparing my pita did offer me the choice of "Now or Later?" -- wrapped up or open so you can munch while walking.

Guess it's worth dropping by again...? 2.5 stars rounded up for the pita prepper.

So the service was good, food was great, but running after someone because you didn't like the tip that was left well that's just unfortunate. Never have I ever had that happened. Yes i loved the food yes the service was great, but if i had had the money to leave more then a freaking dollar i would have. So to the people who aren't getting a tip I apologize for not leaving one when my mother made me pay for her, my grandmother and her husbands meal when I only invited her and then I couldn't leave a proper tip, but running after us because we didnt leave a good enough tip awful!!
 ESPECIALLY FOR MY FIRST TIME EVER HERE!

I have to update.  Since my first review I have been there twice.  We got the original cannoli and a peanut butter cream pie.  The cannoli was okay and the pie was decent but nothing spectacular.  The cream was thick and creamy and the crust was pretty flaky even after being in the fridge for a few days but I started having my suspicions.  The third time my partner got a few cannoli's and decided that for some reason they just werent as good as they had been that first time.  When inquiring about their cheesecakes they informed us that they order them in.  Now, I might be naive but I was hoping this was a from scratch bakery but now I suspect that a lot of it might be frozen and assembled in one way or another.  I am super disappointed.  I wont be back as it's just not my thing.

I could go on forever about the trouble i was having finding a new policy for my vehicle when i Moved from Chicago to Las Vegas... Cody Johnson made every thing simple and within 30 minutes found me a policy at a great rate. I 
Highly recommend Cody and Balsiger Ins.  for auto insurance quotes, they worked with me on a lapse i had in my coverage and found the best fit at a better price then anyone else offered me

Just came here to get a breakfast sandwich to go before getting on the bus and the staff were so friendly and nice and made the sandwich literally within minutes and it was really really good. Didn't even need hot sauce or anything because the cheese was dispersed so well. I'm such a nerd for saying that. Yeah highly recommend it's a great spot!

I had my daughter at this center for 4 years. For the majority of 3 years I was perfectly happy and felt that my daughter was safe. Then new management came in. Since then, I don't even recognize most, if not all of the teachers there anymore. The retention is non-existent which leads me to think it's not just me. I have gotten nothing but a sour attitude from the center director. There is absolutely no control over the violent kids in the classroom. And when I have called with concerns about my daughter (once being stomped on the head) there was no call back or even an apology.  I also had problems with mistakes made on my account and have yet to see a refund after 8 weeks!  I used walk into this daycare and get a warm hello. Now its all eyes down and ignoring me. I would never put my child in a place like this again.

I went to the Mass Ave location. I think the menu is limited by having no salads. The crust was really good. I ordered a shaved mushroom and sausage pie. I didn't care for shaved raw mushrooms. I think it's totally overpriced. With tip for 2 glasses of mediocre Chardonnay and pie it was over $50.  I think I'll stick with Bazbeaux

As soon as you walk in the amazing smell hits you. It's a coffee cafe and roastery. 
Transcend is a quick walk through the ravine from my house. 
It's in the beautiful new Ritchie Market beside the beautiful 'Blind enthusiasm Brewery' 
You can sit outside at the tables with your dog or stay inside, the atmosphere is very charming, you just feel happy when you walk in. 
They offer classes, such as 'coffee tasting and appreciation course' if you want to be an aficionado or 'pour over brewing workshop'. 
These courses are ~ $30-$40. 
This is no Starbucks, this is java culture!! 
Maybe I'll see you there.

After hurricane Isaias came through the Philadelphia area and damaged our deck and our deck furniture, we contacted the Southern company to ask about possible repairs.  The entire process, from getting a quote to having our furniture delivered was seamless.  

Several pieces were damaged beyond repair and Sean was able to find pieces that would go well with our existing Winston set.  We are so pleased with the excellent job they did to repair and restore our set with new color and sling.  We certainly recommend them to everyone.
Really like their sushi and Tuesday is half price on a nice selection of rolls. Haven't tried the grill side, but ot seems popular.

A joke. I ordered a pot pie and didn't get an amount I was told "probably". Then I got to the window and the man was relaxing on it and just staring at me, I almost just wanted to leave. Reluctantly I gave him my card without knowing what I was paying because I was just hungry and annoyed. 
Not a word left his lips the entire time.

My partner and I decided to check out this place for breakfast Saturday morning and wow, I was pleasantly surprised! Our waitress was awesome, I wish I could remember her name. I got the Latin power bowl and WOW!! The Bloody Mary bar was also delicious and you pick your own toppings! We liked it so much we came back this morning for breakfast. I got the Lobster Bennie and it was definitely top notch. My boyfriend had the french toast and he couldn't stop talking about how delicious it was so he got it on both of our visits. If we ever come back to Clearwater this will 100% be our go-to for breakfast!

Parking is horrible here and they have someone up front making sure you are going to have an entree and sit in the front instead of the back (yes, they actually ask you this upon arrival!) otherwise they will not allow you to park.
My Cuban was okay but nothing special. Decent drinks but were a bit overpriced. Kind of a tourist trap, would not recommend visiting this restaurant.

Dealt with an extremely rude, condescending, belligerent associate. No idea why, right at "hello" he was just dishing it out like no one's business. Has Left me very concerned my package will be "lost".

Update: package wasn't lost and customer care was very interested in addressing my feedback.
LOVE this place, great selection of products with fantastic prices.  The staff working there is absolutely the best, it really a pleasure to hit this place often for our needs....  A+

I've been coming here many times the past few years and this time around has been the worst experience by far. Typically the service is not the greatest, but the food made up for it. However, I believe management changed or something changed and the service is worse than before and the food is crap. We asked for spice (medium) and there was ZERO spice. Then, the waitress had the audacity to say maybe we don't know what spice is and they can make it hotter. Besides that, the food was flavorless and over cooked. The boba was extremely mushy and has no texture to it. I recommend finding another Thai place to go to or change the type of food you will get that evening. Avoid if at possible!

Found this place just driving around town and decided to give it a try. It's definitely your sit-down Mexican joint rather than a quick stop or take out kind of place. The atmosphere is fun--I'm always a fan of true Mexican decor on the walls, authentic handmade wooden chairs, Mexican tiles decorating the floors and such.

The food bummed me out. My husband and I so wanted to like this place. The family has a great authentic story. But I just can't say I loved it and honestly it was just okay. I had the chile verde platter and it was lacking in flavor and a bit too spicy for chile verde. Almost like they were using too many spices to make up flavor and should've just used salt. The carnitas were chunked and lacked flavor in itself; the sauce carried all the flavor which I find odd. My husband had the Mazatlan, which was essentially fajitas, with chicken. His was better but not anything special. They served a giant platter of food with two tortillas which seemed odd to me but they didn't give us a hard time when we asked for more. 

We would love to find a place where we can order a bunch of platters for take out and have meals for a couple days at $50 but this is definitely not the place. $50 bought us two entrees and one beer each... that's a bit high for the area and the quality.

They did a terrible job and the salon is very dirty.  The tech was very hurried and my nails look like a child painted them for me.  The equipment also appeared dirty, so I asked if they sterilize their tools and they do not. The pedicure was not too bad but the towels that she used are not clean. They appear to have been used many times. I was horrified by this experience and only hope I do not develop any infections. I will not go back.  Stay away if you care about your health.

Horrible service. I had a yearly membership with 10 months (approx) left when I went to use the wash and was told it was expired. The manager told me he would meet me inside and then when I got in he went on lunch break instead. I was told he would call and follow up and of course I have never received a call and it's been well over a month now. I have also sent numerous emails to corporate about the issue and heard nothing back so now 2 months of money was wasted on a pass I am still unable to use.

I've been traveling quite a bit lately and this is my favorite airport.  Lots of seats with charging ports and security isn't especially stressful. I find it extremely easy to navigate and dont feel like I'm on a hike from heck just getting to my gate. I've flown Delta, AA and Southwest from here in the last year and all have  been fairly positive experiences.  The bathrooms are usually clean and the walkways almost always function. It also has a bright airy feel compared to some of the pressed and full airports I've visited in the past. This place is one of the few places that I'm glad to return to in the midwest.

The food was ok, we had the chicken and pork gyoza which were pretty good, but the dipping sauce was too spice for my 4 year old. I had the black garlic ramen, which barely had any black garlic in it. The music choice was absolutely horrible! I am a lover of all types of music, but please, if you're going to play rap music make sure it's censored! There is a time and place for that and it shouldn't be at a restaurant when I'm eating dinner in public with my family.

On the pricy side, but always has good food. Love the vibe of the whole restaurant. There are jukeboxes at every table and you can select a song to play. Good omelettes, big and can come with fruit, toast (of your choice), bagels and cream cheese, and home fries. There selection is good, plentiful, and healthy.

this is about the online ordering!! one star is too many. 
they lost two of my orders. one of them was a gift and i needed it at a certain time. well they offered to sell me another set, but would not refund me the lost set until weeks later. why would i pay for another set of cigars when i never got my first set!?!?!?!?!
so i'm done with this company. 
the money you think you are saving, you are losing everywhere else with these guys !!!!! 
beware!

Sirata has a nice location but is old and for the price of the room it was not worth the value. The place is a bit run down, the door was difficult to open, and the bathroom was extremely small. The view is nice, but the biggest issue I had was the morning of check out, 8 AM we were awaken by very loud weed whackers and blowers as yard work was being done that went on for over an hour just outside our first floor room. When I brought this up to Cindi at checkout, I got questions, really 8 AM? Really it was that loud? Really it went on that long? I did get a very insincere and uncaring, "I'm Sorry" your balance is.... will you be keeping that on your MasterCard. I wasn't looking for anything for free but a caring, I am so sorry I will speak to a manager and assure you that isn't normal and we hope you stay again.... or something to that effect but nothing. This front desk clerk could have cared less. Needless to say, there are a lot of choice in that area and many for less money or very close and I will not be staying at the Sirata again.

Causal and relaxed dinning at its finest! Amazing Chicago style deep dish pizza! Large pizza was filling and two toppings are included in price. With that, the prices are very reasonable. Overall, I would recommend this place to anyone who loves pizza. I will be back again and maybe again!
Hmm 24 hours but only taking delivery orders. I pulled up and they turned me away. Ya I'll pass on $16 for a $6 order when I'm already here....WTF

Made my way into Big O Tires bright and early on a Saturday morning to get an oil change and tire rotation. They were busy, however they still remained proficient and professional with great customer service. The cost was great and overall was a great experience. I will be back for my next maintenance. Thanks guys!

Such a beautiful interior accompanied by mediocre service and even worse food. The falafel was by far the worse thing I have ever eaten. The gluten free pasta was so incredibly hard that it was impossible to eat. For $21 (+ extra for gf pasta) this was probably the most overpriced terrible food I've ever had. Drinks were rarely refilled and no manager in sight. Yikes, really disappointed.

Awful experience.  Called on a Sunday..broken garage door opener spring....told it was extra for weekend but advised if I could wait until Monday, it would be much less money and he would set up the information so that I could get called between 7 and 8 am next morning to give me ETA for service.
By 8:40am no call....called same guy who said he would contact office and call me back..Now 9:30, no call back.  Called Office myself and spoke with manager who apologized stating they had a lot of messages but scheduled me for technician before Noon.  12:15, no show, no call.  Called Office again was sent to 2 different "service" people; told manager was not there but I was on the schedule.  I asked for an ETA; refused to give me one stating it would be that day.  Pressed for some kind of time frame as my cars were locked in garage and I was very concerned....she refused to call tech for ETA.  Repeated I would get a call and then confirmed my phone number...which was wrong...they had transposed last 2 numbers.  I corrected her and she said she would contact the tech with correct number but again refused to find out an ETA when she contacted him.
1PM I called another company who said they would be at my home between 2 and 4pm.  Now at 2:30pm other company arrived and did the job in 20 minutes.  Just as they were done, Overhead tech called me to tell me he would be there in 15 minutes.  I told him to forget it that I had hired another company due to the extremely poor customer service I had gotten on the phone.  Tech was very polite and understood my circumstance.  As a paying customer, we have choices and shouldn't have to put up with this nonsense!!  I never got a phone call AT ALL on Monday from the office.  Not acceptable!  Funny thing is I don't generally do reviews and never have done a bad one but I felt this deserved to be told.  Just now noticed that there are other bad reviews regarding the same situation....POOR COMMUNICATION....or in my case, none at all!

I think the ratings for this pet smart are pretty accurate. Staff are friendly but product for the carpet shampooer is a -10 score. The product is dirty, I don't think they clean it after it has been used. I think they expect the customer to clean it and then be able to just store it. 

If you don't have carpet shampoo.... buy it elsewhere. Otherwise you'd end up buying shampoo that costs an arm and a leg on top of renting the shampooer for a nose and an eyeball lol. 

It worked alright but it did not really do the work that a real shampooer would do. I'd go to invest in my own or buy a service from a professional than to rent here again. 

This place is expensive but they get stars because when they have deals.... they have great deals!

I have eaten here wayyyyy too many times since moving back to the area April 1st. I stayed with family in South Philly while waiting for my house to be finished and one day decided to get cheesesteaks for dinner. Usually I go to Pagano's or Larry's depending on if I feel like driving or dealing with City Line Ave traffic and the horrible potholes, that night I didn't. I tried Cosmi's and I'm sorry I did. The steaks were so juicy and flavorful, the rolls were soft and chewy and the fries? OH MY GOSH! I have had one almost every week since then. Once when I ordered I asked for them to give me half the usual amount of fries bc they give me sooo much! The fries are delicious and I'm pretty sure I've gained 100lbs since I got here! I'm really glad that my house is ready and I moved out of South Philly but I know I'll be back, I shop at the Italian Market!
This hospital does not follow proper HIPAA protocol. Very unprofessional staff in the emergency department, including the doctors and nurses.

I'll be frank, I didn't even get seated. My group planned to kick off one of our friends' birthday nights here, so we put ourselves on the list. The hostess said they'd call when a table opened up for us. Over an hour goes by --no call. So we head back over, and the hostess said she called and we never answered. But my friend's call log didn't reflect any missed call. The hostess did write the correct number down, and kept apologizing, saying she didn't understand how this could have happened. It was disappointing, to say the least. Case in point: Make reservations well in advance, and make sure check back consistently, or they'll pass your spot up for no real reason lol

This Wendy's just flat out sucks. Doesnt matter what time of day you go they just dont have their stuff. Today I went and got myself and a co worker so spicy chicken sandwich meals because we had a coupon. While our sandwiches are nice and hot our fries are cold and rubber like. This happens all the time, it's like they cook the fries when they first get there and dont cook new until they run out. Secondly since they were both meals we should have received 2 drinks, we got one because apparently neither teas had been made yet. So they asked me what I would like instead so I said lemonade, which apparently was also not made. So she asked me if I wanted a pop or a bottle of water too which I replied with neither. I could have taken the water but that isnt the point. 

I have been here before where they dont have chili ready or they said they sold out and same with the baked potatoes. 

I will from now on be choosing a different place to get lunch as no matter how many times I think it's going to improve it just doesnt.
If you are there early and get the warm yeast donuts you won't find a better donut in Indy.

Nice try SOL, but you are not the MIA.  Being from Miami, I understand the lure in wanting to mimic the club/lounge scene in this great party city, and the vibe at SOL def has potential, especially with a sweet ass DJ (Rob Lemmon was spinning on the night I decided to go).  However, the location is a ways down from the other bars in Central West End, as well as the time it closes (1:30 am, really?), but these matters could be overlooked given the good vibe the lounge radiates. What cannot be overlooked is that when there are only 20 people in the entire bar at 12:30 am, you are still charging cover, even though we are meeting people who bought 3 VIP bottles?!?!?!?  Check the attitude and learn better customer service, and this place could be a hot spot for STL.

Why I went again? I gave them another chance and they screw me up again.
My dish was cold and they brought the food to us on different times. So i start while my wife was still waiting and when I was done she got the food.
NEVER AGAIN.

This 7-11 is a rip off! First of all the night time employees rarely Speak English! Only enough to barely get them by! Like hi and bye! My problem is that they don't honor their promo prices! I buy 2 items that are supposed to retail @ $3.00. They almost always try to sell them to me @ $2.00 a piece! Then when I told the employee that the tax on 3 dollars is only .23 cents he tries to charge me $3.95!!!! It's sooo frustrating. I'm not stupid and I'm worried that other people are being overcharged on a daily basis! I don't tolerate the blank stares of the employees. Something needs to be done about this! I know it's only chump change but it adds up in the owners pocket...I would appreciate it if they were investigated!

I used to love this place but the quality of the food is inconsistent. Sometimes I love my usual order and sometimes it's cold and has strange lumps in the sauce. The restaurant offers delivery but my experience have varied from good to horrible. At first the woman who takes the orders always knew my address by heart and I never had to wait long for my food. Then one day I called and asked for delivery, the woman begged me to come pick up because her driver was busy, it seemed strange and unprofessional but I obliged. Since I am a dog sitter I'm in different houses a lot so on one occasion I ordered food at a house I was dog sitting at. The address was less than a mile away but it took the driver 45 minutes to get my food there and when he arrived he yelled at me and told me to never order at that address again, then he reached into the house and slammed the door shut. The next bad experience was when I was dog sitting at a separate address much closer than the one previously mentioned so I figured it would be okay. It took the driver 30 minutes to get there. I sent my boyfriend to pay for the food because I was afraid of being yelled at again. The food that night was less than average and I have not been back since. It's alright food but only order if you intend to dine in, take out, or if you live extremely close to the business.

Oceana Grill has very good crab cakes.
My friend and I ordered the crab cakes as appetizers. This dish comes with 2 pieces of crab cakes topped with crawfish tails and cream sauce on a thin bed of Romaine lettuce. Each piece of crab cakes contains a lot of real crab meat inside. The outer crust of these crab cakes is crunchy which adds to the joy of each bite.

My main course was the Grilled Ahi Tuna "La Boheme" with bbq shrimp toppings. The tuna slab that came was huge and I chose to have it cooked medium rare which came out just great. A small plate of steamed vegetables and garlic potatoes in a sea of melted butter also comes with this dish. The only negative side of this dish is that it was lacking flavor for both the sauce on the tuna and the bbq shrimp. This was quite a disappointment considering the crab cakes appetizers made us think the main course would at least keep the bar as high.

My friend had the Redfish Oceana, which was fried crusted redfish topped with crawfish cream sauce. This dish also comes with a small plate of steamed vegetables and garlic potatoes in melted butter. I had a bite of it and my verdict is the same as what I said for the tuna which was lacking flavor.

The service was great. Our server was very friendly. One positive note at this joint is that the food comes out very fast. 

We'd most likely return to Oceana Grill to try other dishes.

Terrible Gutter Cleaning: 
Received a mailer from APS.  Paid for a gutter cleaning service where they were to hand remove all debris, then clean and flush all the gutters.  The gutters had shingle stone build up in it like a muddy sand.  The service team spent less than 30 minutes and rushed through the job, literally running around on the roof.  I was  concerned for their safety and damage to the roof.  I found a dislodged roof nail after the service.   They removed a couple of handfuls of the the roof sand and then attempted to flush the rest of it down the spouts.  The result was roof sand splashed everywhere, clogged down spouts and half cleaned gutters.  I now have more work to do from the unprofessional service.  They even left a muddy handprint on the siding.  I should have read reviews first.
Great food. The service was awesome will come here again. Thank you akia for your great hospitality

Lately they been messing up my orders called them said they will send missing item right over called twice never showed up, called made and order asked for 5 items get 4 didn't get charge for the missing one but it showed I asked for 3 of the same item manager wanted me to place order again and pay for the delivery again plus taxes and of course I would have to pay a tip instead of waving the fees on the delivery. the sandwiches suppose to be $5.99 if order 3 or more but because I didn't state that they didn't come off at that price when I never had to before it should automatically come off get a sandwich that was skimpy on the meat looked more like a flat bread really like the food but considering not supporting this one because the way they handle their mistakes

I cannot even being to explain how much a diamond in the rough this place is. I found them on Facebook and I am hooked! I first went to the fishers location and loved it so much I immediately popped over to the Carmel location to see what they had too. They get all their furniture and decor from places like wayfair and Overstock and it is told to the public for a fraction of the cost. I am moving in a few months to a house that needs a lot of furniture, area rugs and light fixtures. That stuff  can get super pricey and add up quick but Salvage saved me tons of money! I got a kickback recliner for $40! Large ceiling pendant lights for only $9 each! And area rugs for $39. And a super cute dining table for only $149! I was grinning ear to ear when I left knowing what a great deal I got on everything. It's first come first serve but they post tons of their stuff on Facebook weekly so you get an idea of what's there. You can even call in and pay over the phone for something you saw online. Then for big stuff you pull around and they load up your vehicle for you. It's awesome! Definitely my new favorite place to buy furniture and home decor. Can't wait til they get their next shipment in because I will be there ready to shop!

This owner is by far the rudest person I have ever encountered in the service industry. We ordered a $100 cake, they messed up the order and didn't write Happy Birthday on the cake. When I asked the owner if she could fix it she started to yell at me and said we can either take the cake as is or leave.

I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

I hate to write a bad review but I also do not want people up at 2am like I am. The lady who checked us in was very nice. The room is clean and they have lots of cool things like bikes to borrow and large sized games but the street noise is AWFUL. My first clue should have been the earplugs they give you at the side of the bed. If you want to party this the hotel to stay at. It is close to restaurants and shopping and unfortunately lots of loud drunk people. It is not cheap to stay here either. Luckily we are only here for one night.

Not gonna lie, this place surprised me. 

I went in thinking it was just a local watering hole. And it is, but it also has some very tasty eats. 

Most surprised by the burger. I love me some burgers and it was really, really good. Now, I wouldn't recommend going here and eating if you don't like smoke. It's foggy for sure. 

Beer selection is great, and you have options if you want to go mix it up and drink elsewhere after as you have about 10 bars in a mile radius.

Here's the thing: Surgery is scary. 

There are tons of emotions and expectations when you enter into a process like this. The fact of the matter is, the process is adequately thought out and there's a purpose for the way they structure their wait times and scheduling. 

1) Bought the Groupon, great value. 
2) Wayne answered all my emails promptly, professionally, and was extremely knowledgeable. 
3) I was coming from out of town so clear communication and adequate accommodation was a must. They followed through perfectly. 

Here's what made me want to write a review for this clinic: After the surgery, there was an issue locating my script for the prescription eye drops. I was the last patient for the day and by the time I was at the pharmacy, I was worried they would've been long gone. I emailed Wayne explaining that I couldn't get my eye drops, hoping something could be done. He responded quickly, ensured me they will call it in, and even had Dr. Oliver wait on the phone until she got in contact with the pharmacist. On top of that, Wayne double checked to make sure the medicine was indeed filled. ON TOP OF ALL OF THAT, Dr. Oliver called and left me a voicemail, making sure everything was alright and that I had indeed gotten my medicine.

That sealed the deal for me. Sure, there are parts of the process that could be improved upon. Sure, there is a technician who comes across as rude but is actually extremely efficient and quick. However, at the end of the day, the work they're doing is scary for people like us. They know that and they care.

Any organization should continuously seek to improve their processes. But the experience I got with this particular Lasik Institute establishment was pretty darn satisfactory.

The food here was pretty good for our first meal in NOLA while visiting. The gumbo is a must as is the cajun tenders. Both were delicious. However, the girl at the register is rather rude for no reason but I've noticed its a thing here to be rude to other females but kiss ass towards male patrons. Just shrug the bitch off, and eat some good food. Its delish!

We visited this location this past weekend for the first time and I was not impressed. My burrito was ice cold and I had to stop eating it because it was so disgusting. I'm assuming their food warmers are broken. The portions are a lot smaller than what Qdoba and Chipotle offer but the prices were the same and even slightly higher depending on what you ordered. The chips given were stale by the next day so we couldn't even enjoy the leftover queso. Also this was during dinner rush and there was no one in the building! I should have known the food sucked since they didn't even have a dinner rush. Overall I'm disappointed and we won't be back. Save your money and go to Qdoba or Chipotle instead

Love love love this place!!  Steaks are alway delish. And if not the Manager makes sure it gets cooked how you like it!!  Bartenders are amazing!  Can't say enough about this place. Stephanie and Audrey Rock!!

Smaller than the typical WF which made for some cramped passings, but also a 2 second walk from end to end instead of an eternity of mazed aisles.

The bulk beans was an interesting idea.
The egg rolls were raw and cold, very dissatisfied, I don't think I will go back to this restaurant, boneless ribs were fatty

I ate at Fellini's on Valentine's Day with my husband. We had a wonderful experience! 

A friend had recommended this restaurant, so we were excited to try it out. We arrived a few minutes before our 8:00 reservation. We were promptly seated by a well-groomed, attractive man in a modern dining room.  The lighting and artwork set a romantic tone for our dinner. 

Our server was attentive and knowledgable, but also gave my date and I the privacy to enjoy our night together. We had the coconut shrimp, lobster risotto, and tilapia. Delicious! We finished our meal with the peanut butter bomb. Although I found this name a little insensitive, the dessert itself was so good!

I am so glad that we spent our Valentine's Day here! We will be sure to return soon.

It's been awhile since I've written a review and have been feeling that yelp itch. I visited ling and Louie's many times several years ago, but haven't been back since today. I figured this would give me good clarity on the restaurant for a quality review. 

The first thing that is noticeable is the decore. It's very sleek and modern and uses several antique pieces to give a nice character charm. Reminded me of a pier one. The only complaint I could see was how dark it felt inside. 

The menu was smaller than other Asian inspired locations, but I don't think that's a huge problem. They did feature sushi rolls which I didn't remember from my earlier trips so that's a bonus. I order a lo mein dish for the group and generals chicken for myself. It was very delicious with a good amount of spice too feel it but not be overpowered by it. 

After this last trip I definitely plan on revisiting again as I really enjoyed my entire meal. I haven't tried the American portions so I don't know how good those are. Enjoy!

They need to get it together because I love house music and would like to keep going to Vango...

SUCKS.. deserve no stars. I don't understand how the same mistake can happen  twice in two different year.. Last year I came here for dinner with my girls and we were told that my friend's card didn't work.. well used alternative method of pay but unable to understand why the card didn't work.. So decided to never come back to VAngo, Lastnite, Friends persuaded me to give it another shot.. Okay, at the end of the night I give the waitress my card, she brings it back saying it doesn't work.. I say to her, there is a lot of money in that card, it should work.. It didn't, SO i give her another card to use and it works its all good. Today, I check my accounts only to find that I was charged in Both accounts... Enough with these conveniences VAngo.

This place was so great. We were starving and this hit the spot. We got 3 different subs since we wanted to try them. The pork has a wonderful mojo marinade on it! The do load up the sandwiches with lettuce and tomato. Im not a fan or that so I ordered a pork with only mayo, still awesome! The philly was probably my favorite! The cheese and onions and peppers were perfectly hot and the sandwiches are pressed ( can get them not pressed). The sandwiches are freshly made and hot when you get them. We also ordered the soup, it was not what I was expecting but it was still tasty. It came with a little piece of bread which my 9 month old ate. They have hurricanes ( milk shakes) which I regrettably did not get, but I saw them and they looked killer. 
We did have to wait a bit for our food, but was well worth it. We apparently got there at a rush because we drove by 45 minutes later and it was not filled at all.
There is no inside seating- it's called the strawberry HUT. There is lots of cute covered seating though. We are in the car because we had been outside all day. The parking is decent, they work fast too. Lots of turn over in the parking. 
Go try! Not far at all from the highway!!

I would never recommend this place. There are plenty of other Chinese places around that provide exceptional food. I don't know what kind of chicken you put in my families dish of lo mein but it was not chicken. And it was not cooked properly. In fact, the spring roll had this green like rubber something in the spring roll. It was not food

My all-time favorite BYOB! Everything i've gotten here is delicious. All of the pastas are amazing. My favorite is the pasta with the shrimp, scallops and pink cream sauce. I love to split the pizza margarita for an appetizer. The pizza is a thinner crust and the sauce is amazing. Also the calamari and mozzarella starters are great as well. Love this place!

The service is excellent, the decor is like a Hello Kitty Sailor Moon cupcake kawaii anime girl's dream come true, and every flavor looked and tasted delightful. Did I also mention that the prices for ice cream were good?

For $4, we ordered two scoops in two separate cups. That means more dessert for us! The funfetti ice cream was good. The strawberry ice cream was creamy, fresh, and perfect. They should be relabeled as the Creme Savers brand because it was basically that flavor in ice cream form.

I was also really cold afterwards and requested for a cup of hot water. They were about to give me a complimentary tea bag as well but I didn't need it. The employees are so nice and so happy, but that should be expected in such a lovely store like this.

For a Dosa place to be "stand out" in my book, they have to make much better dosas  than what I eat at home. Yeah, I am unfair! Dosa is my staple diet and I would have possibly consumed at least twenty to thirty thousand dosas in my life time. That makes me the expert on dosas, does it not?! 

Kidding apart, dosas do not need advertisement or a justification. But Philadelphia Chutney company tells us that people in the "third-world" need it to sustain themselves (third world, really? It is almost derogatory now although it was initially coined in a "non-alignment" context) because it is quite often the only source of nutrition (Carbs etc.,) for them. When you go in, you are greeted by a young man who looks fairly crest fallen and is almost cursing his luck to be serving you. He says "thanks" and knows his manners but no small talk, mind you. He means business and  believe me that attitude cannot be good for business. Maybe I caught him on an off-day. 

Coming to the dosas themselves, pretty below average. Tastes flat without the sour tingle that hallmarks a great dosa and distinguishes it from the also-rans. Sambhar is an apology. "Fresh" Chutney is served from a refrigerator. 

I went here on recommendation from a friend. I am going to have a little chat with him soon!

"Woohoo! As good as it gets!" ...it really is, considering the fact that you're in Reno!

Edge has been open for a while now, and it still has great word of mouth from both the locals and out of towners! ;D 

The last last time I was here, my man's friend got the VIP room handed to him. I guess he gambled too much. Good thing for me as they had it flowing in there. Bottles were everywhere and chasers were always stocked and ranged from juices to Monster energy drinks! 

The attire is semi formal. Guys always in non white shoes and dress shirts/jackets. Only rarely have I seen a guy get in in just a shirt and a vest! Also I have NEVER seen a guy get in there in jeans!!! And women, well we get in regardless. ;D Fancy flipflops or heels, dresses or jeans will work with us ladies.

Came here last Saturday with my girls. They made us go in two lines. The left lines were I guess people who were "on the list." They walked up the slanted floor before us. Well, we were on the right, and I swear I thought I was going to wait forever. Eh not really... :D The doorman called me, said something like "To me these girls are on the list," and we walked right past all the other people who were on the left line. SCORE! Got in for free and way before the people who were on the left lane...puhahahahaha

Walked in and the music was already crackin! A girl was getting body painted to the right. :D Of course we headed to the bar and started our shots! Kamikazes please. One down! Tab open ...the club was already filling up! That's always a good sign. The second bartender offered a fruity drink (of course with a cost) and it turned out to be purple haze.. Some drink that was grape based. YUMMM. It was a good night. I had to leave for a couple hours and headed down to Bubinga, which compared to Edge sucked! Waste of taxi money! I came back to Edge and oh man you know it was a good night! (I had a wristband slapped on before leaving...)

Walked to Edge's ropes again. Everyone was having a great time. The doormen were still very professional and there weren't anyone getting thrown out...Went up the elevator, and I swear the crowd grew 5 times more than when I left. Went back to the bar where I played marco polo with my girls. :( I had lost them and thought it was going to be a short night. I got my Midori sour, made conversation with some guys next to me and God answered my prayers and sent my girls walking towards me! Yay! We took a couple more shots. Then headed for the dance floor. UGH I missed Edge. THe music is great and they always know when to turn on the fog machine and  when to splash us with some water lol good times. 

The DJ seemed to be having a blast too because he had music playing one after another in a good rhythm too! Sadly, my night had to end :( Walked out to the gorgeous patio. Got some fresh air and started my way to the garage. Walking down the elevator, the same doorman wished me a good night, literally, and I proceeded out of the second floor. 

Edge has never failed to give me a good night. From the great seating set up to the awesome bartenders and yummy drinks, it's always a good time at Edge! ;D

I come here on the weekends for the great breakfast burritos and some coffee.  Olivia is usually working, always is in a great mood, and helpful. She definitely takes pride in her work.  I strongly recommend this place!

What can I say, I love me some Bellacinos. We almost exclusively get take out from there and I get a half Italian specialty and my husband gets a BLT. We then split a small pepperoni pizza. It's all tasty.

Although our dog seemed to do well with Michelle it she seemed like she took shortcuts. Not doing anal glands unless reminded. We asked not to shave her but just wash and blow dry due to skin allergies, she still shaved her. . We were no longer in her area but was told she would keep us but would be every 6 weeks. She then raised her prices to $95. when other mobile groomers charged $70. We took the hint. Not professional.

I needed 4 custom cabinet doors made. I informed her that I would get one other price so I can make an educated decision.  she shoved it back in my face and told me she's not interested. Her loss because we're gonna do our kitchen next. Rude!!

Me and my girlfriend were looking for a good place to get some food for Restaurant Week and we stumbled upon the menu online. The choices they had looked very appetizing so we decided to check it out. When we first walked in, there was no one to greet us and the place was not what we expected at all. When we were finally greeted by a server, we told her that we had reservation and they escorted us to this little shitty table right near the doorway where the draft would just freeze us every time the door opened. The whole place was very dark with this blue lighting across the ceiling being the only light in the bar. Service was alright, nothing special. 
In terms of the food, my girlfriend and I both ordered the Caesar salad for our first choice, which was coated in a little too much dressing but contained an interesting spicy kick. For our second choice, my girlfriend had the chicken dumplings which she rated 8.5/10 along with mentioning that they were very flavorful. I had the calamari which was very good but quite battered and came with a very nice marinara sauce. For our main courses, my girlfriend had the Shrimp Fondue which she rated 9/10 and I had the Filet Mignon which I would rate a 9/10 as well. For our desert, we both had the cheesecake which we both rated an 8/10.  
Overall, the place was decent in appearence but had really good food. We also ordered a hookah (Watermelon and Mint), which was very good as well. Wouldn't be a bad place to check out.

Wow, don't let the outside fool you. Very pretty & cozy inside. I have found it difficult to find good tasting local Asian food. Now I can say Han Dynasty is the best Chinese I've eaten. Definitely will be returning. Definitely go on a off time since they are known to be very busy & short staffed.

The worst customer service ever, chicken strips were over cooked, French fries were stale , went into the restaurant to complain, the store manager was dismissive and rude . She said she would give me fresh chicken strips , less than 5 minutes later gave me the same chicken strips I returned for being over cooked. Do not go to this restaurant the food is consistently over cooked , this is not the first time I have experienced over cooked food.

I've been here twice now. Once to drink late-night on a Saturday and another time for dinner during the week. The late-night drinking was your typical sit at a table and drink a few beers. Service was good and the decor was cute. I returned for dinner with my two friends around 6:45 on a Monday and was seated at a booth. We split the house guacamole and chips, both were fresh and tasty. For an entree I had the Gringa tacos (chicken) which came in an order of 2 hardshells. I'm not normally a hardshell fan, but these were good! Not too salty, perfectly seasoned and generously filled with lettuce, avacado, and whatever else they had in there. I didn't get the platter with the rice and beans, but my friends both did and they were fully satisfied. There isn't too much seating, so aside from the large table it the back it might be difficult to seat a large group here, but overall definitely a place I would recommend.

They have availability to sit outside. Service customer is excellent. The waiter who took our order was so nice, friendly and did GREAT recommendations about food and drinks. We got some cocktails which were different and we all liked it. Sushi and bowls were awesome. Music outside was also appropriated. I loved the place and I would come back

Rude staff and slow service. Excellent food with great flavor! The cocktails are wonderful. 
A great new menu to add to Fishers. Will keep going back in hopes they work out some kinks.
Also, the parking is HORRIBLE. So keep that in mind.

I had my eye lashes done twice here. The first time was great and second time was horrible. Both were different employees. 

Second time I did a classic eye lash and the one set on my right eye almost all fell out the next day. I had to use mascara because it looked horrible. I went back to do a fill 3 weeks later and she told me she had to take them off and I had to pay for a full set. The only reason I had to use mascara was because it looked horrible and than I have to pay to redo my entire set? What they should have done it it refunded me the first time since the girl clearly didn't do a good job because the first person that did them they stated on for almost 2 full months!

I don't like giving bad reviews but this was the worst pizza ever. Both pizzas were scorched a little and the wings were burned to a crisp. Since the pizza was delivered, I most inconveniently drove back to Matteo's for a refund on the wings. They took a peek and gladly gave a refund with no explanation or sympathy. Do yourself a favor and bypass a rude awakening.
Call ahead to order if you are on a lunch break. Food is great. I love to support black owned businesses. Vegan and vegetarian options available!

I have been coming to Affordable Brakes and Tires for years. I have always been retreated with respect and honesty. Work always done correctly and at a great price. Tires are so nice for a reasonable price. Go ask for Shiva, Ruby or Sandy they are simply the best so nice, caring and get the job done right.. But stay clear of a guy named Gabe... He is rude, he price gouges you, talks to you like you're stupid, his customer service skills are truly lacking to say the least...

Golden Doughnut is not a destination bakery shop in the tradition of Beiler's, but it is handily located in the Italian Market and it is more than good enough if you are in the vicinity.  Sometimes while food shopping in the outdoor street market, a sweet doughnut is just the thing.  And I can promise you that you won't find doughnuts any cheaper anywhere.  Their 10-for-a-dollar glazed doughnut pieces is a totally tasty bargain.,,and I do like their filled doughnuts - especially the crème-filled.

Good store for 3/4 of my needs, but as someone else pointed out, limited supply of organic produce, which is pricy and often not as fresh as I'd like.  Turnip Truck is also pricy, but has much better quality organic greens.  Otherwise, great selection of things like organic milk, yogurt, chicken, etc., in a pleasant environment. Parking is easy and well lit--feels safe at night.

Our second attempt at a dim sum lunch in Philly led us here today. 

We ordered a total of 13 plates (for the 2 of us), and we took a fair amount home because of how much food there was. 

some of the highlights:

-xia chang fen (shrimp in rice noodle wrap) - this was really pretty good. there were only 2 shrimp per piece, but the rice noodle wraps were chewy and good and the sweet soy sauce that accompanies this dish was perfect. this was one of the best things we had today.

-sticky rice in lotus leaves - this was also very good. I liked also what the had inside (which included taiwanese sausage). very sticky, very flavorful, very good.

-their xian shui jiao (deep fried salty dumpling) and deep fried taro dumpling were monstrously large and very oily. a little too much for me.

-I think we were a little thrown off with how BIG some of these items were - much less "refined" than what I was expecting, and in my opinion, the size of some of these dishes detracts from the whole idea of ordering TONS of different little dishes (less is more) to sample more different tastes.

I think some dishes were better here than joy twin lao (namely the xia chang fen & sticky rice), and others better there (xian shui jiao, cha su bao), but given that you might likely leave joy tsin lao's, with a little more cash left in your pocket, I think I'd have to give it to joy twin lao's for the advantage.

however, my trek is not done yet - still have to try dim sum garden and ocean harbor before deciding where the best dim sum in philly is.

This place is delicious! I'm new to the area and love Thai food and my coworker mentioned to come here. I got the Pad Thai and my husband got the chicken fried rice. Both were great! Large portions and good flavors. Will be coming back!

One of the cooler spots in DT STL for really good drinks. The bartenders are top notch and true professionals, you won't be disappointed with what they make. The main bar scene is cool and you can tell this was a bank back in the day. With that in mind it's a really big space and there is a struggle with the open event space. I plan to go back a little later in the evening and see if the sun being down makes it feel more intimate.

1:30 in the afternoon on a Wednesday...this is obviously the place to be! Food is great. Restaurant is packed. It just doesn't get much better...people are laughing, the kitchen has its noises, the music in the background... I had the Chipotle Chicken and Chipotle Beef Tamales...yummy!
We always enjoy the wonderful food here. The service is superb. You can't go wrong here. Especially at happy hour!

It's really hard to find anything in this store, employees included. I must have walked that store about 8 times before I found the pasta. Maybe it's my own fault for not reading the signs, but these aisles are so long it's hard to see what products they have and where. This was my first time ever shopping at ShopRite. The lighting was a little too dim for my liking, it gave me the impression that the store was dirty, even though it wasn't. 

The cashier was so friendly and I didn't have to wait at all in a line for checkout. On a busy Sunday afternoon, that's pretty good, so added star for that perk. They do sell beer and wine. Overall I will probably stick to a different store for my shopping.

Drinking at 1 Tippling Place is a bit like drinking in your grandmother's living room, if your grandmother was an eccentric hoarder of beautifully-upholstered seating and tables of all shapes and sizes. It's cozy and comfortable, and you can always play a game of "which chair would YOU take home?" with your companions.

Another great feature of this place is the way the seating is arranged. A series of loveseats and chairs are arranged around a table, which encourages you to have a conversation with the strangers you're seated with. If you're going out with the goal of meeting new people and having interesting conversations, this is a great spot to imbibe. Oh, and the cocktails are creative and delicious, and always served with a smile too.
Was very impressed with the doctor and her staff. I made the right choice by switching to Van Dyke The doc took time with our dog and explained everything to us

I've been here twice... once with a big group. that was terrible because they place us awkwardly in the middle of the room in this very long table... never again! and i was there with two other friends- not too shabby.

the food is ok... my sandwich had paper in it... i guess thats cool if you like paper. i was grossed out and stopped eating. it was $2 draft beers so i guess i washed it down with my beer. 

my friends got a dish that was titled melt... they assumed sandwich right? nope! it was chicken in a bowl with melted cheese on top. who knew you had to be specific? they also have stuff on the menu that they don't carry anymore... why would you leave it in the menu?!?! its rather disappointing because then you have to look for something else.

the service is not bad but nothing to rave about.. and the atmosphere itself is ehh. you're not missing out if you don't ever go here.
I will give this 1 star and thats only for the cheap price of the drinks.if you think this is an irish pub you must be high.  The Guinness was stale in an irish pub.  That pretty much says it all.
This place is great. The coffee is excellent. So are the pastries. I might have a slight addiction to their banana pudding.
The nacho cheese they use on their nachos is gross. Felt sick after. Nasty food and slow service.

This place is a madhouse.  Very confusing setup.  You wait in line to order.  Then you have to go one place to pick up your salads and another place to pick up everything else.  Everyone hordes the tables, so after you finally pick up your food, you are lucky if you can find any place to sit.  The condiments section doesn't include any mustard (c'mon people - it's a hot dog restaurant!)  Too bad it is such a hassle because the food itself is very good.   Next time I'll use the drive thru.

Very good food, owner greets at door, take his suggestions for dinner it's very good plus you try new things this was. Nice atmosphere quiet fast service and did I say good food? I would come back here over and over its that good.

I wish I could give this place more then 5 stars. We take our 3 cars here for pretty much anything and everything.  If they can't do it they will tell us..... but there isn't much that they can't do for you. Lawrence is the owner and he runs a very honest, 'the customer is always right' shop.  Whenever our cars need servicing Lawrence will get us in. If there is a big job needed he finds the parts for the lowest possible low price. We have a 1996 Rover Discovery and he is the only guy we trust with it!  Great local place!
This is my go-to place for excellent carry out Chinese...it's actually the ONLY I trust in Fishers! Great people and SO good!

I moved in almost 5 years ago and the place was older, but the maintenance actually took care of things and when you called the front desk for help, the staff there (they were different, actually helpful) answered, and took care of your request.  A lot has changed with their new management "Northland".  They truly do not care and it shows in the staff, lack of maintenance of the grounds (garbage everywhere, especially the ponds!), and all the big dogs they allow in the building barking all hour of the day and night, and poop everywhere and nothing is ever done, so watch where you walk.  
When you call, if the staff answers the phone (which is rare, generally, it just goes to voicemail and they do not EVER return ANY calls), they'll take down your apt.# and then days go by and nothing gets done.  You call back a few days later to see about your request and someone says that Wayne never wrote it down. I am honestly not sure how he is still employed there.  
There is also another snotty plus sized African American woman at the front desk that acts like she LOATHES her job and literally breathes heavy every time you go in to ask for help.  As if it is PHYSICALLY hurting her to help you, even though it's her JOB.  After I moved out, I was told to pay my final water bill, so I did.  I am still getting bills for even more water usage.  Also, my lease was up September 1 and I moved out on August 25, paid my last rent bill August 1, and by August 26, they had changed my locks!!  I am pretty sure that's illegal.  I couldn't go in and get the last of my things the next day because the office was closed.
The water is shut off constantly during the day, and there have been more than a few times I went to do laundry and they had shut off the water in the washer and dryer room and NOT PUT ANY signs up or warned anyone.  When I asked why, they looked at me with deer-in-the-headlights faces, as if they shouldn't have to notify us.  Of course, they did not refund the $6 I put in the washers, either. I was just on my own.
Keep in mind, I am a tenant that has been here nearly 5 years, have been very quiet, never one time paid my rent late.  I CANNOT imagine what they do to people like that if they treat ME this way. 
I do not recommend living here ever.  Seriously, run....FAR FAR AWAY!
There was nothing spectacular or different with my turkey burger.  The fries were yummy.  I liked the monkey and the paintings on the wall, pretty cool.

We just had a wonderful brunch buffet at this hidden treasure.  It is almost invisible in a 2 story storefront complex of little shops.  Interior is small but pleasant.  Sunday offers a brunch from 10=2pm with a great variety.  Two kinds of pita, one with a baked crust of zataar (thyme, sumac, sesame mix), boiled eggs, eggs with potatoes and cheese, eggs with zucchini, felafel, tsatsiki (yoghurt, garlic, mint, cuke) sauce, a lemon-garlic sauce, hummus, babaganoush,  labneh (thick, greek-like) yogurt, assorted pickled olives and other veggies plus sliced fresh. We ate out fill and since we were the only 2 customers at 11am, the owner kindly explained dishes, chatted about Jerusalem and sent us home with the makings for the zataar crusted pita.   A pity there were not more customers but we got special treatment.  
Other a la carte dishes included lamb stew, shwarma chicken, grape leaves, Jerusalem and other salads.  Best of East Med so far and reasonably priced.

To be fair and honest with this review, I've only had Ms Goody's Cupcakes at events which she has visited (for Yelp and others).  However, every cupcake I've had has been soooo good that I have to review.   More importantly, I need to make it out to Passyunk to get more...  Go for the more unique offers over your standard fair and enjoy!
Holly was great. We had the sliders and the Brussel sprouts. Great experience and so glad we got lucky to find this place. Loved the food. Highly recommend. Enjoy!

My office ordered catering from this place and that was my introduction to cheesesteak grilled cheese sandwiches. I've visited this place twice on my own and I do enjoy the food. The fries are absolutely amazing, crispy and not too soggy. They don't skimp on the meat or cheese. I do wish I could order without onions, but I suppose the cheesesteak meat is pre made. Their location on 19th St is very clean and modern. There is a little bit of a wait for the food, maybe 5+ minutes, but the worker came out from behind the counter and handed me my food which I thought was a small gesture but I really appreciated.
Food was good and prices were pretty hood too. Pretty diverse menu and a soup and salad bar. Service was excellent.

OK - SO ...I am not going to bore you with a long review because you absolutely cannot go wrong here. PLEASE go there if you are even looking at this place as a possibility.

Guacamole
Chorizo Tacos 
Fish Tacos
Roasted Pok Tacos

All AMAZING! Wow. I can't wait to go back. 

BYOB makes it five stars! Authentic Mexican served by Mexican people, offbeat location in an unassuming but EXTREMELY clean environment. (I am sorry - but normally the bathrooms are sooooo gross but this one was absolutely spotless, smelled good and looked good) And...I hear that if you bring your own tequila they will make you fresh margaritas. HELLO!

This is our new "the place" when we go to Philly for the day with the fam ....and I don't see it changing any time soon.

I am not a wing eater but I agreed to accompany some co-workers to BWW's for a quick lunch break to escape the hectic-ness of the office one day. I was not super hungry either but I saw they had mac n cheese on the menu for something incredibly cheap like $2.99. The waitress said it was creamy so I went for it. Actually enjoyed it. Not the best I've ever had but not the worst either. The pasta was actually pretty tough which I like...sometimes mac n cheese suffers from icky overcooked pasta. Service was kinda slow, which was my only complaint and the smell of hot sauce was overbearing in the restaurant. Eventually I got used to the smell but it was off-putting for the first 10 mins or so. I see they have other things on the menu besides wings so I'd probably go back here again with my coworkers if they wanted lunch here.
Not the best tacos I have had, but not too bad either. Some of the better Mexican food in the area , which is hard to find.

I hope you're hungry...This food is incredible!  
I recommend a large Cuban, tell mama you want it "all the way" (with lettuce, tomato and onions)
I come here from Chicago a few times a year and it's always my first stop when I get off the plane and my last stop on the way back to the airport.
Running way from a coldest place to touch the local fresh popularity...everything is fresh to me!

A tiny cramped store stuffed with specialty foods. My sister and I came here eager to try the cheese and smoked meats. The staff were very friendly, but also VERY push salesmen, pushing us to purchase this meat, to go with this cheese, etc. Also of course, prices are very high. They were also very generous with samples as well, without making you guilty for wanting to try a taste! We got several cheeses, duck and regular procuttio, and bread. My sister enjoys procuttio more than I do, and while it was good, I didn't think it was fantastic, I thought I would enjoy the duck procuttio more. The sheeps cheese I chose was very good, as was the bread. Overall this place is fun to visit and try out, but I couldn't do this very often we left after having spend almost $70! A nice experience though.

Took our Cali fam here and it is honestly the best buffet you can find in Reno. Seriously!!! Hands down!!! Service was great with a smile.  We're a very mixed fam (Spanish, Chinese, Irish and Filipino) so we're VERY particular about our native foods.  This is why we chose this place.  They got the spicy tofu right!  The Chinese mixed vegies with cabbage was perfect!  To our surprise they had the best tasting pho (in a buffet setting) around town.  Yes, we know its pricey, but it's worth it and you'll feel satisfied at the end of your meal.  Our kids are very picky eaters too and they loved it and are constantly asking us to go back when we try out these other buffet places.  Proof in the pudding right there!  If you have kids, they'll love it!  It'll be a great place for young fams too!  ...VERY clean and they have staff that are like eagles when you need your plates cleared or need a refill.  ...again, with a smile too!  They obviously take care of their staff, which is important to great quality service.  Yes, I"m a manager from the public and private sectors.  I know.  It's also about looking back at great memories too when you're on vacation, right?

It was game day for the Saints, so of course expect a wait, but the hostesses we super nice and were working everyone in as fast as they could. The food was pretty good and we made it to the game before kick off!!

I started bringing my sons here a couple of years ago after them telling me no where we go gets their hair cut they way they like it. After the first time here they have never complained once and are happy every time they walk out the door. (Which says a lot being that they are teenagers) My sons especially love the hot towel and the cold soda after the haircut. Any of the girls are wonderful and know what they're doing. Our favorite is Chelsie. I highly recommend to stop in and get a fresh cut.

Wonderful experience. Quaint, comfortable, cozy place. Had a grilled cheese with tomato soup which was good, and a Mediterranean Wrap which was excellent. Didn't need all the pickles, the coffee was good, had about 5 choices for self serve.

Had a great tour with Karen learning about the history of the world's s second oldest profession.  Very knowledgeable and relaxed pace.  Breaks for a "to-go" drink or two were greatly appreciated!  Karen also went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and even dealt with an awkward moment with a couple of folks smoking.   We did 4 tours in Nola all from different companies this time and I think this was my favorite. Well done.

I hate leaving  lukewarm reviews but I probably won't be returning to PC whoop. Some of the staff members are really nice but others not so much. I dropped my macbook here to get fixed and they told me they needed to install a new keyboard and suggested I get a new hair drive as well. Since I haven't had issues with the hard drive I decided just to get the keyboard fixed. Fast forward to a month and a half later( I was out of the country) they still did not do any repairs on my laptop. Apparently they forgot to since they wanted to wait to see if I will change my mind on the hard drive. When I said no again they said they were still waiting for the keyboard since they didn't have it in stock. The guy was rude about it and didn't seem apologetic. Even suggested that at the same price they would find a old keyboard to install so I can finally get it back. No one should wait 2 months for a new keyboard. Also when I picked it up it had dust all over it and they didn't even bother to wipe the screen down.  Any place for repairs actually puts a little more effort than that. Hope they will work out the kinks at this place.

I'm a big fan of this Anthropologie--they have a huge variety of items, but it's still pretty airy so there's plenty of room to move around and you don't feel like you're constantly bumping into things (a problem at Anthro in general).  They also have a pretty good range of sizes, which means that pretty much anyone will find lots of cute things to fit them.  Even my mother (who usually HATES shopping) found a sweater she adores here when she came to visit, and I credit this experience with helping her warm up to shopping in general, which is basically a miracle.  There are always plenty of people here, but I've never had to wait for a dressing room--the only downside is that sometimes the line to check out is a little long, but that means more time to look around at the jewelry, right?  Every trip to this Anthro results in my coming home with tons of cute clothes and other trinkets, which is dangerous to my MasterCard, but makes me so very happy.

This restaurant is very central to shopping and I decided to come out here based on proximity to the hotel. 

Decided to sit at the bar and take in the sports that were playing on several flatscreens. The bartenders were friendly and the bar has about 50 beers on tap. There were 2 bartenders on our side of the bar who were very attentive and were happy to suggest beers to try.

The environment was very yuppy, a lot of guys in collared shirts and dressed up women. It appears they get in here early for happy hour. I ordered the buffalo chicken pizza on a recommendation from the bartender. I was dissapointed to find that the pizza looked like it was melted cheese on a cracker since it was so thin. Also, there was blue cheese and fresh-cut carrots and celery on it as toppings. Just weird and the ingredients didn't go well together. If I wanted buffalo wings I'll order them. 

Bottom line: Cool environment to grab a beer and socialize but I'd come here on a full stomach next time.

Awful service.   The guys that serviced my recycling in  Colebrookdale Township are the most miserable workers.  I get it may not be the most enthralling job but try harder.  They would throw my bins on my lawn or in the street.  I'm not asking for neatly stacked.  They ran over my neighbor's kid's basketball and laughed about it.   Now the manager did come out and replace it so I commend the managerial staff for that.   It is not a shock they lost their contract with my township.

Christel once again is providing exceptional service, and this time I'm spelling her name correctly. She is definitely a jewel, which is why I inadvertently misspelled her first name. She told me it's fine, but I know what it's like to have folks misspell a first name.

This review has to do with the leasing of a new GMC Terrain. My sales rep, Connie W. spared no effort to find the car with the options that I wanted.  What made it extremely difficult was the additional criterion that it had to "qualify" for GM's extra $1500. rebate.   Connie and the management team found and was able to get my car delivered within a week.  I found out later that this was the last model available in a 200 mile radius. That did it for me hence the 5 star rating.   Look for more reviews as I "experience" the service dept, etc.

Dynamix did a wonderful job on my son's birthday party a few years back. We also just had our sons ages 2 and 5 take a week of summer camp here. Both boys enjoyed it and we will certainly be back for more gymnastics.

took 30min to get a single sandwich when i was the only person in the store. at first i thought they were slow because they were new. now i know they are just slow and inefficient. good for but definitely not worth my time. never again

There's nothing quite like that perfect pair of shoes, especially if you're one, like I am, who suffers from diffuse foot ailments. When I find the perfect pair, I want them to last as long as possible.  Unfortunately, averaging almost 20,000 steps per day, the soles of my shoes quickly disintegrate.   Thanks be to God that I found Cento's Shoes.

I like mom-and-pop shops; they have dedicated owners whose top goal is customer satisfaction.  Cento's Shoes is the paradigm of a generational business, and its atmosphere arouses memories of yore: times when quality and craftsmanship mattered.

I love my Samuel Hubbard shoes, and I was nervous for anyone, other than the manufacturer, to service them.  My initial instincts were wrong.  During my first visit, the owner and I discussed the perfect sole, based on comfort and durability.  The following day, he texted me a picture of an available sole, which I accepted.  In less than a week's time, the job was complete.  The shoes were immaculate, shined to perfection, and all their various nicks and notches were repaired.  The new soles provided a more comfortable wear than the originals.

Cento's Shoes also sells a variety of shoes, care products, and an eclectic selection of hats.  It's the kind of shop your grandfather visited on his way to Lovers' Lane.

Cento's Shoe's is a must for anyone who owns fine footwear, and they have my highest recommendation.
Amazing pizza and great service! We got three different pizzas and all of them tasted great.

This is as good as it gets for Korean Fried Chicken. Easy going staff and a plate full of food. I went with the secret spicy whole chicken and did a medium size, more than enough for one person. I would recommend splitting the fries and maybe skipping the dumplings. OverallBBQ Chicken a great experience and I will be back!

My listing agent/realtor forwarded along some of the unprofessional comments from one of their realtors to mine so I guess I had an inside look after we were under contract. After seeing their comments I did not even want to sell the home to them anymore and was left upset and unwilling to budge on any demands their side made. The sale eventually failed because of either a lack of communication between agents and sellers/buyers. Ultimately, this is an agent to agent issue if communication is not there, but it's also the job of anyone in a business transaction to stay professional and courteous to fellow colleagues which in this case was a complete failure. Oh well, we were off the next buyers and won't look back.

I had a flat tire from hitting a screw, and I ended up coming here because it was close and had great reviews - I didn't even know they advertise free flat tire repairs! They were busy when I came in (without an appointment), but they still offered to see me right away and I dropped off my car for a few hours before getting a call to pick it up when it was ready. All at no cost! Everyone I encountered there was extremely friendly and helpful. I'll definitely be coming back here for any future maintenance.

We had a specific site and while driving down we decided to try and upgrade. The staff was very accommodating and found us a wonderful upgrade with outside covered bar with TV and party lights that was site specific right behind the pool. We had room for our RV, car and tow dolly no problem. The park is animal friendly with poop bags and garbage receptacle right there. Just tie up your trash amd leave it by the road, it's usually gone before you get back inside. Laundry facility is clean just like the rest of the park. There is a lot of noise from the freeway (sirens, ambulances etc) but you are in the middle of the French quarter. I was told It's safe to walk but we had our car and Uber is really the way to go, parking is difficult in town.

Ordered delivery from here and just ate one of the best chicken sandwiches of my life. The chicken was cooked perfectly and fit the bun just right- by just right I mean some goodness hanging out the sides. I ordered a level two and it was flavorful and left my lips a little tingly without being overwhelming at all. It was crispy and complimented by a great bun. The pickles were also great and I'm a pickle snob. I ordered one of the frozen lemonades and sides of ranch and blue cheese dressing. The frozen lemonade was sweet and I'm sure I'll crave it come this summer. The ranch was also tasty. Sadly I didn't get the blue cheese dressing I paid for but it sounds like they're pretty swamped based on other reviews. I'm sure I'll order again when the craving for a great spicy chicken sandwich strikes.

What the heck?? Why is this place so expensive? forreal? $25 for the average entree at this place? The portions are not even giant so you could split it or eat it family-style. This looks like your average college town restaurant on the inside, nothing swanky or fancy looking. For that price, I can take myself to Pod around the corner for a GREAT meal in a waaaay better atmosphere. This place also served water in dirty glasses and don't wait on you after they bring your food. I mean, I know small Asian restaurants have a rep for bad service but this was so....ew. AND, on top of the small portions for big bucks, the food isn't even good!! Nothing even remotely memorable. 
Anyone looking for Korean food in West Philly, go to Koreana... or even better, put in the effort to go to H-mart down by 69th Street where there's a decent food court upstairs or restaurants in surrounding area. This place is not worth your time or money.

I came in here with high expectations, but I left a little unsatisfied. I had the fried bologna sandwich on brioche and was disappointed that it only had 1 slice of bologna on a thick piece of bread. Luckily I added an egg on top or it would've been a total loss. I also redeemed my coupon for a side of tots which were cooked too long, so they were hard, oily and dark brown in color.
