My friend had the hangover burger and added bacon to it which looked awesome, she said it was excellent! The service was great, friendly and fast. The server mentioned they were going through a transition with the new cook, so I'm hoping this place will get as good as the previous reviews stated. I'm sure I just caught this place on a bad day, so I'll be sure to come back in a couple of weeks to try it out again and update this review. It's so close to my house that I'm hoping this is a place I can be a regular at.

My family and I went this past Sunday and had a pleasant experience. On the outside you wouldn't expect such a gem inside. It is elegant inside with attentive wait staff. The menu has many options. We enjoyed two of the specials which included a salmon and venison dish each paired with a wonderful mixed vegetable side. We also had a vegan diner who enjoyed their chef created meal. The fish was by far the favorite of the table it was flaky and the most moist delicately prepared salmon I have had so far. The only let down was dessert. We had the cherry cobbler crisp dish which was lacking flavor and dimensions especially for us who love dessert but this is something we can overlook to enjoy a good dinner.

Ordered a fruit tray online for a baby shower. The photos of the party trays are beautiful, high priced than most stores. But the photos make the party trays look like they are worth the extra money. 

Disappointingly, what you actually get is not at all like the photo online. There is such little food on the tray you can see the bottom of the tray is most places. 

I ordered a $49.99 tray and was too embarrassed to bring it in the condition it was in. I bought $20 more fruit to add to it. 

I do not recommend this store to anyone.

hey! go here! yay! there's lots of local food eateries to choose from.

meat and threes.
greek.
mexican.
delicatessen.
sort of thai, chinese, etc...
oh, and also this place called back alley diner, but, that's a separate review....

A vegan diner in South Philly is exactly what this part of town needs (especially after the Commissary closed a year ago). From the roots of a pop-up vegan bakery, This Charming Bakery, and a Reanimator barista, The Tasty was born. 

Egg or dairy allergic? No problem! Vegan but on the wrong side of south Philly from Grindcore? They got you! (And with a better selection, too.)

Reanimator coffee/espresso any way you want it. Vegan baked goods that make you second guess if they are indeed animal free. Their menu? Try the VEGAN "chik'n and waffles" or French toast or tofu omelet. I'm smitten. Look for the gold glittery vinyl sign across from Columbus Square.

This cute little diner will make you wonder why you ever depended on chickens or indulged in dairy; they will also serve up a side dish of the younger South Philly community (but in the best way).

The Steel City Vibe is great - grungy but pleasant. I definitely prefer their coffee over Artisan's (though it falls as a distant second to Soltane on the Phoenixville Coffee scene).

They have fun window seating from which you can cozily people watch. Tends to be pretty quiet during the day - though their music events are pretty hopping. I've mostly limited myself to early morning meetings when other places in the town aren't yet stirring. Check it - you'll be glad you did.

I've been here so many times and feel bad I haven't reviewed before.

Amazing!!!!

I held an event at avenue kitchen for 40 people. The food and service both knocked it out of the park. 

Want a unique dish? Crab Beignets!!! Life changing.

5 years of event planning for the same organization and this is the place that had rave reviews.
Good food, made fresh to order, and fairly priced. Great place for breakfast! Would definitely come back again.

I like this place for a change of pace for lunch. 

Flat bread sandwiches and skewered meats are pretty good. Most of the food give the impression that it is healthier than what you'll get at most other lunch places which is a plus though I've never dug through the nutrition fact to see if that is actually true.

My biggest complaint is they seem pretty slow with getting your food out. I walked in at 2 and there was no one else waiting on an order and it seemed like it took 20 minutes to get my sandwich.

Their sauces are pretty awesome. Definitely try them all the next time you are there AND now you can purchase a jar to take home your favorite flavor.

(I am fairly convinced they do the whole jar thing only because I kept asking one of the managers if I could get their sauce to go and told him they should start canning it. A few months later they were selling it in canning jars.)

Love the energy in this place. The Buddha bowl is hands down the best salad I've ever eaten while dining out. Chef Audrey is so talented and seems to have perfected the model of fresh, healthy, delicious dishes in well-sized portions for fair prices.  Glad to have this option in Broad Ripple!

The most charming atmosphere to get fresh crepes! Welcome to a warm-inviting crepe shop that has the freshest ingredients and a great friendly staff. A beautiful decor setting with a variety of products to choose from. Great for an assortment of coffees, teas, and of course crepes!! Check them out today!!
I tried their jam bong a couple days ago, and it was delicious! Their portions for their jambong are HUGE and could honestly serve up to 2 maybe 3 people.
This place is just awesome!! We've been coming to this restaurant since they opened next door. And their food has always been consistently great!!!

Loved this place! First impression was made by the two employees who greeted us very nicely even though it was getting close to closing time. The store is kind of small with limited indoor seating, but we took advantage of the BYOB and took our food out back to their courtyard which was great on a warm summer evening. The tacos were awesome. We had the chorizo which combined chorizorefried beans, bacon, onion and a great hot sauce to add just the right amount of heat. the chicken taco and roasted vegetable taco were also excellent. We finished things off with an unbelievable sopapilla cheesecake and a great chipotle brownie.... all at a great price!!! I definitely would recommend going the BYOB route an sit out back or take out would be good too.

Hi, I ordered a dinner pack with choice of 2 items teriyaki shrimp and soup. Shrimp was tasty and awesome but soup was not too good and satisfied. Sushi was medium spicy and as good as always a sushi has to be. Soya hot sauce was given , lobster fried rice was good. I would recommend going back to myself. I felt heavy but decent for the pay. Good luck .

Best rib tips in St. Louis because they are BARBEQUED -outside in a barbeque pit. Lots of  "barbeque" places bake, boil or  smoke. This is the real deal! Hats off to the cook! Don't forget to top it off with some sweet potato pie or peach cobbler.

If rib tips are not your thing, the smothered pork chops and fill up burgers are on hit too.

A true STL hidden gem.

My wife warns me against eating at restaurants that offer Groupon deals. She is right about Brocatos. Our journey started with a confused disorganized menu. I asked the cashier about breakfast and she barked responses treating us more like inmates than customers. With her poor customer service I normally would have walked out, but I had to use my Groupon. 

I ordered a steak omelet that was huge and loaded with shredded Philly style steak. The steak was average quality and the fries were mediocre. My wife's egg and steak sandwich was much better than my omelet. The Cuban bread used for her sandwich was excellent. We enjoyed the diner feel and the oldies music was charming. 

I don't see us returning due to the terribly rude customer service. The 3 stars are for the large portions, good value, and unique ambiance.

I think they do a nice job at this location. I have always lucked out with up front parking, but I guess they offer overflow parking behind the building which is great.
It's nice when they have new selections as this place can become very repetitive with its offerings.
For $10, the 6 bowl can become two very filling meals (for me). Love the no moo almond milk, really fresh and tasty.
If you'd like to taste any of thee ifferungs before purchasing, just ask.
The staff is friendly, decor is cheerful, food is fresh and filling.
I'd recommend a visit to this restaurant if you like healthy, whole food.
This pace has very very very very very slow service . Two and half hours for a pizza,hoagie, and pasta. Still waiting. Don't come. Waste of time.
Love the funky taco, atmosphere, food, and their sauces are dope. Great service and staff. However, we went tonight and would love the Oaxacan cheese bites back!!!!

This review is going onto any possible website with a review option. This past weekend we had bad storms here in Indiana. Our basement had flooded, so we decided to call Mr Plumber. We explained the situation we had and we were quoted $150. The guy was out promptly and we were very happy with. 

However, he stood at the top of the landing and said there was nothing he could do. He didn't even go down and look. After 5 minutes he just left. Didn't even offer a solution to help. But still charged us $150. FOR WHAT ??? At least for that price, he could have pumped out the water. Or even ran a snake down there. 

The worst is yet to come, we contacted the company directly, to politely ask why absolutely nothing was done after paying $150. We had the rudest customer service representative, who proceeded to call my wife a b****. Completely unacceptable behavior, I'm disgusted with how this matter was dealt with.

what an artificial representaion this is of so-called reviews
 my bad experience and another's perhaps even worse experience were "filtered" out......sure.....
at least a couple negative reviews still reside (for now) in yelp's purgatory of "filtered" reviews.  read me while you can, trusting public.
my take (you can still see it for now at least)?
attitudinous wait staff = slow and sullen service
charred pizza = tough cinder-evoking eats
suggestion: require full disclosure for employees or immediate family of any given restaurant.  i have true doubts about the raves i am reading
I used huey's detailing for both my cars. He did an excellent job   Very nice young man.
Had a great, healthy dining experience here. Good energy, nutritious food selection, and friendly staff--made for an enjoyable and low-key byob dinner. Good times!
A solid choice for breakfast, brunch, or lunch, and an ideal place to spot Music Row folks meeting up over French toast and coffee. And pickles.

I cannot imagine worse customer service.

All I'm trying to do is change the address for an upcoming installation. Cannot do it only; waited on hold for 25 minutes; call was answered and promptly disconnected by their agent. 

I think I'll cancel the installation instead...  I'm not interested in dealing with this kind of service, ever.

Significantly more expensive than the three other imaging centers I've visited. 
$80 for 14 weeks+ gestation. 

I recommend driving 2 hours to Roseville and visiting Baby Connection. 
They offer: 
$40.00
Starting at 13 weeks
10 minute 2D
Gender determination
3D/4D sneak peek (3-5mins)
CD with up to 20 images
DVD set to lullaby music
2 black and white prints
Free gift. 

I've also visited a imaging center in San Diego with/for my sister at $45.00 for a 3D gender reveal, and also visited a location in St.Louis, MO for only $50.00 for the same kind of package. 

If you can't wait, then you can't wait. I get it. (:

A little pricey, but the waiters are attentive and the food is great. 
It's a cute little Mexican restaurant that I believe I will be visiting again
If you're interested in great traditional Irish food, come here.  Fish n Chips and Sheppard's Pie are incredible.  Try thr Scotch Eggs and save room for dessert.   Best Guinness in town too!

I've been looking for a decently priced massage that was not part of chain and found just that. King and Queen exceeded my expectations of a "mom and pop" shop. I found them on Groupon and wasn't sure what to expect since I've never heard of them. They're located in a small strip mall in Willow Grove, so you may miss them if you're not paying attention driving down a busy York Road. When I arrived, the waiting area smelled like lavender, so it instantly put me in a relaxing mood. I was greeted by the receptionist and she said my appointment would start in a couple minutes. After about 10 minutes, I was brought back to a single person room. It was dimly lit, but on the way to the room, I did see that they had a couple of single person rooms as well as one for couples. The massage started and I asked for medium pressure. The pressure at first was a little too hard, but after mentioning it to the masseuse, she lightened up and it was perfect! This time I got a 60 minute full body massage, but in the past, I've gotten the 50 minute massage plus 10 minute back exfoliation and it was lovely. I recommend that over the full 60 minute massage. This will be a monthly treat to myself!

This is the kind of coffee shop that makes you long to be a regular.

I had the brie fig sandwich on a croissant, and it was perfectly lovely. I also had a cup of coffee, which I promptly spilled everywhere, which incident triggered the owners' kids scurrying for fistfuls  of napkins without being asked. Apparently the munchkins are typically there on weekends, since their parents are the sweet couple that owns the place. The father's artwork hangs permanently upstairs, while other local artists get cycled through on the first floor.

Props to them for opening this place before the neighborhood was hip & nurturing it to the lovely place it is today!

La Fresita is my favorite Mexican drive-through in town. They don't have the quickest service, but it's worth a 10-minute wait because they always deliver fresh, quality food for a reasonable price. The breakfast burritos are the best I've ever had. The carne asada plate and burritos are flavorful and filling. Their red salsa is amazing (get extra!). Their tortillas are the perfect texture and don't fall apart. The service is friendly. I can't think of anything negative to say about this hidden gem.

Ordered takeout and wasn't disappointed! We got the fried baby corn, the tandoori chicken mix and of curse classic butter chicken and everything was delicious and authentic. Would recommend! 
The only thing is the delivery guy took forever and called me 10 times so I would pick up next time but the food was fantastic!

DO NOT GO TO THIS CRAZY OLD PHYSCO BITCH !!!! SHE IS CRAZY AND RUDE !!!!!!!!!! I couldn't find her location and she went off on me told me I was SUPER late when I WAS NOT, it was only a couple minutes..when i made the appt I told her I got off work at 4:30 & would be there at 4:45 & when I got there it was 4:47-4:50, prior to that she called me 3 times being so rude asking where i was at & basically calling me dumb that I couldnt find her damn place & that she was "pathetically" booked & i needed to hurry up. when I got to her place i was trying to explain to her I got lost & she cut me off and demanded me to take off my shoes and sit down , & I went off on the crazy bitch and left and she BLEW ME UP , I had to block her . Her place was sketchy and DIRTY , not where you want to be getting your wax done in such an unsanitary place . I do not know why people go to her & why she is still even doing waxes , she probably is not even up to date with her lisense! I will be contacting the board of Estheticians to have her lisense REVOKED, I'm in complete disbelief how she has 4 out of 5 stars .

After being featured on some of my favorite food shows (Ugly Delicious (S1EP6) Chef's Table (S6EP4)) - this was a must try for me and I'm so glad that I did.  I recommend watching the episodes before coming here to give you a better understanding of the history and the thought that goes into Chef Sean's food.  Husk is a solid 5/5 and did no stop short at impressing.  Be sure to make reservations in advance, especially for weekends and peak hours.

We visited for lunch and had the salad with butternut squash, fried chicken, catfish sandwich, and this pound cake like dessert.  I wish I took a photo of the menu that day, but I assure you that all the food is delicious.

Everything just has such freshness to it and you just get so much flavor from each of the ingredients.  The bread and butter to start already had me swept away.  And as if you couldn't do fried chicken any better, Husk's fried chicken is PHENOMENAL.  5 years of perfecting the recipe in a place that's so famous for its hot chicken - Husk does not disappoint.  It's paired with the vegetable sides of the day and it is just mouthwatering good.  The catfish sandwich was also equally good with the perfect amount of batter and flavor... just so so good.

This could not have been a better way to end my first real southern experience.  Highly recommend!
Great pizza would definitely recommend this place for Italian food  great small business

Love their pizza and the pricing is fair. Recently ordered the spinach & tomato white pizza and it was very good. Loved the Greek salad as well. Great menu selection and we will be back! (Also love being able to order by the slice!)

While waiting for dinner at SBSC at the Wharf, Figueroa was recommended to us as a cool place to grab a beer, so after dinner we walked over to take in a few pints.

The place is definitely set up as bar (you never know what to expect with breweries), with an absurd amount of Figueroa beers on tap, along with what looked to be a cool patio outside as well. 

For the beers, there were definitely too many good options to choose from, especially will all the awards Figueroa's brews have won in recent memory, but I opted for the Lizard's Mouth IPA and the Future Ex-Wife.

I found the Lizard's Mouth to be a refreshing IPA and the Future Ex-Wife, my god, does pack a punch, hence it's name I am sure. 

One thing to add, in addition to all their great beers on tap with all equally great and witty names, their bar menu also looked damned good, so we will have to leave that for the next visit.  

Tons of beer for any palette, a nice, social atmosphere, and an enticing menu, definitely a good beginning or end to any night.

I must confess that I got sick after eating here.  Sick enough to wake up and think I was having morning sickness and pregnant.  I just don't do nauseous that often and since I happen not to be pregnant then Endomasa gets the blame.  Instead of getting 6 small rolls - you get three big ones.  Doesn't that just mean more rice and less goodies?  I really wanted to like the place but something had to have been off in the food.  They also have like no salmon dishes at all though the Agedashi Tofu was  yummy.
Very very slow service.  Floors were disgusting with something slimy.  Do not recommend at all.

I always take my car here for an oil change, car wash and vacuum.  They consistently do a solid job.  The waiting room/ business office is such a riot - there's music blasting, you can watch the cars being washed or shop for that car accessory you didn't think you needed until then.  For me, I always load up on scented trees but I was especially surprised when I saw a glasses repair kit displayed because I seriously needed one after the screw came out of my Ray-Bans the day before.

Must see if visiting or live in St. Petersburg, Florida! The building itself is beautiful and resembles the one in Spain, designed by Dali himself. The galleries are very spacious and filled with natural light with slimline windows all over the ceiling. It has the second largest collection of master pieces in the world! The curators are very knowledgable (as you expect them to be) and are very passionate about this place. I do suggest taking a free tour with your ticket as you just learn so much about Dali's life and art. You will also learn secrets of several paintings that might appear different if you take another look and are often full of  meaningful symbols. The gift store is pretty vast and you can find a souvenir for every budget, from jewelry to magnets. The labyrinth outside is free and is lots of fun for kids to play in.

I ate here for the first time the other night. we didn't wait that long to be seated and they put us upstairs in the family area, which was good because I have a young boy. We ordered burgers which were quite delicious. The french fries were yummy with the sauce they provided too. No complaints here. Can't wait to go back soon.

I WAS SEXUALLY ASSAULTED BY CAB 1418. This occurred on October 1st at 0500. The White Fleet cab driver told us he was Pakistani. This was preceded by him calling me "pretty" when I first got into the cab. When he dropped me off at the airport he grabbed me to hug me and tried to kiss me. I was sober (I don't drink) and wearing a sweater in New Orleans heat, so this was a very lucid event without provocation. In no universe would a young 30 something year old woman consent to a kiss and hug from a lecherous ugly cab driver in his 60s.

When I got back home I tracked down his cab number from the hotel, called the company and no one has responded since. It has been SEVERAL DAYS. 

White Fleet: please do reach out to me. I am also in the process of hearing back from the Taxi bureau. The lack of response is concerning and his behavior suggests this isn't the first or last time he'll sexually harass/assault people.
Great news we are now starting to expand our services, haircuts, nails, makeup, and fashion clothing...

I went to the washoe club because I wanted to see the spiral staircase.  I timed it just as a tour was starting so I signed up and joined with Betty who was great, she gave a very personalised tour and didn't make you feel like you were being pushed through to get to the next tour.  I was by myself so she also offered to take a photo of me standing in a particular spot where a ghost had been recorded on camera.  This added to my experience because I am a fan of taking photos but not of taking selfies.

This is the reason we use yelp. After leaving the WW2 museum in New Orleans, we were ready to experience a legendary local poboy. Yelp reviewers led us to Parkway and we could not be more grateful! We ordered the shrimp poboy and the oyster poboy. For a side, we added a shared order of French fries with gravy.
The poboys are "dressed" with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and a light spread of mayo. Adding your own Crystal hot sauce tableside is a must. It really elevates the outstanding to amazing. The homemade beef gravy on the fries is ladled with fresh bits of pulled roast beef that is tender and flavorful. The beef turned a side into an almost meal of its own. The seafood has a light breading that keeps the flavor and moisture in without being heavy or greasy. Oysters are my new passion after this trip and the fried option in a sandwich was not something I expected to love as much as I did. Now I can't wait to go back and do it all again.

Is it a thing to charge for water? But yea, other than that there was something weird going on at the register where we could not remove an app promo that made the total jump from 9 to 11- that took like 15 minutes to figure out. Not to mention there was something going on in the play area and the ambulance was called it.  I just wanted my 10 nuggets and to eat in peace! Let's see...we specified "dine in" and we got our stuff as a take out. And the big Mac we ordered was cold and the bread was stale. 
I mean, it's McDonald's. Is this gonna stop me from going to a McDonald's? Probably not. I don't really have standards for a McDonald's cuz like... It's McDonald's. I just there when I'm broke or outta options for that day.

DONT USE THIS SERVICE!!!!!!!

They replaced my battery in February and 5 months later it EXPANDED and cracked my phone open! I couldn't use apple care to replace it because the battery they put in isn't a certified apple product.

When I contacted the company because of their "life time warranty" they said they can't fix it for me. I had to get a new phone and i can't sell my old one. THEY SCREW YOU OVER! 

I'm completely unsatisfied and will warn everyone to not use this service!!

How can you run a business without a manager present. I enjoy the food here however you better not have a issue that may require you get a refund. What happened to me was they were charging more then what was quoted on the menu. When I questioned this practice I was told their prices had increased. NOT MY PROBLEM! you must honor what was posted I said. When I asked to speak with a manager they said there wasn't one there. The staff seemed confused that someone challenged their misquoted prices. I wasn't happy about the runaround I got. I even gave them the option to barter by giving me something of equal value like a fruit cup juice or soda. I wasn't settling for this nonsense. I requested to speak to a supervisor over the phone I'm cool with that too but NOPE! now I'm pissed off you're not keeping my money no way no how. I waited for the staff to come to a conclusion while they waisted my time. Finally one of the workers handed me cash with an apology. Get it together Vale you put your staff in a bad position someone unlike me might get very angry and combative over a few dollars. Give your staff management codes to accommodate their mistakes

Upon arrival to this bar, I was a few hours away from one of the worst bouts of food poisoning I've ever experienced, so honestly, everything is a little fuzzy. :/ But I remember R Bar being a very chill, fun place to hang out! Drinks were cheap (at least I think they were, I didn't pay for any :D ) and we met an interesting guy whom we chatted with for hours. They had pool and nice bartenders and everyone was screaming at the TV because some sports game was on. Me like. :)

I came to the Walmart for an interview for a cashier position at 50 North Madame Blvd. The woman that interviewed me, did not even ask me anything.  She looked at me and told me I was too old to work here and that she was sending me home. I was so disappointed and felt so violated. My daughter told me it is age discrimination and I should sue them. I just wanted a job.

Rooms are large, beds are comfortable, coffee is good. The employees at the front desk have been very helpful and informative. We hungout at the bar Wednesday night. The bartender, Haley, was very nice and engaging. She made good drinks, and talked with us for an hour or so. Overall, good experience so far. I would return to stay again, and I'm a very picky guest.

Excellent cupcakes. 

The key is frosting, which is often very easy to mess up. Can't be too overly sweet, can't be too bland. And MUST be light and fluffy...at least in my book.

Sweet Box Cupcakes was all of that at the Vendy Awards. Moist cake, light buttercream, not too sweet. Loved their chocolate mint and PB&J cupcake! I am now craving for more!

Very small inside there is barely room at the tables to sit let alone eat. We went during restaurant week and the servers were rushing us and kind of rude. The food was very OK.  I wouldn't go back and I have had way better elsewhere. Not worth the $$$
Lived at St Petersburg beach for ten years this is the best burger in area. The staff was wonderful and the service was amazing.

Yes, it is a tourist trap, and yes, they'll be packed in like sardines, but you still need to have a hurricane at Pat O'Briens.   The signature drink (and one of my favorites) was invented here and contains half rum and half juice (seems to be more powdered form than fresh these days).   Two of these will knock a grown man on his ass.   Be careful because they sneak up on you...

Spend some time on the patio, complete with famous flaming fountain.   On busy nights, make sure to get one of the black and white photos (yeah, seems gimmicky at the time, but you'll love it later) from the wandering photographers.   We have a collection of them spanning back years.   Make sure to check out the piano bar inside (unfortunately, the guy who used to play the silver tray with thimbles on his fingers has passed on, but still fun).    You really can't do a trip to NOLA without a visit to Pat O's.   I have at least one hurricane every visit - you should too.

Well, I used to love this place, however, today we popped in and sat at the counter facing the kitchen.... We received out iced tea, and it was sour/old, they were very accomidating and made more fresh tea, but just dumped the old tea into basically a hand sink and rinsed the container before putting new tea in. It got way worse from there..  I ordered and then watched as the cook proceeded to touch her nose, face and raw foods then build sandwiches with no gloves and not washing her hands. I was so grossed out, when our food came I had asked for my bread to be toasted and it wasn't so I sent it back and watched as it sat on the counter and the cook proceeded to scratch her face and nose and reach for my sandwich, I cancelled my order and as my husband ate a few bites someone ordered a bloody Mary and the waitress made that drink without washing her hands and reached into the tray with lemons, limes ECT and touched them.. then there was a bin of cooked bacon used for drinks on the counter that had numerous bugs crawling on it. Holy cow, good thing I'm just a grossed out Customer and not the Health department. Consumer beware, that's just what I observed in about 25 minutes.

Congrats to new salon owner Amy Gregory and thank you for another great cut! Her honest opinion about my curly locks helped me  several years ago and I've trusted her opinion ever since! She gave me styling tips to keep them. Her honest opinion and styling education will keep you coming back for more!

Do not eat here, it is filthy, the food is terrible.  I am easy going, but this place pushed me to write a review because it is literally the worst restaurant I have ever eaten in.  The service, management (ran out of more than one food and drink item), and food were all terrible.  The waiter was very nice, but should seek another profession.   All the one star reviews hit the nail on the head, they are all accurate right up to the ridiculous location of the bathroom.  The crawfish were terrible, I have had them before and they were my newest favorite food, but Montrel's Bistro took care of that, they were mealy and discolored and I now hear that they should not have even had them as they are supposed to be out of season.  That explains it, they definitely seemed to be frozen or old.  I repeat again...Do not eat here.

One reviewer had it very right, this is a prime example of how not to run a restaurant.
Go to burger spot in Tampa!!! They also have wings that are so good. My favorite are the Old Bay!

My husband and I decided to have lunch here on our first wedding anniversary. We had seen Joey K's on Diners, Drive-ins and Dives. We had a great meal with excellent service. The onion rings are divine! Crab claws also delicious. We split a seafood platter- more than enough for both of us. Everything was fried perfectly- not greasy and very crisp- and seasoned well. Some of the best oysters I have ever had- fried well done, as requested. The Caesar salad was good ( not amazing, but good). We could not have been more pleased- now we have another great choice for lunch.

While not everything was of equal quality (incredible meatballs, cheese board, desserts, salsas/good but not quite incredible potatoes, tortilla española) I felt the overall experience was exactly what I want to get when I eat out. I didn't just have dinner, I had a damn meal. And  by god, I will be thinking about this meal for a long time. Rarely would I describe a meal as "cinematic".

How does this place get such good reviews?
Had the pulled pork sandwich. I think they mixed the jerky up with the pulled pork. Horrible & dry. Shoe leather on a bun. The only reason I gave two stars instead of one because the decent BBQ sauce helped me swallow the two bites that I could muster,and can still taste two hours later. I trashed the rest. I know this sounds rough but it was by far the worst BBQ sandwich I've ever tried to eat.

Just picking up my repaired sewing machine today created an extraordinary moment to speak again with owner Peter Chang. He is a gracious and generous-hearted human being who truly believes in taking care of his customers. I can't wait to get my new vacuum cleaner (hopefully!) for Christmas! Thank you, Peter, for your positive spirit and connectivity to your customers. We appreciate you!

Horrible place.  The desk staff is rude and extremely lazy.  Junior airmen are nasty to family members and retirees.  They are very dismissive and act like you are an inconvenience interrupting their day.  Doctors are rude and often make inaccurate diagnosis.  They hate to give retirees needed medication for serious illnesses.  Retirees and family members suffer for months without medication.  It takes months to get an appointment if you can get one at all.  So demeaning to patients, absolutely horrible.

I'm disappointed every time I buy food.  The food is usually very sparse but not awful.  I ordered paella which was not very good at all.  I asked for bread and was given a hamburger bun sliced up.  I was promised butter with it but he never brought it.  I saw him setting up for the DJ about 20 minutes later and when he realized he never brought butter he shrugged his shoulders and said "You're just old school".

My boyfriend's parents took us to Monsu for one last supper before they left town on a ten day trip to Europe (luckieees!). I wasn't sure how I'd feel walking into the former Paesano's location - I had some good sandwich memories from that place. Fortunately, the Sicilian fare Peter McAndrews is sending out of the kitchen at Monsu is no joke, either.

I started with the scallop app, which was served over pearl pasta with dried cherries and a red wine glaze. The scallop was seared perfectly, but I could probably take or leave the accompaniments. Next up was half an order of gnocchi. Unreal. Served in a salty tomato sauce with just a hint of cream, and topped with shavings of ricotta salata, I would absolutely order this as my main course at a future visit. 

Unless of course, I wanted the eggplant parm again. Layer upon lightly crisped layer of eggplant melded with fresh, oozy mozzarella, red sauce and more of that delicious ricotta salata. It was rich and satisfying. 

For dessert, my boyfriend and I shared a cannoli which was just so-so. The bar is definitely raised for cannoli any time one enters the Italian Market, so I think this particular offering could be improved.

Otherwise, stellar meal. I'd also love to check them out for brunch.

On par with other Chinese places in Indy like China wok. Its a relatively new place and the food is very good. It's one of the only Chinese places I know of in the area. The inside is nice and clean if you want to eat inside. Prices are also about the same as any other Chinese place.

The dinner was delicious.  The setting is beautiful and relaxing.  The owner/manager almost ruined our evening!  When seated the host moved our table ever so slightly to keep us out of the late evening sun, for which we were grateful.  After about an hour (nice leisure wine and appetizer) the manager/owner came out and started yelling our table was "out of place" and insisted we move.  I explained we were very content and had been there an hour. She grabbed by friends seat and started to drag her backwards and moved our table insisting " you are bothering the table behind you."  We all seemed very content. She was rude and aggressive. I later met a friend who said they had not been back for two years due to her behavior.  It is a shame as the chef is fantastic!  I can't imagine working for this woman.

Rendon Construction just replaced the countertops and backsplash in our kitchen.  Shawn is extremely professional and provides a high quality product.  He get back to you immediately when you have questions.  His standards for the work product were higher than mine.  Everything provided by his subcontractors was fixed if there were any problems.  I recommend him highly for any remodeling project

It's been a while since I wrote one of these, but after this experience I just needed to.

This place is a classic case of good food overshadowed by POOR service.  After eating at this restaurant it reminded me that good food has to be matched with great serve for the overall 5-STAR rating.  

The server was a horrible communicator.  You would think that being in the service industry that you would have high marks in the communicating field to yield good tips.  This lady (I will keep it anonymous) was loud, a terrible listener and had complete disregard to her restaurant attendees. 

I was with a party of 10+ people coming from a long road trip from DC.  We were seated rather quickly and so began the worse dining experience in my life.  As she took my order I asked her if I could add anything on to the Veggie Pizza... she replied, "You could order and add whatever you want."  I said, "Great!  I'll add the sausage to the Veggie Pizza." 20-30 minutes later out comes this Sausage/Cheese Pizza.  I was irritated and asked, "What happen to the veggies?"  She replied, "You ordered Sausage Pizza...  I could grill some veggies and you could sprinkle the veggie topping to the pizza."  Already irritated I just said forget it and internally I said I will take out my frustration out on Yelp.

When my buddy ordered she ordered a "Gourmet Style" pizza.  The server stated absolutely and asked, "What size?"  My buddy said,"Well I want it by the slice (I know unrealistic... who makes a whole pie for two slices of pizza?)"  She then replies, "O we can't make a Gourmet Pizza by the slice, but you'll like it and you can take the rest with you to-go."  What I don't understand is why didn't she provide a list of pizzas that are by the slice vs. only giving the guest the option of ordering a WHOLE pizza? My buddy ended up ordering the a large pizza and ate 2 slices and threw away the rest of it on the way back home.

The last thing that went wrong was that she did not ask while we were being seated if the bill was going to be in seperate checks.  When the bill came she said she was unable to divide the check.. and if we had issues with it we could speak to management.  I'm certain everyone knows that dividing the bill with a party of 10+ people could be excruciating.  If you have never experienced it believe me it sucks!!!!  

This review is really sad because the food was good... I mean if the service matched the food I would have given this restaraunt a solid 3 stars.  It's been 4 days since I went there I'm still fuming about it.  

So future pizza eaters PROCEED with caution.... A loud mouth, horrible listener female server is on the horizon.  OVERALL RATING 1 STAR.

I had a bad experience at this place. I never order flowers and this year I did but it was more stressful doing this than if I went out and did it myself. Flowers were 2 days late I agreed to 1 day late but not 2. I called and they REFUNDED my money but I wish I could've got what I paid for and had better outcome. These are the flowers I had sent to my mother in law and I feel so embarrassed  even though it was free If I didn't call this would've costed me 80 bucks and that bouque doesn't look like it. Overall I am disappointed and can't trust this business seems they rather lose money than make money.

Do you like Chocolate? Ok, so go to Isabella Gourmet Foods and let yourself eat a piece of heaven by getting the cocoa truffles. Isabella Gourmet Foods (IGF) carries an impressive selection of deliciousness. There is one in particular that is my favorite which is a rose cocoa truffle. 

Bone broth at IGF is excellent because it includes the good for your body herbs and roots such as turmeric. 

The sandwiches are a steal at under $10; very filling and combos such as waffles as bread and  turkey with delectable jam.

Finally, the people are great that work at IGF! Amy is very knowledgable and is that person that you wish she was one of your best girlfriends. Such as cool, smart, sophisticated and still down to earth gal!
Really really good. I'm afraid to say I like it more than Drewe's. :/  I will be back for sure.

Wonderful food and cool vibe. I loved the feeling of updated old south Philly rather than a good restaraunt that could be in any 'hood. 
We loved all the apps and entered especially the peppers and asiago, the fish on risotto and the crab pasta.
My only qualm is server rushed us out the door. It was brusque from the start. That was ok, I understand the need to turn tables but a minute after serving coffee and dessert she dropped off check. No offer of more coffee or chance for after dinner chat. It's a small qualm but seemed at odds with friendly neighborhood vibe.
Great place we'll be back.

Front desk staff courteous and that is the only good thing I can say that is good.   2 days no room service in a 3 day stay.  AC broke 2 times.   No dish soap, dish detergent left in the room.  Had to ask for towels and sheets to make my own bed.  Bugs in bathroom.  No manager on site in evenings to escalate issues too.
My boyfriend and I love this place! The service is really great and the food is even better. The prices can be a little on the high side, but it's worth it!

Pelicana is one of my favorite places for Korean fried chicken (KFC) You have no idea how excited I was about Pelicana opening in Ucity!!! As a student I no longer need to go downtown for KFC! And it does not disappoint!!

The wait for the food is kind of long but I still think it's worth it. I always get half original fried and half spicy (lvl 2 or 3). My friends think I'm crazy but I love spicy food so you should get lvl 3 spicy if you are in the mood for some spice.

And of course there is beer to go with KFC! Also since this is a KFC place I don't think it's worth it to get anything else than KFC and beer. I've also gotten KFC to go before but I think it's best if you dine in to enjoy it when it is most crispy.

Also, you can make a reservation if you need to accommodate a large party. Overall really happy to have Pelicana in Ucity!

I was pleasantly surprised. I was on vacation with my family and I'm the only vegetarian. They really wanted bbq, so I reluctantly said ok, thinking this would be on of those lunches were I only ate fries because there would be nothing for me to eat, not only did they have a smoked portabella sandwich, it was honestly one of the best vegetarian sandwiches I have ever had. The family said they the bbq was to die for also

Came by on recommendation of coworker.   The parking lot and access ramp need repaving (I'm in a wheelchair), but I ordered a chicken tamale for breakfast and it was moist and flavorful. Better than most I've had. Proprietor was very helpful.  Bought a couple of pastries which I will try later.  Glad to have them in an area devoid of places to eat.
Really friendly and supportive staff,  well designed food.  Even in its awkwardness of starting out, the place had a certain charm. The roles were really good.
Not impressed.  First I do not expect any beer to taste sweet.  Add No food except chips to go with and it's a one start place for me.

Less than 1 Star ... disgusted w the service .. the food the drink .. omg threw it all away .. tried to write a review and says too many words ! Lol don't eat here. Look how many bad reviews they have
Was in town over the weekend shared a few dishes with my husband. It was good the best and most amazing dish I enjoyed the most was the brownie dessert by far the BEST "

This was our second visit.  Service was NOT good, had to ask twice for bread.  Ordered scallops with pea risotto.  The risotto was horrible--tasteless.  When I told maitre d or manager, he said he would tell the chef.  Upon leaving I asked what the chef said.  He threw the whole batch out and would start again, with a smirk.  The response was totally condescending and, in my opinion, not true.  Never, ever will return.

I shop here regularly for their offering of fresh fish. I normally get salmon and tuna but recently got some stone crab & snapper. Kathy and her staff are really knowledgeable and offer different ways of preparing their fish. The have a cute store with seasonings, rices, and sauces. The fridge cases offer lump blue crab, conch, and octopus as well as other seafood. I would recommend a visit. Super friendly and the store is really clean. 
 Today I talked to them about Stone crab claws. Kathy showed me how to crack them open and had me try one. I brought some home and warmed them per her instructions and dipped in melted butter. Mmmm 
They carry whole fish, filet, shrimp, clams, and oysters. 
Highly recommend!

One of the top two restaurants we tried in NOLA. Exceptional service. 

Chargrilled oysters - THE best. Must order. The oysters are grilled in butter - so simple but so good. High quality oysters. 

Lobster dumpling - pass on this. Nothing worth while. The texture of the dumpling skin was all wrong and the flavors did not work. 

Biscuit - the ladies at the table next to us were raving about the biscuits to the point that they got the recipe from the waiter. Not sure why, they tasted like flour and were dense. Pass. 

Tempura Fin Wings - creative dish, good balance of flavors and textures. Very good.

Scallibut - their signature dish, creative concept but fell flat in flavor. Scallop was overcooked. 

Local Drum Fish - with chicken crackling skin. This should be their signature dish- crust was crispy, fish was cooked perfectly, and everything on the dish was balanced nicely. Only suggestion is slightly less salt on the fish.

Overall a great meal in a great atmosphere. They have more of strict dress code for men but treated us with the same high quality service in our comfy clothes.

I've been going to miyaku since it opened. Sometime in the middle of my relationship with this restaurant the service became unmentionably bad and almost literally painfully slow. From waiting outside after they've opened while they mill around and keep the door locked with out a word to us (yes they knew we were there... We waved) to waiting twenty minutes for water to even show up I've continued to patronize them because despite the sub par service the food is exceptional. They arguably have the freshest tuna in town and I know my tuna! It's also clearly a family owned operation which I'm always down to support so I've remained loyal and I even bring friends on lazy afternoons letting them know it may take a while but good things come to those who wait, however today was so terrible my taste buds are sorry to say I won't be returning. We came in with an hour an a half to spare before a movie which we planned to see right across the street, we placed our entire order immediately because we anticipated the sluggish rate of service and we waited a record 23 minutes for waters. In the mean time we watched as she went from table to table taking orders after ours. Another 10 mins after the waters were brought she comes back to tell us that her husband can't make our order because he's now too busy and needs to make only hibachi and I was so taken back I didn't know what to say we just left, but as a long time veteran and lover of the service industry myself I'm completely appalled! We waited almost forty minutes to be told our order would simply NOT BE MADE due to people who had ordered AFTER us.... I've never experienced something so inconsiderate in my life....She didn't offer a voucher or a rain check for our wasted time to show were still appreciated customers just NOTHING .... I mean what the hell??? We scrambled to find another lunch joint and needless to say missed our movie. I can deal with a lot of things for good quality food but I refuse to spend my hard earned money with people who very obviously don't appreciate my time or my years of business.... Farewell miyaku and if any of you find yourselves with three hours to spare on a lunch break some day...try the tuna!

I have to say the customer service here is pretty wonderful. I was greeted and offered coffee/water as soon as I walked in. The one suit I had my eye on in particular was sold out in my size. Marissa helped me try on 5 others before I finally settled on another one I liked but it had to be shipped in. I had my suit ordered and it was delivered in store in about 4 days. Marissa wasnt around this time, but Brittany and Torre helped me out and noticed the suit looked odd on me. They helped pick the right suit and fit for my body type and Torre was amazing at eyeing up the alterations that were needed. Overall the staff here are very knowledgeable and know what they're talking about when it comes to suits. I will definitely be shopping there again.

I would have given this a 5 but due to the rudeness of our bartender and lack of interest with us I gave them a 3. He never asked if we wanted another drink or if we like our appetizer or entree or how were the specialty drinks, or would you like another glass of wine. There was no interaction with us. I even asked some of the other patrons sitting at the bar were they local or out of town. I guess the local patrons get the good service and visitors from another state get 0 Service, I would never recommend this place although the food was excellent, the bad service made it unbearable for me.

Yesterday my friends and I got to Stake n Shake at 9:30 pm. We put our order in shortly after we got there. The waitress definitely did not hide that she was displeased to be serving a big group of people. She did not say anything directly but her body language, facial expression, and tone in her voice gave it away. When she found out we had 2 more people coming she sighed. When we just started getting our food brought to us at 9:54 we were impatiently told that at 10pm we had to be gone and the waitress said she was going to bring us boxes to put our food in. I did not know Steak 'n Shake closes at 10 now, and we were not told that information before ordering either. We finished getting our food, straws, and silverware at 10:15, and did not end up having to leave at 10 thankfully.
Wery  a good service nice food good price I really like it me and my friends always going there for dinner launch I do appreciate for services thank you
The mad Greek is mad good!!!!! Had the chicken and potatoes which was amazing!!! I'm excited to try a lot of other things.

Relatives from out of town wanted to try someplace they had never been before. This came recommended by my daughter and her husband who I think never eat at home ever. This was the first restaurant I have seen in quite some time that was actually full and busy, with a short wait. The waitress was prompt, attentive, courteous and fun. All the food was excellent and reasonably priced. An excellent meal was had by all.

Fall/Winter Update - wow!  This place may be cooler (or warmer?) during the colder months. I was curious to see what they would do, well...they have added an awesome Fire Pit in the middle of the "garden" which warms the entire place. A  Fire Pit plus heat lamps scattered throughout the outdoor seating area makes this a cozy and comfortable place to go during the colder months.  Let the liter of beer consumption continue long into the dead of winter!

Plus it seems like they expanded their food menu as well, with the addition of 5 or 6 Burger options, and a soup or two. Didn't get to try them, but a welcomed addition!

Ordered lighting, had everything in stock.  Months later when I was ready to move into my house Chateau lighting tells me they are out of stock and would not provide a free upgrade. Yet they took my money for something they did not have in stock? This is shady business.

Food was totally delicious! The hot chickn was a bit hotter than expected LOL but damn good. I thought the potato casserole was way too oily and thus not 5 stars. My husband loved his chickn sandwich, and my son enjoyed his tenders and baked beans. The milkshakes were amazing. Totally worth checking out for a fix of southern comfort food, only plant based

Great selection of local specialties...gumbo jambalaya and crawfish etouffee.
Don't miss the fresh fruit daiquiri, with flavors like cantaloupe, lime, and honeydew.  yum!  Also the French bread and pecan salad dressing were above and beyond the norm.

We had some holes to dig in our backyard and the ground is very hard and rocky. I tried using a digging bar which worked but it was very slow going and extremely strenuous.

We decided to explore options for an electric jackhammer. We reached out to the big box retailers which did not feel very accommodating or customer service oriented. They expected us to know what a small, medium or large jackhammer was. 

We also reached out to All Star Rents. They were very accommodating and explained the different options as well as how the rental process works. 

We rented a 60lb electric jackhammer for a 24 hour period and it was only a few dollars more than the big box retailers. 

The electric jackhammer enabled us to complete the digging work much faster and was far less strenuous. It was amazing to see the job done so quickly. 

The return process was also very easy. They even helped me unload it from our trailer. 

We would recommend All Star Rents!

You'll find The Parish in an indistinct strip center off of Oracle Rd. It seems to be  our first and only Southern fusion gastropub that's pleasing palates all over Tucson. The atmosphere is funky and the interior is somewhat mixed, but somehow it works. The drinks are creative and bold and pretty much EVERYTHING on the menu has a major kick to it. I think the peeps at The Parish are doing things right for sure. They have fun with the menu and with the flavors. This style of food, however, is not my personal favorite and not really something I could eat on a regular basis. The bacon popcorn is second to none. Holy bacon bits. It's delicious. I couldn't stop eating it. I've never had southern cuisine, so I have nothing to compare it to, but diners at our table, who have traveled to New Orleans many times, were pleased.

This restaurant was awesome! It was my first Thai food experience, and I will definitely try it again. I went on a Friday evening around 5:30 and they weren't busy at all, but by the time I left around 7 the place was packed. I tried the Pad Thai with chicken and it was delicious. You can even choose how spicy you want the food. The tables looked really nice with a small candle and flower at each one. They also put a flower made from a carrot on my main course. I was not expecting these extra touches for the price! I will definitely be back for lunch as well.
Cute spot in downtown Doylestown. Fun decor and good menu. The crab cakes were the best I've ever had--seriously.

Top notch belgian beer selection, definitely comparable to Monks and Eulogy except I didn't have to go to Philly and find parking!  Although the prices are not cheap, they are not the most expensive either.  I got a flight of 4 beers for $9, mind you they were 4 ounces each so it wasn't a massive amount of beer but luckily for me they were ALL christmas beers (super high abv!).   

My lady was skeptical about the menu, as I have dragged her to many a gastro-pub that did not live up to the name in my search of best food and beer resto.  However, her skepticism melted as soon as the Patatas Bravas arrived.  Properly cooked potato cubes in a pseudo buffalo sauce with Garlic aioli on top......unbelievable!  I think my favorite part about this place is the incorporation of Portuguese food style with gastro pub fare plus GREAT belgian brew selection.  They had St. Feullien Christmas from 2010, 2011, and 2012 ON TAP!  That is a place that cares about beer.  And as a result, I care about them! 

Finally, since our apps and dinner were solid choices, we ordered dessert, which is usually crap at these types of places.  NOPE!  The molten choc cake was perfectly warm and complemented nicely with vanilla ice cream over some type of think cookie.

Alas, a warm place with good food and excellent beer selection.  Not the cheapest place, but not the most expensive either.

Cheers!
Very helpful diagnosing my problem today. It sure beats buying a new iPad. There is plenty to do nearby if the wait is an hour, or pick up later at your convenience. Nice store.

This is my favorite spot to get quick, delicious late night grub. My go-to menu item will always be the Street Tacos, they hit the spot every time. I've tried other menu items, but I always come back to those classic street tacos - you can't beat the flavor and freshness! I usually order three and it's the perfect amount of food. 
My favorite drink is the frozen margarita. My only critique is the straws they use are fairly thin, and occasionally, the marg will get stuck in the straw because it's served so cold!
There is bar seating available, but on Friday and Saturday nights it can be tougher to get a seat. You can't beat the $2 tacos after 10pm - such an awesome deal. There's a reason why Mission Taco is so well-loved in the Lou. Stop by and find out for yourself!

This is the best hair salon in DFW. Of course I only know that cause Chelsea Sica was the best stylist I've ever had and anyone who loves looking fly should go and see her. She is fantastic and utterly professional. Talk about a perfectionist, she takes her time and always wants you to look amazing. Go here and ask for her. You wont be dissappointed!

Great location on Treasure Island at Gulf  Boulevard and Central  Avenue. The rooms are large, clean, and overlook the beach. There are two pools, two restaurants, and a very helpful  staff. Great seasonal rates especially considering the prime location.

Visiting near this area and let me say this was a great Saturday dinner choice. Over all my experience was very good. Service from host to server was good. My ahi tuna app was very good and had a great spicy kick to it. They even stuffed my olives for my martini with blue cheese which was perfectly made. My partners burger looked delicious and he said the fries were very fluffy yet crispy. 

I ordered a salad and asked about the Salmon and she said it was very good and not over cooked like most places. She was right the salmon was amazing. But I did order a spinach salad and asked to purchase a side of salmon with it and she said absolutely. But I ended up with a Caesar with salmon. The salad was a very wet Caesar salad, which is fine for some not my preference, but now I know. I didn't correct her as I didn't want my date to be delayed and make my partner to wait for me to get the correct food. So if you like Caesar salad just know  how you like it and order dressing on side of you don't like it really really wet. 

They have a great menu and I will be back to try other foods for sure. Our waitress only checked on us a few times, she may have been really busy not sure but that's okay as I understand how that can happen and we were enjoying our conversation on the date. Towards the end we did have to wrap up as it got very very loud in the bar area and we couldn't hear each other talk. So if you trying to have a nice long date night filled with conversation don't sit near the bar. 

The esthetics and over all experience was great!!!
Could be really good except they press the flavor out of an already lean patty until what you have is not unlike cardboard. Otherwise, good ingredients, acceptable prices, decent albeit oily fries.

This is our go to for tacos... Tuesday, Thursday any day of the week!!! Never had a bad meal here! Take out just as good. 

Chips hot and fresh and a variety of salsas to sample to find your fav flavor and spice level. Also love their jalapeño margarita- refreshing with a lil kick to it! A few of my frequent foods ordered are the mahi salad (o recommend dressing on the side), shrimp tacos, mahi tacos, calabacitas tacos, barbacoa tacos, pozole... The list goes on. 

Calabacitas are amazing out of this world must try!

Went to soft opening last week for Blood and Sand members-flawless. Got the sub (terrific), and fingerling potatoes (love the dipping sauces). Today I sat outside and got the double burger (good but very messy, ask them to cut it and perhaps get the aioli on the side). The hummus is unique and terrific. A few small issues today, that were rectified quickly. Adam and TJ have done it again. Beautiful space, setting, and gracious service-just like Blood and Sand.  No cocktails, though.

I was ordering food today and a man that had already been there shoved in front of me to yell at the person at the register. This man was very angry and said that they forgot his chips and the woman at the register respectfully said " I am so sorry sir I will get you another bag of chips and an extra chips and queso" instead of the man saying thank you he yelled even more even though the cashier was respectfully handling the situation. I am not mad that the man pushed in front of me but I am mad by the way he reacted towards pancheros employees. My food was wonderful and the employees were very nice. I will definitely  be back for good food!

This place sucked. We waited 1 hour for our first round of sushi and it wasn't even good. I know it's all you can eat but it was awful. Do not get the tuna, it tasted like trash. This was the worst sushi experience I've ever had and I've had discounted sushi from shoprite. on the bright side its BYOB, and you can google coupons.

My go-to neighborhood sushi spot on Bath Street. Sushi Teri originally was unimpressive - sushi rice overcooked/watery and fish cuts inconsistent, but they won me over as their Chirashi dinner was the best deal in town for the variety.

However, in the past 6 months, they have upped the price by a few $, no longer include cabbage salad and though the fish is cut larger, it's only 1 piece (used to be smaller/2 pieces). As of 3/4/2014, my dinner came with: Tuna, Salmon, Yellowtail, Saba (J. Mackerel), Albacore, Squid, Octopus, Ikura, Krab, Tamago (Egg cake), Ebi, Snow Crab leg (YUM), Seaweed Salad. Definitely one of the better nights, but the selection varies and when they skimp, it's noticeably disappointing. I added an order of Bluefin Tuna Nigiri - won't get that again.  

The Chirashi lunch is significantly the better deal - same bowl size, same fish cuts (no seaweed salad) for approximately 8$ cheaper. Lunch as of 4/12/2014 included: Tuna, Salmon, YT, 2 pieces of Saba, Albacore, Octopus, Tamago, Ikura, Krab, Ebi, and Tai.  Both include miso soup. I bit the bullet and went for dinner AND lunch to show comparisons. 

The service there is consistently decent; probably because I go there way too much. They know me and I like that both sushi chefs and waiters greet me warmly. I definitely don't get special treatment - I Wish! - but I do feel taken care of especially after a hard day's work, grabbing a quick lunch or getting food to go. They don't judge when I'm being silly with sake with friends, then go back the next day to get ramen to cure my hangover.  PS their tonkotsu ramen hits the spot in spite of SB lacking true ramen - nice rich salty flavorful broth, standard noodles, gelatinous pork slices, but the egg is always rubbery and inedible.

Their uni shooter is unique and their amaebi is yummy - and yes they make fried shrimp heads out of the spot prawns!

Went in for carry out and everything had been sitting there, unfresh, for a while. My food was cold and the fried items were soggy; also got sick from the stuffed mushrooms. It was really a bad visit, and additionally, the thing I wanted (coconut shrimp) wasn't even there. Most trays were empty or just the look of being out since yesterday night. Never again.

My boyfriend and I came here a few days ago. We like exploring local restaurants in Reno every time we are here. I came across this place on yelp and the reviews convinced me. I'm a big prosciutto lover and saw that they have Italiano Benedict with prosciutto in it and that sold me. The staff was cheerful and very nice. He came back a few times to check on us and see if we needed anything else. My food (Italiano Benedict) was really good. The poached eggs were cooked just how I wanted it. The potatoes that came with it was tasty but wasn't too salty. My boyfriend ordered a mushroom omelette and finished it as well. He did wish the vegetables were more cooked than they were. Overall, it was a great brunch and we'll definitely be back.

Just had dinner here with my boyfriend and the sushi and service were incredibly good, as usual. However, the size of the rolls has decreased substantially, and I was pretty disappointed with that. For $17.95, I would expect the King Kani roll to be substantial, not scrawny. Now, the Princess Kani would be a more fitting name. One redeeming factor is the lamb chops--they're still the best I've had. Flavor and service are excellent but quantity/value for the money, not so much.

Considering this spot has tons of great reviews, I would say that if you're in the mood for decent ramen, this is absolutely a great choice! Growing up in Hawaii, I would consider myself a good judge of ramen (broth, noodles, toppings, etc) and this place def hits the spot!

Pretty good for fast food. I got the pot roast sandwich with onion rings and the hubby got a double bacon butter burger with cheese curds. He loved his and I thought mine was very good. Service was great and was very clean. Wish I had saved room to try the custard.....maybe next time :)

So it took me almost three years of procrastination before I finally took the painting one of my friends painted for me to Giant Steps to get framed. Its a huge piece that I wanted on canvas block and I was told it would be ready by December 1st (I dropped it off the 3rd week in November). Its damn near christmas and its still not ready. I didnt even get a phone call before December 1st to let me know it wouldnt be ready in time. Im never going back there again.

Perhaps I put too much emphasis on service, but that is the main reason I give this restaurant a 2 star review. I have been there twice, once on vacation in July 2013 and once again recently since I moved to Tampa this month. 

The first time I thought it was a fluke ...that the food arrived fast but the server never returned to check on us and never gave us refills. I actually had to go up to the counter and ask the server back there for a refill on my coffee and water. She said "I'm not your server, but..."  Clearly, we put her out, but I wanted a refill. The food was fast and was pretty good, as far as breakfast foods go. 

The second time was reminiscent of the first. Except, this time we were forewarned that she was leaving for an appointment and we'd be "taken care of" by the rest of staff after she left. We placed our order and, again, received our food quickly. She stopped by with the check and told us she was taking off, telling us we would be served by the other servers again. But, we were never served by anyone else. Again, never checked on or given refills or even a shout in our direction asking if we needed anything. 

It sucks feeling neglected and having to pay for it. This is my first yelp review, because I had the same experience twice despite other good reviews. 

Take your chances on the service. I won't be returning.
Been here a few times because I live very close. Their hot sauce is good but that's about it. Breakfast tacos are very bland. They do have mimosas though.

Great food! A bit of a drive if you're in Tucson, but totally worth it. The owner is very pleasant and often checks on you after your meal. I'm partial to Greek food and have eaten it all over the place (sadly, not in Greece), but this has to be in the top three Greek restaurants I've ever eaten at, from big cities to, well, Catalina.

Super nice location right next to the beach and the wait wasn't long at all. The waiter was super nice and got our order in very quickly considering I went on a Saturday at 8:30 pm. The food was good but could have tasted better, my coleslaw tasted like it was old and I can tell my veggies where cooked in the same grill that meat was, since it had a slight meat taste, this wasn't an issue for me as I eat meat  but could be for someone that's vegan.

Alana is awesome! Moved to Reno from CA 5 months ago and wanted to make sure I kept to my waxing schedule. So glad I found her. She is personable and makes you feel comfortable. Alana does a great job and I find I don't have any of the irritation and redness I had with my former aesthetician. Book your appointment now!

It was an awesome time!! Nick was a great 'host' and kept the 'escape' moving...if you are looking for a fun time definitely recommend...we had 10 people so not sure how much fun it would be with strangers..but is was a great time.
Easy to schedule online. My lashes last longer than when done at other salons. Mindy's great! Love my lashes; I'm addicted!

We saw an ad online that was up to 80% off with free delivery, so we stopped by. The furniture was over priced approx 4x. My husband asked why the chair was $3000 and after than man responded my husband laughed and said " I thought someone famous sat in it!" We left immediatly. There was no lighting outside and they looked closed when we showed up. To me the high prices are a reflection of cooking the books to be able to hold loans to have furniture on the floor. We were not impressed at all.

Fri. Night dinner ~7:45 for sunset applause with 30 min. wait... for party of eight outside.  Appetizers were excellent: blackened Ahi tuna w/soy sauce and w/very concentrated wasabi (Hot!), and a crab stuffed pretzel that was devoured.  Crab pizzas (two for group) - were okay.  Stuffed shrimp, crab cakes (and mostly crab), grouper sandwich and shrimp/crab/ corn chowder were enjoyed by all.

Brass Monkey was recommended by friends, and we would also recommend.

Terrible service! They took my friends and I in at 3:00 only to have a server chase us out and tell us we either had to rush our order or leave because they close at 3:00. Why take us then? We could've not wasted our time! I had ordered a coke and they refused to let us leave until it was paid for, but don't take debit cards?! Had a friend pay the $2.00 cash since they refused to take any other form of payment! Sounds like a load of crock to me! Don't go! There are many other places with better food and service than this place!

Can't miss STL brunch spot: great prices, easy to get in and out of, amazing food, and attentive friendly service! We made Sunday brunch reservations for 11am just before we left the house, but probably wouldn't have had to wait for a table until after noon. Parking was easy. Nice decor. All of the staff members were nice, informative, and generous in their praise of our menu choices. I had a gingery champagne thing that was delicious, and then took vicious advantage of their bottomless mimosa. "Surely it's mostly orange juice?" No. It was perfectly made with OJ for color. We had scotch eggs (a memorable must eat), salmon eggs Benedict (would have been flawless had the eggs not been cooked solid), breakfast pasties (somehow the gravy doesn't make the pastry soggy), home fries (REAL home fries, not just fried potatoes) French press coffee, and key lime custard (perfect summer dessert - that toasted coconut finish tho). Already can't wait to go back.

Dining the way it's supposed to be done.

We walked in and were had the choice of several different menu types and seating areas. We chose to sit in the basement because we could still hear the live band on the first floor but it was calm enough to enjoy our meal and hear each other speak. 

We were promptly seated upon arrival by the hostess and our waiter was quick to take a drink order and explain the menu.

We ordered an appetizer (kettle chips) to split, and my wife decided to get the Nashville Hot bites as a meal. Me on the other hand, I got the Nashville burger. Our waiter asked us how hungry we were, implying that we were getting a lot of food (trying to warn us). We were starving- it had been a long day and we hadn't eaten in 10 hours. We normally don't have a problem eating an appetizer and most of our meal... we did this time! Portions were huge!

The kettle chips were fantastic! Definitely enough for a few people to share as an appetizer or for one person to eat as their meal. The Nashville bites had great flavor and were just the right amount of heat. The burger was delicious, but could not be cooked to order. 

After dinner, we wandered up to the rooftop where a great acoustic band was playing. It was much more "chill" than Jason Aldeen's rooftop bar that is right next to it. It was nice having the option to walk back and forth to listen to either band.

the first steak of my life was at a Outback and i can never forget that. Ever since than have been going to one when you don't feel like spending a 100$ for a good steak and want your occasional craving filled.

The branch here is pretty decent and no matter how busy they are one thing i have noticed goign here  4-5 times already in 4 years is that they do a an awesome job of serving their steaks just right. You know that feeling when a place is overcrowded like a chain , you just know the food will not be well brought out.

I usually go with a sirlion medium with mashed potatoes and my oh they hit the spot right. Friend got the Fillet minion which was cooked med-rare as requested and man were they filling , even though they looked small.

So try it out and enjoy this place, oh ya btw they did renovate it from teh outside and looks the same from inside as before.

In 28 years, I have never had a cavity. I brush and floss religiously. Dr. Greg Stoici told me I had 4 cavities. I went to Smile Design because I got new insurance, which had a limited amount of dentists to choose from. I felt very skeptical and uncomfortable with Dr. Stoici's approach and also was misinformed, as I had scheduled a cleaning, and then the receptionist was trying to sell me all sorts of other visits. Very misleading. 

I decided to just pay out of pocket and visit my usual dentist, Dr. Parkinson, and he not only laughed and assured me that I has ZERO cavities, but he also apologized on behalf of the entire dental field for the unethical behavior of Dr. Stoici. I can't believe I would have had unnecessary fillings in my teeth if I had trusted this man. So disappointed in him and his practice.

Not too service oriented.  Middle aged man with glasses taking order seemed exhausted and impatient.  Bagels are very good but grill food is hit or miss.  We took quite a break since our previous visit but had a repeat experience.  Bummer since  there is a need for this type of restaurant in the area.

I'm incredibly lucky to work near On a Roll, but I live an hour away. So when I say that it's so good that I'm happy to come even on my day off, that should be an indication of just how good this place is. 

The staff/owners/family are incredibly friendly. Its a family operation and they're always hospitable and accommodating. The menu is very diverse and can be a bit overwhelming, so don't be afraid to ask for something. Just because you don't see it on the menu doesn't mean they can't make it! 

The sushi quality is absolutely exceptional. All of the rolls are built by an expert hand with only the freshest of ingredients. Try a sushi burrito, you will be very happy you did.

I could go on and on about the talent of the staff, the quality of the food and the overall exceptional experience I've had every time I've visited On a Roll, but instead I'll say: Stop reading and GO TO ON A ROLL!

Awesome brewery. It's very large, feels like a beer hall, and beautifully built/decorated. I could hang out all day, and did. The beers are very well done, with tons of styles to try. Prices are respectable. It was busy, and had to wait a bit in line to grab a beer, but well worth it. Service was solid. I think they could improve the system they have for betting beer, its a tad bit awkward - but they are new and I suspect they have some kinks to work out. I will definitely be back next time I pass through. Drink local!

All their Doughnuts are great especially the coconut sprinkled ones.Coffee would maybe be good if they would clean out the dispenser and the coffee maker.
FYI-SOAPY WATER-A LITTLE ELBOW GREASE-THEN RUN DISTILLED VINEGAR THROUGH THEM UNTIL CLEAN

I ordered from this place on Ubereats as I didn't feel like leaving my hotel. I ordered the bbq shrimp and grits and a biscuit. I paired it with homemade mimosas, and this was an undefeated combo. I definitely recommend checking this place out if you're ever in New Orleans! The combination of flavors and the consistency of the grits was perfect!

This review pertains to to-go salad and service only. 

I had 20 minutes before my flight out of STL on Delta. I stopped by Mosaic to grab something to go. I decided on the chicken salad (which by the way was nothing special, tasted about the same as the $8.5 salad from every other vendor in any airport). By the time I picked up the container, there was a huge line and the "hostess", if there ever is a person there, is no where to be found. There were all sorts of empty tables and at least two servers walking around leisurely, but god forbid that they try to seat some guests. 

I went up to the bar area to pay for my food. The girl seemed flustered. After she handed back my card, I asked for utensils; she came back with a plastic folk and a few napkins, not in any sort of plastic packaging; She turned around immediately to walk away but I had to halt her to ask for a bag, to which I was told "we don't have bags." Um...excuse me? So they expect their to-go customers to hold on to their food container, utensils, napkins, and a drink in their hands while juggling their other luggage/bags? What about people who dine-in? Do they get bags for their leftovers? 

As I left, I noticed the line had gotten longer and some agitated customers were flagging down the waiters to ask if they could just sit themselves. I struggled squeezing all the stuff in my hand into my luggage and five minutes after I boarded my plane and began to eat, I realized that without a knife I could not cut through the giant chicken pieces in my salad and had to eat them one bite at a time. 

From just a 15 minute experience, I would say that the restaurant is grossly under-prepared and the staffs rude/under-trained. They clearly don't have all their ducks in a row. For the same cost, I could pick up a salad from any other vendor in the airport, and I'll know that I can pay immediately, and have all my plastic utensils (yes, a knife too!) in a sanitary plastic pouch, and have a plastic bag to tote them around. This is the first and last time I will stop by the to-go counter at Mosaic in the airport. When I'm in a hurry, one bad experience is one too many.
Ordered a ribeye medium. They couldn't get it right not 1,not 2, not 3, but 4 times they tried to cook it right!!! I didn't eat. Check was comped, but this is a steakhouse right?

Take a look at the pictures no words or explanation needed!!!! Have some respect for your clients or shut the damn place. What a joke! Went there for the first time , never again!
