I usually do a lot of research but boy did I miss this one. Do yourself a huge favor and don't deal with this company!!!!!!

Bomb diggity  banana pudding.  The peach banana pudding is great! I'm from NY, & I go down to Philly, to the Reading Market every couple of months. Nina's banana  puddings are always on my list to get. Its so worth it.

The place was mobbed with a line literally out the door.

My espresso was delicious. I didn't eat. It looks like they cater to vegans. Lots of items clearly marked as vegan.

The staff is an absolute joy. I asked the barista his name and it's Carlos. Kudos to you, Carlos. You are awesome in the face of desperate people being cranky.
Snow-cones meet your favorite cheesecake. This dessert is cool, re-freshing, light, flavorful and delicious!! Sno-La you just topped off my first trip to N.O.  Thank you for the bang for my bucks
Good lunch spot if you're looking for something quick on the healthy side. You could ding all Saladworks for the dull experience, but the food is great at this one.

The service here has been awesome .  I had never been a fan of Subway but in the last month I have been back to this subway three times. The ingredients always seem very fresh. They don't skimp on the add on's over all this subway is  very fresh, friendly and fast.

Love this place!!! I know i can always come here and get some good grub and a great honeybush tea. I love the atmosphere and music is always great!! Im not a coffee drinker but my husband swear by it, tea selection is awesome. 6 years and still going strong ..props to highergrounds!!

We ate here for the first time a month ago and it was amazing. The small spinach Gorgonzola salad is full of fresh ingredients and a large portion. But the star is the pizza! The Detroit style Bee's Knees and the old world style Honey Cup are delicious. We decided that we never needed to order pizza from a chain again. But today the experience was a little different. One of the best parts of the Detroit style pizza is the brick cheese in the crust. Today it was overcooked to the point where the crust was inedible. The rest of the pizza was good but it seemed like there was less of the hot honey on top than on our previous visit. We had gotten it as takeout and if we had ordered at the restaurant I would've sent it back. After this experience I doubt that we'll order takeout from here again.

I was contacted by the owner, shortly after this review posted, offering to make it right. I really appreciate businesses that pay attention to customer concerns. We will give them another chance and I'll update this review at that time.

My husband and I met our Designer Amy here to check out plumbing and bathroom fixtures.  Tish was very patient and was a huge help in keeping us within our budget.  If we liked a particular item that was over our budget, she knew the exact model of a different one, more in our price range with similar looks. 

There was lots of sinks, toilets and bathtubs to choose from.  The bathroom lights and mirrors are gorgeous. 

I recommend this place and the staff is super friendly.

This place simply is adorable!  The owner/chef has a wonderful personality always making sure everyone's satisfied.  Most meals are great but there can be some inconsistencies w/how they prepare something, not sure if that's when someone else is on the grille.  Their bloody is a bit different but worth a taste but our go-to are the mimosas.   The menu is refreshingly non traditional on many items but of course the staples are there.  The outside seating is limited but the pooches can tag along which is nice.  There's a lot of great energy here, I just smile when dining here.

I come 3x a week, and I know if I want breakfast I should not come here. On several occasions it's the same lady in the food area, who handles the breakfast. But this past week, made me need to write this review. The kitchen lady was holding up the line of people waiting for the breakfast, as always, and the cashier asked if she needed assistance. Yet the lady didn't even seem to care, so the cashier went herself to bring out the tray. Now the cashier was being a team player, but we all can agree that no one should have to do someone's job just because they don't feel like working. For weeks now, I've seen her just unhappy and not motivated to help her coworkers with simply doing her own job. My advice to management: If you have 1 bad apple as an employee, remember that 1 bad apple can rotten your other good apples of employees.

The place is locally owned and has amazing food. The bell pepper rings are a MUST! They will be the best thing you've ever had. Husband had the steak sandwich and loved it. I had the fried green tomato BLT which is perfect. Topped it all off with the Oreo beignets! Awesome staff and a great place!

I didn't like them. Too sweet & no inside seating with a/c  to sit down & relax. I took pictures so you can see what the place looks like. It's HOT & loud so I really don't see myself coming again. This is 2 stars for favor overall. I highly recommend "Bahama Buck's" if your in the mood for some shave ice. Good luck this place isn't for me!
A special thank you to Juan for the skilled, professional delivery.  We are completely satisfied with our Green Valley Decorative Rock purchase and experience.

I visited this nail salon twice. It had good reviews and was open late which was what I needed. My first visit I had a full set removed which was very painful. The most painful and uncomfortable experience I ha a ever had. I thought the technician could have been more gentle. She basically ripped all the nails off. But I thought I would give it another try. Getting fake nails removed isn't the best way to judge. So I went back and had a fill. The technician did not seem to be paying much attention because I had to constantly remind him the gel light was not on. I try not to bug the technicians about this bc it's not my job and I don't know when they want it on/off. So I had them done right before my trip home for thanksgiving. 30 min after I left the gel began to peel. I couldn't go back to get them fixed because I was leaving the next day. Very frustrating and disappointed. They offered me a 15.00 credit which was nothing compared to the amount of money I had to spend to get them redone when I got home. Will not go back.

My husband and I are regular customers.  We dine here at least once a week but sometimes three times a week.  We love love love this little sushi place.  Don't let the name fool you...the sushi is authentic.  I send a special shout out to Chef Allen who goes out of his way to ensure I have my rolls just the way I like them.  Everyone is just amazing.  This restaurant is just two doors down from Steinmart in Valrico.  Give them a try --you won't be sorry.  They are also open for lunch and lunch is equally amazing.

I've been to BJ's once before at cirrus park and it was excellent. This exp was the worst. We were all out of a family dinner and every single person didn't like their food except for one and she got deep dish rigatoni. We had the sante fe salad and it left a lot to be desired. The shrimp and quinoa dish was ok and that's being generous. The server was semi rude and seemed like she could care less we were there. I'm not sure what happened Bc I planned the dinner and was so excited to take the fam there but I certainly won't be back. The apps we got were mozz sticks and avocado rolls. Mozz sticks were cold. Cold!!! The avocado rolls were cold and all of the avocado was brown and mushy. I wouldn't waste my time or money here.
Awesome place to go! Good is always great! Way better than Chipotle or any other burrito spot in town...

If you love simple and delicious Polish food, Pierogi Factory is singing your song.  

This tiny four table restaurant is in the Shops at Red Lion on Bustleton Avenue, Northeast Philly.  The menu focuses on the staples: Pierogies, Stuffed Cabbage, Potato Pancakes, Kielbasa and a few other goodies.  Service is casual and sincere.  

We ordered their Combo Dinners in order to sample as many of their dishes as possible.  Combo # 1 had two potato pancakes, 3 pierogis of choice (traditional potato and farmer's cheese), and 1 Golabki (stuffed cabbage), with a little container of sour cream ($9.95).  Every element was excellently prepared with taste as good as my grandmother used to make.  The other combo swapped out the potato pancakes for a nice length of smoked (grilled) kielbasa ($10.95).  Also, fantastic.  

I was full, but not stuffed, when we finished eating.  We shared a piece of apple cake ($3.00).  It was not as good as granny's, as it lacked the moisture, density and large apple slices she used to fatten up her grandchildren.  

Still, a very pleasant surprise on Bustleton. Will definitely visit here again.

My dishwasher was not working at all - not draining, etc.  I called them up and made an appointment.  They came over within 3 days, on time and solved the problem quickly.  All covered within the cost of the initial service call fee.  Very nice and capable repairman.  I highly recommend them.

For a restaurant in an airport, this establishment has class and lives up to the reputation of its big city counterpart.  

Ordered the Seared Ahi Tuna over seaweed salad.  Seared ahi tuna was cooked a little longer than seared, but still lightly cooked with a raw center that's tasted pretty fresh...or atleast preserved fairly well.  The sea weed salad was sweet and savory.  The mustard sauce had a kick, but was not too spicy.


Food: 5 star (for an airport)
Service: with a smile
Price: like a 5 star
Return visit; only if I am flying put on business...but yes.

A fine dining and upscale experience - one you shouldn't miss. 

I'm here for a conference and a long-time friend drove two hours so we could catch up. This was the ideal place - the staff was top notch with just the right amount of attentiveness, great recommendations from the menu (hint: steak, or if you're not in to that sea bass or crab cake). The entire restaurant is beautiful, elegant and open yet partitioned in a way that makes you feel like you're in a more intimate setting. 

My filet was extremely tender and cooked to perfection and the caramelized onions were the perfect complement. Pre-steak Caesar salad presentation was wonderful with an almost full-sized plate asiago crisp. 

For a restaurant that opened two months ago, they've nailed their stride.

American Strategic Insurance is overpriced and has taken my money for premium payments for years but has NEVER paid a single penny in claims!!!  Oh, they send so-called "field claims adjusters" out to your home but it is all nothing but a complete waste of your time and a total sham . . . because American Strategic Insurance is just NOT going to find that your claim is covered and will just NOT pay you a cent!!!

I definitely would NOT recommend them!!!  Find a better insurance company for your homeowners' insurance coverage!!!

Lincoln Square is your usual neighborhood breakfast/lunch spot, and this is a good thing. The menu is big, (not as big as a Chicago Greek greasy spoon) but maybe someday it will be! I love Greek diners. 
The decor is not fancy, but they offer a lot of booths and room for large parties.

The service has always been good, and fast. I have rarely been when the place was not almost full. I go mainly for breakfast and the eggs and bacon are better here then some of the more upscale restaurants in the area, pair that with the more affordable price and that makes it a winner. The one thing we do not like here is the buttermilk pancakes. Very dry, but they are fluffy.  Coffee is average. Sandwiches are good, I have had the club and the deli meat was a good quality.
If you get a soda they will offer you a to go cup with a fresh drink. Nice touch.
You pay at the counter, but the line moves quickly. 
Parking can be a pain since this is in a small strip mall in the same lot as a Wal-greens. The nice this is you can park in any spot with in the lot.

Since Iast October we had gone to Sawmill Run and it was really good, I was excited to go there again.    Unfortunately, my expectations were not met.

After reading the reviews here on Yelp, I decided to try the Sweet Potato Tots with my French Dip Sandwich. We also split an order of the only wings on the menu, BBQ.

The wings were OK but nothing to write home about.  They were covered with thick sauce.  But there was no discernible smoke flavor, unlike the WONDERFUL wings we had here last year.  (Those weren't BBQ, either, as I recall.)  They came with celery and carrot sticks and the MOST WATERED-DOWN DRESSINGS (bleu cheese and Ranch) that I have EVER SEEN!

My French Dip sandwich had a VERY skimpy amount of meat and a few pieces of onion.  Most disappointing was the flavor -- it was VERY bland, with almost no flavor.  It was accompanied by au jus, which normally adds a lot of flavor to a French Dip sandwich.  However, in this case the au jus was SO WATERED DOWN that it tasted like nothing, just water.  So what should have been flavorful juice added NOTHING to the sandwich at all.

I had high hopes for the Sweet Potato Tots since everyone here raved about them.  Unfortunately, I did not like them.  They weren't very crisp and had a strong sweet potato flavor.  I would say that those folks who REALLY LIKE the flavor of sweet potato will probably like these.  My friend didn't really like them either so we didn't even bother to pack up the uneaten ones to take home.

I decided to order some regular seasoned fries to accompany my sandwich.  They were hot, crisp, perfectly seasoned, and delicious!  The fries turned out to the BEST thing we had!  Well, the fries and the pickle spear.  :)
Awesome atmosphere, service, and the 6.00 Burger and Fries Wednesday special was exceptional! A coworker had Cod and said it was fantastic! Highly recommend!

Fun fact - As of 12/27/2014 if you check in and order a coffee you get a free macaroon! Not sure how long this lasts but if you are stopping in you might as well check in with your Yelp App!!

The staff is always very friendly at this location. I've only gotten cupcakes and macaroons from Sucre but both are a (pricey) delicious treat! I like getting the box of 15 macaroons as a gift. Fifteen macaroons are about $30 and you can usually select from a mixed box (one of each flavor) or a seasonal box - at Christmastime I got a box of 15 peppermint and chocolate. The macaroons come already wrapped in a box and chilled so make sure to store in your fridge - but they are so yummy that you will gobble them up before you can even put them back in the fridge!

The king cake is another thing to think about - it is very overpriced for it size - $20 for a teeny king cake with some glitter on it. I would say to try this king cake once in your life, but do not purchase it to bring it to a party. Most people in New Orleans eat their king cake based on the width of the color, and if you go by that philosophy, only four people can enjoy this teeny tiny king cake!

I had high hopes for this place but it fell short of my expectations. Soup was SUPER salty I actually think they dumped an entire shaker of salt in by mistake and still served it. Salad bar was really nothing special and the items were not chilled to an enjoyable temp lol....overall I don't see myself returning the staff was nice but I'm not eating them lol. Also there is bathroom attendants I get the place is old school but that's tacky.

I like Ellers donuts. I think the donuts are good, my favorite is the old-fashioned buttermilk. I also enjoy the Thai food, if you really beg hard enough they'll make it spicy for you. They did that for us tonight, and one of the four of us was actually sweating (happily). We will be back.
The pad Thai has an addictive quality.

I ordered take out from here and was impressed at the staff for following my very specific requests. My order was ready on time. The tofu banh mi is delicious my mouth is watering as I write this review, the baguette was nice and toasty too. Lovely place serving up some great food.

I had the hot Roast Beef sandwich with homemade mashed potatoes and gravy.  Wow!  Something so simple and done so well that I will remember it for a long time.  I've had way too many disappointing roast beef sandwiches in my life and I knew somebody had to be taking their time and doing it right,  and this place is it.  We are in town for the marathon and I will be back before we leave to have the excellent Roast Beef sandwich and homemade mashed potatoes.

I've eaten at casino buffets in Vegas and Detroit but none exceeds the fresh harvest buffet at the Hard Rock Casino. The waite staff tells you what is available before you start your search and seizure. The grilled salmon and chicken at the Mongolian grill we're expertly prepared as was the steak that comes with the buffet (no need to purchase the NY strip in my opinion). A brief but lovely conversation with the raw bar staff got me a trough of Nawlins inspired peel and eat shrimp cooked in butter and garlic-yum! To top it all off we enjoyed glasses of wine (extra) with our meal making this a dining experience. Get the players club card as others have said for a $5.00 discount. We shall return.

I ordered a latte from here with boba in it, and while this was user error in ordering (boba isn't great in a latte... stick to tea! lol) the latte itself was really gross. I will say the tea that my husband ordered was delicious, so I'm just bummed that I didn't order the tea to go with my boba.

They have wifi and a neat little area to sit in. If you are at Brandon Regional Hospital, it would be a nice place to escape to if you needed to get out for a minute. 

 I'd be willing to go back here based on the texture of my boba, the tea, and the convenient location. I was really happy that they were open when I went. They are closed one day midweek, so just keep that in mind.

Unbelievably fabulous and reasonable! I am a handicapped 73 year old woman, a perfect target for unscrupulous service people, so after comparing prices for cleaning and maintenance and settling on the lowest by far, it was only the next day that they could arrive. The appearance of Nathan with his winning smile, hand ready to shake and introduce himself was such a relief and a comfort. He explained every step of the way, changed out filters and worked for two hours to make sure the temperature came down and all was working, and while I was soaking hot inside the home, he looked like he had just appeared for work. Nathan was a true gentleman, he set the bar for every serviceman to follow, so congratulations Donelson for not only hiring good people but for training them the old fashioned way, I am beyond impressed and wish I had known about you sooner.

everything I've had here has been great, the mushroom pho is excellent. however, the Khao Poon is possibly the BEST soup I have ever had in my life (and I reeeeally like soup). with tofu it's vegan, too, which is great. HIGHLY recommend trying it, I don't know what I'm going to do if they take it off the menu.
Delicious!!!!  Awesome pizza with unlimited options!  Fast and friendly service.  Great crust, light sauce, and real cheese!  Huge slices!

Wow, it only seems to get worse. I will definitely not be coming back. I'm not sure what happened but the service has gone way downhill. They messed up my order and I have been waiting over 2 months for my contact lenses. No one knows what is going on - I am told one thing and then something different another day. I had to call to ask where my order was and told they would call me right back and they don't. They ended up canceling my order (the one that I've been waiting on for over 2 months) and starting from scratch. Unacceptable.

Incredible incredible incredible. Every bite was amazing. We ordered the chefs plate and the Thai Cobb. I ordered the Thai Cobb for my husband but ended up eating half!The meat was so good you don't even need bbq sauce!
Very happy with blackened red fish for lunch! Close to my hotel, I would definitely come back!

Simply put, Gary and Jenn at the Beautiful Mind Strong Body Center are the dream team.

Gary's extensive background in pharmacology and expertise in pain management, coupled with his vast knowledge in exercise and physiology and his own personal experiences, enables him to help you create lasting positive changes in fitness and movement with compassion and humor. He understands the challenges faced by those with chronic pain well- physically, psychologically, and spiritually- and utilizes a whole person approach based on cutting edge research in cognitive neuroscience, positive psychology, and a deep knowledge and understanding of sensorimotor psychology. You will see and feel results!

I learned how to begin to develop a safe exercise program in the midst of a long and grueling rehabilitation from a serious surgery, and to focus on the little things I could do each day that added up to a significant positive change in my overall ability to function and my perception of my pain. I also learned the importance of breaking the pain cycle early during flare-ups, and how to relate to my body as a vessel for healing rather than a faulty mechanism I was fighting against.

Gary also led me through a visualization designed to retrain the neural pathways in the brain associated with my pain, and helped me realize that I had developed a heightened, faulty pain response to normal stimuli; my body had gotten into the habit of associating certain motions and activities with nerve pain, escalating my perception pain and severely limiting my ability to function. He explained how this happens, how a pain response significantly and permanently can alter physiology, and how it is possible to work to change perception of pain. After this experience, I immediately began to notice a difference as I became more aware of the patterns I had developed and came away armed with helpful tools to improve my daily experience.

The studio has a beautiful array of yoga and fitness classes for all ages and skill levels, and Gary and Jenn are committed to helping you achieve your goals on the road toward building a life of beauty, strength, and balance.

I can't recommend Beautiful Mind Strong Body highly enough!

Maybe I didn't have a good meal!  However the salty gumbo I had a this place made me re think the whole place. Then they were out of crab cakes!! I had some of the flash frozen catfish they served! Disgusting not to mention the nasty flash fried tasting shrimp. I hate to say it but the food was mediocre and priced as such

I'm a fan due to price and selection.  Food is pretty good and unique......not what you'll find in a typical Chinese Restaurant.  Locals were dining there; a school girl stopped by to pickup dinner on her way home.

For $4.95 you get four entrees/vegetables and soup.  Amazing deal.  Food is prepared and displayed behind glass--cafeteria display.  Nothing fancy inside--very basic tables and chairs.

The Bok Choy is amazing.  Chicken was also good.  I had two entrees that questioned my authentic Chinese food identification talents......regardless, they were good.  I just had the kind server surprise me.  Meal for two with one beer and a soda was under $13.00.  Amazing.

Only negative--two of the entrees were not "hot" only slightly warm.
Food was excellent. Service was awesome, friendly ladies there. Had the eggs, grits, biscuit and sausage with a side of debris for my biscuit.

I will include plenty of photos..
 Tish flooring after agreeing to a contract of $6,100 for 650 square feet of flooring and Installation and so on..
I put half down, they deliver the some of the materials the tile and glue. They didn't bring the trim or any of the other things that they were going to need and I did baseboards..
 Then they decide halfway through day one that my floor is not level enough... and they refuse to use leveling solution or anything of that factor unless I pay them minimum 3000 more.. or another 6900 in rip up my entire floor.. with by the way..
 it looks pretty damn fabulous anyways..

I reported them to the manufacturer and I had to called the police, they tried to get into my house while I was gone..  They wanted tools, I told them they can have their tools, when they deliver the rest of my materials..

 Two of my Gates were left open my dogs got out, and my neighbor saw them. I called the police.  I can't believe they tried to do that...

To get the rest of my materials they would not bring them off the truck  without the police telling them to.

Cori's is AWESOME! So so so good. Vegetarian replacements We live right across the street, and have been in multiple time throughout COVID and every time, all the workers are wearing their masks the entire time, washing their hands after almost every touch. I see you behind those hot grills wearing the mask, and I appreciate you.

I give then 3 stars because they have a great happy hour. But I went here for dinner and was very disappointed. The pasta was under cooked even though we had to wait over 20min for our food and the meat portions were small. I did like that they were very accommodating for the two children in our group.

We ordered 5 different items off the menu, and honestly everything was awesome.   I would definitely recommend the Korean pork tacos, the Brussel Sprouts, and the Lobster Mac and Cheese was phenomenal

The atmosphere, menu, and food - they were all amazing. There's lots of seating, mood lighting, and trendy, sleek décor that any modern hipster would love to Instagram. 

The service and policies here though? Completely lacking. I sauntered in after work and upon noticing the front bar was full, asked for table for my friend and I. We were led to the "outdoor" seating area, which I would have never known was considered outdoors due to coverage overhead and well-functioning space heaters. It was in this space that we noticed a second bar area. Odd it was never mentioned or advertised. 

We were sat at a table situated 3 feet from the bar, and the only ones sitting in the "waiter service" area.
 Upon our servers arrival, my first question was "do you offer any happy hour specials?" He gazed towards the bar then back to me, stating assuredly that they did not offer happy hour specials. No worries. 

But wait! As he disappears, I overhear the bartender stating that happy hour goes until 6. Being 5:40, I thought it odd that the server didn't mention this. I got up, went to the bar, and again asked about happy hour. The bartender hesitated, but admitted that there is a happy hour but only at the bar. I mentioned we were seated literally 3 feet from the bar, and asked if I could purchase a drink to take back to my table. She said no, because that would be taking, potentially, from the waiter's tip. Uhm. Weird. I then mentioned that moving to the bar completely would take away any tips he might be receiving from me. Odd. The whole thing was odd. Even a guy at the bar, witnessing the interaction, was like "dude, just let her buy a drink, I don't get it."

THEN. THEN. In comes a group of three, and the waitress kindly accommodates them, making room for the three people but never offering the same to my friend and I sitting two feet away, asking about happy hour. She then flagged the manager - who again explains that I can't buy a drink at the bar and take it to the table, so my only option is to pay $4 more for the beer that my peers sitting two feet higher at a bar 3 feet away. Out of principal, I just ordered my food, sipped my free water, GENEROUSLY TIPPED THE WAITER (who wasn't great), and left. 

I'm a kind, laidback customer. In fact, this was my first ever interaction with any sort of management in any establishment, because I'm typically not a complainer. But honestly? That's the dumbest policy I've ever heard. The communication was hugely lacking. The right answer when I asked the waiter about happy hour would have been "Yes we DO have happy hour, but only at bar" instead of lying (badly) to my face. The hostesses could have mentioned happy hour and the back as well and avoided this whole thing. Additionally, had ANYONE in this place been friendly, I would have tipped them ALL generously. 

By opening up happy hour specials to the whole place, they could only stand to earn MORE money. Either open it to everyone or no one. I don't get it. It's a shame I had this experience because I've been eyeing this joint for a while. The food was good, but service is important when I'm shelling out money. I felt uncomfortable here, and I won't be back.
Just got an awesome pair of sunglasses! Convenient downtown location on 9th. Love that they are dog-friendly, too. :)
Not my favorite by a long shot. Cheap flavoring ingredients. Way too much cream. There are much better ice cream makers out there. This is not one of them

This past Saturday night was a chilly one here in Tucson, and we felt like a nice, warming meal.  Therefore, we made a return visit to La Olla in Marana, a bit of a trek to the Northwest, but well worth it.  One only has to scoot up I-10 West, take Exit 244, left on Twin Peaks, left on Coachline, left on Silverbell; then, it's right there on the right in a small strip mall.  Upon arrival, we were seated promptly, given our menus, had drink orders taken and provided with chips and salsa.  The chips were crisp, and the salsa was great: Just thick enough, not runny; spicy, but not too spicy.

Last time, Mom had Manchego Shrimp, and I had Pork Carnitas; both entrees were delicious.  Our choices were made easy this time because of the two nightly specials that were on offer.  She chose Green Chili Shrimp Enchiladas, and I picked the "Surf-n-Turf," which was a combination platter of Carne Asada and Shrimp Manchego.  Each was served with side orders of Frijoles Refritos, Arroz Mexicano and Calabacitas.  Both the food and the plates were brought out piping-hot, caliente, not picante.

The cuisine at La Olla is inspired by traditional Sonoran fare with innovative touches that one might find at a Baja resort.  Mom remarked that it reminded her of more-upscale meals on which she had dined in Mexico City.  The Chili Verde sauce on her entree was light and fresh, and the enchiladas were packed with shrimp that were nice and firm, neither rubbery, nor mushy.  The Carne Asada on mine was perfectly seasoned, and the Shrimp Manchego was tasty, as always.  Many restaurants make this shrimp dish under various names: In Puerto Penasco, Mexico, a similar dish is called Cameron Carlos Quinto.

The Arroz Mexicano and Frijoles Refritos were very good, not generic, and insipid, as at some Mexican places.  The Calabacitas were outstanding, just as they were last time, the best that I have ever had, bar none.  For a beverage, I had my usual Horchata.  The waitresses were very attentive and kept checking back to see if we needed anything else, more chips and such, and to see how we were doing.  

The decor at Las Ollas is very low-key with a continental feel, not that of an old-style Mexican restaurant, and that suits the food that it serves.  Once again, it was a pleasurable dining experience.  We will definitely be back, and we are even thinking about just having a meal of appetizers one night as we would like to try some of them, as well.  Last, but not least, the hostess who bade us good night had a lovely smile.

I stopped in to get tires, was told I had to order & schedule my appointment online. Arrived on scheduled day my 1.5 hr appt took all day due to they broke 2 of my wheel studs (that they could not fix there) then when I entered my car I noticed that someone had went through my car stealing whatever change/bills (not much, not the point) and charms out of my car! I reentered questioning how this could happen? I was informed that they had this happen before and would refund what I was missing.. Needless to say: I returned my tires and will not shop there again!

The only times I have been to the Coliseum have been for hockey games...so my perspective is all based on that.

The recent renovation seems nice enough...I know a ton of money was dropped to bring the level up.  The building is old...but nice.  There isn't a bad seat in the arena for hockey except maybe at glass eye level and I prefer sitting higher up anyways.

The curtains in the 300 level are weird...it feels like they could have spent a bit more for walls or something (but maybe there is a reason).  And the rows in the 300 level are a straight guessing game...a big letter "D" at the start of the row would help.

Parking is hit or miss depending on where you come in.  Last visit was a nice crossing over the muddy horse track/infield...and muddy feet are always great.
Not only are the cocktails delicious, but the bites are very tasty too! The only thing that keeps me from coming more often is the line to get in!

Very disappointing. I got a hot ham and cheese po' boy and it came out cold and soggy, and the french fries were way too hot. Its like they forgot to cook the fries and then made my poor sandwich wait under the warmer. My husband got a shrimp po' boy and the fried shrimp was not crispy, or de-veined. Our server didn't care about us and forgot that she had already taken our drink order. She said maybe 10 words to us the whole time, seemed like we were inconveniencing her. The only saving grace was the live band on the patio. They were amazing!

To start on a positive note, the food was superb. The lobster truffle risotto entree was everything I hoped it would be to celebrate my birthday with flair. Our disappointment was with the robotic service and lack of responsiveness to our questions regarding whether modifications could be made to a dish. 
When we simply inquired whether cheese could be excluded from the vegetarian entree, the server's response was that he would check with the chef but never gave us a reply so a small salad was the only option for my husband's dinner. The lack of flexibility or willingness to accommodate a special dietary request in this day and age of so many preferences, allergies, etc. is truly antiquarian. It was also the server's curtness, our assumption that he never even posed our question to the chef, and not even bothering to respond to our request that were particularly unsettling (especially when we were paying dearly for another entree). The server charged us $5 for a small glass of seltzer and never came back with the rest of the bottle we paid for! Even though the customer service by phone was great when I communicated with the restaurant about it being a special occasion, this had not been conveyed to the server and there was no warmth or sense of feeling they cared a whit about giving a little extra attention.
We would have felt the love more at Denny's or IHOP.
Talking about the food coming to table piping hot. The place was packed, and the food was great!

Found this little gem through Dining advantage app and was pleasantly surprised.  Little bar in a large shopping center.  What prompts the higher rating isn't necessarily the food; which was good. But the waitress, Carolyn.  She was lively and friendly.  Personable and polite.  We were served with a smile and she could not be more accommodating.  This is rare anymore and appreciated. Menu was full of options and there were additional specials on the board.  It was early on a Friday so it wasn't crowded or noisy - perfect little stop for lunch.

Love Love Love their German Potato Salad! It is the best potato salad I have ever had! It beats any mayo based potato salad! They make it daily, so it's fresh everyday. Will always come back here for more.

We rented the private wine cellar.  Could have used a few more candles, and I found the echo distracting.  Also, other customers tend to peer in at you like you are a zoo animal.  Food was ok, can do much better in Philly.  The service was so bad that it became the joke of the night.

They are totally inconsistent with their hours.  wtf?!  

It says right here on Yelp that they open at 11 a.m.  I have yet to ever see them open for lunch (12:30).  

We've also gone for dinner at 7 p.m., and they're closed - on a Friday night!  wtf?!

Too frustrating, and we want to give a local chef / business owner the business...

This is my favorite Mexican place. I have been going here for 12 years. I love the food it's very authentic and not out of the can. The margaritas are the best in town. Our waiter is always Chuey he is always providing great service and treats us like the VIP
LOVE this place. I have frequented this multiple times in the past couple of years and it has never failed to bring a smile on my face. Yaayyyy to Banana Thursdays!
We couldn't get a seat upstairs, so we ventured downstairs to the clam bar where we enjoyed great service, hearty clam chowder, cold beers, and a great view.

The shepards pie is amazing, it's perfectly seasoned. My only negative would be it's not big enough!  It's freakin delicious and I'm left scrapping the bowl. I know it's rude,  an etiquette coach would probably pop my hand but I cant help it! ITS THAT GOOD! I just wish I could "SUPER SIZE" it!!! Im also fond of the meatloaf. It's so good I can never decide which one I want. Usually, I sucker my husband into getting the meatloaf and I get the pie and we switch plates half way through. It's the best of both worlds and I leave with a smirk on my face.

Great atmosphere.... Great food! The lamb chops are to die for. Last night I also tried the lobster and duck fried rice. Excellent!!! Never had a bad experience. Great go to place for happy hour also!

Venue? Pretty nice and modern. People? No. Thank. You.

3 stars for the venue. 2 stars for the crowd.

This is definitely more of a clubby venue out of the rest of the bars along the area. My friends and I last minute tried to get into this place even though we were clearly underdressed. But being a girl has it's benefits and my friend was able to get in with just a top, shorts, and flats and I was wearing a sundress. Whatever, as long as I get in right?

Friday night was PACKED. Lots and lots of people with a DJ at the front. At first I was totally enjoying the music because the DJ was blasting some quality EDM tunes. But then as the night progressed the DJ played purely hip hop. Okay, so I'm not hating on DJs that like to mix hip hop with their EDM songs because if done right, it can sound great. But this DJ was NOT doing the music right.

Anyway, I could swear that people were trying to do the dirty on the dance floor. I was standing in the middle of the floor just trying to enjoy a good time and I couldn't even stay long because everybody around me looked like they could use some quality alone time in their own hotel room. Gross.

Honestly, I can't even describe the people here. One word: gross gross gross.

Anyway, won't be coming back here. Weird crowd. Weird music.

This place is so cute and you feel like you're in hawaii and then, the food!  Well at least the burgers which are a pretty big staple of the menu - blow!  I mean frozen patties WTF!?!?  So I had a turkey burger my friend had a burger and both were well, obviously cooked from frozen.  Just soooo not what you'd expect froma place that looks as awesome as this does!  Really kinda baffled!  The nacho's were ok, nothing to write home about and the sweet potato fries were, well, a little frozen!  I dont mean like "cold" just obvious they werent made fresh and that's what the place evokes - fresh!  So go for the beer, the wine and maybe something battered??  Maybe stuff that tastes ok pre-made/frozen would fair better with exepectations or just adjust your taste buds and enjoy the ambiance and forget about the food!

Both my wife and I were a little spooked by the Kiosk tablet device on all the tables.  We had ordered lunch and noticed that other tables were being served and we had not yet received our soup and chili yet.  I told my wife that we should get the check and go find someplace to eat.  within 30 seconds our waitress  was at our table telling us our food was on it's way, it arrived 2 minutes later.  You would expect good chili based on the name of the restaurant.  I commented to my wife that it did not taste right and had an odd flavor.  Again within 1 minute another hostess showed up offering a different soup admitting that the chili may not be their best offering and was "missing ingredients".  She was quite insistent that I try a different soup and I am glad I did, The chicken enchilada soup was very tasty.

I cannot be sure that our conversations were being monitored by the Kiosk device, but the contextual attentiveness was a little eerie. 

The rest of the meal was tasty and filling.

Found this randomly on Yelp and decided to check it out. I was glad I checked it out. I had the pulled pork sandwhich and really liked it. Great place to go in the summer with the outside seating and is in a great location down Penns Landing area. I tend to visit this place whenever I'm in the area.

You cannot go wrong here.  The food is great, the bar is fully stocked with tons of unique options (branch out, don't order well liquors - there are far too many small batch or single barrel options that are begging to be discovered) and the bottle room upstairs is top notch.

I munched my way through many of their small plates and several of their mac and cheese and it is hard to pick a favorite.  A few that I can wholeheartedly recommend are the Lobster Mac and Cheese, Chorizo and Fontina Egg Rolls and the Angry Crab burger.  

The bartender and I had a great conversation about bourbons and microbrews and I was definitely impressed with his passion and knowledge.  He made sure I didn't stick with an old reliable favorite but helped me find a new bourbon to add to my list that I absolutely loved.  

If you are lucky enough to live nearby, this really should be your local pub of choice.  If you are a frequent business traveler to the Philly area, this one is worth a considerable drive.

This park would be great except for one thing.  The horses.  First, while there are signs everywhere telling you to clean up after your pet, evidently that doesn't apply to the equestrians because you can't walk 10 feet on a trail without having to dodge a big steaming pile of horse shit.

Second, while the trail system within the park is CLEARLY marked at being for pedestrians and PARK SERVICE VEHICLES ONLY.  The equestrians seem to think they can drive their BMW's any where they want.  I tried to walk my dog there one Saturday and nearly tripped many times because the dozens of cars and golf carts on the running trail were scaring the dog.  

When you are having a horse show in a public park you do NOT get to kick out everyone else.

Regrettably it's taken almost a year to follow-up and write this review.  Better late then never.  The range went out in a rental property I have.  It's always difficult to hire repairmen sight unseen when you can't be there to meet and interact.  I'm happy to say this experience worked out great.  The owner is professional and polite and my tenant had nothing but nice things to say about him.  I felt I was charged a fair price.  I'm happy to have found Apex.  I'll definitely use them again when the need arises.

Every time I visit, they are so friendly!!!  They have some really groovy items too.  I saw lots of mid century, western, vinyl, plenty of good furniture.....  We spent $400 and felt really great about our purchases.  They BLOW the downtown antique mall out of the water.
Wow.....eye.  Opener....impressed seeing bldg along dockside. Delaware River.....On Swarthmore...turn right. Down to the end and bye to Key West...where us raggae and jazz got a bit drenched..
Awesome Deli. This is place if you are looking for Indian wraps, patties and much more. Love this place.

Awesome barbershop.  I've been getting my hair cut and beard trimmed by Harry for several years.  Before all of the covid regulations, you would check in, have a seat in their comfy leather chairs, and be offered a beverage before your appt.  Definitely a step up from your run of the mill Hair Cuttery or Super Cuts.

All of the staff are engaging, willing to discuss whatever you like/share life stories, and make you feel welcome and comfortable.  I usually call to schedule my appointments but you are able to do it online.  I also appreciate the appointment reminders via email/text.

If you're one of the customers that has had to wait for your appointment, that's probably my fault.  I'm usually the guy coming through the door right up against the buzzer.  One tip: park in one of the parking garages and enjoy a stroll through the heart of Doylestown.  It's a gorgeous area with some cool shops, restaurants, and bars.

Obviously a few things have changed over the last year that we have been in this pandemic, but the service has always been fantastic.  It has truly been a treat to come in for a cut and I highly recommend this barbershop to anyone looking to break the "normal" experience.

If you ever go to this mall and survive long enough to need a pick-me up snack, may I suggest the cart vendor between Guess and Bath and Body works on the ground floor?

The kind old gentleman that runs this stand is a total sweetheart. My co-worker had asked me to pick up a pretzel for her while on break. She suggested this vendor, and since I had never been there before, I decided to give him a try.

He offered a choice between salted or unsalted as well as stuffing the bag with some napkins for my journey. He even offered a cup of mustard just in case my co-worker had a hankering for a zip to her pretzel.

Very nice gentleman and with that type of attitude/service, he will no doubt have a flourishing business!

You won't find better customer service anywhere. Weather you're a seasoned runner or just beginning, the folks at St Pete Running Company could not be more helpful or more caring.  And their group runs are a great way to socialize. Highly recommend!

Tried this place out because of their dog friendly patio- which was very friendly for our pup. Your dog can sit with you at your table or they have a doggy play pen area. 

Our service on the patio was slow- we didn't seem to get checked in on and the tables around us were left un bussed. 

We ordered the Shroomer Burger and a Sonoran dog to share, plus a side of onion rings. Sides are sold separately. The burger tasted good. The dog was definitely lacking in pizazz--for a $7 hot dog we were expecting more--Especially considering its local origin. Onion rings were good too-but not a lot to share. You also have to pay extra for sides of their home made dipping sauces.  

We both left feeling a bit hungry and like we had just eaten at an Applebee's-Esque type restaurant. 

Servers were very friendly, but restaurant seemed short staffed.

I have stayed here many times on business and once on a vacation. It does not get better than the hermitage. The staff is amazing - i think the room service attendant even knows me by name, the bellman give great restaurant suggestions - basically everything is top notch. I love the bathtubs and the molton brown bubble bath - nothing compares. I moved to Nashville now and I am sure I will make it to the oak bar for the onion bisque very soon.

I went through the drive-through one Night. 
When I got at home I was thinking I could've made it better. Not bad but not great 
I have to baby it up because I am Korean and I had to add more sesame oil and gochujang sauce plus another Sunnyside egg

Went for a business lunch and was very agreeable. Relatively safe flavors but bordered a bit on the bland side for my taste. Service was good but we were the only ones in there, which makes for a strange ambiance. 

I'd bring a big group and believe everybody would be happy, quality of the ingredients was great, just lacking a bit in flavor.

Actual Food was soo great to work with for our wedding and the food was excellent.  They were always quick to respond the emails, the pricing was very reasonable for the strong quality and they truly delivered the day of the event.  The team worked to overcome a few obstacles last minute - going above and beyone and provided wonderful service to our guests.  We had many compliments on the food and they made adjustments to the offerings based on our vision.  Could not have asked for a better caterer / bar service.  We were very happy with our selection and love what they stand for as a company.
Much happier this trip but still peeled the first week. I guess they think thicker will stay longer. I went to cameo and was taken care of properly. Three weeks later my nails look great!

Unbelievable, this was the best bbq that I have ever had.  Ordered the ribs and brisket and it was awesome.  The ine was long but once you order it is a matter of minutes and your food arrives.  I recommend this place for anyone in the StL area.
I got the classic pedicure and it was not a "clean" look. He went outside the nail and didn't even clean it up. I had to go home and do that myself.

I've ordered take out from here a bunch of times and always thought it to be delicious.  My first time dining in, and I'm impressed. Very clean, nice tables and chairs and decor. Our server was very polite and welcoming. It was a great meal. Tried something new, too. 
THE FOOD: Started with Chinese egg rolls, which I LOVE!!! The in-house hot mustard kicks butt! The heat just pops in your nose..love it. The egg rolls are fat and crispy and burst with flavors of cabbage and veggies and pork. 
I tried fried tofu for the first time. Very bland on its own, the sauce is also mild. Little slices of red and orange peppers don't add much. It was good the next day mixed with other leftovers. 
My entree was Kung pao beef. Disappointed because it was not spicy at all. Added some hot mustard to give it kick. The beef was tasty. 
My girlfriend had Sweet and sour chicken. Which was great. Chicken was moist and coating was good. She also had fried rice which is always good.

The updated beds are amazing. Staff is friendly and encouraging. The mix of hotworx classes in your monthly fee is such a great value. Who wouldn't want to burn 800 calories in 15-30 minutes? Great alternative to go to the gym.

Ok
So I used to frequent this place because it was cheap and fast. The sushi was acceptable and the portions weren't bad. Last time I went, however, they informed us that it's a $10 minimum for sit down service.

The staff is adorable and this place is never crowded so, if you're over in the area, it's not a bad stop. Be warned; their "all you can eat" is hardly that. It's complicated and not worth your money.

Pretty good selection for a chain store, but there is still room for improvement.  Upon my request, they now carry Spectrum brand coconut oil, as well as fresh, young coconuts.  (yes, I am a coconut o-olic) I am very happy that they now carry both of those items, as it saves me a trip all the way down to Essene.
Most of the employees are friendly, except for a mean, blonde woman named Ann-Marie.  Not sure what her problem is.  I avoid her now.

This grocery store, unlike other grocery stores in Philly, is seemingly never crowded and that is one of the reasons I keep coming back.  Also, the parking lot boasts one of the best views of Center City.   I often see people snapping photos of Center City from the lot.
They finally carry apple cider vinegar, but it's the filtered kind :(
I'm going to ask the manager if he can order some unfiltered apple cider vin.

One of the many times I was shopping at S.F., there was a man who was wearing a Beavis & Butthead t shirt,  following women around the store whilst stroking his penis.   I immediately let one of the guys at the seafood department know about this and he hunted the guy down and opened up a can of whoop-ass.  I was impressed.

Another thing that this store is missing is a bike rack near the elevator downstairs on the 2nd street side.  I sure hope they add a bike rack or two.  I have a lot of neighbors who opt for grocery delivery from Shop Rite due to the lack of bike racks at S.F.  I guess this could explain the fact that S.F. is never crowded.

Did I tell you that I love coconuts?
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTqD7I3Dksw

Flowers were delivered late and they were old. Barely lasted two days. I called within 24 hrs, no answer. Finally reached an extremely rude person two days after. She basically called me a liar about calling, and when order was to be delivered. She gave me such a hard time! I mean, I am the paying customer, and she was grilling me about the order.  The right thing to would be to say, "sorry you were unhappy, we would be happy to replace your order". 
Never, ever, use this company.

OMG!!!  This is one of my Top 5 Favorite places on Earth.  LOVE THE UPTOWN LOCATION!  

They are located in my old neighborhood of uptown on Prytania.  When I was alot younger I would go to the same location to buy King Cakes from McKenzie's.  The inside reminds me of an old ice cream parlor which just brings back old memories.  

My Favorite Flavor is Lychee & Sake. YUM!!!

Also the King Creole is awesome but I make a change that some people might like.  I am not a huge Peanut Butter sauce fan but I love Chocolate.  So  my change is as follows:  Instead of having 2 scoops of vanilla I get 1 scp of Vanilla and 1 Scoop of Peanut butter fudge pie and then I get chocolate fudge instead of peanut butter sauce.  CAN I JUST TELL YOU IT'S DIVINE!!!!!

I have also had the mini scoop sampler and gotten Raspberry sorbet, peach sorbet and pineapple sorbet.  DEEELISH!!!!

Honestly you can't go wrong with any of the flavors.  If you see something you might like you can ask for a taste.  

The staff is super friendly and helpful.  If you like a seasonal flavor you might want to call if it's available.  

If you are not up for the uptown location don't forget they have another location off of Harrison in Lakeview.  

Like they say: " Eat Ice Cream. Be Happy"!!  Enjoy :)

So many people recommended this winery and we were very excited to give their wines a try. We shared the Reserve Flight since it was Pinot Noir heavy (and we love our Pinots) and really enjoyed every one we tasted. The main reason for only giving three starts was due to overall tasting experience. First impressions are always so important and we were a bit turned off when we entered the tasting room and were greeted somewhat coldly by the person inside who immediately asked if we had a reservation. Normally I would think much of it as I'm sure most places offer and encourage making tasting reservations ahead of time but we were from out of town and were walking around when we decided to pop in and was taken a little off guard when the first thing we hear was, "do you have a reservation." Almost like we weren't welcome since we didn't have a reservation and only people with reservations get the opportunity to taste these wines. There was also nobody else there! Throughout our tasting, only one other person was present doing a tasting as well...it didn't seem like an early Monday afternoon was a highly trafficked reservation time frame? So maybe if we were greeted in a more welcoming way this would have lead to us having a better tasting experience. We're also not beginners when it comes to wine and this was the only wine club we didn't end up joining that day...we joined 3 others. Overall their wines were great, they just need to improve a little on the customer experience.

This company responded promptly in a desperate time for my family. Our entire basement, extra large and very filled with furniture and accumulated items from a extra large family. 

this company was professional, caring, supportive and hardworking. Through difficult roads and many stairs and wading through debris this Crew never gave up. They focused and stayed on task. 

I plan on clearing our garage before Fall ends and will definitely call this company again. I will give their name to many as review also

My boyfriend and I stopped in to the Ball & Biscuit after checking out Yelp Indy's Bazaar. The place was pretty packed (it's not that large) and super loud. We managed to grab what seemed to be the last open two top. Our server was on top of things even though it was crazy busy and loud. We each had a drink -- mine had a tropical twist and his a G&T. Both were well balanced and pretty tasty! Drinks were around $11-$13, so decently priced for being right downtown. We were also looking for a snack so we ordered the veggie quesadilla. I figured it'd be a quick option and it was so delicious! The veggies were roasted and mingled nicely with the cheese. I loved the fresh pico de gallo and extra sriracha sour cream. It really hit the spot after a couple drinks and was only $10. You can also add chicken and the menu had some vegan options.

Overall I enjoyed our visit to B&B and would stop in again if in the area.

Had the opportunity to check this place out while staying at the Atlantis for a sales conference.

I've got three words to say about this place.. Killer Happy Hour!!!!

A coworker and I had the prime rib sliders, calamari, lettuce wraps and lord knows what else plus a ton of drinks and it only came out to $58!!!

I walked out out of there so stuffed, buzzed  and in a food coma that I lost my freaking corporate credit card! 

The food was just really outstanding and it was probably one of the best happy hours  I've ever been to!

Had some time to kill today so I thought I would try The Local Taco. Man, what a surprise! I had the two taco platter and had corn tortillas instead of flour and had the greens as my side. What a great place to grab a meal and enjoy a beverage on my day off.

I will definitely be returning with my wife to enjoy a meal and the Southern Brunch option looks very appealing.,

If you like it spicy, the bang-bang option is very nice and adds some nice heat.

Stopped in thanks to yelp on our way home to Reno after hard day skiing @ Squaw!. Cool little place, darling server. Very good food. Got here at 5:30PM, already out of special ribeye & mashed potatoes for hubby's New York steak, but all good flavor & juicy! I had sockeye salmon burger on special jalapeño roll-soo good. Nice drinks, very cute decor. You can tell summer will be a blast here! Has special room for large groups, even in winter!
We will return with friends!! Keep up the excellent meals & drinks

Very reasonable rates but baby these seats are so tight anyone over 200 with wide hips can forget it!!! I've never in my life been in a seat so tight!! Thank God the two men on both sides smell good and are half decent looking ‍

The air attendants are funny keeping the energy light and funny!
Great service, the guys work hard and are polite, efficient, responsible.  Hope they will have time to prune more trees in Spring...
I'm not a burger fan but this is the Best Burget I've ever had... Love this place and will eat there anytime I'm in Nashville

Fun place on Delmar with lots of history!! One of my favorite things about St. Louis is that everything happens here :)

Great place to stop with friends and have a drink - they serve food late which is a plus!! Always loud and fun - I love staring at all the memorabilia on the walls. Bartenders and regulars are friendly!

Food is awesome......variety is amazing!!!  They do need to add additional veggy/vegan options, although their fried avacado tacos are to die for!

The only reason I rated a four instead of a five is the price....very expensive.  Typical lunch for two with chips runs us about $30.  But the food is amazing, so give it a try at least once.

I love how fast the delivery is.  There is no minimum that I can see for an order.  I would order from Pita Pit more if you didn't have to spend a minimum.  I'm a married man and more of the time when I'm ordering food it is because my wife is not here to cook.  Anyway, I'm rambling.  I'm a fan of Jimmy Johns.

If anything, come to see the Amish at work. It's so authentic and cool (not even trying to be creepy).

Anyhow, I ended up going to the BBQ Stand and got some ribs but I was pretty torn because there were about 1 million other restaurants I wanted to eat at. I will be back whenever I'm in Philly.

The slowest service EVER. Food was decent, drinks were ok. The entire reason I'm giving such a low review, is because nowhere on this planet should it take 20 mins + for a cosmopolitan. I'm writing this review while sitting here..... I've waited over 20 minutes per drink,  and now 20+minutes for a box and my check. This is unreal. Dunno if it's because my son is with me, but I'll not be back. An hour and a half later, I've had 3 drinks, 1 sandwich, and all I can take of the horrible service.
Fantastic sandwich place! Gumbo is great! Clean, friendly, professional and courteous! Check it out!

Terrible service today! Let me start by saying the food isn't anything special but it's filling. But when you have bad service that makes things worse. I requested bread when I was seated. The bread never arrived.  15 minutes later i saw three other tables that were seated after we arrived being served bread by my same waitress. Wtf! I was never checked on again.  I had to basically stop my waitress in her tracks and beg for bread. My bread arrived when my meal was finished. Next comes the confusing part. My waitress walked by and sat an unidentifiable beverage in front of me I didn't ask for and kept going with no words said. I was speechless. What the hell was this? Here is when things get bad. A different waitress stopped at the counter near our table. I was attempting to get change to leave a tip despite the bad service. I politely said "excuse me" but she choose to ignore me when it was obvious she heard me. My second attempt to get her attention was met with anger. WTF! She angrily said "I'm busy I will be with you in a second!" Then when she stopped "being busy" she walked away without acknowledging me at all. It was so outrageous that my date thought I mustve known this girl because the way she addressed me so angrily it had to be personal. I swore I've never interacted with this waitress a day in my life. Another waitress im familiar with spotted me and actually went out of her way to speak to me but my original waitress never acknowledged me from the moment we sat down and I had to damn near tackle her for bread. So I will give the cool waitress with the braces thats always smiling 5 stars. The rest of this establishment gets 1 star because of the rude waitress with the big fake eyelashes and the crappy attitude. Congratulations, you cost your coworker a tip she didnt deserve in the first place.
prepare to EAT!! make sure you dont eat all day because this place will take care of your belly! :) It's a very small and cozy place.

Place is visually stunning.  Plenty of equipment and classes.  

Pool are for kids is like a miniature adventure island.  Smaller kids have a great time.  

From a family membership holder it's well worth the money paid.  Kids and parents use the Y almost daily.

Does it seem at all ironic to you that when you are most  likely to need a restock of liquor that all the liquor stores are CLOSED?

Not Jasper liquor merchants. This place is open till 2am, rain or shine. And as liquor stores go, this one is actually one I prefer. My boyfriend and I used to go here when we lived downtown, and not just because it is always open late.

This place has a pretty decent selection and the guys who work here know their stuff. They are actually pretty perky too (even at 1:59am).

A good place to go in a crunch (your booze has run out at the party) and any other time of day.

Please though, please do not drink and drive to this store at 2am. Just not cool.

Great little brewery in a neat industrial area just north of the Hill, right down the street from Modern Brewery as well so hit them at the same time. 

Love the beer, menu is deep with something for everyone. GSF doing food service is a plus and having non-beer alcoholic options for those who don't enjoy beer is great too. Lots of room for big groups and a nice little flower covered patio as well.

Was excited to hit Martin's in Nolensville after a great experience at their location in Mount Juliet recently. 

Unfortunately my wife and I were both disappointed and most likely will not return as this is our second below average experience with this location. 

The cashier taking our order was rude, the brisket was cold and over salted, and it was absolutely freezing. We asked if the fan directly above our table could be turned off and were told no while my two daughters were shivering. 

I can deal with average food and give a third chance, but not rude customer service. 

Wish them all the best, but we will stick the Judge Beans in Brentwood and the best BBQ in Nashville Edley's.

A big thumbs up to Joe, the owner of this company for doing a great job! Joe showed up, fixed my heater and is coming back to now fix my fireplace. He was prompt, fair and very professional. He ran out to get a part and was back and finished the job quickly. I highly recommend Joe, and SB Heating and Air! Very professional and fair.
WAIT!
I'm editing my review because Joe CAME BACK the same day to fix my fireplace and did not charge me! Ummm...hello!!! Give this company your business! 10 STARS ***********!!!

First of all I left work to go to the e.r. because I was feeling extremely light headed and dizzy. When I got there I did get seen pretty quickly. I was actually shocked how fast. They took blood and blew out my vein. While the service was fast, they don't  seem to have very good bed side manner. I was told by one of the employees that I shouldn't  have come to the e.r. and wasted their time. I should've  made an appointment with my personal physician. Like, how am I suppose to know my problem wasn't  life threatening? They found nothing wrong. Gave me no answers as to why I felt how I felt. I do not recommend this hospital at all.

Let me first talk about the owner of this establishment. In his absence, my food was made horribly wrong so I called to see if they could send the driver back out with a cup of pico and tomatoes that they left out (this was a delivery). The owner called back and argued with me that my taco salad was made perfectly (once again, was not even there). He then told me that after paying 13.45 for food to be delivered, that I had to come up there and get tomatoes. That's when I just said screw it and told him that I would just like a refund.

His attitude was so bad that I lost my appetite! I had to go to Guac, and show hell out because this man was refusing to give me my money back. His employees looked at my order and confirmed that it was poorly made and missing like 3 toppings. He tried explaining why over the phone but he was so rude that I hung up in his face twice. I had to threaten to take something behind the bar for my money back when ALL of this could have been avoided by a simple "sorry about that ma'am, we'll send someone back out" 

Never have I EVER been so disrespected in my life but I refused to allow him to keep my money after the way he spoke to me. I hand delivered that awfully made taco salad and left in peace with my money in hand.

The chocolate cake I had was amazing!  Also, I've had a lot of froyo in my life and thought I just didn't like the stuff. It's always been watery and flavorless, but La Creme changed my mind!!  It tastes just like soft serve!!  The flavor selection is amazing and I can't wait to go back and try a new flavor!! I can't say enough good things about it!

The staff was friendly and helpful. I love the decor, especially the large photo of Neuschwanstein Castle and the soda shoppe-esque area behind the counter!

Estoy de visita aquí en Indiana y ansiaba probar la comida cubana. Encontramos este pequeño restaurante  y no miento que entramos con poca expectativa, pero hemos recibido una sabrosa galleta sin manos. La comida estaba especial, espectacular, elaborada con el sabor exacto de la comida criolla. Sacrilegio perderse la visita a este lugar !!!

I had dinner with 3 of my girlfriends to celebrate a birthday.  The atmosphere is great and I loved that they had parking! We all ordered a bunch of different things to share.  Here are the highlights (which was pretty  much everything) the burrata is amazing, I am not a huge fan of tomatoes but the tomato salad that goes on top of the burrata is to die for, its sweet and tart and just too good to put into words.  I will be ordering every time i go! Next up was the mushroom bruschetta which was also lovely.  It was served warm which I really enjoyed. We split 3 of the pasta dishes which were great, you can tell that the noodles are homemade and the texture is divine.  We also shared two pizzas.  The fennel sausage and the tartufo (mushroom), both were great although at that point I was getting overly stuffed.  The pizza crust was very thin and crisp.  They knew it was my friends birthday so they brought out limoncello shots which was fun! I highly recommend this place, I can't wait to go back and try more things!

This Happy Harry's used to rock, and now it's a drag to go in there.  As soon as they were bought out by Walgreen's, the place took a nosedive.

Before the acquisition, the employees were pretty bright and helpful, and appeared fairly happy to be working there.  Now, it's very difficult to get a question answered without a blank stare and a cocker-spaniel head-tilt of confusion.   (I'm not speaking Greek people, I just want to know if you have more of these in the back.)

Worse: They have a bunch of mouth-breathers working behind the pharmacy counter, and it's always fun to watch them struggle to avoid eye contact so they don't have to help the customers.   

You can tell the company is paying minimum wage and expecting nothing of their people.

I hate to write such a crappy review, but I'm just calling 'em as I see 'em.  I'm glad to revise this if things improve.

I give it two stars because yeah, they do have the things I need, and they do ultimately get the job done.  But simple transactions are like pulling teeth, and you rarely get a "thank you."  

I'd rather go back to Rite Aid where my credit card information was stolen... at least they were polite about it.
LOVE LOVE LOVE FROTHY! I bring friends here ALL the time. Awesome ambiance and a great stop for coffee!

Bottom line: TERRIBLE service absolutely does not make up for the mediocre food.

Our party of 3 started with a wedge salad (the person who ordered it said it was good), lobster roll starter and Caesar salad (both of which were sub-par). For our entrees, two of us had the filet (one thought it was pretty good, though not comparable to other similarly-priced steakhouses, the other thought it was actively bad) and one had the porterhouse, which he ordered Pittsburgh rare. The server confirmed the restaurant did offer a Pittsburgh rare preparation, but it came out extremely overcooked.

After the steaks came out, the server was nowhere to be seen for most of the meal. By the time he returned to check in, the filets were long finished and our friend was almost done with the 28oz porterhouse, but he pointed out how overdone it was, and the server looked for himself and agreed. He apologized and called it a "party foul," but did not offer anything to make up for it. The manager never checked in on us after this complaint. And when we got our check, not a single thing had been comped - not one drink, not one dessert (which, for the record, was also sub-par), and certainly not the $56 steak, which hadn't even been discounted.

My friend could have made a stink and insisted he wouldn't pay for the steak, or that another one be prepared for him properly. He didn't. He was very gracious, and was not rewarded one bit for that graciousness. Why would we return to this restaurant after that?

As far as I can tell, the only reason to come here is because you're forced to pay to enter the Valley Forge Casino and want to use your dining credit to recoup that cost (which is what we were doing). But I'd highly recommend you use your dining credit at a cheaper restaurant, because this place is SO overpriced you'll end up feeling like an idiot for paying so much for the meal even after the dining credit is removed from the bill. It would be different if the food were worth the cost, but it's not, and the absolutely awful service seals the deal. There's no reason to come here when there are so many better steakhouses a stone's throw away.

We ate here 3 times while we were in the FQ during Mardi Gras. I got the roast beef poboy each times because it was just that damn good. Boyfriend got the turkey club, roast beef and hot sausage and loved all of them. The fries are passable but get them with cheese if you do get them. Their red beans and rice are tasty. Definitely worth a stop. Get the roast beef. Trust me.

Our first time at this resort and we fell in love with Harry's Beach Bar. The three person band tonight was a blast. They played a bunch of our childhood tunes and lots of people  were dancing their feet off. Perfect place to enjoy a beach bar setting. Fun vibe.

Disappointed. It was our first, and last, time dining here. We confessed to the man taking our order that we weren't familiar with the menu. He wasn't helpful in making suggestions that we would like. The food was overpriced and undercooked. Plus we felt as if the workers did. It want us there.

I can only review the service as I was never able to place and order.  

Terrible service. Rude cashier. 

If you have unlimited patience and time maybe you will enjoy this place.

Solid place for a big plate of friend goodness.  I splurged and had the seafood platter, which was way to much food but I was determined to eat it.  At $25 it seems pricey, but you could probably share it if you were not a pig like me. The fish, shrimp and oysters were all delicious and as expected.  The fries were surprisingly better than I thought they would be, since I'm not much for fries... but the hush-puppies were kind of lacking.  Service was pretty good and there was a Yelp check in for a free desert which just made it that much better.  I recommend this place for some simple some what traditional food... scratched my fried seafood itch for sure.

Thanks Jennie M for sharing one of your fave spots with me (and with Wendy P too)... It was cool to be right near the UofA campus and I guess we lucked out with our late lunch, that we didn't have to wait to get a table at SugarBowl!

I loved the casual atmosphere, and the food did not disappoint.  While I didn't get to try the famous cinnamon buns or choose from the crazy huge list of beer, I did enjoy lunch and would totally return in the future.

I went with a tuna melt sandwich and the soup of the day, which happened to be a chickpea curry soup of sorts and was very tasty.  The sandwich, served open-faced on a whole grain bagel was huge and filling.  I recommend requesting some fresh sliced tomato on the side!

If you find yourself in need of food or drink and in the Garneau area any time of day, I'm pretty sure SugarBowl is a safe bet... enjoy!

We made our first visit here this evening. It is a very small place and there was a good size crowd. We waited only a few minutes for a table to open up. 
Ordering is done at the counter and your meal is brought to your table. Additional orders for drinks, etc. are taken at the table. 
First the vibe of the place is most noticeable. Everyone, staff and guests, is friendly and you have a comfortable feeling from the time you enter. 
The food lived up to its reputation in every respect. We ordered 8 items and every one was a winner.
Food this good in a place this nice a a true find. If you haven't been here yet you are missing out.
The best meal I had while visiting Nola. Staff was great, food was amazing and the drinks were perfect. I look forward to returning.
Flavorless, heavily salted, subpar cuts of meat. Gives off that midwest casino buffet vibe.

Don't listen to the negative reviews unless you're just a VERY picky person. This restaurant was so busy (veterans day) and we still got our food pretty quickly . The food was delicious, it was clean, and very nice employees. It was my first time there and it won't be the last.
So, so good! The only place around that has good crabcakes and a classic shrimp cocktail  they need to buy out the space next-door and make it bigger I'm sure they could hold the crowds!

The wings were ok, some of the chicken tasted a little bad though. Definitely not the best and the sauce was average. My problem was the server. HORRIBLE service. Didn't bring the right drinks, was very awkward, charged my friends for some of the things I ordered, and left us unattended for too long when we were trying to order dessert.

Love these cookies. I have to stop at this stall each time I'm in the market. Very rich, thick, chocolatey cookies. Moist and delicious. I get a few to take home and heat them up, sometimes adding a little ice cream on top. These might be my favorite cookies on the east coast.

Full Disclosure! I went on a mini cheese steak tour into the city with my friends, and we went to eight total places. My review will reflect my opinion of only a basic cheese steak with choice of cheese, and in comparison to each other. I'll additionally disclose when I went to each place, to consider how full we already were.

Stop 6 of 8. This place had nice seating options, both inside and outside, and it was cozy, but on the point of a bit disheveled. However you don't come to JRP for the aesthetics - you come for the steak, and man was it amazing. We got the cheese steak with American cheese, and the bread is on point with sesame seeds. The cheese was melted consistently throughout the steak, and the meat was well seasoned with more pepper, which I'm a fan of. This was our favorite steak through our tour, and I without a doubt will go again.

This hotel was all you need. It wasn't luxurious but it was clean and comfortable, and remodeled nicely. The AC worked great and the beds were comfortable. I don't think they use the AC in the hallways though because it's  hot there, but who is spending time in the hallway anyway... :p

After recently moving to Hermitage, my husband and i tried Cinco De Mayo because it is close to where we live.  We immediately loved the feel of the place. The food was really good, and the prices were reasonable.  My husband and I noticed that the place is extremely busy on weekend nights.  

A couple of days ago, we took some family members to the restaurant.  Once again, good food and great prices.  

If there is a weakness, based on our two experiences, it is the service.  That is the main thing that could be a little better.  While not a deal breaker, it would also be nice if the ladies' room was updated and made a little nicer.

So much fun!  For the non-gambling adult, kid-at-heart, person that likes old school games, or kid who likes games from the past, this place is for you!  Located inside the Peppermill, the Game Lab houses many video game machines from the 80s, 90s, and more.  I liked playing the pinball machines although I am not nearly as skilled at them as my Mr. is.  With the gamecard, you accumulate points.  The Mr. and I managed to earn some fun little souvenirs.  The clerks at the prize and service areas were all pleasant.  Definitely will be back when back at the Peppermill Reno.
