Not really sure what the hell is going on here. I feel like I'm in the twilight zone after reading some of the 3 star reviews. 

Really? A thai restaurant? Or a pho dac biet rice dish?

Serious talk now. This place has the most legit VIETNAMESE food in the area. I've had the traditional pho as well as the special phos (not the pho dac biet mind you,or the super special pho dac biet rice dish... wtf?) The broth has a meaty sweetness not to be mistaken with sugary sweetness.

I also just had the bo kho (it's slowly braised beef with star anise and other spices served with bread) and it was pretty damn good. 

The hot soy milk is also awesome and makes me feel like a giddy school girl. 

This place deserves more business ya'll. Come get some legit food.
Excellent service bought a great bed please make sure u are giving Tyler a shot if you need a new bed
Mac and cheese bites were amazing!!!!!!!!! So happy we found this place---the vibe is excellent and the food is superior to many restaurants in New Orleans!

Well After 2 years at the gym... I have to say it is the worst gym I have ever been part of. First the pool is disgusting! They switched to salt water (to be green), but I have gotten sick from this pool (rashes, yeast infections). I stopped swimming because of it. If you look up salt water pools, they are recommended for personal pools, not public pools.  Second, the personal trainers are ok. After a years of personal training, which I though would be safe because I am paying lots of money for some one to help me get into shape safely, I aquired a knee injury and herniated disk. So basically I paid so much money every month to get really really sick. The facility is falling apart, old, smelly.  Yes, I say it is by far the worst gym I have been part of in my whole life.

Are you kidding me?  Brisket is, in my opinion, the hardest meat to get right and they get it right.  Stumbled in there by chance for lunch.  Most BBQ restaurants disappoint with meat smoked yesterday or brisket that is like pot roast, bit this was awesome.  Perfect crust, nice smoke ring, and a wonderful springy texture that only BBQ freaks and chefs know about.  Jambalaya was great (and homemade), too.  Well worth the $10 for the sandwich and side; left perfectly full and happy.  I found the chef and thanked him.  Everyone there was nice and acted like they cared you were giving them business.  Very nice, indeed. Anxious to try the pork, if I can get over the brisket.

So, I was finally able to get to the Milkshake Bar, and it was very good. I had called and place my order ahead of time, and I was pleasantly surprised they were ready. It was definitely worth my money.

Highly recommended- This place greatly exceeded all expectations!

Cute and cozy little bistro with charming Florida decor. The staff was very friendly and we were seated promptly upon arriving at our reservation time. My husband and I ate dinner here one Saturday night during a weekend getaway to Safety Harbor. It was recommended to us by the resort where we stayed (but that's a whole different review). 

Where do I even start? We started with a half pitcher of an awesome White Sangria, gorgeous green salad, and tasty little cup of soup that came on the house. For dinner we had the swordfish special with white wine sauce and the blue crab and lobster stuffed Mahi Mahi. Both were perfectly cooked and delicous. Even the roasted vegetables on the side were divine- seasoned just right and cooked tender-crisp (I do love a crisp veggie- no mushy carrots here!!).  The entrees were so good we nearly licked our plates clean! Then....black and blue cobbler- O-M-G! 

I can't say enough about this place- excellent food and great service!
Really not the greatest bagel shop. Seems to be reheated and the coffee selection is "eh".
Extremely appetizing! Burger w/ bacon was extraordinary and the Irish nachos were amazing. Hope a franchise is open close to home, this would be great take-out.

I truly applaud that they serve grass fed meat from local farms, their burger options are creative, they have patio seating and there's no better way to enjoy a beer, and their fried okra spears are amazing! 

The big disappointment and what I would call a critical mistake is, I asked for my burger medium rare and it came beyond well done which made it very dry.

While I see they have potential to be really good, it was unfortunate a burger fail had to happen here.

Last 2 times I've been here, had a bizarre experience with seating/waiting. First time I was by myself and wanted to sit at the bar-- the bar was wide open but they weren't seating anyone because "the kitchen was backed up" so I was told I had to wait 30 minutes... Very odd. Second time I came with a friend and they asked for my number but never actually called me to let me know my table was available... Luckily we had already walked down the street to Miles Table and were enjoying noms there anyway
Had a billing issue but Steve was great at resolving it.  Would go here again.

Chung Sing gets a solid three-stars for decent "Pennsylvania-style" Chinese food (in all of the places I've lived, only in PA do you consistently get those crispy noodles before you even order) at a laughably low price.

Really?  $7 for a cup of soup, a heaping plate of food, tea and dessert?

The food isn't remotely authentic, but it hits the spot when you're really hungry, don't feel like cooking, don't feel like changing into nicer clothes, and don't want to pay much.

I enjoy the Chinese diner kitsch and like being close enough to the other tables to eaves-drop, so watch out-- I might just be sitting over your shoulder.

Booked a 7 day visit and I regret every single minute of it,  It's an utter scam, a disorginzed, sub-par scam,  From the reservations team, to the website to the really dissapointing services - that allegedly were included (check your bills, daily there). The place is just awful. Their Wellness Advisors are glorified schedulers who have no semblence of an idea of what theyre talking about , the treaatments at best were just ok ( a few were excellent including the Eurphoria ritual - but it doesnt make up for anything else - and anything "free' is just a marketing scam to get you to sign up and pay for additional things.  This isnt wellness, its greed.  If you are looking for a reset, wellness, go to The Ranch in Malibu, Mirival, Golden Door - anywhere but here.Go reD 4 Articles on Goop and find a good self help book.  
  It's for 60+ somethings not anyone else even remotley knowledagble in fitness or wellness.  Did I mention check your bills - they add bullcrap resort fees and have a very unbuttoned accounting system.
This place is so disorganized and awful that they couldnt even fulfil their "pathway" programs - still never got my one on one yoga despite having to call them for basically a month only to get the run around.    Thats right, I had to call them almost daily to lock in my "pathways" and could never get things scheduled.  avoid at all overpriced costs
Best breakfast in Clearwater. The Bloody Mary is awesome. My favorite is steak and eggs (weekend only).

I would not recommend Dr. Brandsted to anyone.  She was dismissive, defensive, did not address the specific concerns I explained to her, did not review all relevant information, and provided an inaccurate diagnosis.  I have since been told (by more than one medical professional) that my inclination to disregard her assessment is the right call. It was a waste of my time and money and left me feeling frustrated.  I found the entire visit and level of care to be disturbingly lacking.
Amazing pastries. Like truly so so so good. The place is awesome. But good lord the staff is.... unfriendly to put it lightly. Made the whole experience less fun/enjoyable.
It's a somewhat classy restaurant and I really like the interior. The food is good but I think the price is a little too high.
Ordered online and brought it home. They forgot go add the pork to my noodles and the chicken to my wife's. Noodles are tasty enough. If you order online check your meal(s) before you leave.

Made an "in line" appointment on line and as I usually do, I showed up 30 minutes early. As soon as I was seated I was taken back! Then as I was seated in my room it only took 5 minutes to have a doctor come see me. 
Dr Rory Ingram was especially nice and had empathy for my sickness. 

Keep it up primary health!! (:

This is a well stocked pet store.  I find the prices are higher than other
stores for some of the items.  What bothers me are the help, who are
not particularly friendly, and this comes from the top.  The large
manager should not be working in a pet shop.  Pet owners want a kind
and caring person to talk to.
The kittens in the window, and the new dog baths are a plus.

Beautiful and colorful creation of a poke bowl! Don't believe me? Look at my picture included. I ate by the window and... you know that awkward moment when you try your best to avert your gaze from those walking by on the streets yet slightly peering into the window to see what you're eating? That pretty much sums up my entire meal. 

This place is a great addition to center city with its fresh selection of salmon and tuna, as well greens and sides! Check out the array of choices you can get! A must get is their mango - delish! And always know you can get half and half for the base, I typically choose rice with greens
Very delicious food and great customer service. You can cal ahead and order for pickup as well.

I've been going here since I was a little kid and Sang Kee was a take out only place so I give it 5 stars because it's near and dear to my heart.

 Clearly this place is not about the decor or the service (is anyplace in Chinatown about that?) For me it's about a number of amazing and consistent comfort foods and few surprisingly good american chinese dishes on the menu.

The plain wonton soup is spectacular and is likely to ruin wonton soup at most other chinese restaurants for you if you haven't had it here before.  The plain shrimp dumpling soup is great too for a slight change.  If you're going to get wonton noodle, I'd recommend getting it with duck or pork or both as well as the noodles do tend to make the broth a little more bland.

Even though it has Peking Duck in the name, go for the roast duck hong kong style, if you're ok with dealing with the bones.  It's really the best.

And the honey-coated roast pork (char sui)  is a must.  Particularly since it's covered in the same sauce the roast duck is served in, made during the duck roasting process.  Mmmm, fatty goodness.

If you need some greens to cut the protein, go for the sauteed snow pea leaves, which are nice and sweet (and good for you!)

On the american chinese side of things, I really like getting the vegetarian dumplings fried for a light crispy appetizer.  

Any of the pan fried noodle dishes are always pretty solid and the general tso's chicken is probably slightly different from anywhere else you've tried so give it a shot and let me know what you think.  

We pretty much almost always get the above dishes when we're going with a group and if it's a large group, we just start throwing on more dishes like shrimp in black pepper sauce that comes out sizzling hot, and the lobster in ginger and scallion.

If I could rate this business a zero I would.  What a despicable and disgusting human being.  This owner has no conscience and could care less about the animals she grooms as well as their owners.  She cut my poor little toy yorkie's ear and tried to play it off as if it was nothing while my 8 1/2 year old yorkie was bleeding profusely on her hand and in the many paper towels the owner was holding her hand.  When I walked in to pick up my dog, she blamed my dog (whom she has groomed for many years) and said "OH, DON'T GET HYSTERICAL ON  ME" as I was simply welling up in tears at the sight of all this.  She was clearly trying to rush me out before other customers came in to pick up their dogs.  Even telling me to go home while she took my dog to the vet herself.  Ummmm...NOOOOO!!!  To add insult to injury, she proceeded to yell at me for making her upset and threw my dog in the car with a paper towel roll and bloody reminents she was using on my dog.  Her demeanor was beyond insulting, disrespectful and offensive.  She clearly is unprofessional and has no concept of customer service.  Dog groomers should be licensed!  I ended up at the vet for 2 hours on a Saturday having my little yorkie stitched up with 3 stitches.  2 weeks later, I had to have ointment prescribed for the area where she was cut.

The restaurant has some great decor and I was there that evening for an event and then stayed for dinner.  The event was well catered - we had a bartender and pass through appetizers.  The Ceviche was yummy and fresh and margaritas hit the spot on a Thursday night.

We decided to stay for dinner and got these little rooms they have to the side. Great for a biz meeting or for privacy.  We had their prix fix dine Indy menu and it wasn't bad.  Had another margarita that was tasty.  The ceviche app wasn't the greatest and we thought it was the same ceviche from the event earlier.  However the service was great and the waitress swapped the Ceviche for the one we liked.  The main dish was sooo good. I had their Vegetarian enchilada option that our waitress suggested and it was yummy.  Ended it with churros with chocolate that was tasty.  All in all - great service and good meal. Plus the bill at the end wasn't bad at all and amazed us with the menu we had!

EDITED: went again because the shrimp and grits were so good. Ordered that and chicken and waffles.  Both were absolutely amazing. We also tried one of the drinks that were on tap with cold brew coffee and bourbon and it was out of this world. The popcorn is insanely good. And the service we had this time was stellar. Highly, highly, highly recommend them.


------------------
The atmosphere had such a cool vibe. This has great outdoor seating area. We were out and talking to a few local people who all mentioned this place, it didn't disappoint. 

We had the spicy crab pasta and the shrimp and grits. The key west pink shrimp and grits were so amazing. The spicy crab was good.. but it's hard to compare it next to a dish that was so delicious. 

Happy hour goes to 7 which was an awesome surprise.

This places was so close to 5 stars, but the service was sort of weird and off. We asked for a beer list and it seemed like we were inconveniencing the waitress, after we got our food it was crickets. We never got popcorn or asked if we wanted anything else..

I highly recommend this place!
Absolutely fantastic! The service was great, the food was delicious and well prepared. Everything felt like a fun and fresh take on brunch!

Came here from recommendation from my boss. Inside this old historic city lies this modern hip wine bar restaurant like the ones you see in Hollywood.  After looking at the menu, I knew we should try it.  It was restaurant week so we opted for the 4course prix fix menu. I had the salad frizz, grilled shrimp, sea urchin pasta and cream brule. I was in heaven. The course was off the top awesome. I ordered white wine to go with the pasta. It was light and the uni was fresh and went really well with the squid ink pasta and crab meat.  I'll definetely have to come back here when I'm in phyli.

Service is and always has been one of top reasons for the ratings and yesterday was a mad house at Walmart (Black Friday deals on Thursday). Luis the assistant manager helped us a ton and accommodated us to something that was very important. He was understanding, helpful, and very respectful. This Walmart is pretty clean otherwise and is normally very easy to get to on any other days.

We've been to the restaurant before and have been met with delicious food, great service and quick attention. Unfortunately today we only received good food. Maybe it was because they were dealing with changes to the way they are doing things because of COVID. But also they've been doing this for a few months so one would think they have figured out some kinks by now. We went on a sat but had a reservation for 5. We got there early at 4:25 and were told we would get a text when our table was ready. We got the text at 4:50 despite several tables being open that entire time. Our waitress was incredibly slow and had to ask for things multiple times before getting them. I got my salad AFTER my dinner arrived. Personally we won't be back until they open the inside and things hopefully improve. Worst experience at this restaurant.

Time... where do I start?

Don't waste your time at Time, seriously. The menu needs a revamp, an adjustment on pricing wouldn't hurt either. Last night I got the burger because the restaurant week menu sucked. WTH are bars participating in restaurant week now? What's that about? Another topic for another time....

Anyway, nothing about my food or drinks were legendary enough for me to be like, "let me spend all of my measly earnings here and laugh my pain away". No, time owes me money and the two hours I spent there last night. Oh and I want my cover back. 

That burger was so damn dry... kinda like when you accidentally dive mouth first into some sand dry. I totally get where they were going with the burger but they still haven't arrived. Perhaps try some avocado or something. I don't know, I'm not a master burger maker, but I eat enough to know that wasn't worth $15. 

Also I love how the waitress is incognito the entire night, GIRL. We finally flagged her down at 10:52 for her to tell us the kitchen was closing in 2 mins.  HONEY, DARLING, MISS... what kitchen closes at 10:54 ever? ALSO who closes a kitchen that early on a Friday night? 

So i dont know, skip Time if ever invited. lol

I don't know how I haven't written a review for Zona yet, I have been a frequent diner there since I have moved to Tucson.  Their happy hour is excellent and the food is good.

My recent experiences have been amazing.   Things seem  to have evened out and the servers are on top of things.  

After a night of great service, good wine and a particularly tasty dessert I can say that my restaurant crush has solidified into love.  

Right now they have the most amazing Tres Leches Cheesecake.  It is amazingly yummy.  Light, spongy, not too sweet.  Everything about last night rocked and made my night into something incredibly enjoyable.

If you are looking for a groomer they have just hired Emil. I have been getting my King Charles Cavalier Spaniel groomed by Emil for about a year at another location. Fantastic work you will thank me later for finding you a terrific groomer.

These guys are shisters!!!!! quote me $103.00 , signed the paperwork went back after they called me to say it was done and checked everything out. They said it was going to be more money for speaker wire, $27.00!! Then went to check out what they did and the sub woofers didn't work.  So they did more work on it with me there in front of them, hooking them up in front of me with more wires and charging me $14.00 more on top of that!!!!!! After yelping them it was apparent. They suck, never again!!!! I've lived here in Reno for 33 years. Took them 5 cars over that time and it has definitely changed for the worse... I'd like to punch them in the mouth, asses....

Tina is a literal angel on earth. She went above and beyond to help me with my dad's storage unit after he died. He passed right at the beginning of covid, so I was unable to travel from NJ to take care of the unit for over a year. The staff ensured the unit and my father's belongings were secure until I could be there in person. Thank you so very much for helping ease some stress during this time.
Delicious food and great service!! Definitely coming again for breakfast soon. I got pancakes which were hot and fresh, coffee fresh as well.

I have a 2010 Porsche 911 turbo convertible and tracked dog poop on the carpet June 2013.  The smell was so potent that I was very nauseous even with the top down. They were able to get the smell out and detailed it making it look virtually brand new.  I enjoyed the entire experience. They also recommended a neighborhood restaurant while awaiting that was wonderful.

YUMMMMMMM!

This place is amazing; a little short on ambiance, but boy do they make up for it with food!

We started with the Vegetable Samosas.  It's described as "Crispy stuffed vegetable pyramid filled with potatoes and mild spices."  I say these are incredible little potato pillows and I want MORE.  Best part of the meal, for sure, but that's not to say the other dishes were lacking.  This was just THAT GOOD.

I had the Saag Shrimps (Delicious shrimps Masala cooked with spinach and fresh spices for added flavor) as my entree along with the Jalapeno Cilantro Naan.  This was super green and dark, loaded with shrimp and Indian/Pakistani spices, and absolutely wonderful (although still not as good as the Samosas.  Oh man!).  New to Indian food, so I'm not even sure how to describe it, except to say it was scrumptious.

My friend ordered the Smoked Chicken Masala, a chef's special.  Ok, this was really close to the Samosas for being tasty; not as exotic tasting as the Saag, but super delicious and with a little creamy aspect the Saag was lacking.  The Garlic Naan on the side really complimented the dish.

Seriously, I cannot WAIT to go back to get some of this food!

Wow! I have very high restaurant standards and Harry's delivered!
It's pretty, clean, great ambiance with dim lights.

Seated right away.
Server right away for drinks.
Her name was Audra I believe.
Fabulous girl.

Told us about many items.
Drinks came quickly.
Bread came quickly.
Apps were fabulous.
We had the giant shrimp cocktail.

Two of us had the steamed 1.5 lobster which was still hot, which is rare that the kitchen can coordinate that with the other dishes.
It was literally just succulent.
Came with taters and haricot verts.
I substituted the sriracha scallion mashed potatoes and they were freaking awesome!

One friend had the crabcake entre. Totally awesome
Other had the surf & turf with shrimp.

Lots of attention from the server.
Check was $65 per person.
Fabulous experience.
Can't wait to go back.

I had  a good experience here tonight and can't wait to go back! I had the fish tacos, which were generously portioned and well seasoned. The guys had a burger and an "adult" grilled cheese, which they thoroughly enjoyed. The patio was filled with people of all ages. The women's bathroom was SO clean. Our server was busy, but attentive and very personable. Do yourself a favor and check this place out!
Staff is great and their beers are always cold but i have had stomach issues after eating there twice. Then came to find out others i went with had the same problem.

We stopped here looking for a place to grab a beer. It was a great little beach bar. It is a beach bar I don't expect much other than beer and sand. Since it was snowing back home sitting on the beach in December was all we could ask for. The bartender wasn't all that social but he kept a full beer in front of us. Only wings and fries available for food but you can order from the place down the street and they will deliver at no charge. The food was really good. We had the shaved prime rib sandwich and blue cheese wings.

We came to Applebee's to find out if they have changed since we were younger. As we walked in, we discovered the atmosphere was much different than it used to be. In a good way. Looks more modern, besides the old style booths. 
We ordered the two for $20 and were a bit disappointed with our meals. Both chicken dishes that tasted too similar. It was definitely a fair price, just not that tasty. 
Besides the food the service was fantastic. Everyone greeted us, smiled, and checked up on us regularly. This was Forbes 4 star quality service without the same quality food.

The Bend Lounge is a small place in Riverbend that looks a bit high class but the atmosphere is really laid back. It's actually a great place to enjoy some time with friends and catch up over a couple of drinks. The music playing in the background stays in the background and doesn't drown anyone out. 

The place isn't cheap but most places aren't these days. The service is good and friendly. They are pretty outgoing and leave you alone for the most part. A good place to check out.

The help are disinterested and rude. I asked for a specific coffee. Paid $6 and got a black coffee with flavored syrup. I went back and told her this wasn't what I asked for, and she sarcastically told me "sorry" as she rolled her eyes. Our ticket for 4 was about $28 for 3 coffees, 2 ordered of beignets and 1 water. Nothing fabulous about this place at all.

The food was definitely on point,  the service was great and the location is perfect as well.  So glad my hubby chose this as the first breakfast spot to eat at when we arrived today.  Wouldn't change a thing!

I stopped by this place for happy hour awhile back with some friends for a late lunch and I have been back more times than I can count. I've worked my way through most of their wraps and I haven't found one that hasn't been great. Liz seems to be bartending the majority of times I have stopped in and always makes us feel welcome and is positively engaging. This is a no brainer for the lunch crowd but even the happy hour and late night crew kills it. Give Wrap shack a chance. The 'NY strip steak' and 'Freeman' wraps are my favorite.
To the woman blender who wanted a Yelp review Saturday afternoon we love you!!! Got the pitaya smoothie and my dad got the peanut butter chocolate and they were so good!!!

This Dollar General store seems a bit bigger with more items than another one very close by. It had a lot of the same items, but the particular item I went in for they either were out of or simply do not sell at this location. I ended up with some other good finds. 

The guy was really helpful, but the woman working not so much. Huge negative vibes, and she never spoke back to me; which is fine the guy helped me.
this store is constantly a mess!  Unfriendly associates and very poor selection.  I won't be back

It was I first time and we experienced Slightly pretentious service. We ordered several apps and enjoyed them all. The entrees were ok and the atmosphere was pretty cool. I can't recall what I ate as we were new to the venue.

Char is where it's at! Came here with a couple friends and we loved it. It didn't take long at all and the staff was very friendly. I ordered the Santa Monica burger. The char and avocado add a delicious taste not commonly found at fast-food burger joints. But most importantly is the Onion rings and the lemonade. I'm never one to rave about little things, but there is just something about these two items that are special. A MUST have if you visit this new and trendy place.

I've been to Bella Napoli Pizzeria 4 times. The pastas are very good to excellent. The service has all 4 times been excellent...Special mention for Oona, my server on one occasion. Ambiance is cozy and relaxed. Over all an excellent dining experience.

I used to be a loyal customer but recently have been cheated, overcharged and robbed by the employees who charge double, charge for things that others have bought (and left on my receipt)    It has been up to be three times to bring this problem to their attention and they don't seem to care.  I will go elsewhere even though I have gone there for years.  Buyer beware   Check receipt carefully each and every time.   I wonder how much money I have been cheated out of over the years?
My favorite slice in all of Philadelphia. Could eat here every day. They have many choices by the slice and all are heated to a perfect crisp within 2 minutes.
Agree with one other review... The drunkin noodles with chicken was excellent.  Nice decor. I'd  go back if we stay in the  area again.
Best cheesesteaks in roxborough! The ringer is a must try. Fast delivery and lovee the Barry's sodas!

The atmosphere was great. Whitewashed brick walls and wood planks on other walls. Cute little bar area and nice outside seating. I had to have my husband go out to the car and get my jacket as they had the front door open and a pretty cold breeze was coming through the restaurant. My husband ordered The Wildwood Triple Chop Sandwich. He thought it was delicious. I had the Tri TIp Sandwich  and it was absolutely amazing .  The french fries were fantastic too. They brought out three types of BBQ sauce to the table. The acoustics made the noise level high so it's not a great place if your looking for cozy and quiet.

We are from out of town and this restaurant was recommended to us. It was amazing all around! Great service, delicious cocktails and phenomenal food. We had the mariscos paella and it was incredible!!! I'd highly recommend this restaurant!

I really like this spot. The atmosphere is homey, family and friends oriented. The owner is super friendly. My wife and I agree that the coffee is about the best in St. Louis. They use Mississippi Mud beans and know what to do with them.  I like the international flair, including decoupage tables of international travel. Lots of good baked goods, and they have just added a gelato cart -- we haven't tried it yet, but it looks good. A great little place to relax.

Cleanest and nicest travel area I've been in. Lines moved pretty fast.
Went to Burger King (for the boyfriend) they has a kiosk where you could order and pay from, that was pretty cool. I went to Brioche Doree and got the Turkey Brie baguette which had green apples and a cinnamon jelly, on great bread. It was pretty tasty but cost $8. 
Also went to Starbucks to get an iced coffee. Drinks came up in a reasonable amount of time.

We've been eating there almost since the beginning when they were in their original location.  Where they are now is very close to my home, but it's not the greatest setting.  Just seems odd.  Regardless, the pizza is some of the best in the Nashville area.  The Shipwreck and the pepperoni and Italian sausage with extra cheese are both great. I like that they have an extra large size (same with 312 Pizza).  I hate pizza places that only offer a 14" as a large. Nice to have places that offer 16" or 18", which is even better!.  Good ingredients and worth the extra few bucks you pay over fast food pizza places.

Wonderful service from the check in to our server, Andrew. 
Key Lime-tini and American Sector Lemonade coming right up.
Roasted turkey sandwich and blackened chicken linguine. Both excellent. 
Will dine here again on my next visit to this museum.

Service was great so I won't take away from that. The food quailty was definitely subpar and not authentic Mexican. They use chedder and jack cheese on everything (none of the dishes use any actual Mexican cheeses like Cotija.) The refried beans are a soupy mess straight from a can. The rice tastes like bagged instant rice, basically Uncle Ben's rice. The enchiladas came with Red sauce, also from a can, and were buried in jack cheese and sour cream. Overall the best part was the service and the only thing "authenic" is the name of the restaurant.

3.5 stars.  We were on a brunch kick this weekend, so Sunday morning we came to Estelle to try their brunch.  I should say that probably unconsciously, I'm making some comparison between Honey's (which we went to on Saturday).  I would say that Estelle is a good brunch spot in its own right.  The entire feel of it is pretty proper and the menu comprises just a few dishes.  The dishes were prepared well and it was good - I got the smoked jack mackerel with poached eggs - but to me, not quite enough food for brunch, although I might be wrong in my assumption that brunch should be breakfast and lunch together (portionwise, too).  I'd say that Estelle is a fancier brunch with things that you wouldn't necessarily prepare at home on any given breakfast - like shirred eggs with spinach, mushrooms, and truffle oil.  The coffee service is also self-serve.

The wait was pretty long, too, about 45 minutes or so, but since its on the ground floor of the 444 Lofts, the wait area is indoors and they provide some local papers and magazines as you wait.  

All in all, while I did enjoy my brunch, I didn't feel like I'd wait another 45 minutes to an hour for the food that I did end up getting.  However, I'd come again if asked.

This was such a cute spot to get tacos. I really enjoyed coming here. Attentive service, great price, and good food/drinks. 

I ordered the pulled chicken taco which was absolutely delicious - I forgot the name of my drink but it was a spicy one. 

Portion is just perfect for one person and the tacos come with a side. Nothing to write home about the black bean sides - and the tacos definitely were savory (I always get worried ordering pulled chicken because it lacks flavor). 

The decor and ambience is also very quirky in here - I liked it and recommend it!

Last month (11/2019) I went to have a remote starter installed on my 2011 Infiniti M56. I must say, Steve and his team did an amazing/ wonderful job. Steve took the time to explained the 3 different remote starters for my vehicle and didn't suggest the most expensive one in which I found honorable. Most places will try to sell you the most expensive item just to make a buck. I wanted a practical remote starter in which I do from my house and incorporate into my existing key fob. After installation, Steve came out and walked me through the process and how the remote starter works. He also told me they stand behind their product. I will continue to use them for all my audio and customization in the future. Thanks for a great experience Steve.

Good service food comes out hot and fresh. Presentation is sub par but at least the food is good. Fair prices but great teamwork on the staff. Went here on a Friday and it was busy and the servers were busy but we were able to be in and out in an hour
I love this place! Been going to this bakery since I was little whenever I am in town I go back. Love their pecan rolls. This is a must for anyone going to Collingswood.

My waiter gets 5 stars.. very attentive kept checking on me.... now the food is another story.. ordered tacos al carbon... there was barely any meat... 
the salsa was watery and boring

Best breakfast I have had downtown.  Was blown away by the Boise Bibimbap Breakfast Bowl.  It is like a delightful mix of gouchujang glazed crispy chicken, over-easy eggs and avocado pickled veggies over farro. This is my new favorite dish here.  Fast and friendly service as well.
Delicious! Though the environent is dank the fondue rocks. The selection on the beer and wine is pretty big. Pretty fun for a date spot

I am so thankful for Walk This Way. We have 3 dogs which can be challenging to exercise when we both work full time. One of our dogs is leash reactive to other dogs and I always worry when discussing this with a walker. Our walker Chris was not phased by this behavior at all. We have been using them for about 4 or 5 months now and the progress of my dog is amazing. She has gotten SO MUCH BETTER. I love that my dogs get the same person everyday and I think because of that they are really thriving. The cancellation/adding walk policy is perfect for us. Sometimes I won't know until the day of that I can work from home and Walk This Way is always accommodating. I can't express enough how great Walk This Way is!

Wow.  This was a bummer.  Again.

My mom and sister are in town, so I thought I'd try it for a family dinner instead of a romantic date night.  Their website said they closed at 10pm.  Their Yelp hours agree.  We all show up at 9:40 - I know, cutting it a little close, but still within the confines of not quite the last minute assholes.  There are two or three tables full outside and I can see a few tables full of people inside as well.  I would have thought this meant that we were good to go for dinner here, as we had arrived 20 minutes before their advertised closing time.

Nope.

As we were walking out to the door, I held the door open for a waitress who was bringing out food to one of the patio tables.  She curtly told me they were closed for the night.

Really?!  At 20 til?  When there are clearly not one, not two, not three, but at least four or five full tables in the restaurant?!

I really, really just want to like this place, but I sure am having a hell of a time!

Service ok for us but when a patron came in from outside to say their table they had just been shown to was dirty the bar tender handed her a rag, really!?!  Also nothing against rock music but some serious head banger tunes were playing to a family group and an old couple...when I said to waitress " oh boy that's some really hard rock" she said " yea I know", that's it,    
ok. No return visit for us!
Simply awesome BBQ.  Best I've had in the Tampa area.

Great beer prices & decent selection ... cold options could be better.  They order anything I've asked for, and employees/owners are mostly pleasant. Access is better by driving in front of the strip of stores instead of behind them.  They also sell ice cheap.
The humidor seems ok, but I don't use it much.

Also, I'm from Ambler, not MA
Need a better sign hard to find at night. Small portions, trying to be like 4 rivers but not able too. No indication that the BBQ is made on sight. Way overpriced, BBQ should be cheap food.

The food is fantastic - great menu and quality ingredients and prep.  Great vegetarian and vegan options.  The service is strange and slow but I can overcome that to eat here. Better service would really enhance the experience and I would definitely go more often.

I absolutely love this restaurant. My husband and I have ordered the hot and sour soup, won ton soup, fried rice, and chicken lo mein. The food is full of flavor and comforting. Definitely our go to place when we have a craving for Chinese food.

I cannot recommend this place at all. Our group was able to get out in under 40 minutes, but there were a few puzzles that we did not solve. After leaving the room the owner starts berating us for not solving all of the puzzles. Turns out that during the debrief that took place afterwards there was a key that was misplaced during their prep of the room. This key ended up being a vital piece in solving the rest of the clues to escape the room. The owner still refused to refund us our money after realizing the puzzle had been setup in a way that was impossible to solve all puzzles. Rude owner. Bad game design. Not worth your time or money.

Mi 'N Tea just opened in the middle of the pandemic, but they have take out options and even do party trays! They sell Vietnamese Banh Mi sandwiches and have a plethora of drinks to choose from. I love that their menu adds a modern, creative twist to more traditional items. They have two vegetarian options - fried tofu and grilled eggplant. I went with the fried tofu Banh mi, and the bread so a perfect balance of crisp yet light yet substantial. The filling was great, but would have preferred more pickled radish/carrots. My friend had the Viet pork skewers and also really enjoyed it. My only gripe is that the price is a lot higher than the normal Banh Mi's I get at home in California. I'm excited to go back to try their drinks next time. I also tried two of their drinks, the watermelon twist and the other "green Thai tea", which didn't taste like Thai tea and was more floral. Innovative drinks, but not sure it hit the spot for me. 

Parking is mainly street parking or a parking lot in Manayunk.

Randall House Rare books is a true treasure in itself.  As a love of books on California, the California Gold Rush and any sort of Western Americana, Randall House's stock consists of all books California, the Gold Rush, literature, science, Americana, history, Pacific voyages and everything in between.  Pia, the manager for Randall House, is a truly wonderful person who is nothing but kind, patient and a true book lover at heart.  She is always extremely fast about sending pics, answering questions or just talking about her love of books in general.  I have bought many wonderful books from them over the years.  I highly recommend a visit to Randall House if you are a true book lover and passionate about rare and beautiful books that are in wonderful condition and exceptionally cared for.  I recommend them highly.

Call them and get ready for the tricks- They start with discount coupon. Then, you learn that that was a "corporate" display on the web site. Rather than $54 the price will be $187. Then, the real squeeze comes with insisting that a $1600 sewer line jetting is needed to cure the problem and it should be done immediately to remove caked grease in the lines.  There has not been one fried or greasy meal since the house was new. We are vegetarians.  After balking, I was offered a "senior" discount of $1200.  The problem was not a sewer line but a septic tank.  Not a  nice company.
Nice guests and reasonable tasting! Would come back here again! There are some good price discounts on wine and if you buy two bottles they will waive the wasting fee

Went to change my car's oil, I haven't been changing the oil since I bought my car so today was my first time and I choose JT auto because my husband used to come here, he told me that the customer service was real good so I went with that in my mind expecting kindness or at least a smile but they didn't... maybe because I'm a women? And they spect seeing just men? I don't know but for me a friendly customer service is important and here I didn't experience that

Pd: Service was good, what I didn't like was just the treatment and attitude! I would say that more clients would come to you if you (JT AUTO) were more kind and friendly.

Aisha's is easily one of the top 3 threading salons in Philadelphia. 

The staff are always very nice and professional. The space is clean and I've never had to wait long, and their prices are very reasonable. 

The main woman (first chair) makes the threading experience so quick,easy,and painless.

Highly recommend!
Attended niece wedding and stayed here. Wonderful! Enjoyed every thing the bowling, theatre, bars! Great place to stay

Short: Great food, fun experience, mediocre decor, can't wait to return. 

Long: Wow, was this food good! We always smelled the amazing scents wafting down South Grand, and the food didn't disappoint. We got the sampler platter for two (under $24) to share which included lentils, cabbage, chicken, beef and a center of two chicken legs and a boiled egg. The indira (bread used to scoop the fare) was AMAZING! The service was fine and the baklava not overwhelming (worth eating every crumb, though), and the meal was finished nicely with some Ethiopian coffee served strong and black. Overall, I can't wait to go back frequently. 

What was fun was learning about the Ethiopian culture of sharing food with the bread. The culture was represented throughout the restaurant, and the education really made the experience. This would be a fun place to bring a family to.

We have used Rite Way for over 10 years, even before they were Rite Way. Recently had a water leak on the indoor unit.  The condensation pump had gone bad.  The professional technician quoted a price of $663!!!! for a tiny pump. Something just wasn't "Rite".  I ordered the same exact part for $44.55 with shipping and got it the next day.  With the price that Rite Way gave me I could buy 15 pumps!!

Rite Way, we are breaking up and I have no heartache!  Folks beware, if you think the repair or part is too much, you are correct.  Just don't do it the Rite Way.

Me and my friends had a great time here. We all went after work because a coworker highly recommended it and LET METELLYOU it did not disappoint. It was delicious TexMex and drinks. Our server Christian was fun, quick, and matched our energy. 100% would go again!
Nick did a great job on my trees and even gave my 10 foot totem pole a fresh cut off the bottom to get rid of the dry rot.  I would highly recommend him.

I'm super sad to be giving a two star review for one of my favorite restaurants in town, but tonight's experience was horrendous. My fiancé, his best friend, another friend and I decided to check out the new location. We were informed of the longer than normal wait time - we were told 45 minutes, no biggie - but we got one order in full with cold appetizers (tots, onion rings, and mozzarella sticks) which makes me think stations weren't communicating about what was being done for each ticket AND we got less than half of the second order. We watched pizzas and calzones for orders placed after ours coming out... we were waiting on a slice and a calzone. I spoke to Bobby, who was happy to ask the kitchen what was going on. She told me another 10-15 minutes. We waited another 20 and I watched more like items come from the kitchen. At this point I was livid so I spoke to the manager, Erica, who refunded our meals. The restaurant ended up having to close early as a bunch of staff walked out and they were having plumbing issues. Plumbing issues are beyond control, but I was dumbfounded that they had lost so many employees on such a busy night. We finally ended up getting the items we were waiting on (one of the people we were with use to work there and helped the kitchen by making the calzone) and the four of us ended up staying and helping with closing duties. It's sad when patrons end up helping a crew stay afloat, instead of the owners, but like I said we love the restaurant and the people who were still there. We're going to wait a long while before we come back. Hopefully things will work themselves out by then.

I like this little pub, decent drinks, food is hit or miss depending on who is in kitchen. When the food is good, it's GOOD! When the food is bad, it's BAD! I do like the outside patio area. Not a lot of places have those anymore, especially with a smoking area. I would def say if I want a drink after work this is the place I go. If I get drunk enough I'll eat dinner here as well. All the while, hoping that it is a GOOD food day

This was some of the most mediocre pizza I have ever tasted. It was very bland without parmesan and red pepper flakes. I also tried a wrap and it was boring.  It's the closest pizza option but I'll drive somewhere else next time.
I love this place. The food is awesome and it's a great deal. My favorite restaurant in Tampa definitely recommended. Those arepas

The best cupcake is the Strawberry Lemonade!  I dare you to tell me different!  For you chocolate lovers, the brownie is ridiculous!  Get a glass of milk though, you'll need it!  You won't want to share any of them.
I went in for an eyebrow wax. She totally butchered my left eyebrow where their not even. The waxing table is in a tiny storage closet where you are squished against a wall.

Say it with me... but it's in a gas station?! Yup, now let it go. This the best Indian food I have had in the city of Tampa. I ordered take out and it was entirely too much food. Way to much. The flavors are amazing.... the tiki masala is by far the best on the menu. The people that work there are lovely, the prices are on point and the quality of food is top notch.... don't judge a book by it's cover or you just might miss some of the best food you have ever had.

They had me at whole hog bbq in the backyard.

So we walk into a crazy busy lunch service, and have to wait a few minutes for table. I see an outside patio deserted due to the 40 degree temps. Go outside and find a poor shlub desperately trying to keep a fire going under a whole hog (see the photo). I'm sold, I'm so happy, I can't wait to eat where there's obviously an obsessive in charge.

After some Q'er to Q'er shop talk, the table is ready. The server not only knows the menu and has food knowledge but is actually an advocate for the restaurant. Turns out he ate there as customer, loved it so much that he petitioned for a job. Server: check.

Intriguing fusion menu. We tried a few things for lunch: chicken wings, chicken and waffles with sweet potato waffle and spiced caramel, pork belly bowl, a custom pho, and I think a salmon dish but food coma took over so don't remember. All recommended by server, all really well executed and satisfying. Food: check.

It was lunch time so only tried a couple of cocktails from the small but appealing list. Both the Tamarind Sour and the My Tie were complex,multi-layered, and *very* drinkable. Drinks: check.

Great food and great experience in a city full of both. Definitely find your way to this unassuming foodie joint.

Great company!  They come right to your home or office to collect your old electronics to properly and safely recycle these items.  They have come to both my house and office several times and are a hugeeeeeeee help.  I would strongly encourage everyone to use this company as they are doing us all a huge favor!

I tried their Father's Day special of a 3-egg omelet with onions and smoked beef brisket.  The server did not mention the garnish of greens and bacon.  That would explain the cost.  Beware that specials are as is.  It is very interesting how they have 3 different dispensers of water.  They offered me the "still" pure water.

Wife and I went for lunch on a Wednesday.  Prices are very low but that wasn't enough to attract very many eaters.  Food was a big disappointment overall.  Egg roll and crab Rangoon were inedible.  Shrimp in Lobster Sauce was poor at best.  Garlic shrimp entree was fairly tasty but overwhelmed with vegetables.  It seems too risky to return for the dinner menu, although it is very extensive.

DON'T GO. DON'T THINK ABOUT IT. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY OR SPACE IN YOUR STOMACH. 

Food is not fresh and taste like the smell of cold garbage in winter. Drinks are Pre made and taste like dish soap and bird piss...w/o alcohol.

The servers are nice and the view outside is cool...but the owner is grumpy ...rude...and accepts that the food sucks.
Good breakfast spot. Quick service, fun options!

Company is good at lying
I cancelled in September and still getting charged monthly payments for no reason

Filing a report on bbb today due to ongoing fraud 

Huge disappointment in quality and service

I never expect much from a Chinese food place with the word "Panda" in its name so I wasn't surprised to find that New Panda is about as average as they come. The portions are large. The wonton soup is very good. Everything else is average... lots of breading, heavily fried and greasy. The workers are very nice and try hard to accommodate you - for instance, there was no teriyaki on the menu but I asked for it and they delivered. Prices are average. Overall it's a reliable Chinese fast food joint.

This is really a limited review, as all I ordered was the gator on a stick for around $9.  Again the star off  is for the price.  The gator sausage tasted great, very mild flavor, nicely spiced.  For 9 dollars though they could skip.the stick and go for the bun, just saying.

So I would give it five stars but my previous experience they got my sandwiches backwards so it messed up a whole meal. Today though I decided to leave a review only because of a kid that made my sandwich right and he deserves a raise! I got a big kahuna cheese steak with no jalapeños. I asked for mayo last time and she put chipotle mayo instead of regular and it was not very good. I'll be coming back and hopefully that kid is there to make it for me again. Good job dude!

We went to the Jimmy Buffet concert, I did not know what to except so I checked out all the reviews on Yelp to get opinions & see what I was in for. It was not bad, getting into the parking was fine, we parked away from the Amphitheatre  but I read that as well on here. You are parking on grass (dirt) but it was easy to get in. The walk was not that bad, lots of people out tailgating. Getting into the place was not a big problem but they did force us to down our little Fireball drinks, by this time we were pretty toasted. We had lawn sits & of course you can not see the stage from there but all the TV's were working so that was pretty cool. Of course the prices on the liquor & beer were SKY HIGH but is seems that everyone knows that already. It was a 2hr concert, after that we had to get shirts, two shirts was $85, yes, $85! It seemed that everyone going up there had the same total, $85 but it was worth it. Restrooms were not as dirty as I would've thought. Good security, of course they would not let me take my beer out of the Amphitheatre but I understand why. I would go back

After a long day of shopping or people watching the Rock Bottom is a great spot to unwind at the King of Prussia Mall.  Usually bars / restaurants located in shopping malls are there for convenience and don't pay much attention to quality.  The Rock Bottom doesn't fit the mold.  The restaurant space large with booths and tables scattered all over.  The bar area is large and has a plethora of TV's.  

I stopped for an early dinner with my girlfriend the day after Christmas.  Although the mall was more packed then a keg party in my Fraternity basement the restaurant wasn't too busy.

We grabbed (2) seats at the bar and took a look at the menu.  I had been craving a beer all day so I tried one of the home made unfiltered Belgian White's. My beer hit the spot and was full of flavor.  My girlfriend ordered a turkey sandwich and I picked the 2am burger.  The burger came with bacon, cheese, fried egg and a hash brown all piled together.  It was the perfect ending to a long day of shopping.  The turkey sandwich was packed with turkey and my girlfriend said she would order it again if we came back.
What a pleasant surprise. Great food yummy margaritas relaxed atmosphere. Would recommend to anyone who wants good food at a reasonable price.
Everything was exceptionally fresh and delicious i would recommend the Pho to everyone and the large is enough to feed an entire hungry family

The Bercy is super cool and swanky restaurant in the heart of the main line. The building it resides in is rich with history as it used to be an old bank and  then was home to the famed Primavera Pizza Kitchen prior to being The Bercy. The cocktails, wine, and food were all first class and I look forward to going back. We had the French Onion Soup (excellent), Grilled Spanish Octopus (amazing and not to be missed), assorted cheese board, Beef Bourguignon (this was good but was not a classical bourguignon and was more of a reimagined / deconstructed version), Norwegian Halibut (great, highly recommend), Diver Sea Scallops (amazing and cooked to perfection), and Lemon-Meringue (delicioso!). Looking forward to going back.

I thought this place would have been a better option than the convention food, but maybe I should've just gotten my lunch there instead. I got their steak burrito with guac and a mango fresca. The burrito lacked flavor and the ingredients used didn't seem fresh. The mango fresca was just too sweet.
Got the tofu snowpea mushroom plate, it was pretty good, the tofu was still pretty soft not really fried. It was go tho for not being authentic Chinese food. The service was good.

Gorgeous place! Authentically German, lively atmosphere....that's where the compliments end.

Food was underwhelming/not good. I ordered the potato pancake appetizer...they were dried out and flavorless.  My friend ordered the bratwurst...I have never seen a skinnier wiener! The bun it was served in was stale...the sauerkraut was tasteless...the fries were decent however. 

How can a German Bier Garten be out of pretzels? Seriously, completely out.

The beer was nice however...we had the Hefeweizen & the Lager.

Service was not good. We had to flag one down after waiting 22 minutes on the patio for someone to make eye contact.
 
Maybe I'll try again next Oktoberfest & they will have improved.

This place is not as bad as people have said. It is extremely roomy and has a vast selection of food to choose from. The decor is nice, the people are friendly and as expected, you will never find a perfect Buffett. The only reason people complain is because they can and they will. I believe that I got my money's worth and most likely will go back. The place seems intimidating.  Great food and prices and a lovely atmosphere.
A must try place. Super crowded during lunch but stay...they mive quickly. Try the shrimp salad on croissant with the cream of broccoflower soup. Delicious!

I've been a long time Suntan city customer in different cities. So I've seen some great customer service and I've seen some down right terrible service. And this Suntan city here Smyrna has probably the worst customer service I have ever experienced. I paid for the entire year of tanning for the basic bed but at a different location who had amazing customer service, I was sad to move away from that one. 
So my first time in this location I automatically got the vibe that the employees were annoyed that I was there and they didn't even bother to greet me. But I scanned in and told them what I wanted to do and they hardly said anything to me the entire time. Being my first time at that location I asked where the bed was that they put me in which thy immediately looked at me like I was dumb and didn't say a word. So I just had to find the room myself so I kinda felt stupid. I'd almost rather drive the 40 minutes to the other salon I've been going to where the people actually love their job and care about their customers then this one in Smyrna and receive shitty service.

Really good food and wonderful service.  My friends are regulars and they are very careful about ensuring meat doesn't end up in their order (they are vegans and vegetarians).  I ordered cheese enchiladas and their green and red sauces are both very flavorful.  

Despite being packed, we were seated promptly.  My only complaint is that it took a while both to put in our order and receive our checks.

Everything I have ever had here is great.  Red (spicy) Ramen is my favorite and it is excellent with any of the available meat choices.  Plenty of add-ones for reasonable prices.  Also some really great sides, like the shishito peppers, for reasonable prices too.  The Poké is also excellent.  Finally they have BOTH Sapporo and Asahi on draft for $5.50 a glass.

For Mexcian outside of Boise, I wasn't sure what to expect. I loved the decor, and the menu was extensive. It's my grandpa's favorite Mexican restaurant in the area- and I could see why. The staff was friendly, and we had plenty of room in their dining area with a big group. The salsa that came with the tortilla chips were a little odd- I couldn't figure out what made it taste unlike any other salsa, and I couldn't decide whether I liked it or not. The bean dip was awesome though, and I was happy to keep that dish near me as opposed to the salsa.

I ordered the burrito fajita and it was good- nothing special- but definitely hit my Mexican core.

We are SO HAPPY we no longer have to drive to FK down in South Tampa. I have never had a bad meal at a FK. Today we got a four bowl and a six bowl. The decor in the inside is so adorable. The utensil dispensers are great, you just grab the stem of the utensil so there minimal contact from other people. There is seating inside and outside. FYI there is seating outside on the side of the building in case there is nothing out front. We will now be adding this FK to our rotation list!

I LOVE  burgers, everywhere. I didnt get a body like this by not liking burgers. Id have to say this was a pretty poor performance. I hadnt heard of this place, and saw it driving, thought Id stop in. The burger was not good. It was so very very salty. I also had the fried pickles, they also were very salty, and it was just clumps of undercooked batter, and the pickles were on the side. It was pretty terrible, as for chains, Ill take 5 guys anyday over this.

I went in for a manicure and pedicure. There was only 3 people in their place. So I sat down In the chair. My pedicure took 1 hr and 15 minutes. I went during my lunch break and I didn't have time for a manicure and I spent the money for no reason because I had to walk out with wet nails because the lady took forever. Now I have to go somewhere else to do my actual mani and will have to pay for a polish change that is less than 24hrs old. I'm used to having a mani and pedi fit into 1hr maybe 1hr and 15 so when I realized that is what it took to get a pedi I was not very happy. If you have the time then it's not a terrible place to go. The place is nice and it is clean but I'm always on a time crunch and just can't afford for a mani pedi to take that long.

I'm sitting here sipping a delicious peppery, rich Bloody Mary with some Guinness splashed in, wishing we had a place just like this in midtown Sacramento. 

This is midtown Reno, which up until now I did not know existed. And where I am right now is a classy bar called Chapel. Take me to church. Being that it's Reno, there is an extensive selection of spirits, cocktails, and beer both on tap and bottled. The bartender is knowledgable and funny. The ambiance is truly unique, kind of country western but not enough to be hokey, comfortable, upscale without getting snobby, and with colors that pop and plants that I find pleasing to look upon. There's a biergarten in the back, a pool table, and a front porch with roll up garage door and stools for people watching, as well as ample space in the main bar area.

I've so far tried the Bloody Mary and the farmer's market cocktail, called the K O Cherry Bounce, with local cherries, bourbon, cherry bitters, and lactart. Yum! And creative to a tee.

I appreciate the aptly named cocktails on the menu as well as the Dealer's Choice option. It's pretty much what I do when I walk into any bar, say, "Make me something with blank in it!" It's nice that Chapel has the option right there on the menu for those who are too embarrassed to ask that. 

"What's that drink again?"
Jimmy Effing Buffet!
"Who's that guy who sings that song?"
Jimmy Effing Buffet.
(Literally how the cocktail got its name.)

Need to order that next time I'm in! Thanks Chapel!

Ranked by NUVO readers as the best Thai restaurant in Indy in 2014, Siam Square has excellent authentic Thai food cooked on real woks. The owners of Siam Square also own Rook and have ownership in Thunderbird and Black Market (I believe). 

I've been getting takeout from Siam Square a lot lately (I only live a few blocks away) and love it. Although typical, my favorite is probably the Pad Thai or the Green Curry. The Siam Roll is a solid appetizer as well and Thom Yum is my go-to for soup. Other than that, it's just a matter of going and trying things out. Portions are good and worth the price in everything except a few appetizers that could be bulked up a bit. 

Solid bottle beer options, but only 2 drafts. From what I understand, one is always an IPA and the other is a seasonal. A decent amount of wine options as well. 

The environment is okay. Not a fine-dining place by any means, but not your typical hole-in-the-wall Asian restaurant either. There is also an upstairs where I've seen big parties go and a cool small bar downstairs. When I do lunch take out, it's typically professionals from Lily or other places downtown filling the diner.  Dinner has mostly trendy couples and parties. Always plenty of friendly serving staff to take care of you. 

This place is excellent. I definitely recommend whether you're a Thai veteran or cultural food newbie!

Today was the first time we've been to Tea Buds since the owner purchased the store last year. I had a great cup of coffee prepared in a one cup brewing system
My wife ordered a cup of tea that took forever to get. The owner kept telling my wife it was steeping, but 20 minutes later she finall got her tea. Shop is in good location, decor is okay but the owner is a grouch probably not suited to retail or customer service. You'll get a good cup of coffee or tea but don't have high expectations for good service

Basically, it's a piano bar where the pianists take requests for everyone's favorite drunken sing-along tunes. They call it a "dueling" piano bar, though I'm not sure why, because there's no real dueling going on... the two pianists play together and off of each other. Whatever.

I think Howl is best enjoyed with a large group of uninhibited, rowdy people who aren't afraid to drink a lot and make fools of themselves. It's a fun place, don't get me wrong, but you're not going to be able to sip on a cocktail and have an intimate conversation here. It's incredibly loud, the pace is nonstop and it's always packed to the ceiling. 

The bartenders are somewhat snotty, but the cocktail waitresses are great and surprisingly fast and efficient, considering how busy it gets. I'd suggest getting there before 9:00 p.m. to avoid waiting in line and potentially finding a table near the front.

Oh, and if you want a request played, you'd better hope someone else puts it in or come armed with lots of dollar bills. They don't come cheap, and the first request goes to the highest bidder.

By far, the worst Indian restaurant I've ever eaten at. In general, I like Indian food. I went with my family during the weekend for the lunch buffet only to be completely disappointed. To start with, there was no good food options. Yes, at a "buffet." There were rices and sides but no good options if you eat meat.  They had Tandoori chicken...but...the first piece I got was colorful outside and completely raw inside (rare if we would be talking about a steak). The second piece I tried was blah, no flavor. Another meat option was a butter chicken but was also dry and with lack of flavor. They kept filling up the trays with veggies and rices but no real options to taste. I was there waiting for about 45 minutes but the meat dishes never came out.   I have eaten several times at Indian restaurants for both buffet and ordering from regular menu with fantastic options. How does Haveli ought to call this a lunch buffet when there's no food?! Unbelievable. It was probably 12:30pm when I was there so it was a good time to get lunch, no excuses to not have food. I was hungry when I left. One thing is being cheap but this was an extreme. I will not go back, for sure.

Really enjoyed this tiny place. We started with the... fried guacamole... essentially guacamole dumplings, very Instagram friendly. The carrot soup with shrimp could be served at a super fancy restaurants and you would be happy with it. Pork torta was pretty good, could have used a little more flavor and less fat.

Don't bother. This KFC in particular sucks. Every time I've gone, the chicken is so over cooked that it tastes like rubber and cardboard. They drench the spicy chicken sandwich in sauce so that's all you can taste. I'd rather drive down to Oxnard to go to Popeyes.

Strawberry Rose Lemonade.

That was the homemade lemonade flavor of the day, and it was refreshing and sweet.  As a matter of fact, my entire experience at Cafe a la C'Art was refreshing and sweet... 

Friendly employees, a clean, welcoming atmosphere, delicious looking sandwiches, and a display case of desserts that looked like they were to die for!

Four stars for now but I will definitely be back and I am guessing that once i bite into one of those sandwiches and/or desserts, I may have to bump up my rating to five stars.

Until my next trip to Tucson, Cafe a la C'Art, stay sweet!

This is THE place to go to eat in NOLA. Eat at then oyster bar if you can so you can watch them shuck the oysters! Such a fun authentic experience. Definitely the best fried fish I had while I was down there.

If you haven't listened to 10 hours of cats meowing in the kitty cat art room, have you even really lived? https://youtu.be/xpntGZMZYjw

In all reality, this is a no frills hostel with a super friendly, helpful, and creative vibe that feels like you're at home in Black Rock City. Ive stayed here several times while working on my art car in Reno and the folks here are absolutely lovely, the art rooms range from hilarious to awe inspiring, and the communal nature of it all is just superb. I prefer staying here over paying the same for an air conditioned room at a casino because it feels like home. Highly highly recommend for a unique experience if you're passing through, or to make some Burner connections and get a taste of the Playa.

I have been using great basin to buy all my personal vehicles for the last 15 years!!!

I started my first loan when I was 18

5 stars definitely earned.
Trust definitely earned !!!!!
The food is good and inexpensive and as promised I received a dinosaur (triceratops) while I waited.

As far as karaoke places go, this is not going to be one of my go-to's.
Let me start off by saying that there is a heavy cigarette smell permeating throughout the venue so it's very off putting if you're sensitive to it like me.
The staff here is cordial but they take a long time to respond to our call bell. First of all, their karaoke machines took about 10 minutes to load the program in order for us to start singing. For a new system it should not have so many malfunctions. Needless to say, I prefer yakitori boy by a landslide.

The 2 sauces alone are worth the trip. I could have simply eaten the perfectly cooked arepas dipped in either sauce. I've had some dreadfully doughy arepas and some terribly dry ones. These were perfect. I had the burger arepa (#6) and my friend the asada (#1). Could have split one since they are generous. What a great find for someone who is gluten free!  Or for anyone for that matter.  Small space that proudly announces no WiFi. The neighborhood is interesting. Right across from the Greyhound bus station with nothing else around. Don't be put off by that.

Went for Saturday evening dinner. Sat outside. Ordered tandoori mixed meat/seafood grill. Menu said it comes with grilled mixed vegetables. But there were only a little sautéed greens and red onions. Dish was good and flavorful, but I wish there were also grilled vegetables. I ordered the garlic Naan and the paneer kulcha Naan (Naan stuffed with cheese and seasonings). Both were good. My friend ordered chicken Tikka Masala, came with rice. Good, but a little different taste than other places where I've had this Dish.  Will return.

Just came in for a quick energy smoothie. The staff was really courteous and they have a nice selection of different types of smoothie combos or you can create your own flavor combo.

Had an açai bowl made into a smoothie subbing blueberries for the bananas w/o missing a step.

They also had a nice selection of frozen yogurt, which you can get free samples of. 

The prices are on par w/Jamba Juice and other similar smoothie outlets markup, but you get what you pay for with good quality ingredients.

Absolutely atrocious... Kevin started an argument with me in the store using the excuse that he is a private business and that he may not operate like other ups stores... Whats the point of a franchise?  He then started bragging that he had started all these businesses...arrogant prick!

Omg! This place is excellent. I ordered the Chicken Parmigiana dinner. When I took my first bite, I felt like I was back in New York. It reminded me of home. The taste of the food was spectacular. The portions are big. My family and I all took home at least half our meals. Why did we like this place so much? The taste, the ambiance. We faced the bottle wall. Adds to the atmosphere We'll definitely be back. The service was excellent.

Great tourist trap! Expensive and very mediocre restaurant. 

Our waitress could not weigh the pros and cons between the veal or stuffed pork chop.  She knew nothing about the wine list but when the least expensive wine is $45/ bottle and most are @ $80-90 with several over $100 K-Paul should be able to sell the wine.  

The etouffee was thin, waterway and tasteless. I sent it back. My daughters beef tenderloin was served essentially raw not rare and back it went! So... 2 out of 3 entrees from our table went back. I suspect K Paul's is using frozen shrimp and frog legs in its food preparation. 

It's a corporate tourist trap restaurant now.


Oh, the restrooms do not have hot water.  Yes, this is a small, inconsequential detail. But it shows that the management of K-Paul's is focused on saving the few pennies it takes to provide hot water to wash your hands rather than focusing on the details that make you want to spend money.

I'm unfortunately going to have to downgrade my 5-stars to 3-stars. I've been going to Sushi Garden (including the old location) for around 7 years and recently noticed a change in the quality of their sushi. 

A family member was in town and I was excited to have them eat at a great sushi place and share my love of Sushi Garden with them. Unfortunately, a lot of the nigri was sub par and the rolls had more cream cheese and other fillers in them then they did fish. We couldn't even eat the Albacore because it had a weird taste. The service was still good even though we had a large party and I still love the new look of this location.

Maybe I've become spoiled by the fresh sushi at Sushi Cortaro as of late and Sushi Garden has always been like this, or the quality of their sushi has gone down. Either way, this unfortunately isn't the best place around for quality happy hour and all you can eat sushi any longer.

Dr. Z and his staff are truly the best dentistry offering in the greater Reno area. After a near-death experience for our son because of a different dentist group, we were, to put it mildly, a little skeptical and extremely cautious to look for another dentist in the area. Fortunately we found Z Dentistry, and we were immediately surrounded by genuine interest, care, and concern for each one of our dental situations. Dr. Z even graciously granted free follow-up care to a severely traumatic (does root canal conjure any thoughts?) situation, which shows nothing but true and genuine care and concern for my well-being. For those doing a similar search for a good dentist, phenomenal hygienist, friendly and warm, professional staff you need look no further. Please trust me, Dr. Z is the real deal.

My poke bowl was legit! I was craving something fresh and super healthy...and I got a really delicious serving of just that, in a perfectly proportioned bowl. The staff was helpful in picking out my goodies, and offered recommendations.  I will for sure be back, as this might just be my new lunch fave!

Gia Nina's is a great example of a clean, professional italian restaurant that doesn't break the bank. Every pizza I've ordered from there has been superb (my favorites include their Jack-Mac and Cajun style pizzas). I don't know if it's the crust or the cheese, but the pizza always stands out as sharper than what I would get from other pizzerias.
They also offer rotating deals on their food every day of the week, which both helps me save money and decide what I want to eat.  

That being said, I have not been entirely satisfied with their non-pizza items. I've tried several items from appetizers to entrees and I really haven't found anything that I enjoy more than their pizza.

If I ever have guests and I want to treat them to an easy meal, Gia Nina's will be my number one pick for a pizza that will astonish them every time.

When I lived in Bowling Green, Ky this was always my favorite bbq place to visit whilst in Nashville. The line may seem disparring, but it moves quickly. I recommend the pulled pork and sausage with the sweet sauce. My husband says the brisket isn't worth trying. There's more seating upstairs, just follow the stairs in the back! Very conveniently located to all the excitement that Nash has to offer!
I called in yesterday and spoke with Wilson Clay about purchasing a new vehicle. He was absolutely amazing and gave me tons of feedback

What a great year!!!! 2018. Everyone counted us out. Despite all the injuries, we beat the GOAT! I've never seen the whole city come together in this way. Cant wait for the parade.  Its scary to think what we could be next year when everyone is healthy!

Great Dinner with friends after the Santa Barbara Marathon.
Check out my photos ... 

Met with with some friends and the restaurant was able to modify the reservation from 2 to 4 customers. 

The cadillac margaritas were delicious, and Roger's black berry margarita was strong.
We started with the pork belly quesadilla and tamale - I loved the pork belly
these were our entrees:
2 enchiladas with shrimp and crab
1 chicken
1 vegetarian quesadilla 

Service was good, and there was a good vibe inside with great decoration.
My only issue was the prices were a little steep for a Mexican restaurant. I wanted the empanadas, but at those prices, well, maybe next time.

What a great place to run to for lunch at work! And did I mention, they have free beer on Monday?! Really excellent food. Portions are small so plan ahead to get a side or two to balance out your meal. My salad however was as grande as the menu said it was! Will be coming back to try their wing special: 1lb of Wings, drink, and side for $8.

Well it's June 2 get a doughnut with your purchase of a beverage. Sounds good. Not. So I went through the drive through and the new clueless cashier evidently zeroed out my DD card that had  a brand new reload of $10...Not free at all. The most unfortunate thing about my stop was she didn't give me a receipt either. Guess I'll never see that money again. Management please train your employees before putting them in front of customers. She was awfully clueless. Haley knows who I'm talking about. BTW, thanks for never returning my phone calls.

Takeout order review:

Ordered the dry pepper style steak and the general taos chicken. Both weren't my style of food cause it was way too sweet. The food was good but it was missing a saltier side. The portions weren't that big compared to the price paid, which was 34 for both. The steak was cut into small cubes and had mainly vegetables. The general taos chicken sauce wasn't to my liking, however, the chicken had a good chunk of meat in them and didn't have a lot of dough for coverup like many other Chinese takeout. I would say the service was fast and after ordering, they told me I could pick up in 10-15 minutes and they were right on queue.
Food is good don't care too much for the thin sauces they use and hate that they add a fee to your bill since COVID.

Long story short, I needed help with a flat tire on a Sunday.  I called ahead and was assured it would not be a problem.  I talked to them when we dropped it off.  I called an hour before close and was told they are getting to it, but it would be taken care of today. It is 7:30 p.m. I have not heard anything.  no phone call to say its done.  no phone call to say its not.  My truck has the tire off and is sitting in their garage.  I was supposed to leave for work tonight, and trusted the guy in the office to take care of this.  My fault.  I am still waiting to see what happens tomorrow....

Went in twice so far and noticed a decrease in quality of dishes when we dined in during happy hour vs. normal dinner hours so keep that in mind for your visit. 

The first time we went here was for dinner, we ordered: 

1. Grilled Vegetable Salad 10/10 (Vegetable abundance)
2. Caesar Salad 10/10 (Tbh, best one I had anywhere)
3. Porcini Mushroom Ravioli 10/10 (So creamy and delicious)
