Then, we noticed they had most of these dishes during Happy Hour so next time we went in for HH and we ordered:

1. Cauliflower Ceviche 10/10 (Refreshing, comes with fresh chips)
2. Porcini Mushroom Ravioli 4/10 (Disappointing and not even close to what we had for dinner entree)
3. Caesar Salad 4/10 (Not as crisp, too much dressing. Not even close to what we had before)
4. Hummus Bruschetta 7/10 (mediocre)
5. House Cab 6/10 (meh)

I will visit again but probably not for HH.

our little pup LOVES this place. She almost seems depressed if she thinks she not going for the day. 
Thanks for everything guys !

I went here on a Monday night before an event at Drexel. It was nearly empty which was PERFECT because we were short on time.

The bartender was extremely attentive (which was awesome because she was the ONLY attendant there). 

The decor is very simple. It's just a dark, wooden bar/restaurant. 

Happy Hour specials were decent. $5 wine, $5 rum/absolut vodka, and i thiiiink it was either $3 or $4 Miller Lites/other 'meh' beer.

BUT THE FOOD DOEEEE! lol We ordered the Tri Tip Tacos, Pork Belly Tacos, Tater Tots, Chicken Fingers, and the Spinach Salad.

And what was the best?!?! The Spinach salad. You're surprised. I'm surprised. Something about the bacon and the citrus vinaigrette was just awesome. It also comes with cranberries but I opted out. My friend got crans on hers and loved them. Whatever.

The tacos were awesome as well BUT if you order one plate, it's just two tacos and that's not enough at all. So get two orders. (I liked the tri tip better than the pork belly.)

The chicken tenders were just okay. They tasted somewhat bland, in my humble hungry opinion, but the sauces (honey sriracha and barbeque) were good.

The tater tots, dipped in spicy ketchup, yum. 

We left nothing on the table. I'm glad we found this place!
Amazing Drinks! A gem hidden in downtown St. Louis! Cannot wait to go back! Recommending it to all my friends. The drinks are Ahhhmazing!

Me and, my family decided to spend our Christmas in reno so I booked them a deluxe room for a decent price. The rooms were spacious and, the beds were comfortable the view was simply amazing! breathtaking if you ask me you can see the mountains and almost all of reno. I love the fact that the hotels are joined so most of the time you don't even have to go outside!

 As soon as we got here to check in the process wasn't that long the front staff was quite nice not super friendly but alright I suppose. If you're anything like me ... my experience is always better if the staff is friendly they make it much better. As soon as we got our keys we headed to the parking lot which gets super crowded fast so make sure you leave your car there and, walk instead lol! We got our luggage and headed up to the 19th floor... and our rooms were joined.. the decorations were nice and everything was clean. I loved the mirror space huge mirrors and enough room to put all my essentials. Closet space was big also. 

The only thing that somewhat bothered me is when I took my sisters and step brother to the spa/ hottub and gym we asked for towels because we wanted to get the hot tub going and, the lady down there had the audacity to ask if we were guests here... it came off as racist but I didn't want to say anything I just answered Yes we are. In fact, its common sense being that you can't even get in the hotel without showing your room key to the security. So that somewhat shrugged me the wrong way but I definitely didn't let it get in the way of our awesome hot tubbing time!!! It was super cold outside but... it was extremely hot in the hot tub it felt really nice and relaxing. 

I can definitely say i'll be returning and staying in this particular hotel. The one thing I love the most would have to be the elevators they go up and down extremely fast lol!
Delicious family style food, especially poboys! Love their red gravy! Plenty of seating. Counter service. Very reasonable prices for the portions.

First of all, the staff alone makes this place AMAZING!! The staff is so attentive and friendly. We went on Mother's Day with my mom and aunt and were treated soooo well! I can't say enough good things about the people who work here. They made our day extra special! 

The food: OMG so good. Everyone finished everything on their plate. Delicious. Drinks are amazing. I couldn't post a picture of our dessert because we devoured it but I would recommend the cookie with ice cream.

It was a sit down quick serve Italian. It was clean and the staff was great. They provide ok food. It was rather bland but we were hungry and the kids enjoyed it. The best part of the meal was the great deserts which were not homemade but really good.
We go to this restaurant whenever we want thai food locally.  Recently, I got tempura basa in panang sauce.  It was fantastic.  This place has great service, lovely decor, and consistently good food.

I received a little ruby and diamond ring for my 16th birthday a long, long, time ago (in other words, my sixteen-year-old-self was a few lifetimes ago) I recently gave it to my 13-year-old daughter and after wearing it for a few months the ring snapped in two in the back. I dropped it off here based on yelp reviews and my OTHER 20-year-old daughter picked it up for me. She said the owner was one of the nicest people she had ever met and was so kind. The ring came back not only repaired but beautifully shined and polished. What great service. This is my new place for all of my jewelry needs!

My mother was 15 minutes late for her appt because she thought her appt was at 2:30 and it was at 2:00pm.  They REFUSED to see her and called her a no show.  She had never been late before.  My mother is 76 yrs old and still driving herself.  The woman who came in after her and was older than she, was also told she was 15 minutes late and would not be seen.  She had run into traffic.  The staff is rude and condescending.  The doctors established this policy.  They can keep you waiting because you are not important.

Nancy shows us beautiful houses the second they are on the market. She tries to understand our needs and desires. She is always excited about getting us our HOME SWEET HOME and gently nudges us to walk away and not to waste our time on outrageously overpriced, cosmetic-Botox rehab chronic disease houses, and even gorgeous houses that are NOT FOR US.  

We met the sellers and had a smooth transaction with our sellers sharing with us the fond memories of their home and introducing us to the neighbors. We not only bought our Home but also enjoy our Neighborhood. Nancy makes it fun and human

After a week of terrible eating in Springfield this place was a gem on our last night before our flights out of St. Louis. My friend wanted me to mention that the lobster mac and cheese was some of the best she has ever had from here but the dessert, although made in house, did not taste like it and I would have to agree. She had the three ice cream choices and I had a chocolate cake. None of the desserts were particularly amazing. Since I'm starting backwards with dessert, I'll move on to entrees. I had the ribeye. It was huge and cooked perfectly but extremely salty for my tastes. I ended up leaving the majority of it which is a shame since it runs around $50. For appetizers we started off with the house made chips and blue cheese and those babies were the real winners here. They were fantastic. Overall, a nice restaurant with plush, fancy decor, food is average, price is steep.
Ok the new bartender Alyssa is amazing!! Great recommendations and awesome food and aesthetic. Will definitely be back. The oyster shooters are a must as well as all of their sushi options!!!

I really enjoyed the red sauce on my chicken parmesan. It is a little spicy with a unique flavor. I would have like a little more cheese on top but the sauce more than made up for it. My child enjoyed his pizza as well-including the spicier than usual sauce.

A small and super easy airport!

By the time I walked out and confirmed my car rental which is conveniently located by baggage claim, my luggage was out already.  The cars for rent are just outside in the lot on the same street level.

TSI was very quick and even friendly!

There are also nice local decorations, slot machines and things to entertain yourself with.

The only thing missing was enough plugs to charge your phone, etc.
They only make ONE size pizza!! WTF? here on business from california wanted to order a pizza, they were nice enough to tell me dominoes was down the street "and they offer different size pizzas"

I came here to purchase the flowers for my wedding bouquet and decorations, and boy am I glad I did! I had a picture of a bouquet that I had in mind and the staff was very helpful; they pointed out the places where I'd be able to find what I was looking for (4 coolers and an entire floor with rows and rows of flowers!). They won't make your bouquet for you (which is not what I was looking for, but just to keep that in mind) but they give you a space to set things down and they'll give you great advice and suggestions if you need it. Did I mention just how many different varieties of flowers they have? Unless you're looking for a flower that can only be found deep in the amazon and is the only one of it's kind I can almost guarantee you'll find what you're looking for here. This place is also incredibly reasonably priced. I recommend coming here if you're the DIY type, if you have something specific in mind, or if you have a bit of a flower fetish. I gotta say, though, my wedding flowers were definitely one of the highlights of my wedding thanks to import flowers.

We loved this place. The Mediterranean but burger and tempeh rueben were both delish! Also, we had a fresh juice with kale parsley apple lemon and cucumber. Food was fresh, service was good. Great value! Would visit again!

Wonderful restaurant!! All of the food is delicious, and I have never had anything I didn't like. The cocktails are very tasteful and they have a wonderful wine selection. I highly recommend the chocolate cake to finish off the experience!

what a complete disaster the Palm Harbor location is.  you post this great picture of Valentine Donuts and don't even have them in the store? ??  The sad fact is that we even called before we went over to see if they had them, but nobody answers the phone so we left a message to call me back, but of course nobody does.  Then the guy there behind the counter gives attitude saying we should have called.   How about you try answering the phone.   Voodoo Donuts is a drive to Orlando but at least they are nice and actually have donuts!

In from out of town, I had heard about Puckett's and decided to give it a go.  It was packed inside with a big line for lunch, but since I was alone, I was able to go right up to a counter seat.  The bartender was very informative in regards to local beers and the menu, even going so far as to get a few samples for me and a couple next to me to try.  

I went for the classic fried chicken and I was not disappointed.  The inside is very cute and apparently they have live music with a small stage.  If I'm back in town, I will definately be back here.

Where do I even start? Commander's Palace is far more than just a culinary experience. From the moment I entered to the last second I experienced a top shelf caliber of customer service. 

We made 6:30pm reservations for my birthday which is highly recommended to make a reservation. To get to our table, we cut through the kitchen and each crew member we passed greeted us with a, "hello ladies" or "good evening". 

We were sat in the patio room which looks out to the courtyard. The tables are prepped with napkins and silverware. My friend had a black dress on and instead of giving her the white napkin our server went to the kitchen and came back with a black napkin to match her dress. 
When the server was told it was my birthday he came back with balloons for the table. 

At the Commanders Palace you have a team of servers. We had three people that continually checked on us throughout the course of our meal. 

When the server took our order he had us put all of it in at once (starter, entree and dessert). I ordered the turtle soup, the fish special and creme brûlée. Never having turtle soup I didn't know what to expect but it was rich and flavorful, similar to a chili verde. The fish was cooked to perfection overtop a sweet corn bisque. Last but not least, the creme brûlée was presented beautifully with a saints emblem of powdered sugar over the top. It was perfectly torched and sweetened. 

For my drink I ordered the sunset on the patio (seemed fitting). The drink comes out with sunglasses that you get to take home with you. 

Since it was my birthday they brought out the creme brûlée with a candle as well as two complimentary birthday shots that were delicious! 

100 out of 10 recommend giving this place a try.

Ford Focus... 4 days... OVER $800. ENTERPRISE... FULL SIZE CAR... 4 days... $450. Speaks volumes. Just the facts ma'am. Also, employees attitudes are not very welcoming. Seemed like they don't even want to be there. When you call you get "Hello!". No, "Thank you for calling Hertz", "Hertz, may I help you", or even just, "Hertz! go pound sand"... Nice.

This place is nothing short of awesome. It's a peanut butter lover's dream! Five different kinds of HOMEMADE peanut butter to choose from!! 

I'm only giving this place 4 stars because parking on Lancaster Ave is awful and they could use a couple more chairs, but the food is 5 STARS!! 

Many of the people reviewing here are actually kind of scaring me. It's called PB and U, so they obviously are built around peanut butter, what were you expecting? Maybe it's just that attitude that so many people in this area have that is coming out in their reviews.  Ben D's review is right on point! 

However, this place is just awesome. They make their own peanut butter! We have been here numerous times! Every time we visit we are more than satisfied! I love trying new things, and I love that they have monthly specials! When I recently got a job in the area, I was so excited to be able to go here for lunch on a regular basis!

The prices are very reasonable, especially for this area! You get your sandwich, and you think, "it's only peanut butter and a bag of chips, how is this going to fill me?" But it does, and this is coming from a foodie! I really can't say enough about this place, we love it! Writing this review just made me decide that this is where I am going for lunch today! 

My favorite go-to is the Peanut Butter (chunky of course!), honey, banana, and bacon if I can't make up my mind. The Peanut Butter smoothie is also an awesome option! They have so many different toppings and specials, it can be intimidating to order! They even offer fondue and pizzas!  And they take suggestions all the time, so if you think you have the next best thing, tell them! 

TRY THIS PLACE IF YOU LOVE PEANUT BUTTER!

Let's start with what really matters.  The fried chicken at Roost is out of this world.  Just the right amount of greasy and salty goodness.  The meat is top-notch, with tons and tons of flavor.  Do yourself a favor and get the dark meat.  A drumstrick will make your day.

Aside about a side: the homemade buttermilk biscuits.  Lordy.  The word homemade gets thrown around a lot these days, but with these things, you can really taste it.  Flaky, buttery and thick, they're the perfect compliment to an already stellar chicken feast.  

I had mine with a Boylan's Ginger Ale but next time I'm grabbing a black cherry.  Don't know what I was thinking.  

HOT TIP: this isn't fast food in the "already ready already" sense.  If you walk up, expect to wait at least 10 mins.  No problem though, you can call ahead and pick up!

Let's face it, a waxing appointment isn't the most exciting or fun thing to do but the staff and the environment at Waxing the City make it a pleasurable experience. This is a great clean and comfortable space with knowledgable and personable staff. I highly recommend any of their services.

Sierra is very professional, full of knowledge, and only wants you to leave happy with the results you would like to have. I am in the process of going from black to a blonde ombre/balayage mix. She was realistic with my results and told me that it is a process that it would be at least 3 appointments spread throughout a few months. She educated me on the products that would be most beneficial for my hair and did not do it in a pushy manner at all. In fact, I think I asked more questions than anything. She did not seem to mind. I am looking forward to my third appointment with her as the results from the second have left me quite pleased.

Found the Nail Bar on Yelp and after reading the reviews, I made an appointment for the Signature Pedicure($45).  What a wonderful treat I gave myself. This was one of the better pedicures I have received and well worth the money. I enjoyed my "me" time and the glass of champagne that was offered.  Yes, the prices are high and I agree with the one reviewer about discount packages. I would probably go more regularly knowing there was a package. I would try a manicure here and another pedicure for sure.  The salon is clean and they have decent selection of colors. The owner was there and he seemed nice enough.

I love love this restaurant. It's just perfect for a wine loving traveler who doesn't need a big meal and wants quality over quantity. This place is quiet, perhaps the quietest place in PHL. Every week when I stop here there is someone who works in the airport napping nearby. They have nice pop music playing in the atmosphere. No TVs, thank goodness. There is a nice view. I can see ships docking nearby. Their prices are fine by me. The food is great. I love the tarts, the chocolate torte, the chicken breast salad, the white chicken chili, and the smoked salmon rolls. I haven't had the other items yet.

Typical bait-and-switch place. They list a car that on paper sounds great and has a great price, but when you arrive the are is magically not available, but what they have instead is something with far less features, higher miles and much higher price. 

In short - scammers, stay away.

Sonata was fantastic. The Executive chef is a 2002 graduate of The Restaurant School, which me and my girlfriend are also an alumni of. We got to try the fall menu and they even offered us complimentary wine since we didn't bring our own. I thought that was a very nice touch. We were the only ones in the place on a Thursday night. The chef came out and talked to us after our meal, which was really cool. He explained that week nights are slow, but they are packed on the weekends. 

I got the Crispy Pork Belly appetizer and The Salmon entree.   My girlfriend got the Potato Leek Soup and the Lobster Mac & Cheese. All of them were really good, but I my salmon was a little overcooked. The sauces on each dish were what really shine. The presentation on every dish was really amazing too. 

I hope this place does well and I recommend it to anyone who is looking for a nice BYOB in the NoLibs area.

This place is a godsend. My partner went here for her hair cut and they just happened to have an opening and a male stylist free at the same time. 

I just got a basic cut, but they took the time to correct the mistakes from the prior barbers. And the cut I had in mind, was the cut I got. There was no unnecessary crimping or cutting where I didn't ask for it to be done. The stylist always asked or gave me a heads up on what was going on next. It was very well done. Also, she seemed to read me pretty well and didn't force conversation where there was none. 

My partner is mixed and her hair is curly. She went here because they do the Deva curl technique. She loved the service and the outcome of the technique.


Overall, it is quality service. However, it is pricey. The place itself is kind of small as well, but they make it homey by adding nice decor, tons of magazines and some snacks to munch on while you wait.

This store has a great location, its  right down the street from the mall. No issue with parking or service  There 's no digging here, the racks are very organized. Unlike the RedWhite store, this store accepts debit cards. I got 6 tees and 6 shorts for about $20 for my son's  camp, all gently used.

They no longer have dressing rooms due to theft. That's why it lost a star, but I do understand

My husband and I tried this restaurant tonight for the first time for our one year wedding anniversary. Everyone is so nice from the time you walk in the door until you leave. Our waiter was very nice and polite and gave me the excellent recommendation if the spaghetti carbonara. It was absolutely delicious and I have enough left for lunch tomorrow. The Italian salad is very good as well and my husband said his steak was awesome. We will definitely be coming back.

Been going to this gym for about 2 years now. 

The good: Its very clean gym with lots of space. They even have extra room for stretching. Really like TVs on cardo-equipment and free wi-fi allows me to listen to podcast while working out. The locker room is amazing - a sitting room with large tv to just relax. Towels are provided with quick access to pool and jacuzzi. I feel like I am at Ritz Carlton when I go to this gym.

The bad: This place is over-run with trainers. I understand their temptation because clientele is older with disposable income. The location of trainers station is at very top of stairs but to get to their break room the trainers must walk thru the cardio section and its constant flow of trainers walking too and from this location. I find it distracting. Why not place their break room and their work station near each other. It can be hard to get on machine or use stretching area because trainers are working with someone. I suspect the gym is profitable just on the monthly fees collected but its probably gold mine once u factor in how much they are pulling with trainers. I won't even venture what those elderly people are paying per hour for trainers. 

Overall I like the gym and if they ever decided to tone down the upselling with trainers it would be fantastic gym.

Update:

The manager ended up having two manhattans delivered to our room with a handwritten apology.  I really appreciate the steps he took to make it right. The drinks were great and I'd probably stop in for food next time I'm in town

------


Staying at the Kimpton here for the next few days. Tried to take advantage of their manhattan specials during happy hour that goes until 6. Sat down at 5:55 and was told I couldn't have one even at regular price because they're "trying to drive in more business" during happy hour. Well they lost business from me for not sticking to their advertised happy hour. Not a great way to drive in business for the hotel guests especially when it's advertised when you walk into your room.

This is a great place to get a sushi snack. I've eaten sushi from here numerous times and it is always fresh.  The pieces are individually wrapped so its easy to get a piece, or two, on the go.  There is a trick to unwrapping the plastic (ask them to show you). I also like the triangles wrapped in seaweed- very tasty and filling- but these are really tricky to unwrap.

I'm not a fan of fro-yo so I strictly go here for the sushi.  After 5pm all the sushi is $1.  Can't beat the price!

The people who work her are super nice as well.  :)

We visited Clearwater and on our last night my wife was sick so I went across the street to this bar and grill where I was very surprised. I really just was in the mood for a salad so I ordered the seafood Cobb salad and by far this was the best salad I have eaten in a long time. Bar staff was very friendly and I received my drink and food fast. I will surly be coming back here next time I visit. Great place with great live music.

My husband & I ran late for a meeting . Found this resturant on yelp- excellent service, fresh , good tasting food, a very warm welcome feeling. I would like to come back & relax & enjoy this lovely place next time we are in this area.

Hands down the best flavor ice cream I have ever had, is their Earl Grey Shortbread. I regularly think about the delicious cone I had, and pine for more! I don't live anywhere near by, so sadly it will be quite some time until I taste it's deliciousness again. For $12 a pint online, my waistline can do without the hefty price tag.

Loved everything about this place.  Work close by and have been anticipating the opening so was excited to try with the family. You must order the cornbread and the Shrimp and Grits (Savannah style) were outstanding. Great service and suggestion from the staff.

 Great outdoor area that I hope they are able to utilize somehow with our harsh winters.  They said they are opening lunch in a week or so.  Will definitely be back.
Excellent Vietnamese food in Old Metairie!  We had a curry chicken plate & beef bun. Both were great! Will certainly be back here!!

Best food ever honesty hands down! You can never go wrong the service is the best me being a regular they know my order by memory :) the food speaks for itself the tortillas are made by had it sad to know that in leaving and this is the one thing I'm gonna miss most because day or night I can be sure they will always be open in the restaurant or there food truck a couple blocks away I drive 15min from Carpintería to SB just to come and eat here. If you guys want authentic Mexican food do your stomach a favor and come

I was told by all my friends that this was the place to have pizza. Im usually skeptical about pizza places because i dont eat beef or pork, and most places have very few options if thats what your pallet is like, except cheese pizza.....which is basically the equivalent of having cheesy breadsticks for dinner. We moved in the greenwood area recently and ordered on moving night. It was great!!! We got the Bar-B-Q chicken pizza and it was phenomenal! !! Omg!! They have a few other options i wanna try as well. The service was friendly and helpful too. I didnt give 5 stars only because, the service could be a little faster.....its been slow all three times we've been there so far. Other than that.....YOU SHOULD DEFINITELY GET JOCKAMOS!
Amazing Restaurent.

Ok, I've tried to like this place, honestly I have.  For one, it's super convenient for me when I don't have time for breakfast or lunch during the day. But the food just doesn't stand out.  I've tried the bagels here on their own and the bagel sandwiches that they offer a few times.  The bagels lack a lot of flavor and they are so dense!  Where is the soft, doughy interior?  They have a ton of different flavored bagels, but they all taste very similar to each other.  My blueberry bagel this morning tasted like a plain wheat bagel.  The weird thing is that their cream cheese has a ton of flavor!  But then I'm all tasting is the cream cheese, and nothing from the bagel itself.  They can accommodate your large last minute order for early morning meetings, which is great for their downtown location.  I think the location is perfect for them, I just wish I liked their food more.  The staff is very friendly and they have a large area for people to have breakfast or a quick meeting out of the office.
Poor quality of food. Ordered the wings which were mediocre, but the fries were terrible. Soggy, as if had sat out prior to being served.

High end quality dining, food, and atmosphere. Seasonal menu and local options. The nitrogen popcorn comes in a multitude of flavors, I have been 3 times and I've had 3 different flavors so the variety is nice. The only place in Greenwood like this. Come in on a Saturday and walk the weekly hot rod show across the street!

I'm giving this place a solid 5 stars. Quirky decor, great menu, full bar. How could you go wrong? Went in for brunch around 10:30am, party of 5, made a reservation as we were there for a birthday. Incredible pineapple mimosas and bloody Mary's with old bay rim, and bacon on the stirrer! LOVE! brunch menu is awesome, I got the breakfast burrito which was simple but exactly what I wanted, we ordered the shrimp and grits, waffle sandwich and 2 orders of one of the specials which was a breakfast casserole. On point! Would definitely recommend. It got busy so you should make a recommendation if you can!

Once again Discount Tire repaired my tire free of charge. They were quick, polite and got the job done. Free coffee and WIFI in a very comfortable air conditioned clean waiting room also made this a good experience.

Tip: one small fry will serve at least 4 hungry kids, no joke!

Sometimes we head to the Five Guys downtown after visiting Curtis Hixon park. They're known for big greasy burgers and huge portions of french fries. I like Five Guys for the variety of toppings, most of them free for your burger.  Otherwise, I don't get all that excited about the burgers.  I think they are just ok. I find it hard to get out of there with 4 people for under $30, and that's only buying one drink and fry. IMO, it's too pricey for an average burger joint.

I love Amy's. I used to live uptown and was a regular client. I now live in Baton Rogue and I get my nails done here as often as I can get by. The location is bright and clean with plenty of chairs. It is busy, so there is still a wait sometimes, but they get you in quick, do a good job, and are friendly. Just remember to bring cash for your tip as you cannot put it on your card.

Franklin Fountain is pretty decent.  It's a charming ice cream parlor-throwback with a nice array of sundaes, shakes, splits and lots of unique flavors (like Maple Walnut and Teaberry Gum) and toppings.  There was literally a line out the door.  The texture of the ice cream is definitely superior to a lot of other places you might go, and the sundae I ordered, the "Southern Sympathizer Sundae (Rum Raisin and Pistachio Ice Cream with Caramel, pecans, pistachios, praline chunks and whipped cream) was put together well and overall pretty good.  But at $9.50, it was overpriced, especially since they only take cash.  The green tea ice cream my sister ordered, while it had the same very nice texture, had a flavor that could only be described as weak, as did the cone it came in.  I didn't like the chocolate egg cream my dad got, but I'm not a fan of egg creams anyway, so I can't really give it a fair assessment.  The seating is very limited to a few small wooden tables outside the place, or a tiny (maybe 3 or 4 people, tops) bar next to the counter.  
     The sundae was ready a good deal longer before the green tea ice cream or egg cream than it should've been.  I guess it wasn't THAT long and I realize they were busy, but this is ice cream we're talking about--that stuff doesn't wait for the order to be finished before it starts to melt.  
     So all things considered, Franklin Fountain is by no means a bad place.  A lot of the stuff they make is quite good.  I think the ice cream is homemade and, except for the weak green tea flavor, is really pretty good.  But is it $9.50-for-one-sundae good?  Not really.

Came here for happy hour with my husband and a friend. We enjoyed the raw oysters and also got the trio. My friend who doesn't like raw oysters liked the charbroiled trio. There was a woman who greeted us at the door and the waiting staff were extremely friendly. My husband ordered the sazarac and he really enjoyed it, it was strong! We would definitely return and recommend this place to a friend!

This cake is the 7inch size golden hazelnut. It is delicious, but I found something shouldn't be in the cake. I don't know what that is. Not like plastic or hair... it is in the middle of the cake. I wish they could be more careful....
ssame as always -- good sandwiches and good soups.

Very pleased.  Good food great service. 

A group of 5 us walked on a very busy night. After going in the wrong entrance we were quickly helped by the staff and were seated almost immediately. Our waitress was very knowledgeable, friendly and fast. Everything we ordered, from teas, to entrees to cocktails was spot on and timely. I must say, the Drunken Muscles special was DELICIOUS (I hope they have it again)!!! 

 The staff was so warm and welcoming, even through the busyness, multiple staff said goodbye and encouraged us to return. 

Overall, I had a great time and being new to Philadelphia, it's nice to know I have a place to go for great tea, good food and a great staff!!!

I am rating this solely on the one thing I like at Jox, which is there 6 pack of hard shelled taco's, which you can get feather (ground beef) or leather (shredded beef). 

I am not a smoker, and just so you know, smoking is allowed in Jox. I usually order the taco's to go with 1 or 2 bonus salsas added. I DIG the super light tomato salsa. 

They have Tu/Thurs special on taco's, which are 75 cents each. They have a W special on the wings, I remember them being really good in the past, but haven't had them recently, but it's on my list to check out the wings again! 

If you are out late night, which I happen to do from time to time, they are 24 hours on the taco specials, so Monday/Wednesday night after midnight, it's ON! 

The taco shells are crunchy and buttery as are the chips they serve with them, there's something truly unique and delicious about these taco's. Also, if you have had a couple drinks, they are extra TASTY!
Consistently undercook both burgers and chicken. Tighten up the grill skills muchachos...

Love the flavor of the patties! The handmade patties are perfect. I love the fries and hope to try all the burgers one day. A big tip is to call and order ahead. The line and wait times can be long, especially on weekends. Happy eating!!!!!

Great atmosphere and helpful staff. Lots of hookah flavors and belly dancing on the weekends. Food is a plus. I recommend the hummus with pita as it is a good snack. Fully stocked bar so you get everything all in one place. Definitely recommend.

Moving from San Diego to NOLA, I have a love for authentic Mexican food. And Juan's is definitely not that. It is fusion Mexican food and I love it! We got the Hawaii 5-0-4 nachos and it was so big my man and I did not need to order more, but we did! We also got the chicken & goat cheese quesadilla w/ cuc salad (tzatziki) which was amazing too. Though I am partial to anything w goat cheese cuz I love it! Good priced beers and good priced food. Will be back to try the black & gold burrito! Yummay!

I have not eaten here, nor would I after trying to sit at a table in the common area outside of this restaurant in downtown Boise. It was 3pm and the only available table with any semblance of shade on this hot afternoon was in the shade of the building this restaurant is in. When my wife and I and our three dogs tried to sit down, an employee came out and told us that the table we were at is this restaurants table, and we had to sit at one in the direct sun. Now let me clarify, there are 6 tables in this common area, and not one was being occupied. There was absolutely NO other business at the time. So, my wife and three dogs had to sit at a table in the sun. Needless to say, this companies actions show they don't care about potential customers, so they have forever lost my business. Unfortunately for them, word of mouth spreads like fire, so I hope they lose more business due to their selfishness. I remember a time when a Boise company wouldn't have subjected a patron to sit in the hot sun, because people and potential customers actually matter more than making sure their table sat empty. Please don't give your time and money to this company.

I usually don't write reviews, but I had to break my silence to give my highest praise to Paul from Arm's for Defense. He is a welcoming owner who genuinely cares about his clients. Paul took the time to educate me and make the buying experience easy and quick. I felt very welcomed and was treated like a member of the family. There is a tremendous value to personal service and focus on details.

Consider me sold. Thank you Paul, and keep the coffee pot on, I will be back soon

I went in for an oil change. They were fast and they also vacuumed, filled my tires, ect. which was nice. However, less than a week later something on the bottom of my car started dragging. They check things on the bottom of your car. Was it something they carelessly did? I don't know, but it seems like it.

Dave is the best! We had been to two other weddings he'd been at, so we knew going in we weren't going to be disappointed... but he exceeded our expectations! Dave met with us in advance to understand our preferences and style without judgment, and he made recommendations where we were unsure of a direction (he has many many recommendations for mother-son dance songs!). It's easy to tell from talking to him that this is a passion of his, and the depth of his music knowledge is impressive.
At the reception itself, Dave kept the more structured parts of the party moving along with great energy (dances, speeches), and then put down the microphone and let the music do the talking for the rest of the evening. I barely can remember all the songs he played, but the dance floor was full all night with guests young and old, which was our main goal! Definitely recommend.

Think it was one of the manager who approached me while waiting for someone help me out. He had this tone as if I was bothering him. I used to like this store but maybe I'll go somewhere else and for that it's a one star.

My husband and I tried to go to this restaurant for dinner. We were turned away by the host who said they had a completely fully restaurant and couldn't seat us. It was at most 2/3 full - counted at least 10 empty tables. Maybe he doesn't understand what completely full means.

I thoroughly enjoyed my experience!  The wait staff was friendly and efficient, without ever making you feel rushed.  I enjoy the warm, classy feel of the dining room.  I tried the Dark and Stormy drink special, it was a great selection.  For an appetizer do not take for granted the Mcilhenny Oysters, you may never find a more perfectly fried oyster anywhere.  It is tender and fried to perfection.  My steak was great quality and cooked to perfection, but what set it apart was having it served Oscar style.  You can never go wrong with asparagus and crab meat.  We had one glitch with an onion soup that tasted way too peppery to eat, the waiter fixed the problem immediately and brought out a replacement dish.  I don't make it DB's often, but this visit was a reminder of why it is one of my favorites.  Great menu, great ambiance, terrific service, well prepared food!
Delicious food, great service, nice atmosphere. Definitely a diamond in the rough location-wise. Overall, very pleased. Recommended!

Really good food, there's a reason Columbia has been around for so long.  The 1909 salad is a Tampa staple, so if you're looking for healthy, start there.  The bread is fresh made and just delicious.  It's busy so be prepared to wait, especially for dinner.  Working lunch is possible, but it will run long.

Jordan gave me gorgeous henna brows! She took the time to consult with me about the shape and color I was seeking. Then, she meticulously shaped and colored my brows and they look gorgeous! Jordan was extremely professional and made sure I was comfortable at every phase of the process. The online booking process was extremely convenient and the atmosphere of the spa was relaxing, super comfy and cute. I'll definitely be back for regular brow maintenance and try other services based on this experience. They know what they're doing here!

Just visited Station 52 today for lunch and was disappointed.  Food was mediocre at best. The nachos were a joke, the salsa is not fresh, all food seems to be frozen and reheated. They display specials on a blackboard as you enter but fail to mention they are only valid at the bar. Found this out once we received the bill. My wife ordered the Greek chicken pita which comes with fries and she asked to have old bay fries instead of standard fries. We get the bill and they charged us for a basket of old bay fries and when questioned why the charge for a basket, they said the Greek Pita came with chips but we didn't even get the chips.  The waitress then says "oh I thought you wanted to sub fries for the chips" then why did we get charged the full amount for the basket of fries, there should have been some discount if it was a sub. The waitress completely forgot my drink refill and brought it out with the check about 10-15 minutes after she took my glass. Overall very bad experience, won't be back.
The service was good. I don't have a complaint whatsoever. Quality of the food was very acceptable at this restaurant.

Super impressed with the food and service.  You would never expect to find such a quaint, authentic and cosy atmosphere in this neighborhood.  The food was incredible. We tried the tilapia and chicken tacos and the flavor was popping.  I love the variety of sauces and the guacamole was chunky and perfect with tomatoes.  We are ordering from them for our Dia de los Muertos party this week since we were so impressed.
This place is nice for a casual bite to eat. I had a burger with pesto, mushrooms, and roma tomatoes. It was good.  The brussel sprouts were delicious but extremely oily. All in all I was pleased.

yes the hurricanes are super sweet but your in new orleans- you gotta have at least one..and this is the place to get them..they have an awesome courtyard with a great fountain where you can people watch..whats not to like.

I haven't had satisfactory Thai in Nashville since Sala Thai closed, and Royal Thai has been the least impressive. The pad thai was gummy and flavorless, except for an unpleasant aftertaste. On the plus side,  I didn't have any of the service issues other folks have talked about here - but admittedly I was the only customer.

Absolutely superb! Service, food, ambiance - this place is an all-around WIN. Our server, Jeff, was wonderful. He was extremely knowledgable about the menu and wine list. He gave us an excellent Pinot Noir recommendation - we ended up ordering a bottle! All of the cocktails are great, but the seasonal summer cocktail is dangerously delicious. Portions are generous and pack a flavorful punch. I've never been disappointed with a trip to Anthony's.

RACIST - I'm never one to pull the race card, but the security and hostess here profiled me as I walked in, told me where I could buy cigarettes, bought them only to find out that the machine was out of order, to which the security talked me like I was an invalid for not seeing the sign. The security guard at the front then yelled at me for not reading it the sign and when I asked why he yelled at me he raised louder, laughed and said "can't you read!?" Nashville - you're cool... but you need to weed out these quality of people. It's mudding up your beautiful city.

A few of us in looking forward to your Wonton Soup & appetizers primarily, after a movie, as we used to do regularly.
The new menu looked great & the place looked clean, but rather empty for a Friday night.
The soup arrived-totally changed! No cilantro, the shrimp were tiny, scarce & fishy, 2 pieces of chicken in there & worst of all the actual broth tasted like boiled water with NO flavoring? We told the waitress & she stated "yes, a bunch of customers have said that also."
So we moved next to the dumplings. Both Shrimp & Pork. The shrimp was  way too spicy. That was never the case in the past. The Pork dumplings were literally cold. We tried the egg rolls & they were so greasy we had to dab them w/ a napkin.
We were going to order an entree but thought better of it, gave up & left. No a word from their manager or waitress to attempt to correct anything.
I called the next day to ask for a Regional or Customer service dept. The 'regional' cannot be called. I was told you have to go through 'guest services' which turned out to be a farce.
They transferred me 2x & had me on hold for over 15 minutes. I then called the ''corporate' number. They told me I had to go through 'guest services.' So I called them again & found out that that # was simply a 3rd. party operator who then transfers you back to, guess who, 'Guest Services.' They are supposed to call back as 'there just aren't many people in that department.'
I give up. Poor food, no one to talk to, & they all seem to care less. Whoever runs this Company needs a lesson on customer care.
What has happened to this Chain? I used to go all the time in many cities. I had a poor experience in Sarasota as well a few months ago. Too many other well run options to ever go back again. What a shame.
Mark my words, these guys are living on their past reputation & can't successfully last with this kind of service & food quality.
The build your own pasta is awesome and delicious. The delivery is really quick and the service is super friendly (which is much appreciated as a Philadelphia non-native). Definitely recommend.

Getting photos done for our family reunion was a painless process thanks to Don at Lux Media.  Thank you so much not only for the beautiful shots, but also for your passion and vision throughout!

Don is so easy to work with, punctual and responsive.  Our crew had a ton of people (including young kids and some adults who don't particularly like getting pictures taken) but his direction and advice led to gorgeous photos across the board.  He was patient and professional, but also made you feel at ease.

Getting the reunion dinner set up was a huge undertaking, so it was definitely a load off to have the pictures go so smoothly.  We really appreciated how communicative he was and the fact that he showed up early was one less thing to worry about!

Very good chips and salsa.  I had the chimichanga which was deliciously cheesy and a friend I went with had three tacos which were also very yummy.  There were a lot of different options to choose from!

Yes, I am a fondue fan!  The Meting Pot in Warrington is my daughter's annual b'day dinner spot, with the occasional visit in between.  The tables are private and the ambience is nice.  They have a pretty decent wine list, which is always a plus for me.  The service has always been consistently good and I have been here at least 3 times per year since they opened.  On my most recent visit, there was a second server, in addition to our waiter, who brought us drinks.  And as always, the manager delivers the check and asks how the experience was.

Now for the food: If you go for the gusto, there are 4 courses to be had (but you don't have to get all 4- it is a lot of food).  First is the cheese. Oh yum, how I love cheese fondue!! There are several flavors to choose from and all are served with unlimited dippers (bread, apples, veggies).  This time we had the cheddar.  The server makes the cheese fondue for you at the table, it usually includes some type of wine or beer with seasonings and a blend of cheeses.  

The second course is salad; there are 4 types to choose from. I had the California salad which was very fresh and tasty and included spring mix, blue cheese, and pecans.  My daughter always gets the caesar with pine nuts; it is her fav.

The third course is the entree.  There are plenty of options, along with 4 styles of cooking broth- beef, chicken, duck, salmon, shrimp, filled pasta, etc.  We shared the salmon and spinach & artichoke ravioli with the classic court bouillon broth. The best part of the entree course is that it comes with unlimited veggies; potatoes, mushrooms & broccoli as well as 6 dipping sauces to mix and match.

The fourth and final course is the chocolate. Again, there are many choices.  We had the yin & yang with dark & milk chocolate (substituted for white chocolate). They also have flaming turtle, s'mores, etc.  The dessert dippers are also unlimited and include strawberries, banana, pineapple, brownies, blondies, rice krispy treats, etc.

They also have special seasonal menus to mix things up. If you tell them you are celebrating something special, you can get a little bauble, such as a candle with your dessert, balloon, etc. It can also be a romantic date spot because they have tables for 2 facing the back wall that are completely private between each table and you cannot see the other diners, nor can they see you.
One final note: If you don't like fondue, or the idea of cooking your own food at the table this is not the place for you!  It really can be a lot of fun though and I recommend giving it a try.  Be sure to make a reservation though.

Clean and great place for date, lunch or even to bring the family. Great indoor and outdoor seating options. Their food is amazing and beers are wonderful. I love that you can see right where most of the beer is made on site. The serving staff is knowledgeable and and great at making suggestions of food and beer pairings. Usually they will allow you to sample beer too at no additional charge if you are not sure of what you want to drink or it's your first time. They have a delicious root beer as well, great for the kiddos or if not drinking alcohol. If you aren't in to beer, don't worry as they have a full bar and can make you just about any drink that you like. 

Their toasted ravs are the best in STL, hands down! A must try. Another under-rated item to try if you aren't sure is the crispy tender wrap with bbq sauce. It goes well with all of their beers this time I had it with the season Chamomile Honey Wheat Beer. 

The brats and nachos are wonderful too, just didn't get this time around. Try them out! You will not be disappointed.
Great location for lunch on Broadway. Excellent service. Club sandwich and salad very good.

We are regular patrons of Tijuana Flats on Causeway in Brandon.  We are always greeted with smiles and even hugs from some of the staff.  There is something to be said to be recognized when you walk into an establishment...  1) you eat there too much...  and 2) you love the service and food so much that you want to come back again and again...  I will say that it is both for us.  

We do enjoy the food and the service that we receive makes it all the more better...  AND we are creatures of habit, so if we receive good service, for a good price and are acknowledged - we will be loyal customers!

Food was decent but not worth the long wait, the incredibly inattentive service, loud atmosphere, or sitting next to a total stranger .  They had no problem getting us the check but was in desperate need of a refill of water which I never got. 
We had chargrilled oysters, étouffée and peace maker. Will not return and would not recommend. Total tourist trap

People are skilled well enough, but I have been charged more than one for their upgraded haircut, which includes the shampoo, massage, etc but never got it nor asked for it. Make sure they ring you up correctly.

I have taken several classes with Christina and worked with her professionally as well. She is an amazing, lively person, as is the rest of the Ploome team. Her workouts are intense and challenging, but just what you need to get you where you want to be. The personal attention I've receive in Christina's studio is unparalleled to any other fitness classes I have taken, and this is due to the loving, inclusive nature of the trainers. I would highly recommend Ploome to anyone who wants a killer workout and an awesome community to do it with.
Very clean office with professional and kind employees. The technician who does my laser is extremely kinda, knowledgeable, and patient with me. Highly recommend!

Great food and amazing staff...don't let the outside scare you off! It's a diamond in the coal mine!

not sure why I even bother going here. 

for years the service at this place is lacking and the parent company should be ashamed to let this location represent their brand

a couple of months ago I thought I would be better if I ordered online and when in the store to pick up reducing the confusion at this troubled location and they could work at their unhurried pace. 

a couple of bagels, sliced in half, and one cinnamon roll. order online, get the email the order is ready, go in the door, typical for the location prior to 8am several workers are talking while one person does the work, wait on line, get to my turn, no one can find the order. I show them the email, "ohh, the kitchen staff marked the order completed for the bakery and did not tell the bakery about the order." So I wait and explain the order 3 more times before it is fulfilled.

today 21 March 2021 I decided to try again, this time no online order so there is not the bakery / kitchen mistake to trip them up. I watch 4 workers stand around talking, one worker is taking care of the couple in front of me. after waiting on line for nearly 12 mins the couple if front of my has their bagel and 4 butters. Finally my chance to order. 4 cinnamon rolls, "we only have two." 

makes sense it is 7:52am on a Sunday morning why would you have more than 2 cinnamon rolls in the entire store. 

me simply: "good bye and have a nice day."

Never again I will enter this location and I certainly will not travel to another. 

I'm sure the business will be fine without me and my money.

Came back to Saigon deli and got the chicken wonton noodle soup and it was so flavorful! Absolutely loved it! The utensils were clean this time which im very happy about. The boba here is literally the BEST IVE EVER HAD! Omg I'm obsessed!  I hate that they close at 5 they need to extend their hours. The food and boba are way too good! I'm a little weird but I went back today and got more boba (of course) and I mixed banana with mango....HONEY! It was phenomenal! Amazing place for authentic Vietnamese food. A MUST try if you haven't been yet!

It all started off when we were seated next to the door to the kitchen even though the resturant was nearly empty.  This was on a Saturday.
We were not able to order from the luncheon special menu since that is only available Monday through Friday.  Downer as far as I'm concerned.  I do not like having to pay dinner prices for lunch entrees.  

The usual salsa and chips were nothing outstanding.  The chips were basically what you'd get from Publix in a bag.  

I tried the Enchiladas Mole.  It came with rice and charro beans.  The rice was done right, the mole sauce was pretty much over-powering and resulted in quite a case of heart burn later, and the charro beans had no flavor that I could detect.  The corn tortillas were paper thin and added nothing to the dish.  The bill of fare for this dish was $8.49

My dining partners split an order of Enchilada Suizas.  Again the tomatillo sauce was over-powering and extremely spicy.  No other sides were included which makes the $9.49 + tax too high.

Wait service was acceptable but nothing special either.

In summary, we won't return.  There is a lot of competition in the Tex-Mex business and frankly this one doesn't measure up to our "Uncle Julio" standard.

Pass this one up and drop into Taco Bell.

I dont know if this is a New Orleans thing that I am just not aware of but this place is unsanitary.

We sat at the bar area right in front of the cooks.

I saw the main cook pick food off of plates before they went out to the customers; i saw him make a burger out of raw ground beef and (without washing his hands) continue to touch peoples food including my own.  Finally, I saw the cook use a dirty rag to clean uncooked meat juices and then use the same rag to wipe off a plate before he used it to make someones food.

Maybe this is a NOLA thing that I am just ignorant to but being a scientist.....it absolutely disgusted me ESPECIALLY THE RAW MEAT PART.

Walked-in around 7pm on a Wednesday night and there was no wait (party of 2) although the place was pretty busy.

The menu is almost set up tapas style, although each dish was slightly larger than what you would expect from tapas.  The waitress suggested 2-3 dishes per person, but I think that would be way too much.

We shared the grilled octopus and a uovo pizza and it was plenty for us.  The octopus was amazing - I couldn't believe it would be that tender (I was expecting calamari consistency.)

We both loved the pizza.  It was really unique, with brussel leaves and a quail egg on top, and tasted great.  It came with a little sprig of dried oregano and some chili infused olive oil which was delicious when drizzled on a slice.  

For dessert we split the budino, which was a pudding with caramel and chocolate and a little sea salt.... I'm not a dessert guy typically, but this was very satisfying.... the little bite of salt at the bottom went so well with the richness of the pudding.  It was around $8 and a great dessert to share.

Service was very polite, helpful and quick.  Total bill with 2 cocktails before tip came to around $60.  If you don't drink, this place is priced extremely reasonably for the quality.  I'm looking forward to trying the other restaurants on 13th street, which are owned by the same 2 chefs.

We had such an enjoyable time here - we sat outside since we had our 6 month old with us on our Father's Day.  We had a not so great experience at Matt Miller's next door and so I requested a do-over.  It was probably a good thing we weren't super hungry since the wait time is a little long here, but we enjoyed high-quality coffees, sparkling water in cute little espresso glasses and when the shakshuka came out, it was plated beautifully with edible flowers included.  My hubby makes a phenomenal shakshuka so it is a huge compliment that he approved of the flavors and presentation.  Ian was so friendly.  The lady that was working was extremely friendly and greeted me with happiness and pep.  Thumbs up for our do-over, all smiles here, food included!

So we ordered food from here a couple of times, i've had food that I haven't liked (that wasn't the fault of them as much as my taste preferences) I would say as a whole though everything has been really good. We had delivered; bacon mac & cheese bites, an extra side of fries, the buffalo chicken wrap, and the blackened chicken quesadillas. 

First, the size of the food is enough for two meals. Price is really good. The fries are delicious. This is even with it being in a Styrofoam box as it was being delivered, they were still crisp and delicious

The bacon mac & cheese bites are a must get every time. Yummy bacon stuffed inside of mac & cheese breaded and deep-fried, I mean could it get any better.

This is a step above regular bar food

First time at Naked Peach, my waxer was super sweet and friendly. However, it wasn't as neat as i'm used to. I'll update my review. But the reason for 3 stars is for the service desk. Not the friendliest greeters. Didn't smile at all. Front desk people, are the face of the company. It also took hours for someone to schedule my appointment. This location doesn't seem to answer the phone and when they do you're on hold for some time. Despite that, I signed up for the their reward program because it's affordable, and I really like the wax specialist personality.
Pizza and salad were very good.However,seating is awkward and crowded.Waiter was terrible.I still recommend the food.

Overly priced. Need to update their thali. 
Advertised as "tiered of eating same food try something new" but thali has paneer tikka masala?
Dal bati was a total disappointment for $14.

We stopped at Fitzs on our way to the Muny.    There was a 30 to 40 minute wait so they gave us a beeper.  
We walked around the loop for a bit and decided to head back before our table was ready.   
Decided to sit at the bar instead.  They had lost of tables - they must have been short wait staff.    
The food was just average at best.   The sodas - of course - were good.    
So stop reading if you have a quezy stomach-----

Someone had vomited in the women's bathroom.   Staff were informed - but they were just to busy to clean it up.  No paper towels in bathroom so we could not even cover it up - ugh....  
I finally got staff to give me some cloth towels which I used to cover up the vomit.    Still no staff to clean up the bathroom.   

I have always liked Fitzs - I sure hope they can figure out the staffing -----

I will typically spend more money buying items from animal related thrift stores than people related ones (sorry... dislike most people but like most animals). I came here for the sole purpose of finding a good enough couch. I bought a cute 1970s, floral couch for $25. One of the workers walking around said I haggle and that I could probably get it down to $20 but given that 100% of the proceeds go to the animals, it wasn't worth haggling. 

Workers were friendly including the female manager. Even though typically only do one day holds, they were flexible with me. They also said if I decided not to get the couch that they would just give me credit for that store (mind you the couch I got had been there awhile and most would consider it ugly and tacky LOL). One, young male worker said that he would unload the couch in my apartment provided I rent a truck. Agreed on $20 but I found people on Craigslist who will do it for less.

-1 for a couple of things. 

The couches are not professionally cleaned. I believe Goodwill and Salvation Army will do this before the items get sold. SPCA inspects the items but they aren't cleaned up (dog hair all over the couch). 

In addition, most thrift stores do have the cards of movers that they have worked with which ends up being cheaper than going with a mover who wasn't recommended by the shop.

Kudos for being close to my house and open a lot. Yep, those are the two stars. Pretty much the greasiest, least fresh (vegetables) Chinese food I've had the displeasure of eating in Indy. I'd rather just eat ramen packets at home. Probably healthier.

My best friend used to work at SB Outfitters and I met him here for lunch a couple of times and I totally dig this place. I've had the burritos and tacos and I have not been disappointed with any of those dishes. What I enjoy about this place is the great flavors from the food without the greasy, heavy feeling after the meal. The food tastes fresh and comes out of the kitchen quickly.

Los Arroyos reminds me of Chipotle but with a more extensive menu. The prices are very fair and the efficiency of how they operate makes this place a great option for people on a short lunch. I dig this location too because is far enough up State Street that it's not too overly crowded but close enough to the action of downtown.

So if you're looking for good quality, good tasting Mexican food for a decent price Los Arroyos is a great choice. If you happen to over eat and the weather is nice, you can walk it off window shopping on State Street.

Seena, Kara & the Posh Kreations team are exceptional! From day 1 of planning up until the wedding day, they were by our side helping us with every small detail, from helping us package welcome bags till 2 am to basically replanning our wedding in a month!!!! Due to COVID, we had to change our church/venue from PHL to NJ a month prior to the wedding, and I honestly can say if it wasn't for Seena/Kara, we wouldn't have been able to do it!!! I had numerous wedding guests and vendors give compliments about Posh and how they are very professional, detail oriented, extremely organized, and just great people to be around! Honestly, Posh Kreations is 10/10 and are a great pleasure to work with! If you're on the fence about having a wedding planner, GO WITH POSH KREATIONS, YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!

In case you missed my review the first time, I highly recommend Cherry Hill Phone Repair for quality work and great customer service. Melvin couldn't have been more thorough or accomodating - and fast!
So happy to have stumbled on this place! Since moving to Delco, I haven't found any take out food that I couldn't make better at home. Real food that tastes damn good!

This has got to be the worst pizza I have ever tasted.  The cheese is not high quality... the toppings aren't fresh.... the sauce tastes like some cheap stuff you would pick up.in Aldis.  Unfortunately, I got really sick soon after. I do not understand how this place is still in business.
Jason Doore was a fantastic salesman - honest, reliable and he answered and addressed all my questions. I buy a new car every year - hands down best experience and salesman I have dealt with!

This is a review for Jack's Cafe and Jack's Cafe #2, since my partner and I ate at both locations on consecutive weekends and had pretty much the same experience -- a good hearty breakfast at reasonable prices. This is your typical all-American breakfast diner that does all the breakfast and lunch basics very well. The menu is pretty extensive with a bent toward some Mexican-style foods. Fajitas came super hot off the grill with a ton of grilled peppers, onions and spicy grilled chicken with delicious beans and rice. Huervos rancheros is excellent. Omelettes are big and hearty. Service is attentive. Coffee is nothing special, but what coffee shop java is? 

I will definitely eat here and again and it may be my new favorite breakfast spot. It's worth a short drive from a nearby downtown or Sparks hotel with expensive breakfasts or crappy continental breakfasts.

Halima has been around since the beginning of time... I can remember coming here as a kid with my Dad on Saturday mornings to get the car washed. He would always tell me to stay in the yellow box right outside the door as we waited for them to finish the cars, and of course, I would always tempt fate and barely step over the line, finding myself instantly punished. Now, my 3 year old does the exact same thing in the exact same box... sorry, I guess that has not a thing to do with helping you decide if this place is good or not... 

On to that... they have a great car wash staff and I find that they are priced better than other full service car washes in the area, and their guys seem to be a little more consistent in paying attention to details. My car always comes out sparkling. Another great aspect is that they often times have deals on Groupon and here on Yelp.... the last time I went, I got $2 off for checking in on Yelp and a few weeks before that I bought some Groupons for $12 for a Deluxe wash... great deal. 

BOTTOM LINE: Best place in the area for a full service wash. A+
Really nice people. Spent time explaining to me how I could work in leash walking with my new rescue cat. Good selection of toys, food, and other bits and bobs. Skip the big box pet stores!
One word Amazing! The food was delicious, the decor beautiful and our server Luis was exceptional. Thank you Luis for the great service.

I'm currently a nursing mother of a six week old. I have a difficult to fit chest to start with, (small rib cage/large breasts) but add breastfeeding into the mix and it's crazy! I was desperate for a bra that really fit and didn't give me uniboob or leave me sagging. I made the trip to The Fitting Touch specifically from Murfreesboro to see if they could help. I was not disappointed. The space is nicely furnished and feels comfortable for all ages. The consultation was professional and quick without feeling rushed. I left with a bra that lifted, supported, felt comfortable and was made for nursing. Anyone with a hard to fit chest knows what a tall order that is! I was pleasantly surprised to find that, while not cheap, the bra was not as expensive as I expected from a nice specialty shop. This will now be my go to spot to get bras.
If I could eat here every day, I would. Tacos are my favorite food on the planet and Tacos Apson has the BEST in Tucson, maybe the world.

We used Lenora last December. Our belongings had to be stored overnight and unloaded the next day. 
Lenora came in with the lowest bid, so we hired them. 
Here is my dilemma. The movers were excellent! They worked hard and were impressively fast. However, they were 3 hours late to load and 2 hours early to unload (we were still closing on our new place when the truck arrived and the clock started ticking)
Additionally, the company assured us that they take Major Credit Cards as a form of payment. Unfortunately their story changed when they loaded the truck. 
If you every purchased a house before, you would understand that looking for an extra 1K in cash on your closing day in not what one would call "stress free". 
Bottom line: I would recommend Lenora if you are paying cash ONLY. 
Unfortunately I will have to give 1 star, since I did not receive the service that I was promised and I will not use this moving company again for that only reason. 
Sorry, Lenora. You lost me as a customer.

For 3 states, 2 airports I've been searching for the perfect beer and burger combo. My search has finally come to an end. I can not rave enough about this combo. The burger was tastefully flame broiled with the perfect thickness of smokey bacon. At last my inner fat guy is happy. Please take the time to stop by and satisfy your inner fat guy

Yikes. 

I should have canceled my order when I heard the cashier make a snarky comment to another customer regarding the customers name being "Ruthy". The cashier thought it was okay to make a drug, "roofie" reference to the customer. Super yikes! 

Anyway, my review isn't just regarding the cringe-worthy and horrendously slow service. I had a very simple order and was in a hurry when I walked in. I came at an off time, around 2:30pm, and thought that it would be quick since I ordered my food to-go. Boy, was I wrong. I ordered a Garden Fresh Turkey sandwich without avocado and a side of cucumber & tomato salad. Ladies and gentleman, it took them 20 minutes to throw together my simple, cold sandwich and side. The sandwich was fine; it lacked more turkey, spinach, tomatoes... it needed more of everything. I didn't try the cucumber and tomato side, it looked unappetizing, as though it had been made a few days before. The sandwich wasn't worth the money or the wait. 

I'm very disappointed that this was my first impression of McAlister's Deli. I doubt I will ever try another location.

The most gorgeous meals in Arizona. We never pass through Tucson without stopping by. Not only is the food fresh, delicious and inspired, the people are kind and generous. Thank you from the bottom of our happy hearts and bellies.

I HIGHLY recommend this place. I went in with a slow leak / nail in my tire. They did everything they could to try to fix it and make it as low cost for me as possible. Unfortunately, because of something out of their control, it was unfixable. They explained everything to me in great detail and were open and honest about the entire process. After this, they still worked with me to find the best/most affordable option for my car. I was very appreciative of their help and would definitely recommend their service to anyone.
Excellent steak tacos has a very warm atmosphere and the cook and server were very polite and friendly if you're looking for authentic Mexican food this is the place to go!!

You must try this incredible Santa Barbara Italian restaurant located directly across from the ocean! We have been coming to Toma since it opened in 2013 and like so many others, we a part of Tom and Vicki's Toma Family! The tuna cones are delicious, fresh, and unique with flavorful notes of honey, sesame and ginger. The arugula salad is perfectly composed as is the gorgeous hamachi crudo. Other fantastic appetizers are the grilled octopus, zucchini blossoms (seasonal) and the steamed clams with chorizo. We love the lasagne and the black spaghetti on the pasta course and they definitely serve the best cioppino in town (lots of clams, mussels, fresh fish, scallops, octopus and more in a luscious tomato broth). Desserts are all great but the strawberry filo parfait is particularly excellent. A full bar, great wine list, and coffe drinks make this a perfect place to eat!

Got my nails done here for my sisters wedding. They look terrible! I got a full set of acrylic, with a gel top coat that I didn't ask for. (Extra $10, by the way, thanks for mentioning) there are bubbles in the acrylic on almost every nail, they are terribly shaped, and they put so much gel top coat on that its pooling in the sides of my nail beds. Unfortunately, it is poorly lit in there, and I couldn't see just how bad the bubbling was until I left. Wish I hadn't paid. Pedicure was fine, nothing special. Way overpriced!

There have been battles and brawls won and lost over which house of Cheese Steak is best in Philly. After watching a recent Anthony Bourdain show which featured the two Philly Cheese Steak giants, I knew I wanted to come see the battle myself. On my most recent weekend trip to Philly, my friends and I drove over to partake in some cheese steak tasting.

If you're in the vicinity of these two Cheese Steak palaces, all you have to do is sniff the air to know you're nearby. The smell of cheese, onions, steak, and oil is very distinct. You might even feel your mouth start to water. Since this is Pat's, you don't have the neon lights blazing in your face. The way the menu is set up, you need to glance at the big words on the wall... pick your stuff and quickly order once you're at the window. Pat's basically puts up a "how to order" guide and makes it quite easy for you to put together your options... wit (out) onions... then wit what cheese, pay and then wait for like a few seconds before your sandwich quickly appears. Pat's is no joke, they have this cheese steak making process down to a science. 

I feel like this type of food is best reserved for eating after a night of boozing. However, if you are like me, and want to see which is the better of the two, I prefer Pat's for sure. My friends Kelly C., her bf and I each shared cheese steaks from both places so that we could have a comparison... hands down we all love Pat's and believe his is the king of steaks! I don't think it's the best in the whole world.. but for the Pat's vs. Geno's  battle, come see for yourself firsthand, but we stand by Pat's.
Best summer party for the kids in the area with Eric Geeb, Jeremiah Nix and Jake Nelson leading the management team. We are lucky to have such a wonderful club in Goleta.
Hidden gem! Bagel was delicious and I can't wait to try their coffee & other sweets next time! Just a small spot, but they do have some outdoor seating!

If you're going for breakfast or lunch this is a great place. The server Whitney was quick and attentive and and gave excellent recommendations. The crawfish Benedict that she recommended was the best breakfast I've had in a few years. Also the crawfish omelette my wife had was made to perfection. This place definitely knows how to make an exceptional breakfast.

My family and I LOVE this location so much- the service and food are absolutely wonderful. We have been here twice in the past month for brunch and it was such a treat both times. Previously, we also enjoyed a few amazing dinners while delighting in the live music! The patio is the place to be- we have such a good time. The servers are always so welcoming, comfortable, and willing to do anything to make our experience even better. THE FOOD IS DELICIOUS! I have loved everything we have ever ordered. Today we savored in the basil and eggs and French toast!  So good and beautifully put together. The eggs New Orleans is probably my favorite. The chef even personally came to our table to ask if everything was meeting our expectations. When spending our hard earned money on going out to eat, these small things are so appreciated. I will continue to come here and recommend to all my friends and family! Thank you, Sasha's!

Happen to try out this great new addition to food/drink scene in rejuvenated Rivertown area on Steak special night. Pleasantly surprised at quality of food and service. Sat at bar as they were busy, great service by Kate. What a bartending find. Good restaurant with great southern ambiance!!!!!! Will come back again when we return.

Once upon a time Datz was the end-all/be-all of indie eateries in Tampa, then somewhere along the line their success got the better of them and their service went down while their prices went up. Datz quickly went from a date-night dining destination for my wife and I to some place we rarely could justify the drive to south Tampa for... I'm happy to report that this has changed and Datz has one again found their mojo it seems. On our last several visits the staff has been exemplary and perhaps more importantly attentive and timely. The food here is always excellent, truly crafted, prepared and plated in such a way that's innovative and as culinarily creative and enticing as it is visually appealing. The craft beer selection is top-notch, offering perfect pairings for any meal; morning, noon or night...well perhaps not morning. Offering a diverse menu everything we've tried has been excellent but I must admit Datz's monkey bread in the morning is a guilty pleasure any carbohydrate connoisseur should experience at least one morning...but get there early because daily baked quantities are limited and on a busy weekend morning they often run out by the time the brunch crowd rolls in. All in all, a new Tampa icon that has seemingly found it's grove again and balanced their growth, success and expansion with what first made them a hit among the local foodie scene. Well reviewed and strongly suggested for your dining dollars.

Our hotel bartender recommended this place in Clearwater Beach so we decided to check it out. It's about 2 blocks off the beach. Seems like a place where the locals would go, rather than lots of tourists - which we liked. Lots of cool memorabilia on the walls. My husband ordered the seafood platter and I had the shrimp and scallop pasta. Both were REALLY good. The prices seemed a LITTLE on the high side, but you definitely got what you paid for. The portions were pretty large! I don't know if I would go out of my way to eat here again, but I wouldn't pass it up if I was in the area.

Was decent. Nothing mind blowing good. They brought out blueberry muffins as a free appetizer. That was cool as they were pretty good. 

I had the corn beef hash Benedict which was good although I don't think the value matched the quality. For that price $16.95 you could get a huge meal in San Diego at hash house a go go and to be honest the rent to run both businesses is probably the same so no excuses in my book. I thought the meal was worth $12.95 at best.

Kayla was a top notch server. 

This review is based off the food and prices.
Food was great, big portions.  Servers were all friendly and hustling.  Had the blue willow special - yum!  Baked goods were tasty, got a few cookies to go.  A great local breakfast spot.

I remember, as a kid, going to Lucky Wishbone on special days, like 4th of July. It was considered a real treat to go there. Our mom would order the fried chicken and we'd go out to a park, have a picnic and then watch fireworks. So, needless to say, I have really fond memories of Lucky Wishbone. And, still, to this day, they don't disappoint me.  First off, I love local businesses that have stayed around and survived the ups and downs of our Old Pueblo. This particular location is quick. Great fried chicken. If you've been to KFC lately, Lucky Wishbone wins, hands down. I have no idea what KFC is doing to their chicken, but when the skin slides off the chicken under its own power, that's scary.
