The chicken fingers tend to be a little dry, but the steak fingers and shrimp are good. If you want to freak out someone who's never been, make sure to get some gizzards and livers and tell them it's some kind of popcorn chicken. Who know, you might just create a fan!  I know, there's a special place in hell for people like me.  Don't forget the garlic Texas toast, coleslaw and onion rings! Prices have definitely gone up since I was a kid. But if it helps them stay open in Tucson and keep sponsoring little league teams, so much the better. You know, in all my years in Tucson, I've never had a burger from Lucky Wishbone. Hmmm, since it's lunch time, might be time to try one.

In mid-February 2020, my husband and I went to Forsythia for the first time and had one of the best meals of our lives. We ordered the roast chicken, hen of the woods mushrooms, and several other scrumptious, small plates. Forsythia soared to the top of our favorite restaurant list (quite the feat in Philadelphia's food scene). But before we could patronize them again...the pandemic hit. And our restaurant visits screeched to a halt.

Fast-forward one year to Valentine's Day 2021. Forsythia was our first choice for the special dinner and we were excited to see that it was available for delivery through UberEats. We ordered our meal four days in advance, and then, thirty minutes before it was due to arrive, we received a notification from UberEats that our order had been canceled. Disappointed, we phoned Forsythia and explained the situation, hoping that we could order from them directly. We learned that Forsythia had blocked UberEats orders for the holiday, but somehow, ours had slipped through the cracks. 

The employee we spoke to was beyond kind, going so far as to offer us a takeout meal, free of charge. Upon arrival, we found a Valentine's themed four course dinner, complete with wine pairing and beautiful packaging. They refused to accept payment or even gratuity.

This restaurant goes above and beyond in both product and customer care.

We cannot wait to support this fabulous restaurant again in person--hopefully very soon!

You know a place is good when you go there two days in a row. Huge burritos, solid fish tacos, amazing crawfish queso dip, and cupcakes for dessert! Very solid lunch spot; expect to pay close to $13 though.

I've have been in this boutique many times and have purchased a variety of wigs.  I've always been very, very happy with the whole experience.  The ladies take their time with me, let me try on all sorts of styles and colours until I'm completely happy.  The prices are very reasonable and the quality of the wigs is fabulous.  I've often been asked, "Where do you get your hair done?"!!  I would highly recommend the Wig Boutique for anyone looking for a good quality wig.

5 STARS is for the workers!! They are always super sweet and do a great job. I've never had anything come to me done incorrectly.  They keep the store clean, donuts made freshly daily, coffees and mixed coffee/ice cream drinks are very good. The people who work there are well deserving of 5 STARS

HOWEVER...ONE STAR is for the owner who doesn't do anything special for his community who buys from him daily. Examples: the owner will not help support teacher appreciation for the school where my son attends. I've never had a business be so rude about it either. I've never seen other specials for say Veterans either. Maybe I just missed that one the last 10 years that I've lived here.  I'm sure the owner is a great person but business wise not the greatest and supporting his community. 

Back to the store and employees!  As I mentioned above they are courteous and very helpful. Clean store! Centrally located in Oldsmar. Near our house so convienent. We go there a few times a year now, we used to go a couple times a month. Everything is fresh! The ice cream is always so good too. 

Good place to stop quickly for ice cream, coffee, and other lighter quick bite kinda stuff.

I've worn glasses for almost 40 years, and this was the single worst experience I've ever had with an eyeglasses vendor. I had purchased Lindberg frames elsewhere, though they are (were?) sold here (the model I wanted wasn't available at this location). Innervision agreed to put the lenses in for me, at a cost exceeding $500 (I have very bad eyes and also need bifocals). When I went to pick them up, getting help from the staff was a challenge. Perhaps they thought I was there to sweep the floor; they acted that way. When the employee came to the counter with my glasses, she gave them to me to put on. And that was it. No attempt was made to see if the glasses fit my face, or if the focal center was aligned properly. The glasses were, in fact, so lopsided that as I was walking out of the store I noticed them in a mirror and had to ask for an adjustment. You would have thought I had asked for a pole dance. Moreover, the focal center was off. After weeks of enduring headaches, I simply put them aside. Innervision wasn't worth the psychological or physical effort of a return visit.

I had my Brazilian Butt Lift in April & I'm in love with it and I send all my friend here, the staff is very friendly and professional also has great bed side manor. If your planning on doing anything lipo surgery this is the place to go! I just started doing VeleShape here and can't wait to see how my treatments go.
Fresh and unique a true dining experience.  Fresh and excellent choices served with Top Tier Beers.  Love the Dutch and I try to visit often, but it is never enough.

So yummy!! Definitely recommend the s'mores cookie dough. I guess some will find it pricey, (we paid $5 for one scoop with no topping) but I would pay that much for a cup of coffee, so for us that's no problem. Hubby and I split the scoop and it was plenty for us. The ladies working were very friendly, and I would definitely come back here next time we're in Nashville.

Alright!! Super stoked on the new truck I'm purchasing from Nissan. I came in and had 3 sales associates try and help me find something that fits me. I sat down with Christy! She was super knowledgeable and very kind. She was funny too. I didn't feel pressured to buy anything like the other places I went. I will be buying a Titan this month! Thank you so much guys!! Team Nissan Rocks

Mediocre at best.  Now that the bar is open that is a plus because the bartenders were excellent previous to covid. Oysters from CA are decent but too pricey.  The rest of the menu is oh so tired.  Shrimp are ok.  Twisted Tail on 2nd near South is so much better for food.

Very positive experience working with Bob. We bought a home and needed to replace existing (awful) window treatments. We have west facing windows with a big solar load. Bob listened to us and helped us find what we wanted. He did a great job installing the new window treatments. I have no hesitation in giving him a five star review.

Having fallen in love with Thai food in Germany at an authentic Thai restaurant we never thought we'd be able to find a place like it. We searched the Tampa area for some great Thai food and never found that style we were looking for. Spicy Thai is delicious and flavorful. They have GREAT service, eager to please, and are always so sweet. They remember their customers and value your business and it shows. The Tom kah gai is VERY fresh and although the broth is thinner than I prefer it NEVER fails to hit the spot! We're not big on eating out but found ourselves eating here at least once a week for a very long time when we moved here, now it's a treat when we do come. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed!

Almost a year later, we've moved 45 minutes away, and we still love Cubby's. We take Ruby there as much as possible, the staff is still wonderful and fantastic. They're the gold standard for doggie daycares! Thanks, Cubby's!

I've eaten here before and it's been okay, but they must have gotten an all new staff because the meal I just had was amazing. Though the parking lot and tables were all full, they had a hostess working to seat people quickly. We didn't wait more than 5 minutes for a table, even with 3 groups ahead of us. Our server was great & the food was delicious. We had bacon, egg, and cheese biscuits with hash browns.

I ordered 2 pizzas online and one of them was wrong when it arrived.  We called and we're told that they had seen issues like this before with their online system but there was nothing they could do.  We asked for a manager and she told us that if we ordered the pizza online,  there was nothing they could do for us and we'd have to order a new pizza and pay for it again.  It's not like I used some other website to order, I clicked on the link on their website. As much as enjoy the food,  I will not be ordering from Imo's again anytime soon. Very disappointed.

Stopped in just because it was in the Target parking lot but loved that I did! 

Excellent happy hour selections for drinks and apps. Only bad thing was not enough healthy options on the HH menu. 

Ordered Jameson in the rocks and got 2 decent pours. Pretty rad for a corporate restaurant 

Ate the Ahi Salad. It was really good. Even had wasabi on the side. 

Service was excellent. Josh and Alex were the bartenders taking care of me and they were friendly and attentive and helped me make some serious decisions  

Best thing was all Gluten-free options were noted with a symbol and their menu was expansive so that was a HUGE plus. 

Would definitely come back! Although I wish I wasn't tryibg to be healthier and could've tried their boneless wings!

First time coming here today and everything was great! It is a typical diner setting where it's older style with close tables. The staff was super friendly and attentive! Excellent customer service! The manager came by and greeted tables to make sure everything was good. 
The food was so good and the portion sizes are huge! I split the monte cristo and you dip it in this incredible tasting raspberry sauce! A lot of excess breading but it tasted great and came with a side. 
Next time I must try the chicken and waffles and the cinnamon roll pancake!

I've been coming here for years. Very friendly family owned staff. The owners will do anything for the customers and it's a great example of a small business catering to its customers. The food is fresh and prepared on site. The firfir is delicious. Support local businesses in philly!

Went in for the first time today.  Had the Western Burger and the Chicken Caesar.   Salad.  Burger-Delicious!  Perfect and Yummy!  Chicken Caesar was the problem.  The Chicken wasn't cooked all the way.  Didn't notice at first so I ate a bit of the greens but then found the under cooked chicken.  At the same time I noticed mine, a customer sitting near me mentioned to the waitress that his chicken was under cooked.  The waitress offered him something else, to which he replied no thank you.  She ended up bringing him a cookie on the house and then handing him a bill.  I assume she charged him for the salad.

 Back to me, I told the waitress about the chicken and she offered me something else also.  At this point I was a little scared that I may have eaten some of the chicken.  My dining companion said that maybe we should try a cup of soup,  She brought us the soup as well as a piece of chocolate cake for us to take home.  Then the bill...YEP, charged full price for the salad.  I was confused but didn't want to cause a problem, so I reluctantly paid for it. I guess the cup of soup and the cake were to make up for the almost 10.00 salad.  

It's sad cause I really liked the burger.....

I've eaten here with my family 3 times, usually when we're in the area for soccer games, and the food has been consistent and delicious each of the 3 times we've visited. They offer a wide variety of ramen and plate meals, and the food is delivered quickly. The Mochi Ko (mochiko) chicken is spot on flavor-wise and is very reminiscent of how my mom used to make it when I was growing up. Japanese fried rice had a nice char (fried) taste to it along with bits and pieces of tender charsiu and fish cake - a must try imo if you like fried rice. Both ramens that we ordered were rich and flavorful with noodles that were al dente, as they should be. The charsiu though!....fatty, tender, melt in your mouth yumminess. If you're like me and love that sort of thing, and on BP meds, then you will absolutely love their charsiu in the ramen. Great variety, great food, happy palettes!
Awesome fresh Mexican, super delicious. No inside seating at this time, but totally worth the takeout out

Wish they had highlighted the fact that you can't order Milky Sichuan Spicy Hotpot when you want to dine in. I just don't get such a practice. Not everyone wants to do hotpot. 

It's also baffling why you couldn't order steamed beef dumplings from the entree section without doing hot pot. The waitress told us we have to order hot pot soup base in order to order that dumpling. But why would anyone drop steamed dumplings (xiao long bao) into soup? Even their menu shows the dumplings in a regular steamed basket. 

We were on a tight schedule today so we ordered two rice dishes and Woodear mushroom salad. The woodear mushroom salad is very good, well worth the money. However the rice dish doesn't look like what's on the picture--instead of thin slices of beef, you get ground beef; it didn't taste bad, but not sure if it's worth $17 each. 

Service is attentive and friendly. May come back again to try the hot pot.

What a fantastic breakfast spot!!

My husband and I had only a short weekend to visit Nashville for a Blues vs. Predators game and I'd read Pancake Pantry was a spot to hit. 

As we drove up for breakfast on Saturday, we were a bit intimidated by the line outside. It didn't quite wrap around the building, but it was enough to make us think we would have to try it another time. I asked a gentleman in front of us if the line tends to move quickly and he assured me it did. He wasn't wrong! After only about 20 minutes, we were seated and drink orders were promptly taken. 

I had the chocolate sin, and it surely shouldn't be allowed as a breakfast meal! The tastiest, fluffiest crepes I've ever had covered in chocolate ganache and raspberries. Sinful it was. 

My husband had the Georgia Peach pancakes which did not disappoint. The ingredients tasted extremely fresh and the portion sizes were plenty. 

My only complaint is that the price is a little steep. We ended up getting 2 plates of pancakes/crepes, a small side of bacon and 1 orange juice and it came to just under $30 w/ tip. It was worth it, but I definitely wouldn't be able to make this place a habit. 

Of course, it didn't stop us from doing breakfast there on Sunday, too. :-) My husband is boring and stuck with what he knew, but I couldn't help but try the regular potato pancakes. Oh. My! SOOOO wonderful. The batter was flavorful without being too overwhelming and it's served with applesauce, butter, and sour cream. I'm a sucker for the potato/applesauce combo and it was incredible. 

I'd definitely suggest this place for an out of towner, but I'd be sure to warn them about the line (though it usually only takes 20-45 minutes) and the prices.

Went last night to celebrate 2 birthdays. Council Oak was the choice of one of the birthday people. I had never been there but expected good things. My daughter and I had been to the steakhouse at the Hard Rock in Las Vegas a few weeks ago and loved it. 

We had reservations and were seated immediately. Let me just say now that service is very very good. The hostess was attentive and efficient. They also have several people at the front, so people are not kept waiting. Server was efficient and attentive without being overly so.

Portions are HUGE, so be prepared. It reminds me of The Palm in that sides really are for sharing. 

Each dish was superb. Onion soup had plenty of onions in it, the escargot were plump and beautifully seasoned. My diver scallops were perfect. 

Several of us had the lamb chops. They were excellent. Cooked perfectly. I wanted a little more seasoning, but the flavor of that aged meat with the charcoal grilling was all it needed. Our other people had lobster and King crab. Both said their meals were great. Council Oak sells their meats to the public. Believe me, I'll be going back just to buy the raw lamb chops. All the meat is Prime and dry aged. You can see it on display, aging.

Dessert was some beautiful and tasty chocolate cake. All in all, it was an excellent dinner in nice surroundings. 

One of the other service staff has a more than passing resemblance to Chef Marcus Samuelsson. In talking to him, it turns out he is also from Ethiopia. The kitchen was immaculate. It reminded me of  "Hell's Kitchen" kitchen.  Decor is sleek and cozy contemporary. Sincerely, the restaurant reminds me a lot of Las Vegas.

Definitely worth a visit for a wonderful meal. Yes, it is pricy, but you really get 2 servings (more with the sides), so with some planning it doesnt have to break the bank.
This is one of the best hamburgers I have ever eaten. If you are in the NashVegas area you have to check this place out. Great atmosphere and phenomenal burgers.

I'm in town for a doctor's appointment & I had to drop by because it was super close.  This is a tiny sandwich shop in downtown St. Petersburg. It's very cozy & just be forewarned I came here on a Monday afternoon - there's going to be a wait - trust me it's worth it.  I came in & the seating was full so I got my sandwich to go. 

I wanted to play it safe & I got the Italian - Chef's choice of meat, roasted red peppers, fresh mozzarella & vinaigrette. ($10) I also got a Diet Coke - it was about $12 for the meal.  This was the best sandwich I've had in years. It's served on this crusty buttery ciabatta bread & its a warm & inviting. I was going to go & sit by the accident water & enjoy the weather - but I couldn't wait, I ate it in my car!! 

The portions are huge, I could not finish an entire sandwich - but that's ok, I'm going to devour the rest later on my way home. 

I'm pretty sure the owner, Matt made the sandwich for me.  May the rest of your life be magnificent, my man - you are an artist.  

I can't wait to tell my husband about this place, he occasionally travels to St.Pete for work & he would absolutely love the food.

My friends and I love this bar. The bartender, Nate, is amazing and makes the best cocktails. To the guy that gave it one star review and critiqued this bartender and the staff- I was there that night. This large group was rude and obnoxious and making other patrons feel uncomfortable. The staff was in fact following COVID protocol. There were tables available outside.  I can't wait to go back

I love the children's museum. It was very fun going there. Everyone that went with us had an amazing time too. We have gone there many times. Everyone loves it. The adults and the kids can have fun there. If you want family bonding time, then this is where you should go. Children love using their imagination here. Every time we go here we always select a date to come back again. We can't wait for quarantine to be over so that we can go back!

Great beer selection if you're in the neighborhood with a healthy wad of cash in your pocket and some beer knowledge in your nogginn or penchant for barley bev exploration. Yes this place is expensive and you do not really know the overall damage until you check out (beer prices not displayed). If you are trying a new beer don't be surprised to have it ring up over $5 and the total causing you to pull out two Jacksons. That being said, it is one of the few places I've seen carrying Hitachino Red Rice.  So good.
Great flavors and if you are lucky enough to get magie you'll love it, always a wait but can't beat the omelette sand try the fresh fruit amazing
Love love love it!! Yummy every time. And the staff is super nice. I get the nachos every time and have never been disappointed.

God was very good. We had chicken, beef and lamb Gyros and all treated great. Was a little surprised to see 4 tables dirty with dishes that appeared to be there quite some time judging by how old the veggies still looked on the plate. All and on good was good service was average building clean just lack of cleaning of tables astound the whole resteraunt.

My friend and I went for massages today. We both felt it was one of the best massages we have ever gotten. This is saying a lot since we are from Chicago and have gone to several upscale high end day spas! This is a hidden gem! Don't be fooled by the exterior of the strip mall. The inside of the day spa is serene, relaxing and very clean. The staff is top notch and so very personable. I highly recommend going there!

The cheesesteaks were pretty good, I'm from Brooklyn but idk if I'd drive down here a gain just for the food lol.the pcs was good especially with the cheese wiz but the sub was a little small , I prob could've ate another! All in all a fun experience but u could find just as good phillysteaks here in Brooklyn lol and the guys who worked there were pretty awesome , they let us skip line when I wanted to take a couple more heroes home for the family

There are a few times in life when a meal is so expertly crafted and planned that it is nothing short of genius.

Unfortunately, you won't find any of that here. Having only 30 minutes for lunch, I placed an order online, got a confirmation number on the website, got an e-mail confirming my order, and my card was charged. However, when I showed up at the restaurant, no one knew anything about my order, and I was met with nothing but excuses, from several people, about how the online order system doesn't work well for their store, the order never came through to the kitchen, etc. No one ever even asked what I ordered so they could try to get it made in time for me to get back to work. With 15 of my 30 minutes for lunch gone, I couldn't afford to wait for them to fix their mistake, even if the staff had been interested in doing so - and they clearly weren't.

I called the corporate number, and they said all the right things. But 10 days later, I'm still waiting for my money to be refunded for an order that I never received. If I could give this dump zero stars, I would. Take your business elsewhere.

NO HAPPINESS         
The local news station published this new website  www.eatsafe.la.gov
They said this restaurant was the worst.  Dirty, understatement.
Now see how you feel about eating there. Rat sake anyone? I'm done.
 OMG - Miss Peggy, did you focus only on the decor?

Courtyard seating! My family loves to get together at this place. I've never been when it wasn't super crowded which could be a bad thing but the servers are always fast and very attentive. I recently went for brunch and sat in the redone courtyard area and it was fabulous. They have big TVs outside so the husbands were very happy about not missing the game. The bloody Mary's here are not to be missed! Make sure you fill up on some of there oysters and bloody Mary's and you will be a happy happy customer!
Great place for a relaxing evening. They have it all great food and weather permitting outdoor seating... Tom S.

I stopped in with my girlfriend and kids for lunch. We all decided to try a little bit of everything.

Calamari: Cooked week and tasted pretty good. No complaints at all. 

Garlic Bread: great garlic taste and lots of cheese! This was instantly devoured.

Margarita Pizza: I believe the fresh tomatoes baked under the cheese made it a bit watery. Over all, it was ok. Nothing to rave about.

Chicken Parmigiana: the chicken was tough. I could be wrong, but I feel as if it was previously cooked and then reheated. Not a fan. I tried eating as much as I could because it was pricey, but it wasn't good.

Chicken Alfredo: My son says "It don't taste very good. The sauces wasn't creamy, it was just stuck to the noodles. The chicken tasted like it came out of a bag". 

The service was good. The waitress was friendly and she did discount our bill (without us asking) which was very appreciated. 

I really hope we just happen to have the misfortune of going on an off day. Unfortunately, we won't be giving it a second chance any time soon.

Server...awesome!  Food...not so much!  

I was so looking forward to eating here but once I stepped through the door I was not impressed.  I expected so much more from the reviews I read.

Stuffed meatballs were not stuffed.  Sweet chili garlic wings had no garlic flavor.  And the bacon in the French onion soup which is one of my husband's favorite dishes fell flat.

If you want to place to get a good drink and mediocre food be my guest.

This review is from only one visit, and for one food item.  We were there as a group of 5 for lunch on 01-02-2015.  The service was excellent and my Prime Fries were way above average.

I'd absolutely eat here again, but it's located downtown.  Yeah, I'm now a transplanted Tucsonan, so I expect to be able to park 6 inches from my table.  Maybe I can get the spouse to drop me off while he parks the limo

This company is giving me fits! I had my ac serviced in May of this year 2017. Since then World Class Heating & Cooling has called me 8 times to let me know "I can have my AC serviced since they are in the area"! Really? it hasn't been more than 2 months since my last service on my 5 year old AC, and I need you again? WTF stop calling me!
Joe Nahon saint Petersburg, FLA. And again I see no rating less than 1 star!
The Lechon Platos is some of the best pork I've ever had! Can't wait to go back and try more of the menu

I stopped in one day after work looking for some broccoli, on sale that week. At first, I thought the layout was kind of confusing because it's a bit different from most ShopRites I've been to. I'm used to walking in right where produce is, but the door I walked into was somewhere else entirely.

Eventually, I made my way to the produce department all the way on the other side of the store, only to find that the broccoli I was looking for was out of stock. Although that was a disappointment, the staff member who was there stocking things was so friendly about it, even showing me an alternative to the broccoli I was looking for.

I didn't end up buying anything this trip, and I may not be back frequently since it's not that convenient of a location, but I did very much appreciate that staff member's friendliness and helpfulness!

Bettie Page is an adorable store with friendly staff and lovely frocks. However, they advertise on the storefront that they go up to a 4X. A 4X in this store is a regular store's XL. It's disheartening and deceiving. If they fix the size situation, I think it will be a great store...for small girls.

I first started going to C'est Moi as a teenager. I've always felt that they do good hair, but Saturday's there were impossible! I ended up going to another salon for a few years but now that I am back I see that they have made great improvements. I went on a Wednesday and even though I was late (sorry ) due to parking, I got in my stylist's chair immediately. The entire process only took 2 hours which is great compared to many other salons. My hair looked wonderful and lasted a long time.
I thought they were playing a bad joke on me, bringing me a miniature meal, never saw such small portions

LOVE having this place only a couple blocks from my apartment. Come weekend time, it is not easy finding a quality sandwich at a reasonable price. 

This location has a friendly staff that crafts together some nice sandwiches. I have gone with the reuben which could have used more russian but not the end of the world. The turkey club is my usual go to; stacked high with crispy bacon and avocado. I find it odd they only cut it into 1/2's and it is served with red white and blue tortilla chips but hey when I'm running my own joint I will say otherwise.

Just browsing through their space which is well spaced out makes me realize how valuable a place like this is to have to pick up that quick item without going to the supermarket. It looks like the crowd has spoken with their 4.5 stars already, long live Palm!

We overshot the turn into the hotel from the main drag, but rather than having to drive up and then U turn-around, took the next left at the gas station and then entered the hotel from the back entrance gates. In fact this was so convenient as there were stop lights so we used this way all during our stay at the hotel. 

Our encounters with all the staff we met, starting from check-in, was lovely! The eating recommends from Andy at the front desk were great and we discovered two great local eating places thanks to him. Pro-tip - if u decide to go to Roosterfish, get the free drink coupons from the front desk. 

They also have a great hot water/ coffee/ tea set up in the lobby. One major downside is that when I got hot water to use for my tea, because the thermos' are swapped out and not dedicated, the hot water caries a strong whiff of coffee into my green tea and the taste really sucked, so ended up throwing majority of the drink away. Still the thought is appreciated even if it's coffee drinkers who will least miss out.

Breakfast is pretty decent too - you get pre-fabricated omelets stuffed with bacon, cheese, jalapanoes, etc and I found this too heavy - could only eat half. Enjoyed the hard boil eggs more. Unfortunately the fresh cut fruit medley had sweeteners and it was so obvious, it really wasn't that great tasting. So some hits and misses for me with the free breakfast. 

Bathroom was -okay, the water pressure was low and also it took a long long while to get the water hot and dunno if this had anything to do with our being on the 5th floor? The room was great tho' as we had a lovely view of the park. Another tip - the water fountains are located on the ground floor near the gym/ pool area and the laundry (you have to buy soap for $2, but it wasn't working when were there) is on the 3rd floor. 

The linens were clean, it was quiet and had great proximity to Indian Rocks Beach. I would definitely return and stay here. 

Note: #178 of Yelp 100 challenge for 2016

I just recently had a botched car stereo installation fixed by these guys and can't recommend them enough. They were prompt, professional, courteous and did an amazing job on the install. They also took the time to show me the features of my new stereo, sync my phone and contacts, etc. Top notch!

My husband and I visited New Orleans for the first time and we stayed in a bed and breakfast near Katies. We heard good things from others in the house and decided to try it for dinner. It was busy but we sat at the bar to wait. While we were there we even got to meet the owner who gave us some history on the place and how long it took to rebuild after Katrina. ..5 years!

The food is great. We had the cheese fries with gravy as an appetizer and the pizza for dinner. It was very good! 

We went back for their Sunday brunch (get there early or you'll have to wait a while). It was just as tasty as the first time.  The service is good and the wait staff are very personable. 

We'd highly recommend it if you're looking for a relaxing, casual dinner!
Bone in pork loin.  Great bar menu as well.  Of course cocktails on point.  Tell them Bart and Jana sent you.

I "cheated" on my regular tire place with Allen's to repair a tire. I like the locally owned tire shops and I needed a quick fix. Pete did the quick fix and sent me on my way. No charge. Support this great local business.

Similar to the other reviews there was a wait, granted we were there for CMAs weekend, but it only took about 40mins.  I had a hot 1/2 bird, white and dark, which was delicious. Only thing I would have changed would have been getting a level down with the heat. We also got mac and cheese and fries which were good, but as expected the chicken was the star of the show.

Great first choice for first time traveler to NOLA.  Jambalaya Pasta and added blackened chicken, and a Sazerak!  Mmmmmm, tasty!  Food was ready within 10 minutes, waitress checked in every 5 mins or so...I would recommend this place.  Cool atmosphere.  Thank you Kim!

Wow!  My Wife and I love the Tuscany Tower rooms.  These rooms are large, luxurious, and clean.  The bathrooms with spa are fantastic. Before deciding to get a winter condo in Reno, we stayed at many of the casino resorts and for Vegas style escaping in Reno, this is our favorite.  They've done a great job of creating a feeling of Italy (though not to such lavish extremes as the Venetian in Vegas, of course).
The employees were all helpful and made us feel welcome.  
The restaurants have delicious food; we love the gelato & espresso stand; the shows are first class; and the gaming is great! 
We stayed here 3 times in November of 2017.

A place that makes their own sausage and I am in the area and hungry, lunch at Crescent Pie and Sausage is it.

The restaurant is located in the middle of a residential neighborhood. The decor is pretty simple but along with the look of the staff gave me the hipster vibe. However, it is not that kind of restaurant and all types of people from old to young were dining here.

Our server was a really nice guy, but it seemed to be his first day and he struggled a bit (forgetting to offer specials, etc) but he went out of his way to create a good experience. 

I ordered the special for the day, Red Beans and Rice with andouille and cornbread. The house-made andouille was exceptional! The red beans and rice, on the other hand were lukewarm; it needed more flavor. The cornbread was a little dry for me, but flavorwise was good.

Besides their sausages, the other thing they are known for are their pies. My dining companion ordered the Mid City Slammer Pizza (Andouille, Grilled Chicken, House-Smoked Coppa, Cheddar, Mozzarella and Red Sauce). Again the andouille stood out and was the star. The pizza overall was good. The crust was thin and crispy. I also liked that the toppings were the focus and it wasn't just another slice loaded with lots of cheese.

Yummy sausages and an awesome atmosphere is what I found in Crescent Pie & Sausage Co.

Not as great as I expected. Slow service, and the food was average. I had the hot sausage for my meal it was a bit different from the typical sausage. It was more like ground pork in a casing. Not my favorite place but maybe worth trying something else.

My boyfriend works out on the Main Line once a week and I offered to come and work at any coffee shop. We found Hothouse Coffee and I gotta give this place two thumbs up. Staff is friendly, I found a spot to work at instantly, coffee is good and they have a large pastry selection.

Stopped by after walking Spruce Street Harbor Park, because we (read I) were absolutely famished.  My friend and I decided on the specials for both appetizer and pizza.  The appetizer was a lovely, little lump of burrata, grilled peaches, plums, mint leaves and pine nuts and it was absolutely delicious.  V. refreshing on the warm summer day.  I was the one who decided on the pizza despite being skeptical of the zucchini topping - the lemon/ricotta was what really sold me.  This too was great.  The zucchini did not make the crust soggy and the hint of lemon was a pleasant surprise.  I've been here before, but this, by far, was my best experience yet.  Check 'em out!

Best Italian in the valley. You won't find people like Gino anywhere else. As an owner, he comes up to your table and genuinely thanks you for your business. Wow! The food is handmade, and the flavor is amazing. Gino's is a must try!

I really enjoyed Insomnia Cookie...I was really looking for an actual ice cream shop but this was the only one open after 10pm. Like many others have said this is just an average tasting cookie and ice cream. The triple chocolate cookie satisfied my craving and I topped it with a scoop of mint chocolate chip.

The store was clean and service was excellent. The ice cream has a limited selection but several great choices. You can just get the cookie, ice cream in a cone or cup, milk shakes, or ice cream wedged between two cookies. They also have a small selection of toppings and of course milk. They also have some pre made cookies in different sizes with funny sayings. Didn't realize this is a national chain; just saw one in Chicago.

We just had a solar system installed for our home through Net Zero.  This is an all around outstanding company.  Chad, the owner is extremely thorough and is actively involved in the entire install process.  For us, the process was so easy and worry-free.  There was no mess or damage from the install crew, they walked our permits through the city office, and always let us know how the project was progressing- which was right on schedule!  The real challenge in solar in Tucson is dealing with TEP- and these guys knew exactly how navigate through the TEP nightmare.
We had quotes from various other companies in town, and Net Zero was by far more professional, knowledgeable, and priced quite reasonably.  One great thing about the company is they are based locally, so no long waits for out of town techs to do repairs. We have had the system up and running for 3 months and not a single issue or complaint.  The ultimate benefit is seeing those power bills decrease.  We are even able to track our solar through an iphone app to see just how much power the system generates. I have recommended Net-Zero to anyone that is interested in Solar in Tucson.  They are reliable and do top notch work!

My family went here for lunch after my sister received her masters to celebrate.  She has ate her prior and loved it.  My wife has eaten at the sister restaurant, St. Elmo's and it's a favorite of hers. 

This experience at Harry and Izzy's was a pretty big miss though.  The shrimp cocktail they are known for is pretty good.  My issue with it is the $16 for 5 shrimp.  It's good, it's not more than $3 per shrimp good.

I had the Izzy style strip.  The sauce it comes in is good but too sweet.  A little bit of it would go a long way.  Unfortunately, the steak sits in a pool of it that over takes the steak. 

My wife ordered a salad and added chicken.  Strangely, the chicken came on a separate plate by itself.  It was very dry so she ordered extra dressing.  It took almost 20 minutes to get after she asked for it a couple times.

My father ordered a ribeye medium rare.  It came out well done.  He sent it back and didn't get it a replacement to basically after everyone else was done.  Much to his dismay the replacement steak maybe you could convince me was medium well.  It definitely was no where near medium rare.  The waitress even described medium rare to have a cool red center (not pink) when he ordered it that way.  He ate it simply because he didn't want to make everyone else wait and just let the waitress know as an FYI.

My sister and mother had a glass of wine.  About when they were finished the waitress asked if they'd each like another.  They figured since my father was still waiting on his replacement steak they'd have time to finish it and not make him feel rushed.  After they had given up on receiving them the waitress finally checked to see if they had ever received them.  They said no and she walked away before they could tell her never mind.  She returned with them right before she bright the bill.

The worst part of the whole experience is that we were charged full price for everything.  No discount on the wine, no complimentary desert for all the long waits and wrongly cooked orders.  A manager stopping by to apologize would have sufficed but that never happened either.  All said and done the bill was $300 before tip.

The only reason this is 2 stars and not 1 is the food that was cooked correctly was good and my sister has had great experiences prior here.  This is obviously a steak/dinner place but come on the chef for lunch should be able to cook a steak medium rare.

I literally hate this hospital. My Dad had surgery here a couple of years ago and we still remember the highlights- like, much of the the staff seemed almost like volunteers who meant well but didn't seem connected, to the horrible stains on the chairs where someone may have hemorrhaged in the waiting room. Bottom line, it was NOT clean (bathrooms, waiting rooms, etc.), no communication with staff while waiting to see my Dad post-surgery, and a $5 latte from a hospital-run coffee shop that apparently supported reparation funds for the archdiocese.
Note: I originally wrote this review for St. Mary's Regional Hospital and shortly after received an email from a hospital PR director. I chose not to respond and it appears my review has been changed to another satellite (urgent care) facility.

Luke was a pleasant enough place, but not nearly as nice as it believes itself to be.

We visited for lunch on a Saturday, and the food was fine. My steak was a perfect medium, which was odd because I ordered it medium rare. The music was so loud that the waiter misheard us several times. A restaurant pretentious enough to have half of its menu in French should probably have more  discernment than to blast 80s pop at a volume that barely allows for conversation.

The tables were small and crowded, the food overpriced, and the wait staff unskilled. In a city filled with excellent food choices, I definitely will be looking elsewhere for a pleasant meal.

Probably one of my favorite breakfast spots in town my son and I eat here twice a month on a regular basis. The smoked ham is delicious. Biscuits and gravy also very good. The Omelette with everything in it is delicious. A lot of food I usually take about half of it home.

Wow, the mussels...I can't stop drooling....how many mussels can you get in a pot?! There were sooooo many and soo good for the price! If you ever crave for delicious mussels cooked in delicious sauce, this is the place to be! And I feel bad for you if you aren't from the Westbank. 

Ok, the restaurant is a tiny cozy restaurant. The kitchen is literally 20 feet away from where you are sitting, which allows you to smell the aromas from your meal being perfected by the chef. There is artwork that surrounds the walls of the restaurant, that I believe is for sale? I'm not sure I see tags hanging on them. The waitress is so friendly and awesome! Her recommendations are right on point with the food. I was pleasantly surprised. I don't think you can go wrong with anything on the menu.
ニューアメリカンで、少し店内がうるさいですが、メリディアン・ビレッジ内でロケーションから良く接待で使います。予約した方が良いです。サンノゼ(サンタナロウ)にもあるチェーン店で、人気の店です。

I would eat here every day if my waistline would allow it.  Every time I bring a box of cupcakes to an event, they are devoured.  I often have people chasing me down to find out where they are from.  I hope some of them actually made the trip to get their own.  

Pound cakes, pies, cookies and tarts are all wonderful.  There is a special bit of magic going on behind the counter there.  Make the trip even if you think you're too far away.  You will not be disappointed.  Order ahead for cakes because they fly.

This place is terrific.  I have been eating here since they opened 4 years ago.   Their food is always fresh and flavorful.  This is a family owned restaurant and the chef's take great care in their cooking.  Highly recommended Italian eatery.  BYOB

Really enjoyed my stay at the Marriott. The rooms are pretty big and the hotel staff was able to arrange joining rooms for our bachelorette party. The big perk for us was location: we were close enough to walk to Broadway but we were off Broadway enough that we could go to restaurants kind of away from that tourist hot zone. We spent a day at the pool and it was pretty full, but not overwhelmingly crowded. Their cabana rates aren't crazy high so I would recommend getting a cabana if you have 6 or more people in your party. They also have a very nice gym and spa if you're into that kind of stuff.

I loved this place.  The beef short ribs were out of this world!! The price was pretty good for the beef short ribs bowl that I had.  I wish the bowl was a bit small for my hunger and I would not mind paying an extra fee for extra meat

It's 8:30 today, and no one is in the shop. The hours online and on the front door say it opens at 8am. Can't give a worse review than being screwed over, with no sign on the store about why no one is here, despite it being open hours.

The Mongolian grill was expertly manned. Between the two of us, we must have had every available option. Everything we tried on the buffet was cooked properly and had great flavor. The hot tea was lovely.  Even the bread and desserts were good.  We will definitely be returning.

Good spot.  We caught a show during Jazz Fest here and liked the venue.  It's a good size place, I'd guess 750 capacity with a nice size stage and good sound system.  

The only downside is that its a bit of a hike from downtown New Orleans.  It's just over the line in Jefferson and if you're in the uptown area its quite close, but from the quarter it'll be a $15-$20 cab ride.
Nice spot to grab breakfast with friends. Service was a tad slow but the proportions of the food were spot on.

These biscuits do not disappoint! They are fresh and flakey. When I tore them open, I could see puddles of butter inside the biscuit- so delicious. 

I stopped in for a late Saturday brunch and ordered the Squawking Goat, a breakfast sandwich consisting of a biscuit, breaded chicken, fried goat cheese, and jam. I ordered it because the menu states it was featured on the Food Network and I was curious. After one bite, I determined it would be a shame to only see that sandwich on TV and not taste it in real life.

This is definitely a restaurant I will return to soon!
We've been to this location a handful of times and haven't had any problems. There is ALOT of traffic coming in and out of this one so watch out!

Since Table 3 is temporarily out of commision due to a fire accident (moment of silence for my one of my favorite restaurants......), we decided to walk across the parking lot to F Scotts.  There is a brand new menu that we were excited to try and it most definitely did not disappoint. 

We had a table for 6 so were able to sample many dishes. We started with the sausage with quail egg that was savory. I am a fan of the texture that a broken yolk gives to a dish even if you're not eating breakfast.  The beef stew was perfectly seasoned and hearty.  The oysters were petite, like an amuse bouche.  The highlight of the appetizers was the four cheese puff pastry- amazing and worth every extra mile on the treadmill!

The main courses were all magnificant. My tuna dish was truly unique - grilled tuna on top of white beans and pork. It's like east meets Tennessee.  Other dishes:  The tenderloin with lobster was so tender I cut it with a butter knife. The chicken dish was aromatic and juicy.   The grouper was the table's favorite and I'll be ordering next visit.  We had a couple bottles of Black Dog Pinot Noir to make this meal perfection!!!

The atmosphere is a little more sophisticated than its younger brother Table3, but the jazz bar makes F Scotts just as charming.  A favorite in Nashville!! And if you're tightening the belt around your wallet, but not your waist, then come after 9 where the dishes are half off.

This place is huge!!!! Love the location. Lots of goodies to choose from. Everything tasted great. 
We had the mussels, truffle Mac, and calamari. I would skip the calamari next time. I would go for the truffle Mac for sure. Mussels were spicer than I thought. 
My server Sam was AMAZING.

Stopped in today. We both ordered burgers. Mine was burnt and hers had a lot of gristle. Never had a bad meal there before. Then this happened. I will go back for the ribs. They used to have good burgers but don't know what happened. 

.

If you are looking for a classic burger place that is reasonably priced, definitely check out Burger Belly. I have been twice now and ate the cheeseburger and tater tots- so good! I will definitely return to Burger Belly when I am in the need for a good, greasy burger!

I'll start here. There was a hair in my black bean burger... 

First, we came in and we were sat almost immediately on a Friday night. Not too bad. 

(See photos in the review.)

We ordered drinks and the manager noticed the server was busy and so he took the drink order of the table next to us. The waitress came over and actually startled us because she put down our drinks so hard on the table that it made a loud noise (clearly upset that the manager had taken the drink order of her table before she had a chance, honestly, I don't really blame her...) and she huffed and met up with the manager over at the stand where they have beverages. The two of them proceeded to legit get into an argument that we could see was going down but couldn't hear. Ok... Weird. Moving on.

The server went on and on about how secret and elusive and awesome the Nashville Hot Chicken slider was and how the sauce is made in their TN location. Sadly, it was nothing even close to the real deal that you will find at Rick Lewis Mike Emerson mashup Southern in STL. That - is the real deal. This isn't Nashville Hot Chicken. 

Secondly, you get the combo plate - $12.50 for two tiny sliders and one (non premium side). Every single thing. Every. Single. Thing. is an up charge.

I ordered the Bay of Pigs - its basically a pretzel bun with some folded ham and a little slice of cheese. Boring ham sandwich disguised as a pretend Cuban sandwich? What the what?

I, also, ordered the black bean slider and while it was seemingly enticing, it had a curly blond hair cooked into the burger. Yep, I found it by biting into it. I took it out and show it to the waitress and she immediately scooped it away, apologized 100 times, and said she was bringing a new plate. 

The manager came over, apologized, and let me know that he was having a new one made for me... That's it? You're not taking it off of my bill? (they didn't... it was on there, full price!) You're not offering to buy me a drink after I found a curly blond hair, in my mouth, from something you served from the kitchen? (Nope, no offer of anything...) Let me be clear on something, I have DARK straight hair, and every single female in my family does, too. So, we certainly didn't bring that long curly blond hair from home and bake it into your black bean burger... We were offered ZILCH from management to try to recoup our experience after this... 

Got the new plate of my order... and they had decided that they weren't giving me guacamole a second time on the black bean burger - nope, they left off the guacamole completely. Defeated, I set the "burgers" aside and went in for the parmesan fries. Bland. Dry. Blah. I asked for sauce - it did not help. Still... just not worth the $12.50 they charged for me for this plate.

Lastly, my husband felt that there was little to no flavor on anything he was given. (See photo of the salad I posted to the business.) They brought my husband's salad and it had a WHOLE TOMATO simply quartered into the salad. How on earth are we supposed to eat a salad with four enormous chunks of tomato in it with the "stump" still on the bottom? Upon digging through the salad, there were multiple sections of lettuce core in the salad and very little leaf. Super sloppy. 

Sadly, even though this place is near to where we live and has a cool patio with a fire pit and some great ambiance upon first look... we will pass this up and go elsewhere in the future. Quite unfortunate.

I would give them zero stars if I could.  I've never had a worst customer experience with a company. They took over a week just to call to get me scheduled after sending in our quote twice. Once the guy did come out, he told me that he would send pictures of the work upon completion.  It has been over two months and no one can seem to get themselves together enough to email pictures to me or even to provide the simple gesture of returning my repeated phone calls and voicemails. Getting an answer from anyone has been like pulling teeth, it just seems like everyone covers for themselves.  The "manager" kept interrupting me when I tried to explain my issues over the phone because it is quite obvious that this company could care less about their customer's concerns or issues  STAY AWAY!

Jotoro is a fun and unique restaurant right outside of Sprkmans wharf with both inside and outside seating. Reservations go fast so make them early in the week! We had several different drinks and had tacos and nachos. Nachos are huge! We split them and still had 1/3 left! Drinks start around $13 and have several to pick from. Staff was pushy and rushed us to put in our order which was not enjoyable.
tasty, simple, quite filling, good deal! I wish they had brown rice but I'm just being picky. Nice ambiance, I would go back.

The bartenders here are great, they have the old school barbershop style wardrobe going on and are friendly, knowledgable and make damn good drinks. Definitely go by the bar when waiting for your table. The food, also great, but it was missing something I couldn't place my finger on which is why I left off a star.
I only had the french onion soup and in my experience it was WAY too sweet.

Breakfast every morning 6 AM to 10 AM. 
Huge number of options.... Don't  waste money on Starbucks next door. Grab the same coffee in breakfast here. They also have complimentary food from 5 pm to 7 pm. Usually a dinner menu. 

Suites are well maintained. Cleaned and hygienic linens with fresh smell can be found in the room.

A good lay out with a living room and French door leading into the bedroom however sofas and carpet are outdated and look very dull. A full kitchen with vessels is provided along with the refrigerator.

Staff is very friendly and accommodating.

Check your linens BEFORE USING!  Stayed there on Aug 2, and towels were so old, threading was loose, and most appalling of all - bed linens had old blood and make-up stains !!! Ugh!! Was awakened early morning (just after 12midnight) with the fire alarm...no message from management/general announcement, just fellow guests telling others it was an error by a maintenance worker....hmmm..can anyone say train staff on fire drills/communications?!!

Mediocre at best. Ordered a pizza steak which was not good. Was very mushy and the flavor left me disappointed. They're just not the same as their other locations. The cashier was very kind and greeted me, which is why I'm giving this review 2 stars instead of one, for good customer service.

By far the best BBQ I have ever had! You'll be in your best food coma ever afterwards!

Don't let the long line out the door intimidate you, it moves really quickly, and they get you a table and your food in no time! Everyone who works there is super nice and super helpful, and gives you that true family owned feel!

The meat is also out of this world! When we went we had the ribs and tri-tip and both literally just melted in your mouth, they were truly perfectly cooked! And the sides are all fresh, just like your Grandma used to make!
Wonderful food and service. Meredith was our server and she did not steer us wrong with the dishes. The building is old and British looking and just what I expected.
Perfect dinner. Our server Ryan was the best. Cazuela Pibil & Santo Old Fashioned... now I can go to heaven. Excellent recommendations & great service. Don't miss out!

There is nothing like the 500 Parade. The race cars, the bands, the celebrities and the other groups that participate in the parade make May in Indiana special. If you have never ventured downtown to the 500 Parade, make plans to go next year. You will not be disappointed.

Could any mall be worse than Northgate Centre? Yes, definitely! I feel like I should have given Northgate Centre five stars compared to Westmount. It's just terrible. And everytime I come here, I wonder why I bothered. There's nothing to do. There's no stores good stores. And the atmosphere is just depressing. 

When the attempt to bring back Westmount was made quite a few years ago, there were commercial saying that this mall was "The New Cool." That made me laugh so much and gave me and my friends hours, if not months, of comedy material. I never saw any "cool" in this mall, unless they just mean the skating rink, which I guess is cool. 

There's a used CD music store in this mall, which appears to be cool, but the CD selection is crap. Although there is a few good CDs, most of the selection of one-hit wonders and forgotten popstars. Sad. 

The only real positives about this mall is the movie theatre, the Dollarama, and the food court. The food court is good, because it has an Edo and a Taco Time. The food court saves Westmount Centre from getting a one-star review from me.

SO AMAZING! My favorite spot from our visit to St Louis. The burgers are great! We shared a bunch and everything was so tasty. We also shared the bacon kale salad which the server sold us on--- delicious! The shakes are so bomb also.. you will be happy and full when you leave there! The only thing we didn't like was the spicy chocolate shake but I didn't expect to like it.

If you like A&W style burgers, Back Yard Burgers is just about the only spot in Nashville where you can get one like A&W. As far as fast-food burgers go, I've mostly cut them out of my life... my days at McDs, BK and Wendys are long gone. But in the odd occasion that I'm craving one, I prefer Back Yard Burgers. The quality is better and the taste is even better than that.

The canal is a really wonderful aspect of Downtown Indianapolis life. It boasts nice views, fairly wide sidewalks, lots of benches and grassy areas to sit and relax, and an easy way for people who live on or near the canal to walk to places like White River State Park, museums, and even a CrossFit gym and a restaurant (shout out to Burgerhaus). It's used to host a few events, including a triathlon and the Greening of the Canal around St. Patrick's day, and those are well attended and a good time. I also can't help but mention that it's an absolutely prime location for people (and dog) watching.

Los Arroyos might be a good, neutral restaurant to visit with co-workers, or for a dinner with girlfriends. A place where the food is secondary to the company. There is lots of space in this restaurant for large groups, and even a semi-private area that I imagine would be great for a party. The decor is very pretty and calming -- lots of wood and leather and earth tones.

The food is just OK. My appetite is positively geriatric, so I get hungry for lunch at about 10:30. Luckily, Los Arroyos opens at 11 a.m. We were the first people there.

We got the chicken taquitos plate, which were covered with sour cream and lettuce, and came with black refried beans and rice. We also got the chicken enchiladas, which were covered with tomatillo sauce, sour cream and lettuce. The chicken was dry in both of our dishes. The food also came out lukewarm, which is disappointing and confusing because we were the first and only people there. You'd think, since the people in the kitchen could focus on only two orders, our food would come out piping hot! Alas.

The chips and salsa were good -- probably the best part of the meal. 

The iced tea is the kind that tastes a little perfumey and fruity, so if you like that kind of iced tea, you will like this one. I do like it. The hot coffee is good and strong. 

There was a steady flow of repair people milling about when we were there. People with ladders and equipment walking in back of our chairs. I guess because the restaurant just opened, I can give them a pass about this. But really, it kills the atmosphere when you have to move yourself to accommodate the guy with the ladder walking by your table.

The best of New Orleans right in St. Charles! We were drawn in by the $1 oyster special at happy hour, and we loved it. After oysters we tried the redfish, hushpuppies, crab cakes, and the gumbo. The bartender was very nice and offered us a Blazing Cyclone - some kind of crazy light & dark rum punch that was yummy. There may or may not have been a pecan cheesecake at the end... I won't tell all of my secrets. But I will say the staff here was really nice, and the kitchen team is fun to watch work around the open kitchen layout.

On a road trip. Found this place on yelp. Ice cream is great. Staff is friendly. I had the fruity pebbles flavor. It was delicious. Place is not the prettiest. If you can get past the appearance the flavors will impress you.

I ordered the cupcake and ice cream dessert. Carrot cake cupcake and vanilla ice cream in a cup. I will say it was very delicious. But we waited in line 20 minutes and for my husband, kids and I it was about $40 for dessert
Who doesn't love a good riverwalk? And this one is more than just a good riverwalk. It hugs the city in a non-linear way that you can see so much. Calming and pretty.

I thought this place was cool and chill since it wasn't super crowded like the neighborhood lounges, but boy I was quickly proven wrong. 

Like Anupma S., I too came here when it was Prime and they seemed to be open to customer feedback and were also extremely nice. Not as Room 12, though, no sir. No cover, and in a nice location so you think it's cool. But what DJ, you won't even take requests? Seriously the Prime DJ looked up a Bollywood song for us on YouTube and played it without any reservations. This Room 12 DJ didn't even let me complete my sentence. My friend asked for a song, and he said he only had a specified list so I asked if he could just play a song from my phone to make things easier, but he couldn't even let me finish my thought. Seriously there were all of 15 people in the venue (all people in my group), you couldn't even entertain one request? Then, the bartender gave my friend and I attitude as well. Again, hardly anyone to serve, so why the 'tude?

Honest suggestion, Room 12, you guys have a wonderful space, just please enforce some better customer service amongst your staff members.

Sat at the bar with Ray & Mark bar tending (2/28/16). They're awesome. Great service, as always, during the busy brunch hours! I'll be sitting at the bar more often when they're around! 

Amazing service. The manager checked on us multiple times when our food took a little longer to come out. Offered & provided a complimentary appetizer to apologize. Devin ("with an '-in'") is the best server and I will always request him when coming here. Love me some City Fire!!

Took my 80-something yo parents here today for lunch. I am vegan but they for sure are not. We ordered the Fried Yuca which we practically inhaled (the dipping sauce was heavenly too). I had the Pescado Tacos which were yummy (I almost licked the plate clean) and mom ordered the Salad Bombon which was also delicious (I want to put jicama in everything). My dad ordered a "beef" burrito but I didn't try it however, I will eat the 2nd half for dinner tonight as it was huge. Our server, Robert was amazing. I asked him for suggestions and his choices were perfect. Robert was very friendly and professional and frankly, they are lucky to have him. Thanks Bar Bombon for a lovely dining experience.
if you are looking for a good, no, great breakfast, then you must go to the Stone House Cafe.  Not only is the food great but the bloody marys are wonderful and the service is exceptional.

Awesome atmosphere, great drink selection, and fun games but kicked out at 9:20 PM and had to toss a full drink because the staff was in a hurry to close. I have worked in the hospitality industry for years, and never would I push customers out. The service was absolutely disappointing.

Sushi...a tiny piece of fish on a bed of rice the size of a softball.

Mongolian BBQ...everything and I mean everything tastes the same, too salty.

Pan Asian fare...tastes kinda like General Tso's 'chicken'.  All of it.

American fare...dried up, over fried, stale.

Soups...been sitting for Lord knows how long, the oily 'skin' on most.

Ice cream...little kids licking the scoop then putting it back in the watery container, gross.

Service...good.

The view....sad, demotivating yet motivating at the same time.

The wait was long, but it was well worth it! This is a small little joint in a really beautiful neighborhood; we walked to a tea house down the street while we waited for a table and the host was very nice about getting us in the door as quick as he could. The food was delicious and the service was very friendly!

I ordered my wedding cake after meeting Laurie and sampling some of the cake types she had on offer. 

We settled for a Lemon cake, with Lemon buttercream and a raspberry marmalade. 

The designed part of the cake looked amazing on delivery and was morealess spot on. However, that where my praise stops. 

The cake didn't taste of lemon (it didn't even taste like it knew what a lemon actually was!) at all. There wasn't even a hint of it. It tasted like a generic vanilla cake with a synthetic buttercream taste. 

I contacted the owner after being told about this from our guests, wedding was in the 27th and we were told on the evening of the 28th (you know how it is, you don't eat on your wedding day!) so our first opportunity to contact the owner was the 29th. 

I emailed her but got nothing back until the 3rd November (after having to chase her up) and after posting something on her Facebook page. 

She then ignored my email again that night and had to prompt for an email again the next day. 

She was very rude to me and I then asked my partner to respond. She has since ignored him.

Great seafood restaurant. Go for dinner alittle early so you don't have to wait on table. The food was some of the best we had on our stay. Very filling and reasonable priced. Wait staff was prompt, polite, and always around but not overbearing.

I've only been here one time and I'll probably never come here again. My experience is a simple one to share. Came in to potentially buy a bed, even found a bed I really liked and was ready to buy a bed that was around $1,000. Well, the salesman was so incredibly pushy that it was no longer a pleasant experience. I had to deal with this very rude employee for an hour because I wouldn't buy the power base for an additional $900! I was fine with the bed that was already $1000 but that wasn't good enough for the sales rep. Makes me sick to my stomach to think that someone who represents a place can get such an attitude and turn away a ready customer. Can't say all Ashley's sales reps are like this, but don't go to this one!

I've been holding off on writing this review for a few months because I just don't know what to say. Five stars for a delicious, juicy burger on a fresh bun? One star for the most overpriced fast food of my life?  

I appreciate what Shake Shack is doing. They're pulling off a modern take on fast food and obviously using good quality ingredients to do it. I'm also always a huge fan of simpler menus--a lack of fancy offerings and choices means a place can focus on doing what they do right.

I got the SmokeShack (applewood smoked bacon, chopped cherry pepper, and shack sauce) and shared a side of fries. The bacon was good but I didn't like the chopped peppers, and after the first bite I was envying the bf's plain old double ShackBurger. The quality of the beef is very evident, and as I said it was juicy and did not disappoint. The fries were on par with freezer section Ore-Idas but when dipped in the shack sauce they weren't half bad. On the way out I sprung for the chocolate shake, and it was rich and thick and just the right amount of chocolatey taste. 

All that being said, when you're judging anything you take into account its price. Ultimately I'll say this is a better burger than I've gotten even at restaurants in the city, but I get a lot more enjoyment out of a $0.99 Wendy's frosty than a shake I'm paying $5 for. What we paid for lunch isn't anything I'd blink an eye at at a sit-down restaurant, but a $20 fast food meal falls in a weird gray area that I just don't frequent.

Still, though, good burgers.

Overall pretty meh.  Their buffalo wings were decent, but the rest of the food was kind of meh.  

I'm low carb so I got a bunless burger.  Despite having perfect lettuce leaves, they only give you one, so I had to eat with knife and fork.  

I would have asked for another lettuce, but service was SUPER slow.  (Almost a half hour from clearing the table to walking out)

The burger was meh, and the broccoli I got as a side sucked.  Tasted like super bland steamer bag broccoli.

Wife got normal burger and wedges, and also said she wasn't impressed.  

If you're looking for an incredible burger, go to Engine No 9. 

If you're looking for neat old cars to look at, go here.

This has been going on for a few weeks and I can't ignore it any longer...
There's a new assistant manager named Amy at this store and her presence is intolerable any longer. 
The energy she puts off is not pleasant, the staff vibe is ruined when she's on shift and I just can't stand being in her presence.
I used to be a District Manager for a Fortune 200 company in retail and she would not survive in one of my stores, no clue how she's a Starbucks member, much less in a management or leadership role. I hope Starbucks doesn't lose staff over her as this is one of the best crews in Tucson and where I go 4-7 times a week to study with my daughter.
Starbucks, listen to me, Amy needs to go, you're jeopardizing longtime customers and valuable staff because of one bad element...
Their Service was good BUT the Women's bathroom at Park Mall was absolutely filthy and it was right after opening!  I have been to the Oracle location several times and never had this problem.
Not a fan of BBQ but this was great. All of their meats are only smoked so this place is GLUTEN FREE friendly. Sauces are all gluten free but one (the green one).
Nice variety of menu options to choose from. Staff is friendly and quick with service. Ample seating with a futuristic feel.

I didn't expect to write this review as i have never written one in the past, but I was so blown away by the work AJ did on our basement, i felt an obligation to spread the word. We had previous estimates to install a french drain  and move a sub pump in our basement, but i was still on the fence wit those contractors. In the past few years we have completely remodeled our home, so we have worked with almost 10 sub contractors, but AJ ranks at the top. He was very easy to talk to and very professional. He not only gave us the most competitive price he even offered to do the job the next day and he did! The next night I got home from work, the french drain was completely done and the entire basement was spotless... cleaner than when we moved in! 
My wife and i couldn't be happier with the work AJ and his team did. We are excited to remodel our basement and it's all possible thanks to AJ's waterproofing.
This place is as good as it gets! Loved the wine list along with all the goodies. Staff went out of their way to please us. Will be back soon!

I love RUSTY's!!! It's the best pizza ever!!! Well, for me that is. I only eat Rusty's pizza. 
I only have one hang up. On Valentine's I ordered a bunch of heart shaped pizzas, among those, a few veggie pizzas. And they came with pepperoni. 
In the description it doesn't say they are outlined in pepperoni, so when I call and ask for veggie pizzas, you would think that operator would 1) inform me that it has pepperoni, or 2) would be smart enough that a veggie pizza should not have meat on it. My vegetarian. Friends had to go without until I arrived and called Rusty's to ask them to resend those veggie pizzas. Instead of getting an apology, I was schooled on how those pizzas come with pepperoni, and I should have requested them without pepperoni. I asked myself, "How clueless Can you be, if I ask for a vegetarian pizza, WHY WOULD YOU ADD MEAT!!!!"
That is all!! I hope next year the description or pepperoni Info is added to the coupon or ad.

Thanks for responding so quickly
From the outside it doesn't look like much but the outside patio has a cozy atmosphere and the food was great.

Food Poisoning! Service and food was great until my wife and I got home, we both became very sick a couple hours after and it lasted until noon the next day. We talked to a doctor and he told us we had food poisoning. Will never go here again. I hope no one else gets sick.

I had not heard of this restaurant and when a date suggested it I was immediately impressed by the menu. The atmosphere is lovely and outside seating is always a plus. I had the quinoa burger and it was fabulous! My drink was even better! A ginger margarita with all the flavors popping. My date had the watermelon mojito, which was so refreshing. This is probably my new favorite spot when I'm KOP.

I was referred to this place by a friend of mine. Moving from Florida to D.C., and then coming back home to visit to find a good eyebrow threading place can be hard. I came here and loved it right away! It is located in a nice little suite in a building and the room is very private, so its just you and the person. I got my eyebrows threaded and she did an amazing job. I have sensitive skin, so while it doesn't hurt, I still get red and my eyes get pretty watery. She soother my skin right away and on top of that she takes rocks and gives you like a head massage to calm the swelling and redness then gives you a little neck and back massage. Nothing crazy but a quick 5 minute rub while you are waiting on the eyebrows to calm. This place is amazing!

My favourite pizza in Edmonton; and it's in my neighbourhood!  If you like Italian-style, thin crust pizza make sure you stop in some time.
I always get take away because I'm not a fan of the service I've received when dining in.  The guys in the kitchen are always friendly and have a great sense of humour.

Solid.

It's located in the heart of a very Mexican part of Santa Barbara. Being from Santa Maria, this area reminds me of home. It truly is a hole-in-the-wall kind of place and yes I don't think they speak a whole lot of English but that's ok. It's Mexican food and that's probably more of an encouraging sign if anything.

I was very pleased with the tacos, probably as good as you can get in Santa Barbara. Don't expect quality service but you will get quality food. That's way more important for tacos.

Big portions! Service was fast and friendly. We waited on a Thursday evening but we're served at the bar immediately and then waited about 20 minutes for a table. I got the salad with chicken and it was huge but nothing to write home about. Veg taco felt about the same.

A friend and I came in here last night and I enjoyed it so much that I had to rave about it to all my coworkers the following day. I loved our server! She was happy,energetic,and friendly in a way that came off as nothing but sincere and didn't give me the feeling that im being worked for a big tip like I sometimes get when im out downtown.

The beer selection here is huge and can be viewed at various monitors around the establishment. I applaud beer revolution for this interesting concept and for saving some tree's although I wish there were more monitors as they are difficult to view from certain tables. I went with the peach fuzz and it was one of the most interesting beers I have ever tried. It was sweet and exemplified what a refreshing adult beverage should taste like.  Without a doubt it was the perfect summer beer!

For food we had the nachos and the beer battered ribs. The food here is a bit pricier then what I am used to but we got good sized portions and the quality was excellent. The sauce on top of the ribs was so delicious I truly think they need to look at bottling it like they do with the steak sauce at Tony Roma's.

All in all it was a great experience and I definitely look forward to repeat trips over the course of this summer and beyond.

Specks is an institution in our area. Amazing chicken obviously- family owned and appreciated.
However tonight I experienced something I've never really seen before there.
Friday night . Line out the door. Three people ahead of me decided to leave. Why? Two young people (two) were struggling to run the register ( taking orders). 
Again I'll say this is unusual .... And I was patient. But when I finally did get my chicken ( taking out). I noticed that the selection I asked for was not was put in the box .
So I asked for the manager - dark hair - I've seen before assuming he is the manager etc - working the grille. 
He rolled his eyes at me as I explained about the chicken and asked if maybe the kids were struggling etc.
He spoke loudly and basically said I was insulting them ( last thing I was doing). 
Look - if your customers concerns mean nothing to you .... If you take the opportunity to not only NOT address their concern, but use it as a reason to cause a scene - there's something wrong.
Speck family : address this . It's got to be hard keeping workers going etc ... but don't throw the baby out with bath water.
Courtesy to your customers concerns ( especially when they are not being rude about not getting what they ordered) can't go away.
Great room, excellent amenities, amazing food.  I loved it and will stay here again.  Kids LOVE the pool.

Great salads! I recommend the chopped Cobb or the paleo power just make sure they include the shrimp as they forgot to add some to mine one time when I ordered at the restaurant on Metairie Road. I liked the salad dressing so much on the paleo power salad that I actually bought some to take home for my own salad.

Hemo's chicken cheesesteak makes my tummy happy no matter how outrageously long the line may be for their food...I know it's always so worth it. 

The chicken cheesesteaks, the regular cheesesteak, the grilled chicken sandwich...they are all delicious and it's really hard to go wrong here.  As long as you get the Hemo's sauce on it, it may be delicious without it but that sauce is freaking incredible.  The sandwiches are also quite large, so it makes for an excellent meal.

After a week in New Orleans, we were looking for a good meal at a great price and something off the grid.  We found it here.  My husband could not believe the prices and we were both pleasantly surprised by the great food.  Every day there are special dishes. My husband got the stuff peppers. They were flavorful and stuffed with eating pleasure.  I got the pasta primavera.  The vegetables were crisp and fresh over angel pasta with just enough cheese and spice.  The best surprise was the cost, less than $30 for the two of us with drinks.  There was so much food, I could not even fathom desert. It is a great family place.
Wonderful breakfast place and a favorite with the locals. The hash brown casserole is a must! The wait staff are friendly and the service is great. They are clean and prompt. Large portions.

My 14 year old death row rescue has a horrible cold. His usual vet didn't have an appt until the middle of Jan. I am livid. The vet here booked him within 2 days. The dr was very thorough and staff was friendly. My dog is on antibiotics and we are to follow up within 2 weeks. I'm very happy with Dr Mule and we will be switching vets!
