Since coming here last week,I've had at least 4-5 conversations with co-workers about the Museum and the things I saw here. For providing interesting (at least to me) discussion-worthy fodder (I could talk about massive colons forever), this museum is worthy of FIVE-STARS!! 

Granted, this museum isn't everybody's cup of tea. On my part, I knew that I was going to skip the art museums in my Philly trip - I get enough of that and more in NYC. Sure we have the Bodies exhibit, Madame Tussaud's, etc. but these exhibits are sensationalist and pander to tourists. The Mutter Museum has been around for a VERY long time, is well established, and does a good job of giving you a boutique museum experience. 

So, this is a definite must-go destination for those have active imaginations and enjoy a little bit of gore. Don't eat beforehand, and bring your student ID (or an old one) for $10 admission, otherwise its $15.

This place has had more management changes than failed Lindsay Lohan drug test, but I hope they stay with the current.  Last time I went everything was delish (yeah I just Rachel Rayed yelp).  

Who knew a Panini was actually a sub?  

Either way I have enjoyed everything I have eaten off the menu.  So much so I'm not afraid to switch it up.  Like in other places, once you find what you like you stick to that one item because you're scared you won't like anything else.  And the one time you do switch it up the food is less than par.  You call yourself "stupid" and say you will never do that again.  

Do it here!
I love this place! The food is delicious and super cheap.  Its always a nice place to watch any sporting event.  The only down side is that they only accept cash.

My husband  and I gave this place 2 chances and will not be giving them a third. The first time we visited was on a holiday. Service was extremely slow but we attributed it to them being understaffed due to the holiday. The food was just ok. The second time we went it was fairly empty but service was again very slow. We both ordered iced tea with our meal but what we got tasted more like water. Our sandwiches were sloppily thrown together on the plate and left much to be desired ever for diner food.

I highly advise everyone to never order the individual pizza! I took my niece and nephew here. I ordered the individual pizza for $8.99. I wanted sausage on my pizza so they charged an additional $1.99. When it was brought to my table, I was shocked, and that's putting it mildly, at the extremely small size of the pizza! The pizza was round but if you reshaped it, it would equal the size of one small piece of pizza . . . and there was not much to it . . . very flat. I cannot believe that they have the nerve to serve such a ridiculously small pizza and charge $10.98! And for that reason alone, I will never return to CEC!  SHAME ON YOU CEC!!!

For the ultimate southern food experience, this is the place! We had a 30-minute wait, but it went by quick as we walked around the grounds and peaked in to the simple shops there. And the wait was totally well worth it.

Everything we had was awesome! At our table, we got the cat fish (essentially, fish and chips), the chicken tenders (which were more like chicken filets) and the pork chops (while two pork chops would have suffice, there were three). The servings were gigantic, not to mention 2 sides each, and we definitely SHOULD HAVE split just a couple of dishes, but we wanted to try so many things that getting several items was essential! We all loved it all. No complaints. Everything tasted so good! I was completely satisfied and I feel like I got some true southern food exposure.

This place lives up to the hype. Definitely worth the effort and whatever wait is required!

So, I went here with my brother for dining days and it was a crazy steal! We had an appetizer, main course and dessert for $15. The portions were large and Delicious. We had wings, quesadillas, fish and chips and crab cakes. Also, pitchers of beer, only $10 not too shabby. Our server, I think her name was Sam was fantastic too!
Never stayed here but the party is dope!! I had a great time with friends. Drink were strong just perfect for me. The hotel was nicely decorated upscale.

Update to my experience with this salon:  When I called the owner of this salon to let her know my experience was less than what was expected or paid for the same day as my initial pedicure; she offered to do my pedicure for me herself.  (By the way, I went to my usual salon across town the very next morning to have a good pedicure.)  The owner of this salon did offer another service or pedicure to me, not a refund.  So Today, I called and wanted to schedule my pedicure that she offered and I paid for..  Now she says she cannot do a pedicure for me since I posted my review on Yelp (which was posted from her parking lot the day of the terrible pedicure).  A chance for that review to be modified by her providing a good pedicure for the price I've already paid seems to not interest her.  She is not interested in remedying the situation and making a customer happy.  Too bad for me.

Liz was the most amazing server I have ever had. We left with such a great impression of this restaurant. She did such an amazing job and anticipated every need before we even had to ask. The food was delicious and she made our experience such a peaceful and relaxing evening.
Too pricey and the service wasn't worth it. I was rushed through and was dissatisfied. Sorry i won't be back

Smells SO good when you first walk into this cute little bakery! Seating outside, or inside (which get a little crowded). I ordered the Pulled Pork Sandwich YUM!! It was so delicious served on a Ciabatta bun. The window of pastries was overwhelming I couldn't pick just one thing to take home- I bought a box of things...Prices were reasonable. I also brought home a loaf of sourdough bread...It was gone the next day! Sliced up and smeared with some butter. Will be back for lunch, pastries & breads!

By far the best pizza and wings in town; however, the service is lousy. I now only go on late nights when I am out with friends and in a position that I don't care about the service. During the day the place is not a comfortable atmosphere mostly because the employs rude.

I've now dined at Treemont twice and cannot WAIT to go back.

I'll start with my favorite items: Brussel Sprouts, sour cream pannecotta, apple wood smoked salmon (blew my mind), lobster ravioli, pork loin..... 

I just listed everything I ate because they were all that good! The chickpea fritters (appetizer) were yummy. Additionally, they're gluten free although they're fried. They come with a really good dipping sauce!

Beautiful food presentation, accommodating and sweet staff, awesome beer list, and wine list. Glasses ($9-14) and bottles (wide range).

The ambiance is very nice. Upstairs can accommodate a large party, but there are also cozy spots for a romantic date. I really appreciate that their tables aren't too close together so you don't feel like you may as well dine with the table next you!

I plan on coming back, and definitely plan on trying their brunch menu.

Considerate, polite, customer friendly, truthful, prompt, efficient are just some of the words you want any company or service provider to exemplify.  I have read the various reviews and see many individuals are tickled pink about this place and many people in the area recommend this place.  However, if you look past the 5 star reviews and do a little extra research you will find out the truth about this place.  I am happy that some people came in with an emergency and got in and out in 40 minutes but that is not everyone's experience.  We set an appointment to have 4 new tires installed along with alignment.  We did our research on the various tires, called countless tire companies and decided to use Bob's Tire.  Just to let you know I will drive to get great service or pay more just to know I am getting the best service out there.  When we set the appointment we inquired if we would get a print out of the alignment so we can have it for our service book and because another mechanic screwed us in the past and did not provide a copy (people, this is not something you should have to request).  Needless to say that we did not get a copy of the alignment as we were lied to and told the printer was out of paper (Just an excuse and a pike if bull).  They said they have been out of paper for about 3 days so why didn't they say this when we set the appointment 2 days prior.  Then you would think they would have the tires you requested when you set the appointment, however, one of the morons there decided to sell our tires to another customer and since they are so disorganized there no one realized they need to order another set so they would have them for our appointment.  Instead, they tried to sell us another tire from that manufacturer.  They said they would either sell us the tire we want for $110 a tire or the tire they have in stock for $120 as that tire normally goes for $130.  We decided to wait a day and get the tire we ordered.  We were told that their deliveries get in at noon and all they would have to do is install the tires.  You would think they would get our car done as soon as the tires got in but it took another phone call from us around 3 p.m. just to be told our car was on the lift and should be done in 30 minute or so.  You think this would be enough but it continues as Scott tried to go back on his word and attempted to sell us the tires at the original price instead of the ten dollars off per tire and they did not have a print out of the alignment.  Then to top it off the arm rest on the drivers door was filthy because they do not care about your vehicle and get in your car with their dirty clothes and do not take any precautions such as paper covers to protect your vehicle.  Plus my vehicle left their lot with 3 new dents which it did not have before.  Two of the rims have new scratches on them because of one of many reasons.  At this point I feel it is a combination of being rushed, lack of caring, lack of experience and not taking pride in their job.  The tires and rims were a mess from the solution they swab the tires with to get them onto the rim.  I have never received a car with such messy and dirty tires ever in my life.  How do I know this?  Well thats easy because I just detailed the car inside and out and know every inch of the car.  As i drove the car home it just did not feel right and i was tempted to turn the car around and go back but I had a couple of ideas of what was causing the feeling and would check it out once I got home.  Plus i am not 100% certain I would have contained myself.  When I got home I parked the car in a cool shaded spot and waited until the next morning at which time i checked the air pressure in all 4 tires.  The tires should be inflated to a maximum of 33 PSI according to the sticker on the door; unfortunately, this is not the PSI in the tires.  Two of tge tires were at 145 PSI, one was at 140 PSI and the other was at 138 PSI. You would think a tire shop would know what PSI is recommended for your vehicle!  I do not know how this place has stayed in business for so long due to the lack of accountability and customer service.  They let individuals stand and wait at the counter while they walk aimlessly on the other side of the counter.  I saw Scott take a pile of smaller boxes from the desk over to a cabinet, drop most of them on the way over and do other little jobs all while making clients stand at the counter and wait for him to be done.  I do not know how this place has stayed in business for so long due to the lack of accountability and customer service.

I had no expectations nor had I had any preemptive discussions about this place...so it was a delightful surprise. I was told the corn bread is a must...well I am NOT a corn bread fan...so I was doubtful. Holy cow...I could eat that all day long. Become 500lbs, but it definitely is a must order. I got the Chilean sea bass and it was cooked to perfection. I'm not usually a fan of the Asian inspired fish prep because its usually too bland for my taste, but this was delicious. I would definitely get it again. I did order ice tea and that was terrible...not sure if they brewed it incorrectly or it was old, but that is my only complaint from the night. Will definitely go back!
Love this place. They have a great happy hour. .50 cent raw  oysters and $1 grilled oysters... Both are really good. We sat at the bar and the bartender was great.
This location supports the children in this community! Had great service during a very busy lunchtime. Sandwiches were delicious and we loved all the holiday decor displayed.

We went here for dinner last night. I found it odd that they had a very large and pungent  candle burning in the middle of the restaurant. I'm allergic to highly fragrant candles like those so we chose to sit as far away from it as we could. (Which really wasn't far as it's a very tiny place!)

Our waitress was very friendly and explained the menu to us. My boyfriend ordered the Alligator burger and I got the "Philet" burger. We also brought an out of town friend and he ordered a Philet burger as well. We wanted him to try the Gator, but he was leery of the hot sausage the waitress said it was mixed with.

Our food was brought out to us and it looked good. Before we bit into anything, there was a horrible manure/sewage smell that appeared. We were completely grossed out by it. We asked the waitress what the smell was. She said it was coming from sewer pipes and the Parish won't fix it. We were sitting near the bathroom, so everytime the door opened we were overcome by the offensive smell. (I can't imagine how horrible it must have smelled in there!) Our waitress helped move us to another table that was under the noisy tv. She wanted to move us next to  the candle but I couldn't because I'm allergic.

We attempted to eat our food. I will say I found my burger to be very tasty. I would get it again. I like how you can customize your order just how you want. They give you a pen and you mark off all of your selections accordingly on their order form. They offer a nice variety of sides to accompany the burger. I got the Tater Tots but the Sweet Potato Fries were tempting. The burger prices are on the higher side though. On average for a basic burger with a side, you will be paying near $11.00 without tax.

Unfortunately, my boyfriend kept smelling the awful stench and was not able to completely enjoy his meal. We were not impressed with the Alligator meat either. We were informed it was two thirds Gator and one third hot sausage. To us it tasted mostly of sausage - specifically, we agreed it tasted like breakfast sausage. We have eaten plenty of Gator burgers from elsewhere over the years. So we know what a good one tastes like. They have become hard to find though. We were hoping this would be our new go to Gator burger place.

Sadly, my boyfriend will never eat here again because of the smell. I would return but not for Gator burgers. Also, due to the candle and smells, I would have to get my food to go.

Not too much more I can add about this quaint custard shop! It does what it does and it does it well. 

I ordered up a News 11 concrete which had their Scotch Oatmeal cookie and Reese's peanut butter cups blended in. My brother got the Apple Pie concrete which was delicious and my grandma got an apple cobbler drenched in caramel and custard. My grandpa went with his favorite dessert- a banana split and although it was huge, I'm pretty sure his empty container suggests it was tasty! 

We got here right when it opened and got our dessert right away to enjoy on the benches. It'd be nice if they had some tables set up but the absence kind of adds to the novelty of the place. Like many others, this will definitely be a go-to whenever I am back in St. Louis.

This place is the slowest on the planet. It also attracts the filth of Delco! Drive Thru takes forever, 90% of the time your order is wrong and on top of that....the places STINKS! I try to stay away from fast food but sometimes on the late night after work I need something quick and easy....I would rather starve than eat here.

This restaurant has been in business since my dad was little and I see why. It's unpretentious, casual, and reasonably priced food in the heart of the touristy French Quarter. 

My table ordered the fried pickles to start which came with a spicy ranch. For entrees, the Felix Special poboy, 1/2 oyster poboy and cup of jambalaya, club sandwich, and soft shell crab poboy. The poboys were EXCELLENT, the fried pickles crispy and the jambalaya tasty. The club was decent but nothing special so I definitely recommend sticking with seafood entrees since they know what they're doing with those!

The atmosphere is good for families with kids and is very casual. This place would be good for casual dates but not when you want to experience something fancy or exotic. I would definitely go back next time I'm in town.

TL;DR: Casual, good price, great food!

Gluten free available with a high level of confidence!!  A dedicated toaster for gluten free bread, although the kitchen is not dedicated wheat-free.  Vegetarian options also on all their menus.

Open for 31 years, they are no stranger to keeping Edmontonians and guests to our city well fed! Specials most days; Monday Fish & Chips (with gluten free beer if you like), Turkey Tuesdays, Ukrainian Thursdays (perogy night!), Short Rib Saturday, and Sunday night Prime Rib supper.

Legendary weekday breakfast, (with cinnamon buns of enormous size - not gluten free), but weekend Brunch as well.

We came most recently for the Fish & Chips on Mondays, but have dined at Ukrainian night as well as weekend brunches. The cod was battered well, crispy and delicious.  Tartar sauce made in house and also tasty.  The fries... while not my favourite part of the meal weren't bad.  In-house made ketchup as well as the commercial stuff.  Try both - you might be surprised. Sampled the grilled corn bread that's now gluten free.  I missed the grilled part of the description and was a little surprised by the char.  Served as a loaf slice. Don't forget to ask for the honey. It was pretty good, but I could only eat one piece.  $5 gets you two pieces - so bring a friend or take the rest home!

Note for the Celiacs - the gluten free beer they carry at the time I visited was Mongozo.  Not a truly gluten free or wheat free beer, but if you can tolerate it, go for it!

Word of warning, portions are not puny. Bring an appetite, or a container for your leftovers!  The gluten free Mexican Lasagne... I don't see it on the menu now, but it used to come in a giant tinfoil pan when we ordered catering. Enough to feed 4... really good too.

Oh yes, they cater lunches, so if your office is having a meeting - order ahead of time and pick up hot, delicious food.

Decor, a little dark and cozy.  Artwork & stained glass for sale, a great way to seek out new local artistans and gifts while you dine!

There is a lovely outdoor patio in summer, sheltered with a plastic wind barrier in fall.

Of note - they're closed Jan 21, 2015 for a Top to bottom Cleaning Party. The website says:  
The entire diner from top to bottom gets cleaned - the kitchen (including the stoves and all the appliances), all the floors, the windows, the walls, the ceiling.... everything gets cleaned.  This semi-annual all-day cleaning is in addition to the on-going day-to-day cleanliness policies that we practice.

BULLY! Not afraid to lose income for a couple of days a year to keep the place hygienic and safe to eat at!

Parking... street, some in the lot by the fence. Park carefully and don't forget to register your plate in the book as you walk in.

To get here: Walk across the High Level Bridge from downtown, or take the LRT to University and wander over.  Bike racks, but they're usually pretty full.
Great place to eat! Loved it. Chicken and waffles all the way.
It was easy to get here and dropped off. I give it 3 stars because I had someone help me out with my bag then aggressively demand me for tips in which I did not like.

This place is perfect for what it is.  It is not the next great hot night spot.  It is not an ultra sleek gastropub.  It is not an irish pub.  It is not a sports bar.  It is not a dive bar.  What you can expect is one of the most chill, down to earth, old school, neighborhood bars in the city.  

With an impressive tap selection, service where you feel like you know the server or bar tender by the end of the night, and simple food done right, this place strips a bar down to the basics and does each part impeccably well.  Expect to see the owner sharing a few stories and laughs with any patron at the bar.  It also boasts a very impressive sized patio for the place, but seeing as how it is almost November, I won't get to really enjoy that for another 5 months or so.

My grandmother lived by herself in Port Richmond running a corner bar until she was 82 years old.  You knew the owner, you knew the bartenders, and you knew the patrons.  You always knew when you went in there, it was the true old fashioned bar experience.  Interstate has mastered that same feeling in an establishment only a month or so old.

People expecting this to be the next Memphis Taproom or Kraftworks will be disappointing, but if you want to experience what a true neighborhood bar should feel like, this is the place to go.

In terms of a true meat and three...awesome!

In terms of what a meat and three should be:

Food: There is so much flavor in every menu item at Arnolds. 

Ambiance: Get in line, grab a tray, grab a serving of Banana Pudding or Chocolate Pie, choose your sides, lament that you that you can't eat all of them, choose a meat, lament that you can't eat all of them, choose your bread, pick up a drink, pay...and take a seat at a table. Eat. You will be happy.

Speed: The longest line out the door will only take about 10-15 mins to get served...so no worries. Usually, it only takes 3-5 minutes to walk in before you are eating.

Bread: I don't let bread be the main event here!

Price: A little steeper than a country meant and three...but worth every penny!

Three bites in and I am SOLD! Garbanzo is my new spot.    Freshly made food that is healthy.  No more feeling guilty about going out for lunch when it's not your cheat day.  I splurged a bit today because I wanted to try the falafel and yellow rice - both good choices - but you have the option to ditch the carbs and make your entree a salad.  Maybe next time!  I ordered a bowl to go.  You have the option to select a bowl, pita, salad, or plate.  Then you add your protein, toppings and sauce.  I selected a little bit of everything and it is all delicious.  And fresh.  My bowl was filled with yellow rice, chicken, chipotle hummus, tabbouleh, tomato cucumber salad, red onions, red cabbage, pickled onions, roasted vegetables and tzatziki sauce.  It sounds a lot, and it is, but the flavors blend together so well.  The falafel on the side was an added bonus.  I think I've found my new weekday lunch spot!

I have to say that Hickory has also been very good to our cat.  I brought him in for the first time on an emergency basis, and the staff could not be more compassionate.  The vet tech actually got down on the floor with the cat and examined him before taking him into a private room for further checkup.  The ER visit is not cheap, in fact its even more that we co pay for ourselves at the ER, but you are paying for a specialized service.  Sad to say, but vets are always expensive to matter where you go.  We were so happy with the ER visits that now Hickory is their "normal" vet as well.  We are also working on getting our new kitten into them.  Please note they also have all services right on site, which means no having to send out labwork, etc.
This place has forgotten part of my order 3 times in a row...this is the last time it happens to me....Do yourselves a favor...Don't go to this place...It's a joke.

We have been to this place with my friends to try some healthy food. The menu was written on the chalk board which was fancy and nice. After entering there was huge brightness which was very refreshing and made us energetic as they have huge glass doors which let sunlight enter directly into the restaurant which is really good and they have all signs which tells about not to use plastic stuff. We have ordered veggie gyro which is simple and tasted good, lemon soup, veggie pasta with sweet potatoes, sesame chicken and chicken taco. The food was not up to the mark when compared to other healthy restaurants and also the price is too much. Can try this place once to get the fee of ambience and atmosphere. I suggest they could do more better for the price they charge u.

I really like City Sports. They have a good selection of running items and knowledgeable staff that doesn't make you feel guilty if you aren't a marathon runner or body builder. I stopped in in search of a new pair of running shoes and one of their employees spent 30-45 minutes with me helping me find the perfect pair. He was awesome, extremely knowledgeable, and not pushy at all. I find that the employees at the register often struggle to ring things up (i.e. how to do a return, how to use a merchandise credit, etc.) but overall it's my go-to for running apparel and shoes when I want to buy in-person rather than online!

Although I've only been here twice..i love this place, such a wonderful space. Bright, airy with a nice flow, great for studying, relaxing or meeting up with friends. If I lived here, this would be my go to spot.

Philly's best! You could always go to a big name but You won't always get a quality cheesesteak. Lots of meat, great flavor, and delicious toppings. Can't wait to come back! The garlic fries were great too.

I am very pleased with my experience with Zander Insurance. They made the process of finding reasonable insurance rates for my family very easy and continued to assist even when the insurance provider we selected took over the process: they kept in touch with us even after we signed our policy. They definitely made the process smooth and I would recommend them to anyone.

My best friend and I discovered Nina's when we were in elementary school. Summer after 4th grade. We graduated high school in 1998, so that would make the year 1990. It's been 30 years, and even though I don't live in the area anymore, I still make sure to stop into this family-owned shop from time to time for a pie. They are, hands down, the best pie in the area. I haven't found one that comes close! 

It's also worth mentioning that the family also owns a Mexican restaurant, Peppe's, a mile or so away. Excellent food at both locations!

On the recommendation of the server, just tried their smoked meatloaf. Took three bites hoping to get a warm piece of the leather sole on my plate. Failed to find it. Tried the green beans, but thy were so mushy, need to use a spoon. Last resort was to try the mashed potatoes....stopped at the dried (and cold) crust. 

The water was good though.

Beware. Try somewhere else.
The food was terrific, especially the hamburger. The view and ambiance of the restaurant was great. I look forward to dining their again!

Such delicious food and attentive service! Loved the hummus as well as the falafel salad we ordered. It's not much to look at, and one can be fooled that it's only a store from outside, but go in and try. They have a few tables setup inside and serve the most delicious Mediterranean food I've had in a while. Their server was a happy, smiling person. Doing his job with joy.

I used Santa Barbara Overhead door to install a gate at my home a couple years ago, and was very pleased with the service at that time.

Now 2 years later, the gate is acting up.  I have been working with them since the end of December (it is now the beginning of February), and have had truly the worst service ever.

Original technician diagnosed a new circuit board was needed.  A couple weeks go by, and I had received no call back or status.  I called them and find out the new board had not been ordered, was needing the Owners approval, and he was out on a maternity leave.  I had to wait for the owner to return to work.  He called me when he got back, and we decided to send a 2nd technician out to make sure what the problem was.

Next guy comes out 2 weeks ago, and diagnoses a different problem, and needs to order a different part.  2 weeks goes by, and no call back and no status.  I was forced to make the call out to them yet again.  They now tell me they have lost a key staff member, and are now unable to accurately diagnose the problem or repair it.  They tell me to call another company!

Incredible lack of customer service, and a disappointment that they will not stand by the work they originally did.

I highly recommend you stay away from this company - very poor service and follow through.

What an exceptional design and interior store. Rivers has such incredible taste. I was on a visit going through with family when I saw the most beautiful lamps, that were extremely well priced. Made by Aerin Lauder. 
She designs her own coffee tables.and to my taste she is a top notch designer. I bought a lamp from Rivers, but I look forward to my next trip to New Orleans to visit her gorgeous store!! I adore her classic and transitional taste with a touch of eclectic antiques. I can't wait!

Nice course in good condition. A bit pricier than we usually pay to play around.   Pace of play was good and courteous service provided both by the desk staff and cart folks on the course...  Disappointed that for the money spent that we received a golf cart without working GPS which the course advertises.  My friend's cart also stalled out on the course but staff did make a quick swap and we did not wait very long for it...

All things considered, overrated.  

Waited an hour to order to sit outside. Waiting for a seat inside would've been another 30 min
Ordered the following:
- 6 uni on top of raw scallop ($22) they were on top of some really rancid limes that made the entire bite bitter. Completely ruined the Uni.
-lobster bisque ($9) - more like tomato
 bisque. Didn't have any lobster flavor at all not worth it
- crab cakes ($15) - bland. Too many breadcrumbs? Are rock crabs just bland? I dont know but I've had better crab cakes made from canned crab. 
- 2lb rock crab ($23) this was ok but nowhere near as delicious as maryland blue crab. 2lb = 1 crab
- linguine & clams $15- prob the only really decent dish

We paid nearly $95 to wait an hour for really poor quality seafood. Did we order the wrong dishes??? I don't know, but we went to Lure Seafood the next day for happy hour and it was a much better experience. Will not come again.
Great place with a great atmosphere and a great view.  They have good quality entertainment just about every night.

Devaney's Irish Pub is an awesome place to go for drinks, hang out with friends, and enjoy a night out!

My friends and I have been coming here for a little over a year. It's in a great location, on the Faculte St. Jean campus of the UofA (just off of whyte ave). 

It is a small pub but a great atmosphere. There are always really interesting decorations on the walls and a nice little patio out back. They have lots of t.v.'s to watch any sporting event on and every Wednesday is open mic! Fun! I don't have a voice that carries very well, so it's nice to be able to go and have drinks somewhere and not have to shout just to chat at your neighbor. 

There is a large variety of food. They have an amazing steak and mushroom pot pie and their Devaney's Burger is mouthwatering! They used to have a really great spinach salad but, sadly, it is no longer on their menu. They also have great pizzas and nachos. In fact, I don't think I've ever been disappointed by anything I've ordered on the menu. 

The staff is very friendly and have even gotten to know some of our names and favorites! And the prices are very reasonable. Portion sizes are large and everyone leaves satisfied. 

We have even gone for breakfast on a weekend and it was excellent!

Overall, this is a great place to hang out with friends and have a fun night! I try and make it out a few times a month!

-Ashley Marie

Love this place!! Super clean, wonderful staff, always love my nails when I'm done! Every nail tech I've had while going here has been absolutely fantastic! My pedicures have always been so relaxing as well. I highly recommend this place and the pricing is super as well!! I always get dip and the amount of choices they have is so amazing!

YIKES!! Right as my girlfriend and I walked in we immediately felt rushed the lady at the front didn't even welcome us in and slammed the paper with our drinks on the table. when we were walking back to our table with our plate we were constantly being watched by the waitress. Not to mention the food isn't the best especially for the price (20.65 each not including drinks). once we payed and were standing to exit the waitress slammed the dust pan at our table. Very rude. And Poor quality. :(
Really good restaurant, i love the handmade lemonade and magnolia stir fry, i would appreciate if they would open up another restaurant, it's get's really packed, but overall great place to grub!

Me and my wife stayed here on January 4-5 for a portion of our honeymoon adventure along the California coast. The hotel staff were welcoming, friendly, and extremely courteous. Our room was upgraded to an ocean-view suit! In addition, the hotel staff provided us with a complementary bottle of wine and chocolate dipped strawberries to congratulate us!! Overall a great experience. Thank you. 

Cookies were amazing of course :)

Wow...this Zoo is awesome...very clean, very non stinky...interactive exhibits were great...you can handfeed giraffes, ride on camels, feed sting rays...just awesome...went on a very hot day the animals were still pretty active which usually speaks good to their health and hydration...not to mention plenty of air conditioned gift shops located all over to duck into for a quick break from the heat
Our favorite Mexican restaurant in the area!! We love this place. Great food, good service and great prices. We love the shrimp enchiladas and chips and queso!
We order a take-out. Great flavors of curry and spring roll sauce. Fresh ingredients, clean environment, and friendly service. Definitely come back and try more foods!

I don't even want to give out a star for this place. Employees are so rude and horrible. They just ruined my day by saying something very mean to me and my friend. I've never felt this much disgusted at any other places. Regardless of the quality or tast of the cheesesteak here, I will never ever come back! The employees should learn how to treat their customers. One more thing: one of the workers asked my friend whether she was a girl or a boy. What the hell? + and they laughed at us when we said we were from a country in Asia. Racists! I can't believe that people here are so uneducated in terms of treating customers right. GO TO HELL

We just moved to Idaho from Chicago and we love a good steakhouse. The appetizers were amazing I think we could even make a full meal of just appetizers- there were so many we wanted to try! My filet was great and cooked perfectly but my fiancé's ribeye was just ok. Seemed overcooked at first but towards the middle was ok, it seemed the quality of the meat was a bit below average. The sides that came with the steak were just ok as well. I think the difference is when I go to other restaurants every little detail on the plate is unexpectedly phenomenal and these just weren't. Chocolate soufflé for dessert was amazing. Service was amazing. Oh yea and the 12 minute martini is dangerous!!!! In the good way. Overall date night was successful but will probably look elsewhere for a steak but would come back for apps and drinks at least!

I have used Arizona Self Storage twice because of its convenient location. The facility is kept clean and appears quite secure. Opening an account, however, is a lengthy process. Plan on spending at least an hour for which you are charged a $15.00 administrative fee, which they assurred me would not be assessed on future rentals. This is, apparently, misinformation. This year, we called to reserve an RV storage space in September, for which we were assessed a reservation fee. We followed up with a phone call to Bruce, who identified himself as the manager. He confirmed our reservation and told us the number of our space. In early November, we called Bruce to confirm. He said they had no record of our reservation and told us to bring proof of payment. He assigned us a different space number, but told us we would have several to choose from on arrival the following week. Today, when we arrived to process the rental, there was only one space remaining, which, while adequate, was not as good as the one originally promised. We took it and spent another hour doing the paperwork. We did, however get a waiver of the administrative fee and they refunded the reservation charge. When we returned a couple of hours later to park our rig, the access code was denied, as was the second one we were given. They opened the gate for us, but at this point, they have our property and we cannot get to it unless someone is staffing the office. Supposedly, when the computer glitch is resolved, we'll finally get what we paid for. If there was a viable alternative at this late date, believe me, I would take it.

We went here twice for dinner last week during CMA Fest.  Jamie was out server both nights and he did a fabulous job. Great recommendations and just the right amount of attention. The second night he remembered our drink orders and the girls dietary restrictions.

Not to forget the food. It was great.
Great pineapple upside down mini cakes. Ordered them for a party last weekend. Loved them.

Decided to check this dog park out since it was closest to our house.  What  a great surprise!  It was so clean!!  Poop bags available at the entrance. Super friendly dog owners.  Grass area and a big sand area.  Lots of shade seats. People seem to donate items to this park... I.E. tons of tennis ball's everywhere,  a hodgepodge of outdoor wicker and plastic lawn chairs in addition to the permanently mounted park benches,  kiddie pools too!  There are clean human restrooms too!  A hose to refill water buckets around the area and even the pools.  We will be returning to let our maniac pup work off her energy!  She loved it!

This place is a small Mexican food spot. You can watch the cook make carne asada, tamales, and serve up some menudo. They have amazing red menudo on weekends! And amazing breakfast burritos all day. They always get it right even for my picky self.

Super nice!! Called 40 minutes before closing to see if they could take off a set and do a new set and they said yes!! Usually salons don't take in walk ins that close to closing but I'm so thankful they did. She was super nice and suggested we do ombré and my nails are so nice!! They're not chunky at all which is a relief !!  And they're the perfect coffin shape !!! Will come back soon. Thank you guys so much

Ordered the Simon Le Bahn to go today. Chicken was marinated perfectly and had a lot of flavors. The pickled vegetables had the perfect acidity and was a nice complement. Really enjoyed the house mayo on the nicely toasted baguette. My only wish is that I wish there was a bit more chicken on it, but I am aware that the chef hand-prepares all of the meats and would have to up the price of the sandwiches if he did so. Can't wait to try the other sandwiches!

The previous review said Rite Aide is bad. I know pharmacist job are stressful and boring so their performance is not always smooth, but at this location I encountered not one but two's, and they're dumb.
  First's, she didn't consider the time zone difference, I transferred from the PAC time zone, and the small mom & pop store opens at 10 Am PAC, means 1 PM EST. She's so upset and certainly that the phone number I gave her was absolutely was a bad number. I called myself, they have a recordings telling their hours. What they're missing is telling the hours are PAC, though I told CVS their address as well. Besides who buy medicines out of state? Except traveling?
  Second's, a young pharmacist didn't know much has to ask some body and forgot to answer my very basic question "Does my plan covers?". When I asked, shows his impoliteness. 

I will transfer to Rite Aide, if my new plan is covered. I've been with Rite Aide before, they're better than CVS, my opinion.

What a fantastic experience I had with this dealership. Honest upfront and no bs!  I have had purchased many GMCs in the past with good experience however I couldn't pass up the deal from this dealership 275 miles away from my home. I made the trip and I'm glad I did!
Kuddos to Steve Hobbs!  What a true professional in the industry and Laura Buick GMC is lucky to have him onboard!  I would highly recommend Steve Hobbs  and Laura Buick GMC. 
Also to add this dealership does HUGE volume but you don't get treated like a number you get treated like a valued customer that can't be easy to do!

This is a small little shop but it is by far the best I've been to. They don't do anything fancy like massage the neck while your nails dry or parafin dip however it is the first place I've been to that took caution around my cuticles and I left with beautiful acrylic nails and no sore or cut cuticles. Everyone there including the other patrons were very nice. Also great prices! $13 bucks for a refill! I will defiantly be back again!

This place is honestly just a tourist trap. We had gotten two doughnuts that were overly sweet and stale. The inside had this odd frosting that made the doughnut worse. Highly disappointed. Would not recommend.

Bar service was quick and really friendly. Great, delicious raw oysters. 
Sadly, a young lady appeared to pass out and whacked her poor head on the concrete floor and it was ~ 4 PM. Seriously, I hope she is OK. Paramedics were en route quickly. welcome to New Orleans  :-/

Ok, I can only give a 1 star for right now. I am deathly allergic to strawberries and I tried to get an açaí bowl without. Finally after convincing them I will die they said they could make it special. Now with that being said they put them on the top and said I only asked without in the base. I stupidly thought common sense would have said " ok allergic, nothing to do with strawberries". Furthermore, they all seem like angry teenagers. No pep here friends.... they are probably a great place but in my opinion I think I'll find a place that is more willing to keep me alive.

I really enjoyed this park, but those power lines are no joke. I could hear and feel them. 
There is a sign posted letting you know if you have medical issues that the powerlines could affect to basically not enter the park. 

There is a play area for kids, and a nice picnic area that is covered. It is also right by a creek. 

There is an area for big dogs with tunnels to go through, and an area for small dogs with smaller tunnels. 

The problem with the small dog area is that there is a huge gap in the fencing. Even-if it was half the size my dog could get out of it. 

We still played in there, and I wasn't worried at all because when I tell my dog to freeze he immediately does so- even if he is in the air he will come down, and land in a position where he does not move. 

If there is any doubt that your dog won't stop exactly when you tell him/her to please be careful or block the open spot. It is right by the road, so they would run directly into the road. 

I taught my dog how to go through tunnels here. Very happy for the experience.

Our favorite place for baked goods! We come here to get our fresh milk, muffins, biscotti, and our all time favorite - Asiago Garlic bread. Need lunch? They even have homemade soup and stuffed rolls. Fantastic baked goods, and even better staff.

Somewhat disappointed....heard such great things. Came for lunch, Slow service is an understatement. (Especially considering we were the only customers....) Turkey avocado was pretty delicious, however.  My husband had veg wrap, he said it was very good. Might come back for coffee....
Oustanding food...! A peaceful place with a lot of good things going for it...! A real treasure for Treasure island....!

We watched the renovation for North Italia in Green Hills. We were happy to see Nashville get a good Italian restaurant. We went there on New Year 's Eve for an early meal and where very impressed.
When we decided to go to the green hills area on Saturday 2/8 we looked forward to going back to North Italia.
We decided to split a Bolognese and we each got a Caesar salad.   When the Caesar was delivered my guest noticed that the waitress, (who had extremely long finger nails), had her thumb nail actually IN the salad. I wasn't paying attention to my salad at that point and even though my guest was quite put off by that we didn't say anything. Then the Bolognese arrived with another waitress; again my guest noticed that her thumb was on inside of the bowl very near the food. We still didn't say anything but were becoming very disappointed. Then it happened - extending from my mouth to the bowl was a very long black hair, (I'm grey and my guest is blond so it wasn't ours). Now we're really grossed out. I was facing the kitchen and observing the chefs and wait staff. The men were wearing baseball caps but no hair nets, one was just wearing a narrow head band. They all had long hair. Several had beards and one in particular had a gross looking beard extending several inches below his chin directly over the food he was preparing, with no protection what so ever. They all had short sleeve T shirts on. The wait staff had to go into the middle of the food prep area to get the food, they used no trays. None of them had any sort of hair protection. Most had long hair, one or two had very long pony tails, others had their hair just hanging down. 
Of course we then called our waiter over. We decided to also tell him about the fingers in the bowls as well as the hair which I had showed him. He apologized and said that they should know better about fingers hanging into the bowl. He then went to see his manager. He came back and both my guest and I understood him to say that everything was taken care of. He then came back with desert cards and said these would be complementary and asked what we would like. We weren't really interested but my guest ordered a Chia tea and a gelato, and I ordered a coffee and gelato. The coffee, tea, and one gelato appeared but not my gelato, so we shared that. He then brought the check. I looked at the check and saw that the only items removed were the  chia tea, one gelato, and my coffee. The total was $51.35. I asked my guest what her impression had been  and she said she thought it all was taken care of, certainly at least the Bolognese. She went to the restroom and I called the waiter over and I asked if he could please take me through the bill. He said sure and pointed out the adds and subtracts for the coffee, Chai tea, and the gelato, and then went to the bottom of the bill and pointed to the $51.35 and said you owe that. I wasn't in the mood to argue so I paid it and actually tipped but resolved to myself that I would bring this up on Yelp and also send a letter to the management as well. BTW throughout all of this the manager never made an appearance. Now I do not know about the health department rules. I do know that at Panera and other places, the food preparers with beards wear beard nets as well as hair nets. This is a filthy kitchen with lax rules for servers. Too bad too because the Bolognese was the best I've had, well, except for the hair part.

I usually a sucker for buffalo wings here and they were good but my burger was so plain nothing like describe that's fine but what I got mad about all our fries were cold like the reserved us someone's else fries if I'm pay I'd like fresh fries but server was nice
Wow so much variety. This place puts shame to all the grocery stores selling k-cups. The prices are way better too. Spend $400 in here and get $20 in store credit too.

The atmosphere is the best! You can't pass up an opportunity to eat while feeling like your in the sea. The huge fish tank is spectacular! Only negative was there wasn't many options for a vegetarian.

I had occasion to eat here recently with some friends who were back in town for a visit. It was a Monday evening but the joint was jumping! On the plus side, it was so noisy that no one near us was bothered by the occasionally fussy infant that was with us. On the minus side, it was hard to catch up without yelling.

I had the braised short rib. I wasn't sure, but I have found that if it is on the menu ANYWHERE and I don't get it- I always regret it. It was delicious and although not an enormous portion, enough to satisfy. I didn't capture a picture because I was too fixated on eating, so I guess I'll have to try again.

I enjoy the hustle and bustle of open kitchen restaurants, but unfortunately from where we were sitting I got a better look at the poor guy washing the dishes.

On the whole it was a great meal but the environment was only so-so. 

They do have a porch which is a great place to dine even in winter.  In fact, a dinner on that porch in December 11 years ago sealed the deal on my move to Tucson.

If it's true that they are closing this place... I regret not coming here sooner... ugh. Great sandwiches and lemonade as everyone says. Great understanding of flavor combination and how good should be. Absolutely delicious.

Easily the best donuts that I have had in quite some time. 

I actually did not visit this location myself, a co-worker brought a box in to work with him. However, based on how good these donuts were, I may have to make a visit or three.

I have been to Tortillaria on many occasions and have tried many of the menu options. The burritos are giant and I always take half home for another meal. The shimp and mango salsa burritos are absolutely fabulous, as is the guacamole burrito. If you are looking for something a little lighter, the tacos are great too.  Basically you cannot go wrong with anything at Tortillaria.  

It is also worth saying that the Happy Hour is a GREAT deal (1/2 price appetizers and cheap margaritas!). Go with some friends and enjoy a strawberry margarita or two or four and you won't regret it!

I like the bright and spacious dinning room! The service was incredible. And the bread pudding Soufflé is very special! but the food is too salty to me. A good place to bring friends and enjoyed the atmosphere.

I would give this place a no star if that was possible.  I stood for at least 5 mins waiting to be served, and there was (I kid you not) at least 10 employees standing around the kitchen area, talking, gossiping and basically ignoring me.  The place had maybe 3 other customers, so I know they weren't busy.  This wasn't a pleasant Chipotle experience, I had to repeat everything in my order at least twice, because nobody was paying attention and I am pretty sure I won't be returning to that place again.  There is one closer to work that I haven't had an issue with.

This place is a true local bakery. I honestly had no idea this place was over here, which is surprising to me because I used to frequent the K&S Market that is the same strip mall. Anyway, this place was pretty busy when we stopped by around 4pm on a Sunday. I think that we were the only non hispanic customers in the store. 

The bakery is set up pretty straight forward. When you walk inside, the left side has drinks and refrigerated pies and cakes, on the right side is all the different pastries in glass, self serve cabinets. You grab a tray and tongs and pick out what you want. The trays are the same you get at a fast food restaurant that usually have the white paper liner. These trays don't have liners, I guess they clean them, but I wished they had some kind of parchment paper to put the items on instead of directly on the tray. 

There is a huge selections of conchas, Mexican sweet breads, churros, oreja, and pan de colotes. I didn't know these names until I googled for them. They don't have any names or prices listed at the cabinet area. They don't even have prices listed up at the front counter. We picked 5 different items and the total after tax was $4.46. Not bad at all. The guy that bagged our stuff was nice, the guy that rung us up was on his phone and didn't say the total or the change or anything. 

Of the 5 items we got, my favorite was the concha. I also liked the one item that looks like a triangle hot pocket that is filled with cream cheese (i think). The large round one with the strips was a little dry, but for the price I think that all of them were worth it. I will be back.

This is a must visit in Philadelphia for breakfast coffee or breakfast sandwiches. The breakfast sandwich is made right then and there. Nothing is frozen and everything was fresh. Very helpful owners and patient while we looked at the menu.
This Subway as far as staff goes has gone down hill. The food itself is still the same but that is just a standard and the place is clean. Just not the most friendly group here.

I was so excited about this place and made reservations for 11 for my birthday dinner at 8:30pm Saturday. We ended up waiting a little over 30 min to get seated but even though we all was starving we all was taken back by the beautiful view of our city! The view here is AMAZING!!! If it wasn't for the view i wouldn't have given 3 stars. One of my best friend came here for another birthday dinner and she said they got a card a birthday dessert well i didn't get any of that. I ordered 16oz bone in new york strip medium and it was tough. And i ordered the mac and cheese which was ok. I was able to try the other sides and they all were ok to me, but my cocktail was good. Service was mediocre but i still tipped good.  Nothing for me to brag about. But the views here are definitely worth coming back to!

I'm not sure what's better- the decor of this restaurant or the food! Okay it's a tie. My fiancée and I were in the area and thanks to great Yelp reviews, we stopped for lunch. We each got drinks, and then split a salad and the "Shue" (BBQ Chicken) pizza. We enjoyed everything! The service was great and now all I need is whoever decorated the place to come do my house! :)

So yummy! FYI the pitas are deceptive, they look small but they're very dense and filling. The staff greeted us and talked us through the menu since it was our first time visiting. Will definitely go back!

Great place I just stumbled on, for being  locked down they were very friendly asked if I would like to sit down an wait, asked for some extras an I'll more needy than some other people may be but they were fast everything was correct an fresh on every aspect, had asked about hash browns  was told he was only doing fried and asked if that was ok that if I really needed it he would accommodate me, 
Give it a try i don't think you will dissatisfied at all
not bad.  pricey for what it is.  the view from inside isn't as good as you would expect.
Free parking, cheap flights, great location. Highly recommended! Remember to pay for your checked luggage prior to departure to save on fees.

Wound up here after Einsteins completely screwed the pooch and we left empty handed.  I was bound and determined to get a bagel with cream cheese but the wife and kid wanted sandwiches with egg so that ruled out the best bagel place in St. Louis.  Literally drove right past the Bagel Factory to get here but it was worth it...because they use Bagel Factory bagels.

I asked for a couple of slices of lox with my bagel just because I was in that kind of mood.  The lox was absolutely perfect.  Mild smokiness, tender and sliced thick enough to not fall apart yet thin enough to be slightly translucent.  Not overly salty.  Just plain perfect!  The waitress charged me $7 for the two slices which seemed a little high but I didn't see it on the scale so I could be wrong.

I also tried a couple of bites of the wife's latkes and they were very good.

Really good, good customer service. Would recommend it to anybody. I got Salmon, Tuna and white noodles all were good. I go this place pretty often. Their spicy mayo sauce is good. They also let you try proteins before buying it.

The oysters here are awesome.  I haven't really been a fan of cooked oysters until I've had them here.  Most of the bad reviews seem to come from the service.  My group didn't have any problems, but then again, it wasn't so busy when we went.

The crawfish are also good, but I dont' have anything else to compare them to since this was the first time I've had them.

The health clinic is a joke. First of all I call the store to see if they have a health clinic.  the girl that answered the phone didn't know and she works there.  Bad employee training or she is just stupid. Filled out a bunch of stuff on the computer. It was noon and the first appointment was at 2:20 or 320. I thought it was a walk-in clinic. Nobody ever came out. At 1 o'clock I left. It said her lunch hour is at one. Would not go back.
I love this place and everything on the menu.  You must try the Oysters and the crab and corn bisque!

This was fantastic!  The Jugg sisters are so much fun.  Appreciate the rules they set out and the way they included everyone on the bus.  This was fun for everyone in our group and would definitely recommend this to anyone in Nashville.

Arrived on a Friday late afternoon/ early evening hoping for happy hour specials... come to find out there are none on Fridays but that was ok. The food and service stood on its own and delivered a great first time experience at this establishment. I ordered a bottle of unfiltered sake, volcano roll, What the buck and K-town aaannnndd mochi ice cream while I waited on friends to arrive... all delicious and filling!!! My server Demi was great!!! I'm adding this to my sushi joint rotation! 
**Happy Hour  M-Th 5p-8p, $10 rolls

After extensive Yelp and Google search for Canada passport photograph in this area, I found Photography Center to be reasonably priced ($15 for 2 pictures). Other photo labs in this area were either charging ridiculous amount because of the custom size requirement (non US size) or were not available to do custom size at all. It was fairly quick - 15 mins to get the picture clicked and printed. Lighting could have be a little better as it was a little dark. But I am okay as long as the picture gets accepted :)

*LOCAL Patron- have eaten at Karamelo King since 2005* 
First let me tell you that this place is amazing, food wise, 
The *CARNE ASADA TACOS* are King* 
Flour is my go to. Having eaten here for over 13 years now I've tried it all, but those tacos are to die for. 
This place has changed a ton since I first began going. 
It is a food truck, with an outdoor grill separate from the actual food "stand". It has now become an actual sit down place with a converted store front that customers can sit inside and dine at. (Used to be outdoor picnic tables only- several years ago- but not any longer- and, yes they have a restroom with running water inside). 
The same family has always been there and running it since I began coming here, great people, great food, but the people who dine there are of course from all walks of life. 
*If you go in on a hardcore night expect it to be busy, expect the salsa bar to be a bit rough, the amount of people who come and go is absurd if you're actually aware of that exact fact* so don't condemn the short handed family on days like that, be aware that so many people flood this stand it's unreasonable to think that they can always maintain it with the on hand staff, given the location and during rush hour times.
PS they stay open late on the weekends and yes this is THEE spot to go if you're local af and go out for food after the Tucson nightlife scene. 
The pico is ridiculously good, hope you like spicy, if you're boring though, the meat is bomb enough, guaranteed. 
Tons of pickled onions, carrots, peppers etc- and of course salsas. 
*parking can be a pain, again this is usually from people who don't know what's going on, because if you frequent this place, it's obvious how *not to park in this one driveway in & out lot, so be advised* 
*the family takes holidays off so don't go when there's a legit holiday aka Easter, Christmas, thanksgiving etc. sometimes in the summer I've seen them take vacay but it's rare* 
*clean up after yourself*, there are recycle racks for glass bottles, trash cans, and napkins, everyone eats at the same tables inside and the employees like I said can't maintain a rush of 50plus people in this small area, and it's more common then you might think, but if you go on a docile night, expect to get your food lightening fast. 

Don't get bent out of shape and be considerate, not a slob...families, young, old, students etc all eat here. 
This is real Tucson, the food the location, and the people who go, most definitely authentic. 

The pics I attached are from my latest visit.
Not really sure what the prices are ($2.50ish per tacos) but I have a menu pic in my phone from awhile back I may upload later.
5 carne tacos and 2 drinks came right up to 15$ and I factually know that can't be beat in Tucson especially on taste. 

Xo, I love Karamelo King

Came here on a Monday evening around 7pm. Passing through on vacation and saw it on Yelp. Wait was about 15 mins. The place was very loud inside, but kind of like "rowdy family get-together" kind of loud. It's not so much that the place is messy, but the people eating there are messy. The wait staff was super nice and you can tell they try to keep things clean and orderly. But it's an uphill battle. I think buffets bring out the worst in people.  With that being said, the food was very good. The salads were all fresh and tasty. I didn't try every single thing on the buffet, but my favorite things were the fried green tomatoes, fried catfish, the salads, mashed potatoes, green beans, cheddar biscuit - I can't remember anything else, it's kind of a blur. I didn't even make it to the desserts but they also looked good (brownies, cakes, etc). Bonus -  it was kids eat free night, woo hoo! Cost was $15 per person for the all you can eat. Forgot to take a pic, I forgot who I was with all that buffet craziness going on.

I have been here 3 times now.  I could not get an appointment with my primary as fast as I knew I needed so instead of getting upset I just walked on over to the Urgent Care.  They have free parking, the place was clean and I was comfortable while I waited. I didn't wait long and I was seen. The receptionists were very helpful and friendly - Noella and Marcy. Marcy went out of her way to get my insurance confirmed since my company just switched. She handled all of it for me (thank you Marcy!) Noella helped me get my prescriptions to the right place since you know how it goes...bad timing for the car to be in shop! So she made sure they were sent right there to that Walgreens on Broad Street. I just walked around the corner to Walgreens, then hit the subway to get to work. It was perfect! Dr. Demedio was awesome and gave me great instructions and the perfect medicine. I have a staph infection from messing up my new tattoo's aftercare. I have many tattoos but there was a problem with this one. And after I spent the night prior on google trying to figure out what it was - guessing staph, I was a mess by morning. Maybe not a good idea to do that!  Couldn't get a regular appointment so plan B, my favorite Urgent Care. I felt so much better when I left. Thank you guys!!!!

I was able to try this food truck at the Tampa grilled cheese fest. I'm so disappointed in the service I received. To start i walked around and caught interest in this food truck being the line was not as long as the others and some of the menu items seemed as if they would be good. I understand that there's a lot of people so wait time would be a issue so I waited about 20 minuets to place my order then about 20 minuets to get my order. But in that time the lady in the truck kept yelling out and messing up the names to orders as well as informing everyone there running low on stuff. I'm upset to see the price jump in the menu being what was posted very recently in a review compared to what's posted for this festival. The prices just don't make sense for the product there putting out. I had got the gambino grilled cheese and the Eliot's untouchable fries. The grilled cheese was so small for $7. The fries where such a small portion and barley coated with there seasoning and as far as "hand cut" goes the fries where just frozen fries out of a bag. I was looking forward to trying the secret homemade fry sauce the most with my meal and I'm disappointed that the fries come with a small cup on the side maybe .5 oz container all for $3 bucks. After spending $11 on a meal and still starving I sadly won't be returning here in the future.

Wine Edventures made for an amazing experience and birthday surprise for my boyfriend.  Hans, our guide, was hysterical and so knowledgeable.  I threw out some questions that I wasn't sure would be within the realm of anything we were discussing, and he knew all of the answers!

The $95 is absolutely worth it.  We traveled up to an hour from SB and visited three wineries and one tasting room---all were distinctly different and offered wonderful wines.  The lunch that was provided (you pick what you want in the morning) was great!   It came with a sandwich, a few sides, fruit, and dessert. 

We were a group of about 22, which made me nervous initially.  Hans did an awesome job of incorporating everyone and making the group instant friends.  He knew so much about the area and about the entire process of winemaking from grape to bottle- it was so nice to learn while standing in the vineyards!  

I would recommend this tour to anyone who is looking to learn a good amount about wine while also being in a non-snobby environment.  Five stars wine edventures!

Came into town this last Friday on what is know as the off season. After a terrible dinner at the Chinese restaurant down the way, I needed a stiff drink.  Walk down the street around 9pm and no frickin bar in town was open then we stumbled upon the Washoe Club.  We walked in and there were a few locals hanging out playing poker we asked them if we could still get a drink and they all welcomed us in poured us some very strong drinks and we spent the rest of the evening chatting in up with the locals(best experience I could hope for)  I hate run of the mill tourist spots and this is def not that bar.  Cool bar with some great history.  The crypt is creepy as hell and made for a fun visit.  Drank all night Jack and coke and only ran up a 48 dollar bar tab! Everyone is so laid back and helpful this is a cool old town and I will def only hit this bar when i come back.

The flavors of the meats I tried were really good.  Not extremely smokey flavored.  But they were a little dry.  The sides I tried (green beans, BBQ beans, sweet & sour cole slaw, bacon mac & cheese) were ALL very tasty.  And yes, I ask to try a bite of everyone's choices!  Very friendly staff and they offer military discount!

The food at smile cafe really took me by surprise. We stopped by for a quick meal while visiting the area. The service was prompt and the food was delicious. I would definitely stop by at your first opportunity.

Review is for drinks only.

Mixology at its finest.  Glad I checked this place out, but probably don't need to return unless I'm waiting to be seated at the Pharmacy.  Service was great, as was the drink.

Fun to check out at least once for anybody.

Consistent, clean, and CARLOS!

First, its machines and equipment are Consistently up and running. If something is not, it gets fixed, fast.
Clean: I see the cleaning staff constantly going through and cleaning and doing their job properly- albeit i'm an evening visitor mostly
Carlos: the most awesome trainer ever. 

Which is to say that if you stop and consider why you might join a gym like this, its based on their equipment, their classes and the excellence of their trainers. And the facilities like whirlpools in each locker room, sauna, and optional features like professional massages and (most insurance-covered) nutrition services, are top notch too!
Thanks for reading!

I love tacos. I could eat them every day. Loco Pez hits the spot when I need to satiate my craving for delicious, flavorful, fresh tacos. The cochinita pibil tacos are my favorite, and the black beans are a great side. Tacos are on the small side, so order three (or thirty). Cash only.

As an added bonus, tacos from Loco Pez will cure your depression. 98% of people have seen this, but for those that havent, I leave you with this. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zYpuuLLKQx4
I guess technically an ego waffle with some dried out chicken wings on top is "Chicken & Waffles" but I wouldn't recommend it.

Earthbound Brewing is a beer lover's haven. It's a shotgun space that I'd imagine fills up quickly. The vibe and space are intimate and warm. More importantly, beer. I tried the magnificent Pecan Chicory Stout. I wanted to try more but I was driving and their beers lean towards the higher ABV. Everyone in our party beamed about their beers. I'm looking forward to going back, especially after their expansion.

I have ordered there three times. My son ordered the hot wings - loved them.  However, if you like your wings dry these are not for you. I ordered the pizza - highly recommend. The delivery service was excellent and a surprisingly good online ordering menu.

Oh Tampa, Florida...my home town.  Place where I grew up, then I went up to Gainesville for college and started drinking beer...then I started homebrewing...and eventually drinking "good" beer.

It's a pleasure to finally have a decent brewery in Tampa (Tampa Bay Brewing is actually also very good, but you have to visit the brewery to get any of there beer, which is too bad).  I came here while visiting family back in Tampa (I've moved out to the US craft beer mecca since) and it was about like I expected.

Chill, no-frills brewery that if you come on the right days you can sample beer and buy pints (no food or...cigars on the premises,which is kind of odd).   I had the IPA which was solid, but as an IPA geek I've had many, many better.  The espresso brown ale was outstanding though!

Definitely worth a stop if you're in Tampa.

They were selling a double brown ale though for....$20 a bottle!  Really guys?  That's pretty bold for an upstart, and I seriously doubt your materials were that expensive.  Beers you can only buy for one day a year at other breweries cost less.

Food is always really good here. We usually order delivery but today we were driving by and stopped in. The service was horrible. The people behind the counter were not friendly At all and on their phones the entire time. We waiting wayyyyy too long for our food and it wasn't like they were busy, we were the only people there. I understanding there waiting while out food was waiting on the counter for 5 min. Very disappointed. When we got home our food was cold and my vegan falafel had cheese all over it. I had to go back and get a new one. They didn't offer me anything not a coupon for the next time I came. Needless to say I will not be going back.
Best pedicure ever!  Kim, the owner was great. She was super friendly and did a wonderful job on my feet, I also dig that her family was there helping.  Support local small businesses.

Went in this morning, they didn't have the model of car I reserved, so I got a free upgrade. Was advised they would call or I could call to see if what I wanted came in. I called in the afternoon to advise, I would be willing to drive somewhere to get what I wanted. They called back within the hour to advise Zach had found what I was looking for. Thank you to everyone who helped me!

The food was phenomenal! We checked in on Yelp and got a chicken and sausage jambalaya teaser for free.  It was awesome.  Then we both ordered red beans and rice.  My side was mustard greens and my husband selected the Mac n cheese.  The owner came by twice to chat with us and make sure we were happy with our food.  Our waitress was very friendly. The atmosphere is nothing to brag about but once the food hits your mouth you forget all about that.  I'm still salivating over our lunch, insanely good.  I also ordered a margarita that was a house special of the day. It was so tasty!

I basically put my feet in like warm water and he painted my toenails... like a 5 year old would. They get plenty of traffic because it's in the mall but save yourself some money, this place is terrible!

Edubirdie is a good website. It helps me with a lot with my english essays. Im giving it a 4 stars because most writers claim to have so many degrees but when they send you the paper the grammar needs major improvement. I asked I writer to revise a paper 3 times and they still did not get it. (mind you it was not a hard essay). I just paid them and took the paper and corrected it on my own. Tips for edubirdie.. be careful who you choose to write your paper cheaper is not always better and if you find a writer(s) try to stay with them.

Great new spin on hot chicken.  Plenty of options on them menu other than hot chicken.  Awesome selection on tap (plenty of local brews) and cocktail menu is very unique and delicious.  Brunch menu is legit, too - you have to try the stuffed french toast w/ hot chicken (their own spin of the chicken and waffles).

Very disappointed.   The hostess wasn't very friendly, and was making people wait in the cold lobby to get a seat at the bar.  Yet, every dinner table was full.  So much for 50% capacity.  We took pictures and will be sending them to the local authorities.   The meal was poor, our steaks were basically raw and had no flavor.  And it's overpriced, as if it downtown pricing.   Our server was moderately attentive.  This is a hard pass if dining in Belle Meade.
Quesadillas were very good, large portions easily shareable.  Buffalo chicken salad was very good. Atmosphere is simple and casual but great food and great service.
Totally bad and I never make bad reviews. Waited 3 hours for a table food came an hour after we sat. Staff was very nice. Managment needs more structure.

I've been here twice and is a must-have when I am in Santa Barbara. I just love their Agaves Enchiladas & Agaves Burrito. I would also recommend getting guacamole on the side. The sauce on top is creamy and yummy and I love the seafood with the mangos. Everything goes together so well and is super flavorful!
This Starbucks is straight. Drive thru service sucks, but if you're coming in to study or chat with friends the baristas at the register are a lot nicer than the drive thru folks.

The atmosphere at Rippy's is very kitchy and touristy, as with any bar in the downtown Broadway area.  The food is all-around not very good. Unusually enough, the pulled pork resembles canned tuna in both taste and appearance.  The service is hit and miss, but there is one bartender that is fantastic. On a similar note, the drinks are well poured and well priced. If I were going to go anywhere on the strip for live music and drinks, this would be it, but I would eat beforehand. 

I would give Rippy's 2.5 stars overall as a place to get a drink, 4 stars in relativity to the rest of the strip for that same purpose, and 1 star for dining relative to anywhere.

Food and service were excellent. The staff was very helpful in finding us gluten free options (you can ask for gluten free pasta!). Clean and pleasant. Had a great Friday night. Accessible for wheelchairs. Very recommended!

Came here on the Cinco (de mayo). Was expecting it to be busy and get bad service as a result. It was busy, but the service was awesome. With the amount of people they have here? That's impressive. The food and drinks were great. Highly recommend it! Corey and Ande were great!
If you like spicy food you may like theirs.  I did not.  Maybe "South" Indian should have given me a clue.
Thursday is $2 Martini night! It's a great deal and the drinks are strong. The food is good here.

Great place for pizza. Affordable and the owners seem like nice folks. I order my pizza and then head next door to grab a few things from savemart and swing by for pickup when I'm done. 
Clean. Friendly staff.

Incredibly delicious cake. Yes the cake is pretty pricey, but it's no cheaper than what you'll spend at a Cheesecake Factory except this cake is better. It's moist and there are big servings! You have to be careful to get there by a certain time or the cake you want could be gone. The decor is extremely cute and I love the shop.

I can't say enough great things about the wonderful folks at the Human Society! We went in looking for a dog and they were so wonderful! They listened carefully to our needs and did not blink an eye when we said that our small condo would only accept small dogs and that we were worried about allergies. In fact they simply used this information to narrow the search to small pups with hair instead of fur. 

With a glint in her eye, the kind woman at the front desk said she knew just the dog for us. They took us to a visiting room and within a short time the pup parade began. They brought in an adorable dog who while very sweet we didn't click with. I was worried that they might be unhappy that we didn't feel like this dog was for us - again not at all! It was simply on to the next, the dog that that thought might be our guy. Sure enough he was! I knew instantly this pup was for us and he seemed to too! 

The adoption process was easy and the requested donation was nominal. As we left with our new family member they rang a bell and you could tell that all the staff were thrilled to have saved another life. 

When I called a few weeks later to request immunization records I cried on the phone as I thanked them for saving my new family member and matching him with us! He is such an amazing little guy and without this no kill shelter his life could have ended far to early. We later learned that they had lovingly kept him for three long months. Far longer then most shelters would have hung in there. Also, in addition to updating his vaccines they had neutered & groomed him while he was there.  

I cannot say enough about the hero's from the Human Society! If you are thinking about a pet - start here!!! They have amazing dogs, all sorts of breeds including specialty breeds and all ages. 

In case you have any doubts remaining just take a look at our adorable snoodle who has made our family complete!
Friendly prompt service. Great drink selection. Best bbq place around. My wife and I eat here all the time

We craved Chinese, and found this place last year. Went back again with a group of 6, and found the food even better, service prompt. I don't understand why there aren't more people here, but it is off HWY 19, in a rather empty shopping center. But the food is wonderful, reasonably priced too. The salt and pepper shrimp were spot on. Mongolian beef was good too. One word of caution: share your entrees or make sure you have room in your refrigerator for leftover.
