Things have only gotten worse. Initially, after I wrote my review, they seemed to work on fixing things, so I felt hopeful. But in the past few weeks, machines keep breaking down, which is bound to happen, but I don't understand why it takes so long to fix them.

This came to a head Sunday, which was unusually busy. I went with my friend to workout, and my favorite treadmill was still "temporarily" out of order (it's my favorite because it's close to the air conditioner), and all the others in that area were being used. So I thought I'd just use one at the other end, one nobody every uses - I found out why they never use them - they are "temporarily" out of order! The two that weren't, the handle bars were so rusted I almost cut my hand.

I think if YouFit Gandy wants to compete with Crunch Fitness, which I just signed up for, they need to invest in some new, modern equipment.
It was good and no lack of food.

I feel like posting the general manager's response to my husband's review says it all...

"7/2/2020This is so beyond inaccurate and untrue.  Compensation was offered.  However their expectations and demands where so unreasonable.  What kind of knucklehead travels 4 hours to buy a trailer they can purchase locally?  
We can fix a lot of things but we can't fix stupid!  Wow not one piece of truth here."

Everything written in my husband's review was accurate. We never said no compensation was offered; but the compensation offered was a joke.  They never offered for us to leave the RV there to get fixed and come back when it was ready because the sales manager made it VERY clear that he did not want to do the deal in the first place and that the sales guy gave us too good of a deal.

I will not resort to name calling as the very unprofessional general manager has done, but I will say this, I have NEVER had a man not stand when I entered his office, not offer me a chair to sit in, or how about even offer for me to come in to his office to discuss while I stood outside in plain sight.  

Instead of calling us stupid knuckleheads for traveling 4 hours to your business, shouldn't a manager be appreciative of every customer they have? (and no, this unit is not available for us to get locally) 

I have a call in to both of the owners in regards to the treatment I (not even speaking for my husband) received by both Dan and Scott Hayden.

I can't recommend this place enough. I was in Illinois for work for about 5 days and my meal was so good I went back again the next day. It was one of the best steaks I've ever had in my life and the salad was incredible, I couldn't believe how good it was. I treated myself to some creme brûlée too and just wow. The staff is all super friendly and the clientele is great too, I loved chatting and getting to know people at the bar. 

Hopefully I get to go back to Illinois for work again just so I can have another meal here!

Our group was there for an appreciation lunch. The quality of the food was good, as usual, but I don't think that management scheduled enough people for this group and the patrons that came to enjoy lunch. I feel that our server did the best she could; however, in the past we have had two servers. Only having one slowed down the serve time.

This is my favorite restaurant and Reno, so I was delighted to see that one was opening right next to my place of work. I was greeted with a hug when I walked in during their very first hour of business ever! I cannot recommend this place highly enough. The food is amazing, the prices are extremely reasonable, and the staff is incredibly friendly. Not to mention how good the food is. Just to make sure I emphasize this sufficiently: the food is just fantastic.

Such an amazing place tucked away in New Orleans. If you're not looking you'll miss it. We stopped in for lunch and got to sit in the patio. This place is a gem. Service was excellent and the food amazing.  Hubby enjoyed his Moscow mule. He soad it was refreshing. We tried the pork belly appetizer and it was amazing! Well seasoned with a great balance of meat and fat. The skin was crispy but wished it was a little bit crisper. Hubs had the baked chicken and it was so well seasoned and the sides complimented it very well. I had the braised pork that they batter coated and pan fried on top of collard greens. It was delicious. I dont like collard greens but I definitely ate these. We were so stuffed that we didnt have room for dessert. We really enjoyed dining here that I competed one of their little comment cards we received with our check. A couple of days after our visit to New Orleans, I received and email thanking us for visiting and responding to my comments letting me know they read my card. Now that's customer service. We will definitely be back when we visit NOLA again.

I chose Besh Steak for my birthday dinner and I was not let down. To get started, we were brought an amuse bouche of deviled eggs with a caviar topping. They were almost too good to simply call deviled eggs. I was chasing every bit of the filling around the plate to make sure I got it all.
I've been to Besh before several times, so I knew to order the BBQ Shrimp app automatically. It's the only item on the menu with the description, "just get these," and it's appropriate. They were as overwhelmingly delicious and rich as I remembered. In addition to the shrimp, I ordered the pate app which was also rich, delicious and plentiful. 
While we were eating the apps, we also enjoyed a couple of cocktails, a Sazerak and a Mississippi Mule. Both cocktails were smooth and refreshing. The Sazerak was particularly good. After the cocktails, we ordered a couple glasses of wine which were both very good. 
For entrees, we ordered the 30-day dry aged Prime New York Strip and the double-cut grilled pork chop. Both meats were perfectly prepared and succulent. The steak came with blue cheese butter, onion rings and bone marrow. The onion rings were awesome and crispy, but the bone marrow was a bit of a let down. Considering how big the steak was though, I was not concerned or put off by the bone marrow. The pork chop was huge and came with a crab and corn orzo risotto which blew my mind it was so good. The jumbo lump crab and corn risotto had been recommended to me and I was not disappointed. 
For dessert, I ordered the bread pudding with Irish Whiskey ice cream, bourbon sauce and carmelized pecans. I'm not much for dessert or bread pudding, but I made an exception in this case. It was incredible and I only wished there had been more of the ice cream. Yum!
The service is consistently excellent at Besh and this was no exception. It is expensive, but for food and service this good, the prices make sense.

It's not fast food but it's well worth the wait for this delicious, from scratch soul food. My favorites are the southern fried chicken tenders with a bacon-infused waffle and the Korean sauce on the boneless wings, which is killer; it's probably some of the best Korean wing sauce I've tasted.

This is one of the cleanest, most well stocked stores I have ever seen. Now I usually don't like to shop at expensive stores, but I did find this worth it. The employees were smiling, and singing as they did their jobs. The music was pleasing. Store was clean as a whistle. I actually felt at ease, and wasn't overly crowded or busy. If you want to be in a pleasing atmosphere the this Raleys is the one for you. I will definitely be back.

I have a soft spot for this hometown cafe but this morning at 9:30 a.m. their pastry stock was very low. There a fresh pie on the counter that they refused to serve me because it was "cooling" . I order a peanut butter cookie, not only was it small it was hard and had no peanut butter taste, so I took it back and traded for an oatmeal raisin.It was hard, stale and tasteless..I returned it too and asked if they get their cookies from the Dollar Store. I was told they bake their own! 
They have gone down hill - waaay down. That's just sad

We did a carry out order which we have done several times with no issues.    This time we got there right at the time they said the food would be ready only to find out they gave another customer our order.   They gave us the option of getting the order or leaving.   They never offered to pay for the meal or even give an option for next meal discounts.   What they did was give us a $5 coupon and minus one meal.   

So as you can imagine I will most likely not do business there again.   Very disappointing on the service side, but for the food we did receive it was very good.

I expected more from a restaurant where we eat often.

If you're looking for dim sum in Philly, I would only recommend Dim Sum Garden. Make sure you get there before the crowd on the weekend lunch and dinner hours, or else you'll be waiting in a long line to get a table (which speaks volumes). 

Any trip to Dim Sum Garden is incomplete without the soup dumplings - make sure you try these, and eat them the right way if you want to actually enjoy it. Our group ordered a lot of food and we ended up really full. The best part was that the total only came out to $40 between 4 of us. If you're in town for the weekend and want to have good food in Chinatown, definitely stop by.

The food here is phenomenal if you're looking for a place to splurge, as it's on the spendier side. The different levels allow you to choose your atmosphere so it's good for date night, family night, or catching up with old friends. Their live music on the second floor is excellent, but you have to pay to access that level which we weren't told upon entering. Server was very attentive.

I've gone here a few times with my boyfriend, out of convenience and avoidance of Starbucks. Unfortunately the service is almost always disappointing. I'll describe a few instances:

One time I went in for a small holiday-spiced latte with soy. The barista bragged about how he was vegan and would take care of me. After paying $5-ish for the drink and a nice tip, I get a coffee with about 75 percent foam. What a rip off.

This past Sunday we were looking to get some coffee at 6:45, and we headed to the shop. There was a guy standing outside, trying to get in, wondering why the door was locked and yet the open sign was on with posted hours for a 7pm closing.

We waited around, trying to even see the staff member hiding in the back. We drove around to the drive thru portion and saw her (brunette) ignoring the man tapping on the glass at the front and our engine running.

She closed up and ignored at least two customers 10 minutes before closing because she already cleaned up the machinery.

After grabbing dreaded Starbucks, we drove past the shop and saw her counting the till at the front counter.

Horrible customer service.

Don't waste your time with this company. Starbucks employees are welcoming and more hospitable than these people.

I wasn't sure what to expect when I came here. It was kind of a fall back when cup cafe had an hour long wait. However, I was so pleasantly surprised. I got the chiquilles for brunch and it was phenomenal. The sauce was spicy but flavorful. The corn tortillas were cut into triangles so you didn't have to worry about cutting through a hard tortilla. It really came together nicely. Great place for brunch! If you're in a hurry I wouldn't recommend this place though, the service was very slow.

Rude service. 
Everyone we encountered this evening acted as though I knocked on their front door in the middle of the night and requested an order of fried rice and sweet and sour chicken. 

Erroneously charged for hoisin and Siracha. 
When I questioned the extra $1.50 on the bill I'm told, "We always charge for these. It's common sense." 

My niece noted on the way home, "this is what we get for eating at a place that has cockroaches scurrying around the kitchen."
This wasn't the best order with them. The shrimp were over cooked and I paid for extra sauce not didn't have much sauce at all.

Food was delicious as usual. This is probably my favorite place to eat sushi. Jenni our server and she was really polite and nice! 
I just dont understand why when the place is empty they want to give you the worst table! But anyways the food and service were awesome!

Love the decor and the fact they have a beer named after me (haha).  It was busy but did not feel crowded, and our server was on e of the best I have met. He explained how competitive the job was, how they kept the best of the best, and I believe him.  I was surprised we were able to get a reservation on pretty short notice for Mother's day. All in all a great experience and will go back when we have guests in town.
Off the beaten path little diner with really good comfort food. Set in the 50's decor. Staff is very friendly and fast.

I love this place for the Rib Cook off! It just makes the weekend alot easier beacuse your right there in the middle of everything. Best part is if you need a break you just go back to your room and rest. Then right back down to the Cook Off.

Super friendly service!
We haven't had a problem with bugs, specifically spiders, since their first visit.

We have been coming here since my first son was ever born! We were never disappointed
always leave full! And the food is always good, you also have to try there steamed ginger scallion fish, it's the best fish I have ever had, it's good every time, and also the beef fried rice is amazing just put a little bit of soy sauce and it tastes amazing! Also the fried pork dumpling are delicious, it always comes with sauce, and it's nice and plump! Overall this place is the best and has the best fish I have!

Ott's is a worthwhile destination because of the quality of the experience you will receive.

Not the typical greenhouse/garden center at all!

- Very large selection.
- Prices seem fair.
- Unusual discoveries await you here.

You might feel like you are at Longwood Gardens after you walk into their really tall greenhouse.

Recommended.

Probably best to avoid weekends during the warmer times of the year. They said it was crazy last weekend.
We came here for a Sunday brunch. Everything was quite standard for brunch items, do know if it is worth the slightly higher-than-average price.

Great BBQ. I've only got to eat there once, and I've tried about 3 or 4 times. It's always way too packed, and they don't accept reservations... Good for them, bad for me. Maybe they could expand their building, or accept reservations on certain days. I'll be back, as long as I can get in!

Channelside is a fantastic place to hang out at. There is plenty of places to eat, a few shopping locations, and a IMAX theater upstairs. The best part has to be Splitsville in my opinion, which turns from a sushi bowling place, into a night club kind of atmosphere along with a bar at night. Hooter' is also located here, though it is not the most attractive part.

Who would of thought that an independent restaurant on the Hotel grounds would deserve 5 stars but it does. We came for breakfast and we were greeted by very friendly staff.  Hit flavorful coffee while perusing the menu was a great beginning.  Unusual selection.  They even cure their own thick sliced bacon here with maple flavor.  My husband chose the grain pancakes, flax, quinoa and other grains. He was delighted at the texture and hot syrup.  I had their house eggs Benedict which was served on sour dough toast, tomato, lettuce, bacon and perfectly cooked eggs.  Wonderful just wonderful and satisfying.

Wait, what??

My son rented an apartment here and basically had the same complaints as others...noise, roach problems, etc. but he moved on and rented somewhere quiet and clean the following year, no big deal.  Imagine our surprise when almost a year later, we are contacted by a collection agency for ~$1,000 in charges Palm Shadows never billed for or explained despite having my complete contact information.  I have to question the kind of business that turns you over to a collection agency before even presenting you with a bill or calling you, and that too nine months later.  It makes for a very stressful situation. 

The renters are almost exclusively young, not necessarily experienced students who don't remember, or didn't pay attention to all of the contractual requirements, so please be aware that you will need to provide at least 30 days notice that you will not be renewing your lease, or a year later you will be contacted by a collection agency for one month's extra rent plus...

Yelp doesn't allow half stars, or I'd add .5 to my 3-star rating.

First of all, Jan & Hollis are nice people who own this poorly named good Thai place.  We live within walking distance & mild dyslexia kicked in as I thought it was called "MENU" Fan (for years) before my wife corrected me. It's written in cursive, & also spelled incorrectly ("Meun Fun") with their email list gathering website.  "Menu Fan" seemed a dumb name for a decent Thai place. Unfortunately, "Meun" is not much better.  I've been to Thailand 4-5 times and have no idea what that anagram for "menu" means.  It always fascinates me when local businesses succeed in spite of being poorly named. Someone slept through their Marketing 101 class.

The food (the main point, of course!) is good.  

There are a couple of original dishes we get every time. The Fresh Rolls are delicious.  Fresh salad wrapped in rice skins w/a wonderful salad dressing dip. The quality overall is decent.  It's not cheap & portions are not large, but it's good.

What has disappointed me is their lack of interest in substitution or cooking anything other than exactly what's on the menu. 

I like almost every vegetable on the planet but can't stand bell peppers. They will omit them from an order, but refuse to add Bok Choi, or broccoli instead. Seems a small gesture to cook what the customer requests. Perhaps the chefs are on autopilot and can't customize orders? I don't believe I should have to pay more for a simple substitution, but that wasn't even an option.  After 8-10 years of patronage (including catering), we've easily spent thousands there.  It's diminishing not to be able to order exactly what we want.

I've had the same problem trying to get a batch of noodles spicy enough. It's comedic. No matter how many "very, very, very spicy" requests, the drunken noodles taste the same.  This is probably fine w/folks who like blander, less spicy food, but it's kind of funny how I have to doctor everything once we get it home. When you eat inside the restaurant, they'll bring a hot sauce/fish sauce tray that's great. They've never done this with takeout.

While they offer white fish on other dishes, they refuse to add it noodle dishes. The chicken used in noodle dishes tends to be dried-out white chicken, so I wanted fish.  [Oddly, the chicken used in satay along w/a delicious peanut sauce is much more moist & flavorful.]

It's disappointing Meun is unwilling to make these simple substitutions to make their food more tailored to folks patronizing the place.  They refuse even for takeout where the cost of labor is extremely low & most customers (like us) tip without any service at all.

We believe in supporting our local businesses and restaurants on the Mesa. There is much to like about Meun.  It's just starting to feel like they've lost the desire to create more interesting dishes.  Or to co-create based on the orders they're getting over the phone today with customers asking for some alterations.  

"Your Choice" on State near Gelson's has been around 30 years. They offer more authentic Thai food with duck, a broader range of spices, fish, & young coconuts to drink. It's more similar to food I've eaten in Thailand. I'd order from them more often, but my wife eats a rather bland diet these days. 

Perhaps Meun is doing a "Natural Cafe" version of Thai food?  Less exotic, less spicy, no organics, but easily scalable?  Sadly, "The Sojourner," one of the last true natural food restaurants in Santa Barbara, had to close its doors, while Nat Caf is franchising all over the place.  Meun has two locations now & it remains to be seen if that will make their food less interesting. It's hard to be creative once you have more than one restaurant to manage. Meun has some of the early markings of a franchise where you simply can't "Have it Your Way," to quote the old commercial.

I hope Jan & Hollis will read this & rethink things. I know Jan & her chefs have a lot of creative ideas that could go into the food, if they're not thinking to standardize the model for franchising & expansion.  The Fresh Rolls are a wonderful example of that.  I'd like to see more exotic food on the menu like duck, crab, and fresh fish & meats that are not dry or bland.

The pandemic has made things challenging for most businesses, less so for those that always had a takeout model.  Meun has had takeout from the beginning. They may miss revenue from the small tables inside, but I suspect they're doing as well as Chinese takeout, Pizza delivery, Chicken Ranch & other locations doing takeout before Covid.

I wish them well & hope they'll consider expanding menu options -vs- more locations in the future. We're not giving up on them, but after years of ordering, just felt like we needed to keep it real with some real feedback that could make them a truly FIVE-star restaurant.

I'm trying the Finch & Fork for the first time, I am so impressed with their 5 star service and food!!  Came in tonight for an early birthday dinner. Our server was fun and polite and extremely efficient. We started off with their Mac & cheese and Brussels sprouts!!  Incredible!! For dinner my daughter and her boyfriend both had their amazing made to order Lasagna with garlic bread!! The flavors were Devine, fresh basil, peppers,onions baked to perfection!! I myself had their wonderful fresh Sea Scallops with a balsamic reduction with bacon, fresh avocado and pink grapefruit with risotto!! My Scallops were cooked to perfection, lightly seared. They melted in my mouth. I pared my Scallops with an Alma Rosa pino Grigio. Absolutely exquisite! For dessert they brought us there S'more pot de creme and the banana shake!! Again incredible!!  I want to thank the staff and Marc for you're outstanding service plus food!! I will be back!! I

Went to P. F. Chang's for Chinese New Year. 
There was a line out the door when we arrived at 6pm. We were actually early for a 6:30 reservation we had. We checked in and were early so we didn't mind waiting.  After our reservation time came & went we went up to the hostess and inquired how much longer. I noticed they seemed a little frazzled and it seemed like there was lots of empty tables!  After inquiring we were seated right away. 

Upon being seated our server Benjamin immediately came to our table and he was great.  Benjamin was probably one of the best servers we've had the pleasure of having.  He even thought to bring a cup full of ice for the iced tea.  This is something we would normally ask for. The extra ice he brought with the drinks was really thoughtful on his part.  The refills were brought to us right away and the food came out promptly!  Nothing bothers me more than eating and having to wait on a drink. Benjamin was on point!  I highly recommend you request him for your server if you go to the Brandon  location. 

The only problem was, I think the restaurant was understaffed.  I counted 9 empty tables just in my immediate area. Some needed to be cleaned off and others were clean.  This was at the height of the dinner rush and it was Chinese New Year. Also, P.F. Chang's sent a coupon out for buy one/get one which was only good for yesterday.  Why would you send a coupon that's only good on Chinese New Year and be so understaffed??  There was a line out the door when we left as well!  

Even tho our server was amazing and the food was delicious some stars were lost due to the long wait and long lines out the door with so many tables sitting empty!


I've been to P.F. Chang's too many times to count at many different locations.  When this location opened we were thrilled!  It's definitely a restaurant we enjoy going to.  This particular location is at the Brandon Mall.  We made a reservation because it was a Friday evening.  Our reservation was for 6 pm and the restaurant had plenty of seating available.  I requested a booth and we were seated immediately.  We immediately noticed how LOUD and ECHOEY it was.  It was difficult to have a conversation with someone right across from you.  The restaurant is very modern and open with high ceilings.  There is also a outdoor seating area and a bar that on one side is outdoors and the other side is indoors.  This particular location seems much smaller than any other P.F. Chang's that I've been to.  Parking is ok, this part of the mall is also where all the restaurants are located and it gets very busy.  Depending on how busy the mall is will depend how easy you are able to park.  After the waitress took our order we asked her to bring us some Crispy Noodles with duck sauce (she called it sweet & sour sauce ) to pick on while we wait. ***A little secret, you have to ask for this and it's free!  They will never bring these noodles & duck sauce unless you specifically ask for it!  I'm not sure why they don't just put it on the table.  For dinner We ordered egg rolls, dumplings, Chang's Spicy Chicken, Mongolian Beef and Shrimp Fried Rice.  I have to honestly say everything was delicious, cooked perfectly and just as good as any other P.F. Chang's we've been to. We even had leftovers for lunAfter reading previous reviews I'm not sure if we just got lucky or if they got their act together. Our server was Cera she was good taking our order but she never refilled our drinks!  This is a big pet peeve of mine when dining out.  There is nothing worse than eating and not having a drink. When we were paying the bill she asked if we wanted another drink.  Um, nooo! Want the drink with the meal, not for the drive home!  There was no excuse, the restaurant wasn't busy.

I grew up in a Family of Sicilians and Neapolitans. I had older relatives who barely spoke English. And I have to say trying to find a place to get anything remotely authentic isn't easy in Tennessee. But this place was incredible. If you're looking for a real Neapolitan Pizza this is the place. If you don't like this place the only thing I could figure id either A. You're a non Italian American who grew up with Ragú meaning ketchup that comes out a jar, or B. You're Siciliano and you're looking for Sfinciuni, which is unfortunately the only other thing I wish they had. But with that being said they bill themselves as making Neapolitan Pizza so I can't complain about them not having Sicilian variants, and the pizza they did have was Incredible! I will definitely be coming back here!
This place has amazing cheeses and food! I love their Hook's Cheddar! Lovely local place with delicious food for an amazing price. The staff is always beyond friendly. Highly recommended!

Incrediplex is such a great place for my son to run off some energy, although I feel like I got my own work out too!! I have never seen such incredible bouncy houses/inflatable slides before...I would even consider having my own birthday party there! My boyfriend also does basketball work outs here so we were watching him on one of the three full size courts.  The staff at the front desk were so friendly and helpful.  We will definitely be back to play some arcade games and maybe even bowl.  This place truly has it all!!

Pizza is very average. Next day pizza it is not. 
What we ordered priced out at nearly $60.00 and they did not give us everything we paid for but we did not want to drive back to the restaurant.

Most of the food was good, nothing was bad but it was not great. The salads they make were very good also.

Nice employee's. We have tasted some really good pizza and we might be too hard on these guys. They all work hard and the place was clean.

It took several phone calls and months to get my name updated. Trying to pay my mortgage each month is a constant struggle as the website crashes, the name change prevents me from auto pay and the phone number for paying online is nearly impossible to find. Expect to be on hold for a long time and feeling like you're in the 90's by having to send snail-mail for everything. I am seriously considering refinancing my house just to switch companies. It is THAT bad.

This mall is great in Bensalem, PA. The Reason that the Mall is good because it has Friendly's and Chick fil A. This mall is clean even the Food Court. I tried Philly Steaks and Chinese food inside the mall, On October, I saw Spirit Halloween. The King of Prussia Mall and the Roosevelt Mall has also Spirit Halloween during the month of October. The clothes in the Neshaminy Mall is very popular, The prices are fine and Mall Security were kind. When you pass by the Pennsylvania Turnpike entrance, You see a sign said "Neshaminy."

Nice vacation condo hotel. Very spacious King suite. Has huge sitting area with all kitchen amenities. Huge bathroom. MB was spacious. 

Very push to sell or have you join into vacation rentals. So refuse it bluntly. Very courteous staff call on you to check see everything ok. 

Not much to do in small lobby. Shops and restaurants nearby. Good location. 

Valet parking is expensive and you have to wait 30 min to get your car! First night it took them more that that so the manager wrote off the parking fee for that night and we were late for dinner party. 

Rest assured nice stay and worth staying again!

The food was pretty good and lots of choices, although everything seemed fried or heavy on fat/protein/white bread and a little pricy for the serving sizes. I had the buffalo Bella and my friend had the cheesesteak. We both enjoyed them but were not blown away. After hearing so many good reviews, I also ordered the sweet potato fries and chocolate shake. The fries were fantastic, but sweet potato fries generally are-nothing special about them and the serving was tiny for the cost ( more than $4!). The shake has a taste and texture like thin cake batter-not bad, just really strange for a drink. Note: the restaurant is very small, much better for takeout than eating in, and there is no bathroom.
Good food and great accommodations for big groups. Overpriced drinks, friendly staff.

My hubby and I are from Ca... We have been eating Pho for many years and couldn't find no good Pho anywhere in Boise or Meridian or Nampa.. Until coming here by far the best Pho with very good flavor and the Best Service .. We are always satisfied coming and leaving

Awesome for a quick paved hike with a great view as a payoff. Great to catch sunrise or sunset. If you're observant and lucky you may even catch some wildlife. You can download the official app to learn more about unique university research site. Search Android and iOS stores for Tumamoc Tour prior to starting your hike.

Most excellent. Our party of four were all satisfied. Very good service, too. We had a mix of salmon, filet mignon, and vegetarian dishes. All very good. They have a nice selection of small plates that allow lighter eaters to get just what they need.
The key lime pie was very good, too. They had some other tasty sounding dessert choices that we didn't get to try.
A keeper.

It is big and and fancy and new.  But there is such a thing as too big.  And too loud.  And too much up sell.  Base membership is on the high side (I paid $120 but I locked in in months before opening).  But all the really GOOD cross fit style classes involve another hefty fee.  I signed up for an onboarding session two months ago, still waiting to hear from them.  The guest policy is very restrictive.  I think this gym is good for those looking to meet other singles, and for families with young children.  They seem to love the pool.  It is always packed.  If you are not in one of these categories there is much about this place that will probably frustrate you. Some of the group fitness classes are very good however, just a bit loud and RAH RAH for my tastes.  I am trying to quit but of course that involves 30 days notice.

Great spot had a full body massage 

Very warm and welcoming

Friendly staff scheduling an appointment online is a breeze .

I would definitely recommend this to anyone 

Would return again !!!

Only complaint when filling out the paperwork there was a question that asked if there were any body part you did not want massaged I clearly stated which body part but the therapist went ahead and massaged anyway. Which tells me she did not look over the information.

Awful experience - I would give them no stars if possible. Their electronic system for ordering food broke down after we already ordered & people (including staff) were just standing there. It wasn't until I asked about our order (which they knew nothing about) & gave them our receipt, that they started getting our order ready (still took 20min before we actually got our food). We then went on their app to get coupons, but kept getting connection issues & poor cellular coverage (never got on it after initial download). We did end up buying credits so the kids could play - my older daughter then went on the horse racing game which took our credit but didn't move until after the game already ended. I was able to flag a staff member during this time who was walking the floor but he had no clue how the ride/game worked and couldn't give me our credit back (so what were they for? Just to walk round & round the floor?). I had to go to the cashier area (luckily there was no line!) to get our credit back which they did but only after the staff member basically accused us of not knowing how to ride a horse (their staff who I flagged down didn't either!) or that my dtr was too young to use the ride (my dtr has been competing in English horseback riding for the past couple of years!). So frustrating - I should have asked for our money back except the kids really wanted to play. We ended up staying to use up the credits but wasted more than half my time having to work with their broken system. We should have just stayed home.
Wish I could say more.  Used to be so much better but cold food and missing sauce on dinner special very disappointing.  Service was still great. Quality control in kitchen needs to be addressed.
Starbucks: The barista, Billy, makes some of the best coffee! I try to always come to this Starbucks location.

I have no idea why this place has 3.5 stars. The food is fantastic!!!! I got my order to go so my review is based on that.

I ordered potato skins and their fried chicken dinner. Everything was delicious! If you order it to go, definitely get the complimentary bread!

Went in last night with 3 of my friends all wanting piercings. Jay was the coolest guy ever and got our work done efficiently. He was super helpful. I    described what type of piercing I   want it and he picked out the perfect stud- exactly what I   was imagining. He was so dope and made you feel comfortable! Thanks dude! We will for sure be back.

I was so scared going into the Hot Room for the first time, I literally thought I might keel over in there !! From the get-go, the staff was so friendly and welcoming that I immediately felt a sense of peace. They told me what to expect, showed me the lockers and shower and were overall very informative. My instructor, Jovanne Muro, was absolutely amazing! She kept me very motivated and I felt like she wasn't just barking orders at me the whole time LOL. Overall, the space is very clean and beautiful, experienced instructors, and an accepting atmosphere. I will definitely be back to the Hot Room!

This is my second time to Prime for a "private" party in the upstairs.  We paid $25 for all you can drink (beer, cocktails.. not sure if wine was included) from 10PM - 1AM.  

My only dislike is that the bartender tried to give me soda water with my vodka instead of tonic... I definitely know the difference so either his tonic was tapped or he was just an ass...

The DJ both times was fun and the atmosphere was energetic on the dance floor.
A very middling diner-quality brunch place. Still, a solid pick. For what you get it really should be cheaper. Pretty popular on the weekends during brunch so be prepared to wait.

I started at F45 about 7 months ago and hit it at least 5 times per week.  

It's a great gym that really gets the job done.  You just show up and guaranteed you will be worked out at the end of the 45 minutes.  The workouts change each day, so its not monotonous and boring.

I love the staff.  The coaches are great, as are the owners.  Highly recommended.

Unfortunately I've had another loss in my family and have had to need the services from this wonderful flower shop. 
I have not been disappointed in the least, I feel like I get a great value for the money. 
I like planters with flowers in them so that people can take something home with them. 
This time I was able to get a picture of the arrangement.

This owner of this one man band co.
came to my home through american home shield said he found gas leak at my furnace but would not fix that because I would not have him add all new pipes in my home replace 4200  at my expense
he wanted from me 
I have coverage for heater repair  from ahs and any pipes or gas lines but only a certified Plummer should ever touch gas pipes or lines he's only an ac/heater guy ahs had another heater company come out test the heater no gas leak there he's an out right( crook) beware get a second opinion always shame on you !

While the food was good, it wasn't on par with the prices or balanced out by the portion sizes. The quiche was overcooked, the vegetarian scrapple more like fried tofu than any sort of scrapple, and the waitstaff seemed a bit unkempt (stringy, unwashed hair, particularly noticeable at brunch on a holiday). I, as were those I dined with, was disappointed with the experience.

Delicious!!! This place is usually a bit busy but so worth the wait. Great food, good prices & awesome service. We had the kick in shrimp, calamari, dinner salad & tacos and it was all phenomenal & so fresh !

This pet supply changed owners about a year ago and while this store was good it only got great...er!
Yes it's a small place that might feel stuffy yet it is always clean and doesn't have any odors besides from the cats but as an owner of two cats (or the ownee of two cats) it doesn't bother me at all. They don't cater to the exotic animal population but they have an amazing variety of cat and dog supplies. They will deliver your purchases for a flat rate of $5 and are always a delight to converse with. 

A special explanation is needed when it comes to the kittens in the window. The kittens are brought there by Cindy and she is actually the one in charge of the adopting procedure. You could say that the owners of the store just house the cats for show and don't really know where they come from. Usually the cats are young, kitten young and they get adopted faster than a fat man eats a twinky. I have never adopted from them but I have a friend who is a crazy cat guy and he has adopted four cats from this place with one of them having some respiratory problems, nothing worth mentioning so I would say that the process is ok. In any case, just the fact that they are getting adopted so fast is good because every cat adopted is a cat saved.

The folks at this location are decidedly MORE friendly and helpful than those at the CWE location. This place is in a strip mall, granted you're in Ladue so this is a nice strip mall, and there is plenty of parking. Unfortunately, my online order was lost in the ether somehow. It finally showed up on their computers after I was originally supposed to pick it up. The manager was apologetic but if I was more hungry, I would have been upset. Would have been nice if an accommodation was made but nothing. That said, the food was good, as usual.

We just had Holcombe electric complete work in our home. Some lights across two rooms in our home needed to be repositioned, added or replaced. They also replaced 2 ceiling fans.For reference,  it was a 2 day job for 2 people.Terry and John and were very professional, friendly, and easy to work with. Prices were fair for certified electricians. They consulted with us at the beginning of each day. If there were any miscommunications, they happily addressed them. 

The team completed the work a few hours faster than anticipated as well. (They really hustled) and even cleaned up after themselves! Their main goal was to ensure we were happy, and we are. We appreciate your help.

i have a hard time with the theory of a $9 salad - but there i was... the salad was was good.  spinach and 5 items of my choice. i opted for no bread (but it was offered).

the two guys working there couldnt have been any nicer unless they fed me.

it was clean all around, including the bathroom.

i'd prefer to make a salad at a local grocery store for 1/4 the price, but if its too late in the evening i would go back.

The bar is very well stocked and the burgers are good. It is very busy but they seem to run out of space before the service suffers. Bartender was awesome and I like the fact you can order at the bar and skip the line.

Had 2 windows tinted to match factory windows in the balance of the car. First set poorly installed and lots of dirt appeared under film on both sides.  Requested the work be redone several weeks later and they accommodated. Second job was equally as unacceptable and as carelessly done as the first job. Wasted my money and had to have the work redone by a shop that cares about their work! I do not recommend their workmanship or their attitude.

Worst property management company. They let a beautiful home turn into a complete dumb. They allowed animals that the owner never wanted on the property. They lied to the owner and didn't help maintain the quality of the property at all! This company should be reported to law enforcement for agreeing to provide services and not upholding the standards. The damage in the home is over $5,000 and there has been multiple episodes of drugs being used inside the property. HOME
OWNERS BEWARE YOU WONT HAVE A VALUABLE RENTAL ANY LONGER IF YOU WORK WITH REALTY ASSET

Did not even get a table. They are concerned only with tourist traffic. Tried to get a table at 12:30, told the first available would be 1:30 and forced to make a "reservation", but in that time several tables walked in and were seated. I have eaten there for years but this is my last time. Remember tourist are not here through the winter, but you will not have my patronage when they are gone.

Went here with a few friends and it was packed....for good reason. Put our names in and went to the upstairs bar to grab a beer. We were not disappointed with a single beer we had and the atmosphere was great. Once we got our table we had Bread and Butter, Spicy Pickles, and the Terrine and again we were not disappointed. Our server was helpful and pretty much on the ball the entire time. She made good suggestions for food and beverage and worked quickly to get us situated. The food was delicious and came out within minutes (it is very simple but also amazing). The meal reminded me of something typical of Germany, where bread (fresh made- and in this case fresh made in house) is served with butter and toppings such as cheese, meat, liverwurst, spices, etc., AND they use local ingredients for everything. All in all we would do this again, keep up the good work, and I can't wait to see how your next restaurant turns out!

Food was great.  Waiter was amazing had great knowledge of the menu and had a few recommendations.  I went for brunch and it was my first time this will not be the last.  Try the
Mimosa so delicious.  Great portion size and so tasty. Would recommend to go early on weekend if you want to do brunch not as many people.  You will wait if you arrive later but you will not be disappointed.

I come from the suburbs of Philadelphia, the western suburbs as Quinn cuts my hair as I like it. She really consults with me and finds out what I want before the cutting. It's not like any salon I have been to before. The staff are so welcoming. No attitude at all around.

Absolute worst! I was directed to this mechanic from my insurance provider. I've never had any issues with my car...no sounds or squeaks! Nothing! Well the original mechanic forgot to my tire back on correctly and BAM! It goes falling off while driving on the Ben Franklin Bridge! Caliber had my car for almost 3 weeks. The receptionist attempted to have me sign a release but everything was not marked off. The front driver tire fell off mid-drive but the passenger front tire was also on it's way off. They attempted to give my car back to me without looking at the passenger side as well. I had to tell them to look at it. It was missing bolts. When returned to me, I didn't immediately submit a review because I wanted to make sure it was fixed correctly. Well, I was headed to the highway and I heard cracks when I made turns. Also, the bottom of the car sounds like it's about to cave! I called my insurance provider and they told me to return it to Caliber. I called Caliber and they said they will have a tow truck come to get my car. The following day, Caliber Collision said "We put your car on the road and the sounds are coming from wear/tear." BULLSHIT. I also would be responsible for a $158.00 tow charge (2.7 miles/6 minute drive) or I would not get my car back. Their receptionist did not tell me that I would be responsible nor did my insurance provider. You ask why didn't I drive it directly to them...hmm have you ever been on a bridge and tire falls off and rolls down the bridge...while sparks are flying everywhere because you axle is on the ground! It's traumatizing! I was too scared to drive my car. I parked it and waited for the tow.

A year or so ago friends of ours suggested we all visit this place after a Phillies game.  Plans for that fell through, but the dream lived on.  In the year since, I have heard many folks talk about how great Brazilian steakhouses are.

This week is our anniversary.  A friend of mine had a show in Philly that we planned on attending.  I figured dinner would complement that well.  I began researching Chima.  My wife signed off on it and we made reservations.

I love being able to have filet, lamb, sirloin, pork, etc. all in the same meal.  That is the takeaway from this meal: variety.

The salad bar is large and makes a good visual impression.  Next visit, however, I will probably pass on it so there is more room for meat.  I eat pretty much a paleo diet.  Because of that, I shunned the various salads save spinach and mushrooms.  I picked some sliced meats and roasted peppers.  Yum!  The asparagus were trees.  Yikes!  Everything was visually appealing.  The taste was fine, but not outstanding.  Chilled plates would greatly enhance my opinion of the salad bar.

Once we finished the salad course, we decided to see how the meat worked.  We turned over the cards.  The gauchos began arriving.  I passed on chicken as I always eat chicken.  My wife proclaimed that it was the best meat she had all evening.  It wasn't long before I turned the card to stop as we had lots of meat on our plate.  I ended up tasting everything save that chicken and the seafood.  Tonight, my favorite meat was the garlic sirloin, which I ate several slices of.  The leg of lamb did not come out until the end of our meal.  It did not impress me.  Nor did the chicken wrapped in bacon or the sausage.  The leg of lamb was dry, the chicken overcooked, and the sausage was blah.  The sirloin and the filet, however, were outstanding.  I thought the ribeye would have been my favorite.  It was fine, but paled to the sirloins.

I was impressed with how the gauchos cut the meats from the spits.  I enjoyed the lamb chops.  After serving my wife, there were no other medium-rare.  The gaucho apologized and said he would bring me out some.  In the time between, I had flipped my card.  That did not deter him.  I was grateful for his attention.

Meat.  Lots of it.  Loved it.

My wife wanted us to have dessert.  I had decided I had finally filled up on the meat.  The last filet in butter convinced me.  We opted for the papaya cream and the chocolate-coffee mousse.  I liked the papaya cream; it was light and refreshing after such a heavy meal.  The mousse was dense and a meal of itself.  It was cut with the raspberry sorbet.  It was tasty, just the wrong choice for us after such a big meal.

I enjoyed our meal out.  Meat.  That's what dining here is about.  You can have meat prepared more elegantly elsewhere, but you won't have the variety on your plate nor the amount.  

We agreed that this would be a fun place to enjoy with a larger group of people.  Chima exudes a festive evening out.

Definitely loving this seafood market for their poboys! We order by phone and the service is always reliable and friendly. In addition the food is prepared quickly and is so good! The seafood is seasoned very well and the shrimp and catfish poboys are so good! So good is really an understatement, they are fantastic!! I'd highly recommend ordering either! I'm always glad when Cajun Persuasion is for dinner!

This exceptional hot chicken! I got the mild and my boyfriend got the damn hot and let me tell you it was DAMN HOT! If you're someone who can't handle heat but want to challenge yourself I would get the hot because they really don't skimp on the spices my mouth and lips were on fire for 4 minutes and nothing could help me. Over all Hattie B's is a dope hip spot and I would recommend it to anyone. The only down side is the line down the street. I visited on a Monday and the line was super long and it was raining!

I had high hopes for this place looking at the yelp reviews, unfortunately this is the worst Chinese food I have ever had. We ordered chicken stuffed bun, duck roast and chicken in chilli sauce. Service was good, the staff took time to explain about the dishes but the food we got was terrible. Stuffed buns were OK not that great. Chicken in chilli sauce had more dried chillies than chicken. Chicken was not fresh, dry, salty and no sauce. Duck roast tasted very oily, raw in the center and she brought all these three dishes in 5 minutes. I wonder how these dishes can be prepared in 5 mins. She just heated the chicken and duck that was prepared way earlier and served. Will not recommend this place to anyone. Zero star !

Best happy hour in Reno! Best sommelier in Reno too. Ask for Christian! He knows how to pair wine with people. Awesome wine aerating contraption they've developed for this place, I've never seen anything like it. We had the Signature Pan-Roasted Chilean Sea Bass with lobster mashed potatoes and the Calamari Steak. The calamari was a true specialty. For a fun twist on desert we did a truffle desert wine pairing. This place is great for an elevated dining experience or if you just want to have a delicious happy hour with friends. It felt safe and clean and the service was exceptional.
This is one of my favorite sushi places in Reno.  The seared tuna, Spicy Ben Franklin, and the Moto Night are delicious!
Would give zero stars. But can't. Closes at 9. Went at 7:30. Was told "no more coffee". Insane. Thought that was a Starbucks. Guess I was wrong.
AWESOME Staff, GREAT space, FANTASTIC Aromatouch and Deep Tissue Massage by Cody Adkins. Well worth the trip and $$

The Worker Bee Cafe is ran and owned by a father and some team. Rick and his son have a niche on the bfast game in town. 

They use their own home produced eggs, doctored up  bacon with jalapeños, and have a variety of items on the menu; they also have gluten free options. The Potato skin "hash, La Abuelita, and the buttermilk pancakes are delicious. 

It's really easy to bypass them since they're flanked by small shops. Come by and say hello to Rick and his son and have a meal. You won't regret it.

Upon recommendation from a local I decided to check this place out. Of course I skimmed through yelp prior to heading out and was excited based on the overwhelming positive reviews. 

They have an array of eye pleasing pastries and desserts as you walk up to order. Decided to try their tuna sandwich and two desserts. While the tuna sandwich looked esthetically pleasing, the flavors were disappointing. Not exactly sure what all was in the sandwich but something gave it an unappetizing bitter taste. 

Not much of a dessert person, and so my review is somewhat biased from that perspective. Having said that, if you're looking for something to send your blood sugars off the scale you'll find it here. Definitely too sweet for my taste buds.

I would give this place a second try if back in town. 

Service was good and friendly. Parking is a little tricky. Setting was chill.

Sandwich, tea, plus two desserts = 19 bucks.

If you're in the county and looking for amazing a Thai food, look no further. After a really terrible first Thai food experience a few years back I was reluctant to give it another try. Now all I can say is I'm sorry I waited so long to try again! Every single bite of our dinner was hands down 5 star delicious. We ordered the crispy pork pot stickers, chicken satay, green curry, and spicy basil stir fry. I was literally "ooo-ing" and "ahhh-ing" the entire meal. I also appreciated the waitresses assistance in not only ordering the right food but how to correctly eat and enjoy it according to traditional Thai standards. I'll admit I love ethnic food but I'm often intimidated when ordering. The setting is quaint, dim lit, and decorated beautifully in Thai culture. I also saw many people picking up take out, and they are partnered with grub hub for delivery! Keep up the great work Manee Thai ... we will be back!!!

First off Sydney was AWESOME!!!! She was on top of everything without being intrusive. Hubby got the Caesar salad with Chicken and some mozzarella sticks. Now me well I created my own entree and she got it perfect. I had a side salad (no cheese) and coleslaw which I mixed. Then cut up the black bean burger mixed it up and topped it with some pico de gallo. SO GOOD! Best of all we both have leftovers for lunch tomorrow. The bathroom did not look bad, had to check since another person mentioned they were horrible. Over all a nice time was had.

Just back from my dogs' annual vet visit and, as usual, it was a pleasure. I have been going to this family owned vet clinic for nearly 10 years and can not say enough good things about it. Prompt, efficient, no-nonsense service. And best of all, Drs. Nicole and Andrea are tolerant of my chihuahua's "quirky" behavior and willing to answer any questions I may have as a neurotic, obsessive dog owner. Even when it was inconvenient for me, (not having a car) to get here, I refused to switch to another vet.

I had two years worth of laser hair removal through this company (appointments every 6 weeks). Bikini line and armpits. Less hair is always better but I did expect to see more hair loss by the end of this process. 
The company and management seem real shady. I'm sure they're commission based as they're very pushy with sales. At one time they called me 4 times within 24 hours to schedule a consultation! They have whimsical sales, which is frustrating when the package you just bought at full price is half off the following week. I think they have raised prices just so they can get more clients in with their "sales". 
Appointments were always in the air. At times, appointments were running 45 minutes late! Sometimes they called to confirm, sometimes they did not. Sometimes (even if you got a confirmation call the day prior) your appointment was given to someone else when you arrive on time. 
I will say, the nursing staff who actually gives you the treatments was always very pleasant & helpful, which I appreciated.

Banh mi sandwiches and bubble teas are good but long wait though! I know they opened not long ago but they should be more efficient by now. They have a limited food menu so everything should be prepared much quicker.  Usually waiting 20 minutes for a banh mi and a tea.

I have no idea what all the bad reviews are about. I've been ordering from here for 20 years. Amazing food. Always pleasant on the phone and in person. 

Oh and if you're ordering from Skip the Dishes, you can't blame the restaurant for the driver. They didn't hire the driver. Grab a brain before you review. Thanks.

I go here often, with family and neighbors - and everyone always has something positive to say. This is a solid diner. The variety available on the menu is awesome, and the "diner basics" - omelets, pancakes, burgers and even the sautéed dishes are consistent and tasty. The starter salads are cold and crisp. Even when it is very busy the food flies out of the kitchen and is good. Once you are there a few times, the servers seem to recognize you and seem to be just a little more welcoming than the first time you sat in their section. The owners keep a close eye on everything, and look to make sure everyone is enjoying their meals.

Tip: it's ok to put gratuity on the credit card, they are very accommodating and it makes it easy to leave a proper tip for your server in today's plastic-fantastic world!

I have shopped here twice before, and the first time Galene wasn't exactly rude but wasn't very attentive towards me because I was younger than the other customer. While that briefly annoyed me, it didn't stop me from coming back. The second time, I walked in on her screaming at an AC guy. After hanging up with him, I validated what she was saying when I said "Wow, it's definitely hot in here. Your guy needs to come out!" She then said "We'll you can fucking leave because I don't want to hear your bitching". Never in my life have I experienced someone so rude and hostile to a customer. I will never be coming back and I will be telling everyone who listens about your horrible customer service!!

Turkish Hummus: Outstanding. Buttery. Warm.

Fava Bread they give with it: Eat it while its warm.

Best Mezzes: Grape leaves, haloumi.

Entree: The chicken shashlik was very very good.

Dessert: Kataifi was outstanding. "Venezuelan chocolate with ricotta cheese to make it softer" inside a bird's nest kind of thing with mango for sweetness. Oh man, my mouth is watering just thinking about it.

Tips: The mezze and the entree plates are small. You'll want about 3 dishes per person. We ate plenty of the superb hummus at the beginning, and so it was okay. Also remember: because you're eating small portions you'll feel like you're not feeling full. But thats not the case. At the end of 1 appetizer, 4  mezzes, 3 entrees and 2 desserts (10 things for 3 people), we were quite full, even though it looked at the end of the entrees that we still had place in our tummies for more.
This place is adorable. Very dark and dim. Loved how you can play some card or board games there. Coffee was great too. 9/10!

I don't trust this place. They got a diagnosis wrong by saying the main belt needed replacing. It didn't 
..

Succulent Food.  Brilliant service.  Comforting decor.  BYO.  Favorite all-around restaurant in Philadelphia.  5 stars for sure.

I've come here dozens of times in the past few years and have yet to have a bad experience here.  Everything on the menu is made with fresh, organic, natural ingredients.  I find that many restaurants can not produce high quality across the entire range of proteins, however, fish, lamb, goat, chicken, beef, octopus and vegetarian dishes are superbly cooked and burst with exciting flavor combinations.  I tend to try the specials, which can range from rabbit stew to bull testicles.  For the less adventurous, the Cyprus breakfast or fisherman's stew are tasty.  Try the ice cream.  And the French Press.  And.. everything else.

Service is equally excellent.  Orders are taken promptly, with daily specials rattled off from memory.  The team always seems happy and they never rush you out even when they are booked solid.  They seat about 40 guests and with warm weather, some outdoor seating is available.  While the space isn't large, I don't feel cramped or want of more space.

Wonderful for dates, special occasions, or when you simply crave excellent food.  Reasonably priced for all of this.  Did I mention it's my favorite?  Cheers!

Not that impressed by what I saw. Took forever to get menus. We sat outside because of our dog and the hostess came out, sat someone else and still hadn't gave us menus so a friend went in to get them. The server wasn't that well informed on the food. I asked a question about some of the apps and she couldn't tell me what they were so I skipped the apps. The menu was a major disappointment. One sheet of the most bland food. They had one burger and use flat iron steak to make 4 different things on the menu. I thought there would be more variety or creativity on the menu. Not going out of my way to go back there.

This review is of the Bryan Subaru used car affiliate, not the new car dealer, with whom I have no experience.  

I accompanied a friend on a test drive last week.  She was looking at a used Forester.  The salesman, Terry seemed friendly and accommodating, and had pulled three cars for my friend and I to look at.  

The first of the three objectively had a brake issue.  I am not a mechanic and did not claim to be, but the braking performance was uneven and you could detect some feedback on the pedal.  I was admittedly hard on the gas and brakes as to be thorough on the car's performance.  While I was critical of the vehicle, I was not disrespectful to the dealership or Terry, who accompanied us on the test drive.  By the time we got back to the dealership, the car was smoking and there was a noticeable odor (which both Terry and the manager dismissed).  The manager drove the vehicle himself and confirmed that there was a brake issue that would be checked out in the morning.  We parted cordially, and Terry said he would be in touch with my friend.  I thought that was it.

At 10 pm that evening, my friend sent me a screenshot of a text that Terry had just sent her.  The timing if the text itself is questionable and it was also rife with spelling and grammatical errors (borderline nonsensical).  In it he referred to me as a "kid" and "boy" a number of times (I am 33), claimed I knew nothing about cars and made fun of my truck (that he never saw) for being a 2002 (which he mistook for a 2000).  He referred to me as "Evil Kneival" and asked that I not return with my friend should she want to look at any other vehicles (spoiler alert, she doesn't).  He signed the text as "2017 Salesperson of the Year".

He not only texted my friend a number of times after that (she hadn't responded) he also texted an out-of-state friend of hers who had called Terry to inquire about the vehicle.  He basically told the guy the same things Terry had been texting my friend.  I told my friend that this is borderline harassment (possibly the sign of a disorder of some kind), and that I would be concerned if I were she.  

While everything about the texts was terribly unprofessional, the timing of the text can be somewhat excused, since he and my friend had been friendly in their previous text messages.  I mean, I wouldn't, but I am just a dumb kid with an old truck, so what do I know?      

My thought is that Terry has incredibly thin skin for a customer service "professional".  He clearly felt disrespected by me enough to mock me via text to two separate people on his personal time.  The really interesting thing about this whole scenario is that Terry was trying to upsell my friend into a newer, more expensive vehicle and did not even want her to buy the Forester that had the brake issue.  With that fact, I am very confused as to why he took it so personally that I advised my friend not to buy a car that he did not even want to sell her to begin with.

As a professional myself, I cannot imagine conducting myself as Terry did.  If he is in fact the 2017 salesperson of the year, I have serious questions about the rest of the salespeople at Bryan Subaru.

I dislike going downtown Indy anymore so I was happy to here Old Spaghetti Factory was opening in Carmel.   I did give this place a month or so to work out the kinks before I go.  Great decor and atmosphere.  Much brighter interior than the one downtown.   Same great flavors.   Started with the Fried Calamari. Good texture but overly breaded.  Ordered the Pot Pourri as the main course which consists of mizithra and browned butter, a red meat sauce,  and a marinara clam sauce.  All delish!  Bread and salad or soup comes with, along with a scope of icecream.

I have never been disappointed with Hattie B's. They are an amazing restaurant with amazing food and great service. The only level I have not tried yet is Shut the Cluck Up, but all the others are amazing. Their Nashville comeback sauce is great on anything. If you have not been there yet then stop what you are doing now and go!

My boyfriend and I walked in around 6:30 on a Friday night, and got a table in the bar area without a wait! Our server was amazing - she was on top of everything and was taking care of the entire bar area (probably 8 tables or so). I loved the little UK section of the menu! I got the Shepherds Pie, and it was just like what I tasted in Edinburgh! They also have a great pizza section with a lot of variety that my boyfriend loved. There was lots of good "Americana" style food that you'd find on an upper-end bar menu - standard burgers, and more dressed-up burgers, quesadillas, fried chicken, etc.

I was also very impressed with all their craft beers! They have a great variety and, in my opinion, anyone could probably find a beer that they'd like! I loved the CircumSaision beer! You can look at their beer menu, and they have it all broken down with how hoppy each beer is, what notes and flavors you'll taste, and how they make it.

Our check was $40something including 2 beers, a soda, shepherds pie, and a whole pizza.

Go for an easy date night, or take the kids. It's a great place!

Laura Beth is fantastic. She has worked on my hair for about 2.5 years now and I have never had a bad experience. Her cuts are always fantastic and I just received a color and I love it. She is confident in her work and is extremely positive. The salon is in a great location and the front desk staff are always accommodating. I would recommend this salon and Laura Beth 100%.

When my BMW needs a good upgrade and I'm looking for an excuse to drive 300+ miles and visit Southern California, the only shop worth going to is this one! Although I usually work on my car, sometimes I rather have a master pro handle certain things. The BMW is pushed to the limits at the racetrack so I extremely value work that I can trust and count on. 

The shop owner is honest, friendly, and incredibly knowledgeable with all things BMW. He has always been helpful in answering my numerous questions. I'm very particular about my car and want only the best, and over the years he's proven to me that I can trust his advice and suggestions. He won't say just anything to sell a part or to have you bring your car to his shop. He recommends only products that he would use on his personal car even if that means suggesting something he doesn't sell.

I live near San Francisco and there are a few good Indy shops here locally - but for the ultimate in service, experience, and price, I'd choose HP Autosport every time if I could.

I had a company seal the pavers when I bought the house new 3 years ago. Terrible job. Black mold kept growing even after treatment. You hate to pay twice, but A Plus did the job right. That's why we post on Yelp, to help other.

We happened by Jane the Friday before July 4th. We read over the menu, did a quick Yelp review on the iPhone and decided to give it a try.

We were seated immediately at a table we requested on the balcony out front. The vibe and decor were top notch. Many items on the menu looked great but I started with the apple fritter and fried brie salad. It was a great new thing for me to try and it was damn good.

I had the Chicken and (more) brie sandwich on ciabatta with fries. It was perfectly cooked, flavorful and satisfying. Steve had the fish and chips which were light, flavorful and a very large serving.

We tried the coconut cake based on reviews. The cake was very light and tasty but there was a bit too much creme anglaise for me.

The service was warm and friendly. This was a great place to start the holiday weekend in Santa Barbara. I will definitely be back.

The food alone is easily 5 stars. I had the diner breakfast; the eggs were nice, the hashbrowns crispy, the sausage thick and flavorful, with the real winner being the biscuit (it was huge! and light and fluffy, a really fantastic biscuit). The atmosphere was great too, it has a laid back neighborhood vibe with live music (that wasn't too loud which is a nice plus).

The service was more 3 stars, it was a bit slow with other (more newly arrived) patrons dishes being brought out sooner than ours. Our waiter was a bit surly as well (maybe having a bad day). The service wasn't too terrible though, just could have been a bit better.

Overall, a really great place with delicious food. I recommend Nadeen's and I will be back.
The trail is great with gorgeous views! Do give yourself enough time though, the trail can take anywhere from 30 minutes to an hour depending on how fast you walk.

Over the top Amazing! I came to Stanley's with a party of 10, I called ahead and Tonja the host was just amazing, friendly and accommodating. Upon arrival she greeted us and had us wait about 10 mins. Once we sat our server came over, not the friendliest but hey we were starving and ready to eat. 

I enjoyed the omelette sandwich which was just something else delicious!!! Eggs, bacon, ham, cheese and spicy mayo in multigrain bread. The cheese and bacon grits were fabulous. However, my husbands bacon double cheeseburger stole the show how good it was. A friend really enjoyed the corned beef hash and the gumbo.  Stanley's was just amazing, they provide you with the New Orleans Experience. 

I will definitely be returning!

My first time being here and the worst service I have ever received at any food place. Laurence specifically gave us so much attitude.  Everyone at the front desk (about 10) were all sitting down on their phones ignoring us as we waited to be seated. I ended up leaving and plan to never come here again. HORRIBLE WORKERS.

Ehhh wouldn't go back. Disorganized and awkward. Had no cheese in the mozzarella sticks. Service was so slow and the bar was practically empty. Overpriced for what you get. Also there was an employee with his baby sitting on the bar. Weird. New Orleans offers so many great bar/pub restaurant and this isn't one of them.

Worst Hollywood Casino I have ever been to. Wouldn't let us in cause one of us looked drunk even though they had only 2 beers. They should really give them the chance to proof to the casino managers they are trashed and not go off of what their face looks like. Will never be back.

We had stumbled upon this lil place by accident one night, driving around for late night food on Veterans. We finally gave it a shot after reading all the great reviews about their bubble tea and because the bf and I were craving bubble tea.

Bubble tea: I ordered the mango and he had the taro. The taro was not like the taro bubble tea we are used to. It tasted good but almost like they used real taro root to make it. The Tapioca Pearls were perfectly made though.  My mango bubble tea with milk was tasty! I could taste the fresh mango in it. I will definitely come back to try all the other flavors. So far, this place is my fave bubble tea place in Metairie. 

Food: The pork chop over rice was awesome!!! and you cannot go wrong with a fried egg on top. The Fried rice was not as tasty, but lesson learned. Oh and both dishes came with a fried spring roll which were sooo good! This place has authentic vietnamese written all over it. and so  will definitely come back to try the Pho!

This lil spot is definately worth a try!

The Food
I tried the Big Zax Snak Meal with Chicken Tenders, Texas Toast, Crinkle Cut Fries, and Sweet Tea. It's really a combo meal and not really snack...it was filling. The tenders were juicy on the inside and crispy on the outside. They were meaty enough, but not really big. The fries were cooked up crispy and dusted in a seasoning salt. It comes with Zaxby's sauce that seems to be a mayo based with worchesteshire flavor. I also paid an extra quarter and had some of their mild wing sauce. The wing sauce was better than the "house" sauce. The sweet tea was good.

The Place
It's weird to sit in a nice and clean place in Hickory Hollow. The whole area is pretty lame these days, but Zaxby's is a rose among thorns. The staff is very friendly and upbeat.


The Verdict
I will be back if I can't make it over to McDougals.

If anyone wants a great example of how to WOW a customer and go way above and beyond on service with a smile you need to come in for this amazing BBQ! The young staff in here tonight made a couple of minor mistakes but handled them appropriately and made my family and I feel very welcome! We will be back!

I passed this restaurant all the time. I was looking for something different and decided to give it a try. Drinks we had 1 sangria $12 (the price of an entree) and ice tea $2. Lemon pepper chicken $13 and ravioli $15. The total minus the tip was $45.60.
The food was decent but they don't give you much. One could easily mistake an entree for an appetizer. After spending $55 (including tip). We were hungry again 1.5 hours later.

This is the second time we have ordered takeout from Burgerhaus. For some reason I really enjoyed it more this time than I did the last. Maybe it's the type of burger I had (which is shown in the photos below). It was absolute heaven. Bacon jam, provolone and arugula were just meant to go together, this sandwich proves it. The fries are really good and everyone's food  came exactly as ordered.
The only thing negative I have to say is that they should consider using different take out containers ... the juice from the onions and/or the burger made the bottom of my container soggy ... they should probably be using plastic.

We eat and take out from Mayflower regularly.  It isn't a palace, but the owners care about putting quality food out at reasonable prices.  They are hard working and friendly.  My kids love it too!  Try it out and help support a local business!

We loved Pickles and Swiss!  We had the Prosciutto and Brie, the Roast Beef & Horseradish, the Crispy Chicken West and a made to order ham, bacon and cheese.  Each sandwich was made with the perfect combination of the freshest ingredients and so delicious!  And the service was superb!  Very friendly and fun.  It was the perfect place for a quick yet relaxing lunch on our way through Santa Barbara and I would highly recommend it!
Nothing to write home about. Decent pizza. Made quick. Friendly staff. We did pick-up but they deliver too. Price was $15 for a medium red sauce,cheese and 3 veggie toppings.

Extremely unprofessional. The look of the office when I walked was disturbing. It looked was unkempt and bare. The receptionist didn't acknowledge me for 20 minutes and the "lab" are was a joke. Besides creating about 20 HIPPAA and TJC infractions, it was dirty and everyone was expected to place their own urine (labeled with their names on them) into a communal SINK!! It was abhorrent. Not to mention their results, sitting on top of each urine for anyone who cared to see them. Then the patient getting her blood work done was told her results right in front of me. I got on the scale next and another medical asst. said my weight aloud. 
The exam was a disappointment as it was hurried and not very thorough. I never saw the DR I made the appt to see at all and the mid level (ARNP) did not appear to have a grasp on women's Health as she not only mis-informed me but didn't have the answers to questions I asked her.
How this place is still open I have no idea!!

Weber's is a pretty cool place.  I usually stop here for a couple of steamed dogs and a hamburger when I'm heading back from Philly to Brooklyn.  The menu is limited to hot dogs, hamburgers, roast pork sandwiches, fries and the like.  Their two big attractions are the drive-in service (like Arnold's in Happy Days) and the homemade root beer which has some nice spice.   Now as a Brooklynite it's my natural duty to say that the dogs don't beat Gray's however for steamed dogs they're pretty good and the chopped raw onion sprinkled with some salt makes a world of difference.  

Service is impeccable.  Everyone from the waitress to the grill people are polite and go out of their way to make you happy.  Just pull in, flash your headlights a few times (if you want car service) and wallah your order is taken and delivered in minutes.  My only complaints are that they don't serve onion rings, pickles and diet root beer.  Not a deal killer but certainly a setback.  You should also be aware that when driving on Route 38 Weber's comes up fast.  Try and stay on the right side and go semi-slow.  

Weber's is seasonal.  I believe they're open from April to October.  Having lunch and being able to stretch and inhale the combination of hot dogs/fries, traffic on Rt 38 and the trees is a nice way to kill thirty or so minutes
Excellent place for Sushi, Tues-Thursday they have a sushi buffet which is always fresh, if you don't see it out just ask they will even make it for you! Excellet service and priced accordingly.

I used to love the Wegman's near me in King of Prussia but then they renovated.  Their main change was that the put the beer and wine in the center of the store and to make room for it by removing some products I used to love.   They changed the cashier policies so now there are only 2 checkout lanes open that you can go through if you are buying alcohol with you groceries.  AND they put the slowest cashiers on those aisles.  So the net effect is that they don't have all of my favorites and it is much much much longer to do a quick shopping that includes a 6-pack.  So the net effect for us is that we will get our beer at the distributors to avoid those long long lines.  

Waiting in line is not anyone's idea of a good time.

I have no idea what they are trying to do....but I hope this post will help resolve.

If you want yummy and affordable pizza and wings Pizza Plus is the place to go. You should know it does take awhile to get it delivered since it is always busy. Definitely have to try this place at least once!

I came in spur of the moment, no appointment, as I was desperately trying to find a quick shop to go to to have some minor repair done. I pulled up to Caliber Collision and when I walked in to the main lobby I was a little nervous that it might not be possible to get in or on the other hand, really expensive based on how nice, clean and professional the lobby itself was. I walked up to the front desk and explained the situation, which was that my bumper on my Lexus lease had popped out in one part after hitting a curb and I could not get it back in. She called a tech immediately, he came out and took a look. Grabbed a tool and the bumper was literally fixed in less than 5 minutes at no charge at all.
