The guys name was Jason and he is in the South Tampa location. He was extremely friendly, didn't take advantage of me and really put my mind at ease about everything. I appreciated so very much the kind, quick and excellent service he provided me and I 100% recommend using Caliber Collision for any troubles big or small. If this is the service I got for something this small, I can only imagine how great they are for the more serious things. Thank you thank you thank you!

Excellent breakfast place. Lots of healthy options, almost too many healthy options as I couldn't tell what some of the ingredients were, but that's what google is for right?! The place was busy but we waited and it was with it. Service was great also. Definitely recommend it if in downtown Tampa.
Was pleasantly surprised with all the food - shocked by some of the flavors and how strong they were. The $33 fixed menu is a pretty sweet deal.

We stumbled upon this place as we were looking for something quick and healthy for lunch on our way to a weekend gateway. Both of us got poke bowl build your own and it was probably the best poke bowl I have ever had. The ingredients were really fresh and there were variety to choose from. I highly recommend this place and can't wait to go back again soon.

The wait on this place is no joke! We actually got there on a Sunday around 1ish and the line was taking forever - we ended up leaving and coming back the next morning earlier around 9am. The wait wasn't as bad. We had a total wait time of 1 hour. We ordered the egg plate, princess and east nasty and an order of bonuts. LOVED the princess - the chicken had a great taste, loved the spicy was of it. The biscuits themselves are so soft and delicious! You can get the east nasty with spicy chicken as well and it's called the nasty princess! haha The bonuts were alright - not a huge fan of them, not as sweet as I would've hoped they would've been but I guess that's where the biscuit flavor comes in. Side note - their chai latte was great! They have their own mix so it isn't your standard tazo chai taste you get almost everywhere else which I appreciated it! Overall I'm glad we tried this place out and I get what all the hype is about it! The service was amazing as well - we ordered and got our food really quick! Definitely a Nashville trip must!

Very satisfied. Bring a light jacket, we sat on the 2nd floor and it was freezing. I ordered the stuffed flounder and my mother ordered the Filet. The chef is amazing it was absolutely delicious. Our server Brittany was great. Had recommendations about the menu and was always checking on us. The table next to us were really giving her a had time and she handled it beautifully. We finished our meal with the award winning key lime pie. Enough said it was delicious!!'
All I can say is they are AMAZING, I have sent several people there and they are hooked as well. Best shop in NV.

My wife and I recently visited your restaurant in Gettysburg. My wife ordered the mashed potatoes with a side of gravy, we were shocked to find out that we were charged for the gravy, which was no more that a couple of tablespoons. You guys are losers or extremely cheap. We spent 83 dollars worth of stuff there, it is hard to believe we were charged for the gravy

What happened to Harvest Moon??? The last three times have been a disaster with food and customer service.  The food has been oily, greasy and doesn't have the taste it once had.  This used to be my (and many other friends) favorite restaurant.  I went to lunch with my daughter a day ago.  My food was so greasy I could not eat it.  My daughter had a beef dish.  It did not taste good. The manager came over and at once became very defensive, telling my daughter it could not be the meat, it was probably her.  When I said I tasted it as well and it was not good, she said it couldn't be the meat, she used good meat, and suggested it was the sauce and we were just not used to it.  She left and came back saying she had taken 5.00 off of our ticket rather than the whole price of the meal because my daughter had eaten her salad.  The good food and times at The Harvest Moon are obviously memories... After similar experiences 3 different times, I don't believe there will be a 4th!
This is one of favorite places when I'm that area. Pineapple fried rice and green beans are dynamite. Best for carry out or delivery. Very small dining room.
The food is amazing and I felt welcome by the great staff. Great atmosphere too! I will def be frequenting this Indy Indian restaurant.

There seems to be plethora of dessert/drink places in Chinatown of Philadelphia. I got to try out this place since it had pretty good reviews and it was very close to where I was staying. It is clean inside and everything looks modern unlike some of the shops in Chinatown. They have a display of real fruits, which I assume they use for their drinks. They deserve some stars for making their store aesthetically pleasing because it makes people want to stay in there.

I got the colorful fruit drink which had bunch of small bits of random fruits and seeds. The taste was good and fruity but there's this sour black seed that I did not like and ended up spitting out everytime. Basically I wasn't able to avoid that seed until I figured out a way to only drink the liquid and not eat any of the fruit pieces inside. I guess I can't really blame the store for that because I am sure they mentioned that those seeds were in there, I just did not really read it. I definitely want to try another drink though.

Another good thing about this place was that they did not have a credit card minimum, which was actually very hard to find in Chinatown. I don't carry around cash anymore and I am sure a lot of people do not these days. But here's why I cannot give 5 stars for this place. They advertise that they sell desserts at the store, which is also another reason why I went there. However, when I got there, they have a sign in the store saying the dessert is all sold out. Well I couldn't even find any pictures of the desserts on Yelp from other users. Could it be that they just never had any dessert to begin with? False advertisement maybe? Not sure, but either way I would still recommend this place to get a drink. Just don't think that they would have any dessert.

What a place!!  The pig is my favorite animal, I have eaten about every part of the animal I can... Living in the SF Bay Area, I'm exposed to lots of Chinese food that cook everything but the "oink"...But I digress... Great place for B.Fast; had Bloody Marys with Bacon stirrer, great idea.  

Great pork dishes, had B.Fast of Eggs Bennie; with nice apple wood bacon...They do serve a taster of seven cures of bacon, will have that next time in Tucson... My pals also had eggs Bennie, had hash browns, asked for them well done and they were, it takes guts to brown hash browns correctly.

Service was great, friendly waitress, 

Bacon?  Hell, yes...You bring it, I eat it.  Thank You Mr. Pig--I do love you...
I went back to The Alley after trying some other places in Philly and NYC, and don't know why I ever strayed. Jeremiah nailed it again. I've found my home.

love that rooster slinger!

its a little loud inside, but you can sometimes get some seating outside
gets busy! but that's a sign of a good place

I keep going back because the food is so good.  Service is usually good, but the employees seem forget about the patio.  My dad and I went to Amy's for breakfast this morning.  He wanted to sit on the patio.  I reminded him that we waited forever the last time we sat outside, but he wanted to sit there anyway.  We saw as we passed the patio that there were empty tables, but the hostess asked if we could wait just a couple minutes, after taking a look outside.  We waited and waited, while people who came after us were seated quickly.  My dad went back to ask about our table.  We were then seated immediately at a patio table that should have been cleaned better, and a spill had never been wiped off a chair.  The hostess brought us utensils, then a server came right away.  We didn't wait too long for our food, but she never brought my dad's toast, and took a long time to refill his coffee cup. I thought about never going back there again, but the food is too good to stop eating there.  I do wonder if the employees forget about the patio, or just don't like to go out there, and if the hostess had a real reason to ask us to wait, or if she was just hoping we'd get tired of waiting and leave. I think it's time to close the patio, or remind the employees that it IS there.
Food is amazing! Great atmosphere and love the restaurant. We're visiting from Dallas, TX and will definitely be back to eat here again.

The first time I went to Farmicia was for brunch.  Let me say outright, that brunch was delicious!  I would give the brunch 4 stars and my recommendation any day.

HOWEVER, dinner was a disaster.  A group of friends and I went here for dinner after I talked it up so much for their brunch.  I ordered the Tres Tamales.  They have a lot of vegetarian options, so I really thought I would like this place.  However, when my meal came out it was plated so unappealingly that I really didn't want to eat it.  It was served on what looked like a cafeteria tray in a grade school.  It wasn't just my food that was plated poorly either.  All of my friends meals looked like they were just thrown together haphazardly.  

But, I thought, who cares what it looks like, as long as it's good.  Nope.  It tasted terrible and I couldn't even finish it.  

The desserts were not memorable at all and mostly dry and tasteless.  

After the meal, I was just embarrassed for having recommended it.  

So in summary: go here for a fabulous brunch, but stay away at all costs for dinner. Blech.
Super nice staff and I had a pretty good massage, however my friend was really disappointed. A little mire expertise and pressure needed. Clean nice little place.

Just enjoyed a nice lunch at Medport. My friend ordered the fried oyster platter and I got the beef gyro. They were both nicely prepared and fresh. Our waitress was very attentive. Glad to see how the new management has turned things around.
Tried the BLT-A in a wrap with fries and it was great! The other menu options sound great too. Will definitely be back.

I love Pottruck. I initially signed up because, as a HUP employee, I get a pretty sweet discount. I wasn't sure how much I'd actually like it since he place is huge and rather sterile feeling. After a couple of spins on the elliptical, I realized that I was extremely pleased with the facility. Pottruck is clean and spacious enough to handle hundreds of people a day. I have never had to wait for a machine and I have never encountered out-of-order equipment. The machines have iPod jacks that will play your music through the machine AND charge your iPod at the same time.  The hours are great - I can go early in the morning, later at night, and anytime in between. The staff, for the most part, is really friendly, accommodating, and helpful. One afternoon, I forgot my lock and one staff member offered to watch my stuff  while I worked out so that I wouldn't have to hunt for a quarter locker. I like that they have day lockers where you can supply your own lock. This means not having to shell out extra dough for a place to stash your stuff during your work out. The juice bar is a plus as well if you're in need of a bottle of water or a recovery shake. I can't yet comment on the the classes, but I'm looking forward to trying a few come spring. Pottruck offers alot from classes, to rock climbing and an outdoors club, to the pool, and their Penn Fit Program. They also offer personal training and massage therapy which I am looking forward to trying. The best part for me is that they are a part of the Blue Cross' Healthy Lifestyles program - after 120 workouts, I get $150 back from my health insurance company.

Great friendly librarians.  Well informed and always willing to assist.  I am not a patron of this county but that does not matter, they have a system set up for anyone to use their public computers with a temp pass.

If I'm the only "less than 5*" review, it is only because Angad is so new and there are still some wrinkles to work out. Read the other reviews, they're right. This place is neat. We stayed in a yellow room, and we loved it. I can't imagine staying in a room that wasn't yellow, truth be told. The only drawback is the sunlight early in the morning. If you're a person of high energy, I would go yellow.

This place really pampers you. The staff are overtly wonderful and the art and furnishings are divine. Words cannot express the entire scene. It's simply beyond words, yet, here I am using them to give it my best college try. Unique? yes. But unique with patterned boldness. Even the parking lot attendants are over-eager to accommodate your every whim. Heck, our fellow even gave us a small bow as he helped us onto the correct elevator.

Which launches me into my small list of changes I would see The AAH change, should they continue into the future and charge triple the rate they charged us. Firstly, and most importantly... Let's label those elevators more properly. It's as frustrating as it tries to be charming. But alas, I eventually found my way out onto the street so I could go to the Fox Theatre to watch my play. Early the next morning, I had to call and ask if the coffee was included in the mini-bar pricing. I couldn't find any information about it (paper-wise) and had to call guest services.

As I have mentioned before, I was in a yellow room. Floor 8 to be precise. I had to wake up at the crack of dawn, because of the light. There is no way to darken such a room... Or is there? Maybe if there were blackout curtains behind the yellow drapes, that would help to alleviate the obvious problem of yellow. But alas, white and yellow hide not yon sun well.

And please give me a chance or opportunity or way to turn off the air! The humidity level was such that I had to keep consuming water all during my stay, so I would not acquire a nosebleed. And I'm not employing sarcasm. It was dreadful... But I got over it, leaving the room and heading to the "lobby" on floor twelve.

I shall recall an instance, here, lest I forget, of a small struggle with my wife and the magical wardrobe provided in the room that served as a functionary closet. She is five foot three inches and hired me to do all of her clothes hanging on said hangers. Maybe can y'all shorten those a bit?  I don't know if even Zsa Zsa Gabor would have needed such height for her gowns to not be dragging on the bottom, for they may have been seven feet high.

As I so sipped my water throughout the night, I looked for a coaster, and could not find one. Also, after a post-coitus shower, I found not a bathroom floor mat, and felt like a hobo using one of the many small towels provided. And, after suffering some post-Catholic guilt, I looked around for the small Gideon Bible that is always there, but alas, I had to recompense myself and take my sins to sleep.

All these things being said, again, I wholeheartedly love and would visit again, this very wonderful place. They make you feel like you are king of a very strange and surreal castle.

Oh... And those eyeball pillows that you see in the photos? I hid mine in the wardrobe. Hopefully, they're on their way to Narnia.

On a rainy Sunday night, we came celebrating the male cub's 15th birthday.  One of the joys of watching your kids grow is to see their taste change from Friendlys to Five Guys to Sweet Lucy's.  And now, he's open to trying some authentic Italian.  Constrained by time we decided we couldn't make it into town for Melograno and so we settled for this Collingswood Italian BYOB.  

The service was friendly and efficient.  The appetizers started the meal well.  The wonderful fried calamari came accompanied by the standard cocktail sauce and a light green pesto.  Although it was a bit greasy, the light, flaky breading surrounded moist and fresh squid rings and tentacles.  The Insalata Saporis was a light bed of fresh greens in a light vinaigrette.  The special octopus carpaccio, I think, sat too long in the dressing and was a bit tough.

The main entrees for our family spanned a number of pasta dishes and a salmon.  The best one was a wonderfully  moist flavorful salmon with yummy fried zucchini chips and a bright lightly sauteed spinach.  I ordered the interesting red beet, squash and sausage risotto, but it was overcooked, mushy, not creamy and not al dente.  I was expecting an interesting combination of flavors with the unexpected pairing of beets and sausage, but there was no real complexity and the flavors did not mesh into something revelatory.  Similarly, the duck ragu gnocchi was another interesting rarely seen combination, but the ragu overcooked the duck and masked any of it's flavor and the gnocchi were too large and mushy.  The birthday boy's Maine lobster fettuccine in a cream sauce was well balanced dish, with the lobster meat just a tad overdone.  Lastly the daughter's pearl pasta with shrimp was too salty with the shrimp way too overcooked and reminded me of the smelly preserved dried shrimp that my mom cooked - and didn't like.  

On the whole, it was a so-so meal, with the execution way off.  I liked their dedication to authenticity and the interesting ideas on the menu.  Would like to return to try again, hoping that Sunday night is when the owner-chef is off.

First- don't come here if you're in a hurry.  Even when they are slow, no one is trying to get you your food quickly.  Second, order only food that you are okay eating like warm.  Third, NEVER order shakes or desserts with your meal.  They will start to make those after they finally look at your food order that's been sitting on the counter forever.  So you can plan on at least another ten minutes while your food gets even colder.  This was my experience both times I visited.  No bueno!!
Everyday d and d.  They get you in and out fast. Know what you want when you come in.  No complaints.  Not enough seating area.
The service was amazing. We were seated  immediately and help right away.The BBQ was very good lots of BBQ sauce flavors we will definitely be back.
drinks only (full bar), great live music, but free to bring any of your food in! I think it's very COOL

Fuji apple chicken salad for lunch: disappointing. Less than one cups of salad greens dried apples and way too much onion. I had two slivers of chicken in my salad. I love Panera, yet this location needs to improve.

I can't believe I never submitted a review for GPPG...  I'm in Boise fairly often for work, but on the last trip, I stayed in Meridian, instead of Boise.  That meant driving around new areas and finding new gems, like this one!  It was near my hotel, so I stopped to check it out, and it is now my favorite place in Idaho!  

I was trying to watch what I eat, so the first couple visits, I managed to steer myself toward the salads, but I couldn't resist everything else for very long.  The salads were great, but let's face it...  Even a great salad is a salad, so let's talk about the real stuff:   all of the pies I tried were fantastic, but I'd have to say the GPPG was my favorite.  The chorizo really pushes it over the top.  If sandwiches are more your thing, then go with the Gramercy.  Pot roast, corned beed, fries and slaw!  So messy, but oh, so worth it.  And can't avoid mentioning the Crabber Tots...  I mean, come on...  tater tots, right?  Not the most elegant dish in the world..   Tater tots with crab, bacon, cheddar, and smoked corn?  Damn, now I'm hungry again...
Great place to watch Game of Thrones and chow on fresh Vietnamese bites on Sunday eves. Lots of seating in back. Nice divey ambience. Get there earlier if you want a good seat.

Overall, very good food. Definitely inconsistent though. I've stopped going there as often as I used to because of that reason.  Seafood Risotto is great depending who makes it. Betabel salad is fabulous. Quesadillas are always great. The pricing is also inconsistent, which can be frustrating. Good food though!!

I would absolutely recommend Carl Alan to any bride and groom! From our first meeting with them, they were attentive, creative, responsive, and professional, and we felt confident immediately that in working with Carl Alan we would get great service, breathtaking flowers and professional expertise, which is EXACTLY what we got! It was wonderful, as a bride, to be able to sit back and feel confident that they would deliver exactly what they promised, within budget and on time, and they did. Our consultations with our designer were some of the most fun meetings we had, and Vito immediately understood the look we were going for and made it happen. They worked within our budget, and were able to re-purpose some of our flowers from an centerpiece that we ended up not needing as a stunning decoration on our escort card table. The centerpieces were absolute show-stoppers, dramatic and beautiful, and were the talk of the reception, and my bouquet and my bridesmaids bouquets were absolutely gorgeous. We got a lot of positive feedback from our guests, and we were thrilled with the entire experience! Amazing quality flowers, incredibly creativity and artistry in the design, and 100% reliable service both beforehand and day-of. I would use them again in a second, and we are so grateful to Carl Alan for helping to make our wedding day so beautiful!!!

Flat tire.

Put on the spare.

Drove to two places.

No one was wearing masks.

We drove on.

Pulled over. Called Pep Boys.

Explained to them that our daughter was in chemo and asked if they would wear masks.

They said "It's company policy."

We drive there.

One guy's mask is hanging under his nose.

Okay, I'll take my chances.

The heavy set lady (4:00 PM on 1/25 if anyone in corporate cares) took her mask completely off and was repeatedly clearing her throat.

I said "I can't be in the room with this woman clearing her throat and not wearing a mask."

Turned around.

Left.

How many people have to die before basic human decency is extended to Pep Boy customers?
Very clean and friendly environment. I'm a beginner and I have felt fine coming here. Not super cramped.

Amazing pizza.  Had the thin crust with basil and a slice of Sicilian.  The sauce is killer!  They even sell it at Walmart.  The vibe is chill and the guys that work there are super nice.  I'll be back for sure!

Good food.  Good price and drinks.  Great beer specials on Thursday.  Live music on some days.  Rhonda is great! Zack is awesome!  The owner Donna is extra nice.  Bad.... $1.50 for tall drinks with no extra alcohol.  When Monica is working it seems that her husband Butch is always there.  He acts as if he owns the place.  Because of this, we are very particular when we go there. 
Give it a shot.  It really is a good place.

Less than stellar french manicure. It chipped within the first day and by day 4 was in need of serious repair. Same with my sister in law's, although she didn't get a french manicure, just normal polish. I guess the saying "you get what you pay for" comes into play here. 
I would also like to add that nothing I did could have contributed to the short lifespan of my french tips. I do have to give Illusion Salon kudos for not using tips though, quite impressive.

The chicken did smell good. Unfortunately the taste was not the same. Service was quick and cold. Seemed like the employees were not happy to be there. Now the chicken, the chicken was under cooked. Bones were broken and the meat was tainted with bone marrow.

   For the most part Popeye's usually has very good chicken depending on the location, owned, and staff. This appears to be a bad location.  Hopefully it was a just a bad batch of chicken, but you're trying your luck buying here.

Very good hoagie place... my parents recommended it and they've tried most in the area. It's no frills but the food is fresh and tasty and extremely reasonable. Their small "Zep" is more than one meal for me, and that's $6 and change... much less expensive than Wawa or any of the chain options, and way better quality. (I used to love Wawa but the deli is not what it used to be.) This is our go-to place for hoagies to take to the park for a picnic lunch, and the second half for dinner that night.

Quick! Close you eyes and imagine a sports watching utopia... What do you see? Let me guess: tons of TVs, a plethora of craft beer, and exposed brick? Yup I thought so. Now, open your eyes... You are now in Tampa's hottest tavern and tap - Brick House. 

This place has everything: tons of TVs, a plethora of craft beer, exposed brick, and even waitresses. Also this is the only place in Tampa where you can find human metronomes. You know, that thing where a midget stands on your table and claps along to whatever song is being played at the restaurant? They have that (not really). They also have human palm trees. You know that thing where a couple of retired NBA players grow out their Afros, dye them green and stand around pretending to be trees? Well they have that too (no they don't). 

Really though, this place is actually great. Nice relaxing atmosphere and an awesome place to watch a football game. They have tons of different craft beers and an assortment of tasty food. The wait staff was very friendly and attentive and our waitress took great care of us. I would definitely recommend!

9 team mates & I piled into this place after our workout so, we caught them by surprise at 3pm.  We did not know there wasn't a wait staff working during the day-it's self serve.  That said we ordered a few Greek salads with chicken, Caprese's, Mediterranean's, slices, cheesesteak sub, & a meatball sub, spaghetti.  They have a limited alcohol selection, beer & wine.  All was reasonably priced. The team poll said all the food was really good & we'd be back again-probably best to call first if you have a large group. It's family run so they really tried to make up for not having wait staff on but, it was 3p....
By far the best drunken noodles, masaman curry and chicken Tom Kha soup in Metairie and even New Orleans!

I'm never coming back here again. I ordered take out late at night (my favorite place Spice C was closed) and was quoted $7.50 on the phone for beef noodles and a marinated egg. When I went to pick up, I got billed $8.30. I asked why the increase, the lady told me it's because the noodles are 6.75, I got an egg for .75, and then there's tax. This frankly annoyed me. The whole reason they are cash only is probably to commit tax fraud or have employees that work under the table. 

Anyway, I shrugged that off and left.  I got home to eat my take out and found they didn't even give me my egg. They are closed now so I can't call them and complain or do a charge back because I didn't pay with credit.

Food is still mediocre, too! UGH. Go to Spice C instead.

This is a great place for happy hour! Until 7 every day they offer $3 stoli martinis as well as $11 prime rib special. They have the best blue cheese stuffed olives for your martini too! They do charge an extra $.25 on top of $3 martini for 2 but well worth it. Prime rib special runs until 7 each day. Comes with 1 side and onion straws. I'd keep the onion straws as garnish, super greasy!!! Prime rib is not the best cut but for the price it's worth it. Must include horseradish and au jus sauce to get the best flavor!  We sat at the bar and service was pretty quick. I'd recommend they always give people water as soon as they are seated is all.

We had a house fire and needed our High Velocity HVAC replaced.  Mike Pagnottelli gave a  thorough and easy to understand explanation  of the work that needed to be  done, he worked directly with our insurance company and has been available for questions throughout the process. The installation team was also excellent- Trong, Jamil, Tan and Mike were very professional and finished the job ahead of schedule.  I would highly recommend Unique for any High Velocity HVAC services.

It was okay, I got fried chicken and it was EVERYTHING! The two sides I got were macaroni and cheese, and yams. I wasn't the biggest fan of those, but the chicken superseded those sides. Everyone working there was nice and welcoming!

Read some of the reviews I didn't think I was imagining this.. went to this joint to check out the personal undies. I wanted to fall in love with this place and I wanted to spend my money and get a nice set. I didn't purchase anything but my friend did. 
 So I'm gonna presume she's the owner..the older woman in the Indianapolis store what a hag! I found her to be short,curt and rather rude. 
There is a such thing as you've worked too long and need to retire especially when your passion has waned. Unfortunately, I sense  it's deeper than that. Let's say she's just born that way,  oh she's always been mean and crabby or that time has hardened the ogre or we can call it what it really is... there's no excuse for rudeness.

With much anticipation the Tiki docks Is open! They have more than exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere is like a margaritaville with a local vibe. The menus offers a variety of items that I believe. Will meet both land lovers and the person looking for something different. They are still working out being a new establishment but the service made it seem like they have been working together for years.

So I know a lot about the service industry from working in it and the "service" we were given was tons of crap. The hostess wrote my name and "number" down. one of my girlfriends later told me that she only wrote 2 digits down and only pretended to take down my full number. After 30 mins we came back and was told that our wait time was only 10 mins. Went to the bar and after waiting 20 mins for a drink. Which was ridiculous(obvious the bartender could care less until a young gentleman pointed at me to serve me). Confused as to why we hadn't been called we ask the young blonde hostess why we hadn't been called to seated. She said they called and no one responded. I didn't get a call and she even admitted this to us after I showed her my call log. WHAT A CROCK OF SH*T. Then they bumped us to the bottom of the wait list and told us if we wanted to wait another 30 mins that they would sit us then. You have to be kidding me!!! And as she tells us this she is smirking... WORST RESTAURANT EXPERIENCE EVER! Left and ate at Frenchies which was good.

Thank you guys for taking such good care of me. Everyone in this office is wonderful. They make you feel so comfortable. The Dr. Really cares and it shows. Office always clean and smells great. Thank you guys for getting me through such a hard time.

Airy and artsy inside with traditional Brazilian food, as well as the new health classic, acai bowl. My BF is a bona fide Acai Bowl snob, and he completely approved of this one! There are also a lot to choose from. 

I got a fresh squeezed juice that was delicious -- beets, dandelion and celery. Either you love it or hate it. I loved it! BF hated it . . . which was fine by me . . . more for me, bwahahaha.
great service, great food, and way better parking than 21st. just wish I could still walk here from work.

I was a little surprised reading other people's comments about the prices here, someone stated $9 for a bowl of soup is ridiculous but that is your entree, I'm happy to pay $9 for a huge bowl of soup as my meal! I go with my husband quite often since we first started frequenting this place 5 years ago and we can easily eat for 19-21 dollars or for $40-50... I feel like people just complain about the prices because the other crappy hole in the wall viet places around stl are cheap, well you get what you pay for if you ask me. I always know that monsoon will impress, we like to order the spicy zen tofu cooked in black bean sauce, Saigon sizzling crepe, scallop curry, pork chop, and the pho. All are yummy and consistently good which I can appreciate. I know for a fact from a close friend who works for the county health dept. that this place is very clean which is important to me, whereas I have read the public records of other vietnamese places around town who have lossed points on there grades for having dogs in the kitchen or for keeping expired food. Yuck! Another thing I noticed is the authenticity reports, monsoon seems to have a great blend of tradition and fusion, which is what the owner has stated they strive for, so what's the problem? If the food is delish then I cant complain! Thanks for continuously creating good food and great service over the past 5 years! Also, they serve alcohol now!

This was a really nice breakfast spot. Service was fast, food was great, and prices were very reasonable.  I highly recommend. 
I had the omelet and grits it was delicious!

ABEDNEGO is a super cute store in the hip neighborhood of Germantown. This area keeps growing and growing and I keep finding new businesses to explore. While the area has a lot of delicious restaurants, I think the shopping is also really great. There are a few cute boutiques that are locally owned (by women, girl power!) that I suggest checking out. ABEDNEGO is in a small strip of boutiques. While it is a smaller store, it has a lot of great items at a reasonable price. The majority is women's clothing, shoes, and accessories, but there are also some home goods for both men and women. The clothing is very "in" and has a boho-chic style. The owner is very nice and has always greeted me right when I walked in the door. She personally chooses everything that goes in her store. I always like buying local, especially when you meet the person who put so much work and passion into their business. It gives you a warm fuzzy feeling every time you purchase something. The jewelry is pretty and has a simple modern style. My favorite part is the shoe selection. If I was looking for a cool pair of booties or mules, I would come here first. And again, prices are fair for the quality you are receiving. If you're in the neighborhood, ABEDNEGO is worth checking out. There is a lot to do in this area so you make a whole afternoon of it!
If you played a lot of Oregon Trail growing up and wanted to know what it's really like to die from dysentery, this is your place.

My friend and i were shopping @ tha green hills mall and later we were both craving for some sushi near the Greenhills area.. This place was the closest one, so we decided to go in and try it out.. We went in around 4Pm and the restaurant didnt seem to be busy at that moment, so it was jus' the two of us out of that entire place. The sushi and the food was pretty good, but the service wasn't as good as i was expecting it to. We literally had to yell 3 or 4 times to catch their attention that we were ready to place our order, our waitress and some other employees were on their phones or just talking the entire time, The waitress also didnt bother to check if we needed more drink, or if everything was ok.. Also, our waitress basically acted like she wanted no customers at all because of the boringness and madness on her face . I was expecting it to be more better service than that. Also, when we sat by the window.. It was Awfully dirty!! As if it hadnt been cleaned or wiped in yearss.!! Anyways, the sushi was nice, Jus' the customer service and all the dust in that place kinda ruined it .

Unexpectedly good.
Sushi was on point. The fried rice and cooked dishes were great. They tasted more like something from Benihana than like a local takeout restaurant. Service was good too.

They make the cutest coasters & magnets!  It's a couple that owns this business and they have a lil' studio here where they're made.  They also sell them @ the French Market.  He does the photography and she makes them by hand, one by one.  They knew they were on to something when locals brought in vintage items (shopping bags, photos, etc) to create into coasters.  All of their designs represent New Orleans and its history, it's really cool!

If you're looking into a great souvenir to bring back home, these are great!  Especially since they're locally made in New Orleans!  I bought a 4 coaster set and he threw in a magnet for my lagniappe, whatta sweet surprise!  They're super heavy duty and well made.  Even our bed & breakfast had them in our room to use as coasters.  We wondered where we could get a set and lo' & behold, we happened to run across them while shopping.

I love love love the amount of choices this place has for our picking! 

For my first time I tried the Bento Box with sesame soy chicken! The bento box included rice, lo mein, a ginger salad and some little wonton triangles. Super good and very filling! We got spring rolls to share - 3 per order which is different than most places that have 4. But none the less - very good! My boyfriend got a orange chicken noodle bowl and a flying dragon roll. We were both stuffed to a brim but not enough to not drink our boba teas!

For the boba we tried a mix for each of us. One milk tea chocolate taro mix and a pineapple mango blended ice tea! Both were great and gave us a sugar buzz for sure.

Overall this place is great and I will be returning! I and excited to try out other options they offer
Very good shrimp po-boy, but not amazing, and for the price it should have been much bigger.

A small airport in Idaho's biggest little city.  TSA generally moves with a little bit of urgency so you don't have to wait in line for a week to get through security but it's not like the airport is big and you need to run from gate to gate.  Compared to O'Hare Airport, the entire BOI airport could fit in one O'Hare terminal.
Great hotel and historical landmark. Excellent brunch spot on the weekend. I often have breakfast meetings there during the week.

The customs officials are great and most of the workers are friendly as well. I just despise the layout of this port. The long walk from deck 7 is annoying plus the walk around and then the wait at the doors. 

The traffic is crazy busy and we had a bus pick us up (custom one not the public ones) and it couldn't get through until everyone was pretty much picked up first so we waited a long time in 45 degree weather. 

The people just kind of tell you to stay out of the way as far as luggage people and come hauling around corners. It's crowded so getting out of the way isn't as easy as they think it should be for you.

There are reasonably priced snacks at the end by door 1, with clean restrooms. The snacks are little bags of chips, crackers, candy bars, gross looking sandwiches and cold burgers, and juices and red bull.

I love this salon! They are professional, friendly and prompt. They do an excellent job on both my nails and toes and take a real interest in caring about me. The salon is very clean and professional. My daughter and I love going here! They make me very happy  All the girls are kind, as well as experts in what they do!

What a wonderful place to relax, enjoy some great food (the drunken pig flatbread is to die for), the drinks and the lake! Troy makes the absolute BEST sangrias around, and be sure to ask for Pauline's key lime martinis. This is just a great place to hang out and have fun. The service is just how we like it -- friendly and helpful; we can get what we need when we need it without being pestered every 5 minutes. If you're in a hurry, just let the staff know when you come in. This is really a laid back neighborhood place where you can spend time enjoying the ambiance without feeling pressure to move things along. We always liked the location, but since the new owners have taken over, we like everything about the place.
Great atmosphere and super fast service! The salsa and cheese dip are some of the best I've had in a while around this area.
My cat was being a little piece of shit and everybody who helped was great even with my cat acting up. Thank you all!!! They are really good

My boyfriend and I brought our two dogs in after they got their shots for a treat. We were the only customers in the store. We had planned to get them treats from the display case, but the two ladies working were too deep into their own conversation to even ask if we needed help despite us standing there waiting for a long time. Super disappointing service. We definitely won't be returning to this location. We left and took them to Three Dog Bakery in Broad Ripple and received excellent and kind service, as always.

Unassuming hole-in-the-wall restaurant in a strip mall. Small noisy interior with 2 TVs one showing Latin Music Videos...but you  couldn't hear them because of the other loud Latin music blasting over the speaker system from a different source. Closed Captioning wasn't on...so who knows what the TV music sounded like.

The Good: Very friendly, congenial, attentive service. Inexpensive.

The Not so Good: Complimentary stale tortilla chips (although they were warm...but definitely had stayed out too long somewhere.) served with thin, spicy salsa.

Empanadas (decent size) - were fine, except that we ordered one Carne Asada (ok) and one Chicken (bland). However, they both came with cheese filling in addition to the meat. No description of the cheese addition on the (limited0 menu. That would not be a good surprise for someone who is allergic to dairy products! ... Empanadas also came with a paltry few tablespoons of salad (ok, let's call it a garnish) along with with a tablespoon of sour cream. (See photo I've posted.)

Worse: We ordered several Tacos: Chicken, Carnitas, and Tongue. Best of the bunch was the Tongue--very tender and flavorful. Chicken was pretty bland and the Carnitas were a bit fatty--but tender. The tacos were served naked...no toppings, no garnish, no nuttin' else. And they were greasy...enough to soak through the paper they were served on. (We both ended up adding some of the salsa to our tacos just to kick in some additional flavor and heat.)

Perhaps the most telling clue about this place today was the sign on the door advertising for a cook.

Hate to say it, but I just can't recommend this place except for the service and reasonable prices. For food....sorry.

I think I've found my favorite Thai restaurant in Indy. I have tried at least 5 or 6 in Indy and this is it! Parking is tricky, but expected. They do have an outdoor seating. We've got 3 dishes. Duck, drunken noodles, and pad Thai. Duck was tender and loved the sauce. Drunken noodle was large and the spiciness was on point. And pad Thai was already great. This is a great place for a family sharing style meal. All the dishes were large size where you would be able to share. I do have to say, server was bit slow and got my order little wrong, but food was great. They do have weekday lunch specials. Looked like it was around $9. I would definitely come back if I'm craving some Thai.
I love this chain, but this is the worst Sonic I have ever been to, AND the worst customer service I have received in all of Nashville.

SO yummy!!  We ordered two sandwiches to go, the Main Beef (roast beef, red onion, thousand island) and a grilled cheese with ham, roast beef, and bacon; both on their homemade cheddar bread. The sandwiches were wrapped up hot, so of course the bread lost a little of it's crispiness.  I put the sandwiches in an air fryer when I got home for just a couple of minutes to crisp them up. They were crazy good.  I can't wait to go back and try more!  

I was pleasantly surprised by their unique drink and chip selection.  Lots of different options in the drink cooler - all the same price.  Makes it feel like a real treat.

One of the best in the area.
The owner is the chef and spends time at the back which is great.
The staff are nice and friendly.

Not to blow my own whistle, but I was a sushi lover way before it became trendy :) And let me tell ya Sakura is the place to go for good sushi. Its a small place and you often have to wait but it is worth it. The sushi is great and fresh and made right to order, sit at the bar or a table with friends. Not only is their sushi good but also the entrees are delicious too, especially the tempura. This is definitely a great place to go with friends sip on some saki and have some sushi!

I think my coworkers built this place up quite a bit as THE place to go to when they get into Boise.

They forgot to mention that it's mainly because it serves decent food close to the airport.  That, and they haven't really spent much time in Boise to find anything else.

Oh well.

The sandwiches were definitely interesting and I made the mistake of getting some fish'n chips... what can I say, I was craving it.  It was way overcooked and didn't put me in a good mood for our drive to Mountain Home.  Alas.  I'm pretty sure I'll be stopping by again should work send me this way.

This was not a good first experience. The tots were good but the breakfast was quite disappointing after such a long wait. However, the waitress was nice and they did apply a discount on the bill for the problems.

The last two visits at Kelly's has result in injuries to my feet during the past 3 months.  The first resulted in the top of my foot being filed down to 1/4 bleeding hole with a pumis stone.  I had no calluses on top side of my foot prior to the visit and I do not know why she was doing this anyways. It took 5 weeks to heal.  I decided to try another pedicure thinking this couldn't happen twice.  It did.  This time the bottom of two toes on my R foot were rubbed raw.  They were red and raw as if I was walking on the bottom of a rough pool for hours.  I could not walk and place pressure on my toes for 3 weeks.  It is gradually granulating up to the surface but still has a scab after 4 weeks  The owner of Kelly's was the one that performed both manicures.  I have never had this happen anywhere else.  You would think if she is the owner of this business that gives pedicures she of all people should know how NOT to injure a client.  I am going elsewhere can't tolerate the pain and negligence.

YAY! I loved Jim's. I know that there are a lot of review comparing Geno's, Pat's and Jim's, so this is not going to be one of those reviews. Of all the places I've tried for cheesesteaks, Jim's is my favorite. I think that the bread they use is definitely I believe softer than the other two places. But one thing that puts this place over the top is the inside sitting area above the shop where people are able to eat. This ventilated and AC place allows immediate enjoyment of the sandwich in a comfortable place other than outside on the scorching or cold streets.

I recommend!

We recently enjoyed a lovely dinner with our son and his fiance here. It's a nice cozy spot with friendly staff and great sushi. We started with the miso soup and the tum yum soup. Next we had the Tapas for Two and the grilled octopus. For the table we ordered some of their designer rolls. We had the ping pong roll, the King Kong roll, the Henrietta roll and the traffic light. We also ordered the sesame-crusted tuna and the seafood paella. Suffice to say we over ordered and took quite a bit of food home with us. We will definitely be back and I recommend you try them if you are looking for exceptional sushi served with a smile.

Best steak tacos in Indy....Period. The guacamole and pico is fantastic as well. A gentleman who lives in Bakersfield CA and spent some time in Indy sorting out which brakes to use on the Singer Porsche turned me on to this spot. I'm forever indebted to Seamus.

had hulls HVAC install new HVAC unit last August. turned system on this year and did not work. called hulls and owner said no he is not responsible for his work. Jason hull does not stand behind his work and is such a fraud. do not use this company. they do not stand behind their work!!!

If I could give them zero stars I would. They bait you with low mileage one year old vehicles on their website that aren't available (apparently they are all sold the day before you go to the dealership). Before test driving, we told the salesman that we didn't want to waste his time because the sticker prices were about 10-$15,000 higher than the ones we came to see. He of course called in the sales manager who told us they could make us a great deal on a new vehicle. They have a small lot and store their other vehicles at several locations offsite and if you are interested in one, they have to "porter" it to the lot which they say happens within 72 hours. We drove to one of the offsite locations which is only a few miles away where the vehicles are parked and found three vehicles we were interested in. We text our salesman to get us best deal prices on the vehicles and email the information to us. Instead, they wanted us to come back and play let's make a deal. We didn't want to waste any more time at the dealership because we had already been there for hours (it took 30 minutes for them to get ready to  let us take a test drive). An hour later we received a text on which vehicle would be best for us at our price point and asking us when we could come back in, instead of just giving us the prices we asked for. They also said that the three vehicles we picked didn't have the options that we read that they had on the window stickers (which I took a photo of). They closed about 15 minutes after our conversation and text my husband first thing this morning to let him know that they  sold two of the three vehicles we asked about (apparently while they slept) and to give us their bottom line pricing on the third vehicle (which was pretty much sticker price).II have never had such a ridiculous experience at a car dealership I won't buy an Infiniti now because they are the only local dealer in our area and I can only imagine that their service department is run the same.

Had dinner here last week with the in-laws.  Waitress seemed very inexperienced and not aware of the importance of specific requests.  Had to ask for water 4 times!  Took an incredibly long time for the food to be served.  Crazy long time.  Had some food for take out and when we got it home it was wrong.  Bad operation.  Has a lot of potential but poor execution.  Disappointing.

3.5 stars rounded up instead of down

The waitress that was serving us was real good about getting our drink orders in and utensils to us when we needed extra. She also checked in with us from time to time. 

Asian station: Rice noodle soup was pretty good! I really like the noodle station; it's my favorite whenever we go to Carvings. The spicy wings/drumettes were reallyyyyyyyyyyy good! The chow mein was ok, had a good amount of noodles + vegetables

Dessert station: DIY ice cream with toppings (perfect for children), eclairs, brownies, cake, cheesecake, TRUFFLES!!!!! They had a crepe station tooo! I really liked this part of the station because you can choose what toppings you want on your crepe and it was FRESH


The steak had good char marks and tasted good! It wasn't dry at all. I also had a slice of the prime rib and it was dry and tasteless...sad. The waffles had a really cute shape and it was situated right next to the fresh fruits! They had a good selection....lots of melons! Probably because it was in season.

I wanted to try their pasta but there was no one manning the station! I passed on the pizza because it looked like cafeteria food...

I'm too lazy to be motivated to write a yelp review because of one good customer experience, but after about dozen awesome experiences I have to say it- these guys are great. Fast and expert. Once I brought my car and they didn't charge me because it was an easy fix.  They've done several inspections, dozens of oil changes, sold us tires in addition to more major fixes.

I went to winter fest tonight for the first time in a while and I forgot how great it is! It is so festive and beautiful. If you have your own skates, it's super cheap, but if you have to rent it's $10 unfortunately. This bothered me a little bit. There's a food truck, arcade, "lodge" and fire pits to hang out when you get tired skating. As far as outdoor skating goes, I can't think of a better place. It was crowded and the ice got choppy, but that's to be expected. My only complaint would be that the skates were in poor condition. They were barely sharp enough to skate on! But again, this is to be expected with rental skates. Tons of fun!

The pork vermicelli, beef cubes and pho is my go to. No tip establishment. The staff is friendly and well trained.
You could definitely work on your laptop and enjoy some Vietnamese coffee + appetizer.

Just ate there last night with my wife and daughter. OH YEAH! It was goooood eatin'. I had a hankering for BBQ and always wanted to try Famous Dave's so we went.

We ordered the Feast for Two (I think that's what it was called.) billed as being able to feed 2-3 people. I'm telling you, if there are only 2 of you, you are going to be stuffed silly as this can feed 4. It came with a half rack of ribs, a half chicken, I think 6 slices of beef brisket (this was the optional choice--we could have chosen chopped pork or some sausage instead), BBQ beans and cole slaw (you can choose your two sides), and potato wedges. EVERYTHING WAS EXCELLENT!

The ribs were really tasty, the chicken was great, the brisket was tender. The BBQ beans were excellent, the cole slaw was as good or better than KFC's (my favorite until now). The cole slaw style was not fine cut like KFC's, but chopped, not huge pieces but around a little bigger than 1/4" pieces so it was very tasty. The potato wedges were the best we ever had, period. Perfectly lightly crisp on the outside and salted just right. They were not soggy potato wedges. Good enough to go back there for those alone, along with the beans and cole slaw.

I haven't tried the corn muffins yet as I was too busy chowing down on other things. The waiter gave us four to take home along with our left overs.

It was just fun being there. They serve this all on what looks like a fake plastic garbage can lid and it is put on a wooden pedestal. It was a fun presentation with all the food being on one platter. The decor is a car theme. Where we were in the restaurant it was pretty loud because there was a big party there enjoying themselves. Not complaining--just saying that people there were enjoying it as I.

The bill including tax was $40.38. We didn't have any drinks, just water as we are water people. Reasonable for three people. And like I said, this could feed four.

Highly recommended.

Boo. Lol. Seriously, when I moved here 5 years ago, the food was great. Now I won't even eat there anymore. Tried it again recently after 2 bad experiences in the past year or so-- and I will not be back! Meats needing long times to stew (beef,goat) are consistently chewy and not given proper time to cook. Goat was full of fat and gristle. The last 2 times, they were out of beef patties. At different times. Out of beef patties??! Unheard of at a real Jamaican spot. This place has turned into a Lon over rated tourist trap, and/or go-to place for people who have no clue what Jamaican food is supposed to taste like. 
Do yourself a favor-- skip it.

Awesome!  Stopped by for a burrito, but what I got was fantastic service, a big smile from the young girl at the register and yes, a hell of a burrito with everything I asked in it. The BEST and it was in a gas station!

Apartments are already expensive enough without thrusting mandatory valet waste fees into the mix.  I've had Valet at the last 3 apartments and they're really hit or miss.  Some are compliance police and look for reasons NOT to take your trash, others don't even show up for shifts and some go off without a hitch.  At the end of the day, property managers need to evaluate the real "need" for this kind of service because in most communities I've stayed in that have it, you only have one trash compactor on site and it's usually conveniently located (one you could easily drop your trash off as you left in the morning, one was only three buildings so you were never more than a hundred feet at most away from the compactor and the current community is also relatively small with the trash compactor located in the middle of it).  A lot of property managers will tell you they've asked residents and residents love it, but if you want the truth, make participation in the program optional and see how many residents decide not to partake in it.
I love their burgers and fries. But I wouldn't buy a breakfast from them. Lunch, a snack and or diner anytime.

Nice hotel, with a great location.... it was nice that they upgraded us to a suite.... and included complimentary breakfast (as we are hilton members).... The breakfast was the best.  cooked to order eggs, and plenty of other things to choose from.

Location is also nice.

The only issue we had was that due to the flower show.. the hotel could not honor in and out parking privelages.  that added an additional $50 in transportation costs as we left the car in the lot.... although... it was nice not to drive for once!

Such a cool spot for a coffee shop. The croissants are delicious but the coffee is even better. The butterscotch latte is perfect every time. It gets crowded-I just wish they had more seating! Probably my favorite coffee shop in Indy.

WOW. Fried chicken and doughnuts...amazing combination!!! 

My boyfriend and I split a whole chicken (8 small pieces) with the Za'atar seasoning. It was a Mediterranean blend of spices and we loved it. They had some other dry seasoning such as Buttermilk Ranch and also some glazes like Honey Ginger.

It was $17 and came with two small doughnuts for free. Easily the best fried chicken I've ever had. The batter is SO crunchy and flavorful and the chicken is perfectly cooked and juicy inside. I also could not believe how much meat there was on each piece! The free doughnuts were not the hot or fancy kinds, just two regular doughnuts, but don't let that fool you-- they were DELICIOUS. We will be going back sometime soon to try the fancy ones-- Smores, Pina Colada, and Oatmeal Raisin are just a few of the flavors I saw.

The place is very small, so don't always count on there being space to eat there. The food was served pretty quickly, especially considering the crowd they had.

The staff was great, very friendly and the place was clean. This is a great place to stop for a delicious guilty pleasure snack!!
Delicious authentic tacos great prices and customer service is awesome, and very clean!!! Definitely recommend!

Stopped in for a quick bite while in town for work. The sandwich was decent, nothing special but well  made and tasty as sandwiches go.

The staff, however, was pretty rude. Service was terrible with a big spoonful of crabby.

Tables were pretty sticky (at least mine was), and the bathroom was atrocious. Seriously, what place these days forgets both soap and papertowels? 

Going on food alone: 3 stars. Considering staff and cleanliness: 1 star.
We had a great lunch today! Brad waited on us and was excellent. Best experience we have had in a long time. We will definitely be back on our next visit.

DO NOT COME HERE. IT IS A SCAM. RUDE SERVICE. WOULD GIVE NEGATIVE STARS IF POSSIBLE.
 
So I wanted to book Kens for my birthday party after hearing people mention it having private rooms, karaoke, and BYOB. I was hesitant after seeing the poor ratings but thought I should still give it a try. Called two weeks in advance and was told very rudely by a staff that I could only book two days before the event. So I waited and called two days before the event at 4:50PM. Immediately I was greeted very rudely by a male staff yelling WHAT? 

When I tell him I would like to book a room for Saturday he tells me they are full. I explain how I tried booking much earlier in advance but was told to call back later. The staff proceeds to start swearing saying "WHAT THE FUCK? ARE YOU CRAZY? I SAID WE ARE FULL."

I then asked politely if I could please talk to the manager/owner and he replies "ARE YOU CRAZY? I AM THE MANAGER. WHAT THE SHIT YOU CRAZY?"

At that point I decided I would much rather have my birthday party at a restaurant that treats its customers politely. If this is the attitude of the manager then the restaurant is truly a lost cause. There's much better karaoke options like Yakitori Boy, Chinese food like Dim Sum Garden or BYOB like Nine ting.

We had LUKE as our tour guide and he was amazing!!! Informative and funny, the tour was a great way to spend our first night in NOLA, taking in some of the culture and spooky sights in the French Quarter! Would definitely recommend this tour!

I really enjoy their local inspired menu and free trade coffees. 
The atmosphere is comfortable with cozy chairs and large bright windows. It's nice to get away from the office.  :)

I was visiting my sister in Nashville for the holidays and got the two of us 90 min Thai massages, I had a fall ice skating and had been misaligned since and it was my sister's first Thai massage so I was really hoping it would be good because Thai massages can be hit or miss in NY where I'm from. Chris and Jacob did not disappoint. I feel so much better and can't wait to get back to exercising again and my sister was raving about how great the massage was the whole way home she even said she wishes she could get one everyday, I guess I nailed her perfect Christmas gift. These guys really know what they're doing and as a ticklish person this is especially important to me because nothing can screw up a massage like being tickled by unsure hands and tensing up. They also refused the $50 tip I tried to leave because "the tip is included in the price of the massage" amazing! I could go on and on...
Solid beer selection great American pub food with and open comfortable environment. Great spot for lunch or dinner or just a drink

The only time I get this pizza is when we're visiting down in Wilmington. I found it to have a great taste. The crust is a little thinnner than I like but the sauce has a good spicyness to it, and they don't go overboard with the cheese. 
My kids seem to like their sandwiches, too, but their pizza is really the reason to go.

I wanted to cry this was so good. We ordered the crab rangoon, the cod steamed bun, and the khao soi chicken curry. As we walked to our car, one of the chefs met us outside with a bonus dish--the omu ramen. The crab rangoon is beyond any other rangoon I've ever had, and I had to stop myself from drinking the curry. Everything was beautifully prepared, the staff was incredibly kind and welcoming, and as a bonus, they are committed to sustainability & use seasonal ingredients. This crew is doing it right. Cannot wait to come back!

Really liked the food. Great fish tacos. Steak burrito was very good. Decor was just ok. There was a big window where we enjoyed watching the valet guys run back and forth getting cars. We will definitely visit again.

Ummm Romarco's.....you know you are in Clifton Height, right?

Ok because I was just wondering since your menu prices are from a nicer zip code (Oh don't be insulted Clifton Heights, you know what you are)....and I wouldn't normally mind if you paid for what you got, but alas, your food is not tasty....

We went for two appetizers and then each of us ordered a traditional italian entree.  The one app, fried mozzarella was good, though it is hard to mess up fried cheese...the other app was a mushroom stuffed with spinach and red peppers topped with blue cheese....not tasty.

Both entrees were ok and edible, but not anything special.  I can't believe I am saying this, but I have had better at the Olive Garden, and I don't like the Olive Garden....I had the Chicken Marsala and my dude had the Veal Parm...I could have made them better....service was ok...and I had a big bug fall onto the table when we were waiting for our meals....gross...

Oh and I tried their italian brunch one time, and it was a sad offering of many egg dishes with just different italian ingredients...oh well....

Buying aftermarket wheels can be confusing, and sometimes frustrating. Wheel Techs website is a big help. You can pick your wheel and tire and the site will show you what the combo looks like on your car.
     Jon took a lot of time finding a wheel that would fit our car,and look good. The prices aren't the lowest in town but the service made up for it. I personally don't mind paying a little more,if I'm being treated well,and we were. I watched Jon interact with other customers, and he took the time with everyone to make them feel important. If your spending your hard earned money on wheels,tinting,or oil changes, give them a try.

I don't know what this says about me, but the fact McConnell's is all I can remember about my time in Santa Barbara definitely says something about how good their ice cream is. Apparently food matters more to me than anything else?

I got their Eureka Lemon and Marionberries, and McConnell's did not disappoint! It was perfectly tangy and the tartness of the lemon was mellowed out by the cream. It was so smooth and soft -- icy is the last word I'd use to describe the texture. I wish I had reserved more time to spend in SB :( Window shopping while eating ice cream equals happy!!

The staff are super friendly. Even on a busy summer afternoon, I was in and out of the store within 5 minutes. The next time I'm in SB, McConnell's will be my first stop!

They had the best price quote for my move from Tampa, FL to Miami, FL. Were able to give me a flat rate based on volume of possessions needed to be moved based on locations. Eli & Ariel were my movers. They did a very professional job. Would highly recommend.

Honestly, I love this place. It's my go-to place to bring visitors. Noodles are solid, great sushi (3 rolls for $14), but honestly it's the best bubble tea I've had. I'd definitely suggest adding pop bubbles.

I'm from WI and missed my Friday Fish Frys, but Miller's Ale House had great beer battered fish. It was hot and flaky! Great French fries! There were only two servers tonight on a Saturday at 5:00pm, but service was great! I hope our service people come back soon! Too many good restaurants are hurting because they lost servers during COVID . We need to realize how important they are for us being able to enjoy a great meal at a great restaurant like Miller's Ale House!

Was so happy to come across THIS medical supply store! My horse just had a laceration repair on his heel bulb. His veterinarian recommended keeping it covered for FOUR days. He initially placed a bandage... however, my horse decided to wear a hole through the bandage on the SECOND day! Ugh!! Long story short, I was looking for a store that carried iodine scrub, solution, saline irrigation AND 4"x4" gauze squares. Jennifer answered the phone when I called to see if they had it  (none of the local pharmacies carried the iodine SCRUB). I was SO happy to be able to swing by and pick the stuff up. It is WAY less expensive than the tack stores! While I was there, I picked up the 3" Sensi Wrap, which is the same thing as Vet Wrap! I would DEFINITELY recommend this store to owners of injury-prone horses. Save yourself some time AND money. Go here FIRST.

I agree with many of the other reviewers. The long line to check in and having to stand there for 20 or 30 minutes is unacceptable. Secondly the walls are paper thin. I stayed in the A tower and the person in the room next to me had their alarm going off for 30 minutes and it sounded like it was on my night table. My non-smoking room smelled like cigarette smoke. The bed was also uncomfortable. I have stayed in many chain motels like Hampton Inn and had vastly superior beds. Last, the resort fee is a joke. why am I paying 35 extra dollars a day when almost everything is closed? There's no in room dining and most of the amenities are closed because of Covid. Why am I paying extra for a pool which is free at any other hotel in America? The plus side is that the room was clean and well decorated and the front desk dealt with the alarm issue right away

Best cheesesteak I've had in a while. Right amount of cheese, perfectly seasoned steak. The roll had the perfect balance of crusty exterior and soft chewy interior.  French fries were crispy and salty. Will definitely order again.

I have never seen anything so funny , but sad.
I saw Peter take the first bite of his burger and it literally disintegrated.
I should not have laughed, the exact same thing happened to me.
I ended up with a plate full of crumbled up bun.
The burger was not good at all, very bland.
The size of the meat is very small.
The restaurant was clean and tidy, the service was OK.
I can say without a doubt, I will not be back.
I just received a pedicure from a younger male who did an excellent job! He took his time with each step (buffing, filing, massage, warm towel).  Wonderful experience!
Recently rebranded but still maintaining a high quality of poke bowls. They now offer a selection of hot Hawaiian dishes. The staff is always friendly and speedy.
Ruf ruf hooked us up. We had a private room and our own waiter. (Keith) It was an exceptional night. Great food, incredible service and outstanding desert. Thank you again. We will be back

I ordered for pick-up and texted from the pick-up spot in their lot that I was outside. No response, so I waited. After 10 minutes, I went in to be sure they had gotten the text. The extremely passive hostess told me she got it and that my order would be right out. After waiting another 45 minutes in the car with nothing, I went back inside where the hostess told me that they had just started my order but I could cancel it if I wanted to. She could not have cared any less. No apology, no effort to make it right for me. It was awkward how passive and dismissive she was. She just said that to me and walked away. It definitely would have been faster for me to sit down inside, order my 2 burgers and leave. They were hardly busy, but I saw people come and go while I waited. I have already heard from a few friends that they have had similar experiences there. They just lost a very loyal, 40+ year customer. So disappointing.

If you're looking for an honest reliable auto repart shop this is the place. After getting a recommendation from a dealership that I needed an expensive repair I got a second opinion from Douglas that was much more reasonable. The shop may not be as new as the dealership but the service is much better. This is the only place I take my cars for repair.
I have come here twice during the afternoon buffet special.  You cant beat the price for the quality of food you get.  The wait staff is very friendly and accomodating

Now they are advertising that they are going out of business so I thought I would go back but their merchandise is as overpriced as ever. Stupid me for thinking that a going out of business sale meant lower prices. Not surprising to see they are closing.

Three words:

Mighty
Meaty
Pizza

Are you kidding? I might have been a bit famished after my flight from LA, so that might sway my review a bit.  But seriously, one of the best pizzas I've had.  Loved all the toppings, but the crust was my favorite part - kind of like a garlic bread in itself.

Really mediocre food, even at that price point. Low quality beef, cold steamed broccoli. There are better options right next door for the same price. Also the service is practically non-existent. We were the only customers and my friend ordered spring rolls to eat before the food was ready. The employee put the rolls on the counter, where we couldn't see them, and didn't say anything to us. We finally found out the rolls has been sitting there the whole time when my first asked where they were. And I, like a schmuck, had pre-tipped when I ordered my food. It's one thing if you're busy but when there is absolutely no other work that you're doing?

Just had my brows microbladed with Brent- and the results are beyond amazing. This is the best present I have ever received. Brent walked me talked me through the whole process, took his time to map our my perfect brows, and did the most precise and realistic work I have ever seen- and they are all mine now! He was very personable and relaxing. The atmosphere of the salon is perfection as well. Very welcoming and super clean. The room was set up with great lighting (as well as a table of gum in Brent's room which I really appreciated! Pro tip- pop a piece in before you start the process) 

I drove from the Sarasota area and waited six months to get in (because I have a crazy schedule) but it was so worth the wait. I can't wait to come back and just hang out for my next session. Thank you so much!

I stayed here for my medical licensing exam for two nights.  The room is very nice - spacious, equipped with a kitchen, TV, living room, and huge desk.  The bed was very comfortable as well.  I got a really good deal for it - only $118 a night due to using the code for my exam.  Parking is also free too.  There is also free breakfast, gym access, and an available office workspace.  Sounds like a great hotel right?

Here is where this all went awry with me - ROACHES.  Okay, I don't know if these little critters are called roaches or whatnot, but there were these little disgusting critters all over the room.  I saw at least 7 of them during my stay.  The night before my exam, I just put up with it because I really couldn't deal with moving rooms and whatnot and it had already been late at night when I had settled into my room.

When I woke up after my second night, I just couldn't take it anymore - all the roaches were overwhelming.  I ended up checking out of my room at 5 AM.  I told the guy at the front desk and he was very unapologetic.  Not only was he unapologetic, but he looked so uninterested in what I had to say.  As a result, I showed him pictures of the roaches that were in my room.  He pretty much just shrugged it off and mumbled "so you want a new room?"  I told him, "No, I just want to leave."  This is horrible customer service.  When your hotel has roaches in it, the least you can do to your customer is to be apologetic.  I will never come back to this hotel again.

HOLY COW. The best pizza in the world! The owner is the nicest guy! If you live in South Jersey or somewhat near by- it's ALWAYS worth the drive. Order early also! The upside down pizza is the BEST. I don't love crust but I eat every single last piece of this pizza every time. I'm salivating just thinking about it.

I try to come here often because I always liked Denny's. There was a man here and on the receipt it says his name is James F. This guy made me sweet tea and he's always pretty cool. The guy in the back never ruins the eggs ever! Staff is pretty humble. Denny's is good. James is good. It's all good :-D
We have been ordering from Tonelli's every week! The kids love their pizza & wings, while mussels in garlic white wine sauce are my personal favorite. The salads are generously portioned & fresh!

Qdoba new chicken diablo nachos turns up the heat on flavor - business wire

"Not for the faint of heart, our Chicken Diablo Nachos are guaranteed to bring the heat" - FAKE NEWS!!!

I walked past this slock of a food chain and tried there newest item which the price wasn't even listed on there menu. The nachos did not have enough chicken in the chicken nachos not a good start Qdoba not a good start at all.

What does it take for a food chain to serve quality nachos its like finding the god dam holy grail.

Never again (On a plus the staff was very nice but I will not be back for the nachos thats for dam sure).

Unfriendly staff. Slow service. Not worth the one I gave them. Food was gross shrimp was dry and most likely sat in the warmer way too long. Tenders were small almost like they were the leftovers or broken ones. Mash potatoes were water down and tasteless.

I came by the drive thru one day and was the only person there. No people in the parking lot. I waited so long to receive my drinks. So long multiple people finally pulled up behind me. I even opened my door to look through the window to see what the hold up was. The people were laughing and talking and doing what looked to be nothing. When I finally got my drink they were so insanely rude and the drinks weren't even very good. I won't be coming back any time soon.

Went into this salon excited, with it being new and all, and was abruptly met by the "hostess" and told there was no availability and I could make an appointment later in the evening. I was a little confused. I asked the lady, "do you not take walk ins?" She said they do, however, there was not one soul sitting in there waiting and I could not see (from the front counter) one single customer or nail tech. I could hear one voice coming from the back but that was it. I asked again, "are you not like a normal nail salon who works people in in between your appointments?" Response: "Oh, we are!" I was left even more confused. Needless to say, I declined the appointment and ran down the street to Ruby Nails, which was FULL, however I was seated within 5 minutes for a pedicure. All that being said, my only assumption is they need more nail techs. Whatever it is, I hope they get it together. East Nashville needs another nail salon. Make your appointments people!!! *wink*
Really friendly service, fast and the food was great!  The chicken enchiladas are delicious!  Plenty of food here- you won't leave hungry!

I am middle eastern and I can honestly say this is the best middle eastern restaurant in Tucson by far.  The quality of the ingredients and the meals are delicious.  I absolutely love eating here.  I do however feel they are a tad overpriced.

The new Fresh Kitchen is in the perfect Westshore location making easy for many professional to pop in for a healthy lunch. Dining options are available inside, outside or to go. This place is hopping but the line moves quickly. The menu is full of fresh health options. I always have to order the 6 Bowl because I can never limit myself on the great options they provide. My favorite is the almond crusted chicken! There are a few parking spots in the front of the building and a lot in the back. During the lunch time rush you'll even see people parking down the side of the road.

This is easily the best bar in N Indy to watch sports, meet some friends, or just enjoy a great meal. Top notch service, wonderful beers, and the most interesting and friendly bartenders in the city. 

Do yourself a favor and stop in!

I definitely would not recommend Favazza's.  I think we came in with some high expectations as this place came highly recommended by a couple of locals.  I feel like we were in the middle of an Italian-rich neighborhood and I'm sure there must've been some better options around.

The reason I give them an extra star was the ambiance was excellent.  The outdoor seating area (called the patio) was really cool.  Nice touch with the exposed string of lights and all.  It was also a beautiful day outside, which made the whole experience better.  The service was fine - nothing great, but also nothing wrong.

The thing I have to just say is, if you can't make a decent tomato-based pasta sauce, then you probably shouldn't be in the Italian restaurant business.  By the way, it wasn't just me that was disappointed.  My friend had the lasagna and he was just as displeased.  We were hungry so we ate it, but I just wouldn't go here again.  The pasta itself was kind of tough, which is actually understandable because I ordered the whole wheat penne.
