The veggies on there were not even properly grilled - they literally undercooked and added absolutely no flavor.  Even then it all comes down to the sauce.  I asked for a spicy marinara and it was just so blah...  absolutely flavorless.  I like to end on a somewhat positive note; the garlic bread they bring out in the beginning was pretty good.  Very buttery, but I guess that's what makes it taste good.

I was a HUGE fan of Dave & Tony's until a couple of weeks ago. I ordered a pick up over the phone and as I pulled up I noticed there were 2 people behind the counter and no customers. I was thinking they would just bring my food out to the car -  not a crazy assumption over the past year. They kept staring at me through the window so I called to ask if they could bring it out and the gentleman  answered the phone and said we are closed and hung up. Needless to say, I was not happy. I went inside and asked what the issue was, that I had placed an order.  The gentleman became very irritated and  said I had not paid for the order yet therefore they  didn't bring it outside. Again, not a crazy assumption that they would meet me at curbside and take payment for the food.  I told him I have been a long time customer and love their food and he really didn't care to hear that and said don't come back anymore.  After a little back and forth he offered to pay for my food, but I declined his offer. I wasn't giving him the satisfaction that everything would be ok f he covered the cost. 
I will not be going back to Dave & Tony's and I have already told a handful of people about the incident and they have stopped going as well. The lady behind the counter called the gentleman by his name - Tony. 
I sure hope it's another Tony and not the owner.  Hard to believe in this environment local business owners are telling their customers not to come back.

Out of towners and stopped here looking for a quick breakfast bite. These bagels are so yummy and fluffy with the perfect toast on the outside! We grabbed the egg sandwich and if we stay in the area again, def looking forward to getting a bagel and schmear.

Nice nail salon and staff however VERY over priced. 

Didn't tell me it was $10 to take off my Dip mani until I checked out (which is usually free of charge at 99% of nail salons). 

$35 for the basic pedi, other nail salons basic pedi's are typically around $28. 

$90 for a dip mani and pedi 

For the amount of nail salons in the area I would definitely find another one because this is not worth it.

Came in here while waiting for a seat for breakfast.  Met JD and staff and everyone is extremely friendly! Couple of T-shirts caught my eye and decided to buy them! If you're looking a well maintained and well informed shop for all of your nerdy needs, please stop by this shop!  Located right next to Greg's Kitchen street parking is available!  Say hello to the shop's dog, Parker! cutest puppy ever!

If you're hungry and want the basics to fill you up, then the all-you-can-eat sushi before 4pm is a good way to go. Hubby and I showed up at 1:30p on a Thursday, and didn't have to wait at all. The hostess and servers were lovely.

I'd say they got the better end of the deal with me. I started with the miso soup, which I'm going to call the most delicious part of the meal. Then ordered unagi (nigiri style-2 pieces), a spicy scallop hand roll, and a Tower long roll - which is spicy tuna, tempura style. The unagi wasn't quite lukewarm - it should be warmed through. The flavor was fine, but the unagi looked a bit crinkled up - definitely like nothing I've seen before. The scallops in the hand roll were ice cold. Is that correct? I feel like they should have been more towards room temperature. Not a lot of flavor. The roll was perfectly fine - and perfectly filling. In fact, that was it for me. Didn't even have the ice cream that comes with the meal.  I probably could have not done the $19.99 all-you-can-eat, but that's okay. Hubby, on the other hand, definitely got his money's worth. Hamachi, Maguro, rolls....can't quite keep track with him. His thoughts were the same as mine. It's fine...and if you're hungry for lunch and want lots and lots of sushi, you'll probably be happy.

The atmosphere, once you find it, is nice enough. The sky bridge is very light and bright during the day, and thankfully people can't smoke at the slots up there. Had to laugh at one guy who had a 1/4-smoked ciggy hanging out of his mouth, unlit, as though he had just come up from the regular floor, saw the machine he needed, and quickly realized he had to snuff it out LOL. Walking through the ground floor wasn't terribly smoky, but enough so that I was happy to get outta there. Probably not a destination for us again, but won't pooh-pooh it for everyone.

Love El Taco Grande 
So fresh and well seasoned.
Love burritos while getting hair done at Sams 
Have them divide into two
I can never finish one they are so huge.
Today trying Robert's Especial Burrito
Chicken, grilled vegetables, sour cream , guacamole and whole beans 
Only 9.99$
Wow 
Love their Chile  relleno burrito

First, I began to receive hostess gifts from Rosetree.  I loved my glass bowl and Christmas ornament, so I went to their studio on Algiers Point. The people at the shop are friendly and helpful. But, if you go beyond the shop, you see an artist @ his craft. There is no better place to pick up a memento of New Orleans, than at Rosetree. Whatever you choose; bowls, wine glasses, lampshades, ornaments or vases, it will last longer than a tee shirt or a hurricane!
Jambalaya was too dry seems that these guys do not know how to prepare it. Lamb ribs are good.

The happy hour here was mediocre. Alcohol was $4 for beer $5 for wine and $6 for the cocktail. Of the happy hour food only 3 were recommended by the waiter. I got the Nashville hot buns ($4) which were amazing!! I recommend coming here for dinner, but for happy hour I've seen better spots in the same area.

Celebrated our daughters 7th b-day yesterday and lets just say I WILL BE BACK!!!! We had Arielle! She was absolutely WONDERFUL!! We had picky kids and even pickier adults! She handled all of the dumb requests like a pro even when she saw me start to get frustrated she was able to deflect my attitude better then my husband! "A" for her!!! Can't give that girl enough praise!! Ask for Arielle if possible!! The party was cheaper too. She explained that for some reason they changed up the way the food is done but when you book on line it doesnt come up that way. Could the guy that called me explain that NO! But Arielle made up for him lack of communication! The ham and cheese sandwhiches were good and the pastarmi was just nasty at least I think thats what it was! Kids had an awesome time! We were there for like 4 hours! So its well worth the drive! Oh and ARIELLE WAS FREAKIN AWESOME!!!

I haven't been here in years. We used to come all the time. It wasn't very good this time. The pizza my daughter ordered was burnt and my eggplant Parmesan was burnt and cold. I don't think we will be back. The waitress was very nice

This place doesn't have a bad dish. The pastrami here is amazing. My wife gets the yam pastrami (vegan) and the flavor is incredible. The kids get a Nutella banana and marshmallow sandwich that disappeared so fast I wasn't sure what happened. Definitely top 5 lunch spot.
Called 4 diffent numbers and didn't get a single answer. Never had this happen anywhere else. It's a shame because there only 10 blocks away from me.

Great service and prices from a family owned and operated business. They have a limited number of loaner cars that you can use but if you choose to wait, you won't wait long. I have taken my car here twice and have always been treated with respect and great service.Highly recommended!

We went here after a few (read:many) drinks, and grabbed a spot in the line to get us a po'boy. I cannot remember the name of the woman tending the register that night, but we could tell she had a long night and we felt for her (both of us having worked in the service industry before). We did our best to put on a smile on her face, and tipped her well. Y'all drunk folk need to be nicer to the service industry folks tending to you...especially on Bourbon Street! 
Onto the food:  I got the spicy crawfish po'boy. LOVED IT. So worth the wait 
We've been to NOLA more times than I can count on my fingers and toes and this was a happen-to-walk-by find and we really enjoyed it. We will definitely be back.
Elana who works at the minute clinic is great. Very helpful looking up records, providing information and gave two shots, flu and TDAP that did not hurt at all.
Huge selection but ciders could be much better. Fun game night Wednesdays! Service is great with the women there, the men "meh" service.
Surprisingly tasty! The sausage and onion plate is extremely delicious. It's a bit divey and my cup was very sticky, but staff is nice and the food was more authentic than I was expecting.
Yummy Thai food! Plenty of options to choose from and inside of an asian market is funny to me. I like it.

This place has potential. When you walk in, it kind of reminds me of a beach bar. Unfortunately it's on the main road and there isn't much of a beach vibe once you look outside the window. The place also seems a little empty. It appears that it's too big of a space for the current setup (but I know nothing about interior design). There was also a weird smell, almost like too much industrial cleaner. The staff was friendly and we were seated quickly, yet service was kind of slow (I think one of the waitresses was training). Food was good. I can't remember the name, but the taco with pork and mac and cheese was delicious (probably super healthy too). Prices were kind of high for what you get since everything is a la carte. Like I said some potential here. But unfortunately I think this location isn't going to lead to huge success unless they establish some sort of crowd of "regulars".

Worst service ever! The employees or servers where mostly sitting on tables outside joking around. When I pressed the red button the lady said hold on one minute . Fifteen minutes later and to more request later We still had not had our order taken as it seem they were only waiting on the People  at the drive up window.  I was not the only one thi was happening to .  The sad part is there where only five vehicles in the driveup Park and order area.  I left there and went to Burger King and got my order in less then five minutes .  Won't be going back there again.
Really great first experience with Korean food. Everything was tasty and staff were friendly. Very cozy inside!

The front of the cafe is really nice and so is the inside.. for my first time here i would have to give it 2 stars because of several reasons.. We were told the wait was 30 mins so we waited. we were buzzed to get seated about 15 mins later and hostess told us it was a mistake to then wait another 30 mins. 

Once we were finally at our table, the silverware was filthy and not polished. we had to request new ones. drink order was prompt and delivered however, the waitress Devin took a while to get back to us for our food order. Hence, waiting some more. 

Appetizers were tasty and entrees were good. The food kinda made up for the other inconveniences. We paid and we headed to the restroom before we left. The women's room was really dirty. paper towels everywhere and on the floor. inside the stalls were dirty as well. 

Needless to say, good food but totally preventable inconveniences.

My new favorite place! The menu is simple but sophisticated, definitely no chain restaurant kind of food here. Portions were generous, ingredients were FRESH, with  sauces made from scratch. Everything was perfectly cooked. Even the simple sweet potato fries somehow tasted better. Ambiance is comfortable and has a homy feel to it. Our server was pleasant and accommodating. It was an overall very, very  nice experience. We will be going back for sure to try out the rest of the menu

My first time at this place on a Tuesday night because I heard about $1 tacos as a promotion.  It is located in a strip mall next to Daylight Donuts.  The atmosphere was average.  I was disappointed due to not having hot sauce available on the table.  The chips and salsa was great.  The salsa had a sweet taste to it and was very tasty.  The restaurant appears to be ran by family where kids cleaned tables while mom waited on table. The tacos were very authentic tasting.  It had fresh lime for tasting and was seasoned with the basic salt and pepper.  The beef fajita was not served on a hot skillet but rather on a plate with the fixings. Overall the restaurant was plain and simple with a mom/pop feel. The pricing was very reasonable.

Completely unprofessional and very rude. First they didn't come on the day they were supposed so it rained on my stuff. Then when they came out the next day after everything was wet they said they couldn't pick up any of my stuff because it was wet or dissemble any of the furniture I had. Then instead of putting everything back they just left my stuff out on the street to get ruined. Terrible service, awful communication. Worse moving and storage company ever!
Glenn is fair, prompt, truthful and best of all he does great work at a reasonable price. We will use him again without hesitation! Thanks for the help Glenn.

I quite like Jacksons, last night makes my 4th time there.
2 rooms and an outdoor dance area with bars in each space; Latin in one room, hip hop in the other and EDM outdoors. Each space had a Vip area and outdoors has the hookah tables as well. 
Clean bathrooms, good drinks and Jacksons is always a fun time!

So here we are in Santa Barbara, driving our pretty, nearly new car, when we noticed - horrors! A nail in our front tire! We are a couple hundred miles from home and it's the evening before we are to leave - and a Sunday! What to do?  I turned to yelp and sent a late night Sunday message to Big Brand Tire - just down the street from our fave fish taco spot.  I mentioned in my message that we were checking out at noon.  Monday morning rolls around and the first call I get is from Big Brand Tire! Yes, they are super busy but will squeeze us in at 10:00am and it is FREE!! Yep, free! And no we didn't buy tires from this place, but if we lived here we wouldn't go any place else! Thanks for taking such good care of us!
I enjoyed lunch here today with a few girlfriends and thoroughly enjoyed it.  The whipped feta cheese appetizer is worth the price of admission!

I don't know why I decided to give this place another shot after my horrible buying experience but I did. Partly because their oil change prices were cheaper than the place I had been going to. The first two times I had my car serviced there the prices was approximately $65, then on my most recent/very last visit it doubled to $120 without warning and after being told it would be closer to $80 by the representative. I will NEVER do business with this place again, and I suggest anyone reading this to avoid.

This is a good location for a walmart and they are rarely out of things.  However, I have never been to a store that is so understaffed for cashiers.  This can occur at 9am 3pm or 1:00 in the morning.  Almost every time I am there I spend far more time standing in line than shopping.  Although this walmart is 5 minutes from my house I often choose to go to Target or another walmart just so I don't have to wait in the lines.
My dad and I go here religiously. The pho here is the best I've had in Reno so far. The portions are good and service is always great.
Look, short and sweet, GO!!!!!! and prepare to have your mind and taste buds blown!

Looked for a daycare that would take care of both our boys and we decided on Mothergoose. Great school in the beginning, but went down hill quickly.

For my oldest it's what he needed to be ready for kindergarten.The teachers in the 3 yr old and 4 yr old classrooms were awesome. They gave him the structure he needed and he is doing very well at his new school.

As for my youngest, things were fine in the beginning when he started there as a baby. We really didn't have any complaints until we found that he needed some extra help and he was given a state I.E.P. Then it began to seem like the owner didn't want to have anything to do with him anymore. First, in the 2 yr old classroom the teachers were very nice, but it was more of a free for all with very little structure. Potty training was a joke as there isn't even a bathroom in the classroom. The last problem before we pulled him had to do with my son finding a very bad safety issue on the playground. When the incident happened the only things the owner had to say was that it never happened before and that she was worried that my son was a safety issue. Not once did she apologies for what happened or that his teacher wasn't watching him when they were outside. Instead all she kept saying was that she wanted him out. Even after we pulled him from Mothergoose the safety issue wasn't addressed. How can you trust someone that they will take care of your children when they knowingly have a safety issue and will not take care of the problem? There is a section that covers this under both state and federal daycare law.

I do not recommend this daycare. The owner seems to only care about the money she's making and not actually about the children in the building. The Mothergoose website says she's a hands on owner. Do not believe the lie. In the 3 years that we were at Mothergoose I only saw her interacting with the students once. I do know that since we pulled our boys out that other families have left for some of the same concerns. This can not be a coincidence. Remember, this is our review of Mothergoose and our experience. I just ask that if you consider Mothergoose for your child/children that you step lightly and pay close attention to everything. We wish we would have from the beginning.

I thought that I would not ever give a 5-star review when I started my Yelp review. I've always found something wrong with my experience at every restaurant I'd been to. That was until I went to Ted's at West End. I honest to God do not have a single thing to complain about. I'm sitting here at my table eating a perfect steak with fries after waiting only about 10 minutes total walking in the door. My waitress is kind, the atmosphere is friendly. My friends and I haven't said a word to each other since we've started eating since we're so focused on our food. 
The bathrooms are clean, paper straws which is always a plus, the location is right next to my school's gym; it seems like this place was made for me.
Highly, highly recommend.

What a great, terrific experience from Tami the cashier/investor helping us first timers to CJ the chef who personally brings you your order. The food was perfect , sublime, my fiancée and I got the Big Kahuna Plate which was so awesome tasting, very fresh vegetables and the house salad was even enticing by just the appearance. Even to the restrooms was an experience I enjoyed, clean, sanitary, and smelled like skittles. Very highly recommended to eat at, the only thing was a wait for our food but it was freshly prepared and hot, well worth the wait for the food. Definitely try it out and let your friends and family know. Overall my fiancée and I were thoroughly impressed and will come back.

This is a solid place for brunch or lunch if you don't have to wait. Their crepes are pretty tasty as well as all their breakfast plates. I went with a group of friends and everybody was happy with what they had although some wish they had other people's plates. I'd recommend picking something that you already enjoy instead of just randomly picking something on their menu. If you already like pork for example, then get something that has sausage or bacon. You get the idea. The service is a little odd I must admit but the crepes and breakfast plates are bomb.com.

Beautiful setting and friendly staff that offered to charge my son's phone while we ate. Our party of 3 ordered Garlic Parmesan Oysters which were a hit. We also tried their shrimp poboy, a burger and the grilled white fish. Everything was great except the grilled fish was a tad overdone. I would def return for cocktails and oysters when I'm in the NOLA area again.

I have been referred to Dr. Bienstock on two different occasions and he is the best oral surgeon in Santa BB!  He is very thorough in his description of his procedure, as well as extremely soft handed and not painful at all.  I highly recommend Dr. Marc for any of your needs!

Jane Perrin

At first appearance, this is a nice hotel. Nicely landscaped, in a good area, close to everything. Rooms just slightly nicer than say a Hampton Inn. Pretty good summer rate with breakfast included. The breakfast was just okay, I've had better at the Hampton Inn so nothing special.  It's June, 109 degrees, AC cannot keep up. It never goes below 84 degrees in this room. Called to complain, maintenance came and pretty much said, very nicely I might add, it's hot. Hmmm. Husband is sweating today so requested a fan from front desk which they promptly brought. The guy says, "it works great, it's been in use by the front desk all day." I think this hotel has an AC problem. I'm from Florida, I'm used to hot, but a hotels' AC should be able to keep you cool. 
Now, if you have a disability, do not stay here. It really cannot be accommodated. The walkways are very sloped. Lots of stairs. I use a shower chair. There is no separate shower nozzle and the water comes out full blast, no way to turn it down.  Worst hotel I've stayed at for disability access. I would not stay here again.

Round One is so much fun! I have spent so much money at this place but it was all worth it! The down fall is getting an alcohol beverage, it's a bad system with standing in one line "Forever" and you can only get 1 drink at a time, then you got to get back in that LONG line for another drink, they need to find a new way to do this and it would make them more profit to get drinks out faster and let us double fist with drinks lol

I got take out from here twice. the first time just to check it out. I wanted to try one of their "smoothies". wow... by far the worst I have ever had. It was supposed to be strawberry but it tasted like watered down soda or something. The burrito was definitely bland, and the taco salad is tiny for the price they charge. 

I would recommend skipping this place and go to Los Jalapenos on South 4th instead.

Perfect hotel - from start to finish. Upon arriving, our children were surprised with a selection of toys to choose from, as well as  customized dessert plates (including mini-chocolate arches).  The rooms have gorgeous views of The Arch. Clean, luxurious accommodations, and superb staff. They were so incredibly friendly despite having to valet our minivan a gazillions times each day. We booked two adjoining rooms (rather than a suite) so that Mom and Dad had their own room and the kiddos could conk out in theirs - that was the move! The room service was lightning quick, and food was delicious. They accommodated my mid-afternoon craving for a Zwickel like it was no big deal. There's a heated outdoor pool that overlooks downtown and The Arch, as well. I cannot recommend this hotel enough, especially when staying with kids!

I have never done any kind of waxing beyond my eyebrows, but read the deal for two "sugaring" sessions for $49 and figured I'd try it. First time was honestly painful and I said I'd never go back. But because I had the second session free and loved the results after the first session I went back anyway. Second session was 100x better and way less painful. I'm in love with the results and will never turn back to shaving. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Also I loved Amanda. She turned what's always an awkward situation into like you're just casually chatting with a friend.
The cheese biscuits keep me coming back. I usually order pasta, which is nothing spectacular, but so so.

I checked this place out during my search for a new bed. I have been many places during my search, and I have to say that the staff here are much nicer than most. A guy named Taylor helped me, and he was so nice and helpful! Though I didn't buy anything (I'm still looking and weighing my options) this place is definitely on my list of places to keep in mind when I actually do make a decision to purchase! Keep up the good work, and I'll make sure to recommend it to my friends!

You have a problem with your staff at the Terminal C restaurant location. 

I can't eat meat so I ordered the Shrimp Pad Thai. Though the menu made no mention of onions I specifically asked for "no onion, shallots, chives, etc." as I am allergic. "Of course" was the happy response. The cashier placed my freshly cooked order into a plastic bag, tied a knot and sent me on my way. 

I decided to take a peak while boarding and even stole a few bites when I realized there were large chunks of onions throughout the dish! Since I had just paid $17+ for a dinner I couldn't eat I decided to jump off line and make things right. The cashier was nice enough but passed me off to the cook who criticized me for choosing the meal saying the "menu says onions."  First of all, it doesn't. Second, it wouldn't matter if it did, I asked for no onions and the cook shouldn't be arguing with the customer so bluntly, or at all if I was the manager. 

The cook dumped my new meal into a bag, tied a knot and sent me packing again. As my plane was boarding I rushed on with my meal and sat at my seat to eat. Failed again. This new meal was chicken, not shrimp and it had none of the peanuts, cilantro or lime I got the first time. I also wasn't given a fork. 

To review, despite my best efforts I paid $17+ for one dinner that conflicted with my allergies and had to take medicine to counteract its affects. Then it was swapped out for something I didn't order and could not eat. If I wasn't on a plane I would have returned the second dinner and asked for my money back. I can't describe how frustrating it was to fly 3 hours with this under my skin. 

I'm disgusted at the lack of attention, disrespect from the cook and the exorbitant cost I forked over to basically miss a meal and go without food until my plane landed around 10:45pm.

The happy hour here is really great! Buy one drink and get the second for 25 cents. My bartender Jeremy took really great care of me and told me about reggae nights on Wednesdays. I came back Wednesday night and the band was really fun.

Great seafood!  It was highly recommended by local for the food and the atmosphere.
She was correct.  Huge portions, grate service and amazing food
I will definitely come back again
Beautiful arrangement! Will definitely be purchasing my centerpieces for every major holiday from Denise!

This is one of those mixed reviews. First let me start with what I love. And I mostly love the place.

Pros- The plant selection is amazing. Like no where else on the planet, and all able to grow here (unlike so many other places where the plants are shipped in from California the night before and die the moment you get them in the ground). My experience is good in that most plants bought there live and thrive in our blast furnace climate. When you find someone to help you they truly know their stuff. I had a citrus question and the guy was full of answers, knew his stuff and was so helpful. My fig and peach trees  (that they recommended) are putting out so many figs and peaches that I give them away. The check out clerks and guys that carried everything to the car were also amazing- very nice and a joy to deal with.

Cons- it is not the cheapest place in town. You do get what you pay for, though. And on occasion you will find an employee with attitude. Just was there and asked about having a small tree put in a pot and was told "the guy that does that is out to lunch and I don't know when he will be back," and then she looked away and went back to work. Hmmm. Would have been nice to be a little more helpful. So for the occasional employee you might find attitude. Then again maybe they, like everyone else, is just having an occasional bad day.

Summary - So if you if you can look beyond the occasional employee attitude or as I do, go find another employee, then the selection and quality and information they give you is worth every cent. And boy those peaches and figs were delicious.

Dump Truck Fries - they are life changing. Waffle fries. Creamy cheese sauce. Pulled Pork. 

Great beer selection. Great Staff.

The owners know what they are doing !   The selection of spices, blends, flavored sugars and teas covers the floor profiles of the world,   You deserve to treat yourself to go in and see what you have been missing flavor wise !   
Definitely a spot that I will be visiting often.

The casino is nice, but the management staff that "assisted" us had a major attitude! We had a problem with a slot machine not registering a $10 ticket that was inserted, and witnessed by two other players (not family). We had to wait 45 minutes for someone to help and finally after checking he said they couldn't find the ticket and we were told in an unprofessional manner, "we couldn't find the ticket, there's nothing we can do, I don't know what to tell you," then the manager just walked away. For me, it's not about the $10, it's easy to blow that in Reno, but the attitude and the way it was handled by this staff member, left a bad taste with my entire family that was playing and having the dinner buffet there.

My childhood memories of Woody's Bodacious Barbecue remain unblemished by subsequent visits as an adult.  The city's best BBQ hands down (the 25 straight years being voted as such doesn't hurt their rep) is matched by a delightfully fun interior.  The distinct aroma emanating from the wood chip-covered floor matches the zany (yet not tacky) abundance of decorations throughout the restaurant. 

You get to wash your hands in a giant public washtub.  I want a giant public washtub.

The chicken is great.  The pork and beef ribs are great.  The tri-tip is great.  I don't ever get hungry writing reviews (would just end up eating the keyboard anyway) but thinking about this place has me salivating.

In fairness, Santa Barbara isn't a BBQ mecca so competition isn't extensive.  But you tell me you're going to a restaurant chain over this and I'll slap you.    

Woohoo indeed.

Offended when I called for service and the female who answered sounded like I'd interrupted her. She took my info (rather like she had to) and said the technician would call me back the next day. Needing same day service I called them back the following day, presumably the owner answered and put the technician on who had helped me a couple years ago. The technician was new then and very good. He listened to my story and said the person who answered the phone would schedule his appointment. I said okay. He handed the phone back to the man who answered the phone in the first place and he hung up the line! Too bad! There are a lot of other good plumbers in SB!
AND then I immediately erased Stewart's plumbing from my contact's list.

food is just ok, good selection of beer on tap.  The service during the motorcycle event on 4/27/19 was horribad.  Was second in line wanting to get a cold drink while the guy behind the counter chatted up two middle aged women for about 10 minutes.  One guy.  Motorcycle event.  10 minutes to get a beer.

Family lives nearby and has reported just getting up an leaving in the past rather than deal with perpetual slow service, even with multiple employees standing around in the back.  Management doesn't care, they must be doing well without putting out decent customer service.

The modern building exterior and the impressive website made me curious about this place which is why we tried it a few weeks ago.  We had made reservations as we went on a Friday evening, but turns out we didn't really need to as it wasn't as busy as expected.  The waitresses were like ones you'd see at Moxies.  Although the interior was modern, it had a feel a bit more casual than expected.  There were also kids there too.  Food was alright, nothing ground-breaking, but still good.  I'm not sure if we'd go back though because from where we live, Moxies or Earls would be comparable and closer to us.

Our server Bethany was very non attentive. Didn't even greet us until after sitting for 10 minutes. Took our drink orders and food, waited 15 minutes and our drinks still weren't out. Someone else brought our food and we told her we hadn't gotten our drinks yet and she was very nice and apologized and got our drinks and sent a manager over. A male manager came over and was very emotionless, apologized and didn't even give us free drinks. Then, Bethany came over and checked on us, and we asked for a box, she brought it out with no check, so we had to wave a manager over to ask for our check. And this whole time it wasn't even busy.

I have finally found the salon that can take care of all my needs and make me comfortable. Marlene is my go to girl but all the techs are awesome. It is always busy in there with at least 10 technicians. They are perfectionists at what they do.

Have been here a few times over the years and they never fail to have a delicious brunch. I went with a friend of mine just to catch up and sat at the bar. Service was fantastic even though it was packed. Food was delicious and I will continue to be back every now and then when the mood strikes. Note: they are cash only!!

I'm that kind of mild hungover that annoys you all day, I can't wash something blue off of the tops of my feet, and I have "Since U Been Gone" stuck in my head.

But I don't care.

I shook it for hours at something called Finger Banger, Basher, Banging? Something dirty. I drank Lionshead. I met tons of people. 

SO FUN.

I also saw a man dressed in a black latex romper that I really wanted to touch (the romper, not really the guy), but I thought it may have been inappropriate. This was early in the evening.
The ladies did an excellent job on my kitchen and bathrooms. Will be booking again in the near future.

This past Wednesday, I had my first experience with Israeli food at Judah. I was a little nervous going in but an Israeli client of mine was taking my wife and I out to celebrate our recent wedding, and he insisted that this place was authentic and delicious. I can't vouch for the authenticity, but I can definitely confirm the deliciousness!

We started off with pitas a slew of different salads. The potato salad, carrot salad, israeli salad, and roasted eggplant salad were all great. I'm ususally not a big fan of potato salad OR carrots, but the way they are prepared here changed my mind at first bite. The pitas were perfect. Warm and flavorful, they were the ideal vessel to scoop up bites of the different salads.

From there we moved on to a roasted eggplant appetizer, house made hummus and a falafel platter. The eggplant was unlike anything I have tasted. Very savory and smothered in a creamy and tasty sauce. The hummus was easily the best i've had, although i've only had Sabra and other store bought brands. The falafel..i'm struggling to put into words how great these were. Let's just say I wish I had about 75 of them in front of me now.

For our main entree the wife had salmon and I went with the chicken shawarma. The wife loved her salmon. She couldn't rave enough about it, and salmon is her go to fish when she's feeling so inclined. The chicken shawarma piled over rice with a bit of israeli salad mixed in, is SENSATIONAL. The chicken is seasoned to perfection and roasted, then thinly sliced into piles on your plate. I have been thinking about it periodically (every 10 minutes) for the last 3 days. I need it in my life again..and soon.

The interior is nice but won't blow you away. I'd probably elevate this place to 5 stars if they update the dining area. That being said, if you live in the Northeast Philly area, or you don't, or you just want to try Israeli food for the first time, check out Judah! They say you always remember your first, this place is no exception.
Great spot for authentic Mexican food. The tacos were delicious. Will definitely go again!

Food didn't disappoint! Quite flavorful, fresh, and creative combos. Lattes were good but wishing they were a bit larger for the price seen at other places. There's a break mid-day before food service opens back up in the evening. They will continue to serve beverages though. Genuine friendly and attentive staff! Seems like a cute place to catch up over drinks.

Segmented dining area in an L shape. Middle section has outlets so you can study or hold a small meeting (may need to rsvp for meeting). I tried to study in the dining area but the stool became uncomfortable after a couple of hours. I dunno if it was legal but i was able to park for free in the lot across the street.
Worst bus company around, I changed my ticket online and they wouldn't let me board the bus, not recommended.

Visiting from culture rich Los Angeles I went in with attitude and was schooled. This place had, perhaps; the best Indian food I've tried thus far in the states. The food is somewhat "americanized" compared to what I've actually had in my travels to India but most would find much of the food there unpalatable. 
 The tandoori was tender and moist in contrast to most places where it tends to be dry. This was an appetizing precursor to every dish we ordered which were absolutely delicious; even those my wife ordered and were not my preference. Made to order my wife preferred mild versions while I enjoyed full spice. The curry dishes were savory and addictive. 
  The service was excellent and personable. I enjoyed stories shared with the owner David, who made us feel at home. I only wish this was close to home as I'd be a regular.

The shrimp pho here is great! The shrimp were huge, the portions were big in general, and the outside seating was nice. The margarita I had was pretty bad and the service wasn't great (perhaps because they include gratuity prior to giving you your check, even for small parties) but overall I would go back for the good food! Definitely recommend sitting outside over inside if you can!

Thanks to yelp reviewers we had Pioneer Floors redo the floors.   They returned calls and emails promptly, had a professional crew that did such good work that we decided to add hardwood flooring to the kitchen.   We're pleased with the work and service throughout.    In the remodel neighbors and friends have commented first how fine the floors look.    Highly recommended.

Was there last night for a event with the convention I was a part of. A terrific location to have a dinner, catered meal was excellent, nice service, fun memorabilia to see, excellent tour of the house and to top it off, excellent life music show. Only thing to improve is the lighting for the stage set up - get some track lights so you can see the artists better. Am amazing 27,000 log home with a homey feel!

Got an Eggplant Mushroom Platter with Coconut Tomato sauce and basmati rice- it was delicious - I was sad when it was gone. The flavorful sauce was not spicy but they offered to make it spicy. Veggies were perfectly cooked. 
We tried ordering with different sauce and rice, but the man working urged us to try a different combo of ingredients instead. I'm glad he helped us order - my suggestion is they should have suggested for dish, rice, and sauce combos so customers know what goes well together.
Staff was very friendly and helpful and sanitary. Clean dining area with nice patio as well.
Himalayan Hot Tea was perfect for the chilly weather.

I love this place, about 6 weeks ago our dog was experiencing severe lethargy was unable to stand, walk barely eating, got her in on Friday night. Lauren the doctors assistant was very helpful and caring, explaining possible tests and even stayed with us while the doctor explained possible causes. Our dog had to stay overnight for IV therapy. When we picked her up Dr. Tony reviewed test results and recommended treatment. Doctors assistant called to check up and reminded us of upcoming lab appointments.   Very caring and helpful assistant. Thank you dr. Tony and also Lauren.

I saw many yelp reviews about this place and wanted to try it out while there in Indiana.

This place was great pricing listed online with mobile ordering and online web page ordering as well. During this time you could eat inside they have socially distanced tables and people and was legitiamently safe for guests.

They had many staff on hand courteous and friendly,knowledgeable on the menu and very fast paced at getting carryout out orders given and seating the people coming in to dine as well.

They were very busy inside and for dine and had a carryout out area bustling as well. People where checking and and picking up rather quickly.

I had ordered online at 11am for 7:30pm pick up wanted this for an evening surprise. Checked in my order was not ready at 7:20am no biggie.

I waited for about 35 minutes or so then the food was brought out it was hot and fresh. It seemed to be worth every moment. I have attached my photos as well.

We were visiting friends in Brentwood from LA so they brought us to Soy Bistro one evening.  This place is awesome, Kogi has nothing over them.  I tried a chicken taco, lots of chicken topped with an asian slaw and a spicy creamy ranch sauce.  Very tasty and alot bigger than a Kogi, great price too!  I also tried the spicy fried rice with beef, also excellent.  I'm going to have to go back and have a beef taco (I want to try the creamy wasabi sauce) and Hawaiian fried rice, it's got Spam!  We got to meet the owners (John, Chris and Hanna), super nice folks.  I'm going to have to try to convince them to open a place up in LA.

Amazing !!! I was so overjoyed, I could have cried. The women in the store were so pleasant and you could feel a sense of peace as soon as you walked in. It was my first time and I think I found my new favorite spot

A great spot, with a relaxed upscale but not pretentious vibe. Great views of the city. Our mixed drinks, while pricey,  were the best we've had this side of the Patterson House - a great selection as well. We didn't try the food, but were told that many of the items on the sparse menu were not available. This is a great place to come for a low-key evening drink, and the view from inside the loiunge, as well as the view from the large, heated rooftop balcony is awesome. Parking is free valet, and there is an express elevator to the lounge, a la Catbird Seat, We're glad Up is in Nashville, nicely done!

This restaurant was on my "must try" list while visiting NOLA.  My friend and I started with the shrimp & grits.  I had never had grits before being from NY, so they were interesting to try.  The shrimp were delicious.  I could have done without the grits.  For dinner I had the garlic drum (fish) and it was amazing.  Perfectly cooked and it was nice and crispy on the outside with a little spice.  The fresh veggies were also great that came with it.  My friend had the fried chicken and was happy with her meal.  We also got the Drunken Monkey Ice Cream Cake with cashew butter for dessert, but it was nothing special.  We could have done without it.  Nice restaurant, and great service.

Beautiful library. They have a very good variety of books. The cafe workers are nice and the food is good. The kids section is beautiful. I have gone to this library since I was 5 and I've always loved doing all the activities held for children there. Movie nights and book club is great. The teen room could use some work I guess. They need more books in the teen area. 

The reason I rate it 4 stars rather then 5 is because the staff can be quiet rude at times. One of the workers was being really rude to me one time, even though I won't name who that is. They seem to be annoyed sometimes.

But the library itself is fantastic.

Average at best. I had the fried chicken sandwich. $14 for this junk!! I could have had a better sandwich at Chick Fil A for $3. There was nothing to the sandwich. The cucumber jalapeno margarita was good but overpriced as well. Was gorgeous out and only the tented area was open unfortunately. Not worth a return visit.

Worst experience ever.  In my opinion if you purchase from this store or company you will be sorry.  All three pieces of furniture have to be fixed. Refused to honor their agreement.  Have wasted my time and with the amount of aggravation probably have shortened my life.  One piece had large gaps not stitched all the way. All pieces had loose threads all over, other piece you could put your hand into, lumpy, bumpy, and poorly made.  The recliner you hit wood if you sat in it, arms were so poorly padded you hit wood when you put your arms on them.  Made with poor particle board similar to what you put under siding of a house. Very little padding. One arm shorter than the other, I could go on and on.  They refused to take it back or replace, claim they only repair.  This is a company store not a franchise.  Horrible experience....  Stay away like the plaque in my opinion, buyer beware or you will be sorry.   Does not even deserve 1/10 of 1 star.

Decided to choose the nearest Cuban spot near me, and it was exactly as great as I expected. The waitress had broken English, she almost screwed up my order, but I would not hold that against her or the restaurant. I assume she still learning English.
The food however was great. I had the Steak sandwich with 2 ham croquettes, 2 empanadas, and a large coffee.. Everything was fantastic!!! Definitely recommend to anyone in the area!! 
Thanks Pepo's Cafe!!!!

I used to love this place so much. I've introduced it to at least six different friends by bringing them there for their first time. In the past, it was totally worth the horrible parking and long drive for me to get there. Last night, I was completely turned off by the hostess. The hostess has one job: not to annoy the guests during the 45 seconds that she interacts with them. She was completely rude and ruined the experience. It was also embarrassing because I hadn't seen this particular friend in 12 years and was bragging about how amazing this place was. Then five seconds after entering, my friend mentions the attitude we were given. I used to feel so at home here and would stay for hours over cocktails. Now I feel like a strange annoyance. The food is still good and it has a cool atmosphere. But with the type of clientele that place receives, you'd think the staff would have higher standards.

This is the first place I've been to since moving to St. Louis where I've actually said "OMG THAI FOODS". When I lived in So. Cal there was this great place less than a mile from my place that delivered, and was amazing, and I've tried a few places out here only to be disappointed by blandness. I ordered for pick-up, they were polite over the phone, the service was speedy, and most importantly it was delicious.

Go to the Carrollwood location as it is far better.  Prices here in St. Pete, are higher & the cut of fish is inferior.
Ordered the grouper & they sent a small piece that had been made to look larger by flattening it & spreading it out.  Told the "supervisor" & who was of no help. 
Emailed the owner, whose email address is on the receipt.  He said he'd check with the kitchen staff, then said he'd send a gift card-that NEVER came. 

Carrollwood location has a different owner & better quality.

I've been seeing Dr. Tjoa for about three and a half years.  Until recently I've just been there for my biannual cleaning.  I've seen two of his hygienists; they're both very nice and seem quite competent.  My teeth are always sparkly clean when they're finished.  I have a bunch of silver fillings on my back teeth that are at least 20 years old and a bad habit of chewing ice.  Needless to say, I have a bunch of broken silver fillings.  Dr. Tjoa gave me multiple options to replace them.  Like most people, I'm not a big fan of getting dental work done so I was looking for the most conservative option that would give me another 20 years.  I can't guarantee that I'm going to stop chewing ice or wear my night guard on a consistent basis.  So we decided on gold onlays.  The actual procedure wasn't too bad.  The shot wasn't a lot of fun but I barely noticed it and Dr. Tjoa won't touch your teeth until you're completely numb.  His assistant is nice and seems very conscientious of what was going on in my mouth, aka no lip pinching with the spit sucker and I never felt like I was drowning.  After the onlays were put in and the numbness wore off, one of them felt a little high.  I was able to get in the next day and after a few seconds of adjusting it felt good as new.  They're always very accommodating and seem to run on time.  I've never had to wait more than a few minutes in his waiting room.

Best place to have dinner in New Orleans! The service was spectacular and very attentive! The food was incredible where I couldn't say no to dessert! The pecan crushed fish dish with crab was the best fish dish I've had in all my trips to NOLA! I had their blueberry cookie dough tart and I licked the plate clean! Must try for a special occasion!

Once you book your car...make sure you go online and do the full check in @ Alamo.com. You can literally just walk out to the cars and no one will try to haggle with you about gas/insurance/etc... 

My car was "full size" but only a Chevy Malibu. I tend to think a Chevy Impala as a *full size" but the Malibu worked. If you're dead set on a specific car....car rental probably isn't the best idea for you.

I be bad. I thought I had written a review for Grapeseed and then noticed I hadn't written a review for one of my favorite restaurants in the South Hampton area. I have dined alone, with a friend and in a group of good size and each time the food and service has been stellar. 

Having been raised on a beef farm, I am very partial to grass fed beef and Grapeseed offers one of the, if not the best grass fed burgers in STL. It comes from Rain Crown Ranch and is served with a true special sauce, lettuce, cheddar cheese, homemade pickles and onion all served on a Brioche bun. I've had it on the bun and without and either way I love it. 

When I'm going low-carb, I go without the bun. However, I have been known to go bun-less so I can enjoy their amazing house cut fries with house aioli. Now these I will say, without a doubt are the best fries. They are thick cut, skin on, seasoned well and fried crisp. In addition to the house aioli, you get a little cup of ketchup. 

Another great meal is combining my two favorite small plates; Tagliatelle and the House Smoked Trout Cake.  The tagliatelle combines Double Star farms lamb with Salume Beddu pork bolognese mascarpone with pizzicato cheese & oregano gremolata. Those who dine with me, have the risk of getting forked if they try to sneak a sample off my plate.  A picture is worth a thousand words, so look at the one I posted of the trout cake and you'll see how delicious it is. 

The menu can change based on deliveries from the local farmers, but when and if you see the Flank Steak on the menu - order it. It will be tender and mouth watering. I always get mine done rare medium. 

My favorite cocktail is the Moscow Mule and I like their version; Macklind Mule served in the traditional copper mug. 

I'm glad Grapeseed is in my hood. I will continue to support them and hope you will give them a try.
The worst happy hour experience I've ever had. Service was non-existent, food was terrible, and our bill was incorrect, even after three attempts. Absolutely not going back.

Good beer selection and the food is solid. The menu does change a little based on the season as does the beer selection. All of the sandwiches are good and the beer cheese soup is excellent.

Highly recommend the Brewery tour.

My go to for fast food crave by my home (Hardee's is also St Louis based)
However, I am not sure about the "self order" station in my pic.

The inside is large/spread out & clean for a fast food. There are no kid play areas so normally quiet (positive & negative).  They have free WiFi & a "business center" that is 6 seats surrounding outlets.

Being in between industrial parks & West Port... I never try to eat during lunch time.

I mostly wrote the review because of the "self order" station. With a credit card swipe, a few seconds of navigation & then grabbing my cup... I found myself in no where land wondering how I would get my food.   The counter person came out & asked my order.  After awhile she came back out to give me the food.... Since Hardee's wants to deliver the food you me, I am not sure if I trust the new system because of not giving me the number cards for my table.  Plus no use of coupons....   I going back to using the counter.

Plus- this is a Red Burrito so "Where is the salsa bar?"

I will be moving to St. Petersburg, FL, from Chicago early 2020. I currently have Star Farm insurance. I initially called a different branch in St. Pete to get quotes and got terrible customer service so I looked on Yelp and saw the 5 star rating for this one and spoke with Delana. She was and continues to be fantastic. She is responsive, knowledgeable, intelligent and gets the job done thoroughly and personably. I'm so happy I was led to Delana. She's top notch. I highly recommend this branch and Delana - especially if you're moving from out of state. She'll explain the right level and insurance you'll need. Thank you, Delana!

Long story short: I purchased a product, waited a month for it to ship, checked in on why it had not been sent, then they find out the manufacturer no longer carries the product, so my order was cancelled.

I found a great desk on Amazon for $100 and found a better price at Goedeker's for $80. I purchased it on January 31 on back order "expected to ship 2/27". It was a long time to wait but I loved it and thought it was worth it. I called on 2/27 to check in and the Goedeker's rep emailed the manufacturers. After not hearing back for a few days, I called again to check in. The product had since been updated to "not available" so Goedeker's will no longer distribute it. They offered a refund (obviously) but I think it's a horrible system to have people purchase items you aren't guaranteeing them. If you're unsure if a manufacturer will keep making the product then list it on your website with a "let me know when this is back in stock" option so I don't sit here for a month looking forward to receiving an item I purchased only to be let down. I can still find it on Amazon but the price has gone up and it won't ship for another month, which is something I would have done a month ago if I had known how this experience would be.

All in all, I'm really disappointed in their service and would not recommend anyone shop at their site.

Me and a buddy stopped in the bar for  happy hour.  The apps were half price and the drinks were discounted. Ordered  four apps that the bartender recommend and drinks. The apps were delicious and the bartenders gave great service. I highly recommend a stop in between 4-6, tasty food at great prices.

Usually always someone around to ask if you don't know what you want.  They really go out of there way here to be nice and helpful.  We were all looking at the Christmas gift items they had just sit out.  They had gift idea's at $10, 15 and $20 price points.

Such a quaint cafe/bakery in a nice neighborhood. The staff was pleasant and even offered us a free muffin. I got the shrimp omelet with a side of grits and orange juice. The service was quick. The food was good and they give you good healthy portions.
Tammy and Paul are wonderful people and always service with a smile. Great food and better than Subway IMO. Prices are competitive with the other major shops and even have daily specials.

This place is trying too hard to be something it's not. Design elements are off,  from the open and unattractive kitchen area to the crooked paintings. It reminded me of Austin's up and coming east side hipster joints, but it doesn't quite make it to their level. 

Mushroom verrine app was tasty and presentation was creative. Pork chop with oyster stuffing was good, but nothing special. Potato mash was way too salty. 

Some guy upstairs bought my friend and me a round of drinks.  That was cool and also somewhat amusing.  

I'm not too familiar with what the Tampa scene has to offer, but props to Refinery for offering something a bit off the beaten path.  I like that their menu changes often, but maybe that prevents them from fully developing a dish before it's shuffled off.

Let me start by saying I am not a food person at all. I generally eat because I have to in order to survive, not because I get any sort satisfaction out of food. So if 24 hours after eating at Juan's, I am still so completely pleased with the meal I had that I literally smile when I think about it, it's got to be good, right?

Juans has the perfect combination of dive bar atmosphere and solidly good cooking. My friend and I sat at the bar, and even though it was kind of busy our food came quickly and our bartender was friendly in a completely genuine way. Plus, he didn't make fun of me ONCE for being weird (I ordered the Pork n' Slaw taco with out the slaw, and then asked him to strain my drink that had real fruit pieces in it). That goes a long way in my book, since I'm constantly being picked on for my eating habits. 

I found Juans on accident, after striking out trying to eat at two other restaurants that night (one was closed for a private function, one just closed for the night) I could not be happier about it. I will definitely be back, and soon!

Location is in the heart of Castleton traffic congestion. Invest a few mins learning the 'back way' into the strip mall to save your sanity and a bit of time.Visited to find xmas pjs as advertised. Unfortunately, the selection was picked over with very few sets left. My son needed XL adults and could only find S or a few sets of M. 
I've had better luck here on a low customer traffic evening and allowing time to browse kids Clearance. With a little patience and a handy 30% off coupon some deals are practically free. Usually size 6 and under are the best and definitely much larger girls selection.
3Rd time here. Kids love this one. Staff is friendly, restaurant is clean and the wait isn't long for our food. Well lit area and right off of 30. No issues with this location.

our first and only trip to oceano was on a friday night. we had a 7:30 reservation, and arrived a few minutes early. we checked in with the hostess, and proceded to wait 30-40 minutes to be seated. this can be frustrating, but if the food and service make up for it, i find this to be a forgivable sin, especially during peak hours on a firday night. what followed however, was a disappointing display of both service and cuisine. 

our server approached shortly after we were seated, and asked if we wanted to start with cocktails. we obliged, my wife ordered a cosmo, and i had one of their specialty mojitos. the server made a comment to me, making it clear he thought it was a femine drink, and he would never order it. he then said "give me a bud and a shot of jameson, and i am good to go." WTF, no one asked for your drink preference buddy. 

the drinks came, and they were both quite good. we still had not been served water, so we actually had to request some. at this time, we also order our appetizer, the kobe beef sliders. 

we sipped on our cocktails, and the sliders arrived about 8 minutes later. at this point we still do not have water, so i ask again, and am told they are low on water glasses, and he would have to go look for some. SERIOUSLY? how does this happen? 

we start on on the kobe sliders, and they actually turned out to be the highlight of the night. very very good. i should have just ordered a whole plate of these as my entree. 

finally, after the sliders, and before our entrees, we are brought water. i was having the salmon, so i ordered a glass of pinot noir. my wife asked the server for a wine to pair with her scallops, and his reply shocked us. he said he didn't know, as he does not drink wine, and then repeated his line about bud and jameson. this is a restaurant that serves dishes for $20+ al a carte, not exactly fine dining, but at this price point, it is inexcusable for the waiter to not be able to spit out a wine pairing for each dish. we have a decent enough wine knowledge to make the choice without help, and ordered her a glass of chardonnay.

so the entrees arrive, and service aside, if they are good, the night will be salvadged. my salmon was not bad, but there was nothing special about it. i have cooked salmon that tasted just as good on my george foreman grill. my wifes scallops on the other hand, were awful. the only flavor either of us could detect was a burned flavor from the grill. they were still very tender, and in my opinion were not overcooked, they just had a very strong grill taste. 

as our waiter cleared our plates, he complained to us about the "shitty tip" he had received from a table near us that had just left. if the service he provided them was on the same level as what he provided us with, he certainly deserved it. 

we both ordered dessert, and i honestly dont remember what we had, so that should give you an idea of what i thought of them. 

overall, oceano made us wait for a table, wait for water, and provided us with poor service and lackluster food. we have no plans to return.

We only stopped by for a beer, so I can't comment on the food YET. But our beers were great and they have their own craft beers. I tried several and they were all tasty, we both ended up having the IPA though. Pints are 3.50 on Mondays-so we will remember that next time. The bartender was real nice. The restaurant itself seems real old and almost feels like a library. There's several different "rooms" for people to dine. The menu had lots of different options, including vegan. We will go back soon to try the food!
Best pest control company I've ever used. They're prompt, thorough, polite, friendly, and professional. Their services are affordable and effective. Customers for life.

This was one of my favorite spots.....I get the same thing every time. Steak frites. One of the best steaks I've had. Well, I went tonight and got my usual order. Steak came out raw (purple in the middle still) she took my plate to the back and the chefs threw it in a microwave it seemed like. The fries were soggy and the steak was dry. I used to recommend this place but that will not happen anymore. I will not be going back.

I love this place - super clean, classy, and non-fussy. I come here for breakfast and the food is always fresh, and the coffee is phenomenal. The staff is also incredibly professional and courteous. My favorite place to eat in Peddler's village!

They have delicious pizza. We ordered a pepperoni (we seriously got to get our boy to try different foods) and the big mackie. (Creamy garlic, honey smoked ham, sweet red onions, pineapple, and slow cooked barbecue pork.) we also ordered garlic knots. Yum! Lots of garlic, which is perfect for me. I bet this place is hopping when School is in session. Atmosphere was casual and friendly. Free WiFi. Tvs. A bar. What else??? It's good Pizza and a clean establishment. Go check it out. I'm pretty sure you can order online too.

Mount Everest Momo Cafe has amazing Momo which I'm told are the Himalayan version of dumplings. They cook at the Saturday market as well! I highly recommend the Momo. They also serve it with a tomato purée that is a surprising and delicious combination.

Birthday party, family get together, or just pure fun for night out. This is family oriented play zone. Kid friendly and "Adult Safe". Safe on the money :)

A lot of games and good for the young one. Not sure this is for the teen. Probably 12 and under is good. Food is serve here for the party. Party setup is available. They do have bowling and pool table to keep the adult interesting if you wait for your young one. 

Rock climbing, miniature golf, giant connect 4 and all can be found in one place. Food stand is available. There is bumper car in this area. Certainly want to try. I wonder it is good for adult too. But check it out.
Left a voicemail after communicating over this app to setup service and never got a callback after 2 days.  Don't recommend.

Water was spewing out of my bathroom and flooding into the basement last night.  I got it turned off and called Matt who was out here by this afternoon.  Fast service, no upselling, just a good guy with great work!  Completely recommend!

I'm leaving two stars for the past experiences I've had here but today has changed my mind about this whole place. The girl at the front, I think her name is Alex, was so unwelcoming and rude to say the least. You ask a question and she replies snappy and like she doesn't want to talk to you.  I know this isn't just a bad day for her because last time I was in here she was the same way. I was coming in to spend money and to walk out happy but I left not wanting to come back, didn't feel welcome and left pretty irritated. Maybe you should consider hiring more friendly staff for the front because that is the face of your business.

This place started as a shack, now they are a large restaurant with two outdoor patios, that alone speaks for how good their food is.  The staff is very nice and accommodating, however, it has been inconsistent at times.  They start you out with chips and two salsas, one an avocado salsa, both very good, the ques o dip is good as well.  The NEED a liquor license badly, no Margaritas  :(  but great food!
Does it get any better than this?  As far as good food for an excellent price this is the best bet around.  I have been many times and never been disappointed

The best ice cream on the beach!! Has the feel of an old candy shop when you were a kid, with all the candies that we loved as children.  All their ice cream is homemade with big delicious chunks.  You can get one scoop of multiple flavors.  The inside is small, and it is always busy but it's well worth it! They also have a new location on Indian Rocks Beach so it is more spread out than it used to be.

I was here a few days ago and the service was absolutely terrible. The bartender (I believe her name is jay Lynn) was by far the worst I have ever seen. The food wasn't good enough to make up for the poor service. She took it upon herself to add a tip when I intentionally didn't tip her. I have left messages for the manager with no call back. Do not give this place your money

Goat sits in a very unassuming little strip mall located off Marsh road.  The staff was very friendly and the prices were reasonable.  I didn't get a cocktail but the menu had a pretty extensive cocktail menu and beer and wine list.  The menu is a collection of comfort foods with a little bit of a gourmet spin.  I went to dinner with my wife, my brother and his fiancé.  We got the crab nachos and the buffalo cauliflower starters.  The nachos were good, the toppings tasted fresh.  The buffalo cauliflower, which is fried cauliflower tossed in a buffalo sauce with blue cheese was good also.  My only compliant was that I thought the cauliflower could have used a little more of the buffalo sauce.  I got the pork meatball Bahn Mi.  The roll was hearty and crusty, the meatballs were moist and flavorful the pickled vegetables and the jalapeño mayo was very good.  Goat is a  solid lunch/dinner spot with good beers and comfort food.

Very warm and inviting atmosphere with extremely friendly bartenders and kitchen staff! I've never had a bad meal or drink at Kelly's Corner. The bar went non-smoking in fall-winter of 2017 and it makes the experience that much more enjoyable. Highly recommend if you live locally or are just passing through to/from the airport. Two thumbs up!!

Wow! I've never had a seamless rental car check-in & return in my life - until now. We had a late arrival on a Wednesday night and our agent was so nice and calm, he was a true ambassador for Hertz. The tram to the new rental car facility was fast and clean. The restrooms at the rental car terminal were also spotless, clean and smelled fresh. Returning our rental was so easy - just leave the car and a copy is emailed right to us. Perfect across the board! I will rent from this location going forward.

Over the past 2 years, I've made a habit of stopping here on my way up to SLO. It's right on the corner, so you can't miss it. Walk in, and you're in the cupcakery, but go right up the ramp and find yourself in their cafe area. There's little table scattered around the cafe and on days when it isn't rainy, it's really nice to sit at their patio tables that surround the outside. They are pet-friendly too. You place your order, grab your utensils and condiments (check out their homey abundance of sauces, it feels like you're digging in your pantry for your faves) and then grab a little table. Really like the simplicity of their wraps and breakfast sandwiches, but on at least one leg of my round trip drive, I get the Red Velvet Pancakes with a Mexican Hot Chocolate. On my last trip up, I brought my cousin with me. As she took a bite of my Pancakes, she was describing how much she liked them, and as we went over and over all of the awesome words that could describe my yummy breakfast, the word I had in my head was Pan-Cup. The delightful texture of a pancake, with the deliciousness of a cupcake. They serve it with fresh strawberry and banana slices, with a flowered butter pat and a side of their sour cream frosting, as well as the syrup. Skip the syrup. The pancakes stand well on their own. And the mexican hot chocolate? Rich, smooth, and absolutely without the graininess I fail to conquer with my at home attempts. The people are always laid back and friendly, they are happy to describe ingredients if you feel clueless. Oh, and the cupcakes? Yeah, I've never made it through one of my little trips without bringing home a box full.
Perfect crust!  We liked the pepperoni much better than the coppa, the latter being so salty it was inedible.  I'll definitely be back to try the other pizzas and pastas though.

I wouldn't really call this place loud or dirty. It's a relatively small hotel with 3 floors and maybe 24 rooms per floor. Breakfast was good, and the attendee kept cereals and baked goods freshly stocked. The rooms are very basic but my room had a fridge and microwave. I don't know if they have them in all rooms, though. The bed is very comfortable for a budget hotel, but the linens do reflect the budget. Kinda scratchy but still comfortable. I don't know why people come to places like this and expect the ritz. It gets the job done. Sure the walls are kinda thin and there's kids running around, but come on. If you want a plush hotel experience, head elsewhere. Hotels like this serve a purpose, and this one is no different.

Great atmosphere, quality service, super good craft cocktails and an inventive globetrotting menu. I think that pretty much sums it up.

Although I'm not quite sure that Fish & Chips originated in Oldham, England specifically - especially since it's landlocked.

We had a gift card so I was happy to give it a try. Here is what it was like. Non-Asian people trying to make Chinese food. I was mystified. It reminded me of when my mother used to do stir fry. The ingredients were there but the execution of the dishes was lacking. I am just glad to live in an area with a rich chinese heritage, and good Chinese food. This place belongs in the Midwest....

Guacamole was good margaritas were also good especially the blueberry one....I ordered Carne Asada tacos and it was fatty  and grizzly beans & rice were cold..... I will go back again and give another try I'll just order something different.

Maybe it's timing... Glass of water, simple order lunch at 4pm. Served within 6 minutes. Yeah, I was busy and that's when I was free to finally eat. Thank you Suzie!
I read many negative reviews...Give these guys a break in week one. Don't destroy them in their efforts. Did you really expect perfection when you showed up?

Where do I  start... as soon as we walked in we were greeted and told we can sit wherever. Our server came over and was a delight our whole visit. We got half the chicken with macaroni And cheese and fries. With a side of honey. 

The chicken was very fresh and hot! The crispness and flavor of the chicken dipped in honey was to die for! The macaroni and cheese was delicious as well. We will definitely go back before we head back home. I'm glad our hotel is right by this place because we would've never tried it if we weren't so close. 

Oh and may I add as me and my husband sat down to pray before our food the waiter said I'll pray with y'all and actually prayed for us!!! Loved it. Loved the food And hospitality!! 

Thank you so much!!!

The cheesesteak was GOOD! I think it could use some more cheese but it's still tasty! 

Also there is a $5 credit card minimum so you're good if you don't have cash on hand! :)

My goodness this is going to be short and sweet. Stop searching Yelp and just make a reservation. You need this experience. Seafood Beignets. Yes. Oysters. Yes. Death by Gumbo. Yes. Clam Linguine. Yaaaasss. Dessert? You just hit it out of the park. 
Staff = 10
Wine and alcohol list = 10
Ambiance = 10
Food =10

Our party of 4 went for dinner. The only complaint that I had was that they wouldn't seat us until the entire party was there. Since everyone was coming from their respective jobs, it was a bit dicey making our dinner time to meet. 
As for food, the deviled eggs were a winner. I got the brisket sandwich and fries and both were delicious. Service was great. We ate outside and the atmosphere was nice and relaxed.
Love this place. Great staff. Very accommodating ! Nancy gives great manicures. My polish actually lasted more then 2 days especially bc my hands are always in water !! Good pedicures too :)

Popped into Finney's last night for dinner.  After learning they didn't take reservations for parties of 2, we decided to take our chances with the general wait list.  Whilst waiting which we told would be 45 min to an hour for a table, we walked around a bit enjoying our  quick LA getaway.  We returned to find out the bar had open seating (something that wasn't voluntarily given) so we found a great spot at a communal table amongst a vivacious group of lovely people enjoying their Saturday night.  

To the dishes...

We ordered all appetizers -Mini Lobster Rolls, Deviled Eggs, Bacon and Cheese Tots and being unable to choose between the cheesesteak egg rolls or the Jumbo coconut shrimp, we laid our fate with our server to choose and the coconut shrimp was the choice.  It was good.  Not great, but good.  Solid.  The mini lobster rolls and the deviled eggs were very good.  The flavors were felt in the deviled eggs creaminess and the sweetness of the soft honey bread used for the mini lobster rolls.  Tots were good as well.  No disappointment there.  Great flavor of cheese sauce with the saltiness of the bacon.   The fudge cake desert wasn't something to write home to mom about but it did the job.  

All in all.  Great experience.  We'll be back.

This place has potential,especially if the owner listens to reviews.  Recently changed over from Taqueria del Sol to Sweet Taco.  The menu essentially stayed the same with a few additions and subtractions.  The additions are OK, shrimp tacos were good but a little too salty.  I'm very unhappy with the salsa changes.  I don't order the chips now because the salsa isn't as tasty.  I also miss the lemon chicken enchiladas and I'm sure I'm not the only one.  That being said the specials are still part of the menu and those can be tasty.  I also still enjoy the pork tacos. 
The donuts are intriguing but I haven't had one yet that I would eat again.  They are just a little too greasy or leave that funny tongue coating after eating them.  
I go back for a few things but once you find the few gems that's what you have to stick with to keep coming back.

I have had prepared food, and fresh fish from this restaurant, and I can't say enough wonderful things about it! The lobster roll was just delicious! I really wasn't expecting that Indianapolis, but they nailed it! The fresh fish is a little pricey, but once you cook it and actually bite into it, it's worth every penny!

Came for dinner and sat at the bar. Bartenders were great! Hubby and I split the duck pizza (delish). Also ordered the meatball app, which was very large. It came with 3 meatballs and was very tasty. We also split the pesto shrimp pasta. It was good too. I ordered the cannoli for dessert, which I would skip next time. Overall, great service and delish food. Recommend you try this place!
Friendly and welcoming environment, great customer service (sales team of course)!

I enjoy this red robins.  We have been at this location a few times and have always had good service.  Not great but good.  I must be lucky cause I've never had to wait for a table.  I do enjoy the bottomless root beer floats!  My must get item when we dine here.  It's definitely a family restaurant 
- generally pretty busy and most times I've been there they have had at least 2 birthday tables where a few staff will sing one of 3 or 4 birthday tunes on their roster. One time there were 5 birthday tables over the hour we were there.  Was kinda fun to watch the celebrations.  There is a gluten friendly option on their menu for burgers now using a gluten-free bun which is great. The food has always been good and my family lives the wide variety of items to chose from on their menu.

I give these restaurants lots of credit during covid.  So tough on their business.  We preferred dining outside but the chill in the air was a bit much.  The 4 of us decided to just go inside.  After all it is going to be a long winter and we will have to bite that bullet at sometime anyway.  I hope to see more people supporting our local restaurants...they are going to need us. 
So the 5 star is mainly for their happy hour.  Runs till 6pm on weekdays.  Lots of great appetizers and drinks all half price.  Food was fresh and nice portions.  Even my dirty martini was half price (house vodka).  Our favorite appetizer is the large bowl of mussels in marina sauce.  The sauce is sooo good. Dipping their bread in that sauce is heavenly.  Friends has one of the best burgers around.  
Service was attentive and friendly.  Atmosphere is just okay...a bit dark...but we have gotten use to it. 
They are complying to COVID regulations.  A few tables are outside under the cover of the walkway.

Cute place if you want to go just for coffee. Service was friendly and very welcoming. The negative: food is cheap quality grade basic prepackaged grocery junkie food, and understandably tasted gross. 
Won't be returning sadly.

Good luck getting a flight that departs from or arrives at this airport on time. From overloading the plane with fuel to not being able to operate the device that attaches to the cabin door, you'll find all sorts of incompetence from the crew and management around here. Have fun.

Best Western Airport Inn swept us off our feet with their genuine friendliness and caring little touches.
