Worked with Eagle inspections to inspect new construction prior to close. They caught a few things I definitely would have missed on the punch list. Also, responded very quickly to my request - out in a couple days and turned the report around immediately.

Buying or leasing a car is very daunting.  I have to say all my worries were alleviated because of working with Bruce Daroff.  He made the whole experience seemless.  His knowledge and expertise is exemplary.  I would highly recommend dealing with him at Ardmore Nissan!   I know I will again in the future.
Great family-owned place. I am vegan and there are always plenty of options for me here. The falafel, grape leaves, hummus, etc can't be beat. Very affordable too since it's a byob.  Cozy atmosphere.

Had lunch here yesterday. Restaurant located on Bridge. Plenty of street parking.

Attractive decor. Server was reserved but courteous. Dishes were nicely presented and flavorful. Very convenient if looking for vegan or vegetarian restaurant. Also very  good for those with disabilities.

Restrooms were clean and orderly.  Inexpensive.
Such a neat little area Lafayette Square is. This restaurant was delicious for Lunch. I highly recommend taking a small party to this establishment.

I've found a new fave place to become addicted to!!! Everything is so fresh and the restaurant looks clean. A huge plus!! There's endless combination possibilities for building your bowl and burrito. I got noodles as my bowl base and loaded up with spicy tofu and shrimp tempura. The sauces are where it's at!! As a drink, I got a freshly cracked coconut. So refreshing. I will be back
Everything is great about Adamo's!  The staff...the service...the food!

Their vanilla latte was vomitable. Apparently, the proportions of their preference are something like 50% sweet vanilla creamer / 50% latte. The only good thing about this place is their working hours. Cannot say anything about the food.

We thoroughly enjoyed our food on Mother's Day. Everything was very tasty...lamb chops, chicken kabobs, beef gyro, hummus, and falafel. Excellent service and polite wait staff. Calm atmosphere. We'll be back.

Staying at the Peppermill here and we decided to come downstairs this morning and I have a little breakfast ran across the island buffet not too expensive pretty tasty food they make flapjacks hot off the grill overall pretty good I got to give it three stars The waitstaff was really good and courteous very responsive and made sure we had plenty of orange juice and coffee and they kept coming by to check on us something that I really like

FRIED CHICKEN!!!! Go early, there is a line. 

The fried chicken is AMAZING! Perfectly fried and not oily, yet oh so juicy and tender on the inside! The side are okay, but the fried chicken is to die for. Get the dark meat! Don't be THAT person and get the white/breast meat. You're eating fried chicken, just go all the way already.

The food is good, but recently (last 3-4 times delivery orders have been really late, with little explanation except "it's busy". That may be true, but don't put an approx Window and not meet it or at least call and let me know. The latest one (tonight) was 25 minutes late and I waited outside (fortunately) because they tried to deliver my food 2 houses down.
Food is good, but I need a break from it...too much tardiness.
Took the 1030 cemetery tour today with BilliJo. She was fantastic. Answered all of my questions with utter patience and seemed to know her stuff. Very friendly and Highly recommended.

I love Pats - their Chicken Avocado Wrap is my favorite! Their food is always so fresh and tastes amazing. 

However, tonight I got a pizza for the first time and was very disappointed. I got the roasted vegetable pizza and it was very overpriced and overdone. The goat cheese on it tasted bad too. I ended up having to order from another pizzeria for my family!

I'm hoping it was just this one time that I won't like what Pats makes, because they're always my first place in mind to go out and eat!

Consistently one of the worst tire/ auto experiences I've had in my life. Come here if you want to wait 3 hours only to find out all 4 of your tires are now magically beyond repair. I know for a fact man-made damage was done to one of my tires at this location as I took the tire off myself before going in and have pictures to prove it. 
In addition, I had all of my bolts COMPLETELY stripped TWICE! I had to take my car into a trucker repair stop and have the bolts cut off! Then Dobbs claimed they were not responsible and has not paid for this. I am beyond belief at how taken advantage of and disappointed I feel after trusting these guys with my service 3 times simply due to location. 
Do not make the mistake I made in coming here.

Came here for dinner with friends. Good concept few bumps with the execution.  Our waitress was great and the food was decent. However, they kept getting my friends drink wrong and food came out super late. Granted they were vey busy but it shouldn't take 45 min for cheese plate appetizer. They were gracious enough to comp some of our tapas unsolicited. So they are trying. 

The space is designed very nicely and the vibe is loud and energetic. 

However, it seems to me that the staff is not in sync yet and is having a hard time handling crowded days. 

Food:  the lamb chops were awesome, great cheese selection, amazing bread, anchovies were ok (had better Spanish anchovies in Philly), olives were good. 

Drinks: bartender has no clue how to handle Lillet, manzanilla which needs to be served cold was served slightly chilled and it took away from the experience (but at least they have it on hand which is cool), woman (someone from management) who came to our table and had us try vermouth and a few wines was awesome as was the vermouth!!  

I think with a little time this place will be great on all ends.   What I appreciated most is that the staff (waitress, woman mentioned above, manager) all really cared about our experience and wanted to make sure we were enjoying ourselves and the food. Great job on that end and I know you guys will succeed with that attitude.

Dr Anderson at Brosy Family Dentistry referred me to Dr Fullmer to have a previous root canal redone due to an infection. The entire staff was so patient, kind and understanding. I have had trouble getting numb in the past which accounts for my anxiety with any dental work. Dr Fullmer was understanding and thorough! He took his time with the Novocain and made sure I wouldn't feel a thing! Aside from the dental work, the office had a lovely peaceful atmosphere and smelled great. Not that weird dental office smell! Checkout was quick....overall a great experience!

After calling around to Nissan in Simi and Oxnard with no luck finding a dealer that would give me what I wanted for the price I wanted (Oxnard was by far the worst of the two), I searched the Nissan site and found S.B. Nissan. Even though they are a bit of a ways away, we decided to give em a call and I am so happy that we did! I spoke to Cristy, who not only found us the exact Pathfinder we wanted with the exact options that we wanted, but also got our payment (with all of the bells and whistles and including tax) within $10 of what we wanted to pay. My husband and I couldn't find a sitter so we had to bring the kids and Cristy's hospitality and patience was an absolute blessing! We applied online, got approved...drove down with kids in tow...checked out the car, signed papers and were on our way. We have been leasing BMW's for the past 12 years but the 5 series just isn't cutting it with our growing family and after test driving a Infiniti Q60 (and wasn't impressed for the price they were asking) I decided to check out the Pathfinder since I read they are basically the same car. Sure enough, the car drove pretty much the exact same for about $11K cheaper! I can honestly say that the transition to my Pathfinder from my 2014 5 series has been a smooth one...I adore my beemers but I really do LOVE this car. It's a solid smooth ride, unbelievably comfy and I LOVE having all of the room and seating for 7 which means we can actually take more then just our kids with us. We are so happy with our purchase and the service that we received that we are even driving up to S.B. Nissan for service appointments. I found out that they are family owned, which usually makes a world of difference when it comes to customer service and is definitely is the case here! Amazing family owned business and I can't recommend Cristy enough...she is a gem! Give her a call and you will not be disappointed.
The sautéed crab claws were a must order! A great portion and delicious with every bite.

Every time I forget how bad this location is I give it a shot and they never fail to remind me why I never go there.  I have spoken with management on several occasions but it's always the same.  At one point I thought they might be secretly filming people to see their dismay.

This place always gets the order wrong.   I usually get the 12 piece family meal and every time they screw it up.    

Today I ordered 11 piece mixed... Got all mild, asked for no wings and got 4.  Only got 1 breast and 1 thigh and the drumsticks were the size of buffalo wings.

The last time I went I had the same complaint about the size of the drumsticks.  If I find the picture I'll update this post.  

Stay away from this place unless you are dinning in.

Lol. Love this place but despise this place, ew.

This bar is so gross... but so awesome. Green carpet that has people's lost dignity soaked in it, beer in bathtubs, and the wood paneling on the walls makes me want to take a shower. However, the bands that play here know how to rock a crowd. This bar is one of a kind and my experience here is awesome. I also ate here two nights in a row around 2am (yikes). They have good late night food that's generally fast and priced well. 

Not sure if I'll be back, but this is a sober review now y'all

The service was great. Food took awhile, and wasn't the best I've had at Friday's. Perhaps it was the location or timing. We were there Friday night around 10pm. Restaurant itself is dark. Waiter was great, but food was mediocre.

First time here for lunch and had a great time. All you can eat for lunch only 10 dollars. Didn't feel like the up charge for some of their dishes was worth it, but the sushi was good. Cute restaurant.  The train delivery system is neat. Make sure you read their signage before you dig in. They will charge for wasted food.

Buyer beware. If a zero was possible I'd give zero. Bad pizza and shady bartenders. Bought 2 pbr's and paid with a twenty. He gave me a dollar back and insisted I gave him a ten. I had just used an ATM that only gave twenty dollar bills. So there was no way I gave him a ten. Total scum bags.

Came here for a last minute family vacation and it was awesome! The accommodations worked for what we needed for the week. The pool area was nice and had a nice bar area.  Everything was clean from the room to the pool area.  The staff was tremendous.  If we had any problems they were fast to correct it and were very accommodating.  Only issue we had was the walk to the beach but you could catch the trolly and go to all the downtown beaches.  We would definitely stay here again!

Sly's is a classic location in Carpentaria.  Good food, good bar and a nice local vibe.  In fact, the majority of times I have stopped in, Sly has been sitting at the front of the restaurant hanging out.  I had the burger with bacon and Rocafort cheese added for this visit.  It was as good as it gets for a burger.  My wife said her salad was also top notch.  The Bloody Marys that went along with lunch were pretty good as well.

I was visiting friends in Tampa and we went to Fly Bar for some drinks and food. The atmosphere was nice and upscale, the drinks were nice and strong and the appetizers we were ordering were very tasty (sort of an eclectic menu selection), the tuna tartar was great. Good place to take a date at night time. It's not cheap, but was worth the price in my opinion.
Great place for all you can eat sushi. I love the variety of sushi. I enjoy that you have the option to order entrees on the menu as well. Great place for trying new rolls. Great service!

To the staff  - Did you attend my daughter's graduation??  Did you notice she was not wearing the dress we bought from your store?  She couldn't wear it because of the atrocious job you did on alterations.  It was simply not wearable.  I was so happy to have to go buy a new dress a week before her special day.

To potential shoppers - JUST DON'T!!!!!!  This store is riding on a reputation built years ago that it is no longer worthy of.  They make promises they can't keep.  All they want is the sale. The alterations staff is awful and they don't listen to what you want.  The owner was present and aware of the issues yet did nothing.  The sales girl loves to make excuses.   We were so happy when we purchased/ordered the dress.  The end result was a train wreck.  And, if you think This is an isolated incident, I wish I could tell you that is true.  However, I can point to at least 6 other girls in my daughter's class who had issues with dress purchases and/or alterations at this store.  They lost the order for one dress!!  I hope this review will save someone else from the tears, stress and heartache my daughter endured during what should be a happy time.

short and sweet review.

i thought the food was excellent and they have a decent amount of vegetarian options and also thought the service was excellent.  i notice a lot of reviews complaining about the service seem to be from when the place first opened?  i went tonight for the first time so no problem here and i will definitely go back.

This has been my go to spot for pizza the past few years and has yet to disappoint me once. 1.99 slices and 1.25 draft beers is pretty unbeatable. Combine that with a vast menu and fast and friendly service and you got one hell of a pizza joint. Not to mention amazing steak subs and salads. A definite must try if you are in the Valrico, Brandon, Riverview area.

My new favorite bbq place. I love that it's local too! I had the nachos the first time and the bbq chicken sandwich the second time. Both great! The mac and cheese and baked apples are amazing too. A little pricey, but worth it. Highly recommend! My only suggestion is to make a sign telling people to go through the line and order before getting a table, some people were claiming tables before they ordered and that's not fair.
I like how the classes challenges and pushes me. Also, the instructors are motivating and play awesome music!

DIm Sum was good.  Had many tasty dishes.  But service was less than desirable.  Dim sum cart pushers were standing around chatting instead of pushing the carts around to serve the customers.  Prices were reasonable.

If you are looking to stay close to Downtown but not right in the noise .. stay here .... you are only about 5 minutes away from the Downtown area and right in front of the college campus at Vanderbuilt. It is real close and within walking distance to food and entertainment.

STAFF: The staff was so friendly; the valet staff, the front desk staff, the bartenders etc ....

ROOMS: The rooms were clean and layed out great, especially if you are sharing a room as I did. The two bed room was roomy and the bathroom was not up in your business. There was enough room to move, lay your bags out, iron your clothes, and still have a walk way. 

VIEW: I don't know what everyone elses view was but I had a view of The Parthenon!!!!! It was amazing! I got to take a peek at the beautifully lit Parthenon every night before bed!

PRICE: The price I paid was on a Friends and Family rate so it was definitely reasonable. I am not sure what the going rate is with no discount, but it would really be worth it. 

Overall, a great hotel. Clean and friendly staff .. what more do you want.

You'd be hard pressed to find a more satisfying meal on Central Avenue then this. Especially for the money.
Great transporting experience

We tried this place out for breakfast. They have really good breakfast burritos. They are very big. If you are still hungry after eating their burritos, you have a big big appetite. The staff here is very friendly and courteous.  We suggest that you try this place.

Many years ago, there was a fabulous local hotspot "The Main Point" in Bryn Mawr where local and regional acts performed as well as some national acts - either before they were famous or after when they just wanted to play with little fanfare.  When The Main Point closed, there was a definite vacuum, suddenly all these really great musicians had nowhere to play.

Enter Ardmore Music Hall.  AMH occupies the space formerly known as Brownies 23 East and before that just 23 East.  Those previous establishments catered to the college drinking crowd and the dive bar crowd, respectively.  AMH is something entirely different, which is fantastic.

It's a fairly intimate space, they've taken care to do their best with acoustics as well as you can in a space that's essentially a two story tall box.  There are raised seating areas, a bar, and even upstairs VIP seating for some shows.  I've been there for a folk act, an acoustic rock act and a full electric rock band.  All of them were great shows.

They have a variety of shows from tribute bands to national headliners (George Clinton and Parliament Funkadelic play there regularly, Billy Squiers is playing there soon), to regional to up and coming.  They even have kids rock shows and a twice-yearly funky brunch and market.   I love that, because these acts all want and need this venue to play.  

Their staff are always nice and polite, even the very well muscled bouncers.  They ask for my ID even though I am most definitely not under 21, and they call me Miss. Their mothers raised them well. 

The food is actually pretty decent for bar food, burgers, fries, etc, and their drink prices are reasonable.  I'm looking forward to more great music at AMH.

PS it's SUPER CLOSE to the Ardmore R5 and the Septa Bus Stations so you don't need a car. That means you can drink and not worry :)
They give a careful and thoughtful twist in their menu. While I feel this place was a little on the expensive side, it was a good value, given it's quality and location.

I still love this place. While the prices have gone up and the portions have gotten smaller, it's still a large portion of good food at a good price. 

We drove in from Harrisburg for a wedding a day early just so we could eat here. This is no small deal when you consider that doing so meant that I have to put up with my mother longer than I want to. I had several martinis to combat that :p

We were seated right away and our server took good care of us. Yes, you are crowded in a bit, but this is not the place to go for ambiance. This is a place to go for lots of good food. 

That said, you really can't go wrong here. I got a martini and a half for $6.  Yes, you read that correctly...$6 for a Tito's martini and a half. Our dinner for two (which included three perfectly done, 6oz lobster tails stuffed with crabmeat as well as a beautiful broiled seafood platter) was $90 before the tip.  And I left uncomfortably full. I also left with a doggie bag, so that should give you a decent idea of the portion sizes. 

Looking forward to our next trip here! Not looking forward to dealing with mom again anytime soon, however.

I will admit, I was worried. As a woman of color going to a salon in the city frightened me. I saw a review from another patron of the salon, and she swore that Tiya was amazing. So I took a chance. A month ago I made an appointment that changed my life. Not only is the salon awesome, the environment is really relaxed too.  If I had the money I'd go weekly. The only thing I wish they had was parking, or a location that offered parking.

We found the Hermitage (home of Andrew Jackson family) to be enjoyable and entertaining; a diverting way to spend one of the mornings on our trip. The home has been immaculately restored/maintained and the guides are knowledgable and friendly. To add to the experience, guests are offered a listening device (included in the $20 entrance fee) with short recordings that correlate to various points on the map in the self-guided portions of the tour. There are separate recordings for kids and special points about the former president and about his beloved wife. The grounds are beautiful, especially the garden, which I learned was commissioned by president Jackson and planned by an English gardener. The gift shop was very cute too! We didn't regret the stop!

Ryan and his crew did a great job cutting down a huge Avocado tree and grinding down a couple of stumps for us. Veteran Tree Service was very professional and cleaned up like they were never even there. Highly recommended.

My family is from Jamaica so I am VERY familiar with the cuisine. When I arrived they had a child working at the cash register who had no idea what he was talking about. They were out of almost every entree so I got the oxtail. It comes with rice and beans, fried plantains, dumplings, and cabbage. Also I ordered a beef pattie. I have to say when I saw Jamaican food is Carmel Indiana I was VERY skeptical but the food was GREAT. They know what they're doing.

This is not affiliated with Kay Nails in Collingswood.  This is Kay Nails on Crystal Lake in Haddon Township.  Go see Cindy, she is the best one there.  Call ahead because the place is packed most weekends.
What a rip off! $55 to send a package to Hawaii.  I always send stuff and normally the same size and weight is $14.  I'll never go here again.

An Italian restaurant that has cool vibes and tasty food, nice team with positive attitude, but something there didn't work for me.

First, the menu has all the vegan options marked which is great. The vegan symbol marks what can be veganized, but not mentioned how. So they have vegan cheese, sour cream and chicken.

We ordered the Caesar salad, which was basically lettuce and few croutons (I wonder if the non vegan is also boring...).
Then our calzone arrived with a pizza that we didn't order, so they took it and we had to wait for ours to be ready. We ate the calzone first, and the pizza came a long time after we already finished with the calzone. So instead of sharing both calzone and pizza, we ate each one separately. 

And we wanted to get more water to the table and it was super hard to get the attention of any of the waiters, until we had to get up and approach them. 

So yes, good food, but they should work better to keep their clients happy !

Food is ok. Fries were greasy. The girl at the drivethru window didn't say ONE word to us while giving us our food. No hello, how are you or goodbye. I can be socially awkward myself at times, but I do know how to be polite.

We ordered a fridge that was delivered to our new home in Caldwell. However, it didn't work. It did not cool 8-10 hours upon receipt as promised. We called Home Depot incessantly, at least one phone call a day. They bounced our calls from customer service to Maytag/Whirlpool, to the delivery dept., etc. A week later, we received a loan fridge that is half the size of our fridge. Two weeks later, we still do not have our replacement fridge and the delivery date has been pushed yet again. We don't appreciate this Home Depot's lack of empathy, especially having two young children where a refrigerator is integral.

Wow Where to begin !! We go because the food is great but once again the service and attitudes of staff are deplorable they don't care about service. When I complained about waiting to be served the waiter literally yelled at me and pointed his hand in my face and the manager completely supported him ! Save your money there are many other Mexican restaurants that treat paying customers with dignity

I'm only giving 4-Stars because I haven't been to the new studio...more on that later.   I took the Mosaic 101 class at the old studio.  The cost was $65 per person and it included all the supplies needed to create a mosaic piece.  I did a mirror.  There was only a small up charge for grouting which I was unable to do myself because I was out of town.  Katie Packham teacher/owner was extremely helpful teaching techniques and theory of mosaic, showing how to cut glass and tile, checking the glue levels on the piece and encouraging us to keep going even if we could not see the end result!  

They have opened a new studio in Midtown - Reno NV. 

GRAND OPENING: Please visit any time before or after, but the Grand Opening Celebration is on January 29th, Friday, 3-7pm. There will be raffles for a free Mosaic 101, Two hours of Free Studio time, and other special offers. Many of the other local artisans whose work will be for sale will also be in attendance.

The following artisans who have their work on display and for sale at Copper Cat Studio: Teri Lark, Mosaics, Bryn McCubbins, fused glass art.  Kerra Kinion, pottery. Karen Vetter, pottery. Linda Starns, soaps and lotion bars. Katherine Case- lino cut prints, journals and cards. Kathleen Hallamore, garden art. Cindy Lundquist, soy candles. Donna Smit- fused glass sun catchers. Photography greeting cards by: Trish Reynolds, Jodi Burke, and Marilee Wintz. 

WORKSHOPS: The lineup of classes, including the ever-popular Mosaic 101. The first Mosaic 101 is January 30th.  The first workshop in the new space is this coming Sunday and is a collaboration with Yoga Instructor Christie Malone called "Crafting your Sankalpa through Yoga Nidra & Mosaic Art". This is SOLD out but due to the popularity of this workshop they are hoping to add another workshop in MARCH.  They offer full day retreats with Denise Sheehan of Sage Spirit Reiki and Coaching to include two gentle yoga sessions, and breakfast and lunch catered by Creme Cafe. "Living the Creative Life" on January 31st.  Classes are already starting to fill up, so please check out our classes page for more information. 

More classes and workshops are being added weekly.

I will be returning here next time I am in town! 

I thoroughly enjoyed my gluten free buffalo chicken pizza and Cobb salad. Try the balsamic vinegarette! I was impressed that any pizza could be made gluten free for $1 up charge. The salad and pizza were both great. Staff was friendly as well.
If you sit and look listen you might hear sounds of all the music that shaped what was to come. A spiritual place

Expensive and deceiving 

I was referred to this place by the Jones West Ford Dealership so I called and explained I was having issues with my heated seats and abs module. I was told no problem. Brought the car in and elaborated a bit more with the first thing I mentioned was the heated seats. Still said no problem and $125 for diagnosing if I don't move forward with repairs. Fair so I leave the car there. I get a call later saying good news no parts needed just labor to reprogram the ABS module $540. Also they say can't get parts for the heated seats. I said well if it takes 4 hours then go ahead. I get a call in less then 3 hours later saying it was done but I was misquoted, still same price. They charged me $261 for parts which is software that with a subscription to Ford it can be downloaded, not an actual part after they said no parts needed. Plus 2 hours of labor equaling $540. How convenient. So I go to pick up the car and ask about the heated seats. I was told oh they don't even touch the seats. I said I was told you couldn't get parts. Well managed to get the Mechanic and Owner Rich to come out and run a scan. Nothing came back. Which I wasn't surprised because the seats will not give DTCs. The Climate Control Modules needed to be check. He was saying that I was told from the beginning they don't work on the seats when I wasn't. Giving his attitude didn't want to pursue this anymore. Paid the bill in cash and left.    

I called Ford and spoke with Don the service advisor and told him the place they recommended to me won't do what I need them to do. I said I understand parts are not available but I just want the seats reprogrammed. Without evening saying anything I get put on hold and Don comes back and says I need to go to an electrical shop. Apparently, he called Affordable Auto Care they said there is short in my seats. Strange I thought they didn't look at my seats. I ask for just a reprogram of the seats. I will pay regardless its successful or not.

During this time my ABS module lost it's programming again.  So After Hanging up with Ford I call Affordable Auto Care to ask,  Did the Ford Dealership call them and did Affordable Auto care tell Ford there was a short in my seats?  Because I was under the impression, they didn't even look at the seats. Also to notify them of the ABS problem they fixed isn't fixed. Rich gets on the phone and let me tell you. If you want to get yelled at just mention heated seats. He went off saying I knew they didn't work on the seats and that I keep bugging them about it  and that they told me from the start. I said "Ok I understand but can I just say something"... I was wanting to confirm what they said to Ford was true and that I still have problem with my ABS, Rich said glad I understand and just hangs up on me. This is the only time I called. 

So I decided this is getting out of hand. I call Capital Ford in Carson and They actually ended up fixing my seats. It just needed to be reprogrammed like I mentioned. Also they fixed the ABS module for $147 total. 
It's a shame I wanted to help a local business out and didn't want to go to the dealer but they ended up charging me a ton of money for not even fixing it and then not wanting to talk to me. I have uploaded my invoices from both places for proof. Stay away please.
Got me in the day I called, explained what he did, didn't overcharge. Just great service.

This place was amazing ! When you first walk in the decor could be a little off putting ( taxidermy animals everywhere ) but I found it to be pretty cool! The waitress was very pleasant and attentive . We ordered way too much food but don't regret it. Make sure you try the Dungeness crab legs and homemade onion rings, you won't be mad you did.
Best pizza and I'm not just saying that I recommend the ham cheese pineapple pizza with an order of 10 garlic parm wings

Pretty good Southern Comfort food is served here. I went with a co worker for an early dinner. We shared the brisket nachos and cherry smoked chicken wings. The wings were very good and the nachos were average. I ordered the chicken fried chicken dinner with white gravy and it was pretty good. The sides were average. I would have thought the green beans would have been better. Tasted like they came out of a can. Overall it was pretty good though. Out waitress was delightful and provided great service.
Pastries are good but the employees are rude. They act like you are a bother to them. Not sure if we will go back. Although the fritters are to die for!

I stopped here on a Saturday for lunch and sat at the bar so that I could watch a football game while I ate lunch.  When initially seated, I was the only person at the bar.  The bartender offered me a drink right away and also provided a menu, but i had to flag him down to order my food.  While I was waiting, several members of the wait staff congregated a few feet away and were talking about a coworker who had recently been fired.  The conversation wasn't flattering for any of them and probably would have best been held in an area where customers didn't hear it.  I also listened to the wait staff complain about customers who asked for assistance in understanding when/where the next trolley pick up was.  The waitress was appalled that the customers didn't look it up on their own phone.  As a person who was also visiting the area for the first time, I would have asked a similar question and hoped the staff was willing and able to help me.  

I ordered the smoked chicken quesadilla.  The quesadilla was just okay.  It was inundated with cheese.  I didn't realize until my very last bite that it was supposed to have beans in it - i think I found the single bean.   I probably wouldn't order this again. 

I also had the raspberry beer.  I thought this was good and refreshing and would order it again. 

When checking out, the bartender gave me my bill but the following receipt that was swiped on my card was someone else's bill.  I was glad that I was paying attention.

Joined some co-workers here for dinner. The restaurant (and all of downtown) was extremely packed, due to some sort of software/gaming conference. The food took a little bit of time, but our server was excellent and the food was very good. One co-worker joined us a bit late, and her meal took over an hour to get to the table. After we complained, they comped her entire meal and a very nice man named Jeff came over to apologize and gave her a free glass of wine. Excellent customer service!
Slow and sketched our.  One girl nice.  One girl a total biotch.  lol  But was worth it to find the ODB story im here.   lmao
The sushi was amazing. Phil the owner was so friendly and made us feel like family. It's so nice to  have moved so close to a place like this. Can't wait to go back!

I went for a business dinner, and my server was excellent! The food was fantastic!

For dinner, I had the 10 oz. filet, medium-rare, with Bernaise sauce, and a side of their Wild Rice Pilaf. The filet was one of the best steaks I have had in Tampa. Extremely well-executed. The rice pilaf was really, really good! The Bernaise sauce complemented both items wonderfully. A great dinner!

For dessert I had their Key Limp Pie tart. Skip out on this one. Key Lime Pie is my favorite all-time dessert, but this version just didn't have the right balance. The description of the item says "not too tart." Well "not too tart" my arse. It was overly tart. My boss tried it too, and also thought it was a bit too sour. The tart crust was okay. It wasn't about the taste of the crust, because I appreciated the neutral base to let the key lime pie-filling shine, but the crust was fairly dry and crunchy almost. The crust was almost like a cracker, and didn't have that gusto that I've tasted in so many other tart crusts. 

The server swore by the peanut butter and chocolate dessert, even after I told him I was thinking of the Key Lime. Maybe next time I'll trust him.

Give it a few months to get its act together.  If its still there, give it a try.   Had clams in the extra spicy house sauce. Not particularly spicy but it did have a great flavor and clams were plump and fresh.  Salad-meh.  Dressing - Sysco. Service - SLOW.  Price - HIGH. Music ABYSMAL.  (Think killing me softly on continuous loop)

Franklin needs a seafood place badly. I hope they make it and I will return to give it another try after they've had time to work out the kinks. 2020 sucks for everyone. I'm sure they are struggling to get off the ground.  Gotta up their game to make it in Franklin though.

I called a few places around, Stanley Steemer being one of them. I called this place and I will ONLY call them from now on for my carpets and couches. They are extremely nice to work with, worked with my schedule (I was running late from work), they explained everything, answered a lot of questions I had and was not there long at all. They also gave me a container of cleaner to use if I ever should need to freshen up my couch or carpets, free of charge. They were also A LOT more reasonable than anywhere else I called. I am a very happy customer and will definitely recommend them to friends and family for sure. Plus they're a family owned local place which I like. Thank you guys!

I meant to write this weeks ago, but it slipped my mind, but I remembered when I was about to put in my order for tomorrow. Last time I ordered 3lbs of Brisket and the order arrived about a lb light. So, I nervously called to see if there was a mistake, and there was one, which they immediately sent out a new delivery, not with one lb of brisket, but two! And some banana pudding. So, in addition to the food being delicious, they go above and beyond. My stomach thanks you, my waistline not so much!

I would like to give Mikado a better review, but... Honestly, their food is good and fresh, and service is good, but I find the food  a bit of a rip-off.

My husband had the Teriyaki beef, which he loved. It came done how he liked (medium) and stayed nice and hot on a sizzling platter. It came with miso soup and rice, and we feel he got a decent deal at $18.

I had the Chirashi, and at $24, the most expensive Chirashi I've seen yet, I found it disappointing. Chirashi should be a bowl of rice covered with proteins. While the pickled ginger, seaweed shreds and lettuce made it look pretty, it also made for cheap toppings. It didn't have any roe, just finely chopped mushrooms. There was actually very little seafood for that high a price. I won't order it again. Not at that price.
Great little dive bar!  Small indoor area with a fun outdoor patio.  The owner/bartender is friendly and makes a great drink!
Do not engage with these pushy sales people. They have called us 4 times just today, as well as emailed. We told them we are not interested and they don't seem to get it. Very pushy and rude.
Road tripping and need a stop? Skip the Starbucks. This place has a clean restroom, super friendly staff, and great coffee. Try the peanut butter cookies!

Okay so, The first time I ordered here it was the WORST pizza shop experience i ever had in my life. Delivery driver was late by about 30 minutes. Pizza tasted like it was sitting out for about 3 days and the wings i got looked like popcorn chicken from KFC. And the driver had no change for me to give her cash. She didn't seem to car AT ALL. However i got a call about my complaint and the General Manager was very polite and gave me the next order free. So i decided to try it agai, BEST IDEA EVER! the delivery was ON TIME! The driver was AWESOME! he was very polite and was just overall a nice guy! THE PIZZA WAS AMAZING! One of the best pizzas i ever had in my life from a chain. I couldnt have asked for anything better then what they did for me this time! Food is great people are great!

Have to give it to this place, it is realllly good! 

The cheese pizza straight up tastes like my pizza, I took my first bite and I got tears in my eyes! Haven't had good my pizza since I left NY 18 years ago! So this place is a gold mine to me!!
We also got the supreme which was very tasty, you can taste the freshness and the quality of ingredients.
We also got their wings mild, so tasty and juicy not dry at all like most places!
Only thing was the calamari tasted really bitter and that's from the old oil or something. That's the one thing that wasn't too good was the calamari, chewy and burnt tasting sadly.

I am super happy to have found this place! It was clean, well taken care of, nice people and tasty food. What more can you ask for?
With a great outdoor seating area, wonderful wines and lovely staff, you can't go wrong stopping by Oreana. Also, they throw a mean party!
Always great food, great service & inexpensive. Atmosphere is lovely. Never had a bad experience & have been coming here for years.

Hello, I bought my engagement ring for my fiancé at this awesome site, she gets nothing but compliments, had it appraised and it was WELL WORTH what I paid for, Extremely happy with my purchase, Customer service A++++++++++ rating. I even had to get it resized, took a mere 3 business days total. Awesome company will go back to get me something as well!

I love the coke machine because I can mix and match from hundreds of different flavors and create a taste that is all my own. The burgers are messy, and nearly impossible to eat without making a mess. The fries are good, but there are lots and lots of small ones that they are hard to eat. Also, I forget to ask for fries without salt, and they cover them in tons of salt. All in all, it is fun to go when other choices are not forthcoming.

I felt compelled to create an account and review the falafel factory after seeing some of the star ratings they were given. I use yelp on my iphone and usually it's dead on when it comes to reviews but some of these are way off base and misleading by sounding skeptically objective. 

I may not be a seasoned reviewer or a food critic by trade but the traditional with fries I got today was absolutely what I was looking for. Was the falafel the best I've ever had? No, but I think a lot of people are ordering new spins on falafel expecting the traditional or are holding the falafel factory to a higher standard than everyone else for some reason.  By the way, who orders fresh food to go and then complains about how after some time passes it turns to mush and is cold? They have counter tops in the front of the store that you can eat over, much like I did. I sit in a chair all damn day and it feels pretty good to stretch my legs once in a while.

The portions were a healthy size and the falafel was a just a hair over done if anything, but like others have stated the owner is a really cool guy and they are tweaking thier recipes. 

PS: The fries were awesome. Think McDonalds fries that don't make you feel disgusted with yourself after.  I'm going to try the greek next time.

Great surf shop with plenty of boards, accessories, and modern surf and skate clothing. 

I came by here this past weekend to get wax, and found the place to be the perfect place to visit in the sleepy town of Carpinteria. While I always wanted to visit the town, I found the young woman at the store to be extremely helpful in guiding me to pick the right wax (Zog's Eco Box Sex Wax at $1.85 isn't bad, but not great) for my board. She even gave me a quick layout of the town, since I stated I wasn't from around there. I checked out the rest of the store and it rivaled the cleanliness and organization of some of the other prominent (non-commercialized, owned by large conglomerate) surf shops I've visited like Harbour Surfboards. 

Their selection of wetsuits, booties, rashguards, and short boards is quite plentiful. As for their surf skate clothing collection, it's even bigger. They carry all the major brands like O'Neill and Volcom at reasonable prices. So in other words, their inventory is large for what appears to be a small shop. For a surfer, boarder, and general beach goer, they have a good set up anything you need to get onto the water.

Love this brunch spot!  Most certainly worth the wait and the price.  The owner is always there and he's as sweet as pie, really loves what he does and you can just tell! PS uber there bc there is never any parking around.

Stopped by Body Graphics for a couple of piercings last night and had the pleasure of talking with Pixie about all of my options. She was professional, thorough and chock full of information. She pierced my ears with 6g glass and gave me a new Jestrum piercing as well. She was so sweet and explained everything she was doing from start to finish.  Her technique was smooth and there was VERY MINIMAL discomfort. Pricing was fantastic and her aftercare instructions were easy to understand. I couldn't believe how well I slept last night and honestly I have ZERO pain or discomfort today! I am shocked, hence why I am writing this review! I would recommend Pixie to anyone looking for a new piercing!

Matcha Melody Ice Cream Rolls are very delicious!  The matcha flavor shines through and tastes authentic, which is not easy to find in Louisiana.  The mixed-in bits of strawberry balance the grassy flavor of the matcha.  Ice cream rolls also come with your choice of three toppings.  I chose Pocky, strawberries and mango.  I was a little disappointed that the strawberries and mango were in a syrup.  Next time, I'll try different toppings.  They also have a cotton candy machine on site and can add a cotton candy "princess dress" to your ice cream order.  Sweet!

Today I got a recommendation to try out Gilben's Bakery. I was told the baked goods as well as the soul food was amazing. I was pleasantly surprised to see this new place in my area. It was clean, professional, and the service was fast. The food was also really good I got baked macaroni and cheese BBQ wings and yams.
My favorite pizza place in the Tampa Bay area! Check it out!

Went to the "Lost Taco Shop" last night and I think it's the same owners but different menus. Got the family taco pack: 6 birria tacos, a cheese quesadilla, 2 hugh bean and cheese burritos, chips and salad, and a side of rice. A lot of food for $30! Food was good but could use more seasonings.
Pick up via the drive thru. The owners are super friendly and she even gave my dog a little cup of whipped cream!

I have been a Sullivans patron for the past three years;
Pros: great service and decent food
Cons: decent food (Don't expect to have an experience like Morton's or Capital Grill because you won't). The restaurant is full of inconsistencies: expensive items on the menu, but average food quality. I took my girlfriend for her birthday, and we ordered two filet mignon. They were overcooked and lacked flavor. 
Overall atmosphere is again inconsistent with what you'd expect from an upscale steakhouse: bright lights, too many tables next to each other, cheap paper menus (looks like we were at Applebees), waiters disassembling tables right before our eyes (after a large party had left the restaurant). dusty tables, table light fixtures with tomato sauce splashed over them. Again, not what you would expect from a premium steakhouse.
Overall, I don't recommend as I didn't think it was worth it.
We ordered the Drunken Noodles. They paid attention to our spice request, mild and medium and they were large portions. It was soooo good! Highly recommended.

The sushi is the best on The Mainline. The beer selection is over 200 different types! I come here weekly and have ordered honestly close to the entire menu. I have been to O-toro, Aziz, Nectar if your getting the idea I enjoy food. This happens to have the best spicy tuna and salmon hand rolls everybody should give them a try. The decor isn't so great but its homey where you aren't uncomfortable if you show up underdressed. This is a true gem of the main line the staff are great people and the owners are also lovely.

Update (03/14/2014): Harusame recently renovated the restaurant hardwood floor, new bar, new paints, lights the works, it now not only has awesome food but competes aesthetically with all the other sushi places in the looks category. The food still rocks and the beer is still awesome!

My lower element of my double oven shorted out. It would of been easy to replace the element but there was short in the wiring which would cause a fire. I called Juan and expected next day service. He returned my call within 15 minutes and at my home shortly after. He quickly diagnosed the problem, gave me an reasonable estimate. 
He left and got the part, repaired the oven. About two hours of calling him and completion of repair. I will call Juan again on any appliance service repair. Thanks Juan.

So disappointed.  Kids chicken strips spent about 3-4 too long in the fryer.  Found plastic wrap in my brisket sandwich.  Brisket was dry and overcooked. Overlooked the first piece but on the second of plastic I called it quits.  Wife said burger was good and Mac n' cheese was okay.  They took things off our bill but I really wanted to eat good food and was willing to pay for it.  Strike two in the Lou.

Ordered the pizza and the wings.  The wings were decent. I usually don't care for baked chicken wings.

The cheese, sauce, and toppings on the pizza wee great, too.  The crust, however, is lacking.  We ordered from here on two separate occasions and both times the crust was undercooked and greasy.  It is a St. Louis store crust (thin, cracker type).

If they fix the crust, I would give them 4 or 5 stars.

my son, my mom and myself went here last night before seeing Blue Man Group. This was a gift to my mother from the two of us. We picked this place because of its location right across the street from the theater. It was really crappy weather, and didnt want to have to bounce all around town, so i consulted yelp and this is what i found. 
it starts with the reservation. the gentleman who answered could not have been any nicer. i tried to make it for 5, but he suggested we do 430, so not to rush thru our meal to get to the show. he was right. we made it to the show with a few minutes to spare. the same gentleman greeted us when we arrived. so sweet. 
my son hates "fancy" places. to him, this was waaaayyyy over the top. but he's 18 and prefers tgi fridays or some kinda chain. whats he know? 
the decor was kinda cool. the octopus legs coming out of the ceiling was a lil strange. but the running water wall treatments were soothing and neat. now the service. i love when a server can rattle of the features of the day with out stuttering or having to read it. im impressed by that. she was friendly, but not overbearing. only came to our table when we needed her. the food was great. we had some aps, i had the lobster rav. and i think the sauce was actually better then the rav. if thats possible. my mom had scallops and fresh veggies and the boy had some type of crab w pasta. they modified the sauce for him. giving him just a garlic and oil because again, he doesnt like fancy. 
everything was great. since we all stuffed our fat faces, i was the only one who got dessert. i HAVE to when im out. no matter how full i am. i need sugar to end it. so, grand manier creme brulee it was. tasty lil mofo. 
all in all, we were all impressed, fed well, and felt comfortable. broad street is never a place i ever think to hang. but im looking forward to checking this place on a fri or sat night when they have live music. for cocktails and a nosh!
Hair in one persons food, another got a slab of undercooked fat in their taco, and they served us the driest juiceless limes in the world. Waiter is also not nice

Had a great meal today with my Nana and 9month old. We sat outside and it was beautiful! Water views, foliage, nice covered area with high ceilings and fans. They have indoor seating and a tiki bar as well. This was my first time, but my Nana is a frequent visitor and they have changed the menu. We had the ahi tuna, the special spicy grouper dinner entree, and chicken nuggets. Great wine list! I had my favorite, Nobilo, Sav. Blanc and Nana got the mojito. Both great. Our food was wonderful. Great presentation and very flavorful. Our server, Tony, was knowledgable and very accommodating with the baby. Not cheap, but not over priced for the quality. I'm spending the summer in Apollo Beach and I will definitely be back! Curious to see if they offer live music any nights/weekends.
Quite a way to while off your buzz from the Palace across the street.  Bring flowers for a monument- some do look lonesome.
I just ate an amazing sandwich at Gina's Pizza! The owner and staff offered me great service and attention. Bring your family and friends!
Great experience! Dan was very attentive to our sushi needs :) the food was all so good and fresh. I'm glad we tried Sushi Saga and will definitely be back.

I was at 32 for my girlfriend's birthday and paid for our tab with my credit card.  It was only for two drinks; we decided we wanted to check out other hot spots in Olde City.  I gave my card to a white, male bartender: tall with blonde hair. 

He took really long with my card. After waiting for over 20 minutes, I reminded him about my card which he then brought back to me another 20 minutes later. I signed it and tipped him in cash. Mind you, my minimum tip per drink is $2. I'm a bartender/cocktail server myself.

Days later, while browsing through my credit card statement I saw that I was charged twice for my one round of drinks. I unrelentingly called to get that cleared up and was finally able to speak with someone who would fix that for me. It was someone from Cuba Libre (next door). I guess they are somehow affiliated.

After about 2 weeks, my statement showed that I was refunded the extra charge, but whoever handled accounting at 32 took the liberty to tip themselves on my card 20% of the total bill.

My advice to you is 1. BRING CASH or 2. AVOID THAT PLACE

I've never had that problem anywhere else in Olde City. No place of business should ever take extra money from a customer without their consent.

I am  so glad that I stumbled across this place on Yelp, and then, someone from the hotel staff highly recommended it. High Yelp reviews and a local recommendation is a win in my traveling book. 

When I first arrived, I didn't know that I should be looking for a restaurant located inside a building. No biggie; just be mindful of that. When I walked in, the vibe was pretty relaxed. I had a choice to sit anywhere because at that moment in time, it wasn't very busy. (A few minutes later, more patrons walked in.) I decided to sit at the bar near the tv. I love sports, and Sports Center was on at the time. 

I ordered Papa's French Toast, one egg scrambled well with gruyere cheese, a side of roasted potatoes and a green juice. The French toast had such a great flavor! They remind me of the Cap'n Crunch French Toast I like from Blue Moon Cafe back at home in Baltimore. While the flavor profile was there, 2 of the 4 slices of French toast were a little undercooked so the texture was a bit soggy. I didn't send them back, but after eating them I wish I did. The service was so great that I'm sure if I mentioned it, they would have fixed the problem without hesitation. This is the only reason one star was docked. The eggs and potatoes work well together. I added my own salt and pepper to my liking to give a little more flavor but both were cooked just right. Now the juice...it was so refreshing and delicious! I am so glad I ordered it. No matter what you get, a juice is a must! You even get to see the woman making the fresh pressed juice! 

The service was wonderful! The women were very attentive to everyone there. They checked on each guest frequently, and were just overall really kind. 

Overall, I really enjoyed my breakfast from here!

My husband and I took our team out for a birthday celebration and a night on the town and stumbled across Davio's... SO glad we did! It was amazing. We had different varieties of steak, all cooked to order, tender and seasoned properly. We had the calamari which exceeded expectations, the spring rolls were delicious. Our waiter went above and beyond for us, he was very friendly and fit right in to our jokester party. They were very accommodating and we will definitely return!
This place never has fresh food when I go . The plus is the price but it's really not a great Chinese buffet to go to .

One of our favorite Mexican restaurants in Santa Barbara! They have one of the best salsa bar as I have ever seen, with unique flavor such as mango or pistachio! Your tacos are absolutely delicious, they have a great variety and the prices are very affordable. I love the service here, instantly feel welcome in our wall taken care of. They have a bit of outside seating or you can take it to go. Food is made to order a minutes and absolutely delicious every single time. Highly recommended!

I came here for a birthday dinner on a Friday night. My party was quite large, as a few people from my group were seated at a different table. All in all, the service and food was everything I had been craving - because you can never go wrong with sushi. The hot food was wonderful as well. If you are ever in the area, you have to stop by and treat yourself to some good sushi.
Had a great bar table dinner here while travelling alone. Very good service and food/ drink. Would definitely return on my next trip.
Some of my favorite tacos in Indy. All of the meat options have been great. I love the guacamole and salsa as well.

I'm from New England and we don't have a Prince's hot chicken. A friend who lived in Nashville recommended this place to me. Chicken was absolutely delicious. You can choose the degree of spiciness and I got the hot. It's was spicy but not too spicy and full of flavor. The chicken breast was moist as if it had been baked and then soaked with a flavorful , light, hot oil. The breading was light and crunchy.  WOW, I wish I was staying another day, I would go back again.

This place was horrible! Very crowded for breakfast on Mardi Gras which wasn't the problem. The problem was the service & the food. They ran out of butter so they locked the doors to keep new customers from coming in. One waitress was arguing with a cook. One cook wore his pajamas to work. The food was absolutely the worst. I don't understand how we could wait so long to be served & still receive cold food. The grits were the worst I had in my life. I had to ask that my food be warmed in the microwave. I never received the waffle I ordered. Our waitress, although overwhelmed, she was very nice & apologetic. Needless to say, we will never return.

I love asian-fusion and this place de-liv-ers! They've really transformed the space from what it used to be into a modern, elegant spot. 

I started with a lychee lemonade, which is a mocktail that perfectly balances sweet and sour. The spicy pork dumplings were tasty too, but you absolutely MUST order the korean beef tacos that have a bulgogi/sesame-type marinade and a crunchy slaw topping. 

The only thing I could do without was the side salad that comes with the tacos. It was good but didn't feel like it made sense as a pairing (think garden salad but add fruit). I'd love to see the restaurant play around with more fitting side options or ask next time if it can be swapped out. 

They were SLAMMED, so we had a rough start. It seemed the hostess was getting quite overwhelmed but we were eventually seated. Our server was wonderful and when he realized some of the orders were coming out later than expected, he gifted us a free Mexican roll. I highly recommend trying it!

I have to be honest this was the worst meal I've had in the area since I moved here a year ago. Had the beef fajita nachos, the queso and guac, and a pulled chicken quesadilla between my husband and I and the whole thing tasted Awful. The queso was legit cheese wiz and the 14 dollar beef fajita nachos tasted like dog food and only came with 12 premade little nacho chips. I couldn't eat more than 2 squares of the quesadilla because the pulled chicken is CANNED. Seriously. We asked for hot sauce and got salsa? The food just isn't good. Never again. 50 bucks, what a waste!

The best breakfast burritos a girl could ever dream of! As a creature of habit, that's all I've ever ordered here so I should probably branch out and try new things but why mess with a good thing? Sausage, hashbrowns, cheesy deliciousness. Large portions too!
Had a great time at game last night.great game great drinks had a lot of fun..football season is best time of year.

I wanted to thank Katie Koester for providing a great buying experience and in fact everyone involved did a great job and working with me in my new Kia vehicle purchase I would recommend these folks to anyone looking to purchase a new vehicle today Thank you!

Finbomb Sushi Burrito & Poke Bar offers oversized sushi hand rolls, raw fish rice bowls, and ramen noodle soups. My family dinner group of 6 were met with two very Midtown issues: the hunt for a parking space, and a shop with far more customers than seats to put them in. Time to split up and find open spots here and there.

We ordered from a list of signature bowls and wraps, starting with a pair of sushi rice burritos ($11.95 ea). The Hook Up included tempura shrimp, spicy tuna, surimi crab, cucumber, guacamole, crispy wonton strip, sweet chipotle mayo, and unagi sauce. The rice-to-fillings ratio was a bit starch heavy, but the crunchy bits provided a nice textural juxtaposition.

While trying to order the F Bomb--ahi tuna, yellowtail, salmon, cucumber, red onion, cilantro, masago, wonton strip, unagi sauce--the boss of the line asked, "You like spicy crab?" Producing a half-completed burrito with rice paper, he furthered, "Extra ahi and I'll add nori." He moved forward repurposing something already started, so we just rolled with it. Biting through two wrap layers was tough, with very little salmon and no yellowtail. That's what you get for rollin' with it.

Ordering three regular size poke bowls ($12.95), we began with a Caterpillar of freshwater eel, cucumber, avocado, surimi crab, tobiko, edamame, wonton strip, and unagi sauce. The rice was so sticky it formed a brick in the bottom of the bowl. There was plenty of unagi and krab, but the chunks of long fish had a faint whiff of bread mold. Not my favorite.

Next, a Rainbowl [sic] with ahi, salmon, yellowtail, surimi, avocado, green onion, cucumber, seaweed salad, tobiko, won ton strip, and unagi sauce. The tuna's texture and scent was less than fresh, with a really unpleasant aftertaste. We ate the rest of the bowl and said a silent prayer. Oddly, my grandson's Hawaiian bowl of ahi, green onion, cucumber, pineapple, seaweed salad, edamame, avocado, tobiko, fried onion, and poke sauce seemed fresher, though he hit an unexpected spot of wasabi. A bit much for the 3 year-old, and not on the menu. He moved on to helping with a bowl of ramen.

Speaking of noodles, those in our two ramen bowls ($11.95 ea) were definitely dried and reconstituted. In the midst of dinner rush we were told, "the water isn't ready, but I can microwave it". Both bowls included paitan "white" broth, starting with the Ooh La La of chashu pork loin, soboro--ground seasoned pork--shitake mushroom, bean sprout, green onion, seasoned egg, garlic oil, sweet corn, and togarashi--Japanese chili spice blend. The broth itself was flavorful, though not very warm. The veg was good, the pork loin was nice, and the ground bits tasted a bit like breakfast sausage--in a good way. In general it worked, though the spice-sprinkled, boiled egg was a disappointment. Once you've had ramen with the jellied yolk of a Japanese 7 minute egg, nothing else compares. 

The Garlic lime shrimp mixture included cocktail-sized crustacean, sesame garlic oil, red ginger, bok choy, green onion, cilantro, sweet corn, seasoned egg, chili sauce, and fresh lime on the side. Both ramen bowls were ordered "spicy" when asked, and though the flavors were good, neither had any discernible heat. The noodles were just OK, though not overcooked. Despite the tepid broth, pedestrian noodles, and boring eggs, the ramen was easily the best part of our meal.

Turk from Grout Lines Plus did a wonderful job on recaulking our master bathroom. It was very easy to set up available dates. It was reasonably priced and Turk got the job done very quickly. Definitely would recommend!

Recently, I was refurbishing a small indoor project and the interior designer I was working with suggested Reed Floors & Interiors for my floor covering. When she and I agreed on a natural woven carpet the installer used an adhesive on my walls as a base which made the esthetics appear hideous.  Hence, when I laid my eyes on it via a text message photograph I instructed the installer to remove the adhesive and use a different rope style base as opposed to a molding.  Once I returned home from work that evening, the installer did not remove the excess adhesive which when dried was a honey color on my newly painted white walls.  Honestly, a true slop job! The following morning, I called Jennifer at Reed's and left a voice message conveying what had happened and I did not receive a call back.  How disappointing and unprofessional!

Oh man oh man this place is amazing. We got there right when he opened and he didn't quite have everything ready because one of his ovens wasn't working, so we grabbed some breakfast and went back a little later because we wanted to try them *all*. And boy did we. The Taro Su is too good for words, the red bean/pineapple bun was glorious, I even liked the little sausage roll which was actually a hot dog. It was just all so VERY good! Definitely hit this up.

Craving Pizza?

My first time trying this place and I honestly just wanted a good slice of pizza and Buffalo wings.

I scrolled the menu and the first thing that caught my attention were the King Cake Knots. 

It's carnival season and King Cakes are everywhere despite COVID-19 and a cancelled Mardi Gras for New Orleans and the surrounding areas; and who doesn't love (garlic) knots.

Let me tell you, if you're reading this and they are still on the menu, ORDER THEM!

These taste like heaven in a pastry! 
Cinnamon knots covered in a light King Cake Frosting nom nom!

The main course.
Pepperoni Stromboli.

Talk about a gourmet pizza roll, yum! The crust was a tad bit oily but still had great flavor. The tomato sauce was delicious and tangy and paired well with the fresh pepperoni.
It definitely hit the spot.

And last but not least were the Smoked Chicken Wings!

Hot wings are one of my love languages and these made me fall in love all over again. I wasn't familiar with this type of chili but was intrigued by other images of the wings on their website. 

The first bite I was met with a mouth full of spice. These wings were so full of flavor, tender and juicy! The house ranch pairs perfectly with this dish and even balances out the heat!

I placed an order online using the toasttab app and my order was ready in 20 minutes. Upon my arrival I called and asked if I could do a curbside pickup and the man that answered the phone simply asked for the type of vehicle I was in and brought my food out to me.

Pizza Domenica, you've just gained yourself a new customer, I'll be back soon!

With Thanksgiving plans falling through last minute, cooking at home not an option. And my wife and I both being vegan. We didn't think we would have any luck finding good food. 
 Thankfully we came across this place. The food was fantastic, we got few things to share, and we were very happy with it all. Sense it was late, we got it delivered. And seeing how they handled a large last minute holiday order. We can't wait to sit down in the restaurant.

Thanks Again
K&A

Tried the Casa Valencia on Campbell for dinner. Happy Hour Margaritas were very good. Service could have been better - slow and order mix ups. Salsa was a weird very thin sauce . . . not what I expect for salsa. We had fish Tacos  (bland and soggy fish with no flavor rice) and Chicken Tacos  (just ok - beans were good). Very disappointed with food and service - expected better fish for a restaurant specializing in seafood. Probably not returning except for maybe the Margaritas.
Just came as a walk-in for the first time today!  I must say they actually take their time and it's not a 20 min pedi.  Super refreshing and awesome.  I loved it!  Definitely coming back.

This location has lots of options for new and used. The staff is very friendly and if you're buying a car you need to work with RICK FORT! meat is dry, the beans are overcooked and dry, the taco shells are raw and dry. You could literally choke on the food. These are tacos that Do suck
pick 2 with roastbeef and honey pecan salad is great. Fritatta also nice if looking for a lighter meal.
Delicious butter cake! I grew up in north Philly and loved our special Sunday treats.  I always make a special trip to Danish Bakers to pick up a few to bring home to the family.
Alle Jahre wieder. Nette Location mit tollen Bieren vom Fass. Hervorragender Tequila. Kein besonderes Publikum und kein besonderes Essen. Alles in allem aber ein typische California Bar

The old owners ran the place into to ground with unedible yet very expensive food so I was happy it had been sold to new management. Went there Tuesday with the Girl anticipating better food. Uh....NO ! This place is still HORRIBLE. Had eggs & sausage $11.95, REALLY. Had a bacon cheeseburger and a chicken sandwich both of which were PRE-FAB, those things that come in a ten pound box that you just cook so ..... forget fresh. In town for St. Pete Bowl.  Ferg's hosted the Christmas evening "Battle Between the Bands.". Waitress was nice but not responsive to patron nreds---took orders,for food from two of the 10 people in our party.  Came back 20 minutes later to take other orders.  Returned to Ferg's ater St.  Pete Bowl and were told the kitchen was closed due to being overwhelmed with orders at 4:30 in the afternoon.  Food was typical bar food.
The service here is really bad. The front desk is always unoccupied. I'm having breakfast down stairs the food is cold there isn't any cups.  THE ATTENDANT IS ON HER FACEBOOK PAGE

So so so fun. My new favorite spot for a weekend activity. We went on a Saturday at 10 and the wait was about 40 minutes, not bad at all. The bar is awesome while you're waiting. Food wise I just got their chips and dip and they were really good. The playing experience itself was obviously the best part, combined with great service the whole time = an all around awesome night!

To say I was inconsistent with working out prior to Amped is an understatement. To say I didn't know how to lift weights is even more of an understatement. I was always an athlete, participated in multiple sports throughout my life. After deciding to stop playing in college and then once I had two kids, I DEFINITELY got lazy, had excuses, and just plain stopped caring. Last summer my husband participated in a golf tournament where he entered a raffle, in which he won a month of group fitness at AMPED!! He's not exactly the group fitness type so he handed it off to me to try. I did a little research (checked out the website, facebook, etc...) and finally two months later after my at the time 3-year-old son poked my stomach and said "your tummy is squishy mommy!" decided to go walk in to a Monday night class (because who starts a new routine on any other day of the week?). Needless to say, I knew no one there and was quite nervous. But immediately upon walking in the door I was greeted by Bryan, met Jayson, and walked into a deadlifting group session, something I had never in my life done before. But it was FUN and I was hooked. Now for OVER A YEAR I have been extremely consistent and dedicated, showing up 4-6 times a week (I absolutely HATE when I miss a workout!). I never before realized how great it feels to be strong, and to see not only the change in my body but my attitude about working out. No matter who you are, what your story is, you can walk through the doors at AMPED and feel welcome, unintimidated, and like you can accomplish anything you put your mind to. So more than anything I have to say THANK YOU Bryan, Jayson, and Dustin for motivating me, pushing me, showing me what I am capable of and creating such an GREAT atmosphere to work out in. And to all my fellow "Amplifiers" no matter what is up on that board you are all pushing yourself to be the best YOU in there and that's what it is all about!

When I have to go back next week I think I will leave my gently used Preperation H ointment.
Amazingly good food and a good price.  Service can be slow at times, but the food makes up for it 100%. Will keep coming back.

My girlfriend and I stopped by this new spot on the Eastside on Friday on our way to the Circle of Lights. I was looking for a car for my daughter and Luis Quintana greeted us and showed us the way.  He was helpful, pleasant, and even entertaining. Best Pho in St. Louis. The service is usually on point as well. This resturant is a consistent as a restaurant as it gets.
My freind wanted a larger selection if dinner entries so we left will have 2 come back another time

Been wanting to try this place for over a year now, but I have to admit that I was a little underwhelmed by the food and the décor.

 We waltzed in with a party of 8 on a Saturday evening and had high hopes for some good Southern food. All of the food that everyone 8 in my party was edible, but not fantastic. I would strongly advise you avoid this dealership. I purchased a used car from them at 25% above market due to the used car shortage but with the premium being associated with the piece of mind buying from a reputable major dealership group. No option to have an independent mechanic review the car before purchase but given multiple assurances that the car had t pass a stringent 100 pt inspection before being allowed to be sold on their lot. Hope this helps as you research dealerships.

Nice job on my newer car. My first time taking it through an auto wash (I usually baby it with a waterless plush microfiber detail at home). I was quite nervous, as other auto washes have put swirls of minuscule scratches in cars of mine in the past. I haven't seen any show up from here (but haven't inspected in direct sunlight). Sunroof wind-shield stayed intact.

ENVIRONS:
The guys who dry at the end are polite and do a nice job (vac guys also nice, and the cashier inside was very personable). Very short line when I went: I saw 3 other cars go before me and one after. Also, 2 in the lube bays. The place was pretty clean and didn't smell bad (like fragrance or exhaust or funk). They have nice benches inside (a/c) and outside (no shade). Unfortunately, you don't get to ride in your car as it's being washed :(

MONEY:
Takes credit cards (even AmEx). Bring cash to tip workers. Was ~$11 for basic exterior wash + vacuum and windows. (They might have a $6 exterior only? I asked for it, but also asked about the basic pkg and the guy just gave me that). The price is kinda high, IMO, unless they're paying their workers really well (which I hope they are). It's not unreasonable, but if you wash your car frequently, it adds up. Hopefully, they'll offer some "bulk discounts". They do seem to have a senior discount and some township thing, but it was a lot of info and didn't seem to apply to me.

Suggestion: They could "clean up" their signage a bit to make it easier to digest all that they offer. They promote their services, but the layout is a bit overwhelming to new folks, people who read slowly, or people in a rush.

I didn't get any extras, (was hard for me to quickly decide what to get), but they do have them (armor-all, undercarriage, waxes, even up to full details and also lubes / oil change, etc; as well as an array of air fresheners, floor mats, and other packaged accessories).

THE CLEAN:
Fresh (but dry) bird droppings, a full coating of pollen, and basic grime were cleaned from the exterior; and, most easy-access dust was wiped from the interior. Windows looked good, with no streaking (yay!). They had a large pile of clean hand towels, which was reassuring (reusing them can transfer animal dander, smoke particles, body lint, and other things you don't want in your freshly-cleaned car; and, can also cause scratches on the exterior). While large surface floor, dash, and door / hatch jambs were wiped (& mats removed for cleaning), areas like vents, wheel wells, seat-width seams, and nooks and crannies weren't cleaned at all; but, this wasn't a full detail.

There were a few areas of towel lint left on the exterior, but nothing awful. Inside, there were no lingering bad scents of "product" after, either (in other car washes, the off-gassing of the window cleaner chemical hung around too long for my comfort). 

LOCATION:
The entrance is pretty close to Cuthbert Blvd (&, fairly easy to miss, in traffic), so be aware of that if coming from Cuthbert. It's easier to access from the Crystal Lake direction b/c it's on the right, if coming from there.

MORE INFO:
The number listed on Yelp right now doesn't seem to be working. This one does: 1-856-858-4477. They also have a pretty basic (but functional) website: http://www.westmontcarwash.com which lists services and hours, etc.

RATING:
I give this place a solid 4 stars. I'd definitely consider returning.

I was leery coming here reading the negative reviews but I so glad I did because it was very good. The service was excellent. The pho was large and flavorful. I am half Vietnamese and it reminded me of my mom cooking . Will definitely come again.
Chorizo omelette wad fantastic.  Coffee makes waffle house coffee taste like someone took a piss in their coffee.  Great biscuits and gravy.  The Potatoe things they serve suck though.

I went to Kammi after moving here from out of state and growing up with a hairdresser mother. Needless to say, I was so nervous to let anyone else touch my hair. However, Kammi has an adorable, welcoming salon and is very skilled so she immediately put me at ease with her confidence. I have never left disappointed and honestly don't want anyone else to touch my hair! 11/10 would recommend Honey Magnolia Hair.

I was pretty impressed with this dispensary! This place is very classy and chic, and must I add that the staff was very friendly! I came here for a gift and I was really indecisive and uncertain of what to buy. I am very appreciative on how patient and extremely helpful everyone was. The staff was incredibly nice and welcoming upon our arrival, and quickly alerted me to all the perks of my stay. The room was beautiful and clean, and our view was amazing, and the shower/tub is amazing. They were also fantastic with all COVID protocols.

Loved the food and the wine flights, I've been multiple times and everything has been delicious.  ESP.  Vegan burger (with real cheese though) and flatbreads.

Only lost a star for inaccurate wait times (both ways, once told a long time sat quick and once told short wait and took forever).
I had a wonderful experience here, the service was fast and friendly, there was an astonishing amount of variety for the crepes, and the dessert crepes are the best I've ever had!

LOVE LOVE LOVE this place. The people who were staying in our room wanted to extend their stay, as so we got a FREE UPGRADE!!!

Our room had a (well equipped) kitchen, a plasma with a DVD player that swiveled from the couch to the bed. We got pizza and a bottle of wine and ate on the patio and watched a movie! It was almost Perfect!!! The pizza was mehhh!
a small cost 4 bucks- nuff said. tasty but not worth spending that much for such a sterile atmosphere and dingy servings. fresh fruit though

The food here is inexpensive for sure!

The fried rice is alright and the chow Mien doesn't have much flavor but the texture was not horrible.

The honey walnut shrimp costed a bit extra but I think it's not worth it--really oily batter--the chicken options are the better choice.

Service was better than the food quality. Didn't feel to great after eating

My husband warned me as we were pulling into the drive thru, that this wouldn't be a good experience, he could not have been more right!! OMG, I literally, 2 hours later cannot get over the waste of petroleum used to attempt at this foul location. So, we get to the intercom and the animal, I mean "human being" loudly mumbles something on the speaker to the extent, "Come to the window instead of the speaker." DELIVERY: Ordered seamless from here and it was a complete disaster. Never showed up. Phone number provided went right to voicemail and the mailbox was full. Seamless was never able to get in touch with them. Canceled the order after seamless was somehow told the meal was finally coming but never did.
