Food was good.
Great service.
We enjoyed our meals and this is our third place that we going out since pandemic. We had smoked old fashion. When we saw it make us thinking of one of our friends that always has it when he goes out with us.

It is often difficult to go into small retail shops with children, even though the tazering helps with the more out-of-control moments... but I was in this store yesterday with my very fidgety 8 year old and my 11 year old who was dying to get her first pair of Toms. I also was able to buy what is now my favorite new purse. The gentleman behind the counter was so gracious and kind, and the vibe is great. Sure it's small, but cozy works well when there's that kind of genuine warmth. Deffo be there again!

Came here the first time for some duck on rice. The duck was reallly moist and quite flavorful. The second time we went for some congee with fried bread. My friend got the fish congee while I got the beef congee. The fried bread was bigger than we thought, so maybe sharing one would be ideal. The congee was flavorful, the service was just fine. A good place for a little snack after school.

I just don't get it. Ok it's a simple, no frills place, which is fine by me. I've had great food from places where the money isn't spent on fancy decor.

Of course I saw plenty of reviewers who loved it and that's why we went, but I have to be brutally honest here, the food is mush. Suck it through a straw cooking. If this is southern cooking at its best, then in my opinion keep it in the south!

For those who like the food, I'm sure it's a sensation. Bon appetite!

We went for the registry consultation today and we couldn't of asked for a better experience! We were greeted warmly and sat with Ron initially and then walked through the store with Jamie. She was patient and answered all of my questions. She was extremely thorough and made it a very fun and stress free experience. She was obviously very competent in all departments. We left feeling very productive and confident with our choices.

This is Fazoli's - the food is good. But I came to the restaurant 30 minutes after they opened, and I am the only customer here. I've been sitting with my food for nearly 30 minutes and have not been checked on, nor offered the ever-coming bread sticks - and this location only gives you one to begin with. 

The service leaves a great deal to be desired and it's only the food that makes me give it 2 stars.

Our family of three needed a restaurant in a hurry and we chose the Marmalade Café for its location despite the ratings. 

I was positively surprised. Well-balanced menu. Significantly better than some better rated places in Goleta.

Didn't notice the place being dirty like the previous reviewers said. 

Staff was extremely nice and lunch with our 2,5 year old was super-relaxed.

Had the brown rice noodles, meat balls and lobster linguine. All of which were very good.

Sherri and Carlos are completely incapable of basic customer service and when called repeatedly by patrons that were waiting at the airport for shuttle we were given the run around and no real answers. We were told shuttle would arrive at 420. It arrived closer to 5 and then only had space for 5 people when they were already aware that there were 12 people waiting at airport for almost 3 hours. I called to speak to a manager and Carlos said the only manager in the whole place was Sherri and she wasn't available.   I find it both hard to believe and sad that they only have one manager in an entire hotel. I'll update once I see the room if I ever actually arrive to see the hotel. At this point maybe it would be easier to stay at a different establishment since I saw every other hotel send actual shuttles constantly instead of lying and saying they would. They actually do. Enjoy your stay in Florida and avoid this trap of a hotel.

Appearances can be deceiving. This place is in a house that been at least 3 different restaurants in the past year. The hot chicken, sides, and service were all worthy of 5 stars. For me, princes 1, hot chicks 2, boltons 3, Hattie's 4. Fairly priced as well. The "Nashville hot" is about as hot as the "hot" at Hattie's and tastes better. The people who got "XXX" looked uncomfortable.

I went to this establishment yesterday and presented my Livingsocial Social coupon to the bartender before eating. The bartender adds that I will get happy hour prices on appetizers and drinks till 7 o'clock.  Once I finished eating my check arrived and the appetizers and drinks were full price on my check. I later reported this to Livingsocial and told me that they would call the owner and remind him of their terms and conditions.  I will never go to this establishment again until this situation is made right.

Food is very good but customer service is abysmal at best. Arrived at 10:05 for a breakfast burrito. The sign and website both indicated they opened at 10 and there we're employees inside but no one came to open the door. We waved and were clearly seen and ignored by employees who made no effort to come to the door. We waited another 15 minutes and at 10:20 a female manager arrived. When we expressed our concerns to her she stated that she was stuck in traffic, employees aren't employed who speak English, and that they don't have the ability to open the door. She then went on to say it wasn't her fault and that we were in a bad mood. I am a customer service manager and I understand the customer isn't "always" right but when you aren't open on time you should maybe offer an apology rather than indicating it is the fault of the customer. We simply stated that we understand that traffic happens but the associates could have simply come to the door to offer an explanation to the delay. We waited because we wanted to spend our money at this establishment but the completely lack of customer service will keep us from ever returning.

Omg! I moved here from Maryland and wanted to find a place that did pink and white nails! 
Well, I found it! Love, Love, love my nails by Joker and the BEST pedicure EVER!  ,Ask for Lisa.  I love it !

I went to Next a few times & to be honest, I really think it's not all that great. I did not like my haircut or color. I also got a pedi/mani, The pedi came out just okay. I felt like the person doing my nails was in a rush to get to the NEXT client. The prices are a little high compared to other saloons in the Pennsport area.

City Fitness is a nice addition to the South Street/Graduate Hospital area. It has friendly staff and the equipment is in good shape. Virtually everyone will find the all the equipment they need here. It can get busy, but what good gym doesn't? The off-peak hours are pretty empty though and you can have entire areas of the gym to yourself with only a few other people basically, which is really nice.

I also wanted to respond to a certain review below that claimed a particular City Fitness reviewer was involved in a violent incident.

It is simply untrue. Like the reviewers below, I am a client of Jamel's at City Fitness. The review from C.D. seems very dishonest and unlike Jamel.

Jamel has always been professional and is excellent at his job. He is very friendly, and he is someone who would simply never, ever do what that review claimed.

It seems to me that person has a personal axe to grind against Jamel. Why would he mention his name nearly ten times in one review? Why would the name even matter? All that would matter was that he was a City Fitness employee.

But, for the person writing the review, it was more important to slander an individual's name than actually report on the alleged event (which never happened - I live almost exactly at 21st and Kater, and I have heard of no reports of any assaults in the past week).

To summarize: Jamel is an excellent trainer and a great guy on a personal level. Ignore reviewer C.D. And City Fitness is a really nice gym.

LOVE!

After reading reviews on Yelp, I decided to give Mary a call to see if I could get an appointment. I live in the DC area and was going to Philly for the weekend. I called her Friday morning  to see if she had openings for Saturday - she told me that she would call if she had any cancellations. Sure enough, around 6:30 Friday night, she called me and told me I could go in Saturday morning. I was really happy that she took the time to call me back and chat with me about what I was looking for. 

I really liked that her place is small and homey feeling. It was fairly easy to find and street parking wasn't very difficult. 

On to the skin - I've had acne problems for about 10 years (I'm 24 now) and never really considered going to an esthetician about my skin. I was seeing a dermatologist in DC the past couple of months and did a combination of antibiotics (solodyn/minocyclin) and topical gel (epiduo). Although I saw results after 3 months, I didn't want to continue taking oral medication and once I stopped the antibiotics, my skin started getting worse again. Also, the epiduo didn't seem to control my bumps that much.

When I went to Mary, she did the acne facial on me - applied different gels/creams, cleaned my skin well, and did extractions (these hurt like a MOTHER but now my skin is so much smoother, I've had fewer breakouts, AND my skin was less oily). I've had 2 acne bumps in the last 2 weeks that were quickly smoothed away by the sample 10% benzoyl peroxide and cleanser I took home. The samples are $5 each and she puts them in little containers for you to take. I've really enjoyed using them and have asked her to send me the full size products by mail (more difficult to find online and the prices aren't any less). 

You can't find a better facial for the amount she charges. I wish there was someone in the DC area who did the same thing!

One more thing - she doesn't take cards so bring your checkbook/cash. Another thing I loved about such a small shop and personal experience was that when Mary told me she didn't accept cards, she said I could go home and send her a check by mail if I didn't have my checkbook on me. Who does that anymore? I loved that she was trusting me to send her a check by mail - gotta love that homey mom and pop vibe :)

Definitely recommend going to see her if you have acne problems. Call early - she told me she was booked through mid April!

I'm very disappointed that this location somehow lost my appointment today for dog grooming. Mgr stated someone had called in Monday when I set up appt. so I shouldn't have been able to make appt.  that's there answer?  I won't be back to this location.

Though we waited over 45 minutes for our reservation, when we finally sat we were brought a glass of champagne. We were pleased but then they went beyond my expectations by offering us 3 appetizers. Both the food and the beverages were outstanding. I can't recommend this restaurant highly enough.

In St. Louis for the weekend and was intrigued by Rooster's menu and location downtown. 

The food - great! I would up my review a star or two based on the food alone, but the hostess' service left us wanting. There was a 15-20 min wait but the hosts got our phone number wrong so we were never notified our table was ready. A mumbled 'sorry' and we were quickly seated. 

Food: I got the German Sausage savory crepe with spiced apples and loved it. Mix it with the sauce that comes on the side and it's a perfect balance of flavors! My friend got the Farmer's Platter and was stuffed. I tried little bits of his plate and enjoyed the comfort food. 

Overall, good place. I'd give the Rooster a try and just be aware that service can be hit or miss.

I ate at this restaurant on Saturday afternoon, around 4 PM and it was fairly quiet on the streets of Safety Harbor. My boyfriend had tried the place before and was raving about the fried chicken. The service was fast and friendly but they do warn you if you order the fried chicken it takes about 25 minutes. It's worth the wait. I ordered a chicken salad that was delicious and light and just tried the fried chicken that my boyfriend ordered. Both meals were great. We finished them off and had the divine banana pudding. My only complain is that I wish they had a few more menu options. It felt like something was missing.

I was so happy to see the newest addition to the Fairmount hood- Frozen yogurt! Although I am a loyal Philly Flavors customer, I do love me some Frozen yogurt and like the fact that I now have a healthier option in the hood is clutch. I recently stopped in to test the goods out. I ordered the salted caramel corn and must say it was delish. They serve the yogurt to you with your choice of flavors and toppings. @ $4.50 for a regular sized serving  including 1 topping, I thought it was a reasonable price considering they completely filled the cup to the brim.The selection of flavors was good for just starting out and there were plenty of toppings to chose from. It is always nice to have a self serve option like in most of the frozen yogurt shops these days, I will say it  felt like I got more bang for my buck with this option.

I will definitely be back to try the additional flavors. It may be dangerous having fro yo a stone's throw away from me! Welcome to the neighborhood, Momoyo!

Never buy a phone at any walmart thru total wireless plan it is totally worthless.  Internet doesnt work consistently n no picture photos wk.  Terrible lack of customer care n no service at all. The techs on phone really dumb n incompetent. I already filed a claim with nevada better business bureau

What else is there really to say about this place? Such a perfect, charming little wine/cheese/beer lets-hang-out-and-chat-awhile kinda place. Perfect for lunch, a light snack, a meet up with old friends.
I frequent this place for before and/or after dinner drinks, but have also come here for a light lunch or dinner. Every food item is perfectly executed. If you just want snacks, order some of the rosemary potato chips or fennel roasted almonds. The toasts are also a perfect quick snack-I love the one with honey and walnuts. 
Honestly I know this place is a wine bar, but the beer is where it's at. They have really great draft selections, frequently changing, and an extensive bottle list. The prices for beer are pretty reasonable, which was surprising to me. Also to note-the happy hour specials are awesome. Definitely do happy hour here.
This place is one of those that I'm happy to visit again and again. And everyone else in Rittenhouse feels this way, too. Expect to wait or squeeze in at the bar at peak times. It'll be worth it, though.

There is no alcohol here.  Their crispy chicken sandwich was inedible and tasted off.  The meat was stringy and seemed old, a far cry from the ones at Popeyes or Chick-Fil-A.  You would expect more from a 'gourmet' place.  Their Wagyu burger was nothing like any Wagyu burger I've ever had with a rather bizarre beer cheese on the side that neither tasted like beer nor cheese.  The burger was tasteless.  The menu is also confusing and doesn't indicate what is a slider or not.  With their late hours, perhaps it's better than Jack-in-the-Box on Keystone, but not by much.

Super clean and amazing results! Received a great gel manicure and it has held up for 3 weeks! At this point, I probably could keep going if my nails hadn't grown out so much. 

Solid atmosphere and complimentary drinks ranging from bottled water, soda, and tea to champagne and mimosas. Will definitely be back! Pro tip: pay in cash - there is an ATM at the salon as well

I had an appt for an in house estimate and no one ever showed or called. I emailed the company to Thank them for being a no show. I was advised that he had my wrong cell # and did not have my address. One day later I received an email from the company asking if I still needed a quote they could provide one. I called the office  and spoke with kathy, she informed me that the rep was at my home but had the wrong cell #. I wonder whose story is the real story. Although they have good reviews, I will not hire them because one of their reps lied, if they can lie about something as simple as missing an appt I would hate to think what else they will lie about.
If you are desperate for Pho this place is okay. Otherwise I would try somewhere else. Not terrible, but not great either.

You will find a more pleasant experience in a used car lot than this Verizon store.  I should have left when I saw a woman who had an appointment with a particular rep had to wait an extra 10 minutes because he wasn't done with his break yet (heaven forbid a pre-scheduled appointment interfere with one's break.)  

Do NOT fall for the free tablet scam.  I was told the tablet would be free.  Huge lie.  Got stuck paying $10 a month for a tablet I don't even want.

We stopped in here for afternoon drinks and had a blast. The time period drinks were tasty(beer flights, cocktails). Servers were very friendly. Decor brings you back into historical times. Great atmosphere. For a gimicky place everything was done well. Would come back to try lunch.

The number of issues I have are quite honestly hilarious to me. I work in the hospitality industry. There was no hospitable greet. There was no proper depart acknowledgement. I was surprised. I mean it's not a heinous thing but it was most certainly noticed. Congregating outside to shoot the shit but no concern for the tables around. Did we order much? No but the time taken on the table (even though few other patrons were present) was most certainly factored into the gratuity. Are we not in the south?

Best fried chicken I have ever had but let me warn you guys about something. Think twice before getting the hot fried chicken(medium is the best), its way too hot to handle. what i like most about the place is they cook they food fresh after order and and the chicken they use is very good. Very tender and juicy like it should be!

Boicott this Store , advertising on store for Politics " Republican " do not support this behavior In Respect of everybody's Political believes is shopping in this Lobby , guess the Democrats going to shop somewhere else !!!

One of my favorite restaurants in Chinatown, and they're now AYCE! The meat is good quality for what you pay and the other ingredients are good, too. Very little to complain about if what you're expecting is AYCE hot pot. One of the best AYCE hot pot places in PA.

This is the place if you are looking for fantastic Pizza and Great Subs. The sauce is great, the crust is one of the best I have ever tasted. I cannot say enough about this place. I have been here several times and will go back several more.

Unfortunately, I can vouch for the issues people have had with order accuracy.

I ordered a turkey hoagie late at night.  I waited a while (slightly longer than they said on the phone, but I can deal with that).  However, it turned out to be tuna.

Other than that, the tuna hoagie was alright, but not great.  I thought it was light on oil and vinegar (I specifically ordered it with oil and vinegar).

I am giving 5 stars after using Uber twice in Wayne, PA a suburb of Phillie. It is very hard to get a taxi here. Usually requires a two hour notice. First Uber driver was from nearby town and knew the area. The second was from 40 miles away but easily followed directions. Both cars were very clean.  Cost from nearby train station was very reasonable, only $8.00. We opted to tip both drivers since the fare was so low. Hope my fellow mainlines keep Uber busy so that all can benefit. Thank you Uber!

To be completely honest i dont think i will come back and order lunch from here again. The food was dry and bland and i had really high expectations from the food i was buying. To me i felt the food wasn't worth the price, I honestly could have made the food myself if i knew that I wasn't going to receive the food i was expecting. Small portions, over priced, dry, bland, and boring.

This place was mediocre. I had never been to Houston's, so I'm not biased from that or anything. I just thought it wasn't very good. 

We got the Asian meatballs for an appetizer, and they were quite tasty. However, they put them each on a piece of lettuce. I happen to like lettuce, so I was eating the pieces with the dipping sauce after we finished the meatballs. Halfway through one, I realized that it was dirty. There was literal dirt on the lettuce, and quite a lot of it; it obviously hadn't been washed. I get that maybe it's not really considered part of the appetizer, but anything that is touching food should be thoroughly washed. Especially if it's edible. 

For entrees, we got the chicken with mashed potatoes, and the fish sandwich with fries. The chicken was fine, but I thought the mashed potatoes had a really strange texture and flavor. The fish sandwich tasted good, but I eventually just gave up on eating it because there were so many bones in the fish that I was having to spit out. The fries were good. Everything was overly greasy. 

Overall, I wasn't impressed, and I will not be returning.

"Only New Orleans could produce a Germaine Cazenave Wells. She was lusty, dramatic, loud and headstrong. Her taste and capacity for alcohol, celebration and men were extreme, even by the standards of today. She worshiped her father; the pair were certainly kindred spirits." (From Arnaud's website)

Although I never knew her, based on this description, I love her. A lot.

This small museum is a wonderful tribute to her...daughter of Count Arnaud, who although left his restaurant in her hands himself, doubted she could pull it off. But she did just that. Arnaud's is to this day a wonderful New Orleans institution thanks to her.

She was also Queen of over twenty-two carnival balls. Her gowns in the museum are sparkly and just beautiful. She loved lavish things and it shows. I think of Germaine as a brunette Marie Antoinette. Definitely worth a visit if you're dining at Arnaud's.

"After all, New Orleans is the Paris of the South." - Germaine Cazenave Wells

^yep. Her and I would have been best friends. :)

Snowy Dessert is the kind of place that serves something you didn't know you were missing until sometime a few bites into that first mountain of sweet, slushy, shaved milk dessert :-)

The presentation is eye-catching, the falling snow mesmerizing, and the result is a bucket of sweet joy that's tantalizingly disappearing; it's less substantial than Soft Serve ice cream.

Hunnybunny loves the mango, so much so that I've brought fresh mango into the store when they've run out (which they frequently do in the afternoons; you have been warned). We keep promising to try other flavors on the menu, but so far it's been mangos all the way down.

Each time we go the service is great, the food is plentiful (usually) take home half for another meal and best of all the prices are very reasonable. Very casual thus thier name, can eat in or outside. Parking is somewhat limited but what the hey.

I'm about to drive away with THE car I want! I've been car shopping for months anticipating the end of my lease. I test drove cars and talked numbers at Mercedes, Lexus and BMW. I ran prices with so many different brands of cars, but I hadn't found anything that fit what I needed in price, style and features. I wasn't ready to pull the trigger until I put myself in an Audi and absolutely loved the car and experience working through the deal with Michael Burns, the Internet Sales Manager. I only write reviews when I genuinely mean it. If you're ready to get a deal done, contact Michael Burns at Audi Reno Tahoe directly: mburns@findlayauto.com.

So disappointed with service at Christie's. We came in on a weekend because our microwave died. Robert our salesman said their inventory site was down but he spent alot of time with us looking at microwaves. We selected one and he wrote down the info and said he would call us on Tuesday with price and installation. $798 because we had a trim kit for $200. NO CALL, felt like the whole interaction was a big bunch of BS. Lucky us!!! We had called GE on  Monday, absolutely great service, out on Tuesday, fixed and $162 for 5 year old microwave! I'll take it!

The last pizza I ordered there was the worst pizza, ever ordered from them. I decided to try again Large pizza, garlic bread and salad.. 
Again pizza was cold, not the Imo's standard I was used to. Barely any cheese the garlic bread was soggy and stuck together. Salad was lettuce with some cheese. Will not order again.

My husband and I visited Lindy's  with our son today.  We have never been there b4.  My son wanted to check it out because he had seen it on man verses food.  So we went.  
My son is 7, of course ordered a cheese burger with only ketchup and onion rings.  My husband ordered a swiss cheese burger with mushroom and swiss, which I know has a name, but for 4got it, with tots.  And I ordered the blue baller with onions rings. 
The service was nice and friendly.  The burgers were excellent.  The only bad thing I have to say is that the tator tots tasted like the were frozen and not good at all and the onion rings were average.  They were out of fries which I was a little upset with but got over it.  Decently priced and relaxing place to hang out.  I would say that it's ok but I would not go out of my way to eat there again any time soon unless I was in the area.
Excellent restaurant! The meat is flavorful and masterfully prepared. I wholeheartedly recommend this place!

I am finally composing my review for IndeBlue after my second visit to this establishment. My first visit was in October of 2013, in which I was impressed. My second visit on the 18th of January to celebrate my birthday only confirmed what I already knew from my first visit; I am going to really like this place. There are still some items on the menu I need to try before I can completely make this one of my all time favorite Indian establishments, but they are really making there way there. 

Whenever you are at any dining establishment, the staff will always ask you whether or not you have any questions. Sometimes I feel this is just standard procedure. At IndeBlue they encourage and recommend that you ask questions. This is not the standard restaurant script for them. When they say they will do their best to answer your questions, believe your questions or concerns will be fully addressed. Accompanying my wife and I on this visit was another couple not too familiar with Indian cuisine. They were wavering between ordering dishes with chicken on the bone or boneless chicken, sauce or dry, and heat intensity. They had a lot of questions, which I tried my best to answer. The Owner came over to the table and my friend supplied her with a handful of questions. She answered every question and addressed every concern to not only help him select a few items off the menu, but to help him narrow down those choices to one single dish he would enjoyed. I was truly impressed.  

In my opinion IndeBlue has the best Vegetable Samosas I have tried at any Indian establishment in the Philadelphia, South Jersey, and Central Jersey region. On both trips, I've ordered them for the couples in my party that either never had them, or have tried them at another Indian restaurant. I don't think I can say anything about the drums of heaven without devaluing the dish. If you haven't tried them, do yourself a favor and make sure they are on your table during your visit. 

On my first visit I went with the chicken vindaloo. I decided to go with the basic on my second trip, the tandoori chicken. This may be what some consider a basic dish to order at an Indian eatery, but there was nothing basic about the flavors encompassed to create the amazing things happening on my plate. The entire dish was filled with so many flavors and the right amount of heat. Not to be forgotten were the well-seasoned potatoes that came with my dinner, and the mango chutney I ordered. 

All four members of my party were extremely satisfied.  I was pleased that the two new comers to Indian food had nothing but compliments and have already inquired about going back. 

I do have one complaint, when they boxed up the leftovers, my friend ended up with the food meant for my wife and I, which meant I was SOL when it came to enjoying that tandoori chicken as a Sunday afternoon snack....AGHHHH!!!! It is ok, I will be back, and my leftover tandoori chicken was in good hands.
Great food. Very authentic dining experience. We ordered appetizers:  ceviche, yuca and desserts. They were excellent. We will be back to try entrees.

I've only been here for 2 private sessions and from THAT aspect, I don't see what all the fuss is about. From that perspective, you get a room that your dog can run around in by himself for 30 minutes. Yay. Thats what my house is for. I should've prefaced all this with the fact that my little boy (dog) is loved so much its sickening. In fact, we had his birthday party here at the Zoom Room. He is a little lord fountleroy. So, its not like I don't like doing cool things for my dog; its quite the contrary. I just don't see private sessions at the zoom room as "a cool thing for my dog." NOW, they have obedience classes and agility equipment and classes, and THAT may garner the Zoom Room a few stars, but I haven't partaken in either of those things. I can totally see the Zoom Room being a 4 or even 5 star (maybe just 4...its a little small) place if you go there for the agility and obedience. But, as a place to just take your dog, nah....go to the dog park. Its free and at least he can socialize there. Besides that, the employees are nice and the facility is taken care off. Parking is also a DREAM, as they have a lot there for customers. Actually, that may be the best part about this place...If I sign up for the classes, I'll edit and give the Zoom Room a more complete review. I have no doubt the rating would improve.

Purchased an $8000 home office in 2008 including 350 for installation into a downstairs room.
They charged $60/h per mover and billed me for 2 1/2 hours to move it upstairs, when it only took 2 hours to complete.
Organization left with a bad taste!

I had the BEST experience hosting my sister-in-law's baby shower at the West Ave Grille!  First I got in contact with Chelsea Kaplan, the events coordinator, who was so helpful and responsive throughout the planning process.  She always answered my emails right away and made sure that everything was perfect on the day of.  We had the front room for 30 people, and it was a perfect amount of space.  We were all close and cozy without being overcrowded.  It really was such a lovely day!

I chose to have fresh fruit and Danish, orange juice carafes for the champagne I brought for mimosas, and a choice of three entrees for the guests.  Everyone was very happy with the food, which came out really quickly after ordering.  Our main server was Jess, who was AWESOME.  Our other server (I want to say Molly... she is the assistant to Dan) was also AWESOME.  They were so nice and personable and really concerned with making sure everything was perfect.

The planning was easy, the staff is wonderful, the food is great, the restaurant is adorable and in a great location.  I would recommend to anyone planning an event that they check out West Ave Grille.  It is laid back and intimate.

Athenian Garden is a great lunch spot if you are a fan of Greek food.  Everything is delicious!  I don't even eat hummus and I love it here. The salads are huge and beautiful and have a surprise scoop of potato salad on top. The service is decent but not spectacular but the restaurant is super clean and ornately done. My critique, they charged an additional $2 for an extra pita to go with the humus. They didn't inform us of the charge and they only give you one to start. The food is fabulous but watch for those hidden upgrades.

I worked at Chaucer's for a spell during my last year at UCSB-  this is a great store with an amazing collection of books-  the people that work here enjoy reading and are always happy to engage in a conversation on recommendations    

remember to support your local businesses

Was craving some schezuan food so decided to give this a try last weekend with my mom. Our server was great - he warned us that the portion sizes run large, so we decided to only order the Dan Dan noodles and Hot Sauce Style with chicken. The great thing about this place is that you can customize the spice level. The Dan Dan style noodles were great, not too spicy but still great flavor. The Hot Sauce Style chicken was amazing. The chicken was so well cooked, and the schezuan pepper oil left a slight numbness in the mouth after each bite. My mouth is watering thinking about it right now!! Definitely the best schezuan dish I've ever tried. Can't wait to go back and try some of the other menu items!!

Pi Pizza is a gem in St. Louis. You literally have so much to choose from and it is definitely a one of a kind. I think I like the Central West End location better than I do the Delmar Loop because it is more eclectic. 

I love their pizzas! Their specialty pizzas are wonderful too.

LOVE IT! Be prepared to spend quite a while browsing the incredible selection of produce. There's a fish section in the back, too. This market also stocks a considerable array of Polish foods (located directly on your left when you enter) as well as international cheeses, tofu, various milks and yogurts, and a huge assortment of nuts, candies, seeds, and other bulk items. Then, of course, there's the produce itself. The prices are very, VERY low and I have always been very pleased with the quality. 

A word of caution: there is a minimum order of $5 needed to use a credit or debit card. Otherwise, cash is the name of the game.
Wow - I have never been so impressed by customer service and compassion!  Andy at the Cool Springs staff are incredible and truly go above and beyond the call of duty!  Thank you to all!!
Wonderful sandwiches made to order with fresh ingredients.    Bread was cooked with the perfect crunchy  outside.   Don't overlook the fries with the drizzled sauce.

Stopped here for lunch for their red beans & rice special on Mondays, with a side of 2 piece fried chicken, and..... just, wow! 

First off, the hospitality here is AMAZING from the second you walk in. All of the employees were so nice and attentive during our entire dining experience, from the second we ordered to the second we left.  

The red beans & rice was absolutely delicious, but the fried chicken was the star of the show for me.  It was so perfectly cooked, crispy on the outside & tender on the inside. Definitely some of the best fried chicken I've ever had! 

There is both indoor and outdoor sidewalk seating. COVID precautions are taken. And the lunch deals are unbeatable. 

Can't wait to come back!

This place is great! As with my other reviews I really value customer service anywhere I spend money and time. I was not disappointed in anyway here. I'm sorry that I forgot the young lady's name who is one of the daughters and a young man that was also there but the service was impeccable. The place was brightly lit, clean and welcoming. I'm not a huge chocolate fanatic but I do like it from time to time and they have great dipped things in here. I brought two of the peanut butter cornflake squares with the bottoms dipped in dark chocolate and they are really good. Also they have a rotating gelato wheel that has some great flavors. I brought the strawberry cheesecake gelato, and that was really really good! They had sliced strawberries in it. All in all this is a really great addition to our downtown area and I'm glad they are here.

Casa papel is amazing!!! Cecila was such a HUGE help when i went to her last minute with a bunch of stuff needed for my wedding that was only a few days away! She had great suggestions and made the whole process stress free for me. The quality was great and i couldn't have asked for a better outcome. She even offered to deliver it all for me since she lived nearby. I would DEF recommend Casa Papel to anyone who is looking to get stuff designed and printed!!

Legacy craft kitchen 

 Eating at Tavern are great for businesses and normally industrial. @legacykitchen gives me that type of vibe. So whether you're going out to eat, get drinks or have a meeting, this is the place for you. This restaurant is very open. It has a pretty big bar, huge windows, and stylish seating areas. 

 One day I went for lunch, solo. While I did have to wait a little while to be seated and greeted by my server, it was understandable. There was only one server and bartender for the entire restaurant. I believe my service from Jerry was pretty good under the circumstances. He was very surprised by my order, due to the fact that I did order enough for two people.

I started with the "Firecracker Shrimp Toss". The shrimp was fried and tossed in sesame soy glaze, spicy citrus aïoli, and served on a bed of cabbage slaw. The shrimp was very good, but I did not care for the slaw. It made the dish a bit tangy. I also ordered the "Pecan Smoked Chicken Wings". They weren't my favorite, they were fried way too hard which made them very dry. Finally, I ordered the delicious "Banana Foster Waffle". Now that was delicious. Topped with caramel honey butter, bananas, and cinnamon whipped cream, it surely satisfied my sweet tooth. I definitely over indulged with this one! 

Overall  3/5
Service  4/5
Atmosphere 4/5
Food 3/5

My wife and I came here last night for a late dinner on a very rare date night, and I have to say, it was the best meal I've had in a long time. Our server was prompt, friendly and had great suggestions for beer. We ordered the poutine to start, and it was seriously the best thing to ever happen to fries. I had the big pig sandwich, 3 kinds of pork with blue cheese slaw, and it made my eyes go wide it was so delicious. My wife had the house burger, which was perfect. (I stole a bite.) Cheddar and bacon were all it needed. It was as good as The Fatted Calf's calfburgers, back when they were still around. We will definitely be coming back.

I rarely patronize a restaurant more than once, simply because there are SO MANY places to eat in Philadelphia, and I want to try as many as possible. 

Tria is an exception. I love the wines, I love the food, I love the atmosphere, I love the waitstaff. The intimate atmosphere makes for easy conversation. The snack-sized portions keep the meal satisfying but inexpensive.

I've visiting almost every Moe's in every city I've ever visited.  This, by far, is my favorite.  The food is always perfect, the restaurant is clean and the employees are ridiculously nice.

Always try the corn salsa.  My favorite is the chicken rice bowl.  I recently had them cater a friend's graduation party. They were on time, professional, affordable and the food was excellent.

I was very nervous to get my first tattoo, at the age of 29, so yes it took a lot of courage for me to even walk into that parlor. I came with my mother and had a tattoo that I had already picked out. My tattoo artist eased every amount of nerves I had. Every person that I talked to there were friendly and very helpful. The guy at the front desk was funny and very sweet! I will be going there for my next tattoo!

i'll start by saying this: i absolutely abhor the fact that they refuse to use a normal system like any other establishment! this is why i have only ever been to B2 twice. the counter operates like a bar. you may stand there feeling ignored while people who came in after you are being served. there isn't even a sign like "order here". it isnt a BAR, it's a coffee shop. there are a thousand other coffee shops in this city that have figured out how to serve their customers fairly and efficiently and there is really no reason to go reinventing the wheel when it comes to giving people drinks and sandwiches.

that being said, i like the green onion cream cheese. I know i could totally make it at home, but i dont. I like that they give you a ton of it, too. i like to really heap it on there. 

i also like the big tables, but i dislike that they are often occupied by one person who is spread out with their laptop and work stuff while my friends and i sidle into cramped corners. More small tables would seat more people.

i really dislike that it is cash only. i tend to avoid cash only establishments. there have been many a mildly hungover morning that i start my trek thiking i'll hit up B2 but end up at dunkin donuts to avoid the cash hassle.
Food is delicious and just as good as Chicago locations. Service is horrible. It's hard to find seating. Orders are incomplete and it takes 45+ minutes to get your food.

A simple place with clean beds, free Wi-Fi and breakfast.  AAA or Gov't disc. Traffic noise grows as Nashville wakes up.  That's OK...considering what we paid I'm not expecting the Hilton or Ritz.  While traveling,  this works....not too shabby indeed.
Lot's of variety and cool place to hang out.

worst customer service ....i bought 3 phones in that store,,,,,i was not happy when i had to go back and get help and the girl told me that what the manager told me was incorrect and that she worked for the company longer than he did, it turned me off completely.....i would call and get hang ups too....not cool ! ... this is not a place that i would re-visit...needs to have a makeover too....

Unfortunately I used the app to order takeout and ordered the turkey sandwich but once I got to the airport I found I was given someone else's order- a vegan lunch. Not sure who fared worse, me or the vegan. Salad was good but when your wanting protein it is a disappointment to get a yam. Maybe would try again but I do need to contact them to see if we can rectify the first situation.

This place is a cute little spot. Super slow service. I realize they may be short handed but it was still pretty slow and it wasn't filled to capacity at the time. The menu states you get certain things w your meals but when the check was presented we were charged extra for the things that were supposedly included. So that's confusing. Our food was decent enough. Nothing spectacular. The coffee was ok. Staff is friendly

What an incredible night at Sonic in Sparks supporting Solace Tree, a nonprofit that helps grieving kids, teens and adults (for free!!) as well as celebrating the Cain family who were helped by Solace Tree when they lost their parents way too soon. Sonic staff were handing out all their go to foods, yummy corndogs, jalapeno poppers (finally know where I can get ones stuffed with cheddar cheese instead of cream cheese), mozzarella sticks, and drinks while local bartenders served up tasty cocktails that were their twist on a Sonic menu item! And all for the good of supporting Solace Tree and, of course, an awesome Sonic Shake fashioned trophy! Everyone put their heart into this fun night and made it a great experience. If you haven't visited Sonic yet, do it. The food is good and the staff really care about  serving the public. Plus, coming soon, Sonic in Reno across from Whole Foods!!

So today is Friday, no meat for Catholics. I ordered a lb of flounder & 1lb scallops. The scallops were so fishy they went right in the trash, the fish all the breading fell of. So $40  later & I have to order pizza.

If you see a crowded gas station, there are only a few assumptions one can make. Yup, you got it.... it usually means cheaper gas than it's  competition. 
This Wawa has new pumps that work easily and aren't  broken, a very nice change in Tampa. And yes, the gas was the cheapest around. 
The traffic at the pumps & in and out of the store was almost comical. This place was full, people were actually waiting to get spaces at the pump & for the store.
I did not have the pleasure of visiting inside the store, but have heard they are clean & offer some good eats.
What's a girl to do? Wawa, presents a whole new experience in stopping to gas up your vehicle.

My husband and I ordered delivery from there for the first time today and we are highly disappointed. After my husband repeated our phone number/address to whoever that picked up the phone for about 15 minutes, we finally got to order 1 Spicy Tuna Roll Bento Box and 1 California Roll Bento Box. Let's just say we were NOT satisfied when our order was delivered. The rolls were soggy and the spicy tuna roll itself wasn't presentable, nor did it taste good. Their chicken satay, rice, and salads were at least edible. This will definitely be the FIRST and LAST time we're ordering from them.

Only  good thing to say was the decor was nice.  We were there for a wedding rehearsal dinner.  Food was ok at best . the chicken and sausage medallions , bland, rigatoni with meat sauce, bland, the rigatoni with pesto (well i think it was pesto, it was green) ,tasteless.the bartender  seemed to pick and choose who they would start a tab for or even serve. My brother in law ordered a makers mark and coke and felt like he paid $12 for a coke.
Made a group delivery for 7:00 pm they arrived right on time. Everything was hot and fresh. Thanks again!

I'm thrilled to say that I'll be getting married at Trinity New Orleans on April 21, 2012. I am positive it is going to be an amazing day whether its raining or not! The Dean of the Cathedral, Henry Hudson, is a wonderful man, welcoming and accommodating in every way. He runs an amazing operation at Trinity. In fact, on the Sunday evening that we went to Trinity to visit, a local brass band was performing in the sanctuary, apparently as they do each Sunday (late afternoon). it was a well-attended performance! 

I can only hope that my wedding in this pink stucco and mahogany masterpiece is so festive and so well-attended. I'll report back after the nuptials!!

I use these guys for tailoring, cleaning and such. They are great. I lost a bunch of weight and had expensive cloths that I just wanted to be sized down. They did a great job. I used to go other places and they kept changing the price on dry cleaning but these guys are pleasant, consistent and do a great job.

This place is so great! I looked at Yelp​ reviews from around the area for iPhone repairs and this place caught my eye. I went in with my screen cracked pretty bad. They looked at it without judgment​ which was great. I told them I just wanted a fixed screen. The friendly male worker just smiles and said sure thing be ready in an hour!​ That was perfect as I went back out to South Street​ for lunch. Came back and paid about $80. Which was higher in price compared​ to others around the area. I used the Yelp check-in​ discount and they gladly​ accept it. I left happy and my phone looks brand new! You are definitely​ paying for quality!!!

I will never come back.  You are not a hospital.  You are a fancy hotel that is only interested in making the big bucks.    The Dr. had no idea what was wrong with me.  What he first diagnosed, a 2 year old would have known this was not the problem.  We had to wait extra long before we could leave, just so he could give us more advertising for your hospital.  Pay closer attention to the patient's requests, and who is to pay the bill, ie my Insurance Co. You received a fax while we were there, with all the instructions.  I still received the bill & had to go thru all kinds of red tape to fix it.  This is a very unhappy patient.

I was really looking forward to this place as I had heard a lot of good things. They offer a limited amount of food but I just wanted coffee. My latte was prepared well. They roast their beans in a little room adjacent to the cafe so I was thinking it was going to be super great. Ironically, the crema that was produced from the shot was minimal so that worried me a bit. The barista did a nice job on the pour and produced some nice art despite the little crema. The latte turned out very good. It wasn't outstanding, but certainly better than most.  The atmosphere in the shop is pretty low key, and they do offer nice outdoor seating as well. I would definitely recommend coming here if you are visiting from out of town like me and are a coffee snob.
Puyero is perfect if you want to try alternatives to tacos and enjoy flavorful shredded chicken, braided beef, sweet and green plantains, and great Latin drinks.

Always enjoyable. I prefer my fIsh medium rare and always have to send back. Especially salmon.  Other than that ,everything is always awesome. Might be my fault for not stressing the fact with the server. Always feel like I'm being a "Dick" but if u want I it cooked that way...

A-OK.  Come here for the great beach side view and the feel of the ocean air on your face.  Come here for quenching your thirst - beer, mixed drinks.  Come here with good company or to find great company to talk the evening / afternoon away.

Frenchy's has 4 locations all nearby in Clearwater,  there could be more.  It seems there is a Frenchy's every 1/2 mile.  This particular location has an extensive menu,  but they are really well known for their grouper -  tacos to fillet, to tamales to mixed with other seafood.   Start the affair with a LandShark beer - a light akin to corona,  dive into a cup of She Crab soup - a creamy lightly sweet thick soup with chunks of crab meat.  Move to Grouper Tamale -  moist and served piping hot in corn husk with thick chunks of grouper in the middle.   The Dessert change to ask for the several choices offered.  If you are not into fish,  then chicken, and beef are also on the menu.   

TIP - Steer away from the Roctopus - though sounds fancy,  the octopus if marinated in far too much lime juice making it taste far too tart and though grilled some of the internals seemed to be not cooked through. 

The service if attentive to your needs though my server did forget the cherries I requested for my second drink.  

All in all a great watering hole with decent food to along.  Nothing to write home about, but certainly a fun hang-out and being right by the ocean.

I just started here and this is the worst college I've ever been to. My professor is extremely narcissistic, which makes sense because the rest of the staff seems to have an extended sense of self as well and is a terrible teacher. Everyone in the offices are so rude. It's like they're mad at you for wanting to pay them to learn. I wish this wasn't my only option right now. I usually really enjoy school but since going here I dread having to go to campus.

Great experience very friendly staff gave me exactly what I asked for and at a great price Ocon is a exceptional artist that makes it worth coming in from out of town I would and will recommend them to any one

This is one of my favorite places to go when we're visiting Boise. The food is pretty good. Not the best but it'll satisfy you Chinese craving. They have a big variety too! Service is good for a buffet like they clear your table often and refill your drink if even half empty. Overall it's worth going to unless your a food snob then don't go.

Thai-Mex, who would have ever thought of this?  I asked some of my st pete friends for a new restaurant to try and they mentioned Nitally's.  As a typical place on Central ave. parking is a little troublesome.  The place was packed on a Tuesday but that only means its worth the wait.  They were super busy but the waitress was able to take care of us.   Food was served in a decent amount of time.  Place has outside seating and inside.  Inside did not really have an atmosphere since it had no music just the rumblings of other table conversations.  We both had pad thai, she had the chipotle and I had the chorizo.  Both plates were delicious!  We also ordered the nachos which was a mistake since the plate is made for like 4 people.  I knocked the rating for this since I figured the waitress would have mentioned the nachos are for more than 2 people.  I would suggest people visit since the food was exceptional.  I will be returning to try more!

This is a fun little hole in the wall that is not so small. The entrance is on the side street that leads to the parking garage off 7th.

Once inside, there is a small but inviting bar with several tables and chairs as well. If you keep walking back, you will enter the courtyard. This is the place to be! One the night we were there, a dj was spinning tunes. There are also bar games and a small bar so you do not have to go inside.  The courtyard is very nice when it is cool outside and the stars and the moon are shining. 

Drinks were cheap, and they have a full liquor bar.

I liked hanging out there and would do so again.

I was uber excited about Tom+Chee coming to Indianapolis after seeing the business on Shark Tank and hearing race reviews about the restaurant in Cincinnati. 

The food is delicious. I love the Pep*Chee. It has pepperoni, mozzarella cheese, and tomato sauce. I love to dip the sand which in the chunky tomato basil soup. 

The only reason I give the review 4 stars is because it's a bit pricey for grilled cheese.

Being new to yoga and overweight, I was terrified to get started.  Everyone at this studio is so kind and helpful.  This is not yoga for wimps, but I will say I felt comfortable as a total beginner.  I was shocked at how quickly I adapted and how much better I felt after only a few weeks.  

This is the best yoga studio in the area.  Jump in!

I actually have never had my nails look so horrible!! Tried out this place and kid you not he finished my nails in 20 minutes. Every Single nail is crooked after I asked him to individually file each nail down after seeing they were crooked , yet they all turned out crooked. Its been 4 days since I got them done 1 nail fell off , the gel is coming off every other nail and looks horrible.Save  your money because i paid 40 dollars for the worst nails i have ever gotten.

Tourist review here for a Friday afternoon visit

Look out for the Lunch combo special!!!! I ordered in a rush and missed this deal

Food - 4: Poboy was yummy and juicier (pleasantly) than expected. I quickly realised that I do  not need that much bread. So, I would stick to a half po-boy next time.
Service - 3: Over the bar, service. Line goes fast but it is long. The tables are not cleaned regularly.
Location - 2: It is relatively easy to find but the AC was leaking water (I guess) at the table we sat on.
Excellent Customer Service! Very friendly staff. Recently, was having an issue with a certain type of coil and asked and was recommended on how to prep the coil.

"Over-rated". Never again. I used to be a fan. :(
I visited on my birthday. Monday morning, April 21 @ about 9:30 am. My 40th even!

Jodi was the WORST server I have had in a very long time. She rushed us, never looked me in the eye, and wouldn't even let me finish a sentence before bolting away from our table! And, there were only 6 other patrons in the entire restaurant!

Jodi arrived 20 seconds after we were seated; "do you know what you want, or..."
She didn't offer us water or anything, or even give me a chance to speak a word past "we need a few more..." 
"K". She abruptly replied before rushing off....

Gosh it will take me a while to write all of this.

Basically, I had to ask for water a couple of times, even after she brought us our V8.
Just dropped it on the table and ran.
Then we had to wait and ask for straws.
Then she had to go back to the kitchen to get those (why aren't they in her apron?)
She rushed off EVERY single time she stopped by the table.

The food sat under the heat lamp for a while before being served, and ended up being burnt, with completely dried out, black and brown cheese. Onions so burned they were dusty pieces of black charcoal.

When I complained, she took it as more of a "I want a discount", and NOT the "please inform the manager/cook" as intended.
My intention is to ALWAYS be polite and help make a better experience for the next guest.

Anyways, in the end, she was also the person that checked us out, and I (politely and directly as any woman with class would do), asked if she was stuck with too much work, as she seemed very rushed.
"Nope."
She said, just as hurriedly - STILL not looking up fast enough to look me in the eye.

VERY RUDE!
NOT WORTH THE FOOD I COULD MAKE BETTER AT HOME.

I mean seriously...Hollandaise sauce takes all of what, 5 minutes?

Jaime or Jamie helped me today. He went above and beyond by constantly checking on me while browsing, tending to me when it came to trying on different shoes and sizes, and also by answering my many questions about one of the shoe's style and fit. The store seemed busy, as it was a Saturday afternoon, and I never had to search for assistance from him. He was answering the phone and tending to me at the same time and never felt ignored. He unboxed the shoes and everything. He order my shoes online to my house, and we shared some sarcasm, as well.

Best. Sandwich. In Phoenixville!!  No frills shop.  All the frills are in the sandwiches.  Pork and prime rib are amazing.  Forget all the sub par pizza shops and do yourself a favor and stop in- you will not regret it.
The food was superb, BB's service was some of h best I've ever had, and the atmosphere definitely has that New Orleans feel without having to go into the city to get it.

We still eat here every couple of months, but the service is really spotty. We've gotten cold food, a forgotten item, wrong item during various visits. The last visit was for Sunday breakfast last month. It was not busy, but it took forever to get our food and when it finally came it was all cold. Bummer. The servers are all friendly so it's hard to get mad at them. Ironically, the only time we haven't had a screw up on our order was when it was completely packed on a Friday night.
Nice room, new age music, really slow service. Beware. 75 minute parking is tight. Food looks good.

Cherry. Hand. Dipped. Dilly. Bars. 

Anyone who knows me knows DQ better have my cherry dilly bars. You get a extra star if they are hand-dipped and not pre-packaged by the factory. 

Now, I am not sure who is dipping them, but they dip them about 5 times. The candy dip is very thick, making their daily bars the best in Indy I've had to date. 

There is a sitting area and swing in the back to enjoy your treat.

Got to be some of the best pizza here in St. Pete. Simple ingredients. Open and beautiful Atmosphere.. I have encountered some really great service and staff. Ask for Pete at the bar. Try the Angel margarita and Truffle and prosciutto pizza. Fan the manager was lovely.

This is a very specific type of barbecue, super authentic to Hawaii. I enjoy it!

Make no mistake: this is not a health food-style place by any means (although they do offer a small low-cal menu). This is greasy, hearty fast food loaded with mayo and MSG - but it just totally hits the spot. 

I am partial to their spam musubi. It's large and extremely flavorful. You'll find off-the-wall (but common in Hawaii) items like the Loco Moco and Chicken Katsu. Unique flavors and certainly not everyday food, but a real treat every so often. 

L&L also makes some of the best malasadas I've ever had. A malasada is a large fried donut hole rolled in granulated sugar. Served warm, they are sinfully tasty and surprisingly affordable. 

If you're looking for a truly unique food journey, give this spot a go.

DO NOT GO HERE. This is the most unprofessional and careless spa I have ever been to. I sent someone here as a GIFT and repeatedly told them over the phone to charge the card on file and my guest went for their gift and had to pay due to the front desk having "no idea what he was talking about". Already a bad experience but I decided it was not a major error and mistakenly went back. For my ANNIVERSARY we booked couples massages to arrive and have them tell us there wasn't a room available and that another masseuse wouldn't stay 10 minutes to accommodate our SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT. Take your business somewhere where they give a shit is my advice. The lack of communication and thought in this establishment is beyond me.

If I could go to a negative number on the stars, I would. On three separate occasions, I have called to get take out and was informed by, usually by a girl on the phone that sounds about 16, that they are too busy to take a take out order and to call back after 8pm. It's 6pm. She said she might be able to get us a pizza in an hour. 

Don't bother with this yuppy place.

A great little neighborhood spot for ice cream and food. Very clean, very friendly staff and most importantly, very tasty. I had the cheeseburger and fries and a small ice cream. I had with me my 2 year old with me who likes only McDonald's French fries, she loved the ones here. The burger is awesome and can't be beat for the price. 
I'll definitely be back and next time with the whole family (5 kids.) I'll give my money to a good family owned joint over a chain any day. This place makes that an easy choice.

Coming from California, we love our Pho! Maybe we came on the wrong day or time. Waited for about 15 minutes for someone to come over to give us a menu. The place was bustling with people and after a few minutes of waiting, realized that they were also other people before us who were waiting for their food. We finally had our meal served after 35 minutes of waiting. I had the chicken pho, the soup was good but on a slightly salty side. We had an order of beef pho and shrimp rolls too which was pretty decent. The lady who took and served our orders was graceful and apologized for the wait. For future perhaps, the restaurant can inform the customers before hand when they arrive of the waiting time so they know what to expect.

Stayed here with friends... what's with the the dark wood theme EVERYWHERE? it's kind of depressing in there. The joke of the weekend became, "I wanna slit my wrists staying here." The decor is dark and dreary! The rooms (though modernly appointed with flat screen tvs and granite countertops) is bleak and cheerless.  One accent wall is a deep, deep brown almost black color and the opposite walls are almost just as dark. The carpet is a dark brown as is the chocolate colored sectional in the other half of the room. Thankfully the bed was comfy and the pillows were extra fluffy.

Looks like they are remodeling the casino floor which is good. But what they really need to work on is the arcade of shops (a country wear store, Georgiou - your Mom's clothing store), fast food (Port of Subs, Round Table Pizza, and an ice cream shop) , game area for kids, and movie theater ($3 tickets - not bad for second run movies).  
It's in desperate need of an overhaul. It's a bit cheesy and very 1980s down there. Perhaps it's on the list for a facelift, but just not soon enough.  We didn't have a car so we were kind of held captive there, and for it being a "grand resort," we didn't feel like there was much to do.

Their pool area,. "The Beach," appears to have that fun, more adult, Miami feel to it with red cabanas and tiki torches. But it's open for use to not only guests but KOA campers. I mean the overall look is chic and upscale but just didn't match the numerous children and families running rampant in the area.

I have to give it an additional star for being pet friendly. Overall it was an okay place to stay for Reno standards.  But for ambience and things to do, it definitely wouldn't be my first choice in Reno.

FANTASTIC food!! Massive problems with service. First, the hostess was sick and coughing everywhere. Sadly she is also who sets the tables with glasses and silverware. We watched her cough, wipe her nose and play with her hair (all with her hands) and then set tables INCLUDING putting her fingers inside cups as she placed on the tables. Our server was super slow and seemed uninterested in timely service. I wish I could give food 5Stars and staff 0 stars.

Absolutely love the atmosphere here .. everyone I have seen is very friendly. Genie and Marianna are the best ! I have only seen those two estheticians for my lashes but have no doubt that the rest of the girls are great . The only reason I have for not giving 5 stars is because it is a very small place and parking is in the back . The lashes are great as well . They listen to what you are looking for .. they offer mink silk and synthetic. They are reasonably priced for the location they are at

This hotel is not far from the airport. Cab ride cost me $15, plus tip. The concierge personnel is welcoming and professional. The rooms are very clean, especially the bathroom (including shower wall). I was really impressed. The decor is contemporary and comfortable. Beautiful indoor pool and decent sized gym are available. Coffee pot and coffee is provided without incurring additional charges. Restaurant in the hotel (Fresh Bites) has pleasant servers. It has TV screens all throughout and looks like a contemporary sports bar.  In addition the food is good and the serving size is good enough for two people. Excellent prices!

I am traveling on business but will definitely stay here again on my personal dime.
I generally come here instead of Tony Luke's if I am at CBP. The chicken cheesesteak and regular cheesesteak are also great!

Linh is not only an amazing person but she is fantastic at what she does. The people who work for her are exceptionally trained and talented at what they do to make you feel beautiful!
Beauty co is my go to for lashes, powder dip brows, and now my hair!

I travel a lot for work and come to Indianapolis often and this is one of my favorite places i travel to for work. 

Every time I have gone the staff if happy and cheerful and seem to enjoy their job which make the experience enjoyable and makes me want to come back again (which i do.. A LOT)

yesterday came in and the girl working behind the counter made a recommendation on the sweet beet and i said sure.. it turned out to make the drink that much better!!! 

pineapple + sweet beet = awesooooome

Poor service!
Came in in for an oil change and tire rotation, I had an appointment, half an hour to get my car in. Over an hour later, finally had the oil change, but forgot to rotate the tires. Another half an hour to complete.

Stopped in for lunch today around 2 PM during a visit from Chicago. Cute place but the service was pretty poor. Our server was not very helpful. When asked if we could split an order of the potato pancakes, he flat out said, "no" and later explained that their fryer was not working. He also stated that we were lucky to get the last of the fries with our sandwiches! The food itself was okay but not really memorable at all. Also, when my friend asked to order a milkshake at the counter, the clerk again said "No. Sorry. I just closed out my cash drawer. I'm really sorry!" Other employees had their coats and bags on looking like they couldn't wait to leave. Does this place really want to sell food??? Seems questionable to me... Overall, pretty disappointing. :(

We've been to Zavino many times.  The flat bread pizza is wonderful.  They also do a great job of pairing wine and small cheese plates, if so desired.  I am also in love with their Caprese Salad, when it's on the menu.  

The place is small.  Because it's so good and located on the best part of 13th street, it can get packed; especially on the weekends.  I don't think this is worth complaining about.  Personally, I think the best place to sit is at the bar at Zavino.  The bartenders are very friendly.

The kind of energy found on that section of 13th street is just what the city needs.

I've never had anything but great service and great (albiet high priced, but it -is- the French Quarter) food at the extremely pink Petunias. Crepes the size of puppies. A relief to find a gay-owned & friendly restaurant after two weeks travelling in the South. Cute little building, typically crowded so try for off-hours. Also, apropos of nothing, it has a kind of Lovecraftian bathroom -- it's perfectly clean and functional, but the angles are subtlely wrong and of no human shape.

For some reason. likely the great responsivenes and service, this is the primary taxicab company that I use whenever I am staying in Philly, and the ONLY one that I ever call whenever I need to call for a taxi via telephone. 

This company has NEVER let me down, and has never failed to send a cab in a timely fashion, no matter where I call from in Philly. On the other hand, a good number of the other cab companies have failed to fulfill my pickup calls in the past, which is what has led me to using All City Taxi exclusively when I need to call a cab! 

In fact, I have memorized their phone number, so that whenever I am in Philly and need a cab, I know their number off the top of my head!

BTW, I have always had great drivers with this company -- never a single problem with any driver!

I love cannolis, so please take this review with a grain of salt. With that being said, I thought this place was great. If memory serves me right, I thought these cannolis were on par with the stuff you would get from the North End in Boston and also comparable to the stuff that you can get from various Italian bakeries in NYC. I loved that they had numerous types of cannolis available.
 
Worth a stop if you happen to be near Pat's or Geno's to gap off your grease-tastic Cheesesteak meal. Or, ya know, if you are just have a hankering for a cannoli.

Have been at this location a couple times 
There is no leadership at this location and it shows. 
Sicklerville location is better. 
What a shame.
Cheese comes out Luke warm

I have been searching for a legit pho place since I moved to Indiana.... took 2 years but I finally found my bowl of heaven.  Funny thing is they moved right into the exact same place my favorite Korean restaurant used to be!  Cafe Korea has moved elsewhere.  Legit Pho makes me miss the comforts of city life a little less. I miss great food!  Thank you for opening up your kitchen to us! I pretty much live there.  !!!!  And I'm not a foodie or anything but I'm sure picky as heck about my food.
This place is great! Very clean, thorough and they take their time and never rush. They also give you a great back massage. I would definitely come back here and recommend to others.

First time here. Boyfriend and I went on Taco Tuesday and we got the shrimp tacos, and they were awesome. Food came out fast. Emilio, our server, was a little lacking. He took a while to get our drink order, water delivered, and our order taken. Had two different servers ask if we were helped already. He also didn't let us know the shrimp tacos were not $2.50. I am a server myself, and I was not satisfied. A+ on the food though.
i honestly felt it was a bit too expensive for what they were offering, nails seems to lift a bit under a 10 days

This place is my go to in NOLO for seafood!  Why value, price, consistency wont break the budget huge portion sizes. Good atmosphere and great service!! If you like good food at a good price this place is for you.

I would give 10 stars if I could! Erica is the absolute BEST! When I first came to see her, my hair was a really yellow, golden blond  and I wasn't very happy with it. I've been seeing her for a year now and my hair looks completely different.. the formula she uses for my highlights is the PERFECT color for me and my hair looks AMAZING. She managed to get it to a beautiful, brassier shade of blond and I couldn't be happier!

Erica is incredibly knowledgeable and has a great, upbeat personality. I always have so much fun talking to her when I go there. Everyone is friendly and extremely polite--and of course, I love how they always offer me a glass of wine. ;)

If you're looking for a reasonably priced, conveniently located salon with very professional and friendly people--no need to look any further! By far, the best stylist in SF!

Ok now if they had an entrance not inside the casino where all the cigarette smoke is it would be amazing 
I had the Kobe Filet and my wife had the grouper Oscar, salads and an escargot app. 
Let's say I was taken a back his perfect everything was!
So pleasant to see true top end dinning. 
Yes so with top end comes price tag and it's worth every penny!

The BEST Chicago style pizza in the area. Also, their house salad is better than every other Italian restaurant in STL. SO good. I recommend the bacon and mushroom Chicago style pizza. You won't regret it.
Excellent food! Great atmosphere.

There name is Medexpress right?  Well, nothing express about this place at all.  They only have 1 doc on duty and lobby filled with patients.   You have to wait at lobby and then more waiting at the actually room.     This place needs to change its name to slowexpress.
So tasty, I try to go every time I'm in St. Pete. I love the Udon Noodles! Location is great too, super walkable.

Came in for a mobile order. Girl at the counter says "we'll be right with you." Waited a while for seemingly no reason as my order was already waiting for me. Received it and the next girl to help me was lowkey rude. I get home and my food is upside down thrown around in the box. The food was not bad, but not worth it.

We order from here from work regularly. Until recently, there has not been a problem with delivery times, cold food, etc. I will not be ordering from here any more, which bums me out! I love the pizza, but if it is delivered cold...why bother. Today I just threw my order out because it was soggy, cold and greasy. This establishment has lost my business. I will stick with Mixed Grill.
Update*** A coworker requested this for her Birthday lunch. I ordered a BBQ Chicken Pizza - SM at 10:30 am. I received an extra small pizza with cheese and chicken...no BBQ Sauce...no sauce at all! There was no garlic butter sauce as requested. The order was delivered 2 hours later at 12:35 pm. As you can imagine, it was ice cold. I work for an establishment that typically would provide a VERY large order weekly to Sicilians. I can guarantee that they have lost that business for good.

This restaurant was absolutely delicious and the most authentic Mexican restaurant I've been to around here. I loved service , the menu, the dishes were made with fresh and high quality ingredients. the waitress Janet and her sister Ana the chef did an amazing job with making us feel welcome and making the tastiest food. I highly recommend this restaurant I guarantee you will enjoy it.

Freaking love this place! I love how amazing this place. As previous reviews have stated, this location is small. It sits in a small house next to Home Depot. They have the best tacos in the city in my option. 

When I used to eat, I had their chicken and steak and it was great! But my jam going forward is there fish tacos. I get them non-supreme with just cilantro and onion with some lime and man on man are they so goodddddddd. They also give you a verde and hot salsa and the hot salsa is hot but has the right amount of kick. The tacos are $2.75 and I order about 3 on corn tortilla and they hit the spot just right. The fish seems marinated in something and lightly grilled. With a fruit punch Jarritos..... 4 thumbs up! 

I also ordered the guacamole which needed some salt to my liking but my aintie loved it. I would not order it again but it was good though and they give you a lot! for $5. They do not  have chips and queso which seems like a huge bummer if you like a crunch to your meals like me but everything else will not disappoint.

As a vegetarian...and at this point your asking, "why is he reviewing a BBQ joint"...let me tell you. As a vegetarian it took me a while to have an excuse to venture into the haven of meat and smoked flavor. First off it's in my neck of the woods. Second off, their bar offerings intrigued me. We interacted with three different servers while we were there one afternoon. All were extremely helpful. Our primary waitress steered me to an amazing Utah Rye. Later I enjoyed a flight of some of my favorite local brews. Food-wise I had my fill of sides: fresh cut chips, fried green tomatoes, cornbread, sweet potato casserole, cheddar grits and corn casserole. Lots of goodness without having to touch any meat.

The couch tomato bistro was......Something. Something unordinary while also extra ordinary. The service was bluhhh at the start but like the Batman trilogy (Christopher Nolan's of course) it grew as time went on. The food was as the millennials say "lit lit". Overall ambience was okay. Lot of of menus and plates dropped. Tough look but I regress my comments. It's a team game and mistakes happen. Overall score 4.23/5

I would have given it five stars but had to wait twenty minutes for a call in order.
Chicken is really good..parking is not..servers are awesome.

I tried Olive Garden's "take one" special with the curbside service. I was so impressed with my experience!
I order my dinner on line and even included a bottle of wine. I pulled up 5 minutes ahead of my requested time and was immediately greeted by someone. Without opening my window, I showed my order number and popped open my trunk.
Within several minutes, my food was in my trunk.
My husband  soup, breadsticks and chicken parm and I had the pasta. It was delicious!
Where can you find dinner for 2 for $12.99?? Oh and in the bag were chocolate mints. 
Go there. You won't be disappointed!

One wonders how places like Subway stay in business when it's apparently possible to make a decent living making sandwiches like these for the same price or less.

I found the "salami and sharp" (i.e. sharp provolone) on a hoagie roll completely satisfying in all respects and all the add-ins (lettuce, tomato, banana peppers) etc. tasted very fresh.  It was $5.50 and I was filled from just eating half of it.

I don't know if I'd say this is "the best hoagie ever." I don't usually eat hoagies, and owing to the fact that I don't eat beef I never eat cheesesteaks and therefore can't comment on their apparent cheesesteak prowess.  But it's a great neighborhood place.

Small Indian restaurant with 4-5 tables and supposedly massive amounts of take-out orders that result in extremely long wait times.  I called in two orders of Chicken Tikka Masala ($6.99), one order of rice ($2.99), and a garlic naan bread ($1.99), and they told me the wait time would be 45 minutes.  When I arrived approximately 45 minutes later I probably waited another 10 minutes before my order was ready.  So not sure if dining in will result in a better wait time (hopefully it does), but if you want to take it home, make sure to call ahead!  Prices are in the more affordable range, and reflect single serving sizes.  It's important to note that the orders of curry or kabobs do NOT come with any rice, naan, or other carbohydrate, so you'll have to have separate orders or cook it yourself.  On the bright side, one order of rice can work with two orders of the Chicken Tikka Masala so yay for that.  Taste-wise everything is pretty good, definitely worth a solid 4 stars.  Tikka Masala is packed with flavor and they are very generous with the amount of chicken they give (not very generous with the vegetables though).  However, the reason why I gave this place 3 stars is because my god the Chicken Tikka Masala was absurdly oily.  Tasted great for sure, but that layer of oil on top is going to cost me (or my bowels) greatly later.

The square pizza is the second best I have ever had (close second to L&B Spumoni Gardens in Brooklyn). The problem was it took forever to come and then was blamed on computer error. The friendly server (rocking an amazing Philly accent) did not charge for sodas so was not too bad. Also, it was mad cheap. A great place to go.
