They were on time with the appointment, and fixed the problem quickly. The service tech kept me informed during the job. I would definitely use them again.
Don't go here if you can help it. The wraps they serve are the smallest wraps I've ever purchased. Definitely not worth 6.99.

Welp, I don't have to travel to Mexico for good tacos anymore! Hahaha! This place has some of the best tacos/quesadillas in Tucson. It's a small inconspicuous place hidden right behind a Circle K. I had some al pastor tacos, and they were delicious. Other places normally make the pork really greasy, but these al pastor were not greasy at all. I also had some carne asada tacos that were tender, smokey, and well seasoned. 

I was enjoying the food so much I ordered a chicken, bacon, and green chili quesadilla (the special of the day) that was gooey, metly, savory, and creamy goodness. That came with a small bean taco that had hits of chorizo. At this point, I was in a food coma.

They also seem to either make their own tortillas or they have them made especially for them. We bought a dozen of the flour tortillas, and they were gone two days later. So, overall great place!

Went on a Saturday night and it was packed! They found us a table for 6 pretty quickly but it was outside (in the middle of Florida summer). The doors were open so it wasn't unbearable. The service wasn't great. After 5 minutes a waitress came over to ask if someone had taken our drink orders.... No one had, so she did. It seemed like maybe we weren't her table which was pretty evident the rest of the meal with trying to get drink refills, etc. BUT, they have a secret vegan menu!! I was so excited. Just ask your waiter. Lots of options and modifications to menu items create about 10 vegan dishes. I had the tofu lettuce wraps (delicious), jicama salad (bland), spicy green beans (yummy), and a noodle dish (average). Everyone else at my table seemed to enjoy their meals. So overall the food is pretty good and the service could be better, but I love that they have vegan options at the ready!

I visited this restaurant for lunch and sat at the bar. The service was good, it wasn't too crowded. I ordered the prime rib sandwich, it was delicious. It was served on high quality bread, the meat was tender and not too fatty, and the cheese, onions, and horseradish added great flavor. It was also served with some potato wedges. The only thing that might have added to the meal would have been a side of au jus. It was a bit pricey, after a soda and tip, the total was around $17. Still, I'd go back in a heartbeat.

Omg this is the best place for breakfast that I have ever tasted. Everything is done to perfection. The beignet bites omg amazing...... I had to take 2 orders to go. You will not be disappointed. I also had the make your own omelette and the home fries are so tasty. Will keep coming back when I'm in the area.
So disappointed that they discontinued their "premium toppers" section of the salad bar.  If you are going to take away such an important part of the meal you should lower the price a bit.  Boo!
Great burgers and the buffalo chicken toasted ravioli OMG so freaking good. Definitely worth the visit.

Visit 2/27/17

Took notes from experience NOLA tourist and every time Napolean House Gumbo was mentioned. 
They have more then mouth watering Gumbo. The rustic atmosphere, the 18th century artwork, the dim lights and the outdoor patio creates a very intimate setting.  
The Englishman's Pimm drink is refreshing for the hot southern sun, and decently priced as well.  ;-)
Besides the d-lish seafood gumbo, the house specialty- Italian Muffuletta is what I would consider an elevated comfort food. 
Our server, Bobbie (I believe) went above and beyond. She was welcoming, friendly and outgoing. Provided great suggestions from the menu to sight seeing. 

This is one place I would go back to in a heartbeat.

I brought my Gretsch 5120 to Mike Virok's Bordentown Guitar Rescue. I had bought the guitar used and there was a pick up modification that was done that was a bit funky by the previous owner. Mike set up the guitar and changed the pickups to Gretsch Blacktop Filtertrons. 

The shop is very nice and Bordentown is a cool little town. It is not really that far from Cherry Hill either. What impressed me most about Mike was that he recognized the odd pick up mod immediately and also the two other Gretsch upgrades the previous owner had made. He also told me the turn around time would be 3 days! I hated it when I visited other luthiers closer by where I live and saw a ton of guitars and then they tell you 2-3 weeks and take 4 weeks. Why such a back up? No with Bordentown Guitar Rescue.

His prices were fair, and my guitar looked and plays really great now. The action and truss rod were corrected and as Mike said, "It looks the way a Gretsch is supposed to look." I will be bringing my Tele up shortly to get some buzzing frets corrected. I was really happy with Bordentown Guitar Rescue and I would absolutely recommend them.
food is good but too expensive and the service isn't that great, waiters act like its a funeral and are quite indifferent

Delicious!! Ordered the Maggie's breakfast sandwich, it was amazing. The staff is super friendly. The place is amazingly clean! I don't live in Reno, but when I come back, I'll be coming here again! Thank you!!

Sooooo...had breakfast here at 10:30 am on Sunday and it wasn't bad.  So we call our friends at the hotel across the street who show up at 10:40 am.
The girl at the counter said breakfast is over!!!???

Breakfast ends at 10:40 am on sundays??

Seems crazy.
Tried the off duty as well despite being unsure how smushed donuts would taste. The coffee/donut combination really did the trick!

I was at Branzino's last night for RW with my bf. I always check yelp for reviews and I'm happy to have selected this particular restaurant for dinner last night. Not only is the food impeccably delicious, but this place is also a byob. We were seated immediately upon arrival, even though the place was packed. Our waitress was very well informed and very professional. She took her job  very seriously and was very good at it. To add to it, she had a very cute accent which made the dishes she was describing us even more delicious. I have honestly never had such great service before. We decided to make this place "our spot" and plan on going there weekly!! 
Must try!!

Staff was great and so was the food. I had the oysters on the half shell which came with two really great toppings. I also had the sandwich of the day which was an open-faced salmon cake with a mango salsa topping. It was great!

I don't know if it's just me but, I had the worst meal I ever had in my entire life at this place. I went with my family who told me this place had good food. I'm starting to question my family for putting me through  such an awful culinary experience. They suggested menu items to me and ordered what sounded good. I tried everyone's food and to be honest it was all awful. Everything tasted awful. I had the grape leaves they were awful, had the falafel and that tasted like a deep fried sand castle and fro dinner I had the shawarma platter and it was disgusting. I never in my life sent a meal back at a restaurant but this was almost the first time. It would of been insulting to send back that many things so I kept my mouth shut mainly because I was fighting the urge to not to vomit.

Cool place, parking was a nightmare.  

Some good product and interesting possibilities. 

Great service by Julia. 

Multiple items (pretzel stimboli and my bean burger) tasted pretty good but were just barely warm or even just cool in the middle and sadly very poorly under cooked.  

Disappointing.

This is the worst take out I posted a pic of gelatinous pieces of slime I pulled from the beef with broccoli.  Odd shaped beef pieces that were gray in color.  The overall taste was bland .  I was going out on a limb to try a new delivery since South Philadelphia has so many lackluster places for Chinese take out.  The food did arrive steaming hot which was the one star.   Kung pao chicken appeared white but was chewy and fake tasting.  Definitely not identifiably chicken.

This is the third time we've ordered from Whiskey Wings in Oldsmar, and every time the food has either been overcooked, dry, and/or flat out cold. And, the Manager Vickie, has been very rude. I was waiting to pick up the to-go order, she saw me waiting, but continued to talk with the guys up at the bar (inside). Then, she brings the bag of food over drops it on the table I'm standing by and leaves. No "Thank-you for your order", nothing?!! What's happened to good ole customer service?!

I move back to Clearwater in 2013... this was the first place that I ordered takeout from to be delivered to my condo... They told me would take 40 minutes to get my order......It took exactly fifteen minutes and the food was so hot ... TEMPERATURE WISE... I had to wait 10 minutes to eat it....on the VERY RARE occasion that I have had EVER had to wait as much as 30 minutes  which was only twice (I order from here OFTEN....which is the longest I've ever had to wait BTW).... I have NEVER - EVER had a COLD or BAD meal from this place..... I have never been happier with a Chinese restaurant their food is awesome their service is great. Their delivery guy is really SUPER nice & EXTREMELY FAST...... I would never order Asian food from anywhere else. 5 stars ALL THE WAY!!!!!!! WOK OUT....... YOU FREAKING ROCK...... THANK YOU!!!!

2nd time ordering. First time we had a calzone and it was good. Tonight ordered a HALF calzone, but was charged for a full ($16), a chicken philly and cheesy garlic bread. 

The calzone was doughy and undercooked, and I could of easily made better bread at home. There was not a hint of garlic to be found. It was just some plain Cuban bread with some melted cheese on it. The philly was good, though. Overall really disappointed. Won't be ordering again.

Wonderfully instructed class this morning taught by an inspiring teacher! Im an out of towner who felt very at home in this heated Vinyasa class. The instructor had a great pace, kickass playlist & a super star attitude! I got bendy & sweaty all before 9:45am. Loved this class & will be back next time I'm in Indy.

Ok since is close to EagleCeek airport where our Commander ship getting maintenance. Had to pull bed away from wall to have bedside charger access. TV not working so front desk girl says 30minutes for fixer person to come help. Internet seems good as is iron and board and other amenities. Pillows...yuk. Filled with junk of something out of distant past.

So good!! Authentic southern Louisiana food. Got the Jimmy J's trio, red beans and rice, chicken and sausage gumbo and crawfish and shrimp etouffee, was amazing. 
The place is really small so you do have to wait for a table most of the time but it is worth the wait.
The waitresses were great even though they were busy the entire time.

Line painstakenly slow....being a loyal SB customer since Seattle shop first opened, you expect a standard level of service.  Like a hello, employees not shuffling around like they were out all night - a pep in your step people.   One barista was actually making my Americano and on her cell phone with her HEAD resting on the milk frother.   Bye PHL - get with the program.

It was only OK , the food is good, the staff seems as though they are doing you a favor. Not very friendly and a bit stuck on themselves kinda strange since we a eating at their place of business. I go for the food sometimes for breakfast but the food has been too greasy the last two times there. Time to try some other places.

I got my hair cut and colored here this week. Caroline was great - she listened to what I wanted and also had some fabulous ideas for perking up my tired hairstyle. I was really happy with how it turned out. She gives a fantastic neck massage when she shampoos your hair too. The atmosphere is nice with lots of cute retro touches. And they use all Bumble and Bumble products. Definitely going back.

We stayed here at the hotel and the dining room was a convenient place to eat. I knew it was a Yelp three star but how could that be.  This is a fantastic location and it's easy to be a critic but I think three woofs is about right. Maybe 3+  

Great atmosphere for sure and we liked the waiter; super friendly. However, the food was just ok and the wine list was really limited. Average at best and disappointing restaurant for a Belmond Hotel.
Fun trendy place ! They have great colorist ! Fun temp hair Coe stuff to of u just wanna try it out for a day or two

These donuts were unlike anything I've ever had before. The texture of the claimed 100 layers is similar to a croissant, but not exactly. I bought two donuts that were recommended as being top sellers. I got the maple glazed and vanilla cream. They were both very, very rich and I will admit I could only eat a few bites of the maple and one bite of the vanilla cream over the course of two hours. So sugary and rich! Out of these two, the maple was by far my favorite. I was surprised to find that it also had vanilla cream inside. The vanilla icing/cream both in and outside of that donut was just too overwhelmingly sweet for me. This was like a mix of a croissant, funnel cake, and vanilla mousse. This would be a really fun place to visit with friends and buy several different flavors, cut into tiny little bites and try several. The prices were pretty high for donuts at $4.50 each. I was not disappointed and glad I went, but I couldn't handle all of the sugary goodness!

Parking was iffy.. So Michael was my server he kept the coffee filled but the coffee was really cold . ... I drink coffee any way so that didn't matter to me. Anyway I felt rushed.. I think I will come back with my entourage. But the food tasted good and everyone seemed friendly ... hey I from Ohio the neighborhood reminded me of Short North,Grandview, and Upper Arlington Ohio.. Hey Michael if you're in my neck of wood in Columbus Ohio... hit up those neighborhoods... only thing is that we don't have the beach lol
This place saved us as we got in last minute before the kitchen closed for our sons birthday. The food and service was great we will definitely e back.

Tried Ms. Tootsies with a Groupon that I had purchased.  After reading the articles that mentioned Ms. Tootsies as one of the best friend chicken spots in Philadelphia,  I was expecting a lot more.  Overall had a great experience but unfortunately the restaurant did not meet up to all the high expectations.  The fried chicken was tasty but the sides looked and tasted like they were just warmed up.  The mac and cheese was the biggest disappointment.  It was not cheesy at all.  One of the best parts to the meal was the cornbread and strawberry butter.  Drinks were a little overpriced.  And the red velvet cake was just okay.

The weather was perfect for outdoor seating! Sangria was plenty and tasty, food was amazing. (See photos) I did have to add some salt and hot sauce to the braised short ribs , but the tenderness was perfect! Will definitely go back again!

I'm reading these reviews and I disagree with the bad ones. If you liked most of everything except the rice, it shouldn't warrant one star. Okay, so on to my review. I've eaten here about 5 times. I usually get the nachos which I like very much. Today, I got a burrito. I had a choice of 4 kinds of tortillas which is nice. Also a good selection of beans, meats and vegetables. I don't find the upcharge on the guacamole to be too expensive and most other places also charge more for guacamole. When I got home and began to eat my burrito, everything was good, but the rice was kind of crunchy. I called and was told by a lovely young lady, Crystal, I could come in for a refund or another burrito. I chose to get another burrito, because I was hungry so I drove back. I was in line and asked for Crystal who greeted me with an apology and remade my burrito minus rice. I found everything to be neat and all the staff seemed very professional. They were all in uniform and every one of them used and changed gloves for each customer. Although the burrito was good, the five stars are mostly for the staff of great, young people! Keep up the good work, guys:)

Spent two nights the other day. 

Rooms were just ok and can use a good refresh. 

They NEVER pick up the phone when you call them. 

The main reason for the 1 Star was room service never came to clean or refresh the towels. I called, or rather tried calling, the front desk to get them to come but they never answered. 

Also parking is an astonishing $42 per night.

Great little brunch spot on the Main Street. Stopped here on the way to NYC. 

Small spot with 6 tables inside and 4 tables outside. Wish I had gotten a seat outside, weather was beautiful in September. 

Great cold brew and omelette. Potatoes that came with it were NOMS!

They are able to do egg white omelette as well

Liked the atmosphere here kind of a dive bar hometown feel. Decent selection of draft beer. We shared the Italian egg rolls. They were going okay. A lot of people around us were having the wings and they looked amazing.

Came here based on a recommendation from a colleague. This is a nutrition store/health food store with a cafe in the rear of the store. The cafe does have seating available for dining in. You walk up and order any of the food displayed in the fresh case or they have a salad bar, smoothies, burritos, bowls and acaci bowls. Any of the food in the display is fresh made and warmed so you can eat there. At first, appeal to the food was not there. Nothing really looked enticing but I chose the spinach quiche with some cilantro rice and black beans. I paid over $8 for my meal pictured which is a bit pricey for the amount of food. But all items are weighed for pricing of what you order. But I was impressed with the taste. The quiche was REALLY good and left me wanting more. My friend ordered the seafood burger with potato salad and Brussel sprouts. She said her burger was not that warm and the Brussel sprouts had too much ginger however she did really like her potato salad. I can say that I may be  back just for the quiche.

I came to this place for dinner with my family while on vacation. We heard of the place from Diners, Drive Ins, and Dives and thought we'd check it out. The server was very polite and even gave us recommendations for our meals. Our appetizers took a long time, almost 20 minutes, but man, it was worth it. The pulled pork nachos and shrimp & grits were amazing. Then our food came. I ordered a catfish dinner, it was easily some of the best catfish I EVER had. It came with a nice, tangy lemon tartar, complementing the fish really well. Stop here if you're in town and need some great food.

After checking in twice, I became the Yelp Duke of this place.  This gives me very little power, but does tell us that people do not check-in here very often.  It is not a Mac-hipster kind of place.  Equally, there are few power outlets, just enough to keep the place clean.  

This rings true, I have not seen people on their lap-tops in here.  It is more of a social vibe and all the better for it.  I do not get the impression that you would be unwelcome to bring that Mac, just that you would be alone in doing so.

I like that.

Food is good, coffee is good, as well covered in other reviews.

I am usually happy with their drive thru service. However, the last two times we have called in an order, both times I've come away with a chicken chimi enchilada style instead of bean chimi enchilada style. How do you confuse the two???? Just now, the lady working read back my order as chicken and I said no, suppose to be bean, read it again and assured me it was bean. Get home cut into it and it's chicken! I should have had her cut into it before I left, that's my fault. I'm done with this place. Food is good, drive thru service just has gotten bad.

Haven't even gotten half of our meal and I'm already not a fan. My husband ordered a poke bowl and it's been incredibly slow, which is surprising given the lack of line when we ordered. Also while waiting, I'm watching the chefs use their bare, non gloves fingers to sprinkle toppings on the bowl. I'm grossed out.

As for me, I ordered two hand rolls. Those came out quickly, but they are TINY with like hardly any fish inside of them. What a rip off!! I've attached pictures. I will not be coming back, I do not recommend.

Fantastic experience! From the service to the food, the evening was very special and memorable.

We definitely recommend the Red Pony Martini, BLT Ravioli & beef tenderloin; finish your dinner with a Good Night Rebecca martini and you'll have a big smile on your face when you leave!

I haven't written a review on this yet? I can't believe that seeing as how biting into one of their buttermilk drops makes me want to scream my love from the rooftops. I love, love, love this bakery. I can't tell you how many times I've gotten off from my overnight shift at the hotel only to head over here at exactly 6am to retrieve my sugar fix. The customer service is always superb and so are the delicious buttermilk drops. The doughnuts melt in your mouth. They aren't like some of those cakey ones that I'm not so fond of. The buttermilk drops, however, are exactly like biting into a cake that God baked himself. I was skeptical at first but now I am a believer. Try this place, you won't regret it; just don't go to much or you probably will.

We were a little hesitant to come to this restaurant since it's off the beaten path, but boy are we glad we did. The food and service were excellent. The food was so tasty and the owner/our waiter, Raul, was very accommodating and pleasant. The mole enchiladas are a must try. Honestly the best mole I have ever tasted. This is a must try restaurant and the next time we are in Reno, we will definitely be coming back.
Incredible. Sausage appetizer sooooo tasty. Skip spring roll. Pad Thai shrimp perfect. Wife got glass noodle dish. Everything fresh. Tasty. Great spot.
Their Burrito Mojado is awesome. The seasoning in the steak is so good. I highly recommended trying out this place.

Hoisting the hefty box off the counter at Pirate's, I couldn't help but wonder just what we'd gotten ourselves into. 

I'd seen photos online, but hadn't ever encountered one of these in real life. The box seemed to be bursting at the seams, barely containing what was inside. I was honestly afraid. These mythical beasts have a reputation for being large and in charge, and somewhat intimidating to most people, so we decided to leave it in the box until we got it home.

As it would turn out, all that build up was hardly necessary. What I thought was something dangerous turned out to be something to be admired and eaten! The box had a really heavy pizza inside, covered from edge to edge in copious amounts of ooey, gooey mozzarella, rich red sauce, very large pepperoni, and a towering crust! 

Turns out, as usual, the pics on Yelp don't lie. This pizza lived up to each and every one of them. That said, it could've been better. One easy fix is in this Pro-Tip: Ordering your pie well done is good move. It'll guarantee your pie is piping hot when you get it home and all that melty cheese will be nice and crusty on top, and melty beneath.

The reason for three stars here is that the crust:topping ratio seemed a bit off. The crust is delicious, but I think there's just a bit much of it. I realize this is something Pirate's is known for, so if you're a fan, this is my personal opinion.

Would I return to Pirate's? I think so. I'd like to put my well done theory to the test!

Nice place for some beers and live music. I have also tried pierogi, bacon cheeseburger, and mussels. Food was good overall. The mussels and flatbread came with four pieces of bread that didn't resemble what I was expecting as flat bread. I would describe it as lightly toasted, kind of soggy thin sliced Italian bread/baguette. Having said that we were happy to have some kind of bread to soak up the delicious sauce (White wine, garlic, lemon, butter, cream) The sauce is definitely richer than most of the white white / lemon/ garlic mussel sauces we have had but it was enjoyable. Service was friendly and fast.

Dr. Kwon and his staff provide the best possible dental experience. I usually dread going to the dentist, but they are so understanding, patient and personable. When not going for a routine cleaning, I always trust they will make the best treatment plan and can expect a gentle and pain free experience. During my last visit, Erika and Dr. Kwon put me at ease and were great to work with.

I just got back with a BESTEST HOT N READY PEP from this location on SR54 & Madison Ave.  I only live 2 miles away and got home to a barely warm pizza and the cheese is already hardening on top...terrible. Supposed to be hot n ready but they`re cold n hard...
Past few times now these pizzas have been terrible and nothing like the ads.  They will hand you this terrible pizza every time, why don`t they care what they hand you. You go home only to be pissed off they just robbed me!

Carlos makes the best Bloody Mary's!! (Vegetable infused!). Beer selection was great too!!  As tourists from Missouri - just stopped in for a quick beer to go and left several hours (and beers/drinks later)!  Such a great time hanging out!  Thanks Carlos from Mark, Kelly, Lisa and Eric!  Highly recommend this place!

I just had a massage with Jon and felt it necessary to leave a review right away. He was fantastic! The massage was beneficial for my "trouble" spots but also relaxing. The space was clean, comfortable and relaxed. I will be back for another very soon.

I would stay here again since our room was large and it was in a convenient location.  However, it was a bit dirty, and housekeeping did not refresh any soap, towels, coffee or shampoo unless you called down to request it (which we had to do every day).  Still, they were nice about it, and the hotel has a lot of great conveniences.  Excellent gym if your'e into that.  Overall, it wasn't the best hotel but it was still a pretty good experience.

I love this store. It doesn't look like much... Bit I love to go here after I workout and just take an hour shopping around. They have all their clothes sorted by size wish makes it easier to hunt and type (sleeveless, blouses, shorts, pants,etc). I bought a Christmas tree that was 8.5 feet tall and pre lit for 14.95 last Christmas..I was so excited like they made a mistake.. I took it home sure that it wouldn't light up bit I didn't care, for 15 bucks I would have string my own. Turned our they all worked! I've found all kinds of misc greens like a coat rack for a buck.. Shirts for 2...I could go on and on. Furniture is a hit and miss. Got to check it out
Was actually impressed by this hotel.  Staff was extremely friendly, place was clean, and food at social hour on Tuesday wasn't terrible.  Breakfast food was just ok but still impressed by the place.

If you have ever been to salt and straw - you would know how exciting it to have bright ice in st Pete! It has very similar unique flavors that work amazingly well together!!

Their staff was friendly and helpful - not to mention, wearing mask and adhering to the 6 feet rule!

Tried the caramelized bananas with honey & Pb  and the roasted strawberry with brown sugar / balsamic ! Both were so yummy!!

Great outdoor seating, what a gem!

There are a couple of nice people working at this store but for the most part the attitude towards customer service can best be described as indifferent. They rarely have enough people working so there are times when you are there on a random Saturday night - like I was last night - where there is one person checking people out and 20 plus people in line. Moreover the selection isn't great either. The stores in Whitemarsh and Chestnut Hill have much better selection (although even then not nearly as good as you can get in NJ). I wish I could say I won't go back given that I have spent so many frustrating times in this store but because it's my local store I am sure I will go back.
Great spot to grab some coffee and hang out. Really nice staff that makes the coffee fresh on the spot. They roast their own stuff which is great. I got their cold brew and it was good.

My Dr. Sutton is in the process of moving his practice here.  I have been with him for 10 years.  Great guy, had a great staff.  Never any surprise costs.  I call Dr. Sutton and the message said he is moving to Nevada Vision Group and to call them.  So I did.   I was having problems with my contact and my eye was irritated, so I was informed my appointment would be covered under my medical insurance as a medical visit.  Called on a Monday and they got me in on Thursday.  Dr. Sutton was not in that week so they put me with another doctor.  Confirmed my medical would cover this visit.  Great!  I get there on time, maybe a little early, and they check me in.  I wait about 20 minutes until called back, where I wait for another 30 minutes to be seen.  After my Dr. appointment, I go to check out and was told I need to pay the out of pocket cost because my medical insurance needed pre authorization.  I asked why didn't anyone let me know before I was seen?  Why didn't anyone get pre authorization?  No response just, please pay and we're sorry.  Anyhow, long story short, don't count on them to make sure your appointment is preauthorized otherwise you'll be paying out of pocket.  Pretty sure they would rather just bill you out of pocket then deal with getting your insurance pre authorized.  Wont be going back.   I'll miss you Dr. Sutton!!!

Went with my family.  Service was good.  The appetizer of the fried Calamari which is served with fried onions and red peppers was spectacular.  Only downside was the marinara sauce was, when we asked for spicy, quite a bit less than spicy.  We could tell no difference between that and the regular sauce.

The garlic knots were served heat hot.  Very tasty. 

@ members of my party ordered the Zuppa Di pesch.  Was good but uninspired, rather bland.  The appetizer portion of the mussels was bountiful, flavorful and nicely prepared.  The sausage and broccoli rabe was a disappointment.  The Rabe was mushy, and over cooked. The sausage had no life and was rather bland.

The cannoli for desert was good.  The shell was crisp, had a good texture and taste.  The filling was a bit overly sweet and the sugar was not incorporated to well as it had a grainy feel on the tongue.

The portions we ample, service was friendly and attentive.  I would go back again to try something different to see if it was an off night or to see if the things I ordered were not mastered well.

I've had their food twice, and they were pretty good! I like the laid-back ambience of the place and their wide open space. The menu is a bit too much, but that just means they offer whatever is imaginable. let's call it "variety." it's a good place to come with parents, kids, what have you, because the vibe is so chill. if you want good food and want to just relax, this is the place.
Everything is very good.  Overlooks/is-on-the beach,  comfortable seating,  good service,  good drinks,  good live music, good food.  I have been several times recently and I'm planning to back soon.

I had high expectations for TwoDeep but unfortunately it fell short on multiple fronts. I stopped in for the "pre party" prior to the colts/patriots game, and here are my thoughts...

Location/space: 4 stars. They have off street parking which is nice, especially downtown. The interior bar/lounge area is really nice. The bar is large and there are multiple couches set up throughout the brewery where small groups can have conversation. It's very clean, shiny, and new. Has a ton of potential. 

Service: 3 stars. There weren't more than 30 people in the bar when I arrived. It took a few minutes but one of the young bartenders came over to take my order. I told her that I'd never been to TwoDeep before. She suggested a flight and I went for it. Unfortunately, they were out of their IPA. Even more unfortunate was that the bartender didn't even know all of their beers (and there were only 7), and didn't tell me about their IBA which had been tapped a couple of days ago but had not been officially released. I overheard another bartender talking about it, so I ordered a small taste from her (and it ended up being the best), but I would have missed it had it not been for me being slightly nosey.  $8 for the flight of 5. 

Beer: 3 stars. This was the biggest disappointment. All of the beers were smooth and drinkable, but I felt like they were all flat. None of them had much of a head and carbonation was definitely lacking. The dunkel was probably my favorite along with the aforementioned IBA. The Scottish ale was again well reviewed on yelp, but I wouldn't go as far as ordering a growler of any of their beers. The Irish red was very mild. I opted out of the cream ale, so I can't comment on it. The stout was just ok, as were the other two. I really wanted to try to IPA, but they were out. Oh well. Again, all of their beers are drinkable, but I won't go out of my way to go back. 

For as competitive as the local brewing scene has become, I left kind of disappointed. I would put this place in the middle of the pack, along with Sun King, Tow Yard, etc. But below Flat 12, Fountain Square, and Triton.

We had a great time.  There was a wait so we sat at the bar.  Man those custom drinks were great. The area outside was the prime spot but we sat inside.  The food 5 star.  The service 5 star.  The vibe 5 star

This place is located across the street from the Galleria, on the east side to be exact. It is unassuming on the outside and a little dark but not bad. I will hit them with the negative now, this place needs a good dusting.
Now for the good: I was seated immediately and brought a water and a pot of tea, without even having to ask. That was unexpected but refreshing. The lunch menu comes with hot & sour soup, fried rice and an eggroll. I went with the beef udon noodles which cancels the rice, no biggie because it is filling.
The waitress was very friendly and knowledgeable.  All told, I got out of there for under $12 (not including tip).
Fast service, love the convenience of the drive thru. Guy working the window was sweet.

I don't know what kind of bimbo ass idiot is running this place, but FCK. I'm livid right now. Last week I came in to do the 1st time donor BS, it took 3 hours. 
And then as soon as I'm about to donate I tell them I shouldn't really do surgical tape bc it gives me a rash. They just happen to be unable to find the paper tape, so IVETTE tells me I can't donate until they get paper tape, if they do. Now at that point I was like oh my god I've been here 3 hours just do the surgical tape I literally couldn't give 2 sht's at this point. And now she says no I'm not allowed to use surgical tape unless I go to an allergist and have it cleared. You think I'm rich or something? My insurance doesn't cover that???? So Ivette then tells me to call back the next day and specifically ask for her to see if she will be able to order paper tape. So I called. And then called again the next day. The day after that. And the day after that. Left my phone number every single day and nothing. So finally I get out over to the supervisor. He says "oh we've had paper tape the whole time you can just come in and donate .... so I just call right now to make sure everything will be fine if I come try and donate and now I'm being told I have to redo the entire 1st time donor thing AGAIN if I want to donate. A whole nother 3 or more MFing hours. Like what the hell? Are you kidding me? This is actually ridiculous. Ivette should be held accountable for totally screwing me over. This is time out of MY life, not your lives. And it's just a waste. Literally the most absolute BS place, if you can go somewhere else, go somewhere else.

Ordered flowers for my wife's birthday.  I don't know much about flowers, so I put myself in their hands on what to get.  They just asked me about what I wanted to spend and they made it happen.  The bouquet was beautiful and my wife loved it!  Highly recommend!

Absolutely horrible!! If I'm going to wait an hour I would at least like my food hot. My fries were literally thrown in a plastic bag. I also received such an attitude after waiting patiently to place my order, the woman on the phone was very short and rude. Never again.

Like the food!  Came at 12:30 and there were so many people waiting, they had to stand outside. HOWEVER, from the hostess stand, I count 8 open (and clean) tables and 3 that need cleaned off. What. The. Heck. ???  Don't they understand how maddening that is??  Don't get it. Hostesses were too busy talking to care.

I can't recommend Lilies and Lavender enough. I wanted to use small local vendors for my wedding and knew that Lilies and Lavender, with their small sustainably managed farm, would be perfect for me. Though my wedding was in New Hope, I live in NYC. I was able to meet with Kate only once and knew from the first meeting that she really understood our style and vision. She lives on a beautiful little farm where she grows all of her flowers. 

After our meeting, she created a Pinterest board for my wedding where we both shared ideas and arrangements for the various aspects of the ceremony and reception. Kate is super creative and really knows her stuff. She came up with some gorgeous arrangements and beautifully incorporated the vintage vases that my mom collected. 

We planned to have our wedding entirely outside, but the weather had other plans for us :) Everything had to be moved inside of 2 barns. The day before the event, I spoke to Kate to go over the changes. I was initially worried about how everything would translate inside, but after talking with her I felt so much better. She was able to bring the outside in by totally transforming the barns into a magical and romantic floral wonderland. I have no doubt that Kate and her assistant worked incredibly hard that day and handled all of the changes with professionalism and grace. They even added some last second details, such as adding candles to the tables and brought in an awesome chandelier made from branches and flowers!
When I walked in to the space, I was truely overwhelmed. It was like a dream! 

If you are looking for a unique, local, artistic, Eco-friendly and absolutely beautiful florist experience, please go to Kate at Lilies and Lavender. Everything is seasonal (as it should be), so if you are looking for exotic tropicals or peonies in January, this is not the florist for you. The prices are completely reasonable and fair, and Kate will work with you to find options within your budget. 

Kate: I can't thank you enough for everything. You were incredible to work with and the flowers were simply breathtaking.
Off the plane, straight to Graze. Chickpea Bay cakes were unexpectedly good. Prompt service and great food!
Sushi is always excellent. Had to follow up on a takeout order I picked up that was missing 2 rolls.
I enjoy shopping at all Targets some are cleaner than others but it's a great place to shop. They stay up to date on fashionable priced items.
Christina does a great job!!  She is a pleasure to work with and goes above and beyond whats promised!  Give her a call the next time you need your home or office cleaned!

This place is fantastic!! They have the best happy hour in town. 4-6 every day of the week, most drinks are half off! They have the best seafood platter I've ever had! The environment is relaxed and trendy. Everything is so delicious on this menu. The burrata is so delicious!!! The service is also great. I highly recommend this place. They also share an outside bar with 86 West, which is amazing as well! If you're in Doylestown, definitely check this place out!

The ice cream is incredibly smooth and creamy.  I have never had anything like it and I highly recommend it.  Just be prepared for a wait due to the process but it is well worth it.  I had the Salted Dulce de Leche Custard and it was great.  Very sweet but with the salt it made it perfect.

The staff is very friendly. I love being able to get my dog socialization and exercise while I work. On the downside I think they need to screen their customers more closely. My rabies vaccination ran out two months ago and I was never asked for a new one. Also,my dog comes back with fleas after every trip. They are dieing from his meds but the sheer number of fleas that must be in there for any to survive all the way to my home boggles the mind. Also my dog was attacked by another dog and I was told that the attacker is a frequent offender. I don't think that a place that requires a behavior test to be admitted should treat a large aggressive dog biting another dog in the throat while he is being led from the cage as an offense worthy only of a time out. I suggest stricter behavioral standards and a mandatory capstar for all campers and boarders to avoid flea infestations.The staff and owner are very responsive to feedback and I will continue to use them.

It was my first time here after tons of my friends and family have been multiple times! The food was AMAZING! I like their pizza way better than their pastas. Their appetizers were amazing as well. I brought my own bottle of wine to pair with my food. Service wasn't terrible but wasn't amazing. Will for sure be back for some pizza and appetizers. 

I would skip dessert.

I am here to warn you.......this place didn't even earn one star, but I don't see a lesser choice on here. My mom doesn't like Mexican food so she ordered a burger. It was missing the mayo and there was no offer of catsup for the fries. Didn't even see the waiter for 10 minutes and then I had to flag him down. Also, there was little sauce on my enchilada. I finally found the waiter and asked for more sauce,  I was down to two bites left when the sauce arrived (and it was cold). We didn't get one drink refill and had the worst service EVER. 
When the check arrived I found he had charged me an extra buck for the enchilada sauce I didn't use. I complained to him and he argued with me about it, then said he didn't want to argue and left the extra charge on there. When I asked for the manager he said that he was the manager. I told him he really needs to work on his management skills. Do yourself a favor and X this off your list of places to eat in Green Valley........I did. I will never step foot in this place again.

We had an opportunity to go see Smokey Robinson at Conner Prairie with friends. We arrived and had a VIP parking pass. Since we arrived late we had to search for the area but soon found a very nice gentleman on a golf cart to assist us. The parking was easy as there were plenty of spaces. 

We made our way down to our table which was located front and center. Smokey was awesome, he did his thang! Lol. We were able to take food and drinks and enjoyed approximately an hour and 45 minutes with Smokey serenading us with his soulful voice. The music was clear and sounded great!  

There are different food and drink options available for purchase, but you can also bring your own. Lots of people were in the lawn area with their lawn chairs. 

Now getting out of the parking lot was a different story...it was a mess!  Once the concert ended we stuck around for a few minutes to socialize with friends.  After getting to our car to leave, we probably sat there for about an hour. 

Overall it was a great time and I can't wait to do it again!

I don't understand everyone's problem with this place? If you're an Indy local you know that this place is made for those who are visiting our fair city. 

I eat there on occasion, usually before a night at Howl at the moon. The food is a little on the pricey side but still good enough to eat. The fries need a little work but eh, it's edible and that's all we can ask for !

Would I ever do anything else there? Probably not. The gaming is too expensive, and bowling is too expensive. The games need to be updated and the bowling alley needs to be remodeled. 

Will those things cause me to not go back? NO! I love this place and I can't wait to go back.

I am a vegetarian, and Hunan Garden has the best General Tso's tofu and Szechuan tofu in town! The food and prices cannot be beat. I was sick of waiting 30+ minutes longer than the estimated wait time at another very popular Chinese take-out restaurant in town, so I decided to try Hunan Garden after spotting it in the shopping complex where KMart (RIP) used to be located. I go here every time I am craving Chinese food now, and I'm never let down. It is seriously delicious!

My Chrysler T & C driver window stopped working over the weekend. I found RJ, they took my van in right away the following Monday, and fixed it before lunch at what I thought was a very reasonable cost for what needed to be done. I look forward to having my cars taken care by them from now on.

It was late and most places had stopped serving food. We rolled into the place about 15 minutes before the kitchen was closing. Waiter came over and took care of us to get our orders. The food came out and was exactly what we needed and very good. Looked like a great place for drinks as well. I would deffinately go back!

It appears that we will need to take S&J to General Sessions Court, as the most recent attempt to contact them (Certified Letter via USPS) was REFUSED by S&J and they will not communicate. 

We have used S&J for several repairs on our vehicles, all with satisfactory results. However, there have been numerous issues with the most recent repair work that we had used S&J for our 2007 Chrysler Sebring, to which we are requesting an amicable resolution, as currently, because of the work done by S&J, the Sebring is currently unsafe to drive, as the Airbag System is non-functioning. 

S&J used an incorrect part (3x) for the blendor which is an incompatible part according to Nashville Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram. They also damaged the passenger airbag squibs under the passenger seat when they repaired the heater core. 

We took the vehicle back 3x. They simply cleared the airbag codes on the car and the blendor is still incorrect. 

We have attempted to resolve this with S&J, however, we are no longer confident in their ability to correctly repair the vehicle, and S&J and the owner Ramon Arellano are refusing to communicate and simply said "we will see you in court". 

I will update this as the process goes along, but at this time, the only resolution we are left with is to file suit in Davidson County General Sessions Court. We have also filed complaints with the Davidson County Better Business Bureau as well as the Tennessee Consumer Protection Agency.

I've been to this restaurant more than a few times, and it never disappoints. They have a fairly wide selection of meals. From salads to appetizers; pizza to full entrees. At my most recent visit, I decided to try one of their grilled paninis. I ordered the Angelo's panini. That particular panini includes broccoli rabe, roasted peppers, tomato, garlic & fresh mozzarella. I have to say, it was the most delicious panini that I've ever eaten. A definite . Oh, and the price was a bargain. 
On another note, the waiters/waitresses have always been top notch. They are polite, attentive & friendly. HG Wood Fired Pizza is a location that I keep on my radar when visiting the New Hope area.

We ate breakfast here while in Nola for the weekend. We got there early as we were told and set down right away, speedy service for drinks.  We arrived at 830 on a Saturday and before we got up in an hour the place was full. We each had a Bloody Mary. Tasty and made with Zing Zang mix. You can add bacon for $1. My wife got the banana fosters French toast and I got the seafood platter . The food was out in under 10 min. The French toast was enough for 2 people, and very very good. It came with Ice cream, fresh bananas, fresh cream, walnuts, fresh banana chips made in house, and sweet rum Sauce. This dish is made with French bread . The seafood platter had fried soft shell crab, shrimp, and oysters , this dish also comes is eggs Benedict. Everything was fresh and hot, I added hot sauce to it for more spice. It all went well together and having seafood as an option for breakfast was different.Nice place right next to Jackson square . Very nice bathrooms unlike some places in Nola. I recommend and we will be back for sure!

I loved the restaurant.   The atmosphere is great.   The dishes are well thought out.   However, everything was under seasoned.     Every dish needed salt, which made the food taste a little bland.    From the broths, to the dumplings, even the raw omakase.

I was excited at first to find a place so close to my department that sells my hometown cuisine, then I went there... and never went back. The food was a-okay, but I sure have higher standards when it comes to Northeastern cuisine. Dumplings were not juice enough and the dough is my biggest problem, I can't taste the made from scratch chewiness.

I tried 2 cupcakes with plain vanilla frosting and I was not blown away. The vanilla frosting was reeeeeaaallly plain and bland. I tried another cupcake from another cupcake shop that just moved in uptown and it was confirmed how boring and bland Bee Sweet's cupcakes were because the other place blew them out of the water.
Cute atmosphere, great French toast, okay frittata, dry potatoes, strong coffee, good bacon

I occasionally go to foundation coffee when I need to focus on work tasks without distraction. The atmosphere is super cozy and they have several tables with power outlets nearby. I'm a fan of flavored coffee, and their orange chocolate latte was divine. I also always order a chicken salad croissant, because they are super flavorful, and are served in a warm, flaky, toasted croissant. 

Hanging out in the back patio is also fun, because there's always a chance you get to make friends with chickens who decide to sit on the chair next to you. 

I definitely recommend this coffee shop when you happen to be in Ybor, or when you're looking for a quiet place to work.

I lived about 10 months and left last month. One word, I would never recommand this apartment. The apartment give you advantages about geographic, easy to access museum, few famous points to see in Philly.
However, there're worse nigtmares at apartment services.

When you decide to move in, you have to be cautious move-in check at every single points and left memo at inspection sheet. I was asked by Apartment to pay 695$ as a move out fee.
They didn't inform me when they performed pre-inspection. According to their manual, they have to explain to tenant if they found somethings wrong. They just sent invoice without explanation all of suprise as below.
100$ for cleaning floor, 150$ for cleaning carpet, wall scrufs 300$, blinder damage 120$ and trashes 50$. 
Where came from wall scruffs of 300$? There're few stickers and few mark pen which made by my 5 years old girl can be removed easily. Blinder were very weak when we move-in, we just neglected without mark up at the inspection sheet. We also requested three times to cleaning carpet upon move in, but they never cared and we gave up.

I can pay cleaning upon reasonable explanation how they calculate and why they didn't inform on pre-inspection. They didn't still reply and just kept insisting me to pay.
You have to very cautious they hide a lot when you move in. You will experience every day out of order elevator problem, inconvinient washer broken frequently. Moreover, maintenance is so bad.
Anyway, you have to prepare to pay when you move out. Parktowne has good system to take out money from farewell customer.

I cannot say enough about Rice Box Kitchen.  If you want Hot Pot then there is no 2nd choice.  It's small so you need reservations but it is worth the wait. The table is ready when you get there. The dipping sauces are amazing. They actually encourage you to eat until you are full. The owner is so nice and accommodating. It is the perfect experience here in Reno.  What a treat!!!

It was another very successful stay at Holiday Inn Express & Suites!!

HIE/S almost without exception provides great sleep quality for me.  Their beds are very comfortable, rooms are clean, and we have decent breakfast offerings.  Due to the current COVID-19 pandemic "recovery" situation, pancake machine is not still used.  Individually wrapped breakfast sandwiches, muffins and pastries, canned juices, milk and yogurt cups  are offered. Besides that, dry cereal, instant oatmeal, fresh fruit and juice from dispenser are also available. 

Staff are courteous and pleasant. Indoor pool was open, but we did not take advantage of it. They also have a small workout room. No longer requiring fac masks if you're fully vaccinated except when you're gathering your breakfast food items.

Loved this place!  Our server Victor was  extremely friendly and informative, which was great because I personally haven't been exposed to a ton of Indian food and was looking for recommemdations.  The food was all amazing- the Naan was 10/10, out of this world.  If you like Indian food you have to check this place out!

In Nashville visiting my daughter. What a great place!  Service and food were great.  Prices reasonable.  And near the restrooms are bowling lanes!!  The half Kale Caesar is enough to feed 2; fish & chips hot and crispy; great cheeseburger.

My wife and I went out to dinner Saturday night to the Wild Hare.  It was not crowded at all around 9pm when we arrived so we were happy to have no wait.  We were seated promptly and politely by our server Steven.  Steven was very helpful to let us know about the specials that night.  

We started out with the soup of the day, a tomato basil bisque.  The soup was delicious but a little on the luke warm side (still really enjoyed it).  Next for the main course we decided to split the beef tenderloin pizza.  Man, this was so good!  It had carmelized onions, cherry tomatoes, an olive oil / garlic butter base to it.  You can really taste that it had been cooked in a wood fire oven.  For dessert we split the famous peanut butter pie the server raved about.  It was too delicious, but thought it was a little over priced.

The Wild Hare is our kind of place.  No frills, just laid back atmosphere and great food.  The prices are very fair for menu selection and quality.  I highly recommend it.

The pub in Wegman's is simply a great place to go with friends for a bite. We ate here the Friday after Thanksgiving, following a movie in nearby Oaks. 

First of all, it's inexpensive. They pay their servers a "living wage" which means that you are not supposed to tip them. The beer and wine prices are very reasonable. I ordered a $6 glass of shiraz. The bar was out of shiraz, so our waitress brought back a small tasting glass of a different red wine. It was a fun way to recommend a different wine. The meals themselves ranged from $8 burgers to $16 entrees.

Secondly, it's kind of fun to peek out at a grocery store while you eat. I was focused on chatting with my friends, but if I was eating alone, I would have loved having the opportunity to plan out my grocery shopping trip while I ate my meal. 

Thirdly, the food is surprisingly good for a grocery store. We started with a few fried appetizers. The french fries were cooked with tarragon, served with a spicy ketchup and delicious. The other two appetizers, fried mozzarella and zucchini strings, were just okay. I recently changed to a vegetarian diet, and I ordered a veggie burger for my meal. It was homemade at the store with quinoa and millet, topped with a spicy sauce reminiscent of Indian fare, and sitting on top of a toasted whole wheat bun. It was delicious. The burgers and entrees are served with either the side salad of the day or the vegetable of the day. The side salad had onions, roasted peppers, feta and baby greens, and the vegetable of the day was kale cooked in coconut milk. I had the side salad and found the onions far too powerful for my palate. 

It's a great place, and would be my first choice for a meal after our next movie at the Regal in Oaks.

The Perfect Little Burger Spot In The Northeast. Please Be Aware, Fries And Onion Ring Orders Can Definitely Be Shared By 2! Although The Turkey Burger Is A Patty And Not Grounded Meat...It Is Still Deliciously Flavorful!!
My companion had the classic burger and I was a bit jealous. That burger, cooked to perfection, was nice and juicy. We sat outside and it was perfect, not too hot, not too cold. When Craving A Good Burger This Place Is The Answer!!

Wow!!! Amada is an absolutely amazing Tapas restaurant, as good as anything you might find in NYC but definitely at a cheaper price point.  For a $65 prix fixe, we had an insane amount of food and almost couldn't finish it (2 big guys).  You get 3 courses, with 4 tapas in each course.  Some of the highlights were:

- Canteloupe with Serrano Ham
- Ham Salad
- Lamb Meatballs with truffle oil
- Pork Croquettes on roasted red pepper mashed with almonds
- Grilled entrecote with goat cheese mousse and quince sauce
- Lamb Chops

The menu was pork heavy because we had someone who could not eat seafood.  I would love to come back here again and try some of the seafood dishes on the menu.  

Also, if you're at the bar before your meal, definitely try the Apricot Rye Manhattan.  I'm not a huge fan of Manhattans, but this was so well-balanced.  I would love to come back here and try some of their other drinks.

I've been using Dry Clean spot for the better part of the past two years now. I used to swear by using the place, but of late I wonder why I even bother. When I first started going here it was dirt cheap to have my work uniform cleaned. I mean sub $8 to have three items looking fresh again. Now it's over $10 to have it all cleaned. I've noticed the change in people and possibly ownership over time, but hey when it's cheap and good you tend to stick with it. Service is always been good, save for a shirt that wasn't done when I needed it and no one knew where it went. Apparently it went out for stain removal and no one bothered to say anything. Messy eater and gyros while drinking sounded like a great idea at the time but I digress. Lately the place has changed. More new people seems like every other week. Walking in and getting a strong smell of cigarette smoke isn't want ya want to smell in a dry cleaners. Again, let it slide. But this last trip killed it for me. Upon drop of my pants had a bit of animal hair on them. I was told that I had to pay extra for them to clean it. Seriously? That's never been an issue before and I've brought em in worse shape before. And it wasn't like a nice "ooh sorry, cause there's hair on here, we're gonna charge you extra". It was a rude yeah "tough, we're charging you" explanation. Annoyed at the obvious attitude I was given cause I interrupted you doing squat tone I said whatever, paid and left. And they keep leaving me a stain notice on my shirt when there's not one to be seen. Really, stop huffing back there. What's the point of dry cleaning if I'm doing the majority of the leg work. Time to move on and fine someone better.

Best restaurant in the area for vegan/healthy options. The menu has dishes you can't find anywhere else. A ton of options to choose from whether you are in the mood for sweet, savory, smoothies, or just a snack, etc. My favorite is the Buddha bowl and sweet potato bowl. My boyfriend loves the nacho mamas bean bowl. I always have to grab a dessert because they are so tasty! Staff is always friendly and helpful. I come here 2-3x a week because it's that good. May be a bit pricey but you are getting what you pay for. Vegan, organic, and raw. All vegetables come from their own farm! 

Parking can be a bit challenging when it is busy, but you have to remember it's Broad Ripple and a small restaurant (next to the always busy, cake bake) I recommend parking on the street and walking over.
Class act. Cashier was pleasant, food was delicious, and the establishment was very modern and clean!

Overall, GW Fins was a great experience, and my entree was excellent.  However, we showed up right on time for our reservation and still had to wait 15 min.  I wouldn't normally comment on that, but from other reviews it appears to be a trend.  We split the tuna tartar and it was really top notch.  My scalibut dish was also fantastic.  The lobster risotto it was over was bursting with flavor and very well prepared.  I would highly recommend the dish.  My friend got the red snapper, which was good but not great.  I feel that it was just a touch overcooked, and the flavors didn't pop the way they did in my dish.  We skipped dessert, so I can't comment on that.  Our waiter was friendly and attentive.  Oh, and the biscuit they give you is very yummy!   I would come back here on another trip.
Finally! A Hong Kong style Cafe in Philly. The food was great and authentic. The staff was friendly and attentive. The only suggestion I have is a bigger menu to include some more of the staples.
Great pizza, great bar, need I say more?

This Wendy's is a good location. Open 24 hours for the midnight fry and frosty fix. They are pretty busy all day long so they are constantly making food non-stop.
The downfall to the constant food production is that sometimes they make so much, a burger may sit around and get luke warm. I did just have a cool temp burger and nuggets, however when i brought it the their attention, they immediately made sure i got fresh 'hot and juicy' food. Not a big deal but does need patience. 
Since i ate inside it was not that big a deal, if i went to the drive through and then hopped on the Turnpike before i took a bite, i would be very upset.
Food quality was consistent with other Wendy's and the 4th star was for customer service and fixing the mistake like a pro!

Their pizza was good but nothing to rave about. I think their baklava cheesecake and the cannoli were on point and super delicious. Service was friendly and location was in a good spot. Wings were ok but pass on the bruschetta.

DO NOT RENT from this company.  The initial estimate for the reservation was much lower then the actual charge when I got the car.  At the end i was still charged a full day extra for being 18 mins Late.  I have never seen this lack of customer service from a car rental Company.  This company uses Low estimates online to bring in customers and then requires mandatory insurance.  JUST stay way.

Loretta's is famously known for their praline. I loved that even during the pandemic I could order pralines states away and have them shipped to me. With that said, I'm not writing about pralines today. This review is all about the light, flaky, out of this world croissant-like beignets that Loretta's nails. 

Cafe Du Monde? Cafe Beignet? Nah, skip those. These beignets are the real deal, and better yet, you can get these beignets stuffed. Sweet or savory, Loretta's has you covered: Chocolate; Praline; Sausage, Egg & Cheese; Bacon, Egg & Cheese; Burger; Crab. I've heard there is a King Cake beignet offered during Carnival season, but I haven't had the pleasure to try.

My favorite beignet is the Crab (one for $7) which is overflowing with a delectably seasoned lump crabmeat and served with a remoulade dipping sauce. My wife's favorite is the Praline Beignet (three for $6.50), which is filled with a rich and decadent yet not overly sweet soft praline cream and topped with powdered sugar. 

Loretta's beignets are the only beignets you need in your life.

No doubt these crepes are 5 stars. The pizza app was delicious - most delicious sauce ever but the whole thing was wondrous.  The beverages are lovely - the tequila whatever tasted like straight tequila but without the kick (would not do this again, though once was ok) BUT the blueberry whatever was amazing and could have had a pitcher of those if that was available. The waitress was easy going and accommodating. The dinner crepes were perfection and you could even "create your own."  My coworker and I got 2 and split them so our waitress had the kitchen cut them for us and served separately. The dessert crepe was awesome - an apple pie one. The roasted pepper soup was delicious. It had some sort of liquid bacon on top. A bacon creme of sorts. For entree crepes I don't even know what they were anymore it was just blissful. One was chicken and one was sausage and our other coworker got a beef bourguignon. All amazing. Did I say that yet?  Just. Go. Now.

This takes the term 'dive bar' to a whole new level! This is more like, jump off of angel falls in brazil kind of dive! Raw concrete floors, uneven pool tables and a warped bar top.  Rileys DOES have some horse shoe pits out back, and a large, dusty, parking lot that leads up to the fancy pole building that houses the bar though.  And even though this place appears to be a dump, bring a group of friends, enjoy some cheap, heavily poured cocktails and you'll have a blast, I only give it three stars because, well, it just isn't for everyone.  Road house fans, enjoy!!

Deck Masters is amazing. I love how easy the owner Dan was to work with!! He gave us great recommendations and ended up saving us money in the long run. He really took the time to consult with us before starting the project but then once things were settled - they finished the whole project in only two weeks!!! The outdoor portion was part of an overall upstairs studio project my husband and I have been planning. Well though there's still a lot to do inside the studio - the outside is DONE and looking FANTASTIC thanks to Deck Masters.

First off - coming in to Philly is no problem.  The folks seem nice.  However, upon departure they have the new swiping TSA thing which they don't really explain and then the folks on the scan were not kind at all - grumpy.  The place is damned cold - unbelievably cold inside.  We go to the gate and froze our butts off.  The ticketing agents were aloof, cool and not very pleasant and started calling people with tight connections hastily then gave the seats to stand by only to have the checked in late connections show up and they had to pull the stand by folks off and put in the ticketed passengers.  Needless to say it made us leave late and our connection very tight.  The people just were not pleasant - really.
If you want to get a great car wash with or without an oil change this is the place to go. Super friendly staff that doesn't try to sell you everything.

Long wait for main course, quite noisy environment - a lot of clattering/echoing around - polite service. House wine by the glass very good.  Fish order was overcooked.  Will not be returning for dinner, but may try the brunch as it is near home.
We have gotten take out from Aji many times now and their sushi is always excellent.  They have great selections and the quality is superb. One of the best options for sushi in Bucks County.

I contacted them about a broken zipper on my jacket.  They asked if I could stop so they could see the issue. I also had a jacket I wanted to add a logo.  I brought both items in and within a few minutes they were able to install a new slider that allowed the zipper to stay zipped after I zipped up the jacket.  They were able to reinstall the logo from one item onto the other jacket.
The quality of their work was outstanding and their charges were extremely reasonable.  They are now my go to place for alterations.

Very cool place, it has a beer hall feel with long wooden benches and a bar area along with an outdoor area that is tented and heated for the winter months. 

The process for ordering is a bit cumbersome, they have one area of the bar where all orders from the tables have to be made and then they bring the food over to you. Beers they pour and hand to you at the bar. Then you go back to the same bar area to pay. It causes some delay at times when someone is pondering the beer list trying to figure out what they want when all you want to do is pay your tab and head out. The line was three or four deep at the order area when I was trying to leave. I would consider having typical waiter service for the tables vs the current approach. 

Food is typical bar food items and they were served quickly and of good quality. You have to grab your own silverware, napkins and condiments which as first time guests took a minute to understand since they brought the food out and left before we could ask where those items were. For the food price I would expect waitered service for things like this vs the more self serve especially since when we paid they had the tip line on the credit card bill.

I was the only customer in the restaurant all the tables were dirty the counter were you order had food and drinks spilled all over it I ordered 2 chicken tacos with quacamole sour cream lettuce all I got was chicken and cheese for 8$

I love this place so much. My husband and I come here often. Never had anything from the menu that was anything but delicious. Even the spring rolls are great. Service is always prompt and warm. They always get our orders right when we just get takeout, too, and don't leave anything out. Thank you, Sapporo!

Friday night is pizza night at my house. If you're looking for a recommendation, and you're in the area, then I highly suggest visiting the long standing ABC Pizza House in Wellswood. Now in my 50's, I have been enjoying ABC pizza since I played Little League Baseball right around the corner. The building has not changed much since my youth and just walking through the doors takes me back to a much simpler time. With such familiarity, it is with great pleasure that I still get to share this restaurant with my wife and kids.

As always, we ordered our standard pizza last weekend. With this, it is how we judge every pizza experience, no matter where we are at. A large pizza, half cheese and half sausage. As seen in my photos, the pizza is flawless. Perfectly rounded edges trap the oozing golden brown mozzarella cheese in to a delicious hardened shell that locks the ingredients on top in place. Trust me when I say that this is an art and it really gets no better than this!

We also ordered some cheesy bread for the table. Our waitress forgot the marinara and we were so hungry that we devoured the cheesy greatness before she could return. I barely even got the photo taken before it was gone!

Not pictured, but also recommended are the sangria and the Greek salad. No meal is complete without these two staples adorning the table as well. The Greek salad is more than enough to share, but be sure to tell your server to add the potato salad! After all, there is no need to count calories on Friday nights...

From the pickup counter in front, to the video games in back, I have many memories inside the building. Long live ABC Pizza House! I'm grateful that you are still around!

We discovered this restaurant while in Nashville for
a conference, and so glad we did! The two best things on the menu are the plantains and the Elote (corn)! OMG!!!  We tried the pork, chicken, and fish tacos and all were great. But you do need to have cash to pay for the food as they don't take credit cards.

Love it! Cleanest pho restaurant in S. Philly, best broth. Broken rice is awesome, and they have bubble tea , taro is my favorite! Also I saw them making an avocado shake, I will try it next time I'm there!!

My wife and I finally visited this place today, July 3rd, after intending to visit for quite some time. Based on other reviews we had read, our expectations were fairly high. It also looked like a cool establishment every time we passed by so needless to say, we were excited for our first visit. As we walked in, the hostess who was very friendly informed us they were having some plumbing problems and as a result, food would likely come out slower than usual from the kitchen. We had no problem with this and decided to sit at the bar, expecting to enjoy some nice drinks while we waited for our food. After no one approached us for ten minutes or so, we flagged down the male working behind the bar and asked to put in some food. After doing so, we were never asked about drinks or checked on in any way the remainder of our entire visit. We had to flag down the male once again to get drinks put in and finally received them 40 minutes after being seated. There was a female behind the bar as well, but there was zero interaction from either server other than requests coming from us to put in drinks, order food, and get the check. The female looked at us several times and never came over despite our empty plates and glasses. What made things even more disappointing was the fact that other couples and individuals were checked on occasionally, which made their oversight of us seem almost intentional. For context, the bar is not big at all. A simple, "Are you guys doing okay?" at some point would have kept me from leaving this review. Even an apology if plumbing was truly the reason for slow service would have been acceptable. But apparently even that was too much to ask for. I cannot reiterate how surprised and disappointed we are in this experience. My wife and I have both spent many years in the service industry and we understand sometimes things happen that make the level of service slip, even if it's completely unintentional. This experience was not that. It was complete laziness and a lack of caring from my vantage point, and although we'd like to give Hawkers another try, it will be hard to justify doing so after receiving such sub-par service.

I was helping a friend in CWE with his hard wood floor. After waiting the whole day (4/1/2017), the delivery guy finally arrived with the hard floors at 5 pm. But oh no, wait a minute. The Home Depot movers hadn't  arrived. But the delivery guys wanted to go home. What did we do? My friend and I had to sit on Maryland Ave. guarding the hardwood floors. There was no way we could carry these floors all the way from the sidewalk to the condo. Home Depot has very bad and uncoordinated service. NEVER USE HOME DEPOT HARDWOOD FLOORS service. Come on, Home Depot, you had only one job to delivery the floors!!!

One of my favorite restaurants in Philly! Delicious and unique food, great atmosphere, excellent service, and not too expensive. I went with a large group for a friend's birthday and we tried almost everything on the menu family style - and we loved all of it, especially the haloumi, the eggplant, and the pita bread. Israeli wine was also unique and good. The only dish that was mediocre was the mushroom entrée. But overall highly recommended and I'll definitely be going back!

This is an awesome place to spend an afternoon/ early evening on the patio. The decor is very nice with exposed beams, brick, and stone. We had a meat and cheese plate, spinach and artichoke pizza and two bottles of wine with our daughter and son in law. The live music was a nice mix of country and classic rock. We will most certainly be back with our friends and family to enjoy this venue.
Me and my husband visited Pedros's and we love it. The decor is spectacular and it provides a relaxing atmosphere. Go to Pedro's Tacos and Tequila Bar in Harahan and enjoy.

We visited Roxane after a night out with friends at Cardwell's.  I guess it's one of the only late night bars in Clayton.  It wasn't that busy, and they had moved the tables out of the dining area to make room for dancing.

Oh how I tried to refrain from singing the Police song with the same name.  But liquor took over, and I belted it out for no reason.

I went here because the prices are awesome. The students definitely take longer than a typical service, but they are friendly and knowledgeable. 

My brow & lash perm took about 3 hours, and my mani pedi with basic polish also took 3 hours. Definitely set some time aside. 

Also no shade at all to my nail tech, but the polish used was either old or bad quality polish. She did her best, and it looked good when I left, but as it dried it got so many bubbles that my nails look like pickles.

When I emailed them about the problem they said they don't do refunds but would re-do it free of charge. The re-do with different polish went great and took about an hour.
Very clean.  Kind & helpful staff.   Loved the big washers and no quarters (card based).
Food and drinks are fresh and delicious. Not a big fan of their cakes. I had a slice of the funfetti cake and it was dry and dense.

My time at Olive Garden is usually pretty good. The food and service is standard. Instead of ordering the usual fettuccine chicken Alfredo I ordered angel hair pasta with Italian sausage and a pesto sauce. Overall I enjoyed the flavors, but wished there was a little more pesto as the consistency isn't to where there's enough to cover the pasta.

It's really a shame that this place has gone way downhill. My husband lived here with his best friend in 2016. Then I moved up in 2017 and my husband and I got our own apartment, because we liked it so much from his experience living with his friend for 6 months. All was great and our one bedroom floor plan that we lived in from October 2017 until March 2019 was really nice. We did have one water leak in the kitchen from the 3rd floor apartments a/c condensation but it was fixed immediately. We chose to move into a 2 bedroom in 2019 because we were due to have our first child and we needed a nursery. Things had really started to decline once we moved. The turnover on our new place was really quick so we moved into a very dirty apartment. I did report the issues to the staff, however this is when they were in the process of new management so I let it go. I had to do some heavy duty cleaning myself, such as the grease catcher filter under the microwave needed to be replaced ages ago. if we cooked something on the stove, the grease melted and the air was oily. We had to unclog both tubs and the sink in the master. It was disgusting to remove the previous residents hair, we knew all of their hair colors. These are just 2 examples. We did this stuff ourselves because we had already moved in and I was about to go into labor any moment so it was a time crunch. The maintenance issues continued and it became a source of anxiety for me to have to deal with the new manager anytime we had to report an issue (which was very often). She was unapologetically rude, often seen out in the community with an unpleasant scowl on her face. Our 2 bedroom apartment was on the third floor and we had water on the ceiling and walls, especially surrounding the a/c vents. I had a hole in the ceiling above my son's bath tub for months. They had to come do the repair numerous different times before the new maintenance person (who is awesome and professional) could finally repair it correctly. The first time they "fixed" it, the piece of ceiling they patched fell back out into the tub, thankfully when my son was not in there. There was a shady contractor who came to conduct this repair, where he carried his cigarette scent into my apartment with him while he worked. Upon discussing this with the manager, she had the audacity to tell me this repair taking so long had something to do with me not allowing them to come in to complete it. However I had 3 different men on at least 10 different occasions come in to repair it.
