Girls weekend and wanted massages and a nice atmosphere. Not a hair salon. Not only was my massage with Colleen amazing but I would come back anytime I am in Nashville. The place is very welcoming and relaxing. Love it!!!! Love the staff.

Elizabeth Johns was the perfect place to find my wedding dress! You get A+, celebrity status treatment from the moment you walk into the door. The salon it's self is clean, beautiful, and has the most friendly, empowering style consultants of any other bridal store I have visited. They carry an array of beautifully designed dresses that fit any style you may be looking for. I went in not having any expectations other than a normal bridal dress appointment, but they completely blew my expectations out of the water. Not only did I get my dress here, because of the selection and excellent customer service, my mom came back to look for mother of the bride dresses for herself, and my bridesmaids also came back to Elizabeth Johns to find their bridesmaids dresses. I can't say enough positive things to say about Elizabeth Johns in Ardmore! I can't wait to come back this week for my fitting and try on my dress again!

I've never had a bad experience here and I am always satisfied, no matter what I get. We usually go on the weekends, and recognize a handful of employees, today (Wednesday) was a new crew, aside from one regular; I admit I was nervous about it not being as good (my expectations are high here). I feel bad for second guessing. Everything was spot-on, per usual. Got my regular, Greek coffee black & kataifi. And cappuccino and spanakopita. All delicious and beautifully made. All 3 behind the counter gave great customer service as well. Can't wait to come back

No fancy frills, this bar is tucked away in a strip on the north side of Washington Square.  It's a nice sized space with plenty of bar amenities such as pool tables, a modern jukebox, and pub menu.  The pricing is fair, and our service was attentive.  It provides a solid option for a bar destination in the area.

We needed our Mediterranean food fix and we are so glad we found this place. While there's not many around town, this is exactly what Tucson needed. I recommend the grill sampler plate (you can substitute the lamb for beef). Food was amazing and great customer service. We are looking forward to coming back!
Very great service, knowledgeable, beautiful corals. Would go again in a heart beat because I was very impressed

Excellent for those with gluten allergies - an abnormal amount of variety, and they carry pretty good GF rolls - my wife especially loves that they offer gluten free buffalo wings.  Multiple meals and we've yet to experience any cross-contamination issues.

Sunday specials are the best - prime rib, soup, and a house beer or wine for around $20?  It can't be beat.

Came in here yesterday to see the new Genesis G70 and looking for Charles who is always our go to representative and has sold us the last 2 Hyundai's. We are currently Hyundai owners and was just treated like we were not worthy of being there. Charlie wasn't there so we were greeted by a new salesman (didn't catch his name and he didn't offer a card). We explained that we just wanted to look inside one of the G70's that was parked out front (they were all locked). He said he'd get the key. We stood around waiting for some time then he came back telling us he was going to pull one around. I explained that we were not looking to test drive, that we were merely wanting to look inside one that's already out front. He said ok and walked away. Was gone for probably 7 minutes then came over to tell us that we'd have to fill out something to look at the car. Explained we weren't going to fill anything out. That we would come back when Charles is there and walked out. We were approached at our car by another rep stating he was Charlie's backup and that the other rep was new and probably didn't explain very well but proceeded to tell us that they are a corporation and they have rules. I explained that we only wanted to look inside one of the G70's parked out front and wasn't going to fill out paperwork to do that. Explained that we are currently Hyundai owners and never been asked to do this before. He interrupted me stating that again they are a corporation and have rules and used the analogy that "you know how a grocery store you have to go through the line to check out, well you have to fill out a questionnaire there."  We said no thanks and got in our car. Completely understand rules however if you're car shopping and want to merely look inside of a vehicle you should be able to do that without filling anything out. We are not taking the car off the lot!  But the smartass comment and actions of the salesman totally turned us away. Never have I ever experienced this at Hyundai. Maybe we will turn to a different manufacturer for our next vehicle because obviously they didn't feel as though my business was valuable during this visit. And if other customers are treated this way then perhaps you need to look at who you have selling your vehicles.

Great food. Even better service. I tried the Indonesian chicken tacos and the fish in banana leaves. dpicy, sweet, AND wonderful. My server was so kind and prompt, she gave great recommendations for food and drink. Great atmosphere. All around wonderful.

Our last three visits have had declining experiences'. In the past food was well prepared and had adequate quantity and quality.  However the meal on Christmas was deplorable. The chicken in the fried rice was dry, over cooked,  bland in crunchy rice. The vegetables, shrimp, chicken, and steak were all over cooked, lacking in quantity, as well as poorly seasoned. I shared this information with the manager and he said he would have the district manager call me when she returned to town. It has now been over a month and I have yet to be contacted. A visit to Benihana use to be anticipated with excitement but the restaurant now is way below par, and way over priced. So much so that we will never return. You have lost eight customers.

Nice little brick oven pizza spot! Outdoor seating as well! Had the prime rib panini, stuff long hots, and arugula pizza! All were spot on! Nice place will come back again!
(Picture of panini is only half sandwich. We ate the other)!

Absolutely phenomenal Mexican food. 

Los agaves has free chips and a help yourself salsa bar with flavorful salsas from fire roasted to mild to hot. 

Their vegetarian/cheese enchiladas were probably the best I've had in my entire life and their red sauce was insane. Whenever I come to SB again, I will definitely find my way back to their enchiladas. In addition, their Spanish rice was also so incredible. It was moist and flavorful and paired excellently with their refried beans which came in a cute little taco cup. 

We also ordered their nachos, which was also really delicious. Baked to perfection, and had a ton of toppings including avocado, salsa, black beans, and we threw some jalapeños on there. My mouth is watering as I write this review, and if yours is too, find your way to this restaurant. 

As for service, you order at the front and they bring the food to your table. The waiters moved our table closer to a heat lamp and they made sure to clean it off. The only thing is the nachos came out slightly late, when we were finishing up but they were so delicious that I wouldn't mind that wait, again.

I love this place! Service has been kind and accommodating to me and my toddler. I am served quickly and don't have to wait for the bill (crucial with kids!) The pizza is tasty and rather affordable compared to other local pizza places. Plus, kids 4? and under get free salad/hot bar which again is great because I can feed my son peas, eggs, and tomatoes long before he sees the pizza show up.

Great food, great vibes, great drinks. Got Agaves enchilada and guayava margarita (that tajin rim made my day I'm not going to lie). This was one of my partner's favorites that he wanted me to try when we were in Santa Barbara for the day--definitely worth a visit!! 

You order at the front and they give you a number to take to your table, which you can pick anywhere inside or outside. We chose outside and they had booths which I was pretty excited about haha, food came out quick and we made a couple trips back inside to check out the mini salsa bar!

Had a great brunch here this morning! Coffee was great. French toast was so good and the flavors were so interesting (in a good way!) Love the decor and ambience. Food came quickly and staff was super attentive.
The bakery did a great job on the cake I needed. It was absolutely amazing looking and tasted great. My only issue was that a lot of the roses on the side were falling off.

Seorabol was recommended to me, so I was pretty excited to try a new place.  Though the ambience is very cozy and comfortable, I really didn't like much else about the restaurant.  

The food and service are both lackluster.  I left feeling greasy and weighed down.  The korean bbq is kinda fatty and not very flavorful.  We also ordered the scallion pancake and asked if we could make it vegetarian; the waittress said yes. But then she brought out pancakes with meat.  When we called her attention to this, she was really resistant to changing it and tried to get us to keep the pancake and insinuated that we never asked for the change.  We went back and forth; at one point, she also implied that we were trying to get her in trouble. It was such a headache, we just kept the pancake.  I think she was so annoyed with us after that she barely gave us any service or attention the rest of the meal.

I was disappointed, especially after seeing all these positive reviews.  My first red flag popped up when I discovered the menu is part-sushi... If you're going to make the long trek, keep going and head over to Kim's BBQ instead.

Very helpful, quick, and inexpensive! Got my car fixed for almost $300 than the another place had quoted me. They staff were all so helpful and nice. And they  have a coupon for a free oil change on their website. Will go here every time! :)

It's really frustrating and difficult to justify how they mess up your mobile order nearly every time AND in response you go order in store only to come out like 30 minutes later cause of how long it takes to get your food ready...

I have been looking for an opportunity to try Charlie Was A Sinner for several months, and was certainly not disappointed.  What a great spot for foodie vegans (and non-vegans won't be disappointed either!) looking for a great little night spot with creative well-balanced cocktails and delicious and innovative small plate dishes.

This year I went to Publix pharmacy to get my flu shot.
They had a great promotion going on. Your insurance pays for the shot & They give you a store coupon to shop at Publix. A win, win situation.
I think the entire process took 10 minutes. The pharmacist that administer the shot was thorough, gentle & knew the proper part of the arm to use as the injection site. Nothing bad about this experience.
What's a girl to do? Quick, convient & I get rewarded with a gift card....now that's what I call good business.

I don't say this to be pretentious but I've eaten at a lot of nice places all over the world (Italy, Mexico, New York, the Philippines), I live in San Francisco, and I'm not a bad cook myself so I have pretty high standards for my food. So I was pretty blown away by the quality of the food I got in this down to earth casino restaurant, especially after being disappointed by a highly rated restaurant in downtown Reno.

We got the eggs Benedict, NY steak and eggs, and biscuits and gravy with some coffee and tea and all were surprisingly excellent. Service was attentive and thoughtful as well. Highly recommend if you are in the area, especially if you are staying at Atlantis.

The food and service was fantastic! There was 6 of us that went and not one of us had a bad meal! Finney was our server and she was great. I got the more basic meal shrimp pasta, but it was bomb and I had left overs. The others had the fresh fish salmon amd mahi mahi with the big easy topping which was tasty but I enjoyed the felix topping with roasted peppers and lobster cream sauce that my sister got. The only thing that could improve is the key lime pie! We have family coming in next week and will bring them here one night.

Just left from lefty's. The food is on point. This was my third time going. I see people complain all the time about the wait time. People need to understand that this is a new establishment and it's a local business. The more support you show the better they will get. It's not a fast food place. It's not an healthy fried rice spot in St Louis. Stop all the complaining and figure out how to work around it. I order my food before I'm even ready to go eat. I learned that the 1st time.

Been here a few times. 
Location cannot be beat. Near the vibrant Penn campus. Next to the RAVE movie theater. Nice views of the city upstairs although be warned there is no waitstaff at any of the tables near the bar. You must order at the bar but in my visits thats never a problem. You just tell them where you are seated, pay for it and its delivered.
Meal: Beet salad with tricolored beats and walnuts.  It was fresh and delightful. 
The bartender made my MM cocktail the way i wanted it with no looks. In the city, thats a plus. I left happy
. 
Last evening 12 of us came in prearranged and our meals and cocktails were very good and enjoyable.  The manager came over to ensure we were having a good time. 
This will bring all of us back.

Chile relleno with chorizo ! Amazing! 
Warning their corned beef hash is homemade. I know it probably better but we love the canned style. 
The bathroom ugh! Needs l help. Water leek in the large stall so when you flush there is water on your hand. There are no seat covers. Gross.

Open 24 hours on Fridays and Saturdays!! The Hubs and I eat and drink here often. Friendly staff and good food in an inviting atmosphere. Not too comfy, as in you'll want to bring you book and linger forever, but comfy enough that the waitstaff might get to know your name. Items to not miss, California breakfast burrito, Ultimate Benedict or the marinated beef tip melt.

This tour was great, HOT but great! Our captain was Captain Jason! He was very knowledgeable and very funny! He kept us entertained and I loved how he knew the history about the swamps and rivers and even gave us some fun facts about the animals we seen. I would recommend the tour to anyone!

Morimoto. What can I say. Perhaps my expectations were too high. Perhaps the chefs were having an off day. I don't know. Either way it is NOT what I would have expected from the Iron Chef's flagship restaurant.

We were a group of four people in town from California on business. Our dinner reservation was made in advance for 8:45PM on a Tuesday evening. We arrived early at 8:30pm realizing that we might want to have a cocktail before dinner. But the bar upstairs was full of people who were still waiting to be seated. Eventually we were told that there was space upstairs so we went up. Several groups were sitting having food and drinks. Realizing that the bartender had just been slammed with people we gave her plenty of time to serve us but it still took what I would call 'too long'. She took our order for drinks and some apps as we realized we might be sitting upstairs for a while.

Eventually we got our drinks, a decent Komei Shochu on the rocks and then went upstairs, where we ordered a nice bottle of 'G' Junmai Ginjo sake. I would have to say that it was not cold enough so I asked the server to chill it in ice more. But then our hostess, Sarah, arrived to tell us our table was ready. Only an additional 45 minute wait. Bottle in tow, no apps yet, and we were headed down to our table. Sarah was awesome by the way.

We were seated mid-restaurant. Good sized table for four people. So once seated Sarah introduces our waitress (can I still call her that?) and she was very nice. She took my bottle away and returned periodically when my glass was empty to keep it cold somewhere.  Regardless, it was now cold and quite enjoyable for an Oregon Sake. 

On to the food. About 15 minutes after seating our apps started to arrive.  BTW - I never complain. I just don't eat the food. I expect the waiter(ess) to notice. Score 1-5 for each dish.

Miso Soup - The tofu in this was awesome! Silken, soft larger pieces cut unevenly. Too bad the miso soup itself was over salted and luke warm. (1)

Edamame - not warm enough, crunchy, and OVER salted with big bits of sea salt.(1)

KUMAMOTO OYSTERS - None available so we went with the market oysters. Half dozen served with three different dressings, very nice.(3)

Yellow Tail Tartare, Caviar and wasabi This was the most enjoyable of the apps. Very clean. (4)

Duck Duck Duck - Basically duck cooked three ways. Roasted sliced duck breast, duck fried rice and a duck egg on top. Too bad the duck breast was like rubber. The fried rice was great though. I'd have to guess that the duck was previously frozen or the person cooking it didn't know how to do it. (2)

Ishi Yaki 'Buri' Bop - We opted for the kobe beef version. I guess I was expecting yakimeishi, a Japanese fried rice dish where the rice is cooked in the stone pot, other items are placed on top and then baked some more and finally all mixed up table side. This appeared to be similar but just a hot stone pot filled with previously cooked rice and the server was trying to tell us about it while furiously mixing it all up at our table while simultaenously attempting to cook the raw kobe beef slices on the hot sides. The pot was not hot enough, not even close to 'cook' the meat let alone sear it like the guy was trying to do.
I'd have to say that of the dishes that I expected the most from this one was mediocre at best. The toppings were not hot, the rice was not cooked in that pot and the beef as virtually raw and almost cold. (0)

Wasabi Fried Rice - Yaay for fried rice. This was nice. Well seasoned , egg fried in there. The wasabi was apparent but not blow your head off. (5)

Sushi. Thank God for sushi.

Tobiko, Tako, Maguro, Hotate, Unagi, Anago, Hamachi, Toro, Chu-Toro, O-Toro -  Every single piece was perfection. The quality supreme. The O-Toro was so sublime that we had another piece each for dessert. Pure butter of the sea. (5)

What really surprised me was that there were four or five sushi chefs behind the counter all 'Americans' except for one Japanese gentleman who I personally thanked for the awesome sushi.

I counted twelve waiters/waitresses standing around waiting towards the end of the night. We did basically close the place as we were seated late.

Morimoto-san, please go home your kitchen staff needs you!

So if it wasn't for the sushi being so awesome, I wouldn't give Morimoto a very good rating. But taking the decent sake and the sushi together and forgetting the rest, I'd go back but wouldn't bother with anything else.

I really really wanted to like everything but I'd have to give it a three overall. If I could give it a 2.5 I would.

If your concerned at all please feel free to contact me.

The food was very tasty and well prepared.My only problem was the amount of the main ingredients in the dishes.My wife and daughter had the papardelle and there was not enough of the wild mushrooms or chicken in the dish.I had the paella and the seafood was minimal for what was charged 23.95.I know that restaurants have to control costs but with the prices that are charged at brian's he should be more generous with the main ingredients.We had a discussion in our over 55 community and several people said the same thing and would not go back.

By bar the nicest, cleanest, and most desirable Qdoba I have been to. I can get a burrito that is large, filling, and delicious for under $8.50. I am not left hungry afterwards. Flavorful,  tender cuts of pork, chicken,  and beef. You can't go wrong here. 

The staff is pleasant and the atmosphere is inviting.  The place is always busy for lunch, which is a good thing.  

I love being in the Qdoba Rewards program.  Will save you money if you are a regular customer. 

This will be a staple while I work up in Fishers.

Had pork tacos wife had fish tacos. Both very good. Wasn't sure if waitress knew we were seated. Once she got to us all was good in the world. Good service and very good food. I'll go back and go through the menu item by item.   Cold beer also. House Margarita was "ok". Will try it with better tequila next time.
Great food! Nice size portions! Only excepts cash! A little bit expensive for a neighborhood little taco tent! But, overall it's a good place to get a unique borrito or quesadilla!!!

Zero customer service. Hangs up on you if you try to teach them on the phone. Completely ignores emails. Sent me 8 miscellaneous dead shrimp. I ordered 12 yellow belly. Should have checked their F rating with the BBB first. Last time ill make that mistake. ***BUYER BEWARE***

Dinner at BJ's after a night of shopping at Citrus Park mall. The meal was disappointing. We ordered easy entrees. Gluten free pizza and a deep dish pizza with mushrooms. The meal took a very long time to come out. The server came and said that they made the pizza wrong and had to remake it. Then when we were served it was actuAlly wrong again! The gluten free one had no tomatoes and the mushroom had no mushrooms, instead chicken???  Very odd. They remade both but it was kind of ridiculous. Not a great experience.

LOVE ~ LOVE ~ LOVE ! This place is great.  Staff is very welcoming, cute little hang out kid friendly place. 
They have a very creative variety of fresh made nightly flavors.  Adult flavors & kid flavors. Home made waffle cones , coffee, cold brew.  I go every other day to taste the new flavors.  You will not be disappointed!

By far the best nail salon!! I'm new to the area and have tried quite a few places. First of all it is incredibly clean. The owner Julia is just wonderful and goes above and beyond. She even suggested not doing something because she said it was not good for my nail and more expensive. They are closed on Mondays and I was told it's not so busy during the week. It's in the same shopping center as Chuck E. Cheese and they have lots if parking.
Slowest coffee shop on the planet you WILL wait 30 minutes for a mediocre coffee at best. Idk who they let go but it shows, you better get them back!

Ordered food a little over a week ago and got 2 bags of chips the bags were full but COMPLETELY STALE! It was late so I didn't bother with it but this evening we went back explaining to the person behind the counter that we had gotten stale chips last week and she just stared at my husband so he ended up buying a bag of chips... fast forward to getting home to open our bag of chips to see that they put a whopping 10-15 chips MAYBE in the bag. Called and spoke with Courtney and she said I guess you can come back and mention my name and bring your receipt to show "proof" that you ordered so at that point we decided to again pack all 3 of our kids in the rain to go bring her back this pathetic bag of chips. So what does she do? Gives us 2 pathetic STALE BAGS of chips! Your service sucks here and your management is even worse.

No frills spot with excellent coffee and a simple but tasty food menu. The atmosphere is pretty quiet; AC didn't seem to be working when we were there on a very hot day, so probably not be the place to park yourself down for a few hours in the summer.

I lived in Ny for 30 years and the Tampa area for 10.  Since I have been here people always talk about NY style pizza, and it always ends up that it sucks.  Im actually upset with myself that i took so long to try this place because it is 100% legit.   I was blown away.  I dont even eat meatballs at pizza places and the meatball slider was great.   The slice  of regular was great and the garlic knots were great.  They even understand to have pepper Parmesan and garlic powder at the table. The memorabilia all over the place is a great touch. Totally enjoyable spot that I will be going to  from now on!

I have been a long time Gemelli customer and finally got around to writing a review. If you have been to Italy, you will know that this gelato is the real deal. Signor Gemelli has an excellent arrangement of gelati to choose from, with vegan and gluten free options always on the menu. I was extremely impressed with the order window they had to accommodate covid-19. From the beginning of the pandemic they were on top of safety. Truly a caring & conscious West Chester business to support
Really good place. Food tastes fresh and has a bunch of flavor in it. Love their dumplings  they taste fresh and homemade. I would recommend this place to anyone
easily the best thai in stl. higher quality meat than most places will throw in their dishes.

Great food and service. Myself and two other guy coworkers went in on a Sunday morning and it was quite busy. Was told about 30 minutes. We sat at the bar for coffee and decided to eat there. About 15 minutes later our table was ready, but we decided to stay at the bar.  Biscuits and Gravy were some of the best I've had!  Coffee was fantastic also. I've been on a work trip in this areas for 2 months. Best breakfast I've had yet.  Definitely recommend!!

This was absolutely one of the best experiences I have ever had. I am a competitive rider and a professional in the horse industry and I have to say that the level of professionalism, safety, and the quality of training on these horses is on another level compared to other trail type rides I have done with my young daughter. The guides are absolutely on their game with teaching the riders how to work with the horses. My daughter is 10, and Jen was incredible when explaining to her how to swim with her horse and it made for an experience she and I will never forget. Also, as a professional saddle fitter, it made me so happy to see these horses properly outfitted in saddles and bridles that ensured comfort and safety for both horse and rider!  Even better that proceed go to rescuing these beautiful horses for so many to enjoy! Thank you!!!

3.5 stars for this one. I like the space (though they'll be moving soon) and the service was pretty good, but the pizza fell a little flat for me. I got the jalapeño popper and was expecting a lot of heat, but only received a mild hit of spice. The sauce on the pizza was a little bit of a mismatch for the toppings and I think it could handle something a little heavier and spicier. A 12" was perfect for one person (I have quite the appetite though). 

I'm willing to give this place another shot mainly to try their house sauce (I smell a custom pizza in my future). Not a total miss for me, but not my favorite pizza in the city.
Coffee good but bagel just ok. Nothing special here

Nothing but great things to say about this place. The food was tremendous. Absolute flavor explosion in my mouth. Let's start with the corn dish. Total surprise. I never knew corn could taste so good. The guacamole was yet another delectable dish.  Now let's talk about the tacos... The Mahi-mahi... out of this world. The fried fish... Flavorful. But this is the taco that absolutely made me crazy with flavor enjoyment... The ribeye!!! Don't leave that place without trying it. The only thing that surpass the food and flavor was the friendly service great people Yogi... The best! Justin M great server. This will be my go to place, again and again and again. Bringing friends this week.

Ate brunch here for the first time and had one of the best brunch experiences ever. I chose the Chef's Tasting Menu. The tasting menu was unique in that you were able to pick from the menu an appetizer, an entrée, and a desert rather than the chef selecting. This proved to be a fabulous deal as I was given more food than I could finish for only $25. I had the Sicilian fries, the eggs basilicto and the cheesecake. I ended up taking home half my entree because I was so full! The quality of the food was also amazing. Everything was cooked and flavored to perfection. The eggs were the right amount of runny and not over cooked (which is usually my biggest complaint with eggs Benedict). Additionally the potatoes served as a side were cooked so well they practically melted in my mouth. The atmosphere was relaxed and not over crowded, which I like because I find most brunch places in Philadelphia end up being packed. My only complaint was that the waitress incorrectly calculated our bill (the bill she gave us was much lower than what we owed). But she quickly corrected it when we showed her the error. Despite this, I would definitely visit this restaurant again and I look forward to trying dinner here!

Great food, and great new spot they just open on Gallatin.
Only take out and outside seating
Looking forward to go inside when it is authorized
Great flavors and nice staff

Love this local pub! Great beer selection and relaxed atmosphere. Bar tenders are always welcoming and attentive. Outside tables which are perfect for people watching on a nice day. Great location. A prefect place to stop in for a pint.
The best Cuban ever!  And cofecito a bonus

The Brewery is such a staple of Dunedin.  I've been coming here for years despite the service. West Coast Fish wrap - the best!  But I'm sitting here listening to the admittedly very talented band - and I'm bored to death.  Come on guys.  Wish you would bring back the old days of open mike Wednesdays where there was an element of risk and excitement and fun.  Stop with the dishrag music.

Lots of good treats! I originally went in for the bread pudding, but the had to try the pound cake, the jelly rolls and a few new things. It's a little different because you place your treats on a tray and they box them for you. Staff is very friendly and helpful.

The only cool thing about this dirty skanky bar is Norman, the famous South Street homeless man who looks like Flava Flav. His name is actually Norman. He wears a large clock necklace and a Viking hat.

How is it that your specialty is making biscuits yet that's the worst thing on the menu?! I stopped in here for breakfast a week or so ago with high hopes and ended up taking 2 bites and giving up. The biscuit was dry and hard to chew and the sausage that I got inside was cold! HOW SWAY?! Not to mention, it was on the pricey side. I paid about $9 for two bites of disappointment. Save your coins.

Falafel Pita, sprouts, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, hummus and extra tzaziki! Yes Please! Though the whole menu is a delicious nugget wrapped in fluffy pita, my favorite is still the Falafel. The girls are great and the food is quick to come off the flat top. It may not be houte cuisine, but delicious indeed. Im inclined to fly to Reno from Tucson right now to grub out!

Totally cool park with a huge green space. It has a nice pond and walkways if you're in the mood for a nice stroll.

It also has the Parthenon. Imagine my surprise since I visited the one in Italy a few months back. It had a museum inside but we decided to skip it. I mean,  if I didn't have to pay a entrance fee in Italy...

Overall,  it was a great experience.  Next time,  I'll need to bring my dogs.

Bubs is a great place for a quick bite! Right off of the monon trail, it is ideal for bikers or Carmel families. Their staff is very friendly, but young. I got the sloppy waffle fries and the big Bub Dog. The Bub Dog was huge and delicious. However, my main complaint with Bubs is the lack of topping options. They don't allow for much variety. Their waffle fries were delicious and LOADED with bacon. Will definitely be back!

I love all the options at this spot. Wait staff and chefs are always super welcoming and friendly. Top notch service. In warmer months its a great outdoor dining spot as well. One of my favorite restaraunts in the city for sure!

I had Sierra Air come out 3 times to fix my thermostat on my working floor furnace. Tim was my last tech and was very professional and replaced the thermostat with one that works and finally my house is warm. Tim was very professional and fair with the price. Thanks Tim and Sierra Air.

Yes the food is Delicious, the service was average yet that is Okay the problem I have with this place is that we are told that the menu's are old and they updated there pricing so they said if the prices are higher on the bill don't be alarmed. I honestly think they only do this to people who use groupon so they can make the money back: its 2014 if you can't have menus with the current prices on them then you should not be in business. Again the food is good but as a customer I should know how much something costs before ordering. I will be back but I might try another Indian food place because I am annoyed with the pricing if they bought new menu's how much would that really cost them? I know everything I order will be 3 dollars more nice. What is your opinion of this? does it bother you or should I just suck it up since the food is good and take it like a man?

Went to see Guys and Dolls which is one of my all-time favorite musicals on screen or stage. This was a fun production which I really enjoyed. Professional singing, great set, fun costuming, great pit. Centennial Hall is a wonderful venue with a clear view to the stage no matter where you sit. 

Not so much a review of this particular production, I want to do a review on Broadway in Tucson. Look, here's a secret: As long as the venue is good, it makes no difference whether you see a musical on Broadway or in Tucson. I've been to musicals in several venues in different cities and there is no difference. As long as the direction is good, you are going to get a first rate show.

We are so lucky to have Broadway in Tucson bringing us great shows. I highly recommend you go.

We were traveling and looking for something local and "Nashville" on the south side of the city. On a search for hot chicken this was one of the only ones open on a Sunday. Counter service, fast, and charming. It was a gorgeous day to sit on the patio. We tried the fried buffalo Mac and cheese side, the hot chicken basket, and the regular tenders basket. They have a ton of sauces to choose from. The buffalo Mac and cheese were tasty, but I didn't taste buffalo or a lot of spice. The fries were great! Thin and crispy. The chicken was the star. The hot chicken was hot! The breading was light and crispy. Overall a great experience!

The Good: The food here will satisfy a Korean fix and the owners are gracious. The big screens are nice when trying not to miss a game. 

The Bad: The portions can be stingy (they obviously run a tight ship) and every dish seems to have the same mix of cabbage, onions, and carrot shreds. Soups and noodle dishes have tiny specks of meat, which is disappointing considering their $10+ price tags. Depending on who's cooking, food can be overly greasy.

The Ugly: I've never been to a Korean place that charges $$$ for extra "ban-chan", the small side dishes that come with every meal. Boo.

Very very nice bar. Friendly staff and customers. Karaoke is on Fridays and Saturdays (I went both nights). Drink prices are very reasonable and I recommend this place to anyone looking to have a great time.

Mike showed up to give estimate on cement work I wanted to get done. Was looking to get steps, walkway and to take up lawn to make a patio. Estimate was very reasonable, said he would get us on schedule within the next two to three weeks. He called within days and wanted to start the very next day. His workers came around 9:00 and were very polite, got right to work, let me know when they were done for the day. It took about four days to complete all the work. I love how everything looks! Can't wait to sit out front. Definitely would recommend this company.

Before heading to the beach, we decided to pop in her to fill our rumbling tummies.

They have a $7 lunch special that gets you one two-topping personal size pizza (thin crust or pan), one small trip to the salad bar, and one small soda.

Decent salad bar and decent pizza. Nothing extra special, but it's not a bad deal.

EXCELLENT!!! 

From decor and service to food and wine selection - fantastic!  This place takes a a creative spin on our favorite bar-food and makes every sandwich/salad or entree a delicious adventure. 

We came there for lunch in a group of 8. All of our food arrived quickly, warm (what was ment to be warm) and well-presented. The wine list by the glass was unusually fabulous with very creative choices (same with beer and cocktails)

I got to taste chicken and grits and grilled cheese (both out of this world delicious and great value:) We even attempted to return on Tuesday, but they were closed. 

Another great bonus - absolutely beautiful private patio with trendy furniture, trees and grapevines shielding you from the street... Would love to return soon!

We came here for brunch and our first impression of the hotel is it's absolutely beautiful. The lobby is open and inviting and the people are friendly. We asked about brunch options and they told us we could sit in the restaurant downstairs or the rooftop bar has a limited brunch menu. We chose to go to the rooftop which had absolutely breathtaking views of the city. The pool and open air bar were very trendy. However when we went to order they told us they just serve a bar menu no brunch. So we headed back downstairs to the restaurant and were quickly seated. We were handed lunch menus and were confused there was no brunch listed. We checked the website and it said it was brunch hours so we asked our waitress about it and she brought back breakfast menus. We ordered our food and some cocktails. We waited for around 20 minutes and another waiter mentioned the complimentary bread items available by the hostess stand. They were delicious we wish we knew about them while we were waiting since our food came right when we started snacking on them. My pancakes were delicious with the added dark chocolate chips made them heavenly. I enjoyed my experience here they are fairly new and just need to work out some of the communication/service kinks.

Enjoying Midway twice in one week is rarity for me, but after last night's late night visit I dare call myself a regular.  Six days prior I was enjoying beverages at the bar with an old friend, however last night was pitchers and pizza.

When we arrived at 830 there was but one booth available which frankly I was a little surprised by, but clearly with Saints losing their hard fought game against the 49ers, fans needed some comfort food and comraderie.

Our pizza happened to be slowed in queue, but Steve - who *might be hardest working restauranteur on Freret - sidled up to us and offered an app on the house.  My cohort quickly requested pigs in a blanket, and no more than 2 minutes later voila!

My point in updating my review is Midway isn't messing around.  It's a sincere and delicious effort, and one I truly appreciate being someone that lives and also works in the neighborhood.

MY ONLY COMPLAINT at this point is whoever keeps the music going needs to quit skipping songs.  I know it's minor but it is irritating.  Midway staff please take note (pun intended): hands off the skip button!
This coffee shop is legit. They make all of their own food and it's wonderful. Their frozen coffee is addictive

I know everyone has beef about the prices at Houston's. And I'll admit when I first came here I was a little taken back by the fact a cheeseburger was $15. But I kept hearing these rumors about them having an amazing burger so I just had to take the plunge and give it a go. After all, it IS Houston's so obviously it's not exactly a casual dining experience. 

Let me tell you, I've never had a $15 cheeseburger before....but it's pretty worth it! When the server told me that each burger is prepared with freshly ground meat for the day I wanted to just write it off as one of those fair weather statements the manger enforces the serving staff to say. But after eating this thing I totally believe it! The meat tastes super fresh and was perfectly cooked to medium rare perfection. 

I was so impressed by my experience that I went back and got the French Dip Au Jus later on that week and was equally impressed. You can tell they indeed use giant portions of quality prime rib. 

So don't let the prices deter you from coming to Houston's! Just remember your definitely paying for top quality. And I don't mind shelling out a few extra bucks for worthy quality. It's only when you spend the extra bucks and DON'T receive outstanding quality food that disappoints me.

The staff was very friendly and looked like they genuinely enjoyed their jobs (which is sometimes a rare find). Although we went during peak lunch and dinner hours, we received excellent, timely, and friendly service both times.

As a side note, they are also really good about substitutions and customizing things for you. My aunt wanted a specific dish that's was no longer on the menu, but they made it for her anyways which was nice of them.
These guys were on it.  Had the parts I needed and while keeping up with social distancing still got the job done.  Thank you guys!  Will definitely reuse and recommend

This place gets the job done. Has about 80% of everything anyone would need. Just missing some specifics for my taste. Weights are all in the basement, which is fine but still gives the place a grimy feel.

Pros-
Decent amount of weights
Friendly staff
large

Cons-
You have to pay for parking across the street (not the gyms fault though)
Basement is dark 
NO ONE RE RACKS THEIR WEIGHTS.....NO ON

We visited this museum yesterday when returning to NYC (it's only a few miles from I-95) and we really liked it.  Although it obviously can't compare to world-class museums, it's very impressive for a city the size of Wilmington and it has many appealing aspects.  We loved the British Pre-Raphaelites exhibit, the American Illustration exhibit, and the Dream Streets: Art In Wilmington 1970-1990 exhibit (the latter is a temporary exhibit).

The museum is larger than you might think from looking at the exterior, as there are galleries on the second floor.  There's also a sculpture garden, although it only has three (large) sculptures.  However, there's a good-sized patio across from the sculpture garden and it has lots of seating.  Speaking of seating:  an appealing aspect of this museum is the generous amount of (*comfortable*) seating in all of the galleries.  Also; all of the staff were very pleasant, and the woman at the reception desk was particularly friendly.

A wonderful aroma was emanating from the café, but unfortunately we weren't hungry enough to eat anything.  Lastly; admission is free on Sundays - but after spending nearly two hours at the museum and enjoying every minute, we felt compelled to give a donation.

(As an aside, the museum is located in a *lovely* neighborhood).

Got their spam mail, decided to look it up since I got three identical letters from three different "organizations" with different addresses. Avoid. This is a scam. Look up the Las Vegas Sun article on these types of folks.

Stayed there this past Monday. Paid $79.00 for a king size bed without a pool view. Take my advise and pay extra for that amenity. My view overlooked the parking lot, and the street light was near our room. So it shined throughout the night, plus got the morning sun.

Otherwise room was fine and clean. I've read many complaints about uncleaniness, bugs, no working hot water or A/C, etc. We did not encounter any of that. 

Front desk check in could have had more personality, but I'm sure he hates his job like most in that underpaid industry.

For under $80 including taxes, its not bad. Its not Buckingham Palace. I would repeat. ;-)

Friday night. Amazing pizza fun byob vibe!

My 2nd trip here same amazing food. Can't wait to come back up.

Was seated immediately upon walking in and had orders taken very quickly.  Our server was extremely polite and checked on us frequently.  Our food tasted delicious, and steaks were cooked perfectly.  This is how an Outback Steakhouse should be!  Will definitely return.

I used to love them I did. However so many times I paid for my cut and color with tip and was not happy when I left. Sometimes it looked like they didn't do anything other times it looked like my hair was cut by my kid. I asked to not use a razor and by the time we got to the cut they forgot and it would
Use the razor. I was always rushed around or ignored while waiting it felt clicky. Everyone knew everyone and the whole life story of each other and despite going for years know one knew me and I felt unwelcome. They say you are getting a mainline cut and color for much cheaper not the case maybe 5 years ago but 130 plus tip is pretty high and on par with others in the area. I had it when I went for a root touch up and they tried to charge me over 100 dollars. A receptionist who didn't even know me got aggressive and the owner had to come Over to intervene. Only to tell me I booked the wrong appointment and this confusion was my fault. How embarrassing as others heard the whole thing and no one apologized. I am sad to write this review because I loved salon true and made my appointments faithfully every 6-8 weeks, but I feel like they turned on me and turned on many clients. It is clear by more recent reviews things have changed and not for the better. All that and you still have to pay for parking. My hope is they see this review and make some changes for the better. Anonym

I just happened to see this place in the corner of my eye while driving from errand to errand with a screaming baby in the backseat. I was almost in tears because I was hot, thirsty, extremely famished, and frustrated. Therefore, I made the executive decision to just stop at mr. Pickles. So happy I did because man that chicken salad sandwich with banana peppers was just right. I walked into the clean restaurant and was greeted by the cutest lady with a heavy accent (she was just too cute and sweet to be annoyed or impatient with though). She quickly made my order up while chatting it up with me and cooing at my baby. Seemed very personal in there. 

It wasn't very crowded at all, so the lady helped me by bringing my food to a table because I had my hands full with my son. I sat in peace, and she would check in on me every now and again. Okay so you get the picture? Customer service was stellar. 

Now for that chicken salad sandwich. It was amazing on the perfectly baked French roll. Not too crunchy, but not too doughy. Chicken salad was just the perfect balance of a little sweet and savory (not a crazy amount of mayo) and was really full of a whole lot of yummyness. Their portions are big enough to justify the $8 prices. I left full and happy with some leftovers! Love this place:)

After buying four coffees and food this morning, the owner came over and was very rude about us "not" being paying customers since we were still sitting and working after finishing most of our coffees. The owner also called the cops on another patron who was saying she didn't liking being berated by the owner while being a paying customer who was doing work.

My experience here was the greatest. I came in to get a vertical tragus piercing after two failed previous tries. The staff that helped me was very kind, knowledgeable and patient. Klyer was my piercer and took extra time to answer any and all of my questions. The process was unlike any other piercing I've had in the past. Sterilization done here is similar to that done in a medical setting, which made me feel at ease due to past experiences.  My experience here was so great my friend went back the next day to get a piercing done! Absolutely recommend this place if your looking for quality jewelry and service.

Worst dining experience I've had in awhile..:( not only did they skip over us and make us wait 15mins longer ..they brought me the wrong food ..and when i said I didnt want a replacement because I wouldnt have time to eat it before we picked up the kids but the manager insisted he get me a new one to go and then charged me for it!! And then got mad that I called him on it and took the to go bag with him ..lol..and dont worry the waitress still got a good tip..because the kitchen screwed up my order not her..
OUT OF THIS WORLD!!! Don't pass it up... Well worth the drive if you're in the Tampa area!!

We stopped by for the muffuletta.  It was about 10 mins before closing.  They had two kids standing at the door ready to close.  We went up to the counter to order a full muffuletta.  There was one premade so they handed it over to us.  Definitely overrated.  It was an ok sandwich.  As other reviewers have said, overpriced and not really friendly staff.
Excellent craft beer selection, only exceeded by the food and service.  Try the gyro.  Best on the Beach!
Disappointed. Very over priced and the ice cream was not even good enough to eat. Threw it in the trash and I love ice cream, I don't oft throw it out...

My girlfriends and I were there this past June for a girls getaway and were so impressed by the customer service at the JW in New Orleans. I stay at JWs very often for work, but this place blew us away in how committed they were to ensuring we had an amazing weekend. I always expect a decent customer experience when I stay at Marriott properties, but at times have been slightly disappointed. This particular property stands out in my memory for the stellar experience and I will definitely return to the JW in New Orleans, over any other hotel. Thanks to the staff for making our stay so special!
Johnny (the waiter is the man!!!!)

We love Kreature Komforts, Dr. Patti and the entire staff! We have been going there for a few years now and have nothing but positive things to say about this vet practice. We trust them with our beloved animals!
Got breakfast here, it was pretty good food. But found it lame that they would not let me sub french fries for potatoes.
One of the best takeout pizza joints in O'Fallon. We love the New York style pizzas. The wings are good but take longer than most places to receive. The staff is friendly and welcoming.

Best little local donut shop. I do try to go no later than mid-morning especially on weekends because they do get hit up pretty hard. I find these donuts much consistently better than other chain donut shops. My father loves their plain cakes and the hubby loves the plain old fashioned. Mom is a fan of the apple fritters and I love anything with chocolate and their chocolate frosting has plenty of chocolate flavor. Employees always helpful and friendly. Hope they survive these trying times.

Chris Somer and his team were fantastic to work with. I was moving across the country so I was not able to be local while my house was on the market. Chris handled EVERYTHING. I did not have to worry about anything. His team was always accessible, kept me informed of showings, feedback on the property and even provided assistance with an unexpected repair that needed to be made at the house! Despite the being in a difficult market with all of the COVID-19 restrictions, we were able to negotiate a good deal on my property within a short amount of time. He organized a virtual closing so I did not need to travel back to Philly.  If you are in the Philadelphia market and you need a realtor, look no further than the Somers team for all of your real estate needs.

AHHHHHHMAZING!!!!!

Lil mom and pop joint. Can't miss the building it's gorgeous. They got fresh / boiled seafood by the pound. Drinks and snacks. Even beer. 

Got the boiled crawfish , snow crab, shrimp, and dungeoness crab. No complaints. It was just a tiny hint of spice and nice Cajun flavor. Not too oily. Did not feel guilty eating this a bit. Soo cheap so delicious. 

Crawfish 4.99/lb
SCL 13.99/lb
Shrimp 8.99/lb
Dungeoness: 15.99/lb

Got damnnnn. If u don't try anything try the dungeoness (you will thank me later) it's sooo sweet and tender. And REALLY expensive in most places. Try this while u can!!!

If I could rate this movie theater zero stars I would! HORRIBLE WORKERS ALONG WITH DISGUSTING AND TRASHY THEATERS! We walked into the theater and there was trash everywhere! Nobody cleaned the theater previous to the next showing! Walking on trash tryin to find seats that weren't covered in trash or where we weren't sitting next to a pile of trash! HORRIBLE! I'm a St.Pete resident and movie rewards member but I will not be coming here anymore!!!!!!

So I mean obviously everyone loves tacos right? So the other day I decided I wanted to surprise my friend at work and bring her tacos. I decided to come here since it was close to where she worked at (6 tacos and horchata $21). So I go in I order carry out & I sit adjacent to where my order was taken and I had paid at. I'm just hanging out on my phone for roughly 25 minutes and then I decide to get up to see where my drink is at the least. It was a Wednesday at like 12 so they're weren't many customers. I see two carryout boxes in bags on the shelf behind the counter. Waited about 6 minutes (standing) to get my food then had to wait an extra like 7 just to get my drinks and extra limes... The two workers up front weren't even there to cash a customer out who had dine in and the tacos were trash. Not to mention cold. I'll honestly never come back here considering there's way better places with better prices in the area
Locally owned by good people. Wash works exceptional. Recommend them - friendly and fair people running it.

The service that we have received  & continue to receive by Marshall Schaap & tiffany stafford has been excellent. I would recommend them to anyone who needs help. They've been very helpful & always available throughout the process.

I've been to Manhattan Bagel twice. The first time was a great experience. My Chelsea bagel was amazing, well cooked and "full." The second experience about a week ago was horrible. I ordered the (2) Chelsea burgers again and got home and the meat was very undercooked, had that "fake taste" and that awkward bite you get when you know something isn't fully cooked. I threw them both in the garbage - throughly disappointed. The very next day my VP came into my office with ..you guessed it ..Manhattan Bagel and bought some for me The name alone made me cringe. I'm a dare devil so I said nothing about my experience with the place. They even had the same burgers "the Chelsea." A true act of God sending us all a sign. They bit into it and immediately spit it back into the wrapper stating "omg it's undercooked ..how disgusting." I tried mine reluctantly (SAME DEAL) Undercooked. I did share my previous experience with them thereafter Haha. Whoever is cooking the food at this cherry hill location plaza needs to be re trained or terminated immediately. It's unfortunate because "Manhattan Bagel" is a reputable chain with great food. I've been to several but this location is horrible and needs to be checked before it damages the brand with the locals/visitors. Undercooked food can get adults and far worse children very sick!! Management should be taking note of their low ratings here at this location  and responding on here accordingly as most other restaurant owners/management does when their restaurant/ businesses reputation is at stake. Sad. I will be giving management  a call today.

Worst place. Kept us waiting for a very long time at the table and we were tired of waiting for someone to take our order. Place was not packed but the staff seem very negligent. We walked out. This place is going down unless they start taking care of customers.

I have been to quite a few foot spas in other state, the quality of each spa is different.

My first time at this foot spa, and I really enjoyed it!  I guess I was lucky when I went early in the morning and no one else was there.  I had an hour foot massage, but the massage actually is from head to toe.  The massage was really relaxing and I fell asleep (in the middle of the day).  I believe I snored.

Since the foot massage business here is not as competitive as other state (such as in CA), the price is considered "high" (comparing the average income here and L.A., also the price point of the service), however, the price is pretty standard here and it is reasonable (just because it is not as inexpensive as other cities, it does not mean the price is not reasonable)

The place is a bit far from where I live, but I would not mind to come back again.

Definitely a great location.  It is close to the action but still away from the craziness.  We went here for a bite after a few drinks on Broadway.  There was a wait for a table downstairs, but a seat yourself no wait upstairs.  The bleu burger was so delicious, I wanted more.  The pizza was just okay.  It was a lot of crust and not a lot of toppings.  It was also a bit burnt in spots.  I would love to try some of their other food options because they definitely had a ton to choose from.

the only thing they have going for them is that they are cheap, but unfortunately, you get exactly what you pay for. I have gone maybe 3 times, each time hoping it was a bad day for them before, once, they were out of rye toast, once out of mashed potatoes and once out of milk (yes milk). And the help, while nice enough seems very used to being out of food, because twice when they were out of what I asked for, they rattled off other items they were out of, too. The food (when they have it) isn't terrible, but isn't good enough to make up for all of their shortcomings.

I love Lucchese's, and inherited my brother's pair appr. 16 years ago. They are just about 27 years old now, and have always fit me like a glove. As soon as the leather started to crack (recently), I decided to retire 'em.

I was visiting Nashville recently, and walked into this store behind an older couple; there were two sales people, and they greeted the other customers and started chattin' them up. I wasn't in thre for more than 8 minutes before I walked out the door - with not even a peep outta the sales people. A simple greeting, or parting word would have been nice - esp from what could be perceived as high-end items.

I also know the price points and levels of quality that Lucchese offers, and will pay the price if I see exactly what I am looking for. Unfortunately, you will never get the whole product line in one store, so as was the case here, I walked out.

...but unfortunately, they will never know whether or not they could've had a sale, cuz they failed to reel me in.
We are from Miami, finally we find a good place to have a delicious Cuban coffee and you can not miss the Cuban sandwich!the owners are very friendly we'll definitely be   back...

If I could give NO STARS I would. I took my co-workers out to Bourbon to treat them to music and the culture. We were headed back to the hotel aNd  decided to stop for pizza. The place was empty, only the worker and one person whom they were talking to. We were a party of 8 aNs each wanted a slice of pizza. I first asked for a slice and the immediate response I got was "the word is excuse me". I was confused by this given they weren't busy or serving anyone else, then they proceeded to say "you interrupted me". I was blown away. They were not talking when I asked to be served. Myself and 8 co-workers went elsewhere. As we were walking away, they proceeded to call us "ignorant" and "bitches". 
THIS PERSON SHOULD BE FIRED. No wonder the place was empty!!

My entire family loves this BYOB restaurant! We have been  diligently working our way through the menu. The ribs are fabulous, the tamales steamed in banana leaves are heavenly but my favorite so far has been the Pork Pupusas with Repollo (a latin sauerkraut) which is more like a slaw with a vinegar base, don't be afraid, try it!!!  My husband's favorite is the Chargrilled Steak hand rubbed with special seasonings topped with Guatemalen salsa, scallions and guacamole. My 9 year old is in love with their Horchata (a drink made with rice, evaporated milk, sugar and cinnamon)  Their black beans over chips is equally as addicting!

The portions are ample, we usually end up taking some home and the prices are great ( between $9 - $11 for an entree) 

We have never had bad service no matter what night we have gone. The waitstaff is very attentive and extremely helpful  especially to the Guatemalen food virgins who are not sure what to order. We feel very lucky since we are in walking distance of this jewel in Phoenixville.

This is probably the most intimate and incredible places in St. Pete! A small beer & wine bar with a really funny and personable bar tender, oh did I mention he does magic tricks?!? A definite must see! John is the charming, magical, and extremely funny owner/bartender. He knows what he's talking about when it comes to wine and beers, my girlfriend didn't know wines at all but simply described certain taste she enjoys and John was able to pick out the perfect wine for her. She loved it! I cannot stress enough the awesome time I had here! Looking forward to coming back!

This is my brunch spot. I have great memories with my work "breakfast club" here. I love the sunset mimosas. I love the scrambles and ham and jam biscuit sandwich. I love the focus on supporting local. I love the seating, be it separate tables indoor or outdoor, or community style. I also love how personable the staff is. This will always be my number one brunch place just for those reasons!

Very entertaining!!!  Burger was under cooked but would have been good otherwise! The Sunday Trany bingo was very lively and hilarious! Worth a visit!. TheS'mores desert was yummy and fun over a lil flame... Ha ha no pun intended!

What are they deboning the chicken from scratch? There's at least 5 employees in the lobby.. The car line in the drive thru goes all the way out to the Main Street and the line is hardly moving at all. It just doesn't make sense- avoid this restaurant at all costs! Unless you're obliged to eat here and it's the only thing that is open. This is my first and last time for sure.

Came here to pick up dinner earlier this week and was extremely disappointed. The portions you get for the prices they charge is absurd. I don't mind spending $12.00 plus dollars on a meal when you get a decent amount of food however this was not the case. One meal we ordered was pork carnitas, I took one look at it and thought it was a kids meal. You can see in the photo how pitful the portion is. I would recommend not going here. When spending $12.00 a plate there is plenty of other restaurants who provide more generous portions.

Alright, now I'm one who wouldn't normally stop for hooters at all. I was so hungry me and my family ended up sitting outside at hooters which was a great view! Watched the bridge rise and everything! Now our waitress was not good at all, she was very nice but spilling a drink all over me and then us finding a hair in our food was a little too much. I will say they did take off the wings we found the hair in which was very very nice but I don't think hooters is somewhere I'd want to go again.

The Mitthoefer Road store in Indianapolis, IN. Ordered curbside, hubby sat there over 30 minutes, two phone calls later he finally had to go into store, "manager" was sitting on a bucket smoking outside the whole time. Got out of car and went inside and she said the breadsticks and pizza had just come out of the oven. It had obviously been sitting there the whole time. She asked if he wanted to check it before he took it, but he'd been there so long he figured even if the order was wrong, we'd just eat it (never suspecting how bad it would be). Got it home - it was inedible and there is NO way they didn't know it when it went in the bag. They didn't even cut it into sticks because it was obviously too hard to do - literally like a piece of flat concrete. The pizza was a mess with a tiny bit of cheese in the center. I called about it to get a refund. The "manager" said it was my husband's fault because he didn't check it. WTF!! I said they are accountable for the food being edible, but the manager just insisted that it was my husbands fault and then said I was rude (I was upset but never used any salty language) and hung up on me. This is not just normal incompetence - this is "fire them all and start over" level of the worst customer service we have ever gotten anywhere. This must be made right. We need a refund immediately. I messaged the company on Twitter about it, it was so bad!

Came here for the bread and pastries and left happy. Some stuff were a little bland but the bread had a really nice chew to it and smelled buttery. There's a ton of pastries to choose from to satisfy your specific cravings. Yum!

As we all know bacon makes everything better and apparently it does the same for a business name. I was looking for some place for brunch and I will not lie I picked BB because of the name alone and didn't look at any reviews so I went in blind. To avoid a long drawn out review this place is OUTSTANDING!!! The wait staff are fantastic, professional and entertaining. If you are easily offended this is not the place for delicate ears because "bitch" is a common person, place or thing here. The food and drinks were fantastic and timely. Even though it was a typical Florida sun blast the music and atmosphere made it an outdoor party. Everyone from the staff to the other customers made it an open and inviting environment for all that were there. My new favorite place for brunch (and this was only my second brunch in my life) if I can say that .

Our LG refrigerator/Freezer compressor died. Still under warranty, we contacted Costco, who contacted LG. They'd come. In a month...

So much for their warranty usefulness.

Called Steve Martin Appliance. Steve came out two days later, diagnosed the problem (said compressor). Gave us a quote. Came back the next business day (Friday then Monday). Fixed the device.

Communication was excellent with Steve. Multiple phone calls telling us where he was and when he'd get to our home.

Excellent service. Very professional.

First time ever in Nashville and we wanted to hear some Blues music but we were apparently too early on a Saturday (5 p.m.) in January because the place was pretty slow.  Tried the ribs with beans and cole slaw and they were delicious but not finger-licking delicious.

The catfish was great however I needed the hot sauce from two other tables to finish my meal. All of the bottles had less than an inch in them. Once I was seated my order was taken quickly and my food came soon after. That is where the service ended. I had to get my own hot sauce and sat waiting for 15 minutes for a drink refill. This could be a much better experience if they had better service. The dirty plate sat on my table but they did take the three empty sauce bottles away. The hostess may be an owner or manager but looked more like a homeless woman. I would recommend the food but only if you are patient.

BEST chicken wings in Santa Barbara. I usually don't care about chicken wings, but I care about these. They are smoked, deep fried, and tossed in a spicy garlicky hot wing sauce. They're served with crunchy celery and delicious blue cheese dressing (as they should be). The result is a pungent, finger-licking masterpiece. If you have not tried these, and you like chicken wings, I recommend you go today!

I haven't tried much of the menu, but we also has steamed mussels in white wine sauce (delicious). They have Einstok on tap (score!). I don't like heavy wheat beer, but this Icelandic version is light, crisp and delicious. The Old School cocktail was great if you're in more of a whiskey mood.

I'm disabled and getting unable to clean my small 300 sq ft cottage. I agreed a week prior for Charlene to come in and clean before my girlfriend's surgery. I wanted the house as clean as I could. Set for 1:15 pm I set my day around her timeframe. She cancelled the 1:15 time slot and then asked for 3 pm, so I hung around some more. At 2:45 she texted we could do it tomorrow, which is surgery day and too late. At that point we cancelled and thanked her for her time. So decent communication but she really left me hanging...
Absolutely legit the torta is just like Mexico City right on points well worth the time well worth the visit come here and get the beer special

Awesome little dive. Visited on a Tuesday night and it was packed so I grabbed a seat at the bar.. Had a cup of seafood gumbo and blackened catfish with Randolph sauce. Both were excellent.. I will definitely visit here again.. Parking is limited out front, but there is plenty of room behind the restaurant

Thank you Moana for asking people to be socially responsible and continue to wear masks. Providing bandanas when at your store shows your dedication to your staff and customers. With so much unknown about this virus, asking people to follow this precaution is extremely appreciated and necessary (made obvious by the many people back out with no masks). Also, your customer service and ability to answer questions goes far beyond any of the larger, chain stores in town. When I need expertise, I'm always headed to Moana first!

OMGosh!!!! Wowzers!!! A loss for words!! This place should have its own restaurant ! Not saying Uswirl isn't the bomb , but this place deserves a better location hands down! I didn't even know it existed. I went to uswirl for a treat and came out with a master piece sandwich! I'm 7 months pregnant so ofcourse my cravings took over the menu. I wanted a bit of everything haha . So I asked to talk to the chef . I told him I liked the way a few of his sandwiches looked but only needed one sandwich . So he took his time to help me create the exact thing my taste budz were searching for. From the Texas toast to the 3 cheese with sausage , bacon , burger, pulled pork with bbq sauce to the egg with a side of slaw. Mmmm sooo yummy! I had to call all my friends and tell them!! Earlier that day I had been crying and cursing people out at the doctors office dealing with pharmacy problems. I'm type 1 diabetic so my sugar levels were all out of whack and I just needed some friendly service with a smile and something tasty too boot. I got everything I wished for and then some . Thank chef guy who ever you are you truly made me happy !!!

First time this morning for breakfast-- really good lattes and coffee. The eggs were cage free and delicious. The grits were excellent. All around great meal.

The only drawback was the amount of pepper on the potatoes. I'm not a pepper person but they were excellent.
Order was wrong. Barely meat on tacos. Queso fundito was just a lump of cheese. Missed items. Insisted it was right and quality was good. Horrible customer service.

Yes try this place for coffee! Worth a little walk to get off the main drag and get delish coffee and bakery. We sat here with our group and planned our day in Nashville! Perfect way to start the adventure!

The server was friendly.  She asked us if our food was good.  I kindly told her that my chicken was tough, likely overcooked.  Other than to "bring it to the attention of the cooks", no offer was made to correct the situation.  This was my first trip here and my friend's third visit. My friend told me that this was his third and last visit there since the food was bad two of the three times.

The place was dead from noon to 1pm on a Monday. There was only one other table with customers.
I used CTS towing and transport, and I'm very upset with their timeliness, lies over the phone and lack of accountability.
The best place for ice cream in Santa Barbara. Well worth the price. The only thing that isn't great is the parking.

I've been there twice, first time was great.... good service, great food.  Last night was a different story.  Granted it was very busy, but when I asked our server for silverware, and she informed me I was welcome to go up to the bar myself and obtain some silver ware, I would've walked out if I hadn't been with friends.  The audacious manner the server suggested i could serve myself indicates to me that Riellys, last night at least, did not have the staff experience, staff capacity, and kitchen management experience to serve the number of guests they allowed through the doors.  Nice place....good beer, good food......but if you're opposed to bringing your own silverware, then I suggest you visit on a slow night or just go somewhere where service is managed well.

Disappointing....that's all... I asked for my food to be suicide hot and there was absolutely no spice to it at all. I asked for extra sauces on the side also there were none. It came with one fork I guess I should've asked for chopsticks. The spring rolls all be it delicious look like a nine-year-old had made them.... just so so food sadly...

Came off my flight and stopped in here with for a "double shot" which is 30min massage.. 

Pros:
Professional massage 
Location, quick and ease of no line/wait.. 
Price
Staff, friendly and nice!!


Cons: 
NA. 

Meh;
Sitting massage only, no laying down here.
Can be a bit drafty /cold as at a major walkway of the airport. 

Update: came back in for a single shot on the flight out.

how many times do I need to fax in a claim form?  Count 4 ... As I said earlier, I have nicknamed them Pets Worst.... once I'm finished with my boy's treatment, I'll be taking both dogs off and finding a better plan....

This place has fantastic food. They open at 10 on Sundays but we arrived at 9:30 and they were kind enough to seat us. The crepe was fantastic but the french toast was to die for - preference will depend on sweet vs salty. It's the cutest atmosphere also.

I'm gonna have to give this place one star. We went there a few months ago and the initial experience warranted 2.5 stars, the food was decent and the service was friendly but slow.

The upside: the food was quite tasty. My boyfriend and I both got the same thing, the bison burger, and it was juicy, perfectly cooked, and the condiments/build of the burger was great.

The downsides: The service was slow. Sloooooooooow. We weren't expecting anything amazing - we came in at a strange time on a strange day, though obviously it was during operating hours - but the server was totally MIA for most of the meal, didn't want to refill my drink (I had water for gods' sake, and I like to drink a lot of it - it was a hot day and a nice glass of ice water was all I wanted after walking around Center City for hours). As others have said, the time it took to have our orders taken and then have the food brought out was definitely stretching my patience thin, especially as I was quite hungry and not drinking alcohol.

But overall it wasn't a horrible experience. However, because of the exceptionally slow/semi-nonexistent service, we 'only' tipped a tiny bit over 15%. My boyfriend paid by debit card and always writes in the tip on his copy of the receipt and saves it.

A few days later, he checked his bank statement, and the charge from the restaurant seemed a tad bit too high. He went back and checked and yup - the charge was about $2 higher than what it should have been. Apparently the waitress wasn't happy with a 15% tip...

Now, it's only $2, not like being defrauded out of some life-altering sum. But it was the principle of the matter that was, to us, unacceptable. When he called and asked to speak with the manager, whoever he got on the line was very polite and corrected the problem very promptly and professionally, so they do get props for that. But unfortunately having waitstaff that changes the amounts on the receipts after it's signed is a bad enough detraction that I'm going to have to give it one star.

Came here after work to get some quick dinner before hubby had to go to work and my food took forever to come out. Was pissed about my food sitting under the warmer for over 8 minutes. Michelle was more than happy to remake it and she made our visit much better. Hubby was pissed about being late to work but she got our mood back great. I also noticed other people just walking around but Michelle and some red hair guy who took our order were constantly checking on us and other guest. I ONLY GAVE THIS PLACE A 4 BECAUSE OF MICHELLE. I will only ask for her when I come and if she's not there I just will choose something else. Thanks Michelle. you ROCK

We are loyal customers of Osteria Natalina for many years.  Last night, we had our first take-out experience and it was wonderful.  We called the main number and spoke to Adolfo, the owner, who told us about the specials.  I had the flounder special which came prepared puttanesca style with capers, tomato, and shellfish; it came with a side of ziti and fresh vegetables.  My husband ordered the strozzapretti with red sauce.  OMG, the food was absolutey fabulous.  My fish was cooked perfectly - soft, light and juice. It came in a beautiful, partitioned container so the sauces stayed separate - yes, this matters to me! My husband's pasta was so good he ate multiple slices of bread to soak up all the delicious sauce.  Once again, I highly recommend this restaurant, certainly one of the best in South Tampa.  Tutto buono!

They take forever to give you your food average 15 minutes but they take your money right away I don't understand what takes so long for pretzels and a snack wrap. I once had a girl tap her fingernails at me like she's waiting on me but hadn't made the food how rude.And you can't give one to napkin in the drive-through give me a break

I needed a windshield replacement and Dent Devil - Clayton had a great price and the service was completed quickly at the time that was set for the service. Very friendly and excellent service. I highly recommend.

Good chicken wings. Good lo mein noodles. Fast service and lots of parking. Their delivery is ok.. I think they are looking for a delivery driver right now. It states NO MSG on their menu. I called and asked before and i think someone said they used a little. I could be wrong on that.

For Indy, they have the best donuts I have tasted.  However, it took 5 years or the right kind of donuts to form this opinion.  At my work, for Donuts with Dad, they try to buy a variety of donuts for the Father's Day event.  I was amazed this year by the honey buns and the glazed donut.

I was so looking forward to this place.

We went on a day when Kenny Chesney was playing across the street, so it was busy. I get that, no problem.

However, we were given a menu that was rather...thin. After ordering something we didn't want, we started seeing other people having food not on our menu delivered to them.

Could we not have been offered the other menu that was put out five minutes after we sat?

The view was great. The food? For the price...very overpriced. Very nice people, but really, four people, one drink each, and a small meal nearly $200?

Don't mind paying for a great meal, but I do for a sub-par one.
I had a Yelp offer for a free chips and salsa. They just said no....Super poor customer service. What a shame.

I initially wanted to come here for nerdy reasons I will describe later, but also heard they have great breakfast and invented bananas foster. When I tried to get a reservation, it seemed they were all booked, but luckily one morning I managed to snag a 1:30 reservation for the same day.
