My wife and I both got the two-course breakfast and between us had each of the four dishes. The seafood gumbo was delicious, and I usually don't like seafood. The baked apple was pretty good, I especially liked the oatmeal on top. The eggs hussarde were fantastic. I particularly appreciated the home-made English muffin. Unfortunately I didn't get to try the eggs sardou because my wife ate them all without giving me a taste. They looked good and she loved them.

As for the bananas foster: We only ordered it because it seems to be the thing to do here. I generally care little for both bananas and ice cream. Boy am I glad we got it. The tableside preparation is a fun show, and the dish was excellent.

Our server, Sven, went above and beyond. At the end of the meal, I asked if it would be possible to see the Morphy room upstairs. Yes, the reason I initially wanted to come here was because it used to be chess legend Paul Morphy's house. I'm really glad I happened to find out that Brennan's has a room dedicated to him so I knew to ask to see it. He graciously took us upstairs, told us a bit about the room and the other upstairs rooms, took photos for us, and told us we could hang out upstairs as long as we wanted. Thank you Sven!

Brennan's was one of the highlights of my visit to the city, and I consider eating there and getting the upstairs tour a must for any visitors, even if you don't care about Paul Morphy.

One final note to Brennan's: please get new chess pieces for the table in the Morphy room. A few of the pieces don't match (there were some oddly sized pawns), which is a little janky but I don't really care, but black had four bishops and no knights. That is a crime against chess and can be fixed easily and without too much expense, so please get new pieces. Yes, there are some ludicrously expensive chess pieces, but there are also affordable sets that would be completely appropriate.

Went for family dinner on Friday night here, and absolutely loved everything we ordered, prices are slightly on the higher side for some specialty rolls but regular are pretty much average. Our food was fresh and delicious. I also liked interior of the restaurant and atmosphere, even though most of the staff didn't speak much English , they made sure we were satisfied, service was good.

This was probably my favorite restaurant while I was visiting NOLA. So good I came back the next day for more of that crawfish etouffee. Must have the crabby wife or the creole slammer. The restaurant is super small so expect a wait but they move people quickly.

Just a note that we still love Cafe Cret - although it is very expensive and a cup of soup is $4.75.  OUCH!!!!

BUT we have to let you know about the fabulous Le Bus chocolate chip cookies.  They are the reason my daughter is giving Cafe Cret 5 stars.  If you get them heated up (ask the guy to do it) they are heaven on a plate.  For $1.08 (with tax) it' s a great winter warm up.

Terrific service from the guys & gals who work here, especially Emily (who may have left by now).  Many are college and post-college aged students.

Great service ..  Great pizza and amazing staff!!   My first visit and experience at MOD was in Houston, Texas.  OMG....I was flabbergasted!!!   Delicious....and the price....OUTRAGEOUS!!   You won't get a savory, all you can put on it, mouth watering pizza anywhere else.  The price is amazing!!!!!! Now, I recently moved to the area (Wesley Chapel) and I CAN WALK to the place  .  I am truly excited and happy I can get my pizza and SALAD  too!!  Ya'll need to try it.....at least once!   You won't regret it!!

The steak scramble was everything I thought it would be. I literally have no complaints. Eggs were perfect, toast was flavorful, potatoes packed with flavor and perfectly salty, steak was delicious. Great breakfast vibe, friendly staff. Totally recommend!!

Finally, a tour guide , Milaka, that could be heard and was very informative and entertaining. I would defiantly request her again. I said finally because a previous tour through pelican New Orleans and Cajun encounters was terrible and overpriced.
Great pizza but the guy who was making it wasn't wearing gloves so he touches all of the ingredients with his bare hands. I will not go back there again.
Gyro was awesome! Greek salad was perfect! This is my go to place for a Gyro in FVH! Place looks shabby, but don't let that freak you out.  This is the real deal!

If you like dark smoke bars this is your place to party. They have two pool tables a large patio area and a good size bar but this is a true dive bar. If that's what you are looking for this is your place. This however was not what we were looking for so we shoved off down the street.
on the jimmy johns website it says they deliver within 5 miles I live in that radius and I call the place and they say they don't deliver to my address pos the sandwiches aren't that good any way

Ordered the spicy shrimp taco & the avocado and fried onion taco. It was all delicious! I used Uber Eats which was a plus! Only downside is I asked & paid for extra sour cream & never got it. Boo. But otherwise awesome food!

Interior is fresh and clean, the have a dining room area the looked nice as well. I picked up a Italian hoagie with fries to go so I don't have too much to add on service. The person taking the orders was nice.

The Italian hoagie was well made but seemed a little more salty than others I have had. 

The side of fries was crisp, hot and salted normally.

Giving them a 3 just for the salty hoagie. Will try again but something different to raise the rating if warranted.

I found Mountaineer By Accident when I was trying out Melt'd. The Person working there was a complete delight. ( These New Port Richey food indusrty workers all seem very sweet and helpful) I had just eaten so I only got a Latte.... It was so thick and tasty and looked beautiful. check it out in the attached pic. They have all sorts of really delicious looking Pastries. including what I believe was a homemade pop tart styled one.  I will definitely be frequenting this place for Coffee and those sweet looking pop tarts!

I love this theater.  My husband and I met Bruce Campbell here a few years ago.  We also saw Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade with a group of friends in college before we 'officially' began dating.  So, this theater is near and dear to my heart.  What's more, I do indie films and videos, and this is a great theater for watching such works.

I am a resident and I am looking to move ASAP.
I would not recommend living in Emerald Pointe Apartments. Handicap is not ADA compliant. Tow trucks drive around parking lot looking to tow whatever they can. While moving in I didn't have a parking deal on the truck and the tow truck driver told us if we left the truck in the parking spot while unloading furniture he would tow. The office personnel said that is policy. Guest parking is very limited and most of guest have to park off of the appointment complex property. You will also be charged a fee for exterminator. I live on the second floor and I have to pay an outside exterminator. I have lived here for 7 months and the list of problems is long. We have had to call police several times for partying at 3am. We called the office and they have done nothing about the problems. We have to call more than once for maintenance to come to fix issues. If you read this and still decide to move into these apartments I hope you don't have the same experience we have had.

What an awesome little place in the bywater. Looks so cool inside and there is a cute patio seating area outside. 

Cajun Hot Spiced Buttered Rum Popcorn - I didn't know something this delicious and unique was possible but it is and you can only get it at Oxalis. 
Frites with two sauces- also excellent. I'm a sucker for fries with aioli. Their burger is one of the best in the cities. And it's not huge but the perfect size, all fresh ingredients.

i am so happy this place exists and that i live close to it!  i had the clooney's choice sandwich and it was very good.  i totally appreciate the time and care taken to make the sandwiches, and the good, friendly customer service.  i also like the lollipop touch.  i'm looking forward  to trying many other things on the menu!

Not your average Mexican joint. Don't go here and expect to get a regular taco. Most things on the menu are probably not too healthy, so you should probably jog here if you live near by. But it is a trendy little joint in Ybor, where I usually try to stay away from. 

I had the fish tacos and dont regret it, but i do wish the combo came with one more taco. I would go there again because fried tacos taste good, hell you can fry anything and it will taste good. But seriously, most people are gonna either love it or hate it so stop listening to me and try it yourself.

Been going here several nice it opened. My daughter loves the playground and the food is great! Can get pretty crowded and refills are tough to get when busy. Have a few gluten free options that make the wife happy. Clean store with baby changing tables as well

Wonder of wonders, I have finally found a place that serves non-Belgian beers that are still palatable. Normally, I'm a fruity, flowery lambic sort of lass because I find most beers to be bitter and icky, probably due to the overuse of hops. Three of Dock Street's beers, the Summer Session (wheat beer with lemongrass and ginger), the Dunkel Berliner Weisse (sort of sour, not bitter, and odd notes of fruit and chocolate, depending on the sip), and the Sudan Grass (sorghum-based **gluten-free** beer, with wildflower honey, hibiscus, lemon grass, rooibos, and rose hips) have made drinking beer actually enjoyable. The only thing I find frustrating is that they tend to rotate out my fav beers and rotate in ones I'm not interested in, but at least they come back. If you happen to be a beer aficionado, I recommend the sampler, which offers 6 small but filling glasses of each beer they have that day. It's a good way to get a taste of their selection and get a bit tipsy while doing so.
Their pizza is pretty pricey, and I tend to avoid it since it's full of evil cheese and tomatoes, but it's very high quality and quite delicious even without cheese. They do offer a vegan option, but since it still has evil tomatoes, I avoid it, though I'm contemplating asking for a tomato-free version. Their hummus platter and fries trio (potato, sweet potato, and leek) are my favorite things to eat here, and are reasonably priced.
This place is a hidden gem. The food is always great. My husband and I love their omelettes. Good home country cooking. The place is kid friendly too.

Please avoid this place. The food is not fresh and overall seems very unhygenic place. I really wish FDA/local authority reviews this place as its below standard and a health hazard. Do not waste your time and money here.
I'm going to say "amazing" .  I walked into my friends business with a box and he said no you didn't.  The best!

I really wanted to love Drake's after hearing great things and seeing the reviews. But, I would quickly choose a different restaurant over Drake's than wait and hour and 15 minutes to have super slow service and cold food. Our server was good, but slow, and appeared to not be focused on being at work that night. The couple sitting next to us even made a comment about it. Our drinks were good, but had to wait a while for them and for refills. The sushi was probably the best part of the meal. That came out quickly and was wonderful. Our burger and fries tasted like they had been sitting in the back fit some time. The server did bring us new fries, which was good, but the burger was dry and cold. Overall, I have no desire to go back. I really wanted to love it.
Super cool place to earn a little extra money. very friendly staff as well, highly recommende.

I have attempted to eat at Dizengoff twice, both times very close to when they close at 4pm, (if they haven't run out of hummus yet!) The second time, on Black Friday, turned out to be a success. So, I did not have to deal with any lunch rush, line, or wait, which was awesome. I love the feel of the place and the rotating menu - my boyfriend and I split two different vegetarian hummus kinds, one with Tabuleh salad and one with Tahini. 

The hummus and pita came quickly to our table, with a few pickled items and a bit of salad. If you have ever had the hummus at Zahav, you are aware of the ridiculously creamy and delicious texture that is possible with this hummus. If you have not, be prepared to be amazed. It is seriously some of the best hummus I have ever had. I found the amount of food to be perfect and didn't feel like a second pillowy pita was necessary, although I am sure that I could have managed to eat one! 

We felt a tiny bit rushed just because they were closing up and we were the last customers in the place, but that wasn't a problem. Honestly, my only problem is the price. I know it's right in center city and has a chef's name attached, but chickpeas don't cost $9-11. If this place was a couple bucks cheaper, I would probably come all the time. However, I'm still looking for an excuse to go back ASAP.

Had to say something:
Yesterday evening my wife and I had dinner at Sushi Garden on Broadway to kick off the first day of the Semester, and we were very disappointed. We were kind of forced to settle for SG because our go-to was closed, but we knew going to SG would be pricey--but we were sort of celebrating. 
It is with pain that I have to write this, which something I don't normally do, but quite honestly the sushi we had was the worst we have ever had in our lives. 
The nigiri was room temperature and sweaty. The cuts of sushi were so jagged the roll would fall apart (resembled someone trying to cut the sushi with a butter knife) and the size pieces were massively inconsistent, some sizes of the sam roll took multiple bites and others could be one. 
None of this would have been an issue if the sushi tasted fine -- which it was below-average at best. Which is disappointing considering Sushi Garden is close to 50% more expensive than other restaurants (did I mention it's expensive here?).
Service was OK. This review is not necessarily about the hosts/servers. But we did have to wait quite a while for a full order. It was strange that 5 minutes after we ordered we got the tempura-style (fried) sushi and then nearly 45 minutes later we get the "cold" (room-temperature) sushi.
In the future, my wife and I will make sure that we plan our sushi-night for a place thats been far more consistent and more reasonably priced (for the record: we had 2 different nigiris and 5 different rolls for $90, ouch.)

This place is a great place to eat from the friendly greetings to the awesome food that is delivered in huge portions and of course our waiter was a very respectful young man this restaurant is the best
The food was good and the atmosphere was nice. I didn't like the bloody marry, I thought it was to sweet.

Woohoo! Online ordering on the website with payment by credit card or Paypal!

We order pizza nearly every Friday night and are Luigi's regulars calling them every other week. Now that I can order and pay online, I don't have to scrounge for cash.

Yay, Luigi's!

We love this place! Happy Hour, dinner, whatever, there is always a reason to go to Borgne. I've literally been there twice this past week. If you like to sit at the bar, Max is always great and highly recommend the Jazz fest lemonade in the summer. Katie took care of us on the floor. She is the best at explaining all the intricacies of each dish. She guided us well with the shrimp toast-this is a must have. Also, you can never go wrong with any of the fish entrees! I particularly love the fish in a bag!

I absolutely love Dr. Blake's office! He transformed my smile which gave me an extra boost of confidence! He is very gentle and I've always experienced a pain free visit regardless the type of exam. The office itself is a chic boutique with wonderful staff. At my most recent visit, Jess was my hygienist and I absolutely loved her! She introduced a new treatment called Sodium Fluoride Varnish which I happily accept. She educated me on the benefits of the additional treatment.

Came here on a Saturday. There was a little bit of a wait and we had to line up outside, I understand and I wasn't bothered by it. The staff was very friendly and everything looked amazing. I ordered the spinach and artichoke quiche and an iced late,  both very good! I would come back and definitely next time I would order some of their other pastries

I was in attendance at the Millwoods Town Centre mall location this morning.
1 person on at front desk, and was not "addressed" for over 15 minutes, when eventually another worker finally made an appearance.

I had lost my glasses, and am currently out of town visiting.  This was the closest location to where I am visiting.

I phoned my optometrist and asked for the specs.  Wrote them down, as presented to me in the e-mail.  

Upon finally being recognized, the clerk wanted a screen shot, to which after review, they were asking to fax my optometrist for the prescription.  Finally accepted the email.  

To top it off, not only was the staff rude, and ignorant, the direct debit pay machine was not working.

VERY POOR ATTITUDE FROM STAFF.  WISH I COULD MARK A MORE NEGATIVE MARK ON THE "STAR" RATING SYSTEM.  

DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS STORE DUE TO SUCH A NEGATIVE EXPERIENCE.

Went on Valentines Day and left without eating. My family and I eat here a lot and  love the food and people who used to work there.Lately it's been new wait staff and when we got there on 2/14 there was 2 of the wait staff sitting at front counter just visiting, only saw them and 2 people at the grill and one lady behind the bar. They went to seat us and I was in shock, the place was filthy,  dirty tables every where and trash, silverware, chopsticks, food and stuff on the floor, I looked over at the food bar where you build your bowl and it was nasty, food spilled all over it. I told my daughter come on let's go, I was not going to eat somewhere it was so filthy, couldn't believe waitstaff just sitting there talking when the place was such a mess.
Food is good.  Service is good. Outside Hostess hasn't stopped looking at her "hidden" cell phone all night.

It depends on who waits on you here, on what kind of service you will get.  I picked up my 3rd and 4th replacement of the EVO 4G LTE.  I recommend a Tech by the name of Alicia or a sales Rep. by the name of Jorge Teran.  He set up the phone to where it was almost back to the state of my last one.  before the guy just sent me out with a phone I needed to re-download everything and update most of the programs on it.  The manager here sucks because when I asked for his help, he did not come over but sent someone else who couldn't do what a manager could.
But this was a pleasant experience.

I know when I need a special arrangement that Thistle is the place :) 
Whether it be a bunch just for fun, for a celebration of life, I know that Carly and everyone at Thistle will create something beautiful and unique.

Made a return visit to Santa Barbara, can't get enough of this picturesque city! Decided to stop at Sunshine Cafe, Yelp pics of their food items looked cool! Ordered breakfast burrito, they use whole pinto beans which gives the burrito an authentic taste. Potatoes on side with green onion topping were very good. BLT sandwich very hearty, and coffee nice and strong! Recommended!

Amazing ribs!  Great pulled pork! 

Love the picnic tables, the fast service, and the personality behind the counter.  Walked the three miles back to Hilton at the Ballpark which turned out to be a great idea as I ate a full rack plus an additional side of pulled pork.  I am a huge hot link fan and judge my BBQ joints on the quality of the sausage they put out.  As good as the ribs and pulled pork are and as cool as it is to see Memphis in May trophy's in the place, the hot link is a bust.  Like Nacho Libre, wear your stretchy pants.

If you're looking for a place to get something authentic Santa Barbara this is it. Best ice cream I've ever had hands down, I bring all my out of town guests here. 

The ice cream is creamy and rich, and the flavors are insane, unlike anything you've seen. Eureka lemon and Marion berries, Turkish coffee, whiskey praline! It's endless, but all are incredible and taste natural. Cardamom tastes like it! 

Not only is the ice cream excellent quality the service is always awesome. The workers are friendly and laid back, they give great recommendations and let you try whatever flavors you'd like before buying. The cookies are fantastic too, pretty much anything you can buy there is excellent quality. 

The first time I came here I had international guests visiting for my wedding, we were served by the manager who gave me free cookies as a congratulations- I told him I would bring all my guests there and I've done that ever since. One of my favorite places.
This was just my first visit, but if everything else was as good as one of the best burgers ive had in my life just was, I shall return! Do yourself a favor and get the Tuscan Burger.

This was so cool, my husband and I stopped in for a treat after dinner and the staff was very patient with us first timers and even explained everything to us, answered a lot of questions and made us the best dessert in the end!

A fresh gem of healthy, tasty food in a city where the options in this regard can be limited. 

Great atmosphere for breakfast, a day of work or happy hour.
Great muffins, cookies, breakfast and awesome coffee!!! Pretty darn good customer service too! My favorite neighborhood shop!

I work across the street from Dimples. I had an issue with the shirt I was wearing. I went over for some assistance and ideas on how to rectify the issue I was having. The team at this place went above and beyond to help solve this issue for me. Thank you for helping me out of this little jam You just gained a new customer.

I like this place because of the service and the shrimp and grits. I have never had it before and it was delicious. I'm from California so grits was surprisingly like mash potatoes. Not your boxed grits. What drove me here was the well made drink French 73 which I was unimpressed with. The salad with beets was just that. Beautiful old school NOLA building. The maître d' didn't keep me waiting more than 7 mins. Have patience  and enjoy!
Beautiful day of 61 degrees to walk around the grounds! This is such a gorgeous pavilion and with the history, it is always our pleasure to enjoy!
Excellent food and great service. Loved the surf and turf tacos. My son loves their burgers. Fresh food and well prepared. Good for just about any occasion.
Staff is very nice but unfortunately I won't go back. The wait for our food was over an hour. We sat outside as inside was just too loud.

I am not generally a fan of buffets and cafeterias.  Like most, Gray Brothers does tend to overcook a lot of their foods like the pork and roast beef entrees.  The green beans are also "well done" instead of al dente.  And their pies have several inches of rich meringue that overwhelm the otherwise delicious pies.  So, why four stars?  There are a number of items available that are really good!

  I like to get the dark chicken for an entree.  Lightly breaded and seasoned, the chicken is tender, juicy, and lets the flavors of chicken and a bit of salt come through.  The light crunch of the breading is a nice touch.  They are generous with the portions as well.  I got 2 thighs and a leg for under $5.

  I also like the pasta & broccoli salad.  Nicely balanced between spiral pasta and veggies, there is a sweetness to the side dish and the diced red onion makes a nice savory addition.  I definitely recommend this.

 For a side, one of my favorites are the beets.  These small whole baby beets are cooked thoroughly and are bathed in a semi-sweet sauce.  There is enough beet flavor to avoid being masked by the sauce.  Give it a try!

  The line workers are more efficient than friendly, but the staff attending the dining area seem to be a bit more welcoming.  Although you usually carry your own tray of food and beverages, the staff will clear your empty dishes, refill your beverages, and fetch a "to go" box if your eyes are bigger than your stomach capacity.  

  My wife and I don't usually dine in.  We prefer to go to the west end of the building where there is a carry out section.  It does have fewer options than the main restaurant, but most of the favorites are there.  The carry out is a great place to stop and get "home cooked" quality food without any of the fuss and dishes.

Review #445

This is a fantastic and unique place to visit. Management does a great job welcoming new people and rolling out the red carpet to existing customers. The drinks and snacks are similar to Starbucks. It's alway clean and quaint.

If you are into live music venues, they often have live bluegrass and Americana music on Fridays and Saturdays. The WiFi is solid and there are plenty of plugs for laptops. Outdoor seating is available in good weather, but indoor seating is available year round. The best thing about this locale is the mood. It truly is an original.

I've seen Chestnut Hall evolve for the past decade, and the space that Beiler's Donuts occupies now has seen its fair share of changes. From a mediocre westernized Chinese restaurant, to an empty room, to a cafe that fought so valiantly to be good (but failed) - and finally to Beiler's, which most definitely has found a home. Brightly lit, with feels of an old-fashioned doughnut joint, it's comfortable and enticing for both lounging and studying. Trays of unique and traditional flavors sit behind glass cases, and the aromas are mouthwatering. I don't know too much about the ice cream, but that's not the highlight of the doughnut parlor anyways. My favorite is the apple fritter. I've always wanted to venture outside that heavenly piece of dough, but I find myself going back to that one. It's moist and chewy, not too sweet, with hints of tastes, reminiscent of warm apple pie. Not your average cream-filled or iced doughnut, the fritter feels lighter. The more traditional doughnuts that stand out are the chocolate frosted M&M doughtnut and the apple harvest. The former is topped with a fudgy icing that seems as though it was freshly spread, not like the stale, hard type you find at Dunkin Donuts (sorry DD fans!), but the kind that you'll lick off the spatula when baking. A bite of the apple harvest is an explosive trio of a vanilla cream frosting, lightly powdered cinnamon, and a smooth apple pie filling, reminiscent of warm apple pie (am I getting repetitive)? But seriously, Beiler's and apples, you can't go wrong. And the prices deserve 5 stars as well! I think I spent around $6 on 6 donuts?? Anyways, my point is that these doughnuts are perfect at any time of day: in the morning for breakfast with a cup of coffee; a midday snack; dessert after dinner; and perhaps a box of a dozen, set aside to be devoured as drunk munchies.

Scheduled appointment for Sam to check our freezer. He was prompt. He was unable to diagnose the problem. He told me that he would need $225 to run a check on the system. I asked for more details -- he started to get short with me as if I was questioning his ability to do the service. When I asked for more details on what the trouble could be, he was not clear and highlighted a bunch of possible problems. When I pressed for more information he became rude. I lost confidence in his ability. I wrote him a check for the service call and asked him to leave. He has received similar reviews on Superpages.com -- can't believe I didn't check first.

I'm giving this 4 stars for the service more than the food.
I found myself hungry and had like 5 hours before dinner so we decided to pop into this place to get some gumbo. Boy am I glad we did. I got the YAYA Gumbo with a bit of everything and Brad got the seafood Gumbo. Both were delicious with the bread our waitress brought us.
What I was most impressed with though is our precious waitress Jasmine. I asked if they had any wet wipes for my hands before I ate and she said they didn't but came back with a bowl of hot water and two clean towels. One to wet for cleaning and one to dry. 
I'm going to tell you that I eat out a lot and have not had someone to go out of their way in that manner in quite some time.
So, the food was good, probably about the same as most places there but the service was above and beyond. 
Thank you so much sweet Jasmine.

Wish I could give George more than 5 stars. Walked in today to have a vintage watch repaired and its battery changed. In the past, other jewelers had been unable to open the watch to swap the battery because the back requires a special tool to be opened. I was about to send it to the manufacturer and have to pay a substantial amount of money for the repair when I came across George. I walked in and in less than 10min he opened the watch, replaced the battery, and fixed the broken clasp. Further, he charged me only $8. I was so happy and in complete disbelief. George is an absolute gem, kind, and considerate of his clients. I will definitely return in the future and hope his business continues to thrive.

After a lot of searching, we came to this super store. Everything is laid out so you can see how it might look. 

We found our porcelain floor tiles and came back and found our backsplash for the kitchen. 

Celia helped us so much with insight and candor. She is just there to guide u, not sell u. 
And she gave us a great lead for an installer  that specializes in porcelain tiles. 

If we do a island I found a super red granite I would love to sit at. 

Super store for adults with Cash.

I'm so glad I gave them another chance. Great service (unlike the previous review), quick service, despite being obviously super busy, and delicious food. We were also able to get plenty of coffee unlike last time too. I ordered the poutine slinger, very happy w the delicious savory and not too spicy sauce, crispy and will seasoned potatoes, fluffy eggs and delicious cheese curds. Our server let us know the chicken biscuit isn't super big, but a great side item. After hearing that the chicken French toast was actually just 1 piece of bread, I switched so I could get my chicken fix otherwise, but still get plenty of food. Apparently the regular order is 3 half slices of, so you're actually getting less if you get the fancy fried chicken French toast w only 1 slice of bread. Glad I asked and glad for the info.
Sooooo good!!! Packed so I suggest using Yelp's waitlist feature. This saved us a lot of time standing around waiting for our table. The food was well worth the wait. Nice portions and so delicious.
Great food and margaritas. My girlfriends and I enjoyed everything, service included. The staff was great and I love the decor. Can't wait to come back!
Had a great overall stay. Room was very clean and comfortable. King bed was very nice. Had friends come to bar and enjoyed Stl.

What a wonderful evening!  I couldn't have picked a more perfect spot.  As a solo traveler, I always appreciate a good bar.  Caitlin, the bartender, was so wonderfully accommodating and personally designed several tasty cocktails that were on the menu.  The food was fabulous and the service was quick. The live music was spot on and easy to listen too but didn't interfere with conversation.  I ended up at closing time which rarely happens in my world.
Really great pastries for an American bakery! I love the atmosphere too. It's a very nice place for tasty desserts.

I came here with some coworkers in the morning after an overnight shift. We made our own tacos with delicious barbacoa, chorizo, and other toppings. What a meal! I would definitely come back and bring friends.
I'll never visit Nashville again without stopping at Prince's Nashville Hot Chicken. They invented it, they know what they are doing. I had the 2X hot.

Food was good. I had the catfish, baked potato, corn (need some seasoning and butter) and the biscuits. The manager was so sweet and all the staff very nice. I will have to try their location in Las Vegas.

Aric was great! I have a multitude of issues that he was able to work out. Neck, legs, I didn't think I had an IT band issue... well I've got a whole bigger issue that the IT band is just a part of and he was explaining it. I've had multiple surgeries and I have MS. Which means I'm kinda a hot mess. He asks questions to get to the actual root of the issues. Not rushed at all. He was able to release some horribly tight muscles and some of the tension I've been carrying for months. I'm not into the whale songs and chirping birds and he put on a cool mix that was perfect. He obviously cares about what he is doing. I was feeling chatty and so he was cool about talking which was cool. The location is a little strange at first. (I'm new to the area) Until you realize it is an artist collaborative. So when you drive up and it is after dark, don't worry ladies, it's legit. ;)

I had an appoint time of 1pm and as My feet soaked in cold water at 1:45 I was told it would be another 10 minutes before I would get helped. I have been a loyal customer and spent plenty of money and tip well and this treatment was not right. Why even have appointment times if you can't honor them? I felt like I was being punished for the person in front of me being late.  Unfortunately this is not the first time I have had with this place.  And my family has had issues with this place getting yelled at by nail tech. Needless to say I will not be coming back. And wouldn't recommend anyone going there either.

PJ's for brunch on the outside patio was awesome. The patio is so pretty with umbrellaed tables and flowers.

Started with a Bloody Cesar and a Bloody Maria.  Perfectly made and very refreshing on a Sunday late morning. 

Brunch was Country Eggs Benedict, too large to finish in one sitting. Yummy with a side of potatoes.  I of course love the Wolf Pack so had the Back the Pack pancakes stuffed with blueberries and bits of bacon. So delicious.  

Tables around us had delicious looking burgers and onion rings. Large mimosas at another table. 
Excellent service by our waitress.  Can't wait to return for another breakfast/brunch.

Its a Good place place clean and small it's 7 pm and it was packed I little bit of wait but not bad food is above average and the sausage cooked in oyster oil was awesome and had that kick to it not hot nor bland mild had lot of flavor.

Huge store. Huge.

Lots of home decor and crafts. And when a big holiday is coming up, you can be guaranteed that the store is going to be decked out with all sorts of decorating ideas.

They cover a lot of different styles, from farmhouse chic to lake cabin man caves to beach house aqua vibes.

On days there are great sales going on, you can save a bundle with discounts of 30-40% abounding.

They don't have a lot of furniture, and don't expect anything that won't just last a few years, but some of the prices are pretty good.
Everything was amazing! The salad I had was my favorite thing I ate while visiting St. Charles.

I had heard wonderful things about Suzy Wong's so I had high expectations of not only the food, but of the service as well.  I was disappointed.  The appetizer I ordered never showed up because my server never even placed my order for it.  I think it was pretty clear that I was ordering it as opposed to just asking about her opinion of it when I said "I'll take that".  My friend ordered the edamame, and when it came, most of it was ice cold, only a few of the beans on top were warm.  We had to stop another server to send the first dish of edamame back.  It came out the same way the second time, so after that we just gave it up as a lost cause.  The General Tso's chicken was good, and so was the Chicken Panang, but the fact that it was just good, and the subpar service we got means I probably won't go again.

Not sure that I like this place as much now as I did before. They could do a much better job at vacuuming the car out & wiping down the I side but they are rushing & not doing even a semi-thorough job....
Disappointed!!

OMG WHAT A CUTE PLACE!!!
I have three words....SPELLBOUND!!! KANE!!! TONEWOOD!!! This tavern should be in Manhattan or Philly, it's so cute, so trendy and a great beer selections. I walked in with a coworker after a busy day, just a random Monday --- and couldn't get over how cute this place was!  We sat down and the extensive beer menu had us transfixed while the music of Jimi Hendrix played in the background.  I got a Spellbound IPA because it's delicious and paroozed the menu while my coworker ordered a house red.  Our food arrived PROMPTLY and was delicious, we talked about work while The Rolling Stones played softly in the background.  Another round? Inquired the lovely server...YES please!!!  Led Zeppelin, Pink Floyd, the Doors, more beer, more food.....this place is a treasure!!!
I never expected to find a place like this in Burlington City, but I did and I love it!  Can't wait to come back---everywhere I looked folks were eating wings.  I'm vegan so I got the fried cauliflower....fried food and craft beer, need I say more?  I hope this place has great success and that the owners make a lot of money, I want them to be around forever so I can go there whenever I want.  Cheers!!!!

I bought the assorted 12 pack for a birthday party this past week and I was not impressed!  Most of the kids did not even finish their cupcake because it was too sweet!  For almost three bucks a cupcake I was annoyed that only a couple of kids liked them enough to finish!
My son barely touched the topping and decided it was too sweet and that he was not interested!  Instead of it going to waste, I ate half of hit and was overwhelmed by the sweetness of it.
Also, from my past experience, I cannot recall kids not finishing their cupcakes and asking for a second one ... either these kids were diet concious or they need to revamp their cupcake!

I normally dont trust the ratings until a certain amount of people have left reviews, so when i saw only 18 were interested in this place i was skeptical. I started reading and noticed all 18 people were talking about the chicken tenders so that's what i ordered. They were fresh, seasoned, perfectly crispy and homemade. I also had the tuna salad, which was again, fresh and tasty. I haven't tried anything else yet, hopefully soon but right now I'm stuck on the these 2 good eats!

Great guys. Very straight to the point and kind. They definitely were south philly guys haha The place is not that big but gives off a western outdoors store. The prices for renting were a little bit higher than average but made up for the way they treated me and my friend. Instructions were good and the range was great. Lacking distance indicators but no problem for experienced shooters. Also huge parking lot!

Had an amazing dinner Saturday night at Cadiz, we had a very large group and they were able to accommodate us on the lovely front patio.  The service was very good, they were very attentive. Had some fun cocktails and wonderful food. Loved the scallop appetizer and the salmon entree.  They made the evening very special for us and was it was so fun to be there when it turned into a dance club.  Add this to your places to visit when coming to State Street.

This gym is awesome.  Every piece of equipment you could ever need.  It is very rarely crowded and clean.  They have tons of great classes and very good personal trainers.  They are open 24 hours which makes it convenient with my busy schedule.  I have trained at several area gyms and I found a home here at fitness 360.

What can I say, I wish they had this place where I live! During my trip out to Nola, we my friends and I heard this place is the place to eat. We got here around 1 pm and there was already a line out the door. Don't worry, the line moves fast. 
 
When we got inside, we ordered the oysters first. A dozen of the chargrilled and a dozen of the raw oysters. I'm not a seafood person by I was blown away at how awesome the chargrilled oysters were! It came in a tray with bread and had lots of butter and cheese on the bottom. Sure enough, those disappeared quickly. Normally I don't eat raw oysters but my friends kept raving about them so I had to try one. Boy they were right! It was awesome. The marinara sauce was on point. We also ordered the seafood étouffée with a side of crawfish tails. Omg it was amazing! 

I would definitely try this place again if I'm in the area.

Walked in off the street while wandering around.  Good smells coming from within.  Sean greeted my Mom and me and continued to give us great service and food info.  Very well done and very good also....as well as the in season Abita beer! The manager James came and made sure we were well taken care of.  Thank you both for the great warmth NOLA style and info on food in the French Quarter area!

The BEST pizza place!! Super thin pie, with a beautiful crust! I can't say enough good things, about this little gem that gives you a feel of an old school Pizzeria! Love the memorabilia on the walls! Great place for couples or a girls night!!

Best Chinese buffet on the west bank . Seated fast hot food plenty of it sushi is hit or miss. One of the best things they make is the fried chicken of all things.
Friendly staff , they even have a meeting room for small events  that we have used for VFW dinners.
Water ice is good but outside area is littered with lots of trash. Please clean up outside. Would be more inviting!!

I've tried basically every flavor of cake pop but the best has got to be red velvet or salted caramel!  They offer cake pops as an alternative to cupcakes and it just changed my mind!  The staff is great as well and seem excited to create each time I visit the shop.  They really worked with me to create something fun for a baby shower.  They even offered mini cake pops as a great favor to give all of our guests.  I can't wait until the next event that I can get more!!!

The shrimp salad is our go-to. Good portion. Beautifully grilled shrimp, fresh greens, beans and Parmesan cheese. Served with a tangy lemon dressing on 
the side. My daughter loves the spaghetti w/ meatballs. Thankful to have this fresh takeout place nearby for dinner.
Awesome outdoor brewery! Good tacos and lots of different beers snd cocktails! Would come back again!

First time at this Jiffy. The attendant was super friendly and did not judge me when I admitted to owning this car for a year and never changing the oil. 

Once inside I was surprised to see some truly comfy looking chairs and not those hard connected plastic things. I will save my last star for when I get my car back.

Update: These guys get my vote for being 100% customer service driven, professional and fast. I was impressed with the efficiency of the process and how I was guided in with my car, shown to the waiting room, the clarity with which the services were explained to me and what my options were and last being escorted to my car, having the door opened for me and thanking me for my business. That is how you do it folks. Thank you Aaron, Anthony, Bryson, Armand and Chuck!

Worst massage experience EVER! Awkward massage. I was tense the entire time. Massage therapist chatted with her fellow therapist while working on me which just added to my experience NOT BEING RELAXING. Man at the counter tried to increase my tip TWICE. He actually covered the machine with his hand and changed my total...TWICE! Thankfully I clearly saw what he was doing and quickly hit the button to cancel the transactions both times.

Kimberly is so sweet and such a talented groomer. My pups have never looked better and they smell amazing. You can definitely tell that she loves what she does and my dogs absolutely loved her. She treated them with such love and kindness as if they were her own and did such a beautiful job. I couldn't be happier!

TERRIBLE! This is the second time we ordered from here. I had a five star review saved that I forgot to submit; I'm glad I did. I called and placed an order for delivery on a Saturday at 630.  Let me start off by saying we never get to order take out or go out to eat because we have a large family and a set of newborn twins.  All of the kids were napping so we decided to have a date night. We placed a $63 order. They said it would be ready in 15 mins (we live down the street) 45 mins later I called and asked about my order. They told me they got busy and the delivery driver had to go in the kitchen. Then she said it would be there in 10 mins he just left. Another 20 mins went by and my food still wasn't here. My husband called and they told him it would be 10 more mins. He asked if the food would be hot and she said yes. The driver finally arrived with a slight attitude and no apology. We opened our boxes and the food was cold, the sauce was spilled everywhere and the order was wrong, not seasoned, and all around terrible. What a waste of money. Do not waste your time here.

We also found a roach leg in the food!!!!

We go there frequently for drinks and apps, but recently started going there for brunch and it's AMAZING! Reasonably priced and they have great brunch options (i.e. shrimp and grits!). Their food and drinks have always been fantastic and the service is always good as well. We love it here for brunch.

Food was pretty good but the service was horrible. Came in on Saturday, I guess it was happy hour. There was a 15 minute wait so my boyfriend and I decided to sit at the bar. It was a while before we were greeted, another 15 minutes to order an appetizer. She didn't give us enough conversation to order drinks so that was another 15 minutes.  Food runners came out with appetizers, I asked for app plates, the server said he would be right back with them. He never came back. Our dinner was brought out by a different server, she actually had two plates and bread with her on her tray. We were splitting the bigger steak portion. We asked her for the plates, she said I'm sorry this is for another table I'll come back with extra for you. She never came back. I would've asked the bartender if we were ever acknowledged. I won't be going back.

I wanted to update my review sense I just finished my season of traveling.   

See I travel on business during the year to San Francisco's, Chicago, Portland, Las  Vegas, and many more places  I have eatin at al's San Francisco. Bravo Rick Bayless and topolo.  Castagna Portland  justin Woodward, Girl and goat and many more. 

I would rate vida as my best dining experience of the year really fantastic

The location/building/facilities are well kept. A few of the staff members were nice but not overly so... 
However...
Overcrowded practice.  Always sitting in a jam packed waiting room.
Incredibly POOR billing department. Over and over again I've asked them to check with my insurance company to bill me appropriately at the time of service. This is the third time I've gotten a bill from them several months later for work I had done and when I call they give me lame excuses as to why. I told them the last time i had it happen if it happens again I'm done with them. There is no good reason.
It's insanely difficult to find good dentists around here and these were just middle grade. Can't say I ever walked away feeling "wow, that was a really great experience"
I'm not a person who dislikes the dentist at all...
I did have one good cleaning there and they were slightly better than American Dental my last nightmare dentist experience... so I'll give them 2 stars but honestly I would never recommend them to anyone.

Pretty horrible. One plate had a hair on it, one was dirty, and another was chipped. Our server dropped off our food and we didn't see her again until it was time to pay the bill. We shared the Wedge salad that was good & the BBQ sampler plate. Pulled pork was decent, baked beans were probably the best thing on the plate and they were lukewarm at best. The slaw had no taste at all & was a strange color. My favorite part was when the server thanked us for our patience while we waited for our check. Would not recommend.

Thank you YELP for leading me to this hidden gem.  The sushi was wonderful as was the Ramen.  A very clean place and reasonable prices, with what may be the friendliest and professional service in all of Pinellas County.  Everything on menu was a great quality.  The only disappointment was the great price on specials only apply to dine in.  In these days of Covid that is not really attractive.

Had the 5-course tasting menu, pescatarian, and it was delicious. We added the wine pairing and the wines were carefully chosen to pair well with each course. I enjoyed the casual, warm, and classy ambience. Overall and excellent dining experience and highly recommended.

Let me preface this by saying that I absolutely love Pizza Hut. Favorite pizza period. 

This is without a doubt the worst Pizza Hut in Indiana, if not in the United States. I was given free pizza coupons from a manager going psycho and cussing out a customer in front of me. I called to place an order they tell me 35 minute delivery time, I tell them I'm using this coupon and not only is the manager ultra rude to me, but now he informs me I have a 4 hour wait for delivery. 

Sadly this is the only Pizza Hut in my area. I have issues with this place every time I place an order, whether delivery or pick up. They are always so rude. They have argued with me about what their own menu say is on a pizza. Management talks to everyone, employees and customers, like they're dumb. 

One delivery when we opened the box the pizza looked like it had been under a heater for at least 4 days. Shriveled. Dry. Disgusting and inedible. We called and asked for a replacement. Got horrible attitude and they even asked if WE would bring it back to get another one. 

Every interaction with this location is an absolute trip. I would give 0 stars if I could. 

WORST PIZZA HUT EVER.

Even in transition I had a great experience here. Plenty of parking, good food and great service will make this place a home run. Oh yeah, by the way they take credit cards. The Coffee Cup better watch out.

I missed the Bagelry in Santa Cruz when I moved down here but this place is just as good. There are so many combinations that I try to get something new every time and I always enjoy it. Cons: takes about 10 min. to get your food and there's no indoor eating (hey, it's IV).
Love this place.  Inventive menu.  Terrific chef/owner. Have been there many times.
This is one of our favorite date spots. We have never had a bad experience! We get the Maui Wowie, and it is bomb!

I'm gluten-free and vegan and my husband isn't and this place is great for both of us! The Impossible Burger with a gluten-free bun is amazing and the sweet potato fries were great! I have a hard time finding "real" sweet tea here but they have it! Dana was my waitress today and she was so sweet, understood my picky eating and kept sweet tea on the table! Great lunch today and a great dinner here last week!

Visiting the area and ordered from here for delivery to hotel. Things to note if you're not familiar with this place:
1) They only take cash, no credit cards and
2) The style of chow mein they prepare is withOUT noodles (this seems to vary regionally)

We had a pretty good dinner. Despite knowing we were from out of town (they delivered to our hotel) they provided a free appetizer of crab rangoon which were good and pretty much as I've had them before and would expect. We also had BBQ bone-in ribs. Very tasty and meaty but slightly too chewy. The Veggie chow mein (no noodles remember?) was in a yummy white garlicy sauce. The generals chicken was really good: deep fried tender white-meat chicken with a bit too much breading (but isn't it like that everywhere?) in a yummy glaze. 

We would return if we lived in the area.

My fiance and I decided to go to this location for Lunch, since we noticed that there were not many cars in the parking lot. We were served immediately, and our waitress Carly was very attentive and always asked us if we needed anything, and with a smile. She was great! The one thing I would love to see on Chickie's and Pete's menus are a beverage section (for standard fountain drinks, iced teas, etc.) I just stuck with water, but would have loved to see what options were available. My fiance tried the crab mac and cheese balls and he liked them. (I'm not a huge fan of seafood, but I took a bite and they were not bad!) I got the Crabby Sweets which are sweet potato crab fries and they come with a side of cheese, as well as maple/cinnamon syrup. IT WAS AMAZING. Sooo delicious. 11/10 recommend. :) My fiance got the BBQ burger which is what I was going to get, but instead I got the Pete-zza cheesesteak. My cheesesteak wasn't bad, it was pretty good and very cheesy, but I feel like I've had better steaks. I kind of wish I got the burger like my fiance did. Finally, I was happy to see that Chickie's and Pete's offers desserts (as I didn't know that), but they were only four menu choices for dessert. Lastly, with the music playing, it's hard to see what's going on on the tv, I feel like they should perhaps add subtitles so people know what's going on. Otherwise, great location!

This night was amazing!!  First off, we started with the "dumplings" which were more like parisian gnocchi, and they were great!  I had the elk loin and it was cooked perfectly mid-rare with wonderful flavors!  My wife had the barramundi  and it was cooked perfectly as well, with a nice crisp skin and juicy filet!  We will be back!

Great atmosphere that is casual, yet classy.   We dined here twice on our short trip to Nashville because it was so good.   The oysters were the best I've ever had.....I got the most expensive ones, $54 per dozen and they were small, but so fresh and delicious I felt as if I was sitting in the ocean enjoying them! Caesar salad and wedge salad were both great. Ribs and country fried chicken were both very good.  The shrimp risotto dish was terrible.  It was very bland, and at the same time had favors that did not pair well together at all.  One bite had bitter lemon peel flavor and the next bite mushroom flavor, and the next no flavor.  The beer was not very cold,  an chilled glasses were not available.  Despite this, we are giving the Southern 5 stars because overall the food and atmosphere are excellent.

This is a great spot for a fun brunch. If you are looking for a bright and welcoming atmosphere with a solid menu, this is the place to be. I came here yesterday for a sunday brunch and could not have expected a more quaint cafe.
I ordered one of the specials of chicken and waffles, which were pretty yummy (the waffles are jalepeno cornbread waffles, so yum...) and some freshly squeezed orange juice. Everything came out very quickly and was pretty enjoyable! The portions are huge (I could only eat about half) and was just satisfying in general.
The service seemed friendly, albeit a little over worked/understaffed but despite the sunday brunch rush, everything was served and cleaned with a smile.
It really is, a cool gem on south street. I can absolutely see myself coming back.

My wife and I have traveled all over the world, and this was unquestionably the worst hotel we have ever experienced:  the front walkway was covered with bird droppings, the back patio had rodent feces everywhere, the carpet was stained in several places, the bathroom sinks were old and cracked, the wallpaper was torn, the window fixtures were broken, the furniture was dated, wall outlets were hanging from the wires, the fitness equipment was filthy, the sauna was dirty with trash, the indoor spa was absolutely gross, the grounds were ill-kept, the road to our cottage was cracked with large potholes everywhere, and...well, I could go on and on.  We were celebrating our anniversary, and this put a real damper on things.  I wrote a letter to management but, after six months, have still not received the courtesy of a reply.

I only wish I had found this place before Covid because I would've been eating healthier a long time. They are grilled meats are beyond compare in flavor, super tender, extra juicy I am so so good. I loved the roasted Brussel sprouts and they have just the right flavor. And the marinated mushroom are delicious! This restaurant prides itself on gluten free dishes. But most are also soy & dairy free!

I will keep getting meals from here! They are my new favorite comfort food!

Good foods at very reasonable price.  The service is so so.  Its more like a family style business.  They do have the best lunch special.  The lady boss on the counter was nice.  The waitress, and waiters comes and goes.  So the service is depending who is serving you that day.
I think I time traveled. So unexpected. The "vibe" feels like a fun and cozy place to have drinks to ride out the winter storm. Except it's Florida. Nina the bartender is friendly and knowledgeable.
The food is okay atmosphere is also fine as well. Not too much to complain about or praise for that matter. It isnt overpriced but the restaurant is outclassed by another chinese place nearby.

We have enjoyed living at Madison Oaks for the last two years. The Management team is great and is always quick to fix any issues you may have. We are only moving because we are looking for a bigger place. The location is great as we are close to everything. June, the Apartment Manager cares about her community and is always there to assist with the people who live in Madison Oaks.

We live in the neighborhood and have been going to this restaurant since it was a hole-in-the-wall next to the fu-wah. We actually think that the waitstaff is lovely and friendly, and always remember us when we come back. There is one (relatively new) waiter that can be a little overbearing and try to order for you, I'm guessing he's the one that everyone is talking about, but everyone else has always been wonderful to us.

The space they are in now is beautifully decorated and well kept-up. Their drinks are strong and delicious also. As for the food, our rule when going to the restaurant is to only order the vermicelli or the soups and appetizers. We have to agree that many of the other entrees can be bland, but the vermicelli (especially with the spring rolls, which are my favorite anywhere) is so good that we keep going back again and again. We've encouraged people to go back and only get the vermicelli, and now they're regulars too. Love it!

I kinda feel bad for this joeys. I know I shouldn't, as they more than made their fair share of money over the years, but with cactus club moving in down the street, this joeys is never busy anymore. 

I always have the beach salad, and it's one of the best salads I've had. I also tried a bite of my companions glazed salmon rice bowl, very good as well. 

Only 4 stars because there menu hasn't changed in sooooooooo long. Keep the beach salad and upgrade the menu!

When in Tennessee, you must go to a whiskey distillery!  This one had great reviews on Trip Advisor.

In order to taste their products, you must do their ~45 minutes tour which is $11/person.  The tour was pretty cool, educating us on the history of Green Brier, showing us how the whiskey is made, & ended with 4 tasters.

Most of their products can be found at BevMo or other big liquor stores but they do have an exclusive only bottle as well.  I fell in love with their Louisa, which is a sweet, coffee caramel pecan liqueur, perfect as an after meal dessert wind down.

Dear Foxy Loxy,
Yes,I agree with all the other reviews that this place is great for coffee, tea, and a delicious serving of ice cream.  Just don't order a sandwich or anything that needs to be grilled, cooked or prepared on a warm night.
The ice cream line was so long that a sandwich takes forever to order, receive, and take back to the counter if something is missing from your sandwich!  The two young ladies behind the counter were working diligently and doing the best they could given the crowds.  Specifics you asked?.....it took a good 15 minutes to order and 2 of the 3 sandwiches I liked were "sold out".....15 more minutes for my sandwich to be prepared and delivered, and I left because my sandwich was missing the fresh basil!....I wanted to take the sandwich back to the counter and ask why the basil was missing, but the ice cream line was so long, it would of taken me at least another half hour to get the sandwich I ordered!....for $9 I can get a bigger sandwich, fresher & tastier, and quicker at Hood's or the Northbrook Market.
My suggestion would be to drop the sandwiches and focus solely on the coffee/tea, sweets, and ice cream.  Thanks for listening and good luck!
Kris S

This place is stunning. A beautifully-kept relic of 1926, the Tampa Theatre is more than a theatre house... it's a time capsule. A conduit of community-building. An escape to a different place and time altogether. 

They have recently upgraded the seating, where the updated seats are now nicely padded, and twosomes are given a granite "side table" for your wine/prosecco, munchies, and other goodies. They retained  the stylistic flair of the original seats, so the overall aesthetic is fabulously vintage and very comfortable. 

This is a must-see for visitors and residents alike. Perfectly located in Downtown Tampa within walking distance of many great bars and restaurants. 

Awesome date night for us two locals this evening. We came to watch the Anthony Bourdain documentary called Roadrunner. It is being introduced by some award-winning , James Beard award nominated local chefs and hospitality professionals. We ended up buying a bottle of wine and enjoying the wonder that is The Tampa Theatre. Cheers.

Wife and I decided to give a try to these place for lunch, we arrive and our hosts was a bit rude with us she took our drink order rite away we order a lemonade and rite away she wanted to take our order, I find it a lil bit odd that a host wanted to take our order, then our waiter came in and apologized he was bit busy with another table, he gave us good recommendations the wife went for jambalaya and I did the creole plater and let tell you I was in heaven eating flavors were there everything was delicious no complains at all our waiter wave off the drinks do to the bad moment that we had with the host. That customer service. Good place to have lunch

As a Korean, I freakin loved it. The low ratings can suck it to be honest. For opening up during the pandemic and being the only decent Korean BBQ spot in Tucson, I'll take it. Is it the best Korean ever? No. This ain't freakin Korea. It's TUCSON, honey cakes. And the girl complaining about lettuce/perilla leaves (oOoOh so CuLtUrEd) doesn't understand how expensive produce like lettuce leaves can actually be in an AYCE restaurant. But you right, they should have Cass or Hite. I asked about it cause I love somaek, but they said it's currently out of stock from the company/supplier cause of this whole pandemic. Like, even LA restaurants are struggling to get Korean beer imported.

I've been coming since their first opening week at least every 2 weeks, and not gonna lie, did have an off service or two since November. But I've constantly been seeing new servers every month, and when I asked about that, they have issues of staff leaving short notice cause of COVID in family/fear, students graduating, managers leaving abruptly, etc. Consistency is key to a restaurant but all I can be is compassionate cause I honestly just love this place AND it's close to me on the east side. ESPECIALLY their cafe counterpart. Booooobaaaaaaa! And it's actually FRESHLY made boba, which is hard to find in Tucson. 

So other snobby farts can suck it. Go to the Americanized Korean joints where they can give you your lil' forks, cook your food for $17 a serving, and be at your beck and call like how you wanna treat people apparently from these "reviews." Especially during these times, man. It ain't always about only you. THIS PLACE CANT CLOSE ON ME.
Sexist. Racist. Will kick you out for the most ridiculous reasons. Don't go to this bar unless you want to hang out with a bunch of college kids. :-)

Had the best experience here! Aimee did an amazing job on my hair and the prices were super fair. Didn't feel like I was overpaying which made the experience 10x better. Definitely recommend this salon!
NOT open on Sundays as stated here on yelp and posted on the door. Absolutely a joy to find out after the 3/4+ mile trek from my hotel.

State Street Pub is great for live music and decently priced drinks.  I've been here a few times to listen to music, and they've kept up with demand well.  I've never had to wait at the bar for drinks.  I've not had the food, so I can't speak to that.  I would definitely go back for another show.  There's plenty of street parking, but the lot is a bit small.  Overall, I had a great time.
Hidden gem where the old heritages used to be. Has everything a convince store has but really amazing food. 10/10. Favrotie place to get breakfast

Completely delicious surprise in one of the most charming corners of St. Louis in the historic Lafayette Park area.  Too many tempting choices to choose from. Our server Rolf delivered seamless service and filled us in on the food scene in town which we very much appreciated.  The restaurant even stayed open late for us after we arrived at closing time.

Went for the dinner to the new location just down the street from the old one.  Same good food.  Lots of beer.  Same servers just more of them.   Lots more space but somehow now the hole in the wall dive mode the old place had is gone.  In its  place is a formula driven cutesy motif that you could find anywhere in Florida.  It's just not the same.

I went here yesterday with my sister to get pedicures. Normally we go to a place by our house but we wanted to go shopping so we thought we would give this place a try. They took us in right away and got started on our toes. They were very nice and did a great job! Now I'm not embarrassed to walk around in flip flops! I will definitely go here again!

Parc is definitely one of my staple dinner places.

It's that kind of place that consistently provides great service and food quality. By now I've probably tried most of the menu in one way or another.

To start you absolutely need to get the french onion soup.  They don't mess around with the cheese and the soup itself is also delicious.  When you pair this with a great beer from their list or a bottle of wine from their also extensive list you just can't beat it as a beginning.

The entrees are all superbly prepared.  From the huge bowl of mussels in the moule frites, to the succulent scallops to any of the great meats, you can't go wrong with your dinner.

Throughout the meal I've always had great interactions with our servers and never had to ask twice for anything.

Sure other restaurants might provide a once in a while better experience.  But, Parc continues to create a great experience and serve quality, delicious food.

I can't think of a bad dinner I've had here and will continue coming here for the food, service and ambiance.
Always good - always friendly staff - always clean - always a good experience!
Full on local hang. Great pub food, full on beer, cocktails ,small and packed. Right off the main drag Virginia St

We had a good experience with Weekends Only in the past. This was our fourth piece of furniture from the store. We paid almost $500 for this recliner and when we got it home, we discovered that the zipper was broken and the stuffing was pouring out. I called the store but was told that it was out of stock and we could exchange it the following weekend. This is a big inconvenience to arrange transportation but I dealt with it. The next weekend came and right before we left to pick it up I called the store and spoke to a very rude Ashley who informed me that the recliner was still out of stock. Good thing I called since no one from Weekends Only bothered to call me and let me know. I asked Ashley to have a manager call me. No call so my husband called and asked for a manager on Tuesday. Nothing. I called tonight, Friday, and still no manager available. This is not the way you run a business if you expect repeat customers.

We had a terrible time dealing with our insurance company, Heritage Insurance, when our home in Cape Coral Florida was hit by the January 9th, 2016 tornado.  We received a lot of run-around and finally received $75k for the damage.  Because Heritage took so long and played a purposeful delay game with us, we hired Mike Stabile from Tutwiler & Associates.  Mike was so helpful because he knows the insurance industry and how they tend to operate when it comes to delaying claim payouts.  By mid July 2016 Mike had secured a 226% increase in the payout of the real damage that was done throughout our home in Florida.  There's nothing like having a real expert fighting on your side against the stubborn and stingy insurance companies who tell you they're great until they actually have to pay a claim.  I can't say enough about how helpful Mike Stabile was in his efforts to fight for what we rightly deserved for the significant damage done to our home.

I will start off by saying that I think Ciccio's is better than two stars, but based on my visit I can't do better than that.

Came in a large party (12+) for a friend's birthday.  For that reason, I won't harp on the service too much, but it was definitely slooooooow.  Had to use some creative tactics to flag a server down so I could order a drink.  But I get it, it was a full house and we were a large party. Not a good combo.  $4 for a bottle of Yuengling is obnoxious, but it's South Tampa and to be expected.

I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Wrap for dinner.  The vegetable and mashed potato sides were very good, but this wrap was disappointing.  It was a good size and I liked the chicken/spice, but it tasted exactly like a Grilled Stuft Burrito from Taco Bell.  I like GSBs, but I don't pay $12 for them lol.  The bleu cheese was tasty on the side.

Overall, like I said, I really think Ciccio's is better than this and I'm sure I'll give them another try down the line...but that was the first time in a long time that I was not happy with a food item I ordered.  Hopefully next time is better and I can update this with a better score.
Carne asada is top notch and I got the El Pueblito burrito last time with no pico de gallo and guacamole on the side and it was perfect.  the green chili pork burrito is excellent as well

This is a great TJs. Parking is easy, and it is a decent sized store. The staff is extra friendly and always willing to check on if they have something/when it will be coming back. Recently, their cauliflower gnocci was featured on the Today Show and now they can't keep it on the shelves! I strongly recommend the sweet potato gnocci as a strong second to the cauliflower one! 

Other awesome things to try: baked okra, savory plantain chips, chicken gyoza, all of their flatbread pizzas, chicken fried rice!

So, when we are traveling we end up playing yelp bingo... Highest rated restaurant we can find near where we are and today's winner was Jack's London Grill. Initially I was a bit apprehensive with the place,  it appeared to be a sponsored listing but they had plenty of reviews and shepherd pie was calling us.

The place is modest on the outside which is always a sign of a good restaurant and they did not disappoint.

We never got to try thier Shepherd Pie, we got drawn in by the sampler platter with the Scotch Egg, Brie and chips (potato chips not fries) .   We added the blue cheese chardonnay dip for the chips which was fantastic.

We followed up with the fish and chips and there is a reason that they have won an award for the last like 6 years for their fish and chips.

Great place that we would return to if we didn't live in Miami.

I have taken my family here many times. Food is ALWAYS delicious!! The staff is always friendly and welcoming. I definitely recommend the prosperity  sandwich and don't forget to add giardiniera peppers if you like some heat! Also the "Rumas Super" is great if you want a cold sub!

I've really enjoyed every dish that I've eaten here, with my personal favorite being the Thai Ginger Tofu. Service is friendly and the place always seems busy, but not so much that it's a problem.

I've seen a lot of people comment that the price and portion sizes don't match up, but I got two meals out of an entree and two-side combo last time I was there, and they let me sub one of the smaller entrees in for the place of a side. It came to around $12, which I thought was really reasonable considering the amount of food I got. There are places in my hometown that would get away with charging twice that. 

I also grabbed a muffin on my way out and they were selling the muffins of they day two-for-one, so I grabbed one for my dining companion as well. They were lemon raspberry and while they weren't the most flavorful muffins I've ever had, they were incredibly moist and soft. 

I would certainly recommend Sunflower Cafe to anyone looking for vegan food in the Nashville area.

I think this might be the best sit-down Mexican restaurant in the area, and it really blows Red Mesa out of the water, especially with their chips and salsa.

I've been to Nueva Cantina several times and have always had a good experience here. Every item I've ordered has been delicious and filling.

Let's start with the chips, salsa, and queso, which are arguably the best in the area. Nueva Cantina uses citrus/lime seasoning on their chips which give it the PERFECT zest when you're eating queso or salsa. I could literally sit and eat those chips all day long. The queso is usually a huge size which makes it perfect for sharing.

On Tuesdays, Nueva Cantina offers $2 tacos, which is a great for competition in the area. The fajitas are excellent and so are the salads. 

Service can be a little iffy sometimes, and waiters can forget about you occasionally, but as long as the chips keep coming, I'm happy.

The drinks are excellent -- try the jalapeno margarita!

Been reading about the Body Shop for years from Teen Vogue to Seventeen (this was ions about I might add but still feels like yesterday:) )

Of course being from the southeast it's a place I could order online but hadn't visited in store.

Stumbled upon this place in the Meadowood mall and made the stop. Lots of great skincare items. 

Totally lived up to all the hype I had heard about back in my teen years.

Love the food, but this lady was rude, and acted like she was doing me a favor. She made 3 others people's food before ours.  Bad. And then she smiled about it when I said something.  Poor customer service. Cross this one off this list.

Omg this place is flavor town! I love their tacos and tortillas are made by hand, which is the best part in my opinion. They have tacos de rajas which are my fave!! They also have the best guacamole ever! Seriously if you're in SB this place is a must! But you need to be patient because this place always has a line because they are that delicious.

Great food, awesome staff and great prices for the amount of food you get. We have had the jerk pork, boneless chicken, bone in jerk chicken, wings-which is similar to the bone in jerk chicken, and always have to get a beef or chicken patty. Don't usually like plantains but these are so good. Ask for the scotch bonnet sauce, goes well with the chicken and patties. 

Owner takes great pride in what he is doing and takes great care of his customers. Always makes a point to say hello. Enjoy going here in the summer when they have live music playing at the brewery next door. Great hidden gem in Carmel!
Sorry to say it, but we got the supposed specialty, and it was a disappointment. Very little taste and soggy crust.

VIC was close so I tried them out .
Can't even compare ,Sushi was tasteless.
Couldn't eat more than 1 roll out of 3 and I was starving .

I went there this week to get my eyelashes done and really wanted it to be a good fit. Unfortunately, they're new to doing eyelash extensions and I wouldn't recommend them at this point. My eyes were puffy, burning and red, it smelled like they were using super glue, and ultimately I had to leave after having what they did removed. Not ready for prime time!

I started but never finished a four star review of this place shortly after it opened but recent experiences have downgraded Mugshots for me. Service is always friendly and attentive and the space is clean and bright but the food ranges from nothing special to disappointing. The hot mess of a Reuben was a standout - I don't know if they meant to serve it open-faced or just gave up on it but the pile of slop on my plate was barely recognizable.  Great to have a diner in this location but they need to step up the game on the food.
I finally got a chance to try the food here.  It was worth the wait.  I ordered the Wednesday special: two Sonoran hot dogs with a drink for $6.99.  I'll have to try the tacos on my next visit.

Ugh. Worse trip ever. The planes were very small, not much legroom at all. Most of the airline attendants acted as though they were having bad days which reflected in how they spoke to the customers. You have to pay cash for in flight purchases but then they say they don't have change and just "to forget about it because they don't have time" and ended up giving food/drinks away. They load the plane by groups (you can pay more to load first if you want). Picture this: you pay more to load the plane first, your seat is up front, so for the rest of the boarding time, you are bumped into, hit in the head by elbows, bags, etc!!!  So stupid. Why not load the plane from back to front and then everyone leaves front to back. Makes more sense doesn't it?!  On the first leg of our trip, we arrived early and got through security rather quickly. The plane before ours was just about all boarded and going to the same connecting airport and was half filled. We asked if we could get on so we would have a longer layover to avoid issues since the weather was bad and delays were happening. The answer was no unless we wanted to pay $75 and we were told our bags were already tagged for the next flight. After explaining the bags would still end up at the final destination at the same time we would, the attendant looked confused and still said no. This makes absolutely no sense to me. I will gladly go out of my way to never fly AA again.
Awesome park a bit on the smaller side but not bad low key prefer it to Tampa skatepark

The owner of this business is outstanding- I can't sing his praises enough. I texted in to book a first float for my partner and I, and the process was seamless. We arrived early and Dominick spent some time one-on-one with us explaining how the process works, and talking to us about our expectations and how to get the most out of our experience. This part alone blew me away.

The first float was really interesting and well worth it. I won't speak too much about it- I think everyone needs to try this themselves and go in without too many expectations. Long story short, I decided to purchase a monthly membership and have been back since.
