The customer service was still 5 stars, and I'm looking forward to introducing some friends to this amazing self-care experience. 

Yay Float House!

I love this place. Always come here when we have out of town visitors. Low prices, good margaritas and great food. Wait staff is awesome, my favorite is a guy named Juan, you can ask to be seated in his section. Fast, consistent, delicious.

This place is huge and so, so pretty.
The boathouse is a cute place to have a little lunch and the jewel box is just a unique place to check out.
My husband and I took our engagement pictures here and my friend is getting married in October IN the Jewel Box!

Perfect place to run, read a book, take pictures and relax.

Please save your money! All of the great technicians have left this salon. The owner is left to do lashes and is open to hiring almost anyone due to the crunch she is in. It's almost impossible for appointments now with the automated machine. I found out my tech Mindy left AFTER i had shown up for my 3 pm appointment and the owner lied and told me she had left for the day for an emergency. I have her number so i texted my tech and she stated that she had quit 4 days prior and that they shouldve relayed the message to me as I am on her client list ONLY. I dont see anyone else. The owner spent 10 min making up excuses for why Mindy was not there, why i was not told ahead of time, and trying to reschedule my appointment for 2 hours later (I THINK NOT). There were 5 girls in front of me EVEN though i had an appointment for 3:00 and there were NO TECHS to be found in the entire place; only the owner. It was a disaster! I refused to make a following appointment so i left and havent looked back. Such a shame because I loved this place for 2 years!!

We were able to get in at the last minute so we were very happy. It was packed inside but the service was great. Servers were constantly walking by to check on us and the owner came by to introduce himself which I thought was so friendly. The tables are pretty close together but it was fine. Just glad I wasn't carrying a bunch of things with me to get in the way. 

We tried the kimchee fries which were good and gyoza. Then I got two different vegetarian sushi rolls which were just ok. I know by nature the vegetarian rolls are not as flavorful but I still felt slightly disappointed. 

I had the peanut butter ice cream which was good. It's vanilla ice cream with swirls of peanut butter. I wish I had asked for some chocolate sauce with it, that would have made it better. 

I do however think this place has great value! It's a BYOB and for the two of us with appetizers, drinks, rolls, and dessert it was still around $34...Hard to find in center city! I probably would have rated the food a 3 stars but I think the service, friendliness, and value of the place bumped it up to 4 stars!

Best limo service in St Louis MO
This company goes the extra mile with special needs. Drivers are courteous and on time. 
You can not pick a better company.

I've given this place many opportunities to change my mind and I still always feel disappointed. 

Cons: 
-their mini corn bread muffins look so cute, but don't be fooled. They aren't even sweet plus they are so freaking oily. 
-their banh mi sandwiches are mediocre. They are just so not like the authentic ones you get from the Vietnamese stores. 
-Their rotisserie chicken is expensive. Better off walking all the way to Whole Foods. 

Pros: 
-they have a friendly staff which is always nice.

I am very late in writing this review and feel horrible it has taken me so long to do so.  My daughter and I came here in July of 2011 to look for wedding dresses for her October wedding.  Unlike other shops who told us that we were late in looking for a dress and we'd have to purchase quickly (what a sham-don't believe them!), Bridal Manor was honest with us about the process every step of the way.  They were one of the few shops in the South Jersey area to stock dresses from my daughter's favorite designer (but even if they don't stock your designer visit them anyway as they were so professional and friendly during the entire process).  As stated in other reviews, the shop is in an old house which to me adds a nice atmosphere.  All of the sales associates were nice and very helpful-not snobbish at all, not pushy at all.  They were patient in helping my daughter try on dress after dress and because the dress that my daughter decided on was $50 less at another shop, they price matched, which was so very helpful during such an expensive time.  We did notice though that their selection was very affordable with bridal dresses ranging from say $400-1500.  Nice selection too.  Alterations were perfect and delivered as promised.  We bought her veil online, but they let us know to bring it with us when we came back for the alteration fitting so that they could press it with the dress, no charge.

We both highly recommend Bridal Manor to any bride, bridal party or anyone who needs a formal dress for a special occasion!

Every time i land at MSY, I'm greeted with smiles. Located about 20-30minutes from the French Quarter, MSY is now one of my faves. Great food, as expected, and getting through the airport is a seamless process. I stumbled upon their local airport shuttle last year, which has become my go-to form of transportation. $44 round trip, there's always a van waiting for you and their staff is some of the most courteous people I've ever met. It's nice to receive such warmness after a long flight. You can schedule your shuttle in advance via phone, or website. I usually just get mine as soon as i land. If traveling alone, this is the cheapest way to depart. An Uber May make more sense, depending on pricing when traveling with others or if you're just going one way. Did I mention the quick, free airport WiFi?? You'll thank me later

My family came from FL to visit and I brought them here twice because it was such a hit! We've ordered the southwest breakfast wrap, breakfast grilled cheese, sunrise on sourdough, and the chipotle chicken club. Everything was absolutely delicious and served on cute wooden boards. I love a place with good aesthetic and Russell's is on point! I got an iced latte that I was also very happy with! 
The service is awesome! Our waiter was very friendly and remembered us from our first visit. He went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of! 
Let me take a minute and tell you about these desserts....
The gooey butter cake deserves a review of its own. One of the best things I've ever eaten!! Their rendition of the famous St. Louis gooey butter cake stands alone with a short bread cookie crust that is to die for. They have several options: plain, with blueberries and with chocolate. All the pastries are made fresh in house and all look beautiful and delicious. Russell's is one of my new favorite spots in St. Louis. Highly recommend this place!!!

The chicken gyro here is what you expect, it's pretty average which means it's dependable. The salad and tabbouleh is ok. I'm giving them a one star because when they say they close at 9 o'clock, this means they have no intention of preparing food until 9 o'clock. You need to make sure you arrive here by 8:15 or 8:30 if you plan to eat.

Absolutely loved breakfast here!! It is so nice to have a buffet of all the must haves in NOLA in a beautiful courtyard with jazz music. The waitstaff was sooo attentive. Definitely try the banana fosters, shrimp, gumbo, glazed sweet potatoes, homemade ice cream etc! It is all great. 

Also, make sure you make a reservation and request the courtyard. It is so beautiful with live jazz music!

I'm not a huge breakfast fan but this place is definitely worth it. Food is delicious, service was quick, coffee cup always filled, and it was all very affordable. Chorizo was really tasty, chilaquiles was a hit. I am coming back. My new favorite breakfast place.

SO EASY!!! I went here last night and everything was AWESOME! TOTALLY GO HERE!! You go in and sign in on a touch screen and then wait 10 minutes and go into a room to fill out insurance information and pay your copay. Then you wait in the lobby again for a nurse to do your vitals and what not. I waited for the doctor to come in and he did in a timely manner. He was so helpful and truly cared about my issue he did plenty of tests and wrote me prescriptions to get a second opinion. I got my antibiotics right then and there, totally reasonable prices. As a young person doctors are stressful and dealing with insurance info is complicated but they made this so easy!!! They will even schedule your appointment at other places if you ask! Blown away this place was great!

My last review was filtered out so I thought I would try 4/5 stars instead, though 5 stars is what they deserve.

I run a fellow paragliding school in Los Angeles but Rob and Ty are people I consider friends.  Their experience in the sport and enthusiasm is a valuable asset.  While they may not value the same things I do in instruction that is the benefit of competition, every school offers a different experience to suit all customers.

The training hill they use in Santa Barbara is second to none the world over and the gear they use is the latest and greatest is safety and performance.  Those looking to save a buck and cut corners are short sighted and don't realize the benefits of getting the latests and greatests in gear and instruction.

~ Aaron

Might go 3.5.  Please note, this review is strictly based on the bubble tea.

The wife and I were looking for something to crave our sweet tooth, and to crave it, we wanted bubble tea.  Not too many places in Noblesville got it, so we searched yelp and came up with this place.

The place itself is set in a strip mall (a very classy strip mall:-P).  The wife and I walked in, and saw a very chic, aesthetically pleasing little joint.  Of course they had frozen yogurt, which is why I'm sure most people come here.  Plenty of toppings, and very well presented.  If i was a frozen yogurt kind of guy, I might come here, but the wife and I were set on getting bubble tea.

They had both milk teas, and fruit blends.  Not sure what the quality would be like, we opted to get a Taro bubble tea.  I had heard the girl behind the register describe the taste of "taro" as being "nutty."  Yeah, definitely would not use that term to describe Taro.

An older lady (who we imagine to be the owner) made our bubble tea, and it rocked.  $3.50 or something for one, the wife and I thought about ordering a second, but were content with just the one.

Fun fact- the backwall of this place is covered with heart shape post it notes that you can write on.  Look for Dana and Ruben, and you will have seen greatness (ok, that was a bit much).

Celebrity Rating- John Cho
Ok, but not good. Very disappointed. Ambiance was lacking and service on the bar side was poor.
Was about to order and watched employee handling raw chicken then turned around and was gonna take my order- no gloves, no hand washing. Um, no thanks...

Amazing. Loved this place, easily the best breakfast we had in New Orleans on a really cold morning- hey, it was early January and around 29 degrees...

We had a "few" of their baked goods and their ciabatta bread. Also, somehow, we were able to pack a King's Cake as well for the office back home. Honestly I haven't been there since they recently went all vegan, however, I would trust them with this. Their scents as soon as you walk in the door are heavenly. Give this place a try.
Amazing total body workout! I am addicted. Great instructors, good atmosphere- motivating and as challenging as you make it! Highly recommend.

This is the most obnoxious Cosi location in the city, and it doesn't even have any Wharton undergrads to swarm it. All of the problems here are due to poor planning and management. 

Want to get breakfast? Come in, walk up to counter where it says 'order sandwiches,' guys making bagels studiously avoid eye contact. When they have made several bagels, one looks at you and asks if you've ordered. When you say no, he sends you over to the register. The guy who works in the morning is super-sweet but he can't make up for bad planning. Want a napkin? Ask the dude. Want a straw? Ask the dude. Need a plastic knife? Ask the dude. Poor guy is run ragged. Also there's nowhere to put your freaking coffee to put the sugar in it. 

Come back later for lunch? You think you have this down. You get in the line for the register all proud that you have figured out their system because it is the opposite of every other Cosi. You get to the front of the line and order. Did you order already? No, you say. Oh, you have to go order over there then come to the register .

ASDF!@*%!!!

Unparalleled service! I didn't even catch her name, but she was so helpful and just all around awesome. I called her up today asking if she had an unusual frame size in stock. She didn't, and when I said I was hoping to keep the cost low, she quickly came up with a creative solution that was well within my budget. She let us come to her shop that same afternoon, and she did a phenomenal job framing a print that is very dear to our hearts. 
Not only did she let us bring in our own frame, but she switched out the "claws"(?) on the back of the frame that it came with when it was purchased, for a more sturdy mounting system. 
She seemed so genuinely happy to help, it's something that you just don't experience very often anymore. 
We will definitely be back, and we recommend her for anyone looking to have anything framed.

Thanks for everything!

Had a sample platter of all the meats available, including their special feature of the night - burnt brisket ends and tips in a slightly spicy darkened tomato sauce (major flavour points on that one). We also with two sides - the cornbread skillet with honey butter and the baked beans with meat. All of it was amazing! All of the meats were juicy and were good enough to eat without their sauces. Beans were yummy but spicier than expected and with meat it was closer a chilli (neither are a bad thing by any means). I'll be dreaming about the cornbread skillet, the honey butter on it just sets it off! For my drink I had the lavender grapefruit, it was good but very mild on both flavours. Price wise, for a BBQ joint I found them more than reasonably priced, especially for the amount of stuff you get. Lastly, considering how busy it was for a Saturday night, our server was awesome at attending us and her other tables. Place was AMAZING and I will definitely go back!
Yay for being open late and having fried food on your bar menu!  Nice digs, gorgeous windows.  Sweet server and enormous portions.

Service provided by doctor was good. 

However, they billed me $30 for a single pill provided at the office.   The prescription filled for 30 pills cost $10.  And they refused to bill the insurance company. 

Watch out if you go here.  Take someone else with you and have them ask the cost of everything. 

Would have been a much higher rating if not for the extreme billing practice.
The food is not mediocre but it is not mind blowing either. It is also priced a little to high for the quality of bbb it is. The banana pudding is good.

I bought a gas fireplace from them. The pilot light went out and so I drove 30 minutes to ask them to show me how to light the pilot light and they refused on safety grounds. I asked if I could have a technician come out and they said it would be $150 and not anytime soon. The customer service is sorely lacking. It seems to me they want to sell you big ticket items and then have nothing further to do with the product.

Update:  so my fireplace doesn't have a pilot light in the conventional sense.  So there is no lighting of a pilot light.  The fix was to change batteries on the thingamagig... like really, they could not have mentioned this and saved me a service call?  In my opinion, this business SUCKS

We've tried quite a few sushi places in the West and South County areas. All of the food we had was very good here--nice, complex flavors. All of their rolls were comparably priced to other places. If you want to fill up and not spend way too much, get quite a few of their hand rolls and veggie rolls ($4).

However, we were at the restaurant for 1:30 hours. We didn't get our food for well over an hour and ate it pretty quickly after being so hungry. There were four total couples in the restaurant and a couple of carry-out orders being worked on. It looked as though there was only one chef present and everyone's meals were coming out very slowly. After finishing, we were ignored. The waitress was all around us doing other things: cleaning tables, checking on other people, etc. It  was quite obvious that we were finished for quite some time. The manager came by early on and apologized for the long wait.

Before anyone dismisses this as me being hard to please, that's far from the truth. I always give people the benefit of the doubt and never complain about meals or ask to see managers (and I didn't do that this time either). I eat it even if it's bad, still tip appropriately for less than good service, and go on my way.

The whole point of this is: If the service was bad, I could possibly see around it and return. If the food was slow, same thing...but not both! If I'm looking for a variety of rolls and a decent place to eat them, there are other options out there.
Amazing sushi selection! garlic endamame yummy!!! The El Mercado, Rajin Cajun roll was so delicious! Excellent service! We will be back again!

I do not grocery shop here, but I am a huge fan of the buffet. They have all types of options, Asian, American, home style, salads, pizza, soup, sushi, sandwiches etc. The cookies by the cash register are way better than the one by the bakery, in my opinion. Be careful, because you can easily spend $15 on a lunch by adding things. The Asian section of the hot buffet is my favorite. I also like that I can pick up a case of beer while on my lunch break.
Stopped in, had the regular Classic King Tuna. The bowl was great, I was able to add in a few other mix ins. Great customer service as well, will definitely be back!

Went up late September for Street Vibrations.  I had booked 2 rooms previous to our arrival, one double for 2 friends and a single for me.  I had given my friends the email reservation printout.  I checked in for my room and my friend checked in at another station nearby.  When we both went to check out the next morning, I put my payment on my credit card and my friend also paid with his credit card.  Checking my bank statement in October I found that I was charged for both rooms.  I called my friend, who said he had paid for the stay on his card and had the receipt.  I immediately fired off an email to advise the Nugget of this oversite and asked to have it corrected.  I got a return email that said they would look into it and get back to me.  November after not hearing from the Nugget, and checking my bank statement again, I sent off another email, I inturn got the same form email, they would get back to me.  Well its mid November, no response!  I am now sending copies of the emails with a letter to Operations.  Maybe by next Street Vibrations they will have made restitution.

It was a great time as always at Cheddars.  There were a lot of people waiting, but my daughter and I got in right away.   

This place has a nice atmosphere and the best prices.  My daughter got the potato soup and I got the red fish sandwich.   The fish sandwich was on the lighter side and it was very refreshing.  I got crazy and had the fries as a side with it too.   The food was all good. 

Then we got the cookie desert.   It was very good with ice cream on top with whipped cream and a cherry.   It brought me a little close to diabetes.  

Will return for the quality and prices.

Dined at the restaurant for the first time tonight.  The food was excellent.  The kitchen is most accommodating.  I ordered the roasted pear salad which was listed on the menu as being served with gorgonzola cheese and a red wine vinegrette.  I asked if they could substitute goat cheese and the apricot vinaigrette which was served on another salad - NO PROBLEM, 
Osso Bucco is my favorite veal dish and Trattoria Totaro's is one of the best I have ever had. It was served with risotto and broccoli rate - both excellent. My friend loved her Veal Vivian.  Portions are very generous and the food is served piping hot and plated well. The lemon cake we shared for dessert was delicious - very light and refreshing.  Our server Donna could not have been nicer.  Will certainly return very soon.

No oranges for the Blue Moon I ordered.  My mom ordered the carne asada which was tough and overlooked.  My husband had the carne asada tacos which he said were good.  I had enchiladas verdes.  Chicken was over cooked and somewhat dry.  Not really any sauce was detected on the enchiladas.  There was no cheese, just slightly seasoned over cooked chicken wrapped in a corn tortilla lightly dipped in a lime flavored sauce.  A huge piece of lettuce and a giant tomato with sour cream were on top of the  enchiladas.  It added nothing to the dish.  The chips were ok and the salsa with it was ok as well.  Nothing spicy.  I will give it one more shot as the beans were flavorful.  The server was attentive and very nice.
Horrible greasy food, workers standing in back of building smoking & on cell phones discusting, hope they use sanitation rules.

First time here. Smoothie was yummy!! Definitely be back as I'm a local. açaí bowls
Looks amazing too !

Spacious and good decor. We got wings and one of the larger wings was still cold in the center. They tasted great though and were pretty crispy. My fish and chips weren't anything especial. My wife got the hangar steak at $24 and the portion was ridiculously small (think quarter of what you normally get). She thought it was cooked and seasoned well. Drinks were good and the bartender was great. Probably wouldn't come back for food, but maybe drinks

The atmosphere is awesome, but a pretty girly place overall. The food was good, pricy, but the French onion soup was definitely worth the $12; the texture on the pastry dough over the top was breathtaking and the taste was exactly what I was hoping for. The cheeseboard was large and we couldn't finish it between two people. We decided to splurge on the $30 chocolate soufflé, it was really good, but I'm not sure 30 is an appropriate price. I was also a little bummed I had to go back downstairs if I wanted a latte instead of coffee, so I ordered coffee and wasn't thrilled about the choice of blend.
It was hard to tell who my server was, and therefore hard to tell who I was tipping, I had two regular waitresses and one who was in training. But two different people brought me checks, so that was a little confusing.
Overall it was a good experience.

How the heck did this place get four stars? It was awful. The only exception to that was the cocktail I had, which was like a margarita with grapefruit juice. All else terrible: service (seemed like our waiter was snubbing us purposefully), food (could not eat my entree nor the replacement soup I ordered), the atmosphere (loud, cold and not even a little relaxing). The Brussels sprouts were ok too I guess. But it was a bummer of a Valentine's.

My husband saw a Groupon for Cafe Dauphine, a restaurant in the upper 9th Ward (Holy Cross neighborhood).   We checked out the reviews, it looked good, so we bought it.  We used it tonight.  What an awesome experience!  The Holy Cross neighborhood is not like any other in the 9th Ward.  No empty lots with tall grass--just lots of beautiful houses that have been renovated to reflect the culture of our city.  But to get back to the restaurant--the food was amazing.  My husband got a deep fried stuffed bell pepper--yes apparently you can deep fry them!  I got grilled shrimp pasta--perfection!  The crab cake appetizer was stuffed with crabmeat and delish.  Oh wait, my pasta came with a "house salad."  It kept falling out of the plate--purple and green and not hint of  lettuce!  It also had berled egg, cucumber, tomato and cheese--not your typical house salad.  To top things off, we had cheesecake with a Banana's Foster topping....I'm not a sweet eater, but that stuff was GrrrrEAT!  The service was awesome and the owner was on site and told us the history of the building (convenient store for the last 30 years-pre-K and before that it was an ice cream store).  Her brother restored it beautifully for her restaurant.
One of my top two favorite Italian places in the area.  Consistent good quality whether it is dining in or taking out.  Love it and so does anyone I've brought there.  Friendly staff.  Fair prices.

I came in just for the fried alligator and the oysters. Unfortunately they didn't have oysters on the menu but I was able to try the alligator appetizer. Cochons alligator put the ones I ate elsewhere yesterday to shame. They are amazing! The spicy garlic sauce was amazing and I almost didn't leave any for my husband. Usually I hate mint and never go near it. However I was surprised that the green in my appetizer was mint. This is the first mint I have enjoyed my entire life thanks to the sauce and alligator. Also, their bread was fluffy and yum. Also my waiter was so pleasant! 

I left this place with the thought of the fried alligator burned into my brain and it really left an impression on me.

Had a great time. The roasted duck was cooked very well! Tender and juicy! Also ordered the Dragon and Phoenix which was a combination of vegetables with Scallops, Lobster & General Yao's chicken. The chicken was all white meat. The scallops were delicious. The lobster meat was scarce in this dish. The House Special Fried Rice was very good although I think the pork component were chunks of ham. We had a group of 8 and decided to order a bottle of Jack Daniels which cost a whopping $45!!!! The portions were really generous and the staff was very accommodating and polite. I would definitely be back. Oh and pay attention to what you're ordering if you want to check the bill, you'll have to be able to read Chinese!

Didn't give me dressing with my takeout salad and the chicken orzo soup has hardly any chicken or orzo in it (basically, hot cream in a cup). Spent $12 and a half hour of my time and still have an empty stomach to show for it.

We can't say enough about this place! We have referred several people to the Hub and all have thanked us. From the service to the food you will be pleased. Make sure that you save room for the amazing ice cream!

If you want to come for decent food come here... If you want terrible customer service... Make sure to ask for Teresa as your server. My friends and I arrived Monday around 5 and the waitress already had an annoyed face. Mind you we were the only ones at the restaurant so it's not like it was busy. And the waitress gave us the coldest, rudest service ever. She even made us feel uncomfortable and unwelcomed. Our food order wasn't complicated, rude, or excessive and she still maintained that attitude. I will never come to this place ever again or recommend it..  I rather go to Brooklyns pizza or even little ceasers.   Distasteful experience.

Stopped by for a quick cocktail before dinner. We each had the Manhattan,  Mi-lo and the U.S.S. Arizona...so refreshing for a hot day. The pineapple in the U.S.S. Arizona is actually a pleasant surprise! Def recommend checking this place out

This was a great farmer's market in downtown Boise that occurs every Saturday.  Located in a main plaza area, it's easy to find and access, with a decent amount of vendors. 

My bestie and I came to check out the Capital City Public Market, and we were pleased to find a variety of different vendors and artists.  Items for sale ranged from fresh produce, to wood-carved jewelry and painted prints, to wine made from jalapenos!  Most of the vendors selling food and drinks allowed for free samples.  

If in the area on a Saturday until around 2pm, I recommend checking out the Capital City Public Market.  It's a great way of learning about and seeing the products grown in the area, as well as supporting local businesses.  Glad we were able to check it out during our long weekend in Boise.

I will be returning here. The food was bland, the aqua de horchata tasted like water with cinnamon and was just a disappointment. Not authentic tasting and just very plain tasting. The service was good but everything else gets a thumbs down. I am Mexican and have had authentic CA. Mexican food so I know real Mexican food and this is not it.

I am so obsessed with this place. I came here with all my siblings and cousins and we had the best time ever singing away. The only thing i wasn't too happy about was that the food wasn't amazing but it wasn't horrible.

Living on its reputation. Went for lunch with three others. Gumbo was very bland with notes of burnt flower. Crawfish dish was tasteless. Dessert was served with all the grace an elegance of s Big Mac. Don't go here. Much better food throughout New Orleans.

It was okay...not a place I would go out of my way. Service sucked! Just not personable. It was our first time so I asked for recommendation.   Felt like it was too annoying for her to give us one. She recommended the tuna nacho's which I did enjoy. I would go back for those only.

Entree I got the seafood platter which wasn't anything out of this world...same old stuff u can get anywhere else. The waitress stated the seafood is food but I think the meat might have been a better choice. Ppl around us ordered filet kabob...

I think it's busy for the happy hour and drinks.

I hated our table...wanted inside due to my allergies and they sat us inside but by the door. They open all the doors so u are really outside with a roof on top u. I could bearily breathe through my nose.

I can't believe this place is related to island way grill.

My husband said the crab Mac and cheese was good. Also the mama fritters? It's the corn muffins that come with entree that is also on the app menu.

Worst experience of my life. The service is absolutely TERRIBLE. The bartender was extremely rude and her attitude killed my whole mood. Such a nice place, such horrible food, drinks, and service. What a waste!!

It is a great place to take in Tampa at its best.  They are working on the last sections of the river walk.  When it's done it will go from the history museum to water works park.  I believe it passes by six water front parts. There are plenty of place to stop sit down and enjoy the view. It's a fun family outing.
So many better sushi places. The AYCE is horse poop and they take forever to get a second order.

Grew up dining at some of the great Brooklyn and Manhattan delis.  This place is right up there with them.  The service is cafeteria style and even the long lines go quickly.  The food is not for the faint of heat, with generous portions on everything.  Reubens, Pastrami on rye, sides, etc., were all excellent.  Perhaps not the healthiest eating but certainly delicious.  Walking distance from the Colts stadium.  Nice to go to with a small, intimate group willing to order different items and share.

I was so excited to discover a Han Dynasty in NJ!!! I've been to the other locations, and loved it! However, this place had a completely different "vibe" than the others. It was completely empty the day we came and our waitress and another staff member kept watching us eat from around the wall (creepy). Anyway, I knew what to expect from the food, so I ordered what I would normally get but it came out wayyyyy too spicy! (every dish we ordered was spicy!) Don't get me wrong, I understand the rating of the heat scale, but a dish that would normally be a 4 was a 10!!! Maybe this was just a bad day for the cook or they were playing an awful joke on us! Either way, this was my boyfriend's first (and probably last) time there! 
I'll just stick with the Manayunk location. Nice try though.

Love this place! I come here often. The service is fantastic, so is the food. One time my pizza was a little too over cooked. I actually didn t notice until my waiter said they were making a new one and I could keep this one to take home if I wanted. I thought that was a very nice gesture.

What a nice find here in Riverview. In these trying times of COVID 19, I'm going to make it my mission to review the local businesses that have made me happy thus far. I have only eaten at Mi Casa once. It was the day we closed on our new home in Riverview. 3 days later all hell broke loose. My Brother ordered a quesadilla, my husband ordered a fajita and really I'm pretty unforgiving if you can't make a taco and you're a Mexican place, so to really gauge their handle on flavor and heat I always go wicked basic and get street tacos. Mi Casa had exceptional street tacos! My husband and brother enjoyed their choices too (so much I wasn't invited to share a bite). We all shared a yummy flan for desert. Our waiter/host was attentive, polite and even allowed us to sit outside when no one was out there yet. I can't wait for this "social distancing" to run its course I enjoyed the atmosphere and long to enjoy it again. 
Mi Casa may be doing take out right now but I'm housebound with asthma and while I'd love me a trip to Mi Casa, I'm staying home for my safety and the safety of others.

As soon as my bf and I finished sampling Geno's, we immediately headed for Pat's. The line was equally atrocious, but there were a few distinctive differences between the two. 
1.The bread was a little hard.
2.The steak was cooked just right.
3.Needed a little more cheez whiz.

So asides from the hard bread and the insufficient cheez whiz, I prefer Pat's because I'm very meticulous about the way my food is cooked...and frankly I don't appreciate any aftertastes.

The new restaurant is OUTSTANDING. I was not expecting such a chic place inside the hotel. My boss and I tried multiple items from the menu and loved each one. We ate them too quickly for me to take pictures, but we tried the eggplant & tomato bruschetta, crab cake sandwich, fries, tempura fried cauliflower, blackened shrimp, and fried brussel sprouts (in two visits ). I wish I wasn't full so I could keep eating! We also had a wonderful server named Kyle. Super friendly and engaging, and all smiles. If I come back into town for business I will definitely stay here again just for the restaurant and wonderful service.

A good Starbucks. The inside has been cleaner than other Starbucks in the area. The staff are friendly and service is prompt. Drive thru can be pretty packed sometimes, but it moves pretty well. Drinks always meet the "Starbucks standard." A nice choice if you are in the area!
Amazing views and many ways to make your way up the hill. Bring water and proper shoes, expect an hour or more to walk up.

The burger was so over-salted that it nearly was inedible.  Don't know if they use a season mix and were careless or if the salt is separate.  I would be willing to try again and be a pain in the ass when ordering if it would yield a great burger that I actually could eat.  Great toppings and friendly servers.
Mediocre food. Extremely poor service. I tried this place twice to make sure it wasn't a fluke. First time for weekend dinner; second time for weekend lunch. Don't bother trying this place.

5 out 5 if you are a raw eating only vegan.  I'm not So for me 3 out of 5 but rounding up as raw only vegans probably have limited options;) 
Super clean, very friendly staff.  They walk you through the menu, give lots of options & samples.  The smoothie was delicious I think it would as the King Rawksta Loved it But not inexpensive at 8.99ish Great ingredients though and good quality
For entrees I'd give the nudge to eggless egg salad over the raw/ dehydrated burger but both were good.
If you only eat raw foot get there and  enjoy
Amazing place and great vibe.  Enjoyed the dessert I think since they are new I am excited to see more things that they cook up!

What a quirky place! We were staying at an Airbnb in the area, and the host insisted that we check this place out. A great place to come at the end of the day to unwind and enjoy a drink.  

Love: the decor was so unique and truly off the wall! Also, there was local music (talented people in STL). 

Tip: it is cash only, but they also have an ATM in the basement.

I love the Grove. When we need to have a girls weekend away or there is something fun going on in Boise (ie: concert) we always choose to stay here, even though we have friends who live in Boise. Funny enough, those friends usually end up w/ us at the Grove, too. I liked it better when it was still "undiscovered" but the rates are still very reasonable and you can't beat the location. The staff is always friendly, despite us acting like we think we're rock stars while there. Everyone needs a good escape that isn't too far from home, but just far enough and for me, this is the Grove. Rooms are decent sized, beds are comfy, price is reasonable and location is excellent. If only they didn't have those annoying energy saving lights that blink several times before just turning on (very unpleasant when hungover) I would give them one more star.

The worst internet ever. The worst customer service. There a complete
 rip off. Garbage they only get one star because I have too

I was not a fan.  It was very crowded, loud, not air conditioned, and expensive. There were a number of children-- a problem if the kids aren't getting services and you're paying 30% more because it's a small, organic salon. Also, the bathroom is connected to one of their rooms for private services, so if someone is getting a wax, there is no bathroom. There was also a lack of flourishes-- they don't use little bowls of water to soak your hands, and my manicurist didn't have me wash my hands before she started on my gel polish.

I really don't get the appeal. My manicure was fine, but I could have gotten one more quickly and comfortably at virtually any other salon in the neighborhood (for ~$20 less).

Wonderful food, quick service, great for a quick bite or coffee with friends. Great selection of healthy options and baked goods. I don't recommend choosing this place if you want to study--the background music is very loud, not a lot of comfortable seating or charging outlets, and it can get very crowded on the weekends.
Had a blast! Friend service and good food! Would reccomend for kids birthday parties.

The food is as good or as bad as any Qdoba... I like it, especially what used to be the Mexican Gumbo and apparently now is the loaded Tortilla Soup... same thing, different name....
BUT the service here leaves a lot to be desired. There is usually one or two kids that are really friendly and helpful and the remainder has attitude, moves slow as molasses, like you are really bothering them by having the audacity to order something and making them abandon their conversation, which actually most of the time they don't even stop while 'waiting' on  you. 
Enough to make you loose your appetite. I love that soup/gumbo or whatever you want to call it, but I rarely get it, just because I don't want to deal with the enthusiastic staff.

This place is glorious. The pizza is delicious and the beer selection is top notch. I highly recommend getting The Dogtown. Also, get Modern Brewery's Citropolis. Go in for a pint and a slice, it's an excellent deal. Oh, and the T Ravs are great.
Out of this world burger and potato!! Delightful, surprise of the beaten path of bourbon street!!

My 3 daughters and I visited this nail spa over the weekend. I must say that I was impressed at first sight. As our visit continued I did realize how terrible customer service was. A massage therapist actually took my newborn granddaughter away from my daughter (without asking), and refused to give her back when we commanded her to do so. That same massage therapist never stops talking. She is completely out of line. My youngest daughter had a new technique applied to her nails. It peeled
Off the same day. When we returned to the salon to have her nails redone; they refused to warranty the nails. So, we spent $300.00, and the management refused to redo a $40.00 service. That is just stupidity. We have been to mcnails several times, because they are open on Sundays. No one in my 10 person household will ever return. You guys had the opportunity to make $600. A month, but because of your refusal to redo a $40. service; you have lost a whole large family of customers. Like I told you today---you are an idiot. I will be sure to spread the news. The spa is always empty. It looks as though you could have used our business----too bad.

I wish there were half stars so I could give it a 3.5, because it just wasn't quite a 4 star experience. The Eagle is owned by the same company that owns Bakersfield just a few doors down. They have similar vibes and decor. I would not recommend going to the Eagle on a date or with a small group on Friday or Saturday night. The tables are set up in such a way that it is more conducive for groups of 6 to 8. My group of four was seated with a group of 3 guys next to us. 

We were told it would be about a 90 minute wait, which is fine, it's a Saturday night. When we were called after 60 minutes we went over the hostess stand to be seated and instead were told it would be about another 30 minutes....which is what we expected from the beginning. The waitress also carded me at the table, even though I had a beer already in my hand from ordering it at the bar during our wait. She seemed pretty nervous about getting in trouble for serving someone underage, I am assuming they recently had a lesson or conversation with the wait staff about that. I think they are just in process of learning and training the staff. 

It was hard to shuffle your plates, silverware and glasses around on the tiny table to be respectful of your friends and the other party seated with you. The Chicken Sandwich was way spicier than I expected, that is not the fault of the restaurant I should have asked however it made my meal less enjoyable. 
I will say the appetizer we had was very good, the warm spinach dip with chips. 
I think I would most likely go back with a large group just for drinks and appetizers.

Located inside the Nashville airport. Service is neither fast, nor friendly. Food takes a while, even when it's slow. The breakfast menu is simple, but has good, basic offerings. Come only if you have lots of time.
All the sandwiches we've had here are really good! Lots of great options, and tasted fresh even getting curbside pickup during the pandemic.

Bern's Steak House has opened an ice cream and dessert shop across the street from the famous restaurant. Now you may enjoy some signature treats without going to the Harry Waugh Dessert Room located on the second floor of the eatery . This is fabulous news for many or could be bad news for your waistline if you find it difficult to fight temptation. The confectionery is not to visible from the street. Let me make it easy for you. Pull into the Epicurean Hotel, park for free in the covered parking and you will find this new establishment. Easy peezy, simple as that! You will not have to valet. I mention this because one might think you must valet. 

I ventured in to get a scoop of my favorite ice cream flavor since childhood, Macadamia Nut. A flavor I could only order if dining at Bern's, until now.  My expectations were high because after all this is Bern's ! I was met with a hi and please let us know if you want to taste a flavor ! I'm excited already ! I was let down by the aesthetics of the shop immediately. I was expecting something a bit more grand than the simplicity of what I saw and what was there before the renovation. It's just an ice cream parlor, I get it, but I was anticipating something a bit more sassy. I can live with this. I waited a long time for one of the two associates to actually help me. I went in knowing exactly what I wanted and there is nothing here to arouse your senses while you wait . I was given my order and took my first lick. I was in heaven! Delicious as always ! For a second my eye went to the pints ready to go for home enjoyment ! Then I quickly thought of the many miles I'd have to run or spin classes I would have to endure just to burn off this 2 minute indulgence !    There are a handful of tables if you choose to hang out.

Main reason they are getting 3 stars is because the pizza is just so good. Lost 2 stars because I am not a germaphobe by any means but bathrooms that make me cringe is bad I can tell ya. Management should address this for sure and not just chuck it up to "well the building is old!" The ceiling fans have not been cleaned in well over a year...thank goodness they were off or the amount of dust balls that would fly off of them into your food would be unreal. Place needs a deep deep cleaning way more than it gets for sure.

Sooooooo yummy! Way better than I thought! And the service was great, too! Walked in with my two babies and everyone was all about helping me with high chairs and booster seats and trying to keep them occupied until my husband showed up! Margaritas were tasty and the food was delicious! Really enjoyed it! Funny thing I'd like to mention, cause maybe they have great burgers, but the couple across from us got 2 cheeseburgers. Like literally no Mexican on their table at all. Lol! Like why!?! Must be delicious???

I will not be doing business with this company again,  I ordered 2 items and was charged $16.99 for shipping.    I was under the assumption that shipping was free.   When I called to complain, I was told that shipping was free, but since  I did not enter correct code, I was being charged.   Most companies would correct errors on their end and refund this amount.  Woman within refuses.  Terrible customer service.  I asked to be taken off their mailing list.

The food is decent. I haven't had anything that would set this apart from the other Thais. Curry is curry and noodle is noodle. Inside the restaurant looks just like the way it looks from outside. The one thing that annoys me is they have a sign that says they might charge 15% service charge for large to go orders over $20. So since when $20 order is a large order?

Good food loved the creamy beans. I had a Chili Rellenos  along with a  sour cream enchilada. No complaints at our table for four. Service a bit slow. Good homemade salsa. A bit stingy with the chips. All and all a good experience. We will come back.

I understand it's spring break, and we're patient, but seriously. Rude wait staff like we're bothering them to order drinks. Waitress should maybe find a new career path, waiting on people and making them feel welcome not so much your cup of tea. Our waitress was not nice, didn't make us feel welcome . We've been here for almost 2 1/2 hours and begging for our bill. My husband has been to the bar twice to get drinks, cuz we our waitress was no where in sight. Needless to say, we won't be back. Disappointing as it looked like such a great place when we drove by.

This is a perfectly placed hotel if you want to be close enough to walk to all of the excitement of Bourbon Street and the French Quarter, but far enough away to get a good night's rest without all of the hooting and hollering of the drunkies. So for me, it was perfection. The lobby is on the 11th floor and check in was easy. There is coffee/tea/hot chocolate and snacks like oatmeal bars 24/7. There is also a restaurant but why the heck would you eat there I have no idea. The pool is on the rooftop which is also a fantastic view of the city. We went up there right away to catch the view of the Super Dome, and most of the FQ. 

Our room was very comfortable. Can't think of anything that was wrong. Free WiFi, Keurig, every channel you can imagine, a safe, a fridge, a microwave. Everyone we came into contact with was very friendly. I would stay here again. 

TIP: No need to rent a car if you are visiting the FQ. Even the Street Car Line is just a block away, if you want to venture a little further out to the Garden District - it will cost you only 1.25 and a fun ride on the St. Charles line!

Called to get information for doing my hair and make up for my wedding. Without even knowing what my date was, she said, "I don't have anything available." So she either doesn't do those services anymore, or she just doesn't want any business. Not very professional.

We checked in for our reservation and still had to wait to be seated.  Why bother?  The salad bar was OUTSTANDING!  The wine and drink list was multiple pages.  The meat service was as cool as usual but THE MEAT WAS VERY SALTY!  I could not enjoy the meal.  Apparently that is normal as I see other comments about salty fare.  I recommend salad bar only..

This is now my go to place for dim sum.  Use to love Urban China but found the food qaulity has gone done and price up.  

Have never had an issue waiting to get a table, as this is has fairly large dining area.  If you have a big group of more than 4 they have lots of big tables.  Service has always been prompt, whether you need more hot water for tea or clearing your table.  

They have all the usual dim sum fair.  Never had any major complaints though the last time the steam shrimp (Hai Gai) tasted a bit burnt.  And sometimes they seem to not push out any of the more popular dishesfor quite some time.  But the solution is to just ask one of the servers to place an order, so no big deal (I just find part of the charm of dim sum is getting to choose from the carts that come around).

Like I said, I love this place for dim sum (can't soeak about dinner here since have come for it).  Great service, clean and roomy dining area, and prices are reasonable.  We average about $45 for 3 every time we go.  Parking can be a challenge on Sundays after 11:30 as it tends to fill out fast.
My favorite Pho restaurant. Great food and service. Great food, fresh, hot and tastes great. Family oriented and kid friendly.

I love Costco.  Great prices that have saved my family a lot.  Good quality and their return policy is excellent.  Get my eyes examined, new glasses, new tires, best prices on prescriptions, clothes, shoes, food, small appliances, and more.  The executive membership always pays us back more in the 2% that the cost.  So nice to end up getting paid to shop Costco.

A portion of our crawl space was flooded and we needed help right away.  I called Andrew at Done Right Flood & Fire Services and he immediately came out - assessed the situation and determined that he could help us.  He coordinated everything with our insurance as well as our HVAC company - because there was duct work damage as well.  Throughout the whole process he and his crew were friendly and professional.  We are very thankful that we found him and would recommend him to anyone that needs help with any home disasters that may come there way.
Mojo was parked outside MorseFest this weekend. We tried the birthday cake and the double chocolate sandwiches. Both were wonderful and the service was speedy and friendly.

NO LOCALS EAT HERE: of 500+ Yelp reviews most locals rate it 2 stars or less.  Every time I walk by their Decatur street location I'm creepily reminded of a Potemkin Village.  Central Grocery idly hides behind their former glory. 

A DRIED-OUT MUFF that even a "coupla Dix" can't revive & at high tourist prices!  Who cares if they invented it?!  This desiccant muffuletta is embarrassingly the worst in the Quarter.  The parched bland bread was once just a vessel to hold the flavorful sandwich.  Now its almost all of it (check out the Yelp! photos and compare them to the one I posted here from Reuben's, doesn't CG's look dry?). And I know CG says the muff should never be toasted, but I think that's only because they're too lazy to do so.

LOCAL'S TIP: Rouse's or Dorignac's make tastier less pricey olive salad: 32 oz at $8; versus CG $18!

WAY BETTER FQ/CBD MUFF OPTIONS: Cochon Butcher, Cajun Mike's, Reuben's, Napoleon House, Welty's Deli, CVS's prepackaged hoagies...

First time at location. Many options to choose from. Food was taking long and wait staff came to let us know that our ticket had been accidentally not turned in and they were taking care of our whole bill. The honesty was great, and the food was even better. Have no problem going to this establishment when I come across one.

The food was acceptable.   We enjoyed the oyster shooters and the catfish decatur.  But the customer service was poor.  One person in our party didn't enjoy her drink so a manager came to our table to tell us they couldn't keep remaking her drink so she'd need to accept it.   Ultimately, she wasn't charged but the way the situation was approached could have been better.   At one point, we asked where the restrooms were and the employee answered us as if he was irritated by us asking.   Most of the employees there seemed annoyed and inconvenienced by the customers.   Our waiter, Chris, was helpful and pleasant.   I'd suggest eating here... if you're desperate for food like we were.
Literally my favorite place to go every time I'm in town! SO yummy. My boyfriend & I split a small sushi pallete and ugh it's so perfect

We in town I love coming here and enjoying some chargrilled oysters . I've come before and if you sit at the oyster bar as they are shucking the oysters. Had the New Orleans Steak patty meal as well. For got yo take a picture. Oops !!!

Stopped in for dinner tonight and the food and service were both great. Had the whole family there and they all loved it. Not to mention I exepected the check to be more than it was. We will definitely be back

This pharmacy has alot to improve. They never have anything in stock. I am on a pain med for chronic pain. My Dr called in a prescription Monday, 3 hours later we dropped by to pick it up. Guess what...out of stock. I had only 1 pill left. They told me they had a shipment coming in Wed.  Well here it is Friday..still no shipment. I have been in terrible pain since Tuesday. Can't sleep. This is unacceptable . They suggested I call my Dr  to cancel that order, so we could go elsewhere. Good luck on that, my clinic take 48 hours to answer calls. Guess I'll be looking for a new clinic and pharmacy. To bad, I have been a Fry's customer for 25 years.

In my younger years, I used to frequent the Renaissance Festival.  I decided to go back this year for the first time in a long while and I had a GREAT time!

There is just so much to do:  From jousting, to live chess, to singing and dancing, to even weddings and most of it is free!  There are also many food options as well as frequent beer and wine stands throughout the park.  The day we went, there was a baby crawling contest that my little one participated in and also a dog costume party.

The people that work for the Renaissance Festival are always having such a great time and make it fun for the guests too.  I definitely plan to make this a new tradition in my family!
Damn this place actually has great pizza. And it's BYOB. She don't look like much from the street but they've got the sauce. Love it.

I would have preferred the option to select three and one half stars which would have been more accurate. We arrived on a Friday evening about 7PM. We were offered outdoor seating but there was a band playing loudly across the street, lots of traffic (including an emergency vehicle with siren), and a boisterous crowd so we opted for inside. We were seated promptly at a rear table. Although only about 3/4s full it was quite noisy, increased by music on speakers.  Apparently ubiquitous in restaurants this establishes a noise minimum which is then built upon by the volume of table conversation. The result is difficulty in conversing in a normal voice. (And of course the music being played is unidentifiable.)  The cocktails were good, especially the specialty grapefruit infused vodka one. The Manhattan was too sweet by half but nicely adjusted by the addition of dry vermouth. 
The mussels were excellent as were the west coast oysters. However the lobster which was described as poached in butter was run under the broiler before serving which made it dry.  The profiteroles were dessert and were delicious.
vibe was pretty relaxing. went here at the start of happy hour so the place wasnt crowded at all.  seems like it would be a good place to go
This place is amazing. Great food, great drinks, and kombucha on tap! The staff is super nice and accommodating. Would definitely go back!

It was my first time visiting the Auction House Market as well as Aloha Lei. The poke bowls were absolutely amazing. It was great being able to customize the bowls to exactly what we like. Service was great and the food came out very quick. I found it a little pricey but the quality of the fish was great and with such a beautiful atmosphere it was worth it! I will definitely return!
I would give this place infinite stars if I could! Superb work, pricing and person. It's hard to find a person so honest and just truly loves what he does.

I've been shopping around for a road bike and stopped in today after being completely ignored at another popular bike shop. I had a wonderful experience and will definitely be back in to test ride some bikes when I have more time. Thanks!

Just came across this place and stopped in for dinner. It was really good - great option for quick Mexican type food. I came with my husband and son and we all enjoyed our meal. My husband and son's only complaint was that their food wasn't spicy enough however we noticed (too late) that there was a shelf with 75 hot sauce options! Prices were fair, place was clean and employees were friendly. Will definitely return.
Love this vegetarian cafe. Great area with cool setting and clean fast service.Also great prices.

The Service: 

I like the concept of a phone call/text to let me know when my table is ready, but I don't like loudly yelling my phone number to a host leaning over a crappy HP laptop.  If you're going to provide this service, please get a tablet of some sort so that they can make eye contact and provide better service. 

Our server greeted us with his name and the phrase -- "As you can see we are busy.." -- COME ON! Please do not lead off my dining experience with the idea that I'm going to receive slow and/or inattentive service!  Also, when you set my food down, don't say -- "You're about to eat the best meal of your life." -- You have no idea what my food history is.  

Beyond that the server was attentive and friendly, I suppose I'm just picky.

The Food:

This was not the best Black & Blue burger I've ever had, but it definitely wasn't bad.  I've spent less on a burger (that actually came with a side) and been more pleased.  I'm definitely willing to try more offerings, but the quality wasn't really where it should be for the price. 

The beer selection was very nice and priced accordingly. I have a feeling my next visit will involve more beer than food.

We always go to this little restaurant on the waterway and have grilled octopus and a nice drink there are several places in Tarpon Springs to get grilled octopus but we have found that Demetries is the best great wait staff very friendly and helpful. I suggest that everyone go to Tarpon Springs if you've never been there it's a little Greek village that is the sponge fishing Capital of the world so they claim supposedly the Mediterranean sponges all died out and they came to America the Greeks and found that there were similar conditions in the golf of Mexico for sponges so they set up shop in this little town so cute so quaint check it out

Had an excellent lunch here yesterday.  We ordered tapas style...fried alligator, pork roast and ribs, liver, Waldorf salad, rabbit dumplings etc.  Very attentive and knowledgeable wait staff.  Rich and delicious food paired with impressive atmosphere and ambiance.  I will come here again.

So I've walked by this place a lot of times in the past 3 years and every time I want to try it it's a 15-20 minutes wait! The day has come that I was able to get an early lunch.. I went there with my colleague around 11:45 and I'm glad we got seated immediately.. When 12:10 hits.. The place was already packed and people are waiting outside. Crazy. This review is focused on the place and food itself. No liquor or anything. The place itself it gorgeous! Great place to have Happy Hour! I didn't check the liquor prices but when looking for great ambiance this is the place to be. Looking at the bar it was pretty decent size.. Servers were friendly and restrooms were actually clean! I got the Beef Burrito for $11.50 I think. It was really good. It's better than Chipotle for sure but the price is not :-p . I'll come back again for the Guac.. The server kept raving about the Guac. But I will be the judge next time

Being truthful I'm not the regular museum type but while visiting downtown Indianapolis I thought it was the right thing to do and check it out. It was very well-designed organized and extremely informative. I highly recommend if your in the area. Only $11 to view.

Devil's Alley has a fun sign and dim interior. Two of us were seated upstairs. Oddly, the tables are situated along the balcony rather than the wall. The balcony is wrapped in holiday lights. There are fake greenery hung about the place and trees on the first floor too. Unnecessary dust-accumulating clutter, in my opinion. 

The beer selection was intriguing. I had a yummy one, the name of which I do not remember. We started with half a chicken quesadilla. It wasn't very impressive. But our entrees were huge. My companion had the buffalo chicken sandwich, and he really liked the hot sauce. I was super pumped to try a fried green tomato, so I ordered the fried green BLT. The tomato did not disappoint! I have found a new food to love. However, there was way, way too much goat cheese spread on the sandwich. They might as well not have included tomato aoli, because its presence in the flavors was zero. 

The two of us took half our meals home. The fries reheated well the next day for lunch. The prices didn't seem absurd or gratuitous.

On a random note, I learned several days later that this restaurant was constructed by non-union workers.
I just moved to Dunedin from San Diego and stopped here to try their street tacos. They are absolutely amazing! Super authentic! This place will be a new staple!

Most the review on this page is from their friends and family  I believe. Zach quoted me $3400-$3600 for a move in April from Reno to ARizona. Our place was not ready at the time and we had to cancel and out the stuff in storage. 

For royalty reason in my mind I contacted him to set up a time for September, he quoted me $5900 and saying that he's giving me a discount!!! Is it something going on in Reno causing more than 50% increase in price?!!!  He was so nice and gave me rate of $3400-$3600 even towing my car!!!

His response to me when I asked why the price went up, he didn't acknowledge the previous quote. 

"It's a 13-hour Drive their 13-hour drive back that's 26 hours drive time. Then 4 hours load time and 4 hours unload that makes a total of 34 hours I charge 180 an hour so you can see I actually gave you a discount."

It took 3 hours for other movers to load everything from my house in the truck and unload them into storage. You are piece of joke Zach!!! Also this is s one way trip of 13 hours. Are you gonna pay me if you take a load back to Reno! 

34/2=17 hours at max of $200/ hour would be $3400, the price he gave me the first time contacted him!!!
Zach thinks he's too smart and found an opportunity because now I'm in Arizona and really need my stuff. 

Zach could make $3400, now he's making ZERO. Because I wouldn't ever deal with dishonest person even for free!

$180/ hour?!!!! Who do you think you are, we as engineers and doctors don't make that much with our high stress jobs. Be reasonable and don't confuse royalty with weakness.  

I don't recommend dishonest and greedy people yo anyone! You have a good life Zach!

Zach make a mistake. Zach is greedy, don't be like ZACH.

These people are the most unsympathetic people I have ever encountered in my life. I requested that they postpone the internment of my parents ashes due to COVID19. I was  concerned about my safety and  the safety of anyone that I would encounter due to the increased risk of contacting the virus during my travel to and from there. They flat out refused and sided with my sister. Oh, and they also allowed my sister to intern my brother's ashes without consenting his widow.

Ok so the first couple weeks they had a rough start, but Stella Blues is the spot this summer. Be patient ya'll, it's gonna blow up. The food is not dried out, it is cheap and awesome. The beef kabobs are amazing. They grill right there in front of you like Fast Eddies. Just had the chicken wings yesterday and was pretty impressed with the sweet and spicy sauce. Monday is dollar wells! ALL DAY! The owners are very sweet and very excited about the new place. You must stop in. They make frozen margaritas and pina colodas and they are freakishly delish. You must GO!

I was in NOLA for a conference and wanted to find somewhere authentic to eat that wasn't too crazy as I was by myself on business. This place was historic, quiet, and the food was delicious! I had a shrimp po boy and a salad. The service was friendly, it did take awhile for the food to come out even though it wasn't crowded but I think it's bc it was 9 pm. But I really enjoyed my experience overall.

Pros & a con.  Someone recommended the pork chop po-boy to me. Asian family place where they put 2 fried boneless chops on 8 or 9 inches (can't re member).  I got lettuce, tomato & mayo.  Price was fair.  While it was delicious, i have to deduct significantly for the amount of fat on the chops.  I had to stop chewing & take it out of my mouth a number of times.  If you eat the fat, go "whole hog" on it.  I don't eat the fat, though, so it was a pain!  P.S.  others soul food plates, looked yummy.

When I usually go there's a young women who has a booth on the left side and she always hooks me up. Well, I took my daughter on Thursday and had a horrible experience w/ a different worker. They didn't wash my daughters hair with any shampoo so when they straightened it it was stiff and it smelled like dirty hair. The only good thing about this place is that it delivers. That's it...
The food isn't horrible, but it's not good either. The prices are fair. I would recommend Golden Sea in Blue Bell rather than this place. The food and service is much better there and they offer more.

Hands down best pizza in St. Pete. Best pizza in Pinellas. Best pizza in Tampa Bay. Best pizza in Florida. Dough is delicious. Simple, great tomato sauce. Owners are awesome. Great selection of local beer.

Employees don't wear masks. (Seen this myself). Owner/ Employees insult, threaten, and kick out patrons questioning their bad hygiene practices (from a friend) this is not an establishment that deserves to continue being in business

The service is pretty bad. They mixed up orders and just handed the sandwich to me as if they want to just get done with it. They also rushed me in ordering. I was not happy at all with the experience. I ordered the meatball sandwich. The sandwich was okay. I have had better meatball Sandwitches in nyc.

Dinner was delicious! Deviled eggs are as good as everyone said it is. Little too pricey unless you catch them at happy hour but are nonetheless worth a try. Service was a tad slow but was well worth the wait. Very pleased with how everything turned out.

This is my go-to car wash. I actually live closer to one of their competitors and I drive an extra 10-15 minutes to go here! 
I frequented this spot a few times before they got me with the unlimited car wash membership. I signed up when they were having a deal for the first month of premium washes for $20 - which was only $2 more than the car wash I was getting that day. After the first month I was billed $36 for the premium unlimited plan. 
Best believe I'm the kinda person that when you say unlimited - I say BET. With this membership I've been getting my car washed on an every-other-day basis. 
I come here for all the extras they got- microfiber towels, dash wipes, a floor mat cleaner, and compressed air along with their vacuums. 

I even came in with my partner in his car, mentioned to the attendant that I had an unlimited plan but with my car- and he still let us in for free because he was "with an unlimited member". I'm never going to let my partner live down the car wash clout that I have here. 

Seriously the best service- such a simple little thing but I love how everyone waves to you here. Everyone that works here just seem like good and happy people!

A grounded and quieter coffeehouse in the middle of the hustle and bustle of downtown Nashville! 

I've frequently visited the Old Hickory location in the past and was completely unaware of this downtown location until recently. I expected a busy and crowded vibe (like the downtown Frothy Monkey) but was pleasantly surprised by the comfortable work environment! Great sunlight, background music that's not overwhelmingly distracting, range of table sizes, and of course, amazing coffee per usual. I have a habit of ordering the Cuban every time - both hot or iced are wonderful with the flavor and strong kick that I need - but their pour overs are smooth and strong as well. 

The only downside to this location is the inconvenient parking situation, but that's honestly expected in any downtown shop or office. If you're already working there or had a meal nearby, then just walk on over. There is a paid parking lot right next to Wells - like 10 feet away - but it's around $20 per 3 hours, just to give you a heads up! Or you can do what I do and drive around strategically forever and ever to find street parking...

Came to this location yesterday since we were at Clearwater beach and needed to stop to get something to eat. Figured this would be a good place since it's the original hooters and we hadn't been. 3/4 of us all got chicken of some kind and ALL got sick. I don't know if we just got unlucky but it's not a coincidence that all of us got sick after eating the chicken. Will not come back in the future and definitely DO NOT RECOMMEND.
Come on....it's chick fil a. Your food is never going to be wrong. You'll always have your straw/napkin. & if you ask for 50 sauces they'll give it to you lol

Just ok.  Would have given it a 2 1/2 if I could have.

Ordered a small Italian sub.  Now this sandwich  was SMALL!! Almost laughable.  The amount of meat was good, veggies ok.  Fries have a weird batter or something on them.  Do not like at all. Didn't eat them.   Pepsi products in the machine, but they sold coke products in the cooler, hurray!!

Not very friendly, no conversation.. Not a fav of mine by any means.

Best Ice cream hands down! It'll make your life easier, choose the carrot cake flavor you'll thank me later!l 
PS. One scoop is not enough trust me!

Was not wowed. It's pleasant and the servers are friendly but the bartenders need training. Giving me a dirty glass, and pouring out the last 2 oz of my beer because it didn't fit in the glass? Give me the bottle at that point. Fries are small, greasy and has some sort of coating.    Chicken sandwich and entrée was cooked well.

Beers, wings and friends surrounded by MKT atmosphere = Really good night!
MKT is one of the restaurants/bars of the Century Hospitality Group based in Edmonton and they have done very well with the old Canadian Pacific Strathcona Station.
They have a big selection of beers and tasty options of food too, but the best part is the service. I'd been here several times, on each one the service is what I appreciate the most. The servers know very well their products, they seem confident when a recommendation is given.
You won't feel like you're just one more customer, they stop by frequently, refill your water, bring more beer, etc. I should add that usually we reserve the table in advance, the website is so amicable that booking a table is always easy and we don't have to go through the hazard of fitting for a table and moving chairs. For reserved tables the policy is 15 minutes wait or the table will be released to walk in customers.  
The second level is huge and you can book it for private functions, bridal showers, Christmas dinners, business meetings, etc.
As every other place around Whyte Ave, it's easier if you park far away and walk to the bar, chances of finding parking are really low even when they have their own parking lot.
While "Tap That Thursday" promotion, where MKT supports local breweries is on, you may see me here quite often! $2.24 per beer can't be ignored! 
Cheers! and remember #supportlocal!
Delicious, fresh and so much to choose from! The apple fritters are the best adult donut (no sprinkles or icing ).
Always amazing food. Veal you can cut with a fork. Delicious pasta.  Canoli's to die for.  Love love love this place.

This place is AMAZING. I've always loved Aveda salons as well as their products but this one is seriously the best I've been to. I have been highlighting my hair for almost 8 years and am most happy with Yen at Level2. Yen makes me looks like a natural blonde! She takes the time to focus on the details. She's a great colorist and one of the best at Level2. 

The staff is very pleasant and the service is awesome! 
I would suggest this salon to anyone and have already had many satisfied friends. Love love love Level2.

Casual, comfort food place with decent prices.  Waited in line about 10-15 minutes before we got a table, but seemed to take forever for our food.  Service was not that great.  I asked for a Coke and extra glass and the girl just brought me an empty glass.  The food was good though and worth the wait.  Nothing like a big juicy burger and fries washed down with a tall glass of Coke (or Pepsi since they didn't have Coke).  The meatloaf and Chinese chicken salad were also delicious.

Am I back in college? Because I think I dreamed I was at a bar with $2 you-call-its last night. No wait, I was!

So the deal is, every Thursday you can drink anything you want (shots, cocktails, beer, spirits straight up) for $2. Nicks has a pretty sweet beer line-up too... a few good craft beers and all the usual STL favorites such as Schlafly and Budweiser products.

The reggae band that plays here regularly is insane! Really great. Though this bar is filled with frat boy types that look like they'll be hugging a toilet really soon, don't let them put you off from enjoying the down and dirty diveness of Nick's!

There's a $5 cover on Thursdays, not sure about other nights. If you're looking for some tomfoolery at a 3am bar, welcome... you've found it!
Great customer service and friendly staff. Rooms are OK - didn't get a feel of a usual Hilton brand rooms. Executive lounge is great!

The absolute WORST Post Office in Bucks County! These window lickers will lose packages you're waiting for, fraudulently claim they delivered them to your house, then the postmaster will have the cojones to give you an attitude about their failures IF they follow procedure and call you regarding your claim. They'll tell you ANYTHING from "yOuR aDdReSs WaSn'T cOrRecT" to "aRe YoU sUrE iT wAsN't a ScAm bY mAiL?" Motherf*ckers must be remedial to not remember that we can TRACK PACKAGES

We are locals and have been wanting to try a new Thai place. We did carry out and the food was quick and ready by the time we got there to pick it up. The Pad seew with chicken was great. We will definitely go back!

Dear McDonalds of Middle TN Specifically the Location at the Shoppes on the Harpeth: Famished, I entered your drive thru a few short minutes ago and ordered two Jalepeno Doubles. They were everything I could have ever asked for in a Fast Food Burger: Jalepeno's, Crunchies for texture, Melted Cheese, and a Crispy Bun. Bravo! The burgers were served with Weapons-Grade High Fives from the Drive Thru Cashier and Assistant Manager. Once Again, Bravo.
Everything here is amazing. Its a quiet friendly community that has almost everything regarding amenities . the layout of the apts are very well . The community is very clean
Really bad! There problem is that they're severely understaffed! Don't think about using their Copy & Print Services you'll wait a good long time!

I have been here a couple times already and I have never been left disappointed. They have an amazing Chicken Katsu, it is super tasty with a yummy dipping sauce, I have also tried the Kalua Pork and it is just as good. Great food at a great price. I also love that they deliver. 

Must try there food.

Have been wanting to come here for years! I am a big fan of Modo Mio. The waitress was very very attentive and detail oriented, explaining every last bit of everything. The food was very good. But...it didn't blow me away like I expected it to. But it was a lovely dining out experience, love the BYOBs!!!

I grew up in California and love Togos! My family and I were so looking forward to it coming to Meridian and all I can say is yuck! It tastes nothing like I remember, bland and actually my husband, son and I felt sick after eating the pastrami. The girl making my sandwich ignored me and carried out a conversation with her co worker about her piercings. The manager seemed rude and mean and demanded the girl making my sandwich go put something on his desk, don't mind me I am just standing there waiting for my lunch. We won' t be back.
Such great service! Quick and efficient! I have struggled to find good trusting people until now.

This is my wife's and I go to place in our area to catch a Phillies game and we are never disappointed.  My wife is happy since she gets to eat her crab fries.  I don't go crazy over them as I prefer the sweet potato fries.  My fav dish though is the cheesesteak nachos...I just love them.  During Phillies games some beers are only $2 so it makes for a good time.  Also have had the all you can eat crab legs here during the week.  I didn't like the sauce they had them in but the crab itself was very good.  There are a couple of other sports bars in walking distance from here, but this is far and above the best of all of them.

These mf. First off they don't listen . I asked for ombré an she gave me white tip(which I hate). Then asked me to show her a picture and tossed my phone on the table an told me she told me that what she did was what she said, but still wasn't ombré like I stated before she started doing my nails. It was not unexpected to have a wait on a busy Saturday night.  It took 50 minutes to get a table for the 3 of us.  We had a coupon which was not honored or even understood by the wait staff.  

We had no silverware even after asking (well, she did bring us 2 of the needed 3 sets after our appetizers were eaten, and eventually a third set).

My salad came with the dressing on it even after requesting it on the side (did she even write our order down?!?).  Had to send it back.  The others' entree is nearly eaten by the time a new salad arrived.
