Goodness me.  I get tired of reminding, correcting, and flagging down the waitress.  She was nice and apologized, but after several mistakes, you just want it right.  The food was tasty, but the rest of the experience just wasn't good.

First visit but definitely won't be the last.  Fast moving line, friendly service, and awesome food.  The portions were larger than average.  Pretty impressive to see the manager walking around the dining room asking if everything was okay.  The manager also mentioned their new location in Metairie.  Guess that's another place we'll have to try.

What a great little museum! Interactive, informative exhibits. I saw the exhibit about Spain's influence in America (a lot more than I realized!!!) and also checked out the permanent exhibit on the history of Santa Barbara. What a gem of a place go and enjoy :)
Love the crepes here and the flexibility of the menu! The lady works here is also super friendly - makes this place a great lunch choice

Best gym ever, clean equipment and friendly staff. Always well maintained and always my go to gym when looking for an intense or even casual workout, from cardio to freeweights. This gym has it all! Would highly recommend. Alex is one of my favorite team members because of his always upbeat attitude and encourages me with his passion for fitness.

So quick tip, it's totally worth it to get an online reservation and pay the convenience fee than it is to wait. Waiting in line to see ticket availability not only sucks but then you'll probably have to wait again for the tour to actually begin. Don't think of going to the Liberty in the interim because the line for that thing is literally down the block. Just pay the damn 3 bucks and save yourself the heartache.

The tour guides are all volunteers and know a lot-so basically it comes down to personality. One was really dry but had a lot of info the other (because Independence Hall is a campus of buildings) had a little more zip to him. Regardless, you're walking through the halls of the House of Representatives and the Senate-it's pretty crazy to think that at one point the Senate met in an attic somewhere but there you have it, 3 bucks to walk and breathe history.

It's clean, convenient and you can use this place or your primary physician as well. They've handled everything from a kidney stone attack to a bug bit here. Sometimes they take a while and it would be nice if they would update you on your status with an occasional, "you're up next or soon". That would be my only comment about having room for improvement.

My husband and I decided to go to CPK, because of the recommendation of a few co-workers, and we had a gift card. The atmosphere was great, outdoor patio with heaters was wonderful. The screaming teenagers I could have done without. 

Our waiter, was friendly and very knowledgable about the menu. He recommended the apple martini, which was delicious, he recommended the a tropical sangria, after my husband asked if there was mango in it because I am allergic to mango, he went to check to make sure. Because there was mango in it it he made another recommendation, the Asian plum martini, again delicious.  Whoever is the bartender knows there stuff because my husband said his mojito was delicious as well.

We ordered seseame ginger chicken dumplings, A+. I was having a tough time deciding on what pizza i wanted, our waiter once again displayed his knowledged and recommended the Spicy Chipotle Chicken pizza. While my husband ordered the California Club. Both were excellent. We will definitely be returning ,hopefully we get the same waiter.

We had an outstanding experience with Scott (Sr. and Jr.), Lisa, and Rick and the crew. Courteous, professional, and very helpful in focusing on what our project needed. Lisa was extraordinary in getting back to us anytime we had a question. The crew took less than a week to build the screen room, handled any issue that arose, AND cleaned up after themselves each day.

We would definitely recommend Affordable Aluminum to anyone who wants a professional, well done project in their home or business.

We got the bus tour deal. They claimed to be the only bus tour that takes you inside cemeteries. That is a lie, you only stand outside at the gate of the cemetery as the tour guide tells you stories.  Only reason we chose this tour was to go inside. They take you inside the Katrina memorial, that is all.

Perhaps it was the hype I heard surrounding this opening that ultimately let me down, but the food certainly had a share in that as well. First the pros- it's a comfortable upscale setting, and the view is wonderful, even if you're sitting in the middle of the room. The service was very good and our server was particularly helpful with unique wine selections that were excellent. However, they have way too many people working there; at one point there were more staffers than patrons. The menu looked very promising...I started with the lobster and beef cocktail franks....don't waste your time....go to the grocery strore and get yourself pre-made frozen pigs in a blanket for a much better treat. I then moved on to the rib-eye with bernaise and frites....not bad, but in a city with such a cornucopia of great restaurants, not bad doesn't cut it. Dessert was good, a warm vanilla cake with caramel. My friends had different dishes...and they also were not mesmerized by their dishes, though one exclaimed that the brocolli that came with her fish entree was the best she ever had. Overall, skip for dinner unless you want to meet up with some friends in a nice bar and lounge for drinks and perhaps a small bite.

I am Sicilian!  I know good food.. This place is a total rip off! A tourist trap. We ordered spaghetti with sausage, and the special, Prawns over pasta.  The bill came to $ 79!. The waitress failed to tell us the Prawns over pasta was $42. (I should have asked, but given most dishes were under $20, I didn't) 
The pasta was over cooked, and  was swimming in a butter sauce that had chunks of garlic that looked like slivered almonds.
The young couple next to us had the same special and four beers. Their total was $126 .
I complained to the waitress that she should have told us the price, her comment was, " I don't set the prices ".
We took a Lyft after, and our driver told us when she saw the restaurant where we were, she thought uh oh, I bet they got a bad meal. 
Diners, steer clear of Franks!

I heard the ownership at Asian Kitchen changed and that new Taiwanese dishes are being offered, so with excitement, I paid a visit recently.

Asian Kitchen WAS my favorite spot for soondubu (Korean soft tofu stew) in St. Louis. They made a darn good one and I would crave it constantly because I couldn't make one nearly as good at home as theirs. 

What happened to my once beloved Asian Kitchen? 

I am sad to report that I'm not quite sure what I even had last Friday could even be called Korean cuisine. My pork soondubu tasted like stale sesame oil, I couldn't taste any of the richness of the anchovy broth base at all. It was so disappointing that I had to send it back. I don't think I have ever sent food back before. Our server was very understanding and offered a replacement right away when I told her that my broth tasted nothing but sesame oil. With skepticism on how they would re-do another soondubu, I asked for a kimchi jigae with pork (kimchi stew, another Korean staple) instead. While the kimchi stew was better than the very low bar that the soondubu set, I'm also sad to report that it was barely a kimchi stew. Sure it had kimchi in it, but again, the broth base was not Korean at all. No richness or even a hint of the anchovy broth - the BASE FOR ALMOST EVERY KOREAN STEW. Instead, it tasted like sugar was added into the soup, no savoriness at all. There was no richness in the soup at all, it just tasted like water in a bowl. Additionally, the pork is no longer pork belly as it should be typically, but now just chunks of tough pork cuts. Why? To make matters worse (or better....), the soup was only halfway filled up in my bowl. There is no love put into any of the menu items that I had, just cost cutting measures. Nothing about what I ate was Korean cuisine and I wholeheartedly mean that. 

My husband ordered a bibimbap with marinated pork and while it wasn't nearly as disappointing, the pork cuts were also tough. The bibimbap was also on the sweeter side prior to adding the gochujang.

Lastly, all the thoughtful touches that Asian Kitchen was once known/famous for no longer live on. The plentiful banchan side dishes - nope. The yogurt drink for each patron that comes with the check - nope. Are there new thoughtful touches that have replaced the old? Of course not.

As for the Taiwanese dishes that are now being offered. I was wrong about that. They offer an "off menu" Taiwanese hot pot. I suspect they use the same broth/water base as the one that was in my korean stews (my cynicism is at an all time high by the end of this review, sorry). I gave one additional star for the super efficient and understanding server.

This place was great! The fried chicken was to die for! The staff was funny. Our waiters made us laugh the whole time. It was a sarcastic funny type of place. Every was sooo good the bread pudding is the best. I recommend this please the wait is not too bad looks like it will take long but it doesn't.

This place as gone from good trust worthy to "you have got to be kidding me" within a few months. I'm not sure what is going on, but corporate needs to take a good look at Management. It used to take less than 10 minutes for a table and the past two time I've gone there were 30 minute waits.  I get it if they are busy, but there are empty tables. This mean that the restaurant is poorly staffed. 

I ordered dumplings and hash brown casserole and after waiting for more than 20 minutes, they arrive like warm and they appear to have been sitting on the plate for a while. The Coca Cola take was dried out and the frosting has a cracking texture.  The silverware really could have used another run through the dishwasher.  

There is no need to wait until the dinner is served before brining out the biscuits.  Biscuits and corn bread should be served before the meal.  When I mentioned to the server that I would like to have them delivered before the meal, I was told that the waitress would try.  This really shouldn't be hard to accomplish, unless the management has some motivation the screw with the customers. 

I have no desire to return to this Cracker Barrel and will give the Plymouth Meeting location a try.  It is a shame that someone broke the tried and true processes in the Downingtown location.
Food is ok. Lounge is small but comfortable.  Service is extremely weak and below expectations.

So I've been looking for some place close to me that has good authentic Mexican food, and a friend showed me where this place is one night. I went there today for the first time, and tried their 7 tacos for $5.00 deal... Ok, I'm sold! I got the pulled pork with green salsa. DELICIOUS!!

The salsa is sooo good, with a decently spicy kick. The pork is super moist and full of flavor! They're small tacos, which is good for me since I don't eat a lot at once. I tried the Jicama juice for the first time... It's really good, but a little on the sweet side for me. The rest of their menu looks pretty great, I'm going to have to keep going back and trying new things!

The women working there were so sweet and personable, I really enjoyed talking to them. It's a whole in the wall kinda place, where you order and pay at the counter, but the food is so good that I would rather go there, then somewhere that serves you mediocre crap!  LOL

Jane's is my favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara they have the BEST burgers and the BEST fries!

They have a lot of different menu options to choose from. My favorite thing to order is their Lone star burger. The burger comes with cheddar cheese, bacon, barbecue sauce, and a fried onion ring. I also love their Jane Burger as well. The Jane burger which comes with fried Gouda cheese and caramelized onions. Their burgers are amazing because they are super flavorful, tender, and not dry at all. Overall I highly recommend Jane's my family and I literally comes to Santa Barbara just to come to Jane's because their food is that good!

Note: -They are closed on Monday.
-There is also plenty of parking spaces available. 
-They offer indoor dinning and outdoor seating.
-They also have a second location on state street.

This Starbucks is the where it's at Starbucks. It is smack dab in the middle of downtown St. Pete and has competition from three pretty close ones, but that doesn't seem to be a problem, for business is always booming.

One of the best sandwiches in the Tampa Bay Area. Cannot go wrong with the Cuban or the beef Marsala. Great hidden gem in downtown area. Beef Marsala reminds me of the Marsala sauce in Carrabbas. Definitely have to try this place out. Fairly cheap and quick food service

Let me start with dessert because the almond nugget ice cream is so good.  I usually get it with either the flan and/or the no-flour chocolate cake along with a spoon for everyone and play dessert chess, your move!  
Garlic soup and garlic sautéed mushrooms are a must and I also enjoy the antipasto plate.  Salads are always fresh, again something to share and for the main dish the grilled fish, seared tuna w/ mojo sauce, or the pork tenderloin are all superb.
Of course for the big share there's the paella served up with seafood, meat, or just vegetables.
Lola's is always a hit and if there's a line, it's one of the few places where I will happily wait my turn.  Best bet is right around 6pm or wait until 9ish.  My guess is around $30 per person before drinks.  These folks work hard for you.

I have always been a fan of this neighborhood chain restaurant. They always had good affordable food, lots of drink specials and in some locations, karaoke.I don't know about you, but a buzzed guy with a microphone in his hand is endlessly entertaining for me! Since I have had to change my diet and lifestyle due to diabetes, I love this place even more. For those of us trying to live a healthier lifestyle, Applebees gives you more choice than any other place that I have visited to date. I counted 12 different entrees or meal options that did not include eating a salad. Wonderful!

 This week I went there for lunch. They have a little green symbol next to all meals that have 550 calories or less. I had the Signature_Sirloin_with_Garlic_Herb_Shrimp_6_2011_high_Ressignature  sirloin with garlic shrimp, broccoli, potato and bruschetta and sliced almonds.  The meat was seasoned well and cooked to a perfect medium. The potatoes were boiled but seasoned, there were only 3 pieces which was really enough and the broccoli was a little crisp and well seasoned as well. I was full, had no desire for dessert and the bill for 2 including tip was less than $25.00.

 Our server was friendly and knowledgeable of the menu. The Manager came by twice to check on us and all in all it was a pleasurable experience. In general I am not a chain restaurant person but for me Applebees is a keeper. It's important to me to be able to go out and have a choice of more than salad or wraps. I wish more restaurants catered to people with special dietary needs. I also hope that Applebees continues to add more diet friendly options. If you are trying to watch your weight and your wallet this place is a must try.

If you know of other places that have a decent range of options for diet conscious people, drop me a line and I will go check it out.

Applebees

Hypersmash.com

Haven't tried the "American breakfast" menu items yet but the Thai cuisine is delicious! The crab fried rice is flavorful and has nice crab flavor with actual crab meat. Tom kha soup with chicken is my absolute favorite and I always get this when im here. The pad Thai is also pretty amazing. One of the best I've had. The patio seating is nice - perfect for people watching. Also great for dogs. Prices are reasonable although my main complaint is that the portion sizes are a tad smaller than what I'm used to for some of the items.

This old house-turned bar is floor-to-ceiling memorabilia from Hoosiers--the movie based on Bobby Plump's story.
It's not your typical bar---and by my standards, that's a good thing. Plump's wraparound deck provides a unique outdoor seating area, complete with comfy chairs and umbrellas to shade the fair-skinned drunkies (i.e. me) from the sun.

My parents RAVED about this place so obviously we went when we were visiting. The new location is adorable: it's designed like an alleyway with flags, doors, and balconies. Loved the complimentary salsa and beans but everything else left something to be desired.
We ordered skinny margaritas which were basically water and tequila (you get what you ask for I guess). The menu is quite large but almost too large. The could easily scale it back and do fewer dishes at better quality. I had the Cancun enchiladas which were alright, the meat seemed pretty low grade and their was more sour cream than anything else. 
Several dishes are served with a side salad which was just basic iceberg lettuce. I asked to substitute my salad for black beans and when it came out, it came with charro beans. Apparently they don't even have black beans, which our waiter didn't even know, nor did he know much about what to recommend on the menu.
I think tex mex has made me bias but I've definitely had better.
The new menu is incredible!  I had the pot roast today and it was outstanding. Perfect comfort food for a rainy autumn day. All I can say is WOW, just WOW. Made from scratch and done to perfection.

I went here for my birthday last night. I honestly do not understand why this place isn't packed constantly. We were there as a party of 4 and got two appetizers, soup, bread and entrees. Everything I tasted was great. I wasn't all that fond of the bread, but it was comparable to most.

The issue I usually have with Italian meals in restaurants is the flavor. I usually don't feel as though I get enough seasoning. This was definitely not an issue at Amerigo. Everything was packed full of flavor. We will definitely be coming back! The favorite meal at the table was the Three Cheese Tortellini. It was delicious! The Lasagna was also great, as was the Compellini (?). The soups were good and the appetizers (cheese fritters, crab cakes, and calamari) were phenomenal! I don't know what they did or how they made those cheese fritters, but I could have eaten an entire meal of just those. 

We had a really good server that was attentive and friendly. She gave great meal recommendations and knew the menu well. We were all stuffed when we left. My friend had eaten appetizers and soup and only had room for one bite of her Tortellini. All in all, I will definitely be back to this place. I can't wait to come back to Nashville just to eat here.

Good pizza at a fair price, in a great location.

I was at the Keswick Theater this weekend for two back-to-back shows in one night, which meant after the first one let out, I had less than an hour to find something quick and delicious to eat before the later show. Everywhere else was packed to the brim with other show-goers, so I decided the pizza shop across the street seemed like a safe bet.

The customer area inside of the shop itself is small and has no seating, but they offer some outdoor patio tables, which was nice. For such a small shop, they were able to handle the long line of people fairly efficiently as well. 

I decided to be less-difficult and order just a slice of plain pizza. I was happy to see, for their price, that the slices were HUGE. So you definitely get your moneys worth there. The pizza itself was a tad on the dough-ier side, which is not my preference, but everyone is different. 

In a pinch, it hit the spot and I was able to get in, out, and back to the theater in good time thanks to their quick service, especially given the heavy foot traffic at the time I was there.

Im hosting a wine and cheese party...so naturally I needed to find some cheese and I definitely made the right decision coming here. 

I had never been in before but with the clear signage saw what I was looking for, went straight back to the cheese section and was immediately overwhelmed by all of the options. I have to give a special shout-out to David Myers who came to my rescue (here's a guy who LOVES his job). He was so knowledgeable and patient, allowing me to taste a variety of options and writing notes for me about recommended wine pairings. I left with some delightful sheep, goat and cow milk cheeses and on top of that he made recommendations and offered samples of some unique jams to go with them...this wasn't your average fig jam. There were so many to choose from. 
...then I went over to the charcuterie...then I got some fruit...some nuts...and I absolutely did not forget the olives...and crackers!!!

This gem is a one stop shop if you're entertaining...pricey though, you're definitely paying to play but I'd say it's worth it for the cheese and most everything else except the fruit. I'd recommend you get your fruit elsewhere, seemed a bit old.
Service was terrible , everyone acted like they didn't even want to be there. Breakfast was gross and WAY over priced honestly IHOP is better and that's not saying much.

I've been to Station  Bistro (only for Breakfast) so many times since I first found it. Even after we moved 30 minutes away; every time we have people from out of town we take them here for breakfast.

They have THE best pancakes around; served with real maple syrup.
Fun local place! Excellent, friendly service! The patio is pretty and a tucked away, fun restaurant to catch up with friends!

One star for the newly renovated building in the middle of the dangerous slums and 6 stars for Linsay. Why? Allow me to explain. 

Since the start of my treatments, the owner (Nurit) treated me once on the lowest settings and was just not as effective until Linsay took over my treatments. If not, I would have wasted my time and probably more than likely, angrily requested a full refund. The company just seemed poorly managed and very unorganized. ( I had to reschedule my appointment three times due to "technical" difficulties they had, unprofessional )   :( On top of it, I get greeted by a high school receptionist with plenty, I mean plenty!!, of stains on her white scrubs (not exactly "medical" spa dontcha think?). Not comforting!

Since my recent discovery of Linsay quitting (good for her, and the new girl? total weirdo! ), I will no longer need any services here nor would I refer any friends or family here again. By the way, very overpriced, not to mention how often the price fluctuates. Never again!

I went there for a bone reclast the first time, and the nurse kept insisting to put the IV needle in the top of my hand. I told her not to put it there. So after the third time she had to have the head nurse do it. Then I got the bill for a $300.00 copay. I have been paying it off monthly but they still like to harass you after you made a deal with paying it off monthly. I can't work because my husband is ill!!!!! Went to Delaware County Hospital in Upper Darby, they treated me great. Love the nurse there. Then I get the copay of 90.00 from Delaware County Hospital. I've heard complaints about Crozer and it's only a money making hospital. I will never return there. I will warn others not to go there.

I stopped going to the Ritz as they left everything sitting out. That's sanitary right? No. Some kid was LICKING the loaves and touching them. Parent ignored this kid, who, by the way was around 13 yrs old. But I am not a fan of food left out for the public to fondle.
  So the Summit was opening and was excited. It's still the Ritz. Things are open for fondling, quiche sits out on the counter in the hot summer with flies covering it.Flies everywhere.
I had ordered a cake, but thank God it was in a fridge. It was cute, but not good. And it was over $40. I could have done much better.
  On the plus side, the cookies are good. .....and it doesn't seem like they are open to flies or public fondling.

Was walking down the street and decided to stop in. One of our people in our group had the prime rib sandwich and loved it. I was not that hungry so I got the bacon and crab dip, this was awesome. We paired them up with a few beers and this was a good place to get our of the rain for a an hour

This place is like the place you take someone who has only ever had one boring type of food in their lives. The magical place hidden away that opens up a whole world of incredible-edible-delectable options to this person. The place that changes their tongue's life FOREVER.

I could eat here everyday and never get tired of it. There's this Lamb "Korma" dish they have...lamb pieces with jasmine rice in a creamy and spicy coconut sauce that is pretty much the reason my taste buds exist, if not for the orgasmic chicken masala they also serve (we're talking full-on "When Harry Met Sally" I'll have what she's having ORGASMIC food of amazing-ness). And we can't talk about the Samosas or my computer screen will explode...

Do you have that vegetarian friend, and you're dying to go somewhere other than (while also awesome, but limiting for omnivores) Pneumatic Diner? This place is your spot. You can both eat here in harmony...and if you make it to the lunch buffet, your harmony is only 10 bucks a person. Otherwise, menu items are more expensive...but worth it. I cannot stress that enough. 

The few things that dropped this little slice of perfect down to a 4-star are these.

The service is in need of some assistance. Indian food is (gloriously) spicy, and this requires much water. When your waiter disappears and you dive head first into a level 8 Curry Vindaloo, your relationship with water becomes the most important in your life, and it's provider even more so. Ours, on two separate occasions, has been sadly absent. 

The parking situation sucks. That's about all I can say about that.

Overall? Please, for the sake of your family, your sanity, and your tongue, I BEG you to try this place.
Maintenance slipping a little. Light has been out in the men's steam room for two weeks.
The office is not the prettiest, but the dr is great and really helped me.

If you are looking for a clean, serviceable hotel within spitting distance of Bourbon Street then this is as good a place as any.  Don't expect ritzy accommodations or exemplary service, though there was nothing negative about either.  Everything was functional, the rooms were very large and spacious, and I slept like a log on my bed

There is only one major issue. The noise.  You can hear everything in the hallways (including all the hijinks of a sorority/fraternity trip from Ole Miss) and depending on where your hotel room is situated (mine overlooked a fine establishment named "The Alibi" - I was thankful I could only see it, not smell it) everything on the streets.
It's a throwback to earlier times where denizens debate free cheese doled out by a certain President with a chimpanzee co- star. Tasty greasy spoon fare in a small hidden location. Try it!

The bao bar is pretty awesome, they got great food and drinks! I always order the Vietnamese meat bowl, I forgot the name lol but it's always so delicious, add that with a fry egg... amazing! And those Japanese fries are so good too!!! The lady who works there with the short hair is so friendly and welcoming! Overall, it's a cool place to chill with friends, plus they open late too and have great happy hour specials.
Definitely get a massage here. Great prices and deals. The place is welcoming and smells calming. Massage therapist did an amazing job; good pressure.

On the surface, WFM appears to be the perfect grocery.  However, being a WFM-believer necessitates buying into the idea that high-quality, fresh produce and product requires paying an exorbitant sum.  My trip today consisted of buying ingredients for a standard spaghetti w/meat sauce recipe.  $50 later, I walk out dumbfounded.  I found everything I needed, but, seriously?  In a city as large as Philly, enough neighborhood butchers and grocers provide personalized service and sell quality goods without ripping you off.  WFM doesn't cut the mustard with me.

Stopped in for a late lunch and ended up getting four appetizers. Dozen raw oysters, half dozen with parmigiana, gator hush puppies, and fish spread. Got a couple cold beers to go with it all. The food was excellent. The atmosphere is very friendly. Locals and tourists abound. Fun place and friendly knowledgeable servers.

The Harvest Room is really quite special. It's located in one of the most beautiful historic buildings in Alberta. Beautifully, richly appointed. The place exudes decadence. Serviced by an extremely helpful and courteous staff, prompt and cheerful. I've tried the food a few different times and I've not once been disappointed. I went once for the buffet breakfast - totally reasonable price (I think it was $26), and the spread was small - but very nice. Mostly pretty standard breakfast buffet, but everything was prepared with pride and care and was very delicious. The eggs bennie in particular, I was very impressed with. My girlfriend had the peaches and cream french toast (off the menu), she liked it enough to order it a second time the next time we went for brunch. I tried it as well, and I can attest to the brilliance. The next time we went we tried out the lunch menu. We both had a starter, her the scallop, and myself the chowder. Bother were very tasty and presented beautifully. For lunch I had the steak frites, which was decent & we had some amazing foi gras on the side, as well. She had the famous crab cakes which did not disappoint. On our most recent visit, we went for brunch - as I'd mentioned the girlfriend re-upped on the peaches and cream french toast, but I decided to go for the crab cakes with poached eggs. So rich and tasty, creamy and savoury. Could go for another portion right now! The cocktail selection is quite nice, and they have an alright beer menu as well. If you're looking for an upscale dining experience, and all that comes with it - with one of the best views in the city - Harvest Room might be a good bet.

I was just visiting Philly for a month when I stumbled upon this place, and I'm so glad I did! This is some of the best chicken ever. I had the rotisserie chicken salad and it was so fresh and tasty! Then I tried the boneless wings and they were perfectly crispy and delicious. I absolutely love this place! It can take a while to make the food, but that's because they make it fresh, so it is worth the wait (and i doesn't take that long, it's just not like a drive through). However, you can call in your order or order through Yelp if you don't want to wait when you get there. The kitchen is open behind the order counter so you can see them making your food which is cool. There's not a whole lot of seating because the place is somewhat small.
Had the chicken and waffles with unlimited mimosas and it was a perfect Sunday brunch! Will definitely be back!!

Had the chicken maroosh sandwich. So amazing! I like it because it has a very unique taste. It's really hard to find this particular type of sandwich anywhere else. Service was great. Restaurant was clean. Would highly recommend!

I've eaten Peace A Pizza for years down in Stone Harbor and loved it. So I was quite excited to see that they opened one up closer to home here in Warrington. But there was something a little off about this one, not sure if its a different oven or something, but the crust didn't have that hard outside, it was all doughy. Maybe I should have had them cook it a bit longer. The place in itself is very clean, they have a great staff and they were playing some great music videos from the 70s on the big screen. The prices are higher than your average pizza place but they have some outstanding premium pies that you can find just anywhere.

First time visiting. Wasn't sure what to expect. 
Well, it didn't disappoint. 
Food was great! Isaac,(waiter) was great! 
I had a calzone filled with meat,so good.
My wife had the salmon pasta, delicious!

Good atmosphere. Wasn't too busy on a Tuesday night. Got drinks and apps promptly.

We will definitely be back to try some more.

Ooooh Pumpkin, you are my new favorite place in Philly. We went on Friday night and got a charred cod (I think) and the steak. The fish and the steak were cooked so perfectly.  Everything in the dish tasted beyond fresh, this must be what organics are about. I felt good eating the dishes and even better after. I felt like I had eaten a really good meal that didn't weigh me down but was delicious. We also got the gazpacho which was quite beautiful. There is something to be said about presentation, they brought out this white bowl with grapes and crab meat artfully displayed and poured from a little vase the soup which was a nice mint green. It tasted beyond wonderful, light and crisp. Very cooling on a super hot night. Our server was really sweet and helpful. Oh and it's BYOB. I will be back.

This is my favorite nail pedi place in the Mainline, Sophia also has one in Bryn Mawr. 
Great massage when u get pedi, they take there time and do a good job. 
Also waxing is amazing.
Go and enjoy
Joy Sophie's daughter is now doing hair cuts and colors, they redesigned the salon and added 2 rooms for the hair salon. Joy worked with Sassoon in NY, very experienced at cutting & coloring

If you are on Canal Street looking for a classic New Orleans dining experience, check out Palace Cafe.

They have a top-shelf bar and a beautiful interior.  Try to get a seat upstairs, if you want a nice view of the whole show.  A decent to good wine list will also appeal.  

The spinach salad and filet were the stand-out dishes.  Also, the bananas foster was quite tasty.  The pecan pie looked great, too.

No stars...
Waited 5 months for a delivery that never came.
They canceled the order but never refunded my money until I called them and exploded.
Worst service ever.
Buyer beware

Overpriced and sloppy job on acrylic nails.
Nickel and dime you for everything. 
Decent selection of colors. Pedicures are good but again overpriced if getting gel.

Visited this lovely restaurant for my birthday and I absolutely loved it. I wanted a very elegant setting with amazing food and this place delivered. I ordered the surf and turf, it came with green beans and potatoes, the sauce was almost like a sweet teriyaki (so good)...and the manager offered me a desert of my choice..I went with the pumpkin cheese cake, I can't remember the drink I had BUT IT WAS GOOD TOO LOL!...thank you all for your great service I will be returning soon!

Booked a room here for Gencon, and then received notification that my booking had been canceled two days before the con. No reason given. Hotels.com did their best to find me another hotel, but its really bad. The one I'm staying at has wet towels, mold in the bathroom, and Wi-Fi isn't working. I'm very very angry that Baymont canceled my booking two days before a major convention. It's completely ridiculous that they did that and I personally would not recommend using this hotel because you may end up getting your booking canceled last minute as well.

This is the first time I stopped in here. It seems like a fun dollar store kind of place. Like a place for stocking stuffers for kids.  The main things I saw were toys, cosmetics and candy. There were also cheap phone cases and earbuds. 

I don't see a need to go back here because I do not have any teenagers in my life, but if you do, it would be a fun place to shop with or for them.

Went through the drive thru at about 6:40am and there wasn't anyone at this location except a little old lady. She was very nice but couldn't help us. She said she was the cook and no one was there who knew how to work the registers. Said the guy that worked the registers decided he wanted to go home early and just left. The worst part is that it has happened just about every day this week. So from about 6am to 7am it closes down and those are prime breakfast hours. The management staff at that location needs to fix this situation ASAP!!!

I didn't actually have service done here on my 2001 Honda Accord, but I am giving 5 stars for the customer service I received from James.  Long story short, the maintenance light came on while my husband had the car in California.  He checked all the fluid levels and filled what it needed, but he had to drive home to Reno in the car and then back to California.  I called our dealership where we usually have it serviced but I couldn't get anything until the 24th and I called on the 14th.  I googled Honda Service near me and  got CoAuto's number.  James answered my call and I explained our issue.  He had no openings for Friday the 18th when the car would be in Reno.  He mentioned that maybe the dealership forgot to reset the light when we had the last oil change and we believe that might just be it.  I thanked him and hung up.  To my utter surprise he captured my phone number and called me back with referrals to two other shops that might could help us?  Who does that in this day and age?  I never got an appointment anywhere but my hubby made it over the mountain safely last night and will have the car serviced in California where he was able to get an appointment at a dealership in Palo Alto.  I just want to say kudos to James, what great Customer Service!

I can't describe enough the great care and compassion the vets and staff here have for the animals they treat. I highly recommend Dr. McGuire and Dr. Freeman, both of whom have incredible talent and "bedside manner". Just last week I had to put one of my cats to sleep. Everyone I dealt with here, from the vets to the vet techs to the front desk staff, were entirely compassionate and helpful. I've never experienced that kind of care anywhere else.

Am I 1st to review on yelp?!

Go to her. Dr. Kim is seriously fantastic & knowledgeable. Love her honesty & she's very thorough in her explanations. She's my go to dentist! :)

TRASH INTERNET This is a great place to live; HOWEVER, if you plan on ever using the internet, you should look elsewhere. My reasons: most of us including myself have experienced MAJOR internet issues to include outages for up to 8 days and major packet losses. The internet provider that Bella Vista (Edward Rose & Sons) uses is Xiber. Look them up and see their reviews. You are not able to get your own provider due to the contract that Bella Vista has with Xiber. Trust me, anyone who has smart-locks which Bella Vista uses should have very reliable internet. There are no key entries except for the garages. Agian before you let them sell you a place to rent, consider the internet service. You will be greatly disappointed.

This review would be four stars if the smoke wasn't so overwhelming in here.

They have a good beer selection and awesome bar food.  I've always had good service at the bar and decent service at a table.  Once, there was a small problem where the bartender was really busy and never put our food order through to the kitchen.  We were happy to wait once we reminded her and didn't expect anything at all in return, but she still gave us a free round and was extremely apologetic.  

If you're not into huge crowds of the 21 year old set, I'd hit this place up on a weeknight as weekends tend to be overly mobbed and a little annoying.

Everyone is helpful and friendly - I mean EVERYONE.  I had my last wax with Leslie.  I was a customer a few years ago but really fell off the wagon.  Back on and couldn't be happier with my experience.  Not nearly as painful as one might expect, excellent service and experience, great aftercare instructions and goodies.  They carry very helpful and cute products in the store, also.  I look forward to being a regular customer.
These people do careless work. I have brought my car in three times and it still isn't fixed.

Be very careful when signing a contract at this gym.  I live in Stony Plain and was working on the south side.  I am now at a new job that has me living in Stony Plain and working in the far west end.  This gym will not let me cancel my membership without first paying a $250 cancellation fee.  That is ridiculous.  If they had a gym that I could transfer to that is closer to where I live or work and I chose not to transfer, then I understand charging the fee.  But they do not have a gym anywhere near where I am living or working.  I tried to prove the job change with a letter from my employer, I showed proof of my home address, etc but they will not take any of that into consideration.  I try and live a healthy lifestyle and would love to join a new gym close to where I live or work but cannot afford it when I have to pay $250 in gym fees for a gym I cannot use.  AWFUL contract.  It is gyms like this that give all gyms a bad reputation for contracts.

So ive been here before but not in a while. Needed a Fill and a pedicure. 

Called originally Monday as I drove up and tried to do a walk in and I just so happened to call first before I got out the car. 

It's a pandemic so you try to get a good look at how many people are waiting in such a small area, 

in which I was told they were busy, to make an appointment. 

I'm like okay, so we schedule for the same time: "noon" the next day. 

She says she will see me then. 

End call. 

I show up today, she greets me tells me it'll be a moment. They get the pedicure ready, as someone else walks in with an appointment at "noon"... so she tells me i do not in fact have an apt and at the same time asks for my phone number, pulls out her phone and I'm guessing saw her call log as she confirmed the last four digits of my number .... sat down and said "no you don't have appointment"... as the technician asks who is ready for the pedicure.... in which the other girl stares blankly because she's only getting her NAILS done. 

So I sit in amazement and just get up and say "y'all have a nice day" and walked out. 

I'll never go back. I know it's a pandemic but wow.

The polenta cakes with sausage gravy appetizer was delicious. (almost a meal on it its own). The pork tenderloin entrée with rosemary and prosciutto was excellent. The pork was moist & flavorful. The prosciutto had a crispy/caramelized crust to it (unlike other places where the bacon or prosciutto is often rubbery). The chicken cacciatore with risotto was tasty as well. The risotto was creamy and perfectly cooked  (you can screw up risotto easily if not done right). The chocolate cake was good but a little dry. Our servers (Karen and Andria) were on-point, very friendly. The owner (Angelo) is always on-site, he isn't an  absentee owner. Looking forward to my next visit. Oh, make sure you make a reservation.

I want to warn anyone considering this company.  The tech Adi came out, told me a bunch of false information that was later discovered and had me enter a contract on false pretenses.

Everything from service to amount was untrue.  No apology or accountability from this company and I am considering legal action as their methods are predatory and based again on the hook and sinker approach.

To any prospective customers-proceed with extreme caution.

So far this is the best sushi that I have in Edmonton. The fish was really fresh and well presented. It also was a decent price for what you are getting. The menu is huge with a ton of selection. The decor is even quite cute. They have a traditional table area where you remove your shoes and sit on small pillows with a low table. 

Only bad thing was that our server was quite slow and we had informed her that we were in a rush - but again it was quite busy that night and I don't know how many tables she might have had.

The parking isn't even bad for the location as they do have a small parking lot in the front of the building. It was quite busy when I went here on a Wednesday evening. I would go again!
ABSOLUTE BEST PLACE . Checks every box you could have for a restaurant . Customer service was incredible , the establishment was clean and the food was incredible . We cannot wait to visit here again

I'm a second generation customer and have been coming here for 14 years! I've been to other vets when living out of the area and Rockville Road is the best. The staff is so friendly, caring and understanding of my dog's vet anxiety and the doctors have always been fantastic with him. They have very reasonable rates and don't try to sell you beyond what is necessary like other vets do. I even moved to the east side of Indianapolis and still make the 35 minute drive. I love this place and trust them with my pup's care!
Nice quiet place to enjoy a glass of wine.  You can bring in food or have it delivered so you can enjoy bingo on Tuesday nights or various music on other nights
Great zoo with tons to see.  A few of the best parts cost money, but when you consider the whole zoo is free, it's hard to complain!

Ordered box lunches for our office employees. Everyone was able to choose what they wanted which was wonderful! Everyone raved about the freshness of their sandwiches and the salads were delicious. We emailed our order a few days before, had it delivered (it was on time) each box was labeled with each persons name, Bettina was very responsive if there was a problem. Chef's table made it so easy for a Christmas luncheon!

Just moved from California and needed to board my two cats ASAP! I called Best friends pet hotel and was helped immediately on the phone with Taylor. She answered all my questions and concerns I had and took the time to explain what their stay will look like. When I dropped my cats off their their extended stay, I was greet at the door by Taylor. She helped get my cats adjusted to their temporary new surrounding. You can tell she has a passion for caring for animals. I felt safe leaving my fur babies in their care. Thank you so much!

Breakfast at Sky Blue Cafe was out of this world! We had the Space Captain Omelet & the Brie French Toast. The Space Captain omelet had spinach, mushrooms, sautéed onions, veggie sausage and pesto with Parmesan cheese. The flavors were amazing!!! The Brie French Toast was delicious! It's stuffed with Brie and drizzled with local honey. The service was great. The cafe is small and quaint. Loved this place!

Food is fine. Store is clean. Service is prompt. 
My kids prefer arby's to other fast food. So do I.

My wife insisted on five stars, and I didn't argue.   My staple, Thai Red Curry Chicken, was the best I've had so far.  The wife agrees, with her chicken and broccoli.  The kicker was the "flirtini" though.  It's a four shot drink with no fillers, and made her very giggly.  Lots of fun on a Sunday evening.  I have co-workers who lunch here, and I'll be back.

Dr. Leticia Medina refused to give me dental treatment even though I was paying cash.  She discriminated against me because I'm Mexican and have DentiCal Ins.  Besides that she demonstrates no customer service skills, she's rude, arrogant and racist with her own people. She forgot that she and her husband are also Mexicans. No, I Do Not recommend this business. 

Dr. Leticia Medina rehusó darme tratamiento dental aunque yo le pagara al contado. Ella me discriminó porque soy Mexicana y tengo el seguro DentiCal.  Aparte de no tener habilidades de servicio al cliente, es grosera, arrogante y racista con su propia gente. Ya se le olvidó que ella y su marido también son Mexicanos.  No, yo No recomiendo este negocio.

Really nice hotel with nice rooms at decent prices.  However, stay away from the smoking rooms!  I have a family member who is a smoker and to accommodate this person, my dad decided to get a smoking room. 

It was horrible.  Now, I've stayed in smoking rooms before, but the ventilation in the room that I stayed in was pretty non-existent .  I was miserable, since I was pretty much coughing my lungs out.  

Other than that minor setback, my stay wasn't that bad.  The beds were comfy and the room didn't look all janky and old.  I would stay here again.  But in a non-smoking room next time.

Yokohama is my favorite sushi restaurant! It has a very cozy and clean atmosphere. Their fish is always fresh which is important for a sushi lover. Their menu is unique and the service is fast and friendly. The owners always say hello to us and take the time to stop to talk. They go out of their way to make sure we are pleased. I have always had a great time there.

Came there for the gumbo. It was very tasty. Also got the triple sampler dish, I like the shrimp part of it I can't remember what it was called shrimp creole maybe? But the other two items were okay. Also had the Irish Channel Coffee which was nice but kind of tasted a little watered down. I would probably go back for the gumbo and also try different items.

Food and atmosphere are great. I'm a dog person but I don't like to have to eat with YOUR dog, I won't make you eat with mine! As I watched the busboy bring a dog dish full over water to a patron with his fingers inside the bowl then turn and immediately grab new service sets (napkins & silverware) without washing his hands my appetite was gone!
I always ask for the same thing EVERY time I order and they can't get it right! The food is good but not worth the aggravation!
The food is decent and happy hour is a good deal but the service is horrible...Not everyone wants to wait for the waitress to take her slow a$$ time to do her job.

This is my first time flying into Nashville International Airport and I had a great experience. 

Close to downtown and tourist area. If you have a few people travelling together, you can even order Uber or Lyft service, it is probably the best option as there is a designed pickup area and provide door to door service.

Food Court area after security has reasonable priced option includes Popeye and Wendy's. There are nothing really fancy here but since they are doing some expansion, so maybe in the future.

No duty free. But they do have shops that sells Whiskey and other spirits. This is great for travelers that has no check bags but still wants to bring a bottle or 2 Jack Daniel's home.

Small airport means it is never too crowded. Shorter lines going through security checkpoint. Shorter walk from gate to gate.
Have used them a lot. they are very expert, very nice and very responsive. Would definitely us them again

Delicious food and great staff. I come here frequently and am never disappointed.
They have breakfast, lunch and dinner foods as well as a huge selecton of desserts. For dinner, there's an option of a 3 course meal. I've never tried it, but it seems like a great deal. 

My favorites are the lasagna, grilled chicken sandwich or the cheese steak subs. The sandwiches and subs come with french fries and a cup of soup, both which are delicious. All pasta comes with soup or salad.
The Golden Dove Diner also serves alcohol and has a huge selection of desserts. 

The place can be a bit dive-y, particiularly on Friday and Saturday nights and especially after last call. However, everyone is usually pretty nice and quiet and is more interesting in playing with the little jukeboxes or watching one of the 5 TVs throughout the diner.

Overall, one of my favorite places to go when I feel like diner food. I highly recommend!

I've never been treated poorly at a chipotle, but this time I was treated especially well. I was greeted by 6 smiling faces. Everyone was pleasant. The staff worked as a team. The place was clean. The portions were generous. I highly recommend this chipotle!

I wanted to love mirko pasta... I tried. But the staff there was just so pushy. 
We arrived about 8pm on a Saturday night (they close at 10pm) and we were waiting for 2 more friends in our party of 6. We were constantly rushed. We felt so uncomfortable. We felt rushed to order, even after our food came, we weren't even given the time to finish before the waitress continuously wanted to take our plates up even while we were still eating. The chef kept looking at us upset. We felt uncomfortable and it wasn't even 9:30 yet. The food was ok. But the staff needs to be more respectful and make the guest feel comfortable. I want to give 3 stars but the staff was so poor.

I don't know what to say about this company. I have a 99 Ford Ranger. I have brought it in for airbag replacement that has been recalled three years ago. In those three years I brought my ranger in 11 times now they have told me they don't have the airbag. This is the worst company to talk to and also never buy a Ford again. Ford has gone downhill very bad. Customer service is very rude to you as well.
   
Wish they had negative stars because they would get at least two

I visited this diner once for breakfast and was certainly satisfied.  We had to wait about 10 minutes for a table to become available, but the staff was prompt in getting us seated.  The atmosphere is cute and filled with wolf decor.  The food was tasty, prices decent, portions swell, and the service was good.  I will definitely be returning!

I went here for the first time after many years of buying spices from The Spice Corner (out of business in 2013), then across the street from the Spice Corner at Scott & Judy grocery (went out of business in 2019).  I must have passed this Grassia Family Spice Company 100 times but never noticed it.  I wanted good quality turmeric and they did not disappoint.  I bought more expensive turmeric from Trader Joe's and Acme that had a taste at was best almost one-fourth as good.  Never again!  Never underestimate a good spice store.   Go out of your way to get good spice.  You'll notice the difference.

Why 5 stars? Because concession stand has definitely stepped its game up!

   ---   ---   ---

This is one of those reviews that I could have sworn I wrote a long time ago, but I've somehow managed to never get around to. I'm glad Yelp prompted me with a reminder that I haven't written it because they've really done some awesome things since I was last here.

First off, the concessions are probably the best that I've ever seen at a movie theater. I'm certain that I've never seen chicken and waffles available at a theater before - even those that specialize in serving you dinner in your seat. There are tons of other great options - there are like four different kinds of hot dogs. They had a ton of great candy, too!

The reason that it's been so long since I was last here is because I've going to Villagio anytime we want to see a movie, primarily because it's right by our house and the seating is so comfortable. But at AMC, they also offer reserved seating, which is just about as comfortable as Villagio. Even better is that it's not frigidly cold like it is at Villagio. 

I think we might just have to make this our go-to theater in the future!

Well staff was nice and potato skins taisted good.  Our concern would be cleanliness.  Lmao wow it was crazy.  Now keep in mind we were there the week that they were allowed to open at 50% capacity due to covid-19.  So you would expect with it slow and having been closed for 2 months they may have cleaned up or remodeled... exactly the opposite!! So we sat out back in a small courtyard.  Seats and tables are all over the place and randomly laying about.  Food and trash on most tables and grounds.  12-20 roaches climbing on everything including walls and we had about a 14 inch rat  all covered in mange come out on the back wall and stare at us for about 10 minutes.  Was actually so crazy to see it was fun!   It was bigger than the Chihuahua we had with us!  It almost seemed trained and waiting for us to throw him a snack.  Lmao. So crazy.  We went there because it was on bar rescue well I think it may need to be rescued again.  Drinks were good food was good (wife did get stomach cramps that night but not for sure they caused it)   I would go for drinks and stay in bar area.  Stay away from patio and food just in case to be safe.

Sometimes you just want a good breakfast sandwich... This is where you will get that. My boyfriend and I are regulars here. They often have lines but they are really quick and the couple minute wait is SO worth it. My favorite is the whole wheat everything bagel with bacon, egg and cheese. TO DIE FOR!

We were going to have dinner there. Stopped in and got seated. We then noticed that no one working there was wearing a mask as mandated. Nor were they following social distancing one bit.  We didn't notice until after we ordered drinks. So one drink and gone. Not following Covid practices at all.  Disappointing. Really wanted to stay there and have a meal and drinks while feeling safe

Generally disappointed. We had reservations but they weren't ready...no big deal, but then when they got to us they were super rushed and kind of pushy. I had to tell my manicurist 2x that she was pushing too hard on my knuckles when she was positioning my fingers to be painted. I had to tell her it hurt 2 times!!  And after all of that the mani was only so so. Wish them all the best but I won't be back.

We walked in for a carry out order this evening after seeing a gentleman eating pizza on the patio. It looked too good to pass up.
The staff was all super friendly and accommodating of us and our loud - mouthed two year old. We ordered a thin crust pizza and crispy wings to-go; we were not disappointed! My sausage and olive pizza was crispy and loaded with cheese... it had a great buttery garlic flavor to it, that almost reminded me of cheese garlic bread. The crispy wings were huge, juicy, and flavorful. I'm looking forward to trying more things on the menu and dining in. I can already vouch for the house salad, as my family gets the carry out version for all of our family gatherings.

This is the best cheesesteak place in Philly. I have been coming here since I was 5 years old. There is something about the place that is just amazing. I love standing in the street waiting for the line to move so I can get a wiz wit. If you know what that means. If not they send you to the back of the line. The line can be quite long. Anyone that visits must try here. This place is an icon.

I love Basque food.  I've eaten at Bar Gernika and Barbacoa's in Boise, Benji's in Bakersfield, CA, Ormachea's in Winnemucca, NV, the Noriega Hotel in Bakersfied, CA and Epi's in Meridian, ID.  I used to eat at the Ranch Club in Garden City, ID before they went out of business.   So I thought I'd give this place a try.  This was by far the most disappointing Basque restaurant experience I've had.

We ordered the Family Style meal which includes:

1. Red bean/chorizo soup
2. Salad
3. Battered Cod
4. Paella
5. Entree with French Fries.

Drinks came pretty quick.  Then it took a little while for the soup.  Then we finished the soup.  Chit chatted awhile.  Then that awkward moment when everybody at the table knows it's been too long but nobody wants to say it.  Then an even more ridiculous amount of time passed.  Did they forget us?  Did the server quit?

At one point we did hear someone ask a busboy if he could help prepare 34 orders of ice cream for the downstairs party.

Finally the server slapped the salad on the table without breaking stride as she raced back downstairs.  Hmmm.  OK.  That was kinda' weird.  So we ate the salad.

Then...   then... then...  Nothing...  Wow.  We checked watches.  It was 9:00.  An hour and a half and we are only at step 2 of a 5 course meal.  I got up to go the restroom and find the manager.  When I got back to our table, the entrees were sitting there.  Number 5 in the order of food but there was no #3Cod or #4 Paella.

Up comes the manager.  "What's the problem here?  How can we fix this?"  To her credit, the manager was very professional, apologetic and accommodating.  We explained about the 1.5 hr wait.  "I'm so sorry.  This is unacceptable."  She offered a free bottle of wine or desert in addition to comping our meal.  We declined these offers because we weren't looking for a free meal;  just a good one.  But the manager insisted our meal was on the house and that was a pretty cool thing to do.

We cancelled the Paella and the Cod.

I ordered the pork loin and fries but what I got was 2 Pork Chops with grilled red potatoes.  They were lukewarm and dry.  Clearly they'd been sitting for awhile after they were ready to serve.  Same with the pimento peppers.  They were almost cold. 

The other dinner guest who ordered the meatballs and french fries got meatballs and mashed potatoes.  The meatballs were also lukewarm/cold.  So was the gravy. Our other dinner guest ordered Lamb Shank.  She too said the lamb shank was lukewarm and dry.

We all took a few bites and decided we'd had enough.  This food wasn't totally awful.  It was just "meh."  Maybe it seemed more terrible because we had to wait so long. 

We left.  We didn't pay.  We didn't tip.  I've never been comped a meal for bad service.  I very rarely skip a tip to send a message.  I walked out of this place with zero regrets for not paying or tipping.

I get the whole Basque concept of taking your time for a meal and enjoying the experience and the company.  But this was unacceptable.

If you read the other reviews for this restaurant, the customer service thing is weird here.  It's uncomfortable waiting that long.  There is something wrong at this restaurant and they need to fix it.  This isn't entirely on the server.  It's the whole restaurant, owner and managers included.  It's how they run this place.

For the record, I put Epi's in Meridian at the top of the Basque restaurant list.  It also takes awhile to be served at Epi's but that's because you KNOW they are making your order with care and it is 100% worth the wait.  The food and service are incredible.

There might be good food waiting to be served in a timely manner at Leku Ona but tonight there wasn't.

If I could give NO stars, I would! The website says the they close at midnight and having done business with them for MANY years, we have had no problems in the past getting service up until midnight. Needless to say, for the past SEVERAL months, we have gone there wayyyyy before midnight, to find the lights off. The other night we went there at about 10:00 p.m., the lights are off, we drove through the drive through, look over into the seating area and ALL the employees are sitting in the seating area doing NOTHING!  My daughter pulls up to the window and a girl came over and said "we're closed"!  My daughter said, "you're supposed to be open 'til midnight" and again, she said, "we're closed".  I don't know WTF is going on there, BUT take your $ elsewhere!
THIS IS A SCAM. They will continue to take your money even though they are closed, which is not listed anywhere on their site.

Ok so my 4 stars are for the awesome service. The bartenders here are so awesome. 

The atmosphere awesome if you like sports lots of TV's everywhere. Plenty of tables with such a nice staff I'm not sure why they are empty?? It's a great bar. 

Yes bar food ... however I had a great steak salad my only complaint was digging into it and finding rotten tomatoes... so much for quality control but my server made it right. You can get flatbread or burgers too. 

All & all I'd come back great service!

I always write positive reviews if a place is above and beyond and Never negative reviews, hence I must be really annoyed.

Found a manual car online at a great price so stopped by to test drive it.  The salesman couldn't find it on the lot, nor 2 other manuals, so he brought me an automatic to test drive. Then he couldn't find a tag and the other salesman wouldn't help him find one either, seemed like he was new and very annoyed by the lack of support.  We test drove it without a tag and told be to come back in 3 days for the original one I wanted (in service supposedly, but it wasn't in any bay when we looked).  I get a call 2 days later that my salesman is gone and another will help me, okay great.

I arrived today, he isn't ready for my appt, doesn't know what car I want and asked me the same original questions. JUST Show me the car!!
But the car is not there, (sold or something he says) he proceeds to check the system for others, says he'll check, walks away and NEVER returns to his desk. I waited a solid 10 Minutes and see him standing at the front desk chatting with the other guys. I go to the bathroom and come out and he's no where to be found, so I left!

Worst dealership experience, Never again..
First time trying Mission Tacos, they were amazing! Have to try the BBQ Duck  and the Shrimp Tacos......OMG A M A Z I NG!! Soooo good! Everyday from 10 pm to close $2 Tacos & Tequila

Love this place.
Good sushi; some over creative but still good.
Fresh ingredients and casual crowd.
Great sushi option in Philadelphia.

Wonderful!!  I could easily live here. 

Beautiful 2 bedroom suites with living room, kitchen, 2 large bathrooms and screened in patio. 

Stayed here twice and love it each time. If you are coming to Tampa and need space this is your place.  Super, super clean. Smells fresh. Beds are very comfortable.  

Fantastic pool with comfortable lounge chairs. Swim teams were practicing here but pool is very large so no worries. No kiddie pool, but they do have splash pad and playground. Pool bar with food as well.

Ice cream cravings? This is your place!

Want Banana sour cream or Thai Basil ice cream?! How about horchata or dirty chai? I love the variety of flavors here. They have the standard cookie dough, chocolate, and vanilla if that's your feels, but if you're looking to try something else a little different, this is great like venue. 

Tip - Ask for samples!

This place is tiny but has a few large tables for groups, has plenty of parking, and is in a great little neighborhood off Plumb St. 

I had the dirty chai and unkle Leo's banana, my boyfriend had the horchata. I was very pleased with all three - great flavors and quantity was great for the price. 1 scoop $2.50 and 2 scoops $4.50. They give you waffle wafer if you don't want the cone - great for added flavor and scooping!

It was nice to see the wood spoons as well - I am appreciative when I see a place steering away from plastic and being more environmentally conscious.

I live in Phoenix and visit Tucson occasionally.  I never ran into any issues with Discount Cab in Phoenix, but my experience with this company at Tucson is extremely horrible.

My wife and I arranged a cab with a given street address.  15 minutes later, no cab showed up so we called again to check on the status.  The representative said it's usually about 10-20 minutes or wait, and our cab will be arrived within 4 minutes.  So we kept waiting outside patiently (we do this so driver could see us immediately).  Ten more minutes passed by, the cab was still not there.  We called again and was told that the cab was at the given address but the driver did not see us.  We double confirmed our address and phone number, so the address and phone number we provided did match what Discount Cab took down.  I understand finding address can be difficult sometimes, but why didn't the driver try to call us?  That wasn't explained, but the representative said if we wanted to make another arrangement then we would have to wait for 45 minutes.

I used Discount Cab many times in Phoenix, if somehow the driver is lost or can't see us at the designated location, we usually get a phone call and NEVER missed each other, not even once.  I don't understand why Tucson can't operate the same way but keep making up excuses and delaying its service.  Very disappointed.

I immediately fell in love with Bartaco after a friend brought me here. It was such a phenomenal experience that my boyfriend and I came back literally a week later. It's situated right in Hyde Park and parking was free and made easy in the garage. The atmosphere was nice, though loud, but definitely date night material. The staff were attentive, and I liked the system of putting up a card whenever you needed something. It was simple to order with a little notepad and sheet.

When I received my food, I was ecstatic. This is by far one of the best taco places I have ever been to (the other one being out of the country in Guatemala). They have unique options and flavors that you wouldn't find anywhere else. I ordered carne asada, duck, and glazed pork belly tacos and it was love at first bite. My life was changed. I ordered an elote as well, which was absolutely delicious. I'm not a huge fan of alcoholic drinks but absolutely enjoyed the nojito! For dessert, we had some ice cream and churros which were fantastic. I definitely recommend Bartaco. It is a bit pricey since the tacos are smaller than your regular taco, but the taste is huge! To me, it was worth every penny.
My burger was very good. My wife however did not like the catfish saying it was bland. I tried it and she was right. Ok selection of beers but the ones I had were good.

I would be lying if I said this place wasn't magical! I've been hashtag blessed to have the opportunity to do two different cooking classes her in the last month. And I can honestly say they made me almost reconsider my current career path. 

Cooking is a love and a hobby and I adore that these classes teach me new and creative ways to do said hobby. 

Ashley P. (No, no not me ) at this location has been my Chef both times and I love how fun and free flowing she is in the classes. It makes it more enjoyable. I've done pizza from scratch (which encourages me to get a pizza stone) and Taco Revolution (which taught me about Asian Mart and other international supermarkets!) 

Great to do with friends, a group or on a date night! Also: let it be known, you can bring in your own wine! 

Call to reserve a class for a discount, and when you do a class you can get a discount if you book that day. 

They offer coffee before class as well which is a nice treat. 

Great shopping, fun cooking classes! What more do you need? OH YA - come hungry :) you cannot take food to go so be prepared to eat it all (except for some of the pastry items).

Took my son's car in for AC service, explained my problem, they provided a recommendation and an estimate based upon what appeared to be the issue, I had them proceed with the work and it was done when promised. Will have to consider returning to them when I purchasing new tires.

Pros: Convenient if you're heading into Bellevue, great selection , knowledgeable staff, decent hours. Cons:  Uless you're heading on to Bellevue, pulling out of the parking lot can be hairy. 

They have pretty good prices, have tastings, and also have good sales periodically. The staff is always super helpful and can recommend good wines and other beverages. I have just bought wine, so can't speak to much else :). They have the wine separated by region and also type (merlot, cabernet, etc.). One side wall is refrigeration, stocked with white wine and the like. Other than wine they carry liquor and some high gravity beer. I recommend the place. I live in Bellevue, so a very convenient place for me to stop!

We made a reservation and we got there right on time. We were promptly seated. We ordered a bottle of champagne but it was room temperature so it had to be chilled. It took a good while, and I wish we would have been offered pre-chilled options, but we weren't so we waited. Due to the wait, our waiter brought us corn and crab bisque. It was okay. There were small pieces of crab shell in mine. We ordered the meatballs as an appetizer. They took a while to come out as well, but they were really good. Our main dishes came out promptly. I had the veal piccata and my wife had the chicken. The food was really good, and that is what brings the review up to four stars. Had we not had to wait for the wine and the appetizer as long, this would have been a five star dinner.

I dropped by the other day to have a pair of Prada shoes looked at.  The leather on one of my shoes was starting to wear faster than the other.  Because of the brand, I was nervous I might mess them up if I tried to polish them myself. 

The gentleman in the back came out and took one look at it and said "I'm sorry, but I can't fix that, it's general wear on the leather, and the best thing you should do is polish it with shoe polish." He said any upper end brand of polish will work and we said our thank you's and I left. 

I decided to write this review because I sincerely appreciated his honesty.  He could have taken my shoes and charged me up the rear end to simply polish my shoes.  He didn't and declined to service them because it was the right thing to do for a potential customer.  When I have a pair of shoes that need more servicing than a general polish, I will visit him again.

We ordered the enchiladas supremas, a Gordita quesadilla and taco and they were all extremely plain (except for the quesadilla, it was alright). There was no flavor which was surprising for a place that is so highly reviewed.

I absolutely love this place, and it is our go-to for group pizza nights.  We like to get the 30" pie because its so much fun~! Looking at the reviews it seems people judge them pretty harshly for an occasional slip-up (really - TWO stars for a great pie but missed the word 'diet' on the pop order? Seems a bit harsh to me), but it's never happened with us in the many times I have ordered from them. Always get what we ordered, on time, and wonderful taste.

Amazing friendly tour guides and office people 
Amazing caves. 

I had accidentally booked kayak tour for a Saturday for 3 people and the ferry for Sunday. The whole booking process is confusing to begin with. And the adventure website is not very user friendly. When they called me on Saturday and asked where I was I stated that I wasn't leaving until Sunday. The girl on the phone said maybe I would be able to get on the waiting list. 
What I didn't appreciate was that when explaining to me that I'd have to be on a waiting list for Sunday it wasn't until the very latest second when we ended the conversation that she said that we might have to repay for the entire experience because we didn't call ahead to cancel. 
If we were aware of the mix up we would've obviously called ahead to fix it. But we weren't so we didn't.

When we arrived they said we would be able to get on the tour that there was enough space for us (only 2 of our party of 3 was able to make it due to food poisoning) and AGAIN not until the very late second when we were about to get all our gear they brought up that we would have to repurchase the experience because the one we had booked yesterday couldn't have been sold to other people. If this is a company practice - it sucks. 

The frustrating thing was that if today's kayaking had been full we wouldn't have been able to get on anyways.

It was rather irritating to hear "you didn't call ahead to cancel" when obviously in our scenarios we weren't in a position to call ahead. Who plans for food poisoning? Sorry it didn't fall in-line with the policy? 
As irritating as it was I didn't want to be rude to the people behind the counter/over the phone though because clearly it's a line they have to say fed from whoever is higher up. 

Either way had we not mixed up the dates they still would've had a couple of unsold tickets on Sunday. Because if Sunday was full they wouldn't have let us join. 


So no beef against the tour guides or the views they did a wonderful job. This review is not against them at all. I'd give them 5 stars. 10 stars. 
But we have to pay for 5 tickets for 2 people to go on 1 kayaking trip and it ended up costing just under $700. Absolutely ridiculous.

Disappointing sales department. After placing my order they charged my card and I received a notification that the tool would either ship from BIS or from the manufacturer and I would be getting a tracking number. Well nothing happened for a number of days until I contact them. Turns out they do not have the item in stock and they don't want the manufacturer to drop ship it, so the tool first needs to be restocked and then they ship it out. A week later they do ship it, but with that added delay it now has a Saturday delivery date when the office is closed. FedEx tells me that BIS has placed restrictions on the delivery so that the package cannot be held at a shipping center. I reached out to BIS to please release those restrictions for an earlier delivery but was told they could not do that. If I had known it would take 2 weeks to get my order I never would have gone with BIS. To summarize: if an item is out of stock, mark it as OUT OF STOCK on your website. If you realize that mistake later CONTACT THE BUYER instead of just staying quiet and finally DO NOT BLOCK FEDEX ROUTING REQUESTS.

Shut the cluck up is no joke. I ate a whole bottle of tums afterwards! Do it to say you did, but if you want to eat with a little spice and still enjoy your life, just go for the hot the flavor is AMAZING. Also, the black eyed pea salad is where it is at. I'd literally go back, just for that.  The staff was friendly. The line is long, well worth it and moves quickly. I'd definitely hit it up again if/when I go back to Nashville.

**and now have been back multiple times and we make a visit each time.

This used to be a personal favorite of mine in Clearwater. The décor/ambiance makes you feel like you're at a beach bar with a great outdoor patio and bar, typically with some live music. There's another small bar inside with some TV's to watch the game and additional seating. I've been dining here off and on since my first assignment to the area in 2006. For the most part, things have been great, though I'm thinking that overall the prices have went up and quality has gone down some. One of my personal favorites, the coconut encrusted mahi was no longer offered on my last trip. The grouper sandwich is still a solid selection and I thought the hogfish sandwich was just ok (the menu claims it is the world's best sandwich). They still offer daily drink specials and I am sure they have expanded their list of mixed concoctions, but they no longer offer up the exclusive/extensive rum menu. I think they still have a decent selection available but I used to enjoy having a menu to pick my poison for the evening. The complimentary cornbread muffins are still around and service is still great, but I think this place might not be as good as it once was...

The place is pretty nice and modern. The staff are all friendly with smiles just waiting to help you. But the food itself is pretty mediocre.

I've had other poke bowls in town and this doesn't live up to the competition. The rice is served warm, which is just sad and unappetizing. The seafood, tuna in my case, does taste good and seems like good quality. But paired with that bed of warm rice, it heats it up quickly to become a lukewarm dish.

There aren't many free toppings to choose from compared to competitors. Something as simple as seaweed salad and crab mix is an extra charge while it's free at other places. And all together, there's not much combined flavor even with the two sauces I requested. The sauces themselves are the issue, likely needing double what they put to have good flavor.

The labeling of things behind the glass isn't very good. One premium thing wasn't marked as premium, and things like seeds and crunchy topping are more difficult to read.
