The staff, while friendly, were pretty ready to close my order before letting me squint out the sesame labels. I had to ask them to reopen and put it on.

My wife got a roll, and it took ages to get. About 10 other people came, ordered, and left by the time we got the roll we already paid for.

Overall, it's a mediocre fare. The place is pretty, but the food is just ok. And the food gets absolutely ruined with the warm rice, making the whole bowl a lukewarm, average set of ingredients that don't come together well. Not a place I'll be visiting again.

So glad I found this Chinese when I moved house 2 years ago. This is the best around and I have never had a bad meal or something I didn't like from them. I recommend this to everyone unless it gets so busy it effects my wait time :O)

Great atmosphere. Very friendly staff. Very clean and safe feeling. The bubble dinning outside is great. It's like your own private room. It's warm enough even on this freezing, windy night. They rent it to you for 2 hours which is perfect! My wife and I enjoyed it a lot. But here's the but. The food for me was bland. It lacked seasoning. Even a little S & P would of helped since there is none on the tables which i assume is for Covid reasons with different guest touching the salt and pepper shakers. Improve the taste a little and this place will be 5 stars! I Guarantee it!

We stopped in yesterday around 1 pm with my fiancé and one of our friends. You walk in and order at the counter, and just sit wherever you like. When your coffee is up, you go and grab it. When your food is ready, they bring it to you. 
I ordered a lightly sweetened cappuccino and the Kennedy sandwich. After we ordered, we couldn't find anywhere to sit. Between the people eating lunch and the people on their laptops, we saw two seats open that weren't next to each other. We waited til a few people finished up and then we got to sit down.
Our food came out surprisingly quick, a gentleman yelled out my fiancé's name and we waved him over. Everything looked good on the plate, and tasted pretty good too. My sandwich definitely wasn't the greatest sandwich I've had but nothing wrong with it either. I think I would've preferred to try their avocado and poached eggs on toast, it seemed like everybody in the place had ordered that. I'll definitely be back to try that out! Overall a nice place to come to for lunch.

Was in town on business and one of my agents wanted to take us to his cigar lounge. I don't smoke but decided to go for the martinis, since I heard great things. You must try the Vanilla Sex martini. It was in the top 3 best desert martini I have had. 

The waitress we had was an absolute crack up! I wish I could remember her name to give her a shout out. Our group was a little rowdy but it didn't phase her a bit. Any wise crack that was shot at her she came back at without a beat. 

The ventilation was decent and I was able to sit comfortably with my group and not get overwhelmed by the smoke. This does not mean that it is not smokey, because it is and you WILL walk away smelling like cigars. 

The atmosphere was comfortable and modeled after a speakeasy vibe. Loved it.
I highly recommend visiting this restaurant. Everything was amazing.. the food, cocktails, service, ambiance.. all perfect. Definitely try the catfish entree, tastiest thing I have ever eaten!

I had several friends recommend this place, and I finally got a chance to try it!

I liked that the menu had so many items to choose from. Whether you wanted lunch or breakfast, there was an option. 

I ended up ordering the patty melt. It was ok. The grilled onions were a little too raw for me, so I just scraped them off. No biggie. The fries were also ok, but nothing extraordinary. I also ate one of the pickles they set out on the table. It had a sweet and sour taste, adding a twist to my meal. 

Overall this was a neat little diner with super nice servers. Really couldn't have asked for better service! As for the food, it was A-OK. Nothing more, nothing less.
The Puttanesca, pasta and meatballs were divine.  Love the house made pasta. Friendly staff is an added bonus.  I'll be back with friends soon.

I wanted to like this place so bad.  I really did.  Their truck is so cute.  The people inside seem so great, buuuuuuut when for my first visit I asked, "Can I get a coffee, please?" and the response was "Sorry, we're out of coffee," I was perplexed.  But that's what you do!  You're a coffee truck!

I did however get an Americano and it was great, but I was rushed because they were closing early on campus (the second time I've noticed this happen since being in the area) and proceeded to have severe caffeine jitters the rest of the day.

But, I will come again, and I will have a great experience, and then I will give them a five star review.  I'm determined to.

Best eyelash extensions ... best price, Mila does an awesome job on my lashes.I am constantly getting compliments on how beautiful my eyes are. The salon is clean and the staff is nice. I highly recommend Milas for lash extensions  u won't be disappointed :)

Very trendy and difficult to get in but sorry not worth the wait. Sunday night experience with reservations for a party of two. Daughter  restaurant to Commanders Palace but chefs need to go back to culinary school because Commanders is way better.

Flavors clashed and entire salt shaker was dumped on fish. Overly sweet or overly salty from start to finish. Chefs were also out socializing with guests while orders backed up for two hours.

Customer service however was good. Manager must have known that failures were occurring in restaurant because they came by and checked on anyone who was waiting three hours to eat.

I explained situation to manager and waitress and they offered to comp meal but I said no, I will pay several times. In the end the waitress provided us with complimentary shots. Then manager decided to comp our fish dinner, which was very kind.

I called for a curb side pickup and the manager was INCREDIBLY rude. She acted like it was an inconvenience that I was calling. It's unfortunate because I enjoy their gluten free cupcakes and like to support local business. This transaction was so bad that I will not be returning.

My 10 year old pug started rapid breathing, I rushed him to Med vet. $900 later they tell me they suspect pneumonia. But gave me antibiotics and told me they gave him a pain med to help him relax  reassuring me he would sleep well that night and the pathologist would call me the next day with the X-ray results. 
Got him home  and he was dead an hour later. I called them immediately. All I was told was about the crematory services. That was my beloved baby who had never had a health problem. The worst was the pathologist never called. They didn't kill him but their indifference and greed  were the most heart sickening thing I have witnessed. 
They took the money and ran. Not even a shred of condolences.   Avoid these heartless people. My baby is dead and they got richer

For the second year in a row our family decided to go to Maggiano's for Thanksgiving.  Big mistake.  In 2017 we found the experience pleasant and fun, the food yummy and the leftovers plentiful.  In 2018, our take was dramatically different.  Our server seemed very stressed (which we understand can happen when it's so busy) but her attitude was bit off-putting.  She seemed pretty upset that we didn't have our drink orders ready with two minutes of sitting down.  We were a party of five and we all wanted something different to drink. There was only one drink menu, so that took awhile to circulate around the table.  A different server brought our drinks and just dropped them off at different corners of the table without asking who was drinking what.  We ordered our entrees; two Thanksgiving items, two pasta items and two sides.  Our entrees were Turkey (of course) and Tilapia.  The turkey was delicious.  It came with a tablespoon of dressing, so everyone had a tiny nibble.  There were five slices of thinly cut turkey (very tasty).  The Tilapia was good.  We have four cheese Ravioli (yummy) and Gnocchi with Sausage (not so good...and the only that went into the doggy bag).  About five minutes after our food was served, I asked our server about our sides (Garlic Mashed Potatoes, and Mashed Sweet potatoes.)  She said they ran out but there should be more ready in 15 minutes.  Huh?  Five minutes later she brought 2 tiny bowls with our sides, enough to feed one person.  They also brought out two desserts to be shared  by five people.  My wife and mother-in-law had to hit the restroom on the way out and said it pretty trashed.  There was no toilet paper in the stalls and an employee was just handing some to people because she did not have the little key to unlock the dispenser.  All-in-all a disappointing $200 experience (not including drinks).
First time doing their brunch and the Peach Bellini and lump crab and asparagus omelette was amazing!

Honestly, this place might have the best tasting sushi rice in Indianapolis. Asaka is very close, and If you're wanting a more sit down dinner, that's where you should go.

Though if you are wanting a quick bite to eat and grab some groceries and other Japanese goods, this is the place to go.

Its like a mini (and I mean mini) or should I say "chibi" version of Mitsuwa (Chicago folks will know what I'm talking about) There's no bakery (some
Pastries), so don't get your hopes up, but there is a small market and a  "food court" with small table seating. 

You can even buy raw fish for them to cook 

Definitely worth checking out if you are wanting a good sushi. There isn't an extensive menu, but what they offer is good.

The bomb Inari is my husband's favorite.

The price of $45 is good, and if you tip your massage therapist $10-$15, you come out around $60 -- which is all I want to pay for a massage.  The facility is new and clean, and the massage rooms are  dimly lit, without much fluff.

One BIG caveat -- the massage therapists can be hit or miss.  Once you find a therapist  you like, stick with that one.  I had a few massages there that were awful -- but on the other hand, I've had many by the same therapist that were excellent.  

Example of BAD experience:  I scheduled a 60-minute Swedish massage with the only available therapist -- her name is Kathleen.  When she started the massage, she used a lot of pressure.  I asked her to go lighter, but she REFUSED, telling me that it was the "only way to work out the knots" in my back.  I had the unfortunate experience of getting this same therapist again yesterday.  She has not changed.  Again, I asked her to lighten up on the pressure -- in fact, I asked her more than once -- and SHE WOULD NOT LIGHTEN UP the pressure.  She told me, and I quote: "I ONLY do deep tissue massage!"  If that is the case, then management should not schedule customers for massages with her without forewarning the customer that Kathleen "ONLY does deep tissue."  While a good deep tissue massage can feel great, especially at targeted points, sometimes I just want a gentler more relaxing massage experience.  Not an hour of someone causing me pain -- which is what happened yesterday!  Sorry to name names, but I'll never schedule with Kathleen again.  Although they do have some good massage therapists, this experience makes me never want to go to Sierra Massage again.

There's a stylish, contemporary-yet-classic feel to the place. It's all about sleek geometric lines and monochrome. Very cool vibe.

The food was excellent and hearty without being boring. Be warned, though: the portions are HUGE, so you'll struggle to finish your meal.

The beef stew was a highlight for our party, especially on a cold, snowy night. I would definitely go back.

I came across Hot & Cold when I decided to grab a coffee while my friends waiting in line at Pancake Pantry!  I walked into Hot & Cold not knowing that I would most likely end up frequenting it.  The people were great (even the other customers - a woman there with her family helped me figure out the ropes at this local spot), the coffee was so well priced, and the flavor of the coffee was fantastic.  I love unique coffee shops, and this one definitely delighted me!  I'll be back!
Who would have thought that the best meal I had in Tucson was in a wine/liquor store! The Confit Duck thigh was easily one of the best duck dishes I have ever eaten! Try the Basil Ice Cream!
Really cute spot. Loved the cheddar chive pancakes.

Ate there once.  Food was so bad we never went back.  Owner was not apologetic about quality/quantity of meal.  Had roladen, our favorite.  When I make it at home I serve my husband three.  This portion was one very fatty cut of beef, lots of tasty potatoes, & beets.  I took the fat home for my dogs & took a picture of it, which I have since deleted.  Then also took a picture of the ones I made, which were lean & delicious.  Everything here is overpriced.  Many items in the Deli had NO price on them.

I came here with a friend for brunch in philly. I had already looked up the menu the night before and the chicken bucket looked really good so I knew what I had in mind. That chicken was juicy and the skin was extremely crispy! The fries also had perfect salt. I'm coming back here on my next trip to Philly

The last couple of times I have been to this location, any car lane I went to, the card reader has not worked. It's a little frustrating considering the majority of people use debit/credit cards, you should make sure the paying source is working efficiently. Also, today I got their new 'Classic chicken sandwich' and it was not fresh at all and didn't have much flavor. It was very very bland. The workers have always been very nice and friendly though, which you don't see often enough anymore in fast food places, but they do rush sometimes and don't always remember to bring your condiments or extras that you ask for. But, even though the workers are very friendly the food that they serve at THIS location has been abysmal lately. I hope they step it up soon, because I love the food at other Sonic locations, but this one is the closest to me.

On my top 5 dinner places in St. Louis. Such delicious food, with a casual environment, and very decent portions for the price! The cup of gumbo was really more like a bowl which did not skim on the sausage or shrimp! Perfect amounts of the flavors mixing in a great gumbo! The cornbread was also pretty special and a stand out from most cornbreads I've had. There was a really delicate texture and taste. The smothered fries was an enormous portion that had pork and melted cheese. The only way to stop eating it was for the plate to run out of food... we sat outside which was nice, but the inside had some great live entertainment!

This was one of the best pizzas we've has since moving to Florida thirteen years ago.  The staff is friendly, polite, and outgoing; I feel as if they really valued my business.  The 16" two topping for $13.95 is possibly the best value around. The crust, sauce, and toppings are all very flavorful, and the portions were generous.  My grandchildren and my daughter attacked this pizza so fast I couldn't even get a picture! My daughter suggested just showing the empty box, proving the pizza was "Delish" . Well definitely order from here again (and again). The only downside was the garlic knors; none of us were a ble to eat them, they were so drenched in grease; however the marinara sauce was really good. Still, no stars deducted. Thanks for a great pizza!

Margaritas were not as good as one would hope. Top shelf margarita was nothing but more expensive tequila with store bought mix. Food had very little flavor and restaurant had a bad smell. Nice staff but not sure how they stay in business. I guess I'll just have to keep going to my mama's house for a real margarita.

I went this past weekend with a couple of friends. It's the first time I've been since they moved upstairs, and I did not find it to be an improvement. Upon entrance you have to walk up a fairly long stair case, and I didn't see an alternate for people who would find that to be a challenge. The space felt cramped. It was so loud just from the din of other guests talking that we all noticed; I was having trouble hearing the person sitting right across from me and they were bothered by the volume as well. The decor is dark / grey, which didn't feel very inviting for a location that's typically a date spot. Our deserts were okay. The staff was nice, but it took a long time to get our check.

One of my favorite restaurants! Food is great, ice cream is even better! They tend to stay pretty busy, but it is definitely worth the wait. Waitresses are outstanding and always have a smile on their faces. Great customer service!
Love this place . They have awesome lunch special. Soup salad, sushi and teriyaki checked all under $10 ;)

This place is so delicious! Stopped here on our way through town and couldn't have been happier with it. Drinks were tasty and the food was amazing - roasted chicken was lemony and delicious. Fish tacos were great, as was the cassoulet. Wish this restaurant was closer to home for us! Oh and they played great music too!

Easily the best pho in a 10 mile radius (I hail from Bridgeport). The service here was very good: I didn't have to wait at all for anyone to take my order and the food came out quickly. They serve a whole range of Viet dishes here but I've only ever gotten the pho. The broth tastes meaty but has a very clean finish. There's plenty of noodles and they also don't skimp you on meat here: I had a lot of slices of steak and meatball in my bowl. I like my pho a little saltier so I asked for a side dish of fish sauce to add more umami flavor to the broth. I also ordered the fried egg rolls. They come three to an order for almost $6. I did enjoy them but only really tasted pork, not much shrimp or crab. Also they're very thin so I wish they gave you a couple more to justify the price. My whole meal was a little over $20 and left me warm and satisfied on a rainy afternoon. Definitely

Out of all of the tanning salons this one is rated near the top of my list. The service is always very nice. The girls who work here are very friendly and helpful - Although at times they can be pushy about buying more tanning lotion etc but that's expected. I think the beds are very nice and even the lower level beds are pretty good and it is always very clean! 

They offer really good deals and free tanning days - you just have to be in the know and show up! This can be great for people who are not members but for people who are members it can be annoying when it is so crowded. In order to keep members happy they often let members cut non-members but I hate crowds so I try to avoid those days. 

They also have a great spray tanning system which I am a huge fan of. I am fair complected and have super blonde hair so it is hard for me to get very dark therefore by opting to get the spray tan I can get great color/ not look orange and save my skin from damaging UV rays.

IT'S TIKIIIII TIME IN NOLA!!!!

But no, f'realz--this place rocks. They have an incredibly balanced menu. Coconut, high citrus, low citrus, you want a crest tiki style cocktail? They have it. 

And, of course, incredible presentation. Plus great servers who are happy to educate you. 

You'll be four drinks in and headed to your mental beach in no time.
Amazing experience for my daughter and I. Although, the tokens and tickets (now bumper cars) are a thing of the past with Chuck E. Cheese, we still enjoyed it! Will definitely be returning:)

Not sure what the fuss is about with the wait. We got our food 15 mins after ordering in the middle of lunch time. The chicken was delicious and so was the spaghetti. The polabok is another story but I think my taste buds are bias because my MIL is an amazing cook. Her polabok is nothing to be compared BUT this is a fast food joint, so It'll be nice. The halo halo was yummy too :)
Solid Italian made to order joint, pizza by the slice. Cheese steak is good, Stromboli is sensational

Lovely, large, comfortable, CLEAN rooms. I'm a fan. 

Nice and quiet, too. 

If business/pleasure ever brings me back this way again to Indianapolis, I'll stay at the Courtyard Marriott for sure!

I went ahead and tried a hot caramelizer this time. It was really good. If you like coffee that's sweet then you will like their coffee. I would recommend getting a small because of how sweet it is. I can usually down a large at other coffee shops but here I can't even get halfway on a medium because it's so sweet. It's good just really sweet.

I must say that I love pizza.  It is by far my favorite food.  I'm not a pizza snob by any stretch of the imagination.  Even chain pizza is still pizza.  I can appreciate the many different ways you can make pizza.

The pizza was more charred that I expected.  I have had brick oven pizza many times and I would say they tend to leave it in longer than I would suggest.  The pizza crust had a nice texture however.  It was crisp and chewy.  The crust was the best part.  

They didn't have pineapple.  I wanted to try prosciutto ham and pineapple.   However my wife and I went for the sausage and fennel with roasted red peppers.  It was a nice combination.  

The prices are better than I expected for the review I got from a coworker.  It sounded more gourmet that it really is.  We snuck out of there with two chop salads, a pizza, and drinks for around $20 before tip.

Service, by far is 5 stars.  Our waitress never let our glasses bottom out.  She was very nice and friendly.  

The bad news, Pizzology is in Carmel.  That means I had to drive there.  I think this place needs to be in the city of Indianapolis and not in a strip mall off of a roundabout.  Bottom line, if I had to choose to drive to Carmel for Pizzology or walk Bazbeaux...I'd walk.
Love this place. Always great service and wonderful food! The spanakopita is amazing!
Great food! great service! great atmosphere! love this place! My new favorite go to spot for any lunch or dinner occasion

I've been here several times (even twice in one trip) for the amazing oysters on the half shell and one of the best margaritas in St. Pete. The outside porch has a relaxing vibe and nice view of the ocean. Not super crowded either, would definitely recommend!
Just had ahi tuna nachos and brisket sliders on pretzel rolls. Awesome flavors, cool place, friendly staff.

Once inside, it was larger than I expected. There was a nice variety of dishes and the staff kept refilling popular items. I was a little disappointed in the General Tsao's Chicken, but on the whole everything was very tasty. Fell in love with the Honey Chicken, and I will definitely be making a return visit.

Strongbuilt installed hood for outside BBQ. Very professional dealings to assess project, detailed quote and timeline. Project competed as planned and with excellent quality. Friendly crew and super-clean.

EVERY YEAR we come to this same spot and I always look forward to eating here. Not only do they have great Sushi (Philly Roll Girl here) but I tried their Pad Thai this year and now I'm hooked. It was absolutely the best Pad Thai I've ever had in my opinion - granted I haven't tried too many Thai restaurants. It has outdoor and indoor seating options. It's nothing too fancy, just a great sushi/Thai restaurant that you should absolutely try with your friends or family!

If you just want to eat and compare costs to a Thai restaurant, please don't come to Vetri or similar places like The French Laundry. These types of places are beyond your current state of mind. If however you would like to share in a culinary experience, welcome and prepare to have an evening that will forever be etched in your memory. Institutions such as these are not meant to be sampled every day, but rather more of a culinary bucket list that should be cherished and shared with someone special.

I had the Greek Omelette and thought it was amazing. I will definitely go back here again. The only thing I wish is if they had hash-browns; they only have home fries. For those of you who are looking for the menu online, here is the website.   http://www.dontigran.com/mybenedicts/about-us.htm

Hi, I was there on Sunday.  I have to tell you that there are so many changes on the menu and some of them are very good.  Also I have to say that you guys should be thinking in give a good clean up to the carpet.  Also the kitchen have to be prepare at all time for the huge amount of people that you are receiving in a regular day, and always have enough food on the steam tables.  I was there like for two hours and the ice cream area was disgusting.  Remember that you only need one bad reference to change people's mind.  I love my Old Country Buffet and I am a continuous supporter but there are little things that have to change.  Hoping you address this issues and give me a surprise for my next visit.
Great shop, save a few hours to visit this place if you are a fruit lover.  The strawberry shake is wonderful.  the citrus is fresh.  Avoid the Crocodile jerky.

Great pizza, garlic bread and desserts!  The zeppolis ( Italian donuts I think, covered in powdered sugar) are deliciously sinful!  We order and pay online and the delivery is always fast. We've ordered some of the pastas and sandwiches too - all good. I highly recommend NY NY Pizza!
Love the catfish and hush puppies. The portion size is very large, I always have to split with someone.

Consistently the bf and my go-to place for a superb lunch. I also come with one of my sorority sisters quite frequently. Actually, we come so often they know our orders. We throw them off sometimes when we decide to order something different. The service is always friendly and accommodating, which is also why we love the place.

We've never gone to dinner here, but it's always in our top 5 for lunch options. The crowd is much older, and very much prim and proper... but that won't take away from the food. (:

I give it a 4 and not a 5 because the food is amazing but you have to be lucky to get a good waiter. Last night was horrible by the time we got our drinks refilled we where ready to go and we where there for a good 2 hours. She sucked.

My friend and I were driving through the area on our trip to NOLA when we stopped here for lunch. We wanted some good BBQ and we were not disappointed. The parking situation is a little tricky on the side streets but there is more than enough room inside the restaurant. The menu is simple which made ordering easy. It wasn't a long wait for our food and it was all great. It was an awesome place to relax while stretching our legs from the drive. We will definitely check them out again when we are in the area!

I can't not give C&P 5 stars. As much as I want to keep this place under wraps as my own personal Tired Hands of the city, word is getting out. It's guyish decor and carefree atmosphere makes you feel like you're at a friend's house (who is a master brewer, mind you). Bike here, chill, and then be sure to fill your growlers on your way out.
Atmosphere is very nice, sunsets are beautiful from the restaurant and the food is nice. Love the brunch on weekends as well.

I turned 21 on a Tuesday, so my friend and I decided to get margaritas and dinner here instead of going all out (saving that for Wednesday and Thursday! :)). We were both SO impressed. The restaurant itself is absolutely BEAUTIFUL. Wonderful atmosphere with a full bar in the front and an adorable 2-level dining area in the back. This would be a perfect place for a romantic date, going out for drinks, or a yummy mexican dinner! I got the fajita nachos, which are technically on the appetizer menu, but they were HUMONGOUS and delicious! I got the carne asada with them, so the pieces of steak added a lot to the dish. Our margaritas were SO yummy! Since it was my 21st, I decided to go with the "beerita," a huge margarita with a bottle of corona (or your beer of choice) upside down and placed in the margarita, so the beer slowly empties as you finish the marg. It was to die for! We didn't make it known it was my birthday, so I don't know if they do anything special for that, but I'm SURE that they do. We will DEFINITELY be back, especially for happy hour! Thanks for a GREAT Tuesday 21st birthday, Rosalitas!!!
Lots of mixed reviews here. The people who work here are super nice, and I had such an awful experience with my previous dentist. Since I've been coming here I haven't had any issues with my teeth!

Sean came through with the payment for my shirt one week early. Thank you Sean. Although the work was satisfactory Albitt's needs to  improve their check in check out system with a bar code system so they can track customers items. Then I would give them an improved rating an consider trying them again.
Omg- I have died & gone to heaven in the South. The fried chicken, greens, mile high biscuits & slap ya mama bread pudding are AMAZING!

I had the veggie Pho.  I was worried it would not be flavorful enough but it really was.  It was filling and light.  The carrots were a little undercooked but that didn't ruin it.  
When combined it really was a satisfying meal.  We also tried the pad Thai.  It was not spicy at all so if that is a concern you won't have to worry.  Definitely will be having it again.

Had a great experience. Food was good, service was fantastic. Upstairs patio is super cool. Funky decor on the inside. You can buy some of the artwork. $1 pbr all day everyday. They also have bands perform like every other weekend!
Lalo was super attentive and friendly! He was literally running the place left and right! Food was delicious; overall, highly satisfied!
Perfection! I work down the block and come here at least every week for lunch (and dessert). I love this place and am so grateful that I work so close by!
Great food. Fresh. Delicious friendly    Go out of their way for customers. Love everything on menu.  Love the food.  Could eat here everyday

There's a lot to love about this hotel and a few minor annoyances. What stood out right away was amazing customer service. From arrival to departure the staff was there for me and they were extremely polite. 

It's a gorgeous building with an impressive view from the interior. The lobby is expansive and beautiful. With the way the rooms wrap around the elevator tower and shoot up into the ceiling it almost looks like a space station. As far as I was concerned about 2am every night in an extreme state of delirium... it was a space station. 

The pool was crowded with children every early evening, but I didn't mind. The gym had more than enough space for me to get a good workout and enjoy myself. Like every other location in the building the gym and pool seemed very well taken care of. 

I was there for the New Year so the building got crowded and noisy at night. While I did lose a lot of sleep (insomniac) during the rush of adults and children talking and running around... there wasn't much more the hotel could have done. I called the front desk on a couple of occasions and they were responsive and apologetic. I think they simply didn't have enough staff to control the flood of noise... But if you're reading this and you're that person typically up at 1am shouting... just know that...

I don't like you. 

Upon seeing the complaint in other Yelp reviews I did notice a great deal of dust in my room. I'm not sure why they're having that problem but it really didn't ruin my stay. 

I was able to request a microwave along with my mini-fridge free of charge. That was AWESOME. 

The night before my departure I wasn't able to get hot bath water for the evening and that made me sad. 

Between reacting a bit to the dust and getting a stuffy nose, and the noise keeping me up, my nights weren't as restful as I had hoped... but I think this is a great hotel with some wonderful people operating it.

This hotel is also close to a number of amazing restaurants
Get the waffle sandwich & a chocolate croissant. Entrees came with marinated strawberries that were very tasty. Was really fun to see their old fashioned cold brew set up!!

I ordered a cafe con leche, took a sip, and tasted a chunk of something.  Spit it in my napkin to realize it was a bug, most likely a roach.  When I informed the cashier, she didn't seem surprised.  Didn't charge for the drink but that was it.  Needless to say,  I will be going somewhere else for Cuban sandwiches.

I work in Largo. A co-worker recommended this place as a lunch option after I was telling him about a cuban cafe in Wesley Chapel with AMAZING food. Unfortunately, Havana Harry's did not live up to the rave review I was given. I ordered the mojo pork, with rice and black beans. The portion was generous; however, the pork was dry and was not tasty at all (it was overpowered by the taste of black pepper), the rice was not fresh (a couple of days old at least) and the beans were not flavorful (I can make better). It was defintily not worth the $7.48 I spent. I only ate a few bites and the rest went into the trash. In addition to the bad food, the place was shabby. I'll never go back again. It was a waste of money.

I've eaten sushi since 1975, and this place rates in the top 3 best ever.
Wonderful quality fish, beautiful presentation and
friendly service. 
They are dealing well with the COVID-19 mess.
Give them a try - they deserve it!

After two horrible experiences at Lakeside Toyota (2 1/2 years apart) I went to Royal Honda on the referral of Barbara from Imports, Etc.--a nearby used car lot--(that also was impressive!). Royal Honda greeted me by name since they were expecting me when I drove up, but they were NEVER pushy as I dreaded. Chad made me feel at ease immediately. I told him what I was looking for, we looked at a couple of models and I fell in love with one immediately. The sales process went incredibly efficiently with no B.S. or game-playing at any time.

I traded in my 2010 Toyota Corolla at an unbelievably great price that paid off my loan and enabled me to buy my gorgeous 2013 Honda Civic LX the day after Christmas with very little $ down, and my new car note is almost the same as it was for a car I despised every day that I had it. (By the way, I will never step foot into Lakeside Toyota again, and I STRONGLY urge you not to go to those scam artists either....I hated all 3 of the people I dealt with a couple of weeks ago, and hated the ones I dealt with when I bought the Corolla a couple of years ago. I also hate their service department.)

As a car-dealership-battle-weary single woman, I had my guard way up when I came in on Saturday, but I cannot rave enough about how respectfully I was treated from the instant I arrived on the lot.

My review would be too long to list everything I was impressed with at Royal Honda, but everyone was TOP-NOTCH and exceeded my wildest expectations. I simply cannot believe that buying a car was so stress-free, and actually PLEASANT. I want to thank attentive, conscientious Pre-Owned Sales Manager Daniel Morse for quickly assigning me to my absolutely awesome, polite, extremely knowledgeable, helpful, fun, delightful, completely no-pressure Sales Rep Chad Lewis, to my amazing honest, friendly, eager-to-make-the-customer-happy and patient superhero Financial Wizard Anthony Hall who went above and beyond my greatest expectations to make me happy. Y'all have a customer for life. I am so impressed and thrilled at my experiences here both Saturday and today (when I made some changes to my financing that other dealerships would have given me grief over). Thank you all for a fabulous experience and a great car!! (And thanks for the roses too!--what a nice surprise!) Happy New Year!
Love this place. The regular Bulgogi is the best thing on the menu. Chicken is just soso.

what a cute little spot in the funk zone! there's not a ton of parking so you may have to walk. they have a lot down the way but it fills up. during covid times they have tables outside on a patio with string lights. no heaters ): but cute vibes

We first ordered some beers and they don't have any set flights but you can order tasters that range from around $3-$7. Four max fit in a box and they label which is which in case you forget. I love their glasses they're absolutely adorable and I wish I could've taken one with me. We tried lots of beers so I won't review each one but I'll just say my favorites were 1-4. 12-13 were a bit too sour for my taste. The tasters are a great option because you can try a variety of beers and if you don't like one, you're not stuck with a whole glass

Lama dog is attached to Nook but you have to go inside to order. They give you a buzzer for when the food is ready. I wanted something lighter so I ordered blackened rockfish tacos and I was honestly disappointed. Although it was fresh and I loved the avocado, the tortilla got soggy and there was no seasoning. It desperately needed some salt...throw that rockfish back in the ocean maybe! It was also $14.25 for three tacos which is a bit pricey given their size. I wish I had ordered a burger but I was worried it would be too much

I really like lama dog as a hangout spot and it's dog friendly too! The service is fantastic and the beers are fun. They don't brew in house but they have about 20+ options to choose from

Its hard to find good Chinese food around Town and Country. Tokyo is my go to for Chinese take out! The food is good and their udon base is actually flavorful which is hard to find. Other favorites are the general tso chicken, beef and broccoli, and pan fried noodles! All of these dishes are flavorful and satisfy my Chinese take out craving every time. OOooo and I almost forgot, the crab rangoons are very good too!

The place is small but you can eat there if you want. We have eaten there once and it was fine but I like getting it to go or delivered better. 

They also deliver which is always convenient. Also, when they do deliver they are really fast and always come before the estimated time!

Had 2 beignets. They were fresh... but not piping hot. They were already prepackaged in a brown paper bag as we placed our order. I was disappointed . Next I will request fresher ones and hopefully can have them on a plate instead of a bag!
Ordered pizza and chicken fingers for delivery. It took a long time and we were super disappointed. We ended up throwing most of it away because it didn't taste good.

Considering I gave them a one star back in 7/6/13, I am ready to say things have improved for the better. So at this point, I am ready to move up to 3 stars. If they had a 3.5 stars, I'd click on it.

Help has been much more customer oriented. Their artisan bread selection is good, our favorites being Gaston's Cafe De Paris.Their Brioche rolls are superb. Just not enough in the case of these.  I still find Whole Foods has an edge on their bread selection, but Coop's isn't bad.

Won't try to do a full meal deal review as Michelle R. and several others have done A-1 job. Just wanted to give the Coop an "Ata Boy" for improving. Hope they keep it up.
Great customer service, great food. 10/10 Would recommend for a friend. Marg wasn't too sweet  and the sandwich had the perfect crunch from the potato chips. Can't wait to come back

Strolled in here off the street and was a little bugged by the people who worked there following me around. It was annoying at first, but then they were telling us a bunch of stories about some of the art. They are REALLY knowledgeable!!! It definitely made up for that creepy feeling of someone following you. 

On a side note, they had a piece of David Bowie that was awesome and they also had a few pieces from Jim Carrey which was pretty awesome.

Whenever I go to a theater, I always end up thinking something like "You know what this needs? Sweaty leather, the stench of old beer, and some too-loud drunken musings on the movie plot". So thank god IMAX finally has that covered. Now I can PAY to feel like I'm chillin' at my cousins PBR encrusted college house with his couchsurfin buddy Bruno, on the what-was-once-a-leatherish couch they picked up off the side of the road in Fernley. 

Thank. the. lord. 

No but seriously though, I rated this 4 stars because it's well-deserved. Sure the leather chairs are squeaky and I did think "how many people wiped their buttery popcorn fingers as well as some of their back sweat on this chair?", but the fact that they recline and have an insane amount of leg room....that's all pretty sweet. And yeah, they do sell alcohol, and yeah, people get tipsy and forget they're not in their own living rooms. But it's not the end of the world.

There is one drawback to the fact that HUGE beers are sold in the lobby.... the pee breaks. I swear, the whole theater left for the loo at some point in the movie. It was a film-long perpetual line of hunched over ants marching to and fro. And, you know, no one wants to be "that" guy. The dude who interrupts at the critical point in the movie and is hated by all. And the "critical point" is always, whether or not it truly is the critical point, when someone is all "um excuse me, pardon me" in front of you. To you, it's the most important moment, scene, dialogue, whatever ...and this tiny-bladdered nincompoop is ruining it! You broke the seal, a$$hat, now I'll have to see your lumbering butt at least twice more. 

As of yet, I haven't seen an actual IMAX movie at this theater, just a standard movie in the deluxe theater or whatever it's called; it's the one's with the reclining leather seats. Anyway, that experience was pretty great. And I've made this review out to be less rosy than it should be so y'all don't cram up the theater with your boozy friends, butter fingers, and infinite pee breaks.  *wink*

This place is a bit trendy, which can sometimes intimate me, but the service is extremely fun and friendly (not pretentious at all like some trendy places tend to be). Our server Ravin was very friendly and knowledgable about what were popular menu items. At first we ordered the 3 for $7 salsa trio and she was imputing it into her little smart board.....and then magic happened.....the salsa came to our table while she will still practically putting in our order! The smart boards that all the severs use seemed a little silly at first but if they allow for that kind of order efficiency than I can see why they use them!

Their sashimi style ceviche is by far my favorite item on their menu. We also had the fried fish and shrimp tacos. All were amazing and we even got a complimentary snack from the chef. 

The cocktails are by far the most curious menu items to me here. They are all very unique and different. The rumors are true, their cucumber jalapeño margarita is amazing and not spicy at all like some people might fear. Also they have some magnificently flavored mojitos (I got blueberry).

Our server said they have different happy hour specials almost every day of the week so just call ahead and ask if your in the mood to try it out on a budget. 

I would definitely come back and try out the patio when the weather isn't so hot. The patio looked gorgeous but we were there in the middle of a hot August afternoon and opted to sit inside. 

I'd love to come back for a happy hour soon!

A whole other world.
So you wait at the door and an dressed up asian man checks your IDs (and questions you if he feels like it, things like how did you hear about us and etc. If you have a large group [maybe 6], there is sometimes a two drink minimum).
When you are lead upstairs, you are first held up in a waiting area where you are given rules (no phones, no photos, and etc.).
Then you are whisked away into a dimly lit, open room, with uniquely classy decor. It's like you're in a different time/place. 
The cocktail menu is lengthy with a wide assortment of uniquely complex and delicious drinks! One of my drinks was some sort of chocolate milkshake name and it was surprisingly awesome.
Just a note though, drinks here are VERY pricey. Expect to spend $15 a drink.
This is not a place you go every day or weekend, but it if definitely a place you should check out!
Very accommodating, delicious frozen peach Bellini, friendly staff. Great place to visit for my friend's bachelorette party.
So crowded and smelled like trash. But a cool place and I get the idea. On our way out we picked up pastries at Termini Bros. The lady was super nice and it was quick considering the crowd.

I highly recommend Stitches. I brought 4 pairs of jeans in to be hemmed, all of them ranging from new to faded. They did an expert job at matching the factory hem and stitch color, and they were very helpful and friendly.

I went into Reis-Nichols with the hope that I could sell a piece of jewelry. I was referred to the buying manager. He was busy at that that moment but I was offered a beverage while I waited. Once he came out to meet me; we sat down in a nice area near the front and though o didn't sell the piece; he was very kind to discuss the ring and possible options. They fairly recently completed renovations and the store is beautiful. They carry many sought after brands of jewelry and watches.

I recommend the "BBQ Brisket Sandwich" with very thinly sliced smoked beef brisket smothered in a thin house BBQ sauce, and served in a small thin hoagie roll ($9.99, is fairly expensive).  That's a lot of THIN, but a nice sandwich.  However, don't expect your traditional BBQed brisket sandwich.

Ribs, beans and slaw are fine, but the quarter BBQed chicken was way over-cooked (sounds like a consistent problem).

Friendly staff.  Parking is easy on the street out front.  BYOB.

I had a small project done recently by McKimmey and was very, very pleased by the work done and the people who performed it.  They were right on time, listened to and understood the concept I had for how to execute it and got it done in less time than estimated, saving me money.  The finished work is cleanly executed, totally professional and they did their best to minimize the impact on my wife.  Great guys who did their work with professionalism and pride and a pleasant attitude.  Highly recommended!

Location of this hospital right off I-75 exit 264 in Riverview. Hospital parking is convenient. Staff is friendly. I have to say the service received from ER admit, to RN and CNA, surgical staff EVERYONE I came across was pleasant and helpful. I really appreciated the way the staff treat the patient and visitors, very welcoming, attentive and hospitable.

Hospital itself is beautifully laid out. Directions are simple and clear, able to get around without feeling lost. No issues at all with any area being dirty or disorganized.

Fantastic steak, absolutely my favorite Five Star Steakhouse, service was wonderful attentive never felt rushed enjoyed my cocktails salad everything was timely just wonderful atmosphere is very nice dim lighting place to take a date to impress great for a holiday dinner or a special occasion of any type or just for those of us that enjoy a fine steak from time to time must say I have eaten at several Ruth Chris Steakhouse locations the one in Clayton is one of the best they're all good but I prefer Clayton been to the one in Hawaii they've all been wonderful really but Clayton is one of the top
I've been to Taste twice before and it's always been delicious. Today is no exception. Absolutely delicious food, knowledgeable and friendly staff and great environment.

This place is amazing!!! Definitely one of the best tasting pizzas I have ever had. There menu choice is great as well. I like how you can choose two different choices in one pizza because it is definitely hard to choose! The customer service and the environment was great as well. I will definitely be back frequently and would recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and a great environment!

Everything I was hoping it would be. And more. A quick trot down the French Quarter from our hotel, we found Clover Grill smiling back at us with a humble face and a Coca-Cola sign. What a cute corner diner that's open 24 hours! Have I mentioned yet that they serve their entire menu all day?! We may have eaten breakfast AND THEN returned 16 hours later for a midnight cheeseburger. And tater tots. And more breakfast. HaHa! 

Food was great! The gravy REALLY SURPRISED me. In a good way. I'm from Kentucky and I'm really really really picky and very judgmental when it comes to my sausage gravy. HaHa! Exceeded my expectations. The chicken fried steak was also awesome! Smothered in gravy and lying next to my over-easy eggs, it was tender and battered very well. Snagged a bite of my son's cheeseburger before he scarfed it down. Was very tasty as well. Fries and tots were hot and crispy. 

Family of four ate for about $35. At this time, they're ONLY accepting credit cards, no cash.
This is a wonderful place and I will continue to come here for massage and accupuncture. I will not go anywhere else.
Great food, good service. The booths are always cramped in this chain, but the price matches the size of the food.

We were seated immediately and had bread and drinks within minutes. We ordered the spicy tuna appetizer and it was amazing! I had the fresh Mahi Mahi and my husband had the grouper. Great food and drinks!

Best pizza in town! I definitely make it a habit to walk over here during my lunch break to get the Spicy Ranch Chicken and White Spinach pizza for my coworkers. I've tried different joints around the city, but nothing like this place! I definitely recommend.

Our first visit was on Super Bowl Sunday and they appeared ready for potential crowds. Hubby and I both selected acai bowls. I tried the mango and husband selected the peanut butter. Both were very tasty and satisfying and portions were very generous. Staff on duty were friendly and patient with our questions. Service was extremely prompt. In the spirit of transparency we redeemed a BOGO offer as incentive to visit but we will make the trip again to this neat place (we live on the other side of town). I definitely recommend!

I don't get manicures and pedicures often to be an experts but after my experience yesterday I know this place does not deserve 5 stars. I start by saying that price wise yes! That's why I gave them 2 stars, they offered me 10% off because we got two sets of mani and pedi, for my daughter and myself. Like the other reviewer said the chairs are worn down and I'm not sure they are following Covid-19 precautions. but what really hurt was getting my cuticles cut so much to bleed in two of my finger nails. I told the lady "that hurts" but she didn't understand and keep going and I said that hurts again and she saw the blood. She cleaned the cut with antibacterial which was painful too but necessary. The first coat of paint also hurt and it still hurts today. The same thing happens to my daughter in one of her toes. During the 2 hours we spent there nobody else walked in or called, please stay away from this salon, I'm sure there are better ones out there.

Celebrated birthday at Akira with family.  The food was good...hibachi table side, the service was also very good...friendly and attentive staff. It was a thoroughly enjoyable evening and out of town family loved the restaurant. It was not crowded so unlike so many restaurants in our area, no long waits on a Saturday evening. Will definitely go back.

I have a couple of different piercings and from all of the shops I've been to this place has got to be the cleanest! I got both of my second ear lobes pierced and it was a bit pricey ($100 with a tip, $85 without). I'm not too concerned with the price because not only was my piercer sooo nice, but it was very clean and the jewelry is high quality. I have sensitive skin and my healing has been great. Like I said the staff is very friendly and informative. They walk you through every step and make sure to check that you're comfortable with what they're doing.

If I could give this place 0 stars I would. It states clearly on their door that they open for business Monday thru Friday at 8:00 AM. It is almost 10 AM on a Friday and they are still barred shut. They have my suit for the weekend and my bus leaves in an hour. This is an absolute disgrace and I will never return to this over priced, dishonest place. If you have an interview or something important, please do not go here as they obviously do not value their customers time and business. I now have no suit for my event this weekend, or I need to miss my bus and repurchase a later ticket. Horrible, horrible, service.

(4) ~ very good overall food & service.  NOTES: There's a line to order your Appetizers & Pizzas and another line for ordering Desserts & Beverages, before finally paying.  Then you'll be handed a Table Number and they'll bring out your food.  Not sure why you can't order everything at once...seems like it would be MUCH easier;)lol

I ordered from here for the first time today. Upon arrival my online order through their website was not found by Manager Matt. I waited additional 20 min in addition to the 20 it took initially. Drove the 20 minutes back home.
I ordered a chicken pita which was described as shaved chicken, feta, taziki, onions and tomatoes.
What I received was a pita with little to no taziki and pieces of chicken skin, and the pieces of chicken were large (one piece was the size of 1/2 a thigh) and spiced with curry.  I was told the chicken skin is the way they come.
I have eaten at many Greek/Mediterranean restaurants but never found curry in a pita sandwich.
I returned back to the restaurant to get a refund and retuned the sandwich. Unfortunately I did not take a picture.
But I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.

I found a Living Social deal for this place, so I decided to check it out.

First, they have a really good selection of sushi (over 30 rolls) from your typical rolls (e.g., California, Shrimp Tempura) to more interesting rolls like a roll with chicken tempura. They also have several spicy rolls. 

Second, their menu has quite the variety. In addition to sushi, they also serve burgers, salads, and a variety of appetizers. 

Third, I really liked the ambiance. I know part of it may be the fact that we went on a weeknight, but I really enjoyed the calm, quiet space. It was clean and pretty sleek.

Fourth, our server was very attentive and friendly. I will say that our food came out in a reasonable amount of time, but I wouldn't say it was quick. I found this surprising given how few people were dining at Mizu the night we went.

Even with all of these positives, I still think this place probably isn't over 3.5 stars. The sushi was pretty good with a reasonable amount of fish in each roll, but it wasn't anything spectacular. Also, the prices are pretty typical. I got 4 rolls, my friend ordered the Japanese Chirashi, and our bill was $60 before tax. 

While I enjoyed my time here, I'm not sure I would come back without a Living Social or Groupon.
Great cheesesteak and fries ... bartender friendly and courteous taking care of drinks and food quickly and kindly.

I am out furniture shopping with my wife at Macy's , hey it's Mother's Day and i have no choice. We are being helped by Pamela who is just fantastic! She is a real professional at her job. What a breath of fresh air.

We've done 3 of the 4 rooms so far...escaped only one, but you get to buy the t-shirt so I can lord that over others...!  It's a fun experience.  We have done all 3 rooms with the same couple so we at least have some kind of strategy when we start a new room.  Hope they keep adding on!

Love the location and set up of this place, was super convenient! We first stopped here for brunch and I definitely have to recommend the cheesesteak scramble! It was delicious! The steak was flavorful and succulent and the creamy sauce was a perfect touch of flavor! We all wanted to order peach mimosa's but they were out of peach... they must be good! We settled with regular mimosa's and they were a perfect add on to our breakfast. We stopped here again late night for some food, and the service was not the best. Our waitress had an attitude when some of us asked questions about the food (we're all from out of town) before and after ordering, especially when two of us were served wings with brussels sprouts (we didn't know and had asked)! I don't think the menu was read correctly but they were still delish! Refreshing of drinks was also slow although there was only 1 other table of guests. But I would definitely visit again for the food!!

We are usually seated quickly and waters served promptly but when it comes time to place our order it seems to take awhile.  So waitress just came by, 1:32pm.  We'll see how long it takes for the food to get here. I ordered the trip tip dip with a salad and my husband ordered Bob's Big Bear Burger Deluxe  with a salad.  The salads came out in 4 minutes.  Pretty quick and not a bad size side salad.  Burger and sandwich came out 4 minutes after the salad. Doing good today.
Last time my dad and I came for breakfast it took over 30 minutes to get our food and then it was cold. My scrambled eggs we runny and my dad's over medium looked Sunnyside up and greasy.
My husband's burger was so good and the portion was huge, he had to cut it into quarters,  but they forgot the bacon in the deluxe part.  Waitress, marleen, fixed the problem. She was real apologetic and very friendly.   My tri tip dip had great flavor and I could only eat half.  Good review here!
The foods were good! I like the spicy squid rice bowl. It's unique and tastes authentic, and also not basic.

JJ's is very casual, serving excellent coffees and teas. The menu is very limited, just pre-made sandwiches and muffins, etc. There is a market attached with all kinds of beer, chocolates, sodas, etc. The cafe itself has couches and lots of tables for studying, which you will always seen plenty of going on. There is wireless internet, which is a plus. It's a bit dark inside, so if you need lots of light to study, this probably won't suit your needs. However, it is a good place to focus or hang out with friends and chat over a coffee. While the decor is nothing special, I like this place anyway because of how laid back the atmosphere is.
