This is the best Steakhouse both my wife and I have ever been to.Grilled Chicken Salad (my wife had),and Ceaser Salad with Steak (me); fantastic seasoning and portions;the Steak was very tender! We went back the 2nd day! Grilled Shrimp Salad (wife),Philly Cheese Steak (me)...Wow,What a fantastic place to eat.Not a fancy place,peanuts shells on the floor.I wish there were a Santa Fe near my home.

nicest courtyard that i stayed at in USA 

BIG clean rooms; 

nice atmosphere; even breakfast buffet was better quality than others 

service very good 

more like a full service Marriott ( and not all are this good either) 

location, location: right in middle of everything , yes visit reading terminal market; but many great restaurants within 2-3 blocks; Chinatown only 6 blocks away too
Good IPA, kids food is great and the pizza was acceptable.  All in all, what I'd expect for a brewpub.

Visited SBPM this Tuesday and decided to park in the underground parking that is free, the market itself closes at 10:30pm on Tuesdays but all the signs posted state the garage is open until 11:30. When the market closed I decided to walk around state street a little bit with the group I was with, thinking I had plenty of time to get my car. 

Wrong! I got back to my car BEFORE 11pm and my car was already locked up in the garage! Even better, the elevator was shut down and the stairwell was locked. I ended up having to call the police and they had to call the building manager to see if they would unlock it. What happened? They couldn't even get a hold of the manager!

Dear Management, if you're going to go through the trouble of posting signs stating the time your garage is open, how about you stick to them? It's a shame because I actually enjoyed coming here but now if I ever do I'm steering clear of the underground parking.

The staff here is super friendly and the place is very clean. I came here for a gel manicure and Ayn did a great job recovering my ruined nails from a bad acrylic job at another salon.. This is by far the best manicure place I've been to, and I will definitely be coming back.

Great people watching place, outdoor sidewalk eating...as well as indoor eating options.  We started with a blueberry martini - a specialty drink here...not a sweet drink...it was delicious.
Then on to the menu...i chose the squid ink seafood pasta.  Despite the "spicy" disclaimer...it did "not" have a kick.  Good, not great, very healthy portion of pasta...minimal baby scallops and shrimp in a tomato base. Meals are served with small, warm loaves of bread and garlic butter, a salad is offered ala carte.  The waitstaff provided excellent service! ... so,  Get out and support your local eating establishments in St. Pete...but more importantly the wait staff...covid has been tough on their livelihood.
.

Since moving here from CA, I've been trying out all the local pho spots to find one that I can come back to over and over again. I've been searching for almost three years now, and even after trying this place, the search is still on.

When I don't feel well, I want pho. Decided to stop in here since it's got the highest rating and most reviews in the area. It's located in the same shopping center as the Jason's Deli and the Orangetheory Fitness off of 19, so it's pretty easy to get to and there's never any issues with parking.
The shop is fairly sizable with plenty of seating, and brightly lit. The wall to the right of the entrance has large photos of menu items, and to the left of that is a large chalk wall that serves as a menu board. Several items were crossed off, but even so, there was still plenty to choose from. Instead of seating and ordering, you order over the counter, pay, and take a number with you to a table.
My daughter and I ordered bowls of beef pho (one with no cilantro, which was repeated back to me) with an order of fried spring rolls, and my uncle ordered a chicken teriyaki bowl with a side of shrimp rolls.

Grabbed a table, and we waited for about 15 minutes before the pho and spring rolls arrived. Both had cilantro. The waitress said she'd have the kitchen remake my bowl without the cilantro. I appreciated that, as some places will just imply that you should pick it all out, as though it's your fault for not liking cilantro. While I waited, I ate the spring rolls. These were, BY FAR, the best thing I had. My uncle got his food, and dug in. He said the bowl was good, but needed more chicken and veggies. The shrimp rolls were unimpressive. He said he was expecting something more like a typical spring roll but with shrimp, as opposed to what he got, which was small singular shrimp wrapped and fried. 

My pho finally came out. The flavor was ok, but a bit on the bland side. I added hoisin and some sriracha, lime, and a few jalapeños. (I asked the waitress for soy sauce when she took the first bowl, and she said she'd bring some back with her. She forgot.) The broth tasted better this time, but still seemed to be missing something. The beef pieces were thinly sliced and ok. My noodles seemed undercooked. I don't know if it's because the broth wasn't as hot, so they couldn't continue cooking as they sat, or if they needed another minute in the kitchen. Either way, they weren't chewy or tender. I let them sit as long as I could, but they never seemed to get better. I ended up finishing the meat and drinking the broth, but left the restaurant underwhelmed. I'm glad that they were willing to correct their mistake, and the person who took my order did come by the table to apologize, but it was too little too late.

If you're on the lookout for pho, I'd say go into this place with low or reasonable expectations. I wasn't at all blown away or wowed by it, or even satisfied. However, I know that even the best of restaurants have bad days, and with the amount of reviews and stars Green Mint has compared to other places in the area, they've got to be doing SOMETHING right. Today, unfortunately, that was the spring rolls. Since I work out at the Orangetheory down the plaza, I can see stopping in here again, but I'll definitely order a sandwich or a bowl. And the spring rolls.

The Mud House was a place we came to as part of my friend's trip down memory lane. He liked Benton Park and wanted to walk around before breakfast. There's definitely a hipster vibe to the place with a vegetarian/vegan bent to it. I was looking to get their breakfast slinger but the lack of meat in it dissuaded me. I ended up going for their breakfast burrito with a dollar upcharge for bacon and then I got their Rosie Palmer, an iced tea/lemonade combo with rosemary+honey syrup.

The drink was good, not overly sweet but balanced pretty well. The burrito though was, the bacon was greasy and it didn't add that substantial meatiness that I thought it would. All told my breakfast was about 14 bucks, and I don't think it was worth the price tag.

Easy in. Easy out. I did a walk-in after a bagel stop at Einstein's next door.

Clean and very friendly, thanks for that. All Covid protocols are in place. 

Senior price haircut is 15% off; $17

The lady working at  the hotel where I am staying. It was the best suggestion yet! I had the  charbroiled oysters, crab salad and spinach risotto. They were all tasty as hell.lets talk about the charboiled oysters that I have yet to find in Miami! They were what the hype was all about. Perfectly charred accompanied with French bread and lemon. The SAMLL crab salad was more like a meal. Good portioned crab salad with romaine lettuce that was dress lightly with what tasted like a cream dressing. The spinach risotto came in a small cup that at this point in the meal was the perfect portion. Seasoned perfectly for me.  Located on the first floor of the Hilton Hotel it was a little walk across the street from the River walk Shops. The waiter was attentive and not overbearing. I cant remember his name but he was a nice guy. My husband being vegan had the eggplant Romano that was equally delishes as my dish. He too had the spinach risotto and thought it was more like spinach with rice rather than risotto cause of the consistency.

I had white wine and the hubs had a wonderfully refreshing bloody Mary, that I can a sure you was to die for!

I had a great visit to Dolce Vita yesterday! A friend and I decided to treat ourselves to a treatment and some relaxation before a fundraising dinner later that night. From the moment we walked into in to the time we checked out we were enfolded in peace and luxury. This place is beautiful and what it lacks in options to the big casino spas it more than makes up for in beauty, serenity, and hospitality. I got a facial from Leah and she was fantastic! I'm already planning my next visit!!

I really want to like the AZ shuttle. It's a sorely needed service. But 4 out of the last 4 times I've used this service, it's been awful. I just spent two hours squished in a corner seat shoulder to shoulder and thigh to thigh with a complete stranger. Literally could not even take a full breath. Could not move my feet more than an inch. Forget about the knees! This was after I raced to make the shuttle from my flight which arrived in PHX (because the last time I booked, I arrived right at the departure time and the shuttle was already gone)...only to wait for another half an hour, and to arrive in Tucson 39 minutes late. Finally, it's way too expensive for this level of service. I hope they have a competitor who can offer better service soon. Otherwise I'm flying into TIA. Every time.
Excellent soups and entrees. Cooked fresh while you watch. Servers are knowledgeable and provided excellent recommendations. Reasonabl prices with ample servings.

Great selection of groceries but very pricy up there with whole foods. Honestly I usually just go to Trader Joe's. Lazy Acres has quality produce and meats. Come here if you have a wallet full of $ to spend because a full cart is going to run you $200 easy. Nice salad bar and deli. It's very convenient if you live in the Mesa area. Enjoy!
Amazing, and well worth the wait. Three piece fried chicken with butter beans and Mac and cheese.

The Drive thru is always crazy. Better off parking and going in. It's a good Dunkin Donuts. But basically like any other. 

Go in hear on Monday morning and your going to wait eaither if your inside or the drive thru. So give yourself some time.

I got a haircut from Jay last week and loved it, when he was done. I'm used to getting haircuts which I love and then go home & shower and my hair sticks up like crazy. Not with this cut. I can now say, 4 showers later, that this is the best haircut I've ever gotten. Throw in that Jay only charges $20 and I'm a big fan.
Very disappointing place. Food was overpriced for the quality. Server was rude. I definitely recommend Chophouse a bit more pricier but definitely worth it.

Whoa... this store is insane. They have pretty much everything you'd need for organizational purposes, and a lot of stuff you don't need but is still pretty cool. I actually bought my lunch bag here and looked around because of it. I will come back when I get around to organizing my kitchen this summer!
The eggplant dish is DE-DAMN-LICIOUS.  The sauce on the noodles mixed with the fried eggplant......OMG. Highly recommend. Get it with the potato salad.

I had never tried dumplings before until I tried Steam Boys. I absolutely love them now! For a restaurant being brand new, this place is excellent! Very great service and the food came out quickly. I will definitely be back very soon, maybe even tomorrow!

The only downside to this Chipotle, is that they don't have enough seating. There are quite a bit of tables but now enough for how busy it gets. 

On the plus side, the staff is really friendly and efficient. There's always a long line, but never a long wait. The food is always good (and cheap) which is important. What can make your meal expensive are the extras (guac, juice, etc.) Chipotle offers more than one option for vegetarians like myself which is a relief to still be able to have options while eating out. And their Nantucket juices are my absolute favorite!
I always love a good bagel spot and this place was exactly what I wanted! Pizza bagels, rainbow bagels, lox and bagels, just awesome will revisit!

Constant faulty equipment is a waste of time. TV Cable boxes don't have a long life. Now I'm told to get a replacement one (which I pay monthly for) I will pay a service charge. So Now I pay for you to replace your broken equipment I rent? 
I have had Comcast for decades. Very disappointed in this new scam to have me pay a service fee for you not full filling what I pay for. I call to rectify and get disconnected twice, how convenient for your agents.

The diviest bar I've ever been to, and that's saying something when I've been to the diviest of the dive in both San Francisco to NYC.

Deep down Frenchman St. lies this gem of a locale.  It's filled with locals who enjoy Ms. Pac-Man, ping pong and cheap booze.  And if you haven't been there, you don't know what cheap booze it.  Vodka/cran and a Jameson on the rocks: $12.  INSANE, HUH?!?  We were there on a very off night during the week, but if you've had your fill of live music and still wanna get your party on, keep going past all the bars, past the tattoo parlor on the left and all the residential houses till you hit it on the left.  Look for the pick-up filled with sod and the funny jewish bumper sticker and you'll know you're on your way.

I bought a Groupon for Blush well over a year ago and finally decided to use it for boudoir pictures as a present for my soon-to-be husband. I encountered an issue when calling because, due to the popularity of the shoots, it was very difficult to get in before the Groupon expired. However, I was offered to use my Groupon value towards another package, which I accepted (I was interested in lengthening the time of my shoot, anyway). I set up an appointment, they charged a $50 deposit, and I waited a few weeks for my appointment.

Upon arriving at the salon, the stylist immediately started on my hair. I forget her name, but she was extremely personable, and obviously very experienced, which I was worried about given my extremely long, thick, sometimes unruly hair. She did a fabulous job creating "bedroom" hair after I described to her what I wanted. She also asked if I had pictures, so if you have something specific in mind - bring a picture! While she was doing my hair, she also described the products she was using (not for a sale!) & how she was doing it - I am now able to recreate the look at home thanks to her tips! 

After hair, the owner/photographer, Alanna, began working on my makeup. Again, she asked if there was a certain look I was going for, and off she went. I did not receive airbrush makeup, but either way - I loved it! 

It was then time to shoot. I originally paid for 1-2 outfit changes and 10 pictures. I brought an entire suitcase of lingerie, jewelry, and shoes, so I wanted to do 3 outfits/15 pictures. Alanna has many different sets, props, and even some outfits, and she is a genius when it comes to matching up what will look best with what. I learned that these types of shoots are very acrobatic and tiring! She had me contorting in different ways & climbing on furniture - I couldn't see it then, but they made for amazing pictures! She must've taken hundreds of pictures, but some of my favorites were the "goof" pictures. She knows exactly how to capture you & your personality in the best ways.

When it was time to pick out the pictures I would purchase, I was met with so many options! She also told me that if there is something certain I don't like on myself or in the picture background, etc., she can edit it out. For me, she edited out a tattoo that I'm currently having laser removal for in every single picture! I selected my pictures & was promised them in 2-3weeks by email. I received them all in just over 4 weeks, but they are PERFECT! I look so amazing, it blows my mind!

The most important thing about this entire process and about Blush/Alanna is that you feel totally comfortable throughout the process. I went topless for the camera (!!!) and was walking around in basically no clothes in the area where you shoot with a woman I barely knew - but that speaks to the comfort level Alanna's personality brings while you are being photographed. My friends and I are already planning a Blush Boudoir Party!

It kills me to leave such a low rating because the food here is wonderful, but the service always leaves much to be desired. We have visited Gattuso's 4 times with 4 different servers and still had the same substandard service. Each time it has taken a minimum of 5 minutes for a server to greet us and take drink orders (on our 3rd visit it was easily 15 minutes). 

The ticket time on our appetizer of cheese fries had to have been close to 15 minutes today and I'm pretty sure our entrees were prepared at the same time because when they came out the plates were very hot like they had been sitting under the lamp (we both had sandwiches so the food would not have heated the plate that much). We actually waited until the lunch rush was over before going today thinking the service would have to be better when the girls weren't so busy...nope. Our particular server today actually saw us sit down at the table and still did not come greet us for at least 5 minutes. There were only 5-6 other tables in the whole restaurant. 

It's so disappointing that the service is so bad because the food is great.

A lunch/brunch spot with great decor and service! Food was pretty good, nothing mind blowingly special but tasty. To drink I got a boozy iced coffee, which was the highlight of my meal. I got the 1/2 chicken salad and cup of French onion soup. The soup wasn't the best French onion soup I have had but the sandwich was great. The chicken salad had grapes in it which was a nice burst of flavor.

This is hands down the best Indian food around. Madhu accommodates all of her customers and her meals never disappoint. I eat here multiple times a week, always vegan options available  and always delicious! If you haven't gone here before, it's a must try!! You will not be disappointed and you'll quickly be hooked :)

After a month of traveling to over ten dealerships, negotiating out the door prices with a handful, I'm pleased to say that Sam Buffington at Autonation Nissan earned our business. He wasn't pushy, he was straight forward and answered my four hours worth of questions. We had a minor issue with our car we purchased which Sam replied to text and email within two hours and set it up to be looked at immediately and was fixed with zero cost or question. Also sent a follow up text and email to ensure we were happy. We felt very comfortable here, transparent pricing and no pressure unlike many other places we visited. We would do business with him again in the future and recommend any friend or family member to work with him.

I also want to mention that I initially contacted this office via the Internet and discussed this purchase with Phil Tallon, we didn't make it in on a Saturday but instead a Sunday. He wasn't in on Sunday's and didn't get upset but instead suggested we ask for Sam to help us out when we got there and even Phil sent a follow up email and gave us a phone call to congratulate us on our purchase. Great customer service!!

We had used them in the past and they were reasonably priced - I was out of town and they came and charged my wife way more than we paid last time - defiantly dissatisfied and will not use them again m

This location IS THE WORST LOCATION!!!! Went there this morning to order two damn bagels one with cream cheese and the other with butter not a hard task at all! Took them 30 fucking minutes to do it. The two girls names are Talushay and another worker.  They were very rude and didn't care. At the end of the day it's all about customer satisfaction. And they didn't care that we were upset and told us it was our problem. Tried to call the location later in the day too get a hold of the manager no response after 2 times during business hours called again and they unplugged their phone! Extremity unprofessional and rude!

Based on all of the ads I've seen and commercials I've heard, I thought that this pizza would be really good. I was very disappointed. I got a slice of pepperoni and a slice of cheese. Both slices were extremely thin and the bottom of each slice was soggy/soft. The texture of the thin and soggy slices was too much that I ended up just picking off the cheese and only eating the crust. I'm mad I wasted my money to only eat the cheese and crust. Being that they have received good reviews from others, I may give them one more try...but no time soon!

Love it here!!! Great prices and i always get what i ask for! I come here for eyebrows mani/pedi and the girls are always so sweet and get the job done quick!!! Sometimes a wait but never too long with a wide variety of colors to pick from! I go every chance i get!

This place is spot on, great pizza, they're doing adventurous stuff so if you're down for some Dominos style, or that stodgy old stuff your grandma makes, stay home, or order Dominos.  Instead they're making exciting pizzas, playing with cool ingredients and knocking it out of the park with service.  We had the greek pizza, with the pistachios, the name escapes me, it's dynamite, they could change the name to that.  We also had the Joey or something to this effect, again, excellent.  We got that mushroom one as well, also great. The service was friendly and funny, she laughed at my still water joke.  Is there a downside to this place? Maybe it's too small, it's on one of the best corners in town for an eatery and it can get jammed.  They do a great job though once they get you seated.

This is a favorite place for us to visit as often as we can. You never leave hungry and without bags of something. Neat neat one stop shopping stop whether its yummy cupcakes, cheesesteaks, fresh fruit, candy, or lots of other goodies. 
Just go, it's an adventure.....

Having the opportunity to visit this national landmark will be one of my most valuable experiences ever. I loved Philly and this made me love it even more. I was so stoked that I finally got to see the things that I learned about in school so so long ago. History truly comes alive when you are able to visit in person then just read it in a book. This was awesome everyone should visit here.

My daughter took me here for lunch. I eat gluten free. They had a nice choice of gluten free items. Greet salad selection. The gluten free bun they used for my slider was delicious. Even my daughter liked the gluten free bun. I definitely will be back.
One of my favorite spots. Enjoy a great meal, in a great part of town at a well designed restaurant. The staff is great and the food always is impressive!

From the butchers Butcher Board to the delicious Smoked Wild Boar Ribs & their infamous Royale with Cheese Sandwich, I will honestly say it's a must! 

STEVE the bartender brought us one of the best experiences, friendly, knowledgeable, and extremely talented with his bartending skills! 

Please give this place a try! It's 5/5!

Beautiful scenery. Not worth it for the lack of security. After our hike we returned to the parking lot to find that our car window had been smashed and my mother's purse was stolen. We were told by the lot attendant and a passerby that this has happened here before, yet there's not a single park ranger present. Even with the constant foot traffic and activity in the parking lot this person was able to get away with breaking into our car. Unbelievable. Went and found the manager for help at the village tavern who was rude and unsympathetic. Will not be coming back here ever. My advice, if you go there don't leave anything of value in your car but you might get your window smashed in anyway.

I called this location today and asked if they could help make my girlfriends birthday special since I'm out of state at the moment. Since they couldn't accept a payment for the meal over the phone, I was told they would relay a birthday message and give her a pastry. 
Total disappointment that none of it happened. I didn't want a song and dance or anything spectacular; just a simple message since I could not be there for her special day is all that was requested. 
We really enjoy dining here, but I'm very disappointed in the lack of follow-through.

This place is our regular place for pizza. We likes the white pizza with bacon and Greek salad.  The Italian Wedding soup and garlic knot are also excellent. Gerry is our regular waitress, who knows what we want and like. Very friendly place, with great food. Our pizza always come fresh, hot with thin crust (by request).

My wife and I were excited to try this place! We were very disappointed. The only thing worth noting is the salsa! It was great!  Very fresh. (The salsa is why I gave you 2 stars and not 1.)  With the name Guac I was very excited to try there guacamole!  I was really disappointed! It was like bagged guacamole you would buy at a grocery store.  You could definitely tell it was not made fresh! Very saucy with no chunks of tomato, onions, etc. With their name I was expecting tableside guacamole or at least some of the best guacamole I've ever had with some different options maybe spicy etc.  Bottom line: it's just another average Mexican restaurant! It's not cheap either.  Kind of bummed to say it, but I doubt we will be back.

I have visited the Cleveland Heath three times now, and each time  I have receive fantastic service and great food. I have yet to be disappointed from the menu so I suggest sampling as much as you can, but I do have to recommend the salads. They are expertly crafted and could be a meal by themselves. Certainly one o my favorite spots in Edwardsville.
New owners have serious service issues to resolve. Takeout is a disaster. Owner and counter staff huffy. Please someone buy this place from them.

I need to write a great review about my physical therapist from Mercy Home Health Care. I had my hip replaced May 24th 2017. My physical therapist that came to my house, Keesha Vassel- Ford, what's phenomenal! It was very frustrating not being able to do everyday tasks and she helped me get through it. She gave me confidence that I did not know I had. She treated me with the utmost respect and at the same time it was like she was a friend that I've known for years. She need my recovery so much better I'm so much easier. Anybody who would have her as her as their physical therapist is very very lucky

The service was great and the food is fine, but it is considerably more expensive than the other Indian restaurants in Nashville, while the portions are smaller. I am assuming that this has something to do with location (the rent might be higher in Green Hills area). The parking lot in front is very small. We went with a groupon, which excluded the lunch specials. The lunch specials seem to be a good price, but I'm not sure if the portions are small.

In sum, great service, good food, small portions for price.

We ordered Toro, Amber Jack, Mada and Tamago, as well as shishito tempura and gyoza appetizers. All of it was very good, especially the tamago. Good atmosphere and the sushi chef at the bar was very friendly. Would recommend.

Sub par. The chicken tacos had no spice or flavoring. Just plain shredded chicken breast, normal lettuce, shredded cheese and tomatoes.

The chimichangas were also disappointing. The chicken was dry and the rice was bland.

The service was also subpart. Two items were left off our order. And THEY WERE OUT OF STEAK, FISH, SHRIMP AND BEANS. Its labor day weekend in St. Pete. Being out of certain items should be expected for a place that's been here for so long. The waitress also failed to tell us this information until after we received our drinks and would therefore have to wait until we were done drinking them and paying for them. 


THE ONLY GOOD THING we had were the nachos. 

Im thoroughly disappointed. I wont be going back there with such lame service and bland food.

My daughter and I were in Ybor exploring and had heard of Snobachi rolled ice cream on the Internet so we stopped in. My daughter got the Oreo concoction and I bought the dragon balls to try. When we first got there it kind of smelled like cigarette smoke for some reason. Looks like they were trying to fix it with a diffuser but I quickly got distracted by the experience of watching the ice cream rolls get made. They even topped the rolls with a toasted marshmallow. Fun! The dragons breath was a fun experience. I wouldn't do it again for $5 but it was definitely something that you should do once. The trick is to keep your mouth closed when chewing them so the nitrogen comes out of your nose. All in all we spent over $14 for a bowl and the dragons breath. A fun afternoon indeed. We'll be back with the rest of the family!

I planned this week in New Orleans to share one of my favorite cities with my partner and wanted to include some of the iconic restaurants and food experiences, since it was his first time visiting. Brennan's was our last restaurant experience before leaving NOLA this past week and it was perfect from beginning to end. Absolutely the best end of vacation/last New Orleans meal experience anyone could have asked for. 

For those not in the know, be sure to allocate at least 2 - 3 hours if you plan to do the full breakfast ... and then don't plan to eat anything else until dinner. 

We were seated in the back dining room by the courtyard window. The service from everyone was professional, efficient, and friendly. No one was rushed, our water glasses were kept full, and the experience was everything that you would expect from an iconic New Orleans restaurant. 

We had:
~ Bloody Mary - Well made: spicy and just the right balance of vodka to mix. Garnished with an olive, a pickled green bean, and a pickled okra. Delicious.
~ Baked apple - Perfectly baked so that it was tender on the outside and still lightly crispy on the inside. The oatmeal topping was crunchy and not too sweet and paired well with the brown sugar glaze. 
~ Irish oatmeal - This was my partner's appetizer and he loved it. The bite I had was also very good. Creamy and slightly al-dente oats with fruit and a variety of nuts mixed in. It was lightly sweet.
~ Eggs Hussarde - A twist on a traditional Benedict with coffee smoked ham, and a rich wine demi-glace with enoki mushrooms. These were fabulous. The eggs were poached perfectly and the smoked ham was rich and slightly chewy the way a good breakfast ham should be. 
~ Duck Andouille - My partner ordered this and it may have been the best thing on the table. The duck andouille was served sliced over a bed of stone ground grits, topped with sauteed cabbage, and then at the table a cup of a rich, clear bacon broth was poured around the base. The grits were tender but not mushy, the broth was the pure essence of bacon, and the cabbage was lightly sauteed and still a rich green when served. The sausage itself was rich and meaty, salty, and the best andouille I've ever tasted. Amazing. 

Now at this point I'd recommend finishing the meal with the bananas foster because it's a classic New Orleans experience. Several of the tables nearby did and we enjoyed the show. However my partner wasn't feeling well as he was recovering from a bad chest cold and so we decided to finish the meal with a couple of Irish coffees instead. They were also excellent; the perfect balance of whiskey and coffee with a lightly sweetened cold cream on top to contrast with the hot coffee. 

There were absolutely no cons to this experience: The food was amazing. The service was fantastic. The restaurant was charming and maintained it's classic New Orleans feel without the old-and-grungy atmosphere of some of the other iconic restaurants in the Quarter. 
 
Of all the places we ate at in New Orleans on this trip, Brennan's was absolutely the high point and the perfect way to end our trip. Well worth  a full 5* rating.

I've been trying to call the business for 30 minutes since they opened and either it's busy or they don't answer the phone!  Hard to order pizza's when they don't answer the phone.  Something for management to keep in mind.  I've called a competitor and they answered the phone and got my order.

Ordered for a group lunch the day of - they answered the phone at 9 o'clock and helped me out tremendously by agreeing to bring 5 large pizza's and wings. 

Delivery driver was right on time, food was hot & delicious.

Ordered the Carnvivore, the Hawaiian, the combo, etc.  First let me say that much pizza feeds way more than the 12 people I had at the meeting.  I think at least 2 were untouched, along with 1/2 the wings.  Not for lack of trying, and better to have too much than not enough.

We will continue to order from Pizza Plus because they take care of our people who are on call 24/7.

A lovely house with traditional decorations and white linens on tables. We had brunch here on a Saturday and sat right next to the door facing the street. There was a nice breeze that floated in every once in a while. 

Our unsweetened teas were refreshing and refilled constantly on this warm spring day. I had the curry chicken with salad, a slice of melon, and a blueberry muffin in the shape of a star. The muffin was warm and moist; the melon fresh and cold; and the curry chicken light and tasty. It was served on a large piece of lettuce that I scraped to get every last morsel. The only thing I wasn't a big fan of was the salad, which had a strange foamy dressing that was just a tad too sweet for me. 

Our waitress was sweet and friendly and had no complaints splitting our checks (five ways, five cards). A wonderful brunch experience overall. Highly recommended for a girls' day out meal!

Love this place. Not to be missed: The doughnuts and I mean, not the low quality doughnuts you get from that doughnut chain. No my friends, I mean the real French doughnuts. I should know, I was born and raised in that country.

Great service, great food, classy yet casual place.

My boyfriend and I spent the weekend in Santa Barbara for Memorial Day. We stayed walking distance to the funk zone and were excited to try a few wineries we hadn't been to in the past. Santa Barbara Winery was our first stop and was by far our favorite. They have an array of cute items to purchase in the shop as well as their wines. We each did a tasting and got to keep our glasses. I loved the white tasting but my favorite was a Chardonnay that Chad recommended that wasn't on that menu. 

We enjoyed sitting in the back barrel room as well as outside on the patio. We went to a couple other wineries over the course of the weekend but found ourselves back at Santa Barbara winery again. Chad and Mar were both so helpful, knowledgeable and genuinely enjoyable to talk to. We'll definitely be back next time we're in town!

As mentioned in other reviews the name of this place has changed, but I loved it as Pier One and I love it as Atiya Ola's. They're classic breakfast is as good as it gets in Philly and although the service is slow; (I've only ever gone when I've got plenty of time to sit outside and enjoy their atmosphere.) I truly enjoy everyone that works there and their offerings of raw foods is something I'm always willing to try!


Sorry to be moving as I will likely not visit again for a long time.

Nice, historic landmark hotel. Not hard to miss when driving up! Called ahead to request a fridge and a king room - fridge yes, king no. But with some persistence the front desk attendant Katey worked some magic and got us into a king room (pays to travel Thurs - Tues!). Room is nice - older but remodeled with nice bathroom fixtures, windows and super comfy king bed. NO problem getting pool chairs at 10am. Starts filling up about noon. Got some at 2pm the 2nd day (ppl had left). Live music at the pool, nice bar, servers with food and drink service. There are kids and there is splashing (adults too), but there are 2 pools (one a bit smaller) so you can work around the kids/adults if they bother you. Pool chairs are free, beach chairs are not. However there is a Walgreens nearby if you NEED a chair and don't want to spend lots of $$$ renting one. Or just grab a few extra towels and plop down in the sand.

I checked out Terrene because a friend of mine gave me a $50 gift certificate to the place. Let me start by saying that this place was good, it was just too expensive for my normal price range.

I took the opportunity to turn the gift into a date. We began by ordering the cheapest Chardonnay on the menu...not bad. I believe it was under $20, but there went almost half of my free meal. I guess I really shouldn't complain about the price of a bottle of wine if it's less than $20. 

I ordered a steak, which was perfectly done medium-well. It came with a delicious potato and an assortment of veggies. The house sauce on the steak was better than I hoped. 

Since I'm not really in the business of high-rolling and eating at places like this, I may not be the best critique of this type of food. But I guess my opinion is as good as any other food snob's.

One of the better Palm Restaurants out there, of course none of them are better than 837 Second Avenue, but that aside, this location was terrific. 

I was in Philadelphia last week and we went here for dinner. It had a cozy bar area that was not too overcrowded. The bartender was so nice and chatted us up about where we were from and the differences between the original Palms and their nationwide counterparts. 

He bought us a round of drinks and as soon as we were ready, we were seated at a table. We requested a booth, and the hostess was happy to accommodate our party of two. When we sat down it was relatively empty, but filled up fast. Everything we ate was, of course, prepared perfectly and the staff made us feel right at home. 

Definitely one of the better Palms out there.
I had heard by word of mouth and read reviews that these were the best bagels in South Jersey....Well they might be, but you don't carry Onion Bagels or Garlic Bagels on a weekend????   A shame....

Been in town for a couple weeks but just found out about this bar tonight on my last night, better late than never. Awesome place with a great selection of beer! Menu is huge with plenty of options for anyone. The bartender Miriam was very personable and easy to chat with. Will definitely come back the next time I am in town.

The people at the New Port Richey store are awesome.  
Every question we had was answered.  Thank you Terry and staff for a
stress free experience.   We love you guys
mary
This place is always busy but you still get quick service and good food. Definitely a popular place!

Service was great. The service as just as good and if not better than going to a large chain such as Benihana. You are getting better bang for your buck here! I was blown away by cooking style and showmanship of the chef. Also ordered a plate of sushi and was amazed. Sushi is fresh and very tasteful! Defiantly visiting again and will be bringing friends with me!

Best chicken sandwich ever. Popeye's who?! The honey chicken sandwich with a fried egg is my go to and it never fails. The chicken is always hot and crispy, the caramelized honey is a delicious touch and the fried egg seals the deal. They have a bunch of different variations but I have yet to try anything else bc the honey chicken is THAT good. Do yourself a favor and try it out

Sunday night dinner is more reluxing and less crowded than Saturday nights.   They do not take reservations unless you go with a large party of people.   I think it may be 6 people or more.  So for a party of three we did not have to wait for a table when we arrived at 6:00 pm for dinner on Sunday.   The waitress was pleasant but did not offer too much advice in terms of food.   When I asked about their special, which was pork, the best advice she could give me was that many people ordered it.  My friend had the salmon.   She liked it.  They do make an effort to substitute the side dishes.  Instead of mashed potatoes. I ordered asparagus and my friend had the rice.    The one good think about their food is that it is consistent.

I do not eat beef. Therefore, five guys made me sad :(

not many options unless you get grilled cheese AND get lots of toppings AND put fries in your sandwich.  THEN maybe you got something substantial there.  I like their fries.  But otherwise, I get sad seeing no other options besides so much cow :(

They do have a mean kosher..hot dog?  hamburger?  i forgot what my kosher friend got?

Good food, slow service. Bar tender was great when we arrived and got drinks right away, but ordered food and after 30 minutes waiting had to ask and they hadn't even started it yet. Food was good once we got it though, so may be just an off night for them.

I agree with the reviewer who gae them 1 star.  VERY OPPORTUNISTIC!!!   Their work was fine but they knew I was in a fix a charged me $1,600 for replacing a pump.  By the time it was too late I found that I could gotten it done easily for less than $1,000.  The gave me a quote on replacing a valve for $760.  It wasn't urgent and I had no trouble finding someone to do a totally professional job for $350.  If at all possible get a second quote.  Nice guys but they shaft you good if you give them a chance.

Delicious! Best steak I have ever had (literally) in my life and I have dined around the country at what would be considered the "finest" establishments (courtesy of my clients thankfully as I am not in a position to casually done at a $300 a night dinner haha). 

My wife and I have visited Urban Grub 3 times since moving to Nashville a year ago and will be going (again) for our anniversary dinner at the end of this month. This is our 3rd consecutive anniversary dinner at this restaurant and we will continue this tradition for as long as we live in Music City.

Maybe not the most beautiful presentation, but definitely the most amazing toasted ravioli.  A very guilty pleasure.  The sauce was so good and the half inch layer of finely grated Romano cheese on top was decadently good.  Kitschy but warm home style atmosphere and at ease by attentive service with smiling eyes (not just mouth) make it one of a kind. The setting and space evoked past times perfectly.  Will definitely be back to try the pizza.
If you need fuller brows, try microblading!  Sabrina is a complete gem. She knows exactly what she is doing and explains every step. You will not be disappointed.

This appears to be a family-owned restaurant. The food here is extremely good. They seem to make everything from scratch including the tortillas which are amazing. We had enchiladas and soup as well as a plate of three tacos they were all exceptional. I would highly recommend this restaurant anyone in the local area or anyone that may be traveling by on 10.

Stopped in here to have an afternoon drink while shopping on 4th ave. They had Buffy playing on the TV so they won my wife's heart off the bat. Server was amazing...great time here with drinks poured well and nice cold local brews. 

Coming back to check out Burlesque nights next month, sounds like a great time. See you next time.

The only way I can think to describe our recent visit to Iron Barley is that we died and went to hole in the wall heaven. From the over the top eclectic atmosphere to the unique and surprising food offerings, it's truly a rewarding dining experience.

  The menu at Iron Barley is small, but that's ok. They always have several specials going, everything from appetizers to main dishes. We started our meal off with the sausage sampler, which was three different varieties of homemade sausage served in a spicy, smokey- sweet BBQ sauce with bread on the side. All were delicious, particularly the jalapeno sausage patties. The Captain was so hungry he used the bread to mop up the remaining BBQ, which was almost as good as my mom's version, and her sauce rocks!

  Captain ordered the Oak Roasted Pork served with toasted barley and vegatables. Be forewarned, this pork chop is HUGE and I was surprised that he managed to eat the whole thing. Since I don't dig on swine (except for bacon, duh!)  I didn't give it a taste, but I could tell based on his numerous "yums" that it was delicious. The only way he could think to describe the taste was to compare it to "eating a campfire". The pork was perfectly smoked and it smelled fantastic. The toasted barely is pretty darn good too. It's served in a savory tomato sauce with spices and herbs. It's not something you see on a menu often and is my recommendation for a side if you've never had it before. 
  
I ordered the Ballistic Elvis which is one of Iron Barley's best known sammiches, and lets just say it's not for everyone. I personally think it should be called "The Pregnant Woman's Ultimate Feast", as the toppings are ridiculous yes curiously appealing. They start off with hot Texas toast and top it with peanut butter, strawberry jam, bananas, cheese and bacon. The bacon is optional, but you may as well throw it on there anyways, what have you got to lose? To make it complete, a dill pickle on the side. YUM-O?!?

  When my sammich arrived, I felt like kicking my own ass. What the hell did I just order?? It looked like death on a plate and I felt my stomach roll over. I was actually sweating a bit when I went to take my first bite, but praise Jebus that I took that bite 'cause this sandwich is AWESOME. I can't even begin to describe how wonderful the flavor combination is. I was literally doing the chair dance of joy over how tasty it was. It got even better about half-way through when I started to get this weird feeling of heat in the back of my throat. Come to find out, they also add crushed red pepper to it! Seriously, I don't know if the inventor of this concoction was a genius or a stoner or what, but it was pure bizarre goodness. You just have to try it to get it.

  The sammich is normally served with chips, but I decided to order a healthier side ( LOL) and got one of the specials, a barley risotto with sun-dried tomatoes. It was delectable. The barley was cooked perfectly and had a nice sweetness to it, and it was loaded with slices of  the tomato. It needs to be put on the menu as a regular side. I would do very bad things to get a hold of this recipe. If you are lucky enough to try it, please do so. You won't be sorry.

  To top it all off, Captain ordered a slice of Peanut Butter Blaster Pie. Now, the pie is ok. It's served frozen and tastes good, but what you really want it the Habenero Strawberry sauce and the jalapeno whipped cream that is served with it.  Yep, jalapeno whipped cream. They mince up jalapenos and mix it in, and it's really, really good. It's a flavor combination that sounds weird but is very satisfying. Once again, just TRUST me. It's really, really yummy.

  In addition to the concoctions above, they have more traditional sandwiches and main entrees. They are also known for their Double Dogs, which are hot dogs served up weird like the Monte Cristo. Also available are soups, salads and chili. The have a full bar and if you feel like trying a different beer than the old standby, they have a nice selection to choose from. Lunch specials are also available.

  Service is exceptional. Everyone was great, and if you have a question about the menu they have the answers. The atmosphere is very entertaining as the decor is hard to miss. Literally, I have a fake mounted deer head wearing Mardi Gras beads right next to me! They have live music on the weekends so it can get loud. They are always busy in the evenings, so don't be surprised is the place is packed and you have to wait. They do offer seating on the main floor, but my recommendation is to eat in the basement level, which is darker, more eclectic and has a really cool bartender. Prices are reasonable for sammiches and dogs, but it can get pricier if you order the main entrees or specials.

My only regret? It was too dark in that dang basement to take pictures! So, you are just going to have to take our word for it and go experience it for yourself. It's definitely a fun time...trust me :)

The only reason I went to this one was it is the very 1st ever Hooters.

Pretty substandard visit.  Service was good and the pie was awesome!

The cheese enchilada plate here is to die for!!! 
The portion is generous, hot and oh sooo cheesy good. The rice is tasty, fluffy and moist. The beans are amazing. The margaritas are perfect. The ambiance is festive and the service is totally welcoming. Friendly faces floating around with impeccable service. Definitely not The Dutch!

I know nothing really about beer but it appears this is a great place to go for it.  The space is pretty cool, nice and open, lots of places to sit, nice outdoor patio area, plenty of screens to watch sports (Mizzou game on when I was there), a lounge sitting area and live music after the game was over.  I'd say a great place to meet up.  More a 20,30 something crowd and right across the street from Llywelyn's.  Staff was very friendly and on the ball.  Check it out!
If you like to have some microwave hot dog, this is the place. But if you want good foods, go some place else

Great service and awesome food!! Their breakfast was great. I was shocked at how busy it was, they had a line up going out the door. Made me realize how amazing the place really was. 

It is a family run business and again I love that. They actually care about their customers satisfaction. I wish there were more places like this in Edmonton.
I've actually never eaten here but bar is great.  Service friendly and attentive.  Quick and personable nice place to unwind.

I had so much fun at Painting with a Twist in Haddonfield! I attended with a bachelorette party and had a blast! The teachers were great and easy to follow. The studio was roomy and had a great atmosphere. It's BYOB and you can also bring snacks. I will be back for sure! It was such a fun experience!

These guys are so nice.
I called on Friday and made an appointment for Monday (today), dropped off my car and I was driving it back home before 5.
They made sure to call and tell me the price before they did the work which was just a great thing.
I would recommend them to anyone.
I will be back, hopefully not too soon though 
Thanks Gary and Mike

I ordered a set of sashimi labeled the "Chef's Choice" and it was not up-to-par for an upscale sushi restaurant. The fish is certainly not sashimi grade and like the other reviews about the taste, it was cold, bland and had a freezer burn texture. The chef didn't cut the fish to the right dimensions either, it looked like somebody took a slab of fish and chopped it up on a block. Particularly with the yellowtail, you can tell the knifework was godawful as some bits of the fish got sheared off. Good sashimi comes from good knifework and careful cutting. Either the chef preparing the fish was lazy or did not have that passion.  

I had a couple pieces of the sashimi and was so disgusted by the taste I ended up not finishing 5 pieces, what a waste of money... I ended up ordering room service dessert from my hotel to wash out that taste.  

Like all great restaurants, you have to have the basics right. If you can't even get the fish right, then you don't deserve to be called a japanese sushi restaurant. 

A bit of business advice to the owners, don't feel obligated to sell sashimi because you're labeled a sushi restaurant, especially if you lack the expertise or discipline to prepare the product. If you're going to sell half-ass sashimi, don't bother selling it at all. I would even go as far stop selling raw fish in general if you're skimping on quality and preparation. People who know what they're eating WILL call you out.

I've gone here 3x (and to the original location 2x) for hot donuts and they're perfect every time. Employees are always friendly. Cinnamon might be the best, strawberry-lavender second best, cookies and cream third, but they're all delicious.

All of the sandwiches are amazing, the croquetas are so good you might fight your own mother over the last one, and the beer selection is decent. Go when it isnt packed or your service will be mediocre, and try to sit outside otherwise no matter what you do the bathroom will be too close for comfort.

I will gladly add on to this one. Ray, at point needs to get out of denial. Everyone in the valley knows he's a complete jerk. Most people reviewing this are here to make known that he is a jerk. This guy and his family honestly need to wake up. At any moment someone could pull the owners of all the rentals they manage and send them screens shots and print outs of all the terrible reviews this guy and his company have in the valley. I think a lot of owners are misinformed because he will smile in there face and say whatever he needs to.

We've been here several times. If you are looking for "Tex-mex," this is not your place.  It's really good Mexican cuisine, and very good.  It's not 5 stars because you drop a bit of money.  So we don't go often.  But we like it and I recommend it.

Good spot for a quick bagel & coffee.  To be fair, I should have planned breakfast better.  Had peanut butter with my bagel & it was their own sweet/lightish concoction.  Tasty but messy.  A local favorite, I hear.

Had my transmission lines break while I was driving. And I was close to Dave Sinclair Ford. I pulled in, I left my vehicle. Picked it up a few days later. they were very nice and gave me a ride home.
Brought it home and  park in the driveway . Then backing out I noticed oil on my driveway. 
They did not clean the oil off my truck so it just continue to drip........
You pay for premium price you expect premium service.
Next I noticed my RITC 30 ounce mug was missing. 
Along with a dark pair of fishing glasses with readers on them. 
Usually I go to the Lincoln store because there's a conflict with the Ford store.
There's an employee there that should've been fired A few years ago, but the good old boys club sweet things underneath the rug. 
I wish Dave would've found out about that !

I cannot say that this place is bad, but I can say that the food lacks a lot of flavor. I came here with a party of five and we tried the gnocchi, chicken amalfitana, cavatelli ai sapori marini, cheese ravioli, the veal special and the fish special. Nothing was bad, but nothing was really impressive or worth coming back to try again. It is certainly not the worst restaurant I have been to as the service was good, the place was nicely decorated and food came out promptly, but if the food is just meh, I really cannot recommend this place. 

The one dish that we had that I think they really need to work on is the gnocchi. They were leaden balls of dough and a chore to eat more than a couple. 

I did like the fact that this was a BYOB and their bread was good, but the food really needs a lot of work.
Always my fave burger place on the west coast. Try to get here everytime I'm west. Good stuff

yesss sirrr -- the best place to stay in Santa Barbara period!  If you've stayed at Four Seasons in Charlestown, Nevis or Four Season Maui, Hawaii or W hotel, San Francisco or St. Francis, San Francisco or Venetian, Las Vegas this place dominates it. 

a mini fridge, cable tv, mirrors in every wall of the room (including the bathroom), and complimentary wireless internet -- enough said.  lock it up!

They haven't let me down in the past.  Today, they did, but just a little bit.  

The Godmother sandwich is breaded chicken cutlet, provolone, and broccoli rabe on a seeded hoagie roll.  Taste wasn't the problem.  I liked the sandwich.  The amount of chicken on the roll was the issue.  Two small pieces on a big hoagie roll?  Really?  You can't skimp on sandwiches like these, not when competition is right down the street.  

Let's just say they're not Primo.

From the moment you walk in..you can truly smell the freshness..from the fresh Bread.. Freshly sliced ham..turkey To the toppings all the shakers..friendly staff..clean tables and floor..to their always stocked refreshment fridge...and convenient location this is my stop on my lunch break for a nice delish sandwich..but if you in a hurry..don't come during lunch time around 12-130...place is packed..line out the door(or by the door)
Favorite meat market in Tampa!! Always clean, good prices & staff are welcoming & helpful.

Don't go there!  The salesman Perry is a rude self serving individual who did not care much as long as you buy from him.  I had just as bad experience as dealing with a Ford used car salesman.  Since I did not buy my RV from him I would not buy my next ones from him either.  Guess no cigars from me.  The parts department was nice and friendly though.

I went here on accident but thought I would give it a try after seeing the menu I changed my mind because there wasn't many options waited for about 10 minutes after receiving our drinks so we could tell the waiter we were leaving he didn't come back so we went up to tell the main area we were leaving and wanted to pay for our drinks we ordered 1 lemonade and 1 strawberry lemonade just lemonades no alcohol and our bill was 9$ and some change I would understand paying that much if they had big cups but the cups that u drink from are small if we woulda poured both drinks into a water bottle it wouldn't even be have full I had never used this app before but after going their I felt a need to download it.

This is great Mexican food!  Not the usual plate full of beans, rice and shredded lettuce and a little something else.  The mole sauce is the best I have tasted since my last trip to Mexico.  Definitely worth a trip.  Try for a Sunday to avoid the crowds, the service was just right on Sunday.

when planning my trip to New Orleans with my mom this one of the first places I knew we had to go to. I did at one point almost say ehhh maybe not but then I came to my senses. I'm happy I did because this was absolutely amazing. it's not even just food it's like an experience. I cannot wait to come back one day and bring my husband here just because I cannot believe he didn't get to share this experience with me. now I've been to places with a menu on an Ipad which btw I think is awesome. but a place with a purse chair just omg. this place was made for a girl like me who hates putting her purse on the floor! 

besides loving this place, the crab beignets I really wonder where they have been all my life. they were like heaven in your mouth. I can't even describe the deliciousness that they were. they were my all time favorite meal of this trip. the gift box at the end is also a very cute treat and I think so unique and just omg I loved it. I can't imagine anyone not liking this place. I need to find a place like this in NYC. just what a great place. highly recommend anyone to come here. I wish I remembered to take photos here with my mom. I loved the decor inside also.

I'm so glad we got to squeeze in a reservation for a Saturday lunch on our last day visiting New Orleans. If you sign up on Resy, they can notify you when a table becomes available. Our initial res was for 11pm (yes at night-that's all we could get) and we were able to change it to 2pm after we got an email notification from Resy..sweet! Looking back on our wonderful meal, I'd say even the 11pm would've been worth it. The place is beautiful. Bright and open. It has a comfy, casual yet elegant charm. We were greeted warmly and directed to the bar while we waited for our table (as we were about 30 minutes early.) From the bar, we saw Chef Alon Shaya working the wood fired brick oven making the Pitas fresh. It was cool to see him doing his thing and putting so much heart into it. He even came by to one of the tables and signed a book. Once seated, our servers greeted us and offered more drinks. We were given hot, yummy pita to devour as we reviewed the menu. We opted for the crab hummus (that came with a round of fresh hot pita), Fried Oyster schnitzel (think dressed Po boy but with a pita and BETTER), pickled carrot salad and lamb kebob. Everything was amazing and more than enough for two to share. There were many layers of flavors that complemented each other. The hummus was creamy and the crab just melted in my mouth. The Oyster schnitzel was perfectly crispy and not greasy...wonderful. I'm a fan of relish and sweet pickles so the carrot salad was a perfect compliment to the schnitzel. The carrots had a nice crisp to it, tangy, sweet, bright, fresh with an added crunch from the lentils. The lamb kebob was also delicious. It was moist, flavorful. Although our choices were considered small plates, we were stuffed and ate everything. Service was excellent. They were attentive, quick to fill our cups but at the same time gave us the space to enjoy our meal. We never felt rushed. It was our favorite meal experience during our whole trip hands down! It's not "traditional" New Orleans food but it's definitely a place I'd return to over and over again.

I have been eating at this joint since 1982. I watched their kids grow up. Not much has changed. The serve New York style pizza a other Italian classics. My favorites include the meatball sub, lasagna, baked spaghetti and the pizza. I treated like family. Stop by and see for yourself. It is conveniently located on the corner of Florida Ave and Brass. Bonus a petite.

I've heard a lot about this place and finally gave it a chance today. I had "The Chooch," which has roast pork, sharp provolone, and roasted peppers, and it was delicious. I'm looking forward to going back to try other sandwiches. Note: hoagies come in small, medium, and large. I found the small to be perfect/more than enough for one person; a medium is good for sharing with someone.
From the outside you would say the place is ok. But the inside is pretty nice. But most importantly the bagels are amazing big portions and prices are reasonable.

RUN, don't walk, to get a massage here. I discovered it by chance, and boy am I glad I did. You cannot beat the $35 Reflexology massage for ONE HOUR, starting with a 20-min foot massage and then back on table. I highly recommend this and will be going back!!! Do yourself a favor and check it out, especially if going to/from the airport down Campbell M-Sat 10 am to 8:30 pm and Sunday 11 am to 7 pm.

I visited this office for the first time a week ago. I was very disappointed with their services, for two reasons. 

First, I came in for a routine eye exam, which took 2 HOURS. I arrived on time at 2pm, and did not leave their office until 4pm. For a routine eye exam, I find this to be an awful lot of time. An eye care office should let their patients know if they're running behind and keep them updated when waiting to see the doctor. I was not notified nor kept informed of the status of the doctor during my wait time. 

Second, one of the gentleman in the glasses division rolled his eyes when I asked for my pupillary distance measurement. Yes, I was planning to order glasses online, and after their poor service and disrespect, I will definitely be ordering my glasses online. This behavior was inappropriate. 

I hope they can improve their services soon. Until then, I will not be returning to this office.
Slow service, but maybe it was because they were perfecting my yummy custom blizzard!! Mmmm mmmmm!!!

Just ate here with 2 kids and my husband. Housed in a gorgeous old home on a golf course. Really beautiful interior. Lunch menu was excellent and reasonably priced. We loved the soft pretzels and crab cake sandwich. Good kids menu as well. Highly recommend!

Overall, this is a standard BBQ chain... nothing special and nothing horrible.  Bandanas is, however, significantly overpriced for the quality of a chain restaurant. 

This particular location is fairly busy, but decent service. 

For the food, highly recommend the potato salad and sweet potato fries. The garlic bread that comes with every meal...is terrible.

Santucci's is a no brainer when I want pizza these days. Whether you're going into this family owned and loved establishment or ordering in at your home with Netflix, prime or whatever you're watching tonight! The traditional pizza with the sauce on top of the cheese has changed the way I want pizza. It's hard for me to justify ordering pizza from anywhere else! The veggie works is also an awesome choice if you're looking for more than just cheese and sauce. As for me, I'm willing to drown in that traditional pie willingly any day! Bonus! This place is BYOB so come ready! The fries and salads are also a great side addition to these fanatic pies as well!!

The restaurant opened on August 21, 2017 and this was their first weekend. We experienced no "new opening hiccups" that you might expect to encounter on an opening weekend. 

Menu is the same as the Phoenixville location. Food was excellent and we didn't have to wait very long. Salad that accompanied the quiche was very fresh. I preferred my home fries over the home fries a family member had. Theirs were seasoned with a seasoning I didn't like while mine were simple with just a little bit of salt and pepper. 

It's not very big. There are several stools at a counter that are at the kitchen/cooking area, 4-5 tables for two along the wall, and two tables for four in the front. Although small I didn't feel cramped. 

My biggest complaint is the other patrons standing and waiting for a table. It's crowded...deal with it. Standing and complaining about the wait isn't going to get you a table any faster. If anything your complaining is going to make me eat slower. If you don't want to wait then leave and go somewhere else!

Really cool vibe in here! Neat art, cool music, really nice and attentive staff. Sweet relief from the summer heat in a delightfully air conditioned space, with vegan friendly ice cream! I had a large (not sure if it was called large or two scoops) of vegan coconut ice cream and it was awesome! A super generous portion and a great deal for the price. I would definitely go back. This would be a great space to bring a group on the larger side, and also a great first date spot! The server brought out our cups of ice cream within like two minutes, and it was virtually empty when we went in around 3:30. Perfect afternoon delight spot with a twist of punk flavor.

Way over-priced and over-hyped. I expected a semi-decent restaurant. This place was awful. They wanted $26.99 for a pound of crab legs. We got less than a pound, that's for sure. The "Juicy Crab" sauce was almost pure garlic. Normally, for an Italian gal like me, that wouldn't be a problem, but this time it overpowered any other seasoning.
The whitefish was delicious but pretty greasy. Chips were delicious. Soft drink prices were outrageous. All in all, I would skip this place. It has Long John Silver quality and atmosphere at Red Lobster prices.
Theater is really clean, friendly staff. The reason for 3* is I got a pretzel at $4 and it was a the worst pretzel I've ever eaten and I like the boxed frozen ones you need nuke at home.

I took my nice watch in for a new battery. After putting in a new battery, it was discovered that was not the problem. It needed to be repaired. They were very friendly and I was comfortable leaving my nice watch with them for the repair. They called with an estimate and it was ready on the day as promised. I would definitely recommend this jeweler for repairs and beautiful jewelry

This was my first visit to this restaurant. It was recommended by the locals. There is no social distancing. The waitress was not very well trained. She reached over my food, almost putting her arm in my food, in attempt to get a plate.  The egg plate was bland and there was no seasoning. 
Apparently this is a hot spot in the area. Will not be a option next time I visit.

Take your Dyson in!  There was a free health check promotion going on, so get on their email  list to take advantage!  My vacuum stopped cleaning and it turned out there was a clogged filter I never knew that it had!  I was in and out in 20 mins.  They didn't pressure me to buy anything, but I replaced a $20 filter since mine was 10 years old.  Great customer experience!  Thank you, Dyson!  They also said I'd get about a $100 credit to exchange for a new one and they recycle old ones too.

Found this place while in town for business. Wanted to try a fancier place downtown, but not on Saturday night. The pix are not current.  It's more wide open now after an obvious remodel.  Atmosphere was good for the most part.  Nice server.  Decent selection.  Higher prices than back home.  Opted for something totally random and was not disappointed.  I'd go back, but can tell it's mostly a locals place b/c they were hoarding the comfy chairs.

Talk about warm and inviting! The people at Epi's are phenomenal- the friendliest we've met since moving from Texas last year. Food is amazing. Simple dishes with a ton of flavor. I love the small, intimate atmosphere. Cozy enough for a romantic date night, but not overly formal, so it's pleasant to take your family along! Kris and Angela are lovely women, and they truly treat their customers as family. Can't wait to go back!

Coming here for 10+ years and it's amazing. Highly recommend it to locals or anyone visiting. Very friendly, amazing food, and great prices. Manager remembers regulars and we always get a card for a free appetizer of cheese bread.
Some of the best homemade pasta. Everything is locally sourced and the sauces were so rich and creamy. No need to dress up, just sit relax and enjoy the wonderful service.

While it said I had two check-ins here, I can only recall just the most recent time. I don't do a lot of business or hanging out on this side of town. It's a little far from where I live.

But I can say the one time I was here, the lady was super helpful. It was right about 1230 and I hadn't had lunch yet. I asked her what her most filling juice was, and she recommended the green something. (I suck with names). It was all delicious, until the ginger taste kicked in. The lady made the drink well, so it wasn't overpowering, I just don't like the taste of ginger. Next time I may order it without the ginger.

The location wasn't very busy for a Friday midday. It was nice to be served within a reasonable time frame with a delicious drink. 

I don't know how often I'll go back to any Keva Juice location, but I'm not opposed to the idea based on this good experience.

Here is a copy of the letter that I sent them. I guess that says it all. Don't go to this place. 

Dear Dr. Feeney:
I would like to inform you of the reasons I will not return to Mid-County Dental. 
1. Even though you were open for a month, no one ever called me and informed me or offered to make a new appointment for me, no consideration for the fact that I had a previous appointment before the closing
2. I was repeatedly told that I could only get cleanings paid by my insurance once every six months. I even received a bill for cleaning in the mail. This after I had, on multiple occasions, informed your staff that my insurance was different and would pay for two cleanings a year no matter when I got the cleanings. I had dental through Optimum. Obviously, no one bothered to put it in my records, or no one bothered to check

We wanted Mexican food and we got it! It can get a bit pricey but you get what you pay for. We ordered Guac with our chips (8 bucks!) but the plate was huge! I had some carne asada tacos and they were delicious. I will definitely come back here. The staff is friendly and we got some really good margaritas!
Best eggs benedict in town! The stuffed french toast is also delicious.

This place really puts a smile on everyone's face. I am in the service industry and on my first visit here they made it very clear.....they actually enjoy thier job.  It is so rare and wonderful to watch. I'm determined to try the entire menu. I have tried the pad thai, thai basil, short rib special, spicy drunken noodles, crispy duck, and pot stickers. They have all been so good.....I can't even choose a favorite.

This has been my favorite pizzeria for a while up until now. The delivery driver was very rude. He was saying how he was in front of my building but when I went down I didn't not see him. I tried to explain that I did come down and that I didn't not see him and that I was sorry but he just walked off. If that delivery driver is there still I probably will not be ordering from there again.

When pure passion and wonderful people come together you get a place called The Merchant! I cannot say enough about the food, the incredible coffee and the people. We were in town for a few days from Denver and luckily our hotel was directly across the street. I only wish we had found it sooner. I tried a latte and the chai with the lemon curd crepes and the egg, ham and cheese sandwich on a croissant. My son had the Nutella and banana crepes and they were also outstanding! The woman that (I assume) owns this gem knew ever persons name that came in for their morning coffee and even remembered us! 
This place is so good, I would argue that you need to buy your plane tickets now and before visiting the French Quarter or any other spot in this town, go to The Merchant!!!

Went here for lunch after spending the morning going from bank to bank trying to secure finances.

I was greeted with a very nice hostess and was then passed off to another that insisted we had to have an application for their rewards program. Please don't push that stuff on me if I don't want it.

My server was very nice and attentive. I ordered a Jeremiah Red Beer and it was a bit of a darker beer but very smooth with no bitter after taste.

My meal consisted of the New Orleans Jambalaya. I honestly cannot make a true comparison with a Jambalaya from New Orleans, but this dish had a good taste, with plenty of shrimp and meats and had a nice spice to it that made it just hot enough for my tastes. The meal was plentiful and I left feeling satisfied.

This restaurant would have received the fourth star if they did not try to force upon me the rewards program.
Place is chill. Staff was very friendly and even dealt with rude customers very well.  Food was delicious and would definitely go back!

If you like your coffee to be fruity, definitely try their pour over coffee.
I like my coffee earthy so it wasn't really great experience. However, I'm so glad they're open during COVID19 with patio seating so I can at least try the popular zipzinger

We could not get into the Bluebird Cafe...Happily we enjoyed this place. We went to a songwriter night mid-week. So did not expect to see STARS.  Getting in was smooth with prior paid. Show started on time. We saw American Idol performer Craig Lloyd Boyd...great voice and top entertainer. About four other songwriter/artists. Can't remember the food... but that it was better then we expected! We were there for the music.  We were staying downtown so this was a walk away.

It is by far the worst service ever. Purchased a Groupon and decided to drive several extra miles to get my remote started and installed there. The guy and the girl who introduced themselves as the owner. They were super rude, harassing and intimidating. Zero customer service. They didn't honor the Groupon and charged another $200 on the top of what the Groupon said. I was forced to live from the abusive language and harassment I was faced by the guy "co-owner". Never ever would go there again.

Loved the food! We ordered the vegetarian combo plate as an appetizer with extra grape leaves (dolmes). The dolmes, babaghanoush and tabbouleh were excellent! Great hummus, falafel and homemade pita. Also loved the Spinach Pastry and the Kibbeh (fried ground lamb filled dumplings)...amazingly delicious! Also had the beef shawarma sandwich! Yum!!!...had to take half of it home. The restaurant is small but has a nice quiet atmosphere with beautiful lamp fixtures and decor. The staff were very cordial and attentive and wore masks the whole time. There was plenty of space for social distancing. The Rose Tea was really nice to have at the end of the meal...really helps digestion!

I have been here a few times, and this place has never failed to impress me.  The service is good, the atmosphere is great, the drinks are delicious and the good is top-notch.

I've had different noodle dishes, most recently the pad thai.  I've also had the lettuce wraps as an appetizer, which are good.

For whatever reason, this Wendy's location has REALLY slid downwards regarding the quality of the food, service and speed of food delivery.    I used to frequent this location when I would have fast food (which isn't often), as the food was always hot and the staff was friendly.   Whether dining in or going through the drive-thru, I was satisfied.

Yesterday I ordered a Baconator meal at the drive-thru.  The lady taking the order was nice enough, but she sure didn't want to be bothered when I drove forward to pick up my food.   She didn't say anything.  Nothing.   Not "thank you", "kiss my butt", "have a good day" or anything.   The sandwich tasted old like it had been sitting around under a warmer for awhile.  Most of the fries were soggy and hadn't been cooked long enough.   (By the way, Wendy's why did you ever change your fries?   They used to be GREAT and now are sub par).   

Listen up Wendy's on Parkside Drive - GET SOME NEW MANAGEMENT.  I've been there once a month for the last 6 months and the people there are not friendly, slow and come across as apathetic or lazy.

First, the cashier was not very nice. We ordered 4 cookies, by chance I saw an ad that said buy 4, get 2 free. I had to ask for it though, she wasn't trying to sell anything. The cookies tasted like I could have bought them at the store. We ordered ice cream and she forgot to give it to us. Also my 3-year-old daughter had to use the restroom that was visible to all customers and she told us we could not use the restroom. After I said she is about to go on the floor she made us go next door. Luckily the lady next door was very nice. Overall, very disappointing and we will not be returning.
It gets better and better with each visit. Amore has been tweaking all aspects of their business. Review changed to 5 stars.

Sorry to say that this isn't my favorite place.  Part of it is due to the location and the people in the neighborhood (not the fault of DD) and part is due to their poor selection of non-coffee drinks. 

The employees are nice (though turnover seems high) and it's a good enough place to wait in while before the bus shows up.

I am from California, and I was here training for a new job and stumbled across the best Burger King in America! (At least the best so far) I wouldn't write this review if it were a one time thing. These people are over the top friendly, helpful, and quick. I've never seen such quality and passion in the fast food industry! Keep up the good work!

So happy that we have a Jewish deli in town, and a BOMB one at that.  Bagel sandwiches are always a solid choice, I love the vegetarian sandwhich as well.  The've got an amazing beer selection as well.  The staff are a bunch of dicks, but in a good way.
Airport is ok and has plenty to eat and easy to navigate but the rental car return is ridiculous to get to if you really don't pay attention to 1 turn.

Look.
