I really don't expect that much out of Steak n Shake, especially when it's a couple hours past midnight. But I do expect a basic level of service that I didn't get this night. 

I walk into the restaurant and pick out what I want to eat in half a minute. It's not hard. They have a set menu. I close my menu. And I wait. And I wait. I wait for over five minutes before the cook comes over and tells me that someone is coming to take my order.

Another couple of minutes passes and finally, the woman running the drive-through comes over and tells me that one of the waitresses is coming to take my order and then returns back to taking orders to the drive-through.

It's 2 a.m. in the morning. It's not a busy time. I literally see the TWO waitresses pushing in the chairs to the table. And then they start gossiping to each other. 

Guys, I just want to put in my order to get my stuff to go so I can get out of here. I'm shooting them dirty stares the entire time to try and get their attention. No such luck. I finally walk over and ask them if I can give them my order or not. I'm pretty sure I would have been ignored even longer 

The food. What a disaster. I guess was my fault for not checking the order carefully enough after I got it. When I finally did get home and looked through the food...  I ordered a steakburger with bacon, cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion. What I got was a cheeseburger. How does this happen? How do you forget 4 out of the 5 toppings I wanted? But at least the burger was edible. The fries? Terrible. They were mostly all burnt/overcooked and super hard. I didn't eat half the cup of fries because I was just so tired of the food by this point.

And the thing is, I've been to Steak n Shake many times and the fries are actually one of my favorite things to get at Steak n Shake because they're thin fries and they're tasty. What a disappointment.

Uchi Sushi is our go to for sushi.  I'll tell you why...  Consistent delicious food, friendly attentive service & all dishes are good size portions.  We go (not lately due to Corona) or order just about every week. Johny, his staff & food are the best!

Fantastic tandoori. Garlic naan to die for.my wife is vegan and there were plenty of options for her. I'm new to Indian cuisine and have only tried it a few times but my wife, who eats Indian food regularly, said its the best she's ever had.

This is still my all time favorite Mexican restaurant!  Just wish it was closer to home! Best chips and salsa...the chips are so light and crunchy! 
Several menu items I've never seen offered at any other Mexican restaurants. Very nice decor and atmosphere. Again everything was delicious! ! The only down side to this years visit was our favorite waitress wasn't there.

I just had a magical experience with enrolling in TSA Pre-check at the Reno airport. I pre-enrolled online first, so my info was in the system. However, I couldn't get an appointment for a while (and have had some Global Entry er...issues so just wanted something for holiday travel). So I decided to try my luck at a walk in appointment; people cancel or get sick, right? Well, it was super easy and I don't know how often it's like that but I feel like I won the lottery. I parked in short term parking and went to the TSA office (cubicle) which is by the Delta check in counters (to the left of them). Someone was waiting with an appointment but no one else. The nice TSA man said it was super busy and he had appointments scheduled every 10 minutes, but he'd try to fit me in. Well, he did! He processed the woman waiting and me within 10 minutes and it was a glorious thing!!! I only had to bring my passport and a credit card for the $85 fee (for 5 years). I had even changed my address since pre-enrolling - not a problem. This was around 3 pm on a Tuesday afternoon so maybe that's the sweet spot? Of course, make an appointment if you can but if not - there is hope! Oh - and I paid $1 for parking, I was in and out in under 30 minutes. 
**There is a list of credit cards that include the $85 fee as a member benefit or give a statement credit or let you use points at https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/credit-cards-offer
This place was a gem! Everything from the ambiance, to the staff to the food was incredible! There's a lot of Italian places down here and Pia's is definitely the best!
If you're a guitar lover, nothing marries Nashville and music more in the airport than Gibson Cafe.  Great memorabilia for the intrigued or the collector.

My husband and I love this place!  We frequent it several times a week.  Atmosphere is very cool and comfortable.   They are now serving beer and wine and have outdoor seating on the Monon for the summer!   Definitely a great addition to Carmel. Welcome!
I felt very cared for & very pampered by everyone at LeVisage!  They anticipated my needs... it was lovely!!

One of the best restaurants in Largo. The food here is always really delicious and feels like something cooked by someone who loves cooking and eating. We always have a great experience. This is really comfort food for anyone whether or not you grew up eating Indian. I believe the restaurant is family run and you can really sense they take pride in the business. Do yourself a favor and stop by for the lunch buffet to get an opportunity to try a variety dishes (especially if you're not familiar with Indian cuisine) 10/10 love it

Food is solid at this location, but the timing of carry out orders is not communicated well. We told an order of 3 rolls and an appetizer would be 30 minutes. At 50 minutes there was still no food. The hostesses weren't accommodating or apologetic regarding the delay. There was no explanation nor remedy offered.

I am currently staying here in my room smells like an ashtray. The front desk staff assured me that there was no smoking in this room, but it's undeniable. I came to this hotel to heal after a medical procedure and I regret it now.

One of my favorite destinations in Philadelphia.  The look, feel, and overall ambience are fabulous.  Carol and her staff are always on top of things.  Authentic French bistro with the best location in the city.

Okay it's good and for sure worth a visit. What you're gonna wanna order is the "Jambalaya Risotto" folks you may want to order two dishes! I'd come back here just to re-order it and I 100% will next time I'm in town. They also make a killer andouille sausage dish that's gotta happen again. 

Only reason I didn't go 5 's was the Shrimp & Grits. Folks I'm on the hunt for the absolute best S&G and the S&H they're serving just aren't great IMO. They use a orange juice based sauce and for me the citrus just doesn't play well with the other components. Honestly if it weren't for the other dishes I would have gone 2 stars on the S&G dish but wow those other two plates were amazing so 4 stars it is!

Overall, this place is tops! An awesome addition to the St. Louis scene. The size is huge and provides for plenty of seating options and the ability to be spaced out. *check your local listings for mask requirements, LOL. Newly opened, not all of the Food Boutiques (what I call them) are not functional yet, however there are plenty of Savory and Sweet options along with Ethnic selections. This visit, I went with an Arnold Palmer add Bulleit Bourbon cocktail from the Kitchen Bar and then also the What Would Glen Do sandwich from Sub Division. Cocktail was very tasty, fair amount of Bourbon in the pour and the Arnold Palmer wasn't too sweet or tart. The sandwich is an ample size and definitely packed full of toppings on the bread. Bread is a nice thickness to support the ingredients and doesn't fall apart and I thought the flavor was spot on. The chicken could have been hotter with heat tho. 
Be aware that just because the space is open, doesn't mean that the boutique you wanna visit is open. Some places had already sold out for the day and were closed, some places closed early and some places were closed and reopened at various times. Still a great place to hang out and meet up with friends.

K'Far definitely rates as one of my favorite middle eastern cafe/ bakery. I only got a chance to try out their pastries and cafe menu.

Boureka's: I tasted the potato, and bulgarian feta flavors both were really good a tiny bit on saltier side so i recommend trying this with coffee or beverage on the side. I'm not sure if these are supposed to be tasted cold but would love to try a hot one too!

Chocolate Babka: Again a very good pastry not too sweet and the right amount of pastry and chocolate. 

Macchiato: I'm not a coffee connoisseur but the coffee had some middle eastern and earthy taste to it. 

It's a great addition to the area something different for someone to try if they are bored of the standard american bakery fare at nearby cafes
Great find in New Orleans, service was excellent, food was amazing! Started with a fried oyster sushi roll, braised duck rib, tuna nachos and amazing beef tips.

This is a place for all age children. So do not go with the intention of having a quiet meal - like we were under the impression we were going to have.

Temperature was delightful. Can't remember the last time the temp in a restaurant was actually refreshingly cool.

House salad was one of the best we've ever been served.

Table size was big enough for two people to sit comfortably.

Bread was not good, tasted like Wonder bread.

Bathroom needs updating. Thought I was in a public restroom.

Music was terrible, again old stuff. Have restaurants never heard of the internet? You can play current Italian music directly from it!

Desserts were good.

Wow, where to start. This place is great! The food, the service, the owner walking around and getting acquainted with everyone. And did I mention that it's one of the most affordable Italian restaurants downtown? Their fresh pasta is truly fresh, and the sauces that they use (I had fettucine with white wine sauce and sausage) are very original and delicious. I'm kicking myself for not coming here sooner! Don't make that mistake, and try this when your in the mood for an amazing meal and great service to match. Be sure to bring a bottle of good wine, this place is BYOB.

My girlfriend and I usually get iced coffee from here and it's one of the best in the area. Today we got maybe the worst iced coffees we've had. First off Tania S. Took our order and got down the 2 iced coffees and 2 maple donuts. We pull up to the window and she had 1 iced coffee and 2 donuts. So we corrected her and she made the second rather quickly.   My first drink consisted of unmixed sugar and caramel. I'm never really super crucial about something so small but being in food and beverage and commiting myself to service excellence knowing  it wasn't busy I can't figure out how it's that hard to get a small order correct that you took yourself and rush it then serve it.

Little gem in Midtown! This cozy joint is perfect for summer night patio-sitting and cocktail sipping. Fun drinks and Italian cafe concept are spot on. I had the Spritz and it was light, refreshing and lovely! A gorgeous rose petal garnished my drink and made for not only a great tasting cocktail, but a wonderful smelling one too!Great for date nights or to spend time with friends. Will definitely be back!
The salad was awesome.  The atmosphere was great (TV's all over the place).

Swung by after eating dinner and we got the key lime pie cheesecake and the strawberry cupcake. 

First off, there was way too much frosting and the cake was not moist. It tasted like it had been sitting out for awhile. The key lime was ok as well. It was way too dense. 

We ended up not even eating the entire thing.

We stayed here for a weekend and man did it make or trip better. We got frustrated with traffic then when we arrived we couldn't find the hotel but the Hyatt regency staff explained to us how to get there. Once we got to our room it all got better. Front desk was friendly the room was clean and very nice. I also thought the view was nice. We would recommend staying here an Uber drive to the French quarter is about $15 dollars so not bad at all.

Cool, somewhat hidden location.
The pizzas we tried were pretty darn good!

The Standard. 
Fennel + Sausage.
Marinara D' Italia (Vegan).

Would come back for sure! :)

I went to Reading Terminal during jury duty longing for something pleasurable to offset the boredom I had been experiencing. I checked Yelp on my blackberry and found some reviews for Flying Monkey. Sounded great! I loooooooved cupcakes.

BUT, the are JUST OK.. I got the Black Velvet - chocolate with cream cheese icing. The icing as delish Yum yum yummy. The cake was OK but not all that. I also picked up a lemon raspberry. I was pleasantly surprised that the cake was lemon with raspberry filling... I was quickly disappointed that the cake was dry and not very flavorful and the filling was little more than jelly. 

Sadly, this is NOT the Magnolia Bakery of Philadelphia. I will continue my quest!

Love love love this place. How can you not love a bar that is made of a gorgeous lighted former carousel that slowly moves around the bartender and his cunning libations.... And what libations they are!  Vibe is great. Nice jazz music playing from the lounge area which is quite large. There most likely will be a wait to get a spot at the carousel but the vibe is good so take your time. Maybe go sit at the other bar that is closer to the music... 
 Next time I'm in town I will stay at this hotel and visit this bar again... Loved it that much. Fun fun fun....

One of the best places close by us here on the west side. We enjoy all the house made options, breads, salad dressings, sausages, they even corn their own corned beef. The beers are good as well. Really good spot with good service. The diner style tables really don't fit the overall vibe of the place but otherwise it is an excellent choice.

We went here for a group lunch during the weekday, and we had about 10 people. The inside is huge! Very large place with outside seating that you can also use if interested. The theme is sports-bar like with lots of TVs playing various games. The menu is pretty large and I had a hard time deciding what to get. I ended up with the burrito with the queso on top and it did not disappoint. It was a lot of food for lunch, I was stuffed. Service was alright, could have been a touch better but hey did have another group show up so I think they were stretched a little. The location was convenient, easy to walk to if you work downtown. I would recommend this place for a group outing since seating is plenty.

Obviously the beer is awesome, but I must admit my tour was the best. Victor was extremely informative and hilarious. Went on multiple tours that day and cigar city was definitely a favorite because of him! Got some soap to go home also and it's amazing! Hoping to go back next time in Tampa!

Came here for brunch. Very small place, an old house turned into a restaurant style. There's a couple different rooms and each room does not fit many people so it's kind of quaint and intimate. They have an outdoors little porch area also (pet friendly). There was mostly hits at our table but one miss for me. The shrimp and grits was very under seasoned. I added salt and pepper and it was ok. Though I would not order this again.

That being said, everything else was very flavorful! As a starter the Nemo rolls are very fresh and delicate. I could eat lots of those and not feel guilty doing so. I also had the calamari Caesar salad. This was probably one of the best Caesar salads I had ever eaten! The Caesar dressing was perfect , not fishy and not overpowering and the calamari was seasoned and fried perfectly, not greasy. I would come back again just for this salad.

Koreana, why did it take me so long to find you? Is it because you're hidden behind place I will never go to (Chilis, Abners, Atlantis Gentleman's Club)? Is it because I usually pack my lunch, and so haven't fully explored my near-work options? I don't know, but there is just no excuse. I'm sorry. 

I can only give three stars now, because I've had better BimBimBop, but your service was fast and friendly and fairly priced. I'll be back for another shot.
Little homey tastefully simple place with comfort foods. Good food, good price, great service.

Nothing in the immediate area of the hotel, restaurants/shopping are at least 2 miles away. Upon entering the room we realized that it had not been cleaned...trash cans not emptied, table was dirty, urine in toilet. As my husband was traveling for work I was there during the day. After 3 days I asked them to come clean the room and they told me I had to be gone for at least 3 hours, I was gone for 4 hours and it still wasn't done when I came back. Bed is uncomfortable and squeaks with minor movement. Gym is ok, you can get wipes from the front desk to wipe off equipment. Used the restaurant twice for dinner, food was ok. The hotel is pretty dated (room and common areas). Large tv in the rooms with Netflix/HBO. Love Marriott but would not stay here again.
I've been here twice! There are over 7 eaterys within plus a full sit down restaurant and an ice cream shop. Great atmosphere, very relaxed excellent food!

I normally wouldn't review a chain, but after returning to this concept after years it's wild to me that there's enough of a following to keep this place going. We came in on Memorial Day to a dead restaurant, which was surprising. 

Our service was exceptional, but the food was forgettable and overpriced. I ordered the spaghetti and house-made meatballs and the better half got some rigatoni dish with a cream sauce and chicken. The fresh bread that used to be good absolutely sucked, and the calamari was whatever. Had it not been for the gift card I'd have had no reason to come in, and I certainly have no reason to come back. Butternut squash ravioli for $21?! That's hilarious.

For the prices they're charging, you can get far better quality food from local establishments.

This is absolutely the coolest place to take your fur baby. The staff were all very nice and professional. My dog is very shy yet she actually wanted to stay here! It seemed like she was disappointed that I picked her up so early because she wanted to play more! I felt very confident that my doggy was well taken care of during her over night stay. I will definitely recommend this place to my friends and family!

Went to LouVino for the Valentine's Day menu.  Service was great.  The appetizer was the best thing we had. Risotto was not done and very chewy.  Truffles were good but definitely felt like we were pushed to be in a hurry and leave.  The food had the same overall rushed feeling.  I know it is a small plates restaurant but this was really small and overpriced.  Had much better and see no reason to return.

Nailed it!! It's so hard to find plant based restaurants who don't use seitan and things of that nature. The ingredients are REAL Whole Foods that taste AMAZING!! Couldn't be happier with my visit here. Sooo delicious!!
We order take out regularly, burger and chicken sandwich always delicious. Loaded fries are also a must!

Okay so I feel like I was the least upset about my most recent experience here. I think a lot of that has to do with the fact that I wasn't in a rush or hangry. 
We first showed up and found out there was a 30 minute wait. That was a good sign I thought as I've never experienced a wait at a Vietnamese restaurant. However we were all hungry and not looking to stand around. We asked if we could eat outside as they had all the tables open outside and we were told that they didn't serve food outside. So waiting is what we did.
After a 20-30 minute wait we were seated at our table. We looked at the vast menu and ordered some drinks. We then all ordered food, admittedly we all ordered multiple things as wanting to really see how this new restaurant was.
After a bit one of our meals came. Within 10/12 minutes we all got at least one of our items.
However that's where it seemed to take a turn. We  all got our pho, stew, and vermicelli but the fresh rolls, spare ribs, and banh mi were no where to be found. We assumed they would come when made as not all of our other food came at once. Once we had finished those dishes we decided that was enough waiting and asked. Not to mention the table next to us that ordered those exact same things were already almost done with theirs and they were seated after we were. Luckily I wasn't that upset since I had my Pho already, but if that wasn't the case I would have been very mad. We then told the waitress who did not know why they missed 4 of our items from our order, but to her defense I could see where she had put it in.
We cancelled a few of the items and got the others to go. Overall no complaints about the food, but the mistakes kind of overpowered the food. 
Then we decided to order the egg cup waffle and shaved ice. This took another good 20 minutes to get. We were warned about the wait for this so I don't know how much you can fault them for that.
To top things off as we were leaving we noticed other people dining outside in the same seats we were told they did not serve food at. After the mess ups with our dinner that was the cherry to the top of the frustrating dinner experience.

The only reason I'm giving this a two star is because I hope the other waxers are better and more professional than the young girl I had.  I went in for a Brazilian, but I won't go into all the gory details.  I will say that she did not complete the task at hand and she left my skin raw for nearly a week due to her multiple failed attempts.  Not sure about the other services here, but some of the comments she made while working on me did not leave me with the urge to return and find out.

I got piercings yesterday and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The shop is super cool inside and very welcoming. The guys working made me feel extremely comfortable and walked me through the process of making the actual piercing less painful, and proper aftercare instructions. Their prices are much more reasonable than others in the Philadelphia area for how clean and smooth both the process and the jewelry were. I will definitely be back for piercings, or perhaps even for another tattoo!

Zarett rehab is amazing. The therapists are extremely knowledgeable and great to work with. They pay close attention and adjust therapy as needed. The stretch and massage at the end are fabulous. Joe Zarett and his team clearly treat the entire patient. I would never consider therapy anywhere else.

Got to Hattie B's at 10 minutes to open and there was already a short line.  The servers are very fast and friendly.  We ordered the chicken medium and the pimento mac and cheese and potato salad.  The sides were nothing special, the mac was mushy and bland and the potato salad okay.  But the chicken..... OH!!! the chicken!!!!
Perfect, crisp, a good amount of heat (if you are used to very spicy foods you could do the hot-if not stick with medium or mild) juicy....amazing.  Next time I am in Nashville, I will be back and I will not be wasting my appetite on sides! All chicken all the way.  The banana pudding is perfect for cooling down afterwards.

Service was great and fast. I ordered buffalo chicken Mac. My boyfriend ordered the Sully's sweet pork. Mine was not quite what I expected. My macaroni tasted like franks hot sauce soup, it looked like they poured half the bottle of hot sauce on top. Boyfriend thought that his macaroni was good.
Nada is a wonderful bar near 21st ave and Vanderbilt University. I was especially pleased with Chris the bartender, he was very friendly and a great help for our first time at Nada!

Great gelato and a great location. Friendly staff, but the restrooms were out of order (!) I live in DC, but have been to Philly a few times and we always go to Capogiro.  We've had pistachio, chocolate, grapefruit (gonna make it again?) and blood orange.  Good for an afternoon snack, but we've eaten there after dinner in the middle of winter, ok?  : )

Got them because of a living social coupon. They're great!  I would recommend that anyone in the Santa Cruz county area get them. Mike himself answered all my calls and emails promptly. He was a little late but made sure to call me that he was going to be a little late.  He has his machine in a trailer that he pulled with his truck. It was huge and looked new.  It looked so impressive that I wanted to get a picture of it. Maybe that's why my carpets looked so nice.  A family-owned company that should be supported!

Unforgettable first time here:

I went with 3 friends. Both my roommate and I order fish tacos. The wait for our entrees goes from 'longer than average' to long to 'let's start thinking about leaving'.

Wen we had questions about our order status and wait time, the waitress was nowhere to be found. And plus,what can she do about the fact that they ran out of soft taco shells and someone had to...wait for it...leave the kitchen to buy more.

I don't know. Maybe someone could've told us. We aren't addicted to fish tacos or anything.

That was 2 years ago. Bad customer service memories linger and are repeated to friends.

As for the food, it was unremarkable.

Hands down one of the BEST pedicures I've ever had. Usually it's sub par because of the massage.  But Tara is the only person I've been to that can really do a great foot massage. You can tell that she's very passionate about her work. For my pedicure (W/O polish) was very affordable! It started with a nice soak and she had over 4 different scents to choose from I chose Lavender to calm my nerves from the work week and boom instant bliss. This service includes the soak solution, a scrub which was amazing and really helped my feet. And the best part a massage lotion! The best part was the relaxing foot rub! And the soak tub has a vibration massage and keeps the water warm. I ended up getting a gift certificate for my grandma for mother's day!
Worst service and customer service. No COVID rules. No Covid rules and regulations . Don't have a big collection of drinks

The foods great, but we spent time looking at the menu online and tried calling it in for carryout and now they have  a "Weekend menu" thats eliminated 1/3 of the items (some of the best too).   Parkings a pain too.  Would not carry out from here on a weekend, but if you are walking by then check it out.

Our last breakfast in New Orleans and my cousin and I were craving eggs Benedict. Stanley was the place because it was literally a minute walk from our hotel. We were immediately greeted and seated and our waiter brought us coffee right away. Great start, right?? 

After carefully reviewing the menu we already had our hearts set on their Eggs Stanley. Our dreams of a delicious breakfast was crushed because they were out of oysters. Booooo!!!! So we settled for our second choice which was the corned beef hash. Don't get me wrong it was just as delicious, but oysters are always better!!! Well, a family was seated next to us by a different waiter and when they got down to ordering the man got to order an Eggs Stanley, no questions asked. We were so hurt!!!!! 

The breakfast still good, but it could have been memorable, you know!? Oh well...gives me a reason to come back! ;)
The gumbo was excellent ant the sword fish amazing. Chicken and dumplings are yummy also.

I always enjoy Panera Bread. They have a nice selection of sandwiches and soups that you really can't find anywhere else. I LOVE the rapid pick-up option they have so I can order and pay online then just swing by the store to pick up my items-- no waiting in line.

Pastries are really delicious but overpriced so I rarely get those, although the orange cranberry scones and the cinnamon crunch pastries are my favorites. 

Every once in a while, I like going to Panera to work when I need to take the job away from my home office.  It's nice to tuck myself into a quiet corner, grab a soda and treat myself to that overpriced scone while I work in a different location. Guess I should reconsider it as paying for an experience.

Anyhow. You shouldn't be disappointed in what Panera has to offer :)
Great atmosphere, excellent coffee!! :) Love the location as now you can hang out after a hike in the canyon. So peaceful, beautiful views. Got a brown sugar & cinnamon latte - so good!!

Other reviewers don't give this place enough credit! We try to limit ourselves and only go here once a week, but we would go every day if we could. We've tried PJ's in New Orleans before, but it had a limited variety of drinks and didn't taste nearly as good as the Chalmette location. Our favorite drinks are the white chocolate granita and the southern wedding cake velvet ice (seasonal, but they'll make it any time if you ask). It also has a drive-thru, which is nice. As for the inside, it's always clean and very comfortable. Definitely the best place to get frozen coffee in Saint Bernard, and definitely better than any Starbucks.

My husband and I dined at Bibou on a Sunday in May of 2015.  This was the most overrated restaurant on all fronts!  It was a prix-fixe so maybe it is better on other nights.  The escargot was too pungent, I regret eating it, I ate it to not waste it.  The duck terrine was meh, not great.  I cannot even remember what we chose for the main dishes.  I remember the chocolate cake was the driest and worst dessert we have ever had in our lives. The waiter was snooty and off-putting.  It must've been an off night?  I cringe every time I see it on the top-10 list.

Our 9 month old yorkie was recently diagnosed with a liver shunt.  There was not a specialist in our town that was able to perform the surgery.  We were referred to Westvet.  From the very first phone call to Westvet, we were treated with respect and kindness.  We drove nearly 300 miles to see the doctors there.  Our dog ended up being hospitalized over night, and sent home on meds for 1 week to prepare him for surgery.  The next week, we returned for the CT and the operation.  Every visit, before we left we were given a cost estimate.  There was never a time that we were unaware of what the cost would be.  While the hospitalization, and the surgery were costly, it was worth every penny, and seemed to be right on track with clinic charges at other facilities.  We felt very comfortable leaving our pet in their care.  Everyone there was very good at what they do.  Not only did they treat our very sick dog, but they also took very good care of us.  Having to visit an animal hospital with a critically ill or injured pet is very scary, but Westvet made a terrible situation so much better.
Horrible food! I found a worm in my italian hoagie. Fries were wet, salad was damaged. Terrible delivery conditions.

Always dependable! So I am surprised at the negative reviews. Usually a to-go lunch spot for me: Their Tacos and Sopes are honest and excellent, especially the Sopes -- three cornmeal tartlets covered in black beans, the meat of your choice, and queso fresco. Simple, elegant, and delish. On beautiful days like today, the windows are open to a lovely breeze, which can enjoy while eating at the windowside counter.

Got a groupon for the tasting menu
They are OUT OF BUSINESS effective 12/1. Yeah a day after a groupon went out.
I really like this neighborhood bar. Nice staff, customers and very good tropical drinks. Thanks to Danny for doing a boil on Sundays!

Decided to give this place a try. The menus online looked excellent and we were excited to go. 

First disappointment was right off the bat. We were seated and someone came fairly quickly to take our order. We were not sure if breakfast was being served, but we heard the table next to us ordering eggs Benedict, etc. So we decided breakfast it was! That is until we were told they were no longer serving breakfast. So I asked why the table next to us, who was seated maybe only 2 mins before us, was able to get breakfast items. I was told "they are the last table to be allowed to order".... okay... so on to lunch items then. 

4 sandwiches and a few salads were your ONLY lunch options. NOT the huge lunch menu on their website. I couldn't believe it. I wanted to leave right then because if all I wanted was a sandwich or burger, I would have gone to the Boise Fry Company nextdoor, but we decided to stay. 

We each ordered a sandwich of some kind. Mine was chicken. The bun was BURNT and the chicken was dry and tasteless. I couldn't even bite through it. 

My family said their buns were a little more on the burnt side and the burgers were dry. 

So just to sum things up,

1. We missed brunch by 1 min and was denied the option of that menu, even though the table seated right before us was given the option. 

2. The lunch menu was far more limited than any menu I have ever seen. 

3. The food was not worth the money. 

I'm sad because I was really excited to go there but I doubt we'll be giving this place another shot.

Been in 3 times

Fast drive thru wash and gets the car clean

Great vac, wipe down and window service for one interior price 

No extra charge for the trunk/cargo area you just have to ask

The interior team is fast, polite and efficient 

My new go to place.

We love this place! We hadn't been here for awhile and stopped by for an early lunch with my sister-in-law. My husband and his sister got chicken salad (The Sherbrooke). It was a hit - with Utz potato chips. I used to get The Victoria (which was GREAT), but it's no longer available. So, I ordered a bagel with veggie cream cheese. Delish! And the coffee was as good as I remembered. Quaint bagel place with wonderful  service. My only complaint was our dirty table. Gross.

Ate here on Thanksgiving Day.. not your typical Thanksgiving meal but boy was it delicious! The seafood pasta has shrimp and crab in it. It was so so good! If you want to feel like your on an island in the middle of downtown it's the place for you... OH AND you gotta grab a Landshark beer!!

This place is very delicious and has a great vibe. It is the only bar & restaurant in walking distance to my apartment so I hope to make regular visits. Good beer selection here including Sour Monkey!

I have been buying my mattresses at HBC for years. My first purchase there was a Simmons black series with a price that no one else could beat, great delivery and set up too. Since that first purchase I have bought my sons mattress there, guest room mattress and just recently bought my little girls first bed. They have plenty of choices from economy models to the high end mattresses that I prefer. Always a great price and the service is outstanding. Ask for Pat he will go out of his way to satisfy you. He even tracked down a mattress cover for me for my sons bed and mailed it to me at no cost! You just can't beat the service at this store. I will not buy anywhere else. There is no need to when you get the best price and the best service!

Little Italy has held its position as our number one pizza delivery establishment for almost two years.  When I'm feeling like delivery, there isn't usually a question.  Little Italy it is.  They have everything you could wish for in delivery: credit card accepting, delicious food, great hours.
Love busch gardens! You hardly wait more than 15-20 (if that) to get on a ride. One of my favorite things to do!

Amazing rooftop bar in downtown St. Pete!  Cool vibes with a beautiful view of Tampa bay. Our waitress was highly responsive and our drinks were never empty! Great drink menu as well as small bites. 

It was a little chilly so we sat by the fire, which was a lovely touch!

I highly recommend this bar!

We got a couple of cheeseburgers, tots, fries, a Korn dog (yes, spelled with a "k") and a raspberry shake. The food was so-so, definitely wouldn't come back for it. The car hop also seemed like she absolutely hates her job. :(

When your dog does everything possible to get into the door of the groomer as fast as they can, you know its a great place. All I have to do is say, "Let's go see Melinda" and Annie is on her way to the car.  Melinda has been grooming Annie for 6 years with love and great attention to detail. Can't say enough good things about Canine Design.
I love sushi has great prices and GREAT quality fish. The best sushi I've had in Nashville, great service and really awesome rolls. The rainbow Naruto is my favorite. Literally so good.

On April 13, I called Discount Taxi for a pickup at 4:40 pm. 

After standing in front of my house for 35 minutes, with no one but neighbors driving by, I called Discount Taxi a second time at 5:15. The dispatcher informed me that the cab had come and I wasn't there, and I said, "If that was true, the cab was invisible." I asked a second time for a pickup. 

At 5:45 I called a third time for the cab that never came, and was informed that "I" had canceled the pickup. I did not. 

I complained about the absence of service on Google, and Discount Taxi replied that I am mentally ill. I stood in front of my house for more than an hour for nothing but abuse!

The next morning, I called Independent Taxi. They arrived 12 minutes later. 

I am not mentally ill. I am angry and disgusted. Discount Taxi is worth exactly what I paid that afternoon: nothing.

We arrived 10am and check-in isn't until 3pm.  We were able to do a pre-check-in and were told we would be called as soon as our room was ready.  We left our bags with the bellman and went out to get brunch.  At ll:00 am we were called that our room was ready and the bellman had delivered our luggage to our room.  I was very impressed with all of this.

Our standard king room was very large, we really enjoyed the roominess and the clean modern look.  The room had all of the basics that we needed and a nice flat screen TV. The air purifier was a good plus.  The bed was comfy enough, but we hated the pillows- they seemed like cheap overstuffed ones.  The bedding was odd in that the comforter was sandwiched between two top sheets, rather than in a duvet.  This was annoying because the sheets would slide down leaving the top of the comforter exposed which I am sure doesn't get washed often.  

Great location if you're interested in things to do in the French Quarter!  However, the construction on Bourbon Street woke us up every morning around 6am.  I know this is out of the Hotel's control though.  Just keep in mind if you're visiting... everything in the French Quarter is way over-priced.  We took a short Uber ride to other parts of downtown New Orleans and found the same food/alcohol for fractions of the cost.
Worth your afternoon. Super fun. Great look back at history. Very interesting stories. Not suggested when it is raining as you move from  building to building. Highly recommend.

My wife received a gift certificate for Yarn Refuge and was excited about going in only to be interrogated and given a hard time about the legitimacy of the gift certificate by the woman at the counter. The yarn she got was great quality but because of the customer service experience, we would not recommend Yarn Refuge. Jimmy Beans Wool in Reno has much better customer service. Check them out instead!

I was at the Ethical Society of Philadelphia last Thursday to see Jens Lekman perform. The only pictures I could find of the Ethical Society showed a big room with lots of folding chairs. I was hoping the show would be seated, but alas, it was standing room only.

The opener, a nice Australian boy named Geoffrey O'Connor, said it best: "It's so lovely to be playing for you inside of this giant wedding cake."

The place is beautiful, with a sweeping staircase and lots of white decor. The acoustics were A-OK as well. I would definitely return to see another show here.

r5productions.com

I walk in and erry time I do I get a YUGGGEEE " HERRRROOOOOOOOO" and a smile. After that, I have some super yummy chicken fried rice, and stare at my hot girlfriend. Super great prices, super friendly staff. I love it!

I'm writing this review a couple months after getting a bikini wax here. I'd been trying to go somewhere else but they'd cancelled or postponed my reservation 4 consecutive times so I finally made one here instead after seeing all the great reviews.

I spoke to Mrs. Ken on the phone and she was very professional and welcoming. On the day of my appointment however she was nowhere to be seen and someone else actually did the wax. I'm new to waxing, but the previous times have been very professional, clean, and sterile. This person put on old, used rubber gloves that had holes in them, used the same sticks repeatedly, and broke off more hairs than she pulled out. She also kept trying to convince me to get something I didn't want, and used clippers (that still had hair in them) to trim down all my hair to stubble - which proceeded to get all over me and the chair.

Overall, it was a very unpleasant and uncomfortable experience - certainly one of the more painful waxes I've had, and also just a bad wax. Most of the hairs grew back in like they'd been shaved (because they were broken) and there wasn't great coverage to begin with. The whole thing kind of felt like a bootleg operation as well because it's in the basement of a nail salon with a completelt different vibe and they only take cash. It cost me about the same as the best wax I'd ever had, so it really wasn't worth the money or the experience.
Excellent food and fantastic family of real Greeks who really know how to Treat customers.  A MUST if you are in the area.  AND the icing on the cake; they support their local chamber of commerce!

Been here a dozen times but always forget to write a review. Service is friendly but food and drinks can take a little bit to come out. Place is clean with plenty of places to sit. Restroom is kept clean as well. Drinks have been consistently good. I've had milk teas, fruit slushies and mangonada. Food is just okay. The banh mi is full of meat and veggies but is not my go to place for banh mi. Ramen is not as authentic. Spring rolls is standard. Chicken wing is good.
My favorite place for dessert In town. It's worth waiting in the long lines out the door you see on a regular basis.

Such a great place. These donuts are delicious and have NO PRESERVATIVES! I love knowing my kids (and myself!) are eating a treat that isn't full of all the extra and unnecessary ingredients. The staff is awesome- genuine donut-lovers who pour their hearts into this place. Tell your gluten-free people too as they have an Idaho Potato donut option!

This is my second time eating at this venue.  And after my first visit, I invited 13 friend to join me for dinner and conversations.  The food is amazing, the service is direct and informative.  We enjoyed great salads, various sliders from Duck to Breakfast burgers and even a great pickled plate - we didn't know what most of the item on the plate were, but they were all delicious.  One of the many unique things about this place, besides the food is the secret location of it and that they serve outstanding food till 3am!  If I had to pick at one thing that I didn't like, I personally thought it was too bright, but then again I am a vampire..
Excellent! Dinner last night was wonderful. The wine selection is classy. The Menu was lavash and tasteful. We have added it to the list. Thank you.

I grew up in Newtown, and Goodnoe was the coolest place in town. More than a diner, more than an ice cream parlor, this place was as much a part of Newtown culture as was any other establishment.

I was saddened to hear the original place was torn down a few years ago, making room for a bland, ultra-commercial and faux-chic strip center. But I'm glad that their ice cream has survived at a small, yet charming "dairy bar" on Sycamore St..  And even though my experience was probably influenced by nostalgia, I'm going to suggest you give them a try.

I had a couple of scoops of chocolate marshmallow, and it was super, as was the friendly staff and the small town appeal. Convenient parking in the front, and although the seating area isn't very spacious, it's still very comfortable.

Goodnoe is still my favorite: highly recommended.

Average margarita pizza - kind of bland in my opinion. We did take out (due to COVID-19) and their system of waiting outside was very efficient. I just didn't think the pizza was anything great. It had way too much sauce and 2 of the slices didn't even have cheese on them. I probably wouldn't return based on this experience.
Like being in Italy. The tuna special to night was superb. Capri is always great. The hot rolls are delicious, the chicken saltimbucco, the chicken lasagna and much more

We were visiting for a game and delighted to celebrate my husbands birthday here. It was a delicious meal and they accommodated our request to sit outside despite it being 45 degrees. They put a heater next to our table so with our coats on, we were comfortable. Not to mentioned I felt so much more comfortable knowing we were outside. There were tables inside that were spaced apart but it was still too full for my comfort. We're from Chicago and our COVID restrictions are much tighter. I think Indiana has 50% capacity whereas Chicago is the lesser of 25 people or 25%. Anyways our server was great and his recommendation made me change my order. I got the sausage and peppers with the fresh house made pasta (I'm always a snob for fresh pasta) and it was absolutely delicious. Perfectly al dente pasta with just enough spice from the sausage with a well balanced sauce. My husband absolutely loved the chicken diavolo which says "very spicy" but in our opinion, it was just the right amount of the spice. My husband also loved the cozy sweater drink and the house Italian blend red wine was great. Highly recommend you try this place!

Lobster bisque Fridays is my favorite time to go to Uncle Giuseppe's.This family-owned and operated business has brought an old school NY sandwich shop to Boise. They build their sandwiches with great hand cut meats, cheeses, and the style of onions & peppers that you only get from people who appreciate making a sandwich right.
These guys are not for you if you're all about the corporate style cookie cutter sandwiches you get from the Subway chain where they have to pump their sandwiches full of lettuce because there is so little of anything else.

Its also nice to meet people that appreciate what YA & LT meant to the NYG!

have been coming here for just over a year now. I couldn't have found a better place for a guy to come in and relax and get his haircut and beard trimmed. Brittany is awesome, she listens to what you want and keeps you engaged with the conversation. I definitely recommend this place to all my friends.
Good pizza and the restaurant was really well done!  I think the service could be a little prompter, but overall it was awesome and I will be going back.

Finally had the opportunity to check this place out with my kids. I have a 5 year & a 11 year old.  To sum things up ! Atmosphere / Cleanness 4
Restroom Cleanness 3
Customer Service 5
Price for GAMES arcade 3 ( a little bit EXPENSIVE )
Drinks (Soda) free refill 3
Price for individual games such as bumper cars/ mini golf/bowling 3
Bar Liquid Drink Quality  (taste) - I had a long island 3
Overall experience?  It's very large "playroom" - but my family was NOT impressed by available arcade games. "More Needed" - I really think if game prices were just $5/$8 cheaper would be more affordable. We didn't have any food on this 1st timer but looks REGULAR.  FYI they have deals so "yes" if you haven't gone here - it's OK to check out! I took lots of pictures.

As someone who grew up in a small business family, I always try to support local business owners--- and let me tell you, Chiccarine's Fine Jewelry does not disappoint!!! The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, and their jewelry is high quality and reasonably priced. With a large selection and variety of pieces, you're guaranteed to find whatever you're looking for. And if for some reason nothing catches your eye, the owner Paul is more than happy to open his vendor books and special order whatever it is you need---good luck finding a chain store with that level of customer service!

My fiance and I love Chiccarine's so much, we even got our engagement and wedding rings there! Paul was incredibly helpful and patient as he helped us go through, what seemed like, dozens of settings until we found the perfect ones! 

It's a complete dream to shop at Chiccarine's, and I would recommend them to anyone!

I've always loved the atmosphere of BDubs. Ever since my first football game here. It's just a fun environment, full of sports-lovers who want to have a good time. The service has always been amazing (as long as you know it's not super fast. Due to each server having up to 10 tables) although, I'm used to fast service. Buffalo Wild Wings is based on quality. It takes a little while to get what you want, but when you get it. It's totally worth it. Servers are friendly, and the beer is always cold. 

Best way to watch football in my opinion.

Had to check out Martin's on our quick trip to Nashville.  It was across the street from our hotel so major score!  Pick up was easy and fast, service polite and friendly.

We got the baby back and spare ribs.  They were AMAZING! Smoky goodness and I loved the not too sweet sauce. The hush puppies were super tasty and the "side" salad was ginormous-loved it!  The biggest disappointment for me was the brisket, it was dry and didn't have enough of the fatty juicy pieces :(   Next time, I'll stick with the ribs.

IF YOU LIKE  BUGS THIS IS THE PLACE TO STAY. They have roaches. I saw 2 in the bathroom crawling on the tub and on the walls. I report the incident to the night shift manager ADOLPHO  he basically insulted me by offering me $50.00. Called corporate spoke with Bruno he was understanding took the complaint and said he was very sorry. Spoke with Katie the day shift manager the morning I was checking out she applied a credit to my room which in my opinion was not enough. She also told me that these type of things happen which is another slap in the face. I've stayed at lots of hotels I have never seen a roach in my room. Can't bring my suit case in the house It's just sitting in the garage. I've been Waiting on corporate to call me back to discuss this matter and I have not heard from anyone, no emails no phone calls no text. But yet I'm getting emails thanking me for booking with them and asking about my stay. I Guess this is how they treat BONVOY members. SMH THEE WORST!!!!!

Hubby and I checked out the brewery tour this past Sunday, and it was really enjoyable.

Tours run on Sundays from 12-3. We arrived around 2:30, worried that we may be too late. Luckily, the last tour started at 3 so we had plenty of time.

When we walked in the door, we entered through the retail section. We then headed up a set of stairs into the pretty huge tasting room. It was pretty hot in there considering it was 90+ degrees outside, but there was a gigantic fan in the window offering us some relief. When we walked up to the bar, a very friendly bartender handed us a tasting sheet. On that is a list of all of the beers they have, and you get to have a tasting portion of each one. Each beer that Philadelphia Brewing Co makes is really unique and of course delicious, including a raspberry hard cider that was not sweet at all but uniquely dry, almost like a champagne.

We really enjoyed the tour too. Our tour guide was very informative and funny, and even snuck in some history for us. In a nutshell, PBC is a socially conscious brewery that cares not only about the ingredients that go into their product but also the community around them. 

After the tour, we were led back into the tasting room to finish up our tasting sheets. I loved how mellow and laid back all of the employees were about not kicking us out and giving us plenty of time to enjoy our experience. I also really liked how all of their cases available for purchase are mix & match, so you can fully customize your purchase. They also sell growlers, t-shirts, pint glasses and some super rad "Kenzinger" bibs for babies.

This was a really great time, and I will definitely be back!

So this is only the third time I've been here the first two were OK but this time I got the hot chicken salad and it took almost 25 minutes to get the salad. And then when I got it I think it had been sitting for a while because it was soggy with tons of tortilla strips (I took most of the off) And when I told the waitress she said oh I'm sorry. That's it and then here's your bill. Don't think I'll be going back anytime soon. Too many better places in downtown Nashville to eat.

It's 10 of 11am & you offer breakfast sandwiches until 11:00. When I try to order one the miserable woman that answers the phone says 'nope!' we only serve them until 11. Does anyone else see the issue here? The help here are always jerks. We like  the food but can't stand speaking with the  employees

Dr.Wollock's work and his team are amazing. They have been nothing but professional. Their job is outstanding ! I've been referred by a friend whose teeth were extremely complicated to straighten and when I saw her after just 4 months of wearing Invisaligns I was so impressed. I am currently in the beginning of my second month of wearing the trays myself and I can already see outstanding results. I have two more months until I'm done. I recommend this place to anyone who is looking for professional experience for a very small price !

I need to write this review before I try to suppress this memory. There is no veterinary care quite like that which your pet will receive at 2nd Street. For several months we've been trying to figure out the cause of mysterious symptoms in my very small, deaf, mini-lop rabbit. 2nd Street not only figured it out immediately but they are also the world's sweetest, calmest and most caring staff of nurses, administrators and doctors. 

Now for the real sign that the nursing and administrative staff are human angels: This morning I arrived to drop off my rabbit for surgery. Upon leaving, a man was frantically running down the street carrying a dog. While screaming "my dog is dying" and crying, knocking on the door the nurses ran over to assist him while still trying to follow their office's Covid policies (no entry). They took in the dog, locked the door, and let the owner watch through the glass as they dislodged a stick from the bleeding dog's mouth, as if it was effortless. They saw us trying to keep the man calm so they did the same for the dog then gave him back to the owner with the following sentiment: "your dog is okay! She's calm now and we just want to make sure you're okay; we are so sorry for yelling but we just wanted to make sure the dog didn't dart out of the door because she was scared. You're all going to be okay." They saved the dog's life FOR FREE, and this man's. He was on his knees, hysterical, (as anyone would be) and 2nd Street revived him. I am so grateful for these amazing women and I don't think an argument exists for a better vet.

*I've been going to Dr. Weiss for 20 years at his practice in Washington TWP, NJ.
This place is great.  Very fresh ingredients.  If u call ahead they will have it ready.  Really nice guy at the window. Homemade and yummy!

Ordered the Turkey, Swiss, Egg & Salsa Bagel.
Not only was receiving REAL turkey over flowing out of the bagel excellent - but the cost was equally as exciting.  

$5 bucks. Can't beat that for a healthy filling breaky eh!

Looking forward to trying lunch next !

A

I love to play pool here. The games are only a dollar and they have like 5 tables.  They also have shuffle board and the buck hunter game. Great selection of unique beers. I almost always go for the state street stout which is delicious. Come here for pool and yummy beer

So my girlfriend and I wanted to try something different so we tried Ariana for Afghan food.  The place was located in a shopping center.  The decor was very nice old school Afghan decor.  The server took our orders, she was friendly but I could teller her English was a bit limited.  I ordered the spicy chicken dish with chicken and spinach with plain basmati rice.  My girlfriend ordered the curry chicken with cauliflower and basmati rice.  Bother our orders came with salad and bread.  The salad was good, it has iceberg lettuce and a yogurt dressing which was pretty good.  Next the entrees came and mine was exceptionally spicy, however I felt as though this meal could have been made in my home!!! There was not exceptional about the meal that had me falling on the floor to have a flavor orgasm... My girlfriend was so pissed at her meal she complained the whole time about it being bland and wont be remembered.  Also she complained that the portions were stingy and the portions were definitely a little on the light side...the bread was okay...a bit on the tough side...like its been left out for a bit...hmmph..
To add to a bland meal we ordered a dessert to share...the desserts looked different so we went for the gusto and ordered the flan dessert with pistachio and cinnamon...it definitely was different but not bad...
Needless to say I am impartial as to whether or not I will be back...but just know you can make these dishes at home cheaper and organic...

Safelite came out to my office to replace my windshield. It took 45 minutes and was super easy and painless. I used them because it was recommended with my insurance. Its great they send you a profile of who will be coming. And they let me know when they would be there. I will definitely use Safelite again if needed.
Beautiful grounds, beautiful room, fabulous staff. Out of the way which makes it hard to find but also makes it peaceful. Close to airport so very convenient for travelers

Have used this company previously when they were reliable! Prior to leaving town, I made a reservation for an airport pickup for the day I was to arrive home. They took all necessary flight info, assured me they'd track the flight to be there awaiting my arrival. Great, I thought!  I called to reconfirm my booking the day of my return flight, but each call went directly to voicemail. Left messages with all info. NEVER received one return call!  Ok, This is strange!  Flight arrived early, but I waited until my scheduled arrival time, and still no taxi in sight.  Called, but as before, got voicemail!  Stranded lady at 1:30 a.m.!  Bottom line...call an Uber use Airport Cab Service, BUT NOT CHESTERFIELD TAXI SERVICE IF YOU WANT RELIABLE AND COURTEOUS SERVICE.
It was quick, affordable and the rep was very personable. He even swapped out a last minute battery add on in about 5 minutes. Amazing service.  And with a lifetime warranty, you can't go wrong.

I usually only go here for dinner when they have table service, so my experience is based on that. 

One of my favorite burgers in the city. So good. 

The cheese puffs are the most delicious appetizer in the world too. It's like taking a cheeze-it, inflating it into a soft pillow of cheesy goodness, and then eating that. I think it is bread double baked with some kind of cheese mousse that they make in-house. 

And the desserts, good lord. The gooey butter cake, the cheesecake, the signature cake. I could eat their desserts until I die, they're that good. 

But this place at night turns into a romantic date-night spot. Or the outdoor patio is good for a relaxing dinner with friends. I've never had any negative experience here. Even when a tornado warning was alerted and they crowded all of us downstairs, the waitstaff was still trying to be friendly and accommodating. 

100% would recommend Russell's.

This is a great hotel if you are in Tucson! We felt safe, the hotel is clean and everything is so nice! The staff are friendly, complimentary breakfast with a buffet and omelet station. They have a complimentary social hour with well drinks, wine, bud light beer and sangria which is delicious! They serve different appetizers to go with your drinks. You can also have juice or soda as a non alcoholic option. We ordered from their restaurant and the food is very good. The surrounding are is upscale with many fine dining options too. There is a CVS and Starbucks within walking distance. We will stay here again when in Tucson.

Food was not great. Photos on Yelp were deceiving. Ordered chicken parmigiana, chicken piccata, linguine w clams, sausage and broccoli rabe and mixed greens salad. Everything was bland, flavorless and dry. Maybe only thing that was good was the bread they threw in. Will not be ordering again. Wish they took some care w the order.

The service is always really lame, so that immediately pisses me off, but the food is definitely fun and tasty.  I agree, the fish tacos are banging but their Mexican chopped salad is really what got me with the lime vinegarette.  Whenever we go there for lunch and cocktails, everyone orders the burrito or tacos or what have you and they laugh when I get the salad because I HATE SALAD.  It is that good.  The other thing that annoys the hell out of me is the moratorium they have on chippys.  Unless you order their $12+ guac, no chips for you!  The service can be very forgetful...you wait a longggggg time for your drinks...It's fine as long as you know what you are getting into.  It can be very loud...that usually doesn't bother me, but I know that matters to some people.
Food tasted okay.  Serving sizes were small compared to the price.  2 pancakes, nothing else $10 wtf?  So many other better places to go.  My food was just warm.

Love the drink menu! The ceviche was fantastic...we had a few different tries at that. I ordered a trout special and it was savory and wonderful. The decor is great and I think Mango has become a staple to the downtown dining scene. We even took advantage of check in special and loved the Crackberry. Service was polished and effecient. We were doing some work talk, and our sever got that. He was there when we needed him and was soooo polite, I am sorry I don't remeber his name because he deserved a shout out so management knows he is an asset. Mango always comes through for a good dinner out!

Just bought an 05 Honda Odyssey from this place. They have "haggle free" pricing policy and from what I could tell, the prices are actually right where they need to be or just below value so no real need to haggle. Martin F. Was my sales guy and he was very knowledgeable about the vehicle and went above and beyond. I was in and out in about 1.5 hrs which is uncommon in used car buying. I you like straight forward and simple, this is the place for you. If you like to haggle over the price of your cheeseburger at McDonalds, this is not the place for you.

Tampa shouldn't even really be classified as an international airport. It has a few international flights, but most of them are domestic. I think this is why Tampa always seems... quiet. It's a small airport, and I always experience short lines at check in, security, etc. They have an hour of free parking for people to walk travelers in and do their thing. The people who work here have been pretty nice across the board, there are stations to plug your laptop/phone into, and there's free wifi. The only thing I'll complain about is the excessive use of those body scanner things. There's nothing wrong with metal detectors! /rant

I will say to plan your departing flights in the summer for before 2pm. Those stupid afternoon storms in the summer can delay departure and have you miss connecting flights (like I experienced earlier this month).

Our favorite pizza spot in the area.  We had been searching for a good pizza spot since moving to the area 2 1/2 years ago.  Hidden Gem, we tried it on a whim last September after a long day at soccer traveling back after reading other reviews on Yelp.    Have ordered take out  many times since. Try the Grandmom's pizza.   Want to try other things on future visits/orders.  Place is a little small, so there may be a wait, but it is worth it.  Otherwise leverage the take out.  Order is always ready on time and fresh out of the oven.  Great spot!

What a disappointment for a James Beard award winner. I guess James Beard is lowering its standards.  So, to be fair, the bill was seventy dollars for my mom and I. Not a lot of money but not fast food either. The meal was blah. The biscuits and gravy were great! Everything else was mediocre. Scones were burned (yes, I know I'm nit picking but c'mon, if you're going To do something do it well). I guess the really insulting part was the attempted alcohol upsell. The pitch was a free mimosa a person, don't make us ask for it. Just bring it. I recommend this restaurant. Just keep your expectations low and you won't be too disappointed.

I have been ordering pizza from here for over a year ONLY because it's close to my house, but this will be my last time. This is the 1st time I've picked it up pizza from here. There were kids in the restaurant being very loud  obnoxious. I had to wait inside for 30 minutes because they didn't start making the pizza when I called it in 30 minutes before I got there, so I'm total I waited an hour to get a pizza. Literally a pizza, that's all I ordered. I get home and begin eating and the third bite I took had plastic in it! So I called to let them know and they didn't care at all. They just said they would make another one and bring it to me. The "owner" ended up calling me shortly after to ask me if I was referring to the black cups they put on the pizza so the cheese doesn't slide. She was arguing with me about what I thought it was. Needless to say never again.

I've been going to Jack Schmitt ever since I was little and couldn't drive with my dad. Every time we went we were greeted with warm smiles and a IMMACULATE  car. Every nook and cranny was washed rubbed and clean. Now I go to Jack Schmitt and I still am impressed to this day I definitely love going to Jack Schmitt and I recommend all the time to my friends if they need a good car wash

SUPER SLOOOOOOOW! 

Going on 25 min waiting for our drinks. These guys are so smart they are stacking the new cups in the older cups waiting to be made. So the newer orders are made first. These guys are very disorganized.  What a sad excuse for a Starbucks. Not to mention they are out of souvenir mugs....

We started kitchen remodel with Kin and ended up remodeling 2 bathrooms with him.
My experience with him were great.  He listened to our picky requests and offered me several alternatives too.  He did many extra things for me throughout the remodel.

There were a few unexpected things happened. Kin was very honest and worked diligently to fix the problems!

Also I think his price is reasonable.  I picked materials and he charged me the labor. He sometimes buy something and gave me the receipt.  It's very fair.  I trusted him and his long term crews. I often left home while they are working.

One impressive episode, my son accidentally hit the new kitchen cabinet, Kin was so kind he replaced it at no cost!! 

 3 remodel projects took about 3 month ( some rests between the projects) he has been very honest and provided professional job.  I really recommend him.  I will call him again for our next project.

We met another couple for a Sunday afternoon double date at Ed's for ten pin bowling and we had a great time. There was about a 20 minute wait to play, but I think that was fair given that it was 4pm on Sunday of family day long weekend. 

Once we got to the front the staff were pleasant and set us up right away. Not going to lie, I was super pumped about the adorable pink shoes that I was given!! Shoe rentals are only $3. 

The place was fairly clean and the custodian came around fairly often to pick up any garbage, bottles, etc. It looks like they have a quite extensive menu. We just had a few wobbly pops and they had the selection that we were looking for. 

We ended up bowling three games and had a ton of fun - we had no problems with the lanes, pins or balls, which was nice! Games were just under $6 per person and the three games took us just under 2 hours. So that's a fair price per hour entertainment in my books. 

We hadn't been to Ed's in over 3 years. The last time were there we actually rented out the party room and two lanes and had our gift opening there the day after our wedding. And that was a blast!

Excellent experience!  This is the 4th time I've been there with a group and the service was great every time.  We were celebrating a friends 60th birthday and she was treated like a queen. Good happy hour prices on drink and appetizers! I've never had dinner there, but will go back for happy hour!

This Nail Spa is now my favorite. The employees were so friendly and talked to ME and not the other employees. The Spa is modern and clean and my pedicure came out awesome. I have zero negative comments about LV Nails. 

I'm going back for a gel manicure!

My husband and I discovered this awesome place the other day. We wanted something to eat and just about walked into their sidewalk sign.  It read Pernil, rice, tostones and salad.  It sounded good.  Boy was it!!!! The food was awesome.  The staff was amazing, Jamie helped us and was so friendly and funny.  But everyone was so friendly.  It's worth another trip.  

Great food. Great people. Definitely worth the trip.

Thanks everyone!!!!

this restaurant is the definition of lucky location. expensive weak drinks. one good menu item (the burger). and the slowest service i've ever seen. if it wasn't for the fact that it was a great location in lakeview this business would be toast. i heard the way the management treats the staff is horrible and it reflects on the business.

This place is amazing!!! Very welcoming, clean, and has a positive atmosphere. It was my 5 year olds first time ever going into any type of martial arts studio and he was incredibly nervous and a little scared (he thought he was going to have to fight someone). They were SO nice to him, made him feel comfortable, gave him some one on one time to show him what he needed to do and then introduced him to the group. They have an amazing creed the kids have to remember as well. 

I'm very excited to see my son excel in this program!

Frisco is yummy, great atmosphere. Our waiter 
Mark W was absolutely awesome, very attentive, didn't rush us despite how busy it was, very funny, took time to explain menu items, catered to our picky drink needs, and a pleasure. He's clearly seasoned in the restaurant business!

I have never been disappointed while dining at this LornHorn in Citrus Park. Taylor our server greeted us immediately and welcomed us to LongHorn. As always the food was awesome, the French soup was delicious and the drinks were nice and cold. 
However, there was one thing that has been bothering me for sometime. Throughout our dinner there was very small insects flying around.  It has been a problem here at this particular Longhorn, even from previous visits. There are very small flies constantly buzzing around our food and table. If I had to guess what type of insect they are , I would assume they were fruit flies or nats. So annoying

Well, TERRIBLE customer service  for this place because no one answers the phone there. After the initial automated "welcome to Body Central", press 1 for if you are new and want to make appointment for consultation.
I've called twice already at 800am and now at 10:25am, just rings and rings and rings.   
I'm calling the 325-4002 number.

Don't go here if you want to get attacked by the bouncer! Worst experience at a bar!!! The bouncer wearing a cowboy hat physically grabbed my friend and flicked her drink out of her hand spilling it all over her! He was yelling at us saying no outside drinks. Hey, I get it no outside drinks but couldn't he just say it?! Did he have to grab her?! He was totally crazy. The fact that he thinks it's ok to act that way to anyone is crazy. I used to love going there since I lived down the street but after last night I don't think I'll be going back.

My dad and I ate here twice while we were in New Orleans. We aren't big fans of seafood or traditional Cajun/Creole cuisine, so we decided to check out some chains, like this one. Both nights we went, it was pretty busy, but the wait was decent and there were lots of tables inside. The food is not super cheap, but you get a lot for what you pay for so it's worth it.

Seriously, this food was amazing! The first time I ordered nachos and the second time I ordered tacos, both of which were unbelievably delicious. There were lots of choices as far as meat and toppings go, so take your pick. I thought the guacamole was also really good, considering I'm picky when it comes to Mexican restaurants.

From where I live, I would compare Felipe's to Chipotle, Cafe Rio, and Roberto's, but Felipe's definitely takes the crown. Oh, how I wish that Felipe's would open a restaurant in Las Vegas, Nevada!

I used to live in West Vincent Township where the Miller farm is located.  In response to one of the previous reviews, I have never found Ken Miller "surly".  He is a hard working farmer and probably was too tired to talk to that reviewer or flatter his ego.  In addition The cheese made at the Miller farm is outstanding, every bit as tasty and good as any french import I have ever had. THe previous reviewer probably likes Velvetta cheese.

Now I normally come here for dinner (and love it) - but today I didn't feel like dealing with all the craziness of all the traditional brunch places in Phila, so we decided to give it a go for brunch!

We got there right at opening (10 am), so it was pretty dead. We got two egg sandwiches, tater tots, and pancakes, (don't judge us ) and let me tell you what I was so pleasantly surprised. The sandwich was huge and so was the serving of tater tots. Everything was delicious. I feel like we discovered a hidden gem of a brunch spot - especially since it's BYOB! We asked the waitress if it's normally more crowded and she said it really just depends. I will now be coming here for more than just pizza! (But definitely still for pizza because well it's amazing)


Update: ordered takeout from here. When I got home I realized they forgot the side of garlic parm fries I ordered. I had gotten a grilled cheese panini as well and the cheese wasn't melted. When I called to say they forgot my fries they told me unless I wanted to come get them there was nothing they could do. Not even refund me. Disappointing customer service. Triple check your order....

We ordered egg noodle soup with roasted pork and duck which came with a very generous amount of meat! It was lovely! 

We also ordered beef stew and I was not sure what to expect but the meat was flavorful and tender which I appreciated having been in the chill air.

The beef chow fun was mediocre and the noodles kept breaking apart but the beef was tasty. It was probably bland for most people but I like that.

The roasted duck was delicious so we had to order more to take home! 

If we are in town again, I'll remember to come back.

Do not get a cake here.
I thought I would try this place.  I ordered a vanilla cake with buttercream frosting for a 69th anniversary party.  It looked beautiful on the outside, but when we sliced it the layers weren't cake like, they were oily not cake like at all.  There was no taste and we could barely eat it.  Was money thrown away.  The cupcakes may be ok, but I would never buy a cake here again.

This is basically the south side of the old Cafe Sedona on the 2nd floor of the Silver Legacy.  The north end will become Pearl Oyster Bar & Grill.  The menu is pretty much the same as the old Cafe Sedona with a page dedicated to Chinese fare.  Like Cafe Sedona, this is your run-of-the-mill casino diner with the usual suspects: burgers, steaks, sandwiches.  The problem I have here is that I had their pot stickers and prime rib and got really sick.  I'm not sure if it was bad food or the simple fact that I seem to be sensitive to grain-fed beef, but I got really sick.  I usually eat grass-fed beef free of hormones and antibiotics, but I was craving a steak and it was really late.  That is one of the worst things about Reno.  At 9 PM, all the good restaurants close, the ones that have natural, local, organic food so you're left eating garbage and getting sick.  The decor is the same.  You get to watch people walking by and listen to the live music coming from Brew Bros.  I'm not taking any chances and not eating here again.  I think Silver Legacy dining in general has gone downhill.  I had their seafood pan roast at theh old Fairchild's Oyster Bar and the seafood was gross, small, and old.  I'd stick with Eldorado which does a much better job with their restaurants.  You'd think the Caranos would keep standards high across all properties but I guess not.  I'm not bagging on Silver Legacy completely, their Brew Bros is still one of the best nightclubs in Reno.
The tour guide was a little all over the place, but she was brand new so that's cool. Was a really fun time!

The Pho is excellent. Friend spring rolls are good too, but expensive for what you actually get. Favorite beverage? The soda chan. I recommend Far East Nashville for those who wish to try Vietnamese food and those who are already fans alike.

This isn't a Wawa and I'm glad they don't try to be a Wawa.  This is a local store with a small town feel. 
MARY is the manager and she runs a tight ship. Not many business today have young employees that get the job done and have good attitudes while at work.
They have plenty of selections of ready made items at lunch Monday through Friday or order a sandwich that is made with fresh sliced deli meats upon ordering.
The hot sandwiches are very good and my wife really enjoys the BLT on white bread with mayo. 
The rolls and bread are always fresh and never frozen.
The employees get to know their regular customers by name and when you walk in chances are very good you'll be greeted with a Hello before you even get to the counter.
So in my opinion ya don't have to have a Wawa when you have a Heritage's.

Salsa,
Homemade "ranch" worth the trip. Food was good. More fancy than your typical Mexican spot and higher prices. The plates were yugeeee and patio was amazing. Sunday special was a margarita pitcher so we definitely got that too!  Will be back. My arroz con pollo wasn't your typical dish but tasty overall. Could have been more seasoned but I think that is their take!

Great burger, the bun is different than your ordinary bun. They give a lot of fries, both regular and sweet potato fries are tasty. They have a large patio in the back with seats and a good number of spots inside. Never had to wait here. Could be a little cheaper and the food could be a little more of that wow factor. Good date spot overall

It took 2 months to convince myself to give Parx a chance.  I've read many poor reviews and heard some disappointing reviews word of mouth about  this place but said screw it I want to see for myself.  At first glance Parx was clean,  massive,  well lit, not overbearingly smoky,  and perfectly crowded for a Friday evening.  I appreciated being ID'd at the door and headed for the members line.  The customer service young woman Delmira was absolutely wonderful.  She was patient,  friendly, courteous,  and very informative.  After getting my comp card and free 10 bucks I found a slot attendant to ask if they had my favorite slot which only one casino in AC has.  I always always win at that brand machine... always.
