Sorry can't tell you which it is but I walked out with 1200. Anyways. .. the slot attendant was very kind and didn't seem annoyed like most in AC.  Made my way to the bar and was ecstatic to see so many elderly having the time of their lives dancing the night away.  The bartender was very friendly and quick.  The floor was filled with a mix of old and all the brand new slots found in AC. No lie.... this place was much cleaner than Ballys and Ceasars... didn't even see overflowing cigarette butts in the trays. Now I know 6 miles away is the perfect casino for me. All its missing is a beach.

Cozy is probably how I would best describe this wonderful small sandwich shop located in South City. F&B's Eatery serves both hot and cold sandwiches, however the real winner here are their freshly made hand pressed burgers. On multiple visits I have went with a simple bacon cheese burger, and both times it has been cooked and seasoned perfectly. Fries are available in regular or sweet potato, both are good however my recommendation is to go with the sweet potato they are just delicious and made fresh. In fact, everything here is made fresh, and once you get your order you will see that the food is prepared with perfection in mind! 

The burgers are on the smaller size, so if you have a monster appetite I recommend going with a double with a side of fries. Another major plus is that you won't find any corporate soft drinks here, the fountain is loaded up with products by Excel Bottling company which is a locally owned soft drink company. Go ahead give them a try, I am sure you will prefer them over Coke or Pepsi! Service here is very personable and super friendly, both times the cook/owner has been out between orders chatting up with the customers. Overall F&B's is a nice addition to the great South Hampton neighborhood.

I have an adult daughter and she has a particular food allergy and is particular about how she likes her food and what she will eat.  She is not a picky eater, just someone who knows what she will and will not eat.  She ordered a pasta dish and didn't want 3 of the ingredients in it.  The waiter came back to the table to let her know that while they could leave out one of them, the other two were part of the sauce.  He offered her the menu, to which she told him that she could live with the 2 as long as they removed the one.  The wait staff continued to make sure our water was filled, our drinks were filled and the bread was fresh and warm.  My daughter likes tea with LOTS of sugar.  Each time she dressed up her tea, they would come by and take away the 10 empty packs of sugar without a word.  We ordered the sorbet trio for dessert and while the mango and pomegranate were tasty, the blackberry thyme had too much time.  As these are all handmade, maybe they will see this review and hold back a little the next time the make it.  Our waiter and waitress were the best from the moment we ordered water until I paid the check.

We took the lower 9th ward tour in early November and it was fantastic! Our guide, nick, was knowledgeable and funny, making a 3.5 hour tour interesting and fun! He also had a TON of great recommendations for places to eat - we checked out 2 of them and they were legit! Highly recommend this tour and guide!

I was very disappointed with the food especially given the great reviews. It's not cajan food it seems to be French food. As most people point out the service isn't great. I am somewhat of a healthy eater and had a hard timeout finding the meal. I just got the gambo soup. I thought  it was just ok but very small portion. I just didn't like the food and didn't meet our expectations especially given the high prices.

If you like sweat dripping in your eyes until it burns, throwing up in your mouth a little and not being able to lift your arms high enough to wash your hair after your workout, then this is the gym for you! Just kidding, but these classes are SERIOUS. And, I actually have experienced all  of those problems, but the results are more than worth the temporary pain. To say these classes are challenging is just not descriptive enough. It is absolutely the hardest fitness class I have ever done, yet it also the class which has provided noticeable changes the quickest. 

The classes are set up with stations, usually about 5-10, and you may go through them all slowly, spending 3-6 minutes at each, or very quickly - 1 minute each and then going back for another round. I would say it's pretty much circuit training. The staff may feel differently about that description, as they do have a dedicated "SHED Circuit" class on Sundays. I have been to that class as well as the "Upper Body" class on Mondays, and both of those classes use the station structure. The instructors take you through a warm up before you start, and I really appreciate that they always do a demonstration of the exercises as well. All of the exercises are written on a huge whiteboard for reference, but unless you have been doing this for a long time, you may not be familiar with all of the exercises. I am definitely still learning. Afterwards, they also take you through a stretch/cool down/ab workout.

If you're like me, I will not push myself when it comes to my arms, chest and back. I have a lot more strength in my lower body and it's so much easier, mentally and physically, to focus on my legs when I work out alone. I need someone to make me work out my upper body, and the Monday "Upper Body" classes are perfect for that.  

The staff are super helpful and very encouraging. They are attentive, and if you aren't doing an exercise correctly, they will let you know to make sure you don't injure yourself. I have an existing back injury, and I can't do high impact exercises such as running and jumping. There is always a treadmill station in each of the workouts, and they are kind enough to let me do the rowing machine instead, even when there isn't a dedicated rowing station for the particular workout that day. I have taken the majority of my classes with Cody and Derrick, and they are both great instructors. I highly recommend this gym. I have Class Pass, and I have tried MANY gyms and studios throughout the greater Nashville area. Look no further. This is the best one.

We really enjoyed our visit!  Nice place, decent food and drinks.  We ordered pizza on our last visit, which was very tasty!
The service was very good, we sat at the bar.  They offer live music too, which we just stumbled into.
They also have some outside seating.

Small and cozy with a good entry fee.  My kids loved the goats.  Several of the small cats appeared not to be in their enclosures, though, as we circulated through.  (I was really looking forward to the bobcat and serval).  I was a bit concerned for the tiger in the exhibit near the entrance, because its enclosure seemed so small and it seemed to just pace back and forth.  There was a lot of repetition going on in the Exotic Animal House--about 4 or 5 enclosures with the same type of monkey.  The place was nearly empty and the mood was kinda blah.  I think we spent a little less than an hour and saw everything.  Not so bad as a midday activity.

One word- amazing! I could tell by the reviews and the ambiance that this was going to be great, but I had no clue just how great. We were greeted by an extremely charming lady at the counter, which set the tone for the whole visit. I had three different tacos- beef short rib, pulled pork, and sweet and spicy chicken. All were extraordinary and definitely hit the spot! Eat here and eat here often!

Memorably awful. Restaurant fairly empty- took over an hour for food for 3/7 people in our party-- one of the people who actually got food they made it incorrectly but somehow remade it wayyy before the rest of us got food. An hour later after we finally got up to leave and my coworker literally knocked on the kitchen door, they did bring the rest of the food in boxes.. worst part was through the entire hour the waitress did not check on us or acknowledge any issue.. ultimately they did comp most of the food but it was still horrible.. tater tots cooked in old grease- nasty! Boneless wings really overcooked, but the regular wings were alright. After the over an hour wait, one would think the food would at least be hot or taste good. Nah.... after an hour of not acknowledging us, the owner introduced herself..... wow a little too late. Just awful. Never seen anything like it to be honest.

I had the pleasure of learning about Style Me Beautiful from a friend of a friend.   Liz and Maggie are both wonderful to work with.  I had my hair and make up done for my Wedding in May.   They came to the location we were getting ready which was amazing so we could relax a little while getting ready.    I've never felt so good before!!  My hair lasted the entire day thanks to Maggie and my make up was flawless the whole day.  I did not want to take it off.  I would recommened Style me Beautiful to any new brides that are looking for a stress free way look amazing for your big day.

On the quest for great Middle Eastern cuisine I discovered Wah-Gi-Wah!!!!  Thank goodness!  I've only lived in Philly for about 8 months and coming from the DC area Kabob Palace is where it's at!  While Wa-Gi-Wah doesn't compare to the AMAZING Kabob Palace, it's the best substitute I've found in Philly.  I've tried Kabobeesh and that is not where it's at.  The BBQ Platter at Wah-Gi-Wah really give you a bang for your buck!  Great selection, fresh and cooked to order food.  My bf loves the lamb kabob platter.  This is def my top choice when it comes to Middle Eastern cuisine in Philly.

This place was terrible. We ordered online after a little over an hour called and was told the delivery driver had an emergency but they were sending another person to deliver it. Another hour goes by and I call and they said the driver wasnt delivering anymore but another one just came it and it should be there shortly (after over 2 hours at this point) i told them they should inform people not just leave them waiting, I said id just come to pick it up(i had 2 hungry kids at home) i got there and the place was DISGUSTING. The smell was awful. The people didnt washing their hands or wear gloves when making the pizza. This place should be shut down its so gross. Also, The manager is clueless how to run the place and obviously had no idea what to do, as there were two other ppl in front of me upset saying they're calling corporate

Who would have thought some of the best pizza would come right out of a window in the heart of Ybor City? Every time I'm in Ybor I end up getting a slice or two from this joint. It's a godsend especially in the wee hours of the morning after you've been partying all night long and need some fuel. If you don't want to wait for an open table or bar stool inside, jump in line to order your pizza through the window. Their slices are huge and they are generous if you order toppings. The crust is thin and crispy and overall, the pie doesn't seem greasy like most places'. I gotta hand it to them - they know what they're doing!

UPDATE: 10/17/18

YEP. STILL THE BEST PIZZA IN TOWN.

There have been times in my life where I ate at Paco's every day for weeks, and I have enjoyed every meal there. The people are incredibly friendly, the food is both amazing and inexpensive. If I could suggest only one item on their menu, it would be the chicken burro. I have tried burritos all across the southwest and throughout California, including the famed Mission Street burritos in SF. Paco's has always been my favorite. It's simple and delicious, especially with the salsa verde. I can't recommend it enough.

FOOD: I ordered their special, "Salmon Adeline" and the fish was only cooked on the outside.  The entire center of the fish was raw. It sounded great on the menu and looked great when it came out but as soon as I cut into it with my fork it was obvious it was raw. I declined another Salmon and decided to go with their thin crust pizza of sausage, onion and green peppers.  Thin crust, I'll say, it was paper thin and fell apart, the cheese was barely melted and there was only 11 very small squares of green pepper (yes I counted). If you like pizza, don't order this.  

SERVICE:  After I was seated, I observed 3 waitresses huddled in the back talking for 8 minutes before my waitress came to my table. There were only 2 tables with patrons at this time. I placed my order of salmon and an iced tea.  After eating my salad, I placed my empty glass on the edge of the table.  The waitress walked by 4 times, on the 5th time I pointed and she asked if I wanted another tea.  Not too attentive to her customer.  She did apologized about the fish being raw.  When she served the pizza, I had asked for red pepper and oregano.  I waited a few minutes and since she hadn't returned I started to eat the pizza.  I was on my 2nd slice when she came to ask how everything was.  This was the only time she had asked this. I again asked about the spices in which she replied she had forgotten. 

I left 2 slices on the tray and asked for the check. When the cashier asked how everything was I said, Lousy!  She didn't say anything but just looked at me, so I told her the fish was served raw and the pizza wasn't a good pizza.  Her excuse was it was a new cook and she did apologize.  Really, a new cook, they should be fired.  My bill was $12.27.  I had a quarter and penny in my pocket so I gave that to her plus a $20 bill.  I mentioned she probably had a penny somewhere as most cashier stations do. She gave me my change of $7 and 99 cents.  

I've eaten here before both breakfast and dinner.  Overall the food is just average at best.  Service is a hit or miss.  Sometimes good (at breakfast time) and subpar (usually at dinner time).  

There are better places around to eat.  I wont go back.

Anthony of Washington Twp

I was absolutely in ow with this place for years until I visited yesterday for dinner- took out a business partner - it was her first time there  . Everyone including the buss boy was friendly but the older gentleman who was at the register - rude , short and extremely unprofessional. We asked couple questions and he was visibly annoyed with them - couldn't get reed of us quick enough. Left a very unpleasant impression. When we got the food and sat out it was dozens and dozens of flies everywhere including on our food . I was giving them raving reviews and after last night felt like a fool . 
The only reason I gave two starts it is because the food was delicious and the waiter was helpful and friendly . BIG disappointment!!

This was the absolute WORST restaurant food I have ever had. Completely tasteless chicken, previously frozen then fried to a burnt crisp set on a tasteless bun with a spicy (not at all) tasteless dressing. Also a completely tasteless short rib grilled cheese that tasted like OLD GREASE.  HORRIBLE FOOD!

Can't say enough good things about this place. We have been brining our pup Badger here since we first adopted her and we have had nothing but great experiences. Dr. Shaw treats her so well and we trust him completely. If you are looking for a reliable vet and caring staff- look for further!

Is fork still a top restaurant in Philly? Doesn't appear so. 3.5 stars this time around. Service was awkward and prolonged; I have a feeling our waiter was new because he kept filling up our water himself and kept saying there was "good stuff" on the menu when describing it. He unfortunately killed the meal. Tried to tell me the skate dish was not large, but it was the biggest entree. Told my mom the crab app she was getting wasn't spicy at all, despite the jalapeños. Luckily, a manager rectified the situation because our server wasn't anywhere to be found. Manager's service was excellent, but the food itself in all regards (even the "dry aged' Wagyu) seemed to be lacking a punch.
Pizza is delicious, great for take out and small parties. Seating area is small and tight.

What a tasteful, pleasant surprise! I had passed by Kabobeesh a quite few times and finally walked on in. This quaint Pakistani restaurant prides itself on their kabobs, and didn't disappoint. We had a chicken, resham beef, and beef tikka (?) kabob meal. Each came with a side of vegetables, either mixed or an okra mix. Both were very flavorful, as well as a small green salad. My fave was the resham beef kabob. Perfectly seasoned and all were charcoal grilled. The meal also came with fresh, hot naan. Delicious! The authentic grill aroma permiated the restaurant to water the mouth on entry. The dipping sauces, including yogurt and multiple hot stuffs, were readily available at a small station. We took home some baklava that was honey moist, crispy, and finger licking! A simple Pakastani/Indian spot with tons of flavor. I'm looking forward to trying their Biriyani and Curry dishes soon.
Cute, fun, excellent drink menu! Loved all the craft cocktail choices and the old skool classic cocktails!! Sidecar was so sweet and tasty!

I love St. Roch Market. The market is both past and present. My friend tells me it reminds her of when she would come here years ago. I can only attest to what it is now since it has been blighted for the last 10 years. It is a beautiful open spen space where the vendors make you feel welcome. I have sampled a number of the dishes (all good) but must confess I'm addicted to Kristopher Doll's meat plate at Shank Charcuterie. I could eat it at least twice a week. Add a nice glass or two from the wine shop and you have a perfect dinner.

Thankfully I had a discounted Groupon because Tamar B and I will not be returning here for anything. Yikes!

We wanted to grab dinner before a Yelp Event so I purchased a Groupon and came here. I would have been really pissed had I paid "real" money for the sham of a taco they served. 

First, the restaurant is extremely small. Probably about 12 tables total and super close together. Usually small means intimate but its small and very loud. So small that you almost knock a table over that's sitting close to the entrance. However, they do have outside seating. 

We ordered a guacamole and two orders of Cancun Tacos which were made with tilapia, chipotle mayo, pickled onions and cilantro. 

The guacamole was $9!!!! We ate about 3 chips apiece and it was gone. The portion was very small and needed to be salted. Plain and just overall blah. For nine smackers, I want a bowl not a couple of spoonfuls. Ugh. 

The tacos took about a half hour to get to the table. The fish was overcooked, had a microwaved taste to it. Almost as if it were yesterdays fish and someone reheated it and threw crap on them. The tacos were soft so with all the goop thrown on top, you had to eat them with a fork. Yuck. Wet and soggy tacos. Disgusting. 

We were asked if we liked everything and we didn't. I tried to finish my plate. Tamar had hers replaced with a $6 ear of Mexican corn . Overpriced in my opinion. I didn't see anything else on the menu that I wanted so I just didn't finish it. 

Bland food, slow service and too small of a restaurant makes an unhappy customer.

Great food, super friendly staff and quick delivery! What more could you want from your neighborhood pizza & cheesesteak joint?! 

We always order the chipotle wings and white pizza. So delicious :)
 
Only complaint is a minor one, most of the time when we order they are out of their desserts!!  Not a big deal but sometimes I'm craving something sweet. 

Anyway you can't go wrong with this place so give it a try!

-Ordered a supreme pan pizza online delivery.
-Received a hand tossed supreme pizza (crust like frozen pizza. Handtossed=bad) 
-Called and manager said they ran out off "pan pizzas" and they meant to call me but didnt.
- Offered me a $5 coupon
- Fuck pizza hut.

Just got my haircut this weekend. I'm not entirely sure how to feel about the style of the cut yet so I may post another review in a couple of weeks. 
The service was 1 star- the moment I walked in, someone rushed and asked what i needed and then hurried me over for a hair wash. The hair wash was pretty unsatisfying, the woman kept splashing water all over my face and got water in my ears.
The wait wasn't terribly long even without an appointment, that is always the plus. Since there are over 5 stylists working at one time there's always someone to help you. 
I didn't engaged with my stylist the entire time. I think he asked me two questions- what length and if I wanted layers, the rest of the time he just cut my hair and moved on the blow drying. 
I think he could have done a better job with the layering - on shorter hair more layers- more volume and that wasn't the look I was trying to go for. 
Overall, the walk in experience was a 2 out of 5 
The hair cut might be 3 out of 5 since I can't completely say I hate it.

HUSH PUPPIES!!! They were amazing! Seriously, our food was great. We both had the grilled fish and were completely full by the end of our meal. We had ordered the hush puppies for an app and we couldn't stop eating them...even after we were completely full! The kids loved their food too. And as usual, I find that if I order one meal for the kids, this is plenty of food for a 4 & 6 year old.

We sat outside during sunset and although the buildings on the other side of the street didn't allow us to see the actual sunset, it was nice to be outside while the sun was going down. There are umbrellas on the porch too which would be good during the lunch hour and heat of the day.

On a positive note, this place is very clean and does not have the odor some nail salons have.
On a negative note, the gentleman doing my pedicure made a comment regarding my nail fungus as being a lack of calcium and made recommendations as to what I should use to cure this.  I have been to 3 podiatrists, and dermatologists regarding this. I have had laser treatments and have also used topical and holistic measures to cure it.  Prior to this visit I have not been to a salon for a pedicure because I am embarrassed by this condition and also did not want to spread this by any means.  With this being said, I feel that the employees should keep their opinions to themselves and not make medical guesses or recommendations.

Just ate here for the first time. The sauces are so watered down, it was bland and had almost no flavor. Added additional sauce, soy sauce and salt after they cooked my bowl, still bland and the flavor was poor. Our server was kind, but the food won't have us coming back.
employees are great, latte was amazing and had a design, the avocado toast was super good

The first impression left a lot to be desired. Our server was also seating people. My husband and I asked about a dirty table for four. She said she'd clean it and we could sit there if we wanted. Then a group of 4 older people approached and she rudely told them there were no tables available (there was a two top). Chris and I gave them the 4 top and sat at the 2 top. They were so appreciative, but the server was mad! The food pretty much made up for it though. I got a delicious waffle with a ton of whipped cream. After I scraped off some of the cream I saw that the waffle had an imprint of the Liberty Bell. Pretty cool. The waffle itself was airy, and delicious! Hubby enjoyed his too and the service was super fast.
If you want fresh, crisp, and cheap, then this is your place, usually packed out with fellow like minded produce seeking customers...in the back right hnad corner of the terminal...

We went to this place for brunch on Sunday morning and mad a reservation. Our waiter was very funny!! I got the eggs benedict and the eggs were way over cooked. Other than that the food was very good. We had the friend pickles which were one of my favorites ever. The sweet potato skins were amazing!!! We also had the beignets which were amazingly light and tasty. The best thing on the brunch menu has to be the french toast with the creme anglaise it was so good and could serve two. Dont forget to check out the okra at the bloody mary bar!

Amazing food. We had the bore marrow, catch of the of the day, and the duck confit. They were all amazing, especially the veggies and sauces the entrees were served with. 

The food does come a little slower than in most places, so be prepared to spend a good hour and half or two. 

The cocktails were interesting but were not particularly impressive. Possibly could have stuck to beer or wine.

I don't usually order takeout/ delivery but when I do I typically order several items from the menu because A) I was craving a bunch of stuff B) I like to test out all the foods for a fair review. I ordered plain pizza, cheesesteak Stromboli, fries, and tiramisu. The pizza was fantastic. The Stromboli was out of this world. I'm glad they put the sauce on the side. It was huge so I will say I wish they included another order of sauce. The fries were amazingly made of potatoes and not greasy at all. My issue came in w the dessert. The tiramisu was frozen as I but into the center of the cake. You could tell it was not a popular item because it probably came out of the freezer. Not sure I can judge this on flavor because again it was frozen and a disappointment. Otherwise I will also say no napkins, or utensils were given and that was a negative. I would definitely order again now that I know they do have quality food. Thanks for turning my bad day better!

This place is phenomenal. The quality of the haircuts and the personalized customer service is unparalleled and worth every penny (not to mention the time im taking to write this review, which is rare for me). 

Elvis just gave me one of the best haircuts I have ever received in my 27 years. Not only did he give me exactly what I asked for--which says a lot because I'm picky and scrutinizing--but he improved on my usual style in a way that I'm going to incorporate going forward from now on. And he managed to do this even though the last person who cut my hair drastically screwed it up. So, Elvis was a life saver!

I can't even begin to say how thankful I am for Elvis not only fixing my botched haircut but making me look awesome! I start a new job at a corporate law firm in one week, and we all know how important it is to look good when you work in a profession where you interact with other people. Now I'm going to start my job feeling confident because I know My hair looks great, and that confidence is going to help me make great first impressions at my new job, I just know it. And I owe that largely to Elvis!

The haircut is great: it has aspects of both a chic salon cut on top and a clean barber shop fade on the sides. It's easy to style, and I can put it up in front or lay it down and slick it back. That is so rare. And it's hard to get the barber shop look that's so trendy these days anywhere other than a barber shop, where you risk coming home with a lopsided haircut because the barber just rushed through the job with huge scissors (that was what happened with my last haircut. The barbers are just so hit-or-miss, you never know what you're going to get, and so often barber cuts look good at first then a couple days later look uneven and lopsided). But I've never had that experience at a nice salon like this, where stylists like Elvis use careful techniques to give you that high-quality salon look on top. Seriously, I look like I just paid $100 for this haircut. 

Again, in addition to great haircuts, the service exceeded my expectations. Elvis is friendly, charming, and funny! He always makes me feels valued as a client, remembers my name, and makes me feel very welcome when I arrive. He even offers me coffee. Then, not before telling me a series of jokes which I appreciate, he takes time to ask me exactly what I want from my haircut, and makes sure I know that he's heard what I want before digging in. And then, throughout, he stays engaged and maintains friendly conversation. That's so important to me because I mucho prefer natural human interaction to awkward silence or the like. Simply put, Elvis is the man! 

I will definitely be back. I already have referred this spot and Elvis to my family and friends, and will do so in the future. You should take this review as a personal recommendation if you want a great haircut at a reasonable price from an awesome, professional, personable stylist.

We have been going there for almost nine years.  We have had one or two less than perfect meals, but they always make up for any shortcomings.  Can't ask for anything better than that.  The food is impeccable, prepared just right, and served with great care.
We go there for special occasions, guests, out-of-town guests, family, etc.  Owners are local and almost always there, wanting to know how to do better.  I don't know, maybe free?

The staff was exceptionally friendly and accommodating!  I ordered my bridesmaid dress back in August which was scheduled to arrive in November.  Unfortunately, I fell ill and could not attend the wedding or even leave the house to drive and pick up my dress.  I called to make sure my dress was still there and to inform them that I still planned to pick it up within the week.  The woman that I spoke to offered to mail me my dress at no shipping charge to me.  I  thought that was an above and beyond move!  I received my dress in perfect shape within a week via UPS.  I was very pleased!
If you dont mind sitting down with random strangers and have things get really awkward than this place is for you. Place has lots of strict rules. but food is pretty good.

Not your normal liquor store!! Chef Rene is in back cooking a killin menu. Some real authentic Mexican food and a great sandwich section. I never leave disappointed. You gotta try there home made salsas!! Keep up the great work Rene!!

Either the yelpers over sold this one, or maybe you just get used to your local pizza, or maybe it was a bad day but the pizza was just OK. A-OK as Yelp says. The pizza is neither thin nor thick. Sauce was plentiful. Cheese, no so much. Mushrooms were canned. Since they are in the Italian village I was hoping for something more autnentic; either authentic Italian or authentic Philly would have done.
So cute and I can always find something unique! Wish they were open later but one of my favorite stores by far!
This is THE PLACE FOR WAXING in Tucson. They are so thorough, and don't leave any patches or hairs behind. They are pricey, but worth it when you want a great waxing job!

Disappointed. My total was almost $60.00 (pre-tip), and I received very little food for that amount of money. Everything was rather pricey. We ordered steamed pork 'n chive dumplings, sesame balls, Shanghai shumai, Spicy Beef Szechuan Style, Edamame, Pickled Radish w/ Shredded Pork Soup, Mixed Vegetables, and a Steamed Pork Bun. Barring the spicy beef entrée, these are all very small dishes ("dim sum" = small plates).

The Shanghai Shumai, Steamed Pork Bun, and sesame balls were very bland and lacking in flavor. The sesame balls were very doughy, with barely any filling. The sweet black bean paste inside a sesame ball is to die for, so I was rather disappointed.

The Pickled Radish w/ Shredded Pork Soup was ok flavor-wise, but it featured only a few noodles and other ingredients. Too broth-y.

The edamame was very tough and stringy, pretty much unpalatable.

I will say that the Spicy Beef Szechuan Style was delicious. Flavorful and full of depth. This was the saving grace of the meal.

I may come back for the spicy beef, but I will have to look elsewhere to get my sesame ball fix. =(

By the time these photos were taken, great amount of food had already been eaten. I must say, this is one of my new favorite place to have lunch in Tampa. It was already crowded with a lot of locals waiting in line for their food. The wait wasn't too long though. They also have plenty of outdoor seating including a repurposed shed for shaded outdoor seating. I will definitely consider this place for catering of future home parties, work, etc.

Really impressed with the food here! 

It's a small spot, so plan to arrive early or expect a wait, but it's definitely worth it. It has all the price points you'd expect at a breakfast restaurant, but definitely an elevation of the old favorites. My breakfast sandwich was delicious - probably the best I've ever had - and I honestly couldn't even finish it. I loved the gravy on top. Obviously messy, but a truly tasty sandwich. Also, while a small orange juice is $5, it packs a punch. Would order again.

The only thing keeping this from 5 stars is that our server was really having an off day. He forgot a few things, then brought out the wrong meals to our table, and also totally rearranged the items on the bill. We resolved this with him while we we there, but our whole table left thinking that he really was flustered. Maybe his first day? He was very polite and understanding, so no hard feelings on our side. 

I'll be passing this along to friends as a go-to spot for breakfast. Next time I'm getting a cinnamon roll!

I am a fan! While this isn't gourmet pizza, it's still really good and delicious. The delivery service is awesome and fast. In addition to the pizza, the salad is really good. I would order from Zio over many other options in the city!

The Rooster for me will always be the DMV where I took my driver's test. Yep, I'm that old ;-)  

We love the Rooster.  Hubs and I go 'off-peak' times and rarely have issues with waiting for a table, or the time it takes for the food to arrive.  My usual, the "Farmer's Feast" is a heart attack waiting to happen, I get it with Grits instead of potatoes -- a much more generous bowl of grits than Denny's :-). Really Good Coffee and huge glasses of iced tea round off our breakfast well.

Hubs always eats what I don't, and I usually end up taking the pancakes home to 'fry again in just a little bit of butter...'  -- which, if you've never tried it, probably could be a concept for a new pancake house, "Twice - Fried Pancakes!" *yum*

The owner is usually there, keeping a watchful eye, and our servers are extremely capable, efficient, fast & friendly - kind of truck-stop/diner style of service... (a good thing).

The artist who decorated the building is fab (I think he's the same guy who has done Chuy's here in Tucson) - -and it is really cute with the farm/rooster/animals/barn theme. There's a little gift shop with chicken/rooster things, and it seems like it supports local business and organizations with fliers and posters; which I think is awesome.  

I have to disagree with the reviewer who said it compares to the Good Egg... I love the Good Egg (for different reasons), but The Happy Rooster is much more down-to-earth and traditional 'diner' style with its menu options... the healthy choice options are: oatmeal, or fruit, or a bagel.

I've now made 3 purchases from STL Beds, Doug has helped me with all 3. When my wife and I got married we were in a rush and strapped for cash not only for the wedding but to get into a place and get our bed. Both of us are bigger people but I'm a bit larger than life at almost 400 pounds, unfortunately my weight was too much for the frame we were given and the box spring also broke. My first purchase was a new frame made for supporting a water bed but very adequate for obese people, the difference it made even with a broken box spring and our piece of crap mattress was insane. Our next purchase was going to be a box spring (it's all I've ever known) Doug talked me out of a box spring and got us setup with a forever foundation, it was easy to put together (easier than the bed frame actually) and yet again the difference it made even with this god awful mattress was incredible. Unfortunately for the 5mos we've been living in our apartment my back has hurt every single night, there are nights I go out to the living room and sleep on our oversized chair because it's more comfortable than the mattress. Today I pulled the trigger on a two sided medicoil HD 1500 a mattress made for obese people to avoid the very problems I've been having with our current mattress. I feel confident that in less than a week I'll be able to be very comfortable in my bedroom again and it's all thanks to Doug who has been extremely patient taking his time to help me via email and ship things almost entirely across the country. Doug is extremely knowledgeable and the fact that they serve the obese population makes me eternally grateful. I don't plan on being this size forever but it's awesome to know that someone cares about my business while I am this size and for those who's circumstances are beyond their control. I recommend this business to everyone reading this, I don't think you could possibly go wrong.
Meh. Nice atmosphere, food is pretty good but nothing stellar. It's a little pricey too. I wasn't impressed enough to want to go back.

Two of my co workers recommended this place. Everything that I have ordered has been fresh, fast and wonderful. I decided to order online last Friday night on my way home from work and the order was waiting for me when I got there 30 min later. If I have any criticism, it's that their portions are way too large. But their selection and variety are top notch!

Love everything about this place. I was looking to change salons and was calling around when I discovered Salon Patine. Emily answered my call and she was great. She gave me some background on the salon and the stylists there and was able to give me some great recommendations. She was very patient and nice which I rarely see at other SB salons. I chose Hannah as I remembered seeing many positive reviews about her on Yelp. She is absolutely AMAZING! I left loving my hair but I waited a few days to write a review because I wanted to see how it would look after sleeping with it wet and trying to style it on my own. My hair looks great no matter what I do. I absolutely love it and have received many compliments. I will definitely go back and highly recommend Hannah!

This place is amazing! So relaxing and smells beyond words with all the essential oils and organic products that they offer. The facility is warm and inviting and the staff create a wonderful energy that you can sense through the entier facility! I love my new hair style and I will defenatly be back!

I have been here before for used tires and the service was always good.  Today I needed to come here because my car had two tires that each needed a flat repair.  Lucky me right? 

Anyway I came here probably around 1:00 and Gave my information and was waited on very quickly.  I left my car with them and said I'd be back to pick it up.  They pulled my car right in and had it done within an hour and called me like I asked. 

They are faster to do the work than some of the big chains who kind of push a flat repair to the side if it didn't warrant a tire sale.   And they make you wait for hours to get your car or tell you your gonna have to leave it. 

I chose to leave mine and come back for it cause they are close to my house.  They are always very nice and very quick to assist and get you in and out!   Great job!!!!

Traveled outside my usual perimeter for dinner and ended up at Gino's due to a friends recommendation. On this busy Friday night there was a definite left hand doesn't quite know what right hand is doing vibe. However once our drinks arrived and were quickly followed by simple garden salads with a tasty vinaigrette (no dressing choice given) and mediocre garlic rolls things went smoothly. I had the best chicken Marsala I've ever put in my mouth. Delicious sauce with sliced mushrooms and chicken cutlets filled the plate. I had a side of pasta with their very flavorful house marinara. If I visit again I want my pasta in the Marsala sauce. It was that good.
Gal at the check out counter was curt and unfriendly. I get it's a busy Friday night but let's just be nice, ok?

We recently ate at Buttonwood Grill. Delicious food and drinks. Really liked the atmosphere and location. The service was extremely professional and attentive. Our waitress , Lindsay, was very efficient. She was knowledgeable and very friendly. Very nice service , even when the restaurant was very busy.

Visited here after seeing article in Phila paper. This place won't make it. At least not without major changes. 

Had chicken, ribs, mashed potatoes, vegan chili, green beans, and apple crisp. Chicken had good smoked flavor, but skin was soggy. Overall, not bad.  Not great either. The ribs were just OK.  Again, not great.  The potatoes were very good, but the green beans tasted like stewed tomatoes. Yuk. Husband liked the chili, but it came out with the rest of the meal, which was a bit strange. The white bread that we received was stale.  Husband took one bite and left the rest.  The apple crisp was very good, but ala mode added $2.50 to the tab -- for about 2 tablespoons of ice cream!   

Everything here was overpriced, and the food at best just wasn't that special.  The plates are small, and placed within small metal baking trays. It was hard to eat.  

You can get much better food for this price elsewhere. Don't waste your time or money here. You will probably be disappointed.

I have been a member for about approximately eleven years since the opening of the LA Fitness in Cherry Hill, NJ. Initially, it was a beautiful club with new equipment and a staff that cared. However, the past two years, I have found the overall gym cleanliness and the good working condition of equipment VERY unsatisfactory. I have noted that some of the equipment has not performed accordingly and the locker rooms are absolutely filthy. 
An example is the treadmill or elliptical, which has been making squeaky noises when in use. While there is a general announcement for gym members to keep the gym equipment clean following use, I believe the housekeeping or maintenance team can take measures to prevent certain equipment, like the treadmill, from damage and malfunction.
I also wish to take this opportunity to inform you that on several occasions, I have found the bathrooms/changing room conditions to be dreadful.  There is a large amount of paper towel on the floor. Floors look constantly dirty with hair and fuzz all over the floor. There are broken lockers doors that have gone unfixed for many months, if not a year. Toilets and showers are in terrible condition and not always cleaned. I am disgusted every time I enter their changing rooms/bathrooms. Do you realize, sweat can also accumulate and breed bacteria? Uncleanly fitness centers are a liability to your business. A lack of deep cleaning could spread bacteria like ring worm. Cleanliness should be a top priority at your club!! Without proper cleaning and disinfecting, gyms can quickly become a breeding ground for bacteria and unpleasant odor. The place should be clean and shiny like a hospital and I can tell you it's not even close! There is nothing worse than going into a gym and seeing dirty carpets and floors, no soap or paper towels left in dispenser, dirty bathrooms, weights everywhere and broken down equipment. 
I have paid 3 years in advanced for their membership and now want nothing more to just get my one year left refunded! Safety and health issues are my biggest problems at this gym and I can tell you I do not feel like they address these concerns at all to their employees.
Tourist trap. Expensive. Worst po-boy we had in NOLA, we ordered crawfish, but you couldn't really tell what deep fried thing it was, the batter was so thick. Fried tomatoes were dry and tasteless.
Good food and great attentive service! Getting 4 out of 5 because most of the menu options were California style rolls. Everything was good but nothing really blew me away.
Great dinner! Very affordable. Very friendly and attentive staff. Generous proportions. I'll be back

Cutest spa ever! The staff is overwhelmingly helpful. A very special place. They offer every beauty treatment under the sun. I had an amazing facial with Karen. My skin felt super smooth and looked radiant when I left. Be sure to check out the trendy little boutique too. Their menu includes, massages, facials, waxing, manicures and pedicures. The setting is tranquil and soft.

Provisions is my favourite kitchen store in Edmonton, no question.
It isn't huge and it doesn't have 50 different kinds of the same item, but you can trust that what it does have will be fantastic.
And despite the specialty nature of the store, the prices of most items aren't outrageous (especially considering the quality).
The service is always top notch and they even sell frozen pie dough, chocolate, salted caramel and baking books to put it all together. 
Is there any doubt this would be one of my favourite stops in town?

We went there for lunch on Saturday. The atmosphere was fabulous! Our meals were good, although the Bavarian Platte (two sausages with sauerkraut and potato salad) was a little mediocre. I would highly recommend the Kassler Ripchen (hardwood smoked bone-in pork chop with apple sauce). We also had their Black Forest Cake, which was bad and too sweet. It's like what you can get from any supermarket or Walmart.  I'll definitely go there again and try other items on the lunch menu next time.

This was a great place but i have a warning!!!! Ambiance was fantastic, all the sauces were great!! We had deviled eggs, prime rib, fries and beans, all were fantastic, steak was  done exactly how we ordered, everything was fresh and hot. Now for the warning... there are no prices listed for the signature product... whiskey, i had the Sinatra select. I like good whiskey and was... I thought prepared for the bill but it was $55 a glass, well ok someone should warn a guy if a drink with no price is over lets say $30 especially when a mixer was $11 ok overall great experience but.... I'll order jim beam in a jack Daniel restaurant next time!

I don't even know where to begin with my last visit. After a horrible experience with the towing company our insurance agent recommended (which was in no way connected with Royal Kia), the service department at Kia made sure to turn my visit into a positive one. It began by me getting a flat tire on my Acura and not having the wheel key to unlock my wheel locks. Fortunately/unfortunately my car has these certain tires that have taken other tire shops a few days to get. How long did it take Kia? 2 hours! I was shocked and so happy. After taking off all of my wheel locks, and replacing with new lug nuts (and not just doing the new tires so I wouldn't have this problem in the future), they did a beautiful job detailing my car which is always the icing on the cake. My car drives beautifully again. Kia was efficient, extremely helpful and overall did a fabulous job with my car.

We stopped in here yesterday for a quick bite. Had 1/4 chicken, Sizzler sandwich and hummus. Everything was really good. So good we went back today and tried some other stuff. Can't wait to go back. I pray they can establish a good base of customers so they stick around for a long time
Pleasantly surprised by this place. I liked the table side salsa. Margs were pretty good too. Menu was really diverse.

Bigger than it looks from the outside, Mario & Frank have a good thing going at the tail end of Nottingham Way in Trenton/Hamilton, NJ.  Apparently, there are at least three other shops, as this one says it is number IV. I can understand why they have expanded.  Their food is very good as far as old school pizza parlors go.  Short menu with the usual suspects, but what they do, they do well.  This is a family operation, and during the course of my lunch, I received service from at least three of them.  All friendly, efficient, and happy to have one more customer in the house.  

I ordered the Eggplant Parm Sandwich.  It arrived about 10 minutes later on a white oval plate (no paper here).  It was neatly transected amidship, with three layers of lightly breaded, twice sautéed eggplant, just enough mozza (not drowning in it), and dollops of homemade chunky tomato sauce with the right amount of garlic and pepper for a great aroma.  

It is my habit lately, due to trying to reduce carbs, to eat almost every sandwich open face, to reduce the bread intake.  Thus, I was able to eat each layer of eggplant top to bottom, and enjoy each bite.  It was very good.  I couldn't resist a few bites of the roll.  The top was shiny and the bottom nicely showing flour and yeast remnants.  It was also enjoyable, and left me wanting to abandon my dietary resolution for another day.   

The plan now is to find and try the other Mario & Franks locations and see how they measure up. If as good as #4, the discovery will be a great tasty adventure.
Best Sushi in St Pete. Fresh, delicious, great service. Doesn't get any better. All fish is fresh on Mondays, that's why they're closed. We loved it and would be back in a second!

Believe these reviews.  Cary and his crew removed a MONSTER banyan tree for me and did an amazing job.  There were power lines very close to the branches and they had to get part of it done through the neighbors yard.  They show up on time, care about how they do the job and follow through.  You won't find a better tree service anywhere.

Please read about the Ravioli!

Started with the Bruschetta and ignoring the description, it wasn't something I would order again. It wasn't your traditional bruschetta and not very enjoyable. However, this was my fault for not reading the description, and not the restaurants fault for their actual appetizer.

For my entree however, I ordered the Shrimp Mousse Ravioli. Wow. The flavors, texture, presentation, amazing. I have absolutely nothing bad to say. It was hands down the best ravioli i've ever had, and would encourage those who visit to order this entree first before anything else. Absolutely amazing dish. 

Drinks were good and prices were what you would expect from a fine dining restaurant on state street. Everything is made in house from a family owned business. Definitely worth stopping by if you're a foodie.

This has been one of my go to Thai spots for a while - but I recently experienced the worst service here. I've visited this restaurant at least 5x-6x before . On Saturday 1/4/2020 -  I called 40 mins before they were closing to ask if a table of 3 would be okay. A girl answered and said "yes, but come quickly!" 
I let her know we were 10 mins away. Once we arrive, a male worker just told us to sit wherever. Sure thing. We sit and at least 5-10 minutes go by without any menus. We had to get them ourselves because we just wanted a quick bite. My boyfriend went up to ask for them and he said he felt a hard grip from the waiter when asking for the menus - as if we were a burden to come visit and provide business to the restaurant.

We then look at the menu and decide and the male waiter doesn't smile or treat us like paying guest and just takes our order. I had to repeat myself when saying "beef pad see ew" because he said "did you say beef" - not that I wasn't already annoyed to start but it really seemed like he didn't care to be working based on my interpretation. 
They were already near closing time so I get it, sure. But then an elderly couple comes in and the host walks them to their table and smiles and gives them menus right. away! What the... where was that service when my party  came in? Eventually I'm sure they are at closing time and I see them bringing in two other parties as well with no issue as well. Okay...?

My gripe is that 1. I call in as a courtesy because I usually don't like coming in near closing because I worked at a restaurant before. 2. They treat other guests better? Maybe not consciously but come on? Is it because we  look younger? 3. The current waiters and hosts don't seem to care much about their job 

Food was fine. We got a tofu pad kee mao, beef pad see ew,  seafood tom yum soup, and the tamarind chili wings. That said it was ridiculous that the charge was $3 for a side of noodles that was very small lol... PLUS the waiter did not let us know. You can get a bag of rice noodles for a $1 back in LA. 

Anyways, I don't think I'll be recommending this place because of the service because I left with a sour taste in my mouth. If it was a over the counter, order, and pick up your meal and find a table kind of place - I wouldn't bother to write a review like this, but because I've visited so many times and to have this kind of experience where it's as if our table is experiencing prejudice - nope. My advice is fine waiters who are impartial and treat all guests the same please - otherwise the food won't cut it.

The only person who made it up was a sweet girl who got the check for us, got our take out box, and  refilled our water before paying. She was kind and I wish she was the one who took our order to start. Hopefully my review changes in the future, but I don't see myself visiting a while.

Decent place, but I really don't want to see political messaging on the face masks of employees.

It's bad enough that during a pandemic we have to put up with all the protocols of social distancing and masking and all of that, but to come into a restaurant and pay top dollar, I now have to stare at your politics??

Tacky.  Inappropriate.  

Please and no thank you.
I been using them for years. They always get everything right and know what they are doing. Very happy and satisfied. Highly recommend.

E Fizz gave amazing service and delivered the best southern chopped i've had this week, because it is a favorite. Always impressed with the service no matter who it is but always want to give credit where credit is due. Thank you Erin!

Fantastic service, felt like we were taken care of every moment of the day. Scott was very attentive to the needs of our group. Scott was extremely friendly, personable, and just a great person to chat with. He was knowledgeable of the region's wine growing history, geography, and of the wineries visited. A well curated day! Definitely recommended.

I went here with my family because they didn't want to wait at Ruth's. For the price the food wasn't great. And the portions were small. We went at like 10 on a Sunday and it wasn't busy. There are other fantastic breakfast places in Indy I would go to before this in a heartbeat.

Cool concept! Definitely could be executed better though. 
We came in super excited to check it out. So much nostalgia, we loved it!! We enjoyed sitting in the area with the couches and board games. 

Unfortunately, the service was one of the worst experiences ever. I'm a server. I am very understanding when it comes to service, but a nasty attitude is UNACCEPTABLE. To say our server, Rosie, was unfriendly is an understatement. She was flat out rude, condescending, and snarky. She genuinely seemed bothered by our presence which really put a damper on our good mood. She was so awful that we ended up leaving to go somewhere else because we couldn't take her attitude anymore. I could go into more detail, but I think you get the point. 

Food was okay. We ordered several items. Some of the order was wrong, but we just ate it. I enjoyed the cauliflower, although I think it should be accompanied with dipping sauce. Specialty drinks seemed really cool, but we didn't try any.

We couldn't find a game that wasn't missing pieces. This sucked because we loved the place, and we were really looking forward to playing some games. We felt like there are a few ways that you could prevent this problem. Would also be cool if they played old school movies and music instead of current stuff.


Anyway, I would try again, but hopefully we get a different server next time.

I have nothing but wonderful things to say about my experience with Allen's.  My car had scratches on the door that were completely removed!  The inside is spotless and shines.  The process was so quick too.  When finished, they delivered my car directly to my house.  Price was extremely reasonable.  I recommend them to anyone that has a car in need of a good scrub!

We visit here frequently, always stop in to say hello to Jame, she gives a great tour of the upstairs, which is a very large space with lots of history and major "activity" going on. The crypt in the back is worth a visit, turn off the lights and sit in the dark for a few minutes to get a real feel of the atmosphere. Young children may get scared, so don't push them, however tweens should really enjoy it.

After receiving a recommendation from a co-worker, I started going to Dr. Stone. He is by far the most well rounded dentist that I have ever been to. He's gentle, empathetic and I've never gotten the impression that he was doing unnecessary work just to make a quick buck. I've been going to Dr. Stone for about 5 years now and his dedication to me as a patient and his commitment to quality service has not wavered. I would wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone that's in the market for a new dentist.

If I could give this company less than one star I would. The job described and the job actually done were two different things completely. The rep, Mike Harris, did the old bait and switch and when questioned, he tried talking in circles to avoid answering the questions asked. When we showed him photos of the work that was being done, he tried to divert the conversation. If a topcoat of asphalt was what he was offering I would've not had the job done. Now, we're left with a mess around our stone garden borders that we need to fix. Don't confuse this company with the more reputable Harris Blacktopping of Yardley. That's the mistake we made. Don't fall for the bait and switch. Our next step is a report to the BBB.

This place is incredible! First time there the other day for brunch. Had the specialty mimosa and the special was an amazing quiche ! Like wow! I was thrilled with everything from atmosphere, food (incredible), prices, service, and the pour (heavy)! And when I went to the bathroom (which is downstairs), I found an awesome speakeasy bar! Hopefully COVID restrictions will be lifted so I can head down there! 

I think our waitresses name was Jenny? She really knew what she was talking about and gave me a great recommendation:)
The best Vietnamese food I've had. You must try the pork stirfry noodles, the Pho is ridiculous. If you like Vietnamese food you must try this place , did I mention they have the best prices too.

Absolutely delicious! I've been here many times and always enjoy the food and the fun atmosphere. Their Santa Barbara location is cute and cozy and makes for a fun night out!! Delicious food and talented with their cocktails. If they're busy (which they usually are), sit at the bar and watch the chefs at work! Always a great evening!!
Another awesome place to bring a friend. Great wine selection. Great food. Service has always been great. The crabmeat crepe is usually what I order. Yum!
Love my Carmel Frappes.

Not much to say other than we view this as a below average dining experience. Out of spaghetti so son settled for linguini and meat sauce. Oort marinara (sorry for poor spelling) sauce was burnt. Giving a second star because of the salad accompanying the meal. It was large and fresh. Other than that, quite disappointing.

I was here the last time I visited NOLA and am so happy I found it again! You order at the counter and the staff brings the food out to you. Absolutely fresh and healthy combinations that are vegetarian and vegan. I had the Carmo Salad which is an enormous plate of deliciousness. My friend had the Peruano with vegan sausage, which she said was excellent. The lemonade is just right, not too sweet, not too tart. If you want unusual and interesting combinations of flavors, this is an excellent place to go!

This is my second time here. First before covid and now the last time is during covid. The tables are all spaced and they have outdoor seating. Staff is gloved and masked which is great. We were able to eat outside but It was a significantly longer wait and they don't do reservations. Obviously It was very busy around breakfast/brunch when we went but we knew that. Service was so so not overly slow but not too fast. My breakfast was good. Potatoes seemed slightly on the undercooked side but my boyfriend also got them and his were perfect. The omelette was good almost too cheesy and way too many red onions. Otherwise was good overall. Iced coffee with vanilla was great. But could take It or leave It. Nothing outstanding but if you want a good place for breakfast that is cute check It out. Pretty classic breakfast options.

Upon walking into restaurant there is a terrible smell and that should of told me something was not right but I sat down.  Ordered sesame beef...  Noticed very dirty table in spots where previous person was.  Should of ran at that point but no I wanted to give it a try.  People across from us requested manager and complained that after waiting over a half hour they had no soup,appetizer or nothing and questioned if they had ever worked in a restaurant. The managers reply was "I can make it now for you"--they got up and left as she was on tight work schedule.  Our egg drop soup arrived and was hot but I had only a small sip and about lost it.  It had a funny smell and a chemical taste that overpowered any resemblance of soup.  It was not fit for human consumption.  Manager sits down and says oh --I have replace your sesame beef with chicken as we are out of beef then leaves.  Out comes the sesame chicken and it was like a processed tv dinner type chicken.  Egg roll had a funny taste---kinda chemical in  nature also.  Very seldom do I give a poor review but to sum up our experience RUN, RUN FAST AND NEVER THINK OF GOING HERE.  If any of us could see the kitchen we would of all ran as that smell is terrible and at age 63 I have never tasted soup with that chemical flavor.  HEALTH DEPARTMENT SHOULD SHUT THEM DOWN......

Nathaniel was very prompt and professional when the hot water in our shower began to sputter causing my partner and I to take a number of very chilly showers! While another plumber had immediately jumped to how we should spend $$$ on a new hot water heater, Nathaniel offered a number of other lower cost interventions to get our hot showers back! His friendly and efficient demeanor made it easy to ask questions and trust the answers. This is our first experience with home ownership and in the past 6months I've met and worked with many different kinds of contractors (eg electricians, plumbers, general contractors) and I will definitely call Nathaniel again for any plumbing concerns. I highly recommend him!

I have been coming to Blue Dot Water for some time now and I love Love LOOVEEE this place. I've watched this place grow. Chris and Christina are amazing and kindest people you could ever meet! It's such a friendly place to come in and fill up for water. I love water and YES WATER HAS A TASTE for those of you who do not know the difference in water, this place will change that. The staff are always so friendly and super helpful. Great business BEST WATER IN TOWN HANDS DOWN! They also have an array amount of hydro flasks from size to color :) KEEP UP THE GREAT WORK GUYS!!!!

All I can say is "wow!"  This tour is worth every penny. Our tour guide was phenomenal, his breadth of knowledge was praise-worthy. Go on the weekend so you can definitely tour the recording room where Elvis recorded many albums. If you love music (not just country), you should definitely add this to your places to visit in Nashville. Even my ten year old son was enthralled.  Loved it.

On 5/14, my family and I came to La Scala's (party of 12!!) and the service was unbeatable. Rosario took the time to tell us about the menu, the wines (he even taught us to pronounce the names of the wines), and the cocktails. He was fast/efficient, but he also took the time for us and joked with us. His engagement with us made the experience even better. We did not feel rushed at any point, and Rosario was right there when we needed anything. Another server, Joseph, also contributed to our experience by monitoring our table and answering questions. I have not had an experience of this caliber at a restaurant with such a large dinner party - it was quite impressive. Not only that, but our food was absolutely incredible. I had veal piccata and it was EXCELLENT. Everyone agreed that the food was outstanding.

What a SCAM. This place will take your money and then never call you again. I've placed multiple claims and emailed their customer service SO MANY TIMES and haven't heard anything back.

Their representatives never know anything and seem totally clueless. It takes FOREVER to get a response from anyone. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE.
Salads were amazing. They served us after they has closed. Southern hospitality!! The other food smelled great. We'll return during normal business hours.

Now this Mexican restaurant has a good flavor. Friendly with good service . Medium priced i enjoyed a great  Margarita . Then i enjoyed. A outstanding chicken fajita. Beans. And rice .

Truly a great Tucson. Restaurant

I had gone out walking to get the lay of the land; and, after stopping into a few surf shops, decided on a refreshment.  I came in for what sounded like a terrific Oatmeal Stout; but, Melissa said they were out, so I opted for another dark, craft beer... little did I know this was a spectacular brew that sells for an exorbitant price.  I also ordered a Cinnamon Toast Crunch shot, which had Fireball and Rumchattah in it.  With tip, the total came to $20, which seemed a bit steep.  However, I couldn't linger, as my wife needed to go to the hospital just a few minutes after I ordered.  I downed my drinks and made a dash out the door.

I ordered a designer's choice arrangement for my friend's birthday, and Jasmine absolutely nailed it! My friend loves Japanese culture so she did her own take on Ikebana with stunning results. Jasmine really did an excellent job and made this arrangement feel personalized and special. Next time I'm needing an arrangement I will absolutely be returning to Jasmine.

I eat here often while in STL for work. The staff is very friendly. The bartender Jeff is great. Typically, I order the salmon. It's prepared medium and is delicious. I've had other entrees as well, which are equally as good. It's a good ambiance and a great value.

I wanted to love Delicia. This was my second trip, the other being a few years ago. Honestly, for the price, I'm pretty disappointed. We went during midtown specials week and even so paid too much for the quality we got. 
Drinks: Paloma was good, fire and ice interesting and good 
Food: appetizer salad and taquito were not impressive. Taquito came out cold and the salad was just average. For entrees we got the churrasco and the pork chop and while both were decent they lacked flavor and the pork chop had a large fatty piece. I could have made a more flavorful steak or chop at home. 
The one happy note here is the flan was GREAT. I'm glad my drink and flan was good otherwise it would have been a total fail. I won't be back any time soon.. there are much better places to spend $100 on dinner in the area.

I coordinate several events each month for my company, and Philadelphia Catering is my absolute go-to. They consistently deliver top-notch food and service for an incredible value. Most recently we hosted an event, and with less than a weeks notice, our registration numbers suddenly increased. Megan, our coordinator, was patient and always quick to respond with updated invoices to accommodate for our several adjustments. Every interaction I've had, from office staff to event staff, has been fabulous - everyone is very kind and accommodating. The food is awesome, too! They offer a varied menu, and they're gracious about catering to special dietary requests : i.e., Gluten-free, dairy-free, etc. I'd highly recommend Philadelphia Catering for your next event - fancy, casual, or backyard party, I think they can do it all.
The breakfast food is good but everything else is average at best.  Service is average.

Amazing hot summer day treat!

This was my first time at Rita's and the girl that helped me said I should try the Gelati because it's one of their popular items. Well let me tell ya, I am IN LOVE with their Gelati! I got the pineapple Italian ice with the vanilla frozen custard. Ooh man, it definitely hit the icy, sweet tooth, spot.  

So, if you're in the Northwest area, check out this place for a cool treat! :)

The menu is meat-heavy, but there are numerous vegetarian gems that are astonishingly good. The service is fast and the prices are more than reasonable. This place is worth going out of your way to try, be sure to make a reservation.

You'll leave feeling healthier than when you arrived! 

Definitely try their hot chocolate, and the burger was to die for.

I was excited for them to finally open because I love chicago beef

Needs are good service is good atmosphere is good

But the salads were not good. The lettuce was very brown ruined it for me.

Made a reservation and was called while on the way to pick up the rental and advised not to come because they didn't have my car. Dear Hertz-isn't that what the reservation is for? Don't take the reservation if you can't follow through. Also, try not to be a total jerk on the phone. Would leave zero stars if possible.

We just came to Chick-fil-A and Viris our favorite person of all time  helped us out and made our day which was unbelievably stressful with a raging fire burning near our house, so much more easy going to have a nice smiling face greet you first thing in the morning thank you so much Viris
Literally the slowest drive thru I have ever been to in my life. You make burgers and hotdogs. And half the time you get the order wrong. It's just ridiculous. This place sucks.

Branch is closed,Dade city closed. People have to go all the way to Wesley Chapel to Bank if they do not bank on line!For Seniors who don't drive very far,don't have on line banking or a computer,this is unacceptable. Close your account & move your $$$-it isn't worth the hassle!
The gyros here are delicious. So is the hummus! The staff is pretty friendly, and the food comes out in a decent amount of time. It's a little over priced though.
After not feeling an hour and a half wait at Martin we (group of 13) walked into this hidden gem. The drinks were well crafted and the food was fresh a very tasty, from burgers to salads.
Great place to watch the Saints and Seahawks! Indoor and outdoor seating with a back bar.

The Horizon Services team was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient.  We had a HVAC service call on Wednesday and they found the compressor on our 7 year old Carrier AC unit was busted.  Doug (the Horizon technician) did the diagnostics and research and found that our unit was still under warranty and had a new compressor installed for us by Friday afternoon.  We are grateful for the responsiveness and diligence of the Horizon team.  We would definitely recommend them!

One of the handful left in central Indiana! Love their Dole selection but call before you go if you're going for a specific flavor. I went and hoped to get pineapple and they swapped it out for their featured jolly rancher stuff. Not a fan of that! And we drove quite a bit to get there. Lesson learned! Otherwise, it's the usual orange leaf vibe with an outdoor patio, which is awesome for the nice weather.

Fun place Gillys inside The Nugget. Line dancing lessons and mechanical bull riding.  Had a great time. Appetizers plentiful, prime rib dinner excellent and large portion.  A definite stop in Reno for a gun time and people watching.
Freshest uni possible. At ~$15 per urchin, it really can't be beat. This was definitely the highlight of my Santa Barbara trip!
Friendly staff,  but very loud, also the food is very expensive and the red sauce is to watery.

Wonderful salon! The staff and my stylist Marie are professional and take great pride and care in keeping their clients' hair healthy and beautiful. This is the best salon I've visited in Missouri and the 3 other states I've l lived in. You should definitely try it out.

The quality and service has really slipped at this Habit. I tried calling in my order to avoid waiting in line. Nobody answers the phone. I called 15 times and it just goes immediately to a recorded message. So I had to order when I got there. The burger was smashed and the bun was grilled until hard. The fries were not hot. When I asked for a new bun, they took so long preparing it that the meat was cold. They also are not allowing indoor dining and the bathrooms are closed. I guess they just don't want to work to keep things clean. The Habit in Lompoc has much better service and you can eat inside and the bathrooms are open.  I will say after I complained, they remade it and it was hot and good. The manager also gave me. Coupon for a free cheeseburger in the future.
Nice casual place with a big bar. If you are in jovial mood and want some creative cocktails or want a good fish sandwich this is your place

The man working here named Das was a complete and utter nightmare. He had a total attitude while giving me my order and when I asked a simple question he made this disgusted face at me. I felt like dumping my coffee in his face by the time I left.

Every time I dine at Frammi's the food is amazing. I always stick to the Italian dishes because the owners are from Italy. One day I'll force myself to try some thing that's not Italian but Why change when it's so good.  I have visited many Italian restaurants in the area and in Clearwater and Saint Pete and this is by far the best and most authentic Italian food I have found. My personal favorites so far are the eggplant Parmesan, pasta carbonara, pasta with Vongole clams, and the pasta with salmone. For dessert the tiramisu is amazing- homemade! You won't go wrong eating at this place.

Worst experience with a repair service ever. The repairman wasn't in the house 5 minutes when he was trying to up-sell us to a new a/c unit to the tune of $10,000. He used what I would call fear factor by telling us that he could have a new system completely installed the next day or we'd have to wait 4 days for the part to be ordered (because of the holiday weekend). We're new to the area and he seemed to sense that & attempt to take full advantage of the situation. Stay away!  We will be using another company to do the needed repairs. They only received one star because I couldn't submit this review with no stars! 

Update:  we called another a/c company and their technician was able to provide us the parts we needed for $700 less than the Air Rescue quote. The tech also advised us not to replace the system. He assessed the system as "top of the line" which still had many years of life left in it!

Zero stars would be more accurate. I can't actually rate the food because I walked away due to the incredibly rude staff. No greeting, no can I help you, nothing. Just a disinterested attitude. Ugghh.

This review is for Jake. The best barista I have ever known. 
He made THE best latte. and i only went here for that reason. Your morning cup of joe is important, and how well it is crafted is a big deal. I hope that one of the new guys will be able to replace him (so far....not so much...).
I know he's no longer with the company. But someone needs to know how ballin' he was at his job.
Life without Jake - 0 stars :(

I loved the pizza! The crust was nice and crunchy and had the perfect amount of sauce and cheese. The antipasti salad also hit the spot and I loved the vinaigrette, it didn't have a in-your-face bite that a lot of bite that most vinaigrettes have. I loved the garlic knots, but some of then did not have enough seasoning. The calzone was HUGE! It was bigger then my face! The crust on that was nice and golden and was filled to the brim with very good cheese, although, I did not like the ricotta in it because it was bland. All together, I loved the pizza but fell short on the seasoning of the garlic knots. I did like them, but the others in my group called them "just baked balls of dough".

Hands down, the worst experience I have had with any company  that has done work on my house in the 19 years that I've owned it.  I paid $6000 for new front doors that should have been a really easy installation.  I waited 3 months to get these doors and, when they finally arrived, I had little communication as to what to expect.  The installers were on time and very professional. Although I paid for hardware holes to be bored on both of the new doors, only one door had them. I was not offered the chance to have that fixed by the installers. They simply told me I should take the hardware I had purchased back and get some that would work on a door that had no holes.  When it was time for them to leave they pointed out that the 1/4" gap between the tile and the new door would be something that I could take care of with grout or caulk.  I also had to repair and paint the wall where they ripped a chunk out of the drywall.  When we walked outside, I was stunned to see that the framing was not completed and was told that the "stucco guys would be around in 2-3 days" to finish the job. I had NO previous communication about this. I was not given the choice to have a wood frame. The guys arrived a few days later and did a good job on the stucco but left a mess on my porch. I also found out that WE had to paint the stucco.  We had no touch up paint left and had to go to our Homeowners Association to find out what color of paint to buy. So many surprises and so much finish work for US to do on a $6000 job!!  I received an EMAIL from the company after the installation asking if they had met my expectations.  I replied that they really hadn't and sent detailed info about my "surprises."  I received an EMAIL back, not a phone call. The only phone call I got was to ask for my payment.  When I told the young lady that I still had some questions, she got the Installation Manager on the phone.  Of all the people I dealt with at Carrollwood Window and Door, Bruce was the only one that really cared. He listened to my concerns and agreed that I had very legitimate concerns and that he would be out to handle them himself.  In the meantime, the door did NOT pass inspection with Hillsborough County because they did not secure it completely.  Bruce assured me that he would take care of it when he came out.  He arrived, listened and told me that he hadn't read the Inspection report.  He did not have the tools he needed on his truck to finish the job, but guaranteed me that the installers would be back out that afternoon. He called me after he left and told me that they would be there at 2:30 and would give me a courtesy call to let me know they were on their way.   At 4:30 I finally called him, told him that no one had called or bothered to show up. I had been very patient until this point but was really furious by then. The amount of time I spent trying to get my job finished and the number of trips they made was just ridiculous.  They finally came back out and finished the job and it passed inspection...three weeks to the day after they initially put the doors in.  Now all I have to do is wait for the painter to arrive because, after a $6000 job, a lot of grief, and not even an offer to take any money off for all of their mistakes, we still have to pay $875 to get these doors finished/painted!!!
