My advice to you if you are considering Carrollwood Window and Door is to RUN not walk the other way.  I need a whole house full of windows and decided to start with the doors.  They actually had the audacity to say that they hoped I would call them to do this job.  Wow. 

Note that the pictures I've attached were taken the day of the installation.

Happened in after taking in a movie with friends. Plenty of street parking on a Saturday night and plenty of room inside the place. Situated on the corner of 12th and Green, the space is fairly large with plenty of seating, several flat screens lining the walls (all playing Austin Powers 3 on TBS, which was oddly a great conversation piece) and some great beers on tap for a reasonable price.

We had a great time in the relaxed place, joking around with the friendly staff, chowing down on some yummy hummus (though they didn't have the pita so we got toasted bread), and great beer. Love a place you can hang out and talk in a normal voice rather than yelling over a blaring sound system. They do have a jukebox where you can pick your own tunes.

Quite enjoyable. Will definitely go back and recommend to others.
Great grilled fresh food

I grew up in Northern VA where Korean food is abundant and I ate/still eat a lot of it whenever I'm home. To me, the center city location is just ok. Food is good but not great and the menu is super limited. They do give you a good amount of banchan. I had the dolsot bibimbap recently which was good and the seafood pancake. My friend kept biting on hard pieces from the pancake that the waitress/sous chef told us was cartilage from the squid. I definitely believe them, just have never had that experience with other pajuns before. I think this place does the job in satisfying Korean food cravings in center city since there's a general lack of it but not my favorite place in the greater area.

I take my elderly father there for his macular degeneration and FINALLY my family has decided that this place isn't suitable for farm animals! They treat the elderly like cattle! Have been going there for years and not sure why we haven't left sooner, probably because it was just convenient and close to home for my Dad. But NO MORE!! ENOUGH! You go there and sit sometimes for hours. Dr. Sardi takes all but one minute to run in give his little hello and injection. Could care less about his patients. Cattle!! Move them in and out!! No compassion and very rude. My father questioned him about why injections were stopped in his left eye, and he didn't like the questions and thought my father was being argumentative and told office staff that he wouldn't see Dad unless a family member was with him!!! My Dad is the most peaceful man I know. He just didn't like being questioned! Ever since that day, we've had nothing but problems in that office. My Dad is a WWII Vet, an amazing man, going on 97 years old and deserves respect! That doctor is the worst doctor we have ever encountered. All my Dad's doctors in other practices literally adore him!! I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND this office or Dr. Sardi to anyone. IT'S ABSOLUTELY HORRENDOUS!!

As a Philadelphian and history minor I think the Founding Fathers would be proud of this place... 4 Yelps for the following reasons: 
1. Civics: Atmosphere is great, high ceilings, open space, lots of TVs but you don't necessarily feel like you're in a sports bar, its clean and modern but warm at the same time.
2. Representation: The service was great, very friendly staff who made good recommendations, we were sort of tag teamed by the bar tender and another server and never felt like anyone was hovering, but our beers never went empty either.   
3. Freedom: The Beer selection is great, ranging from well known staples (ie: Yungling) to harder to find beers such as my new face the Ommegang Hennepin. 
4. All (bar food) is created equally: The food is done well but you don't have many choices past the common bar food.  Not to say you won't enjoy eating here if you want a burger or onion rings or a flat bread, all of the food is good quality, done right and tasty.  I'd definitely return to try the flat breads and the dirty fries.  
So, hear ye, hear ye, come to Founding Fathers for a good time, good beer, and to enjoy well done bar food.

I can't believe I haven't reviewed Heights Meat Market yet! I love coming here for special occasions or if I just want to try something different. I'm also very lucky that I'm a quick 5 minute drive away.

They have pretty much every kind of meat that you can imagine from Elk to Ostrich. I've gotten some really amazing Pork Butts here. I've also tried their Wagyu Hamburgers and Hotdogs which were phenomenal. They also offer a variety of sauces and spices in-store. All the meats are pre-wrapped for freshness but you can also call and they will special order anything your heart desires.

You'll notice that the quality of the meats here is SO much better than what you'll find at Publix. I definitely think you get what you pay for when it comes to meat. Also, the staff is always helpful and friendly. Definitely come check this place out the next time you need to stock up on meat!
Casual atmosphere, good food, friendly service. Mine was made to order but they have some things set up cafeteria style so would be perfect for a quick lunch.

I normally don't leave reviews but the food and the service were amazing. I had to comment. The shrimp and grits were a first for me and they were awesome! The waitress was great. The manager stopped by our table and gave us great advice on things to do in Franklin. Make this a for sure place to eat!

Well, first I have to say that their sales people are VERY aggressive.  We actually were followed the first time we came in after politely stating that we just wanted to check out the store.  The store is big, clean, well lit and have a nice variety.  But, the sales guy was so aggressive that we left.  We looked at the site online, applied there for a line of credit.  They claim to have "Yes Money" and they will finance almost anyone.  let me say that the online app was worthless.  They take basic info and then just end up calling you, verifying the info on the phone and then you have to bring in paperwork, paystubs, references, etc.  But - whatever - it's all part of the process I guess.  So we returned.  Soon as we walked in, THREE salesmen started to circle us, almost like vultures.  We stopped the closest one, and told him, "yes, we have been here, yes we applied for credit, and please leave us alone so we can look at stuff and decide." he obliged, but managed to stalk us throughout the store and approached us 4 more times.  I appreciate trying to make a sale, working on commission, etc but it was too much.  But, we also found out that if you don't qualify for their financing, then they refer you to another choice which is managed by RENT-A-CENTER.  Um, no thanks.  I'm not interested in rent-a-center, rent to own, and paying double for merchandise.  So, we told them, thanks but no thanks.  

So, short story is, only come in if you have a high tolerance for aggressive, pushy salesman and good credit.  Otherwise, you might as well go to the local rent to to own store where you will probably have better luck.

Buyer beware! The price you see on the internet does not include a $1200.00 prep fee. The prep fee from my understanding brings the car up to par so that you can then purchase additional coverage via their warranty. Expect to pay much more than the "base" price. NO DEAL.
Killer bread, no more need be said.... got the crusty loafs, wow, too good!

The design of the place is cute and the smell from the outside drew in my brother.

However, the costumer service was eh. My brother asked a girl for a sample which she gladly gave us but then just walked away to the back. A guy eventually came out but he was definitely new because he didn't seem like he knew what he was doing and had to ask the girl that walked away to come back and figure out where the checkout screen on the iPad was.

We bought a small bag of KETTLE & one of CARAMEL. I really liked the caramel one; my mom liked it too and she's very picky with her stuff.

Don't know if this place wil last very long but I'll be back soon to get another bag of caramel.

Oh and they have weekly or daily specials on the board on the right when you walk in.

It's an experience. If you are over 21 and out for a fun night this could be your place. The wait staff is intentionally insulting which is part of the 'fun'.  The food was reasonably ok to good. We had fun but probably wouldn't take kids there. We were with kids under 12 - one was in heaven when eating crab legs. Both saw party toys from 1 of 3 bachelorette parties happening in the same room. That was not appropriate. Enjoy for the schtick- not for kids.

We went to this mall to check out the new movie theater (Studio Movie Grill) and had some time to waste before the show started so we walked around. I had been to this mall maybe 7 or 8 years ago and oh man how things have changed. 
This place is 100% Ghetto now. 
This place would actually improve if it turned into an Outlet Mall or an Indoor Flea Market.

Let me give you a rundown of what kind of stores are left: 

9 stores that just sell sports shoes (3 of them are Foot Locker and 2 are Journey's).
10 places that sell cheap gold chains.
5 stores whom just sell baseball hats.
2 Hong Kong nail salons. 
A Tattoo pallor
A 'smoke' shop
A Sheriff's Office Substation
The clothing stores sell 'urban wear' that was the in style back in the 90's (think baggy pants and Wu Tang t-shirts.
 1/2 of the food court is closed down, the only Department Stores are Sears, Burlington, and a Dillard's Clearance Center.

If you like People Watching this is a great place if you want to see a Parade of Homeless, Douchebags, Stripers, Players, Pimps, unsupervised screaming children, pregnant teen moms, and the always lovable Mentally ill.

I got to the store at 8am and had very prompt service, the assistant manager assested me and was very helpful. While waiting for my tire to be changed they were unable to locate the tire I had originally paid for. Wes advised me they upgraded my tire and covered the extra cost. I am always so pleased with the service here. Thanks guys!

This is my second time coming here. I came about 2 years ago to get my VCH with guest piercer Elayne Angel. I came back today because I wanted another piercing and wanted a triple forward helix. Nate Janke, another guest piercer from MN came over and we started discussing what had brought me in today. He said that based on my anatomy, a triple helix might not be the best, but that a double would def. Work really well. I mentioned that I had a hankering for 3 piercings today and he showed me some pictures and I showed him some of mine and we finally decided on a design and jewelry. (See attached picture for reference of finished work)

All in all I was very satisfied with him. He was sweet and professional and informative, funny and efficient. It was a pleasure to be pierced by him. MAKE SURE YOU TIP ACCORDINGLY! :) I def. Did. 

All in all, finished work was $282.48

This i a great date night spot as well as a fun place for birthdays or other event celebrations. The crowd participation option is very entertaining and can be taken lightly to seriously. I was able to participate onstage as a volunteer and earned a free pass to come back another night. They also teach stand up/improve comedy classes!

Who doesn't love Dorman?  As Indy grows, it's nice that a little neighborhood family-owned spot is still thriving and keeping true to its mission.  They have a great selection of beers and booze, along with a very short lits of mixed drinks, all of which are long soda concoctions that will get you drunk as hell.  But you don't go to Dorman to sip fancy cocktails - this is a great place to chill with friends, enjoy the intimate patio, play some tunes on the excellent juke, or scarf some pizza.  Dorman, I hope you never change.

Received Groupon = motivation to go here. Creole cuisine...yes, please.

It's in a quaint residential neighborhood, which unfortunately means the parking is horrendous, but we were not going to be deterred. Upon entering, we noticed it is much smaller than we expected; it definitely has a neighborhood feel. We got a table in the back by the kitchen and ordered some beer they had on tap....probably a Kenzinger or something, nothing crazy.

The food. Oh my. The Duck Jumbalaya was phenomenal. Spicy, hearty, flavorful, texture is right on, and it looks pretty. :) Also, the gumbo is quite different and delicious. It is a little more loose than your typical gumbo, very, very dark, and a little salty. Try it, it is worth it. 

I would definitely revisit for some more jumbalaya. Also, it looks like there is an area for outdoor seating on warmer days.
They have great service, good food, and great music. I also like the vegetarian options.

this was absolutely the worst food i've had in my life.  They gave me steak tacos in dollar store tortillas that were literally fat rolled up in rubber.  I choked on a piece of fat that made up the entire bite i took n when i called to complain they said thats how mexicans like their food.  Ive never heard of cutting up fat n serving it but i got my $ back.  My friend got chicken enchiladas he said they were ok.  I'll never go back.

Overall it's okay. The combo deals are priced very well for the portions you get. The flavor was mediocre. Ranked "best" to least is : chorizo , pastor , asada, carnitas , barbocoa ( ground beef lame ). If one star is tacobell and 5 stars is gramdma Juana from Tijuana... it sits right at 3 stars for everything from food, service and ambience. 
Pro: portion to price ratio. Grilled tortillas.
Con: lackluster flavor. White onions v red.

I went to this Beyond Bread location for the first time recently and was not disappointed.  The building used to be a Blockbuster, so there is plenty of space, but now there is nice flooring.  I got breakfast for the first time, and I have to say, the breakfast sandwich was amazing!  I got "Santiago's Sonoran" which is ham, egg, provolone and green chile.  The breakfast sandwich also comes with potato pancakes which are great.  Plus, this is all for under 6 bucks!  In short, Beyond Bread continues to deliver great food that would impress anyone from anywhere.

The food at Thai Cuisine is delicious and, best of all, vegan-friendly. There are many meat and egg-free dishes on the menu. Better yet, they will veganize just about anything if you ask.

The ambiance and service are always top-notch. They even do great take out! 

If you like fresh, veggie-based Thai food be sure to give this place a try.

LOCATION:  @ the Ritz Carlton Bacara (near the lobby)
FOOD:  
APPETIZER
1. Shrimp Empanadas - 2 empanadas served. pastry was crispy and light.   filling had a lot of shrimp.  avocado chimichurri was a great compliment.
2. Tuna Tosada - 3 small tostadas served.  refreshing.  hint of acidity balanced w/ the avocado mousse.  
ENTREES
1. Tacos Al Pastor - 3 tacos served.  flavorful tacos.  not overly oily and greasy like usual street tacos.  
2. Arroz con pollo - a very hearty dish.  unless you are very hungry, there will be leftovers.  after a good mix, all the flavors and textures meld together and every bite was fantastic.  the grilled queso panelo was rich and creamy and was great with the fresh jalapenos.
DESSERT
Spanish churros - who doesn't love churros?  these churros aren't overly sweet and the dark chocolate dipping sauce was decadent.
SERVICE:  our waiter (Amir ???) was spot on with all his recommendations.  he was charismatic and very catering.  food came out in a timely manner.
MISC:  beauty here is there was no wait, we were seated by the hostess immediately.  outside seating was great because of the ambience and view.  pricing here was very reasonable.  
OVERALL:  no open reservations for Angel Oak during our stay at the Bacara, so we headed to O'Bar for dinner.  pleasantly surprised with the food and fast service.  this is a great option if you happen to miss Angel Oak.  Would eat here again.

if i could give them zero star, i would. they have really bad credential reputation. my friend and i split the check into $23.42 and i gave them $3.5 tips. HOWEVER all of our bank records say each of us spent 62 dollars at this restaurant
Awful service. Someone got and walked out. Waitress was terrible. Must have been her first day. Only 2 tables including me!!!!! This place is normally good.

We stopped by Cafe Beinet over the course of our few days in NOLA.  It was always a little crowded (the wait topped off at 30 minutes) but the staff was moving quickly and the food was coming out quickly as well.

The beinets here are INCREDIBLE.  Of course Cafe du Monde is a staple, but with the lines and fanfare we far preferred Cafe Beinet.  The sandwiches looked great, but we stuck with coffee and beinets which were delicious.

The outdoor seating area is a little rough around the edges, but it's beautiful and worth spending a few minutes.  

A highly recommended spot - delicious, friendly, welcoming...all really great attributes for a tiny restaurant with a line out the door.

Favorite place to stop!! We read reviews on yelp and went for it... Couldn't be happier that we did! The pizzas are unique. And flavorful, you can't go wrong with which one you choose. We also had the Greek salad which we are officially addicted to. In the past month already been there 3 times! Go for it!!

From outside the place just draws you in. Neat old place just South of downtown and right next to the Sinner's Shrine. Neat outdoor seating in an enclosed and shaded patio covered in flowering vines. Inside the feel is warm and inviting. On a Friday it wasn't too crowded early (5:30). There was a sitting duo playing soft Mexican music on guitars. Nice as it was good background but you could still talk. And there was no awkwardness associated with the typical wandering musicians you often see in Tucson Mexican restaurants. The chips were good as was the salsa--standard spiciness with minimal chunks in it, just as I like it. I had water to drink but the wife had a margarita. Both came in the same plastic cups. The margarita was nothing to write home about. There are certainly better ones all over town. While it was acceptable, it was likely just tequila and generic margarita mix with lime keeping regular table salt around the rim of the glass, er, plastic cup. I ordered, and thoroughly enjoyed the chili relleno. The chili itself was very fresh and the cheese inside flavorful with a good sauce on the outside. The rice was standard fare and sadly the beans on the side were subpar. You would not be hard pressed to find better beans almost anywhere else in town. The wife had a chicken chimichanga. It had a nice looking sauce on it. She thoroughly enjoyed it. Also it was large enough that a third of it was brought home and enjoyed as a leftover for lunch. 
Service was punctual but it took me half our trip to figure out if the waiter was happy we were there or not. Halfway through our meal though the friendliness with which we were conveying was warmly returned back our way. 
While I can certainly see myself returning, there are better places in town to enjoy Mexican food. And like I said, the margarita is poor enough that it really should be skipped altogether. I'll stick to my favorite for regular outings for Mexican likely--Las Cazuelitas on 22nd.
Overall decent to average food but an above average patio and location.

In a trendy spot at 49th and Penn, Apocalypse Burger has a nice open interior and some outside seating. 

You look up the menu with your phone and a QR Code.

I ordered The 16$ meal I picked  loaded fries with out scallions ( we all shared ) , Swagyu Beef Hotdog with only mustard and onion. (Forgot to take pic of dog) It came with mustard, onion , ketchup and pickle relish, wasn't too happy about that. I picked off what I could of the relish. The hotdog was good. Would have been better without the ketchup. Fries were amazing and bacon and cheese sauce was great. 

Husband got the smashpocalypse burger and fries. He said the burger was great but a bit messy. Extra napkins weren't available near by. 

Friend got plain jane and fries. Her fries got forgot. She liked her burger. 

Other friend got fried chicken sandwich. She said it was ok, not great not bad. 

We all shared an order of onion rings. We all said they were amazing!!

Husband and I shared a black out ding dong cake. Being dark chocolate he loved it. I thought it was ok one bite was enough for me.


*** I ordered what I thought was a meal combo not seeing it was a Devour Indy Menu. 16$ for loaded cheese fries, hotdog, and drink. I was charged 10$ for fries, 10$ for dog and 3$ for drink. If the Devour Indy is not an on going menu it needs to be deleted.***

Review 1000

A total fraud and rip off in Reno. Matches are complete garbage and losers. Not even worth the time to drive to meet your date let alone the money you pay for it. After the first ugly date, I walked away when seeing all the others. (did not even bother to talk to them or meet them) This program should be illegal and out of busienss!  My Dates were all ugly, fat and strange low lifes!

Sunday brunch, no jazz band needed! Delicious drinks, salad, gumbo, entrees, and a beautiful courtyard. Definitely check this French quarter gem out as they have great service also. We loved their version of chicken gumbo. The chicken is "shredded" for a great texture.  All around quality food and casual, friendly servers.

Made an appointment with them to fix my leaky shower panel. The day they were supposed to come out, they emailed and said they had van trouble and they'd let me know when and if they could come out. Later that day, they emailed again saying their van would not be fixed until the following day and would be out at 12:30. By 1:30, they still hadn't arrived so I emailed them but received no reply. So not only did I waste one day waiting for them but two. That's a terrible way to run a so called business and an ignorant thing to do to someone who is also trying to make a living.
Amazing food, wonderful service! If you are looking for a place to just chill & have a great meal this is it! You have to try it out!

The food is pretty good here, but the waitresses may be a little ditzy. Probably a good thing for business when it comes to the guys who go there to get wasted and flirt a little, but not when you're going in there to enjoy a meal. We asked for a cheese burger....CHEESE ONLY...they put mayonaise on it...YUCK...so we had them take it back...all they did was put the burger back on the grill and bring it back out...supposedly it was to burn the mayo off, but didn't work...so then we had to send it back again. By the time we got that burger, everyone else in the party was done eating...so remember...CHEESE ONLY...means ONLY CHEESE, hold the condiments please :)

I absolutely LOVE this place and will surely be back. The caramel apple pancakes were SO good. Breakfast and dessert in one. My daughter devoured them. I did ask to have my caramel sauce on the side - good thing because it's REALLY sweet and it didn't even finish half of it. I also got an omelet with mushrooms, onions, green peppers and American cheese. Great. My soy caramel mocha was pretty but wasn't sweet enough for me. I'll try something else next time. So...yeah. I'll be back. Maybe tomorrow!

Needed a new microwave but as I'm on crutches and couldn't find a cart anywhere, a super helpful associate (maybe manager?) not only carried my microwave upfront but made sure it was taken to the till and then personally carried it outside to my car. I'm super grateful for this and is one of the reasons I return to shop here due to the good customer service I have gotten in the past.

I should have read the reviews before going but I had been to busch gardens Tampa a few years ago and it was amazing. I guess they're trying to make back their revenue losses from covid... 

$100 a ticket, paid $45 for preferred parking online only to arrive and be told that parking was full and i'd have to go get a refund. Why would they keep selling preferred parking when they knew it was full? Plus once in the park they didn't even give me a refund, but a $20 park credit which I ended up spending on ONE (1) nasty hotdog and some bottles of water. If they actually cared about customers they'd have water bottle filling stations. The only other food I purchased was 4 chicken tenders and cold fries costing $15. 

Here's the kicker: The entire day, never stepped foot on a ride. Some rides had over two hour waits and all others were shut down. On top of that, now you have to PAY to leave your belongings in a locker in order to get on any ride, either $8 for the whole day or $2 a ride I think. It's a small thing but it really made me feel that the park was trying to squeeze out every penny they could. Even the sky ride was closed. I wouldn't be upset if I knew any of this beforehand. Also, bird exhibit where the birds come and land on you: gone. 

The day was spent walking around sweating our butts off looking for literally anything to do. 
Such a huge waste of so much money and the day.

It's been awhile since we have dined here & I remember now why we haven't returned. We started with 5 lbs of crawfish, 4 of us at the table & none of us could eat them, we sent them back, mind you I NEVER send food back! The crawfish themselves were not good.. ordered the crawfish Taylor, that was good, its fried crawfish tails in a creamy sauce & stuffed into a "taco" type bowl. Next was the lobster bisque, not good save your money, also had the corn & crab soup, I have never tasted anything like this in my entire life, this "soup" tasted like what you would think licking an ashtray would taste like, it WAS THAT BAD, H O R R I B L E!!! . My daughter had the chicken parmigiana & she said that was good. My husband & I split the shrimp plate, it had fried shrimp, shrimp etouffee, boiled shrimp, grilled shrimp & 1 stuffed shrimp, which I found the stuffing to be freezer burned. I couldn't even compliment their tea as the lemons they use taste like a mixture of a lemon & orange & tasted like they didn't wash the pesticides off of them.  I will not waste my money again to try this place. The only thing that was worth the money is the waitresses & tonight was her first night!

Sabrina's was awesome - got the blue cheese and bacon frittata and the huevos rancheros. Very creative with flavors and large portions. All of the wait staff dresses like a bunch of damn hipsters so be prepared :-) but really nice people great service and phenomenal food!

Great food, interesting and different menu, good service. These are veteran restaurateurs, and they have a strong following. We were delighted to see Guy and Cathy back at it again!! There are a lot of tables outside, which was nice on a comfortable summer night. Inside it is loud, very loud. VERY loud. I would strongly recommend a reservation, especially if the weather is bad, since there isn't anywhere to wait really inside the restaurant. Staff was very friendly and accommodating. Overall it was very good and we will be back!!
A blend of European style cafe aesthetics with amazing Southern Comfort food. We loved their Creamy Crawfish Pasta and Lafayette Chicken. Their eggplant sandwich was also very good.

Beautiful theater....excellently restored with lovely ornate details. Every seat provides an excellent view of the stage. No complaints- great performances at very reasonable prices. The smaller seating is attributed to the time the theater was constructed, which was in the 1920's when the average size person was much smaller than people today. Overall this is a wonderful place to see theater. Highly recommended place to visit and enjoy a show!

Inspirational  displays that are constantly changing.  Knowledgeable staff and unique collection of plants, pots, statuary and everything garden. This is where I go for that something special whether a gift, garden element or bedding plant.  Also, just a fun place to browse.

I was so excited when I was told that a food truck would be at The Still in the Heights tonight. First Friday at The Still is always a great time but three hours straight of drinking free rum, brandy, and absinthe without food is probably not the smartest thing to do. 

Keon and his staff at the Claws Food Truck were very friendly and a pleasure to deal with. I placed my order and was so delighted that they took credit cards! 

I placed an order for the Claws Mac and Lobster Balls. The food took less than ten minutes before it was ready. 

The balls were very good. I liked the fact that I could actually taste the lobster and it wasn't overpowered by the Mac and Cheese. The dipping sauce that was served with the balls was very good too. 

I also had the chance to taste some French fries that a friend of mine had ordered. The fries were very good. It was a pleasant surprise because most of the time, French fries come out soggy so, you just deal with it. The fries were tasty and perfectly seasoned. 

I am disappointed that I had to leave because I would have liked to try more of their food. The Claws on the Cob sound interesting and so do many of the other dishes they offer. 

I will definitely keep my eye out for the Claws Food Truck, and you should too.

If I had to pay for my hotel room, I'd probably only give this place 3 stars--it's good, but not great.  But since my stay here was absolutely free (2 free nights promo), I'm a fan.

The lobby area of the hotel is nice, for Reno standards.  It was recently renovated with lots of marble, crystal, dark wood and other modern accents.  

However, the standard rooms and floors (through level 17) were not renovated.  In fact, they look like they belong to a completely different hotel--Western and desert themed with tons of green, red and wallpaper.

The standard rooms are large, spacious and clean.  I believe the beds have been replaced and are relatively new and the sheets are average.  The rooms have the basics (TV, desk, beds, closet) but nothing fancy and nothing more than basic.  The bathroom needs a bit upgrading, as well.  In order to turn the sink off, I'd have to turn the knob a little to the left before fulling turning it to the right.  A bit annoying but definitely a bearable annoyance.

My friends did the $25 upgrade to the summit rooms and stayed on the 24th floor--I think it was worth every penny.

The room size is the exact same as the standard room, but the decor is completely renovated.  The bed is plush with a bed frame and the bathroom is all marble with lots of mirrors and new fixtures and shower (no tub).  Now, THESE rooms look like they belong with the lobby of the hotel!  The rooms, also, have a little bar area with a mini-fridge and microwave and added furniture.  My only complaint is that there was way too much furniture in the upgraded room.  My friends had to move the coffee table to the side of the sofa bc there wasn't really any room to move around.  And even when they did, it was still easy for all of us to run into the corner of the bed frame--ouch.

All-in-all, for being $25 and less/night, this definitely is a bang for the buck.

All the good reviews are about the previous owners of Bob's.  The new owner has terrible customer service, not helpful & just wants you to leave ypur vacuum with him (for weeks!), no matter how minor the issue.  There is another vac repair shop on Chapala.  I strongly reco you go there

Started ordering here when I moved to Claymont. Pizza matched the kind I loved from the area I grew up in so it was time to try the other menu items. Steak sandwiches juicy and packed with meat! Hoagies overstuffed and the meats are balled and fluffed to bring out the flavor. Buy a large to feed several people or make several meals for one. The sandwich is $17 but if you were to buy the meat to make your own, it would cost you that much! And the fries, wings, salads and sides - all special bonuses!

I gave this place a 1 the last time I posted a review, but the Manager contacted me to make it right. This time I got Annie and she is AMAZING!! She took her time to go the extra mile. She didn't rush and massaged my feet back to life. Give it a try, they have some great people in there. I will go back!
Found a strand of hair sticking out of the Burger as soon as it was served. Reasonable staff. Replaced the burger. Still, unlikely to go back again anytime soon.

The lunch buffet is good and set at a reasonable price for the selection, especially the made to order pasta. The happy hour appetizers are also tasty and the happy hour drink prices are a little high, but not bad. Unfortunately, the service is usually lacking in friendliness, accessibility, and just plain being nice; on my last two visits the waiters were really rather rude and kind of snooty.

The bottom line is the food lacked the depth of flavoring you would expect from a restaurant of this type.  For the most part it was bland and anything but outstanding.   The wine list has an overall markup of 400% rather than the 100-150% we're used to.

Went to get my cartilage pierced. Amiee was very very nice. She washed her hands and then wore gloves. The place was very clean. Everything was medical at standards. I would recommend it to anyone who wants a great piercing!
Andy is by far the best dj and should bartend every day; he's the reason why I go, good conversation and over all sweet guy with a good music taste

Never again! Called in a order after reviewing menu online. After picking up food I realized NY Grill does not honor the menu offers they have online. My husband and I ordered the NY mixed grill. I'm assuming the seasoning they used was curry and they used waaaaaay too much. After a couple of bites I could not eat anymore and then felt sick afterwards. My brother, who eats any and everything refused to eat it! We also ordered a 2 piece Talapia.... Fish was not crispy. Their phone customer service is very poor felt like I was talking to middle school child. I will never go back!!!

First time visiting this place. I saw the good reviews and decided to try it. Not only is the food great but the people working there are very nice. They even gave me a soup to try which was delicious!! If I'm ever back in the area I'll def be back. The cost is fair and the food a awesome!

My wife and went here recently for dinner to celebrate our anniversary. We did not have a reservation, was very busy and had about an hour wait. While waiting we grabbed a drink at the bar and rarely can a bar make a martini better than I can at home, this was the exception. One of the better martinis I've had. Dinner took a very long time to come out after ordering but food did not disappoint. Wife had pork loin with amazing brussell Sprouts, I had the prime rib and the horse radish was amazing. My only gripe would be that the meal should have also came with a vegetable or side salad for the price. Overall a nice experience in downtown Boise.

Well 2 times in about a week is a new record for me for Applebee's , that same friend who suggested this location this time , so off I went.  It was a Friday night and even at 1130, it was standing room only, however our wait was only about 10 minutes.  I prefer the Brandon location over this one, much nicer and more comfy.  Our server was very friendly and attentive despite how busy it was. 
I contemplated on a few different items but we both settled on that Pecan Encrusted Chicken Salad once again , this was why he suggested this place , he has a limited palate and he thinks Applebees has awesome food, yea ok sure......

The Salad was good but again the one I had in Brandon was much better , our other friend who also has a limited palate it seems ordered a burger on account he thinks they have the best burgers anywhere... No comment ( I understand its personal preference, but applebees???)  I guess growing up near the restaurant capital of the world (NYC if you don't know) I have become biased and a snob in a sense of what good food really is .  There are much better options for food even in Tampa but my friends are not as adventurous as myself..

Yes I know , back to the review...   Overall for less than $12 it was typical but decent.  

Heads Up : If you decide to try that salad my suggestion is to have them add in some strawberries and blueberries to it, it compliments and enhances it much more.

This is one of the better Buffalo Wild Wings to visit. The wait is not typically as long as other Buffalo Wild Wings. Restaurant is always clean and the servers are pretty friendly. Love their new updated trivia machines. Always a good time

So I have to say I was a little disappointed when we dined on 12/31. Ordered the funghi pizza and the Floridian salad. The salad was excellent. Superb. Shrimps were cooked perfectly and the champagne vignegrette was tasty. The pizza took about 40 minutes to arrive.. Understand this was a busy night, but then the crust were very charred...almost all black. We were hungry and we were already late to an NYE bash event so didn't want to complain & get another one and wait ..another 40 min. After the meal though as we were paying, my husband calmly (and nicely) told the server that the pizza crust seemed burnt and... Even though she gave us excellent service up until then, she changed and got a little defensive. She said the crusts were not "burnt" and are naturally like that from wood-fired oven. So they were cooked alright. 
Well...I've been here once for lunch in the past and the crust were definitely not like that, hence why I gave a 5 star rating then. I loved the dough crust -- fluffy, tasty, and definitely not charred at all used for my Calzone. Maybe it's a bit different for Calzone than a pizza but don't they go in the same oven??
So unfortunately, this experience makes me not wanna come back for dinner, especially during busy night outs since the kitchen can't seem to handle it based on timing and the experience.

Wow! Great breakfast! Huge portions, smoothie was custom made and the breakfast was delicious! I got the sampler and all of it was good. Only thing was I subbed the backn and pork for sausage, but it turns out you get 2 links per meat order and I ended getting 6 links of HUGE sausages! Couldnt finish it. Wish the server would have told me how many sausages were going to come out. Other than that fantastic!

My car is relatively low to the ground and needed some bumper work in both the front and rear. Additionally, someone backed into my passenger door leaving it crinkled and warped. After one too many times of hitting the small cement dividers at the front of parking spots, my front bumper was very loose.  I came to spray master on a Friday afternoon, and before trying to sell me any services, Richard attempted to suction cup the dent out of my door, and he offered to secure my bumper for safety - both of which he did at no cost.  The Spray Master estimate came in at the lowest price, and I just got a really good feeling from Richard.  Further, I appreciated his sincere concern for my personal safety and the fact that he was willing to fix something for free even though he could've charged me for it, and I wouldn't have known any different.  Though the suction cup made an improvement, I decided to go for the full repair, and replace my front bumper, paint my back bumper, and repair and paint my door.  I just picked up the car, and I couldn't be happier. It looks brand-new, and I think they detailed the inside of my car in addition to detailing the outside of it. The cost was exactly as stated in the estimate, and I am a very satisfied customer.

Flew out of terminal C. The bathrooms only have two stalls and I'm a shy pisser, so had to wait a long time.  There are almost no outlets and the ones that do exist are in inconvenient locations. There are only about three places to eat. They all did not have their stuff together. For example, they had kiosks at one place to order, but you still had the give them your only receipt. It turned pretty disastrous when the line picked up steam. The food and coffee lines went all the way down the hall for a while. The airport is old in a not good way. It wouldn't take much to improve things. It just seems like no one cares. Also, the TSA annoyingly searched one of our traveler's bags just because they were training someone.

Update: Back today since Frontier cancelled our flight due to staffing issues. This is an issue with the terminal across the board. People show up for their shifts late at all businesses. It's ridiculous. They closed down the coffee shops because the next shift takes too long to show up. Staff everywhere takes forever to do basic jobs. The floght information boards are unreliable. The PA systems are underutilized. This airport is so out of touch that the bar had a movie on a about a plane crash.

It was not the best. So many ppl hype this place for being really great bbq. I have to disagree. Service was great. I give them that. But the food was not. The bbq was dry and lacked flavor. The Mac and cheese was horrible! Oily noodles. My kid wouldn't even eat it! It was oily and grainy. It didn't not taste like cheese at all. Will not be back. Sorry.
Great environment, clean, friendly customer service. The sushi is well prepared and tastes authentic. I got to meet the head chief, GM and other staff as part of my dinning experience. Very fun time
Printing person has no knowledge of USPS regulations. Less than plesant to deal with.  I will go to a different location and chain.

Great food! Better than expecting
Spinach pie rolls like nothing I've ever had.
Saganaki superb

Drove in from Indianapolis to purchase a GMC 2500HD truck that I saw on their website. I spoke to JD DeLong several times over the phone and then met in person. He was top notch! They amount of inventory they have on lot makes it very easy to see most every vehicle configuration possible. JD made our buying experience great - can't wait to come back and do business again.

Came here two nights ago to try some "authentic" Mexican.  I say that because being from Florida I suspect we don't have authentic Mexican like you would being so close to the border.   I asked the waiter for recommendations and he immediately suggested the carne seca.  I'm not a huge fan of beef so he brought me a sample to try....done deal, I'll have the carne seca combo.   Dinner was delicious, however I would forgo the chili relleno to have a larger portion of the carne seca.  Don't let the fact it's dry put you off, it's so full of flavor and the lime brings out that deliciousness.   Not sure if I'll make it back for another sit down meal, however I'm definitely going to call and see if I can buy just the meat to take back to Florida with me.  We are so deprived not getting that at home.  

The margaritas are a little lack luster and would probably pass on that the next time.
Love everything about this place. The one in Ballwin is my favorite. More pub feel. Food amazing especially the wings and cheeto mac and cheese.

I'm only giving this place one star because simply there isn't an option for zero stars. 

I'm very surprised this place even has more than 2 stars on their page! Worst customer service ever, wasn't even a greeting when we walked in, just walked up to the counter and said "do you want to order?" My friend orders, he gives her straight up attitude, slides the receipt to her, she ask "do I need to sign this?", he points to a pen that's basically hidden, and slaps a little sign thing on the counter. He never says "your order will be right out" or "we'll take your order to you" or anything! He was the one to bring her, her drink, but at least I had a friendly guy in glasses to serve me mine. 

So, if you happen to go...watch out for the bad attitude bald guy with the hard a** look on his face. 

Coffee was okay, nothing remarkable and the food looked decent. Basically something you can make at home. 

There's so many different coffee shops in Nashville that this one will be last on my list.

I've always enjoyed Che's BUT tonight, I was refused entrance because...
I was wearing sunglasses.
Seriously. The door person apparently decided that wearing shades in the evening means that one is drunk - that's what he told me. In fact, I rarely drink at all, and was just coming in to have a Coke, which is what I usually have there. I was wearing sunglasses because my clear lenses were back in my vehicle, parked a few blocks away, and I didn't want to go back and fetch them. I had consumed no alcohol in the preceding 48 hours.
Maybe this place gets away with treating the college crowd that way - although I can't imagine why they would treat ANY patron like that - but acting like an asshole just because you can is just stupid. I will make a point of advising my friends and associates to steer clear of Che's - unless an apology is forthcoming.
So I haven't been in years the food has gotten much better very pleased..It was very clean and staff was friendly...

So good!  We went with a bunch of friends and were really impressed with the quality of food and service!  Everyone at our table had something different, and no one was disappointed. French toast, bananas foster, eggs cochin, and I had a really scrumptuous eggs cochion, with catfish, spinach, artichoke, bacon and poached eggs served on these huge french bread spears.  Our waitress was super friendly and kept the coffee flowing!  Great time!
It's hit or miss coming in here. They do a really good job with their appointment/walk in management. But they tend to get distracted and forget about you. One of the better places I've been to.

The sad thing about this review is that the food is actually OK for a chain restaurant. It's the service that drags the rating down into fast food territory. 4 times have we've eaten at this Uno and 3 of those the service was as lacking as a Mississippi GED. One round of slow or bad service is excusable. It happens. Twice? Three times? I do hope Uno's corporate folks read these reviews and fix things because I'd love to go back... but at this point I can't say that I ever will. My time is valuable to me even if the wait staff feel that is is not. When it takes 20+ minutes after our table has been cleared to finally give up and get another server to tender our check ... yeah... you saw us sitting there. We made eye contact as you shuffled drinks around on another table and picked up trash. I politely gestured that we wanted your assistance. You ignored us. We could see you fiddling around ducking direct eye contact. We saw that you had sooooo many responsibilities that you could putz around at work on a lazy Sunday. I just wish I was a big enough jerk not to leave a tip... enjoy your $5. Maybe spend it on an energy drink or something. 

Hey, Uno, do you guys deliver? No, scratch that, we'd still be stuck dealing with staff that apparently doesn't really care. How about server-robots? Maybe just those tabletop kiosks where we could not deal with your highly trained wait staff??

I just had a situation with them tonight with the owner who could care less on who he loses. I guess I'm not the only one. He wanted to bicker over the wrong sandwich that they made a mistake on that we picked up and just to have it delivered he wanted to charge me an extra $2. It's a joke will never go back there again they just lost a considerable amount of money each year will never order from there ever again. Admitting it was their fault, the owner still was unfair. We live a mile from there. Why should we go back out? They constantly screw up our order. Lousy customer service. We will spend our $300 plus a year somewhere else. Apparently they enjoy losing business.
So good. The pork bun is out of this world. A must try. And then the spicy ramen. Delicious.
Apparently you can't trust their hours on Yelp, Google OR their official site. They close at 10 on Saturday, not midnight.
Great food and AMAZING service! My wife and I ate here on our last day and we're happy we did. Must get the crab legs.

I haven't been here in years but I ordered a banana whip today and it was absolutely delicious. Greenstraw is so underrated and has such a good menu with clean ingredients! I definitely will be going back this week!

Enjoyed a quick meal here at the counter and the best part was both the ambiance and the service. This is not to say a word against the food, the thing is I only ordered such random items, which I enjoyed, but which likely won't paint a full picture of the restaurant. 

First of all this in the heart of party central but it is a lovely oasis from loud music and wild tourists for lunch. The staff at the counter was so quick to chat, fill a water and talk about the menu. 

I went With the balanced (hah) meal of duck fat tater tots (small order), green salad and white wine. 
The tots were yummy - I mean when aren't they? - and came with three dipping sauces. I normally hate honey mustard and this was delicious!  Salad was perfectly dressed with a bright and tangy vinaigrette. 

I will definitely come back next time I am in town for a meal, great service and such a nice spot!

A new addition to The AMP Beast Burgers and Bites is going to do well! The burgers are so good! The pickles were made there and the ingredients they used went well with the burger I had. The fries came hot and ready to eat. They're not the standard krinkle cut fries. They look hand cut and are great. They come with a nice amount of ketchup to go with them. All of it was packed into a nice box and I would suggest eating it there. You want the fries and burger to be hot and the fries would get soggy if kept in the box for long. Take extra napkins the burger is good, but can get messy. My only suggestion would be that I wish they had other dips to dip the fries in. I rarely get ketchup. I like ranch usually or any other sauce that isn't ketchup. Other than that it's a great addition and I'm sure will do well!

I came here with my parents on a beautiful Saturday afternoon.  I love bakeries, but I have a major butter allergy.  No fun!  Everything looked delish!  I sooo wanted to try some of the baked goods.  They do make some things with vegetable oil, but the bakers were gone for the day when we were there.  In any case, I will definitely come back here hopefully at an earlier time.  My mom got a bunch of things & loved it.  The staff were really helpful & nice.  It's definitely on the cheap side.

My friend & I went mid afternoon & it wasn't busy at all. I ordered the Grueben with onion rings & holy Toledo. I don't know which one was better. These onion rings are HHUUGGEE. They serve them with a sauce that's similar to what you get with a cactus blossom. The sandwich was delicious & unique. It's fried fish served on rye w/ Swiss cheese, red cabbage & Russian dressing. Mouth watering. I really enjoyed this meal!

This place is terrible.  This is the reason why I am always suspicious of suburban strip mall sushi.  Second red flag they have "Asian cuisine" a.k.a. Chinese on the same menu.  

Bluefin is to sushi as taco bell is to Mexican.  Allow me to explain. 
1. Sushi rice has no discernable seasoning or vinegar to it.  It's an inconsistent mushy-sticky texture.  
2. Fish is of poor quality and WARM from being out all day, not on ice. 
3. They do not even put Wasabi on the nigiri?!?? 
4. Mayonnaise is used gratuitously on a variety of rolls. 
5. Tempura.  Lightly breaded, lightly fried.  That's how it's supposed to be.  I shouldn't get a God damn corn dog when I asked for tempura shrimp. 

Add to that that the service was bad.  I don't mean rude or anything, just really slow and careless. 

In short, this is not to be considered a sushi joint, more like a vaguely Asian themed fried mayonnaise restaurant.

Ok So to be honest I didn't want to go to Ginza originally because of the "Endless Sushi" tagline.  That implies some sort of a buffet or mass produced sushi to me and frankly its something I never wanted to try.

So I was pleased that once inside its actually a regular restaurant where you order and pay by the dish.  And they have some sort of endless deal which I did not investigate.

The server the first time we went there was named Joy.  She was overwhelmed by our big party somewhat.  However I have to say we were there a long time and by the end of the meal she had caught up with everything and was actually pretty friendly and helpful, so the service ended up being actually pretty good.

Meals were brought out by runners who were universally friendly and patient.

Now, on to the food... First off, I am not much of a fan of rolls because in America they often come with cream cheese ... which I will never figure out how that ends up in a Sushi restaurant ?

Never the less, I ordered a "Hawaiian Roll" which did have just a touch of cheese and was absolutely delicious. 

And I tried the Crab Rangoon as an appetizer (more cheese) which was likewise quite good.

Finally I ordered what I came for, which was just a few pieces of Sushi, mostly Salmon and White Tuna.  This was excellent.  I particularly liked that they weren't huge.  I find Cavernous sized sushi both less flavorful and hard to eat gracefully, so the modest size was much appreciated.  

I don't remember a lot about the inside decor!  But my first experience here was quite good and we'll be back for sure.

UPDATE: May 17 2016

We have been there twice since the review and we did indeed order the "endless sushi" because it works out cheaper, even if you are not a big eater. You just order more often which is fine if they aren't too busy.  Not really a fan of that model for paying for food though personally, but it did keep our bill reasonable.

Service and food was likewise very good on subsequent trips.

they are always very nice and good customer service! we were curious about a wing flavor they let us try it in a sample cup and we couldn't decide which flavors to get and they threw in a couple extra wings on the flavor that we sampled :) it's things like that that make us want to support small businesses

This place serves great kava and tea. The flatbreads are delicious. Try the Freaky Tiki and Delicious - amazing drinks. It can get pretty loud after 4PM. If you like a high energy atmosphere, this place is pure electric. Awesome staff. Make sure to check out the one-of-a-kind Hyperspace lounge.

Worst place I have ever eaten. Service was non existent. Took 30 minutes to even be acknowledged. When we finally got our food an hour an a half later it was lousy. Had the jaeger schnitzel an couldn't tell the difference between the schnitzel an the greasy potato cakes. Canned sauerkraut an German potato salad an not even high quality. A soup an salad bar was included with the meal only there wasn't any soup or salad an they didn't restock in the two hours we were there. Anyone who calls this authentic German food has never been to Germany. This place serves low grade dog food. An service to match. To top it all they don't even care. When asked how everything was my wife said not very good. The reply was "well you can't please everyone". At least they take pride in their poor service an lousy food.
Yes, ok it may not be the BEST Chinese Food I'd ever have..but its the best in this college town. Prompt delivery, low prices, nice people. Seriously, its your best option as far as Chinese goes.

On the plus side obliging service. Relying on table settings and interesting pieces to overshadow the small portions and the food. Flavors ranged from pretty good to blah.

First time I've ever walked into a restaurant hungry and walked out still hungry 45 minutes later and $45 dollars lighter in the pocket, feeling as if it had been picked.

Decided to come here with the wife on a lunch break. First off, I can say that the staff is VERY friendly, which is the only reason why I'm giving it two stars. I had myself a bacon cheeseburger with bacon cheese fries. My wife had the meat lovers pizza. The burger, wasn't to my satisfaction, neither were the fries. Although, the food came out pretty quick, the burger was too small, and the price was too high. To my taste, the fries did not taste "fresh". Maybe it was, but I think that it could have tasted better. My wife's pizza... Let's just say it tasted like cicis pizza. To end it all, the price I paid, I could have went to five guys or dominos pizza and paid a better price and would have walked out satisfied. I don't recommend trying it, but if you do, beware. It's not the best place in town. I won't be going back there.
Employees dont listen to your order. Line takes forever and the ice water glass is tiny. Don't shame people for getting water. Not healthier at all than Edo or Wok.

I came here to get coffee and beignet.   It's great setting with music.  I had the best time in New Orleans relaxing and listening to young group called Pelican 212.  I originally went there to grab a coffee but ended up staying there for an hour.  Such a cute and innocent group in the midst of crazy and weird place

The food was good, but that was the only thing that was. Long lines, sullen service. One of the counter people just seemed to wander off. One funny thing---the counter person made a big deal of using her safe serve wrappers to grab a bagel, just as the grumpy old guy who calls you for your order showed up with two completely unprotected fists full of bagels. Well, funny but also gross.

I used to go to Joy Luck on a regular basis and always found it to be ok.  I recently stopped in in mid-Feb 2012 and was surprised to see the place had been renovated and is now much nicer than before.  They also seem to have gone an "all you can eat buffet" all the time establishment.  I can tell you the food is what you would expect from a Chinese buffet with all of the regular menu items available but I was a little shocked (and happy) to find they installed a sushi bar as part of the buffet options.  If you like Chinese buffets you will probably like this one and the price is very cheap.  I cannot complain about Joy Luck as it is what I expected and have come to know: Chinese food on the cheap.

We were planning a trip to Philly for a long weekend and found a great deal for Loews on Priceline. Hotel is centrally located and perfect for tourists like us trying to see it all in three days. Parking was outrageous but apparently comparable to everyone else at a banging$46 a night. Rooms were clean, beds comfortable, decor modern. Housekeeping was good at keeping up with rooms. Concierge was helpful when looking for place to watch Rousey fight and eat thai food. No spectacular views of city from my room which would have been a complaint had I paid full advertised rate. They know when you book through Priceline and place you accordingly in standard double queen rooms. Totally fine by me! We werent looking for the luxury, we were looking for location without paying a fortune. There are deals out there that can land you in a place like Loews for a hundy a night.  At that price, in Center City, who can complain?

Highly recommend these guys for maintenance or parts for your bike. I just recently bought a used 1975 Fuji special tourer and need to replace the double brake lever.  Scott was very quick to respond and helpful on the quote I submitted on yelp. Jesse that helped me when I came in and was very helpful also and I told him exactly what Scott had quoted me and what I needed. Jesse also gave me a heads up before hand that I might need to replace the brake cables when I dropped my bike off which was awesome and was not hit with any unexpected charges. I will definitely be coming back for more maintenance on my bike.

We popped by for dinner and had a reasonable but not particularly memorable time.

This strip mall location is decorated with surf boards and they play a surfing movie. Honestly, it's hard to get in the surf mood in a strip mall. Perhaps if the floor was made of sand and we were getting sun burned...

The food was good, not great, and the prices were a bit higher than I expected for what we got. The solution had to be alcohol but even the $28 pitcher of sangria was weak.

We showed up with reservations for dinner but they didn't have a table ready. They tried to put 6 people around a table made for 2. The manager advised us to buy cocktails while he tried to figure something out. we ordered scotch. It took them over 30 minutes to deliver the drinks, and they were only "delivered" because we walked to the bar ourselves and grabbed them. By that point the ice had melted and the scotch was undrinkable. This is all on top of an inexperienced wait staff, incredibly loud atmosphere where you had to yell across a two person table to hear each other. Trust me, do yourself a favor. Go somewhere else, anywhere else. You won't regret it.

FYI Meril is right down the street.

As an official pizza lover, I have determined Toby's has the best pizza in St. Pete. It's New York Style, thin crust, not too saucy, not too cheesy, perfectly foldable and served piping hot. It's definitely better when you eat it there rather than take home but that's with most places. The pizzas are a good size so there's delicious leftovers (most of the time!). They also have great garlic knots, sometimes better on different days depending on how liberal they are with the garlic oil. All in all I highly recommend.

I made an appointment for a gel manicure. When I went, I was unable to have the service done because I had powder nails (I guess this is similar to acrylic) on. They don't have the tools to take them off because they only do natural nails. It would have been nice to know that before driving over there on my lunch break.
My favorite hibachi place, we travel 45 minutes to here. I can't wait until covid is over and we can come back.

The food was so so, but service was just horribly slow. After my glass sat empty for over 15 min, I had to get up from the table and walk to the bar to ask for a refill. I ordered a grilled cheese and when it finally came it was cold and the cheese wasn't even fully melted. I would not recommend this place to a friend.

Why 3 stars? Because it's Jekyll and Hyde.

   ---   ---   ---

On one hand, I'm quite fond of the fair. I really like coming here, and even though I've only lived here 6 years, it's sentimental to me. 

On the other hand, the parking situation is nothing short of a travesty here. I recently visited the Funshine Music Festival, and was basically sitting still in my car for 20 minutes after backing out of my spot. Why was the traffic so jammed up? You'd think there would be a team of parking attendants on-hand to prevent this, right?

Nope, just a single hillbilly yokel with a wand in his hand, attempting to (poorly) direct three different flows of cars. How does this happen?

Similar situations have occurred when leaving a concert at the Amphitheater. I don't know how it's never addressed, but it definitely lowers the quality of the experience.

Stopped in and ordered a Bob's Deluxe pizza for carry out.  The pizza was ready in less than 20 minutes. I've never been to this location before as we normally go the one in Ballwin..Like that store the toppings are extremely generous.The crust was a bit thick for a St Louis style pizza but it was still OK.

We came in, late of course, for a large party reservation and we were welcomed with open arms and full plates. The lamb (anything) was the best I've had; and, the veggies are amazing. Maurice and "family" were so sweet and accommodating in how they made a table of 14 feel at home so far away from home.  Will come back every time I visit, possibly again this time before I head home.

I came to Santa Barbara to "discover" yoga.  After a lot of Googling and asking others about their opinions, I chose Yoga Soup as my place.  It was the best decision I could have made.  Staff were amazing - both front desk as well as instructors. I took 5 classes - all very different - in 3 days and am now a yoga enthusiast! If you are looking for your yoga home, FLOW to Yoga Soup.  It doesn't hurt that Backyard Bowls and SB Roasters is around the corner.  Deb D, Yoni,  Rachel and Steve are your sure bets to truly learn poses and your needs and limitations.  It will be VERY difficult for me to find something comparable in my hometown.....once you try the best, your bar raises significantly.  Thank you Yoga Soup!!!!

Excellent quick service, I ran in after a long day and was very hangry.  Greeted right away with a smile and suggestions on what would be quick to the table was appreciated.  The atmosphere was nice and clean.  Definitely will return when I can relax and try some of what looked like tasty appetizers and red wines.

Came In for a birthday with a party of 12. Waited two hours for cold incomplete meals. They ran out of food items. Staff didn't seem to care about our concerns. They mostly hung out in the serving line. They had a gentleman that a person in my party saw serving tables come over and seemed to pose as a manager  while what looked to be real manager was far away trying to avoid us. Will not be back!

Wasn't a fan. I had to go here for an follow-up ultrasound even though I'm delivering at Einstein because my PCP is affiliated to this hospital only and I needed a referral. 

The registration process is seriously inefficient. It takes 30-40 mins just to get your information into their computers.  But the worst was the ultrasound experience. The tech seemed stressed and spent time just clinically taking pictures with the computer turned completely away from me. I asked several questions curious about the baby and she never once turned the monitor so I could see or pointed out what she was viewing. The baby was kicking a lot during the process so I asked her if she could see it. She just said no I'm not looking at the baby yet. My husband and 2 year old daughter were with me too so it would
have been nice for her to at least show us something during the 30 mins she spent just clicking buttons on the computer.  

After she was done she told us that she needed to get the doctor to review and he would come in and talk to us about the results. We waited in the room for another 30 mins at least. My daughter was getting incredibly antsy and we were becoming annoyed. The tech then came back into the room and handed me my papers back saying we could go and our doctor would be in touch. Uh what???? Why did we just sit there for 30 mins????? I'm happy to have my dr give me the results; in fact, I'd prefer it but don't tell us to wait for 30 mins so the dr can discuss with us and then return with no explanation as to why that didn't happen!!!

Completely different experience at Einstein. I hope I ever have to go to phoenixville again.

So this is where all the hipsters go when they're not posing in coffee shops. There were enough horn rims and unkempt beards to almost take my mind off the s-l-o-w service, long wait in line, and strange lox. This house-cured salmon is one of the odder foodstuffs I have seen in New Orleans: dry, salty, and chewy. That's not lox; it's jerky.

The salad was better, but not good enough to erase the memory of the worst bagel and lox in the city. Nor did fetching my own water from a plastic tub give me warm and fuzzy feelings.

In any event, if you're around 20 or so and imagine that eating here will give you hipster cred, enjoy. I'll find someplace with decent food and service, even if it might be too mainstream.

I swear this is the fastest Chick-fil-A I've been to yet. The line was wrapped around the building when I arrived in the drive thru line, however I was out of the line and with my order within 8 minutes.  Very very impressed with their speed,  accuracy, attention to detail, and kindness. I have found myself avoiding Chick-fil-A ever since  the remodel since they are always soooo busy, however I'm yet again impressed by their speed!

I was feeling sick and congested this afternoon and was craving spicy ramen to clear my sinuses, and the spicy miso ramen definitely did the trick! The broth was really flavorful with lots of spice and there was a generous portion of pork. I also got a free gyoza with my meal! Will definitely be returning here as the location is just a minute from my office building. Excited to try the bao!

I've been to a couple of the other La Haciendas in town, but this one is way over and above the rest.

The food is always hot, fresh, and tasty.  Our drinks are always kept refilled, and the servers are always friendly.

Due to the location, the lunch and dinner hours can get quite crowded, so there might be a bit of a wait if you arrive at those times, but it's never been terribly long for us.

I knocked a star off because, both times we've been there, the service has been great up till the time we needed our check, but then there was a bit of a wait.  Not terribly long, but long enough to knock a star off.
Nice dinner on the patio.  Food was very goid.  they have a chef rather than a cook. I had the fish special.  Nice and light for summer.  Weight staff very responsive.
Great place for a great meal. The service is friendly, and the owner is on site, to make sure the experience is consistent. The BBQ turkey wraps are great...and the home made cole slaw rocks.
Most awesome ahi tuna steak and black beans with rice; all cooked and seasoned perfectly.  Great view of the ocean and John's pass.

My wife and I went here last night to try it out.Very good pub food and reasonable prices.large selection of bottled beers, not much on tap. Would be nice to see craft beers on tap in the future. Would definitely go back.Daily specials look great, and nice clean neighberhood pub.

I think this is a really cool use of a church space. I came here for lunch because a collaborator works nearby and we were checking out her lab. She said it's a great place to hide and work. 

I got a half panini half soup and it was delicious. I wish the portion sizes were bigger for the cost though... on the other hand points to this place for having gluten free options for one of my companions! It's really cool that they do that. 

I also got a rice krispie treat. It was really good. It had that wonderful home-made taste to it. :) I approve! My friends shared a brownie and they said it was amazing. 

If i were in the area, I'd definitely come back again!

This is a local hidden gem!! Great place for gyros with great prices that have never changed over the years! The quality and taste has always been on point each time I've gone ... I don't think I've ever had a bad experience here. The owners are very nice and friendly as well!

Second attempt... No Bueno! 

Pizza was greasy, small, and the black olives had a bad odor. 

Will not be back.
AMAZING espresso! Coffee drinks are the perfect ratio of milk to espresso and flavoring. The coffee has a robust and rich flavor. Also, I got a match snickerdoodle scone and it was to die for...
I've never had a bad experience or meal. Been coming here for a year plus. The salmon sandwich is amazing and the wings are top notch. Very welcoming staff. One of my fav restaurants in the city!

I am so happy I found Nail Care Systems. The quality of work is great and long lasting.
If I could give them 10 stars I would.
They do not accept walk-ins so be prepared to make an appointment.

I've been a customer for the last few years and overall am happy, at least as happy as one can be with an auto repair place.  I've found them to be friendly, honest, and knowledgeable; Marshall, the owner, truly conveys a professorial vibe.  

If you're visiting for the first time, be aware, their waiting room is just that, a room, not as comfortable and spacious as you'd find elsewhere.  Decor is very 1960s and includes a vending machine that may or may not actually work with snacks that may or may not be edible.  

Nonetheless, I recommend them.  Good service and no pressure to get work done.

So the branch on Wedge deserves a 1, but only when it's open and operating at it's peak.  Otherwise, it's a zero.  If you came from California and have a Chase account that you probably didn't open at Chase and was bought up from another bank - RUN AWAY from CHASE.  They aren't helpful here. Their hours aren't good, they aren't on every corner like in CA, and they don't have ATMs deployed except at branches.  Wrong bank for Nevada.

For a fast food joint, this is pretty darn good. My burger was juicy & tasty. The girl taking my order was very friendly, which was nice. My favorite thing, though, was the frozen custard. I got a vanilla Concrete with cheesecake pieces and strawberries. Oh, yeah, baby. This was delicious!!! I also saw they sell hand-packed pints to go. Yum.

The service is wonderful and I love the staff!! I have never been disappointed. When we are needing a sashimi fix we definitely come to this delightful restaurant, I will post picks next time I visit!!

The food is decent but so overpriced like all the other steakhouses in the city.  Although I will say, their pineapple martini is amazing.  They soak pineapples in vodka and use that to make the martini.  They're strong but taste great (and they should be strong for the $14 price tag)!  Their wedge salad is also really good too.  It's probably best to take in the decor and have a drink at the bar if you don't want to drop a few hundred dollars on dinner.

Hole in the wall atmosphere, pleasant service, my waitress was very helpful with recommendations. I had the Blackened Grouper Tacos, the Sriracha cream sauce on them made them extra delicious! I also had an Ultimate Cooteraid cocktail, which was equally delicious.

On our last morning in Santa Barbara, we wanted brunch.  SB has a lot of options but we settled on the menu at Scarlett Begonia.  The space is small but charming, located in a plaza behind Bouchon.  Though it was too cold to sit outside that day, they also have a lovely outdoor patio that would be great during the summer. 

After we ordered, the waiter arrived with an amuse bouch for each of us.  A little condiment container was filled with homemade granola with a dallop of yogurt.  It was a sweet effort and the granola was delicious, the perfect in between texture of chewy and crunchy with berries and nuts along with the oats.  

Our dishes arrived quickly.  One of the dishes that lured us here was their shrimp and grits.  It was a very large bowl of cheesy grits, topped with a saucy mixture of chorizo, onions and peppers, shrimp, and two poached eggs.  It was an excellent version with a savory, spicy sausage and all the peppers.  The egg yolk was mixed in and thoroughly flavored the grits.  We also shared the Pork Belly BLT, which sounded much better on paper.  The pork belly was a little too soft and textureless, especially on the slightly soft bread with relatively soft ingredients sandwich toppings - like arugula and avocado.  We also ordered their cream scone, which was buttery and soft and interestingly, had been split and baked with strawberries inside.  

With the bill, we received two pieces of english toffee to nibble on.  I like the Scarlett Begonia's little touches and overall, they make excellent food.

I know Jason Melton professionally and have been very impressed not only by his knowledge of the law and how to utilize it to the benefit of his clients, but also by his strong commitment to finding new ways to improve the client experience.  He goes well beyond the state requirements for continuing legal education to pursue additional knowledge that will improve his practice.

Still sitting here. In town from Columbus, Ohio. Great beer, boiled crawfish, andouille and shrimp grinder, oysters on the half shell. Perfect! Sam is a great bartender. Could not have been more pleased. The grinder (shrimp and andouille is a must-have!)

This place was such an incredible experience. We were visiting from California, so we (mainly my boyfriend) had done a lot of research prior to coming. He was finally able to get the code, and we made reservations- the manager was so kind!
 The food was good, I really enjoy a simple food menu. The slider buns were AMAZING!
 The drinks were great I ordered mainly tequila drinks while my bf ordered mainly whiskey (which is what they're mainly about). 
We also smoked a cigar- our server was so great and gave us cigar recommendations. Over all great experience!!

EXCELLENT B&B to stay at while visiting Santa Barbara!  It is close to town, so you can walk or ride your bike to lunch or dinner, a movie, shopping, massage. We rode our bikes down to the pier / beach.  Great location.  We stayed in the Craftsman room.  LOVE this room.  It has it's own private entrance, with a private porch and spa.  Breakfast was delivered every morning and was simply delicious!  We will definitely stay here again!

By far, the best, most courteous florist in Santa Barbara. I visit Riley's about once every 2 months to pick up flowers for my beautiful wife, family, and friends. The designers at Riley's ask me about the occasion, ask me my budget, and a few key questions about preferences. Then they create the most beautiful arrangements. I feel like I always get a lot for my money and the flowers last a long time. The team there is courteous and quick, even when there's a lot of holiday orders. My only complaint is that I don't live close enough to stop by more often and pick up small bunches of flowers to have more around my house. This is one of my favorite Santa Barbara businesses.

Horrible experience... Purchased tickets but the Ritz over sold the show, so when I went to the bathroom I wasn't allowed back in the main stage area (no warning).  While I waited in the hall for my male friend (also using restroom) I was approached by security who threatened to kick me out unless I moved.  I told him I was waiting for a friend and said I would meet my friend right here after using restroom (not to get separated) and wasn't going to move.  Security got in my face as my friend met me, and we were reluctantly hearded into the other room ("not at capacity"). Then had to watch more than 1/2 the show on projection in side bar area.  What a waste of $ and rude security.  Never going to a show here again... It's been about two years and happy to say I haven't.

This location has free tours (with samples). 

It also has an outlet rack! (half priced mistakes? I think it's mostly just the wrong weight)

I'm a big fan of their dark chocolate but not so much the milk. They have solar panels and are very conscientious with their whole process. Go get some chocolate chocolate chocolate!!!

Pretty good food overall, some really creative and yummy appetizers, but the main course wasn't anything special. We ate outside so we escaped the bar atmosphere inside. Service was decent. A nice place to go for a bite, but don't expect anything too spectacular.

Spicy Tuna Don Volcano style and tonkatsu ramen.  Didn't find the first near as great as some people say, and the ramen dish was pretty blah with some sliced meat substance and bits of pickled vegetable.  Friendly people.
This place was ok. The store itself was cool but the employees were too busy talking to each other to say hi much less ask if we needed help with anything! We took our business elsewhere!
Great ambiance. Great service. Great food. What more can I say? If you're in the Hendersonville area you definitely have to stop by!
