I love this place. I've been eat at different locations but never had any bad experience. I love the meaty of all meaty pizza to unique cheese pizza. I don't drink anymore but pizza from here & beer was my go to in summer time ^_^

This place serves up green tea flavor with a punch! I was in Philly for interviews and craving something sweet and I stumbled across A La Mousse. They specialize in green tea desserts and I was particularly drawn in by the green tea cheesecake and green tea mousse. I ended up getting the mousse since they were out of the cheesecake (next time!). The mousse was light and not too sweet with lots of green tea goodness. It's composed of a light white cake layered with silky green tea mousse. When you get to the end of the cake, it is pure mousse and it tastes heavenly. I got it with the green tea ice cream which was the perfect accompaniment. Next time I gotta try the cheesecake and an iced green tea drink!

I went yesterday, close to midnight after going to a concert. Consider it was my 1st time eating in Nashville, the hostess was very nice and well informed. I went to the 6th floor and the waitress, was very nice and well knowledgeable. I order the salmon and it was the best I ever had! So tender and flavored! I recommend this place if not looking for live performance.

Well..this is one in our Brunch rotation, & I took my mom. We waited, Told us be ready, still waited. When we finally sat down, took our orders, got Sweet pot. fries, & gentleman, said it was on the House, since we waited sooo long. How nice!!!
My mom got Scrambled Eggs with dill & honey wheated toast, & my brunch buddy & I split the Dark chocolate & raspberry French toast with Iced Aussie coffee.Yumm.
I rated them low before because their corn suuuuucked....Whew!  They stopped serving corn!!!  I guess I could now ding them for NOT SERVING CORN NOW...BUT DAMN THOSE TAMALES ARE GOOD!!!

I've been here twice. The first time I was here, I had a great experience: the food was great, the service was on point and it was an overall good time. 

My most recent time I decided to come back after my enjoyable first experience. Obviously that was a huge mistake. 

First off, the hostess was rude. She was constantly at the bar chatting with the bartender when people were coming in and out of the restaurant. It took our server 10 minutes to even come to out table (and I had to flag the hostess down to get the server, and of course I received a scowl from her). We had a simple order of an appetizer, salad and pizza. It took an hour for us to get our pizza, and at that point we had to get going to our show. We took it to go and just left. I doubt I'll be back here, there's so many other quality restaurants in the area to choose from.

So if you like a long wait for your simple food order and terrible service, this is the place to go.

You want Brooklyn and live in Florida, then you must dine here. One of my family's favorite spots.  Note, we live over an hour and half away, and we drive up here to feast and enjoy the cookies and Italian desserts. Never disappointing and never going to break your bank. Prices are extremely reasonable and you will definitely have left overs. The angel hair pasta is done perfectly and the chicken is generous. My husband loved his red sauce, again, with his eggplant. He had leftovers for two lunches. Yes, two.

Remember, you want to leave room for dessert. So pack up your left overs and wait to see the tray of the samplings for dessert and not to mention the massive bakery display of all the cookies. Some did come home with us. In fact, I think we spent more on the cookies then we did on the whole dinner. Great place.

Good, solid gastropub that I'd definitely come back for.  I had the grilled chicken sandwich and my husband had their burger.  Both were very good.  We also had the deviled eggs, which were a nice touch.  Prices were reasonable and staff was very friendly.  Can't think of better qualifications for a neighborhood bar.

New Orleans never ceased to amaze this Houstonian boy! I really liked my dinner visit at Cochon yesterday, it really made my second one-day trip in New Orleans complete.

We were very lucky to get a table without reservation at Cochon at around 8. The restaurant has a huge dining area, so it really has higher seating capacity than other venues in NOLA. Our waitress was extremely friendly as well! 

For starter, my friends and I had the wood-fired oysters and the fried alligator. The oysters were sooo good! I have to say these beat Acme for sure. They were succulent, juicy, and so flavorful with the garlic butter topping. The fried alligator was also tactfully done, though the sauce made it a little heavy. 

For entree, our group fell in love with the short rib. It was so moist and tender, YOU MUST TRY IT! The rice was also served with a flavor-pact sauce as well. Nothing I would ask to change the way it is! The ham mock, ok the other hand, was a bit too tough and dry for my taste. I wouldn't order that again. 

Tl;dr: order the wood-fired oysters and the braised short rib, you won't be disappointed!

I love the atmosphere here. However, I recently ordered a matcha latte and as I was drinking it, I realized it was sweetened. They told me they only use sweetened matcha and that is what every uses. I have been drinking matcha for years and this was the only local coffee shop that had sweetened. I expect that from Starbucks, not a great local shop. 

The sweetened matcha is one thing, them managements response put this only at 2 stars. They did not apologize but rather told
Me I was the crazy one. That is not good customer service!  I won't be going back somewhere that doesn't want to listen to its customers!
The pizza here is one of the best I've had in quite some time! Fresh, hot and simply delicious! I recommend the pepperoni pizza. By far better than Papa John's or Domino's.

Went here last week on a recommendation from our hotel. This place is perfect for a date night out. NO COVER and great live music. Beautiful decor inside , nice and classy.

Menu was easy reading and tasty. Kinda pricey but expected with upscale ambience and free live music.

Drinks were super tasty. I had the Tigers Blood.

Service was great and speedy. I think our waitress's name was Natalie.

Do pass up this spot if you like jazz and good eating.
Food is ok but atmosphere is loud. The tables and chairs are kind of low quality and the staff isn't super friendly. The sangria is good but the prices are a bit high.

Words can not express how much I love this place. For years I suffered in pain having over 65 percent of my teeth broken and deteriorating. I went to so many other  places for this one, and it was awful, they accused me of doing drugs and worked up dental plans that cost the most money and sold it to me by saying "we know a girl as young as you would hate to have dentures." BUT NOT THIS PLACE!!!! Not only was this place kind and understanding but they smiled at me and generally cared. THEY EVEN REMEMBER ME BY NAME!!!  The amazing doctor there sat me down and told me the hard truth.. I needed dentures they were more affordable and would last me a life time. Where other places told me my bottom teeth couldn't be saved he told me they could be. When others tried to charge me an arm and a leg for me to be put under for my teeth extractions. Not this place. This is only a small portion of how grateful I am to them. They took away my pain and gave me my smile back and even though I have bad credit. They worked with me giving me a an affordable payment plan. Thank you for treating me like a person and for giving me my smile and life back.

Standard items at an American style sushi-ya.

Biggest Pros: The grilled hamachi collar was very good; the sashimi is relatively good quality for the Midwest; the service and atmosphere was prompt but relaxed and there was no rush for the afternoon lunch.

Biggest cons: the rice is cheap rice if you care about that sort of thing (I doubt it was Japanese); the nigiri style was definitely more Korean style than Japanese style if you care about that sort of thing, and so I guess it's no surprise and necessarily follows that the service was also not very much like a Japanese sushi-ya in terms of atmosphere if you care about that sort of thing. But it's difficult to find those things in St. Louis (Nobu's is the only place that I know of within the inner-belt that has that, and alas it may be closing soon).
Smelled like something died in there, everyone was covering their nose throughout the whole store. Disgusting.

I was really curious to try this place out as it received five stars on Yelp. I also have been on paleo and was craving something carb based, which I know this would've fixed that craving. 

Since we weren't in SB for very long, we decided to take a dozen of these empanadas to go. 

They sell half frozen and fully frozen empanadas to go, so you can enjoy them as fresh as possible. We ordered the half frozen, so the cook time was cut in half at home. 

These empanadas are some of the best that I've had. My favorite were the hongos, which were the mushroom based empanadas. 

Next time I head up to SB, I'll definitely be grabbing some to go again or eating some there.

I looked this up on-line and decided to purchase a night to take my two daughters and  my son and his girlfriend for a Christmas present.  We went last night and it was a wonderful evening.  Christina is a charming hostess and a delightful teacher.  There were 8 people in total, and we really enjoyed the other three guests.  We learned how to correctly hold a knife and how to properly dice veggie, herbs, and slice chicken for Chicken Marsala.  We made an apple walnut salad and roasted broccoli with "to die for" very simple peanut butter cookies for dessert.  Christina made it all look so simple!  I heartily recommend this for a nice evening of socializing while cooking and eating together in a cozy and beautifully decorated city home .  I am definitely taking my husband back in the summer for a grilling class in her beautiful back yard.

Cheap beer, burger haven, and wide open spaces? Count me in! I wish I could have tried more of the menu. 

My only complaint is the parking nearby, which is almost nonexistant. It is something I will consider in visiting The Abbaye again, which will happen sometime soon. I just don't know when.

We heard so much about the restaurant so my wife and I drove from St. Petersburg to give it a try. We were first sent away by the hostess because the restaurant was closing early but then the manager brought us back inside and we sat at the bar. We ordered three appetizers and a pizza to share. The food was excellent and perfectly prepared. Great ambience and service. They have inside and outside seating as well as a wonderful side room for large parties. Going back next week (A little earlier) and will recommend the restaurant to everyone.

Arrived a little before 9pm tonight (Sunday) after checking that they still serve food. The hostess was delightful and confirmed that the kitchen was still open and I could take a seat - a server would be right with me. After about 5 minutes, two servers walked right passed me and smiled. I gave them 5 more minutes for one to at least say "hi, I'll be right with you." Didn't happen. I left.

One of the very best cheese steaks I've had in a very long time!!  Sandwich was HUGE in comparison to many of their famous competitors.  Service was good... friendly and fast.  A bit of a hike if you live in Center City, but if you find yourself in the neighborhood, don't hesitate to stop in.  You'll be happy you did!

Well deserved 5-Star reviews. I've been trying to support local businesses as much as possible, so when I was in need of a new vacuum, I resisted the sales at a big box store and went here instead. I'm glad I did.

One of the employees demonstrated a few vacuums for me, didn't pressure me, and was really friendly. He answered all of my questions, and was very knowledgeable about the product. When I was checking out, I spoke briefly to the owner. He made me feel confident in my purchase - and explained a little bit about how they started to carry the brands they sell. They even carried my vacuum to my car, which I appreciate.

Great experience purchasing - now to try my vacuum...

I absolutely loved this place! My husband and I visited Nashville for our anniversary and this was a place we had to visit regardless of the reviews on here. All the food that we had and the food my sister and brother-in-law had was delicious! The brisket is to die for and the view of the river was great. The two guys singing with only guitars sounded amazing and the classic country songs were perfect. Our serves was really on top of it also.

Terrible expierence. Took my French bulldog to get his nails cut. The tech dragged my dog to the back without calling his name or making it a more pleasant expierence as he hates this. Almost got out of his collar and the tech did not seem any part compassionate or care. Seemed to be many people working there and walking around the lobby yet not doing anything. If you love your dogs like your own kids please do not take them here. I will not be bringing my English bulldog pup to this vet and will be sticking to my Beaumont vet (30 min travel) as she treats the animals like her own and professional and compassionate service. Well worth the drive!

Ever want to grab food alone? I often times come to restaurant by myself and enjoy the chips and food. I'm typically in the restaurant with others dining alone. Never felt odd or off put. If you ever want Mexican food but don't have anyone to go with go and grab a seat at La Tapatia!
This is a MUST STOP every time we are in Nashville. Try the Chicken and Waffles or the Lemon Blueberry Pancakes or both!!!!! Make sure to order a Bloody Mary as well.

I would never recommend this place to anybody. I ordered the nights special which was steak, broccoli rob and potato. The broccoli rob looked like cream spinach and the steak was like an old shoe with grizzle running through it. The potatoes were bland. Even the salad that came was just field greens with some onion on top and a carrot. We had a new waitress. I took one bite of each of the foods on my plate and sat there while my husband ate his meal which was a pizza. No offer from waitress to take the meal back to the chef or anything as she knew I was very disappointed with the meal. This was not cheap either. So we spent a lot of money on a terrible meal!

Not much more I could add to the 400+ reviews.  I was a local off and on for 10 years.  Always loved Pats but for logistical reasons started to hit Ishkibbles at the end of my Philly tenure.  After a return trip to Philly, I was slightly disappointed in the Pats steaks my family orrdered.  Seemed to skimp on the meat.  Rolls were not as fresh as they could have been.  Because we were there late on a Sunday morning, and on an Eagles home game Sunday non-the-less, I bumped up from 2.5 to 3 stars.  OK, but not as good as it has been.

Delicious seafood pasta and a gorgeous dining area. There's also a beautiful outdoor area that looks super inviting with comfy looking couches. Unfortunately it was too hot out side to enjoy it. Only gave 4 stars because the server was a little distracted by talking to other employees and I was never offered a beverage refill

I dropped my sister off at Greyhound Bus Terminal in Nashville, Tn. on December 25, 2017.  She was traveling from Nashville to Beckley, West Virginia.  The scheduled bus at 7:00 p.m. was cancelled.  Finally over three hours later she was taken to Knoxville Tn.  and dropped off in the terminal.  There was no counter open until 4:30 am in the morning.  She was stranded there all night and into the early afternoon on Dec. 26.  She was scheduled to transfer in Wytheville, Va.  The driver told her that she could not get off at Wytheville.  She is diabetic,in poor health and was going to dial 911 to receive assistance when the driver allowed her to get off the bus.  He wanted to drop her off in Richmond, Virginia which was not even close to her purchased ticket destination.  Many hours later she was picked up by a relative that had to drive four hours to get to Wytheville.  She never reached her original destination.
Look and read all these reviews before you decide to go on Greyhound.  People are not writing them because there is nothing better to do.  Being too poor to take any other mode of transportation caused my sister irreversible damage.  Until everyone joins together and sues this company they will continue to take advantage of the handicapped and poor.  Make some noise!!!!!!

Stopped by for a late night snack/drink with my wife. Found two seats at the bar. Nachos sounded great with an old fashioned and a margarita. Whoa! The Texas Ranger Nachos were enough to feed the Texas Rangers. They were absolutely wonderful. I've heard all their nachos are great but these are on my every time list. The drinks were stiff but made right. I'm an old fashioned snob and the guys made them just right. This will be a local hangout for us so we'll see you there some evening soon.

Purchased a package of cinnamon buns on 12/30/18. Our child ate one before we noticed the date stamp on the package of "APR 05/18." Our hope is that the date is in error but it proved impossible to actually speak with anyone from the store on the phone to get any clarification. After 25 minutes trying to reach the store via IKEA's 888 number, we gave up. Unbelievable that a customer can't actually speak with a store employee via phone. Incompetence all around.

Just got my roots and highlights touched up by Annie yesterday at Balance in West Chester.
This is my second appointment with Annie.  I have dark hair (90%grey) which is difficult to work with as it  absorbs color differently and I have problems with dark depositing around face.
I also have been to multiple salons on the mainline, city over the past 5 years and have not been able to get rich brown balyage highlights - they kept giving me gold and obvious yellow ones. This required me going back and getting them to correct not always being too friendly about it. Plus I do not have time to waste.
Annie immediately corrected my issues and gave me the caramel highlights I have been looking for.  
She is an extremely talented colorist and I will be going back to her. She also gave me a great cut. 
She actually listens to the client and provides options and then does what is agreed on.
The salon in West Chester is very calming. The owners are very customer focused.
I highly recommend them and I am not the type of person who spends time writing reviews. Worth going from Phoenixville to West Chester.

Thank you,
Great broth! Delicious food and nice service. It would be a five star but they are a bit pricy for pho.

Food was standard. Definitely not worth $55. I prefer to go to Nabrasa in Horsham, PA. Not only was the food mediocre but it was a icebox inside. The whole room was freezing and made the experience not enjoyable. Our server was kind and nice but did not make up for the lack of flavor, originality & comfort of the restaurant.
This place is a hidden gem. Amazing food and super nice staff. If you go, do yourself a favor and get the Cuban nachos. Not sure why it says it's in Carrolwood - it is in Lutz.
Never been to a massage spot like this... Being from LA I am used to go to nail salons and get a foot massage thrre... So this is pretty cool!!! Def loved it!!!

I forgot to place an order for a cut of meat l needed immediately.  When I called the business to see if they had what I needed, not only did they have it but they told me I could come in and pick it up right away even though the store was closed. The butcher was cutting the roast  to my specifications when I arrived and I took it home  a very short time after the initial call. A customer has been gained and I will highly recommend to anyone looking for quality meats and extraordinary customer service!
I've been looking for a good enchilada place in Reno for 35, years, finally found one! Absolutely outstanding food, excellent enchilada sauce.

Absolute 100% Perfection! I did a LOT of research about different wedding planning companies, actually flew from DC to Florida to check them all out, and it was obvious that I had to go with Suncoast!

Michelle and Autumn held my hand every step of the way. I'm a perfectionist, and I had extremely high expectations. And they SURPASSED every single one of them!

-They held my hand and were patient answering my 1000's of questions and requests throughout the entire process.
-They set everything up and it went off without a single hitch!
-They recommended the reception location and all of my guests could not stop raving about the food and elegance of the entire day!
-Michelle and Autumn are Number 1 at customer service! They want you to be happy! And they do everything they can to make it so.
-Their prices are so much lower than anyone else I looked at, AND you get SO MUCH MORE for your money, that it's a no-brainer!

Without any hesitation, I over-the-top highly recommend them! You will have an Absolutely PERFECT wedding day!!!

Walked out after waiting over 45 minutes for appetizer. Despite our servers insistence that our food was coming right up, all the tables seated after us started receiving their food. It also took them over 5 minutes to acknowledge our existence upon arrival even though they seemed to be well staffed and the restaurant was mostly empty. Should have taken that as a sign...

I've been a regular customer of the Aveda Institute for three years. I do both color and cuts here. Why? Mainly because it's affordable for me. I have long, thick hair that costs a fortune to color at a salon.

I do have to invest quite a bit of time, though. Students can be slow, and they have to get checks from their instructors multiple times throughout the process. 

But, I'm almost always happy with my hair.  There are times it doesn't turn out like I want, but it's always something I can live with. I figure that's the price to pay for students doing my hair (since the price to get it done is not nearly that of a salon.

Worst Denny's you will find in the Midwest. I've been here twice the first time took an hour and 45 minutes to get our food. I'm sitting here in the car writing this after walking out due to waiting 30 minutes on even putting in my drink order. 5 staff members messing around on FaceTime with their friends instead of helping customers. Who's the manager? Utter chaos. There were only 2 other tables in the whole restaurant.

Highly over rated.  Brisket incredibly dry. Smoked turkey was good. Sides obviously out of can. Won't go back.
.

Zorba's is a very good neighborhood BYO.  I've been there a few different times, some better than others.  A must is the cold appetizer platter.  In addition to their homemade hummus, it features a yogurt dip, some sort of seafood dip, and a few others.  Be sure to order extra pita bread with it as the one pita they provide you with isn't enough.

The last time I went there I ordered the charcoal sampler, which was phenomenal.  Though this included all sorts of meats, the best of bunch was the leg of lamb.  This was incredibly tender and a fall-off-the-bone type dish.

The one dish that I've had that I wouldn't recommend was the meatballs-they were a bit dry and I would avoid them.

Really cool place to try Latin food, mainly Colombian style, with very unique, creative, and sumptuous flavors from regions of Latin America.  The coconut flan is INCREDIBLE and the pina colada is delicious!  The supervisor Elizabeth was sweet, delightful and accommodating, and our server Ivette was very attentive.

I love this hidden little Bar in SB.  The Craft Cocktails are absolutely amazing.  The Staff is friendly and aim to please and there is no other establishment in SB that matches their quality by far.  Finally an above par place to have a superb cocktail.  They have lots of other beverages to offer like wines, beer, an homemade ginger beer.  But the mixologist here make one mean ass drink.

We were super excited when we saw that a new Vietnamese restaurant had opened up in Hamilton County. We're huge fans of Super Bowl Pho in Westfield and were excited to try another Vietnamese spot, especially since it's labeled "street food."

The menu is small, or at least much smaller than Super Bowl's. A few kinds of pho and bành mi, and a couple meat-and-rice dishes, and the typical assortment of Vietnamese drinks make a well-rounded menu, but it's minimal. The service was great! You could tell they have just opened a few months ago, but they were super nice.

I had the crispy chicken. I figured it would be chunks, but it's a whole chicken leg...even better. It was juicy and tender, and the skin was crispy. I liked it a lot, but it could have used some salt on the crust. The rice underneath it was heavenly because it soaked up all the chicken juices. Just wish there had been more of it!

My parents' food was good as well. My dad had a pork chop with an egg over rice, which was better than my chicken. My mom's bành mi was also good (not quite as good as Super Bowl's though). 

We will be back, but not for a while since we have so many other places in the area. I'll probably get the pork chop.

Really Suzy "Wrongs" house of RUDE!  I have never been so dismissed by a Nashville restaurant!  I was so excited to try the dining experience here but never even got acknowledged at the table!  A Saturday night around 8:00pm and the place was half empty.  No...we didn't have a reservation but we were there ready to eat, drink, and spend plenty of money.  They tried to seat two of us at a table in the window next to a very oversized party.  We would've been basically at their table so being very laid back people just said we'd head to the bar.  We found a tiny bar table with stools and sat down.  We sat watching the bartenders ignore us and multiple servers parade to and fro not even making eye contact with us.  We spoke with an employee making sure that we were seated appropriately and even later spoke with the absolutely clueless host(s) who informed us that the server assigned to our station was handling a "party" (never saw a party of any size, hello?) and couldn't be bothered with us.  Whatever!  We left and spent our money elsewhere!  Shame on the bartenders for not even acknowledging our presence!  Drinks and an appetizer and we would've been happy.  How hard is that?  Rude, Rude, Rude!  Owner, I would be doing some retraining of staff if I were you.  What a horrible experience!

It is rare for me to give a five stars, and I've been wanting to give c&r a great rating for years but did not under Mom's principle "if you don't have anything nice to say, don't say it". In short, the place has turned around (and this is a fairly recent phenomenon). Allow me to be specific. The menu has gone from inflated and lacking a common theme to very simple and focused. The simplicity is huge! It is allowing the chef to focus on quality over quantity. 

I've eaten there now 4x in 2 weeks. Consistency, which was historically lacking, is now steadfast. My burger 2 nights ago was excellent. My lamb burger last night may have been the best I've had. The cauliflower appetizer exceptional. Lamb chops are excellent and possibly underpriced (not complaining). Steak is solid. 

Service is great (was not always) and importantly, they now deliver on Grubhub which is huge for local businesses in Bala Cynwyd (like mine). So...I'm now feeling really good about C&R and hope they can keep up the strong execution for people like me who demand excellence.
The Melting Pot is a great conversational dinner. Provides great service and great food
