My mom was actually the one who first found this place and now it's a go-to when I'm in town.  The people who work here are so friendly and helpful.  They asked what I was looking for and guided me in the right direction of what I would need.  I've been into other voodoo shops in New Orleans and this one just felt the most comfortable and helpful.  They have such a wide selection of items as well.

Spent the day in Chinatown, sampling heres and theres. I sampled here twice.

It wasn't supposed to be a special visit- I'd done Tea Talk a few doors down, but found myself extremely anxious. I was juttery and nervous and didn't know what to think of it, but Tea Talk wasn't serving anything warm that day, so we took a stroll down 10th and walked into Tea Do. Without noticing the hot tea menu, I asked for the Honey Jasmine hot... "we'll do that for you!"

I have never had Jasmine like this. It was like rolling in a bed of Jasmine flowers and honeysuckle, the smells and the flavors bringing sweet peace to my nerves, great relaxation after trying to find parking. I watched the 10k on their screens from my place at the bar, and a couple at a table behind us played complimentary house Jenga.

We returned not long later for a light snack, getting the curried fish balls and the gyoza... both were satisfying, affordable, and just what we needed as a late pick me up. More tea to share!

They do a cool spill-proof lid, too, for cold drinks. Never saw it before.

p.s. downside- while I found some of the service to be amazing!--- there was a female barrista who was bitter, rude, and swore in front of children while on duty.
I ordered the burrito bowl with brown rice and chicken. Had a long wait while it was prepared and ended up with white rice instead of brown. Definitely not worth $10!!
Great value, good quality work and just overall nice people! What a great family owned business! I will always come back!
Josh was a great tour guide and very knowledgeable. I have a whole different perspective of the bayou. He was very nice and we had a great time.

Excellent sushi - some of the best I've had. Great and quick service despite being crowded. Everything served was good. The grills in the back had lively crowds and the private dining looked like a great place for a small group. A place to go back again and again.

Disgusting flies everywhere! I have been shopping at WholeFoods for a long time in various locations throughout the country. This one in Boise has been a big disappointment. Starting with the patronizing customer service booth. But the main issue is the FLIES! Never have I seen so many flies in any food store anywhere. At the food counters, open condiment areas, produce - you name it. I had to wave over the deli meat I ordered to keep them from landing!  The sales person behind the deli counter just nodded her head when I asked her to watch the flies. And when I mentioned the flies to customer service up front - he replied " yes - the flies just keep getting ahead of us". Unbelievable!
Great traveling exhibits!! The interactive standing exhibits are showing serious wear.  We also had concerns over the cleanliness of the interactive exhibits.

We had really bad experience with food here. Ordered seafood salad, meat pie, seafood gumbo n gumbo with sausage and shrimp. Gumbo was very watery, not hot and with very little seafood. Salad was not fresh. We were very disappointed because we set our expectation high for this so called authentic restaurant

My husband and I have frequented Mystic Fish several times during the past few years, and we typically go for the Eventide menu which includes a soup or salad along with an entrée such as the shrimp cake or boneless short ribs,as well as either mashed potatoes or rice and the nightly veggie, starting at just $14.75. Despite the meals being of consistently high quality, the food sometimes lacks a bit in flavor and is not always exciting. However, we truly enjoy the bread and garlic butter they serve before dinner, and their mini desserts are incredibly delicious, especially the white chocolate bread pudding and the espresso one. As for the wine, I'm pretty sure that each pour is only $2.75 and the well drinks are the same exact price, but do note that these prices are strictly available during the Eventide hours. We have also dined here on Mother's Day and my birthday, and ordered from both the regular menu and the daily specials. I was pretty happy with my small plate of seared scallops and strawberries, plus feta and arugula with lemon and honey. There aren't enough words to describe how amazing it was! Likewise, my husband fell in love with his hog fish, saying it was super fresh and flaky, and surprisingly, had lots of flavor. My mom is a fan of their steak and of course, the garlic shrimp should not be missed. Also, my 17-year-old daughter is nuts over the assorted vegetable plate, with many different styles of preparing them. Even though it's primarily a seafood restaurant, they still have a huge selection for almost everyone who visits. The atmosphere is upscale, with white tablecloths and aquariums situated around the dining room; yet, it really doesn't feel stuffy or pretentious. Service is always excellent! Since this is a popular restaurant to dine in, especially during Eventide and on weekends, you might want to make a reservation several days prior to your plans.
The salads were tasty and the bread was good, however the entrees were heavy handed and my wife's seafood dish was too seafoody-tasting. My truffle pasta was decent, but nothing great.

The worse food I ever tasted in my life, I would not recommend anyone to spend a penny at this place, employees was very rude, food tasted like it was 4 days old, place had a strange smell upon entering the business, I'm sorry I even gave them a try,

One star for the servers!!!  Four stars for the food, the beer, and the patio. If this place had servers that were just half capable the experience would be great. Had dinner with friends last Friday on the patio and got the wrong appetizer, got spilled on (without an apology) and had to hunt down our own beer at the bar (server never came around). The table next to us got spilled on also. We like coming here in the summer, great atmosphere. But please!!!!  Fix the servers!!!
Love this place! Highly recommend to anyone who is looking for great food, beer and ambience. Great prices/portions. My new go to place.

Patrons with children or dogs BEWARE!!!! If safety is a major concern, it may be best to seek an alternative park in the area.  I've stayed at this RV Park several times, for New Orleans, the park is pretty nice, there are full facilities, including a bar/lounge and restaurant (all in one) (Cajun style menu that's pretty good), in so far as the people, the front desk employees, (Ashley, Shaun, Christy) are the nicest and most professional employees you could wish for, other employees such as the grounds keeper are rude and quite frankly act like total A** HOLE that lacks any consideration, customer communications skills, or respect. They have rules that apply to the "guests" (or people that pay to stay) yet the very same rules do not apply to the employees, for instance one grounds keeper has a pit bull that he states does not need to be on a leash because the dog is an "employee," what BS, he allows the pitt bull to roam the park, leash free, endangering the paying patron's children and pets. It is strange that management condones this behavior.  Aside from the great amenities (cable TV, Internet, store, propane sales station, and at night hourly security patrol) included with the space, the spaces are not to grade, there is no pavement, so there are a lot of pot holes, everything is covered in decomposed rock, which is rough on the feet, even with shoes on. The great staff aside, the grounds keeper and more importantly the free to roam pitt bull is reason enough to stay away from this place. There are parking rules which, in my three past visits, are selectively applied, noting rules is the best way to avoid the grounds keeper, as his method of communications and mannerisms are abusive, threatening and rude at best.

Check out the events at Sundance. If you like NPR and lively discussions of conditions, history that affect life, particularly in the Basin, you will be entertained. There are also music events.  It does have a nice interior. For the books: keep looking, you may come across an unexpected surprise in there. I did. Poke around.

Man, the Poke bowls here are amazing!  I like the salmon and tuna with mango and seaweed. The deli subs are great, but wish they had gluten free bread for my Italian.  Wife loves the coffee and my son goes crazy for the fancy donuts.  I like the gluten free chocolate cake, with some Mother Kombucha on tap or a craft beer.

i had some of the same problems that other reviewers had...  i was told to drop my vehicle off at 10am, no one was there.. someone eventually showed up at 11.. i waited with two other people till someone showed up..  i was told the van would b ready by 2, no call to say it was ready, i stopped by at 4 to pick it up and it was still parked in the same exact spot where i had left it and it was still dirty, they told me they didnt have enough time to clean it. maybe cause they  were an hour behind from the late start to the day...i took it home and tried to rebook and was told  there was a five month wait (they only have so many appts available for dealfind voucher users per month)  this was an older voucher  i was trying to use, at the time this all happened there was another dealfind  promo running.. i told them maybe they should stop selling vouchers  and honor the ones that were outstanding in a timely fashion ..  i held onto the voucher for a couple of years (the old ones did not have expiry dates) and decided to call them in april to use it.. at first they told me they would not honor it cause even though it didnt expire they would be in their new location by the next available appointment date (four months away) and therefore the voucher was void!!!  after going back and forth with the person on the phone they eventually said they would honor it...  i was finally able to use it yesterday.. i picked it up quite late and it was dark so i couldnt see if my van  was properly cleaned.. the one thing i did notice was that my windshield was really streaky and the drive home was challenging to say the least..  they also did not clean the inside of the windshield above the rear view mirror.. as far as the rest of the van is concerned i didnt have a chance to look yet (drove the car to work this am when it was still dark) fingers crossed that the rest of the van is good..   i get the feeling that judging by the reviews the bad service/ poor workmanship might go hand in hand with the use of the vouchers...  so dont buy the vouchers i guess!

I was looking for a unique place to stay in New Orleans for a friends birthday. I found it! St. Vincent's Guest House has a very somber history and you can feel it in the buildings ambience. 

Creepy factor A+

It's location is also really close to local bars and restaurants.

Absolute MUST for adventurous people bored with the usual accommodation.

We had a rough go at it, and once the review hit the internet, we finally had some follow up.  It took some time for me to make it in, although the behind the scenes owner Danny stayed on top of making sure I did.  Two points for him for sure!

Aside from the awkward greeting by the hostess "are you the guys who didn't like their pizza last time and wrote the review on yelp?", everyone was very friendly and attentive.  The Root beer has the right amount of carbonation and the food came out well.  The sausage pizza was flavorful and we had a couple salads as well.  

High notes to Chris the part owner and clear operator.  He certainly followed through with personalization and true concern and passion.  He discussed some changes that he made and even shared with us some locals specials.  

The real deal here is their clear attempt and practice of partnering with local businesses and a true desire to embrace and support their local community.  

The look of this restaurant is certainly perfect and there are lots of little details throughout.  Chris recommends eating in the store for flavor reasons and I'd support his decision.  A fun night out and a business you can feel good about supporting.

Had the best experience here.  Service was on point and the manager Richey was so hospitable. Being in the service industry it's not easy getting good service anywhere much less a manager checking on how we were doing.  Very impressed.  Great job to Richey and his staff.

This is the worst roof repair experience ever. They did one time repair, leaking again in two days, called them back, bad attitude, event intimidating me. I almost called police. 

John B. at University City

This little gift shop sells jewelry, clothing, decorative items, and accessories which are all local and handmade.  It's a pleasant, friendly space, and everything is reasonably priced.  The inventory changes frequently- when I went, there were some really cool Fleur-de-lis (I know we've all been Fleur-de-lis'd to death, but these are hand-made and very unique,) hand-sewn baby bibs, crochet blankets, hats, and hat pins, and some really neat jewelry with a local influence.   One of the necklaces featured a medallion that looked very similar to an immortelle, which is a very intricate New Orleans funerary wreath which was popular in the 19th century.  If you're looking for that unique gift, check them out. Combine your visit with a great meal at Maurepas.
Very interesting menu! Had to google what a lot of stuff was. Ended up ordering the smoked salmon and trout pate, it was pretty good.

My fiancee and I had a horrible experience with 33 Jewels.  We thought getting our engagement ring from a small company would be better than an impersonal big company, but that was totally wrong.  Go to Blue Nile, or if you want palladium like we did, check out McGiverns (cheaper but you have to get insurance on your own).  Even places like Fred Meyer or Ben Bridge are more worth the price you'll pay because they actually offer service and insurance in exchange for the markup. 33 Jewels was a total mistake!

We ordered an engagement ring from Diane Garmendia, co-owner of 33 Jewels, who told us it'd arrive during our Winter break (it was my Christmas gift from my fiancée).  She didn't tell us it was going to be delayed. She ruined our Christmas. It didn't arrive until the second week of January, and when it did, it was loose on my finger. Diane told me that it'd fit better when the weather got warmer. She also said we'd get the appraisal for the ring (so we could insure it, since the diamond wasn't certified) in a couple of weeks, so we took the ring and paid her for it.

Fast forward to April. The ring was still way too big, and we still didn't have the appraisal. We finally went back to 33 Jewels to ask for the appraisal and check the ring's size.  Turns out the ring was almost a size 7 (we ordered a 6.5), and on top of that Diane had done a bad sizing job the first time because after I made Diane go through all the ring sizers, she found I was actually a size 6.25. Either 33 Jewels never checked the size of the ring they delivered to us or they just didn't care. They said they'd fix it in under a week and get back to us, along with the appraisal. We had to call them to see when if was ready, and when I went back to get it, they still didn't have the appraisal. And on top of that, when I got home, I found out that the ring was damaged! There was a set of deep tool-marks on both sides of the ring (like from a vise) and filing marks all along the back, top, and bottom of the ring. It hadn't been polished at all. We got it sized, and found it was a 6.00 (which Diane had said would be too small). Diane had inspected the ring and checked its size before giving it to me, too, so she knew perfectly well what she was giving me, and didn't care at all about the shoddy workmanship. We took the ring back to 33 Jewels, and Diane said she'd fix it for us. She also said she'd email me a copy of the appraisal and took down my contact information.

Another week passed and we didn't hear anything. At this point, we decided that we had had enough and just wanted my fiancee's money back. He called 33 Jewels to ask for a refund. Turns out that they don't give refunds, even though they never delivered on what we ordered (a correctly sized ring with an appraisal). Diane never told either of us that she had an "all sales final" policy. She claimed the ring was "custom", but really, we picked a stock design from a catalog, and the only "custom" part of it was the center stone ... which is no different from getting a semi-mount and stone at any jewelry store. We tried to get a chargeback through my fiancee's credit card company, but more than 60 days had passed so Chase wouldn't do it.

After Diane heard we wanted a chargeback, she suddenly realized she had our contact information. She called multiple times to say that there was nothing wrong with the ring, and there had never been anything wrong with the ring (?!), and that we were being completely unreasonable in wanting his money back.  She claimed she hadn't called him to say the ring was ready before because she had the wrong number on file, even though his number was correctly written on the receipt.  She said what she put us through was "totally normal" according to her "experienced friends in the business", and that there was no way she'd even consider a refund because she didn't think she did anything wrong. Diane also insinuated that she thought the real problem was our relationship and she offered me counseling of all things.

Diane's calls were getting progressively nastier, so my fiancee decided we should just pick up the ring and hold off on filing complaints about 33 Jewels before they did something else bad to us, like damaging the ring on purpose as revenge. When he finally went back to get it this last time, Diane finally gave him the appraisal.  The appraisal was just a Word document with a picture of the ring on it.  A 3rd grader could have made something that looked just as official.  They managed to remove the deep tool-marks, but damaged the prongs, which may not be fixable.  So now my fiancée and I are stuck with a damaged ring and an appraisal we don't trust. We're obviously pissed about the BS 33 Jewels put us through and don't want to be reminded of it, so I have not worn it since we got it back. We will be selling it and buying another ring elsewhere if we can't force a return. 

Avoid 33 Jewels at all costs!

Wanted to get social interaction for my son. He just turned 3. He's slightly on the spectrum in areas of speech and social interaction. I thought a place where I could drop him off for a few hours to be around others kids was great. Upon dropping him off these was no concerns. I explained to the young lady at the front why I wanted him there for a few hours. My sons Speech Therapist opted to drop in on him seeing as the environment was new. And what she basically informed me was the young lady in the back assigned to the kids was rude and lacked patience. My son kept going on the slide and she wanted him to stop because "could not attend to him each time he went on the slide". "He requires too much attention and talking to and I don't have the time for that".  
Needless to say I was shocked so I went to get my son as soon as his ST called me. Upon arriving there my son was still on the slide and the young lady at the front went to get him. She kept saying to my son "Mom is here come on let's go". She said it about 2x when the young lady in the back said "Just pick him up"! With an annoyance in her tone. And I'm standing there just in disbelief. You are trained to work around kids. But the kids you have to attend to annoys you? The kids that was on their iPad or sitting in a corner playing was ok. But a child where you actually had to work got you upset. Upon getting my child the young lady at the front said "I'll be honest with you, if you're looking for a structured environment this is not the place for your son". I supposed she wanted me to respond to her but the look on my face was one of please hand me my child so I can go. I WOULD NEVER SET FOOT IN THAT PLACE AGAIN. UNPROFESSIONAL AT ITS BEST!

This place is amazing. I met a friend here and this was both of ours first time visiting Prep & Pastry and I was so happy we picked this place. 
It was absolutely packed which was annoying but that just means this is the place to be! Everyone working was so sweet and the place is gorgeous. 
I ordered the everything croissant sammie and it was amazing! The prosciutto was so good. I highly recommend coming here.
This place is such a hidden treasure! The chef is on top of it! Love the variety on the menu. Been here many times and always consistent. Friendly service and delicious food morning, noon or night.

It was my first time traveling to the mid-west and I am so glad I stayed at this hotel. The hospitality is real and I called twice and spoke to Tommy before arriving. I asked a bunch of touristy questions (probably very silly to him) and about the safety profile of the neighborhoods of St Louis-- well, Tommy was super informative and very helpful. Thank you for the help and putting our parties next to each other even though the hotel was hosting a huge wedding. 

The hotel itself is very clean, modern and newly updated. The bathroom isn't huge but that wasn't a big deal to us. I just loved how modern and chic everything was. We arrived around 3pm extremely hungry and their regular lunch me I was already closed BUT they still had options from the bar menu. We all ordered burgers and shockingly it was actually really good! I would totally choose to sit here and eat instead of walking outside to a nearby eatery. The restaurant area has a nice sit down ambience, better than most generic hotels.

Last but not least, I loved the gym on the top flow. There are 4 peloton bikes you can use and a decent size gym along with cold towels in a fridge for you to use (Nice touch). Clayton is about 15 mins from STL, so if you're visiting  the area-- I would choose this hotel

They're not priced like Papa Johns(eww),but that's the idea-you definitely get what you pay for. Every one of their pizzas I've had is so delish-when in doubt,order the pizza they're famous for,which is their chicken artichoke pizza. Their delivery and dine in staff are always prompt and congenial. I'll still order from here,even when I move out of Tampa!

First time in. Great coffee house. We got a latte and it was very foamy and tasty.   Also enjoyed their baked goods. Both the pumpkin orange muffin an banana bread.  The design of the store was also nice. Lots of great places to sit and chat.

I was recommended to Smile Direct by a coworker who loves her results. I knew upfront that it was only for mild to moderate corrections, and it's ONE price no matter how many or few trays you need. All of this info is on the website. If you show up not knowing this, you didn't do basic research going in. The women at the office were fabulous! Shelby was my representative and she was great. Super friendly and answered all questions. They were not high pressure with me at all. Shelby did my tooth scan which was cool to see! More accurate than impressions I was told. Can't wait to start the process. I would recommend this location.

N.B. The given star rating does not imply that this place is comparable to other three-star establishments; the rating given here is skewed, as no one has ever had food from All Star while sober.

That said, as I recall, All Star is the best food I've ever had--ever. Every time I ordered it, I was starving and it was 3am. When all other establishments had left me for dead, All Star was there to rescue me, much like a St. Bernard with a barrel of rum tethered to its collar, there to rescue a moribund skier.

I don't recall how much it costs--I just gave the delivery guy money until he left--but I assume that the price is good, too. 

So, if you're kind of far from sober, awake at 3am, and starving in Manayunk, call All Star. They will be at your house in no time, and you won't be able to recall a time when you've had better food.

I positively reviewed Lakshmi once before when I was seeing a different stylist. That stylist has since left Lakshmi so I took a chance on Laisa over a year ago and I've never looked back!. Laisa is wonderful! Never I have I had someone spend so much time to ensure that the cut looks just right. She is meticulous and you can tell how much pride she takes in her work. Laisa is also incredibly down to earth and listens to what you want while at the same time offering suggestions when you might be looking for something new. In addition to her cutting skills, Laisa is adept at color techniques. I generally go with a single process but I have had highlights done by Laisa and they were beautiful. If you want to try Lakshmi ask for Laisa and you will not be sorry nor intimidated.

It's hard to tell a southern girl what a good fish sandwich is supposed to taste like, but y'all, this is what a good freaking fish sandwich is supposed to taste like. My mom and I had no idea what kind of experience we were in for when we got fried fish between two pieces of bread for dinner, but oh my gosh... We're talking big fresh sliced tomato, light airy batter, a spicy aOli, and the lightest, Buttery fish I've ever had!
Very good Italian beef samwiches! The fries are the best! Order them "extra crispy"

City Park is great because it has something for everybody--actually, it has 2 or 3 somethings for everybody. Perfect place for a stroll, fantastic people watching, a newly opened Morning Call for some beignet-and-coffee action, a small amusement park for the kidlets, boating, art museum, sculpture garden, 2 stadiums (Tad Gormley and Pan-American), nature trail through some swamps, wildlife, boating, kids' train, phew! I know people fish here as well, though I am not sure exactly where; you can also hit up the nearby Bayou St. John. 

My pro-tip: On a warm spring/summer day, grab a snoball and take it with you for a walk around the park. And do not be surprised when an overwhelming feeling of beauty and peace wash over you.

From reading the previous reviews of this place, my friends and I were inclined to try this place.  Our first impressions of it when we walked in was very nice, authentic Japanese feel; because of It's decorations and atmosphere.  Plus, it's a small restaurant .

The staff were very friendly.  For such a small area, there were 3-4 waitresses working.  So they were attentive to your needs.

So far sounds good place right?  But the reason I give it only 2 stars is because of the food.  It was not amazed by it at all.  In fact, disappointed.  Sushi rolls were good and came out very nicely decorated.  But the ramen and donburi were salty and there was just nothing special about it.  My ramen soup was heavy too... maybe a bit too much msg??

I highly recommend adding this to your stop of places to visit while in Santa Barbara (assuming you're not from the area!). 

There's an assortment of little eateries, all very diverse and unique. The must here is the ice cream shop Rori's, although we passed by a cupcake shop that looked amazing as well as a noodle shop that also looked to be well worth the visit (but we unfortunately didn't have enough stomach space to try a dish).

Bathrooms are clean and public so if anything, take a stroll and use the restrooms. 

New vendors seemed to be coming in over the next months so I'm excited to see how this place transforms! Surprisingly, on a Saturday early afternoon, it was quite empty. Not sure if it's SB's best kept secret but I think this market is pretty underrated. Or maybe it's just very attractive to a visitor like me because you can experience the local food scene of SB without having to drive or walk around the whole city!

I tried ONLY the Dim Sum here at 8:00 pm on a Monday night. I ordered the BBQ pork buns, deep fried egg buns, and the shrimp. Firstly, the food I tried was not worth the price. Not comparing prices to other restaurants, but based on this experience. 
AND there were only about 5-6 options :(. 

Having lived in San Francisco, and having delectable Dim Sum available nearly at all times, this did not measure up to my expectations. I did not expect it to be as tasty as (anything) in San Fran, but it was more expensive than some the amazing dim sum places out there. 

The shrimp was goood. Great texture and taste. The BBQ pork buns were flavorful, but fatty, and the meat was sparse. 

The egg buns were--interesting. When I was in Taiwan, I at egg tarts that has this same flavor, but the texture was different--much smoother. The texture of these egg buns was gritty. It seemed like the eggs weren't mixed all the way, and I was biting into bits of flour the entire time. Whether or not they're made with flour..is a different matter. Texture doesn't bother me all that much, but someone else may have been turned off by this. They were VERY sweet, to my surprise, as the waiter told me they were a bit salty and just kinda sweet. Oh well. 

I wouldn't try this restaurant again for dim sum, even if all other dim sum places were closed for the week. The three stars came from the shrimp and the flavor of the buns.  I would, however like to try their other dishes and adjust my rating accordingly.

Looking at some of the other reviews it appears that this place is hit or miss - well, I guess I caught them on a "miss" night. 

The restaurant was moderately crowded - not packed, but busy. There were a few open tables. We were seated promptly and immediately noticed that we were sitting right under an AC vent. My dining companion was complaining of being uncomfortably cold (it was) and I asked that we be moved to another table. Apparently, this request took an act of congress to be approved. But eventually we were moved to a booth that was more comfortable (note: by this point we had already ordered). Apparently, and according to our waitress, a patron's request to change tables confuses the kitchen and delays the food (why? I have no idea. Food took forever to be served. Therefore I just go with what I am told). 

First Bottom Line: I'm not impressed with the service. 

Now for the food: We both had shrimp po-boys -I had a cup of gumbo with mine and she a cup of corn chowder with hers. Shrimp po-boys were passable. Not awful but far, far from the best. The shrimp were sort of cold - you know, like maybe the po-boys had been sitting out for a bit? The gumbo - petty bad. Had a very fishy taste - kind of unpleasant. Took a lot of Tabasco to render it eatable. Corn chowder was OK. We had also ordered a serving of something called cajun potatoes. Can't say if they were good or bad because we never got'em. Asked the waitress and were told that it would take another 20 minutes or so for them to be ready. Needless to say the omission of the potatoes was also blamed on the patron's request to switch tables. Really??? 

Second Bottom Line: Bad gumbo, mediocre everything else. 

Bottom bottom line: don't think I'll be back

Don't get me wrong I love their subs like mentioned in another location but the people that work there are extremely rude! There is one girl even give me a B***** look when I was just asking a napkin. Like she can't believe I just give her more work to just reaching out to get a napkin! Will not go there ever again.

Finally a restaurant that serves full portion, quality food! I don't know what's with the tapas trend in Reno, but I absolutely hate it. If I like the taste of the food I got, I want a lot of it, not a tiny bite and only with a full plate, I will share it with my friend. Thank you for not doing that small plate thing. The food was amazing!

This restaurant has been open 2 weeks . We ordered the supreme pizza ( 14 inches) minus olives & red bell peppers &  added bacon . The pizza is thin crust . Taste was good but light on toppings & cheese . If I go back , I would say double the meat & cheese . I asked for marinara sauce to dip my pizza slice in . It was served cold with my hot pizza . I should've asked them to heat it up . It was located in a new shopping location & easy assess to get too .  Ill wait awhile to try again .

Do you like eggs for breakfast? Do you like eggs Benedict? Do you like fried green tomatoes? Do you like shrimp? Do you like pork products? Do you like fried chicken? Do you like great flavor?  Then this might be the place for you to get the Trifecta to satisfy your taste buds. Not everyone may be able to hang with this combination for breakfast but if you can, you won't be sorry.  This is the place for breakfast on Canal Street.

Ate here last night for the first time and had a fantastic experience! The food was excellent and was so fresh! Even better than the food was the service! Friendly, personable and knowledgeable. Everything I look for when trying a new restaurant. Our server Orby who I believe was also an owner was awesome! I will be going back here for sure simply because of him. Thank you again for a great experience!

The food was really great! Especially the oysters. They were so fresh and thicccc!! The chargrilled oyster was slightly salty but still good. Would def come back in the future. 
Our server was also super nice and good at her job! She knew we wanted more food and recommended us good options.

How have we lived so close for so long without trying this place?! We stopped in today before joining friends for an afternoon of gaming. Just wanted a quick bite and figured we'd try somewhere new. We were greeted warmly by a gal behind the counter when we walked in, and told we could sit anywhere. Another gentleman seated at a table welcomed us also... we thought it was odd until we found out later he was the owner/chef LOL. The piped in music was lively and fun, but not so loud that we couldn't have a conversation.

The menu was limited, and we weren't familiar with Perivian cuisine, so we asked our server for a bit of help, and at her recommendation we ordered the Lomo Saltado to share, with a side of yucca frites. The meal came very quickly and o...m...g... was soooo good! The marinade used on the meat was fantastic (the cilantro really stood out also)! We were offered a hot sauce, which we really enjoyed also. The yucca was light, with a crispy outside and fluffy inside.The yucca came with a sweet, creamy sauce that was good, but we mostly used more of the hot sauce on them. MMM!!

About halfway through our meal, the owner came by to say hello and make sure everything was good (it was!). He told us they bake their own bread and work with a local rancher to get their beef. We complimented him heartily on a well done meal and promised to return soon. 

As we were checking out, our server talked us into some Alfajores (Peruvian Caramel Cookies) to go... she didn't have to twist our arms much. LOL They were a nice little sweet treat after such a good meal. Four cookies came in the box, we each had one and took the other two home to our son (he's lucky they made it home... we have no willpower!).

5 stars for the food, service, atmosphere, prices, and location (less than 5 minutes from our house!). We don't have a single negative thing to say about Don Juan's!

I've been to booty's once for brunch and once for dinner.  Our brunch experience so much more fun, mostly because of the service.  (Brunch was so delicious and the server was excited to suggest food, etc.)  Try the cottontail drink and the pork belly pancakes!  

I work in the hospitality industry and understand not everything is a servers fault.  However, our server just seemed uninterested in our table.  My second drink wasn't rang in or brought out for a long time.  We ordered a bunch of food, so at first I thought they were coursing out all the food to share.  

However, neither of my dishes were brought out.  When I asked to cancel the order since we were finishing up, she brought out the dish which was alright but overcooked because it was probably sitting in the kitchen too long.  No apology or offer to buy it for us, just a "well it was made already..."  I'm not a difficult guest, just want to feel taken care of.

Really fun, interesting food, but service needs some help.

Super tasty steak! Have tried Rib-eye, Porterhouse and Wagyu and like Porterhouse the bset. All the sides and other dishes are so-so... And soda with no refills costs 4.5usd in a small cup ????? Wine and cocktails are good though. Just don't ask for soda...

First 4 star hotel experience for me.

Brought my girlfriend for a weekend getaway and was very satisfied (if you know what I mean :D )

We got a free room upgrade to coastal view. The valet service was excellent, the location was great, the beach was beautiful, the room service + food were second to none, and the *ahem* was intense and steamy.

Bed was super comfy and lots of pillows, A/C was very sensitive and worked the way it should. Everything was clean and neat.

I would definitely stay here again next time I visit Clearwater.

10/10 Resort is 10/10.

Cheers.

I live all the way in Los Angeles, CA and decided to look at the Indianapolis Market as an Investor. Naturally there are a number of concerns when looking at investing out of state; however, after getting in touch with Tom and seeing how professional he and his team operated the majority of those concerns went away. Whenever I had a question or concern, Tom would PERSONALLY handle any issue and put my mind at ease. Overall, Tom and his team were a TREMENDOUS help and I am looking forward to working with them again on my next rental property!

My husband and I planned a last minute Monday to Wednesday trip to Reno. We stopped by GSR during our last trip and said we would stay there next time we went. And it did not disappoint! We had such a nice time. Our favorite part was the pool. Some restaurants were closed but to be expected during the week. That didn't stop us from a good time though! We hope to come back soon.
My favourite salon in west county. Great service,  reasonable prices, clean salon, and rarely a wait.

Consistently good food at decent prices with veggie options.  Extra bonus points for the city's best Mac & Cheese for only 5 bucks & their wines by glass are very drinkable considering the price point.

I have been a patron here on & off for years due to proximity to 2 jobs in NoLibs.  It's a relaxed place to grab a bite to eat with nice happy hour bites & drinks and a great location on the corner of 3rd & Fairmount.  My only quibble is that the service can be a little slow at times.  They serve food all day, so it's a go to spot both at lunch and after work.  Good stuff.
Best pizza on earth ‼The owner is extremely friendly as well as the staff. Italian entrees are straight from Italy and I highly recommend eating here . The place is immaculate too

I am not a vegetarian in any way, but I enjoyed my meal. I ordered the tacos with the mushrooms and cheese sauce. My friend got the curried vegetables. We finished off with a maca smoothie, lemon cookie, and brownie.

My favorite selections were the tacos and the lemon cookie. The tacos were two heaping, flavorful tacos that were perfectly spiced and piled with delicious toppings. The cookie was dense yet had a light, lemony taste. I left feeling satisfied that I had eaten delicious food that was probably better for me than my usual fare.

If it weren't 100 degrees outside, it would have been nice to go enjoy the patio seating.

Service was warm and efficient. I'll be back. Next time I'll be tempted to get the tacos again, but I want to try something new.

..Wow!!!! ....I used to only be able to dream about having inner peace but never was able to make it happen...it was only after I worked with  Debbie Dubickas that I was to achieve this... now I am living with inner peace every day! !!  So thankful for her!! Go see her, ...you will be so thankful you did!!  :)
          ...the rest of the staff are just as great! I had my eyebrow shaped and dyed, and Elle  did an amazing job!!  
 Call them, make an appointment I PROMISE you won't be sorry!!
Been coming here for years but this was my first time eating the new breakfast and it was very good.  They're close to work so I'll be making this a regular stop.

First time here and recommended by a friend. First and foremost. The atmosphere and music gives out an awesome laid back vibe. 

Rachel took care of us for the evening and my fiancé and I ordered the Full Rack ribs and porterhouse steak. Steak cooked perfectly medium rare and seasoned well. Ribs were straight fall off the bone and a not too overwhelming BBQ sauce. 

Drinks were really good and strong! (not complaining!) other than that we didn't get a hand to order any deserts because we were already so full. 

Side notes, restrooms were clean, music and vibe of restaurant was awesome, and our server was very knowledgeable of the menu and questions we had. Definitely will be back!
Consistently wonderful food, service and atmosphere. Have been three times and will go back again. Gluten free menu available and the food is great.

After going to the other Brazilian steakhouse in Nashville, I was hesitant about whether this place would be any good or not. I was pleasantly surprised by many aspects of Rodizio Grill- the attentive service, the large salad bar with something for everyone, and the properly cooked meat. The only reason they lose a star is because the meat was a little slow coming around, but the manager noticed this and started coming around with meat himself. When I went they had recently opened, so hopefully that was just a kink that they've worked out. Either way, this is a great restaurant for a special occasion, with or without a crowd. I'll definitely be back.

It was a quiet Tuesday evening Sept. 1st 2009. Figured we drive to Downtown St. Louis to try one of the Local Pubs for dinner. We happened to pick Flannerys Irish Pub. The waitress was nice (kinda quiet), I ordered a Cheese Burger and as usual hold the onion, tomato and lettuce to get the true taste of their food. The waitress wasnt  fake and forcing the friendly thing to get the big tip. Ordered soda as well with the meal. Waitress's normally dont like that, the bill stays low. Lower tip then. She was fine with that. Broke out the Camel light and had a smoke while waiting for our food. She brought us our utensils and napkins. Not long after our food came. The Cheeseburger was hardy and the fries were golden brown. You could tell that the deepfryer is cleaned consistently, which is good. The burger was awsome, full of flavor and just the right amount of seasoning, not greasy and just the perfect amount of juice. The fries were not salty at all and tasted great. The waitress checked on us several times for refills and to ask if our food was prepared properly. 
Last, but not least, it was and awsome meal and awsome service. I recommend the quiet night on a Monday or Tuesday. Definetly a go again resaurant ~!
Did some inspections prior to our home purchase. Great follow-up on the repairs & some improvements. Wouldn't hesitate to use again. Reasonable & professional across the board.

I've heard about this place for years and just never made it in to check it out. I have to admit that I'm glad I finally did!

I'm always a fan of atmosphere at restaurants/bars and this place has a feel that I really love. There are TVs, pool tables, a large bar, lower table tops, and higher cocktail tables throughout. The menu is awesome and the drinks are delicious and cheap. I ordered the chicken strips and asked for them to be tossed in the asshole sauce. I love spicy and this is the hottest sauce they've got. They were delicious! Also order the mac and cheese or the star tater tots. I still can't get over the variety in the menu for being a rock and roll/punk rock bar. I always need some meat in my meals but I love seeing vegetarian/vegan options filling a menu. 

I'll be returning very soon. Most likely on another Tuesday to get that great $2 drink I had last week. Can't find many good/strong drinks for that cheap too often anymore.

This gym is an amazing value all around. It's not full of obnoxious, grunting body builders and everything is very clean. Patrons do a great job of cleaning after using equipment and the staff is constantly making rounds to clean/replenish sanitation supplies. I am ALWAYS greeted by the awesome front desk staff with a friendly hello and a kind farewell as I leave. The equipment is rarely broken and when it is, it is fixed really fast. This gym has just about everything you need to get a great workout and there are TONS of cardio machines. The strength building stations are in multiples so you will almost always be able to work on what you want. They offer tanning, massage chairs and body sculpting with the Black Card Membership which is a steal for around $22/mo. They have both lay down and stand up tanning beds and the bulbs are brand new. I can't express how good the value is at this gym. Parking is ample and the AC is amazing in this gym. I was formerly an LA Fitness member and I'll never go back. The only thing I miss is spin classes. If you're looking for a gym in the Seminole Heights/Sulfur Springs area, I highly recommend you look here.

Shannon and a few others are great here, the one chick should be fired, absolutely worst service attitude ever! Mostly great experiences here, will always avoid the one chick tho, bad attitude, no work ethic and pretty well useless

Food was not good, red beans and rice was Popeyes Fried Chicken red beans and rice exactly no joke!!! Cajun étouffée tasted like it had a table spoon of lard in it. Gumbo was from a can!!! Small slice of sausage was the best part of this meal. Bread pudding and service was good! Appetizers were good as well. Fries and Alligator.

DO NOT LET THESE PEOPLE NEAR YOUR ANIMALS!! 

My sweet puppy girl Charlie went in for a routine spay here. When we picked her up that evening, we noticed her right eye was blood red in the corner. We didn't worry too much, thinking it was possibly from anesthesia. The next morning when she woke up, her entire eye had no white left and was completely blood red. I called Pet doctor and explained her symptoms and they asked for pictures. I sent them over by email and then called the office back. I was immediately put on hold for 15 minutes and was shocked to have the office manager answer my call and know exactly who I was. She very  nonchalantly told me "oh yeah, Charlie hit her head and had a nose bleed during her intake because she couldn't be restrained"  this information should have been given to us the second it happened and NEVER should an animal or human be put under anesthesia after a head injury. Charlie is 10 months old and the fact that a doctor of animals does not know how to handle a scared puppy is unacceptable. These people tried to hide this from us and it is inexcusable. I took Charlie immediately to Dove Mountain vet and they confirmed she had a severe head injury. I could have lost my puppy because I wasn't notified of her injury and made aware to watch for signs after a head injury that can be even more dangerous or deadly. 

This place only cares about the money and not your pet and what they did to my dog has forever traumatized me. They are the worst of mankind and don't deserve to care for even a rock.
We loved the atmosphere here.  It is a quaint place in a beautiful area. We took our daughter who is 17 months and had a pizza.  The food was great. Make sure you allow time to walk around the area.

I am a huge Rockwell fan so when hubby saw they had an exhibit of his work here we went the very next day.  

The building is large, open and contempory.  A bit of a walk from the parking garage for those of us with issues walking or handicapped.  Also watched an elderly couple where the husband was in a wheelchair and they had to go quite a way to find wheelchair access from the building to the garage.  This has to be rectified (minus a star for this)

The fee was $15 each, not too bad.  On the first floor there is a small deli and a small gift shop. Outdoor seating seemed plentiful if you like Al Fresco dining.  The museum was on the second floor.  Listen, there could have been a closet with a few Rockwell lithographs in it and I would have been happy...but this exhibit covered 3 large rooms plus a couple halls.  I was in Rockwell heaven.  So happy to have gotten the chance to see this.  

There were 2 other rooms that had an ancient pottery exhibit that was pretty interesting. Didn't take very long to see it.

Guess we will have to keep an eye out for the next exhibit, this was fun!!

i just love a good burger!
its done right if its cooked to the perfect medium I ordered.  patty was thick and juicy. fat was dripping out.  thousand island sauce adds to the extra fattiness. bun was lightly toasted and oily.  everything was fatty!

tator tots was soft and crunchy and, again, greasy.

a little on the greasy side for me....but for others, thats what it is all about.
ive had burgers multiple times this week, and within the week, the village burger was the best of the ones i had

Best ramen in Tampa! Very affordable, great service, FAST service and wonderful environment. The garlic lover is my FAVORITE, and the gyozas are AMAZING! Would give 10 stars if I could, my new go to for ramen. Would highly recommend if you're in the Tampa Bay Area!

Since I bought my 2016 Honda civic Crest is way closer than Franklin, TN.
I now get my car serviced with them.

Every time I've been in this place I am greeted. Someone takes care of me and goes over my car. I do see the same guys which is nice. Seems like when you get to see the same people, makes it fun to see them again and catchup. They know what you need with your car.

They made a mistake where they over charged me by accident due to miss hearing what I needed. But checking out, it was corrected and no questions asked. They again took care of me.

One thing I will say that's cool is in the waiting room during lunch they have free hot dogs and all day a soda machine and coffee. Well stocked! Best tasting mix of sodas. I don't drink a lot of sodas anymore but this is one of the best tasting ones! Who knew? In a dealership?
They also have a popcorn machine. This is great while waiting. Not having your car or able to go anywhere and not want to spend on Uber, they had something to get you over hunger or thirst until your car is ready.

Compared to other facilities I've been to, this place seems little outdated in the waiting area. The desk and chairs, tables make me feel like I'm in school or a library. Not sure if its just the layout but the amount of time waiting for my car which every time has been over an hour I get restless? But again this is about service and taking care of my car.
If you need to work on laptop or want to charge your devices, they do provide this which is nice as well. There is a TV lounge area and bathrooms are right there and clean. 

Over all great service and experience.
Great vibe, great food, great service.  Everything we had was outstanding. Will definitely become repeat customers.

Our flight cancelled so we ended spending the night at one of the airport hotels.  Other than Wendy's this was our only option.  Chicken wings were great!  Burgers and Ribs were not the best we have had.  Over all 3 stars.

We were so excited to discover this hotel prior to our latest trip to Nashville. It's a brand new hotel and price and proximity in comparison to other stays in the area will keep us coming back. Modern decor, friendly staff. 

(Note: I had read reviews on another site that suggested street parking might be a problem and yet we always found a space and were able to avoid the high cost of valet.)

Highly recommend.

Major kudos to my husband for finding this place for us to try! 

Per the recommendations, I made a dinner reservation for 4 people at the time that would work best for us. When we arrived, I noticed our table right away and we were seated promptly. Our server was so kind and had some amazing recommendations. My husband and father in law got some fancy bourbon cocktail that they said was very good! I will get to try one of their fun cocktails once I'm no longer pregnant. 

Their food was also incredible. We started with their roasted Brussels and they were everything I had hoped they would be. All of the food that we ordered was very tasty. The chefs were incredibly kind as well to assist with a special request from my husband as well. 

At the end of it all, we were all very satisfied and looking forward to returning. We also tried their seasonal desserts they were offering and I'm still drooling over the lemon cake.

Best nail salon! The place is very homey and the girls there are really nice and they do the best designs...prices can't be beat. I go there about 3 or 4 times a months and I have never had a bad experience.

5-stars for delivering 2 beautiful arrangements with only 1 day notice, including a text with photos of the delivered items. Thank you! I will return to Alpha Floral because of their quick turnaround and quality product. However, 1 star reduction because I paid $30 for an upgrade on an Ikebana arrangement and don't see any difference when compared to the "standard" version. I can compare the photo of what was delivered ("deluxe") vs. what is the "standard" version as pictured on the website - no real difference. I feel like I wasted that $30. In the future I won't pay for any upgrades as there doesn't appear to be a discernible difference.
It took us about 45-50 minutes to be seated even though the wait was supposed to be only 20 minutes. The food was very good though.

There may be multiple options in the area for Thai food, but this place has my vote. From the overall ambiance to the food itself, it can't be beat. 

My recommendations? Appetizers- chicken satay or Thai dumplings. Curry, pad see ew, or pineapple fried rice (my favorite) are great options. Don't forget the mango sticky rice!
The food here is excellent and the service is phenomenal.  We made sure to visit during off hours as we heard it gets very busy and the seating is limited.  Will definitely be back.

in a world full corporate cookie cutter sameness, there are those who stand out. chances are, they have been around awhile and they might remind you of your smelly old eccentric uncle, not likely to change much and that's a good thing. every city has at least one. sparks has one too.

that is of course, the yellow submarine, the venerable sub shop in a slumming old strip mall on pyramid highway. i finally found the confluence of hunger, money and location and stopped in.

now if order and symmetry make you happy, this is not your place. for there is memorabilia to ponder and enjoy in every square inch of the place, running the gamut of 20th century pop culture. its a wonderful way to spend a few minutes waiting for your food. 

and the food? i had a tuna sub and it was quite good. the meatball sandwich being prepared looked amazing. the smells and smiles and friendly customer service all contributed to an overall festive vibe, which i suspect is part of yellow submarines charm and appeal.

my only complaint was the choice of bread used. franco, while local, is mass produced. i know this is sparks and not incline village, but for a 6$ 6" sub i would expect something a little more gourmet and substantial. i guess i could paraphrase and old saying and quote "i have incline village tastes on a sparks budget!".

but this is only a momentary nitpick. i love places like this and will always try to support them. you should too
Great local grocery store! They have just about all your basic things! Everything is lock and fresh! The deli is great! Also a great place to stop for lunch! The staff is always friendly and nice!

This restaurant was highly recommended by friends as well as numerous web sites so it was a must visit on our trip to Indy and it surely did NOT disappoint.

Starting off with the house bread...our basket had actually several different types of bread in it which was a refreshing change from most places which just have one standard bread.  The onion bread and lavosh in particular were nice starters for the palette.

For appetizers we tried the shrimp cocktail which was highly recommended.  Shrimp was awesome but be warned if you have low tolerance for spicy as the cocktail sauce was imbued with horseradish.

For my main entree I took on the 28oz porterhouse steak with mashed potatoes.  It was easily one of THE BEST steaks I've ever had in my life easily showing me why this place is a legend in steak houses.

I finished off my meal with the Sugar Cream Pie which is touted as the State Pie of Indiana.  It was absolutely delish.

Prices here are pricey (entrees run anywhere from $25 - $40) but it's worth it for the treat.  High quality food worthy of the price tag.

We were seated within 10 minutes of our reservation time.  Waitress was very good, attentive, but unobtrusive.  One complaint is please don't wait until we are ready to order to tell us the daily specials.  Tell us when you give us the menus.  Our cocktails were very strong.  I had to add ice and lime to my drink to water down the alcohol.  My Farm Chicken was very good.  I would come back.

We came here for brunch around noon this past Sunday. We attempted to get brunch across the street at kitchen coffee house but after sitting at the bar for 10 minutes and no one making eye contact or saying hello though they were right in front of us we decided to take our business elsewhere. We ordered chicken and waffles and the pork belly Benedict. The chicken and waffles were very good, crispy and good flavor. The pork belly Benedict had good flavor but the eggs were a little undercooked for me and the croissant doesn't stand up to being the bottom of a benedict very well. The restaurant was hopping but we were helped right away. I also enjoyed a bloody mary.

Spicy beef noodles were V delicious! As well as the Szechuan chicken! Owner came out to greet us and was super sweet! You won't find the mainstream stuff like sweet and sour chicken, general tsos chicken etc. She said the dishes she prepares are authentic recipes and along with handmade dumplings!

I met a girlfriend for lunch here a couple weeks ago, and I ADORED this little place....
You walk in- order at the counter- and then go find a seat- 
When we got there, luckily we didnt have to wait long- 
But by the time we left there was a long line- 
I didnt know how the ordering system work but luckily my gf had been there before. 
I ordered the farmers market salad- and i have to say this---
I LOVE the fact that they chop it up for you and mix all the ingredients together 
(think, Coldstone Creamery) 
It was delish indeed! 
I cant speak for the pizza, because neither one of us ordered one- 
and for an app she had ordered the hummus- which was indeed delish as well! The parking--- well.... there is none-- and we had to park down the road
and pay for a meter- which was a pain- we drove around for a bit looking for a spot- 
I cant wait to go back and try a pizza-- they looked really good-
and I'll definitely order a salad again---
Its not a good spot if youre in a hurry.

On vacation in Florida and  was bitten by sand fleas and having an allergic reaction.  Finally went in due to the itching.  I saw  Heather one of the nurse practitioner and she was the nicest healthcare professional in an urgent care setting I have ever met.   The nice lady at the front desk was also pleasant, helpful and efficient!  I walked in, filled out the paper work and was seen within 10 minutes.  If you are in need of an urgent care center I highly recommend this facility.

If you have not tried massage therapy I highly suggest trying out Body Mechanix. I went for the first time due to lower back pain. Have tried other options but may have found something that actually works. Saw Lydia and she was very personable and took the time to answer all of my questions. Can't wait for my next appointment.

My fiance' and I worked with Bibe Chin to purchase our first home (which ended up closing during quarantine!).  She was fantastic, honest, extremely personable, and proactive.  I highly recommend her as an agent, as she really helped walk us through this process and made things as easy as they can be.  During house walk throughs she didn't hold back her opinion of places just to get a sale.  Many times she pointed out small things about a house that we weren't thinking about that eventually make or break a home.  Even during quarantine when we were finalizing everything for closing and she couldn't be there in person, she made herself available at all hours to make sure we were able to finalize the deal.

I spent 4 nights here. The room was not special, new, or very clean, but fine. I elected green choice,  knowing that I will not require turn out service for such a short stay. 

Unfortunately, I can't give the staff too much praise. 

Timing out my vehicle out of valet is an art form alone here. My car was not ready at the promised time even once. The ticket shows 10-15 minutes advance, before desired departure time. I was in need of my vehicle on daily basis, and timeliness was essential to my appointments. 2 out of 4 times, the valet staff claimed that the dispatcher never called for my vehicle. At another time, a valet employee walked over with no sense of urgency, asking for a ticket number. When I politely informed her that I have been waiting for 40 minutes, she replied with: 'don't blame me, I just got here', and continued on her stroll, presumably retrieving the vehicle. Needless to say, 55 minutes into my call, the car showed up. Daily parking fee: $50 for this service. 

My coworker went to the front desk to inquire about a package he was expecting. After eying him up and down, the manager lady literally told him: 'you're not a guest here, are you?' He couldn't find words to respond, and she walked away. Someone  else retrieved the package. Both, my friend and the manager are African Americans, in case you are wondering how racist this encounter was. 

As far as amenities go, I have not used any, but not for a lack of trying. I needed to print 1 page from my email. I went to the concierge & bell desk. The person behind the desk acknowledged me briefly, but kept organizing some paperwork and didn't tend to me. I waited for a minute, then decided to ask at the front desk. Unfortunately, there were only 2 people working at the time (there are 5 stations), and there were around 5 parties in line waiting to be checked in. I ventured on my own, and found 5 large screen computers at the opposite side of the open lobby. I didn't end up printing anything, as there was a minimum usage charge, charge per minute, and charge per page printed, amounting to over $10 to print 1 page. 

My incidental charge hold on my credit card was $50 daily. 

I know that this may have been out of the hotel's hands, but needless to say, it didn't add a positive spin to my experience. The fire alarm went of one time for about an hour, just around midnight. I was not evacuated, but the alarm announcement kept going the entire time. 

I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, unless they like boring rooms with no personality, unhelpful staff, and inflated prices for amenities.  I was generous in rating, I'd give 1-1/2 stars, if I could. 1 star being strictly for existence.

I was so excited to go to this place because of all the yelp photos and reviews. Other Filipino friends and I were anticipating pork face hash, crispy pata, pig ears, etc. we got none of those. We went there for lunch and learned that we were strictly supposed to order only from the very limited variety lunch menu that didn't have any of the promising stuff we expected. The only Filipino thing we tasted were super small lumpia and halo halo. The karaage bowl was good although it wasn't my first choice, nor my second choice. My first choice was ramen and share crispy pata with friends. None of those were available. My second choice was pho but they only had two servings left and 3 of us wanted it. It turns out the pho was double the usual price and faaaar from authentic pho. I guess their defense would be that they're fusian. Still. If it's fusion or Vietnamese and Filipino favors I won't expect a sweet broth for pho. guess this restaurant was made for people who want to try Asian-inspired American food. They told us too that their chef is filipino so their menu is mainly Filipino. Nah! If you want Filipino food, open a can of Argentina corned beef and eat it with rice. That's more Filipino than this place. 

When asked why even in the non-lunch menu, the food they used to feature are not there, they said they change their menu every few weekso. The moral lesson: don't anticipate anything. 

I was going to give one star for this restaurant but the second star will be for the good halo2 and clean restaurant. In summary, I didn't feel anything filipino in this restaurant at all.

My fiance kept talking about this place for a few weeks, had no idea it existed. Decided to check it out and was pleasantly surprised. Parking is a little tight, although I believe there are some spots around the back. 

Walking in, I loved the energy and enthusiasm of the staff. One of the staffers was very engaging and made us feel welcome right off the bat. Everyone seemed really happy to be there...which makes me want to be there as well.

The ordering process was pretty cool a lot of menu items, which I am a fan of. I also like having the option of having my dish as a burrito, taco or 

I decided to go with a bowl, I believe it was the MC Yum Yum. I thought the bowl was pretty good. No major complaints, I probably would go with it again, although there are so many other good looking options on the menu. Overall I would recommend this spot...But I wouldn't say it rates #1 on my list of Taco/Bowl spots in the Tampa/St. Pete region.

This is a shout out to the customer service at this location. Like an idiot I ordered 6 tickets via the app on Sunday for Monday night's show (or so I thought). Upon realizing I had actually failed to change the date and I had indeed purchased 6 tickets to Sunday night's show (which had occurred 10 hours prior to my realization) I frantically called to see what I could do as it says many places online that no refunds are offered past show time. While getting ahold of someone at the theater was less than easy, once I did they were so gracious to help and upon arriving to the theater I was offered passes and it was like my mistake never happened at all! Thank you, AMC West Olive for allowing 6 tired Moms the night out we so desperately wanted and needed.

If I based my review only on my meal, I'd have to give it one star.  But everyone else in my party of 10 enjoyed their meal, and we had a great time.  I ordered the vegetarian meal, and it was the WORST veggie meal I've ever had :(  My meal came with soup and rice, just like everyone else, but when the others got their choice of meat I got a plateful of sliced red peppers.  That's all.  Sliced red peppers.  Uh,   how about some mushrooms or zuchini or squash or about a million other veggie options.  Fortunately, I'd had enough sake bombs not to get too upset about it!

I thought that this Sicilian Pasta Kitchen would be the same thing as the one downtown but I was wrong. 

This location seems like a lower class version of the one downtown (which I am a big fan of). The looks and overall mood/atmosphere are close to being the same but I would say this one is a bit more kid friendly. The menu doesn't have as much of a selection either. The food, especially the entrees, is not even close to the quality. 

Even though I wasn't overly impressed the pasta I ordered was really good. I can't remember what it was called but it was penne with grilled chicken, shrimp and a cayenne sauce. It was the one thing that saved this place. The service was good, quick and friendly as well.

I have to admit if I didn't go in expecting this restaurant to be the same as the one downtown it may have gotten a better review.
Mark and everyone else at LT automotive are great and a very reliable shop they keep my car running great throughout every season!!!

Forgot to do a review of this the other day, I like their food very much. We started off with chips and quas and guacamole, the guacamole was made fresh but unfortunately one of the avocados were over ripen and barely chopped up,  The queso was good and fresh, The tacos were good although me and my friend thought maybe the meat could be a little more chunky and not as ground up as it was but it was flavorful and the Spanish rice is flavorful also. My  frozen strawberry daiquiri was delicious.

I've had a hard time finding a place to have my hair cut.  The cuts are always fine but nothing I've ever loved.  I came here to see Melina because of a group on voucher I had and hoping for a different experience.  This was the first time I've ever professionally colored my hair and Melina did such a great job taking care of me!  She worked with ease and picked a great color for my highlights. She gave me a different cut than I've gotten in the past and showed me how to style my hair.  It was beach gorgeous!  I loved it and cannot say enough good things about Melina and this salon.  I'm definitely going to come back.  Thanks Melina!

The best Happy Hour on the patio! I love meeting friends there for drinks in the summer. Also, in their restaurant they have amazing dinners. I love their salmon and the sides that come with it. Highly recommended!

I hate to post this because I used to love this place. I am not sure if they changed chefs or what... but I went the other day and it was bland and disappointing. My shrimp pad thai had no flavor.  I was also super disappointed because I called in my order ahead of time because I was on lunch, and it wasn't nearly ready when I got there.. there were only two other people there so there should have been no delay. Very aggravating experience only to be disappointed by subpar food.

Now I have to find a new Thai spot. Meh.

Mitch's is near my home, and as a novice in this space, everyone is always helpful to everyone. Let's not dress it up to some sort of outfitters, but what you will get is expertise. From where the spots are to fish, to the actually bait you'll be using, information is something that is helpful to anyone just starting out. Mitch is wonderful and the animals and cannine greeters make you feel welcome the first second you walk in.
Best kept secret for dining in Goodlettsville. Good, fresh food and affordable. Service is timely and friendly.

Easily one of the best brunch spots in Indy. The restaurant and kitchen are entirely open concept with the interior being a retrofitted garage that opens up to the outside where there is additional seating. This makes it optimal for safe dining during the pandemic as the tables are farther apart and for the most part outdoors. 

My personal favorites are the Dutch baby pancake and the grilled cheese. Do yourself a favor and pay them a visit!

As a photographer whose job is to make sure you capture every important detail of the day, it's vital that the team you are working with is on the same page. Working with Jess was an ideal experience. She was always present when I needed her and is extremely organized and detail oriented. She's also ultra creative and a joy to be around. She has great suggestions and vocalizes them in a way that feels fun and collaborative. I hope to work with her again in the future and would highly recommend her services!

Tried this place with a guy from work while on a business trip in Philly. I love pizza, but I've decided I'm not really into the trendy/upscale pizza places like this. To be fair, when I found this place online I didn't know that it was this style of pizza place or else I would not have checked it out. We have places like this where I live in California and it's just not my thing. I will give it to them that their restaurant is a cool spot. I really liked the outdoor patio. It was also cool how one of the regulars that we were sitting next to gave us the clue to use a "code word" with the waiter and when I did I was told that they had 3 pies that were 1/2 price with mentioning that word. My friend and I both picked one of those pizzas. I ordered the broccoli pizza and didn't care for it at all because they broccoli had a strange chemical-like taste. Once I took the broccoli off, it was decent, but still not amazing. My friend ordered a different type, which I tried and I will say his was better, but still not my favorite. Overall, some people may be into this place, so still give it a shot.

Looking for the best Pizza around?. This is the Place. Serves burgers, & pasta too. Who need ketchup for asiago garlic fries, very yummy as it is. Italian soda topped with whip cream is worth trying new.

My wife and I are visiting Philadelphia this weekend and came here today. What a great place. It feels like you're in a friend's dining room. The owner is sweet and inviting. We ordered the Vegan Cheese steaks with mushrooma, Avocado rolls and cheesy Bread! Oh. My. Goodness! It was better that I had expected. I wish we were staying longer so we could go back.

Well, I'm reviewing the tour of the Ryman, not a concert in the Ryman, so if you want to keep reading, feel free...

I was in Nashville for the first time in April, and knew I had to visit The Grand Ole Opry, The Ryman, and The Bluebird Cafe (yep, I watch Nashville on tv!). After touring the Opry we next visited The Ryman and got the backstage tour. It was worth the extra money, but the tour wasn't as great as the Opry tour. Probably because the venue is just so much older smaller - I think if I had it do over again I'd do The Ryman first, then The Opry. 

At any rate, this is the home of Country music and the tour helps explain all of that. From the radio shows to the live concerts, The Ryman is the 'Mother Church' that gave so many young musicians a venue to share their music (Little Jimmy Dickens, Minnie Pearl, Johnny Cash, Elvis, etc.). It is pretty inspiring to stand on the stage they all performed on, to walk through the dressing rooms they used, to feel (just for a moment) what it must have felt like to be them.

I would definitely recommend this tour to any music fan - country or not. The history is far too rich to pass up, and it is right in the heart of downtown Nashville - just off Broadway.

I've loved Silver Peak for years but today I love them even more. They were really slammed and we kind of fell through the cracks service wise, but they remedied it as soon as we brought it to their attention. Sat us within 2 minutes and comped an appetizer and our drinks. I'm already a regular customer and I'll stay one!

Humble pie is a poor man's Scordatos, except for the same price. The place seems like it would fit in more downtown, it is very loud and they pack you in like sardines. The chairs are uncomfortable and it is way too dark. The chop salad is flavorless and the only difference I can tell between the salami and the lettuce is by the texture. Their pasta is not homemade and their sauces taste canned. We ordered two different pizzas and both were flimsy even though I specifically asked for extra crispy. Both pies came with very little toppings and were limp when you picked them up. Final complaint, the crust was loaded with cornmeal on the bottom and that was what I tasted most.

Amazing location, superb pool, good service, dated rooms

Just got back from a stay at Ventana Canyon Resort.  First up, the location built forward of a canyon area is superb.  The views, the golf course, the ponds, and the pool really set this property up to be memorable.  The staff and eating options are great, as well.  Definitely worth the trip.

The criticisms I have focus on dated rooms-- very 1990/2000s in style, we had some musty smell from our AC, and the front door did not keep out the sound of the occasional group of teenagers hollering.  

Heads-Ups: There is an astronomer who comes by and gives kids a look at the stars Fridays and Saturdays at 9 PM.  There is fish food in a treasure chest in the back right of the lobby to feed the carp.  If you walk the path to the pool at night, be careful of rattlesnakes. (Hotel is built against a natural area, so makes sense they are around.)  They charge $9 a night for parking and I think $10 for WiFi.  And bring charging cables for your electronics.  The reception is so weak that or phone batteries were barely lasting 16 hours.  On the plus side, I guess that latter item would be a good excuse for ignoring calls and relaxing.

The chicken was perfectly crunchy, juicy and full of flavor with a touch of spice. Paired well with the mac and cheese, corn muffins and sweet tea. 
Definitely worth the 30 minute wait and $10 cab ride.

If I could give this place a -100 stars I would. They broke a part on my truck and then flat out lied to me multiple times and then lied to my dad. It took an act of God to get them to issue a refund. I'm also sure they didn't order the part like they said they would. At this point, as soon as the part comes in,if they did order it, I'm having my personal mechanic take care of it.  I'm not letting these guys touch another vehicle ever again!!!!

- The charcuterie plate was fantastic.  I particularly liked the country terrine and the hogshead cheese.  The country terrine was incredibly savoury.

- The cracklins were perfect.  Lots of crackle and just a little bit of chew to go along with their excellent salty flavor.

- The brussels sprouts had a perfect texture and a lot of zest.

- It took me a couple of spoonfuls, but the pork neck soup was rich and hearty, with just a hint of spice.

I do wish I could order the jambalaya stuffed chicken to eat in, but that is my only wish that did not come true.  Delicious, friendly, and quick.
Great ramen, the staff is very attentive. Also the surf and turf sushi roll is great! They recently opened and I have already been here a few times, hasn't disappointed.

The food is far better than I anticipated! 

It gets quite crowded, but everyone I've chatted with seemed like decent folks.  I'd recommend getting a drink and shrimp & grits app on the sidewalk patio.

My fiancé and I eat here all the time, such good food! We normally go for breakfast, but their burgers are also incredible. Definitely the place to go!
Stopped for breakfast before our flight and was pleasantly surprised at how good the food was. The breakfast burrito was so good and enough for 2 people. The Smoky Bloody Mary is worth the price too!

Great authentic  fresh Mexican food. The look of the place still needs some work but don't let that fool you. They use fresh ingredients.  It's delicious authentic mexican. Your in for a treat! They also do catering for big parties.

OMG, What a gem this place is! I recently traveled to New Orleans for a week vacay and this fried chicken restaurant was one on my list of eateries to try during my stay.
