When in Louisiana, fried chicken is a must on my bucket-list that's for sure! My oh my, I am still so shook about how amazing the food at this restaurant is! My boyfriend and I visited on a Wednesday afternoon, around 2pm, which was one hr before closing. We took a Lyft to the restaurant since we were staying at a hotel closer to the french quarter. The restaurant is well blended into a neighborhood, so it gives that homey feel once you see the homes surrounding the restaurant and dine inside. Upon arrival, we barely waited 5 minutes outside the door and were greeted to come inside immediately. The ambiance is so cozy and I really liked how there was a cat named 'chicken' just casually stationed outside when we walked through the door. I have to say, I was so so excited because friend chicken has been one of my favorites. 
My boyfriend and I ordered a ton of items to try since were too eager to miss out on anything from the menu..  (fried okra, red beans and rice, corn bread, green beans, and one 3 pc dark meat -fried chicken entree with a side of mac n cheese, plus their classic Willie Mae's lemonade.. oh yeah.  Honestly, I can't get enough of that crispy chicken skin because the batter they use at Willie Mae's stands out from your usual fried chicken places; not to mention, their dark meat thigh and wing is just so darn juicy! Can't stress enough that our late lunch was just absolutely delicious! My boyfriend and I couldn't stop thinking about that meal that we actually came back to eat Willie Mae's before flying back home to California. 

Our server that afternoon was Nathaniel, he was just exceptional! Not only did he make sure we enjoyed our first time in New Orleans, but his energy, customer service, friendly attitude, and genuine smile made him such an excellent server. Nathaniel too the time to make sure we had a good experience and also gave us some recommendations on what to do in New Orleans since it was our first time here; we greatly appreciate him and he deserves so much recognition for his hard work.

Can't complain too much about Sidney's. Pretty wide selection of beer by the bottle, a few inexpensive wines, and of course liquor. 
Insider tip: go for the $6.99 spanish red (cheaper than yellowtail, way better), or the $5.99 walnut creek white. Both are great value. Oh, and did someone say $10 for a liter of Evan?? Yes, I did.  
P.S. Go for the Kubler Absinthe for when you're feeling green. :)

Brian was extremely helpful when I came in to open my account, he was super knowledgeable, extremely professional, patient, and understanding when it came to working around my rambunctious toddler while trying to get everything set up. I was beyond appreciative and grateful for the customer service I received yesterday and I'm happy to be part of the MACU family!

A tip of the cap to Yelp for the option to call/text ahead for seating, without it; could've been a long day.

My previous experiences with First Watch were long waits and slow service, especially on Saturdays and Sundays for the brunch crowd. Not totally their fault though as brunch locales are very fleeting in Saint Louis County. 

Today we were in a time crunch and with the text feature where you could enter your name on the virtual waiting, it assuaged our time concerns. Seated almost immediately, the service was prompt, fast, and so was the delivery of our food. No loss in quality either, the "Bacado" omelette with a small spring mix salad and bread was delicious. It was so good I even ate the bread which is a rarity for me, coupled with the strawberry jam; it was a must have. 

Next time with a little more time we'll peruse the menu for the other options in the expansive list which features healthier alternatives as well.

We'll be back and so will everyone it seems, the place was and is always; packed.
Suicide wings that are actually HOT! Good BBQ all around. Friendly staff and Phil will even come out to chat sometimes.

You have to love the Ritz theaters. Great movies AND they let you bring your own snacks. The people that work their are pretty friendly and the other patrons are always respectful and friendly. By far my favorite movie theater of all time.

Lovely place. The waiter was so nice, he even offered to make me homemade ginger ale! Shrimp cocktail. Yummy! Petit filet mignonette perfect. Very nice experience with my hubby. His oysters on the half shell ans flat iron steak was tender and juicy. Loved it!

The lady with the orange tie- dye and ginger hair color was rude I asked her for help 3 times and she ingnore me. How are you working the register with a bad attitude I do love the whoppie pies here but that nasty dismissive attitude makes it not worth spending my money here.  This company should get their shit together. Because I never experienced that when I was their in the past. This happened today 6/12/2019

Few years ago, I stopped in.  Place was so filthy I left.

Being suspicious I looked it up on the Pima County Health Department web site. They had the address as 2400 North Pantano, last inspected in 2013!

So I guess they had not been inspecting Kenny Ds at all, since they have the address wrong.  

I called the Health Department and " someone will get back to me".  Of course they didn't.

Just checked Health Department again. Still at 2400 N. Pantano. Who knows when they were inspected..

While this Popeyes (the employees) is consistently hood and seems to careless about customer service (watching employee right now on her phone while a customer is waiting) my butterfly shrimp are made at the time of order are consistently the Good! So I'm slightly ashamed that I will probably return for those shrimp:/

Just got back from our honeymoon in Hawaii, which Jennifer M. helped plan for us. Her suggestions for everything worked out great and extremely happy we went with her suggestion of the Andaz in Maui over the Grand Wailea hotel. We would recommend her to anyone!

Had an absolutely fantastic experience here the other night. I say experience because literally every aspect of the meal, service and ambiance was on point! Gabrielle was our server and she was phenomenal - so friendly, attentive and was so enthusiastic about the food which got us excited about it too! Had the two fire-grilled appetizers of the day - Asparagus with heirloom tomatoes, goat cheese and balsamic (delicious and light) and grilled Caesar salad with Shrimp (amazing). Followed those up with gnocchi misto's (the gnocchi flight basically) - Gorgonzola, Baked, Stefano and Short Rib - each one better than the last. Finished the meal off with a pistachio cheesecake (totally grows on you) and then we were garnered with the highlight of the night - white chocolate cello with a raspberry rim. Excuse me while I regroup. Holy heck that might have been the best thing I have ever had. Bonus points for the chef coming around asking if we wanted a second round. I already have my next reservation booked for this week. Top notch.

Good food but we waited 2 hours to be squished in a tiny table in the middle of everyone.  We'd have to get up and stalk our server once for a refill since she dissappeared quite often.  Food was good but tiny portions especially for the appetizers.  Really cool decor and convenient location.  I'd go back again maybe when it isn't peak time...

We stayed in Clearwater for a softball tournament this past weekend. Arriving late Friday night we ordered pizza, wings and garlic knots to our hotel room. Everything was hot, fresh and tasted delicious. The next night (after 9 hours on the softball field) we decided to order pizza for the team. I decided to give the restaurant a heads up and called at 3:30 for a 6PM delivery time. The lady who answered the phone was super helpful in deciding how much pizza we needed and even suggested the buy 1 get 1 50% off deal. The pizza was delivered to the hotel hot and on time. They even included paper plates. I could not have fed 45 people for $150 any where else.

We ordered pepperoni and cheese pizzas as well as a supreme, all meats, and veggie pizza. The specialty pizzas were divine. If we are in the area again and want pizza, I would definitely call Westshore Pizza first.

Really gorgeous decor and great lively music. Good selection on food. The service was really bad. Guy was on his phone the whole time and told us to ask for help when we needed us instead of checking on us. Lackluster flavor but the food was fresh. The waiter ended up eating lunch with a customer during his shift. Definitely better places to get Mediterranean food.

Despite the big hype from my friend about the place, I just found the product average.  I got the vanilla mango Ice Custard, which is basically just a big ice slurpee with the vanilla custard in it.  You have to eat both parts together to get a taste of something good, otherwise the individual parts are just very average.

Lunch here is mediocre. I got the basil fried rice with shrimp. It had only 4 pieces. The flavor was mediocre as well. Wife got red curry dish. The sauce was thin and watery. Felt more of Chinese guys trying to do Thai.

So I don't usually rank restaurants especially local ones and never give low reviews.  I have eaten here in the past and would have given Fork 5 stars then.  My daughter had a birthday and wanted to go to some place special.  I booked a reservation online and let them know it was her birthday and asked if they could do something special.  The hostess wished her a happy birthday when we got there (which was great) but then the experience went down hill.  My husband and daughter both ordered the Urban burger and I had the Idaho Philly.  We ordered the asparagus fries and Parmesan fries for an appetizer.  The asparagus fries were great, but the Parmesan fries we got as the appetizer and with the burgers were over cooked.  My husband asked for bacon on the burger and they forgot to add it. The tomatoes that came with the burgers had a hard center and were terrible, my husband was shocked the kitchen would consider putting them on the plate. My Idaho Philly was just okay.  I was so disappointed as we loved this restaurants food previously.  There was no additional "birthday wishes" and the waitress was inattentive.  My daughter wanted to order the doughnut holes as her birthday dessert, we ended up ordering them to go and waited an additional 10 minutes for them to be done.  When we got home to eat them, and sing happy birthday, the center was raw but over cooked on the outside.  What should have been a special dinner ($100 bill) was a big disappointment.  I even feel like we have to "make up" a ruined birthday dinner :(

3 stars because the food was mediocre average. The staff did a nice job and I would give them an A-Ok for service. 

My haddock was so so. The french fries were not crispy. Salad was delicious. Did not have the bread. The dessert was decent. The person I was with had a filet which she said was delicious. The sweet potato was very good. Her bloody mary was way too spicy. They do not offer a regular mixer, just the spicy one. 

It took me 2.5 years to try this place due to their hours. I most likely will not return 1. because of their hours and 2. because the food was nothing special. 

I get frustrated when we pay so much money for items and they are just 'ok.' If I wanted just ok I would have eaten at home. :(

10/10 must-go café in Doylestown!
We visited some friends here and were recommended to go here. They raved about this place, especially their avocado toast. I thought, what can be so special about avocado toast?! Ummmmm they were right! Hands down the best avocado toast I have ever had (and I've had a lot)! Everything we had was fresh, scrumptious and fairly priced. We already cannot wait to return!

The best part about this place was how makes you appreciate the food you're used to having.  It wasn't terrible.  But it wasn't worth the price of admission.  Service was okay.  I'm surprised that this has such a high rating.

Now for the triad...
Decent food?
Eh.
Good price?
No.
Return visit?
Hell No.

I was out of town and the house sitter lost the key. I was beside myself with worry because my cat needed to be fed special food and would starve to death  ! Carl came to  my rescue and met my friend at my house. I appreciate the fact that Carl was very professional and went to check IDs and verified that everything was legitimate . He came within the hour and worked quickly to resolve the problem. Carl saved my cat and my sanity. This guy is my hero and will definitely only use his service from now on.

I came here for a custom tan for New Years Eve. I never had a spray tan done in person before, so I was a little nervous coming in. However, Jessica put me at ease immediately. She was welcoming and was very thorough with how the process would go. The custom tan was quick and easy, and there were results immediately. The price was $41 and you can add a tip, as well. I can't wait to have a nice glow for New Years Eve!

The service was fine and the food was tasty but I thought the ambiance was a bit lacking. The menu reminded me a bit of Taco Bell.... A few key ingredients shuffled around to make a variety of different options. We ordered the cold appetizer platter. It was so small that people at our table thought it was something that was compliments of the chef. This was a fine place but will not be a go to staple for me.

This place is the real deal. Great prices, great flavor. Every time I feel hungry I know we need to come here. Location is not fancy, so keep in mind that you are coming for the food. Their soup pork dumplings are amazing! Their scallion pancakes are a bit greasy. 

I don't recommend to visit this Dim Sum place on weekends unless you want to spend some time waiting in line.

Good food, great drinks. Fish and chips, sandwiches, even the curry is alright... But I really come back for the drinks. Along with all the craft beers etc..They have Moscow Mules, and my favorite---- Pimm's cup. It's a great, refreshing, not too sweet English drink. It typically comes with a cucumber, but I have gotten it with an orange.. Either way delicious!

Great spot had a couple slices of pie. Traditional had a nice snap to it. Sauce was good nice flavor cheese was a little heavy but good. 
The other slice I has was a grandma nice snap. Little to much sauce and a little to greasy but over good flavor

8 out of 10 for me. Thanks guys.

Love this place! Great atmosphere with a cool patio outside. This place kinda has a dive ambiance but I love that vibe. 

I got the five finger basket with a beer and struggled to finish. The basket comes with a healthy helping of fries that are darn tasty. The chicken was greeeaat. I got a plethora of sauces. It was my first time here so I got three different sauces. They let you mix and match you fingers anyway you want for no additional charge which is nice when you're wanting to try a lot of sauces. My favorite sauce was honeybee. It is a thiner sauce, which I love, that is darn tasty. A balance of sweetness that isn't overwhelming.

In summary this spot has a cool vibe, good beer, and great fingers with delectable, finger licking sauces.

I hate seeing a one star rating for this place. Hey buddy, people that shop at Jos A Banks don't need somebody to hold their f'in hand, thats one of the main benefits of shopping here....nobody hounding you! Sheez, go to Dillard's you mook.

Different fits, clothes for men and soyboys alike. Great selection, all current styles designed for the local market, and if you need a dress shirt, tie, a suit or a tux then this is your place. Off the rack suits in a slim, traditional, or tailored cut... tailored used to be called athletic cut but I guess the SJWs took care of that one, tailored is more inclusive I suppose. LOL

They have regular sales here on a frequent basis, right now they're having a clearance sale combined with a bogo on suits and that is what I call a bargoon. You want style, come here. You want a babysitter and ill-fitting suits, go to a department store.

I love love love Vera!!!!! I highly recommend her for color and balayage. She does an amazing job and takes her time. You can definitely tell she loves what she does and she doesn't try to push any products on you or anything.

Everything is good but loud when it's crowded and a little slow. Hate they don't give military discount all the time. Our military didn't fight for them at certain hours and days why should their discount be limited.

I was visiting NOLA for the first time and had an airbnb on St.Roch so I went to the market multiple times during my stay. I got the Louisiana crab cakes my first day and they were absolutely spectacular, I couldn't stop thinking about them and had to get them again before I left. Honest to god one of the best plates of food I've had in my life I was blown away. I never had to wait more than 10 minutes and the food came out hot and delicious. Friendly staff and a very cool environment. If you're in New Orleans I heavily recommend the crab cakes from Elysian you will not be disappointed.

I've been to this location and the one in DC. Very consistent. 

I've gotten the taste of maine and the lobster roll. The taste of mine has quarter shrimp, crab, and lobster. Out of the three I highly recommend the lobster. The shrimp and crab were average. It comes on a toasted buttery roll and a decent amount of lobster. I'm not saying you're going to get completely full but it is good enough for a meal and the price. Lobster roll is $17 for a combo, chips and a drink. I think the taste of maine is $20 something. 

When I come here I just get the lobster roll and it fulfills my lobster craving. Juicy and buttery!!! If you are craving a lobster roll, this is the place. It's a fast take out spot so don't expect it to be a full service place. It's right in center city near the liberty place mall.

Yay! Hamburger Mary's has a location in Brandon. This review is more for entertainment and ambiance vs food. Let's face it-- you're coming here for the overall experience and entertainment. That said, food is fine and burgers are solid.

Great food and atmosphere. 

They have a brewery on site which makes decent beer. 

I have had several tasty dishes there, so go hungry. 

They have some decent cocktails too!

Just move in 6 months ago and We hate it! Apartment was not done being fixed when we moved in, they said they would fix it and they never did. Heater and ac have been broken for over a week! I have called management and maintenance and have not had this issue fixed! Hoping to get out of lease so i can get the hell out of here!

Always great food! My favorite is the chicken shawarma, but you seriously can't go wrong with anything on the menu. The pizza is amazing! Delivery takes about an hour, but the food is always hot when it arrives.

I ordered wings and fries. Omg ! My email said my food would be delivered at 6:05pm. I did not receive my food until 6:32pm. Before I opened my food I knew it was cold. Fries are disgusting cold. Very disappointing.

Do not stay here!  Horrible doesn't begin to describe our experience.  We usually book at the Comfort Inn and Suites Airport on Plumb, but they were full.  Thinking we'd have a similar good experience, we booked 3 nights.  Walking to the room, we noticed the wear in the carpet and a bad smell in the hallway.  In our room, the disinfectant used was more akin to an industrial poison, causing eye and throat irritation, but thankfully dissipated after a few hours.  The second night, we were awakened at 1:45am to the loud banging noise of someone outside our window - sounded like they were trying to break into the window or trying to rip off the A/C unit!  We tried to call the front desk and the phone was dead!  Hubby looked and saw a man at the window, then quickly put on his pants and went to the lobby.  They told him "Oh yeah, it's a guest outside your window trying to put the screen back on.  He thought it was his room."  ARE YOU F-ING KIDDING ME????  At daylight, we packed up and checked out early.  Never before had such a horrible, frightening experience.  This place is not even worth one star.

Ive heard many things about the staff of this establishment being unprofessional. Today this was not the case. The lady I had the pleasure of meeting was very nice and efficient ALL BY HERSELF while the phone constantly rang and multiple people waited to be served. 

The problem that I had encountered during this visit is the little friends I purchased along with my cake.....ANTS!!!!! During my ride home I noticed an ant on the box and I began to panic. Upon my arrival to the house I opened the box to find a couple ANTS. I promptly drove the cake and critters back to the bakery. My refund was a easy process. While waiting for my refund I Notice more ants on multiple cakes in the bakery. One word ewwwwwwww!
How did I not know about this sooner?  Great location for downtown fun and the food is oh course amazing.

Beware- place was super hard to find!

I saw Aaron who seemed like a pretty chill guy. I feel confident that he knew his stuff but I was VERY unhappy with the color my hair turned out. I wanted a red, a deeper red, that wouldn't be so brassy after my first time in the sun. Basically if I walked down the street now 10 out of 10 people would say my hair is black. It's so dark! With the light just right you can see a ever so slight tint of what I guess is red??? But looks more like purple. I felt disappointed but he didn't inquire as to my opinion. I like a hairdresser that wants me to be 100% satisfied. 

I also like to be kept informed of every step of the process. Aaron is very quite, and not inclined to discuss what he is doing, the color, what he will do next. When he does the answers are very brief. I get nervous because I have long hair and it's quite important to me. I don't think that Aaron knows what its like to give up all control and power to a new person who is doing your hair. 

I went back in several days later for a color correction. Again, I told him I was aiming for a "deep red." I think that Aaron is a great hair cutter but is terrible at coloring. I don't think he really understands what I was describing even though I felt like I put it very clearly and multiple times that I wanted my hair color to be red. A dark, deep RED.

If you request deep blue hair I imagine your hair would be black with a slight blue tint.

If you request deep green, same thing. Black with a green tint.

I seriously and beside myself that a person trained in hair color does not realize that the COLOR needs to be the shade you request. There are different shades of red within the scope of red. But the bottom line is, you still walk out with red hair!!

I wanted a confidence boost but I got just the opposite. What's worse is, even though Aaron was polite, albiet hesitant, while doing the color "correction" I still don't think he cared at all. It's like adding insult to injury. I'll never see him again!

I am going to post a photo of my hair and you tell me what color you think it is.

Have eaten here multiple times now. Their sushi is very good  and very fresh -- not QUITE as good as Masamoto in Chadds Ford, but delicious nonetheless. The teriyaki dishes we've had are great, and the atmosphere is very cool. I've had the spicy chicken stir fry off their autumn seasonal menu a couple of times and, while it doesn't melt my face off as they promised me it would :(, it's very very good. 

Highly recommended if you're in the Wilmington/Chadds Ford/Glen Mills area and looking for sushi and a drink (While Masamato has better sushi, they're BYOB, so if you want to have a drink with your meal and not BYO then Le Shio wins every time).

My only complaint is their sake menu is a bit sparse. Better than some other places but considering they TRY, it seems if they tried just a tad harder it would be a great list.

We will continue to go back until they give us a reason not to!

Very Disappointed.  My husband was admitted for a bowel obstruction and if I hadn't "supervised" his care, I don't know what would have happened!  You must have an advocate with you in this place or mistakes will be made.  Some of the nurses are wonderful, others are terrible.  It's a crap shoot.  Next time I will go elsewhere.

This place is busy right now since it has recently opened!  But it's right next to IKEA and the perfect stop for lunch or dinner right after shopping.    I've been to the Portillo's in Chicago numerous times and have always enjoyed the food, this location was no different.  It's a little heavy on the price to feed a larger family because I couldn't locate any type of children's menu so if you have small mouths to feed you'll have to order for them off of the regular menu.  

I wish that you could refill your own drinks, instead you have to ask them for refills in the pick-up food area which is pretty busy and surrounded by people waiting for their food.  They forgot the cheese for our cheese fries but it was easy to go back to the pick-up area and ask for these.  I do appreciate that they have a condiment area where you can get unlimited ketchup (must have for the kids).

The Street Sausage is my favorite, I highly recommend this.  It's a filling entree item and I think a better deal than the Chili Cheese dogs (which were slightly disappointing).  The fries here are my favorite - crinkle and perfect.  Add the cheese and they are even better.  And the chocolate cake shakes, you just have to try to know what I mean!

Ok first of all i did not know what to expect at all this was my families first time to the east coast and we were hoping we will enjoy our stay.  
When you first take the exit to the hotel you're not to sure what to expect because this hotel is in the middle of downtown/financial district.  The outside is very clean...clean concrete very quiet and it doesn't look like a hotel at all.  When you walk in small front desk area and the 3 elevators are right there. 
The front desk staff were very nice to us and (2 males/1 female) and liked to chat with my family.  However there was 1 that wasn't really friendly at all and not very helpful either.  She had a miserable look to her everyday we saw her.
The rooms were very clean and the kitchen is a plus!  Although 1 day when we left and returned back to our room we found that our room was not serviced at all.  I think the maid forgot to check back since our DD sign was on the door when they were next door but removed before we left.
We all enjoyed the breakfast in the lobby.  I thought it was descent.  When eating breakfast thats when you'll see the most people other than time the place seems deserted.
I don't think they had a swimming pool.  All in all this was a nice to place to stay and you will never know it was there.  We did find out that each of the front desk staff share multiple rolls to keep cost down and the employees are getting burnt out.  Great experience for 4 nights.  
I remembered a few names that chatted and we got to know.
 Dwayne-bartender front desk
Tyrell?- front desk
Ashley- front desk
There was also an older lady in the breakfast room that we met and we were looking forward to seeing her on our last day but she took the day off.

Wow. This space has certainly come a long way since it was Happy's and I really have to commend the owners on the change. It honestly looks nothing like it used to and there's even a fancy upstairs area now!

David and I were here for his cousin's birthday celebration and we were seated upstairs. We didn't have a full dinner, but we did have some really good fries and we had a few cocktails. First, since it's a wine bar, I started with a really good malbec that was reasonably priced. I like that they give you the option of a half pour or whole pour, I guess in case you want to just do some tastings. Even though they mainly specialize in wine, they do have a full bar and a pretty decent beer selection. I had the Holy Roller IPA which was a fairly priced $7, especially considering the atmosphere of the place. 

We hung out at a while and they didn't rush us at all as we basically just sipped drinks and enjoyed conversation. Every now and then I did feel that they forgot about us (I ordered coffee that never came), but all in all it was a good experience and it good place to start your evening.
Really enjoy the pleasant atmosphere. The nail team is very kind and happy. My toes and dip nails always look great. I always love bringing people with me here.

If you need a reconstruction on a radiated breast stay away from this dr. He can do some things, but a breast reconstruction specialist he is not. He put me through many failed surgeries, while at USC University hospital-who fired him. I finally had to find someone capable and experienced at this surgery.

I see he has a lot of good reviews on Yelp but most of them are for minor fixes or hands which I think he specializes in. But he is definitely not a Breast reconstructionist for radiated breasts.

After all the failed surgeries, he blamed them on me, saying my skin did not heal right.

If you need a diep flap surgery on a radiated breast DO YOUR HOMEWORK . There are not many good surgeons competent with this difficult operation.

I see Schooler has responded to me and another patient's diep flap surgical disaster that he was responsible for.  He will not take responsibility for his failures.

As USC is a teaching hospital, he allowed his little trainees to work on me with him on all  of my failed reconstructions.  During one particular surgery, they yanked out a piece off flesh off of my upper rib cage, leaving a permanent indentation. Either Dr, Schooler did that, or he allowed one of his trainees to do it.  In any case- shame on him for allowing it to happen. 

 
Fortunately, I found competent Diep flap specialist surgeons in Thousand oaks. I was not going to let Schooler touch me on a Diep flap after butchering me in my tran flap surgeries, using up all my available back skin and causing me so many hospitalized infections.

 It is a grueling operation as one of the other reviewers stated. I was under for 14 hours. However, after the skin transplant, they put my breast on a monitor to make sure it was getting blood through the skin so the transplant would survive! What a novel idea! How come Dr, Schooler never did that for any of my trans flap failures that died , went necrotic and ended up infected.

For example, after one tran flap surgery, the drain slipped out at the end of the week. I called Dr, Schooler and told him I was developing a huge hump on my back of fluid that could not drain due to the plastic drain falling out. He blamed the drains they had used at Huntington Hospital! Can you believe it??  Then, he would not see me until he had  "clinic" on Monday. By then my hump of fluid in my back was so large and painful I could cry and did. When I saw him, He manually expressed all the fluid with his hands!!! SO PAINFUL! The he replaced the same drain tube. By then I was running a fever and had to go admit myself into University Hospital for infection again!

The icing on the cake was when the new doctors did the Diep flap, they found that Dr, Schooler had not completely closed up the area in my back where the tran flap was and had left a huge gap  that was also accumulating  fluid.  So, another fixit job had to be done under the knife to correct the incompetence of Dr, Schooler.

Dr. Schooler, should be ashamed of himself for all the pain and misery and almost death he caused me. Especially when I was in University hospital for 9 days before Thanksgiving in 2011 trying to stave off a staph infection. And all this after suffering a double mastectomy, heavy chemo and radiation earlier that year.

If I had the $$ to sue , believe me, I would have taken him all the way.

If he doesn't want to take responsibility, then why doesn't he blame his residents that he let cut on me? Or did he pull that chunk of chest/rib flesh out of me on his own???

Maybe he is doing better now because he has taken some plastic surgery training classes and improved his skills, but he sure fxxxxd me up as his lab rat!! 

But no matter what, I wouldn't trust Schooler with anything beyond hand surgery (which he did a lot of at County General in LA on gang shooting victims) or routine procedures such as boob jobs. And I do not think he could do 100 diep flap surgeries in the time stated in his rebuttal. Each diep flap-given a radiated breast which is very difficult to deal with- takes about 14 hours. That would mean that he was doing about 2 per week- 28 hours worth of diep flaps. What about all the other surgeries? He used to brag to me about how many surgeries he did in a day- like 5-10. Do you want a dr. operating on you who is doing so many surgeries a day? Not me, he is too exhausted. He told me that he got paid at University Hospital based on how many surgeries he did. So there it is. (I even had to have 2 mastectomy surgeries-each on 2 breasts- because he could not get the expanders in right).

Dr. Schooler  misrepresented himself to me from the day I met him.  I was in a weakened condition, didn't know what to do. The best thing I ever did was quit him and find competent surgeons. Now I have nice breasts back-nipples and all!

PS I have all the surgical reports for everything this Dr, ever did to me. All my statements are true and correct. I would swear under oath to that fact.

This is my first time here and it's just fantastic! There is outdoor seating on this beautiful sunny day. I tried the sausage and the burnt ends. OMG Yall I ain't never tried burnt ends until today and I LOVE it! My friend and I also split some mac n cheese and mashed potatoes and Texas toast. Just so good. So fast too. It's exactly the type of place we were looking to eat at today. YUM!

Food was served fast and hot.  Everything tasted exactly how I pictured it would.  I ordered the spanakopita and gyro plate, which came with the standard pile of lettuce, dipping cream and lamb.  The olives and feta cheese were a nice touch.  Spices in the salad dressing were tasty and the feta made it especially good.  The lamb was typical but not as hot as the peta bread but still delicious all the same.  I will definitely eat here again as it was quite and you get nice silverware as well as lemons for your water. The little touches made a huge impact.  Worth the money and the place is classy compared to other fast food restaurants.

This is my go-to TJ location because it's right around the corner from where I live.  I love Trader Joe's...like I don't know if the word love can encompass how much I like this place.  I just can't seem to like this location though.  It's small, cramped, and the parking lot is a complete nightmare.  Good luck turning left on to Campbell from the parking lot.

I am really disappointed with my experience here tonight. My girlfriend and I were looking for a place to get milkshakes so we went to Sonic. We were sitting there for 45 minutes after ordering to receive 2 medium milkshakes and an order of onion rings. Then, a young woman in no uniform at all came to tell us that they're out of onion rings. We then waited for an order of chili cheese fries while still waiting for the 2 milkshakes. This took another 10 minutes. FINALLY upon receiving our drinks, they got the milkshakes wrong, didn't give us any napkins or utensils I'm mad.
I've made this place my treat of the week. Clean restaurant, consistently made food, and friendly staff. Northside gem

This place seemed promising upon arriving in the parking lot as they not so subtly park their smoker out front. We came a bit after the peak lunch time so sadly they were out of the brisket. Between the three of us, my aunt, uncle and I opted to share an order of pulled pork and a full rack of baby back ribs, a couple sides of potato salad, cole slaw and fries and a fountain drink. We spent around $40 for the meal. Overall the flavors were not bad. The ribs were off the bone but also on the dry side. I wasn't crazy about the sauces offered and really only liked the sweet bbq sauce. Pulled pork was much better than ribs in my opinion. I felt like the portions could've been more for the $. Overall for it being connected to the mall I guess it's better than most offerings but I don't think I'd go out of my way to eat here.
Delightful! Great service, great food. They even brought out blankets for our boys because they were cold sitting outside. Really enjoyable experience.

Family owned. Excellent Chinese food. Everyone there is always so nice and greets us like we're family. I especially recommend the roasted pork dishes. Char Su Ding (I think I'm spelling it right) is especially tasty.
COVID UPDATE (8/1/20): open for carryout and delivery only - no dining room service yet. When we went inside to pick up our order, every staff member I saw was wearing a mask and following safe practices

Came in and the sales rep. Mark was mad annoying!!!! Came in to spend with a no limit budget and couldn't take my time to look at the rings that I wanted without Mark coming every 1 min and asking me to narrow down the 6 rings that I had on the ring board to my top 3! I am the customer who is going purchase....if I had 20 rings on the ring board he should let
 "ME" decide and narrow down my selection because I want to be comfortable in what I purchase! It became so annoying and I felt he was trying to act like "Mr. Know-it-all" and trying to tell me what I should do because maybe he thought I was much younger than I looked, so I had to just leave. I'm going to go purchase my ring somewhere else; where I know that I will be respected and can feel comfortable purchasing a ring whether I spend 5k or 50k!!!

I have taken the tour of this building 5 times. And each time I have found something in a room that I haven't seen before. 

The staff was very polite and knowledgeable. Although some things he couldn't talk about, for the most part he answered most of everyone's questions. 

Seeing George Washington's Apron was quite a site. And to see the photos showing it being built in stages and how city hall was yet to be built was great. 

If you are looking to see a piece of American history and a rather beautiful building I suggest taking this tour.

I have been going to Ellen for cut and color for about three years now. I just love her. She knows how I like my hair cut. One time she didn't use the razor (we were talking and I didn't pay attention) and my hair wouldn't go right.  I called to let her know something wasn't right and she fit me in for a re - cut and styled me for free. We experimented with some different hair color and she always did a beautiful job.

My mother uses Steven for haircuts. He does a great job on her short wavy hair. 

I have my eyebrows shaped Mira. She is wonderful.

I loved this place! It's such a great addition to the SoBro area! Their artisan style pizza is delicious, and they have a ton of options to choose from. You can also get creative and build your own pizza if none of the others tickle your fancy! They allow you to do 1/2 and 1/2 on their pizzas, but only if the two pizzas have the same sauce. 

We started with the baked goat cheese, and it did not disappoint! I ordered the Pera Pesto pizza (pesto sauce, fresh mozzarella, pear, Gorgonzola, and bacon), and holy moly! It was unique and insanely delicious! I also tried a piece of the Del Papa pizza, and it was great too! 

I will definitely be coming back for more!

Very cold Sunday, got there at 11:30ish and was suprised at how small the place was. Packed in tables in a room the size of your master bedroom. 
However,  we were seated promptly. The waitress was very efficient and handled the slew of customers that came in very well. 
I got the bison sliders and my lovely guest had the pesto tofu omelette.  
5 stars on the sliders! Perfectly cooked. Juicy with the grilled slightly sweet bun. The three sauces that came with were incredible.  Aioli, Spicy mustard and house made ketchup. 
No kidding the best sliders I've ever had. 
My companions pesto tofu cheesy ( I think goat cheese ) omelette that was amazing!
LOCAL, FRESH and worth the extra cost.
can't wait to come back!

My pcp had prescribed an antibiotic for a uti. After a couple days the symptoms came back and my pcp was unavailable so I made an appointment with the Vandy clinic. The np for dr Penson told me I needed tests ($5K worth of tests) and no suggestions for dealing with the terrible symptoms. I ended up seeing my obgyn who gave me a different antibiotic and I was well by the next day. My complaint with Vandy was that they didn't listen to me, consider my general healthy state nor use common sense to determine the probable cause of my uti symptoms.

If you're looking for a professional company for your event, this is definitely the company! We hired NOLA Crawfish King and I'm so glad we did. Our boiler, Austin reported to our home early to start the boil in order for us to eat on time. My family and I love Austin! He gave us a brief tutorial on how to eat fresh Louisiana crab and sat around to provide assistance to all. Thanks to this company for providing excellent service.

I need to apologize to the owners and staff that it has taken me this long to give my review. I live in Affton and order sushi about once a month from here. Great sushi and even better customer service. Lunch specials are great and price it awesome. Everyone needs to frequent this privately owned restaurant. Thanks for being awesome guys!!

Zuppa is a nice place that serves at all times of the day. I had never heard of it before and decided to check it out. We went at lunch time and it was fairly busy. So I assumed it was going to be a good experience. 

It was suggested to me to try the smoked salmon wrap and I was surprised. It didn't sound appealing to me but it was very good. Everything here was fresh and delicious. We didn't have time for desert but they looked delicious and I want to go back just thinking about them.

I don't know why most people don't know about this place but it's worth a try!

Just want to give a huge shout out to Cat on the 6th floor and Nick behind the coffee bar. Both are SO nice and their service was impeccable! Visited twice in two days...had breakfast for dinner the first time and Oysters the second! Thanks again for treating us so well!
My review is just for drinks and atmosphere.  Stopped here during the overly crowded Spring festival. This would be a fantastic spot to people watch and have a light bite on a less crowded day.

This is a great place to get your hair cut.  The staff here are very friendly and helpful.  They also give you a free coffee, tea, or beverage while you wait.

It can be a tad pricey, but you get what you pay for.

We loved this place!! We sat outside in the courtyard for dinner & had a great waitress whose recommendations were all spot on. The fried green tomatoes-served with crab-was so yummy! We then had the shrimp & grits which was PERFECT (my friend & I shared cuz it was huge) and ended with quite possibly the best dessert I've ever had: bread pudding beignets. This blows Cafe Du Mondu out of the water & is so so delicious without being overly heavy. Drinks were just ok, in my opinion, but with all the drinking we did in NOLA, I was ok with not loving my drink here! As you know, there are a trillion great options in NOLA for dining; this definitely makes my repeat list for next time!

Their pizza is the perfect blend of crispy and doughy, saucy and cheesy, and it is cheap. Two large, plain pizzas are only $10.99(great deal). Their stromboli is also delici-O. Unlike other stromboli theirs is not grease at all; the stromboli crust stays nice and crisp.

If you want a five star food experience in NOLA it's worth going mid city (out of downtown). There is a little restaurant in a house in Carrollton that is owned by a chef who schooled at the Culinary Institute of America. Every single thing we ate at the restaurant was fantastic. The gumbo is very unique. Starting with duck and chicken, the chef adds  horseradish potato salad which gives it a unique pop. I ate a hamburger with kimchi and a Sambal aioli served with hand cut French fries. The hamburger was out of this world and the Korean cabbage added some nice hot spice. My wife had a tasting menu that included chilled watermelon gazpacho, duck tamales and pork tenderloin with sautéed apples. The deserts were out of the world and the Pastry Chef (also schooled at CIA knows her craft). Wine list was great. We had a 1998 Gran Cru for 125 dollars which is not bad considering the year and the region of the wine. Oh I forgot the handcrafted cocktails. Not too sweet and not too sour. Just perfect balance and harmony. All locals and tourists should check this place out!

I was in the Tampa area 25 minutes away from Shelly's Cafe and decided to make the drive to try this place out, and all I can say is that it was the best decision I made! The location was easy to find and there was plenty of parking. When my sister and I arrived, we sat down and were handed menus right away. The atmosphere was calm and relaxed, it made breakfast very enjoyable. Our waiter was very attentive throughout our meal. I don't think my cup ever went below halfway full. The staff was friendly and made us feel like regulars.
I ordered French Toast with rye toast and home fries. The french toast tasted homemade and were very fluffy. When I tried them I thought it couldn't get better, but then I tried the home fries. The home fries were the best I've tasted! They were the perfect sized slices with just the right amount of seasoning. I swear I could eat an entire plate of the home fries if I could. I will definitely be back to try the pancakes and get a second dose of the home fries!

We went there on the opening night and it was great. There is a ton of space in the beer garden, so you don't feel cramped like some others I have been too. Their beer selection was pretty good- about 10 different cans for $6, a couple of drafts for $6, wine was a little expensive at $10. I do hope they change up the beers they carry throughout the summer. One side note- the staff was all very nice and helpful!

This may be the best hibachi in middle Tennessee! I am always convinced that good customer service doesn't exist... but it does here. We were greeted with smiles, didn't have to wait long and our hibachi chef (Andy) was awesome! Super friendly staff of people. The food was great. It was my daughter's birthday & they went out of the way to make sure she enjoyed it. Great time, great good, great people! We will be back.

While the food and atmosphere are pretty good at this place, its service seems fake and the food is overpriced. I would recommend going to the buffet to save some (read: alot of) dough, but its selection is pretty pathetic considering the place calls itself the 'flavor of India.'  I took off half a star alone for the fact that a soda or iced tea costs 3 bucks.

Everything we had was fantastic! My personal favorites were the calamari, caprese salad and Seafood Pescatore. Venue is small and didn't have accommodations for our party of 7 at first, but we were able to add chairs to our table. Service was a bit slow as they seemed well understaffed but they made us comfortable and provided unlimited hot, Italian rolls. Highly recommend as the food was wonderful!
I have been coming here for years and it never disappoints. I love their gyros and their small Greek salad is more than enough. The Baklava Cheesecake is a must try!

This is one of our "go to" restaurants on our trips to the Big Easy. Go at lunch time...no need for reservations and we are always promptly seated. Staff is so friendly and service is great. The food...omg. The buttermilk fried chicken is awesome.

I went here for the first time today. There was a special deal for cut/color/deep conditioning treatment/brow wax for $95. First off, the owner Marilyn couldn't have been nicer when I booked the appointment. Then Lauren, the stylist, was great. She was so nice and really listened to what I wanted. My hair looks and feels amazing and the brow wax was perfect, too. Nice ambiance, as well, clean and pretty salon.

I'll come back here again even without a special deal. The regular prices are very reasonable for the quality of services. I'd highly recommend this salon.

Any bar good enough for Hulk Hogan is good enough for me.

As stated in other reviews, this place affords some of the best views in Clearwater Beach...spectacular, as some would say.  At sunset, this place gets wild (and they give away free shots, have drink specials, etc.) Want a mellow sunset?  Probably not going to find it here.

The price was right.  We had two local craft beers, three well-made mixed drinks, two Roy Rogers, two Shirley Temples and some nachos with (spicy ass) homemade guacamole and (less spicy ass) homemade pico de gallo salsa.  37 bucks.  Not TOO bad for the beach.  

BTW, the guacamole, although not bad, was nothing overly special.  BUT after 3 drinks, it became some of the best guac I've ever eaten!

The bartender, Chelsea, is a PRO.  It wasn't too busy...after all, most normal people don't go to a rooftop bar during a rainstorm at 1pm.  Anyhow, it was empty except for us dumbasses from Ohio, and she had lots of time to talk and fill us in on the local buzz (where to eat, where NOT to eat, which attractions are cool and which are rip offs, etc).  MORE IMPORTANTLY, she knew beer and was able to make my wife happy not once, but twice with strong drinks that were "fruity and sweet, but not too sweet."  

Great place.  And even though the Hulkster didn't show up that day, I'll be back.  4 stars after one visit.  If the place is consistent, I'll bump 'em up to 5!
Good Cuban food at a fair price. We love to come here for breakfast. Love the cafe con leche! My girls enjoy the Cuban breakfast sandwich and the fruit parfait.
I went in for a cleaning and came out with a double gum infection from the use of dirty tools. Afterwards, the office continued to automatically charge my account for a paid bill. THE WORST

Really nice atmosphere. I sat at the bar and the service was excellent. This was my first time in Idaho, and chose Fork because of the 1200 plus 4 star ratings.  I was really disappointed with the food. Started with the tomato soup which was good but luke warm. Then I had the tri tip  salad -   the meat was flavorless and dry. Maybe I ordered the wrong thing,. Should have gone with the asparagus fries.. those looked really good.

Good food, horrible service.  Folks who work here don't want to work here.  Sign on the door says closed, but there are several folks dining, so we step in to inquire.  The host walks away from us and eventually someone lets us know they are open and we need to order at the bar.  Very very long story short, food was good but we will not return.  Heading down the street in hopes to meet and spend $$$ with nicer people.
I am over the food... Go for the beer & enough room to lounge with friends and actually hear the conversations!
Not wearing masks.   At least two members of staff preparing, serving and handing customers food not wearing masks...in the middle of a pandemic.  Very disappointing.  #Covid19
I am so impress with Apple store. They are so knowledgeable. The small atmosphere was so comforting.  Angel was fantastic. Thank you.

I really loved the place for 3 years. It was a bit pricey but nice people. We hit a hard spot with finances and had to go somewhere else for a while. When we were back on our feet I called to get a appointment and guess what! The manager sent me a email saying " I would strongly urge you to find a different salon " for good! WOW I didn't think a hair cutting place could be so rude! I am still trying to figure out what happened. To be honest I think it has something to do with that little break in the cutting schedule. Well I have since then found a better and nicer place to go. I'm not telling you not to go. I'm just saying don't get attached. Also don't ask them to color your hair blonde it will turn orange. O one more thing if you ask for just one person to cut your hair you might as well let yourself out the door.

My wife and I stopped by here to sample some bourbon the other night.  They have an amazing selection of whiskeys.  From Kentucky, to Scotland, to Japan, to Ireland, they have great whiskeys from every corner of the world. 

The bar tenders were very friendly and knowledgeable.  They gave us some very good recommendations to try and spent a ton of time talking whiskey with us. 

If you are a bourbon or whiskey lover this place is a must try!
Ordered the Brooklyn pie and wings and both were very good! The pie tasted fresh and was a nice change from your standard pizza. Wings were crispy and good sauce. Will order from here again.

Yep, I was duped. My fault so I'm writing this review.  I purchased a used 2009 ram1500 Laramie 4x4 w/38000+ miles awesome decent price not a good price.  Here's where I thought I was protecting myself with all the computer components and electronics on newer vehicles a extended warranty for $1300 for 10 year/100,000miles seemed like a Great Deal especially since they Certified it.  Well that was all a LIE as it turns out the 10/100,000 was back dated to the Original sale date to the First buyer not when I purchased it. My fault I didn't read it thoroughly before signing I took the Dealers word that it was my purchse date. They do trick and lie. This is also after 4 1/2 HOURS of waiting detailing prepping. BEWARE

The Home Hero is a well-organized company.  Peter came swiftly to our place for a free estimate and Leah promptly answered our questions, whether by e-mail or phone.  Randall did a great job at our place.  He took care of all the things that needed to be fixed.  He always either showed up on time or called to advise of a delay.  We think that all this comes at a price because the cost is high.  Also, the work took about three days to be completed because he only worked a few hours each day, fitting this in between other projects elsewhere.  If you are in a hurry, try to get them to schedule full days for the work.

We were a party of 3 and had a reservation wherein we had asked to be seated at a table and not a booth. We then restated this request to the hostess upon arrival. We were ignored and then shown to a booth....when we objected, we were reluctantly provided a table. It should be noted that there was only 1 other party dining at the time and no one was waiting to dine (the restaurant had just opened for lunch)
     We had the Brussel Spout appetizer....this was disliked by all....... the Brussel sprouts were tasteless.....they tasted as if they were partially steamed with no seasoning and then had a topping poured on top.  The topping had minimal flavor at best.
     One person had a meatball PoBoy, one had the Spaghetti and Meatballs, and the last had the Baked Lumache. It should be noted that everyone thought the menu descriptions were great and had us expecting a wonderful dining experience. Unfortunately the food did not meet anyone's expectations.
     In our opinion, all of the dishes lacked even basic seasoning. Meatballs were dense and flavorless. Spaghetti Sauce didn't meet anyone's expectations. The Baked Lumache was actually served burnt. The waiter told the manger who came to our table to tell us "that is the way the dish is made" but he did offer to have a new one made. We did not want to wait another hour to have a dish remade that the manager tells us was supposed to be burnt.
     The Baked Lumache is described as dish with Parmigiano, Romano, and Gorgonzola cheeses.We all looked but none of us could find any cheese. This was the most disappointing dish of all. The cream tasted as if someone had opened a carton of cream.... microwaved it.... and the poured it in the dish.
     We all were really disappointed as we were excited to see this place open and were really looking forward to a great meal.

Nyla Allen is one of the best massage therapists around. I first started seeing her at Mind, Body, Pilates... but now she has her own setup off Mt Rose Hwy on Wedge Pkwy. This location is beautiful and they've done a good job of making it more of a spa experience than just a massage parlour. There's an infra-red sauna and lockers to put your things in. They've made it a great place for groups, such as a bridal shower location. I do believe all of the rooms have two tables for couples massage options. I love the decor of the rooms! My favorite thing is how a good portion of the massage is done face-up, using your own body weight to get an even deeper massage (if you have knots and enjoy firm pressure like I do!). I also really like how they put the orange and peppermint essential oils on your hands to put over your face and breathe away the nasal congestion that massage often causes. I wish I could afford to go more often. It's definitely worth it!

This dunkin donuts is not the best one in the area,  every time i go there i get charged more 4 a lg ice coffee than at any other ones in the immediate area, y is it 47 cn more there, or am i the only one being chg. That am i being ripped off n don't know it. And y is it that there isn't 1 dunkin donuts that's not owned and operated by indians, y, n for god sake please be able to at least communicate clearly in english so that i don't hv to decipher what it is ur saying to me. If u can avoid this dunkin donuts  by all means do so.

Bad service. Do not use if trying to appraise a diesel. They will abuse it before they appraise it. I have a 1999 Dodge Ram 3500 I wanted an appraisal on and the salesman didn't know it had a wait to start which was fine because not a lot of people know that so I excused that then he brought his manager out to look at it. Told the manager there was a wait to start and the manager just disregarded it, did not let the grid heaters cycle whatsoever and just started it up. Then proceeded to floor the engine and constantly rev it as well as redline it for a good 15 seconds after only letting it idle for not even 5 seconds. Everyone with a diesel knows you don't do this because it can cause problems with the engine. I told him not to do that and he responded with "why?" and I told him that even though it is fairly warm out (25-30 degrees) that it is an older Cummins and you can not just floor it and rev it without letting it idle for a bit because it causes engine wear. He disregarded it and said well you drove it here so it must be warm which is somewhat true but it was sitting for a good 5 minutes but a diesel does not warm its engine till it is under load and it does have low battery and needs a new grid heater as well as low oil and slow oil getting to the engine you should wait at least 30 seconds to fully circulate the oil. I told him you don't do that it's not good for the vehicle and he was abusing my Cummins before he even appraised it. He looked at me and just said I don't want it. Which was fine by me after how he treated myself and my vehicle. I was looking to sell this truck to a reliable dealer who will take care of it and sell it to the right person due to the fact that upkeep had become to expensive for me and I knew it was time to pass it on to someone who could take better care of it. He just disregarded my wishes and then walked away like I wasn't a customer who was looking to get an appraisal. I do not recommend this dealership to anyone getting an appraisal on a trade in or an instant cash offer from KBB. They don't even have a diesel mechanic and are not even equipped nor have the knowledge to treat a diesel the right way.

Cute small place. Fresh, local food that was very tasty. We went around 10am in a Sunday. The waitress is clueless and not personable. We sat for about 15/20 minutes before able to order  - others came in after us,  ordered before us, and got their food before us. Probably won't go back.
Fast, efficient service. Has more than bagels. Great place for quick meal or snack before flight.

Food rivaling a middle school cafeteria.  Service rivaling the DMV.  Like any other "Clearwater Institution", you're either going to get brainwashed or served a bad meal-- come here for the latter.

What's bad?  Here's a checklist:

Want to wait 33 minutes for a frozen margarita when you ordered one on the rocks?  We did, while our waiter was probably hiding in the attic snorting ketamin.  

Want to pay double the price for half the quality of the McDonald's next door?  

Do you love listening to Creed, Nickelback, Kid Rock and others?  

Do you feel that a waitress's stretch-mark'd tramp stamp improves restaurant ambiance?  

BOOM-- Frenchy's.  Go there.

We got the cheese steak with fried onions and mushrooms. I am very perplexed by this cheesesteak.  We both liked it.  It was very well made. Our appetizer came with a very nice seeded roll and the Cheesesteak did not.  The meat was very good.  The cheese, fried onions and mushrooms we're all mixed very well with meat.  It was made with love.  It was under $10 but felt very small.  Anthony's, Jill and the Cheesesteak we're all very nice but I just can't score the cheesesteak very high.  I can't get past the roll and size.
Amazing breakfast spot! The chicken biscuits are amazing! We had the Bloody Mary and the boozy bourbon slush and they were good!

Great breakfast for GF people. Staff is very knowledgeable and accommodating with allergies. Portions are very generous and the GF toast is probably the best GF bread I've had. My kids were thrilled with the GF pancakes. 

I haven't had any issues here as a celiac.

I lived at Pine Tower for a year. The apartment itself was great, clean, no critters of any kind.  However the staff isn't always the friendliest. They misplaced my deposit refund form and it would have been helpful to know as soon as possible.  But they wouldn't give me information about my deposit until 30 days after I had moved out. At that point they said they hadn't received the form so it was my fault. The free internet that was promised was mostly terrible (very slow).
Great tacos, can't go wrong with anything. The pineapple turmeric marg was delicious and the foam classic was so fun! Would definitely recommend to friends. The short rib barbacoa was 2 die for

A few weeks ago my husband and I drove down Route 30 looking for somewhere to stop for dinner. We decided to give Gulifty's a try 

It was pretty packed, but we were seated outside fairly quickly. 

Service was incredibly slow. It took forever for everything - drinks, our food, refills (oh wait, I never got a refill on my ginger ale...), and the check. A quick dinner took well over an hour. 

The food was so disappointed. I ordered the crab cake sandwich just for the crab cake. It was incredibly bland and there was some grit in it. The fries weren't that great either. 

My husband had one of the chicken sandwiches. Also very underwhelming.  The meat didn't fit the bread and he had to rebuild his entire meal to make it edible. 

All in all, great location and layout, loved the patio, but he food and service were sub-par.

Excellent service from everyone we met. Good food, reasonable prices. We got the lobster bisque (very good) and shared the crabcakes and mahi mahi with a tomato cream sauce. The last was too heavy for my taste but maybe my fault for ordering something like that. Menu could use some updating. Fish and vegetables were all really good and fresh, even the vegetable medley that came with our dinner was crispy (unlike soggy gray and overcooked as in most restaurants). Obviously this restaurant invests money and time in getting good fresh ingredients and the cookstaff has excellent culinary skill. They can do better than the big section of fried fish, the rich sauces, and the 1980's style converted rice that came with our dinners. My advice is to take what they do well -- fresh seafood and vegetables and good flavors -- and move their menu towards a healthier, more modern and more interesting sensibility that showcases their excellent potential.
Great live music in a small setting.  This is a very small place and it depends on the band playing as to how the vibe is.

This restaurant service caters to their customers and they truly show phenomenal hospitality. Stone, the manager treats everyone like true family and makes you feel right at home. Another wonderful person who really knows how to represent Carnes is Lamar. He is the absolute best server and will always put a smile on your face. He is nothing less than continuously positive, upbeat, and will go the distance to make a night special. If ever in Ybor city, Carnes is the place you want to be. The atmosphere is spectacular and nothing in Tampa beats this kind of service.

We read reviews and decided to give this place a try during our visit to Clearwater Beach. Our server wasn't knowledgeable at all of the menu. (we could see there were other servers around us who were better) The food was pretty awful- We started with oysters- I asked if they were small or large.. She said they were pretty large. They were tiny.. barely quarter sized. Waste of money. My daughter ordered the Pulled Pork nachos and they were average- Tostada chips with some BBQ thrown on top.. She ate the BBQ off and left the stack of chips.. waste of money. My son wasn't starving so he opted for the fried calamari. This was dreadful- imagine fried styrofoam.. similar taste and texture.. Can't imagine no one has ever complained and they have changed this menu item.. Who knows. I ordered the langastinos.. They were okay- not awful, not great and still not worth the $$. I can't even remember what my husband ordered. He didn't complain and said it was fine. needless to say- $80 later we left and drove through the McDonald's. Go elsewhere!

Enjoyed a Sunday lunch here with a couple of friends. I had one of the best cheeseburgers I think I've had in a long time and a huge basket of fries which I split with my husband and our friends had cheeseburgers and a tuna sandwich which they both enjoyed and my husband had the pastrami on rye grilled.
It's a pretty interesting place with batting cages indoor golf and the place was very busy. The owner Tommy came by we got to met him very nice gentleman. We will surely return for another excellent cheeseburger or something else on the menu.
It's kind of out-of-the-way in the industrial area of Sparks but not far from where we live.
It would be a great place to take with your kids or grandkids.
Lots of things going on and many large-screen TVs around.

Tourist trap. Go when there is no line. 
Great charbroiled oysters. I don't know if I'd order anything else. 

Only reason why this place would not be good for groups is the amount of wait time.
Unfortunately, not a good hair cut. Very disappointed. That is really all that needs to be said.

Rooms are ok but not loving the bar. They ran out of Pepsi mid-drink and the bartender said that even if they had another one in back, he wasn't going to replace it so pick something else. Then, as I was about to order another round of drinks ($15 for 2), a patron at the bar mentioned that if I waited 3 more minutes, they would be free (managers reception 5:30-7:30). Thanks, Mr. Bartender. :P
After returning to our room, I called to ask for extra pillows and blankets to put the kids on the pullout couch. After 2 hours, they still haven't been delivered. I called again to check and the front desk said I couldn't have 3 pillows because of the "pillow limit" but they would check on 2 pillows. Apparently, they frequently run out. Weird.  After another hour, I finally went down to the desk to ask for pillows and a blanket and they were finally sent up. 
The TVs are some brand called 'Chimei' I think and they're really bad so don't bother with an in-room movie (we were charged for one we didn't see but I didn't bother to object).  The remotes don't work and neither does the in room check-out system.

Pretty tasty and quick spot for lunch.

The lunch special menu is pretty good, it's actually probably too much food. For $6.95 you get your entree, fried rice, fried wonton, an eggroll and the soup of the day.

The soup of the day when I went was totally delicous, but I have no clue what it was. To eat I had the lunch special #4 which is simply called Thai Curry. I got it vegetarian and it was a red curry. Delicous, the menu calls it medium but it really wasn't too spicey. They do bring this little basket of spices for you to add though.

The service was pretty quick, we were in and out in about 30 minutes which for lunch I really appreciate.

One of the best dining experiences I've ever had.  Service was outstanding, professional, and even though we were using the last of our Hawaiian package meal coupons, they treated us like a King and Queen.  Even the manager came by and sincerely asked how we liked our meal.  Be aware there is a reasonable split charge.  Not very hungry we split a delicious prime rib with bone dinner with starch and vegetables.  For an extra $9 we received a soup, starch and vegetables.  The desserts deserve the "Wow" factor award!  Even though we said we were too full for dessert, the wait staff rolled the dessert cart to us and described each dessert in detail.  From Mile High Chocolate Fudge Cake to Strawberry Mascarpone Shortcake.  I was impressed with a dessert topped with a baseball size ball of spun sugar strands.  Thinking we were done, we were unexpectedly served two large chocolate covered strawberries.  We'll be back.

If I could give this place 10 stars I would. The food was amazing and plentiful. The options were healthy and delicious. The service was prompt and friendly, and the bill? Incredibly reasonable. We can't wait to return.

As a tip, try one of their omelets with andouille sausage and some fresh veggies. It was fantastic.

West County Nissan needs to repair their Charge Point charging station. It has been at least on month (mid July) perhaps longer that their 240V 6kW charger has worked. If they purport to support the sale of electric vehicles - specifically the Nissan Leaf - then they need to complete the investment and repair the Charge Point charger. I have called Charge Point and they stated that although the charger carries their name it is owned and operated by West County Nissan.  Original Publishing date: August 26, 2014. Will be happy to upgrade when Nissan does.  Two stars because they at least offer a 3kW charger.

Lovely place for a quick bit and lot of chats. I wouldn't come if you're expecting a full meal but maybe a light bite. The do have some entrees but it's not very expansive. Their tea selection, however, is quite large.  

Tried the lavender oolong and loved it. It was light but aromatic. Quite excited to try other tea offerings. I split a teapot with my gal pal. Between us two, it was a decent amount. I think three to a pot might be a bit too little per person. Also got some fries and their dessert trio to share. The Goma (black sesame) Brulee is really good. Full of flavor, nutty and creamy. The Pâte à Choux were alright and the green tea financier is passable.

The service is quite nice. We didn't feel rushed and we enjoyed our tea time.

Had lunch here recently with coworkers. Usually a good pick and have never hesitated in the past to recommend. Unfortunately this trip was not great. We sat in the pub side. I ordered the cheese burger, with bacon and a side of fries. The burger was med well instead of med, bun was burnt and fries were also burnt. Bacon was a small thin strip and a half with no flavor. I've had better bacon from a microwave able pre cooked pack. I know it was just a burger and fries, but I was wishing I had gone to the Checkers next door, not good. 

I was most disappointed since previously the same meal was perfect. But clearly no quality control in the kitchen today. I'm sure I'll be back, but it will be a while. I really hope this was a one time bad experience.

I've tried this place two times, both were equally disappointing. The first time we waited patiently at the front entrance near the 'please wait to be seated' sign....for ten minutes. Three employees made eye contact with me and quickly dodged my attempts to flag them down. I was so irritated that we just left. 

The second time around (a couple of weeks later), I hoped that they had worked out the kinks. Nope. Still waited at the front and finally just decided to go get our own table in first floor patio area. The place was no where near full (no Cards game on), but we just got all of our drinks from the bar. No one ever greeted us or told us that we needed to do anything. We finally wanted to order some food, and were told "no" because we hadn't been "officially seated". I was dumbfounded- as we had been there for two and a half hours, and not a soul had told us to move or offered to "officially seat us" so that we would be placed in the system. 

At the end of the day, the service at this place is just terrible. The music is so loud that the employees probably can't even hear themselves think (hence the foul looks on everyone's faces...) Drink prices are above average, and the food is on par with what you'd expect at a place like this. I will most likely not return. What a waste of potential.

Ate here while at school, service was good girl was friendly food came out at an ok time i guess wasnt super busy and getting together mac and cheese, cornbread, and pulled meat ud think would be out almost instantly, but not so much, im leaving the review because the food was just ehh, meat didnt hardly have any flavor, super dry, the cornbread was dry aswell, as soon as you touched it it crumbled into tiny pieces, the mac and cheese was pretty good you could tell it was homemade, gave it a 3 because the serivce was ok, food was not something i would write home about, and the portions to amount was ok aswell would i recommend to a friend, i would say if you want to try it to try sure go ahead, id let them be the judge i wouldnt say no don't go because i didnt like it it wasnt horrible

As good as it gets... the food is authentic and bursting with flavor.  We usually get the papaya salad (bummer they don't offer sticky rice), Cambodian salad (i have to warn you it is slightly bitter, an acquired flavor), mussels, chicken sticks and meatballs skewers.  The beef stew, a special item, is cooked for hours.  The beef is so tender, it melts in your mouth, and the sauce is great for dipping with bread.  The pork belly wrapped in leaves and served with fresh veggies are worth trying.  I have not had a bad experience.  The neighborhood is kind of sketchy, but worth a trip!!

Need to wait until they get their staffing issues corrected. They just opened so we decided to try them. Called at 6:45PM on Wed night. Left on hold for 10 min. Hung up and called Papa John's. Picked up the pizza 15 later will try BlackJack again, just not until they get their staffing corrected.

This is the best damn burger place in all of Indiana as rated by a guy from New Jersey. The staff is friendly and accommodating. We stopped here twice while we were out there. The burgers were amazing as were all the appetizers. Will absolutely be returning if I ever end up in Indiana again.

We have now dined here for bunch & dinner and the food is easily 5 stars!! Seriously everything we put in our mouths was delicious. 

I'm deducting a star for two reasons: Service & Ambiance. The service during brunch was less than stellar. Granted it was packed, but they seemed unprepared or apathetic really. Dinner experience was much better, but we were one of three tables on a Friday night. **Side note: go here for dinner!! We started here with a bottle of wine and then walked one block over to Burgs for a few more drinks. Support the neighborhood - it's getting there!!

Regarding the ambiance: nothing about the decor is inviting. I guess it kind of has that homey feel, but there's nothing different or exciting about it that makes you feel special to be there. Maybe some people would disagree and say that's what actually makes this place special, but I think this could be so much more of a draw with more intentional design on the inside. The lighting was WAYYYY too bright for dinner time. Thankfully they ended up dimming it, but it felt more like a cafeteria until that happened. 

All in all, I am so happy to have this gem in our neighborhood!! I can't wait to go back :)

Very good dining experience.  First off, four stars is great, and we're talking about a hotel restaurant, but it's a Four Seasons hotel restaurant.  :)

I had lunch at Cielo and really enjoyed it, although there were a few things that knocked the restaurant down to 4 versus 5 stars.

Let's start with the positives:

- Warm and inviting environment and staff
- The views, the views!
- Open-air design, yet very elegant plating and linen
- Inventive, seasonal menu
- Nice bread starter
- Octopus white beans and sun-dried tomatoes starter is wonderful - very fresh, good flavor profile, and oh-so-Mediterranean
- Perfectly cooked salmon with crispy exterior and moist, tender interior - I can recommend the market salad

Some room for improvement:

- I had ordered a side of vegetables, which was the broccoli - this did not come out to me, although the salad was served with a side of avocado so maybe there was some confusion (interestingly, avocado is a fruit, but let's not get digress)
- The avocado side was sliced cleanly, although there were brown marks on it from being a touch over-ripe.  I was a little taken aback that they served it as such
- I had ordered dressing on the side for my market salad, and while the dressing was on the side, there was still a base of dressing underneath some of the leaves - not sure if this was included with the marinated mushrooms and was a holdover, but I have not had that happen before

Anyway, no need to be nit-picky, this is a great restaurant, with warm, eager-to-please staff, and the hotel is gorgeous.
This used to be a great deal but now the drive thru car wash sucks. I think the machines and employees are off

Prettt delicious food. Serving sizes are small. The place itself it really nice, interior. The service was very good! The recommendation was that you get a 3 course meal since the serving sizes are small. We shared plates but got two each. I would def recommend the restaurant if you want a place for fine dining.
This place is awesome.  Peaceful and tranquil. Best haircut I've ever had!
Small bites in a hip atmosphere. Worth a trip just for the oyster taco.

I've been here a few times, and have only tried the fried chicken and fries. Never even thought about ordering anything else, it's so good. Someone brought some in to work a while back, and I've been hooked ever since and got my mother hooked on it also! I always call ahead and pick up my order, and it's always done fast, fresh & friendly - just the way I like it. I just read a few reviews and see that I need to check out the philly sandwich also!

this place is really hit or miss, but i think they used all their good pizzas in their opening. 

ive come here at least six times  each visit the pizza comes out more soggy and flappy. 

originally the pizzas were crispy, but now - most likely due to huge lines - they dont cook the pizzas long enough, and they come out flappy and messy to eat. 

there are so many better pizza places in IV. blaze was a nice novelty but now it's just meh.
