I have been brining my samsonite bags here for years.  Its the only samsonite luggage repair authorized center in the entire southeast.  They do an excellent job and if the bag is under warranty its free!

Every time I go to Izzos on Vets and on the Westbank, the dining areas are filthy; none of the tables are clean, the trash cans are over flowing, the sauce bar is disgusting. Employees hover between the kitchen and serving area and don't seem to care about the rest of the restaurant. Makes me wonder if I should be eating the foods they prepare. If I hadn't been searching for something quick with vegan options on the 4th of July, I wouldn't have set foot inside.

HORRIBLE TIMING. They take forever to send a cab. I have used them on several occasions and have been disappointed every time. This time the lady on the phone tells me 30 minutes or less. 40 minutes pass by so I call back to see what the problem is and spend 5 minutes on hold. Someone finally calls back about 50 minutes after I asked for the cab, asking if I still needed the cab and it would take another 10 minutes for a cab to come.

We went with the prix fixe New Year's Eve menu.  Great waiter.  Very pleasant and  helpful.  Food was brought out a steady and easy pace.  No feeling of a rushed service on a busy night. 
This being my third Garces restaurant, I lowered my expectations. I found both Tinto and Amada to be overblown, over hyped, over sodiumed hipster hubs.  Chifa was a more pleasant and more intimate atmosphere where your conversations were your own and not part of the silly small and over packed room. The food was fair and interesting but not worth the 120 a person with one drink each.  

In my humble opinion, Chifa was a nice place for half maybe three quarters the price.  But honestly, if Garces is the Face of the Philadelphia scene, he disappoints.   Chifa just doesn't deliver what the menu promises.

One of the best BBQ places in the Treasure Valley! Everything is made fresh and delicious. When you first walk in they give you a rib to sample while you decide what you want to eat. I love the pulled pork and the smashed potatoes are to die for. 

Staff has already been friendly and on point. 

The reason why I don't give this place a 5-star review is because they only serve beer and one kind of wine I think. They use to have a cocktail menu but I guess they got rid of their liquor license because not enough people were ordering drinks. That made me a little sad because everyone I came here in the past I always got a cocktail and they were delicious. 

I don't hold that against them too much as I understand that liquor licenses are expensive and you gotta cut costs that are necessary, it just a little unfortunate as I don't like beer lol. 

I will definitely be coming back because them meats be delicious!

I see no reason not to give this 5 stars.  First time in and we were greeted at the door by a friendly staffer who informed us that we could grab some self service coffee and take our time to look over the menu.  Food came out quickly and was excellent.  Freshly squeezed Florida orange juice to top it off.  Nice trendy atmosphere and when I ordered they asked me which job I would be terrible at and that is how they called my order out... Nice touch

I don't know why I don't eat here more often. Their food is fantastic. Guess I am just always distracted by their fantastic selection of alcohol, making it easy for them to make any cocktail you want.
The only thing better than the food and drinks is the fantastic service by by the best bartenders, waiters, and waitresses in Fountain Square.
I was not happy with the up-selling, but they are a good vet.

Noodles and Company exceeded my expectations. I expected fast food noodles to be the epitome of grungy, greasy and low quality. It ended up being a pleasant surprise. The food was great and it was brought out in a timely manner. Everything was also super affordable. I would recommend for noodle enthusiasts or people who need food on the go.

Not sure if management is just incompetent or this place borders on a scam.  Go somewhere else, I'm not sure where, but go somewhere else.  Use only if you want someone to show up, not tell you how much they are going to charge you, immediately get to work without asking if you are ok with their plan, and then later try to charge you exorborant prices.  There were so many things about this place that were bad but the main ones were:

     -  Took 3 days to get on site and then tried to charge me an emergency arrival fee.
     -  When they got on site to assess damage they charged $250 which took them about an hour to do.  They could get to work immediately but they couldn't tell me how many anything would cost, only the project manager could tell me that.  Or they could leave and I'd have to reschedule (SCAM).
     - The customer service person I talked to said the original $250 would be applied if the folks did any work on the first visit.  I had them do about 2hours of work but when I talked to the billing department they tried to add the $250 on top of that.
     -  I asked for a quote of the work with some items taken out I would do myself, the "project manager" never got back to me with the quote.
    -  The "dehumidfyer" they left for 3 days (waste) as I had my own going, actually leaked causing more water damage.
     -  After trying to get a hold of the "prj manager" for 3 days I gave up and I never did get a final bill as the charges must have been less than $250 and they didn't want to give me a refund.

This place is a scam that takes advantage of people that are in a desperate situation, luckily I was smart enough to do most of the work myself and then use another contractor for the repair work.  Unless you want to get ripped off, don't use these folks.

Been going here for over a year. Everything was great in the beginning. I was drawn to this gym because it's the only 24 hour gym that I know of in Tucson and it was walking distance from my house. Not only that they had a location near my parents' house in Gilbert so when I went up to visit I could still workout.
It is uncrowded, like the previous yelper stated, and during certain hours of the night you can have the whole gym to yourself, which is nice.
However, I gave them one star because the management is really shady. Whenever you call the listed gym phone number I think you're calling the owner's cell phone and he's always rude, condescending and unhelpful. Just today when I called to cancel my membership the guy was being a total jerk and basically told me to come into the office another day or contact the corporate office. The thing is I don't live in Tucson anymore and I'll be going overseas so I'm unable to stop by just to cancel my membership. You could tell on the phone he was mad that I wanted to leave the gym and was giving me attitude.
Another thing too, I referred my friend to this gym awhile back and the dude gave my friend the runaround and made him pay almost $50 a month. Told him he'd get a month free but he signed up in the middle of the month so really only got half a month free. 
I'm telling you. STAW AWAY. MANAGEMENT IS SKETCHY.
Don't be discouraged by Snap Fitness though because the staff I've dealt with at the Higley & Ray location in Gilbert are the polar opposite. Super helpful and friendly. If you feel you have to workout at Snap Fitness I suggest getting your membership from another franchise, you still get access to all the Snap Fitness gyms nationwide no matter which franchise location you sign up with but you won't have to deal with the poor management at this location.

The staff at Steve's has always impressed me.  Super great people, who really care about the job they do.  These guys aren't worker bee drones.  They are fast, friendly, and quick to offer suggestions, and will go the extra mile to make sure you are happy.

That alone, for a restaurant is impressive enough, but the dogs (and mac bowls) are also suitably impressive.  I only wish they kept the brainless sauce in stock.

Also - Call delivery orders in directly to Steve's.  I know that on the page, it points to third party delivery services, but they end up doing the delivery themselves, any way, and you end up throwing extra money at the grubdelevery service for nothing.  I have never had ANY issues with delivery.  Faster than Jimmie Johns!

The chilled soup option was exactly what I was looking for on a hot afternoon. A freshly prepared Kale gazpacho - flavors of cucumber, olives, black pepper, garlic and a hint of red pepper - served with lightly seasoned and toasted pita triangles. The cup size was plenty. Haven't tried any other food options, hence the 4 stars. Refreshing and filling. Looking forward to catching another variety before summer runs out.

I like this spot, especially the location. Being so close to the highway, it's a convenient meeting place, and I usually find street parking. 

The bar food is pretty darn good if you're looking for cheesy, bacony waffle fries or a sandwich. Perfect greasy food for pre or post drinking. 

There are specials on week nights, and I especially like the Thursday's Ladies Night with free martinis after 9pm. The cajun martini is just like a bloody mary. And free tastes so good. 

I deducted a star because they could use a wider beer selection. I usually end up getting whatever the Abita seasonal offering is, which they usually have in bottles. I have seen small live bands there from time to time. Wish they'd have live music regularly.
I had an appointment with Madison. She was really great and I love how the cut turned out. She really took her time and made sure I was really happy with what she was doing.

By far one of the best restaurant experiences I had in a long time. To sum everything up Al de Cuba went above and beyond to make sure I receive five star service, food and entertainment. I would like to give a special shout out to David aka "Bartender of the Year" - the guy knows his stuff and went above and beyond to make sure my first time in Philly was a memorable one. He recommended the Vaca Frita dish w/ a side of plantanos fritos which was magically delicious!! I couldn't help but live in the moment so I also order a glass of Zacapa Rum. 

I highly recommend this restaurant to anybody looking for good eats or a good time.

Also, special shout out to the hostess Brianna for everything. You the ish gurl!!

Excellent dinner here tonight!  Great Italian food. Worth the very short drive from New Orleans. 

https://blainerestaurantreport.wordpress.com/2021/04/17/oak-oven-harahan-report-370/
Friendly, efficient, and successful in saving our cat during his very serious heart health emergency.

FRAUD! MISREPRESENTATION!! DECEPTIVE SALES PRACTICES!! Worst car buying experience of my life. The owner Dean is a scumbag stay far away from this dealer all they do is lie. The whole buying process was lie after lie. Everything was misrepresented to me they will do anything to sell you a car. I purchase a car which I was told and appeared to be in pristine condition only to have the car delivered damaged.
The food was AMAZING!  Service was impeccable (shouts out to our server Shawn!) and the ambience was great. All in all a great dining experience that I think anyone would enjoy!

I've been meaning to try this spot for awhile now. I went yesterday for the first time and now I can say that the best tacos I have ever had were from a food truck on Drexel's campus. The best part is that it's cheap too!!!

I have been a patient at Florida Wellness since moving to the Tampa Bay Area several years ago. I was in an auto accident in July and needed treatment for the pain I was experiencing. I have been seeing Dr. Abrahams every week since the accident and has taken great care to help me get well. I love the staff, especially Deanna at the front desk. I definitely recommend Florida Wellness for any of your health needs.

Has to be one of the largest selections of cigars in the US - I was truly like a kid in a candy store.  Found some old favorites and discovered some new ones.  Very competitive prices, and friendly service.  Very nice selection of accessories, too.  Next time I hope to have more time so I can enjoy at least one beverage at the bar!

So the hotel tricks you by giving you a free continental breakfast voucher if you do xyz. What you don't know is this is only for "non-hot foods," meaning bagels, cereal and fruit. It's an extra $4 (which isn't that bad, of course) to get the hot bar which includes omelettes, biscuits, French toast, bacon, sausage, etc. Hot bar was good, nothing special. The lox over by the fruit table looked expired and discolored, though. Coffee was good, orange juice seemed fresh. Waitress was wonderful. Hostess seemed uninterested.

I'm giving Bubblefish 3 stars because of what my preferences are. However let me be clear, if you want to hang out at a cool trendy place with some friends in Chinatown and order some fancy milk tea drinks, this is definitely a strong contender.

However my wife and I visited for the food. So firstly there were no soda offerings here. It was tap water or fancy tea drinks only. I'm a tap water kind of guy but my wife is a Coca Cola fiend, so while it doesn't impact my review heavily, I did want to throw out that disclaimer. They were also cool about letting me hop over to 7-11 and grab my darling wife a bottle of her favorite fizzy drink. Kudos to the staff for being flexible.

That said, I'm kinda sure that Trump didn't initiate a tariff on spicy peppers or spicy Sriacha mayo, but if there is one let's hope that this summit in Singapore resolves this issue and restores the term spicy at an Asian restaurant to its rightful place.

I ordered a spicy Tuna/Salmon roll and really it wasn't spicy at all. I was surprised that the heat was lower than the standard sriacha mayo you'd get at the local Poke joint.

I also had some salted Taiwanese chicken. This dish is one of their appetizers. I enjoyed it, despite it being mostly darker meat, and at $6.00 you get an entire pot of chicken. My disappointment here was asking for some sort of spicy dipping sauce, and being told ok, only to find out that at the completion of my meal none was furnished.

So for anyone looking for spice or a special kind of accommodation (a sauce), my recommendation would be to set the expectations for what you need ahead of time and follow up as the food/beverages make their way out piece by piece. 

The cool thing about this place is that they'll serve you the food as soon as it's ready in no particular order. I liked that.

Mike's dishes up excellent ice cream across a broad spectrum of flavors at reasonable prices, and that's frankly all you need to know. Get yourself in the door!

Star 1: How were the service and atmosphere?

Unlike some of the new-age ice cream spots that have sprung up across the country (Salt & Straw http://www.yelp.com/biz/salt-and-straw-portland-2?osq=Salt+Straw and Smitten http://www.yelp.com/biz/smitten-ice-cream-san-francisco-3 come to mind), Mike's is your traditional ice cream parlor right in line with some of the gems in New York and Chicago. The flavors are on the board, the cones lined up in their stands, and the servers fast and friendly. What more could you want? Star Granted. 

Star 2: How were the portions relative to the cost?

Very much unlike the new age spots, the prices at Mike's couldn't be more affordable, and my single scoop in a cone, which was sizable as you can see in the picture, was priced at only $3.50. That's value. Star Granted. 

Stars 3 and 4: How was the food?

Before going into my actual Caramel Cone selection, I'll point out that Mike's wins when it comes to flavor variety. Simply too often I've rolled into modern ice cream or gelato spots only to find that I either have basic chocolate and vanilla to choose from or some kale and blueberry goat cheese nonsense. Mike's leaves the gentrification at the door, offering up a huge selection of classics, contemporary flavors, and combinations of the two that are sure to satisfy anyone. 

My caramel cone in particular was very, very good, with the right ratio of caramel to cone and ice cream. Single Star Granted. 

Star 5: Would you eat here every day if you could?

As far as I'm concerned, Mike's is the best ice cream in Nashville, and a classic like this would easily secure my patronage daily. Star Granted.

OYSTER HAPPY  HOUR!

I could leave the review at that but since I'm a nice guy - and incredibly witty - I'll provide some additional details and context.

My understanding is prior to the "rebranding" and updates the treehouse was a bit run down, menu was lacking etc etc.  Well, I can't speak to that but I can say the "new" treehouse rocks.  It rocks your ass off.

The back patio is a great area to enjoy the amazing weather and sip on your favorite brew or a delicious cocktail.  We first went on a Saturday for the oyster happy hour only to realize/learn that it was only Mon-Thur which sucked at the moment but gave me a reason to come back.

The oysters are fresh, flavorful and the cilantro mojo is so so soooo good. Everything I've had there has been very flavorful and satisfying from the ceviche to the tacos it's just really good food.

If you're looking for a unique spot for a weeknight happy hour definitely give this a go.  If you're looking for a great patio to enjoy food and drinks - again, definitely give this a go.

I plan on making this my Thursday night habit.

Finally, after years of disappointment with Barbers in Philadelphia we have an upscale barbershop with very competitive prices. From a service perspective they are comparable to a shop that I used to patronize that charged $60 a haircut so their $22 price for a buzz cut and exemplary service puts them way above the ghetto fabulous experiences for black men in Philly. Bravo William! I am a fan!!

Roxy is amazing! Had a wonderful experience at Wink. I love the cute store with so many fun products. The space was clean and very safe. Roxy did a great job with my lashes and even educated me on what would look best given my features. I've been getting my lashes done for years and never had someone give such great recommendations!

Amazing all around! I'm so happy I found this place. I was in a pinch when I realized how out of control my facial hair had become - and not being from here I had little hope but to yelp it! The wax salon is located inside an Aveda hair salon. The ambiance was beautiful - from decor to music. The staff was friendly and helpful. But my wax girl Elizabeth was the best! She was professional and an expert at her craft. They were even nice enough to allow me to use their advertised discount - even though I am an out of towner. Can't wait to come back to NOLA and use their services again.

Really surprised at how good my lunch here was. I'll be honest, I had pretty low expectations from a sports bar in a Marriott across fom the convention center (shocking, I know). 

The inside is what you'd expect - TV's every 5 feet, ample availability of chicken wings, framed jerseys on the walls, Smashmouth on the sound system. The menu is what you'd expect too - the aforementioned wings, nachos, burgers and the like. That said, you can be healthy-ish. They've got a turkey burger and you can sub fruit or salad for a side instead of fries.

The person I was with went with a burger & fries which were described as "solid". I had a Cuban sandwich which was honestly really, really good - they roast the pork in house and it shows - very flavorful. Portions are HUGE - just half of my sandwich had me plenty full.

Service was fine - they were busy but our order came out quickly. Overall, way better than expected.

I don't know which is better -- the excellent tailoring talents of their seamstress or their amazing customer service skills but I can't say enough about the wonderful experience that I have always had with Metro Cleaners.  They do top quality work on formal wear as well as business suits and casual clothing.  I have never been disappointed with their work and always leave feeling glad that I support this local business that gives 110% to their clients.   Highly recommend them!

This was first time here, heard it was pretty good, my first 10 mins wasn't good at all. The cashier shouldn't be there she has no idea how to count money,  for god sakes it says right there in front of you how much to give me back. Okay moving right along I finally got my food after waiting about 15 , and it turn around. It was amazingly delicious that's all I have to say the end.

Pretty good sandwhich shop. 
Parking available outside. 
Customer service is good. 
The menu is NOT vegetarian friendly (if any of you don't eat meat)
Prices are reasonable. 
Ordered a shrimp sandwhich, it was ok. Not a lot of flavor to it, added my own sauces once I got home. 
Would I go back??? Eeehhhh wasn't impressed it was just ok.

WE ARE: Thirtysomething Ventura County locals who frequent Santa Barbara. We've stayed at many inns, B&B's, house rentals and hotels in this city. We've done fancy. We've done cheap. We can appreciate good value when we see it.

OUR STAY: Mid-August when most hotels, even the pricey ones, are booked solid.

BOOKING THE PLACE: Easy; directly on the B&B's website. Email confirmation of booking + email from innkeeper with all sorts of extra instructions are sent in a timely manner.

ROOM RATES: Extremely good value given that breakfast is included. Similarly-priced hotels in the area are typical California motel liptstick-on-a-pig-and-create-a-pretty-website conversions. Trust me on that.

PROPERTY LOCATION: Upper State Street. You are not right in the center of things but only 2 blocks over and up to the nearest restaurants on a very safe street. Walk to go further into State or take the 25 cent electric shuttle that goes all the way to the beachfront of Cabrillo Blvd.

PARKING: On the street or parking lot behind the house. Easy.

PROPERTY ITSELF: Late 1800's Victorian. Well-maintained outside. Impeccable inside. Seems true to the period without being too "granny-ish". We've seen and smelled what that's like at other B&B's. This does not come close.

ROOMS: Even the smallest room is not small. Every detail was considered, even a small water cooler and fridge is available in the room. Kinda feels like mom lives there, minus the nagging. (Sorry, Mom).

INNKEEPER / BREAKFAST: James House and Marie, the Innkeeper are synonymous. So are Marie and her breakfasts. Marie is warm, attentive, very passionate about what Santa Barbara can offer her guests. A quick chat with her beats staring into the clueless faces of young hotel workers trying to pass themselves off as a concierge because their nametag says so.

Breakfast is served at 9 a.m. most mornings and 9:30 on Sundays. For those who think they will be hungry earlier (like me), stow away a box of snacks in your purse and don't dare wish for the hotel vending machine or in-room bar goodies. Marie's breakfasts are worth the wait.

She specializes in frittatas and omelets with fresh local vegetables served with some type of potato side dish (like herbed wedges or double-baked smashed) and a wonderful concoction of fresh-baked bread (like polenta cake with pear compote or blueberry scones). You get orange or apple juice, coffee, tea - whatever you please and however much you want. Like most homespun treats it's not always just how things taste (one morning my eggs lacked salt) but how much care and attention the cook gives the food that makes the difference.

IF WE WERE BEING NITPICKY: The water fountain outside our room gave me the nagging feeling that someone left the faucet on. Also, some rooms only have a soaking tub with a hand-held shower head. Luxurious in concept until you realize you're used to showering with both hands free. Each morning, our bathroom was a wet-room filled with giggles as we tried to master the acrobatics involved bathing in this manner.

WILL WE STAY HERE AGAIN? Absolutely, which is not how we feel about other B&B's in the area. Or many hotels for that matter.

The most amazing place ever. I have never felt more comfortable and listened to. Kournti made me feel so at ease and I love their Vision. I can't wait to come back for more services. The halo therapy room helped me detox from all the smoke that I have been exposed to from the caldor fire. This place helped me escape from my stress and fears. I truly needed this moment and can't wait to come back.

So it's Sunday, so what could possibly go wrong!
Bath tub and both toilets suddenly not draining properly. Neighbor suggested rapid router, called and within the hour the truck was here and Timothy quickly and professionally determines our situation. Was it fourteen tree roots entangled in our pipes? No, simply a toilet in one bathroom that is quite possibly the same age as our home, built in 1964.
Certainly recommend Rapid Rooter on all levels. Price for a weekend call was more than reasonable and now we have a plumber we would use in the future. May have to request Timothy as he was awesome. Saw others reviews where there were complaints of how the bathrooms were left, not our experience at all so attacked a photo.

Visiting from out of town and wanted to find a nice brunch place. There was a short wait, cute waiting area with bathroom and refreshments. 
Very cute restaurant, I loved the vibes. I wish I knew it was BYOB prior to coming, that would have been perfect. 

Looking at the menu pricing was fair, my family and I all got different things and everyone was satisfied. Food was very good! Waiters were attentive! We loved this place, so glad we found it.

On Friday I ordered brisket, green beans, and coke slaw. I kept it overnight and took it up to my parents on Saturday. We ate it Saturday evening. The green beans were delicious. The coke slaw was excellent. The brisket was amazing. Seriously. So delicious. No bbq sauce added. So tender. So good. I love brisket and I was impressed.

I am particular about cleanliness, the energy of the place and finally, if they are knowledgable about the body and how to heal. 

This is now the place of my choice to get weekly massages. 

They care from the heart. They are loving people. All of them not just one of them. 

Their motto is "we will fix you with a heart".  Their bathroom is cute and clean! 
Peter was my therapist. A professional!! Very kind and loving. He knew that I had a problem and where without me telling him. 

I look forward to next time!

Thank you so much, Peter!

Santa Barbara County Courthouse is definitely a top place to visit when in SB. The court house is open to the public and has gorgeous views of the town as well as open spaces to chill and to enjoy the weather. The clock tower is probably the most popular thing to check out and the views up there do not disappoint. The tower gives a complete 360 view and is absolutely beautiful. The tower entrance is not hard to find once inside the main building. The tower can be accessed through the flight of stairs or an elevator. Parking to get here can be tricky, but the surrounding blocks have free 75min parking! There are some spots that are 75 min free parking Mon-Fri, but just make sure to read the parking signs. The courthouse was one of my favorite places in SB and I highly recommend people to check this place out!

I was so excited because I found a clean place that uses the proper cleaning agents and actually scrubs the pedi baths after each client.  They wash their hands and seem cleaner than most of the nail salons.  I found the best technician ever!!! Her name is Ann.  Without her, the salon would have sub par work.  The other technicians do not seem to put pride in their work and they are sloppy with the painting.  The work Ann does is very clean and very durable...lasting up to three weeks without any chipping!  The other technicians, especially Jenny, were awful!  My nails only lasted 3 days when Jenny did them and I paid $70 for it.  I love Ann and will only go to her from now on.  I do like that you can opt to have your own nail supplies kept in a box.  You pay $5 and you can keep germs to yourself!  It's worth it not to get a fungus.
If you happen to get Jenny or Kathy.. RUN!  Don't do it!  They are both horrible and uncaring.  They don't listen to your preferences and they do an awful job.  I am very disappointed in their performance as nail technicians.

That is not where the problem was.  The NAILS chipped due to a poor shellac in the first place!  I don't know why I can't get a good job from anyone but Ann.  
So, I'll be back... but only by appointment with the best tech in the place!

We were so excited to try Russet after reading rave Yelp reviews and hearing fantastic things from a friend. I wish we could say we liked it more. We got there on-time for our reservation and had to wait (outside in the 95 degree weather) for about a half hour. The staff was very apologetic (apparently the previous diners finished and paid but stuck around to enjoy their wine). Shortly after we sat down, we were offered a small plate on the house, which was a nice gesture. The service was OK, but we had to ask several times (and wait over 20 minutes) for ice. Apparently they were out, which seemed a bit odd to me. The food was only OK. It was very inconsistent. We ordered a second small plate, which was very good but quite small (not so good to share). For our entrees, most of us got pastas and one veal entree. My ink pasta with some type of seafood was awful. It had a terrible taste of anise (I hate anise and double-checked to see it was NOT mentioned in the menu). The papardelle with braised meat was good, but severely undersalted. I honestly don't think they put a flake of salt in that dish. The veal was good, but severely oversalted. The meat was cooked well, but it was nothing to write home about. It was also VERY VERY loud. I understand the minimalistic look, but they really need to add something to absorb the sound. Furthermore, it was pretty hot in the restaurant. Overall, we were not happy with our meal and I do not think I'd return.

Solid Restaurant. I would come back again. I had ribs which were delicious my wife had the catfish, and she said it was great. I tried another persons elk sliders and they were very tender which surprised me. Interesting decor that will amuse the kids. Service was good.

I give Dock Street two stars, although we at least pick up a pizza here every month.  Why do we keep coming back?  Sheer desperation.

Dock Street is the best pizza in the area.  Hands down.  It's not cheap, it's not unique, we always get the same thing (the Portabella and Gorgonzola number), and the atmosphere is crummy.  But there's really no place else to get a decent pizza around here.

If you do need a good pizza and are in West Philly, though, we'd recommend getting take-out.  The space is big and looks as if it was originally intended to be industrial, but in a futile attempt to warm it up someone had amateur craft night and spattered their work all over the walls.  The staff is, generally speaking, slow, and working too hard to affect how icily chic they are to serve you with any sensitivity or consideration.  The beer is actually all right, but five bucks for beer brewed on the premises (which costs very little, despite the spiking cost of hops) and served in a tiny glass is just too much to bear.  We hope never to have to eat in the restaurant itself again, although we'll certainly spend our hard-earned money on a palatable pizza, once in a while.  That's the price one pays to live in West Philly, I guess.

Had no idea this place was right across from the beach but I'm so glad it is. Hubby and I came here to escape the sun for a bit to try their beer and wine freezes. Lulu was amazing! She let us try most of the beers upon ordering. My hubby enjoyed the 7 mile bridge IPA and the Belgian Hoppy Amber. I ordered the flight and enjoyed the Apple Cider, IPA, and the Sunset Beach Bikini Ale. The mill stour was okay but it was hot out so it didn't pair well with the weather. The Jalapeño Blueberry stout was also delicious! We also got to try the wine freezes. The wild berry, key lime pie margarita and sangria was delicious! I'm so glad we finally were able to make it out here. Also we can enjoy some beer/wine while at the beach. They also have food which we weren't able to try as we had such had lunch but based on the reviews we will be back! Staff were super friendly! Great big and open space!

We visited Oceana based upon a recommendation from a taxi driver during our stay in New Orleans.  We were warmly welcomed by several staff members and seated immediately in the upstairs dining room.  Our server, Ashleigh, was friendly and knowledgeable.  She answered all of our questions with a smile and made some excellent menu suggestions.  The service was efficient and the food was delicious.  We highly recommend the Chargrilled Oceana Famous Oysters (get a dozen because six won't be enough).  They were so delectable that this will be the first stop on our next visit.

Recommend the butternut squash taco, it's delicious!  I also got the steak and the chicken taco, they were ok.  Portion size of each taco is not large but not too small either.  The pineapple water was very good.  

They are open late which is a plus.  

Only reason I'm giving this place 4 stars and not 5 is I would have preferred tacos with hard shell, but the only option you have is a tortilla.
Best happy hour in the city! Buck a shuck, baby. I'm pretty sure I ate close to two dozen oysters in one sitting the last time I was here. Such a great deal.

Place is okay. I had a burger. Not much to it. Could have eaten the same sandwich at Burger King. Supposed to be a bacon burger, but if it was, most of the bacon was hiding somewhere. I substituted a salad for fries/tots, and the bleu cheese was strange tasting...sweet, so I re-ordered some ranch dressing. Wife had burger with tots. Again, just okay. The service was average. Nothing to boast about. To sum up, overpriced for what you got and mediocre service. Would I return? Probably not. I would search out other options in the area.

Cohen's has more than my appreciation. It has my total respect.

From the minute you walk in, you're family. They chat you up. They trade restaurant suggestions. You want to know where to eat in Philly, forget Yelp. Talk to the Cohens. They won't steer you wrong.

You want to brainstorm how to repair or improve something in your home, they can help.

You need a handyman, they'll hook you up. In fact they've done this for me twice already, with great results.

Hooks, nails, hinges, latches, drain stops, chicken wire ... they supply me with every conceivable random thing I decide I need that day, and there's never a lick of sales pressure. They are nice, they listen, and they go out of their way to save you money. 

If they don't have exactly the thing you want, they'll tell you where you can get it (like today, they told me where I could find quality lumber for one of my little home projects, for cheap, right in the neighborhood a few blocks away.)

Or, they'll order what you want and it will come right away.

I am proud to live in a city with such outstanding local independent businesses, and Cohen's is top of the heap.

SO glad we found this place. So so yummy. Went there early on a Friday evening. Like 2 year old, 4:45 dinner, early. It was perfect. Only one other table had people at it. 

We were greeted when we arrived and promptly sat. The waiter came over and took our drink orders immediately. My husband had a whiskey ginger. It was very good, although I found it a little odd that it was served in a martini glass. My FIL and I stuck with water. The waiter offered to bring milk for my son (which was wonderful because so many places just glaze over kids!).

For an appetizer we had the calamari. It was lightly battered and fried. Holy moly, I am SOOOO happy I have found a place to get fresh calamari. It was probably the most tender calamari I have ever had. We also ordered the parmesan truffle fries, which were also good, but I'm not sure I would splurge on the calories for them again.

Foccacia bread (I think it was foccacia) was also served at the table- it was very yummy. It was warm and tasted like butter/ olive oil melting in my mouth. I'm sure it was horrible for my waistline, but it sure was delicious.

For dinner our table had the Chicken Parmesan, a happy-hour pizza with lamb and ricotta salata, a salad with fried goat cheese, and the kids spaghetti and meatballs. The only thing that wasn't amazing was the spaghetti and meatballs, although my 2 year old sure did enjoy his pasta. We also tried the calamari and truffle parmesan fries. 

The chicken parm was very tender and was a solid man-sized portion.

The salad was also good. The greens were rather bitter, but complemented the sweetness of the goat cheese.

I didn't try the pizza (which was on the happy hour menu), but my father in law really enjoyed it.

Entrees were a la carte, and next time we will make sure to order a side of veggies.

We didn't try dessert, although the kids meals come with ice cream. Add to our bill a Whisper Creek Tennessee Sipping Cream, and the grand total was only $77. Not bad for a great meal, friendly service, two drinks, and meals for 4 people!  We will certainly be going back.

Frankie Gs has always been one of those places when I'm back home I really enjoy nothing super special but usually pretty decent. The last time I went the pasta was very bland and tasteless and the salad which is my one of my favorite salads was bland as well. I got the chicken modega and that was decent. Honestly I am only giving then three stars cause our waitress was great.

Want rude terrible service? Want to be aggressively upsold on everything? Want to wait forever for mediocre food? Want a bartender that mistakes being a b:+@h for having "spunky attitude"? Then by all means come here.

Dr Denny & his staff are the best!  I have been going to them for years now and they have always been very accommodating, very professional and always friendly. I have told many friends about them. Dr Denny is meticulous when looking over my teeth and will tell me if something can wait or needs to be treated right away. Cheri is exceptional!

Very friendly and fast service. Doesn't do more than what needs to get done. (For instance, I just got front brakes and rotors done. Rear brakes almost need to get done but have a little more time. They didn't try to sell me on replacing those sooner than necessarily.) Comparable prices to other places I've been. I also love the location: I have the convenience of dropping off my car and can go to Charcoal for a good meal, wander downtown Yardley or the tow path or hang out at Starbucks for coffee and free WiFi.)
Absolutely fantastic dining experience. Our server. Sieda was the best. Friendly, attentive and professional.

Favorite Italian in the city! I can't believe I haven't reviewed here before. I always receive friendly service and delicious food. The atmosphere is warm and inviting. The Torta appetizer is AMAZING and I adore their Chicken Marsala (I have regular cravings for it). They are very happy to accommodate for different side items, gluten free, allergies, etc. I'm also a big fan of their Tartufo dessert. The crowd tends to be a bit older, but that's part of the charm. You'll need a reservation of the weekends, but you can usually walk right in on weeknights.

This was the worst Chinese food to have ever met my tongue. Their special chow mein was more like special slop mein with rubber shrimp. It was covered in soy sauce goo and soggy veggies that looked and tasted like baby poo. As for the chef special crunchy beef... I think the chefs ever so special ingredient was ketchup. It was super tangy. And the kentucky fried chicken blobs covered in sweet sauce, I mean the sweet and sour chicken, was below edible. Filled with so much sodium and awful taste, it left us with unbearable MSG headaches and the fried food stomache grumbles through the night. But the service and crab ragoons were good. Go here if you want to leave hungry and leave the slimy leftovers behind. I'm sticking to Noodle Cafe or King Doh.
I felt welcomed from the second I checked in! Very supportive, friendly staff-and spacious comfortable rooms. Free wifi was awesome as well! Don't miss out on breakfast, it's delicious!

An unassuming diner that looks like a hidden gem but is actually just a plain ol' so-so diner, albeit with an expansive menu. 

Started off with their signature appetizer, which was a mild pepper stuffed with cheese and wrapped with bacon. I'm sure keto people will love this but it didn't appeal to me at all. Very messy to eat, and the bacon was cheap and less than impressive. The side of soy sauce meant to be applied liberally didn't help much. 

Next was my entree, a green chili chimichanga. There was absolutely no green chili sauce to be found on top or inside, just some peppers cooked into shredded beef for extra flavor. Wasn't bad, but was incredibly bland and not the saucy, spicy dish you would expect it to be anywhere else. It was still more than edible, and I found the rice to be perfect. 

I'm sure I could find something I like better here. There are quite a few taco varieties (and these tacos are crispy and pan fried!), burritos, quesadillas, etc. They have a lot of booze here too and people seem to like the margaritas. I'm not gonna sit here and say El Sur sucks or anything, it's just average and not worth going out of your way for.

Horrible food and operational issues! Ordered the wahoo and it was disgusting.  Had to send it back and it was replaced by a piece of fish that was better , but over all dish was no good.  My wife ordered the duck , which came out raw and had to be sent back.  They brought the duck back so fast that they must have just put it microwave to cook it through.  I am a huge foodie that has had the pleasure of dinning in all the best restaurants that the Tampa Bay Area has to offer.  Unfortunately, we will never be back to Roux ever again.

I'm very glad this restaurant continues to stay open. I have had many great times here, with friends and family. A bottle of plum soju and kimchi fries are all I've ever needed to pass the time and enjoy hours of smiles with the staff. Truly a blessing to have in Little ol Reno
OnSept 8, I came to watch the Dallas Cowboys and have a burger. Unfortunately, they do not have NFL Sunday ticket, so only local channels, no game

I remember when the Enterprise was right on State Street.  Then the city bowed down to CalTrans and they're hidden away behind the bridge with LOUSY signage to lead to their parking lot.
A small chain, so I'd expect some unusual fish.  Nope - same thing you see down at the chains on the pier.  Are those chains?? -- they sure seem like it.  Good service, pretty good atmosphere.  But....so-so preparation.  Seems like a few south of the border guys who -- oh, never mind.  Go on down to the pier.  For $2 more you've got a great view of the water.

We are locals (20 years) and my hubby wanted a good steak on a Friday night so we headed to Stephens even tho we know it is somewhat overpriced.  Service was awful, food was ok, Drinks were watered down.  What a disappointment.  Witnessed another couple leave before ordering due to bad service.  Won't be back.  Shame on Stephens.

Wonderful lunch buffet which offers a great opportunity to sample many different kinds of Indian food without the expense of ordering individual dishes.  The Tandoori chicken is the best!  Their Naan is wonderful and perfectly cooked.  Be sure to save room for the rice pudding for desert... delightful!  I have taken many friends here and it always is a delight.  The entire buffet is low on spices and anyone can enjoy the fare.  Service was wonderful and the staff enjoys talking about the different dishes.  Great experience and reasonably priced for lunch.

LOVE THIS PLACE!  The food is great! I love that they have one in Philly and one in Collingswood.  Being Vegan not all places have options so it was great to see that they had many different options for me.  I love their tofu scramble for brunch. It was delish.  My only complaint is the wait and that they don't take reservations.  I tried to go to brunch with my girlfriends and it was over an hour and a half of a wait so we went elsewhere.  
Still a great spot and we plan on going there soon!

Take my golden doodle puppy here for grooming. It's his first time getting a grooming so he gave the groomer a hard time. They worked on it for 4 hours without complaining anything. Not to mention how cute my puppy look after. Highly recommend!

The most whimsical experience a woman could wish for. Seriously.  If you have the opportunity to have Alisha help you choose the most beautiful dress you will ever put on your body, then you will under how I feel writing this review.  I am a PLUS sized woman. I walked into this salon and felt like the most important person on the planet. I have an exquisite dress. It was's ordered exactly in my size, delivered perfectly on time, & now all that I have to think about is my wedding date.  This shop is a dream come true.  Check it out. You will fall in LOVE.
Great service by Tyron. Food was delicious as always. Sunday morning 9:45 reservation and back in the car by 10:30.
The location is top notch - was enjoyable to sit in the park. Burger was just OK, but others really enjoyed the veggie burger. Waffle fries were good - prices were average.
Excellent service, great & friendly staff. Comfortable atmosphere. Cash only! Reasonable prices, perfect hang out for the afternoon or evening. Highly recommended.

Went with my boyfriend for dinner. We've been wanting to come here since seeing it on Instagram and definitely recommend making a reservation. We had a great experience and the food was wonderful. I was a little put off by one thing. My boyfriend saw it was ladies night on their Instagram and that there was a special menu. We did not unfortunately receive that menu and I had to ask for it. I was rather disappointed by this because I definitely would have tried one of the drinks and apps on that menu. I ordered the lychee old fashioned. It was good but strong so I sipped on it throughout the night. We ordered edamame lightly salted to snack on. It was good, nothing exciting. We decided to order 3 rolls to share. The house roll of the night was tempura shrimp topped with tuna. We also ordered the Crab Maki Sushi Roll and the Citrus Salmon. All rolls were very good but the crab was my favorite. All in all it was a good experience, I just wish someone would have asked if I wanted to see the ladies night menu. I will probably return and try something else.

Pros: Food was great! I had the spicy Italian, and my mom had the grilled cheese. Portions are huge!

Cons: our sandwiches were not made fresh, the gentleman working the counter took them out of the cooler and unwrapped them from the film wrap; I have no idea how long they were in that cooler for. He didn't wash his hands, nor wear gloves before handling our food. We sat at a table beside the window, and there were many dead bugs on the window ledge. The sandwich did not come on a plate, just on a piece of waxed paper on top of the tray...kind of odd.

Overall, I was impressed with the food, but everything else kinda grossed me out. Probably won't return.
This place is filthy. Don't eat here. So sad but the saying that you get what you pay for is so true in this case.

Slowest service.  In line now almost 20 min and still three cars in front of me, it will be over 30 min to get a blizzard.  Please staff better.  Inside isnt even open, thus all efforts are on DT and still beyond excessive.  I only hope they dont close before we get to window

Recently went into place for a drink. There were only 4 people at the time. We sat down and order drinks and food. While waiting we looked at u tube on one phone. The owner who was at the end of the bar send the waiter to tell us to turn it down. First of all it was a news report  and second it appeared loud bc no one was in the bar. . When people did finally arrive it was extremely loud and no one was told to lower their volume. Best to arrive when there is a crowd so you can talk.

Last night, I ordered a pepperoni, sausage and six cheese pizza and an order of garlic parmesan wings. The food was okay for a late night dinner. Sometimes, I forget to eat because of work. My DoorDash driver was a sweetheart, but the food arrived cold. Never will order from here again!
Delicious, generously sized bowls of yum.  I had the açaí bowl, but I think I will live on the edge and get the kale bowl next time.
When shopping I like to browse. But here sales people literally block your path when you go in. What an awful experience. Go to weekend only instead.

This Team is fantastic! I went in there looking to get my very first policy after turning 18 and being able to get off of my parents and they were so helpful with explaining coverage to me as well as the little things that some people can miss they cover everything 100% and they save you as much money as possible with all the discounts they can get we searched around all afternoon before finding them!! Go see Sandra!!!! She was phenomenal!!! Thank you Terelak Team!!!
Seated right away and waited 15 min for someone to greet us or take our drink order. Manager flagged and he made amends. Food awesome as usual. Overall will come back.

The staff was courteous & pleasant.  The car exterior was nice & clean.  However, the car smelled heavily of cigarette smoke which was worsened by the even heavier smell of air freshener.  This is increasing becoming a problem.  I rent from Enterprise monthly and at times weekly from several locations.  Despite the warnings, people continue to smoke in the cars.  This is a major problem for those of us with respiratory conditions.  The car details must include more that an interior wipe & air freshener.

Went here today in the afternoon and was blindsided by the rudeness and disdain we were confronted with. The policy of no separate checks is ridiculous. The waitress was outright rude and then mouthed off about not receiving a tip from the previous two ladies. I would assume it was because of her attitude. I gave in and tipped her because I felt bad. The food itself was adequate but the way we were treated soured the whole experience.

Their food is just okay! With so much competition in New Orleans, it surprises me that there is such a following here. With that said, I have not had their brunch or pizza, which is what they are known for. Maybe if they reduced their menu and fine-tuned some items, it would be better. I have been here several times and waited to be wowed every time. Most of the appetizers are okay... the crabcakes are meh. The highlights - the eggplant fries and chargrilled oysters. I give their oysters 5 stars. Best item on the menu. None of their entrees or sandwiches stick out in my mind. Their drinks can be either really good or just okay. I am interested in their brunch, but I have been let down so many times by the rest of their menu that I'll probably keep going to Atchafalaya for brunch in the city.

I actually look forward to my dental appointments these days! The facility is new and very pleasant. All of the staff are nice and they do a great job at keeping to the schedule and on keeping my teeth shipshape!
I love this place! Great hot dogs, tacos, etc. Drive through is painfully slow, but food is always worth the wait.

Decided to try this place on our last day of being in NOLA, wanted to try something different besides local dishes.  We ordered Mole Enchiladas, Queso Fundido, Taco Sampler and the Quesadilla.  The food was delicious!  Giving them 3 stars because the service was HORRIBLE!! The waitress was very unfriendly and cold.  Took her forever to take our order and once the order was placed we waited 1 1/2 for our food  and when it came out some of the order was incorrect and it was not brought out all at once.  We had to remind the waitress that some of the order was missing. The waitress response to one of the orders being incorrect was "oh the kitchen added onions because they forgot you asked for no onions, you mean you don't want the tacos like that". Any other place would have taken the plate away and replaced with the correct order. Knowing it was Mari Gras weekend they should have been prepared with extra staff.. This establishment automatically adds 20% gratuity to the bill.  I don't mind paying 20%, in this case the service provided did not warrant the 20% gratuity added to the bill.  This place needs to improve on the service they provide to their customers by either hiring extra servers or hiring servers who are more customer oriented.
Delicious dishes, attentive waitresses, cozy environment- I was more than happy about this dining experience.

You may have passed this place without knowing what fun awaited inside! Our first experience with an escape room but so glad we chose Room 5280. The Room Master greeted us as soon as we walked in with welcoming service. He explained the course and assured us what to expect. The whole course was well thought and engaging for everyone!  We took our family and visiting family ranging in ages from 45 to 12.  Everyone left saying it was a great activity and we should come back again and do a different course. We escaped!  Definitely recommended for days when then weather keeps you from the beaches and theme parks!

Very delicious chicken, and the drinks offered are great. Because they just opened this weekend, everything was a bit disorganized which is why I gave it 4 stars. The wait time for the food was a little long, but the taste was definitely there. The potato salad was just okay, but the mac and cheese and coleslaw was delicious. We will definitely be returning, maybe once it slows down a bit.

Meh- Just meh. I only stopped in for Happy Hour not realizing Pucketts was no more. One would hope when a restaurant changes ownership it gets a menu and style makeover for the better. Not so. AT seems like it can't decide if it is still Pucketts, a pub or a dinner destination. The menu seems all the same, and still overpriced, except now the things you loved are gone- like raw oysters, shrimp, wings and onion rings. Appetizers try to be bougee with artesian sauces that leave you wishing they would just stick to the tried and true ones because they're odd pairings. Avocado sauce on crab cakes? Nah. 
Happy hour beers are $2 off, and appetizers 50% off. That's a good thing because who wants to pay $16 for a "tapa" size appetizer?! For a brew house, the tap is really limited, unless you like pale IPAs
The bartender was completely unenthusiastic and grumpy. Didn't bother to mention 1/2 off until I overheard a cocktail waitress tell her customers. Seemed aggravated to have a solo customer. The fun bar is gone, and so is the wine bar, now morphed into one. 
The good news? You can still sit by the river which should be nice in the fall. Not sure if doggies are welcome anymore though. Hoping dinner might be better,, but probably will try somewhere else first.
All I'm gonna say is Bow Wow Bow Wow Dint miss out on this cocktail it's the whole truth

Good bar, good music, fun scene, and a staple of Frenchmans. It is crowded, and I would say the crowd isn't the best, but it gets good bands and again, a great bar to stumble in and out of while enjoying the music and the scene

Three phrases come to mind: quality workmanship, excellent customer service, honest advice.

When my minivan was rear-ended, I was told by my insurance company to go to the local drive-in collision estimating monopoly in Doylestown.  Based on Buckingham Collion's reputation and a previous consultation with him, I called Steve, Jr., instead - who set up a meeting between me, the insurance adjustor, and himself on the site of Buckingham Collision.  The entire process was smooth and nearly effortless - rental car delivered to Buckingham Collision on the day I dropped the car for the work, adjustor brought back to approve additional work, frequent updates by phone.  The end result was even better than we'd anticipated - our vehicle's color and metallic finish is tough to match, but the shop did a superb job.  When a minor problem with the rear hatch mechanism cropped up, it was taken care of promptly, and I was given rides to and from the shop.  

As the other guy's insurance took care of all of the work, and our insurance policies' OEM equipment rider insured that we had genuine Honda parts, I can't really give an opinion about their pricing structure - but their pricing for the quality work that they performed seemed to be comparable to what I have heard from people who have used other independent shops with good reputations.

Two lessons learned - 1. The cheap OEM rider from Nationwide was worth the minor premium upcharge (get it if you have a newer, especially foreign, car - and your company offers it). 2. You do NOT have to go to a drive-through center if you don't want to - insurance companies just tell you to go there because it is easiest and cheapest for them (all I had to do was call the adjustor assigned to my claim at the beginning and request that they give me the number of the person who would actually see the car; and then Steve, Jr., called and did the rest of the arrangements).

Over 50.00 cheaper than Safelight. Able to get me in the day and time I wanted. Tooky car back and got started immediately. Done within the hour. Had to wait 3 hours at safelight the last time I used them. Don't bother wasting your time calling around, I already did that for you. A+ service in my opinion, and believe me I'm opinionated.

This patient first is the worst doctor office ever.  I'm here with my daughter who is really sick.  We went her last week on Wednesday and it is very disorganized on how the staff checks in patients and the staff takes forever to care for the patients and the time it takes.  I don't understand why there is such a long wait. All they have to do is put a few things in the computer and take down insurance info.  Don't come to this patient first or you will be waiting here all day.
Worth a visit. Staff has a little attitude.  Oysters with chili butter and rib appetizers were delicious. Couchon with cabbage was savory without being greasy.

Went in to try the bubble tea and ramen. Both were great! Really good ramen - we ordered chicken, pork (tonkotsu), and shrimp. Good noodles and great broth. The only reason the restaurant gets 4 and not 5 stars is because they were a bit slow to make both the bubble teas and ramen orders, and I was the ONLY person in there in between lunch and dinner time. But I do plan on returning because the food was really good.

A pitstop whenever I have friends visiting especially since it right across my apartment complex.  It can be pricey but the atmosphere is great especially at night.  Definitely one of my favorite bars to hang out, relax and drink.  

Though, if you do drink a bit too much, you might just end up in the water - so stay off the dock side.

Toodles!

If this part of chain, where has it been all my life!!!?

Absolute favorite Pancake place!  And I've been to a bunch - KY, TN, CA, VA, FL, NC, SC, and now Indiana.

You've got to try the Dutch Baby and anything else with the tropical (citrus) syrup!  It is all fantastic.  The Swedish Cakes are like supersized crepes - knock your socks off!

Can't believe people wingeing about this or that or the wallpaper!  

These are not formulaic mass produced pancakes.  These are melt in your mouth earth shaking.  None of the spongy rubber you get at other places.

If you get your pancake urge - this is where you'll beat the cravings.

I had seen this place a while ago here on Yelp, and the great reviews it had. For some reason never ate here, but their new location on Tanque Verde is right down the street from us. My girlfriend and I decided to finally give it a try. I gotta say this place is pretty good. I had the New Mexico sampler (at least I think that's what was called) it had one hard shell taco, a chile relleno, and enchilada with green and red sauce. All of it was good except the chile relleno. The hatch chili was fine, and the cheese, but what I hated was the batter they used to coat it. It reminded me of a corn dog, and I HATE corn dogs (you white people haha JK!!) and some people like that, to each their own. However, the meats, sauces, rice, and beans were good. I will stay away from the chile relleno. Now the service, I give it an "eh." Our waiter was this lady who was a bit loquacious to say the least, and after getting our order she would stop, and talk to several tables on her way out. In all this it was busy, I had asked for a fork and knife that never came. I had to remind her, now I'm not Kim Jong Il, I;m not saying you can't socialize, but it is a job and moderation is good. All in all, I'll come back to this place.
Service is very friendly but also very slow and inattentive. Food is decent bar food but nothing special. The kitchen is terribly slow.  We waited almost 30 minutes to get two salads.
stay away, do not order delivery from here. Food came late, cold, and without flavor. They have zero customer service.

I'm happy to report this place totally exceeded my expectations! My boyfriend and I came here on New Year's Eve and they were offering a $100 per person price fixe menu.  So for $100 it better be good and thankfully it was!
Our first course was scallop ceviche which was delicious.  Very fresh and flavorful! 
Let's talk about this bread. My man and I were hangry when we got here so we wiped out about 3.5 bread baskets, but they were so good! The butter apparently had honey in it which made it sweet and delicious. Perfection. 
For the next course I got oysters. I forget the name of them but they were cooked and had spinach on them. I love oysters and these did not disappoint. They had an interesting flavor and were prepared well. I tried a bite of my man's crab cake which was delicious as well. 
Now for the main event. I ordered lobster tails and they were definitely the best I've ever had. They gave me two huge lobster tails that were cooked perfectly and were just fabulous! They really were the best lobster I've ever tasted. I was too wrapped up in all this deliciousness to remember what my boyfriend got, but I remember him saying it was very good as well. Probably steak. 
For dessert we all received a chocolate cherry torte which was almost too pretty to eat. I was full beyond belief at this point so I only had a bite, but the bite was very enjoyable!
The service and ambiance were both spot on too. I will seize any opportunity to come back here and get my hands on more of that lobster.

The food was super tasty! The ice cream was to die for. The beef kebabs were so tender, but dont ever ask the cook to make em well done, because they may not like that. It was a tad on the expensive side.

My partner and I sat at the bar, which normally means a diminished experience, but this was the opposite. The bartender, Jackie, made this an exceptional and memorable meal from beginning to end. She took our orders in a friendly way, chatting with us the whole time and making us feel like we were at her home. She was the right balance of attentive and helpful. Can't recommend her service enough, she was a highlight, only rivalled by the food. I had the Pancake Flight, which came with bacon. My partner had the Trifecta of Eggs Benedict, which were scrumptious - pulled pork, shrimp and fried chicken sat atop 3 fluffy biscuits. Would definitely return, if only for the staff and guarantee that I'd leave stuffed.

Had a great lunch with friends at Elle-J's.  We had a large group so we tried all of the pizzas. They were all very good but the seafood pizza appeared to be the hit.  We tried most of the appetizers and all were good.  Everyone enjoyed there entrees with the redfish being the most popular.  For not being open that long the service was perfect. Our waiter, Chris, handled our table of 12 with ease.  Will definitely go back!

Wonderful helpful staff . I worked with Anthony and he called me everyday my car was there giving me updates as to what was being done to it. I thought it would have taken a week to fix and I got my car back in two days and it was flawless . I never could even tell it had been in an accident !

Updated review: we have been back multiple times and it has been terrible everytime. We must have lucked out on our first visit. Service is ridiculously slow in the restaraunt and in the bar. I feel as if I'm bothering the staff just by walling in the restaraunt. I overheard one waitress say that 2 tables with 4 cusromers each was too much for her to handle....  As soon as another sports bar opens this place is in serious trouble.
Great place to take a walk and get to know someone. The views are amazing. They have several bars in the area which makes it a lot better.

This is one of my favorite places to visit when I come to NOLA. But,  today,  the service was terrible.  We came in and it wasn't busy.  We were quickly seated right by the server area. Then we were forgotten about. Once again,  it wasn't busy. There were at least 6 empty tables. We sat there for 15 to 20 minutes and were never checked on for drink orders. Did I say that they weren't busy......  Just terrible service.  So,  we left. 

Very big disappointment.

Yeah ! Excited to have a new restaurant in Fishhawk! We started with a fresh salad with ginger dressing -crisp and delicious.  I changed out the onion soup for the dumpling soup -very authentic , 3 large dumplings.  For my entree I had the Filet Mignon & lobster -nice portion.  The Teriyaki sauce was a little heavy , next time I would likely hold the sauce.  It is served with friend rice on the side and Lo Mein noodles.  A different twist on Hibachi but goes well together.  The restaurant is clean , servers are friendly.  The small sushi bar is a great place to watch the chef prepare.  They recently got their liquor license so Beer & Wine will be on the menu this week !

Love the food here. Sure service can be a little hit and mis, but the quality of food and variety of toppings are excellent! Too bad their only Tucson location is at the airport on concourse A (Southwest, etc.) If you are leaving on concourse B, you are permitted to go through security in Concourse A if you want, buy your burger, and go through security on concourse B to get to your gate. If you go with the veggie burger, sometimes the staff does not know it's available because its not on their menu. If you run into any trouble, ask for Don. He's the manager of the concourse restaurants and is very helpful.

Ok this was  my first time to gave someone 5 stars . I had been tried a lot of ice cream shop but the first time when I put ice cream in my mouth and I can not stop say  ..man so yummy .. Believe me , I am so picky ..all my friends told me that...ice cream handmade ...I love it ...I would come back again for sure .

I admit that I went with low expectations based on the street view when I searched the address on Google maps...don't let that deter you though! This was a great spot for both adults and kids. We brought a 10 mo. old baby to the farm and she was thrilled with being greeted by a big capybara! We saw kids of all ages having a great time, and adults as well!  Clean, well cared for animals in a safe environment for children. I was impressed with the knowledge of the staff regarding the animals on the farm as well as their attention to educating the visitors on each species in a way that children and adults could both relate to. Tip: Definitely opt for the 12 buck ticket and see the exotics along with the farm animals (the Capybaras are incredible! Something you really don't want to miss!)
Great brisket with #47 sauce.  We had some pretzel crusted fried cheese curds that were amazing!  The burger was good but the bun needed to be warmed or toasted.

We were taken here by a Filipino friend and food is super authentic.  When we came on Sun morning around 10am  it was pretty busy.  It's in a center and plenty of parking was available.

The food is premade and you pick what you like.  I really enjoyed the fried pork belly and chicken curry.  The skewers were pretty good as well.  They have a lechon sauce that is great compliment to some of the meats.  There is a mini market there if you need certain ingredients.

The prices were reasonable and we would definitely return here again.
Wow! Didn't stop until the job was to his satisfaction. Seriously impressed with this guys skills and methods. Thanks again!!
This place is awesome!! I enjoyed the Trefongo Mar Y Trerra. Awesome meal plenary for two so be ready to share!
Food is always good, but they are always super slow...especially the drive thru. But everybody I've encountered there are always friendly.
Well...I can't say enough about the mac & cheese. It's the best I have ever had. Everything I get from there is great. The corn bread is awesome as well. Ugh!  I want some now!

Mambu is set off of West End Avenue in a small house that can be spotted easily because of the valet stand out front and huge front patio section. As we walked up the ramp into the restaurant, we were both pleasantly surprised at how quaint and quirky it was decorated and our excitement for this new experience began to grow. The décor is one of my favorites in Nashville, right up their with Firefly in Green Hills, and definitely sets the tone for the meal to come.

The Happy Hour specials change but our waiter told us it was $6 Wines and $6 well drinks. I have also seen them run $5 frink specials for Mojitos, Margaritas, and more so maybe call ahead to find out what they are offering that night. I sat this one out on the alcohol front and Cole had a glass of the house Cabernet. Our waiter had our mouths watering while thoroughly explaining the many featured specials and the menu was full of appetizing choices. The menu also features small plates which invokes a Tapas style feel and is perfect for sharing and trying more than one option.

 We started off with the Corn Fritters ($7) that were the perfect combination of spicy and sweet, with an unexpected surprise of black beans and green chiles inside. The fritters came on top of a sweet chili sauce that was great for dipping but not enough if you are sharing and both love the sauce as much as we did. 

 We were in the mood for a steak but with our $50 budget in mind, opted to share the Flat Iron Steak ($21) in a red wine demi glace with sautéed Zucchini on top of hickory-bacon Gruyere macaroni and cheese. The waiter kindly separated the steak into two meals without us having to ask and even with splitting, I wasn't able to eat all of it. The steak was cooked to perfection and the zucchini was grilled with just the right texture to compliment the steak. The star of the show however was no doubt the bacon macaroni and cheese The macaroni and cheese is as good as any I've had but the bacon hints, while not overpowering, are definitely present and catapult this dish to legendary status. It is worth a trip to Mambu just to try a bowl of this heavenly sent concoction.

Love the Thai food here!!! This is my go to stop for Thai in Boise/Meridian area! They have all the traditional stiff as well as some unique fun menu items that will get your tastebuds chatting! Their sushi is just ok in my opinion, but it's a huge sushi  menu and I haven't tried every roll on it. Good atmosphere and attentive staff...give this place a try if you are craving Thai!

Food was amazing , service was Fantastic! Highly recommend!!
We all got something different from fresh fish of the day to scallops to pork chops to chicken . Everything was homemade cooked to order. 
I definitely go back
i have been here twice, both times the service was horrible. rude employees who don't care at all. every time, there has been raw food and undercooked meat. never coming back again.

Just like the other yelper, place is all smoke.  We also asked for non smoking and failed.  We had two rooms.  One with a mini bar half eaten and drink bottles left behind.  The other room the tv and ventilation didn't work.  They ionized the room to rid the smoke smell, FAILED.  I know, it's a caino but I've stayed at others and didn't smell smoke.  We tried to ask Kyle to help since my son was getting sick from the smoke, but Kyle sounded very snotty and condasenting.  It took an additional 4 hours before we can settle in from a long day.  I will give up staying at casinos in Reno and pay more for the Hyatt place or something away.  Hyatt place, their rooms are huge!!!

I love coming here when I'm craving ramen. Great atmosphere, delicious food and servers are always friendly. The menu is simple but everything I've had on there is fantastic. They have a cool patio area too. The only things I don't like are the tables are super close together and it can get very loud, to the point where I can barely hear the person across from me. But those things don't prevent me from eating there. I love it and recommend it to everyone.

I've been going to Mint since my 21'st birthday. Music is always good, drinks are moderately priced. Only flaw I would have to say about this place is how dirty it could get. By the end of the night my nice dress shoes are so sticky on the bottom. My birthday last year, I got into an argument with the bartender, he claims I ordered a drink that was sitting on the bar (ice was completely melted). But yeah, not a bad spot if your looking to get into a lounge with no fee.

Now Spectrum:

They are the absolute WORST! I'd give zero stars if able. 

Today is the second day I've missed work due to a technician not showing up or calling. Yesterday they were to be here between 3-4pm. Nothing. I called every hour up until their closing time (7 pm) and was told everytime that I was an escalated priority, and still, no one showed up or called.

Today was the same song and dance. They tell me they that "I am a valued customer" however, this is NOT how you show it. This along with a skyrocketed cellphone bill because I have to use my phone as a hotspot for work and school. 

I highly recommend finding a different cable/internet provider. This is the most unprofessional provider I've ever dealt with.

Tampa International Airport is good, it's easy to get into and out of.

I'm from California and my local airport is LAX - Los Angeles International Airport which is the poster child of what an airport should not be.  LAX is a horrible airport in all aspects, especially the amenities and food options for travelers.

So, it's always refreshing to see a city do it right when it comes to designing an airport that is organized and accommodating.

I absolutely LOVE the Samurai Platter. Aside from being a great deal, the sushi is fresh and delicious. Also, while probably not authentic, the crab and cream chees filled Volcano roll is a gunky, sloppy but a deliciously guilty pleasure. I felt I needed to go to confession afterwards. :-) The staff is friendly and highly organized.

I was hella scared when I saw a white lady working the cash register, but my fears were allayed when I peeked into the kitchen and saw older viet ladies back there. 

Def didn't expect to eat really great pho in new orleans, but this place is no joke. The dac biet here was truly dac biet, as were the spring rolls. My soup had just the right amount of oil and was not playing around on flavor. The noodles were fresh and the beef was properly cooked. 

I would highly recommend this place to anybody (especially from CA) who appreciates their pho and is looking for a break from cajun/creole/oysters while in nola. 

btw Justin T - you can't hate on this place and give it one star because you forgot to get your credit card back. that's your bad. just like your grammar =P

Very friendly service and a reasonably clean restaurant (I chuckled a bit when I saw the Robin's Donuts sign on the washroom door though). The onion cakes were excellent. My beef pho was average. There was a decent amount of meat and noodles, and it was very hot, but the broth was lacking in flavour. It tasted strongly of anise and not much else. I would not avoid the place but would not go out of my way to come here again.

Service was poor I asked for coffee and water, but only got coffee.  I now realize why my omelet sucked so bad,  They doubled the cheese and forgot the meat.  I felt like I was going to vomit a few times choking down the bland #%$#. The food did look really good.
Overrated soggy burgers and tourist trap. Plenty of better joints in town. Try Farm Burger!

Let me start with I really like the food at beyond bread. What I don't like is their customer service.. Came in today  at 6pm. It was not busy, yet we were not greeted right away. Finally a young lady came in from outside (didn't wash her hands) and took our order. She was not friendly at all. In fact it was like she was annoyed with the fact that she had to take our simple order. Then after finishing with our order she stayed at the counter and cleaned her nails.... I hate to leave this type of review, but it is honest and I have been in several times with bad customer service trying to give them another chance.
Great food. Fajitas were delicious. Black beans are a must. Will come back. The decor is nice too

Service here was so friendly and the food was so fresh and amazing. The mini is a decent size and the giant was, well, giant. Parking is scarce (street parking) but I would definitely give this place a try!

This place is amazing! The flavor combinations will blow your mind. It is so hard to pick one dish when coming here. The decoration in this restaurant is so fun and colorful, it makes me feel happy! The service is efficient and the servers are knowledgeable about the menu which is very helpful if unfamiliar with a dish or words. Everything is so good and the portions are large. We had enough left over for another full meal the next day. The restaurant has great parking out back. Try out this place the next time you are in the area!
This is one of my top 5 places to eat. Easy light fare with great options and easy on the stomach food. I love the drinks and everything about the restaurant.
If you are looking for greasy comfort food, this is the place to be.  It's even better after a drink or two; however I did enjoy my French dip and fries sober with some gambling.
Very nice hotel. It's so close to the main road bit very quiet. Beds are comfy and place is immaculate. Aqua bar is cool to.
very fun and a lot of selections to choose from.  a must go when visiting philly!

The place provided a good atmosphere for a chain restaurant. The attendants at the bar were very friendly and service was quick. The house wine was good and the wings a'la Tennessee BBQ were good. A major plus that it's co-located with the Crown Plaza. You could tell locals were at the bar which says alot. I got "stuck" at this hotel because I am a Hilton guy but I will make an exception in the future.
Great find! Very flavorful and fresh Mexican food with friendly service. Love the vegan options! The picnic tables in the back are nice. Best Mexican in Indy.
