I know that Riverwest generally gets good reviews, but I've been here for less than 2 months and can't wait to leave. It may be the case that I was spoiled in 2601 Parkway, but I'm of the mind that people should do their jobs and buildings should be managed by intelligent humans.

Where to start. For one, the elevators are horrible. Add at least 5 minutes to any travel time. Recently 3 out of the 4 elevators were broken and this was seriously unpleasant. I've also heard stories of people getting stuck, and I've experienced dogs peeing in them.

The hallways are pretty much not taken care of and are all dirty as hell. I've been tempted to go clean the walls and carpet.

I could deal with all of this if the staff were at all functioning. But they aren't. I have never had any of my questions answered, and I'm usually yelled at. Recently I've been having issues with my apartment, stemming from the contractor that the building recommended I use. The building maintenance was not "equipped" to help (ie. hang up a curtain rod) and so I had to hire someone else. I've learned through this situation that the manager of the building is pretty much unattainable and it took me a call to the management company to actually get him on the phone. You normally have to leave him a voicemail and hope that he calls you back. When I finally talked to him I asked if he could recommend another contractor since both the original one is MIA and the building maintenance is not "equipped" to do maintenance. He told me he had a card somewhere but that he's really busy with classes and probably won't have time to look. Right. Thanks. I proceeded to call the manager at my old building who was able to give me an organized document of people they recommend...contractors, plumbers, electricians, etc. etc. Glad they had time to help despite the fact that I DON'T EVEN LIVE THERE. I also find this funny, because they are managed by the same umbrella company. How Riverwest has gone so terribly wrong is beyond me.

At least the location and price are great, or else I'd be a VERY unhappy camper. My apartment has also been very nicely redone by my landlord. Wish the rest of the buildings management was up to par.

I will NEVER bring my car to this location again. 

I brought my Scion to this location to have my takata airbag replaced. The service was lacking. I stood around their install bay while people presumably finished something on their computer before even saying hello or addressing me in any way. I'd say after 15 minutes of feeling invisible, someone finished up and asked what I needed. I told them of my appointment and everything went fine from there. 

When I got the car back, it looked good on the outside - no scratches or dings or anything. But on the inside, what I found was frustrating beyond belief. I had a small pot of flowers in a cup holder (to the left of the steering wheel). That pot of flowers appeared to have been thrown in the back seat. There was soil everywhere and killed the flowers. Mind you, the work they were doing was on the passenger airbag - not the drivers side. 

Also, I have a dash cam installed that records audio and video. The cord to the dash cam was not only unplugged, but ripped out of the areas it was installed in. The cord was found on the floor of my vehicle.  I don't know why it was so important to rip out and completely uninstall my dash cam. So I had to personally reinstall all of it. 

They get two stars because they did do the service for free (because the takata airbag was a recall), and I can only assume they DID in fact replace the airbag. But again, I will never bring my car here again. If you value belongings in your car, you might want to reconsider bringing your car here, too.
Food is consistently on point. Highly recommend the Lambogini sliders and Some "Brie" Sauce.
Had my first hibachi here last night. It was very good. Stylish and seemingly fresh place. Quick service and pretty reasonable. Sushi guys looked pretty good and know what they are doing.

Kitchen is now open. Finally got around to trying it out yesterday. I'll probably be working my way through the menu options over the next few weeks, but so far I've enjoyed everything that I've tried.

We went to Yeoman's for Father's Day, as my husband has wanted to try it for some time after hearing good things from friends.  We walked in and were immediately seated in bar area, which unfortunately was very loud and had several young men sitting at bar, cursing.
The server was very nice and allowed us to move to the back room, where it was much quieter (and no cursing).
The decor was nice and the music was awesome.
The food was great, from the pretzel appetizer to all of our entrees.  I couldn't give it 5 stars because when my son unwrapped his silverware from the napkin, both knives had food stuck in them. I know things like this can happen, but it was quite disgusting.
Overall a good place to go for food and drinks.  My husband had a great end to his Father's Day.

I'm being generous about this review because I respect the buildings history. In fact it was the amazing history that led us to this historic site. The rating I offer is for the tour. It was a huge waste of money, even at just $8 a ticket, still not worth it. We were only allowed to tour the bottom floor and the tour highlighted a lot of topics, but not much about the history of the building. I would love to tour all of the building and learn about its beautiful history, but we were in and out in 15 mins. Totally disappointed.

I do not recommend this place at all. Invested with cockroaches and spiders. I have to stop and wait to look around before I enter the kitchen and the wash room. It's an awful way to live. And the spiders are real little and all along the top of the walls. Awful, awful. Be very cautious moving in here.

If you are looking for a chic restaurant that serves great food/drinks, provides entertainment and has a great atmosphere then look no further. This was my first time at this restaurant, and I can't wait to go back. From the moment you walk in you are welcomed by a friendly staff, swanky decor, and the sound of live music in the lounge.

Even though I didn't have a full meal, only appetizers (colossal shrimp cocktail and jumbo crab cake with sweet corn cream sauce). I was completely satisfied with the presentation, portion, and the taste . One of my friends ordered the black truffle mac n and the other ordered the chilean sea bass. I was able to try a smidgen of each, and they were both excellent. On top of having great food, they serve great drinks as well. I  cannot wait for my next Tampa visit just so I'm able to dine here again!

Workers were friendly however the lady who helped me told me the incorrect info. She said "Pick whichever car you see, the key is inside". I paused and asked "Any of these?". She replied "Yeah. Any. We are trying to get rid of them". 

Of the choices were a Camaro, 328i or Q50. Obviously I walked toward the luxury car only to find that the key wasn't in the vehicle. I walked back inside and inquired about the key. I was told by another worker that it would be an upgrade because it was a luxury. Grr..National needs to make sure not to mislead us.

Worst delivery food Iv ever had. Wings tasted like rubber, no flavor, over cooked chicken parm,  fries undercooked, didn't add the extra cheese I added, delivery guy didn't ever have change. Never again

Was so excited to see this new restaurant in our backyard!
The first 4-5 times the Rib Eye was FANTASTIC!  The last couple times it was poor.
I emailed the Manager/Owner and within 1/2 hour he was on the phone to 
personally apologize and offered to make it right the next time I visit.
That is what I call GREAT Customer Service!  Everyone deserves a 2nd chance!
I'll be back Emil.

The people that work here are complete idiots and treat you like absolute crap. After going for 3 interviews they found me a couple jobs, I was looking for permanent, not temporary. But most of the jobs they found were just awful, nothing like the jobs they post on EdmontonJobShop.ca. 

What ever you do, do NOT go to randstad to find a job, I just kept sending in applications to jobs that I was interested in and found an amazing Administrative Assistant role in a huge firm. All by myself. No help from randstad.

It's funny because the guy that had "interviewed" me at randstad came into our office to speak with our manager about using them as a hiring service and he recognized me and was so surprised to see that I had found my own job! What a jerk! So I made sure to tell my manager how terrible they are and she was really glad that I let her know. I'm glad to say that we won't be needing their services.

on 05/28 I came to this Auto center to get brakes, a alignment and new tires on my car. I came to this center after calling two other auto centers in Torrance, and carson gave me bad service on the phone. When I called This one I spoke with Carlos. He was extremely knowledgeable and was able to answer all off my questions. I came in as a walk in at 11:30am and to my delight my car was done 2:00pm instead of 3:00 like he had advised me. My car now drives even better than when I purchased it. I am very happy with the service I got from this location. It is definitely worth the drive 20 miles from home instead of going to the one 2 miles from it.

I will update this later to give a true rating and why I feel it deserves at a minimum of the stars received! Off the top phenomenal service, killer attention to detail for what service is chosen! Today was the Super Wash, and not a bug left from getting back home from California! Simply the best car wash in Reno, and I've tried em' all! Thanks for treating me and my cars the right way! It just keeps getting better each time ever sense ownership changed!
Been here twice all I can say is WOW. Crabs WOW!!!!

Came here after being turned away at Club Congress. The place was packed when we arrived, but the crowd was friendly and there was a decidedly low-key vibe to the place. The beer selection was run of the mill, but I can overlook that for tasty fries and a cozy outdoor patio. I had to laugh at the graffiti in the bathroom, the TV turned to Larry King (?), the middle aged man who's known to break into a jig when he's three sheets to the wind, and the wildlife biologist from California who discussed his plan to put a saddle and sombrero on his yellow lab. I have no idea what we were talking about. Clearly, a good time was had by all.
I love this place.  Everything we had was excellent.  Fried catfish platter was amazing, Cajun jambalaya was terrific.  Can't wait to come back.

Took a coupon to this location on my way to work at 6am to BOGO and the manager who says her name was MCKAYLA,refused to honor,although the store is 1 of 8 that the Kaplan Family owns.I asked this manager for Mr. Kaplan's business card and she refused.I then went to another store that is also owned by the Kaplan Family,and they not only accepted the coupon,but apologized to me and stated that the previous manager was totally wrong.
This manager should be fired.Not suspended but fired,because she showed no professional skills at all.

Service is AMAZING! Staff was friendly and profesional!  Nice clean car! My kids were super happy w/free lollipops! I got Free dash wipe! Air Freshener! And a $5 dollars discount for next visit!! Coming back !

It does my heart good to add this update!

I was so disppaointed by past shopping experiences at Lush on Walnut and often went elsewhere (KoP, AC, wherever) that I avoided it.

Then I saw that it closed.  At first, I felt sad but then figured that maybe it needed to as the service was so previously annoying.  I was actually relieved to see the opened up the street.

Folks, Lush Spa is what Lush should be.  The staff is helpful but there is no hard sell. As expected, they know the products well and can make suggestions if needed (which I did this time). 
Overall, they staff all work together to make sure things are happening.  I was buying a Christmas gift for a friend, and the associate who was helping me was scheduled to go on break.  Rather than leave me adrift, he got another associate to be my point of contact while he went on break.  Very nice, and in this case, it was also necessary.  So you know, they can open any gift box and you can add products to it if you want.  Then they will retie it and no one if the wiser.

I want to give a shout out to Matt who is simply lovely and even gave me tour of the spa as it wasn't in use. In fact, he recognized me the next time I went in. He was also the associate who was helping me and then made sure I was still taken care of. Matt, you're lovely!  

The product range is changing all the time and I now enjoy going in just to see what's new.  

Finally!  Beautiful products and beautiful service!

We were visiting Franklin and read the Yelp reviews.  The amazing reviews set high expectations.  I may have enjoyed Ground more if I hadn't read all of the great reviews as the reviews set my bar high.

Upon entering, we were confused and underwhelmed by the setting.  We weren't sure where to order.  Thankfully, we were the only customers.  The guys at the grill walked us through the process.  We ordered one of the signature burgers, 2 design-your-own burgers, and a kids' meal.  While paying, the system automatically asks for a tip.  We were surprised when they called a number for you to return to the counter to pick up your own food.  Given the request for a standard 15-20% tip, we assumed there would be some level of a server.

I had a design-your-own burger with pepperjack cheese, avocado, and bacon.  It was good.  The fries were the highlight of the meal.  My son stole many of my fries.  He's not normally a fry eater; therefore, they must have been unique for him to enjoy them.

The kid's meal included 2 small chicken tenders and a few apple slices.  It was fine, but definitely meant for younger children.  Note - Kids' meals are free on Saturdays with the purchase of each adult meal greater than $10.

Visiting the area for the weekend. We were looking for a local non- chain restaurant for lunch 
We found a Growler USA on yelp and decided to give it a try. 
The Brewban (Reuben ) was great.  Thin sliced pastrami, cheese and kraut on a marbled rye, nicely toasted.  You have a choice of curly fries or tater tots. I chose the tots. Crispy outside with soft centers, just as tots should be. 
Service was great starting with a friendly welcome. Several pages of craft beers were available however, we did not try them. 
Highly recommend you try this restaurant when in the area.

We decided to give this a try tonight.. We were seated right away by very nice and attentive staff.  We ordered the chicken and rice as well as a Cuban sandwich. Everything was excellent, the best chicken and rice I've ever had! Although the place is small, the food made up for the atmosphere!

Cheesecake need to close there doors when they suppose to because if we gonna be let in just for you to make the order you should be rush to order wether you take and hour or not just say your closed yall close at 12:30 if i dont order till 1:15 you shouldnt get upset just tell customers you are closed pls thx
Excuse me, but you are out of tea. Okay we'll get you some later. Still no tea. Is there a chance I can get tea. I paid for it and you are out. Sorry we are busy. There were 17 empty tables.
Food is just OK, but the service is wonderful. Unique environment and outstanding personable staff pump the stars to 4. Try it!
Received the worst mani / pedi ever! Stay away. Also brought two nail polishes that cover horribly- maybe organic- still terrible.

Great sushi in this area isn't all that common, oddly enough. Sun sushi however DID NOT DISAPPOINT!! From the miso to the quick and generous service, this place is great. Will definitely be coming back for more. Recommend the state street roll and the salmon delight roll.
Great market overall. The German deli, the Cajun restaurant, the Amish restaurant are especially great. Also, the sushi bar, produce market and cheese counters make the trip worthwhile, too.

Okay, Thrift City U.S.A. is definitely on the grubby and dusty side (take your allergy meds if you've got 'em!), but I still have to give them four stars due to their selection. It's always a great place to go for reasonably priced clothing with a very large stock available, so plan to spend some time there.  

Every time I go, I find multiple items of interest, whether it's a vintage magazine, funky top or picture frame.   They have a decent book collection that rapidly changes due to high turnover, and the books will sometimes include accidental extras such as photos or old scraps of paper - all part of the quirky charm.  Artists and crafters will enjoy rummaging around here, as there are always interesting bits and pieces that are suitable for a variety of projects:  Beads! Yarn! Patterns! Gears! Wires! Wood Boxes!  Action figures! Canvas! Costumes! Whatchamacallits!They always seem to have a great variety of general randomness and even the occasional WTF item.  

Two thumbs up

Everything was amazing. From drinks to lunch and dessert to the ambience. My boyfriend and I went a few days ago and we loved everything about the place. I had the best pomegranate martini ever. (Hurt my bartender boyfriend's feelings a little ) The crave roll was heaven in my mouth. The crispy chicken sandwich was great. Our bartender was amazing.. he did get my hopes with with their s'mores dessert-- but they ran out  but I had to let it slide because the chocolate mousse cake was out of this world.  honestly. Best dining experience I've had in a very long time.

I very much like this restaurant! Korean, Chinese hybrid. MANY different dishes to choose from! I really like their steamed dumplings and their beef bulgogi. If one goes for lunch, the wait is nice and short. There are several other dishes I've tried as well that I really like. Garlic beef being one of them

A typical BWW experience, but I was pleasantly surprise to find such a large location in the heart of Ybor.  I met up with some friends to watch one of the final four games and it seems a lot of people in Tampa chose this spot as it was packed.  Luckily we were able to manage a table right in the middle of the restaurant with plenty of TVs around to catch the game.

The first drink I ordered (single tall Kettle One and Tonic) came out in a tiny glass of straight Vodka.  The manager quickly noticed the issue and came back with the perfect drink.  I tried the dry rub on my boneless wings and it ended up being a good combination of spice and flavor.  Good spot to catch any game if you're in the Ybor area.
Awesome musicians, great service and cool laid back setting to enjoy music. Definitely a must in Nashville.

I want to preface this review stating that I have not worked out at this location before, nor did I today. 
I came to this location to cancel my membership as I have moved from another state. My home location gave me some incorrect information, so when I went into this location to cancel, you can understand my frustration with the new knowledge that I could not cancel here, that I would have to get in touch with my home state's location to do so. Andrew, the manager of this location was incredibly helpful in helping me achieve the best way possible for handling the situation and getting my membership cancelled. He went above and beyond without breaking the rules which was completely appreciated. I am confident should I have had any issues with this location, Andrew would be there to help fix it in the best way possible!

This was the actual worst. This was the first time in 5 years I have ever seen my boyfriend send food back . Ordered the burger medium and it came BURNT. Like to death. My Seven-year-old ordered a salad and when they set it down he looked at me and said mom there's only three little pieces of chicken and here it was so bad a seven-year-old knew it was unacceptable they had Krispy Kreme donuts bread pudding when they brought it out it was completely dry no sauce you could see were the donuts had not even been soaked completely it was actually the worst restaurant experience I have had in years the server was nice enough but A good server doesn't make good food they added 18% gratuity to my party of three and I didn't notice until I left so the lady essentially gotDouble tipped which I feel like it's very shady business will definitely not be going back to this one or any others
Amazing food the lamb was seasoned well and juicy. A lot of good beers on tap and fresh cocktails. And the best bouncer ever "Kash"!

The pretzels are very good. As someone mentioned to their disappointment, they are somewhat of a hybrid cross between pretzel and breadstick...AND that's what makes me love them. The brat pretzel is amazing. But don't expect them to be on hand before 10:00. Good prices too! We will be back!
Last week we tried this place. It is just like other burrito place with the exception of some Indian flavours and spices.

I would like to share an experience I had here last night. I have always enjoyed taking my family here. The service has been great and the food even better. Yet last night taking my children and wife out was a very different experience where I decided I will not be dining here any longer. We were greeted and our order was taken. The lady was friendly and helpful. As for the men in the back I would be ashamed as an owner to have someone like the men in the back working for me. They were rude and disrespectful to the lady in the front. Children and families were around and he was making a scene. At one point I got up to make sure everything was okay since the man in the back kept coming up front and saying things to the lady. The lady was clearly embarrassed and kept apologizing to everyone. Another lady had came into the restaurant to help out and the argument in the back with the men still happened. I love the food and the experience most of the time except last night. No women should ever be treated in a manor where they are made to cry and apologizing for someone else behavior. If I was the owner I would have a good long talk with the men. If you would also like I can let everyone know what was going on. I recorded it.

This is my third time going but after today's visit im not going back. With my gel mani / gel pedi I was given poorly done service. With my pedi I wasn't given the proper treatment. With my mani she rushed it and didn't get what I actually wanted. They also charged me an additional $20 due to me wanting a french tip style. I got the basic pedi which was $27 and when I went to check out, the total came to $77.. does t make sense why they'd charge me 50 for my manicure? She didn't even advise me of the extra charge with how the other workers usually do.

If you live in the area, there is no reason to drive to Philly unless you want your dim sum fix. They have EVERYTHING here and its pretty good.

The Peking Duck + Duck bone soup combo is great. The skin could be a bit crispy but you only have to ask to make that happen. The house special wonton soup is made in house and has a very delicate skin wrapped around some decent sized shrimp. The pea shoot tips (or any greens) in the shrimp paste sauce is awesome...just ask them whats good and go with it.

The also have an American chinese menu, which I am sure is pretty decent, though I didn't get a chance to check that out. They have way too many other options on the vietnamese/chinese menu.

Pros: Duck Bone Soup and Peking Duck, greens in shrimp paste

Cons: NO dim sum

I decided to try FLöK out because I appreciated how they offered a free consultation. I have a hard time figuring out exactly what I want, but Kenny went above and beyond to learn about my lifestyle and goals to help me decide what my perfect hair would be. It took me a while to find the perfect color, but Kenny worked with me until it turned out exactly how I wanted! The all-over color, balayage, and cut that I got turned out beyond beautiful.

The whole atmosphere was so relaxing and high-end, too. I was able to enjoy a mimosa and some chocolate​ while I got my hair colored, but they offered quite a few refreshment options. At the color bar,​ the other stylists got to offer some input​ and this really made me feel confident that I would love the end result. The products they use are incredible, as well. My hair is softer than it's been in years. Overall I couldn't be happier with my experience, and I can't wait to go back!

For context: I have a lot of fine hair that was a mix of color-treated and virgin hair, and I'm in my mid-20s.

Great place for groups, for great pizza, and lots of items on the menu.  They have several vegetarian options.

4/5 for the price.  Each slice is upwards of $8, but they are pretty big slices.

I have had the Vegetarian slice and The Presto slice. Both solid!

Bring cash. Tips are expected and can not be put on a credit card.  Excellent soul food and great selection of items not found in your typical restaurant such as Oxtail and Pork neck. Not brave enough to try any of those I opted for the meatloaf which was very flavorful and delicious.

This is not the tourist destination it's made out to be. Being in Grand Center there are many other options with  less of a cafeteria feel. If you are from out of town, try Pappy's or some of the others true destinations.

Heard the food was good, note the word HEARD. Got there, ordered the Okra w/ Fufu, was told it would take 15 mins. 45 mins later still had not received my food. Constantly asked when the food would come out, kept getting the response "food is on the way." Eventually walked out after waiting an hour for food that was originally supposed to take 15 mins. It makes it hard trying to support Black/African owned restaurants that don't value customer service or serving food in a timely fashion. Would not recommend, nor would I return to this place. The location was ridden with drug dealing hoodlums, not to mention the parking was terrible. At no point in time did I feel safe sitting in this establishment. DO NOT COME HERE!

You can't really go wrong with all you can eat sushi. The service was quick and nice. The sushi was good and there was quite a bit to choose from. The green tea ice cream was also good. I will definitely return.

Enjoyed our meal at Valentino's.  Greeted professionally ,  waitstaff on point.  Ole school decor.  Bib salad delicious.  Osso Bucco was really good and quite filling.  Went upstairs to enjoy Johnny on the piano. A treat !!!!
I'm so excited about this place opening up! Versatile menu with yummy drinks, sandwiches, and bakery items. It's in a great location with a nice sunny atmosphere. Definitely check it out!

This is my family's go-to spot. The food is really delicious. Service can be a bit slow - this place is always packed and servers always seem to have a lot of tables. Love the warm rolls that come out at the beginning of the meal. We always need a few refills. The bruschetta is a must-get. I also really enjoy the roasted artichoke antipasti with mozzarella and prosciutto.

My go-to entree is always the gnocchi and I usually get a blush sauce. Portions are BIG and food is really quality. Since the menu is so big, i suggest picking two entrees and splitting with someone so you can try more. My dad and I did that last time - he got the chicken parm which was also amazing. Their specials are always worth hearing- there's always a good seafood choice. Great dessert selection as well - I always go for the classic cannoli!

One of the few, if not only, sit-down dessert placed in Chinatown! This place is always popping, so expect a wait, but turnover is quick; we've never had to wait more than 10 minutes. Cute, clean, but slightly disorganized/inefficient service. Also, they frequently run out of items by night time, so come early! 

They have a mix of Asian/Hong Kong style desserts, along with plain ice cream options for those not interested. Of course, as with the name, anything with Mango here is quite delicious. Tip: their shaved ice is huge (much larger than pictured on the menu!), and can feed about 4 people.

Martin and his staff were super friendly. He works pretty quick; was able to change out all 4 tires, add new valve stem, balance, and reinstall in probably an hour and 15 minutes. I had the tires sent to him from tire rack and he met me with his mobile setup at my apartment. It was definitely worth the money and I'd call him again for tires. Would recommend.
Kudos to the new owners. It's not complete but it looks damn good. So good in fact I booked one of the new suites for my 50th Birthday party.
Really nice people with a great layout, tons of TVs and a cheap/wide beer selection. Will stop by again.

This is one of my two favorite coffee shops in the city (the other is World Cafe, for different reasons). Park Avenue is a great little spot, and suits Lafayette Square very well. It is comfortable for everyone ranging from neighborhood residents to college students. I'm amazed at how much useful space they squeeze out of their storefront space, including the best outdoor coffee seating in town! The drink quality matches any place in town, and the baristas are always both friendly and skilled. Finally, I have to give "props" for the gooey butter cake - Park Avenue has been an inspiration to me as I continue to experiment with my own flavors!

Third time is NOT a charm.  Went to the new LD last night (against my better judgement) and it was a terrible culinary experience.  The bartenders are so nice but the food is totally overpriced and the servings are tiny.  I ordered an arugula salad ($8) and added blackened shrimp ($8) with balsamic on the side.  What I got was a side salad with 4 shrimp and lemon vinaigrette.  In all fairness they eventually fixed the order BUT we still paid $16 for the dish and I left starving.  My husband ordered a fried chix sammy and said it was very tasty.  His side was 4 pieces of lettuce with ranch.  Come on LD!  Step up your game!  I REALLY want to love you again!
Second time here and it was even better than the first. The pesto is fantastic, and the crispy duck was succulent and flavorful.

So this is my first time back here in 30+ years and wow have things changed. So much to do and enjoy. Rides, arcades, safaris, lots of food options and shops. Surprised at the prices being lower than most amusement type parks. Food fairly reasonable and not charged $4 for bottled water. Lockers everywhere to access as needed and certainly before going on some rides where you cannot have anything that you carry. Lockers only 50 cents which is really cheap for some sense of security. 

Parking was $17 which I thought was kind of steep.

I found this park to have many more attendants around always asking if you need  help or directions. Guides placed strategically throughout the park with microphones giving directions. Makes it easy when you are looking for directions. Live music and dancing engaging the audience so people feel part of the shows. 

The one big drawback is the signage. If there is any suggestion for improvement would be better signs and directions. We walked past the same kiosks 3 times trying to find the exit. No exit signs in the park till you get closer to it. Well darn it I needed to know a lot sooner than that as it was starting to rain heavy and frustration was setting in. Small thing with all the good things but definitely an easy improvement to make life easier for the customer.

Definitely will be back as we just couldn't see and do everything we wanted.

Buy weekday tickets online as much cheaper and just print them off so no lines to stand in. Need 24-48 hours so tickets can be sent via email. I decided to call for the deal and got them sent within 1 hour so best way to get them if you leave it to the last minute.

Zales quality work (commercial and boring) at ridiculous prices.
There's nothing interesting or creative about this jewelry. So many similar things can be found at discount mall stores, I don't know why anyone would buy from this guy, especially when you add on his snooty attitude.

NO THANKS!

The place was absolutely filthy! The outside the trash reeked so badly you can smell it from the entrance. When inside, the kitchen had smoked out the store. The floor was littered with dried up food. The place hadn't been cleaned for a while and no one seem to care. A Wawa, any Wawa, offer similar products and is ten cleaner that this royal farm.

Frustrated today with pharmacy. Dropped off prescription yesterday and they were going to text me when ready for pick up which is a nice service. Never got a text and went to bed. Stopped by this morning and was told they had no prescription ready for me. After some research the clerk found a note in the computer that said my insurance would not cover the drug. Ok so why wouldn't they call me and let me know so I could make a decision to pay myself or call my physician and get it changed before the office closed for the weekend.

Clerk was very helpful though and said same drug now over the counter. I am a nurse so asked to check the prescription myself and compared to OTC product. I checked and same ingredients and same dosage. Prescription would have been $295.00 for 30 pills and OTC was $24.99 for 42 pills... Ugh! Obviously I chose the prescription ... NOT! 

The clerk should get 5 stars but CVS this time only 3 and that is basically for hiring a great clerk with good customer service!

My two star rating is a gift because the service was good and the opera singer gave dinner a nice ambience. Villagio is an old school type of Italian restaurant with an older clientele.My wife and I started out with the house red that was fine and then we  ordered the bruschetta with mozzarella appetizer.This bruschetta was tasteless with barely any garlic no basil or balsamic basically diced tomatoes. The baguette was stale and hard which bad bread at an Italian restaurant is sacrilege.The garlic knots where definitely better than the baguettes. The salad was decent if iceberg lettuce and mealy tomatoes is your thing.All this rave about the dressing has gone to their head because they barely give you enough of it to do anything so I had to add the oil and vinegar that was on the table.My wife ordered the eggplant parmisian which was decent nothing special. I ordered the seafood fettuccini in the white sauce that was supposed to have scallops mussels  clams and shrimp and grouper but only had one bay scallop in it three shrimp half a dozen clams and half a dozen mussels all overcooked and mushy fish. I didn't think the pasta was anything special either for a family Italian restaurant I would expect better. I wish my experience was as good as all of these other reviewers but it wasn't.

I love the posole here. It's one of the best I have ever had. It's very spicy so be careful but I prefer it that way. It's only available on the weekends so that's when I come in.

The customer service here is bad. No one is ever friendly and it takes a long to be served even if no one else is there.

I've had the posole, breakfast burritos, tacos and hot dogs. I would recommend the posole and breakfast burros but that's it. The hot dogs weren't really sonoran style and that's the only way I like it. 

Overall this place isn't great but it works for a lazy day when I don't feel like cooking.
Super cute little spot and the owner is incredibly nice and clearly puts a lot of love into her desserts. Strongly recommend the Nutella berry cake jar.

Derfs is in a great location on the corner of mission and de la vina, which is literally the only good thing about this place. My boyfriend and I went there to watch a game and have some food and drinks. The menu looked great and so many choices, when we got our food it was so plain and unappetizing. We barely ate any of it! Along with that the waitress had an attitude the entire time and never came to check on us. I wouldn't go here, save yourself and go somewhere else!
Excellent Band, Superior Service and  a Great Group of Fun and friendly Meet up Group

Showed up for my 6:30 reservation on time and had to squeeze through the maze of tables to get to ours.  Waiter finally came to our table about 10 after 7 and the experience went down hill from there.  Everything was weird and gross.  The chorizo flatbread is some Pillsbury pizza dough from a can with a few pieces of chorizo on it.  The root beer ribs, recommended by the waiter, where half hot, half cold, and fully disgusting.  We ordered tomato basil ravioli, but they gave us lobster ravioli instead.  It was ok, but not great.  To get out you literally had to push other seated customers out of the way because so many tables are in this tiny space.  Won't be back.

Verdict: Check it out!

Atmosphere / decor - 4
Service - 3.5
Food - NA
Location - 3.5
Value - 4

Overall 4

I came here to meet up with my friends on a weeknight. It's a really cute spot, not a big place but a cozy feel. The place was pretty full. I know this is a popular study spot! They have water sitting in the back that you can grab yourself. 

They have a small snack menu as well as a decent sized drink menu. I was impressed with all of the options (beer, wine, soda, kombucha, etc.). I opted for a kombucha, which they have on tap and in a bottle (different flavors). 

Overall I like this place and think it's a unique place to hang out, study, or catch up with friends.

DO NOT GO HERE FOR WAXING.  I had been a regular customer for almost 2 years, but in the last few visits, I have been burned every visit.  Additionally, the woman who does the waxing will just start waxing parts of your face without asking.  Overall, it is clean and the employees are friendly, but there are much better places to get waxing done in the area.

The first thing I noticed here is that it is clean. So many bars are not!  The bartender, Michael, was welcoming, as were the other clients. I like the lounge feel of the place. 

Comparing it to the only other gay bar we have visited in Reno, this is by far the best.
Great service, great environment and delicious beers.  We came in after a soccer game and really enjoyed ourselves! Can't wait to come back.

I finally had the chance to dine at Hyde Park Village's newest restaurant, Goody Goody Burgers. I invited my fellow Yelper, Steve E., to join me for lunch.

After reading multiple reviews that mentioned the long wait I downloaded the "No Wait" app and we decided to meet at 11:30 am to beat the lunch rush. I checked the app multiple times prior to our visit so that I could reserve a table and each time I checked the app it said "no wait, come on in". Unfortunately, this meant that there was no wait for a table OUTSIDE. There was a 30-40 minute wait for a table inside. Since my lunch break is only an hour we decided to eat outside, overlooking the construction on Swann Avenue. Luckily, the weather was nice, but I would have preferred a table inside since there is no atmosphere in the outdoor seating area.

Goody Goody's menu consists of your typical, all-American diner dishes including breakfast served all day, club sandwiches, meatloaf, and of course: pie! Steve and I decided to order the signature POX burgers with cheese. For our sides I ordered the coleslaw and he ordered the side salad. 

My first impression when our burgers arrived was that the burgers looked small and I should have ordered a second patty. I couldn't believe that this squashed, messy looking burger cost $5.50 and comes with no sides. The POX secret sauce wasn't my favorite and reminded me of a really sweet ketchup. I would probably order the Hyde Park cheeseburger next time because I couldn't taste anything on the burger other than the POX sauce. If you do not like sweet relish I would not recommend the coleslaw. Next time I'll order the french fries or onion rings.

Overall, my experience was good so I would visit again, but I think I will visit for breakfast on my next visit since it looks like you get more bang for your buck.

It was wonderful to find this little restaurant in the middle of Old City. The ambiance was nice, although it was a little small. Note that Chloe only accepts cash and is BYOB -- something that could be annoying if there wasn't an ATM and liquor store literally next door.
The food was fantastic. Bread brought out came with creamy, delicious hummus. For an appetizer, I had baked feta cheese, which was just spicy enough. I ordered the pumpkin ravioli for the main course, and it was the highlight of the meal: complicated, exquisite flavor with garnishings that went together wonderfully. And finally, the bannana bread pudding, which I had for desert, is reason to come to Chloe alone.
Altogether, Chloe is a treat that you shouldn't miss if you're in the area.

Nice modern hotel in the Theatre district - walking distance to SLU.  New, clean, has a rooftop bar, has a restaurant with a renowned chef attached.  Rooms were quiet on the 9th floor - which was green (you may know that each floor has a separate theme - rooms are green, red, yellow, or blue).  Beds were comfortable.  Pillows were nearly new and ideal.  Interesting lighting - a moon rock for instance...  Shower has high-end shampoo and soap.  Definitely a boutique place with character.  My only knock (keeping it from a 5) is the thermostat.  You can't just "set it" to a temperature.  We spent 20 minutes fiddling around moving it up then down then back up part way until we got it to stay at the temperature we wanted - trial and error...   

Oh yes... I see some people commented on the neighborhood.  Just do the valet parking.  You're fine during waking hours.  Overnight - better to be protected.

Lizetta was wonderful all around. She did an amazing job. Was very pleased that she kept our table neat, was very attentive, and kind. Her attitude made everything so much better she radiated positive energy

I love this place, 2 blocks from my door.  The food is great, I love Greek!  They have happy hour with 2 for 1 drinks, anything from the bar.  All day buy one get one free Margaritas, Mai Tai's,  Piña Colada, etc. I like to take my dog, sit on the patio or without the dog on the 2nd floor patio, and enjoy the St. Pete lifestyle.  Gyro's are great for lunch!

Spicy chicken cheesesteak was really good and similar to little sicily in philly and so were the masala fries
Will be back

Best pizza in Tampa Bay! I love it, I crave it, and it's always good, never disappointed. You can tell the people that work here put much effort and care into what they do. As far as the looks of the place it seems a bit outdated like from the 90s, but that kind of brings out a "historical beauty". 

My favorites are the lasagna, or the chicken parm, but of course, all of them are soooo good and worth trying.

One of my top bars for happy hour in a chilled setting. 
The bar is very well stocked especially with beer and whiskies (more on that later) 
The bartenders are top notch, friendly and knowledgeable and can recommend a drink/beer based on what you're craving at the moment.
One of the coolest things is the big patio in the back (reminds me a bit of Zeitgeist in SF) where they sometimes have live music.
But my favorite thing about here is the Mug Club. I won't spoil the fun, so just go there and ask about it. All I can say is that in order to join it, you'll have to drink a lot of great beer (along with a few crappy ones, but it's all part of the challenge). Great excuse to try new stuff. They also have a John Wilkes Booth Shot Club, and it's all about whiskey. Daily happy hour specials help the cause!
It's located in a seedy area of town (nothing to worry about really, the characters will provide for extra entertainment when looking out the windows), making it feel more of an oasis.

I ordered take out and hands-down it was THE BEST sushi I've had...ever. The fish is fresh and melts in your mouth and the flavor lingers. The pieces are generous without using too much rice. Very satisfying meal. My husband even enjoyed it and he's not crazy about maki rolls.I ordered the spicy tuna crunch roll, dragonfly roll (replaced the eel on top with fresh salmon for only $1 extra) and the kai roll. They were all so very delicious. My faves though were dragonfly and tuna crunch. Also, the hostess (I don't recall her name anymore as I went there 2 weeks ago) was kind and helpful in answering my questions and accommodating my requests. Am looking forward to actually dining there, enjoyed the nice relaxing atmosphere as I waited on my rolls which were being crafted fresh to order and in a very timely manner.

The service was great and everyone was super friendly.   Ordered take out and it took 15 min as estimated.    Got half of the OG and the other half the buffalo chic.  Pizza looks and smells amazing.  Has good flavor and is loaded with toppings but it is very salty.  I don't mean a little salty ....I mean way overboard.   A 12" pizza runs you $16 for one type, add a dollar to get 1/2 & 1/2.

I like rap music but I can see how it could deter patrons from going in.  Door says 21 and old inside.

Not sure if I would go back.  Just ok for me.

Just visited here on Thursday and was so excited to try it out. The waitress acted as if she didn't know what she was doing and even mixed up our drinks. My mom didn't get her salad. The onion rings still had not come, so she told them to please cancel the order; they brought them anyway! My nachos were disgusting. The meat looked weird and the tortillas that they used had a horrible taste. After starting her salad, my sister could not finish and almost vomited. I've been to Cheddars in other cities and was totally delighted. If this is what this restaurant will be, you need to go ahead and close now.

This place is overpriced and the hours of operation are terrible. The food court meets the standards of your run of the mill shopping malls. I'm glad I didn't spend any money here. The visit was definitely a waste of time.
Had the cheeseburger and the chicken sandwich with my husband.  We did halfsies.  We gobbled it up and contemplated order 2 more.  Sheer perfection!   Wishing them luck!

I made online reservations in May for this weekend and when I arrived Friday they had given away my room.  You could not find a hotel in Indianapolis this weekend because there were mutliple events going on including the Indiana State Fair.  The lady with the pink hair at the desk (dressed unprofessional for a hotel desk, may I add) was snooty and acted like they were doing me a huge favor by calling hotels asking if any had a room available because they screwed up.  I will never book in a Candlewood again because of these two broads.

Lisa from Aussie did a FABULOUS job on both of my German Shepherds. She took her time to make sure each of my dogs got EXACTLY what they needed. My 12 year old shepherd has a bit of anxiety about being groomed. All of his worries were soothed by Lisa's friendly demeanor and professionalism. My 4 year old long haired shepherd was long over due for a bath and haircut. With our first baby due any day Lisa suggested a "Puppy Cut" which would last much longer for our soon to be jam packed life. He came back looking like a new dog! I went from having to vacuum every day to only having to do it twice a week! Thank you Lisa and Aussie Pet Mobile for making my life that much easier and making our fur babies look their very best!
I love the flaky crust and the flavor profiles let one know that only the very best ingredients are being used. I will definitely keep buying their pies cream and fruit both are wonderful.

We have had Revolver twice now during the covid19 pandemic and it is delicious! Revolver makes everything from scratch and has simple yet delicious ingredients. We love getting the pepperoni and the white pizza. Order 2 hrs in advance as pizza is a popular pandemic take-out option. The pizza is thin crust for thin crust lovers! One pizza is plenty for two people but we like to get two pizzas to have variety and leftovers!

I have been going there off and on for years but now I'm totally sold on Lori! I highly recommend her to everyone! She did a wonderful job on my highlights, color and cut - SUPER job! Everyone else really friendly as warm. DEF. will continue to see Lori!

My boyfriend won a raffle prize of dinner for two here.  Since it was about to expire in a week, we finally got around to making reservations to go.  It's a conference center / banquet hall, not a restaurant, so it's hard to really rate.  And it was hard to know what to expect.  It was a bit of an odd prize in the first place, but hey, I don't look a free dinner in the mouth.

We shared the dining room with a couple groups of business people, and it seems this is their usual clientele.  Dinner was buffet style and included salad, raspberry and brie filled filo, chicken with stuffing, grilled tuna with mango salsa, fried rice with shrimp, breaded pork loin, veggies, candied yams, and dessert.  Not bad.  Salad veggies were really fresh.  Candied yams and filo were my favorites.  Tuna was kind of tough and not too tasty, chicken was a little dry.  Berries for dessert were really good, which is especially surprising since November isn't berry season.  I could have used some sprinkles on my fro-yo, but that's just me.

Of course the best part of the meal was it's price tag.  Included soda, coffee, tax, and tip.  All of the staff were friendly too.

I don't know if this review is very helpful since I don't think people really go here just to dine. But if you're going to be here for a conference or whatever, you probably won't starve.

This is the absolute worst pharmacy. My scripts are never ready when I arrive, even when I call ahead 3+ hours or when the pharmacy itself texts or calls me to say something has been refilled. It is beyond me how the customer service can possibly be this bad. Each time my specialty pharmacy delivers something to them, it takes them 2+ hours and sometimes days to find the item which always turns out to have been in their possession the entire time. I hate that they are the only 24 hour pharmacy beat me. I think they use the lack of competition as an excuse to continue to suck.

Booked a beautiful suite overlooking the city with a jacuzzi in it for a few nights just before the 2018 new year. I felt so stylish upon my arrival, valet & bell hop service YES PLEASE!  The self serve check in kiosk is the way to go because you don't have to wait in line and you get to jump on your bed faster. My room was well stocked with towels, blankets, and linens. The jacuzzi even has it's own supply of towels (bubbles too) so no need to fret about ordering more. The small table near the big window was perfect for my bf and I to order room service breakfast and enjoy the scenery. My favorite part about room service was that it requires no interaction at all, you simply check off what you want delivered and at what time and place it on your door handle before 4am, knock knock it's there. I utilized the gym they have to offer (very nice) as well as a the day spa (WOW SO LUXURIOUS). Many restaurants inside and very good ones located closely to the hotel as well. I really felt like royalty here, what a nice get away.

Great food! After a long day of shopping and building up an appetite, we decided to grab some grub for home. This convenient location at the mall is on point! Thanks Walk-On's for providing so many delicious options and giving ppl on the go choices other and your typical unhealthy fast food items!

The perfect place to go ballz to the wall (literally) and unleash my inner St. Lunatic. 

City Museum kicked our asses and we loved every sweaty, bruised, callused bit of it. Yes, my manicure took a beating and my non-sports bra equipped attire was pushed to the brink, but it was all worth it. Did I feel like a kid again? Hard to say since I'm really never not feeling like a kid but I defo felt more accepted acting like one here. Leaps+Bounds and defo no limits were the guidelines. 

I twisted and twirled, climbed and crawled, writhed and rode, slipped, sled and scaled the walls, tunnels, tree houses, ceilings, caverns, and more at this AMAZING indoor playground for both big and little kids. 

Don't miss going to the roof. Fantastic views of the city... even if you have to ride the terrifying super fast Ferris wheel to see them. Just make sure you clench that Bhole tight if you're on a date. Remember, there's less shame in adult diapers than there is in just out-rightly sh*tting your pants. I think my top faves were any of the slides and the rope swing as you go out onto the roof. #TooMuchFun   Aaand there was free S'mores roasting oustide on the ground level on the Friday night we went- Yummm. 

Open till 1am on the weekends and even though it's packed with kiddies, you don't even notice... plus, their parents will likely be nowhere near so you can kick, push, and scream all you want.
I had a root canal done there, they do an excellent job, but their payment plan is somewhat misleading, and the cost is very high.

The food was absolutely DIVINE!! They have these vegan al pastor tacos that come on the most delicious corn tortillas. The vegan al pastor is unreal it is so meaty it's like my brain wants it to stop being so meaty and also never stop because it's so unbelievably good. Truly worth every minute of the wait, but that's why it's 4.5/5 and not 5/5 because I DID wait 40 minutes to get two vegan tacos and that seems like a there's a little room for growth. (And I am not exaggerating I watched the clock because I was starving.)

You can never go wrong with Chick-Fil-A! It saddens me to leave a negative review for them. We entered  the store and it was PACKED! I mean, who doesn't like to end their day with The Lords Chicken!?! We wait in line, order our food to dine-in and end up waiting almost 20 minutes to get our food. It was not a big deal because, like I said, they were packed! But, everyone who ordered after us received their food. I went up to the counter to notify one of the workers that we were still waiting on our food and that's when I noticed the manager. "Lex Manager of 7 Years" on her phone texting, while bringing order after order to a table of (what appeared to be) very close friends of hers. Maybe, if she wasn't preoccupied with her friends and wasn't texting, she could've assisted her employees with the very busy dining area. 

I hope to have a better experience next time.
I am a New Englander so I know good seafood. This place rocks. Everything we ate was fresh  great and very reasonably priced. Our waitress was super friendly and helpful.  A Boise must.

It's a shame this place is invisible when you go past it on Main street. I've been looking for a spot like this for months. It's perfect for working, has wi fi and outlets, selection of teas is great, and the owners are superfriendly.

We are from the bay area and know our sushi...this place was recommended by a coworker whos from here. Great sushi, inexpensive for all-you-can-eat, service was great. Best time was about 2:30. 

Loved it!

This was our second year attending and the weather provided a perfect evening with friends and a perfect gyro! Plenty of wine and Sun King beer to enjoy with friends and neighbors. Put it on your list!

Is it worth standing in line for an hour - possibly!

Depends on how long you have in Nashville, the food is absolutely phenomenal and the decor is on point. 

Order the biscuits and sausage gravy and don't let the kale deter you - it was amazing!

Honorable mention to the Lily because the mascarpone was perfect
Got my food delivered. It was good but not fresh. Bread on the sandwich was soggy, fries were lukewarm. Delivery guy was cool though!

Other than being a little pricey...

The oysters desire and crabcakes were both absolutely incredible. Even asked for bread to dip in the butter the cooked oysters were served in. My brother ordered the Kobe sliders however, and they were very underwhelming. If something is advertised as Kobe beef, it should absolutely not be overcooked so much so that one cannot tell its a higher quality.

other than that everything was fine.

I wish I could give this place 5 stars. I thought it was going to be AMAZING based on how many people have told me about it. To be honest, I was impressed with the presentation of the sushi rolls, but the temperature of them kinda freaked me out. They were a little warmer than room temperature. I prefer sushi to be the right amount of cold, otherwise I worry about the temperature danger zone of fish. My guest loved it, so maybe it's just me. That's why I gave 4 stars vs anything lower. Will try some of the other locations.

Fun experience for my nephew's first time putt putting. Price was a little high, but that's what happens on the beach. 

Try to go around dinner time and eat after so you won't have to deal with the huge crowd. After 7 the lines start getting long. 

Feeding alligators was a great experience. Again a little pricy (4 pieces of food for $3.75), but the kids loved it.

The aquarium is starting to look very dated.  There were a few missing exhibits, but that's understandable.  Parking is $10.00, so add that to the price of admissions.  If you have a child that loves sharks, they have a few examples , but honestly, it will take you about 2hours to finish your visit, even on a weekend.

This location is a decent Wing Stop. I saw the old reviews and was curious of how bad this location could possibly be. I'm from New Orleans East and I already came to the realization that we can't have nice things here!

I ordered for take out and the food finished within the time frame. I went for the Monday and Tuesday 60 Cent Boneless Wing Special and ordered the Garlic Parmesan, Lemon Pepper, and Spicy Korean Boneless Wings. I also threw in their Louisiana Voodoo Fries to spice it up a bit. 

Garlic Parmesan and Lemon Pepper are my favorite Wing stop flavors, but this location really could had added more seasoning for it to be balanced. The Spicy Korean wings were well sauced up and had a great spice kick. The Louisiana Voodoo Fries looked delicious, but had too much going on for fries. Everything was good nonetheless. Even though it's a Wing stop in New Orleans East, I will be sure to try most items from the menu.

I only like their hot chocolate and wake up wraps. NOT THEIR COFFEE that sooo many people in my life are ga-ga for (I'm a WaWa girl, except for THEIR hot chocolate!) 

We stopped for a cup of it though for my man, who likes it and to use their bathrooms, which were crazy clean by the way. 

Nice staff, plus cool lounge area.

The Sculpture Garden instantly moved me from the moment we entered to see the first few pieces.  Inside City Park, adjacent to NOMA, situated on roughly 11 acres, and open 7 days a week, 10am to 5pm daily && FREE, this breathing taking garden is beyond worth spending time inside. 

With more than 90 sculptures among picturesque mature existing landscape of pines, magnolias and live oaks surrounding two lagoons this is a MUST see!!

A few of our favorites were Reclining Mother and Child, Karma, Pablo Casal's Obelisk andd Diana (my favorite)

We literally could have spent a better part of the day here & ate lunch, added bonus Cafe Du Monde is right outside of the gates so be sure to grab some to enjoy while you take in the beauty of everything.

I highly recommend this florist. Recently, I celebrated a 70th birthday and received 3 breathtaking arrangements. The artistry & design were gorgeous and the flowers lasted days beyond the celebration. If you want to send some floral love to someone special, look no further than Mayfield!

Last week a friend of mine took my wife and I and our grand kids to the oak oven. It is a quaint little Italian place in Harahan.  The pats is home made and quite good. The have a number of daily specials and fresh sea food. The kids menu offers several good selections for kids. One major negative in my opinion was a very average and small wine list and the wine we ordered was served a little warm. My wife felt that the service was rushed.  Would definitely recommend this place when in the area.

If the tortilla wrap hadn't been stale to the point of breaking off in pieces, European Republic would have been an easy 4-star. There really is a lot to like about this little sandwich shop. Quick, kind service; a selection of 23 dipping sauces to go with their stellar french fries (which are titled 'frites' because of the supposedly Belgian identity of the place); and an interesting selection of wraps and salads. 

I agree with most reviews of European Republic - both the good and the bad. Yes, the chicken was dry and the sauces on the wrap a little light. yes, the frites are amazing, some of the dips a little off. Yes, the dips are mostly mayonnaise based - we ordered the European Ketchup and Jalapeño Cheddar - but that aside, we still enjoyed both of them decently well. The European Ketchup, though only a mix of ketchup, mayo, and onions, was pretty tasty. 

My hopes are that I visited on an off night for the Republic. I'll go back for the frites alone, and maybe next time the meat will be a little better cooked and the tortilla will be a little fresher. I'd really love to give this place 4 stars because given its great location and price, European Republic could be a lunch or dinner favorite for anyone on a budget.

NOTE: $.35 charge when you pay by card, regardless of the total bill. I think if you spend over $10, this fee should be waived, but oh well: their place, their rules.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Datz! Phenomenal food, cool and unique atmosphere, great location- I have had nothing but enjoyable food and overall fantastic service there. Not only have I dined there, but I also had Datz cater an event I had- the food was a HIT and just as yummy and delicious as ever. Would highly recommend to anyone- one of South Tampa's food gems.

Good food, great service, and a delicious menu are why I continue to come back to this location. Do not mark this establishment off simply because it's a chain. The people working here truly care about the customer experience.

Not impressed here we stopped in and got 3 ground beef empanadas and 2 guava empanadas. We waited and waited for them. The sauce with the beef empanadas wasn't very good. Maybe I am not used to Venezuelan food. The empanadas seem to be made from masa mix very thick and heavy. The guava was just sweet masa hardly any of the delicious guava flavor. They tasted like sweet tamales. I am used to flour empanadas. Well I just don't care for them. I watched them make many sandwiches out of pita Bread, because we waited so long the people seem nice. I don't think I will be back,  I may try something else there.
Service was good.  I had dinner salad and wings. Lettuce was brown around the edges.  Wings were a soggy mess.  They were very over cooked.

Went here to celebrate the end of a long week and was not disappointed. Had the Izzy steak with the bourbon butter sauce and peppercorn crust, and it was awesome. Wish I'd had time to read the reviews below before coming; next time I will try the shrimp cocktail!

I never take time to post anything on YELP, but I was so impressed with the kindness and patience displayed by a Hostess on Valentines Day.  The restaurant was real busy and I called the wrong location for my reservation.  The Hostess with RED hair was so understanding to my boyfriend and I.  She kept on checking on us because I was so upset since it was our first Valentines Day.  She found us the perfect table for our delicious dinner.  I think her name was Kelly.

Horizon charged $89.00 for the service call and said I needed 2 parts. The parts would cost me $1105.00 with the $49.00 coupon.$1194.00 total. They did not have the parts on the truck and  he call the wear house to get them delivered. Although it was only 4:30 pm he could not get an answer. This was on a Wednesday. He said they would call me on Thursday morning. They did not call me on Thursday or Friday so I called C&C on Friday. I told them what parts I needed and they said it would be $634.48 including the service call. They came on Monday and did the work. I called Horizon on Monday and they did refund the $89.00. Horizon was almost twice the price. That is price gouging to me. Takeing advantage of people when they need heat is not fair and I wiill not call them again. Always get a second  opinion when dealing with Horizion.

High quality food and lots of flavor. I haven't been at Cali's in a while, but this place it's so great. We had a Fajita bowl and a Mexican bowl both with steak. The meat was very tender and flavorful. We also had agua fresca, one with cucumber and the other with ginger, they were both very refreshing. Our waitress was very sweet, she got us chocolate chip cookies because it was my husband's first time a at the restaurant

I came here twice during my 4 days in New Orleans because I love everything about it. When I opened the door, I swear I heard some Angels sing which is weird since I don't believe in them. Everything is so shiny and beautifully arranged. I believe they serve brunch upstairs but I usually order a coffee and sit in the table and read.

Even if you can hold off in not getting their assorted truffles, you have to try one of their cream puffs. I ordered the coconut passion fruit. The first bite took me to Heaven or how I imagine Heaven to be. I still smile when I think about eating that cream puff.

Take a break during your wanderings of the French Quarters and stop by there to get some sweets.

Service is great and the food is delicious. I had the pork chops. Both fried and baked. The baked just falls apart and is smothered in gravy. Awesome! Corn bread is excellent green berms were perfect. This is southern cooking at its finest!

Such a cute place! Loved the decor and the southwestern vibe. The family was super sweet and gave me food & hiking recommendations. The room was clean, spacious, and air conditioning worked perfectly. Also had Netflix & Hulu available. Perfect location just 2 blocks from bustling 4th street. Would love to stay again and would recommend friends & family to stay here too.

Jackson's Barber shop is the best barbershop I've ever been to hands down! I recently moved to Philly to attend medical school from Houston, Texas. Dorsey and the barbers here have me looking the best I ever have in my life . The attention to detail and skill is unmatched. To me coming here is like seeing family , a home away from home. If you Want to look the best you ever have in your life and have a great time while you get a haircut come to Jackson's and talk to Dorsey. By far the best experience I've ever had ,it's family , it's amazing . Jackson's barbershop is always clean, will always greet you with a smile and leave you looking like the best version of yourself!

We've rented our apartment with Zukin for two and a half years now and we've been happy the whole time. They're very attentive and take good care of the property. Jason is great! We'd definitely recommend them if you're looking to rent in the area.
First time coming here; the guys were amazing and recommended a very delicious crepe. They were super friendly and are extremely affordable! Love the atmosphere too. Must try it!

In one word, "WOW!"

This small find in Ambler PA is well worth the travel.  Indian food with flavor not heavy on spice flavor or fire, but rather flavor due to their preparations and cooking.

A meal so well worth saying no more to other good but mediocre Indian fare.

Started with a chicken Kaathi roll, flavorful. Not greasy or bland.  Probably the best representation of kaathi rolls.

We shared an order of Tandoori Lamb,so tender, cooked to perfection and not overly seasoned; a must try dish.  Complemented with a disk of the month (month long specials vs daily) honey garlic shrimp.  Don't jump to conclusions until you taste it.  A red sauce, not sticky honey, just enough I give a tangy flavor.

Of course, a garlic naan to dip into the flavorful sauces from our dishes.

A BYOB and they accept credit cards.
Small find, suggest making a reservation.

Wow!! Private event upstairs. Greated as we arrived with champagne, and cocktails in the Seance room and then moved into dining room for dinner. The wait staff was attentive and at the top of their game. The food... well mouth watering. I heard so many compliments over the food. The room was a perfect setting and Erin Bowman plus the wait staff, chefs, made the evening a wonderful experience for a twice postponed wedding rehearsal dinner.

As a tech, Amy was great!  She is so meticulous and careful.  My nails looked spectacular when I left and the lotion rub really moisturized my dry winter hands.  

Good thing I waited to write this review.  Less than a week and the nail polish was chipping.  Used the Shellac brand that I was accustomed to from my previous salon, but the quality here is nothing like my previous salon.

Probably not coming back to Amor.

Koizi was a first for me in that I've never been to an "endless" hibachi before.  Compared to other hibachi restaurants I've been to you can get a lot more food for your money at Koizi.  We went for dinner and the place was packed.  I thought the interior of the restaurant looked really nice, especially the cool blue lighting around the bottom of our hibachi grill.  When you're looking over the menu you have to start discussing whether you're going to get the all you can eat or order individual entrees.  I'm not a big eater and would have preferred getting entrees, but the problem is that it's "all or nothing" in that everyone in your group must make the same choice.  That wasn't a great scenario for me, but I can understand why they have this policy.  Otherwise they'd have people who ordered a cheap entree taking food from the person sitting next to them that ordered unlimited food.

We decided to go with the unlimited.  The menu is split into appetizers, hibachi, and entrees.  They let each person order more than one appetizer at the same time, which was nice.  The appetizers themselves were very small.  I didn't like the gyoza at all.  The skin was crunchy and dry.  I've never had gyoza like that before.  The tiny egg rolls were pretty good.  When you're done with your appetizers (which won't take long) you can get more, but you have to wait for the waitress to come back and you have to wait for them to be prepared.

I decided I wanted two entrees instead of the hibachi choices.  Our waitress seemed shocked by this.  She kept insisting that "the cook will only come out once".  It was very loud and I had trouble understanding what she meant and I was pretty confused because I thought it was endless.  I relented and told her I would get a choice off of the hibachi menu.  I later realized what she was indicating was that the chef would only come out and put on a "show" cooking the hibachi items once.  After that you could still order off of the hibachi menu, but the meals would be prepared in the kitchen and brought to the table.  I've seen the hibachi shtick a million times so that would be no great loss to me.  Our chef was very talented and made us laugh a lot but I ended up wishing I would have just ordered two of the small entrees.  I did end up getting the mango chicken and, much like everything else, I thought that it was just okay.

I would definitely come back for lunch sometime, but as for dinner if I'm paying $17.95 I would rather go somewhere where I know that I would get a single great entree instead of what I got at Koizi.

I got dragged here with my family for Father's Day dinner.  I'm giving them 2 stars because the staff was very friendly and attentive, Sherri was a great server. The food was barely edible.  Nothing had flavor or seasoning and there isn't a lot of variety. I won't even recommend this establishment for a "quick cheap dinner". I did have their famous steak, it was ok and a bit though. I also had the baby back ribs which were awful aswell

Best AYCE sushi and top notch Chinese food in Reno.  They have the freshest fish and top notch service.  The nigiri are deftly cut and rolls are creative.  Their hamachi and sake nigiri melts in your mouth l like butter.  The sushi chefs are friendly and personable.  

Intimate setting and just plain amazing Chinese food.  Pot stickers stuffed with minced pork and vegetables wrapped in a thin casing that achieved nirvana by being crunchy and golden brown on one side only, juicy inside.  The sea bass is is cooked to perfection and it lightly flakes off of to swim in a honey sauce that creates a perfect symphony.  The chef, Quoc puts his pizazz into the chili oil and XO paste.  It's has wealth of flavor but not one over powers the other - a must try since they make it themselves.  The owner David is extremely knowledgeable about wine and provides impeccable service.

My family and I have been buying our birthday cakes here for 30 years. The bakery is always fresh and filled with anything you could possibly want, including ice-cream. A nice, family- owned bakery feeling
Best Mexican food and drinks within 100 miles. Service is spot on. Food is always cooked to perfection. Deliciousness. I'm lucky I live a few blocks away.

Louis Armstrong New Orleans is definitely an outdated airport. Though, Hawaii's HNL still got them beat. The airport is pretty small, which is surprising, considering all the tourist traffic that it gets. Still, even with it's older look, the main traffic areas are kept clean. 

The bathrooms? Not so much. Trash is usually filled. Toilet paper on the floor. Messy sinks. And, I won't even discuss the smell.

MSY has a number of local chains and eateries. Having a southern comfort meal is a nice change from all the hipster and hippie joints that populate east/west coast airports. Prices are as reasonable as they can be for airport food. 

For the most part, the staff is kind and polite. Other than that, there's nothing else to much to this airport. It'll probably be the least memorable airport that I've ever traveled through.

well, I didnt actually attend Canzelle due to illness and inability to travel to CA (which I was super bummed out about) but I did speak  with the owner, Brad, and he was super nice. I highly recommend visiting this beautiful farm and experience what I didnt get to :( Brad was super understanding of my situation even though I was a dunce, and was nothing short of extremely helpful. Canzelle is at the top of my list next time I travel to CA for vacation!!  I felt the need to review because of the amazing customer service I received from him.

So we frequent this place monthly and it can be a really fun theater to visit - depending on who's working there ... yesterday afternoon I noticed that the lady taking my food order was in what appeared to be in an unnecessarily passive-aggressive mood . I went back to get my husband and me drinks during our movie . Nobody else was around and she was acting quite grumpy and rude so I held back on giving her a tip this time through. I signed the card slip and drew a zero where the tip should be. While she handed over our drinks (wine and coke), I turned around to find straws and then came back to the counter to grab them. I heard a plop at the time when my head was turned away, but thought nothing of it at the time. I then went back to the movie. At the conclusion of the movie upon my completion of the cup of wine, I noticed a dirty coin at the bottom of my cup. The inference I have drawn is that the disgruntled server dropped a coin in my drink when I wasn't looking. If so, there is something definitely wrong with this particular person and she has no business handling food and drinks for the public let alone having a job in customer service .

We booked The Grand Plaza in October 2017 right after we got engaged. I knew I always wanted to get married on that beach considering I basically grew up right across the street. I read amazing reviews, then not so good reviews and I started to get worried. The main ones that bothered me were the high turnover of wedding coordinators. The one we were assigned with was Tatiana. I approached her about the reviews I was reading and she assured that would never happen and that she had been there for 3-4 years. Well... that was a lie. I stopped hearing from her, she wasn't answering my calls or texts. She finally responded with- "I live in Atlanta now. I no longer work for TGP." Strike 1! So trying to find another coordinator- that was fun. I called and called and finally had Amanda call me after about two weeks of being in the dark. She was great. She helped me with everything I needed and answered all the questions I had. 
Fast forward to wedding month (October 2018) Tatiana had told me that I would have a free night stay on my wedding night and could pick any room I choose. So of course, I chose the Penthouse. Well weeks before my wedding, I was told that's not a choice, but because I was already told so prior, Amanda was able to honor that for me. Well, assuming that I had that free penthouse, I figured the Groomsmen can get ready in that room... not. I called to make sure the room would be ready in the morning and I was told no because check in time is 3-4pm. So now, if it wasn't for me asking, this would have happened that morning. After speaking with two managers, I was again told there was nothing they could do about the check in time. So last minute, this is why I had to spend another $300 to book a room the night before so that i could make sure our wedding party had a place to get ready in! Long story short, our prices must have changed 6-7 times during that week. With the wedding, guests and food/drink spent at THP, there was easily $30k spent and our room discounts for our guests were like $15... it was a joke. Between the night before the wedding room charge, (I ended up getting charged for the Penthouse but that got taken care of), charges in the contract constantly changing etc. I woke up the morning after the wedding with $900+ in charges between the room fees, other charges that they fail to mention and their 'sister' hotel The Beach Comber allowing people on our WEDDING NIGHT to forge my husbands signature, write the wrong room number and charge it to our room and somehow it still went through. Crazy right? Who should worry about these things on your wedding?? 
Now to our reception... it must have been 100+ degrees the entire 4 hours in The Presidential Ballroom. I read these reviews prior about the hallways being hot, but not the actual reception room. It was miserable. People left early/ were sitting in the lobby to cool down, everyone was sweating like crazy trying to eat their dinner. Then I noticed multiple floor fans were brought in... just very disappointing and unprofessional. I had a donut wall and a dessert table which I later found out that multiple hotel guests were coming into our reception, eating our desserts and leaving!! Why was this not stopped? I've never heard of such thing. Last, but certainly not least, months prior to the wedding I had asked Amanda if my cake could be saved, put into the freezer and I could grab it or just left out so I could take it back to my room. She told me it shouldn't be a problem. Well the reception came to an end and the workers were cleaning up my decorations.
