I had about 10 boxes filled with plastic/ bubble wrap and all of my things wrapped and organized when they took it out so they knew which table it went on and exactly what it was supposed to look like (via pictures) Instead of using any of the wrap, all my candles/lanterns/woodslabs you name it- just thrown into boxes. My strings of lights- so balled up and tangled that they had to be thrown away. $20 no big deal right? Half of my decorations had to get tossed because things were broken. Things that i could have sold to get my money back from wedding costs, now in the trash because of the lazy and careless Grand Plaza workers. My bouquet with sentimental charms- just shoved in a box. So when we got back to our family's house where our stuff would stay while we were on our honey moon- I realized our cake was gone. It wasn't saved like I had asked. I reached out to Amanda and she told me it wasn't her responsibility. To some it may not seem like a big deal- it's a cake. But to me, it was. I wanted to save it for our anniversary. Well we came back from our honey moon to unpack boxes, this is when we found our stuff just tossed in there and broken- well, there was our cake... right in the bottom of a box of candles and wood slabs. 
I have never seen or heard of a venue provide this kind of service to newlyweds who picked YOU to have their wedding and spend thousands and thousands of dollars.
My favorite part besides the food being delicious and almost eating myself into a coma was the margarita mimosa!!! A what!!! Yes honey!! The bomb!!
I live close by so I stop in occasionally for a case of beer. Very friendly staff prices are reasonable. They have a great selection of beer and will order it for you if it's not in stock.

I am absolutely horridly shocked by the quality of food at this place. By FAR, the worst sandwich I have ever had IN MY LIFE. 3 of us ordered the chicken, brie, and pineapple sandwich, and every single one of us absolutely hated it. The sourdough bread was old, the chicken was so ROCK SOLID that it cut the roof of my mouth! My friend tried to cut hers but the knife wouldn't even cut through! How can they even serve this?! The brie tasted like plastic, and when they say pineapple salsa, they literally mean one tiny cube of pineapple.

Fries also tasted like cardboard... not just cardboard, but old bland cardboard. If I could I would rate this place negatively for food. But, I have to be fair and say the location along the river was nice, and the servers were helpful, which brings this place up to 2 stars.

I really don't understand how they can serve the food they did. Maybe they assume people will be drunk enough to not care about what they are putting in their mouths. I wish I could say I am exaggerating, but trust me when I say I am actually trying to be nice. Nonetheless, I would definitely recommend AGAINST coming here for food, but to give a fair review, would say this would be a nice place to come in for drinks.

The Goods
Cannot function without a latte.
Leboulangerie is the new bakery and it is much better than before 

Ambiance
1. I like the faint lights in the ceiling kind of rustic chic

Service 
1. These people know me all the time!!!  Remember me by name!!

MoJo
1. Anything drink, I love them all but sugar free coffee is my fav

I have been a client of Berman's for decades and have had nothing but great service and gorgeous outcomes when redesigning my jewelry.  Fred and Debbie are fabulous.  I can't say the same for other Jewelrs in the area who prefer to cater to the elite clientele, snubbing you if you don't "look" just right.  Recently Fred and Deb redesigned 4 pieces of jewelry for me and the results are spectacular.

Great diner, especially with all the renovations and wide variety of choices on the menu.  The food has been good, no matter what I have ordered.  The rest of my family and friends also agree that this is definitely a must try if you're in the area.

If you're looking for a GREAT reasonably priced breakfast, this is the place!!  We've eaten here several times and it's always great. Great friendly service. Great food, excellent coffee! Highly recommended!

We stopped in for breakfast after checking out the easter egg hunt at a nearby park.  The service was excellent and fast.  My kid enjoyed the pancakes and bacon.  I had the reuben with a chef salad (the honey mustard dressing was sooooo tasty), and the spouse had the omelet.  Everything tasted great.  I would definitely return.

(tip: if you don't like your salads too wet, ask for the dressing on the side.)

Having the first ultrasound of our first baby, they don't allow recording or taking pictures in the premises but show in multiple posters that they will send you digital copies of the ultrasounds at your request. Asked the ultrasound technician to confirm and she said that we can have the images but we need to fill paperwork on the outside desk. When asking for the paperwork in the outside desk they say  they only send the pictures from the second ultrasound. Before we left we ask in the outside desk again and they say we should have filled the paperwork before entering for the US. Three different people, three different answers. final result: we had to walk out without the pictures. This is outrageous, we have the right to have those images, processing a complaint.

I don't really know what to say other than THIS IS THE BEST MEXICAN PLACE I'VE EVER BEEN TO!!!! 

Wow. I don't think I'll ever go to Santa Barbara and not eat here. My boyfriend and I got the fish enchiladas and I got the shrimp stuffed pablanos. The refried beans are amazing and so is the rice. Wow wow wow.

Had dinner tonight at Massa's. Recommend by Michael (my driver for the Embassy Suites across from the restaurant).  I had a Cesar salad, Tutta Mare, and a chianti wine.  The salad was good and contained Anchovies.  The Tutta Mare was very good with muscles, shrimp, clams, and scallops. In a white sauce.  

Price was reasonable for this nice meal.  The ambience of the restaurant was quant and low lit.  

I would return for another meal here.  I would recommend it to you when you're near the St Louis airport. 

Enjoy!!

We were invited to a get-together in one of the shaded shelters in the park. It was a perfect location for a picnic or a BBQ with a large crowd. You can rent out the space at various sized shelters depending on the # of people. I think we were at a medium sized shelter for 31-60 people for $74.90 for the day.

It's $2 per vehicle. It seems worth it because during our stay, I observed trash collectors 2x emptying out the large bins. The area is well-maintained and clean.

The park is extremely big with a lot of different parking lots so check the map that you can get when you first arrive at the park (to pay the parking fee) and ask for directions if you want to park closer to your shelter.

The boardwalk area was a great place to stroll and see animals. We spotted turtles, gators, a snake and various birds. There were running trails that I saw many joggers and bikers using.

The bathrooms were clean! There is a playground area for kids to play at.

Their brisket is out if this world. They've got really good bbq sauce as well. If you love bbq and brisket, you will not be disappointed. Their serving size is so big for their combo platter that I'm able to get two meals out if it.  I haven't been there since before Covid but you need to get there early for lunch or you'll have to get it to go. It's a popular place and it's not that big inside.

The whole pizzas look okay from the pictures on Yelp, but stay away from the pizza-by-the-slice despite the great price ($3.50). It took almost 30 minutes for us to get our two slices and they were greasy and reminiscent of the frozen pizza you get from the grocery store and make in the oven. That said, I would give this place another chance for three reasons: 1) They are open late (in fact, our slow service may have been because we came in at 1:30am), 2) The decor and diner-like vibe was cool. There were plenty of people hanging out, drinking and having a good time until late. 3) Like I said, the whole pizzas look higher quality than the by-the-slice. Try this place out but stick to Goodfellas on Mass Ave for pizza by the slice.
love this store, very friendly staff and helpful. items are cleaning packed. Prices are average.

Amazing. I first went in with neck issues and within minutes I had full movement back. They're just so knowledgeable about the muscles and what to do. Quick to respond about appointments and amazing customer service all around. I almost fell asleep during the massage I was so relaxed. I'll absolutely be coming back.

My expectations were exceeded a thousandfold here today. I recently decided to wear glasses full-time instead of taking my readers on and off all day. And since I was going to wear these full-time, I wanted to make the best of the situation by finding something to enhance my looks a bit. I don't really trust my own judgement when it comes to fashion-sense. So, I placed my fate in Sue's hands, and she came through big time. Instead of looking in the mirror as I tried on each pair, I trusted her use me as a canvas, and she handled it like an artist. The experience of having a personal shopper was fantastic. Plus, it was a true pleasure working with Sue. She's a gem. I wholeheartedly recommend the experience at the Optic Shop on S. Howard Ave.

Finally tried this lovely and authentic French bistro in our neighborhood and found a new favorite! Family owned with true French favorites such as poached pear salad and beef bourguignon. Extensive wine and dessert list, in addition to pizza!! Dishes are more European in nature than the usual "bistro" fare, earthy--prepared with a much lighter touch and without heavy sauces made to please American palates. Enjoy and appreciate the slower service by the owners. This place is a gem.

I was excited for this place cause 1 I was hungry and 2, I love ramen. The place is new and small; twas very hard to find and they didn't have a sign up making it harder to find. 

The service was good; waitresses were friendly and we were seated right away. The food was very... Very... Meh... The broth was super bland, noodles are chewy, and the chasu was super fatty and not in a good way. The process of them making the ramen is definitely not what I was expecting. They just heated up all the premade ingredients on a burner... I was expecting a lot I guess for a place in collegeville. 

The pricing and everything is fine but my goodness... The food is super bland (at least to my Asian taste buds). 

I understand that they just opened but, from what I saw, they don't make the noodles fresh (maybe they made it in the back? But... )

Nice burger & fry combo: melty pub cheese running off the decent sized patty and nicely crisped fries allowed me to have the cheese on both the burger and fries. 

Service was quick and friendly.  We had extra time to get to the gate.  Didn't order Nachos, but the guy in front of us did - it was a sizable dish for one-two people.

Have been a big fan of their Pizza. Their crust has always been excellent. Tonight we ordered our Pizza and the crust was horrible. Tasted like cardboard. Very dry. Not sure what they changed but hopefully they go back to their previous recipe.

The  food and service was horrible.. Never again. Took too long and when food arrived the whole order was wrong and they did nothing to try to fix it only gave me attitude.... For the money I spent my service should have been better

my average is 20 minutes to get a pour over cup of coffee. east nashville is not keeping up with hipster demand for craft coffee! BP does have excellent breakfast biscuits, very friendly service and coffee is deliciously smooth, whenever it eventually arrives (i've waited 30mins before!) i live in portland oregon where we have barista parlors on every block so maybe i'm just extra impatient!?

We attended couple of events where Saffron catered. AMAZING food! The first night it was Cajun inspired Indian food (best combo ever) and the second night they had Indian Chinese. 

Some of the dishes they also have on their menu and is a must- try- Tamarind shrimp and lamb chops!! Yumm! I wish they were closer than a 5 hour flight, I would've reserved a table every Friday!!
Was told I could pickup currency today but everyone was at lunch! Only 1 person was able to help and that person was at lunch! Do not bank at this branch.

I tried the chargrilled oysters at Acme and Drago's, and Acme won hands down.  The oysters were better, with more of a smoky, chargrilled flavor.  And in spite of the long line at Acme, once we were in, the service was better at Acme than at Drago's. 

Even if you don't like raw oysters, these chargrilled ones will make you happy. From the first bite to the last drips of butter Parmesan oyster liquid, this was really good.

Delicious, I had a shrimp taco and a chorizo and egg torta. My husband had the enchilada plate. It was prepared infront of us and it was seasoned well every condiment complimented the other. I enjoyed the atmosphere the cooks were great. We met great people while sitting at the bar. Awesome experience in Reno!

Love this vineyard, especially in the summer! They have the cutest outdoor patio seating area. Live music on weekends, even in the winter. Spacious indoor seating area and friendly staff that are very knowledgeable about the types of wine they make!

Syphay is a new-ish Thai place that opened up where an old Vietnamese restaurant used to be. We came here because it was across the street from someone's workplace who I was meeting for lunch during a weekday so it's a good location in the Quarters - an up and coming part of Edmonton's downtown. I enjoyed the food and some of the dishes were particularly good. The Goong Krateum (Crispy Garlic Shrimp) was the best dish that we ordered and I'd give it a 5/5. It's probably not the most healthy dish but tasted great. We also ordered a Pad Thai which was fairly standard and Coconut Rice.

The service was friendly, and the food came out quickly. The portion sizes were huge - the Pad Thai and the Crispy Garlic Shrimp were too much for two people to finish. Add on the Coconut Rice and we had way too much food for two people. I'd definitely go back here again for Thai food (especially the Crispy Garlic Shrimp!).
I love this place so much. The chicken nachos are the best thing on the menu. The margaritas are also so good! Service is great.
Yep, it's as good as it gets!  Authentic German beer garden atmosphere, outstanding staff and a jolly good time!  Check it out!

We flew into the Trenton airport on business and solicited the staff's lunch recommendation for good local non-chain food. We were not disappointed by the food or service at Mikonos. I chose the vegetarian sampler, and I only wish I'd thought to photograph my plate before devouring every delicious morsel. My co-star exercised his natural proclivity to order full-beast; I think he had everything on the menu. Yeah, Okay, the decor is a little dated, and someone needs to discover windex, but our server was sweet, friendly, and efficient, and as I said, the food was good, which makes up for the dirty windows. Our server recommended the Galaktobureko dessert, saying it was rarely served in other Greek restaurants. That must be a fact because I'd never heard of it before. It was spectacular in taste, texture, and presentation. I am, however, glad they don't post the calories in their dishes. I'll definitely go back if I'm ever in Trenton again, but if there is a next time, I'll take some Windex wipes and clean the front door.

I can't say enough about how fantastic Dr Oates and the entire team are!!  Our family moved to Franklin last year and needed a dentist closer to home. My husband went to Dr Oates for an emergency and was so pleased we now have the entire family at their practice. Not only do they have exceptional service, but late last year we were out of dental coverage for 6 weeks during a job change and couldn't believe how reasonable a tooth extraction was!!   We highly recommend Dr Oates!!!

This is my favorite McDonalds in the area. My go to order is a McChicken and fries with a large Dr Pepper. DELICIOUS. DONT GO TO ANY OTHER MCDONALDS COME TO THIS ONE!!!!! I've learned this the hard way/: The mayo to lettuce ratio is exquisite and the fries are always nicely done. There is never a wait. I LOVE IT HERE!!!!!

We went for a quick getaway on Thanksgiving weekend and the hotel did not disappoint.  If you stay, get a room with an atrium view and a balcony!  Sleeping with the door open and listening to that waterfall was FABULOUS!  The steakhouse was really good - but put your name in early - we had a two hour wait.  My major piece of advice is this - DO NOT - I REPEAT - DO NOT buy the tickets for the carriage ride!  $65 PER PERSON and it MIGHT have been 10 min long - around the parking lot.  Biggest rip off ever!!!

the GAP is my favorite spot in phoenixville. The food, service and atmosphere is great! If you want to relax and have a good beer this is the place! There is normally music throughout the week and it is great to meet and hear local artist play. Definitely my first choice when my friends and I are grabbing drinks and dinner.
I was disappointed, and so were my friends.  The meat tasted of lighter fluid, and the salad bar wasn't as bounteous as advertised.  And I got sick the next day -  bacteria city!  Stay away!
Beignets were good! Service was fast and excellent. The western omelette seemed greasy. The Cajun hash browns were good.

So I will warn you... I'm a bit biased. My friends and I used to go to their old location like once a week, so I was so happy when a friend suggested it while I was visiting Tampa.

Wonderful Sunday afternoon.... I had quiche and a great glass of wine. The service was fantastic and the food was every bit as good as I remember! Their vinaigrette dressing was unexpected and really great.

Better location I think, also. Not right against the street and movie traffic anymore.

Before coming to New Orleans, my neighbor assured us we wouldn't require a car. She also suggested rather than pay the extra costs per person for a bus tour to the plantations, to rent for one day. She told us to Uber to the Convention Center and rent from Hertz. 

Ha ha! I found a much less expensive and preferable way to go: NIFTY! Nifty has a fabulous service in that they come to your hotel and pick you up and take you to their car rental for the paperwork. And they bring you back after you've used the car all day! Best of all,NIFTY WAS  less expensive than Hertz!

The women that work at Nifty are FABULOUS! They have great personalities and make the usual tedious experience FUN!! 

USE NIFTY!!
Food tastes so gross they only thing good was the chips! Found a piece of hair in my food!!!! So gross

I am new to Indianapolis, and I am so happy to have finally found a new salon!  Scott is very kind and has a gently touch.  He understands contemporary looks and listens to me.  Other salons left me leaving with what I call "hooker" hair with all sorts of products sprayed on me.  Scott understood my personal style.  The salon itself is comfy and a nice place to escape!  Again, I'm so glad to have found this place!

I will add to Lorri's review-Don't drop your iPhone X in your garage, especially when you don't have a screen protector.  It really is annoying to have an expensive phone with a cracked screen.  Fix Master came to my rescue and in less than an hour I had what looks like a brand new phone.  The owner also gave me a discount on a new super cute case and screen saver.  Other businesses could learn customer service from Fix Master!
The mapo tofu was terrible, probably one of the worst I've ever had. Not fragrant or flavorful at all, and even though I requested extra peppercorn I didn't get any of it.  Will not order again.

Doctor Johnson was awesome! I had exploded my 2nd metatarsal on a wave runner accident.  After the surgery with the first surgeon, I thought I would never be able to walk normal again. I just ran a 5K with my wife! Thank you doctor Johnson!

I went in thinking 4.5 star rating would be worth a shot. 

Turns out, their "Korean BBQ" isn't even close to the real "Korean BBQ". I've never had Korean BBQ that bad in my life. Beef cuts and their freshness is definitely questionable. Their galbi was a total disaster. Never had galbi that is marinated in so much spices, 80% of it was fat. It tastes nothing like the Korean version. I kind of had a little suspicion just by the name of the place (definitely not a Korean place name). Should have known better and walked right out when I found out that place is Chinese run Korean BBQ place. If you want legit Korean BBQ, don't ever bother going to this place, PERIOD.

This place is great for vegetarians with plenty of meat options that are different - a memorable experience that will stand out with all the drinking and fried food you will eat in NOLA. 

Place is hidden in a tiny alley but with google maps, you should have no issues. It was closed on New Years but I am glad we came back again to try out the food. 

They have small seating in the front, some seating in the back and some outside. Not a great place for big groups. 

For food, Moroccan lentil soup with chickpeas reminded me of Chole at an Indian restaurant with some variation of spices. 

Pomegranate beet hummus is a must try - accompanied with bread, toasts and fruits - will leave you asking for more bread and licking the plates.  

Rolled Uttapama is a nice variation with spiced curry filling. Very filing and great option to try.

Quality has gone down and prices have gone up. I don't send dishes back often because I'll eat just about everything. I'm easy to please, hard to impress. But when you take your first bite of chow fun and your noodles crunch, its just not ok. Sent it back and it came back more cooked, but still not cooked enough. Chicken was all dried out in it, and there was a shit ton of garlic that overpowered it. Im pretty sure chow fun traditionally does not have garlic in it. I've had the chow fun here before and it's always been the best you can get around these parts, but now I'm not sure I even want to go back. The crispy pork roll was way overrated, the pancake pork roll is far superior, Altho that's assuming quality hasn't gone down in that aspect. The saving grace of the meal was the braised beef/ tendon noodle soup. That dish has remained consistent in the quality, but when I first started coning here it was about $3 cheaper. One of the most disappointing meals I've had, it doesn't help that I had been looking so forward to it. Very sad now
This place has always had bad "joss"    "vibe"  son arguing with the mother etc etc

I purchased a bike pump and rack here, then asked about service to my husband's bike.  Getting a response was like pulling teeth and the owner was barefoot.  He never looked me in the eye.  I live in Newtown and always support local businesses, but I just can't make myself go back here, even though the pump didn't fit my tire and we ended up pulling it so hard to get it off the air hole, we ripped the tube.  Other reviewers who gave this place more stars are waaaaaaay more tolerant of poor customer service.

I stopped by for a quick lunch last week. Went inside, it was good but not a great Po' Boy like I'd expect at a top Cajun restaurant.  Hook & Reel has the normal seafood decor, like Red Lobster, McGrath's (sad about them), Joe's, etc. with a Louisiana twist. 
I thought I'd get the oyster Po Boy, a New Orleans standard with fried oysters, shredded iceberg lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and a remoulade aioli sauce (spicy Mayo).   It was nice on a fresh sliced toasted French baguette, but they were skimpy with the smallish oysters. I believe there were only 3 or 4 total. The oyster basket with fries included most everything else the same for roughly the same price--and with more oysters!! I should have gotten that.  Instead of fries, I paid extra for clam chowder. It had lots of potatoes, few clams. The oyster crackers with it were on point and soaked up the clam juice broth. That was nice. 
  I was alone, next time I'll go with others--the crab boils appear to be the standout items on the menu.  I saw and smelled the steam fest at the table next to me. The spicy plastic bag of fun looked great. Although I've never found anyplace that gets everything cooked just right at the same time...I saw sausage, mussels, shrimp, snow and Dungeness crab, crawfish, plus corn cobs and red potatoes in there. They have several seasoning choices as well. I should have taken pictures!  
I will be back, but no more Oyster Po' Boy.  The value ratio isn't great on it.

Wow! This place has changed since last time we went there! For the worse I mean. The staff was great and on top of things!
  The menu has change they eliminated lots of good options they had. The food quality has gone down, just not the same awesome flavors it used to have. 
 The portions were smaller and presentation was bad. We have eaten there for years and food used to be good, with nice size portions, and great presentation. I don't know if they changed owners or management but it is bad we won't be back for a while hopefully they get to the way they used to be before.
Love Foxs donuts!! We would come here every day if we could. Great variety of flavors and always fresh!

This little place is right down the road from our house, so we decided to give it a go on date night a few weeks ago. All I can say is AMAZING. The bread is fresh and they give you marinara that is CLEARLY homemade to dip it in. We are talking...best marinara I have ever tasted. Their meat spaghetti sauce is the only spaghetti sauce I have ever tasted that rival's my Dad's, and he is a chef. The chicken marsala was delicious and had plenty of garlic and mushrooms. The gelato was amazing as well. Everything was just excellent, honestly. We will be back a thousand times over!

I came here to get some cheap pizza. I ordered two slices of pizza for $6. Thought that was a bit steep but the slices are huge so I can't complain about the price. However, the taste just isn't my thing. The sauce was too sweet and overpowered the pizza. I like sweet sauces but not on my pizza. The pepperoni at least added a bit of bite on one of the slices to take away the sweetness, but it just didn't improve, even after adding hot pepper flakes and garlic powder. Can't speak on anything else, but I wouldn't come here for the pizza at least.

I routinely place online order but pickup in store orders at Old Navy. I like their leggings. During the pandemic my size has been sold out for about 4 weeks. I check once and a week and the other day I saw that the Edwardsville, IL store had 4 pairs of my leggings in my size. Since I work in Illinois I decided to place the order and run over to Edwardsville during my lunch break on Saturday. I arrived about 11:30 am. I decided to run in a get the order and not call the number for curbside. When I walked in I was greeted by an associate. I explained I was picking up an online order and she instructed me to wait in the checkout line. Well there were about 20 people in line to check out with 4 registers open and I ended up waiting 15 minutes. The woman behind me in the line did not get the social distancing memo and was standing 1 foot behind me instead of 6 the whole time. If Old Navy is pushing the convenience of buy online/pick up in store then why are we being made to wait in the checkout line? Doesn't that defeat the purpose of buy online? 6/13/2020.

Great local brewery with amazing beers and helpful staff! They offer brewery tours and even yoga on the weekends some times. Great place to stop for a beer to enjoy at the bar or to take home. Glad to have these guys right here in our own backyard!

The steaks are awesome but they've consistently had the worst customer service I've ever seen at both NE locations. For some reason they only hire late teen and 20 something punks with attitude problems. They act like they are too cool to be polite. And even if you kill them with kindness they still won't respond. It's ridiculous.

I was in the other night and my server was Jessica, I was unsure what to get. My friend suggested I tried this place and Jessica helped me decide on what food to order! The food was great and Jessica also suggested a margarita I've never tried before all her recommendations were spot on and the service was great! I'll be back and I'm definitely telling people about my experience!

This is the best salon experience I've been to! The place is designed beautifully, the staff is extremely nice, and everyone is so professional. Tabby did my hair and I couldn't be any happier. She really takes her time in explaining everything and making sure you're satisfied. Also, the lather lounge was my favorite part. So relaxing and unique. However, prices are a little too high. I ended up paying $300+ which I wish they had offers Or first time guest discounts. But you do pay for the quality and the time and effort they put into you. Good service.

THIS FOOD IS AMAZING. I've eaten at some of the best restaurants all over the country, and I've never had food this pretty that also tasted this good. We had a squid and chive pancake with elderberry sourgum vinegar that is my new answer to "If you could only eat one thing for the rest of your life...?"
I would say it's worth the drive from Broad Ripple, but on the way home I realized that it's not really far at all. It was faster to get to this part of town right across from Woodruff Place than it was to get downtown. 
Beholder gets everything right: food, atmosphere, music, and service.

TO DIE FOR! Awesome sweets & treats with a super friendly staff! Love this place - authentic & traditional Italian bakery - don't walk, run ... as fast as you can (at top speed) to get there! Since you already burned off calories, eat anything you want cause it's ALL good! YUM

Went last night for my birthday & the food, as always, was delicious. Nate, our waiter, was excellent as well. The only thing was the hostess. She was extremely rude to my partner & I when we walked in & repeated to us multiple times we were late (by 3 minutes) & that they were having their company party. We felt very rushed & unwelcomed by her specifically, especially as she continue to stare us down our entire meal. We're sorry it was your party that you were very obviously eagerly awaiting but her attitude was no excuse. I wish that it would've been communicated to us that they were closing early too- we would've eaten somewhere else.

My fiance and I went into Tampa over the holiday week last week and we went to the aquarium. Afterwards we asked an information center where was a nice place to eat and was referred to the Columbia Cafe. We went into this place not knowing what was going on or how their business was run. When we walked up to the outdoor area there wasn't anyone there to seat you and we walked inside to find out how the seating worked, was told by a waitress inside to just seat ourselves and if we wanted to we could sit outside. So we found a table outside that wasn't dirty and sat down. Waited for at least twenty minutes for a waiter to come over and give us menus. Then another fifteen minutes for them to come back over and take our order. I ordered the 1/2 1905 salad and 1/2 Cuban sandwich both were very good in my opinion. I especially loved the salad but the service was horrible. After a two hour lunch that shouldn't have taken that long the great food just didn't measure up for the experience.

I could not believe the service at this place.  I have never seen a server walk so slow or get so many things wrong in our order.  Our food took forever to get - I ordered the Goat Roti and I got the Curry Goat Platter by mistake, which was 75% bone and fat.  It was pretty good, but not nearly good enough to make up for the horrible experience.  My friend got a shrimp kabob platter that had 4 over cooked shrimp on it and it was $19.  WTF. Major fail of a restaurant.  I could see how college kids would think it was a cool hang out, but really it is just a greedy stinking hole of a place.

You know how you go to Italian Restaurants like...."ROMANO's Macaroni Grill"... Who is ROMANO? What does he stand for...

Giorgio on Pine is NOT like that.... Giorgio is what makes this restaurant.  He is a nice older man who cares about his restaurant.

The food was declious, and although I had a meat dish, I should have chosen the pasta because it was probably even more delicious than what I was eating.

If you are a gluten free person, they have an entire gluten free menu.

The service was a tad slow, but we had a big group and we were getting a little crazy off our BYO Wine.

Highly recommend!!

I've been attending for at least 20 years and agree that this year was disappointing.  But want to flag anyone attending with a physical or cognitive disability unable to drink directly from bottles (water, soda, etc).  The Overlook food court does not have straws or cups this year.  I agree with the need to cut down on paper and plastic waste but some people have limitations.  I brought someone with Alzheimer's who cannot manage bottle.  Fortunately, a cashier went into the storeroom and got me a cup but I'm certain I wasn't the only visitor in need.  PHS markets the show extensively to older people and promotes its accessibility but no one seems to have considered this.
Perfect lunch spot! Yummy and many different chicken salads from sweet to spicy to savory ones. I really enjoyed their chicken tortilla soup too! Will come back!

I used to love Panera, and I've spent many, many afternoons here eating their succulent soups and salads, but I am thoroughly distraught by their new prerogatives to disrupt the democracy of food! 

My sole request is that Panera bring back the "steak and blue cheese salad." This salad, which was launched in 2011, was a customer favorite across the country. If you simply google the salad, you'll find the Facebook post littered with comments demanding that Panera bring it back. The 23rd of March would mark its 8 year anniversary, but alas, I digress. 

This is an ultimatum. Bring back the Steak and Blue cheese salad and this will be a 5 star review, OR, reject popular demand and wallow in a sea of one-star reviews. 

Thank you and good day.
Very nice establishment, attentive wait staff, and lovely atmosphere. The pan fried pot stickers are wonderful!
Haley was a joy to work with. Professional service as always. I have used Joy's Flowers for years and I've never been disappointed.  Call today and tell them Ms. Sheila said to call.

Typical Jersey Diner maybe a little better than average.  Clean inside.  

I always get breakfast here it seems, which most diners seem to be at least decent at.  My go to dish is a Bacon, Spinach, and Feta Omelet.  Omelets are fresh, fluffy, and cooked perfectly.  Never greasy.  Pretty big too.  Maybe 4 eggs worth?  Puts Ihop to shame.  Generous parts of bacon, feta, and spinach too.  Comes with toast and FRESH homefries, not the old gross ones.  You know what I'm talking about.  Which is a lot to ask for in most diners after the early morning. 

Service has always been attentive and pleasant.  A solid 3 star diner.  Nothing more, nothing less, but a solid choice in the Hainesport area.

So the food is good, but the service is poor. One of the ladies at the register was depressed and moody where we asked her a simple question, and she replied with a no and shook her head, slowly. Not very happening or happy in comparison to other places.

I just left here and literally I feel the same way I did when I entered. Still have the tension in my neck, back and arms despite 50 min of massage! Smh. I'm so annoyed right now. Total waste of time and money. I have been getting massages for years (here in the US as well as outside the US) and have never had this experience. Despite voicing my dissatisfaction, all that was said was I'm sorry to hear that! I paid my bill and left. Will not return!

I ate here for dinner last week with a few friends.  We were all very happy with our food.  The service was great - we received our food and drinks very promptly.  They were also very flexible with us despite the fact that we had my friend's 3 yr old daughter with us.  I would say that it's a great place to go both as a family or even as a date night.

I found this place and was amazed. It's the type of place you always want to find.  I wouldn't have been surprised to have found it from diners drive ins and dives. I have in my life have found ribs this good.  Mike has made smoking meat his obsession. You will not be disappointed. I recommend it highly

One of the few places I can get a burger that's in any way satisfying. However, the temperature of the burger is hit or miss. I order it MEDIUM and hope for the best. It usually comes out half-medium rare and half medium. But, I've come to learn that this is about as good as burgers get around these parts. There must be better burgers out there somewhere, but until I find them, I'll be content with LongHorn.

Service is usually pretty good unless you get seated in the bar area which, in my experience, sucks. I think this can be attributed to two issues: there were some bad servers in the bar area and the bartender shouldn't be tending bar AND serving tables.

Pretty solid food. Pretty solid service.

I don't even know where to start. OE is not only one of the best restaurants I've ever been to. It is also such a lovely place to be. I could sit in there for hours. The coffee and tea are enough to keep them in business on their own, but throw in the incredible food, shopping, and atmosphere, and you have this amazing gem of a place that I'm sure will be a hot spot for decades to come.

Worst Italian pasta meal we've ever had. 

The service was good, especially during the COVID-19
pandemic. They were very accommodating and polite. The buffalo mozzarella caprese appetizer was good. That's pretty much where the positives end. 

The first two bottles of wine we tried to order were out of stock. Ok, no biggie, we'll order something else. The third one was available and was good, but not as good as what we would have liked. 

My wife ordered a fusilli pasta dish with chicken.  It was overly spicy and had 4 tiny strips of chicken in the entire thing. Not good at all. 

But it gets worse. I ordered the lasagna bolognese, thinking it would be a delicious hearty entree. I've had that at numerous Italian places and it's always been very filling. When this one came out, we were surprised at how small the portion was. It looked like a kitchen sponge covered in sauce. It also had no height to it at all. It was maybe an inch thick tops. I started to try it, and the sauce that it was drowning in was delicious. The lasagna itself - not so much. I tried another bite and same reaction. My wife (who is Italian by the way) then tried it, and she said "what the heck is this?" We proceeded to lift up the sheets of pasta within the "lasagna" to discover that there was literally nothing in between them. No cheese. No sauce. No meat. Just 5 layers of lasagna noodles. No wonder it was so thin! (See pictures for proof). 

The wait staff, again very nice, said that's how theirs is. "It's been that way for 30 years." No clue how that's possible. I've never had anything that pitiful in my life. Neither of us finished our meals. Worst part? We paid nearly a hundred bucks for that crap. Needless to say we won't be back.

We went in for the lunch buffet, and while it isn't going to be earning any awards any time soon, the food was hot and fresh, I really enjoyed the boneless wings that were included, the price was fair, and the restaurant was clean.  I wouldn't go out of my way to go there, but I'd definitely go back again if I were in the area.

Went in here on a Tuesday night. Was planning on watching my college basketball team and aaked if i could have the channel changed on the small tv, but the bartender told me they were about to turn on the Sixers. Nice customer service considering there were more tvs than people in the place. I took my order to go and saved on the beers i would have watched had i stayed there. I live a few blocks away. Won't be back.
Quick Asian food - red tea with passion was very refreshing and the yaki-udon shrimp was better than expected but the shrimp were just a tad too done.

They really need to start paying more, and hiring smarter people at fast food restaurants. I'm am so fucking sick of my order CONSTANTLY being wrong!! And then when you confront them about the mistake, instead of being nice and apologizing and fixing the problem, they just act like I'm the one he did something wrong. UGH!! Customer service is very important if you want your business to succeed. It's not that hard to make tacos and me nice!! Seriously!!
Best pork shoulder I've ever had!! And if you check in they give you a free dry rub bottle to take home. Oh and I highly recommend the apples! Delicious!!
Great service from Seiji and Jeff and the whole crew. Wonderful local feel.  We are smitten before we even took one bite!

While the food is pretty good, the service is terrible. I've been there numerous times and the service just seems to get worse everytime I've gone. The last time I was there, I actually ended up walking out since a server never came to our table after sitting there for 10 minutes watching them talk behind the bar. There are better burger options around.

You know that incessant beeping noise that large construction equipment makes when it backs up? Or the sound of a dump truck's tailgate hitting the back of its truck bed when it's emptying dirt? Or how about the screeching of old equipment that probably should have been oiled months ago? 

Well, move in at Brockton and you'll learn to love all of these sounds. From the 7am beeping and grinding to the 2am dump truck emptying, your dreams will be riddled with beeps and bangs as long as you live here. 

Oh, not to mention the sounds of the state fair train whose tracks are conveniently located within walking distance...which means during state fair week expect to hear a train roll by and toot it's horn (which is a sound probably pretty close the sound of the gates of hell opening) as it passes your building. 

The reason I give this place three stars is because my apartment is nice, the location is awesome, the neighborhood is safe and calm, and the management is nice enough. So there's that.
Had an amazing meal from start to finish here with my GF. Started with sheeps milk ricotta and for my entree had the grilled Mediterranean octopus, which was grilled to perfection.
Just not my favorite.  From North Jersey and I'm serious about pizza.  IMO, it's not very good.

I always receive fantastic service at Serenity. They are always friendly and very punctual with my appointments. Lots of options for nail colors.Today Kim did my pedicure. I got the sugar scrub, it was Amazeballs!

I do really enjoy Allegro. I have tried everything from a Burger to a salad and enjoyed each experience. My favorite of everything presented on the menu is the the Crawfish Carbonara. Words cannot explain how this unique dish warms you with every bite.

The only reason why I did not give this place 5 stars is because service tends to be on the forgetful side and there is no way you can have a simple quick lunch here unless you call ahead to order take away.

Love this dentist!  Dr. York is super nice and professional.  Staff is always so very nice and friendly.  The office is incredibly clean and has all nice equipment.  Dr. York spends time with you and addresses any concerns with each check up.  There is a long wait as a new patient, but it is worth it.  I recommend this office to anyone out in the area.  I am absolutely a fan.

I am trying to remind myself - they just opened, they just opened. And I also want to start off by saying the food I ordered was fabulous. But the whole experience has left me exceptionally disappointed with this company. My husband has been such a fan of Redner Jr. and the potent,flavorful beers his company have produced. I love how much the beer culture has taken over my hometown and happy to know he is a major influence.To start, I know they just opened, but I only come to Tampa about 3-4 times a year. Everytime I try to hit CCB on Spruce when in town, they are TOO busy and I just end up leaving before I can get in the door. When I come back to town this time and heard this place has opened, I coordinated a group of beer fans I went to school with for dinner. 
The day before I call CC Brewpub and ask for a reservation for 8p.m. First time I call, the girl ends of hanging up on me. Okay whatever, I call right back and get it scheduled. She states that she will put me on the list and call me if there are any issues. Great, I thought. I call the day of the reservation confirming everything and the same girl tells me that I was scheduled for 8:30 for my group instead. No excuses or apologies were given on why I wasnt contacted about the change. I'm slightly agitated because now I have to call my group of 9 to make sure everyone knows the new time. No big deal, just annoying. We get there and the place looks great. Cool interior, very busy and I'm just happy to be there. I am now told that they cant sit me until 8:45. Okay whatever, I am meeting some old friends and we are laughing it up outside waiting for our table. Finally, at 9 p.m. we are seated. I apologize to my thristy and hungry group and let them know this place just opened. 
Our waitress, very nice and seemed attentative, but was quick to forget some people's orders. I was served one beer and two waters while one person at the table still hadnt received his first beer. I joked about him getting the short straw and reminding him that this place just opened. We had to track down our waitress to see if he would ever get his beer. On top of that, they were out of half of the beers on the menu. It ended up causing a bit of frustration when you had the waitress continuosly coming up saying that they were out and what other beer would you like. Two people in our party had that happen three times in a row. At one point, one asked the waitress, just tell me what beers you have. Four within the group complained that their beer tasted like hotdog water. I'm glad I stayed with the Florida Cracker which tasted fine to me, after it took two times to remind the waitress to being my second beer to me.
The food, however, was so freakin good. I split the farmers salad and mojo pork rilliettes and was able to try a bite of a friend's burger. Everything was so fresh and well seasoned. I absolutely loved the sofrito on the burger. The food was well presented and just so tasty. 
After the 4th time I caught myself apologizing to my group for the poor service and stating that they just opened, I realized that no one that worked for CC Brewpub actually apologized for the delays, eff ups, poor service, etc. I also realized that they must not have a manager if our table had SO many problems and no one came up to see how everything was going.
I wish Joe Jr. much success. He obviously doesnt need my business because he is in such a great market. However, I am done with this company. I have no interest in ever going back to this restaurant or the brewery, despite how good the beer is.

Just visited, coming from out of town because my purse was breaking. Found this place on yelp with the reviews and drove 30 mins. Came in just 30 mins before closing and Rick saved the day. Great work with a witch easy fix and looks like new. If only I lived here, this would be the place I'd get my shoes done. Thank you so much for your help!
Went based on the high rating, but left disappointed. Starter was fine, main disappointing, (seafood green curry, low on seafood). Rushed service.

The good folks at Faulkner always look out for me when it comes to auto body repair. From  calling a rental car company to pick me up from the shop to being reliable when it comes to keeping me posted on the status of the repairs  and most of all to ensuring I was satisfied with the repairs done, I've never walked away from my time with them feeling unsatisfied. Repairs are seamless.They also stand behind all their work with a written guarantee! Not sure what else there is to say, it doesn't get any better! Be sure to ask from Greg, great guy, he'll take care of you!
This was an overall good first visit. Great atmosphere - the coffee was overall good and the struddles were okay.

Food was pretty good even though my 10 year old didn't care for his "pink" corn dog. French Dip was great, onion soup not so great. Service slow even though it wasn't too busy. I like that they list nutritional info. Pretty shocking how much sodium is used.

Do not go to this place if you are in Clearwater. The waitress forgot a whole food order, as well as drink order. I had to go to the manager in order to "make it right". She blamed the mistake on the kitchen, which in fact was a server order mistake. The managers don't care as well. DO NOT GO HERE

I'm a yelper who doesn't give 5 star off the bat of a new restaurant that just open up, because there is always room to improve in the food and new establishment. Food here is pricey but the portion somewhat match the price in my opinion. The food here is really good but   some of the food I ordered for my wife was really salty including sauce for the chilaquiles. Went there 2 days in a row.
First time there I ordered the los colorados with flank steak xtra charge of $4.99 and the portion was huge that came with red chilaquiles sauce on crispy tortilla chips top with Mexican sour cream and feta cheese, potatoes top with cheese, grilled purple onions, grilled poblano peppers, grilled jalapeños( spicy ) garnish with stem of cilantro and slices of sweet peppers with a side of black beans. Everything was good but the chilaquiles sauce was a little to salty for my liking but it was still good. The strawberry lemonade was really really good but didn't match the price of $4.99, Also order their mole burrito to-go for the wife and this thing was huge when my wife showed it to me lol, it was almost the size of my thigh yes I said "THIGH", filled with ALOT of strip of grilled chicken breast, black beans and cheese covered with mole sauce and sprinkle sesame seed. I was pretty bummed out that it doesn't come with any rice in it. It could easily feed four people, that's how big it was. The chicken was pretty salty and also the mole sauce.
2nd day I went there I ordered the machaca and taco to-go for the wife. I was too hungry to take a picture of the machaca but it my opinion it did not match the price of $16.99 and wish there was one or two more egg scramble into the machaca. Love the juicy and tenderness of the shredded beef in the machaca but it was pretty bland and I had to add salt and pepper. Scramble with eggs, shredded beef, diced tomatoes, sarano peppers, onions and cilantro with one small scoop of diced potatoes top with cheese then put in a salamander to broil making the cheese melt and turn crispy, which I like, but wish there was more potatoes. Taco which was $11.99 for two matched the price since there was alot of steak meat serve with house made purple tortilla but with all that meat the tortilla ripped when picking it up trying to take a bite. Basically street taco but huge like the size of my forearm huge. Top with diced raw onions, chopped cilantro and guacamole with grilled onions and a side of lime wedges. Love the house made tortilla, always a plus for me, but the steak meat was very salty and almost overpowered the taco. Love the clay plate they serve the food on. Salsa was just ok but good for breakfast. They charge xtra on things you want with your breakfast for additional charge but doesn't stated any prices on the menu including the prices for the lemonade drinks but I hope they soon put it on the menu for the customer's to see.
Wish I could eat here 3 or 4 times a week but it will definitely put a dent in my wallet. Overall I like this place and their location. Will definitely be back to try their other breakfast dish.

I would give no stars if I could.  When you call their number, you get bounced to a call center (which I did not know).  The call center told me they would arrive at a concrete time.  They said "no problem"!!  That's why I hired them.   I also told them that the street we were moving from was a small street so they would send the right size truck.  This was for a one bedroom move.    When the rep called to go over details of the move I reiterated about the time and the size of the street.  After he googled the street, I was told they could not do the move, their truck would not be able to get down the street.  He also said there was no way they could commit to a certain time.  I was left without a mover 4 days before the move.  Left us high and dry!!!!  No help, no alternatives, just said they couldn't do it.

This is the only place we stay when we are in Reno, which is about 2-3 times a year. They have the best players club by far. Most of the dealers are very friendly. The rooms are modern, clean, and comfortable. We bring our young daughter most of the time and it's great that they have many dining options AND family fun options.

The dining is pretty good, except the buffet has been less than average every time I have gone (3 times so far... I finally just stopped eating there). The drink staff in the casino is friendly but it's hit or miss on the speed. Sometimes they will ask every 10 mins. Then there are times I'm at a table for 45+ minutes before someone will come to the table. So the one star off is for the buffet and the sometimes very subpar (but other times, great) drink service. But it hasn't deterred us from returning over and over again. In fact, we are on our way there today.
Coolest bar in Santa Barbara hands down. Nice beer, great feel and awesome music. The bar tender was really friendly and the pool is free! Love this place!

Basin has a great happy hour with a bunch of 4$ dishes- all very decent. The fried pickle side is worth it, they're good. The charbroiled oysters were excellent. The beignet was alright. The ceviche was good. The fish tacos were very good. Nice selection of beers. Service was great. I'd give a 3.5 star review but you get a 4 instead!

Oooooooooo yummy! So glad this Restaurant opened! It is not your typical pizza restaurant by any means! The restaurant itself is on the smaller side, but they do have outdoor seating. We prefer to sit at the bar, because you get to watch your food be made, and the guys making the pies are friendly and will fill you in on the ingredients you're about to eat! 

Our favorite dishes there are the meatballs, and the Pauli G pizza. The meatballs come 3 to an order, and are fantastic! The Pauli G has a "sauce" that isn't really a sauce, but rather some kind of honey with Sriracha or something added into it to make it a spicy sweet flavor. The crust is on the thinner side, and prepared in a Neapolitan style 900* oven. 

If you're looking for someplace different to satisfy that pizza craving we all get, give this place a try! You'll leave satisfied, but bot stuffed! Yummy!

I wish I would have read the reviews about these idiots before I agreed to do business with them. I'll never ever in life recommend these people to anyone. It doesn't matter if you pay ahead on your car note, you'll still end up owing them more than you should. I doubled my note for almost a year and it does not reflect on my balance. When you tell them to apply what you paid extra to the principal, they lie and say that they did when they didn't. Then they'll send some bs spreadsheet showing absolutely nothing. I've already contacted my attorney about this company. Beware and stay away.

This is probably my new favorite pastry shop. It's super cute and quaint. The decor is very vintage and Rustic at the same time. The staff was super sweet and helpful even getting my puppy a bowl of water. The pastries are to die for. And it's even more awesome that they have an open kitchen where you can watch them work. Super perk $1 macaroons on Wednesday's.

I fell in love with Panera because of their Thai chicken salad and chicken salad sandwich. However, at this Panera, they did not accomplish that satisfaction of either. I barely had any chicken salad on my croissant and my Thai chicken salad didn't have ANY chicken. How does one forget the chicken in a Thai chicken salad?
This place is absolute garbage.  Do not eat the food or order through DoorDash.  Don't waste your money.  I'm so upset I order this crap.

One of our family go to place for a night out. Kids love the pasta options while there is something for everyone. Usually left overs for next few days! The order did take a long time when we were there but manage threw in a free appetizer which was nice. Great standard similar to other Maggiano's. Always busy so make sure you have reservations!

Very poor service and don't care attitude. Placed an order online and was told it would be ready in 30 minutes. I arrived 30 minutes later to see a 8-10 others waiting for their orders. After waiting another 45 minutes with queries by me and others the order finally came. No apologies to me or any other customer even when orders were wrong. The few people dining in faced loooong waits as well.
Great spot to get wings, beers and watch sports. The servers are always friendly.

I went to The Dandelion for the second time last week and it was amazing...again!  My husband and I happened upon this place in the spring and loved it!  The bartender was amazing the first time and the second time and so was the food. Last week I was in Philly for work and brought co-workers in. They loved the food and the scene. I live in Baltimore, but visit Philly a few times a year. We look forward to our next visit to the Dandelion.

I normally go to Tea Do, their drinks have never failed me.  I was with a group of friends and Tea Do was completely packed, so we decided to try Tea Magic across the street.  It was almost completely empty, which should have been a red flag.  We were a party of 7 so at least there were tables for us here.  

I ordered a mango milk tea and I could literally bite on the powder they use to make it... The two girls making bubble tea here also don't have the proper shakers as they were doing everything by hand, which took forever to crank out drinks for 7.  

The atmosphere was different though, we could actually hear ourselves speak.  But after all, this is a bubble tea place, and it was terrible.

Okay, this place is great. Not too big but very cozy and comfortable to be in. Staff is great and friendly and make you feel valued as a customer. I truly appreciate the feeling that they're not just there to sell to you and get your money, but rather the fact that they actually want you to have a good experience in their restaurant. That really boosts their customer experience! 

Now lets talk about the food - I went with the chicken tamales. The flavor was out of this world! The sides were black beans and a delicious chicken ceviche, completely worth the go. 

100% would come back.

Second time here and the service is horrible. I put my order in a half hour ago no food no waitress. The don't seem to come back to check on refills you have to chase them down. Food is good but the service just sucks. I thought it was just our waiter last time but evidently it the whole operation that is slow.

We got the chicken sandwich with broccoli rabe, side of salad and French fries.....and shrimp tacos and butternut squash soup with side salad. 

Best thing we had from each of our entree were the butternut squash soup which was really flavorful and the French fries with garlic Parmesan and truffle oil.
The chicken sand which tastes more burnt then the tasting the chicken or broccoli rabe.  Shrimp taco tasted very regular
Taco shell cold and chewy. Actually hurt my teeth. Almost smelled liked old rancid grease. Meat was good. Cheese and lettuce cold. If the shell would have been good would have got 4 stars.

Three weeks ago I flew from LA to Tampa to undergo parathyroid surgery from Dr. Norman and Dr. Lopez. The experience was outstanding. The staff was terrific. Dr. Norman is as advertised and has a very deserved sterling reputation. Highly recommended.
Peacemaker was good. The staff was very knowledgeable on their menu and drink selection. The drinks were refreshingly different.

Excellent customer service with delicious food and beer.  Mistakes happen, there was a computer glitch.  Everyone was really nice and acted quickly and it was like my order didn't get lost in the internet land.  Management really knows how to handle an issue smoothly and all the staff as well.  I went here because of the one in my hometown and was not let down, I am so happy to have one in Reno!!

My boyfriend and I were looking for Korean food without having to travel into Philly and this place came up on my radar. We decided to give it a shot and went for lunch. We went right when it opened at 11 AM and were greeted very enthusiastically from the get-go. We ordered rabokki as an appetizer and a spicy pork dolsot and a dolsot bibimbap. Everything was delicious and the side dishes were good as well! It was a little pricey, but there was more than enough food for us to take home leftovers for a second meal, so well worth it in my opinion.

My favorite sandwich spot in Goleta, hands down!! Can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Only criticism would be that the wait time for a sandwich can be long sometimes, but it's because it's usually busy.
Top notch all the way. Inventive, fresh, exciting food.  The vibe is elegant and relaxed.   Excellent customer services.  Ellen and Eli deliver the best of the best!

I'm shocked. The bouncer shoved a girl in our party out of the bar for absolutely no reason. It is one thing to ask someone to leave. A completely different thing to push an individual. We asked to speak with the manager, he started calling us a bunch of "bi*ches" and wouldn't listen. I would never support any sort of disrespectful treatment as it was at Bourbon Cowboy. Please pick a bar where the bouncers treat their customers with more respect.

Very good food i was able to get in right away came to the bar. Food was great service everything wasgood today! But the food is amazing ! I say them totally at 1:56 seat a party of 10 that had a birthday and the entire staff didn't get mad they treated them as if they came in at 12.  Very good attitude i will be back!

Arrived around 11am Sat and around half the tables were empty, but still a 45 min. Wait due to "kitchen backup". Not happy, but already through $4 in the parking meter, so just waited. Ordered the French dip and fries. The sandwich was very tasty, just wish the bread was a tad softer. Enjoyed the fries. Also ordered the quiche and it was good. Mimosas poured perfectly with just a splash of OJ.
Wait staff was personable and efficient. The initial wait was the only drawback, but will return, maybe to try happy hour.

Consistently excellent food! I come here every time I'm in the area, and I can honestly say that I've never had a bad meal. Everything I ever try is delicious, which makes it hard to order because I can never decide what to get, because it's all so good!
Plenty of seating inside and it's seat yourself, so just walk in and grab an open table. It gets kind of crowded at lunch, so it pays to get there a little before 11:00.
Service is very friendly, but a bit slower than at other restaurants. I'm OK with that... quality takes time, and it's worth the extra few minutes' wait.
If you're nearby, you really need to stop in and try this place, it's a hidden gem.
Food is consistently good. Great atmosphere and excellent service. Ceased salad made table side is the best

New to Franklin, this decades old franchise is still wowing diners while some competing Italian food chains are ruining their staple recipes. That and the large number of customers waiting for seats were unexpected. The only remnant of the original franchise that built the space is the building exterior. The interior immediately welcomes you to the new experience with an old friend.
The salad and breadsticks still rock. Many old favorites remain on the menu and some new items are sure to please. The new Lasagna Dip with pasta chips is meravigliosa! Surprisingly, there are also pasta nachos reminiscent of the previous franchise (good things do occasionally find ways of hanging around!)
While I despise tabletop checkout terminals, this location still maintains a personal touch through its wait staff. Your mileage may vary, but it's a good trend that I hope they'll be able to continue!

When you buy a used car from dealership, you are expecting some security and are willing to pay for it. Maybe not over 4k from sales price, but to certain amount it would make sense. 
They preform "inspection", charge ridiculous amount for it, and at the end you get a car that you need to spend additional few thousands in the first week! 
After you use common sense to get the inspection money back from the obviously broken car, they simple ignore you. 
What a scam their business is......

I love their food
My favorites:
House wonton, crab Rangoon, Szechuan beef, shrimp and scallops in garlic sauce, Moo Shu Shrimp, and shrimp lo mein
The best park in Edmonton for kids!! Picnic sites, a pond, huge rock climbing, two large playgrounds and a huge splash park. I will drive far for this park anyday.
Good food at reasonable prices.  Recommending the deviled crab.  Drink and dessert included in the price of the meal.  Delicious comfort food.  Very good experience dining here.

Talk about wasting my time. I made an appointment two days ahead of time and was told someone would show up between 9 AM and noon. At 11:30 AM I got a call from the office saying someone would call me A half an hour before they get here. Got a call at 12:30 from a man who said he was the technician that was going to fix my door. Did not need my door fixed I was looking for a quote on a new door and garage door opener. This man asked me if overhead door was the only company I have called, when I said no he asked me how many other companies I have called, and when I told him two other companys he said do this, call me after they show up and I'll beat their price.
Ah.....no. 3.5 hrs I wasted. 
Ill pass thank you.
Great tasting side items. Meat is average I've had better and I've had worse but the good thing is it's always consistent and friendly service.

Very honest and thorough! 
I was referred to DiNardo by my local tire guy, I had been having problems with my VW Passat and needed it fixed before I headed on a trip to MD. I called and they were able to see me the next day.  They took a great deal of time and care in diagnosing the car and I could not be happier with the result.  Thanks Guys
A great way of spending a Saturday afternoon.  I like the idea of just hanging out right from the source of great beer.  Pretty inexpensive and does not have a bad location either.

My family and I were on vacation in Goleta for the holidays and were roving around Calle Real, starving from our hike. We decided to park in a strip mall near our hotel and wished out loud that an Indian restaurant would plant itself in front of us. So when The India Club turned up a couple steps ahead of us, my sister and I forged forward and the parents reluctantly followed. 

We came in time to take advantage of the lunch specials, which include naan, rice and daal. We ordered were Channa masala (chickpeas), palak paneer (spinach with cheese), and Baingan bhartha (eggplant dish) for the vegetarians, and my dad ordered a lamb sheeshk kabob. The channa masala was the biggest surprise--usually when I order it, it's just so that we'll have some kind of non-meat fiber/protein nutrients rather than because we actually like it. But the channa masala at The India Club had wonderful spices in it and was quite flavorful. The palak paneer felt healthier than it does at restaurants in the South Bay because it had less cream and visible strands of greens instead of being totally blended, which gave it great texture. The lamb sheesk kabob comes with grilled onions and was also delicious. 

A serious plus of this restaurant is the self-serve toppings bar, which includes mint chutney (medium spicy) and never-ending raita! This is a huge deal for my family because we are yogurt fiends, and I was starting to feel embarrassed at how many times we went back up for more. Another motivation for my 5 star review is the attentive staff. We were checked on many times for anything we needed. The restaurant has TVs playing Bollywood songs and plays music hand-selected by the server/cashier, Amir! When I asked him about who the artist was, he even offered to burn it to a CD before we returned home. How awesome is that? His CD was our soundtrack of choice for the rest of our roadtrip. 

Thank you Amir for your kindness and to The India Club for the wonderful food!

Duck Sauce is great.  Defintely the best option for Chinese and asian fusion anywhere around.  

The atmosphere can be alittle snooty (as is the area in general) but I have a feeling that's more the other customers than the establishment.  I have gone here dressed casually and nobody has looked twice and the service was excellent. 

The food is flavorful, not at all overdone and presented really beautifully. This is one of my favorite places to go all year round.

Matt Berry is the man. He is the Senior Salesman and is a great guy. On the service side, they have been great to me. Anytime my car needs an overnight stay they always provide me with a loaner. 

I had the pleasure of meeting Mr. Maher before he passed and he was a really nice man who was happy to meet me. He seemed to really appreciate my business. Very down to earth guy and it seems that his family is running the dealership with the same values.
Best Thai Restaurant ever! Loved the pad spicy as recommended on the extensive menu and I nearly cried at how good the crying tiger salad is. Definitely coming back!

First time trying their churros.. Delicious!
I would definitely recommend if you like churros

Where everybody knows your name, 
and they're always glad you came. 
You wanna be where you can see, 
our troubles are all the same 
You wanna be where everybody knows 
Your name. 

There are plenty of awesome neighborhood bars in New Orleans, but most of them require you being in that neighborhood.  The trick to the Quarter is how to avoid the masses, that giant sucking action that emanates from Bourbon Street.  That's where Good Friends comes in.

It's an open space, not too crowded, and welcoming and friendly of people gay, straight, or whatever.  A-holes not welcome.  And the good news is that they don't make it past Bourbon Street.

Decent drinks, two levels including a balcony, a pool table...what's not to like?  I enjoyed coming here with a friend on a Saturday night and even finding a comfy couch to land on.  People talked to us.  Interesting, not-completely-wasted, not-after-something, friendly people.

A+, Good Friends.  I'm a fan.
The staff I encounter are always pleasant and polite. I stop here once a week and have never had a problem with my order.

This place is a cute little Jamaican spot located in Uptown New Orleans! 

They have frequent events and "themed nights" here featuring live music, poetry, open mic, and even live art paintings!

The staff here is soooo inviting and the customer service, atmosphere, and entire vibe is out of this world! 

The "Calaloo" is similar to the southern soul food dish "Greens". They were so tender and seasoned so well! I also got an opportunity to try the jerk chicken and all I can say is WOW!!! 

I've definitely found a new place to eat away my worries!

A couple frozen margaritas with patron may have biased the experience a little, but I have some pretty sweet memories at Juan's. Mostly, that the luau quesadilla and the pork n' slaw tacos were mighty tasty and that the super nachos grande hit the spot (as nachos grande usually do, but super-ly so). Everything, including shrimp, chips, pineapple, and salsa, tasted really fresh and homemade. Yeah it's not "authentic" and it's no fancy joint, but it serves its purpose. Although I do remember service being spotty and the place closing reallyyy early.

There is real quality  there. The caveat, they use a lot of canola oil which no 1st  class bakery would. But on the other hand they will make with real butter and do if you call ahead and those products are very fine.

I would give them zero stars if I could. I contracted with them to replace two garage doors.  I had problems....  it took me four months to resolve and staying on their case every other week (dedicating my day off).  I didn't receive the leadership or ownership of my job that I expected from the Home Depot name.  I still didn't get exactly what I ordered, but finally got them to a point where the product was acceptable.

I hadn't had a chance to swing by this Target since I moved to Reno. Being close to the Christmas holidays I wanted to pick up some inexpensive gifts to have for the neighbors and friends that swing by during this festive season.

I have found that most targets are basically the same, with the exception of some that don't have a food section. This one did and had some good prices too.

I really like the dog toy section. Most of the good "Kong" brand they had for $10 each, and I also got my dog a very cute sweater for the holidays. They also had these different size cheese board gifts for, $10, $15 or $30 sizes. I got several of the $10.99 pack because I actually opened one up on thanksgiving and we really liked it. And i was very aware of the "Hickory Farms" brand that I grew up with. 

The holiday collection of all types of wrapping paper, bows, boxes and just perfect stocking stuffers. This store was very neat, clean and organized. I just adore when a store has a strategy for placing all the holiday offerings in the same area...at least the stuff I'm looking for.

The checking out line was pretty brutal but it was a Friday afternoon! It was a good one but pretty far for me when I have other similar shopping choices nearby.

I have used wright's for take out lunch many times. I have not had a sandwich or salad that I have not liked there. The fruit and cheese platter is really nice for a group. Also they are known for their cakes. You can get an entire cake or just a slice. Either way it's AMAZING!

Very annoyed. Received email about setting up reservation for the night of a concert. Filled out # of people and time - it was noted we would be contacted for confirmation and payment info. Received a call - missed it - called back - left message - call returned days later (I assumed they didn't call on weekends). Second missed call/call back and now am told no availability.  It was obvious I was still interested as my numerous attempts to call. They need to change their system- it's broken. Very unprofessional.

I was recently purchasing several items from Sam Levitz about $7000.00 and there was a wall unit for 119.00 and I needed to measure prior to purchasing. When I went back in days later not months this wall unit increased by 60.00. Seems odd because it is during the 4th of July sale. I guess Sam Levitz raises the prices during their sales! I did asked to speak to management but the girl in the office explained that's just how it works, she has nothing to do with sales and I explained that's why wanted to talk to the manager she was very polite and said sorry there was nothing else she could do for me. Hopefully this saves someone else the frustration of dealing with this location.

Went here last night for a business meeting. The menu was very limited and I wanted a slight modification performed to an entree because I have a food allergy. The waiter explained that he needs to "check with his captain" and that it wouldn't be a problem. 20 minutes later he comes back and says that his captain told him no. 

We had to continuously ask for drink refills, including wine. Very disappointing considering the premium price you're paying. 

It's a very interesting atmosphere, but unfortunately I wanted a positive dining experience from start to finish - they did not deliver. If you need modifications to dishes for any reason, I would advise against going here.

My bf and I love this place!  The staff is always friendly and quick to remember frequent customers.  The food is always fresh, well seasoned and delicious.  Everything I've tried there is good, but I must say, their falafel is the best I've had in Nashville.  I also recommend their Philly made with chicken instead of steak-- but honestly, as I mentioned before, everything I've tried there has been excellent.  Cizars is not just the run of the mill same old, same old gyro place like the others on Gallatin Rd.  If you're reading this, trying to decide if you should try it, do yourself a favor & just and call in your order.  It'll be ready in 10 mins!

This was my first time coming here and wasn't sure what to expect, but my wife and grandson had been here a couple of times.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because they don't put any cheese on their tacos and I didn't realize it until it was too late and had gotten them home to eat.  The tacos were very good and the ladies working there that night were very sweet.

Would I come back here again?  Definitely I'd come back and try something different next time.  Not far away from the house and not very expensive, compared the other restaurants in the area.

We only been here twice in a life time and for good reason. When you walk in there you never really feel welcome the atmosphere is snotty at best. Some of the staff are grumpy not warm and inviting. I think this restaurant cater's to the regulars not people visiting for the first time. We always get a grumpy waitress named Hannah she was not engaging to us but to everyone else she was fine. It is a shame when they treat the regulars better than the ones who may be back it they were not so snotty. This food was expensive and nothing to write home about. I do not see all the fuss about this place it is average at best.

I love L&M bakery. I'm not a sweets person, but I never pass anything up if I know it came from here. This is where we get our goodbye cakes for coworkers who leave, and over the years, i have never been disappointed in the taste. The only small complaint I have is that the first time I personally put in an order, the paperwork for it got stuck somewhere unusual. When my proxy arrived to pick it up on the designated day, they could not locate the order for about 45 minutes and it left me very stressed as I was not sure if we would be getting a cake. Aside from that, I have never had any issues here.

Worst experience ever! I brought a used 2007 toyota corolla and it broke down a week after purchasing the vehicle. The managers are very unprofessional and disrespectful. They get mad at you for them selling you a messed up car. I will never buy a car from them again and I will never recommend this place to anyone! Run fast!

Healthy mongolian grill in a fast-casual environment.
