Step 1: Pick your protein!  They have chicken, pork, beef, shrimp, tofu, or you can just get veggies.

Step 2: Pick your sauce!  They have BBQ Black Bean, Sweet & Sour, Special Sauce, Ginger Sesame, General "Not-So-Tso's", Spicy Sichuan, and Kung Pao sauce.  

Step 3: Pick any four of their fresh veggies!  Each additional veggie is only .35 cents.  They have white onions, celery, green pepper, red pepper, baby corn, carrots, green beans, snow peas, broccoli, mushrooms, and zucchini.  

Step 4: Select your base! You can have brown rice or white rice for free but they also have fried rice, egg noodles, and whole wheat noodles.  

You order at the counter and they will give you a buzzer but they actually brought mine out to my table which I thought was really nice.  They have free hot green tea and strawberry fortune cookies to enjoy while you wait.  

They have several tasty dim sum options and a Coca-Cola freestyle machine.  I just noticed on their website they have some good-looking desserts that I'll have to try next time. Also you can order online and they have a loyalty club.  

Why are there not more locations? I love this place!  I can't wait to go back and try different combinations until I find my favorite.

Decent all you can eat hot pot place. Large selection of hot pot food. Came here with a group of 6 on a Saturday night and it was pretty busy. If you have a big group on the weekends, def make reservations. We got three flavors of broth for the big pot. The tum yum broth was probably my favorite one. $24.99 per person includes AYCE hot pot and sushi/sashimi. The sashimi pieces are cut into pretty small pieces.

I usually don't write reviews but I was so impressed with our experience. Our food was good and so was the service. Exactly what I expect grabbing something to eat during a shopping day but a manager came to just check on us. He was so sincere and welcoming without being interrupting. It was such a change to find that type of friendly professionalism in a casual restaurant. Thank you Michael. We will see you again.
We have been with Quality Degree now a few years - the technicians are very professional, friendly and seem to care about doing a good job.  We will continue to have our maintenance contract with QD.

Why can't this place be located in Seattle? As great as Seattle is supposed to be for vegan food, we have yet to find a non-Asian one that is truly great (the vegetarian/vegan Asian food here is pretty spectacular). Lo and behold where do we find  knock your socks off vegan food? Boise and at a BBQ place no less. Now they do serve carnie food here, but they claim they have the best vegan food in Boise. I don't know if that claim is true, but what we had was excellent. Extra star for serving up delicious BBQ that my husband can actually eat! 

My husband went for the BLT (with tempeh), and I went for the smoked squash sandwich. He was a bit disappointed with his because he had asked that the veganaise be left off and it wasn't. I maybe should have taken a star off for that, but I thought the sandwich was a great representation of a BLT. As for my smoked squash sandwich. Oh my. I have never eaten anything like that before and it truly made my week. Fantastic. 

As for the kids, not being vegetarian my son ordered the pulled pork kid sandwich and my daughter the mac n cheese. The pulled pork is legit (I'm not strictly vegetarian and will eat bites of meat from time to time). Mac n cheese was pretty standard. Kids loved it. 

We asked to try several of their BBQ sauces. We were worried that the chocolate one would be too sweet but it wasn't. They were very good and very unique.

Dr. E is the best! I started going to him during a tooth crisis and he got me in right away, even though I wasn't one of his regular patients. He was caring and honest and got me on the path to tooth success. What I found most impressive was that he called me at home after hours to check on me and my sick tooth to make sure things were feeling better. I have never had that experience with any doctor or dentist. Since then, each appointment has been thorough, professional and pleasant from all staff members. I have been to various providers in town and this office is on a whole different level. As a medical professional, I feel confident in his care. Highly recommended.

I came here with such low expectations. Boy was I wrong! 5 full stars for service and flavor. 

Trust me. I did not want to like this place for the simple fact that I could get/make (so I thought) cheaper Asian food in Nashville.

Reason why I came:
Yelp reviews and this was basically my old stomping ground. Yup, back a little less than ten years ago when it used to be called Mai then Anthem (shows my age?). I sure hope they sanitized the heck out of this place. Anyway....!

Service:
Our server, CHRIS, was amazing! We were seated in the second floor and he was so attentive. He described every entre and answered all our questions. He really was a very good server so a huge shoutout to him!


Food:
Now, let's get to the chase.
1. SUI MAI: It was delicious. Flavor and presentation were there. However, I thought it was quite dry. The meat was cooked right but man, I grew up in the Philippines where Chinese food was everywhere and my cousins are Chinese. I'm quite biased but it was still good.

2. WHOLE CHICKEN: Laaaaawdddddddd! This is really what converted me. It.was.DELICIOUS! You just get this. Idk how the heck they make it but it was so moist and yet the skin was crispy! They present you the chicken before they chop it up so that was neat. My husband and I shared the whole chicken and we still had left overs!

3. BEER SELECTION: my husband was surprised that they had la fin du monde and I also had Ballast Point which was beer infused with mango flavor. Delicious!

Ambiance:
The restaurant is beautiful. I really couldn't believe the transformation of the place. It's a great place for groups or date nights. Btw- there is another bar upstairs should you find the one downstairs full.

I can't believe I'm saying this... I really said I will never come back and only try this place once but man!!!! I look forward to trying their other dishes. I had a wonderful time!

"Bruegger's bagels bakers bake a better bagel," is  bodacious slogan, but true.  This alliteration is right on target because they start with fresh no-preservative ingredients and bake their bagels fresh daily at each location. This Belle Meade Bellevue location is near the fork of highway 70 & highway 100.

La Piedad is one of our favorite Mexican restaurants of all time! And we're picky! We still drive a ways to visit when we have a craving. Sometimes there's a line to get a table if the weather is nice, but it's worth it. Their drinks and queso are really good. The food is too, of course! It's another one of those places where you really can't go wrong with what you order.

The beignets are light and deliciously airy. The coffee rich and full bodied.... Definitely much better than Café Du Monde, (disclaimer) in my opinion. Skip the tourist trap, and instead, go to the mom 'n pop shop around the corner.

With the rustic charm of its reclaimed wood interior, the über friendly waitstaff and of course, the tasty burgers, dogs, fries and shakes the KOP Shake Shack Rocks! Perfect location for a pre movie meal and a quick post movie stop for a concrete for the ride home. You won't be sorry!

Had a weekday lunch there ($11.25).  As other reviewers have mentioned, the slices are HUGE.  I had two and was stuffed (next time I'll have one slice and try a side).  

The crust was good, not too doughy.  The service was very good.  

The pizza was VERY greasy--I was able to pour off at least a teaspoon per slice.  That's not a deal-killer for me, so I'll be back sometime when I'm on the south side.

6/25/2018 - We decided to visit West Chester for the day. We wanted to find a place with outdoor seating to enjoy the great weather. After looking at different places and menus we were not convinced, then, we found Teca. After a look at their extensive menu, we knew this was the place. We walked in to the restaurant to speak with the hostess and as we walked in to their lovely colorful restaurant we decided to sit inside. Plus, they had both the Spain game and Portugal game in all the TV's. 

We sat at the bar and met our nice and knowledgeable bartender Josh. He gave us a background on this family owned restaurant and also recommended their featured Spanish red wine, Isabella Bobal, D.O. Ribera del Jucar. After hearing the specials we went with his recommendation of stuffed figs wrapped in prosciutto with arugula, peppers topped with a balsamic glaze. Also, a fresh tomato, cucumbers, onions, avocado and cheese salad. 

The prosciutto on the figs was cooked through, crispy and crunchy which made that goey cheesy middle just melt in your mouth. It is the ultimate flavor explosion with the sweet and juicy fig, and the salty, crunchy prosciutto. YUM! The salad was super fresh and just so pretty, colorful!. Josh was telling us how they get their tomatoes from a local farm. 

We only had the wine and these two appetizers because we were visiting for the day and wanted to try out more places but, I would definitely come back for a meal! 

Thank you Josh for all the West Chester recommendations!
Custom ordered tile for our home.  Came faster than anticipated  and not one bit of damaged.
Hands down the best Mexican food I have ever tasted. The dishes are pure genius. This is truly eatable art!

I Dream of Dive Bars!!
Nothing better than a great dive bar!! This one does beer, lots of beer, and at $2.25 a bottle, you'll never beat it. No food, but I can deal with that. Pool tables, darts, pinball, and newer electronic games. Bar maids were fantastic, and sweet as could be, unless you're a regular, then I guess you're fair game. Fun atmosphere, especially where it was NFL playoffs weekend!
Highly Recommend
Service wasn't bad but they make bad tasting pizza. Papa John's as a whole makes disgusting pizza so I didn't expect much
Great food, great service, and the place is really cute.  Get the gnocchi. Everyone is friendly and accommodating.  Love it!!!!
very interesting menu of well prepared foods from around the world prepared with a flair, impeccable service and BYOB.  only caveat is decor a little uninspiring but well worth a visit

Honestly don't want to give them this low of a rating but after today I have to. This place has always been one of my go to spots as it's located in nearby trolley. The jameson  wings and soup are on point. I typically like to order to go from here or sit outside. I don't order takeout often but the last few times I have called to order, they have been very rude and short with me. Not sure why. I tried to order this evening and again was met with shortness and being put on hold for a long period of time. Not wanting to be further strung along, I hung up. Such a shame.
my friends and i stopped in here twice for the meeting point for tours and its a nice place with good prices..super nice staff
Very good food and highly recommended. We ordered the lamb and chicken platters and will 100% be going back.

One of my all time favourite restaurants. An authentic Greek taverna serving authentic Greek cuisine.  The decor is beautiful. The food is absolutely to die for. 
You must try the slow roasted lamb shank. Don't forget the lemon potatoes!
Best food, awesome service. Go to place for outstanding breakfast & lunches in Carp. Thank you! We love this place!

Courteous and responsive - made an appointment and they called in advance to ensure we were still on schedule.  Friendly and easy to deal with.  The only issue was that the lock replaced - which was for a mailbox - was angled differently that all of the other mailbox locks.  It would have been nice to have them all symmetrical or to at least have been asked if this was a problem.  I may end up having to get the lock changed again at some point.  For now, I needed it as I lost the key....

Received a defective washing machine. Water does not completely drain after wash cycle is completed. We contacted Goedeker's, who has informed us that the only remedy is repair. We ordered a brand new appliance, and expect it to function as such. We will not accept a broken or defective machine, and want either a refund or replacement of a properly functioning machine. We were informed further that we may return it only if we pay both original and return shipping. VA to MO?  Really?  Not our problem that the appliance is defective and we will certainly not pay for any shipping of such. This appliance was ordered over the phone and no information was provided on any policies regarding receipt of broken or defective appliances.  What a scam!   We have contacted an attorney, BBB, FTC and the MO Attorney General so far. Do not buy from these shyster crooks.

They have over 50-80 kinds of beers presented by the bar, inside refrigerator. Very impressive of the quality and decoration of this place. Pricing wasn't bad at all. Customer service was good too. It's a nice place to watch game, hangout, brunch, and happy hour.

One of my favorite tucked away restaurants is Aya Sofia. Step inside and you are greeted with friendly staff, wonderful aromas and Mediterranean decor with dim lighting. I really love the booths filled with pillows which feel very private.

Aya Sofia is the only Turkish restaurant in town. If you like Greek food, you'll find some familiar entrees with seasoning that are just different enough to create a unique taste.

I highly recommend the Borek, an amazing hot appetizer of feta cheese and parsley baked in layers of filo dough. Not a Greek food lover...you can always stick with a basic salad and steak. Definitely worth a drive into South City.

We ordered carry out and enjoyed drinks and pretzels while we waited. The sliders with Brie and bacon jam were perfect. The avocado burger was a hit as was the beef sandwich. The service was quick and felt safe and appropriately distanced. Drinks were excellent. I look forward to visiting in the future.

Crestwood lacked exceptional breakfast options. 

Enter: Yolklore. 

Everything I've had is delicious. "Billy The Kid" is the breakfast sandwich of my life. 

The juice is fresh, the coffee is fresh, the ingredients are local. What else would the eager breakfast goer want? 

Oh, you want treats, pastries, cream puffs? Yolklore has those too. These Yolklore treats are 5 star situations. 

All the employees are super nice. They are professionals on the griddle. 

Pro tip: seating is limited. Seating more than 4 people together can be a challenge. If that's the case, hit up the drive through with your huge order and meet your large group friends at your favorite park, or make the group hang a more intimate situation and come to Yolklore a few times with a friend or two.

I just asked if they priced matched. My daughter sent me a picture of a bottle to get for a gift with the price saying $17.99 at a different store. Since I was picking up a gift card at total wine I thought I would pick up the bottle of jack in the picture. Total wine was $2.00 more.  No big deal it's only $2.00, it was when the manager was called over to verify the price match and she saw the picture, she was quite rude and said "we don't do pictures, you need a receipt or an ad" then she walked off.  It's not what you say, but how you say it.  Rude!!!

I had a very unpleasant experience and I know my expectations shouldn't have been so high...but the staff was extremely rude and I did not get a free birthday drink. Also, do NOT go here if you have asthma. It's a smoking bar with no ventilation.

They always have a great selection of jewelry and tops. Their dresses are adorable, but some of them tend to run on the small side. The owner is very helpful and really sweet. It's a great place to find an adorable unique outfit for a special occasion :)

0 out of 2 stars for Food
1 out of 1 stars for Service
1 out of 1 stars for Cleanliness
1 out of 1 stars for Atmosphere

Due to an unfortunate incident, this restaurant receives no stars for food.  What food I did eat was fine, not nearly as good as El Gran Rodeo, but I couldn't finish my meal due to a RUBBER BAND in my chimichanga!

The server was very accommodating, especially after "the incident."  My meal was taken of the bill.

I could see into the servers station and both it and the restaurant were clean.

As for atmosphere...it is very over the top Mexican themed.

As far as eating out goes for my wife and I, I must say that for the price, I can do much better.   I have never understood the "high end burger".  When it is all said and done,  it's just a burger!  Really, no actual skill goes into the preparation of anything we had.   For around $60 after tip for two beers,  some tots with chili poured over top,  and two burgers I have to say the hype outweighs reality.

Delicious! Yummy vegetarian/vegan food seems difficult to find. This place is a must. We enjoyed the lemongrass coconut curry and the spring rolls both with tofu. Spring rolls are off the hook! Super fresh and light.

The flavor of the food isn't bad at all, but be ware of the grease. The large I ordered had to be one of the greasiest pizzas I had ever eaten. Heartburn city if you know what I mean. 

On a good note, the calzones are wonderful. I'd put it among one of the best I've eaten. Still a little greasy, but nowhere near as bad as the pizza.

Tonight was our third time eating at Dimitri's.  The food and service all three times were great.  Tonight we each got a gyro and split a small Greek salad.  So glad our wonderful server said that the small salad would be enough...it certainly was and was so good!   Gyros were huge...I couldn't even finish half of my sandwich, so I know what's for lunch tomorrow.  Our server was nice enough to take several photos of us.  Such a beautiful water view too.

Well the service was great! Love the ambiance! And the full order of the biscuits and gravy were COLOSSAL! Serious appetites need only apply! This is dangerous stuff! So good you want to keep eating it but then you just can't take another bite. The will persists but the gut fails you. Hats off if you can conquer this unyielding mountain of yum.
Had an issue, try not to order through apps. They are pretty glitchy lately. Otherwise the food is pretty good
The only way to sing karaoke at this bar is to know or bribe the karaoke DJ. Have fun putting in your request and waiting for hours to see the same people sing over and over. Corrupt!

Last night was my second visit to Vecchia and this place is the real deal.  If you've ever had the pleasure of eating pizza in Italy, you will see this as the excellent value it is.   Three of us shared two pizzas (the Regina and the White Pizza) which are 12" - so 2 pies for 3 people is about perfect, depending on your appetite.  This is artisan pizza with a delicious crust and premium ingredients.  Frank, the owner, was busy on a Saturday night but makes a point to visit us and make sure we're happy.  We are.

I took a Nero D'avola called NERO (Pa Wine & Spirits) and it's a perfect pairing.  I agree with my guests and other reviewers, that Vecchia would do well to add another salad (Spinach or Caesar) or an Antipasto that would add a little variety with ingredients that he mostly has on hand anyway.  Seems like it would be a win-win as restauranteurs can only make so much $ with a byob pizza place in the high rent district of Wayne. 
 
Tip:  Frank makes some of his best pies late in the evening when the oven is hottest.

4.5 average? No.

Went here to check out their late night menu, and left extremely disappointed & unsatisfied. 

1. Pork Banh Mi: $9?! Unbelievably overpriced for banh mi that is tiny, filled with shredded pork, and offers nothing unique whatsoever.

2. Fried Rice w/ Tri Tip: Rice was sticky & clumpy. Fried rice should not be like that. Honestly just seemed like rice topped with meat, sauce, and chilli paste. The poached egg on top had a rubbery texture.

3. Thai Basil Burger: It came dripping all over the place. It was a patty served on two slices of bread no better than wonder bread, I swear. Got it with an egg. Once again this "poached egg" was rubbery and strangely hard & tough.

Only later did I find out from a friend that they don't even have a cooking license...so everything is just heated up. That explains the chunky "fried" rice, the shredded pork in place of normally chargrilled meat inside a banh mi, and the rubbery poached eggs. 

Definitely will not be returning here. Definitely will not recommend this place to anyone.

I love soy cafe, and make an effort to go anytime I'm in the area. They make by far the best soy latte I've ever had in Philly, and I love the great selection of vegan desserts! It's got a very chill vibe, great to sit back and relax.

They still have great crispy, chewy pizza and service! The pizza is crispy and chewy, not the service. The Godfather pizza is amazing; marinara sauce, mozzarella, swiss, cheddar, romano, italian sausage, canadian bacon, and capicolla, oh my! The regular hot wings are very spicy, not just one note hot.
Good sushi, the ramen was kind of "Top Ramen" esque, but the Udon noodles were good. Good prices too. Only thin was the staff was a little disinterested and not very helpful.

LOVE, LOVE, LOVE Parc! Our favorite place in the city. Always five star service (today from Kelly) which really makes for a great dining experience. Awesome new outdoor booths (see pics) with lights and heating. Highly recommend!

Went back again.  Trendy and upscale, nice beds and ok sized rooms.  The beds are comfortable with quality linens and nice pillows.  The room is laid out nicely for work and relazation - and mine had a cool armoir for hanging your clothes as well as holding the minibar and coffee service (should have taken a picture).  Desk and chair are comfortable for working and the TV is just the right size - big enough for comfortable viewing but not too big for the room.

The lobby has fun interior décor with a cool lobby bar and nice alcoves where you can sip with your special someone.  The staff is helpful and friendly.  

There are a number of fine hotel choices in Philly, add this to the list.
Avo was so helpful! I was more than pleased with the service! I was definitely in a crunch and needed a storage space quickly! I loveeeeee this place.

I was so nervous to try this studio about a year ago when I was completely new to yoga, but I'm so happy I did! I took the Yoga 101 workshop and have been hooked ever since! Every instructor is super welcoming and meets you where you're at no matter what level. They offer great adjustments and modifications so you can really get the most out of your practice whether you're a first timer or an experienced yogi. I also love how involved the studio is in the Fairmount community. The new student $21 for 21 days is a great deal, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to try out yoga!

This is truly a five star review.

The customer service is without flaw! Products are cool, different, and yet somehow unpretentious.

I went there for their Warby Parker glasses. Was shown a ton of options, and passed along my prescription. Done deal $295.00 for the frames with progressive lenses.

ALL MY FAULT!.........BIG MISTAKE by me. Having never had glasses, no less progressive lenses.......I got exactly what I ordered, by I became frustrated and got headaches from these lenses. I called Art in the Age just to get some feedback. I was asked to visit just so we could make sure that I got what I liked. I visited the store a second time, was greeted happily and they went to work FOR ME!

......end result? I got a new pair of glasses that are purely readers! I got the coolest pair of sunglasses I've had in years!........and wait...... I got a refund to my card! As the readers and the sunglasses were $95.00 a pair I actually was taken out of an expensive/frustrating experience I totally did to my self and ended up with more for less!

If you need glasses, and or gifts, or even just a really cool shirt.....Art in the Age is the place!

To the crew at Art in the Age.......it was great shopping with you! I'll be back for gifts!

You are the best!

Best Regards,
Brent
Fast friendly service.  The omelets are huge!  Coffee was delicious.  Would definetly come back again,

We've been to Menjiro about 4 times now and I think it's quickly become one of our favourite ramen places in Edmonton. Their menu isn't the biggest but we've always ended up finding something we like and leaving with full bellies. 

They've changed their menu from the first 2 times we came so I couldn't quite remember what I ordered those times. But the most recent time we went, I ordered the miso jiro ramen with pork belly. The broth is really flavourful and I like the assortment of vegetables in the bowl. It was also nice that it comes with half an egg for that price already. A lot of ramen places charge extra for their eggs. I normally don't eat too much so for me to finish the bowl was definitely challenging but their bowls are a good size and I would definitely be coming back again for their ramen.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Jacques-Imo's! Every one of my experiences there has been wonderful. The ambience is great, this place doesn't get anymore New Orleans then this! Food is to die for! Service is over top GREAT! 

Must Eats: Alligator Cheesecake, Duck Gumbo, Yummy Cornbread, Fried Calamari, Carpet Bagger (filet) 

Will not leave unhappy.
Way over MSRP for new cars. They're taking advantage of people because of the shortage. Sorry customer service ain't going to cover up the price.

It's been a while sine I've been in here, but when I was here, it was because they were the ONLY place I could find in town that carried Bella Bands. I liked that they had a few out of the packages so I could find exactly the right size. I wore that thing ALL THE TIME! Great purchase.
I'm not really into expensive designer clothes (especially maternity) so I skipped the front of the store and went straight to the used section. It was like a treasure hunt and I loved it!  I ended up buying some Gap jeans, Old Navy capris, a shirt and my Bella Band, all for $50! Not bad a all. 
I'm not sure if they still do this, but at the time they took down my due date and said I can come back and get half off a nursing bra. Any business that supports breast feeding moms is awesome in my book!

Very hard to find good/great pizza in Florida!  This is one of the greats!  1st time had the NY style. We'll try next time Chicago style and Greek salad.

We live in a credit/debit card world now a days, this place is a cash only option. Luckily had cash on me. I prefer using my platinum for my points!
Alex is fantastic!!! She was professional, patient and very friendly.  I will definitely go back for another organic Brazilian wax.

I agree with Patrick S.; Snappy's is much better than the nearby competitor a couple minutes away.

The pizza is alright, and they have a pretty decent selection too. If your pizza isn't there, you can just ask the people to make it. 

The salad bar is fresher than the other pizza buffet that was mentioned. 

It's neat and clean. It's great for families! And the staff is really nice.

It costs ~$6 per person.

20$ to plug a tire we purchased from you 3 months ago? Really? The going rate for a plug is $10.
I would have done it myself if I knew your customer service sucked so much.
Don't make the mistake of believing MacGee is your friendly local auto shop. It is a corporate franchise just like Midas,tires plus, etc...

I love Snap Pizza!! It's the best bang for your buck in the area. Great selection of toppings. All of the pizza ingredients are so fresh & I love that the custom pies can have as many toppings as you please. I have only tried their pizzas, but I know they sell salads as well. When I call in a order, it's always ready on time & the employees are pleasant. Super clean too!

I give a one star because I went to get some beer and bought two 6 packs. Later noticed that one 6 pack was a year expired and the other 6 pack was two years expired. Two years is pretty ridiculous which would question me what else on their shelves is expired.

eh. mediocre pizza.  mediocre steaks.  they've got a good location though to hook tourist families (right near betsy ross house).  this tends to be my last resort for late night food... sometimes i say, "forget, i'll wait til breakfast."  

and the service is never great.  i walk in to pick up an order, head to the register and the lady says, "whatcha want?"  it was just sort of odd.

What a pleasant place for lunch. My friend and I came here for lunch and had a wonderful time. It was a beautiful day in Tampa, so needless to say the patio area was pretty full. We ended up getting seated in inside and had the whole restaurant pretty much to our selves :)

Our server was a young guy and he was great! Very personable and knowledgeable about the menu.  We started off with the white peach sangria and OMG how refreshing! It was so good, I could have had another. For our meals we decided to split the lobster and shrimp fettuccine and then order our own salad. I got the wedge salad and it was delicious! They don't put the typical blue cheese dressing on there, it was more of a Parmesan dressing and it was delicious ! My friend ordered the chopped salad and she loved it as well. Both salads were the perfect pairing to splitting the fettuccini. The shrimp and lobster fettuccine was cooked perfectly ! Just enough for my friend and I to share since we didn't want to be too full. 

Overall, we had a great experience and I can't wait to come back and try their lobster bisque!

I really love HotBox pizza and their bread sticks.  Great location for delivery or carry out.  Every time I've been here they have a great attitude.  Also love their POTW special, it's the pizza of the week and they offer it for half off. Sign up for their emails and get free stickers and a free pizza on your birthday!

Nifty Fifty's is a really nice place and I've been coming here for years.

We recently stopped in on a weeknight; I had the filet mignon sandwich (medium) and my woman had the chicken florentine sandwich. Mine was good - the only thing it was missing was a sauce as it was kind of dry - it also came with a couple of onion rings on top of the steak. My girlfriend also enjoyed hers.

While we didn't get any this time, the milkshakes are always good. I've also had breakfast here a couple of times and I was satisfied.

The service here is also excellent - every time I've visited, the server was always very attentive.

I also like the fifties diner theme. Overall, Nifty Fifty's serves good food, has a nice atmosphere, and very friendly service.

I would give it a try if I were you. I'll be returning.

I just had to he most pleasant experience in trying to get my computer printing problem solved.  "Kat" answered my call and easily walked me through how to fix the problem after having  no luck talking to three different techs.  from my cable provider.  She fixed it in 5 minutes.  In the future, you know who I will be calling first!  Thank you Kat!

Foxy Red's is a special shop for fun and interesting gifts (for others and for myself!!!)  The owner has a great eye for what's fantastic. 

I only wish I lived closer but happily they provide shipping.

It's been a few years since I've been here so my dad thought it'd be nice to take the family out to eat. The first time we tried to go eat was a Friday on New Years weekend and the place was PACKED with an hour wait time. So we decided to come back on a weekday. 

So the weekday comes and we tried the place again and got a table in less than five minutes! Woohoo! We got to the table and our server came up. Her name was April and she was a pretty cool chick. She wasn't rushing us to order and gave us enough time to make up our minds on our entrees. So my family all ordered steak with an onion blossom as an appetizer. 

Texas Roadhouse is known for their onion blossom which is a deep fried onion that's cut to look like a blossom. When it came out, it was small. I remembered it was a lot bigger a few years ago. But I guess when the economy's down, so is the size of the food. 

Their complimentary rolls were soft and had the perfect cream (?) to go with it. It had a cinnamon flavor to it but it went well with the roll. 

Our steaks came out and my brother's steak was the only one that came out the way he ordered it. My dad ordered a medium rare and it came out too rare for his liking. I ordered a medium well steak and it was a medium well, but too dry for my taste. I would think a "steakhouse" would know how to make a good steak, but I may be asking too much from a chain restaurant. 

I'm not saying the place is bad because there are some menu items that are good. I just hope the next time I come in, my medium well steak will be nice and juicy. :)

As I read some of the reviews for this place, I can see why it can be bit disarming..I have not been to other location ---yet..But this one , been to couple times now.I ran out of my Izzo Coffee, had to go get it. Barristers are quite personable, line was long , but it moved. I am quite satisfied with this one, though I wish they would have little bit more then biscotti's, & one or two other pastries to eat with coffee here. But love my Columbe coffee here..
Awesome customer service and my suit jacket came out as brand new! I will recommend this place to anyone.

The aguas frescas (fruit juice) are fantastic!! You never know what you are going to have as an option, but you always know it will be delicious.  Honestly, it is the best place to eat downtown.  I love the options, the flavors, but hate the wait.  It does get crazy busy at lunch and the wait can be frustrating on a short lunch day, but it is the sacrifice you make to enjoy the wonderful chips and salsa, the chile rellenos, the tacos, the surprise salad/fruit, the sopas, or whatever taco your heart desires.  My favorite thing to get is the plato, just like for the element of surprise. The chicken soup is the hands down as good as my Nana's and that is hard to beat. Oh! It's cash only so if this is your first time here, be prepared.  It is laid back with loud music and tons of laughter - it's like being at a good friends house with a bunch of strangers sharing a meal.

This is by far the cutest coffee shop I've ever been to. The patio is lush and lovely and has a table over a pond. I sat inside listening to the rain on the patio curled up with a book I purchased from their collection of used books. The quiche and coffee were delicious. If I lived here this would be my favorite place.

UPDATE!

Still closed with no chance at a reopening, but I just discovered another chip and put course relatively close to Philadelphia (Voorhees, NJ). Without ever having been there, I can immediately tell it's not as cool as Woods, but that's a tall order to fill.

See for yourself if it's worth a trip: http://www.golflandnj.com/information.html

apparently they have mini golf, too, though that seems less enticing: http://www.yelp.com/biz/golf-farm-voorhees
Always great. My daughter is Gluten free they always make her a cheesesteak and use our bread Great Place

Excellent steak. Excellent menu. Awsome wine cellar. My wife and i will comechere for steak before we go to Ruths Chris or Porters. This place rocks!  The Head Chef walks the room to ensure his guests are receiving the best food and the best service.  You don't get that kind of attention in most places.  We will bring our friends here and our parties!

This place, no matter how busy, always has an amazing atmosphere and a very welcoming crew! Always very clean and true to their menu! They have an amazing variety of long rolls, hand rolls, nigiri and other dishes for the people looking for a less fishy meal! 
The all you can eat is very reasonably priced and they even have a happy hour every day from 3:00pm-5:00pm, so when you purchase an all you can eat you receive 1 FREE Small Hot Sake or flavored sake! And Beers are 2-for-1 every Monday-Thursday. 
I can't wait to come back and eat again!

I just started reading comics again this summer, getting in to Marvel for the first time since all these movies and Netflix shows have become so popular. I really didn't know where to start or what I would like, and chose to stop in to Avalon to try and get some guidance. Not only did I have a great chat with John about the types of comics I might like/what I was looking for, I felt welcomed into the community and confident that I could return regularly with continued satisfaction. The atmosphere is non-confrontational and warm, and the help I received was excellent. If you're considering getting into comics or are new to the area and need an outlet to feed your habit, I couldn't recommend Avalon more.

This place was perfect for jumping in and getting a bite and beer or more beers than bite. While I don't eat meat, I do eat fish.  it seems they do a lot of beefy things because I did order some shark filet and they brought me beef instead. I thought when I bit into it, the taste and texture was not fish even though the waiter assured me it was. After closer inspection it was beef. It's the beach so you know the fish is fresh if you can get them to bring you some. the atmosphere is casual and low key for a few beers with friends. It does get really loud and boisterous the later the night gets. The price is right and perfect for the flipflop wearing shorts clad, Jimmy Buffet look alikes to hang. I found Frenchy's to be a better food experience but Cooters will have live music on occasion.

I love the atmosphere here...they have a great outside area to hang out and party. We had a great time. Shared a couple pizzas that were delicious and drinks were good as well. Love a good outdoor space to chill with our friends and talk. Will definitely be going back! Love Franklin and it's close to the factory at Franklin too!

They have really good coffee, but $4 cold brew? Starbucks isn't even that expensive for a 16oz. The interior is beautiful, and the guys who work here are great. I accidentally came in 5 minutes before closing because I lost track of time, and they still made me coffee! Anywhere else probably would've turned me away (in fact one place I won't name did that to me 20 minutes before closing).

I finally took an 'official' survey and left some comments through the website from my recent receipt, but I wonder how much USPS will take mine into account because it was generally negative, hah.

I'll lay it out short and simple

PROS:
- You can rent PO Boxes
- they have a Passport office
- plenty of parking space if you drive, also pretty close to the RTA bus stop
- convenient location for Uptown and Mid-city folks

CONS:
- NOT ENOUGH WORKERS UP FRONT, or perhaps the issue is NOT ENOUGH efficient, well-mannered, professional workers. Yeah I know government jobs aren't the best...
- Clerks and other postal workers are unfriendly at best, rude, irritating and infuriating at most. Some of them either seem to have hearing problems or don't have a good grasp of English
- Closes too early on weekdays for my tastes, 4:30pm?!

TLDR:
If you need to interact with a person, I strongly suggest GO TO ANOTHER USPS location.
Food is honestly below average like I don't like anything they have and the coffee is meh like nothing too crazy. HOWEVERRRR! Their outdoor seating is amazing and it's worth the ok coffee haha

Don't let there website fool you I just sent a request to have a FREE HOME EVALUATION they called me and told me the there will be a $75 charge for the evaluation if I decide not to use their services

SO IF YOU DO NOT USE THEIR SERVICES THEY CHARGE YOU FOR A HOME EVALUATION

Only had to wait about 25 minutes before we were seated. Nice layout inside. Only issue is the food. I got the feature with the cinnamon raisin apples instead of the potatoes. For me, the only good thing on my plate was the bacon. My husband got an omelette. It was anything but an omelette. It was a scrambled egg laid on top of meat with very little cheese mixed in the meat. Customer service is good though.

You get what you pay for.  Inexpensive, clean, room clearly recently remodeled, small place so you park just outside your room, unlike Nugget next door where the trip from car to room might take you 10 minutes, lugging your luggage.  On the other hand, room was musty, that does not mean all rooms are, and they want a $180 damage deposit, which they refund to your card in "3 to 5 business days".  We shall see.  Outside needs a little maintenance, but room, other than musty and no heat - A/C was working - and city road noise, plus Sparks main fire house next door - so not quiet but I am a city boy and can sleep through it.   I am guessing they are improving their image by keeping the riff raff out by the big deposit.
Staff is kind of intrusive, and the actual quality of the clothing does not justify the prices, even if some of the designs were cute.

Recently started workin in South Philly and all I can day and thank Goodness Corp Fitzwater. I come here weekly  for their chai tea and bagel sandwiches.

Their chai's a good mixture of sweet and spicy. It's great both iced and hot. You can make it dirty for an extra $1 something. All in all 20oz for $5. Wayyyy cheaper than Starbucks.

Bagel sandwich are my favorite. They have a huge variety of bagels! Some of my favorites are cheddar jack, French toast, everything and tomato raisin. Their chicken salad is to die for. Definitely order your lunch between 12-1:30ish. I've noticed when I order within that last hour, the food isn't as fresh or put together.

I've been going to this place since I was a kid. It's still one of my favorite places in the world. It's easy to find what you need. It has almost everything. The service is good and friendly, can't remember when it hasn't been. It's a great little neighborhood hardware store. Very happy to give them my business when on that side of town.

Stopped here on a whim one day about a month ago because I've been trying to quit smoking. Owner's son got me and my gf setup with vapes and I haven't smoked since. Not only has my health improved dramatically, but I've come to love this shop because of the amazing customer service. They truly love what they do. They have all sorts of smoking accessories and they're very fair with their equipment. Bring anything to them and they will try to fix it or offer you replacement suggestions. I will not go anywhere else. 

The shop is also very clean and not shady at all like some smoke shops can be. Very comfortable atmosphere for anyone and friendly as well. If you're considering stopping in, DO IT!

I wanted to like this place so badly. The first time my boyfriend and I were there, they treated us so nice. But the second time, they were extremely rude and we've never gone back. They talked about us behind our backs at the counter. They told us to put our food we brought away, in front of everyone, embarrassing us. And they made it a point to make an example out of us. Not only is this bad customer service, but how and why would a human treat another human like that?? Don't go here unless you want to be judged by the staff. Oh, and the woman who is the owner was the one who did all of this. Not a place I want to be at ever again.

Blasphemy!  Not only reviewing a McDonalds, but giving it a 4 stars!  This guy must be on Yelp Crack!

Listen, I'm not saying Mcdonalds is a 4 star restaurant, I am just rating this location in the context of other McD's and fast food joints.  This spot is always very clean.  The staff is surprisingly clean cut and welcoming.  They dont have that usual "I hate my job please shoot me, can I take your order?" thing going.  That being said, I wanted to give them some recognition. 

If you're short on time, or just having a hankering for fast food, this one spot is actually pretty decent....for a McDonalds.

(coming soon, my review on Yelp Crack Dealers)

This is a newly renovated place so it's clean and fairly modern looking. I suspect the owners are appealing to the "macho" guy crowd as decor is a little too austere. I like an Irish pub to have a few nooks and crannies where I can hide out with my husband and people watch and drink too much :) But that's just me! Still, I just couldn't escape the sensation that there's a "boys club" mentality here.  (Very, very inexperienced pretty young servers!) And then there's that "hotel restaurant" feeling that I could not escape. They cook for the Windsor where they're located and so it feels like a "fake" Irish pub, certainly not cozy in any way. I had dinner with my husband on a Friday evening. There were a few men (middle-aged) at the bar and only one other couple eating. Food was OK but meats a little over done. Worse though was the fact that little ingredients were missing from the description on the menu. As though the chef was off that night. And that really annoys me generally. If it's on the menu it should be on my plate. I think details are important. Cocktails were good, Sauvignon Blanc nice. But overall just not worthy of a second visit.

The food here was the best Indian I've ever had. Flavorful, fresh and delicious. You get a lot of food for the money and the service is excellent. I recommend sitting outside or getting carry out. I love that they are a locally owned and family owned. Please support this gem! I know I'll be back!

Meh, had high hopes but definitely was disappointed. We drove from Long Beach to Santa Barbara for a day trip and based on yelp reviews I thought we should have lunch here. We arrived at a time when they were serving both breakfast and lunch items so we got a little bit of both. 

The berry waffles were pretty unimpressive. Without the topping or syrup, the waffles tasted like cardboard. I also ordered the seared ahi salad. I'm not a big fan of sweet dressing and this one was drenched in sweetness. Guess that kind of ruined it for me. 
Looks like yelpers love this place but unfortunately, can't say that I would ever go back.

I wouldn't recommend this place if you have a special event like your birthday please don't book it here. I have been to Meat Market Tampa multiple times and always had a great experience until my birthday dinner Sunday. I had a party of 8 and while making the reservation the hostess advised I could book 6 and would have to get permission for the remaining people for the party. I said "ok cool" she provided the number ( I have attached a screen shot of the conversation). This person never got back to me. I called two other times and left a message with another hostess who was extremely rude. I assumed it wasn't a issue so I didn't worry about changing my reservation to another restaurant. I show up on Sunday and was advised I had to wait for the full guest list to arrive which was fine and I confirm party for 8. Emily or Emma quickly told me umm no it was only for 6 and I advised no I advised her of what the previous people told me on the phone. Her and the guy Jose was so rude and advised that there was a contract need which I was never advised and then he states "oh make sure your party guest list is in dress code no sweat pants etc". Im like sir its my birthday dinner why would anyone show up in that. They made us wait outside for over 45 mins never went and got the manager to try to accommodate the issue. 45 mins later the waitress come to great us and I was so upset because I had my pregnant sister with me. It was so unprofessional. Once seated the manager then shows up trying to talk but at that point I was over it. The waitress forgot my moms entree and claims she didn't hear it. Towards the end the manger asks how  my experience was and I was just disgusted with him for even bothering to ask me. Worst birthday dinner ever!!! rude/racist staff after being a loyal customer I'm honestly disgusted with the service received. Next time I will just book my dinner somewhere else who gives better service.  Do better!!!! Lesson is don't book anything important here.

Drinks are very well priced and delicious. Drinking it out of a mason jar only adds to the gritty charm of this establishment. Also the bartenders are very friendly, and will make suggestions about how you can improve their drinks on the menu. (The Spring Fling, which is great as is, gets even more awesome when you switch out peach schnapps with cherry vodka). 

Also, this place uses its limited space pretty awesomely. There always seems to be a natural path to the bathroom from anywhere in the bar, and they managed to make a dance floor out of what at first glance, appear to just be a spot for spill-over bar stools. 

Cash only is a bit of a drag (no pun intended)

I love their Indian styled Philly cheesesteaks!! It's spicy and the cheese is so well blended with it. I love how they add the cilantro to it, which is my favorite seasoning. It was pretty empty when I went, however don't be fooled by it because this place is a gem!
Went here for the first time for the dinner buffet. The service was excellent, there was a great variety of food, and it was all tasty. Would come back again!
Ice cream isn't bad at all the wait is truly kills me here but it isn't your typical ice cream place so your waiting for art to be made

The view and the food are both great. We usually get the seafood gumbo or the she crab soup. The ahi tuna is good, too, but the portion is a little small. Their seafood cobb salad is huge, though.

I was surprised to see so many people complain about the service. We usually sit at the bar, and have always had attentive, friendly service.

I had the best experience coming here for my first time, the food was prepared just the way we wanted & tasted amazing !! Customer service was great as well, he was very consistent with checking in on us. Overall this was one of the best night out's to a restaurant I have had. :)

I stumbled upon this place on my way home after a long run. I was already on my way elsewhere and i decided to make a u-turn and try this place. I'm so glad I did. They have so many options for smoothies, juices and food as well. I usually fast until late in the afternoon so I opted for just a juice. I ordered the anti-inflammatory juice and it was so refreshing. I ordered and the cashier said to find a seat and they'd bring my order to me. I thought that was very kind. There is a lot of indoor seating and plenty of outdoor seating as well. They have cute palapa seating areas and a corn hole game. While waiting for my juice I noticed there is a bike trail and there were a lot of bike riders passing by and some stopped here at the cruising smoothie after. The name of this place then made sense. The parking situation was confusing. I had to enter through a dirt dead end road to park behind the business. I noticed they also have a drive thru which is pretty cool. Overall, I had a great experience! Friendly  and prompt service. I will definitely be coming back!
Horrible food...horrible service...a whole bunch of attitude if you complain. You are better off skipping a meal
Awesome on the phone. Very nice and super responsive. Knowledgeable and considerate. Really appreciate it!!!

I hate to give the Tower 1 star. It's a legendary venue, but it seems it is being destroyed by the current management. The people that work there seem very unhappy. Their attitudes range from indifferent to downright hostile, especially Security. No one seems to be in charge and no one is able or willing to answer the simplest of questions. To spend that kind of money to see a show and receive that kind of treatment is infuriating.

I was there for a show recently and, in fairness, I'm not sure how much of the following was the fault of the artist and how much was down to the venue. The headliner did not come out for over 2 hours after the opener. There was not explanation given. The sound was terrible. There was feedback happening well into the show. The artist had to give instructions to the sound engineer from the stage. The kick drum had no low end in it for the first few songs. It was all very unprofessional.

I won't go to a show here again unless someone is performing there that I absolutely must see or the management changes.

We went last night. There was no wait, and the restaurant was only about half full, maybe less. Immediately after being seated, I took my daughter to wash hands, and by the time we got back to the table our waiter was there to take our drink order. He was very friendly, very personable, and made some great recommendations about the menu. He was definitely knowledgeable about the different dishes and how spicy each of them were.

The steamed shrimp is really good; it's steamed in beer, which adds a great flavor, and the 3/4th pound of shrimp was gone insanely fast. Their cocktail sauce is a little more spicy than other places and went well with the shrimp. The shrimp are brought to the table in a small iron pot and poured onto a tray with newsprint. This newsprint is awesome, it's based on the movie Forrest Gump and each news article reflects a different part of the movie.

Everything we ordered came out pretty fast. I say this because as we were finishing our meal, our waiter was very apologetic about the wait. What wait? Heh.

The server asked if we wanted to do trivia. We (mostly my husband) answered the questions and he gave everyone high fives. 

The kids meals are awesome. They come in a cardboard box that resembles the boat 'Jenny' from the movie. There are different sections to hold the kid's meal, each of which has more of the newsprint, and the boat has a cutout area at the top that holds a dip cup. The kid's meal came with a surprise, blue jello. My kids were both in love with their dinners, and they took the boats home (and are still playing with them!).

I ordered the "Accidental Fish and Shrimp" and this was awesome. Everything was perfectly cooked. The shrimp were just a little on the spicy side, but the rest of the dish wasn't, it went very well together. There was a slightly sweet butter sauce for the fish and rice. Absolutely delicious. The portions were nice, small enough that I could finish the plate, but not so small that I was hungry afterwards.

My husband had the jambalaya and my father-in-law had the fish and chips. Both of those were really, really good. I think I want to get their fish and chips next time we go, I think they're on par with the best fried fish I've had in the area. 

The prices are pretty much on par with any other seafood restaurant. Some things are more expensive, but those seem to be the larger platters that you can easily share with a significant other.

Very inexpensive you get what you pay for it's directly one street from Washington Avenue which is downtown St Louis and the pool is ice cold when you go in in the dryer does not dry you're clothes.. Almost a great location for the Rams in the Cardinal games.  I was here for 2&a half to 3 weeks because it's super close to where I was going to live in I am now... But no free buffets in the rooms walls are very thin so you hear everything above you in on the side view and its kinda weird

I was first attracted by the sign out front, simple elegance, once I received my chicken veggie soup I knew there were great cooks behind the food and couldn't wait to taste my carrot spice cake! Yum!! So delectable! And to top it all off, they make the perfect homemade lemonade! Not too sweet with the right amount of sour! I highly recommend this bakery/patissierie! Did I mention it's gluten free! You wouldn't even know it!

I now know why the prices are so low. There is nothing but lettuce in the salad. You need a magnifying glass to see the toppings. I ordered two salads for me and my husband for dinner. One of the toppings was green apples. The girl picked up 5 apples slices and put two back. The picking are very small. I can make a better salad myself with a lot more toppings. Maybe I will do that the next time and skip salad works altogether

We always go for the limit two margaritas and stay for the street tacos! Canyon cafe is one of my personal favorites, you can never have to much of their chips and salsa and my favorite combination of their street tacos are the bison, al pastor, and crispy chicken! Everything on their menu tastes amazing and we are never disappointed! They atmosphere and the staff are very friendly
Best value microbrewery in Dunedin!  Your quality beer, styles, & prices really rock Dunedin!!!

Well I've had 3 experiences with Jack's now, so I feel really confident with the 5 star rating.

My first experience was when my office did a large order for takeout.  The packaging was fairly greasy by the time it made it to the office (about half an hour away) but everything was absolutely DELICIOUS!  It was most of our first times trying Jack's and everyone was really happy.

Second experience was at the end of a road trip, i was craving a milkshake so bad.  So we stopped and picked up a couple of Malteser shakes to go.

Third experience was right around lunch time on a Saturday after wandering around the market.  We somehow managed to get there right before the rush.  There were 3 of us, and we all ordered the standard with cheese.  We shared an order of Jack'd up fries.  2 of us got milkshakes and the third got a pop.  The total was $51.00 which I expected and really wasn't that bad for 3 of us.  And we were all painfully full by the time we left.

Things I've noticed with the 3 very different experiences:
The staff are always incredibly friendly.  They are a young bunch, but they appear to work hard.
When they say the beef is fresh, they mean it.  I think I read that they get it from D'Arcy's, which wouldn't surprise me at all.  it's amazing.
The buns - oh man the buns!  I usually take off my top bun because there's just too much bread, and although this one looked like it was going to be very heavy, it was not at all!  It was the lightest bun I've ever had with a burger.  
The milkshakes are delicious... I almost wish they had more flavours!  But who am I kidding?  Both times that I've gotten a milkshake, i've stuck with the malteser.
The fries are seasoned perfectly.
The Jack Sauce..... what is it?  It's what dreams are made of, that's what.

So yah, I recommend it...

This was the best, most flavorful Indian food I have had so far.  The veggie pakora was crispy and the sauces were delicious.  For my entree I tried paneer for the first time.  The flavor was so rich and the sauce was very creamy.  Even the chai tea was a cut above anything I've had before.  I highly recommend this place for it's food.
Best hot chicken!! Never dry and always impresses, I bring people here that want classic Nashville hot chicken while in town and go here quite often on my own as well.

Stayed here while on a business trip. Quick check in and since I have my account linked in the app I had chosen my desired room type and floor before arriving. Key-less entry using the app worked well and was uncomplicated for a first time user. When we asked the front desk to get us a cab the next morning they instead had the shuttle driver bring our group to the office park we were heading to. Staff was friendly and accommodating and hotel was clean and convenient.

This place was beautiful. Came here for a nursing conference in the beginning of April and I was very pleased. I got lost several times, but there were employees scattered around to always assist you and walk you to your destination. The conference hall and ball rooms were very nice and my coworkers and I enjoyed the restaurants and shops (especially the live music at Jack Daniels). 

It was a very good trip and if I ever stay in Nashville again, I will make this one of my top choices!

Nondescript Mexican food, coupled with poor patio service.  We ordered drinks, had the appetizer sampler and some tacos, and everything was alright. Nothing special.  However, having to flag down the server multiple times was a real let down.  I would be unlikely to return.

We had a party of 7 on a Monday night. We were seated right away.

The bread was delicious and fresh, crispy on the outside and warm and soft on the inside.

Here's what we got:
- Crispy Risotto Balls ($10.25 for 6!): $10.95 for 6 fried balls of risotto is ridiculous. We also asked if they could do one extra ball since we had 7 people and they would not.
- Crispy Eggplant ($8.95): They have chicken parm on the menu. Why not eggplant parm? We asked if they could just make it and they said no. So we had to order their Crispy Eggplant side and the Chitarra al Pomodoro and then we had to put the eggplant on the pasta ourselves.
- Roasted Brussels Sprouts ($8.95): Tasty, but very oily.
- Chicken Parm ($22.95): Fine, but very cheesy.
- Chitarra al Pomodoro ($16.45): It's pasta with tomato sauce for $16.45. Just make it at home and save the money.
- Canestri Cacio e Pepe ($18.95 + $5.95 for chicken): It was described as adult mac and cheese. It was not. Very disappointed. It wasn't even that cheesy.
- Lasagna ($18.95): Good.
- Pistachio Ravioli ($19.95): Very oily. Only came with 12 raviolis.

For drinks, we got wine, the Red Sangria, and the Santa Lucia. I wish there was more presentation with the Santa Lucia. Disappointed.

I'm giving 2 stars because the food was not that good and the prices are absolutely outrageous. Adding in meat is an absurd up-charge. I understand they make their pasta in-house, but that doesn't justify their ridiculous prices.

The service was great. Samantha was our waitress and she was wonderful and patient with us.

Terrible. After submitting a ton of paperwork on their new web based med history site and waiting over a month for an appointment, they waited until my appointment to check on my insurance. They told me when I initially called that they are contracted with my provider. It turns out they are not. Apparently, this happens a lot. As a matter of course, they do not check until appointment time because they "have so many patients." Clearly they think their time is more valuable than their patients'.

So if I could give 4.5 stars, this place would still get 5 because of effort and attitude.  The people working here were working so hard and were still so cheerful!   The ice cream was delicious, and although it wasn't cheap, it was certainly worth the wait.   You pretty much should go inside, and know that you're going to be there for a bit.  This is not for impatient people.

After a TERRIBLE experience at the Mount Juliet Old Navy (where I left my clothes because the line wasn't moving at all), I went to this location to buy what I'd left at the other store earlier that day. So much more organized, so much cleaner, and the line actually moved! A low bar, but wow was it better than the experience I had earlier in the day!

Don't get me wrong the ramen is good. The noodles are cooked well the broth is very tasty. But remember I do my reviews based on price and basically this is $12 to $15 for a bowl of noodle soup. So, for instance, if I compare this to China Pasta House... China pasta house has slightly inferior noodles and much better broth and ingredients for $5.75 to $7.75 per bowl. The gyoza were clearly frozen. The surroundings and service are okay nothing special. So although this was good it really isn't worth the price and based on that I give it a 3 rating.
Excellent line of products, as well as knowledgable staff.  Adorable & conveniently located in the Garden District.  I will always shop for makeup & get beauty advice here when in New Orleans!

This place is fantastic. Ambiance wise, it is the most unique, interesting restaurant in this city. Every detail in decor has been thought out. If the food sucked, I'd still come back just to sit there. But no, the food does not suck. The drinks are creative and delicious and the food is out of this world. Reservations are pretty much a necessity because of demand, but they take you at the bar if there are open seats.

Server was nice, but that's about the only positive. We ordered appetizers, and they took 45 minutes to come out. Once it finally came out, the order was wrong and the food was terrible. The overall menu is crazy over priced especially considering how bad the food and experience is.

Great little place. Large open doors but lots of fans to keep the environment very cool. Wait staff was very genuine and fun. Singing to music and having a little dance here and there. The shrimp poboy was overflowing with shrimp. Fries were pretty average. The sodas came out flat but they quickly fixed that and comped the sodas. Impressed with the customer service. The waiter behind us hitting on the poor flight attendant and asking for her number if she paid with a credit card was a little unsettling. But the food overall was good and decent priced.

WOW AMAZING!!! This hot pot/dim sum place is comparable to the top notch LA locations--I recommend 10/10 for flavor profile/food quality/service. The portions are perfect for sharing and the price is reasonable too! Please go give this place a try if you're craving some decent asian food :)

The decor is modern and hip for this part of town.  The menu is a bit pricey but the wide range of tapas available will make you forget the prices as they have some really interesting combinations to try.  (The Beef Carpaccio was excellent!)

The waiter recommended I try the duck entree as it was his favorite dish, and I can see why, it was excellent.

If I lived in Pass-a-grille, I would be here once a week!

I have had wayyyy better service at other Starbucks. They were "out" of most of the frozen coffee drinks, so when I asked about a Frappuccino, I was told rudely that they were out of that too. Plus, the drive thru line was very slow. Not bad service, but I have had must must better service at other franchises.

This review is only for this location's sandwiches/deli.
Other than during "Hoagiefest",  I think the value isn't there with the amount of meat & cheese you get on their sandwiches/hoagies...and the thin, partial slices of tomatoes we kept getting were ridiculous - why bother?
Actually, it seems you have to order & pay for "extra" of everything there in order to get one the way it should be made in the first place!!
And who puts American cheese on an Italian hoagie?
The girl who made mine here does!!!
I also got sweet peppers when I asked for the hot ones & it was very dry when i asked for oil & vinegar.
They just always seem to get my orders wrong here...and my family has said the same keeps happening to them.
Due to these two issues, I now go elsewhere when we get a craving for good hoagies.

I got the bbq 4 piece with a side of macaroni salad and fries. My friend got the kimchi rice. Everything was amazing. The bbq sauce was just the right amount of sweet, chicken was so tender it just fell off the bone and the fries were a little soggy (but that's just how I like them). The kimchi rice was good too. Very flavorful and moist. I recommend ordering ahead.

All I can say is "Wow". I came in for a simple oil change after being quite disappointed by the services offered by Jiffy Lube up the street and I was blown away by both the customer service & the variety of service options. Everyone was so polite, and I definitely appreciate being able to stay in my vehicle while they're working on it. I will definitely be returning. Thanks so much to the Valvoline guys for being so amazing and for keeping my car in tip-top shape. Such a great addition to the North Valleys.

Its a hidden gem. I come here when Morning glory is overwhelmingly packed. You can come in here and just find yourself a seat and there is no wait for a waiter.  I am in love with their lattes and biscut and gravey. I am a fan of the art work that they have posted up. This is a great place if you do not like a place that is congested and if you are a fan of creole foods.

They don't tell you the central air conditioner is not working until after check in. It's been close to 90 degrees in the room, 2 nights in a row now after promising they would fix it. No refund, partial or full. They treat you like a child by giving "complimentary" popsicle and small bottle of water. Yes, 1 popsicle, 1 water. Really?! I've stayed at hostels in 3rd world countries better than this pathetic dump.  In hindsight I would gladly pay an extra $100 per night somewhere else had I known I'd be sleep deprived 2 nights in a row. But here's the kicker; We had stayed here several months back when the weather was cooler. The AC wasn't working then either! There's a reason this place is cheaper. They really don't give a s#!^.  But if it's money you want to save then sleep in your car, you'll be much more comfortable. And corporate, in the slightest chance you're reading this, stop dumping your money into your false advertising and kick some over to this god forsaken branch.
The black cook and this server refused to serve us because we were speaking religious within the restaurant about our Jewish faith. This is very disgraceful.

I set out on a quest today.  I wanted to get my hair cut.  Easy enough right?         
Well, three hours, three miles, and three establishments later I finally stumbled on a wonderful hair salon (another mile down the road) called Hair We Are on E. Willow Grove Ave.  Fair prices and wonderful conversation and very personable staff.  Highly recommended.

Our usual Indian spot was closed, so our cravings made us try Mood.  We were glad we did!  Jalfrezi and Karahi were very tasty, but the Saag took the prize! Delivery was sooner than predicted for an extra bonus.  They even threw in a Galub dessert for us!  Mood just cracked into our rotation!

Not much to say about this place.  The waitress, Marilyn Monroe was very nice. Salad was tasty but there was an odd ingredient in the dressing.  Crepe was very good flavor but chef didn't know how to cook the crepe properly.  Quiche was overcooked.  Atmosphere was  cafeteria-like with flimsy tables and uncomfortable chairs.  Sorry Creperie, I won't be returning.  
My rec (though I didn't yelp them) is Beau Monde in Queen Village.
Great establishment. Great food, great prices (-although prices are creeping up). Be nice to your barista, they put up with cranky uncaffeinated people all day.

My girlfriend and I had there buffet on Saturday. Our server was Afsaneh and she was absolutely the best! She was very attentive to our needs. It was our first time for dinner and it was a very pleasant dining experience. The food and atmosphere are great. Everyone working there seemed to be happy to be at work. Smiles everywhere! 
If you are looking for a different dinning experience give them a try! The Belly Dancer was killer too!

Very first Waffle House experience. 

Now, I'm not one to ever see a need to review a chain. But EVERYONE in this restaurant was not only polite, but went out of their way to make you feel "at home". 

The food wasn't amazing. But it filled the bill of breakfast just fine. 

Big props to these fine folks for making an over-saturated chain feel like a hometown diner!
All i can say is OMG these hot dogs r the bomb. They are so good, and there good price too.Thats all i have to say. If you havent tried them you need to. They are delicious.

Albertson's  isn't usually my first choice when it comes to groceries. The Vista location in particular is just okay. Their prices are more than their competitors and the selection isn't as diverse in the things I shop for. The thing they do have that is better than most is the craft beer selection, but then again, Brewers Haven is right next door which is the bee's knees for beer. Let's just say if you need vinegar and eggs on Thanksgiving morning, Albertson's will do in a jam.

Fun divey bar! I am fascinated by old center city businesses and this is definitely one of the few that has made it. I've only gotten drinks here. Good prices, good atmosphere, very low key. Probably my favorite center city dive bar.

Excellent wine list.  I was really impressed with how much Spanish wine (my favorite) they had available.  

Enjoyed sitting at the bar, marble bar top, good lighting, good music.  I appreciated hearing some Busta Rhymes, haven't heard him in forever.  The bar was comfortable, the mood was casual even if the place has a fancier look to it, effortless and inviting.  This more than anything reminded me of time spent hanging out in the Gothic Quarter.  

To go with that mood we slowly munched on some unassuming tapas that tasted much better than their description would give you any reason to think.  The tomato bread was flavorful and a perfect small bite (like I said, unassuming).  The fish croquettes were also very good... actually I'm not sure they count as croquettes, as the fish wasn't chopped up.  Whatever, a flaky fried fish ball that was well seasoned.

Anna Jo at Belle Starr Salon has been cutting my hair for about 5 years now. She's changed my hair in the best way and I can never go back. If I'm going to be out of town for a while I always have to plan an appointment with her first because I won't let anyone else cut my hair. She's a sweetheart and the best stylist!!! I also love the salon and the location, super chic spot. Thank you Anna Jo!!

The food was mediocre, my husband and I shared the stuffed grouper, it was supposed to be stuffed with shrimp, scallops and crab, there was none of that, it was a sweet cranberry cornbread stuffing instead. Flies buzzed our heads throughout the meal and we were inside not out. I make better coleslaw at home and the salad was served on a bread plate- you do the math. Please don't waste your time on this place.

Excellent service! I had a flat tire that was not fixable.  I got a fair price and excellent service on a new one. What set this company apart though were the little extra's.  My washer fluid light was on when I got there and they filled it up for me.  I had a small piece of molding that was loose and the fastened that into place as well.  It is the kind of service you get by people that really care about their customers.  They made an unpleasant situation a little easier.
Wow these doesn't are AMAZING! If you like cakey donuts, try this place. I got the creme brûlée and banana donut. They are the perfect consistency. Best donuts I've ever had!

**BTW, edit here, they are going to be closed every Sunday until Labor Day.  They are truly running this potential gem into the ground before taking off**

Sorry, Avero, it's true, you are truly awful.

My mother in law and I took 3 of my daughters here for lunch today and for $80...well, it was awful.

Service?  Our waitress appears to have very little table waiting experience.  She not only didn't know how to operate her hand held check book (dude, go back to paper or a stationary Micros system!), she also mumbled, didn't know the menu, tried to sell an upgrade of free bread and worst of all, came over while we were all highly engaged in eating and talking, actually interrupted us to tell us about desserts.

Decor?  Patio umbrellas in green and orange are hung from the ceilings.  There was a bazillion inch screen TV hung on the wall.  3 of our diners were sitting directly under it and therefore had their backs to it and the other two sat there looking at it.  It showed maybe 30 pictures of Rome, Capri and Venice.  It was not only distracting, but if the other people wanted to see the screen (I hate, hate, hate TV in restaurants) they had to turn their whole bodies around.

Food?  We ordered the mozz and tomato platter which on the menu says "perfect for sharing!"  Um, 2 SLICES, yes, of tomato, 2 baby-mini bell peppers and a hunk of mozz.  Eventually our upgraded free bread came along, 1 small piece per person.  The bread is awesome, btw.  The pizzas we ordered 2; the ham/argula and the popletto (ie mini meatball).  The crusts on the pies are really, really superior.  The sauce is terrible.  There is something "off" in the flavor and it stood out much more on the popletto.

Overall?  They are trying way too hard.  They are charging $25 for a kobe pizza, ha ha ha, they have tiny spoons, tiny plates, itty bitty everything.  They are having some sort of personality split.  If they focused their energies on training their staff and the food, it'd be a pleasant place to go.

I do not see them lasting long here.  It's a shame.

Great atmosphere but disappointed with meal. We had short ribs which were dry, we didn't even finish it even though it was tapa portion. Quail was pretty good but husband thought sauce was too sweet. Brussels sprouts were just ok. I'm amazed at all the high ratings since that's why we tried this place, maybe it was our three dish choices? Almost 40.00 and left hungry.

Not too happy with this place...Ordered a pizza with red sauce & there ended up being no sauce on it.. tasteless pizza!! Also, ordered a Diet Coke & they delivered a Coke...come on people, for $34, everything should be on point!!

I went into HopCat for the first time and I was pretty impressed with their draft selection. I wasn't sure of what I wanted since there are so many awesome beers to choose from. The bartender Joe was very helpful in my decision. He asked what kind of beers I liked, and I said it depended on my mood so I was not fully sure what I wanted. He left and came back with a sample of a beer that was similar to one of my absolute favorites, and I never even told him what my favorite beer was! It was a hoppier wheat that was similar to Gumball Head by Three Floyds. I ended up choosing a black IPA from the nitro draft that was quite tasty. Chrissy, was the bartender who poured it and added a very impressive heart shape to the head of the beer as she was pouring it. 

I did not have the chance to try their food, but I definitely will be going back there for that opportunity. I have heard advertisements on the radio about Sunday brunch at HopCat and I am very intrigued to try it. I was in there on a Sunday night around 830 or so and it was pretty dead in there. I would like to see what it is like when they are busy. I think that the restaurant has a pretty good flow and awesome ambiance. There are a quite a few tvs throughout the bar and the entire restaurant has painted portraits of famous musicians hanging on all the walls. I like the design of the bar as well it is big and spacious. There is also a bar in the back of the restaurant for busier nights I would imagine. 

They have 100 rotating drafts, which can change daily and 30 drafts that are local and generally stay fairly constant. I think it is awesome that they have 30 consistent local drafts. If you are not as daring of a beer drinker this may not be the place for you because I did not see any domestic beers on draft. Personally, I think that is awesome that every single beer on draft is craft. If you are looking to try a beer that you have never seen or heard of before I would recommend venturing into the HopCat to try something new!

During heavy construction on the way to work this year it seems as if we were always needing to get a tire fixed or replaced, and it made me so thankful that we used Discount Tire. No matter where you purchase or generally get service you can get tires repaired at any location. I had a flat tire at work and was able to make it to the closest shop, and they were very gracious and fast. I didn't miss much work at all, and there was no fee! We highly recommend their services.
