Also if you only need to check the air pressure they have a convenient spot outside. You pull up and someone will come out and check to make sure you only need air and not something else. Great savings of both time and money!

The Hub has the best ice cream in town, hands down, and now they have their own ice cream shop on Congress street. This is dangerous...I already went to the Hub for ice cream regularly, and now they open a shop that is open late...I'll be here daily. 

My absolute favorite ice cream is the oatmeal chocolate chip cookie dough. I will try all the different flavors and always come back to that one. A few other favorites are pistachio-lemon and the drunk brunch.

Pro Tip - Get a large for $8 rather than a small for $4 - get two or three flavors and a lid to save for later. Much better deal for the portion size.

Fastest, most thorough, oil change I have gotten in a while.  Jessie and the team were top notch with customer service and answered all questions without hesitation. Highly recommend! Even offered military discount! This store should be recognized for doing a great job all around!!

Horrible. Crab rangoon with absolutely no cream cheese, just deep fried wonton. They were so hard you couldn't even bite into it. When we asked to have crab rangoon with cream cheese...they just said no. When we asked for a refund on the crab rangoon, it was also no! Every dish here looks and tastes exactly the same. Just really shitty food. Not expecting much for late night takeout, but I would at least like it to be edible.

I don't understand the draw to Rustica... I would almost rather gnaw on a piece of cardboard w/ pizza sauce then eat this overrated, bland piece of garbage.  It's seriously the worst pizza crust I have ever had.  Somehow even the fancy toppings don't seem to save the tasteless dough that seems to be so popular.  If you want some really good, cheap pizza... buy some pizza dough from trader joes, roll it out, brush it w/ olive oil, put it on the grill for a few minutes, take it off/flip it, put on your own toppings, put it back on the grill for another couple minutes and you will have something way better than what Rustica is selling.  Don't waste your money at Rustica... it's a disgrace to pizza.
Brilliant!!! So good. Fabulous food, great service. Get the bacon scallops! Beet salad with salmon and the steak are amazing!!! Will totally come again.

This place is awesome! Love it! Great bar! Perfect place to watch any sport. The food is very good! I had the Temple Owl Sandwich. It was amazing! They have a great happy hour selection too! Great bar atmosphere and bar food!

This hotel deserves better than a 3-star rating.  So, in addition to a recap of my recent stay at the Hyatt Regency St. Louis at The Arch, I'll comment on a few of the shortcomings discussed in other reviews.

Looking at it as a business traveler, Hyatt Regency hotels offer most of the features you might want, such as good locations, exercise facilities, high quality furnishings, well-staffed service counters, and reliable restaurants.  At the same time, they avoid some of the less useful stuff, such as the nightly turn-down with mint, that serve mainly to drive up costs.  I've grown to prefer Hyatt's understated decor, which tends toward accented earth tones, over some of the more garish hotel schemes.  The Hyatt Regency St. Louis at the Arch fits right into this mold, with several pleasant surprises and one important deficiency.

On arrival, I was greeted by a friendly registration clerk, who noted my Gold Passport status and immediately offered coupons for the on-premises Starbucks, complimentary Wall Street Journal, and extended checkout on the last day of my stay.

Although booked at a discounted corporate rate, my room did offer a view of The Arch, as well as a usable desk with a real desk chair, an upholstered arm chair with a side table, a flat screen TV, a comfortable bed with a bolster and enough pillows for a small pillow fight.  The room itself had clearly been redone in the last several years, with up-to-date fixtures and HVAC controls. And, lo and behold, a good sized mini-fridge, empty and ready for my own perishable items rather than crammed to the gills with overpriced snacks. Iron and ironing board in the closet, but no robe (not a big deal).  The only real shortcoming was the lack of an in-room safe, which meant I had to go to extra lengths to secure my computer when going out.

I checked out the "historic" Brewhouse, which offered lots of TV screens, tasty fare of the pub variety (burgers, wings, ribs, onion rings) and servers willing to walk you through the menu of local brews.  I can't vouch for the historic part, but this establishment had something that so many hotel sports bars lack -- actual fans watching the game!  My only suggestion would be to come up with an alternative to the less-than-crisp saltines served with an otherwise satisfying onion soup.

I didn't eat at the other in-house restaurant (Red), though the idea of locally grown ingredients, cooked to order, looked promising.  There's also a Ruth's Chris on premises for the steakhouse fans.  I did use my comp cards at the Starbucks, which was friendly and efficient, and I spent the better part of an afternoon working at one of their big tables while hooked to the wireless.

The location was great -- about as close to The Arch as it was possible to get, and within walking distance of Busch Stadium, downtown restaurants, and several points of interest. If I were to do it again, I'd stay an extra day and look around.

A couple of small, helpful touches:  The lobby included workstations where you could check-in to your flight and print out your boarding pass.  And the doorman was able to direct me to the side of the building where my shuttle bus would stop.

Now, responses to comments from some of the less satisfied reviewers:

* $14.95 a day for Internet - This does seem pricey, especially if you stay multiple days.  Not an issue for me, since I was content to surf at Starbucks. But Hyatt corporate should consider whether the revenue is really worth the customer ill will.  It is the 21st Century after all.

* $25.00 for valet parking - Not unusual for a major hotel.  In my home city this rate would be a bargain.

Actually, I was surprised to read all the negative comments about parking. Downtown STL looks like one of the most parkable city centers I've seen in years.  C'mon folks, you can't expect a shopping center style lot in a downtown location close to a major tourist attraction.  And it looks like people who asked found alternatives close by.

* Untimely, poor quality housekeeping - Not my experience.  The housekeepers honored my door tags.  Both days I was there I observed a supervisor checking the rooms and monitoring the housekeeping staff.

* Small rooms, no fridge, no hairdryer - Not my experience.

* No in-room safe - True.  All business class hotels should have these.

* TV is not Hi Def - True.  Not a significant item on my list, but it could be for some.

* Elevator service is slow - Not my experience, but I can see how this could happen when the place is packed with Cubs fans.  :-)

* Hotel charged 15% tax. - Hotels don't charge tax, they merely collect it. Welcome, fellow traveler.

* Restaurants and nightlife are two blocks away - This is a negative?  Whew!

Bad things can and do happen.  However, my experience gave every indication of a pleasant, reasonably priced, well-managed property with a courteous and competent staff.  I'd return without hesitation.

i came here 3 times in a week! love this place. their margaritas are amazing, and decently priced. their guac is the best i've had in town (including my previous nyc food life). Food is also decent, although i think the highlights are nachos, guac, and the drinks. ambiance is great for groups, and perfect location to bar hop after some food and drinks. love this place.

I ordered the "Andy's Apple" cake as a surprise for my mother-in-law's 70th birthday and she loved it!  I went with this bakery because of all of the positive reviews, not to mention, quick service (I only ordered the cake a day prior) and was very pleasantly surprised.  My in laws are not big on sweets and they both said the cake was moist, not too sweet, and just plain delicious.  We'll definitely be ordering from here again in the future.  Thanks Swiss Haus! :)

Had breakfast here during my recent stay.  Very nice and clean inside.  Definitely feels fresh and new.  

Perfectly cooked eggs, and delicious breakfast potatoes.  Very good coffee as well, but did think that it was a bit over priced.  Nice and convenient for guests of the Hyatt.

$2.70 for a Coke, and not even an offer of a refill?
1 hr 30 minutes for lunch?
It was NOT that busy.

When we came in for lunch, there were only 6 tables occupied in the entire restaurant.
The waitress came over 5 times to ask how the food tasted, but never asked about the empty soda glass sitting at the edge of the table. You would think if they are charging such a high price, they might actually TRY to make it worth the patrons money.

Lessons learned:
1) Drink water: the wait staff is more likely to refill the water glass, they refill it right in front of you from a pitcher that they bring around, and the drinking water is free.

2) When you bring in a 2 for 1 coupon, do not let the wait staff walk off with it when they take your order. They WILL forget they have your coupon!

3) Don't think the wait staff is attentive to your needs, wants, desires, or expectations.

4) The original receipt has a survey option printed on it, and the detail charges. When they bring back your credit card, that receipt is no longer included, and you can not tell what they included in the final charges. Memorize it the first time, or snap a picture with your phone.

5) Choose a different restaurant, even though you have a coupon. Just say NO.

Food horrible.  Seemed like it is precooked and then heated.  Both dishes we ordered came cold.

Staff very friendly.

I think in comparison to Bay Area Mexican food, this place is not four stars at all. However, being in Reno and being one of the only good places to eat in Reno, this is not bad at all for Mexican food.

I always end up getting some kind of a combo at a Mexican restaurant that is more authentic because I can get a good burrito or taco anywhere. I got the shredded beef enchilada and the pork tamale and both were very delicious. Their chips and salsa are ok, but the great thing about the salsa is that it is ACTUALLY SPICY! :D

They have this $7.00 46 oz. margarita which is VERY worth while noting because it is delicious and much cheaper than an equivalent that I can find anywhere else. However, evidently the chicken mole was not that good so ... get their other authentic dishes and you'll be just fine.

I only wish I could say that I have had the same positive experience as others have at this establishment unfortunately, I have not. Why is this? It is because I have never been able to get an appointment at this salon. On three separate occasions I have been ignored or turned away. 

On my first, I was a walk-in, placed my name and number on the list and was told it would be 30 minutes. I went to do errands and came back 30 minutes later to be told they would call me. I never received a call back and when I called to inquire, they did not have my name. In the second instance, I made an appt by phone, arrived and was told they had no record of my reservation! Today, I walked in hoping with all my might that they may have time for a finger fix as I was shopping in the plaza. I was told bluntly "no time today, very long wait, we are busy with others." While I can certainly understand not being able to accommodate a walk-in or finger fix, the level of rudeness is unnecessary. Each time I have contacted this salon, it is the same young man - he has never been even pleasant or tried to be accommodating in anyway. 

This is sad as it looks like a nice place, closer to my home than my current salon and it seems to have a bustling business. Would love to give them mine but after today, I'm going to walk away - and I will not recommend them to others.

The best kindest thorough and attentive dentist office I've ever visited. Dr. Lee is the most gentle and sweetest dentist I've ever met. Being a very anxious patient I was instantly at ease with the staff's gentle and professional manners. I will never go anywhere else. Just an awesome experience and I will refer them to everyone I know.

What a wonderful experience! This museum is huge, with a great layout and more than enough history to soak up. The exhibits are curated with the utmost care. We learned so much and left astonished by the range and scope of beautiful cars to see and the depth of knowledge we gained. There's JFK's personal-use car from Florida, Elvis's car, Sammy Davis Jr.'s, Sinatra's, and John Wayne's, and so much more. This is an unforgettable experience. We'll recommend it to anyone.

I came here for lunch the other day and it was great! Just so people don't get confused. It's not a separate restaurant but a part of the Newtown Farmers Market, right near all the candies! I got the wings and they were great! I personally loved the hot wings because the hot sauce was great and the smoked bbq was great too. They're more "skin" than fried if that's what you prefer. I'm definitely come back and trying to ribs!

Was so excited to win tickets to the opening weekend of The Franklin Institute's new Karabots Pavilion: a three-story addition that houses the new permanent exhibition "Your Brain". Like the giant heart, I'm sure generations to come will remember their travels through the brain (which looks as though it takes some good scrambling abilities!).

The temporary "Circus! Science Under the Big Top" gave opportunity to fire up all senses. Loved watching the children walk the tightrope or do flips in the harnessed rigs. Enjoyed reading the history about the contortionists, sword swallowers, hearing the circus music and elephant trumpets. Got most of the familiar circus smells correct: guess the only thing I didn't really do was taste anything!

The new multimedia exhibit "101 Inventions That Changed the World" was a fantastic opportunity to snag a bench (or a spot on the floor) to rest the feet and watch the quick countdown on screens both on all the wall space and lighting up the floor. It was fun guessing what would make the list (and approximately where on the list)!

So I had planned a walk of Candy Cane Lane nearby, and needed a place to lead my merry bunch of chilled light-seers afterwards.  Going solely on Yelp reviews, I narrowed it down to Haven Social Club or Delux Burger.  A friend tipped my vote for Delux, and am I ever glad we went there.

It was simply what I was looking for.  Casual yet chic, seating with ambient noise, but close enough and quiet enough for our group of seven to easily converse.  We went on a Thursday night, and the place was quiet enough, as in we didn't have to wait for a table (for seven!) and yet there were no vast empty stretches of tables.  Hell, there aren't vast stretches of tables period.  The place is cozy.

I knew it would be pricy, and it was.  I enjoyed my mini kobe beef burgers and wee shopping cart of fires (to share).  The drinks were reported as quite enjoyable, and the hostess kept my tea full.

Service was there when needed, and unobtrusive when it was clear we were our own entertainment.

A nice place to have a classy bite.  A solid food type being served with upscale ambience and tasty additions.  Kinda like a black lab dog in a fancy pink sweater and matching booties.  You don't need it, but sometimes it is fun to dress it up.

You can feel the love behind everything in this cafe, from the ambiance/decor, to the food, to the service.  This mother/daughter team are dedicated to making sure your experience here is memorable. Everything is made from scratch, and is always fresh and delicious.  They go out of their way to make you feel welcomed.  They're also dedicated to helping the local music scene flourish, and regularly select unique and talented musicians for their Saturday nights.  Open Mic is every Thursday, and is ALWAYS a great time for everyone!  There's not another spot like this in the area, and you will always feel at home here!

This place is great! They have MANY different beers on tap plus several different bottles which are always changing.  Prices are very reasonable and you can get a beer for 2 or 3 bucks on just about any night.  This low key sports bar also hosts many different activities such as Quizzo, karaoke and live bands.  Fun place to hang out with friends, or meet new people!

Unfortunately the past two times I have eaten here, I have left hungry. I was there a month ago and did not write about my experience because I thought it could have been an off day. 

That day, I ordered a lunch special of Caesar salad and a hamburger. The salad was good but small, of course it was a lunch special. I could barely see my hamburger between the bun. It was the thinnest burger I have ever seen. I did not think anyone could get a burger thinner than Steal N Shake but they nailed it.

Today I got the chicken salad sandwich with potato chips. This place has got to be making a small fortune during lunch.  The chicken salad on the sandwich was spread thinly on the bread.  I ate all the sandwich, the chips and as I walked out of the door, my stomach growled. 

Would I come back here?  No, three times is enough to decide that this place can be taken off the lunch list.
Amazing place with great owners. I love the Greek salad for two, feeds my family of 4 without any issues.  So happy we live close to this place!

After years of COVID (will it ever end?) I went back to Helm for a wedding rehearsal dinner. The entire restaurant was booked for this event. Food was served family style, so big plates came out and we would serve ourselves and pass it along. 

To say the food was amazing does not begin to say enough. As in my last review, this is a fantastic tiny little place for some amazing food. 

Two notes - it can get loud as they don't have any sound management in the place. Also it is byob so bring your best wine to pair with the best food. 

I am gluten free and they were careful to point out what was being served and what I could or could not eat. Very good people there.

Good Service and no singnificant wait time.

Delicious crawfish boil. Came out hot(tempurature wise) and flavorful. Also has a nice kick!

Gumbo was delish. Got it with a half shrimp poboy which was also spot on. Decently priced

Employees greeted my friends and I so warmly from the second we walked through the door! So friendly. Their service was fast, and food was great. Pizza is very thick with lots of cheese and a crisp crust. Definitely unique taste in the local pizza biz.

First time at Ted Drewes today. I heard a lot of hype about this place, so was trying not to get my hopes up : )

One thing I had heard was that there could be long lines, but when we pulled in, on a Sunday afternoon, there was no wait.

I opted for the concrete with Heath bar mixed in. I thought it was good. This is a custard place, not ice cream.

My best comparison is a concrete mixer from Culver's. I think Culver's is better, a little creamier and more substantial.

I'd definitely go back. TD is good, in my opinion, not great. But it is priced very reasonably. Three of us got custard for about $12 - that's not too shabby!

Nashville's "Little Kurdistan" section has led me to explore Newroz Market just next door to Azadi International Food Market. Newroz is similar to Azadi in that they sell grocery staples and have a bakery but Newroz also sells shawarma sandwiches & plates, shish kabobs, roast chickens and hummus.
First trip - I had a large beef shawarma sandwich which is served on naan bread and a small chicken shawarma which is served on sammon, a different shaped bread with a nice crust. The naan is softer and more more chewy than the sammon. They are traditional shawarma roasted and sliced right off a vertical rotisserie. Shawarma is an Arabic word from the Turkish çevirme meaning "turning." I ordered mine with everything and that included lettuce, tomato, cucumber, onion, tzatziki and hot sauce. 
They had a lot of other sauces in bottles but I didn't ask about them all yet, but I will. I overheard someone ordering theirs with mayonnaise so there's that. Priced at 4.99 & 5.99, these are a good deal. They are good sandwiches but fall somewhat short of A & H Mart's shawarma. Ibrahim is still the best I've had. (Next shawarma to try is Sulav then Mazi.)
It's fun to eat in this bustling little store, there are four or five tables which fill up quickly at peak hours. Next I'll try the kabobs.

Fries are a must! Crispy, plentiful,perfectly salted, hand cut  and a treat for your palate. Service at counter and staff friendly. I got the hamburger that is cooked in metal cooktop but wasn't crispy on the outside ( I guess I mean browned correctly) and was soft. The bun is uninspiring and very thick. The lettuce was crunchy and other condiments good. I just wish the patty had been browned to make for a much better burger. The atmosphere is pleasant and family friendly!  I would come back just for the fries alone!

Appetizers were good. Theme burger for $22.00 good once. Had better for half. Atmosphere not what I expected. Manager breezed by multiple times, almost like an apology. Sunday night dinner around 6. Staff seemed like it was past there bed time.
Seems inner City restaurants do not need to try as hard as suburban establishments, just by per capita...

Pleasantly surprised.  Cute byo, helpful staff. Zucchini pancake appetizer was almost perfect, just needed to be more cooked in the middle. Stuffed cabbage, filled with meat and rice, was very flavorful. Even the rice was great. I think I'll be back.

Ice cream only.  Very refreshing while waiting for a table at another restaurant.  Waffle and plain cones, strawberry and vanilla, all good.  Strawberry had significant quantity of real fruit chunks.  Good ice cream.

I've been here twice with different friends. Located in an old house it has about 10 tables inside, a cute fireplace,  a long bar plus a covered patio, it has a nice, cozy atmosphere. I found I really enjoyed it both times I've been. The mango iced tea is sooo addicting! I had sushi both times and really liked it. The fish tasted fresh and I liked the unique roll choices, especially the ones with spicy elements like serrano pepper! The service wasn't bad, wasn't great either. She was polite however, for being the only table in the restaurant at 4:30 on a monday I don't think my glass of mango tea (did I say how amazing it is!!) should have gone empty.  
My friend had the udon bowl and really enjoyed it too.
     I don't understand how the reviews are so mixed. Perhaps they are inconsistent when they are busy? Both times I've been have been during slow times of day. I will definitly be back!

Best restaurant on the East side!!  The crab cakes are meaty and wonderful......a definite winner!  The perch and chicken milan are also on our list of favorites-great atmosphere-big portions....go tonight!

I am absolutely appalled and livid at this scum of a restaurant and the owner. They served my TWO YEAR OLD child a raw burger and he now has extreme food poisoning!

My husband, my 2 year old son and I came for dinner May 22nd at 5pm. We were seated outside, they are under staffed so it took forever to get orders in and for our food to come out. My son ordered the burger off the kids menu. It came out and he had a couple of bites while holding the burger with both hands. The amount of flies that were landing on our food was gross so we asked to be moved inside. Upon being moved inside under the super bright lights and cutting my sons burger we could plainly see the whole inside of his burger was RED, raw and uncooked! A waitress came by and was appalled and went to tell who I now know is the owners husband who tried to discretely walk by to look until I caught his eye and he took the burger and went to make a new one. While it was alarming, we didn't realize how bad it would get since he had only consumed a couple of bites but in only a few short hours at 11pm my son was asleep in bed and throwing up everywhere.

He continued vomiting non stop so we took him to the ER where he was given an anti nausea pill while we waited to see the doctor. This pill did nothing and my son continued to vomit except now the contents of his stomach were empty so he was vomiting up bile and dry retching. Upon being admitted he was given an IV and more anti nausea medication so he could try to get some sleep.

We were at the hospital until Sunday where they ran tests and by pure luck decided it was 'only' food poisoning and not E. coli or salmonella as at that time he had no diarrhea or bloody diarrhea.

Upon 11am on Sunday when The Lazy Gator (or lazy owner/lazy cooks it should now be called) opened my husband called and spoke with the hostess and asked for the owner and was told she doesn't come in today so he asked for a manager and she gave the phone to a waitress. This waitress said she would get the owner 'Sunny' to give him a call back. Never heard one word back from her. I reached out via Facebook and Facebook messenger and heard nothing back. My husband, growing frustrated at 3pm drove to the restaurant himself and surprise surprise Sunny was there! She claims no one told her. Not one word of sorry and the best she could do was give a check back for the amount of the meal minus the 20% tip which against my better judgement I left since it wasn't our waiters fault.

All day Sunday my son continued throwing up, not eating or drinking and having diarrhea. The owner finally replied to my message saying she had "sorry ur going thru that talked to my husband earlier" - and????? The level of pitiful ownership or conscious she has is frightening. We took him to his pediatrician first thing Monday morning who confirmed it was food poisoning. He took 3 stool samples from my sons diarrhea to test for bacteria/e coli etc.

As Monday progressed my son continued having diarrhea every 15 mins and he has developed such severe diaper rash he screams in agony to be changed, CANNOT WALK ON HIS LEGS AS HE IS IN SO MUCH PAIN, has to walk on his knees or crawl.

We consulted with a lawyer who was phenomenal and caring (more than we can say about this trash of an owner) and the only thing that is saving her ass from getting her restaurant closed and owned by us is the fact that her husband took the burger away as soon as he saw it so we do not have the burger to test and food poisoning cases are notoriously hard.

All up this has cost my family missed days of work, paying for daycare that my son is too sick to go to, a $150 rug that is now ruined with throw up and diarrhea and would cost more to have cleaned than it's worth, hospital and doctor visits, 30 diapers in 2 days, pedialyte, ondanestron pills, diaper rash creams, the list goes on..

Do yourself a favor and avoid this place like the Black Plague that it is - as a patron or as someone looking for work. Do not take this risk your health is more important. Do not risk your livelihood this lady is a cold hearted B who is morally corrupt - do your own research she has questionable allegations against her for buying meat illegally.

This review is based on the donuts only. 
I heard some good reviews about their wings but I was on my way to get dinner when I passed by Fed Donuts. My friend and I peeked inside thru the glass the windows and checked out the massive pile of chicken. My friend, who was vising Philly, wanted to try at lease the donuts, so  we stepped inside. 

I am obsessed w/ bread but no so much w/ donuts. But let me just say...

I never knew donuts could be SO GOOD. 
We got a strawberry donut and mocha donut. The ones we got were literally fried, sprinkled w/ the flavors, and then served immediately. Wow.. like i said.. .it was first time learnging that hot, fresh, donuts can melt in your mouth. I couldn't taste the mocha that much but the strawberry donut was not too sweet and slightly fruity. When we were at Federal Donuts, they were actually about to close in like ten minutes because they were sold out. So the owner gave us 2 free extra donuts (in vanilla and something else (sorry i can't remember) and more cut up samples. 

I definitely will go back here when I am craving fresh donuts. 
And I definitely will go back to try the wings. 

Even if you are a not a fan of donuts, you should try it out!

I really like this place. Unlike most big box (Menards, Lowes, etc.) hardware stores I can actually find things here. When I can't find something there is always someone to ask, and they actually know where it is. The selection isn't super huge, but you can usually find what you need, just not 15 different brands of what you need. Also they give free paint can openers and paint stirrers, even if you're not buying paint. They're awesome.

I can see how these places have so many ratings! Awesome food and service was just as good. They are one of the most popular spots here for Oysters. I have to admit prior to my trip to NOLA I wasn't much of an oyster fan. Something about them just didn't attract me. I think it was more mental than anything. However being here and on vacation I knew I had to give them a shot. So we tried the raw and the chargrilled ones. Man o man, they truly surprised my taste buds and I can say that I can see what people rave about. 

Now, we ordered some other platters they had and that to me was just as good and delicious. The sampler plates are highly tasty and I would recommend.

WOW!!!!!!!
This place is amazingly delicious, a hidden gem.
The Dragon's Nest was to die for.  We will definitely be back and order from their Asian Menu

Very honest, trustworthy, and reliable auto shop. 
I've been a Customer for over 7 years, I've never went back for the same issue. Eigess and Thomas are the best

*Well Staffed and the service is Friendly/Timely

*Lots of seating! Good for couples or groups

*Nice atmosphere! Great location!

*Restrooms were kept up

MY FAVORITE APPETIZER SO FAR: CHEESE STEAK EGG ROLLS!
(from my friends) I heard that the CRAB QUESADILLAS were awesome! Also I love their Yeungling Beer!

I'm ready to go back and try more!

We've been here before and yes, the biscuits were good and the honey bar-b-que chicken was fantastic.  However, the fried chicken was overdone and tough.  Some of our other food was just so so.  

That being said, I am glad we came back and ate here again but I don't think we'll stop in the next time we are in town.

The views outside this restaurant are spectacular! My husband and I came for breakfast! We ordered the omelette and banana cream pancakes! My omelette came out wrong and had to be remade. It was okay. Nothing spectacular for a $30 omelet. The size was Pretty disappointing. My husband loves his pancakes! Would come back for the vanilla latte with oat milk! Was amazing! My husband wasn't a fan of his chai tea latte though.
This place is great if you want to hang out with the locals and drink some amazing coffee!

Gabrielle was wonderful! He called ahead, was timely and professional. We called because our dishwasher had been leaking. Before he arrived, my husband did a thorough deep clean of the appliance and was able to finally get it to a point where it no longer leaked; however, we still wanted an expert's opinion. Gabrielle looked over the machine and also was unable to find any leaks but he provided some great advice not only on the dishwasher but also our washing machine! Well worth the service call charge!!! I highly recommend Cody's Appliance. 

Cavalli House

I was really really impressed at the variety of items they stocked, including the massive beer selection of local craft beers. It was king cake season when we visited, so there were the obligatory tables of king cake, in over ten different varieties and four different sizes that I counted. 

What made me realize this was a local classic are the specialty K-cups for Rouses own blends. Definitely would have tried the beignet one if I liked coffee. Speaking of NOLA flavors, they stock king cake mix and Cafe du Monde beignet mix in case you want to take something home to your pet/plant sitters but don't want frosting getting messy in your suitcase. 

While I can't understand coming to Rouses for dinner when there is a whole feast of a city outside, they did look to have a good selection of hot bar items and pre-made dishes that could be reheated for your supper if you preferred that. Something I would personally appreciate if I was a local not a tourist (hypothetically). 

Prices seemed reasonable throughout the store and the staff were lovely.

We came for East Passyunk Restaurant Week and had a really lovely time! There was live bluegrass throughout, which was very fun. We loved the country poutine and Mac Daddy - would definitely order both again! We were pleased, but not amazed by, the pulled pork sandwich and the burger. Both were good, but nothing to write home about. We finished with the fried pound cake which was delicious!! The wait staff was also super friendly! 

All in all, we'd definitely recommend for a casual, southern-style meal in a great atmosphere!

This place was amazing!! We sat at the bar area and was served right away, even though the wait for a table was over 90 minutes. They have a solid beer selection, and the beef jerky was phenomenal. The meatballs are very zesty, so buyer beware.  Our waitress was very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu, and the manager even comped one of our drinks because it took too long to get to the table (with no prompting from us whatsoever!). While it's only a year old, it has a solid future in Philly!

I got to say, I'm not thrilled with this place. That being said I've been going to Ramen Bar just down the street for years now and have probably developed an emotional attachment there. But - doesn't mean I don't have evidence. I just didn't find the ramen from Terakawa all that flavorful. The service was incredibly quick and the ambience of the place has more of a fast casual vibe than an actual sit down ramen place that I'm personally more familiar with. The portions are big which is a plus, but idk, seems like a quantity over quality dilemma. Would not go back - would much much rather go to Ramen Bar down the road, where it might be a little pricier but it's definitely tastier and more crafted.

Their 150 point inspection on a used car apparently didn't include checking the dirty oil that was 2 quarts low.
Also, their advertised used car price doesn't mention the $495 car conditioning fee (yes, FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS and it wasn't 500 dollars clean.)
Another thing, it costs FOUR HUNDRED DOLLARS origination fee to take out a car loan if you finance on the spot.
But, here is my latest gripe.

This is in reference to a Cadillac CTS bought from Erwin (EJ) in May of this year. It is now the 16th of JULY and the car that we bought from your dealership is no longer legal to drive. I'm thinking of options here and I'm going to suggest a few things. First Option, the car is driven illegally and every time we get pulled over for not having registration, we submit the bill to you for reimbursement. Second option, we go to a notary tags place here and in 45 minutes we have the plate that it took more than a month to not get one from you. And then we submit the bill to you for reimbursement. By the way, my wife has to pay extra for tolls because of the fact that she cannot transfer EZ Pass to the car that we bought from you in May and now it is July. How are you going to rectify this dilemma???

A go-to spot for coffee and a light breakfast. I always get the latte and a ham and cheese croissant. The latte (hot or iced) never fails to live up to my expectations. The croissant is perfectly flaky (make sure to ask for it to be warmed up). The inside of the shop is quaint and features a selection of unique groceries.
Rex and his team at Auto Painters did a great job with my SUV! I will definitely use them again if the need arises. They were so pleasant and helpful!

WORST POSSIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE IN THE ENTIRE WORLD!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The representative hung up the phone on me while I was politely talking to her about a ticket and asking what my options were as I got the ticket by complete mistake. I received the ticket on the street near the MOST CONFUSING SIGN which was clearly just a way to make money off of people of Philadelphia (the usual). I am beyond angry! Not only was she rude and disrespectful, but she was not listening to a word I said. THEY failed to send a letter in the mail requesting a payment that I was disputing and more than 4 months later, I received an invoice for double my already ridiculously high fine. When I called, this poor excuse of a decent human being advised me that the only option I have is to pay the fine with the late fees (double the original fine) and to stop asking her any questions. I have never had a more unpleasant experience with customer service in my whole entire life. All they are are a bunch of schemes just trying to suck money out of people with their misleading parking signs and completely and utterly disgusting customer service representatives.

I first started going to Dr. Orloff-Kurzrok (O-K) when the practice was under Dr. Nikki Lang, about three years ago and continue to go to her as a general practitioner as well. I went at the recommendation of a friend, with a caveat about the staff at the front desk. They're a bit short and cold. It's all business all the time with them, so be prepared. Dr. O-K is friendly enough, but I wish she would spend more time explaining her methods. I know all doctors are very busy, but I wish some took on fewer patients. Also, it's a bit tricky to find the office as it's downstairs in a row of lovely brownstones.

We ate here, our first night in new orleans and it was a wonderful experence. They have the most delightful patio seating. The service was good , the food was better. I highly recommend  the porkchop with Corn Maque Choux.

I was involved in a multi vehicle accident in which I was an innocent bystander. After finding out that the person at faults insurance was gonna cover 100% of the repair costs I was relieved. So I started the task of finding a collision repair business that was close and convenient for myself. I stumbled across service king in downtown Nashville, in which I made an appointment to take my car there. I was treated by Amber who handles some of the cars that come through to be repaired. Since my car is a Subaru and a specific model that has parts that are not very common I knew they might have my car for a while. Amber told me that my car would be expedited because Geico partners with this location and they have priority over others. After the adjuster denying 3 major parts including my windshield, side panel and quarter panel I was going to accept that I had to fix those at a later date. So even with this repair process happening between the week before thanksgiving and during I was dead set that my car wouldn't be completed until after the holiday. My car in fact was actually ready the day before thanksgiving, and needless to say I was 100% happy with the repairs that were done. My car which had complete front end damage looked brand new as in "New Car" new. I was so happy with the repair that I recommend this particular location over others. Amber and the team were very friendly and helpful

Used to order arepas from their food truck and now ordering that and more from their restaurant! You won't be disappointed if you love Latin cuisine! Price is right, food is amazing! Had lunch with my husband and two of our kids yesterday. We ordered three huge arepas, the cheese sticks (not your normal cheese stick), beef empanadas and rice beans and shredded beef dish that my son devoured! Service was good and the place was clean! Definitely check it out!

Girls night out! Nice decor and very spacious. Has an air hockey table, two small bowling lanes and a few other games. Was a little surprised didn't have more games as is a large place and not proportionate to number of guests. Advertising is huge on my promoting activities so would have expected more. Had a light snack-seasoned sesame edamame which was delicious and a Punch Bowl watermelon cocktail. Both were pretty good. 
Friends mostly had wings or nachos. They were underwhelmed -comments ranging from not hot ( fries) wings (bland). Not a bad spot would be willing to try our again but hopeful food is better.

I have been here 3 times now, and everything has been tasty! I HAVE to tell the owners one thing though--PLEASE GET A SIGN, PREFERABLY ONE WITH LIGHTS, because no one knows this restaurant exists. There is no sign at the top of the building, as there is for every other business in the shopping center. And the dark facade makes it look like the place is not open! 

Here is my review from our first visit: My boyfriend and I wanted to try out this place because it's so close to home and sounded awesome! This restaurant is located in the old Pizzeria Uno/Copabanana. It looks nice inside, though I think they should add some drapes to block out the view of the parking lot/movie theater.
We had 2 appetizers: the guacamole with tortilla chips ($5.99) and lobster fries ($10.99). The guacamole was very fresh and yummy! The lobster fries had an Old Bay-type seasoning on them and chunks of lobster and a good dipping sauce. We liked both appetizers a lot. We each had a drink (all mixed drinks are $6 each) and the drinks were pretty strong, so we got our money's worth! I had the Jamaican pot pie with mashed potatoes for dinner ($8.99) and it was very tasty. My boyfriend had the Tuna tacos (3 tacos with fries for $11.99) and they were good too. For dessert, we shared the Nanaimo Bar, which was a rich dark chocolate shell on top of ice cream with a thin layer of brownie underneath ($4.99). That was very good; good quality chocolate. We enjoyed trying this restaurant. It is a good value for your money. 
They do an express lunch from 11:30 to 2 pm Mon-Sat where lunch is $6 including a soda. They also have a midday menu every day from 2-6 pm which features $5 small plates. Next weekend (Valentine's Day weekend) is their grand opening celebration; they are going to have cheap drinks and a dj from 10 pm-2 am. It's nice to have something different (aka not pizza, cheesesteaks, or hoagies), but still reasonably priced, in the neighborhood.

ALWAYS a Great Experience! Evan Richards was the best server with a great memory! He remembered my favorite drink order and was able to recommend something perfect for my girlfriend-triple xxx!
 Check them out! Best happy hour in the valley!

Outstanding burgers. 
I've had the Burnt Cheese and Blue burgers, with the latter being my favorite. The beef is fantastically, drip-down-your-fingers juicy, smothered with piles of grilled onions and plenty of blue cheese. I wasn't expecting anywhere near the quality of burger I received- at a great price, too. 
It's a great alternative to Bru if you want something a bit quicker

Just moved to the area and love this Target, it reminds me of the one back home. Never super packed, quick in-and-out if needed, but can also take your time to browse without feeling overwhelmed by other shoppers. The Starbucks inside is always a bonus and the employees are super kind and helpful.

Visited for the first time today with some coworker's for a holiday lunch. Tucked away little spot in downtown Clayton; nothing fancy in the way of decor but a solid, delicious meal at a good price. I enjoyed the pizza combo of a 9 inch pizza and a small house salad. Both were delicious - the margherita was super cheesy, super thin St. Louis-style crust. 

Lots of people were coming in and out for carry out orders. Looking forward to visiting or carrying out again soon.

We went to Seltzers today for a birthday (4 of us in the same 10 days).  Three of us steak and none of them were cooked as ordered.  I ordered a bone in Rib Eye steak medium rare and it came med well - no pink at all.  My son ordered his steak Medium and it can very well done and my wife ordered her Prime Rib medium rare and at best is was medium - very little pink to it.  We reported this to the waiter and he did offer to take them back and have them re-done and my son did this.  My wife and I did not and am glad as it took my son's steak a good 15 minutes to come back from the kitchen.  The waiter did not seem like he thought that the over cooked food was a big thing.  We had to ask for refills of drinks several times, so all and all service was marginal at best then of course they add 18% gratuity to the check ($36.00) like it or not.

The care and attention and service from Dr. Schmidt is exceptional. He is extremely knowledgeable and attentive to what I describe as my symptoms. I feel put at ease every time I have had to come in to see him. I could not recommend his office more. He gave me information tailored to my issues on how I can improve my health on my own and within the short window of time we had together I felt completely tended to. 

As a side note, the reception office is also exceptionally warm and also efficient. 

Everyone in this office is so professional and helpful. Not only Dr. Schmidt but also the nurse practitioner (a gentleman I forget his name). I am very grateful this office is the place I can go when I am sick.
Pharmacy is really nice moved here from out of state and they made the process of getting my scripts over to them very simple. And they are very efficient.

Sevtap is a fun place for wine tasting. It's not that traditional or stuffy type of place to do tasting, but a real chill and even funky place. 

All the walls inside are made of chalkboards so people write and leave messages, draw, etc. 

The wines are excellent, but the best part of our experience was chatting with Art the owner. He is friendly and knowledgeable about wines. We learned more about wines (and not his wines, but wines in general) from chatting with him and tasting wines than any tour, or any tasting we'd been to. Art was able to suggest tours, vineyards to visit, places to eat, etc. We did a lot of wine tastings in Solvang, and this was one of the few places where we bought some wine to take home. 

There are coupons (groupons) for Sevtap around town. Check this place out. They had said they were hoping to add a cheese shop, and as soon as they do we'll be back. We tired over 10 places in Solvang and this was one of the places that landed in our top 3.
ive tried going here four times with no success because the drive tru takes so long that i have pulled away every single time. great job idiots!

Horrible experience - Went in to pick-up reserved truck , am told I have some issue that needs resolved . I call C.S. 3 times total 
1) Am told that there is a hold but they don't know why my name is attached ?
2) Am told there is some issue that I have been "affiliated" , what I supposedly did or am part of is not available and that I have been banned forever ( again , I've never had any type of issues prior to this ) from renting UHaul 
3) my next call went to U-Haul Corporate and the rep I spoke with tried sending me right back to the department I was reporting , when I explained , he rudely said " I can either send you to the department or I can hang up " I responded with-  as a customer , you won't talk to me like that . Then he hung up ! Needless to say U-Haul is one of the worst places for a customer to get issues resolved and their customer service is by far the rudest and dare I say shadiest groups I've had the displeasure of dealing with !

Love these bundt cakes!  they are perfect! Not too sweet and is super sweet! My favorites are the chocolate and red velvet. 

When you walk in, they have some samples for you to try  love this place and def recommend if you want gourmet cupcakes!

One of our local shops is Zesto. They combine tastiness and consistency to be our favorite neighborhood pizza.

They have an online order system so for the times when you don't want to talk to anyone, you are covered. Delivery is fast and has a reasonable $3 charge for us, I don't know if that changes by distance. Having two young children makes the delivery very important for us.

The pizza is very good. I have gotten a burger too and was very happy with it. We have also ordered cheese fries, the Zesto Fries are pretty awesome. They have huge wraps and a nice little salad selection.

Overall a good consistent shop with fast delivery. I would recommend it to others for sure.

Scammers! Scammers! Scammers!
This is the WORST company I have ever had to deal with!
I paid $2300 for Performance to get my system up and running then 6 weeks later the system failed and Performance said it failed due to bad duct work. Wouldn't you think they would of checked the duct work first seeing that I had a service plan that covered duct work!  They wanted to charge us another $1400 for more repairs or $7500 for a new system.
The owner Terry should be ashamed of himself.
 I got 2 other quotes for $350 to fix the problem or a new system for much less.  New system is up and running by a reliable and honest company.

CVS always has what I need... 90% of the time! From cleaning products to personal care to nutritional supplements, prescriptions, candy, holiday cards, etc... CVS is usually my "go-to" spot. 
The store even has a wide selection of groceries, and strangely the prices range from great deals to huge rip-offs. If you're money-minded, it's worth comparing CVS to your usual supermarket.
Pretty good. We usually get their wings and pizza. Very good overall and the service staff are very friendly. Highly recommend

Big "E" Taxi in New Orleans is the best! We made arrangements for airport pick-up a few days in advance (he likes 2 days notice). He was waiting for us at the airport, no hassle trying to get a taxi. On the way to our hotel, he entertained us with local information and places to go and see. We had also booked a return trip to the airport and our taxi was at our hotel as promised, even a little early. Big "E" is the way to go in New Orleans. $33 each way for 2 people.

The food here was spectacular! Delicious selection. Absolutely loved this place. We had the best service! Truly enjoyed my time here. I could not get enough of how cute this place was. Finished off dinner with a delicious cappuccino. Wouldn't have it any other way!

I'd give it a 4.5 if I could. The drinks are AMAZING ! My husband and I loved this place! The entrees were spectacular. The pork tenderloin was so tender and delicious, while the asian sticky buns were equally as good. The only reason I give 1/2 star off (hypothetically) is because the octopus we had was overcooked. However, they have us a free drink since we were disappointed in the octopus, which speaks volumes about how much they want to please customers. They are decently priced for the quality food and drink you get. We will definitely be back! Great place! Our waiter Dawson was fabulous!

sent me the wrong engine which took a month to get to my mechanic. I had to buy the correct one all over. Bryan said he would refund in full(I recorded all my phone conversations with him) after he got the first one back. he lied, wouldn't refund fully.

the second engine he claims has only 53,000 miles. it burns oil at a rate that I have to top off every two weeks.

check out these crooks on B.B.B. you will find a plethora of similar complaints and shoddy business practices. stay clear!

My man Allen does my cloths right.  I don't know of a better cleaners uptown past the park.  Its within walking distance from my house and prices are comparable to other cleaners uptown.  They open early Saturday so you can bang out this errand quickly and then breakfast at Maple Street Patisserie...good way to start your Saturday!

Restaurant is cute and owners nice, but the day we were there the food was very "meh". Bland, underseasoned, ungarnished etc.  Was dying to try the spaetzle with cheese and was disappointed with meager dumplings and cheese. Curry sausage was just plain flavorless. People who come here and like it must like very plain food!  Was nowhere near what I consider authentic German food. In the plus side everything is homemade and fresh.

I took my mom here today for a mani/pedi.  I like the salon...very clean and bright.  Our nails look nice, but my mom's nail tech put a damper on our mother/daughter outing.  My mom had a male nail tech who accused her of biting her nails and then called her a liar when she said she doesn't bite her nails.  He also asked her how old she was (not something you ask people) and then called her Grandma.  Seriously?!  I will go back again but will never go back to that tech...wish I remembered his name.
Great place to eat authentic Mexican food. Awesome service! Best Mexican restaurant in town!!!! Check it out, and you won't be disappointed!!!!
Always a good breakfast spot, but come early if you don't want to wait on the weekends. Delicious pancakes (they are huge) and good biscuits!

What a cute 50 style diner.  We visit often  when in Tucson. It is a family run operation. The food is delicious and save room for the ice cream treats.  If you can get to their rib fest which is once a month, you will be delighted.
M. Hammond
Fenton,Michigan

Finally getting in a review for this spot!  We've been countless times since opening, brought family and fri nds, so you can see the direction this review is going. Get there!  

We arrived close to noon on a Saturday.  It wasn't packed and we sat outside to enjoy the great weather. Our server was quick, friendly, and checked in quite a few times. 

I like the fact that they have the lunch portions now, we don't fill up and in our style are good to hit another spot for some bites to share not too long after  always make the most of days out to try new spots and dishes! 

I had the duck. My favorite here!!  With shishito peppers on the side. The ramen is just the right portion, and as mentioned in a couple reviews the noodle to broth ratio is on point. There was also a good amount of duck, so crisp yet juicy and really flavorful. The broth is tasty, but in our style we always add in a bit of their hot sauce. Don't miss out on this!  Just enough heat and kick but it doesn't overpower the underlying goodness of the dish. The side of peppers was also a good size, and those are delicious how they are blistered, with some roasted garlic and sugar to top. 

Since it was national beer day (um, when isn't it??) we indulged. I had a stout on draft and my hubby had an interesting can that was from Japan yet Belgian style. It was $12!  Granted we saw that and still got it, but beware.  Considering the ramen lunch was $13 the drinks are what sneaks up. 

All in all we love heading to st pete for an afternoon and make our way here quite often. Delish!

This was my first time here in philly. I was hearing all the rants and raves about this product known to man as the elusive Philadelphia Cheesesteak. Mind you I'm from the south & the only steaks we mess with is typically grilled and seasoned to perfection.

So a really great friend of mine took me to this place for my first cheesesteak. When it came in front of me, I was so amazed at what I saw. I immediately took my first bite and I almost lost my mind. My taste buds experienced such bliss that it felt orgasmic! Such a huge flow of emotions flowed through my mind as I continued to indulge in this cheesesteak. I was ecstatic, I was calm, I was frustrated, & I was angered. Why you ask? I felt angered because of all these other places I've had these so-called Philly Cheesesteaks at. 

Rock on Philly! I hate the snow but your hot sandwiches keeps everything in balance.

I had a great first experience here. My husband and I got the All for One and loved it. We got fries and coleslaw as sides. The sauces they keep in the fridge were both really good, and they  aren't kidding about the spice. Everything was great taste wise and the service was prompt and friendly. I'm looking forward to coming back and trying something different.

Came here on a Saturday night the wait was about 20 minutes but if I tell you the food was delicious and worth the wait you should definitely go here. The beer was delicious it was cold and refreshing. Now the Yuzu hot wings are by far the best wings I've had in a while the sauce and the crunch on the wings is phenomenal. The burgers were delicious and I highly recommend getting the tater tots as your side they were very good. Will definitely come back here

To date, the best Pakistani food I have had in the metro area. It is a privilege to be apart of the familial dining experience created by the husband and wife owners. 

Outstanding dishes all around including saag paneer, chicken tikka masala, chicken korma, chana masala, and so much more.

Soft shell crab platter and andouille and chicken gumbo. So very good. Prices are reasonable compared to some of the overhyped places down the road.Portions were just right. Just a bit away from overcrowded Bourbon Street. Friday night place is packed. If you can, sit at the bar with Rohan the bartender. Fabulous service, attentive and friendly even as he's serving a dozen customers. Will come here again.

My boyfriend and I have been ordering pizza from PIZZAVA for about 3 or 4 months now. We get pizza from here about once a month... sometimes two because we can't help it. Everytime we have ordered online, and our food is always cooked well and everything is evenly distributed. My boyfriend is a little picky so we normally get a XL cheese pizza and the crust is EXCELLENT. I wanted to get out of my comfort zone a little bit and try something that was a little less picky. I tried the chicken pizza with bacon bits and steak pieces with Alfredo sauce and fell IN LOVE. That's my go to pizza. I'm going to go order it again, right now along with some Cheese Bread. Can't wait!!!

Found this place on yelp, the first thing I notice was that the employees and the server wasn't that personable with taking our order. They all had on dirty clothes and shoes . The tables are pretty sticky and the place has a dirty water smell. The food was just average. This experience does not make my family and want to come back.

My landlord called them because I had a minor leak under the sink and couldn't figure out where it was coming from.  They called me Monday am, and were out by 2:00 that day.  Aaron showed up, introduced himself to me and my dog, and figured out what the issue was within about 10 min.  The disposal button on the sink wasn't sealed properly.  He resealed it - and within 30 minutes he was on his way.  Super friendly guy, seemed experienced, and explained all the way through.  $92/hour.

I had my hair cut with Mae and I went in to have a long graduated bob. My hair was down to my waist and i did not want short hair.I showed her a pic. She did a great job the first time around and I really loved it. It was to my shoulders. I had not had my hair cut in 20 years from a bad haircut so please keep that in mind and I told her that .
Then I went back for a trim 3 months later. Her prices increased an extra $10 in the 3 months to now $70 but I figured it would be worth it bc I loved the cut the first time.
 I showed her a pic of what she did last time and she said ok. 
Well, SHE CHOPPED MY HAIR TO MY CHIN AND ITS NOT A BOB. It is all choppy and so so short. I told her I didn't like short hair and I had a wedding to go to. But she got scissor happy apparently. The one side of my head is a total different length then the other and it's totally chopped and razored cut. Not a cute haircut at all. 
The reactions I get on this haircut are all negative which make me feel worse.  I thought this couldnt happen since she did such a good job the first time around. I learned my lesson. I WILL NEVER GO BACK HERE OR ANY SALON AGAIN!!!!!!

I visited here with my brother on a Tuesday night and we were seated promptly. The service was great, the food was mediocre and the prices were high. The chicken burger came with one peace of lettuce and three pieces of onion. My brother ordered the tuna steak dinner and the tuna was over cooked, the rice was bland, there was no trace of garlic in his garlic bread, and the best part of his meal was the side salad which he had to pay 90 cents for a dressing. Come on show me's you can do much better than this! Also the ambient temp was so hot due to 50+ TVs playing the exact same three channels.

Food was terrible. Obviously everything was frozen before cooking. They clearly do not care about the food they are serving, but what's worse is staffs nasty mean attitude. Don't waste your money here.

My experience with Michael's was disappointing.  I called them and got an estimate of between $300 and $400, and arranged to take the car there for a firm price late on a Wednesday afternoon, with the detailing to be done the next day.  Since they require the car to be dropped off by 9 AM on the day of service, my plan was to get the price established and just leave the car there.  So my wife and I drove separate cars there, and when we arrived shortly after 4 PM the place was locked up tight as a drum, with no note on the door and not a soul in sight.  I then verified their phone number on the sign outside and called them up, only to get their recorded message saying they were open until 5 PM.  Needless to say, my enthusiasm to do business with them faded pretty quickly, and I ended up having the car detailed elsewhere.
really good food + terrific, friendly service + DELICIOUS housemade horchata with rum (rumchata, if you will) + reasonable prices = i'll be back.
Call ahead because the last three times I tried to go they were full due to private parties. I've given up on this place which is sad because they make an excellent Filet Mignon.

This is a great spot, and I got a great haircut!

I've been looking for a good haircut since my wife and I moved to Tampa three years ago, and now that we bought a home in Seminole Heights, I decided to walk down the road, and I was not disappointed. It's a cash-only barbershop, but the owner even let me walk to an ATM afterwards so I wouldn't lose my place in line.

The owner Chris is a good guy, and this turned into my new permanent barbershop.

Great mechanic! Been coming here for over a year and have not had any issues! Staff are all really friendly and provide excellent customer service. I've had some more serious issues with my car and the staff are always willing to explain everything that is going on and do the work for a reasonable price and are pretty quick in completing repairs. The mechanics have even text pictures of repair work needing to be done to ensure I was aware of the needed repair. 
Also, they are very quick with oil changes and have a key chain where you get a free oil change after so many (I think the 5th one is free).
This place is very unique. I got my haircut yesterday at the chair. It was a pleasure talking with Becky as she cut my hair. She did an a amazing job. I will definitely be back.

Close to my house but of course I tried them last and found out they're the best and the easiest to fit me in and they do a great job they're super nice they actually know my name and I still go everywhere and anywhere for a pedicure still trying to find who gives the best foot massage. KY has been doing my last few acrylic fills. He's an artist!

Went up to Reno and had to check out this spot. Had a great time,  beautiful venue, great talent, amazing night but it wouldn't have been nearly as awesome without our incredible waitress, Ali. She made us feel at home and far exceeded our expectations for the evening, will definitely be back!

I had a wonderful experience here actually purchasing my new best friend. I've had an even better experience watching him grow healthily and happily. I would recommend this business to anyone interested in purchasing a doggo.

Great atmosphere with great food! It's nice to see creativity coming from the culinary arts at theory. Moderately priced for such quality ingredients and innovative dishes. A great place to eat or just grab a beer at their quaint bar. To sum it up..modern, artistic, casual, creative, attentive, attractive delicious. A wonderful addition to midtown!

Bottomline: The food is good however the service is terrible. The owner/manager is great and really friendly, however the service staff is young and inexperienced. We've ordered espressos many times and anything made by the service staff is disappointing whereas when made by the Manager/Owner, it's great. My most recent experience was really awful - I ordered a turkey hoagie for takeout and I came to pick it up (was quoted over the phone for 10-15 minutes) and waited 25 minutes before I asked the waitress to check with the kitchen. After they checked with the kitchen, they advised me that their system screwed up and the order never got to the kitchen. They refunded my money, however set me back 45 minutes and I left without any food. This was a waste of my time and could have been prevented by having more communication between the service staff and the kitchen. These inconsistent experiences prompted me to write this review in order to make others aware. You may get a great experience (if served by the Owner/Manager) however experiences lead me to conclude that it'll be a bad experience. There are a lot of restaurants nearby that I would go to rather than trying Cafe V again. My suggestion is to hire more experienced service staff.
Good price, good portion size, good food. The flow 5/5 tbh. I am making this spot my regular because of how amazing it is ^_^

I went in about a month ago (early March).  My student from Syria invited me there.  MAN it was amazing.  I'm not one to rave about food unless it merits raving.  My go to middle eastern dish is falafel so I ordered that.

Fresh fresh fresh and so well seasoned and bursting with floral aromas.  Everything down to the fresh fluffy salty pitas were perfect.  Service was good- although the impatient American may have to wait a bit around rush hour.  But so worth it.  I plan on sampling other items and told my Dad and friends who live in the area about it.  The owner, (who I believe was the guy preparing the food) was friendly and very attentive.

If you like middle eastern or any exotic meal with lots of unique seasoning you won't be let down.  It lives up to the hype.   I plan to make a trip from St. Pete on the weekend to enjoy again.

Cute little place!!! It gets busy and parking is hard to come by! We didn't eat. Bought one reasonably priced drink each, sat at the bar to drink it & people watch. Then hit the beach for a walk. Great little local place to watch people play sand volleyball.

My husband went to this dentist in October, 2019, to get a quote and exam for invisaligns.  The dentist looked in his mouth for all of 5 minutes and told him he would not be a good candidate as he would have to wear them for 3 to 5 years.  He then told him to wait and they would do a scan, he waited an hour and no one came to see him for the scan.  He left telling the front desk this.  No one ever called him back.  He went to our regular dentist and they have confirmed he will get great results and will only have to wear the invisaligns for up to 15 months.  I would never recommend this dentist.

The only poke bowl spot here in Reno so it gets pretty busy especially if you get stuck behind someone who's indecisive. It's pretty good, the fish are pretty fresh,  although it doesn't offer anything different from most poke bowl spots. Also, if you've left some room, try the macaroons, it's from a different company but it's good.

My wife dropped off her laptop with a new screen to replace the cracked original.  She was quoted a price of $129.00 for the job.  Some hours later, we received a call saying that the job would be $195.00 due to the motherboard needing to be removed.  It was late on a Friday and we wanted the laptop back, so we paid it.  The extra 70 bucks is not the issue.  The issue was the bait and switch tactic.  Why did they not know that the motherboard needed to be removed?   They did, but they got us in the store by quoting a lower price.  For some reason, they felt the need to show us photos of how difficult the job was, even though we did not utter a single word of complaint.  The guy at the desk also felt the need to tell us a "black" person walked off with his last cell phone when he left it on the counter.  Decent quality work..very low quality individuals running the place
Fantastic sized portions and super friendly customer service. We ordered the GF gumbo, GF crab tacos, GF crab-cake po-boy and carrot juice. It was all super tasty and delicious.

We had dinner there tonight. The steamed dumplings were tasty. But the Drunken Noodle entree was heavy on noodle  and light on vegetables. Pretty disappointing. For such a fancy place I expected  a little more inspiration. The meal was comparable to any dive Thai restaurant in any town. Nothing special. Sorry.

Food is excellent. Highly recommend the tomato pie. Wings are crispy and full of flavor. Got it delivered to the hotel I am staying in and the delivery was right on time. Delivery man was very nice and called as soon as he arrived. Would definitely eat here again and will be recommending this place to family and friends.

This new addition to the scene in Louisiana is part of a large chain.  The store features a large selection of wines from very inexpensive to some very nice bottles.  

Local wines, sparkling, etc are along the right side of the store.  There is a distillery section featuring bourbons, a large selection of scotch and a fair whiskey selection.  Aisles of vodka and gin are much smaller than others.  There was a good and interesting selection of tequila as well.  

Beer selection is solid.  Good mix of local and national craft brews, cold beer fridge in the back with self serve and kegs available.  The layout of the beer section allows for plenty of case stock in addition to individuals.  Hard cider, hard seltzer and other drinks.

Good selection of mixers including fever free tonic water - but that was located in two different places and a bit confusing.

Glassware, bareware, ans bar tools throughout the store.  Some of the locations don't make sense- but they just opened and things will change over time.  

Prices are good on some items - best price on Veuve Cliquot and Maker's Mark in the city (including better than Costco).  

They have a rewards program and if you plan on shopping there it may be a good idea to join.  

There is a tasting area that is open Friday, Saturday and Sunday right now.  Excellent store hours (open until 10pm).  There is a cigar room as well as a classroom in the back of the store.  

I'm sure I've missed a few things - but I will update this review over time.

I went in about 18 months ago for an oil change and they told me I needed front brakes.  Told them I would take it to my mechanic.  My mechanic laughed, I didn't need brakes. Last week my husband went in for an oil change. He forgot this was the Jiffy Lube who told me I needed brakes.  They proceeded to tell him he needed his radiator flushed.  His radiator had been replaced 10 days prior and his cooling system flushed. Avoid this location!!

Excellent meal! We got in around 6pm and got seated immediatelly.. When we were leaving after 7pm there already was about an hour wait. Dining room was cozy. Staff was pleasant and fun.
Sausage cheesecake was indeed great (not die for but very tasty!). BBQ Seafood Stew (flounder, shrimp, oysters in the most wonderful sauce on top of grits) was EXCELLENT! Loved it! :)

These guys are amazing!  From the people at the front desk (usually the office manager Katie) to the techs to the doctors, everyone here is just a pleasure to interact with.  They're amazing with our pets and on more than one occasion have been able to help us get a same day or next day appointment when we needed to do so. They have helped us get control over our 3 legged cat's thyroid and subsequent skin issues and they carry the prescription food she needs.  They're kind, affordable and have cared for our pets consistently for the last 13 years.  If you're looking for someone to care for your fur babies you won't find a better place in the area than Dr. Crocker and Dr. Davis (and staff)!

I always love mom and pop taco places. This place uses fresh ingredients and what I like about hem most, is that they give you the autonomy to determine how much spice you want. 

I got the following: 
- Chorizo: crispy and flavorful
- Al Pastor: right amount of pinapple but pork could have a tad more flavor
- Sesina: was a bit extra crispy and a tad over grilled but still very good
- Fajita: doesn't really represent fajita ingredients but was very good

Most tacos are $2.00 and the most expensive is $2.50. This place is priced extremely well for the size of their tacos. I also like how they have a wide variety of Mexican drinks which is great 

Why my 4: The main complaint here is that is that we (group of 3 individuals) waited a solid 35-minutes to have our food brought to the table. At the time, we were only only the 2nd table with people.

This is what a local casino should be. Amazing food at reasonable prices. Great service around the casino. Smoky atmosphere is toned way down from the past, but is still in the air. Bathrooms are always inconvenient if you are dining in the restaurants but that design flaw was made ages ago. Be prepared for a busy parking lot and long wait times for the cafe. This is a reflection of the good service and food. The Steak House goes head to head with any in Reno and blows away the likes of Outback and Claim Jumper.

Love this Airport. It's a lot of walking so be prepared but I love it. It's fairly new, very clean & updated. Plenty of fun shops & restaurants. Spacious. There was even this one table where you can pedal while sitting there. It was awesome. I was in the southwest terminal B and was very impressed. 

Note: I don't recall seeing a Starbucks. **gasp** I'm hoping it's only because I overlooked it. I'll check back tomorrow. Let's hope.
Stopped in because we heard great music.  Mario was awesome.  We will go back there again.

I work at the Navy Yard and it's about time a great restaurant went in! My boss, a coworker, and I went over for lunch and had a great time. I had the roasted octopus roll, which is served with a side salad, both of which were great! He had the burger and really enjoyed it, as well. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The upstairs dining room was crowded but our server took the time to go item by item to explain any modifications that could be made so that my coworker with a shellfish allergy could order. 

I went back for a happy hour and the place was mobbed. Our happy hour ended up being much larger than anticipated, and they were really gracious and gave us a separate room upstairs, even though we weren't ordering food. The bartenders give great recommendations and are fun to chat with! 

I'm sure Vetri's latest venture will be just as successful as his others!

Ants all over the room! There were people smoking weed and cigarettes in the rooms and halls even though it was a non smoking room hall and staff did nothing about it. Most staff was friendly but front desk manager Karla Patel has got to be the rudest most nasty individual I have ever come across she definitely does a good job representing the establishment for what it is...a dump. Breakfast made me sick, I second guessed the sausage but it may have been the yogurt who knows and the court area fountain was disgusting and depressing. Parking was a joke and if we came to our room after 8 pm we had to park in the middle of the street! Asking for a packet of toothpaste? A spare toothbrush? Forget it all you will get is a nasty look and rudeness as if asking someone to do their job is asking for to much. Karla in particular did not want to be bothered to lift a finger talk about hospitality. I should have spent the few extra bucks to stay next door at the residence inn by Marriott. Lesson learned

Everything is made as you order, and it's all worth the wait. Trust me. 

The fried chicken was among the best I've had in town, and the Mac and cheese and coleslaw were great, as well. 

I'll be back ASAP! Lots more to try on the menu.

Just visiting this bar and we came to see Robert and Issac, a reggae/rock band that is super chill and so lovely to sway to. The bar pours good drinks and hosts local musicians, which makes me happy for humankind. They are very inexpensive and will introduce you to young local talents. Come and check it out!

Stopped in to try this place as I didn't feel like cooking after a rough day at work. Service was excellent-- the staff is very personable and attentive. Food was on par with other Indian places in the area, portions are generous for the price. For those who like spice, they offer spice levels for all their dishes. My husband ordered his meal "Indian spicy" and was satisfied with the heat, which is rare for him. This is a family business and you can tell a lot of care and pride has gone into making the dining room look and feel nice. They even imported a rickshaw that diners can use for photos (for you Instagram types).

I have been a Wells Fargo customer since High school and I must say they always go above and beyond with customer service!

This location can get fairly busy but they always manage to see customers in a timely manner. The bank is alwasy clean but parking can be a mess if its busy.  

I plan to bank here for years to come :) Why mess with a good thing?

Excellent and professional customer service and my car looks like new! Would recommend to anyone and everyone. Don't wait to get your car detailed like me, I wish I had done this long ago! The business owner, Chase, was very communicative and went beyond to ensure a great experience with this service. Thank you!

The quality of the drinks, the flavor of the ribs and the mouthwatering dessert I had are the only saving graces for an establishment I otherwise probably would have decided not to visit again.

For one, the service was lacking.  Our server was friendly and chatty, but really backed up even though it didn't seem packed and it was the only restaurant on 13th street on Friday night that still had available outdoor seating during the dinner rush.  It took forever for the drinks to come out (though they were delicious and fresh- I'll give them that.  My white wine sangria was perfectly tart).  Then my 3 friends got their entrees at least 15 minutes before mine.  I understand the paella requires far different preparation than the charcuteria (and 5 minutes would have been forgivable) but for them to be nearly halfway done with their meals before I even get mine is a little frustrating.

And my seafood paella wasn't even really worth the wait.  It was quite tiny for $27 (though still bigger than my friends' tiny entrees) and a lot of the rice was burnt to the bottom of the cast iron skillet, making it chewy and unpleasant to eat.
