The rice actually tasted like those $2 yellow saffron Spanish rice packets you can get at the supermarket- not bad by any means, just underwhelming and overly gooey in consistency- not fluffy how I imagined.  The shrimp was the best, but scarce.  There was maybe one singular piece of octopus/calamari.  And the mussels, though there were plenty, were just okay.  I've had better at Devil's Den.  It was mostly just tons of rice heavily laden with spice.

The lemon/goat cheese/crabmeat arranchera appetizer was absolutely delicious- though only 1 ball per person and hardly any crabmeat.  The papas frites were tasty and a more substantial appetizer meant for splitting, so that's redeemable.  The rib entrée was quite possible the tastiest meat I've ever eaten, but again- there were only 3 measly little pieces of rib.

The dessert was heavenly- some type of peanut butter ice cream with a pretzel brittle and a giant toasted marshmallow on top- it was absolutely perfect.

I would maybe come back to try something else since their menu is seasonal, but for the prices I'm not entirely sure it's worth the trip.
Love this place. Eat here at least every other week. Consistantly fresh, refreshing, and delicious.

This location is hit or miss.
I have been here multiple times and the food tasted different each occasion. Sometimes the food is perfect while others it was tasteless and bland. 
I got the dandan noodles and chili oil dumplings for and appetizer which are usually delicious but i have found the noodles can vary in taste sometimes very dry and they also have forgotten to put pork in it.
When ordering your main course even though you will find the spice level next to the type of style we have gotten dry pepper that was so spicy were crying while other times it was very bland with no spice at all.
I have found it helps if you tell the server the spice level of the dish that you want and they adjust accordingly. This has helped us get the exact tasting meal that we are expecting each time. 
I definitely recommend going into eat instead of getting the food togo as i haven't had great experiences.
Overall pretty good food as well as the service is always great. 
Also a great BYOB restaurant

For breakfast, it was different and pretty good. Perfect service and charming place. Food was Tex-mex breakfasty and that was fun. The food was par for a typical Tex mex restaurant, which is to say it was good but not elevated. I'd recommend it but it is not a place I'd go out of my way to return to.

Had a wonderful anniversary dinner at this small quaint Italian restaurant. It's located next to the train station So The place is very small so make sure you get a reservation on the weekends. The food was amazing and BYOB helps too. Definitely will be back!
High quality Asian cuisine. Excellent bento boxes, superb sushi, great ramen and udon! Don't leave South Philly. A true gem.

Very awesome breakfast place!  I ended up here with my father-in-law on the strength of the good Yelp reviews.  We both had trouble deciding between the ham steak and the eggs benedict, so one of us got the ham, and one got the eggs benedict.  Excellent choices!

Portions aren't huge (which is actually rather nice).  It's just enough for a meal.

The service was also very good, very friendly.

Oh, my goodness this was the best experience! 
My husband started this tradition where we have dessert first. Because you can always take your food home for left overs and we don't have to try and save room for it.
We started with this meringue fruit ice cream thing that was wonderful! My husband does not like sweet things, but he really likes this.
Then we had 3 appetizers and my husband asked the server to pick them, because who would know better as to what would be the best. Shrimp and grits-loved, pork belly sandwiches- loved and a tomato and watermelon salad- loved!
For dinner I had a steak and veggie entree and my husband had the snapper. He loved his, I loved mine we tried each other's dishes and agreed the ones  we had picked where for us, where the right choice for us.I do have to say I hate raw tomatoes and I ate them not only with the appetizer, but with my dinner. They have everything brought in daily from local farms and farmers markets! The server was awesome, the busser was awesome,  he told us of places to visit in town that where off the beaten path. 
Just know if you visit you will pay top dollar, but it is well worth it. 
I wish we could have this place in the STL!

I give jimbos a strong 3 stars, Mac and cheese is ok but you can tell it's not that true southern cooked Mac n cheese. It taste artificial that's why I say a strong three stars. Their smoked sausage is pretty good, hush puppies are really good, pulled pork is good. BBQ sauce is also good. It's hard to fine a true authentic BBQ place in Tampa. I definitely keep going back to jimbos but they could improve on the Mac n cheese. I'm a huge Mac n cheese fan and it honestly tasted like that frozen meal by stouffers or something

Steaks were rare twice after being sent back. Manager wasn't friendly and condescending. Broccoli and cheese wasn't able to be cut because the cheese was hard. And to top it off the manager asked how we wanted our cheese? Like sir cheese should be smooth and runny over the green mounds of broccoli. Would not recommend for people.

OKAY...i see what you did. Tacos tasted PHENOMENAL. Ordered the Barbacoa, fried fish and pork tacos. All had unique tastes and super fresh. Ingredients were great as they accompanied and complimented the meats very well. All were garnished with just the right amount of veggies such as onions, cilantro, things of that nature. I went during a quiet time and tacos came out fairly quick. Guessing during lunch it's gotta be super packed because it's located on the roof of whole foods. To get up there, let's just say I had to ask around and when I got up there, I saw a good truck on top of the building. Peculiar...yes...cool...also yes. They have corn hole and plenty of seats as this seems to be a nice place to grab drinks from the beer store downstairs and for my alcoholic buddies...you can pop the bottle right upstairs.
Everything about this place was excellent. The atmosphere, the service & the food. Will definitely eat there again on our way through Reno.
Great experience. Clean. Professional. Very little waiting time and staff was excellent and caring, especially Wendy, she is the best!!

Sushi rolls all fell apart when touched.  Shrimp tempura roll was dripping with eel sauced which is not described on menu and manager wouldn't replace it (one of my staples and I've never had it served with sticky sauce anywhere else). Went in for happy hour and was not given a special menu so I ordered items I knew were on happy hour.  Was charged full price for everything, a great way to cheat people who are not in the know.  Ordered a house white but they didn't have it so they gave me something else and then charged me full price instead of happy hour price because it was not a "happy hour wine" BUT the same price as a happy hour selection on the menu.  Manager was completely rude and was yelling, so loud she created a scene and I was being stared at.  Plenty of other places to go - Don't waste your time here!

I am absolutely appalled by the behavior I experienced at this restaurant!!!!! The manager asked me to stand in the corner with my back facing him as he pelted me with spaghetti and meatballs! The waitress was the absolute goat and and tried to hold him off but it was too much and he overpowered her. We both left in an Uber crying and covered in red sauce. On top of that there was a rat under our table. So gross! Fortunately, the rat was friendly and we ended up saving him from this retched place and taking it home as a pet. The manager also was not wearing his mask properly. Will never be returning!!
Standard Subway shop.  It fits their corporate template well. Clean.  Food is consistent with other locations of the chain.  Employees had a pleasant attitude.

This is probably my favorite place in the world. Everything you could want under one roof. It's a foodies dream. You can get a delicious pork sandwich, walk around the corner and get the best Pennsylvania Dutch pretzel you will ever eat. I would live here if I could, like a rat

Sigh.

The food here is really good, when you can get it. The beer selection is solid, and the shakes and cocktails are great.

But the service is ATROCIOUS. I swear, whoever manages this place is illiterate and can't count past 4. There are 17 cooks on the line, 7 servers for a dining room of 4 tables, and one bartender for a bar with 25 people.

And dear GOD it's slow. And inconsistent. I've ordered two things tonight, and I've had to send each back twice. And I'm NOT PICKY. They just seem allergic to even the slightest possibility of getting anything right.

Stay away. The food, as good as it can potentially be, is NOT worth the soul-crushingly unpleasant experience of eating here.

This place was a straight up culinary experience! The food was AMAZING and you're really getting your pennies worth! Probably one of my favorite hole in the wall places that I found! High chance I'm going to become a regular!

The store looks creepy and super 80's from the outside, but on the inside it's clean and inviting! Last time I was in, their super friendly manager told me they're working on doing some updates and giving the property a much needed face lift! 
When shopping, the staff is always friendly and super helpful. They go above and beyond to answer any questions, and it's clear they know what they're talking about. If you've never been in before the awesome staff will even offer to give you a guided tour! Lol Suzie's is most definitely a judgement-free zone. I know most people may find it a little daunting to ask questions or tell a stranger what they're looking for in a toy, but the faster you just blurt it out the faster the staff can help you find what you're looking for! They've always made sure I go home with a quality toy that lasts me a while instead of cheap stuff I bought when I was younger that I hated after the first time I used it. I've always been satisfied with the toys the staff has recommended to me! My mind was blown that some of the toys even have a warranty! Talk about a smart investment! 
Whether there's a particular type of movie you enjoy, or you're looking to try out some of the stuff with your partner you read about in 50 Shades of Grey, if Suzie's doesn't have what you're looking for you'll be hard pressed to find another place in town that does.
In regards to the (ahem) Video Arcade...if it makes you uncomfortable don't look at it. I've been to the theater store on Virginia st and Suzie's arcade seems to be a lot cleaner (less smelly at least) than their arcade and way less creepy than the theater! I don't use those booths, but it's not my place to judge the people who do. Hey, maybe they can't have porn at home or something. If it's not your thing, you don't have to use it. 
All in all, I love shopping here!

My brother had us go here to get pants for his wedding. Ed told me the pants were ordered and I would receive a call when they arrived. I called to check in a week later and I spoke with the female manager saying they were just waiting on them to arrive and they would alter them for me to fit perfectly. After calling a few times with no answer I went to the location and asked when the pants would arrive and they told me they hadn't been ordered and Ed was no longer was with them. I may not have the matching pants for my brothers wedding in time because i relied on what they said. I would NOT recommend using this company to manage your wedding party needs

I went with a Groupon and I was super excited to try a new place out! Once we walked in, we were approached by a server and he was amazing! So nice and so welcoming. The service is 5 stars. 

The food was hit or miss. Nothing to rave about. My girlfriend got the oxtails and was disappointed because there was more fat than meat. My curry chicken was pretty good- spicy and plentiful. The fried corn and hot water cornbread were GREAT! The dirty tea was so yummy and different. It has Tang in it so it gives you a nice twist on regular ol sweet tea. The mac n cheese wasn't the best in town. We took our cake to go. I got strawberry (definitely a must have) and my gf got chocolate (not sure how she felt about it).

We didn't wait long at all but we were literally the only people in there. The decor is very basic but the placemats are newspaper articles from the 1940's and I thought that was pretty cool! 

Overall, I will go back and give it another chance.

Caesar & his girlfriend were awesome! Very welcoming, comfortable terrific environment! I sat with a couple of regular customers that raved about their experiences at this store. I have to say I was very impressed... The only thing that would have made it a 5 star experience would be more well known & popular cigar selections.

My husband had wanted to try Blackfish for a while, and I was a little reluctant after seeing the New Year's Eve tasting menu. I'm not a big foodie and don't always like to try new things. But for him, I said ok. And I'm glad I did. We did the pre-fixed, four course menu for $75. The waitress first came around with a choice of two types of bread -- sourdough and cheddar. I had the cheddar but I didn't really taste any cheddar or cheese at all. However, the bread was soft and appealing.  An amouse bouche starter was a shot of a sweet potato type creamy soup. delicious. I was a little worried when the first course arrived. Not seeing anything I was comfortable with from the choices, I was forced to go blindly with a parmesan "panna cotta" with beets and apples. When I got it, I thought I was in trouble. Not used to any of these tastes. I didn't really like it. My husband got the foie gras and he said it was ok. For the second course, I had a chestnut ravioli which was DIVINE. Heavenly. Three little light pouches of flavory goodness. The pasta delicate and delicious. The sauce was so flavorful I found myself wanting to lick the bowl. My husband's similar dish -- looked like ravioli but was some type of meat dumpling -- was equally delicious. Both the first and second course were somewhat small plates. The third course was larger and the best of the night. My husband had the duck breast, which he said was out of this world. I had the beef short ribs and they were melt in your mouth delicious. Everything you'd want in a short rib and more. I was so full but couldn't help but clean my plate. It came on top of a hash-brown like potatoes and delicious onions. Truly a pleasure. Dessert was also good. My husband had what he thought was a "chocolate mousse," which was more like two chocolate truffles (very good chocolate, however) next to some delicious candied walnuts. I had a rich and tasty creme brulee. Service was attentive and delightful. This is a BYOB, so we brought our own wine. There was no corking charge. Coffee was additional $3 to the prix fixe menu. Drawbacks to Blackfish -- not much. It's a bit on the pricey side. The waiting area is REALLY SMALL. People were up in each other's business and every time the door opened into the restaurant, it made it worse. The group ahead of us complained they had been waiting for a table for 25 minutes and had a reservation. They also complained that the heat wasn't on in the waiting area. My husband and I were seated within 15 minutes with a reservation, so we had no complaints. Seating was tight inside as well -- maybe because it was crowded for new year's eve. People had to occasionally get up from their seats to let people get by, including waiters and waitresses. All in all, I was very happy with my experience at Blackfish. You can tell that this chef is a pro. We never received our complimentary champagne that night, but I was so stuffed, I didn't really mind. We will be back to check out the regular menu soon.

Buckboard bacon melt was amazing! So were  the artichokes; and literally everything on the menu. the place has a very cool vibe with all its memorabilia  and is incredibly efficient for how busy they are.  I had a road trip and stopped here on my way out of the city and got three sandwiches. I would eat breakfast, lunch and dinner if it wouldn't end up giving me heart palpitations. But on the other hand it could be worth the health risk. I also bought a few of their in house meats; can't wait to try them! A definite must try.

it was .. a non horrible dim sum.  service was good, food was kind of weird at times.  seemed like everything had pork in it.  chicken satay tasted like fish.  sauteed bok choy was cold & super-oily.  atmosphere had something to be desired.  probably not going back.

Went to an awesome blues concert here & it was rockin' the house!  I think it's so cool that not only do we have a great concert venue in a convenient central location in World Cafe Live, but they have some amazing musicians playing here -- often for free!

I was also here for a StorySlam on the ground floor (upstairs) & it seemed confusing & disorganized with inadequate seating.  We still had a great time, but World Cafe Live should just figure out their seating issue there.

Truly special Mexican food. The menu is extensive - I had a special vegetarian plate with eggplant enchiladas, calabacitas tostada, and Tarascan spinach Tacos. My husband had their famous carne seca, which they make by hand and dry on the roof of the building. The family who owns the restaurant started 35 years ago and is still run by the family today. Excellent service, clean and cozy atmosphere, overall LOVED this place. I live in Tucson, and if someone were to ask me where to go for good, authentic Mexican food, this is the spot.

Nice little burger joint. Very good service. I ordered the pastrami burger and a water. The drink glasses are huge. The burger tasted great, and the pastrami had great flavor. Generous toppings as well. The only downside was that there were only 2 thin slices of pastrami. It could have used a little more, even if they wanted to raise the price by $.50. The place is nice and clean, with high and low tables plus some booths. They have a 1lb cheeseburger special on Mondays that comes with large fries and a drink for $13. I'll be back with the wife to split that meal.
Nice bartenders, strong drinks, good music. It's not fancy like the other places in Santa Barbara, and I think that's a good thing. Has a smoking patio, and a stage for live music.

Mediocre. Do not get a skillet unless you want potatoes that taste like they came from the bottom of the dishwasher. The chicken fried steak was great. Eggs were under cooked. 
Second visit I got chicken fried steak breakfast. Hash browns were good and eggs were better.

I think the best part of this place is the a ambience. Came here on a Friday night, didn't have to wait too long, service made its rounds well, no boisterous groups. The food was pretty good, although the vegetarian flat bread was a bit too salty for me.

The grilled salmon salad was delicious though! I'd ask for less salad dressing - while the pomegranate vinaigrette was nicely sweet and thick, it seemed to have been poured with a heavy hand. The orange slices were juicy and complemented the mix well!

Tofu Stir Fry - spicy kick. The portion is a bit on the smaller side!

I picked up my sister's wedding cake from Nadine's last month, and was surprised both with the price and the elegance.  I'm a guy and am not the expert on wedding cakes... but I was certainly impressed! Great job!

Always a great place to stop to relax after a meal.  Unappreciated beer selection, La Maudite was amazing.  We were ambitious (a little to much) and each got a dessert.  Her brownie sundae was amazing as always!  Every time we've been here it's the same and we LOVE IT.  The Bailey's ice cream is the best.  The only negative thing was the chocolate bread pudding was dry.  We've never had it, sounded amazing and pictured it with some h
As good as it gets. Moshit is extremely talented and her pastries are as good as anything you can get in any major city. Excellent presentation all around. Perfect for a hostess gift.

They're not quite on the radar yet - not listing in Google BUT ... it should be on YOUR radar.  The food is excellent, with large portions and polite service.  We've already been there twice in the last week.  The only thing missing is Turkish Coffee.  It's a family run place and they don't want to add that to the menu until they will be satisfied with the results so they are trying to source just the right thing first. 

So far we've had the Salad with Feta cheese (served with loads of fresh baked bread), various kebabs (beef and chicken), the "turkish pizza" and something else that was sort of like a Turkish folded pizza, as well as the rice pudding.  EVERYTHING was really good.  

The place is BYOB and merits a visit straight-away before everyone else knows about it.  Bring an appetite!!!
Very poor customer service. Initial interaction with female receptionist immediately turned me off from pursuing further business with this company. Learn some manners.

First time here and I was pleasantly surprised. Went in for lunch but had a breakfast item and it was GOOD! A good portion without being overwhelmed. The Watermelon Wake Up drink was a nice detour from an ice tea or lemonade. My party tried the egg Benedict, I did a Farmhouse Skillet Hash, another did the Biscuit with the turkey sausage gravy and last but not least the chicken salad melt. All was excellent. Seriously we will be back. Service was very friendly and clean. Nicely done.

Lunch - ordered Chicken Parmigiana. Wasn't super impressed with it - the breaded chicken breast seemed like it was a frozen patty thrown in a deep fryer.  Same old salad and bread sticks although I'm really happy we ordered the salad dressing on the side because it was so salty.

The interior of this OG location is nice - sat in a nice tucked away area which didn't have the open air feel of most OG's. 

Server was good.

The  best thing in the house is the gyro pizza. Handmade crust,  bechemel  sauce and gyro meat. We love it!  This a an  order and pick up place, but the owner does everything fresh and by hand.  It is worth the price and the drive over. I don't know what the other person is talking about. My daughter took a picture of her pizza with 1 bite out of it and put it on Tumbler with the caption "the best thing I ever ate"
Nice size omelet. But there were no flavor in it. And found a log strand of hair. Not sure if i should come back.
I have not been disappointed, yet!  Nice outdoor seating over the Truckee River adds a wonderful touch to the dinning experience.

What the heck happened?

While they've never been authentic Mexican, they've never pretended to be.  What Santa Fe had going for it was options - flavors and fillings.  You want a cheeseburger burrito?  Check.  A tofu burrito? Check.  Chicken mole? Check check.  The last couple of times I've gone, though, the burritos have been fairly bland and didn't really taste all that different, in spite of the fact that they had different fillings *and* different sauces.  Everything now tastes fairly bland -- almost watered down, as if they're trying to make their sauces go further.

It used to be more like its Wynnewood cousin, but now it's just lost some of its pizzaz.  I want to support the "little guy" but if it's not as good as its larger peers?

I had a major washer overflow in my laundry and kitchen. Servpro came promptly, submitted their estimates to my insurance company, pulled out damaged material and executed water mitigation. I especially want to thank Josh, Trent, Brandon and Darren. They were always there at the appointed time. They explained thoroughly what they were doing and why. They noticed other issues that I needed to have cared for. They were courteous and friendly. Exactly what you want in any professional entering your home.

The food is really good but the service on a Friday night is awful. We were a party of 4 and 2 meals came out and the other 2 didn't come until after the 1st 2 people finished. Server didn't really care about it either. Don't think they can keep up with take out orders plus dine in. Would go again bc food is good but during the week vs weekend.

Amazing prices and deals.  Very large selection too.  But the best part was the staff.  You don't expect this at a thrift store, but it really felt like everyone there understand and portrayed their purpose.

Find that many items are broken, chipped, or they don't have a good stock of items.  It also bothered me that I called them to see if they offer shopping cart pick-ups when people leave them in neighborhoods (shame on you, cart thieves!) and the young woman laughed at me when I asked...she didn't even try to appease me with asking where it is or telling me she'd tell her supervisor.  It showed me that their employees don't really care about their community reputation.
I was surprised to see that they served a Paleo Bowl here! It was huge and delicious!  Would definitely come back if I am ever in Tucson again

After begging my husband to go here for our first time in NOLA he has made us go back two more times on our 6 day trip. The first day we had the Dulce Cuban corquenut & a chocolate strawberry donut. Amazing! The next time we had a pork belly & the fried chicken slider. We got the fried chicken slider with a waffle fry but I would recommend just doing the regular bun. The pork belly slider was definitely our favorite. The 3rd time we went we got a couple varieties of donuts & they did not disappoint. Love this place & staff is great.

Well let me first start off with saying I wish I had gone to Yelp and read the reviews on this location before ordering. It started off with a long wait on the phone around 10:00 and when the guy answered he seemed extremely rushed. I ordered a Medium Pan Pizza that was cheese and pepperoni with extra cheese and a family order of breadsticks (Two bread stick orders). It came to 29$ and didn't end up questioning that until later. When the order came to the door the guy seemed nice and slightly high. Everything went smoothly and he got a 3$ tip. When I opened my pizza it was thin, burnt and had no extra cheese on it. Not to mention one of sauses was opened and had spilt on the breadsticks. I looked at my receipt, and noticed I was charged 4.29 for each breadstick (Originally listed for 2.99 each) and I was charged for pepperoni (1.15$). I called the location and waited 20 minutes on hold.. When the guy finally answered I was put on hold again because he was supposedly getting the manager. Only 5 mins later the same guy gets back on the phone... He said he could credit me or send out another pizza but told me it would take an hour to arive. (It's 5 mins away the location) it's 11:30 and my daughter and I are extremely disappointed and starving. Should of just went to another pizza place.

I am never in North Reno but had to come here for an errand and I am so glad I didn't eat before I came up here.  The closest place to eat besides McDonalds was this spot. I love Mexican restaurants located in the backs of Mexican markets (they are always good).  I got 3 carnitas tacos. Food came out really fast.  Three small street tacos and a bowl of orange-colored salsa.  I have not had a street-style taco this good since visiting Sayulita five years ago.  I went to compliment the chef and she directed me to the "best street tacos, Reno" trophies. Well deserved!

I would deduct a star for dirty tables and being overcharged at the register, but the food was so good that I can't bring myself to do that.  Try this place!!

Nothing earth-shattering. So far, everything I've had passes the quality test. Good, solid pizza, wings, and stromboli. I wouldn't put them on a 5-star level, but what I like about this place is it delivers, they have takeout beer, diverse menu, and decent prices. I'd really like to check out the gyro next time.

I took a medium-size cup of chocolate ice cream. The amount seemed huge. It was served in a paper takeout container, which is a bit unusual. Despite the large amount, I managed to finish it all in a nearby park. The ice cream was perfect. Just what I needed after biking for an hour.

Horrible dining experience!  First time customers.  Ordered spaghetti and meatballs and mushroom risotto.  Spaghetti noodles undercooked.  Brought to waitresses attention.  She took back to chef.  Chef insisted that noodles were cooked.  Are spaghetti noodles supposed to be chewy?  Waitress apologized to the chef for him having to cook another plate of spaghetti.  Provided another plate of spaghetti with undercooked noodles. Spaghetti sauce was terrible.  Chef Boyardee makes better spaghetti sauce.  Risotto dish was warm and bland.  Asked for salt/pepper from the waitress.  Had to ask for salt from bar before waitress remembered to bring a set to the table.  We will not be back.

My first time. My absolute last time. 

I was appalled by the driver's attitude and demeanor from Lafayette to Chicago on Fri 12/19/21. Her initial greeting was shouting at passengers, telling them that they had too many bags and need to "figure it out." She was aggressively abrasive and downright rude. This was a very poor first impression of Greyhound.

I understand that all of us dealing with the front lines are tired, especially during the pandemic, but I've never seen such a poor attitude firsthand. Other passengers around me were commenting on her attitude and professionalism. 

I thought it made sense to explore Greyhound for a short trip to Chicago but I can't suggest another option more. The station (Chicago) was in poor condition and didn't even have hand soap dispensers, whether during a pandemic or in general, is disgusting.

The driver on the return trip was also impressively rude, but better in comparison. I'd expect to be treated better on a prison bus than a fare-paying Greyhound passenger.

If degrading passengers, and shaming them on the intercom system is part of your routine conduct, get a new job - away from the public.

Do not consider them for travel.
Great app-Calamari, but no Tenticals.  The meal is bangin you though.  Menu selection is excellent!  You may think it's s little pricey, but it's worth it

Outstanding place to watch a baseball game. This was my second time visiting this ball park. Had really good seats for both games. 

The staff we encountered were very nice.

Can not wait to do it again next spring!
This location is like all other locations. Nothing really new and special about it. Friendly staff and fast service! Keep up the good work!

My apologies; It is only now that Yelp allowed me to update this review; hence, the delay in the equation, however, it should be said that I had requested Olga to provide the number for the main office so that I may contact her supervisor by the name of Clarissa as it pertained to Olga's vast misconduct.  As the receipt included illustrates, Olga intentionally left out a digit to prevent me from contacting her supervisor; although, I was made aware by Clarissa that Olga contacted Clarissa in the midst of her having dinner; obviously to cover her tracks. Was there 8/13/2012.  Very nice upscale establishment.  Great place to take a first date or 10th anniversary dinner.  Not at all good for kids - but that's the point.  This is an adult, quiet (when we were there at 8pm), elegant, small, intimate, bistro.  At first I was confused at the level (casual? formal?) while I sat down in view of the open kitchen area. I have been coming to Hair Jazz for the past few years that I've lived in the area. I have gotten haircuts and eyebrow waxes here several times. The facility is clean and the supplies they use are really good. The coconut shampoo they use smells so good! 

Most importantly the staff is very friendly and talented! Joe and Brianna are the only two who have ever cut my hair and they both do a great job! Joe is the owner and he is multi-talented because he also owns the bike shop next door - Barr's Bikes and Boards. It's always nice to have a bike-related conversation with him!
Tried the best buffet.  Was not very good.  Place seemed kind of run down.  Will not be back.

Attended Howl o Scream. There was a lack of staff and the directions on how to get to the attractions were very confusing. To top it off when we left at 1AM we had to wait in the parking lot for over an hour. We were at a stand still; it was a parking lot. I will give them credit. The haunted houses were very good as were the actors. To me the negatives outweighed the positives so I can't see myself coming back anytime soon.

Overpriced and the waitstaff was inattentive. Portions were small and the crab melt was skimpy on the crab; it mostly tasted of the remoulade (which was tasty, but I didn't order a remoulade sandwich.) If you order anything stick with the shrimp and grits.

the me too movement is alive and well at this location in addition to these females not wanting to work. the checkout line served round the coat rack in mens so i went to jewelry i heard the cashier say she couldn't check out the guy before as she was helping a customer look at jewelry. he left i asked her to call over help and she did another female came over mexican and read me the same line the first one told the guy in front of me then she walked away, i immediately asked for the manager tess, zero help i didnt bother to tell her what just happened i called corporate they put me in contact with alice the store manager who tries 2 buy me off with a $25 gift card lol my sack off again this is why i type me too is alive and well at this location.

Anton's has now replaced three major appliances in our home and we couldn't be happier with the products, services and team members.  Most recently we had a seasonal check on our new furnace and Dan pointed out that our water heater was over 25 years old. We decided to replace our 25 year old water heater and the process was so easy. I didn't have to make one phone call, Dan and the staff made all the arrangements for us and within three days Dan was back to install our brand new water heater. Dan was very polite and super friendly to our dog, who is super needy, answered any and all questions we had, and worked so quickly. Our new water heater has been a game changer. Not only do we have excellent hot water, as we upgraded to a bigger option, but our water pressure has improved drastically. We have been so satisfied with the customer service of Anton's and will continue to turn to them for our in home needs.

I'm a fan more of donut places that offer different types of donuts more than places that have a signature type of donut in which they dress up. If they offered different types of donuts rather than different ways to decorate it, I think they can turn a few heads. I like the idea of the decorating the donut concept, but I don't know how I feel about it as a business practice. The location is notorious for opening new places and closing them as its been a Crown Fried Chicken, a Deli, and a short-lived Caribbean restaurant. I'm a fan of the airier donuts such as the glazed because it's not so heavy. The option for both is a must!  Overall decent place with no pressing desire to return, however optimistic for progress.

I've always ate here and like it. I'm going give you how it's now with the whole COVID-19 protocol. Staff wears face masks. After they take your payment, they said there's a table where you can wear plastic gloves to server yourself. So customers can still grab whatever they want themselves. I have seen customers that didn't put on gloves to grab stuff and nobody said anything. I don't see staff wear those gloves either. I don't see any hand sanitizers anywhere. Also they should give the customers to-go utensils. They still have the metal utensils I don't want to use that. They did have the tables separated by labeling one table reserved for social distancing. Food and drinks are the same. They could do better with the whole COVID-19 protocol though. Eat at your own risk.

Went here for an early dinner while visiting Nashville. My mom and I shared the wedge salad and substituted honey mustard dressing rather than blue cheese because neither of us are huge blue cheese fans. Comes with fried green tomatoes, huge chunks of flavorful bacon and some other toppings. It was a great starter to our meal and we both enjoyed it. For a main entree we split the ribs and subbed out the coleslaw for Mac and cheese at the recommendation of our server. The ribs had a good dry rub on them and were light on sauce, so this can be good or bad depending on one's preferences. It also came with sweet potato fries were were very good. The Mac and cheese was made with a penne and what I think was white cheddar cheese. Very delicious! Also, a basket of warm biscuits was brought out after our salad which tasted of cheddar and broccoli, very good as well. I had a glass of Pinot Grigio which was very smooth and the best Pinot Grigio I was served while in Nashville. Would definitely return to the Southern!
Also, we had the sweetest waitress who took the time to give us additional recommendations of what to do during our visit. She recommended Robert's on Broadway for after dinner entertainment which ended up being the most fun we had while in Nashville, watching the Don Kelley Band!

Don't judge a book by it's cover. 

Came here looking for a quick meal while in the area, and the Yelp reviews came in high, and they were open for dinner. As we drove up, I'm now having second thoughts, it's old, definitely needs a face lift. I knew we should have went to Yardley, PA., BUT, we are here now, and I'm all for divey establishments. 
Only one half of the diner was in swing, but it was full of patrons. The dining area was definitely older, but clean, so no complaints there. Seated immediately, our waitress was very nice, and knowledgeable of the menu. 
Food came out quickly, we ordered four different items. Each made very well. Stand out dish was the crab cake, I expected a frozen pre-made Sysco crab cake, I was really impressed with what I got. A fresh cake loaded with crab, and a small amount of filler. Freshly made, and perfectly fried on the flattop. It's a good size too, much bigger and thicker than a burger. I didn't take a picture, shame on me! I also had a Greek salad, fresh with lots of feta, and a different twist on the anchovy, they incorporated it (it was all ground up) into the dressing. 
Everyone else enjoyed their food, as it was fresh cooked (as a diner should be), the gravy was meh, but that wasn't a deal breaker. Good service and good people!

The food is decent and the shakes are great, low rating due to poor customer service. Workers are often rude, unhelpful, and self involved. The bare minimum of being friendly and greeting the customer isn't even met most of the time.

This is one of the coolest cozy spots in broadripple. It's a garage turned into a cool resturant. Here's a few reasons why I like this place. There's plenty of seating, you can bring your pouch with you and sit out side and have lunch, they raise the garage door open on really nice days, they grow alot of the veggies that they use and the decor is just darn relaxing! I love the chandeliers so classy! The employees make you feel like you've been friends for ever! You have to check this place out. The only small (and I do mean small) drawback is that it's a little hard to find but there's nothing wrong with hidden gems! It's kinda hidden behind other shops but it's worth looking for. And lastly  it's just a hair off the monon. So you can eat then take a walk.. or walk then have lunch. Hope you take time to check out this cool place. They also have Saturday and Sunday brunch. There a different menu on the weekends.

Best "nice" mexican food around. When it comes to Mexican food I am picky and I can honestly say that this is genuine mexican food that cant be beat. Some of my favorites are the mole poblano, adobada tacos, salmon, fish tacos and the los agaves burrito. Salsas are all spectacular. Prices just keep going up so that is the only negative thing I have to say about this place and its a little pricey, but for the quality I guess its worth it!  I always take friends and family that are visiting from out of town here and to this original and first location that "started it all. "

We've been taking our family cars here, an SUV and a Minivan for several years now. So many car dealerships and service centers try to nickel-and-dime their customers with unnecessary procedures and overpriced services. Other places offer amenities like Free Wi-Fi and coffee but with a large markup on their services.

I'm glad to say you won't find anything like that here! We've been seeing John for our needs several years now and he has always been fair and to-the-point when it comes to our car repairs. Spending money on car repairs isn't pleasant, but how fair they are here is very refreshing.

I like how they take the time to explain their findings, and the subsequent actions done to mediate the problem. They've even showed me the worn out parts they'ved replaced! Come here if you're looking for a sincere and honest mechanic to do get your car up and running again.

I needed a last minute poster for a bridal shower and when kinkos failed the job miserably walgreens got it done quick and right. The work was top notch and i was able to order it through my phone and it was done within an hour!!! The young lady at the counter even cut it to fit my frame free of charge and the total was only 17 bucks far cheaper than the 45 bucks half price sale kinkos was charging. Walgreens made my day!!!!

Yummy! This place has one of the best southern dishes I have had. If you are in #neworleans it is a must try kind of place! Pretty fast meal after you order it at the front it takes barely 5-10 minutes or less to get your food after being seated. The service there is great! They really take care of the customers. Our areas server saw I was sharing a root beer and got me a new one for myself! He was so sweet. The food here is also delicious and worth the wait! I was lucky enough to go during lunch time on a Wednesday and the line was just long but stayed in the inside. Unlike other photos I've seen it would have been out the door for a long way. The line moves pretty fast though. I would highly recommend this place as a tourist!
In Reno for a convention, and had lunch here. Excellent salads and sandwiches. The service was a bit slow to get our food. Staff was otherwise pleasant.

We have ordered from here many times and usually it's a good experience.

We have an autistic son who loves the kids grilled cheese. The last time we ordered they started cutting the crust off on his grilled cheese. He wouldn't eat it, i know to most this seems ridiculous but our son just doesn't deal with change well. No big deal next time we know to ask them not to cut the crust off.

So we ordeeed again today, and I specifically left a note on his order to please leave the crust on the sandwich. Delivery driver comes, and his grilled cheese has had the crust removed.

When I called to let the restaurant know, the girl answering the phones couldn't care less with my issue, and no offer to make things right. I would of gladly picked it up myself had they offered to remake it. 

We will not be returning to Steve's grilled cheese, which has been a take out staple for us since they opened this location.

Not the cleanest... just saw they have 35 violations:
-Rodent activity present
-fresh rodent droppings found in grill area, prep area & hand washing station.
Eww!

Just finally tried this neighborhood taco shop.  It was great!!  
Bean burrito was expertly wrapped and the beans were delicious and cheesy!!!
Tacos de cabeza, pescado, adobado and the Toritos were all great.  
Tortillas and beans are on point!  We will be back for sure. 
Try them, they are awesome.

3.5/5 - not a bad ciccio concept but needs a bit of tweaking! If you are looking for traditional Cuban food, this place is probably not what you want.

Since their opening, the food has improved a lot! It is fairly priced, lots of great healthy (and gluttonous) options and great coffee (oatmilk option!) They have a lot of happy hour specials and ladies night on Thursdays! Honorable mentions: Lima platos with the chicken, loaded nachos, chicaronnes and Cuban! 

Overall not bad, lots of great options and drink specials!

Very friendly neighborhood bike shop. Did a great job of repairing my son's mtb, and they're always helpful with advice.

Found this place because it was close to friends house. Diamond in the rough. Started with Shepard's Salad with feta, which was fantastic. The small was a meal in itself. Then ordered the mixed grill. Enough for a family and all perfectly prepared. I highly recommend this place. Fantastic, well prepared food, great service, and fanatic value for very large servings.

Perhaps it's my fault for going here at 1 o'clock in the afternoon but I just finished camping and was Jones in for a donut and a coffee the donut was horrible and we tried four different kinds so it wasn't just me the donuts were dry and stale as if they were from yesterday I really feel like we wasted our money. If I knew spudnuts was just down the street which I just passed as I'm writing this review I would've gladly stopped.

I had heard about this restaurant but never ate there until I had an invite from two friends to try the place. This is not a place to eat all the time. If you love meat you will think you have died and gone to heaven. I thought the meal was a little pricey but I got my money's worth. The environment was comfortable and the staff were very professional and provided top notch service. For very nice evening out, but make sure you don't have much for lunch in order to have room for supper.
Great spot for a nice dessert.  Service was pretty quick considering they were packed.  Great flavors of shakes!

I bought a recliner on July 17th. We were told it would be six to eight weeks before delivery. That was acceptable. At eight weeks after no updates I called and was told it would not be delivered until November. That would be two more months away. That was not acceptable. I requested my money back and was told it could only be done through their manager who was not there and only on Tuesdays. So I waited until Tuesday and requested my money back. I was told the manager wasn't working that day. After much conversation over the next two days I've been told it will be 7 to 10 days. So i don't feel this stir is reputable.
Best Taco Bell I have ever went to. I've ate a lot of tacobell in my life this one stands out lived by it for a year now and they always make food good and move pretty quick
Yet another place that gets higher points than it should. Pricey, not very flavorful, and just allaround horrible. Go somewhere else. Giving 2 stars is a stretch

This place is amazing! The food is phenomenal...seriously. Everyone I've gone here with has raved about their dinner and I have always been thrilled with my choice. The ambience is great- the deck overlooking the park is gorgeous, but inside is cozy and cute too. As good or better than anywhere I've been in the city, and at reasonable prices.

Someone told me to visit King State so my expectations were set high before walking in. They were definitely met if not exceeded! I had a cortado and really enjoyed the espresso. The drink that is pictured is called the Cig- yummy If you like la croix and espresso, but maybe not for everyone! The environment/atmosphere was great with indoor, outdoor and bar seating. I'm excited to go back and try some food! Definitely recommend stopping by if your in the area and want some great coffee and food options.

I love this place! The chef and staff are so wonderful helping people like me who have to eat a certain diet. I love the mint/lemon water! I ate there almost daily for a month and loved everything. My favorite was the kale and broccoli soup.
Craig runs a tight ship - service is great, very clean, and great price.  A welcome addition to Delaware County and highly recommended.

Great gym, but don't ever try canceling your membership. We were told at the start of our membership it would automatically cancel at the end of our 1 year contract and that we'd not get billed anything else. No need to fill out paperwork or anything, just automatically cancelled, we asked repeatedly if that was true and were told yes it was. Imagine our surprise when we discovered that they've been periodically billing my husband's card a month-to-month fee for the past 6 months! Now we're stationed outside of Idaho for my husband's military service and Axiom is giving us a hard time and saying we have to cancel the month-to-month memberships in person at the primary location we used! We're stuck in an email battle with them after multiple phone calls have ended with them saying they can't do anything unless we're there in person. 

Lesson learned; we will never use their services again and actively encourage our friends to stay far away from them.

Of the sandwich places in Philly I visited this was the best place for sure.  We arrived around 11 AM on Sunday morning and there was no line, We just sat down on the stool and 7 minutes later the roast beef with sweet peppers sandwich was in front of me. . I added some additional banana peppers and horseradish and it was excellent. I really like how the additional "gravy" was put on and the bottom of the bun is soaking in it. 

Staff was friendly and service was prompt. Glad I came here and a must stop for anyone who enjoys a good, hearty sandwich.

Great neighborhood place for Sunday brunch. The food and service are always top-notch. The interior is really cool and when the weather is nice they have outdoor seating. If you're a fan of Bloody Marys be sure to try the Ghost of Mary, it delicious!
Love booster juice!! Relatively healthy fast food is hard to find these days. Booster Juice tends to be a good choice if I'm on the go.

My lovely husband surprised me with dinner reservations here on 10/30/2021. Overall, we both enjoyed our meals and had a great experience. 

Upon walking in we were seated at the second lev right by the bustling open kitchen. While I appreciate an establishment that is transparent with it's kitchen I didn't enjoy being so close. Plus the seating was awkward. My husband and I were side by side instead of across from each other. Not very romantic at all, so we requested to be moved, which was done so promptly. 

I ordered the Gibbon Burger (SRF & Double Ranch blend, melting onion, Beecher's flagship cheddar, Gibbon sauce, medium, $17.00). I'm a fan of Beecher's and an even bigger fan of burgers so this caught my attention right away. My husband ordered the 1/2 Roasted Chicken (king trumpet mushroom, pommes purée, Spanish sherry vinegar, $25.00) which a side of the richest mashed potatoes you'll ever have. More on those in a minute. 

My burger was nothing short of excellent! It was cooked to the perfect doneness as asked and paired wonderfully with the well-seasoned, crispy fries. One of the best burgers I've had in a long time. My husband's chicken was exactly as describe - a whole half (?) of juicy chicken on top of the best mashed potatoes I'd ever put in my mouth. From what I remember, they were half butter and half potatoes. Super fluffy yet filling and tasted so so soooo good. 

Besides the seating issue in the beginning which was fixed right away, I enjoyed the rest of my time at the Lively so I can't give anything below 5 stars. Definitely recommend!!!

Simply perfect! This was our first time at Oyster House. Loving oysters we normally have to go far to get really good ones well no more! What is truly wonderful about this place is you can get the oysters singly so we ordered 2 of each to see what we liked then ordered a dozen total of our favorites! There was a variety of 9 kinds.  the place is loud because it's packed. We went at 7:30 just after happy hour where at the marble raw bar the oysters are only $1 no limits on amount or variety! By 8:30 it began to slow down. Order the clam bake for dinner . OMG they know how to cook clams and muscles properly so they are nice and tender. Our server, Brian, was very very good. Friendly, very attentive, listened to everything we said. We are currently on the Whole 30 program so our diet is limited, he actually took the time to ask about the program so when we ordered he double checked to make sure that they didn't put cocktail sauce on the oyster platter and that there were no ingredients in the clam bake that we couldn't eat.  We will be frequenting this place often. And Brian works Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday nights and lunch a few days a week I believe. Ask for him! You will like your experience there even more!

we ordered 2 personal pizza cause we was told the oven for by the slice wasn't working yet. we also ordered some wings payed with a atm card. we no cash on us. so when the food came we asked for some ranch to go with the wings we were told that it is 57 cents it does not come with the wings this is ridiculous ranch always comes with wings and we had no cash so no ranch we will not be back. oh yeah we also ordered 2 beers. the manager brought them 2 are table unopened and no bottle opener. just think no one there is trained especially the manager has no customer service.
The quality and quantity of my turkey sandwich is not worth it. The chips and cookies were good though.

South Street, PA

old review..
They kindly made me my imitation pho soup! LOL. The place next door closed down... So I asked them for beef, any green veggie, ginger and onions. It was pretty good! Any pho substitute is great when ur not feeling so great.

Came on a Sunday for lunch and ordered a small pepperoni and cheese deep dish, garlic bread app, lasagna entree, and kids meal chicken fingers. 

The waiter was super pleasant. Very friendly and attentive. Welcomed us as it was our first time there. Explained the menu to us and he told us how long it would take to cook a deep dish pizza-about 45 minutes. 

The pizza was really good. Very rich pizza, tons of cheese. Only complaint is that the cheese outdid the pepperoni. Pepperoni got lost completely, wish they did a larger layer on the bottom instead of one pepperoni to about a half inch of cheese. But I think that's the style of pizza. Still good though. 

Didn't try the other entrees but the cheese garlic bread was good. My boyfriend liked the lasagna too.
GREAT PLACE !!!! Tons of different thinks to shop for..

My husband and I have stayed at some of the finest hotels in the world. The Roosevelt New Orleans, a Waldorf Astoria Hotel, and its parent company, Hilton Hotels & Resorts, provided the worst customer service experience we've ever had.

After a hurricane on October 28th in New Orleans knocked out our power, my husband and I decided to treat ourselves to a stay at the Roosevelt. Mid-morning on the 29th, called the hotel website number and was transferred to the Hilton reservations call center. I said that we had three small dogs and the rep said that this was ok but mentioned a $170 charge, which I was fine with. I asked if I'd be able to check-in early and they said as early as 1pm. I asked if they had room service during Covid. They said no so I said I would check with my husband to see if that was amenable to him and call back.

I called back and spoke to another Hilton rep, deciding to book the King Astoria suite with separate living room, the second-most expensive room in the building. Again, I mentioned the three small dogs and was told, again, that this would be ok with a fee of $170. I asked if I'd be able to check-in at 1pm and the rep said they'd check and put me on hold. After a few minutes on hold, I was transferred to a phone ringing for several minutes and hung up.

I called back and repeated everything to the third rep, including the three small dogs, and were told they were fine with a fee of $170. After checking with the hotel, the rep said that I was able to check-in immediately. I asked about parking for my husband, who was coming later with the three small dogs and the rep said that I could pay a per-night parking fee per night upon check-in.

Such calls are recorded "for quality assurance," so if either the hotel or Hilton replies that these things were not said, they are not only lying but then they are guilty of defamation, which can be proven by a subpoena of said calls. 

I got a car over to the Roosevelt. When I got to the check-in desk, I mentioned that my husband would be coming later in the jeep with the three small dogs and that I needed parking. The woman at the front desk replied that there was a two-dog limit per room. I said that this was unacceptable as I had spoken to three phone reps that said three dogs were ok. She asked if I had booked third party and I told her I had booked via the phone number on the hotel website. She said that they don't book at the hotel and I replied that the number brought me to Hilton reservations. I insisted she get a manager because I was told by three different employees of the corporation she works for that this would be ok. She said her manager was on lunch break but would go ask. The manager refused to come out and sent the front desk clerk back with the message that no exceptions could be made.

I then let a few choice words fly. It wasn't my finest hour but what if we had driven from another state only to find out that the number of dogs we were told were ok were suddenly not? Thank heavens we were only driving from just over a mile away!

I went home and spent an hour with a customer care rep who wasn't very helpful at first, which only made me more irate. My husband told her from the background that he'd heard me on the call with the third rep and that I had mentioned three small dogs. The rep became helpful and called the hotel to say that I was told three dogs were ok. The rep told me that the hotel would not budge on their policy and had told her that they were not an evacuee hotel.

Evacuee hotel? Seriously? We were renting the second most expensive suite they had! If you're going to get nitpicky about two dogs per room, our room would be nearly three times the size of the smallest room they allow two dogs in, and they should have made an exception just due to their corporate mistake.

The customer care rep created case 76007240 to go to the general manager of the hotel and to that person's higher-up. She offered us another Hilton property, but it is comical to think that I would ever stay in their hotels again.

Today, I got a response by email and was told that I should call the hotel directly, as though I was going to get anywhere after their continued refusals!

We own several businesses in New Orleans and in Salem, Massachusetts. We've appeared on numerous television shows, including on the Travel Channel. I was on the board of directors of the Office of Tourism in Salem. We run two tourism-related retail shops in each city, host festivals in both cities, host year-round classes in both cities. We plan to make note on our festival and e-commerce websites naming each and every Hilton owned or licensed property as not to be trusted for good customer service. I can see why so many people love this place. First when you enter the lady at the counter gives you such a happy and warm welcome.  The food is so fresh and delicious.  They have smaller booths for parties of two and a few high top chairs in the front. Must be ok with Christian music.  I'm not Christian yet I'm ok with the music. Love this place and would love to come again when in the area.

I can't give anything but 5 stars to this place.  Given that they now have a location close to my house and 5 minutes from my office I think I could give them 10 stars if it were allowed.  My wife calls this the "toy store for men".  And guys, there really isn't one thing in this store that requires a hairbrush, mirror or makeup! They have about everything you need, tools, tarps, power tools, concrete mixers, about 20 different types of work gloves, tool boxes... really I could spend an entire rainy day in here.  Finally a store that gives your wife the same feeling you get when she says "I'm going shopping"....

You guys! This place is kinda cool! I'm a sucker for a good ethnic market and this is certainly one. Not only does it have "regular" market food, it also has:

-A fantastic variety of Russian, Uzbek, Bulgarian and other Eastern European gems. 

-The largest smoked salmon department I've ever seen.  

-The largest variety of apples. I've never seen so many different kinds. Not even at an orchard! Some I've never even heard of! 

-Rare'r' fruits like pomegranates, kumquats, persimmon and HUGE tubs of pomegranates seeds! At a steal too! 

-Caviar selection to make "The Rich & Famous" jealous 

-self serve, pay by lb. frozen pirogies and dumplings of all kinds. 

-Over a half a dozen soups from Borscht to cabbage to the kind that grandma used to make.  

-salad bar with all sorts of amazing, unique cold healthy salads. 

-hot to go bar for a quick din in a pinch! (If you enjoy the Uzbek restaurants this area is known for, you'll notice some of your favorite dishes in the to go section here! Fried potatoes with mushrooms is my fav!) 

-any kind of fish you could imagine. 

-fresh baked breads of all kinds!! 

-drool worthy pastries. 

-thick, cut to order bacon for you bacon lovers out there. 

-a very impressive honey and tea section! 

Fellow veg-heads, steer clear of the meat department!! Beside the normal bloody meats, I happen to unfortunately see skinned rabbits, turkey necks, veal tongue and cow feet. Ugh. Almost vomited. 

Prices were very fair! 
Tuesday's are 10% off for seniors. 

Slight language barrier, but not a big deal. 

If you're local and are used to Bell's Market and some of the Uzbek/Russian restaurants up this way, you'll be very pleased here. 

I will definitely be shopping here again when I'm in the area. Kiddos ate their .89 round seeded loaf in 2 seconds flat. Hubs enjoyed his almond cake too. The salads I sampled were delish!

If you want to taste some of the best donuts in you life, come here. 
Can't go wrong with a chocolate long john, or if you're lucky a warm apple fritter. 
Donuts are always fresh unlike others nearby that seem like they've been there since the worlds fair. If you know what I mean. Most of the time you will find the worker going back to get them fresh off the rack. 
Although most of the time she is in a bad mood. So, just order like you would order from the "soup natzi". Don't let her put you in a bad mood though,because you are about to have a life changing experience. 
I'm a purist, so when I want a donut I want donut. These donuts are classic. So delicious you'll thank me, and them. 
Ps: best coffee coffee in town. It says so right on the box. Lol. What a riot! Enjoy!

Went here for the first time and had the sweet & sour chicken with fried rice and crab rangoon. While it wasn't terrible, I think there are much better spots for Chinese food. The crab rangoon was strangely flavored and flat. The fried rice was super salty and tasted like it was a mostly soy sauce. The redeeming part was the chicken, but that alone cannot save my entire opinion. Wouldn't recommend unless desperate and close by.

My 3rd time there and boy, was i disappointed! Table wasnt ready so we had to stand around like a bunch of dummies . The entrance needs more benches to wait on. 
Food was average to shitty... so much for their 'new' head honco. My steak was apparently blackened and wayyyy too salty that i couldnt finish it.  Deep fried eggplants   Were tasteless and also looked burnt.
The black and gold brownie was also burnt... lousy dessert, even on a Saints W day.

They were out of the chicken and thats what everyone at my table wanted. Plan ahead, people!

My Cosmo was too lemony and i sent it back

1.5 stars. Honestly, I hate to write this review, but this is for poor customer service.

We received a free cheesesteak voucher for purchasing the Visit Philly Overnight Hotel Package that visitphilly.com was promoting to increase tourism to Philadelphia. Unfortunately, while the perks of the package were great, this was one of the bad experiences. 

We went to Campo's on Memorial Day and despite being only semi-busy, service was poor. Nothing compared to Sonny's a few doors down who was crazy busy. We waited in line only about 5 minutes. However, after we ordered (a regular cheesesteak with onions) we ended up waiting over 40 minutes. That would have been fine, EXCEPT, our order was ignored and many people who ordered after us proceeded to receive their orders minutes ahead of us. That was such a disappointing experience. The workers seemed polite, however, why was our order ignored. Most likely because it was a free voucher. However, I do not know why that should come after all the other orders. We paid for a package. 

In regards to the cheesesteak, it certainly wasn't a full size cheesesteak. It was about 6 inches. In addition, there wasn't anything spectacular about the taste. Plain bread with steak slices and provolone cheese.  

After this experience, we won't be back.

Delighted once again, so much that I feel the need to leave a brand new review. This time I received an hour-long pedicure. Icon meets my exacting standards for hygiene and quality, and the aesthetician is awesome! There is no chair pedicure to be had here, so if you want something cheap and quick, you'd best go elsewhere. 

When I arrived, I was situated on a comfy table and given a cup of tea. My treatment began with a metal tub soak (with a liner for safety), then moved into extensive clipping, trimming, and filing--it's my first of the year, after all! Once my nails were perfect, I received an excellent foot massage, followed by several coats of robin's egg blue polish.

With tip, my total came to ~$80, but it was totally worth it.
Great place that you could spend hours just looking around.  They have everything that an artist or craft person could ever want.

My first experience at Studio Green was good. I had got a good cut with a stylist who's no longer there. I went back and was willing to try a new stylist to get a cut and color. I was so excited to get natural color. I was looking forward to the appointment for weeks. I got there 5 minutes early and sat waiting for 25 minutes. Then the stylist came over and, without even apologizing for the wait, asked me if I was in a rush. I wasn't really sure how to answer since I wasn't but I wanted to get things going since I knew the appointment would take a couple of hours. She said she still had to blow dry her client's hair and she would be only another 10 minutes. 25 minutes later I decided to just leave. 50 minutes is far too long to wait at a salon, in my opinion, and she had absolutely no regard for the fact that she left me waiting for so long. She was so inconsiderate that I couldn't imagine trusting her with my hair. I thought I might make an appointment to go back to see someone else but I'm so frustrated with the place that I won't go back at all. Sad since they seem to be the only place in Nashville with natural color. I emailed them about my experience but never heard back. Customer service doesn't seem to be a big consideration for them. It's really too bad.

Needed a Curt hitch installed that I bought on line from e-Trailer onto my new Audi. They did an excellent job at a very fair price and let me know that the local Audi dealer usually refers people who don't want to spend the (stupid expensive) money on a factory hitch.  They also let me know they will match e-Trailer's price and the installation is even more reasonable when you buy through them.  They took good care of me on a very busy day and the installation looks great!
Tiffany did my nails. Very professional! Had a pedicure and gel manicure. Gel manicure very clean and the exact color that I wanted.

Bagelshop moved into the old Mile End space in the Fairlane Hotel on Union Street downtown. We checked it out for brunch this past Sunday. Heads up: the parking isn't great even in this part of downtown and even on a weekend. We aren't downtown a lot, but I made an exception to try Bagelshop! It was a little busy when we arrived; there was a bit of a line. But it moved quickly, and our bagels were ready quickly. They don't have a huge variety of bagels, but they had the classics. I don't see salt bagels all that often anymore, so I went with a salt bagel with their lox schmear. I loved that their lox schmear had red onion and capers in it! Like a full lox bagel just in the schmear! You can sit and eat their bagels in the restaurant area next to where you order or you can take your bagels to go. We took ours to go and enjoyed them under the cherry blossoms at Legislative Plaza. A perfect brunch! If you're craving a classic bagel, Nashville's newest bagel shop might be the perfect spot!
Lousy food, and even worse owners. They support extreme right wing conservatives. Avoid at all costs.

I've seen Katie many times at Skin Prophecy and she is wonderful! Her guidance has really helped make a huge difference in my skin. After each treatment I wake up the next day and say "wow!" And with every new visit it gets better. I will definitely be a long time client of hers and continue to refer my friends and family!
Alberto and team did a very nice job trimming my trees.  They look beautiful!  A bit more clean up of the tree debris would have been better but overall very happy.
Above average Chinese take out. Unfortunately the two teenagers that answer the phone, take orders and ring people up are very curt and rude.

I drive out of my way to come here as often as possible. I get the rolled tacos with cheese and guacamole. The guacamole is freshly made and piled on! Drizzle with their green salsa and you are in heaven. I also love their cheese enchiladas combo meal that includes a taco. Their enchilada sauce is so good I could drink it! And they have plenty of cheese. The taco is on a freshly fried shell and filled with tender shredded meat. The rice and beans are delicious. My daughter gets carne asada fries and makes 3 meals out of them. Plenty of toppings. El Potosini is probably my favorite Mexican in all of Tucson.
$20.00 oz. Opus one. And dozens of wines from all over the world that you can sample one oz. at a time. If you like wine. Get there.

I am from Tampa so I am no expert on Nashville Hot Chicken but I do know good food. This chicken was SO GOOD!! My husband and I both enjoyed what we ordered. I had the Hot Chicken and Beignets and he had the Hot Chicken. We both got the mild spice since it was going to build up to a medium. We also got a side of the Mac and cheese and really enjoyed that as well! Joe, our server, was Fantastic! We will def be back next trip to Nashville!

Only came in once.... but they have awesome lunch specials!  We ordered pad thai, tempura veggies, and sushi rolls.  All came as either a bento or with soup & salad.  Everything tasted good & we were given good portions!
Love the King George salad!  So nice to sit on their deck by the river.  It's a must go in Bristol

I love this cafe.  The food is delicious.The waitress is a hoot; always enjoy interacting with her. I feel like I can just go to this quaint place, sit in a very comfortable environment and thoroughly enjoy my meal.  I don't mind music, but it is nice to be in a place where there isn't loud music playing especially of the variety that is on the radio these days.  The quiche is so very good; it's hard for me not to order it every time.  Well done to the owners and service people.  You've made a lovely place to go.  Toni B.

This is the perfect place for an excellent meal before seeing a show at the Horizon Theater.  The staff are friendly, food delicious, and you get Telemundo on the TV in the corner.  I love this place.
Amazing every time me and my girlfriend go in. Friendly staff, vegan options, amazing meatballs and sausage. All around solid place, love the selection of beers.

Hands down, these people are THE best!  I had been searching for a vet and, after much research, I discovered this wonderful team and I couldn't be more pleased.  The staff treated Murphy like he was one of their own, putting him at ease immediately.  The techs were professional, courteous and caring; he didn't even seem to mind getting a shot!  It's rare to encounter such good customer service, excellent bedside manner and competitive prices all in one place.  Thank you to Ashley and the rest of the staff for making our experience such a pleasure!

Brasserie continues to hit it out of the park every time we visit! You can always win going to a Gerard Craft restaurant and each one has its own appeal. We usually visit Brasserie on a special night out or a romantic night for my husband and I. The outdoor patio seating is always lively, the food is fantastic, and the service is top notch. Our visit last night was no different and we walked away full and happy. Can't wait to come back again!

This is THE place to go if you need to redefine or create your resume. From the beginning I received excellent customer service and prompt responses from John. My resume was quickly assigned to Becca who spent almost 2 hours on the phone with me just to make sure she caught every little detail and aspect of my professional history. You could tell they really care.

Within a week and a half of my initial contact, I had a resume I was proud to hand off to employers. I sought out StandOut Resumes, not to find a job, but to update my resume with my current work experiences. Within a month of updating my LinkedIn with remnants of the final product, I was contacted by a huge company and now I am moving to San Francisco! Throughout my 9 panel interview process, each person commented on different aspects of the resume that stood out. The format created for me easily allowed my new employer to identify my skills and abilities.

I have referred multiple friends to Standout Resumes and am also in the process of getting my fiance's updated. I would never go anywhere else. The price is reasonable, the customer care is stellar, and the final product is untouchable.
This place is great. If you're in be sure to get the Bibimbob! Rice, fresh vegetables and sprouts topped with delicious bulgoki beef and a fried egg. To die for.

We have been coming here since the 90s and it has taken a nose dive.  Most recent visit...waited for 45 minutes for our food to arrive ONLY after I finally asked someone that wasn't our server to check on it.  She brought it out and it was so cold it had to have been sitting for a long time.  When I approached the owner about the wait, he just said ok and went to the back.  Not sure why he didn't seem to care but we didn't get an apology or did he even care to ask anything further about it.  It's a sad day for our visit to this once great local spot.  I hope it turns around but we won't be back to find out.

I went to Carrabba's this past Sat night, with three friends.  Knowing it was Saturday night, I went the day before, on Fri morning to get our name on the list for 7PM Sat. Let me preface this by saying, I've been a Carrabba's customer for awhile, probably 3-4 times a month. We arrived for our 7PM time 15 minutes early, and were told, that yes they had us on the list for 7PM.  I knew we might have to wait, but..................As we waited & waited, we saw people requesting the same size table as us, being seated within minutes of arrival. When I asked the hostess, she said they called ahead, and she knew I placed my "call ahead" the day before. She had my name on her screen when we walked in.  At 7:45, after seeing three groups of 3-4 being seated, that came in after us, we said our final arrivederci to Carrabba's. The hostess didn't care, so hey Carrabba's.......we don't care either.   With so many other options, why put up with one that doesn't care??

Char grilled oysters were grilled pretty much perfectly.  Only downside was a few too large oysters....had to cut into 3 big bites.
Hush pups were awesome as was remoulade for dipping.  Boiled shrimp had very good seasoning.
And for dessert,  beignets were delish!
The red dragon, pink lady, and angel hair were wonderful! Crab rangoon left a little to be desired though. Overall great dinner.

We had a great stay here last night! We loved the perfect location and Leesa was super welcoming. She showed us around the house, gave great recommendations for local spots, and her butter bars are awesome. Our room was comfy and clean. The only thing we'd change was the lack of water pressure in the shower.... That was a major downer. Other than that, we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and recommend it!

Walking into this modern beauty bar everything seems so relaxing and quiet. Not your typical salon that's noisy and technicians screaming across the salon. I walked in and was greeted by their friendly host. She sat me down in my pedicure chair and assisted on me right away. As I was sitting there she brought me over many pallets of colors to choose from.  I found the perfect dip color for my nails and my toes I always stick to French.  My technician came and he started on my pedicure right away. He was very friendly and he made sure every step of the way that I was happy with his service. A+++++. Even when he was painting my French pedicure Ryan made sure that it was up to my expectation. Once my pedicure was done, he assisted me over to the bar top manicure station. He started on my dip manicure, usually during this time I get very nervous because I never know what's the outcome of my nails.  He was very detailed on my nails and made sure every finger looked perfect.  I was in shock that Ryan did such a perfect job on my pedicure and my dip manicure. Usually I always have to tell the technician wherever I go to do a certain way up to my liking. But with Ryan I didn't have to say a thing besides that I wanted my nails square shape... 

I highly recommend this Salon to anyone that is visiting Nola because I'm a visitor as well and found this Gem. Now everytime I visit Nola I know exactly where to go to get my pedicure & manicure done! 

Btw... when I was sitting there I notice that after every client the staffs at the salon they really do disinfect their area down... That's a big plus in my books...

WOW! I'll be honest, I was not expecting this. We are so glad we ran into Glen at Cocos last night. He told us about this place and we had to try it after hearing him describe the food. We ordered the peach mango habanero wings, IRB burger, volcano burger and the localz burger to go. We asked for medium and medium rare. The burgers were cooked perfectly and the wing's sauce was delicious. Good balance of sweetness and heat. Everyone in our household enjoyed the food. Zero left overs. Well done!

Looking forward to our next visit.

I have been to skeptical of acupuncturist for different reasons, one being they say you have to go back 10-15 times to get full results. But found Dawna to be well trained, very sensitive to my needs, and well beyond my expectations.
