I've had only 3 treatments for possible carpel tunnel Due to my 15 years as a massage therapist and am thrilled to say I may only have one or 2 more treatments to go. She knew exactly where all my spots of pain were all the way up to the back of my neck. I would highly recommend her to anyone.
They got the most unfriendly people running there store been going there every since they be open not going back

I never review anything and this is my first post on Yelp. Why am I bothering... because my wife and I found a gem and the food was so wonderful they deserve it. They started us out with chips and 3 salsas, a chilli, tomatillo, and chipolte based which were all excellent.
For the appetizer my wife and I shared the Crab San Lucas. This was basically a complex salsa with plenty of crab meat on a bed of lettuce. The ingredients were blended to give a perfect balance of sweet, tart, and heat then harmonized with lime and a hint of salt.
For dinner I had chill rellenos. I was expecting this to be served with a ranchero or some other chili/tomato based sauce as described in the menu, but it cam out with a chipolte cream sauce instead that was outstanding. It was not as spicy as I would have liked, but that was easily remedied with a little supplemental chipotle salsa that remained on the table. The batter covering the chills was light and not greasy at all. The chili itself was wonderfully cooked al dente. The accompanying rice was cooked and seasoned perfectly, but the retired beans were sort of ordinary.
My wife ordered the chicken enchiladas and contrary to what someone else posted, neither of us found them to be bland. They were moist and fresh. The tomatillo sauce she ordered with them was excellent.
The portions were sizable and both of us were filled from the above. My wife could not finish her entree. Our waiter gave us a complementary mango cheesecake to try. I loved it because it was not too sweet or heavy. My wife did not care much for it, but she does not like mango either.
We are most defiantly returning with friends very soon. There were not many people there for a Saturday night for whatever reason, but this place is just too good not to make it.

We could not have been more pleased with the fantastic job dj hectic did and the entire Gavin Roy team for their effort in making our wedding so special. Everything from the guitarist at the ceremony to the non stop jams at the reception were very much appreciated along with the professionalism of the entire staff. We received many positive enthusiastic comments from our guests and even hope to see Gavin Roy being involved in some of their future wedding plans as we would highly recommend them all!

I actually stop here often.  I have discovered that what is price posted on the shelf/ben is not what will ring up when checking out.  So I have learned that using my phone to take a photo of the posted price is helpful.   That's all well and good, but it seems to me that to post "SAVINGS" when you pick something up and it not be the price when you check out ..... It's intentional or it's not, OR very sloppy management.  It has happened often enough to me that I'm suspecting intentional, but, maybe sloppy management.

My shopping lists usually aren't that long so it's easy to remember the price I picked something up for.  This time correction was only $2.02 ($1.01 on two items) and my total receipt was under $30.00.  I'm just curious about the folks with $200. in their cart.  What happens to them.

From the drinks to the food everything was on point, it wasn't overly salty or spicy it was well balanced with the flavor of the OG sauce. 
Our server was so delightful, thank you for your recommendations dana (not sure if it's spelled correctly, I apologize) but I would definitely recommend you ask for his service. The seafood was fresh and well portioned I felt full off of combo C and two bogo drinks (it was happy hr) 
My family and I sat outside and it was excellent do expect onlookers passing by on their stroll if choosing outdoor seating but who wouldn't look with the enticing aroma of delicious food in the atmosphere . 
Thank you we'll be back the next time we visit Tampa.

Food ordered:  4 entree, 1 appetizer, 4 drinks
Meal of the day: Brunch
Price: $85 in total
Satisfactory: very full
It's a reallly nice BL branch! If you're traveling around Nashville I really recommend to drive down here! And have biscuit love too! Also this BL is in a very cute house. I reaLly liked the biscuit donut. It has such unique taste- lemon mascarpone on top and fresh berry sauce on the bottom- amazing. The chicken is a bit dry but the gravy totally had made that up. Ill recommend fried chicken over ham, and sunny side egg is a must!!!

The fact that this place has won Best of Tucson awards baffles me. It's thoroughly mediocre, from the quality of the toppings to the style of the pizza.

The crust is too doughy, and the sauce far too sweet. It's like a more expensive Domino's. 

Skip this. Brooklyn's better on 4th Ave., and if you're interested in takeout then Grimaldi's is the place to go for New York style pizza in Tucson.

I've been doing a lot of case studies lately in an attempt to score a gig at a consulting firm. Here's my "professional" take on Zeps as a business.

Basics: Since there are no other Armenian take-out joints (at least with this sort of visibility) in the Northeast, Zeps could potentially dominate the market. But is there a real market for Armenian food among the general public in Philadelphia? I mean, I like it a lot. What about the rest of you? As insurance against a potential "no," the people at Zeps would have to serve something they were sure would sell here.

Conclusions/Execution: In fact, Zeps has decided to sell pizza along with its normal Armenian and Middle Eastern offerings. A no-lose choice in Philly, right? Well, by selling such an obviously "sellout" item, Zeps has run the risk of being labeled a "sellout" business, and, consequently, losing the customers in search of a real Armenian take-out joint-- the folks looking for authenticity. But wait! By masquerading this very quirk, Zeps has managed to make it work. 

"Pizza and Shish Kabobs" is what the cool looking sign out front says. Odd, but attention getting. And why not? The result a place I'd trust for Armenian classics, but also a place I'd consider fun and innovative.

Try the lunch specials: Lamb Louleh. MMM.
This is by far the best pizza in the area.  Fresh, nice thin crust, good quality cheese, great taste.  Try the Brooklyn and the Trenton.  Just wonderful.  I keep going back!!!

I was a bit hesitant after reading the reviews.  However, although the room was a bit dated, it was comfortable.   Hot shower, stable WiFi,  and clean room.  Breakfast was nice, many options.  I would stay again.

Growing up there was one thing you could count on...there was also a Chevy truck in the driveway! So when I unexpectedly found myself car shopping it came as no surprise when dad said we are going to the Chevy dealership.  I can honestly say the carl black team amazed me! They went above and beyond to find the right car for me. I'll admit I had a bit of a unique set of request (a comfortable seat and a sunroof). Ben the inventory specialist did everything short of moving mountains to get the car in from another dealer.  George is an outstanding salesman he never makes you feel pressured. He even found time to personally deliver my new car to me at work! They make you feel like family from the moment you walk though the door! Thank you to all of the Carl Black family you may never know how much I appreciate what you did for to make a stressful process seamless.  George and Ben my family is grateful for all your help and patience! Thank you from my family to all of yours!

Worst hair experience. Went in for blonde hair with no red color correction and got dark brown hair with no blonde, and they charged me almost 300. Then they put a 60 hold on my debit card for 4 days. Went back for cor correction and still came out with dark hair, no blonde! They refused to take blame for any of it. Totally unprofessional small town salon. Buyer beware!

Very poor experience. I came in hoping to relax on a Sunday afternoon and my nails and toes were rushed through in 20 minutes total. They are barely filed, polish slapped on. I could have done a better job myself for much less money. 

I will not be returning.

It was ok. We came out of the way to find it because of the beer selection. The fries were good but the rest of our meal didn't keep our interest. It did however, get the attention of my wallet. Slightly over priced for what we got. I just wasn't a fan.

This restaurant is fast food but not fast. You have wait for them to cook to the order. The burger is 100 percent pure Japanese Akaushi Kobe beef, 2-3 grades higher than USDA Prime. It is heathy burger that you are getting in this joint. 

Monday is a special for any patron that show up in the store and get a 6 oz burger for $5. Normal price is $7. A 29% discount. The burger here has many assembly choices. They are dividing into three categories. First is cheese- the choices are American, aged Swiss, cheddar jack, pepper jack, provolone. You also can add premium cheese such as Mozzarella with additional $1.49. The second selection is the sauce - the selections are monger sauce, ketchup, mayo, mustard, honey mustard, grey poupon, ranch jalapeño ranch, A-1 steak sauce, BBQ, attic goodness sauce, chai chipotle chup. I like my burger plain. The third category is the topping - the choice are lettuce, tomato, balsamic tomato, sweet onion, grill onion, grilled mushroom, jalapeño, dill pickle, onion slaw, banana pepper, tomato relish, roasted red pepper. You also can add bacon for $1.49 more. 

I like my burger with lettuce, tomato, grilled mushroom, and balsamic tomato. The balsamic sauce drip into the burger created the sweetness and combines with the burger meat burn make this taste heavenly good. I will come for more.
Good food but man... waited 35 minutes when it was dead there to get a burrito that was just chorizo and egg... update.. still waiting for my food

So many good times here so many good friends here. This place is not a bar this place is more of a friends hang out. Inexpensive shots so you can't go wrong. So stop by and support your local businesses.

Amazing spot - especially love the happy hour and all of the amazing yummy food options here. I am with my friend and he also enjoyed himself after getting his back cracked that was really the best part of the day, but the food was also yummy. 
He says "everything was so new to my palate thank you!"

Today the service was average to below average, slow, inattentive, and we had to remind them of additional items we asked for. It was a typical Friday night, not very crowded  The pizza was just ok and they served my son a bad apple juice. When I pointed it out it was almost as if the waiter knew it was bad. BUT the General Manager, Chuck, asked how was everything and I told him and made it right.   No excuses, he accepted the feedback and said it would be different next time. That's stand up leadership. Which is why it got the three to bring attention to how good the manager was.

We ordered it at work all the time. Loved it!! Since it changed owners we have had it a couple times. Pizza was lacking in flavor and also lacking in sauce. The customer service is even worse. Last time I ordered for a delivery at work they couldn't find the address. I work 2 blocks from them!! They called my phone to find me but I was unaware "BECAUSE I WAS WORKING!" When I called them back some man answered and yelled at me because I Didn't answer my phone. Told me that the delivery people didn't have time for this and wanted me to come and pick up my order. I couldn't pick it up!! I gave him my address again. Took him a while to write it down. I wish I would have told him to forget it. It was a waste of $40. Pizza had no flavor and hardly any sauce. Went in the garbage. He's not going to have to worry about delivery drivers being busy for long. Very rude and food is definitely not the same. I will not be ordering again. Very disappointing.
I think this place is honest and caring. It's that's so convenient that they will drop you off at your job and pick you up when the job is finished. Great customer service.

One of our favorite places to dine al fresco when the weather breaks. Magnificent set up with outside bar, and garden. Just a gorgeous, relaxing setting to enjoy a cocktail and a few appetizers (their pizzas are popular) or dinner. The service is always good, without being pretentious. The inside dining room which you pass on the way to the restrooms upstairs, seems a bit stuffy to me, and almost like a shrine to George Washington. Great if you're a history buff.  The food is good, but not remarkable, and a bit on the pricey side. We had an appetizer salad, and me, opting for more plant based choices, had a pasta entree. Not many other choices for vegetarians, except pasta and pizza.

Meh. Service was just ok. Definitely not friendly. We popped in for some late afternoon beers and a snack. I want to say there are locals and regulars here, but it's hard to tell. 

The vibe and decor are mellow, and the beers are cold and the selection is good... it just doesn't move me as a place. 

Also the bathroom was kinda filthy and the toilet was black. Like black from the factory. Weird and gross. A filthy bathroom at 1 am is expected. A filthy bathroom at 6 pm is laziness. 

Now don't get me all wrong. It was enjoyable, the beer pretzels were Dericious, it's just not the greatest place ever.

What a wonderful experience and true Italian food!
They've been open for 22 years and this is our first time there. We started with a couple of drinks and a basket of delicious bread, hot and crispy on the outside. We then ordered the Cavateli Bada Bing and the  Gnocchi Pugliese. It was wonderful to watch the owner himself, Dominique, cooking the Cavateli in front of us!  Both dishes were delicious!  Very cheesy, so prepare your stomachs, but totally worth it!  Perfect temperature,  great spices and amazing taste!  Most of the staff have either been there since the opening or for the last 10 years!  Many repeat  customers treated the staff really well and even hugged one another.  We'll definitely be going back! Great job, Gratzzi!o

This buffet is on my regular lunch rotation.  Ever changing dishes (although there are some standbys).  The various chutneys for the salad are always tasty.  The many saucy dishes are full of flavor, but not too strange for Western palettes.  Atmosphere is musical and soothing.

"Never judge a book by its cover" definitely applied to this place. It seemed a bit sketchy looking from the outside but was pleasantly surprised by the look of it from the inside. The service was very pleasant and the food was pretty good. It was a typical diner menu and had a little bit of everything. I'm a big omelette guy and was not disappointed with my Polish Omelette.  Being only 2.5 miles from my place in Tarpon Springs made it very convenient for me. Looks like I've found my breakfast spot!

What a wonderful restaurant! We  had  A DELIGHTFUL-- NO rather a MEMORABLE DINNER. The food was what I expected, the atmosphere, for a little Italian restaurant,was what I expected but what I did not expect was the owner and sometime chef Jay to be so friendly in stopping by asking if  we enjoyed our dinner, and engaged in delightful conversation.  Will definitely return soon. 
Joe and Theresa

Small place, full of Penn students all the time.  Waitstaff still needs to get their act together but the food is delicious (though BBQ is so good in general that you have a pretty wide margin of error).  

I ordered the baby back ribs platter with cornbread, mac and cheese and collard greens.  Ribs were tender and tasty, cornbread was actually the highlight of the meal, while the other two sides were decent.  

I also ordered a $3 tall boy of PBR and they brought it 20 minutes later and claimed that someone knocked it over and the bartender had to make me a new one.  I was like "o rly?" to the waitress.

I have, been coming here for about 4 years now and have never had a bad experience. The food is amazing ! The brussels sprouts are a must . The staff is always friendly and attentive. My favorite bartender Ed is leaving for Cali :( but they have a new person behind bar stephanie that seems to be a fine addition . Always a good place to drink with food that does not disappoint .

Used to love this place and gave it a glowing review once upon a time. But we went in a few weeks ago and were shocked to find the interior redecorated (cheaper tables and chairs) & the menu COMPLETELY different. They used to have really cool menus with a huge selection of food and drink- their menus now are just basic and very limited on the food front. It's obvious the Tippler just wants to be a bar now- don't bother coming here for food. The drinks are really great, but it's just a bummer that this used to be a spot for amazing food AND amazing drinks. And it definitely had a classier vibe before. Oh well- on to the Patterson House!

So like many people on Yelp, we do our research of places and restaurants we plan to visit. My visit  happened in October of 2015 and in February 2016 I am writing this review. Why did it take so long?

I dream about Vinny's curry chicken and roti! It's that good I can't wait until May when I visit again from Ohio.  At least this time he will know what the zip lock bags and containers are for (I'm a displaced Trini) when I ask him to fill it up ;-)

Best tomato pie this side of the Delaware  crust is thin crispy usually get the square half sausage and always delicious.  Have also tried their other Italian dishes and have found them to just as good.
First time. Bar was loud but not an issue. Heather usually bartender was awesome friendly honest and attentive.  Food was good. Visiting the folks.  From Allentown we'll be back.

Large antique store consisting of 4 floors. Each floor appears to be divided into sections consisting of merchandise from different dealers.  This used to be my favorite store in lambertville until yesterday.  On the first floor-I had an item picked out for $20.  I asked if they could reduce that to take into account the item was kinda broken.  The nice lady said they do not discount under $20. She said they would discount $22 down to $20.  We found a second item not priced.  They called the dealer and came back with $22.  So we offered to take both for $40 instead of $42.... And the old manat the counter refused with the meanest, nastiest most condescending tone I have ever heard.  So... Whereas I would have paid the extra 2 bucks... This troll's attitude lost the sale. I still gave it 2 stars because I did make a purchase on the 2nd floor and the woman was a pleasure to deal with.  But I will not be returning.
First, customer service is amazing! Food is absolutely amazing! The bacon bloody Mary's are to die for! Highly recommend this place! This is my husband and my new favorite restaurant in Boise!

Went for the first time to stock up for a camping trip. After spending a little over an hour browsing and receiving help from staff I proceeded to check out where I met a RUDE cashier who rudely asked for ID only to refuse to continue with my purchase until he got a managers approval because my little brother (15 who was well behaved and didn't touch anything) was with me. Clearly there is a sign out front that the employees walk by EVERYDAY as seen in photo. "Minors MUST BE ACCOMPANIED BY AN ADULT" will not be returning to total wine.

We had a party of 8 and were going to have to wait quite a while to be seated, or split our group.  After a bit, the manager came out and told us she was going to open the party room up for us so we didn't have to wait.  AMAZING!

Not only do they have great food, they have amazing service!  I was thoroughly impressed!  Our waiter checked on us many times throughout the meal, and was very helpful and pleasant!

I don't think there is a dish on the menu that you can go wrong with.  Their complimentary bread is awesome too!   So soft, and with a great dipping oil.  I'm sure I'll be back to try something else on the menu!
Started our trip here and came back to finish it. Chandell (Dell)  the bartender was the sweetest. Food was delicious and served quickly. Place was clean & very welcoming.

I kinda get the vibe that that half assed hippies who work here think they're better than everybody else.  Just so we're clear, you're not.  And it's going to be funny once your college money runs out and you have to do something more legitimate than overcharge people for groceries for a living.

Seriously, there's not one thing in this place fairly priced.  Is your entire marketing strategy "hey, at least we're not whole foods"?

Go fuck yourselves.

My wife purchased expensive designer frames and lenses there 2 years ago. The lenses got scratched so I brought the glasses in for lens replacement only that I was willing to pay for. 
Nope. The prescription expired 11/19 and "according to state law" LensCrafters cannot instal new lenses. BUT had she purchased their protection plan they would replace the lenses using the old prescription. That makes no sense at all. They obviously have good lobbyists in Harrisburg .
Thus ended our families 20+ year relationship with LensCrafters and we will be taking our business elsewhere.

Shock City is a power-packed full-service studio with plenty of talent behind the equipment. We were amazed at how efficiently and skillfully they honed in on what we were after, they made our band sound great!

Guppy's was the first stop in a friend's birthday bar crawl this past Saturday. We invaded promptly as they opened (5 PM). This modestly-sized, informal corner spot has cushy seating, appealing decor, and a fun selection of beer.

This place has an awesome name - how can you beat "Guppy's Good Times" - and our bartender (John) was just as awesome. He made us tasty Duck Farts [shots] and even comped one for our friend's birthday.

Recommended for a guppy good time. (It's also a million times better than the Great American Pub, for those of you who've been.)

I just had to say a few things about this company! The office staff is always very courteous and helpful, and the technicians are professional and knowledgeable. I am always pleased with the service I recieve, especially compared to other businesses in the service industry! 
An added bonus- we just had a new system installed and our electric bill was cut in half!
Would definitely recommend!

Burgers are cheap and decent.

The photos on yelp are very misleading. They do not have all the crazy looking fancy doughnuts like in the pictures. They just had a small selection of pretty generic doughnuts that were old and sad looking. I got a dozen with a few different kinds, and they were alright, until I noticed that one of the glazed doughnuts had MOLD on it!!! You'd think that regular glazed doughnuts would be a safe bet, and that they'd make them fresh everyday, but apparently I was wrong. Will not be returning.

Yes, it's a ladies who lunch kind of spot. It also happens to have the best chicken salad ever and lots of yummy take out options. I go there with my mom, but I also go by myself and pick up soup or salad or a casserole to take home. The interior of the place is very casual and the women who work there are very friendly. What's not to like?

It's easy to get caught in the tourist trap of Bourbon Street especially when it's your first visit to this historic City. Olde Nola Cookery was my first outstrip and it didn't disappoint when it came to their hospitality and it's blackened chicken Po' boy. Instead of regular fries I opted for the Cajun fries the offset of the blackened season and the Cajun sauce put this meal over the top. I walked in looking just to get lunch and after seeing every table next to me order desserts I had to follow suit. Two girls at a table next to me ordered the Banana Fosters Ice Cream and the Kentucky Bourbon Pecan Pie. After hearing the one girl request a glass of water because she was starting to feel the bourbon I decided to go with the staple that is the Banana Fosters Ice Cream. Thanks to my waiter, John not just for his hospitality and making me feel at home but for telling me about checking in on Yelp and being able to get 1 free drink or dessert. Definitely worth going back or stopping in if you're in NOLA.

If you take the Applebee's name off an Applebee's, it is still an Applebees.

Devil's Den feels like an Applebee's.  

I guess its a matter of personal preference, but the the interior is so pristine and shiny I almost feel as if gone to visit the home of a obsessive compulsive friend who covers their furniture with saran wrap so as to not "ruin it".  Personally, I hate that feeling.  

Devil's Den is too well lit.  Its too spacious.  It's an Applebee's without the name.  

However, Devil's Den has an excellent beer list with some decent choices on their rotating Draught system.  They are doing that much right.  Their happy hour is unbeatable compared to other bars within that vicinity (think POPE, or South Philly Tap Room) with their 50% off Drafts.  That is a plus.  But is the 2 bucks I save worth feeling like I am drinking in an uncomfortable setting?  I cannot hold my personal views of how a bar should be against a place as I am certain there are many people who feel like dimly lit dingy establishments are depressing, but this is my review and this reviewer wants dank.

Its a great bar to take co-workers after work.  Its a great bar for a blind date.  Its not romantic.  Its clean.  I honestly did not get the chance to sample the menu much but I did have the popcorn shrimp Happy Hour Tapas special.  While I was glad to find they pulled the tails off the shrimp (I've been to a place where the whole shrimp was fried and unfortunately not all the tails were gone), it was not what I expected.  The shrimp was a decent size but it was only six.  A shrimp cocktail sized platter at a shrimp cocktail sized price.  The chili sauce was interesting and while I do prefer my food spicy, it was more than acceptable.  I did find it a bit on the sweet side though.  But what should I have expected for a Tapas style dish?  I incorrectly assumed a multitude of Shrimp in line with its "Popcorn" appellation, but that is my problem not theirs.

Devil's Den does have a lot of good things going for it.  Would I go back?  Maybe.  But I might only stick to happy hour.  And I might only stick around for an hour.  Its perfect if you like well lit well stocked establishments.  If the idea of bright lights with your beverages is not appealing, I would pass it on by.  But as far as other gastro pubs in the city go, I feel like its falling short of something.  I want to say character, though I hate to sound that harsh, but I'm saying it anyway.

This is probably the best hibachi restaurant we have been to. The food was delicious and they give you give you good portions. I will say that sushi was just mediocre but if you're looking for a good hibachi spot then this is definitely a go to!

I am a fan of this new place.  My group split the delicious hummus tray.  I had a half veggie sandwich.  It was so flavorful and filling.  I really wish I got the full sandwich, not because it wasn't enough to eat, but just because it was so good!  My friends each got one of the health "bowls" they offer, and they both said they loved them.  The beer choices aren't bad, but I don't like that all you have for water is a luke warm bottle waiting at your table when you sit down.  The service was pretty good. I sat at the table waiting for my friends and was never once approached until a couple minutes after my friends got there.  Towards the end of the meal our waitress was more attentive.  This restaurant is doing a lot, if not close to everything right, check it out!
Oh- quick tip: don't park at the stip club, you'll get towed!  stick to the small parking lot and street parking.

Should have looked at the reviews. The food was absolutely terrible. Old, nasty frozen garbage. Slow service. The only decent thing was my husband's bloody mary. We barely ate anything because it was so awful. Do yourself a favor and avoid this craptastic restaurant.

Anytime we come back to town we visit here at least once. It like eating great food in a historical re enactment. Actually, that's precisely what it is. I cannot recommend this enough! Oh the turkey pot pie is out of this world. Even when its busy, conversation is easy so great place to take a family get together.

I had a very good experience with this company. I never needed a tech in the past and I really had no idea what to expect. This company worked with my crazy work schedule and fixed my fridge, it's like new! I was so afraid that we had to replace it. The tech was on time, neat, polite, and very knowledgeable. I don't think a smile left his face for the entire experience. You can tell they really love what they do, it shows in their manner. The customer service at the main line was extremely helpful getting someone out at the right time to help me. From start to finish this was a stress free process with no hiccups, I will absolutely use them again.
Happy Halloween ! Sandy and crew does it again trick or treat I went from solar nails to acrylic with pink and white gel!

Food was pretty good for a non china town restaurant. Can tell that the dim sum was not fresh but still was good. Cant expect too much since I am used to the NYC china town. The prices were a bit high for that reason. But the enironment was very clean and nice. Beware, they only have the dim sum carts on WEEKENDS which was what I thought I was getting. Instead, you ordered off of a list.

As someone with a disability and who doesn't drive. using the PC Express service is a great option. I moved to the southside this year so I haven't ordered from Loblaws very often, but I do have a friend who picks up my orders for me.

Unlike Superstore or Save On Foods, I've never had an issue with my orders here. They're packed on time. They're accurate. And their deli products are one of the reasons I still use this location from time to time. And unlike Superstore, their phones are always open and answered. There have been many times when using PC Express with Superstore, I couldn't get anyone on the phone. Orders are also packed really well too for transport.

I just wanted to say thank you for all you do!

Waited in line for more than an hour to get a simple plan line tattoo. The guy who did my tattoo was nice, but his hands were shaking the whole time and he was in a rush. My friend and i all got the same tattoo and none of the lines on the tattoos are straight. You can see every imperfection. Would not recommend for anyone getting a small basic tattoo.
Always friendly and very helpful. Anytime you walk in you are always greeted with a big hello.

Stopped  in here a week ago- I've been there a few other times -the food seems to be inconsistent -last week I got a Philly sub and it was fried to death and  the fries were under cooked and there was only one other table in the place at the time -
I am from out of town but went to this location today and Renee was welcoming and the gym was extremely clean.

Stopped in tonight for the first time and ordered a meatball parm sub. Nice atmosphere, delivery drivers coming and going and very friendly service behind the counter. It's hard to make a bad meatball sub which makes it even more difficult to make a standout meatball sub-which is exactly what they did. I'm full from half and actually excited for leftovers for once. Can't wait to explore the rest of the menu. Will definitely be back.

Attempted to order delivery from here but the food never made it to me.  Restaurant claimed an attempt had been made to deliver my food but had never contacted me and refused to deliver my order or refund my money.  Won't be ordering from here again.

Sweet potato fries r thin, tender and crispy, def some of the best I've had.  Chicken  tenders fresh seasoned,battered  and fried moist and tender.  My husband says its the best he's had and I agree they were perfect. He shared his cheesesteak with me,  it was an A+! 

Gretna/ NO, show some love!  Great sports bar atmosphere with tvs in different angles.  If I come this way again I will surely stop in again. Sweet Airielle took good care of us as our server. Five stars are saved for my last meal on earth,  lol!
Adorable. Had the creamed chipped beef with well done home fries, delicious.

Do not hire them. They broke my door and are only offering $25 dollars for the damage. 

For the move itself, the movers showed up late, were not prepared, and did not even finish the job in one day like they promised. I had to reschedule the pod. The premium price for their services is far from the quality of the work they do.

I had a haircut here today by Melissa. She is new to Dandy. She was very pleasant. I let her know before hand that not a lot of people can cut my hair to make me look good. Lots of stylists can't seem to work with my face shape. So, I told her ... "no pressure". Ha! I have to say, for a newbie, she did a darn good job on my hair. It looked very good when I left, and it felt lighter and it formed to my face shape. It was a nice start to my day. I really like Dandy's atmosphere and it always smells fantastic. I was treated very well today. Thank you Dandy.

Food was good, but no soap in men's restroom. Watched an employee use said restroom for an extended period of time and come out without any soap in there.  Informed employee of this, and they were unconcerned. Too gross for me. Will not be back.

What can I say, I'm a sucker for Bruegger's.  I used to live right down the street from this location and used to hit it up quite regularly.  It's always been quite busy.  Service is typically good and the bagels always seem to be pretty fresh.  Recently returned when I was in this area of town and found that it appeared to be exactly as I remembered it.
Yeah, there's better places to get bagels in town, but like I said, I'm a sucker for Bruegger's, and this one is nicely located in the middle of this sprawlish city we call home.

You would think that a Gordon Ramsay Kitchen Nightmares visit would make a restaurant better.  You really would.  Unfortunately, it seems that Zocalo may be on the same path to closure as the other Ramsay redone-dive in Philadelphia, Hot Potato.  At this rate, I'm really hoping that Chiarella's doesn't suffer the same fate as well.

Regardless of the Ramsay element, Zocalo's problem used to be (and still is) the same.  As long as stubborn owners like Mary (and to a milder degree, Greg) rule the ship with an iron fist, you're not going to experience much progress, and this certainly still shows up in the restaurant.

Aesthetically, sure, Zocalo has gone miles ahead of where it used to be, and the iPad POS system definitely adds the "cool" factor to the dig.  Nevertheless, the food still remains sub-par, with certain items borderline disgusting, certainly ruining the experience.  

The servers, however, definitely have a more positive vibe amongst them, and while I question the need for 12+ servers (that's how many I counted, at least) in such a small place, I think that they are the only positive element to this place.

Long story short, swing by if you're interested in experiencing the ambiance of a Ramsay makeover, but don't hold it to any of his other standards.  One-time visit, if even that much, and definitely not worth the money.

I evacuated to St Louis following hurricane Ida.  I really needed color and a haircut, and I knew salons won't be open at home for quite awhile.  After reading reviews, I
made an appointment with Julie.  
Julie gave me an awesome cut and lovely color. I felt so spoiled! Just what I needed!
Julie is very talented.

I just wanted a quick bite for lunch. I ordered a jumbo dog because frankly, it was cheap. Is it just me or are the prices here kind of wild. $6.50 for a smoky. $3 for small fry and a drink... I dunno what the costs but I'm sure it's north of $2. So that's close to 12 bucks for a hot dog lunch. I dunno, maybe I'm cheap. 

The hotdog was good but the  place lacks any charm and the counter staff are, well odd I guess would be the best description. They don't really interact with customers they just stand and watch. 

Anyways it's a hotdog not 5 star cuisine. I just think it should have hotdog prices...or vibe... or something.
I purchased a necklace for an anniversary present and the service was impeccable.  Great people and experience.

The club is in desperate need of a manager that cares. The facilities are DIRTY. They just closed the pool because of health code violation. I swam mostly with my eyes closed because I was often grossed out. They should lose their license all together and get a company to take over that knows how to run a quality sports club. 
Where do I swim now?????

I come here often for their Indian pancake. The sauce usually has one piece of chicken and potato in it. My typical entree option is the Mee Siam noodles. I've had the pad Thai here and it was okay. The chicken satay is good. Weekend dinners can get crowded so come early.

(My review was removed below and not sure why.). 

We tried different off the beaten path places for beignets and no one came close. Light and fluffy and lots of powdered sugar. Cash only. Totally worth the sugar rush afterwards. The French Quarter involves lots of walking so you have time to walk it off!

My partner-in-dine and I have been to Hooters Tucson quite a few times now and we've had outstanding service and excellent food every time. We always start our meal with Beer Cheese and Pretzels. The pretzels are always hot and soft, the cheese sauce sinfully creamy. After whetting our appetite, I set my sights on the 10-piece Original Style Wings. My favorite sauces are Honey Chipotle, Spicy Habanero and General Tso's. My partner-in-dine worships the Daytona-style wings. But the créme de la créme of the whole Hooters dining experience is the enthusiastic and courteous service we've always gotten from our server Angel. We have our lucky stars to thank for getting her as our server 3 times! She always displays consistency in her effervescence and attentiveness. We'll be back again (and again) knowing that we'll always get sumptuous food and groovy service.

The food was delicious and that is the only reason for a 2 Star review instead of a 1. The host was super friendly and everyone that wasn't our actual server was very friendly as well.

Our server was a tall, kind of skinny, older blonde woman who complained most of the night about how busy the restaurant was and that she wasn't taking anymore tables. While she was complaining, she brought us the wrong drink order and huffed when questioned about the menu and brushed off our inquiries. We had to flag her down multiple times for refills on waters only to have her set it down and walk away without a word. We sat with dirty plates for quite some time until another server came over and took them away. The entire time, I watched our server behind the bar yelling at the bartender. Even still, ANOTHER server came through and wiped down our table. We asked him for our check and he said he would make sure it got to us immediately. We then sat for another few minutes watching our server yell and throw her arms up at her manager. 

Finally, the mother of my friend stood up and flagged her down for the check. She brought it over and told us she was sorry and that she hated nights. She also told us that we didn't have to tip her and walked away before we could give her our credit cards to pay the bill. We finally gave up and simply paid in cash and left.

I have NEVER had this kind of experience at Cafe Maspero and after this mess, it will be a very, VERY long time before I return.

Delicious delicious delicious! So my friend and I came here with high hopes because we love all Asian food...and we wanted to try out a new place downtown. The servers are all super sweet. Greet you right away even if they're not right at the front. Service was great! Never needed a refill and they got everything right. I was super excited because I get "hot" when I get pad Thai...but most of the time  when I order it it doesn't even come hot at all which is annoying. But when I ordered I asked if the hot was actually hot and she said yes so I ordered it and it was! And it was SOOOO GOOD! I felt sick after cuz I  ate all of it and some of my friends curry meal and some Rangoons lol it was all so good I couldn't stop and I was stuffed! The layout of the restaurant is kind of weird because it's narrow and tight so you're close to people everywhere but there's nothing they could even do about it because it's just the way the building is. But other than that everything is perfect!!!

Dissapointingly, I have to say this was one of the worst meals I have been served. I ordered selivery throufh the GrubHub app, and sincerely regret it. I ordered Lasagna, which was literally below room temperature and essentially a brick of cold cheese. I ordered wings which were disgustingly rubbery, barely room temperature,  and extremely chewy as if microwaved. I ordered a can of Dr. Pepper, which was not included with my order despite paying the $2. My side salad was actually pretty delicious, and ended up being the only palatable item I received. 

If a restaurant doesn't care about executing delivery orders, they should just not do it. If you don't want to deliver food to me, then just don't make it an option. To pay for such a half-assed meal is insulting, I'd prefer to just be told no.

There is no hyperbole in this review, and I am the easiest person on earth to please; just give me something resembling what I paid for. I will never order from this place again, let alone step inside of it. You got my $35 once, Coco Bamboo, never again.

My boyfriend and I are typically fans of unlimited sushi places. However, Sushi Maru is FANTASTIC- from start to finish. 

They have great combination sushi platters if you want a little bit of everything and 2 for 1 wines. Their M-F happy hour/specials are also a great deal! To top it all off, our server was impeccable. We  will be going back again - just for the quality of service and food.

The food is good but it is pricey and the portions are small. I could have ate two breakfasts. I think I have been here twice and both times I had waited 10-15 minutes before anyone even acknowledged me after being sat at the table. The girls always look super busy and overworked.

One of their tow trucks nearly hit someone running a red light at the intersection of Franklin and 184 connector in Boise on 2/13 @10:30am. Driver was turning right and failed to stop, it was not accidental. Slow down. Incident has been reported to Boise police and ISP. NO towing business should be running red lights and putting lives at risk.

What a delightful night! What an entertainer! 
This will be a night I remember forever. I grew up listening and laughing to Ray Stevens and his comedic songs. As I grew older, I began to respect his talent. Tonight he put on one helluva show. At 80, he can still belt his songs out with more vigor than anyone! I detoured to come tonight and I will get home to Ellijay Ga after 3am; but the show, my memories, autograph and pictures will be worth it. I can sleep anytime.

Dr. Biscardi is professional, kind, and goes the extra mile to make sure you're comfortable and satisfied with your corrective lenses. She's personable and yet quick. I don't feel like she's too busy for me or rushes me, yet she keeps things moving and gets me on my way.

 I'm a first-time contact wearer and I visited her three times until everything was right, all for just the initial fee!

The secret is out--she's amazing--so plan your appointment several weeks in advance!

This place is well worth the money. The price isn't bad and the servings are pretty big. I got a gyro and was impressed. It had more meat than any that I've had before. It definitely tasted better than any I've had.
The place is fairly small. Seats 8. There are so many options on the menu anywhere from wings to sandwiches to shrimp. I can't wait to go and try something else. I would definitely recommend this place to others. They have delivery available but the times are limited.

Good German food and terrific baked goods. Best Rye Bread west of Chicago and the best Pretzels and Pretzel rolls that I've ever had. Be certain that the baked goods are fresh, tho. If they sell out on fresh they bring out goods that have been frozen. Still good but not great. Rye is made without caraway seed but you used to be able to order it ahead to be baked with caraway. Don't know if Klaus will still do that. Pastry also excellent, flavorful and not overly sweet. Far better than Josef's and less expensive.

I take my dog there to get her nails clipped and they have always been very good to her.  I have used their DIY bathing service a few times and found that to be extremely helpful.  They use good products and the staff is very helpful.  I will continue to go back and will always recommend them to anybody looking for grooming help.

Eek. Went here on some night around Halloween and it was no good.  

While it was hard for me to get a drink here, it seemed as if the rest of the crowd here was pretty intoxicated. I think they may have let too many people in on this particular night and I was not liking being stuck underground and not being able to move through the crowd.

The lighting here was kind of awkward too. Not light, but not dark. Not sure if they wanted people to be dancing or to be standing around and socializing.

This IS the best night life place in Reno. Amazing bar, the best people and phenomenal music. We went Thursday and they had live jazz music. It was great! The people working there and the owner who was actually serving and having fun with us and other guests was like just what you want, that welcoming place where everyone knows your name. Best night in Reno! Thank you guys very much!

In town visiting and had a wonderful dinner! My daughter and i are both vegetarians and had plenty of selections. Plenty to take home for a second meal. Service was fabulous too. Everyone was so friendly. My daughter loved the free surprise dessert at the end of our meal. A causal place with fantastic food.

The oil soaked olive rolled off my plate and landed right on my beautiful dry-clean only, silk skirt. Forget about trying to treat this monster stain on my own, I took it over to Adams. 

This wasn't the first time this skirt has seen the inside of Adams, as it is dry-clean only. However, this was the first time it was coming in with a massive stain that was front and center. 

I made sure to point out the stain and it was marked clearly with tape. Unfortunately when I went to pick up the skirt a few days later the stain was still visible. I was told that since it was silk, they didn't want to try anything too harsh to remove the stain. They suggested another round of dry cleaning. On my next trip to pick up the skirt, the stain was still visible so they suggested one more round of dry cleaning. This did the trick! The stain is no longer visible and my silk skirt wasn't damaged. 

Adams had the patience and expertise to accomplish what I wanted- stain removal and general dry cleaning. I appreciate that they only charged me for the first round of dry cleaning. I feel some places could have easily taken advantage.

There are two things that I'm taking away from this experience:
1) I'm never eating in this skirt again.
2) I will continue going to Adams for my dry cleaning needs.

Update: I recieved a call from them after my initial review asking if I would like to come in to have my nails redone. They were very professional and friendly. I feel that the nail shape and edges of the polish are much better than before. The tips of my nails are also now wrapped with nail polish and I think that this will prevent the chipping that I had previously experienced! Much better and I appreciate the call very much. Great customer service.

Big, super cute place.
The service is slooow and distracted. Although, their coffee and cappuccino were really good.
Nice the pastries and other random things too.
Their outside area is very pretty.

Great vibe, great coffee!

I ordered a "give me a tan". The description reads fresh carrot, oj and ginger. The person who made my juice put in 5 small pieces of carrot, filled the 20 ounce glass to the brim with OJ, liquidized it and then handed it to me. The whole experience was gobsmacking as my cranium refused to register the 5 round pieces of carrot in the juice. If I wanted orange juice I would have asked for it. Surely the proportions should have been half carrot half OJ ? Oh and there was no sign of the ginger. So essentially I paid $5 for OJ. 
As I said before I was left completely gobsmacked. Next time I will get my carrot+oj+ginger juice from Pumpkin market.

Fun way to grab a drink and a bite before a concert. Mac and Cheese with duck confit was awesome and my wife loved the French onion soup. Everything else else food/drink wise was good but not great. Atmosphere was what you expect from a sports bar, but the ship decor was very cool.

I had dinner the other night at Merchants. They have a fancier dining option upstairs with a smaller menu. We opted for the more casual option downstairs. The mad hatter cocktail was tasty, but should have been stronger. I had the turkey club with sweet potato fries. The sandwich was awesome, but the fries weren't the best. My husband loved the beef brisket.
A really solid shrimp and grits. Good texture on the grits (which I take very seriously), flavorful, well spiced shrimp and a decently cooked egg on top. Very nice breakfast.
Great service, allowed you to browse on your own instead of helicoptering you for a buy. First time in my life looking at a car was low stress!

The good stuff: Perhaps the most gorgeous restaurant in Tampa, South Tampa included. Drinks are surprisingly well-priced ... it's easy to find a $10 glass of decent wine. Atmosphere is lively on weekends and pleasantly quiet otherwise. Food is beautiful upon arrival. Great for romance or with a group of well-behaved friends.

The meh stuff: Menu variety is great, but food itself is hit-or-miss. Sometimes we feel prices are fair for what was ordered; other times, the portion size and/or flavors don't add up. Clientele is ... interesting. Friday and Saturday nights it's like a club in disguise. People dress across the gamut (black tie to flip flops). They give you big buzzers to clumsily carry around until your table is ready. (Maybe switch to the text message method?)

Overall, it's a 3.5 but I rounded up due to Yelp's options. We will always return when we are in Carrollwood, as there are really no other comparable options that far north. :-/

I'm so excited about this edition to Germantown and to Nashville's pizza repertoire! I am a huge fan of Chicago-style pizza but always bring my business with a healthy dose of skepticism when I try anyone outside Chicago. I have assumed that I would be bringing the frozen pizzas back from the Windy City for any hope of getting the real thing here in Nashville. I won't need to do that any more! Upon entering I was pleasantly surprised to see the nice laid back corner restaurant vibe. Marty, our waitress, was very helpful and gave us good suggestions for appetizers, etc. we got the Stockyard pizza which has a full layer of sausage under delicious cheese and sauce (think Gino's). One pie was easily enough for 3 people. I could say more but would simply recommend everything I've had from there so far (fried risotto appetizer, stockyard pizza!) and can't wait to try the Italian beef..

Meets nearly all my game needs, comparable prices to Amazon, friendly knowledgeable staff. Happy to special order items they don't carry, seem to be particularly centered around magic and other deck-based games, including special events and tournaments, long tables in the back for casual game play, too!

I had several issues and the service manager was more than willing to see everything was fixed to my satisfaction and agreeable price.  It would have been nice to have the car road tested before it was returned to me.  But after my second visit everything is working great. They did provide a Rental for me at no charge when the replacement parts were not immediately available and their regular shuttle bus was not available.

There is NO customer service at the "Main Headquarters" on Oracle. I had gone in and picked out a few pairs of shoes and did not get help from anyone! The sales people were just standing around and talking.  I finally had to ask for help, so I could try them on.  I really liked a pair of boots and sandals but decided to order from zappos instead, their customer service is awesome!!  There was another pair of boots that I wanted but the sales person said they didn't have my size.  He didn't even offer to check the other stores for me.  This was my third visit to the Oracle store, every visit was the same.  I will definitely not be going back and will let coworkers and friends know!
Had a Pizza steak and old bay fries!  Food was Phenomenal!  Staff was very pleasant.  Will definitely be going back.  Worth the 20 minute drive from home!

If you don't eat here you are doing yourself a disservice

I love this restaurant. I want to preface that I am a huge pizza fan. I am pretty certain have eaten at every pizzeria in Tucson. Hands down the best pizza I have probably ever had. Ever. Not just in Tucson. This shop is a hidden gem that you would miss if you blinked. The idea that the restaurant reflects in their style and quality is really creative. 

Long story short, if you have not been here, go. Excellent pizza and sandwiches. Neat atmosphere and superb customer service.
Got the 3 year alignment for my Lexus and when I got home I noticed one of my stock wheels had a big chip in it and the maintenance icon wasn't reset.  Decent place but I nothing to brag about...
Beer and food are great but it was really annoying to swat away fruit flies during our entire experience.

I believe the manager's name is Chris (sorry If I got it wrong). He was of the most professionalism and efficiency when handling my rental.

I had an issue with our car. Our dealership arranged a temporary car for me at their location. Someone came to pick me up at the end of my work day and took me to their location where my rental was ready for me.

The exterior was immaculate. The interior, however, had a strong cigarette smell. Because I was already running late for an appointment I left like that.

I received a text message as a follow up from my experience. I reply and within the next day, I got a call from Chris. He addressed my concerns without any issues. 

Things always happen, I expect that. How a company deals with the issues makes the whole difference. Thanks again Enterprise in Pinellas Park for all your help!

Just about noon on a weekday and I thought this place would be packed.  It wasn't and we were able to snag the last U booth, although there were still tables available.  I didn't want to have a meal leaving me too full before a meeting so I had a turkey burger with no sides.  We waited about 10 minutes for our meals, and my friend got his beef burger before mine.

The turkey burger had cranberry, tomato, lettuce, and mayo.  It was tasty but not amazing and usually they put too much mayo for my liking.  I should have asked light on the mayo.  One of the staff came to check on us during our meal which was unexpected service.  She was also prompt taking away our empty trays after we were finished.

Burger was alright for almost $9 but there are better places to eat for a lunch date.

Stopped in for a quick dinner before a show.  Cameron, our server, was amazing.  He gave us great service, was extremely attentive and was able to get us in and out quick so that we could make it on time to the concert.  All of us enjoyed our meal.  Our steaks were cooked properly and the three way spaghetti dish looked really good, next time for me!  Demos is my new go to restaurant before a show!

When we got our pup last year friends recommended we try Michigan Road Animal Hospital. From the first visit, they have taken great care of our pups. Most of the time, a staff member has walked around the counter to greet and treat our dogs. 

The staff at Michigan Road Animal Hospital are wonderful. We primarily see Dr. Estes, but Dr. Jacobs is also good. Dr. Estes is so great with our pups. She is caring, compassionate, and answers all of our questions thoroughly. She is very patient and helpful. 

The facility has two waiting areas, one for dogs and one for cats. Typically, the wait times are very minimal, easy checkout process and for certain things they don't require a vet visit. We highly recommend Michigan Road Animal Hospital and Dr. Estes to anyone searching for a Vet.

After waiting more than 20 minutes in line, we were finally led down into a dark and secluded hall of tables (sitting room only), where not too many people lounged around sipping well-iced potions in glasses of all sizes and shapes.  The air was distinctly secretive, refined, and purposeful. 

Almost every drink was accompanied by eccentric bitters that had long become extinct in pubs and other modern bars.  The names of these bitters would fit well in any Greek tragedy.  Other ingredients like pumpkin and maple syrup, or egg white, showcased the expansive art of mixology practiced here. 

Why only 3-stars you ask?  While I can appreciate certain art forms for what appears to be art, I partake in some more for edification than enjoyment.  My first drink - Stormy Monday - tasted regrettably like Chinese herbal plaster used for painful joints.  While my companion enjoyed it, I had to order a different drink.  The Old-fashioned is well-done, fragrant and smooth, while the other cocktails taste like no other food form I've had.  While I like good liquor straight up, my palette was not too pleased with all the bitter encounters it had that night.  

It's definitely an interesting place to try at least once, but for me, I'll stick to a nice bottle of red wine.

I had an excellent masala dosa here. Dosa was crisp and buttery, the masala stuffing was flavorful and filling. The accompanying coconut chutney was spicy but you could taste the sweetness of fresh coconut. We had a mango lassi as well, and it was an excellent balance of sweet and tangy. 
The ambiance is very nice, and the location is very convenient, being located in a strip mall with plenty of parking. The bathrooms are clean (to me, very important in a restaurant) and there's plenty of space in the dining room. The owners are very nice, coming over personally to make sure that every part of our experience is perfect. The menu is diverse, with selections from both North and South Indian cuisine. This may not be the cheapest Indian food in Philly but it's definitely a great value. The portions are heaping and you'll definitely struggle to finish an order. 
I would recommend Ateethi to anyone craving a little exotic flavor for a great price.

The food is always pretty good here. The issue I have is when the manager chases after me once I left the restaurant asking if I've paid. 1st issue, I'm not going to jail for a $11.00 breakfast.  2nd issue communication between you and the staff needs improvement. Prior to leaving my waitress told me someone had paid for my meal and I'm good to go whenever I'm ready. There's no need for me to tell every person I pass that someone else paid for my breakfast.  Short story short, you have lost my families services at this Cracker Barrel. Do better!

What an amazing place to get your hair done! The level of service is amazing! As I arrived I was cheerfully welcomed. I was offered an opportunity to change into a robe to prevent any hair from falling on  my clothing. I was offered a variety of beverages and waters to suit my palate. It was. A lovely way to start my appointment.  I was seated in a beautiful leather chair under the lovely sparkling chandelier. I only waited a few minutes before my stylist came an so escorted me to my chair, gave met cape and went to town on my head. She did an amazing job, paid attention to the growth patterns in my hair and came out  with a professional and yet edgy cut. The scalp massage before the wash was so relaxing and the hot towel treatment felt fantastic. I would recommend this salon to anyone that needs or wants a new stylist. Although, it is popular, so you'll have to make an appointment. Stop by and try it!

Overall, I had a pretty good experience after getting past the small waiting area and the long wait to see Dr. Jeffrey Wilson.Kim was very friendly and her laid back attitude helped calm me down--I had a new, unfamiliar condition. Doc too was laid back with his ponytail. He listened and didn't make me feel rushed or like a piece of meat.

Ate here on our way back home 5 hours south of Nashville.  After reading the reviews we had high hopes.  The bonuts were the only thing we ordered that were actually pretty good.  The brûléed grapefruit tasted good, for what little grapefruit I could actually dig out.  They could probably go ahead and run a knife around the edge before they brûlée it. It was hard to eat.  Biscuits are flat and flaky- not fluffy at all.  If that's what you like- you'll like this restaurant.

This place rules! A friendly atmosphere with live music and an amazing selection of beer and coffee. The store has an extremely charming aesthetic that makes you feel welcome and comfortable. It's a great place to shop for records, see live music, or grab a drink and a bite to eat.

I live around the corner and haven't taken enough advantage! Taqueria Corona is a super cute and cozy restaurant. There aren't many places like this on Magazine, where you feel like you're eating dinner at home. They have an open kitchen and you can eat at the bar and watch the food being made. 

Get the guacamole to start. Simple and delicious. Chips are thin and crunchy, just the way I like it! I usually get the tacos. Fried fish tacos are my favorite! Not tiny either, two pieces of fish, great flavor. Two tacos easily fill me up. The burritos are MASSIVE. I'm pretty sure anyone who finishes one will be stuffed. Easily shared or taken home for left overs. I tried the tostada for the first time the other day. I really liked it. I love the crunch of the hard shell. The beans and sauce provided enough flavor and juiciness without making the tostada soggy. Don't forget to ask for the hot sauces! They'll bring you a rack of three to choose from. I've enjoyed everything I've had here, including the margaritas. Portions are generous in size and it's super affordable. I'll definitely be coming back!

Ate here several times during our stay at the Atlantis.The service was always exceptional. A basic coffee shop with a small menu that does what they do well.  They are of those coffee shops that does small things to make you feel appreciated. The first was the serving of individual little containers of honey and jelly to go with biscuits and tea. They also melted a container with butter in it to go on your biscuit. The waffle was crisp and delicious and the omelet I had also had a nice mouth feel of crispness.  The real star at the Atlantis is the bakery and the sticky bun we had was truly wonderful. I would have given the place five stars except the corn beef hash they served was canned.  I could have overlooked the canned hash if they had taken the time to grill it  Its a shame a place that strives to do so many little things well couldnet get this one thing right.
customer service is extremely slow very grumpy male manager no one even came when we asked for help at the spray paint isle

I was expecting more from this place especially when it came to the ciders.  There are 6 on draft and I was only feeling 1 of them.  There were more in bottles but most were priced st $18-$22.  I think they were larger bottles but I'm not going to pay for that if I'm not 100% I like it.  They don't have flights but are working on it.  

We had the sausage pizza and the jalapeño poppers and they were good.  The interior is very rustic and warm and they had large tvs.

I would recommend this place but for happy hour or a couple of beers.

This place was awesome lots of awesome food got the steak and white fish and crab cake and crab claws!   The staff is really
On it and was a great time!  Will be back

The food is always fresh and delicious! I've tried almost everything on the menu and never disappointed... Great portions at a great price! This hidden gem should not be missed... Smiley is a delight and lives up to her name!

I didn't know what to expect from this fascinating Ghanaian restaurant on South Dupont Highway.  There is a spacious eating area where we enjoyed some freshly cooked whole fish along with yams, spinach, and spicy fried plantains.  The fish was perfectly prepared with a few lightly sauteed vegetables on top, while the spinach was creamy.  The plantains were so delicious with an unexpected hotness; I asked them to pack the remaining ones displayed in the counter to eat at home.  The staff were very friendly and helpful and I plan to return the next time I am passing through on the way to visit my Dad.
The food is good. The meats are done right and the sides are on point. But I can't give 5 stars due to price, dinner will set you back $15-20 per person.

First it's annoying to have your bill increase in price unexpectedly for no reason. I pay 90 dollars a month just for internet. No cable or additional benefits. Cox will randomly tell you that your price is going up. 
Second, I just got transitioned, without my permission or without any request, to paperless billing. I did not see my bill located now in my email, and missed last months bill. So now I have a late fee that are unwilling to remove. That is a terrible practice. It's dishonest and sneaky. Cox attempts to squeeze as much money out of their clients as possible assuming they have no where else to go. They have no regard or care about their paying members.

I expected more since I enjoy the owners other restaurant (Drunken Fish).  The 4 of us had 4 small plates, 2 salads, 1 soup, a flat bread, a sandwich, and  1 or 2 drinks each for $120.  Not bad compared to some of the other tapas restaurants in town, but the quality of the food at this price point just isn't quite there.  The biggest miss of the night was the oyster shooters.  They were warm, smelled and tasted so fishy, we left two uneaten, and hoped not to get sick.

I was also disappointed that when the manager stopped by.  As I set down my shooter, he asked how we liked things, I said we didn't like the oysters we heard "have you ever eaten oysters before", and "hum, I'll tell the cheff" from the 20 something "manager".  I'm not used to attitude like this in this neighborhood.  Fortunately our waitress was quite charming.

I really would have enjoyed a glass of wine with dinner, but the wine markup is redonkulous.  I refuse to pay $9 a glass for a wine I can by at the grocery store for $10 dollars a bottle.  If a restaurant wants a 4 x markup on their wine they need to find unusual wines people haven't seen before.

Overall, this restaurant is a little proud of it's self, and an ill fit for Westport.
The infamous raising canes! Where people go crazy for their chicken strips and dipping sauces! This location was quick and easy. They had my order in a minute well done!

The food was fantastic and the service impeccable! 

We had the Coconut Shrimp, Spinach Dip, and a Bacon Burger. Everything was cooked and seasoned wonderfully. The dip was so delicious it was had not to over fill. The shrimps were HUGE and full of flavor (I would suggest a jelly sauce as an option for dip), and the burger was cooked to order. 

The waitress was one of the best we had and with the staffs help, our table was cared for perfectly. 

It was a great choice for our 14th anniversary!

This was my first Thanksgiving dinner away from my parents and at a restaurant. What is usually a regular sit down place, was a buffet-style meal for Turkey Day. The setup was still very much formal though. They had a dessert/cheese tray/salad bar area, main entree/side side area and a carving station for turkey and beef. We ordered a bottle of Pinot Noir and then made our way to the salad bar. They had a small array of toppings, like walnuts and such, but the pinnacle was the white balsamic dressing. Holy cow, I need this dressing by the gallon. It was absolutely delicious! I was very happy to see they had vegetarian stuffing in addition to the sausage variety. The sweet potatoes were wonderfully light, sweet and creamy (even better with their orange cranberry sauce on top!) and they offered a decent selection of vegetables to balance out all the carbs. They also had salmon with a coarsely ground mustard sauce, if you weren't a turkey person. Finally, the desserts were the perfect size. I love dessert, but after a large meal, I rarely have room for anything. The individually sized tarts were my favorite. Overall, it was a lovely meal, but I think I would still prefer the traditional home cooked Thanksgiving dinner.

While in town visiting, I needed a jumper to be altered so when I returned home it would be ready for an event. Everyone was super friendly and she clearly explained what she could do to help! My jumper was ready to go a couple days later at an affordable price. My sister is grateful that I've found her a great tailor for future alterations!

I've been here several times, and every time I've had an enjoyable experience. I just wish it were in Center City! I would visit very frequently. Alas, I will just have to keep making the trip out to University City. The restaurant is HUGE and the patio with the fire pits is an amazing oasis in the middle of the city. 

All of the waiters are very knowledgable on their extensive beer/wine list. As someone who likes trying new beers, but doesn't know what to get, I really appreciate their expertise. I always get whatever the recommend and I have never been disappointed. They also are reasonable priced. 

Beyond the alcohol, the food is also quite delicious. They offer a wide selection from pizzas to "craftwiches" to pastas or fish/chicken as entrees. Last time I was there, I order the gnocci which I highly recommend! Even though it's on the smaller side, it definitely worth it!

This is the best Mexican food I've had in Florida. Never have I had a creamy hot sauce, ask for the green, that went so well with a burrito. I got the steak burrito but there are many different vehicles for your wide variety of meats. 

Please eat here if your in the area!

If you ever want to see RREETARDSS AHhh DUhhh at work: just come here. They are close for UberEat clients but open for other drive thru, when I reached to pick up my order the iiiiidioottts who was high as fuddddge actually said "I don't even know  what you got." ‍ laughing  joking all the same time. Hands down to wasting my gas and time. Why do your establishment even hire lazy folks like this that can't even take an order? Oh yeah my food was all over the place. Love to dig my hands in a paper bag hunting for hash browns that was not placed properly in the mini hashbrown  bags. Totally messed up my order. Wrong food, and they can't differentiate the number 1.vs 2.  If you are too lazy to even place an order properly how can I be assure my health is not at risk, because God forbid if these staff have to "clean" for the day. The stupidity is too much for my anxiety, lord please mercy on my soul.

I'm giving this 3 stars because I've ordered from them a total of three times and that's the aver. The service is friendly and I feel like they try. I only have a problem with delivery time I live literally 1/3 red a mile away from this place. I walked here bought a sandwich and walked home once it took all of 20 minutes and I was lolly gagging. Here's the issue. I ordered 3 sandwiches, chips and 3 drinks delivery. It took 45 minutes to deliver which is crazy long for jimmy johns. Once we got the food I had stuff I didn't ask for

Do not waste your money here! $30 for an okay brunch buffet was not worth it. Very limited vegetarian options. Omelets were gross and tasteless. The Jazz band was alright and took about 5 breaks in the 2 hours we were there. So ridiculous. The mimosas were good though and service was great.

They will send you to collections for $38,.00 even though your $380.00 St.
Lukes bill is paid in full.

I think about this pizza at least twice a week. Chain pizza has become a thing in the past the moment I took a bite of this incredible pizza. I always get the meat lovers which includes pepperoni, homemade sausage, and prosciutto.  *chefs kiss*

The wood fire brick oven helps make the crust perfectly chewy and creates those awesome little burnt bubbles. The oven itself is a thing of beauty and really is the main show. 

I've also had their gellato (fantastic) and their cannoli's (also incredibly tasty). 

So if you are looking for some authentic Italian pizza, come here! One bite and you're hooked.

If you're looking for a quick, filling bite when in West Philly, this is one of the best places for you - especially for a University student. This place is located in-between a 'green food' restaurant and a Chipotle... And while the green food sounds interesting (I'll be trying it the next time I'm in Philly), I encourage anyone stuck between the Chipotle and Burgers to walk the road less traveled. Its burgers are not the type displayed in Burger King or White Castle, and actually taste genuine - white bread, a square of juicy meat, and any of a list of toppings. Even better yet, you're given the option between beef, turkey, and (I believe) pork, and moreover the rarity of the meat. 

The restaurant also has an smooth ambience, similar to that of a jazzy cafe... But the music was very quiet, unnoticeable even. The people inside were spread around nicely through the seats, leaving room for newcomers. The lighting within was dimmed but smooth, and the room was bright with the sunlight streaming in from the glass entrance.

There would be two flaws from making this my own food 'palace'. One is the price. Each burger is almost $9, and that does not include a side or a drink. Water and soft drinks are both $2, a little on the pricey side. Then again, it may be a great price for others, especially in the city. The other fault I find with the restaurant is with the meat. The first bites of my beef burger were wonderful... But the grease and oil on the meat, dripping a puddle onto the plate were not quite appealing.

I've frequently driven down Alvernon and seen Nimbus and the neat artwork on the building, but never really known how to get there. I have heard good things about it so I decided it was time to venture over. It ended up being not as tricky as I thought it would be, but my GPS did try to get me lost so I recommend you know the generally vicinity of the building so you can navigate your way. 

I got there around 7PM on a Saturday and the doorman told me it was a $5 cover charge, which vaguely, kind of annoyed me. He could tell I was annoyed by it considering I was there to eat and drink, so he waived the fee for me and my husband. Once we got in we realized there was a live band and I felt like a jerk, so we ended up giving them $10 dollars. To my surprise, I actually really enjoyed the band! One of my favorite parts was when the lead guitarist wished his 84 year old mother a happy birthday and she came up and rocked out with him. Way to go mama! I know this is besides the point, but I loved the laid back and welcoming feel of the atmosphere for all ages. Definitely a place to sit back and relax.

Now on to the food and drink. Neither disappointed. I got the blonde beer and it was definitely different from any other blonde I'd ever had, but I enjoyed it. Along with that I had the turkey pesto sandwich with cole slaw and was surprised how healthy it all tasted considering it's was bar food. My husband had the monkey shine to drink and a burger and fries to go with it. He was pleased with both and we were surprised how fast they got our food out to us. 

The only downside to this place is that it was really hot inside. It was a little confusing. They had ceiling fans running everywhere, but there was a big door that was left wide open, so not only did it make it hot, but also humid from the monsoon rain. We figured they had some sort of air conditioner or swamp cooler to keep the beer stills at a decent temperature, but it wasn't really doing much. We ended up leaving because my husband was too uncomfortable with the heat. Other than that it was a good experience.
Really friendly staff. Wendy was very sweet and helpful with recommendations. Food is always great.
Still outstanding quality sophisticated cooking which is healthy filling and attractive.

Awesome food, service, and overall atmosphere. Great menu selection. A little pricey but worth it. 

My friends and I came here after dining at a nearby restaurant that left us quite hungry. We probably looked confused but the staff was awesome. They explained the menu and led us to the best spot which was upstairs on their patio. It had such a lovely view of Frenchman Street. 

My friends and I ordered hot dogs to share. We got the Crawfish Sausage Dog, The Chicago Dog, and the Guinness Dog as well as a selection or tots because we just had to try them.

Let's just say that we were very pleased with everything at Dat Dog and it is now in my book of places to eat.

Yes there was a wait. Only took us a half hour to get in and order and the food came up pretty fast. The chicken is great and so were the sides but I have to say the servers made the trip awesome. These people hustle in this fast paced restaurant but everyone is so kind. Wish I would have gotten your names for a special shout out but if I were to guess the entire team all seems  like very nice people. Thank you Hattie B's!

If you are looking for "healthyish" food on the go, this is your spot. Come here to eat actual REAL food; not some frozen nonsense with a bunch of preservatives. What I like about True Food Kitchen is that they cater to all kinds of diets-vegans, vegetarians, my gluten free peeps, paleo, carnivores like myself, etc. I've been here several times pre-covid and presently, and I must say they remain consistent. They are extremely clean and my food is always fresh. Some of my favorite dishes include:

-Herb Hummus (Super yummy)
-Tuscan Kale Salad
-Korean Noodle Bowl (A MUST!!)
-Kid's chicken teriyaki bowl (Delicious and its a heaping portion!! Enough for an adult.)

They are a little pricey, but you pay for what you get. Also, they do deliver using door dash! Don't forget to download the app, as the loyalty points do add up quick.

So after tonight I will not eat here ever again. My husband ordered crusted tilapia and when we got it, it was raw! If was bleeding and still clear. It also had a noticeable odor coming from it.
