We had to flag down a manager and show it to her. She could have cared less. She took only that off our bill and walked away and never came back.

We also asked for the kitchen manager. He let us know he already knew. So if you knew why wouldn't you make it a point to come to our table?! Yeah okay. 

I will be calling the health department Monday morning and sending them the pictures we took.

Please check your food before you eat it here!!

I took my dog in because he had lost his appetite and was jaundice. They did blood work, a urine sample and an IV. The vet insisted that we do a $200 blood test which was negative and took 4 days to receive back. My dog passed away before the week was out and no one has still called and asked about the well being of my dog but called to collect the rest of the payment. My coworkers dog had the same symptoms and she took her dog to a different vet and after 2 days her dog was back to normal and she only paid $125.00 they should really be ashamed. The total cost was $710.00 and for what just robbers.

Gave this place a second chance when my parents were in town and boy was it a mistake, the fact that there is never a wait should be a sign in itself, our server was absolutely miserable, fajita's we're ordered however they don't come with any sort of cheese, when I asked for cheese I was billed an additional 99 cents, their portions are small, the carnitas that my father ordered weren't cut up they were just huge chunks fit for a dog, we were all laughing at the table because it was that funny.  Never again.. Do not go here border Cafe around the corner is worth the wait trust me..

A few family members were in Philly visiting my cousin, and she suggested we try "the best gelato EVER." She wasn't kidding! Capogiro is the real deal. Unless you're in Italy, this place can't be beat!

This place has a pretty cool yet terrifying aesthetic. I love the veggie sharwma wrap and at a great price. There are very limited places to sit, but their service is quick and the servings are huge, so it's nice to pick up on the way to something else. Nice for vegetarians, vegans, and non-vegetarians alike.

Met up with a gf here for a coffee and a visit (neither of us have kids) ALL THE VEGAN THINGS the food was amazing my cappuccino was so tasty! They had tons of gluten free options also. They have 2 sides 1 side is a cafe the other side is a play area for wee ones. This place is ridiculously clean, beautifully decorated and very has great zen energy. Check out all the fun stations and stuff for kids to play with AND they have an area in the back that people can rent for private get togethers!

Nothing to write home about. Cool atmosphere but the food is ordinary at best (the menu is very bizarre) and the drinks are expensive. Service was also sub par. I feel like this place tried too hard to be unique and failed.

So glad I found Sierra! My blonde color turned out perfectly, cut is beautiful. Sierra asked a lot of questions about my hair before starting. Also great to be in a suite with just the stylist vs a busy, loud salon. Can't wait to return!

Rachel is amazing. I made it a point to try to find someone with experience with Asian makeup and hair, and she was really knowledgeable. She did a great job making things look as natural as possible, staying true to how I usually do my makeup. Loved the time and attention to detail that she gave me during the makeup trial. She was good at making sure i had exactly what I needed on the day of. My mom and mother-in-law also really enjoyed having her do their makeup. She is really talented, not only with these one-on-one sessions, but also with teaching students to learn bridal makeup and created a certification program for this! We were all really impressed by her and loved her dedication. HIRE HER!

Hotel: we took a quick escape from Laguna Beach last minute on Friday. Got lucky and snagged a little bungalow at El Encanto. Upon pulling up the valet seemed over whelmed but I think they were dealing with hotel and restaurant patrons at the same time. Beautiful grounds with a heated pool overlooking Santa Barbara. Decided to slowly make our way back through the buildings checking out the hammocks, wishing well and views on the way.

Well appointed room with a huge tub, perfect for soaking after a long drive. Heated floors in the bathrooms, my only request would have been to have two electrical outlets instead of one. I know first world female issues, but we need power to get our hair pretty for dinner at the onsite steakhouse! All was redeemed the next morning though. A quick call to housekeeping and it honestly took less then one minute to get a pile of warm fluffy towels. Considering the grounds are sprawling that guy must have been hustling! 5 stars for the hotel

For delivery, ordered Summer Rolls, Spring Rolls, Sprout Noodle and Mi Ka Teng (spicy). 

Summer rolls and spring rolls both came with pork. My wife and I do not eat pork. There was no indication on the menu that pork came in either of these dishes, nor do these dishes come with pork at any other restaurant that sells them in our experience, be it Cambodian, Thai, Vietnamese, Chinese, etc. So our appetizers fed no one but the trash. 

My Sprout noodle was rather flavorless, but I didn't order it spicy anyhow, and it was kind of unique I guess so i wasn't entirely displeased. I just doused it in sriracha and it tasted good. 

My wife's Mi Ka Teng (ordered spicy) was as flavorless as mine was. 

Couldn't eat 1/3 of what we paid for due to lazy menu posting by this restaurant. Won't be ordering again.

Impressive operation front to back. Food is outstanding. If you have to wait for a table, do it. The wait is worthwhile.

I had brunch on a busy hot Saturday afternoon. The table shared a Dutch-baby with blue berries and lemon curd. YUM. I had the Tom-lette with amazing potato latkes (these are your typical latkes), coffee cake muffin and applesauce. It was unique, perfectly balanced and memorable.
must come to nifty fifty and to get milkshakes and fries. Hand cut fries are great. I gave it 4 stars because it is so far away to come all the way up here and eat

Food is really well done, obviously they care about quality. There's enough new Orleans stuff in here to warrant something a little southern. My pitch: a beignets with cream cheese icing instead of powdered sugar. You call it the Beign Franklin.  So happy this place is doing well. Will be back.

Great guys, great service, reasonably priced. Every time I've had an issue with my car they've taken care of it expediently and well. Not only that, they have price checked against other shops in the area so I could make a well-informed decision about what to do.

Right from when we walked in to when we got the keys and left Sammy the manager made the experience so much better!! Fast service and great customer service very highly recommend! Thank you Brake Masters!!

This Starbucks was okay. It was crowded but I was still able to get my work done. I ordered a hot chocolate with whipped cream and it was delicious. Can't really go wrong with that. I was there until closing and towards the end of the night the staff was a little loud behind the counter. I do understand that it's the end of the night but I feel like Starbucks is supposed to be a semi-tranquil place to get stuff done. I put my headphones in and it was fine but I don't think I should've had to do that. Everything else about this Starbucks is just like the rest. Can't really go too wrong with a Starbucks. Parking is crazy, though. Definitely not enough for the amount of people that go here.

Dropped in on a Sunday on our way back to Northbrook from Branson. We sat at a window seat - lovely for people watching and sipping on very good bloody-marys. 

There was a bartender and a waitress. They were very friendly and attentive. There were a few other customers that came and went through out our visit.

The menu was slight. I settled for a chicken sandwich that was average - it had okay flavor. My husband had cheesy shrimp grits - they were well done. 

I nice little place to hang with friends while enjoying a drink.

was concerned when they couldn't seat us -845 reservation, seated at 9:15. They handled it very well and sent out some appetizers courtesy of the chef. Food is excellent. Nice cocktail menu. Awesome service. Just off Broadway so you don't feel like you are in a tourist spot but also close enough to get your honky tonk on after dinner! Really fun vibe and cool decor. Deviled eggs. Great oyster selection of course.

If I can give this a negative 10, I would. This is the last time I will ever shop at Walmart. I will go to target and pay way more at this point. I do not care. I ordered something online, I call on the outside pickup, they make me come in to get it, which I do. I wait 15 minutes for my purchase and then they do not even help me bring it outside. it was a very heavy for me to lift. Then, I had to wait for a cart because there were not any available. When a cart finally became available, they gave it to somebody else even though I was clearly waiting for at least 15 to 20 minutes altogether for an online order. Not sure how this helps with Covid, when you still have to go inside to pick up online orders. My Last experience at Walmart I asked three people to help me, none of them could help me. They had to page somebody from a different department three separate times and still nobody came to help me. If you work at Walmart you should be able to help meNo matter what department you're in and if you can't, then I expect you to make sure somebody from another department actually comes to help me. this is the worst customer serious service I have ever experienced in my entire life and it happened at Walmart on numerous occasions.  When you work at a business, any business, your job is to help the paying customer. I work in customer service and we daily go above and beyond for our paying clients because that is our job. Walmart never does this for me and I am sick and tired of it to the point where I am writing this review and I am not the type of person to get this upset. well you did it for me thank you, Walmart!

This store is pretty organized everytime Ive stopped by. I would say I stop by every 2-3 months. Have petites which is a plus. Sales section is well kept. My size seems to run out fast XXS to XS but I think thats the norm.  Ann Taylors are disappearing. My favorite and go to flagship store in Manhattan closed. It was a huge bummer. Glad to see this one is still open.

Terrible service. This is my first time here. I have already sat for an hour and a half and never received my food, but half my table has (well over an hour after we ordered). Our drinks are empty.  I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.

The famous NJ tomato pie has come to Bucks County!! 
Yes!! This is third generation DeLorenzo!! Before you all say it isn't, Tyler, the owner,  is the grandson of Big Rick. Yes they are building one in Yardley that is the Hudson St. family. That is a second generation just building another restaurant. This is not the DeLorenzo's on Trenton Rd. Just to clarify that. Lol  We had the clam pie. Absolutely amazing!!! The clam and garlic flavor together were heaven to my tastebuds!!! We shared the large mixed salad with the homemade balsamic dressing. It was absolutely amazing!  It was the perfect portion for sharing. Our waiter was magnificent!! I am so sorry I do not remember his name. We spent a lot of time chatting with him. He is young but has worked for the family for many years. He is very knowledgeable about the history of the family. My only wish is that they offer fresh brewed iced tea. Sadly they do not. They are a BYOB. I definitely recommend this restaurant!!! We will definitely be going back!!!

Went to Mavis Tire on way from airport with rental car, due to low tire pressure, just what I needed at start of trip. Pulled in and spoke with Jim, stated there were about 4 or 5 cars ahead of me and would be about an hour or so. Must have seen the look of despair on my face, said wait a minute, came back said give me your keys, took car and found a nail in the tire, plugged it and didn't charge me, just said give the fella that fixed it a tip. I was on my way within 20 minutes. Will definitely go here for service when I have my personal car as I am moving to this area.

Heard so many people recommend this place but the staff was so rude. I know they're popular and busy but they can definitely treat customers better instead of leaving them 20 minutes on the table without water and no one even come say hi.

To the owner's reply: just pretend you guys care. It's easy to write on yelp say "I'm sorry" but when I complain to your manager on spot, he just says "you can always leave if you're not happy". Lmao

What a wonderful place!  The staff was wonderful.  Each person we ran into was pleasant and personable.  Unfortunately, you don't find that everywhere today.  I was also impressed how clean the park was with attendants constantly sweeping and wiping up.

What a joy it was to spend the day here.  We weren't sure if our one son would be too old at 11, but both boys had a blast.   It was a perfect day trip.

Best Bakery in New Orleans. I finally arrived when they opened last week at 6:00 am and had a spiritual experience with a fresh out of the oven croissant.  
This place is amazingly great! Everything is freshly baked that day and the workers are all kind and courteous.  I go here twice a week and have never been disappointed. 
Order the quiche Florentine and a croissant. You won't be disappointed!
Amazing food and amazing service!! Everyone was so nice and genuine. Definitely going to be back very soon
Awesome barbershop!   Junior followed the direction what I wanted and he made the great hair!  I will def come back again.

SIMPLY THE BEST CHINESE FOOD IN THE CITY!  I order from them at least 2 a month via Seamless.  The gen t. chicken is great, as is the walnut shrimp.  Everything else is AMAZING TOO!

VERY affordable, generous portions, quick delivery!

Everything you get from here is fresh and tastes amazing. I got a Poor Boy today during my visit and it was as usual,  great. Their prices are about what Subway is with a bag of chips but the taste is 100% better. If I could, I would eat here everyday.

I have been dealing with Courtesy Nissan for almost 2 years now, and after having repeated transmission and transmission-related issues, I will be taking it for a second opinion before I give them any more of my money. I no longer trust their ability to legitimately fix my problem. At this point, I'm not sure if they know what the issue is, or if they're guessing. My car is on it's 3rd transmission total (2nd in a year), and I keep having transmission hose leaks that result in my transmission slipping. After replacing one hose for $262, I am now told that a different transmission hose is leaking and will cost $76. I will be having that diagnosis verified elsewhere before I pay.

You'll find this store to offer a cleanly relaxing shopping experience whatever day of the week.  I've visited 4 Kohl's in Nevada from Henderson to Reno and can say this one is just like the rest.

 As you enter you'll feel two things, a cool breeze of ther air conditioned environment and a panoramic view of clothes to fit a variety of occasions.  They carry a very consistent brand image and offer the same experience at any of their locations. Clean dressing rooms and clean bathrooms facilities at a modest price.  

My visit recently brought me to their shoe department. A young girl named Kaitlyn helped me find just what I was looking for and went out of her way to accommodate my needs. She even called the Kohls off Pyramid to see if they had my size shoe in stock will definitely be returning. 

P.S.  If your creative u can find clothes at bargin.

I could not give it "0".. it does not even deserve zero. Some of you called it the ghetto. It's a lot worse than ghetto. They need to tear this place down and start all over again.

NOTHING WORKED

We had to stay there as we were part of a large group of artists. Boy was it a tragedy. If you've ever seen the movie 
            My Cousin Vinny 
where the train goes all night honking... this was exactly it. Even though we were booked for 3 nights we stayed one night and got out of there. Sleep in your car but don't take a room in this hotel oops sorry dump.
We have the pizza and mussels weekly! I was a loyal mussels marinara eater until I tried Il Giardino's white garlic mussels...now we have to get both! Great place, great food!

This is our first visit since the great pandemic visited Tucson.  We have been there twice in the last two weeks and while I would like to give four stars I will stand on three for now.  We ate outside on the patio for the first time.  Much better ambiance than inside.  I would give an extra half-star to be outside.  Back to the food.  Overall the quality seemed down since last year.  While we had multiple items on our two visits I will only address several.  My chimichanga seemed short changed on the green chile verde filling but it was tasty.  The wife's chili rellano was a disappointment.  The rice was typical Tucson, not inspired.  The beans were tastly but the portion barely 1/4 thick.  Beans are cheap guys!  Since our last visit they now charge for chips and salsa which was a surprise but evidently this is becoming a Tucson standard  practice.  What a shame. The portion was acceptable and the chips tasty.  We will probably be back but  hope the old standards return.

I went in for the first time to use an extra large washer.  I needed help finding it and using it.  Monica the attendant was so helpful and friendly.  She showed me everything I needed.  I left for a nail appt. and when I returned she had taken the item out for me and held it until I came back.  The place was very clean too.  I recommend it for your laundry needs.

I went there last night and heard Eric Gales with the BB King All Stars. It was like the best music experience off my life. Eric Gales was phenomenal  it was crazy good. I had spent all day at jazz fest and my experience at BB Kings exceeded anything I saw all day. Thank you BB Kings. I will be back.

This place was great!  Both my best friend and I went in and had Flex as our artist.  He was great!  He was patient and designed a beautiful tattoo for me!  Couldn't have been more pleased!  Definitely recommend this place!

Delicious barbecue!  Huge portion sizes and the smells are amazing the minute you walk in the door.  Friendly and very attentive wait staff.   We are here visiting and vacationing and if I happen to find myself in Boise again,  will have to make a stop here for dinner.  Prices are very reasonable, less than $40 for two people.
employees turned me around and did not help me with return process whatsoever extremely rude workers but have nice fish

We went in last Wednesday and sat at the bar, and we were attended to right away. The bartender's name was Kier and he was great. We told him that we like IPA's and he let us sample a few different varieties. The selection of local and other craft brews from around the country was phenomenal. I had a pint of the Jai Alai from Cigar city and an IPA from 7th Sun (who  was a great recommendation from Kier) which apparently is brewed just down the street in Dunedin. We started with a margaretta flatbread pizza which was so good we ordered the Hawaiian. We also had the porkbelly sliders and the mojito scallops which were delicious and fresh (all the seafood comes from Frenchy's, who is also part owner we found out). Overall outstanding service and delicious food. Make sure to stop in next time you are in Dunedin, can't wait to go back.

My hub's has been wanting to come here for months.  We were out about and he pulled in and said, today's the day!  We walked in, only one other couple inside, we were greeted and told to sit where we wanted. Haven't been in since it was Benton Park Cafe, the place was totally different. Really cute. Seemed to have more seating.  Loved the ceiling murals.  It was bright and colorful.  The menu isn't big, but there's plenty to chose from. Some apps, salads, paninis and pizza.  The bar is nice, looks well stocked.  Sam was our bartender and waiter.  Nice and informative.  We kept it simple, ordered a couple Caesar salads and a couple pizzas.  I did order a cocktail, the Pink Italian lemonade.  It was ok, but I wouldn't get it again. The Caesar's were good, on the smaller side, but had a good dressing.  The pizza's were wonderful!  Hand tossed, crust had crunchy edges, but chewy too with a great flavor.  We tried the Momma's Meatball and the Sazizza.  (It's how they spelled it.).  I noticed they also have a Yelp check in special, a free gelato, so we did that as well.  You get two scoops and we chose the Strawberry and the Chocolate Hazelnut.  I've had much better gelato, but it was ok.  All in all it was a great experience.  We left full and have some leftovers!!  They are working on their website and are revamping their Wine Dinners that sound amazing!!  We'll be back!!

This is my favorite Norstroms I've been to and I've been to several. The customer service is excellent. I work with Mimi who is a stylist/personal shopper. She's always been super helpful with finding the right outfit for certain occasions. The makeup department ladies are great to. Everyone always goes out of their way to make my experience a great one.

They will redirect your UPS package without any notification. I spoke with UpS and was told that this location only accepts up to 10 packages, then sends the rest to another office. I had a package specifically redirected here. They sent it to another office without updating the tracking or notifying me through MyUPS.

Love this place. Only problem is once you go here you can never go back to other theaters. 
1- totally reclining comfy chairs 
2- awesome staff 
3- 1/2 priced drinks and apps after 9
4- food and drinks DELIVERED to your seat throughout the movie
5- adult friendly 
#onceyougoroadhouseyounevergoback
Dining at Tommy's is well worth the flight from Colorado to eat here.  Our Uber driver made the recommendation and said it is it was his favorite place to eat.  Spot on!

Dirt Stripper is a self-serve 24/7 car wash on Crawfordsville Road. We chose the standard automated car wash which is just 9 bucks. It does a nice good and easy enough to use with card or cash. They also have spray bays car washes for those of you who hand wash.  Vacuum machines are directly behind the car wash.

My car was COVERED in Bradford Pear buds and starting to dry which means their like glue. The car wash removed all. Now of course, it started rainy again 1/2 hr. later but at least my car was free of tree buds. If you're in the area, give it a try sometime.
Best damn Tiki Bar in NO. The drinks are all hand made by expert mixologist.  Don't settle for street auto-blender drinks.  Come get a real drink!

If you got the coupon on your magazine don't use at least you have 10-15 min spare time to wait until the owner approves it.,  

My second dissatisfaction goes  to the lack of refills for fresh coffee very relate to the bad customer service. 

Last but not least my food was advertised with fresh fruit as a side and I got rotten pieces of cantaloupes. 

I know this place can do better and hopefully they will to serve us better to the neighborhood .

Loved the coffee. This was my first time having a draft latte. I guess I'm late to the party. Awesome building, too. While waiting for my drinks and food, I watched baristas; the cooks working the big fancy, copper oven; and someone doing some baking in the back behind the roasters. The bread was also stand out.

The cleanest laundromat I have ever been in. Outstanding customer service. She told me which machines are better than others. Thankfully taking the mystery out of the which machine actually works game. The washers and dryers work great and are very fast. Highly recommend if you need to do a quick load. Different sizes of both washers and dryers was very nice.

Dear Newk's,

Thank you for all of the brown, slimy, rotting lettuce in the Caesar salad I ordered today. 

Signed,
Someone who is not ordering from Newk's again.

I had a wonderful experience here. The place was completely clean, all of the workers were extremely professional, and I felt very at home! I took my car here to get a last-minute oil change before a trip after being denied from my normal place because of schedule. They also took the time to look at my car's overall health and ended up recommending $1700 worth of repairs and maintenance (spark plugs, coolant, brakes, engine timing belt) that I thought was probably a racket, but when I brought it in to my normal guys they confirmed that Big Bend Auto had gotten it right. My normal guys quoted me a cheaper price of $1100 but I think I got a family/friend's discount. Overall, would recommend. Thanks big bend auto!

yum yum yum....have had the joy of eating here on 3 seperate trips to NOLA lunch and dinner and we always leave stuffed, happy and satisfied.  Yes there is usually a wait outside the door, but the line moves and it's worth it.  Suggest the gumbo, crab cakes and well just about everything-enjoy!

Dreadful. Got take out on a Sunday early evening. Naan were flat and undercooked. Lamb Rogan Josh was drown in oil (see how much I spooned out in the attached pic.) Also tasteless and the lamb was as tough as old boots. Matar Paneer - horrible - peas undercooked and generally tasteless. It's a shame because this place was a five star gem when it opened a few years ago. But this and the last meal we had were really dreadful. We wouldn't be trying again.

Matt and his team are beyond exceptional. I've worked with literally hundreds of lenders in my career as a Broker, and Matt's service delivery, exceptional knowledge, and ability to work with our clients in a way that leaves them with peace of mind are far above the rest. And, at PNC, he's able to be ultra competitive on rates and pricing. :-)  We've consistently referred him to all kinds of different clients, and every single one has been SUPER happy with him. Not only that, I've also worked with Matt first-hand on my own mortgage and the experience was awesome!

Had lunch here and we ordered the broccoli beef and the sweet and sour. Both dishes were delicious. The fried rice wasn't my favorite, but the egg drop soup and the egg rolls were delicious and super hot. The building is a little shabby but the food is good.

(4.5) ~ Very Good ~ Overall (Food & Service)  NOTES: There's plenty of Parking in the back and they do take Credit Cards(MC & Visa).  It's VERY CASUAL with Styrofoam Cups & Plastic Spoons, but it's worth it, b/k the food is VERY GOOD.  Many of the patrons are Indians, which is a good sign of the authenticity of the food.  The TV's are always showing Bollywood Programs too:-)

DINING NOTES: This is Southern Indian Cuisine, which emphasizes more Vegetarian Items than the more common Northern Indian Cuisine.  Don't worry "Carnivores" they still serve MEAT dishes;-)  The Lamb Biriyani is a very good substitute for Lamb Vindaloo fans and I actually think it tastes better:-)

MENU
** Mango Lassi = (4.5) Very Good
** Lamb Biriyani = (4.5) Very Good
** Rasmalai (dessert) = (4.5) Very Good
** Onion/Chilli Uthappam = (4) very good; came with (3) sauces
* Onion Dosa = (3.5) good; came with (3) sauces.
* Indian Chai = (3.5) good

Best sit down chicken sandwich in town. Be prepared to eat when you go here. The meal and sides are all huge and heavy, but everything is always flavorful. The bar/patio is great if you just want a few drinks with friends. Go early to get a spot, it gets pack quick and they don't take reservations.

Well my favorite is when i went to see sex and the city..... and the movie had no sound everyone was shouting turn up the volume..thay never did..than about 10 mins in some one came into the theater and said the same movie was just starting in theater 11 so everyone got up and ran down the hall to theater 11 ......awesome!

My friend Liz turned me on to Capital Tacos more than a year ago. She lives in LOL and always raved about it. One day, we went for it. We have been back at least once a month since then. We drive from Oldsmar area to Land O Lakes on a regular basis for tacos. And we don't mind one bit.

So, almost every time I have been there, it is mobbed busy. Since the Wesley Chapel location opened, it's still busy, but not like it was when getting a table was like an Olympic Sport. Inside, there are a handful of tables, outside there are 6 or so tables, so when it's busy, may the odds be ever in your favor. You walk in and head back to the ordering booth, grab a beer or soda from the cooler and place your order. You can order any of the fillings in a taco, burrito, nachos or a bowl. Once you've ordered, you get a little license plate tag, for example, ALABAMA. When you hear them yell out ALABAMA, go pick up your order from the window. The decor is awesome, rustic and simple. They have a soda machine, of sugar cane sweetened sodas. I appreciate this thoughtful touch, as well as the eco-friendly dinner ware. 

The food is just damned good. That's all there is to it. This is not Chili's or a Tex-mex cantina, where all the food is bland and greasy and in desperate need of salsa or a hot sauce to make it interesting. The flavors are complex, with high quality ingredients and creative twists on traditional flavors and techniques. There is a reason people rave about this place, and it's the food.  It's approachable, affordable and freaking delicious. I hope the next branch opens up on the west side of town, but until then, I'll keep on making the drive! #KeepItCapital

After reading a bunch of reviews about it I was super excited to try it but it just didn't hit the spot like I thought it would. :( 

Chicken was kind of dry and the hotness to it was a bit weird tasting.
Really good bahn mi, didn't get to try the wine or any of these selections but has a very cute vibe.
Delicious unique comfort food (grilled scallop salad with fresh avocado) that will entice your crea8tive side and leave you wanting more.....

A friend and I arrived right on time, 8AM for the posted hours. Only to find out they actually open at 9AM, despite the house on the FRONT door saying 8am. We waited an hour in the heat until they did open. The hostess quickly informed us this was a cash only (what?!) and they also would not split our bill? So how are people who are paying separately split their cash, who's carrying ones around? Super irritated but decided to stay since by this time we've been waiting over an hour. 

Waitress was looking super frazzled even though they had literally just opened, not even long enough to be overwhelmed yet. Never came by our table other then when she initially took our order. I had to get up to get sugar for my coffee and condiments, because I got tired of waiting. 

Overall food was okay, but not worth all the drama that came with. Cheesy hashbrowns were awful, dried hockey pucks. Will not be returning.

Been here three times and never disappointed. Here's what I've had, in descending order of tastiness (but they were all delicious):  Sweet and sour pork, cumin lamb, hot crispy fish, sizzling eggplant, vegetables with special sauce (appetizer), korean short rib skewer.  The hot crispy fish looks intimidatingly hot, with all the peppers covering it, but it was just right for me (although too spicy for my spouse).  And surprisingly, the leftovers were good the next day.  Can't wait to go back and try more new things ... bok choy in garlic sauce looks good.

So hungry after a day riding and trekking around Santa Barbara that I forgot to take a picture! Sorry Yelpers! But I can definitely recommend SBCR. The sushi looked beautiful, as did the cocktails. Lots of sushi and ramen options from which to choose, including vegetarian and vegan. Service was good, attentive but not bothersome.

The Boulevard in St. Louis is one of my favorite areas, but with the new addition of Nadoz Wine Bar, it has moved up even higher on my list!  The wines are outstanding, and the waiter was patient and allowed us to taste several before deciding on the perfect wine!  We had a cheese plate with our wine, and it was wonderful as well.  This will probably be a place I visit often when I need a break from shopping, or just some time to unwind with friends.

Charity is a cool art deco style building. There is really no experience like the waiting room on a weekend night. That being said, it has been closed, with no real hope of opening, since Katrina. 

I hope they don't tear it down. If someone had an assload of money, they could probably make it into some cool condos.

I've been staying in Philadelphia for a month on business and because of some last minute scheduling, we found the city hotels booked during the week of graduation.  One of my team found the Alexander Inn on the 'net and they had some limited availability for us.   
Just like the other reviews, the Alexander Inn is fantastic.  It's a charming building in the middle of Center City, surrounded by great streets with restaurants, coffee-houses, and some local bars.  The hotel itself was as charming inside as out and the staff was tremendously friendly and helpful.  I was in a larger room with two queen size beds and beautiful bow windows looking out over the city.  Everything was fresh and clean and quiet and I've slept great during my stay.  This Inn is highly recommended if you're staying over in Philadelphia and would be a great part of any trip.

Holy smokes!!! You have got to try this place if your are in the area!!!! The staff was super friendly, attentive, and the location is really cool. You can watch them make the biscuits from scratch while you eat. And the food is ridiculously good. I got the brisket biscuit, loaded hash browns, and pop tart. By no means did I intend to eat it all but suddenly it was gone. I even had to take some fresh biscuits with me for later. Check this place out!!!!

Been coming here for years!! My favorite place to relax!!!  Good selection, great locals, lots of choices, beets on tap and plenty of room to spread out. Came here to work undisturbed and got a lot done!!!
SUCH A BAD SUBWAY. the workers were so rude to me that they made me cry. on top of that there were pieces of meat in my subway even though i'm a vegetarian. horrible.

I went to The Diamond Family when I was looking for an engagement ring for my girlfriend.  They were very nice to me each time I came in; they listened to me, they gave me something to drink, and they just did a fantastic job overall.  They had a good selection of rings and loose diamonds, and they offered to get more, if you found something else that you wanted.  Their rings and the loose diamonds were competitively priced, and I really liked some of the extras that went along with buying a ring from them.  For example, they give you a bottle of wine or champagne with you and your fiance's name on it if you get an engagement ring there.  Also, they have this deal that if it rains [fairly heavily?] on your wedding day, they will refund [most of or all of, depending on cost] the cost of the engagement ring you got from them.  I think it is a family run business, which I thought was nice.  I did not end up buying from them, but that decision had nothing to do with my experience at that store.  I'd highly recommend them if you are looking for such a ring.

Don't bother. My friend and I went New Year's Eve day at lunch and were wanting to get some items from the Happy Hour menu. Well, the owner decided it was a holiday and the only menu available was the dinner menu. More expensive and no Happy Hour specials. We ordered Shrimp and Vegetable Tempura to share and I got a Spicy Tuna Roll. The server that brought my sushi did not bother to give me a dipping bowl for my soy sauce. The Tempura had 4 shrimp and maybe 7 or 8 pieces of vegetables. The Tempura was just okay. A bit of a small serving for $10.00. The place was mostly empty. Our server was wearing a totally filthy food and grease covered red tie. Looked like it took weeks to get that funky. Ewww! Very unappetizing. That made me wonder about the cleanliness of the whole establishment. I won't go there again.
New location. Still a great steak. Pepperoni wiz wit. Can't go wrong. Eat two and you'll feel better about yourself afterwards.

This place was a fantastic all around experience. A small but cozy little place with a very modern look to it. Service was fantastic. Although it is pricey, it was well worth it. They have a course option where you can sample multiple dishes for a flat rate, which I highly recommend since their menu has so many great dishes to offer. Wine choice was great too! They also have patio seating out front during the summer. I can't wait to go back!

This no frills donut shop doesn't have anything  fancy but you can still choose from the standard glazed, twists, fritters, and cake donuts. 

I normally go for glazed with a new donut shop because if a place doesn't do those well...well, there's no point in trying anything else. 

However, here the glazed looked tired. Since I was already inside I asked for a cinnamon twist. Good choice. It had plenty of cinnamon taste and a nice sugar glaze. 

This is take-out only: No tables or booths available.

This came highly recommended for our trip to NOLA due to vegan/vegetarian options and it did not disappoint!! What you quickly learn when in the Quarter is that Bourbon street is crazy (given) and most food establishments close at 2am. This lovely find is located on Frenchmen's and is open until 4AM!!! Frenchmen's is like the "local's bourbon street". There is still live music and the street is full of drunks but it's more enjoyable and with late joints like this place it's a must visit if you go.

Anywho, we visited for lunch since we were down in the open air market and this was nearby. You can't miss the large "13" sign on the outside of the building, once inside the building it transforms into a little hipster, art deco, eclectic joint. Its a typical shotgun-style house with a bar immediately to your right featuring local beers on tap as well as their boozy Irish coffee maker and the rest of the restaurant is comprised of metal high tops or metal rimmed tables with bright red chairs. The tables have various old movie poster pictures plastered all over them and the simple paper menu sits in the middle with your condiments.

It was pretty quiet the day we came, probably because everyone was probably still hungover from Halloween, but our server was also the bartender and took very good care of the guests he did have. We were told to get the tachos on our trip and our server recommended them as well. I ordered the BBQ tofu and the hubs ordered the classic philly. You can add a side for 2.25 or the tachos appetizer for 7.25....DO NOT GET A SIDE WITH YOUR SANDWICH GET THE TACHOS -you're welcome. We ordered the original tachos which are vegetarian and can be made vegan - chili, cheese, black beans and jalapenos coat a hearty order of tater tots making it a super hearty side. AMAZINGNESS. The food came out quick and was piping hot. All of the portions are massive and while we had plans to grab a boozy shake to go we couldn't even finish what we ordered and didn't want to be miserable for the next 3 hours. I would say both sandwiches were easily 10" and stuffed to the brim with fillings. Not only were not only huge but more importantly they had great flavor. Grab extra napkins because it's going to get messy!!!

My pals Mike Oeming and Bryan Glass (creators of the comic MICE TEMPLAR) signed here and I came in to visit them during that event a few years ago.  The staff suggested drinks at one of my fave bars, Sugar Moms, after the signing and I knew I had found my new LCS. 

Always helpful staff, they will help you find the book you're looking for and not at all pretentious like some other comic shops can be.  A great selection of comics (indie and mainstream), graphic novels and collectibles.  They have some DARTH MAUL swag that I've never seen which is no small feat as I have a pretty healthy obsession with this particular STAR WARS villain.

They also have a book club which is basically like a frequent buyer card w/o carrying around a card.  Spend a certain amount of money and you get store credit.  Simple and sweet!

I love this place and order i from here monthly almost. Lately I have been placing orders and my pasta bowl is just not full. The food quality is good but if my bowls keep getting smaller, I'll have to reconsider this is one of my favorites.

The people in the referral booth act as if they are giving you assistance from their personal accounts. Dont let James haul your items! I repeat DONT let James haul your items or they will get damaged. They treat you like you are less than human. Hopefully my experience is an only time thing. For this to be a Catholic/Christian Charity it was a lot of hell to get mismatched items and damaged furniture. If you sincerly dont want to help people, say that. Dont makw them feel bad for needing assistance...
I've heard great things about this place and finally tried it. Happy to say the hype is warranted. Excellent Thai food & friendly service at a great value!

Great food in a really comfy, cool atmosphere! The smoked fish starter plate was great, and the beer cheese was awesome too. The cheesecake - Irish Cream Cheesecake - was AH-MAZING! So delicious! If we're in the neighborhood again, we're definitely eating here again!

They are amazing! Life savers literally! I was visiting Nola from LA for the weekend and cracked my iphone 6 screen Saturday night (don't ride your bike inebriated) and called them next morning Sunday. They were able to give me a quick quote over the phone and when I arrived, they helped me out immediately. Their customer service is incredible! Not used to the humid weather and biking there from 20 minutes away, they offered me ice cold water. It was like heaven! They told me it would only take 30 minutes to fix it (so fast!). I rode back to get some beignets and came back so a beautiful new screen! They even offered to put on a tempered glass cover on my screen to prevent something like this happening again for free! Again, incredible service!

Highly highly recommend if you want incredible friendly service, great pricing (check in for 10% off!), speedy, and just an amazing job!

Thank you guys!
Horrible service. Horrible experience. Go somewhere else. Peyton Manning has enough money anyways...

I'm a big fan of Tria but I normally go to the one on Rittenhouse.  The upside of the Tria on Spruce is that they have the $5 happy hour specials and it is more spacious than the other location.  

I was sad to see they took off the Fresh Mozz with Prosciutto Panino.  We got the artichoke one instead..it was okay.  Not a new favorite of mine.  The happy hour cheese was Daru; too mild for me.  

We also tried the potato chips with the aioli.  I liked that the aioli was light.
WOW!! Wonderful Thai food, fresh ingredients, fabulous flavors.  I had spicy green beans with chicken, my boyfriend had Thai basil with chicken both delicious!  We look forward to going back!

I have often gone to Chapin Aesthetics for chemical peels. However, last week I came in and was assigned to a new aesthetician. Her name is Dionna and she was absolutely fantastic. I would say as far as medical aestheticians come she is as good as it gets. I received a DermaSweep treatment that made my skin simply glow. Dionna was extremely knowledgable and took the time to educate me not only about what new skincare treatments and products were on the market but also exactly what products would be best for my personal skincare regimen. I am already seeing results with the products thatI purchased on my last visit!!! One product in particular SkinMedica's TNS Essential Serum has made all the difference. Dionna really helped to create an actual plan for what skincare services are best suited for my skin and what the next steps should be for me. I have also been considering on making a Botox consultation and learning more about fillers - I will definitely be doing that with Dionna!

Two reviews in one here, one for the market and one for the kitchen.

Market: I like that Maynard's has a more affordable counterpart with a decent happy hour that lasts until 8pm. Wine and beer specials are about $6 or less and there are some yummy appetizer-size food specials that are under $10. Some food options include flatbreads, mussels, fries, and a burger. The ambience is very casual and it's a nice place to go for happy hour in general or for a drink before dinner in the Kitchen. 

Kitchen: I've dined at the kitchen a few times now, both in the dining room and outside on the patio. Both spaces are nice. I find that the dining room is much more elegant if you are looking for a fancier night out. Entrees will run your $25-30 but they are prepared well with local ingredients and the portions are just right.  Their fish is usually done very well and I would recommend it amongst other places in Tucson of its caliber. Their wine menu is extensive, so there is something for everyone.

Interesting place to visit in New Orleans considering you are required to be part of a tour in order to visit the cemeteries (reasonable, since our tour guide informed us of all the vandalism that had occurred previously in the past.), but it was still interesting none the less. There was significant damage done to some of the tombs, and red "x"s placed on some of them.

It's sad that individuals choose to cause significant damage to a place that is so rich in history and information. It truly is still beautiful even with all the damage you can observe while walking through. Marie Laveau's tomb was the highlight of our tour, and her tomb as well also adorned "X" marks put there by misguided folks.

I really hope they continue to preserve this cemetery. I think it's a staple in New Orleans history and the people in it have such rich history and lead interesting lives -- and the process to adding more people to this particular cemetery is incredibly interesting (and macabre). I would definitely love to come take another tour and see more of it, because I feel like we spent most of our time on the tour focusing on only a few tombs instead of the cemetery as a whole.

Avoid. Hard pass. The sushi seaweed wrap was noticeably old, the rice was tough, and the fish was such poor quality they must source from the cheapest place possible, like worse than a Safeway sushi bar but 4 times the price.

After politely returning the terrible sushi, we feeling bad for the waitress and wanting to give the place an honest try, ordered a plate of seafood Chow Mein and the over sauced sugar plate that came out was only slightly less gross. Felt more like Chinese-themed-fast-food. Which, sure that's fine if you want Panda Express, but a resort restaurant with those prices only disappointed.

We gave up at that point and boxed it. The next morning we didn't want to eat it either. Only thing decent there was the over priced Miso.

 (For the record, our server was great, accommodated us completely and was polite. The bussers were on point too)

Since it was a hot day, we ordered something iced--specifically a Cuban along with a coffee soda. The Cuban was very smooth, and I'd probably say it's one of the best coffees I've ever had. The coffee soda was a novelty to me, and it was pretty refreshing. Overall a good cafe environment as well.

LOVE LOVE LOVE  this place! WINGS and burgers are out of this world. It does tend to get crowded some nights, but bartender is always running around and attentive. Dana Marie rocks! We are going back to Nashville in January for my birthday weekend and Piranha's will be a daily spot for us! Love the dive bar feel! For those "bougie" people who don't like it too loud, smokey or dive bar-ish, just stay out bc we don't wanna hang out with you anyway!

Everything was going along well and the girl finished my pedicure in record time. I was sitting there letting my toenails dry as I was instructed and after about 20 minutes she came back to ask if I wanted a flower on my big toenail. I said that would be fine and she put it on very quickly. I have never had a flower before so I didn't know how long it might take for it to "set" So I continued to sit in my chair. And sit, and sit, and sit. I finally had to ask one of the other girls to tell my practitioner that I thought I was dry and I didn't need to leave. She was well into another pedicure. She did come over and remove the toe separators and line up my shoes so I could step into them but I could tell she was not happy. Her tip reflected my unhappiness is having to wait so long for her to finish her job.

It has been awhile since we ate here but I have to say it was one of the best meals I have ever had (no kidding). I highly recommend them. Each course was better than the last.Their gluten free chocolate desert was excellent. Do your self a favor and stop in soon ;-)

Great hotel and excellent service. The front desk was super nice and attentive! I honestly prefer this Marriott over the Courtyard one. It was just cleaner, larger, and overall had a nice atmosphere. Would definitely stay here the next time I am in Santa Barbara and would recommend this hotel over the courtyard.

4/15/2018 Update.... ok, this is early Sunday afternoon & after awaking from a nap I'm kinda stunned over what just happened; 
Yesterday, I took my wife's GX470 to have the brakes inspected after she told me the front was shaking when she was stopping. These guys had replaced the front rotors a few months ago. Chris inspected it promptly upon my arrival at about 4:30pm and found that the rotors had warped prematurely and he'd have it ready in a little while.  Walked down to the Gyro restaurant to eat & watch TV, etc. When I got back, he apologetically said a bolt had broken off in the caliper and they can't get another one until Monday. 

I thought Dang it! But oh well... it is what it is... so I got a LYFT ride back to Franklin and started shopping for a short term car rental, etc. for Monday morning workday. 

Then about 1:00 today, Chris called me and said he fixed the GX and that he had someone following him to Franklin to return it to me! They got here, handed me the keys, told me the work was covered under warranty and if I'd  call the office tomorrow, they'll reimburse my LYFT fare! 

UN-BEE-LEEVABLE......WHO DOES THAT? 
Who gives customers that kind of service these days? Think about it... This guy got up on Sunday (his day off) went somewhere and found a part, came back to the shop, fixed my car, then arranged to personally deliver it to me 25 miles away!

Thank you again, Budget Brakes on Charlotte Ave. Job Well Done!

The best thing about this place is the decor. The atmosphere was great and this place has a lot of potential but they really need to fix a few things. It was very crowded and it's seat yourself, no list, just first come first served so everyone is fighting each other for a table which is very unenjoyable. Plus, the tables are packed in there like sardines! The food doesn't come out at the same time and to top it off the tacos were just okay. Not very impressed.

I was very excited to try the Chicken and Waffles (and they were on sale!)  The waffles were thin and dry but the chicken was moist and tender.  For dessert we had the crème brûlée which was very good.  It was topped with pop rocks which didn't add much to the flavour and seemed a bit pretentious - but were fun to eat all the same.  Service was okay but not great.

Last Night my husband and I celebrated our 1 year wedding anniversary here and we were blown away. We have never had an experience like this in our life. First we made reservations in hope for a window seat , little did I know they walked us to the outdoor balcony, I was speechless and teared up . I believe our server was Joseph and he was outstanding, he answered any question we had , brought us a free celebration glass of champagne (out of this world) there was a happy anniversary card signed by the staff, free fries ( I thought they were for someone else and I said "oh those aren't ours" the man laughs and says actually they are , it's like free bread but better, we order the 100 Day Aged Ribeye (insane ) I asked which cut of Wagyu was best and was recommended the Wagu Australian Filet( holy crap melted in my mouth, potatoe purée (best I have ever had in my life)and Brussels sprouts(who knew there could be so much flavor). Oh and s'mores dessert was soooo freaking good. This night was the best night of our life, food beats any food I have ever had. I want to relive this day over and over. Side note I was escorted to the restroom and people literally let me walk by like I was royalty. The service staff  was just so over and beyond anything I have experienced I can not recommend it enough. Best night and best money ever spent ! If I could give them 100 stars I would !!
Incredible pizza, incredible atmosphere. What an awesome addition to the warehouse district and Tucson!

Got to the shop with no idea what I need it. Maggie , Margarita and German helped me to get my new bike. You guys are the best. I am super satisfied withy new bike.

Thank you so much!  
Oneida Rivera
I have used many rental car companies over the years and none of them are as accommodating as Enterprise. Thanks!

I had higher expectations for this cutely-decorated restaurant, especially given the extensive gluten free menu (I am strictly GF). The food was just boring, overly salted, and small portions. Surly staff did not help. There are better options all around you in Old City.
Good tacos with fast efficient service. The place is known for its many varieties of hot sauces.

Company Cannot deliver the sunroom they guaranteed me and has only offered hideous  alternatives instead of just refunding my money.  Company general manager even asked me to take down a negative review so we could negotiate some kind of settlement but his only intent was to have me remove the post so he could block me from posting more negative reviews.  Luckily I had 2 negative reviews and only removed 1.

The girl at the counter was awful. I had to repeat my order a couple of times, I literally had two basic items and a smoothie. They didn't have some things from the online menu, and their egg maker (what ever that is?) was broken. The waffle was burnt and not cooked at the same time and my bagel was burnt to a crisp. I'll never come here again.

I'll admit we stopped in around 7 pm one night, drawn in by the christmas lights after visiting the christmas village. Its a small cafe and bar that offers coffee, croissants, as well as cocktails if you're so inclined.

That night we were so inclined to have a prosecco and the service behind the 'bar' was very friendly and welcoming. I realized a few minutes after we got our drink that they were past closing hours but were being very accommodating to us. We appreciated the place to rest our feet and the nice service and we will be back again one day for a happy hour on their outside patio.

I ate here on Saturday night at around 8:30. It was fairly crowded but we were still able to get a table by the window (the place is huge!!) Our waitress was wonderful and very accommodating, although we were really disappointed that a few of he beers we wanted off the list were kicked already.

As far as food goes, the pierogis were great! Super crispy and very flavorful. The truffle fries were delicious and the brussel sprout appetizer a huge portion and super yummy! 

I didn't have the wings but my brother did and was a fan. He had them buffalo style and felt they were a great size and that they were crispy.

The burger and chicken sandwich were said to be good but nothing special!

Will return to try more of the menu and sip beers from their long beer list!

A funk zone staple, the Project never disappoints. Lovely atmosphere, and giving you the best of both worlds-- you could have a taco in one hand and a craft beer in the other! 
I've mainly eaten at Corazon Cocina, and the tacos and margaritas there are top-notch. I recently ordered the camote taco, a sweet potato taco, which is something I never thought could be so delicious. The inventiveness of the taco combined with the perfect textures and mix of flavors was absolutely perfect. I always tell my friends to go here for margs, as the margaritas here are strong! Definitely getting bang for your buck.

AMAZING! Overall experience 10 out of 10. Walking in the staff was so welcoming and ready to help! Specifically Corie, Bryan, and a nice women who they called Ma. 
They answered any questions I had with a smile. For the food itself was filling and overall DELICIOUS  this will definitely be the new burger joint for me. Amazing service. Great Food, and delicious milkshakes!! *Chefs kiss*

Was in Philly for a day or two and picked up a Groupon for this location. Really, very pleased with my purchase. Got a french vanilla latte as well as a chicken panini for $2 over my $5 for $10 Groupon. The staff was really friendly and helpful, and I loved using their free wifi for a bit while eating my lunch. Both my drink and my meal were utterly delightful. Not quite sure how they did it. I had low expectations, but was simply blown away. Made me depressed that I cannot become a local at this location.

We went over on a rainy Saturday and had an incredible lunch. We got the "lunchbox sampler", which is a daily-changing selection of their cuisine, and I cannot say enough good things about it! The butter chicken in particular was so delicious! The service comes with naan and rice, and they were perfect complements to the meal. 

It's a small, family-owned restaurant, very friendly and comfortable, and believe me we will be back soon. The egg curry has my eye for next time!
This place was amazing and I would go there all the time before I went to school in the city. Unfortunately, it has since shut down. We will miss you!!

Fritanga is hands down the best restaurant in St. Louis food-wise.  My boyfriend and I eat here regularly (at least once a month for 2 years).  You have to try the Nicaraguan guacamole and the tajadas con queso.  I'm a vegetarian (definitely vegetarian friendly) so I can't talk about the meat dishes first-hand, but everyone I bring there loves the pork especially. 
I can't even describe how good the food is so here's an anecdote:
I once directed an out of town couple, who I had not previously known, to eat at Fritanga.  They were looking for a place that was off the beaten path and asked what was the one restaurant I wouldn't miss while visiting.  The next day I happened to run in to the same couple at an antique shop I recommended and the man gave me a huge hug for recommending Fritanga.  Yes, their food is THAT good.

Also, as a bonus, they charge practically nothing given the quality of the food and service.  Great for when you want quality food but can't afford to go to an expensive restaurant--and after you eat here once you won't see the point of going any where else!

Not a great experience.
My burger had some kind of metal in it?? They ended up replacing it in a timely manner. The red headed waitress we had was very inattentive and didn't seem to care about what she was supposed to be doing.

Delightful little hideaway in center city. Small (not trying to do it all) expertly crafted and clever cocktail list - just what I look for in a cocktail bar. Relaxing and inviting vibe, and actually quiet outdoor seating since it's off the main roads! Lovely decor and friendly bartenders. Will be back soon!

We ordered from here on a delivery site (Grubhub,I think). The food was excellent- fried shrimp Poboys and fish Tacos ( 3 tacos to an order and great batter on the fish)... Poboy came with sweet potatoe fries. We ate it all ! Top of the charts good. Since they have a full menu, we will definitely order again- Prices were better than reasonable and food better than average - a big win in the present shutdown, COVID world. 5  good. .
Nice server. Food is basic and bland. What you would ezpect from Mexican food in Fenton.

I've been reading good things about this place lately so we decided to try it for the first time this evening. We waited about 40 minutes for our food, nothing. Our server came by once to refill my son's soda once otherwise we never saw her. I finally flagged her down to ask where our food was. Other tables who were seated after us were enjoying their food. She then went to see. Not sure how she didn't think to go check herself before this point, but again she was never really on our side of the restaurant. We were told the ticket was never put in. We paid for our appetizer and soda and went somewhere else to eat. I was not going to sit there for another 30 minutes waiting for our meal to be cooked after already being there for as long as we were.  I wouldn't go out of my way to come back here. Nobody really seemed concerned about the matter either.  We never actually got to taste the food so I won't do just one star.
I love their seasonal drinks here! You can never go wrong and it's a cozy spot to hang out.

I have always wanted to try this place. I was given a giftcard to Hello Juice for Christmas and I was so excited to finally have the opportunity to go! My family and I stopped in yesterday around lunch time. The atmosphere is very cozy and friendly. The staff was not very friendly and barely communicated. We did not get greeted or thanked. They were out of many ingredients, leaving one of my family members with nothing to order. My mom ordered a smoothie. The employee informed her that they were out of apple juice and coconut milk and said that would have to use oak milk. This was no big deal. However, I ordered an açaí bowl, which did not have any acai in it. This was not communicated with me ahead of time and somewhat defeats the purpose of an acai bowl. I overheard them telling another customer they were out of almond butter. I understand that busy places can easily run out of ingredients, but they seemed to be out of a lot of their main ingredients. It was also disappointing to be served something that is missing the main ingredient. 

Overall - I was disappointed that a place that seems to promising would become a let down. I have been to other juice bars that have similar menu items that are far more welcoming and always make their products correctly. I hope this review only leads to positive changes that will allow me to give Hello Juice one more chance.
Kennedy was my massage therapist and she did a great job. I was very happy with my massage! Very glad I decided to come here

This little dive have everything one would ever want in a pizza, all in a little spot! The employees were very friendly and every made small talk! Our pizza was made quickly! The provided plenty of parmesan cheese and red pepper seasoning packets! If u are ever out on bourbon st., Dont forget to drop in for a slice of their yummy pizza!
Very friendly staff. Clean place with fast service. Food is amazing! Always a great experience here!

Underdogs is half a block from work and is a pretty popular lunch spot with my co-workers. I'd have to say that I've enjoyed the hotdogs I've gotten there, myself, though I'd say it's wildly overpriced. I think I dropped almost $8ish on a dog, some fries, and a canned soda. There were some cool toppings on it, and it did taste great, but something about any hotdog costing that much seems ridic. I did get a dog that was actually a lamb sausage, but even the standard dogs weren't that much cheaper than mine.

That brings me to the food itself - I got the Marrakesh which is a lamb sausage with a bit of mediterranean salad on it. I thought it was pretty delicious. The fries are  pretty standard, but the array of dipping sauces to choose from to come with the fries are really what make the fries come to life.

Overall, if money is no object, Underdogs has some pretty great hotdogs. Get it to go, though. The tiny little location is situated down a flight of stairs from ground level and it can get a bit overwhelming when it's packed for lunch. Service is pretty fast, so you won't be waiting around long.

I crave the food from Lucy's vegan cafe on a daily basis. The flavors linger in your mouth with each bite. I am so impressed that it is all vegan. Especially after eating the Reuben sandwich. They call their dressing 3000 island dressing and use seitan in lieu of pastrami or corn-beef. I have to say it is my # 1 Reuben I have tried. I am from New York so this is hard to believe, even for me. I have only had a few other vegan Reuben's, but as long as Lucy's keeps offering this sandwich I will probably always get it there. 

Their unique sides go perfectly with any sandwich. I have also tried their bahn mi which was also great as well as a sandwich on special: the shrimp po' boy sandwich that was incredible. I'd have to say that the sauces they use really do the trick for me. The shrimp po' boy was served with some type of honey mustard aioli which was just as to-die-for as the 3000 island dressing on the Reuben. They have some sandwich that is called a melt that I have not tried yet, but looking forward to it. You know when you get 1 or 2 items off a menu that are just too good for you to try anything else? I plan to do a sampling of sorts, (because that is what I do) at some point but I can't seem to get off the few sandwiches I have already eaten because they are simply too memorable. In addition, there are other good looking cafe's around there, but I cannot seem to try any of them because of wanting to go to this cafe. 

A side-note: they do have various vegan grocery items that are not sold in a lot of stores that offer plant based items. So don't forget your cooler to stock up for at-home snacks and meals! 

This place is an hour away and I gladly drive there to get my fix!

I was very disappointed with this restaurant. Huge variety of drinks...which were actually good but the food was meh. Quality of the food was sub par and  was cold by the time it was brought to our table. willl not be returning

Big thanks to Dylan Hubbard and everyone at Hubbards Marina. I had a great time on the 44hour deep sea fishing trip this weekend. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. The captains and crew were excellent and worked hard to put us on the fish. Also big thanks to John Martin who taught me a lot about how to do and use the proper knots for this type of fishing. Without him I probably wouldn't have landed all the fish I caught this weekend. Especially the monster amberjack I caught. Unfortunately he was out of season so he was properly released to swim another day. Still ended up bringing home my limit of snappers and one large gag grouper. Also had a blast catching if you Bonita, amberjacks and some big porgies. I look forward to many more trips with these great Charter fisherman and I would highly recommend them to anyone wanting to go on a great fishing trip.
Some people working here are rude and don't care about customer service,. Not a great experience coming here.
First time. Very nice. Met the New owner and she is very nice. Great beers. Will definitely be back

I wish I could really express how grateful I am that I hired this company. I'm thrilled with what they have done for us. Our pool is more gorgeous than I imagined it could be. Our sales person, Jon, was very honest. We met with 6 other companies and when I started asking about some features we wanted for our pool, he was less expensive and explained what it costs them to install that feature and what they made off it. The honesty was refreshing after all the other salesmen I spoke to. He also explained that we needed a special line put in for the cleaner we wanted, that none of the other salesmen mentioned which made me feel like I could trust that he really knew what he was talking about. The plans, pricing, contract all went seamlessly. We knew we were in line behind other builds. When our time came to start, men were here at 8am each morning that they were suppose to work. I was never chasing down "when will you be here". The man who runs the build, Curtis, was awesome! He answered all my millions of questions along the way. He never tried to nickel and dime me, which I'd heard stories about other companies doing and was worried about. Everything went off without a hitch. Our job was particularly complicated because our yard is large and the house is old, 1928, with lots of strange complications. They rocked it. The pavers are beautiful! The sales person, Jon did warn me that if I went with a particular paver company I had picked out that they take a little longer..he was right but in the end it was worth it. I also used their paver guy, Junior, to seal our pavers after. I'm so happy with the outcome and how they took care of us...I'd recommend them to anyone.

This man charges way to much for his food 
I didn't care for it and I don't understand the fascination with it

Had a great lunch here after my jury duty. The food was excellent and very nice portions.  In fact the chicken nachos could feed a boy-scout troop. Great tunes and a good selection of craft beers on tap. But the best part of my experience was the bar keep Celena. Whenever you have a friendly and attentive server it make the experience even that much better.

AMAZING service today!!  Above and beyond what I expected.  My car hasn't been cleaned in... well... who knows how long.  The work was great and the staff was very friendly (even though I know I put them through a lot of work).  Thank you!!

I highly recommend this location.

I am startled at the bad reviews. We have been going in and ordering out for years.  We've never had a bad dish.  This is a very small restaurant offering chicken, fish and pasta.  Try the Chicken Pozzo - it's great. 

The Rich and Charlie's on Watson Road offers a larger menu selection, including steak, which I would like to add is great.
Go next door and try the pizza and sandwiches - everyone we entertain love them.

Thank you and shout out to Melinda at Lucky Nails Salon. This was my 1st visit and I will be back. Love my nail design and she completed them within an hour. I can't stop admiring them. Lol also, excellent receptionist and office assistant, Harley!!

SANITATION:

4.5 out of 5 stars

All the tables were more than 6ft apart and there was plastic/glass divider between the tables that were behind us

All servers were wearing masks and tables were wiped down after each customer

The only reason why it is 4.5, because our servers nose was hanging outside of his mask. Thanks for trying buddy.

FOOD:

Wow I am speechless, my fiancée was asking me if I liked my tacos and i couldn't respond because I was stuffing my face

Flavor is amazing and I am so impressed by the care they put into their food, they even seasoned their tortillas!!! I've never been to a taco place that seasoned their taco shells - that was the Homerun for me.

All the tacos we tried were amazing, the flavor was well balanced.

& there is gluten free, vegan options in all of their food available.

SERVICE:
I had a great time with our server here, he came to our table immediately and explained to us our drink options.

We told him it was our first time here and he was patient enough to give us a summary of the menu.

One thing I loved about him is that he explained and then walked away to figure it out instead of pressuring us.

BONUS:

The restaurant is beautiful, they have amazing wall art all through the place. 

It is walkable distance from other bars 

And they have parking on site.

This... is not a diner. I thought it was. I went in to eat by myself and had a sarah marshall moment. "Seat for one? Just one? Um... hmm.... let me take a look"

I thought it was a diner! I went in and just wanted some greek food, but it's a legit restaurant with tables and candles and all that fancy stuff!!

Anyway, it was pretty good. I went with the red wine lamb leg for take out. It was good. It only took 5 minutes to prepare because it becausei t's slow roasted/cooked so it's all premade I guess? The lamb was a little dry, it probably needed more sauce, which was kind of sparse on my take out. 

The sides were greasey and delicious. You get some potatoes, some veggies, some chickpeas, and all on rice. I would definitely go again, but just ask for extra sauce on the lamb. It's roasted/cooked so it falls off the bone w/ just a fork. Forking delicious

We had lunch during the first week they opened.  Restaurant decor is beautiful. Food is beautifully presented and service is very professional. The lunch portion of salmon was just right, and the gnocchi were excellent. I'm a little disappointed that no bread was offered, since this is typically offered in France.  About half of the tables were full, and the noise level was almost unbearable - they need to add sound absorbing panels to improve the experience (I left with a headache from the noise).

Had me some Philly cheesesteaks from what locals rave to be better then Pat's and Geno's. Arrive at around 11:30am they open up at 11am to find a line outside the location with about 30 people ahead of me. Patiently waited on line, I was placing my order in about 20mins. Order the Cheese Steak provolone cheese mayo and onions. The steak was taster then Pat's which I had two nights before. My husband wasn't fan of their bread but said it was good. For myself I would say it was good but meat maybe needed a bit more seasoning (aka salt). Over all a good sandwich next time I will try it with the peppers and cheese whizz authentic style lol.

I would recommend that everyone try it staff was okay but it's a fast beat place got to keep it moving even in their upstairs seating area it's like eat and get going lol.

This is the review I just posted on Rode's Fireside facebook page. I think everyone should know this when considering this resturant...


So I went to Rode's this Easter with my family. There were 22 of us & it was reservation only, so there were no walk ins. We had a great time and the food was great. But then when my Mom called and tried to make a reservation for Mother's Day, the owner got on the phone & told her that they won't take large groups like that anymore and what we can do for Mother's Day is come at 945 but we have to be out by 11. She told my Mom that we stayed too long, which is absolutely ridiculous because number one our waitress told us to stay as long as we like bc there weren't any other parties coming in that day. Also, we were not there too long.. We ate our food ( which took some time since prior to us even getting there a line had formed & we had to wait too just like the other customers.. Which of course we don't care about the line, it was a buffet & a line is to be expected. I am frustrated bc the owner acted like we caused this long line which is simply just not the case),then we had dessert, sang happy birthday to my aunt and then we left. I just think that for 30 some dollars per head it's ridiculous to say we took too long. We were very respectful & my family goes to restaurants like this ALL THE TIME. We have never once in all these years been told something like this. It was very rude in my opinion and because of this we unfortunately will not ever be going back there. So I recommend that if you have a large group of people and your looking for a place to celebrate a birthday or a holiday or whatever occasion, don't waste your time with Rodes because they don't appreciate your business. I'm sorry to say this because we did have a nice time and the food was great.. But I feel like people should know this when considering this restaurant.. With our group of 22 people we spent almost 1100 dollars there including tip and we were looking forward to coming back until my Mom spoke to the owner Joyce. To say that we can only come back for Mother's Day if we're there by 945 and out by 11 is just rude and it's not realistic. Because of this none of us nor our friends or extended family will be giving our business to Rodes again. I hope this review helps anyone who is considering going there with a group of people.  This truely is a disgrace and I'm surprised by the owner Joyce's actions.  Hard to believe she would ever treat patrons in this fashion.  Please do yourself a favor a keep driving past this restaurant onto another restaurant in Swedeboro. Furthermore their food here is about average nothing great. I rate this Restaurant at 1 Star.  The owner should consider and think next time before she speaks to patrons like this at least be smart enough to keep the thoughts to yourself right !!!!
Great place! The bottomless mimosas are reasonably priced and the food is great! Our server, Isaiah, was awesome and made our experience here great!
This is the place if your tryin to get fat.. Food is just ok though I did eat my whole plate, don't understand why this place is on TV though, isn't good enough for that shit
Classy beautiful, great for drinks, great for brunch. Love that i discovered this place!

I would like to recommend Mark, the Tucson Tech Guy, for any home theater problems you may have. I had Mark come out and fix my screwed up Home theater system. He came out on a Saturday, and found out my problem (bad HMDI port) and gave me a working fix. He also gave me excellent recommendations on replacement equipment. He was very prompt and professional. I will use him again for any of my audio-visual needs!

The hours on the door and voice message state this location closes at 7:00 pm. I am at the door and it's locked and no one is answering.  I saw a worker go to the car about 6:05pm but I thought they would come back. Silly me! For trying to support this location on my anniversary. Never again. Make sure you call and speak with someone before you come to this location, but don't be surprised if they're not here

Horrible chicken quality the manager was very unapologetic.
Very worst subway experience we have ever had
Casey? the manager was unprofessional & unprepared.
Great casual dining restaurant.  Service was super fast.  Food was good.  It's a typical low-key Florida seafood bar and restaurant with excellent execution.

LOVE this park!  I have been here before but this past time really sealed the deal for me.  I was visiting for a concert, The National, and was so pleasantly surprised when the park staff offered free lawn chairs to use while enjoying the evening.  YASSS!  Such a great idea.  I wish my local waterfront park would do that for concerts and such.  
Beautiful park, well laid out, super clean and large bathrooms, close to lots of things to do and see downtown, and free lawn chairs!  
If you haven't been, go.  Also, you can connect yourself to some cool stuff at this park via walking, cycling, etc.

The only thing Asian about this place are the workers. Food was decent but it didn't make up for the service and shadiness. 

Anyways..Service is HORRIBLE. And their management is whack. We ordered 7 bowls of rice and they charge a dollar each. Which is totally fine, that part wasn't important.
