But when the rice came out , it came out in ONE MEDIUM SIZED BOWL. I'm like what the .. I don't understand. Also our server was this middle aged Chinese man who was fairly stuck up. 


Food was good. Service es no bueno.

I am so excited that Tampa has The Hall on Franklin. The best thing about this place is you have multiple restaurants to choose from and your server delivers to your table. There are so many options and really it's just a perfect dining spot for groups. We've visited so many times, it's hard to pick my favorites. 

The chicken and waffles, stinky buns, and charcuterie board are some of my favorites. I recently tried the new pizza vendor which is owned by Bavaro's and it was fantastic!!

There is beer, wine and full bar options available. Definitely give this place a try!

Yes! This food truck is great! Must get the brisket verde tacos and fried pickled okra! The brisket is so tender and flavorful. Two tacos per order and they are huge, not those skimpy tacos.

I love fried okra, but pickled fried okra is even better! 

The ribs are great as well, the "Hot" wasn't that hot at all, so don't wimp out and get mild. They were tender and full of smokey flavor.

Definitely give this one a try!

I highly recommend eating here! The food was fresh and delicious, and unquestionably gluten free! The owner was very knowledgable of the gluten free requirements. He was friendly and explained that the establishment started out as a heart healthy option, but found an easy adaptation to gluten free for many of their items after their first year. 

The food is delicious and oh so fresh! We really enjoyed the crab cake tacos and tilapia tacos. My husband ordered gumbo, too, but after only one of the crab cake tacos, I was satisfied. My daughter loves the gf brownie. Best news yet? They will ship the crab cakes and gumbo to YOU! AND THEY HAVE A GF KING CAKE! I didn't think I'd ever taste one again.

What a great experience! I had my very first facial, an enzyme peel as well as dermaplaning done and my skin feels amazing. Brittany was great, she explained every process and was so sweet and friendly. Thank you Beauty Republic!

The Station Taproom was recommended by our neighbors who are 30-40 years our juniors. Imagine Septuagenarians visiting a singles bar during happy hour on a Friday night, and you'll get a good picture of our first visit. We vowed to return at a better time - Hold the Earlybird Special gaffs!

Return we did for a late lunch on a Thursday afternoon; it was late because the Taproom doesn't open until 3pm,

We ordered the Prince Edward Island mussels served with baguette and a tomato onion fennel sauce. It was excellent. Them we ordered the Taproom hamburger, medium rare and topped with bacon and cheddar cheese my wife had a shrimp and grits dish. Both were superb. The hamburger was the best I have ever had anywhere, and my wife licked plate of shrimp and grits and sauce clean.

The station Taproom has an excellent selection of craft beer. I had a Mission IPA that was the perfect compliment for the hamburger, and my wife enjoyed a white sangria.

Top off the excellent food with a pleasant and attentive waitress, and the result is a perfect dining experience.

It looks so classy on the internet but when you actually settle in you will quickly realize it's a bucket.  The rooms are average.  The aroma of stale feet hits you when you leave the elevators terrible.  The art bar down stairs is a joke how are u a bar and have Zero drinks.  Also this place is filthy they washed the table with a rag that smelt like ass but I guess that's what's to be expected. So in conclusion it's over priced and a zero interest opinion.

My family and I met our friends here for dinner. They were able to accommodate for our party of 11 with no problems. Server was so friendly and warm. She checked on us regularly, refilled our drinks and the kids drinks and the food came out in a timely manner. We did not have to wait long for our food. Overall it was a pleasant experience. We would definitely come back again.
Fun place to grab a cold beer and hear some great live music. Worth stopping in for a cold one on a hot day. Beers are about $5
The epitome of dive bar. Xmas lights, indoor smoking, and cheap booze. Also, random animals.

This place is so nasty, do not stay here!!  It smells nasty.  Looks like it's been pieced back together after damages were done.  We had been on the road for 7hrs it was 1 in the morning, I would have told the associate to give me my money back but was too tired.

Rude customer service! Will definitely not come back. I came in to ask about whether they will arrange a spot for me for the outside seating. The person in the cashier could just reply about that. However, he seemed to be unhappy about something else at that time and he put all his rude attitude to me, which is certainly unprofessional customer service.

Happy Nails created the most wonderful pedicure experience for me as a first timer. The staff is very friendly, accommodating and helpful as this was my first pedicure experience as a male. I had the perception that I would feel like an outsider. Katie was amazing and I will be sure to stop by every time I'm nearby. 5 stars.

Best crust/sauce combo I've ever had period! Thin, crunchy yet soft at the same time. We ordered the vegetarian with some added toppings and it was nothing short of spectacular. The buffalo wings definitely tasted award winning and the service was excellent as well. I have zero complaints about my first try at this place, I'm going back and I'm telling everyone I know about it if they don't know already. Great job guys! New favorite pizza joint. And, I gotta point out that I live damn near in Verdi and I will go out of my way to only get my pizza from here. It's not close, or even on my way home it's just worth it.

My son is a cross country runner and kept insisting that I needed to quit complaining about my running shoes, get into St. Pete Running Company and get an expert opinion. Finally threw away my crappy, ill fitting, unsupportive Dick's Sporting Goods Nike shoes and went shopping. 

Wow! Cannot say enough about this place: they evaluated my stride on the treadmill, made intelligent recommendations on my running needs and even suggested appropriate socks (no pressure sales, just informed suggestions). They were even able to make a recommendation for a shoe to wear in my kickboxing class, (which I did purchase and LOVE). Owner/Operators that actually compete in the sport that they are making recommendations for make all the difference in the world!!

Apartment seems good but then when you actually look at it, it's terrible. This unit seemed like they just finished remodeling it, but did a half ass job. 
- the apartment door is so chipped by the locks that it doesn't shut/you can look into apartment through the crack
- one of the shower handles is so loose you can see into the wall and it feels like it might fall out 
- the toilet seat was so lose we had to screw it back on 
- The furniture is rickety, some still have the plastic wrappings on them 
- the hallway carpets are stained and disgusting (probably pee and/or vomit)
- the lobby smells so strongly of an 8th grade locker room that it's obvious they're masking something worse
- there's no vent or heat lamp to help air out the bathroom 
- also no decent towel rack to hang dry towel

No wonder this place was so cheap. If there's a silver lining, this apartment made me want to escape into the city more.

What a cool gym! First discovered this place for a Yelp event two weeks ago and so was immediately hooked. I've never bouldered before and was pretty certain I physically wouldn't be able to (weak arms). Wwoooweee the adrenaline rush after getting to the top of my first one was pretty amazing. It's hard to describe how I felt, as it's a combination of fun and terrifying, but such a good workout. I did fall off the wall once, but the padding obviously caught me. They have shoes you can rent, and based on what I was told/experienced, would size down. The walls are color coded based on difficulty so easy to determine where you should be. There's a regular gym on the other side, fitness classes and even a little kids climbing wall. The cafe upstairs is also really nice, with a lot of drinks and food to choose from. Ample parking, friendly staff and clean facility, I'll be back!

So delicious! I can't get over how great this place was! I had the scallops and they were so buttery and perfectly cooked. My husband had the pork shoulder and could barely talk he was so busy scarfing down his food. And the pot du creme for dessert was so out of this world good! Definitely would come back.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Never use this cab company they should be put out of business. I called for a cab at noon for a 6:45 pick up to the airport. They never showed up. We called several times to inquire about when a cab would be arriving with consistent lies stating one would be arriving shortly. No cab ever arrived after an hour of BS from the dispatcher. DO NOT USE THIS CAB COMPANY EVER

A cacophony (!) of children.  Walked in around 11:45 am and was hit by a wall of noise:  the restaurant was almost full and nearly every table had kids at it.

The food was basically good (dill pickle soup is not to be missed!); service was very slow and very friendly (our waitress offered us free dessert because we waited so long for food that didn't even require cooking); and decor is adorable.  

I would go back, but only for a very late lunch - the noise was unbearable before about 12:30.

P.S.  to the owner:  thank you for the response; I will definitely consider it when next in STL - the pickle soup would be worth a return in itself!

I practice at this studio pretty frequently for a few years now. My issue is that the 4th floor studio is inconsistent with the temperature. Some classes I barely break a sweat (and feel sore the next day) and other classes are unbearably hot. It's supposed to be 110 degrees. I am tired of hearing excuses from the instructors about the heating issues. What's unfortunate is that they are losing students because of this. I know two that have stopped going as a result and now go to other hot yoga studios that are consistently hot class after class. This studio better fix the issue before others leave... myself included.

Cheap, tasty food.  I know, it's a store.  BUT, I come here to eat just as much as I come here to shop.  There is fat free frozen yogurt for 99 cents!  Tell me where else in the city you can find that.  You come in, go upstairs, have tasty lunch well under 10 bucks, shop around, and grab another tasty cheap snack after checkout.

I've gone to this parking lot on and off for over 4 years now. I previously had a contract with them when I worked at the art gallery, and multiple times I've parked here for Yelp Events. 

I can't give you specifics on pricing but it's always been reasonable unless you're parking during an event, but that can be said for any parking in the Quarter. This lot has two entrances which makes it convenient considering the Quarter is a labyrinth of one ways. 

Why the 5 stars you may ask? On two occasions, they've gone above and beyond the call of duty. The first time I was dressed in my formal work wear, i.e. heels and a dress that doesn't allow one to bend. I was heading out for a date that I was already late for, and it wasn't a great day to begin with. I go scoop up my car from it's floor since this is when I had the parking contract, and as I'm leaving one of the attendants points out that my tire is COMPLETELY FLAT... F to the u to the c to the k. 

I get out and look at it for a sec, and then begin to take off my heels for the doable-yet -arduous task of changing my tire. That's when one of the attendants flips into NASCAR pit crew mode and changes the tire in, no joke, seconds. I tried to give him money but he wouldn't take it. I vowed to send in a review then, and I didn't, and I suck. 

Present day, I've been running around like a chicken with my head cut off, and a few to-dos and items sometimes get left behind. Today was nearly the breakdown when I realized something from an event hosted in the Quarter was missing. The only place I could've left it was the parking lot, and knowing how things move in the Quarter...I wasn't hoping for much luck. 

By the gods, they had it! In tact! I drove swiftly over to pick it up. Ella, who has worked their forever, and the only person I can remember a name for, is sweet and a great person to encounter when you're two seconds from pulling all your hair out. 

Thank you to the staff here who has always been great, and, again, I appreciate what you've done for me in the past and today!

Five stars is not enough ! They came in and wrapped everything up. They helped move out a king size bed along with couches boxes of clothes and books. Best price on town. Moving would've been such a hassle without them.

I think there should be an option of zero star because i don't want to give any star to this practice. I found this doctor through ZocDoc and for my my situation he was the only one available and i urgently needed to see the doctor. I trusted ZocDoc reviews which says 4.3 star (Fakes for sure) and set up my appointment for 11 AM. I reached doctor office at 10:30 AM for 11AM appointment. I filled up paperwork and approached reception and they asked for copay. I gave her a card and she said they only accept cash for copay. I did not have any cash so they said there is ATM downstair in convenience store. I took out the cash, not to mention paid ATM fees for taking out from non bank ATM machine. I paid the copay in cash and started waiting to be called. It was already 11:30 AM by now, but i have not been called for another hour or so and then i approached receptionist and they said there are another two patients ahead of me. I again started waiting and after another half an hour i was called and i went to consultation room. Nurse took my vitals and ask me about problem and said doctor will come and see you soon. But that soon was not soon at all, he came to room almost after an hour. I was sitting in room and pulling my hair for whole time and thinking where i got stuck. Doctor was nice and suggested treatment. I had few follow up questions on prescription and for that i have to wait for another half an hour for both nurse and doctor. Overall i went there at 10:30 AM and came out around 3PM. Total 4.5 hours for 5 min of doctor time. It was urgent for me therefore i waited so long. I lost 4.5 hour of wages, $15 parking. During my wait in waiting area i noticed almost 10 fancy Sales Rep going, in and out of office, i think doctor was busy seeing sales rep than actual patients. Also the staff was looking boring and rude, no smile on their face especially when you are dealing with patients. The whole waiting room was filled with people waiting for hours, not sure how these people were coping with this much wait time. Looks like this practice accept appointments much much above their capacity and they know that some people will leave without actually seeing the doctor therefore they only accept cash for copay and don't give you receipt at the time of payment but at the time of check out, so smart isn't it.

Coffee + Bar, for some those two things are enjoyed by many. Coffeebar in Reno is a great place if you're looking for a drink, something to eat, catching up with someone, or getting some work done. Depending on the time of day, it can get quite crowded making it hard to find a place to sit. They do have outside seating. It's my favorite when the weather permits. The parking here isn't bad as there's typically plenty street parking. 

The service and drinks here are amazing and is one of the reasons I come back time after time. Your drinks are made quickly and the staff is always nice. Coffeebar is one of my favorite places to go. If you're looking for a place you can't go wrong with coming here! Come check them out if you haven't already!

When I go to Boise, whether it's for a day or a month, whether it's hot or cold, I go to Bar Gernika for one thing... the spicy lamb grinder. It has everything you want and need in a delicious dip style sandwich. I will never go to Boise and not go to Bar Gernika. Period.

Very good food.  Call to make a reservation.  We called to get in on a Tuesday night and the earliest we could get in was 8pm for a party of 5.  Food was very good and they came around promptly with the food.  The selections on the food bar was excellent, not just salad, but pastas, soups (including a lobster bisque that was good) and my fav was the Fried Bananas.  We were celebrating my sons 18th Birthday and let the server know when we sat down.  They do sing to people, about 4 times why we were there, but they never came by and sang to him and we even ordered and paid for two desserts.  Cheesecake and the chocolate cake were great and each slice is enought to share for two.  Besides being dissed on the birthday celebration and cake, the place was great.  Oh, the only thing they missed on was to ask the idiot in a table behind us who wore a tshirt with profanity on the back to either put his jacket back on or leave, since this was a family restaurant (shirt had the f word on the back twice) and not a biker bar.

I really wanted to like this place. The owners are just so cute and friendly. Unfortunately, their corner-cutting means bad quality services for their customers.

I went here for a mani and pedi. The pedi was fine but not great-- it seemed a little rushed, but for the price, I didn't complain. The real problem was with the gel manicure. 

I opted for the gel manicure because they are supposed to last a minimum of 2 weeks and not chip. Unfortunately, within 2 days, large chunks of my polish was lifting and peeling from my nails. I called back and they did do a free fix of the nails (however, they guilted me in to getting an eyebrow wax that they charged me for). This time, the nail color peeled off in large chunks starting the day following my manicure. Within three days of the "fix", the polish is completely gone from 4 of my nails. 

I'm not positive what the problem is, but I think it is either the use of knock-off products ("GelArt" polish rather than Shellac), incorrect UV lights (I believe they used the same ones for acrylic nails), or poor control over the timing under the lights (while the UV lamp had a timer, they paid no attention to it).

If you're looking for somewhere for a quick and inexpensive standard mani or pedi, this place is just fine and the people that work there are great. However, if you want a gel polish manicure, don't waste your money here!
Amazing brunch. Amazing view!  Had a ridiculously quick trip to the Boathouse just before a flight. The staff rushed out food even with the place being packed.

I needed my makeup done plus just wanted to try new stuff I usually go to MAC but I have wanted a change. The reviews about the staff made me worried this would be unpleasant and I have had rude or unhelpful staff at other beauty stores but that was not the case here.  I am not the cliental for anywhere at green hills I am not rich, no fashion sense, pink hair with a tote bag as a purse. I walked in and was pleasantly greeted by different staff. Kelsey (hope I am remembering that right) did my makeup and she did an AMAZING job. Exactly what I was looking for I didn't feel uncomfortable she easy to talk to and seemed sincere. I ended up getting foundation, bright blush and eye makeup (to go with my hair) OCC lipgloss (the best colors need to go back and buy them all.) It ended up costing less that I expected and I wish I would have bought everything she used now that I think about it. I got my samples, which I didn't even ask for (only mentioning because some people complained they didn't.) I will mention this was in the middle of the week during the day so maybe that is why I got great customer service? But honestly while I was getting my makeup done Kelsey helped other customers without leaving me and I constantly saw sales people helping customers so seems like good customer service to me. Anyways pretty sure I am doing all my future makeup shopping here.

I'll put this out there and you guys can decide if you want to do business with this company. First off we showed up and the driver was not on board. The hostess proceeded to go over their 15 minute of rules and regulations and told us because she had to go over this it was 'on our time' and the trip would still end at the 2 hour time limit. Best part was, the driver did not arrive until after 20 mins of our start time (and 5 mins after the hostess's lecture). The hostess was so negative and literally felt like we were being scolded. She went into how she was going through a lot and her mom was sick, this would be her last day with the company so she didn't care if we had fun or not, it was and I quote, "On us to have a good time, not her responsibility for us to have fun". It was such a negative experience, it put a cloud over our trip. 

Here's the worst part, we messed up and two of our riders brought glass containers on the bus. I want to make this clear, we were wrong. It was clearly stated you can not bring glass on the bus. They should've known that. Now my African- American friend asked 2x if he could put his drink in a plastic cup before we left, she said, " No, you better chug it." My Caucasian friend asked her if he could put his drink in a plastic cup 5 mins later, and she provided and poured 4 cups before we left. I won't say it, but take it for what you will.

Just know there are companies that will appreciate your business much more, spend your money with them!!

Edit in response to the owner: why would my group ask to book her the next day when our flight was the next day at 9am? Sounds like a lie to me.

My friend absolutely asked for a cup for his drinks and even if he didn't, why didn't she offer it rather than to "jokingly" (which it wasn't) say chug it? Her entire attitude is what spoiled the trip, not just her sad story. Nice try in making us seem insensitive to her.

I'll be honest food trucks, I know you're a big thing these days and everyone loves you, but I just never really thought that eating awesome food while sitting on a curb ever really sounds appealing.  I take it back.  I take it ALLLL back for one reason and that is YOU Scratchtruck!  

After leaving the Yelp Bazaar last month, Stractchtruck was waiting outside for me - most likely resembling a "beacon (nay...bacon) in the night - you can ignore that joke and move on, but it's kinda funny.   

My fiance and I ordered our food and I got some sort of delicious goat cheese burger and fries.  We had to wait a good 20 minutes, but my god was this food outstanding!  Luckily for me, I only live a block away from the library so we were able to take our food home to enjoy (and didn't require me to eat gourmet food on a stoop)  - but I'll be honest, I'd eat that food again on a lump of jagged rock if necessary, haha!  

Oh and we also got some Poutine Fries as a side - needless to say, they were amazeballs as well!

I've wanted to come here since the opening but I was was afraid it was going to be packed so I figured I'd wait a bit until the newness wore off and hopefully the crowds wouldn't preclude me from sitting down and checking this place out. I made a crucial mistake in waiting so long since with a place like this, you want to go as much as you can.

The wine selection was awesome and the cocktails too but what makes this place awesome is that Nick Elmi didn't skimp on the quality of the food. It is quite excellent!

Loved it a lot. Will be coming back a lot more often!
This is a great little cozy Mediterranean place the food is awesome the host is super friendly and they make you feel like family.  The food is a good portion and cooked great.  Would definitely ret

Ordered online.  Said pickup 5:22pm.  I arrived early,  order not ready... no problem.   I go get my salsa to go.

5:35pm, I asked.   Was told their bagging it.  The girl that was doing my order was clearly new.  But no one was helping her.   She litterally stood in the middle of the line staring down.  

Then this is my food....

Stacker was not grilled, no shells in it.
And the quesadilla

Visited this establishment with friends. I have never had a more ridiculous experience than what we experienced tonight. A friend ordered a beer and it was obviously flat, so he let the waitress know and sent it back missing only the sip. She gave him a confused look, but asked what he'd like instead. She brought the second beer and miracle of miracles, it was flat too. Obviously, there's something wrong with the CO2 tank, but that's beside the point. The manager walks out obviously inebriated by what one can only assume is a "contact high." So, she tries to demand payment for the beer AFTER taking a "test sip" to see what the problem was. That's right. She tried his beer. So, after explaining that no one was paying for beer that wasn't consumed, and threatening to post our experience on social media, the manager told us to leave. As we were stepping into our cars, the manager came out to make sure she flipped us the bird. Now, there was no need for this. There were 8 of us in our party as only two had alcohol; we were not drunk, not disorderly, nothing. So avoid this place at all cost.

Love this place, wanted to go for years wherever I drove by other locations, but thought of it as basic franchise.........To my surprise the food, service and atmosphere are FANTASTIC!!!!......Only problem is this I have to be careful not to go to often

Fresh toppings, whichever ones you want, on a thin crust, cooked in a brick oven.  What more could you want?  Two different sizes, no matter which sauce or however many toppings you pick, it's one price for the mini and one price for the mod.


Thin crust pizza with your choice of fresh toppings, made while you wait.  Didn't know what to really expect and honestly, I wasn't expecting much.  HOWEVER...the pizza was good.  People were friendly.  I would definitely come back.

I'm so happy I found this place!!!! I moved here 6 months ago and my family has been crying for real Mexican food. We finally found it! Authentic Mexican SoCal street tacos super friendly service and great prices. We will definitely be back!

My husband raved about this place.  While visiting my husband in Spaks, he recommended we grab dinner at this place.  The experience was horrinle!  The food qas served cold, took 20 minutes to get our starter dish, the teriyaki sauce tasted like soy sauce, the zame server dropped solied dishes like 3xs, took 30 minutes to get our sampler tray.  The upside, the rotisserie  chicken was great, mac and cheese was delicious!  My husband stated that they went during lunch tine and everything was awesome.  May give them another try in the future.

This was my first eat indoor eating spot post vax. Showed up at opening time during dinner. It filled up and got pretty crowded for a tuesday night. sushi was very delicious and definitely a good AYCE deal. I came hungry and left stuffed. I'm coming back in 2 weeks when I am in town again.

WAY over priced. He charged $100.00 an hour, he charged us the most expensive break pads for my vehicle.
It's sad, because I've gone to this mechanic for a very long time and I am no longer going back. There's cheaper mechanics in the area, trust me.
My sister also had a situation with her car as well, they fixed the wrong problem and didn't even give her her money back for it.... this mechanic has known us for YEARS and didn't even give us a small deal? I'm very disappointed to even have to write this review. Just don't waste your money here.

Very good management. After a recent visit that didn't go as hoped, which inevitably happens sometimes, management did a great job to rectify the situation. Well run establishment with a solid menu. I'll be returning.

Two words: MIMOSA TOWER. Oh my goodness. Didn't even know this was an option here. It's an 88 ounce tower of mimosa that has a dispenser at the end. It's $40 per tower and serves 12 people. There were 13 in our party, so we ordered 2 towers. Sunday Funday was a success. 

We came here for brunch with a reservation for 11:30am. Christian was our server. He was a sweetie and laughed with us whenever we joked with him. He also took our group photo right before we left. Such a helpful young man. Thanks, Christian!
A woman (didn't catch her name) walked over to the table after Christian took our drink order and asked us if we were celebrating a special occasion since there were so many of us. She did take the time to acknowledge the 4 birthdays we were celebrating and that was very nice.  

I ordered the Veggie Benedict (can't go wrong with a Benny) and it was incredible. It has spinach, mushrooms, tomatoes and a poached egg and is topped with hollandaise sauce. I split the egg open with a knife and saw the yolk pour down onto my fries. What a beautiful sight. Home fries were crispy, and came with a side of ketchup. 

Parking here is a little difficult. They don't have a parking lot. The side streets are mostly metered parking, however, if you go on a Sunday you won't have to feed the meter. 

We were made aware that only 2 credit cards can be used per check. If you come with a group of people, be sure to bring cash. It'll be a whole lot easier. 

I have to mention how gorgeous the restaurant is inside. Very shabby chic and stunning at the same time. Great food and even greater service! Will be back here to try their lunch/dinner menu sometime.
It was a great experience!  Easy to book and get a price via email.  Francisco was so responsive.  My car looks amazing.  I am very happy and will be a return customer!

This review takes place during the pandemic.

Went there as I had a hungry child and another hour worth of driving to deliver a bunch of scout supplies to various kid houses.

The McDonalds had at least three people working, I suspect four but due to the Covid standing dot locations on the floor I was not in a position to watch much.

The dining areas were closed, the dots to stand were in the main areas and your option appears to be stand on a wall or order... ok, I'm not claiming they needed to remodel or anything here.

People approach from the left and the right and there's no real clear waiting space. Everyone who came in asked what they were supposed to do to order, were we in line, was this a line, was this waiting, where was waiting?

Basically bad. Combine with everyone being there 15+ minutes for no reason I could tell.

All that needs to happen to fix this: designate one door entry, one exit. Have a couple of arrows on the ground to indicate progression. Have a designated place to stand and wait because there was no off to the side waiting here forever line.

The Reno black bear diner is a lot quieter than the other BB diner's that I've previously been too. If you haven't been to BB diner your shocked by portions. They're huge and filling, So good also. The giant bear claws are not to be missed. Just go ahead and add one to the to go bag

Maryland Crab Seafood House is located in the former Extension Diner on Olden Avenue Extension, Ewing, NJ. It is the fish restaurant project undertaken by the proprietor of the Ewing Diner, a traditional Greek stainless palace nearby.

 The space is nicely renovated, but retains the familiarity of its beginnings with marble lunch counter and enormous slices of dessert cakes, pies and puddings. The service folk looked vaguely like the old staff at The Extension, but as it was many years since my last visit, I wasn't sure if we were all just older versions of our previous selves. They were well schooled in taking care of customers and made certain I had all the water and oven heated rolls I wanted.

I walked in after 3 and was hungry enough for dinner after skipping lunch and an early breakfast. I saw Flounder Francais on the Specials Menu, and stopped reading. As a Francais Fanatic there was nothing more to consider. Let's see what these guys could do with a favorite dish. 

The side Caesar Salad was big and fresh, but lacked anchovy based dressing. The small Dinner Rolls were excellent right from the oven with a tasty herb butter melting into them. The large plate with a bed of yellow rice under Flounder fillet dipped in egg and lightly sauteed in more butter, lemon and white wine was flakey and tender and seemed to have avoided freezer time.

 Its only shortcoming was caused by my expectation that it would be an Italian or French style finish with a pan sautee browning and thin lemon wine butter reduction. Rather, it was a much heavier bright yellow Greek gravy that was more a thick Avgolemono soup, than the delicate tart complement to the flounder. It wasn't bad, but just not what I envisioned.

That will remind me to live in the moment and leave expectations behind where they can't influence what's yet to come.
Not few places can make a good turkey meat loaf, with the right gravey and not so salt turkey. But Honeys! Had every perfectly done. I was happy :)

Not trying to dump on a small business, but we stopped in today after noticing they were open for dine-in.  We were confused as we thought we maybe walked into a daycare. Kids toys everywhere, adults tending to the kids, but no adults tending to seating us, but we saw a few menus on the counter and started perusing.  $18 dollars per person for a Tikka Masala?!  Not to mention what they charge for drinks...   Sorry.  I'm not down for a $50 dollar lunch for a dive under an interstate overpass bridge. I also noticed another bridge near-by was a local street art spot, and wanted to check it out. I was confronted by a couple of cooks possibly on a smoke break who have no business to be worried about what I was doing looking at street art on commercial property that they have nothing to do with. Mind your business, stay out of mine, if I want to look at the graffiti, your cooks have no place trying to police me off the lines.

I get lots of browser security warnings trying to visit their website.

I am in the process of bathroom remodeling, where I am buying materials and handyman is installing it.  My friend recommended me to Floor and Decor. This is my first ever project and I knew nothing about tiles, bullnose, showerpan.  Ms. Teressa has been wonderful. She patiently answered my questions, showed me options and helped me make the best for my money.  After ordering, I changed my mind (yep as someone told me to not use marble in shower), so I went again.  Ms Teressa again patiently went through with everything, and she even told me that I should not feel bad for changing at the last minute, she only wants to see me happy with my new bathroom. When I needed some other things, she helped me on the phone and got my order pulled out.  I am really grateful to her for helping me.  I would absolutely go to her again when I do my second bathroom.

This place was a pleasant surprise! I had tried rolled ice cream in the past but I didn't enjoy it because it was too icy for me and wasn't creamy enough so I have been skeptical to try rolled ice cream ever since. I had family in town this time and they never had rolled ice cream before, so I decided to take them somewhere close to home. Roulé is has a really cute atmosphere, and the workers were quick and helpful! There are two different sizes you can choose from and plenty of different flavors. I decided on a kiddie cup Cinnamon Toast Crunch and I added strawberry syrup and graham crackers. I finished the whole thing and wanted more after!! It was really good, and I loved how it wasn't too icy. I'm still more of a regular degular ice cream girl but I wouldn't mind coming here again for a rolled ice cream fix!

I would give this a zero if I could. The food was cold and absolutely disgusting. I tried a clam and honest to god it tasted like the smell of feet (obviously I spit it out). Still decided to give their other food a chance though. Tried to eat a stone crab and it smelt like urine. My fiancé and I hardly ate anything and ended up paying almost $40 for our "meals". Even their lo mein noddles were foul, like how do you mess that up? I will never go back nor recommend this place to anyone. Should have taken the drive and went to manor buffet in Lancaster.

I am not sure what the other reviewers are talking about!  Great service.  Hot bartenders (thank you Paulette and Kim).  Not a huge selection of beers but some Abita seasonals on tap and a great vibe.  We saw the great Little Freddie King play here and the acoustics are superb.  Food was great and Mike is a great cook and thanks to Matt for showing us a great time.  Better than 95% of the places in the quarter..   Will return!

On our constant search for new brunch spots, Allan G and I decided to try a new spot today. Well, not new exactly, but new for us. 

Not sure what took us so long, but I'm wondering if they've recently updated the breakfast menu. When I first looked at it when they opened, it didn't appeal to me much-- I have no desire to eat salad for brunch. But with their recent listing in Avenue as 2nd best brunch spot in town, I looked again, and noticed the waffles and crepes and other yummies, so we decided it was time.  

I was unimpressed with the seating options-- those silver metal chairs with not a lot of support and a pew style bench-- also not super comfortable. The decor was fun and interesting. But comfort counts for a lot. I was also kind of miffed that we were seated right next to a large group of six, even though there were other free tables not as close to them. But I guess since those were 4-seaters and there were only 2 of us, it was practicality. Still, we were there right when they opened, and didn't plan on lingering. The group was pretty loud, so that sort of bummed us out initially.

Allan G had the regular coffee (served with little mini milk bottle of cream. How cute is that?) and the Traditional breakfast-- eggs, sausage, toast, and a side of fruit. He proclaimed it satisfactory. 

In one of my sweet-craving moods, I had the latte with multiple spoonfuls of the dark brown sugar kept in a jar on the table. Good latte, but my only complaint is that with the tall glasses, it makes it far more difficult to drink while the drink is still hot. You burn your fingers. Might want to consider Irish coffee mugs or something a little easier to hold. 

My entree, the chocolate hazelnut crepes, were to die for. Crepes with a handmade chocolate-coffee flavored sauce, garnished with hazelnuts and fruit. I also got a side of the sausage. Yummy, with a little maple flavor. The crepes were delicious. I give extra points for the fruit being multiple types of berries, orange, and apple. SO refreshing that it wasn't melon, which I hate! Props for that. 

I'm subtracting a point for the sitting us so close to the group. Especially since one of the loudmouths seemed intent on talking about the poop/diapering habits of her child, which I SO want to hear about while I eat. Seriously, honey? Nobody gives a %^& about your kid's %^&. 

We're an in and out sort of dining couple. You can sit us further away, even if we take up more than 2 seats. We won't stay long.

Come hungry. Bring your appetite. 

These guys will serve you some authentic Vietnamese cuisine called : Pho -  soup consisting of broth, rice noodles called bánh ph, a few herbs, and meat, primarily made with either beef (ph bò) or chicken (ph gà). - as per Wikipedia. 

We really did not bother knowing the names of the dishes. Just try number 1,2 and 12. Everything is fresh and hot. Friendly staff and very affordable. 

They're also a big Philadelphia Eagles fan!

I thought I would like this place being that others had given it high reviews. I came with a friend, and we didn't have a reservation. We had to wait 30 minutes to be seating during a week night when there was a hand full of empty tables. We both noticed that it smelled weird inside the place like if they clean up with old rags with beer still on them. We tried to order their meat and cheese platter for a starter but they told us they were out of the meat. So we didn't get to try that.

My husband and I order delivery from here allll of the time. It's perfect because he loves pizza and I do not, and this is a local pizza place with a huge menu so we can both find something we love. He of course gets the pizza, but I'm a sucker for the tzatziki which I'm sure I just spelled wrong. We've never once had a bad experience with the food, the delivery, anything. It's great food, big menu, and fast service. Woot!!

We ate here as our last dinner in New Orleans.  The saving grace was that it wasn't crazy expensive but you get what you pay for and the food was not good.  Certainly after all of the amazing food we had enjoyed around New Orleans full of flavor and spice, everything we had was bland and cold.  Even the drinks were blah.  The only saving grace is that it is in a good location and that there was no wait.  I would not return or recommend.

This place is gross. Like scary not fresh not sure what's going to happen to my stomach gross.

I'm shocked at all the 5 stars. No flavor, old food, not even Cajun. Not sure what else I can add to that.

Cupcakes were dry, bland, unflavorful, and unattractive. We thought we gave it a try anyway. Even the server was not welcoming. I basically had to beg to get a cupcake out of the display. I guess the quality of cupcakes or any food in general are as good as the quality and care of the maker. I tasted pumpkin, red velved, and chocolate ganache and cake batter seems to be the exact same. Just a slight change of flavor from one to the other. Philly needs a Georgetown Cupcake.

Definitely one of the better Spanish places in all of st Pete although it's not owned by Spanish people they do a great job of bringing the flavor of Puerto Rico here to st Pete. Very nice selection excellently laid out and clean with generous portions and a very nice seating area inside. Although the shopping center there and does not look that great the inside is amazing. With very friendly staff

We came here on a whim because we were in the area and I had a friend mention this place before. She raves about their salads but I tried the gyro. It was good but not GREAT. Definitely not the best in the area. We sat outside and even though we came on a wednesday night when it wasn't busy it took the waiter way too long to get us our drinks and even longer to take our order. We could see him inside just chatting to his friends in the front. Would I come here again? Sure, if I was in the area and craving a gyro. Would I go out of my way to come here again or recommend it to someone? Probably not.

Perino's didn't really stand out to me in any above-average ways. You get a good amount of food with your order, but the prices are a bit steep for the quality of the food. Nothing seemed seasoned beyond a bit of salt and pepper, which is a shame because the seafood was fried well. 

We ordered po' boys, the bread of which could of been a little fresher. The condiments, like lettuce and tomato, came in a little plastic container. It was a build-your-own type deal, and it kind of felt unnecessary since we weren't eating it to-go. 

The wait staff seemed to do a whole lot of standing around and avoiding eye contact or just flat out ignoring diners. We just weren't impressed. I don't see us coming back to this location.

Best Thai food I have ever had .
Not even close , fried rice must have crack in it so addictive. 
Curry dishes are amazing, rice noodles and all the apps.

Went here for lunch today. Was not impressed at all. Service was slow even though there were a total of 5 people in the entire place when we arrived ( 3 with me, 2 at another table). It's quite possible that they were short because of the weather- didn't see why it was so hard to manage 5 patrons though.  My table all agreed that the food was lacking. My burrito was made without the salsa and sour cream that the description included. This left it dry and nothing special with just chicken and rice and beans. 

The place was cute and had a nice vibe so maybe I'd return for drinks- probably won't be eating lunch there again though

Fantastic staff. Lenny is great. He has a lot of experience in the food industry and deserves to be recognized for his improvements with staff at World of Beer. The staff was amazing. The restaurant ran out of champagne but only because of the underestimated business from the new changes they made internally. Overall good location and good service. Also Marilyn is the best and if you disagree you're a scumbag.

The restroom they had was terrible. It has no lock and the stall door had no lock either. It had no toilet paper in there. The staff are okay and there sandwiches are okay but I hated my experience with their restroom.
Why empty kegs in the bathroom? Why 2$ upcharge for hot romaine lettuce as "salad"? Why is pulled pork made with taco seasoning? Why dirty mason jars?

I made an appointment and wasn't acknowledged when I first came in but still filled out the time sheet for when I arrived and sat down.  Finally, 30 minutes passed my appointment, I nicely asked the lady if she needed any of my information and she rudely replied, no I will call you when I'm ready.  Then, 15 minutes later she called me up and we realized that I wasn't able to get my lab work done there.  I've been here before and this wasn't an issue so I never thought to question it.  I didn't appreciate her attitude and would have liked to know that there was an issue before I waited 45 minutes for no reason. I understand that there may be only one person working back there but the receptionist who is the first face to the company should be nice and helpful, no matter how frustrated or how quickly she would like to go home.  The customer service here is unacceptable and I would not recommend this location.  I had been there previously and didn't have as bad of an experience but still had to wait about 30 minutes passed my scheduled time, which is very annoying if you are coming during your lunch break, etc.  After leaving, I went to quest diagnostic without and appointment and had a wonderful experience and was done with everything in 20 minutes.  I will never go to lab Corp again.

Allright I'm upping my review. I have yet to find as tasty as a margarita as that served at Distrito. I crave these margaritas- they're that good!!! As for the food- the key is to order the right things. After trying a slew of items on the menu I would totally recommend the hamachi ceviche, the carnitas tacos, defin the guac!, the duck mole, and the crab enchilada...ok i'm drooling and i need a margarita!!
Loved the smaller location and sitting at the   Bar. Had excellent service and Teresa had a great personality and was lots of fun! Would go again just to see her again!

Great meal and great service make this a fantastic place to spend your evening. Started the meal with lobstercargot - delicious - be sure to sop up all the delicious butter with the sourdough bread! 

Grilled grouper with avacado salsa was moist and cooked perfectly. Blackened grouper was also fabulous! Fried grouper and fries was deemed , "grouper taken to the next level" by our son. He also raved about the fries - battered dipped and crispy on the outside with good potato flavor. 

The mango margarita was flavorful - the perfect porch drink. We ended the night with key lime pie that we shared - great culmination of a great meal. And, Rob, our server was super knowledgeable and responsive.

All around great experience and fabulous meal! We will be back!!

Had lunch at Vientiane Cafe.  Unfortunately, it wasn't any better than I'd remembered it.

Past experience with Vientiane Cafe indicates that one shouldn't order meat here. All the meat I've seen here has been overcooked. 

I ordered an eggplant veggie dish, which was poorly executed. The texture of the eggplant was not great -- it wasn't cooked well. The dish was edible but not very tasty. Disappointing.

My favorite Italian restaurant in St. Louis.  I liked the ambiance better before they built the addition, but I can't blame them for expanding, since the place is always full.  Everything I've had here has been delicious and the wait staff is very professional.

They have a separate Chinese men. It's quite small, but interesting. Tried the roast pork fine rice noodles and fish maw soup.  Pretty good. I'll try their roast duck and maybe give them another star. Friendly people.

Nail lounge now offers facials. I wasn't sure how it was going to be since they specialized in mani/pedi, but I am so happy I tried it out. I went in to get their anti-aging facial. I was greeted by a friendly staff. While I waited, I was handed a complimentary champagne glass. My aesthetician, Micky, was friendly and a great conversationalist. She made me totally comfortable and relaxed. Before I knew it, I was on cloud 9. After my facial, Micky gave me some pointers on how to keep my skin smooth and prevent wrinkles. My skin felt so smooth and it glowed. Even after a week later, I could see significant improvement. I would recommend, Micky, as their aesthetician to anyone. She was so nice, knowledgable, and made me completely relaxed. I felt totally pampered and most importantly, my skin benefited from her expertise and skills. Thank you, Micky for doing such an awesome job. I'll definitely be booking with you again!

Came here to catch a Cubs/Cards game. Beautiful stadium, I sat in Lower Deck so everything seemed easy to get to. Great views all around the ballpark. Even though my Cubs lost, still had a good time & it was a great atmosphere. Will definitely be back!

This place holds a special place in my heart.  It used to be called Natural Village, and I used to go several times a week in high school.  I spent so many stoned days here.  I went back recently, and it is almost as good as I remember.  The staff was sweet as ever.  The new decor borders on cheesy, but this place was never about looks.

Their veggie wonton soup is better than any normal wonton soup you will ever have.  In fact, despite my love for meat, I prefer all the vegan options here.  They are unbelievable.  I live in the city now, but any chance I get I go here.  It is never crowded and it is a crime.  This is the best Chinese I know of.
Saw Dan Cummins the other day staff was excellent and the show was phenomenal!!!! Definitely a big date place only recommendation if you want to spend the money get better seats it's worth it!

Starshine Salon is the best salon you can ever imagine. The girls here are so fantastic at taking care of you and doing anything they can to make it the best hair care ever. So far I have gotten my hair colored twice by Grace. Not only did she do a perfect job of multicolored look but she is such a sweetheart and puts so much passion into getting to to look just right! I have been so happy with my coloring and my family has adored it! If you ever need your hair done and want a fantastic experience definitely see Grace!!! You won't regret it!!
With the exception of some restaurants in Epcot this is by far the best theme park food we have ever had !!!!!!

Ordered from this food truck last week. It was REALLY GOOD. Only thing was lots of cole slaw and it was not really Asian style, more like wet Publix coleslaw. Next time I'll ask to have the slaw on the side as it made the tacos a little soggy. The crispy chicken tacos were awesome   I also ordered fried rice and it was delish

This join was a but out of sight until you realized it's a small establishment sharing the same building as Fred Meyer.

I had one of the freshest Banh Mi I've had yesterday and that prompted me to give this place another try when i noticed they got Pho. Word of advice (DONT COME HERE FOR PHO!) if I write this post for Pho, they would've got a bare minimal of 2 stars.

This 4 stars rating primarily on Banh Mi place in general. If they're trying to make it a competition with other American joints, they've fallen short on nickle&dime counting on their drinks. (No free cup o water y'all) However, have I mentioned the sandwich was really good? Really fresh vegetables, good pate flavor... I will definitely come back for more Banh Mi as matter of fact, just order #3 & #6 togo on top of my Pho ()

Excellent in all categories.  Fresh dough and toppings, all staff keeping busy, staff very friendly and very nice to my 5 year old daughter when she placed her own pizza order.  Love that they have gluten free crust that's made fresh to order.  Will definitely go back there!!!!!

I have never had a bad experience at Lighthouse Coffee, in fact, the friendly, outgoing and competent staff can make even the gloomiest of days better! I love their Dirty Chai Lattes, Blended Carmilla, and have never had a slice of quiche that was not delicious. Lighthouse coffee is the perfect neighborhood shop and I would highly recommend stopping in anytime you're passing by!

This is a nice Sephora located in one of my favorite shopping centers. Sephora carries some great brands and everything is displayed beautifully. I ordered online pickup which is so easy. They have the pickup stand right inside the front door which makes it a quick and easy transaction.

So fun, happy place-my kids loved it. I skated too, first time in a long time.
We'll definitely be back!

I have been going to this place for a very long time.
Knowing that it's an "all you can eat" place, I should say the quality of the food is pretty good and the price is a normal price for the service.
Parking may be difficult sometimes because the parking in front of the place is small and if they are busy, you may have to park on the streets south or north of the place.
I like the staff. They are very nice, helpful and friendly and they constantly make sure that the customers receive the best service.
Overall it's a very good place and I do go there once in a while and I enjoy the experience.

I discovered Lush when a friend gifted me with a bath bomb for my birthday last fall. Since then, I found their location at the Village and am there at least monthly - if not more.

First off, I adore this company as a whole. I'm a fan of anyone who focuses on lessening their footprint, hand-makes products, and fights animal testing! They're extremely innovative and continually seek ways to be better.

This Lush location is a prime example of what the company works to represent. Each time I've been in, the staff is friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. There is a large selection of products and the bath bombs are beautifully displayed. Plus, they always send me with the latest catalog and a sample of a new product. 

I also love that Lush focuses on naked packaging! Their shampoo bars are a prime example of that. 

If you're into health care / beauty products at all, do yourself a favor and checkout Lush! You'll definitely find something perfect for your needs.

Ugh as much as I love Los jefes they've really diminished on their quality of service. I'm not sure if it's the new hiring of staff or the fact that they might be getting more customers, but they barely meet my expectations at this point. After like 7 pm they say the wait is an hour, sometimes it's significantly less and other times it's even longer. You'd think since they added the hour time limit on tables sitting down and eating that they would actually be quicker at seating but it seams to be the complete opposite. This time they said "oh we don't have any tables open" as I saw 4 different tables open. It took me complaining to them that I knew for a fact they had tables open for us to get seated after waiting an additional 20 minutes.  Then after waiting the additional time it took atleast 20+ minutes to get the food and when we got it it was cold. So cold my friend's cheese on the taco didn't even melt. Either way, as much as I love the tacos, the service damn near makes the eating experience unbearable because of the wait times. And this is after begging my friend to come with me for Taco Tuesday for weeks. So thanks Los Jefes for embarrassing me food choices lol. Maybe you can just have luck and be seated and eat quicker but thats up to you. May the odds he ever in your favor.

The chips and salsa are a great start. The salsa is a Pico de Gallo - very fresh. The tortilla soup with chicken is creamy and delicious. The veggie burrito is my go to item on the menu. This is not your typical heavy or greasy Mexican food. The service is the best.
Aerobe has gone down, no one checked how our food was. The food was horrible. I wouldn't recommend and won't go back.

Do not come to this place.My experience was awful.First of all, there has got to be roaches infested within the walls, basements, and I'm sure in the kitchen as well.My family and I dined here a while ago and during our dining, a COCKROACH CRAWLED ONTO OUR TABLE. #EWW I even saw a cockroach on the walls.Now if cockroaches are just crawling around like that, I could just imagine the amount of cockroaches within the kitchens.I was so disgusted I just couldn't enjoy my dining.

Fabulous family restaurant with great food and friendly staff. The dishes we got for pick-up were fresh and flavored "hot" just as we requested, which doesn't happen everywhere! My parents have been here before too and loved it. All around a terrific neighborhood place. I used to live closer, but am willing to continue to drive here for super tasty Indian food. Highly recommended.

I eat gluten free as much as possible and really like Chipotle for value and good food. My favorite is a burrito bowl with chicken, and I love the lime flavored rice. They add a little cheese, some fresh mild salsa, little sour cream, and lettuce. It a whole lot of food for the money. My son's favorite is the steak burrito, and he gets double meat and can never finish it. He loves the chips and salsa too.
Not just Indian! They have some incredible modern jewelry pieces! Friendly and knowledge staff.
Great service! I like the upfront prcing. I highly recommend Hoffman Electrical.

Usually, I've had good meals here but certainly not yesterday. Had been wanting to have quiche -- sadly, their delivery of that item hadn't arrived, so ordered my other usual favorite: chicken salad on croissant. What a disappointment. The croissant was small and stale; the chicken salad  was just not up to par. Overall not happy with lunch at all. Not likely to return soon.

A stop a MUST make when visiting Philly. What can I say about Sabrina's--whether it's the Fairmount location or South Philly house--both do NOT disappoint. Over the years, I've pretty much ordered everything from the brunch menu, always with leftovers and never unhappy. Some favs are the stuffed french toast, egg white fritatta and egg white turkey bacon fritatta. 

One thing to note though is there will almost always be a wait so take a stroll around Ben Franklin Parkway or don't come in a large group (it's easier just to grab a bite to eat at the bar) The staff are always friendly-don't let the tattoos fool you.

Business has picked up and is better then it was. The last to times we have been in the servers were both friendly and efficient. Food was served hot and correct and drinks were never empty. The French dip is AWSOME and the rolls are the best. I love the loaded potato soup. Tonight Anthony was the best. We Will be back soon. Oh can't forget the pie!!!

New pub restaurant in the Strathcona Hotel. Inside is cosy and not too big.  Walls pasted with posters and clippings and photos. Casual tables and high tables.  Casual inside. There is a patio with picnic tables outside. Full sized 20 oz pints of beer. Typical pub food. Burgers and appetizers, poutine and breakfast.  I had a quesadilla and added chicken to it.  It was filling. Is part of a chain. Staff were friendly.
Love their baked seafood and sushi. They are so delicious! The rolls are super affordable, but they can be pretty sweet for some reason. Service is always excellent as well.

Trash Company, such poor service. When I called them and would like to ask some questions, they answered the question rudely. Then my uncle wanted to confirm the answer, the operator told us they even did NOT want to repeat the answer again, OMG. Hate this place.
Excellent food. Best calamari I ever ate. Excuse my brevity, I'm having drinks at Lana's atm.

The cheese shop is top notch, the sandwiches are the stuff of dreams, and they have the KINDEST staff. We always eat here with our five kids when in SB, and we haven't had so much as an eye roll from them. In fact, they go out of their way to answer their questions and treat them with dignity. PLEASE hurry and finish the extra space!!! More is better! TIP: truffle grilled cheese sandwich.

Got a vanilla malt. It was disappointing, lacking malt flavor and not very creamy. Most fast food places are putting out better milkshakes, pales in comparison to other ice cream shops in town like the screamery. 

Might give the place another shot for their breakfast. Won't be getting ice cream here though.

It's great!  I really like the Jessica Rabbit. It's great to have a sandwich place with so many special dietary options. The parking is a little bit less than desirable but I definitely think the sandwiches are worth the hassle.

The decor of the restaurant was all over the place.  It was a bit overwhelming and dingy. We almost walked out, but am glad that we stayed because of the food.

My family enjoyed our dinner.  We had the Kartoffel puffer pancakes as an appetizer with apple sauce.  They were greasy but yummy.  My daughter had chicken Spätzle with tomato sauce.  I had Jäger Schnitzel with Spätzle and my wife had Jäger Schnitzle with fried potatoes and onions.  It was all good.  For dessert, we shared a crepe with blue berry marmalade.  A drizzle of chocolate sauce covered the top.  The crepe was wonderful!

The highest compliment came from my daughter who said, "This is really good.  German food should take over the world!"

Next time we come I want to try some wurst!

The one criticism of the food that I have - it needed salt.  I read many reviews asking for salt.  As someone who has hypertension I appreciate that the chef is concerned about my blood pressure.  My blood pressure is treated and I want the chef to prepare my food with the proper seasoning with his pallet.

My son took me to El Torito this past week for dinner and I have to say we were very impressed.  Our server Jose took very good care of us, despite how busy it was that night. Our food came out nice and warm, and sadly we had no leftovers to take home for the next day because we ate everything on the spot. We will be coming back soon to try their Sunday Brunch.

Kinni you not right now?

They make a lot of Fresh Foods and some of them are exported to America which is where I've tried them. Usually by land... trucking, I think.

They're actually pretty good. A nice Canadian company that has probably better standards of what goes into their stuff that America does. But then doesn't every country?

I went here with a friend last week and had a pretty good meal.

Pros:
-Great tasting & affordable wine
-Trenton Pie was delicious, one of the top 5 pies I've ever had. I will be back for this!
-Serving sizes were good - a little large, but I was really hungry so it worked for me!
-Super convenient to PATCO

Cons:
-Server was really rushing us; it seemed like he was trying to get us to put our initial order in ASAP. I believe he came back 4x to ask us for our order, including once when my friend was in the bathroom, to ask us for our order. 
-The table next to us received their apps & pizza at the same time; luckily, our app & pizza was nicely paced. They were not happy....
-Arancini appetizer was just OK and was burned a little on the outside. I like it crispy, but it was a little too crisp. I wouldn't order it again.
-My friend's Margherita pizza was good, but was really 'floppy' and hard to eat..it was hard to even lit off of the plate.

I really like this spot and their sister store off of South Street and will for sure be coming back soon! I'm already craving the Trenton pie...

I obviously came here because I'm a fan of It's Always Sunny. Got Caribbean jerk tenders. Little pricey for just 3 strips and nothing else (13ish dollars) but tastes really good, also, I'm on vacation so price doesn't matter to me haha Also got a Mac's tea, hard initial hit with mellow aftertaste. Really good. Nice servers. Standard bar atmosphere.

This place is top notch and it is practically downtown. Do you want to buy something in a box that has been on the shelf for who knows how long? Then you will want to go somewhere else. Everything is as fresh as it can be and the grains are ground while you wait. AWESOME. Plus every recipe is tailor made to match your home brewery. Extract? They have it. Partial mash? Yep,  same recipe and the right ingredients. All Grain? You bet ya. Oh, want to do an all grain batch in your kitchen? Check out the Tuxedo Park Brew Cube.....you may never use that turkey fryer outside again.

BTW, the prices are competitive with anything you can find on-line...so don't do that and instead go to Tuxedo Park Brewers Supply.

I recently moved here from Chicago and frequented a couple of brewings supply stores there. The shops in Chicago were great but the staff was talented wihtout being super helpful. If you can imagine going into the bike shop with a flat tire. Most bike mechanics can change that tire in a few seconds. However, ask the mechanic to show you how to do it so that you might repair it yourself sometime instead of walkind the bike home. Most mechanics will give you a funny look and expect you to somehow figure it out for yourself. This is the way homebrewing staff was in Chicago, they were very knowledgable but could not really identify with you as a beginner. 

Not so the staff at Tuxedo Park Brewers Supply. They seem genuinely interested in helping me become the best brewer I can be. Of course they are happy to sell me freshly made kits from any of thier 100 or so tried and true recipes. They even ask me questions that lead me to think about my brewing process and how I may improve it. 

I should mention that this shop is a little bit hard to find since it is an alley suite. Don't  despair, turn in at Brass Ring Lounge, go to the alley, turn left and go past the Teamsters Union Hall. I promise you that you will not miss the shop.

Great hole in the wall. I started going here before the were 'found'. Also before the spruced the place up. I kinda miss all the Christmas ornaments they had hanging from the ceiling. 
The salt and pepper calamari is the bomb! I have ordered this at other places and no ones (so far) holds a candle to Yummy House's. 
I enjoy their Malaysian style fun chow and their duck is good.  
It's family style so take your friends and family.

This is a great local place. On the water with fire pits and live music. Good variety of food from seafood to salads. Weekday happy hour and $3 draft prices. Very casual and great place to see the sunset. They also offer rentals like pontoon boats and kayaks.
Good place.  Large room more like an apartment then a hotel. Nice workout area.  Hot water could be warmer.  Staff nice and friendly  and would stay here again

Not the best and not the worst zoo I have been too, though I did find it a bit disappointing for the cost of parking ($5) and admission ($15/adults).  Call me crazy, but the zoo seems to be lacking in animals altogether.  No dolphins?  No seals?  No walrus?  The aquatic offerings were very lackluster.  Unless I missed them, there were also no bears of any variety.  There just wasn't much to set this zoo off from any other zoo.  No wow factor.  I did like the animal habitats.  They were large and very natural.  It seemed like someone took a park or wooded area and decided to throw down some paved paths and call it a zoo.  I also noticed several families rolling around coolers and enjoying picnics throughout the zoo which is nice because oftentimes you can't take outside food into a zoo.  Plenty of walking to and from the different animal habitats and again, very natural.  I would probably skip this the next time I am in Nashville as it ends up being a bit pricey for what is offered.

We fell upon this cute cafe while on our way to the Largo Medical Center. We got the Belgium waffle, Loraine quiche, and egg, bacon and cheese sandwich. Belgium waffle had amazing flavor with just enough cinnamon. We love the quiche - was flaky and crisp where needed.  My son loved the egg sandwich.  Ice and regular coffees were great as well.  The team there were so nice and excited for be working here.  So cute!! We will be back!!
Very knowledgeable staff in aquatics! Great product selections!

Dammann's has always been a favorite nursery of mine for years.  Their various choices of different types of plants is basically unmatched by any other greenhouse that I am currently aware of in the metro area.   

I was excited to discover this greenhouse many years ago.  I pay them a visit every growing season.   It's just cool to walk around all of the vast space of  greenery and see what they have, even though I do not remotely have room for most of it in my garden or landscaping plan/scheme.  In the past, I have found many obscure and hard to find types of plants at their greenhouse. Most of what I have found there can only be found on the Internet otherwise. 

The staff is always helpful and very knowledgable.   Their prices are fair enough, especially considering that you can find so many varieties of plants.

Customer service is terrible! Worse Sephora I've been to. Been shopping in the store for over 30 mins and was completely ignored by every staff member in the store even while at the register! Horrible

Unfortunate, but I'll keep it honest.  My food was spoiled.

I ordered miso love chicken and the Seoul burger for a friend and I, to go. We both agreed the miso dish was off.  I thought it might have been the chicken, but my friend confirmed it was the coconut milk because he is familiar with the taste.  Really disappointing considering the stellar reviews and I loved the look/vibe.

For what it's worth the Seoul burger was great. It was fun, tasty and the fries were phenomenal.  I'm a fries enthusiast and its my go to side.  My friend also really enjoyed the pickled cabbage.

Still, spoiled food is an immediate blacklist for me. One should also then question food quality and kitchen practices.  I hope this experience was an outlier and wish this place future success, but as for me "once bitten, twice shy."
Delicious! You've seen the reviews. It's totally true.

Their motto is "a penny saved is a penny earned."  Well if I had a penny for all the BS excuses I was given, I could've gone with a more reliable, but slightly more expensive, contractor.  Like other reviewers, I called Lincoln after they did my home inspection and promised me a discount if I used them to update my system.  After receiving the estimate they told me the discount only applied to repairs, not new systems.  That should've been my first clue.  

I was promised an install date 4 weeks after I sent in the deposit.  It took  two more months and lots of phone calls before the project was completed.  Here is a list of the excuses:
-The permit took a while. I found out these permits are issued on the day they are requested
-The the equipment wasn't readily available
-The truck broke down
-They have personnel issues
-They needed a part and had to make sure it was the right one

When the job was started, the crew worked for two days promising to return and finish it the next day.  They showed up 3 weeks later.  The office told me it was because they needed a part, but the crew never said they needed a part and upon finally returning told me they were short handed.  I am dreading what will happen if, like other reviewers, something goes wrong.  The system has yet to be inspected, so we will see.  

The only reason I gave them 3 stars was because the workers were nice and professional.  I don't think it's their fault.  Every time I hear their commercials I feel sorry for the future customers.

So don't let the fact that this place is tucked in a Best Western fool you - it's DELICIOUS. Our sandwiches, drinks and dessert were all fresh tasting and full of flavor. The waiter was warm, knowledgable and hilarious. We can't wait to come back to try breakfast and lunch!

i cashed out here on a bunch of knitting supplies for my grandma's 74th birthday because she is obsessed with knitting. She has actually created some sweaters that I wear pretty often because of how dope they are. The selection here is great and the owners are such wonderful people, they helped me out personally

i have been tanning with pacific sun for quite some time and have NEVER been treated like the way my sister and I were a few weeks ago! We were actually accused of stealing rugs, towels, deoderant and you name it.! It all started when I bought a bottle of lotion and then like an idiot, i purchased the tanning accerlerator  to go with it. The guy behind the counter, who, which by the way was super stoned I swear I could have flossed his eyelids with dental floss...thats besides the point and none of my business however he told me to pour the accelerator into the bottle of lotion and when i did the lotion exploded on me. At that moment the "manager in training" came into the building to begin her shift. Now mind you I havent even made it into a room yet and they both refused to replace my old empty bottle of lotion with a new one. They said they could not do returns or exchanges. My credit card was charged almost 80 dollars and they pretty much told me sorry for your bad luck and I am now 86ed from all pacific sun tanning salons. I was humiliated and horrified. They are all a bunch of stuck up snobs who have not a clue how to run a business. How does a manager not have the authority to refund or  exchange a product  when she clearly watched the entire thing happen???? AWFUL!!

I enjoy coming in this store because of the selection. I have an old school Nintendo ds and I can still come here and buy games for it so...you guessed it...that's why I was there. 
There inventory was pretty picked through from the holidays but no worries! I'm sure new games will come in soon. 
The store was empty so I got the run of the whole place to myself ha ha! The employee was respectful and polite. The older I get, the more I appreciate that quality. 
Even with a small selection, I found a couple games to keep me occupied for a few months! I'll be back!!!
Good Tex-Mex food. The restaurant seems always busy as it is a local favorite. I would recommend for anyone in the area desiring Tex-Mex cuisine.

So underwhelming. Due to horrible planning, I just wanted some brunch without an hour plus wait during MG weekend. Came in and went to the bar. Took forever to get a menu. The brunch menu wasn't that great with hella limited options. Ordered the crab omelet and I've had better food at a waffle house. Unseasoned, about 2 or 3 pieces of tiny crab. The begneit fries were cute and good. Ordered a voodoo brew, once again, nothing special.

Other than that, I wish I read the reviews.

They are not at all clear with their billing process. they do not tell you how much it will cost until after the work is done.  very poor communication between the people that work there .  they need to have their policies written up and sent out.  i specifically asked the tech if there will be a charge for today; is this covered under my cleanup agreement with them and he said yes when i told him the agreement that i have. the tech that came out today said they do not have a system to do that.  really??? they are a computer tech company; surely they should be able to get a business program(s) set up.  totally disrespectful to their customers in this respect.  they need to get their act together administratively.  the technicians  know their stuff but dealing with any other aspects of the company has been a nightmare

I am about to re-send a fax to Cenlar FSB for the 3rd time to have them make a minor change to my Escrow. Prior to that, I wrote two letters regarding the same issue without hearing back from them. Before that, I called them 3 times: the representative said she "took care of it", while in reality she did nothing! If CENLAR is running for the "shittiest business in milky way", I think they are on the right track
After calling for two days I finally managed to arrange for someone to come out and give an estimate. The guy never showed up nor did I receive a phone call asking to reschedule. No thank you.

Still consistently one of the best restaurants in Reno. We haven't had a bad meal and everyone we recommend it to always loves it. I've had a few of their soups for lunch and the Reuben is excellent. My wife usually gets the NY steak for dinner while I love the Wild Boar. Also, they do great cocktails!

Don't go to Cabela's in Christiana if you are purchasing any type of firearm. I mistakenly purchased a 22 rifle here and went on Cabela's online after the purchase. I found they had 2 SKU's for the same item and I was charged the higher price. I returned to the store and pointed out the issue and asked for a partial refund. I spent 30 minutes reviewing the specs with an associate who agreed with me. He went to speak with his manager (Cameron) and returned by himself and told me they had differences "internally". It was absolutely a lie made up to refuse issuing $120 credit. Shame on you Cabelas in Christiana.

Let me start off by saying that I was raised on juicing (it is a big part of Latin American-Hispanic culture) and although I juice at home almost everyday, it's nice to have a place to pick up a freshly made juice whilst on or near South Street.  I was disappointed when Whole Foods, which is across the street from Sip N Glo, closed down their fresh juice bar, so it was a very smart move on Sip N Go owners' part to open up shop.   I am also very pleased that they offer freshly made wheat grass juice, as most juicing places I have come across in Philadelphia do not.  Also, I do not own a wheatgrass juicer.

My only complaint is that they are a bit pricey.  If they were to open up ANOTHER Sip N Glo in zip code 19125 (Fishtown) the rent would be more affordable for them, and they could then pass along the savings to their customers .  **Hint**HINT**  :)

Food is always good, and cheap for the ampunt, staff is extremely nice, and although there is sometimes a wait it is never long, always satisfied with eating there and it's hard to not be with the high quality of service, and food

The scenario:  the kids were at my parents and we wanted takeout dinner but something more elevated.  

The background:  my friend from college, Chef Brian, has been sharing pictures of his dishes for years on Insta and they always looked incredible.  Fast forward to 2020, Chef Brian is at The Goat's Beard and I finally have a chance to taste his food!

We ordered:  street corn salad, brisket mac & cheese, pork fried rice, sticky ribs, and pineapple upside down cake

We loved:  everything!  Seriously, it was all amazingly delicious and nothing was lost due to it being takeout.  It was the perfect balance of eating creative/delicious food and not having to wear shoes (or pants).
