We didn't like:  the fact that we didn't order more.  Don't get me wrong, portions were just fine and it was more than enough for 2 people - but, I would've eaten more of it the next day.

In sum, you have most likely seen menu items like this before but all meals are not created equally.  TGB strikes the right balance between rich and thoughtful flavors without leaving you heavy and sedated.  You will not be disappointed!

We turned a walk in closet into a bathroom.  These guys were the very best from start (quote) until it was finished.  They performed all plumbing perfectly and with a very reasonable price.  I would most certainly use this company again.

First night in Nashville. Ended up at merchants because the reservations we had at another restaurant didn't pan out. The restaurant was closed. Merchants got us in within 5 minutes. The blackened tilapia was amazing!!! I would 100% go there again and likely get the same thing. Service was great. Drinks were tasty.

Fantastic place!  Live band, 3-story "longest" bar, a car mounted on the wall, and Elvis and other celebrity costumes decorating the walls.  We went to the third-story roof bar and had a couple of drinks and watched the people go by on Printers Alley.  We enjoyed it so much we went back the next day.  Very Fun.
Great addition to town. Great pizza (We have Big boy), Greco salad and hot honey sesame wings (which is less crispy than normal wings). Good service.

Awesome! The Heart Beet juice is very hearty and refreshing (I added kale for an extra boost and because I love the flavor). I ordered the veggie sandwich, the balsamic pesto was perfect!

This place has lots of veg and vegan options, check it out!

Omg I love the decor it is so chic!!! Beautiful marble table and plenty of seating. 

Pork belly 5/5 yummy crispy and flavored just right

Zucchini salad 3/5 ehh it was okay I like zucchini but the dress was very mediocre it tastes like Caesar salad dressing

I would definitely stay here again.  Tucked off into a lovely neighborhood few miles from the major tourist sestpools.   Walking distance to live music and neighborhood bars. Nicest place I've ever stayed.  Romaine blinds, antique furniture, dish TV tall windows to let the sun in while taking a morning shower.  Hardwood floors. Man hold up.

  Dedicated bus line to the French Quarter till 6pm where it's about impossible to find somewhere to park!    If you plan on being out getting your swerve on after dark on bourbon st you'll need to grab a taxi.

Two thumbs up

I live a few miles from this site and it is not in the best neighborhood. I go through it any time I have business at the county offices. It really is the area you don't want to linger in unless you've got some sort of Charles Bronson life quest going.

And it's not fair to blame the rank and file behind the counter for a cheap paint job or the quality of a bathroom shared with a gas station.

That having been said this is a place to avoid. it has now made news for an employee beating a customer unconscious with the TV news showing him brutally kicking the man when he's down. 

and even that I can't site the other employees for it, though let's be honest that alone is enough to avoid this place. where the real problem comes in is how the staff responded. Local TV news crews were just told to get out and it was 'private property' when they went to the employee's last known address a foul mouthed woman, IN McDONALD's UNIFORM greeted them (ha!) at the door and said, with several expletives, if they told you to get out at the McDonald's why do you think we're going to talk to you. It was clear the McDonald's had called the house to warn them. So in uniform and swearing and clearly the go to is COVER UP. 

At that point you can hold them accountable. this isn't a case of "I can't believe I work in a place where someone did this" so much as it is complicit in the act by not being up front and swearing while in uniform without a disclaimer or any statement, from management shows how this place is run.

Cleanliness, and food quality have been cited often enough in these reviews and the fact that homeless panhandlers are not stopped from harassing customers but when it reaches the point of not only criminal assault but a culture of 'cover up' instead of even a normal  corporate blank statement of we do not endorse..' or 'our customers are our greatest concern...' then clearly this is a place corporate management should take steps to removed form their books.

I had the worst experience of any medical professional ever.  I couldn't get in to see the doctor so they had me see Stacey Scrogin, NP.  Even then, I had to wait months for an appointment.  She was rude and even insulting.  She rushed through the appointment.  She would ask a question and interrupt before I could fully answer.  She rushed me out the door telling me to simply change the shoes that she "assumed" I would typically wear.  After a long delay in the waiting room and a rushed appointment, I left having no idea what is wrong with my feet.  No diagnosis or at least not one that she took the time to provide.  As I drove home, I began to cry.  I realized that this "nurse" made me feel bad about myself.  She made me feel small and stupid.  She has no business working with the public and most certainly not in a role of providing "care".

Great food. Casual dining. My wife had the potato crusted salmon. Boy what a creation. Very very good. The garlic mashed potatos were also great. I had the grouper Kingston which was spicy but not too spicy and also awesome. Service was great as well. Price was great for what you get.
Quite possibly one of the worst hotels I've ever stayed in, staff has no idea what's going and are extremely rude.

Another score for FL. Walking distance from the beach, fair prices and a nice overall vibe. My favorite part of our meal was actually their key lime drink. So good! I also had the blackened grouper, oysters, mussels and crab. They all had nice flavor.  TJ was my server and he did not disappoint. Without him, I might've skipped up the key lime drink and that is unacceptable now that I've tasted it.

Apparently my family came here when I was a toddler, probably around '89, and someone broke into our conversion van and stole the TV and my brother's Yankees cap.  I don't remember all that, but now after a 23 year hiatus I have a different story to tell.  I've been to the zoo twice in the past year and both experiences were just awesome. 

The first visit was as a chaperon on my students' class field trip.  The entire 7th grade was bused over to the zoo and had an amazing time.  I could not believe how large this place is after driving past it twice a day for two years and basically writing it off.  It's huge inside and there are so many cool animals to see.  Everything from lions, tigers and bear (oh my) to rhinos, kangaroos, penguins, and giraffes.  So cool.

My second visit was just a week ago at Boo at the Zoo.  What a great experience that was.  I got my brother & sister-in-law to bring my 2 year old niece out, in costume of course, and spend the day in the city with us.  She had a blast.  Checking out all the animals she loves, seeing all the costumes of the other children, and even taking a pony ride, we couldn't have asked for more.  

Such an awesome experience.  Only downsides are the ticket expense, about $20 per person, and the parking, crowded and $15 per car.  Other than that, I have no complaints.  If you're a teacher, be sure to get your free summer long pass!  One of the best deals in Philly for sure!  Highly recommend checking out the Philadelphia Zoo.

Food quality has dropped so much this year. The pork cullet has three times flour more than n the meat. It used to use pork chop but now it's some grand pork.... The tanpanyaki is also  not as good as before. Really dry
Amazing food but the prices are just a little unreasonable. The food really is great. I've been about four times.
Lunch buffet is worth the money if you're needing a pizza fix.  Enjoy

I came to Splitsville after dinner to check it out for drinks and dessert. I know it's main attraction is bowling and I have been to a few Splitsville before but wanted to see what this location was about. We were immediately seated and ordered drinks and the sprinkle and bacon pecan donuts. It was fairly quick to get our order and we enjoyed chatting and the donuts. The donuts were the same base donut just with the different toppings. We got our checks and waited for our cards to leave. When I got my bill back they had run my card but not provided the receipt to sign. We waited a while but couldn't find our waiter and it was too loud to flag down someone else. I went to the hostess booth were there seemed to be a manager standing too. I explained that my card had been charged and didn't get the printed receipt to write a tip or sign that I authorized the charge. I was concerned with just leaving because I didn't want to be charged or have any issues with my card. The manager took my receipt and book and looked for my waiter. We stood around and she returned but didn't say anything to me. I asked if I was free to leave and she told me the waiter would come to talk to me. After another 5 minutes (total 25 mins looking for him, giving my receipt back, and waiting for someone to update me) I got a fully processed receipt and was told it must have fallen out which didn't make me feel any better that my info could be laying around the restaurant somewhere. I quickly signed and the waiter had left again so I had to leave my receipt with the hostess. Their lack of communication and concern was a little off putting. I was doing my due diligence to make sure there weren't any problems and they didn't seem like they overly cared and I didn't enjoy sitting around waiting for someone to come help me after I was trying to leave too.

I never leave reviews but I walked out of there crying. Please do your research and go elsewhere. It took longer filling out the paperwork than it did for the doctor to see me about my visit. She didn't even go over my teeth in the X-ray, but actually pointed out my sinus infection instead of what I was there for. After that, a young lady at the front desk printed off my bill, for $3,000. That would've been $1,000 per tooth extraction. Couldn't be me. I asked if there was any way I could make payments and she proudly told me, "You could pay half now and half the day of." I brought up the CareCredit brochure that I saw in front of me but she said she didn't know how that worked. So I obviously didn't feel welcomed so I cried. The ladies at the front desk sat three to one computer but not one greeted me when I came in but were quick to tell me "have a great day" as I'm walking out crying. I'm upset because all the reviews here are great which only gets me thinking if they're fake. Please go anywhere else but here!
I love this place!! I called and ordered and then went to pick up, ordered a crawfish platter and an additional pound of crawfish and was so pleased.

They have a bar and food is brought to your seat, so that's nice. But overall it's an awful place to watch a movie. 

I go to about 30 movies a year... this is the only theater I've been to that consistently has noisy audiences either talking to each other or yelling at the screen. 

I asked management to quiet a noisy audience member (first time I've ever done that) and they did nothing.

I won't lie I'm not a big breakfast eater but I throughly enjoyed my breakfast. Everything tasted so authentic I could tell it was made fresh. Everything came out just how I wanted and I got it delivered. My food was still warm and enjoyable. I'll definitely be eating breakfast more but this time at the restaurant.

Best wings outside of WingStop! Since there is not a WingStop near, this will be my goto place! The Chinese food is not bad either, it's better than ChinaKing. The chicken fried rice was very fresh, right amount of grease. 
The place was clean, good seating area if you choose to dine in.

Best restaurant I have been to eat really good sushi, wide variety of sushi and other Japanese appetizers. They have karaoke thurdays nights and it gets really busy! Every night they have sushi for a half price. My favorite place to go when I am craving sushi!!

This is our 5th transaction with Clay Glover in 3 years, both buying and selling- so we're obviously very satisfied with the knowledge and level of service he provides!  We are consistently impressed by Clay's ability to efficiently and equitably negotiate deals.  He finds a creative, insightful approach to address any issues that may arise.  His depth and breadth of knowledge of real estate and the local neighborhoods is unparalleled.  We will ONLY use Clay in the future and highly recommened him to anyone looking to buy or sell a home!
Great food.  The tacos are TJ style. The corn (elites) is awesome like the street vendors in Mexico.  Great experience.

TL:DR - A Mexican place that happens to serve Chinese food. I found myself constantly saying, "It's not bad, but it's not great either" but wasn't bad enough to give it 3*s. It's fine.

Stopped by after my friend was like "NEW ASIAN MEXICAN FUSION SPOT" and also seeing Max's glowing review. I will say that this place does less of a fusion and just more of a "we have Mexican and Chinese food on the menu separately." Really the only crossovers are you can get Mexican rice (if you wanted) with the Chinese dishes and Chinese fried rice with the Mexican dishes as well as offering teriyaki chicken as a protein option in the tacos/burritos/quesadillas. In addition, it honestly feels more of a Mexican place that serves Chinese food, vs. the restaurant Golden Wok (that used to be where the Dorsett Sushi Ai is now) that was a Chinese place that served Mexican food. The clientele, music, and staff were mostly Mexican. Again, not a bad thing, just something to note.

My partner and I ordered the sweet and spicy chicken and the Chipotle Chicken Noodles based on the recommendation of our server. The sweet and spicy chicken was really good. It had a Thai sweet chili sauce base that was a bit more spicy and a little less sweet, which was perfect. The outer crust of the chicken wasn't super thick like Panda express, but still had a nice crunch. The Chipotle chicken noodles were super confusing to me, not in a bad way, but just something completely different than anything I've ever had before. The coconut cream and Chipotle flavor has so many complexities that I wasn't sure if I liked it, but kept eating it. It has a little bit of Thai Yellow curry in it (probably the coconut cream), but it wasn't bad. The chicken was perfectly cooked and not overly dry. But overall, the food was relatively underwhelming. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't great either. According to all the other Yelp reviews though, I missed the good stuff which apparently are the appetizers (wings, crab rangoons, etc.), so I may have to come try those.

Overall, I had a really hard time deciding whether to give this 3*'s or 4*'s, and really felt it was leaning more towards 3, but I just couldn't bring myself to do it. So four stars it is. Not sure how often I'll make the trip out here just for this place, but I wouldn't be opposed if someone wanted to come try it.

Chef Bettie is such a delight and her food was AMAZING!!! We had her join us at a rental estate where she cooked a beautiful brunch for a bachelorette weekend (15 ladies!). The first delicious course was set out for grazing while the ladies were waking up, there were fruits, the finest spreadable cheeses with some delicious jams and these melt in your mouth pastries. Oh and I can't forget, the Amish butter (it was to die for!). From there, the food just kept rolling out. We had a sweet course with some amazing sourdough french toast and these delicate buckwheat waffles (with glazed peaches and bananas, YUM!) and delicious crispy bacon on the side for dipping. Lastly we had a savory course which included the most scrumptious frittata I've ever had in my life! All the ladies were asking for more, it was FANTASTIC (along with everything else!). Oh and did I mention, a breakfast strudel!?? Simply amazing. Chef Bettie's service and food was beyond our expectations! Each one of us ladies would HIGHLY recommend her for any upcoming event, she will not disappoint. Thank you so much chef! Your brunch was such a treat for us all, we'll be calling you again for future events. Until next time!

We had our wedding reception last year at the top level, and it was wonderful.  The food was delicious and got great compliments from our guests.   The service was outstanding and Gabi (the owner) was very helpful and flexible with our requests.  It was a great choice!

Patrick filmed a Super 8 film of our wedding. He did an amazing job filming, editing and setting our film to music. The film is my favorite keepsake from our special day and we love it so much. Pat is a true artist.  He captured all of the highlights and details of our event in a beautiful and artistic way.

This is my favorite Mexican food place in Carpinteria. Friendly staff, amazing food, and it feels like home. The guacamole here is the BEST and margaritas are delicious. I can't wait to come back in for more.

We got here around 6:30 and were seated immediately. Our waitress, Holly, was great. Very friendly and patient. She checked on us several times. Our food came out quickly. I normally go for the chicken zingers with parmesan garlic sauce but I went with french onion soup. The soup was perfect with the right amount of cheese. I really enjoyed it. No complaints at all.

I tried on about 5 dresses and found the one I wanted. I'm pretty decisive and I knew what I was looking for going in so I'm not surprised. The staff was pleasant and helpful and admittedly I had just spent the weekend moving so I wasn't as energetic as I usually am. I had no issues with the selection or trying things on, the staff is right there to help zip and button and even pull suggestions for you. However, if you're looking for a full bridal experience with all the bells, whistles and champagne, this is not the place to go.
Beautiful Publix but the managers there suck . They are not friendly and always seem to have an attitude when you ask for anything . Far from the customer service I'm use to in my past local publix's

I live close to this store and have been in countless times. It's OK for self-service and carry-out items, however, I would caution against buying large appliances that require special delivery arrangements. I recently bought a washer/dryer set and arranged delivery for a Saturday AM. I waited for them from 8 AM until 4 PM and nobody showed up. I called Customer Service 3 times during the day and each time I heard that they were on the way to my house. On Monday, I walked into the store to hear their excuse for non-delivery and was treated to an exhaustive assortment of lies how they came at 10 AM, how nobody answered the door and how they called me, then called dispatch, then dispatch called me, and how they then came again and waited in front of my house. They had a description of my house as proof (just as I do of any other house in Edmonton courtesy of Google Street View). The reality is that no one came, no one called, no one knocked or left a note on my door.  I took my money back and will treat this store as a convenient product showroom only from now on while taking my business somewhere else.
Fabulous food. Fresh fish. Seasoned restaurant management. Run don't walk to this spot. Byob. Enjoy!

I love how they have gluten free options. Their selection keeps expanding. I've tried the waffle with ice cream and the macaroon sandwich. It's a little more pricey than your typical ice cream parlor but it's well worth it. I like how they let you sample the ice cream. Since they offer gluten free I think it's best to try before you buy. And I've never seen anyone beside them offer more than one waffle flavor. I went with the pandan because it taste like fortune cookies to me. Also the macaroon ice cream sandwich is frozen so you have to let it thaw a bit before you can eat it.

Tried all three of the name places in Philly and this was the only one we went back to. Meat was much better than the others. Not sure really what else made the difference (as they all seem to use the same ingredients) but this one was hands down better than the others. 

Cheez Whiz is a must (tried provolone on 1st visit and wasn't nearly as good). Just don't think about what's really in it. 

The waiting in line and anticipation only makes you hungrier and it taste better. Maybe that's the secret - might start lining up outside my house before dinner from now on.

WOW. Had an amazing service with this Limo company.

They picked me up from Jazzfest twice and also took my family (2 kids and pregnant wife) to the airport.

+Brand new looking SUVs
+They insisted on providing a complementary car seat for our little one
+All drivers dressed professionally in suits
+Great complementary water
+Easy to reach drivers via their cell phones
+Drivers were waiting to pick us up at least 30-90 minutes before we were supposed to be picked up so when the kids were tired from the festival, we were able to leave early!!

Would give 6 stars if I could.

Awesome service. Thanks for making my NOLA experience less stressful!
Great boba tea shop on White Bridge Road. Don't know that I would go out of my way to get here, but if I was in the area, it's certainly worth stopping in. Try your tea with a milk cap!

I returned here after 16 years for the bread pudding soufflé.  It did not disappoint.  Delicious and rich with flavor.  Great customer service too!!! The portions were too small for me. I'm a big guy.

Late night slinger always does the trick. Friendly service (regardless of the drunken state my party has usually been in during my visits). This is what I think of when I picture a classic diner and they do a great job of fulfilling the experience... cheap food with a smile
A friend yelped this place.  She didn't do so hot the night before. So this was sketchy, but she redeemed herself !! This place was awesome. Must visit.  Won't be disappointed!!!

My fist time going here and it was a pleasant experience. The whole staff was very nice and welcoming. The hygienists was very welcoming and nice easy to talk to. She explain everything very well. They have small screens in front of the chair so u can watch TV while you get work done also so they can show you the x-rays.  Everything was very clean and comfortable. The dentist came in after my cleaning and did a check up and explained my x-rays and recommendations for work that needs to be done. I love dentist that explain to you what they see and suggestions on how to take care of your teeth correctly. I've had dentist in the past that didn't explain my x-rays and didn't address the issue I would bring up. I am so glad to have found this place I'm happy with their service and will continue to go there and recomend this place.
The ramen was tasteless - very disappointing.  I have high standards for ramen, but we couldn't even finish our meals.  It was also way too expensive for what it is.

Very good customer service and are very attentive!  They actually pay attention to you.  They ask if you had any injuries to help you select the perfect shoe.  I had a very rare experience of high quality customer service.

Good food at 11:30. 

We opted for lunch, gator bites as an app.and we both had the crawfish pie.  It was a delicious flaky crust with crawfish ettoufee underneath.  No skimping on the crawfish either. 

I gotta say though, the majority of the people around us ordered breakfast (at 11:30?!?) and we were really envious. The biscuits looked huge and the pancakes fluffly/delicious. 

We're going to try them another morning for breakfast, but lunch wasn't bad, probably one of the 2nd best meals we've had so far in NOLA.

This place has a beach vibe and two floors.  There is a Bloody Mary bar on the top floor.  Our food was amazing as were the sides.  All the sides are home made except the tots.  Their desserts looked tempting but we were too full :( 

April is the awesome server.  Make sure you ask for her!
Super friendly workers and delicious food! Plenty of selection on the menu that will please anyone! Reasonable prices too

ACME is iconic and a must-stop place in New Orleans for Oysters and other New Orleans fare. 

It was the first place when we go into New Orleans. There was about a 15-20 minute wait. We had to stand in line outside, which was fine - just noting it. 

We only ordered the Chargrilled Oysters and were really happy. There was a strong Parmesan flavor and crisp atop the oysters. 

Had we not tried other oyster places that just happened to taste better, we would've left thinking that ACME was decisively the best, because it's very good. We just think that there are better options out there if you do the research is all. Still worth checking out though. Not a place I'd wait 30+ minutes for though.
The food here is DELICIOUS. They make everything from scratch and it shows. The sauces are fantastic and there are a lot of options. I would highly recommend Wibs.

It's a small space, but I find a lot of little gems here and the workers have always been super friendly.  It's a convenient location for dropping things off, and they have saved my bacon when I spill something on myself at work or forget my gym gear.  I just pop in and grab something to wear, since driving back home through traffic isn't always an option.

If you live in Boise or are just visiting this is the best place to climb indoors! Staff is amazing, friendly, helpful and full of knowledge. 

The gym specializes in bouldering, but they also have a great top-rope section and Ninja Warrior obstacles in the climbers vein. There is a weight room, slack line area, silks area, and yoga studio too! They change up different sections of the wall weekly so there is always new routes to entertain.

You won't be disappointed whether you get a monthly membership or are just visiting for the day.

Great food, drinks  and great networking opportunities for young professionals in the city. The only reason why I knocked a star is due to the giant roach anatomy artwork on the wall. Not appetizing!!

Love coming here :) so many goodies. It is very bustling so if you're one who doesn't like waiting in lines, you'll have to suck it up! It's definitely worth it! All the baked goods, cute crafts, food, snacks, fresh produce, and service are great! Definitely an awesome market to bring the family to and enjoy your time together. The choices here are endless! Definitely need to go back and try them all.

I've eaten here 3 times and I've been disappointed 3 times. It's overpriced for one thing. Their burgers also taste weird. I'm not sure what it is that makes them taste weird, maybe a sauce, or the buns? 

Today I ordered online: bacon cheeseburger with lettuce, tomato, relish, hot sauce, and jalapeños. The burger only had jalapeños and maybe a little bit of (not very hot), hot sauce. For that I paid $9.17. Ridiculous. 

The manager did offer to remake my burger (after she checked with someone who told her all my toppings were on it), but I declined. It's too cold to go back out. 

3 strikes and they are out! I won't be eating here again.

Literally the best avocado toast I've ever had and the staff is amazing! 
I would definitely choose to eat here over First Watch! 
Coming back to try the S'mores pancakes!

Their work looks good on the surface but lacks pride of workmanship. Cheap switches, electrical tape from Harbor Freight, LED lights that can't be seen unless they are in the shade, poorly fabricated brackets. Overall lack of pride at high end prices.
This place was all around amazing. Very courteous staff, delicious food & drinks & the atmosphere makes it such a great place for date night, or really any occasion! Will definitely return!

I stayed here on business for 12 nights. I saw the negative reviews before I came, but I am a loyal SPG customer, so I went with it anyway. This Sheraton had its short-comings, but its staff more than makes up for them.

First of all, as of today, the elevator problem is cured. Both elevators work and they are as fast as you would expect medium-aged elevators to be.

There is still a limited menu in the kitchen. As other reviewers have noted, this is because of a kitchen fire. I was told by the friendly bartenders that the kitchen will be repaired around the middle of September. The limited menu still has enough variety to satisfy the typical diet. If not, there are loads of nice, walkable restaurants around the area.

My room was clean with no signs of excessive wear. Perhaps the carpet could be updated. It was surely enough space, but I am traveling by myself; if there were four people in my room, it would be quite cramped (but perhaps the two double bed rooms have more space).

The gym has two tread mills, stair masters, a stationary bike, free weights, and a Nautilus-type machine. There is also an indoor pool and an outdoor space. The pool area isn't as bright as the picture makes it out to be, but it is a great pool for swimming laps. It was also clean and well-maintained.

---

With all this said, it was the professional staff that made my 12-night stay most pleasant. Everyone was incredibly friendly. Not just the front desk, but the bell hops, the bartenders, and those than cleaned my room. The answer to every request was "yes".

Call me an apologist, but I was offered a great rate and received a great service. I would certainly stay here again.

It has been a few years since F and I have visited the Yardley Inn. I remember loving the ambiance and vibe, and see nothing has changed in that respect.
The Yardley Inn has the welcoming and cozy vibe of the inns of yesteryear....low ceilings, dark warm rooms and views of the Delaware.
On a Sunday night F and I and a couple of friends stopped in after the Roxy Ballet.
I ordered the Kale salad with salmon and F had the House Burger and Potatoe Cheddar soup.
We all were very happy with our choices.
2 glasses of Hacienda Cabernet and I was completely happy.
The Yardley Inn host many different events throughout the year. I am glad we reconnected Yardley Inn. See you soon!
Out of: alcoholic drink preferences, lasagna, ice cream. Soup came out cold. Billing was wrong. Took forever.

This is my all time favorite place for sushi!

Although, to be fair, I am allergic to sea food, so I have to have chicken in them, or vegetarian. They are always willing to let me create my own sushi, which have always turned out phenomenal. The Tom Yum Gai soup is to die for, I can not get enough! 

I would definitely recommend this place, every time I have been there, all the people I am with enjoy their meals.

I've been living in a Premier Access property in Northern Liberties since the end of January with 2 friends. It is far and away the best rental experience that I have ever had.  The properties are beautiful:  3 bed, 3 full bath, 1 car garage, roof deck, finished basement, contemporary design... the list goes on.  The employees in the leasing office have been very good to us as well.  Ariel and Amy were amazing to work with during the process of signing the lease.  They answered every ridiculous question that I had and always responded in a timely manner.  The property manager, Mike, spent over an hour with us at the walk-through when we moved in. The rent is more than reasonable considering how nice the properties are, and I have no doubts that we will be extending our lease before it expires.  6 stars!!!!!!!

Quality work at a very honest price!
Wish I would have known about Tucks a long time ago.would have avoided a lot of headaches.
Absolutely recommend!

It's all been said before so I'll keep it short. Love it! Great food, great service, nice decor, BYOB, what's not to love? Only downside is dealing with limited parking, and make reservations or get there early. A gem in the burbs!

I like the fact that their burgers are freshly made. Sometimes they seem to be understaffed and can be slow. And when they are understaffed, the priority seems to be taking care of the drive-thru customers over the people dining inside. But it's usually worth the wait. And where else can you get chili to dip your fries in?

I never could figure out what all the fuss was about with Super Cuca's. That is, until I had the nachos and the huge shrimp and grilled veggies over rice plate.

I'm not really a nacho person, but I make an exception for the pastor and shrimp nachos. They are in our regular takeout rotation now!

We stayed at Peppermill for two nights and ate dinner buffet on Sunday and Monday.  Food were pretty much the same except Sunday have little bit more seafood than Monday.  Sunday price for adult is less than $25, and Monday to Thursday is couple dollars less.  Kids is same price on both nights for less than $13.  

Selections are pretty good, I especially like the Asian section.  Egg roll and coconut shrimps are the must try items.  I am not a big meat eater, so I only tasted the Korean chicken wings.  It was really good.  For those who like the prime rib well done, bring it to the grill.  Overall, they controlled the taste very well.  They don't over salt or sweet their food or drinks.  Another must try is their ice-cream.  Four of us tasted all of the favors.  Each night has different favors.  

The service were good.  Sunday was little bit busy, so it took some time for the drinks to come.  Everyone were working hard and still carry smile.

Been back here a few times now. Great selection of food and the food is superb! The rice is also the purple-y kind and not just plain white rice. I've tried two of their three soups/hot pots and they're great with the right amount of spice. Pork BBQ is tender and well flavoured. I also actually really enjoy their side dishes! Prices are a little on the expensive side with family owned Korean places but it won't break the bank. Only downside is the service is slow - sure they have those 'call' buttons on each table but nobody ever responds to them.

Okay I've been to/through St Louis a couple times.
Last time they were closed for a funeral (Understandably). This time we came w/ family we had their cafeteria meal. Mine was pork chop w gravy, Mac and cheese, yams, green beans, and corn bread. 
1) The meat/gravy and green beans wasn't seasoned( 1SMALL CHOP), the corn bread was average, the Mac & cheese was good and the yams were average.
2) Having been to numerous soul food restaurants from LA to ATLANTA to Chicago to NYC. Their  portions are very small for a cafeteria style restaurant small meat & sides are in tiny bowls.
Especially for almost $20.00 a person seriously???
3) The management was nice Plus our waiter D "Guy w the gold grill" Bruh was cool handing out Now & Later's to me and the family.

Sorry to say All in all we all agreed it's not a place we are going back too.

AMAZING service. 

I called from my home, which is hours away, in order to get some flowers, hopefully, to one of my Essential People. Unable to visit her this afternoon, and knowing she felt awful about that, I decided at least I should get some gift of love to her, while she awaits my visit the next day. I tried the usual places, the mass dealers and big brands, and all stopped same day service at 2pm. Of course, it was about 2:15pm. So, I try locally - same problem. So I think to myself...hmm...maybe the gift shop can help. 

Turns out yes, they can. Help a LOT, actually. 

The very kind, compassionate woman that I spoke with (Oh, NO! I forgot her name! Carol? Oh, darn - she should be recognized! Whomever worked between 2 and 3pm on June 3, 2013!), took my number and promised to call me back after she assured me that yes, flowers to my EP were certainly possible. She asked her location, I let her know and she said she would verify, call me back and we'd get the flowers set up then. I wasn't sure what to expect, but not too long after that, the phone rang...and yes, it was she! But it didn't stop there. 

She told me she had some trouble locating her and wanted to make sure she was still there, so she was going to WALK OVER to that area and verify personally for me. Promised to call back in 30 minutes. She did, indeed (more like 10 minutes!). She then proceeded to describe the bouquets available, and then after I said that my EP's favorite color was blue, when I asked for a small, stuffed animal, she found, specifically a blue one. Just for her. 

Oh! And? The cost was only $34.00, rounded out. Not a bad deal at all, considering! Care AND a decent price? Yes. YES. 

This woman made my day - she made a very hard day so much better, just because of that personal care and gentleness. The understanding that one needs in tough times, came from a "stranger" over 100 miles away. I think when I am up there tomorrow, I will stop in there and see if she is working, so I can personally thank her for the kindness she bestowed upon me.
We had a great time and the food was over the top. My wife had the pear salad and I had the forest burger. Oh wow. Cool place and great atmosphere.  Server was very helpful with the menu suggestions.

A bit pricey, $30 for a skillet, an omellete and a thermos of coffee. That's when I realized it must be a chain restaurant originating from a pricier zip code (they're from Atlanta). Zero charm or ambience. The potatoes weren't even toasted brown. The skillet had diced raw onions, which didn't really work for me.  When I asked to leave the bacon out of the skillet and substitute an extra egg, I got charged for the extra egg. The coffee was good, as was the service. For a big chain restaurant breakfast, try Le Peep in Belle Meade for better food, price and ambience. But I'd rather suggest Marche or Fido (or Noshville if you can get past the bad coffee). Note: there are no vegan choices save maybe pancakes, so unless you eat eggs, go elsewhere.

We've had a great experience so far with Zippy Shell. They have been very responsive and extremely flexible with our changing plans throughout our cross country move, accommodating multiple changes to our shipping dates, delivery location, and storage needs. Our move coordinator saved us by connecting us with a local company that helped us to (cheaply) load our shell when we were in danger of not finishing in time for our scheduled shell pick-up. Prices are very competitive, and the fact that the trailers have license plates and can be parked on the street legally without acquiring a potentially costly city permit is a huge perk. If you can unload within 3 hours, Zippy Shell will do a same day pick-up of the empty trailer. I would recommend Zippy Shell to anyone, especially for a long distance move.
Great food, service, ambiance. Wat there at least once every 10 days. Staff is the best. Have to wait a bit? Just visit the cool shops on property!

This Starbucks is easy to get to for me on the way to work. The parking lot is a little tight tho. I order in the morning through my app and pick it up on the way to work. It's so convenient! 

Certain times of day they are a little busier and what should be a quick in and out for my mobile pick up takes a little longer. Sometimes people who ordered in store are all standing around the end of the counter and that's the same place you pick up mobile orders so it's hard to tell who is mobile and who was in store
Great spot for delicious homemade ice cream. Good selection and everything looked so tasty. My kids enjoyed it! Will definitely be returning!

Went to Tom's Pizza Bar and Grill, for the first time, last night. Very nice atmosphere. Family friendly. We had the Antipasto and a pizza. Both were very good. The Antipasto ($9.95) was enough that we took home one half. The pizza (half sausage and half peperoni) ($11,75) was very tasty. The crust was excellent the sauce has a nice flavor. This place, while in a small strip center, is worth a try. They have a very nice dining room and the service was good. Full bar and credit cards accepted.

My boyfriend and I are new to area and love going to get ice cream or water ice. This place is so close to home and OMG the best homemade ice cream and water ice I have ever tasted! The girls there are so nice and never seem annoyed when people ask to taste. My favorite and would definitely recommend is the Peanut butter ice cream and strawberries and cream water ice!!!!!

This review reflects one item, as there is no reason to eat anything else when going to Rubio's!!!!

The Shrimp and Bacon Burrito will kick your tastebuds into overdrive. 

Prepare thyself for the perfectly pan seared shrimp to the wave after wave of citrus rice, to the billows of toasted cheese! Lest ye not forget of the mounds of crispy bacon pieces or the waves of handmade guacamole and out of nowhere BAM BAM BAM Come the war drums of the Blackened Jalapeños for the Heat you desire pair that with the roasted chipotle salsa and the creamy chipotle sauce and get ready to rock!

Eisgewordene Träume, täglich frisch hergestellt mit Milch von glücklichen & hormonfreien Kühen sowie Obst und weiteren Zutaten -- bis auf Exoten, versteht sich -- aus der Umgebung.


 Seit der Eröffnung 2002 wurden bisher sage und schreibe 354 Sorten hergestellt, jeden Tag hat man die Wahl zwischen 27 und diese Wahl ist eine echte Qual, denn die Kugeln sind nicht gerade klein. Man gehe also auf jeden Fall zu zweit und probiere dadurch mehr als eine der sagenhaft crèmigen Kreationen wie z. B.:


 Saigon Cinnamon, Rosmarin-Honig-Ziegenmilch, Birne, Rote Pflaume, Kokosmilch, Lancaster County Kürbis, Süße Orange mit Kardamom, Pinienkern, Schwarze Walnuß, Kaki Sorbet, oder Zitrone & Opal Basilikum einige dieser Angebote sind natürlich saison-abhängig, es findet sich aber ganz bestimmt jeder Zeit eine Sorte für den persönlichen Geschmack.


 Das letzte Mal, das ich dort war, hatte ich z. B. ein Eis mit Meersalz. Der Laden ist sehr beliebt und mittlerweile auch durchaus über die Grenzen Philly's hinaus bekannt. Verdienterweise, muß man sagen!
This is a up scale restaurant. I didn't find anything really great. Need to go back and try some thing else. I had the ribeye. The flavor was good. Service good. I would go back. $$$

I was really excited to try the boozy desert milkshakes here, but they were honestly too much of a good thing. The donuts are blended into the milkshake with alcohol, then topped with a mini donut as well. I had the Tutti Frutti and it tasted like it was made with milk instead of vanilla ice cream. And it was WAY too sweet. I made it maybe five sips in before I had to stop. That said, the donut tasted good and service was amazing. Go here for the donuts, not the shakes.
Great atmosphere, cool vibe, amazing food in a cool area and at an attractive price point. Plus.... hushpuppies!!!!

Reading some of the reviews makes me think that people have UNREALISTIC expectations when going here. First off the front desk staff has always been nice and pleasant and greeted me. Secondly this is not only an emergency clinic but an animal hospital. People that complain about waiting need to go somewhere else. I work in healthcare and any place that deals with emergencies you have to expect to wait, it's just the way it is if you don't like it go somewhere else where they aren't willing to get you in the same day and after most people's working hours. Every experience I've had at WGAH has been pleasant and met my expectations from the front desk to the tech to most importantly the vet. They always get me in when I want so I don't have to leave work and on short notice if my animal is having a problem. Are they more expensive than most places, yes, but people you PAY for convenience. My dogs and cats have always received appropriate care and we've always been treated with respect here. My only recommendation is to ask to find out charges and whats necessary and what isn't so you don't get sticker shock when you check out at the front desk. Once again shame on all of you who gave them one or two stars, you just need to go somewhere that will make you go in during the middle of your work day or make you wait a day or two to get your pet in.........again completely unrealistic expectations if you expect to not wait or pay for the convenience of them being able to get you in whenever you need. I would recommend WGAH and going to continue to keep taking my pets there.

The chicken is just as delicious as it was last time I ordered it. Driving from Florida to California and made it a point to stop in here. If you're coming for the chicken you won't be disappointed, if you're coming for certain sides you might be disappointed. I rated it a 4 this time due to the potato wedges being bland in flavor, and they were out of okra, mashed potatoes, as well as veal (luckily wasn't ordering the veal anyways). It was 10am when they opened and they were already out of this, they should get a better supplier to keep up with their demands as I remember last time they were also out of some things. 

It's still worth coming and I will definitely be back again.

I am so happy to have this place here.

I've now experienced it for two different reasons and they both met, and exceeded, expectation.

My first visit was with a group of 3 other adults. On that visit we were able to take advantage of all the activities that the place had to offer. From dodgeball to the foam pit to the basketball hoops the joust/padded fighting area and the standard trampoline area - everything was perfect for adults. Easy to spend time in each of the locations in the hour permitted. By the end of the hour I was ready for a break.

My most recent visit was with 2 other adults and 2 little boys. My nephews, age 20 months and 4 years, were in town for the holidays. The boys were not doing well with the cold weather as they are warm weather San Diego boys. Having an indoor exercise option was perfect. I was worried about the youngest being able to participate but we called ahead and they gave us a thumbs up on him. He was only unable to do a few activities like the padded fighting area and the dodgeball. He was easily able to get into the ball pit and to bounce on the trampoline. Noticing the fun the boys were having made us adults have an even better time. The boys were exhausted by the end of the session which was exactly what mommy and daddy needed! haha.

Kuddos for being a safe, clean place for kids and adults to do a fun activity with major health benefits!

The cutest tucked in gem of a cafe ! The outdoor seating is so nice , and even though it was hot out there was ample amount of fans which made it a cool visit ! For starters we had the Parmesan fries which were piping hot and SO good , the shape made them all the better , also a side Caesar salad that had delicious dressing and fresh shaved Parmesan cheese ! We then had the margarita pizza and cheese with pepperoni and garlic , all piping hot full of robust flavor ! We will for sure be back to try more !!
Service was excellent and quick. The sweet Cuban sandwich was very good, lots of meat in it. Flavor in the sandwich was perfect and to go with it I had passion fruit that was awesome.

sadly this place has gone downhill after the recent remodeling of the decor and menu. They have much less options on their dim sum menu and serve more cold items (which can of course be frozen and served later). Delicacies like stuffed egg plant, chicken feet etc are not on the menu anymore. You have to ask for it and may get it if you are lucky.

Sad to see the trend on this one. I frequented this quite a lot in the past.

Went in for a basic manicure and was very pleased! The place is very clean and everyone that worked there was friendly. I was a walk-in on a Saturday morning and did not have to wait. Well priced and my manicure came out great. I will definitely return!

I can only speak to the food (ordered Postmates from here last week) and it was phenomenal. I've literally raved about them every day since. My boyfriend and I split the bulgogi fries and I had the wings. The flavor balance on both was lively- sweet, spicy and salty, but I didn't feel gross after eating. The portions were generous and leftovers good too. The kimchi fried rice is even better cold +1 day. I like that the containers are all compostable. Will definitely dine in soon and often. Thanks!
Super friendly, efficient, and professional. The office environment was bright and welcoming. The music and sunglasses were a nice touch too.

Went into this UPS Store to ship a bunch of random crap (and said that to the owner who was helping me) and told her I wanted it to go the cheapest way possible.    So she goes about her business and I'm noticing that she is shipping 4 lamp bases in two different containers (they are metal and wood -- so i was thinking it was weird that they needed to be in two different containers) and then she packed one picture in a separate box -- when were there a bunch of other things roughly the same size.   But again -- i think she knows what she is doing.... then I get the total $284.07 !!!   HOLY CRAP !!     At this point I'm flabbergasted but I've already hauled in all this crap and told her I didn't need additional insurance on it and am really so shocked I just hand over my debit card ....

On the way back to my office -- I call a friend who's parents own a UPS store in another state and they confirm my suspicions that I kinda got taken to the cleaners !!   So me being a chicken -- have my friend call them to address the situation.    This woman says to her that there was no way she could have packed them in fewer boxes -- which is not true -- if nothing else the 4 lamp bases could have gone in one box ...  and that picture could have gone in a box with a dartboard and a couple other random things.   She clearly is soooo afraid of getting stuck with the damages if something were to break that she goes too far the other direction.     And all this after I told her this stuff was not worth that much and was just random crap !!!

The only option she gave us was to come get all my crap -- which at this point is not worth it but ... 

be warned ... go to another UPS store unless you are looking to pay a premium or are shipping the crown jewels.    I could have purchased all new lamps, lampshades, pictures and dartboard for the money she charged me to ship them !! 

and don't hold this against all UPS stores ....  i have had lots of other good experiences at other locations.

Would really give this more like 4.5 stars. Basing this off the rooftop food and drinks only.

Super cute and trendy downstairs! Rooftop is awesome- can't wait for warmer months so it's more open but there are tons of heaters and it's partially open which was fine even on a cold evening.

Can't base this off of dinner because on the roof you can't get more than just bar snacks which is what drops it from a 5 to a 4 for me. Guac is really good!

The margaritas are super tasty! Went around 5 ish on a Friday- the place was packed but not unreasonably so. 

Looking forward to going back for dinner downstairs!
What can I say 2 can eat for $22 includes appetizer or two salads and free chips. It's a bargain.
Went to gumbo ya-ya on Friday with my daughter and granddaughter Corey was our server she was excellent when you go to gumbo ya-ya definitely ask for Corey

Excellent!!! Did take out today. 2 sandwiches. Fantastic service and great food. This place is the real deal! 
Very happy to have this place nearby.

BEST INDIAN FOOD IN TOWN!!!

We've ordered from here twice in three days and literally everything is delicious. Philly finally has momos!!! Their kebabs are amazing including their green chutney which seems to be tough to nail down for the restaurants in the area. Indian Chinese was amazing and so was the biryani, we got the dum option. So many of these things hard to find in the US especially all under one roof. This is our go-to Indian food spot now and I can't wait to try everything on the menu!
Food comes extremely well packaged which I thought was very thoughtful

I was waiting for over an hour (1 hr and 24 mins) AFTER my SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT TIME. 2 people that came after me were taken before me. Very unprofessional. Even tho my nails came out OK, I would NEVER come to a place that makes me wait 1 hr after my apptmt time. 

Tip: don't overbook and have a bunch of ppl waiting inside the shop (esp during covid smh)

The shops at Liberty Place has a nice collection of stores for the average Center City worker to look through during his or her lunch break.  Here you will find stores such as J.Crew, Anne Taylor Loft, Borders Express and a decent sized food court.

I tend to like Liberty Place better than the Gallery because it is quieter, cleaner and easier to get in and out of quickly. Another feature that is nice about Liberty Place is the ability to access many of the stores from the street instead of going through the mall.  Check out the website for a complete list of stores.

I was looking for a ride to the airport for my mother and me. My father had just died a few days before Christmas, and we wanted to be back home with the rest of the family for the holidays. I wanted someone responsible and professional who would make our last-minute trip less stressful. Victor responded to our quote request right away, and that made me feel confident our pick up would be on time. Victor showed up early in a very clean, nicely appointed car. He was very pleasant and caring. I would definitely use the service again.

Service: 5 Stars. Server Sean was excellent. He was very attentive, explained the specials and drinks like a pro. He made our drinks and they were FANTASTIC (Peach Smash & and a 1944 Mai Thai). His appetizer recommendations were spot on. The corn fritters were so good we ordered a second round for "dessert".  Sean brought us out extra spices & chilies (spice kit) to add a little more heat if we wanted. Great extra touch! We'll be back!

While at the Sparks Food Truck Drive-In, my husband and I decided to grab a sandwich from the Kinder's food truck. The guy working the front was funny, but polite as he cracked jokes, trying to get more people to grab a bite to eat from their truck. He was very sociable, but also professional. He was the first reason, we decided to give Kinder's a try; the second was seeing a bunch of people walk away with some delicious looking sandwiches. We decided to try the Ball Tip Sandwich with the fresh broccoli salad ($8.00.) We waited patiently, for our order, but after about twenty minutes we were starting to wonder what was going on. We had seen many people, who had ordered after us, already get their food. We approached the cashier and he apologized for the mix-up. It took them just a few minutes to get us our order and the cashier gave us a fully punched punch card for another sandwich, as a way to apologize for the confusion. The sandwich was similar to tri-tip, served on a soft bun with mayo, lettuce, tomatoes and BBQ sauce. It was tasty! I only wish there was more BBQ sauce, slathered on there, but that is probably why they have some set out for you to use. The broccoli salad tasted fresh, as promised and was flavorful for just being a small salad. Regardless of the confusion, with our order (Everyone makes mistakes!), I'd give Kinder's a solid four stars! The food was cooked well and flavorful and the customer service was wonderful! I plan on going to their location to try some of their other BBQ options.

Stopped in for a spur of the moment 8pm dinner and were able to walk right in. It was such a pleasant surprise! We ordered the scallops and another fish dish that came with crawfish. The fish was perfectly flavored with a sauce but I have to say the scallops were probably the best I have ever had. They were incredible. We ended the evening with their chocolate lava cake and cream puffs. A beautiful and delicious meal.

Can I give them 6 stars? The wild boar taco has been a favorite of mine for 10 years (of course there was a short period of insanity when they took it off the menu). This place is a hidden gem...and was actually featured on Diners, Drive-ins and dives. Must get tacos and fried PB & J.
Overall, a great pizzeria. Love the flavor of the coal oven, and a good variety of toppings. I only came for the pizza, but I love it. Will definitely come again.

I placed my first takeout order online with Terron today for the Seitan Cheesesteak Lunch Special. All their lunch specials are $9.95 + tax including a delicious cookie and $1 extra for a drink!

The sandwich itself is very good - ooey gooey it barely tastes vegan!
I personally am not a huge fan of seitan - and would prefer this sandwich with an impossible meat substitution - but it's not an option on the website. I do wonder if they would allow substitutions if you call in..

The meal is also served with HUGE potato wedges which were great.

Overall I had a solid first experience, and YES THEY ARE OPEN DURING COVID-19 just check their new hours and go support! I will be updating my next review since I am certainyl eyeing that impossible meatball sub...

Was a nice clean place to take a walk. Not a lot of bums thankfully. The water adds to the peacefulness of the stroll. The lights at night make it quite the adventure. There is a water taxi. I feel like it would be safe at night.

Pros: 
Great location
Most comfy bed ever
Majority of staff was super friendly
Huge flat screen TV
Fast elevators

Cons: 
New key system was being installed. Got locked out of my room 3 separate times
Everything seemed sooo much more overpriced than the typical overpriced hotel costs... $7 for a bottle of water, $3.50 for a small (smaller than can size) Diet Coke, $4 for a Snickers bar, $1.50 for 1 Aleve, etc.
$9.95/day for wifi
Hotel restaurant is super pricey
Paper thin walls

I was here for a conference, so I didn't pay for most of this, which kept my annoyance level down. I really liked my room, I slept great every night, the shower was always hot and had good water pressure (although, the shower head might be a little low for a lot of people, I'm only 5'6" and it felt like if I was much taller, I'd hit my head).

Getting to and from the airport from here was a pain in the ass. There's so much construction going on that our cab driver dropped us off 2 blocks away, and on the day we left, it took over half an hour to get a taxi, and it was impossible to find one that took credit cards. Make sure you have cash for this.

Service was speedy and friendly. Bartender Carissa was great to deal with and I'll be sure to stop by again next time I'm in Boise. I didn't order food, but everything coming out of the kitchen looked great.

Modernt hotell i ett nästan 100 år gammalt hus. Läget är perfekt med gångavstånd till konferenscenter och de flesta sevärdheter liksom bra shopping nära till hands. Trevlig personal. Träffade managern i hissen som gav bra tips om matställen inom 2 kvarter. Frukost ingår inte. Inte testat att äta på hotellet heller.

I was referred to Window World by a friend who used them and had a good experience.  The quality of the windows are superb in my mind.  The important thing for me is that the heat does not penetrate from the hot Florida sun into my home.  The salesman Joe was nice, friendly, and took his time with my family which was important.  I read a negative comment about his tardiness which I can understand, but I appreciated that he took his time answering our questions and concerns which could make him late for his next appointment.  We had a lot of issues with an old permit (nothing to do with Window World), but tried helping us nonetheless getting it cleared up.  My only bad comment is trying to call the office.  I use the local number and they are always too busy.  They either put me on hold a lot or cannot get me to the right person.

I've been there 3 times at this point. Each time it's taken over an hour to get our food. Shame on me, as I continue to go back thinking they will have the kinks worked out.

The real shame is that the beer list and food is pretty good. Service and kitchen are really bad though. Too many other good options in the Indy area to waste at a place with bad service.

Amazing food, drinks, and atmosphere. Menu was almost too big to make a decision! But cannot wait to visit Tampa again to try out more on the menu.  
I tried the Mahi Mahi Cayo Hueso, and it was amazing. All the various flavors in the dish complimented each other perfectly.
The Pelvic Center of Santa Barbara is extremely knowledge in these area. I recommend them as five stars and better. We need more places like this to get treated for pelvic problems.

I really want to like this place because it's close to home but after many tries I just can't. The first time I tried them the food was mediocre. The second time I tried to get food the place was empty, yet still had a difficult time finding a clean table so I left. Another time they were closed although they advertised having late night food? Last night I ordered take out 3 hours before the advertised close time. When I walked in I was told the kitchen was closed? I did get my order but the food was awful. The wings that I ordered extra crispy were soggy and lacked flavor. I also ordered an appetizer than was like a loaded fries, and asked it be served on the kettle chips instead. Well, I got tortilla chips with some melted cheese and something else. It went right in the garbage. When I signed my credit card receipt the total was $17. This morning when I checked my bank account I was charged $19 and change. That certainly wasn't what I signed for. Seems pretty fraudulent. I won't be going back.

We did not make reservations but we were there by 5 PM on a Saturday and the restaurant was about 1/3 full , by the time we left at 7 PM it was packed. So in the future I will probably make reservations. Yes I will be going back, I was pleasantly surprised I honestly wasn't expecting much but everything was very very tasty very fresh and everything is explained in detail , our waiter and I wish I could remember his name was very very helpful. For three of us our Bill came to around $52, Hubby had the $19 lobster plate, our guest ordered Chicken wing plate & I ordered a steak plate ( Rib eye) . You do get white rice & quite an array of 'stuff/ aka sides. I was full when we left & I am a good size eater.I feel it is a restaurant worth going back to.
Poor service. Took 15 minutes to get our drink and 40 minutes to get our food. Food came out not as we ordered. Would not recommend.

Came here as a visitor to the area on the recommendation of a friend and it was walking distance from my hotel. Although they make a mean margarita the food is marginal, overly cheesed and the atmosphere is not very friendly. Maybe it was particularly bad day but I won't come back here or recommend this to my friends.

BEST SPA IN ARIZONA!! You will feel taken care of and supported at all times at Le Visage. The experience they provide is like NO OTHER!!

Doron the owner is an incredible human. He makes sure everyone knows they are already beautiful before he will even book them for an appointment. His heart is beautiful and so is his business!

You can tell that the staff LOVES working there, they shine so bright! Clearly they are living their purpose!

When you walk in you will feel the good energy right away!

Some items are better than others but overall a very solid Thai joint with great customer service.

While not my favorite in Nashville, I think their Pad Thai is still pretty good. It's not too sweet which I personally enjoy. Their CURRY has always been delicious and, to me, that is a dish that is far more difficult to get right than Pad Thai. There is no Pad Se Ew but there is "Soy Sauce Noodles" which looks like Pad Se Ew but tastes extremely bland. I had to add a shit ton of soy sauce to it to make it edible. The fresh rolls come with a clear sauce and not peanut sauce which makes me sad. 

All of the other items I've tried have been really good and fresh. Siam isn't Thai perfection for me but it's pretty darn close to it.

This place has the absolute worst service I have ever experienced.  It is easily accessible to my house so I
Tried there. The first time I tried there I went in around 630 and they told me immediately they would not be able to do me because they close at 7. That was annoying but fine I came in late. So the second time I made sure to get there at 6 so I could get in and after having me wait 30 mins they decided they didn't have time to get me done and sent me away. I have never had worse customer service at a nail salon. To me, if you get there before they close in plenty of time for them to complete the job then they should respect the time limitations.  It's plain lazy and I will never be going back to this place.

Had a fantastic dinner there recently. All of the food was delicious, and their desserts were HUGE! The service at this place really stood out. We started as a party of 2, and were surprised with friends that changed our party to 6! The server immediately got us an extra table as soon as one was available to accommodate us. 5 stars!!

This is hands down THE WORST fuel in the city. I'm used to fuel being over priced but at the other locations the flavor on top of nutritional value makes it worth it. NOT THIS ONE. I ordered a 9 dollar avocado toast like I do at the other locations bc they're usually a decent size which makes it worth it, this location gave me the smallest piece of wheat bread, like it came out of the precut loaf it was so tiny. Literally fit in the palm of my hand. Their rice bowls at this location are always bland. The rice is wet with water and mushy. It's the blandest fuel.

AHAHAHA AFTER POSTING THIS REVIEW IVE SEEN THE OWNER COMMENT ON ATLEAST THREE COMPLAINTS THAT THEY NEVER GET COMPLAINTS HILARIOUS

Purchased our Toyota Rav4 from another Toyota Dealer last Fall.  While staying in the Clearwater area, the first maintenance appointment came due and we chose the closest Toyota dealership, Clearwater Toyota.  While choosing Clearwater Toyota was random, our experience with the staff and service has made Clearwater Toyota our "go to" dealership when in Florida.

Our service appointment was completed on schedule, including the complimentary car wash, and while we were waiting we watched a movie in the comfortable waiting area while munching on pop corn and drinking coffee.  What's not to like?

Friendly staff! The shrimp cocktail was mushy, overcooked and several weren't completely de-shelled and one was not cleaned properly. The server replaced the uncleaned shrimp immediately. The chef select raw oysters special was tasty.

I called for a reservation for a birthday dinner, and arrived to find a wonderful table in the front room.  We ordered the tiger prawns for an appetizer.  These were delicious.   Guests ordered a variety of dishes for dinner -- salmon, filet mignon, flat iron steak, and another fish special -- all of them were cooked to perfection, appropriately seasoned, and artistically garnished.  Everyone raved about the food.  We had two delicious desserts, one of which came decorated with "happy birthday S..." in chocolate on the plate, which was a nice touch to a festive evening.  Service was attentive and appropriately paced, and we didn't feel rushed to turn over the table.  Opal was a perfectly lovely experience for our special occasion.

We have placed an order Saturday to have something to be delivered on 5/10/21 and it has not been delivered. They do not pick up the phone. I sent an email to the main company and all they said was your response was received and the store owner or manager will contact if needed after 48 hours. It has been over 48 hours and still nothing. Please contact me back or give me a refund. 

Concerned customer

Two-stars only because the Mongolian grill was actually "fresh" and tasty. Otherwise, this is a one-star review.

Everything at the buffet was old. I saw only one entree (the pepper steak) replenished at the buffet the whole time I was there for dinner on a busy Saturday night. The seafood (when it was actually out) smelled spoiled and some of the crabs where actually completely empty. I was too scared to try the sushi.

The dessert area was pretty unsanitary. The ice cream area is "scoop yourself", which still looked questionable even when it wasn't surrounded by unsupervised kids using their bare hands.

Needless to say, a huge stomachache ensued later. Not surprised.

As someone who is a regular waxer (and has been religiously for the past 5+ years) and has lived in major cities across the country, I have to say that there is no better than  Risa at this Waxing the City!! I moved up here from Dallas and was terrified I would NEVER find another waxing home again. After a horrible experience or three at another establishment, I was admittedly skeptical that "this place" would not work out.  So glad my assumptions are often proven wrong!

First things: ownership is awesome. Always so accommodating, friendly, warm conversation and great environment. You are running an awesome establishment!

Now for the waxing: for what an outsider may deem an uncomfortable experience, I would challenge anyone to become a believer and go see Risa already. Is it weird to enjoy going to see your waxer? I swear it's like a catch up session time I go. I've never felt uncomfortable and each experience is virtually painless due to the expert technique she uses. Cannot say enough good things!!

Final side note: when they offer up suggestions on products - BUY THEM. This is not a case of upselling at the counter. These products are great quality and have helped tremendously between visits. Now go make an appointment with Risa!!!

First time eating here for a quick bite after one of my Real Estate appointments in Fishtown. I love diners, and this place was perfect. The two things I look for in a diner are quick service, and friendly staff. Mugshot has them both! 

The whole point of going to a diner is to have some breakfast food that reminds you of home, and the staff made me feel like I was an everyday regular. I had the Insomnia sandwich, which was so good I devoured the first half before I got a picture. 

Will definitely be back next time I'm in fishtown and need a pick me up!

My husband and I (with our 2 dogs: white fluffy bichon frises) were on vacation and strolling around at night at State Street when we stumbled  this cute restaurant. I was born in Indonesia so I always have a soft spot for indonesian food, so excitedly, told my hubby "woohoo...lets get some indonesian food!!".

I asked if it's ok for us to dine in the outside patio with our 2 dogs and they said "absolutely" (yes!).   All in all, we really enjoyed our dining experience in here.   They had a special (tahu isi) and I knew what that was. It is actually Sundanese food (where I was from).   Unfortunately, they ran out so we ordered fried noodle (mie goreng) and nasi campur (rice with different type of assortments).

The food verdict: we really appreciate the effort and creativity of this restaurant.  Yes, it's not traditional indonesian food but I love it.  Personally, not that many people can handle the heavy taste that often come with authentic Indonesian food.  My husband and I are always wondering why we can't make Indonesian food more mainstream here in the US and we always thought that the problem is in Indonesian heavy seasoning/sauce.

The ingredients are fresh, the taste is light & delightful, and the ambience is very nice.  Despite of the light seasoning, I can still tell that it's indonesian food.  Of course, an extra star for being dog friendly to my adorable pups (who are well behaved for the whole dining experience).
Jess is one of the best bartenders in this place. She listens when you need someone to talk to and she is quick to refill your drink. Her warms smile always greets me when I sit down.

My girlfriend a friend and I went for brunch. The food was excellent (French toast and the Texas breakfast). French toast was served with bananas and sweet cream. Definitely recommend that.

However, the service was pretty bad. Our original waitress got halfway through taking our drink order, then walked away to get my coffee but never came back. When we flagged her down she seemed really annoyed and gave our table over to another server. Nobody refilled our coffee without asking, nobody refilled the water until the very end of the meal, and nobody asked how the meal was or if we needed anything. I'd say it was because it was new years day and they were busy but it really wasn't that crowded. 

Disappointing, because I've been there before and it was better and the food is good, but there's just too many good places in the city to want to go back to a place that doesn't seem to value good service.

Little food trolley at the end of Ashley dr with a really nice owner/ operater. Great food! He is a morning person and it's nice to pick up a morning meal from him and strike up a conversation to start your day!

First time ordering. Husband in rehab & needed a meal because I didn't want to cook & didn't want fast food. My stepson & I ordered the potstickers, Rangoon, kabocha bisque, KFC, sweet potato gnocchi & the mini baguette.
Everything was delicious. Gnocchi were perfect- not gummy or dense. Rangoon with real lobster was amazing. It was a perfect meal ( with leftovers , woohoo) after a very tense week.
We are now spoiled. We will be back. Thank you Akar for a wonderful experience.

When the Martoonie days started I won a radio package for $50.00 martini's! Well then my friend and I get there and we were told we couldn't have a table because it was for "paying customers only", and the bartender forced us to redeem all 25 martini drinks at once (which I think goes against AGLC regulations), and my friend and I had to do the best we could drinking these 25 martini's. The most unprofessional bartenders ever and the waitresses are not much more effective. I will never go to this place ever (by choice). They kept telling us how they "rely on tips" and yet didn't even treat us in a pleasant manner to warrant even leaving one (and we didn't, not my problem your employer pays you minimum wage). I have never gone back to this place but once with a realtor friend of mine where he treated me to a $25 burger there which was not the world's greatest. Overall this place blows, go spend your money elsewhere (in my opinion of course)!

I really don't understand how this place is "authentic." There was not a lick of Thai on the menu (which sometimes makes it harder for those of us who read Thai and expect the items to be named a certain way). I asked for my dish to be "very spicy" and it was so plain I asked for "fresh chilis" which I used all of. Small, cute, and charming for sure, but the taste was not to par.

More health code violations than I could count in my hour in there! First, the place smelled like mildew, and it took a few minutes to realize it was the pound of rotting bananas in the bowl right next to my pedi chair. Second, the very sweet girl who did my pedicure, whom I am positive it was her first day based on her confusion and constant questions to the owner, pulled out that "cheese grater" tool that most places have been banned from using. I quickly objected and asked for just the pumice stone. Overall, the place was not kept at all, personal belongings everywhere, dirty chairs, scary looking, "disinfectant" jars, and my pedicurist's phone kept ringing off the hook to a rap song. never again!!

03/12/15 I ordered Nematodes and a box of Milky Spores from this company.
I received a "shipping scheduled to be sent on 03/17/15" email from FedEx and then received my envelope with the Nematodes minus the box of Milky Spores.
On the envelope was a label stating they were oversold on the Milky Spores and were waiting for more stock to come in.

1st: When I ordered I was not told it was out of stock.
2nd : The email about the order was about to be shipped made no mention about part of my order being backordered.
3rd: There never was an email explaining the situation and when I might receive my ordered supplies.
4th: I finally sent an email to them and they replied that they had no idea when they might get new stock from their supplier and asked if I wanted to Cancel the order.
5th: Had I not sent my email to them would I have ever heard from them?
6th: After I told them to Cancel the order I received no reply or copy of my revised account.

I'm wondering what kind of company doesn't know their inventory when an order is placed? 
What kind of company doesn't contact their customer to explain these types of issues?

The shipping story is even better: The tracking email showed it left Tucson, AZ  and was sent to Memphis, TN then to Los Angeles, CA. When I received the envelope the cold pack was actually warm so I put the package in the refrigerator. If the contemts where still good time will tell.

In summation I will never purchase anything from this unorganized company again!

Lovely dinner last night. Intimate atmosphere with friendly attentive staff. And, close to home! I had the bucket of chicken. Was delish! My wife had the gnocchi, sans the sausage in the cream sauce. Was also very good! The only things I would do different perhaps include a side in the price of the bucket of chicken and proclaim on the menu, and particularly on the website that any, or most dishes can be prepared without meat. Other than that, Fort Louise is a gem!

Yes! Eat here for breakfast for sure!!! Amazing food, service, and choices. I had a Bloody Mary and the hot salmon omelette with sauce and capers. It came with a biscuit with choice of jelly and side. I chose fruit as my side and thankful I did as I wouldn't have been able to finish it all. It was an amazing mix of flavors. My husband said the same about his hot salmon Benedict!

Went here with some friends to grab brunch on the Monday of Mardi Gras weekend. The place had a bit of a crowd, but wasn't too bad--but we still waited for about 20 minutes while they figured out a table for our party of 6.

After perusing the menu (and a few mimosas) we decided to order some meatballs and crab cakes for the table.

Both the meatballs and the crab cakes were very good--and were a good size to split. I think that I would give an edge to the crab cakes overall.

For my main meal, I decided to go with the burger. To be honest, I was not expecting anything spectacular, so I was pleasantly surprised that this burger had such great flavor. From the perfectly cooked meat, to the soft and crispy bun, to the sauce--it was really well done.

Overall, the aesthetic of this place is great and all the food we had was delicious. I'm still a bit miffed that it took so long to seat us when there were a lot of empty tables and the service was a little bizarre, but everything else more than made up for it. Definitely not a bad spot to grab a bite in the city.

High quality meat, stand behind their product and EASY to work with. Organic, antibiotic & chemical free meats. Not happy with something in the order? Not a biggie - they'll take it back and make it right every time! I order everything through email so don't have to worry about setting aside time with a sale representative, and it's delivered in the next week! Sweet. :)
