Solid breakfast with good coffee. Lots to choose from, menu layout organized by category so it's easy to make a decision. 

Pancakes were large, fluffy and cooked perfectly. Fake butter and powdered sugar cost a star, wish I had them hold both. 

Great staff, friendly and professional.

I'm a huge fan of the lululemon gear for yoga, so I'm always visiting the store for new things even if my wallet cries at the idea.  Prices are pretty hefty -- $100 for stretchy yoga pants and $60 for a running shirt?  But dayum, are they ever comfortable and last a long time... and the sale rack at the back of the store often have great things left over from the previous season ($80 cashmere wrap sweater? YES!).  Staff can vary from bubbly to downright rude, but all seem to be generally knowledgeable about what products suit what forms of exercise.

Check their activity board for athletic events and the free weekly classes held at a local studio nearby.

I too received this response from Andy Bello:

"If you left a message and emailed me i would have called you back so with out a name and number to call what can i say. i am almost perfect but only the lord is perfect my friend. my thinking is maybe it sounded like a sales call. try again. and remember be happy just be happy."

I can assure you I left messages and emails (two of each) with perfectly clear contact information, but no response whatsoever.

My friend and I were both disappointed. Aside from the beautiful decor and the cute little Mexican wishing dolls, there was nothing special about it. We were there for a late lunch and only a few tables were occupied, but service was slow. Both of us felt the food was ok at best. The salad dressing was tasteless.  We won't be returning.

****I added to the bottom a clarification based on CB response... it clarifies their error, my findings that lead to understanding their error, and some addl information****

I was torn writing this review... I even pondered not writing one at all... In the end I felt it important to write a review.

The day of service was almost perfect... almost 5-Star worthy... and they were almost my new go-to mechanics...

Here is what happened:
I called and brought my car in for an Oil Change and Tire Rotation...  It was a Great Price!

The office impressed me:
* Nice friendly people
* Beautiful Leather Couches
* Chocolate Chip cookies
* Free bottled water
* Free Shuttle ride home and back
* Free wifi
* Text communication updates

They called and said my car was ready, so I had the driver come get me and I picked up my car up.

I arrived home and was about to leave a 5-Star review and then I realized that they failed to deliver what they sold me: It is not like they just forgot to do the rotation, but instead I can honesty say that I have no idea what they did...  In order to do a rotation properly it is not just swapping 2 tires, but all 4... 

Let me explain... A tire rotations supposed to have the rear tires moved to the front and then the front tires x-crossed and moved back...  What I received back was one of my front tires still on the front and one moved to the back.  I drove back and I pointed out that the rotation was not done properly... To this he took my car and when given back I had the tires back on the front that started on the front... I again told them that is not a rotation and explained that the front tires need to end up on the back... He again took my car and this time it came back with the rotation possibly done correctly (I have no way to verify if they were x-crossed).

 So, in the end I spent and extra 45 minutes at the place waiting... I had to fight and argue to have what I paid to have done actually get done... and I left wondering what else was neglected that I could not see.

I do not like leaving a mechanic wondering if the work was done and if it was done correctly... I would rather have a thorough and complete job and not have the cookies and water.

Unfortunately, I will probably not be back.

I really wanted to like this place.

If you have work done here, label your parts/tires and make them prove work was done... that might be the solution.

-Dave

**** This part was added in response to the response by CB: Yes CB did tell me one tire was lower and offered to sell me a new one... This part of the service appointment was spot-on.  In fact their records probably show that BOTH my tires that were on the FRONT were lower than the ones on the back since they commented that the ones that were on the back were "like new"... to which I responded that that was due to me not rotating often enough, which is why I needed it done...  Even after that conversation, CB still some how missed the mark ... Maybe their records have what happened since after the "tire rotation" there was one tire that was low tread on the back and one tire that was low tread on the front...  That lower tread is how I knew that CB messed up... Then after CB "fixed it" and did the rotation the 2nd time: Both the low tread tires were again on the front... The 3rd time CB did the rotation they actually managed to get the tires that started on the front axels to end up on the back.... I hope this is in their records.  Did CB actually x-cross the back tires like recomended?  Seriously, I would like to know****

Food was great! We had the crispy pork belly for our starter which was delicious and made me wish I  had ordered the pork chop as my entree!  It was my son's bday and we love the burger and fries so once again we had our favorite and it was perfect! For dessert we had fried bread and chocolate!  I almost forgot about the Brussels sprouts... yes they are that good!!! The atmosphere is cozy with a nice comfortable appeal!  The staff did a great job of keeping our water glasses filled and making sure we were well taken care of. We will definitely be back with the rest of the family and friends! Thanks for making my sons birthday special!

Cafe Beignet has been on my bucket list of food places to try for quite awhile, and I'm so glad I finally got to try them! 

I visited the cafe on a Tuesday night, so thankfully it wasn't busy at all-- just one or two diners. The folks that were in there seemed like locals and I apparently looked like a tourist, because they said I would love the beignets! Hallelujah! 

When I ordered my food, I ordered the basic beignet plate -- the tried and true! Once I ordered, they gave me a number (not that I needed it) and I sat down eagerly awaiting my beignets! 

Soon, the heavenly sound of the back doors opening rang in my ears, and here came my beignets. I was all smiles, and those smiles were certainly warranted. There were three pillowy beignets in the cardboard serving tray, LOADED, and I mean LOADED, with powdered sugar. When you bite into the beignet, the powdered sugar just melts in your mouth and turns into this delicious, sweet paste that mix amazingly with the fried dough of the beignet. I inhaled all three of those beignets and I loved every second of it. The aftermath of powdered sugar was a bit out of control, but who cares, I loved it. 

This was such an amazing eating experience. Next time I go to NOLA, this will be a first stop for me, and it should be for you as well.
Excellent service and delicious food. Prices are reasonable. I like the atmosphere as well. Fresh ingredients. Not crowded.

First time to Oceanaire & it was the best experience. My boyfriend and I enjoyed our evening thanks to our waiter, Tom. He recommended the best items & may I recommend the add on of crab meat, best crab I've had in a while. Dessert was fabulous. Get the toffee pudding! You can't go wrong at Oceanaire. Coming back very soon. Thank you!

I signed up for a week and was happy. Free towels! Just be careful with all the Rules. This gym doesn't know what it is. There are a lot of younguns who want this to be a gritty urban experience. There are a lot of seniors who want this to be a fitness room in an assistant living facility.

My husband and I loved this place! We have had Thai at several different places in south tampa and this has been our fave so far! The Thai island fried rice and pad Thai were BOTH so delicious! We sat outside and the string lights and ambiance were so cute :) we will definitely go back!
The best. The Reuben and the Rachel are two of the best sandwiches in the city. A classic deli. Make sure to try a lemon bar or brownie. It's worth the caloric splurge.
Great food! It's consistent and always fresh...and the butter with olives is amazing!

The orange chicken was so old and chewy we couldn't finish it. When I tried to go in and pick it up they have doors blocking the entrance so you can't go in. So he said he would call us when it was ready. We waited 15 minutes but I'm not sure why, because the soup and chicken was cold. Orange chicken was the worst I have ever had. Panda Express is a better choice that is how bad this is.

I have been doing yoga off and on for 10 years, and can say that Sol Yoga Studio is addicting.  The instructors, the people in class, make it a fun place to be.  The work out is about as intense as you can get, but is absolutely doable for newbies.  The instructors are really the best aroud, and not only teach a great class, but their enthusiam is contagious!  They have amazing workshops, tons of classes, and an atmosphere that leaves you wanting more.  I highly recommend Sol, and proudly identify it is as "my yoga studio," a place where i know I will leave with a smile on my face :)

Last night was my birthday.  Because of the amazing service we've received in the past, I thought, Growlers it is.  Travis used to help us and I've been here dozens of times.

 Here's the part that really made me mad.  My father had a stroke in September and is in a wheelchair.   My mom got there before me and was told that 5 people can sit at a 4 person table.  This was the first time we had all gone to dinner together since the stroke.  Everyone that worked there just watched us struggle with the table and chairs, clearly we couldn't all sit at one table.  I had to go ASK if we could put two table together.  Really?  So WE push the tables together and move all the chairs.  

Service was slow, it looked like someone had hit my mom and dads sandwich with a hammer and it only had meat on one side.  I ordered the sliders, they were cold.  Appetizers were amazing, beer was great, and there was live music.


We were getting ready to leave and my dad started crying.  I calmed him down and he asked if he could see who was singing, thinking it might be a friend of his.  Well we couldn't see because there was a table IN in isle!  Then we had to move two chairs to be able to leave!  My dad was embarrassed and it broke my heart.  My experience of Growlers this time is that they are not handicapped friendly, and need to hire more people.  There were too many people there and not enough help.  

The tables and chairs should have never been setup like they were.  No one cared.  It was like they couldn't see us.  I will not he back.

The location couldn't have been more perfect. Right on the corner of bourbon street, but far enough towards the end to avoid all the noise. The hotel is clean and beautiful. The gym was a decent size-about 4 treadmills, a few elliptical, 3 weight benches and free weights. The pool is rather small, but kinda expect them for a rooftop pool. The connecting restaurant Bourbon House is great. Also the Red fish grill right outside the side door was awesome. Would defined stay here again

Came in around 830 on a Saturday night. It wasn't that crowded so we were seated right away. Waitress/bartender came right over and got our drinks (which were delicious by the way--strawberry jalapeño margarita and swirl margarita). She was very polite and attentive throughout the entire meal. 

Food was delicious and very unique. Was expecting standard mexican food but was happily surprised with the Latin flair/vibe. Will definitely be back if we are in the area again. I would recommend this for anyone wanting to try something different but still in the mood for Mexican(ish) food and margaritas.
Worst dominos ever . Dumb employees dumb manager I wait for 1  .30 hour and I don't have any pizza yet

Yogurt is good. It's the best. They are awesome. The flavors are yummy. They have choclate and colada and raspberry. And banna. I am mad that I signed up for my birthday and the ad says I get it for free on my birthday and they charged me. I told them. And I showed them. But they charged me. I signed up and did what the ad said.

Pork belly mac and cheese, deviled eggs, pickled veggies, good beer list, go-go dancers on the projection screen and live dancers on select nights.

Hello, awesome. This place is amazing! All the positive reviews on here I am basically reinforcing. The only thing I will be specific about on my visit was how amazing our server was. He took time to talk to us about the space and everything on the menu as well as what they have going on throughout the week. I hope this places succeeds and sticks around for a long time.

This place was great! Very clean, everyone was friendly! Came for my bachelorette party and everyone wanted tattoos. The shop was very accommodating and took us in. They do have appointments for clients like every tattoo shop. Everyone was very nice and kept us updated. We love our tattoos!!

This was my second time taking my dog to 5 points and my first time seeing Dr. Regan. My dog had been having gastro issues and I was able to get in for a same day appointment. Dr. Regan was awesome. He spent at least a half hour prior to even doing a physical on my dog going over different possibilities of why she might be having those issues. He explained everything that would be done today very thoroughly. During the physical he was very sweet with my very nervous dog. Will definitely be sticking with Dr. Regan for all future visits! Very knowledgeable.

Went back to silk city for some drinks and their bangin garlic bread crusted Mac n cheese & smoked turkey greens sooo good. 

Service could have been more attentive but other than that I love this place! I paid 14$ for a Long Island ice tea which was pretty ridiculous but I think server was annoyed after my boyfriend had to flag her down for service. She cashed us out before we were done ordering.  And had a bit of an attitude cause we wanted to order more. Other than that everything else was great. 

Good music and great vybe! Good is always on point hats off to the chefs! I would have gave Five stars if service was better! Bus boy was more worried about what we needed then the server. I hope they get tipped out. Cause they deserve it

Love to order from here the food is great. They delivery is on time, I order vegetable fried rice no eggs, the order of chive and onion rangoon, and the jalapeño rangoon. Delish I recommend  this restaurant if you're  in the downtown location.
Very nice and efficient office. Doc was very thorough and took plenty of time to explain everything. As good as my PCP. I was able to get X-rays there and examined.

I went to Lee's tailoring because I needed a suit tailored before graduation. I needed the pants hemmed and the sleeves on my coat shortened.

When I walked in, Lee helped me immediately and was very friendly. I put on the suit, and he marked the sleeves accordingly. When it came to the pants, I told him I wanted little to no break and he worked with that splendidly.

I picked up my items a week later and tried them on--fit like a dream. I was very happy with the outcome! 

Now, the only complaint that I have, and this is potentially unfair on my part, was the price I had to pay. I saved a lot on the suit, so spending money on the tailor was something I knew I was going to have to do--I just didn't expect to pay as much as I did. 

But I think good tailoring is like getting a tattoo--if you have articles of clothing you plan on wearing perfectly for a long time, you have to go to a good tailor. Bargaining on a tattoo artist is not something you do and it should be the same way with a tailor. 

I give the place 5 stars for perfect tailoring, excellent service, and an overall great experience.

A Tucson classic whose drinks won't disappoint. My favorite food items include the deluxe grinder and fries with ranch on the side. All Eegee's locations are consistent with quality. Sometimes they get held up when they're busy. I also like catering their sandwiches and drinks since it's fairly inexpensive. I love taking my friends/family here if they're visiting from out of town.

a friend and i went there, ordered fish tacos, and the tacos were moldy, and you could tell before noticing that, that had been gone bad. we complained and thet brought us two more, and apparently the cooks didnt even check the tacos. these were also moldy. worst mexican food evee, la parada is by far the best mexican restaurant ever

Incredible! It far exceeded my expectations. I came on a Saturday with a 7 and 4 year old. The huge Remo drum head and Zildjian gong right up front kind of intimidated my older girl but it didn't take long before she was banging away on whatever she could find. The place has an awesome mix of historical artifacts, educational opportunities, and just plain hand on fun! I was really surprised at how much stuff there was to play with and the fact that there weren't snobby employees everywhere mediating the activities. It's totally self guided and the guy at the front desk was very cool. 
The sound simulator rooms are really neat. 
Seeing drum sets by some of the greats kind of took my breath away. I've seen them at the R&RHoF before but here they are so close you can see every scratch on the heads and every nick in the cymbals. You could touch them - but don't! :)
I would enjoy this place with or without kids. Come out and support this amazing museum / playground.

I went in for a mani/pedi and eyebrows and spent $80 for above along with extra for gel to make it last 3 weeks. I was told regular pedi would last 2 weeks (which it normally does anywhere else I've gotten it done).  This was for a special occasion, 3 days later in Carolina. 

By Saturday, the "3 week" gel was already wearing off and my nails showing through. And the pedi? Same thing. VERY DISAPPOINTED! My eyebrows weren't shaped. The nails look raggedy just a few days in, and the owner didn't want to do a partial refund on the mani/pedi - they don't guarantee it will last, even though that is what they push when you're in there to decide what you want. He gave me $20 which is only partial on the extra for the gel that was supposed to last THREE weeks!

You be the judge if you want your nails to look like this a few days after spending that kind of money. (AND I was overcharged, because according to him, it should have been several dollars less, so in actuality, he really gave me much less for my trouble. WON'T be back in there!

The first guy in lighting that we talked to was not very helpful so we asked for someone else. Taylor came to our assistance and helped us with what we needed. Ask for Taylor,  he knows what he is doing.

Yep, this is my go to place, the food is great on a bad day! They get busy so be patient. Great for breakfast, good for lunch.  I recommend the breakfast burrito, and any of the Benedict's, or just a home baked scone and a cup of coffee. The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars with this review is pricing. Breakfast for two will cost $40 with coffee, tax, and tip. A bit steep, but I still go at least once a week!

5 stars for the entertainment, the Song Suffragettes were great and I liked supporting young women getting going in the music industry.  But the food, drink, and service were lacking.  They require you to purchase $15, but when you can't get your waiters attention that can be hard to do.  The menu is limited and un-inspired.  I would prefer to pay a higher admission charge and then just consume if I would like to.

My son just got his braces on and we had a great experience with the Dr. JAW staff team.  The staff explained everything to both me and my son. Looking forward to interacting more with them! Thanks, Dr. JAW!!

Super service, excellent beer selection, so much great food to choose from.   Love the atmosphere!  Hard rockin super cool joint.  I'll be back to try the rest of the menu.   Just moved into a top hangout for me when I'm in town.

I am gluten free and always have such a hard time finding good gluten free pizza. Boston style pizza has the BEST gluten free pizza I have ever had!! I recommend it! Super delicious and taste just like regular pizza!

Still one of the best Sushi spots around.
The tamago is frozen (bad) but the Spicy Tuna Balls are great and the sashimi is solid.
The last time I went I tried a specialty roll (can remember the name) for $14.95 (ouch) and the hamachi sashimi app.  (YUM!).

Ask for sauces on the side if you prefer.
Sushi chef Sam is very nice, too.

I'm still a fan!

Not a chain but a family run business. The lunch menu features hoagies, cheese steak, and pizzas. My favorite is the broccoli and tomato white pizza. Their dinner menu has changed recently with the veal dish.

I went for a Pedi for my birthday. The worst experience! Just when the woman was getting ready to do my massage, she was distracted by some man at the counter. She ignored me for a good 10 minutes talking to him. Meanwhile, my husband was next to me getting a foot/leg massage the whole time. When she finally got back to me, she just polished my nails & sent me on my way, no apology. I will never return!
I'm glad to see a lot of positive change in this last year. Service has greatly improved and the food has obviously always been great. Will always come here for a nice iced coffee. Great improvement!

Not good? More like deplorable!  The table was filthy and waitress got miffed when asked to clean tabletop. The tomato sauce on the entry was served BOILING clearly microwaved. Could only eat one bite. When the bill arrived the total was too high. ONLY at that point was advised there is  $4 cover charge during entertainment.  When seated in dining room, there was no entertainment. When ordered still no entertainment. The entertainment did not start til presented with the bill.  I have lived here 7 years; was always told don't go Alpha House lousy. Now I know first hand why this place is awful.

I write this review hoping that Santo can make a few changes - because they are on the right track. We loved the whole experience, interior design, service was good and the food was excellent - HOWEVER the DOWNFALL IS the portions are SO SMALL - to the extent of being ridiculous.  It is a fully priced restaurant but seriously I have never seen such tiny portions.  I thought perhaps it was what we ordered - but the Branzino - could not have been 3 ounces with the skin on - for $32 that is not ok. I was so dissappointed since my husband came home and made a sandwich and I know that he does not want a repeat of that no matter how good the food is.  The chicken we ordered also tiny.  What I do not understand is that I LOVE the other restaurants this group has.  I have Never left Epice hungry.  The one constant feedback I am hearing from people in Nashville and travelers is the portions.  So I am hoping the owners are reading this an upping their game.  If one compares the price level they are trying to charge with the food portions they are servicing - especially the protein - its just not competitive. I spend more than half my time in San Francisco - and the best michelin starred restaurants are not this skimpy.  Maybe we went on a bad night but food flavor and preparation was delicious - quantity no.  The other friends we had who went and whose husband will not go back - went and ordered pizza after they left.  For the record my husband and the other man in question are fit trim guys.  Even I was hungry - so get the portions right and this place will be a huge success.

Great place to go in downtown Fishers. Menu is great. My favorite it the tacos. I usually try different ones. 
Sangria is great if you are not a beer drinker. It is family friendly and always great service! 
Wonderful addition to downtown!

Joe G and Ricky shot our Union Trust wedding in Old City, Philadelphia. I don't even know where to begin. We were set on having a photojournalist for our engagement and wedding photos. The instant we saw JPG's photos, we knew they were it. Hiring them was the absolute best decision we made in planning our May wedding.

We talked to Joe G more than any other wedding vendor throughout the process. Joe has this ability to make you feel comfortable about everything. He's so relaxed, easy-going, and incredibly thoughtful. As the bride, I can honestly say that my entire day wouldn't have been the same without Joe G there.

JPG has completely surpassed our expectations for a wedding photographer.
We highly recommend them for any occasion and can guarantee they will impress.

It's IKEA.  I actually rarely buy anything because a 550sq ft apartment is rarely laid out as they have it on their showroom floor.  I do like the meatball combo in the cafeteria & the food at the front of the store though!  I go back & walk around about twice a year.

I just rented a tuxedo from Iacobucci for the first time ever recently and I could not have been more pleased with the process. The selection was great, the fitting was smooth, I was able to pick up the rental just 1 day later and the price was lower than I expected.

Between my two stops I met and chatted with both owners who were great guys. Looking forward to using Iacobucci for years to come.

Went here on Saturday.

Service was a bit slow.  I had the bucatini which was fantastic.  Fresh, handmade pasta, definitely fresh.  Would go back.
I had a really nice meal here--the cheese plate and the fried green tomatoes were awesome. My dining companions said only great things about the food. Lovely little restaurant.

Was driving through Indianapolis and saw this place had a high rating, so I stopped for lunch. Had the BACON, MUSHROOM, SWISS BURGER (Hickory smoked bacon, sautéed mushrooms, and Swiss cheese.) It was really just ok. Nothing stood out or was remarkable, it just was an OK burger. 

Well, I take that back. I had ordered the burger "medium well" but for some bizarre reason the patty was well done on one side, and as you ate through it the other side was medium. The only thing I can guess is that it was cooked on the very edge of the grill so one side got more heat than the other? It was certainly something I've never experienced before. I wish I had rotated that sandwich just a tad so I could have had proof to show the waitress how it was cooked!
Diane is the best morning bartender! She makes an amazing strawberry shortcake martini that is sure to please !!  She is fabulous and very personable and always makes you feel welcomed !

I went to Trader Bay Seafood the other day and when I walked in (wearing my mask) the old guy who works there came out from the back room.  I asked him where was his mask?  He replied that he doesn't need one.  I said we all need to wear our masks now.  He told me if that I don't like it I don't have to come in there!  The gal who waited on me didn't have a mask on either and when I said everyone should wearing masks she replied, "I learned in high school that wearing a mask is harmful"!  I wondered how many years ago she was told that and by what idiot!!  The way I was treated in there was disgraceful!  I will never be returning.  The kids they have working there don't know anything about seafood anyway.  I would NOT recommend Trader Bay to anyone!

I love this shop. The owner, Donald is great and knows it all, the mechanic Jonathan knows his stuff and Mary at the front desk, is so flipping nice. They have helped me so much. Thank Bicycle Connection!! Regina D's

$1 drafts from a local brew. Sure they are maybe 10 OZ, but a buck? You gotta be kidding me. They also sell six packs.. a bar selling six packs. "Come to the west coast!!" I shout from the rooftops. Of course a jukebox full of all my favorite jams, a shuffle board table, and oddly enough I adore you can smoke in here. Plus, who doesn't love a bar that is next door to a pizza shop and opens at 8 AM? Perfect. Just the perfect dive bar in all of mankind and I will proudly sport around my new tshirt!

Hooray for neighborhood hardware stores. I know it is really Ace but the people that work here are top notch and many are actually really knowledgeable in their respective department. The paint department guys are especially excellent. They have a great garden section as well. It is a little more expensive than home depot but with member coupons they can have good deals. They also gave us a month of discount to set up our new home. Awesome. Totally recommend here as the first stop.

Just had my brand new 2015 Honda CR-V tinted to the tune of $533.93. They did a beautiful job on the tint (initial assessment... not dry yet)! But they put an 1" long scratch on the outside of the rear window... taking off an emblem I put there after buying the car two weeks ago. Looks like maybe a screwdriver was used to pry up the emblem or something. All they said was sorry.. and offered $20.00 dollars off the tint job. This is a two week old $32,000 dollar vehicle that now has a very noticeable scratch in the glass. They do nice tint.. but don't back up their mistakes... and don't make good on them! Use them at your own risk!
food was great we got bugogi and sushi was cheap staff was great was empty but that was fine had a good family vibe
The food was delicious!! The bowwow fruit punch was on hit!! The chicken was outstanding!! Old school like bigmama just salt and pepper.

I appreciate the great work they do by letting shelters & rescues show  their precious homeless pet CATS there to help them find loving forever homes (some also, have -dogs -usually on weekends). It gives the animals more opportunity to be seen by potential adopters... 'the animal lovers who come in',-  Like me!-   & I got one of my gorgeous black cats at a Pet Smart! --Thanks!

My friends and I bombarded Kinetic last weekend in an effort to snatch up some new snowboarding gear for a series of upcoming trips. I was overjoyed when I realized that I don't think I've ever been coddled nearly as much by sales staff as I was as Kinetic. Holy hand grenade! Bran, the awesome dude running the show on this particular Saturday, brought out 25 different pairs of boots for the 4 of us to try on. 25 pairs. And we tore all of them out of the boxes and left the carnage for them to pick up. And they still smiled at us. Either they've got a screw loose at Kinetic, or they are just really, really awesome. I'll go with the former. Plus, he held our hands while he explained the intricacies of snowboard design et al and calmly and expertly answered our 13 trillion questions. I took a look at their skateboard and equipment selection, too, and was pretty impressed. I couldn't get into it too much because that's not what I was there for, but I do plan to go back to Kinetic in the spring to drop a buttload of money on a rad longboard that struck my fancy. 

Needless to say, we walked out of that place with a small boat-load of gear and huge grins.
Excellent food!! Super fresh and homemade taste! Wonderful service-Jeff was fantastic!!! Highly recommend!

Some of the employees need to know the meaning of being polite. Most of them are awesome but some really make the customers feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. Cough cough lady with blue and blonde hair.

Blue Sake is a cute little Asian Fusion restaurant with so many options including Thai, Chinese, Japanese, & Vietnamese food.  They also have some outside seating which is perfectly fitting since Dunedin is super dog friendly.

We ordered four rolls including the Lobster Roll, Spicy Tuna Roll, Tuna Bomb, and JB roll. The lobster roll and JB roll were my fave. We also ordered edamame to go with it. It came with a very tasty ginger salad.

My hubby's drunken noodles were okay, but there was barely any chicken, and I thought should have had a few more veggies.

I do like it here and feel like they have options on their menu that I don't see anywhere. No complaints about their service. It was pretty good, but I liked our first server, better than the second one.

The food, the drinks, and the service was amazing. Ryan was our waiter and made sure we had full glasses and good food. Everything was perfect, our food came out hot and delicious. The drinks were tasty and delicious, with average size drinks. All in all I had a blast here.  The outdoor sitting area was cool with the Halloween decorations and music.  If you are looking for a good time and good food and great drinks look no farther folks this place has it all. I will definitely be coming back and bringing some people with me.

If you procrastinate like me every time you need your hair cut or colored,  and always wait till the last minute, you should try Beauty Brands!  I had no idea they were a salon until I read it on yelp! 

The prices don't break the bank which is great!  I do have to say my hair doesn't need much usually, but I would feel confident going in for color as well.  

They were able to get me in for a haircut on a same day appointment!  I was immediately asked if I would like a drink as soon as I walked in and my stylist promptly took me to her station and began asking me what I was looking for out of my appointment.  I told her I just needed a trim and she discussed how much she would take off before we started.  I like this.  

She washed my hair first and gave me a scalp massage.  I feel like I hadn't been that relaxed in a salon in a long time.  Don't get me wrong, it's not a spa like atmosphere, or anything special really, but I just felt relaxed there.  

She trimmed my hair next and really didn't talk to me the entire time.  I thought it got a little awkward with the silence at one point, but I also don't like to sit and try to make conversation every time I see a new stylist.  An in between could have been nice.  

She did a really good job with my trim and blew dry and flat ironed my hair before I left.  For not even knowing this place was more than a store that sold makeup and hair products, I'm impressed!  I will definitely back to see what other services I've been missing out on!  Surprise!  YAY!

Dr. Yu as well as his support staff are wonderful, answered all of my questions and walked me through the process numerous times - as I have anxiety at the dentist, but they were all so wonderful! I would highly recommend these guys! ~Kirsten
The food and sports screens are 5 stars but the music is just way too loud. I don't like shouting over it and you can't hear the servers.

I had a great experience with Yong's alterations . I brought in a pencil skirt that I needed to be taken in around the waist. They fitted me and said that they would have it done in less than a week. When I got the skirt back, it fit like a glove. Honestly, it's probably one of the best fitting pieces of clothing I own now, and I am think about getting the rest of my dress pants (and maybe even jeans) altered too.

Brunch was excellent , from the omelet station to the waffles as well as the crepes and other variety of items but save some room for the desserts I almost didn't  service was prompt and courteous as well will defiantly be back soon

This place is very hit or miss.
Tonight was definitely a hit when it came to the bargains I found;perhaps it was due to the fact that no one else was crazy enough to shop today.

I found a gorgeous dress with cream top and black lace skirt for the low price of $6.99. 

On my way to the register, a rack of shoes caught my eye and I found the most gorgeous pair of boots I've ever seen. They were taupe thigh-high boots with quilted gold and brown interior and topped off with a bow in the rear of the top of the boot. Originally $39.99, I got them for $22.99.

It's days like this that make shopping worth it.

This Tim Hortons is always busy, but it is usually pretty fast. I go to this location in either the earlier morning for a small breakfast or the afternoon for a quick lunch. The drive - thru is the way to go. I have gone into the restaurant in the morning and it was extremely slow. Whenever I go through the drive-thru I am in and out in a couple minutes.
The coffee is always hot and food is always fresh. They truly do stick to their slogan (Always fresh).

The employees are also very helpful. My car stalled in the drive-thru during the 7am rush and an employee came out to help push it! Talk about going the extra mile!
The pupusas were fantastic. As good as any I've eaten anywhere. Definitely the real deal.

The manager/owner is rude, careless and has disregarded my requests four out of four times. He's certainly earned this review, along with his I.V.-wide reputation. When I called to inquire as to whether or not he's receiving them, he just ignores me and tells me that he's busy. Is it really too much to charge me for additional sides of condiments? How about to tell his delivery-person to call me to open the door for him? Alright, how about calling me to explain to me that he can't accommodate those requests? It's a shame that this jackass is in charge of the only Indian-restaurant in I.V. Even though I crave Indian-food, he'll never have my business again.

I used to seek out Hard Rock Cafe's when I visited other cites in the 90's and early 2000's now not so much.  I usually go for the weekly radio show.  The food is average at best. It's a gimmick restaurant. 

To me they need more variety.  I mean they have burgers, wings and chicken fingers and fries.  I go every week and I am sick of the food already haha. Oh well at least the show is entertaining.  Maybe they could do weekly specials or something to change it up.

Try not to notify owner Kristen about skimpy bland food because she will respond by reprimanding you.
The service was inattentive.

When the local CVS was having a hard time getting my medication, I turned to Fishtown Pharmacy. Not only did they have it in stock, but they contacted the CVS to get access to my prescription saving me the hassle of having to contact my doctor. They also delivered the medicine for free on the same day! You can bet my future prescription needs will be filled at Fishtown pharmacy!

Stopped in for our final meal before heading out to the airport. Mambos did not disappoint. I had the Louisiana crab cake pasta it was excellent. My husband had the taste of New Orleans. It too was excellent. I particularly liked the gumbo. We also had the bead pudding for dessert absolutely delicious.

The ribs and sausage dinner is my favorite and the side are delicious.  When they opened the first month, I was there 6 times.  It's good food and you don't have to deal with long waits for seating. 

You walk up, order your food, find an open table, sit down, eat and leave.  

No mood candles or low lighting ambiance.  Can't beat that.  No separate table which is fine for me.  Great family friendly restaurant.

I swear, if they reheat my pizza and leave it in the box like a big soggy mess, im gonna have to go back to Eddies and Sams. And they're a sorry excuse for a New York slice. Please don't throw the pizza in the box, and please make that slice crispy. Its why I started coming here every week. Dont let up the consistency.

My favorite part about Buddha Bowls is that it genuinely is a really novel and cool idea.

Especially living in IV, I feel like a lot of business owners don't really take risks. Besides Kogiliscious' Korean tacos, most of the food is pretty standard fair. Lots of burritos and burgers and more burritos. Buddha Bowls is a breath of fresh air and really appeals to my inner foodie. I came at one point towards the beginning and there were definitely some kinks to work out, but more recently they seem to really be getting their stuff together. 

I would definitely recommend Buddha Bowls, particularly the peace bowl or the BBQ chicken bowl.
Funky and excellent. You have to try the corned beef hash. Ambiance is superb. Great cure for a hangover.  Bloody Marys are house made.

Cute place. Tons of people are working there on their laptops. Great fresh coffee. They have food( I saw pre-made sandwiches), beer, and wine, but I only had a latte. Friendly barista. I like that they have covered outdoors seating and an option to sit indoors if you need AC.

Good Pizza...some people that are pizza snobs and yes this is not your New York Pizza but for good eats, easy ordering, fast and hot service this is a good alternative.  My husband is from New York and he enjoys the pizza also.  The different specialty pizzas are good and good variety. We were skeptical to try it because the old Domino's left something to be desired, but they have changed and are greatly improved.
Try it you may like it.

Before I go any farther into this review, I must admit this is my first time eating Indian food; however I have been here 3 times now and I think it's delicious - especially for the price. I tend to go here on Sunday evenings to grab some quick grub to go from the buffet. On a side note, the guy who works the cash register (who I believe is the manager) has exceptionally good customer service skills.

I would echo all the positive things said about the food and also cheer peppermint hot chocolate on the menu. Nice touch. 

Also, there was a crying toddler in the restaurant. The management was really watching everything that went on. I felt they waited JUST the right amount of time before discreetly going over and saying something that cause the dad to take the crying kid outside. She didn't rush over as soon as she started crying, but she didn't wait until our experience was ruined either; just right. Kudos to mgmt because this is a tricky, sensitive thing to do.

Visited here for a date night. It is located in the Four Seasons hotel. The elevator ride up to the 60 floor was pretty cool. The ambiance was perfect for a date night or if you're trying to impress someone on a first date. You cannot beat the views from the top of Philly as you wine and dine. I would say if you're very hungry this isn't the place for you in terms of value. The pizza was delicious and we tried the sushi, as well as their take on a strawberry sundae. Had a few drinks. Only reason I gave 4 stars is because of it being unbelievably pricey but the experience was well worth the visit. If we go back it would be just for drinks and the cool experience. And oh yeah, dress to impress !

Chante Padilla is a true gem.  She has been helping us with our supplemental insurance needs for several years now.   We meet with her during open enrollment periods every year.  She guides us through all the insurance confusion and finds us the best policies at the best rates to meet our individual medical needs.   She is very thorough, and we trust her.  
T. Coaster and G. Coaster

I received six laser hair removal sessions on my underarms. I have been waiting to see if there would be results and sadly the results are not even close to what I believe I should have gotten. 

Let me preface this by saying I am getting my Brazilian done at a competitor. I have had four sessions and I have almost no hair growth. 

Laser Me Inc. Did six whole sessions and I am still shaving EVERY. SINGLE. DAY. I believe they are purposely deceptive in their services so that you have to pay for multiple unnecessary services that could have probably been taken care of in less time. 

Not only this but I always arrived early/on time and always had to wait at least ten minutes to be called in. The appt. itself would literally be less than two minutes. They don't even keep the laser on for that long. 

I would never recommend them to anyone. It would be one thing if just one aspect of the experience was poor but the wait time, the customer service, the service itself, and the price is just not in line with what you can get at other places.

Sadly, I have to update my review and remove a few stars due to a horrific experience with this clinic. Since 2011 I have been bringing my three cats to Dr. Hong and he has been fairly efficient and kind when treating them. One of my cats has diabetes, and needs insulin shots twice a day. We were going on vacation and needed to board him, to make sure he got his shots regularly (anyone who has a diabetic pet knows how important it is). I thought he would be in good hands with the veterinarian's office, as they had watched him previously had had not reported any issues. 

The second time boarding was horrible. I called the morning we got back to see how my cat was doing, and the girl reported that he had been urinating all over himself, he had to be squished in the corner of the cage to get his shot (and couldn't tell me what times he had gotten his shots), and by the way, they would absolutely not clean him. I came in to pick him up, expecting him to be stinky, wet and scared but I would have rather found that then to see blood on the bottom of the cage, and after inspecting him, I found his back claw had been ripped right out of his nail bed, quick and all (he didn't even smell like urine..so what was that about? They said he hadn't been bathed). Obviously, I was quite distraught... the tech in charge at the time was amazing, she was as shocked as we were and she made sure to call Dr. Hong right away. He insisted that he thought it was his own blood, since he had been scratched (so leave the cage dirty?). How long had he been sitting there in his own blood? 

I spoke with Dr. Hong on the phone (he was at his second office) and he only said that I should give my cat antibiotics. He also wouldn't comp the antibiotics, reason being "if your cat hadn't been so upset, he wouldn't have gotten hurt". SO, it was my diabetic cat's fault that he lost his own claw. Found out later, the antibiotics were only $15...and it made me very upset, because I would have thought at the very least, since my cat was injured on their premises, under their watch they should have treated him (I signed a waiver that said if medical treatment was necessary, they would treat him).

I was forced to go to another veterinarian in the area to make sure he was ok and to get better advice on diabetes and how to best monitor him. The other vet actually spent a lot of time with us, and spent a lot of time getting to know our kitty and even said if he started to get upset and angry, they have special gloves they use to protect their arms. 

In summary... If you have a cat that is special needs don't board him here. They are more concerned with dogs than cats, and don't keep appropriate records of medication administration.

My most FAVORITE taco restaurant in St. Louis! The brisket taco is by far my favorite, but I always get a variety of tacos when I come here. I live in St. Charles so the drive is a bit far but definitely worth it when I'm craving great tacos!
Got a tattoo from Noah today. Super nice dude, chill environment and clean studio. Definitely recommend him!

Okay, we are somewhat still new to T-Town and the ways here.  We are finding out the some of the same name places to eat don't serve the same food.  This DQ is a classic example.  We pulled in to get a burger and Blizzard but found out fast they don't serve burgers or anything that isn't frozen.  We left still hungry but with blizzards in had.  Thank God there was a Jack in the Box just down the street.  The staff was nice and service fast, so they get 4 stars, 5 if they had a burger.

Had New Year's Eve dinner here with the wife, we sat around for a while (around 20-30 mins) before anybody saw us other than that the food was great big portion appetizers steaks were flavorful well prepared and juicy and our desert was on the waiter since we did wait a bit when we first sat down
This place is a breath of fresh air! The employees are always kind and upbeat, the produce and products are only the highest quality and for a small shop they have most everything you need!

Toyota of Tampa Bay was a great place to buy a car. From Ty Elliott, the sales consultant to Greg the GM, their first priority was to make sure things went smooth and fair. I appreciate the time Ty put into the sale from the beginning.  There was proper follow up without being over pushy and the entire team at Toyota of Tampa Bay ensured we were satisfied even after the sale. Thank you all!!  She is a beauty!!

My family and I tried out this place for lunch today and we got a mixture of breakfast and lunch food. The fried okra disappeared minutes after being served. Shrimp and Grits with sausage is a LARGE portion but delicious. Waffles were soft and tasty!  Service was good and waitresses were very nice.

My family and I truly enjoyed our first experience! Our waitress was super friendly and attentive! It was a Friday night at 6pm and we got seated right away and greeted right away as well! The place was not packed but it did have plenty of people in it! The food was absolutely delicious as well. Being from the restaurant industry service and food make or break an experience. This place is a MUST go to. I love that it is family owned and operated! We will be back for sure!
Cindy did a magnificent job for my son and daughter in laws wedding. The flowers were the perfect colors and the arrangements were exactly what we wanted. Thank you so much Cindy for your expertise.

I have been using Philly off-airport parking for more than 15 years, given the exorbitant costs of parking at the airport, when you can get it. There are several excellent facilities within 5 miles, all with delivery and pickup, decent prices, and many with services. Colonial Airport Parking has been the one I've used the most, since they also have a points program towards free or discounted parking. I've utilized a couple of their services - getting a car inspected, car wash and an oil change - on a couple of occasions. The location is terrific, and I always prefer the valet over the "self park" function, since they pick you up, and drop you off, first. Count on a 15-20 minute ride to the airport. As for the pick up, well, it has taken as much an an hour for their shuttle service to show up. The drivers are great, but every other parking service will show up 2 or more times before Colonial makes an appearance, and as happened to us on Dec. 28th, we had to wait for a second shuttle since the first one was too full. And woe to you if your car is parked under a tree in the fall - they will not clean off the leaves. 

They have a nice website, and a nice app, but the very poor airport pickup shuttle schedule has really soured me on them. Wally Park costs more, and Parking Spot may be a little farther away, but their shuttles show up much, much faster.
Great food, terrible customer service.  $40 minimum on a credit card ???!??!?!? And the credit card machine is always down.  Just lost a loyal customer :(

First visit today. Best real tacos in St. Louis. Had two al pastor and two carnitas tacos. Wife has two carne asada and one pollo tacos. Flavors was great, and the salsa for the tacos was spicy but a nice addition. Chips and salsa were great as well. Price was good ($2/taco), and the place was packed.

I ordered takeout for dinner. After trying the phone at least 6 times, i finally got through after calling Brick Wall Tavern, the affiliated bat attached to the restaurant. Got through to the host and learned that they do not do takeout orders on weekend evenings. Went in to order and wait for the food. Ordered a Duck Hunt and a Snawzeech for takeout. Duck hunt 7/10 and as ordered. Snawzeech was missing the cashew ricotta which was the whole reason i ordered the pie. 4/10. No cheese to cut the pepper. Essentially 1/3 of the toppings were missing. Very disappointed. 

Ordered the Snawzeech a while back at the Jersey City location and it was great. 9/10. 

Only saving grace was the mushroom Arancini. 9/10 even as takeout.

I'm ten years old I loved this place it is the best Mexicana food I ever ate  if I could recommend something to eat is the chimichangas Texas one me and my father agreed never to go to any other place for Mexicana food this is coming from a 10-year-old

The only reason we came here was to go to the Biergarten. It is closed today for an event at 6 pm.  It is currently 1 pm and there is no one setting up. I understand no service out there but can I not sit in a chair and enjoy the outdoors? I will NOT be back. The manager that made us come inside was extremely rude. This is one of your main sellers to come here!!! Let people enjoy it!!!!
Such a great salon!! I highly recommend Kelsey. She does amazing work. I will definitely be going back to her

Before I begin, the moral of this complaint is that customer service/communication is key with any business, and G2 Computers is as communicative as Helen Keller using Morse code to recite the Gettysburg Address (sorry Helen).

My phone was scheduled for a screen repair on a Thursday morning and I was told the repair would be done the same day. When I got to the store, I was told the technician had "just" called out sick, they couldn't fix the phone that day, and I would need to come back the next day. I completely understand that the technician called out sick, however I was slightly annoyed that I didn't receive a call from them before my appointment to reschedule. 

I brought the phone in the next morning, which was Friday and I was told that the phone would be ready by the afternoon. It was around 4:30 pm and I didn't receive a call; I was getting concerned since the store closes at 6:00pm, so I gave them a call. I was told they were backed up all day and my phone wouldn't be ready until Monday! As you can imagine, at this point I was extremely annoyed; what if my phone was imperative to my job!?

I went back to the store to pick up my phone and expressed to the lady who was waiting on me, how annoyed I was and how I intend to contact Apple and share my frustration with this "Apple Authorized Service Provider." She asked me what had happened and I explained to her the whole situation and all I got was a "sorry, we were very busy today since the technician was out yesterday." She told me that she didn't know how I was even able to make the initial appointment because the technician was scheduled to be off that day. On the day of the initial appointment, the gentleman told me the technician had called out sick! 

I told the lady that nobody even tried to make things right and that if I didn't call when I did, I wouldn't have a phone all weekend. I told her all of this could have been avoided with a few phone calls; a call to let me know the technician wasn't going to be in before I arrived at the initial appointment and a call to let me know there is a chance that the phone might not be ready until after the weekend before the second appointment.

We came to this chick Fil a for date night quick dinner. The kitchen director Larry Hurst was very amazing.  We asked for two sauces and then he had to run and grab us more because it wasn't enough and not once did he sigh or huff or catch and attitude. We came back for a refill on drink and he was more than happy to service us and even gave us conversation. Very nice guy and will definitely come back.

Abby's is THE best natural foods store in Tampa, no doubt about it. If you're looking for a certain supplement then chances are they have it in stock. There's also a great grocery section and a deli in the back offering smoothies and yummy wraps.

I also appreciate how strongly Abby's is against GMO foods and how they side with the Non-GMO Project. They certainly do their research and will not carry an item if it's from genetically modified sources.  That's a huge plus for me.  It's REALLY nice to do some grocery shopping and not have to wonder about every item you pick up.

My husband and I have eaten here several times and we love it!  BEST Caesar salad I have ever had--they make it fresh at your table.  Definitely a must!  We have never been disappointed in their dishes and have always had a wonderful waiter!  The ambiance in the dining area is great!  Perfect for a date night :)
Lava flow drink was amazing! Vicki the server was very personable. Great place on the beach!  Good variety on menu.

Tiny place and the entire sweaty staff was sitting in the dining room eating at 5 pm.  Yuck.   2 jaeger burgers, fries and 2cans of brisk came to 36 bux with tip.  Ouch.  Great bun totally overwhelmed the burger.  Flat top cooking usually means a crisp exterior holding in great burger juciness...this one had absolutely no texture or flattop developed flavor.  Onion from the bun, salt then pickle...thats all i tasted.  Fries were more like thick chips and were absolutely greasy.  French's mustard and heinz ketchup rounded out the experience.  Big whoop.  The burger quest continues.

I am not as enamored with this place as other reviewers. The bagels were just okay. They are too soft inside, instead of that nice chewy texture of a good bagel. I personally did not like the flavor of the bagel either, although that is subjective. Lastly: 6 bagels and a container of cream cheese = $15. Ouch. 
The service was quick and friendly.

I LOVE Castleton Nails! This is a family owned and operated nail salon that provides superior service to their clients. I live in Chicago so I don't get there too often but when I do I get the warmest welcome when I walk in the door...they know me by name. If you become a regular they even make you a box [with your name on it] with your own person tools! I'm box number 44 ;). Now, some may be wondering why I only gave them four stars...Well, the owners mother works in the salon and she is the WORST! I love her but she can't work on my feet and hands. Cindy, one of the owners, is my technician of choice...shes the BEST!!

Sies is good, but not remarkable in a crowded Mexican food market. The ordering model is different than what I thought it was going to be. You go to a counter and order your food, which is brought to you later. It's like counter food dressed up with a bar. Food was good. Service was quick and adequate, but nothing notable. Prices were high for what we ordered, but current circumstances are a challenge. I would eat here again.

This is the cutest darn brunchy place in all of the land.  I absolutely love the French signage, photography and the shabby chic feel of the interior. I had heard a great deal about the coffees at Eggshell and as excited to check it out (they serve Blue Bottle--my favorite from San Fran).

The menu offers a variety of interesting, not easily found items.  I feasted on the sweet potato hash with chorizo and 2 sous vide poached eggs.  But what I loved the most was the New Orleans iced coffee--cool and perfectly sweetened.

So why you ask does this establishment get a mediocre 3 stars?  Well, for a couple of reasons...
1. The prices make this a special occasion brunch.  My coffee hash combo left me $24 less rich.  And while everything was excellent, I didn't feel like $24 worth of goodness.  
2. The portions are smallish.  This is no place for a dude to find his hangover cure.  I would have enjoyed a bit more iced coffee for the $5.50 price tag and the same for my hash...or perhaps include some toast?
3. The pacing.  This was, to say the least, a leisurely brunch.  The place is small and it wasn't too busy when we stopped by, but things did seem to take quite a while.


All of that said, I'll venture back once my wallet is ready to take another hit.

Durance made our experience great! He was super friendly all while working hard to accommodate multiple guests on his own. He had a smile the whole time and made our visit memorable! Pizza was good, loved the green tomatoes - not a topping we get at home in CA so it was a nice change!

Probably the best restaurant in Nashville. Superb ambiance and fantastic food here! Excellent, interesting cocktail menu, and some dishes I keep going back for. Upscale comfort in such a lovely space. Servers and staff are unfailingly attentive. Love the 404!

This was one of the best local pubs Ive had the pleasure of patronizing. The bartender was awesome, friendly, and hard working. The local clientele was also the best. I only had three days to spend in Philly, but this was a great place.  Wish I had a pub like this back home. I ordered the Shepherds pie along with a cold Yuengling beer and was not disappointed.   

Place was clean and friendly and support the local Chester PD. My kind of place. 5 stars all around.
Loved my Finbomb burrito!  Tony, the owner, was so sweet!  Like 3 suishi rolls in one for a great price and you can make your own.  Loved it.

Great service on a Saturday afternoon! My boyfriend had the baked salmon with arugula and rosemary potatoes - pretty good! I had the lobster Mac and cheese which is VERY filling, but absolutely delicious. Our waiter was very attentive and kept our waters full. Great for couples and families. Their char boiled oysters were amazing; would definitely recommend getting those as an appetizer for two (half) or meal (full). Parking was great for an early dinner time (3pm-4pm).

I'm not so keen on these veg places.  I'm more than willing to eat tofu, mushrooms, etc, but not so sure about chick'n or burger (that's not made of meat).  I heard about this place and especially heard about their Buffalo Bella sandwich and it was SOOO good.  I also ordered a side of Sweet Potato Fries with their siracha sauce and really loved that as well.  It might take me a few visits before I try their chick'n but I'd def go back and next time try Bistro Bella

Great concept.  Good variety of trucks.  Table seating is somewhat limited.  Lots of umbrellas setup in the lawn, if you like sitting on the ground or decide to bring your own chair.  Still some bugs to work out, the trucks dont sell beverages due to the canteen on site.  Beverages on 1 side of the property, food trucks on the other, its awkward.  Let the trucks sell water and soda.

Only other thing that seems wierd- the food trucks are all tax inclusive, the canteen(the beer) is not?  Pricing inside is elusive.  The selection is great with a wall of taps and many local choices.  But almost $8 for a cup of civil life brown ale after tax is ridiculous for the area. Nothing posted (yet) regarding BYOB onto the property, so something to consider for those who are budget minded.

All in all, a unique spot to stop if you dont mind spending $20-25 on a meal sitting outside.

It was my first time boarding my Maltese around the holidays, and the day before we were meant to drop him off, he fell down the stairs and sprained his shoulder. The vet said he would be fine to stay at the boarder as long as they administered his medication for pain and swelling. 

We dropped out boy off the next and and informed the staff of what happened. We brought his medicine and showed them to put it in a treat to have him take it. We also brought his wet food, which is the only food he can eat due to allergies. We told them to please call if he seemed in pain and we would come straight for him. They assured us he would be fine and they had webcams where we could watch him online!! We were so happy to hear that and left our boy, assuming he was in good hands. 

That evening we go to check the webcam address they gave us... And the webcam was out of service in the small dog area, it only showed the large dog area. I called and asked, and they said "Yeah, it's been out for a while. Sorry." I was LIVID after being told we'd be able to see him. I was also upset to see that the dogs weren't kenneled or boarded at night, but all put in a giant concrete floor room together at night. No beds, nothing. A big empty room with hard floor. And that's the large dogs I saw, I couldn't even see my baby!

I called every day while gone to check on him and they assured me he seemed fine. I asked about the webcam every day, and they basically told me it was just broken and not going to be fixed any time soon. 

The week finally ended and I went back to pick him up. He looked great and smelled great from his groom, but his pill bottle was completely full- they hadn't given him a single dose of medicine the entire time! And his bag of treats was still sealed and had never been opened. His bed was on a shelf exactly where I left it, and he never got to sleep in it. 

I brought him home and he drank 5x more than a days worth of water all at once, and scarfed down THREE meals worth of food. If they had fed him, the other dogs probably scarfed up his wet food, and he's so passive he wouldn't fight back for it. I don't think he ate a thing all week. Dry kibble gives him a rash on his back, and he had scabs and a rash all over his skin. He definitely didn't get to eat his own (expensive) food and had to eat whatever he could. 

We still decided to have him groomed there again because the groom was great from when he was boarded. But as soon as we pulled up, he started crying and I had to literally DRAG HIM inside. He was terrified and traumatized! I will never bring him back. There's no telling what he went through there, and I couldn't see due to the broken webcam, but I know my dog was hungry, thirsty, and in pain for a full week because the staff didn't give him his medication or make sure he got to eat his own food. I then spoke to a former employee who spoke of borderline abuse to dogs who won't be still during grooms, hitting them and holding their necks and yelling at them for fidgeting. I will never ever set foot in this place again.

Apparently, they sold out last night, so no early check in for me. I think I'm officially done with this Hilton.

I am a Hilton Honors Diamond member. With this status, Hilton hotels will usually go out of their way to accommodate you. Not this one. While most things are pretty standard, I didn't get that next level of service I have grown accustom to.

And my biggest pet peeve is their separate wing. I travel with lots of luggage. It is not easy getting all the way to the rooms on the other wing of the hotel.

3 stars. My experience with this hotel has never been better than just ok.

I like Albertsons, however it can be expensive if you buy all your groceries here. Some things are pretty good here, such as their bakery. They also have a good variety of wines. It is clean and it closes late (1:00 pm) but their prices cannot compete with Wal-Mart.

This is a wonderful alternative to fast food, and the delivery is great!
The Mac & Cheese with Bacon was VERY tasty.
Definitely recommended :)

I bring you a review from my trip to Nashville.  Well, just about the only thing I did in my trip to Nashville was eat, so these next few posts will be the outcome of my gluttony.  My partner in crime, Debbie, decided that our first stop of the weekend would be to the Pancake Pantry.  I had scouted out some other places for brunch, but we were both excited about this place once we saw that there was a huge line outside of it.  Of course, some of the best places in the world to eat have long lines to get in, two of them most notably Shake Shack, in NYC, and of course Sprinkles Cupcakes, in Los Angeles.  Anyways, as you can see from the pictures, there was about a 30 minute wait to get in.  Not a big deal, considering that the weather was about a brisk 60 degrees, and everyone in line seemed pretty excited at the prospect of eating here.  Going in a pair allowed us to get much quicker seating than larger groups, so I definitely recommend going here with just one other person!

Alright, enough about the line and getting in.  How was the food you ask?  Well, in short, it was well worth the wait.  I started off with a large, 20oz glass of fresh squeezed OJ that was less than $5 a glass.  I would have spent well over $10 for the same amount of OJ in LA.  I ordered a classic, blueberry pancakes, while Debbie ordered these Chocolate pancakes that looked like crepes.  Of course, I had to also order a side of bacon, while Debbie ordered a side of hash browns.  These pancakes were some of the best that I've ever had, and I love pancakes.  They were fluffy and tasted very buttery, even without additional butter, which I smothered on anyways.  The fresh and all natural maple syrup was great, and there seemed to be the perfect amount--5, medium sized pancakes.  I didn't care much for the blueberry sauce that came with it, and I think I would have been perfectly content with regular buttermilk pancakes.  

The bacon was, well, bacon.  Almost always good, as long as it is not super burnt.  This bacon was a bit too crispy, but that's always personal preference.  I will say that the hash browns were quite good, as they were a bit crispy/burnt on the bottom for a nice crunchy texture, but the other half was soft and buttery.  Anyone notice a common theme here?  Butter is great with anything.  

All in all, a must try place for anyone going to Nashville.  Very affordable (remember, I'm used to prices in NYC and LA)--I think pancakes, OJ, and a side only cost about $18 dollars with tip.  Of course, you could economize with not getting OJ or a side, but then again, $18 dollars provides a lot more than what you could get in LA.

Go here for some pictures!  http://www.winstongu.com/2009/03/26/pancake-pantry/
Lived around the corner for 14 year and after reading the reviews, decided to stop on for a beer. Ordered PBR. He charged me $8. I cannot go anywhere where I question anyone's ability to basic math.

I've been living here for 6 months and I am very happy with my experience at the Edge! The Edge is a great place to live and is located an excellent location to commute to NJ, NY by train, or Philly. There are a lot of great perks to living here. Abundance of parking spots, The gym is nice and open 24/7, the pool and lounge area are so nice and relaxing in the summer, the lawn and landscape is cut frequently and the maintenance keeps it looking really nice, this area is rather quiet at night and on the weekends which is nice, I hardly ever hear my neighbors, & valet trash is a plus, but it would be nice to have that optional. My minimal experiences with maintenance has been quick and easy and management typically responds quickly to emails. 
My only few issues with this place is that there continues to be people who do not clean up after there dog. I have reached out to management a few times about this and as a I understand you cannot necessarily catch the people doing it, it puts me, and other people in a position where i'm always looking down when i'm walking to my car in fear of stepping in it on my way to work, esp at night. 
Overall, this is a nice place to live and i'm very happy here. There is defiantly room to improve communication between management and tenants about community news, pool hours, reinforcing cleaning up after your animal, and any of information that should be shared to tenants.

Really good idea executed poorly.
The theater seats are not tall enough that it chops off the bottom of the screen. So you better hope nothing important happens down there cause you'll miss it!

There are no concessions which means you can only buy popcorn, drinks and other "gourmet" foods and wine through servers who are far from "light on their feet" and who carry mobile devices with bright lit screens to charge your order. You would think these servers would stop stomping around the theater once the film has begun but no- they run through the aisles like an elephant stampede and stroll across the screen all while the movie is playing. Interactions happen loudly so good luck trying to hear what is happening in the plot over the glass of wine and crackers the guy next to you is ordering with a side of mustard.

I am really surprised some people say the coffee was good. It was awful and extremely weak. However the Brussel sprout salad was amazing. Just need some better coffee - my guess is someone didn't leave the right instructions for the staff due to the French Press. We complained and got new coffee made - a little better but not much. Brussel Sprout salad worth the trip.

OMG this has to be the WORST meal I have had in over 10 years. There was a party of six of us and to a man NONE of us could find a kind word about their food! My diet coke was the high point of the evening! I had the spicy cabbage that was served stone COLD! My wife had the hamburger and it was totally inedible. I have never seen so much grease and fat in my life! Even the texas toast was horrible. I should have trusted my first instinct and walked out when the wait staff outnumbers the paying customers 2 to 1. And this was 6pm on a Wednesday night! Do your self a favor and run don't walk away from this place! The food is absolutely horrid.I made the mistake of giving my dog some of the leftovers .... last time I saw her she was licking her butt to get the taste out of her mouth!
Danielle came in clutch helping me out with delivery for the first time. Even gave me a first-order discount! Definitely will be hitting this place up again. No complaints.

Great studio and welcoming atmosphere. The instructors are professional, and well trained to help you maximize the results in each class.   The classes have a constant flow. You get what you pay for here!  Lots of class times and packages available!  They have a lot of interactive activities within the studio going on to keep members active and motivated! So glad I joined!

This should really be a - 5 very rude people totally unprofessional no consideration that your livelihood is in their hands and the state has become a nanny state with their counseling and their schools this is a complete overreach of government this facility I should be shut down I would highly recommend not using them as a driving school they don't need any more money

Ordered the Atomic wings, ribs and chicken. Wings were very good, ribs were super moist and somewhat flavorful, chicken was not very flavorful.  The smokiness did come out in the chicken but the rest (skin, moistness, chicken flavor) I didn't enjoy. Also had the greens which I wasn't thrilled about, way too salty. Would I order from here again, yes.  Does it compete with some of the great BBQ places I have been to, in my opinion, no. Still good to have this place locally and I wish them well.

This was a terrible experience. First off, be aware that you will not be allowed to sit at their counter unless you sit down first and order from the counter. If you have ordered your food from the line, you can't sit down to eat. Even if you have a small child with you, who you also bought an order for. This is not made clear beforehand in any way - they just shoo you if you sit down. So we had the fried Mac and cheese and the crawfish etoufee. The Mac and cheese is doughy, greasy and bland. My 7 year old is a huge Mac and cheese (and fried foods) fan. He tasted it, made a face and just picked at it. I didn't like it either. The crawfish etoufee was lukewarm and tasteless. There was very little crawfish in it - it was almost completely just rice plus a bland, gummy gravy. I didn't finish my meal either. It is lucky that we were able to go to Bassett's for double scoops of ice cream after, or we would have gone hungry. It is tragic that they call themselves Cajun/Creole food, as anyone from New Orleans would not agree. And their rude service does not enliven the meal. Don't waste your time or money - skip this one.

This food was not very good. Took a while to order and didn't even finish the meal. Our server was very nice and checked in on us regularly but didn't really help with how the food tasted. Kind of expensive for what you got too.

Since I'm not a big-spender, I wanted to go during Center City Sips to check it out. The front entrance area can feel somewhat unwelcoming, like you're entering an office building, but once you get off the elevator, it opens up. We got there at 4:45, so we were able to snag a seat on the couch. I had the pasta chips (sounds strange, but quite delicious!) with bolognese sauce and the crostini platter. I wouldn't have thought to combine artichokes and mangoes, but they did a pretty good job. My friend also got the crostini platter, which she wasn't as excited about and pizze, yep, pizze, not pizza...I guess because they are small slices? All the same, very tasty. I'm a BIG fan of thin crust and they do a great job, there wasn't too much sauce and there was plenty of cheese. We split dessert - the warm chocolate molten cake with vanilla ice cream, SO good. The cake came out scalding hot and I got a little overzealous and burnt my tongue, but that's price I paid! We were mostly served by the hostess, but every now and then, a waitress came by to check in, which was comforting, but we didn't feel rushed.

We ordered carryout from Flame Burger for my birthday and it was a hit.  My husband ordered the bacon cheeseburger on a brioche bun which was very good.  The kids ordered the kids' cheeseburger and grilled cheese, respectively which they loved.  I ordered the grilled chicken Caesar salad and it was very good.  The lettuce was fresh and it really hit the spot.  We also ordered the parmesan truffle fries, which were ok.  The parmesan was a bit much, but overall the food was good and ready quickly.  We will go back!

I have lived at Creekside At Providence since April 2018.  I LOVE it here. I really can't say enough about the office staff (Michael, Angela and Sharon) and maintenance staff.  The office staff has been so helpful,  on a number of occasions, no matter the size of the request.  And every maintenance request has been handled same day.  I like the fact that this community is on the opposite of the main Providence area yet its close enough to walk or bike to the stores if I wanted to.  Nice community with plenty of amenities for everyone.

The food was fresh, nicely packaged and incredibly tasty!  I even customized a dish & it was prepared exactly as requested.  We were happy to find a Chinese Restaurant that delivered & we were able to order online within the Yelp App...Bonus!!  Delivery time was on point, exactly in the window the app advised.  We will be ordering again!

I've tried every Vietnamse restaurant I could find to get egg rolls like a former employee used to make - this is as close as it gets.  AMAZING!  I love the vermicelli dishes and sandwiches, spring rolls too.  My uncle said their fried rice was the best he's ever had.  

Don't be scared, try it out!  The owner/operator is a great help with the menu and helping make selections.

Andy's Place is a nice place for breakfast or lunch, which serves some German dishes in addition to more typical diner food.

The food is very good, and the German items are authentic (I think the owner said that he made his own mustard and sauerkraut).  Service is friendly, and the dining room is clean and inviting.  Baked goods and pastries are available, too (yum!).
I would not categorize this a a seafood restaurant.  It offer shrimp, oysters and crab with one "Pan Roast" of salmon.  It was no more than a glorified "Red Lobster"

Pets & the City is very accommodating (quick and easy to make an appointment).  I have a 90 lb. Briard that has a super thick undercoat and long hair and she always does an awesome job trimming him up and helping me keep his hair mat free!  Prices are great and the job is always professionally done.  Wouldn't go anywhere else.
