I don't even know where to begin! I just finished a nice bacon burger and bacon wrapped jalepeno popper dinner, and I couldn't go without reviewing this fantastic place.

The first time I went in here was with a family member, I saw the prices of the meat and about fainted. Everything is basically half price compared to what you get in the normal grocery store. Freaking awesome! Then the selection... Oh man the selection. You have at least 4 types of bacon, steak, goat, alligator, bison, elk, chicken, in every possible cut you can think of.


But wait, there's more! Not sure what to buy? Not sure how to cook it? Ask (if they don't ask you first :) ) and they'll answer any questions you have and give you tips.


I'm trying to make excuses to go back and buy more meat already.

Food is okay, if a bit over priced. I always have greater expectations than what I am served. Food is good just not exceptional. Service was very slow for lunch today. If you only have an hour for lunch, you might want to go somewhere else.

In Philly on vacation with my friend whose visiting from Pittsburgh and we were looking for a place for Sunday morning brunch. We tried to go to OCF coffeehouse but the wait was too long so we came down to Fare they had a wait too but there were seats at the bar so we decided to eat there. I ordered eggs Benedict and my friend ordered the veggie omelet of the day which had red peppers, artichokes, and feta. The eggs Benedict was just okay, I liked the idea of the potato pancake but it was greasy and unseasoned, also you have to pay extra for meat? Eggs Benedict is supposed to come with at least ham but they charge you 3 dollars for it even though its already a $14 dollar meal. Just seems cheap to me. My friends omelette was pretty good but was under seasoned as well. The coffee very good and was the best part of the meal, I would go back to give them a second chance just for that.

Love this place!  Clearly a favorite with the locals, steeped in history and has excellent food!  A bacon wrapped filet, salad and twice baked potato on Fridays for under $12...yes please!  The tenderloin is as good or better than any I've tried in the city and the catfish is perfectly breaded and seasoned.  

Supposedly frequented by Dillinger back in the day and home to some freaky paranormal activity as well.  I can't vouch for either of those claims, but the stories are pretty cool.

If you're looking for a divey bar with great food, cheap food and drink prices and colorful clientele, look no further.  You will not be disappointed!
My first diner in Wilmington Delaware, the food tested good the service is nice, very clean place, and the atmosphere was great.

Save yourself from getting food poisoning - no joke! After stopping by the drive-thru for the usual burrito and tacos, I went home and tried to go to bed only to wake up a few hours later puking (and other things) my guts out. It was so bad I couldn't even keep water down. I was pretty weak but managed to drive myself to the urgent care where they put two IV's of fluid in me, and gave me some medication to help with the nausea. Upon talking to the Publix pharmacist next door to the urgent care (where my prescription was filled), they told me that their entire family had gotten food poisoning from the same exact Taco Bell location! So, save yourself - and if you are craving TB, hit up the one by Hickory Hollow Mall, Donelson area (near the airport) or La Vergne.

Food was delicious especially the stuffed dates. However, the service on the patio was lacking. No water refills, waiting forever for items such as being noticed for the check and getting the check. We actually walked in to pay to expedite the process it was taking so long. I think the server just had too many tables assigned to him to really serve them all well.

What a wonderful restaurant!! First, they donated food to a local elementary school for a fundraiser night!! Thank you!! The food was fantastic! So, this morning, my husband and I thought we would return the favor by enjoying a Sunday brunch. I had the Green Eggs and Ham and my husband had eggs with bratwurst. The food was spectacular and staff was extremely pleasant and friendly! We will definitely be back and next time we will bring friends.

Took me right on time. Harrison was very professional and answered all my questions.
I was very happy with the service at the Fairless Hills Safelite.

Best drinks I've ever had, seriously!!! Highly recommend. Also great music 10/10 they want me to keep writing to make it a legit review so I will but I don't know what else to say except it's excellent! I loved our server too she was knowledgeable and super sweet. Give this place your business above all others, you won't be disappointed. The lions tail is my new favorite drink!!!
This place is fantastic, great food and crystal is super friendly. She always takes care of me.

Delicious food, fresh sushi, friendly service. The interior and music selection could use a makeover but the food and service more than makes up for it.

Great food, affordable prices.  I will definitely go back.

Try the kimchee fries!

We just ate here for the second time. The food here is excellent. Nirvana took over old building that used to be Dosa Hut. This area has had a big influx of Indian restaurants but we have found Nirvana the best of the lot. Happy who runs the dining room is great and makes sure you are satisfied. He floats around the dining room making sure all the customers are taken care of. He compliments the great food with energetic service. We are now dedicated customers.
New cds start at $20, used cds start at $10 and reissue lps are 2x overpriced elsewhere. Not a great record buying experience.

A tip:
The fastest way to long term parking is via 'Arrivals'

Not a bad hub, I would rather fly out of here than Newark.

Absolutely the best Mexican food we have ever had! Small intimate atmosphere. If crowded, I'm sure it's loud but when we went, we were the only couple there on New Years Eve. Absolutely the BEST margaritas!!! Mike was a kicka** bartender!

I decided to try this place the other day for lunch. I haven't tried it before because I felt like it was a bit more than needs to be spent on a daily lunch. One cool feature they have is they featured meatballs of the month. They also have many other types of meats and even have vegans option meatballs. They meatballs were very good, I just wish they were bigger or more came in the order. What I am going to brag about the the brussels sprouts. I normally don't order them and normally don't like them at all but I took a chance because I saw some come out of the oven...... they were absolutely amazing! Great flavor and great crunch texture. Still in my mind not worth is for a lunch or portion size but the food taste is amazing!

Saritas is authentic and delicious! Their pork tacos are incredible and the create a bowl with chicken is fantastic! Hands down the best guacamole ever! It's family owned and you can feel the family pride & ownership of their place! We have been coming here regularly for almost 10 years and we have never had a bad meal! Our daughter who is almost adores their black bean & sour cream tacos. She literally begs to eat here all the time. It's a hidden gem on Freret Street that you should seek out and enjoy!
What can you say this is DOG perfection! Great variety, fresh buns and tasty condiments. Quick and easy lunch time fun. Bite a dog and hear the snap! That's good dog eating.

I visit SB pretty often and have come here a couple times before with my friends and the food is pretty good but the customer service has been consistently TERRIBLE. I'm not usually one to leave a bad review of a place, but I just couldn't let this one slide. The same hostess/waitress always gives off such a rude vibe. 
Most recently, my friend and I walked in and were just completely ignored by the tall Asian hostess with long black hair. She looked like a college student and was younger than some of the other staff. She didn't acknowledge us and just completely ignored our presence when we entered. The restaurant wasn't even busy at the time. We weren't seated until after we asked her to. She gave us attitude when she seated us even though we politely asked to be seated. Her tone was also just rude and unnecessary. 
Usually the hostess are the first people you see, so the customer service could be greatly improved if the hostess wasn't so terrible. Food was good but don't expect good service here especially from the young Asian girl with black hair. We also had to wait a long time for our check and the same girl was rude as hell. She dropped it on our table and left. 
It just made me not want to come back here again and I probably will not.

I had a lovely lunch here. I got the dumpling appetizer and katsu chicken sandwich. Both delicious and satisfying. My favorite part was the environment. We ate outside on the porch. A lot of greenery and a lovely view of the pool. This would be a great place for brunch and drinks.

This is not for the rooms.  I haven't been in the Hotel Rooms in forever.  It's just for an overall experience from a locals perspective.

Peppermill has always been a great property for the Reno area.  For restaurants they have some hits and some misses.  Island Buffet used to be THE buffet to go to.  Now it's THE buffet to avoid (that and Circus Circus).  It's dated and needs an update, heck, it might be better just to clear it out and put in more slot machines.

The gaming floor is pretty big and the variety of electronic games is pretty good.  My wife is the gambler in the family and that is only on a rare every 2-3 months occasion and she likes coming here with her girlfriend.

Most of our time spent at the Peppermill has been in the new section.  It has the best restaurants and bars.

The parking garage here is handy and they even have parking on both sides of the property so you can enter on the north or south sides.

Based on what I have seen I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place to family or friends coming into town for a little vacation.

Gotta love a place that has beer, games, and sandwiches on pretzles.  Fun little hangout that is close to my house.  Always packed and sometimes hard to get in and out of.  But it is definitely worth checking out.

Wow! I had a craving for a good Ol' fashioned cheeseburger so my fiancé and I went to Five Guys and as soon as we walked in the door we were warmly greeted by Hailey the cashier, and then we were immediately asked by Corey and Kianna( on the grill) if they could get us started( we were very impressed with the fast service). Corey and Kianna were friendly, fast, and the burgers and fries were absolutely delicious. I really enjoyed Kianna's voice, that girl can sing! The energy in the place is positive! As we were leaving Pat (I assume he is a manager) said "Hello folks, how was everything" with a big smile on his face. Thank you Five Guys in Clifton Heights,PA and a GREAT BIG THANKS to Hailey, Corey, Kianna and Pat.

Brenda n Jesse

This is an interesting local-chain restaurant, serving dutch pancakes. These are not Dutch babies. Rather they are thin, flat, crepe-like pancakes. They are large, filling a good-sized plate.

There are many choices of toppings and fillings. I had the apple and cheese; he had granola filled. I would recommend a plain pancake with a topping, rather than the ones that have additions incorporated in the batter.

The tea was really hot, which is always a pleasant start to the morning!

Service: The staff move around like lightning, which makes for very efficient service. Unfortunately, when we were there, they didn't have time to stop by tables and make inquiries. I would have appreciated chatting about recommendations.

Had dinner here last night. My steak came out over cooked and when I told the waitress the response was incredible. They obviously prepared another steak but they brought me something to eat while it was being prepared. Two different managers came by to apologize. The new steak was perfectly prepared and larger. They also gave me a card for a free appetizer and took the steak off the bill. Over the top customer service. And, the waitress was outstanding!!!!  We will go back.

Prime 108 is located inside the Union Station hotel in downtown Nashville.  It's small and intimate, and usually packed, so be sure to get reservations.  It's an ideal spot for a romantic dinner or special occasion.  

Their menu is fantastic and they are always offering new specials.  They have excellent fresh seafood.  We have also enjoyed their duck and apple wood pork loin.  Be sure to save room for dessert -- their spiced pear cheesecake and creme brule are to-die-for.
I was getting my food and then the cashier said "Hey yo! You can get your food free if you want" and I was like how and she was like go buy me a Coke Zero. So I did and she gave me my food for free.

I have been going to Chung Sing for as long as I can remember.  I think that I actually had a first date there back in high school...anyway, I digress. This place has pretty basic Chinese food and has been a staple of such between the boundaries of Wynnewood and Ardmore long before I can remember.  It sits in a little tin box on Lancaster Avenue and is popular among residents of the area.  The waitstaff is very friendly and the service is above average.  The portions of the entrees are so big that you will probably end up taking something home to heat up the next day for lunch.  The combination lunch and dinner specials include soup, egg roll and dessert.  So bring your appetite.

This place is so worth a stop if you are remotely close. Come here for the fantastic original meatballs but you'd be absolutely foolish if you  didn't get a traditional grandma pizza, that has that quintessential sweet tomato sauce you look for in a grandma pie. This place may be called mama's meatballs but the cheesesteak sandwich has to be mentioned w some of the best in Philly. Don't let yourself leave w out one. The ribeye is so good. They use a grass fed imported ribeye which gives that beefy flavor which is usually masked by the cheese (cooper sharp on mine please) but not here. !!! I can't wait to come back for another one

This place is fairly new at least to me,
You walk in the store and first thing you get greeted by is and amazing aroma of cooked meats and cheese!
The staff is at the store was super helpful and warming 
The food is beyond better than I could have imagined 
Will be back for more delicious subs

I wasn't expecting to love this place as much as I did! The food was delicious, the service was AWESOME and the menus were very friendly to my friends' nutrition needs. Will definitely be coming back!

I remember when DeSerres was made up of two levels. Now it's located on the first level and much smaller than it was before. I come here occasionally to pick up art supplies. DeSerres carries various paints, canvases, frames, books and arts & craft supplies. I find some of the stores prices comparable to Michaels. The staff here is always available and willing to help.

Chargrilled oysters were AMAZING!!! Not typically an oyster fan but oh boy, these were to die for. The shrimp po boy was pretty tasty, bread could have been a bit better... and the new orleans sampler was just okay.

I got my tragus pierced here and loved my experience! The piercer was kind enough to let me film the experience, she made jokes with me and made me very comfortable, I also got my second tattoo here and I fully intend on going back to get more from here!

I really should learn not to give a bad rating for one experience.  I went back tonight and was very impressed.  Maybe it was from my bad review.  The bartenders were all over it.  Quickly said hello to me and got my drink.  while I was waiting I noticed the manager talking to a group of folks at the bar and they were having a great time.  He then started helping the bartender with there orders.  They took my order and my salad and bread came out very quickly.  I had more than enough time to eat it waiting for my entree.  very important to me.  I started to order the prime rib but the bartender told me they were almost out and I might not get the best they offer so I got a ribeye instead.  It was cooked perfectly medium rare.  That is awesome that he was aware of the food quality and didn't want me to be disappointed.  Going back to the manager, he was running around helping out everywhere he could.  I use a comp card to pay that I thought was a gift card but it was limited to what I ordered so no remaining balance.  Jennie, another manager that has worked there for many years came to me and suggested I take something home to get the most out of the comp card so i could get the best value.  We talked about how many years I have been going there and how I stopped because things got really bad but I came back and was very impressed.  She was very happy that I had a good experience.  I hope she passes it on to the staff because compared to my last experience this was excellent.  I keep learning that I shouldnt let one bad experience stop me from eating somewhere.  jennie told me the manager that impressed me was a partner so I think that means he has ownership.  Maybe his presence made the staff work better but I have to say, the two bartenders were awesome.  they paid attention to there guest and didnt ignore anyone.  Over all I would say they are really trying to make a difference.  Service was great, management was productive and food was excellent.  I hope when I go back its the same.  compared to the service I got the last time I noticed a huge difference so maybe my poor review helped.  as always, if the management responds to my review and I notice that they take the changes needed I will always change my raitings.

Great service - fixed an amp I thought wasn't worth bothering with for next to nothing - in a couple of hours to boot!
I didn't have a look at much of the merchandise but it looked like cool used stuff and plenty of new accessories  (sticks, heads, strings, cables, etc). My guess is this is the best mom and pop store in Nola.

We have been there several times and have enjoyed the food and the service. Two weeks ago we went back and we were promised a seat by the wall, and the owner took our reservation. When we arrived we were told that there where no tables available by the wall ? Why make a reservation and why promise something you can't deliver? The owner came out and gave us a half assed apology and sent out some raviolis. When the owner walked away he commented the the food would taste just as good from that table ?? We were very disappointed with the seating and the food was ok. Not heading back anytime soon.

I love quick trip. There iced coffee is great, with a little whip cream. There hot dogs are are really good, with steamed buns and all. I have not meet a staff member that isn't professional and friendly . They even sell gas.

I love sitting outside and doing work here. The lemon ginger iced tea is delicious, and right now I can hear a jazz band practicing nearby. The baristas are really friendly, and all of the baked goods look delicious. Plus it's open late, which is great for getting work done.

I love Five Guys! The burgers are the best, always hot and fresh. A bacon cheeseburger with mayo and ketchup rocks my world! I love the fries too, though sometimes they're a little over salted. I hit them up with some of the vinegar they have there, and I'm set. They remind me of fries you'd get off the boardwalk. I love their soda fountain too, so many cool flavors. Oh, though it may sound like a small detail, I love that they wrap their burger in foil and not paper. Keeps the burgers nice and hot till I'm ready to eat it! 

Bottom line, if you want hot, fresh, and tasty burgers....these are the best in Broomall!
Got the trio of the gumbo and it was . Loved the seafood gumbo. The vegetarian one had great flavor and veggies.
This sushi restaurant is brand new , has awesome food also affordable price. If you live around this neighborhood definitely needs to give a try . Everything we ordered was so delicious!!!

I've been coming here on and off for a few years. I never expect much, usually it's a good place to hit up when you need something cheesy, fried and greasy after a night of drinking when everything else is closed or too expensive. This place has always been one of my go-to's for their prices (you get what you pay for). Tonight two friends and I all ordered small cheese fries and were immensely disappointed from the moment we were asked to pay. $5.37 for what was about 15 soggy French fries. Not cheap, not enough food, not even enjoyable food. The price for the amount of food we got was absurd. I remember paying around the same amount for a large size, aluminum round container filled to the brim. Now, all I got was a 1/4 full 3x3 styrofoam box. I could easily go to any food truck and get triple the amount of fries (SO cheap to make, I mean COME ON potatoes and wiz!?) for half the price. Better yet, I'd rather not eat anything at all. If I could, I'd get my money back.

Big portions! No need to order large amount. Smaller plates will do THEN grab some deserts. My wife and I always get the red velvet cake. It's tasty. Don't believe the hype either, even though it's a chain restaurant, the food is still better than most around the area. Appetizers are good too. Try their stuffed mushroom, calamaris crab cakes, and soup of the day. I didn't even use to eat shrooms but this made me a fan. 

For small plates, I tried their Vietnamese tacos and I really liked it. Also, I tried their sandwiches but can't remember which one ( might have been blackened chicken sandwich) and it was good but apparently not THAT good. HAHA.

Bottom line, the atmosphere and their food is enough for me to give it a 4-star. Price is fair. The patio is the place to be on cooler days.
The tres leches cake is incredible! I always eat one and take one to go! Can't wait to come back to this spot.

Great outdoor patio day and especially night. The drinks are cheaper inside though. But the Hurricane I still believe is the best mixed drink anywhere! I also thought the Cyclone was very good. But at the price get a hurricane! i can't stress this enough. They pack quite a punch! I also had Jambalaya, it was good. If you do one thing in the big easy go here and get a hurricane. Would've given five stars if it were just a little cheaper

This post is far overdue. Let me start by saying that I, like most people, HATE going to car dealerships. However, Perkins was very easy to deal with and made sure I got the car I wanted at a price that worked for my budget. They also did not try to oversell packages and were honest that frankly, I didn't need it all. They had a warranty on the car, and when I had AC problems within the first few days, I brought it back and they happily fixed it at no cost to me. I was also overcharged about $30 for registration, and they mailed a check to me covering the amount. Honestly, I would have never been the wiser about the overcharge, and thought that it was amazing that they took the initiative to make me whole for something that I was unaware of in the first place. I've had my car now for 5 years, and I've had no issues whatsoever besides that one. The owners here actually care, and want to help you. I purchased one car before my Mazda, and one after, and Perkins was the best auto experience I've had. If I ever live near Nashville again, 10/10 I would use their services again!
Had Late Lunch here. Had a tuna sub and it was soo  good. I prefer this place over a pizza shop in my area at times.

I've been going to this salon for over 2 years. The staff is wonderful and I typically don't request a specific tech, as they're all amazing. They can recreate any Pinterest mani/pedi. They're clean, take temperatures upon arrival and offer beverages if desired. You can make appointments online, over the phone or in the salon, as it can get busy as a walk-in. I haven't had a bad experience yet! I typically get a dip powder mani and a pedi- they have far more color options than other salons in the area. They have clients traveling 30+ minutes for their work, including friends I have referred! Make an appointment here, you won't be disappointed. Also- they will be expanding their space in June 2021!

Ate here previously in the evening, and today gave the Buffett a shot.  I recall the food being very good, and today it was decent, though buffet options were limited, nonetheless, the stop served its purpose.  For some reason the iced tea stop flowing after my initial refill, couldn't tell if it were time to go, or if I were limited. Lol

Bartender opened 4 separate tabs on my credit card, and did not close me out when I paid my check. I was charged $157 for 2 beers, 1 pizza, and half of an appetizer. While a fun and exciting atmosphere, it is not safe to use a credit card in this establishment.

Went this past Saturday as I raged out of Bath & Body because of the $9.95 candle lines......we were seated quickly and received our drink order just as fast. Table behind us was seated before us but the waitress coverage was missed. Our waiter apologized to them and got their order taken right after ours. They rushed their order, gave them a free dessert and a discount on the bill. My food was good American pub grub. The way they handled the table behind us was top notch for their miss.

This place is excellent! Great food, great service and great beer. Our server was extremely helpful and the rest of the staff was super friendly. Food was good, beer was unique. Definitely recommend hanging out here.

Oh you have to try the Habenero beer, its awesome.

This place is just plain wrong.  I had high hopes for it, as a colleague recommended it.  The chips and salsa was okay, nothing to write home about, but not bad.  The food on the other hand....  My meal was luck warm and everything tasted and looked as if it came out of a can.  The beans were not even edible and my pepper, which was supposed to be stuffed with potatoes and cheese, only had a nasty processed cheese sauce inside.  This is not Mexican food!  I could do better buying something in the frozen food section.  My boyfriend ordered a burrito and it was small and lackluster.  At least his was warm though.  The place didn't look clean and there was trash and pieces of food all over the floor.  I should have followed my gut instinct and walked out the door as soon as I walked in.  Needless, to say, we will not be back. If you are looking for Mexican food, cleanliness, and a hot meal, this sure isn't it.

Some of if not the best plant based food I have had in Reno!
I have tried a few things like the burrito, a burger, tostada bowl, but the Al Pastor torta is my favorite.
I love traditional Mexican food but also like to eat mainly plant based, so this place warms my heart knowing I can have the best of both worlds.
The workers are so kind and everything is freshly made. I would definitely recommend calling in your order ahead of time. :)
there also is a Yerba Mate fridge!

The food is okay. 

The margaritas? Dangerous. Tastewise, they're good not great. Drunkwise, they're good AND great. I figured that's why most people frequent this place anyway. To-go cups from this place are all I ever see during Mardi Gras uptown.

I was looking forward to the salted caramel croissant, they only make it on weekend, WTH.   Their coffee was awful, so bitter & seemed a day old.  Their mini chocolate chip cup cake was blunt, but the blueberry mini cupcake is better.
Great cheesesteak...wiz with! Fast service with a smile (I think...everyone's wearing masks!)

Okay so I am a bit torn writing this review...but, here goes....

My Fiance and I tend to host a lot of gatherings at our house so wine and champagne is a MUST!  My in-laws tend to enjoy Andre, whether it's the Moscato, Cold Duck, Brut, Pink Moscato, Peach Moscato, etc.  

Lately it has been incredibly hard to find the Cold Duck and Strawberry Moscato in stores in California, so when I came across Luekens I instantly decided to buy a case.  I also knew that since the wedding is coming up and my birthday is around the corner, we really needed to stock up.

I think I payed roughly $20 in shipping and it took a little over a week for my delivery to come.  In checking the route, Fed Ex showed that my package stayed in Tracy, Ca for literally 3-4 days before it was sent my way.

When my package arrived, all bottles were in tact, THANK GOODNESS but all of them were incredibly dusty.  We had a little gathering this weekend and ended up opening maybe 2-3 bottles.  We noted that the foil on top was super hard to get off, I mean it was practically stuck on the tops AND one of the bottles was leaking somehow, we could not figure out from where.

Ultimately I was disappointed overall.  These bottles must have been sitting for a while because I have opened champagne bottles plenty of times and the foil has never been sticky or that hard to get off.  Just the fact that the bottles were super dusty was another giveaway.

Thanks, but no thanks Luekens!

Thanks Yelpers!  Stopped here on a road trip and treated myself to All You Can Eat Sushi for 22 bucks.  And it included four huge pages of the menu.  I ate too much, but loved every bite, and got to try stuff I'm normally too cheap to order.  So awesome.

The staff is friendly and accommodating and the hotel is clean and tastefully decorated. However, the walls in the rooms seem to be paper thin, resulting in very little privacy for you and your neighbors. Conversations at normal volume can easily be heard word for word between guest rooms. It might be quiet if there's no one staying in the rooms next to you, otherwise, be prepared for a noisy and possibility disruptive stay.

I like it here.  Friendly staff and patrons add to the already cozy atmosphere of the place.  No matter what day of the week or time of day I happen to stop by, there always seems to be a deal running on food or drinks.
Loved the Po Boys last night. Had sign announcing a closure due to "unforeseen circumstances" today. Not sure what that's about.

I've stayed at a lot of hostels overseas and this hostel just doesn't compare. They charge for every little thing, even to use the computers...its 2016. How can you have free wifi but charge to use a desktop? Also nothing was included in the room fee except free coffee. The coffee station was terrible, all they had was cheap powder creamer. At first I thought it was a nice place but once you walk around and see what they actually have then you're left disappointed. I've never been to a hostel that didn't provide a full coffee bar, small breakfast, free towels, and free access to computers...no one is asking for hotel service but as a hostel in the states you have a tough competition and this hostel should do its research. My nephew also had his phone stolen right in front the of the check in desk that is monitored 24 hours. Even though that is the guests responsibility the whole staff was rude and extremely unhelpful during the whole situation. I'll never return.

I can't believe what passes for a gyro here. Needless to say, I didn't order it. I ate before I came here for a birthday party. 

I had a cocktail that was mediocre. My friend had one that tasted like a Jolly Rancher (it was the pomegranate booze explosion one, fyi). 

I wandered into the bathroom only to find it reeked of rotting produce and old, acrid spices. A bulimic woman would probably be happy because the odor is pungent enough that she may not need her finger. 

It's really less than two stars, but more than one (still) because the waitstaff really is nice. I hope that they know that they could probably make more money where the food and booze is better.

Small gallery. Free admission. Paid parking available via garage. 

We were unimpressed by the presentation. While (some of) the photos were very compelling, the exhibit lacked providing the context they were taken in...time or place or history.

Some of the worst service I have ever had at a car dealership, and I hate car dealerships. We negotiated a price on a car and told the salesman that we wanted to sleep on it. He called the next day and asked if we were still interested. We said yes, and came in to sign. by now the price, terms and payment had all changed, to their benefit of course. The salesman claims he never offered us the price and terms that he did, when I called his bluff, he brought in his "boss" to tell me that I was lying- he would have never offered that price, but the price they were now offering was really good and I should buy it anyway. I left of course. 

To top it all off- the salesman calls me again the NEXT day to see if I want to come in and buy that car after all. 

Lithia is the reason that car salesman have such poor reputations- dishonest, smug and condescending. To add insult to injury, they treat you like you are a dishonest idiot. 

Guess what, Lithia? There are other Ford dealerships in the valley!

One of the most lousy Indian restaurants I have ever eaten (I am Indian). Very very very very poor service. Weird setting of a shop and restaurant in same location. Went for dinner and server forgot almost all dishes. Had to be prompted. Food is total junk. Novelty of sitting down on floor and fact it is on State street keeps this place alive. The owner was just standing there and did not help the lonely waiter for the whole restaurant. Will never go back. Food is really crappy. Would like to give 0 stars.

This place has some of the best pizza I've ever eaten.  Its a little pricey, but the quality is worth it (and a second pizza is half price), they great beers on tap, and everyone there is really laid back and fun.  Great place to take a date.  Love these guys.

Great food! I love hole in the wall places. The only reason I didn't give it five starts is because I've tried to call ahead to order food to-go and the phone just rang and rang and rang. It was annoying and probably not warranting a star deduction, but ya know, it wasn't perfect so there you have it. If you head down to Ballast Point in south Tampa, you will not be disappointed by Big Ray's food.

Surprised that's only 3 1/2 star go to Ruth's Chris everywhere and this is an excellent one ask for Neil brome to serve you when you're there totally outstanding caring great energy gets how important it is for a customer to have a great experience always had a good meal there been there a handful of times.

Conclusion: no frills airlines, no frills airport. But it is convenient for central NJ and eastern PA. Cheap and easy.

Two gates, probably no waiting.  The airport itself is small, but serviceable.  Flew out December 26th and it was pretty busy.  One delayed flight waiting to board, another non delayed flight waiting to board before our flight, so it was standing room only in the terminal.  Once both boarded, the terminal emptied out. There's a small bar and it also sells snacks.  TSA was same as anywhere else. Parking is cheap and close to the terminal.  Didn't use baggage claim but as you get off the plane, you walk through the baggage claim building which was a building with two small garage doors they opened and placed the luggage on a manual roller table.  Exit the baggage claim and you are outta the airport. If you need to get back to the terminal, it's a short walk back. The airlines that fly from here are Frontier and Allegiant - cheap fares and good service.

Great service. 
Great mechanics. 
Honest people 
I would highly recommend Dash for all your needs.  That includes imports!

The service here absolutely blew me away. I came here with my a family, a rowdy bunch of 14, and sat outside overlooking beach drive and the park. Our server and his assistant were cool, calm, and collective the entire meal and everything went smoothly with no mistakes. I always expect meals and drinks to take longer when I'm in such a large group but everything came out so fast! I love wine and the wine menu had much more on it then expected. The bread for the table came out hot and our water glasses were never empty. I ordered the filet mignon and king crab legs. Absolutely amazing, especially since they slice open the crab legs for you so you're mess free the entire meal. I have also been here for brunch and both experiences have left me anxious to write a great review for them. Their brunch buffet is reasonably priced and the food ranges from all types of breakfast specialities to King crab legs. The manager visited our table to ask how everything was both times, definitely a sign they care about their patrons. This place has officially been added to my list of St. Pete favorites.

2.5 stars...not terrible &  not good.  I love Japanese, Chinese, Thai, & Vietnamese. However, I was very disappointed. Things did not have much flavor at all and all of my vegetables were raw. I love having properly cooked vegetables that are still slightly crispy but these were not even cooked. I cannot stress enough how bad I wanted to love this restaurant. I guess I'll still be driving further to get good food.

So many cute shops as you're strolling downtown Philly, which one does a girl chose to go into?  This particular shop caught my eye with a sign outside exclaiming new arrivals of Dolce and Gabbana, Dior, and YSL.  How could a girl NOT be tempted to go in?  Upon entering the store the smell of used goods wafted towards me to greet me.  I gladly accepted the invitation and began my treasure hunt!  But, alas, it was not meant to be for me.  I was not able to find anything that I wanted to take home to CA.  However, that doesn't make this place not cool or fun!  
Lots of different clothes, shoes, and accessories... in all sorts of shapes, sizes and colors!  Maybe if it weren't Sunday evening and they weren't about to close, I would have had more time to rummage and find something.  All in all, pretty cool little shop.  Worth peeking in at least once!

So we went here last night with a group of 18.  The service to start was great, they were filling our water glasses without us even seeing them.  They took our order when we indicated that our party was all there and they knew their stuff when asked questions.  The food was great, there were many oos and ahhs going around.  The problem came when it was time to settle the bill and we asked for 18 checks.  I'm surprised with the number of large parties we saw there that this was apparently a difficult task.  From the point at which the check was ready to the point  at which we got our individual checks it took 51 minutes!! Then when we got our individual checks they were wrong.  In the end we paid our individual checks and started passing money around the table to make up the differences in each other's bills.  It was a terrible end to what seemed like it was going to be a good night.  

My recommendation if you plan to eat at The Capital Grille is to go with a small group or all bring cash and calculators - it will take you a lot less time to split the bill than it will take them.
This is a great place to eat Mexican.  The tacos are great as are the Margaritas.  I also love the guacamole and chips.

Horrible service. We pulled up at 7:55 and tried to find parking. The OPEN light was on. We were with a 6 month old so getting out of the car took a few minutes. Went to the door at 8:06 and it was locked. There were people inside and they just looked at us. Didn't even have the courtesy to come outside and say "Sorry, we are closed."  Ended up going to Anatolia Turkish restaurant which had EXCELLENT service and food. Go there instead!!!

Loved this place. It was a birthday gift from my wife. Food was really good and the entertainment was exceptional. We watched multiple magicians while we waited for our food. When your food is at your table, the wait staff will come and find you to let you know. We both had a great time and would definitely go back and recommend it to friends. Our waitress was awesome too, her name was Jill from NY and super honest and friendly. If possible, we would ask for her every time we went.

Ambience: 5
Service: 5
Food: 4
Magic: 5

We like the history of City Tavern and the added touch of the wait staff dressed in Colonial period clothing but, we were not impressed with the food. Mostly everything on the menu is as close to traditional colonial fare as possible which means salty food and smoked meats. We had the artichoke & smoked chicken salad and Salmagundi which is basically a chef salad. Other items on the menu are rabbit, duck, pork and fish. I suppose we would have liked a pork or chicken entree but it was lunchtime and we were not in the mood for dinner. Incidentally, the lunch and dinner menu are the same so unfortunately no burgers or sandwiches. Although there might be some good things on the menu we won't be rushing back.

December, 2019 Review:

Schiller's was most helpful this Christmas... our daughter wanted a photo printer for her iPhone pictures.
The Schiller's staff helped me on the phone and in person... and our daughter now has a really nice Canon Selphy printer that can print photos a up to 4x6 (most others I saw are only up to 2x3).

Thank you, Schiller's staff!





Summer, 2019 Review:

AMAZING Prints... our walls look SO NICE!


We have wanted to print and hang photos on the walls in our home for some time.

Once we down-selected our many photos to the ones that we did print and hang, we contacted Schiller's and we're all VERY glad we did... the prints are AMAZINGLY good... so crisp and brilliant!!!

I have been capturing HD / 16x9 aspect ratio images for some time, and I wanted the prints to reflect that size (i.e. I did not want to crop any of the images).
Schiller's quickly confirmed they could readily print that size (and Hobby Lobby has frames of different sizes, 9" to 27" and you can mix and match!)... and now our images from Devils Tower and Old Faithful and Kona are on the wall just as we captured them, bringing us BIG smiles from the great memories!

And, of course, they print the standard photo sizes, too.
Our photos look so good on our walls!
The room looks so great now!

The staff was friendly and helpful and our walls look great now!
And flexible.

No, Schiller's is not as close to home as we would like, it takes a short drive to get there... and it's worth it... they are helpful and the print quality is great. 
One example of their helpfulness... we had a timing issue with getting there by closing time and their manager was very cooperative working with us to make sure we still got the prints.  THANK YOU for this effort!



Since then, we recently entered a local photo contest... all four of us submitted two prints apiece.
We used their website to submit the images, again in various sizes including the 16x9 (HD), and they look great!
Whether or not any of us win anything in the contest, we do have more great images for our walls!



We have a new photo printing source for our family!


Thank you, Schiller's!

Oh my goodness, the all-day hash was full of flavor. Coffee rich, delicious, and balanced. Hitting at 11am Sunday morning, it was busy, but they found us a table quickly. Such a great surprise of a new place.

Dined here tonight.  Our server Cole was great and so sweet.  Started with Caesar salad and tomato bisque soup. Had the fish tacos and turkey burger for dinner.  Delicious!  1st time here.  Would definitely go back.

We chose the private tour to celebrate our 10 year anniversary yesterday and all I can say is WOWZA! I had high expectations going in after reading reviews about Sustainable Wine Tours, but Scott blew them out of the water. 

The first class customer service doesn't just start on the day of your tour, it starts from when you book. They truly love what they do and it shows in every aspect. 

Now on to the day of... We were picked up in a swanky Tesla SUV which was an experience in itself. Scott instantly becomes a friend. He's so knowledgeable, passionate and a lot of fun! 

We were taken to three different private tastings...each completely different from the next. From seeing the wine making process behind the scenes, spending time in the vineyards and sitting down to learn from / drink with the winemakers themselves was the most incredible experience. At every stop, Scott killed  it with the details. I could write forever...

Thank you, Scott and Sustainable Wine Tours for making our anniversary the best day ever! We WILL be back!

Just opened so they were waiting on their credit card machine, but the Pho was delicious.  Great wait staff and very clean. Reasonable prices and everything is made fresh daily.  I will definitely go back.  I want to try the pastries.
This is a must restaraunt. The service is good and the food is just as good! I love this place. Much better than stinky old Applebee's. HEHEHE

Ordered last night for the first time. Fried chicken mac and cheese ,collard greens ,Candied yams and peach cobbler. It was all delicious.  Girl who answered could be a little bit more personable on the phone. Otherwise I look forward to ordering again

Just had the stuffed peppers and they were amazing. So much flavor and just melt in your mouth. The peppers themselves were just the right consistency, not too firm and not too soft. It came with a nice Greek side salad that had all the ingredient that a good Greek salad should like olives and beets. I liked that it included pita bread and Tzatziki  sauce. I couldn't pass up the desserts especially the Baklava cheesecake.

I have no complaints about the food or the service or the food , it's always great.  However, since I've been using the order ahead service I like to tip the servers and there is no provision on the App to do that if I use my credit card and do not happen to have any cash on me. And Fry Sauce should be added to the menu , please. If tipping and fry sauce can be reprogrammed into the application that would be great for the customers and servers. Thank you.

PJ's is a great place for food, drink, and plenty of sports games on their numerous TV's. Wings are great, large and tasty with the several choices of sauces they offer. For drink, try their Copper Lager draft. Burgers are delicious, we like to add the Vermont Cheddar (sharp) cheese.

We had a delightful bunch. I had a Pisco sour, frothy and tangy served in a champagne saucer. We followed up with the blue crab beignets that were hot and cheesy and salty and tasty. The salad was flecked with nuts and creamy blue cheese, crisp radish and tossed with a bright vinaigrette. The paneed rabbit featured a variety of delightful textures though the syrup was a bit overpowering. The pistachios and honey lavender ice cream were an excellent accompaniment for the waffle which was perfectly crisp and golden.

Very nice for an older hotel in New Orleans. Rooms are small and shower was not functioning properly. The shower was repaired promptly upon request. I was attending a conference, plentiful rooms but confusing floor plan. Overall, I enjoyed my stay and would recommend to other visitors.

An amazing place with great atmosphere. The inside has nice light decor but food was the best. Wide variety of chef creations. The beignets were awesome with a great honey orange marmalade. Banana Foster French toast was creatively displayed in a pinwheel design and a pecan studded decadent delight! Prices reflect the excellent quality but very worth the price for a nice experience and satisfied tummy!!! And doesn't even touch the mimosas.
Chicken entree was deeeeeelicious and eggplant parm was very tasty too. Very reasonably priced. Nice service and quaint outdoor seating.

Deliciously prepared eggs and bacon brunch!
This is one of my favorite places to have a later breakfast. Service and food are always great and the price is super fair.

Tucked away amidst office building across from Keystone at the Crossing, MOD pizza is another take on fast personalized pizzas. Of course they offer suggestion but the topping list is vast and includes the usually elusive anchovy YAAS. Pizzas are about $8 each and have 4 large pieces. We went with the Mad Dog meat loaded and the seasonal special Isaac which had no sauce but lots of roasted tomatoes, balsamic, ricotta and basil. The side of garlic bread too had a quite pleasant hint of rosemary. Lucky us we were there on free shake day but I would have happily paid for them as they were super thick and rich with a sweet dairy tang to the vanilla. A lovely open space with large and small group seating, MOD pizza is super family friendly Weirdly enough most of parking front is 20 minutes or less but again, this is a fast pizza place

Found this salon through groupon because I needed a spray tan before an event. I've only been here that one time to fulfill my groupon but I think they've succeeded in converting me to a return customer. The salon is clean, it has everything you need, my mystic tan came out great and EVEN (yay!), and the girl working there was just amazing. I believe her name was Cindy or Sydney (I'm sorry I don't remember!) but she was so sweet and helpful. Will be back soon to get a more permanent tan with the beds :)

If you're new to Nashville, you gotta check out Five Daughters for their version of a cronut. $4.50 is a bit pricey for a donut, but when you're on vacation-the calories and the experience is worth it. 

Maybe you're watching your figure this summer. Donut worry, they offer mini doughnuts that will cut half the guilt. 

This was our second visit after getting the original Vanilla Cream. Before we hit the road, we got one of the Purist (vanilla bean), Cherry Pie, and a mini Pink lemonade.

If you are going to GSR to gamble, DON'T. If you expect action for your dollars you will not get it, slot machines are like shredders, put money in and makes a lot of noise and you get nothing of value back. I am a video poker guy, I put in several hundred dollars into 3 different wheel poker machines and did not get one thing. That has never happened at any Casino I have been in. Tried the high limit slots, joke. Figure I would try some penny machines so at least I can last awhile and get some action, NOPE. This place as gone down hill, if you want to stay in nice hotel rooms, great place, especially if they are free. Just don't gamble there, you'll end up paying thousands for that FREE room. At least you'll get $25 free play, really?

For four years now, we have 4 vehicles that gets serviced here, and Dennis knows every single one that we have. Hes the best! How often can you actually say that you TRUST your dealerships service advisor? 
Last November,  my car was totaled and Kate in collision really treated my very well. I had injuries, and she was patient and kind. 
I wouldn't go anywhere else.

Their barbecue chicken sandwich was barfy!  A McChicken is 10 times better, and much, much cheaper. I couldn't even find the chicken as it was lost in the onions and whatever else was in there that I couldn't identify.  Once I did find a small piece of chicken, it had a consistency of paste. Very much overcooked and certainly no barbecue flavor. Such a ripoff!

The wings did not taste fresh and the sauce is not satisfying.

As for my friend's mussels, he thought they tasted alright but they were quite small, but more concerning was the fact that they didn't come with the proper mussel-eating accouterments, such as a bowl to place the shells in.

They seated us all bunched-in like sardines, and thanks to the heavyset guy behind me I couldn't get in or out of my chair without great difficulty.  

Yuck all around, and although I formerly liked this place, I will not be returning.

If I could leave a zero I would. I try to be very understanding when it comes to service and quality because I myself work in the restaurant industry so I know mistakes can happen but this was above and beyond poor.
We were quoted 20 minutes for a patio table. No problem, we waited. 
We were seated and it took over 25minutes for a server to even look our way. A man bussing tables made small talk with us but never asked if we were taken care of. It was 25 minutes from when we started counting so there was at least a good 6/7 minutes  before that. 
My order of chilaquiles was completely wrong. And when I pointed out what was wrong the server didn't apologize or anything, she just said "oh I'll get you some" and that was it. 
The other person at the table had an omelet that looked like it was from a kids menu and toast that was burnt black. No jelly or butter. 
No one ever asked how our meal was.
This kind of service and quality would never fly at the restaurants I work at. My managers would have been on top of it and tried to make things right. This isn't the first time I have had bad service here but it will be the last. I honestly can't believe we paid for that poor quality of food and service. Disappointing is an understatement.

Came here with friends for HH on cinco de mayo. Armed with our wine and spirits- purchased tequila, we were able to sit on the back patio and get some sun. They carry a few different types of margarita mixers and will add your tequila right in. 64 oz of mix ran about $15 and I believe there was a fee of $2-3 for bringing your own tequila. They have the option to add cinnamon and sugar to your glass run, which I had never had before (tasted amazing). We ordered chips and salsa to share which tasted pretty standard. All 3 of us ordered tacos with a side of refried beans; we ended up being served regular black beans but that didn't make or break our dishes. Overall, there was a great selection, including vegetarian options. If you're feeling margaritas but don't want to go to some of the other busy NoLibs spots, I highly suggest giving Pura Vida a try! FYI it's cash only, but there's an ATM there if you forget.

Well most ppl already know who is on top of the donut franchise chain which if you don't, its Krispy Kreme. As seen in the pic, you can get a assorted dozen that you can pick or have your dozen randomized.

  You could go for just the famous glazed too which in most cases you might as well get 2 dozen, that's just how good they are.

  Watching your figure or calorie intake? You can just settle for the 3 pack of donuts. Need a caffeine lift? Grab you a iced or warm coffee too.

  Not much more needs to be said but the donuts are always fresh everytime I purchased and no sir or maam, you cannot eat just 1.

  Overall for donuts, here's my go to. When that sweet tooth kick in it could be yours too.

Awesome!!!  The ONLY reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the salad was below mediocre...  But I knew that going in from the reviews.  Everything else was definitely 5 stars!!!  After reading some bad reviews I had reconsidered our choice of restaurant, but I'm glad we didn't change plans.  

Had eggplant with capers & crab - LOTS of crab and very balanced dish.  

Also had mussels, NOT the menu mussels but the special with a traditional white wine garlic basil sauce, I believe.  I read some reviews of people who got a "bad" batch of mussels but we definitely didn't!  They were perfect! Maybe a tiny more sauce woulda been ok, but excellent!  

Also got cannelloni.  Good, borderline great, but not quite there.  Probably just got overshadowed by the other two!  

Main items come with choice of pasta and house salad.  I got salad, wife got pasta.  Coulda done without the House salad...  Just wasn't very good.  Like what you'd get at a cheap banquet or hotel.  Pasta was great, but sauce was REALLY spicy for a marinara.  I personally liked it but It was a little hotter than expected...

Main courses - stuffed trout with ocean sauce!!  Not crazy about the name, but that sauce was really really great!  Someone mentioned it wasn't balanced?  I say that's BS.  It was perfectly balanced with sweet, savory and salty, with a hint of SOMETHING pleasant that I couldn't identify... Would definitely order again! 

Also got lamb chop special and it was probably the best I've ever had!!  HUGE portion, grilled in a butter rosemary sauce.

All in all, this was an awesome meal and I'll be back! B

TERRIBLE....long wait for take out order, completely unorganized, everyone looks confused. The food was horrible no taste at all. The pulled pork Mac and cheese had no flavor at all. The pulled pork was blah, well the beans were right out of the can  no additional spices added. This is bbq spot how do you screw up pulled pork and beans! Ordered a vegan burger also and let's just say save your money . How do you over cook a vegan burger? The best factors of this place were the French fries and their ability to open a can! Will not be returning, and will surely let my friend and family no it's not worth the stop .

Had a birthday dinner here and it was amazing! The event coordinator was very attentive and nice from the start. All members of my party enjoyed their meals, and our waiter was so nice and accommodating. The waiter made sure to listen to each guest. Along with allergies and dietary restrictions, we were all accommodated properly. The menu had a wide variety of options which allowed my guests to feel as though they had multiple choices. 

They even allowed us to use one of their sparklers in my cake. Overall, the whole experience was great & the room was beautiful.

Love this place. Very nice interior, although sometimes it gets a little smokey in the kitchen area and makes my eyes water when I'm sitting in the dining area. But the food more than makes up for a little discomfort. Food is seasoned to perfection and the staff is friendly and makes you feel welcome, even if you're just getting take out. Haven't any of the BBQ yet but that will definitely be next on my list. Very reasonable prices and you get a decent sized portion.

Showed up a little before 6 last Saturday with a party of 7. I figured we'd have to wait a little. They told us it would be 30 minutes. Sure, no problem.
About 25 minutes later, the woman at the podium in front came outside to tell us there were back-to-back booths available immediately, or we could wait for a table together - the previous customers had paid their check and were about to leave. 
We said we would wait - and then the problems began.

Next thing we knew, a different party of seven that arrive after us had been seated at our table. For the next 20 minutes, we got to witness the half-dozen people at the front podium question eachother over how the other group was seated ("They sat themselves!" "I didn't seat them!" "They said they were the party of seven!").

Nobody actually told us there was a problem or that they were trying to solve it - we just got to witness everything while they tried their best to avoid eye contact with us. They went to the table of seven (to, what, ask them to move? I'm still not clear on this.)

Eventually, about 50 minutes after we arrived, we were seated at a table right next to the other party of seven. The person seating us offered minimal apologies. No effort was made, otherwise, to correct their error.

Truly, a giant mess.

Next: The service. It was another 10 minutes before we got water. The basket of bread they brought could not have been meant for a table of seven (maybe two baskets for the larger table?). But it didn't matter much, as it also is some utterly flavorless bread.

Out table ordered a few burgers, a flatbread, a reuben, fish and chips and a chicken pot pie. Of these, the burgers were best; the reuben was dry and the boy who normally devours fish and chips ate half of one piece of fish, which he said was also dry.

Average to below average food. Average service. Prices above what they should be. Terrible, terrible organization.

Maybe it's better when they're not so busy?
By far the best pizza in town. Great staff and just overall high quality pizza! My favorite place in Indy.

I love this nail salon; it is very clean and the technicians are gentle and skilled.  Pricing is very good and fair.  Best pedicure I have ever had anywhere!  So happy I found this place when I moved to town! I see some bad reviews here related to prior management.  They bear no relevance to the current experience here.  Every time I have family and friends in town I bring them here and they say it's the best salon experience they have had and are jealous that I live here and can go regularly, which I do!

Since it is close to my house this is my hang out spot. Aside from the food being good It's always busy, which is great for people watching.... If you come to Panera be prepared to be stared at by me. Don't worry I'll try to be subtitle and it's not like I'm here all the time.

The best pizza place in Santa Barbara by far. I'm a local here and I love Barbarians. It's always quiet for lunch and the service is great. They are one of the few places left that doesn't over charge for a meal. The people that work there are always super helpful and nice. At night after the bars close they get busy but they handle the rush perfectly. Highly recommend going to this place if you just want some god damn pizza without all the frills. State street is a bouchey touristy mess but this place is all right.

Michelle is an excellent stylist! I wanted to cut several inches off my hair and was nervous about how it would look. I brought a few pictures with me and she helped choose the one that best suited me. I love my new cut! The salon is beautiful and all the staff are kind and enthusiastic. I didn't have a set salon in the area before I came to Art Plus Science but I definitely will return again to Michelle!

Don't go here if you actually want to eat. My family and I sat down at 4:30 and were not even greeted for about 10 minutes. After we were greeted we ordered right away. Our drinks still had not arrived after 30 minutes. At around 5:20 we had still not received food, while another table who had gotten there after us had received theirs.  When I asked our server how much longer as she gave us no answer while walking away from us. Do not recommend this place.

I had such a delicious burger from this artistically decorated mobile food trailer, that I decided to hire Josh and his Spot truck and staff to cater a party of 60 + for my mother's 90th birthday celebration. Everyone loved the festive atmosphere and the food was amazing, fresh, inventive, abundant and appropriately priced considering the quality and presentation. One added convenience of using a food truck to cater a party is: No indoor set up or clean up in your home. I set out some chairs, tables and trash receptacles outside and that was it. All fun. No fuss.

Went here the other night because all the other places in the mall had a long waiting list. This place was half full and we were hungry. It's seat yourself, service was prompt and friendly. The food was just okay. The calamari were very greasy, the potstickers were not too bad. The burgers were good, nothing outstanding but hit the spot. Not a place I would frequent, maybe on $1 burger nights, but the restaurant choices are here are too many to come back here.

We came back here TWICE on the same trip. Their beignets and hot chocolate are to die for! I would keep coming back here if I could. The line seems long but the wait isn't too bad. 10/10 you HAVE to try this New Orleans staple.

Myself and my wife went today. We got the 90 minute massage. It was fantastic. 1 hour on body hitting all the pressure points. The key is to relax so they can get deep into tissue. Job well done. Therapist knew what she was doing. Then another 30 minutes on feet. Great job. We plan on going once a month. Thanks Eva and Linda.
Came here once with friends and we got the fries with garlic aioli and the corn and cheese empanadas. Both were amazing. The beer selection was really good also.

OK, so I get that people love the special Maki rolls.  This place has them and I've seen people I eat with salivate over them in dramatic ways.  Personally, I like the traditional sushi and sashimi with good miso soup and this place is not remarkable.  It is average.  Three stars.

For a place that is supposed to be Chuckie Cheese for adults there were too many kids running around the midway.  Now I know you want to have a nice night out with your "baby mama", but it would be cheaper for you to hire a babysitter for the night than take your future juvi offenders to D&B. 11pm on a Saturday night is when your 7 year old is supposed to be in bed. 

Also good luck and getting to play the basketballs games. The only place where there wasn't a huge line to play was the trivia game (now there's a shocker).  But to see how people were spending their welfare money at this place started me thinking that I should open one of these in Newark and Camden and rake in the dough.

The place was over crowded, and over priced.  Would never come back to this D&B again. I'd rather drive the extra 30 miles and goto the one in Penn's Landing.

Not impressed service was terrible it took forever to get our salads and when we finally got them we had 2 minutes to eat them before our main course came out. The food was not very good we ordered the beef stew and it came out luke warm. Also, getting a refill on your beverage was like pulling teeth.

I enjoyed this place more some years back.  It has changed.  Good beers.  Dive vibe but not prices.  It seems to want to be a sports bar, dive bar, locals only bar, heavy metal night bar, we're all about Patrick bar, etc.  The staff can be super cool to standoffish.  It can get loud.  Very loud with people shouting over the TV's.  I've dodged first fights, bachelorette parties and darts.  It's a spot in the Nation's.....

New Brewery on the Mainline. Had a great experience. Beer was great. I had the Belgian Blond Ale. Great tasting. Good diverse menu. I had the chili which was great....bits if pork.  Gouda Mac and cheese was delicious and loved dipping hand cut fries in the white bbq sauce. Several other bbq sauces on table to choose from. My only complaint was that it was really loud.

There's one thing that I crave from Barbuzzo. It's their salted caramel budino. That said, however, the last time I had it, it wasn't as creamy or smooth as I had remembered it in the past. Maybe it was just an off-night. 

Everything else is good, but not mmmm good. I came once for their Valentine's Day menu and got the vegetarian cannelloni as my main, something that I could have easily recreated at home. Their tomato sauce is tasty, and I sopped it up with extra bread, but the other components were meh. 

Most recently, we ordered their arancini. Fried risotto balls are always yummy, but I've had better at some of the other Italian places in the city. The Brussels sprouts had potential with all of the pancetta flavoring them, but they were undercooked. The pizza is something I was looking forward to the most. They just look so darn pretty. We ordered the sausage pizza, only to be disappointed. The pizza crust had a nice char, but it was soggy and droopy in the center. I understand the less is more concept of topping a pizza, but don't place all of them in the middle of the pie. 

I haven't given up on this place, but I'll have to think closely about what I order next.

Excellent food and great service!! Definitely recommend the baked spaghetti!! This location had changed their meatballs and I didn't like it as much but now the original meatballs are back and just as tasty as ever!!! Eat here and you won't be disappointed!

I tried too buy an online ticket, but I had too fight with a password.  I wanted too go this weekend but I can't.  I can't buy a ticket because I have too because I too too fight with a  password.  The website won't let me buy a ticket without a  password.  And the website won't let me submit a password.  I guess never be able too visit the Santa Barbara zoo, all because of a password on their website!!!!

Great experience today at the Color Bar in KOP! It was as described on the website as doing roots, full color and bayalage only, which was perfect because I needly to QUICKLY get rid of a at home dye job gone wrong.  Without judgement, Percy matched me with a color similar to my natural color and got to work.

MAJOR selling point was there were no awful mirrors that you have to sit in front of for 30 minutes while processing.  Percy was a dream and sang Beyonce while fixing the mess i created on the top of my head.

If you are expecting a full salon service, this might not be the place for you - but if you are a busy gal in the KOP area and need quality service quickly, I highly recommend.  I left with a great color, great blow out and out under 1.5 hours.

Our second day in SB after the trolley tour and lots of walking.  We were hungry but couldn't decide on what to eat. Stopped by Joe's as it was highly recommended by our tour guide.  

It's got a cozy diner like feel. But the service was great and the food delicous. I had the most amazing Rueben sandwich that left me craving it days later when I returned to San Diego.  Unfortunately nothing came close.

Stopped by as I needed to grab a quick lunch. You're not greeted by anyone when you walk in, just two kiosk where you place your order. I got the Goma Tuna Poke Bowl while my gf got the Sansho Salmon Poke Bowl. The bowls were good, just not 16$ a pop kind of good. The fish appears to be pretty fresh, but the avocado appeared to be left out for a while as they were turning brownish.

Filling, overpriced, inconsistent poke bowls is my conclusion about this spot.

Today my wife and I went to Loli's Mexican Cravings  for the first time. We both had the ribeye taco and the Pork carnitas taco along with the pico de Gallo and retried black beans. The tacos were extremely good with the pork carnitas being our favorite. The prices are very reasonable and we will be back.

Ok. A story of love, betrayal, and reconciliation. 

My original 5-star review is just below. Really love the vibe of this place, etc. 

Came in July 2018 and ended up with the wrong tip on my card and got all indignant up in there (I'm a grad student and in the service industry so I have basically no time or money and felt hurt to be taken advantage of by a place I considered a friend!)

Was contacted almost immediately by a manager who explained it was a complication of moving to a new system, and offered me amends and asked for me to come try them again. He even offered to venmo me the entire cost of my original purchase, but the difference between my original tip and the wrong one was a dollar and that seemed unnecessary. So, in a show of good faith, I brought a couple friends I *knew* would dig this spot by, Tchoup Yard got us a few drinks, I felt redeemed for my troubles and Tchoup Yard won my business back and a few new customers as well. Makes me like Tchoup Yard even more! Can't wait to be back! 

P.s. We got the tots and they were delish, just like my cheeseburger was last time!

This is a typical mall. 

I try to shop at home in my bed as much as possible but this is a great alternative when I want to be out and about. 

I can usually find what I need here including some decent lunch options. I tend to stick with the same stores as I know beforehand what it is I'm looking for and where to find it. This time of the year the place is completely packed and there's not much space to maneuver. Again, if you have a game plan you  can be in and out fairly quickly. 

The grounds are usually kept nice and each of the stores tries to be consistent with upkeep so I appreciate that. I will continue to return here in the future for my needs.

Others have noted this is a landmark, an institution, etc. etc. etc. and I can certainly see that.  From the older men chatting in the corner loudly at three different tables to the friendly waitresses, you instantly get the classic diner type of vibe.  The décor probably hasn't changed ever but the place is generally clean.

The coffee is straight, it's medium bodied, not bitter but not very strong.  Every time you get below half, they freshen you up.  Yay.

The Spanish omelette with grits.  First of all it's huge, I don't know, are 4 eggs legal?  LOL.  Maybe only 3...  It's juicy, wet, full of green peppers, sausage, with cheddar cheese sprinkled on top.  I ate it all, and quickly.  The waitress provided 3 different kinds of hot sauce. and I used the Cholula.  Definitely enhanced the experience.  The grits were basic, but the waitress put two pats of butter on top, awww yeah.  

I don't think it's possibly to walk away hungry here, and I in fact left a couple tablespoons of grits I was so full.  Great food, great vibe that puts you back in time.

Nice little spot in a very unexpected little plaza. We started with the lamb tartare which was yummy with the little pieces of cut up beet. I had the fish tacos which were just ok but I should have asked what kind of fish came on them because it was salmon which I'm not a huge fan of and had I asked i would have ordered something else. The toppings were great but salmon just isn't my fave. We also had an order of chicken tenders and the fried chicken (thigh) sandwich which were all delicious. Our server was great and overall a cool spot. I'd def give it another go.

I lived near this clinic and sort of defaulted to taking my maltese there for her standard "maintenance" visits. The front staff was pleasant. Rates were somewhat reasonable--more than I paid back home in Texas, but comparable for Nashville.

I adore Dr. Werner--she was always very approachable. There were a couple of times where I asked about certain situations (dog food brands, for example), and she seemed less knowledgeable (she recommended a grocery store brand, which I'd never seen recommended elsewhere--she didn't seem to be too aware of Blue Buffalo, which is highly recommended all over, yet didn't work out for my dog). 

At one point, I had to see Dr. Singleton when Dr. Werner was out of town, and I was a little less drawn to her. She seemed to be admonishing me for my maltese's concerning dental hygiene situation (I brush my dog's teeth more than anyone I know brushes their dog's teeth--malteses are just prone to have dental issues). While she was knowledgeable, her warmth was lacking--by the time I left the clinic, I was in tears.

Knowing my dog did not seem to be in pain, I waited until I was home in Texas to see my old vet to have her tooth extracted. I'm glad I did.

I've since moved across town and have a new vet. If you live in the Brentwood area, I would suggest trying Southside, as I have no other knowledge of vets in the area. Affordable, and caring enough.

Ordered pineapple fried rice, was not impressed. Smelled terrible. The panang curry was good but I wasn't given rice soooo soup?

Ordered spring rolls too, they were okay. 

The fried rice was such a disappointment!!!!!!
Loved the atmosphere, corn fritters were so good, the southwest chicken wrap was so fresh tasting. And the entertainment was one guy who didn't blast the music! It was a great night for all of us!

This place food was ok but not better than the Slacks on Aramingo ave. Beware the $5 for 10$ worth of food deal on yelp it is misleading. Nowhere is mention in the terms that you have to purchase $20 worth of food to get $10 off but when I brought the deal and tried to use it they said I had to spend $20 first. I was pissed!

We wanted to get away from the French Quarter and didn't want anything fried.  So that we did by trying Madina's.  

Starters, turtle soup and salad with vinaigrette.   Both were very good, I've never had turtle soup and this I would trie again.  My husbands salad, the vinaigrette was some of the best homemade dressing I've ever tried.  The buttered toast was ok, maybe it needed some spice or more salted butter.

Meals- husband had grilled pork chops, I had grilled gulf fish.  The pork was flavorful and I liked his roasted potatoes better than my boiled potatoes.  The green beans were also good, seasoned a little different that what were use to.  The gulf fish was flavorful, but it was a bit dry/crispy from being overcooked.  It seems like this is a struggle when I get grilled fish, to get the right char the fish is usually over cooked and this wasn't any different.  This was a thinner filet that should have been quickly chard.  Anyhow I ate it all up because it was flavorful.  

Lastly we ordered dessert, I wanted to try something local so we split bread pudding.  Husband wanted the marble cheesecake, should have tried that.  I was kind of excited when the server said pineapple with rum sauce and how rich this was.  Now I'm a dessert person the richer the better.  This was a let down, the pineapple was a good addition, I would leave the raisins out; they take away from the pineapple.  The sauce needs to be changed up also, the creamy white rum sauce was kind of flavorless.  I would make a sugary, buttery rum sauce this would have hit the spot.  

I wouldn't be opposed to trying some of the other dishes, the Po Boys looked good and some of the specials that went by looked good as well.  I'm just not that thrilled for a $74 meal to hurry back and there wasn't the wow memorable factor that I'll be taking about when we return to the city in a couple years.
Went back a second time, ordered the burger a second time.  They nailed it again!  Very possibly the best burger I've ever had.

We came here around 8-9 on Friday morning with no wait. The menu has so many things that look amazing so it makes it definitely hard to choose. The have French toast, crepes, savory crepes and toast as well as sandwiches, and pancake bites. They have some bar seating as well as tables. Not too big of a space so I'm sure there are lines out the door at times. 

With the restaurant name being French toast we felt we should give it a try I also ordered their biscuit sandwich with egg cheese and bacon. When the food came out my expectations were a bit higher for the French toast so I was a little disappointed. The French Toast came with a handful of blueberries that was the "fruit" it came with. It was so hard/crispy on the outside I really think they must've overlooked it. I was able to just pick up a piece with my fingers and dip it in the syrup to try it. There was nothing special about it. I would definitely pass on it in the future.

So why 4 stars? The saving grace is everything else! There was a coconut French toast a friend had ordered it was stuffed with a cream cheese with coconut that was huge and delicious. Th biscuit sandwich I ordered was huge and amazing. It had a homemade cheese biscuit that melted in your mouth, bacon was crispy, eggs were fluffy. Everything you want in a sandwich. A friend of mine ordered the same and asked for a side of spicy aioli and after trying it with that I honestly don't know why they don't have that on it normally. It gave it the perfect something that brought it all together. The pancake balls were confusing because when looking at the menu I had the idea of them being stuffed with Nutella or whatever you choose however they just give you a side of it for dipping. They were still nice and fluffy. 

When coming here try a few things out but I'd stay away from their French toast unless it's their specialty ones such as the coconut. I gave the leftovers to a homeless person so at least someone enjoyed it.
Martinis and shrimp cocktail. Enough said!

Don't use this company, even if it's more expensive, use Uber or Lyft. This company is full of sh**.
