I spent $40 to get from TPA to the corner of Dale Mabry and Kennedy, the driver made me pre-pay "in case there was no internet at the destination" and joked that he though I was going to Dale Mabry and Gandy when I arrived less than 6 miles from where I started. DONT USE THIS COMPANY.

I'm not really happy to write this review since I have been pretty obsessed with salad society in the last month. I picked up a salad for take and was really disappointed to see that most of the romaine had started to turn and was slimy and soggy looking. i ate some of it thinking it would taste fine but it quickly became obvious that it wasn't.  I understand that it's hard keeping ingredients fresh on a daily basis but if a salad is going to cost me $10 I expect decent quality. I ended up throwing most of it away. I won't say that I'm not going to go back because I have loved salad society thus far but it I will probably think twice before returning anytime soon :(
My favorite Mexican style restaurant in Saint Petersburg. Hand crafted margarita is fantastic. Great atmosphere. Always get the fajitas when they have them. Only one day a week, Tuesday I believe.

The lady was very responsive online replying to all my texts.  The guy showed up the next day on time.  He was very professional and got the job done in about 30 minutes or less.  He also noticed a couple more sprinkler heads that needed replacing.  He had the parts with him and was able to switch them out.  I would recommend them to anyone who need sprinkler repairs.  They were not expensive at all.  Very  good prices.

Since moving to Indy earlier this year, Sushi Boss has been my go-to delivery option. I love being able to easily customize my order on their site. Almost all my orders have arrived before the delivery estimate and everything has tasted great. I do wish they would make at least one vegetarian signature roll, but hard to complain when I can create my own. : ) Also, the Boss sauce + the eel sauce may be my favorite combination of all time. Highly recommend the cucumber salad, as well. I love Sushi Boss!

I really wanted to love this place, just on vegan principles, but was underwhelmed. I ordered the cornbread dish which sounded fabulous, but just wasn't :(
I was in a party of 4 and only one of the other meals looked like something I would have enjoyed (the polenta!)
The veggies were bland and only the dessert was a saving grace.  But our server was top notch :D

Fresh oysters, great ambiance, and an all around good time. The service was quick and efficient. Definitely more than just a dive bar. It went above and beyond our expectations and we can't wait to see what live music is in store tonight!!
Small restaurant with a lot of atmosphere.  You must try the pizza; it's some of the best St. Louis-style out there.

Def 5 Stars the best Japanese restaurant in PA to me!
I've been there few times now, the food taste more than great, customer service impressed me.
It is a small restaurant but it makes you feel really homy.

As a native New Yorker, this is the best bagel I've had outside of Brooklyn. Doesn't hurt that the owner was super nice and a great conversationalist. By the time I left, it was like we had been friends for years. Fantastic food and great service!

I don't even know what to say that hasn't already been said.  We found this place through Yelp & Trip Advisor and after reading all the wonderful reviews, we couldn't NOT stay here.  We were absolutely delighted we listened to all you Yelpers (and Trip Advisors).  

The property is absolutely stunning. The place is sparkling clean and has that old-time charm about it yet is wonderfully updated for all your comforts.  We stayed in the main mansion, in the Garden District Room, and everything was perfect.  This was probably one of the best B&Bs we have ever stayed at.  Every room came with luxury amenities, and yet the prices for this B&B were so reasonable.  

There are 4 rooms in the Main Mansion and 3 rooms in the Patio Wing.  Though I'm not a super light sleeper, I was worried that we would be able to hear every little noise being in the main part of the mansion.  Not so.  We remarked at how little we did hear - even other guests said the same thing.  

The B&B is run by Patrick and his wife, Karma.  We didn't get to talk to Karma too much (darn short weekend!), but Patrick was absolutely lovely and hospitable.  Makes a damn good breakfast, too!  Not only were the breakfasts always amazing, the breakfasts always stuffed us to the brim!  

Ashton's is just about a mile from the French Quarter.  Most times we took a cab (maybe $8 each time), but on some mornings we just stolled down Esplanade down to the French Quarter.  Pleasant walk.  

Oh .... and though I am a pretty restless sleeper, the beds and sheets here are ah-ma-zing!  Awesome!  

Next time we're down in New Orleans, we will definitely be staying here again!

Last night we had a great experience at the Fork. We are here traveling from out of town. Food is really important especially when you're traveling on a vacation your expectations are a little higher. 

  We weren't disappointed at the Fork. We 
Made a reservation days before. A family member who lives here in town highly recommended this place so we took the suggestion and glad we did. The food was all on point. A few of us had a couple special request and all of that was met. The food all came out really good. My wife got a protein style burger, uncle got a steak, aunt got a Hawaiian chicken of some sort and my self a recommended brisket sandwich. Everyone was happy and the entire plate was cleared. 

 Our servers were Ryan & Rochelle, they did a great job making sure we were taking care of. They knew the menu pretty well explaining things very thoroughly, and were very accommodating. They didn't miss a beat on filling up drinks, sauces, checking in on the meal and making sure the steak was cooked properly. 

 We ended up getting dessert: Butter cake and an epic bread pudding (highly recommend) 

  If you're looking for good food in Boise I would highly recommend this place and also make reservations it seems to be a popular spot, you will not be let down. 

 Very grateful we found this place. 

Good job Fork Chefs and good job Ryan & Rochelle 
Team R & R 

-The friendly people from California, don't worry we're only here to visit, keep
Doing what your doing. We had a great experience.
First time here, our server was Lindsey and was pretty sweet/cute haha! Food was great and drinks were great! Will definitely be back again

We got a nail in our tire on a Friday night and needed to be with family on Saturday afternoon. Mid-City Tire and Auto was the only place willing to fit us in on a Saturday morning. They were honest, efficient, and got us in and out well before the promised time. Aaron at the front desk was especially helpful, updating us constantly making sure the job got done to get us on our way. Highly recommended!!

I coofficiated here at a wedding 10/15/11. Unavoidably, my friend and colleague, the priest was detained and then got lost en route, and, I mean, very lost. I went to the manager's office (so no one would hear me on the phone with the priest and get concerned and scared). The manager was just returning from fixing something (which he did personally rather than assign it to someone else) and he sat down at his desk and calmly took my iPHone and guided the priest in, especially unnerving when Father sailed past the turnpike exit and had to turn around. Simultaneous to guiding the priest in, the manager directed his crew as to how to keep the concerned wedding party and guests from getting unhinged. No barked order, just simple directions followed immediately because there was a history of respectful good working relations which is so required when there's a problem.  During the ceremony, my assistant observed the manager himself sweeping the leaves from the front entrance. 

I have never been so impressed with the professionalism and competence of a club manager under fire. Although the wedding did start late, he was sure to reevaluate and restructure the timeline so that what could have destroyed a wedding was a passing annoyance. 

Jason never complained about the couple or how hard he was working: not one word of self-pity or self-congratulation. No moaning; no groaning. Just getting the job done: nice 'n neat.

I always tell couples that no one will ever remember the pattern of the carpet or the color of the wallpaper. They will always remember the kindness of the wait staff and the attentive attitude of the club. No one, not one of the staff just "sat around" or appeared to "relax on the job" or not project an alert persona. This was modeled by the manager, Jason, whom, if I could choose the club at which couples get married, would be my manager for every country club wedding. After 30 years of being everywhere and seeing everybody, Jason is sincerely superior. I shall forever be grateful for how he helped me make the wedding of Mr and Mrs Miller a happy and memorable occasion.

If you can think of a single reason not to give this place 5 stars I'll treat you like the Sunday morning sorority chicks from the UofA that stumble in in their pajamas were treated the night before...(and yes, that is a pretty popular Sunday attire for many of the patrons)

:)

okay, this place is awesome with a capital A! Pancakes folks rave over, but for me the "special" omelette is fantastic!  The home fries are good, and if the place is packed, sure it won't have the token crisp on them like usual since there's a high turn-over, but seriously...isn't that the mark of a great place??  They're now open all day into the evening, which means you don't get to see 'grandma' unless you go at night (I miss her on our family sundays going there...)  But, Debbie, daughter and the rest are the best at taking care of us and for the past 5 years+ we've never had a single complaint (other than there's not a bottle of Louisiana hot sauce on each table).

Here's how much I liked this place: I joined Yelp specifically so I could leave an awesome review for Ciro's. I eat at a lot of high end restaurants, and this was, without a doubt, my favorite place of 2012. When we first arrived, I had a very hard time finding it. You think you're at some random apartment building--you're not. Keep looking, it's there. When you find the door, they ask you for a password like an old time speakeasy. It's all in good fun.

They seated us in a little private cove with a curtain, which was very intimate. I love craft cocktails. Twice I just ordered off the menu; two other times I told them what I liked and had the bartender make me something. I was never disappointed.

At many places where the cocktails are the the focus, the food goes by the wayside. That's not the case here. We really liked the Crab Avocado martini, the duck fries were great too. Everything we had was wonderful. If you're into delicious, exotic cocktails that you can't find anywhere else and great food, you're going to love Ciro's.
The service was amazing. The setup of the restaurant was interesting and provided for a nice ambiance. The sushi came quickly and was served nicely.

This was a great haunted prison. my best friend fell to fall bc she got so scared. First room is the best. Love the 3D room. Love the origination of the line entering the prison, only waited 35 minutes which was bad bc of the entertainment outside with the scary guards.

Great place for fresh vegetable and fruit juice drinks. I usually stop in daily for a double shot of wheat grass, very fresh and sweet. The people that work here are very friendly and personable. The inside is wide open and has about a dozen stools to sit on. Come to think about it, I've never seen anyone sitting on them.

The only negative on the place is they have no concept on how to actually run the place to serve customers. They generally have 4 or 5 people working in the place but only one that actually waits on customers and makes drinks. Since the vegetable/fruit drinks can take 5 mins each to make, you can easily end up waiting 10 mins or more with only 1 or 2 people in front of you. The other 4 people appear to be working in the back. My guess is they're making the juices for the cleanse program they sell. They might make a lot of money on these drinks but they should focus a little on the customers coming in the door. Here's a suggestion, have one person take orders and one or two make the drinks.

Great restaurant, generous portions for lunch and fantastic service at affordable prices. Our server who I assume might have also been the owner was so friendly and kind. The meatballs and marinara were delicious as well as the strombolis. This is the best food I've had in New Jersey.

Unfortunately the employees are not trained to be customer focused. Received a faulty product and wanted to exchange it for one that worked before a bridal shower. Went to multiple registers and waited around for 20 minutes just to say I wanted the other product that worked. There was no point of sale transaction needed, just someone with common sense. Almost as bad as K-mart employees...

The breakfeast and dinner's are both Great!!!  Good food, huge portions and great service.  It is a family owned restaurant and that is what they do, treat you like family.  You feel at home at Jessi's with home style food.  From the moment you walk in the door you feel like your home and the waitresses remember your order from your favorite meal, if you choose to order it again.  Thank you Jessi's for serving food the old fashioned way and correct way!

I used to be a regular here. Until that time a person I was with got sick off the tacos. Was literally eating their taco and then had to excuse themself to the bathroom to throw it up. Gross

A week after that incident, we saw this place in Dirty Dining on ABC NEWS: http://www.abcactionnews.com/money/consumer/dirty-dining/dirty-dining-popular-downtown-tampa-mexican-restaurant-shut-down-for-22-hours-because-of-roaches 

Hopefully they've cleaned it up since then, but we haven't and will never return.

All you can eat sushi is a great value! Excellent service for those who choose to dine in. 

There is a koi fish tank. I kind of feel bad because it seems like too many fish for the tank size. Minus one star.
This is my favorite steakhouse, however I love their grilled chicken as well! Family owned and operated. The food is always delicious and served hot! Nice atmosphere, to either wine and/or dine!!

Came here a couple different times since opening and love it!! They still have some kinks to work out being as they've only been open for 3 weeks but it's still one of the best diners I've been to in awhile. (Much better then Hollywood Grill) There's so many different options so you can bring the whole house and they'll each find something to love the price isn't that bad either. Carri was so nice and attentive to us the whole time definitely my go to 202 diner following all Covid laws and offering takeout

Everything was excellent!!!!! This is definitely a hidden gem, tucked back in a little plaza.  The owners (I assume) were very nice and went out of their way to make us feel welcome.   The food was prepared fresh and everything tasted so good.  We will be back!

Very professional staff , state of the art facility .Good advice in general and thought for your health first . My only complaint is they do not take insurance , at least not from my last company and now delta so they are quite expensive . I haven't had bad work from them , I have gotten 'cosmetic ' estimates that were astronomical and not at all necessary - unless you want capped newscaster teeth , but the insurance is a big problem . 
They are double the price of all the dentists who participate within 25 miles . If they took my insurance still ( Dr. Patrick , the son did take delta for his 3 yrs there ) I'd still be a patient .
I'd check coverage first and get a second opinion ( they aren't dishonest to my experience - but the second price will be likely half of theirs ) before any costly procedures .
Today was our first time eating here. Very good food, and the atmosphere is nice too. We had potato pancakes & pierogis. So yummy. Highly recommend.

I don't like a super thick crust that is about about 5 stories tall, and all the pizza topping go to the center, and that's how they serve pizza here, so I am not reviewing that pizza, but I am reviewing my recent experience of a less than stellar Calzone 1 week ago. 

You know how they say when you are drinking mostly 2 or 3 star foods tastes like 4 or 5 star, we'll I wish this were the case, because what I got for $10 price ranges was mostly reheated chicken, a minimal appearance of artichoke hearts and mushrooms, but the bread was BIG as they do with their pizza. 

If you like bread than Pirate's is your place, I mean $10 for bread and some reheated chicken isn't my idea of anything stellar. You got to balance the toppings and fill the damn thing up! 

It looks like a ghost town in there, it really needs some help. 

The food was super slow to get too. 

It's not a place that I enjoy eating at, except the Mozzarella Sticks are THE BEST in TOWN, and I would give those 5 stars and recommend them HIGHLY. I wish I would have stuck my to plan and gotten those instead of that crappy calzone. I was super hungry and thought they would do a proper job, another $10 flushed way!
The girls who work here are super sweet, and the Pad Thai is amazing each and every time I order it! I love this place!
Ordered take-out... Buffalo Chicken Breadsticks, Grilled chicken quesadilla, Fried pickles.. and they were all fire!! Some of the best food in the area

I don't crave deep dish pizza but after going here I could see how some would. Cute place nice staff. Location okay. Parking lot near by. If you are feeling like it's a cheat day this is an amazing treat

They had an amazing drink and appetizer menu, so I was very excited for this restaurant, but I was greatly disappointed. The servers were not welcoming and neither were the hostesses, but I thought it was because they were semi busy. That was not the case. While we were sitting outside, it started raining and I was sitting in the half of the patio that was not covered. I'm quite confused to as why the patio was only half covered, if it rains a lot in this city. As I was getting poured on, the waitress did nothing to solve the problem until 3 minutes later when I brought it up. She then brought me to the back room and was not nice about it. I'm so sad, because I thought this would become one of my favorite restaurants. I loved the drinks and settings, but not the customer service.

Carlos is great. The only man who has all my numbers to reach me. I have been loyal since 09/1996, Labor Day Weekend, when he came to my rescue. I ,too, have an old BMW 1991( owned since 07/90) and he has taken car  since that time.. He is honest and to the point. He is my best friend in auto care. I have refered him to many. His staff is great. His shop is also a member of AAA with excellent ratings.******* Excellent!!!

This place is amazing! The staff is super friendly. I went in the morning before a conference started and got the trifecta and black coffee. Coffee is strong but it had my veins pumping! The trifecta came with the shrimp bengaloo, egg cochon, and st. charles. All three were delicious but the shrimp was my favorite. I was in a food coma after.
They overcharged me by $200 over the agreed and quoted price. Movers were not careful at all and several items were damaged.  Tried to reach out to the company but they haven't responded.

Over the last 17 years, I've taken 3 cats to Sugartown.  Our cats have always received outstanding care from all of the Sugartown staff.  I agree with the other reviewers about Dr. Prier's caring heart.  He is thoughtful, helpful, sensitive and sympathetic.  He's also deeply knowledgeable and interested in his craft.

Never go to the  DDD party cafe the owner is rude,disrespectful, shady and very unprofessional her service was awful and I don't recommend this place to no one I had my wedding  reception and she just ruined it with her bad attitude and service she lie about the contract she was more on making money then pleasing her clients very poor quality of service I rate this a no star because of the unprofessionalism due  bad interpersonal skills and horrible hospitality

I think NESCO has potential and I love that it's located so close to my office, however, after reading rave reviews of the Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich, I, of course, had to try it. However, I found that it was ENTIRELY too spicy. There was no balance of flavor. It tasted like someone dumped a whole container of ground cayenne pepper into the sauce that the sandwich was tossed with. It was even too spicy for my friend who also ordered the hot chicken sandwich and he loves spicy food. The fries were good and the crispiness of the sandwich on the fluffy potato roll would have made the sandwich delicious had it had some acid and salt mixed in with all that heat. My friend also ordered the special soup of the day, which was also covered in cayenne making the whole meal too hot to eat. 

The second time I visited, I got the brisket sandwich. The brisket was cooked perfectly, but again the seasonings were off. It needed some acid and something creamy like horseradish mayo or an aoili. The duck fries, however, were just like the old blue duck and worth every penny and the calories. 

I will give them another shot, maybe I'll do a burger next.

After moving into a less than sanitary apartment I was hiring a cleaning service at my landlord's expense. I called Kristina to explain what I wanted to have done and she came by that day to look at the place and quoted the job for $175. I was only having her clean the kitchen, bathroom, and stairwell, but those areas needed a lot of work! She came on time and brought all of her own supplies. The stairwell (which is not air-conditioned, and must have been very unpleasant to clean) was dusty and filled with dead cockroaches. The kitchen was covered in years of grime and crumbs. She moved both the electric stove and washer/dryer to clean behind and around them. Before steam cleaning the surfaces and appliances. She even took everything out of the fridge in order to clean it inside and out. The kitchen and bathroom both shine now that Kristina is done with them. She is extremely detail oriented and cleaned all types of things that I never would have even thought of! I was conveniently able to pay her through paypal. She was a pleasure to work with, I highly recommend her services!

If I could leave no stars I would. I stayed at this hotel as my friend had a wedding in their facility. To start the hotel overcharged us. We were told guests had an 109$ rate. We were charged 180$. When we complained the day of we were told 140$. Better but not good enough. 
The day of the wedding we were getting ready in the honeymoon suite and when I ran back to my room to grab something I found housekeeping cleaning our room. When I asked why she was there she said she thought the room was empty. Completely ignoring a wedding dress hanging from the window, our luggage on the bed and all our random personal items still in the bathroom and around the room. I asked her to leave and she argued with me. 
I went downstairs to ask the manager why there was someone cleaning our room when we had a late check out and he was confused as to why I was upset. Apparently cleaning a room before a guest checks out is par the course. I had to explain that the room would not be clean if I take a shower, jump in the bed, or lick the cups of my heart desired. I don't understand what was so hard to understand. A room being marked cleaned before being vacated is not okay. He said he'd talk to the staff. That was it. All I can think is that if this is the way they conduct their cleaning then this hotel is far from hygienic or clean. 
This was just the tip of the iceberg for a wedding where staff broke my friends wedding cake and served frozen pastry and desserts amongst many other issues I witnessed first hand. 
I will Never. Ever. stay at a Radisson after this experience because this hotel clearly has no idea what they're doing.

Where to begin..
I absolutely love this restaurant!!!!
The food is mouthwatering delishius, the service is professional and prompt, yet I never feel like I'm being rushed or bothered, and the ambience is just fantastic. Everything about their decor, from the maroon table cloths to the wooden art hanging from the wooden walls, just SCREAMS europe and more importantly; sophistication. I LOVE dining here. Whenever Im feeling a bit frisky I go to Continental Treat and the warm servers, the beautiful decor, and the smell of hot schnitzel make me feel less frisky and more happy!

This place has gone downhill, fast. With new management taking over at the end of the year, it was the worst thing to happen to this beautiful community. 
Living in an apartment is difficult as is. When you have a management company who makes simple tasks, such as paying rent an ordeal, or requesting maintenance to fix items that break with normal wear and tear and then they charge you for it, is just ridiculous! When you rent a place, especially in an apartment community, you expect them to maintain your apartment, not nickel and dime you! 
Good luck getting a call back from the property manager, or even a friendly smile. Walking into the office, you are met with attitude and feel like you are bothering them. 
Stay away from this place! I will be moving as soon as my lease expires, if not before; considering paying the fee to break the lease.

This is by far the best sushi I have ever had! The service is even better and the waiter Glen is absolutely awesome. Great prices for excellent, fresh food. The Gyoza, Miso soup, and philly roll is my personal favorite! Great location and great atmosphere. Please take my advice and eat here.
I highly recommend the Megan's Tuna Salad with the house dressing!  Every Saturday night we pick it up to eat at home!  What a treat!!!

Best Roast Beef Po-boys in New Orleans. Don't miss out on this experience.   Great fresh fries with brown gravy and cheese. Great service too.  Don't forget to read the menu of the history of this place and how the Po-boy got its name.

We usually go to the location at 96th St, but popped in here last week since we were in the area. The staff was super nice and quick about getting our order. They have hot dogs and sandwiches. My husband got a Philly and I got a hot dog. They have so many toppings and choices to really customize your hot dog. I am a big fan of the pretzel buns and love the chili and cheese!

Are you REALLY an Indianapolis resident if you haven't been to Goose the Market? Apparently I haven't really been a true Hoosier for the past 24 years because it took me until last weekend to stop into Goose.

I had heard rave reviews about the sandwiches and needed to experience this awesomeness for myself. The Goose sandwich did not disappoint. The bread was warm and perfect and the mix of the meat, basil, olive oil and cheese made for the perfect dinner. At first I thought the sandwich was a little small in size for the price point but when I was done eating I understood why - I was full. Not full enough, however, to end my meal with a gluten free peanut butter chocolate chip cookie from Three Birds.

I love the fact that Goose locally sources
the majority of their products. 

At this stage in my life I wouldn't personally stop in for any other reason than to grab a sandwich to go, but I can see the meat counter being popular with a different crowd.

Next time - definitely the gelato. The flavors in the case were unique and tempting.

Love love love to eat here. I have been a few times got something different each time and it has been great. Have not gotten anything I did not like. Always top my meal off with the funnel cake fries that strawberry top they put in it is the best. I could eSt a whole jar of that stuff it is sweet and a little hot. Every time my husband or friend wants to go out and eat and they ask where I want to go. Guess where I say. You got it The Kitchen Sink. Love it.

Tried both the turtle and All Shook Up... The former is packed with nuts and the latter is wonderfully packed with ripe banana... Get some, but due to the extreme richness, order a size smaller if you want your pants to still fit...

The food was amazing when we finally found where to sit. There is a bar on the 1st floor when you walk in and past that was a banquet area that had a private party which we were scolded for walking in on. when the bartender finally sent us upstairs it was all great. Service was great, waitress helped explain what everything on the menu was. The Portuguese style steak was one of the best meals my wife and I ever had. I highly recommend this for a nice romantic meal for couples.

We were here on August 25 on a day trip to Philadelphia. At first there was a sign on the door, "Be back in 5 min." We almost went elsewhere but a few minutes later she came back. Interestingly, we were not the only people waiting to get in. I can understand why. The woman who helped us was incredibly friendly and warm. The prices were fine but the big draw is the customer service. From reading the other reviews it looks like the woman who helped us is the owner, and she's probably the only employee, which explains why she has to close whenever she needs to take a lunch break. Her manner is direct which I think explains why some reviewers interpret her behavior as rude. I think she's cool and I will come back the next time I'm in Philly.

Went for one pair of boots, left with two! Make sure you get Courtney as your sales associate....super knowledgeable and has a great eye for matching the right boot with the right person. I've had boots before that rub or give me smelly feet. But the Lucchese's I bought here are amazing. My most comfortable pair of shoes, stylish and landing me loads of compliments. Thanks Courtney & Lucchese!!

Love, love, love Coppertail! Coppertail was recommended by a friend and I am so glad we stopped by. Parking is available out front (or in the grass outback if they are busy) and nicely located just outside ybor. (And close to ikea is you need to get some home decor done!) 

What sets this brewery apart from the others in the area are their bar tenders, they are amazing! Very knowledgable and can help your sort out their extensive list of beers. They make you feel right a home and you leave having a new friend! 

Overall a fantastic brewery and I can't wait for my next visit!
For a small bar restaurant, it's a hidden gem.  If you like grilled cheese sandwiches... this is the spot!

Went in on a Saturday night, a bit after 8.  Had a 15 minute wait, not too bad.  The bar is kinda bland, as is the decor.  There's booth seating mainly.  We got seated by the refrigerators in a corner/end booth table, kinda facing the folks next to us... Little bit awkward.  It was also kind of chilly, so we kept our jackets on.  
The wife doesn't drink beer, and we didn't know it was a BYO for wine. It was too late to run and grab a bottle of vino, so she had soda.  That was a downer, but our fault for not finding out before going.  
We each had the pub burger.  They were OK-- nothing earth shattering, but good.
Don't think I'd go back for dinner as prices were pretty high for the specialty items on the menu, considering the atmosphere was dull. I might  stop snd have a quick beer with a beer drinking friend, though.  Nice selection of beers you've never heard of, as well a decent tap selection.

Home away from home!  I had the "Pollo con Mole" it absolutely deliciously authentic. From the first bite it transported me to my Mexico lindo. You can feel the LOVE! If you have ever watched "Como agua para Chocolate (like water like chocolate)" and craved the mole when watching the movie, this is the place to come and eat.  It will not disappoint. By the way Cristina the founder and chef is Devine. Her story is inspiring, she is so sweet and welcoming.

I love the decor and ambiance of this small, but not crowded restaurant near Music Row.  We were seated at one of those big, spacious wooden tables.  The table felt warm to the touch which was pleasant on a chilly November day.  

My steak burrito was done perfectly.  But the side order of hash brown casserole was even more memorable.  It paired nicely with the mimosa and Bloody Mary which happened to be offered during Happy Hour while we were there for lunch, so quite a steal.  

The staff was prompt, friendly and very accommodating to our children.

Four of us had a fabulous lunch here today with outstanding service! The food was delicious! Mushroom soup, fried asparagus, bison burger, Rubin sandwich and Caesar salad with grilled blackened chicken....every bite was great! The service was A game and on point! Total experience was worth every dime!

Happy Hour is great here!

Best. Meatpies. Ever. 

Love the mixed drinks they offer.
One of my favorite tampa spots. Great food, beer, ambience

Village Bakehouse 

Bananas Foster French Toast on rich challah french toast topped with candied pecans was very sweet and tasty.

BYO Omelette with bacon, sausage and ham with toast and red potatoes was a good choice and was loaded with all the items at a reasonable $8.99

Chocolate Chip Pancake ale carte was a very good size which took up  the entire plate. 

Orange French Toast, french baguette dipped in buttermilk batter with orange zest served with fresh fruit definitely had a distinct taste of orange 

Probably the best items were their baked items, had the huge Cinnamon Roll and the awesome Cinnamon Crunch Roll warmed up.

Busy on a Saturday morning but was able to walk in and have a seat for 4.

Great reasonable prices, large portions and quick service with a large dining area outside with heaters

Stopped in this place while walking around the other day and not only do they have a nice selection of produce and organic foods, they also had a nice little deli where I grabbed my lunch for the day! Delish :)

My dad has been raving about this taco place for a while. I am a big taco lover so I am pretty picky. The place is being expanded and going to be really nice. $6 margaritas were a win. Ordered #15 that came with three tacos and rice and beans. The only thing I am upset about is using my calories up on rice and beans and not more tacos! Although the rice and beans were amazing, the tacos de carne asada were one of the best I have had. The meat was seasoned so well. Such good flavor in every bite. The best I have had in a while. I live in Orlando, my parents here in Brandon and I plan to make this my spot every time I come in for a visit. Service was great too. There was only one person there serving but we never had to ask for refills. She was on top of it all. Must try! Loved it!!!

I found this store, because was unsatisfied with Williams & Sonoma in Lakeside ! 
I like LeCreuset pots, and really like this store. Glad they reopened, both staff persons are very helpful. My husband and I have been there numerous times, very satisfied with their help.
    I love my pots & pans, I wished I had gotten them twenty years sooner! My husband has taught me how to cook,with them! He had them in the past and loved them. I have completely replaced all of my old cookware. I even like the TEA mugs, for my coffee now. 
I also now order from LeCreuset.com. 
Well pleased, thank you for good products,

I was wanting to visit a local place while in Nashville. We stumbled upon this place and was expecting something mediocre. I am of Thai decent so I lowered my expectations a bit for a Thai American place.To my surprise, the food was pretty true to taste/seasoning. My boyfriend loved his dish and I was pretty fond of mine . My only complaint would be that their spice level is off. They have a 1 to 5 level and I asked for a 4 and there was not a lick of spicy in it . The service was decent and the food was good. Sushi may be a little over priced for the variety. I'd still reccomend it though

I had reservations about shopping at this location, but I must say the staff all around are very friendly and helpful.  I usually don't leave comments unless the service is horrible. Myself and my family have made this CVS our go to drug store and every staff member up front gives a warm welcome upon entry. They have new faces ( Whitney ) and  ( Dan) and they put the C in customer service. Its really nice to not have to pay for kindness thank you Whitney

Just found this newly opened place and are we happy. Plenty of variety and everything is fresh.
A nice outgoing staff.  This is the best Chinese
food we have found in Tucson.
I liked the agua frescas a lot. Food was good, but a little pricey. Staff is really friendly and helpful with suggestions. They don't take credit cards, but they have no cork fees.

It's unfortunate that this is a cool place other than the bartenders! Food is decent, good beer selection, and plenty of entertainment.
However, that said, the service at the bar is some of the worst I've ever gotten. There are a few guys who have been there too long, hate the world, or maybe just their job.  (a coupe of tattooed bearded men) have terrible attitudes. I even complained to a staff member at the desk, and he replied "yeah, we know, they're terrible, we get it all the time" well if that is the case maybe they should fire them all and start over with the bar staff. Just a suggestion from a local patron. Or ex-patron.

One star is far to high to rate this business.  I just went through Apsco to address my ice machine not making ice. Casey the tech who came out to my home spent no more that 5 minutes, only looking at my ice machine and 4 of those minutes were on the phone getting me a quote for a new ice machine. My fridge is 1.5 years old, it shouldn't need a new ice machine. Needless to say Apsco did not repair my ice machine, charged me $59.00 to only give me a quote for $230 + tax to replace my current ice machine. I would STAY FAR AWAY FROM APSCO unless if your looking for lazy workers and really interested in spreading hundreds of dollars!

This is the KING OF DOG BEACHES!  Since there are zero dog beaches in Los Angeles we always hit up Arroyo Burro when heading North on the 101. Large parking lot that was nearly full on a November Saturday at 11:30am -- but we waited and found a spot. FREE by the way!
After a short walk you head to the left as that is the off-leash area which goes at least a half mile where you can take a walk and watch your lucky pup at play. Tide was out so lots of room for running. "Daisy" had the time of her life and got soaked. They do have a restaurant but it's NOT DOG FRIENDLY!  What's up with that -- don't they want the extra business?  Patio is huge so why not divide it up and have a section for dogs? (Ok, owners can come too). 
Instead we drove 5 minutes South on Cliff Drive and found this fantastic Vegan place called Mesa Verde where doggies are welcome on their patio.

Quiet, open, clean, and, most of all, delicious. Breakfast is no-frills (except for the delicious rosemary cheese grits), but satisfying, well-prepared, and served in perfect portions. The coffee is hot, the service is friendly, and you don't have to crawl over everyone else around Bourbon Street if you're in town for the weekend to party.

As a native Chicagoan I have to say the pizza is on point. It's like a cross between Chicago deep dish and a New York slice - my friend and I were pleasantly surprised! We tried pizza from a few places nearby and were not impressed.

The restaurant itself is cozy yet spacious, and it feels like you're in someone's well maintained home. The owner is very friendly and inviting. He is also quite knowledgeable of Nashville so it was a bonus chatting with him as an out-of-towner. 

I highly recommend swinging by after some shopping in the nearby area or after a couple of cocktails from the Saloon across the street.
Food is reasonably priced , authentic New Orleans flavor ! Would deff recommend stopping by and giving it a taste for yourself ;)

The Chef JJs beer pairing dinners used to be my favorite events in the city. I don't remember the Chef's name, but he got poached by Sun King. He used to talk about how he would only work with breweries that would put 12 solid beers in front of him and let him pick his favorites. There were usually special beers you couldn't find elsewhere. Now, it's the most boring, popular beers in the brewery's repertoire. 

I have gone at least four times since this change seems to have happened. Tonight, they paired an IPA with halibut. Jesus. Really? I have one more reservation. If it isn't fixed, I'm done. $200 for Applebee's and some mediocre IPAs and summer styles is absurd. It makes me sad. These used to be beer nerd events. Now, it's Coors Light drinkers.

This is my favorite casual pizza place in Philadelphia. They have signature pizzas that are delicious as well as options to fully customize your own pie. You can make a salad as well for the healthy eats! I suggest the Bianco Verde. Must try this place!!

Nice spot for people watching as well as good food.  Seafood raviolis were awesome as recommended from the waiter. I had a couple of nice drinks and overall not bad at all for cruising around and wanting a sit down lunch.

I chose this location based on the availability of cars...but won't make that mistake again. I actually will likely not rent from enterprise again. I rented a car to drive to Florida...a 17 hour trip with two kids. Seemed like a nice newer car. They didn't give us that "free" upgrade that they promise...but the car was fine. The car had two "lighter" plugs and one USB. One of the lighter plugs was used for my GPS since I have never made this drive before and needed to rely on it. When our phones started to die we plugged into the USB port only to find out it wasn't working. So we had a lighter charger and plugged that into the other lighter port...again to find out it wasn't working. So I am on a 17 hour trip now with two children and no way to charge my phone and use my GPS at the same time.

When I got to my destination...I called the enterprise that was about 10 minutes from where we were staying. They informed me that if I had an issue with the car and wanted to turn it in, I would have to drive 1 to 1.5 hours out of my way to an airport to exchange the car. Never even considering the safety of the driver or passengers not having a phone in case of an emergency.

When I turned the car I told them what had happened and they also felt is was no big deal. Unfortunately I didn't feel the same way. I was driving through the night, through states, cities, etc. that I did not know without a phone or a GPS...I would have to decide at the time which to use if I needed one. 

Enterprise is supposed to be the rental place that "picks you up" yet no one offered to come exchange the car for us. They just made the experience more and more of a hassle. They did give me a whole 10% off the bill after I complained and said I would not use them again. Wow.

I'm not sure if what happened was just a fluke because the girl I was dealing with at Bridge happened to be an idiot, or if this is truly the case all the time; if it is indeed something that will work all the time, I am very happy because the gift certificates that I purchased with my student ID at Drexel University (for $7.75/each) got me into the 3D showing of the newest Shrek movie (3D movies running something like $15/each). I'll test this out soon enough, but for now I'm pretty psyched at the possibility of getting to watch 3D movies for so little.

By the way, I have found it impossible to find showtimes for this place. Whenever you Google the place, it takes you to a website that tells you about the showtimes for the Bridge in California. And Yahoo! Movies apparently doesn't even consider this place to be a movie theater, because it doesn't even show up on there. So I've usually found myself just walking past this place at a time when I'm free with friends and we just decide on a whim to watch a movie.

edit: I figured out why I couldn't find The Bridge on Yahoo! movies... It's because it's now referred to as Rave Motion Pictures University City. The more you know. You're welcome.

This place is owned by the same people that owned kebab bq in the university district, By far, this is my favorite Indian restaurant . The food is consistently delicious and leaves you wanting more. Worth the trip up Oracle !

The poke bowls are amazing. I get one three times and week because the ingredients are healthy fresh and tasty. I have tried the octopus, salmon, ahi, seared ahi and hamachi. They do a build your own bowl so you can customize it with white or brown rice, kale or quinoa as the base, pick your fish then choose from an array of fresh toppings like pickled ginger, carrots, cucumbers, mango or seaweed salad. If that's not enough you also can pick from 7 different sauces like ponzu, spicy ponzu or sesame oil. Crazy good and only $12. Seems like a lot but it's a solid portion size. They will let you sample different things and the staff is super friendly.

The work performed was absolutely perfect!  They transformed a cloth interior to leather and added a headliner that made the car as good as new.  I  would advise anyone who is keeping a car or truck with a tattered interior to get an estimate from them and consider doing it as a holiday gift for a family member.  You will never feel better about the time you spend in the vehicle (and God knows we all spend more time there than we want to!) after upgrading the interior! The work they did was FIRST CLASS!

Our tour guide extremely knowledgable and funny, and this ended up being one of my favorite parts of the entire trip.  We learned about not only the tombs and people buried in the cemetery (Number 1) but also had a great quick summery of New Orleans history.  We also love that the money goes back to helping preserve the cemetery.  Bring water, comfortable shoes, an umbrella, and sunscreen!

Yes, we are health freaks, but really... they have probably the best burgers and fries I've had.  I rarely eat red meat... let alone with a side of deep-fried potatoes... but I will stretch to make excuses to eat here ("I was in Vegas all weekend and still need to soak up the alcohol.... I went to the gym everyday this week, my body probably needs protein...").  Hey, I didn't say they were good excuses.

I tried the turkey burger once, which is usually my go to if I'm craving a burger... but I say, splurge for the classic cheeseburger and fries.  This is a once-a-year treat, but so worth the wait!

This pub is close to my house, so I go time to time. Their food is decent- the norm pub food. However their burgers I would say are above average. Loaded- huge and very filling. I have yet to finish one. I will say they have pretty good pizza too, but it does take awhile for them to make. 

The atmosphere is pretty relaxed, always pretty steady in there. 
I will say that the manager is very nice- My boyfriend and I happened to be there on a Tuesday evening and they have trivia night, which we weren't aware of...Alot of regulars come out for this from what I could tell. The manager came around and told us about it and asked if we were interested, we had nothing planned so we stayed for it. I can't say that we were pros at trivia, but the manager helped us, probably because we were new, and it just so happened that with a little help we won! $50 GC to come back. We have been since a few times- enjoyed it each time. 

I will say that there is one waitress/bartender that I am not fond off, just isn't very friendly like the rest. You could even say border line rude.

This place is awful.  I am definitely too old to appreciate the "youthful vibe" and the lack of furniture.  We are in a giant, really weird, corner room.  719. There is no chair, no place to put a suitcase or lay out your clothes.  There is some big bean bag thing in a bag.   The TV and remote is old.  The windows are really dirty.  No counter space in the bathroom.  It's $249 per night with $28 parking, valet or self is same price.  Nothing around here.  I won't be using Expedia ever again.  I've stayed in many hotels all over.  This is the worst ever and a giant rip off. Get the idea I hate this place?

The food was less than desirable. We ordered shrimp for appetizers and calamari as well. Not only was the shrimp batter severely soggy and greasy, the calamari was extremely bland as well. Our entrees were tasteless. Not to mention when we took the soggy breading off our shrimp, the shrimp had its fecal matter still inside *puke*.
 I wouldn't recommend. I usually don't write reviews but this just really wasn't that great. Only thing that was good was the breadsticks and wine. Perhaps the chef was having an off day? I'm not sure but definitely won't be back. Our server Sarah however, was extremely pleasant, she also took the shrimp appetizer off our bill

This place is a one and done. Tacos are expensive and pretty basic. Seating is horrible.  You eat in the dirt and  smell of the sewer . Lots of homeless walking threw the alley but HEY IF YOUR FROM MIDTOWN YOU'LL PROBABLY LOVE IT.

Tried this place because of the pictures of the ceviche. The ceviche was tasty for sure but they were light on the serving. We happened to walk in right as they were opening, don't know if that had anything to do with it. Also had small ostras frita (fried oysters) - these were super tasty! This seemed like a cool little place , I would def try them again !

Taqueria Pico de Gallo's veggie burrito has earned it a special place in my heart. Filled with beans, greenery and who knows what else, it's a great cheap lunch in colorful South Tucson, and the guy who has been working there for years is so nice! One problem....as of early 2008, something has changed in the veggie burrito recipe which results in an unappetizing oil dribble as soon as you reach the halfway point; both my friend and I found this to be the case. I have no idea what it is but it makes me sad. I hope it changes back or was a temporary problem, 'cause that's just gross.

Friends have raved about the various meat taco and burrito offerings, and they do look great. The hot carrots, purple onions and mysteriously compelling hot sauce are fun complements to the food; however, a meal at the taqueria is not complete without the pico de gallo, a plastic cup packed with tropical fruit slices and topped with lemon juice and red pepper powder. Yes, I know it sounds strange. Try it anyway. There's not much better than a chilly, tangy pico de gallo on a hot Sonoran afternoon. Throw in a really fantastic monsoon and we're all set.

I worked in a retail store and once a year the company would do a massive clean up of inventory. Ever wonder what happens to the clothes that just don't sell? The dumpster. (Background story :sad but true, retailers don't want to risk people trying to "return" the clothes for cash, we fixed this by slashing though the brand name with a sharpie so we would know if someone tried) Something just did not sit right with me to throw away 14 boxes of perfectly good unworn clothes. Lacking a truck, I made a phone call to Bridge House and they happily came and picked it up from my location and were so grateful for the donation. The clothes were out of my storage room and off to better use. Where there is a will, there is a way.
Outstanding - it's expensive and worth every penny. Order their house specialty. It has melted cream cheese in it and I was apprehensive however it exceeded all expectations. Awesome sandwich !!!!!
This place has everything! It would have garnished a 5 star if the beer was a little colder but I am a big fan!

Great place to eat. I eat here all the time. Great food for even better pricing. In Philly the prices are higher and I would rather go here to eat since it is better with quality and price. The atmosphere is average but the service is good. I would definitely recommend to everyone.

Finch & Fork! What a cool name, but the food was definitely a letdown for me. I came here for brunch on a Saturday afternoon.  Finch & Fork is located within the Canary Hotel.  Parking is a little hard to spot, but there is a lot next to the hotel.  I made reservations, so it was a breeze to get seated.  I came at the earlier part of brunch so there wasn't a lot of people, but I could see it start filling up as I was there. 

I looked through the menu (brunch menu is a little limited) and decided on the 2 eggs, toast, bacon and potatoes.   Once I ordered, I looked down at my cup and it was dirty with leftover food. Yikes.  I requested a new cup.  My friend mentioned that the water tasted weird, so I tried some and it definitely had a weird plastic taste.  I think this might have been due to the unclean cups.  I didn't try to drink from the cups for the rest of the meal and I have to admit I was a little wary of the food due to the uncleanliness of the water cups. 

Once the food came out, I have to say I was rather disappointed in the food itself.  I ordered my eggs over medium and it was definitely overcooked.  I also tried some of my friend's poached eggs, which was also way overcooked.  The toast, bacon, and the potatoes were all average.  With other options for brunch in SB, I definitely recommend going somewhere else. Definitely a disappointing experience for a restaurant with a cool name.

I am going to a dentist who graduated from Temple and so very sorry that I started with her.  Before they let cretins in at Temple they should at least require that they be able to READ and are not DEAF.  I discussed my case with her in detail about what I wanted and even gave her a WRITTEN reminder before she began the work.  She went and did the exact opposite in a way no competent dentist would have.  TOO MANY DENTISTS ARE STUPID AND UNQUALIFIED AND THEY KNOW IT.  Unfortunately the patient does not find out until AFTER THE FACT.  Protect yourself by demanding references if you are having any level of involved work done.  If the dentist refuses go else until you find one who is not ashamed of his "work."

Ok this place is really cheap. Casual dinner for 4 is around $40-$50, are you kidding me!? Sometimes I wonder how they make money considering everything is going up in prices. Anyway it's not my problem.

If I were to rate Nam Phuong in term of prices, I would rate 5 stars along with Checkers ($3 for 2 double chili cheese burger!? You can't beat that).

BUT I prefer to rate on the basis of their food, and on that basis I give them 3. And I tell you why I give them a 3.  Their Pho, Hu Tieu, or other noodle soups here suck!?  If you in a mood for a quick eat don't go here. Dinner dishes is where this place shines. My favorite are the fried fish and sour soup. They also offer a variety of vegetarian dishes which is nice.

On other note, I recently heard that they change ownership, their owner who was also their head chef is no longer there. This could be a good thing or a bad thing, not really sure. I do know that they will increase the price slightly though.

Last night 5 of us had a wonderful fathers day meal at Mark Pi's in Carmel.  We were promptly seated and immediately waited on.  We ordered an egg roll, spring rolls, and crab Rangoon to share.  All were very good. Entree's included lettuce wraps, Classic,Szechuan, Pea Pods with beef, Shrimp Tempura, and vegi Lo Mein. Everyone loved their entree's.  

We have been getting carry out and eating at Mark Pi's since it was in Nora.  The Carmel location is a go to place for us.   Not sure why some of the more negative reviews - we have always had good food / good service

I've had breakfast and brunch here numerous times and felt that the food was pretty good, but I just had the most amazing dinner! I ordered the salmon special, which came with asparagus, redskin potatoes, portobello mushrooms, and lemon cream sauce with chives. It was just perfect: the potatoes crispy, the sauce rich and delicate and lemony at the same time. Mushrooms were super delicious and salmon cooked just right. I also had a bowl of some of the best clam chowder I've ever had (and typically I won't even bother with clam chowder if I'm not actually in New England). The cream was so fresh; there was something very special about this soup. It was just inspired. They went far beyond the expectations of a decent cup of clam chowder.

A great place to take out of town guests. While you're digesting, you can walk around the kitschy gift shop, where you'll find a million objects that you could live without, but will still amuse you.

Even though we were completely full from dinner, the cashier pointed out that, as it was after 8, the pastries were half price, and we split a lovely "homemade oreo" (two cakey cookies held together with a cream cheese frosting). Yum. The lemon cookies looked great too, but we didn't want to go overboard.

Best po boy in town! I came here for the shrimp po boy off a recommendation from a friend and it was the best I found around town. The shrimp was extremely soft and fell apart as I bit into it which was really nice and they stuffed so much in there it was overflowing with deliciousness.

The vibes at this place were also great!

My best friend took me here as a surprise for my birthday! I love giving back to the community and I absolutely flipped when I read the purpose for setting up this restaurant. 

For an appetizer we tried the fully loaded baked fries! AMAZINGGGGG!!! The fries were to die for. The fact that they were baked with no fried skin on the outside made me feel a little better about the lovely bacon and cheese that I devoured that were on top of them. On to the main course I tried their Got the Blooz burger that is topped with Bleu cheese, mayo, grilled onion, tomato, lettuce and bacon. If you would like to see what heaven taste like you should try this burger. All of the ingredients play so well together and the burger was huge and they are severed inside a wheat bun. My friend had their Veggie Burger made with Cannelloni and pinto beans, rice flour,  celery, onion and carrot with Monterrey Jack Cheese. She couldn't speak with the amount of flavorful goodness that was in her mouth. 

For drinks I had one of there many flavors of tea and decided on the fruit tea. I am not normally a tea drinker but I tried it because I don't drink soda. It taste like a mixture of strawberries and peaches, it was simply amazing and I actually got a refill.

The staff was very nice and attentive to all of our needs! The most amazing part about the experience is that I knew that the food was fresh because after we left I didn't feel sluggish after eating!

I suggest everyone experience the cookery not just for the amazing cause but truly because they have AMAZING food!

Sure, I'll go 5 stars on this one.  I went to the north location and was quite pleasd.  I wasn't in the mood for a Sonoran hot dog but I'm tempted to try one next time.  I did get the medium carne asada burro and was very glad I didn't get the large.  I opted for the cabbage and beans as well (turns out it comes inside the burro, not on the side) but barely noticed it.  The burro was plenty big and absolutely jammed full of delicious beef.  No shortage of sodium but frankly who cares when it's this good.  The salsa bar also included grilled peppers and an assortment of pickled stuff, all good!  My only wish was that I could have a cold cerveza with my burro but the Mexican origin Coca Cola was a good compliment.  I'll go back!

Pineapple espresso is a great local alternative to "big box" drive through coffee places like Dunkin or Starbucks. They also have a healthier selection of goods. Service is always very fast and efficient and everything is delicious. Keep St. Pete local by checking this place out!
Good prices, best in west Philly. They don't stay open extra late like others and they open later also. Wings are great.

Kim is the best! 

After having my hair butchered by a previous stylist, I avoided salons like the plague! 
I finally decided to give Tantra a try and was lucky enough to have Kim as my stylist. She always listens to what I want, and the color is always great!

As far as renting a car goes this Avis location made it very easy. Staff at the desk were very friendly and accommodating. I came in late on a flight and since it was the end of the day and I was renting a car for about 18hrs the employee behind the desk gave me the option of pretty much any car on the lot with no additional charges. I asked him to give me whatever he thought would be best and I ended up walking out with the keys to a convertible Chevy Camaro SS. It was a fun car to drive for the day and really made the whole trip a little more exciting.

Moved here from the French Quarter because we had an early flight to catch the next morning and the price was right. While my stay and room wasn't as disastrous as some of these other Yelp reviewers (OMG the holes in the ceiling would've been the last straw for me!), there was one huge problem with the room that I can't overlook. 

So this place has those damn motion sensor air conditioning units. Usually Hilton properties have the Inncom brand thermostats which are easy to override to a VIP setting (just Google it) so you can disable the motion sensor and keep your room cool. This Garden Inn had an Amana brand that you can't disable. I'm sorry, in hot and humid New Orleans, I should be able to have my a/c running nonstop if I choose. It is not acceptable to have the temperature reset to 74 degrees at night. I woke up multiple times drenched in sweat. Who can sleep in a 74 degree room? 

Other than the a/c issue I was just fine here. The rooms are comfortable enough (except for the outrageously warm temperature) and the staff was friendly (though not polished in the least). My room had a useful small refrigerator, microwave and Keurig coffee maker in it. Lots of free parking if you have a rental car, and off the beaten path a bit so there's not a lot of traffic or noise. As a diamond level Hilton Hhonors member I was handed a big chocolate chip cookie at check-in which was nice (it wasn't that great, Doubletree is the master at the check-in cookie, but I still appreciated the friendly gesture). 

I would never, ever stay at this property again, and it's a true blemish to the Hilton chain. I should've refused to pay my bill because I think a hotel should offer basic amenities in their room rate: a shower, toilet, running water, bed and a COOL ROOM! So beware if you are hot natured: go ahead and cancel your reservation and look elsewhere, because you will be MISERABLE here.

Showed up at 11:20 AM on a weekday that they said they were open. Closed sign in the window and no message on their voicemail saying they'd be closed during posted hours. Real bummer to not eat on lunch hour.

Really good vegan restaurant.  I think they grow their own veggies.  They always have fresh flowers on the table. Everyone is friendly.  They use paper biodegradable straws.  And most importantly the food is good.  The hummus tray is good. I have had the Frida burger and it was excellent.  And you must try the avocado chocolate raspberry mousse.

I have been coming to this salon for many years. Everyone that works here is super nice and always accommodating. While many people may have a different experience, I disagree with some of the reviews of this salon. For everyone complaining about the wait, schedule an appointment. It's that simple. They have new chairs, which are very relaxing. After every pedicure, the lining in the pedicure bowl is changed. They also use disposable tools for an additional charge. The owner is personable, always asking about my family and how I'm doing. There is minimal turnover here and most of the ladies have been here for a long time. Linh offers eyelash extensions here and her work is immaculate. Unique Nails is the best salon in Tampa and deserves 5 stars!

A great open space that is flexible for any event you would want. There are two drawbacks to this place. 1. There are two large columns in the middle of the large room that makes seeing the stage difficult. It blocks about 1/4 of the room. If you're there for a festival like event where the stage isn't the focal point, it's great because it's easy to circulate around. 

The back room has the fully stocked bar. The bathrooms are always clean and with a lot of stalls, so you never have to wait too long to go to the bathroom during a big event.  They even have a little tray table stocked with hair spray etc and mints for your use.

Amazing service. Amazing food. We had no idea what some of the menu items were and our server did a great job of breaking it down for us and making it more accessible ("so-and-so is basically just a fancy word for _____.") Can't wait to return!
Went there yesterday - This was the best pie I've ever tasted aside from my mothers!  Highly recommend.  The next time I throw a dinner party, I know where I'm placing an order for dessert!

Stayed here with my wife and have no complaints at all. On check in they stored our luggage until the room was ready, and booked a cab for us on check out. In between everything was great. We had a balcony overlooking the street and about a block from Bourbon street. The room was recently refurbished and in great shape. Plenty of water pressure and hot water. Staff was friendly and accommodating. Finally, the restaurant downstairs is great at least for breakfast. We ate there all four mornings had something different everyday and was never disappointed. Check my other reviews I don't give 5 stars very often, if back in NOLA I would stay here again.

Ruby Tuesday, Ruby Ruby Tuesday.

Oh, how I wish there were more of you closer to home. 

Your biscuits. Your salad bar. Your drinks.

I was stuck between the New Seafood Mixed Grill and the Parmesan Shrimp Pasta... but I knew I wanted to get my $3 worth for the add-on salad bar so I ordered something I knew would be fine as reheats. Pasta it is!

THOSE BISCUITS!! So delicious. I'd never had them before. I don't know if it's a good thing--I'd eat these things like Skittles if I could. Herby, garlicky goodness. MAN!!

The salad bar--it's so good. I don't know what it is... the choice selection isn't mind-boggling. Maybe it's just really fresh? Whatever it is, my spinach salad with lots of goodies was FANTASTIC. Three times over.

The non-alcoholic drink selections were nice, too. I got a Watermelon Fizz--it was like I was drinking the juice out of the rind. Very refreshing. 

This location was very on top of it--They saw our large party coming and started setting up our tables before we set foot in the door. 

Hopefully the nearest location (45 minutes away!) is as good as this one.

This is definitely my favorite pizza place in town. Visiting family and this place is a must eat at least twice in the week we are here, great dough on the pizza amazing homemade sauce and meatballs my mouth is watering for it again, don't miss out its fantastic, great staff, very friendly employees

The people running the pharmacy couldn't run a lemonade stand. If you are in urgent need of medication do yourself a favor and start working on a cure yourself. It'll be faster than waiting on the pharmacists to figure out how to do their job. If you're a veteran, just drive an hour into Philly, drive by the VA, and then drive right off a cliff. It'd be faster and more reliable than picking up medication at the pharmacy. Veterans aren't welcomed here and are treated like villains. The people working at the pharmacy do not care about your well-being. They are rude, moronic, communist hippies. When, not if, because they for sure will, but when they make a mistake, they will blame you and give you a rude condescending attitude. You will get better customer service at the DMV or Port Authority. These people should be working helping hands at Wegmans, not running a pharmacy.
Good food, great lime cilantro rice, but noone seems to know how to roll a burrito that doesn't fall apart
Ordered pizza, wings, and prosciutto & mozzarella sandwich.  They delivered.  It was ok.  Sandwich was soggy.  Wings were ok - their medium is HOT.  Wouldn't order again but we were starving.

I visited this airport for the first time this week.  It seemed like your standard airport but the thing that stood out for me regarding this airport were the overwhelming number of gates and the amount of walking to get to them.  I had to look at my ticket a few times to verify that my flight was really at gate C30 and it was indeed a long walk to get to that 30th gate.

Walking within F terminal was no fun either as it seemed like a long hallway.

Fortunately, there is a decent selection of restaurants scattered throughout.

Yo, yo let'me get more dat jerk chick-chick baby cheeks. Ok, so here is the low down ball stank on this place: This is a order take-out sorta joint, all though you can dine inside at a few of their tables, but when I'm going full chow on some jerky chicken I like to strap the feed bag on in my own crib, you feels me? So get the large , cause that gets you basically a giant portion of jerk chicken (or meat of your choosing) and rice. They do add like a small serving of plantains or cabbage on top, but it so small you could miss it. They gave me extra some oxtail sauce and jerk sauce, both of which were delightful. I will return soon, hope to fart on you there.

Best haircut ever with Amber, in such a relaxing atmosphere! This salon is my favorite place. I know in this pandemic we are stuck at home and we are doing alot of zoom... a lot of ponytails!! I go here just to feel good about my self and know when I walk out that I feel pretty.. even in these depressing times it's nice to take care of your self. And, I KNOW I am safe here. 
The entire staff is so fabulous.. The owner has always been so nice to me and my daughter, and I really appreciate her kindness. 

They are VERY serious about your health and safety, from the products they use, to the actions they take to protect you from Covid-19.  The owner, Julie, is absolutely committed to protecting you from the virus. What a nice set up that she's created to protect you!! 

I go in for haircuts and color and know that the color I get is not harmful to me, as she uses organic products. I will go in for wash and blow-dry just so my hair looks nice for quite a few days.. I always thought that blow-outs were reserved for the "older generation" .. but not true!! it makes my life so easy! and I know that they are drying it without creating the heat damage that I do!! Also, their blow-outs look so much better than my home job.. Thanks Robin for making my hair look so great last time.. 4 days and counting!! And thanks for taking me in at last minute as a WALK-IN!.. I had to wait a couple of minutes, but no biggie.. I did some shopping for some gifts right in the salon.. very cute, sustainable, and local gifts.. I like to buy ahead and have it available for gifting.. 
I know the nail products are really nice.. my daughter uses them and it looks so nice. so, this salon will be my go to for a LONG time.. 

But the real reason I am writing this is because my sister was in town... she decided to do her own covid at home haircut... not terrible.. but we had to fix it up a little.. Amber did an AMAZING JOB.. Thank you so much for making my sister look sooooooo great.. what a boost to her self esteem!! before and after photos attached!!

I've never had a bad meal here. Usually I get the Pad Thai with chicken, but today I tried the Yaki Udon with chicken since it's highly recommended by other reviewers. It's so good. Definitely my new favorite. 

This place is clean and has great, fast service. They also play very eclectic music which I like.

I was in the area having dinner and wanted caramel cake. When I checked yelp, this bakery came up. 
The style of the bakery is really cute and upscale. It has a throwback look, like a parlor and everyone that works there, dresses in the same manner. You have the option to eat your dessert on site or take it to go. Reservations are suggested, especially during Covid. You can also have a tea party at the bakery as well, I'm sure that would be super cute for little girls or a GNO. 
Sadly, they didn't have caramel cake that night. I ended up getting a lemon bar and piece of millionaire cake. The lemon bar was soooo good! The millionaire cake wasn't bad, but I wouldn't order it again, I mainly got it because it had caramel and chocolate in it.
Keep in mind it is an upscale place, and the prices are upscale as well! But the portions are HUGE, so the prices aren't far off.
I definitely will come back to try the caramel cake, when they have it again.
Always fun to bring friends here - can be really crowded sometimes but that is part of the experience!  From raw honey to donuts to grilled cheeses you can find everything here!

Used to be when you walked into a Cracker Barrel and there were just a few people, they would walk you to a seat away from everyone else , now today there were like five couples sitting arm to arm in one row , doubtless to make it easier for wait staff , it reminds me of an incident earlier this week where a paying customer and doctor no less was forcibly removed from a plane so employees could take his seat, there is a huge problem in this country when the people working for a paycheck are more important than those paying said paycheck, it has been painfully obvious in government institutions from the whitehouse to the courthouse for over 20 years , now it is becoming more apparent in private business across this country, the quality of my food also clearly reflected this same attitude that my happiness was second to staff and management, I am very close to placing Cracker Barrel in the same lot with a couple of fast food chains I have excluded from ever getting another one of my dollars to support the thoughtless, stupid and the lazy ,, that's what I pay a 38 percent tax rate for, if you don't want to serve get out of the service industry, if you don't want to work go home and draw .

Some of the worst food I've had in manayunk. Couldn't get our order even remotely correct. No dressing on theirs wraps and they come with a couple of chips, literally. So many better options in the area don't make this mistake like we did...

Happy hour is from 3 to 7. Appetizers are half off, drinks are cheap, servers are laid back, service can be a little slow at times but this is definitely one of my favorite happy hour spots and by far the best place to start off to a great night ;)

Tried the buffet.  Good variety.  Not cookie cutter.  Pizza crust is tasty.  Some fresh herbs on the pizza would be a nice addition to add a little flavor, some things were slightly bland. 

Will def be back to check out other options besides the buffet.  

They had some English dishes that I would be keen to try.
Everything on their menu is gluten free- dream restaurant for those who avoid gluten. Delicious variety. Tried two items but will be back!

Came into Kin for a table of 4 and didn't make a reservation. We luckily got in before the reservations started coming. I would definitely recommend for future customers to make reservation as I'm sure this restaurant will end up being always packed. 

The atmosphere is small and quaint along with superb service. The dishes were decadent but light. I didn't feel like I needed to take a nap afterwards, rather go do something active. Their dishes were creative and each had its own character. I look forward to trying their other dishes. Overall, the food was fantastic. I'm pretty excited to see what they come up with once they get their alcohol license. 

Dishes
-Brussel sprouts and cherries 
-Hamachi Crudo (Day Special) 
-Pork Belly and Slaw
-Game Hen 
-Duck Confit 
-Mushroom pasta 
-Lamb with sugarcane

Met friends and went to one our favorite places -- Firebirds.  I'm not one to complain however we were sitting in the bar area and there was a six top with very obnoxiously loud females who were laughing and screeching at the top of their lungs.  It was impossible for us to enjoy ourselves and noticed other patrons were bothered as well, since these screeching girls made it impossible for anyone to even have a conversation.  We had to scream to hear ourselves talk.  The entire bar area looked annoyed.  When we received our first drink we asked our waitress Ashley for the bill and told her that we we were leaving because of the extremely loud obnoxious table.  She commented that she understood and felt the same way.  Not one manager went to the six top to quiet the girls down, instead we saw the bar tenders bringing them more drinks to them.  Unfortunately Firebirds missed out on a profitable bill and our waitress lost out on a great tip because they catered to loud obnoxious females.

We had an outstanding experience this week. Very professional, friendly, efficient and the best movers I have ever worked with. The came in exactly on estimate. Great care was given to all our belongings and I would use them again in a heartbeat.

This Store has gone down hill. They do not know how to handle there inventory levels and the manufacturer that makes their products must not know what they are doing because my bed has been delayed twice and when i call in all that I get is there is nothing we can do. I truly loved this place and so does my whole family, but after this experience.. I think my days of shopping here are over unfortunately. I understand COVID has caused issues but at a certain point that excuse gets old. It has been 3 months and counting. They should do right by their customers and expedite shipments for customers that have been waiting this long.

My group of 9 had a great time at The Pharmacy. We were able to put a name down and have a beer while we waited. The estimated wait time was 1 hour and 20 minutes, but we were seated in 40 which was great. We ordered chicken, beef (burgers), falafel and fish burgers among all of us, and there were no complaints! Great service and an awesome price. PS if you're a fan of sweet potatoes, the sweet potato fries are a must-try side.

The good - five stars for the pleasant ambiance and live singer. She was the best! The Cure cover of "Lovesong" was phenomenal! 

The not so good - ZERO stars for the food! Fillet minion was incredibly bland. I actually had to add some salt that's how bland it was. The asparagus on the side was undercooked also very bland. Was it so difficult to add just a little hint of some kind of seasoning?

The so called garlic mashed potatoes had way too much dairy (buttermilk or milk) it was actually quite disgusting and I've never ever used this word about any restaurant food. Our waitress would repeat every word we say back to us only 10 times louder for some reason, some attitude issues as well when we took time to order. 

The desert was served in the shot glass which was nice, but again didn't live up to the presentation. It felt like it has been defrosted earlier.

If you read previous reviews it might seem like this review doesn't belong here but to my disappointment that is my experience with Season 52.
