I really wanted to like this place as the interior is really beautiful and classy. Unfortunately if you are after great food it's a total miss. The piano girl saved this review from zero stars.

This place is the best. I got a few pastry items and a black milk tea with boba and everything was wonderful! The owners and staff are so incredibly kind and helpful too, which made the atmosphere warm and welcoming. The cronut was the best out of the pastries and I will definitely be back for it!

This is one of the best pizza places in St Petersburg we eat here at least 2 times if not 3 times a week sometime the staff is OK jason is the best pizza maker and Gianni is just a nice nice person the best pizza so good

This place is my new favorite burger place! 

First of all the restaurant interior is really cool with bears everywhere... BARE(bear)burger get it?? Haha.. It also has nice spoon chandelier! I love everything about it

The burger was on the smaller side but I don't eat a lot anyways so it worked out for me! Never had no-beef burger before so this was a nice experience for me. So yummy I'll definitely come back for more!

This mall is no doubt the worst in all of Hillsborough County.This ma is located in Northern Hillbourough, on Fletcher Ave., near the University of South Florida. At one point in time, many years ago this was a nice mall.
It is fairly spacious, very run down & depressing. 
The stores are not your top stores & personally, I would wait till I was somewhere else.
I recently went to a movie at this mall and felt quite uncomfortable  and unsafe. I personally like a few stores in this mall, but my days of going to this mall I believe is over.
What's  a  girl  to do?  Go where you feel comfortable  & feel safe.
Found this in my burger. This is absolutely disgusting. I can't believe this saucery the audacity they had. Eat here at your own risk. Disgusting.

I don't usually write reviews but I feel that I should share this with all wing lovers. Best wings ever. I believe they are baked in the hot pizza oven and they are amazing. The rub is warm so you have to like spicy. They are one of my favorite wings.

Terrible. Unorganized. My boyfriend placed an order to go for me to pick up. When I went to pick it up, I was directed to the bar area and then back to the front. A lot of confusion going on. So, one of the servers said he was going to check in the back. I finally get my order. A few weeks later, my boyfriend called in an order. This time they were better but the service at the carry out counter isn't the quickest or friendliest. 

Also, they do not carry everything that is on the O'Charley's website.
Very good gyro. Although they wouldn't honor the Yelp coupon they still gave me a discount. Food was fresh hot and large. All good things.

Probably the worst Dairy Queen the city has to offer. Blizzard's are always runny, staff is rude, wait's are long and food isn't well... That great!

If you're willing, make the drive to Southgate where your food is guaranteed to taste awesome, and your blizzard's are served right: upside down.
Ordered a lunch special. Waited an hour for delivery no big deal. Get my food pizza is ice cold.  Location is less so than 10 minutes from my house

The staff was great but the food was not good. The lobster on the surf and turf wasn't done. The ribs were hard as a rock. The crab cakes was very amateur. The whole cooking experience was amateur show. The table side salad was the highlight of eating experience. The ginger tea was great also. 
The food experience was not good at all.

It was really bad food. Reheated boneless wings that were hard and tasteless. Not freshly made to order. Very stingy with tomos, lettuce etc. the bread was tasteless. It had very little meat on it. Prices for food are high not really worth buying. Prices not on the takeout menu. 

There are better places to eat than this. Don't waste you time or money here.

I think I will refer to this as the bougie Publix from now on. Right across the street is a regular Publix. If you know this area, you will be able to tell the difference immediately. Bougie Publix has complimentary valet parking, a pharmacy, catering department, cooking classes, wine department, they even sell liquor. It's an all-in-one, one-stop-shop, Publix experience. When my friends come in town, I will take them here in a hot second. Parking can be a problem on the weekends, but honestly, why would you go to the grocery store on the weekend when everyone else is there?! That's on you, bro. 

Go here. Go now. You know you want too, because... well... Bougie Publix!

5 stars for the food no doubt about it. We got the sriracha burger, but let me tell you this, the burger does not need anything other than the meat and a bun. It is that good. The roast beef sandwich was better than decent, kind of like a sup'd up "Arby's" roast beef (in a good way). 

The service however left me wondering if I would come back though. I get it, you are busy. Deservedly so, it's great food. But, if you can make time to be rude, you can make time for a smile. 

Despite that, I do suggest you try this place. Just for the food.

Been coming to this restaurant either for dining or dancing or attending an event and it's always a 5 star.  The staff are very attentive.  Food is always delicious, we had salmon grilled for dinner and it's too die for...I ordered calamari appetizer and Tyler our server was excellent. We ordered a bottle of red wine and we end the night by attending the event called The Best of Tampa.

A Jazz club present itself with a certain mystique: a dim-lit room, a lighted stage, a maroon curtain, a baby grand piano with sax and bass, looked upon by a chilled crowd with cocktails in hand.

Another stop on the Cocktail tour, we arrived at the Irvin Mayfield's Jazz Playhouse, inside the quaint Royal Sonesta Hotel. Obvious Mayfield is not playing tonight, being the Jazz Fest was going on and he was one of the local headliners. We did however catch him later at the Festival, and agreed that he was a tremendous musician. I can see why he is quite respected and liked in the local community here, and the crowd that poured in here night after night showed for it.

Eventually we got what we came for, and tasted the Ramos Gin Fizz, supposedly one of the favorite drink of a former NOLA governor Huey P Long. It is obviously one of the stable drink orders around this part, and every cocktail bar has its caveat. The one here is not bad at all, the lemon-lime and simple syrup topped the soda foam give it an unique taste.

I would love to rate perfect 5-star, but we were giving special treatment for the tour; next time we arrived in New Orleans, hopefully we can catch Mayfield Jr performing in here, and I will update my review again with the full experience.

We came to this restaurant for a Valentines Day Dinner and had a wonderful meal.  The food, and service were very good.  We also thought the price was a good value too.

We started off with the cheese plate and the had some great selections that we'll definitely be looking for at home.  I had the filet and it was so tender that it was devine.  My partner had the grilled salmon with rissoto and it too was flavorful. I tried some of it and would order that anytime.  We both got desert and loved it. I had the chocolate tart with a Grand Marnier sauce...  the bomb!!!  He had the cheesecake which was creamy,  dense and served at the right temperature - so many restaurants serve it ice cold. .. 

The service and decor were great. Travis and his helper that night totally took care of us.

We'll definitely recommend this to friends visiting Reno.

Pros: Great selection of fresh baked bagels, maybe the best in Philly. The seeded bagels contain just the right amount goodness on top and bottom. A number of popular styles are offered in a whole wheat versions which can make the bagel choice a little more health conscious. The selection of cream cheeses and spreads is above average. 

Cons: The eggs on the bagel sandwiches are microwaved, think Dunkin Donuts style. It's kind of strange putting a pre-made, microwave reheated egg on a great fresh made bagel. The line on some weekend mornings can be intimidating, and although it moves quickly, it's not something you wanted to be greeted with in a hungover state.

Very disappointed with my last order. I order from this place regularly. Ordered take out dinner tonight for my daughter's birthday dinner for 7 people and one order was missing when we opened the bags at home. I called right away and they couldn't find the order. The only options offered were to wait for 35 minutes to make the dish or refund, which means we have to wait another 45 minutes for all of us to start dinner or one person wouldn't have dinner. Very sad birthday.

Great authentic Haitian food! Excellent service! My family and I called ahead of time and made some special orders. When we arrived the food was prepared, hot, and fresh. Every thing was delicious. The griot, rice and beans and goat soup was amazing! The owners of the restaurant made us feel like family. Good Haitian cuisine meets southern hospitality. We will definitely go back there on our next visit to Louisiana. Highly recommended.

I always order pizza at PM and never ever had any issues. I found a piece of pineapple in a pizza that shouldn't have pineapple, my husband found a piece of sausage in the pizza that shouldn't have had sausage. I was very disappointed and couldn't even finish eating the pizza . It was disgusting. Also the pizza tasted way worse than any other locations. I am very sad cause this location is super close to my house. I rather go farther next time.
Doug and his crew are the best. Quality, availability, service and price. Nothing comes close.

After a protracted visit to San Luis Obispo, this HGI has attractive rates and is far enough from SBA to get you out of the congestion just outside it.  It's a little tricky to find in the dark.  I missed the entrance and then turned right instead of left to turn around which took me into what seemed to be a wilderness which was kind of scary.  

When Waze guided my navigation-addled brain back to the hotel, there was plenty of parking and the trademark HGI paint job on the sliding doors.  Hilton is nothing of not consistent about little details like that.  Room was clean but I was too tired too notice much else.

Anyway, per my style, I'm writing this more as a reminder to myself that this is a good place to park if I'm too late or too tired to force my way onward if I'm taking 101 north or south.  There are better reviews here that list why this is a 4 star stay.

Waited 2hours to have my TMPS sensors (2) replaced that they found but there equipment was not up to date to program new sensors ,so no work was done! I left not getting anything done! Do not recommend! Plus the workers were talking to much and not getting any work done and there was one guy talking on his phone constantly!
Okay drinks. Okay service. Okay food. Overall, fine. Prices are high. Hype is a bit high. I'll go to The Lark next time.

The placed looked great and very busy for a Saturday afternoon.  Many people were staying there attending weddings near this location.  As I was also attending a wedding on Sunday afternoon and getting dressed, I misplaced one earring.  I used the light on the cell phone and started looking.  I found clumps of hair on the bathroom floor and under the beds, bottles caps, gummy bears, papers, hair accessories and plenty of DUST.  It was disgusting. I will never recommend or stay in this disgusting place again.  I couldn't wait to leave.

This is absolutely my most favorite restaurant & their seared ahi appetizer is simply amazing!! Love the Ginger Soy dressing, I could eat anything with that sauce on it!! Service is always prompt & with a smile, when ever I've had a problem its handled quickly & very fair!! The phone app is great too, just give them your cell number & every 4th time is 50% off- who doesn't love a discount?!?

It turns out that if you have a BIG bunch of junk you don't want, you can't just haul it off to the city dump and pour it into a big hole. As a result, I decided to use the junk hauling company that Hoarders uses. 

After a failed first attempt over the weekend to employ their services, the representative contacted me this AM to see about moving up my appointment with them. 

The representative was very nice, and was there very promptly. They bill based on volume, not on time and I was quoted a price between 1/2 and 3/4 load. 

The work took about 30 minutes, and ultimately was a bit more than I was quoted in volume but the representative charged me for the maximum value I had been quoted. 

Except for the initial difficulty in contacting them, I was very satisfied with the work that was done, and if I had to have my junk hauled away again I would easily recommend them.

If there's one thing to know about me is that I LOVE noodles. Know what I don't love? Piss-poor customer service. I've been to BNH several times and USED to recommend it to anyone and everyone I knew who loved noodles. Seriously, they didn't really need advertising since I did it all for them! Until one day, I called them to speak to the manager and ask a question regarding donation opportunities for a larger nonprofit organization I was working for (no, not to place an order), and one of the male workers who answered the phone was a complete a**hole. He scolded me for calling at that time and said he had to go because they were busy and hung up. Ok, so what if I called at an inconvenient time? Does that give you the right to be a dick? I think not. Needless to say I haven't been back and my word of mouth recommendations for this place has ceased to exist. If the guy who I spoke with gets a chance to read this, my advice to him for the future would be you never know who's on the other line, who they know, or what kind of impact they can make.

Most disgusting place I have ever walked into.   Upon asking about hair nets and I actually had to ask the lady why she is picking up slices for patrons with her hands.   This is nasty sending the video to health unit Monday . IT IS NOT ITALIAN FOOD.   I'm posting the video on utube just type Marconi pizza and you will see the disgusting habits they are keeping and touching your food bare hands?!   This is Canada.  Free health care or jot don't touch my food.    This is natural to them as you will see on YouTube

Fashion Forward and Classic frames at very reasonable prices. Customer service was great. I visited a couple of times and each time they took time to assist me in frame selection and to figure my out of pocket after insurance. 

I'll be honest, I ended up ordering my new glasses from another optical store, that saved me more out of pocket $'s.  However, I still want to give SEE Eyewear 4 Stars for selection and service. My SO who does have insurance used a Groupon and got a great pair of glasses. I highly recommend SEE and will check them out again when it is time for new glasses.
I got to say I ordered a bunch of times from Pho Orchid and love it. Pho is one of my favorites to get & will get it again!!!

Excellent food and service. I took my three adult kids to eat there for the first time but not the last. Salads, appetizers, and the pizzas were excellent. Dessert were also great. 
Highly recommend Sofia
i absolutely love this place its clean and they always have the best nail polish to choose from. Tip if you want an amazing foot message ask for one of the guys!

Dr. Ray is a very kind, compassionate, & an excellent physician. He really is concerned about my care & well being. I was having ear aches about 6 yrs. ago, & he diagnosed a hearing problem, so I could get a great hearing aid!

The food and service were both very good. I had the Eggs Benedict and home fries and was impressed! They kept the coffee coming and were quick to bring us anything we needed. I would definitely recommend this restaurant. The prices were very reasonable and the food was yummy!

Haven't eaten Chipotle in over a year and this location gave me an inedible burrito that completely fell apart as soon as I touched it. I didn't even get extra ingredients.

Go to Moe's instead, they know how to wrap a burrito.

If you want to go dancing in Center City, this is the place. I've been to Noche a few times, once for happy hour and the other times for a night out, and I will keep coming back for more! The drink prices are average for the area and the dance floor is on the smaller side but the music is always good!

Members only dog park, which I love! The park has two sides (large dogs and small) both with benches, fresh water, poop bags and tennis balls. It's a great addition to the neighborhood and my pup loves running around!!

This is a great place to play, not such a great place to eat.  The food is standard fare for a chain, but the service was slow and disorganized.  Gaming was a completely different experience, though.  All the games were operational, which is kind of unusual for such a large entertainment venue, and we all found plenty of games to keep us interested and engaged.  Lots of opportunities to play together with our teens, which is also unusual.

I got a pedicure here for the second time today, and it was a much better experience than the first time. The first time I didn't request anyone specific. I don't remember the name of the technician who did my pedicure, but she didn't do a good job at all. I asked her to cut my nails short; my nails were still long afterwards, with sharp edges. Everything felt rushed, and she finished in slightly less than 30 minutes.

Today I had made an appointment with Lisa, thanks to those who recommended her on their review on Yelp. Lisa was excellent! She took her time, was attentive to my requests, frequently checked in with me to make sure I was happy with what she was doing, and she paid close attention to detail. I'll be going back for Lisa from now on and would highly recommend her.

Took them 45 minutes to seat us for our reservation. Then when we asked the waitress what was good on the menu, she rattled off her favorites, a handful of which we proceeded to order only to find out that they were out of 4 of them, including guacamole.  Also, as far as tapas goes, only about half of the products are tapas - the rabbit, the sea bass - not really sharing foods. The taste was good, but doesn't warrant a return trip.

This place is pretty good. Very similar to honeygrow. I got a stir fry and a piece of focaccia bread. Stir fry was yummy but I think the sauce was lacking some flavor. My bread was also kind of old and dry tasting. I am definitely going to go back and try the stir fry again but with a different sauce and no bread lol.

Stayed at the Independent with 3 friends and were extremely satisfied!  Got in for a great price, the room was more than enough space, and the bathroom was just as spacious.  Continental breakfast was great - they have a great spread in the lobby!  Walking distance to a lot of major sites.  I would definitely recommend this hotel to friends and anyone looking for a boutique hotel in Philly.

This was an excellent example of a chef and staff taking pride in what they do. Both th e lamb lucy and Salas where outstanding but to be honest, the star of th e show was the homemade pecan pie dessert. I can't get that out of my mind and can't wait to go back. This is a must ho!

My order was completely wrong and when I called to get the order corrected I was told they couldn't deliver the corrected items. When I asked for a refund for the wrong items I was hung up on. I tried calling back 3 times and a lady answered the phone and hung up on me 3 times before I could say anything. Also The food that was as actually correct was cold. Worse experience I've ever had with a restaurant.

I have been a fan of Goldy's for 5+ years. I left the area for 4 years. Returned to Boise for a visit. Brought a friend from Central America. The "Greeter" was less enthusiastic than people I have seen dressed in orange and in handcuffs. Truly bored, zero smile, seemed troubled to be there. I wrote it off that he was filling for someone on break.
(Note: It was a thursday @ 10:30, they had empty seats and were not slammed)
The server arrived (I recognized him from years ago). Zero smile, almost troubled. I advised the guest was a newbie to Goldy's. He made what we construed to be a snide remark (he later said it was "dry humor"). We were having a grooving day, so I tried to rescue the moment. He commented that they were lucky she didnt go to "Moon's" and came to Goldy's.
We finished the order. Then after we left, we both went "WTF?" I said lets go. We stopped and cancelled the order with the server. And, as kind as I could dredge up...advised he was in need of time off. He attitude, delivery, tone and energy all needed work. He said he missed the humor cues and he was using dry humor. I advised of the greeter and that at no time did anyone laugh at the table.
I closed with if I owned the place, I'd close it for a day and do a serious in-service training. I now revise that...we walked to Moon's (food was average) and realized, all the staff at Goldy's needs to do is eat at Moon's and get a free in-service about customer service.

Blue Lizard is a hookah spot that many of my friends frequent. I'm not a smoker and this one of the few hookah spots that I can actually come to comfortably and not have to smell tons of smoke because the place is ventilated really great! The main workers are really friendly and you can request songs that you want to listen to while you're there if they can find them on their list. The couches are super comfortably and it's a really great place to chill late at night. They have cards and other things to keep you entertained, a television as well. Refreshments are also available and they have a variety of choices. For those that do smoke they have a huge list of hookah flavors and you can keep changing flavors for only a one time fee of $10. Non-smokers have to pay $5 to get in but it's not that bad to pay. The place is open late and closes at 3am usually and is located right by USF as well.

This is a really good restaurant for healthy but tasty mediterranean food! My go to order is steak kabobs with roasted vegetables and grilled potato salad. Their grilled potato salad is beyond amazing, highly recommend! I have also tried the cauliflower bowl which was also really good.  The restaurant itself is really nice and clean and the employees are always very helpful and friendly. I am hoping that they open more locations in the Tampa area since this location is a little bit far from home!

I am sooo happy for you Sissy - finally achieving your dream job and the love you have for your four legged babies ! I know since I can remember our house was like a zoo growing up - you would take care of any of them dogs-cats-bunnies-turtles-birds-fish yep our house was like a zoo! Congrats again!

If you enjoy a relaxed, warm, at home atmosphere then there is no salon that I could better recommend than JuJu. Everything from the decor to the staff is charming and inviting. The friendly greeting, the warm cup of tea, and the beautiful aromas all contribute to making your visit to JuJu a truly wonderful experience. While all of these things are absolutely great, they are just a plus for me because what I am truly looking for is fabulous hair when I walk out of the salon. Luckily, JuJu is able to give me ALL of that! From the day JuJu opened I have been a customer, and from the day JuJu opened I have heard nothing other than compliments about how fabulous and beautiful my hair looks. My color is always vibrant and rich, and my cut is always precisely what I'm looking for. I have also gone to JuJu for a couple of special occasions, and my hair has always looked fit for any red carpet. Julie has truly brought her own charisma to the salon, and I can't imagine going anywhere else. 

So if gorgeous hair is what you're looking for, rest assured that JuJu Salon & Organics is 100% the salon for you!

My favorite Thai restaurant for years! They make the best Pad Thai and their lunch specials are such great deals. I always get their shrimp pad thai but now that I tried their royal fish (tilapia) during their lunch specials, that is beginning to be my new favorite dish. I also love their Thai Iced Tea, Tom Yum, and Tom Kha. And although their appetizer platter is pretty much all fried, I still like getting it.   Their Siam Rama is good here too, which is my cousin's favorite dish.

Hole in the wall Indian food place on the edge of the Quarter.  Best Indian food I've ever eaten in my life.  I would go to New Orleans just to eat at this fine dive!  Chana and dal masala to die for.  It's rich and epically spicy so you might not be able to handle the awesomeness so be careful!   When I worked as the bicycle delivery person here I ate this amazing food every single day.  Delicious pakoras and samosas, perfectly cooked naan and the goat briyani was a huge hit with savvy locals and taxi cab drivers who ate there religiously. I miss this place sooo much!

Order take out for dinner tonight. This is our favorite dim sum place in Tucson. Really authentic. When they open the dining room, you will see a lot of people from Hong Kong come to dine here. One thing is the location, very far south. It takes very long to get here.

Was in from out of town looking for donuts and found this place on yelp. Nothing fancy, but like supporting the mom and pops shops. Donuts were yummy and the price was right. The fritters were HUGE although they could have been more fruity. Had a hard time telling the difference between apple and cherry. Would definitely go back though.

My 2nd visit - Wow! Incredible staff- wonderful atmosphere- open windows on a delightful late spring day- incredible pizza! Great craft brews! 
Grape Gorgonzola Pizza on 1st visit- unique and delicious! 2nd visit- R&B Pizza - again - delicious! Highly recommend this unique spot- with an eclectic staff that entertains and delights!

I got a GENERAL DELIVERY package which they are supposed to held for 30 days till February 3rd, and and 3 days after it was delivered, i got an email saying ... Sorry we missed you! Schedule a Redelivery to receive your package. If this item is unclaimed by January 15, 2021 then it will be returned to sender.

So, I went into wicked 13 tattoos today and the experience was amazing. I went in nervous because I never had my nipples pierced before. The ladies at the desk were very welcoming.  My piercer was Ms. Amber. She made me and my husband feel comfortable. She explained everything to us. When it was time she made jokes to get my mind off of it. She is a true professional and skilled piercer. I will be back.

Went for the all u can eat crab legs on Sunday evening, the crab legs were very good, waitress was awesome, just one glitch when a refill of crab legs took about 10 minutes but was comped a free beer so all was well. Will go again for this and will also try the all you can eat blue crabs on Thursdays.

When you walk in, you are excited to see the menu. Everything looks fresh and you look forward to having them stuff the pita with all your favorite fresh veggies! Unfortunately this not what you get, instead, you get someone that just graduated high school, throwing a bunch of mixed matched veggies that are brown from sitting in the walk-in cooler too long and squeezing a bunch of nasty sauce over the ingredients to make it manageable to eat. Not only is the staff from the show "walking dead", the food tastes like its post apocalyptic. Please change your gloves after walking through the nasty metal door to the back of the store. Eat at chipotle if you want a better low budget meal choice.

We discovered this wonderful, warm place two evenings ago and I inhaled the toad-in-a-hole and my wife filled up with the pie of the day (ham).  The beer selection was remarkable and service top-notch.  Our waitress introduced to the owner, Mike Stoney, who invited us to their Burns' Night Celebration last night.  We jumped at the chance to be a part of it and I was decked out in full kilt and accessories.  I've had haggis at many a Scottish celebration but never as good as Stoney's chef prepared it.  Downing a single malt Scotch with it, the naps were awesome and the tats delicious.  I finished up my meal with the fried Mars bar.  I can't remember when I've had such a good meal, with good people, and pints of fresh Guinness!  I've found m'new favorite pub, m'thinks.

Fast response. 
Professional Service.  
Reasonable.  
That's enough for me.  5 STARS *****

Where to start? The restaurant itself was about 80 degrees inside. The sushi was room temp, the General Tsos chicken was watered down, and lo  mein noodles were chewy. Grocery store sushi is better. Crab rangoon tasted good, but was mostly breading. The air ducts were caked in dust which is a bad sign for cleanliness. 

The only good point was the prompt service. I would rather eat literally anywhere else. $60 after tip for two people. Never again.

Great selection of sneakers (asics, Nike, Ryka, Saucony) and workout clothing for men and women. While geared towards runners, there's gym rat gear too -- basic, well made, and functional. Best selection of outdoor running gear I've seen. 
The staff at the Doylestown shop is very helpful esp when it comes to getting you fitted for a running shoe. 
I've been to the Newtown store a few times - usually catch it when it is busy, and can't get help, but guess that is a good sign. 
If you're looking for a velour tracksuit with "JUICY" on the butt to match your Uggs, go elsewhere.
The store is not easy to find; it's NE of the 611-313 intersection, behind Dunkin Donuts. It is worth the hunt!

I recently tried coaches due to steak and hoagie factory being boarded up now. I was pleasantly surprised with the food. My chicken cheesesteak was delicious and the French fries were very good. I left it only at 4 stars due to the hours not being open later.

What a great place! PB&J's. Stopped in a few weeks ago right before they opened, couldn't wait to check it out. Came in for a few drinks and met the bartender and owner. Super great guys. They have some good venues coming up. Can't wait to check out the music! Great addition to the new downtown scene for sure:)

Let's start with customer service:
Delivery came an hour and 40 mins after placing my order for a large Stromboli and 2 liter soda.
When the delivery driver came to my door he hands me the box with a 20oz soda on top and immediately says you can't order 2 liter soda through yelp app. So I ask why wouldn't they call me and order it however they need to instead of showing up an hr and 40 mins later and telling me to deal with at after they also already billed me?

Worst Stromboli ever!
Pics speak for them self but it was paper thin dough that was just made sloppy and so full of grease it was falling apart. Not sure if the little bit of cheese only in the center was bad or it was just drowned in grease, either not edible
It's a miracle this location is still open. Everything is slow here like it's stuck in a time warp. Just close the rest of these Steak n Shakes and put them out of their misery

Love this place! You have a range of food options as well as grocery items to choose from. 

No words to describe how much I love Reading Terminal Market.

Finally! An awesome festival to speak of in Nashville!!

I won 2 amazing vendor passes to this wonderful festival (thank you Yelp!), and I have to say, I felt like a rockstar.

They had excessive amounts of delicious, top notch beer brought to us by craft breweries from coast to coast.  This beer was magnificent, never-ending magic.  I grabbed my beautiful pint glass, purchased a much-needed PBR sweatband headband, and strutted around with my pretzel necklace like Goldilocks and the Three Beers.  Sweetwater? Good People? Terrapin? The list goes on!  Abita rocked their Purple Haze, which is always a fan favorite.  I believe I was most impressed with Shlafly.  They had a bourbon cask aged stout of some sort that tasted like coffee, chocolate, whiskey, and beer.  Could a girl ask for more??

Yes, she could.  I also enjoyed a wonderful Chicago-style dog from The Dog of Nashville, and good times with great people.  And of course, great music!

I was thoroughly impressed that no matter how busy the festival seemed, no matter how many swarms of people were around, the line for beer was never too long.  This festival was laid-back, extremely well organized, and I cannot WAIT until next year!!

Well done Music City!
I had the Brisket Burger lunch special and it was the best tasting hamburger that I have ever had.   The service was excellent too.   I will be back.

While the nail technician was friendly and the prices are comparable to the area, the product is sub-par. I had Danny as my nail technician for a gel manicure, and after less than a week the gel has chipped, bubbled, and peeled off. A gel manicure on me usually lasts 3 weeks, my first nail chipped after 3 days. I am very dissatisfied and disappointed as I was hoping there was going to be a nail studio in the Fishhawk/Valrico area that offered a great service.

I would give a solid 3.5 stars. I ordered in; naan, 2 vegetarian entrees, and their rice pudding. The delivery took over an hour and 20 minutes ( minus 1 star since I could have walked and picked it up in under a half hour- damn my sloth!) but the food itselft was excellent! However, for $45 I expected the servings to be much bigger. The entree its self was in an (estimated) 2 cup container about an inch under full. The rice was less than a cup, no joke. The food itself was no complaints, but almost $50 for two tiny dishes of rice, 1 peice of naan, and two humble entrees with an equally humble sized desert seems to be overpriced to me. 

In short:  Food was very good, highly recommend
                 Take out portions were super small and overpriced
                 Delivery? Not if your hungry. Pick up the phone and place the order      *before* hunger sets in ;)

I don't know what the deal is with this place, at face value they look and sound great! Super friendly staff in the building and over the phone. It's when you book an appointment and go in that the crumminess begins. (Also, that appointment may get pushed back a couple months because they want to "close up early" ... wtf? Are you serious? Inconvenience me for months because you want leave a little earlier that day?! What a god awful way to do business.)

I had to get a deep cleaning so I was going to be there for a couple hours. They set up an iPad with some blatantly obviously pirated movies on it which seemed kind of sketchy. The staff didn't know how to operate the bluetooth headsets that they pair with the iPads, luckily I'm familiar with iPads and managed to figure it out myself. The lady who performed my deep cleaning said "oopsie" more times than I think I'm comfortable with and the left side of my mouth hasn't been the same since, my teeth seem more sensitive than they were before, and there was a complete lack of caring anytime those "oopses" happened, I was just sent out with a "Sorry, you're cheeks and gums are going to be pretty tender and bloody for a while." Gee thanks, maybe next time don't try to rush through things, eh?

All and all really dissatisfied. Going to find a dental office that cares about their customers, rather than trying to get as many in the door as they possibly can.
Slowest service on the face of the Earth. I fell asleep waiting for our food. My son's clothes went out of style and my daughter graduated from college while we waited.

I have been to this place several times before and I've always had a great experience. I had my parents start going and they didn't like it but I still like them. I came in today for pedicure and nail polish and asked if I could get a manicure instead and she said yes. I finished my pedicure and asked where to go for my manicure and she said that I said no to Manicure. So I just had to leave. I'm having surgery to take my kidney out due to a kidney Mass that is cancer and I don't know when I'll be able to go back to get my nails done. This was supposed to be a nice relaxing day for me and it turned out horrible. I will not be going back and we'll find somewhere else.

Malvern vegans rejoice!! Who would of thought one of Malvern's best kept secrets would have more vegan options than most local restaurants?? Pictured is the vegan BLT with a side of pickled veggies!! Everything is always so fresh and delicious!! Also, top notch customer service. I love this place, never disappoints!!

The salon itself is nice enough,(it can get a bit loud) with the shampoo area set up to be a calm , quiet place in a separate room.  However, the customers and stylist's kept talking in that area the day I was there, so it's not really used as it was designed to be.  The neck massage and warm towel were 5 star though.  What I didn't like was the constant push/upselling of products during my appointment.  All in, the stylist tried to sell me over $250 worth of products and it caused constant interruption to my appointment.  I came in with a picture of what I was looking for: blonde with blonde highlights and the stylist appeared to be listening during what I thought was a very clear 15 min. consultation.  However, at the 4hr mark, after she finally blew my hair out, my hair was all over ash??  My head was splitting from the 4hr nonstop chatter on the part of the stylist, and I left the place in tears. The stylist became defensive and did not apologize. When I got home, I noticed my hair was shorter on one side versus the other side. Poor haircut, poor color, 4 hrs in the chair and over $200 spent?? I had a special event to go to so I was very upset. I did email the manager describing my experience with the picture I had shown the stylist and one showing what I left with requesting a full refund, which I received. That is the only reason I give this salon 2 stars.  If you are a new client, be prepared that their business model includes pushing products throughout the appointment because the stylists work on commission.  Also, either the manager or the stylist taking a moment to say "I'm sorry" sure would have gone a long way.
Consistently good food, nice atmosphere.  A nice midtown spot. Only issue is needing to climb stairs.

Was aggressively man handled by a tall white bouncer on 2/24/18 around 11ish. Never in my life have I been touched in this way. It was unprofessional and uncalled for. The 2nd bouncer was appalled but of course didn't do anything about it. I was so shocked/ afraid that it took me awhile to process what had happened. No one, yet alone a small 5'4 girl, should be treated this way. Scarred for life and will never return.
I went here for lunch one day and the food was pretty good. I had the pulled pork sliders and homemade potato chips and enjoyed it! I love Winthrop Town Center, it is such a cute plaza!

Spades Park is a lovely simplistic park.  It's a park truly dedicated to the beauty of the nature that runs through it and surrounds it.  It's a heavily wooded park with concrete bridges crossing Pogue's Run.  It's a designated bird sanctuary and boasts 31 acres of which 2 acres has been designated as protected prairie for animals such as rabbits and chipmunks.  If Bugs Bunny or Alvin and the Chipmunks were visiting Indy for an event, this is probably where they would stay incognito, of course.  The park is not without some of the basic modern amenities, such as a shelter, a play structure, and swings.  Every year, at the end of summer, Spades Park is host to the Feast of the Lanterns Festival featuring live music and food, beverage, and merchandise vendors attracting neighborhood residents and city dwellers alike.
Very inconsistent enforcement of the rules.  There are often adults jumping in the little air area.

The food is absolutely delicious and so full of flavor. So far I've had the mini tacos, spicy pad Thai, sushi with ginger pate and the fudge brownie dessert. I plan on eating my  way through the entire menu. I took my 74 year old father there, who is not an adventurous eater and had never had vegan before, and he loved it, which is saying a lot.

Great pub!

I love the "It's Always Sunny" theme.  The bar is nice and long, huge amount of beers and great food.  The bartender was very cool and with my Mets hat on I wasn't treated like a complete @$$.

The turkey BLT was very good.  Pretty big too.  The fries were delicious, especially with the sauce that came with the sandwich.  I believe I have found a pub to hang in in Philly.  Although on game nights maybe I'll leave my NJ/NY allegiance at home...

If there was an option of zero stars I would have liked to give that because this place doesn't even deserve a single star. HORRIBLE FOOD, HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. First of all the food we ordered was super cold. I ordered a drink (Pina Colada) which was stinking. I couldn't drink more than a single sip. There were eight of us but nobody's food was satisfactory. Then when they brought check they had charged us for salad which is normally free at Olive Garden with entrees and we all had ordered entrees. On asking the server was so rude that he said "We don't serve free food". My brother found it so disrespectful that he said go and charge everything. We are not here for free food. We had boxed one of our kid's food but he said he doesn't want to eat at home and we left the box there. The server came to us when we were leaving and said we forgot the box. We said we don't need it. He threw it in trash in front of us saying "Why did you have to waste our Box". I can never expect such a customer service from any place. Will never go back again.

Arguably, Nashville's best bagel can be found at the Star Bagel Cafe!  They've got a great selection of freshly baked flavors as well as delicious cream cheese.  They've also got a nice selection of breakfast and lunch sandwich options, though I haven't tried these.  It's a very popular weekend breakfast spot, but the turnover is pretty fast, so don't be scared of the line.  One huge gripe: it's nearly impossible to find parking due to the breakfast volume and the dry cleaner next door has scary 'we will tow you' signs.  There's also a nice patio area with tables and umbrellas for Saturday morning coffee and newspaper reading.

So very glad I stopped by here today. Was recommended by a local (after I saw his takeout). 

This is off the main drag but totally worth the stop of you are looking for a awesome Rueben sandwich.  A true delight and the freshest of ingredients. This kosher deli and marketplace has lots of choices when it comes to food. Fresh, canned, dry, breads, etc. 

I was very happy with my meal and it arrived very fast. Most lunch plates in the $9.00-$11.00 range. 
When back in St. Pete, I'll be back again!

I'll do an updated review once I'm able to experience it aside from last night's Yelp Elite event.  For the time being, here are my observations.

I love burgers, but I hate how greasy they can be.  That is NOT the case here!  Not once did a drop of grease hit my plate.  Everything tasted delicious and fresh and the staff were incredibly friendly.

I *LOVE the branding and am so happy to see them making their way out west.  The Big Texas burger was definitely my favourite of the evening, but I'm excited to try out their other offerings.  

There's no dedicated parking lot, so you have to find parking on the street.  Even with our event causing a packed house, I was able to find parking about half a block away so I really can't complain!

I really look forward to returning :)

Hands-down the best tuna melt I have ever had. It was shear buttery deliciousness. I really enjoyed the onion rings as well! Best onion rings in Tucson. The cinnamon roll was sinful and delightful. The coffee was definitely not good hence four stars out of five.

We are Still waiting for food. 16 people and they "decided to serve 8 first because the kitchen was backed up". So an hour later we are STILL sitting her the other 8 of us with no food while the people have for the food and already eaten are done. At this point I want to go and not even eat. 

Then I get my medium rare burger and it's cold inside! Not cooked enough and freezing  cold inside ! My daughter ordered chicken fingers and friend got no fries at all! Then now is sick at home from the spicy chicken fingers! She said they tasted funny and they did, like fish. 

If you can't properly serve a party of 16 don't seat us. 

Hungry and pissed off

Second time eating at this location and I have been 
very disappointed both times. I have been going to the lafayette hall location for years and expected the same quality. My chicken tikka masala was a joke. Literally 9 chunks of chicken and very little flavor.

AMAZING FOOD! This place is a go to! I love their sticky buns. When the dinning room is open, it's an amazing little room and the service is always great. While being only take out for COVID they are still upholding their amazing customer service and delicious food.

I've been getting my lashes done for a couple of years at different places and I finally found my girl. Natalie really does great work.  I always get compliments when she does my lashes.  She is very sweet and accommodating too.  I would definitely recommend her.  Go check her out!

So very good! 
We have come here a few times now and I have enjoyed the atmosphere, staff and food. 
The last two times I had the Brisket Bomb sandwich which was great. Today I tried the Banh Mi (pork belly sandwich) and wow!

The rest of the family all enjoyed their meals as well. This restaurant is on our short list if local places to have dinner.

This spot is awesome! Great atmosphere, good food, and craft brews is a mixture for a good time and that is exactly what they got going on at Carolina blue.  My usual order is the wings and the shrimp spring rolls but their smokehouse burger it knock your socks off good.

One of the best Indian food we have ever had. 
Every dish was freshly made. No premise stuff here. You can taste it with every bite. 
The owner came and greeted us at the table. Checking in to make sure we were 1000% happy. 
Very accommodating   You will not be disappointed. Authentic 100%

Came in with a party of 12, all couples. Me and my boyfriend ordered a quesadillas, nachos, and a margarita. The food came out before my drink ever did. Finally got my drink and asked for a water, water took another 15 minutes to come out. Mind you it was 11 pm and the place was nearly empty. Then our chicken quesadilla came out with no chicken so we sent it back. It came out again with beef not chicken. Didn't bother saying anything because we didn't want to wait again. Finally we asked for the checks at 12pm. It's now 12:40 and we are still waiting on the correct check. The original sever charged us for multiple things we have never ordered. Never once did a manager come to help us or apologize.

Love this old place.  The music may be a bit too loud for conversation but you can't beat the atmosphere.  Best time to go is off-season and you can hang with the locals. They make a mean Sazerac here!
Dirty as soon as you walk in...I walked back out. If a nail salon can not be sanitary then my question is, why would you want to take a chance at putting your health at risk ? NO THANK YOU !!

Theyre fast food so we cant hold them to a high standard as another type...

Yeah del taco is my guilty pleasure... shhh dont tell anyone...

I tried the fish taco #7 deal, two fish tacos fries & a drink... turns out its cheaper to buy this combo & throw away the kinda soggy fries...

They do not serve mcdonalds grade of fries nor do they have fish tacos like rubios...

Del taco has the lil green cheese n bean burritos i like n mcd & rubios cant compete

I came here for contacts hoping to finally get 
My prescription precise and that's exactly what I got!   The dr worked with me as we got it precise.   It's nice to see without readers anymore.

Fantastic dentist and dental staff, from reception to the hygienist to Dr. Z himself! Everyone was so genuine and warm and I really felt cared for and that my dental health was important to them. Went in to have a chipped front tooth repaired (and a bonus cleaning because they were able to squeeze me in and save me a future separate appointment) and I walked out with my smile restored and my teeth squeaky clean! I Highly recommend Z Dentistry!
Killer gumbo--smoky, spicy, wonderful.  Great 'beer wall' and friendly service.  I've been here twice two years apart (I'm not from NO) and the food, service, and beer were great both times.
OMG !!! Definitely one of Tucsons treasures. The pizza, excellent. The cheese steaks, amazing....even the potato salad was probably the best I've ever had. You have to try this place.

Located across from the Mud House on Cherokee Street, Midwest Pasta makes fresh pasta onsite and they sell to grocers, as well as the public.  They also offer a variety of imported Italian food items (pestos, pasta, olive oil, etc).

Mike was excellent from the start - our last minute reservation, meeting us in baggage claim with a sign with our name, helping getting our bags, and delivering us safely to our hotel & then coming back for us 2 days later & delivering us to the cruise terminal. Friendly service & clean, roomy comfortable ride. Reasonable rates too!!

My sister came to visit and we found polished through Yelp!! The entire team were so nice and provided skilled/detailed services on our nails! I cannot wait to plan the next sister adventure. Thank you for having us!
Good Chinese buffet near campus. Keeping seating and good selection. Staff is very nice and attentive.

My husband and I decided to try this place last month. I've lived in Arizona for over a decade and had never had a tamale. Yes, never. Anyway, this was a good place to start. They have all kinds of tamales, but between the two of us we sampled the chile relleno,  the Tucson (I think that's what it was called?), and a couple others I'm forgetting. They were pretty good except one of mine, the cheese never melted quite right and so it was like a semi-hard cube in the middle--just a weird texture is all. 

We got rice and beans on the side, but unless you HAVE to have those, I'd skip them. The black beans had a very strange taste. The first two bites were fine, but the rest of it tasted like they used a lot of clove or something similar. My husband said these tamales were good, but not typical of tamales everywhere (his family makes them, but not like this is how he described it). 

We agreed that when we have visitors from out of town, we'd probably take them there so they can try it. And the next time we go, it will probably be for breakfast so we can try the soyrizo tamales.

First time in Saint Louis, my team and I went to Zia's.

Pro:
1- beautiful Italian restaurant, simple but nicely decorated.
2- very pleasant hostess
3- server was very knowledgeable (could of been more friendly)
4- salad was fresh, and huge
5- toasted ravioli (the Missourians) claimed started here. It was absolutely delicious (don't care who started first).
6- my spaghetti side order and my main dish which was chicken was delicious and the source of the best.
7- great location (please see the warning)
8- reasonable price
9- will go back again

Con: 
None

Warning: take a Uber/lyft, very hard to park

Another great meal at The Wild Cow just wish they would open a West location too. Taco salad, fajita style, is always an excellent choice and make sure you get it with vegan queso...so good. Buffalo grinder is also a great stand by. Tonight's special was Hawaiian Taco's...seitan curls with slaw and pineapple salsa with a chipotle sauce...absolutely delicious. Place can get crowded sometimes and food may take awhile to get to your table but always worth the wait.

Omg!!! I can't say enough great things about Amy! My experience with her was just perfection!! Made me feel super comfy, we shared stories and laughs the whole time. She did an amazing job with my Brazilian and was very calming. And I've had my fair share of experiences at diff salons but this one is def Clean professional. This place is 30 mins away from me but so worth the drive.

This is the real deal. I walk in and hear Vietnamese 80s dance music playing at a moderate sound level. I get the universal signal of sit wherever you'd like and I took a seat in the front. The waitress comes over with no menus, only her pad. I try my hardest to order in Vietnamese their special Bun Bo Hue but the questions about if I wanted everything started to get tricky. For some reason she switched to Mandarin which I am equally as bad at speaking. I tried switching to English with no avail. After an exchange of half broken Vietnamese and Mandarin, my order was ready to go, Bun Bo Hue the small size with everything, make it spicy... To drink, complementary iced green tea. I think. 

You get a plate of basil and another herb Vietnamese coriander that I normally don't see but appropriate for Bun Bo Hue, with bean sprouts and a lime. So far so good. They brought out a glass bowl of an almost perfect Bun Bo Hue, loaded with different cuts of pork and beef including a ridiculously tender slice of pig's feet, cha lua (pork roll ham), soft beef tendon, and thin sliced beef brisket. The only thing missing are some pork blood cubes that would've made it slightly more authentic. The broth was extremely flavorful with fresh chilis adding to the right amount of heat and onions. You need to pull all the herbs from the stem and fold them into the broth. Also break up a handful of bean sprouts to add in for crunch. Then with a squeeze of lime; that's the proper way to eat it and it's so good. 

Even though the language exchange was a little silly, the food speaks for itself and the people are very nice and accommodating. Definitely have to return.

What a nice surprise!!! The cutest little spiritual store on Girard. Wow I wish it was here when I lived in Philadelphia! Anyhow I stopped in over the weekend.Great choice of crystals,incense,sage,palo santo,cute jewels etc...Good prices and very nice lady at the counter. Love it! I'll gladly return when I'm back in town! Namaste,xoxo
Falafel was ok but a bit too heavily spiced. The chicken schwarma had dry overcooked chicken. Step up the game

Cute place. Maybe there are similar places that show up in NYC, however I guess I'm not in that scene in the day to day life living in the city. AM I A TOTAL WINE NEWBIE AND DID NOT KNOW PEOPLE OFFERED WINE FLIGHTS?! Sorry if I am a newbie. Forgive my ignorance HAH. The atmosphere is extremely romantic and cozy with a lot of people on first dates, second dates, I don't know - everyone just looking like they are having a good time together. The fire is really amazing to see indoors. Sorry I'm from NYC. This whole review is just me apologizing for my New Yorker mentality. The wine flights were really amazing because I got to try a bunch of merlots at once. I do enjoy having a bunch of different flavors to explore, rather than commit to one and then end up not liking it! I was extremely nervous to knock the whole dang thing over though. The seating probably should and can be arranged a bit differently with a little higher "coffee table" next to the individual loungey chairs, so I'm not kicking the whole thing and spilling on their carpets. I really wish I could eat oysters because they looked amazing. My fav thing of the night though was the truffle honey. Yum yum yum!!!

I would be wary of some of the complaints on here. The receptionists aren't there to greet you with a smile and start up a conversation. They're usually quite busy. Also, I would be worried if reception is how you are grading your quality of care at a doctors office.

I've never waited more than 24 hours for an appointment here. I've never waited for more than 15 mins in the waiting room. Doctors, nurses, and practitioners are smart, polite and attentive. I'm more than satisfied with the care I receive from this group!

What an incredible night out! My husband and I wanted to celebrate and had looked for restaurants close to us on yep (thank you!) and saw this beautiful place! We had driven by it many times but decided we would treat ourselves and try something new and higher class! It was a slow Tuesday evening and wow the atmosphere was relaxing and romantic! Our serving staff were incredibly helpful and knowledgeable. We started with the Caesar salad - best I've had!!!! Then I had the New York strip and my husband was over the moon to see a ravioli that wasn't cheese stuffed but rather filled with a short rib beef!!! We were both impressed with the flavors of or dishes and the lovely presentation! I highly reccomend Bistecca for a date night, special occasion or a night with friends or family who love and or appreciate good food, wine and service!!!
probably the best bar in mayfair, ive never had an issue here, they keep all the kids out during the pub crawl which i like

Walked in store picked up a shirt brand that I buy on the regular and it was marked up 3 times higher than the brand's official site. This place is notorious for over pricing the African American community and we are their #1 client base. It offended and I've shopped here and with Rome at the Westbank store.
Been to Davio's many times always have a great time, This visit the service was over the top, sommelier very knowlegeable and food outstanding, looking forward to dining there soon! Thanks.

This place is a strange little nook on the corner on East Passyunk. Any time I go by here, there's nobody sitting down to eat -- I think the majority of their business is from take-out orders. Please do be careful when you walk by or go in, though, because they like to leave their sidewalk-to-basement doors open like a death trap. 

I picked up food from here one time, and it was made to order quickly, just as I had expected it to look upon receipt. The restaurant seating area has a few mix-matched hard chairs and small square tables - it really is not an inviting atmosphere and I'm not surprised that I've never seen anyone sitting to eat in the establishment. The front area also serves as a storage area for them - there are towering stacks of soda cases that sit near the cash register a bit strangely.

Once I took it home, the food was mediocre - chicken a bit dry and the sauce a bit too greasy. If I'm ever desperate for Chinese food in this area, I may give it another shot, but probably not.

This place is easily worth 5 stars. The staff and the ambiance make you feel welcomed and relaxed. Now to the food! The Convivio menu has endless pastabilities. I ended up picking the Meat Ravioli and it did not disappoint. Ravioli contained braised beef, tossed with mushrooms and caramelized onions in a cream sauce (Menu Description).  We also had Tiramisu for dessert to wrap up the night and I would highly recommend it. This place is the real deal and not an impasta.

I came to check out this place for a long-overdue meet up with a former student of mine. I love Downtown Dunedin as it is such a cute place to visit for a nice fight. This place was amazing and I definitely want to come back. It's also great to know that they are dog friendly so my husband and I can come with our baby girl. To start my former student and I ordered 2 espresso martinis. Definitely some of the best espresso martinis that I have had. They were super delicious and made me feel very relaxed hahaha. We also ordered some of the beignets for an appetizer. My only complaint about the Beignets was there was not more of them hahaha. It came with a nice raspberry glaze and there was a hint of lemon in the dough. The Beignets were superb in fact I still have happy dreams about them hahaha. I also ordered the smoked gouda grits and some fries to share with my former student and both dishes were super delicious. I am a huge fan of brunch especially with my girls so I definitely want to bring them back to this location and to come here with my husband as well.

Wow best chicken ever!!! We had a half chicken and couple extra breast pieces fries and slaw. This place is really awesome!!! The bad news is I live 40 miles away!!! Arg!!!

We ha The crab soup too....yes it is awesome as well.
I only get gas here if I absolutely have to.The young boys that always want to pump your gas for money need to find something better to do with their time.

Came here specifically for the lamb dishes. I have a hard time finding GOOD lamb dishes in tucson. They have two lamb dishes on the menu (rack of lamb and lollipop) We each ordered a lamb dish and both were delicious and flavorful! I had the rack of lamb with the risotto and asparagus, yummy! I got a side of potatoes (mixed sweet potatoes) and they were fluffy and good. For dessert we had the caramel crunch cake. The staff was attentive and very helpful. They adhere to social distancing guidelines. Definitely going back for the lamb!

The amount of meat on the sandwiches is a serious joke.  One, yes one, slice of deli ham and one slice of deli turkey lunch meat.  My sandwich was supposed to be a panini, but the almost nonexistent slice of thin cheese on it barely held it together.  I guess this is a great place to go if you are on a diet.

Really wanted to like the Olde Town Inn as it is our old neighborhood in New Orleans. Stayed for two nights starting the Sunday after the first weekend of Jazzfest 2014.

Unfortunately, the hotel is run down and the staff are run down too, not very friendly but just getting on with their job. My wife and I booked a Deluxe Single on hotels.com which was supposed to have a Queen or King bed but ended up with two rooms with 6 single beds. Their reservation system could do with some work and I would only recommend booking with them directly. 

That wasn't the only problem though, the shower was so moldy we didn't use but went to a communal shower next door. Never get the wifi to work either.

The only plus point is the neighborhood which is upcoming and has a couple of cool drive bars. If you want to walk to Frenchman or even the Quarter it is close enough too.

Great food, good atmosphere. There were only two other groups besides us so it wasn't loud or packed. Friendly service from our waiter as well. 


Such decor.
Much curtain.
Very sushi.
Such lovely.
Wow.

Had a package i needed returned to at&t. Walking in around 11am didn't have to wait at all. 
I explained to the dude at the counter what i was doing. We had a couple laughs about how messed up my phone was. Then he packaged it up real quick gave me a tracking number and i was out the door.
I left pretty happy , considering I expecting to have to wait awhile to even be seen.
A+

We saw in This Is Tucson that this bakery was opening right around the corner and the husband surprised us with a selection of pies tonight - banana cream, key lime and mixed berry.

The key lime was the star, and we just spent five years living in Miami and visiting the keys on a regular basis, so we know our key lime (side note, if you ever find yourself in key west get the frozen key lime covered in chocolate). Sydney's key lime has a whipped cream consistency and packs a tart punch. Great graham cracker crust.

The mixed berry was very good, with a perfect golden crust. The banana cream was filled with sliced bananas and the whipped cream was nice and light without being overly sweet. 

Slices were five dollars each and came in cute individual containers. Can also by whole. Right now it's to go only but I'm hoping when able they will offer some eat in options. 

We hope the have great success in the neighborhood!

IN MY OPINION,  I tried lucky cupcake co. but found it to be a bit high$$$  for a cupcake these days...I would pay this price for a top notch bakery anyday... Some flavors are consistently good,  others just need more work on the drawing board 
Overall it's ok,  Id say to the bakery just stick to what works don't overstuffed  your menu....consistency sell's in the longrun.
Sorry about losing on cup cake wars on the cooking channel aired March 6th.6-7pm... I'm sure you will do better!!
Friendly staff and great food. We had shrimp stir fry and veggies, chicken fried rice, wonton soup and crab puffs. Everything was delicious.

Best restaurant experience I've had in a while!! Cocktails were delicious and my drink never went empty. Food was absolutely amazing and fairly large portions; we had an octopus appetizer ,cant remember the name of it, but it was spectacular. Our waiter Jim was the cherry on top of the experience, great sense of humor and the perfect amount of attentiveness. Considering all the about it is definitely worth the price.

I have been here a few times now and I keep coming back for a few reasons. The beer selection is very strong. It should be with a name like that but they do deliver. There's outside seating which is something I always want in a bar. The staff is nice and attentive. There is typically some form of entertainment going on musicians, trivia or what not.
       The food... Hmmm... I love food. I eat it almost everyday. I almost don't want to review the food because you can tell whoever is cooking here loves to cook. However they are a little too creative in my opinion. The last time I ate there, the special was a vegan grilled cheese that apparently was award winning. What I experienced was savage attack on the religion of grilled cheese. Swear to god if anyone ever puts the words vegan and grilled cheese together in the same sentence I'm going to fight them. If I were in a room with Hitler, Stalin and the guy that made this thing and I had a gun with only 2 bullets, Id shoot the creator of this sandwich twice! Now I'm making a complete joke here. If vegan is your thing you'd probably love it. I just don't understand the need to label something as a vegan (whatever traditionally carnivorous food applies). I would think of you are vegan that you accept the fact that you aren't eating a grilled cheese anymore.

Delicious! The food is great! I usually avoid bread and really limit my carb consumption but he fries here are totally worth it.  Triple fried and perfectly salted.
I really like that you can get your burger on a beautiful brioche bun OR on top of a perfectly portioned bed of triple fried fries, macaroni and cheese or mixed greens.
The sauces are fantastic.  If you get your burger on top of any of these, there's a generous amount of sauce drizzled over the entire creation so the flavor hits from start to finish.

nice place, corn bread comes with no meals, too pricey for some meals, and we get burnt ends with our meals alot, but unfortunately the last 3 x all fatty. quesadillas ( weren't bad tho) lots to pick from, convenient but plaza can be seedy after 5

Don't get this one confused with the one in Salem, MA. Similar idea, different stores.
This one located at the end of Decatur Street, heading toward Frenchmen Street.

Sure there are plenty VOODOO shops around here along the Bourbon Street and in French Quarter, this one stands out a little from the other, with nice display cases and neat presentation. The owner will chat you up with some history of voodoo and old Wiccan ways.

But wait, what is that? Is that harry potter wand?! That is kinda cool!

P.S. I wish I have some pictures to post from inside the store, but I was asked not to take any photographs. Bummer!

I was referred here by my Mom years ago, and they are the. best. I have been taking my kitties there for years now. They remind you when your pet is due for a visit, because they know time can get away from us. I have always had very good impressions of the vet techs there (other places, they can be ...cold). Well, except for the fact that I have one bad kitty. He's a bad kitty at home, and he's a VERY bad kitty at the vet. He decided that he despised his vet tech, and gave the tech a terrible, terrible time (so now the feeling is mutual, which is fair). But, even if that tech gets stuck with me and my rotten kitty, the professionalism and care is still present. The Veterinarians, are both stellar. They really care about you and your fur baby and are willing to give you advice and listen to your concerns. If only MY doctor was as good!! If you're on the fence, do it, go see these people, they are great.

I was fortunate to have 3 dogs stay at the Indy West location for daycare, training, and boarding. After enjoying these services, I was excited to try the facility's grooming services. Big mistake! The groomer (Summer) skinned my dog where a large chunk of skin is missing from my poor dog's throat. I have never had such a nightmare grooming experience! I won't return to this location to allow future torture sessions on my small dog and advise anyone who cares about the health of their dogs to tread carefully at this location.
Great place to dine in. Always recommend to make reservations if going because there is long wait.

The Barrio is a Tucson institution for a reason -- despite its odd location just south of downtown, in the middle of warehouses and railroad tracks, and a little hard to find the first time. But cross the tracks and it's totally worth it! For happy hour or dinner, this place always has a crowd, but not too crowded, and there's a treat every time a train rumbles past.

The microbrew beer is delicious -- I'm a big fan of the Redcat Amber and the Tucson Blonde. My IPA-loving friends tell me that's good, too. The food is pretty standard pub fare, especially the excellent pretzels.

Also: BEST shuffleboard table in Tucson.

This is one of those restaurants where the overall experience is what they are selling.  The line (and I am told there is always one) was probably 100 feet long when we arrived but it moved quickly (maybe 20 minutes to get in.)  The restaurant has been there for 72 years and the walls are filled with celebrities, Presidents, Generals who have all been there.  The food was good but certainly does not stand out in a city known for it's food.  However, as breakfast joints go this one gets top marks.
The ugly and way less hipper sister to Mellow Mushroom

My favorite movie theater in Boise, period. This place is an institution, always picking first rate indie films, great espresso drinks, and great service. If you are ever visiting the Boise area I really encourage you to go, order a glass of wine and a pretzel with cheese and enjoy a movie. Its not the newest movie theater in town or the most updated, but it has character and its where I fell in love with movies.

Made reservations one month in advance for fourth of July. Requested a certain floor as there was a group of us staying. No problem the gentleman said. Checked in and no where near what we requested. A perfect evening ruined!!!! Not staying again!!!

I really enjoyed eating here. The atmosphere is very relaxed and welcoming. The food was great, even the ketchup is homemade! I also love that the beef is grass-fed. The only thing that's kind of disappointing is that all of the sides like fries are extra.

Do yourself a favor and skip this fake representation of good food. I've not had one good experience after giving it several chances to redeem itself. The food is below average and the coffee is even worse. To make matters worse, you have to wait way too long to be grossly disappointed. I've complained, I've asked for refunds and there's been absolutely no change. Customer service is nonexistent. If I could give it no stars I would. Don't think twice about trying this spot in Nashville's airport. It'll leave you irritated at best

My Summer fling. Unless they stay open in the Fall!

This truck is magical. The Scoop N Roll is all the rage on Instagram. If you haven't seen the photos yet, then you are missing out on the #instafood #foodporn trend. The best part is that photos on the rolled ice cream will not only look good on your social media, but it tastes DELICIOUS. 

The rolled ice cream concept was started in Thailand, and is now the best ice cream in town. It is fresh and made right in front of your eyes. Yes there is usually a line-up especially on hot days. But be smart! Head there on a weekday evening for less of a crowd.

STEP 1: Choose your ice cream flavour. Flavours include vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, banana, mango, Thai tea, coffee, coconut, avocado, pistachio and Matcha green tea. I am attempting to try all of them, but so far the pistachio is killer.

STEP 2: Choose two mix-ins/toppings (extras are 50 cents a piece). Toppings include blueberries, strawberries, mango, pineapple, banana, nutella, oreo, chocolate chips, mint chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, reese's,  m&ms, rainbow sprinkles, marshmallows or almonds. Some are mixed in, whereas others are added on top. There are additional mix-ins for a charge: cheesecake ($1), ferrero rocher ($1.50) and honeycomb ($2).

They also have specials of the week that are mentioned on their Instagram. So the options are unlimited!

Plus, the staff are hilarious and super chill. They always ask if you are new and where you heard about the truck. Check it out!

Our new favorite Chinese restaurant!  Got the Mongolian chicken, bbq pork fried rice and house chow mein. Make sure you tell them what level spice.  Medium was burning our tongues!  They even let us order our meals with no veggies. Little on the pricey side, but sooooo worth it!!!!

James was flawless.  The decor is pleasing and thoughtfully simple.  The service was warm and well-trained; I felt the staff was extremely committed to helping us celebrate our anniversary.  The food was very good, and we were able to stretch our table time to about 2 hours with desserts and digestifs (and an amuse bouche).  I brought a Napa cab, which they were happy to accomodate.   $30 is relatively steep for corkage, but I was happy to pay it after the staff paired food recommendations to the wine.  All told we (2) were treated to a round of cocktails, amuse, apps, entrees, desserts, and dessert wines, plus corkage, for under $200 before tip.  Exceptional value and exceptional experience, a must if you are in Philly for one night.

I have to give this delightful little eatery 3 stars just for their fabulous back patio. Such a lovely little place to have a light lunch or a few drinks and starters. The service is good and the food is quite delicious. Decent portions. The decor is very casual but elegant. The prices are a bit on the high side IMO. I have never really quite understood why Italian restaurants are so expensive....I mean let's face it...a lot of us can make good italian food to rival what we get out...but still it is very nice and good. I enjoy coming here more for the patio and the relaxed feel.

Can I tell you how much fun me and my girls had last night? The mc was hype. The crowd was extra hype. My drunk was Poppin. And when I sang... The support was amazing  felt like a star baby 

The song list is not long, but it won't matter. Pick something that you like and own it. If you want a memory, let pay for your video BEFORE you hit the stage. I found out that part late. I would have loved to have that souvenir. I'll be back

Just took the prohibition tour and really liked it. 
We visited several area bars and learn some local history about Philly's probation days. The small pub tour was nice at to spend an evening. Now sitting in a hookah bar.

I would love to know the context for the 4 and 5 star ratings. Maybe compared to super market. Really average in my experience. Maybe if you are a roll fan it's ok but if you favor nigiri or sashimi not really more than just ok.

I've been there a number of times. I have never been disappointing their food. I usually get the combination platter.  my son loves their dumplings. To him, they're the best he's ever had. He judges other dumplings by the ones he gets at Golden Bowl.

I'm very optimistic and love to see the good in things.  I figure 1 mistake is completely understandable, as nobody is perfect and we all make mistakes!  

1st Mistake! (Parking)  We arrived at the hotel, and wait 10 minutes for someone to show up (valet driver) only to find out we aren't given the choice to park our own vehicle.  $38 a day to have your car valet!  Valet is the biggest scam I've ever seen in my life.  I can park my own vehicle and walk my happy self from my car to the hotel just fine.  When we asked how long in advance should we call and ask for our car, they tell us 15 minutes.  We called for our car 15 minutes (8:45pm to be exact) in advance like we were told, and wait.  15 minutes turns into 30 minutes, then 40 minutes, then after constant complaining on the wait, the valet guy let's us know they're right around the corner and will arrive in 30 seconds.  30 seconds turns into another 5 minutes, we waited 45 minutes for a car that never showed up.  At this point it's already 9:30pm and restaurants are closing, so we had to change the restaurant we were going to eat at.  Our car never showed up, so we cancelled the valet and had them take it back to wherever they (NEVER) got it and ate at a seafood joint across the street.  Don't valet here, valet across the street, TRUST ME!

2nd Mistake!  (Elevators)  You MUST use two different elevators to get to your room.  The first elevator will take you to the second floor, from which you MUST get off, walk around the corner to another elevator to get on and take you to your actual floor.

3rd Mistake!  (Towels)  By this time, you probably think I'm making things up and just bitter about something, NOPE these are all true statements!  We didn't have enough bath/face towels in our room so I called the desk to get more towels.  After literally 2 (TWO)/(DOS) hours, I go downstairs to the desk to see what's taking so long.  The guy says, "I'm sorry I see you did call a while ago, let me call again".  I wait, wait, wait and finally call again asking for an exact time I should expect towels, and the same guy I spoke to earlier says, "I'm sorry let me call again".  At this point I'm thinking, let me go find a housekeeper on one of these floors who has towels on their buggy.  I go up to the next floor and find a housekeeper vacuuming like nobody has called for service.  2 1/2 hours later the housekeeper says, "yes, let me get you some towels in 5 minutes", then continues to vacuum.  (SERIOUSLY)  15 minutes later towels finally arrive to our room.

4th Mistake!  (FALSE ADVERTISING)  If there's one thing in this world that doesn't boil my blood sooo bad, is a company of CEOs, Presidents, Directors and Shareholders who knowingly allows one of there business to operate, but does not stand behind what they say they offer.  Their website shows they have a pool, but what they don't tell you but rather let their employees tell you is that they don't actually have a pool.  They have a deal with the hotel connected to them (Ritz Carlton) who owns the pool, which charges $10/person to use their pool.  I didn't sign up for a deal will Marriott and Ritz Carlton!

Overall, the obvious is out in the open and many people here have voiced their opinion based on their service they received, but honestly (WHO PAID YOU TO GIVE 4 OR 5 STARS)???  Really, I NEED to know, did I stay in the wrong hotel thinking it was the Courtyard, haha I think not!  Very dissatisfied.

Waiter was non-cooperative and did not give the correct change to our bill.
