I used to love Distrito, even had my birthday party there years ago, but yesterday me and my family had a terrible experience. 

The good bit: the receptionist who welcomed us was really nice and took into account our seating preferences.

The slightly annoying part: our waiter. There was a special combo of dishes for the day: pick 2, pay 16$. The waiter kept insisting that we pick the more expensive option, which was having the 2 dishes separately. When I pointed to what we wanted he said "I am confused, don't you want the normal portion? This is smaller". Yes, I know, and we are fine with that. He eventually gave up and proceeded to write down the combo. A malicious person would think that the waiter was trying to push the more expensive version to increase his tip amount. 

The really bad ordeal: our waiter. I explicitly explained that my family wanted mild versions of what was on the menu and he assured me most absolutely that, in his words, "there's nothing hot or spicy" in here. Then we order a soup and it turns out to be as spicy and hot as hell. 
The waiter's comment was "well, Mexican food is spicy". Agreed, but you either provide a mild version or you tell us that it's not possible to have it mild, so we order something else. But it'd be great to know it before we actually order! In this way, we ended up asking the server to return the dish to the kitchen since we could not eat it.

The ugly part: again, the waiter. We asked for the check, paid cash and waited for the change to tip the waiter. Well, guess what? He came back and our change was $5 short!!!  I called the receptionist, explained the situation, and in 5 minutes here comes the waiter apologizing that the change was $5 short! We left $1 tip ad run away!
Again, a malicious person would think that the waiter, guessing he was probably not getting a good tip from us, decided to literally takes matters in his own hands. One usually rules this kinds of incidents as involuntary mistakes. The fact that it happened in a case in which the service was way below average, though, does create some grounds for suspicion.

I was very skeptical since it looked like a little hole in the wall. They serve actual chips with your fish  omg it was delicious! And I am a pain to please but I am so happy I walked 8 mins to come here! Thanks to all you yelp fans that rated  . And ooo my favorite wait for it.... $5 glasses of wine.... 

Ps service. A M A Z I N G !

Their weekend happy hour is incredible. We like to load up on $5 appetizers (pimento cheese hushpuppies, green chile cheese dip, deviled eggs topped with fried oysters, shishito peppers) and $5 old fashioneds. Yesterday I also tried the $5 fromosa, which was a good place to start for brunch. Several of us tried the lobster grilled cheese, which did not disappoint.

My husband just returned with dinner for our family, and he warned us that all three of our gyro salads might lack vegetables because the young woman told him that they ran out of them. When we opened our salads, I noticed the lettuce appeared wilted with a lot of hard pieces and only included black olives and tomatoes with a skimpy portion of dried out gyro meat. 

We were so hungry, and by the time we tried to call them back to complain, we couldn't reach anyone because it was already past 8:00 p.m. We attempted to eat our meals out of desperation, but they were just pitiful and did not taste like the gyro salads that we had purchased in the past from here. My stepdaughter even said the salad tasted funny and stopped eating it.

If they were running out of vegetables, and since a salad consists of vegetables, the apathetic young woman could have informed my husband that when he placed our order. We would have ordered something else or went elsewhere.

We barely ate our salads, and after realizing we weren't going to reach anyone since they were now closed, my husband had to step out and buy a second dinner for all of us at Arby's, which will probably be of much higher quality than the pathetic gyro salads from this place. 

We deserve our money back, but I'm sure we won't get it. If not, we will never be back or recommend this place to anyone. Excellent customer service goes a long way, and this place severely lacks just that unfortunately. If I could have given an accurate rating, I would have left zero stars for the non-existent customer service and awful food. 

There are too many wonderful non-chain food  establishments in this city to waste any more of our money on the trash that we received as "food" tonight from this joint. I wouldn't even feed this to our dogs.

What an incredible surprise in St Louis.  I've eaten Dim Sum in China, Singapore, Toronto, Vancouver, Seattle and SanFrancisco regularly and can't believe One of the best dim sum places is in St. Louis.  I love the traditional cart service and overall atmosphere.  Everything we tried was amazing.  Highly recommend the pineapple buns!  Before you think St Louis doesn't have any culture, think again.  It's not all about barbecue and toasted ravioli.

Classic bdubs. All your sauces, all your burgers and all your excellent appetizers. Too many tv's to count(only 121 :-] ) and no complaints with the beer selection. Can't wait for my next return trip.
Cute little boutique cafe with fresh squeezed mimosas. Generous variety of coffee and breakfast options for the broad palate. Highly recommended.

We took my mother here for her birthday and what a disappointment!  Service was just okay and for the cost of the meals the food was bland. The crab soup was a big glob of almost more pudding- like substance. Each platter was about $25-30 and the quality just wasn't there. I had the crab imperial which was bland. The broccoli was cold, and the award winning fries were nothing more than regular, plain old steak fries. Also, the decor was outdated and run down. For the money you are going to pay I suggest you try someplace that had atmosphere and where the quality of food is better! I will not be going back.

A much needed addition to the quarter! If you're looking for chinese food when you're wandering around Frenchman, walk a few minutes and you're find yourself at this spot. I came here on a Saturday night so i knew the wait was going to be long -- i used the yelp waitlist feature to save a spot in line. The hostess called  us when our table was ready and when we got there we were almost immediately seated! Couldn't have been an easier process.
Now, the food. Sooo good! I haven't had good chinese food in new Orleans in a while and this did not disappoint. We got the soup dumplings, the sizzling steak, salt and pepper squid, and the Peking pork chops. The dumplings and the steak were hands down the best things we got. Will definitely come back so we can try other items on the menu!

If you want run of the mill service, don't come here. If you want service that leave you inviting the waitress to your next party, you want Linda. While the uptight may be put off, ortino's delivers a dining experience that's like a warm blanket on a cold day. And the beer selection is unbelievable. You won't leave disappointed.  Or hungry.

ok so yes I am really picky with my food these days, and as I get older I get pickier. I am even more pickier with my pizza and italian food. Today we tried a place called Rocco's. I have to say it was the BEST pizza I have had in over 25 years! Also, the chicken Marsala was AMAZING! I hope they stay in business and stay making it so good! We will definitely be repeat customers.  Cant wait to try the chocolate italian ice!!!

Went here two days after Mother's Day. We ordered salads and ate through two loaves of bread. I ordered steak and lobster and she orders a steak as well. London, the manager, had noticed it was taking long and came up to our table to talk with us. She said she was comping the whole meal and asked if we wanted an appetizer while we waited but we said we were fine. Food came out eventually. My steak was well done (asked for medium) but hey, you can't complain about free food. She felt bad so she gave me a $10 gift card for our next visit. We even ordered a chocolate parfait and then they told us they accidentally made a second one. Looking back on it, I should have bought a lottery ticket at the rate this night was going!

Only side note: our server made no effort to let us know that our food was taking long, nor did she ask us how it was once we got it. All she said was "sorry for everything" at the end. I figured it was just her personality: get right to the chase and do her job.

"A-Ok" suits Ciao's perfectly.  A very cool location in Trolley Square section of Wilmington, DE.

I found the staff at Ciao's to be extremely pleasant.  From taking my order on the phone to the personal interaction while in the shop, the staff was as friendly as they come.

They make a decent pie here.   A great blend of cheese and sauce with some fresh pepperoni made this a winner.  Ciao's also does a great job of making condiments easily accessible and available.

The only challenge here is the parking.  Due to the shape of the building which is very cool, the dining are is relatively small.
They say a photo says a thousand words and all I can say is the owner of this place made my entire wedding, easy, fun, beautiful and easy!!!! Love this spot!

This is a fish out of water story.

So I'm en route to El Fuego for some 'ritos when the signage outside Chops catches my roommate's eye. The exchange goes something like this:

"I wonder if that place is any good."
"I dunno, but it's probably pretty fancy."
"Nah dude, check it, $6 burgers!"
"Hell, alright, let's go."

So we enter, the both of us dressed for dinner at a low-rent burrito spot; t-shirts, shorts, baseball caps. As we cross the threshold of the second set of doors, it's quickly become apparent my initial instinct of "fancy" is about seven shades of understatement. This place is opulent! Before we're able to realize just what we've gotten ourselves into, the greeter (in appropriate suit & tie) approaches and has the same deer-in-headlights look in his eye that I'm sure the both of us maintained. I'm waiting for a line about dress codes and a quick escort to the door we'd just walked through, but was instead welcomed and simply asked, "Two?"

Not one to shy away from an awkward social situation for the sake of a decent story, we follow the gentleman to our table located a few feet away. We're seated and finally have a moment to take in just how posh this joint really is. It felt like we had just sat down to dinner in an opera house--incredibly high ceiling, gigantic mural against the far wall, flowing curtains to cover the multi-story windows. I at least have the insight to take off my hat. My roommate does the same.

Moments later we're approached by our waitress, Kanika, and are offered our choice of bottled or ice water. With a glance at our matted hair and my college football t-shirt, there's a subtle moment between the three of us and mutual recognition that we don't really belong there. Far from giving us any grief, I detect a slight smile creep onto our server's face and a good-humored acceptance of the situation.

Resigned to fully experiencing Chops, we don't even bother looking for any $6 burgers (though I suspect we may have just missed that lunch special and were now considered dinner guests). I order a steak, my dining companion, the veal. A few of the other reviews here have commented on over/under cooked meat, I'll say that Kanika came by our table about 15 minutes after we had put in our order to reassure me that due to the size of my steak, they were making extra sure that it was cooked as ordered--medium.

When she returns to our table with our food, I'm faced with what can only be described as an XXL concussion grenade looking slab of meat. This thing is massive. And curiously rotund. I can also say, quite delicious! My roommate enjoys his veal. You know that you're underdressed for an establishment when the team of not one but two people who come by to refold the napkin your company has tossed aside while heading to the restroom are both dressed far nicer than you. All of the desserts shown to us looked incredible but we were both far too stuffed to attempt such a feat.

We are presented with the bill, wished a good evening, and asked to come back. Dinner didn't go at all as planned but we had an unexpectedly humorous time and some tasty food. I'll be sure to at least wear pants next time.
Man! I've gone to Archie's every Saturday for lunch since 2015. The hamburger is amazing and the service is excellent!! I strongly recommend the not so giant w/ bacon! So yummy!!!

Not very good and a little pricey for bagels. Everyone else had breakfast sandwiches on bagels and had the same feelings I had. I had the "shmears" trio which is 3 little bagel balls filled with cream cheese shmear. I had two cookies and cream and an Asiago. The Asiago was actually good and I wish I just got three of those. The cookies and cream were disgusting. Not a real chocolate taste, I don't know how to describe it lol. Would not order again.

This place has THE best Pad Thai so far that I have found. The restaurant itself is not overly busy with dine ins but they do a lot of business for take out.

Definitely on my favorites list.

I didn't know my Server understood English well or didn't know much about food on the menu, I think both. Dim sum wasn't worst or best I had. Place is new so it looked clean and nice. I don't think I'll go back. If I want good dim sum I'll spend little more time and drive to Chinatown in philly.

I really liked this place.  I am lactose intolerate so I went in thinking I wasn't going to get anything.  The woman showed me their selection of sorbet.  I was super excited.  I tried the green grape and I thought it was wonderful.  The mouth-feel was great.  It was smooth and silky.  I cannot tell you anything about the gelato, but the sorbet was great.  I would definitely try if I was in town again.  I now want to see if the gelato spots in DC compare.
I absolutely love this place! The grilled chicken Parmesan with spinach is my favorite. The cheesesteaks are pretty good too.
this shit salty af like super duper salty salty as a bitch i'd rather eat an MRE, bad service in general.

OMG, this place is AMAZING!!  Natalia, the Manager, and Eric, our server were top of the line.  Great personalities, very knowledgeable, and so very friendly.

The food was out of this world. Fresh, farm to table.  Wine was spectacular.  I suggest sitting outside for the full experience.  

This place is a must try!!

I will be back again and again, and bring anyone that I know!

Thank you Natalia and Eric, do not forget, we need to do a community rehab and bring the Olde Heights Bistro to its fullest potential.  I am in, and will help any way that I can!!!

Till next time my friends.

Patty

I didn't get enough time to really enjoy this place because we were rushing to check out of our hotel, but the quick impression we got was awesome. We tried an iced mocha and an iced Cuban which was perfect. The iced Cuban wasn't too sweet, but just right. And it wasn't too creamy, but just right. And same goes for the mocha. We got a little hipster vibe here which I liked. And the patio looked pretty if the weather was nice. Definitely recommendations worthy
Kevin and staff are the greatest. Will miss seeing them after I'm released. I have more movement than I've had in a long time.

If you've never ended up here at 3 am, drunk off your ass, eating mozzarella sticks (which, by the way, are legitimately the best I've ever had. No bullshit) and being extra kind and respectful to the overnight staff, did you even really have a good time?

The answer is no. No night is complete without a stop at the Mayfair Diner before you Uber home.

My signature move is to spend all night at McKenna's, across the street, and mosey on over to grab some late night bad-for-you food. And a hot chocolate, cause that's my thing. Go here, enjoy their stuff, tip your waitresses.
First the customer service was excellent. We went here for the ice cream. I had the strwberry ice cream. I am eating this 4 stars for ice cream, the extra star is for the comforting customer service.

My husband and I visited this place last weekend. It came highly recommended for their New Mexican cuisine. It is probably one of my favorite cuisines. I am from Phoenix and I frequented Richardson's often,so they are pretty hard to top. I decided to give this place a try with hopes it would be as good as Richardson's.  The night we dined there, we got there about 7:30 and we're told there was no air conditioner in the main dining room so they were using their banquet room. Fine, it happens. We were told there was no room their either but we could dine in the bar. We were starving so we did. The bartender was attentive and friendly. I had a wine and my husband had a beer. We ordered the New Mexican plate which had a taco, enchiladas and a chili rellano. I have to say the taco was great but the rest was subpar. I had a chicken chimichanga with green sauce on the side. The chino was more bread than meat. It was ok. The green sauce was phenomenal!!!! So yummy. Overall I probably would not go back. Service was great!!!
Awesome shop, very friendly staff. Nose piercing is perfect!

I had a great experience here, so I cannot speak to all the other reviewers. Staff is friendly, attentive, and they try to get you in and out as quickly as possible. Many different choices for oil based on your needs and they offer a free top off of your oil between changes. I was able to get my car completely checked out for no extra charge. Will be coming back in the future.

We had a great time last evening at Great Basin. The outdoor seating area was comfortable and we enjoyed food and beer. 

I had the fish and chips and I appreciated having a few choices of chips. I went with the sweet potato chips and would do it again. 

My son had a burger and thoroughly enjoyed it. 

I recommend the Icky IPA if your an IPA fan.

We chose Kota for our 'regular-dinner-get togethers' last Saturday night with friends. It is one of many 'to-try' choices in my Yelp bookmarks. For a party of 8, there was no trouble getting a table as the Fox was vacant this weekend. I am sure this is a much different venue with the pre-show crowds. Nevertheless, love the location of this place and the real city-feel you get in Grand Center. Suffice it to say, having lived in the city for many years, Grand Center really has come to life.

The service was aces, with a very attentive hostess, bartender and server. Again, it was a slower night. The waitress even walked us to the table pointing carefully to the short set of stairs. The decor is tasteful with carefully selected art and a huge row of colored glass and low lighting to add ambiance. Very comfortable space.

Trying to describe 'New American' style of cuisine invites some laughter, but indeed it's interpretation can vary depending on the chef. Someone in our party got excited for the cajun dishes offered, another the variety of vegetarian choices. Presentation was good. We started with the calamari, ahi tuna tostadas  and stuffed mushrooms for the table. Our entire group seemed pleased. The tostadas have been reviewed before, and they are that good - not the best by any means - but served on a plantain chip gave this app a good flavor.

For the main course, I ordered the Voodoo Shrimp Pasta (hickory fired shrimp with squid ink fettuccini in jalapeno cream sauce, with roasted corn and poblano peppers). And it appeared every one asks the server what 'squid ink' fettuccini  is; simply by the look on her face when we did the same. For the record, it is just dark-colored noodles. The flavors were great. The cream sauce brought out the bite and made the shrimp rather tasty and juicy. Good dish. We had a duck connoisseur of sorts on-hand and commented on trying that the coconut curry duck linguini was very lacking. It was the only dish that offered us an option of leftovers. The jambalaya - made with mussels - was said to be very good.

Before I forget, Koda offers Delirium Tremens on tap here which is an excellent Belgian pale ale if you like yours strong.

Because of it's proximity to the Fox, I am sure the mood of the restaurant changes between casual and semi-formal, depending on the night. My recommendation, to soak in the surroundings and your meal, go when there is not a show. But alas, it fits the bill for a perfect dining option where you can where your jeans and yet eat a refined, creative menu.

My standards arent very high if I'm ordering dollar fiddy fish tacos after work on a Friday night but they would suffice under normal circumstances. You could reproduce them by pan frying cod and chopping up cabbage and red onions and adding cheese but frankly I am just too lazy to go to the trouble. My only real gripe is that the salsa and the taco sauce they included are both way too sweet. Please lay off the sugar...

It is a fun environment and I can see this as a good place for a family or work dinner. I might come back one day to try something different.

Went here for Saturday brunch with my mom and brother. We ordered the shakshuka, the full monty, and the salmon eggs benedict along with a side of mac and cheese and the butterscotch cake. The shakshuka was alright, but a bit flavorless, and I thought hey would have baguette bread with it, but it was smaller kind of bread that wasn't as airy as baguette bread. It was a 3 out of 5. 

The salmon eggs benedict came with potatoes that were really small and were too crunchy, so we were basically eating pieces of burnt potato. However the eggs benedict was alright and was also a 3/5. 

The full monty was a bit underwhelming and I wish I got the croque madame. The waiter gave me a description of savory and sweet, which I'm all about. But really it was just french toast with cheese and bacon. It wasn't sold well and wasn't as good as others I've tried. The reason why I didn't get the croque madame is because it didn't include the french toast, which from my brunch experience most places have that as the bread. 

The mac and cheese was average and could have had more flavor. The butterscotch cake was like any other pound cake you could get in a store, but did taste more "homemade."

The ambience of the restaurant was really good. It is very much a cute place to go with family or friends and the waiters are so nice. I like the set up they had and I feel like it wasn't crowded (seating setup-wise) like other brunch places where you could turn your head and enter the other tables personal space from how close you are. 

I would recommend this place if you would like a chill, non-fancy brunch with family or a group of friends.

Fun little stop when your in the mood for ice cream but want something different.  The ice cream rolled are cute and a medium goes a long way.  Decent pricing for the serving size and tons of combos offered or you can come up with you own.

As far as all you can eat sushi this is on the the best places I have been.  The food is great.  They have a pretty extensive menu for lunch and dinner.  I like that they make their Philadelphia rolls with avocado and not cucumber like some other places.  I took a star away for service.  We have been several times and the service is very inconsistent.  Some times it is amazing, sometimes it is mediocre and once it has been terrible.

Everything about this hotel is clean, comfortable, modern but not overdone. All of the staff are attentive, kind, and helpful. It's an easy walking distance from great food and bars (not to mention the restaurant and bar downstairs). If this place is in your price range, definitely consider staying here on your New Orleans trip, even just for one night.

My favorite go-to place for quick Mexican in Tucson. All fresh house-made ingredients like the many salsas. Of course you have to order the name sake quesadilla but everything is good and flavorful. Friendly service too.

Not good the Hispanic lady there is the worst Hispanic to Hispanic racist I've ever seen (were Hispanics too) asked for some thing and she gave me some thing totally different. Badddddd experiencee evererrrramd her attitude omggggggggg

I am a big fan of Virago.  This is where my husband and I had our first date so it will always be a special place to us! 

First off, if you have not been up to their roof top bar on a nice night- you are missing out!  They have a great view of downtown and the casual upstairs is the perfect place to begin the night with a pre dinner cocktail.  I suggest the wasabi martini.  It sounds intense but it is truly delicious!   The lobster shooters are a great appetizer to go with the spicy edamame.  They have this  signature spice sauce they use, V2, it is awesome.  I'd buy it to cook with at home if they had it for sale.  My husband also always likes to get the yellowtail jalapeño appetizer, it has a great flavor but you could eat it all in one bite!    

Why we like Virago a lot is because we feel the sushi is good quality.  We have never had a piece that has been questionable.  Typically we get a couple pieces of sashimi and a few nigiri (which fish depends on the night).  Then we finish off with one or two rolls, the New Moon is one of my favorites.  For two people we eat out fair share in sushi!  

We recently went with a couple who does not like sushi (so sad for them) and they introduced us to the rock cooked wagyu beef which was unreal! Super good, and so fun to cook your own meat.  They also got the coconut rice which was like a desert.  It is very sweet, but not overpowering sweet, and complements the beef perfectly! 

I would recommend Virago, make sure to get a reservation early as they do fill up!
Go see TJ!  Easy to get an appointment.  Super friendly and great a cutting hair.  Highly recommend.

Legendary Teri holds up to every ounce her Legendary name.  She has been the best thing for our dog Luna.  Not only did she help train Luna but she took her out to the park and on walks and hikes several time a week. 
There isn't anyone I would trust more to take care of our dog.  
She instantly gives off that "pack leader" vibe and Luna listened to every word she said.  She took the time to work with us - the humans- and explain the reasons behind her training method so it made perfect sense.  

She is warm and patient and extremely knowledgeable in her work.  I would and have recommended her to anyone that has asked. 
We miss her so much since she moved from Seattle, but I feel happy for the lucky people who decide to work with her next!

This dealership explemifies how car salesmen are slimy. Slick talking and not delivering on what they say. You get half of what is promised. Never received the overages i paid for car nor my deposit check back. Gave me the run around on a warning signal that they claimed would go away, when it didnt they said dealer needed to reset, got to dealer and found out it was a bad central curcuit that not only impacted the sensor causing the warning light but also the door locks and cost me close to 600 to repair. When called on it of course it took forever to get anyone on the phone,  i was told by the manager that i should have contacted them, they could have negotiated a better price. WTH,  why didnt you fix in the first place. Then they replaced brake pads that were just fine and now i have a vibration when trying to brake at high speeds. Dealership says pads are warped. SMH they're slow and unless youre buying an expensive care, the customer service is typically poor. Other than that, the car is fine.

Was really looking forward to a Reuben sandwich so we ordered takeout for dinner. Have been here numerous times, but not recently. My husband repeated the order to the hostess when he picked up our order. But when we got home- my sandwich? Some corned beef on rye bread!! No melted cheese, no sauerkraut, no sauce but a plain corned beef sandwich on some damp rye bread. Then my husbands sandwich was missing the thousand island dressing. Soooo disappointed. Any recourse? Nope, but surely won't get takeout from here again.....

Thanks yelpers for this local gem. I was prepared for a Sunday morning wait but it was only 15 minutes. Friendly service. Amazingly fresh ingredients. Soup today was mushroom Gouda. Homemade perfection filled with mushrooms and cracked pepper. Breakfast wrap came with two big eggs, turkey sausage, side of guacamole was a nice twist. Fruit cup with more than stale melon - raspberry, strawberry, blueberries, oh my!!!!
This is a must visit.
Lunch menu looks equally delicious.
I'll be back.

Talk about the hours! What place in the Westbank is open on Sunday at 10pm?!

This place is amazing! The food is generous and really good, and it's not crazy expensive. This is always my go to Mediterranean restaurant. The hummus is delicious, as well as the combination plate and some fresh baklava to end the meal right.

The staff is always super nice and respectful. Absolutely recommend making Sahara one of your regulars!

I ordered the side salad and tamale's with a side of chili. The salad was fresh and the tamale's tasted great. My daughter ordered the garlic cheese bread and a side salad she ate every bite. We will dine at Soulshine again very soon.

My favorite new discovery!  The boyfriend and I had an AWESOME brunch here to start off our Valentines celebration.  The food was delicious and beautifully presented, the service was speedy & friendly, the decor was adorable, and the drinks kicked ass and were half off!!!  What is not to love about this place?  We made reservations and I would recommend doing that because it did get a tad crowded.  Try the bloody mary even if you are not really a fan because it is out of this world and it will convert you....true story.  I say go here and spread the word.  And try the eggs Benedict with the salmon because you will fall in love.  I will absolutely be back here and next time I will try dinner and dessert.

Went for breakfast  the Croque Madame was HUGE. Two eggs on top of a huge sandwich and the wonderful red new potatoes done with andouille and scallions has been enough to last till the Saints game celebration if not till tomorrow!
Jarred's new place is as good as his others

We stumbled upon this gem at 2:15am after consuming copious amounts of cocktails at Hop Sing Laundromat..... This was our saving grace to not having such an excruciating hangover.

We started with snow pea leaves, pan fried dumplings, and salt and pepper seafood -  All of which were fantastic.  We proceeded to have some other delicious things that I honestly cannot remember but know that there wasn't anything that we didn't enjoy!  

Good Food - BYOB - Open late :) :) :)

I have mixed feelings about my visit here. Two days ago I spent the morning hiking in Saguaro National Park.  I feel that maybe I saw more there?  But maybe if you have children, you prefer to introduce them to the desert here rather than on a trail?
Currently, you have to make a timed reservation & purchase your ticket online.  I am fine with that.  I wish the website had a big notice that masks are required not only inside, but also outside.  I would have skipped my visit rather than be forced to mask outside. Even Biden announced masks are no longer necessary outdoors for fully vaccinated people.
I felt especially bad for the coyote who looked a bit thin and paced in his pen.  I have seen healthier looking ones in the wild. I also felt sorry for the reptiles in their small glass enclosures.  At least these were the only rattlers I have seen in 10 days!
Good book selection in the gift shop!  I was happy to see everything from cook books to history books to guides to identifying cactus.  Everyone working on site was super nice.
Just don't feel this is a good stop if you have already hiked in the National Park.

Last time I went to this place and ordered a noodle bowl. And then it was tasting okay until I found a dead bug in my noodle bowl. I asked the waitress to come and look at it. She saw it and then she didn't know what to do about it so she asked the owner to come. The owner came and then didn't admit that it's a dead bug. Didn't even say sorry and just told us that it is just something from the bone. But I have three friends with me. All of us see there are wings for that bug. How come that if it is not a bug, there are wings? So I never went to this place again.

First time there.
Didn't stay long.
Don't feel the need to go back.
I won't be missed.

They wanted a credit card even though I was going to pay cash.

Good thing their not the only indoor range in Reno.

Amazing food...amazing customer service!!  Used a gift card to pre-order New Year's Eve dinner online and arrived there at around 5PM only to discover we had received an email informing us that our online order never actually was received by the Brentwood location due to "technical difficulties" of some sort.  The server came out to our car (we were there for curbside service) to apologize to us for what had happened and informed us that the manager was putting our original order as top priority to get ready ASAP and that we did not have to pay for the dinner!!  They covered the cost of the entire thing (3 meals).  It was well over $100, which left us with a full gift card that we still get to use.  Of course, we were upset in the beginning when we were informed we would have to wait, but we ended up only waiting about 15 minutes, and the manager made our evening when the restaurant covered the entire cost.  That is great customer service!  And the food was done to perfection (as it always is).  This has become one of our favorite places to get carry-out during the pandemic.  We have never had any issues at all with our many orders.  Thank you so much for going above and beyond!

We had food delivered to my work for our International Women's Day forum and it was fabulous. Very fresh taste, loved the kale salad, the grilled chicken, grilled broccoli & green beans, quinoa. All was yummy!! I did hear we requested the grilled brussel sprouts & they were out of them so a little disappointing. Food was great though!!

The amount of traffic that comes in, out and around this post office is already an off-putting feature of the post office itself.  When you throw in the fact that the postal employees on the inside are the least helpful bunch of postal employees (most likely to go postal?) that I've encountered in a while.

To my senators and congressmen/congresswomen:  please let the post office quit Saturday and Wednesday service, please let the Postmaster General renegotiate postal union contracts and retiree benefits, and most of all let the Postmaster General eliminate the debt and the waste.  I'd rather pay the $10 extra to go to a FedEx Office or UPS Store than to set foot in the post office - particularly, this branch of this post office.  

Rude, rude and more rude-ness.
Tony was super and attentive to our every wish our food was super Delicious and a great place to eat
Worst Starbucks experience. The baristas here need to find a job in something other than customer service.

The manager Chesley took the time to reach out previously with a negative experience and went above and beyond to make it right, even a year later. We had a very good experience today and definitely recommend Altitude!

It's Friday... I was hungry & Banh Street served up deliciousness.... The Ribeye Hoagie offered up the right amount of spice & tenderness & I paired with an in-house made Lemongrass Ginger Tea (cold) but you could heat it up.... Hands down Banh Street is a great culinary experience.

First of all, misadvertises the fact that there are "no minimums". There are indeed minimums. Then, chatting with customer service was absolutely useless, as they basically said 'yeah, there are minimums except for these few shirts'....and then stopped chatting ENTIRELY! Based on the last 15 minutes of nonsense, I wouldnt recommend this company to anyone

I cannot recommend Modern Aesthetic Plastic Surgery and Michelle enough! The whole experience from the time I called, through my consultation and appointment, to when I checked out was just incredible. Definitely go see them, they'll make you feel so comfortable! A wonderful experience
Ate here tonight and the food was superb. We had the soup 1-1-1, the apple salad, the shrimp + grit, flambé bananas and bread pudding souffle. Great wait staff and experience!!
I picked Leo because reviews mentioned he was great for back pain.  It is true!  After 90 minutes all my aches and pains are gone.  Great job!

I'm torn about this review, because this could very easily be a fantastic and modern gym with just a small amount of effort from the owner/employees.  The equipment is up to par (though some of it is spaced too closely together) and the facility itself is a nice size for our town, but the operation practices of this place do not prioritize cleanliness, comfort, or customer service (things I really appreciate in a gym that costs $600/year).  

Most often, there are only two spray bottles available to clean up equipment.  On week nights it is not uncommon to find 15-20 people in the gym at one time so this is not sufficient.  Additionally, they do not leave out clean wipe rags to clean up after you use the equipment (I sweat, ALOT).  You have to ask someone at the counter for these rags, or take the initiative to grab them from under the front counter desk yourself.  This discourages people from cleaning up after themselves and is a pretty embarrassing practice.  It is like asking for toilet paper in my opinion. An easily solvable issue/practice - one that I've mentioned to at least two employees with no results.  They used to provide disposable disinfectant wipes in a dispenser, but I was told the dispenser fell off the wall and they couldn't figure out how to put it back on.  In the same week, they managed to install a 60" tv 12ft into the air, go figure.  I guess they thought it was an expendable amenity and chose not to replace the dispenser.   

One of the biggest issues I had this summer was the lack of air conditioning.  When you sign up for this gym and see the nice HVAC system installed do not be fooled.  They do not use it.  Even on hot days it is rare to find it on.  The gym doesn't have great natural ventilation so it always hotter inside than outside...not using the AC is just absurd.  I asked one of the female employees what their air conditioning policy was, and she said they didn't have one.  It just depends on who is working. We are paying for a modern gym, use the air conditioning.  OK?  

The 3rd treadmill from the front of the gym is still broken after being a member for almost a year.  I have told two employees and the owner about the issue.  After about a mile of running the machine abruptly loses all power.  For some reason, the owner does not see this as a liability, but I do.  I no longer use that treadmill, but watched it happen to a patron last night and it is dangerous.  

I did have a major issue with one of the employees, but the owner corrected this and I will not fault him for that.  However, the employee still attends the gym so I just give up.    

If you are picky, if you appreciate great customer service, etc. the convenience factor of this gym will eventually wear off and you will find yourself joining the YMCA in Montecito for $10 dollars more a month (they have a pool!).  I'm to that point.  All of the small things add up, ya know?

At first service was a little slow I'd say. Second time I went there they were freaking awesome!
Food and drinks in no time, friendly service, and good quality. And they have Heineken! You can't go wrong with their boneless wings. It was kind of busy but I was in and out in half hour. Just the way I like it. Keep it up Hooters!

Great location with parking close to store front easily accessible. Large selection of frames and sunglasses with a friendly knowledgeable staff made selecting the right frames simple. Dr Tom handled my daughters eye exam perfectly too.
The depot chicken and fries were AMAZING!! Super fast service and really friendly atmosphere. Jake is the best, he took great care of us! Will definitely be back!

This restaurant is offering takeout during the pandemic which is awesome. It's easy to place your order online. You'll receive a notification when your meal is ready. My husband ordered the Grande Burrito. It's filled with grilled Angus Steak and Citrus Chicken, Chipotle Salsa, topped with a Parmesan Crust.  You can't beat the price at $13. It's so much food he had to save some for the next day. He said it tasted just as good as the day he ordered the meal. I ordered the grilled Chipotle Tiger Shrimp Tacos with pineapple papaya salsa. It was $12 for three tacos. It was really good and tasted fresh. For the beverage, we ordered the Mango Passion. It's a mix of mango, orange juice, passion fruit and ginger. It was only $5 for the drink which is awesome. We'll definitely order it again. Looking forward to visiting again.

I rarely give out 5 stars, but Butcher & Singer deserves praise. I decided to take my wife here for her birthday. I noted it was her birthday on the OpenTable reservation. The host graciously said happy birthday to her as she completed seating us at our table. No further mention was made. That is until the very end when we finally decided to order some cheesecake (which was very good by the way). They took time to decorate the plate with Happy Birthday! written in chocolate and also had a lit candle. 

The dinner was extremely good. We opted to have a mix of east and west coast oysters followed by the Porterhouse for 2. The oysters were very good, but I must say the steak tasted great and was cooked to perfection. 

I can't believe it took me so long to finally try this restaurant. It is a great place to go for a special occasion or just to have a great steak!

GET THE BONUTS (Biscuit Donuts)!! They are heaven and you will be dreaming about them when you go back home. They are topped with a delicious whipped cream and the bottom is covered in blueberry sauce. They provide plenty of sauce at the bottom, so you can swirl the bonuts all up in it! Because they are sweet, you should be too and share them! ;)

We also ordered the Nasty Princess (Spicy Chicken Biscuit), and it was sooooooo good! But, it wasn't really spicy, and the chicken/biscuit ratio is a bit off by having a little more biscuit than chicken. You can also add an egg to the chicken biscuit, which can be already on the sandwich or on the side. 

There most likely will be a long line if you show up for brunch, so come early, and figure out what you are going to eat while you wait in line. You pay and order first, and they will give you a number to find a table, so be on the lookout for table. There is additional seating outside in the back.

Gecko Pest Management is professional, knowledgeable, and thorough.  They came out and did the assessment and initial visit. The owner was very knowledgeable and knew exactly what I needed for preventative pest control at my home. I'm now on their every other month preventative plan which has the best value for the price based on the 4 other quotes I got. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality and professional pest control in Tucson.

I love love love Bibo. Never have a bad coffee or tea, service is always great. I just wish they offered more food options. the scones are a bit of  a weird texture for me (again for me others may not feel that way) But then again I am here for the coffee.

They hire unskilled movers who have no experience in moving. they are not professional movers in any capacity they do not know how to load a truck and they do not know how to use a hand truck. If you have cheap furniture that is fine but if you have expensive furniture then you need to hire a professional company and clearly Big Boys moving hires people who have never moved before. they rank themselves no. 1 for the last 5 years as the best movers in tampa yet fail to disclose that it was from laofing magazine that they had paid and falsely claim that this is a national ranking. False advertisement. they are anything but professional movers. Hire a family company who actually have a skill set in moving. Big Boys are a Bull in a China shop. Stay clear away from this low end Franchise...

The sushi here is great! The rolls are plentiful and the mix of flavors is perfect. They don't overpower you or underwhelm of what you choose.

The sushi tastes fresh and doesn't "weigh" you down. I'm guessing the rice they use is minimal in sodium. 

Always clean location, jpop in radio and staff is always friendly.
Great smoothies and usually pretty good customer service. The avocado toast tho had way too much stuff on it imo but some people may enjoy that.

We are regulars at this location, usually ordering online for takeout.  We have always had good food and service and our orders are always spot on.  It's one of the few places I can get a veggie sandwich and feel like it's hearty and satisfying.  They don't skimp on the fillings!  Hubby usually gets the Cheesesteak or Rueben.  The bread is the best sandwich bread because it's soft enough for biting in to but firm enough to hold the ingredients without getting soggy or falling apart.  I love the marble rye and they are super great about swapping bread options or adding things like dill pickles if you want.  Hubby LOVES their cookies.

Hands down my favorite Mexican joint. The chips are perfectly paired with spicy salsa and a mild quest. Have never had something I disliked. Fried ice cream as a finishing touch!!

My only complaint is that the arroz con pollo (my absolutely favorite) has had many chicken surprises lately. This could be the careless cooking trying to keep up with demands. It just sometimes is unappetizing to pick fat from your mouth when eating your dinner.

Beware the drive thru

If you want to use the drive thru make sure you have a lot of time on your hands. Several times I have been here and waited more than 20 minutes with only a few cars ahead. You get trapped if someone comes behind you and can't leave. Need better management or training.

I am so glad that I found this coffee shop!! Their espresso is delicious!!! We are lucky enough to live only 2 miles away and this is my first stop on my Saturday morning errands!!

The artwork they feature in house is of local artists and I always feel like I'm sitting in a really cozy living room!! 

My boyfriend loves their food and they have a pretty extensive and impressive tea selection!! A must stop on your way through coffee shop!! 

Also... The owner is so freakin cool!!!

My go to lunch spot on Mass Ave and by far has the best lunch special in town. The waitresses are always nice and I love that they remember your order. My go to meal is the Beef Hot Pad Thai in which I could eat for days.

This was the most awful experience I've ever had at a nail salon. The lady was rude and sloppy. My feet were so rough after the callus removal part of my pedicure that I left before she finished. The salon felt dirty. They put flowers in the water that look like they've been used all week. The techs talk to each other in their native language and laugh loudly. It was the most uncomfortable I've ever been at a nail salon.

We have been looking for a new veterinarian since we moved to Eagle and had the very good fortune of meeting Dr. Fineman at Paramount Animal Care. I cannot say enough about this very talented and caring doctor. He's extremely knowledgeable about recent developments in treatment and will never treat your pet using cookie cutter methods.  His diagnoses are accurate and based on sound medical evidence and he will not prescribe medications with out thoroughly explaining interactions or side effects.  He also LISTENS. Dr. Fineman suggested a new Rx for our dog's chronic issues that no one ever mentioned before. He most definitely puts quality health care above the profit motive...can't say that for all the vets we've had in the past!
The staff members at PAC are also very kind, considerate, and professional. I've had so many negative experiences at doctors offices, with surly front office staff, that I will no longer frequent those businesses. At PAC you will find the most friendly and courteous staff who go out of their way to make your pet comfortable and welcomed. We've dealt mostly with Sarah, Mariah, and Cheryl....all exceptionally talented!  Cheryl was even able to trim the nails of our one pup who does not like his feet touched.  He was so calm when he came back to the waiting room and I was in awe.
Dr. Fineman is also very involved in various animal rescue groups and organizations. He even took in a little kitty who someone heartlessly tossed in a dumpster and found a new home for the adorable boy! We feel so fortunate to have Dr. Fineman and his staff in charge of our critters' care.
Not too crowded on the weekends. Korean beef tacos were wonderful, served with cilantro and lime. Will be back to sit outside next time.

Alessandro's... a takeout pizza and beer joint. To be honest, I mostly go here to take-out beer because it was* so walkable from my apartment.

In addition to the usual suspects, such as Coors, Miller, Yuengling, etc., they have some interesting, craftier beers (e.g., Samuel Adams seasonal beers, Ommegang, Victory, and more). However, the pricing system for a mix-and-match six-pack is kinda weird here. Apparently, to get a six-pack deal, grab 6 beers from the same column in the fridge. Different columns have different prices. Except it only works *sometimes*-- i.e., I tried mixing and matching six different beers from the same column and I didn't get a six-pack deal. Different employees, different rules? Eh, whatever works, man.

The employees aren't exactly always on the up-and-up, but service tends to go goes pretty smoothly and quickly. As for the food, we've had their salads and pizzas, which are generously portioned and pretty decent on the taste scale--even as leftovers!

*Recently moved away.

We just had dinner here and we were blown away at how delicious it was!! The server was also super friendly and made sure we had everything, and even explained some of the dishes to us. This was by far the best Mexican we have had in Reno and I've lived here my whole life.
We had shrimp chile rellanos, beef enchiladas, tres leche cake and the chocolate cake. We will definitely be regulars here on out!

Oh, and when we ordered the chocolate cake, our server said it was the last piece and it's normally much larger so he didn't even charge us for it!!! Such an awesome guy, and an awesome place!

Indigo and I were on our way home from shopping at the mall and I was hungry. I wanted mac n cheese and remembered that bbq4life had some. We ordered lemonade,  tempeh tacos, mac n cheese (they have a vegan option which is yummy but I tried the regular for a change)and chocolate cake. Everything was delicious as always, service was fantastic and prompt. The lovely staff were very kind and thoughtful. 
Indigo gives bbq4life 20 stars.

I stopped in here for a margarita with a couple friends. It was AWESOME, they only use fresh lime juice. The bartender was sassy, but she really knew what she was doing. We sat at the tiny bar downstairs on a Friday night. It wasn't too crowded, but they had a cool DJ. Seems like a good place to go hang out for late night drinks.

Wow! Hands down some of the best banana french toast and breakfast burrito we've ever had. Strong coffee as well! My GF and I are huge breakfast fans and only hit up the best spots when away from home. Not sure why these guys don't have 5 stars. Hit them up if you're seeking a food orgasm :)

Haven't been here since they opened. We got here around 11:30. There was a little wait but not too bad. Waiter we had was very quick. He got our drink orders right away and our glasses never went empty. Took a little long for our food to come out, however they were a little busy. Food was good, the side of bacon I asked for to be crispy was perfect. Husband had the Loco Moco and I had the Spinach Omelette. I would definitely recommend.

The Carousel Bar, located inside the Hotel Monteleone, is a revolving bar that manages to be both elegant and whimsical. No lurid circus colors here; instead the walls are painted a sophisticated dark grey, embellished with antiqued gold mirrors and moody artwork. The bar itself moves at a relatively slow pace, making one revolution approximately every 15 minutes. 

While I enjoyed the novelty of sitting at a revolving bar, I actually kept coming back because the bartender made fabulous cocktails. I went for the classics: bloody marys and ramos fizzes in the morning, pimms cups in the afternoon, and manhattans in the evening. 

Whatever the time of day, the Carousel Lounge will provide perfect mood-enhancing libations. Stop on by and give 'em a whirl.

I love Kelliann's. It's been my regular hangout since I moved here almost 5 years ago. We've lived in the Spring Garden District for the majority of our time here, so my boyfriend and I just like to walk over to Kelliann's for a hangout. 

Personally, I do NOT like college crowds. I prefer to go places where I can feel relaxed and hangout without having to shout to be heard. Kelliann's can *usually* provide that, with the occasional mess of people. I'm not really sure what brings them -- it feels really random to me. But I guess that's a good, because it shows that the bar attracts a really diverse crowd. I've been there when it was just a few guys sitting around after work watching a hockey game; when it was filled with Eagles fans shouting drunkenly at the flat screens; when it was filled with people from the CW Building across the street, having wine after work; and when it's been filled with what seems like an overflow from the Old City crowd. 

Kelliann's always has really friendly, personable bartenders though, including the owner of the place who will occasionally buy a round on the house when it's a room full of regulars. The food selection is pretty good [their chicken Caesar salad is the best thing I've ever eaten], though they close the kitchen pretty early [around 10 or so, I think]. As far as entertainment, they have a live band there every Sunday night, and the rest of the time it's between the radio, jukebox [if the patrons are feeding it], or whatever sporting event is on the flat screens.

My only problem with the place is the size -- it's a teeny little Celtic bar and the very definition of a hole int he wall. But it's definitely always clean and crisp.

Just came back from happy hour! It was my first time coming here and it will not be my last. Chicken nachos were great and for happy hour they had these great taquitos! I got the goat, pork and chorizo! All were amazing! We also ordered a pitcher of margarita for $20 which was great!! Highly recommend

I came here at my friend's recommendation. The inside is quite nice, especially the tables. Each table has a little plant on it. The staff is super friendly and the service is quick. I had a latte - simple but delicious.

Highly recommended if you're looking for a place to work/study while having a cup of high-quality coffee.

Thank you for making our reception a hit. Everyone loved the food! They are still talking about it! You guys did an amazing job! I can't thank you enough. Excellent food, superb service, on time and ready to go. We appreciate you all!

I stayed here after they renovated and turned this into a Fairfield Inn. I was disappointed in the color choices they used which smacked of the 70s. I had stayed here before it was a Fairfield and I think it looked allot better. Also I disliked the amount of ottomans , chairs and couches in the lobby. I mean come on, this is a hotel , not a furniture store. The lobby is not very large by any means. The rooms are fine but where did they get the idea to put two small ottomans in place of a coffee table? Also there is no end table, there is this ugly floor lamp/table with a Tucson tour book on it. Designers may think it looks pretty but the question is, is it practical?
The organ is located inside the Macy's building which used to be a department store called Wanamakers. The store is hugely impressive and the organ inside looks stunning.
Great service. Best place to go for pet supplies.

Website shows they are open til 7.  We walked in at 6:25 to be told they were closed.  I asked if they weren't open til 7.  The owner, in a condescending manner, said they were closed...almost implying I couldn't tell time.  We are big hot chicken fans and will eat at the many other (and better) places around town.  400' obviously has too much business as they are closing 35 minutes early and turning cash away.

Had juevos rancheros. Definitely yummy. A cute cafe with good food and a nice vibe. Only note is i wasn't super down with a ramekin of unseasoned potatoes for $4. Sides should be a bit better portioned, but main dishes are worth it. They have a nice menu selection for meat eaters to vegans alike.

Ordered food to-go, one of the items were incorrect, the manager said that it would cost them more to reimburse me for the missing items (which was an uncharge) from my burger, so I couldn't get a refund. The manager put me on hold, then put the "owner" on the phone, who immediately went into, "My girls said they did put everything on the burger!" I asked him if he's like for me to send him a picture of my burger and he refused. His best offer was the next time I visit that I don't get charged for the uncharges.

Sushi roll lovers, take note: Conola may just have, in my humble opinion, the BEST DAMN sushi roll that I have ever had!

The kicker here is that Conola is not specifically a Japanese restaurant.  In fact, upon walking in and seeing all the winter sport paraphernalia adoring the walls, you will wonder why this place is tucked away in Old Metaire instead of being perched mountain-side in a Colorado ski resort.

Further adding to this cafe's apparent multiple personality situation is the menu.  The sushi shares it's staring role with brunch and burger selections.  Oh, yeah...they also do Taco Tuesday. 

Let's get back to those sushi rolls, though...Conola has some of the most innovative rolls that I have ever come across.  My companion and I tried three of their signature rolls during our visit: the Blushing Geisha, the Triple Treat and the Tsunami.  All were fantastic, but the Blushing Geisha was by far best!  It features beet-cured salmon, avocado, mixed greens, pico de gallo and jalapeno cream cheese with cilantro oil drizzled over the top.  I had a mini foodgasm with each bite, and I was legitimately sad when we had finished the whole thing.

The other two rolls were great as well, but having started with the Blushing Geisha, they both faded into the background of the whole experience.  It's a bit like a wine-tasting: we went straight into the big bold red before starting with the Pinot Grigio and Chardonnay.  I would definitely be sure to ask your server for recommendations on not just what rolls to get but also which ones to start and finish with.

I'm not sure why Conola hasn't gotten more buzz.  It is a fantastic neighborhood cafe that is worth the trip if you live outside of Old Metairie.  Did I mention that they have 2 for 1 sushi rolls during Happy Hour?  That's just one more reason besides the delicious food for this girl to make a return visit!

We didn't come here for a full meal, just a couple appetizers and drinks. The blood orange margarita was delicious- not too sweet. I had the crab cake, which tasted so fresh, and my husband had the gumbo, which he said was a 3 out of 5. But let me tell you, the desserts, holy moly. Best pecan pie I've ever had and the white chocolate brownies... Melt in your mouth good. Larry was the best bartender.

I've ordered from here several times now and am always pleased with my choice. The employees here are very helpful and kind. I've had some great meals from this place. The first time I ordered a cheesesteak and fries. The second time I had the chicken francais which was excellent. The last time I visited I had a few different appetizers- the risotto balls and buffalo wings. The food is always fresh and delicious. Looking forward to trying more things in the menu.

Came by for a check up of our 22 year old cat Misty. We have come here over the years but have not been by for some time. Nurse showed up around 825a for our 815a appointment and took history. Vet poked head in at 845a and said she would be back soon.  I guess all doc/vets are the same and eventually we will see the vet.

We originally got Misty as an abandoned kitten from this place 22 years ago, so they have all her history. She is slowing down and we just wanted a second opinion about what to expect and do. 

Vet diagnosed late stage renal failure. There is no coming back from this. The Vet was extremely empathetic and explained our options. Neither my wife nor I were prepared for this today. Tears were shed. A painful moment. Goodbye Misty.

We Recommend this Animal Hospital. They are caring, supportive and tender with the animals. The place was not crowded but there were a few other pets waiting their turn. There were assistants and helpers everywhere. The place is well staffed and very clean.

Nancy & Mark.

Sooooooo good. Best burger in Indy! Why? High quality, local grass fed beef. I got a double cheese a little pink on whole wheat bun. Side of housemade pickles. I also got side salad with garlic vinaigrette dressing. Just. Amazing. Note the first time I ate here I got the turkey burger which was very good but the beef is just off the charts!!!! If you don't eat here than you aren't too smart.

We ordered  a $49 bottle of Chardonnay for the two of us....  15 min later waiting for our pre dinner drink- no wine!  We see our waitress boxing up leftovers and giving out bills. Why couldn't she have brought us our wine and then taken care of the leftovers. We asked the busboy to please have our waitress bring our bottle of wine... we like to have a glass or two while waiting for dinner- it still doesn't come!!  I go to the bar... there it sits (amongst dirty dishes) -I asked if I could just take it to my table -we've been waiting at least 15 to 20 min.  Bartender said he would have it brought over -(but wasn't too happy about the request).  Wine arrives - not by our waitress - who was still boxing leftovers while we sat waiting.  Poor service X10.  We also miss the table cloths - Not the same ambiance - think twice before going back to spend over $50 a plate.  There are other Italian restaurants!!!

I have forever said to myself "Self, why isn't there just a traditional diner around without the  hassle? Just a down to earth place that you can stop in and eat a quick bite but have the best food on the planet". "Also, I would like it to be old fashioned and serve burgers and grilled cheese sandos" "oh, and self, can it serve a coke in one of those big flar d out coke glasses?"  Well, I can quit asking myself this question having now eaten at the Red Hut.   This place is it. It is the bomb. Close to my office and I have never been here. In this neighborhood I expected pretentious. Well this is not that. 

This is my first visit so I have yet to try some of the other fare but I got a regular old grilled cheese. Awesome sauce!  Actually no sauce on the sando. That would be pretentious. This was just a great sandwich with fries (and seasoned salt in a shaker) and a coke. The fries were perfect by the way. 

Lexi was awesome. Attentive service. (Didn't have to wait for anybody. Three different people helped us).  Reggie has an enthusiasm that can't be beat. 

I will be back. Maybe get a soda at the fountain. 

Don't assume low quality food. The choices are good. 

Keep it up Red Hat. 

Oh, btw, loved the hand written check. Feels like . . . . Home. 

Also, the sando was too good. Didn't get a before pic.

I am outrage of the phone operation at Service Cab!!!! 
I'm a customer and you do not need to raise your voice at me if i am talking to you in a calm way asking you for my cab!!!! 
Please rectify that you have to always answer out questions properly!!! IM HELPING YOU KEEP YOUR JOB AND YOU HAVE THE NERVE TO SCREAM AT ME?? 
I have never in my life left a bad review on nothing even tho things happen! But if you have an attitude problem please stay yo behind home. Learn how to talk to people.

My wife and I had a couple of wonderful sandwiches here.  She had the avocado turkey which was very good. I had a build your own roast beef, provolone, aioli sauce.  The bread and ingredients were wonderfully fresh. I love to see a non chain restaurant open up in the county. I will be coming back to try the St. Louis made hot dog.   Great sandwich shop!
Love my Pappy's. We use them all the time for our catering. Great ribs and I love the fried corn on the cob.

This hungry howies saved my family's thanksgiving. Due to a death in the family, we had to drive over 19 hours on thanksgiving day. Obviously we were unable to prepare a traditional thanksgiving meal and NOTHING was open. Thanks to this hungry howies we were able to eat a hot meal, together after tragedy. The service was excellent and the pizza reminded me of my childhood. Wishing for a Hungry Howies in New York one day.

Holy crap this place is amazing! Spectacular vegan options, and non vegan!! Really impressed for vegan bar food! Super fresh tasting, yet perfect greasiness you look for with bar food! The carnivores were as pleased as I was here!

We've had brunch here three times. I cannot say enough good things about this restaurant.  Let me try. The great:

1- Fantastic service.From our first call/approach right until we walk out the door -  Attentive, knowledgeable, friendly, warm, thoughtful and welcoming. 

2- Food- delicious. Hard to stand out when there is soo much good food in the French Quarters but Angeline's delivers because the food is prepared perfectly and the flavors and textures never took a misstep. The best boudin ever - made fresh and served crispy *rolls eyes in ecstasy* . It's served on a bed of creamy grits and topped with a runny egg and red eye gravy.

It doesn't stop there - the collard green and black eyed pea soup is HEAVEN. The broth is laced with bourbon and will make you want to lick the bowl to get the last drop.  The made-from-scratch biscuits are light, crispity/crunchity on the outside and fluffy on the inside. Not weighted down with butter, salt or sugar - perfect vessels for the variety of jams offered or a crispy and flavorful piece of their fried chicken with black pepper gravy.

If you need a more traditional northern breakfast go for one of Angeline's omelets. We sampled three:  the sausage with Hook cheddar and caramelized onions; the house-smoked fish with creme fraiche; and the fried LA oyster omelet with bacon and a hot sauce hollandaise. No regrets.

The not so great:
Not one single miss.  We'd order every single item again...and again.
Also? I'd happily let the staff decide what I order should I ever be blessed enough to go back. Angeline's should be a mandatory food stop if you find yourself in the French Quarters.

This is a quirky popsicle haven. They were pretty empty when we walked in on a sunday afternoon (granted it is january.) You can tell right away that this is the epitome of a local business that cares about it's product and it's customers. It's exactly the kind of store I want to keep supporting.

The interior is small, but perfect for the business. there are about 6 adult seats available and one children's table. I thought it was adorable because they had a toy shelf for the youngins. Not to mention any place that does tapestry circles on the wall as decor and plays with a combination of pastels and bold colors is perfection.

For three george washington's, we ended up splitting a chocolate salted caramel brownie one and the texture was so rich and great. I don't know how they did it but it was like gelato and brownie had a baby and made this popsicle. If that flavor doesn't suit your fancy, there are plenty of other interesting choices to pick from as well. It was super dense- not watery at all- and therefore was really easy to eat. The wrapper of the actual popsicle was also a bag so you could take it to go as well.

If you can't make it over to the store, be sure to check their food truck out during some of the festivals. Having been to a few of these, I know that one of these popsicles would absolutely hit the spot in the springtime!

Me and my lady decided to head out for a last minute late dinner and we had an excellent night the food was awesome. She had the roasted chicken which I consider 3 1/2 little under seasoned I had the grilled octopus which was delicious followed by the lamb chops which were seasoned to perfection & the tzatziki sauce was breathtaking

Christine saved my skin. I have suffered my entire life with some form of acne, or scarring from said acne. After a consult, she got me started on a regimen that cleared me up pretty quickly. I soon started with microdermabrasion, which  was scary but she helped me relax through the process. It doesn't hurt at all! Six months later, I had no pimples on my wedding day, and I couldn't be happier. I will keep using her products and the microdermabrasion. She offers a lot of other services that are worth looking into, considering her passion for skincare!

Indianapolis Day Trip Part 8: Downtown Comics: Stopped in here on the way to dinner. Wish I had more time to explore, but it was right before closing time. But a great selection along with a lot of cool statues out of my price range at which to gawk. I got a Die-Cast figure of Jack Knight/Starman for $5! That's a pretty deep dive for a figurine. And, since it's made of lead, I probably shouldn't lick it any time soon.

Anyways, Downtown Comics. Cool place!

Upon entering the salon, I felt the 'cold' attitude. No warm greeting from the front desk guy and that didn't feel right.  I don't want to write a long and detailed review but let me just say that the nail tech I had was friendly, but...dang it, she really hurt me. She DUG  too deep on an already tender side of my big toenail and OWWWW.  Yep, I bled. Yep. She kept probing after I told her. OUCH.  She was a nice young gal and I was sure she was embarrassed and worried.  Thank God she didn't probe on the opposite tender toenail. Yep, I let her know it hurt. She scraped too hard on a callused area and I noticed it burning when I got in the show an hour later.  I took pictures just in case. Nails were cut shorter than I wanted and they aren't even. The tips of some of my nails aren't painted. Sigh. I'm too nice sometimes and yes, I tipped her. I will survive this but don't want to damage her reputation. Maybe she will learn from this? I hope so. :(

A big group of us (25) get breakfast after our very early Saturday morning run. They are always able to accommodate us and fit us in our usual spot by the bar. We always have the same waitress and she somehow remembers all of our orders without writing any of it down and knows what we regularly order; pretty impressive. I love their freshly squeezed orange and grapefruit juice. Their biscuits are amazing too.

We had a great breakfast here.  The Bloody Mary was really good. It's cozy inside and it was very busy while we were there.   Lots of action and tons of people all around the area. 

My wife ordered a boring omelette sandwich but said it was really good and she did seem to enjoy it.  She was there for the Bloody Mary more than anything I think.    

I ordered the Soft Shell Crab Benedict and it was very good.  This was the first time I have ever had a whole fried soft shell crab and I didn't anticipate the flood of salty liquid that came out of it when I took a bite of the body of the crab.  It was really fresh and salty but a bit more than I was ready for.  All of the other components of the Benedict were great.   The sauce was very tasty! Don't get me wrong, I liked the crab it was just a shock for me.   

The people watching here is great!  You can watch the crowds, check out the street vendors, and listen to the music in the street. There was even and comedy magic show going on out front.  

Great place!  I'd return!

One of my favorite local spots.  My wife and I go at least once a week.  Very fast and friendly service.  Even the ice cream is good.  I tend to go back and forth on whether I like the beef Pho or the Oh Miso Spicy Ramen more.  This is great carry out if you plan on eating it later in the day as well.

We tried to go on a weekend without a reservation. They said sit at the bar, it's first come first seat. You have to fight for an available seat, people just take the seats before you can get to them, it's a terrible setup. The bartender was making people wait for a waitress  rather than helping at the bar. We came a second time and had the same terrible experience at the bar, we did get a table this time, food was good, forgot to bring my wife's salad. Overall not impressed

La Morena is both a well-stocked Mexican grocer and a mouth-watering taqueria, and it's not in North County or on Cherokee but situated in the heart of West County, across from the brand new Super Walmart at hwy 141. 

In the last few years the Ballwin/Manchester area has exploded with a very culturally diverse business sector, which is fantastic for breaking up the monotony that West County has come to represent. On the way to La Morena, you pass a Pakistani grocer, an Indian restaurant, and a Vietnamese Bistro- and this is all in one plaza!

I digress... getting back to La Morena, you can get anything from authentic Tacos al Pastor served in double layered corn torillas that come with cilantro, onion, lime and 2 salsas, half liters of Mexican Coca Cola (made with real sugar) in glass bottles for less that $2, fresh Pan Dulce in all the colors of the rainbow, and torillas to take home in 3 different sizes- not to mention imported candies, bottled salsas, canned goods, and the ability to leave very excited that this place exists.

I will say that Spanish is kinda-almost necessary to order at the Taqueria side, but if you're shy like I am to use what little you learned in high school spanish, there is a take-out menu that has everything you need to nervously point out what delights you.

Update: The stylist from my last trip is no longer there. This trip was for our favorite stylist! My family has been coming to see Tara since she worked at a different location and she is the BEST. Three haircuts and a wax later, we were all out the door in about an hour. She goes the extra mile, every time, to make sure we are all happy and to learn each our -isms so that the cut looks right. She's friendly, funny, and the kids love her. Thank you, Tara!!

Very good. been there a couple different times with larger groups and had no issues. the bathrooms always packed but it is a small restaurant so I understand.

Okay if there's one thing I learned about German food is , presentation isn't on the high end but flavor? Its really good stuff and unique , the spice blends as well as ketchup on fried pork indicative of that. Let's start with the pork schnitzel with mushroom gravy including the red cabbage and dumplings. This was probably my favorite of the the night. Perfectly cooked pork with a light breading and delicious mushroom gravy that wasn't too salty everything was just right. The red cabbage was tart and sweet and totally different from what I used too. It's good for cutting through the richness of the gravy , something like a palatizer so the flavors never get old . The dumpling has no filling to my surprise it was like a moist ball of dough they most likely boiled but a perfect sponge for the gravy so save that for the dumpling because by itself it's daily bland . The curry wurst would be on par with the the schnitzel if it didn't have ketchup IMO. The currywurst was easily one of the best German style sausages I've had , so tender and a wonderful curry flavor. The homemade pasta was great as well , not too heavily seasoned and slightly aromatic.  The sauerkraut had a strong olive taste with a bit of tartness, definitely not the kind I'm used too and an acquired taste I'd feel for most. Overall this place is amazing , it's some of the best authentic German food in the area

So excited when I found out about this new healthy food place! Had the açaí bowl today and it was amazing. All the ingredients were fresh and it was so refreshing on this warm spring day. They have a nice variety on the menu. It's not all smoothies like I thought. Definitely will be back to try out one of their salads or toasts. 

The space is also super cute. I like the variety of seating they have. I sat in the back room which felt like a little oasis of its own. It was such a warm and inviting place to be in. The owners are also so sweet and welcoming. A great place to bring a family too. This is just what the area needed an organic and non-gmo place! So happy to finally be able to get some healthy smoothies and açaí bowls too. I'll probably be frequently going here so I'll update my review as I try more items on the menu. 

Also, the owners mentioned they will be starting a loyalty program soon so keep an eye out for that!

Went here a few years ago when I was down doing work in New Orleans would call this kind of a locals place they have quite a bit of different seafood options and excellent oysters. I was a little disappointed in my grilled fish this time. Seemed a little bit rubbery. But I shouldn't complain it was right after the hurricane Ida
Best pizza in the area. The wings are fresh not those frozen wing ding types. Absolutely awesome food.

Some of the best pizza on St. Pete's beach! We ordered the medium pizza with onions, plum tomatoes, artichokes, mushrooms with pepperoni and sausage. I asked to light cook the crust. Absolutely pizza perfection.

Great views and awesome service from the staff! Best time in a long time. Today is  rowing tournament on the Cumberland which is great! Tourist everywhere but that is ok as this place is great!! We went to rooftop bar and enjoyed some beverages that were  prepared with

Ordered a banana split ($9) and some rolled ice cream ($9) for a total of $22 with tip. We received about $1 worth of ice cream and maybe an extra $1 with the toppings. I can't see this place lasting very long.

Here's a picture of a banana split that I had in TX (with amazing blue bell ice cream), for only $4.99. Look at those scoops of ice cream towering over the banana and the tray. 10X the flavor and value.

The groomers here are amazing! We took our almost five month old standard poodle puppy to get his first cut, and he looks great! The full treatment - ears, paws, claws, face - was done so well that I can't stop taking pics and staring at how good he looks. The cut is even better than what we had described! Very clean spot with friendly groomers who know and share the best tips for grooming in between appointments. They even recommend the best brushes/combs to use for the future and send you links for products after your pup's first appointment. We don't live close, but we (and our pup) are looking forward to the next trek to Poodles & Pals. Amazing place!
