Sitting at the bar is my favorite! I went tonight for the second time and it was just as good as the first. The potato fritters are like nothing else, the butter bean Caesar is unique and delish, and the agnolotti was amazing! Bar wait to come back.

If you're gluten free, you know how hard it is to find good gluten free pizza. Well your search can stop right now! Chick's gf pizza is good, but not just good for gf pizza, actually good for pizza pizza. So good in fact that when I go here with non-gluten free people, they will  share a gf pizza with me and not even complain about it. If you know someone who is gf, you know that this is actually a really big  deal. 

The pizza crust is crunchy and chewy and doesn't have any gross after taste. I guess there's a chance that they use frozen, but if they do, I would NEVER know. I've tried a ton of their pizzas so I couldn't even say that you should get this one or that one because they're all just really yummy. 

Aside from pizza the only other things I've had are the Greek salad, beet and orange salad and the burger. The burger was cooked perfectly medium rare, was huge and drippy and delicious and both of the salads had a ton of cheese, which is basically the best part of any salad. This place gets a 10/10 from me. 

The only thing that is annoying about this place is the pick up times. They're never ready when they say they'll be so come 15-20 after your pick up time or you will be sitting around!

I had never heard of this store before and live out of state. I placed an order for this game online. The game was shipped next day and shipping cost was only about $3!!! The game arrived quickly and in great shape. Very impressed. Thank you Go 4 Games!

I'm a big fan of Blaze pizza so I was definitely looking forward to this competitor opening up.  For one thing, I can walk here during lunch rather than having to get in the car to go to Blaze.  It gets points for walking accessibility.  It also gets points for having one of those new-fangled drink machines in which you can get everything from peach sprite to root beer to regular cola brands.

On to the pizza.  I got two of them (they had coupons.)  The first was an artisan thin crust with alfredo, garlic, spinach, chicken, artichoke hearts, kalamata olives and some other stuff. It was very good, imo.  It didn't have the nice crisp edges of Blaze but the flavor was good, imo.  Also, it is very big in my mind that the artichoke hearts were drained well enough they didn't make the pizza all mushy.  Then it was finished with basil and some good pesto drizzle (not just a somewhat pesto oil like Blaze.) I will definitely order that pizza again.

The classic deep dish was good, but not quite as successful.  The marinara could use some seasonings and the pepperoni wasn't a great quality pepperoni.  overall, it was still good.  However, the real issue was the cooking.  you just can't put a thin crust and pan into the same oven and expect them to be o.k.  this pan was a bit doughy and undercooked.  I liked the flavor but Its a big critique of mine if the dough isn't fully cooked.  Its just a tweak the shop needs to do, but it does need to be fully cooked.  That's the reason for the 4 stars instead of 5.  However, the place is a keeper for downtown Indianapolis lunch options.

Great addition to the main line! This relatively new Wayne, PA casual dining restaurant offers delicious, classic dishes with a modern twist.  Breakfast sandwiches are made with fresh ingredients, and all items are reasonably priced.  The restaurant is situated next to a dry cleaning business on Lancaster Avenue, and largely due to zoning restrictions, has minimal signage.  Don't miss this main line favorite.  And don't skip dessert--the pie is fantastic!

Pretty salon with good access off the freeway. Brighty is awesome! She put feathers in my hair and i get compliments and inquiries on where i got them almost daily! They also sell Kerastase products which are wonderful.

So as many of you know, Burger King is not allowing people in their dining room yet. So we only can go by the drive-through experience.

When I pulled up, the line was going quite fast and the person on the intercom was very nice and teary asking for my order. I told her I had a coupon for a three dollar double whopper and she was happy to ask for the coupon code. But I went to the window to pick up my double whopper, the guy was really friendly. We chatted for a second about my debit card being from Fresno state. He recognized it, and told me he was from Fresno.

The burger was fresh, and taste quite nice.

The only issue I have right now with Burger King, is they do not allow people to sit in their dining room, and you were only allowed to use one coupon per drive-through order. Previously, a couple of my teenagers would grab some coupons and go to Burger King to save some money. Now we don't go near's often due to this rather strange restriction. I do believe that if they are going to limit seating, which mini fast food places are allowing seating now, that they should make accommodations for two or three people in a vehicle that have discounts or coupons. Other than that the food was fresh, the service was nice.
Horrible service. They literally walked past my table several times and no one helped. Too busy focused on their other tables and those powered doughnuts wasn't even all that. I won't be back

Walking around Canal street on the hunt for some food, I stumbled upon this place. It is hard to miss as it is surrounded by a swirling mass of people, as if they were caught in some gravitational pull.

Despite the very long line, I was able to sit at the last seat at the bar (it pays to go solo sometimes). However, once I sat down, service was a little slow, In defense of the waitress, it was at capacity at around 25 people and she was the only person behind the bar. That is a fail on the part of management that couldn't predict a Saturday morning rush.  
 
While waiting, I pulled up Yelp and instantly saw my choice--the Eggs Blackstone. Pretty much eggs Benedict, but on a biscuit. If ever you should see something like this on the menu, get it!

After waiting a good 10 minutes, I got the menu and ordered my coffee. Another 10 minutes pass before actually getting my coffee and being able to order... which ended up breaking my heart--they were OUT OF BACON!!! 

Bacon being the proverbial glue that connects the eggs to the biscuit is an essential component of the Eggs Blackstone. And they didn't have any. Breakfast without bacon is like an earth without water: incapable of sustaining life. Without this, it is just eggs with tomato on some carbs. Unacceptable. In my sorrow, I ordered what appeared to be the closest thing--Eggs Cochon: slow cook pork debris served over an open-faced biscuit, topped with poached eggs and hollandaise.

True to its word, the slow cook pork came slowly. About to eat my hand off and having finished my coffee 5 minutes ago, this beast of a plate appeared before me. I didn't really know what to expect, but what I saw made me think of pulled pork in gravy sloppy joe, with poached eggs and sauce. Hiding beneath this mountain of fat and grease were some carbs in the form of soggy biscuits. While no means bad--and actually good at first--it was a bit much. A bit much for breakfast and a bit much to eat without having my coffee refilled. After putting it away, I finally got my first refill and downed that in a heartbeat. 

Overall, service was crap due to so many people and poor management. I felt bad for the waitress, but still begrudged my lack of coffee. Then for not having bacon, I am sorry. There is no excuse for an established early on Saturday morning to have run out of bacon. Together, this knocks off two stars. The food was food, but not worth the wait to get in, fight to get attention, and disappointment of maybe not having bacon. I'd consider coming back here, but only if it were not busy, which I am not sure happens.

Bacon.

What else is there really to say about this place? Such a perfect, charming little wine/cheese/beer lets-hang-out-and-chat-awhile kinda place. Perfect for lunch, a light snack, a meet up with old friends.
I frequent this place for before and/or after dinner drinks, but have also come here for a light lunch or dinner. Every food item is perfectly executed. If you just want snacks, order some of the rosemary potato chips or fennel roasted almonds. The toasts are also a perfect quick snack-I love the one with honey and walnuts. 
Honestly I know this place is a wine bar, but the beer is where it's at. They have really great draft selections, frequently changing, and an extensive bottle list. The prices for beer are pretty reasonable, which was surprising to me. Also to note-the happy hour specials are awesome. Definitely do happy hour here.
This place is one of those that I'm happy to visit again and again. And everyone else in Rittenhouse feels this way, too. Expect to wait or squeeze in at the bar at peak times. It'll be worth it, though.

I have been here several times and always has great service, however today I was trying to get a prescription straightened out that my pharmacy screwed up and had the most unfortunate event by speaking with a nurse by the name of Monica.  She belittled me, talked down to me and acted as if I couldn't count 5 pills in my pill bottle.  Maybe she should listen to patients rather than trying to be rude and talk over them.  I won't go back to this location due to this event!

Stopped in here when it first opened and was unimpressed. Returned today to try, and nothing has changed. 

Had the brisket sandwich, which is really more like a pot roast and nothing close to what real Brisket should taste like. Even the texture of the meat is very dissimilar to real brisket.

Ribs were totally dried out with limited flavour.

Buffalo wings perfectly crispy and nice heat.  But the best thing (top five personal favorites) is the pizza turnover.  Perfect crust, great sauce.  Order it!

Best topper to the meal, the waitress ran outside to give us an item we left on the table.  Great service!

All I can say is the wings are bomb! Golden Wings is the hood spot! In a good way! True to the name, Their wings come out Golden every time. Walking in, it's counter take out service only! The menu is pretty simple. After you order, they give you a number and you wait. The lines can be long, but the little girl behind the counter does a good job yelling out and distributing the goods fast and efficiently. You know it's a family business!
We ordered a 100 count wings, original fried with a large pan of Combination fried rice. 
The wings are crispy and moist and definitely packed with flavor. It was not overly salty which makes this wing something you can have with or without ketchup which is rare for me. I need ketchup for any chicken I eat! My preference though. 
The fried rice was moist and filled with all the goodies; vegetables, proteins such as shrimp, ham, and chicken! They give you soy sauce and duck sauce if you need it more savory or sweeter. 
This is the go to spot to get that party pack for the game or just a good family meal. Or for any event for that matter. Don't take my word for it, go try it yourself if you're ever in the area!

Ken Rippy was the most polite and knowledgeable car salesman I have dealt with in many years. He made the experience fun, while always being respectful. The entire sales staff was very helpful in making sure that I got exactly what I wanted, so that I drove away with a new car and a huge smile. 

I have taken my previous Prius (bought elsewhere) to Toyota of Turnersville for service for years, and have always found the service staff to be friendly and professional while providing top-notch service.

This great buying experience, combined with the reliable service department, will keep me a faithful customer in the future.

The actual cruise, cleanliness and quality of the boat was just fine.  My problem was with the unnecessary waiting to board the boat.  Picture this, about 200-300 people (elderly, kids, etc.) standing in line,in the sun, starting 30 minutes before boarding so cruise personnel could take one couple or group at a time to take a promotional photograph.  If you did not want to be photographed, you could only skip to the next 'boarding' line when tour turn came up for a picture.  So, approximately 40% or more of the passengers had to unnecessarily wait in the sun, some for 15-20 minutes.
Why not two lines, one for those that want pictures and one for those that don't?
We are very very pleased. We have a shepherd with a lot of allergies and they covered 80% of all the costs including meds. We have never had a problem with claims.

Absolutely loved this authentic tasting Italian restaurant. We got the margherita pizza and vodka penne pasta and they were both absolutely delicious. The atmosphere is awesome, and there's outdoor seating away from the Main Street. This place is a must eat!

I love going to Pia Spa for so many reasons. Let me count the ways... 1. Staff, including PIA, are professional, courteous and always available. The front staff helps you pick a service when you're not sure about what to pick. Jasmine knows just about everything! The other girls are very personable too. They offer me something to drink and I LOVE their Zen, green or mint tea. I've never been to a salon where the owner stops and has a conversation with you. Pia treats everyone with respect and I love how she blends in with her staff. 2. Tania is so comfortable to be around while having my nails or waxing done and interesting/fun to talk to! 3. Service is SO fast! Tania is usually right there waiting as soon as I walk in. If not, she comes down pretty quick :). 4. Products; whatever type of wax they're using is great because it works for my sensitive skin! (I don't know the name of it). Their candles are perfect for anyone special in your life. I bought a couple for some friends and they love the smell. IF I keep going, this will turn into an essay. Love you all at PIA!!!

I wasn't thrilled to have to stop in Reno for the night and having our German Shepherd puppy made it all the more taxing.  Whitney Peak not only accepted pets , they genuinely loved and welcomed them,  I was very pleasantly surprised by the hotel- decor, staff, service, convenient location.  Cool, hip young vibe. Pet or no pet, if you find yourself in Reno, Whitney Peak gets high marks .  Bonus:  the rock climbing gym is superb and the world's tallest climbing wall is here!  Another Bonus:  Heritage, their restaurant (Farm to Table) was superb.

I took two Love Seat cushions to the Foam outlet today 12/30/2015. They were two years old and absolutely in bad shape. Jim took a few minutes to explain why the cushions had failed and after going me advice on which density foam to choose, was able to make those old cushions better then new. The price was fair, and the best part is my wife thinks I'm a hero. Our very nice love seat is now looking like new for our New Years Party! Thanks Jim!

This UPS Store has the friendliest staff & are super helpful. I usually come in with just the items I want to send because I'm not sure how to ship things or what packaging to put them in. 

Jen usually helps me and she's great, but yesterday D helped me & he was super helpful with me. I witnessed him answer a phone call for an elderly person who didn't know how to attach images to an email. He was super patient and kind on the phone & went right back to helping me afterwards.

If you are in college or want to relive those days this is the place for you.
I really didn't qualify for either on this beautiful day in SB but that is where we ended up.

On a positive note the happy hour has some great deals and the margaritas were OK. The chips and salsa is a pretty sad display of flavorless gunk, but I think most people just come here to get blasted.
It just wasn't one of those days for me - yes I was shocked too.

Let me start by saying good was great and I'll be back.  With that said, they need to clean tables quicker and give silverware to all table.  I say 3 tables looking for it.  Only other big issue is they only have a portable ac which didn't cut it.  Was way too hot.
George was great. He kept us updated all a long the way. This was a very easy process. I strongly reccomend Safelite.

The duck gumbo was alright. Maybe I'm just not a gumbo person, but I wasn't that impressed. The crab claws remoulade appetizer was tasty, although a bit more sauce would have been nice. I also tried my friend's andouille crusted fish. The fish was cooked well, had a nice crust, and was accompanied with a nice creamy sauce.

I can't even begin to describe how delicious their sandwiches are.  This is going to be my recurring lunch-spot.  Their foccacia bread is soft, and flavorful.  Their ham tastes prime and their pineapple chunks are juicy and large.  I've only had two of their sandwiches thus far but I expect to have tried everything on the menu by the end of the year.  It's that good.

Great addition in Reno.  I've been here twice so far, and the food was excellent both times.  Each time, I split a pot pie and a salad with my boyfriend.   Perfect for us. 
Salads were light and fresh.   Pies were delicious with well balanced flavors and uh-mazing crust.  And not overly creamy/ heavy/ gut bomb-ish. 

The decor is great and service super friendly!

Both times the service was a bit slow.   But it sounds like recent reviewers had faster service, so they've probably gotten this sorted out.  

Definitely worth a try -- highly recommend!  I'll be back... again and again I'm sure.

Ordered on line tonight for 6:30 pick up.  We waited in our car to give them a few extra minutes and when I went in to see if the order was done, people were still waiting for their 6:15 orders and we were told to wait outside, mind you it's 12 degrees and windy and the orders are 30 minutes late.  Finally got the order at 6:55, but only after the young man working on them constantly adjusted his hat with his  gloved hand since his hair was hanging down to his lips and all over his face.  What an utter mess!

They have about FIFTY taps! MAN! I wish I lived here!
I had the NOLA Hopitoulas IPA (hoppy, like the description states) which was very good. I also had the Abita Wrought Iron IPA, which was good, but not as yummy as the other. 
The food was good, too. The wife had the turkey, burger, which she described as both tasty and not dry. 
I had the wings, with MOE sauce. Their version of Buffalo. They were very tasty and hot, but not crazy hot. Just the right level. 
We both had the crosscut fries. I love crosscut fries! We both thought they were great and not too salty. 
I would be a regular, if I still lived here!

Order anything and it is wonderful.  We love their vegetarian fried rice, spicy noodles, and  Bangkok eggplant.  We used to love the moon dumplings but for some reason they took it off the menu='(  But all their food is soo good we will get over it!

It's so cute I could gag. But not in a good way. 

In more of that "yummy" "brunchie" "cutesy" stuffed French toast kind of way. 

The menu looks much better than it is. They claim to do Southern Cuisine, hence the "Tupelo" moniker, but even Elvis would send this shit back. And Aunt Jemima would have fired that chef's ass long ago. 

Fried chicken salad does not a Southern restaurant make. (Half the restaurant had ordered this. Why?)

My burger was good, but that's not exactly brain surgery. I might add that about an hour later I had to dash into a Starbucks to, well, it's best left unsaid. 

Like Paris Hilton, Tupelo Junction looks good on the outside. 
Stay on the outside.
Food was cold.  Ribs were tough and not a good flavor will not order again.  The dishes lacked sauce and flavor
Our carpet looks and smells fantastic!  I was worried because the dogs and kids have been very hard on it, but it now seems brand new :)

We had a reservation next door but it was a long wait and packed house. We went here and it was a great meal. Smaller menu but what they do they do good. The ramen dishes were spot on with fall off your fork slightly fatty bites of pork and hard to find real deal ramen noodles. The pork bento bowl was fabulous with spot on flavor profile of ginger and garlic sauce with perfect blend of sauce to meat to rice portion for like 7 bucks. The gyoza were perfectly cooked and a tasty app. We fed four for a Friday night meal and with tip and even a beer for under $50.  Just went into the new location closer to Meridian. We really like the food here. I would have given it 5 stars but we ordered our appetizer first with drinks and app came after our ramen. The pork rice dish is cheap and flavorful. The sampler appetizer was like 5 bucks and was well worth it. You could even sub in a kids meal with the chicken bites. Next time we're in town we'll be back.

A little better than your average breakfast chain place with a southern twist. 

The corn bread is a little dry and tastes like a store bought mix.

One of the middle aged waiters was very rude when I dined here because he kept staring at me like I was crazy. It may have been because of the mass amount of food I was eating or that I looked somewhat disheveled, but that is terribly rude and made me feel very uncomfortable.

For a family vacation we chose to stay at the Double Tree in downtown santa barbara. It was the first hotel stay since having our first baby. We were super excited for the mini vacation and chose a double tree for its family friendly atmosphere. The room was great and we really enjoyed our first night. We woke up Saturday and took a walk thru the neighborhood having breakfast and sightseeing. Upon returning to the room we discovered the maid had thrown out all our baby bottles and breast pump accessories. We checked everywhere and had left them near the closet to the right of the door. We immediately brought it to hotel staff's attention in hopes we could recover the needed items. We called first to the front desk and we received no call back. We then walked with the baby to the front desk in hopes they could contact housekeeping to find the items. No such luck. We were kept waiting for over 40 mins in the lobby while they located security. Security asked a few questions and contacted housekeeping who denied throwing out the items. We were very discouraged and upset with our treatment and the staff's inattention to our predicament. We were basically told sorry, there is nothing we could do. We had to spend the rest of our day finding a storethat carried the necessary items. We then received a letter from Segwick ( I guess the insurance company) telling us we should have put the items in the safe.  I would never think to put plastic baby bottles in the safe. I left them in bag next to a large breast pump. I am a sales executive with years and years of traveling experience. I can honestly say this was the worst customer service experience.  Our vacation turned out to be stressful and aggravating. Not to mention costing us $300 additional dollars to replace the items and priceless time spent driving around with a crying baby to find the items.

I got my nails done here last week for a mani/pedi and was impressed with the service! I got there around 345 on a Friday and waited about 45 minutes to get service. It seems like I came in at a bad time though because most people who came in after did not need to wait that long. I have had a few mani pedis this year but none of them did as much work as she did on my nails. She cleaned underneath my nails and I haven't had that done during a mani/pedi in a long time! Even before she started painting my nails, they looked beautiful! I will definitely come back here!

Went last night for some quick highlights before a trip.  Amanda got me right in, got to work and they turned out great.  I think I have found my new salon.  

Work is great, prices are great, and the staff is very welcoming.

The girls are extremely nasty and rude because of their standoffish behavior I will be paying thousands of dollars to terminate my lease after 10+ years of living here.  Parking is terrible bugs in apartments are a problem.

Today was my first class.  I really didn't know what to expect aside from what I saw on-line and from word of mouth.  I haven't worked out in some time and so I was a little apprehensive.  The staff made me feel very comfortable and explained everything to me prior to class starting.  It was one of the best work outs I've ever had.  Very intense.  I decided to join as there is no long term commitment and also because I felt like I had a private coach encouraging me all the way through.  Angela is one of the coaches and she actually took the class with me so I would feel more comfortable.  I am looking forward to my next visit, and to losing those pesky inches from my stomach!!  Yay!

Really enjoyed the tour and pedaling. The guide was awesome and it was so fun. Plus it helped us work off that fatty BBQ food. I only has fries but the other shad ribs. Make no mistake it is not so easy. Luckily enjoying some drinks and spending time with friends collaboratively working together while pedaling down Broadway was an experience not to be missed! 

Folks from the company were outstanding.

Applebee's has rats. I found a whole rat in my Cobb salad. 

In all seriousness, it's a chain restaurant. It's middle of the road. Never terrible. Some times better than others. I gave it a fourth star because our waitress was awesome.

I was very upset with the service and quality of service of this place.

For one, the place was packed and i had to stand for almost 30 minutes before anyone even acknowledged my presence.

Secondly I wanted acrylics and the nail tech just kept saying no no no you damage you nail get gel, so i let her do shellac to try it, I had never gotten it before so i figured why not. She then clipped ALL the length off my nails leaving me with stubs, even after i told her long, she painted them very sloppily and when she had me put my fingers under the uv light it burned so bad! she just kept saying no no burn just light two more minutes. then on top of all of that, the polish was all bubbled and looked like garbage, it was $50 $23 dollars more than i would have paid for acrylics at my regular salon mind you, and get this it only lasted about four days before it peeled off.

I would not recommend this place to anyone, it was an unprofessional waste of time and money
Been going to Maxine for 4 years and she is great. Very gentle and she does great work.  Your skin looks brand new
Love Sassafras!! Great Gumbo, chicken Bernard is so good with the grilled asparagus & potatoes , it's my favorite.
Really great pizza! We had the bhodi BBQ and it was very good. Great sauce and meat. Probably the best (american) pizza I've ever had! I love it!

Great atmosphere, but extremely overpriced for no apparent reason. Meat and vegetables are mediocre at best. Rewards program isn't too rewarding. I believe I received $25 after spending $1000. Other than that, there is an abundance of all types of foods, a great alcohol selection, fresh coffee beans, and numerous food stations.

Should have checked these reviews before we came in for late dinner after Christmas shopping. We would have continued up the road to the Gravois Bluffs location to use the gift card I had burning a hole in my pocket. The service was terrible, the food came out late and had been obviously sitting while our server hustled about his side work ... which involved pulling out the table next to us all the way into the aisle so he could sweep crayons and crumbs into a dustpan (with an actual broom) while we were trying to eat our long-awaited food. Disgusting. The place was practically empty and he could have waited until we were finished to do his deep cleaning 3 feet away from us. I don't expect the moon at our friendly neighborhood grill, but a little effort would go a long way. The place just reeked of apathy. I used to work for Applebee's, and although it was a few years back, I know their commitment to quality far exceeds the shoddy service and atmosphere we experienced tonight. I truly hope the management is paying attention to these reviews.

Ordered an adonada burrito  and found out it only comes with rice, beans, and meat. So I paid for the extra lettuce, pico, sour cream, and cheese. I was starving and this hit the spot. Came out to almost $13 for things most other places include otherwise I would give them 5 stars. Place was clean, food was made to order fresh, and the salsa bar was fresh as well. Also not much leeway for first timers during lunch rush so read the menu ahead of time before you get in line.
Their pad thai is amazing and the guy who makes it knows me and makes it freakishly hot for me. I never find foods to be spicy enough but this guy is no joke!
Los Sarapes is without a doubt the best Mexican in the region. Make reservations Friday and Saturday because you'll need them.

Amazing experience!  We loved every minute of being at Olive + Oak.  The bartenders know their business and our waiter, Pete, was a lot of fun! There was an energetic vibe and everyone was having a good time.  On top of all of that the food was exceptional.  We had the fried oysters and the BLT gnocchi for appetizers, they were both different and great!  The filet and scallops were wonderful as well.  We can't wait to return!!

Eh, this place is OK.

It has the atmosphere of a Chevys...for real.  I read about this place on yelp, and when I got there I was surprised to see how big it is.  When I think tapas, I think small spot featuring small plates made with care...not big restaurant on the corner.

It took forever for a waitress to come take our order, but once she finally got there she was really cheerful and cool.  Our food all came quickly, but that may have been because we didn't order any meat items.

Black bean soup was good and flavorful; thick
Baked goat cheese was tasty and a generous portion
Fried artichoke was kind of like breaded artichoke calimari? so-so
Empanadas tasted like bread with flavorless boiled spinach inside (exactly what they were)
Fried potatoes was like french fries smothered in spaghetti sauce. no thanks.

If I ever go back to Indy, it won't be here, SRY BRO

This place was really interesting!  The booths are very comfortable, the drinks were decent and although the pianist couldn't carry a tune in a bucket, it was so fun to sing and dance along.  I think this is a great after dinner entertainment spot.  
I wish they had a small bites menu, or some bar snacks, but overall a good experience.  
This could also be a great venue for a corporate event or party.

Amazing selection of anything and everything you could want at a grocery store.   Appears to be high quality and care taken in what they do.  We had a much better experience at the store on Baronne than the store on Carrollton.  Overall, I suspect this is by far the best grocery store in NOLA and they are local to the South which I prefer to a national chain store like Whole Foods.

I give this place a 1 star for the first time. I generally do not have a problem but i must say I received the worst pedicure ever. It was so bad that I did not even let the lady (Amy) polish my nails.. yes that bad!!! Do i reccomend this place yes.. I'm just sorry because  I was upset it ruined my sister time and made my sister uncomfortable.. sorry sis..

Absolutely perfect chicken!! I got the 3 wings. I did 2 at the Damn hot level and 1 at the Shut the Cluck Up level. I love everything hot. The damn hot was perfect. The next level is truly for soldiers! The flavor is great, but it will burn your lips off!

Fantastic Sams suck in wood river, Illinois. I went there yesterday, and what a big mistake! I wanted a sweep haircut, and dark brown color for my hair. I Specifically asked for my hair not to have absolutely no red cast to it, but instead I got just that! She butchered my hair! I had to go to Jc penny's hair salon to have it corrected. I wanted my money back, but they wouldn't give me refund. They did offer to do a "redo," and was like "F" that. I do find it suspicious that the girl who butchered my did not give me a receipt. DO Not GO THERE, YOUR HAIR GET BUTCHERED,TOO.

Yum!  I had a slice of their bruschetta pizza the other day, and it was quite possibly the best slice of pizza I've ever had.  I also ordered a slice of plain, but ended up taking that one home because I was too full from the first piece of heaven.  The plain slice was not so great leftover unfortunately, but definitely worth trying again.  The sicilian pizza is also amazing, if you're into a thicker crust.

Zen Pizzas, - delicious, the mushroom was  to die for. We sat at the bar and watched the kitchen run like a top.  Fast service, a nice drink selection in a great  space.   What's not to love.  Salad was citrus fresh.  The raviolo was incredible.  Implanting on another visit very soon!

Sigh...I fly out of Philly all the time and it pains me to say it, but this is possibly the worst hub airport in the United States.

The terminal layout is horrible...nothing efficient about getting between the concourses like in Atlanta.  

Security is okay some days, but every Monday morning and Friday afternoon they have massive lines that are not well coordinated.  Can't someone explain to TSA that there will be more people traveling at these times every week and to be better staffed to handle things?

When the wind blows in the wrong direction in the northeast, you are looking at massive cancellations and delays.

For those of us who have no choice, we live with it.  If you do have a choice, fly out of Atlantic City or Newark!

My favorite grocery store. If you shop the weekly ad, you can get great deals on meat and produce. Not only is the every day pricing competitive, but they have the freshest selection in town. Prefer to shop here over the big name supercenters or big chain supermarkets.

My go-to when shopping for gifts in the quarter. Though they boast several locations, they are not identical in terms of goods they carry. Their collections are beautifully shopped with a wide array of tastes, styles and prices. Inventory doesn't move so fast that you feel pressure to quick purchase as well as changing often enough that I'm always finding something new. If you're local present your ID to earn 10% off each purchase.

AHHHHHHHHMMMMAAAAZZIIIIINNGGG! The food is ridiculous good 
Super burrito is my favorite thing 
Management owners staff are awesome

I've used them several times and every single trip to/from the airport went off without a hitch! I've always opted for the "valet" service where they pick you up at the airport in your own car and you immediately drive home. 

Two big PRO's for this are:
a) car is warmed up inside, great when you land and it's been 20 degrees all day
b) you cut out about 15-20 minutes riding on the shuttle/going to the lot and are able to drive home right away, great if you land after 9-10pm after a long flight and just want to get home

I'm paranoid about damage to the car, so they drive by a bunch of cameras that automatically take pictures of your car on the way out (protects them and makes me feel better that I don't have to bust out my camera myself). 

Drivers have always been courteous and attentive. Don't get why the reviewer below docked TWO stars for having a supposedly tired driver....especially if there was no damage to the car or accident. Anyway, I'd definitely recommend this, especially for trips less than 1 week since it's competitive with shuttle pricing to the suburbs.

Oh! And check out their cool collection of vintage Pan Am posters inside their office (look up).

This new WF is just great. They have almost everything you could want (though they haven't started selling wine yet, just beer and cider), the parking is easy, they have a cart escalator (so cool!), and the line moved fast even on a Sunday. I will be back for sure!
Bought a Sizzle and it was cold by the time I got to my car. Coffee banging though. Will come back again.

This is my all time favorite Starbucks. Sometimes when you have a harder drink order, with substitutions and what not, the taste of the drink varies on a daily basis depending on who makes it. This Starbucks is the ONLY Starbucks to constantly make my drink correctly and tasty. The employees always have such a great attitude, even when they're busy and running around all over the place trying to get you your drink as fast as they can. This Starbucks always actually HEATS UP my food. So many times other stores will 'warm up' my sandwich, but it's done so half ass that my bread it still tough. If you've had a bad experience at a Starbucks I most definitely recommend trying out this location to make the experience right.

Very much enjoyed the pizza that I had, and the guy that took my order ensured that I got the best deal for my money. The fried jalapeños were a nice surprise and clearly were fresh made and not frozen. The only disappointed was that they didn't have any feta cheese.
We went during the lunch rush. The line was insanely long. The food was undercooked. The presentation was beautiful but overall it was too high priced for too low quality

I really want to give this place a positive review, it's just difficult for me because I work right down the corner and I always get screwed over. Their food is awesome! There is nothing wrong with their food or their customer service, except for the fact that they take WAYYYY to damn long! Since I try to be understanding and work around this known fact, I call in my order to pick it up at LEAST 20 min before I know I want to eat. Even still, just today I called in their "Breakfast in a Go cup" which consists of scrambled eggs, bacon, hashbrowns, and sausage. It's delicious! Anyways, I called it in at 8:55 I get there at 9:20 and it's still not ready! I had to close my shop to walk over there and the longer I close, the more potential sales I lose. So for me time is money and I did not appreciate that I had to wait another 10-15 min for my called in order. 

I hope I don't have to start calling in my breakfast an hour before hand. if not, I may just have to go to Magnolia Grill or some other near-by breakfast place. My issue is time because I don't have a lot of it. I tried to work around it, like I said, but I feel as though I shouldn't have to.

If you're not in a hurry then by all means, this place is great. their coffee and cookies are delicious. 

it's worth a try.

Floris is the best! Cleanliness,  customer service & selection is beyond a 10!  Amazing massage and all of the extras they do make it an incredible experience. Treat yourself to an Organic Pedicure. You won't be disappointed!

This place was way too overhyped. I came here as the first stop on a Philly cheesesteak hop because the reviews looked great. Maybe my first tip off should have been how there was no line at all. I was so disappointed. I ordered an original cheesesteak with cheese wiz and onion. There is no option for grilled onions, so I got them raw, which I don't mind, but they way they were placed on the sandwich, they kept falling out every time I brought it up to my mouth for a bite. I had to re-stuff the sandwich myself. The sandwich was pretty big, but that was really the only plus. The meat was so dry it felt like I was chewing on rubber. I know cheese wiz is salty, but the sandwich was a lot saltier than most cheesesteaks I have had. 

On the plus side, there is a huge selection of beer that is pretty well priced.

Really 3.5.

Our book club met here on a Sunday morning at 10 AM. The place was packed! I decided to skip getting any coffee because it was obvious that the group of annoyed people waiting by the cash registers were all waiting for made to order drinks.  It seemed a shame to not order a coffee at a place called the Coffeebar, but I wasn't in the mood to wait too long because well, the rest of the book club was waiting on me. I just wanted a little quiche and water. They handed me a little table marker and told me my food would be delivered to me shortly. I'm not sure how long it takes to microwave a tiny quiche, but it took over 20 minutes to get to my table. Not only that, but it was not even warm. I was hungry by then, so I just ate it.

The property itself is beautiful - lots of outdoor seating, not too loud inside (we were probably the loudest!)

Another pet peeve: Few, if any, of the items in the display cases had any prices on them. If you can take the time to handwrite the name of the daily menu items, take the time to write the price next to it.

Been twice, first time it was one of the best meals I've eaten in New Orleans. Second time was so-so, but we also have a table for 6 versus 2 the first time. My only complaint is that even with reservations you can wait 45 minutes or longer for a table. That's unforgiveable and therefore I choose to go elsewhere.

Literal sense of don't judge a book by it's cover. They have a dorky sign that made my friends and I avoid it forever. After not wanting to drive some place to grab breakfast we decided to give this place a try and it was really good!

Some of the best micro brewed beers around! I always enjoy coming here to dine and. Have a drink with friends. The staff is great and the food and spirits are awesome! Highly recommend and also a place worth waiting for when there is a long line!

The shrimp spring rolls were really tasty. The pho was disappointing. They had none of the normal fixings - tripe, tendon etc... and the broth was bland. Hot sauce helps. My friend had the vermicelli noodles with pork and liked it a lot.

My husband and I were strolling the streets of Philly looking for a place to eat after 9 pm.  We saw the lights on and went in and even though they were obviously in The "shutting things down" mode, they graciously welcomed us and treated us like family. The food was amazing too.
Good service. But inconsistent pricing. For the same haircut, I have been charged anywhere from $10 to $20. Tips in cash only.

Not sure why such great reviews, I guess not much Vietnamese to choose from in Nola. Had the shrimp and avocado fresh rolls. Good. Had the pho ga. Broth is just ok, nothing special, and not a lot of it. Asked for veges instead of noodles. $2 up charge. Ate half and asked for to go. They mixed up our to go packages, didn't find out till got home, so into the garbage the leftovers went. Want great pho? Go to Houston or Los Angeles. Stay with the poboys and red beans here in nola, y'all.

What happened to the original Rolynos???  They do not deliver anymore, the pizza tasted burnt, I ordered half cheese and half meat lovers. The pizza was 75% just cheese. This used to be my husband's favorite pizza place, unfortunately we will not be ordering from them again.

This was a great first experience for a float spa. The facility was very clean and they even change out the water in between floats. I found it to be a very calming relaxing experience. Lots of options of keeping the pod open/ semi open while floating. The rain shower you start and end with was wonderful. Would definitely try it again and my skin was very soft after floating!

I think three or four employees approached me at different times offering help. Generally, employees here seem happy and eager to offer assistance and advice when asked. The store is large, clean and laid out in a logical sense. During my past two visits, I came in around 8pm and stayed a few minutes after closing (they close at 9 and I lost track of time), but I wasn't rushed out. As a matter of fact, a nice staff member at the deli asked me if I needed anything from there as they were getting ready to put away a few things. 

In addition to the nice service, one other thing that stood out to me is the crazy price difference between store brand and name brand. Store brand is called "365" and is sometimes MUCH lower in price depending on what type of item you're looking for. In some cases, especially with bath and body products, vitamins and other items, I found a difference between $6-$7. For instance, "365" body wash products will cost you $3 and change for 16 oz. Compare that to the surrounding name brand items that start at around $8 and more (for about the same size). My point? Take advantage of store brand when possible. They're just as good quality-wise and will help you save. 

Food bar offers a nice selection of different ethnic cuisines. Bakery has everything from cakes to cupcakes to french macarons and more. Oh, they offer a variety of coffee and tea beverages at the bakery too. Also, there's a juice bar right next to the bakery. They have a chalkboard menu and paper menu too. They'll take the selected fruits and veggies (in addition to things like dates and such) and throw them into a blender to make your smoothie- no added crap! Deli makes made-to-order subs and they have pizza and sushi too, in addition to several other items like salads, meats, cheeses, etc.

Two really great attendants, one of whom met me as I was bringing laundry in and held the door open and explained the machines. Other attendant helped me figure out how much soap to put and put in for me since I didn't have measuring cup. He helped me get the right amount of $$ on laundry card using the machine (no coins!!) Very clean. Very well maintained. Machines wash at 22 minute cycles. Various capacities available. Attendants really make the experience very pleasant.

Excellent twist on Mexican food. Favorite restaurant in this town
Crispy shrimp tacos or excellent.

I tried Barbuzzo a month ago when I tried their takeout menu during the pandemic. I was so impressed that I leapt at the chance to try the restaurant in person when they reopened for outdoor dining. I made a reservation, but (perhaps because it was July 4th) there were some empty tables available for walk-ins. 

To start our meal, we ordered the rose sangria. This was a refreshing drink, not too sweet and some nice chunks of apple. For the food, we started with the whipped ricotta with grilled olive oil brushed bread. This was DELICIOUS. The ricotta is so creamy and decadent and paired with a balsamic vinegar that offers just the right amount of contrast. We licked the plate clean! For the entree, we ordered the caciocavallo stuffed meatballs - these were extremely flavorful shortrib and a cheesy center. They had just the right amount of kick from the chile and were presented in a hearty tomato sauce. Finally, we got the summer corn pizza which was truly unique. This was a white pizza topped with roasted corn, truffled egg that oozed out, guanciale (bits of fatty bacon), and some scallions on top. It was excellent, every single bite was interesting and rich and delicious. 

Overall, I was very impressed by Barbuzzo - the food was superb and they provided a wonderful dining experience during these uncertain times. I would HIGHLY recommend to anyone in the mood for a delicious mediterranean/italian meal.

Very very good!!! The waiters will be arrogant and challenge you on your ability to eat spicy food but pay no attention them.  This food is fantastic!  And you adjust the level of spiciness based on a numeric scale.  You may want to start low to get a baseline.

Dan dan noodles are amazing! Garlic chicken something was so good!!! Dry pot beef was great!!!

Certainly will be back!
We've worked with Advance Appliance twice now and they've been super pro both times. Highly recommended!

Liz cuts my hair and she's always SO AWESOME. She knows what's good for your hair and she knows exactly what you want, or better. She's so friendly and funny! This place has just been totally renovated about a few weeks ago and it looks awesome!!!!! 

Now when it comes to the other services, I've never tried yet, so this review is for Liz and her hair services here!

Tons of bang for the buck - I've had good luck with the chop shop.  $10 has bought me cuts that were awesome and a few that were not as awesome but still cute.

I think you'll do fine if you go in with a strong idea of what you want: this is a place with a HUGE volume of customers, so they don't have a lot of time to lavish on your hair.  If you're seeking that kind of attention, creative artistry and inspired hair, choose your stylist carefully and tip well - or go to The Alley or AmMo.  This is the kind of place where you need to bring a picture and a verbal description of what you want.  And once you find a stylist there who fits, request them next time (it's worth the extra $5).  For what they are, I think the chop shop does an incredible job.  They consistently turn out good (and at worst, mediocre) hair for a ridiculously cheap price.

I have reviewed this salon before, but it was over a year ago, so I want to review again. I love this salon. I don't always get the same stylist, but I have always been happy with the cut. I also haven't had to wait long to get my hair cut and therefore have never used the "call ahead" feature. As in all businesses, there is turnover, but don't disqualify this place by reading other reviews because I honestly couldn't be happier with everything about this location.
Umm lets see ... A donut shop thats always open, has friendly service and has amazing blueberry filled donuts...yeah I give it five stars!
the pot roast melts in your mouth; the burgers and pizza are great; and the pretzel with beer cheese will make you wanna slap your mama!!
Wow! Small plates, large flavor? Amazing staff from check in, "JP" the bartender to our server, phenomenal!!!

Good food. Especially for a location near the beach. Because of COVID-19 we took our food Togo. 

I like the chowder fries and lobster roll. 

I'm not putting 5 stars because the fish and chips that my wife had wasn't as great as the rest of the food.

Every visit to this place puts me at ease instantly. The atmosphere is quaint, comfortable, and entertaining all at once. There are tons of little touches throughout the place, you can tell someone cared to fill the place with love.

The owner is very helpful, and will help you dive through the massive amount of choices for drinks and sundry.

I ordered the picnic basket on my first visit, and everything in it was just the perfect combo. I felt a little piggy for eating it all by myself (it's meant for two), but whatever! 

Tonight I got the Danish Brownie and Spiked Hot Chocolate (w/ Walnut Liquor) -- Soooo sooo sooo good.

They have live music some nights, and poetry reading on others. Whatever the case, I invariably find myself drifting here when I find myself in St. Louis.

Had lunch, enchilada and  burrito. Sauce on enchilada is a little on the sweet side. Salsa is not bad, could be more hot for my taste. I thought the plate could use a little more beans and rice. Overall ok

Don't let the size of the bakery fool you. Their desserts pack some punch. Beware though as the delicious cupcakes are very addictive! 

PS - Try the cookies too. The flourless chocolate cookie is Heaven.

I like it here. There isn't anything that stands out but it's reminiscent of my early 20's. I love live music and I'd say anything goes but I'm not a huge country fan (yea, I know it's Nashville). I like the diversity here and the staff might be indifferent but I've never thought them to be rude. The patrons are pretty relaxed and clearly out to enjoy themselves. The booze is pretty standard and at a place like this I'm fine with that. It's not fancy or super hipster and it's not "dirty" but it's not spotless either. I love how the customers vary depending on the band. Overall, I'm not a regular but I enjoy stopping in to check out the atmosphere for the night.

I typically don't like it when the hype around something turns out to be justified. When something is super hyped, I usually look forward to being let down and thinking judgementally, "people are so sheepish.. and don't think for themselves." 

Well, the hype around Husk was real. It was definitely justified. The atmosphere was great, nice and clean and simple. The service was top notch with no hint of pretentiousness.  This place probably could've gotten away with a few degrees of pretentiousness from the servers, like maybe 2/5, with 5/5 being the most douchebaggy pretentiousness a server can exude...but however, there was none. I think that's what I liked the most about this place.. all the makings of fine dining with zero douchebaggery. That's hard to come by these days. 

Oh, also, the food was amazing.

I just can't say enough good things about Clesi's Restaurant and Catering. The food was the best crawfish boil I've ever had (and I've had my share), the staff was A++, and the care they took for my dear friends wedding reception went above and beyond expectations.  If you're looking for an unparalleled experience, look no further! Thank you for such a  wonderful experience Clessi's Catering!!

Probably the worst dining experience ever.  Cold meatballs, rewarmed wings with left over onions, eggs on a salad that were already crusty and the inability of the wait staff to get the order right.  Not only did they fail on ever level, but once an item was sent back and then returned to the table, it was still wrong.  This place needs serious management help.  Food is only fair at best, and now with other offering the same fare at lower prices, not worth the trip here.  Take a pass, save yourself some aggravation and go somewhere else
Overpriced, tiny portions, and ice cream is not rich in flavor. Avoid.

Great customer service is a must for the prices that this store has. The employees are friendly and so helpful. They genuinely tried to help me with any item I needed. They are great with returns too.
Chill, family-oriented Italian spot! Prices are great for some quality pasta. The spaghetti with meat sauce is fantastic!

I was trying to be a good citizen and recycle a garage full of cardboard left from our recent move.  I called Waste Management, our garbage provider, and they would not take my cardboard.  I asked where I could find an recycle center closely and she told me to call 1800-Junk.  I couldn't believe it!  So I called The Bridgade and Harvard said he was taking a day off, but he could come right over to help us.  And he did!  He brought a huge trailer and loaded all the boxes and even some other items in about 1/2 hr.  He was very pleasant, conversive, and interesting.  The garage looks fabulous! I highly recommend Harvard and The Brigade!!  This is in Tucson, AZ
Returned here while on jury duty a few weeks ago, still a great unique place with so many choices. It's pretty crowded in the summer, but you can handle it.

After calling last week and asking about happy hour and being told it was still on, I was finally able to venture to to Datz today to get my happy hour on for my mom's birthday. I walked in and encountered the host, who didn't say a word to us, just put up 3 fingers. I asked for 3 people for happy hour and he abruptly turned and led us to the table without a word or anything. He came off very rude. When the waitress came up, she informed us there was no more happy hour. At that point I was already annoyed about the host and his rudeness, but we were hungry so we just decided to sit and eat. The food was good, as always, but I only saw my waitress once after we got our food and weren't really checked on. I get that it's not fun during covid, I'm in the industry as well, but there's no need to be abrupt or rude to guests who make it a point to come out to the restaurant that usually makes them happy. The host needs to work on his attitude some.

Normally, I don't review chain restaurants. But once in a blue moon, you have to pay homage to one of America's finest, the Waffle House.

Do you know that FEMA uses Waffle House as an informal gauge of how bad a natural disaster is? If that doesn't indicate how important this establishment is, I don't know what will. The people who work here are some of the most important people in the world, and they work their asses off to ensure we get our greasy hashbrowns and coffee 24/365

Per usual, Waffle House never changes, that's why we love her. She is the same, with the food you could probably make yourself at home, but still tastes 100 times better in these 4 walls.

5 stars? You give her 5 stars because you need to, not because you want to.
Loan rocks!!!  She's very attentive to details and the gel nails look great for up to 4 weeks!!!!!!
So happy we got our Philly cheesesteak fix here instead of Genos or Pats. We ate in the comfort of air conditioning and had yummy sides with our sandwich and a beer!

good:  nice place, trendy feel to it.  Very busy on a Sunday at 10:30 and yet we only waited probably 15 mins to get a table for 5.  

Bad:  waitress was barely there.   only refilled drinks once.   food arrived slow and some people's were cold.  I ordered the slinger, it was ok at best.  nothing to get excited about that's for sure. 

probably won't be going back anytime soon.

This is an excellent Exxon. It is the first station after you exit the Causeway Bridge and it has a boatload of pumps. The convenience store section is huge and has nearly everything you want. This station gets very crowded, but I have never had a problem getting a pump.

I have noticed that people stare at me as if I am an alien in the mornings when I fuel up. I don't know if they have some superpower and can tell that I am actually an alien, or if I just give of the "hey stare at me" vibe.

Happy pumping.

Our table was ready as soon as we arrived. While waiting for the rest of the group, I went to the bar for a martini, and I was greeted and served almost instantly. I went there for a large group gathering, and we didn't have to wait very long for our orders. The food is pretty good. Everything about my order was brought just how I asked for it. 

The downside here is that our waiter was a little rude. He almost never asked us if we needed anything, and his replies were very short and ill-tempered. It was difficult for us to get his attention, and everyone at our table noticed our waiter's lack of friendliness. Aside from that, the service didn't give us any issues.
Great food, awful sense of urgency and not enough employees to handle busyness. Do not come here if you're not in the mood to wait around

a few months back we took our cat in to get examined. She was all of a sudden having 2 seizures a day and going through some discomfort.  since collingswood was near by we took her there. The vet assistant was a bit unfriendly and didnt really show any sign of a caring person.. Enters the Dr.,  who "examined" our elderly cat by literally twisting her back skin,  as well as pulling her scalp hairs as our cat was reacting in obvious agony and I honestly came extremely close to physically stopping him and restrained myself from hurting him . They had no records of us being there years ago and were very heartless.  After the threshold of pain exam was finished. the assistant came back in w a 2 page list of mandatory tests and service costs that were well over $ 2,000.00  in costs, and that was just to maybe figure out the problem, and find out what tests they would need to do to treat our cat.. They were horrible in every way possible and gave us zero advice, zero hope,and recommended nothing except getting all these tests done and pay or consider euthanization.. We left infuriated never to return. Then went to vet in Blackwood and had a totally different experience where the staff cared and were personable and got our cat examined and left with an inexpensive office fee and proscription which totally has stopped the seizures and our cat is doing quite well .. thankfully.  I NEVER write reviews but in this case i had to and hopefully it will help some people and their pets from maybe euthanizing an animal that can be treated and maybe even to stop this place from operating..

This strip mall restaurant really confuses me. The inside is relatively small but clean and well kept. There was also outside seating available which is nice. On a Sunday afternoon there were about 6 tables occupied with 2 tables that were occupied by Hispanic people which is usually a good sign. My son and I were seated quickly and chips and salsa brought to the table. Tri-color chips? Really? The salsa was smooth and tomatoey. Drinks were brought out timely. On a Sunday early afternoon, 1 TV was on American football, 1 on European football (soccer), 1 on CNN and 2 on a camping show. The menu is huge. Too many choices.

I ordered their signature cilantro cream enchiladas and my son order the Monterey Quesadilla. The food came out fast. I mean unexpectedly fast. The quesadilla was rolled which I hadn't before and appeared to be heated on a flattop but it came out way to quick. My son said it was good. The cilantro cream enchiladas were just 2 small tortillas rolled with only precooked chicken chunks, no binders. Every time I cut the tortilla the chicken chunks pour out. The cream sauce was good but needed more cilantro. The enchiladas came with rice and black beans. The rice was pretty standard overcooked and dry. The black beans came in a tortilla cup and they had no flavor. They didn't even taste like beans. They had NO flavor. They were very confusing and I left them behind.

All-in-all, there must be something tasty on the menu with so many 4 and 5 stars but I didn't find it and I am not planning to go back and try to find out.

Unless you're a country music star or already have perfect hair DO NOT go here. By far, this was the worst experience I have ever had at a hair salon (or anywhere for that matter). After paying my nonrefundable deposit and speaking with both the manager and stylist via email about my concerns, they assured me I could come in and get my boxed dye job gone wrong fixed. Instead, I show up and am immediately laughed at by how bad my hair looks. The stylist (savannah) took pictures without telling me why. I'm then told they can't do anything about it. They didn't want to "risk" anything, even though I had already sent pictures of my hair before. They cater to wealthy, basic barbies. I was not refunded my $100 deposit despite getting nothing done to my hair. These people just don't want to get bad reviews because of their high profile clients. Unless you want to be judged, laughed at, and, in my case, left with no service after taking my day off to get my hair fixed, DO NOT GO HERE!

Heard the cakes are good. Husband got one for my birthday.. I didn't like it strawberry shortcake. No one liked it, the kids or husband. Im sad. But hey i gave it a try. We will stick to our other place. We went to sweet eats in Marlton.

THE WORST!  I waited for 3 HOURS for my delivery order to arrive and called 6 times to inquire what their problem was! When my food finally arrived, it was cold and disgusting.  I love Indian food but this truly tasted awful and the customer service was negligible!  Do not eat here.

So glad a Papa John's opened up closer to where we live and now we have one within delivery range. Of the big chain pizza stores, I prefer Papa John's over Pizza Hut and Domino's. I usually just do online ordering and pick up my order. It's nice inside, but no place to eat, so it's basically pick-up or delivery here. Staff was friendly when I went to pick up my order. The place is easy to get in and out of. My kids love their pizza, so we'll be frequenting this location often!

Owner owns this shop and the Upholstery shop next door.  He says he can not sew a simple pillowcase FFS.  I wasted my time trying to locate this store and all he could say to me was he could not show a cushion cover (pillow I had with me)  Fortunately for me I found this out before dragging an actual cushion from my couch to his store to be fixed.  Avoid this business unless you have free time to waste.

What a treat! It's been five years since my first Kumas experience in Chicago, and I was so excited when I heard the news of them expanding to Indy. Kumas fits right in with Fountain Square's cool, hipster culture. 

Their burgers are all named after (in)famous heavy metal rock bands eg Metallica, YOB, iron maiden, just to name a few. I personally am a huge fan of their hand cut fries and housemade potato chips. Oh, what's that now? You're a coke person and not team Pepsi products? That's cool, bc they don't have either one. They throw it back to RC cola. 

To this day I still have yet to try their Mac n cheese, but i hear it's pretty fire. 

I don't agree with the notion of the original always being better esp when it comes to food. However, having tried both Midwest locations, I would have to agree this time and say that I thought the food quality was slightly better at the original Chitown location. My husband and I ordered two very different burgers yet we both found them two notches north of just enough salt - hence the missing fifth star. 

Regardless, I will come definitely be coming back to try the Mac n cheese next time!
There's something nice about being able to bike to your local grocery store and greet some of the same people each time you go. It's not polished or cheap but it feels like home.

Whether you are starving  or just looking to have a light lunch, Red Robbins has great variety of affordable dishes to exceed your expectations.  Among my favorite are the Fish and Chips, the Cobb Salad and their Bacon Cheddar Burger.   The resterants interior is a bright and colorful atmosphere great for family or couples.
After working all day came to Botto's for Margaritas and the bartender was very rude and rolling her eyes at us. Overcharged us on one of the Margaritas. I will never go back here again. So unhappy.

I had some tires shipped here from Tire Rack and made an appointment for installation. When I got here, I was informed that installation would take about an hour. Within three minutes of my arrival, staff had lost my keys. After waiting for about 75 minutes I asked about how much longer the job would take was treated as if I were an inconvenience for asking and even for bringing my car in that day, even though I had made my appointment nearly a week in advance. In total, the job took over an hour and 45 minutes, and I received no apology for the wait.

I love this place! The first time I went was for a company party. I wasn't too excited seeing that I'm a vegetarian. However, my mood changed quickly once I made my first plate from the bar. 

I LOVE the coconut coleslaw. It's different and leaves such a good aftertaste. The rest of my family enjoys the endless rounds of meat. We eat here about once per month. 

The service has always been good for us. You can valet, then walk around downtown after eating before returning for your car. 

Highly recommend!

They have very good Chinese food. We have had several different times and all very good. Only thing didn't like was fortune cookies and almond cookies - must buy rather than make as taste stale. But again food great and place clean and people friendly - recommend!
Cindy and her crew of ladies are just awesome! Pleasant, hard working and do great nails and pedis. This place is clean and attractive. Always busy and welcoming, a winner in Yardley.

I really wanted to try Varga Bar after seeing, twice, quite a full house. So, I went on a Thursday, and was surprised to get a seat immediately. Thought there would be a wait. Our waiter was very casually dressed, making me think he might be a busboy, but their dress code is apparently just really casual. He turned out to be very polite and knowledgeable, recommending a beer, which I tried. No non-alcoholic beers on the menu, though, which my friend drinks. We were enticed by the somewhat limited menu. The truffled mac and cheese turned out to be the highlight of our meal. Rich and cheesy and soooo yummy. Darkened on the top, just to perfection. We ordered that with the beet salad. I'm not a fan of beets, but I thought it was tolerable. 

For my main meal, I had a burger. I figured that no one can mess up a burger! It was quite good, yet so tall that I had to mash it down. Traded half for half of my friend's pork sandwich. Burger was better than the pork. Very interesting - they make their own ketchup and mustard, pickles (with pickled ginger). The waiter mentioned their breakfast cereal ice cream, which sounded fascinating, but we were too full. I have also read about a root beer float, which could have been good, if I weren't so full. Overall, I'd recommend this place. I thought the prices were okay, the vibe in the restaurant was great (though it was quite loud), and the food was decent, depending on what you ordered. I can't forget that mac and cheese, though. I'll be back for it!

Incredible. From the moment I saw the outside from the moment I walked out the door, my experience here was nothing short of excellence. 

Upon arrival, I was amazed with how beautiful the outside looked like. The multicolored building really caught my eye and from that moment I couldn't wait to see what was in store. We walked in to a crowded lobby to give our name to the hostess. She informed us there was going to be a 30 minute wait & took my number. We waited for not even 10 minutes before my phone was ringing saying they have our table ready. I was already impressed. We were seated in the main dining area and wow- was this place BEAUTIFUL. I was truly blown away with the architecture of this restaurant and have never seen anything like it. From the multi-level eating, to the different seating areas, this place was already a 5/5. 

We were quickly approached by our waiter, Sebastian, who took our drink order & asked us if we had any questions about the menu. He also gave us our bread & butter (which was amazing). Once our drinks arrived, he gave us plenty of enough time to look over the menu & even made sure we had a lunch menu and a dinner menu. Once we knew what we were getting, he informed us one of the dishes was going to take 30 minutes to prepare. We ordered the Empanadas appetizer to hold us over and wow was that an amazing idea. These were the first empanadas I have ever tried and I had no idea what to expect. After the first bite I took, i was hooked. They were the perfect texture, filled with the exact right amount of meat & goodies, and warmed to the perfect temperature. 

Now for the main course. Indescribable. I ordered the Breaded Steak Milanese and when it came out it honestly blew my mind. This was the biggest piece of steak I have ever seen. It was literally hanging off of the plate because it was that big. It was nicely sauced with their Catalana Tomato sauce with some yellow rice. The steak was so tender that I could literally cut it with my fork. There was just the right amount of sauce & rice for the steak. I honestly took about half of the meal home because it was that huge. 

Sebastian was a phenomenal waiter. Our glasses were always full & he made sure we had everything we needed. He was timely, attentive, and so friendly. I wish I was staying in Tampa for a couple more days so I could come back to Columbia Restaurant!

My husband and I are regulars there. We live this place. Sp far everything we order always a big hit. Hard to choose between rolls because we can only eat so much, but we love them all. Service is always excellent too!
Worst pizza and cheesesticks I've ever had.  Ordered for delivery and both were burnt and cold; what a terrible combination.

Do not underestimate the four stars. Understand that these are very SOLID four stars.

This place is great for any amount of parties. They have plates for one or family share. Tan Dinh is one of two staple Vietnamese restaurants for foods, other than pho, in the whole city. I stick by this resturaunt when it comes to Nola Vietnamese cuisine. 

Their egg rolls are very unique and a must order always.

I love their grilled beef spring rolls

nem nuong springs are really good. Love the sauce

Tamarind chicken is super Delish.

My go-to plate would be the rotisserie chicken. It's enough for now and later and that sauce is a must.

I've been to place for many years and will continue to visit this place when I get cravings for amazing Vietnamese food.
A great family place as well as a place to take a date. Wonderful food and service. It seems they are always busy. Try the Turkey Burger, you won't be saddened!

Fun place - 3 stories & a lot going on. Nice selection of beers, cider & cocktails. Food was solid but nothing special although I had the shrimp & grits which I'm thinking was not the best choice. Live music on a Friday afternoon - good place to spend some time on Broadway. Rooftop area good place to settle in for a night of drinking with friends. Also offer sushi menu on second floor and they are ok with ordering from one floor and taking to another. Cool space overall.

Don't place a delivery order from here, or actually any location. You'll get the pleasure of speaking with an employee who sounds miserable. I have placed a delivery order twice and never again will that happen. The first order I placed was a pepperoni pizza. Sounds simple right? But when the girl on the other end asked me what toppings I wanted I simply said pepperoni, obviously because cheese comes with your pizza unless otherwise stated. When my pizza arrived I had a pizza with pizza sauce and pepperoni. She had actually taken me literally. 
The next time I ordered delivery I ordered a pepperoni with 2 extra toppings. When I asked the SAME girl if cheese came on the pizza she answered annoyed "Ya, it's standard" .. Yeah I know. Rustys is crap when it comes to customer service.
Tried to hard to design eclectic, service moderate, the food was ok, nothing outstanding, odd location.  Good for a few visits.

FABULOUS Farmers Market! WOWZA!! We went down to the river to run our dog after a long hard rain so we could actually see water in the "river" and got lucky just happening upon the market. I've heard of it numerous times but normally we're busy on Sunday mornings, so we never had the opportunity to go. Well, after our experience I will be making a point to go as often as possible!!

The availability and selection of spices, fresh produce, farm fresh eggs, local foods, beef, seafood, jams, etc. were outstanding!

Tip: I did not have cash. There are 2 banks in St. Phillips Plaza with ATM's. However, if you don't want to pay bank fees, head over to the Farmers Market Information booth. You can purchase $5 wooden nickels to use at any booth at the market. Debit and credit accepted. You will receive cash back in change from the vendors. If you don't use all your wooden nickels, they are good anytime. They never expire.

Tip#2: The same people that run this market also run the Oro Valley Market on Saturday mornings. Not as big but great nonetheless. AND...there will be a new Saturday morning farmers market opening at Maynard's downtown in October 2011. I'm so excited at the ever-expanding opportunities for fresh produce and local goods!

Tip#3: Planet of the Crepes is here every Sunday!!

Ever since they reopened for daily lunch/brunch it just isn't the same as it used to be. No pizza, no Asian/Chinese, desserts are limited....
The food isn't always fresh and the service has even fallen off. 
It's been very disappointing and I have given it three shots. I mean it's a little odd to have breakfast and lunch in the afternoon on a week day. I mean, C'mon! It's pizza!!!
Anyway, it's about one step above Casino Queen's buffet and that's not saying much.

We spoke with four other companies prior to our appointment with David and nobody ever mentioned plants. David is very passionate about plants and his designs worked well with our needs and budget. Immediately, he started on the project and finished in 6 days. We had a 2100 sq ft muddy back yard that he turned into a National Park nature trail. David stands behind his plants as a few of them did not survive the summer heat and he replaced them. Just trust his vision and let leave him to his art. No one else is going to care about the balance of yard privacy, water conservation, and practical budget demands like Arid Plant Designs.
One of many favorites in New Orleans. Outdoor dining is a treat. Drinks are great. Was able to get seated right away.
The food is great! They also have really good gluten free options. I always get the gluten free pasta and the sausage appetizer.

I've fantasized about a weekend getaway in Santa Barbara ever since I saw L.A. Story (ahem, that's was 20 years ago). This weekend I lived the dream with a stay in Chesire Cat Inn's Mobberly cottage.

The Inn has all the charm of its English owner and associated Inn Keepers - that damn accent always makes you feel special. The Mobberly cottage is quite large for two people with a bedroom, bathroom, living room with fireplace and slit of a westward facing window for the sunset, a kitchen that we simply used to drop our luggage, and a back patio primarily important because it has a 2-person jacuzzi. The cottage is a small 1BR house across the street from the two main houses that make up the property.

I found the breakfast to be very convenient - one day we had a decent frittata and the next day Swedish ebelskivers. We had breakfast brought to our room on Day 1 and tried the parlor dining room the next morning. In the parlor you can choose several quick starts to your day.

Many great things are within easy walking distance:
*Santa Barbara Mission
*State Street (restaurants & shopping)
*Alice Keck Park Memorial Gardens

The park was an unexpected gem. It's a city block of unexpected biodiversity in an urban park. Phenomenal.

We were busy running round town and never made it back in time for the wine hour.

The gas fireplace in the cottage was one of the best I've ever seen, high flames convincingly lapping ceramic logs an put off a lot of heat.

I got to explore during a recent Sip & Shop event and left with a beautiful set of tableware and the friendliest people you could ever want to meet! They helped me coordinate my sale items with a smile. They also were so gracious in hosting the Sip & Shop..... it was a wonderful night!
Amazing place to stop for a bite to eat. Every time we are in town our friends bring us here. Wonderful people and wonderful food!!

Horrible experience today. I've been coming here for about 3.5 years and the bikini waxes are always good and the eye brows are usually fine. Today, they stated that I had a service that I didn't have and was charged for it. I was told that I needed to pay for it and then call the manager the following day since she had left already. I stated that I was not being charged for a service I didn't have - or know that I was having. This process went on for 25 minutes and finally, they stated that it would be "complimentary" which was infuriating. The customer service was horrendous and I'm shocked that this is how people behave and treat customers. Get it together!

I've been waiting for a Jamaican restaurant to come to the area so that I don't have to go to Nj. I've been to Paradise 3-4x and had the jerk chicken w/ rice n peas, Mac n cheese, chicken patty, and plantains. All the food was tasty and the jerk chicken had just the right amount of kick. They have a house sauce that's sweet n spicy, I love it and put it on everything.

So yesterday I dined at Brooklyn Tomato for lunch with two guests. I had the number 21 which has a peanut satay sauce. It was spicy but in a good way for those who enjoy spicy foods.
