The presentation was unique as the noodles were in a circular ball in the middle.  It looked great and was probably the best pho I've ever had.  My wife couldn't come yesterday so I'm back again, two days in a row. This time I ordered the #17 Thin Sliced Medium Rare Beef Pho (my number 21 yesterday was better) and she ordered the #20A Tom Yum Noodle Soup which was full of vegetables. Hers made for a very balanced meal. We also ordered the salad rolls. These came with a tasty peanut sauce and we both loved them.  The salad rolls did tend to fall apart before we were finished but they were too delicious to care. I can now say that this is my favorite pho place.  There is plenty of parking and the service is friendly and helpful.  Our appetizer came out quickly and the soup arrived just as we were finishing the salad rolls. There's lots of space between the tables so you can enjoy your visit with friends or family without hearing others or being heard.  This is a place that you can take anyone and not worry about anything.

They were doing well on a Thursday evening but fortunately we were still seated quickly.  First they bring out garlic bread which is really really good. Then we started with fried mozzarella and mussels, which were both also very delicious. I ordered the rigatoni and marinara sauce which I really enjoyed. My boyfriend's meal came with a side of penne vodka which was amazing, and I'd definitely recommend. Another guest got the lobster ravioli which was also really good. We also all shared a small pizza which was okay too. Our service was really friendly and great as well. It is more on the expensive side, but we had a nice time and I hope to return again. Also they're BYOB, so make sure you bring a bottle of wine or two when you come for dinner.

Website says DMV closes at 5:00p. I came there on a Friday with to get my driver license. I did the application part online thinking I could just show up with the Confirmation # and it would speed up the process and I could get in and out quickly, right? WRONG. I arrived at 3:30pm just as the lady came out to the parking lot to the wait line outside due to COVID social distancing to say they were no longer taking appointments. I'm thinking I have a confirmation # that can't possibly apply to me right? No. It works like this: you show up with confirmation # and get IN LINE to GET an appointment to BE in line. What the heck?! My point is I showed up 1.5 hrs BEFORE closing time to get turned down because they were done for the day. F. Up.
Went to Scoop de Ville last night. Great stuff. I had peanut butter blend. Yum. Long line but was quick. I'll be back

BEER is good but the food may be lacking depending on the current rotation on the menu that constantly changes. If you're unsure, stick with burgers and fries. The back eating area can get very loud, so if you have a chance to sit in the front near the entrance, take it.
When I showed up yesterday, they we're sold out of literally half of the items on the menu, including the Kennett square mushroom soup that they had just added to the menu that morning!

This place is not even worthy of one star. The service and food were horrific! The restaurant was empty yet we waited and waited and waited.......the food was disgusting and grossly overpriced! NEVER AGAIN! Seriously!!!
Single reason for walking out two seconds after I walked in, Cigarette smoke! The last place I want to get my clothes cleaned is a place that reeks of smoke!

Aloha Shack is in a convenient location for us living im the Valleys. Service is always great, quick, & my order is always accurate. I am a big fan if the Teriyaki plate. I order the mini one, because the portion is rather large. The rice and seasoning on the tots are addicting! However, I am not a fan of the Lumpia. Excluding that, everything else has been great! If you get the opportunity, you should definitely give them a try.

Good beignets, but I preferred Cafe du Monde. After ordering, it was clear that people come here not only for the beignets but for the breakfast sandwiches as well. By the smell of it, the breakfast sandwiches are superior to the sweet treats.
I don't think i would need to say more than absolutely delicious. Great service. Everything i have had here has been very good. Very fresh ingredients.

My girlfriend and I stopped in for a late dinner on a Friday night. We were seated right away and were both very hungry. The waiter, who was very nice, came over fairly soon and took our drink orders, brought them then took our food orders. So far, so good. Our appetizer, brochette, arrived in short order. However, it was quite spicy and my girlfriend ended up not even being able eat most of her portion. Then we waited. And waited. And waited. Our main course took forever to arrive. Finally, someone from the kitchen (not our waiter) brought the food and explained that they had run out of the sweet potato fries for my girlfriend's order and that was the cause of the delay. Fine, but it would have been nice if someone could have told us during our extremely long wait. Of course, now my food was cold because it had obviously been made first and just sat around. I might have said something if our waiter had been around. We hardly saw him for the rest of the meal. By the time we finished our meals it was quite late or else we might have tried the very tasty looking deserts at the counter. I don't plan on eating here again anytime soon.
Great menu options. Many for vegetarians as well. On the small side of portions so an entree with garlic naan was the perfect amount with no leftovers. The food was AMAZING! Highly recommend.

Chose Frazer's  for a friend's Birthday celebration and it was perfect.  Service was  outstanding, thanks Dave. He really knew the menu and wines. Entrees and appetizers were excellent. On the negative, two of the  specialty salads sounded great but had an  unappetizing presentation and taste. The only other negative was the  view from the outside of the building -it is a bit unkept and looking into the kitchen from outside gave some cause for concern as we arrived. The inside was immaculate however and overall is was a very enjoyable dinner,

The milkshakes were horrible. We bought 3 different flavored milkshakes and they all tastes the same and slightly freezer burned. The ice cream was good. The young ladies working were less than happy to be working but there was a huge line.

Got a new key FOB for my car from Batteries Plus Bulbs. It was super easy. They had to order the key specifically for my car -  they gave me a call as soon as it was ready, made sure it worked in my car and I was on my way! Very nice and friendly staff!

Great atmosphere to watch a ball game.  Went there to watch the A.L. playoffs on their 15ft wide TV.  Then, Archie Manning showed up.  Chatted with us for a few, took some pictures with us.  Real class act.  Would've gotten 5 stars, but we couldn't get a waitress on the outdoor patio, so we had to keep going inside to get food and drinks.  Staff inside were great.

I called Hoffman to request someone come out and take a look at some electrical issues.  I explained that we had sockets that were not working.   I was told that there was an $88 fee to just come out, which I agreed to.  I had to step out and when I did the electrician showed up and proceeded to tell my co-worker that the fee just to take a look was $379.  This was supposedly a troubleshooting fee.    I was told on the phone that once the person arrived they would troubleshoot and see what the problem was.  If we decided to have them fix the issue, the $88 would not be charged.  The guy was here a total of 10 minutes and said that there were 2 breakers that were not on...he said that it was the quickest job he had ever done.  So, for $379 the guy was here for 10 minutes and switched 2 breakers.   I called the office to complain and a lady answered the phone.  I was very upset and she stated that they did what they were supposed to do and that my friend should not have signed if she did not want them to look for the problem.  I explained that I had checked the breaker box and just did not realize if it was just 2 breakers...I just did not know.  She then said, "Well that is why you need someone to come out and look at it for you now, don't you?"  This may not be the exact wording, but it certainly is close enough.  I asked to speak to a manager several times and she eventually said she was a manager and I said I wanted to speak someone above her.  The sales person called me back and I proceed to explain the situation to him also.  He said that when the electrician comes in they have a book that shows them what they should charge to troubleshoot and repair.  I said that he never told me anything about needing to pay up front for anything except the $88 fee.  I asked him why he would not have quoted me the $379 over the phone since my friend gave the exact info to the electrician when he walked through the door prior to him looking at anything.  He said he does not have access to the book of fees.  I cannot believe a business does not have the fee book and only those in the field carry those. The electrician did showed my friend the price in the "book" and she thought it was something requiring some time to fix.  He literally walked in the breaker room and flipped 2 switches and it was fixed.  
I understand that there are protocol and even understand charging a couple hundred dollars for the time, but to charge that kind of money and have it be 2 breaker switches and not help renegotiate an almost $400 charge...what a rip off.  The guy also told me that I better watch what I say in any reviews that I write...he threatened me by saying that I could be in legal trouble.  Great customer service...charge me an exuberant amount of money, have a lady on the phone that was rude, a salesman not try to work with the customer along with threatening me about what I would write as a review...I am so disappointed in this experience.  Again, I absolutely think there needs to be a charge, but not for almost $400, that and the lack of customer service was extremely disappointing to me.

I had the Papaya shrimp and my husband had the Salmon special they were explained to us as a meal we would never forget!!!! No we won't forget this meal ...burnt spare ribs....had my soup served in a  dirty bowl ..dried out fried rice..and literally 4 pieces of shrimp with the skin still on the papaya..My husband's salmon had "hair" in it!! $75.00 later....never going back...

I've ordered from here more times than I can count. My go-to order is the carne enchilada burrito and the chips and guacamole. Prices are pretty reasonable for how much food you get. Guys there are nice and get your order done on time!

I often hate recommending restaurants to coworkers and friends, I always fear they may not feel the same way I do about places. That has all changed.

Thank You Garces Trading Co:  I have full confidence I can recommend you to anyone and they will enjoy it.  The energy is great, the food is always amazing, and a BYO you don't have to plan a trip to the wine store before hand? Genius!   Lunch or dinner, this place is great.  I have come here with big groups where we sat for hours without one dirty look from the waitstaff and I have brought my family for a quick lunch that was equally amazing.  This place never fails!

Wanted to try my first Pho ever, so I found this place. No signs for wait to be seated, so I sat at table near the window. I waited a bit and saw a few people come in raise there hand and they got seated and got there order. Being a bit confused!! I raised my hand. To my surprise it worked. The waiter came to my table and took my order. This must be the way they do it in there country. (Of course I am not sure of that) Ordered The Shrimp Pho. It was good.. but I was not sure what real Pho taste like since this was my first time. Tip ask for extra napkins cause your going to sweat a bit.

We went here for happy hour yesterday and was very impressed! They have great drink specials and all their speciality cocktails are $5. I got the raspberry peach margarita. We got some apps to share: ranch rings, crispy mahi tacos, crispy chicken tenders, and tenderloin sliders. Every dish was so good and worth the calories! We'll definitely be back.

What can you say?  It's Chuy's!  I love the light chips (some are too thick and flavorless), and especially the Creamy Jalapeno (just ask for it when they bring out the chips and salsa - no charge!  you will thank me for it!).  The service was great, and the food was hot and fresh.  They are Tex Mex with a few New Mexican flavors, too.  While I was not there for it, I did see something about free chips, salsa, and queso, during their week day happy hour, from 4p or 7p or something like that.  Also, while I normally would not get Mexican food to go, this is a great place to stop and pick up Creamy Jalapeno, salsa, and chips to take home to the family (or pig out on in your car before getting home! no one's judging, here...)

Angelo is a man. He is incredibly nice, kind and care. My car got in an accident and totally damage. Angelo help me tow my car and he doesn't charge me a penny like other else for keep my car there in his storage. He is so kind and I can't thanks enough for his works and time resolve my car. 
Totally recommend. Best body shop in town. 
You won't be disappointed.

We had a really good quick dinner here tonight, and the guys working there were so nice!   We had a fish taco, pastor taco, Sonoran dog, two types of burritos, chips & guacamole, and a churro.    All was delicious! Our only thing was we thought perhaps the oil was too hot because the chips had a slightly burnt flavor to them, and the churro was a bit underdone in the center... although still very flavorful!  We will be back!

Not bad!  I ordered a small pizza for take-out.  I got the smallest size, and it was about $5.87.  The pizza was very tasty.  Next time I'm going to try their salad.  Nice lunch for a reasonable price.  If you're in the area, I recommend giving it a try, I think you'll be pleased.

Considering it's Christmas, I almost feel bad leaving a terrible review. However, I like to leave reviews for people who are traveling. My mom and I don't have plans til dinner so we wanted somewhere to go for lunch. This was the experience... 

15 min wait for a table and it's empty.
15 min to order a water
Ordered food.. waited another half hour. 
It never showed
We asked for the check.
Didn't eat.. didn't want to even waste my time.
Then she messed up the charge, had to void.. idk if I even paid once or twice.

I've never left a place without even eating in my life.
This is really bad.. plus just to add it's dirty too.
Terrible service .. terrible place. Idk whether it's even terrible food because I left.

Still left her a tip because I've been serving for 8years and I think it's still the right thing to do.
Don't go here though.

In Tampa for the weekend and took a chance on German food. We live in Jacksonville, FL and there are no good German restaurants within 40 miles. We lived in Germany for 6 years and really appreciate good German food. Jagerstruble fits the bill as a good German restaurant. The Jager Schnitzel eand Spatle were very well prepared and presented. The portions were generous, but best of all was the salad. Amazing carrot salad and the carrot salad was the best I have ever tasted and I am not a big carrot lover. Kudos to Jagerstuble. I would definitely advise reservations because this is a cozy place that fills up fast. Highly recommended.

Not that great. Very slow service for one person sitting at the bar. Sandwich came with tomato and pickles, which I had asked to take off when ordering. And where are the seasoned TGI Friday fries I remember being so good? I got a double order of cold, plain, and tasteless fries.

This was my second time trying Sabrina's cafe, first time at this location. While the venue itself is very cute, my food was, as it was the first time, cold. Really disappointing to have the same bad experience at two different locations! If you like cold breakfast food, maybe this is the place for you, but i won't be frequenting Sabrina's anymore. Not to mention the extremely creepy and weird ad inviting guests to "text Sabrina's dad" about their experience.

My family and I just got into town and we're so excited to sit down and eat. Our mistake was choosing this joint.. service was okay food is AWFUL!! The steak tastes like the smell of a wet dog, the Philly Cheese steak is tasteless and isn't even on the right bread, the wings were awful as well. We also heard the chef sneeze in the kitchen while cooking. Highly recommend going anywhere else but here.

Superior Grill is a fantastic location for any group event... birthdays, book clubs, hangover recovery dinners. The restaurant is big enough to accommodate big tables (last time I was there the people in line before me got a table for 28), but is sectioned off so it's still pleasant for smaller groups. Make sure to try a margarita, and if it happens to be pay day, try one with a shot of flavor for $2 extra (my favorite is raspberry!).
The front staff was wonderful and so kind and helpful all throughout my experience. Dr. Lew and his team were amazing. I highly recommend this facility. Fair pricing and great care. Thank you again!

The cream cheese icing sticky bun is just amazing. The pastry itself is buttery and flaky while the icing is incredibly creamy with just the right amount of sweetness. The perfect indulgent breakfast.   Definitely not for the health conscious but it's good for my emotional health...

New Wilko post 2009 remodel is SO MUCH BETTER! 

Now it's not a convenience store/coffee bar/place to buy Spanx... it's suddenly a cute and posh restaurant where the food is great and the service is impeccable.

The servers have tattoos and look like they probably also work across the street at American Apparel - but the delicious soups and sandwiches more than make up for it. The lighting in the space somehow makes it substantially more classy than something that's located 0.1 miles away from a college campus. The bar is also very well stocked and the bar tenders are nothing but nice - which makes Wilko a fun places to go in between classes on a weekday. 

Overall - you can't go wrong with their sandwiches or extensive wine list.

McMahons
I had high expectations for McMahons and was sorely disappointed after my dining experience here. Here are a few more things that went wrong:
My table request, that I made weeks prior, was not honored. We had to sit near the noisy kitchen.
The server did not follow proper wine serving protocol - I know I sound like a snob saying that but he should've known better. They did have an amazing wine list though and a beautiful wine cellar though.
The wrong orders came out. 
Our steaks were severely under cooked, I have never seen my boyfriend send a steak back but we both had to this time.
The sommelier went around to literally ever table except ours though I could clearly see we bought the most expensive bottle (I guess I should mention my boyfriend and I look very young - we occasionally get treated this way and it drives me nuts)
Server was mostly MIA, I had to hunt down other severs and the hostess for help.
Last but not least, the food was above average but as good as it should've been for the price. 
Here's a quick review of the food:
Caprese Salad: Came with a lot of chese but was still pretty mediocore, skip it
Wedge salad: had a bite of my boy friend's, it was pretty good, i would order this over the caprese.
Filet Mignon: For this price, the worst I have ever had, thats not to say it wasnt good, but of all the filets I have ever had, this one would be in last place, skip it
New York: again, had a bite of my boy friends, it was very good, better than mine, and he enjoyed it as well, go with the New York over the filet.
Creamed Spinach: not all creamy, a bit bland, skip it.
Potatoes McMahons: scalloped potatoes with green chiles and cheese. Eh, just ok.
In summary, I may go back only because there are so few nice steak houses in Tucson and my boyfriend liked it. But compared to the other steakhouses Ive been too, it didnt compare at all.

The location is very good.  It is very close to highway 55 and  it is very close to my house. You can find a vast variety of produce and fish. The staff is awesome! The only thing that would make the experience off the hook would be if they delivered.   It has been a long time since I have had really good chicken adobol.   I am learning how to make chicken adobo and they have everything I need to make it. Thanks!

This place has great food, great drinks, really great service and lovely outdoor patio. All great combinations to bring a date or even take out relatives.  This place is both impressive and has great grub and it's in the heart of downtown SB. 

By far the king of brunch in SB!

Alex Leeder is absolutely wonderful.  He has given me perfect eyebrows and facials for 10 plus years.  I highly recommend Alex if you are looking for someone professional & conscientious.... he will pamper you!!!
Great place!!  Super nice staff, clean...  100x better than the laundromat I used last time I was in Tucson!!

I order pick up often since i live in the area, their service is very efficient never takes more then 15 minutes, I also like how generous they are with the servings. The food itself is delicious, if you also enjoy very spicy cuisine I definitely recommend it.
Always extremely fast service! And they accommodate my needs when my order is complicated. I go at least once every week.

Cute place.  I don't have any pictures, but I am an avid Amazon orderer.  I also tend fo find things that are not exactly as they are described to be.  So, it's nice that this place is open on Saturdays to return things via UPS back to amazon.

Equally good, they print the label for you.  Cute dogs is waiting by the door when you come in, and it's been nice to say hi, drop off the package and be on my way.

You can rent P.O. Boxes, fax, copy, and bring things to ship as well.

Pay them a visit.  Love local owned businesses!

This place is awesome!! It reminds me of Echo Mountain in L.A. but without the endless switchbacks. I believe the story is that someone rich built a place high up in the hills and it burned down. What we see now is the ruins of the place...and the 360 view of Lake Cachuma and mountains in the area.  

The views are absolutely breathtaking!! I wouldn't really classify this as a hike since it is just a very short walk to the ruins. Good for all ages. The drive itself is a bit more daunting - the roads are very windy and narrow. Since you are driving up a mountain, depending on the weather, the drive can be really hazy and cloudy, so please be careful and drive slow! The car is really doing most of the work, not your legs.

To get to Knapp's Castle, you take the 154. It is really easy to miss the turn into Camino Cielo since there isn't a major sign or stop, so set up your GPS to assist you. To make the drive a bit more worthy, stop by the Painted Caves also! 

Parking: need adventure pass (but I don't really know if anyone is checking)...parking is just on the side of the road. Hopefully there are other cars there so you don't miss it! 

Here's a helpful link for more info: http://www.hikespeak.com/trails/knapps-castle-hike-santa-barbara/

We came in here for lunchtime. The restaurant is nice looking for a cafe, with a heavy dose of sunlight at that time. The service was good. The dishes we had were both delicious, and reasonably priced for the area. My wife had the polenta royale, which she said was delicious, although she could have eaten the full serving (and she's petite, so just the full serving would be right for just about anybody). I had the Sojourner Tostada, which was also delicious. The tortilla chips were crisp and tasty. We go to Santa Barbara often, and the Sojourner Cafe will definitely be on our list of places we will return to. - Aaron Widera

First time here,

After returning home with my salad, there was a long, singular, dark hair in it. I hope when employees are prepping or whatever there is some kind of hair net being utilized for those with long hair.  

The employees in the front did not know how much the chips were, or how much some of the deserts were.  

The salad portion was great size for the price.  There are a ton of options to choose from in customizing the salad.  It would be great if there was an  unchopped option, one with just normal lettuce.  

Overall the price was fair for the size, fairly new, and the possibility of a healthy alternative.

Classy tasting center with inviting hosts. $5 tastings that include the glass. Some of the better wine on Acapa. The rep basically poured and ignored so don't expect learn anything on your visit if you don't specifically ask.

I saw michelle for the first time yesterday and she was amazing. I was long over due so needless to say I had a ton of kinks to work out. I'm a bit sore today but in the best way. The pain in my neck and shoulders have calmed down and I was able to sleep in any position last night pain free. I highly recommend  michelle and am proud to say she will be apart of my weekly routine!!!

The food is great when eating in. It's plentiful and great pricing. We've never had a bad meal when dining in. The only issue that I have is when ordering takeout the entrees have been watery. I've ordered ropa vieja and there's barely meat. Mostly liquid. I've ordered other entrees and same. Little to no meat. This will not stop me from ordering because the food is good, but will have to check it prior to leaving and hope that management sees this and makes the change.

Best sushi in Wesley Chapel! They have a large menu for those who aren't super keen on sushi. Service tonight was quick and the food was exceptional. I eat here all the time and they are constant with their food. I've never had a bad experience

We went before the place got busy for the evening, so we missed the live music option. The chicken marsala was delicious. The hubs wouldn't necessarily get the filet again, but there was a lot to choose from, with plenty of specials. A nice outdoor seating space as well.

who would have thought that philly was such a vegan/vegetarian-friendly city!  i came here for dinner on sat night, and i was the only non-vegetarian.  this is a vegan restaurant that is on the fancier/pricier end.  

the bread that comes out before the meal is delicious and like a foccacia w/ olive oil to dip.  i didn't have a starter, but everyone else did.  the mushroom crepe w/ truffle oil looked (and smelled!) particularly good.  for my entree, i was not that adventurous, and i had the pacific rim grilled tofu.  the tofu was really good and came on top of an edamame potato puree.  i'm not a huge seitan or tempeh fan, so i thought i would stick w/ tofu.  i tried the heart of palm cakes w/ ratatouille, and it was pretty tasty also.

they have a bunch of vegan desserts, and i heard the strawberry cheesecake was good.  i tried a bite of the coconut chipotle ice cream, and it was definitely interesting.

I have been coming here for years. You have to get over the run down exterior but once you do get ready. The strong spices immediately saturate the nose and you will during the week day be greeted with a small buffet.

The buffet is stocked with Naan, butter chicken, and curry chicken. As well as Dall and other side dishes. The food much like the service is excellent and this is testimonial cooking from a small mom and pop restaurant. I highly suggest you give them a chance if you have never had or love Indian food.

Full Belly Deli sits in a strip mall by the GSR.  It has all the trappings of a strip mall place, a wall of windows on one side, sort of challenging to park when it's busy and spartan furnishings on the inside.  A self serve soda machine on the inside has a pic of rapper Ice-T on the iced tea and a pic of Ice Cube on the ice cube button gets my attention. Always enjoy a good pun.

  I really like Cuban sandwiches, but it's hard to find an authentic Cubano outside of big cities.  It's not hyperbole when I say the best Cuban restaurant near Reno that I am aware of is all the way up in Chicago. Most places here in town to claim to have  this sandwich just take ham, pickles and swiss, grill it on a generic white roll and call it a day.   

  People may disagree on what constitutes an "authentic" Cubano but at the very least it should have roast pork(marinated in mojo) ham, swiss, pickles and mustard, pressed on a panini grill with Cuban bread.  Salami is optional.

  Full Belly definitely does the best version of this sandwich I've found in Reno and the rest of their menu is an adventure of uncommon lunch fare that is worth exploring.  It's nice to go to a shop where the choices aren't all the same "meat and cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion".

Ten of my closest friends recently joined me in Philly for my birthday and we stayed at the Palomar.  I was blown away by the quality of the customer service and the hotel decor.  When I checked into my room, a bottle of wine and piece of birthday cake were waiting with a personalized card from the hotel staff.  Every member of the staff was uber-friendly and helpful.  The decor was beautiful and the rooms were stocked with fun details (animal print robes, free fashion tape and other practical items, etc.).  There is free wine for the guests in the lobby at specific times and the little fire place in main gathering area adds the perfect touch of class. 

This is my new favorite Philly hotel!

Pleasantly surprised by first time visit to SB FisHouse. Have walked by it many times while in Santa Barbara, but somehow thought it was just a touristy restaurant, being so close to the beach.  However, when I stopped in at a wine tasting room in the Funk Zone and asked regarding suggestions for a nearby bite to eat and one of the owners mentioned this place, I decided to give it a try.  Turns out there's Happy Hour on Sunday they have a pretty good menu with a variety of food and drink items.  I ordered the fish and chips which I really liked- not at all greasy. And had a delicious special mimosa - the 'Lit-Mosa' - with vodka, champagne and multiple juices. I'll be back again...

I had a wonderful experience at No. Lib. Vet this past week. My puppy had his first vet visit, and I couldn't have been more pleased. They were so informative and helpful and made the experience great for both me and my puppy. The girls prepping me and my puppy for the doctor were wonderful and Dr. Smith was great! This will remain my vet for sure!

Awesome awesome place to eat , we had the thai garden fried rice , Mexican roll in brown rice paired with lovely dessert the mango sticky rice and fried ice cream ! DEFINITELY come back here for more amazing food

My coworkers and helpers loved the Hot Chocolate Bombs I gifted  today! Just ordered round two! A piece of cake not only makes the most delicious cakes and treats they make it easy. Individually wrapped or custom wrapped by the quantity of your choice. I paid over the phone and curbside pick up. #christmas2020

I met a bar tender who works here. I told her I'd drop by some time. Eventually my path brought me nearby and the time was appropriate for lunch so I decided to keep my promise. I pulled up to the lot. Send nice enough from the outside. I noticed the ah trays on the outside tables. This is par for the course for places like this. Not happy but okay. Walked around too the door and wham!  I will not patronize a place that Ernie's indoor smoking. Sorry. Another potentially decent place that will never get a penny or a kind word from me.

This is a great place for breakfast or lunch. I go there a lot and always have a great meal. Fast, friendly, competent service with a smile. Wait staff and cooks are awesome. Would recommend them for all of the above reasons and the reasonable prices. They have a wonderful Ruben Sandwich!! Great soups too.
Dirtiest Old Navy I've ever been to.  Yea sure they have everything every other store has plus massive dust bunnies.  Its not really that hard to dust off the registers and keep that space clean.

We always go to this place, but been couple times that we been having trouble with our order, the staff changed, every time we go; we notice new employees who doesn't say hi or they don't even say "how may I help you" the customer service is very low, and the time we get our pizza; totally different than other times, we order white pizza all the time but they always manage to mess up our order some how , we told the owner about it and he apologized but it's been repeating so this is the last time there, good luck with the terrible customer service

It's veryyyy good just like the one I've tried at New York. The staff is really nice, too. The sad thing thought was that it melted very fast so make sure you can eat it very fast if you're going on a hot day.  But, it's a must try especially if you like ice cream.

We went on a Saturday for a burlesque brunch. It was pretty empty. The food is overpriced for the taste, but the experience was fun and we had a decent waitress. I'm not sure why a meatless taco costs $26 with a salad and peach cobbler or why they force you to order an appetizer and a dessert with your entree...it's a waste of money if you're just in the mood for just an entree. Anywho, I ordered the Caribbean style shrimp salad, the fiesta tacos, and peach cobbler. The salad was much better than I expected. The tacos were okay, but fresh, the bread (not dough crust) on the peach cobbler was terrible. The sweet potato beignets were good. Fun experience, but overall the food was mediocre.

I came here for a nice breakfast with my mom. We ordered and waited for our food patiently for 45 minutes. After no update, no food and no refills, we were about to ask about our food but were rudely shut down by our waitress telling us it was ready and it would be out any second. We proceeded to wait for another 10 minutes while everyone around us (people who got there 20 minutes after us) got their food. Keep in mind, these people were getting feasts. All we ordered was crepes, some bacon and eggs. When we told the manager, he comped our drinks- not a great look considering we had to leave after AN HOUR with NO FOOD. We had to go to Burger King and get a sandwich because we were so hungry by the time we left the RESTAURANT. The service was PATHETIC and I will be sharing this review with my 18,532 local social media followers.

The dealer I worked with was nice, patient, and answered all my questions. My low marks are for pushing me to buy a car I really wasn't looking at and also the impact on my credit.

Caution: The credit report that they will push to run even for an estimate will add a hard inquiry to your report. Don't do this unless you're sure you want to buy.

Unexpectedly excellent. We had a little trouble finding the place. Very little ambiance but the food was amazing. We are vegan and the owner went out of her way to accommodate us. The food was so amazing we are going back today. Worth the trip.

This is the most majestic of the Center City train stations and is a good example of the glory of the railroad era. Huge windows and a soaring ceiling in the atrium gives the enormous space a sense of grandeur.

You can catch Amtrak here, as well as all of the Regional Rails (the Amtrak section is much nicer, though--why am I not surprised?). There are also plenty of places to eat as you wait for the train. Everything is very well-marked, and if you are coming from the Schuylkill Avenue side of the train station, the SEPTA entrance is in the very back right corner of the main hall.

Probably the worst thing about this station is that it's the only one in Center City with an outdoor (albeit covered) track for the Regional Rail. In the winter, do yourself a favor and wait to get on the platform until your train is nearly there.

The staff was great. They remembered my name each time I came in. The room was fine, bed comfortable and the breakfast was a nice touch. Overall I would stay again. This hotel may have been upgraded since the last time people reviewed it.

Disclaimer: I've used Aveda products for 15+ years and am partial to their brand and mission....

That said, I scheduled a hair appointment on the same day and was pleased by the welcoming staff. I was offered tea and waited for a short time until I met with my stylist, Jade. She was very professional and cut my hair exactly the way I requested. 

I'll definitely be back to the Kirkwood Ginger Bay location to try some of their other services, especially the green plant peel facial.

Love these guys, very friendly. I try to buy film from them whenever they have what I need, unfortunately they dont seem to have a lot of used medium format gear otherwise I'd buy it from them. If there were to be a detractor, it would be their outlab service always sends negatives back fairly dusty. Their in-house c41 processing is great though!

Food is excellent!  Menu offers a nice variety. Portions are perfect. Price is reasonable. Atmosphere is nice and fits for a casual jazz cafe. A great venue to see your favorite artist. Would definitely visit again!!!  Crab cakes and not-so-Cajun shrimp were yummy!!!!

The decor is cozy and warm, the bread is really good, and the crab cakes were excellent.  But the good pretty much ended there.  We also ordered the Napoleon Heirloom Tomato salad with goat cheese and basil.  Not sure how you can go wrong with that medley, but the flavors were not balanced.  Way too sweet - I could hardly taste anything.  For entrees, I got the rack of lamb, which was only tasty because of massive amounts of garlic.  Otherwise, the meat was not juicy or flavorful.  In fact, it was rubbery.  My husband got the Venison that had no flavor at all (and no garlic) and was really tough.  It was pretty disappointing.  It came with burnt cornbread that was soggy from the sauce.  Dessert was eh - we got the molten lava cake.  Overall, for an expensive meal, it was underwhelming.

How do you have empty seats, have the bartender look at you, and still not ask if you need anything? Maybe it was the end of Nicks shift and he was having a bad day.... But You're a f ing bartender, all you do is customer service. Maybe you should get out of the business bro. This place won't be getting my money.

The receptionist that works there (she's an older lady) is the most rudest receptionist I have ever encountered! I went there with two of my friends because they recommended me to go here to get my spine cracked. My friend had a coupon for a free visit and the receptionist told her rudely that it was not valid at all, my friend politely tried to explain to the receptionist that she was the one that gave her that coupon of course the receptionist answered very rudely to her saying that that was not true at all and it's not valid, so she accused my friend of lying, she accused the patient that's been going there for over a year!! so she continued to treat my friend and I very rudely and also treated us as dumb little kids that didn't know anything!!! Mind you there was other patients coming in that she treated perfectly fine and very respectful which I found very upsetting because those patients were white Americans and  my friends and I are not white Americans we are a different nationality's!! Another bad experience that I had with this same receptionist is that I called to cancel my membership because I had gotten very sick with the flu and I did not feel comfortable going in To cancel my membership because I had just recently finished getting sick, she was not understanding whatsoever she didn't care that I felt uncomfortable to go in to cancel my membership, she didn't care that I just finished getting sick which you would think she would understand because we're in the middle of a pandemic but nope she did not care at all she was very rude on the phone didn't help me at all!!! at the end of the call she said I'll try to forward your number to someone else and they might contact you but if not you're gonna have to pay the full membership fee and I continued  to explain to her that that's not fair because I only used my membership once since I got it but she continued not to care and said the same thing, my patience was very low at that point so I decided to end the conversation because clearly you can't have a conversation with a very rude person. I would not recommend this place  to anyone due to how horrible this receptionist treated my friends and I!!! Here's a piece of advice find a different receptionist that isn't rude, has manners and has respect for patients even if they're a different color!!!!

I work at a local elementary school, brought in two tricycles (over sized and ready to dominate our "First Field Day.").  Unfortunately the front tire on both wear flat and off the rim. Mavis fixed both, got them in working condition, FREE of charge.  We need more businesses like this in our community, will gladly support them as they support us!

A Devour Downtown outing brought us to Oceanaire and it was well worth it!!

First thing I would want anyone to know is how great the service is, genuinely warm, courteous and prompt.  A passing server helped out our server in explaining the devour menu, after a briefing she returned and took over seamlessly.  Good cooperation and communication between servers is the hallmark of a well managed house.

The food was top notch, mild fish that was fresh but not overpowering.  We also enjoyed an appetizer and chocolate dessert, I wish I could remember the names of but it's been a while!!

I highly recommend it, great date night place with great cocktails too!
Let start off with the Good! Ambience and drinks were amazing!!! Food was just okay (I ordered the Jerk chicken) ... I'll go back again and try something different to eat!! Really cute place!

This is a great card/gift/holiday store on Metairie Road, not too far from Mid-City. They always have a very nice selection of what-nots, perfect for the most hard-to-buy-for person on your gift list. They have a huge selection of not-sports-related Saints and fleur de lis objects, like party platters, fancy glasses, dish towels, etc. They have great gifts for kids and grown-ups alike, plus a huge selection of cards and frames.

Anyone giving this place less than a five star should be kicked off Yelp! Here's the deal- you want a crazy good donut? The kind the cops eat?
Like seriously ridiculous yummy donuts.  This is pretty much a need to go to establishment.  This is a donut you would travel to eat!

Great hole-in-the-wall breakfast/lunch spot. Definitely gotta try the Mels Big Breakfast (eggs, meat, potatoes, peppers/onions - all on a hoagie roll) and the JC Breakfast Special (Eggs, cheese, bacon in a waffle sandwich). Breakfast burrito and huevos rancheros are good options too.

Highly recommend Hollywood collision!! My car looked fantastic and it was finished quick. The girls that work there were so nice and helpful. Besides my car looking brand new on the outside, they even cleaned the inside.  I couldn't be happier with their work!!!
Great hole in the wall spot. Food is always delicious, and lots of options. The amount of food is plenty to split, come hungry!

About the only perk that Covid has offered is that it helped me break the lazy habit of going back to a salon where my hair was just okay... and sometimes not. Looking for a great cut and color after 5 months of coloring it myself led me to try out this salon. Dean proved to be more than a top notch stylist. He made me feel like an old friend and I was so relaxed when I left the salon. And did I mention that my husband said that I looked 10 years younger??

Don't get me wrong, the food here is delicious. Our server was amazing. But it's really expensive. Over $50 for two basic pastas. There is no bread with your meal either. Also it's quite a small place, no really cozy or intimate seating, unless you get that one booth. To pay that much money and leave hungry is not acceptable. My companion and I both finished our meals, and had to go elsewhere for reasonably priced dessert. But hey, if you are rich and enjoy elbow to elbow dining, go for it. Food is awesome.

Dimmitt has been the best car buying experience I've ever had. They relentlessly worked to make sure I was completely satisfied with every part of the buying process. My salesman Travis literally ran to make sure he got the job done. He worked diligently sealing the deal and remaining transparent about every detail of the sale. No other salesman has ever shown me the amount of effort to gain my business. Will definitely recommend anyone in the region. The finance department will get the job done and they're well worth the drive within the southeast. Give your business to an honorable dealership such as Dimmitt.
The tour company responded to my review and refunded my tour even though I did not request it. They also sufficiently apologized and said they would speak to the guide about his actions.

The only churrascaria I had ever visited was in Kenya and I had my fair share of delicious exotic game meats.  Though Fogo de Chao did not have zebra or crocodile, they had an excellent mix of steaks, chicken, sausage, and lamb.  

We made reservations a few days before without any trouble. The service was stellar from the time we valeted our car until the time we walked out.  The venue itself is exceptionally beautiful with high ceilings and great lighting.  

As mentioned in previous reviews, they have an extensive fresh salad bar.  My 8 year old nephew particularly enjoyed the huge bowl of bacon.  It can be a bit overwhelming as evidenced by the look of fear and confusion on my mom's face as the servers whizzed by offering various meats. You also receive sides of mash potatoes, fried polenta, pao de queijo (fried cheese balls) and fried bananas (not plantains). I could have lived without them.  In fact I did.  I ate meat, and lots of it.  To the point that I felt dizzy.  My 4 year old nephew, who has the metabolism of a hummingbird, fell asleep and plopped his head down on the table by the end of dinner.   

It's a bit  formal but you can certainly pull off wearing nice jeans and a shirt.  You can save your tux for another day.  It was my dad's birthday and they decorated and brought out his cake with a candle. It's a bit steep but kids over 10 eat half off and kids under 5 eat for free. Plus, it's well worth the experience.

Bottom Line:
Goth/Black Leather/Black Hair Feel, Super Friendly Lady Bartender, Memorable

Overview:
After stopping in at the Thaxton Speakeasy, my friend and I stopped in at the Crack Fox.  My first time.  Tonight, they had DJ Chrome along with some cat of nine tales(?) beatings on these 'X'-style crucifixes (is that the correct plural usage?).

Drinks:
They had a beer that was decent.  That's all I got and all I recall of their selection.

Atmosphere:
I think most of the goth contingent of STL was in the house.  (Yes, I'm a white guy.)  Quite the scene and quite hospitable.  I felt welcome hanging out in my 'Lion's Choice' retro T-Shirt and shorts.

The food and the young woman serving was very good. The music was lacking. It was loud and jumpy Cajun music that detracted from the atmosphere.

On the Tuesday before Thanksgiving, I was invited by Denise, the organizer of The Tampa Bay Bloggers, for a day of giving back at the Metropolitan Ministries Holiday Tent in Tampa. I had never volunteered for MM before, so I was excited to see what it was all about. I was able to bring some guests with me to help out for the 4 hour shift. Volunteering is always, ALWAYS better with friends ;)

The Metropolitan Ministries tent is located at 400 West. Palm Avenue in Tampa (behind Blake High School near the Hillsborough River). It is set up seasonally, to aide families during the holiday season. Additionally, there are donation tents set up in Largo and Holiday. However, MM accepts donations and assists families and individuals in need all throughout the year, not just during the holiday season! Read more about their mission and services here. 

We spent our shift directly working with the clients receiving services at MM. When clients qualify for assistance, they are able to come directly to the holiday tent to "shop". We acted as personal shoppers for the clients, and it was such a rewarding experience getting to interact with them on a one-to-one level, instead of behind the scenes. Metropolitan Ministries is extremely organized, and has a seamless system paying attention to even the smallest details. The shopping area was divided into about 10 identical aisles and the volunteer would stand at the end of the aisle with a cart and a box, waiting for the client to be sent down to us. When they arrived, we'd guide them through their shopping experience, directing them to the different sections and telling them how many of each item they could choose. The quantity of the items they could choose depended on the size of their family.

The shelves of each aisle were divided into sections: cereals, starches (rice, pasta, potatoes), stuffing, yams/pumpkin, canned vegetables, beans (dry and canned), canned fruit (including applesauce), cranberry, sweets and miscellaneous items. As they chose their items, we would bag them, then walk them to the area in the front of the tent to pickup either their turkey or chicken (individuals and couples received a whole chicken). Then we would return to our assigned aisle to meet another client and help them shop once again! 

I helped close to 20 clients during my shift. Some quietly shopped along, while others engaged in conversation with me. Some were nervous, some were teary, claiming they had always given before, but they just couldn't this year. Some were embarrassed, hoping to not be seen by someone they knew. Some were pregnant, some were immigrants experiencing their first Thanksgiving. Although they were all very different, the one thing they had in common was the fact that they were grateful for the help they were receiving this year from Metropolitan Ministries. They were grateful for the kindness of the volunteers, and the generosity of their community.

My experience at Metropolitan Ministries was such a rewarding one. I'll be returning to volunteer some shifts before Christmas. If you'd like join me, please let me know! The tent will also be open for donations throughout the remaining holiday season. For more information on the drop off locations in the Bay area, visit their website. :)

Food and Drinks with NO Flavor - I so wanted to love this place with the neat decor and good wait staff.  But, our margaritas had little to no flavor on the rocks and our friends speciality drink from the menu had little flavor as well...lots of ice and tasted watered down.  Sodas are from a can.

Our waitress suggested the Cheddar Grit Fries which are a MUST!  The popcorn is plain popcorn with seasoning.  The 2 pcs of Chicken was nice and crispy, but the chicken didn't have much pickle flavor --lavender honey was missing.  The 3 ovenbaked ribs with sauce was basic as well as the beans.  The "smoked" potato salad was just boiled potatoes with a basic dressing with little flavor.  The 2 Confit Duck Tacos was good even though it was missing the avocado--I do feel the price could come down about $2.  The collard greens were a bit above average with bits of ham meat.  So considering the group all tasting each others food...we felt overall a bland flavor with the above exceptions listed.    Is it because it's a weeknight?  We just felt for prices that things were overpriced as well.

Will we recommend?  Probably not since Fountain Square has other options with more flavor for the prices.  Our friends are a bunch of foodies and I don't believe this will fit their palates.
Large area, plenty of room to run, plenty of dog bowls with water!

Wow! what a great restaurant!  Being a local, I knew to let them get the kinks out of the works so we waited a couple of weeks before trying it out.  On a whim, last Sunday, I made a reservation for 4 at 8pm - at 7pm...was able to do it on line and was surprised that my time was available.  I grabbed the family and headed to the Tradewinds resort  .  The valet was extremely polite, the hostess was cordial and seated us without the usual two drink minimum (20 minute wait, get a drink, and the table is ready in 5 minutes).  Our waitress was attentive, and we loaded up with three apps, oysters, calamari, and ceviche.  All were really good.  The girls had the salmon, and the boys had the cobia.  The smoked beet puree had such intense flavor and really accentuated the cobia.  The atmosphere was enjoyable and the "tanked" fish tank lived up to the Guy Harvey hype.  The only two downsides were that our waitress was a little too much in the turn 'em and burn 'em mode.  She should have sensed our tempo instead of pushing for us to order our entre before the apps arrived and she should not have been so quick to remove the plates from our table while we were still noshing.  Secondly, the price was a little high for what we received, but I also realize that we were paying for the ambiance.  After dinner, we explored the aquariums, enjoyed the reggae music and photos of old Florida. The valet was as charming as he was upon arrival, and we left with a good experience.  We'll be back soon.

I've seen killer posts about the bar on IG and wanted to check it out... well, let's say the bloggers did well by telling a story.
Horrible customer service! My card was charged to someone else's tab with the same last name.. the place wasn't busy on Sunday at 4p, so why make that mistake.. then when I mention it, it was a casual, sorry, we've post voided it.
I closed out and we went else where with more competent staff!

Update!!! Another good review. I think the sandwich I got this time was even better than the first, if that's possible. I went to Firehouse Subs over the weekend with my daughter and mother. I ordered the new pulled pork sub with the Hawaiian roll. OMG! It was so good! It was meaty and juicy. It had the cole slaw on it. The roll was soft and fresh.

It wasn't as loud and crazy as the first time I went but it was busy and we got the last table inside that wasn't occupied. We will be back next time we are in Tucson.
Drivers test was great. Efficient and very nice! Then you move on to the MVC to get the actual license. Wow, not friendly and waited over 2 hours ...no urgency!

Miguel is an electrical wizard. I brought in my guitar (Telecaster) because I recently changed out the pickups and messed up the soldering. He went in there, redid the soldering, cleaned all the connections behind the bridge plate and tone controls, and secured my input jack. Now my guitar sounds clear and clean with no buzzes or hisses. If I had taken it to be repaired at a big chain music store, it would have taken a week and cost a fortune. Miguel fixed my guitar within hours! Sir Fixit is fast, friendly, and affordable. He specializes in smartphone and tablet repair, but he could probably fix anything electrical you bring into him. I highly recommend getting your repairs done with Miguel.

Great people. Took my car in for a check up as my ABS was acting up in the morning a few weeks back. They mentioned they might not get to it today but for sure the next morning and contacted me later on in the same day stating they were able to get to it and diagnosed the problem. That was a Tuesday and said it should be a quick fix and ready for me the next Morning however was not able to pick it up until Friday that week due to a couple of errors completely on them. Wrong size part, breaking another part of the car that then needed another reorder to fix that. They did not charge for those parts or the labor it was just unfortunate it took as long as it did with me having to call them on multiple occasions to see what the delay was. I would go back but wasn't the best first impression.

No wait when I walked in. Victoria did my mani. Wasnt really 'wowed' with the service. Nails werent really filed evenly, etc. ...Was looking for a quick spot to get a mani on Lunch. During my mani she got up at least four times to answer the phone which kept delaying the time. Cordless phone anyone?.. To sum up it i had to go home and re-file and re-polish.

So disappointed. We were looking forward to this place being a go to place. At best it is very expensive cafeteria food. As other have said the shrimp in all dishes tasted off. The lobster in the Paella was so over cooked it was like a rubber lobster. And the clams were rubber bands. We were thinking about sending it all back but it was obvious the kitchen staff did not have the ability to do any better. So it was $25 for a bowl of fair rice.

Didnt ask whether I'll sit in or take out but gave me a to go cup... 
Maybe I shouldn't have ordered a soy milk latte (b/c I wanted to see the art work everyone is commenting on?) cuz the taste of milk totally covered the scent of the espresso and I was not sure how would the coffee beans actually have been tasted....
The internet was on and off... couldn't really do anything... 
The ambience was not bad for just chilling out there.. 
Had to park in the garage and pay an extra parking fee.... 
May give it another try some time later, but the internet really bothered me...

We have lived across the street from this place for over a year and finally decided to try it and we are blown away by how awesome the food is...We had the charcuterie tray and the braised short ribs and both of them exceeded our expectations.. the amount of food for the price is ridiculous!

Amazingly good food. Our orders came out in under five minutes. The bonuts were heavenly. One of us got the hot chicken - not too hot at all. The chicken/gravy was yummy. Biscuits are light and fluffy. It was worth the 20 minute wait.

$8 minimum on credit card. Staff were attentive and knowledgable. Very trendy cafe with good lighting and ambiance. Overall, the baked goods were not that impressive. Mini-muffins were dry and noticeably bland. Interesting mix of tofu smoothies and straight soy milk. Specialty soy milk is eclectic. Had a black sesame soy. Freshly made soy milk is very different than what you get in the grocery store and super tasty. Will probably give this place another shot some time and try their hot breakfast foods.

I purchased a groupon for a gel manicure here. Such a great deal for a great quality manicure! Everything was clean, and they were very nice. They didn't have the biggest color selection, but I still found a color I loved!

One of the best places in the nashville area!  Food is amazing, service is even better, and the beer selection is perfect for beer drinkers!  Their live music is always on point and they have the best wings in the business!  I've never ordered anything that wasn't perfect!

Just when I was beginning to think Nashville is only cowbros and bachelorette parties, here comes Husk to save the day! My only regret is that I couldn't fit more in my stomach. There are definitely enough options here to satisfy meat eaters and vegetarians alike.

The good vibes start early when you roll up Husk, which is inside a historic house a few blocks off Broadway, rocking a solid classic fancy southern vibe inside and out. My group arrived a little early for our reservation so we started off with a drink in the bar downstairs. I tried one of their twists on an old fashioned and found it delightful and strong. After about 20 minutes we were seated ahead of schedule. 

I seriously think our group of three ordered enough for six, so I'm not going to go through everything we ate, but I will say the johnny cakes were crazy good and the southern vegetable platter was awesome too. Those were definitely the hits of the night, even with the carnivores at the table. Service was on point and our waiter killed it with the recommendations. 

If I had to find a criticism I would say that some of the dishes seemed to be overseasoned. It wouldn't have been a problem if all the food--even the salads--weren't so decadent and rich, which is a good complaint to have. So overall I'd say I was extremely pleased with the meal and overall experience, despite the salty misstep.

Visiting NoLa and dropped my computer. Called them on a Sunday, made an appointment for Monday and they had it fixed by 5pm.

All in all, couldn't be happier.

4 years ago I tried Chick-Fil-A on my college campus and it was so-so. I wasn't too tempted to give it another try but I'm glad I did. Since it's opening this place has been packed. I went at 12:00pm during a weekday, you'd better have a long lunch break if you wanna try this place. 

It's weird to say, especially because it's a chain fast food place, but I'm obsessed with Chick-Fil-A. I was overwhelmed with the menu and decided on: spicy chicken sandwich, chicken strips salad, and the mini sundae. The waffle fries are on the softer side rather than crispy, but I prefer them that way. The ranch dipping sauce is amazing, I don't want to look at the calorie content of it. The chicken is a good sized portion and you can see the spices in the crispy breading.

The biggest compliment I have is the service and cleanliness. Everyone who works there is courteous, we ordered to go and they hand deliver your meal to you. The staff is great and they keep the place spotless like a well oiled machine.

The only con was the waiting time and the lines got confusing. It started as one line but morphed into 3 somehow so we had to wait even longer, but worth the wait!
LOVE LOVE LOVE Vincent's!   And Tony!   The St. Charles location is our go to place for Italian when we're in Nola.  Extensive menu but I always end up getting the cannelloni.  It's just sooooo good!

Coffee is sub-par.

I went to this place because I've heard so many positive reviews from other locals. 
Although the vibe is hip here, there are a lot of hip places in Santa Barbara. It's cool that it's cycling focused! That's a definite plus. But really it's a hipster vibe, so I figured the coffee must be delicious for it to be so highly rated.

The people serving me were uninterested (some were on their phones), the coffee was ok, and the experience was mediocre. 
I was excited to go here! But then I was let down. 
I will try again and maybe write a more positive review in the future.

Been a customer/ friend of Planet DJ for many years not only exceptional personal service but the knowledge to back it up. Ceasar is my go to guy any time I call night or day he has even given me a number to call if I get jammed up at a gig. ( who does that)  probably the most important things to me is that they never try to sell me on something I don't need just for the sale, that's integrity at its finest!!
My first experience with Body Flow Wellness was great! Clean, professional, and peaceful. Highly recommend! Susan is knowledgeable, relatable, and truly cares. Put me at ease. I'll be back!

Emeril was in the kitchen, BAM! I expected magic and was sorely disappointed. We asked for recommendations from the manager and they were so blah that I left full yet unsatisfied. I'm nut sure what went wrong so I muggy give it one more shot,  but man was I let down on this one and it was my burst so booooo Meryl!
Great food, great service! The crabs Benedict was fantastic and was a special for the day.

I get that it's a chain restaurant that is geared towards kids. I honestly get that. But really...who the heck would ever take their kids here????

Every burger, even the turkey burgers, except for the garden burger, is over 1100 calories and 40+ grams of fat. That is not including the fries. As for the "healthy" sides of broccoli and carrots...they tasted like they had been cooked days ago and had been sitting under a heat lamp ever since. To make it more insulting....the burgers are HUGE and the sides are tiny. The broccoli side I ordered....literally 4 small florets of broccoli. The carrots? My portion of 6 baby carrots.

Really? In this day and age you are going to make HUGE burgers and sides tiny enough not to be able to fill up a toddler?

The burgers are OK. The service is slow and miserable. Did I mention the burgers are just OK...nothing to brag about.

Nope...won't be going here again.

A hidden jewel. A bit hard to find, but if you're looking for a man who knows his leather goods, Byrum is your guy. Brought him a filthy light tan nubuck handbag that no one else could clean. Did not want to have to send to specialists in NYC, brought to Byrum. Not only did he do spectacular job cleaning the bag, he did it quickly and Fed'xd back to me when I was unable to pick up.

Possibly the worst Culver's in the area.  Every single time we go through the drive-thru, they always forget something.  Tonight was an ENTIRE family pack of Cheese curds!!!!!  They even had the audacity to lie about it and told us that we weren't even charged for it, but by the time we got home, we realized we WERE charged for it.  Very bad business practice and horrible customer service.  Bunch of liars!!  Hate to even give them a one star because they don't even deserve it but had to give it to be able to post this review.  Awful place!!!
The breakfast spot -Germantown go to! Quality and  quantity both excellent-home style community table -a must visit spot whenever in Nashville.

the worst!!!!! they'll sale you a vehicle that's no good & when you ask for the money back they'll play games until after the 7 day money back  guarantee so they wont have to give you anything!!! the general manager at the location name is mike!!!! he's the worst.. will never return back to this location again & i still havent received my money back from the car either !!!! btw it was a 2013 camaro

I thought the food was good (omelet) and our server was great. Bloody mary was very tasty, too. Did not have to wait long for our food and it came out hot. We were there during brunch time on a saturday, so based on the reviews, I expected waits and cold food. Not the case for us. My only complaint is the prices. Very high compared to other diners just a bit north. In all, though, I'd go back if in the area again.
I love this place! They did an amazing mani/pedi at a very reasonable price. Even after a week my polish still hasn't chipped. The staff were very friendly as well, I definitely recommend it

Ian - This was the nice birthday dinner culmination of our Santa Barbara mid-week trip, and I was not disappointed.  Our waiter was friendly and knowledgeable.  I was excited to watch Natalie try frogs legs for the first time, and boy was I proud of her willingness to try something new.  My duck was cooked just a wee tad over done, but the flavors were spot on.  Our cocktails were delicious and dessert did not disappoint.  

Natalie - The spiced blood orange margarita made me dirty my pants it was so good.  Not really, but you get the picture.  I ordered the braised short ribs for dinner, and they were tasty, but I was hoping for a starch.  They were served over a medley of corn, tomato and fava beans with fried julienned sweet potato as garnish.  Delicious, but missing that one key component.  On a side note ... I know this not the fault of the restaurant, but there were three tables during the night where people arrived wearing sweatpants, sweatshirts, and one lady in yoga pants!!!  Really?  If you're showing up to a nice restaurant, at least try and dress the part.

The service here was a little odd.  Our server stayed behind the counter and took our order from afar instead of coming over to us - were we supposed to order at the counter?  We just had no idea.  That aside, our sandwiches were actually really good.  The cafe itself is bright and adorable and it was easy to find street parking outside.  The menu also had a lot of vegan options, they had a small ice cream bar and plenty of baked goods, and my husband was a big fan of their coffee.  I'm not sure how crowded it gets here on weekends, but we showed up first thing on Sunday morning and it was nearly empty, so our orders came out very quickly.  I could see myself coming back here for more brunch outings; hopefully next time, I'll figure out the ordering system.
The food is literally always good, but last night either the spinach and mushroom etouffee or the wine slushie made me throw up, but I cannot even be mad at it maybe just get smthn else instead .

Second time I have been their.  On this occasion we stopped in on a Sunday when the menu is not served.  However, the staff was gracious, showed us a limited selection cold plate (which was super), and we sat by the fire on a rainy afternoon and had a super time.  I will go here each time in Reno.
Great customer service and fast. She is nice and informative. The place is clean. She uses the hard wax
I'm not sure why this place has such good reviews. Margs are way too sweet with little tequila, and the potion sizes are small. There are definitely better spots to go for Tex-mex.

Joshua from A & A came to my house and my mother's hone today for a service.  From the moment I called immediately I felt welcomed and Anthony listened to my needs, provided prices and was able to make an appt the next day for myself and my mother's homes.  Joshua serviced both homes. His was very knowledged about the business and provided details of what was going to happen...which was very welcoming. He answered all of my questions and provided recommendations for my mother's home.  I felt very assured with his suggestions and will get them.  His personality also made us feel very comfortable.  He is a great asset to A & A. I will definitely recommend them for anyone who needs them for any service as they are very professional, always answers the phone and prompt. Thank you
Seriously legit BBQ. No frills, fun environment, very affordable. Surprisingly good house label bourbon, and great house made BBQ sauces. Go now!

I've been taking my car(s) to RW for basic maintenance and service for close to ten years.  The guys are all great, and know what they're doing.  Never have I felt pressured into something, and their honesty always shows.  Very accomodating, even at their most busiest hours.  Waiting area typically accomodating in terms of space to the guests.  Overall, would recommend RW to anybody.  Can be slightly more expensive, but I trust them more with my vehicle(s).

So thankful for the Mono Trail!

Last fall I was training for the Indianapolis Monumental Marathon, and I have to say- I could NOT have trained without this gem!

The Monon Trail starts at 10th Street and goes all the way up to Carmel (maybe even beyond?)  I used to have to run 8-20 miles a DAY and this trail was perfect for it.  Plenty of greenery, friendly people (walkers, bikers, other runners AKA MY COMPETITION!).  I loved swinging by Local Grown Gardens on the Monon.

I do wish that there were more coffee shops and options directly off of the Monon trail.  And yes there are unfortunately a couple of sketchy-ish areas.  But I always felt safe.

You can even continue on the Monon Trail to the Cultural Trail downtown!  Love the walk-ability (or run-ability) of Indianapolis!

Went for Sunday Brunch, with my expectations set extremely low (I just wanted some serviceable breakfast-type food)

We dined all alone in the absolutely cavernous main room, where one massive wall was completely bare with empty hangers where art once hung and a layer of dust and sadness covered everything. I could see that many areas in this place had not seen a cleaner's hand in many moons - normally the death knell for any failing business.

The service was fine, though the "chef" yelled audibly and angrily at our waitress when we had her ask about something on their dinner menu. We were just asking since we were considering coming back at night sometime, which she explained - then he just walked away from her in a huff without another word. Bad vibes aplenty. Our waitress was obviously humiliated as we watched the whole thing...she apologized to us heartfully. 

The food itself was barely passable. Sadly our reheated biscuits and gravy were served with cold biscuits - making the dish very unappetizing. The home fried potatoes tasted like they'd been in the fridge too long and had acquired some other flavors. I get it. You're not a brunch place and were just giving it a go. The prices were fair though! My croissant sandwich was 100% fine.

This could be a great place to eat and drink, but the location is BRUTAL. It's too big, no water views, and feels awfully depressing inside. It's a great space but impractical (two entrances?) - I can't even imagine the rent they are paying. The restrooms, for example, are fancy and amazing, but nobody has actually *cleaned* them properly, so there is a crust of filth and dis-use over everything, which makes you feel like you are dining in a place about to go out of business. The depression is contagious. When this place passes along, I hope they consider doing a complete rebuild/redesign of the property rather than trying to utilize the fixtures of the previous dead location.
Deirdre took excellent care of us and gave us city tips and history.  Really nice vehicle.  Super friendly.  Thank you D!!!!

One of my new favorite restaurants!  We had such a wonderful experience.  As we walked around the strip we stumbled upon this gem, we were dressed very causal and decided to go to the bar and check things out.  We ordered the clams casino and some martinis.  The clam were spectacular... sizzling perfection!!  The martinis were delicious and frosty.  Then we order clam chowder, it was velvety smooth with big pieces of tender clams.  For our entrees we ordered the grouper and filet.  The salads were interesting but refreshing.  The grouper was perfectly bronzed and came dripping with herbed butter and a quinelle of perfect mashed potatoes.  My boyfriend ordered the filet which was perfectly cooked.  When we heard the dessert options we splurged for the baked Alaska... simply because you never find that on any menu like ever!  It was ridiculously scrumptious and delectable.  It was a wonderful experience, the service was absolutely perfect and the ambiance -between the soft lighting, clam style banquets and live piano player - was dream like and I can't wait to come back!!!!

Long's! Indianapolis legend. I don't know anyone in Indy who hasn't gone here, prior to them opening (around 4:30-5:00AM), to wait for a fresh warm batch of donuts at least once in their lives. There's a line out the door at the crack of dawn every day for a reason. They can do no wrong in my book!

I recieved amazing service here. They took their time and made sure everything was perfect. The entire shop is neatly organized and Tiffany was very personable and super friendly. She knows how to run a good business that is very successful. Kelly did an awesome job on my toes. Tiffany's technique is impeccable. She did not hurt me even once. I will return!

Used Nola Girl to cater this past weekend for about 50 people. Food was excellent, delivered on time, and was hot. We had the bbq burgers, jerk chicken tacos,and the pulled pork poboy. Thanks for a great meal!
Good pizza, good price, nice workers!  I would most likely be back as walking distance from my apartment!!

Wonderful service, authentic ingredients, attentive staff, the best in Indiana!!!!!!  

Food is always hot and taste original!  They are always polite!

This is a little restaurant on the pier. It's covered in dollar bills. It is a small bait and tackle house in front. When you walk towards the back it's a small restaurant also with a small bar. 

It is very quaint. You seat outside and their is a small area where you are seated to wait for a dining seat. 

I ordered their fresh catch of the day, Triple Tail Fish. I never had that type of fish, so I wanted to try it. It was very good. I ordered it Sautéed in a butter Garlic. It was full of flavors and very tender.  I ordered it with a side of Broccoli. The Broccoli was steamed and it lacked any seasoning. 

The drunkin shrimp is absolutely a must order. It was so good. They place the shrimp in a small bowl drowned in a soupy like sauce. This sauce is soooo good. I literally did drink it like soup. 

We also ordered the peel and eat shrimp. The shrimp was fresh. 

Totally recommend this place. It is very nice old looking pier. It is covered in bills, ceiling, tables, and walls. Very cool.

Went here for brunch with on a Sunday. Place is beautiful with ultra modern decor. We chose to sit outside in alil cute outside dinning area. I honestly wasn't too impressed with the menu. I was really looking forward to trying this new place out but I left alil disappointed. Don't get me wrong food was good but a very small menu selection and almost everything had pork in it which I don't eat. Was worth a one time visit to see what it was all about but I won't be going back for seconds.

Graeter's never disappoints! We went here to celebrate national ice cream day (7/15) a few days early. They have plenty of street parking. The inside was clean and the service was quick! The seasonal flavor is PEACH - which is my all time favorite. Tip: go for the sprinkle waffle cone. It's delicious!!

Great tasting and quality. We go there for the sushi, sashimi more often. Get the chirashi bowl if you like large portions of great sashimi over rice. 

Rolls and other dishes are a must try. 

Happy hour is a great deal. 4-7pm.

Love it!  I'm originally from SoCal so I know good Mexican.  This is definitely it!  Very fresh, drinks are great, staff is friendly,  and the decor is awesome!  We are sooooo excited about the new location on 66th Street.  It's a short bike ride for us on the Pinellas Trail.....waiting is so hard to do!  Keep up the good work, Casita!

Pros: Good food, nice and clean, quick service and in NE Philly. 
Cons: Noisy (but it worked out for me because my daughter was crying the whole time and no one seemed to be bothered), and little pricey but the food made up for that.

This hospital is a total joke! They're SO INCONSISTENT with their customer service and bed-side manner! I expect that sort of thing at a restaurant, NOT AT A HOSPITAL! My mom was told by her kidney doctor to go to the ER after she reported severe rectal bleeding. She was there for 5 1/2 HOURS and during this whole time they only drew one vial of blood. The ER wasn't busy, and they kept claiming they didn't have an actual room for my mom when she saw all the doors open to different AVAILABLE rooms. They wanted to keep her there overnight WHEN THEY DID NOT EVEN HAVE A PLAN IN PLACE FOR HER!! 

SERIOUSLY THIS IS RIDICULOUS! I hate typing in all upper-case but I am just FURIOUS with the hospital staff right now. If my mom wasn't by herself, I'm sure this review would be very different. MY MOM WAITED 72 MINUTES after pressing the Nurse Call Button for assistance in getting the IV out of her arm as she refused to waste any more of her time there. And when the nurse did come in, her fingernails had dirt and grime underneath them! 

They didn't give my mom ANYTHING TO EAT OR DRINK! DIDN'T OFFER HER A MACHINE SHE CAN USE FOR HER DIALYSIS! THIS IS COMPLETELY UNACCEPTABLE AND I AM ASHAMED TO SAY THAT I AM A STUDENT OF IUPUI AND HENCE AM CONNECTED TO THIS JOKE OF A HOSPITAL!
