They were wonderful November of 2015 when my mom got C. Diff. I don't know what changed between now and then but it sure as hell hasn't been a good change. My mom is going to St. Vincents in Carmel next time she needs to get medical treatment. AT LEAST THEY HAVE COMPETENT ER STAFF!!

66 Q-pot is a solid place to go for hot pot or Korean bbq. They have plenty of parking, and tons of space for cooking whether you're coming alone or with a group of people.

They have all you can eat hot pot, all you can eat Korean bbq, or even all you can eat hot pot and Korean bbq in one, which is definitely the way to go if you're looking to try a bit of both. 

For hot pot, you pick your soup base and then order a la carte the items that you want for your pot. As a warning, the personal pots are extremely tiny and it's hard to put a lot in it so it's sometimes better to ask if you can do the shared hot pot to get a bigger one. That way you can also try multiple cooking bases.

Pro-tip: they also have a ton of vegetables to cook that's not on the printed menu but also on a written table tent menu, as well as asking your server... so don't go crazy on your first order of veggies and meats without first asking your server or consulting the little table tent what items they have that day. 

As for the Korean BBQ, it's your typical run of the mill grill, the meats are great, seasoned to perfection, and I'm always all for grilling and cooking my own food. They even took the time to come out and change the grill top for us once while we were cooking to keep the food nice and clean. 

They have pretty solid options for both the K-BBQ and the Hot Pot and I really like that they have a deal so you can do both the BBQ and Hot Pot at the same time. This is a pretty solid spot to get your hot pot fix without having to head all the way over to Orlando. 

Service is fine here, however I will say that I came here at a completely dead time so I'm not quite sure how the service is when it's packed at max capacity.

I'm keeping this spot on my list of rotations for asian eats in the Tampa bay area for sure.

My husband was impressed with their catered food at a recent work function. He was anxious to try it so we ordered for Christmas Eve dinner. We were quoted $175 for an antipasto plate, bacon-wrapped jalapeño poppers, chicken Marsala, beef bourginon for 10 people. Picked it up the day before Christmas Eve- was charged $207 for the 3 "food" plates and $25 for 10 poppers and they added a $23 tip! For what?!?! 

The food was quite disappointing. The chicken was tough and dry. The beef was ok. The antipasto plate was pathetic- about 5 pieces of prosciutto, some green pimento olives, pimento pepper strips, artichoke hearts, pieces of bread and lots of cheese. The poppers were on a plate of wilted and slimy lettuce. The poppers were the only tasty thing we had from this place. 

The price was outrageous for the quality. Learned our lesson- we won't give this place another chance.

We ordered a large for topping thin crust Jack's Pizza last night. In the past their pizzas have always been pretty good. Last night's pizza was the worst pizza ever... Crust was like rubber. Shame on you Jack's
Me and the friend I went with both got food poisoning after eating here and getting a mango margarita.  Not sure if it was the meat or the marg but deff not a good first experience.

Sales person was not honest and forthright. Managers would make promises, but would not hold to their word. Installation team was good. Not sure of their Lennox systems reliability, since their blower motor failed within three weeks of installation. Front office and schedulers were good and prompt, which made the experience less painful. They didn't install Honeywell controllers per contract and would not refund me the offset cost.

This place is really charming and the food is very fresh. 
What I really, really enjoyed was that our service was so fabulous. It wasn't too busy that evening, so we asked if we could take our time ordering/eating/drinking etc, which was no problem at all.

We started with the really, really stellar cheese plate, complete with an incredible fruit chutney (apples, apricots, etc.) which we paired with our BYO wine. This place has a full bar, but also allows you to bring your own with no corking fee. EXCELLENT.

For entree's, my wife had the whole trout and I had the lamb. I cannot say that I've ever had trout, or any fish, so fresh and so well prepared. The ramps it was served on were a delicious compliment. My lamb was perfectly cooked (I ordered it medium) and really nice with the yogurt sauce and braised fennel, but the lentils didn't taste/feel fully cooked- that was the only downside. After all the cheese, however, I wasn't too concerned.

For dessert I had the creme brulee-- pretty standard, and my wife had a peanut butter chocolate martini, which was really interesting, quite strong, and a far better choice than my standard selection.

It was a great experience from start to finish. Thank you, Farmicia!

When you call to make an appointment you will have to wait 10 to 15 minutes before somebody picks up the phone.  I had a pet scan done they told me I was too tall so they did two thirds of me and then after an hour told me they have to do it again because the image was incorrect and then they imaged the lower half of my body.  That is too much radiation.  I have going there to other times and had the procedures done two times again also.  The Park Avenue facility has old equipment and I think that's the problem. The people who work there are very nice I just wish they had newer equipment that worked perfectly.

I love Red Robbin but customer service is at an all time low. Servers are so caught up in whatever else, that they don't do simple things like silverware and ketchup/condiments in a To-do order of burger and fries!

This hotel is exceedingly tidy, and the décor is quite nice especially for a Holiday Inn.  It's conveniently located in downtown Nashville:  close enough to walk to downtown, but far enough away to evade the noisy party atmosphere. Our room is also spacious and it is equipped with blackout curtains.  The fitness room is fantastic -- probably one of the best I've encountered in 5-star hotels.

Unfortunately, it's also inconveniently located next to a bustling construction site, which is quite noisy, and this is by far the most expensive Holiday Inn I have ever visited:  $440/night.  It's also one of the more expensive hotels I've stayed in.

The employees at the Ewing branch get dumber by the minute.  They refuse to provide me with a payment history for my auto loan and keep saying it's available online, according to the online account information they took out biweekly payments that equal the monthly payment numerous times.   Here's the latest proof of stupidity by the Ewing CUNJ employees,  today I deposited a check that was made out to me and in the purpose box on the check it had loan repayment the incompetent drive through teller said this check is being used to pay off your loan I said what are you talking about and the idiot said it says loan repayment I said if I gave you a check that was made out to me and a deposit slip that has checking account checked off then common sense would say the check is being deposited into my checking account.

Been here once before for dinner and it didn't impress. Came back for brunch today and the food did not disappoint. I recommend the eggs Benedict on avocado toast with a side of smoked salmon. I paired the meal with a long black which was absolutely delicious.

My husband & I love to walk here for dinner as we live in the neighborhood!
We love the food & we are never disappointed. Good sized meal salads that leave you satisfied & great starters to share!
Coffee is also good & of course warm soft fresh bread to start with butter....yummy!!

Best BLT ever!!  I've been here about 5 times and thought the food was really tasty.  However, after trying the BLT today, I will have a hard time ordering anything else.  Super fresh bib lettuce & perfectly ripe tomatoes, crispy but not burnt bacon, on buttered grilled bread.  Also, I do not like mayonnaise, but forgot to tell my server to hold the mayo.  I felt so bad asking for a new sandwich, but they were so understanding and made me a fresh one right away.  I love this place!
Amy Loving helped me today. I went in for an upgrade plus questions about jumping into my own plan. She was very helpful and very knowledgable. Thank you Amy!

The sauce for the spring rolls is delicious! The spring rolls were good. I had the Pad Thai w/ extra veggies and tofu. The food was mediocre and the service is slow. We sat for about 7-10 mins before we were offered water. They service the sodas in cans so don't expect to get a refill. My buddy ordered the chicken fried rice and said it was just ok.

I came here during peak lunch hour, the place was packed so I had to get my order to go. I got the medium bowl which was more food than I expected. The quality of the meal was pretty good, the turkey meat balls where a little dry in my opinion but everything was well cooked and tasty.

I would advise new comers to have a look at what they want before getting in line. You kinda feel rushed when the servers ask what you want.

This place, is fucking joke. Seriously.. whoever is the manager here, needs to get fired. 

We made an order from postmate 12 pces 

What we ordered was half spice half mild 
For the side fries and coleslaw 

But what we got was dry chicken all MILD
2 bag of fries which they fked up and sourly bisuket..

How can they be this dumb? To fuck up the order.. fking golden fish IQ dickheads..

No wonder why this place already has 1.5 star before I even make this review. Hopefully this place gets shutdowned

My first time here was terrible, both my manicure and pedicure looked messy. Not only that, but the guy clipped something and made me bleed. The bleeding took forever to stop, even after I left the nail salon. I decided to give this place another try because I thought the inside had a nice feel to it and I figured I could try someone else there. Again, very disappointed with how my manicure and pedicure turned out.

A couple co workers and myself were in town for 2 days scoping out restaurants for a large group dinner. We had some free time in the morning and booked the "Queen of the South" tour. The shop is neat and clean and the bikes are well taken care of, they all look brand new and have comfy seats! The basket in the front is also extremely convenient for holding your belongings. Teddy was our guide, he is so nice and he knows so much about his city, I learned a lot that day!! If you are in the area I would definitely recommend taking this tour. The history and traditions of this city are really special. I liked New Orleans even more after the tour. Thanks Teddy!!!

I love this place for Sushi. I come here on my birthday & order Sushi A, since I don't like salmon roe, or Chirashi. I have been coming here since 2000. Always fresh! I can't ask for more. My family likes to eat cooked food, such as Fried oysters, Donkatsu, grilled salmon, etc.

I am a blue cheese FA-REAK! Just can't get enough of the stuff. And this is the best blue cheese bacon burger I have yet to find in St. Louis. You know why? It's not because the beef itself is downright delicious - because it is, but that's not my point. It's ultimately because Seamus literally puts an entire fist full of blue cheese crumbles on top. Being stingy with the blue makes for a dry, boring burger...and stingy they are not! Most places are. 

Also...ALSO...their blue cheese dressing is out of this world. It's homemade and super thick. I sometimes get a side of it to dip my fries in. So that's a blue cheese burger with a side of blue cheese dressing for my fries and, if you think that's gross, I think you're gross.

I've tried a good amount of items on the menu and haven't had anything bad yet. My only two complaints is that they serve crinkle cut fries that are kind of lackluster and you have to eat out of a basket - which I hate. Everything's touching and, yes, I probably need to get myself on some meds for that issue.

Anyway, my point is - BLUE CHEESE! It's awesome and they are using it properly!

Not usually one to try sushi, but I met family for lunch. Try the mozzarella tempura. It's phenomenal.  Had the Miami roll. Very filling but fresh and delicious. 

Atmosphere is typical for a sushi place and very welcoming staff.

This places has to be the worst place to get a Philly cheese steak in Philly. Steak was tough, cheese was cold, bread was stail, and it was really expensive. Pick something else. anything else. Don't make the same mistake I did.
Have gotten film developed here a few times! Moving soon and definitely will miss this place!

Seafood a la carte, Asian style! This place is delicious, but on the expensive side. The sauce is flavorful, and even though I went for the seafood, the corn and potato sides were my favorite parts. I've never been to a seafood place like this before, and it's a lot of work dissecting the food, but I think it's worth it.

My only hold ups are they only sell soda by the can so it gets pricey; the scissors they give you are children scissors so they barely work; the workers don't speak English well so the language barrier is tricky, but don't hold it against them. 

Overall I'm full and satisfied!

I stopped by Zuzu's Kitchen off the recommendation of a friend and it did not disappoint! From the interior decor and the friendly staff to the creative menu, this is definitely my new go-to spot. I ordered Zuzu's salad and the only thing I can say is WOW! The ingredients are so fresh and I especially loved the avocado and artichoke! While I was eating I decided to order Zuzu's special pizza to bring home and eat with my roommates. Lamb on a pizza??? I figured if the salad was this amazing, the pizza has to be too! (I mean, it is a pizzaria after all) Holy CRAP!!! Best. Pizza. Ever. Lamb is my favorite and so is pizza. Both combined? HEAVEN. The lamb is obviously great but the 2 different cheeses and chickpeas on top really seals the deal. I am not in this area often but I plan to be here a lot more! The owner was great as well, I asked him a lot of questions and he was very knowledgable about everything on the menu. You can really tell that this is his passion.

My wife and I live in Los Angeles and both agree that Vedge is in our opinion the best Vegan Restaurant in the nation. 

We frequent Philadelphia at least two times a year and Vedge is ALWAYS  a must!
Pad Thai w/chicken was delicious with huge portion size.  Great value and quick service.

I was exceptionally happy with my experience with Dr. Loden. I had lasik surgery in August 2016 and the whole process was smooth, comfortable and Dr. Loden and his associates were able to answer any questions and were very professional but personable. Since the surgery, I've had 2 more follow-up visits and the warm and friendly experience continues. I highly recommend using them if you can.

$3.75 for cheese and $4.25 for a specialty slice. This place is simply a reliable and delicious pizza find. Each time I have come to RTM I thought that I would eat somewhere else... but I just end back here.

What can I say? I love me some pizza.

These aint ya momma's green beans and that aint your daddy's beer. I like Grace. Good bar food (forget the gastropub shiz), good prices, good brews, nice staff (especial dudebro #1 behind the bar)

Just go. If you want to sit go at an off hour. It fills up and gets crowded. Try the green beans and the tuna burger with hot sauce. Serious.
Very large selection at good prices.  You can always find a good bottle for you price point.  The staff is always ready to help and give recommendations as well.

Just off gandy in the location termed "red neck Rivera" this place it's a small dive that has a lot of character. Although it is colorful, you might miss it if your not looking for it. Their menu is pretty large with various seafood dishes. Their claim to fame is their various crab and they offer many options. I brought some out of towners with me l, who love crab legs. I appreciated the waitresses honesty when my friend ordered one variety of crab. She let her know she might be disappointed because they are unusually small. She offered king crab instead. My guest was satisfied. I was doing a light day, so I got the scallop appetizer sautéed instead of fried with a side salad. The scallops had a nice buttery flavor but I did not like the side salad. It was pretty bland. I am not a fan of iceberg lettuce for a salad. Otherwise, I noticed they have a lot of specials that are all you can eat different days of the week. The prices are pretty decent.
Best pizza in Idaho! We got 1/2 Mac and cheese 1/2 enchanto pizza. Mac and cheese pizza was the best!

The cutest in Nashville. I am always met with such great service. I love the creative new flavors each month. "Parent Trap" was peanut butter and cookies and cream, supposed to have crushed peanuts on top l, mine did not, and the filling was pretty light. The berry crisp I got to was so fantastic though. Crunchy oat crumble, brown sugar, amazing, thick jam inside. I loved it. Can't wait to see next months flavor!

Yaasssss, Gurl. Get your cappuccino, latte, espresso, and flat whites here! Their breakfast wrap is a WIN. I get mine made with jalapeños, & it makes me moan & groan with celebratory after tones. Honey! Affirmative, chica. Y'all need to twerk yo' jerk to the Perk, okkkerkk?  I can't wait to go back for a fourth time to try new tasties. Oh, great location too! Sitting outside beneath the oak tree was lovely.

Some of the best food I have eaten in Florida. Comments about the portion sizes being a bit small are fair game, but flavor is the reason you eat at Rooster & the Till, and that is something other restaurants don't currently offer at this level. The pork belly and mushrooms in particular are worth the 30 minute wait, complimented nicely by a $5 glass of Foxglove Cabernet, one of the better valued Cabernet's I've enjoyed.  This is the kind of place you go for culinary inspiration. The presence of this restaurant is evidence that Tampa (and Seminole Heights in particular) has become a surprising mecca of culinary creativity.  Thank You to the owners for bringing excellent flavors to the city, we will come back for seconds.
Amazing place for photogs of all ages and experiences. Awesome fireworks and fountain shows and amazing customer service from the staff. Also great for botanists and history buffs.

Review is for Sunday brunch.

I want to give The Standard a 5, the interior is gorgeous and the menu is extensive. I think the staff just need to get into their groove. It will come with time. I will definitely be back.

The mimosa's come with ice and not in a champagne class. That bugs me. I want the fancy glass and don't try and make it look like a giant drink by filling a cup with ice. Also I want the fizz of the champagne so please leave out the ice.

I had a version of eggs benedict with lump crab meat. It was fine. Didn't leave me speechless or drooling lol.

I want to try for dinner and re review.
Gave and Brice have great customer service, will definitely be coming back!

This facility has 2 NHL sized rinks, 1 olympic sheet and a studio (small space) rink. They have A nice referee room with wooden booths to store your gear. Lift the lid to put your shoes away and little boxes to store your valuables. 

They also have a cozy bar restaurant on the 2nd floor. I ordered a cuban sandwich with a side of fries and a coke. The sandwich and fries were served hot, the coke was warm, no ice. The place seats about 50-60. It was quiet tonight. Nice servers. Lots of TV's with a general buzz in the room. Typically when I see these kind of restaurants in hockey arena as they are not successful. This place looks to be different. The food was good, it hit the spot right when I needed it. I will return.

Very good food and service! Definitely will be coming back. Steak was good as well as the wraps. Homemade croutons in the salad was a plus. Very very pleased. We have been looking for something that has a little bit of everything and this is the place.

The Columbia restaurant was good the first time I went years ago but I think the food has gone down hill. The experience is nice but they need a new Chef. My husband got sick after eating a creamy pasta dish that was made. Who remembers but we never went back.

I've carried my receipt from Midtown in my wallet since September 21, 2010. That's about three months! I wanted to make certain I got to Yelp to write a review. Because this is one of the BEST beer stores I have ever walked into. And boy, let me tell you, after walking over a mile in 110 degree heat (it was a September heat wave, I tell you!), I have never been so happy or excited to see beer in all my life. Or be in air conditioning. (I used to live in Phoenix, too, so walking in the heat was like being back in the desert.)

Since I knew I was going to have to walk another 1/2 mile back to my hotel, I had to be VERY mindful of the amount of beer I snagged. I wanted all of it, to be honest. But the guy working there really helped me hone in on local things I can't get in Boston.

Without further adieu, here's my receipt:

Rogue Northwestern Ale - 6.49
Terrapin Rye Pale Ale 6 pack (heaven!) - 8.39
Fort Collins IPA - 4 single bottles (fantastic!) - 7.16
Yazoo IPA - single - 1.99
Schlafly Pale Ale - single - 1.69
Fort Collins Retro Red Ale - single - 1.79

All this came to under $25. It's like I was stealing from the store, this was so inexpensive. And what I picked up is only the beginning. I really, really, really wish I could bring the entire store back to Boston with me. What a happy person I'd be living so close to a stock of Fort Collins' IPA and Terrapin's Rye -- Two of my favorite beers!
Haven't been here in years, but glad I finally did.  Delicious food, great service, entertaining chef.  What a nice experience!

I finally feel like I can relax now that I found a used vehicle. In my "Quest" to find one I was hesitant to go to a dealer because they are obviously more expensive but thought at least I'll get a quality car. 
I actually felt like the used car dealers on Kensington Avenue and in the "cash only" dealers there were more honest than these crooks. 
I was looking at a used Honda Pilot that sounded too good to be true (about $3,000 less than Kelly Blue Book) but needed minor body work/paint. I thought the work that needed to be done was why the price was dropped on the vehicle. I asked why the price dropped and I was told "sometimes we just do that to get traffic in the door". I didn't believe that but OK...whatever.
I picked up the vehicle to take it to a mechanic for a pre-purchase inspection I had found out in Hatboro PA which is approx. 15-20 minutes away. It was "highway" driving (turnpike) and the vehicle seemed OK, on the way back to Honda with a check in my hand to buy it, the vehicle started driving differently with the stop and go starting. By the time I got to Lancaster Avenue I decided this was going to be a problem and then the car broke down approximately a mile away. 
The transmission had metal shavings inside and was shot. 
I know all used car salesmen are slime but to try and pass this off, then say it was only a minor problem was BS. I played dumb while they ran around going to the enclosed "bullpen" to plan out what story they were going to try and sell me to make me believe that this was an honest mistake. After conferring with a few friends that are mechanics they said they most likely flushed and re-filled it and that is why it was fine for a short distance and being on the turnpike in gear, not shifting.

6-26-14
RE: Martin Honda's response 
Thanks for your "form" letter response but there isn't anything further to address. I was lucky enough to have the vehicle break down on me and NOT purchase it and I believe you have removed it from your inventory (which it should have never been there in the first place). This was just a heads-up to other consumers of how you conduct business.

Great food, friendly staff, nice decor. No frills but that doesn't matter to me. I got the baby back ribs, Mac n cheese and crazy corn. All very tasty. My husband got the brisket, fried okra and Mac n cheese. All of it was cooked to perfection. Definitely would go back!

There's no way I can review this without seeming like an absolute fatty, but let's be honest here: who orders Chinese with the intention of being healthy?

I ordered Chinese via Total Takeout, and this was the only restaurant option given my address.  It's not that the food was terrible or expensive, but the portions were (here comes the fat girl label) too small.  Like, JS was trying to make sure that I didn't eat myself to an oblivion.  On any other day, I would have been grateful, but after spending my day drinking about 50 beer samples at Winterfest.  I was looking to eat a shit ton of General Tso's and fried rice.  Given my intentions, my meal had my stomach feeling disappointed and wishing I an ordered another meal.

In terms of quality, the food was good.  It wasn't bottom of the barrel terrible, but also I wouldn't say this is the best Chinese in town.  I most liked how the chicken wasn't 75% fried breading and 25% poultry, giving me the protein I deserved.  The fried rice felt like microwave vegetables, rice, and scrambled egg thrown together.  The fried egg roll was small.  I think it was wrapped in a spring roll wrapper, which threw me off a bit.

Which brings me to my final verdict: should you eat Chinese at JS Garden?  Yes, if you don't want leftovers or the feeling of being stuffed.

Exceptional service, very nice space, great design, clean and delicious food. I opted for a plate of food; sea bass and Brussels sprouts. Both were excellent. My Dad had 8 pieces of sushi and was very happy, and dessert was mochi and a piece of chocolate cake. Both were excellent. Highly recommend this place.

I was in a fair amount of lower-back pain when I called Dr. Halle's office. Julie, the receptionist, was kind enough to get me in for an appointment within 90 minutes of my call for my first visit. Dr. Halle informed me about his method before making any adjustment, which made me feel relaxed and comfortable. I'm happy to say that I was pain-free within a couple of hours after the adjustment. There was no pressure to return immediately or set up a series - which many chiropractors do. He simply stated: "When I can be of service, please give us a call".  Great Chiropractor - great office - great people!

Joyce has started a new massage business that is the best in Tuscon. The quality of massage is on a much higher level. No language barrier, custom massage the way you request according to your particular pain and areas that matter most. They are licensed professionals which means the standards are followed with accuracy - not like foot spas that do not require licensing. The price is excellent - my first was $60 for one hour and it was worth every penny.

CC's is a local coffee chain. I'd choose it in a heartbeat over Starbucks and so should you! Hell, no one should be stepping foot in a damn Starbucks while in New Orleans (yay for them being unable to set up shop in the French Quarter, at least!) because there are very good coffee shops at every turn (not unlike Kansas City, FYI). I can't say the same of many other cities, including New York. Just sayin'.

CC's coffee houses sell their *premium* blends, while you can get their standard roasts and chicory blends at any area grocery store (and from what I've heard, it's preferred by locals, over Cafe du Monde). 

Besides their coffee, I'm a huge fan of their branding! Years ago, I'd buy their coffee online and I couldn't resist their fab retro coffee mugs (one fashioned after a 1930s cup with their old logo and another after a 1960s style). Not sure if they still sell them, because I fear if I go to their website, I'll buy yet more mugs and I have no place to put them! Yes, I have a mug problem. As we speak, I'm drinking my morning brew out of a giant Loveless Cafe mug.

Baristas here are nice, if a bit slow (on weekends, lines are to the door) and will do their best to get you your coffee just how you want it (hence the potential slowwwwwwness). Hey, it's New Orleans! Accept that people move a bit more slowly (makes sense if you've ever been there in the months of June, July or August) and all will be OK.

We had good service here but the food was not impressive at all. I felt that the meal was uninspired and most items were bland. The best thing that we had was the croquetas, which I probably could make at home.

Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable! I truly enjoyed the two hour tour! I learned a great deal about the Voodoo Queen, the French Quarters' history and interesting facts about the burial process in New Orleans. Thanks for the great tour.

I've been here only once, with two other friends.

The food is great -- I had their "meat" omelette, served with hashbrowns, sourdough toast, and it was perfect. It was a nice-sized serving, not too big, and certainly not too small.

They have an espresso machine, and actually know how to use it, which is not often the case.

The service was quick, efficient, friendly. 

The place is clean, well-lighted, and the seating is comfortable. All the booths were filled, and we had a nice table, which I often prefer over a booth.

My one and only complaint is that the acoustics are a bit harsh.

Server did not speak English , I wanted tuna and it was on menu, waitress said, no tuna, not ever.  Asked if they were going to update menu, she said no. ???? Anyhow I got the crab soup and yummy:) got the crab salad and was good but a little bland.  Had to ask for some of the sauce they gave me with soup to give it some flavor and then it was better.  I likely will not eat there again, maybe take out though for the yummy crab soup

WOW.  Food and service are amazing!  Start your meal with the crab cheesecake, quite possibly the best thing I have ever eaten.  Leave room for their white chocolate bread pudding.  Even if you don't care for bread pudding, you have to try this!

We came here when they first opened.  We used to be faithful to another small sushi place, but this  so much better. They gave more of  selection. Uni and sweet shrimp for a small local place is rare for me. 

They deliver also!

Service is great, attentive and very friendly.

Our new favorite  local spot!!

The wait was extremely long and a lot of customers asked for money back because they have been waiting for two hours. The cashier tried to communicate with the cook but he instantly started cursing at her and yelling which caused an argument. We all heard it and the cashier was swamped with people telling her they've been waiting long. I got my food and the Alfredo sauce was super thick and my chicken was burnt and the pasta underneath was all stuck together with no sauce. The owner definitely needs to make some improvements this place used to be my go to spot.

Quick, local, nice, honest, and good! Had mysterious pressure leaks from my front wheels that were eventually diagnosed as rim leaks. The repaired the rims and remounted the tires with sealant and my tires have been rock solid holding pressure since (for months now). It's easy to go to the "big place" instead of trying out the "local place" but well worth it in this case.

I LOVE MY NAILS!!! La nail bar is now my go to place. amazing services They offer wine or water , and a lot of colors to choose, friendly staff, i'm a very picky person they did my nails perfectly. Also they have dipping powder not every salon have that! Over all I love my experience here I will definitely coming back here.

Somewhere within Reading Terminal Market, this sandwich shop has all that you need to try for some hearty, gut-busting, satisfying sandwiches.  The roast pork sandwich with sharp provolone and roasted spinach is the best you can probably get in town, and the roast beef sandwich is TO DIE FOR.  Perfectly cooked, seasoned, tender roast beef was rich and went well with some sharp prov and grilled peppers.  I drool when dreaming of that sandwich.  Will need to pick half of one up (because a whole one is ridiculously huge for little ol' me) the next time I'm in town and in the market.

Me and my hubby ordered the lamb shawarma sandwiches. Being from the Middle East we weren't really expecting much but.....wow! So good and tasty! Just 1 filled him up, :) this is our 3rd time eating from here and every time we do it just gets better and better

Who thought that revamping and rebranding the back bar (by the back stage with the video poker/slots games) was a good idea? Me and my wife have been coming to Sugarhouse for over 5 years and will no longer be coming due to the management totally blindsiding its loyal "customers". The renamed "Fishtown Hops garden" will be a total flop. For people that dont know they removed the video poker machines at the back bar with a post it note type of letter saying that the machines were being removed at the beginning of MAY 2017.

It seems like the casino thought that the back bar was costing money with free drinks but with that gone the casino will lose profits from the slots and less people will come. Talking to other loyal customers such as myself all the opinions are negative about the rebranding. Should have been thought out more as the drink services on the floor is very slow. Drink service is non-existant at any of the video slots on the floor.

We have always had a good time at Sugarhouse but this different way the casino is going will not sustain.

WILL

I am definitely going to miss this place. The menu did change for the worse during the past couple of years, but as a Parrothead, it was definitely a place I felt at home! I started an employee, helping to open the Bloomington store, and stayed a fan long after I hung up my grass serving skirt. Tons of great memories and fantastic people to work for. Sad day for all the CIPers. Best wishes and I will hold all the memories made and the Dockside burger close to my heart. ;)
Bottomless bloody marys seals the deal for me. They are pretty tasty too! I enjoyed my breakfast sandwich as well.
This place used to be a lot of fun, but the service is so cold. The bartenders act like they are high and mighty. There are so many better places to go in the neighborhood.

I love this place.  Every time I am in town I come here.  Consistently good.  Good bar, good food.  I had a rather large bone in rib-eye that was just as good as any top steakhouse I've been to...and I've been to many.

Welcome to Yelp...the new Citisearch!

Nancy is awesome!! Went in with a form of vertigo and she did adjustments and acupuncture. Worked like a charm for me. I've been going to her for quite a few years and recommend her to anyone looking for a chiropractor!

I don't know what the company does to keep employees so happy, but they are the happiest people I have ever met in a store (at least at this store). Always so ready to help, always so cheerful and friendly. I love the daily product samples. I can't tell you how many times it's given me the perfect idea for dinner, and the employee chef du jour always has the ingredients right there on hand or directs me to where I can find what I need. I don't even mind waiting on long checkout lines because the cashiers are so pleasant and inviting. Weird, right? A trip to TJ's has become a daily routine.

I fly through many airports throughout the year, and have always had a special place in my heart for PHL. although it may not be the friendliest, most helpful, or cleanest, you can still navigate around there with ease. 

I have only had a couple of minor delays / cancellations here, however, nothing to really get angry about, or threaten to never come here again like many of my. Coworkers say. 

If you are into waiting in lines, some small delays, but always knowing you can find a flight out of Philly if something goes awry, than this airport will work for you.
Ice cream is so delicious!! Lots of neat candies and an unreal selection of in house made yummies!! Will definitely be back when we return to Nashville!!

I NEVER thought I'd be excited by a vegan restaurant.. or writing a review to describe how fantastic the food tasted. We tried just about everything on the menu at our table - and everything was fabulous. Loved the seasonal nature of the cooking and the amazing attention to detail and taste. The ambiance is warm and cozy. Highly recommend to vegans and non-vegans alike. I'm very much a meat eater - but if Vedge was feeding me everyday.. who knows!

I've been here twice, never waited more than 10 minutes, always given mouthwash and a new toothbrush.

Everyone is friendly and I have nothing but good things to say about this place.

I have never been disappointed when going here. The place is always clean when I'm there; I've been going on a semi regular basis for a few years now. Definitely worth the price. There's always a new bowl to create & the service is phenomenal. Never had anyone that was rude or seemed to not be pleasant. I would highly recommend to anyone for any occasion. Could be a Sunday out with someone or a special occasion, it would suit it.

Came back for brunch round 2! This time we got the steak and egg chilaquiles, the coconut French toast and the jalapeño cornbread! The coconuts French toast was very fresh and the shaved coconut and whip cream was so airy and light! The jalapeño cornbread was a savory choice with just a little bit of kick served in a little skillet. The bread wasn't too spicy so you got this! Finally, the chilaquiles were absolutely amazing the steak and eggs were cooked to perfection but it was the sauce under the chips that truly stole the show. Brunch is always banging here but when we added those $2 mimosas to the mix, the day just got even better!

Pretty awesome place to eat lunch! Go before noon, or the line gets long. Sushi is pretty delicious for this place being so quick. You can pick whatever items you want and make a roll! First place I've encountered with that. Not overly expensive and they deliver!

They did my move in Nashville about 1.5 hours faster than another company did in Madison and cheaper per hour to boot. They were slightly less professional, but they're a great option for someone looking for movers. The guys were very nice and moved quickly, whereas the other company I worked with had long delays for inexplicable reasons. Would definitely recommend these guys.
WOW! That all I can say, food was great drinks was amazing. From when you entered this black owe restaurant you are treated with nothing but love..  Thank you for your great customer service Canada
Huge Lines for the Pharmacy. Not coming back. The pharmacist in charge is very rude yelling at customers. It'a mess!
Not impressed, Hurricane drink was to sweet, bartender missing when ready to order, won't go back.

I have been to plenty of bakeries around Nashville, and none of them compare to the deliciousness of this one. Forever a loyal customer 
Definitely recommend the tiramisu they have.

I don't think I have ever been as disappointed with a bar as I have with Happy's Irish Pub. On my second night in NOLA, Saturday June 17th, my friend and I decided to go to Happy's because of a deal that we had noticed. They had advertised online that they were doing "St. Practice Day" drinking specials on the 17th of each Month. $1 PBR, $1 Guinness Pints, $1 Jameson Shots, $2 Irish Carbombs, etc...

To my friend and I, "St. Practice Day" at Happy's seemed like an awesome place to drink. However when we arrived we were only met with disappointment. For us, Happy's was a bit of a walk from our hotel, give or take 6 blocks off Bourbon street area. We walked into a dead bar with an off-putting smell and sticky floors. My friend and I, shrugged it off and decided to stay for the drinks. Unfortunately, according to the bartender they did not do that deal anymore (her actual words when asked about it was "No") She did not offer an explanation, nor did she even attempt to make us feel welcome afterwards. 

I understand that bars have to get people in, especially when your bar is off the beaten path. Happy's Irish Pub has all the potential to be a great space, but if their common business practice is to offer deals only to fallback on them, I doubt this bar will exist by the next time I return to NOLA. 

Honestly, making the effort to go here was by far the worst part of my trip. You know what's funny though? The specials are still listed on their website, we looked it up right after the bartender told us "no". Stay away from this bar, it's not worth your time or your effort.

so i tried this bar again last night because i had a christmas party in the area and needed some pre-festivity holiday cheer.  sadly, it's still like vanilla ice cream dressed in wayfarers and deck shoes.  though, i'll give one extra star because the bartender actually fixed a really good cocktail.

note: douche central starting around 10 pm.

Tried Burger Joint  Nash for dinner tonight and it was a great experience.  We sat at the bar and had exceptional service from the bartender who was stretched very thinly having to run food to tables as well as manage the bar, but did an excellent job.  My only criticism would be that there has to be more people working:  the bartender and cashier had to stop what they were doing to run food to the tables, bus tables and also serve people in line which jeopardize the customer service.  While we thoroughly enjoyed our Wagyu burger and tots (they were hot, crispy and delicious), we ordered it medium and it came out well-done and I attribute that to the busy night and team members being stretched to do multiple jobs.  Lastly, the credit card machine doesn't print receipts so we had to sign a blank piece of paper with the amount on it- hopefully this is being fixed. We'll definitely be back!

Dr. Farina, his staff at the South Tampa office, and the rewards/points program for patients are awesome!  We had a wonderful experience there with my daughter (for braces), and soon, my son and I will also be patients.  They made the process easy and exciting.

Food was ok, overpriced for breakfast food. Coffee is ridiculous @ $2.99! Service was good and fast, but they need to add more options for breakfast and lower their prices. 

Patachou prices for greasy dinner food.

My friends and I eat here for either breakfast or brunch when at Reno. Good place for both. They have a "Reno Skillet" which includeds eggs, sausage, and hash brown all in one. Nice place to relax while staying at Grand Sierra.
Good and friendly service.

Really enjoyed the atmosphere at PAW. I'm not huge on craft beer but there was one I really liked and our friends from out of town (who are much more in the know about beer than I am) thought it was great! Customer service was on point :)
Very nice service, fresh food and the sauce they use isn't sweet which I like because I hate sweet and savory personally!
Excellent food.  Great atmosphere.  Parking want bad.  I'd go again if i ever got to that area,  without a doubt.

In addition to BMW service they are specialists in voice mail. You call and the receptionists are quite capable and courteous.  Try connecting to a service advisor ...... Different story, voicemail, voicemail, voicemail.
Try hiring a few more Advisors.

So if you need service, leave a message and then sit by your phone.

Absolutely delicious and great experience all around. The restaurant itself is beautiful with an amazing patio with tons of greenery and a water fountain. Inside is dim and cozy. The staff was incredibly nice and helpful, very patient and had great suggestions. I had the shrimp al mojo which was delicious, great flavor, and great portion size. It came with some really flavorful rice and beans. I had the scorpion mezcal, they have so many tequila and mezcal options. I also really enjoyed the chicken chicharrones, perfectly crispy crunchy and juicy. I was here for a late lunch and it was mildly busy.

Recently went to the iconic restaurant​ for dinner with friends.  I had been to the Columbia some years ago. We had made reservations to see the flamenco​ dancers.  The dancing was beautiful, graceful and made this moment in time a memory.  If you have read my post before life should be made up of beautiful memories.
 We I had that delicious salad that made this restaurant famous.  Thin slices of salami​, mozzarella​ cheese, green olives.  With that tantalizing dressing.
I had the shrimp saleto​--shrimp, green peppers, ​onions, potatoes, chorizos in​ a rich brown gravy.  Yellow rice accompanied this dish.  The dish was delicious.
One of my friends had the mussels in a tomato broth. Accompanied​d with the wonderful crusty Cuban​ bread.
Another friend had the Pompano fish in paper.  She gave me a taste and it was flaky and fresh.
The waiter was courteous and helpful.
If you get a chance and want to see and eat in one of the oldest restaurants​ in Tampa, FL.  You should try the Columbia Resturant.

Bombshell did mine and most of my bridesmaids hair and makeup. They were so sweet and are really great at keeping things fun and uplifting for everyone. I gave my bridesmaids freedom on their hair, but not too much on their makeup so the stylists made sure to run everything by me first. They are amazing at what they do, and I'm so glad I used them forg wedding!

I've been lucky to have eaten lots of yummy food in this city, and it's rare that a restaurant truly blows me away. Palm & Pine blew my mind. (The few other places that have wowed me are Maypop & Sofia!) SO creative/innovative in their menu with flavors that just go together without having to try too hard! All around, amazing.

We ordered so many items. 4 apps, two entrees and dessert. Highly recommend the goat curry (so good!!!!), and many here have. But, one of my favorite dishes was the Dr. Pepper braised boiled peanuts! Now, I didn't detect any Dr. P flavor in the peanuts, tbh, but the combination of everything they had in that dish was delicious and probably my favorite thing on the menu!

Crabclaws were fantastic, the shishito peppers were good, pimento cheese (a gift from the kitchen!) was delicious. We also had the La Wagyu beef- cooked to medium rare perfection, and served with smokey potato salad & green tomato/serrano salsa. On special was a cornmeal fried softshell crab also incredible.

Dessert was the peach & frangipane tart with honey & vanilla ice cream. Two thumbs up. They also sent us a generous scoop of paloma sorbet (also a gift from the kitchen!) to try and it did not disappoint! 

The interior is beautiful pink & green classy kitsch (if there is such a thing) with gorgeous wall paper panels, a beautiful bar of resin coated palm leaves and bubblegum pink counter seating saddled up to view the kitchen. A colorful map mural adorns the beautiful brick wall. I love this place.

They've been open just over a year and dealt with closing down due to the Hard Rock hotel collapse and now COVID, but I hope this lovely little gem if a place survives. I'll definitely be back!!
Highly recommend this place! They did such a great job! The people truly care about your satisfaction with the nails and it shows
This place is awesome. Mac and cheese is amazing and so are their pizzas. Don't forget the peach moonshine tea sooo yummy!

I love this place. One of my favorite places in St. Louis to get lunch. All the sandwiches I have tried are delicious. I get the Salem de testa with provel cheese and it's amazing. I get the half and half and get half of that sandwich and half house salad. Great service and good prices for an awesome lunch.

I ABSOLUTELY LOVE living here!  I've been here for a year and am so proud to call this place home.  I wake up to a spectacular water view every morning and have  a spacious floor plan that is beautifully appointed. I've got interesting, cool neighbors who are friendly and fun. The front office staff is helpful, responsive, warm, honest and kind. The maintenance crew is top-notch; they're courteous, timely, efficient, knowledgable. Common areas stay clean and are well-kept. And the best part is - I've lost 25 pounds since living here because Bayshore and RiverWalk are so close and I have NO EXCUSES! Only thing missing is a whirlpool or hot tub...

I recently was up in the Castleton area to watch a movie with some friends and we chose to stop on by for some dinner before our show. Upon arrival, our hostess was not overly enthusiastic about having to leave her phone to come seat us, but she did offer us a quieter table in the back of the restaurant. 
Our waiter was a polite and attentive fellow who went about getting our orders in quickly, despite the crowd. We had our drinks and appetizer within five minutes and were served our main entrée in short order. 
The food was actually rather tasty. I was surprised and pleased to notice they had several local ingredients on their list, including Smoking Goose meats. I chose a grilled portabella "burger" topped with caramelized onions, a chipotle may, white cheddar, and balsamic tomatoes. It was DELISH!! 
All in all, my experience was a pleasant one and I would be happy to return on future occasions.

Sorry Wok Box just because you put your food in those cute little Asian take out boxes doesn't make it good.

Not bad. But not good enough to go back either. And not even good enough to eat the leftovers we brought home (I left them on the fridge all weekend hoping that someone else would eat them but no luck).

I have used team D a few times and i am always so relived and satisfied. I've had so many cleaning companies come and spend hours for me to end up just being unhappy and having to clean myself after they leave and it always upset me to be dissatisfied after spending a good amount of money. They have reasonable pricing and they are simple and easy and reliable. Won't go with anyone else. I love how Team D just cares and wants you to be happy. Love them and love the company.

Nice place. Pretty upscale. Better get there early or make a reservation or you'll be standing trying to enjoy a cigar and drink. Was in town visiting from DC and was well under dressed, but nobody seemed to mind. Especially when they saw the Cohiba Magicos 5 I had to puff on. LOL But overall, its a nice place. Especially if you can find a seat. Next time I'm in Philly, I will return.

My favorite Thai restaurant in the area. I have tried numerous menu items and never been disappointed. The staff is amazing- warm, welcoming and friendly- although I live out of town and only make it here once every couple of months, they always remember and greet me. My favorite is the green curry grilled grouper & seafood.
One of the best steak houses I've ever been!  Get the coffee filet mignon - it's the best!  The deviled eggs app is great too. All the dishes are very good.
Delicious oysters and great service. Fair prices for Happy Hour. Will return next time I am in NOLA!

These cheeseburgers are delicious! The special sauce that comes on the side is very tasty. The beer selection is well thought out with a good variety of local brews. Their specialty burgers are top notch too. Honestly, you can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Parking can be an issue, so I would highly recommend taking a ride share. My children regularly ask me to take them there.

I called County Line Plumbing around 6 am with a leaking water heater.  Mike was here with a new tank before 8 am and finished the job before 10.  He was very knowledgeable, friendly and honest.  After comparing with other companies in the area, his prices are more than fair.
I hope that my house doesn't need anymore updates that Mike could help me with, but if it does, I will not hesitate to call him back.  I would recommend this company to anyone looking for quality work.

It was a rainy day and so coming in was with hopes of great expectations ... the food was Great .. service was not so good .. there was a change of servers and ours was called in.. he did suggest recommendations but then they didn't have what was on the menu ... so I was disappointed .. everything else was great !

When we arrived it was pretty busy; but we were able to take a seat. After just two second Alexis came by and let us know it might be alittle bit of a wait and if we wanted any drinks. My girlfriend and I ordered two kombuchas. Both were absolutely amazing! Our meal took alittle bit of time; which we didn't mind cause we were admiring every other item which came from the kitchen.  Our food came and it was AMAZING! Alexis came over and asked how everything was; we explained how we just became vegan and it's been very difficult to go out and eat. Not to mention the transition wasn't "fun." He reassured us sticking to it will really pay off. We will totally be back; and will recommend them to everyone.

We're debating a purchase.  

Dan, who helped us, was nice & knowledgable.  We looked at our leisure. 

Thank GOD not pushy.

Ill write an update IF we decide to buy!

THANK GOD I READ OTHER YELP REVIEWS - PASSED !!!

My fiancee and I went here for our 'Engaged Encounter' couples retreat.  Make sure when you drive up Mission Canyon Rd,  make a right at Los Canoas.  It's easy to get lost up in those hills.

This seminary is so beautiful!  High above the Santa Barbara hills.  You can really get away from everything else that is going on in the world.  You should be able to see the ocean on a clear day though both days were gloomy for me.

For those that are doing the couples retreat, Saturday's schedule starts at 6:45am (wake up time) and end as late as 11:00pm.  Sunday is from 6:45am as well but you should be done at 4pm.  Each breakfast/lunch/dinner breaks were 45 minutes each.

The whole weekend consists of writing letters to your fiancee in regards to different categories.  Communication, family, outlook on children, marriage, vows... the workshops are great.  There were only a few exercises where we worked in groups.

All in all a great experience.  If you have any questions you can send me a message

I just finished a facial with Chris who was very nice and a really great massage therapist. I'm bummed tho because I purchased a 80 minute facial with options to for a couple different types of facials (your choice). Unfortunately there was no consultation. The massage was amazing tho! Not sure if there was a missed communication but the whole treatment only lasted about 50 to 55 minutes. The last 5 minutes I was laying there while she was cleaning up... I was kind of just wondering what was going on. I thought it felt short but wasn't sure til Chris left the room and I
Checked the time. When I mentioned this to the front desk receptionist she said she would tell Chris but didn't offer anything to me. I get that it was a Groupon so there is a discount but I think that the customer service didn't come together here. I don't think I'll be going back, it's just not what I wanted it to be.

I love this restaurant  sooo much. Everything on the menu is amazing and they have 2 happy hours every day at the bar that is so cheap. The crispy salad long hots and wings are our fav... The look is so good here..

I have rarely eaten Carl's Jr's burgers, fries, and other meals, but they have GREAT biscuits. Knowing they are part of the Hardee's chain from the midwest, whom also had the best biscuits, Carl's Jr. follows suit. What's even better than their flaky, buttery biscuits is the two for $2.00 bacon, egg, cheese, biscuit sandwiches. Pair that with some mini hash brown hockey pucks and you are set! I can get my family of four breakfast on a lazy weekend morning for under $10 and that's awesome. Try that at Bruegger's!

Viera is a really nice property. We just moved in and I look forward to community events that they hold there. The location and customer service are great! My biggest complaint is that the renovations to the kitchen and the bathroom seem to be done really cheaply and without much care. However, we have only lived there for a month and I'm hoping other factors will make us enjoy it more.
Just had Father's Day dinner and it was superb. The Filet was as good as any I've had. If you haven't tried this place it is a must. Thanks to the staff who did a great job.

Stopped by here because I wanted Thai food. There were 2 vegetarian options: pad Thai and red curry each for $6. Red curry was very flavorful and tasty. For the price and quantity can't beat it. Red curry had broccoli, corn eggplant, peppers, onions, and way too many bamboo shoots. I wish it had come with tofu as well. Also cash only.

Started with the crispy potatoes and bruschetta- garlic butter on toast & buffalo mozzerella. The crispy potatoes were underwhelming but both bruschetta were really good. For the entree I got the Rigatoni that comes with vodka sauce and chicken, which was also very good. Everything tasted fresh and homemade. 

My only concern was the pricing overall. Great food but hard to justify some of the pricing. 

Don't sleep on the garlic butter on toast bruschetta!!

As an update to my earlier review, I took the advice of the "manager" at Advanced Family Dental Care and found another dentist.

I had an appointment today with Dr. Silvana Cumani.

The dental care that I required will be completed on Monday - not in two to three weeks as Advanced Family Dental would have taken. 

Additionally, the out of pocket cost for the procedure with Dr. Silvana Cumani was about 70% of the costs that the "manager" at Advanced Family Dental Care tried to shove down my throat.

One has to wonder if the rude, unprofessional, hard sell by the "manager" at Advanced Family Dental could be directly linked to the additional cost that I will not incur with Dr. Silvana Cumani.

Advanced Family Dental would do itself a favor by ridding itself of the "manager". He deserves no respect and, in my opinion, should not be dealing with the public. 

My rating has now decreased to 0 stars but I have to give it at least one to post this review.

I was actually pretty satisfied with the selection at Retrospect.  I didn't buy anything, but from what I saw, the prices were decent and the store was well-organized and had friendly staff and cool music playing in the background.  Didn't get to spend too much time in here because my friend with whom I was hanging out in the city that day wasn't the biggest fan of this store but I definitely plan to return to see what else has come in.

This is a great Cat Cafe in Fountain Square. Here you can get a great cup of coffee or tea, and spend an hour relaxing with the kitties in the cat lounge. The cats are all up for adoption and extremely adorable. You can also purchase gifts for cat lovers, and their feline friends. I highly recommend it.
This is a very good Mexican cantina. I had the chimichangas, THEY WERE THE BEST!! If you are looking for a place on on the beach this is the place!!
This is a great place to sit back relax and have a beer. The pool table and darts is almost always open and the specials are pretty great.

Great experience for a family outing.
Though I would have liked a simple return phone call as it took a while to get a hold of someone and left several voice mails.
Don't waste your time or money here.     Everything is overpriced, out dated, and the owner is very pushy and makes you feel uncomfortable.

In a word, the food was great.  We had a sampling of a number of things, all of which were really good.  And the dessert was to die for--sort of like baklava, but with shredded filo dough and round in shape.  I would come here again in a heartbeat.

The girl who did my makeup was so sweet and kept checking in with me to make sure I was comfortable with the look she was doing. She achieved EXACTLY what I was looking for, it was better than the picture I showed her! My makeup looked great, it lasted all night (even my eyelashes)! I will definitely be coming here from now on. I wish she had written her name clearer on the card, because I wanted to tell everyone to see her. It looks like Jo, so I hope that's correct! Anyways, if the manager is reading this, she had long dark brown or black hair and did my makeup on thursday, 9/06 around 4:30pm.
This is one of my favorite neighborhood shops. I love to stop in to see what's new and pick up a comic while I walk around on South St.

Great beer selection. Nice atmosphere with awesome decor, absolutely loved the church pews as seating.

Our server was okay, kind of disappeared for a bit, but was quick. Could take or leave the food selection. Would definitely return again.

After living here for two years I would've legitimately rather lived in a homeless shelter. The only reason I renewed is I had no where else to live, they pressure you into resigning, and if you don't, they harass you. Let me just start with the building itself. 4th ave is cool and close to the bars but every time I walk out the door there's just some tweaker in the parking lot. My car was broken into 4 times in two weeks parked in the garage. When I bitched out the office about it they said "management will call you Monday they have the weekend off". Great. They never called. The hallways smell worse than fraternity bathrooms. We've had about 15 cockroaches in our kitchen. Dishwasher has been broken for a year, maintenance never showed up. They trick you giving a tour of a nice decoy room, then when you move in it looks like a child painted the walls. I spent three hours on move in day cleaning my room because they just caulked over the dirt in the tub. My carpet was black by the door from the dirt, the cabinets and floors are cheap. I physically cannot do school work in my apartment because the wifi is atrocious, and there is zero cell data. When I asked them to fix the wifi they told me to call a number. Uh, no you call them that's what I pay maintenance for. It never got fixed. The garage door was broken and left open for 4 months so tweakers could just walk right in. The "maintenance checks" that the managers do is just the employees letting themselves into your room at 9am, but they never fixed the shit that was actually broken (dishwasher, washer, stove, etc). The first room check the manager just let himself into my room when I'm passed out with my girlfriend in bed. Yea. Weird. When I kicked him out the front office called me complaining that I didn't comply to a room check. Imagine if you're a 19 year old girl sleeping and a 40y/o man just walks into Your room?? Honestly probably just a gimmick to snoop through your stuff if you're not home. The manager looked through my clothes drawers, closet, under my bed, and medicine cabinet. I don't think I was having a yard sale? One of my friends had some stuff stolen from his apartment once he got home after a room check. The pool is terrible and gross, the gym sucks and legit hasn't been open at all even BEFORE covid. And if it is open you have to get permission from the front office for only an hour. My fob has stopped working multiple times, so at 2am when I get home I'm stuck outside and I legit have to break into my own apartment building. One time I had to use a tree branch to hit the green button on the inside to open the door. I'm not even kidding. If my drunk ass can break in, imagine an actual thief? The "security" just smokes on the roof of the garage all night just allowing crackheads to walk around in the hallways and garage. There was one time someone threw up in the hallway, and the stain was there for LEGIT two weeks. And the cherry on top is that I pay 880 DOLLARS A MONTH to live here. EIGHT HUNDRED AND EIGHTY. Seriously live in a house or other places like the mark, urbane, luna, etc

Again, this place is fantastic. My best suggestion would be to go brewery hopping and then come to the Smokehouse for dinner! The town of Dunedin really is a gem.

We had the ribs, wings, jalapeño corn bread, smokehouse burger, brisket burger, Mac and cheese and the happy hour cocktails.

Quaint and friendly, Casa Del Rio has perfect portions of great tasting Mexican food! Staff is friendly and nice. Chips are homemade and you can't just eat just one! 

Orders come fairly quickly and are piping hot! This place will become a habit.

Dr. Gluck and his staff are truly the best- they go over and beyond for you and your child time and time again.  Once they kept the office open late when my son, during a routine appointment, pointed to a spot in his gums that was sore and had become infected.  Dr. Jonathan Gluck stayed late to remove the offending popcorn kernel and even followed up the next day with a personal call.  They treat every patient like they are the most important patient.  You cannot beat the experienced care at Gluck Orthodontics!

First let me say I ate here for free as part of a promotional campaign in connection with the opening. But I think I can be objective. This place was well above average. It's not in the class of Tru burger or Company Burger. It's more in the style of a fast food burger, but a very good one. All of the burger selections looked very traditional. The one I had came with cheddar and bbq sauce as well as a nice topping of fried onion rings. Very tasty. The veggie burger looked awesome, and the salds were huge and looked like they were made with fresh and high quality ingredients. All in all a place to come back to.

This place really is more for the sake of getting a good view of the city. The food were on the average side, came out super quickly that I feel like everything might have been pre-made instead of prepared as you order them, and are slightly on an elevated value. I haven't dined up on the 26th floor of anywhere so perhaps this is the norm.

I took my friend here for her birthday because she's been wanting to experience/do more of the STL things being a new resident of the city. I have heard about this place and for fear of being disappointed, I did not have very high expectations coming in. 

When you enter the Hilton lobby, it's pretty clear which elevators will take you up to the bar (East). Someone will slide their card and get you to your destination.  The guy from last night was a bit rude when I had originally asked which elevator will take us up to 360 since there are 3 and I wasn't sure if all 3 ended up to the rooftop bar. There were no lines for a Tuesday afternoon to go up and once up there, we chose the table with the arch in the background. It was quite a lovely view even for a cloudy afternoon.  The view did improve in the evening. There was a game so the stadium side was slightly packed but we checked it out anyway for a minute or 2. It looked fun.

Their restrooms were quite fancy and yes, you can see some views of the city as well while you wash your hands. They are located downstairs from the bar area and there is a small lounge right outside. I imagine this area is useful during the weekends when the bar is packed and there are people waiting to use either facilities.

So we ordered several small plates to share. The California roll ($11) was probably the most expensive I have seen them to be in the smallest portion. It also came maybe 2 minutes or less after we've placed our order so they didn't obviously just make them. The cheese and cured meats platter ($25) had some small chunks of pickled veggies next to the meats (6 pieces to be exact) which appeared to have been an afterthought more than anything. The cured meats were nothing special.  The cheeses were fine and there was a tiny bit of mustard-based spread that came with the platter. Then we had the chicken skewer plate but I don't remember the price (it was over $10 to be sure) and they were small pieces of chicken with some asian glaze sauce.  That was actually good and I would most likely get that again.  Also, the dish came out a little later so they might have had to actually prepare them. 

While finishing our drinks, we decided to munch on some spicy chips. They were large thin slices of potatoes with some spicy seasoning so naturally, I was excited. Then comes my disappointment... The chips were a bit overdone.  I could taste some bitterness to the chips as a result. I did not really like it.

For dessert, we ordered the beignets to share. They were okay... Some were doughy, some were crisp so I settled for 2 or 3 pieces and was done.

Service was wonderful, however. The lady taking care of our table was extremely nice. The place is well-taken care of and the view is probably one of the best in STL. My friend loved everything but to me, the experience as a whole wasn't quite as impressive as she thought it was.  With that said, I will give the view and service a 4-star rating and the food, 2 for an average of 3.

I have a military/ silver membership. They discount for military/police. I believe it was 150 for the year. This allows me to use a lane anytime they are open, of course if lanes are free, you still have to wait membership or not if it's busy. Weekends are usually busiest, or rainy/overcast days. 
I can bring 1 guest every time as well, free of charge.

For civilians looking to purchase a membership. Your membership prices will be higher. 

Gold membership allows you everything stated above, plus the ability to rent their guns free of charge. 

If you want to just go and shoot, you can do so as well, you don't need a membership to shoot/rent here. 

I have a small arsenal of my own firearms that I can always better myself with, close friends and family with their own small arsenals that they'd let me shoot anytime if I  wanted, so the silver membership suited me best.

Their ammo prices are very, very high, bring your own! 

if you rent a gun, you MUST purchase and use THEIR ammo, range rules, even with a gold membership.

Staff is very friendly, and professional. I had a problem with a hand grip screw with one of my higher end hand guns, i let them correct the problem and it was fixed the same day.

I just purchased another hand gun while in Kentucky, the dealer in KY is shipping my new purchase back home to Ready Aim Fire. It will be there by the time I get home. So, they can do state to state transfers. Not sure what they charge for the transfer yet, my guess is 30-50 dollars, but I'll be sure to update this review when I get back and pick it up!

EDIT: 4/5/2015
Have been a member for a year now and just renewed for another year, all the people that work there know me by name, I'm there 1-2 times a week at least. Staff hasnt changed much if any, all great guys over there. They won't let you shoot .223/5.56 or larger rifle rounds. Shotguns are allowed.

My husband and stayed here while he competed in a bowling tournament (oh yeah, we're classy people) and we really enjoyed our time. Our room was done in soft yellows that I found relaxing, and the bed was huge. Another person we were at complained that the beds were bad, but I didn't have an issue with them, all though I will be bringing my own pillows next time we come. There was a tempting mini bar and snack bar in our room that I nearly had removed because I was terrified of sleep-eating a three dollar Kit Kat bar, but if my husband and I had more money I would have been super psyched about the tiny bottles of liquor and gone nuts.

The general use pool was gorgeous and I loved the fountain. There weren't too many splashers and the life guards seemed to be doing a good job. I didn't think to bring workout close so I didn't get to use the awesome fitness center, though I thought it awesome that each cardio machine at a TV on it and you got to borrow head phones. My husband and I both made several visits to the steam room in the male and female locker rooms though. I had never been in one before so after I got over my initial freak out when the steam turned out, I loved how soft it made my skin feel.

I treated myself to a pedicure at the Spa, which also allowed me access to all their little pools and sauna's and (much hotter, admittedly almost unbearably so) steam rooms and more. You got a nice soft robe (which you can purchase- alas, next time!), lockers, and free little snacks, juice and some of the most bomb ass tea I have ever had! My pedicure felt great and came out nice. It was way more than I'd normally pay, but my husband insisted he treat me since we don't get to do these things very often (awwwww). My sister in-law got a wine massage- or something like that, and said it was among the best massages she's ever received.

All in all, I love this plays. I know they have a lot of kid stuff too (and arcade I never got around to). My only complaint would be the pillows and the fact that its sort of hard to find your way around.

An adorable hipster brunch spot in Fountain Square.  I found the atmosphere to be a lot of fun.  The menu items were unique, but slightly overpriced for what you got.  They do have some great coffee drinks though.
I really love this store!  Great selection of furniture, art,  dresses, jewelry and other little knick knacks at reasonable prices!  I never leave empty handed :-)

stopped in for lunch today. I was not impressed with my first order.  they put mustard on my sandwich when I asked for mushrooms.  this was because they have children operating the place.  

The order was quickly corrected and the cheese steak was OK. I've had better and worse.

Also, the exhaust system must be broken as the place  was full of smoke and had a pungent burnt odor.
Jean is amazing I've been going to her for the past few months. She does a very thorough job and the lashes last at lest 3 weeks.

Great food, drinks, and awesome team from bartender up to the owner! We had an interesting first experience - truly an off day - but they quickly made up for it with personal attention to details. Pizzas are unique and delicious. My favorite part are the wings - one of the few places in Tampa that serves killer BAKED wings. A must try. 

Proud to support local South Tampa businesses and looking forward to going back soon.
Mark Rocks! He gets you in and out fast!!! He even worked with me to get the very best priced tires and rims!!!
Great place to eat, always fresh ingredients the chocolate chip pancakes  were absolutely amazingg:)
Very impressed with this place. The food was great and the atmosphere even better. Ordered the prime rib which was massive. My wife got the lamb which was amazing. Highly recommend

This is a favorite stop of ours and love sitting at the outside bar and/or patio and admiring the view.  Each time we've been here the food has always remained consistently good.  Lately my favorite is the chicken and vegetable wrap.  It's served warm and it's got great flavor with the cajun flavored aiola giving it a nice kick.

Absolutely outstanding all around. We live two blocks away and were excited to eat here. Really fun atmosphere, nice staff, creative and tasty drinks, and the food was just top notch. You could tell whoever came up with the menu and makes the food really put a lot of thought into it and executes everything to perfection. We got the seafood pasta and the gobblin goat and both were incredible. Although the Nations is growing into a pretty special neighborhood and there are a bunch of great restaurants, this place may be our favorite. It was nice to hear everything is made from scratch, even the pasta. In the future it would be nice to see some weekly specials. We will definitely be back.
Ok at best. Service was slow, food lacked flavor and was Luke warm, beverages ran low had to find a waitress to refill. May try another location.

Awful. 

Dirty.

Rude.
 Ask for extra Pico, they give you hell. Carne asada burrito... Burnt meat with a bolt in it . 
I've tried several times going here... And I'm always let down .

This was the first time I was there,let me tell you it was delicious from the drinks to the desserts. Was a great experience,our waitress was wonderful.I have been going to restaurants in the area for years but always have past Bahama Breeze by will never make that mistake again will definitely be back time and time again.

A hidden gem?  This Tucson brewery is relaxing and the beer is good.  I ordered the Copperhead Pale Ale and the wife had the Hola Hefeweizen after a very informative waitress provided answers to all of our questions.

The food was beautifully presented for a brewery...and the flavors popped in my mouth!  I had the Phoenix sandwich, which had s a succulent chicken breast, bacon, and Italian red peppers.  My  wife had a salad, the Lizzie.  With chicken, bacon, and fresh greens, the salad also was a pleasure to consume.  Good food, service, and reasonable prices...overall...a great experience!

Come one come all for a pizza specialized just for you! This place is a pizza and salad place where you can come and create your own delicious food item! They have a large assortment of toppings which allows for the ultimate customization. If you're not all about that customization that okay too! They have preset pizza's so you dont have to stress about what's good or not. They've already done that for you! They offer additional side items and grill it up as soon as you tell them what you want. They have beer, soft drinks, and delicious lemonades/other misc drinks. I tried the Marion berry lemonade and I was HOOOOOOOOKED.  I decided to go with a custom pizza and man did I go crazy. Best part is that is all okay! No one judges you for what you want on your pizza and that's how it should be! Great crisp to the bread and cooked to perfection.

Let's just say I could of slept on streets and been better off especially not at the rate I paid for this room. I am very pissed off and let down booked a room for 2 nights and ended up canceling it. Let's say hallways smelled of weed and loud rap music, so I finally get to room and open. I got hit with a pungent odor. Smelled like wet dogs and cat liter. No fridge, no toilet paper and the tv did not work. So I got down stairs and had room switched. I go to new room I went from a deluxe king which I paid for to a single full size the other one was being replaced. The guy would not adjust my rates or refund me nothing. Don't waste your money. I am so pissed.

DO NOT MAKE AN APPOINTMENT. THEY ARE CLOSED, BUT STILL TAKING APPOINTMENTS ONLINE. TOTAL RIPOFF.

After using a Groupon, I prepaid for my next manicure. It was a small, humble business, but the technician, Shanay Williams, did a good job. I booked my manicure for Thanksgiving weekend and she called to say that she was sick and needed to reschedule. Fine. I rescheduled for Sat., Dec. 13 at 3 pm through their online appointment booker, and when I showed up the BUSINESS HAD DISAPPEARED. The office space they occupied is EMPTY. I know I'm out the $25 that I paid for the manicure, and I wasn't able to get my nails done for an important event. I'm going to keep my eyes peeled for Shanay Williams and AVOID her business ventures in the future. How disappointing. They should have stopped taking appointments if their business was closing, and they should have called me! I am furious!

I called at 8:30am and no one called me back.  I called a second time at 11am and made a 1pm appointment.  I dropped my boy ontime at 1pm and asked for a poodle cut with shaved face and feet when I dropped him off.  They never asked me any information like has he had his shots?
