Algiers is so New England/Creole adorable.  Charming people, homes, and pets. A puppy named Beniet decided to follow us to the Irish pub we had on our To Do list. 
Best. Irish Coffee. Ever...at least in Louisiana.  A mix of locals and tourists. One great Irish Coffee is allowed to lead to two when we are days happily ignoring cars to safely snoop the little bars/delicious eateries on foot, trolley,  on and off bus (our favorite) and now ferry across the Mississippi.  
Totally DO THIS. Ferry to Algiers from public transit and hit the pubs. Sit. Stay awhile.
St. Patricks Day promises to be excellent.
We had a single cushion reupholstered for a couch.  When I got it back it looked straight from the manufacturer. I think it was also only a one day turnaround for the job. Super impressed!

I give 4 star just because all food were way too salty! We love pistachio and black truffle pizza, especially the dough was great! But will be better if they are not that salty! Their special sautéed baby squid is another recommendation, tasty with zucchini sauce

A clean mini mart with lots of natural offerings.  They have really good chocolate selection... Not your ordinary Hershey's chocolate.  Of course, the tofu hoagie is great. A great place to pick up random ingredients or relatively  healthy snacks.

First of all this shop should not be listed as a smoke shop on google.  I drove all the way up here looking for butane.  When I asked in the shop about it they were very snippy and rude.  

I was greeted with no we don't carry any of that stuff.  Please get your store relisted as a vape shop and not a smoke shop.  Be a little more friendly to customers.

Went into puppy room to visit. Was in there for a couple minutes before an employee came in and was not nice about telling us that we had to fill out an application just to visit puppies. There was no sign on the door or anything that mentioned an application. It only said visiting hours are limited. Why would I fill out an application to adopt a puppy I haven't even met?! My reccomendation: set separate visiting hours for puppies or at least lock the door if you're going to just kick people out

This place is right down the street from my office, and the food is pretty good, but can only comment on the rice vermicelli dishes, which is what I normally order..  You get a bowl of noodles and crisp veggies, which are served cold, along with either chicken or spring roll which is warm and crispy.  Makes for a very satisfying lunch.  It may not be as good as some of the Rice Vermicelli dishes you will get at any of the Vienamese restaurants in Chinatown, but its still very tasty.  Prices are pretty reasonable for the amount of food they give you.

Finally I've been here a few times where I'm comfortable to give a review. Somebody who I'm close friends with enjoys coming here and took me to this place. I now can see why he thinks it's so good!

This time I took and ran with one of their daily specials. I got a half sandwich with a soup. I ordered a chicken orzo soup and got a chicken salad sandwich (just realized now how much I enjoy poultry) and the soup was homemade and delicious. Then I got the sandwich: there was so much meat, any more and it would have compensated for the other half; both the sandwich and the rest of the grub was delicious!

This place seems perfect: great staff, tasty food, some generous portions (as I noted above), mmm mmm-mmm...

I'm getting hungry again for this place just thinkin' about it! Maybe I'll come here more often. I think it's worth the travel. Pines Cafe gives you service, kindness, and so much more. Try it out if you get the chance!

It's delicious. The pizzas are large enough to share one  especially if you add a salad.  The sauce is delicious, the toppings top quality. 

This feels pricier than Blaze and Mod pizza so that might hamper frequency. But it's one of the few spots in channelside. If they expand their wine/drink menu, I think they'd be surprised by how many more bodies they could get in the door. 

Pepperoni 
Funghi
Large trittata salad 
2 glasses of wine 
Gelato 
About $65 including tip.

You know those recipes where there's one ingredient that you've NEVER heard of so you go to Google and search "XX substitute?" Chances are Saraga has that spice/herb/ingredient...and every other possible substitute. Looking for a way to spice up and impress guests with international ingredients or ingredients they've/you've never heard of? This is your go-to.

A quick 10 minute drive from downtown Indy, Saraga is a MUST for international ingredients. It is HUGE, with stuff from all over the world. They've got you covered from baked goods, to produce from all over the world, to seafood, to pig heads, to dry goods, to teas, to desserts, to basically everything.

It's all extremely relatively priced considering that many of the ingredients came from across the globe. I always get so excited when I come here. 

No, it's not the cleanest place, but get passed that and you'll be fine. A MUST if you're an Indy native and you've never been!

My husband and I came here for dinner as part of our honeymoon. When booking, I indicated it was a "special occasion"-- before getting seated the hostess didn't ask us what the special occasion was. 
We were seated in a private area which was nice. Our server was very very nice. Later during the meal he did ask us what the occasion was and he congratulated us. That was very nice of him. 
We ordered the braised short rib, the lamb and the crab cakes. For dessert we got the lava cake. All the food was delicious. My husband got two types of beer-- he enjoyed both of them! 
The only thing we were surprised by was the wait time for everything. Our reservation was at 8:15pm. An hour and 15 mins passed and we still did not have our main dinner. I'm not sure if this is a regular thing at this restaurant but it became quite annoying. I do not blame the server at all about this. What was very apparent was how a couple who was seated after us was done with their meal and dessert by the time we received our main dinners. Also they were celebrating a birthday and their table was nicely decorated with flower petals. 
As good as the food was, and it's a cute restaurant, I most likely will not make it a point to come back.

I have never been the type to pamper myself. This place pampers you so much and takes such good care of you, it is becoming a habit! Everyone goes above and beyond caring for you and making you feel spoiled. They do such a wonderful job on every detail...even down to the items in the spa dressing room. 
Since I was schedule for my hair, I brought my daughter, very last minute, to let her be spoiled, after the grueling schedule for school she has. Not only are they spoiling her, but they let me enjoy the brine room while waiting for my hair appointment. 

If you have never been here, you are missing out! I went to a 5 star resort in Mexico and was disappointed by the spa after being pampered here. Don't wait for a vacation, come to this spa before your vacation!

Jimmy John's:  ground level, just above the Subway...

If one had to view the corporate, fast-food sandwich joints in terms of quality and placed them accordingly to geographic terms, Subway would appropriately be placed below ground.  Sub-par is Subway.  Extending this line of logic, one would then place Jimmy John's right on ground level:  not disgusting enough to have to bury the food but not good enough to exalt it in the heavens.  

As the 85701 zip code suggests, this location is right smack in the middle of downtown Tucson.  Ironically, it's steps away from a Subway location.  I wonder if the staffs of these two establishments ever have gang wars on the streets of Congress.  That would be cool to watch as I'm eating an average sandwich that I could probably have made at home.  

So let's get to the food.  I cannot really say more than that it was okay.  On my first and only visit thus far, I opted for the "Big John," a simple roast beef with mayo, lettuce and tomatoes.  The quality of the meat, the most important ingredient in sandwiches next to bread, can best be described as better than Subway's.  The rest of the ingredients seemed fresh and of decent quality as well.  As there was nothing else in it, all of this put together cumulatively made for an average sandwich.  

Like many places downtown, there is not much seating on premise.  In fact, at around the noon hour on a weekday, not one table was available.  So actually, I sadly wouldn't have witnessed any kind of Subway vs. Jimmy John's gang war unfold on Congress.  Thankfully, the service was lightening quick, as I barely filled up my cup with Coke when my order was called.  

So off I went to eat a picnic lunch at the nearby park with the Pancho Villa statue.  Yep, I actually sat at a table just underneath his shadow, close enough to have thrown my roast beef sandwich at him.   Okay, going back to the actual review.  I consider myself a fairly big sandwich/deli fan.  Seeing that I'll be stuck in the downtown area for the foreseeable future, I will most likely, and willingly, make a return visit to Jimmy John's.  Needless to say, I probably will not order the roast beef again.  The last time I went, I was actually eying their version of the Italian sub.  

Boy, how do I wish I could write a review of a sandwich shop in the downtown area that would place it high above both Hell's neighbor (Subway) and its earthly cousin.  I'm sure it was look down, perched in the clouds, and spit upon Jared.  Did I mention that I don't like Subway much?

I would not recommend this place. I recently moved into the area looking for a new vet. I made an appointment for my dog. I am disabled and asked to wait outside while they looked at my dog's teeth for an estimate for cleaning.

The staff took the dog into room and brought her right back out and gave her back to me stating"the doctor won't talk to you outside"!!!!  

I have never had a vet office do that before because of the disability! Caring?? Integrity?? Too lazy to walk outside the door?? 

There loss, since I have 4 dogs. Will never recommend them......
These people work so hard. Best car wash in Reno by far. I bought the cheapest wash and they still spent 25 minutes cleaning the inside of my car. Tip them!

Great store!  Open air has a fantastic selection of bikes for any style of riding and ability level.  They continue to impress me every time I walk in. Jermaine knows me by my first name, even though I have never actually purchased a bike at this shop. Every time I come in for a jacket or water bottle or tune up we start talking about local trails or answers questions I have relating to their stock.

Both of their stores are equally great, keep up the great work guys and thanks for supporting our local trails and trail riders!

Still waiting for food... it's been over 30 minutes we have half of it and we have had half that for 15 minutes. They are now telling people it's a 30-45 minute wait when they walk in the door. 2 - 5 people have left without ordering. I get the kitchen is busy and they are doing the best they can but this is crazy. This was my first time here. I don't know if I would be back since half of my food will be cold.

Had a great experience here last weekend - not sure why this place doesn't have more stars. Super clean (seats, theater, bathrooms, bar area) nice, friendly, and attentive staff, and popcorn was good! We only ordered popcorn and beer, so I can't review the food. Will be going back!

Really good, husband had the gorditas (carne asada and carnitas) and said the fresh tortillas were amazing. My chicken burrito was huge and really yummy. Great prices too...my $5 happy hour margarita was really good!
Loved my crawfish dinner and for a Friday night I personally didn't have to wait too long!

I love MOOYAH. Love the ice burger!  Fries are like dope. Decided to try chips. Most were inedible. Extremely greasy. Some were not fried crispy and were essentially raw potato slices. 
If you can't cook something well, then don't sell it.
This is amazing! The donuts are freshly made in front of you and it's nice and hot. When ever we go my kids wear a smile! And the donuts are DELICIOUS!!!!!!!!!
Huge poboys. Great crawfish. Cheap seafood gumbo. Nuff said!!  Quaint lil clean spot run by nice people who gave us beer and bottled water.

This is a review for the Inn only.  I have been here 5 or 6 times, and just recently last weekend.  The rooms are clean and some have a view of the Delaware.  Rooms are decent size and the inn is relatively quiet considering it is more of a hotel where wedding parties are held. It can get busy here on weekends.  The location is central to walking around the town of Lambertville, on the Canal Path or over Bridge Street into the quaint town of  New Hope, PA. The adjacent Station Pub has good food and a nice bar and Wine Cellar on the lower levels below the main restaurant.  All rooms come with a nice continental breakfast of juice, fresh muffins and coffee.

Not happy my BF had a chicken sandwich that looked like chicken nuggets from Burger King. I am not really sure how this place was voted best seafood in downtown. Soup and my salad was sooooo disappointing. I would never recommend this place to anyone.

My wife and I have been craving good empanadas because we both served our missions in South America. Sadly we have always been disappointed, UNTIL NOW! They have great options and I love the beef & cheese. So great.

I will go ahead and add my review to this place. I've been here about 4 times and it's a mixed bag. When you are already ripped drunk, this place is awesome because you get to go in the courtyard with friends and cut up. Then the picture girl comes around and everyone is trashed and tried to to each other with doing the stupidest thing for the camera.

Now here is the review of if you are dead sober. I wondered in here with my mother one night. She told the bartender that she saw a special on hurricanes. The bartender chuckled and said, "We don't offer specials on hurricanes. Why would we do that?" So I questioned the special she saw and just got out hurricane. We walked around and thought the place was very boring. We went to the courtyard that I usually vaguely remember and saw just people sitting down and being civilized... I started to think if this was the same place where my friend took of his shirt and proceeded to do the worm. Then the picture girl came and asked for a picture. The same awesome feature from my drunk nights. We declined and she walked off. Another person came by 3 minutes after that and asked. Knowing he didn't know if we were asked yet, we politely declined. Girl A comes back by 10 minutes after her first time asking and asks again. I'm confused and decline again. Girl A comes around after 10 more minutes and asks again. I tell her I don't think we will have pictures at all tonight. She comes back and asks again even after that. Come on lady! So that turned into an annoyance on a sober night.

We leave there after determining it to be too boring. We get into the house and go right to the Gambit where my mom thought she saw the special and BAM there it was. Some little special for an event that was going on. I guess my review should be 2 and a half stars. Maybe a drunk and sober review would work better. If you are with a huge crowd and you all are over the legal limit, then stop in. If you are just getting started, this place will make you want to go home.
I love Maggie Maes. I had the tuna fish sandwich, it was very good.  My parents had omelettes and they enjoyed their meals as well.  The view out back is great.  It is a local  breakfast lunch spot.

Food and drinks are decently good. I got the Vermecelli and my boyfriend got the pork fried rice ! I also got the Thai tea which was not as sweet as Hana kitchen and had its own good flavor. The fried rice flavor is also bomb! I would come back if I'm craving Chinese food. Just not the cleanest place but will do in IV...

My boyfriend and I came the other day for Kings's Corner's Birthday and it was a real treat. All of their food was 50% off and they had a "mystery beer in a bag" random bottle deal for $2.00 which I thought was very cool. We got the fried pickles to start which were piping hot, and the batter was relatively thin. I think those most places think that more is better but the ratio of batter to pickle was spot on. For my meal I got the KC burger with Swiss, bacon, mushrooms, BBQ sauce and crispy onion straws and they served it on a poppyseed bun (or maybe an everything bagel??) and my boyfriend got the Cajun chicken pasta, with linguini, roasted tomatoes, asparagus, mushrooms and grilled chicken tossed in a  name that included the word Cajun, but the sauce was otherwise good. 

We really need to come to this place more often, the vibes and aesthetic are great and the beer list is extensive.

So incredibly delicious and such a great price! I had the carnitas chimichanga plate and it was soooooo good! Most places serve lukewarm rice and beans with your plate, but everything at Taqueria El Pueblito is hot and delicious. The carnitas had wonderful seasoning. Definitely coming back!

I love Ulele! This had to be one of my favorite places for a nice lunch outside or a quick beer down by the spring.  Today was only a quick beer in the sunshine watching the birds and fish in the spring. I had the wedding beer, my favorite,  although I have truly enjoyed all the beers I have tried here.  They have a few new beers on tap that look exciting too (Weekend Weiss and Amarillo IPA) That I am excited to try in the future.

Love this place!  We all had steaks, and they were perfect.  Too much food here of course.  Took a friend from out of town, and she really had fun.  Love the line dancing the waiters do - very entertaining.  the service is very quick and friendly.  They don't take reservations, but on the weekends, call before you go down there to get your name put on the list.  We only waited about 10 minutes, and others were waiting over 45 minutes because we called ahead and got on the list.  Great place to take kids.

I thought I knew what good gelato was until I came to Capogiro. This is my new go-to dessert spot in Philadelphia. The flavors are extensive, and very unique. I decided to venture out of my comfort zone (read: chocolate or hazelnut gelato) and try a fruit one. I got the starfruit and lime gelato, which was basically like a key lime pie. Amazing. For two big generous scoops you pay around $6, which is about what I pay in Baltimore for the same. I think the difference here is that you almost always want more than 2 flavors. 

Lastly, shout out to the staff for being patient with everyone and allowing tastings of their many different flavors. I always figured that part would be super annoying but these guys do it with a smile on their face. Can't wait to come back here!
It was adorable and delicious. We had sushi and chicken teriyaki and it was a great choice! It takes a long time for the food but it was good! The lunch specials are good too!

THE best neighborhood bar in town. We come here almost every Sunday for the build your own omelette and bloodies/mimosas. Such great prices with very friendly staff. We love seeing Janet in the kitchen in Sunday's, and she sometimes brings out sweets on the house! We love playing pool while we wait for food. I've been hesitant to post about how great this place is, as it feels like a neighborhood secret, but the town deserves to know. Go support!

Was there the other night for 3rd Friday. My girlfriend went in to get us some slices and they told her to go outside and get them from the warmer at the booth. I went in and told them we wanted fresh slices and one of the guys just glared at me and threw a couple of old slices in their oven to reheat for us. Their whole staff was surly and clearly didn't want to be there. They were beyond rude and by the sounds of the other reviews I've read I'm definitely not alone in thinking so. There is litterally no way their 5 star reviews are legit. Liars. They don't deserve to have a place on Main. I truly hope they go out of business. What a bunch of jerks. 0 stars.

Family of 6, we just said what the heck and went for the Chef's tasting menu. Was absolutely incredible and overly generous portions for us to share family style. You know you're in for a treat the minute you bite into The sourdough focaccia and olive oil butter - quite simply, the chef is most creative and understands how to extract the best of every ingredient and combination to just have you keep saying/ thinking ... I can't believe how good this is... best for a foodie. If you or your party just wants Chicken Parmigiana- you best go someplace else!

Great place that will be missed!

Unassuming front but once you get in you see the spaciousness  which is appreciated. Fun times were had by all.
It will be missed.

My rental experience was a smooth transaction.  Minimal line/wait at the counter, car was clean and new and then quickly rolled out of the terminal rental garage and was on my way.  Return was even faster.  Gave my keys to the car jockey, mileage and fuel gauges were noted and I headed for the terminal in under two minutes.  When I picked up the car I was up-sold to a fancier model by Angel but I figured it was ok to splurge while on vacation.

My maid of honor made me an appointment to get my hair styled here on the day before my wedding! They got me in right away and they were terrific! Not only did they offer me tea :) but my hair stylist was very professional and experienced. I told her the look I wanted and showed her a few pictures and she absolutely nailed it! She made it even better then the pictures. I'm very grateful and definitely recommend them and continue using them in the future!
I went to a party with catering from this restaurant and it was wonderful!  Great food and very friendly service
Had food from the taco stand, it was good and priced well. Great selection of beer! Indoor and outdoor seating options allowed them to continue helping many customers even during covid.

My family and I have been on the great search of finding a lovely breakfast spot in St Pete for many years now.  When I read the reviews about Angie's cafe I was very excited to try it out and hoped this would be the place we would come to for breakfast on a regular basis.

We got there right when it opened as we have 2 small children and did not want to have to wait a long time for food.  We loved the neighborhood and the kids loved the pond.  The cafe was charming and the staff were very friendly.  The kids got coloring books and even chalk for the side walk.  Our experience was off to an amazing start.  The menu looked good and I even commented that I heard they made home made bread and I would like some with my food.  I ordered the vegetable scramble and my husband ordered the french toast with home fries.  The kids would munch off our plates.

The food came fast.  "That was fast" my husband commented to the waitress and we wondered how that could of happened given that our orders should have taken at least 15 minutes if they were cooked fresh.

We soon discovered that the reason it came fast was that the only actual thing cooked fresh was the eggs in the veggie scramble.  The home fries on both our plates were clearly cooked a few days ago and were reheated to order.  The french toast was the same, made days earlier and merely reheated in the microwave, you could tell by the way it was so hard on the corners as it cooled down and eventually turned into four pieces of hard brick resembling crutons.  The home made bread never appeared just regular sliced bread toasted.  I still cannot believe that they would reheat home fries and french toast and especially as we were the only customers there.  They should not do it even if they are slammed.

We both barely ate the food and when we got home we were all hungry.  I wish I had said something, I think I would have if we were not their with the children.  Everything was perfect except the food and that is the only reason you go to a restaurant, sure it is important for the atmosphere and staff to be wonderful but that does not keep customers coming back or recommending it to friends.

Our great search for a breakfast place is still on!
It's a lot nicer than I remember, It's like a mini tourist center or mall they actually have some really great kiosk, stores

This review is based strictly on a return I had to make. 

After being sold an incorrect part for the issue / need I described at their Reno location I dropped by here after work to return it. This location is easily accessible from 80 with plenty of parking. I walked in with the battery charger and receipt in hand. I was helped immediately. When I explained my problem the employee was a tad snide, initially asking me if I was "charging a space shuttle" when I mentioned the charger was underpowered. When I stated I wanted both crank assist as well as trickle charging the employee immediately changed his approach. He apologized that I was given incorrect advice because this would definitely not suit my needs.

He handed me a laminated card with a number on it and sent me to the counter with my receipt. The cashier rung me up immediately and refunded my money to my credit card. All in all I was in and out in 5 minutes. It would have been 5 stars if the first employee had refrained from making a snide comment only to realize it was misrepresented by a different location and it wasn't a random poor decision on my part.

I don't normally review corporate restaurants and when I do it's typically to rag on them .... Not this time. 

We came in for a late lunch and we're promptly created and seated.  Our waiter, John, was on the ball great ING us and making us feel welcome. He answered our questions about the menu.

First, we were served a Ceasars sale that was very fresh and tasty.  

Just as we were finishing our salads out entrees came out - very hot...almost too hot. 

Presentation was good and the food was tasty. Portions were a good size / my wife left some of her food, only because there was too much for her. 

So no complaints about the service or the food and the ambiance was very nice. Gavin old swing songs playing was also nice to listen to and different. 

Like I said, no complaints so no reason not to give it the full 5 star review

Great local taco joint. Burritos are legit as well. I had the California bowl with carnitas and guac. The beans are awesome and definitely cooked with some pork, as they should be. My friend had the biggest burrito I've ever seen in Tampa.

If the menu heading of "Global Tapas" makes you groan like it would for a lot of uptight foodies/hipsters that can't just enjoy some good food sometimes, then don't bother coming here. Otherwise, if you like some really tasty, satisfying food, then you will love your meal here like I did.

There are a ton of great choices here, consistently mostly of the aforementioned tapas and small plates for sharing. I usually prefer these kinds of menus since you get to try so many different things. The one drawback is that you often end up dropping way too much money to get enough food, but that was surprisingly not the case here - given the nice atmosphere, great service and the fact that it's a Stephen Starr restaurant, I expected to see my wife shake her head at me when the bill came, but we were both shocked in a good way that it came out so reasonable for the ton of food we got:

- Szechuan Shoestring Fries ($8)
This is the only time I've ever actually liked shoestring fries. Something about these was so great, I just could not stop eating them. I think it was that amazing sauce, which they slather over them a little bit, and also have on the side for extra dipping. Everyone here gets these, and you should too.

- Kung Pao Baby Back Ribs ($12.50)
Great twist on ribs, bringing a delicious combo of flavors with the peanuts, glaze and tender, buttery soft meat. 

- Korean Pork Tacos ($8.75)
These also packed a really great flavor. You get two generously-sized tacos filled a lot of delicious pork.

- Cheesesteak Eggroll ($13)
This is the most gimmicky, but best thing here, and you must get it. It has all the meaty, cheesy goodness you know and love from a cheesesteak, only here it's surrounded by a hot, crispy fried egg roll shell. This was definitely the best bite of the meal and is a really satisfying dish.

- Rad Na Thai Chicken ($12.50)
This is an enormous bowl of food, and we were beyond full by the time this came out. I still made a good dent in it though, because it was pretty tasty. It is a little deceiving though, as there is quite a bit of bulky cabbage taking up a lot of room in the bottom of the bowl. The very wide rice noodles on top though were excellent, and the chicken was delicious. This is a good choice, but note that it's way bigger than most other small plates.

- Liquid Chocolate Cake ($5)
This was a really excellent dessert. Along with an always delicious piece of hot, chocolate cake with a molten center of more chocolate, you get a great scoop of Salted Caramel Pretzel Ice Cream, which is a perfectly refreshing complement to the rich, sweet cake. This is a must to end the meal.

- Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup ($5)
This was pretty tasty too, but not as peanut buttery as I hoped. It still tastes good, but if you are a normal person and only get one dessert, I would go with the Liquid Chocolate Cake instead.

As mentioned above, the prices were very fair here. Most places I'm used to in NY with this type of atmosphere would charge nearly double for the same desserts. Service was also perfect and very attentive. I would definitely return here, or maybe visit the other location next time to try the rest of the excellent menu.

Why cant I ever get a correctly made order from this McDonald's? Even when there are no special requests. Always wrong or incomplete. Manager tries to apologize and offer explanations but I honestly feel quantity over quality here. I wish this wasn't my neighborhood Micky Ds..
One of my favorite places to eat. Beautiful atmosphere, incredible bread, and Cuban dishes as good as any I've had in Miami.

The burger was good. The meat was fresh and the buns had a good texture. The fries and onion rings not so much. It was very greasy. The frying oil might not be hot enough. It was $12 for a burger and fries. I'll probably try other places before coming back here

My girlfriend and I are currently getting 3 days of delicious plant-based meals delivered from Brooke weekly. Given our schedules, it is the most convenient way for us to eat clean and get food that is nutritionally aligned with our expectations. Everything is from the local farmers' markets and made to taste. It's excellent and she's great to work with.

I was happy when they switched to La Columbe coffee... but they still can't make a decent cup.  The food is overpriced.  Yucky egg and cheese croissant, the eggs were runny and it stunk like farts.  Pretty sure my grilled cheese sandwich was microwaved.  Why can't this place serve better quality food?

Disappointed.  Now, I know that this was the day of the Strange Folk Festival, but....  We stopped in right as they were opening up. It GOT busy, but it wasn't real busy when we got there.  They were running a limited menu, both food and drink.  Only beer and Margaritas, but no ciders offered.  Had a house Margarita, which was good, but would have preferred a Bloody Mary.  Ordered a side of Guacamole for our chips, but didn't get it until after we were done with our first basket of chips.  Had to ask a 2nd time, and it still took forever.  Finished off a 2nd basket of chips, and no ordered food in sight.  We finally got it, and if it would have been really outstanding in the taste department, all could have been forgiven, but...Cindy and I split a Fajitas meal and Kay had Enchiladas.  Kay said hers was really good, but our Fajitas were only okay.  Had to ask 3 times to get extra napkins.  Just NOT all that great.

Very unhappy with lasik plus! I had my surgery over ten years ago and it has faded over time to the point I was back to where I started. I was originally seen at the office in Tampa where I live but then "flipped" to another doctor in Clearwater whom I had never met.  Procedure went well and vision was great for many years, when it did begin to fade I was  not worried about it because I was told that I had a lifetime warranty by the doctor himself.  When I called a few months ago to schedule a redo, I was "tossed around" from person to person begging for someone to schedule an appt. after several weeks of waiting, I was persistent and asked for the office manager-she was on vacation.  Waited over a month and kept calling until someone finally "found my file".  This person informed me that I indeed DID NOT have a warranty on the procedure because my procedure was a "special".  I informed her that NO, my eyes had a special problem and they had to use their machine twice during my procedure and therefore  charged me double-not a special price-double.   Of course I was never allowed to speak with the doctor whom was the one whom told me I had a warranty for life, and was informed-like it or not-I would need to pay again FULL PRICE.  They treated me so rudely during this process that I would be nervous about having any procedure performed there again.  I am not a whiner so I wont go into boring detail of how they made me feel like a begger for trying to have my eyes touched up AFTER I paid them over $4000.  They made me feel as if I was asking for something for free that was not promised.  If you are looking for follow up care and go here, you better be an attorney and keep all your paperwork.  Good luck with trying to get a touchup appt-it wont happen and they will do their best to try to get out of helping you.   This is a money making racket that holds something very precious as a hostage-YOUR VISION. For not much money they could actually do more on the backend of patient care and actually not have people like me unhappy with them.

Workers were not wearing their masks correctly or just not wearing them at all. I've seen the guy that runs the desk at el taco. He has zero customer service skills. Pretty rude honestly. The food isn't really good.

If you like going out for breakfast you may like this restaurant .  Although it is a chain they have a wide selection of entries and the price value is great.  All the coffee your bladder can hold both before and during your meal.  The star of the menu is a make your own omelet and the biscuits and gravy shine brightly.  Prices are what you would expect and the decor  is nice.
I will definately visit again.

Had great success in the past but today ..I feel like I've bee had . 123$ plus only to get home to find out it was on my end . They replaced parts that where Good in my dryer.  Then rude when I called bad ... very unprofessional. Will never be back .and I would never send anyone there. Rude and not on the up and up.

I think I actually grew up with this movie theater (I moved far away, but returned while visiting some childhood friends). It's no longer the drab and shabby movie theater that we had our mothers to drive us to. It's.... AWESOME!

I cannot believe how great this movie theater is, and have yet to experience the luxuries offered here anywhere else. You can choose the seat you want for the movie and they assign it to you (no more having to worry about whether or not all your friends can sit together or not). The aisles are wide and getting to your seat is no hassle, since the rows are spaced so generously. No more asking people to tuck in their legs and belongings! The leather seats are so cushiony and THEY RECLINE ELECTRONICALLY. They're nicer than my car seats!! Or any other seat I have in my home for that matter.. But I seriously could lie down in them, lay on my side, sit up, put my knees up, and it is IMPOSSIBLE for the row behind you to kick at your seat. Love love love love the seats.

I haven't tried their food, but I saw that they offered sabras (or the like?) hummus and pita dippers. Yay for substitutes for overly buttery movie theater popcorn! 


I am in love with this place. I hope other theaters follow suit.
One of my favorite sandwich shops ever!!! I could eat this 7 days a week for lunch. Yuuuuuuuummmmmmm

A little disappointed with the service, burgers were excellent, but in my opinion, not really a smash burger, but still good and I'd be willing to give Baby's another go.

Service, once we had a waitress the service was excellent, and our food came out lightening fast, and hot, but I feel like we were seated in a section where our waitress was maybe on break or something because man, it felt like we sat at our table right next to the host stand completely unnoticed, for a really, really long time. And I'm OK with waiting for somebody to finish a break, just let me know, take our drink order, and just say something instead of nothing.

Again, burgers came out fast, fries were hot and awesome, and I'd definitely go back, I just think that...these burgers aren't so much smash burgers as they are thin burgers. Maybe my opinion of a smash burger is wrong, but I grew up in Chicago and I'm thinking Schoops is a smash burger. A thin patty, smashed to the point that it's crispy on the ends? Either way, slow start aside, I really did enjoy the food.

Not sure where all this good service and food was that other reviewers mentioned when we stopped by for lunch-but it wasn't there during our visit.
To be brief, we were part of the early lunch patrons-we arrived around noon and the restaurant was virtually empty.  After a fairly long wait, our waitress came by for our drink order.  I ordered a craft beer and after probably 15 minutes of it not being served, I asked the waitress where it was and her response was "Well, the bartender is pretty busy now."  From what I could see, he was busy chatting with the female waitstaff and not doing much of anything. Another 10 minutes and the beer was finally served.
A word about the beer--the beer was good but it was lukewarm, not a great experience.  Continuing about food/drink temperature-wife's soup had to be returned because it was cold.  My burger was also only warm and you could tell the beef patties had spent the better part of the morning under the heat lamp.  The fries were hot and crispy and we enjoyed them.
Bottom line evaluation-food average to below average, wait times-very long, waitstaff average, prices-maybe a little higher than other "American food" places, menu-lots of selections.
There are lots and lots of these mall eateries-recommend that you try them instead of this place.

I was invited here by friends last night, and really enjoyed it.

Our foursome ordered a ton of food (all delicious!) and several rounds of beer.  I recommend the curried popcorn and pea ravioli.

I started with a sampler of their 4 Belgian inspired beers before choosing my favorite - Palomino.  Others had Tiny Tim, Kinch, and Poor Yorick - all to favorable reviews.

Our server was terrific, the atmosphere cozy and friendly.  We had our growlers filled and left very, very happy!

Also, the upstairs bathroom is really, really neat.  This matters to me.

This isn't an area I make it out to often, but for this cute little spot, I may travel.

Had a great experience while shopping there. Even got a cupcake! Bought a super comfy grey oversize shirt that i could sleep in, wear over leggings, or skinny jeans. will definitely be shopping there again.

I stopped in here back in February of last year on the recommendation of a bartender at Brickie's Tavern who also worked here (Leanna I think). While sitting at the bar, she remembered me and announced my presence , and the fact that I've been coming to Reno from San Antonio every year for the last ten years. I wasn't expecting that, but it was a cool feeling just the same. Anyway I had a few bar-type conversations with some of the regulars. Incidentally, it was here that I was made aware of the Clamper organization, and that this establishment was one of that designation. The EVOC bit was completely new to me, as I had never heard of it. The bar itself is non-descript with nothing offered but a good time for whomever stops by. I do plan on stopping by on my next trip.
This is a very good place.  Service is extremely friendly, food is amazing, and the atmosphere is just right.  Highly recommended!

This is based solely on my experience last night... I went for a light night meal the open light was on lights in the restaurant were on but doors were locked. I understand we are in an unprecedented time but I'f the open light was off I wouldn't be updating my review.

had the seasonal smears, Amish chicken,hangar steak, bread pudding. service spot on- food was good but far from great; chicken was a bit dry, steak a bit undercooked- we took it all in perspective but it was hard not to compare to the French brasserie it once was- nice experience overall but were not compelled to come back soon.

We found this place thanks to rigorous research about veggie food in Nawlins'. This treasure is tucked away inside the historic French Market. Tummy, hot red lentils and rice with fresh orange juice was the perfect comfort food I needed before strapping up to explore the Quarter. This is a little stall, so you sit on limited chairs facing the counter .. and watch the fresh food come by slowly as you soak in the chatter that can only be New Orleans :)

Absolutely love this place! I've been a repeat customer several times now (I guess it also helps that I live right down the block), and don't have even a single complaint. Great food, great coffee, great staff, great prices, and complimentary cocktails??!? You just can't beat it, especially for the area!

Such a cute place near Washington University!!  I wish we had My Daddy's Cheesecake in Chicago!!  Where do I even begin??

OK - we went in for lunch and had:

Meatball sandwich:  Excellent - very moist meatballs - although I wish it had more of Gonnella type of french bread - but it was still excellent!

Roast beef sandwich - my son at it all - means it was YUM!

And another sandwich I can't remember - except that it was a chicken breast with an avocado spread - and my BF also finished it all.  Also YUM!

Each sandwich served with chips and a pickle.  

This place also serves breakfast items and, you guessed it - CHEESECAKE, as well as muffins, gooey butter cakes and cookies...and BOOZE!  I love the idea!  They have also have late hours, so you can come in, have a drink and dessert or a sandwich.  Awesome!

This review doesn't do My Daddy's justice.  Although the menu of non-sweets is not extensive, it's enough, in my opinion.  

We did not leave without getting dessert.  We bought several types of cheesecakes, and all were delicious!  I only wish I could have brought more home.  

Every member of the staff we dealt with was very friendly and patient because we made fools of ourselves as we drooled over the dessert cases.
Great drinking bar  the app aren't bad the beer and drinks are cold And tasted great   This is a place you have to stop in to   Walk all the way to the back bar

Boscos food is just, well...OK.  I've never had a day when I thought, you know, I'm really craving Boscos.  Their beer is really pretty good, especially the nut brown ale.  The service, atmosphere and location is the reason why I end up at Boscos.  Not a bad place to go for a beer or meal if you plan on going to The Belcourt.

A really nice room with a great atmosphere and food/service to match!

The genius chef that came up with the stuffed hash brown potatoes deserves an award. You have to try them. I've eaten there twice in the past two weeks and intend to go back soon.

So far I've had the lamb and the Shrimp & Crab Louie salad, both were stellar!

The service is top notch and better than the other steakhouses in Philly.

I've been back twice since my first time...three weeks ago and last night...and that's because Adrianne my server the first time works most Fridays and I wanted to have her serve me.  Adrianne not only is easy on the eyes but is very friendly professional and prompt and is a sweetheart...and if it isn't real busy like last night she'll take time to talk to you for a couple minutes.  
I didn't get much to eat because I ate before I got there..I got potato skins to go and they were good....the nacho platter I understand is huge...I'll have to try out the other food later....there are about 50 bottled beers and one is called Young's Dirty Dick (I'm serious).  There are lots of sports on TV including the baseball package and UFC. 
Back to the service....if you go to Fox & hound and if Adrianne is working please ask for her...and please tip her very well

PAWS took the "pet store" concept and turned it on its head... in a good way!  The downtown adoption center has rescued pets for adoption, not sale.   You can visit and play with the three rooms full of cats and a couple of friendly, goofy dogs.  They also carry a small but high-quality selection of pet supplies, and all the proceeds go to helping the animals.  The store is bright, clean, and cheerful.  Instead of buying a cat or dog (and supporting cruel puppy mills), adopt a shelter pet and save a life!

I love this place and I come whenever I'm in the area. The food is ok, mostly pub food (I eat before I come). But the atmosphere, wines, ciders and beers are fantastic. The outdoor deck is pet friendly and the band is usually great. I took the tour once and I learned a lot. The service is great, I always enjoy my visit and I highly recommend it!

COVID19 Quarantine Review (Pick Up);

I loved Denim at their Cherry Hill location, and was excited to dine with them again at their Haddonfield location. But with the craziness going on right now, I had to opt for take out. 

I ended up ordering a DIY burger kit and a DIY hot dog kit. Both were super affordable and provided everything you needed to enjoy the delicious hot dogs and Angus beef burgers. 

All of the ingredients were individually packaged, and super fresh. The burgers were some of the best I've had. 

Ordering can be done over the phone. In addition to these kits, they have a full menu and lots of cleaning / household supplies. Pick up is done curbside. 

If you're looking to try something different, give Denim a try!

Delicious, authentic and low key Mexican at this new place on 9th Street in the Italian Market area. Amazing homemade soup w meaty broth and chick peas!  Tacos are perfect!  Lovely waitstaff! We will come back. Thanks!

I was in town for business and after checking into my hotel, I searched for the closest BBQ place. I wasn't sure what I'd find at Hendricks but I was pleasantly surprised as I was driving through the neighborhood. I liked the small town feel. Since I was by myself, I had planned on taking it to go and eating at the hotel but after walking inside, I had to stay to enjoy the decor. Light bulbs in mason jars, flat screen TV's and an amazing lighted patio. Although the view is just a parking lot, it's too bad it wasn't closer to the river behind it or had something else to look at. 

I ordered pork steak (which I've never heard of before) and it was really good. It looked like a T-bone but was tender enough to be cut with a fork. For my sides, I chose collard greens and cole slaw. The cole slaw was awesome. I have a weird ritual where I always order the cole slaw at different places to see how they make it. This one is definitely in my top 5. The slaw was finely chopped and had ground pepper in it, which I love. I usually put black pepper in my slaw anyways but this one was perfect. Cold and with a kick. Collard greens with a bit of bacon in it was good too. If I had more time or with a group of friends, I'd definitely come back because everything looked comfortably country.

I wish we would have found this place on the first day of our vacation! 
We had dinner one night and the next morning went back for breakfast.
Our dinner portions were huge! My only complaint was our food came out way too fast. First soup, immediately followed by salad. We had only a few spoonfuls of soup when our salad was served. Before my soup was finished and salad had yet to be touched, our dinners arrived. 4 of us were seated in a booth so table space was limited. I held my salad in my hand while I ate it due to the limited space. When we finished our meal, the owner or manager (not sure which) offered us a shot of Ouzo. We raised our glass and said Opa! 
Breakfast was just as delicious as dinner. Ample portions and very friendly service. Prices for both meals were great. Dinner for 4 was about $100 and breakfast was around $40, well worth it!
If you check in you get a free beer or a sake! Love this place. Very quick, cheap, and good sushi

The chinese place I regularly order from was closed and Chopsticks was the only other place I could find within my area that delivers.  Wasn't expecting much because of the low reviews but ended up pretty satisfied.

Ordered sweet n sour chicken, Krab ragoons and  honey chicken wings. Everything was packed well in a brown paper bag and still hot when it arrived. The sweet n sour sauce was actually thick and not watery like most places and still warm. The chicken was made differently but ultimately liked it and hit the spot. Krab Ragoon, Chicken Wings and Egg Roll  were good too and what you would expect from a fast food chinese place.

This is the best steak I've ever had. I am a big fan of high end steakhouses and this is by far and away the best. The food, the service, the wine selection are all sensational and the shrimp cocktail is worth writing home about. I dine here every chance I am in town and agree that is is worthy of the praise it gets in the national media.

Walking in, I was excited to see how they turned the old place in to a nice restaurant. Decorations are simple industrial. The best part though, is the FOOD! We both ordered the White House Special. Meat, eggs, potatoes, bread, and added a Belgian waffle. It was all good. We went at noon on a rainy Saturday and got right in. The morning rush was slowing down and the service was top notch. Plenty of servers for the amount of people, and the management came by a few times to make sure everything was good. We will be back.

I've been here a few times, and needless to say, I was a little bleary/worse for wear & tear. (Steph D & Britt S can attest). Let's be honest, at my first SOBER time at La Margarita, I was extremely pleased with the outcome of the meal. 

First of all, pretty lady/OG blue haired badass Stephenie at the bar suggested mojito margaritas, which were on summer special for $6. All I can say is wow to those. Fresh muddled mint combined with margarita. 

I really like that LM gives you three salsas. We ordered the guacamole app, and while a little odd with the not smashed, but diced avocado situation, it was truly delicious especially topped with the green salsa from the chip basket. 

I had the three carne asada tacos. They were prepared well, juicy and seasoned nicely. I do have to say by this point I had eaten about 6 avocados so I was pretty full, struggling to find my inner Joey Chestnut, and eat these three tacos. The plate comes with this super rice and more guac. I managed to get through it, and could feel my food baby kicking by the time our server brought the check and I finished my second mojito marg. 

I loved La Margarita. All components including patio space, service, drinks, and food made me so happy that I could have taken a food induced coma nap.

If you like Cookie Butter and/or cinnamon you MUST have their Speculoos flavor, and add in a little salted caramel for some contrast.  It is freaking amazing on a hot day to have icy rolled ice cream.  It held up really well in the heat and was such a refreshing treat even after a big meal.  One bowl is enough to share, but next time I don't think I would :)

It is hypnotic and soothing just to watch them make each bowl. Yummm! Definitely best dessert I had in New Orleans!

Got a 4 cheese grilled cheese for lunch. The cheese was good and so was the bread. But it was NOT grilled.  The bread was soft and slightly warm. The cheese was melted but the bread wasn't even toasted, let alone grilled.  It appears the bread was microwaved to melt the cheese.  A big fail.

Under new management,  went had a great breakfast, waiters was very nice and food was great.  It was very quick.  

Hope to see some of y'all there if I'm in the area again.  Thanks to David and the other workers for making it feel like home
Tourist trap!!! Go to Phillips on Passyunk ave!!!

Came here late at night while visiting a friend in St. Louis.  I'm really glad they were open until 1am.  I think we got there a little around midnight and we were starving.

The separated menus gave me a bit of a puzzle, because what was supposed to be the tiny insert for the ice cream/shakes/desserts ended up being a tiny version of the burger menu.  I spent a while looking for it before I figured out I just didn't have what I was looking for!  I borrowed one from my husband but decided I wanted to go with something alcoholic instead.

I ordered the Buzzed burger (rubbed with espresso, topped with apples, diced onions and blue cheese)--medium, small fries with the wasabi ketchup, and the Bermuda cocktail.  My friend ordered onion rings to split between the three of us.

The onion rings were good. They had this smokiness to them that reminded me of cookouts over a campfire.

My burger seemed to be more medium-rare, but still amazing.  The flavors all worked amazingly well together.  I wasabi ketchup was good, but I ended up liking the rooster sauce my friend ordered even more.

Before we left my friend ordered a large shake of salted caramel and chocolate--per my suggestion.  It ended up being more salted caramel than chocolate (maybe there's a better chocolate flavor option?) but yummy none the less.

I'd certainly go back there!

Outdoor seating is very COVID-19 friendly. I ordered the house cocktail #31 - Wheatley vodka, blackberry, Thai basil, agave- the best cocktail I have ever had. Kyle is an amazing waiter!!! I ordered the French dip with asparagus on the side. So good. Service was good. Food was great. Love the outdoor space. Happy hour had some good drink specials. Will definitely come back.

I've tried this salon about 5 times and think this one will be my last. Last time I went I had Van. First during the pedicure I was burned twice to where my legs were bright red afterwards. During the manicure I was cut multiple times, the polish was messed up on my nails, was on my fingers, and there was still multiple imperfections around the nail. When brought to his attention he said it was fine and did not fix them. The next morning they were already chipping and my nail beds are red and swollen. It honestly looks like I could've painted the nails myself. When you're spending basically $40 for a treatment it should at least be relaxing. I have had a few other problems when I've gone to this salon before but this is by far the worst.

FIVE STAR FABULOUS ALL THE WAY!!!!  Really shocked this place doesn't have a thousand 5-star reviews!!!!  REALLY SHOCKED & COMPLETELY FLOORED!!!!  I had the best experience here.  From the 5-star food-a small caesar salad is huge & delizioso & the chicken parm was TDF; to the incredible service.  Couldn't have asked for a better meal or overall experience.  Also thanks to Bob & Sue for making the experience even better, incredible, in fact, and thanx so much for the wonderful wine, your generosity is unrivaled!!!!  Luv u guys!!!!  If you haven't tried Abruzzo, all I can say is "What are you waiting for?". You don't know what you're missing.
Wonderful restaurant! I really enjoyed the spicy gyros, very flavorful. Neat and clean restaurant with good service
Very slow, didn't have the breakfast sandwich I want either. I'll stick to PJS

Went in with a friend who recommended it as a good place for a drink.  The atmosphere was good but it stopped there.  Bartender (whose name I didn't get) was not a friendly guy and kept calling me 'Miss'.  I'm old enough to be his mother and calling me Miss is so disrespectful.  Hated it.   However I would have dealt with him had the drinks been good but that didn't happen.  Ordered a Patron Margarita on the rocks.  What I got tasted like fruit juice.  It wasn't bad but could not tell there was tequila in it.  So next time I ordered a double from another guy since I couldn't get the first guys attention .  He brings me a drink that tasted exactly like the first.  I call guy number one over and tell him the drink is exactly like the first.  He looks at me, starts walking away as he says "I am quite sure that is a double Miss".  Walks away and that's it.  So they either water down their liquor or have no idea how to make a drink.  Also the bill was over $50 for 3 drinks I couldn't even say I actually had.  Wil not be back.

I will definitely be going here again!!! The food was AMAZING and the service was AWESOME. We arrived for lunch around 2:15 and picked our own place to sit. Our server, Jorge, quickly came to greet us and take out beverage order. We ordered our food (chicken teriyaki and steak teriyaki "lunch boxes"). It was made super fresh and in front of us within 10 minutes. I cleared my plate! It was awesome. You get quite a lot for your money ($10 for my chicken teriyaki lunch box). Jorge made sure to check on us and see how the food was. We didn't realize they close at 3 and open back up at 5 for dinner so when 3:15 came around, we felt bad but never did they rush us! In fact, they had a conversation with us about the food and were super friendly. I look forward to going back very soon! The location is awesome as well. It's a "fancier" restaurant but you can also go in for a quick bite! I highly recommend this place. I'm picky about food and this restaurant definitely did well!

We went to a pig roast with second shift and salt + smoke catered.  We are looking at salt + smoke for my daughters wedding and thought this would be a great way to see the catering side. We were impressed with food. It was a pig roast (we will not do this wedding - 1st time daughter went to a pig roast she became a vegetarian for 7 years)
The food was served hot, fresh and great seasonings on everything. The staff stayed on top of everything and the large crowd seemed very happy
We have tried sat + smoke on the loop and liked ur, especially the large selection of bourbons   A bourbon lovers dream!!!!

6am, New Orleans Airport. I basically want to die because I spent the previous day, until 2am, partying at my cousin's wedding (which, btw, included complimentary hurricanes). I am still wearing last night's crazy professionally done make up, and the schelacked curls in my hair are finally coming amiss (all of this complimented of course by my pajamas - a cut-up Yelp NYC t shirt and yoga pants - sexxxy!). For some reason, I feel like it's an AWESOME idea to eat some grits and a biscuit from the Creole fast food joint in the American Airlines terminal. 

I waddle around, full of Creole mish-mash,  my blistered feet (so much dancing, such high heels!) hating every moment, hoping for respite from my hungover woes. Instead, I get snagged somewhat impolitely out of the boarding group three line to be informed that my seat has been changed. Whatever happened to Southern hospitality?! My seat was actually better, closer to the front and no one directly next to me, so I don't know what the fuss was about. Geez, guys, way to interupt a girl's no-sleep hangover.

But all in all, this airport is clean, neaty organized, and efficient. My flights to and from were on time, and the bathrooms were nice. I think I'm just cranky from too many hurricanes. I'm such a cliche!

Hey alright! My first time here and I will come back. Jack B took my order very pleasant asked me if ninjas ever been here before could he recommend anything. I had looked over the menu got the Cinco burger fries and a Coke. The burger was very tasty nice flavor with the toppings and I really liked the fries. Hey it's what a lunch should be all about and I liked it just fine!

We used PackRat for moving our household belongs during our recent move from MA to FL.

The Good
- The pods were delivered intact.
- The pods were picked up in a timely manner and on schedule.
- The drivers were generally professional and skilled.
- It was easy to get a quote and schedule a pod delivery.

The Bad
- The delivery of the empty pod was delayed by about a day and a half. We were on a tight schedule to get out of our house and this threw a major wrench in our plans. It took us about a week to fully recover our schedule, and probably two to recover the lost sleep from late nights and an all-nighter to adjust for the delayed delivery.
- The delivery of the full pod was delayed by four days. We had much less time pressure on this side of the move, but this still was very inconvenient for us.
- The communication was almost non-existent. We called about half a dozen times the day the pod was supposed to arrive, and were told that the pod would be there that day. By 8 PM, they were still saying it would arrive that day, but that if it didn't it would arrive first thing the next morning. After it didn't arrive in the morning, we called again, and they had no new information. We were eventually told that it would arrive no later than 4 PM. The pod finally arrived at 5:15 PM or so.

The Ugly
- We were charged an additional ~$300 on top of the quoted amount. Customer service said that it was for renting the pod, but this charge was not mentioned, never showed up in our quote, and still does not appear in our online PackRat account.
- Customer service ghosted us after we requested that this additional charge be reviewed. We haven't heard from them in two weeks after being told they would look into it further.

The problems we've described may be common in the industry-- we've seen similar reviews for other services. Just be aware that PackRat may disrupt your tight schedule, may charge you hundreds more than they quote you, and will likely be difficult to communicate with throughout the process-- especially if they've already gotten your money.

This is a cool coffee  spot. It reminds me of a better much comfortable Khaldi's. I had the Peachee Keen smoothie. This smooth was delicious. It was so good that drank a 20oz serving, in the midst of a conversation, 7 min which is very fast for me. I love to take my time and savor my food and drink.

This is my home zoo.  I absolutely love it.  The only reason I don't give it five stars is because they don't have a whole lot of animals.  The animals that they do have are taken care of very well and their habitats are big and beautiful.  This zoo is maintained wonderfully and the staff is always friendly.  Some people claim that the animals are so far apart, but this allows the animals to have more space and also helps the zoo feel less crowded.  

Pack your lunch and you'll save some money.  The Nashville Zoo is a beautiful, clean and fun zoo.

Well, since my husband and I technically didn't have a FULL meal here, I can only offer a partial review.

We came here for an after-dinner drink and dessert on a Friday night.  I was surprised at how empty the place was at 8:00PM.  But again, it was the July 4th holiday weekend so I will just assume that was the cause for the lack of clientele.

Anyway, the exterior kind of reminded me of a cross between a vintage garage and a Krispy Kreme doughnuts outlet (must be the green and white color scheme.)  There are some cool props in the front for tourist photos.  

The decor on the inside is even more fun.  There are upside down race cars suspended from the ceilings.  Automotive paraphernalia all over the walls.  The hostess stand is modeled to look like the front portion of a classic Ford Mustang.  There was even a motorcycle just inside the entrance near the gumball and claw machines that are sure to attract the young ones.

We sat at the bar and had a couple of glass of merlot.  We also order the apple pie nachos for dessert.  We got a large plate that held several scroops of vanilla ice cream, large cinnamon coated tortilla wedges, apple pie filling and caramel sauce.  Once the ice cream melted, the dish looked messy and unappetizing.  However, it WAS tasty.  On a scale of 1 to 10, I'd give it a 7.

I'd love to come back and try their wings as they seem to have a very wide variety of sauces.  Unfortunately, despite this being part of a large national chain, there is only this one location in the entire state of Florida at the moment so I will have to wait until we return to the Clearwater area.

This place is awesome! 
Ice cream, Donuts, and coffee!!!
They gave us a sample of a powdered sugar donut that was delicious. 
We ordered two double scoops that came to about 11 bucks! 

Such a great experience, super nice staff. I recommend passing by the chain ice cream store to get a cone from this place.
Great food, drinks, service and atmosphere. Loved the smashed avocado on crusty toast and the immunity booster drink (beets, turmeric, ginger & so on) and our server was wonderful.
Food is awful. Expensive for what you get.  We had a small service dog with us and were forced to eat outside out of Styrofoam dishes.  Can't say enough bad things about this place.
Great little sandwich place with fresh sandwiches and soups. It's a good option if you need to escape from bbq/heavy food for a bit.

They are managing covid very well. I called in an order for diner, told them what time I would be there and the food was ready when I got there. It was still hot by the time I got it home and on the table. Thank you for going above and beyond during this crazy time.

This is my go to place, to bring friends from out of town.  
This is where the locals go to enjoy very reasonable New Orleans cuisine, listen to some outrageous music and to just be in a neat little place where everyone is friendly.

Friend and I went to dinner on a Saturday night.
The place was packed, the music was rockin', people were booty shakin' near their table..  Band members walked around the room, playing their guitars..

The food is amazing.. So fresh, so good, so well seasoned, so reasonable..
Found myself conversing with other diners about the taste of the homemade peanut butter pie, or the beignets.  Blackened catfish, fried okra, gator bites, gumbo, muffulettas..  

This is where you bring your friends for a great night out, and it won't break the bank.  Told my friends, "We need to come here more often."

Great place for a date.
Great place to bring out of town friends.
Great place to feel the flavor of happy diners.

Everyone around me mentioned they are regulars.
So they have quite a following

We will be back. No doubt about it.

After living nearby for the last 18 months, finally got around to visiting Spiro's. The food and service were both excellent. As has been pointed out by others, the decor is a little dated but the reasonable prices more than make up for it. I had the rack of lamb and my wife the stuffed fillet. Both were cooked precisely as requested and were delicious. We will definitely be coming back!

For years, I was a vocal advocate of Tucson Tamale. The food was fresh and delicious, with tons of variety and was a good value to boot. I both loved getting fresh tamales in the store to eat right there and to take home the frozen packs. But over the past year or so, everything has gone downhill.

Where one tamale and a side used to be the perfect lunch, now two tamales barely does the job - they have dwindled considerably in size. The ingredients don't taste as fresh, and you can rarely get freshly made ones in the store anymore, it's mostly reheated. Not to mention that the cost has skyrocketed; a two pack is nearly seven dollars now.

I also want to note that this was a particular favorite for me and a good friend as we both are gluten-free. We always used to be able to count on getting a meal that didn't make either of us sick. Unfortunately, with the addition of a number of gluten items to the menu, that is no longer the case. We ate at the Oracle location this week and both felt horrible afterwards. So it's no longer a gluten-free friendly spot.

I have been going here for many years. I will not go anywhere else! 
A perfect cut and it's quick and cheap! This is mom and pop through and through! You can hear the kids playing games in the back room. 
It is beautiful with real plant vines trailing through the building! 
My friend would go in and get the guys package with a hot shave and neck massage true old time style barber for the gentlemen! 
For the ladies a simple nothing fancy amazing hair cut with out the chemical burn smell of most salons!

Used to go there alot now know how outsiders felt. Took forever to get a drink. Many people walked up after my wife and I and we're served prior to us. I guess sucks to not be a friend of the bartenders.

My husband and I love Mungo's!  We live south of Belleville, but it's always worth the trip.  The Mungo's salad is always cold and yummy.  I love the chicken brochettes since I'm always trying to eat light and it's so good!  The bread is even special.  The food and service at Mungo's are consistently wonderful.  The "other" place doesn't compare:)

This is a fantastic restaurant. You need to check it out. The food is so fresh tasting and not greasy. They don't dump soy sauce all over the fried rice either. 

Their service is fantastic and the food comes out so fast!  The restaurant has a nice ambiance and is more upscale than most Chinese food places.

Worked with Stacy and Ed, service they provided was exactly what was quoted. Very clean operation from start to finish.
I would highly recommend them for chimney cleaning and service.

Bella's is such a divine gem of a restaurant. I just love this place! The food is AMAZING ...like every single thing is just so darn good and they have plenty of vegetarian options which is such a plus for me! It's also the closest place to authentic Italian food you'll find in Nashville or just awesome pizza if that's what you're looking for. 

The owner is from Italy himself, his partner runs the show and they do a great job! The staff is always super nice and the ambiance is always perfect.  I will keep coming back, bringing friends who visit, or just order out on a rainy day. The outside seating is precious and can also feel like you're not in Nashville, but maybe somewhere in Italy because of the little village it's located in. I highly recommend this place for great food and a lovely time :)

The concierge who was off of her post, showed up after we stood at the desk for 5 minutes, her shirt was untucked and she was unapologetic about her absence. I signed up for a deluxe King room, the room was not available, the same concierge did not care about the booking of my room to someone else. I ended up getting a room by the 2nd floor elevator...what's worse of all is that the toilet was having issues flushing throughout the night, it flushed sometimes and sometimes it didn't...Eek!!! I know. I expected more and didn't get that. Try the Sheraton instead.

One of the worst customer service experiences. The people at this location are nice when you buy/rental an item. When it come to anything else (incorrect billing) they are apathetic and combative. They are now owned by Linncare which in 2017 paid $20millions for medical fraud. Do not trust this place of business. 

https://www.bna.com/lincare-settles-oxygen-n73014461205/?amp=true

Do not trust the post below. From Medical West it is a great example of the type of service you can get.

This is a fun location, their country store is moderately big and lots of choices! I have been here a few times, I like the orchards for picking never had a long wait time (guess I just showed up at the right times) I haven't been to the other locations but this is a lot of fun to do for an outing with family (Word of the Wise: make sure you call ahead and see what is being picked)

This place is garbage!!!!!  They are rubber band cars with lengthy price tags! They don't fix anything on the car when you bring it back for repairs even when under a warranty. How they are still in business is beyond me. The car I bought from then has been just that: a headache. Not to mention how they blame you for anything wrong with the car and take no ownership for their wrongdoings. Glad they don't have a BBB accreditation!

I like this place quite a bit, the staff, for the most part, cares about customers and beer. The decor of the place is rustic and quaint. The beer selection is good, but the facilities could be better. The parking is a small dirt lot south of the location and on the street, be mindful of when parking enforcement is out. As far as I know there is only one restroom. The other location is laid out better and has more amenities, but if you're in the area and looking for a great beer bar stop here.

All right here we go, I have been to this location many times and for the most part it has always been satisfactory except for one time prior and the manager was so wonderful that she actually delivered the replacement pizza herself. This time unfortunately they fell very short in customer service and quality of the product. I had ordered a thin crust medium  chicken, extra cheese, mushrooms, black olives and red onion, only to find a scantily topped dry piece of cardboard. The second pizza we ordered was also a medium pan crust pepperoni with jalapeño, it turned out just OK. Now the worst part here is we walked in with $100 bill not realizing they were not able to break it. OK, that's totally acceptable however the young man behind the counter with what my son refers to as a neck beard was extremely rude sending him out to shop for change. I can deal with that however his attitude I cannot. After going to several stores to break the $100 bill and having to purchase items we really did not need in order to have the 20.00+ in change, upon returning to the store this same young man behind the counter was even more ridiculously rude than he was the first time. We told him that we had to go to several stores to make change just to pay for the order and his comment was, "oh well, and"? Luckily my son was in a decent mood or he would've snatched him up from behind the counter, he has zero tolerance for anybody that is disrespectful to his disabled mother. So thus far, we have subpar pizza that was non inclusive of toppings I had paid for and extremely poor customer service. I don't know what's happened to this store as in the past it was really pretty good, whether it's a change in management or if it's a franchise, I'm not quite sure. Corporate needs to be made aware of their lack of professionalism and poor performance as far as food preparation. I do plan on posting this to my blog.
Lobster tail was overcooked, and the service was terrible. Truffle Mac was dry and the potatoes were undercooked! I was excited to try this place, but I was not impressed.

There are many reps that I interacted with at this location that I really liked and were very helpful. Unfortunately this location has a really horrible female manager  (dark hair, dont know her name) and a really bad history of overcharging their customers for damages. 

I was renting a car from this location for over six MONTHS so I had spent a considerable amount of money with them. One day I went in to renew my rental agreement, and the lady I mentioned above treated me like a criminal. 

She said I was over 1 WEEK late renewing my agreement and I was at risk of having the car repossessed etc. I laughed and said, "I just in this office last week, and spoke to YOU, and no one said anyting to me about being late"....She had no response. 

So in the end, she said they could not rent a car to me anymore, and sent me home on a Friday evening with no vehicle. Needless to say I was very angry. I went to Hertz and got treated like an adult and had a really good experience. 

I recommend to everyone to NOT use this Enterprise location, and go to Hertz, much better experience. 

Then to top it all off, I get a bill in the mail saying I owe Enterprise 275 bucks for damage. Not once while I was in there office did any representative ask me to pay this bill, explain to me what it was for, or offer to help. 

When speaking to friends, many people have experienced similar things renting from Enterprise, PHANTOM charges for damages. Very bad experience, very poor treatment of their customers, and very shady business practices. 

Go somewhere else! 

Sincerely, 
Brian Kopp

I purchased a couch for our new home. Noticed a spring popped out the bottom when it was assembled together. We reported it the next week and was told we had to be without a couch for 3 days. I was told that this was a factory defect, instead of providing us with a new couch I experienced rude costumer support and who is to say this would not happen again. I recommend everyone checking their furniture before hand because if you do not report it with the "three day turn around" you will not receive great assistance.
The Chicken Maroosh maybe the greatest sandwich i've ever had....in my life.

We stopped in for happy hour and appetizers. We ordered the Irish nachos, the charcuterie board, and some wine. It was all delicious and the Irish nachos were by far our favorite thing!!!!

We used to come here when it was called SoDo and we always loved the food so we were apprehensive and nervous that maybe it wouldn't be the same. Turns out it was just as good if not better!

Kat is our favorite person there so we always try to go when she's working. She's very knowledgeable about food and wine pairings and she also knows our palettes well so she always tell us what we would enjoy the most. 

Can't wait to explore more of the menu!

Great fresh donuts!!
You must try the glazed croissants :)
Support local businesses 
They have full selection of drinks and coffee
As well enjoy

Do not leave this place without getting the massaman curry.

Every time I go with family and or friends I order it, and have them try it and they are hooked for life.

I've eaten at Thai restaurants in multiple cities around the world, and I always come back to their massaman curry. Yum savory yum!

My friends and I frequently dine at Farmacia, about 3 times a week because it is a block away from where we're living. We dine there so frequently because one of us is a vegan and the other(s) omnivore. To their credit, they are very accommodating to special requests, such as having a meal of sides, for example. Generally, the service is pretty good.  The last time we dined there was for a party of four. One observation that might be helpful: the quality of the food/service decreases as a function of how busy it is, meaning if you go there when they're not packed then you're likely to get a pretty good meal.  The only negative thing I could say about that meal is I ordered an extra side of broccoli rabe and it was served in some kind of butter/beef stock. If you order items and you're vegetarian/vegan, you need to be explicit about it, even if you're just ordering vegetables.  

In summary, Farmacia is A-ok with me.
