I really wanted to like this place. I wanted a quick appointment for a blow out for a holiday party. I went 15 minutes earlier than my appointment and was seated immediately! However when I was introduced to my stylist, she was less than friendly and not very talkative - which is fine usually I don't tend to talk during hair appointments, but I expected a little bit more talking about what I wanted. She was semi rude & didn't offer me anything to drink, which I thought was strange. I also wasn't given a chance to look at my hair which I thought was strange. I was rushed out of there. To be honest, I STILL don't know what my hair looks like because I'm writing this in the cab home. 

That being said, I don't want to knock this place because watching the other stylists, they are very good at what they do. I'm sure my hair looks fine & I'll most likely return if I'm in need of a blowout - I just hope I don't get the same stylist!!

I know we said in our last review that we would not be going back to this place... In a moment of weakness, we gave them another chance. When I showed up to pick up our order 20 minutes after placing it, the girl at the register looked at me like I had 3 heads. They forgot our order. If I hadn't showed up, they would have never made it. I told them not to bother. For real, never stepping foot in this establishment again.

Great cheese steaks and fries made to-order, get it made anyway you want and with any of the toppings you want. You really can't go wrong. And while the place is known for the cheese steaks, the real treat is breakfast.  Everything is made fresh on the grills, out for everyone to see. The decision to eat here is always an easy one to make.

I have had outstanding customer service support. When I call in for an issue or to purchase they are always patient and deliver for me. Special Kudos to Anna for help this week and Darlene for help earlier in the year.

Five Star Flooring is the complete experience. I bought a house in Carson that needed a lot of work. 
To start, it needed a mini face lift. New kitchen counters and flooring would really help. Since I couldn't move right in and I literately knew nobody in town, I searched all possibilities on the Net. 

It was then, that I was drawn to Five Star Flooring.
I talked to David, who arranged for my Luxury Vinyl 
Tile to be installed before I moved in. He also introduced me to his designer, Edwin, who helped me choose my floor color and granite. I couldn't move in right away, so they made sure the installation would be in before I moved in.

I can't say enough about this company. They were
so accommodating to my every wish and need. In this day, it's so hard to find great customer service.
These guys show great craftsmanship, as well as, putting the customer first. I'm so happy with the results and have to say you would be crazy not to
hire this company for your home improvement needs.

Now, if they could only help me unpack!
The pumpkin pancakes were pretty good but I would have liked more pumpkin spices. The hash browns were overcooked on the bottom. The coffee was fresh, hot and bottomless.

I'd give this place a 3.5 stars if possible. Not quite a 4 but not a 3 either.

My friend and I came for lunch. We love trying new sushi places so we decided to come here. It took us a while to decide what rolls to get. There weren't very many options compared to some other places around SB so that was kind of disappointing. Eventually we ordered:

007 roll: we subbed the shrimp for salmon and it was so good! Avocado, salmon, and cream cheese inside. I'm normally not a cream cheese sushi person but this one hit the spot today.

Chefs special: spicy tuna and shrimp tempura inside, topped with salmon and special sauce (I want to say it's some sort of miso sauce and teriyaki sauce). I enjoyed this roll as well. My friend didn't like that it was pretty covered in sauce, but I thought the sauce coverage was fine.

If you check in on Yelp you get free edamame (which is normally like $5-6 sheesh it's just edamame lol). The server wouldn't let us use both of our Yelp offers, which I guess is expected.

This place is a little pricey compared to some of the other places we've been to, but the quality was decent. I'd come here again I guess if I want some free edamame and I'm not feeling adventurous with my sushi, but if I want more variety I'd hit up a different place.

It was probably the least offensive bagel I had while in Purgatory (I grew up in NYC, so bagels were an every other day food), but I stopped going because the service was so surly. If I said ANYTHING other than placing my order & saying maybe "thank you" or "have a nice day", they acted as if I was truly imposing. Who needs that? You don't have to be my best friend, but don't treat me with disgust just for breathing.
The fruits and produce are some of the freshest in the area. They also have really good fruit pies.
I'm an older woman and the people at RMA are so professional and personable at the same time. They are so nice when answering your questions and following up with you. Top notch staff.

Mmmmm! I must say I felt very out of place here. like We didn't belong.. Staff was very unwelcoming, No smiles or greetings just a lot of staring. Myself and my son felt so uncomfortable we decided to take our yogurt which was pretty basic and Gooooo. I hope it wasn't because we're #africanamerican   Yup #welikeyogurttoo I would never go back #unprofessional
An honest mechanic who does great work and goes out of his way for his customers.   Lucky to have him in our neighborhood!

I was promised my shoes on a Tuesday.  I went and he was closed.  So I went back the next day and he was closed again.  I called the number and it went straight to voice mail.  I hung up before I left a message so I redialed to do so and the owner, Rick, picked up the phone and proceeded to yell at me!  I could not get a word in edgewise it seemed.  He told me that I was a selfish b*tch b/c I thought about my shoes more than his dying dog (I hadn't known anything about this until he mentioned it right at that moment) and just berated me before hanging up on me.  He then proceeded to text me and told me that his dog was more important than my shoes and I should be ashamed for being so selfish.  Oh, and that he was his own boss so he could make his own hours and come and go as he pleases.  I still have that text message btw.  He mentioned that if I wanted my shoes that I should text him a description of them and my address and he'd mail them to me so I didn't have to go back.  Oh, and he also resent the text where he berated me again.  I knew I had to play nice in order to get my shoes so I replied back politely a few times before promising to come at lunch the next day to get my shoes.  I'm sorry but I do not know who he is,  beyond that phone call/text message, and therefore was NOT about to send him my address.  When I went back I was able to get my shoes and this man didn't even remember that I was the one he was yelling at!  I talked to a co-worker of mine who said he mentioned having a sick/dying family member when she went and I also read where he said something similar to someone else.  I'm not saying none of this is true but if it is, man he has bad luck.  Regardless though, you don't talk to folks like that as small businesses use word of mouth.  If I hadn't already paid I might have replied in a different manner or never replied at all but I had paid and I wanted my shoes.  I am very sorry if his dog really is/was sick but again, does not excuse  being so rude to a paying customer.  And it was a bit scary because no one has treated me like that.  I have now informed my whole office of this incident and one of my co-workers, who had gone there before, now refuses to go there.

I came here and tried the jerk salmon and cane juice first. I. Was. Hooked. It was amazingly delicious, juicy, and tender. The cane juice was out of this world! 
Mama is real nice, and when it comes to meat, I only eat halal so i went to ask her if she'll make me chicken if I brought her my own. She looked at me and showed me where she gets chicken from. She gets halal chicken!!! So I tried her chicken then and I felt like I hadn't had chicken before eating hers!!  It was really delicious!
The vibe is on point, the attitude is on point, the service is on point, and the food defines the point. Mmm so good!!!
Comfortable, beautiful rooms. Wonderful bathrooms. AMAZING food. Completely gorgeous pool area!!!

The service is slow BUT since everything is made from scratch it needs to be!
The flavors were amazing. My tongue is still celebrating all the different experiences. 
Serving sizes were very generous. 
I suggest the cassava cake for dessert.

Great food, location, interior decor, comfort, ambience and service. We shared a lot of the plates on the menu between us and everything was great including the specials. Between us we had a mixture of cocktails, beer and wine and all enjoyed our drinks. We had a late seating at 9.30pm and missed out on the Bao and Noodles which was disappointing but everything else we ate was delicious. We were still at our table close to midnight after everyone had left and staff had started to pack away - we didn't want to leave!
Best pulled pork sandwich I've ever had.  This is the type of place that would show up on DDD in its first season.  When the places all made your mouth water just watching the show.

First time client.... I just moved to the suburbs went to the same salon in the city for years so I needed to find a new spot. Let me tell you this place did not disappoint. It was clean, the staff is friendly, relaxing and I felt super safe there in the midst of all the covid craziness. I got a mani and pedi, the mani was great but the pedi was AMAZING. I am 7 months pregnant and the massage that went along with the pedicure was exactly what I needed. I felt so relaxed upon leaving... safe to say I will definitely be returning real soon. Thanks so much!
One of my favorite place in tampa to get flaked ice with fruit. Comfy couch seating, friendly staffs, and big varieties of drinks. Boba tea, smoothies, and coffee
Best steak fajitas I've ever had! Brought corn tortillas on request, perfect service, great chips and salsa. Highly recommended!

I recently attending a 4 year old birthday party at My Gym in Brentwood, TN, and I was blown away by the facility and the experience. Steven (employee) led the party and had an amazing amount of energy and understanding of children. He remembered EACH CHILD'S NAME - all 20 of them, even though he had just met all of them. My son is shy in new situations. Steven came up to him and very gently brought him into the party. He helped him get comfortable - while also keeping the energy of the party high (seriously - I have no idea how he did it!). He also was keen enough to note when some of the kids were hesitant to jump around or do an activity and zeroed in on them and gave them special care. 

The party was high energy and special attention was paid to the birthday boy! It was simply a wonderful experience. 

I was so impressed, I am now planning to book the venue (AND STEVEN!) for my son's 4th birthday.
If you can survive the front desk person, (bring garlic and a sharp object) you will be better for it-
It is a fairly nice outdoor mall. A variety of stores, but JCPenny and Dicks are the only anchors. It's an enjoyable place to kill time and shop.

This is the perfect addition to the Overland area! great service, good coffee, and a pleasant atmosphere! It's even better that it's walkable from my house! ive had the Carmel macchiato and and iced almond milk latte and both were great! can't wait to try the food! You've got a loyal customer here!

As a board director for the Nevada State Apartment Association, part of my involvement includes helping to organize an annual Apartment industry awards event for the Northern Nevada apartment industry.  

The theme of the event this year was "Magic Under the Stars".  Naturally we wanted to have a magician at the event to entertain prior to the award ceremony.  

I had seen and met Justin at networking events.  Later I was able to attend a show he did at his magic shop along with some other great magicians including a young magician named Ace. That show was wonderful so we decided that we would talk to him about providing entertainment at our event.

We spoke with Justin about several options with different magic show options, shorter and longer times to cover, roaming magic, a stage show etc.  we eventually settled on an hour of roaming magic tricks during our cocktail hour along with a 15 minute magic show to transition us into the seating and award portion of our event. There were a few options that he was able to customize for our budget.

Justin wasn't going to be available the night of our event and I had been very impressed with Ace at the show I was able to see at the magic shop so we requested that he appear instead.

As with many events we had some slight changes in our scheduling and some things ran slightly behind to get everyone into their seats.  Even though I know Ace had other plans for the later in the evening he very graciously offered to accommodate us and stay a little longer. He didn't seem like he was in a hurry to get out of there and was very helpful. He also asked if there were any guests that we would like him to focus on as far as bringing them onstage for magic tricks. We did have two young ladies that we had wanted to pay special attention to that evening even before they offered this option. This solved that challenge perfectly for us.  

Ace walked around the cocktail hour performing tricks in small groups with people who were drinking cocktails, providing great entertainment while people arrived and were networking. He then went in front of the group and performed a short 15 minute magic show that included our two chosen focus guests. 

The attendees that I spoke to were all very impressed with Ace, his roaming magic tricks and magic show. It was a fun addition to our event. I'm very happy with our choice to add this extra touch.

Overall I would highly recommend Justin, Ace or anyone on the team to provide wonderful entertainment at your next party or event.  They were easy to work with and Justin got back to us quickly with all of our questions and was very easy to work with setting the event up

If you're into organic soaps or you collect rubber ducks, this will be the place for you. It's small, but there is a large selection and the aroma when you walk in is heavenly. Workers are very friendly and always have a smile on their face. Prices are on the high side, but not terrible.

Bobbie's has been sitting closed for winter on my way to work for the last two months. It's a real tease. Sitting there, taunting me, reminding me of the good times and tasty meals. This place opens up again at the beginning of March and you can bet your bottom I'll be in line. 

I don't know what they call them, but their "blizzard" is the best thing I've ever had. They're cheap, they're big and their ice cream is so much tastier than anything I've had anywhere else. I can actually walk here from my house, which is bad, because I often justify a tasty treat late at night. I can't wait til they reopen!

I had the pleasure of working here for almost 5 years and I can say that this family has the BEST small business in New Jersey. Everything is high quality and they take immense pride in everything they do (for good reason)! Their customer service is absolutely unbelievable and the product quality is just as amazing.

My up-close-and-personal experience with the Melonis and their business has been one of the best things that ever happened to me and I 10/10 recommend them to anyone! If there were more than 5 stars, they'd be getting all of them!
I have been going to Pancho's since I was 4, it's delicious every time! I love the way they treat the consumers and the food is just incredible! If you go you  won't be disappointed!

I heard this business advertised on the radio while I was having an MRI. I was impressed because they said they guaranteed their service for six months after they sprayed for weeds. We live on an acre, and have a huge weed problem.

I told my husband about them, and he called and asked them to come out and look at our yard. They came out, gave us a quote, and sprayed our front and side yards. Within two weeks, we had a bumper crop of weeds after it rained! I don't think the spray they used was effective at all, and I don't think they knew what type of weeds we had, or what to use on them.

They might be effective in lawns and gardens, but in a rural setting like ours, with sagebrush, rabbitbrush, and real weeds, their service is not effective at all, and I would not recommend them at all.

I have been here once and have had something delivered once as well and I think their food is actually pretty good.  The atmosphere is nice if you prefer to dine in, and their staff is very friendly.  When I ate inside, I ordered the wok seared seafood which has coconut curry and vermicelli noodles and it was tasty.  I agree with the other reviews saying that they give you large portions even though from the menu, the items look rather pricey.  You could get two meals or share out of an order which isn't bad at all.  I ended up having another meal from when I dined in and when I ordered for delivery, they brought me pretty much the same amount of portion.  That time, I actually ordered beef and green beans with udon noodles and again, I was not disappointed and made 2 meals out of it.  Surprisingly, their noodles heat up really well!

Great music ! Super friendly and attentive bartender and the sweet potato fries were deliciously dessert like ............ The hot chicken sandwich was spot on as well . Deducting a star because we were guilted into giving the band a tip while we were in the middle of eating which we would have done anyway on our way out .

I have to admit after all of the rave reviews I was a bit let down.  Got the beet salad, bone marrow, charcuterie plate, grilled octopus, and meatballs...all which should have sung with diverse flavors...everything was a bit bland and meh.

We came here as a party of 7. Let me just tell you that the food was amazing!!! This is a family owned restaurant: father/husband is the chef, wife/mother is the server, kids walk around checking on the tables! Super cute! 
Their pasta is homemade and the seafood is delivered FRESH everyday! Nothing is frozen and you can tell! We ordered the calamari for an appetizer...which can easily be overcooked and become chewy. Not here! Cooked perfectly and may have been the best calamari I ever had! Everyone was thrilled with their meal! Flavors were just amazing! Absolutely impressed with this tiny little place. The chef came out to talk to us at the end of our meal which made us feel good. We raved to him about his food. You can tell the whole family has so much pride in their restaurant. May be my new favorite restaurant .....
Hospitality is front and center. The view, coffee, breakfast sandwiches and perfect. Cool spot - walkable over the bridge from Manayunk. Go!

More expensive than the Jerry Bob's at Oracle and Magee, this is more spacious and more upscale than any of the others in the chain.  They serve breakfast and lunch all day.  Their specials are wonderful - the Vaquero breakfast of eggs, refried beans and steak, especially.  The menu is a mix of home made and packaged food.  My brother in law loved the French Dip sandwich for breakfast, I can recommend the basic breakfasts.  Nothing special, it is a local place to meet up for breakfast.

3.5 stars! MMM Great hummus. Kabobs are tasty. Chicken is tender. I love the pumpkin spiced entree. the rice is great too. Good service. It's not hip and fancy inside, but you come for the food! So much flavor!

We had an expensive 12 year old Natuzzi light beige leather  sectional that we had made and shipped from Italy and delivered to us. It was in near-perfect condition except that the leather on one of the seats was peeling. Chris drove over two hours to Delaware to look at it. We wanted the leather replaced, not touched up. They came back picked it up, reupholstered the leather and also touched up some rub marks elsewhere when it was returned. There is no way anyone can tell that the leather has been replaced. Amazing job, Chris. Thank you so much!!!!
Hajimaru Signature Ramen! Chashu was tender and the soup was on point. I will be back for more ramen next time!

One of the best places I"ve ever visited in Tampa. I have been meaning to get into plants and caring for plants, so I decided to come to Fancy Free Nursery with my roommate, who had my similar interests and plant aspiration. The second we walked in, we knew we were in the right place. The place had an inviting energy, and that wasn't because of the plants alone. The workers who helped us pick out plants and pots were absolutely incredible. I don't think I've ever had a better retail experience than the one I received in Fancy Free Nursery. I felt like I didn't want to leave, because it was just a wonderful environment. Some may consider the prices a bit high, but I think it's worth it for the connection you get with your new plant, and with the lovely ladies that work there. I will definitely be returning, and I highly recommend this place if you're looking to get into plants or love plants in general!

Until this weekend I was a loyal Capital customer. I never understood the bad reviews - the dispatcher was always sweet to me, recognized my name and address (I guess she lives in my neighborhood) - the cab drivers are super nice and always on time.

However, after my experience this weekend, I won't be using them again.  

I had to go to a wedding in Center City on Saturday night (I live in Pennsport). I called at 1:30pm and reserved a cab for 4:45 - she said "OK great, we'll see you at 4:45. So 4:45 rolls around and I'm standing outside in the pouring rain in my formal attire and then 4:50 rolls around. I think I'm just being paranoid, I'm sure they didn't forget about me... but I'm running out of time so I call anyway. I said, "Hi, I reserved a cab for 4:45 and I haven't seen him yet, is he/she en route?" The dispatcher says "No, he's not" and then says nothing... til' I say, "OK well is there anyone who can come right now because I am on a time crunch... "   She said, "no, there isn't"... silence... "I don't know WHO took your reservation but we can do advances in bad weather". Funny thing is, I call them all the time so I know for a fact that SHE took my reservation. Then she just flat out hung up on me!!! Unfreakingbelievable.

 I should have listened to the other reviews. I called Freedom and they sent me someone right away (a bad ass lady driver who tore up the streets to get me to the wedding on time). I made it! Thanks, Freedom. See ya never, Capital.

The first time I went to Trend Eye Care I was in quite a panic because I had really messed up the hinges on my brand new glasses (bought elsewhere) and did not have the money to purchase new ones at that moment. 

They not only fixed my glasses in about 2 minutes but then proceeded to wave me away when I tried to pay them. A welcome to Philadelphia gift. I told them they'd be my first call when I next needed glasses. And so they were. 

Friendly, professional, and thorough, Dr. Tempesta deserves a shout out for really taking the time to make sure things are as good as they are going to get with your prescriptions, and for being patient with me as I fumbled to get the hang of contact lenses. 

Similarly outgoing and precise is Dontae who helped me select the frames for my new lenses taking into account how and where I would be wearing them, along with what will accentuate my face/overall sense of style. 

So long as I reside in or near Philadelphia I have no intentions of looking anywhere else for my eyecare needs.

My significant other and I fight often over barbecue.  I'm a Texan so I'm a beef barbecue kinda girl and he likes Southern vinegary pork barbecue.  Don't get me wrong, both are good, it's just like all respectful Southerners we sometimes get that craving for barbecue that comes from deep in your bones, and when we do, we can only satisfy it with our barbecue of choice.  Sad to say, unlike Texas, New Orleans barbecue can range from really freakin good to "you know those people who think barbecue means hamburgers and hot dogs" which is surprising since we are in the South and New Orleans is a culinary institution.  However, none of that really matters now that we live in the same neighborhood as The Joint.  Their beef brisket is tender (please don't add sauce) and gives me a taste of home.  The pulled pork is perfectly smoked and tastes amazing with a touch of their homemade sauce (with just enough vinegar).  Their ribs are mouthwatering and the chicken is also delicious and nothing to sneeze at (even for a girl who thinks chicken is typically "BBQ for first timers").  The drinks are decent and the sides are all solid and decently portioned.

Please don't eat here. I got general tso's on Tuesday 12/30/19 and after just a couple of bites I knew it was bad so I threw it all away. With in a few hours I was sick and three days later I'm still in the bathroom. I have never been this sick before. I will never ever eat here again!!!!!!!!!
Loved the orange chicken and the fried rice! A great place in the mall to stop for a quick and filling meal.

Just ordered a sandwich and it was wrong. Called in to tell them about it and got the manager, Makayla, and she said oh you didn't order it like that in a very crappy tone. And I wish I could say this was the first time they screwed up my order but it sleep it's been wrong almost every time I've ordered it.
Absolutely delicious food at a great price. An authentic hidden gym in the Temple area, and super friendly staff. The lamb sandwich with French fries is my go to hangover cure. Delicious!

Happy Father's Day!!

We had Crispy chicken drumsticks with caramel sauce 
Po mi sandwich with crispy chicken vindaloo
Louisiana fried shrimp bowl with coconut rice and herbs

Stopped in for lunch on a Sunday only to realize that only breakfast is served on Sundays. Which probably explains why after a few departures we were the only patrons. Our disappointment lasted for all of 15 mins while we waited for our amazing food! 

I had a cheese steak omelet and the wife had a western omelet. Both were good, in fact the wife couldn't keep her fork off of my plate. 

Prices were fair for the quality and portions and well definitely be back!
Great food. A little loud no matter where you sit but friendly servers. Long wait times.

This place is SO FUN!

I was looking for something to do for my birthday. I'm pregnant, and going to a bar seemed like a snooze. While this place is a bar, it's much more of an experience. SPiN is a ping pong bar! For $39 per hour during peak times, you and nine friends can rent a ping pong table  and listen to a great mix of music. The food is fabulous, and my virgin drinks were great, too!

If you suck, no worries. Employees pick up all wayward balls. They have a cool little contraption, so seriously, just let them fly.

The crowd was very diverse. Tons of younger and older people, but everyone seemed to be having a blast.  The food was delicious. Those who got burgers complained they were charred to death, but my salad was super fancy and filling for a bar!

My group was big and they ate a large selection of menu items. Reasonable prices and no other complaints. I tried anything meatless and loved it.

This place is a nice take on nightlife of you are itching for something to DO and are sick of bowling and billiards.

Located directly across the street from Max Brenner.

This property has a GM who is literally a crazy person. She was rude, condescending, talked over me, cancelled my reservation right in front of me and then said she claimed she rebooked it for someone else. I complained to IHG as I am an elite member with the highest status. Fortunately I was able to book a room at another hotel. I have been a member of IHG for over 6-7 years now but this experience has left me questioning that. I will be contacting the property owners regarding this experience and their absolutely abhorrent employee.

We ordered through yelp ( I guess it goes through grub hub.) my boyfriend goes to pick it up and they act like they don't have an order. The man was utterly confused, making us confused. I guess this post is to get your s*** together cause that's not good business. 
Food is alright.

We took a group of 10 last Saturday for my wife's leap year birthday. We've been before so we know the food is good. It was great as usual and the service was outstanding. Food came out in a timely manner, drinks were refilled and special orders accommodated quickly. They did a really fine job of making a once every four year occasion special. We'll be back!

It was a little hard to find at first i was not sure where it was but after seeing the sign it was a xake walk. Walked in as the first people there for the day. The food was fantastic and the service was great. I had the brisket it was jucy and full of flavor.

The furnace in my 45+ year old Goleta home quit working in January.  After seeing a few positive Yelp reviews for this company and another SB business, I called both companies to see if I could get an estimate on a replacement furnace.  The company owner, John McCormack, happened to be not far away and came over the same day I called.  He provided a reasonable estimate with 3 different options from basic to high efficiency.  After selecting a nice 2-stage high efficiency York model, they said they could install it the following day.  They showed up right on time at 9 AM and had the old furnace out and a new one in by mid afternoon.  Work was done well and unknown to me, requires a permit and inspection, which the company is arranging for.  John himself worked on the installation and it was done professionally and quickly and the new furnace is working very well.  I am happy to recommend both the company and the product for anyone looking for a replacement home furnace.

Love the charcoal chiller drink. It's awesome !!!  
One of my faves in fact I think I'll have one this weekend !!

Great service! They were super busy when I came in but very attentive. I got a burger and it was huuuge. Will definitely be back when I'm in this neck of the woods. They had a dark boat vibe inside (best way I can describe lol) which I thought was kind of neat but they did have outdoor seating if dark boat isn't your thing.
This is what bars were like a few decades ago, and thank the Lord there are a few still left. Nice folks and cold beer. This place anchors Carmel in the real world.

According to the menu, the house specialty beef is "hot and spicy".  Actually, this is a sweet dish, with very little heat to it.  I encourage the management to either change the wording on the menu, or to change the dish so that it is in fact a spicy and not sweet.  These are completely different taste profiles... so it's a pretty big let down when one is expecting one thing and gets the other.  Fried rice was pretty good.

I have been to this restaurant quite a few times when the food was very good, but thus last visit was different. I don't know whether or not it's a new chef but the food was really awful. In general, the menu is filled with ingredients like pickled andouille sausage that is just is to a New Orleanian, just ridiculous. 
I loved this place before the storm when 
it was a simple bistro.

This was a terrible experience. My husbands friend recommended this place so we decided to stop in. I told my husband he needed to make his friend give us a refund! First off, let me start off with the fact that we were annoyed by flies the whole time we were there. While I'm not a fancy pants and can easily get past flies, it just adds to the overall dissatisfaction of the experience. We got our drinks served relatively quickly, but the wait time for her to come back and take our order was longer than I would have liked, again by itself not the biggest deal, but overall dissatisfaction trumps again! My husband wanted to try the "cuban pizza", My daughter just went for chicken wings for her entree, and my other daughter ordered yellow rice and black beans because she is vegetarian. I went with what was listed on the menu in english as smoked pork. (My husband is Cuban and cannot read, and doesnt understand what im trying to read to him in spanish as I dont speak it)  The wait time for the food was extremely long, except for the chicken wings that came out instantly almost and the waitress just walked over and plopped them on the table without saying a thing leaving us to think that our food was on its way also, but no. Enter more flies landing on our heads and flying in our faces. My daughter ended up going ahead and eating the little tiny wing pieces that were breaded and fried like fried chicken (not what she was expecting) so that they wouldnt get cold before our food came. Its not very fun for any party sitting at a table together for one to have entirely eaten their meal while the others just sit there watching them.  So finally our food comes out, and the pizza is as good as any frozen pizza I've bought at the grocery store with a little chorizo thrown on it, the smoked pork turned out to be actually ham, which I just decided to keep due to reading/language barrier (although it would have been nice for the menu to accurately translate the food), the rice was hard and flavorless, and the beans were probably last weeks beans reheated from how they tasted. Well then I had to walk up to the counter to ask for some hot sauce because the waitress never came back to check on us, and the waitress just stood there bewildered like she didnt know what I was saying... SAUCE? she said. Yes sauce, hot sauce. SAUCE? So i asked, Um, caliente sauce?  She just looked at me. My husband overheard and spoke up, picante? Ohh, picante! I thought again, oh well language thing again. So she started searching everywhere and it looked like she went under a sink or something and came out with this dusty bottle of hot sauce. I took it over to the table and my husband said to me, don't touch that hot sauce! When I took a second look at it I realized it was rancid! It was a funny color with bits of mold in it! Maybe they never have heard of hot sauce before! I dont know... and last but not least, when we recieved our check, which was totally rediculous for some ham and frozen pizza, they just added an 18% gratuity to the bill! It was not written anywhere on the menu or stated at anytime that they would add a gratuity! I thought that legally had to be posted?  All in all a really sad experience. I would reccomend anyone looking for good cuban food to pass this place on and go somewhere else! I dont even want to give it one star! Oh, but if you do go, bring a fly swatter!

Called here to order a gift card for a family member who lives nearby. I am not local. They couldn't have been more helpful. Card was delivered promptly along with my message. The family was thrilled to receive it and used it immediately. Thanks Caruso's!

1st time on a Saturday lunch, tried the tacos ( carnitas, shrimp, carne asada) very tasty. Had the trio of salsas, great as well. Overall a really good meal, very reasonable on prices. Save room for Churros & Gelato. Sam was our server, he did a great job.

I love burgers but most restaurants make them soo thick and undercooked to suit me.  I was looking for a place in St. Louis that makes THIN hamburgers and came across Jack Nolen's. Smashburgers are great and so is the ambiance at this place. We went on Tuesday at lunch and the place was full.

Went in on a Saturday night around 7 and had a great time. Restaurant was plenty clean lots of openness and great decor. Food was about what you expect from a better burger joint between $8-11 and it comes with your choice of fries or homemade potato chips which where both good. The burgers were a very decent size and were nice and juicy. Would deff go back.

We had heard good things and were excited to try, when my friend saw a dead mouse out of the corner of her eye. We alerted the staff...who tried tried clean house, but there's no coming back from a dead little mouse.

Excellent menu. Nice environment and priced nicely for lunch. Would definitely come back for more and really look forward to seeing what other items are on the menu for me to explore. Keep the good food coming.

I really loved their customer service, portion, prices, and flavors!
Though only a food truck with a few signature items. Everything is delicious. 
The fries are the best!! So crunchy and so much flavor.
Growing up in and around philly you always find guilty pleasures in simple food trucks! 
The curry is really good and flavorful. It's served atop white rice and a side salad which is plentiful and refreshing. 
It's such a large portion I eat it for two meals which is great because Japanese curry is more flavorful the longer it sits, similar to Pho.

Had a lovely lunch here while catching up with a friend. The service was awesome! And their menu had a nice variety of delicious items on it. 

They bake their gluten free bread in-house (I snagged fresh slices of it out of the oven), and while it tasted good, it was not necessarily the best sandwich bread.  Would have been better as toast. 

There's a lot of seating here- both indoors and outdoors- and even in the enclosed tent area in the back.  

A great addition to the Westchase area!

Extremely poor management! Refuse to give me my security deposit, despite having no damages or needed repair. New tenants moved in, and they have not yet returned my security deposit because they have not received the new deposit from the new tenants. 
WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!

Just got my whole HVAC System cleaned out. Man was it's filthy. Just got a home and was looking for a company I could go with; many wouldn't return my calls but I ended up finding GoldKamps company log in the basement. Sent them a message on yelp and they got right back to me. Set up a appointment and Jamie came out to do the service. Not only am I satisfied with the cleaning I'm satisfied with having a good person come over and show me the ins and out. Jamie was super personable and knowledgeable. We talked some before he got into the service and shared some good laughs and times. He explained to me what he would be doing and even showed me what it looked like inside. It hadn't been done since 2015 which I bet would change the price for most company's but they quoted me a reasonable price and stuck with it. He showed me exactly how dirty it was and I mean it was wrapped around bundle after bundle of animal hair and other things. The filter was fiiiiiilthy. He also cleaned up around the area he worked on,  hooked me up with a clamp to help my AC drain flow to the drain smoothly without it spraying out water or flooding my whole basement. Gave me some recommendations as far as filters and some tips on fixing a few other things around the house that I greatly appreciated. He went waaaaaay above and beyond the call of duty to ensure I was happy with the service he provided. All in all I will for sure recommend this company. When I told him I didn't have cash he just told me to call in and make the payment but wasn't pushy; he kind of just said it in a get to it when you can kinda way which actually got me right on the phone. Even as he was leaving I was trying to show him the receipt he was like no worries. And the lady I spoke with was very easy going and took my payment over the phone and got me a receipt fast. If your in the STL makes no sense to go with any other company in my honest opinion. They get the job done fast, efficiently and affectively, thanks Jamie. Your a solid dude and thank you GoldKamp for the fast reliable service. I posted a few before pics below I was so happy with the after I forgot to take pics but it was clean as a whistle by the time Jamie left l.

I found the atmosphere to be rustic and authentic but the bartender was slow and missed details about my order. Thankfully, I pretended like I forgot my order and repeated it to him again. After finishing enjoying my wonderfully made margarita, he automatically attempted to refill my empty glass with water before I stopped him.

** This review is soley for Jennifer Farr, I can't speak to the other stylists and am confident that they would do a better job if hired. ** I hired Jennifer to do my hair for my wedding, which required a hair changeover before the reception. She emailed the Thursday before my Saturday wedding to say that she could come for the initial updo, but that she wouldn't be able to stay for the change "due to obligations for me daughter". Also, although she said she was confident about doing my hair when I went in for the trial, when the actual day arrived she got frustrated, didn't use the brand new hair piece that I had brought to the trial because she couldn't figure out how to use it, and was pretty much useless. My friends ended up doing it, which was an outstanding experience. :) All in all, don't hire Jennifer unless you like working with unreliable people.

This is the only place I go to when I need my tires checked due to low pressure because of nails.  They're quick to attend to their customers, do the job fast, and are always very welcoming.  I wouldn't consider going anywhere else because they do their job so efficiently!

P.S. Bola you're the best
Was trying to go to this place for a while . Worth the trip . Full Bar & pizza . We were invited to the special screening for a movie The neighborhood.

Wonderful atmosphere, wonderful food. Brisket is AMAZING. Chicken strips were good. Best part of the whole experience was our server Hollywood. Best service we've ever received. The food could have been terrible and I still would've rated 5 stars for atmosphere and service.

Go check this place out, and ONLY ask for Hollywood.

I was in the area for for an appointment and had a little time to kill. Short on cash but wanting a fashion pick me up, I stopped in. Immediately, I was impressed by the cool vibe, the cleanliness of the store and the layout. And it just got better. It was like a carefully curated collection. No matter your age or taste, you couldn't walk out of there empty handed. I swear I could have brought my preteen daughter and my mom and we'd all fall in love with something. Well chosen pieces, from casual to couture reasonably priced. The owner Jen is wonderful. While she greeted me and offered assistance should I need it upon entering the store, she left me shop without any uncomfortable hovering. We chatted a bit when I went up to pay for my goodies and she couldn't be lovelier. Only wish I lived closer so I could go back sooner!

I stopped here over the weekend when I was crazing something sweet.  They had cookie trays on the counter for sampling and they were so good I had eaten three of them without even noticing.  They had a variety of cakes pies, cookies and donuts available for purchase. After getting to sample the cookies I opted for a few donuts.  I choose a glazed, pumpkin crueler and cream donut.  The glaze was hands down one of the best (if not the best) I've ever had.  The cream donut was overflowing with cream and was also very good. The pumpkin crueler was dense and had very little pumpkin flavor.

I absolutely will visit again to try some of their other offerings.
Stopped by for a quick lunch and enjoyed a chicken salad sandwich with iced latte. Everything was delicious and the best part was a surprise cookie with our bill. We will be returning!

Wow. I was stood up. Twice. Bad bookings. Don't count on it happening. When I called to follow up on the late technician,,, had a lengthy conversation about the fact that  noone showed up for my 2.30 appt.  I was told I would get a call back in 10 min.  My next phone call was answered by the same gal I had talked to about 30-40 minutes prior.  But,  I HAD TO CALL HER BACK, waited about 30 min to do so bc I was being nice and figured she was busy... Anyway, she had zero recollection of me or my voice, or having talked earlier.  She asked for my address and said that their 2.30 was at "such n such" other address.  ....  "what do you want to do about it"?    Hmmn.  Well, I know that I do not want to do, is give you guys my business. It was pretty bad.  I don't think that's right. Do not shop here.

I was in town in New Orleans for the holidays and wanted to take my dog to get groomed but wasn't sure where to take here.  I usually take her to PetSmart in Austin but I don't get the vibe from the New Orleans area locations that they have the same level of employee working as they do in Austin...

I looked on Yelp and saw that Hair of the Dog has great reviews.  I called after hours and someone surprisingly picked up.  She said that they could take my dog the following day and asked some questions about what services I would like done and what kind of dog I had.  She quoted me a price of $30 which is a great price.  (My dog is ~20lbs)

When I got to Hair of the Dog for my appointment, I was greeted by the two owners.  I have a rare breed dog so the one owner said to the second owner that I really did have the type of dog I said I did.  Apparently, a lot of dog owners think they have certain breeds which they don't.  I asked if they let the owners know and they said that they don't because it only makes them angry.  I little inside scoop from the world of dog groomers.

They said my dog would be ready in an hour and couldn't have been friendlier.  I went across the street to eat lunch at Artz Bagelz and I think they called within 40 minutes to tell me that my dog was done early.  When I came to pick her up they were in the middle of taking her picture for their Facebook page.

My dog smelled great for days after her bath at Hair of the Dog and I could tell that she enjoyed her time getting groomed.

The only thing I'm not sure of is if they expressed the anal glands and brushed her teeeth.  PetSmart and other groomers usually express the glands as a standard service (my breed of dog doesn't have too severe problems with the glands but it is still nice to have it included) whereas brushing a dog's teeth is usually extra but it is well worth the charge and my dog likes having her teeth brushed.  They did include a nail trim.

I would definitely recommend Hair of the Dog!

This is my second time visiting, first for a birthday party and most recently for dinner. This review will be based on my dinner experience. 

I came on a Saturday night because they had a guest dj that they were featuring. When we got there, there was no hostess and we had to wait awhile to be seated. No a big deal for me. When we finally got to a table, it was very loud inside so I had to sit beside my boyfriend just to have a conversation instead of sitting across from each other. Keep that in mind if you're going for a date night.

The menu was limited at the rooftop, which made it so our food came extremely fast. I ordered the burger and my boyfriend ordered the chicken salad sandwich. I ordered the truffle fries to share, which he demolished. The food was really good, which I was surprised by. Our drinks were strong as well!

Great vibes, mixed crowd, and great music is what I've come to expect from this place. Definitely a fun spot to start the night!
Took my 2019 Sprinter to upgrade the terrible stock speakers.  Casey and his crew did an outstanding job, definitely worth every penny.  Sounds incredible and looks factory.
Pretty good bbq. A little pricey and sometimes slow. Great live music in the basement
Sooo happy they finally opened.  They haven't exactly figured out how to whole grill my whole grilled onions, but they'll get it with time.

Alyan's Restaurant is a little gem in the middle of Philly! Great spot for Middle Eastern food. The place was has that small, homey feeling and kinda divey at the same time, which I love! You walk in and it's wall to wall tables (small place) but then you step into the back room and there are about 5 tables more to fit parties of 4-5 people or possibly more. Love the outdoor/indoor feel with glass ceiling and foliage. 

The Hummus was on point, swirled with extra olive oil and olives, smooth and creamy. We ordered the sampler platter to start which was loaded with lots of goodies like hummus, roasted peppers, Feta cheese, pickled onions, etc..yummy
It was enough to keep us satisfied until the main course. 

My main dish was the Lamb & Couscous with veggies which arrived on two dishes (lamb/couscous on one, chunky veggies simmering in a broth in the second dish) and it was perfect portion size. (In NY, you are given so much food at my fave restaurant that I always save half for lunch the next day)

Price was right, service was good, location was great, and it is definitely a place to return.

We recently stayed at the Peppermill, Reno as part of their Flyaway program. We flew into town on a Friday evening and were scheduled to return home Monday evening. The flight was excellent. Xtra Airways flight attendants were funny and made the 45 minute flight seem like 5 minutes. The Peppermill had charter busses standing by for us and drove us to the hotel. 

We paid an extra $40 to be upgraded to the Tuscany Tower. I'm not sure what the standard rooms are like but ours was excellent. The room was clean, spacious, and very comfortable. 

The price of the package was $129pp + the $40pp to upgrade so we paid $325 to fly to Reno and stay in a suite for 3 nights. 

Gambling in the Peppermill was fun, but nothing too special. The staff was friendly and attentive. 

Our trip was extended by a night after the return flight plane had a mechanical problem. Peppermill stepped up and gave us $100 in room comps and a comp'ed room for the additional night. 

All in all, we'll be back- good deal.

Let's start with the fact that the prices on the online menu are not what they charge. Ordered a medium pizza for $9.99 but was charged $13.99. Called to ask what was up and was told the prices on the menu are wrong. We were hungry so we proceeded with the order. When the pizza arrived, it was tiny. The original bogus price of $10 would have been too much. They also charge $5 for delivery. The pizza itself was delicious, hence the 2 stars. This place could easily be 5 stars if the website pricing wasn't shady and the medium pizza didn't look like a petite.

Really friendly and helpful staff- very comfortable atmosphere. In town for a family wedding so we had 15 people coming and going with kids and all kinds of things going on and it was absolutely no problem.

Attended the Inaugural Beer Pong tournament and while the atmosphere and tournament were a blast.... the service and food were not.  When we first get there, there's no host and we stand around trying to figure out what's going on.  After a few minutes, we decide to seat ourselves and nab some menus from a passing bus boy.  About 10-15 minutes later someone asks for our drinks but waits to take our food order. Delivers our drinks and then comes back about.... 30 minutes later to finally get our food order.  The kitchen is backed up, but we wait and enjoy the music and atmosphere.  Food finally arrives and its really nothing to brag about.  If anything, come for the beach bar attitude.

Cochon Butcher secures a spot for top three sandwich places I've had in my lifetime.

In order to maximize our trip, one lunch we got a couple sandwiches from Cochon Butcher and a couple from Mother's down the road.  At Cochon, we decided on the duck pastrami sliders and the BLT.  The BLT was my friend's choice...after all, how good can a BLT be?  It's just three simple ingredients slapped together on toast that any idiot can make, right?  WRONG.  This BLT was the bomb!  I don't know what they put it in to make shine above all others, but it was dee-lic-ious!  The duck pastrami slider (which is basically duck pastrami and cheese panini cut in four pieces) was awesome as well!  Suffice it to say, Mother's paled in comparison with these two ingenious creations.  Next time, I'm coming back to Cochon Butcher for a full on meal.

Don't forget to try the sweet potato habanero hot sauce.  Not that spicy at all, but adds an entirely new element to the mix.

My friend and I went there around 4 in the afternoon, the people were super friendly and often checked in on us. We got our food with 10-15 minutes of ordering, I ordered the chipotle IPA brisket sandwich, overall it was good, but I personally did not like the bread it was served on, the fries that came with the meal were great, and the side of onion rings I ordered was hot and fresh, the only thing I have to say is that I wish there was more flavor to everything, but overall a great place! There was also also plenty of street parking, as well as a lot next door.

Wow, triple d got this one right!!! Took the whole family and we were ALL impressed!! Highly recommend the pastrami dip! The house pickles ROCK! Friendly staff and the owner really goes out of his way to make your dining experience awesome. If your in Santa Barbara you HAVE to go.

I live in centre city with no cars and no desire to take the bus anywhere to get pho. So in my area, this is my go to place for pho. Sure, i've had better pho at other places, but the best one in chinatown and in the area is hands down this place.  

I usually get some variation of pho or the spring rolls and vermicelli with pork.  And we usually get the shrimp rolls to share.  It's weird they put mint in the shrimp rolls i don't like the taste necessarily, but i usually just take it out as i'm eating it...

sometimes the pho has great texture noodles, perfecty chewy and just the right amount of stickiness.  but sometimes, its just OK.  

The vermicelli tastes good but someimtes the spring rolls are a little too hard.  The pork is always on point though.

Service is great! They are always attentive and fast.  So I never get annoyed dining here.  Not always the most pleasant place to eat especially during busy hours and downstairs, but i always left here content and satisfied!

My group of 4 went here on Monday evening and were expecting a comedy battle, but instead we were just performed for by about 5 or 6 different comedians. It was really good! We had a great time. The Waitstaff was great and I really enjoyed the show! I'll definitely go back.

Low quality food, spotty service and the most revolting hollandaise I've ever encountered. If there's no where to go, I guess it's hard to screw up an omelet, but the overall quality of the food is just so very sub par compared to pretty much every other diner in Philadelphia. I guess it suits the need for the after-church crowd to flood in there on the weekend for brunch, but I can't see any reason to go there over one of the good diners nearby in Roxborough. They do have a good take-away beer selection, and once I had a bourbon-sauce burger that was pretty decent, so I guess that warrants a second star. But, really, its a convenient place for tourists and the nondiscriminating eaters and it's probably exciting for your grandmother, but in a city with hundreds of diners, this one is dramatically inferior.

I was very skeptical of this nail salon as the decor was very outdated and there was not a glass of wine in sight. I previously had my first set of SNS dipped powder nails done in North Carolina and wasn't sure of where to continue my new habit in the Mt. Holly area. After reading a few reviews and seeing pix on Yelp, I liked Kevin's work the best. I must admit that I was somewhat disappointed in the limited supply of colors for the SNS dips but was very pleased with his results. Kevin told me to trust him because he was a professional, he turned out to be true to his word because I left very happy with my experience at U.S Nails!

WOW! They've got 2 speeds - if you don't like the one you see, you'll hate the other one. Arrived at 11:12 and they were quick to get the wash done, then came the wait...
After waiting 45 minutes to have them dry, vacuum, etc. I watched several employees stand around and practice their twirling of Windex as if they were Doc Holliday... I watched them take dry rags/towels and "wipe off" the missed dirt. A number of cats were scratched today. 
We did not get our services we paid for. We left without windows cleaned, mirrors still dirty, no vacuuming.
There's better places in town. Don't waste your money or your time!

I liked the location of the hotel and the cleanliness. It was close enough to walk to the French Quarters, but far enough away from the nighttime atmosphere. The staff were friendly, but a bit unprofessional. If the staff improved on professionalism, I would rate this a 5.

Love their baked goods. Was addicted to their carrot cake for years. On a whim tried  the German chocolate cake. 
Fan-f***ing-tastic!!!! Love love love. Addiction to that now. Oh well, a happy fat man needs his sweets.

Went to this place for dinner on a Sunday. We sat on the patio and it was so nice!! Ordered the fried risotto balls for an appetizer and the tortellini for the entree. The tortellini was fantastic and had the best sauce! Would have given 5 stars but the service was just a little too slow this time for my taste, but the food was incredible.
Just had appetizer fried cheese flame it right in front of you AMAZING!!!!!! and I'm only 10 years old. Can't wait for main meal yum steak and potatoes (Mom & Dad Luke the food too!)

NOT COVID SAFE. Went to this restaurant for the first time the other day. I was doubtful because I had heard bad things but it closed so late so I gave it a try. This restaurant is NOT covid safe. Cooks in the back don't wear face masks. also pizza was very soggy definitely not worth the price at all.
Delicious food, amazing potatoes, timely service, fair prices, courteous delivery people

Mallory was a doll! Prompt service, friendly with knowledge of the menu. I ordered a margarita (not sweet). It was good but had too much salt in the glass. It's a pet peeve of mine when bar staff do not properly prep the salt rimmed glass. It simply ruins what could have been a really good margarita. Especially when I was specific about (no salt inside the glass). I switched to straight tequila to avoid further disappointment.  Mallory was very good at directing me to other tequilas offered since my go to "Patron" was not an option. 
The Queso and guacamole was really good! Should have stopped there though. I ordered the steak taco, nothing special. My friend ordered the short rib nachos. Not a fan of the sweet tasting nachos although, I can see how others may like the taste. 
They do have valet across the street so parking is not easily accessed. 
The decor  is quite nice, staff are friendly but it would not be my "gotta return to" place while in Nashville. Perhaps because I'm use to Mexican food being Mexican, not this version. I did enjoy the music but again, Green Day does not a term Mexico to me.

I really hate to write this review, because I love these cars and I appreciate that there are precious few shops willing to specialize in them. However, I have had 2 negative experiences having my car worked on here that I need to share.

The first time was several years ago, when I noticed my clutch pedal felt odd. I called to get a quote for a clutch replacement and was told that if it wasn't slipping yet that I didn't need to bother. Fast forward 2 months and my clutch pedal mostly stops working. I was quoted for a clutch job, and I drop off the car. After having the car for a couple days, I receive a call that the throwout bearing has failed and that I need a whole new transmission. Once the transmission is replaced, I pick up the car and discover four things: a pair of pliers has been left in the engine bay, part of the intake is missing, one of the three bolts mounting the motor to the car was started but not tightened, and a new check engine light related to a wheel speed sensor. After tightening down the bolt, returning the pliers, picking up the rest of my intake, and replacing a speed sensor, I'm on my way.

Having not learned from the first experience, I returned recently for assistance with the blower motor. To be fair to the shop, it was an abnormal situation where I had removed the old blower motor, but was having trouble figuring out how to install the new one. They quoted me for a full removal and replacement, which was fair. When I got the car back, there was a loud buzzing sound from the motor and a new airbag light. I mention these to the shop, and they offer to keep it a little longer to determine the problems. After several more days, I return to the same problems. I am told they "diagnosed the airbag light for free" but would be very expensive to repair, despite there being no light when I dropped the car off. And they told me that the brand new blower motor I bought from the dealership must be bad, and that I would need to pay labor again to have it replaced. I took the car home and noticed three things: the cabin air filter was installed upside down, there are several plugs missing from my blower housing, and one of the tools I left in the car is missing.

I genuinely think these are good people, and I respect that they are running a small business catering to one of my passions. However, I don't believe they have the care or attention to detail for me to use them going forward.

WoW!  I can't say enough about the staff at this hotel.  From the moment I walked in (after a VERY long drive to get there), they made me feel like an old friend they were welcoming home.  Michael and Zach were working the front desk and they were amazing.  Everyone I spoke with was so nice.  By far the best service I've received at a hotel and I stay at different hotels each week.  Well done!  I will definitely be back.

DO NOT BUY FROM THIS PET STORE.

My husband and I only adopt animals, but we gave in after falling in love with a baby bunny.

2 weeks later, she stops eating and starts having bathroom problems. Then dies.

Thanks to My Pet neglecting their animals and failing to take care of them, our bunny had something called FLY STRIKE.
Basically flies started laying eggs inside of her and she was being eaten from the inside out. 

What's their solution? They claim they don't monitor "young rabbits" and instead offer a 30 day warranty just in case they die. ?!

DONT SHOP AT THIS PET STORE.
Report them to Animal Control.
They are selling sick, neglected, hurt pets.

We visited New Orleans and, coming from the Northeast, had never done a crawfish boil before. I'm glad we made the trek for this! We got crawfish, crab, corn, potatoes, and sausage - all delicious. I ate many pounds of crawfish myself, it was so good! The corn was also great. The sausage was nothing spectacular, but it wasn't bad - and the crawfish was really the only thing I cared about.

Very nice and helpful staff. Only my second visit to this club, first was back in 2013. Could use a makeover, very old and not up to AA standards. However, it's the only club I know of at BNA and it's a nice Oasis before my flights to Tampa on Southwest!

Went for brunch on a Sunday at 11:30 and were seated outside fairly quickly. Our party was only given one menu, due to a shortage. A few minutes later silverware was delivered by the hostess, which also seemed to be in short supply. Kind of an odd start to the experience, but the place looked really nice with an old FL vibe. By 11:40 we had not seen a waitress for any of the surrounding tables which were also full. At 11:45 we spotted a waitress taking a prolonged (over 5 minutes of negotiations) order from 3 women at the table next to ours. At the same time a second waitress appeared from, what can only be described as a secret door, in the rear of the porch. We thought this has to be our time. Just as the first waitress finished prolonged negotiations with the table behind us, she walked past our table at the same time as the secret door waitress and nether one even glanced in our direction. At this point my lady companion wanted to let the hostess know we needed a server, but I didn't want to chase someone around for my entire meal, so we decided it would be best to leave.  We left and let the hostess know at the 20 minute mark, that no one had been to our table. She didn't seem to mind and took back the single menu we were so friendly to being back for her without even a thank you. There was a couple of people waiting to be seated as we left, and I am sure they ended up at our spot. Rumor has it they are still sitting there waiting for that elusive Sunday brunch. 

I can only give one star, but for some reason I still want to go back and will be happy to amend this review if someone can ever find their way to my table.

I'm new in Spring Hill and needed a reliable mechanic to work on my VW.  Bill's European Autoworks was recommended by someone who has been taking his car there for a few years.  I couldn't be happier with the service.  Bill and Brian are very knowledgeable and the prices are very reasonable.  I'll be going there for all my automotive needs from now on.  Big thumbs up!

Mid Designer Labels at great discounted prices. If I need dressy evening Florida wear, (shorts, Hawaiian shirts) I will always run through this place first! I go straight to the clearance racks first then hit the every day low prices. I'm already packing discount coupons when I come. 
From Men & Women fashions to bedroom and bathroom linens to home decor to quick gifting, you might be surprised at what you find.

So-you go to this oil store, they have plenty to choose from, you wonder why the 3 star rating? Because you seriously have to buy your bottle to get the oil. Okay, we've been to about 10 to 15 oil stores-we hit up different ones when we travel-this is the first one you had to buy the bottle. 
The staff was very friendly. Answering question. Letting me sample-which you use a spoon-first time too, usually have little cups, they said they cut waste down by not having cups. 
But buying your own bottle? We just left after that. Their prices were higher too than we've ever seen-then the bottle cost on top of that. Nope! We were out. 
The staff was like you can bring a bottle to fill. I'm like-I live two states away. Lol

Let me just start off by saying I drive 30 mins just to come to this salon! I stumbled across this place by driving by and I am so glad I did. I will never go anywhere else. When you first walk in, you are welcomed with such a clean classy elegant atmosphere.  The owner and his wife  are by far some of the kindest people I've ever met. T (the owner) is the nail guru! He does the SNS on my nails with French and it looks amazing each and every time! If you want one of the best pedicures where they take the time and attention to detail come and and for MYA!!! She is the best!!! 
Well worth the drive if you ask me!  Come check them out. I can assure you will be glad you did!

I came here for one thing only: Falafel Wraps.  The falafel balls themselves are good.  End of praise.  The only guy working was unwelcoming and very slow.  The "wraps" are just a few falafel and chopped lettuce without any dressing, and no sauce apparently.  It makes for a very dry mouthful.  I am very experienced with falafel, when I lived in Germany I basically lived at three Turkish joints around town, so I know what goes with it, and I know what I like.  These wraps should be overflowing with steaming falafel, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, maybe more veggies, and two different sauces.  When I asked for the sauces I got exactly one tiny to go container of the spicy red sauce, but he refused my request for tzatziki.  I couldn't really hear through his muffled speech but I thought he said "too expensive."  I'm sorry but at $15 for two tiny wraps, I expect a proprietor not to be stingy with sauces that typically go with the dish.  This place looks so cute and well kept from the outside but inside it is dark and dingy.  I live down the street from this place, so I was hoping to have my new usual, but unfortunately because of the service I really don't think I will be going back.

Yesterday enjoyed lunch at Cal Neva's Finest. A Local's Favorite. Great Food and Good Prices. Was waited on by Tony. Par Excellancr. I highly recommend Top Deck. It has Pinache and an Intimate atmosphere.

Ate there on a Sunday afternoon.. $10.99 a person I think was the price. This is not one of those fancy buffets. The food has a southern flair. Red beans and rice, and collard greens etc. Lots of variety.  Fish, chicken, beef, vegetables, salad, soup desert, etc.. Again all with a southern flair. Food was good. Not fancy. Atmosphere low key "kick Back".  I liked it. Nice change from all the whistles and bells high hype casino restaurants. If you like Popeye's Chicken fast food restaurant then you will enjoy the food here. The Buffet quality is better and more homey. I have not ate here for breakfast yet. I usually shy away from buffets for a breakfast meal. I'd rather go to one of the specialty breakfast restaurants in town. TIP: Before you commit to eating at a new buffet, ask to go have a look at the food they are serving. Also the booze drinks in the Casino are great and don't cost a arm and a leg. Casino is low key as well. All In All,,,Good Stuff.  :)

I moved from Tokyo where we have so many fantastic hair salons. My main guy in Tokyo was so awesome that it took me 5 months to get over him and finally got my courage to try new salon here in STL...well I wish I came here sooner!!! At this point, because of the dry air and difference in water, my hair was in a mess like I had never seen in years. Charlie the owner took my appointment in very smoothly and appointed Dominique for me. She took time to listen then got to work right away. The whole process was very relaxing, perfect amount of conversation, too, which I find it hard to find for customer service in general in the US.
She recommended getting intense treatment which I still can't believe how well it worked on my hair...I mean it looks, feels and smells so so so good to the point that I can't focus on my work.lol
For the cut, I told her that I'd like minimum hair cut basically just for the damanged part of my hair. The result? PERFECTION. She even kept the faceline that was made 5months ago, made it even better.
I highly highly recommend this place and especially Dominique. So happy that now I have my new stylist to go;)
My vote for the best cupcakes in Nashville!  Try the peanut butter and chocolate ones.  I couldn't stop thinking about them for a week after I had my first.

I finally found my Tampa nail spot!! After months of searching and going to crappy places, I found a hidden gem. Morgan did an amazing job on pedicure and manicure. She was so detail oriented and made sure I was happy throughout the whole experience. I also love that the salon is toxin free. No harsh drills either!! It was such a treat to spend my Sunday at Luna Luxe. Already scheduled my next appt in two weeks!! They made my day! Highly recommend!!! I've been doing my nails for 10+ years and haven't had this awesome of an experience before today. Thanks ladies!

Hunan Star has been a great spot for years, with consistent quality.  Tonight was no exception.  The Hot and Sour soup was delicious with the right combination of heat and the vinegar for sour.  The veggies were great.  Pot stickers were exceptional.  Steamed  chicken, prawns and mixed vegetables - sounds boring, and it is, but works well on the low carb diet and tasty with a little sauce!
Crepes presentation is the most impressive part of the meal.  The crepes are cold by the time they're served.  Staff forgot to serve the two coffees ordered.  Food is good but not memorable.

Great little rooftop in the heart of Philly. Came here as a pre-game to our night out on a Friday night and were blown away by the view. Absolutely stunning with outdoor seating aside a fire pit. The bar area and rooftop in general seem pretty small making it hard to navigate from simply the bar to the restroom without bumping into people. 

They had a good selection of drinks but I was super disappointed they were out of the alcoholic hot chocolate. Ordered a rose instead and my friend ordered their chili drink with the chili oil sprinkled on top. My rose was fine, but I was skeptical of this chili drink. Having tried it, wow it wasn't bad at all and pretty cool! 

We hung out here for about an hour or so, good conversations, drinks and music. With that being said I would definitely come back just based on the atmosphere.

The staff was friendly but it seemed like they were very understaffed.  While I was waiting, 2 different customers were told they couldn't go upstairs to the shop because there was no one available to go up with them.  I also wanted to go upstairs to buy some items but didn't ask since everyone else was told no.  I shot 100 rounds of .40 with my own pistol at 2 targets and paid around $60.  You have to buy their ammo which I'm not a big fan of but it's not outrageously expensive.  They have a wide variety of targets and ammunition.  The range is smaller than I expected but clean and fully functional.

As a St. Louis native I can't believe that I had never heard of this place. But I am happy that I finally did. Stopped in for lunch today. Since I always get Italian beef when I am in Chicago I had to see how this place's stacked up. The flavor was all there. Roast beef dripping with au jus, Red peppers and onions topped with provel(the mystery cheese of st. Louis). I added the hot giardinara peppers like they do in Chicago. It was pretty incredible. I look forward to coming here again and trying out some other items on the menu--like the mambo sicicliano. Can't wait to tell my friends about this place. The Hill never disappoints.

This place was very delicious. My boy friend and I came here to eat dinner before hitting up some of the bars on Broadway! I got the Maker's Mark Bourbonzola and my boy friend got the Fireman's burger. They were both cooked so well. Everything just melted in your mouth and the seasoning were great. I got the rockin' red rice as a side which definitely has a kick to it. If you aren't a spicy person, avoid this. 
I gave this 4 stars because the service was a little slow. We ordered beers after our food, but had to wait about 15-20 minutes to flag a waiter down just to get the beer list. It wasn't even that busy either with tables open for others to come in and sit.
However, the food was definitely good in my opinion. I would come back!

I recently had JJs for the first time, to take a break from Blind Onion, which I originally thought to be the best in town. Now I'm gonna have to reevaluate some stuff! Try their ranch dressing! Yes. With your pizza.
Chef Samantha Mitchell is killing it in the kitchen! I came here with my family and got the carpaccio, halibut, beets and apple pie dessert. Everything was phenomenal! Keep it up Sam!
If I could go here everyday I would! Ambiance, friendly service, delicious Chai tea and food, cute café, lovely décor. If you haven't made your way here yet, "chop chop"!

First, a disclaimer: I've been going to Sacred Grounds (or "Sacred", as it's called by many in the local vernacular) for years.  Maybe this will have no hope of sounding impartial, or maybe it will.  Take that for what it's worth.  Here goes:

In travels across the country, I have never found a coffee shop that combines the comfort, friendly atmosphere, ambiance, vegetarian food selection (it's great, and I'm not even a vegetarian), quality and consistency of coffee drinks, local flair, and passion for good community causes that you can find at Sacred Grounds in Edwardsville.

I looked back at old digital photo albums to try to figure out, if I could, when I started to go to Sacred, or when it may have opened.  I got as far back as 2000 and 2001 and had some early photos of me and friends there on Wednesday nights, drinking coffee or Jones soda and playing poker or Trivial Pursuit (there's a good selection of board and other games available at Sacred for patrons to use during their visit.)  I had some pictures there with ex-girlfriends and some old sketches that I made on trips there by myself.  There was a time when I would be there almost every night.  Again, the comfort factor is what draws in the regulars and makes it a sort of "Cheers" for metro-east caffeine addicts.

When I met my now-wife back in '02, we immediately started going there a few nights a week to talk, relax, unwind, enjoy the environment, and share some drinks and baked goods.  And to this day, we're still frequently there with our young son for Sunday brunch (don't miss the chance to catch the brunch on Saturdays or Sunday mornings.)

Sacred carries the standard menu of coffee and tea drinks of any good coffee shop.  It also has a huge assortment of niche sodas, juices, and other bottled drinks for the non-caffeinated crowd.  The nice-sized glass case of baked goods are outstanding - my personal favorite is the pumpkin bread.  And through lunchtime and the evening, don't miss the chance to try one of the grilled sandwiches (the Sicilian rocks!) or paninis or soups of the day.  And, again, the weekend morning brunch has a different menu each weekend but is always outstanding - and you can never go wrong with the vegi-Mex brunch option offered each weekend.

Goodness knows when they open (I don't think I'm up that early), but they close nightly at 11 PM.

There's no Wi-Fi, which is actually a nice thing even thought I'm a wired 24/7 kind of guy, since it creates a less modern, less hectic kind of environment.  Sure, people are always there with laptop computers, but there's no Internet access available onsite.

The art on the wall is coordinated by the local art council, features a local artist each month, and changes out once a month, normally the weekend mid-month.

The only downsides:  During or just after busy times, it may be hard to find a clean table (or, if you find one that's empty, you may be inclined to ask the staff to wipe it, or to just lend you a wet rag to wipe it yourself.)  Sometimes during the weekend rush, it can take more than a few minutes to get your food, but it's cooked to order and well worth the wait.  Patience is a virtue we could all use some more of nowadays.

So stop by, grab a cup of joe, and introduce yourself to one of the regulars.  I've never had a disappointing conversation here, and no one bites.  Cheers!

Loved every bite. I really want to give this place a 4.8 due to the noise level and the speed and which we were served. Would have liked a bit more time between appetizer and entree. We started at 8:30 and were done with main course by 9:05. 
But it's just too yummy to give it a 4, so had to go with 5.
The bbq shrimp pie was sublime with a great kick in the sauce. The Traiteur Fish with crawfish cornbread was decadently delicious, but i thought a bit too much of the cheese mousse was slathered on. My husband enjoyed his steak very, especially good were the potatoes. 
If you can deal with noise, get there now.

Been here twice and both times were great experiences.
