The first time I went was with my girl before seeing Ninja Turtles (not as good as the 90's movies I might add) and ordered a buffet of food that the waiter did an excellent job of providing recommendations and knowledge of the different dishes. The duck wings are BANGIN. The vampire tacos tastes a lot better on paper but it's always refreshing to see some originality (not with the name). 
The second time I went was during lunch and the lunch special is a solid deal that left me full but not loosen-up-your-belt-and-shamefully-try-to-suck it-in kind of full. 
Oh, and obviously great beer selection that has Dirt Wolf IPA (best Victory beer out there) on tap. Little pricey but definitely somewhere to try when you have a few extra bucks in your pocket.

I took my 7 year old here to get her ears pierced and it was the best decision I made. The staff did a tantum pierce and both ladies were so great. I first went in and got a gift certificate and set up an appointment to get my daughters ears done. The owner was so helpfule! She set everything up and told me the best ways to help my daughter have a good experience. The place was very clean, friendly and informative. Then a week later I got a call from the store making sure my daughter's ears were healing fine and everything was good. Fabulous customer service!!!!! I think everyone should take their kids to a professional and not to some store at the mall.

The Italian style pizza is wonderful. The crust is thin and crispy--the way pizza should be. The ambiance is clean and refined. The service at the restaurant is impeccable during the few times I've been there so far.

Dream tea is a classic for bubble tea. There have been a lot of newer bubble tea places opening up in Edmonton but it's still pretty good. There is a large selection of flavors available; however, unlike other chains that have opened, the sugar, ice, etc is not as customizable. Dream tea offers food snacks that are fairly tasty but I find them to be a little expensive. This location has renovated and looks much more modern and cleaner than it has in the past.
The room was pretty nice and the beds were comfy.  Breakfast wasn't that great but don't expect much. The hotel staff was friendly and very helpful. I would recommend you stay here.

Amazing service, not only did I call at 5:00 needing a cleaning ASAP (since other service never showed) they answered promptly, and came out first thing in the morning. My house looks amazing, and they were professional, quick, and friendly. The owner even stopped by to check on the process, and make sure I was happy, great company, would recommend to anyone!
Delicious!!! The burrito was my favorite in Tucson so far. It's all so fresh and such big portions.

Lovely, relaxing, well kept nail salon with NO acrylic nails being done so no toxic odors! Personnel is always friendly & inviting. Best place for these services I've found. Booking an appointment is highly suggested as they're always busy. Wonderful for duo pedicures with my husband
They have some good beers and a really Great staff.  Plus a very chill atmosphere.   The poolside lager and and the saison are great.

Second visit after a less than stellar first visit.  Does this place only hire high school sports teams because they're only concerned about themselves and personal gossip.  I didn't  know a business could be handled by children?  Donuts this visit lacking in hair which is great were exceptionally doughy and heavy.  No hair nets, no gloves and employees who wear running shorts.  Back to Center Grove and I dread the drive but they continue to dominate on professionalism.

This place is really popular with the local teenager crowd and the interior design looks very trendy.

As for the drinks, they are pricy compared to others in the area but have pretty tasty bubble tea that is authentic.

The snacks look good on the menu although I didn't get any.  

I got the large Japanese green tea bubble tea for $5 and it was well worth the money, the green tea was milky and smooth, not too sweet which is my style.  

Pay with Level Up for a $1 discount on your first purchase also.
One of my favorite places to eat! Get the sweet tea! Delish! Very consistent. Can always count on them for a good meal!

My family was celebrating our Mom and Dad's 90th birthdays. A very special occassion!  We spent a fabulous weekend at The Inn at Whitewing Farm. Of course we made time to enjoy Longwood Gardens as well.  Each room was spacious, had individual ammenities, a fireplace or an outdoor or indoor sitting area.  Such a relaxing environment.  Beds were extremely comfortable, rooms were decorated so tastefully. Our host and hostess, Lance and Sandy, were so friendly, made us feel welcome from our first "Hello".  My family plans to return in late spring or summer to enjoy the outdoors (pool, beautiful pond, flower gardens, and tennis courts). Thank you, Lance and Sandy, for making our special weekend extra memorable.

Went there for a breakfast at night since this is one of the very few restaurants that serve breakfast. We ordered the eggs medium but came out easy over. I asked for well done potatoes and they came out with lots of oil on them - like they were coated so they would be well done.  The toast was cold and had to send it back.  We used to go here quite frequently but stopped because the food and service was not great. I guess they are back on our do not eat there list.

I never post on Yelp but I thought I would update. We went to savor again about 2 weeks ago with my mom because she wanted to try it (she lives in the area) the owner was, again, loud and rude towards BOTH patrons and staff. Looking at other comments on Yelp I see this is definitely a common theme. The food was okay but the sauce on the pasta was very heavy and my mother's salad was small for the price. Wait staff was attentive and kind but we will NOT be going back again. Spend your money at restaurants where the owners treat those around them with respect.

After going to another restaurant on Cherokee and finding out they didn't have much on the menu available due to a menu transition, my sister and I happened upon Frankly on Cherokee. Having German heritage, we're both fans of a good brat. 

Frankly's interior has a very welcoming feel to it. Rustic wooden tables, chalkboard menu board, and beautiful hanging Edison lights are some of the design highlights. 

Upon reaching the register I decided to go for the beer brat and a side of fries with the rosemary and kalamata dipping sauce. After paying for the items I noticed the half wheel of Raclette being melted on top of fries in the kitchen, and decided right away to make another order with those fries! 

The brats were really good. Nice and simple. I'm not a fan of sauerkraut, but I was digging it on this brat. I was also happy to see they use La Bonne Bouchee buns for their brats, as I'm a fan of their bakery. The fries were good, classic hand-cut fries. The rosemary kalamata dipping sauce was a perfect pairing, and those savory Raclette cheese fries were piping hot with the cheese stretching when you pulled a fry off the pile. Nice stretchy cheese is always a good sign.

The staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating, asking if we needed anything at all  and making sure everything was good during the meal. 

It's was nice to read that Frankly on Cherokee uses local ingredients and humanely raised meats. That kind of ethic is something I can really stand behind. 

Thanks, Frankly on Cherokee, for a great meal!

Not a bad diner. I ordered the turkey club. The price was reasonable. The service was sub par. 2 waitresses in the place. I noticed a lot of people waiting several minutes at the register to pay. As for cleanliness.... I always take issue with people handling filthy money then touching the bread for toast.. Seems to me they could have someone work the register so waitresses aren't contaminating food. I will not be returning.

Blarg!  This place is the reason I hate d-bags and idiot girls.  Am I an idiot? Sure I am, anyone would agree.  But the lack of originality with anything in this place including the people makes it one of the worst in Philly. Shame on you because this place used to be cool when it was the Independence Brew Pub.  And shame on guys for thinking that overly gelled hair with button down shirts is an acceptable way to live your life!  And ladies, stop all wearing the same things as each other and drinking Miller Lite!  There are better things out there, I swear!

After a long day of travel (and a glutenous weekend in Virginia) the fiance and I decided to try this place out.  We are now lame and like to eat dinner early and take advantage of any happy hour specials a restaurant has to offer.  They have a Sushi and drinks HH that lasts from 4-6:30 so we made it right on time. It was a little weird at first since we were the only patrons at the restaurant but we got over that real fast.   We started with our beverage of choice, Dirty Martini for him and a seasonal sangria for me.  I cannot vouch for his martini since olives are gross but my Sangria had fall written all over it.  Being in VA all weekend I drank a ton of caramel apple ciders to go with the changing of the leaves.  This just went with my obsession.   Anyways we took advantage of the other HH specials and ordered the ceviche, sashimi and a nok roll.  We also ordered the steak tips since we were both craving a little red meat.   The first items to come out were the salad (which came with the steak) and the ceviche.  I have to say that we were fighting over that ceviche because it was so good.  The remaining items all came out together.  The sashimi might have been the BEST I've had in Tampa.   You could tell everything was fresh and prepared perfectly.  The nok roll was nothing to right home about but still ok.  The tempura asparagus completely took over the salmon in the roll.  The steak tips with the horseradish aioli was also really good.  I could not stop eating the french fries that came with it.  At the end we ordered a donut.  I think the kitchen got held up by the very large party that came in when we ordered it and my fiance kept asking me if this was worth the wait.  Well yes it was and not because they comped it.  It was like the donut had a threesome with a funnel cake and a churro.  The dipping sauces it came with were also delish.  I hope that South Tampa gets its act together and hits this place up.
This review is actually for The Healing Place, located in Mesa Chiropractic.

Ate here with family, we're all from out of town and we picked this place without knowing any better. 

My dad got the brisket and it was the driest brisket hes ever  had.  For the side he got the potato salad and it was disgusting,  I think it was made with mustard....maybe its a st louis thing? Im not sure.

I had the ribs and pulled pork.  The ribs were tough and dry. The pulled pork was like shoe leather and had about as much taste. 

The only thing that I had that was palatable was the smoked chicken wings.  They were decent but not exceptional. 

I would not recommend this place to anyone.

The staff has always have been nice to me or to my parents when we needed something. They have many types of selections of wheelchairs, power scooters vroom vroom, lifts, bathroom products if needed and many more. Brandon Brace INC is a family own and ran business which is quite nice instead of dealing with CORPS they claim they can get it and later on they can't.  The family always goes out of their ways to make the customer happy which is quite nice!

Now for a little bit about the family and company:

Brandon Brace is a family owned business that has been serving the community of Brandon, Florida for over 25 years. We specialize in quality medical supplies, wheelchairs, walkers, orthotics as well as a wide variety assistance equipment. Our knowledgeable staff are here to help you choose the products that are right for you.
Always have what I need at a great price! Have been a local customer for 15 plus years.

Friendly & great brunch menu. Laided back & located at arcade.   You can have drinks with breakfast.  I had brisket hash plate. Fantastic...
Cooked in front of you.  I'd highly recommend kitchen Downtown

They have Great ice cream at great price, and amazing flavors. Push yourself to be brave and try something new. The home means Nevada is mind blowing. Great combination of sage and pine nuts, yes pine nuts! Clay grown up flavors, totally worth the trip from Carson. I'd drive into reno just for the ice cream!

Beautiful RV Park, very well designed.  Sites are not huge but do have picnic table with a place for BBQ, also an astro turf lawn area. Restroom were very clean and well taken care of. Pool area was small but had lounge chairs. Check in was very efficient, several clerks, plus escort to site. It is a great park for a visit to Reno.

Wowee! This is just what I was looking for! Personally, I don't like "American" Mexican food because it is greasy and loaded with calories. While In Ft. Collins, CO I got to experience fresh mexican cusine, which was to die for!  I have been craving finding a place like that around here.  And finally I did! I wanted to go out for cinco de mayo, and came across this family run business - and the menu sounded very much like what I had experienced in CO.  

We went there with two friends - the seating is limited!  BUT they make everything to order, so it's well worth it.  I got their veggie burriot, which they let me customize, and my BF got their steak burrito.  One friend got shrimp tacos, and the other got something with the green salsa, that she said was amazing! The price is right, and the portions are too.  We also sampled their house made cantaloupe and mango juices - deelish!  We also tried their homemade chips, which were very good.

Our one friend loved it so much she and her BF (who was there also) went back for lunch with her mom a few weeks ago. I really can't wait to go back!
the best service food was amazing worth every penny highly recommend, the people were all freindly the chief came out we he was so nice really great experience i regret not staying at this hotel

Rented a car, reserved a time slot over the phone. The car "just arrived" it wasn't clean, we had to wait while he did a botch detail job. Then at check out slaps us with a 300 charge. That over the phone FAILED to tell us about.

Yes!  Yes!  Yes!  Authentic Mexican food that has managed to mimic the concept of Chipotle or Qdoba but soooooooo much better!  Clean restaurant with quality ingredients and a friendly team.  They do not skimp on toppings and their jalapeño ranch is incredible!!!!  This local hidden gem needs to be exposed to our entire community.  Great job guys!!

Exellent service, though the food fell short of mediocere... 




No more needed.

McPrison!!

Like most people, I grew up with McDonald's. The first one we visited was probably in 1963 on the Berlin Turnpike in Newington, CT. The novelty of cheap, fast food was thrilling to the Harris family; prior to McDonald's' arrival, we'd rarely eat out, and when we did, it was Howard Johnson's, or the luncheonette counter at Kresge's or Woolworth's 5-&-10¢ store. So the economical menu appealed to both of my Depression-era parents, and even though we all knew it wasn't exactly the most nutritious meal, it was such a treat!!  Long before the "you deserve a break today" jingle hit the airwaves, there was "McDonald's is our kind of place - it's such a happy place! A clean and snappy place!"  YOUR kind of place!

While I never made it a habit to eat at McDonald's, I generally enjoyed it when I did, remembering fun times with my dad and sisters (Dad loved their coffee and was a real fan of the Filet o'Fish). Over the years, it became more of a "road food" option, especially on long trips; I stopped at a lot of McDonald's on my cross-country road trips: FUTURE STREET tour ROUND TRIP tour. I did best ordering the "side salad", which could be consumed without dressing while driving. As one of the Dollar Menu items, I felt okay ordering 3 or 4 at a time and skipping the sandwich and/or fries... (tho I always had a weakness for their hot apple pies.)

A lot has changed at Mickey D's over the years - and not just higher prices and a more varied menu! I noticed the decor making a quantum shift from the familiar yellow/orange/red palette a while back when the corporation attempted to turn their outlets into "McCafes" complete with Wi-Fi.

And then the backboard menu "came alive" with a frantically changing video menu featuring huge photos of the food in fast rotation with the names and prices of same, which made it much more difficult for economy-minded folks like me to figure out what we wanted/could afford to order!

The latest wrinkle appears to be in response to the rising minimum wage paid to fast food workers; the closest McDonald's to our house has remodeled their outlet to a new design which apparently necessitates employing only half of the former staff. This remodel has an "industrial" look, to put it kindly; dark gray cinderblock walls interrupted by hyper-busy mostly black wallpaper surround the public area. There's no background music, only the mechanical hum, buzzing and clicks of unseen machines. Frankly, the ambiance is dystopian, unfriendly and feels like... McPrison.

Electronic kiosks shaped like giant iPhones stand like Stonehenge, available to take your order. In fact, this is the ONLY way you can order. Walk up to the counter and you'll be turned away, directed back to the kiosks by the attendants, whose forced-cheery greetings sound desperate and reminded me of the little waitresses working at Raisins on TV's "South Park" Since transactions cannot happen thru any other means than these kiosks, heaven forbid there's a glitch and the computer ever crashes?! (We all know that NEVER happens, but if it does... well, No Soup For You!)

McDonald's is probably not the first place most people think of when trying to lose weight, and yet the menus list the calorie counts for each food selection in large bold numbers, mostly obscuring the prices which don't show up until another few click-thrus on the kiosk. Said prices on the big board (if you're quick enough to actually see them while they flash around in a frenzy!?) don't always match the kiosk prices. And, as you might expect with all this technological "progress", ALL of the prices are substantially higher; a small hot fudge sundae that used to cost $1 is now close to $2.

The acoustics of the room are weird; while many customers were buried in their smart phones, the ones who spoke to one another were clearly audible to everyone - so much for privacy. Every conversation we overheard was about how much they didn't like these new, streamlined "improvements" to their McDonald's experience.

I have to agree. While it was never a substantial part of my diet, I didn't think that I would ever completely "age-out" of McDonald's. But apparently that day has come.

New wall signs now limit customers' visits to 30 minutes - then you'd darn well better vamoose! Lunch time is OVER! Back to your cell!

Just left Mile277.  We had the absolute worst service.  It was unacceptable how long it took for us to get our food.  Our food arrived at our table 1.5 hours after ordering.  We were not offered any discount, and the server was not apologetic. The food was so so,  and we had to eat so quickly it wasn't enjoyable at all. If you are ever at conference  at Holiday Inn Southwest do yourself a favor, and leave to get food.  It will be quicker.
This is a GREAT new park for children who are 5-12 years of age or older!   My son was too young, but with our help he was able to do the slides.    Awesome adult equipment too!!

Why do mediocre resturaunts think all shortcomings and errors can be remedied by discounting a meal......my time is worth more than $ 4....get serious ...all you had to do was your job...prepare one meal
..perhaps all that money and training was not meant for reality.

I always enjoy Riverpark Inn when we stay. They have be most beautiful outside areas. They also have a bar in the lobby which is definitely a plus. The reason we always stay here is because it's about 5 min lyft to down town bars, and that it honors military discount. Rooms are a little older but clean.  Nice place!

Wasnt impressed.. Customer service was bad.

Martinis were fabulous but small... Don't let the pictures on Yelp fool you.. They are optical illusions.. They are tiny...
But....fresh & tasty. 1 star for that. 

First off food was mediocre. I don't eat seafood, but my hubby loves it so I figured there had to be a few items I would like... Wrong! Lunch theres one non seafood item. Chicken sandwich. Server told me I could order a dinner item, steak.. Was ok, not too shabby. Mac n cheese tasted like velveeta. 

Hubbie ordered some fish plate, it was sad looking. 

Manager "Garrett" wasn't cool at all. We had our kids with us, tried to sit in the "happy hour" section, planned on having a couple drinks since we were going to be shopping for hours at the mall.. Don't allow highchairs in the section available for "happy hour".  Garrett REFUSED to give us happy hour prices because "the computer wont let him". We asked if we could walk to the bar and order, pay and walk back to table. He said "Im not going to advertise that." Total Weenie. Mike the server was cool tho, tipped him generously :) 1 star for him. 

We are Native SB peeps, wont be going back! Thanks to Garrett!

Had a heck of a time trying to find the place because my GPS kept bringing me to a vacant spot across a cemetery. When I called to get directions, ole Mr. Thanyh Pham mumbled something and hung up on me. When I called again, he did the same thing. I guess he no like speak American or was not the helpful customer friendly type. 

But based on the rave reviews of this hard core Pho joint, I had to find this joint and sample the broth. So I put my phone's GPS to work and had better luck 30 minutes later. Pulled into a typical strip shopping center with decent parking in a Viet looking part of town.

The place had all the good signs of a hard core Pho joint alright - pink walls, shiny vinyl tile floors, nasty washroom w/ketchup squeeze bottle holding liquid soap, huge one room dining room, and lots of square tables with spoons/chopsticks/napkins/sauces on top. 

A short silent stone faced guy seats me, puts a menu on the table, and brings me a glass of ice water. What, no hot tea for a fellow Asian? So I ordered a #3 with flank, tripe, fatty brisket, tendon, whatever, etc. I could never understand why Pho joints number each bowl of Pho just for omitting one ingredient. It's like if McD's put 5 burgers on their menu like this - Burger #1, plain; Burger #2, ketchup; Burger #3 mustard; Burger #4, pickle; Burger #5, pickle, ketchup, mustard and the beats goes on...

Finally got my Pho. It was hot. It was tasty. It was satisfying. It was $7.94. It was pretty good. Was it the best Pho ever? No. I've had better in Chicago and way better in LA.

Sometime ya gotta say "What da Pho?!!"

Well I would have a picture of my food to go with this review if I hadn't eaten it at the speed of light- because it was LITERALLY that good. Like you know how they say Philly Cheese Steaks are actually better if they're from Philly? Yeah, I discovered the day I went here that it's true. 100%. This place is tucked in on a corner, and upon first glance you might think it's a hole-in-the-wall that you briefly consider skipping. But don't! You would SO regret it. I had the most amazing, mouth-watering Philly cheesesteak AND veggie lovers cheese steak from here. It's worth a trip to Philly all by itself. I would give it 6 stars if I could. Quick service too.

Why aren't all pampering businesses run like this? This place is amazing! I have been a regular client for months and this place is absolute heaven! I'm going to start with the staff: Jessica and Maggie are phenomenal reservation specialists. Their customer service is unsurpassed in this field! All of the Wax Specialists are EXPERTS of their craft. Every product I have purchased is stellar! This is the place I go to spoil myself. My eyebrows have never looked better! If you want to be treated like royalty, this is the place to pamper yourself. I walk away from every experience with this location feeling like a QUEEN!

Some of my favorite snowballs come from Imperial Woodpecker!! Sometimes there is a line but it is well worth the wait! There is a little picnic table you can sit at to enjoy. I love the strawberry and tigers blood, and actually every non dairy flavor I've every tried has been amazing! I highly recommend Imperial Woodpecker for all your snowball hankerings :)

I was coming to check out the academy for my daughter but before we could get out of the car I seen an employee telling all the construction employees next door that there is no  parking and or smoking very rudely and said the police were on the way! I watched as several pulled up to work next door unknowing about parking from lack of signage but the men were congenial and simply going to work where the employee looked as if ready to argue. Them men were nice and pulled off but that struck me the wrong way and I will not do business with people that are overly aggressive especially to call the police over someone not knowing where to park. Sad to say but this experience is enough to turn me away.

Wonderful food and a great staff. I was lucky and Clyde recommended the short ribs. My God. If I lived closer I'd be back as often as I could. As is it's a monthly trip from Lancaster to Philadelphia easily.

Very over priced! Had the steak fajitas and it may have had 1oz of meat that had no taste whatsoever and was burnt. The cheese dip was bad. The brisket was cooked well, however it lacked in taste. The stars are for the server who was very nice....even though he forgot my mimosa and got it to me at the end of my meal.

The food at The Southern is fantastic; one of the best restaurants in its price range in Nashville. I have thoroughly enjoyed everything I have tried there, the atmosphere is sharp, and it's in a great downtown location. The waiters and waitresses here, however, are not very friendly. They generally act as if they hate working here, so I do wonder what the management is like. I don't like supporting places that treat their employees bad.

This location is filthy. I received my drink with coffee stains all over it. Not from my drink but from other drinks that splashed on it. The restroom is also filthy! The only cool thing about this location is all the gift card options they have. Over 50 to choose from!!! What?!?!

Great craft brewery with excellent knowledgeable service. We went in close to closing and rather than feeling like a burden we were welcomed by our friendly server. We enjoyed a flight with a great variety of beer styles. The spicy red was definitely a favorite, but they were all tasty. Out of the multiple Tucson breweries we have tried this is by far one of our favorites. I would highly recommend stopping by for a quality brew.

Jorgie welcomed me as a first time customer in such a personal way. Asked about what brought us here, what I did and shared his story of how he got into being a barber. Please ask him if you haven't heard it already. Loved the welcome from right when you walk in. Staff is fantastic and love getting a good old fashion hair cut and leaving with a modern style.

Here's a quickie review for my quick stop in:
Super chill place.
Open till 3, so great place to keep the party going after the bars.
Great service, they changed and stoked our coals without being asked.
No alcohol.
Comfortable couches.
Reasonable prices.

What more do you need? You can mix the flavors as well, I'd recommend the mint with berries. Mmmmm.

I feel a little like a poser when I talk about Thai food because the only thing I ever eat is Pad-thai. Seriously, I've been to quite a few thai places and have ordered only pad-thai. Shame on me. 

But it's just so good!!

I have to say, Sen Thai offers a great lunch-to-go, and their pad thai is definitely good. However, it isn't the best I've had, and it left me wanting a little more. I would have given it 3 1/2 stars, but decided to round down. 

The only service I've experienced has been the take-out, and they are efficient enough, but nothing special. 

I will order Sen for lunch because it is so close to my work, but I think if it weren't, I wouldn't venture there much.
My friends and I went here for a birthday dinner. Service was okay but two of us got food poisoning. Avoid.

After a cold morning of hiking we determined to try this spot as their online menu had a ton of vegan options. There's a small parking lot in front or parking around various other spots, and one entrance on the east side. We were able to be seated immediately in a space empty of other patrons, probably because we had come in an off time. It meant that we felt as if we had the space to ourselves which was actually quite nice. The waitress was friendly and helpful, and after a few questions we determined to get several of their specials. I had the Portabella mushroom vegan wrap which was filled to the brim with vegetables and had a nice mayonnaise sauce. My only regret is that I did not ask for house made potato fries instead of the bag chips that came with the sandwich. My husband got the fish and chips which were really battered and fried tofu with house made potato fries. He said it was absolutely to die for, And after sampling a few of his fries I have to agree they were very delicious. Their menu has quite a few sandwiches but a lot of other dishes so there's some thing for everyone. They have quite a few interesting vegan options as well as a soup that's either vegetarian or vegan daily. We've not heard of this place before but will definitely be back if nothing else for their vegan fish and chips!

My first and only time, I was desperate for an appointment for a pedicure on the Saturday before Labor Day.   Every part of the process felt rushed and perfunctory - the soaking, the trimming, the scraping and buffing, the painting....my feet were still rough afterwards and the polish chipped in a couple weeks.  The chairs were wonderful, however, as others have pointed out.  I won't be coming back - the prices are on the high side and both Allure on Chestnut and Cosmo's on Walnut do fabulous, long pedicures at the same price point.

I have been going to this salon for a few years. I'm not a loyal customer, I've seen at least three different stylists (I can't keep an appointment to save my life). I've always been happy here. Everyone is professional, nice, attentive, and you get a scalp massage before they wash your hair, that just can't be wrong!! All of the employees have great sort of edgy styles, tons of inspiration. They listen to what you say, and when you're like me and have no idea what you actually want, they seem to talk it through. I've always been comfortable and felt happy when I left. If you're in the area and don't want a boring, plain Jane stylist giving you a boring cut, this is the spot. (But they will do boring for you, if that's what you like!)

Website said you open at 0700.  We were there and you seemed hesitant to open as advertised stating you hadn't planned on opening until 0800 as you had a catering order to do and they're more important.  Really?   Husband ordered 12 onion.  You didn't have 12 only 10, which he asked for plus 2 pumpernickel.  You sent him home with 7 onion and 6 pumpernickel.  Again, really?   Our first time experience has been unpleasant and won't be coming back.  Husband said bagels were delicious though.  Maybe better customer service would bring your ratings up.

We went on a Monday evening, right as we arrived in town for our short vacation. We had heard Willy's burgers & brews had a great Monday evening special, but there was a wait and we were starving. Crab Daddy's looked awesome - open concept, full rooftop seating, and a huge bar. We should have known better by how empty it was. 

We sat down inside, where there were two other tables occupied. It was $5 margarita night, so my fiancé and I both had a margarita and I asked for a water. Save yourself the $5 here - they tasted like straight syrup and I can't explain the taste but they just were awful. My fiancé tried to pour more water in his to make it drinkable but we both ended up calling it quits a few sips in. Mind you, he's a tank and will drink just about anything. 

For dinner, I ordered the boom boom shrimp (a Crab Daddy's fav!) and my fiancé ordered the coconut shrimp dinner. This is after we were told they were out of crab (¿?¿). The boom boom shrimp came out in a bowl that was deceivingly filled with lettuce to make it look like more. The breading was super dense and so thick in some places that it remained doughy. The shrimp were also poorly peeled and had the tails, which isn't too big of a deal but when half do not and they're fried, I was in for quite a surprise. 

My fiancé ate his entire meal, but mostly because he was starving. His coconut shrimp were a little burnt, the fresh veggies (zucchini) were a garlic overload, and the fries were okay. 

Our server came to check on us, and we didn't verbally complain about the food/drinks at that point - but you could definitely tell we didn't drink any of our margaritas and I didn't eat my shrimp. I got Papa John's on the way home. It was great.

If you haven't been here you're missing out! They bake their breads in house, they have cute gifts and will create a basket for you if you'd like. My 'go to' is the veggie croissant and salad- amazing! Another is the turkey, bacon, avocado salad. Not only is it huge (I get a half and it's plenty) the turkey is like Thanksgiving Turkey not deli meat. They have soups, smoothies, pastries (get the salted caramel pecan praline cupcake or a mini fruit tart) and so much more.. the service is always outstanding and fast. I'm here at least once a week.

All of the other reviewers have called this place a hidden gem, and it really is. I am praying that they benefit from word of mouth, and they stick around, because restaurants in strip malls don't do very well around here. 

But this restaurant really is fantastic. It is very nice inside, and you forget that you are  on Grant Avenue, not in Center City!

It's a BYOB, but you don't even need to add alcohol to their pineapple mojito. It was so fresh and good all on its own. 

We had the Parmesan truffle yuca fries as an appetizer, and they were stacked up like Jenga and were not too salty. 

As my entree, I had the seafood ravioli, which was topped with shrimp and a great creamy prosecco sauce. It was very good. 

For dessert, I had the chocolate mousse, which was just the right size for one person, and was topped with fresh whipped cream. It was delicious! 

I can't wait to go back to this restaurant.
Amazing service.  They just opened a few weeks ago so it is still very busy,  but it is worth the wait. BEST COCKTAILS IN TOWN.

Came for the crab Rangoon nachos and the white bbq chicken sandwhich.  They were out of the nachos (and the two drinks we wanted to order) and the "white bbq" was definitely not that. The shrimp tacos were dry and not very flavorful. The buffalo shrimp were pretty good though.

My girlfriend and I came in on a weekday for lunch in Nov 2013, and just got two dozens of raw oysters...each.  Yea, that's how we do.  Service was efficient, no wait...not much for ambience, but I don't care...the oysters were so fresh and so clean clean, and shucked well.  Exactly what I wanted that day, and no need to mess with the craziness of Acme.

Nice, clean, organized, consistent big box store.  Located off of Virginia in South Reno, it is a "one stop shop" for all of your needs.  
Stopped in while waiting for some take out to be prepared.  Grabbed a few items. Since it's cold and flu season, was lucky enough to have one of the last cold and cough medicine duets left.
Was very impressed on how friendly our check out person was. LOL, she even "carded" me!   Great customer service that encourages customers to keep coming back.

So.... we moved here in April of 2020- right when COVID hit... we purchased 9 acres in the immediate area---my husband is in the film industry ... one year later- we came  into Krazy Kats to have a drink and to get a feel for the venue ( we were interested in acquiring the entire property for an event)..we were turned away at 8 pm on a Saturday b/c they were closing ... all we wanted was one drink and they turned us away despite the fact there were still patrons in the dining room ... congrats on being able to turn business away in this day and time!!
Great pizza and Stromboli's!.  Great friendly service every time I come in.  I never had a bad meal.

Party of 7--very good service and delicious, locally resourced meals and apps.  Full bar and nice atmosphere.  Went here for dinner, only complaint is the music was a bit too loud resulting in our server mishearing one of our orders.  However it was corrected without issue and overall we enjoyed our dining room experience .

I just moved to TN and was looking for a store in Clarksville. I do not feel like driving to Nashville every time I need something. I was already getting disappointed by the local selection of clothing and department stores, when accidentally I found Dillard's. The moment I walked into the store, I was greeted by a very friendly sales associate. I looked around at every department, and everything seemed very organized and nice. 

That day I was searching for some clothing, so I looked around and went to Vince Camuto and Antonio Melani departments. The sales associate that was helping me was very flexible, patient and helpful (I tried about 20 pieces of clothing since those brands were new to me). I ended up buying several things that were on 65% sale. I can't say that the selection is the best, but associates are super friendly, the store is conveniently organized, and so far it is my favorite store in Clarksville.
I never associated fried rice with Peru. Boy was I wrong. This place has the best fries rice I have ever eaten. Nice decor and great food. The papa dish was also out of this world.

You'd have better luck winning the lottery than actually getting tapioca pearls at this place. I've called FOUR times to see if they have boba and they said they did. Drove 20 min there only to be told they were out. This has happened FOUR times. A grand total of 160 min of my life and gas wasted. The employees are always shocked when I say I do not want boba without the actual boba pearls. I'm not spending over $5 on a drink that doesn't even have the main component. Needs better management. Used to be great but I've been disappointed far too many times to come back.
We had a minor repair done for our cello.  Excellent service and very reasonably priced . Thank you for being open in this pandemic!

I was so happy to get takeout from Santo Mezcal today!! Their service was lovely and they were able to serve us our to-go mango margaritas as we were waiting for the food, which wasn't more than 15 minutes even with other orders coming out. My friend got the quesadilla and I got the Enchiladas Ensenada (shrimp and fish enchiladas, melted cheese, creamy chipotle sauce, topped with mango, served with Mexican rice and salad, according to the site.)

I never opt for enchiladas when I get Mexican food but omg! It was so delicious, seriously hit the spot. The guac was expensive but honestly great serving size for 2-3 and was a great fresh addition to already yummy food. Thanks so much! See you guys next time!

Wow!! What a great dining experience we had tonight at Casey's Craft Bar Kitchen!!! Our server Conner was very friendly and worked with the chef to accommodate our requests to adjust our sides! We ordered the fish/chips and BBQ pork bowl and our dishes were so wonderful we asked to have the chef to come out so we could compliment his work!!  Chef Michael was genuinely kind and informative about upcoming events we could participate in! We live close and plan to become regulars for sure!  We also spoke with Johnathon as well and would like to say a BIG Thank You to all of them for making our night out so memorable!

Sincerely, The Bigler's

Nice place for a good filling American Chinese fusion lunch. We ordered spice level of 6 (on a scale of 1-10). I would say the spice was reasonable and we could have actually asked for 8. The highlight was Garlic Chicken, possibly due to my Asian roots - packed a punch with garlic, sauce and veggies. The garlic and orange chicken come with a side of steamed or plain fried rice. Hot and sour soup had a unique flavor - which was neither too spicy nor too warm - just the right touch. All in all good good at a very reasonable price - definitely recommend. They do serve halal - chicken and beef only.
Such a great experience! Really took the time to go through my vision and how he could make the best photos possible before we got started. LOVED the results!

These guys are great....always smiling and laughing, food is always prepared fresh and quickly.  Been here many times, but 1st review.  If your looking for a great little greek place with the traditional flare you need to check them out.

So disappointed. Not worth the $55 we spent at all. Went when they first opened and it was AMAZING from the food to the service even though they were so busy. Visited this morning and will not be returning. To start we were seated and it took ten minutes to get a water and iced tea. We quickly placed our order. The food took a very long time to come out but we knew it was worth it, WRONG! One person ordered chicken and waffles and opted to pay the extra $ for the 100% maple syrup. When her food arrived it did not come with syrup so we asked for it again. 10 minutes later still no syrup so she started eating the chicken which was the driest piece of chicken I have ever seen or tasted in my life we could not believe it and actually passed it around the table for all to test out....syrup still was not there so we asked the manager. As our waitress was about to walk over empty handed he told her to go get the syrup AND I forgot to mention the fried egg that was missing as well. Eventually she returned with the missing pieces. On to my food. I ordered the casserole with eggs on top and when it arrived I had to send it back because of how unsightly it was there was no way I was paying $12 for that. I apologized and kindly asked for a different menu item. My food arrived when everyone was already done which I had a feeling would happen. The manager never came to the table again or addressed any of the issues that were happening and to my surprise the guest who had the syrup and egg problem was still charged extra for both. Also strangely enough the whole section we were sitting in seemed to be having issues that were not being addressed and to start with the section actually remained vacant for 30 minutes of us sitting there while there was a long wait outside. So it does not appear that the wait staff was over loaded on tables...

We will never return to this location and should have opted for the fishers location. We had just been there for lunch this past week and the food and service was off the charts.

First off, we accidentally went and sat at another place by the same name which just so happens to be connected to the same which shop? Confusing! Thankfully we were directed to the right spot. 

We ordered three sandwiches, one boundin plate & two bags of chips. Everything had great flavor and interesting flavor combos. No complaints other than the cost and portion sizes. Nice spot to try!
Amazing atmosphere. Great tequila selection. Guacamole made to order. The happy hour fish tacos are my favorite

Just moved to Tampa and this is definitely a go to spot for me because the food and prices are great. My favorite is the Cuban sandwich which is massive and only costs 4 dollars. I also really like the yuka fries and the soup they sell on Fridays only.

I want to address the neighborhood comment from Veronika P first. That sums up Kensington. It is like a war zone. But it can be very amusing if you're not one to be scared off or lured into buying bootleg movies or other illegal items from the locals. It's North Philly, alright. Last time I was at the store, I saw a man on a giant tricycle, lugging around his stereo system with giant speakers on the back, for the whole neighborhood to hear. It was very funny.

Now to the store, there are some overpriced items, but I found goads of cheap dresses and shoes. Housewares is small, but I was very happy with my clothing finds. I've been having a hard time finding nice dresses at Circle, the Salvation Army in Roxborough, and the place at Aramingo in the Thriftway parking lot. To quote Veronika, it is "untapped". Go find, girls!

This place is the coolest! Everywhere you look there is something to look at! We went for a cocktail on the rooftop bar, but made sure to explore the rest of the hotel. It is like nothing you have ever seen! The rooftop bars has one of the best views of the downtown skyline and of St. Louis University's campus. Great spot for happy hour!

This is my go-to place on South Street. I know there are a lot of cozy Italian BYOs around, and that's great for the right occasion, but I'd rather hit The Latest Dish any day of the week. The restaurant is cozy, the food hasn't let me down, and the beer list is divine. I've seen beers here I haven't seen for years elsewhere. The service wasn't amazing the first time I went a few months ago. The service at the bar was great last time, though, and I left very happy and a little tipsy off of two La Fin du Mondes (Les Fins du Monde?).

The tamales are great. I mean, the place is called "The" Tamlae Place. Excellent choice. Move along please.

Great, now that you're at the front of the line, don't order a tamale. Order the nachos! The Tamale Place has the best nachos in the city. Covered in warm queso. Topped with beans and lettuce. 

If you want spicy (and you absolutely do), add the fresh serrano and jalapeno peppers and a side of hot salsita. Meat? Get the spicy and incredibly flavorful chipotle chicken. The steak option is just ok - it's not very flavorful.

it looked like everything there had been sitting for awhile.  the eggs benedict was straight up nasty.  the chicken was dry.  the eggs were watery.  but the links & bacon were good.  i didn't bother to try anything else.  

bacon - quite possibly the worlds most perfect food.

We broke out!! We had a blast this is something for anyone that loves mind games puzzles anyone and everyone would love this place!! Go check it out definitely a friendly staff and a great place to go! Worth the money! Had a great time!
Everything about this place is great.  Every dish I've had here is authentic and delicious.  Would highly recommend.

So they don't brew their own beer.  Moving on.  If you read nothing else, read this:  Ask for Marny.  She was our server and was outstanding.  She made the evening fantastic for us.  We sat outside on a Friday night and were very impressed with their set up.  We chose a table at the far end under the umbrellas where we sat for hours undisturbed.  The sun was hot so Marny moved the umbrellas a few times to keep us in the shade.  I ordered a beer but when it was given to me, Marny pointed out that she thought it didn't look right and asked my opinion.  When I agreed, she took it back and gave me different beer of my choice for no charge.  Really?  Who does that?  I was so impressed because it was obvious she was committed to making sure we were happy.  

I ordered the lettuce wraps and thought they were very tasty.  The sauce was flavorful and the crunchy wontons on top added good texture.  My friends ordered the appetizer platter and seemed to enjoy it.  I snuck one of the coconut shrimp off their plate and thought it was tasty.  

Yes, the food is overpriced but overall I had a great experience and will return to sit outside with Marny as my server.

It took me a long time to write this post but I am writing this in hopes of helping someone else from experiencing the care I did with Center for Womans Health. First off I wish I would have checked this Facebook before going there any business that has so many 1-3 ratings regardless of how many 5 stars should be a red flag. I am also disappointed with reading through how the staff responds to patients and tells them they are wrong etc. very bad PR.

I went to this center for regular obgyn care and I never had an issue and then I became pregnant with my first baby. This was such an exciting time for me- early on in my pregnancy I was bleeding very badly- my first bad experience starts with the obgyn nurse I  will not write her name out of respect as I do not want anyone to lose their job although I was treated very poorly, my hope is that she sees this and knows who she is and treats other patients accordingly. I would call in tears and was constantly told "this is not an emergency" bleeding is normal and if it's bad go to the er there is nothing we can do. They wouldn't let me come in to ease my mind nor would they let me be connected to a doctor. 

Needless to say in the course of three months I went to the ER total of 7 Times. I went in once they fit me in. I spent thousands of dollars in Co pays which isn't the point but the best is after all my ER visits which I'm sure my obgyn was notified each time not ONCE did a doctor call me to follow up, see how I was feeling etc.

Long story short my experience ended with the worst as I miscarried but that is only the beginning of this disaster. I went into the doctors after miscarried and was manually checked. The doctor pressed on my stomach and asked if anything was tender and told me ok bleeding may be normal for the next two weeks. Well the bleeding continued and there were days I couldn't even stand up. At this point I stopped going to the ER as I was only going so much before because I was obviously nervous about my baby. Three weeks after I miscarried I was rushed to the hospital with terrible pains that I can't even begin to explain. The hospital told me I was going into labor regardless of me having a baby as I had so much left Over remains in me. They said "your doctor didn't do an ultra sound or take your levels to make sure everything was gone". I know this may sound like ignorance on my part but this was my first pregnancy ever and I had no idea you could have "placenta" stuck in you or you had to deliver it. I spent three weeks in agonizing pain while mourning the lost of my first baby. This all could of been avoided if I was given the proper care and checked.  this makes me cry just writing this review. 

I had to have an emergency dnc almost on the spot because of this. It was just a lot of trauma at once. There was no compassion from so many doctors and people in this office as many people have stated in their reviews. Although I want to be as mature as possible and shout out the good care I actually did experience - Dr. Walker who I only saw once was so nice and comforting she talked to me showed compassion and even stated that she is not sure why they didn't do an ultra sound after my miscarriage or check my levels and admitted if she saw me that day she absolutely would have. I also had a nice experience with Dr. Berk who was also not my main doctor and showed a lot of compassion to me and performed my surgery which gave me no problems. Also the surgical scheduler woman was beyond nice I had surgery two times once not related to pregnancy and I always remember her claiming me down telling me I would be ok. She was honestly a great person.

As I went back in for my next visit my main doctor who I have been seeing for maybe three years I was emotional about what happened and I expressed to him how I felt like my experience was the practice was horrible and I asked him doctor can you please tell me why I went to the er 7 Times and no one Checked in with me he said "if I checked in with every patient I would be too busy to do my job" the last question I had for him was "why was I not given and US after my miscarriage?" His response was "you told us you passed the fetus we took your word for it and when that happens it is usually not needed" Them responses right there made me immediately get my records and switch to A new practice. I could never imagine being pregnant again and dealing with this ever! 

I am begging any new moms who see this or parents who are thinking of sending their children here pleAse reconsider no matter how close or convenient this place may be. Maybe if you had a normal pregnancy with no complications this place was ok but if you are dealing with an issue this is not the place you want to be.

As I said it took me months to be ok to write this but I feel as if I should I want to help out anyone else from experiencing this type of care :(

Gone downhill.  Went this past Friday for Seafood buffet.  The available seafood was OK, nothing memorable.  The prime rib was beyond well done, the ribs were burnt and dry, the brisket was dry.  The only item that was still good was the gelato.
Wow what an exquisite sandwich menu they have here! Great selection, remarkable quality and they have KOMBUCHA ON TAP (three of them) that go great with anything you order, it's an amazing thing!!!
Reopened as Desi Vega's Steakhouse, but much more than a typical steakhouse.  Same phone.

This is only about the SERVICE. FOOD IS GOOD.
Im a long time customer of the this restaurant . I Have been going there for the fried rice dishes . The rice dishes are good but the Service from the Vietnamese lady who looks like the owner or owners family or wife doesnt know how to treat customers . First she brings and dropps the menues on the table.(rude). Then she comes takes the order brings the food and just throws the plate on the table. (Everytime i get served by her) is this the infamous TAMMY that everyone is complaining about? I wanst even bothered to even ask her name. I know she is asian. There are some hispanic servers and they are fine and have smiles on their faces. This other lady shouldnt work anywhere if she has this kinda attitude . People come to this restaurant not to see someones attitude. What a shame even with all the BAD REVIEWS ABOUT THE SERVICE the owner has failed to do justice to service part of his restaurant.
I usually dont write bad reviews on anything just for one time. I have been a customer for years with them and ive had it.
BTW the owner is a good guy .

Nugget Bar & Grill

Decided to check this place out for dinner with the guys while we were out here in Goleta working on a project. 

The place is not huge and the parking, let's face it is even worse so plan accordingly. The wait was not long surprisingly even for a party of 4. 

They did happen to take a while to get our drink order and by the time the waiter came through we ordered our meal as well. Our food came out shockingly fast. 

Everything was picturesque to say the least, but full of flavor. Everything from burgers to fried chicken was cooked perfectly. 

The ambience seemed to say it was more of a local hangout spot for all ages and the place to be even on a Thursday night. Nonetheless it was a decent night and I would probably still come back again.

Food was amazing.  Chef made us an off menu dish that was incredible.  Bacon dates will blow you away. 
Will be back

What can I say about Chuy's? The food is good and the service is great.  If you've never been here you should go. You will walk out feeling like family. The owner makes it a point to meet everyone and to make sure they feel like they belong here.
Try the halapeno margarita. I know it sounds weird but it's delicious.
The way they serve food is a bit different and takes a minute to figure out as everything is plates. You wont find the typical tacos, burritos and chimichangas that you are used to and to many people this will feel a bit strange. But once you settle in to the setup you will find simple authentic mexican food that is comforting.
I do wish that they had burritos. I think the carnitas i had would have been great in a burrito.
All in all a nice birthday dinner.

I just love the new safeway south of town.
I went in for some fresh flowers.  They really do have a wonderful assortment of beautiful flowers, plants and balloons.  I found everything I needed.  I  checked out. 
The cashier was very friendly and I  was in and out and quickly.

My 3 roomies and I hit this place up at least 3 times a week. The shakes are amazing; fruity pebbles and anything peanut butter are my faves. It's a health alternative to other smoothie places and it's truly a meal replacement. The teas have replaced my expensive Starbies habit and it's way less calories. 

While the shakes and teas are on point the staff and owner is the icing on the cake. Rachel and her team are a breath of fresh air, have excellent customer service, and take pride in what they do every day. 

Go support a local business and get healthy!!
This bar is fantastic. The food is great and the atmosphere is everything you want in a beach bar. Couldn't recommend a better place to hang out in St Pete beach.

We went on Saturday night, just 2 of us, and was many parking spots outside but was very surprised to hear of over an hour wait.  We found 2 spots at the bar so we decided to eat there.  The bartender was excellent once we realized she was pretty much the ONLY one there serving the 12 or so bar spots along with all the waiters orders for their tables!  She suggested the Miso glazed salmon and it was AWESOME!  My husband loved his too.  Shame that this poor girl was alone but she worked  her butt off serving everyone.  I sure hope that they don't normally only have 1 bartender and maybe someone called in sick but it was a shame.  She was a trooper and worked very hard and that made it a great experience for us!

Fo' Shizzle?!!!??!!!! This is one of the greatest spots in South Tampa!!

The pan seared sea scallops here are to die for!! Fun ambiance, great servers full of personality, and incredible food...... this truly is my kind of place. 

I ended up here one night around 9PM.... reading reviews on Yelp led the path to this beautiful discovery. This place was popping, all of the tables were full, however there was a booth available in the bar, which had my name written all over it. I started out with a pinot noir that was recommended to me by my server, it was fantastic. I love when the servers know their menu and are comfortable sharing their honest opinion - with confidence.. These servers know what they're talking about and they get a big thumbs up for that. 

The food I ate (and LOVED).... well, I am a harsh judge when it comes to scallops. They have to be "jumbo".. I mean really jumbo, the searing must be done to perfection, I even look for presentation. I am a dork when it comes to scallops, but in honesty.. these are the things that make for a perfect scallop. Pane Rustica hit every nail on the head and blew me away! Although I fell in love at first bite with these scallops, I must give a shout out to the short ribs, because they were unbelievable as well. So tender and full of flavor!! MMmmmm!!! 

I can't wait for another opportunity to get over there for another meal... I'm very curious and interested to see what they have to offer on the  lunch menu, but I've yet to make it there during the day. When I do I will be updating this review, promise! Their dinner menu is very impressive and there are many different things I yearn to try - they also have a seasonal menu which is going to make it even harder on me next time, the anxiety is building!

This is the type of spot that you can close your eyes and point to a random meal on the menu and know you're getting something incredible. I'm soooo looking forward to eating and enjoying the little pieces of heaven Pane Rustica whips up for their guests!!

Simply put, this place is out of this world.

We had a group of 7 and did the tasting menu.  I cannot remember the names of most of what we ate, but they were excellent.

The raw lamb was the real winner in my book...  Don't be scared to get it.  It really is excellent.

Our bill was $95/person with tip but we ordered several drinks and a few bottles of wine.  

The dinner took about 2 hours for a group our size with tasting menu.
Chris was awesome! Very Knowledgable about Tucson, the food, and the bars! Highly recommend...you will get to know Tucson and enjoy it at the same time!

Cute place with a chill vibe and really good food and lavender lattes! Vegetarian vegan options available! Oat milk for dairy replacer. They also made me a sweet little kids lavender iced drink so my toddler could feel like she was getting a special coffee too (iced oat milk with a pump of lavender) the avocado toast had amazing enoki mushrooms on top which was really different and good! My wife's veggie wrap was also very flavorful and she said she would order again.  Also loved the dressing on the salad. WiFi available and cute stickers and candles also available
Great Location and staff. Plenty of classes and events. Clean with the only proper steam room in town. I love this place and go almost everyday for a great workout, swim, shave, shower etc...

We visited the Opryland this year to shop and look at the christmas decorations.

It seems like even the Opryland scaled back on the decoration this year. We were a little disappointed, unlike in previous years, it wasn't much of a winter wonderland.

I love to shop at Savannah's for Christine Alexander clothes and now they have a new shop called Angels and Cowboys. I wish I could have afforded some of the clothes in there, but they were beyond my meager budget, especially after already shopping at Savannah's......

Parking is really outrageous, we were only there for 2 hours and it's 18.00 no matter if you drive and drive out, or stay the whole 24 hours.

Place was clean and the service was very nice! Enjoy the food and it surprised that they had like four different flavored ketchup on stock. There are other menu items that I'm willing to come back and try out!

I am not sure what is is about this location. I have been an Aladdins customer for at least 8 years. I frequent to other location. One day my friends and I went to this location. We were there for approximately 20 minutes when the server came over and told us the owner asked that we leave. We asked why, and they said we were loud. We were not loud. It was a Wednesday night.  Only about 5 guests were present. It is my assumption that the owners only want certain customers to visit this location. I assume that they are racist. I have never been asked to leave any establishment. Horrible experience. I will never visit either location ever again.

I'd you're looking for an awesome day outside, this is your spot. Starting from the Mt. Rose parking lot puts you a good 2.5 hours from the summit without snow. If you've got to contend with snow, make sure to get an early start. 

This hike has tons of views so don't forget a camera. But also don't forget sunscreen  if you get tired of the weekend crowds on the main trail don't be afraid to check the less traveled side trails around the summit area. 

Dog  friendly
I've only ever been here for breakfast and my mouth is watering just thinking about it!  Great neighborhood spot and treats the cops great! Highly recommend!

Okay I was sitting in Philly today and had a craving for some drunken noodles...checked yelp of course and had hit places that were open.  A LOT of places don't open till 4-5pm.  Anyways, this joint pops up so I put in the Navi, and start driving.  Now mind you, when I'm spur of the moment like this, I look for a place with 4 stars or better with a TON of ratings, that's when you know it's gonna be good!  

Well let me tell you, when I pulled up to the place, I almost kept driving.  It looked like one of those little corner Chinese joints that you can find all over the city.  However, I had trust in my fellow Yelpers so I pulled over and went in.  There was no seating, apparently they have a sit down side next door that opened at 4...lol.  Who knows.  So I ordered my drunken noodles level 3 hotness and a Thai tea.   Everything came to like 10$.  I peaked in the kitchen while they were cooking and all I saw was ALL FRESH VEGETABLES....Good sign.  They had my food ready in 5 mins and since there was no seating I sat on the stoop and dug in(see picture) ....Let me sum everything up for you in one word....SLAMMMMMING!!!!  Dude, this place is no joke, probably my top 3 drunken noodles of all times, which I've had a LOT!!!!!!  If not this is number 1....that's a bold statement coming from me, but I'm going there.  I challenge anyone in the city, show me where I can get better, and I'll buy you a 50$ gift card for any restaurant of your choosing.   That's how sure I am.  I have no more to write, I hope you got the point....

Love this publix stickily because it's rarely ever busy! Parking lot is spacious and it offers all the wonderful customer service you would expect at any publix supermarket. Just off if dale mabry, this place is easily accessible.
You have got to stop in for the shrimpfest lunch or dinner menu. What a great meal, filling n tasty. If Carlos is your waiter, he will always be ready to keep your drinks filled. He's a GREAT waiter.

I found it to be pretty good pizza.  The crust was not soggy and they supplied ample toppings.  I tried dine in, but preferred delivery.  It seems the pizza delivered to my hotel was hot and fresh.  To complement the restaurant, the pizza arrived in around 20 minutes or so!  Thanks again for the fantastic pepperoni and sausage pizza.  My only complaint is that the pizza was way too big for one person!  Kudos!

Come here for drinks. Food is fine, but drinks are the purpose of this place. A fishbowl will get you lit if that is what you're going for. My cousin and I enjoyed ourselves and the drinks are solid for an easygoing happy hour on the patio. It's a bit out of the way of everything, but worth a visit. Dine outside on their covered patio. Inside might be a little covidy because the server folding the napkins and silverware didn't wear her mask until we walked into the establishment.
Great flavors, wonderful taste and consistency.  Staff is terrific. You can't do better.

Simple diner food.  The service is friendly but a bit slow.

There's no a la carte menu for breakfast and pretty much everything comes with pork so if you don't dig on swine I guess you just go without.

We had lunch for this reason.

I had an open face BBQ beef sandwich.  The Mrs. had the fried cod plate.

Both were a bit bland but the portions were generous.

The place is fine.  Not bad.  Not great.

3 stars.

My fiancée and I recently took a cooking class here, and we had a blast! We took "Pasta in Every Way, Shape, and Form" with Nathan Hatch, chef at Trattoria Marcella, and now we're basically pasta pros (kidding, but we're getting there.)

I wasn't really sure what to expect since every cooking class I've been to has been so very different from one another, but we had a ton of fun. Get there early so you can secure your seat next to your +1... the classes are small, so you'll get to know the people around you. We were welcomed warmly, aproned up, and were ready to learn.

Chef was great and did an excellent job leading, and the Kitchen Conservatory team was great as well. It was a bit disorganized at times and we couldn't always find what we were looking for. Something to note: this isn't a step by step situation. Everyone was divided up into different "jobs", and there was a lot going on at all times. It was definitely more collaborative than I was expecting, but that's not a bad thing.

Look, I'm used to drinking a lot of wine during cooking classes, but be prepared that the wine won't be broken out until you're eating the meal. It's fine and probably more civilized, but again, something to note. I'm sure you could open it earlier but then you're that person drinking by yourself.

We made three pastas, learned a ton of techniques, and everything tasted SO GOOD. We ended up buying the damn pasta maker and every accessory we needed, so what started as a decently affordable class turned high dollar. It was worth it! 

We'd do this again for sure.

This is a great place for competitive and casual gamers to meet up at! Every time I go I have new competition and it definitely helps to keep my skills sharp. I always have a great time there and I recommend gamers casual or vets to give this place a shot. Also if you're ever hungry the lounge is located in Irvington with plenty of food choices.

I have been going to this Salon for 3 years now, and this is the first time I am extremely disappointed with them and their costumer service.

Back in November, I called them to ask if they did hair for weddings.  They told me I would need to speak to the owner and come in with pictures of the girls' hair.  I came back in in December with most of my bride's maids and pictures they had of the hair style they wanted, along with hair accessories they wanted to use.  We walked in and the receptionist was very rude and told us we would need to come back when the owner was present.  That's hard to do with 7 bride's maids who all live in different states.

I called back later in December and was told to make an appointment in February.  I put an alert in my phone to call them on February 1st and I did.  The owner was not there and I was told to call back the next day when he was in at 11:00am.  I called back, and he was busy with a customer and I was told he would call me back.  I waited a few days, no call.  I called again, and I was given the same story that he would be in the next day at the same time to work with a customer.  Again, I was told he would call me back.  He did not.  This went on for about a week until he finally answered and gave me his email address.  He gave it to me so fast and with such jumbled wording that I wondered if he even knew I was trying to write it down.  I had to ask him for it 3 or 4 times and he did not sound happy that he had to repeat himself.  He ended the conversation quickly, hanging up before I could even finish my last sentence.

I emailed him pictures and information about the wedding.  He never responded.  I called again.  They said his email wasn't working and asked if I could text him.  The email was very involved as I have myself, 7 bride's maids, my mother and my soon to be mother-in-law.  I told them this was impossible since the email was very involved.  They asked if I could come in to meet with him, and I asked what times and they said during the week between 11am-1pm.  I work as a teacher so those hours are impossible and it didn't seem as though it was negotiable on their part.

They asked me to send the email again, and I did.  He responded, but it was very hard to read.  His grammar made it very difficult to understand what he was saying.  He had a general time of when we should start the hair and a price for all the girls.  Nothing about a deposit or overall price, just individual prices and a general time to start.  I emailed him back with questions and asking if we could book a time, no response.

I texted him and he responded to that and mentioned a deposit.  I asked him how much it would be (a deposit did not surprise me, but since he had not mentioned it before I wanted to know how much it was).  He didn't respond, so I texted him again the next night and he told me, "He was sure he sent this all in a prior email".  He did not.  His emails came off as if he didn't care and was simply responding on his phone when he had the time.

The prices also didn't match up with the overall price he was going to charge me.  My fiance and I sat down and added the numbers 3 different ways and tried to compare it to the end price he gave me and it just didn't add up.  The prices were fair and I would have been willing to pay them if I felt as though he would have even shown up the day of the appointment.


Overall, I was upset at the lack of communication, the fact that I had to pester him to get any response and when they did respond, it seemed to be with little to no interest.  I was going to be giving them a lot of money, and the least I would have liked back was to work with my schedule and at least respond with full details through a coherently written email.  If they weren't able to accommodate such a large party on such an important day, then they should have just said that and i wouldn't have wasted a month of my life trying to set an appointment with them for the most important day of my life.

I got my Macbook 13" screen fixed here. Jamal, Janelle, Gamble, Chris, and John were all awesome. The price was as good as it was going to get compared to anywhere else. I HIGHLY recommend them for electronic repairs. Also, Janelle set my iPhone X up with a screen protector which she put on flawlessly. Thank ya'll!

27.95 for automatic car wash and still my car wasn't clean or dryers properly. I had a handful of trash that wasn't vacuumed. I'm used to a real hand car wash where they take pride in detailed work. St. Louis, you need to step it up. Poor service, they did try to rectify the problem.
This place is awesome! Had a party of 40 people and Tina was an incredible server! She was so attentive and personable! The music was great and the drinks were delicious! Good time for sure!

I don't normally drive almost an hour from my house to go eat and drink when there are dozens of places 15 minutes away, but three dear people who served me very well at another Sidelines which has since been sold ended up in Avon.  I saw two of them on Friday night, and we were very glad to see each other.  And needless to say the service was great and the food good as well.  I just had potato skins and they came out quickly and were good.  I was sitting at the end of the bar next to the servers area, and I could tell the other servers were on top of it with other people.  Lots of TVs to watch the NCAA and other sports, a DJ on Friday and a roomy area to dance and for bands (on Sat) to play, poker on Tue.  Even with a lot of people it is so roomy and doesn't feel crowded.  Yes it can be smoky and I can do without it, but it is what it is.  As long as people whom I can count on are there to serve, I will gladly come back.
We just left after enjoying an amazing lunch! Chicken shrimp fried rice and chicken stir fry! Mindy was sweet and was very attentitive. Plus the entire menu and Thai tea was the best!

First time visiting, and my daughter found you guys by accident. We were heading to a Carl's Jr, and she noticed a burger/shake joint while we were stopped at the light. We were glad we decided to give you guys a try, because honestly you guys have some of the best tasting fast food we have ever eaten. Not to mention the service was fast and the employees were very pleasant and helpful.

Came for lunch and both the food and service were excellent!  I was with a party of four and we were seated immediately.  I ordered the Shanghai Juicy Pork Dumplings for an appetizer and they were delicious- juicy, warm, and the dumpling dough wasn't too thick.  For my entree I ordered the honey walnut shrimp and it was really nice.  The shrimp were a nice size and they each came with a candied pecan which was a really delicious burst of flavor and texture.  These resembled the creamy shrimp that you can get from the hot food bar at Wegmans, but better.  We got creme brulee to share  for dessert which was also very good, though not necessarily the best creme brulee I've ever had.

The restaurant looks nice, it's elegant with fancy lighting, tablecloths, and other little details.  Our server was absolutely superb, too.  He brought out some complimentary tea and it was delicious.  He was telling us interesting facts about the tea and when we finished that pot he brought a new one out for us to sample.  You can tell that he really cares about the food and has very high attention to detail.  I'd love to come back for their tea service to learn more about the different teas that they serve here.  You won't be disappointed with Hong Kong Fusion.

This is such beautiful venue in the heart of downtown Indy. The team running the venue is wonderful and the bartenders are superb! From the stained glass, to the wood floors the historic charm of The Sanctuary is unparalleled. I have been to this venue a couple times and would most definitely return again - way more fun than a basic ballroom venue.

I live close by and I've heard great things about this place, as well as see their ratings reflected on Yelp. I came in for a walk-in and was told I'd be waiting about 20 minutes. This was mid-day on a Wednesday and it was fully packed and all technician busy! I was hoping for both a pedicure and manicure within a 2 hour period but sadly waited 40 minutes before being seated for the pedicure and I wasn't able to fit in my manicure. The pedicure was just alright to say the least and it didn't seem to last a long time before chipping.

I'd say try to make a reservation before hand if you'd like to try this place.

What I did like is that they had their own ATM in their location so it says you from driving somewhere to provide a tip.
recommended for family bonding activity, or group activity, don't take your date here if you don't want her to find out you have body odor.
The best there is! Clean eating and I'm not a vegan but definitely could be if all meals taste like this!

I was glad to learn that the restaurant at the Morris House was reincarnated yet again with a new chef who promises to use lots of local and sustainable products.  

I love the intimate bar area at the entrance of the restaurant and the restaurant itself is small and beautiful , with well-spaced tables and very comfortable chairs.  The menu is small but diverse, prices are on the higher end.  The smoked butternut soup was rich and earthy, the tartar of sahimi of hamachi fresh if a little too cold to relinquish all its flavor.  The braised and glazed short ribs were our best entree, intensely flavorful and very satisfying.  The chicken was of good quality and roasted nicely but the skin was flabby instead of crisp, always a drawback with chicken.  

The biggest issue we had was the temperature of the plates - none of the food was really hot and some items were less than tepid when arriving at the table.  Heating the plates would really improve the dishes a great deal.  Another improvement would be a simplified approach to accompanying side dishes, presently too many and not well-enough integrated into a unified taste experience.  What sounds adventurous and special in the description (on paper and by the waitress) tuns out to be more underwhelming on the plate - a bit like the Stone Henge set-up in Spinal Tap.

The cheese plate is excellent, with a fine selection of interesting cheeses, both from Europe and the US, served at ideal stages of ripeness and with fine chutneys and other embellishments.  The service is attentive and nice, qualities easily outweighing a lack of experience.

The restaurant presently deserves 3.5 stars but because of support of local farmers, I go with the four instead of three available category.
