We really enjoy this restaurant. Good quality Italian food, very consistent, and just what we're looking for when we want Italian. The atmosphere is very pleasant with white tablecloths and comfortable seating. Cocktails are well prepared and my husband always enjoys a Chianti with his meal. Our servers have always been pleasant and attentive. When we arrived late on a weekday recently, it was clear they were about to close up, but they welcomed us with open arms and didn't make us feel rushed. We love this place!

Good food and surprisingly good service. The menu is huge, probably too big. I've been happy with most everything I've gotten like Bulgogi beef or pork, Kalbi ribs, all except for Katsura chicken which was waaaay over cooked and hard like rubber. Could barely eat it, maybe it was a one time oversight, and I'll be back to check. But 4/5 for me and my family's taste.
Best ever broiled and raw oysters.  Really meaty.  The break served with the raw oysters is somewhat dry but goes well with the buttery delicious sauce.

Stopped into Home Goods yesterday after my open house. It's conveniently located at Broadway & Kolb, and if you're trying to decorate a house, it's a good place to pick up odds and ends. I've found interesting things here to use for home staging, as well as fun things for my own home. 

Recently I purchased a lovely wind chime for $30, large sized Yankee Candles for $10, good biscotti for $4, and a pound of gourmet coffee for $6. You can save some serious money over retail & grocery stores (for the gourmet food items). They have a lot of comparable merchandise to Bed, Bath, & Beyond at much lower prices. 

It's one of those type of stores that you have to pop into every now and then just to see what they have, as their selection is constantly changing. They also have a new location in Oro Valley, on Oracle Road, just south of Magee. 

In addition to gourmet food products, I've also bought some silk plants, wine glasses, and towels here. The prices and the quality are good and consistent, and the selection is usually good too... They also sell some select furniture (no couches or beds) and a lot of framed artwork, mirrors, and lamps. The clearance section is fun & (if it's not too picked over), you can find some great bargains!

This was my husband and I first time trying Jordan's. The food was fresh and delicious. Check out the photos and see the amount of food you will receive. Definitely worth every penny. My husband ordered the Whiting Fish. Delicious. I ordered the Catfish. Delicious. If your in the Indianapolis area. Check them out. Customer Service was Awesome.

I have been to this salon 3 times. On my second visit I scheduled the appointment 2 weeks in advance for the morning of my rehearsal dinner. They knew this was my wedding nail appointment but when I arrived they tried to get me to come back hours later as my technician was with a walk in. I refused and waited 45 minutes for my appointment.
Fast forward 2 weeks, and I made an appointment for 1:30. My technician didn't finish with prior customer until 1:40, I was getting my toes painted while waiting. When I finished 4 minutes later, he took a walk in, then told me his 2 o clock was here and it was my fault that I couldn't be seen! Again, they did not honor my appointment. I left due to how unprofessional they were. There will not be a fourth visit.
Just had dinner here- by far the best Indian food in the area. The butter chicken was so tender and delicious. Shrimp was great too!

This is a really good place at a good value.  I would recommend this for lunch and or dinner.  The Sushi is fresh and they deliver.  Good creativity with their specials and very nice service.  I hope they make it and would recommend it to anyone.

This was a great place for kids and adults alike. We didn't have to go all the way to Clearwater beach and our kids got to have some fun. They had wake boarding and a water obstacle course. Clean beach area for the little kids and a snow cone food truck was a added bonus
Horrible customer service. The cashier was screaming just because I asked for some napkins.

I've become a regular here. The food is delish and the prices are amazing. It's become my cheat meal. :-) I dream about the black pepper chicken with fried rice. The chicken satay skewers are really great as well. It has a great homey, mom & pop, hole-in-the-wall feel.

Okay...WOW! Second time getting a cake from here and I can't wait to keep coming back! Their cakes are so moist and flavorful without at all being too sweet! Starting with the chocolate cake, I was at first a little scared of it just being way too overwhelming but everything fit so well together! The cake itself was moist, the buttercream was light enough that it made you want to scoop up another bite! And I don't even know how they did this but they added chocolate chips in it that gave it just a little bit of crunch that was both fun and delicious! 

The pumpkin cake on its own deserves a paragraph of its own cause it was just so good! I've never been a big fan of pumpkin spice or espresso but this cake found a way to incorporate both flavors perfectly. The pumpkin spice had a sweet yet savory taste, almost like what you'd imagine fall to taste like and the buttercream had just a little bit of bitterness that countered the pumpkins sweetness. 

Both the cakes were decently sized that we even had leftover dessert for the next day. Can't wait to try out some more of their surely fantastic flavor combos!

We get gyros as a pick up order more regularly than I'd like to admit. The staff is always super friendly. The food is delicious. The pricing is reasonable. They have a an appetizer that's a flaming cheese thing and it is magical. Obviously not something we get to go.

very friendly and great people always helping!

my favorite place to get my eye check & beautiful people.

Pleasantly surprised by what the Grand Plaza has to offer. Being that this is an older hotel I was a little skeptical when we first got here. I was here for an on-site wedding and had a great time. The view of the beach is spectacular and the outside area of this hotel on the beach is perfect.

We stayed in the pent house and the view was breath taking. They have 24 hour room service, we got a few bottles of champagne during the our stay and the bottle service was very professional. The wedding coordinator was very organized and we were not in the dark about anything. 

Everyone on the staff was friendly, helpful, and accommodating. I would definitely recommend the Grand Plaza for either your next event or just a couple nights on the beach!!

The Corn Crab Bisque was thin, everything in it was over-soft as if it had been sitting too hot too long. The Cochon pork was good, moist and tasty. The sausage was smoky but otherwise rubbery and forgettable. I had the bread pudding which came in a ramekin,  was at least 24 hours since it had been put together. It was nuked, the exterior was as hard as granite and the interior was cold. Yuck. Maybe I made a mistake ordering the special but I was mostly disappointed.  The service was good (it was a Tuesday night) and the bar served a good martini.

Why is that EVERY time I order chicken fingers that I have to pull forward to wait?  Whether I order one order or 5 have to pull forward. Whether there's a car behind me or not I have to pull forward. Why is that? Chicken is a fairly common item that I would think would not take 15 minutes to deep fry. On top of having to wait when they bring the food out to you most times there is no sauce in there and you still have to go inside to get whatever dipping sauce you want for your chicken. I have 4 Kids and I cannot leave them in the car to go back inside to get my sauce.  Overall the drive-thru at this particular Steak and Shake is very poor. The inside of the restaurant is also in bad shape. There are dirty bathrooms & dirt tables and dirty seats. It is unfortunate that my kids love Steak n Shake and to avoid catastrophic meltdowns I am forced to experience this on a weekly basis.
I just got a Harley from sam's and it runs great very friendly service and had no problems what so ever.
Front desk is unprofessional. They are too busy to meet the needs of their patients. Laura specifically is rude and unprofessional.

Big fan of chipotle. This location cut back soo much on the portion that I actually mentioned it to the manager, who didn't care to listen btw.  Not ever going back there as this is the first time that I felt ripped off. If you want rice beans and lettuce bowl with 8 half inch pieces of beef then i recommend.

Monsoon has been one of my favorites if not my favorite restaurant in town for over 10 years. The owner, Nick, is just a magnificent person and a fantastic restaurant owner. He actually came to my house and cooked for my 40th birthday several years ago. Used our backyard grill and created amazing food on the fly....he's that talented. The food at Monsoon is always amazing. Fried calamari, beef salad rolls, sea bass, salmon, the best curry around and the shaking beef will literally MELT in your mouth. Everybody I bring to the restaurant absolutely loves it. And his cocktails are out of this world! Get the Monsooni is you like martinis. He also makes a mojito with lichee that is out of bounds! Bring a group and everyone will love something different.

Huge pancakes! Short stack with a side is plenty for even a hungry teenager. Bacon was crispy and flavorful, not too salty. Meat lovers omelette was spot on. Good prices. Closed on Mondays now. Home fries in pic for reference.

Fine facility for concerts and other performances.

The only slightly annoying thing is the restrooms are all downstairs. During intermission everyone gets corralled downstairs in a huge line, kind of like how the wildebeests line up to cross the river full of crocodiles on their annual migration.

Parking is easy and cheap - often free. I can get there, park, and be inside in 5-10 minutes.

First let me start by saying that I have eaten here about 30 times.  The food is absolutely delicious and the chips and salsa that they give you while you wait for your order to arrive are to die for.  Up until recently, I have been a very loyal, frequent customer.  If it weren't for the food, this place would deserve 0 stars.
However, in the past year or so I have noticed a severe decline in customer service.   The first time I really noticed was my birthday.  We had a party of about 7 and we ordered a lot of expensive food and drinks.  It wasn't even that late in the evening but our waiter started rushing us, hovering around the table, and clearing away plates and half-empty glasses of margarita before we were even finished.  It was a really annoying experience to have on my birthday.
Just yesterday I made the mistake of choosing to make a reservation here for my boyfriend's birthday.  It was a party of 9 and we requested to be seated in a particular room that is quieter than the rest of the restaurant.  They said that they would make a note of that in our reservation.  When we arrived for our dinner, they said that they would not be able to seat us in that room because there was no note of our request.  IT THEN TOOK THEM 45 MINUTES TO SEAT US.  They finally ended up seating us in the room we'd requested since I made a fuss to the manager about what a crappy experience we were having.
One last small thing...The waitstaff was definitely aware that it was my boyfriend's birthday as it was mentioned several times.  They typically give a special complimentary tequila shot to someone celebrating their birthday there and I saw this being done for someone else while we were eating,  however they skipped that for us.
In conclusion, don't even think about about taking a large party here since they clearly don't like it.  In general you may want to consider a different restaurant if good service is important to you.

Flavor of India doesn't disappoint.

What we like, yes all their lovely dishes.

Staff is super friendly and most helpful every time.

Their wonderful food can be prepared how you like, just let them know!

Love the appetizers, all super yummy.

Go for it, enjoy.

Nothing but problems!  Broken dryer for 3 weeks now!  I've been a homeowner for 26 years and have never had such difficulty getting an appliance fixed! Too many issues to write about...I Just keep getting the run around!  I'm definitely canceling and never going back!

The staff is very helpful, knowledgable, and friendly.  I love keeping up with the current beers on tap via their FaceBook, too.  While, the beer is expensive, it's on par with other places that have this good a selection.  I only wish the food were little better, but nonetheless, I'm a regular and I recommend all my friends come here.  Great spot.

Restaurant is nice and clean. Hostess/waitress was very friendly, almost motherly. I came for Pho..because duh..it's called Pho 54! its was hot spicy and refreshing due to the mix of hot broth, noodles, fresh herbs and peppers. She suggested goi rolls..they didn't dissapoint..so fresh tasting. I will return!

Love this place! Been here many times. Outdoor patio in the summer is gorgeous. Atmosphere is great, staff is friendly and efficient. The food is phenomenal. Always fresh, wonderful flavors, not too heavy on seasonings and the menu has so many options.  Never disappointed!

My husband and I visited Zed's for a beer after hearing a lot of positive feedback about the selection. I had a flight of In Ireland, Black and Gold, Copper Cream, and on the Liffey. By far, I loved the Black and Gold the most, but the Copper Cream was also excellent. The beers here were supreme. 

I also like the space, but it's a little small. We got there super early, so we were able to get a table. As we stayed it started to get really crowded and people were standing around by the table, which drives me crazy. I wish it was a little roomier, but it seems like a great started location. 

Service was good, but the guy behind the counter seemed a little flippant. There was a larger party nearby that he seemed very concerned with. I felt like we were a little secondary to them, which is the worst. Still, Zed's is great and definitely worth a try, just get there early.

The food here was pretty good. Although   the service wasn't the best and they charged us for tip on only 3 trips to our table. 1: To bring us the food 2: To check if everything is okay. And 3: To ask us if we wanted any coffee or dessert at the end. Also the prices were pretty high we ordered I believe it was called Prizola kabab for 19.99$ and in the end it was only two Kababs and just a little bit of Baba G. On the bottom. We ordered dessert at the end witch was very very good though. It wasn't the best experience but besides the Prices and the service the food was pretty good

Came here a few times during my visit in Nashville. This is a bar, so if you can't stand smoke, then you won't like it inside. But for those that don't smoke but can endure....You will be ok..If you can hold your for a while...lol. 

The first time I came here, I had Lemon Pepper wings and a basket of fries. Both were really good. The wings were naked with the lemon pepper dry rub seasoning. I would definitely get these wings again. The cook did a great job. 

The second time I came here, I got a to go order to take back with me to the hotel. I ordered a simple bacon cheese burger with fries. This was one of those home made old fashioned hamburger. It wasn't thin nor too thick (which I don't mind). It had great flavor, and my taste buds was doing the MC Hammer -  hammer time dance in my mouth. I should've ordered 2 more burgers. 

I would come back - For TAKEOUT if I was in the area.

#DJEATSFLA
I just picked up a biscuit and gravy pot pie at the farmers market to bake at home. Best pie ever!

I was disappointed with the service on my last trip today, 1/13/2020 at around 1:30 pm.  At first I was excited to find some Luminarc water glasses that I've been needing to replace broken ones, and I found them pretty easily in the clearance section.  However, when the clerk rang them up, he disregarded the red tags on the 3 items and said "Nobody told me nothing."  He couldn't be bothered to call for help, but just rang them up at full price.  I was in a hurry to pick up the kids, so I couldn't make a fuss.  I shop there instead of ordering online because I like to support local businesses.  Next time, I'll get it on Amazon.  I hate to see these stores close, but they need to hire better people in order to keep my business.  Not upset about the money I should have saved - I'm more upset about his attitude.

The food was super average.  The waitstaff horrible.  And it was the worst tres leches cake I have ever had in my life.  

I was not wowed by my first encounter with this restaurant but went back with friends who wanted to eat here.  The waiter was a jerk.  He swooped in and cleared my friend's cocktail when it was only half consumed.  When she pointed it out to him his response was, "It was empty."  Five of us sitting at the table saw her glass was half full.  He would have nothing of it and charged her full price.

Called Logan's at 9 p.m. Saturday night when I left CoolSprings mall Morgan picked up the phone and put me on hold.... I drove all the way to Logan's 12 minutes away before the phone was picked up again.  I ask for the manager as I stood in the door and told him that I was placed on hold never got to place my takeout order he apologized and offered to take my order ....I declined and told him the only thing I wanted was service... and I didn't get it. Drove to Buffalo Wild Wings in Hermitage where I got excellent service !! I will not be visiting Logans again
Nasty disgusting food. I threw it out. Bad slow service. Don't go and waste your money. This place should close down.

I'm sure this spot sells great food overall but the vegetarian options I had weren't that good. The veggie burger patty didn't stay together very well but it didn't taste bad! But in the future I wouldn't try anything else on the menu again.
Used for drop offs. Notary here is not regular vs the Collegeville store. Staff is friendly, courteous, helpful.

Was a little skeptical to come here after reading the reviews about the service here. I must say, the 2 guys I interacted with were awesome. One even hooked me and my brother up with free eye protection. Prices are about the best I've seen at any range. The range itself wasn't anything fancy but it served its purpose and had lots of lanes. The only thing stopping me from giving 5 stars is that they rent out pistols only. Would love to be able to rent out some rifles as well! Overall a great experience.
I've had better food at a fast food seafood restaurant.

We love this place!  This is the second time we've dine at The Crazy Lobster, and it was as good as the first time.  Having a Groupon is pretty awesome because it's a bit pricy, but so worth it.  Voodoo Juice is a must for me every time we go to NOLA, on point all the time.  The Avita Amber draft was very smooth, I made him share .  The Char-grilled oysters were mouthwatering.  My entree was the Bourbon St Combo and it was delicious, the sausage was a bit salty tho.  He had the Catfish Decatur, and it was perfection.  Our waiter was great as well, friendly, attentive, but not too pushy.  Even the weather was great, just an overall great experience!  Fyi, those aluminum chairs are uncomfortable, makes your ass hurt lol!

The best hot tub experience ever. Jessie was a delight to work with. No high pressure sales just straight up honest. I could not believe how many hot tubs they had in stock. we went to other places and no one had spas. Im so glad we found this gem of a place.

Our visit was just......meh.
The staff was nice, the service was a bit slow...the food was just McFood. It's just TGI AppleChilis style stuff.

This is my second time coming to this place and it's been a magically delicious experience every time. There's always a bit of a wait, but it's worth it. Anyone who walks out of here without trying the lemon ricotta donuts has lost value and quality of life.
I loved the quality of the food. This is on my top 10 of fried rice that I've had. I heard the pizza is good and honestly from the rice I ordered I bet it is too! Friendly environment and good food.

The food is good when it eventually arrives, but the service is the worst I've experienced anywhere. I've given this particular restaurant an honest shot (4 times), and I've had the same experience each time. I won't be going back. This place needs new management and a better-trained staff or it won't survive.

Lived up to its bad review. Waited 20mins after ordered, it was right BUT it was ALL DRY! Dry fries, burgers, 20nuggets. Good thing I had a coke
Wow! The McDonald's brothers would turn on there graves if they knew how bad this location is. Kroc is the only one smiling here
A nice staple to have near by. I've had the pho and the Vermicelli, Also the dumplings. Very ummy!

We eat here, or one of the other locations in town every week, sometimes twice/week. This was not our best visit.

I ordered 2 Choose Two combos for my wife and I, and 2 kids meals for our children. My combo came out with the wrong sandwich. When I told the server that brought it, she gave me an attitude, and never even apologized. She just grabbed the half sandwich off my plate with her bare and and took it in back, then, brought out my replacement.

We waited several more minutes, and my sons cheese potato still had not come out after all of the other food, so I told her, and she made an excuse that it wasn't on the ticket, and walked away to get it. I took my receipt out of my pocket, and walked up to the counter to show her it we as the first item in my receipt, and yet again, she gives me an attitude, and she she figured it out. So my cashier input my order wrong for my combo, AND someone else completely missed my sons spud kids meal...not your best day McA's.

We eat at the one in Des Peres at least once/week, and often go to the newer Maplewood location. I only go hear when I meet my wife for lunch on workdays , because it's halfway between our home and her office. This is the first time it's been a really bad experience...let's hope it's the last.

This is our new go-to delivery place. It's affordable, crazy fast, and delicious. Great option on the west side. We order through the Slice app (because too lazy to call on the phone), and they generally deliver to our place in Sylvan Park within 20 minutes. To be clear: this isn't artisan wood fired pizza. If that's what you want, go to Five Points or whatever. But if you want way above average traditional delivery pizza, you can't go wrong here.
In and out in 20 min with a new tire at the lowest price I found in town. The guys were speedy, honest and wanted to please

I've this place! My idea of a scone is a little different based on my upbringing but these scones are to die for! 

I finally ordered something other than a scone and it was a great meal! Lots of food for a great price. 

Friendly staff and a fun juke box!

I've done these kinds of tours all over the US, and this one was by far my favorite! The quality of these things are so dependant on which guide you get, and Evian was AMAZING. He was really nice, threw in lots of humor, and had a great presence (I imagine it's difficult to communicate to 20 people over the loud sounds of NOLA), but man was he knowledgeable! He gave such a detailed history of every stop, and happily answered any questions we had about the city. I was overhearing other groups and tours we passed and they were just describing general stories of the ghost lore, not nearly as interesting OR impressive. I highly recommend this tour, and Evian as a guide.
Absolutely delicious!  Fresh sushi, fun atmosphere, great service!  I LOVE this place!!!

My friend was a inmate there for 4 days on the suicide watch he is not suicidal they asked him if he had thought if suicide he said everyone in his day an age does they took his clothes even his underware he only had a hospital gown..he is on methadone sob3 days he got no methadone at all so then he was withdrawn an he asked for something to help the symptoms they ignored him he had to eat with his fingers they gave him his tray but took the silverware. The food was do discusting at 3 am he had massive stomach pains he called for the nurse for 2 hours an nobody responded to him so you eat like a beast when u are there get treated like a animal an to be on life sustaining medication not to give him anything to help with withdraw that's down right wrong he could have died from there negligence he's lucky he made it out alive..He plans in taking this to the media

The one and only good thing about this place is their outdoor seating. That's it. 

The food is horrible, and the service is slacking. Always a long wait. There's so many better places in Skippack to go.

Had the lunch special which was a Italian sausage turkey burger with the salad and balsamic dressing. It was literally the best burger I have ever had( any type of meat!) this place had a good mix of locals, regulars and out of towners. Service was good and the decor was pretty original. 

A must if you are in meridian!

Great experience here I was a walk in, and they greeted promptly and helped me out fast. I had a specific vision and they met it, and exceeded my expectations, I love a nail spa where they know how to do various types of designs/art on nails. They took their time and the results were great. Also very hospitable, offering drinks during your visit.

Update 4 moths later... went back to the same Sally's and the manager and both employees were still not wearing their masks correctly! All three had masks under their noses, not to mention their masks were loose! You're in a tiny shop very close together and not wearing your mask properly? Please do better!

Used to be when I wanted a Cuban sandwich I'd go into Tampa to Aquila after reading reviews and seeing them TV. Not anymore. Tia's has hands down the best Cuban sandwich I have ever had. Do yourself a favor and head on down.
The mussels we had were big but not fresh at all. Steak was very mediocre. Our waitor was nice and attentive though. Overall we are disappointed with the food.

Very pretty inside; love the space and had a delightful breakfast here a few weeks ago.  Ended up going again and when I ordered a bit of extra bread for my cheese spread they charged me for it.  Running out of bread for a pimiento cheese thing is such a small expense to uphold so that wasn't great.  But it was minor and they did have great beverage service and the glassware and tableware is pretty as well.  I will be coming here a lot; it's a great little spot for SB.

It's the best dog friendly bar in St. Pete without question. If you love dogs, whether you own one or not, you have to come here, have a drink, mix with a lot of great dog people and dog watch. It is a blast. If you're not a dog person, then why are you reading this and get out of St Petersburg. 

This huge bar offers something for everyone. Like another reviewer wrote, its like someone dropped a tiki bar in the middle of a dog park (-Todd B.). There are two main areas: (1) an off leash area where your furkid can play and (2) an on-leash area for those pet parents who like more control. There is an agility platform and a pool in the off-leash area for the dogs. The on-leash area has games and a fire pit for the humans. It is an outdoor bar but Most areas are now covered by either an overhang, tent or roof, so there is plenty of shade for you and your pup. Plus the owner makes sure to have fans out. 

Whether you are alone in this city or you have a group, this is a fun bar with room and space for everyone. Plenty of tables and high railings with nooks to keep your drink safe.  You don't need to have a dog to enjoy thus place, just a love for dogs. 

No food is served here but you know what's awesome? Walk next door to Taco Bus or a grab a pizza from one of the nearby pizza joints and you can eat it here! That's another reason why Dog Bar is the best place to host a dog party or dog birthday or heck any party here!

I love that the bar hosts events to raise money for local rescue groups. It makes me feel better to spend more money on drinks here! Lol. We need more people adopting and less (or no!) people buying from breeders. Anyway, there's always something going on and you're sure to have a good time.

If you're a local like me, it is certainly worth the $40 annual membership (~$3/ month!) to come here, especially to support such a great business.

Bruce Du Bois, Master colorist and Master stylist has been my hair Guru for many years .  He is a leader in his industry and a consummate professional. Bruce may be old school in his approach to customer service ( the customer/client  comfort is paramount ) but he is all about 'right now' when it comes to style,trends,innovation and cutting edge services and products.The Bellevue Salon and Spa  is staffed exclusively by highly trained, seasoned beauty pros.
Picked up sushi to go. Loved the Big Daddy roll. California roll was okay. Will definitely eat there again!
Once you've enjoyed the funky decor, there's not much to bring you back again.  Lots of flashy presentation, but the actual food isn't all that unique or well-prepared.

The line was 5 deep when we arrived and by the time we left was out to the door.  Clearly a local favorite.  The menu is extensive, something for everyone.  The crepes are very large, could feed 2 or 3 and they are very tasty.  I can't say the same for their coffees, while they had many variations from espresso to iced mocha's the quality was average at best.  Anytime a coffee shop use powdered chocolate in the mocha that is an indicator, use real chocolate or don't offer it.

We were in town for only a day and did enjoy the crepes, but wouldn't make it a must visit next time we are in town.

I  this place because being a artist myself I use this building as an outsource to get away from all of the craziness in this world. It inspires me to think larger with my pieces and inspires me to use my talent as a therapeutic remedy.

Had a wonderful brunch! Our server was extremely friendly, helpful and patient with our questions even though he had the entire floor to himself. I had the hot espresso martini that gave me life with just the right amount of caffeine and alcohol. For food I got the pork belly cornbread Benedict. It was especially nice that they let me substitute scrambled eggs in place of the poached (I can't do the runny yoke). Plenty of social distancing and everyone had on their masks
Great service! Conch fritters were delicious! Will visit when in town again! Beautiful view of the bay.
Hotel is beautiful and elegant inside.  Very quiet on the street facing rooms. Beware of rooms off the center atrium the sound was loud and travelled straight up.

Not really happy with the quality of the piece that we purchased. It was also damaged and unfortunately does not look as good as we had hopef. I had asked to return or select a different product but was told I would be required to pay a $450 (25%) restocking fee regardless if I exchange or return. Needless to say I will never be purchasing from them again with this type of service.

I come here several times a year depending on when my job posts me in Sherwood Park. I've been to several Mucho Burritos in the city, and this location is clean and usually not busy. 

It's been a few months since I visited a Mucho Burrito and it seems their prices have increased by about a $1? Or perhaps I never noticed it before. 

I ordered the small veggie burrito which came out delicious, albeit a bit overheated during the final press stage. I also opted to try the chicken tortilla soup - it was suuuuuuuper salty! Ugh... I've had it before and it was the opposite last time, not enough salt. I guess they've now tried to overcompensate. The soup, if it was't salty, would've been yummy since they place a scoop of guacamole, plus crushed tortilla chips and pieces of chicken into the bowl, prior to scooping the broth into it. 

Overall, hit & miss but I'd still return since I'd like me a mucho burrito anytime =)

Food was pretty good but probably won't go back because huge wine bottle display next to my table was so dusty, I was disgusted. Also dust on the ceiling fan and surrounding area, and suddenly the fan was turned on. Yuck! Particles flying everywhere.

Simply delicious. The fish is very fresh, the gyozas are really good, the pork belly skewer is good too!
I recommend the Summer roll very much! 
The service was also amazing, as all the waiters are very nice and helpful (thanks Kenny)! 
We'll be back in the (near) future to try more delicious sushi

9 times out of 10 you're better off physically walking in to place an order. If not you'll be on hold until the end of time. I've walked in plenty of times to place an order while still being on hold for 5 minutes. The staff is lazy because they never seem to be working when I come in. They are pretty good at sitting around and watching the phone ring. Lake Terrace needs a new pizza shop with better service ASAP.

This was my second trip with Captain Jacks wine tasting tour in the last two years. Both experiences were absolutely magnificent and I will definitely be using their services again. Here are a few reasons why this company just does it best... 
1. They are incredibly accommodating and polite when booking. They will work with you and actually pick you up from a location of your choice (Within reason, of course) 
2. Incredibly punctual. They say 9am, they actually mean 9am! 
3. Great, great, great employees! I can't stress this enough! Our tour guide totally made the trip so much more exciting! Guy you da man! Guy was a good driver; he had endless amounts of knowledge about the history of Santa Barbra! Very interesting,  I leaned tons! He is a great asset to the team! I can't remember who I had the first time around but she was awesome too.  
4. We were given ample time to take photos at all stops. Never did I feel rushed or compelled to get going, it was fun and relaxing.
Their ribeye, American white cheese, onions and cherry peppers is the best! Love the chocolate booze shake as a dessert to share! Friendly staff too.

EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED! Their Long Term parking lot was full, due to the Thanksgiving holiday rush and signs were posted, "CLOSED, park in Short term parking for Long term rates." However, when I exited the lot 2.5 days later, that was NOT the case. Further, I was simply "handled" by the staff at the window and they denied me the correct rate. My only recourse (on a Friday evening) was to wait until Monday to call "Fred" because they did not believe me nor did they have a record of the Long term lot being full/closed on the day before Thanksgiving! Completely unacceptable.I paid $48 instead of $39. 

I will be forced to use this airport but I recommend against their parking lot.

I will post the outcome from my call to Fred on Monday. Hopefully, they will remember the old adage that the customer is always right!

It was alright, we ate here today. Food was not very good but not bad either. If you live within the area and want a bite to eat in a social environment then come here. But for quality and a nice brunch or lunch i would not recommend.

The greatest bar known to man!

I spent many a drunken night enjoying the lovely atmosphere here.  The 6 foot ceilings help hold in the smokey must(it's in PA, so, yeah, you can still smoke inside).  The blood, sweat, and tears of local and touring bands over the past 25 years line the walls, as well as their show poster.

 Live music 365 days a year, this place has given rise to such great acts from Ween to Johnny's Dance Band to Penn and Teller to Birdie Num Num and the Spirit Squad.

So, let the Jameson drown and the Yeungling chase your blues away, and you'll be okay at John and Peter's.
My son and I got an 18" Pepperoni on Sat. night and it was great! And it was even better the next day! Will be making this our Pizza Shop from now on. Next its the Steak Bomb.

vibes are amazing, food is even better. the amalfi pizza is sooooo good. you would never even know it was vegan unless I told you. the almond ricotta cheese is so tasty. 100% recommend this restaurant. can't wait to come back!!

Talk about a shitty place. I only say shitty, because there's literally one bathroom on the ground floor during peak times and there's nowhere to go, and trying to get a drink at a bar is impossible.

 We hear there are more bathrooms upstairs, but then we have to wait in line and when we didn't realize this, the bouncers were complete assholes. I actually heard them call a bachelorette party a "bunch of cunts". 

This place is worse than the music that Dierks Bentley makes. In some respects, it's the same exact bar as every other downtown Nashville bar (crazytown, honkytonk central, etc), but the staff at other places seems much more professional. For contrast, Nashville Underground also recently opened, and the staff there is extremely pleasant. Of the country named bars downtown, like FGL house, AJ's Good Time Bar, and the George Jones Museum, Dierks' bar is the worst. Hopefully it loses money and shuts down soon.
Went for breakfast and everything was well cooked and the prices are good. The service was fast and friendly.

The service is great. No pressure to get you order in and get you out. Matt was our waiter and he was superb. My wife and were very satisfied with the experience. Relaxed atmosphere and great food. BYOB makes even better.

I stayed here for one night. I decided to give this hotel a chance, because it had both good and bad reviews and despite the bad reviews as a Hilton Honors member I am pretty loyal to staying at Hilton's. The location was great because it was right across the street from the stadium, which was the whole reason why I was there was for the game.  Upon our arrival we used valet for parking. The valet was exceptional and had great customer service. When we went to check in to the hotel the receptionist didn't explain anything, or inform on anything about the hotel. Just gave my keys and sent me on my way. However, the lobby was well kept. But then you got to the rooms. The rooms are very out dated and need some renovations done. The doors were falling apart, and the AC didn't really feel like it was cooling the room.When you stay at a hotel you expect to find hair every now and then but when we got to the room there was hair on the toilet and in the shower like they didn't even clean it, I even open a couple of the towels and there was hair on them as well. Upon our check out- the people that was running the valet parking didn't really seem enthused to be at work, which affected her customer service skills. Other than that the stay was ok.  I will probably look around at other hotels before making my decision if I will return to stay here again!

You NEED to come to this place! Part cafe, part food stands, part market place. This is a great example of local business, cultural exchange, and micro economics at work. A great middle-east coffee and tea cafe, Ethiopian food stand, spices, food, housewares. Boise NEEDS more local business and this is a group trying to make it happen! Go there...

I just tried Lulu's for the first time and had to immediately write my review because it was THAT good. I got the Loaded Nacho Crunch Wrap and I kept staring at it as I ate it because I was convinced there was no way it was vegan! I can't wait to go back and try every other item on their menu. Their prices are very right, the restaurant is inviting and adorable, and it's so great to have amazing tasting vegan food!

Ft DeSoto has it all. 
It has beautiful, unspoiled beaches, campground (VERY popular during winter months), dog beach, dog park, recreational trail, fishing piers, boat launch, ferry, history (fort), bike/kayak rentals, snack shop, playgrounds, picnic shelters, showers (in the public loos), and an overwhelming amount of parking... what else? I know I'm missing a lot more. 
All of this can be yours for $5 entry fee (plus 2 toll booths en route to the park). 

Ft DeSoto is a great place to spend an afternoon outside.

This restaurant is an absolute must visit by foodies or those that simply want an amazing experience in delicious Italian American dishes.  From appetizers, to pasta, to entree's to dessert all superb all done to perfection. Wait staff very attentive, but our number one winner goes to Christian from California. Friendly, extremely knowledgeable about the menu. Very pleasant and patient.  My favorite dish was the Pork Osso Bucco. The taste was amazing, the pork was so tender it fell off the bone and the bone marrow was left to enjoy.  What flavor! We were greeted by the General Manager, Steve Rogers who made our experience complete.  He deserves special recognition for his passion in delivering excellent customer service. Kudos to the team!

Came back.  Thanks.

Although, back again today and waited for over an hour.  Yikes.  Really bummed.

What can I say but, worth every penny. Stayed in the cabins on the course and was happy to see that we had our own private putting green and sand trap. Sand trap was crap and not maintained  but we didn't care. Oh and ice.. every day a fresh cooler of ice. No maid service is the only downfall. Food inside was great every time, little slow but no complaints at all. Now the courses. The President's side is absolutely outstanding. Top five course I've ever played and I've been all over to golf. Wide cushy fairways, nice dense rough and just an outstanding layout and design. Grounds crew, bravo. Seriously, take a friggen now. You have a collection of par 5s that rivals any course in this country without a doubt. The course definitely gets a lot of play but is immaculate. I cannot day enough good about this golf course. We really liked the General side as well, just much slower play.

I gotta admit it, I loves me some Diamond Lounge... er uh Palm Room... ahhhh Laurel Lounge. The name keeps changing but the food and drinks stay the same.

At this place, Caesar's Diamond Plus level (or Diamond with a $10 in points copay) get free entry and 4 premium drinks from the bar. Food is complimentary and generally on the pretty good side. They usually have a salad, bread, soup, and a couple of entrees like fried catfish or meatloaf and maybe a side like mac n' cheese. I've been there a dozen or so times and always find it tasty. Somehow a few plates of it always seem to disappear down my gob. The friendly staff will seat you and get your drinks for you. Just keep those drink tickets handy and have a tip ready at the end.

You'll find a lot of local regulars here at times. Heck, I'd be there too if I could go once a day and grab some free stuff. But it makes for good conversation & eavesdropping. Service is usually good, but like most places can be spotty if you happen to get an unengaging server. Lucky for me, we've almost always had the super friendly ones.

Came here based on prior Yelp reviews and a hankering for BBQ.   There's plenty of free outside parking and the restaurant is large and self seating.

Food is on point!  The brisket is so juicy large and savory.  Skip the sandwich because bun was not that yummy.  Pulled pork was mildy dry.  The other popular item here are the ribs and we wished we tried this.  Will get next time.  

Sides were A+++  bacon green beans were so good- sweet and savory at same time.  Cheesy potatoes and mac n cheese were great compliment.  Best thing here is their array of BBQ sauces.  We tried out all six and our favs were the Smoky and BayBQ.   You can buy it to take home as well which we may do next time we do our own BBQ at home in the summer time.

Prices were fair and great eating experience.  Great place for groups.  Bathroom was one of the nicest I've seen.  Overall had a great time and would come back again.
Cute atmosphere, sub par service, pretty good food but overpriced. If you're in St Louis for a short time I wouldn't wait 30+ minutes for this place necessarily.

Have not been to Golden Dragon in years.
It has really gone downhill.
My Pad Tai noodles were under cooked.
Noodle were clunked together.
My husband's Mongolian Beef was also a disappointment.
Never go there again.
Run of the mill hair chain. Not bad but nothing outstanding. Pricing is a little high.  The stylists really only know basic hair cuts and can't recommend styles for men.

We enjoyed our lunch with friends who were staying at the Vinoy. Modern with a very cool and colorful tropical decor. They need more outside seating with shade. We ate inside for that reason.

Inside is pretty but the restaurant is loud. They need soundproofing.

We loved the food. We shared shrimp advocate toast, edamame hummus. Roasted Brussels, grilled asparagus. These were all fantastic.

His fish tacos were ok. His quinoa burger was ok. Nice craft beer selection.

Seeing the Vinoy hotel was special. Overall a nice dining experience but on a pretty April day in Florida, we would like outside dining with shade too.

By far the best Indian cuisine in Philly. I had their lunch buffet this afternoon and the food was so flavorful. The chicken tandoori was so juicy and well cooked that I ended up gobbling way too much. Same goes for the goat curry. I definitely recommend this place and at 10 dollars this buffet is definitely worth every penny.

2.5ish, but I was torn on how to rate this place. If I had not come here seeking food I probably would have rated it higher, so your mileage may vary. I understand they change their food offerings and I was hungry so I thought this would be a tasty option. First of all, do not come here hungry, or at least verify if they actually have any food available first. When we arrived the place was not very packed, and it smelled like food, but they seemed to be out of everything that looked interesting. What they did have seemed like reasonable prices, until it arrived and was comically small portions. Along with not having good flavor my whole plan was dashed. Normally I do not eat very much anyways, but I feel Inglewood needs to rethink their food offerings, or just be a bar and drop the food pretense. I suppose I should have expected that since it is a bar/lounge, but they are a catering company also with a "real food" truck parked outside.

Forget all of that. Come here for the ambiance, cocktails, and overall vibe.  Also be prepared to go to the bar if you need anything, but that really is not a big deal to me. This would be a great date spot, and the cocktails are not overpriced along with being tasty. I may try again when I am not hungry and alter my review, but since this visit was primarily to taste the food I was let down. As a neighborhood lounge/bar this is a great spot, so do not be afraid to give it a shot!

Meh... Food is nothing to write home about.. Drinks are EXPENSIVE. I had the crab cakes appetizer (three individual cakes, about an inch and a half in diameter). I should've taken a picture! Anyway, that plus two cocktails = $49 tab. Pretty view of the water and a couple of big boats, but I won't go back. There are too many other amazing waterfront view restaurants in the greater Tampa Bay area to see that have amazing menus at a reasonable Tampa Bay-like price.

You know that friend whose house is impeccably adorned with the most unique decor you've ever seen? You know... The one who has incredible pieces of artwork, each with its own story from their travels to some far off distant land, carefully placed around their home in such a way they seem placed without purpose at all, yet are clearly placed intentionally to make you ask about or interact with them? This is the same friend that also has a fantastic sense of style and  the jewelry that you can't stop staring at too. most creative and inventive pieces of jewelry  and accessories to complete the look.  

Yeah. We all have one. Now tell the truth, you envy their sense of design and wish you could bring a bit of that inspiration into your home don't you? 

Well, at La Galleria, you now have a friend that not only has that crazy cool sense of design, they also have the worldly stories to back up each piece you may want, AND they'll happily help you find the perfect way to integrate it into your home. 

Think of La Galleria as the most interesting art collection you've every seen, only everything is for sale and has a sweet story to back it up. The items you'll find at La Galleria are sourced by the owners through their travels around the world, they hand select the artisans they work with, and the selection of products is ever changing.

This store is inspiring, intriguing, and incredibly interesting. Having just one piece of anything in your home is sure to draw compliments and questions from guests, and lets be honest, that's all we really want when they come over! 

We're pretty fortunate to have La Galleria's second location in Reno. Check em out!

Fabulous meal
Steak and Prime Rib were both cooked perfectly
Great service from Roxanne and Salvador
Really a hidden gem

We frequently travel through Santa Barbara from our home in Lompoc. I have favorite eateries along the route and this one has now made my list! Hubby and I were offered a taste of the fresh fomato bisque and was it ever delish! Hubby chose the pulled pork sandwich and was highly impressed. Being a North C'rlina boy, that's impressive! I chose the Eggcado & Watercress sandwich, which consists of several of my favorite ingredients. Again, this did not disappoint! I must say that I had a difficult time choosing from all of the options on the menu so we will definitely be back to try more. I had a wonderful chat with the owner about a faux pas in the spelling on his menu, along with a good laugh, and who told me that most of the recipes are his mother-in-law's. She can cook for me anytime! He has another place downtown, so I must try that one as well. We highly recommend this place.

While visiting the French Quarter with a colleague from Japan, I was determined to expose her to as much Louisiana culture as possible.  Our last night in town, we were taken out by another colleague who suggested Arnaud's Jazz Bistro as the proper way to end the trip, and we couldn't have been happier with the choice.  The Jazz Bistro had a more laid back vibe, with lots of natural light and a great jazz trio playing in the corner.  The music added to the ambiance without being loud enough to overpower the conversation.  

The drinks were strong, the service was attentive, and the food was first rate.  We shared the alligator sausage (a must for our visitor) and the souffle potatoes, which were another house specialty.  Having a shellfish allergy, I opted for the fillet and was absolutely delighted.  It is rare that I get a TRUE rare steak when I order one (no pun intended), but theirs was cooked perfectly and covered with a brandy cream sauce.  I'm still daydreaming about that steak.

After splitting a few Nola classic desserts, we all left full and happy.  I would wholeheartedly recommend Arnaud's to anyone visiting from out of state as an upscale French Quarter option.

I miss Disney, but the wife said 2 years of Disney passes was enough. So this year we will be at Busch Gardens a lot. This place has changed so much in my ten plus years absence. I miss the brewery and the Clydesdales, oh and Mick and Bud. Why would they get rid of Mick and Bud the dolphins?  Stadium priced beers suck! Two bottles of Budweiser for $14??? The animal exhibits are good, my favorite being the Tigers. The park is tidy, and the employees are nice.
 New for me is the "Bands, Brews, and BBQ" which is fricken wicked awesome. Last Sunday we enjoyed craft beers while watching Bret Michaels Band perform. It is a great outdoor stage for bands. Next we will see ZZ Top (for our 2nd time),and The Steve Miller Band. Smokey Bones BBQ was there making great BBQ. The ribs and chicken were fantastic.

Ally was absolutely wonderful.  She did a fantastic job cutting my 12-year-old's hair from very long to very short. She was personable and fun and took lots of time to give a great cut and style. 

The salon environment is friendly and enjoyable, and the hours are incredible. It was very easy to get a next-day appointment. I also really liked the pricing system--a great yet very affordable cut. 

No complaints here. An all-around excellent experience. Highly recommend this salon and look forward to getting family haircuts here in the future.

Do you like ice cream? Are you currently within driving or walking distance of Prytania Street? Why are you reading this review?  Go get your ice cream on at Creole Creamery! 

I've only had the hot fudge sundae, but it is amazing. Unless you are very hungry, you might want to go with a junior sundae--the regular sundae is HUGE. 

Take cash! Ice cream and credit cards do not mix! Fortunately, ice cream does mix with waffle cones, hot fudge, oatmeal cookies, etc. Yum.

Beaver Hill is a pretty little park in the otherwise steel and concrete laden downtown core. The city has done a wonderful job maintaining it as it has some of the most green and lush grass I have ever laid eyes on not to mention the lovely little man made streams and plentiful picnic tables.

I have fond memories of getting subway sandwiches and sitting in Beaver Hill reading my books during my college years but that doesn't diminish the fact that something really needs to be done about some of the shady characters that loiter in this area. It is unfortunately a fairly popular area to both use and sell drugs as well as  being attractive to panhandlers during the lunch hour when office workers come down out of their buildings to eat outdoors and enjoy nicer weather.

If you don't mind being asked for change it really is a nice place to stop and sit a spell just be sure to stick to visiting during daytime hours as I can't imagine what it's like in the evening with the darkness contributing to the hills and tree cover available to use for less then friendly individuals.
Good little spot close to home. Good beer selection. Wine/Spirits are a bit overpriced, service was a bit slow, but not a bad place. Doubt we will be back.

Exceptional drinks and quality food. This place was news to me, but quickly became a spot I will remember. I had their version of a Paloma and did not disappoint. I also had the crab tostada and all the flavors were there. The only change I would make is to take some of the cabbage off the dish as it overwhelmed the other ingredients. I will definitely be back!  Oh and they have extreme covid measures, so you cannot help but feel safe.
Since my last rating, the temperature  control issue has been fixed and resolved.    The manager has addressed all my concerns.

You have to wait in line to order at the counter and the line was kinda long at lunch on a Saturday, but after we ordered our food came out very quickly. I had a fish taco and one called The Puffy (on the right) -- pork, quac, queso, all the good stuff!! They had real cane sugar Colas, too! It was super good. I'd go here again when in the area.

Vince Moreno's band was so much fun! We danced to old country hits for several hours! Not much to eat here, 2 types of pizza.
We visit here every time we come to Nashville. Today we heard Joyful Noise.  They were great!

Saw this place on a Buzzfeed video and they were impressed with the cost versus quality.  So I though, why not.

Tempura green beans!!!!! I would eat those as my side or French fries any day.  Crunchy, salty delicious!

The burger was actually really delicious.  A notch above other fast food chains, for sure.  Hot, fresh tasting.  And a good amount too.  I wasn't stuffed, but I wasn't still hungry.  For what I paid, I feel like it was a good amount of food.

Staff was average for a fast food place, no complaints.  Place was clean.  I would return, just for the green beans.
This place is a racist discriminatory place that only wants American customers. If you are from out of town (especially out of the us) do not visit this place. Terrible door staff.

Can't give an accurate review. We are still waiting for our 8:30 reservation at 9pm. They say there are still 3 groups to seat before us. They should really take into consideration the amount of time it takes to seat and serve groups when making reservations. I have never had this issue at the Brandon location.
Never had such impeccable service. Jeff with the glasses, cheese guy brian, and jake made our experience unparalleled. will absolutely be returning . could not recommend more.

Pretty good brats - had the Reuben brat, which I enjoyed pairing with some mustard. Even better dessert - loved the Black Forest cake!

The thing that really makes me love this food truck is how sensitive they are to the environment. They will give you biodegradable plates and utensils. And the cake dessert was served in a glass jar, which if you return it after, they will refund you $1, I think it was. How many food trucks take these extra steps? Not enough, and I wish more were like this place. Kudos.
My daugther and I arrived in Philly tired and hungry. We are here on 6-5-21 and were super impressed. The food was delicious we are going back today.

Stayed here after a wedding. Not that nice of a hotel. Our room seemed to be decently clean. However, a lot of other people had issues with their rooms being filthy. Our room reeked like cigarettes which was concerning especially being pregnant. They are advertised as having an outdoor pool but it was closed when we stayed there. Breakfast isn't included and didn't look like it was anything worth paying for. I would stay elsewhere if you can. Only positive of the hotel is that it's across the street from total wine.

Hosted a "Ladies Night" Happy hour with 6 of my friends.  Service from Allan was terrific and the drinks ($5 specialty cocktails and wines) and food (mostly we got small plates) was very good.

A great choice for a fun night out.

While I still go back because I enjoy many of the great servers and the food, Tina is the worst server to work here.  She would make her customers wait while she spends time chatting with her friends.  We were waiting for almost 30 minutes for refills and a check while she sat and relaxed as you can see in the photos
Great little restaurant in Goleta. Service can be a little slow but the customer service is great and the food is delicious!

Our driver was late, the power in the bus was completely out and we had no AC or lights inside, and they double booked us and had 2 drivers show up and tried to tell us it was our fault. Our driver was very nice, but he drove SO fast and when you're going up the windy streets in Santa Ynez, it's a little freaky.

GREAT PANCAKES! It would be 5 stars if I rated solely on pancakes. My sons french toast was soggy but he didn't seem to mind.  Not the most kid friendly (no kid menu) so I had to get my 4 year old an adult sized meal. And even though we were only one of 3 tables there, early in the morning, I felt hurried (my kids were behaving nicely and no, we didn't make or leave a big mess). The waiter actually started to take my sons plate away while he still had half the food on it, was chewing, and had his fork in his hand. But give it a try (really those pancakes).

Wow is an understatement!  This is a must visit for Tucson. As a matter of fact if you own a restaurant you should visit. This place is operated to perfection. Great food great service. Every staff member we encountered was great. Oh and it was busy the entire time.

The fiancé and I had an amazing dinner here the other night. We came in on a quiet weekday and were pleasantly surprised at how wonderful everything was. 
Our service was top notch. Everyone was so attentive and polite. Heck even the live musicians cared how everything was going.
The meal was absolutely amazing. We started with wine and beer pairings to go with the roasted bone marrow. The portion was extremely generous and the dish came with a whole grain mustard and shallot salad that was simply amazing. My fiancé hates mustard and I avoid raw onions but we both cleaned the plate. Next we shared the duck confit and wild mushroom risotto. Again the portions were plentiful and the taste was simply amazing.
I can't think of any reason to  give the Black Sheep anything less than 5 stars.
Unfortunately it looks like Ray's is no longer in business. Wonder if it was the service issues that got them.

1990 called they want their food back!! The food preparation and presentation is so dated and lacks anything interesting or tasty! We came here for a lunch date and we ordered a caprese salad to start and it was your basic red steak tomatoes with watery buffalo mozzarella and basic pesto with onion granules. For my main course I order the salmon sandwich, the bread was so soggy I couldn't eat it and while the salmon was a nice size piece it was over cooked, I did inform them and they comped mine. My husband ordered the steak sandwich with mushrooms, the steak was prepared nicely but the mushrooms looked and tasted like they came out of a can! The only thing that saves me from giving them one star was our very friendly server and their beautiful outdoor patio/garden. This is by far the worst dining experience I've had in Boise and I will never go back to this dated restaurant...

Let me say right from the start: If you haven't tried The Pickled Heron you simply must! Also, LOVE that this place is a BYOB! 
Atmosphere: Walking into The Pickled Heron, one might feel as though you're walking into the front door of a close friends home. 8 tables in the center of the room, along with a lovely church pew along the right side of the room, make for wonderful decor. The lighting, mood, and atmosphere, are exquisite.  
Starters: The housemade charcuterie plate was superb. Foie gras mousse, hunter sausage, and prosciutto. The onion soup gratinee was delicious, complete with a house made veal stock.
 For dinner: 4 of the most perfectly seared sea scallops, and the most decadent lamb sirloin we've ever had. Followed up with the best creme brûlée this side of France, combine that with the friendly, knowledgable, and professional manner of our handsome waiter who really went the extra mile to make our evening superb and you can see why The Pickled Heron has become our new favorite dining experience.

Once I stepped foot in this place I felt like I was back in Italy. Such a great authentic restaurant that truly cares about their customers. Once I was seated, the owner Jana came up and personally greeted my company and myself and made sure everything was taken care of. #1 restaurant in Carpinteria. Definite stop if passing through this quiet small town!!! Love this place!!!

Love Bodega? Don't live in St Pete? It's now much easier to get your Bodega on. The food is exactly the same(Which is awesome because Bodega) as but with much better seating :) This location has two bars for serving you drinks, Shuffle Board, and a great look. If you haven't tried Bodega yet...shame on you stop reading and just Go!!!!! Our favorites are the Pollo Asado, and Frita

What a disappointment!  We used to eat here all the time and loved it!  It seems like the ownership must have changed.  We went in and EVERYTHING we used to like is off the menu. No more 'Lil Hoagies, no more Big Bakers (got some story about how Costco supplied them small potatoes yet they are completely off the menu), no more ham, no more meals with sides (all sides are a la carte and that equals spending more $$).  No more free ice cream. The ice cream machine was stripped from the wall and signs taken down. We were told it was "out of order" but why bother removing the signs and the machine from the wall?  Sounds to me like it's not coming back.  Walked in an hour before closing and half the restaurant was off limits because the crew had already cleaned and didn't want anyone sitting there.  This is where we like to sit because it's away from the line of people that are ordering and in a quieter spot.  Very unfriendly environment. Young kids behind the counter smiling at each other after our disappointment in all the changes. We will NOT be coming back. Too bad.
This was a great festival! I wish I could say I went to multiple venues but I got sucked into Time from the beginning.  The music was fab and the vibe was really good. Really enjoyed it!

7/17/15...Drinks were good, music was good, food was horrible! I sent my steak back twice! Chicken was way over cooked and dry. Even the baked potato and rice were overcooked. I was shocked that the manager did not check on us especially after two poorly cooked steaks! Keep the bartender, lose the grill cook!

8/20/16
I'm thrilled to update my review to tell about our great experience last night! My family went to Ellendale's following my dad's celebration of life service bc my parents always loved to eat there. They immediately accommodated our large party in a private room. Our server was excellent and the food was really good! The menu seemed to have been updated a bit. I had a spinach salad and the sea bass. We also tried the pimento cheese steak biscuits as an app. Everyone at the table was pleased with their food! I would still love to see them freshen up their decor but I would go back!
It's very convenient if you work or study in UPenn. I like the salads of course and the place is ok in size with a nice location on campus.
Best hummus and falafel in town! This is my first time at Amalias and I loved everything. We ordered falafel entrees, hummus and baba ganoush! Highly recommend this place!

I read quite a few bad reviews but know somebody that said their pizza was the best in Tucson ? So we decided to go check it out . When we walked up to the door there was a awful smell ??? Don't know what it was but glad we didn't want to sit outside and eat. Got seated immediately in the bar area. Waiter came quickly to get our drink orders. We looked at the menus but did not see pizza, so we asked about it. The waiter said they only have pizza on weekdays and at the bar only and take out on the weekend. So since we were already seated at a table we just ordered from the menu. We ordered pasta dishes and then we overheard the next table's waiter tell them about the specials, which sounded pretty good and our waiter never told us about any specials. So our food was pretty good but the prices are a bit high ! We did see a pizza that was ordered at the bar and it looked really good ! We will go back to try the pizza and hope it tastes as good as it looks : )
All delicious foods, so if you are hungry beware because your eyes will be bigger than your stomach

So-so sushi at reasonable prices if you're looking to get a quick sushi fix. That's about it. I really only go here when I don't feel like driving to Montecito or Santa Barbara (and being in Carp this is my only option). If you're looking for GREAT sushi, go to Sakana in Montecito.

Some locals recommended this place. Although we only had to wait 5 minutes to be seated, we were warned that there is a long line sometimes. The waitress was on top of her game. The food was above average. Highly recommend the smoked duck quesadilla. The fried chicken batter was amazing, but the chicken was slightly overdone. We washed it all down with an Abita, and we're satisfied with our decision to eat at Coop's!

My family and I visited Try Wine to celebrate an engagement before dinner at 400 Beach (a few blocks away). The staff is knowledgeable, friendly, and accommodating for our large party. I brought my 2 year old and she had a ton of fun too! We ordered the cheese board - I had just returned from Napa a few days prior and their cheese board and wines really did rival some of the best in Wine Country! We're planning on coming back for a date night sans kiddo so we don't have to share our "chee and meat" with her :)
This guy,George,is more than amazing. Taking 60s to change a battery and cost only $5! Absolutely recommend!
Always good. Fair price. Far more healthy than most restaurants. This is a great place to have in the neighborhood.

I'd heard so many rave reviews about Bitar's that I thought it was going to blow my mind. I ordered a falafel sandwich and waited, my mouth salivating. The first bite was devastating, but I was hungry so I finished the sandwich slowly with generous amounts of liquid to help it go down. So dry, so crumbly, so sad.

Falafel is best when it's fresh and warm and crispy on the outside. It shouldn't sit around waiting for someone to take pity on it. I would have gladly waited 5 or 10 minutes for it to come out fresh.

The people working there seemed nice. There's a small grocery selection, so I have a place not too far away that sells tahini when I need some. The pistachio baklava is otherworldly. So, I can't hate this place. I am just going to avoid that falafel from now on.
The food was very good!! The delivery was before the expected time. The delivery guy was very nice

Food was great and they worked around all our special requests: gluten free, substitute this for that, add this, but leave this off. It sounds like we were picky but it was like pancakes or oats instead of hashbrowns, add fruit to pancakes. What wasn't spectacular was their service. It took 15 minutes before anyone took our order and 30+ minutes or more before our food came, so almost an hour after we sat done before eating.
Amazing people. Excellent coffee. Really a very pleasant place to hang around. They have a Morrocon touch to the place which is nice. Highly recommend.

After hearing about how amazing Magic Carpet was and seeing how long the lines were every day for the 4 years I've been at Penn, I finally decided to get the highly-recommended magic meatballs pita sandwich yesterday and was actually.. kinda disappointed. I can eat vegetarian food just fine, but I don't like it when they try to imitate meats I guess. Just give me vegetables or tofu as it is please. I might try the falafel or something else before giving up on Magic Carpet but considering this experience and the long lines.. doubtful.

What's the wonderful store! Just few days ago I had problem with my car and went to ask Manager what will be the best solution. He solved everything so nicely with a high level of knowledge and a professionalism.
Manager's name is Joshua and we (me and my husband) love this guy absolutely. He is so intelligent, skilled and the best fit for the position! Besides that Joshua posses such a great personality. I don't know better store in this area with such a wonderful customer service. Way to go guys and others should follow! Thank you so much!
Joanna W.

Went here after reading the decent reviews.  Service was sub par, but I'm sure it was the server we were assigned.  Food was decent, but not authentic.  No Horchata...a big clue that shouts..."we're not OG, we're just Wannabees..."  Anyway, with so many other Mexican restaurants around that area,
I would try others before considering another visit.

Took my 2005 car to this shop because they had inexpensive tires. I plan on trading my car in within a year and I looked for the cheapest I could find. So I ordered the tires on line in the evening after the shop had closed. I received a confirmation email that the tires were available the next morning. I called to set up an appointment and the gentleman who I spoke to was very nice. I made the appointment and also requested an oil change, the man making my appointment said he would add that on. I arrive at my appointment about 15 min before my appointment time. I was ignored by one of the men at the desk, but the other one acknowledged me and checked me in, his name was Kevin.  The oil change was never added. My car also needed an alignment and they informed me of that and gave me the price. All was fine, but there were a few issues: 3 stations to check people in and out and lots of customers standing around waiting to be acknowledged and checked out or in, no updates at all regarding how much longer things are going to take; my appointment ran 1 hour over what they estimated time for service would be. .I realize they don't need to update people but it would just be nice. Otherwise, I would return for service to this shop, they have a nice waiting area and the mail to walk around. It wasn't a bad experience, from the time I got the text telling me my car was done to the time I was checked out was about 9 min and I was in the waiting area.

This was quite possibly the WORST dining experience I have ever had. My seafood risotto was swimming in oil and my wife's fettuccini was delivered with a hard shell exterior from sitting in the window too long. My minestrone soup was flavorless as was my risotto. I would NEVER recommend this place for anything. One star was the lowest I could go.

My husband and I had drinks with dear friends at the bar/lounge over the Thanksgiving Holiday. They were visiting the area from the South and were staying in the hotel. Very nice! While they were out of stock of the original bottle of champagne we ordered, we settled on another. We had great laughs and enjoyed catching up while warming up next to the fire place! Hopefully I will get to check out the guest rooms in the near future on a Philly "stay-cation"!

This evening was the first time I visited this nail salon and I was presently surprised. My sister and I both felt pampered, warmed neck pillows, beverages and cleanliness will have us back for sure. 
Appointments only, but we didn't have to wait at all.

One of the BEST Record Stores in the country in my humble opinion.  Amazing selection of music/Vinyl, merchandise, and lots of very cool knick knacks.  FREE In-Stores with some of the most amazing artists touring the country.  A+++  Support LOCAL and IMAGINE yourself at this cool place hanging out A LOT.
This place was amazing and the service by Jordan was superb! Will for sure return. The ambiance and the food was impeccable.

The reason I gave Harvest 4 stars was for the exceptional service . I honestly wish I remembered my waiters name but I didn't have to ask for absolutely anything he did a great job . I had the avocado and artichoke dip for appetizer which I wasn't fond of and scallops for dinner which was great

Very honest, respectable place. Great costumer service! The employees are very knowledgeable. Their prices are very reasonable too.

If you need regular maintenance for your vehicle, this is the place!

Best place for breakfast! Huge, very tasty portions. Just the right amount of attention from Mike, our waiter too (I hate waitstaff that asks 10 times "Is everything ok? Is everything ok?") Mike was busy but stayed on top of everything....refilled my coffee at just the right time! Big smiles and greetings from all the friendly staff who seemed to really enjoy working here. We like their "wait time" online option as they are always busy.
Cash only! Staff was nice, but un-attentive. Service was very slow. Had the Cheese steak. It was just ok. This would be a better drink stop. I would not stop to eat again.

Natalie was awesome! If you've already done all of the craziness that comes with NOLA and want something a little more chill and informative, this is a good time. Bar break half way through and tons of informative stories about the birth of New Orleans!

I love the shrimp dumplings!  Soup dumplings are a little messier than I'd like but they taste great.  Make sure you have them read your order back to you, I've received the wrong items on more than one occasion.

I was here for lunch on new year's Eve and this is one of the coolest bars I've been to the food is very reasonably priced and I sat on the heated patio which was at a comfortable temperature considering it was at least 14° outside and the staff is very friendly and attentive but keep in mind this place is strictly 21+ so bring your ID.
I only order 2 dishes, they r really really terrible!! Too salty and not like Sichuan food at all!反正如果是四川重庆的大概不会喜欢这家店...醋溜土豆丝用白醋，酸的很奇怪。火锅鱼就是火锅底料做的，鱼片和手指头差不多厚.这些菜还没自己在家里做的好吃也是醉了.....

Amazing authentic food... Finally!!! I had the wonton noodle soup and spicy BBQ pork bahn mi. Broth was definitely made from bones. Noodles weren't soggy, always a plus. The wontons are a perfect mix of pork, shrimp, fish sauce and maybe oyster sauce. Not sure but delicious to say. 

The bahn mi was perfect amount of spice and freshness. The roll was toasty and huge. This place does not skimp on portion sizes. Couldn't finish everything will have the rest later today. 

Service was great too and attentive. They are open to other cultures being there I was not treated any differently. I will be going back.
Worst Bloody Mary I've ever had. If you like drinking horseradish, this is the place for you.

If you can't find something that catches your attention on this menu, there's maybe something wrong with you. The menu is a book, with adverts, that goes on, and on, and on.

And they pretty much nail everything on the menu too.

If I had to pick a favorite dish it would be the chicken costelletta (sp?). It's a huge piece of pounded down chicken cutlet lightly breaded and sauteed with a lemon sauce, yummy!

Of course the cheesecake here is awesome, and again, there are way too many choices for cheesecake as well. Not to be outshone by the cheesecake... I can also vouch for the carrot cake and the black out cake, both to die for.

By far the worst shopping experience I have ever had! Not only did noone greet me when I walked in, but every employee I came in contact with was very rude. There were a lot of employees walking around and not one asked me if I needed anything or I I was finding everything okay. After being ignored by multiple employees while waiting for a dressing room I was disappointed that every piece of clothing I tried on had a rip, stain or tear. Highly disappointed and will never return!

What a great find! It took me a while to locate it because I thought it was a separate business. It's in Assi (to the right and back) which I had also never been in before. Misoya Sushi has GREAT sushi at a very reasonable price. 2 rolls for $7.50 includes Miso Soup. I will definitely be going back there again. The sushi was delicious. 

Just to note, it's not a sit down restaurant, there are shared tables/chairs next to that and other restaurants.

I cannot say enough about how amazing my experience was and the results... OUTSTANDING.  The salon is beautiful, the service is impeccable, and I have definitely found my new Tucson salon!  I am coming from LA and ATL and can honestly say that this salon is up to every expectation that I had hoped for.  Thank you Circa 79!

We ate here for lunch one day because our mule carriage tour guide told us it was a great spot for lunch, it was! We had 2 delicious sammys and some onion rings, all was good! The rouben was good but the chicken sandiwch with pesto I believe and some other stuff was awesome! Our server was a peach too, I think her name was Noelle, she was fabulous!
The server Theo was awesome in his recommendations and the food portions are huge and the taste was out of this world will definetly return

This is a must visit place for people living and visiting Philadelphia. I recently toured this place with my friend and we both loved the tour. It is a self guided audio tour and is pretty cool.
