If you are in Philadelphia and want to explore something not traditionally historic or hip, check this place out and experience the penitentiary.

Back in town for a junior year of college meant I had to get my doughnut fix in again! The Cotton Candy doughnut is still one of my favorites & my boyfriend is still hooked on the Sweet Pig, but we once again went overboard on how many custom ones we wanted to try so we ended up ordering 16 again. Still super fair pricing - we got 16 doughnuts, a lemonade, a chocolate milk, and 2 waters for a little over $20! They had brownie bites & cookie dough bits that we added to a few of our custom ones & I did a vanilla cake with lemon icing & raspberry drizzle that just tasted absolutely wonderful. We had to wait a bit for the chocolate doughnuts that day, just 10 mins, & it was well worth it too because our peanut butter cup doughnut was on a chocolate one & the warm doughnut melted the peanut butter cups perfectly - so delicious! The guy working the register that day was super helpful too with his suggestions & had a great personality too!

Great atmosphere and extremely nice and accommodating staff! We ordered the Santa Maria BBQ and the Burger. The burger was very good and the bBQ was good as well. The meat was cooked perfectly. We also got the Chefs plate which was good but the soup was just ok. If I could go back, I would get the eggamuffins instead. The eggamuffins are phenomenal. I  think our experience was very good and we will come back. It was worth 4.25-4.5 stars. The food was good but I think could of been a little better to get 5 stars. I would highly recommend this for a small group or a night out on the town. The outdoor seating area looked very nice but we sat inside. We will be back.

We loved our recent stay here!

The hotel is located right across the street from West Beach and Stearn's Wharf.   And, it is on the corner of State Street which is Santa Barbara's "downtown" area.   We just parked our car at the hotel and didn't need it until we checked out.   I'd have to say that the location is one of the best things about the hotel.

We had a balcony room overlooking the ocean.  The views were great!  The plantation shutters in the room let just the right amount of sunlight in.  The room is quite spacious - we also had a small sofa and coffee table to relax in.  The bathroom and entry floors had Spanish tiles - very pretty design.   A really comfortable room overall.  Plus, it was quiet in the room - we couldn't hear any traffic noise or people in the other rooms next to us.

We walked along Cabrillo Blvd, and I couldn't help comparing other hotels we saw with the Harbor View Inn.  Definitely, this is one of the best hotels we saw.  The hotel is well kept, beautiful flowers on the grounds.  

The restaurant at the hotel, Eladio's, makes pretty good food.  We had breakfast via room service - huge portions, quite tasty.  We had dinner there also - it's a casual place which was also good for our toddler.  (Of course, we went early at 5:30pm!)

A charming hotel in a wonderful location!

We went to this establishment the other night. This was our second time. We came back for the delicious Fried Pickles.. There was a lot of different sandwiches on the menu.. The first time, I had Cuban Sandwich and French Fries. My second time, I got chicken strips with french fries. My partner got the Buffalo Chicken wrap with french fries. The food was superb.. We really enjoyed the atmosphere.. The pub feeling, full bar, very clean.. The wait staff was very attentive and made sure that everything was ok.. It was kind of funny, we ask the waitress what was on the fries. We couldn't tell what made the fries tastes so good. Something on it made it tasty.. She thought that I didn't like the fries and offer to get me another plate of fries. I told her that I was wondering what was on it.. I guess it has salt and pepper with garlic powder. I am guessing they sprinkle dill on the fries. It was delicious. 

 I highly recommend this place.. Very good..

My friend and I had been wanting to try Suraya and were pleasantly surprised to score a reservation on a Saturday night. 

After checking in we did have to wait a few minutes for our table which was a small two top in the very back. The patio was closed but looked like an awesome place to dine. 

The best dish we had all night was the fatteh, a warm brown butter chickpea dip served with pita. The batata harra (crispy potatoes), fried kibbeh (ground beef dumplings), and turmeric rice were all delicious as well. 

I personally would not order the muhammara (red pepper and walnut dip) or the ground lamb kabob again. 

The kabobs were served with a side of charred tomatoes, onions, and peppers which were perfect on top of the rice. I wish I could make vegetables that taste that good at home. 

By the end of the meal we were both completely stuffed. I am anxious to come back and try brunch at Suraya, which I heard is their specialty!

We finally had the time to check this place out. Every time we visit NOLA we always say we want to come check out the "Famous Mother's" restaurant. I ordered the famous Debris PO-Boy but had to send it back, it simply had zero flavor, it tasted like meat & water on French bread! I also got Jerry's famous Jambalaya, it was okay not bad, it just had hot & cold spots so I'm guessing it was not fresh! My hubby ordered the shrimp PO-Boy and Fries. We sent the fries back they were old & cold, the P0-Boy was okay nothing spectacular. BTW, the sides are  sold separately, you would think it would come with a $16.00 sandwich. 

For this place to have so many famous people "pictures all over the wall" who have eaten here, you would think the "Famous" in front of most of the dishes would make you want to come back...Not!!  I traded my Debris sandwich for a sausage PO-Boy it was better but still just okay. Oh & my hubby ordered a beer on draft, it's not cold so he didn't finish it. I love NOLA and the great restaurants, but spending $50 on 2 sandwich's fries & a regular Jambalaya (lunch) would be just fine if the food was absolutely WOWing me!! So this Is my first & last visit here, it's not worth it. Oh the wait staff (you seat yourself) was really nice! She did bring us hot fries.
Great place for all shopping needs. 5% off on our total with a Target card. The workers are helpful and nice and the facility is fairly new/clean.

3.5 stars

"The more things change, the more they stay the same".  

I was a regular at the old Mainland Inn late 80's through late 90's.  Back then, the restaurant was run by and owned by Wendy and Donald Jonas, and in the first dozen of their 20 year reign the restaurant was superior in every aspect as to compare to any fine dining establishment in center city Phila or NYC. I am not bullshitting you.  After awhile, things got tired.  Oh, the service was still exemplary but it seemed like management "dialed it in", lost interest and thus I too lost interest.

Last night I returned for the first time since new ownership took over.  I was pleased to see the charm of this historic inn was not lost.  But expecting a new dynamic gastronomic  twist, exceptional creativity, something to make me coming running back once a month again, I was let down.

Let me just say that the manager is the best, from the greeting to helping you through your choices of spirits, (some gins and vodkas I never heard of and I've been drinking for years. ;-) wine choices, food selection, this guy did it all and so well that if I owned a restaurant I would have him run it.  One of the reasons I believe he did it so well is he had to assist what seemed to be an under trained wait staff which should not be in this type of establishment.  It's my opinion, don't shoot me nor key my car.  The buspeople were great, kudos for paying attention.

The Food:
The winter salad which was supposed to be supported by root vegetables had 1 narrow slice of beet, one small circle of parsnip, and maybe one other small piece of turnip? smothered in slightly wilted and over-salted mixed greens.  The truffle vinaigrette was divine.  The beet salad I was told was good.

The fresh oysters of the day were tender and excellent, two of which not completely shucked from the shell, but not a big deal.  The mignonette was tasty and appropriate.

The spiced lamb entree had a wonderful presentation.  The curried cauliflower, the duty trumpet mushroom (singular). the bulgur mixture, etc upon which the lamb sat was a good accompaniment. But the lamb cooked a perfect medium rare, suffered from some gristle, some toughness and fat in half of it, the other half was very good.  The sausage stuffed chicken which I tasted seemed good, not exceptional, and again with the salt, paleeese.

The wine list was interesting and varietal.  I love to try different wines.

The atmosphere for mid-Xmas week was quiet, only about 1/3 of the place was full, not a good sign, and  I would say 75% of the crowd were experienced eaters...you know,  50-60+ yrs old. ;-)

I'll try it again maybe in the summer, the new back patio looks inviting.

Excellent service. Server was very friendly and personable.
Extremely delicious food. Fantastic menu. Loved the variety of selection for food and thrilled that they have gluten free that is taste good. Portions are huge. Some of us had breakfast. Some had lunch. All really good!
And the best part was that for five of us it was only slightly over $60.00. For those of us on a strict budget this was a real treat!

I wanted some pulled pork; what I got was "Georgia Chopped Pork". Georgia Chopped Pork must be fast-cooked, careless BBQ because I had and equal ratio of fat to actual edible meat. 

For 14 dollars the portion size was TINY, and when asked by the server if everything looked "great" I had to politely say I was a bit disappointed. The manager quickly came out and said it looked like what was supposed to be my 8 ounce portion was indeed a bit skimpy.  

What erks me is that they are treating and pricing 8 ounces of pork shoulder like it's 8 ounces of a steak (and 4 ounces of that was unmelted chunks of fat). 

The server informed me the this so-called "Famous" Dave likes his BBQ full of chunks of rubbery fat and after proverbially "chewing the fat" for a bit longer she did admit that everything but the ribs were "hit-or-miss", everything is overpriced for what you get, and if you want traditional style BBQ without all that fat ask for it "lean" (nice to know after the fact).  

I can't say everything is gross because I only had my gross "corner-cut, feed these fools the fat" BBQ.

And the "macaroni & cheese" was full of corn.  I don't even...

I was in town on business and was looking for a place for a good Philly cheesesteak.  I walked past this place and talked with one of the servers.  Later I returned with some friends and decided to try the food here.  

That decision turned into a  wonderful eating experience.   This place has amazing food and the deserts are out of this world.  A complimentary glass of wine to start off with is a bonus.  I would recommend this restaurant to anyone living in or traveling to Philly.

I say it's not good for groups because it's a small place.  We had 7 in our party and we took up quite a bit of space.
Fantastic as usual. The French toast and pancakes are the best . We stop by whenever we are in town and never disappointed .

I love, love, love Chocolate Walrus!

Every time I've come in, the staff has always been excited to see me, and extremely helpful. The prices are reasonable, and they have an INCREDIBLE selection for such a small store. They have a great selection of toys, lubes, outfits, shoes, costumes...they have it all! I recently went in with my sister to find a Valentine's Day outfit, and found exactly what I wanted at a great price (the proof was in the look on my boyfriend's face ;]). As soon as we walked in the door, we were greeted by a smiling staff member and were offered chocolate covered strawberries from the chocolate store next door...they were so yummy! I always have a great experience coming here, and would refer Chocolate Walrus to anyone looking for an awesome adult shop.

My favorite place in Edmonton right now! We've definitely been missing a restaurant like this. Very similar to lots of restaurants in Toronto - small, tapas, urban style with hip hop music. The atmosphere is perfect for a young crowd planning to go out. 

As for the food, I enjoyed everything I had. The best item on the menu is the brussel sprouts (how surprising)! I've tried the beef carpaccio and the deviled tea eggs; both were packed with flavor. The beef bau, dumplings and fried chicken are perfect if you want a little bit more food. 

Overall, this place is awesome. Can't wait to go back!

Phoned in for a quote to assemble my spring/shock combination.  50 dollars... EACH.  For something that takes literally 5 minutes each side.  That's literally double the normal price...  That is ridiculous. That is to compress the spring and screw in 1 bolt...  Never had their tire service but I think i'll go bankrupt with the tires that I buy... last year bought 5 BFG 32 inch K02 and 4 Michelin Pilot Sport for both my cars.  If assembling a strut cost that much imagine how much installing a tire would cost... Good thing there is big brand & america's tire coming soon...

Fantastic treasure in Nashville! It was my first time to shop here and it definitely will not be my last. 
This special shop is upstairs and when you arrive at the door you must knock; then you are greeted by one of their knowledgeable, friendly, stylish, fun friends. I say friends because that's what you will become before you leave this fantastic boutique! 
I had such a delightful experience and I know that you will as well. 
I loved knocking on the door; I felt like I was entering a secret place just for me! The selection of clothing was nice and so were the accessories. If you like Saint John look no further, they have a great selection. Their variety of good condition designer clothing, handbags, shoes, jewelry, formalwear and men's clothing is wonderful! 
The decor is special as well! From the minute you walk in the door you will feel happy and not pressured because this my friends is a very unique place and everyone should experience the beautiful selections and the friendly staff.

The food is good but the service was horrendous. Might be the worst service I have experienced in all of Philadelphia. There are so many restaurants in Philly with amazing food that dealing with the very rude and unhelpful staff here is not worth it. They dropped plates and glasses constantly with one plate chard hitting me and no one said anything. They took plates while people were still eating and served us cold plates of food. Don't eat here.

Buyer Beware!!! We purchased the very expensive Kinetico system for our home. Shortly after a brief period of usage we noticed the brine tank was overflowed and the tank was filled with water. Caller Kinetico service, the tech came out and performed a brief service at a cost of a $139.00 service charge. A short time later we noticed the unit was not using any salt, we called the service tech  to re-check the issue. He advised us to wait a few months to see if the salt usage increased. It did not increase the usage of salt. We called service and was told it would cost us another $139.00 for a service charge. What a rip-off this company is. Customer service is the worst.  We should have purchased Culligan!

10 stars! 

We were searching for a custom wooden dining table base for our stone tabletop (purchased elsewhere), and Paul and the Philadelphia Table Company were simply a pleasure to work with. We had a very specific idea of a design we wanted, and they executed!  We showed them a photograph of a base found at a big-box store, and Paul and the team recreated it for us.  

I'll be honest - I ask a LOT of questions, and struggle with not controlling every aspect of the process.  Every email and DM that I sent over (which, were multiple, I assure you) were promptly and thoroughly answered, with the upmost professionalism and enthusiasm.  For stain colors, I was having trouble visualizing the stains in our space, and the team mailed over physical samples for us to look at.  They continued to update us during the build process, showed us mock-up photos, and even worked with us to change the design slightly, at my request. 

The obvious best/most important factor is that the table base was everything we hoped for.  The piece is stunning, sturdy, and perfect - it's very clear the team takes pride in their craft.  Delivery was a breeze, and was super fast and efficient.  My only regret is that we don't have a need for anymore furniture right now!  Would absolutely recommend Philadelphia Table Company to anyone looking for beautiful furniture, made to last!

*Note: We never stepped foot in their show room, nor met with Paul or his team in person, due to Covid19.  Despite that, I felt extremely taken care of, and valued as a customer throughout the process.

This past Friday night was my first trip to Saigon as well as my only experience with Vietnamese food.  I wanted to try it the previous weekend, but they were closed for several days, presumably on a family vacation.  This former Bob Evans isn't much to look at on the outside, but I am so glad I tried it. The inside is decorated well and seemed to be very clean and mostly updated.  This honestly turned out to be one of the best meals I have ever had, no kidding!

I began this feast by giving the Tsingtao beer a whirl.  It was refreshing and crisp, reminding me a bit of a Grolsch with a hint of Heineken.  It was actually a very good lager and far exceeded my expectations of what a Chinese beer would be like. 

I had ordered the vegetable spring rolls as an appetizer.  They are cold, with sauteed tofu, rice and basil leaves wrapped in a rice paper.  I haven't cared much for peanut sauce in the past, but the one that came with these rolls was delicious!  I also enjoyed the mismatched vintage Corelle plates that came out with them.

For my entree, I went with the basil tofu.  It was absolutely divine!  A very generous amount of  perfectly cooked tofu strips along with broccoli florets, snow peas, onions, bean sprouts, thin carrots in a lovely flower shape, cooked wedges of tomato, and of course, basil leaves, topped with a nectarous brown sauce on a beautiful white, square plate and a heaping little bowl of steamed white rice on the side.  I kept eating even though I was full because it tasted so, so good.  Even though I had to have eaten half to three quarters of my meal, I still had a hefty amount of this treasure left over to take home for later.  The flavor of the sauce was amazing, spicy without feeling like a fire-breathing dragon.  I could seriously eat spoon fulls of the sauce alone, but everything combined, especially with the basil, was such a fresh, tasty symphony for the senses.  

The only thing that could POSSIBLY make this dish any better would be some mushrooms, but it was definitely excellent as is.  I got to brush up a bit on my chopstick skills, but was also given a fork and spoon which came in handy.

My dining companion, who was so thoughtful to bring me here, ordered a "clay pot" of beef that also came with rice.  It did seem to be very good, as there was none left, and did appear to be pleasing to my eye as well, but I didn't comprehend it to be as much of a life-changing experience as my meal was.

Saigon had an extensive menu with plenty of things for everyone, including many choices suitable for you fellow vegans.  I will have lots of variety from which to choose on subsequent visits, though I will positively be wanting that basil tofu again.  Among the things I saw on the menu that looked interesting were the bubble teas and an avocado shake.  I would absolutely like to try pho also since I hear such good things about it and its addictive properties.

I might add, the restaurant had a pretty good radio station playing that also made for nice ambiance.  The tables were shiny and of high quality.  The dining room was very colorful and sparkling.  It was surprisingly not crowded at all, but I think the stormy weather had affected the crowds this night at many establishments.  The children that sat us were a delight and so adorable.  Our server, who I am guessing was the owner, wasn't over-the-top friendly, but was very prompt with food, drinks/refills and fulfilled my request for a to-go box with a hospitable smile.  The restroom was probably the original from when this building was first erected, but it was clean and stocked,  The only thing I would like to see is a working website so customers could peruse the menu online, but it is not a necessity.

Overall, a wonderful experience ESPECIALLY due to the incredible food.  How on EARTH had I not tried Vietnamese until now?!?  I do reckon I have found myself a new favorite cuisine!  I greatly urge you to try Saigon.

Stopped in mid week for a beer and some music. Longest bar in Nashville.
Music was good and wait staff was friendly and attentive.
This YMCA is great I have been to many ymcas from Chicago to jersey to Daytona  but none has been this good they are friendly and has plenty of things for the seniors and young alike to di
i wish i could put into words just how much i love and miss yats. sigh.

I love walking around in here. When I step through the doors it's like venturing into the mid 90's. Nothing has changed. Clearance sections are abundant with hidden treasures intertwined within. The thrill of the chase is enough to provide an hour or so of fun for you and a friend....and for those who are brave enough to seek it, they may find a hidden gem to take home at 75% off the original price.

This is a nice little gem in Broad Ripple.  There is a pretty strong hipster vibe mixed with the yoga mom/possible college student set.  One of the best thing about this place is that their food tastes like you could make it at home (even if that's not true) which gives it a very welcoming and homey quality.  Speaking of quality, they select high quality ingredients and clearly take pride in their menu and service.  Their salads are outstanding.  OUTSTANDING.  And the lentil soup with ham is really quite fantastic.  It is earthy and unassuming, highlighting everything that is good about lentils.  If you are in Broad Ripple and looking for a nice place to eat in your yoga pants while you type away on your laptop, this is the place for you.  Actually, this the place for you regardless.  The food is fantastic.

We have been to Sedona Taphouse several times and have always had excellent food and service.   Sedona is a great addition to downtown Phoenixville.  The truffle fries are fantastic as is the Devil's Pass pasta.  The draft beer selection may be the best in town.
Great place, great people, and great food. What else can  I say? We've been going here for years and this is our go to place for Mexican

I was in the area so I decided to check this place out.  I really like trying authentic Mexican joints and this one fit the bill.  As with many other places, this Mexican restaraunt is attached to a grocery store.  The place is small but comfortable.  I think 8 booths with a large family sized table in the middle.  

We tried the shrimp diablo and carne asada.  Although the dishes were good, there was nothing spectacular about them.  I guess the asada was the best.  Although the meat was chewy, it was flavored well.  The shrimp was just ok.  I was expecting a sauce with a bit more punch.  The rice, beans, and tortillas that accompanied both dishes were plentiful but just average in flavor.  

All in all, this place was fine and offered good value for the money.  I just wouldn't travel across the city to eat here.

The place was packed on a Sunday at noon but we only waited about 15 minutes for a table for 12. We all enjoyed great service and excellent food. I ordered the Eggs Benedict. The eggs were properly poached and the holindase sauce tasted authentic. It's a little expensive for breakfast but you'll leave satisfied.
Had a great meal on a Wednesday afternoon. Plenty of great choices on the menu. I had the sampler, which gave me a lick of almost every plate. Yummy!)

I had a bad experience with a coat I purchased.  It was literally falling apart.  I HATE RETURNING THINGS!!!!!  ...So I just returned it with ease back to Macy's.  Great experience.  I was never left to feel uncomfortable at any time.
Had a 1-hr massage yesterday by Denise. One of my top-10 massages....she is EXCELLENT. And the prices are very reasonable. I wish I lived closer!

Bad food -  reverse discrimination


Wow - simply amazing. I waited 25 minutes for a Big Mac and a 20 piece. Seven minutes in line before anyone at the fire drill occurring behind the counter actually thought to see if there was anyone at their counter. I was fourth in line.

Once I ordered, I waited and waited. Halfway through, one of the fine crew jostled her friend and mumbled something - the two words I could make out were White and ***hole.

Really? Sorry to bother you guys. I guess I'm not really sure what ethnic groups are keeping you afloat. On Lancaster Avenue. On the Main Line.

Oh, and the order was wrong! Yay! I know it was two items - my bad.

Reevaluate your staff - the Supervisor was completely oblivious as to what was going on in her store. When you change your policies towards serving everyone, you just let me know.

Phone number rings off into the nether regions, so no way to complain.

I am writing this review for my parents who don't have yelp. We/they have been pretty good customers at jacks pizza....since we've lived in Avon (2004). My parents ordered pizza last night and were over charged for their toppings. Then today as my mom and grandma were eating leftovers, my mom was eating a slice and hit something hard, she then spit out her pizza and noticed that there was a staple in her slice and that's what she had bit into. They (jacks) called back and offered a $10 discount towards a pizza or next purchase. I work in the food service industry and this is so wrong. If this was at a real restaurant, purchase would have been refunded and no charge to customer, but a $10 discount is what they received. After being over charged for toppings, and then finding a staple which is a choking hazard and if my mom would have swallowed it, who knows what harm that could have caused. Luckily she didn't and spit it out just to have awful customer service. Most likely won't be ordering anymore pizza from jacks.

Great Salsa and  fried Jalapeno app.  The quesadilla was small and boring came with a teaspoon of guacamole, sour cream and salsa.  The tacos were gross and completely dried out.  Service was decent but he forgot our entrees.  Food is way overpriced for the quality and portion that you receive.  The spicy margarita was good. The top shelf was horrible and I watched the bartender make it and no jigger used.  Also no orange liquor or cognac float as stated in description. Don't waste your time with this place!!!!!

Eating healthy has never been easier, thanks to Revel Kitchen. 

I literally get the build your own bowl every time. You choose a base (quinoa or cauli rice for me), veggies (sweet potato, broccoli, or mushrooms are my favs), and a protein (mojo chicken and pork). Top it off with a sauce - I've had the bbq and the cilantro lime. Cilantro lime has sweet tangy flavor - it's my favorite! 

Portion sizes for the bowl are good - the large feels like a bargain for the price. 

Food is consistently good. I've never had a bad-tasting meal.

A couple times I've been here they've put the wrong veggies in my bowl, but tbh all the veggies are pretty good so I never complain. 

In the Brentwood location, they have a cool water station that dispenses sparkling water. I love sparkling water, so I've always loved this little touch. 

If you download the app and order through it, you can earn reward points!

What a fantastic stay! Though the ghost of Aaron Burr never stopped by to say hi. Checking in and out was incredibly easy. The owner and additional staff were all exceptionally friends, and educational about the history of the Inn as well as New Hope. Our room was cozy,  and breakfast was ABSOLUTELY delicious. Would stay again. Would live there if I could!

Ordered a spider roll today and the staff was really nice and the wait wasnt too long so I'll give them 2 stars, however the portion sizes are ATROCIOUS. how are you going to charge customers $14 for a roll with only 5 (edible) pieces?? the end pieces were so large they fell apart when I tried to pick them up with my chopsticks :/ Really unfortunate since it seems to be the only sushi place in my area

Love this place! I've always appreciated their cleanliness, but even more so now with COVID-19. All the staff wore their masks the entire time I was their, over their mouth and nose as one should. 

But enough about that! Stephanie always does an amazing job on my hair! I've never not been happy with her work. I love that she is so knowledgeable! On top of all of this you can tell that she loves what she does! She also always makes me feel so welcome when I come see her... Like a lifelong friend!

It's as if my cool Aunt and Uncle decided to open a food truck and hook me up with their tastiest treats. These guys don't come around Drexel as much as they used to (or as much as I'd like), but when they're here I'm running straight for their vegetarian specials. Why the almost-perfect score? It's a little pricy for the portion sizes.

It's a local greasy spoon.  I remember as a kid being so excited to go here for breakfast to get one of the pancakes that hangs over the plate or ooohing and aaaahing over their chocolate cream pies.  I went for dinner this time, and although I was happy to see they finally updated their physical menus (they were worn out before), the food was just okay.  Portions are large and prices are low.  The cornbread was really good.  The pies were still calling my name, but none for me on this visit.  I suggest going by for a pie to go (because they are so tasty).  Service isn't the quickest and this isn't a farm to table type of establishment.  However, it's a fixture on the south west side of Indy and will continue to serve the neighborhood for years to come.

Excellent food. Priced rite. Always consistent.
Atmosphere is bland-not good date nite location LOL
HIGHLY recommend this place for awesome Chinese food

I had Easter Brunch at CJ's.  It was fantastic!! They kept it stocked and fresh, Food was very tasty and hot.  Great presentation!! Keep up the good work.

I went back on Dine Out for Life, I had Chicken and Dumplings.  It was very good, plenty of chicken and dumplings.  Norman was my server and did a great job.
This place is great! Baristas know their coffee, are knowledgeable, and the selection of beer is fabulous. The building has a lot of natural light and it is perfect for working.

Well, we got back the best part of Applebees in our opinion.. which if you checked with the  "regulars" ... is Jordan!!! She is such a super friendly person with amazing service and interpersonal skills. We, along with a  "bar full" of folks were not happy and were ready to give up being the regulars we are...we love Sara, Ella, MJ  Jenny and Matthew too!! Our Applebees 
Life is great again and we just purchased another $200 in Gift Cards!!! The regulars are THRILLED!! Go Jordan!!! Happy!
While visiting Santa Barbara, I walked in to check out their bikes. Their inventory was low due to the pandemic but the staff was friendly and informative. Would definitely recommend this bike shop.

I always try gumbo whenever I dine out in New Orleans. With that said, this place has one of the best I've had. Good rue and nice okra base. The combination dinner place was ok/good. The jambalaya was the worst part on the plate. The complementary bread was hard and did not taste fresh. Cream spinach was a bit flavorless. Bread pudding was awesome!!

Upon walking into the restaurant we found 2 hostesses on their cell phones that didn't acknowledge us until we were too close to ignore. They continued to chat and tell each other that they had no idea where to seat us because they weren't paying attention. We were sat at a table near the railing and waiting for over 15 minutes for our server to greet us. She was rather inattentive to us but gave great service to her friend that came later and sat at the table behind us. Managers could be found standing around chatting with employees as tables went back to the host stand to ask why they hadn't been greeted by a server after waiting - much like we did. All in all, drinks were watered down, queso on the nachos tasted like Kraft mac and cheese sauce and the fried grouper sandwich was over done. Extremely disappointed. Seems like the only thing they have going for them is the location.

Got on waiting list when we arrived 
Several people were seated before us that arrived long after we did
Waited 45 minutes and never got seated 
Last straw was having to deal with a Rude employee

Best Mexican restaurant we've ever been to! Very busy but seated and order taken quick. Great food fast friendly service. Highly recommend. Don't know if it's forever but 50% off for senior citizens on Tuesday nights. Hell of a deal! 

The Unknown Diner digs it the most!

Cleanest, friendliest, best selection of drinks, gas, food, snacks and the best car wash in town. All this with a twist of unique options. Things you won't normally find at any other store, period. A friend said they don't sell Truly Raspberry Lime in sigler anywhere. Fast Eddy's does.  I just found out they have this cool scan as you go and pay on your phone. You don't even need an app. So smooth, so easy. So cool.

Would give it 0 stars if I could. Are you pregnant and needing lunch? If so, don't come here! I've now had two encounters with this place (one in 2014 and the other today) in which I was NOT able to get my meat packaged on the side by request until I argued with the associates. I should not have to argue with associates to receive a special request for health purposes. 

For those of you who are not aware, the American Pregnancy Association recommends that pregnant women heat deli meats to a certain temperature before eating them to kill any listeria that it may contain. Some recommend and choose not to eat it at all. Everyone it entitled to their own choices. My choice today was to purchase a cold sandwich, with my meat packaged separately, to heat that meat in my own microwave until the required temperature and reconstruct my sandwich when it cooled. I think it's hilarious to have associates say "I'm not sure we can do that" when I ask for my meat to be packaged separately. YES YOU CAN! Wrap it in the many pieces of butcher paper you have lying there and stick a little sticker on it. I assure you, you CAN do this. It is not rocket science. 

As I'm writing this, I see another complaint in my sidebar about the service from a pregnant patron. In 2014, I was called by the district manager and assured that this situation would not happen again. He said that he would be training all staff in this district to understand these (simple) special requests. Especially when there is a health risk involved. I see that training never occurred. Very disappointing. I will be taking my business to Jersey Mike's and Subway, who are VERY accommodating when presented with this request.

Ate there Saturday night. Your typical white table cloth fancy high end seafood restaurant. They were out of the cheesy potatoes when we got there by 8PM. Really no potatoes and cheese? Although compliments to the chef who made the hollandaise sauce for the asparagus and the choco mousse, it was really good. The rest of the dishes we had, just ok. Pricy but the service was good and the place and ambiance  was great. Good for special occasions.

The best thing about this place is its location. It's the best place on South Street to sip on a cool drink, catch a patio breeze and people watch. Don't go there and expect to eat anything edible..... lol

I ordered a pizza, and those morons used AMERICAN CHEESE on it instead of mozzarella. Who does that? When I complained about my food, my friend and I were ASKED to leave!  I;m not kidding!

I was told that they are a "family-owned" restaurant and they have the right to deny service if they so choose, and would we please leave!!!

NO PROBLEM!!! The food was gross, and the staff was unaccomodating. I will never go there again. You can tell by the lukewarm ratings from most other people about this restaurant that I'm not the only one who hates this place.

Great place to wind down, relax, chill, you get the idea! Its recommended for those who love art and reading, as UE has plenty of space to do that. They are good at holding events there, and its a cool place to hold small meetings. Their sandwiches and baked goods are great, as well as their smoothies. They also have a decent craft beer selection as well. Only bad thing is the parking, well sometimes. I could say the same thing for most other nearby places. Check out this place next time you're in Dutchtown!

Finally got to eat here and it will be the last.

If you've read my previous experience at Wakin' & Bakin', you know it ended with me not being able to eat. Well, I wanted to really try this place, so I decided to today. The food was subpar. 

I ordered the gravy train and my friend ordered the queso burrito. Both of us were unimpressed. The gravy train, as they called it, was overpriced and tasted quite bad. The two small biscuits were undercooked and the smaller amount of gravey they put on top of them tasted of mostly onion. The 2 eggs and bacon were the only decent things apart of my meal. 

The queso burrito with sausage was dry and  mostly tortilla. We ordered grits, which they forgot and we had to go request them after our food arrived. All while there was only one other patron drinking coffee in the store and multiple employees talking. We had one coffee and two waters and the total bill was $24.00

Overpriced subpar food. I gave this place two tries. Maybe you'll have better luck than I did.
Love this bar! Such a good happy hour and yummy food. Kory is the best bartender, he makes delicious drinks and is easy on the eyes too. You have to try his mojito, perfection.

Picture this: your favorite brewery serves cold coffee that's nitro infused.  That pretty much sums this place up. In other words it's awesome.  I had the cubano which is a cold coffee that is creamy and delicious. I got to try a delicious orange flavored coffee as well.   I prefer strong coffee so the cubano was a natural choice for me but they have other offerings that's aren't as strong.  They serve food and craft beer too.

The fact that this chain does not offer egg dishes made only with egg whites is very disappointing, and seems about 15 years behind the times in an era when low-cholesterol version of egg dishes are available even at Denny's.  While the menu is attractive, for people who are attempting to stay healthy or keep a vegan diet  the menu can be a bit of a test of willpower even though the pictures of the fruit they use would lead you to expect otherwise.

WOW is all I can say. we came into Boise and cruised down by the down town, Anet said that is an interesting center, but I can't tell what is in there because of the trees. SO we pulled in looked at two menus, asked for a great salad and the man said you are at the right place. Well we were! The food came out incredibly fast and we were at lunch hour (for those who work)! The ingredients were incredibly fresh and my chicken club was perfect! Go as often as you can this place is GREAT.

We got a pretty big takeout order and everything came out perfect, nothing was forgotten and all special requests were completed. I had the mahi mahi wrap which was good but needed a bit more flavor. You could definitely taste the chili but not much else. The fries were SO good. We got a side of the white cheese sauce that just made the fries even better. The Cajun pierogis I wouldn't really recommend, they were just greasy and nothing amazing. I didn't try the sausage egg and cheese egg rolls but they looked delicious, got eaten very quickly and came with spicy ketchup. The spicy ketchup was such a nice addition that I also used for fries. Can't wait to visit when they're fully open and operating and try more dishes.

Omg! Another way too expensive overrated burger joint replacing the exact same restraint. (Was table rock) overpriced drinks also. Slow service. Love the way condiments come in a thumb sized container. Good for about 3 fries at those prices, put the whole damn bottle of "fancy".lol ketchup on the table! Don't see how this place won't fail when its exactly like the place it replaced!

Truly horrible! We made an order on UberEats....spent $36+.......missing a whole $7 burger, getting a refund of $2.68.....thanks. Oh, and the other burger wasn't what he wanted at all.....but didn't realize it until after I requested my refund. I wouldn't recommend them at all...,.I'll make the drive for Five Guys, or the delivery isn't too bad from them either. At least the damn sprite wasn't flat.

I was expecting something else. This was just a high gloss greasy spoon restaurant. Very little seating and for being a small joint the service was slow.  Maybe it's a Nashville thing. Once we did get our food it was just ok, not worth the wait.  The corned beef hash was pretty bland and greasy.  

But I will give them props for the customer service. The 2 guys working the counter were very friendly and made sure my coffee was full.

Great night in their outdoor seating "beer yard". Service was excellent during a crowded first Friday evening. Stable 12 has a great menu that extends beyond typical bar faire. It's not just wings burgers and fries. The beer menu is extensive and all their own brews with about 6-8 on tap and a seemingly endless variety in cans ready to go or pour in house.
This was so amazing and totally worth the wait. My server Skye was super sweet and friendly. The food is so yummy!!!
Awesome subs, nice customer service and very large selection of sandwiches to choose from, my favorite is the Hero!!!

So good!!!! 
The service and food were great!! 
I will say I was a little disappointed with the Mac and cheese hot chicken because it was not seasoned that great and just wasn't as good as I thought it would be for all the hype. 
But overall the experience was great!

We just moved back to town and use to love the food. Now, honestly their menu is terrible and the food has gone down hill big time! If you are going to make such a limited menu then I would think they should nail the food! We won't be dining here anymore

Its a decent place around to meet with friends for some drinks located in the mall. I liked their Jambalaya. Tried their nachos, margherita pizza,firecracker shrimp and tacos. Their rice was flavorful.

Okay, the decor and potential ambiance of this place are legit, and I've heard good things about Ladder 15's food. But it ends there.

Dat. Crowd.

I thought Field House attracted a douchey clientele, but this place ups the ante substantially. I checked in on Foursquare and got the "frattastic" badge, which is always a good indication that I should locate my nearest exit, keeping in mind that it may be behind me (it was).

There's a slim chance I might return before sunset to sample the food I've heard all about, but you will have to drag me kicking and screaming if you expect me to go back after dark.

Try the eggnog special if they have it. Really good. Plenty of seating and really long tables so you can have large groups come and have a good time. They have a lot of artsy pieces and the place will definitely grow on you.
Great food wonderful staff enjoyed my visit I will totally come back. The short rib was so good but I ordered shrimp and grits regretting not getting the short rib lol.

I have been seeing Dr. Moelleken for about 8 years. In 2002 I was diagnosed with a herniated disc and told I could no longer work. In 2008 I finally was referred to Dr. Moelleken.  I did a little research and found he was very well educated and qualified. What a life saver! He also found I had a pinch nerve. Surgery was not something I was ready for so he went through all of my options. I am on a pain management plan where they  monitor my health very closely. I have never experienced what the others have said where he comes in and isn't thorough. He carefully picks his P.A.'s. They are very qualified and competent. This year Dr. Moelleken performed spine surgery on my husband and he is doing amazing, he can get out  of bed without pain radiating down his legs. I just wanted to give Dr. M a big hug. In 2014, my work sent me to an IME who said I had miraculously recovered and could return to work. I appealed and Dr. Moelleken came to my hearing and testified. You could tell he truly cared for me as his patient. I was so impressed when Dr. Moelleken actually pulled my MRI up  on the screen and walked them through exactly what was wrong with my back.
I will say that sometimes the wait is long, but that only tells you that he does take his time with his patients. Isn't quality worth the wait? Anytime I've had an issue office manage George Rodriquez was quick to find a solution.  The front staff are always friendly. When I decide its time for surgery Dr. M will be the only one I let touch my back!  I would highly recommend Dr. Moelleken.

The food here is OK--the ingredients seem to be pretty high quality, but the flavors were not very imaginative. The atmosphere is really cool and the decore is very nice.

The biggest problem, in my opinion, is the service. Despite there being only one other patron in the restaurant when we arrived, we had to specifically ask to be sat at a table and the hostess sort of grumbled about having to push two tables together in the otherwise empty room. Further, even though there seemed to be 4-6 people working, the service was quite slow. After we had decided what to order we were passed by no less than 3 employees before someone finally came by to take our order. Finally, when it was time for us to pay, the waiter stood over our shoulder and watched us select the tip amount (options were 20, 25, and 30% or custom). Because the waiter was standing over us, it was pretty difficult to negotiate the tip amount.

Overall, I would say the lack of creativity coupled with the unpleasant service are probably enough to keep me from coming back.

I've only visited the Brickhouse twice so I'll reserve the right to call shennanigans if necesary with future visits. I recommend that you either find a different establishment if there is a huge sporting event being televised or expect at least an hours'wait to be seated. Service can be a little sketchy if they are packed. Try going when it's not so busy. Food is decent & portions are good. A bit on the pricey side for pub food but it's elevated pub food so it's worth it..

Excited to try out this place after seeing so many reviews on Yelp, so came on a weekday night for to-go. Happy to see that its owned by Taiwanese people!

- Braised Pork Belly Rice Bowl - The pork was pretty good, but wish they put more of that meat sauce on the rice. I am a big fan of the pickled cabbage in this dish which cuts through the fattiness of the pork with the "sour" flavor of the vegetable.
- Braised Beef Soup - I'm not the biggest fan of soy sauce based beef noodle soup, so I wasn't a huge fan of this dish. Also the beef had too much fatty portions for my liking. 
- Beef Wrapped Pancakes - I really liked the pancake portion of this dish, I think it might be green onion pancakes. The beef though was too thick cut and I wish there was a bit more hoisin sauce.
- Black Pepper Chow Mein with Egg - Haven't had this dish is forever and definitely my favorite one out of the 4 that we ordered. There is a such a distinct black pepper taste which brings me straight back to Taiwanese Night Markets. Wish there was a little bit more ingredients other than noodles though.

Overall, not bad for Reno. Probably cannot compare if you bring this restaurant to the Bay Area, but its not a bad choice for Taiwanese people in Reno.

I was blown away by what must be the BEST lodging in the entire Department of Defense. The new building is amazing. The rooms are up to date and clean. The lobby has a really nice cafe and bar.

The staff is phenomenal. Seriously great people.

Nits: I'd like to see a better selection of food in the lobby for breakfast. The packaged food wasn't appealing. There aren't any plates and that was inconvenient.

Pricey yes, but as good as any steak I've had in a top quality steakhouse. I took my Mom out for a night on the town and we shared the aged Porterhouse for two, medium rare. It was a delectable, tender piece of meat. The creamed spinach side was excellent, though a bit on the small side when they say that the sides are "enough for two". 

Overall ambiance was excellent, though we were seated near the kitchen which wasn't great. But we were 45 minutes late for our reservation on a Saturday night and still got seated, so that made up for it!

Gardens of Babylon is appropriately located next to the downtown Farmers Market.  I'm no expert gardener, but the place is pretty large, and seems to have everything you could ask for: soil, fountains, cacti, ceramic pots, exotic plants, trees, rose bushes, a shade garden section, and, most importantly, some classy lawn ornaments.  The staff was helpful and everything was well-organized and labeled.  

In addition to the nursery, Gardens of Babylon also offers landscaping and design services.  They'll even give you free advice on your personal projects if you bring in a picture of your yard or garden.

terrible service from this establishment just go to papa john across the street despite their values. if you want rude service, misplaced orders, tardiness, bad quality, and mean employees eat here....!

Takeout and Delivery available - Get the chips and make the margs!

Another review I can't believe I haven't written! I've lived in the area for almost 10 years and this has been our neighborhood Mexican restaurant. Many an occasion have been spent at this restaurant, margaritas and big tables full of friends make up many fond memories. 

Of course we can't have those experiences now but we can bring home the fun with takeout or delivery via FoodJets or Doordash. 

Their carnitas are delicious, and the portion incredibly generous. Their guac is fresh and lively with a kick of citrus, and I really love their enchiladas suizas too. 

I'm looking forward to mkre happy hours at Los Compadres and thankful they're still open to keep us smiling with every scoop of salsa!

Exactly what you want out of your neighborhood lunch and breakfast spot. I've tried a few things on the menu and it's all been really good. Great friendly service, nice and clean and bright. I would go five stars if they were open a bit later. I work around the corner and will be wearing out their take out menu.

I might get pitch-forked for stating this, but... forget the NOLA oyster po-boys, just come to Elizabeths for their fried oysters! My goodness, their fried oysters were excellent and not incredibly pricey like other places. We also ordered the fried chicken livers and praline bacon. The fried livers were excellent and the jelly sauce accompanying it at first sounds off-putting but the sweet and sour flavor similar that you would find in a red-pepper sweet and sour sauce from a Chinese dish complemented the livers quite well. The praline bacon was sweet, had a nice bacon taste and definitely hit the bacon-craving spot. We also ordered our first Virgin Bloody Mary which tastes like a very spice-ful tomato juice - we were not the biggest fan, but it is homemade!

Right when you walk in you get to sample some of their teas in small sample cups, self serve. Me, I grabbed quite a few rounds of the samples because the tea that was sampled was really good. 

I went and ordered. They give discounts to usf students. So there's a plus. There's a lot of students in there studying and a little lounge area where the students are hanging out. It's a nice little shop, a lot of seating and good environment. It's not the best boba or tea around but it will do.

I write this review as I sit in a pedicure chair at Clayton Nail Spa. 

I called at 6 PM to see if they could squeeze me in at 7 for just a pedicure, to which the woman on the phone replied that there would be no wait - they wouldn't be busy - and there was no need to make an appointment. 

Well, I arrived at 6:45 and there were two people waiting for services and all of the chairs were full. I put my name on the list anyway. About 25 minutes after my arrival, I was lead to a pedicure chair to soak my feet while waiting for a technician. It's now been 40 minutes since I've arrived and I'm still sitting here, soaking my feet in now-cold water. They didn't even add any salts or anything to the water - it's just water. It remains to be seen whether they will deliver on the actual pedicure, but if this is the standard for their services, I will not be back.

Terrible Seating Arrangement!

Small Entry Area!

Poor Screen Quality!

Lack of Organization!
Good pizzas but I have to give them such a low rating becuase the prices are insane and the delivery always takes at least an hour!

I had a very interesting experience recently. I was stranded in a hospital while my wife was in labor and we decided to order out. After the delivery of our baby boy, we decided to treat ourselves and get some friend sea food. We ended up using door dash and getting Don's Seafood. She ordered the 1/2 catfish and 1/2 shrimp party tray for $75.00. It was pricey but the price was worth it. The amount of food they included in this order was insane. We ended up having left overs for days. 

The food was received about 1 hour after order. It was still hot and nice and crisp. It came in some easy containers that could have been easily recycled. 

The taste of the food was good and it had plenty of favor. I am not a massive fan of fried food but this was a restaurant worth looking into. It has a very "New Orleans" type of flavor. The catfish was delicious. The shrimp was crispy but had the tails on them. The french bread was not very crunchy and felt just right. The hush puppies are always my favorite but I have always been a glutton for them. 

Now, I was unable to experience the restaurant experience but based on the quality of the food and the great cooking, it might surely be worth looking into the location itself. It is off of Veteran's Memorial Blvd., so it is not far from most locations in Metairie. The food was worth the experience, so the restaurant must be as well!

Food- A
Location- N/A
Convenience - B
Romantic / theme setting - N/A

I had a great experience buying a car here, Josh in finance was extremely helpful and personable!! He spent the extra time finding an amazingly low interest rate for me and worked with my budget, I HIGHLY recommend asking for him if you are buying a car! Very friendly staff and am in LOVE with my new Acura! Definitely planning on being a lifetime customer!
The best sushi restaurant in town! Always fresh with good quality. Friendly staff and food comes out pretty quick. Don't go on a Friday or Saturday night they get really busy and under staffed.

Other than perhaps the 21st Amendment or Olde Absinthe House this is one of the best cocktail bars in the Quarter. 

All the drinks were expertly prepared and we came several times to sample different libations. Their Vieux Carre was outstanding, the Sazeracs were fabulous, the girls loved the gin fizzes and I liked that you could get a traditionally prepared Absinthe with an old fashioned fountain. 

Amazing jazz each night and plenty of seating. They also, since they are in a hotel, have clean bathrooms which is a scarcity on Bourbon Street.

Prices are in line with other better bars and the service was top notch.

The staff is friendly and helpful, if not always knowledgeable.  They've got everything you'd need from a business supply store and their rewards program is rather solid.  They even have free wireless (you know, for when you're hanging out in office depot working on a paper with your coffee and whatnot)

This has been my husbands favorite sandwich joint for 15 years now. He lived in Philly 15 years ago and has ranted and raved about their "Turkey Inferno" ever since I married him. Well we are from AZ and are finally paying our dues to Philadelphia and Lil Nicks was of course, at the TOP of his to do list. I went for the first time today and it lived up to every expectation! He had their "Turkey Inferno" & I had their "New Italian", it did not disappoint! I subbed the ham for turkey and it was probably the best sandwich I've ever had! If we lived here this place would be a regular spot for us! Customer service was great, really friendly. You can tell they have great relationships with the regulars that come in.
Hands down my favorite Mexican restaurant when I go to the garden district. Their tacos are amazing!!! Mole!!!

To start, the ambiance is incredible- from beautiful grounds to the amazing dining area where we sat outside- you truly feel like you are in a special place. Flowers and fairy lights made the terrace enchanting.

Our server, from South Africa, was charming and helpful, without being cloying. She helped us pick a wonderful local Chardonnay to get the party started.

We ordered the Kampachi with sea grass and the grilled octopus to start. Both were tasty, thoughtful in presentation, and definitely whet our appetites.

For our entrees, we had the steak Diane and the venison and we were in heaven. 
I have never had a better steak Diane, and I've had it many times.
The venison was perfectly prepared, tender and paired with a very complimentary sauce.

Would definitely recommend for a romantic or special occasion if you want to be treated like royalty. 

Ps. We found out afterwards that this is where JFK and Jackie O spent their honeymoon!  
Didn't surprise me at all- it's that gorgeous!!

Brought my five year old here and we had an absolute ball. We watched the 3-D Dino pic, Walking with Dinosaurs, and we both loved it. They do a great job of layering the learning exhibits and films so that kids of all ages engage, take something away, and have fun. The train and the electricity exhibits were our favorites. Definitely a don't miss in Philly.

I have never had a bad experience with Clay's, but I have never actually ordered a cake. I LOVE the cream cheese icing they put on their brownies though! They used to make brownies with peanut butter icing... yum! The donuts are pretty good too, but my favorite item is the huge cinnamon rolls. I had a friend who worked there who brought home 3 cakes they were going to throw out, and I remember those being delicious... but maybe I was in a foodcoma from all the sugar...

I don't even know where to begin. I lived at Niido/Burnham for a bit. I'm going to make this as short as possible. Don't come here for an Air B & B and NEVER live here. Word from some
people is there is a class action lawsuit coming. Let me provide a list of all the things I witnessed and had to deal with here. 

1. Car break ins happen frequently & there are no cameras in the most important parts (hallways, parking garage etc.) 

2. They have thrown away people's mail 

3. Extremely loud partying ALL night. (No quiet hours). I've seen someone fall off A 6th floor balcony. Skinny dipping in the pool at all hours. Broken glass bottles everywhere. Throw up in the elevators. Trash in the hallways filled with piss stains. Actually sounds like a concert everyday. 

4. *EXCESSIVE FINES* For all Air B & B people who smoke or vape. They will fine you $250 if they catch you with it. If you smoke you should stay somewhere else. 

5. Elevators are very slow. The app that allows you to ride the elevators is typically not working. 

6. SKETCHY people. On 3 different occasions I've heard someone tell me they've gotten drugged. 

7. People pulling the fire alarm at crazy hours of the night 

8. Drunk people all the time 

9. TERRIBLE management. AMY BRINSON. This is important. She's one of the sketchiest property managers out there. We were fined $1,500 because apparently my dogs poop wasn't picked up a couple different times. I asked for video evidence and she said "I don't have time for that." Other residents who have asked for any evidence have been rudely declined. THIS IS ALL AMY BRINSON. She is the issue with this building. 

Overall you should probably just stay next door at Margaritaville Hotel. They are pushing residents out because they will make more money off Air B & B. How do they do that? By fining people excessive amounts for "allegedly not fully picking up dog poop OUTSIDE." Actually we got evicted over the matter. 

Amy Brinson is flat out RUDE, she could care less about the tenants, and will steal your money & time. People like her shouldn't be working properly management. From my view the way she runs it is very very unethical and dirty. Multiple people can attest to that.

I was beside myself with heartbreak over the loss of Sweet Charlie's, but when I saw the signs for this new ice cream spot, i was excited, eagerly waiting for this place ti open. This is a paleta shop, gourmet mexican ice cream on a stick with the refreshing creaminess that makes me think of gelato. Like its last two predecessors, the paleta bar also offers toppings and drizzles to customize your treat. They offer several choices for cream flavors, and between that and the toppings the choices are ENDLESS. But I zoned in on my classic go to faves. I went for a coffee flavored paleta with dark chocolate coating, pecans, chocolate with caramel drizzle. It hit the spot on a sweltering hot day. The ice cream itself was creamy and smooth, yet had a good bite to it, and didn't leave me with a messy mouth. It paired well with the dark chocolate shell and crunchy pecans, so I had a good variety of flavors and textures to contemplate as i enjoyed my treat. The worker behind the counter was very nice and had alot of energy as he explained everything they have to offer. If paletas are not your thang, they can make a milkshake out if any treat, but I do recommend trying the paleta first.

I visit this place every tome I go to New Orleans. You order at the bar but service is quick. I have had all the classics here....po' boys, crawfish, etouffee, jambalaya and have never been disappointed. The bartenders are friendly, food is fast, drinks are cold, and the atmosphere is casual. The perfect place to pop in off of Bourbon Street.

After what we all witnessed over the past weekend ... it was nice to get out and explore downtown a little. Slowly getting back to normal! So blessed to be a part of an amazing community like we have here in Washoe County. #renostrong 

Dinner and live music out on the river! Wild River Grille's Summer Concert Series is in full swing! Wonderful local artists all summer long! It was great seeing friends Mel and Gia on stage last night while enjoying dinner and a great surrounding ambiance! Reservations suggested, as we are still in the "social distancing" mode. Our waiter was attentive and pleasant and the food and cocktails were excellent!

We started with a couple of TAHOE TESSIE GIMLET'S ($11.50 each) 'Local' Seven Troughs Argentum Single Malt Gin, Fresh Squeezed Lime Juice, Simple Syrup. Muddled Cucumber, Mint. So refreshing! And shared appetizer SEARED PORK BELLY ($14) with morello cherry port reduction, green onion on crispy rosemary na'an. Perfection!

My entrée - COCONUT CRUSTED MAHI MAHI ($26) with honey mandarin creme, toasted macadamia nuts,
parmesan risotto cake, summer squash medley. The mahi was a bit overcooked but the coconut crust made up for it! Yum!
Natalie's entrée - SAUTEED ELK MEDALLIONS ($29) with port shallot demi-glace, hand foraged sierra mushrooms,
cherry tomatoes, delta asparagus, parmesan risotto cake. I had a taste and the elk was tender and flavorful!

For dessert we shared the BERRY CHEESECAKE FLUFF ($8) with triple berry compote filling, whipped cheesecake, raspberry syrup, crumbled ladyfinger cookies... oh my! Super sweet for me with a little too much raspberry syrup, but a couple of bites were divine!

And as a digestivo - we both ordered the BIGGEST LITTLE CITY CITRUS SIDECAR ($13) D'Usse Cognac VSOP, Orange-Infused Brandy, Simple Syrup, Fresh Squeezed Lemon Juice, Lemon Zest... by far my favorite!

Summer Concert Series and dinner there on the river is fantastico!

I went to Rio Mar the other night (Thursday night around 8pm).  We sat at the bar.  The bartender was SO nice.  I have an msg allergy and so I told her this (on the off chance that they did use it).  It was so nice to have a waitress and kitchen staff who knew what msg is and could tell me if they used it.  Turns out they did (in one pre-made marinate that they used for squid only), but it was only 1 or 2 dishes on the menu that were effected. We had a wonderful meal here.  I would DEFINITELY recommend the ceasar salad with roasted sardines (there's a spanish term for it but I can't remember what it is at the moment).  Wow.

If I could give this place no stars I would... Horrible hospital... I worked here and know what the staff are like... nurses are rude as well as everyone else... No one wants to work here... everyone is miserable, management staff doesn't do their job and is lazy... STAY AWAY!!!

I had wanted to come and visit this restaurant for a while now. Also would have liked to check out the rooftop garden, but weather was not cooperating, so my group and I settled into the dining room. 
That said, I am used to dining out with larger groups and understand that a 'big' table is often difficult to handle. I also worked long years as a waitress, so I can relate. 
However; the lack of service and the way I personally was treated by your wait staff was simply put: horrible and in-excusable. 
Service wasn't great from the get-go, but we are a patient group and as long as the food is good, we're happy...  I was so looking forward to the mac-n-cheese being that it looks awesome in all the pictures that I have seen on Yelp. Anyway, orders were placed, food starts to be served... wonderful.
Well one of our gentlemen, received his food and kept looking at it, saying he didn't think this was his, but the waitress insisted it was his. Well he took a bite out of the burger and it wasn't what he had ordered. The waitress found his order and served it to him. She so apologized to him.  I however was left without food. I was also left without an apology or even an acknowledgement that I was yet without food. The gentleman with the extra order went ahead and gave me his mac-n-cheese side since I had also ordered some, otherwise I would not have had anything to munch on. Well the waitress rushed back and brought him another mac-n-cheese, concerned for his well-being. Everybody was letting her know that I had no food, she sort of ignored that on the way to the kitchen said something to we'll get  you a burger... how rude. 
No: I'm sorry, can I get you anything in the meantime, nothing. I had ordered the Bison burger medium well done with a side of mac-n-cheese. So after a while she comes back and slides a plate with a burger in front of me. No mac-n-cheese... again, no sorry... no excuse me... no can I get you anything. No ditch it and run. Now I do realize I had "stolen" the mac-n-cheese from another guest, but really? If  you're already messing up can you at least act like you care or value plate presentation? But fine... I will deal with it. Well I bit into the burger... and is was anything but medium well. Crispy on the outside, and at best medium rare. Yes I had the audacity to send it back. Now that was a mistake, cause when it finally came back, it was shoe leather, guess that shows me... the lettuce on the burger could have easily passed as seaweed, it was a gross mess with brown spots... either yesterdays or more likely the same Piece of lettuce from the previous burger that had been dragged back and forth. The burger was also in bits and pieces, so probably the same one, or it had a hard life so far. Even so by now I was really hungry, I gave up on it after taking a small bite, the whole thing being completely inedible. And everyone else was ready to go, their meals eaten. I did eat about half of the mac-n-cheese (which by the way is a fabulously cheesy mess, highly recommend this side), so I was hungry, eager to get out and grab some food elsewhere. 
Of course my bill was also messed up. Actually I was waiting to see if I would really be charged for this.  I sure was, and then some... So she had to at least take off the extra items I was charged for. And for the first time ever, I decided to leave no tip, no tip at all. I had spent 2 hours in a restaurant without food, could not even get a single refill on my water and so I was not only hungry but also very thirsty. 
I asked for a manager, because I really think somebody should be aware of this lack of service. Well, then she came back and grabbed my bill telling me "he said  you don't have to pay", at which point all the money flew out of the folder.  That is the most she had spoken to me all night. 
Anyway, a nice gentlemen came and talked to me, he tried to excuse some of this, like I told him, orders get messed up, it happens, no big deal, but avoid me like I have the plague? Treat me like an outcast? What was that all about? How exactly was it my fault that the order got messed up? I didn't get upset, I didn't make a scene, I just would have liked something to eat. An apology would have went a long way. A 'can we get you anything while you wait? ' anything like that and we would have just laughed about it. 
About half of our group really enjoyed their meals and would come back, the other half said it was nothing special and they would not go out of their way to return.

If You Are desiring the Best Brunch in All of New Jersey RATS is a hidden Treasure. The Food and Experience is Top Notch. A celebrated Sunday with Jazz Band and the most amazing food for your pallet. After Brunch take a stroll through the gardens of Sculpture. Enjoy!

Do not waste your time at Julios if you are looking for quality customer service. I will never give this establishment my business again and will continue to share my experience with others in hopes this issue will get some attention.
I used to think Julios was a great place just to go and have a good time after a long day of work on a Friday night.  Yesterday I went with a couple of friends, waited for half an hour for a table and was very happy to get in and seated. We all ordered the flautas and one bulldog each. Near the end of our dinner, one of my friends tried to order a second drink, only to be told by our waitress that ALL three of us were cut off from ordering any more alcohol. I asked her for a reason, indicating how it didn't make sense as we had only ordered a drink each and took our entire meal to finish them. We were not at all rowdy, basically keeping to ourselves the entire time. She then said it was her discretion and responsibility since it was a family establishment and that she believed we had gone drinking before coming to the restaurant.
Now, both of these reasons are absurd - I don't know any family who goes to Julios on Whyte after 9 on a Friday night. An extremely generous portion of their Facebook page is devoted to advertising drink specials, especially Bulldogs. This reasoning has absolutely no basis whatsoever. Regarding her second reason... There was absolutely no way for her to know if we went drinking beforehand, which of course we did not. It's completely ridiculous that she would try to suggest this, and I honestly do not know her motives behind treating us this way. We spoke to the manager, which proved to be completely useless because he expressed that he didn't particularly care about our side of the story and stood by his waitress' decision. This was odd in itself seeing as we were having a completely civil and rational conversation with him and he still agreed we were "too drunk" to be allowed any more to drink.
This whole experience showed me just how little Julios cares about customer service. It basically ruined our entire night and they couldn't even admit that they were in the wrong. I am truly disappointed in this restaurant's attitude towards serving their customers.
Bottom line: If you want more than one drink with your dinner, skip over Julios and move on.

Best Cubans in Tampa, period.  The trick is the bread.  It's always fresh, and the sandwiches are assembled perfectly.  We are regulars during football season.  I don't like football but these Cuban sandwiches get me thru the season as my significant other is a huge Bucs fan.  The staff are very friendly.  I would give it 5 stars but unfortunately the other sandwiches are not up to par.
Soooooo good. I ordered the Carnicera with Chimicurri and it was wonderful. Beautiful presentation and great service.

This was our best meal on vacation! A bit of a hidden gem in a strip mall. We went on a Sunday night and sat outside.  There was great live music that they pumped outside as well. Favorites included the hush puppies and crab cakes. My sides were also fantastic -coconut rice and the broccoli! So good even our 4 year old devoured it. Highly recommend, especially if you want a nicer meal amidst a sea of bar food.

Went here with my grandparents for lunch. Wow, I can't believe this place has any ratings over 1 star-either those people have no taste buds or haven't been to a decent place. The reuben was inedible-I'm not kidding.  Do yourself a favor and drive right past this place and to McDonalds if you're hungry. Absolute waste of money. My 80 year old grandma didn't even eat her sandwich. Leaky roof really topped off the experience, sandwiches are made on a griddle (the kind of griddle that is on sale on Black Friday for ten bucks).
The Mike is the best! And the Chocolate Milk is so awesome!!! I myself would rather buy my Milk from here then from a Store!! Plus it's Local and for me that's a plus!!!

Duffy's has become one of my "go to" places. Why? The quality, variety and atmosphere. The food is absolutely delicious and there are so many options. It's higher end than your typical sports bar food, for example the sesame crusted ahi tuna. 

They have great drinks specials, typically 2 for 1 unless you order from a limited menu. Not a huge wine menu, but they have the basics which keeps me happy. They also have a lot of fun cocktails, like the gummy bear mojito! But watch out for those if you don't like super sweet drinks. 

They have a tonnnn of tv's so you can watch pretty much any sport that is playing at the time. You can almost guarantee that you'll have a view of several tv's from any seat in the place. This also makes it a great place to go watch UFC fights. 

Overall this has been a great place and I haven't found a downside yet. Oh, and don't forget to sign up for a Duffy's card which earns points for free food!

The sliders, cheese fries and donuts are delicious! Sliders are juicy and made to perfection! Cheese fries have a cheese mixture that almost reminds you of a gravy texture. Non the less the taste is awesome! They have this soda called "mexi-cane"? Better than your coke! Loved this place!

There is a magical effect that OTF has on my level of enthusiasm for working out. I have never consistently stuck with any workout routine longer than a month or two. I'm now in my 5th month of OTF and am completely hooked. The muscle tone and increased stamina I am experiencing makes me want to keep going back week after week. Plus, having a trainer to keep me moving (so I don't have to think about what exercise to do next), takes the anxiety out of "getting in a good workout." Some trainers at the Brentwood location are better than others, but for the most part, I appreciate the energy and enthusiasm they bring to each class.

Early I did a review of Soulard's Restaurant and Bar. Phelan's Pub is owned by the same people as Soulard's Restaurant and Bar but is definitely more casual, more of a straight bar feel. Unlike some of the other places in Soulard, Phelan's hasn't tried to go too trendy and still feels and looks like a beer joint, which is fine with me. Phelan's is a great place to just relax, have a couple of drinks, meet with friends, waste time before, during or after a Cardinal game, or just stop by an after dinner drink. The service is pretty spot-on and the bartenders are really friendly.
The dan dan noodles are amazing! The portion sizes are large, and the price is very reasonable. We ordered the ginger duck and the ma po tofu. The service is unobtrusive.

This is my absolute favorite place to go when I'm craving something spicy! The mapo tofu and spicy noodles with bean curd are always delicious and flavorful. I'd definitely recommend to anyone with a taste for spice.

In the words of my girl Shavanna C. (Yelp her!):  

"Aww Hell Yeaaaaaassssss"  

It's about time Philly got a KK.  Man!--I use to put "Krispy Kreme" into my Google Maps (before KK came to the Philly area) only to find that the closest one was like 2hrs away.  Now yall know that is some injustice right there!

You already know the donuts are that bomb-diggity-deal...and if you don't know you better ask somebody-BIG BABY!  (from my writing you can probably tell that I'm still on a sugar high from these things).  The service was phenomenal-pleasant and patient :-)  I literally broke a sweat trying to pick out a half a dozen....they all look so good....the anxiety was killing me---I needed them ALL!

Okay, I'm going to stop because writing this review is making my skinny-fat ass hungry again.

Tip:  Heat the original glaze donut in the microwave for 8 seconds---that way you can experience the "HOT" sign at home...yall know what I'm talking about...and if you don't-- you better ask......yea you get the point
Very pleasant outdoor dining area. Service was very good!  Nice wine selection.  Food was of course very good.  The four of us enjoyed our evening, food, and wine very much.

One of the best dive bars I have ever been to!

Located right next to the swankiest NYC wanna-be dance party, this 6-ft tall ceilinged hole in the wall has the friendliest and most helpful waiter ever, good prices on imported beers and the most willing to talk about any type of shit you want clientele.

I didn't want to leave this place and I think it would be pretty easy to get laid here.

Nothing is cooler than a 7 day a week farmer's market.  Believe me, I realize this.  However, nothing is worse than arriving at a farmer's market that you think is going to be bustling and it is dead.  It might have been the fact that it was Thursday.  It might have been the fact that it was 40 degrees and drizzling.  Yeah, I'm pretty sure it was.

Farmer's Markets are meant to be experienced on sunny days so all you want to do is get home and sink your teeth into a juicy watermelon or put that corn on the grill husk and all.

I don't imagine freezing my ass off to buy a butternut squash and going home and cooking soup.  

Just not my idea of Farmer's Market.
