So while today's experience wasn't stellar, I think it is cool that Nashville does have a daily farmer's market.  So I will give them 4 stars... but remember today's visit is worthy of 3.

HAPPY VEGAN DINING... AND VEGGIE HUNTING!
Sooo good and amazing happy hour! The burgers are incredible and so clutch to have the chips and salsa while we sip on some tasty beers and margaritas
As others have said, great place to set up with your laptop or books. Spacious clean interior. Bubble tea never tasted so good...

I do not get the hype about this place at all. The portions are so small, the quality isn't great, and the service is non-existent. When I ordered a pho, the amount of bean sprouts they gave us on the side was laughable. And lemons instead of limes... come on, spend a bit more money for likes. The salad rolls also didn't have anything great to them either. Lots of other good places asides this one.

Tried Castaways for the first time today.  The Service was good and the staff was friendly.  The building needs some updating and some cleaning.  We had tacos, burritos and margaritas.  The chicken was good and the shells were fresh.  The margaritas were good and had a kick to them.  The chips,salsa and queso were not good.  They need to shop around for better quality product.
Price was cheap.
Incredible service and great food!! We will definitely be coming back to Green Chili :)
Awesome place clean friendly burritos are great definitely recommended A++++ will see u guys today.!!

Why can't more diners in Manhattan be this good?

Typical of most diners, Vincentown Diner also offers a large array of food and drink; however, when possible, they try to serve local products, and all of their beef is grass-fed, and all of their chicken is free-range. 

Most recently I ordered a Dogfish Head 60 Minute IPA to accompany a side salad and buffalo tenders, but they also offered a nice selection of other brews, as well as cask beer, something that I previously have mentioned is a hard find! The side salad was fresh and colorful, and the buffalo tenders were just as spicy as I like them, forming a delicious duo.

My grandfather ordered the crab cakes and worried about the state of the seafood in the Gulf following the 2010 BP Oil Spill: http://gizmodo.com/5903021/bp-oil-spill-aftermath-eyeless-shrimp-clawless-crabs-and-fish-with-oozing-sores , I asked where the crab came from and, much to my relief, it came from the Pacific. He enjoyed them. And my grandmother ordered the chicken pot pie. While not as good as in the past, it nonetheless was tasty. She doesn't plan to order it again, though. And all of this came with a warm side of bread and a trio of savory spreads.

Finally, our server was super-friendly and helpful, never once appearing to be irritated in spite of our many questions regarding the chicken pot pie and origins of the crab, and my late addition of the side salad. More servers should learn from her!

Please save your money. So many things wrong. Terrible customer service. Nails all different sizes, gel is lumpy not fully covering nail and acrylics already coming apart from nail. I called and would have been more than happy to come in and get them redone unfortunately, the man on the receiving end was extremely rude and their response to my review was no different. I would never ask to get a service don't for free. But asking my money back to a very poor job is not unreasonable. Where I work you can bring back half eaten food and we still refund the money with a smile. It's a shame. Hopefully they improve their quality and customer service.

I stayed here on a recent work trip.  The people working there were very nice and helpful, especially for all the times we needed a cab.  It's located right downtown by many bars which made it convenient for the work outings I had to attend.  The rooms and hotel were very clean and the free breakfast had a pretty good selection.

Burger Monger easily has the best burger in Tampa. I'd even say it was perfect compared to others. From the taste to the presentation, the competition doesn't come close. I don't eat burgers often, but when I need a fix I come here.

UPDATE:  It had barely been a year since I had my front yard re-landscaped and my sprinkler system converted to an irrigation system. I had add to my review that the irrigation system Dan had Todd put in has sprung no less than six additional leaks this season, and that's on top of the multiple leaks it sprung in the weeks after he installed it last spring. (Yes, I did have the system properly turned off and drained during the winter months.). Every time I turn around, the system is leaking somewhere else and it's become a nightmare to maintain. The whole point of my having this landscaping done was to convert it to something low maintenance. So much for that. The proverbial frustrating gift that keeps on giving.

Original Review:
I was so hopeful when I hired this company to re-landscape my front yard because they were so highly rated, but I did not have a good experience with them unfortunately. Dan, the owner, seemed a nice enough guy at first, but I found that unless I documented everything and held him accountable to it, things didn't get done the way they were promised.   He didn't instruct his crew to follow all the instructions on the quote that I signed to authorize the work. His crew leader Todd, in fact, said the owner instructed him to omit some of the work in the quote I signed in order to save them money on the cost of the job.  

Very disappointing that I had to keep referring back to the contract to remind him what was agreed upon and get them to come back out to fulfill what was promised.    Also, the irrigation guy, Todd, copped a bit of an attitude with me when I asked some questions about how my yard had been laid out and why the irrigation system sprung so many leaks after he worked on it.     I was willing to let that go as long as he made it right & followed up on his word, but after he promised to come back out and winterize the system free of charge this fall, I contacted him to follow up on that promise, and he blew me off. 

There were so many mistakes made throughout the process, and although I will give Dan credit for sending his crew back out a couple of times to correct most of what went wrong, the overall experience was poor.  If you do use this company, document everything, stay on top of the work that's done, and hold them accountable.

The employees are very friendly and welcoming which is something I always look for in a great restaurant. The food may not be the best greek food around but when you see the price it is very fair. I'm very satisfied with this place. It's a great spot to hit up for lunch and you'll know you'll get quality service.
Another beautiful experience. Another smile, more friendly conversation, and that free pen...did I mention I got a smog check as well? Took about 5 minutes.

Would recommend this place if your looking to get rude bartenders...bad service...your money taken & ohhhhhh wait,kicked out too! If your looking for a place to have a great time...take a group of people with you...show them around Indianapolis...don't come here...you will all be treated poorly..& THATS COMPLETE EMBARRASSMENT.
As a business you treat customers with respect,but apparently the staff working feels they can treat anyone poorly since they are already in a s*itty mood.SORRY,but that's not right.Staff needs to learn not to role eyes at customers when ordering.LIKE,HELLO ARE YOU FORGETTING your at work!??? Save your $$$ hit the other bars .NOT THIS ONE.
The food is outstanding whether it's babka, challah, ruggelah, or bagels. Everyone already knows that. But what makes it even better is that people are top notch. Love them all.

I grew up in Kirkwood so there's a soft spot in my heart for The Magic House - I even went to the junior high that is right next door.  Now that I'm grown-up and have a kid, I love The Magic House even more, especially with all of the amazing improvements they've made in the last few years.  It is not to be missed.  We make a point of visiting as often as we can and there's always something new to see!  My one regret is that since we live in KC now, my son is growing up with the Magic House 250 miles away instead of 2 miles away like I did!

Good food 
and a fun atmosphere. They have an excellent selection if beer which is nice. I enjoy having options other than Canadian and Rickards. A little loud maybe, but that may have just been our luck as we were seeted beside The Loudest Girl in the World. A very enjoyable casual dinner though. We'll be back.

Noisy, overpriced, and uninspired mediocre food, Not even the cheescake is as good as many other places. Service was only so so. Took forever for our meeet and greet and the pace didn not get better from there. Nice decor, but did I say it was NOISY.
Beautiful garden, well maintained. Nice to visit when it's not to hot outside but there is plenty of shade throughout the garden. If your looking for a nice walk with great scenery it's a must visit
Great customer service, and delicious. The Soho bowl is delicious and a good size, won't be dissapointed.

While visiting out of town, I encountered a problem with my older Lexus. I was able to make an appointment for the next morning late the night before! When I arrived, I was greeted by a pleasant young lady who was my service advisor, B! The wait wasn't long, and to my relief, the problem was an easy fix. I cannot thank this dealership enough for the way they treated and helped me! A young man even opened the door of my car for me when I was getting in to leave after the front tires had been counter rotated! This was my second pleasant experience with this Lexus dealership, and I would recommend them to anyone in this area! Thank you, thank you, Lexus of Tucson, Speedway!
My husband and I really enjoyed lunch at Tarpon Turtle. Delicious food and a beautiful view.

I've had the food twice, and it was superb! My favorite item is the soup--MY GOODNESS! It's delicious with the breadsticks! My husband absolutely loves the shrimp and lobster ravioli. I'm excited to try more items!

Got a brand new haircut (pixie!) from Carolyn on 11/21/13. She was very nice, chatty, and attentive to what I wanted. She did a good job and I love my haircut! The place was a bit pricy ($60) but I'm ok with that because I did have a dramatic hair change and she did a good job. I went to a different place yesterday to get a trim since I couldn't get in here, but comparing the two places, I would have much preferred to come back here. I will be sure to try for an appointment earlier!
Great vibe and concept. Right in the heart of the arts district.  And a 3 minute walk from my place = good stuff.

This is a good restaurant. The food is fresh and has a taste of homemade food. The service is quite good. The owner is very attentive and food comes to our table in about 10 minutes. Since I have never been to Peru, I can't say how authentic the food is. But I know good food when I taste it. Lunch is reasonably priced, $7-10 per dish. You have 6-7 options from vegetarian to seafood. Dinner is expensive, ranging from $14-20. I have never tried their dinner, so I can't tell you much about it. The restaurant is very clean, good music (not too loud either), interesting Peruvian decor. It's a bit drive from downtown but I would go back again for special occasions. Peruvian food is not spicy. If you want some spicy and cheap, I recommend the Thai restaurant next door.

we were looking forward to eating here for a while. To say we were let down is the under statement of the year. The first time we tried to go we were turned down because they ran out of food. We get the chance to go back. We placed our order, which some how came to a huge over priced $50 dollars. One of us didn't even get a burger. We ordered the perogies, which were 100% the frozen Mrs.T perogies you can get for shoprite ($5.00 for an entire box I might add). We never ended up getting the fries we paid $5.00 for, but the line was too wild to even consider waiting and there wasn't a soul out from the kitchen to even ask. I would not recommend anyone going here. It's just over hyped, extremely over priced frozen food.

I loved the hotel...... At first I looked up the hotel in the Internet and it looked non attractive and I thought that it will be all cheap but when I got their I was super wrong. Everything was new and big. I loved the rooms they were clean and enormous and it says that their two beds in the guest from but really their we're three because of the sofa bed. Delicious complimentary breakfast :D Lesson: Don't judge a (Hotel) by its cover.

I'm not sure how I haven't heard about this place sooner but wow I will definitely be back soon!!

The food is so bomb!

Pickle chips were perfection especially paired with their house made ranch. When I order these next time I'll ask for them not to be salted. They use pretzel salt and to be honest they didn't really need salt at all. Just my personal preference. 

Spicy cauliflower bites had a great kick to them, not too much breading, and so much flavor. 

Boneless wings were good. I chose the Hot flavor which I would say is more like a Medium. Also, they're not really wings so much as they are tenders. 

I really want to go back to try the knockwurst. Gonna be a new favorite lunch spot for sure!

Like most franchisees this place isn't that much different than other locations. Food was ok and the price wasn't that bad. Service was really slow, we only saw our waiter 3 times. They also forgot a item I ordered which took forever to inform because the lack of our servers appearance.
Very clean, very nice people. Wide variety of colors. Got my nails dipped for the first time after my pedicure.
Not great. Not very friendly either.  Normally I would give it another go, but since it wasn't great I don't feel the need.

i'm a big fan of new orleans. and whenever i'm in new orleans, i have always tried to make time to stop by drago's to get some of their charbroiled oysters. this time, for whatever reason, my experience was awful. it was as if this was a giant popular tourist trap.

the charbroiled oysters were inconsistent. in the dozen that i had in front of me (our table ordered 3 dz) a good 3-4 of them were burnt, a few of them were not cooked enough (missing the charbroiled marks) and the other ones were just alright. if i didnt know how these *should* taste like, i probably would never order these again.

i ordered a pasta for my entree and NEVER in my life, have i had pasta that was so overcooked. i considered sending it back, but looking around the place was so busy (so busy that we had to SHARE MENUS when we sat down) that i just ended up eating my shrimps and picking at my pasta. 

for what it's worth, i am told that the metarie location is a lot better and is not as much of a tourist trap (for obvious reasons).

The customer service at Best Buy Downingtown, PA has always been great.  Although it is a very busy place and sometimes you have to wait to be assisted...when that time comes, the staff is always very knowledgeable and on top of their game which is great for the customer & Best Buy because the staff can always point you in the right direction to buy the product you need.  If there is a problem....they always seem to find a solution.  I recently signed up for Geek Squad and the service has been great.  Yes, you do pay a pretty penny for it ~ but to have someone to talk to about computer issues whenever needed is a nice service to have.  Joel in the Geek Squad department in Downingtown has assisted me on and delivers great customer service and follow up. If I need an answer, I get it.  I appreciate that.  Kudos to Best Buy Downingtown...Keep up the good work and the friendly customer service!  You have my business.

I had the most amazing pedicure ever! I had the Deluxe pedicure and it last about an hour. It was AMAZING! My only complaint is that my gel manicure lasted about 1 1/2 weeks. Other than that this place is great!

So good! Me and my fiancé did not want to leave the house on New Year's Day. So we ordered in and they did not disappoint! Everything we ordered was so good and still hot when it got to our house. Definitely will be dining in soon!

Went Sunday for the boat races.  Was upstairs and one bartender taking care of the whole floor.  Very nice friendly.  Ordered the sliders that were the special with slaw.  Food took A LONG TIME... when it finally arrived I was surprised to see 2 hockey pucks on buns with potato salad. I mentioned to the food runner I ordered slaw.  Response was we are out and walked away.  No setups on the table,  flagged the bartender down and asked for pickles.  5 minutes went by came back no pickles.   We are out.  I asked him to please send the order back.  My date felt bad for him as he was so nice and said leave it.  After tasting the puck he agreed we should have sent it back,  I was not offered anything else or compensated for the meal I didn't eat.  Like I saw nice bartender but that about it.  We won't be back,  Lost a customer over a 5 dollar special.  Crowded day with the boat races but we went early and they were already out of food.

Where to begin is terribly difficult. Was seated right away inside and were given menus. Looked through for a few minutes and was ready to order. 15 minutes later I looked directly at our waitress and she gave me the hold on a moment finger. 5-7 minutes later she came over and asked what'll you have. My buddy ordered the eggs Jonathan she asked what side. It was not obvious  on the menu that there was a side option for that entree. She said look at the top and walked away! Now the restaurant was not bustling like a busy diner. She did finally make her way back over about 4-5 minutes later after she went to roll silverware. We finally realized that we could opt for home fries or grits. After my buddy finally finished his order she looked at me. I ordered the Plantation Breakfast with home fries quickly to avoid the side question she then looked at me for about 10 seconds and finally said "and?". I was completely confused, she is less than a foot from my face and starts waiving her hand like "come on". I asked "and what? What are you looking for?"  She said and and and and? Eggs! I said scrambled and she scowled and said "how was I supposed to know that?" I never got a, how do you want your eggs, or anything. The whole exchange took over a minute. 45 minutes later I hear the cool yell at our waitress and tell her the food has been ready for a while and it had gotten cold. She grabbed it and brought it over to us. It was lukewarm and my buddies was wrong but we are anyway and asked for her to bring the check immediately. The food had pretty good flavor no complaints from me except it would have been a lot better hot. The check never came of course for 10 more minutes and we finally left. It's a shame. If the service was even decent I would have given it a 3 maybe a 4. Please avoid!

Didn't think this place was anything special. Food was very blan and the sides were once again a disappointment.  My best friend had the peel and eat shrimp,  a rubbery mess, even charged $0.50 for old bay seasoning.

Terrible experience at DiBella's today. Went with two sons to get four subs. Took over 23 minutes for my two while everyone else that had ordered long after I had was getting their subs. Got back to house and all four subs were completely wrong, not even close. Although it's about 12 minutes from my house I went back, showed the wrong sub, asked for a new one and credit back on the others. Didn't give me a credit but cards for free small subs. Place is not that clean (prior review) and staff is running around like chickens with heads missing. Don't waste time eating there, Sub 16 much much better and less money.

Overall good BBQ place, the only disappointment was the brisket which was over cooked and dry.  Sauce excellent, pork ribs are also exceptional, links were good, the Mac and cheese was good.  Spicy coleslaw wasn't spicy by any measure, also the habanero sauce is mildly spicy with sweetness to it which still makes it enjoyable even though I prefer much more spice.

My girlfriend and I came here last night for my birthday dinner. This was our second time here. First - let's get the covid stuff out the way. The staff all wore masks and were constantly sanitizing areas. The tables were more than 6 feet apart. Felt extremely comfortable. 
Now the food - we ordered the gnocchi appetizer trio, Sweet potato, Stefano, and short rib. All were cooked perfectly. And the sauces were amazing. Couldn't pick one as my favorite. For entrees the specials of the evening were a seafood fra diavolo and a pan seared chicken stuffed with roasted red peppers and sharp provolone covered in a cream sauce. We both ordered the specials. My seafood diavolo was delicious. Not too Spicy but packed enough heat. The linguine was topped with jumbo scallops, jumbo shrimp, muscles and crab meat - and the chef did not hold back. The seafood was a generous amount which justifies the price. Simply delicious. The chicken special was also delicious. The combination of flavors were spot on. 

Lastly, the service. Our server was Blaine, young guy under 21 y/o, but he was the most professional server. He made the dining experience a lot better. At the end of the night my girlfriend and I looked at each other and knew that a generous tip was deserved especially during these tough times. It's nice to have someone truly care about your dining experience and he did just that, so thank you! 

Will be back. This place is a must try for anyone considering.
this location is closed

Food was delicious! I tried the carne asada tacos w/ rice and black beans. The carne asada tacos was delicious. The drinks were great. Staff are friendly and atmosphere is welcoming and comfortable. A bit on the expensive side for tacos though.

Burritos are terrible. Literally some of the worst I've ever had in my life. I also had the worst upset stomach after eating these. Could have been something else but hadn't eaten anything else that day so who knows. 

Finally the delivery guy has 0 compassion. I have broken my foot and so tipped extra with the expectation that he would bring the food to my apt. Nope. I had to hobble down with crutches barely carry it in my hands back up. Learn how to show some sympathy for others buddy. When you break something I hope you don't run into assholes like yourself.

All in all if you value your money, health and tastebuds, please avoid.

William Way serves as a home, refuge, and haven for the many sub-communities that comprise the LGBTQ community in the Greater Delaware Valley.  It's a great place to meet old friends and establish new friendships.

There are many opportunities to participate in workshops for art, dance, employment, or just to socialize and perhaps learn something about recent books, films, theater, and other interests and concerns.

We like the Philadelphia premium outlet for many reasons, first for the large selection of outlet stores that offer truly good deals. Granted store have faux-deals that doesn't stand out from the malls but many do have steep discounts:

ADIDAS almost always have significant discounts
Reebok is another favorite for us
Polo is a hit or miss, this memorial day weekend 2015 was pretty good
Coach hit or miss
Express is pretty reliable, especially during holidays

Remember to checkin on yelp to get the coupon pamphlet (ultimately saved us $15 on our ADIDAS experience)
Additionally, love the way the outlet is designed so that you are mostly shielded from the elements when going between store but still have that open feel and plenty of fresh air.
Food court is nothing to write home about, maybe just bring a snack instead since the selection and quality can't even compare up to many malls.
Finally parking spaces are plenty but make sure you remember which store you parked near.

Table 31 was a sad disappointment. Went on a Friday night with a large group of friends and were looking forward to a place that had so much hype behind it. 

Unfortunately, it didn't live up to any of the hopes I had for it. The food was sub-par...steaks were bland and overcooked and our Kumomoto oysters had to be sent back as they were far from fresh. The cold seafood platter was fine, but it's hard to mess that up. Aside from the food, the restaurant was as cold as a meat locker. We had a hard time enjoying the meal while shivering and covering ourselves in napkins just to stay slightly above frigid. We asked for the air to be turned down, but the response was that it would take a long time because the space was so large. The only redeeming quality and the best part of the meal was the chocolate bread pudding dessert which was actually good (and why I didn't give a 1-star rating). I hate giving low ratings, but for as much as we spent ($100/person), it should have been much better. I hope this is only a result of being new.

Final thoughts...
If you want a good steak, go to Barclay Prime instead where you'll get the quality you pay for.
Really like the selection of gear they offer. Wish they had more snowboarding goggles but everything else is awesome!

Arrived at Villa Di Roma with a group of 8 anticipating our 2nd installment of Supper Club... This time south Philly Style.

Food amazing, solid, as my brother James had previously posted. I had a veal dish w lemon butter, capers and mushrooms. It was difficult to understand the menu items as they just listed them on the board/menu with no detail & the waitress seemed to be bothered as I ran down the list asking what each veal dish was. I get it. Your on 9th street, you get loads of tourist, and you expect everyone to talk & be Italian, right?
Just expected a little more pep in our waitress's step however I won't let it stop me from giving this Italian hot spot in the Italian Market a 5 star! Boom!!

Called to ask what time they close, very rude person on the phone answered. Walked in to get a quick gel manicure, was greeted with "what do you want," and I responded nicely. The owner, who I'm guessing is Sunny, didn't even look at me and was rude the entire time. I got up and left after seeing she and one other tech were the only ones working and a gel was $25---that's how much I pay in the suburbs at a clean, friendly and professional salon! 

I would assume she will go out of business soon because of her lack of customer service skills. Very rude, I hope they see these reviews and plans re-evaluate her business structure.

Visiting from the bay area. We found this place on Yelp and decided to try it for dinner.  The food is excellent and very inexpensive $64 for a family of 6.  It was half the price of our lunch at Wild River Grill also highly recommended.  One star knocked off from the meal taking a really long time maybe they should get more kitchen help especially on the weekends especially with all these great Yelp reviews.

**Covid Update** This is my second visit to Rollies and it's been way too long! This time we had carne asada flats and carne asada fries (we didn't share!). A little pricey for lunch with two fountain drinks and a 20% tip--$37. However, taste-wise it was totally worth it.

Covid part--everyone was wearing masks. Signs at the order window said "No Mask No Tacos".  The bathroom was closed to customers (I saw an employee exiting while I was waiting for my order)
It was after the lunch rush and a number of the staff were cleaning, mopping and changing out the very full trashcan. They were all wearing masks, as were the folks behind the counter. There was also a notice saying they had met Tucson's covid requirements for restaurants. 

The part where my husband wasn't too happy with was that the patio is fully enclosed and the stainless steel picnic tables out in the front of the building were unshaded and hot as a frying pan. The back open-air patio was shaded, but locked. We asked the person mopping the floor if we could sit there and he answered "Sorry".

As my husband is a cancer survivor and high-risk, we have committed to only eating outdoors to minimize the possibility of exposure. It was one of the reasons I had suggested Rollies in the first place. A little disappointing, but we ended up getting our food to go and ate in the car instead. Not ideal, but it worked out in the end.

I was driving home after a weekend road trip and stopped in Carpinteria to get some relief from the traffic and a little dinner.  I was disappointed to find that Crushcakes stops serving their cafe food at 3:00, but I bought the marble cupcake and found dinner somewhere else.  The cupcake was very good and a nice treat to break up the rest of the drive.  I would love to try some of their other flavors.

We were really looking forward to our first dining experience at Fieni's. We had a reservation, and considering the packed restaurant, we were seated fairly quickly (waited approx 10 minutes). There were several other parties waiting as well, and the extremely courteous staff acknowledged everyone and apologized every time they passed by. The restaurant is delightful. We loved the ambiance, and the service was wonderful. Unfortunately, what lacked were our meals. We started with mussels in white sauce. Neither the mussels nor the sauce had much flavor, and the mussels were gritty. For my main course, I had pasta with seafood. While the seafood was done ok, there wasn't much flavor. The dish was too salty for my taste. My husband had the veal special. It was accompanied by two seafood ravioli, which he liked. Regarding the veal, he said there was a lot piled on top of it (cheese, tomato, crab...), so the veal was kind of lost. Their bread is accompanied by oil with roasted garlic and was the best ever. And we enjoyed the tiramisu. The portions, across the board, are far from skimpy. I can't say enough about the waitstaff and charm of this restaurant. I just wish we enjoyed the food more.

Like a warm hug! Familiar with the history of the Pappas family in this area so I know the food would be good. My first trip didn't disappoint. BF had rice bowl (seriously enough for two people) and I gyro lettuce wraps. Enormous portions of everything. We split the grape leaves and family style (huge) small size Greek salad - how do people eat one without potato salad??? Just what I want Greek to taste like.

My dental appointments always feel like spa sessions here. I've never looked forward to going to the dentist as much as when I go to this place. 

The staff has always been so friendly and kind. Sometimes there's freshly baked cookies!! And during my appointment, they always offer a lavender scented neck warmer and I get to dip my hands in paraffin wax which makes them super soft. They have big screens which are always playing something that's easy to zone out to - usually the home renovation shows when I'm there.

So, not only do I get my teeth checked/cleaned, but I walk out with my hands feeling like I went to get them done, my neck less tight and a great smile.

I tell all my friends about this place!

We saw Sang Kee's stand in the Terminal Market and decided to try the real thing based on the juiciness of the Peking ducks hanging at the stand. I had the roast pork and roast duck rice plate which was solid and cheap! Hubby had the roast duck soup which was also delicious. 

All in all, they serve great duck platters and will be back someday for the Peking duck dinner--seemed too heavy for lunch. Service was quick and attentive, but don't forget to bring cash! It's cash only.

This stores manager is not very customer service oriented. She talks down to people and is very condescending on three of our visits to this store. We have had nothing but issues with a wedding ring for the last 3 years. It has lost diamonds and been sent back for repair 4 times. We have bought their extended warranty that covers the issues but this ring needs to be replaced. She just says everyone wears their ring different. My wife works in an office setting, she doesn't build houses. This ring should have been replaced long ago since they still carry it. We are told repairs are sent to S. F. and has taken months to get the ring back. The manager is doing the company a disservice with the way she treats customers. I would not recommend this store to anyone because of the manager. We have driven to Twin Falls twice for service when they closed the store here in Boise even for repairs. We are definitely not happy customers. Go elsewhere!

We showed up just in time for the guided tour at 1pm. I highly recommend coming for this, it makes the whole place come alive. We didn't stay for the whole thing, but if you're looking for some educational content during your day, this should be on your list.

Disregard the 1 Star, it's actually 0.

What an absolutely HORRIBLE place with the most unprofessional staff and the most pitiful food I have ever seen. The staff is pathetic and should be either working at McDonalds and especially for one guy in particular; he should be in jail for his verbal assaults and racist attitude. The manager has no reason to be a manager; and I can cook better than that garbage I was served. I should have went to McDonald's next door or to Tijuana Flats (who has AWESOME food) for way better food and service. This place is absolutely Disgusting! 

STAY THE HELL AWAY!!! I doubt this absolute DUMP of a "restaurant" will be open much longer anyway. I look forward to seeing what they put in its place.
Best po-boys in town!  Off the beaten tourist path but well worth it!

Signed contract in early Dec.  Targeted completion was 3rd week of Jan.   Completion was not until April.  

Requested 1 day notice for scheduling so I could manage work, access, dogs etc, but frequently got notified of someone coming out mid morning the day of.  

Too many issues to go into and dont want to get into a back and forth with replies from yhe owner. (He tends to do that with a negative critique).  If you use this company, plan for the opportunity to work on patience. 

In fairness the pool looks nice so the work was pretty okay. It wasnt worth the frustrations.

Servers were all extremely friendly and informative.  It was lunch time so she was hungry and rattling off alllll her favs!

Definitely try the riblets for a lunch appetite with the veggie chili including guacamole and sour cream!

delish :-)
Food is not great, crowded, 1.5  hour wait and no country music.  Don't waste your time.

I'm very picky about nail salons. I always look for higher standards of cleanliness and I have to say I'm impressed. They offer individual liners on the pedicure bowls, individual packets during the pedicure (files, toe separators etc) which is amazing. I drive 40 mins away to a salon in Tampa for this same standard. I made an appointment with Lenny for an SNS mani. He did an amazing job. Very attentive and listened to what I wanted.The only negative was with an SNS mani your nail tech should always disinfect your hands before starting. If you're unfamiliar with the process you're dipping your fingers in this color powder which is better for your nails than gel or acrylic but obviously without proper care the powder can harbor bacteria. Look it up. Im a germaphobe, I'm admitting it, so this may not be a problem for some but for me it was. Also, a polish change was $10 on my toes. Pretty steep IMO. I should have asked the price beforehand. All in all as I said I'm impressed. It's obvious Lenny cares about his business and most importantly his clients. Yes there are nails salons on all over the place but finding gems like this is few and far between. Im gladly retuning soon.

With the exception of the hostess who asked the peculiar question (in a barely audible voice): "do you have a name?" - it's been amazing. The wait was short for lunch. My pregnancy cravings literally are the salad and breadsticks (the dressing is everything) from here - my husband and I usually eat local, mom & pop style restaurants - but as I said this what my body wants. I feel bad that my bill isn't more than $7 and yet Harmony, my sever, was amazing. She was attentive and kind. She was sweet in her demeanor and never frustrated that a person could sit for 45 minutes at a table and eat two bowls of salad and a five breadsticks... she worked hard for her other guests as well and extended them the same amount of kindness. I'll be visiting plenty over the next six months and look forward to dining in.

SO... today I wanted to share a post about the AMAZING dinner I had a Domenica on Christmas Eve, located in the The Roosevelt New Orleans, a Waldorf Astoria Hotel.

This post will be from a Foodie perspective, so expect a LOT of details about every course and exactly what I thought about my first real FINE DINING experience. Without further ado... here we go!

So, for Christmas Eve, I knew I wanted to go out for a very nice, big city dinner, and I had heard about Domenica, and decided I would book a reservation there. I was so excited to find out, that it is a John Besh restaurant, as that was something I got to check off my bucket list (long story).

So I arrive at 9:30pm and was say at 9:50, 10 minutes before my reservation, and I was already impressed by that. I received the Revellion Menu, which is the preplanned 4 course dinner for holidays and special events. 

The dinner was $60, and included the following courses.

Course 1: Fried oysters with pickled Raddichio
Course 2: Ricotta filled Raviolo with farm fresh egg yolk, with a parmigiano butter sauce lemon sauce, with sliced black truffles.
Course 3: Veal Osso Bucco with Saffron Risotto
Course 4: Hazelnut Tartufo, with cherry and dark chocolate

LET ME JUST SAY THIS... it was the best food I had ever eaten!!!

Starting with the first course, the fried oysters with pickled raddichio was delicious. I love fried oysters, however, I find they can be a big heavy and greasy sometimes, but with the pickled raddichio, the fried oyster was really light as the pickled vinegar flavor balance out the fried component. It was fantastic, I didn't think I could find anything special about fried oysters, well I was wrong!

The second course was... eventful.
I was served the ricotta stuffed raviolo with farm fresh egg yolk inside, and shaved black truffle, and was told that when I cut into the raviolo, the yolk would be runny and moist, and that this was the most enjoyed course by most people. I started by tasting the truffle by itself, as it was the first time I had ever eaten whole slices of truffle and really wanted to learn that flavor... well let me tell you this, it was magical. The truffle starts with a slight aromatic flavor that you taste on the front of your mouth, and as you savor it, the earthy umami of the mushroom hits full flavor in the back of your mouth, reminding you its a mushroom, but all while being savory and warm. I relate the whole flavor to being lifted in someone's arms and then laid to rest in a warm comfy bed.

As I then cut into the raviolo, maybe a minute after it was set before me, I was let down as the egg yolk was not runny at all, and when I cut a bite of the raviolo, I found the edges of the pasta thick and slightly undercooked. The sauce was also very watery.
I called the waitress over, and she immediately apologized and returned the course to the kitchen and assured it would be made correctly. Unfortunately at this time, my third course was ready.

She presented me with my third course, the Veal Osso Bucco which is the leg shank around the ankle I believe, and it was cooked bone with, with marrow. It was accompanied with a saffron risotto and a rosemary veal jus.

This course was amazing. The saffron was very noticeable in this cheesy risotto, and the rosemary in the sauce took a heavy starch and made it soft and delicate. The Veal was very tender, and the marrow was a bold beef flavor yet slightly sweet. One of the best things I have ever eaten.

I then received the Ricotta Raviolo, and I am SO GLAD I had them remake it.

When I took a bite of the raviolo, the egg yolk was runny and delicate and rich, with the lemony parm sauce with the rich ricotta, and the earthy aromatic truffle, I realized why fine dining was so enjoyable. I had NEVER eaten anything in my entire life, as delicious, balanced, flavorful, rich, pleasing, and YUMMY in my life. The Raviolo was the star of the entire dinner, and I am glad it was the last thing I tasted before the dessert.

Lastly, I was served a Hazelnut Tartufo with a cherry and dark chocolate crust and what seemed like a hazelnut or caramel ice cream. When I had a bite, and finally got some of the cherry, the whole bite, hazelnut, dark chocolate, ice cream, all together, it was the most delicious dessert.

I have never, NEVER, eaten anywhere so delicious in my life. I have had a lot of food, I'm fat, so there is proof. Domenica however, will forever be a memory for me, being the first fine dining experience I have ever had, and everything will be compared to it from now on.

Bottom Line - I will never ever ever go to this hospital again, they have no clue what to do or how to handle an emergency situation.  I wouldnt take my dying sister there - i would drive a half hour out of the way just to avoid them - they would leave her rot in the waiting room.  I cannot warn you enough - stay away - Paoli Hospital is down the street (ive never been there but it cant be any worse), or if your in that area, take a road trip to Einstein - apparently if you go there all the time, you have no idea what a real emergenccy room is like - in and out in 45 mins tops unless theres a situation that requires an overnight stay.  The staff is friendly - even when they answer the phone, you can hear them smile at Einstein - I called there today to give my information and they are MISERABLE over at Bryn Mawr - I don't know man, you think the ritzy area they are in, the people wouldnt stand for it; guess not!

Rybrew is really fun. Has some outdoor seating and a shuffle board upstairs. Draught and can beer selections- huge variety. Great paninis, other sandwiches, and salads (similar to sister restaurant Rybread). Ice cream. Recommend as a relaxed and engaging place for a casual lunch or dinner with friends.

I went to this location on two different occasions. The first was a pleasant experience, fast, kind, smart, and cheaper than expected 5/5 stars. The second occasion is why I am writing this review. I came in to get an estimate on new wheel bearings. After an inspection they said it was going to be 1311.90 to replace them. They did not know that I had replaced the wheel bearings in my previous car myself. It costs a max of about 300$ to do the same job. I went ahead and got the brake pads and rotors replaced but now I'm getting those checked out because I'm 90% sure I didn't need them. Do your research before coming here or they will rob you blind. I highly recommend the Meineke on Madison. I showed them the estimate and they busted out laughing.

Went there for a Father's Day breakfast, outstanding little gem in Skippack.  Very open seating, they could use a few more bigger tables, sitting five was a little tight.  All five meals were delicious, French toast was light and fluffy, thick cut wonderful flavored bacon, excellent chocolate chip pancakes, the Hawaiian waffle with fresh strawberries and pineapple and the coconut cream sauce was a sweet treat for my wife, I had the flaming pig omelette which was spicy and delicious and the home fries were outstanding. Service was excellent and the prices were very fair. Absolute go to again if you're in the area.

Stopped by for a quick bite and was very pleasantly surprised with an outstanding meal.  Waffles made of cornbread? Fabulous!  Pulled pork on the macaroni and cheese on the waffle? Even better.  Warm, comfortable dinner charm.  Definitely worth the stop.
One of the only holistic veterinarians in town. She's practically a miracle worker for aging pets.

As authentic as Vietnamese gets!  After relocating to South Jersey from Philadelphia over a year ago, I can say the food here beats the Vietnamese places in Philadelphia.  Located right by Inspira hospital in Woodbury it is so convenient for eat in or take out. Must try the chicken wings, spring rolls, and any of the pork dishes.  Outstanding!  Excellent service and very reasonable!

********IGA TRIED TO SELL ME SOME OLD MEAT********

Ok, let me address the fact that IGA has spruced up the market since it took over for Pathmark. The parking lot & the exit/entrance are a lot better than what Pathmark had.......but on a different note, variety is sparse. And the worse thing I can say is, they sell expired or close-to-expired products!

I have only been to the market twice since they originally opened. The first time, I said "ok, I think I may come back here". Although they didn't have most of the items that i usually would get from other markets, the prices were pretty fair. 
The issue came today. I drove to IGA instead of driving to Shoprite, since I knew it would be crowded. I was looking for smoked turkey for my cabbage, and found smoked turkey that looked old...well to my surprise, upon further inspection, I noticed that it had 2 price stickers (the thing with the barcode, price, description, and SELL BY DATE) on it. When I noticed it, my curiosity got the best of me and I proceeded to lift up the top sticker....and as soon as I did. I noticed the 2 different prices and the 2 different dates!!! Well needless to say, I immediately looked at all the others and they ALL had 2 stickers on them...So even tho the original sticker sell by date says it expires the end of November....now I'm inclined to believe that they may have rewrapped it and out later dates it it, ESPECIALLY since it looks old and grayish! 

Sorry IGA, I wanted to give you guys a try, but I doubt that I will be returning anytime soon.  And I will be contacting the store to speak with a manager.
A great drive thru burger shack with friendly service. Gotta try that homemade fry sauce. Always great with natural cut fries
The Dome was okay. The bathrooms are big, but tend to overflow and be messy. They only serve RC products, What the hell who drinks RC. If they decide to move the Rams no one will miss the Dome.

I wanted to give this place 2 stars but my husband reasoned with me - the place was clean, the hostess was friendly, and the waiter was fine. By giving the restaurant 3 stars, I am giving this place the benefit of the doubt. Perhaps we ordered the wrong dishes! We ordered meatball appetizer, shrimp pad Thai, and caramelized shrimp. 

Generally, everything we ordered lacked any kind of authentic taste. The meatball appetizer was good, but not mind-blowing. The shrimp pad Thai and caramelized shrimp tasted identical! One dish was supposed to be spicy and another one not so spicy, but both tasted exactly the same- bland. If I had to blindfold myself and try from each plate I would have assumed that I am eating the same thing - a flavorless shrimp. The prices for both entrees were exuberant for the quality of our meal.

While my husband thought that the service was ok, I didn't think so. The entrees were brought while we were still eating our appetizer, and by the time we were done with our appetizer the entrees were lukewarm. That's not a good service.

Pretty decent Marriott. 

Located off of Terminal B (walk across the walkway), so easy access to the airport, or they have a shuttle that runs ever ~20 minutes or so.

Check in was a breeze as I used their mobile check in feature. Our room was on the 9th floor, and faced I95. No noise came into that room from the outside at all! 

King sized bed, nice linens, spacious bathroom.

No free wifi unless you're an Elite Marriott Rewards member. But the room service (and/or restaurant menu) looked really good!

This place was a blessing in disguise for my recent trip to St. Louis. The trip has been one disappointment after another and finding out the only people here that like the out of towners are those in the car rental and hotel business. 

This was a recommendation by the hotel (Residence Inn) and I'm glad we finally went somewhere that had good service and decent food. 

The Ups: Service was great,the selection of the micro brews and the micro brews sampler platter. The soup of the day was the New England clam chowder. Surprisingly for being in the mid west this was very good. I would recommend that.

The Downs: I ordered the Adult Mac and Cheese and shocked at how fast the food made it out. The downfall of the entire night was the Mac and cheese seemed watery. As the cheese was watered down. The dish included chicken and bacon.  If the chicken were in little bigger chunks as with the bacon and the sauce not runny this would have been a 5 star dish. 

But based on the horrible experience in St. Louis (which I'll advise anyone from the east coast not to visit) this was the highlight. Unfortunately only got to it the last day.

I would not recommend this place. The food was terrible, from the wings to the Greek salad... The Greek salad I couldn't even eat, was just caked with feta cheese.  The wings were rubbery and drowning in teriyaki sauce. The chicken Parmesan sandwich was edible but not great. The only thing that was decent was $1.50 beer. The service wasn't bad however, I was charged two times on my bank account once for the amount of the check and once for the amount of the check plus the tip. When I called to have the situation rectified I was told by management that oh this happens all the time. Just wait a few days it'll fall off. After nearly a week the second charge finally was gone. Tying up $80 of my money for a horrible lunch is definitely unsatisfactory.

I was in New Orleans for a couple days for a conference and got a recommendation for Red Fish Grill from the guy I sat next to on the shuttle bus from the convention center back to the hotel.  

Since I wasn't really sure what I wanted to do for dinner that night, I ended up taking the recommendation and headed over to Red Fish after dropping stuff off in the hotel room.  I was seated and greeted by my waiter right away.  Prior to my main entree, a whole loaf of bread is brought out to your table with warm butter.  The bread was crusty on the outside and soft on the inside and still fresh-from-the oven warm.  I devoured half the loaf before realizing I still had a whole dinner to consume.  

I ended up ordering the pasta jambalaya and a side order of veggies of the day (which were grilled eggplant and tomatoes that day).  Everything tasted really good.  If I end up back in Nola, I'll prob try out their grilled redfish dish, which is their specialty.  Makes sense, since the place is named after it! =)

I was stuffed, and unfortunately didn't have room for dessert.  However their chocolate bread pudding sounded really good.  The table next to me ordered it and I couldn't help but stare in their general direction while slightly drooling at the sight of the bread pudding...  maybe next time

Guided and self guided tours with wine tasting are offered of the plantation and grounds. The wine tasting was nice but mediocre experience. However, they should allow those who pay for the self guided tour to be able to tour the main plantation house and not keep it closed for only the guided tours.

Have had quite a few massages done by Mandy. She is seriously the best. She always listens to my needs/areas that are bothering me and knows exactly how to make me feel 100% again. A few weeks ago I really injured my back in the gym and she was able to make me feel normal again after being in major pain for the previous few days. If you are looking for a massage therapist to keep returning to - book with Mandy!

Amazing French pastries!!  My husband is part French and spent time in France and he had no problem convincing me that this was great food!!  I could have eaten here every day of our vacation!!  The service was great and the croissants amazing!  Wish we had this place in Denver.  Great job!!

Summary: seamless experience, no issues or concerns, fair pricing, safe and reliable transport, would absolutely use again and highly recommend 

I could not have been more pleased and impressed by my experience with Happy Tails to get my new puppy from her breeder into my arms. I live in New York City but my breeder lives in Kentucky. Because of the many travel restrictions due to COVID, there were no non-stop flights between us, and I did not feel comfortable putting the pup on a connecting flight. When I started looking into ground transportation, my first stop was to look through the directory on International Pet and Animal Transportation Association (IPATA). My vet made it clear that the most legitimate and safest companies would be listed there. I reached out to a handful of companies, and Happy Tails not only got back to me first, but they did so with a clear price and detailed policies as well as flexibility on timing. They also reassured me that all COVID-related precautions would be taken with the transportation. Elaine at Happy Tails was indispensable as she worked tirelessly to arrange the transport within less than a week from when I first contacted the company. I was so grateful! As soon as the driver, Marko, was assigned, the communication was perfectly coordinated between everyone (Elaine, Marko, the breeder, me). Marko called two days before the trip to tell me his planned route and discuss things like feeding and potty breaks. Elaine called me the night before to answer any lingering questions. I felt tremendously well taken care of the entire time, and the absolute same was true for my pup. Throughout her drive from KY to NY, I received frequent updates (including GPS location and pictures) from Marko, and the pup arrived fed, pottied, and in good spirits! I did not think such a long ground journey on such short notice would be possible, let alone such a seamless and safe experience. I would absolutely use Happy Tails again -- without any hesitation! 

Attaching a picture of my new pup, who is named Bleecker, on the same night the Happy Tails driver dropped her off into her new home with me. Doesn't she look like a happy customer? :)

Delicious dinner, easy to make reservations online, good drinks! (Bloody Mary!!) 

It was so much good and so filling we just decided to pass out after. So happy we went here!

I had a delicious breakfast here at Star Bagel. I got their Early Bird breakfast sandwich (egg, cheese, and tomato) on an everything bagel along with a small iced coffee with a shot of peppermint. The prices here were very reasonable for food and AMAZING for fancy coffee drinks. A small iced coffee (which is the size of a medium anywhere else) was only $2.75 and adding flavor was just $0.60 more. The peppermint made it refreshing, creamy, and not too sweet. My bagel was piping hot and generously stacked with ingredients, and thankfully they put the tomato in between the eggs and cheese so it wouldn't make the bagel soggy - a pet peeve of mine at many breakfast places! 

I also got to try my friend's blended Snow Cap drink (like an iced cappuccino smoothie) which was so yummy.

Looking forward to returning to Star Bagel on my next Nashville trip! If you can't find a menu to read while you wait in line, try to get one from the check stand where they seem to pile up.

The is BY FAR the best BBQ that I've ever had!! The chicken was SO ultra tender it was falling off the bone. It was SOOOO moist!!! The flavor from the smoker was so delicious!!! Everything we got was wonderful!...we ordered: mac n 7 cheese, baked beans (not your ordinary baked beans...these were made with black beans also and had a beer flavor...very different and better than any I've ever had), smashed sweet potatoes, corn bread. Everything homemade. We are ordering again right now!! PLEASE try ASAP so you get hooked and help keep this place in business because there's nothing like it!!! Oh, and apparently the owner cooks in the smoker everyday even in zero degree weather! His passion for his cooking really shines through in the quality and taste of his food!

I pass this place all the time and I decided to give it a try today, bad idea,  I walked in and had to stand there for a few min because the sign says to wait to be seated, there were only 2 tables being occupied, and one waitress that needs a class in customer service, she acted like she had an attitude when she seated me,. I decided what I wanted to eat and had to sit there another 10-15 min before she came and took my order, she brings me my food, but I had no silverware, so I had to wait till she brought my silverware, the food was horrible I have never seen egg drip soup so thick and disgusting, it literally looked like snot with peas in it, the rice was tasteless, and the sweet and sour chicken had no taste. So needless to say I left just as hungry as I did when I walked in. I will never patronize Sky Dragon ever again.
Super hipster coffee place with tons of tables (with people who work in the area and students) so come here to people watch :-)

I had the All American Juicy Lucy with fries. I love that they use Tony's Chachere season on their fries and despite how juicy the burger was the bread didn't fall a part. The service wasn't the best, but I would definitely go back.
Not bad but I can't wait to get back to Kansas City for real BBQ chicken. Not enough smoke. Tasted par broiled.

Aldi is perfect for my needs. This neighborhood has poor supplementary grocery stores. Between corner stores and beer take-out shops, you can barely piece together a weeks worth of food. 
Aldi is the perfect combination and right balance of frugal shopping and quality foods. They have some name brand staples for your cravings and for quality assurance and they have some off-brand surprisingly high quality items to help keep some coin in your pocket.
It doesn't have everything EXACTLY how you'd like it or exactly the name brand you've become accustomed to, but it does well on selection for the price range.
Managers, cashiers and security are professional, helpful and friendly. 
Bring a quarter for a shopping cart(it WILL be returned), and a reusable shopping bag or be prepared to buy a few bags for cheap.  
If you have time, hit up the wine and spirits next door. They make a great one-two punch on my trips.

I stayed here for a few days mid-week while attending a conference at the convention center (conveniently located about a block away).

Location is great for downtown Tampa and the decor is standard for a large chain hotel.

But no free Internet?!?  Come on!  I stayed here in 2011 and I think in-room Internet is about as important as in-door plumbing.

Compare this to the Marriott Residence Inn right up the road, where for less money you get a kitchenette, Internet and extra space.

I will admit, while I didn't get to partake, the pool deck looked pretty special.

This is a big store with a huge impressive collection of most things you could expect to find in a head shop. I was in Reno for 4 days and needed some liquid for my vape. This store has a big selection of vape juices. The clerks left me alone and didn't hover around me, which was nice as I like to take my time to concentrate on my shopping so I can choose wisely. There was also liquor and other typical convenience-store fodder available. But again the size of this store was quite big and much more impressive than many of the little hole-in-the-wall smoke & liquor shops in the downtown area.

1 hour and 35 minutes for delivery.  But they sure do charge you card as quick as they can.

I hope this is useful to those wanting a good food experience.  Had to call back to see where the order was and they said it was in the oven.  Cheesesteaks in the oven?  They were right one was charcoaled when it arrived.  Onion rings not hot and just shoved in the bag not wrapped.  They said the order will be there in a less than ten minutes.  It was but after an hour and a half.  The young lady who took the order was not attentive and was slightly rude.  Utterly too long of a wait by any standard, utterly mediocre food at best and utterly bad customer service.

I wish it wasn't but it was.  Hope they learn from the folks with bad experiences.  Good luck won't be back, better elsewhere.

Quick and polite service! I stopped in for a lunchtime doughnut and was impressed with the size of the shop, cleanliness, and professionalism of those working. I had a blueberry cheesecake doughnut and the flavors were great: a different flavor profile from what I've had before and excellent doughnut taste. Can't wait to come back!

I'm normally not a fan of pineapple on pizza, but it is an excellent accompaniment to the artichoke, roasted garlic, and basil on Magazine's aphrodisiac pizza. The crust is very tasty as well. Since I've ordered the aphrodisiac 3 times in the past month or so, I decided to try one of their sandwiches tonight. The avocado chicken did not disappoint--fresh avocado, tomato, spinach, and grilled chicken topped with the perfect amount of melted mozzarella. Very pleased they've opened in the neighborhood!

I dropped my car off Saturday morning asking for an oil change and an estimate on the repair of my heater. Saturday night, I get a call saying the car is ready for pickup. I ask about the estimate. They only had the oil change noted, so we go through the heater symptoms again and are told they'd check it out. About 15-20 minutes later, another person calls and says the car is ready. We again ask about the heater. Again they know nothing about it. Since it's almost time for them to close, this guy says they'll take a look at it first thing Sunday morning. We agree. No phone call at all on Sunday. So I just called now on Monday morning. I'm told my oil change is finished. What about the estimate? What estimate? So 2 days and asked for an estimate 3 times and there's still not even a note that it needs to be done. I told the 4th guy nevermind. I'll take my car elsewhere to get my heater fixed.

This review is about the food and service at the ball park. The field is nice. But the food is nothing like you'd expect at the prices that are being charged.  And there are definitely not enough workers behind the counters.  I stood in line for 20 mins just to get some popcorn. Missed half of a half of the soccer game. Yes, the baseball field was converted to a soccer field.
Loved the pizza! Will be our new go-to pizza place and will be trying other menu items in the future. Decent price and great quality.

The place does not look like much from the outside but my Hubby and I decided to give it a try since it had mixed reviews on Yelp.
Pro's
-Nice inside and very clean 
-Not busy, will get service right away 
-Got the sushi for two and it was filling and delicious 
-the fish was fresh and they served very generous pieces 
Con's 
-dirty front door: this is the reason I didn't want to try it but inside is completely different. 
-while the sushi for 2 was filling and delicious, we thought $40 was too much considering that their competition is Terrayn and they have $25 for 56 pieces. 
- I got the tempura ice cream which was just ok. The whip cream and sprinkles was too much. 

The owner told is he is going to be doing all you can eat soon. We look forward to it. Will def go back

Went to the VIP party at "The Stick" in downtown Reno off of Sierra Street last night and WOW! Great sport bar with really good food and it has 24 large TV's going with all the sports and action out there. We will be coming back!

I wish I could give this facility less than one star. I visited out of state for a national tennis tournament, while I was there I got a pretty gnarly sunburn that consisted of rashes and blisters. Being the nearest urgent care in the area, this one was chosen. Strike one - the greeting receptionist, Nathan, was less than delightful. He had a snippy attitude and felt very condescending to talk to. The wait time to get in wasn't too bad at all, so I thought it might have been a good sign. Wrong. The first LPN that came into the room had taken an automated blood pressure and read out a reading that was different than the one that was documented on my visit summary. I'd described to her that despite lathering myself in SPF 70 sunscreen with a visor, I still get severe reactions from the sun. Some problems happened shortly with her key card and computer or something, so she had another nurse come in and briefed her on my situation ( I also mentioned key points with the sunscreen and length of exposure ). Strike two - This next nurse asked about my current medications, and I named my birth control pill Tri - sprintec ( norgestimate ) . It seemed she struggled finding it in the computer and just put in whatever sounded closest and called it good. What showed up in my visit summary was Trispec ( dextromethorphan guaifenesin ), a cough medication. Strike three - The doctor was in the room for probably a total of 2.5 minutes. Dr. Mersy had taken a look at my rashes and blisters and had no idea what was going on, and said all he could do was prescribe me a steroid cream to help with the itching and swelling. Which is what I expected as far as urgent care, but he couldn`t offer any elaboration on my situation and symptoms. Strike four - On my way being sent out by the same nurse that entered the wrong medication, she made a comment to me. "You should probably wear sunscreen in a sunny state like Arizona, dear." which told me she did not listen to me when I explained to her that I basically bathed in sunscreen before my matches.

Bottom line is, I would not recommend this urgent care to ANYONE. Some others seem to have had better experiences, unfortunately I was not able to vouch for that.

First time I went there great customer service and very friendly crew, extra helpful and wonderful experience. Today I went there and "Adam"  (blond hair with blond beard and blue eyes), was not "fun". If your trying to keep your good vibes skip him as your cashier, and skip the chit chit, come dressed in a suit and tie to buy from him, if no other choice lol jk. Adam, just be friendly to everyone, CUSTOMER service is important. I hope to see you again in better SPIRITS.

My favorite Mexican restaurant in the Tampa bay. The atmosphere is very authentic with decorations and Spanish music playing- I've even seen a real mariachi band play. Soccer or another sport is on TVs throughout the restaurant. Staff is helpful, prompt and friendly. The chips are homemade, complementary, and to die for! Very delicious, lots of options, and a reasonable price. Can't beat it!
Amazing service!! I loved the atmosphere and my waiter was so great. Food came quickly and hot.

We stopped in on a whim. I have to say this is the best suchi we've had in a very long time. We will be back for sure. We tried a variety of dishes: nigiri, hand rolls, long rolls, a deep fried fish thing. Everything was fantastic.
The bar got a little crowded but it was well worth it! Did the all you can eat. We had plenty of food served quickly. 5 stars for sure!

On a recommendation my wife and I tried this place. WHAT A GEM!!! The staff was super friendly and service was fast even though it was hopping. Let me say the burger was fantastic and cooked perfect medium rare!! We will be back and look forward to it!!!

The food, service, and overall experience were great! I had the margarita because I love margs and everyone was saying how I should try it--absolutely worth the hype! I also had the chicken, duck, and ribeye tacos and they were awesome and the perfect amount of food. The most expensive thing I got was the margarita, but other than that, prices are fair and affordable. Everyone was extremely accommodating and genuine from the moment we walked through the door. I will definitely go back.

Decent size D&B but the customer service was lacking!! Some servers were friendly and helpful and others weren't!! Food was decent.

New games are in and my kids racked up on gifts!! They were well occupied! 

This D&B is in a mall and has an internal and external entrance, so be careful with young kids!

While the food is fine, the overall condition is making me question how the food is prepared and under what conditions. If the guest bathroom... looks like this... I highly doubt this small place has a staff bathroom so now I'm wondering if the staff washes their hands before touching food?
Is the dish washer clean and up to grade honestly? Is the stove ever cleaned?
I know I refused to use the facilities just because the sink looks so bad. The decay has been so long it's literally eating the faucet... so let's wonder for how long has it been like this?

A new faucet is what.. $25 at Walmart? 
My meal with my husband was $26... and never again will we be back. Money is walking out of the door, the owner needs to prioritize when addressing the conditions, or maybe the next owner should prioritize the conditions?

Food was good. Service not so good. We went at 9:30am on a Friday. We were seated right away but didn't get any silverware or napkins just water for 15 minutes until a waitress came by to take our drink orders. They were out of all their beer which is what we wanted. We ordered our food and asked for hot sauce. Food did come out quickly but still no napkins, silverware or hot sauce. 5 minutes later we received our silverware (food is getting cold) ask for hot sauce again. After the meal was 2/3 finished, hot sauce comes out. We didn't even need it anymore at that point. I also witnessed another waitress getting angry at a bus boy in the middle of the dining room and pulled down her mask to raise her voice at him. The whole thing was super awkward. Food was good but service was weird and slow for it not being busy.

I love me some wang gang!! The drunken noodles and the drunken rice are my go to dishes!  They have great specials throughout the week, wine Wednesday's for example!! Their lettuce wraps are amazing as are the crab Rangoon! I stop in anytime  (or order out) when I'm in town!! They also have some creative cocktails on the menu that are worth a try.

I have been a customer here for 4 years. My pedicure yesterday was the worst I have ever had - and he injured my toe by scraping it with the buffer.  I had to come home and use antibiotic ointment and a bandage.  He was an older gentleman & was TERRIBLE. I paid $45 for a Volcano pedicure that wasn't worth $10.  I loved this place, but the quality is gone.
Delicious food and excellent service! I tried their Pelua which is an arepa with shredded beef and cheese... You won't be disappointed!
Fantastic bouquet of cookies for a child home from the hospital! The Emoji cookies lifted her spirits! Cookies were fresh tasting and perfect with a glass of milk.

My food tasted good, but we had a pretty terrible server. She repeated our orders back to us because there were some vegans amongst us and even after that, the order was still not correct. She even told us that when she brought the food and didn't even try to fix the mistake. There was also an ordeal when trying to pay because the menu had a lower price than their computer. It was a pretty irritating trip to Wild Eggs. The downtown location doesn't seem to struggle this hard.

The food was good, but not good enough to bring me back. Not to mention the price you pay for what you get...

The major disappointment of the evening was the cornmeal-crusted catfish which was to be served with stewed tomatoes & brussels sprouts. The catfish was completely flavorless & I wasn't even served a whole (or even a half!) of a brussels sprout... there were just a few brussels sprout leaves sprinkled on the plate. I get the portions are supposed to be small (our server suggested we order 2-3 plates per person) but COME ON... & this was one of the more (if not the most) expensive plates on the menu.

Came here on a Friday night with no rez and got seated downstairs. The ambiance of the restaurant was warm, cozy, and intimate. I love the byob, and if I remember correctly there was no corking fee. I was please with my house made pasta, and wood definitely return and recommend to friends!

I live close by so I can easily walk to this gym.  And for those who can't find parking, they just don't know the area, and don't know where to drive. Around the block is a whole street you can park at.... The locker room is nice and clean and they even have hair ties if you need one! Right after work the gym is extremely busy, I recommend the mornings which aren't so bad.  5:30 am is a good time to go, closer to 8 it picks up a little more but not like after work.  

On classes: I LOVE the Zumba classes and the instructor is amazing.  If you can make the lunch time CitySeries, it's probably one of the best workouts you'll EVER do. I recommend doing ALL of the 15 minute short workouts.  I'm not a big fan of Body Combat, and I'm trying their spinning class today. Spin is usually one of the first classes to fill up, so I'm surprised I even got a spot.

Definitely worth giving this place a shot. They have clean towels provided, lockers, tons of free classes to choose from that comes with a basic membership and a waterbed massage chair.

The hotel itself it non-assuming from the outside but clean and charming on the inside. The front desk staff was curt, but performed their jobs well. My only complaint is that the rooms are definitely noisy. Our room was on the highway (95) side of the hotel and you could hear the traffic all day and night. You could also pretty clearly hear conversations from the room that was adjoined to ours, including bathroom sounds. It's not high on the list of the worst or the best places I've stayed. If all you are looking for is a nice bed to come home to while you stay in Philly, this hotel should suffice.

Talk about discrimination to the fullest degree!!! If you're not white don't go!!! Horrible service, waited 10 minutes  before the waitress came to see if we wanted something to drink & take our orders.  Not attentive at all or friendly staff.

I crushed one of there philly steaks- onions with sharp.  Bread and meat were great and I would for sure visit again.  Wish they served Coke, but that's just me.

They take cash and credit, also a few places to sit .  Close to the I95 .

Curtis was so sweet with my niece who is a beginning skier. Showed her how to put the boots on and had her practice. Then showed a way to carry all her own equipment...which I rather appreciated. Great price for season rentals and such friendly service.

I was very disappointed by the food they had for lunch here. They did not have many options so I opted for a simple meal of chicken, rice, vegetables, and beans. However, it to my dismay when I walked over to the rice pot only to find it EMPTY. Due to this, I was forced to eat only chicken, beans, and some medley of vegetables they offered which ended up being cold. The only redeeming factor about this establishment was the worker at Pascual's bar who served me my chicken. He was very friendly, and made this dreadful meal a little more enjoyable. Overall, it is very clear this establishment has a lot to work on.

Robin, all I can say is AWESOME.  Based on reviews I decide to give you a try.  Within ten minutes of my phone call, you came and met my family.  We hopped in and went on a ride of a lifetime.  We learned about the city from a locals point of view, learned about the history, and were very entertained.  My children thought you were very funny with your sense of adventure.  When the tour was over, my children wanted to go on another one.  We all agreed, we could have gone for hours.  Thanks for being so accommodating.  Will definitely recommend you and this tour to everyone.

I wanted to take my very special best friend out for a very special birthday and Cake Bake did not disappoint. A hidden gem in Broad Ripple, Cake Bake is a gorgeous house outfitted with lights and flowers that make it feel like you are entering a very tasteful bridal shower.

Taking proper precautions with Corona, Cake Bake offered reduced capacity, additional outdoor seating, a QR code menu and required masks for both patrons and staff. 

The service was quick and personable. Our server was able to recommend cake and cocktails based on our preferences and took an interest in whether we enjoyed them or not. The birthday girl and I landed on the Raspberry Champagne cake and the Hibiscus Passion Cocktail. Both were amazing!

The cake was the perfect amount of sweet and tangy with the raspberry layers. The icing was even better, resembling more cool whip like texture than buttercream. The cocktail was very sweet and complimented the cake very well. It even had a hibiscus flower in it!

The price of this endeavor was a little high, but well worth it for the special occasion. I highly recommend Cake Bake for those looking to celebrate a special milestone or just have a super upscale dessert!
Best pancakes ever!! The pecan banana pancakes are a must have!!! I'm never eating pancakes again because no other pancakes could live up to the pecan banana pancakes !!!!!!

This morning I had breakfast with a companion. The first problem was the volume of the music, they refused, refused to lower the volume,the reason  of our request denied was the "owner" will not allow it. Strike One! My omelette was cold, Strike Two! The breakfast potatoes were luke warm and not crispy, Strike Three! Finally, Strike Four, one 3" diameter of sausage patty @$4.00, I think not. Gorgeous interiors, great adaptive reuse, great expensive market, high quality but very expensive. I wish this place some luck, I plan to likely not return, maybe once more but things better improve. When a customer asks to please lower the volume.... comply!

Both of my daughters did Movemakers Philly and the entire experience was nothing short of amazing.  Vince is so great with kids and what they learn from him both dance and life in general are extremely valuable lessons.  The structure of the program is so well thought out and Vince does a great job ensuring all kids participate and contribute.  To top it off the end of session performances are fantastic and exceeded any expectations we had.  I cannot say enough about the job they do with kids and the end result.  If you are considering any dance classes in Philadelphia, this is by far the best.
Stopped for a quick lunch. Clean restaurant, pleasant service, and very tasty food. I was nice to have a filling meal and not break the bank for once.

When I am in Millstadt, this is one of my favorite places to eat.  I get the egg drop soup and the special fried rice.  It is VERY good, and the prices are very reasonable.  I love that it is a family restaurant and I was waited on by the owners children.  They are cool kids.  It is nice to see kids willing and happy to help their parents.  It is right across the street from the school, so it is handy if I am there for a school function.

The meat is marinated and flavorful. Every piece of meat has the outside crisp edge it gets on the spit, every single piece. The hummus is near perfect, not whipped consistency or too thin.  All of their salads are very tasty and fresh. I got the steak shwarma with a couple falafel on the side. The falafel are 75 cents a piece for a large ball of perfectly done falafel.
