The bread is baked onsite and is the perfect thickness to retain all of the juices from the salads and tahini. Finally, cheap good Arabic food in CC.

So good. Had the mushroom appetizer, fried pickles and burger with egg. Everything was delicious. Tasted very fresh and homemade.  The place is very cozy and comfy.  The service was quick. Shane the server was excellent. i also like the doggie home decor.  Definitely will be coming back as the menu had quite a few interesting items.

Brief: Paid $19 for a my son's FIRST professional haircut for his birthday & it was choppy. 


In depth:
I called in to schedule an appointment, and the receptionist was polite, explaining that only walk-ins were acceptable at that time. That wasn't a big deal as I wasn't familiar with any of the stylists. I explained that this was my first time at Hollylocks and that I was taking my son for his first professional appointment. She added me to the waitlist.

When we walked in, it was evident that the salon was dedicated to children, as there was an abundance of toys in addition to a very relaxing, and welcoming kid-like atmosphere.

Our stylist didn't meet us too long after. She guided us to a chair nearby that faced a wall which had both mirror and TV mounted. 

She starts to shave away very... sloppily. Yes, his hair was long, but she didn't even create a clean guideline when starting with her 1, which a barber is supposed to do. How do I know? I went to cosmetology school, but I don't say that when I go to salons because I don't like stepping on stylists' toes. She changes from a 1 to a 2, then tries to fade with a 1.5, but she fails to create the smooth transition. Oh, she doesn't create a guide when cutting with the 2 either. Then, she starts to cut with shears, the top of his head. She tells me that she's going to cut finger length, but stylists know that finger length is near 3, maybe 4, but her finger length was closer to 2.5. 

I brought up my dissatisfaction with the fade and she excused it by blaming the shape of his head. My brother has a weirdly shaped head also, as well as two hair whorls, and his barber gives perfect fades, every time, for... guess how much? $20. I didn't want to take my son to the same barber because the environment is a bit intimidating, geared to young men and teenagers. 

Although I went to cosmology school, I was never good at cutting men's hair. I paid $19 today for a fade that does not fade, and an ugly, choppy haircut. I could have done this at home for free. 

The receptionist is well aware of who is good and who is not. I wish that she would have taken into consideration that this was my first time at this salon, and that it was my son's birthday haircut, in addition to first professional haircut. She knew that the stylist she sent me to was below mediocre, because that's how it works in a salon. You know who does an awesome job, and you know who does a horrible one. 

Thanks for making me pay $19 only to turn around and schedule an appointment with a real barber, and pay the same amount. Except this time, with tip.

The food is good though the service is not so good. One time I was there and ordered a panini along with two slices of pizza for my daughter. The pizza came out right away. I waited for the panini for almost a 1/2 hour and could not wait any longer and had to leave . The owner, Leo, was furious because he had started the order and now it would we wasted. He was not very polite though I chalked it up to be a "bad day." Several months later I gave it another chance. I asked Leo how long it would take to get a panini and two slices of pizza knowing I could not hang around as I had a meeting. He said 10 minutes. I again ordered two slices of pizza and the panini. Twenty minutes later the pizza was done though the panini wasn't even started. I told him I had to leave and he berated me (yelling actually) in front of other customers saying, "If you want fresh food you have to wait. You can't get it in five minutes." I tried to explain that I was waiting for 20 minutes and the reason I asked how long it would take to get my order was because I had a commitment. He just continued to yell louder and louder. I just turned around and walked out. I think the problem is that he does not have enough help. He was there alone so he had to answer the phone to take orders, accept payment, and then take care of walk-ins (like me). There are several other places, one within walking distance, that do not abuse their customers. I will choose them the next time.

The food was ok. The staff were rude and slow. We had shrimp remoulade which relatively bland. The turtle soup was great especially with sherry on top. 
We shared an eggplant crab for the main dish. It was beyond bland. 
The turtle soup tho, was amazing. 
Our server was very slow and rude.

I take back my last review. All that I loved about Bittercreek in the past seems to have changed. I just went back for the first time in maybe a year and the menu is much smaller and less interesting. The beer/wine/drink list is also less interesting. Looks like they're trying to focus on local Idaho beers and have dropped a lot of great stuff from Oregon and Washington. I got one of my old fave sandos - the Verde Chicken. The portion of chicken is MUCH smaller than it used to be. Also it didn't taste nearly as good. The fries also changed and are not as good. The service also sucked. This was the consensus of my entire table of five - not very good. Food was okay and the server was slow and didn't check on us very often. I will not be back to Bittercreek anytime soon. Why would you mess with such a good thing?? Consistency is gone and my favorite classic menu items are gone. No thanks. I will pine for the old Bittercreek.

Ok so now i have to speak out i just move into this place and it is a nitemare. Today was the end of it all. On the second floor their is poo on the window seal seriously the management of siegel suites and their corperate dont care about none of the tenanta senior or disabled or familys.

Great professional crew. Great pricing and totally pleased with the work. Will and his team are awesome and we would recommend them to anyone who's looking for a great team with a great price. Customer for life here.

This company is great and I only have positive things to say. After sitting for a few hours for another tow service to pick me up, my insurance company called a new service. Thank God it was Mr. Kitts service who was called. They let me know it was a slight delay in getting to me and I appreciated the call. 

Then my operator arrived and the first thing he did was apologize for the delay. He also took me to his truck and told me to get in so I could warm up. This wonderful young man made me comfortable and was very engaging. We had a great conversation from the moment he arrived until we reached the place where he parked my car. I tried to give him a little something for helping me and being so courteous, but he politely decline. 

I was given a business card to contact them in the future, and I definitely will.  This company is professional and efficient, and I can't say enough great things about them. 

Thank you for everything.

The brasserie is one of my favorite spots to grab some lunch and a few pints. They have a welcoming staff and a cool building. The people working are knowledgeable and usually have great suggestions. The building is kind of tucked away but still easy to find. We need more of these kind of businesses around mid town!
Our favorite go to diner. The food is always consistently good. Great specials and friendly staff.

Wow great stuff. My husband tried the oysters both Louisiana and Dauphin, he said both were good but he preferred the Louisiana. We both shared the crab claws appetizers - it had this great blend of flavors of mint, green onions, olive oils and vinegar maybe broth? We asked to keep the liquid after we ate the crab so that we could dip stuff in. We really enjoyed the shrimp roll and absolutely loved LOVED the Brussels sprouts. I know it seem crazy to go nuts over Brussels sprouts but man we're they good. If you're in New Orleans definitely go. We took a break visiting the WWII museum -- it's only a couple blocks away.  Oh and wait staff super nice and helpful

Echoing many of the prior reviews, Cherry St is definitely a local bar that seems to attract both older, blue collar, heartier folk exchanging war stories, as well as young hipsterish kids analyzing the biblical history LOST is based on.  Nonetheless, a "cheers" like atmosphere greets you where when you ask for a mixed drink a waitress as handsome as Carla will ask you if you want a double.

Decent beer selection with the standard big guys and handful of the usual suspect micros, served cold and at a decent price.

Had the hot pork sandwich, the waitress said they're known for it.  It was very good, esp the bread that was dipped in au jus.  Friend had the nachos, they were chips with shredded cheese on top...you're not coming here for the food unless its the roast beef or hot pork.  Problem was the food took FOREVER.  But...this really isn't the place to come for a quick dinner, a quick beer? Sure, but you'll probably end up staying longer than you thought.

Great atmosphere and the food was good. We did have to wait an hour and a half for our meal. Just as we got up to leave the manager came over and apologized. He then comped our whole meal which was very nice of him. We will give them another chance.

First impression: not as terrifying as I expected.  Of course, I was expecting to get stabbed.  Since that didn't happen, I had a delightful time.

The bar has a lot of dank, hidden by the fact that it's only illumited by a couple strands of christmas lights.  We enjoyed watching guard cat as he seems to take a liking to some of the patrons and tries to get a petting as they try to get the bartender's attention.

A buddy of mine heard that there was a courtyard in the back so they checked it out, but it was a lie.  Apparantly they don't like people stumbling around back there either (perhaps they don't want you to find the bodies?)

If you want to relax, drink cheap beer, get a hand massage, and get drunk with a bunch of local flavor and interesting types, this is a good place to go.

I am a sucker for Italian food, it's definitely my favorite cuisine. I like this place. It's really unique because it has a trolley car that you can eat inside. There are multiple levels so it has a lot of space but there is often a wait during common busy times (Friday/Saturday nights). This is a nicer restaurant so I wouldn't wear my PJs. It's very family friendly.

They bring out a complimentary loaf of bread and butter which is nice and tasted pretty good. Chicken Parmesan is my go-to so that's what I ordered and it was wonderful! It came with salad and ice cream. Spumoni ice cream is their signature item that comes with the meal but they also offer vanilla. The salad isn't much different than the salad you begin a meal with at other restaurants but it's not bad. I ordered sangria and it was great as well!

Perfect. Everything. The food felt like it was made specifically for us! We had southern fried chicken and Belgian waffle, Paul's waffle, and the Paul's parfait (wrong name). The chicken was great and not heavy. Pauls waffle comes with bacon and pecans in the batter! The butter and gravy were both amazing. Never had anything like that before. This cafe is hands down worth every penny. Our server was Paul (not the Paul from the menu) who had us laughing; playing back with our banter. Finally, the atmosphere was nice and clean. We sat outside and enjoyed the morning and delicious food.
Came here last night based off Yelp reviews. Again thanks Yelp this place is awesome Penne Chicken Alfredo pizza very good!

We had outstanding customer service from start to finish.  They were flexible with our drop off date/time and finished the vehicle repair ON TIME!  Their text updates were extremely helpful. The vehicle looked excellent when they were done.  Anthony was extremely helpful and professional.  I HOPE we don't need to see them again soon, but if we have another fender bender, we WILL go back to Caliber.

I'm a fan of Sheraton & Starwood.

The pool area is just outside of the Bar, I found this very convenient for taking my cocktail poolside and enjoying a cigar.

The Breakfast Buffet was very good and our server Jason was fantastic.

The complementary airport shuttle doesn't start until 5:AM, this made us use a taxi as our flight was boarding at 5:25 AM

Let me start off by saying I dont review often and I dont drink beer often either.  I drink only mixed drinks since I left Germany and have not found a beer to bring me back to the beer stage.....Until now!  The owners are the friendliest around, and I finally have a beer I can drink.  The only downside is that it isnt bottled so I can enjoy it at home.  Thanks for the friendly atmosphere SP.

Mike

These folks are the best vets in Nashville. If they don't have the capability to handle your problem, they will set you up in the meantime and recommend a specialist instead of jerking you around. 

They have the best front desk staff, the best techs and the best hours. Dr. Piper is who I usually see and I wish she could be my doctor too. She's delightful, has a gentle manner and spends ample time explaining things, no matter how busy she is. 

I rather like south Nashville, but I can see how some people might be put off by the location. My advice is suck it up because the inside is pristine (no weird veterinarian office smell) and the quality of care is excellent.

Worst supermarket in the area because they know there aren't any other supermarkets in the area. They seriously gouge you in the prices and they have a very small amount of health related foods. As a vegan, their vegetable section is pretty sad too. The staff is usually ok.

My mom had the key lime cookie and the chai latte. She enjoyed both! Said the chai had the perfect amount of ginger. And LOVED the cookie. I had the gluten free chocolate muffin (super soft and served warm!!) and a coffee. Recommend it all! Great atmosphere and decor as well.

I have yet to see a ramen place in Tucson that does ramen it as authentic and delicious as they do here! Very, VERY generous portions as well. I came here a few years ago when it barely opened and their menu was small but since then it has expanded and they even have vegan options! I get the vegan ramen with and sometimes without the crispy tofu but the BROTH... the broth is where it's at. That broth could probably bring back Michael Jackson from his grave and then go cure half the diseases we have. The flavor is just so spectacular and I know Gordon Ramsey would approve. Anyway, to say the least... the food here is amazing and you should try it. Also, SUPPORT LOCAL!

Don't let the fact that this establishment looks like a trendy upscale bar and lounge keep you from coming here for dinner. Their food is actually amazing. It only took me at least five years of coming to Sambuca to figure that out! 

My friends and I used to come here to hang out for drinks after dinner usually somewhere else in the Gulch. Sambuca has a great ambiance and amazing drinks. I loved their pomegranate martinis! One night we were hungry and got a few tapas/small plates and thought, man this is good food!

Fast forward a few years later and we're now all married. My husband and I decided to make a dinner reservation for one of our birthdays. We were blown away at how good the food was! My husband had a really amazing steak here. The live music was a nice added romantic feature. 

I would definitely say this place is worth checking out whether you are looking for a place to hang with friends or for a nice dinner.

Bottom line: The food quality salvaged the otherwise lackluster customer service in what I hope is a one-off experience.

My family and I received a mailer with the menu and some specials, and with nothing better for dinner, we decided to give this place a shot for the first time.  We got several different varieties of cheese steaks and a few orders of sides.  I approach a menu in the same way a CPA approaches an audit, so I was thrilled with the variety that they offered.  When I called the order in, I was told that it would be ready in 30 minutes.  I live roughly five minutes from the store, so I left at the appropriate time and arrived on time.

Walking into the store, I was thrilled to see all of the Philly sports memorabilia (some of the menu items are even named after the teams) and noticed that it was incredibly clean.  It was fairly empty when I arrived, with only one table occupied, so I was a bit surprised when I was made to wait 3-5 minutes for a pleasant woman to come to the register to ring me up for the food.

(One quick aside about the pricing: On the menu we received, it proudly proclaims that there is a 5% discount when paying cash on dine-in and takeout orders.  I'm glad I caught that and brought the cash, because inside the store it also says that there is a $10 minimum and a $0.75 convenience fee on credit purchases.  This does not affect the assignment of stars or the content of my review in any way, but it is helpful to note if you are considering ordering from here -- pay cash!)

After being rung up (and told how much I saved paying with cash), I expected the food to be brought out to me with only a small delay.  No such luck.  The same woman brought the set of customers dining in their plated orders, saying that this was done special as it was their first time at the store (also saying that normally the orders are placed on the window).  I proceeded to wait a solid five minutes minimum before I was asked by the same woman to clarify a critical portion of the order (two of the sandwiches were staunchly similar, so I expressly said when placing the order what that difference was and that difference was verified over the phone).  The indication from that was that this order was not even remotely close to being done yet.  I saw a bag get placed in the back through the window and was hopeful.  I knew it was my order, as there was literally nobody else in the room.  I waited another five minutes before I was asked how long I was told on the phone and responding with 30 minutes.  I kept waiting, then a few minutes later I was told that I would've been offered a fountain drink had they "run out of lids."  Finally, a full 20 minutes after I arrived, a full 50 minutes after the order was placed, and after someone else had walked in, they finally had my order ready.  They were apologetic about the situation, but other than the fountain drink (which wasn't really offered, just the non-offer was explained away), no other customer recovery attempt was made.

When I got the food home, I was pleased with the food quality.  I remember overhearing in the store from the woman who was talking to the other seated customers how they slice the chicken down in store, and I wouldn't be surprised if that was true, as it sure tasted very good.  The sandwiches were "messy," according to one of my family members, but I liked the fact that there was a lot of meat to the sandwich that I got and everything seemed fresh.  I don't take pictures of food, but it was quite good and if I were reviewing this place on food alone, it'd get a much higher rating than this one carries.

Reading other reviews of this place, I'm incredibly hopeful that this is a fluke, but in that shopping center, next to several other shopping centers, near other storefronts with stalwarts who have been there for years and where food is of great quality, you need something to set you apart.  Unfortunately, the customer experience I had was that differentiating factor for this store; at its neighbors, the customer experience is as tight of a ship as its food.  First impressions are key -- they can make a customer loyal for life if they're positive and they can be difficult to recover from if they're not.  My first impression of the food was superb, but given that it was unfortunately tarnished by the hour it took before I could eat it, the only appropriate response for this store is, "Meh."

Very disappointing.    Waited over 20 minutes for food that never showed up. So disgusted that I just walked out.    My order was to go so I could see what was going on behind the counter.   They were very concerned about the large called in orders.  As they assembled them they placed them on the side to work on the next one.  All the while people who ordered in were getting their food.  The people with carry outs were ignored.      There was more people waiting them just me.

There are numerous ways to correct this problem.   Serve the people in the restaurant first.  There was no one there to pick up the big orders.   Work the orders in order, whether you are eating in or carrying out.   

This left me with a very bad taste in my month.   McAlisters is usually pretty good....  But only if you eat in or call in a large order.  Sorry guys there are more customer attentive restaurants out there.   You're off my list

Big meaty sandwich.   Friendly folks.   

I admit I haven't tried Pudge pt 1, but pt 2 was great!

It's a strip mall type place, the atmosphere isn't anything special, but no worries.   It was all about the food.   And the food was good.

I'd go back over and over and over.  And over.  :-)

I previously lived in Woodridge Apartments for over 2 years.  Ever since these apartments were sold by HSL to MEB this apartment complex has been going downhill.  The management did not fix the lighting problem with the pool for at least 8 months since they acquired it from HSL.  They are very reluctant to spend the money necessary to fix problems properly.  I filed complaints about the pool lighting and the lighting in areas of the complex and stairwells with code enforcement and section 8 and the apartment complex management then made slanderous and false allegations with section 8 getting me cut off from section 8 and then I just packed up the stuff I could carry and left the rest behind and left.  I would not recommend these apartments to anyone or any other apartment complex that MEB manages.  There are plenty of snakes in Arizona and walking snakes working in the management at Woodridge and at MEB.    DO NOT RENT IN ANY APARTMENT COMPLEX MANAGED BY "MEB".

Dinner on the hill started with a lemon martini which was delicious. I began the meal with the special of the night appetizer, seafood stuffed mushrooms. They were served in a red sauce with fresh basil, it was OK but with a white cream parmesean sauce, it would have killed!! The dinner salad had a really good house dressing but the red onions were way too bold (as they always are). The main entree was shrimp scampi. The shrimp were laid out side by side with a lemon slice and basil leaf between each. The sauce was very good, garlic and butter, how can you go wrong. This came with a side of pasta. The shrimp were good but way over done. Overall not bad but for the price, I expected my shrimp to be cook properly.

Went in and the owner Roy is an absolute ass... Doesn't deserve my business. Was wanting to purchase gift cards and his snot locker attitude was a deal breaker. Word of advice Roy, you have a salon in Land O Lakes florida. Not LA, not NYC, heck not even Tampa.

The food here is DISGUSTING!!!!!!!! One star because Yelp wouldn't let me give it negative stars.  I ordered ceviche. Ceviche is shrimp with FRESH veggies, lime, lemon, and orange juice. They put ketchup in it. I'm not kidding. I told the waiter it tastes like shrimp n ketchup. He assured me that it indeed was ketchup. GROSS!!!!!! Fajitas were repulsive. Couldn't chew the meat. STAY FAR AWAY!!!!!!! Do not read any other reviews. This is the only one you need.

The food at this restaurant is incredible. I come here often, as it's one of few restaurants near my office. Don't let the low-key appearance fool you. The food is unreal. The Tortellini Valentino is to die for. The buffalo chicken pizza is also amazing. I've had salads, wraps, pizza, and pastas here and have always been thrilled.

Best pizza in South Philly. We order from here so often. I seriously feel guilt-free eating this pizza because it's so light and has such a thin crust. They know what they're doing at this place! Only down is that it's cash only!

Great find!  I had the chicken tika masala and my wife had the ceviche. Both were flavorful and fresh tasting meals. Amidst all the hype in SB of the uber expensive, shi-shi fine dining, I think I will rethink my restaurants of choice. Great meal, great price.

I've had my eye on these apartments for quiet awhile now. Finally bit the bullet & got one. These units are GORGEOUS! I absolutely love this area. This is the 2nd 1st lake apartment I've been in, however this one far exceeds any of the rest! Matthew was AWESOME throughout the entire leasing process. I HIGHLY recommend Clearwater Creek and of course i recommend Matthew. He will definitely take care of you and make you feel comfortable.

Like many, I purchased a Groupon to get a reduced rate massage from Origina Salon.  Walking in, this place really looked classy (an Aveda salon) and I figured I'd be experiencing something quite serene.

Needless to say, that didn't quite happen.  My massage was ok.  Thank goodness I wasn't paying the full $80 fee.  Yikes!!  That's a higher priced massage in the first place, and for a just less than an hour, less than stellar rub down?  She wasn't a bad person.. I'm just sorry to say I won't be returning.

The massage was followed by a complimentary shampoo and blow dry.  It was a nice gesture.  The results.. they were just ok too!  And the woman doing it made a comment to another employee about how she was stuck there.. Sorry I contributed to the entrapment!  I could have blow-dried my hair and it would have probably looked similar.  Where's the heart in this salon??  The passion for aesthetics and body work?  This just isn't the place to go.

We went to Brittingham's for the fist time since the new owner and renovation. Understand that we had history and a fondness of the old Britt's. 

The renovated Britt's is a wide open design. Lots of air and outdoor dining availability. We sat inside.  

The menu was kinda small, but our party of 5 all found something to our liking. 

I had the Brittingham Burger. It was fine.  Fancy little house salad instead of fries (my choice). My son had the Smoky BBQ Chicken Sandwich. He enjoyed it. It was a little spicy. My daughter had the mussels appetizer. It came with a LOT of mussels!  She are them all, even though the sauce was very strong and buttery. My father had the Beef Stroganoff Pasta Bake special. He said he liked it a lot. And my wife had the Vegetable Curry. It was very spicy. 

So, in all. A nice place to visit on a warm spring evening. If you're expecting the old Britt's, be prepared... It's not the same. But it was a good meal. Good prices. And a good experience.

Probably the most mediocre bar you'll ever go to; not bad, but not mind-blowing.  Around a dozen beers on tap, but nothing original in the way of craft brews or imports.  Friendly servers, but not all that attentive.  Clean bar, but bland atmosphere.  Food definitely edible, but not spectacular; keep in mind it's a bar, not a restaurant.  I didn't really expect those sliders to be Kobe beef but places throw that word around way too much, frozen wagyu patties at best.  Nothing here stands out at all, no negatives, no positives; the even Steven of the bar world.  Good for groups on a Friday or Saturday night; plenty of room.
Best place for little kids and moms. Very clean, super friendly staff, good parking, safe location.

I'm still in the glow of my vacation road trip, so I gave it 4 stars - although it's really more like a 3.5. Nothing too special, just a place to sleep.

There are perks to this hotel such as the price ($90.00 a night, not bad comparing to other SB hotels), the room was large and had a refrigerator, microwave and DVD Player. You can rent newish DVD's from the front desk free of charge. They give you all kinds of complimentary samples and have coffee and juice at the front desk 24 hours a day.

What I did not enjoy was the location of the room, although it's not really their fault that our peace was disrupted all night long.  The room was in the back of the property and our back windows were right against an apartment complex where the people staying there threw a party with people drinking and making a lot of noise. Oh well.

I normally have a decent experience here but this time changed everything. Ordered two large concretes. Received two shakes with the wrong ingredients. Ok, I'll deal with it, oh boy was I in for a surprise. My vanilla concrete with chocolate syrup and whipped creme and cherry on top turned out to be a cherry milkshake. But the kicker is the cherries were added with the stems still on. Every other bite was a stem and every bite was stem pieces. I tried calling them twice with the number on the receipt and they wouldn't answer. The second concrete was supposed to be a chocolate with pecans and banana. It ended up being a chocolate shake with no banana. We threw both away. Ridiculous. Bye bye $14 and bye bye Freddy's.

It was awful! The staff was rude. The service guy literally shrugged his shoulders and walked away when something was pointed out with the vehicle. A man claiming to be part owner (later found out that was a lie) tried to solve the vehicle's issues by selling us a new car. So, rudeness, lying, and basically cheating. It could not get any worse. Will NEVER buy another Chevy/GM, will certainly not visit this dealership again. Awful.
If this place ever closes I'll riot. Best seafood in town. Best atmosphere. Best music. Great service. I've eaten my way through most of the menu and I'm never disappointed!

I'm always looking for great authentic Mexican food. This restaurant is by far the best I've had in a long time since moving here from Southern California. The wait wasn't too bad but I couldn't blame the guy because I think he was not only the owner but one of the only waiters besides one other woman. He was very accommodating still and never forgot about my fiancé and I even when it got busy. Will definitely go back again!

Hubby and I went there for lunch today. Being a New England gal, I went for the whole belly clams which were amazing. They were cooked perfectly and the portion size was just right. They were served with cole slaw (not too much mayo, the way I like it) and fries. Hubby had a burger which he said was one of the best he's had. His burger was served with fries and slaw. The food was definitely worth the price. Service was excellent, too. We will back!

Had a great lunch with my family. We sat  outside with a view of the bay and causeway. Beautiful weather. We all ordered salads. I had the New York. Wonderfully cooked steak. Wonderful attentive service too. I'll go back anytime ...

Such a great place to eat lunch...we pulled up to the drab interior and hoped the reviews were right. They were right this place is great! The interior is interesting and homey feeling. We had the gumbo and the fried green tomatoes and they were delicious. I recommend this restaurant for a great place to eat some Cajun food and a great environment to hangout.

This ambiance of the restaurant is always nice. The food is ok, the fish although it's never full of flavor as I would like it to be, it always tastes fresh. The sides though are Super BORING! Broccoli, Mash Potatoes or Rice are sooo Blah!! In years past there used to be additional side options but the chain got rid of them!
Anyways, I like to come here occasionally for Sea Bass & a cocktail.
Went here last night and sat at the bar. I was THE only POC at the bar.
As I sat down, I could see the Bartender but he took a few minutes to even acknowledge me but he brought me a menu & took my drink order. My cocktail was brought to me with, no straw & no cocktail napkin and he walked off.
I don't care to drink directly from public glasses so I had to wait for him to return, after several minutes he returned, I asked for what I needed... and he literally, slides, damn near Threw a straw at me from across the bar. He then takes my food order. 
He returned and placed bread on the counter, from behind me... AND NEVER SPOKE TO ME AGAIN!
My food was brought out by a Server and I was Never asked if everything was Ok or if I needed ANYTHING else!
Later a female Bartender appears, there's a Non POC couple that comes in. She greets them (I didn't get that), offers to wipe down their area and proceeded to assist them. After making their drinks, she is nice enough to look my way, greet me & ask if I needed anything, so I ask if I could get a Togo box, she says Yes, walks away & then goes back to the couple to take their food order!
Meanwhile, another Non POC comes in any my original Bartender is FRONT & CENTER, present & eagerly awaiting to take their order, AND HE STILL HAS NOT SAID ISH TO ME!
I ask the female, once she's finished with the white couple, Of Course!! If I could get a Togo box! She brings it and then she comes back with my check!! No Asking for my telephone number for rewards & Never asking if I needed Anything else!! Oh & my $47 bill was paid with $100 & she brought me back all $5's & $1's!! Maybe All she had but did she bother to say anything! No!! So, my Casamigos Mule that I didn't finish, I poured into my plate & left!!! With a full piece of Sea Bass!! I'm 50+ years old & in my adult years I have Never left a restaurant without tipping 15-22%! Last night I left NOTHING & it saddens me!
I've been patronizing Bonefish restaurants since 2009 and this is absolutely the worst service I have ever received! Mission accomplished Bartenders!! This POC, will Never be back at this location in Indianapolis! The pettiness of people in this day and age! You'd think we would grow and move forward as this World ages but too many want to go Backwards! Sad!

Horrible Customer service for RV space rental unless you own a $20,000+ RV that comes in a "standard color".  They refused to rent us a space for our immaculate beautifully purple painted RV.  This was no beater, it is in perfect shape!  

Would you refuse to rent storage to a classic car that was painted purple? Are you also refusing to rent space to the new winnebagos that now come in all sorts of colors? It's a parking lot in LEMON VALLEY for gosh sakes, It's not the Taj Mahal.  Get over your snobby self!!!

Well this was our first try at a breakout room. The husband chose kidnapped.  Which turned out to be the hardest room.  Needless to say we didn't get out . We can't wait to come try again. We will try one of the other rooms next time and bring some friends.

Joe's is a Philly institution (at least for the Center City office crowd).   The pizza, conveniently sold by the slice, is reliably decent.   Because they rewarm the slices in the pizza oven, you are unlikely to end up with a soggy mess (and who wants pizza sauce on their office duds).

Joe's pizza is relatively thin-crusted and the sauce-cheese-crust ratio is o.k.   I prefer a more flavorful sauce and less cheese.   Indeed, the generous quantity of cheese produces the dreaded "oil slick" on the top of a slice (which must be sopped up with napkins).    For decent, quick, cheap eats, Joe's is a fine choice.

Best Mexican food in town, hands down. The people of Belleville have no idea how good they've got it. I just moved to Florida and I have found nothing down here that comes close. Great food and good prices. You can't beat the place!!!

Me and my wife made reservations at Jakers last Sunday for our anniversary. We made the reservations for 5:30pm. We walk in the door and they hand us a buzzer. Thought that was strange but went along with it for 25 minutes with 20 other people waiting as well ! We looked around and there were tables clean and available for customers to sit down to order their dinner. We finally asked the hostess that was running around ragged how long it would be and we finally were seated. We ordered crab stuffed mushrooms for an appetizer and I ordered surf and turf (prime rib and prawns). The waiter then told me they ran out of crab stuffed mushrooms. We said that's ok we will just eat the complimentary scones instead. Then 5 minutes later the waiter comes back by and told us they had run out of prime rib as well !! I was very upset and it ruined our anniversary dinner !! Also no manager came by to ask us how our meal was were I could have let them
know I was not happy ! This was unfortunately the first and last time I go to Jakers to eat dinner ! People always go with first impressions regardless of this was just a bad night or not but I am so disappointed and so done with this restaurant !!

While it was fun to find a Pittsburgh friendly bar in Nashville, the service here was absolutely awful. Of course if you had big boobs (which I do but I didn't need to pop them out to feel good about myself) you get served right away. The owner seemed friendly but kept pouring himself drinks when the rest of the bartenders were struggling to stay afloat. The bathrooms were by far the most disgusting I've ever seen. I hope they can make it in Nashville, but I don't know how they make money only serving one customer every 45 minutes.
Went twice. Not bad. The Boudin Ball is great!!! Other gumbo is ok.

We are not difficult to please, and this is not our first visit to a Cheesecake Factory. In fact, this is my first negative review EVER on Yelp. However, it's hard to describe how disappointing today's lunch visit was in this Cherry Hill Location. We were seated quickly, as the restaurant was not too crowded. Our waiter, Eric, was friendly when he took our drink order, and gave us plenty of time to study the menu. I did not realize that was probably because time apparently didn't matter to him. We made a simple order--Asian lettuce wrap apps, a macaroni and cheese burger (medium well), and a soup and salad. 

Eric left, and two other couples came in and were seated near us. We sat and waited for our appetizer, and time started ticking away. The appetizer took FOREVER to come out, and Eric apologized for the wait. We were fine with that. Then, it came time to wait for the meal. We waited and waited, and watched the other two couples receive their meals. They had burgers and salads too. Their burgers had so much meat that they looked like they did not fit on the bun. Their salads had lots of fresh looking veggies, and their burger came with an abundance of fries on the plate. Eric walked by several times, but never with any food for us. He apologized again for the wait, and left and came back, but still did not have our food. 

We had been in the restaurant an hour at this point. Eric walked by again, and I said, "any luck yet?" He said, "Yes, soon." I said, "I don't understand, those two couples came in and ordered long after we did, and are almost through with their food. We only ordered soup and salad and a burger. I don't understand the delay." 

Eric left, and the next time we saw him he had our food. I look at my husband's burger. It was half the size of the bun, and look like it was cooked to the point of being a hockey puck. There were no fries on the plate, and Eric said the fries will be right out. Eric lay down my stupid salad as well, the soup looks fabulous but the salad was nothing but greens tossed in a light dressing. I was surprised that there was not even a cucumber or tomato or a shredded piece of carrot in sight. 

My husband and I just looked at each other stunned, and started eating. He could barely chew his char-burnt burger that was supposed to be medium well. Several minutes later a table runner brought out a small cup of cold french fries.  

My husband and I were quiet the rest of the meal, and did not see Eric again for a while. No asking how the food was, no offers for refills, nothing. He finally showed up, and spoke just one word, "desserts?" My husband and I responded simultaneously with a somber "no". Eric quietly gave us our check in and we paid and left. To add insult to injury, The cloth table napkins had shed white lint all over my black sport, my husband's shirt, and his shorts.

Great lunch today! We ordered the mussels, Chicken Byron with sautéed spinach, garlic mashed potatoes and Caesar salad. The mussels were the best, hands down, that I've eaten in New Orleans. Extremely fresh and lots of fresh basil and garlic. The food and service was great. I've been here a few times since this location opened and they have improved vastly over earlier visits.

I would give no stars, if possible.  Came in with a couple of friends.  Two other groups of people followed after us, but the cashier had his eyes on us from the moment we walked in.  A friend of mine had no interest in buying beer, so she just hung out by the door, on her cell phone.  The cashier kept asking us, only us, asking if we needed help...following us around the tiny space, pretending to tidy up around us.  When we went to pay, he asked all three of us for our IDs, including my friend who hadn't touched or even looked at any beer.  We are all 23 years old with valid state IDs, but it's the principle.  I told him that only two of us were at the register with beer in hand, trying to pay and he said it was "state law".  I attempted to inquire further about said law, when he snatched the beers out of my hand and went to put them away.  I am not sure if it was because my friend was Muslim, or because we were all African American, or if it was because this poor cashier was upset for having gone bald so prematurely and was far below  the average height for an American male (can we say Napoleon complex?).  But we were definitely profiled and treated very poorly from the moment we walked in.  No worries, Fresh Grocer has a beer garden now :)

Had the pleasure of being tattooed by Anna at a tattoo expo in my home town. The ladies at Lucky Cat were both highly skilled and a lot of fun. Anna personally drew us two different but equally amazing phoenix designs in the matter a few minutes. We are so pleased we have even discussed the several hours of travel so that we can book her for future work.

Great place to catch indie movies. Small but good selection, plus great calendar of classics being screened. They have much better offerings in the food section than typical theaters. Also in a great area to catch a bite to eat before heading over to watch movies.

The onion rings. The onion rings. Oh my god, THE ONION RINGS. Nothing can prepare you for these crispy, crunchy, razor-thin, just-greasy-enough little salty pieces of heaven. Even if you aren't normally a fan of onion rings, you have got to try them at least once. And certainly if you're turned off by the usual thick-cut, overly-battered ones that end up falling apart, these will be a revelation to you. Do be advised: the two of us got a large order, because we love onion rings in general, and were sure a small wouldn't be enough to share without resentments. But the basket she brought out was gigantic, and even after freaking out over how amazing they were and being quite gluttonous (they arrived before the poboy), we had barely made a dent. I couldn't bare to let the rest go to waste, so we packed them to go, thinking to recrisp them later in the oven. But when we tried them straight out of the fridge that night, some sort of fried food miracle had apparently occurred - they were even crispier, and possibly even better than before.

And oh yeah, they serve poboys here too ;) We got the 12" French fry, cheddar cheese, and roast beef gravy poboy to split, and I guess it was because of all the fillings, but that thing was kind of a train wreck - tasty, but I think in the future I'd prefer not to have to eat a bunch of my sandwich in salad form, using a fork to get the fillings from where they'd fallen all over the paper wrapper. Other customers nearby with more modest poboys didn't have this problem, so next time I think I'll leave out the fries (which didn't add anything to write home about, anyway) and have a more manageable experience.
Absolutely amazing!!!! The freshest, most delicious food!! My new favorite place! Will definitely be back as often as possible!!! Delicious margaritas too!!!

Received a very young girl for my service then moved to a older lady because the you girl said she was not experienced enough.  The second lady seems to be on a rush. Very ruff and did not remove  the dead cuticles that needed to be removed.  I don't think I will go back or recommend. I did chose a more expensive pedicure then the basic. In the middle of painting the older lady stopped and a older man finished.  The salon was not busy me and one other customer. Not impressed!

Five star view, two star food.

We were down here to gawk at the car being pulled out of the Pacific. We decide to come here after, for lunch. 

Had the fish and chips. Three pieces that were about the size of a fish stick. The fish minus the batter was probably three ounces. $14

Service was ok.

Service really is excellent and very friendly, drinks are good and some vegan options. Hawaiian and tiki and sixties themed music added to the ambiance. Great place to visit regardless of whether or not you're a tikiphile.

This is the first time I tried Gelato and I'd say everyone must try this amazing treat!  I tried the peach and the Fior de late/cream both delicious.  Then I shared a coffee with Gelato and cream on top, heavenly!  

Customer Service was Great, Melinda explained the difference in the flavors and told me the popular flavors.  This is what motivated me to try the Affogato (expreso coffee with gelato).  Go there and see for yourself and if your there because of me make sure you tell MELINDA!

Fun place to get your WOD on.  Personally, I prefer to workout outdoors so I love the fact that most of the WOD's are on turf outside.  I also really like the Wodify program they provide that allows me to track my performance.  Very high tech.  Extremely clean bathrooms show that the owner and staff really care about this place.  They just added some new equipment too!  This place is really evolving into the best box the city of New Orleans has to offer.

I can see why people would love it.  I came during lunch on a weekday, it was our last day in town and near our hotel.  I would have loved to try the brunch or been here for live music, so next time!

The fried pickle slices are amazing.  The grits.. omg!

I wasn't in love with the fried chicken.  The bloody mary wasn't exciting.  

Service was great, the bar area is really nice, relaxing feel and very open.  Gives it a home feel, not stuffy or pretentious. 

If I lived here I'd come back!

I used to go here on the reg years ago. Went back for the first time in a while this weekend. I was surprised to find a few decent 99 cent records. Stuff used to be pretty expensive here. Prices seem to have gone down a bit. Pretty good selection of rock, country, and soul. I have to admit, though, my favorite thing about this place was the upstairs bathroom. A fairly private sanctuary off South St. I used it many times. I didn't use it last time but I did take a quick run upstairs and it looked to be in top form. I'm changing my review to 4 stars because of it.
Also, out front, there are always crates of records for cheap.
Best sushi place in the area. If you're looking for quality- go here. Been going here for 10+ years and it's better than any other new place in the area.

Whitfield's has a great ambiance and often has live music in the bar area. This chef-owned restaurant offers a wide variety of interesting entrees and delicious salads.  On Tuesday nights, most bottles of wine are half price!  Whitfield's has a nice outdoor patio and friendly waitstaff.  The bar area is cozy, but comfortable. You should definitely give this place a try.

Local unassuming restaurant in a strip mall, not your jam? Well, you are missing out! This place is wonderful!!! (yes, worth the 3 exclamation points) 

Enjoyed dinner here on a Friday night. The pita was warm and delicious. Started with the Fried Cauliflower and Eggplant. This dish was very tasty. Also ordered was the Steak Kabob which my husband said he would come back for again and again. I had the Sauteed Vegetable Plate and it was enough for three people. 

The Lebanesse Iced Tea and the Fresh Mint Lemonade would quench any thirst. Both very sweet, which we enjoyed. I imagine this Summer I will be craving that Lemonade (more like a slush). The Baklava was the perfect end to the meal.

Very happy we finally dined here!

Note: No alcohol served.
Conveniently located inside the Hyatt French Quarter, good selection of pastries and breakfast food. The staff is very friendly.

Zoe's is a great lunch spot. 

 I would describe it as a Greek-themed Panera Bread (with alcohol!). They have a great "pick two" option where you can pick a half sandwich and a salad or soup.

I recommend the Gruben. Although it is not the healthiest thing on the menu, it is freaking delicious. 

The Greek salad with grilled chicken is also really good.

Tip:  check-in on Yelp for 10% off

I would never use them again. My dryer will be down for 2 weeks before the part is repaired. The part came in on a Monday and they won't be able to install it until the following Monday. Their reason is they have a lot of clients. I suggest they hire more people and friendly staff who answer their phones. Giving a passive aggressive attitudes to clients means I won't be back.

Absolutely disgusted by the people who run this place. Everything falls apart, yet the rent continues to go up. My vent was clogged, called maintenance, they found a dead bird in it. Said it's probably been there for "years"... my washer broke, they put an order in for a part that did not fix the issue. My ceiling was leaking and Continues to... they painted over it and told me it wasn't. My dryer had to be replaced after a couple of months. My air conditioning wasn't working correctly for my first few months, resulting in 3 consecutive 300 dollar electric bills. Lastly, I wanted to add my significant other to my lease so we could move in together and get her daughter registered for school, they denied her over a class C misdemeanor that occurred shortly after her daughter was born. In the middle of a global pandemic, they refused to budge on the denial, making me look for another place to live, again in the middle of a pandemic. Management here does not give a damn about people and their lives. They only care about raising the rent in a place that is outdated and falling apart.
Food is real good, service not the same. Slow and rude. I would avoid this place if it seems busy when you get there.

So I heard about this place from a friend who lives in the area.  So while on vacation in New Orleans I knew that I  couldn't leave without eating here. I was so glad that I did however I wish that I hadn't waited until the day before I was leaving town. I ordered the gator and pork sauage poboy and it was the best poboy ever! The bread was perfect and there was plenty of meat and so delicious and huge. I was only able to eat half due to the fact that I ordered boudan balls that was great! I know when I return I will be eating here more than once.

I've rented from this location numerous times in the past two  years.  I'm a Enterprise Plus Gold-level member, but it's not obvious to me that I'm treated any differently from the other customers.  Since I know my way around the rental counter area I know how to get through the process quickly (use the kiosk!).  While the agents in the garage usually have a car pre-selected, they are happy to walk around with you to make sure you're satisfied with the vehicle.  They may offer you an upgrade, sometimes at no cost if you aren't already getting a discount from, say, AAA.  The staff in the office, if you have an issue to address upon returning the vehicle, can be challenging to deal with but most of the time the reason you're dealing with them is the real problem, so their attitude may be more of a perception than reality.  Returning the vehicle is a breeze, just drive into the garage, follow the Enterprise signs, put the vehicle in Park and yet another friendly agent will do a quick odometer reading, check for damage, help with luggage, and hand you a receipt on the spot.

On my most recent visit I was assisted by Marcus, a very friendly, polite, and courteous guy who persuaded me to accept an upgrade (at my expense, at the best discount he could offer), placing me in a premium class Hyundai Genesis.  It was a great car and was a surprisingly good value considering what one might have expected to pay.  I hope Marcus had a great birthday weekend with his mom in town for a visit!

As a loyal Enterprise customer who rents from this location regularly, I highly recommend it for very good customer service, generous deals from time to time, and the availability of quick service via the kiosk and at  the time of the return..

Been ordering 2 stuff from Apple website. One came on time with FedEx within 3 days, as planned on the tracking. The other on has been sent via UPS, and it's now 10 days without a single hope of it moving from the warehouse. It keeps getting scanned every morning " parcel moving to destination " but i really feel like it means " parcel on a treadmill at the warehouse, currently moving but not moving in the same time " LOL
Customer service inexistant, no answers. Kinda frustrating since the parcel is something like 9 km from home. Amazon and FedEx seem to deliver in time, I received everything i ordered in the delays.
I know that period is hard for everyone but we are all expecting stuff to work from home, medical devices, AC systems, and other. What i disrespect is not the delays, it's the lack of listening, willing to find solution and, above all, lying on tracking experience. The tracking system has become a total festival of random dates and scanned hours.

Looks small when you drive past but it's nice fitting for its size. Loooove their food. Very kid friendly and just enough food portion. I wish the queso bowl was a bit bigger because it's sooo good! Anyways, this restaurant never disappoints us. You order and get your food quickly!

You see Bobby Flay's name in the restaurant's name- you think you're going to get a top-notch burger that will blow your mind. Instead, you get a over-franchised, boring and, tasteless meat-patty on bread. Once again, seeing an Iron Chef's name, I was expecting an fun but adult atmosphere yet, when I walked in, my knees were almost taken out by the 5-year olds running around.
Great Doctor.  Did just what we needed and did great follow-up.  We were pleased with professionalism and clear explanations.

Breakfast visit (served 'til 10:30) for Breakfast Tacos and American Breakfast (eggs, bacon, nice hashbrown/veg medley) with a pancake adder were both tasty.  It was a bit pricey, but for an airport it was expected.  Would visit again.

bent my ID almost in half and claimed it was fake. i've been 21 for almost a year, about to turn 22. said "this is what our manager told us we have to do" yeah. bend my ID in half is definitely what your manager told you. now i have a bent ID and they will be paying for my new one.

Don't understand how this place could only have 2 stars, I have never had a bad cheese steak from here or any other tony Luke's for that matter. If there is a few people here yes it can take 10-15 minutes to get your order but what else do you expect from a place making your food fresh, if you want quick service go to McDonald's.

I have no idea what a Montreal style bagel is but the everything bagel with cream cheese is absolutely incredible. That's all I get but recommend that everyone try it. It's delicious. 

I agree with others that it's pricey. Bagel + coffee/tea ends up being $5. Which is more than i'd like to pay for a neighborhood place. I wish they had a frequent buyer card and gave discounts for bringing your own coffee mug. 

Originally gave this place 4 stars but reduced it to 3 because three times now I keep asking for an everything bagel but end up with whole wheat everything- huge difference and not in a good way.
Very typical american Chinese fare. Cooking times sometimes back up, but not by much.  Very straight forward menu and clean if shopworn kitchen. I like it

Aquatic Critter is the ONLY aquarium & tropical fish store to visit in the Nashville area. The best selection of fish and supplies, plus a knowledgeable and friendly staff on top of it. When I arrived in Nashville last year, I was running around to the stores that I found in the yellow pages, and was completely disappointed in what I found. Then, someone at work told me about Aquatic Critter, and I haven't had (or wanted) to go anywhere else since. They are the absolute best in the area.

We arrived 4:45 but unable  to snag seats for two. Maybe next time...have heard great things...make reservations for this very small venue. 

The Listening Room was recommended as an alternative - unfortunately it was closed on Sunday.  May be an option if you can not get in to Bluebird.

From the admission processing in the front lobby, that offers hot/cold fruity/protein drinks, baked goods and croissants, we were treated like family. The ward and surgery staff were role models for other hospitals on how to treat patients.

So glad to see this place again and its now closer to my house. Im hoping they will open 24hours soon. Right now they close at 10pm. I dont knownif it's me but the begniets seem to be getting smaller, definitely pricier over time. 
I grew up with morning call in Metairie. I would go clubbing in Fat City and end my night with my friends with some cafe at last and these powdery fluffy of fried dough. So its very nostalgic for me.
Now that they have relocated closer to City Park, I feared that it just wouldn't be the same. I was right, its not...but thats not a bad thing. 
Morning call has been given a rebirth. Newer, bigger, more accessible, brighter. I loved that they kept the arch and tried to keep some of the nuance of the old place. I also noticed that business seems to be much better now that they're located near the park. When I got here, there were 3 tour busses  parked outside and a huge line of people making to go orders.
Despite the lines, there was plenty of seating..even outdoors. We sat, greeted by a server, and promptly served or beverage and begneits. Still delicious as ever. I loved the seating outdoors. It has a great view of the street cars and the cemetery off at the distance. Just a good New Orleans vibe.
If you haven't been yet, check it out. If you've been to the old one, let me know what you think of the new one.
I believe it is still cash only. Not 100% so bring cash just in case.

My first time in and I feel right at home. Between the friendly staff and peaceful atmosphere you feel welcome and relaxed the minute you walk in the door. They have fun options as well as familiar staples. I really enjoyed my vanilla latte and the latte art was too cute. They even have a private room for meetings which I thought was a nice addition as lots of people like to work from coffee houses.

i just had sitar indian 15 min ago and it made me so full i can't be bothered with capitalizing words or spelling or much puncutation.  ughhhhhh.  ugggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

i cant even

This place is awful. It doesn't smell very good, the pizza is worse than it smells...honestly, I don't understand how they managed to mess up pizza. The employees aren't very nice; they became short with us while ordering. The atmosphere leaves much to be desired, as if they are in the middle of demolishing the place. We won't be coming back here. Ever.
My family comes here all of the time. We love it! Jimmy is the best! We all have dietary restrictions, and DT is always very good about changing the ingredients in their meals.
Don't trust their service department. Complete ripoff!  I was lied to about what my car needed and they got a lot of money out of me for unnecessary work. I will never go back. Go somewhere else!

Love, love, love POP!
I live within walking distance of Parts of Paris, and I truly appreciate the great food and the vibe that they cultivate here. Every time my wife and I come here, it feels like date night. The food is truly outstanding - French sans fluff. The bar is a destination in itself. These guys are very knowledgable, creative, and serious about their cocktails, but they have fun with it. I see a few reviews that ding POP for noise. I have never experienced excessive noise here, but I guess I can understand what folks are saying. This is not a coat-and-tie/pressed-duck-at-the-table French restaurant.  It is a quaint, cool Safety Harbor joint serving delicious, approachable French fare. If noise is an issue on a Friday or Saturday night, try the sidewalk seating out front. This place is definitely worth an hour or two of your time on your next outing.

the food is very good and authentic, especially the soup dumplings and spicy cucumber. i've been here about 5 times and they've been very consistent except for once when we ordered a serving of pork soup dumplings and every single on was broken. they still tasted good however i would definitely come back.
I was a walk in.  No wait, clean, friendly staff. Then I got the shock of my life... Only $15 for a gel manicure? WHAT?  I'll be back!

Let me be clear: this was the best thai in New Orleans. Since we live nearby we came here all the time. So, why the bad rating? What we loved (in addition to the food and cocktails) was the ability to sit outdoors. They had wonderful tables on the sidewalk. We LOVED this. Not only was the weather great 9 months out of the year for outdoor eating, but it was much quieter than inside. 

Recently, however, they got rid of the tables. I don't know why, but we haven't been back since. Until that changes, they have lost us as customers.

I absolutely love this place! The house is very quaint and the eight rooms are beautifully decorated with Americana, primitives, antiques, and vintage items. The have a large selection of pewter, yelloware and redware pottery, primitive lighting, linens, botanicals, pottery, painted items, quality primitive furniture, and hooked pillow and rugs.

Most of the items are ONE OF A KIND PIECES created by true folk artists, which includes holiday items, pottery, pincushions, and more! 

Another thing I love about the house is that the inventory is forever changing and they have a great selection of holiday items. There is always something new to look at! Every time I shop at Old House in Hog Hollow I find something I can't live without. 

And don't miss the garage sale on the property in early May and the antique sale in early October - lots of treasures to be found. 

And of course the women working there are wonderful - very friendly and helpful.
I got the cut from Nina. she did a pretty good job for what I have asked. I am trying out this salon for the first time and kept it simple with the hair style. I am happy with the results.

What a wonderful restaurant and the service is fabulous!  

We live in Naples FL and were visiting in Philly. We started our meal with delicious fresh oysters and then ordered the NY Strip and Fingerling Potatoes. The steak was done to perfection. I'm learning that bone-in steaks have the most flavor. The atmosphere is very comforting- the way a steakhouse should be. We didn't order seafood for an entree but there seemed to be a good selection. The service was impeccable and Briana our server was awesome. Would definitely return!

I forgot they have a location in Santa Barbara. The one in SF is amazing and this place is just as good. You can't find too many deep dish places that rival Chicago and here you have one. Takes a while but worth the wait. Small can easily feed three.

On my "Visits to the Ballparks of America Tour," I recently visited Busch Stadium and quite enjoyed myself.  This stadium had all of the normal, modern amenities but there wasn't anything terribly unique about it, save for the view of the Arch that you get from certain seats and places in the stadium.  

I like stadiums that have things for people to do.  Yes, I like watching baseball games, but if it's two teams I don't necessarily care about, I like to be able to wander around and find things to do.  Unfortunately, Busch Stadium doesn't have much of that happening.  Just a lot of food and beer.

Not even any unique food choices, either.  Some ballparks have local specialties (Philly Cheesesteaks, Clam Chowdah, Elotes, etc.) and apparently Busch Stadium does not.  Only a ton of Budweiser brand beer.  

Tickets are at least cheap enough (this is still a stadium that offers standing-room only tickets and cheaply priced bleacher seats) that you can wander around with your cheap ticket and find another place to sit and no one will kick you out.

Glad I had the opportunity to go and, since it's so close, will probably be back again but this stadium isn't really anything special.
This salon is the best in the area.I think Tyler is the best stylist there.Really great place !
The absolute very best tomatoe pie! Great Italian rolls & good bakery/deli! Staff very friendly. Decent selection of Italian goodies in terms of frozen pastas & canned goods.

The food is mediocre (after two visits).  The service was horrific.  7:00 reservations resulted in 7:40 seats.  The manager did not apologize, but rather blamed patrons who didn't leave fast enough.  This is a huge restaurant; that's a ridiculous excuse.  The waitress said it was always like that.  She was clearly overworked, with way too many tables.  Our service was comically terrible as a result.

I would suggest out-of-towners avoid in favor of a place like BT or Sideberns.  Or for a real Tampa culinary experience, go to one of many good Cuban restaurants.  Columbia is, at least presently, a gimmicky, fool-you-with-the-atmosphere restaurant.
I am in California and ordered yarn (and pattern) by phone after seeing item on Ravelry.  Yarn was sent promptly and arrived quickly in perfect condition.  I am impressed.

Came here on a Thursday night with my 3 young children. Everyone talks about how bad bourbon st. is for kids but I took a gamble to come here because I saw they had Jambalaya. When we got there we waited roughly 5 minutes before we were seated. They took us to the back of the restaurant, and sat us near the exiting door leading out onto Bourbon St. Which I didnt mind because they were playing some nice upbeat Jazz music. The restaurant was very clean and service was great. Will come here again when I visit in the future.
The coffee and service are solid, but the wifi is cripplingly slow. It's not possible to do anything requiring internet access. I cannot recommend it.

He walked me through the isles to pick out the right material for my project and even helped me figure out measurements and then cut the wood to size. Plus he helped me pick out the correct hardware. So grateful for this place!

I also like their freshly ground peanut butter and their wine and beer selection is good. 

They regularly have what I think is good wine on sale for like $3.99. I know the owner has said that they have the cheapest wine and beer prices around. Not sure if it's true, but it's pretty good.

The employees are super nice and helpful, which is great.

Glorianna is such a genuine, kind soul and really cares about her work. I love that she doesn't use any harsh chemicals. I was really impressed by my manicure and pedicure, and I'm excited to try out a facial next time.

If I could give this place zero stars I would. I would NEVER EVER recommend this apartment complex. 

I lived here for 10 months...the apartment was not ready when I arrived to move in, there is NO PARKING AT ALL, and the gates are ALWAYS BROKEN. 

Do not live here.

Cozy little cafe featuring tasty, substantial food and great staff located just across the street from Wash U - such a great combination! I went here a couple times and during both was very satisfied. The first time around I ordered just a hot tea and was pleased with their large variety of options. My friend ordered a chai latte and while I thought it was a little on the sweet side when I tried it, it still had flavor and was respectable. We ended up sitting and chatting for a while and didn't seem to disturb those studying around us, although the noise level seemed quite low and we could hear each other clearly.

The second time I went I was looking for something a little more substantial and got the Banf sandwich, which although a little too buttery when held (left a lot of oil on my hands) was absolutely delicious, chock full of tasty things and held together on sturdy toasted bread. The staff were very helpful with giving me recommendations of the different sandwiches, with the vegetarian staff member I talked to recommending her personal favorites then noting which other sandwiches were popular with customers, which I really appreciated.

For students and staff of Wash U alike I highly recommend Kayak's, whether you are just looking for something to drink or are in the mood for something larger. Again a big shoutout to the friendly knowledgeable staff!

How long before "epic" becomes the next "extreme" -- or, for that matter, before "bowl" becomes the next "chipotle"? Taking it as a case study in planned obsolescence, I couldn't resist paying at least one visit to Epic Bowl. If you want to go, go now, because it's clearly meant to see 2020 as much as Chess King was meant to see 2011. (I also went because Backyard Bowls -- the "original" -- mysteriously decided to close on July 4th.)

Into these bowls -- actually oversized paper cups, unless you deliberately get it for "there" -- go, basically, a smoothie, then another layer of the unblended constituent fruits of a smoothie, then a pile of crunchy stuff, then maybe a drizzle of something even sweeter than all that. Swirl this all together, and you get the tastes of strawberry, mango, coconut, granola, honey, and surely açaí or something all in one bite. This tastes exactly as you'd expect: just fine and dandy, unless you were looking for something culinarily innovative. Hence the common criticism that "I could make this at home." Sure, but you really intend to routinely do all that buying, blending, and chopping? No you don't. (Read: I don't.)

So I do like a good bowl, but where does it fit into human eating habits? They feel way too heavy for breakfast and totally inappropriate any later. I get the sense that maybe 22-year-old girls somehow scarf them between meals and try not to think about the consequences. ("But it's fruit!") I especially don't see myself paying nearly ten bucks a pop -- of which how many pay for Paseo Nuevo rent? Seven? -- to try to figure it out among Santa Barbara's worst-dressed. I realize you own cargo shorts and flip-flops, people, but this... this is public!

(NOTE: I find it somehow poetic that, across from Epic Bowl, you'll find a frost-your-own-cupcake shop. Vegas odds on which establishment the caprice of fashion will wash away first?)

The seafood gumbo was fantastic, the best that I have ever had!  It is great enjoyed slowly, letting the tongue savor all the complex flavors.  I had an Abita Turbodog with the gumbo, and as another reviewer stated, "Perfect".  In addition, we had the roast beef po' boy and found it to be sensational, as well.

Chef Ron visited with us at our table, really made us feel welcome.  This is a must visit spot for me now, when I am in New Orleans.

First of all, my husband and I agree that the burnt ends were the best we have EVER had and we eat a lot of barbecue in a lot of locations!!  Fire and ice pickles are good but couldn't begin to finish them.  I personally had the BBQ salad and it was good but I wouldn't get it again because I will be getting the burnt ends in the future.  I am afraid that I won't want to get anything else but would like to try some other things also.

I love when you order and they tell you half hour forty five minutes and the food comes in like 20. 5 stars for that, even though I had to scurry downstairs to answer the door. What can I tell you, I  am a huge fan of TIffin, with that said, Ekta is closer, and from what I hear the chef  is from Tiffin so how could I go wrong, not to mention that their food is a tad cheaper which I can feel less guilty for ordering indian at least once a week for my chicken tikka addict daughter. Which was fabulous. The naan hot and soft and perfect. Not sure I want to fully abandon Tiffin but hey I can spread the love equally. Just another reason to love living and never leaving our  lovely neighborhood.

We visited Clearwater for the first time and came here first. Food was average. I was expecting much better seafood. The hostess looked like she was having a social hour and ignored us for a few minutes yet finally seated us. The waiter was great. If you want higher quality seafood I would try some where else but if you like bar food seafood you may enjoy this place.

Fantastic December 26th meal.  Finally back to normal.  The meal was a hit and I'm happy I tried it one more time .  Keep the quality and your Chefs happy......we are done.    Nothing right with our order. How can you stay in business

Service was actually great tonight.  I was nervous after reading the reviews.  But the service was friendly and attentive. 

A large party, we started with baked brie which was to die and the harvest board which was good.   Even on a Saturday they had happy hour prices on wine until 7pm

Recommend the beef stew. The chicken pot pie is not creamy.  Its more like good chicken soup. But the huge puff pastry they serve it under is tasty.

Finished up with chocolate ravioli and pumpkin bread pudding.  Both good. TVs had the Cardinals game on which might ve upset of different crowd.  

Not cheap but a really good experience!   We'll be back.

Nicole assisted me in finding a place to rent while moving to the Philadelphia area. She was very informative and personable. Any questions I had she definitely answered in a very timely manner. If you are looking for a property to rent, surely give this company a chance and you won't regret it.

I wandered around the Westshore District looking for a place to have lunch and randomly settled on Mitchell's Fish Market. They had a Lobster-Shrimp Roll on the menu in the shadow box out front that caught my eye. I walked in and was immediately greeted by several friendly hostesses. I told them I'm fine sitting at the bar and they directed me in the right direction. I pulled up my stool and was greeted by the bartender Ashlee very promptly. I informed her I'm ready to order whenever she has time; that's when my eye caught sight of the lunch Prix Fixe menu. You get your choice of a salad/soup/app and choice of main course for only $14.95. Great deal, I'm sold! I order the Lobster Bisque (for +$1) and the Crab Cake Sandwich on a Pretzel Bun. I could tell Ashlee was busy, as she was taking tables and holding down the bar, but she collaborated with her teammates to make sure service went flawless. I received my bread and butter before my soup arrived. The soup came out nice and hot, which seems easy enough but you might be surprised how often places get that wrong. The bisque was delicious; the flavor was rich and powerful, the texture was silky and there was a hint of sherry and the sea in the background. The Crab Cake sandwich quickly followed, and Ashlee remembered to put the remoulade sauce ots. I was pleasantly surprised the Crab Cake was more crab than cake, some places make them with too much breadcrumb in the mix. The pretzel bun was soft and tasty but it seemed like the dough wasn't really pretzel dough. Overall, I would definitely order it again. I cashed out quickly and was in and out in around 35 minutes. Great experience, I'll see you all again.
This is the best vegan food I've ever had. I'm vegan and my boyfriend isn't but he loves this place. The staff is so awesome and kind. New regulars!! Dank af

Returned for lunch this weekend.

Was told by the waiter that they didn't have the lamb--they only had pork or chicken.

I love the decor and ambiance, a good place to go if you don't want that insanely crowded bar scene with long bathroom lines and lung-squishing trips to the bar.  Don't have to worry about the meathead trying to get in your face because you bumped into his girl or worse yet.. him.  This place makes you never want to go back to LM again!

this was some of the best Chinese food that Ive had in a minute. I would definitely eat here again whenever I'm in PA.
The service was fast. Servers were nice. Food was delicious and plentiful.

This place gives a different take on burritos and their menu items are very unique. It's not too expensive and their burritos are pretty stuffed. I love French fries so I of course love that they put French fries inside their burritos. Their fries are very crispy and have a good seasoned taste. We ordered for pick up and service was quick and friendly. It's definitely not the type of food you see on the regular and worth a try!

This is just my first visit to M3 and we didn't eat only drinks at the bar.  But our bartender was fantastic with us. She made sure to pay attention to us and never let us sit without a full glass even though it was a busy Fri night and was quite busy. I have just moved to the area and happen to be barley a block away. I will be happy to review the food soon, I just got to get my butt in a chair there lol!

Solid Mexican chips-and-salsa place. I really enjoy the atmosphere, very friendly and consistent service. Food is above average, salsa is good, and margaritas don't disappoint either. Glad to have them nearby!

I wanted to miss my flight home and stay here forever. Best meatballs in the world.  Nothing more to say.

Oh wait, they've got frozen sfogliatelle!!!!!!!!!!!!

This place is sooo good!!! Pizza was amazing. Do the lunch special!!! Servers were amazing and very helpful.

I love TL Tailor so much! I think their seamstress is the best that you will ever find anywhere, at least in a 50mi radius and will only trust all my alterations to her. I'm new to area and it's hard to know who you can trust your animal children with, they were compassionate and my dog wagged his tail when I took him back to have the Cath removed, I would take him back there in a minute and would highly refer them.
